verses.sanskrit: शिवं शान्तं तमजरं अमरं विश्वपूजितम् । सदाशिवं नमस्यामि भक्त्याऽहं शरणं गतः ॥
verses.transliteration: śivaṃ śāntaṃ tamajaram amaraṃ viśvapūjitam | sadāśivaṃ namasyāmi bhaktyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
verses.translation: The Auspicious, the Peaceful, the Undying, the Immortal, worshipped by all — I bow to Sadashiva with devotion, seeking his refuge.
verses.hindi: शिव — जो शांत हैं, अजर हैं, अमर हैं, समस्त विश्व द्वारा पूजित हैं — उन सदाशिव को मैं भक्तिपूर्वक नमस्कार करता हूँ और उनकी शरण लेता हूँ।
verses.commentary: Shiva's name means "the auspicious one" — not as euphemism but as metaphysics. Shiva is the one in whom dissolution (which appears terrible) is ultimately auspicious — because it clears the ground for renewal. "Shanta" (peaceful) — Shiva is the stillness that underlies all movement. "Ajara" (undying) — consciousness cannot age. The highest identity one can inhabit is Sadashiva — the ever-auspicious awareness itself.

verses.sanskrit: एको देवः केशवो वा शिवो वा हंसो वा सूर्यो वा सर्वश्रेष्ठः । अर्चन्त्येनं विप्रा होतारश्च याजमानाश्च सर्वे ॥
verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ keśavo vā śivo vā haṃso vā sūryo vā sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ | arcantyenaṃ viprā hotāraśca yājanānāśca sarve ||
verses.translation: The one God — whether called Keshava (Vishnu) or Shiva or Hamsa (the Swan) or Surya (Sun) — is supreme. All Brahmins, priests, and sacrificers worship that one.
verses.hindi: एक ही देव — चाहे केशव हो, शिव हो, हंस हो या सूर्य हो — सर्वश्रेष्ठ है। सभी विप्र, होता और यजमान उसी की पूजा करते हैं।
verses.commentary: Remarkably, the Shiva Purana — a text devoted to Shiva — declares that Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, and Hamsa are all the same one God. This Vedantic inclusivism is characteristic of the great Puranas: each glorifies its own deity as supreme while simultaneously acknowledging the non-difference of all divine names. The wise worshipper does not fight over names — they see through the many names to the one reality.
verses.wordMeaning: Remarkably, the Shiva Purana — a text devoted to Shiva — declares that Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, and Hamsa are all the same one God. verses.sanskrit: मृत्पिण्ड इव तैलाभं शिवज्ञानं प्रदीपवत् । तेनाऽऽदर्शो हृदयो मे भस्मीभूतं विलोकयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛtpiṇḍa iva tailābhaṃ śivajñānaṃ pradīpavat | tenā''darśo hṛdayo me bhasmībhūtaṃ vilokayet ||
verses.translation: The knowledge of Shiva is like a lamp to a clay pot soaked in oil — my heart, becoming a mirror through it, beholds the universe as ash.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञान तेल से तर मृत्पिण्ड (मिट्टी के बर्तन) के लिए दीपक के समान है — उससे मेरा हृदय आदर्श बनकर विश्व को भस्म रूप में देखता है।
verses.commentary: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). This is the Shaiva teaching on vairagya (dispassion): not that the world is destroyed, but that one's attachment to it is burned away. "Bhasmibhutam" — turned to ash — means the world is seen in its true nature: impermanent, insubstantial, and ultimately sacred as the play of Shiva.
verses.wordMeaning: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). verses.sanskrit: शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि । अतस्त्वामाराध्यां हरिहरविरिञ्चादिभिरपि प्रणन्तुं स्तोतुं वा कथमकृतपुण्यः प्रभवति ॥
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṃ na cedevaṃ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditumapi | atastvāmārādhyāṃ hariharaviriñcādibhirapi praṇantuṃ stotuṃ vā kathamakṛtapuṇyaḥ prabhavati ||
verses.translation: Shiva, joined with Shakti, has the power to create. Without her, the god cannot even stir. Therefore, how can one without merit worship you — praised even by Hari, Hara, and Brahma — or even address you?
verses.hindi: शिव, शक्ति से युक्त होने पर ही सृजन करने में सक्षम होते हैं। उसके बिना देव हिल भी नहीं सकते। इसलिए हरि, हर और ब्रह्मा द्वारा भी स्तुत तुम्हारी — पुण्यहीन व्यक्ति पूजा कैसे कर सकता है?
verses.commentary: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.

verses.sanskrit: नकारो भूमिरित्याहुर्मकारं वारि गीयते । शिकारस्तेज इत्याहुर्वकारो वायुरेव च । यकारोऽकाश इत्याहुः पञ्चाक्षरमिदं परम् ॥
verses.transliteration: nakāro bhūmirityāhurmakāraṃ vāri gīyate | śikārasteja ityāhurvakāro vāyureva ca | yakāro'kāśa ityāhuḥ pañcākṣaramidaṃ param ||
verses.translation: Na is earth, Ma is water, Shi is fire, Va is air, Ya is space — this five-syllable mantra is the supreme.
verses.hindi: न = पृथ्वी; म = जल; शि = अग्नि; व = वायु; य = आकाश — यह पाँच अक्षरों वाला पञ्चाक्षर मन्त्र परम है।
verses.commentary: The Panchakshara mantra "Namah Shivaya" is decoded as a cosmic map: each of its five syllables corresponds to one of the five elements (pancha bhuta) that compose physical reality. To chant this mantra is to acknowledge all five elements as Shiva — to see the divine in the ground under your feet (Na), the water you drink (Ma), the fire of your body (Shi), the breath (Va), and the space in which everything exists (Ya). It is a complete ecology of devotion.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिः स्थितिः संहारस्तिरोधानमनुग्रहः । पञ्चकृत्यमिति प्रोक्तं नटराजस्य नर्तने ॥
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiḥ saṃhārastirodhānamanugrahaḥ | pañcakṛtyamiti proktaṃ naṭarājasya nartane ||
verses.translation: Creation, preservation, dissolution, concealment, and grace — these are the five actions performed in the dance of Nataraja.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि, स्थिति, संहार, तिरोधान (आच्छादन), और अनुग्रह — ये पाँच कृत्य नटराज के नृत्य में किए जाते हैं।
verses.commentary: Shiva as Nataraja — the king of dancers — performs five simultaneous actions in his cosmic dance. The usual three (creation, preservation, dissolution) are joined by two more profound ones: tirodhana (concealment, the cosmic forgetting that makes the play possible) and anugraha (grace, the cosmic remembering that makes liberation possible). These five together are reality. The dance never stops; the dancer is everywhere.

verses.commentary: Remarkably, the Shiva Purana — a text devoted to Shiva — declares that Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, and Hamsa are all the same one God. This Vedantic inclusivism is characteristic of the great Puranas: each glorifies its own deity as supreme while simultaneously acknowledging the non-difference of all divine names. The wise worshipper does not fight over names — they see through the many names to the one reality.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्पिण्ड इव तैलाभं शिवज्ञानं प्रदीपवत् । तेनाऽऽदर्शो हृदयो मे भस्मीभूतं विलोकयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛtpiṇḍa iva tailābhaṃ śivajñānaṃ pradīpavat | tenā''darśo hṛdayo me bhasmībhūtaṃ vilokayet ||
verses.translation: The knowledge of Shiva is like a lamp to a clay pot soaked in oil — my heart, becoming a mirror through it, beholds the universe as ash.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञान तेल से तर मृत्पिण्ड (मिट्टी के बर्तन) के लिए दीपक के समान है — उससे मेरा हृदय आदर्श बनकर विश्व को भस्म रूप में देखता है।
verses.commentary: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). This is the Shaiva teaching on vairagya (dispassion): not that the world is destroyed, but that one's attachment to it is burned away. "Bhasmibhutam" — turned to ash — means the world is seen in its true nature: impermanent, insubstantial, and ultimately sacred as the play of Shiva.
verses.wordMeaning: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). verses.sanskrit: शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि । अतस्त्वामाराध्यां हरिहरविरिञ्चादिभिरपि प्रणन्तुं स्तोतुं वा कथमकृतपुण्यः प्रभवति ॥
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṃ na cedevaṃ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditumapi | atastvāmārādhyāṃ hariharaviriñcādibhirapi praṇantuṃ stotuṃ vā kathamakṛtapuṇyaḥ prabhavati ||
verses.translation: Shiva, joined with Shakti, has the power to create. Without her, the god cannot even stir. Therefore, how can one without merit worship you — praised even by Hari, Hara, and Brahma — or even address you?
verses.hindi: शिव, शक्ति से युक्त होने पर ही सृजन करने में सक्षम होते हैं। उसके बिना देव हिल भी नहीं सकते। इसलिए हरि, हर और ब्रह्मा द्वारा भी स्तुत तुम्हारी — पुण्यहीन व्यक्ति पूजा कैसे कर सकता है?
verses.commentary: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.

verses.sanskrit: वामार्धं पार्वतीरूपं दक्षिणार्धं महेश्वरः । अर्धनारीश्वरो देवः स्त्रीपुंसयोः समन्वयः ॥
verses.transliteration: vāmārdhaṃ pārvatīrūpaṃ dakṣiṇārdhaṃ maheśvaraḥ | ardhanārīśvaro devaḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ samanvayaḥ ||
verses.translation: The left half is the form of Parvati; the right half is Maheshvara. The Ardhanarishvara deity — the harmonious union of the feminine and masculine.
verses.hindi: बायाँ अर्ध पार्वती का रूप है; दायाँ अर्ध महेश्वर का। अर्धनारीश्वर देव — स्त्री और पुरुष का समन्वय।
verses.commentary: The Ardhanarishvara form encodes the Shiva Purana's deepest non-dual teaching. The division into left (Shakti, feminine, dynamic) and right (Shiva, masculine, static) is not a claim about gender roles but about two fundamental principles of existence. Shakti is the power of becoming, transformation, manifestation — without her, nothing moves. Shiva is the ground of being, the unchanging awareness — without him, there is no witness of the movement. The world requires both. The human being requires both. Psychological health requires the integration of both the receptive-aware (Shiva) and the active-creative (Shakti) in each individual. "Samanvayaḥ" — harmonious union, not domination of one by the other.

verses.sanskrit: सौराष्ट्रे सोमनाथं च श्रीशैले मल्लिकार्जुनम् । उज्जयिन्यां महाकालमोङ्कारममलेश्वरम् । परल्यां वैद्यनाथं च डाकिन्यां भीमशङ्करम् । सेतुबन्धे तु रामेशं नागेशं दारुकावने । वाराणस्यां तु विश्वेशं त्र्यम्बकं गौतमीतटे । हिमालये तु केदारं घुश्मेशं च शिवालये । एतानि ज्योतिर्लिङ्गानि सायं प्रातः पठेन्नरः । सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं स्मरणेन विनश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: saurāṣṭre somanāthaṃ ca śrīśaile mallikārjunam | ujjayinyāṃ mahākālamomkāramamalreśvaram | paralyāṃ vaidyanāthaṃ ca ḍākinyāṃ bhīmaśaṃkaram | setubaṃdhe tu rāmeśaṃ nāgeśaṃ dārukāvane | vārāṇasyāṃ tu viśveśaṃ tryambakaṃ gautamītaṭe | himālaye tu kedāraṃ ghuśmeśaṃ ca śivālaye | etāni jyotirliṃgāni sāyaṃ prātaḥ paṭhennraḥ | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ smaraṇena vinaśyati ||
verses.translation: Somnath in Saurashtra, Mallikarjuna at Shrishailam, Mahakala at Ujjain, Omkareshvara, Vaidyanath at Parali, Bhimashankara at Dakini, Rameshvara at Setubandha, Nageshvara at Darukavana, Vishveshvara at Varanasi, Tryambaka at the Gautami bank, Kedara in the Himalayas, Ghushmesha at Shivalaya. One who recites these jyotirlingas at morning and evening — the sins of seven births perish by this remembrance.
verses.hindi: सौराष्ट्र में सोमनाथ, श्रीशैल में मल्लिकार्जुन, उज्जैन में महाकाल, ओंकारेश्वर, परलि में वैद्यनाथ, डाकिनी में भीमशंकर, सेतुबंध में रामेश, दारुकावन में नागेश, वाराणसी में विश्वेश, गौतमी तट पर त्र्यम्बक, हिमालय में केदार, शिवालय में घुश्मेश। जो मनुष्य इन ज्योतिर्लिङ्गों का प्रातः-सायं पाठ करता है — स्मरण से सात जन्मों के पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.commentary: The dvadasha jyotirlinga stotram — one of the most practically used verses in the entire Shaiva tradition. The twelve jyotirlingas form a sacred geography of the entire Indian subcontinent: from Somnath on the western coast of Gujarat to Rameshvara at the southern tip, from Kedarnath in the Himalayas to Shrishailam in Andhra Pradesh. They are not merely pilgrimage destinations — they are twelve nodes of a continent-wide sacred grid. The stotram is designed to be recited at dawn and dusk: by holding all twelve in consciousness twice daily, the practitioner ritually inhabits the full sacred space of the subcontinent, regardless of physical location. "Saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ" — the sins of seven births: the depth of the purification corresponds to the depth of the sacred geography invoked.

verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ keśavo vā śivo vā haṃso vā sūryo vā sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ | arcantyenaṃ viprā hotāraśca yājanānāśca sarve ||
verses.translation: The one God — whether called Keshava (Vishnu) or Shiva or Hamsa (the Swan) or Surya (Sun) — is supreme. All Brahmins, priests, and sacrificers worship that one.

verses.commentary: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). This is the Shaiva teaching on vairagya (dispassion): not that the world is destroyed, but that one's attachment to it is burned away. "Bhasmibhutam" — turned to ash — means the world is seen in its true nature: impermanent, insubstantial, and ultimately sacred as the play of Shiva.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि । अतस्त्वामाराध्यां हरिहरविरिञ्चादिभिरपि प्रणन्तुं स्तोतुं वा कथमकृतपुण्यः प्रभवति ॥
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṃ na cedevaṃ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditumapi | atastvāmārādhyāṃ hariharaviriñcādibhirapi praṇantuṃ stotuṃ vā kathamakṛtapuṇyaḥ prabhavati ||
verses.translation: Shiva, joined with Shakti, has the power to create. Without her, the god cannot even stir. Therefore, how can one without merit worship you — praised even by Hari, Hara, and Brahma — or even address you?
verses.hindi: शिव, शक्ति से युक्त होने पर ही सृजन करने में सक्षम होते हैं। उसके बिना देव हिल भी नहीं सकते। इसलिए हरि, हर और ब्रह्मा द्वारा भी स्तुत तुम्हारी — पुण्यहीन व्यक्ति पूजा कैसे कर सकता है?
verses.commentary: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो भूत्वा शिवं यजेत् । न शिवाद्भिन्नो यजेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: śivo bhūtvā śivaṃ yajet | na śivādbhinno yajet ||
verses.translation: Having become Shiva, worship Shiva. Do not worship Shiva as one separate from Shiva.
verses.hindi: शिव बनकर शिव की पूजा करो। शिव से अलग होकर शिव की पूजा मत करो।
verses.commentary: The most concentrated expression of the Vayaviya Samhita's non-dual Shaiva philosophy — and one of the most radical statements about worship in any tradition. "Śivo bhūtvā śivaṃ yajet" — having become Shiva, worship Shiva. The quality of worship is determined by the identity of the worshipper. If you worship from the position of a small, separate, deficient self — you are projecting a powerful, complete Shiva external to yourself, which reinforces the distance. True worship begins from identity: I am already Shiva. From that recognition, the act of worship is the divine worshipping itself — which is its own deepest delight. "Na śivādbhinno yajet" — do not worship as one separate from Shiva. Separation is the fundamental error; worship from separation deepens the error rather than correcting it.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद निहितं गुहायां परमे व्योमन् । सोऽश्नुते सर्वान्कामान्सह ब्रह्मणा विपश्चिता ॥
verses.transliteration: yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ parame vyoman | so'śnute sarvānkāmānsaha brahmaṇā vipaścitā ||
verses.translation: One who knows what is hidden in the cave, in the supreme ether — that one enjoys all desires together with the all-knowing Brahman.
verses.hindi: जो उस गुहा में, परम व्योम में स्थित को जानता है — वह सर्वज्ञ ब्रह्म के साथ सभी कामनाओं का भोग करता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayaviya Samhita quotes the Taittiriya Upanishad's "guha" (cave of the heart) teaching in its Shaiva key. The Shiva who is "nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ" — hidden in the cave — is not Shiva the external deity in a temple but Shiva as the innermost awareness, the "space" of consciousness at the centre of the human being. "Parame vyoman" — in the supreme ether: the innermost space that is simultaneously the largest — the space of pure awareness that contains all experience. This is the convergence of the Shaiva and Vedantic traditions: the external jyotirlinga (infinite column of light outside) and the inner jyotirlinga (the light of awareness in the cave of the heart) are the same light.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्पिण्ड इव तैलाभं शिवज्ञानं प्रदीपवत् । तेनाऽऽदर्शो हृदयो मे भस्मीभूतं विलोकयेत् ॥

verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | mune śaunaka sadbhaktyā dattacitto jitendriyaḥ | avatārāñchivasyāhaṃ vacmi te munaye śṛṇu
verses.translation: The delighted ParameSvara, the Vamadeva incar¬ nation of Siva bestowed on Brahma lovingly, the power of creation and perfect wisdom.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--हे मुने! हे शौनक! में [शिवजीमें] मन लगाकर और इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके भक्तिपूर्वक शिवजीके अवतारोंका वर्णन आप महर्षिसे कर रहा हूँ, आप सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted ParameSvara, the Vamadeva incar¬ nation of Siva bestowed on Brahma lovingly, the power of creation and perfect wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पृष्टः पुरा नन्दी शिवमूर्तिस्सतां गतिः । सनत्कुमारेण मुने तमुवाच शिवं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: etatpṛṣṭaḥ purā nandī śivamūrtissatāṃ gatiḥ | sanatkumāreṇa mune tamuvāca śivaṃ smaran
verses.translation: EkSrnava symbolises the state of the universe during the period of dissolution when the divided units are drawn together forming a single watery mass. For details sec MP—A Study Pp 9'io*
verses.hindi: हे मुने! पूर्वकालमें इसी बातको सनत्कुमारने शिवस्वरूप तथा सत्पुरुषोंकी रक्षा करनेमें समर्थ नन्दीश्वरसे पूछा था, तब शिवजीका स्मरण करते हुए नन्दीश्वरने उनसे कहा था

verses.translation: Intelligent and wise persons call Tatpurusa as the lord of Tvac (orgin of touch perception), hand, sense of touch and the wind element.

verses.sanskrit: एकोनविंशकः कल्पो विज्ञेयः श्वेतलोहितः । सद्योजातावतारस्तु प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: ekonaviṃśakaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ | sadyojātāvatārastu prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: That form of lord Siva consisting of the firmament that pervades everything and affords space to all is called Bhima and it splits and differentiates the group of elements.
verses.commentary: Sense: That form of lord Siva consisting of the firmament that pervades everything and affords space to all is called Bhima and it splits and differentiates the group of elements.
verses.science: सर्वोपकारनिरताः सेव्या: श्रेयोडर्थिंभिर्नरे :॥ १७ चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तत्परमं ब्रह्म ध्यायतो ब्रह्मणस्तथा । उत्पन्नस्तु शिखायुक्तः कुमारः श्वेतलोहितः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstatparamaṃ brahma dhyāyato brahmaṇastathā | utpannastu śikhāyuktaḥ kumāraḥ śvetalohitaḥ
verses.translation: That form of Siva shall be known as Paifupati which is the support of individual souls, and abiding therein splits the bondage that encircles them.
verses.hindi: उस कल्पमें जब ब्रह्माजी परम ब्रह्मके ध्यानमें अवस्थित थे, उसी समय उनसे शिखासे युक्त श्वेत और लोहित वर्णवाला एक कुमार उत्पन्न हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: That form of Siva shall be known as Paifupati which is the support of individual souls, and abiding therein splits the bondage that encircles them.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मरूपिणमीश्वरम् । ज्ञात्वा ध्यात्वा स हृदये ववन्दे प्रयताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaṃ brahmā brahmarūpiṇamīśvaram | jñātvā dhyātvā sa hṛdaye vavande prayatāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Brightening the entire universe in the form of the sun, the form of Siva, IiSana, moves about in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brightening the entire universe in the form of the sun, the form of Siva, IiSana, moves about in the heaven.
verses.science: नामक दूसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं शिवं बुद्ध्वा जहर्ष भुवनेश्वरः । मुहुर्मुहुश्च सद्बुद्ध्या परं तं समचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaṃ śivaṃ buddhvā jaharṣa bhuvaneśvaraḥ | muhurmuhuśca sadbuddhyā paraṃ taṃ samacintayat
verses.translation: The eight forms of lord Siva constitute the five gross material elements, the soul, the sun and the moon. Each form stands is relation to iu constituents as follows t—
verses.hindi: अर्धनारीनरका रूप धारणकर ब्रह्माके पास गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight forms of lord Siva constitute the five gross material elements, the soul, the sun and the moon. Each form stands is relation to iu constituents as follows t—
verses.science: अर्धनारीनरका रूप धारणकर ब्रह्माके पास गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य ध्यायतः श्वेताः प्रादुर्भूता यशस्विनः । कुमाराः परविज्ञानपरब्रह्मस्वरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: tato'sya dhyāyataḥ śvetāḥ prādurbhūtā yaśasvinaḥ | kumārāḥ paravijñānaparabrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The moon of ncctarlike rays that strengthens and fattens the universe to satiety, is the form of lord iSiva called Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon of ncctarlike rays that strengthens and fattens the universe to satiety, is the form of lord iSiva called Mahadeva.
verses.science: वाणीमें सृष्टिके लिये ब्रह्माजीसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुनन्दो नन्दनश्चैव विश्वनन्दोपनन्दनौ । शिष्यास्तस्य महात्मानो यैस्तद्ब्रह्म समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: sunando nandanaścaiva viśvanandopanandanau | śiṣyāstasya mahātmāno yaistadbrahma samāvṛtam
verses.translation: The incarnations of the omnipresent lord Siva are countless in the different aeons.* Yet I shall narrate them as far as I know.
verses.hindi: और लोहित वर्णवाला एक कुमार उत्पन्न हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The incarnations of the omnipresent lord Siva are countless in the different aeons.* Yet I shall narrate them as far as I know.
verses.science: और लोहित वर्णवाला एक कुमार उत्पन्न हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातश्च वै शम्भुर्ददौ ज्ञानं च वेधसे । सर्गशक्तिमपि प्रीत्या प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaśca vai śambhurdadau jñānaṃ ca vedhase | sargaśaktimapi prītyā prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: In that Kalpa, Svetalohita, endowed with a tuft, was born as the son of Biahma as he meditated upon the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that Kalpa, Svetalohita, endowed with a tuft, was born as the son of Biahma as he meditated upon the supreme Brahman.
verses.science: जोड़कर प्रणाम किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो विंशतिमः कल्पो रक्तो नाम प्रकीर्तितः । ब्रह्मा यत्र महातेजा रक्तवर्णमधारयत्
verses.transliteration: tato viṃśatimaḥ kalpo rakto nāma prakīrtitaḥ | brahmā yatra mahātejā raktavarṇamadhārayat
verses.translation: On seeing that Being in the form of Brahman and realising that to be Ivara, Brahma meditated on him in his heart and saluted him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद बीसवाँ रक्त नामक कल्प कहा गया है, जिसमें महातेजस्वी ब्रह्माजीने रक्तवर्ण धारण किया
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Being in the form of Brahman and realising that to be Ivara, Brahma meditated on him in his heart and saluted him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य प्रादुर्भूतो विधेः सुतः । रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरो रक्ताक्षो रक्तभूषणः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya prādurbhūto vidheḥ sutaḥ | raktamālyāmbaradharo raktākṣo raktabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Knowing that Sadyojata to be Siva, Brahma, the lord of the worlds became delighted. With pure intelligence he pondered over that great Being again and again.
verses.hindi: जब पुत्रप्राप्तिकी कामनासे ब्रह्माजी ध्यानमें लीन थे, उसी समय उनसे रक्तवर्णकी माला तथा बस्त्रोंको धारण किये हुए रक्तनेत्रवाला तथा रक्त आभूषणोंसे अलंकृत एक कुमार प्रादुर्भूत हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing that Sadyojata to be Siva, Brahma, the lord of the worlds became delighted. With pure intelligence he pondered over that great Being again and again.

verses.sanskrit: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं कुमारं ध्यानमाश्रितः । वामदेवं शिवं ज्ञात्वा प्रणनाम कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kumāraṃ dhyānamāśritaḥ | vāmadevaṃ śivaṃ jñātvā praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: As he thus meditated, sons white in colour and famous for valour, were born to him. They were of great wisdom and had the form of the Supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: ध्यानमें निमग्न ब्रह्माजीने उन महात्मा कुमारको देखते ही उन्हें वामदेव शिव जानकर हाथ जोड़ करके प्रणाम किया
verses.commentary: Sense: As he thus meditated, sons white in colour and famous for valour, were born to him. They were of great wisdom and had the form of the Supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्य सुता ह्यासंश्चत्वारो रक्तवाससः । विरजाश्च विवाहश्च विशोको विश्वभावनः
verses.transliteration: tatastasya sutā hyāsaṃścatvāro raktavāsasaḥ | virajāśca vivāhaśca viśoko viśvabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: They were Sunanda, Nandana, ViSvananda and Upanandana. They were the disciples of that noble soul. By them the Brahman was encircled.
verses.hindi: तदुपरान्त उनसे लाल वस्त्र धारण किये हुए विरजा, विवाह, विशोक और विश्वभावन नामक चार पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Sunanda, Nandana, ViSvananda and Upanandana. They were the disciples of that noble soul. By them the Brahman was encircled.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवः स वै शम्भुर्ददौ ज्ञानं च वेधसे । सर्गशक्तिमपि प्रीत्या प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vāmadevaḥ sa vai śambhurdadau jñānaṃ ca vedhase | sargaśaktimapi prītyā prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The delighted great lord, the Sadyojata incarna¬ tion of Siva, lovingly bestowed on Brahma the perfect wisdom and the power of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted great lord, the Sadyojata incarna¬ tion of Siva, lovingly bestowed on Brahma the perfect wisdom and the power of creation.
verses.science: करके प्रणाम किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिमः कल्पः पीतवासा इति स्मृतः । ब्रह्मा यत्र महाभागः पीतवासा बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśatimaḥ kalpaḥ pītavāsā iti smṛtaḥ | brahmā yatra mahābhāgaḥ pītavāsā babhūva ha
verses.translation: As Brahma desirous of sons meditated, a son ap¬ peared in front of him wearing red garments and garlands. His eyes were red and his ornaments too were red.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brahma desirous of sons meditated, a son ap¬ peared in front of him wearing red garments and garlands. His eyes were red and his ornaments too were red.
verses.science: पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य विधेर्जातः कुमारकः । पीतवस्त्रादिकप्रौढो महातेजा महाभुजः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya vidherjātaḥ kumārakaḥ | pītavastrādikaprauḍho mahātejā mahābhujaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that noble-souled son, he resorting to meditation knew him as the Vamadeva incarnation of Siva and so bowed to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न करनेकी शक्ति भी प्रदान की
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that noble-souled son, he resorting to meditation knew him as the Vamadeva incarnation of Siva and so bowed to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: उत्पन्न करनेकी शक्ति भी प्रदान की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा ध्यानसंयुक्तं ज्ञात्वा तत्पुरुषं शिवम् । प्रणनाम ततो बुद्ध्या गायत्रीं शाङ्करीं विधिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhyānasaṃyuktaṃ jñātvā tatpuruṣaṃ śivam | praṇanāma tato buddhyā gāyatrīṃ śāṅkarīṃ vidhiḥ
verses.translation: Your sons wearing red garments were bom of him Viz, Virajas, VivSha, Vioka and Vivabhfivana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your sons wearing red garments were bom of him Viz, Virajas, VivSha, Vioka and Vivabhfivana.
verses.science: कुमार अवतरित हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा तु महादेवीं सर्वलोकनमस्कृताम् । प्रसन्नस्तु महादेवो ध्यानयुक्तेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: japitvā tu mahādevīṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtām | prasannastu mahādevo dhyānayuktena cetasā
verses.translation: As Brahma desirous of sons meditated, a son was born unto him mature, of great arms and great splendour and wearing yellow garments.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brahma desirous of sons meditated, a son was born unto him mature, of great arms and great splendour and wearing yellow garments.
verses.science: योगमार्गके प्रवर्तकके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य पार्श्वतो दिव्याः प्रादुर्भूताः कुमारकाः । पीतवस्त्रा हि सकला योगमार्गप्रवर्तकाः
verses.transliteration: tato'sya pārśvato divyāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ kumārakāḥ | pītavastrā hi sakalā yogamārgapravartakāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him engrossed in meditation and realising that Being as Siva, the Creator bowed to him after performing the Japa of Siva-Gayatri, who is the great god¬ dess, bowed to by all the worlds. The gpreat god was delighted with the mind in contemplation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him engrossed in meditation and realising that Being as Siva, the Creator bowed to him after performing the Japa of Siva-Gayatri, who is the great god¬ dess, bowed to by all the worlds. The gpreat god was delighted with the mind in contemplation.
verses.science: कल्प प्रारम्भ हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मिन्गते कल्पे पीतवर्णे स्वयम्भुवः । पुनरन्यः प्रवृत्तस्तु कल्पो नाम्ना शिवस्तु स
verses.transliteration: tatastasmingate kalpe pītavarṇe svayambhuvaḥ | punaranyaḥ pravṛttastu kalpo nāmnā śivastu sa
verses.translation: Then from his sides sons of divine features issued forth. All of them had yellow garments and they were the instigators of the Yogic path.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then from his sides sons of divine features issued forth. All of them had yellow garments and they were the instigators of the Yogic path.
verses.science: देखकर दुखी होकर सोचने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवे संव्यतीते दिव्यवर्षसहस्रके । स्रष्टुकामः प्रजा ब्रह्मा चिन्तयामास दुःखितः
verses.transliteration: ekārṇave saṃvyatīte divyavarṣasahasrake | sraṣṭukāmaḥ prajā brahmā cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: When that Kalpa of yellow colour of the selfborn lord elapsed, another Kalpa set in and it was named Siva.
verses.hindi: चन्दनका अनुलेप धारण किये हुए था
verses.commentary: Sense: When that Kalpa of yellow colour of the selfborn lord elapsed, another Kalpa set in and it was named Siva.
verses.science: चन्दनका अनुलेप धारण किये हुए था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽपश्यन्महातेजाः प्रादुर्भूतं कुमारकम् । कृष्णवर्णं महावीर्यं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: tato'paśyanmahātejāḥ prādurbhūtaṃ kumārakam | kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahāvīryaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā
verses.translation: After a thousand divine years had elapsed and the entire universe had become one vast ocean,* Brahma desirous of creating subjects thought in sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a thousand divine years had elapsed and the entire universe had become one vast ocean,* Brahma desirous of creating subjects thought in sorrow.
verses.science: प्रिय वचनोंसे स्तुति करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धृतकृष्णाम्बरोष्णीषं कृष्णयज्ञोपवीतिनम् । कृष्णेन मौलिनायुक्तं कृष्णस्नानानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: dhṛtakṛṣṇāmbaroṣṇīṣaṃ kṛṣṇayajñopavītinam | kṛṣṇena maulināyuktaṃ kṛṣṇasnānānulepanam
verses.translation: That lord of great splendour saw a son coming into view. He was black in colour, possessed of great strength. He was shining in his own splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord of great splendour saw a son coming into view. He was black in colour, possessed of great strength. He was shining in his own splendour.
verses.science: परमतेजसे सम्पन्न तथा शिवस्वरूप थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानमघोरं घोरविक्रमम् । ववन्दे देवदेवेशमद्भुतं कृष्णपिङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānamaghoraṃ ghoravikramam | vavande devadeveśamadbhutaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam
verses.translation: On seeing that noble soul of terrible exploits, (named) Aghora (non-terrible), he worshipped him—the lord of god, of wonderful black and tawny colour.
verses.hindi: कि तो नाभतः परमादत: अद्भुत कल्प प्रारम्भ हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that noble soul of terrible exploits, (named) Aghora (non-terrible), he worshipped him—the lord of god, of wonderful black and tawny colour.
verses.science: कि तो नाभतः परमादत: अद्भुत कल्प प्रारम्भ हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अघोरं तु ततो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मरूपं व्यचिन्तयत् । तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्भक्तवत्सलमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: aghoraṃ tu tato brahmā brahmarūpaṃ vyacintayat | tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirbhaktavatsalamavyayam
verses.translation: Brahma then contemplated on Aghora in the form of Brahman. He eulogised that unperishing Being favourably disposed towards his devotees, by means of pleasing words.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिव ईशानके रूपमें प्रकट हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma then contemplated on Aghora in the form of Brahman. He eulogised that unperishing Being favourably disposed towards his devotees, by means of pleasing words.
verses.science: भगवान् शिव ईशानके रूपमें प्रकट हुए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य पार्श्वतः कृष्णाः कृष्णस्नानानुलेपनाः । चत्वारस्तु महात्मानः सम्बभूवुः कुमारकाः
verses.transliteration: athāsya pārśvataḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kṛṣṇasnānānulepanāḥ | catvārastu mahātmānaḥ sambabhūvuḥ kumārakāḥ
verses.translation: Then from his sides sprang up four noble-souled sons all of whom were black in colour and had black toilet and unguent articles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then from his sides sprang up four noble-souled sons all of whom were black in colour and had black toilet and unguent articles.
verses.science: ईशानको देखकर प्रणाम किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृष्ण कृष्णशिखश्चैव कृष्णास्यः कृष्णकण्ठधृक् । इति तेऽव्यक्तनामानः शिवरूपाः सुतेजसः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇaśikhaścaiva kṛṣṇāsyaḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhadhṛk | iti te'vyaktanāmānaḥ śivarūpāḥ sutejasaḥ
verses.translation: These brilliant beings in the form of iSiva had the
verses.commentary: Sense: These brilliant beings in the form of iSiva had the
verses.science: सुन्दर बालकोंको उत्पन्न किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवम्भूता महात्मानो ब्रह्मणः सृष्टिहेतवे । योगं प्रवर्तयामासुर्घोराख्यं महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: evambhūtā mahātmāno brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭihetave | yogaṃ pravartayāmāsurghorākhyaṃ mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: The noble-souled beings of this nature initiated the great and wonderful Yoga called Ghora for the purpose of Brahma's creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The noble-souled beings of this nature initiated the great and wonderful Yoga called Ghora for the purpose of Brahma's creation.
verses.science: इस जगत्में प्रख्यात हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यो ब्रह्मणः कल्पः प्रावर्तत मुनीश्वराः । विश्वरूप इति ख्यातो नामतः परमाद्भुतः
verses.transliteration: athānyo brahmaṇaḥ kalpaḥ prāvartata munīśvarāḥ | viśvarūpa iti khyāto nāmataḥ paramādbhutaḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, then another extremely wonderful Kalpa of Brahma, named ViSvarupa began to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, then another extremely wonderful Kalpa of Brahma, named ViSvarupa began to function.
verses.science: क्षेत्रको अधिकृत करके स्थित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणः पुत्रकामस्य ध्यायतो मनसा शिवम् । प्रादुर्भूता महानादा विश्वरूपा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇaḥ putrakāmasya dhyāyato manasā śivam | prādurbhūtā mahānādā viśvarūpā sarasvatī
verses.translation: As Brahma, desirous of sons, meditated on Siva mentally, Sarasvati (Goddess of speech) of great sound mani¬ fested herself. She was Vi pa (Universe-formed).
verses.hindi: प्रकारके कार्योंको सर्वदा सम्पादित करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brahma, desirous of sons, meditated on Siva mentally, Sarasvati (Goddess of speech) of great sound mani¬ fested herself. She was Vi pa (Universe-formed).
verses.science: प्रकारके कार्योंको सर्वदा सम्पादित करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथाविधः स भगवानीशानः परमेश्वरः । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः
verses.transliteration: tathāvidhaḥ sa bhagavānīśānaḥ parameśvaraḥ | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Isanu of such renowned features, supreme lord of crystal-like pure brilliance and bedecked in all ornaments manifested himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Isanu of such renowned features, supreme lord of crystal-like pure brilliance and bedecked in all ornaments manifested himself.
verses.science: वागिन्द्रिय तथा आकाशका ईश्वर है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणनामासौ ब्रह्मेशानमजं विभुम् । सर्वगं सर्वदं सर्वं सुरूपं रूपवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāmāsau brahmeśānamajaṃ vibhum | sarvagaṃ sarvadaṃ sarvaṃ surūpaṃ rūpavarjitam
verses.translation: On seeing the unborn lord, an pervading,
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the unborn lord, an pervading,
verses.science: अधिष्ठातृदेवता कहा गया है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानोऽपि तथादिश्य सन्मार्गं ब्रह्मणे विभुः । सशक्तिः कल्पयाञ्चक्रे स बालांश्चतुरः शुभान्
verses.transliteration: īśāno'pi tathādiśya sanmārgaṃ brahmaṇe vibhuḥ | saśaktiḥ kalpayāñcakre sa bālāṃścaturaḥ śubhān
verses.translation: Lord liana after instructing the path of the good to Brahma, created four auspicious sons in collaboration with his Energy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord liana after instructing the path of the good to Brahma, created four auspicious sons in collaboration with his Energy.
verses.science: परमगति प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जटी मुण्डी शिखण्डी च अर्धमुण्डश्च जज्ञिरे । योगेनादिश्य सद्धर्मं कृत्वा योगगतिं गताः
verses.transliteration: jaṭī muṇḍī śikhaṇḍī ca ardhamuṇḍaśca jajñire | yogenādiśya saddharmaṃ kṛtvā yogagatiṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: There were born Jatin, Mundin, Sikhandin and Ardhamunda. By means of Yoga they imparted good virtue and attained the goal of Yoga.
verses.hindi: वे जटी, मुण्डी, शिखण्डी तथा अर्धमुण्ड नामवाले उत्पन्न हुए। वे योगके द्वारा उपदेश देकर सद्धर्म करके योग-गतिको प्राप्त हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: There were born Jatin, Mundin, Sikhandin and Ardhamunda. By means of Yoga they imparted good virtue and attained the goal of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तः सद्यादीनां समुद्भवः । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṅkṣepataḥ proktaḥ sadyādīnāṃ samudbhavaḥ | sanatkumāra sarvajña lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Thus I have succinctly narrated the origin of Sadyojata and others, O Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, being desirous of the welfare of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: [नन्दौश्वर बोले--] हे सनत्कुमार! हे सर्वज्ञ! इस प्रकार मैंने लोकके कल्याणके निमित्त शिवके सद्योजात आदि अवतारोंका संक्षेपसे वर्णन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have succinctly narrated the origin of Sadyojata and others, O Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, being desirous of the welfare of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तेषां महाप्राज्ञ व्यवहारं यथायथम् । त्रिलोकहितकारं हि सर्वं ब्रह्माण्डसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: atha teṣāṃ mahāprājña vyavahāraṃ yathāyatham | trilokahitakāraṃ hi sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Then, O intelligent one, their dealings arc bene¬ ficial to the three worlds and everything that is existent in the universe.
verses.hindi: हे महाप्राज्ञ ! तीनों लोकोंके लिये हितकर उनका सम्पूर्ण यथोचित व्यवहार इस ब्रह्माण्डमें फैला हुआ है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O intelligent one, their dealings arc bene¬ ficial to the three worlds and everything that is existent in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः पुरुषोऽघोरो वामसंज्ञस्तथैव च । ब्रह्मसंज्ञा महेशस्य मूर्तयः पञ्च विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: īśānaḥ puruṣo'ghoro vāmasaṃjñastathaiva ca | brahmasaṃjñā maheśasya mūrtayaḥ pañca viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: The five famous forms of Mahela* are thus named
verses.hindi: तस्मिन्व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इब॥ २  मणियाँ
verses.commentary: Sense: The five famous forms of Mahela* are thus named
verses.science: तस्मिन्व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इब॥ २ मणियाँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः शिवरूपश्च गरीयान्प्रथमः स्मृतः । भोक्तारं प्रकृतेः साक्षात्क्षेत्रज्ञमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: īśānaḥ śivarūpaśca garīyānprathamaḥ smṛtaḥ | bhoktāraṃ prakṛteḥ sākṣātkṣetrajñamadhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Intelligent persons call the form Aghor, the sup¬ port of the physical body, the sense of taste, of colour and of fire as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intelligent persons call the form Aghor, the sup¬ port of the physical body, the sense of taste, of colour and of fire as well.
verses.science: ही शास्त्रका निश्चय है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवस्तत्पुरुषाख्यश्च स्वरूपो हि द्वितीयकः । गुणाश्रयात्मकं भोग्यं सर्वज्ञमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: śaivastatpuruṣākhyaśca svarūpo hi dvitīyakaḥ | guṇāśrayātmakaṃ bhogyaṃ sarvajñamadhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: They know the form of Sadyojata as the lord of the organ of smell, of smell itself, of the earth and of the generative organ.
verses.hindi: शिवका भव नामक रूप कहा जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: They know the form of Sadyojata as the lord of the organ of smell, of smell itself, of the earth and of the generative organ.
verses.science: शिवका भव नामक रूप कहा जाता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्माय स्वाङ्गसंयुक्तं बुद्धितत्त्वं पिनाकिनः । अघोराख्यस्वरूपो यस्तिष्ठत्यन्तस्तृतीयकः
verses.transliteration: dharmāya svāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ buddhitattvaṃ pinākinaḥ | aghorākhyasvarūpo yastiṣṭhatyantastṛtīyakaḥ
verses.translation: These forms of Siva, the source of all glory shall be honoured and bowed to strenuously by those who seek glory.
verses.hindi: परमात्मा शिवका उग्र रूप कहा जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: These forms of Siva, the source of all glory shall be honoured and bowed to strenuously by those who seek glory.
verses.science: परमात्मा शिवका उग्र रूप कहा जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवाह्वयो रूपश्चतुर्थः शङ्करस्य हि । अहङ्कृतेरधिष्ठानो बहुकार्यकरः सदा
verses.transliteration: vāmadevāhvayo rūpaścaturthaḥ śaṅkarasya hi | ahaṅkṛteradhiṣṭhāno bahukāryakaraḥ sadā
verses.translation: He who reads and listens to the origin of Sadyojata and others, enjoys all desires and attains the ultimate goal.
verses.hindi: गया है, वह महाभूतोंका भेदन करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads and listens to the origin of Sadyojata and others, enjoys all desires and attains the ultimate goal.
verses.science: गया है, वह महाभूतोंका भेदन करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाह्वस्वरूपो हि शङ्करस्येश्वरः सदा । श्रोत्रस्य वचसश्चापि विभोर्व्योम्नस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: īśānāhvasvarūpo hi śaṅkarasyeśvaraḥ sadā | śrotrasya vacasaścāpi vibhorvyomnastathaiva ca
verses.translation: O dear sage, listen to the great incarnations of lord l§iva that carry out all worldly activities and bestow happiness on all.
verses.hindi: पशुपतिका पशुपति नामक रूप जानना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear sage, listen to the great incarnations of lord l§iva that carry out all worldly activities and bestow happiness on all.
verses.science: पशुपतिका पशुपति नामक रूप जानना चाहिए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वक्पाणिस्पर्शवायूनामीश्वरं रूपमैश्वरम् । पुरुषाख्यं विचारज्ञा मतिमन्तः प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: tvakpāṇisparśavāyūnāmīśvaraṃ rūpamaiśvaram | puruṣākhyaṃ vicārajñā matimantaḥ pracakṣate
verses.translation: The 'iniverse consists of the eight forms of lord Siva.® Pervading that the universe subsists like the pearls in the string.
verses.hindi: वह महेशका ईशान नामक रूप है
verses.commentary: Sense: The 'iniverse consists of the eight forms of lord Siva.® Pervading that the universe subsists like the pearls in the string.
verses.science: वह महेशका ईशान नामक रूप है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: वपुषश्च रसस्यापि रूपस्याग्नेस्तथैव च । अघोराख्यमधिष्ठानं रूपं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: vapuṣaśca rasasyāpi rūpasyāgnestathaiva ca | aghorākhyamadhiṣṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The eight presiding deities are Sarva, Bhava, Rudra, Ugra, Bhima, Paupati, liana and Mahadeva. They are well known.
verses.hindi: वह रूप महादेव नामसे विख्यात है
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight presiding deities are Sarva, Bhava, Rudra, Ugra, Bhima, Paupati, liana and Mahadeva. They are well known.
verses.science: वह रूप महादेव नामसे विख्यात है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रशनायाश्च पायोश्च रसस्यापां तथैव च । ईश्वरं वामदेवाख्यं स्वरूपं शाङ्करं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: raśanāyāśca pāyośca rasasyāpāṃ tathaiva ca | īśvaraṃ vāmadevākhyaṃ svarūpaṃ śāṅkaraṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: By these eight forms of Siva, viz. Sarva etc, the earth, the waters, the fire, the wind, the sky, the individual soul, the sun and the moon are presided over.
verses.hindi: शरीरभूत संसार शिवार्चनसे पुष्ट होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: By these eight forms of Siva, viz. Sarva etc, the earth, the waters, the fire, the wind, the sky, the individual soul, the sun and the moon are presided over.
verses.science: शरीरभूत संसार शिवार्चनसे पुष्ट होता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: घ्राणस्य चैवोपस्थस्य गन्धस्य च भुवस्तथा । सद्योजाताह्वयं रूपमीश्वरं शाङ्करं विदुः
verses.transliteration: ghrāṇasya caivopasthasya gandhasya ca bhuvastathā | sadyojātāhvayaṃ rūpamīśvaraṃ śāṅkaraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: The form of the Supreme Soul, consisting of water that enlivens the entire world, is called Bhava.
verses.hindi: संसारके प्रसन्‍न होनेसे शिवजी प्रसन्न रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The form of the Supreme Soul, consisting of water that enlivens the entire world, is called Bhava.
verses.science: संसारके प्रसन्‍न होनेसे शिवजी प्रसन्न रहते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इमे स्वरूपाः शम्भोर्हि वन्दनीयाः प्रयत्नतः । श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैर्नित्यं श्रेयसामेकहेतवः
verses.transliteration: ime svarūpāḥ śambhorhi vandanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | śreyo'rthibhirnarairnityaṃ śreyasāmekahetavaḥ
verses.translation: The form of the great lord Siva that holds the outer and inner universe and throbs by itself is called Ugra by the noble.
verses.hindi: अनिष्ट किया गया है, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: The form of the great lord Siva that holds the outer and inner universe and throbs by itself is called Ugra by the noble.
verses.science: अनिष्ट किया गया है, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Should the slaughter or captivity of a person be carried out, undoubtedly it is an offence committed against the eight-formed lord Siva.
verses.hindi: तुम्हें इच्छित वरदान दे रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Should the slaughter or captivity of a person be carried out, undoubtedly it is an offence committed against the eight-formed lord Siva.
verses.science: तुम्हें इच्छित वरदान दे रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Should the slaughter or captivity of a person be carried out, undoubtedly it is an offence committed against the eight-formed lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Should the slaughter or captivity of a person be carried out, undoubtedly it is an offence committed against the eight-formed lord Siva.
verses.science: देवी पार्ववीको अलग किया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । शिवाष्टमूर्त्तिवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात महेशस्यावतारान्परमान्प्रभो । सर्वकार्यकराँल्लोके सर्वस्य सुखदां मुने
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.2. dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | śivāṣṭamūrttivarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu tāta maheśasyāvatārānparamānprabho | sarvakāryakarām̐lloke sarvasya sukhadāṃ mune
verses.translation: Worship Siva who presides over the universe in the eightfold forms with all devotion. Worship Rudra, the great cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worship Siva who presides over the universe in the eightfold forms with all devotion. Worship Rudra, the great cause.
verses.science: ब्रह्माजी उनसे प्रार्थना करने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शम्भोः परेशस्य मूर्त्यष्टकमयं जगत् । तस्मिन्व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.transliteration: tasya śambhoḥ pareśasya mūrtyaṣṭakamayaṃ jagat | tasminvyāpya sthitaṃ viśvaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
verses.translation: Then assuming the wish-yielding form of Isana—the perfect consciousness, and in the guise of half-male and half- female form Siva approached Brahma.
verses.hindi: और प्रभु शिव भी अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Then assuming the wish-yielding form of Isana—the perfect consciousness, and in the guise of half-male and half- female form Siva approached Brahma.
verses.science: और प्रभु शिव भी अन्तर्धान हो गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो भवस्तथा रुद्र उग्रो भीमः पशोः पतिः । ईशानश्च महादेवो मूर्तयश्चाष्ट विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: śarvo bhavastathā rudra ugro bhīmaḥ paśoḥ patiḥ | īśānaśca mahādevo mūrtayaścāṣṭa viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing lord Siva united with great Sakti and bowing to him prostrate, Brahma eulogised him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: शर्व, भव, रुद्र, उग्र, भीम, पशुपति, ईशान और महादेव--ये [शंकरकी] आठ मूर्तियाँ विख्यात हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing lord Siva united with great Sakti and bowing to him prostrate, Brahma eulogised him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यम्भोऽग्निमरुद्व्योमक्षेत्रज्ञार्कनिशाकराः । अधिष्ठिताश्च शर्वाद्यैरष्टरूपैः शिवस्य हि
verses.transliteration: bhūmyambho'gnimarudvyomakṣetrajñārkaniśākarāḥ | adhiṣṭhitāśca śarvādyairaṣṭarūpaiḥ śivasya hi
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva, ihc creator of the universe, spoke in words majestic in sound like that of rumb¬ ling cloud.
verses.hindi: स भुक्त्वा सकलान्भोगान्प्रयाति परमां गतिम्॥ ३१  प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord Siva, ihc creator of the universe, spoke in words majestic in sound like that of rumb¬ ling cloud.
verses.science: स भुक्त्वा सकलान्भोगान्प्रयाति परमां गतिम्॥ ३१ प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धत्ते चराचरं विश्वं रूपं विश्वम्भरात्मकम् । शङ्करस्य महेशस्य शास्त्रस्यैवेति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: dhatte carācaraṃ viśvaṃ rūpaṃ viśvambharātmakam | śaṅkarasya maheśasya śāstrasyaiveti niścayaḥ
verses.translation: "O dear son of great fortune, O grandfather, I have understood correctly all that you have cherished in your mind.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शिवस्याद्धनारीश्वरावतारवर्णन॑ नाम तृतीयो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear son of great fortune, O grandfather, I have understood correctly all that you have cherished in your mind.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शिवस्याद्धनारीश्वरावतारवर्णन॑ नाम तृतीयो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जीवनं समस्तस्य जगतः सलिलात्मकम् । भव इत्युच्यते रूपं भवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sañjīvanaṃ samastasya jagataḥ salilātmakam | bhava ityucyate rūpaṃ bhavasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: After saying these naturally sweet and magnani¬ mous words, lord Siva detached Siva from his body.
verses.hindi: समस्त संसारको जीवन देनेवाला जल परमात्मा शिवका भव नामक रूप कहा जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying these naturally sweet and magnani¬ mous words, lord Siva detached Siva from his body.

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तर्जगद्विश्वं बिभर्ति स्पन्दते स्वयम् । उग्र इत्युच्यते सद्भी रूपमुग्रस्य सत्प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: bahirantarjagadviśvaṃ bibharti spandate svayam | ugra ityucyate sadbhī rūpamugrasya satprabhoḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that great Sakti, detached separately from Siva, Brahma bowed to her politely and requested her.
verses.hindi: जो प्राणियोंक भीतर तथा बाहर गतिशील रहकर विश्वका भरण-पोषण करता है और स्वयं भी स्पन्दित होता रहता है, सज्नोंद्वारा उसे उग्रस्वरूप परमात्मा शिवका उग्र रूप कहा जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that great Sakti, detached separately from Siva, Brahma bowed to her politely and requested her.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावकाशदं सर्वव्यापकं गगनात्मकम् । रूपं भीमस्य भीमाख्यं भूपवृन्दस्व भेदकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāvakāśadaṃ sarvavyāpakaṃ gaganātmakam | rūpaṃ bhīmasya bhīmākhyaṃ bhūpavṛndasva bhedakam
verses.translation: *'0 Siy3, I cfcafcil' at first your husband
verses.commentary: Sense: *'0 Siy3, I cfcafcil' at first your husband
verses.science: मनुके पुत्र होंगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मनामधिष्ठानं सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासकम् । रूपं पशुपतेर्ज्ञेयं पशुपाशनिकृन्तनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvātmanāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ sarvakṣetranivāsakam | rūpaṃ paśupaterjñeyaṃ paśupāśanikṛntanam
verses.translation: O Siva, the gods and others were mentally created by me. But they do not multiply themselves. Hence they are being created again and again.
verses.hindi: द्वापर युगके अन्तमें अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, the gods and others were mentally created by me. But they do not multiply themselves. Hence they are being created again and again.
verses.science: द्वापर युगके अन्तमें अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सन्दीपयञ्जगत्सर्वं दिवाकरसमाह्वयम् । ईशानाख्यं महेशस्य रूपं दिवि विसर्पति
verses.transliteration: sandīpayañjagatsarvaṃ divākarasamāhvayam | īśānākhyaṃ maheśasya rūpaṃ divi visarpati
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, thus the well known eight forms have been explained to you. These forms engaged in helping everyone shall be resorted to by those who seek glory.
verses.hindi: परमात्मा शिवने सभी प्रजाओंको नियुक्त किया है
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Brahma, thus the well known eight forms have been explained to you. These forms engaged in helping everyone shall be resorted to by those who seek glory.
verses.science: परमात्मा शिवने सभी प्रजाओंको नियुक्त किया है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आप्याययति यो विश्वममृतांशुर्निशाकरः । महादेवस्य तद्रूपं महादेवस्य चाह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: āpyāyayati yo viśvamamṛtāṃśurniśākaraḥ | mahādevasya tadrūpaṃ mahādevasya cāhvayam
verses.translation: O dear one of great intellect, please listen to the description of Siva's form half-male and half-female,* than which there is nothing more excellent and which completes the work of the Creator.
verses.hindi: जो अमृतके समान किरणोंसे युक्त होकर चद्धरूपसे सारे संसारको आप्यायित करता है, महादेव शिवजीका वह रूप महादेव नामसे विख्यात है
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one of great intellect, please listen to the description of Siva's form half-male and half-female,* than which there is nothing more excellent and which completes the work of the Creator.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा तस्याष्टमं रूपं शिवस्य परमात्मनः । व्यापिकेतरमूर्तीनां विश्वं तस्माच्छिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: ātmā tasyāṣṭamaṃ rūpaṃ śivasya paramātmanaḥ | vyāpiketaramūrtīnāṃ viśvaṃ tasmācchivātmakam
verses.translation: When the subjects created by the Creator did not multiply, he was very much distressed and worried.
verses.hindi: आप अखिलेश्वरीसे प्रार्थना कर रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: When the subjects created by the Creator did not multiply, he was very much distressed and worried.
verses.science: आप अखिलेश्वरीसे प्रार्थना कर रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शाखाः पुष्यन्ति वृक्षस्य वृक्षमूलस्य सेचनात् । तद्वदस्य वपुर्विश्वं पुष्यते च शिवार्चनात्
verses.transliteration: śākhāḥ puṣyanti vṛkṣasya vṛkṣamūlasya secanāt | tadvadasya vapurviśvaṃ puṣyate ca śivārcanāt
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice said—''Carry on the creation produced by couples.*' On hearing it, Brahma pondered over the creation produced by couples in order to carry it out.
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार वृक्षकी जड़ (मूल)-को सींचनेसे उसकी शाखाएँ पुष्ट होती हैं, उसी प्रकार शिवका शरीरभूत संसार शिवार्चनसे पुष्ट होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a celestial voice said—''Carry on the creation produced by couples.*' On hearing it, Brahma pondered over the creation produced by couples in order to carry it out.

verses.sanskrit: यथेह पुत्रपौत्रादेः प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवेत्पिता । तथा विश्वस्य सम्प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yatheha putrapautrādeḥ prītyā prīto bhavetpitā | tathā viśvasya samprītyā prīto bhavati śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Since no generation of women had formerly come out of Isana, the lotus-born deity (Brahma) was unable to produce the creation by means of copulation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since no generation of women had formerly come out of Isana, the lotus-born deity (Brahma) was unable to produce the creation by means of copulation.
verses.science: जगन्मात: आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रियते यस्य कस्यापि देहिनो यदि निग्रहः । अष्टमूर्तेरनिष्टं तत्कृतमेव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kriyate yasya kasyāpi dehino yadi nigrahaḥ | aṣṭamūrteraniṣṭaṃ tatkṛtameva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma then began to perform penance thinking "Without the power of 6iva, the subjects will not be born."
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma then began to perform penance thinking "Without the power of 6iva, the subjects will not be born."
verses.science: दक्षकी कन्याके रूपमें अवतरित हों। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमूर्त्यात्मना विश्वमधिष्ठायास्थितं शिवम् । भजस्व सर्वभावेन रुद्रं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamūrtyātmanā viśvamadhiṣṭhāyāsthitaṃ śivam | bhajasva sarvabhāvena rudraṃ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: Within his heart he pondered lovingly over lord Siva united with the great Sakti called Siva. He then per¬ formed great penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within his heart he pondered lovingly over lord Siva united with the great Sakti called Siva. He then per¬ formed great penance.
verses.science: दूसरी शक्तिका सृजन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्ताः स्वरूपास्ते विधिपुत्राष्टविश्रुताः । सर्वोपकारनिरताः सेव्याः श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैः
verses.transliteration: iti proktāḥ svarūpāste vidhiputrāṣṭaviśrutāḥ | sarvopakāraniratāḥ sevyāḥ śreyo'rthibhirnaraiḥ
verses.translation: Ere long Siva became satisfied with the severe penance of the self-born lord Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ere long Siva became satisfied with the severe penance of the self-born lord Brahma.
verses.science: होना स्वीकार कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The unchanging generation of women has not come out of you before. Hence I do not have the power to create women.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unchanging generation of women has not come out of you before. Hence I do not have the power to create women.
verses.science: रूपमें अवतार लूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The unchanging generation of women has not come out of you before. Hence I do not have the power to create women.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unchanging generation of women has not come out of you before. Hence I do not have the power to create women.
verses.science: मेरे लोकको जायँगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३. तृतीयोऽध्यायः । शिवस्यार्द्धनारीश्वरावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात महाप्राज्ञ विधिकामप्रपूरकम् । अर्द्धनारीनराख्यं हि शिवरूपमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.3. tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | śivasyārddhanārīśvarāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu tāta mahāprājña vidhikāmaprapūrakam | arddhanārīnarākhyaṃ hi śivarūpamanuttamam
verses.translation: All Saktis spring up from you. Hence I request you the great Sakti, the goddess of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: All Saktis spring up from you. Hence I request you the great Sakti, the goddess of all.
verses.science: परम ब्रह्ममें समाधि लगानेवाले होंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा सृष्टाः प्रजाः सर्वाः न व्यवर्द्धन्त वेधसा । तदा चिन्ताकुलोऽभूत्स तेन दुःखेन दुखितः
verses.transliteration: yadā sṛṣṭāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ na vyavarddhanta vedhasā | tadā cintākulo'bhūtsa tena duḥkhena dukhitaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this pious narrative enjoys all pleasures and attains to the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this pious narrative enjoys all pleasures and attains to the greatest goal.
verses.science: केतुश्वृंगस्तपोधनः ॥ २ नामक पुत्र होंगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नभोवाणी तदाभूद्वै सृष्टिं मिथुनजां कुरु । तच्छ्रुत्वा मैथुनीं सृष्टिं ब्रह्मा कर्तुममन्यत
verses.transliteration: nabhovāṇī tadābhūdvai sṛṣṭiṃ mithunajāṃ kuru | tacchrutvā maithunīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā kartumamanyata
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the four Brahmins well-versed in the Vedic lore viz. Dimdubhi, Satarupa, Hfika and Ketuman.
verses.commentary: Sense: There too my disciples will be the four Brahmins well-versed in the Vedic lore viz. Dimdubhi, Satarupa, Hfika and Ketuman.
verses.science: अवतार होते रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारीणां कुलमीशानान्निर्गतं न पुरा यतः । ततो मैथुनजां सृष्टिं कर्तुं शेके न पद्मभूः
verses.transliteration: nārīṇāṃ kulamīśānānnirgataṃ na purā yataḥ | tato maithunajāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ śeke na padmabhūḥ
verses.translation: Foul* sons will be bom of me there viz—Viiloka, Viiesa, Vipkpa and Papana<ana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Foul* sons will be bom of me there viz—Viiloka, Viiesa, Vipkpa and Papana<ana.
verses.science: वहींपर अन्तहिंत हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावेण विना शम्भोर्न जायेरन्निमाः प्रजाः । एवं सञ्चिन्तयन्ब्रह्मा तपः कर्त्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: prabhāveṇa vinā śambhorna jāyerannimāḥ prajāḥ | evaṃ sañcintayanbrahmā tapaḥ karttuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: O four-faced deity, I will help Vyasa and will propagate firmly the path of renunciation in the Kali age.
verses.commentary: Sense: O four-faced deity, I will help Vyasa and will propagate firmly the path of renunciation in the Kali age.
verses.science: एकोनविंशतिशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम पश्मो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवया परया शक्त्या संयुक्तं परमेश्वरम् । सञ्चिन्त्य हृदये प्रीत्या तेपे स परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: śivayā parayā śaktyā saṃyuktaṃ parameśvaram | sañcintya hṛdaye prītyā tepe sa paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: In the fourth aeon of Dvkpara in the age of Angi- ras Vyasa, I shall be bora as Suhotra.
verses.hindi: उन्‍नीस अवतारोंका वर्णन नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fourth aeon of Dvkpara in the age of Angi- ras Vyasa, I shall be bora as Suhotra.
verses.science: उन्‍नीस अवतारोंका वर्णन नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तीव्रेण तपसा तस्य संयुक्तस्य स्वयम्भुवः । अचिरेणैव कालेन तुतोष स शिवो द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tīvreṇa tapasā tasya saṃyuktasya svayambhuvaḥ | acireṇaiva kālena tutoṣa sa śivo drutam
verses.translation: There also four sons will be bom of me all aspiring after the Yogic path and noble-souled. O Brahmfi, 1 shall mention their names.
verses.hindi: चाहता हूँ, अत: आप मुझे बतानेकी कृपा करें
verses.commentary: Sense: There also four sons will be bom of me all aspiring after the Yogic path and noble-souled. O Brahmfi, 1 shall mention their names.
verses.science: चाहता हूँ, अत: आप मुझे बतानेकी कृपा करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः पूर्णचिदीशस्य मूर्तिमाविश्य कामदाम् । अर्द्धनारीनरो भूत्वा ततो ब्रह्मान्तिकं हरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pūrṇacidīśasya mūrtimāviśya kāmadām | arddhanārīnaro bhūtvā tato brahmāntikaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: They are Sumukha, Durmukha, Durdarbha and Duratikrama. O Brahma, I shall then render help to Vyksa through the disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Sumukha, Durmukha, Durdarbha and Duratikrama. O Brahma, I shall then render help to Vyksa through the disciples.
verses.science: समयतक अति कठोर तप किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा शङ्करं देवं शक्त्या परमयान्वितम् । प्रणम्य दण्डवद्ब्रह्मा स तुष्टाव कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ śaktyā paramayānvitam | praṇamya daṇḍavadbrahmā sa tuṣṭāva kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: In die fiflh aeon of Dvkpara there will be Savitf Vyksa. I shall be born as a Yogin of great penance and called Kafika.
verses.hindi: हूँ। अत: है मुनिशार्दूल! आप वर माँगें
verses.commentary: Sense: In die fiflh aeon of Dvkpara there will be Savitf Vyksa. I shall be born as a Yogin of great penance and called Kafika.
verses.science: हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवो महादेवो वाचा मेघगभीरया । सम्भवाय सुसम्प्रीतो विश्वकर्ता महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: atha devo mahādevo vācā meghagabhīrayā | sambhavāya susamprīto viśvakartā maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O Siva, O mother, O beloved of Siva, for the in¬ crease of the mobile and immobile beings of the universe, give me the pov/er to create women. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: दुन्दुभि: शतरूपश्च हृषीकः केतुमांस्तथा॥ १२ केतुमान् नामक वेदज्ञ ब्राह्मण मेरे शिष्य होंगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, O mother, O beloved of Siva, for the in¬ crease of the mobile and immobile beings of the universe, give me the pov/er to create women. Obeisance be to you.
verses.science: दुन्दुभि: शतरूपश्च हृषीकः केतुमांस्तथा॥ १२ केतुमान् नामक वेदज्ञ ब्राह्मण मेरे शिष्य होंगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । वत्स वत्स महाभाग मम पुत्र पितामह । ज्ञातवानस्मि सर्वं तत्तत्त्वतस्ते मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | vatsa vatsa mahābhāga mama putra pitāmaha | jñātavānasmi sarvaṃ tattattvataste manoratham
verses.translation: O goddess bestowing boons, I request for another boon from you. O mother of the universe, take pity on me and grant that too unto me. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: पापनाशन नामक मेरे चार पुत्र (शिष्य) होंगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess bestowing boons, I request for another boon from you. O mother of the universe, take pity on me and grant that too unto me. Obeisance be to you.
verses.science: पापनाशन नामक मेरे चार पुत्र (शिष्य) होंगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानामेव वृद्ध्यर्थं तपस्तप्तं त्वयाधुना । तपसा तेन तुष्टोऽस्मि ददामि च तवेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: prajānāmeva vṛddhyarthaṃ tapastaptaṃ tvayādhunā | tapasā tena tuṣṭo'smi dadāmi ca tavepsitam
verses.translation: O omnipresent mother, be born as the daughter of Daka, my son, for the increase of the mobile and im¬ mobile beings through only I5a."
verses.hindi: त्याग दिया था, पुन: जीवित कर दिया था
verses.commentary: Sense: O omnipresent mother, be born as the daughter of Daka, my son, for the increase of the mobile and im¬ mobile beings through only I5a."
verses.science: त्याग दिया था, पुन: जीवित कर दिया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा परमोदारं स्वभावमधुरं वचः । पृथक्चकार वपुषो भागाद्देवीं शिवां शिवः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā paramodāraṃ svabhāvamadhuraṃ vacaḥ | pṛthakcakāra vapuṣo bhāgāddevīṃ śivāṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Thus implored by the Creator, the Supreme goddess consented and bestowed that power upon the Creator.
verses.hindi: अंशसे उत्पन्न ऋषभ पुन: सहसा उसके घर गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored by the Creator, the Supreme goddess consented and bestowed that power upon the Creator.
verses.science: अंशसे उत्पन्न ऋषभ पुन: सहसा उसके घर गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा परमां शक्तिं पृथग्भूतां शिवागताम् । प्रणिपत्य विनीतात्मा प्रार्थयामास तां विधिः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāṃ śaktiṃ pṛthagbhūtāṃ śivāgatām | praṇipatya vinītātmā prārthayāmāsa tāṃ vidhiḥ
verses.translation: Hence that goddess Siva, the Sakti of Siva consti¬ tuting the universe, created a Sakti equal in lustre unto her self, from the middle of her eyebrows.
verses.hindi: किया, जो शत्रुओंके विनाशमें समर्थ था
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence that goddess Siva, the Sakti of Siva consti¬ tuting the universe, created a Sakti equal in lustre unto her self, from the middle of her eyebrows.
verses.science: किया, जो शत्रुओंके विनाशमें समर्थ था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । देवदेवेन सृष्टोऽहमादौ त्वत्पतिना शिवे । प्रजाः सर्वा नियुक्ताश्च शम्भुना परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | devadevena sṛṣṭo'hamādau tvatpatinā śive | prajāḥ sarvā niyuktāśca śambhunā paramātmanā
verses.translation: Siva, the foremost among gods, the ocean of mercy, the great Iana indulging in divine sports saw that Sakti and laughingly spoke to her.
verses.hindi: हाथियोंका बल भी उसे प्रदान किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, the foremost among gods, the ocean of mercy, the great Iana indulging in divine sports saw that Sakti and laughingly spoke to her.
verses.science: हाथियोंका बल भी उसे प्रदान किया। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: मनसा निर्मिताः सर्वे शिवे देवादयो मया । न वृद्धिमुपगच्छन्ति सृज्यमानाः पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: manasā nirmitāḥ sarve śive devādayo mayā | na vṛddhimupagacchanti sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: "O goddess, yon have been propitiated by Brahma, through his penance. Lovingly become pleased with him and fulfil his desires."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O goddess, yon have been propitiated by Brahma, through his penance. Lovingly become pleased with him and fulfil his desires."
verses.science: स्वेच्छागामी प्रभु ऋषभ चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मिथुनप्रभवामेव कृत्वा सृष्टिमतः परम् । संवर्द्धयितुमिच्छामि सर्वा एव मम प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: mithunaprabhavāmeva kṛtvā sṛṣṭimataḥ param | saṃvarddhayitumicchāmi sarvā eva mama prajāḥ
verses.translation: Receiving that behest of lord Siva with her bent head, the goddess became the daughter of Daka on the im¬ portunity of Brahma.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग्य यशस्यमायुष्यं श्रोतव्यं च प्रयत्नत: ॥ ४८  बढ़ानेवाला है, इसे यत्लपूर्वक सुनना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Receiving that behest of lord Siva with her bent head, the goddess became the daughter of Daka on the im¬ portunity of Brahma.
verses.science: स्वर्ग्य यशस्यमायुष्यं श्रोतव्यं च प्रयत्नत: ॥ ४८ बढ़ानेवाला है, इसे यत्लपूर्वक सुनना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न निर्गतं पुरा त्वत्तो नारीणां कुलमव्ययम् । तेन नारीकुलं स्रष्टुं मम शक्तिर्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: na nirgataṃ purā tvatto nārīṇāṃ kulamavyayam | tena nārīkulaṃ sraṣṭuṃ mama śaktirna vidyate
verses.translation: O sage, after giving the unequalled power to Brahma, the goddess Siva entered the body of Siva. And lord Siva vanished from the scene.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृ्तीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायाग॒षभचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्थोड ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after giving the unequalled power to Brahma, the goddess Siva entered the body of Siva. And lord Siva vanished from the scene.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृ्तीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायाग॒षभचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्थोड ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां त्वत्तः खलु समुद्भवः । तस्मात्त्वां परमां शक्तिं प्रार्थयाम्यखिलेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ tvattaḥ khalu samudbhavaḥ | tasmāttvāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ prārthayāmyakhileśvarīm
verses.translation: Thus O dear, the excellent form of iSiva, half¬ male and half-female that bestows auspiciousness upon the good has been told.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus O dear, the excellent form of iSiva, half¬ male and half-female that bestows auspiciousness upon the good has been told.
verses.science: नामक चौथा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवे नारीकुलं स्रष्टुं शक्तिं देहि नमोऽस्तु ते । चराचरजगद्वृद्धिहेतोर्मातः शिवप्रिये
verses.transliteration: śive nārīkulaṃ sraṣṭuṃ śaktiṃ dehi namo'stu te | carācarajagadvṛddhihetormātaḥ śivapriye
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, the story of!§iva that ever confers happiness, was gladly and lovingly narrated by Siva to Brahma.
verses.hindi: प्रलम्बक नामक चार दृढ़ब्ती मेरे शिष्य होंगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumara, the story of!§iva that ever confers happiness, was gladly and lovingly narrated by Siva to Brahma.
verses.science: प्रलम्बक नामक चार दृढ़ब्ती मेरे शिष्य होंगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यं त्वत्तः प्रार्थयामि वरं च वरदेश्वरि । देहि मे तं कृपां कृत्वा जगन्मातर्नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: anyaṃ tvattaḥ prārthayāmi varaṃ ca varadeśvari | dehi me taṃ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā jaganmātarnamo'stu te
verses.translation: In the seventh Varaha Kalpa, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the lord Kalpeivara who illuminates all the worlds will be bom as your great grandson and son of Vaivasvata Manu. O Creator, in that Manvantara all the four Yugas will take place.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the seventh Varaha Kalpa, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the lord Kalpeivara who illuminates all the worlds will be bom as your great grandson and son of Vaivasvata Manu. O Creator, in that Manvantara all the four Yugas will take place.
verses.science: सहायतार्थ निवृत्तिमार्गको दृढ़ करूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चराचरविवृद्ध्यर्थमीशेनैकेन सर्वगे । दक्षस्य मम पुत्रस्य पुत्री भव भवाम्बिके
verses.transliteration: carācaravivṛddhyarthamīśenaikena sarvage | dakṣasya mama putrasya putrī bhava bhavāmbike
verses.translation: For the welfare of the worlds and for the benefit of the brahmins O Creator, whatever will take place in the Yuga called Dvapara, 1 foresee now.
verses.hindi: एवं शर्व नामक मेरे परम योगी चार पुत्र होंगे
verses.commentary: Sense: For the welfare of the worlds and for the benefit of the brahmins O Creator, whatever will take place in the Yuga called Dvapara, 1 foresee now.
verses.science: एवं शर्व नामक मेरे परम योगी चार पुत्र होंगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं संयाचिता देवी ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरी । तथास्त्विति वचः प्रोच्य तच्छक्तिं विधये ददौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃyācitā devī brahmaṇā parameśvarī | tathāstviti vacaḥ procya tacchaktiṃ vidhaye dadau
