verses.science: श्रुणु प्रीत्या महादोषसंहरत्री भक्तिवर्द्धनीम्॥ १ बढ़ानेवाली दूसरी भेरवी कथाको प्रेमपूर्वक सुनिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र श्रुतिसमूहानां विधानं ब्रह्मलक्षणम् । भविष्यति तदा कल्पे कृष्णद्वैपायनो यदा
verses.transliteration: tatra śrutisamūhānāṃ vidhānaṃ brahmalakṣaṇam | bhaviṣyati tadā kalpe kṛṣṇadvaipāyano yadā
verses.translation: On hearing that, the sage SiJada bowed to die moon-crested lord and spoke in word* choked with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that, the sage SiJada bowed to die moon-crested lord and spoke in word* choked with pleasure.
verses.science: पीछा करना न छोड़ा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणमनुगृह्य महेश्वरः । पुनः सम्प्रेक्ष्य देवेशस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā brahmāṇamanugṛhya maheśvaraḥ | punaḥ samprekṣya deveśastatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: O lord Siva, if you are delighted, if you are ready to grant boons, I wish for a son equal to you, devoid of death and not bom of a womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, if you are delighted, if you are ready to grant boons, I wish for a son equal to you, devoid of death and not bom of a womb.
verses.science: ही जाननी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After a short while, my father, the foremost among those who knew the sacrificial rites, ordered for the construc¬ tion of the sacrificial altar for the performance of sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a short while, my father, the foremost among those who knew the sacrificial rites, ordered for the construc¬ tion of the sacrificial altar for the performance of sacrifice.
verses.science: सब कुछ देनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: After a short while, my father, the foremost among those who knew the sacrificial rites, ordered for the construc¬ tion of the sacrificial altar for the performance of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: द्वारा हृदयमें देखते हैं, वे ये ही हैं, आप उनको देखें
verses.commentary: Sense: After a short while, my father, the foremost among those who knew the sacrificial rites, ordered for the construc¬ tion of the sacrificial altar for the performance of sacrifice.
verses.science: द्वारा हृदयमें देखते हैं, वे ये ही हैं, आप उनको देखें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । नन्दिकेशावतारवर्णनम् । अथ नन्दीश्वरावतारमाह । सनत्कुमार उवाच । भवान्कथमनुप्राप्तो महादेवांशजः शिवम् । श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि मे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.6. ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | nandikeśāvatāravarṇanam | atha nandīśvarāvatāramāha | sanatkumāra uvāca | bhavānkathamanuprāpto mahādevāṃśajaḥ śivam | śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi me prabho
verses.translation: Then Pukaravartaka*' and other clouds showered. When I was born as the son of Silada, the Kinnaras, Siddhas, Sadhyas and other beings walked through the sky and the great sages made showers of flowers all round.
verses.hindi: स्वरूप धारणकर यहाँ आ रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Pukaravartaka*' and other clouds showered. When I was born as the son of Silada, the Kinnaras, Siddhas, Sadhyas and other beings walked through the sky and the great sages made showers of flowers all round.
verses.science: स्वरूप धारणकर यहाँ आ रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ सावधानतया शृणु । यथाऽहं च शिवं प्राप्तो महादेवांशजो मुने
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | sanatkumāra sarvajña sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu | yathā'haṃ ca śivaṃ prāpto mahādevāṃśajo mune
verses.translation: When I completed the age of seven, the two sages Mitra and Varuna came to the hermitage at the bidding of the lord in order to see me.
verses.commentary: Sense: When I completed the age of seven, the two sages Mitra and Varuna came to the hermitage at the bidding of the lord in order to see me.
verses.science: समस्त चेष्टाएँ ठीक-ठीक जानता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाकामः शिलादोऽभूदुक्तः पितृभिरादरात् । तदुद्धर्तुमना भक्त्या समुद्धारमभीप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: prajākāmaḥ śilādo'bhūduktaḥ pitṛbhirādarāt | taduddhartumanā bhaktyā samuddhāramabhīpsubhiḥ
verses.translation: Delighted with that Japa, lord Siva, accompanied by Parvati and bedecked with the crescent moon, said:—
verses.hindi: शम्भुने मुसकराकर हरिसे यह वचन कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted with that Japa, lord Siva, accompanied by Parvati and bedecked with the crescent moon, said:—
verses.science: शम्भुने मुसकराकर हरिसे यह वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधोदृष्टिः सुधर्मात्मा शिलादो नाम वीर्यवान् । तस्यासीन्मुनिकैर्वृत्तिः शिवलोके च सोऽगमत्
verses.transliteration: adhodṛṣṭiḥ sudharmātmā śilādo nāma vīryavān | tasyāsīnmunikairvṛttiḥ śivaloke ca so'gamat
verses.translation: Then, taking me by the hand, lord liva said— "Tell me, what excellent boon shall I grant you?**
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, taking me by the hand, lord liva said— "Tell me, what excellent boon shall I grant you?**
verses.science: ब्रह्महत्यासे छुटकारा मिल जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्रमुद्दिश्य स मुनिस्तपस्तेपे सुदुःसहम् । निश्चलात्मा शिलादाख्यो बहुकालं दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: śakramuddiśya sa munistapastepe suduḥsaham | niścalātmā śilādākhyo bahukālaṃ dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: Shall we dry up the oceans? Shall we kill Yama with his servants? Shall we slay great death or the aged Brahma especially?
verses.commentary: Sense: Shall we dry up the oceans? Shall we kill Yama with his servants? Shall we slay great death or the aged Brahma especially?
verses.science: रूपको धारण किया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपतस्तस्य तपसा सन्तुष्टोऽभूच्छतक्रतुः । जगाम च वरं दातुं सर्वदेवप्रभुस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tapatastasya tapasā santuṣṭo'bhūcchatakratuḥ | jagāma ca varaṃ dātuṃ sarvadevaprabhustadā
verses.translation: O great brahmin, thus at the instance of the great lord, I, Nandilvara was coronated and eulogised by the gods including Brahma.
verses.hindi: देखकर लक्ष्मीजी भी अत्यन्त विस्मित हो गयीं
verses.commentary: Sense: O great brahmin, thus at the instance of the great lord, I, Nandilvara was coronated and eulogised by the gods including Brahma.
verses.science: देखकर लक्ष्मीजी भी अत्यन्त विस्मित हो गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिलादमाह सुप्रीत्या शक्रस्तुष्टोऽस्मि तेऽनघ । तेन त्वं मुनिशार्दूल वरयस्व वरानिति
verses.transliteration: śilādamāha suprītyā śakrastuṣṭo'smi te'nagha | tena tvaṃ muniśārdūla varayasva varāniti
verses.translation: O great sage, the marriage having been celebrated thus I, in the company of my wife, saluted the feet of l3iva, BrahmS and Vinu for the sake of welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, the marriage having been celebrated thus I, in the company of my wife, saluted the feet of l3iva, BrahmS and Vinu for the sake of welfare.
verses.science: तथा लोकोंकी रक्षा कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं स्तुत्वा स्तुतिभिरादरात् । शिलादो मुनिशार्दूलस्तमाह सुकृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ stutvā stutibhirādarāt | śilādo muniśārdūlastamāha sukṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Siva, lord of the three worlds, favourably disposed towards his devotees spoke these words with great love and pleasure to me accompanied by my wife.
verses.hindi: स्मरणसे ही उसका समस्त दुःख दूर हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, lord of the three worlds, favourably disposed towards his devotees spoke these words with great love and pleasure to me accompanied by my wife.
verses.science: स्मरणसे ही उसका समस्त दुःख दूर हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिलाद उवाच । शतक्रतो सुरेशान सन्तुष्टो यदि मे प्रभो । अयोनिजं मुत्युहीनं पुत्रमिच्छामि सुव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: śilāda uvāca | śatakrato sureśāna santuṣṭo yadi me prabho | ayonijaṃ mutyuhīnaṃ putramicchāmi suvratam
verses.translation: O Nandiia, O lord of Ganas, I am always pleased with you in the company of the goddess. O dear boy, listen to my weighty words.
verses.hindi: शान्त करनेमें समर्थ हैं--यह पूर्णरूपसे निश्चित है
verses.commentary: Sense: O Nandiia, O lord of Ganas, I am always pleased with you in the company of the goddess. O dear boy, listen to my weighty words.
verses.science: शान्त करनेमें समर्थ हैं--यह पूर्णरूपसे निश्चित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच । पुत्रं दास्यामि पुत्रार्थिन्योनिजं मृत्युसंयुतम् । अन्यथा ते न दास्यामि मृत्युहीना न सन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: śakra uvāca | putraṃ dāsyāmi putrārthinyonijaṃ mṛtyusaṃyutam | anyathā te na dāsyāmi mṛtyuhīnā na santi vai
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other gods together with their wives, Vi?nu, Siva and Parvati came there lovingly.
verses.hindi: महादेवका दर्शन किया जा रहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma and other gods together with their wives, Vi?nu, Siva and Parvati came there lovingly.
verses.science: महादेवका दर्शन किया जा रहा है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न दास्यामि सुतं तेऽहं मृत्युहीनमयोनिजम् । हरिर्विधिश्च भगवान्किमुतान्यो महामुने
verses.transliteration: na dāsyāmi sutaṃ te'haṃ mṛtyuhīnamayonijam | harirvidhiśca bhagavānkimutānyo mahāmune
verses.translation: After praising Silada and eulogising Siva and Par¬ vati by reciting good hymns all of them returned to their respective abodes. Siva and Siva, the lord and goddess of all, went away too.
verses.commentary: Sense: After praising Silada and eulogising Siva and Par¬ vati by reciting good hymns all of them returned to their respective abodes. Siva and Siva, the lord and goddess of all, went away too.
verses.science: करनेवाले तथा मोक्षदायक हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तावपि त्रिपुरार्यङ्गसम्भवौ मरणान्वितौ । तयोरप्यायुषां मानं कथितं निगमे पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tāvapi tripurāryaṅgasambhavau maraṇānvitau | tayorapyāyuṣāṃ mānaṃ kathitaṃ nigame pṛthak
verses.translation: On seeing me the boy with three eyes, four arms and lustre like that of Yama, sun and fire and clad in matted hair and coronet, Silida was highly delighted. I was
verses.hindi: और कुछ भी अशुभ बात नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing me the boy with three eyes, four arms and lustre like that of Yama, sun and fire and clad in matted hair and coronet, Silida was highly delighted. I was
verses.science: और कुछ भी अशुभ बात नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादयोनिजे पुत्रे मृत्युहीने प्रयत्नतः । परित्यजाशां विप्रेन्द्र गृहाणात्मक्षमं सुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādayonije putre mṛtyuhīne prayatnataḥ | parityajāśāṃ viprendra gṛhāṇātmakṣamaṃ sutam
verses.translation: ForPufkara, Avartaka etc. see note.
verses.commentary: Sense: ForPufkara, Avartaka etc. see note.
verses.science: प्रणाम करके यह कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु देवेश्वरो रुद्रः प्रसीदति महेश्वरः । सुदुर्लभो मृत्युहीनस्तव पुत्रो ह्ययोनिजः
verses.transliteration: kintu deveśvaro rudraḥ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ | sudurlabho mṛtyuhīnastava putro hyayonijaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, since I have been delighted by you, you will be named Nandin. Hence I bow to you, bliss (incarnate), the lord of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, since I have been delighted by you, you will be named Nandin. Hence I bow to you, bliss (incarnate), the lord of the universe.
verses.science: यह क्‍या कर रहे हैं ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहं च विष्णुर्भगवान् द्रुहिणश्च महामुने । अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनं पुत्रं दातुं न शक्नुमः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ ca viṣṇurbhagavān druhiṇaśca mahāmune | ayonijaṃ mṛtyuhīnaṃ putraṃ dātuṃ na śaknumaḥ
verses.translation: My delighted father after bowing to the gpreat lord returned to his hut with me, as pleased as an indigent person who had struck a treasure-trove.
verses.hindi: राज्य देनेवाले ! मुझे यह सन्देह हो रहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: My delighted father after bowing to the gpreat lord returned to his hut with me, as pleased as an indigent person who had struck a treasure-trove.
verses.science: राज्य देनेवाले ! मुझे यह सन्देह हो रहा है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आराधय महादेवं तत्पुत्रविनिकाम्यया । सर्वेश्वरो महाशक्तः स ते पुत्रं प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: ārādhaya mahādevaṃ tatputravinikāmyayā | sarveśvaro mahāśaktaḥ sa te putraṃ pradāsyati
verses.translation: O great sage, when I reached the hut I cast off my divine form and assumed the human one.
verses.hindi: उन प्रभुने विष्णुजीसे हँसते हुए कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, when I reached the hut I cast off my divine form and assumed the human one.
verses.science: उन प्रभुने विष्णुजीसे हँसते हुए कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवं व्याहृत्य विप्रेन्द्रमनुगृह्य च तं घृणी । देवैर्वृतः सुरेशानः स्वलोकं समगान्मुने
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evaṃ vyāhṛtya viprendramanugṛhya ca taṃ ghṛṇī | devairvṛtaḥ sureśānaḥ svalokaṃ samagānmune
verses.translation: After seeing me assuming human form, my father, honoured by the world, was distressed and so lamented sur¬ rounded by his own people.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--हे मुने! परम दयालु इन्द्र उन विप्रेन्द्रको इस प्रकारसे कहकर तथा उनपर अनुग्रह करके देवताओंके साथ अपने लोकको चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: After seeing me assuming human form, my father, honoured by the world, was distressed and so lamented sur¬ rounded by his own people.

verses.sanskrit: गते तस्मिंश्च वरदे सहस्राक्षे शिलाशनः । आराधयन्महादेवं तपसाऽतोषयद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: gate tasmiṃśca varade sahasrākṣe śilāśanaḥ | ārādhayanmahādevaṃ tapasā'toṣayadbhavam
verses.translation: The son of jlahk&yana SilSda fond of his son performed all the post-natal** rites for me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of jlahk&yana SilSda fond of his son performed all the post-natal** rites for me.
verses.science: पुनः इस प्रकार कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यैवमनिशं तत्परस्य द्विजस्त वै । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु गतं क्षणमिवाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: atha tasyaivamaniśaṃ tatparasya dvijasta vai | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu gataṃ kṣaṇamivādbhutam
verses.translation: Within 6ve years my father taught me all the Vedas with their Ahgas and Upahgas as well as other sacred texts.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म आदि भी मोहित हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Within 6ve years my father taught me all the Vedas with their Ahgas and Upahgas as well as other sacred texts.
verses.science: ब्रह्म आदि भी मोहित हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वल्मीकेन वृताङ्गश्च लक्षकोटगणैर्मुनिः । वज्रसूचीमुखैश्चान्यै रक्तभुग्भिश्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: valmīkena vṛtāṅgaśca lakṣakoṭagaṇairmuniḥ | vajrasūcīmukhaiścānyai raktabhugbhiśca sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Duly welcomed by the sage and seated on their seats, the great sag of noble soul looked at me again and again and said.
verses.hindi: आप स्वतन्त्र होकर क्रीड़ा करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Duly welcomed by the sage and seated on their seats, the great sag of noble soul looked at me again and again and said.
verses.science: आप स्वतन्त्र होकर क्रीड़ा करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्मांसरुधिरत्वग्वै बिले तस्मिन्नवस्थितः । अस्थिशेषोऽभवत्पश्चाच्छिलादो मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nirmāṃsarudhiratvagvai bile tasminnavasthitaḥ | asthiśeṣo'bhavatpaścācchilādo munisattamaḥ
verses.translation: O dear sage, although he has mastered the sacred lore, your son Nandin will be short-live I do not his life for more thsm a year from now.
verses.hindi: निष्पाप शिव! आपके पीछे ब्रह्महत्या लगी है
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear sage, although he has mastered the sacred lore, your son Nandin will be short-live I do not his life for more thsm a year from now.
verses.science: निष्पाप शिव! आपके पीछे ब्रह्महत्या लगी है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टः प्रभुस्तदा तस्मै दर्शयामास स्वां तनुम् । दिव्यां दिव्यगुणैर्युक्तामलभ्यां वामबुद्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭaḥ prabhustadā tasmai darśayāmāsa svāṃ tanum | divyāṃ divyaguṇairyuktāmalabhyāṃ vāmabuddhibhiḥ
verses.translation: When the brahmins said this, SilSda fond of his swi was much distressed. He lamented loudly after embracing me.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the brahmins said this, SilSda fond of his swi was much distressed. He lamented loudly after embracing me.
verses.science: विनष्ट हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवर्षसहस्रेण तप्यमानाय शूलधृक् । सर्वदेवाधिपस्तस्मै वरदोऽस्मीत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: divyavarṣasahasreṇa tapyamānāya śūladhṛk | sarvadevādhipastasmai varado'smītyabhāṣata
verses.translation: On seeing my father and grand-father fallen like
verses.hindi: पाप भी उसे बाधित नहीं कर सकता है
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing my father and grand-father fallen like
verses.science: पाप भी उसे बाधित नहीं कर सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महासमाधिसंलीनः स शिलादो महामुनिः । नाशृणोत्तद्गिरं शम्भोर्भक्त्यधीनतरस्य वै
verses.transliteration: mahāsamādhisaṃlīnaḥ sa śilādo mahāmuniḥ | nāśṛṇottadgiraṃ śambhorbhaktyadhīnatarasya vai
verses.translation: **0 father, what is your distress for which you
verses.commentary: Sense: **0 father, what is your distress for which you
verses.science: आपका कुतूहलमात्र है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा स्पृष्टो मुनिस्तेन करेण त्रिपुरारिणा । तदैव मुनिशार्दूल उत्ससर्ज तपःक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yadā spṛṣṭo munistena kareṇa tripurāriṇā | tadaiva muniśārdūla utsasarja tapaḥkramam
verses.translation: O son, I am much distressed at the thought of
verses.hindi: परमेश्वरका मैं दर्शन कर रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, I am much distressed at the thought of
verses.science: परमेश्वरका मैं दर्शन कर रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोन्मील्य मुनिर्नेत्रे सोमं शम्भुं विलोकयन् । द्रुतं प्रणम्य समुदा पादयोर्न्यपतन्मुने
verses.transliteration: athonmīlya munirnetre somaṃ śambhuṃ vilokayan | drutaṃ praṇamya samudā pādayornyapatanmune
verses.translation: O father, I shall deceive death by means of my penance, not learning. By worshipping great god, I will con¬ quer death, not otherwise.
verses.hindi: तृणके समान ज्ञात हो रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O father, I shall deceive death by means of my penance, not learning. By worshipping great god, I will con¬ quer death, not otherwise.
verses.science: तृणके समान ज्ञात हो रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हर्षगद्गदया वाचा नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः । प्रसन्नात्मा शिलादः स तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: harṣagadgadayā vācā nataskandhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | prasannātmā śilādaḥ sa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: O sage, after saying this and bowing at his feet And circumambulating my father I went to the excellent forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after saying this and bowing at his feet And circumambulating my father I went to the excellent forest.
verses.science: चलनेको उद्यत हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्देवदेवस्त्रिलोचनः । वरदोऽस्मीति तं प्राह शिलादं मुनिपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavāndevadevastrilocanaḥ | varado'smīti taṃ prāha śilādaṃ munipuṅgavam
verses.translation: O sage, after going there and staying in an isolated place with a steady mind I performed a severe penance very difficult even for good sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after going there and staying in an isolated place with a steady mind I performed a severe penance very difficult even for good sages.
verses.science: त्रिशूलधारी भेरवको छोड़ दो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसानेन किं कार्यं भवते हि महामते । ददामि पुत्रं सर्वज्ञं सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगम्
verses.transliteration: tapasānena kiṃ kāryaṃ bhavate hi mahāmate | dadāmi putraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvaśāstrārthapāragam
verses.translation: Meditating in the lotus-like cavity of the heart the lord Tryambaka, Sadaiva wtih five faces,** ten arms and three eyes and quiet in features I performed the repetition of Rudra Japa. I was in great meditation on the northern bank of the river. My mind was concentrated and I had pure thoughts.
verses.hindi: इस बहानेसे मैं भी अपनेको पवित्र कर लूँगी
verses.wordMeaning: Meditating in the lotus-like cavity of the heart the lord Tryambaka, Sadaiva wtih five faces,** ten arms and three eyes and quiet in features I performed the repetition of Rudra Japa. I was in great meditation on the northern bank of the river.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditating in the lotus-like cavity of the heart the lord Tryambaka, Sadaiva wtih five faces,** ten arms and three eyes and quiet in features I performed the repetition of Rudra Japa. I was in great meditation on the northern bank of the river.…
verses.science: इस बहानेसे मैं भी अपनेको पवित्र कर लूँगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं तच्छ्रुत्वा च शिलाशनः । हर्षगद्गदया वाचोवाच सोमविभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ tacchrutvā ca śilāśanaḥ | harṣagadgadayā vācovāca somavibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: "O Sailadi (son of Silada) I have been pleased by this penance of yours. O intelligent one, you have performed the penance very well. Tell me what you desire. I am here the granter of boons."
verses.hindi: स्वभावके अनुरूप ही आप वचन बोल रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Sailadi (son of Silada) I have been pleased by this penance of yours. O intelligent one, you have performed the penance very well. Tell me what you desire. I am here the granter of boons."
verses.science: स्वभावके अनुरूप ही आप वचन बोल रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिलाद उवाच । महेश यदि तुष्टोऽसि यदि वा वरदश्च मे । इच्छामि त्वत्समं पुत्रं मृत्युहीनमयोनिजम्
verses.transliteration: śilāda uvāca | maheśa yadi tuṣṭo'si yadi vā varadaśca me | icchāmi tvatsamaṃ putraṃ mṛtyuhīnamayonijam
verses.translation: When thus addressed by the lord I bowed to his feet with my head and eulogised lord Siva, the destroyer of the sorrow of old age.
verses.hindi: अतिसंस्कृत भिक्षाओंसे भी नहीं प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: When thus addressed by the lord I bowed to his feet with my head and eulogised lord Siva, the destroyer of the sorrow of old age.
verses.science: अतिसंस्कृत भिक्षाओंसे भी नहीं प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्तस्ततो देवस्त्र्यम्बकस्तेन शङ्करः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा शिलादं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktastato devastryambakastena śaṅkaraḥ | pratyuvāca prasannātmā śilādaṃ munisattamam
verses.translation: I was endowed with great devotion. My eyes were filled with tears. I fell prostrate at his feet with my head resting there. Lord Siva, the destroyer of great distress, lifted me up and stroked me with his hands. The bull-ban¬ nered lord clasped me with his hands and stood face to face with me.
verses.wordMeaning: I was endowed with great devotion. My eyes were filled with tears. I fell prostrate at his feet with my head resting there. Lord Siva, the destroyer of great distress, lifted me up and stroked me with his hands.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I was endowed with great devotion. My eyes were filled with tears. I fell prostrate at his feet with my head resting there. Lord Siva, the destroyer of great distress, lifted me up and stroked me with his hands.…
verses.science: महेश्वरसे बोले--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ शिव उवाच । पूर्वमाराधितो विप्र ब्रह्मणाऽहं तपोधन । तपसा चावतारार्थं मुनिभिश्च सुरोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: || śiva uvāca | pūrvamārādhito vipra brahmaṇā'haṃ tapodhana | tapasā cāvatārārthaṃ munibhiśca surottamaiḥ
verses.translation: Glancing at the leaders of the Gaas and the god¬ dess, the daughter of Himavat, the lord of the worlds, looked at me with sympathy and spoke.
verses.hindi: आपका दर्शन बिना यलके प्राप्त निधिके समान है
verses.commentary: Sense: Glancing at the leaders of the Gaas and the god¬ dess, the daughter of Himavat, the lord of the worlds, looked at me with sympathy and spoke.
verses.science: आपका दर्शन बिना यलके प्राप्त निधिके समान है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रो भविष्यामि नन्दी नाम्ना त्वयोनिजः । पिता भविष्यसि मम पितुर्वै जगतां मुने
verses.transliteration: tava putro bhaviṣyāmi nandī nāmnā tvayonijaḥ | pitā bhaviṣyasi mama piturvai jagatāṃ mune
verses.translation: "Dear Nandin, O intelligent one, wherefore can you be afraid of death? The two brahmins were sent by me alone. There is no doubt. You are equal to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dear Nandin, O intelligent one, wherefore can you be afraid of death? The two brahmins were sent by me alone. There is no doubt. You are equal to me.
verses.science: वरका वरण नहीं करता हूं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा मुनिं प्रेक्ष्य प्रणिपत्यास्थितं घृणी । सोमस्तूर्णं तमादिश्य तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktvā muniṃ prekṣya praṇipatyāsthitaṃ ghṛṇī | somastūrṇaṃ tamādiśya tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ
verses.translation: You will be free from death and old age. You
verses.commentary: Sense: You will be free from death and old age. You
verses.science: वाराणसीपुरीमें जा पहुँचे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गते तस्मिन्महादेवे स शिलादो महामुनिः । स्वमाश्रममुपागम्य ऋषिभ्योऽकथयत्ततः
verses.transliteration: gate tasminmahādeve sa śilādo mahāmuniḥ | svamāśramamupāgamya ṛṣibhyo'kathayattataḥ
verses.translation: On the five*faced form of iSiva see note
verses.commentary: Sense: On the five*faced form of iSiva see note
verses.science: पातालमें चली गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कियता चैव कालेन तदासौ जनकः स मे । यज्ञाङ्गणं चकर्षाशु यज्ञार्थं यज्ञवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: kiyatā caiva kālena tadāsau janakaḥ sa me | yajñāṅgaṇaṃ cakarṣāśu yajñārthaṃ yajñavittamaḥ
verses.translation: You will gain strength from me. You will always be at my sides. You will be for ever my favourite. Due to my favour you will have neither birth, nor death, nor old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will gain strength from me. You will always be at my sides. You will be for ever my favourite. Due to my favour you will have neither birth, nor death, nor old age.
verses.science: नामसे प्रसिद्ध हो गया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षणादहं शम्भोस्तनुजस्तस्य चाज्ञया । स जातः पूर्वमेवाहं युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṣaṇādahaṃ śambhostanujastasya cājñayā | sa jātaḥ pūrvamevāhaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus, the store*house of mercy took off his own lotus>garland round his head and tied it round my neck immediately.
verses.hindi: देखकर रुद्र सबके सामने परमानन्दसे नाचने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, the store*house of mercy took off his own lotus>garland round his head and tied it round my neck immediately.
verses.science: देखकर रुद्र सबके सामने परमानन्दसे नाचने लगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अवर्षंस्तदा पुष्करावर्तकाद्या जगुः खेचराः किन्नराः सिद्धसाध्याः । शिलादात्मजत्वं गते मय्यृषीन्द्राः समन्ताच्च वृष्टिं व्यधुः कौसुमीं ते
verses.transliteration: avarṣaṃstadā puṣkarāvartakādyā jaguḥ khecarāḥ kinnarāḥ siddhasādhyāḥ | śilādātmajatvaṃ gate mayyṛṣīndrāḥ samantācca vṛṣṭiṃ vyadhuḥ kausumīṃ te
verses.translation: O brahmin, as soon as that garland adorned my neck I became three-eyed and ten-armed like a second liva.
verses.hindi: इसलिये काशीका ही सेवन करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, as soon as that garland adorned my neck I became three-eyed and ten-armed like a second liva.
verses.science: इसलिये काशीका ही सेवन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवा देवपत्न्यश्च सर्वशः । तत्राजग्मुश्च सुप्रीत्या हरिश्चैव शिवोऽम्बिका
verses.transliteration: atha brahmādayo devā devapatnyaśca sarvaśaḥ | tatrājagmuśca suprītyā hariścaiva śivo'mbikā
verses.translation: Then he took the water from his matted hair, water as pure as necklace, and said "Be Nandin.** Then the bull-bannered lord let off the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he took the water from his matted hair, water as pure as necklace, and said "Be Nandin.** Then the bull-bannered lord let off the water.
verses.science: तिथिको आविर्भूत हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सवो महानासीन्ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः । आदृत्य मां तथालिङ्ग्य तुष्टुवुर्हर्षिताश्च ते
verses.transliteration: tadotsavo mahānāsīnnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | ādṛtya māṃ tathāliṅgya tuṣṭuvurharṣitāśca te
verses.translation: Then five auspicious rivers flowed. They had pure water. They were very rapid. They were beautiful and dmne in form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then five auspicious rivers flowed. They had pure water. They were very rapid. They were beautiful and dmne in form.
verses.science: सद्गतिको प्राप्त कर लेगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रशस्य शिलादं तं स्तुत्वा च सुस्तवैः शिवौ । सर्वे जग्मुश्च धामानि शिवावप्यखिलेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: supraśasya śilādaṃ taṃ stutvā ca sustavaiḥ śivau | sarve jagmuśca dhāmāni śivāvapyakhileśvarau
verses.translation: The five rivers** are glorified thus—Jafodaka, Tris- rotas, Vradhvani, Svarnodaka and Jambunadi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five rivers** are glorified thus—Jafodaka, Tris- rotas, Vradhvani, Svarnodaka and Jambunadi.
verses.science: महादुःखको प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिलादोऽपि च मां दृष्ट्वा कालसूर्यानलप्रभम् । त्र्यक्षं चतुर्भुजं बालं जटामुकुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: śilādo'pi ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā kālasūryānalaprabham | tryakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ bālaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam
verses.translation: He who goes to the holy centre of Paficanada, takes his bath there, performs the Japa of the lord of lords and worships him, certainly attains the Sayujya of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who goes to the holy centre of Paficanada, takes his bath there, performs the Japa of the lord of lords and worships him, certainly attains the Sayujya of Siva.
verses.science: समान बढ़ते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलाद्यायुधं दीप्तं सर्वथा रुद्ररूपिणम् । महानन्दभरः प्रीत्या प्रणम्यं प्रणनाम च
verses.transliteration: triśūlādyāyudhaṃ dīptaṃ sarvathā rudrarūpiṇam | mahānandabharaḥ prītyā praṇamyaṃ praṇanāma ca
verses.translation: Then Siva said to Parvati "I am going to coro¬ nate Nandin and proclaim him as the lord of Ganas. O unchanging goddess, what do you think?"
verses.hindi: कृष्णपक्षके चन्द्रमाके समान क्षीण हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva said to Parvati "I am going to coro¬ nate Nandin and proclaim him as the lord of Ganas. O unchanging goddess, what do you think?"
verses.science: कृष्णपक्षके चन्द्रमाके समान क्षीण हो जाता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिलाद उवाच । त्वयाहं नन्दितो यस्मान्नन्दी नाम्ना सुरेश्वर । तस्मात्त्वां देवमानन्दं नमामि जगदीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: śilāda uvāca | tvayāhaṃ nandito yasmānnandī nāmnā sureśvara | tasmāttvāṃ devamānandaṃ namāmi jagadīśvaram
verses.translation: O lord of gods, it behoves you to give that to Nandin. O lord, Sailadi is my most beloved son. *
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, it behoves you to give that to Nandin. O lord, Sailadi is my most beloved son. *
verses.science: मुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । मया सह पिता हृष्टः सुप्रणम्य महेश्वरम् । उटजं स्वं जगामाशु निधिं लब्ध्वेव निर्धनः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | mayā saha pitā hṛṣṭaḥ supraṇamya maheśvaram | uṭajaṃ svaṃ jagāmāśu nidhiṃ labdhveva nirdhanaḥ
verses.translation: Then Siva the independent lord, the Supreme deity, the bestower of everything and favourably disposed towards his devotees remembered his excellent leaders of Ganas.
verses.hindi: प्रादुर्भावं भैरवस्य श्रुत्वा मुच्येत सड्डूटात्॥ ७२  को सुनकर संकटसे छूट जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva the independent lord, the Supreme deity, the bestower of everything and favourably disposed towards his devotees remembered his excellent leaders of Ganas.
verses.science: प्रादुर्भावं भैरवस्य श्रुत्वा मुच्येत सड्डूटात्॥ ७२ को सुनकर संकटसे छूट जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा गतोऽहमुटजं शिलादस्य महामुने । तदाहं तादृशं रूपं त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: yadā gato'hamuṭajaṃ śilādasya mahāmune | tadāhaṃ tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tyaktvā mānuṣyamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Even as they were remembered, all the leading Ganas of Rudra came there. They were countless. They had the shape of Siva. They were highly delighted.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भरवावतारलीलावर्णन॑ नाम नवमो ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as they were remembered, all the leading Ganas of Rudra came there. They were countless. They had the shape of Siva. They were highly delighted.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भरवावतारलीलावर्णन॑ नाम नवमो ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्यमास्थितं दृष्ट्वा पिता मे लोकपूजितः । विललापातिदुःखार्त्तः स्वजनैश्च समावृतः
verses.transliteration: mānuṣyamāsthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā me lokapūjitaḥ | vilalāpātiduḥkhārttaḥ svajanaiśca samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those leading Gaas bowed to lord Siva and the goddess Parvati with joined palms and drooping shoulders. The powerful Ganas spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those leading Gaas bowed to lord Siva and the goddess Parvati with joined palms and drooping shoulders. The powerful Ganas spoke.
verses.science: नामक नौंवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्मादिकान्येव सर्वाण्यपि चकार मे । शालङ्कायनपुत्रो वै शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: jātakarmādikānyeva sarvāṇyapi cakāra me | śālaṅkāyanaputro vai śilādaḥ putravatsalaḥ
verses.translation: O great lord, the destroyer of Tripuras, why are we called? Please command us, O bestower of wishes. We arc your servants and we have come here.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great lord, the destroyer of Tripuras, why are we called? Please command us, O bestower of wishes. We arc your servants and we have come here.
verses.science: हूँ, उसको सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदानध्यापयामास साङ्गोपाङ्गानशेषतः । शास्त्राण्यन्यान्यपि तथा पञ्चवर्षे पिता च माम्
verses.transliteration: vedānadhyāpayāmāsa sāṅgopāṅgānaśeṣataḥ | śāstrāṇyanyānyapi tathā pañcavarṣe pitā ca mām
verses.translation: Shall we bind Indra with all the gods or Visnu vi*ith all his Parsadas and bring diem here? Or the Daityas and Danavas?
verses.hindi: द्वारा दितिके गर्भसे पुत्ररूपमें उत्पन्न हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Shall we bind Indra with all the gods or Visnu vi*ith all his Parsadas and bring diem here? Or the Daityas and Danavas?
verses.science: द्वारा दितिके गर्भसे पुत्ररूपमें उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूर्णे सप्तमे वर्षे मित्रावरुणसंज्ञकौ । मुनी तस्याश्रमं प्राप्तौ द्रष्टुं मां चाज्ञया विभोः
verses.transliteration: sampūrṇe saptame varṣe mitrāvaruṇasaṃjñakau | munī tasyāśramaṃ prāptau draṣṭuṃ māṃ cājñayā vibhoḥ
verses.translation: To whom shall we cause great and terrible distress at your behest? O lord, who is to be extremely jubilant to-day for the increase of all cherished desires?
verses.commentary: Sense: To whom shall we cause great and terrible distress at your behest? O lord, who is to be extremely jubilant to-day for the increase of all cherished desires?
verses.science: पुत्ररूपमें उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृतौ मुनिना तेन सूपविष्टो महामुनी । ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ मां निरीक्ष्य मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: satkṛtau muninā tena sūpaviṣṭo mahāmunī | ūcatuśca mahātmānau māṃ nirīkṣya muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these heroic words of the Ganas the great lord spoke after praising them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these heroic words of the Ganas the great lord spoke after praising them.
verses.science: धारणकर हिरण्याक्षका वध किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणावूचतुः । तात नन्दी तवाल्पायुः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः । न दृष्टमेव चापश्यं ह्यायुर्वर्षादतः परम्
verses.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇāvūcatuḥ | tāta nandī tavālpāyuḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ | na dṛṣṭameva cāpaśyaṃ hyāyurvarṣādataḥ param
verses.translation: All of you, crown him lovingly as your leader and resort of all my Ganas. From today onwards, Nandivara is your lord.
verses.hindi: कि आपकी सृष्टिमें कोई भी मुझे न मार सके
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you, crown him lovingly as your leader and resort of all my Ganas. From today onwards, Nandivara is your lord.
verses.science: कि आपकी सृष्टिमें कोई भी मुझे न मार सके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विप्रयोरित्युक्तवतोः शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः । तमालिङ्ग्य च दुःखार्तो रुरोदातीव विस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viprayorityuktavatoḥ śilādaḥ putravatsalaḥ | tamāliṅgya ca duḥkhārto rurodātīva visvaram
verses.translation: Thus ordered by Siva, the leading Gaas *>aid **LeC
verses.hindi: वशमें करके निष्कण्टक राज्य करने लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus ordered by Siva, the leading Gaas *>aid **LeC
verses.science: वशमें करके निष्कण्टक राज्य करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मृतवत्पतितं दृष्ट्वा पितरं च पितामहम् । प्रत्यवोचत्प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtavatpatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ ca pitāmaham | pratyavocatprasannātmā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam
verses.translation: Then Narayana and other gods including Indra, and die sages came from all the worlds with pleased faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Narayana and other gods including Indra, and die sages came from all the worlds with pleased faces.
verses.science: देवताओं तथा ऋषियोंको सताने लगा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: केन त्वं तात दुःखेन वेपमानश्च रोदिषि । दुःखं ते कुत उत्पन्नं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: kena tvaṃ tāta duḥkhena vepamānaśca rodiṣi | duḥkhaṃ te kuta utpannaṃ jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of iSiva, the holy Brahma performed the coronation of Nandin w th care and attention.
verses.hindi: करता हुआ अग्निके समान जाज्वल्यमान हो उठा
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of iSiva, the holy Brahma performed the coronation of Nandin w th care and attention.
verses.science: करता हुआ अग्निके समान जाज्वल्यमान हो उठा। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच । तवाल्पमृत्युदुःखेन दुःखितोऽतीव पुत्रक । को मे दुःखं हरतु वै शरणं तं प्रयामि हि
verses.transliteration: pitovāca | tavālpamṛtyuduḥkhena duḥkhito'tīva putraka | ko me duḥkhaṃ haratu vai śaraṇaṃ taṃ prayāmi hi
verses.translation: Then Vi$nu, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, Brahma and the sages eulogised me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Vi$nu, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, Brahma and the sages eulogised me.
verses.science: उनसे अत्यन्त भयानक युद्ध किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच । देवो वा दानवो वापि यमः कालोऽथवापि हि । ऋध्येयुर्यद्यपि ह्येते मामन्येऽपि जनास्तथा
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca | devo vā dānavo vāpi yamaḥ kālo'thavāpi hi | ṛdhyeyuryadyapi hyete māmanye'pi janāstathā
verses.translation: While they were eulogising, Visnu, the lord of the universe, eulogised me with devotion with palms joined to¬ gether over the head.
verses.commentary: Sense: While they were eulogising, Visnu, the lord of the universe, eulogised me with devotion with palms joined to¬ gether over the head.
verses.science: विदीर्णकर मार डाला। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथापि चाल्पमृत्युर्मे न भविष्यति मा तुदः । सत्यं ब्रवीमि जनक शपथं ते करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: athāpi cālpamṛtyurme na bhaviṣyati mā tudaḥ | satyaṃ bravīmi janaka śapathaṃ te karomyaham
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence he bowed to me and cried shouts of victory. Then all the leading Ganas, the gods and the Asuras did likewise in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence he bowed to me and cried shouts of victory. Then all the leading Ganas, the gods and the Asuras did likewise in order.
verses.science: विशेष आनन्द प्राप्त नहीं हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच । किं तपः किं परिज्ञानं को योगश्च प्रभुश्च ते । येन त्वं दारुणं दुःखं वञ्चयिष्यसि पुत्र मे
verses.transliteration: pitovāca | kiṃ tapaḥ kiṃ parijñānaṃ ko yogaśca prabhuśca te | yena tvaṃ dāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ vañcayiṣyasi putra me
verses.translation: The daughter of the Maruts, the gentle and beauti¬ ful lady Suyaa became my divine wife pleasing to my eyes and mind.-
verses.hindi: पिता बोले--हे पुत्र)! वह कौन-सा तप है, ज्ञान है अथवा योग है या कौन तुम्हारा प्रभु है, जिससे तुम मेरे इस दारुण दुःखको दूर करोगे 2
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter of the Maruts, the gentle and beauti¬ ful lady Suyaa became my divine wife pleasing to my eyes and mind.-

verses.sanskrit: ॥ पुत्र उवाच । न तात तपसा मृत्युं वञ्चयिष्ये न विद्यया । महादेवस्य भजनान्मृत्युं जेष्यामि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: || putra uvāca | na tāta tapasā mṛtyuṃ vañcayiṣye na vidyayā | mahādevasya bhajanānmṛtyuṃ jeṣyāmi nānyathā
verses.translation: A well-decorated umbrella shedding moonlike lusixe was held above her in the company of women holding the chowries in their hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: A well-decorated umbrella shedding moonlike lusixe was held above her in the company of women holding the chowries in their hands.
verses.science: क्रोधकी ज्वाला शान्त न हुई। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वाहं पितुः पादौ प्रणम्य शिरसा मुने । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य च तमगच्छं वनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvāhaṃ pituḥ pādau praṇamya śirasā mune | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca tamagacchaṃ vanamuttamam
verses.translation: A fine necklace worn by the goddess round her neck was given to me. I got a fine bull, a white elephant, a lion, the lion-banner, a chariot, gold necklace, like the disc of the moon and many other auspicious articles, O sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: A fine necklace worn by the goddess round her neck was given to me. I got a fine bull, a white elephant, a lion, the lion-banner, a chariot, gold necklace, like the disc of the moon and many other auspicious articles, O sage.
verses.science: शंकरकी शरणमें गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O son, your father will be endowed with all pros¬ perity. He will become a presiding officer of the Ganas, a great devotee of mine and very powerful.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करके प्रसन्‍नचित्त होकर कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, your father will be endowed with all pros¬ perity. He will become a presiding officer of the Ganas, a great devotee of mine and very powerful.
verses.science: प्रदान करके प्रसन्‍नचित्त होकर कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O son, your father will be endowed with all pros¬ perity. He will become a presiding officer of the Ganas, a great devotee of mine and very powerful.
verses.hindi: अधिक प्रिय हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, your father will be endowed with all pros¬ perity. He will become a presiding officer of the Ganas, a great devotee of mine and very powerful.
verses.science: अधिक प्रिय हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । नन्दिकेश्वरावताराभिषेक विवाहवर्णनम् । ॥ नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच । तत्र गत्वा मुनेऽहं वै स्थित्वैकान्तस्थले सुधीः । अतपं तप उग्रं सन्मुनीनामपि दुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.7. saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | nandikeśvarāvatārābhiṣeka vivāhavarṇanam | || nandikeśvara uvāca | tatra gatvā mune'haṃ vai sthitvaikāntasthale sudhīḥ | atapaṃ tapa ugraṃ sanmunīnāmapi duṣkaram
verses.translation: O dear son, your grandfather too shall be like-wise. This is my rule that whoever approaches me is certainly endowed with a boon.
verses.hindi: शिवजीका स्मरण करते हुए वैसे ही चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear son, your grandfather too shall be like-wise. This is my rule that whoever approaches me is certainly endowed with a boon.
verses.science: शिवजीका स्मरण करते हुए वैसे ही चले गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पुण्डरीकसुषिरे ध्यात्वा देवं त्रियम्बकम् । त्र्यक्षं दशभुजं शान्तं पञ्चवक्त्रं सदाशिवम्
verses.transliteration: hṛtpuṇḍarīkasuṣire dhyātvā devaṃ triyambakam | tryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ śāntaṃ pañcavaktraṃ sadāśivam
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, neither Vinu of four arms nor Brahma of four faces knows the greatness of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sanatkumara, neither Vinu of four arms nor Brahma of four faces knows the greatness of lord Siva.
verses.science: महाघोर एवं कठोर वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रजाप्यमकार्षं वै परमध्यानमास्थितः । सरितश्चोत्तरे पुण्ये ह्येकचित्तः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: rudrajāpyamakārṣaṃ vai paramadhyānamāsthitaḥ | saritaścottare puṇye hyekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas were there in embodied form. They shall be specifically asked. With this idea in mind they asked the four Vedas about the truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas were there in embodied form. They shall be specifically asked. With this idea in mind they asked the four Vedas about the truth.
verses.science: दोषोंसे परिपूर्ण हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिञ्जाप्येऽथ सम्प्रीतः स्थितं मां परमेश्वरः । तुष्टोऽब्रवीन्महादेवः सोमः सोमार्द्धभूषणः
verses.transliteration: tasmiñjāpye'tha samprītaḥ sthitaṃ māṃ parameśvaraḥ | tuṣṭo'bravīnmahādevaḥ somaḥ somārddhabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then a great flame menifested itself in their
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a great flame menifested itself in their
verses.science: नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । शैलादे वरदोऽहं ते तपसानेन तोषितः । साधु तप्तं त्वया धीमन् ब्रूहि यत्ते मनोगतम्
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | śailāde varado'haṃ te tapasānena toṣitaḥ | sādhu taptaṃ tvayā dhīman brūhi yatte manogatam
verses.translation: O Kalaraja, you will have forever the suaerainty over my city Kali, the city of liberation, which is greater than all other cities.
verses.hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ हैं और मेरे भक्तोंको वर देनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kalaraja, you will have forever the suaerainty over my city Kali, the city of liberation, which is greater than all other cities.
verses.science: सर्वश्रेष्ठ हैं और मेरे भक्तोंको वर देनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो देवेन शिरसा पादयोर्नतः । अस्तवं परमेशानं जराशोकविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto devena śirasā pādayornataḥ | astavaṃ parameśānaṃ jarāśokavināśanam
verses.translation: This Vi$nu shall be honoured by you as well as by Brahma, O Nilalohita, hold the skull of Brahma as an atonement.
verses.hindi: उसे अन्यथा करनेमें कौन समर्थ हो सकता है !
verses.commentary: Sense: This Vi$nu shall be honoured by you as well as by Brahma, O Nilalohita, hold the skull of Brahma as an atonement.
verses.science: उसे अन्यथा करनेमें कौन समर्थ हो सकता है !। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ मां नन्दिनं शम्भुर्भक्त्या परामया युतम् । अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणं सम्यक् पादयोः शिरसा नतम्
verses.transliteration: atha māṃ nandinaṃ śambhurbhaktyā parāmayā yutam | aśrupūrṇekṣaṇaṃ samyak pādayoḥ śirasā natam
verses.translation: Thus directing the Brahmahatya, the wonderful lord Siva, vanished from the scene.
verses.hindi: पुनः एक महीने वायु भक्षणकर रहने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus directing the Brahmahatya, the wonderful lord Siva, vanished from the scene.
verses.science: पुनः एक महीने वायु भक्षणकर रहने लगे। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाप्य परमेशानः पस्पर्श परमार्तिहा । कराभ्यां सम्मुखाभ्यां तु सङ्गृह्य वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: utthāpya parameśānaḥ pasparśa paramārtihā | karābhyāṃ sammukhābhyāṃ tu saṅgṛhya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumira, listen lovingly to an¬ other story of Bhairava that destroys all defects and enhances devotion.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन्होंने एक वर्षतक अद्भुत तप किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumira, listen lovingly to an¬ other story of Bhairava that destroys all defects and enhances devotion.
verses.science: इस प्रकार उन्होंने एक वर्षतक अद्भुत तप किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य गणपांश्चैव देवीं हिमवतः सुताम् । उवाच मां कृपादृष्ट्या समीक्ष्य जगतां पतिः
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya gaṇapāṃścaiva devīṃ himavataḥ sutām | uvāca māṃ kṛpādṛṣṭyā samīkṣya jagatāṃ patiḥ
verses.translation: Due to Brahmahatyk's presence Bhairava began to calculate the time for release. At the words of the lord of gods, he kept on the rite of K&pika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to Brahmahatyk's presence Bhairava began to calculate the time for release. At the words of the lord of gods, he kept on the rite of K&pika.
verses.science: स्वरूप शिवकी स्तुति करने लगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वत्स नन्दिन् महाप्राज्ञ मृत्योर्भीतिः कुतस्तव । मयैव प्रेषितौ विप्रौ मत्समस्त्वं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vatsa nandin mahāprājña mṛtyorbhītiḥ kutastava | mayaiva preṣitau viprau matsamastvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Then the goddess, the granter of the boon and of great fortune told me—"Speak out what your desire is. Tell me all your wishes."
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शार्दूलावतारे नृरसिंहचरितवर्णन॑ नाम दशमोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the goddess, the granter of the boon and of great fortune told me—"Speak out what your desire is. Tell me all your wishes."
verses.science: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शार्दूलावतारे नृरसिंहचरितवर्णन॑ नाम दशमोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अमरो जरया त्यक्तोऽदुःखी गणपतिः सदा । अव्ययश्चाक्षयश्चेष्टः सपिता ससुहृज्जनः
verses.transliteration: amaro jarayā tyakto'duḥkhī gaṇapatiḥ sadā | avyayaścākṣayaśceṣṭaḥ sapitā sasuhṛjjanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing those words of the goddess, I spoke with palms joined in reverence "O gc ldess, let my excellent devotion be always towards your feet."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of the goddess, I spoke with palms joined in reverence "O gc ldess, let my excellent devotion be always towards your feet."
verses.science: नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: मद्बलः पार्श्वगो नित्यं ममेष्टो भवितानिशम् । न जरा जन्म मृत्युर्वै मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: madbalaḥ pārśvago nityaṃ mameṣṭo bhavitāniśam | na jarā janma mṛtyurvai matprasādādbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On hearing my words the goddess said **Let it be so." With great pleasure Siva spoke to SuyatSa, the beloved wife of Nandin.
verses.hindi: उनकी ओर देखकर प्रीतिपूर्वक कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing my words the goddess said **Let it be so." With great pleasure Siva spoke to SuyatSa, the beloved wife of Nandin.
verses.science: उनकी ओर देखकर प्रीतिपूर्वक कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा शिरोमालां कुशेशयमयीं निजाम् । समुन्मुच्य बबन्धाशु मम कण्ठे कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktvā śiromālāṃ kuśeśayamayīṃ nijām | samunmucya babandhāśu mama kaṇṭhe kṛpānidhiḥ
verses.translation: Dear daughter, as you desire I grant you the-boon that you will be enciowed with three eyes. You will be devoid of future births. You will have devotion to me along with your husband, sons and grandsons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dear daughter, as you desire I grant you the-boon that you will be enciowed with three eyes. You will be devoid of future births. You will have devotion to me along with your husband, sons and grandsons.
verses.science: कोपाग्निको शान्त करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तयाहं मालया विप्र शुभया कण्ठसक्तया । त्र्यक्षो दशभुजश्चासं द्वितीय इव शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tayāhaṃ mālayā vipra śubhayā kaṇṭhasaktayā | tryakṣo daśabhujaścāsaṃ dvitīya iva śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted Brahmfi, Viftu, all the gods
verses.hindi: न हों तो तुम मेरे परम भेरवरूपको दिखाओ
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted Brahmfi, Viftu, all the gods
verses.science: न हों तो तुम मेरे परम भेरवरूपको दिखाओ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत एव समादाय हस्तेन परमेश्वरः । उवाच ब्रूहि किं तेऽद्य ददामि वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tata eva samādāya hastena parameśvaraḥ | uvāca brūhi kiṃ te'dya dadāmi varamuttamam
verses.translation: Taking me along with all the members of the family, kinsmen and relatives, lord l9iva mounted his bull }*nd went to the abode of the goddess.
verses.hindi: और जहाँ नृसिंह थे, वहाँ वे अतिशीघ्र जा पहुँचे
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking me along with all the members of the family, kinsmen and relatives, lord l9iva mounted his bull }*nd went to the abode of the goddess.
verses.science: और जहाँ नृसिंह थे, वहाँ वे अतिशीघ्र जा पहुँचे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो जटाश्रितं वारि गृहीत्वा हारनिर्मलम् । उक्त्वा नदी भवेतीह विससर्ज वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tato jaṭāśritaṃ vāri gṛhītvā hāranirmalam | uktvā nadī bhavetīha visasarja vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Vinu and all other gods praising these and eu« logising Siva and Siva lovingly returned to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: जैसे पिता अपने औरस पुत्रसे बात करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinu and all other gods praising these and eu« logising Siva and Siva lovingly returned to their respective abodes.
verses.science: जैसे पिता अपने औरस पुत्रसे बात करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः पञ्चमिता नद्यः प्रावर्तन्त शुभावहाः । सुतोयाश्च महावेगा दिव्यरूपा च सुन्दरीः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pañcamitā nadyaḥ prāvartanta śubhāvahāḥ | sutoyāśca mahāvegā divyarūpā ca sundarīḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, O dear one, thus my own incarna¬ tion has been narrated to you. It is always pleasing and heightening the power of Siva.
verses.hindi: आप परमेश्वरको पालनके लिये नियुक्त किया है
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, O dear one, thus my own incarna¬ tion has been narrated to you. It is always pleasing and heightening the power of Siva.
verses.science: आप परमेश्वरको पालनके लिये नियुक्त किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जटोदका त्रिस्रोताश्च वृषध्वनिरितीव हि । स्वर्णोदका जम्बुनदी पञ्च नद्यः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: jaṭodakā trisrotāśca vṛṣadhvaniritīva hi | svarṇodakā jambunadī pañca nadyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to or narrates, reads or teaches the incarnation of Nandin, the granting of the boons, the coronation and the nuptial ceremony with faith and devotion enjoys all pleasures here and attains great goal hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to or narrates, reads or teaches the incarnation of Nandin, the granting of the boons, the coronation and the nuptial ceremony with faith and devotion enjoys all pleasures here and attains great goal hereafter.
verses.science: धर्मोको शुभमार्गमें प्रतिष्ठित किया है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पञ्चनदं नाम शिवपृष्ठतमं शुभम् । जपेश्वरसमीपे तु पवित्रं परमं मुने
verses.transliteration: etatpañcanadaṃ nāma śivapṛṣṭhatamaṃ śubham | japeśvarasamīpe tu pavitraṃ paramaṃ mune
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, listen to the story of Bhairava by listening to which alone, devotion to Siva becomes 6rm and steady.
verses.hindi: नृसिंहरूपको मेरे समक्ष ही उपसंहत कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, listen to the story of Bhairava by listening to which alone, devotion to Siva becomes 6rm and steady.
verses.science: नृसिंहरूपको मेरे समक्ष ही उपसंहत कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः पञ्चनदमासाद्य स्नात्वा जप्त्वेश्वरेश्वरम् । पूजयेच्छिवसायुज्यं प्रयात्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ pañcanadamāsādya snātvā japtveśvareśvaram | pūjayecchivasāyujyaṃ prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: If any one knows him the supreme soul, he alone is lord Siva. But then, none of these people know him out of their own will.
verses.hindi: ऊपर शासन करनेवाला कोई भी नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one knows him the supreme soul, he alone is lord Siva. But then, none of these people know him out of their own will.
verses.science: ऊपर शासन करनेवाला कोई भी नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ शम्भुरुवाचोमामभिषिञ्चामि नन्दिनम् । गणेन्द्रं व्याहरिष्यामि किं वा त्वं मन्यसेऽव्यये
verses.transliteration: atha śambhuruvācomāmabhiṣiñcāmi nandinam | gaṇendraṃ vyāhariṣyāmi kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase'vyaye
verses.translation: O great sage, in this connection I shall narrate an
verses.hindi: सभी शक्तियोंका प्रवर्तक एवं निवर्तक हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, in this connection I shall narrate an
verses.science: सभी शक्तियोंका प्रवर्तक एवं निवर्तक हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उमोवाच । दातुमर्हसि देवेश नन्दिने परमेश्वर । महाप्रियतमो नाथ शैलादिस्तनयो मम
verses.transliteration: umovāca | dātumarhasi deveśa nandine parameśvara | mahāpriyatamo nātha śailādistanayo mama
verses.translation: All the great sages with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down came there and bowed to Brahma. They asked him respectfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the great sages with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down came there and bowed to Brahma. They asked him respectfully.
verses.science: ही तेजसे विजृम्भित जानो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततः स शङ्करः स्वीयान्सस्मार गणपान्वरान् । स्वतन्त्रः परमेशानः सर्वदो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tataḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ svīyānsasmāra gaṇapānvarān | svatantraḥ parameśānaḥ sarvado bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, O lord of subjects, O Creator, O leader of the worlds tell us the real fact. What is that sole unchanging entity?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, O lord of subjects, O Creator, O leader of the worlds tell us the real fact. What is that sole unchanging entity?
verses.science: हर्ता तथा अखिलेश्वर हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणादेव रुद्रस्य सम्प्राप्ताश्च गणेश्वराः । असङ्ख्याता महामोदाः शङ्कराकृतयोऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: smaraṇādeva rudrasya samprāptāśca gaṇeśvarāḥ | asaṅkhyātā mahāmodāḥ śaṅkarākṛtayo'khilāḥ
verses.translation: Deluded by the Maya of gpreat lord and net know¬ ing the great fact the lotus-born Brahma replied haughtily.
verses.hindi: मेरी शरणमें आकर निर्भय होकर तुम चले जाओ
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by the Maya of gpreat lord and net know¬ ing the great fact the lotus-born Brahma replied haughtily.
verses.science: मेरी शरणमें आकर निर्भय होकर तुम चले जाओ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ते गणेशाः शिवं देवीं प्रणम्याहुः शुभं वचः । ते प्रणम्य करौ बद्ध्वा नतस्कन्धा महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: te gaṇeśāḥ śivaṃ devīṃ praṇamyāhuḥ śubhaṃ vacaḥ | te praṇamya karau baddhvā nataskandhā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: O gods, O sages, all of you listen with attention and intelligence I shall describe the great unchanging entity as it really is.
verses.hindi: वे महाबली गणेश्वर शिव एवं पार्वतीको प्रणाम करके हाथ जोड़कर तथा विनत होकर शुभ वचन कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, O sages, all of you listen with attention and intelligence I shall describe the great unchanging entity as it really is.

verses.sanskrit: गणेशा ऊचुः । किमर्थं च स्मृता देव ह्याज्ञापय महाप्रभो । किङ्करान्नः समायातांस्त्रिपुरार्दन कामद
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśā ūcuḥ | kimarthaṃ ca smṛtā deva hyājñāpaya mahāprabho | kiṅkarānnaḥ samāyātāṃstripurārdana kāmada
verses.translation: I am the womb (material cause) of the universe, the creator, the self-born, the unborn, the lord, the primor¬ dial being, the Brahman, the sole unsullied soul.
verses.hindi: मेरी ही कृपासे जीवन धारण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the womb (material cause) of the universe, the creator, the self-born, the unborn, the lord, the primor¬ dial being, the Brahman, the sole unsullied soul.
verses.science: मेरी ही कृपासे जीवन धारण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किं सागरान् शोषयामो यमं वा सह किङ्करैः । हन्मो मृत्युं महामृत्युं विशेषं वृद्धपद्मजम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ sāgarān śoṣayāmo yamaṃ vā saha kiṅkaraiḥ | hanmo mṛtyuṃ mahāmṛtyuṃ viśeṣaṃ vṛddhapadmajam
verses.translation: O excellent gods, I am the instigator of the worlds, and the deterrent too. There is none greater than I or any other who causes their revoludon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent gods, I am the instigator of the worlds, and the deterrent too. There is none greater than I or any other who causes their revoludon.
verses.science: अवज्ञापूर्वक हँसकर कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वेन्द्रं सह देवैश्च विष्णुं वा पार्षदैः सह । आनयामः सुसङ्क्रुद्धान्दैत्यान्वा दानवैः सह
verses.transliteration: baddhvendraṃ saha devaiśca viṣṇuṃ vā pārṣadaiḥ saha | ānayāmaḥ susaṅkruddhāndaityānvā dānavaiḥ saha
verses.translation: I am the Creator of ail the worlds, the great Atman, the greatest Purusa, the sacrifice, the lord Nfir&yaa, the master of M2yfi and the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the Creator of ail the worlds, the great Atman, the greatest Purusa, the sacrifice, the lord Nfir&yaa, the master of M2yfi and the greatest goal.
verses.science: आपके विनाशका कारण है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्याद्य व्यसनं घोरं करिष्यामस्तवाज्ञया । कस्य वाद्योत्सवो देव सर्वकामसमृद्धये
verses.transliteration: kasyādya vyasanaṃ ghoraṃ kariṣyāmastavājñayā | kasya vādyotsavo deva sarvakāmasamṛddhaye
verses.translation: O sage, thus starting a mutual clash due to delu¬ sion and desiring to conquer each other they asked the Vedas about truth.
verses.hindi: आप कथामात्र ही शेष न रह जायँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, thus starting a mutual clash due to delu¬ sion and desiring to conquer each other they asked the Vedas about truth.
verses.science: आप कथामात्र ही शेष न रह जायँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां गणानां वीरवादिनाम् । उवाच तान्स प्रशंस्य गणेशान्परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ gaṇānāṃ vīravādinām | uvāca tānsa praśaṃsya gaṇeśānparameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Vedas are the authorities everywhere. They have been honoured everywhere. Hence you please say un¬ reservedly. What is the sole unchanging entity?
verses.hindi: नहीं हैं, आप परतन्त्र एवं विमूढ़ चित्तवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedas are the authorities everywhere. They have been honoured everywhere. Hence you please say un¬ reservedly. What is the sole unchanging entity?
verses.science: नहीं हैं, आप परतन्त्र एवं विमूढ़ चित्तवाले हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । नन्दीश्वरोऽयं पुत्रो मे सर्वेषामीश्वरेश्वरः । प्रियो गणाग्रणीः सर्वैः क्रियतां वचनं मम
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | nandīśvaro'yaṃ putro me sarveṣāmīśvareśvaraḥ | priyo gaṇāgraṇīḥ sarvaiḥ kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the Vedas spoke in reality after remembering the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, the Vedas spoke in reality after remembering the lord.
verses.science: अवतार धारण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे प्रीत्याभिषिञ्चध्वं मद्गणानां गतिं पतिम् । अद्यप्रभृति युष्माकमयं नन्दीश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarve prītyābhiṣiñcadhvaṃ madgaṇānāṃ gatiṃ patim | adyaprabhṛti yuṣmākamayaṃ nandīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Tf we are honoured, O deities as the causes of creation and maintenance, we shall cite authorities that will dispel your doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tf we are honoured, O deities as the causes of creation and maintenance, we shall cite authorities that will dispel your doubts.
verses.science: में विद्यमान है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्ताः शङ्करेण गणपाः सर्व एव ते । एवमस्त्विति सम्प्रोच्य सम्भारानाहरँस्ततः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktāḥ śaṅkareṇa gaṇapāḥ sarva eva te | evamastviti samprocya sambhārānāharam̐stataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the conditions mentioned by the Vedas the two deities told the Vedas—"What is mentioned by you is acceptable to us as authority. What is that entity? Please tell us that.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the conditions mentioned by the Vedas the two deities told the Vedas—"What is mentioned by you is acceptable to us as authority. What is that entity? Please tell us that.
verses.science: शिवजीको आप भूल गये!। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाश्च सेन्द्राश्च नारायणमुखास्तथा । मुनयः सर्वतो लोका आजग्मुर्मुदिताननाः
verses.transliteration: tato devāśca sendrāśca nārāyaṇamukhāstathā | munayaḥ sarvato lokā ājagmurmuditānanāḥ
verses.translation: That in which the Bhutas stay, that from which everything comes out, what they call as the greatest entity— that is Rudra alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: That in which the Bhutas stay, that from which everything comes out, what they call as the greatest entity— that is Rudra alone.
verses.science: उसे भूल गये हैं ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पितामहोऽपि भगवन्नियोगाच्छङ्करस्य वै । चकार नन्दिनः सर्वमभिषेकं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: pitāmaho'pi bhagavanniyogācchaṅkarasya vai | cakāra nandinaḥ sarvamabhiṣekaṃ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: That by which this universe whirls, that which is
verses.hindi: हो, ऐसी स्थितिमें तुम सात्त्विक कैसे हो ?2
verses.commentary: Sense: That by which this universe whirls, that which is
verses.science: हो, ऐसी स्थितिमें तुम सात्त्विक कैसे हो ?2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो विष्णुस्ततः शक्रो लोकपालास्तथैव च । ऋषयस्तुष्टुवुश्चैव पितामहपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: tato viṣṇustataḥ śakro lokapālāstathaiva ca | ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuścaiva pitāmahapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: The lord of Pramathas incessantly sports with Siva. He is naked and of yellow colour and tawny due to dust. His dress and features are ugly. He has matted hair and moves about on his bull. He weani serpents as his ornaments. How can he be the supreme Brahman? Where is that Brahman free from any attachment?'*
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of Pramathas incessantly sports with Siva. He is naked and of yellow colour and tawny due to dust. His dress and features are ugly. He has matted hair and moves about on his bull. He weani serpents as his ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Pramathas incessantly sports with Siva. He is naked and of yellow colour and tawny due to dust. His dress and features are ugly. He has matted hair and moves about on his bull. He weani serpents as his ornaments.…
verses.science: मृत्युके भी मृत्यु हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिमत्सु ततस्तेषु विष्णुः सर्वजगत्पतिः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टाव च समाहितः
verses.transliteration: stutimatsu tatasteṣu viṣṇuḥ sarvajagatpatiḥ | śirasyañjalimādhāya tuṣṭāva ca samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the all-pervasive Pranava who though unembodied assumed an embodied, extensive form told them thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, the all-pervasive Pranava who though unembodied assumed an embodied, extensive form told them thus.
verses.science: सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा जयशब्दं चकार च । ततो गणाधिपाः सर्व ततो देवास्ततोऽसुराः
verses.transliteration: prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā jayaśabdaṃ cakāra ca | tato gaṇādhipāḥ sarva tato devāstato'surāḥ
verses.translation: Lord 14a, Rudra, Siva indulging in sports and assu¬ ming various forms never sports about with the Sakti different from him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord 14a, Rudra, Siva indulging in sports and assu¬ ming various forms never sports about with the Sakti different from him.
verses.science: क्रोध मृत्युरूप होकर तुमपर गिरेगा। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुतश्चाभिषिक्तो देवैः सब्रह्मकैस्तदा । नन्दीश्वरोहं विप्रेन्द्र नियोगात्प रमेशितुः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutaścābhiṣikto devaiḥ sabrahmakaistadā | nandīśvarohaṃ viprendra niyogātpa rameśituḥ
verses.translation: Even after this explanation the ignorance of Brahma and Viu was not quelled. It was due to the Maya of Siva alone.
verses.hindi: इति अ्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शरभावतारवर्णन॑ नामैकादशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after this explanation the ignorance of Brahma and Viu was not quelled. It was due to the Maya of Siva alone.
verses.science: इति अ्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शरभावतारवर्णन॑ नामैकादशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहश्च कृतस्तत्र नियोगात्परमेष्ठिनः । महोत्सवयुतः प्रीत्या विष्णुब्रह्मादिभिर्मम
verses.transliteration: udvāhaśca kṛtastatra niyogātparameṣṭhinaḥ | mahotsavayutaḥ prītyā viṣṇubrahmādibhirmama
verses.translation: O sage, then Brahma and Vinu saw a shape in the form of a man in the middle of the mass of flame. Its body was huge and wonderful.
verses.hindi: करके उस वृत्तान्तको इस समय प्रीतिपूर्वक कहिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, then Brahma and Vinu saw a shape in the form of a man in the middle of the mass of flame. Its body was huge and wonderful.
verses.science: करके उस वृत्तान्तको इस समय प्रीतिपूर्वक कहिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मरुतां च सुता देवी सुयशास्तु मनोहरा । पत्नी सा मेऽभवद्दिव्या मनोनयननन्दिनी
verses.transliteration: marutāṃ ca sutā devī suyaśāstu manoharā | patnī sā me'bhavaddivyā manonayananandinī
verses.translation: The fifth head of Brahma burnt with rage (as. though saying) "who is this bearing a man's outline and features in our midst?"
verses.hindi: मन तथा नेत्रोंको आनन्द देनेवाली मनोहर तथा दिव्य सुयशा नामक मरुत्कन्या मेरी पत्नी हुई
verses.commentary: Sense: The fifth head of Brahma burnt with rage (as. though saying) "who is this bearing a man's outline and features in our midst?"

verses.sanskrit: लब्धं शशिप्रभं छत्रं तया तत्र विभूषितम् । चामरैश्चामरासक्तहस्ताग्रैः स्त्रीगणैर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: labdhaṃ śaśiprabhaṃ chatraṃ tayā tatra vibhūṣitam | cāmaraiścāmarāsaktahastāgraiḥ strīgaṇairyutam
verses.translation: By the time Brahma could reflect properly, the great Being was seen immediately as the three-eyed Nilalohita with the trident in his hand and an eye in the forehead. Serpents and crescent moon constituted his orna¬ ments. The deluded Brahma on seeing him said laughingly.
verses.hindi: तेजसे तिरस्कृत जुगनू विश्रान्त हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: By the time Brahma could reflect properly, the great Being was seen immediately as the three-eyed Nilalohita with the trident in his hand and an eye in the forehead. Serpents and crescent moon constituted his orna¬ ments. The deluded Brahma on seeing him said laughingly.
verses.science: तेजसे तिरस्कृत जुगनू विश्रान्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनं च परमं तया चाधिष्ठितं मया । अलङ्कृतो महालक्ष्म्या मुकुटाद्यैः सुभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanaṃ ca paramaṃ tayā cādhiṣṭhitaṃ mayā | alaṅkṛto mahālakṣmyā mukuṭādyaiḥ subhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: *'0 Nilalohita, I know you. Do not be afraid; O moon-crested one. You, Rudra, came out formerly from my forehead. Since you cried, the name Rudra was also assigned to you by me formerly. O son, seek refuge in me alone. I shall save you."
verses.hindi: लेकर वृषभपर सवार हो चल पड़े
verses.commentary: Sense: *'0 Nilalohita, I know you. Do not be afraid; O moon-crested one. You, Rudra, came out formerly from my forehead. Since you cried, the name Rudra was also assigned to you by me formerly. O son, seek refuge in me alone. I shall save you."
verses.science: लेकर वृषभपर सवार हो चल पड़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्धो हारश्च परमो देव्याः कण्ठगतस्तथा । वृषेन्द्रश्च शितो नागस्सिंहः सिंहध्वजस्तथा
verses.transliteration: labdho hāraśca paramo devyāḥ kaṇṭhagatastathā | vṛṣendraśca śito nāgassiṃhaḥ siṃhadhvajastathā
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing the haughty words of the lotus-born Brahma, Siva became angry as if out for destruc¬ tion.
verses.hindi: लोग 'नमः ' शब्दसे उनकी स्तुति करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on hearing the haughty words of the lotus-born Brahma, Siva became angry as if out for destruc¬ tion.
verses.science: लोग 'नमः ' शब्दसे उनकी स्तुति करने लगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रथश्च हेमहारश्च चन्द्रबिम्बसमः शुभः । अन्यान्यपि च वस्तूनि लब्धानि हि मया मुने
verses.transliteration: rathaśca hemahāraśca candrabimbasamaḥ śubhaḥ | anyānyapi ca vastūni labdhāni hi mayā mune
verses.translation: Angrily, he created a Puru$a Bhairava blazing in great brilliance. Then he spoke lovingly.
verses.hindi: कल्याणकारी भगवान् शंकरकी स्तुति करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: Angrily, he created a Puru$a Bhairava blazing in great brilliance. Then he spoke lovingly.
verses.science: कल्याणकारी भगवान् शंकरकी स्तुति करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृतविवाहोऽहं तया पत्न्या महामुने । पादौ ववन्दे शम्भोश्च शिवाया ब्रह्मणो हरेः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtavivāho'haṃ tayā patnyā mahāmune | pādau vavande śambhośca śivāyā brahmaṇo hareḥ
verses.translation: O Kalabhairava, at the outset this lotus-born Brahma shall be chastised by you. You shine like god of death, hence you are Kalarija.
verses.hindi: हे महामुने! इस प्रकार विवाह हो जानेपर मैंने उस पत्नीके साथ शिव, पार्वती, ब्रह्मा एवं विष्णुके चरणोंकी बन्दना की
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kalabhairava, at the outset this lotus-born Brahma shall be chastised by you. You shine like god of death, hence you are Kalarija.

verses.sanskrit: तथाविधं त्रिलोकेशः सपत्नीकं च मां प्रभुः । प्रोवाच परया प्रीत्या स शिवो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: tathāvidhaṃ trilokeśaḥ sapatnīkaṃ ca māṃ prabhuḥ | provāca parayā prītyā sa śivo bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: You are called Bhairava because you are of terrifying features and you are capable of supporting the universe. Since even K§la is afraid of you, you are called Kalabhairava.
