verses.transliteration: viṣṇuruvāca | yathecchasi tathā krīḍa sarvavighnāpanodaka | māyayā māṃ mahādeva nācchādayitumarhasi
verses.translation: Thereafter Rudra remembered the powerful Vira- bhadra, the cause of dissolution and addressed Bhairava, hi« own form.
verses.hindi: सर्वकामानवाणोति ततश्च लभते गतिम्॥४२  बाद परमगतिको प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Rudra remembered the powerful Vira- bhadra, the cause of dissolution and addressed Bhairava, hi« own form.
verses.science: सर्वकामानवाणोति ततश्च लभते गतिम्॥४२ बाद परमगतिको प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाभीकमलकोशात्तु कोटिशः कमलासनाः । कल्पे कल्पे पुरा ह्यान्सस्त्वन्नियोगबलाद्विभो
verses.transliteration: nābhīkamalakośāttu koṭiśaḥ kamalāsanāḥ | kalpe kalpe purā hyānsastvanniyogabalādvibho
verses.translation: Then suddenly there came the leader of the Ganas laughing loudly and accompanied by the leading Ganas laughing boisterously and jumping about here and there. He was surrounded by crores of fierce manlion-formed Ganas, madly dancing heroes joyously leaping about. The warlike heroes Brahma and others were playing about as if with balls; the leader of the Ganas was surrounded by others too who had remained unseen. He was respected by the heroes.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां यक्षेश्व॒रावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षोडशो5 ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Then suddenly there came the leader of the Ganas laughing loudly and accompanied by the leading Ganas laughing boisterously and jumping about here and there. He was surrounded by crores of fierce manlion-formed Ganas, madly dancing heroes joyously leaping about.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then suddenly there came the leader of the Ganas laughing loudly and accompanied by the leading Ganas laughing boisterously and jumping about here and there. He was surrounded by crores of fierce manlion-formed Ganas, madly dancing heroes joyously leaping about.…
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां यक्षेश्व॒रावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षोडशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्यज मायामिमां देव दुस्तरामकृतात्मभिः । ब्रह्मादयो महादेव मायया तव मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: tyaja māyāmimāṃ deva dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ | brahmādayo mahādeva māyayā tava mohitāḥ
verses.translation: He had a fiery splendour as fierce as the fire at the end of Kalpa. His three eyes shone splendidly. He had no weapon. He had matted hair. He was bedecked by the refulgent crescent moon.
verses.hindi: हे देव! आप पुण्यहीन मनुष्योंके लिये इस मायाका त्याग करें। हे महादेव! आपकी मायासे ब्रह्म आदि भी मोहित हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a fiery splendour as fierce as the fire at the end of Kalpa. His three eyes shone splendidly. He had no weapon. He had matted hair. He was bedecked by the refulgent crescent moon.

verses.sanskrit: यथावदनुगच्छामि चेष्टितं ते शिवापते । तवैवानुग्रहाच्छम्भो सर्वेश्वर सताङ्गते
verses.transliteration: yathāvadanugacchāmi ceṣṭitaṃ te śivāpate | tavaivānugrahācchambho sarveśvara satāṅgate
verses.translation: With his fierce hissing whooping sound be deafened the faces of the quarters. He was as dark as the blue cloud and collyrium He was terrible and wondrous with full grown moustaches and beards.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले एवं भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: With his fierce hissing whooping sound be deafened the faces of the quarters. He was as dark as the blue cloud and collyrium He was terrible and wondrous with full grown moustaches and beards.
verses.science: करनेवाले एवं भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संहारकाले सम्प्राप्ते सदेवान्निखिलान्मुनीन् । लोकान्वर्णाश्रमवतो हरिष्यसि यदा हर
verses.transliteration: saṃhārakāle samprāpte sadevānnikhilānmunīn | lokānvarṇāśramavato hariṣyasi yadā hara
verses.translation: He said to Siva—**0 lord of the universe, why I have been remembered by you? Please do me a favour and command me.**
verses.commentary: Sense: He said to Siva—**0 lord of the universe, why I have been remembered by you? Please do me a favour and command me.**
verses.science: तुर्था भक्तसुखदो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रद:॥ ५ देनेवाला है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा कृते महादेव पापं ब्रह्मवधादिकम् । पारतन्त्र्यं न ते शम्भो स्वैरं क्रीडत्यतो भवान्
verses.transliteration: tadā kṛte mahādeva pāpaṃ brahmavadhādikam | pāratantryaṃ na te śambho svairaṃ krīḍatyato bhavān
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Virabhadra, and glancing at his face respectfully lord Siva, the chastiser of the wicked, said lovingly.
verses.hindi: सज्जनों एवं उपासकोंकी कामनाएँ पूर्ण करती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Virabhadra, and glancing at his face respectfully lord Siva, the chastiser of the wicked, said lovingly.
verses.science: सज्जनों एवं उपासकोंकी कामनाएँ पूर्ण करती हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतीत ब्रह्मणां ह्यस्थ्नां स्रक्कण्ठे तव भासते । तथाप्यनुगता शम्भो ब्रह्महत्या तवानघ
verses.transliteration: atīta brahmaṇāṃ hyasthnāṃ srakkaṇṭhe tava bhāsate | tathāpyanugatā śambho brahmahatyā tavānagha
verses.translation: An untimely terrible fear has cropped up tor the gods. The fire of that man-lion is blazing You shall quell this inaccessible one.
verses.hindi: जो अपने भक्तोंका मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाली हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: An untimely terrible fear has cropped up tor the gods. The fire of that man-lion is blazing You shall quell this inaccessible one.
verses.science: जो अपने भक्तोंका मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाली हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं यस्त्वां स्मरति मानवः । आधारं जगतामीश तस्य पापं विलीयते
verses.transliteration: kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yastvāṃ smarati mānavaḥ | ādhāraṃ jagatāmīśa tasya pāpaṃ vilīyate
verses.translation: At the outset convince him in a consoling manner. If he does not subside thereby, show my great terrible form.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset convince him in a consoling manner. If he does not subside thereby, show my great terrible form.
verses.science: फल देनेवाली हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा तमो न तिष्ठेत सन्निधावंशुमालिनः । तथैव तव यो भक्तः पापं तस्य व्रजेत्क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: yathā tamo na tiṣṭheta sannidhāvaṃśumālinaḥ | tathaiva tava yo bhaktaḥ pāpaṃ tasya vrajetkṣayam
verses.translation: O Virabhadra, at my behest, bring me his head and hide after quelling his subtle fury with your subde one and his gross splendour with your gross one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Virabhadra, at my behest, bring me his head and hide after quelling his subtle fury with your subde one and his gross splendour with your gross one.
verses.science: हैं, जो परम आनन्दस्वरूपिणी हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चिन्तयति पुण्यात्मा तव पादाम्बुजद्वयम् । ब्रह्महत्याकृतमपि पापं तस्य व्रजेत्क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: yaścintayati puṇyātmā tava pādāmbujadvayam | brahmahatyākṛtamapi pāpaṃ tasya vrajetkṣayam
verses.translation: Urged thus, the leader of the Ganas, assumed a calm body and features and hastened to the place where the man-lion was sitting.
verses.hindi: समस्त कामनाओंका फल प्रदान करती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged thus, the leader of the Ganas, assumed a calm body and features and hastened to the place where the man-lion was sitting.
verses.science: समस्त कामनाओंका फल प्रदान करती हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तव नामानुरक्ता वाग्यस्य पुंसो जगत्पते । अप्यद्रिकूटतुलितं नैनस्तमनुबाधते
verses.transliteration: tava nāmānuraktā vāgyasya puṃso jagatpate | apyadrikūṭatulitaṃ nainastamanubādhate
verses.translation: Then Virabhadra, the destroyer addressed Vinu. Siva, then spoke to him as a father speaks to his own son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Virabhadra, the destroyer addressed Vinu. Siva, then spoke to him as a father speaks to his own son.
verses.science: मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मन्परं धाम स्वेच्छाभिधृतविग्रह । कुतूहलं तवेशेदं कृपणाधीनतेश्वर
verses.transliteration: paramātmanparaṃ dhāma svecchābhidhṛtavigraha | kutūhalaṃ taveśedaṃ kṛpaṇādhīnateśvara
verses.translation: O lord Vi$ 9 u, you have taken the incamauon for the happiness of the universe. You, the great lord, have been entrusted with the task of maintaining the universe by Siva.
verses.hindi: शास्त्रोंमें निगूढ़ है, ऐसा जानना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Vi$ 9 u, you have taken the incamauon for the happiness of the universe. You, the great lord, have been entrusted with the task of maintaining the universe by Siva.
verses.science: शास्त्रोंमें निगूढ़ है, ऐसा जानना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्य धन्योऽस्मि देवेश यन्न पश्यन्ति योगिनः । पश्यामि तं जगन्मूर्त्तिं परमेश्वरमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: adya dhanyo'smi deveśa yanna paśyanti yoginaḥ | paśyāmi taṃ jaganmūrttiṃ parameśvaramavyayam
verses.translation: Formerly, multitudes of creatures moving about in the one vast ocean have been split by your lordship in the form of a fish by binding them with your tail.
verses.hindi: है देवेश! आज मैं धन्य हूँ; क्योंकि योगीजन भी जिन्हें नहीं देख पाते हैं, उन जगन्मूर्ति अव्यय परमेश्वरका मैं दर्शन कर रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, multitudes of creatures moving about in the one vast ocean have been split by your lordship in the form of a fish by binding them with your tail.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे परमो लाभस्त्वद्य मे मङ्गलं परम् । तं दृष्ट्वामृततृप्तस्य तृणं स्वर्गापवर्गकम्
verses.transliteration: adya me paramo lābhastvadya me maṅgalaṃ param | taṃ dṛṣṭvāmṛtatṛptasya tṛṇaṃ svargāpavargakam
verses.translation: Again in the form of a dwarf, you had bound Bali. You are the origin of all living beings. You are the eternal lord.
verses.hindi: धनाधिपो हि वैश्य: स्थाच्छूद्र: सुखमवाणुयात्॥ १९  है एवं शूद्र सुख व्रात है है
verses.commentary: Sense: Again in the form of a dwarf, you had bound Bali. You are the origin of all living beings. You are the eternal lord.
verses.science: धनाधिपो हि वैश्य: स्थाच्छूद्र: सुखमवाणुयात्॥ १९ है एवं शूद्र सुख व्रात है है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं वदति गोविन्दे विमला पद्मया तया । मनोरथवती नाम भिक्षा पात्रे समर्पिता
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vadati govinde vimalā padmayā tayā | manorathavatī nāma bhikṣā pātre samarpitā
verses.translation: Whenever any misery torments the world you incarnate yourself and make it free from distress and ailment.
verses.hindi: सुखिनः स्पुर्विशेषण शिवभक्ता भवन्तु च॥ २०  भक्त हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Whenever any misery torments the world you incarnate yourself and make it free from distress and ailment.
verses.science: सुखिनः स्पुर्विशेषण शिवभक्ता भवन्तु च॥ २० भक्त हो जाते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षाटनाय देवोऽपि निरगात्परया मुदा । अन्यत्रापि महादेवो भैरवश्चात्तविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: bhikṣāṭanāya devo'pi niragātparayā mudā | anyatrāpi mahādevo bhairavaścāttavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: That Danava Hiranyakaipu has been killed for which purpose you have taken this incarnation. Prahlada too has been saved.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृतीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां जिवदशावतारवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदेशोठ5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: That Danava Hiranyakaipu has been killed for which purpose you have taken this incarnation. Prahlada too has been saved.
verses.science: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृतीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां जिवदशावतारवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदेशोठ5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वानुयायिनीं तां तु समाहूय जनार्दनः । सम्प्रार्थयद् ब्रह्महत्यां विमुञ्च त्वं त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvānuyāyinīṃ tāṃ tu samāhūya janārdanaḥ | samprārthayad brahmahatyāṃ vimuñca tvaṃ triśūlinam
verses.translation: O lord Narasiihha, O soul of the universe, subdue this extremely terrible body youiself in my presence.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Narasiihha, O soul of the universe, subdue this extremely terrible body youiself in my presence.
verses.science: वर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्योवाच । अनेनापि मिषेणाहं संसेव्यामुं वृषध्वजम् । आत्मानं पावयिष्यामि त्वपुनर्भवदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyovāca | anenāpi miṣeṇāhaṃ saṃsevyāmuṃ vṛṣadhvajam | ātmānaṃ pāvayiṣyāmi tvapunarbhavadarśanam
verses.translation: Urged thus with quiet peaceful words of Vira- bhadra, the arrogant man-lion assumed a more terrible anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged thus with quiet peaceful words of Vira- bhadra, the arrogant man-lion assumed a more terrible anger.
verses.science: पाप पीड़ित नहीं करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सा तत्याज न तत्पार्श्वं व्याहृतापि मुरारिणा । तमूचेऽथ हरिं शम्भुः स्मेरास्यो भैरवो वचः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | sā tatyāja na tatpārśvaṃ vyāhṛtāpi murāriṇā | tamūce'tha hariṃ śambhuḥ smerāsyo bhairavo vacaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, threatening the heroic Vlrabhadra with his curved fangs he spoke harsh and terrible words.
verses.hindi: नन्दीएवर बोले--विष्णुके कहनेसे भी जब ब्रह्महत्याने भैरवका पीछा नहीं छोड़ा, तब भैरव शम्भुने मुसकराकर हरिसे यह वचन कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, threatening the heroic Vlrabhadra with his curved fangs he spoke harsh and terrible words.

verses.sanskrit: भैरव उवाच । त्वद्वाक्पीयूषपानेन तृप्तोऽस्मि बहुमानद । स्वभावोऽयं हि साधूनां यत्त्वं वदसि मापते
verses.transliteration: bhairava uvāca | tvadvākpīyūṣapānena tṛpto'smi bahumānada | svabhāvo'yaṃ hi sādhūnāṃ yattvaṃ vadasi māpate
verses.translation: Go back the way you have come from. Uo not speak offending words. 1 am now going to annihilate the universe of the mobile and immobile being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Go back the way you have come from. Uo not speak offending words. 1 am now going to annihilate the universe of the mobile and immobile being.
verses.science: स्थापनाकर कठोर तप करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणीष्व गोविन्द वरदोऽस्मि तवानघ । अग्रणीर्मम भक्तानां त्वं हरे निर्विकारवान्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ vṛṇīṣva govinda varado'smi tavānagha | agraṇīrmama bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ hare nirvikāravān
verses.translation: Everything functions fearlessly by my favour. I am the instigator as well as the restrainer of all powers.
verses.hindi: ऋषिको वर देनेके लिये प्रकट हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything functions fearlessly by my favour. I am the instigator as well as the restrainer of all powers.
verses.science: ऋषिको वर देनेके लिये प्रकट हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नो माद्यन्ति तथा भैक्ष्यैर्भिक्षवोऽप्यतिसंस्कृतैः । यथा मानसुधापानैर्ननु भिक्षाटनज्वराः
verses.transliteration: no mādyanti tathā bhaikṣyairbhikṣavo'pyatisaṃskṛtaiḥ | yathā mānasudhāpānairnanu bhikṣāṭanajvarāḥ
verses.translation: They know me, the knower of the reality of the
verses.commentary: Sense: They know me, the knower of the reality of the
verses.science: प्रसन्‍नचित्त होकर उनकी स्तुति की। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचः शम्भोर्भैरवस्य परात्मनः । सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा समवोचन्महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya vacaḥ śambhorbhairavasya parātmanaḥ | suprasannataro bhūtvā samavocanmaheśvaram
verses.translation: Brahma, the creator of the universe wfio was tormerly born of my umbilical lotus* is greater than all, being independent, maker, remover and the lord of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, the creator of the universe wfio was tormerly born of my umbilical lotus* is greater than all, being independent, maker, remover and the lord of all.
verses.science: अद्वितीय तथा अविनाशी हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । एष एव वरः श्लाघ्यो यदहं देवताधिपम् । पश्यामि त्वान्देवदेव मनोवाणीपथातिगम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuruvāca | eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yadahaṃ devatādhipam | paśyāmi tvāndevadeva manovāṇīpathātigam
verses.translation: I am Kala, the cause of destroying the worlds. I am engaged in annihilating the worlds. O Virabhadra, know me to be the Death of Death. These gods are alive by my very favour.
verses.hindi: हैं, अत: आप इन दु:खियोंकी रक्षा कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: I am Kala, the cause of destroying the worlds. I am engaged in annihilating the worlds. O Virabhadra, know me to be the Death of Death. These gods are alive by my very favour.
verses.science: हैं, अत: आप इन दु:खियोंकी रक्षा कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अदभ्रेयं सुधादृष्टिरनया मे महोत्सवः । अयत्त्ननिधिलाभोऽयं वीक्षणं हर ते सताम्
verses.transliteration: adabhreyaṃ sudhādṛṣṭiranayā me mahotsavaḥ | ayattnanidhilābho'yaṃ vīkṣaṇaṃ hara te satām
verses.translation: On hearing the arrogant words of Visnu, Vira¬ bhadra of immeasurable exploits laughed and said contem¬ ptuously with throbbing lips.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the arrogant words of Visnu, Vira¬ bhadra of immeasurable exploits laughed and said contem¬ ptuously with throbbing lips.
verses.science: शरणमें आये हुए हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अवियोगोऽस्तु मे देव त्वदङ्घ्रियुगलेन वै । एष एव वरः शम्भो नान्यं कश्चिद् वृणे वरम्
verses.transliteration: aviyogo'stu me deva tvadaṅghriyugalena vai | eṣa eva varaḥ śambho nānyaṃ kaścid vṛṇe varam
verses.translation: Don't you know the Pinaka-bearing lord of the universe as the annihilator? Baseless argument and disputa¬ tion will end in death for you.
verses.hindi: आकर आपके लिये तपस्या कर रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Don't you know the Pinaka-bearing lord of the universe as the annihilator? Baseless argument and disputa¬ tion will end in death for you.
verses.science: आकर आपके लिये तपस्या कर रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभैरव उवाच । एवं भवतु ते तात यत्त्वयोक्तं महामते । सर्वेषामपि देवानां वरदस्त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: śrībhairava uvāca | evaṃ bhavatu te tāta yattvayoktaṃ mahāmate | sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ varadastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Tell me the defect which has led you to this plight. With that lord capable of annihilation you will get the balance of Dakina.
verses.hindi: कीजिये और देवताओंके दुःखको दूर कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Tell me the defect which has led you to this plight. With that lord capable of annihilation you will get the balance of Dakina.
verses.science: कीजिये और देवताओंके दुःखको दूर कीजिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अनुगृह्येति दैत्यारिं केन्द्राद्रिभुवने चरन् । भेजेऽविमुक्तनगरीं नाम्ना वाराणसीं पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | anugṛhyeti daityāriṃ kendrādribhuvane caran | bheje'vimuktanagarīṃ nāmnā vārāṇasīṃ purīm
verses.translation: The Ckintents of the verses ai, 29, 30 and 35 in this chapter are reminiscent of similar ideas expressed in the Bhagavad'-giti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ckintents of the verses ai, 29, 30 and 35 in this chapter are reminiscent of similar ideas expressed in the Bhagavad'-giti.
verses.science: देवताओंको आनन्द प्रदान कीजिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रे प्रविष्टमात्रेऽथ भैरवे भीषणाकृतौ । हाहेत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्महत्या पातालं चाविशत्तदा
verses.transliteration: kṣetre praviṣṭamātre'tha bhairave bhīṣaṇākṛtau | hāhetyuktvā brahmahatyā pātālaṃ cāviśattadā
verses.translation: Remaining in a severe penance, he contemplated on Siva, the blue-necked, in his forehead for the creation of the three worlds.
verses.hindi: भयंकर आकृतिवाले भैरवके उस क्षेत्रमें प्रवेश करनेमात्रसे ही ब्रह्महत्या उसी समय हाहाकार करके पातालमें चली गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: Remaining in a severe penance, he contemplated on Siva, the blue-necked, in his forehead for the creation of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कपालं ब्राह्मणः सद्यो भैरवस्य कराम्बुजात् । पपात भुवि तत्तीर्थमभूत्कापालमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: kapālaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sadyo bhairavasya karāmbujāt | papāta bhuvi tattīrthamabhūtkāpālamocanam
verses.translation: Siva came out of his forehead. 1 am the ornament of the lord of gods in the form of Bhairava in the matter of creation.
verses.hindi: कहकर उनके देखते-देखते वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva came out of his forehead. 1 am the ornament of the lord of gods in the form of Bhairava in the matter of creation.
verses.science: कहकर उनके देखते-देखते वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कपालं ब्रह्मणो रुद्रः सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम् । हस्तात्पतन्तमालोक्य ननर्त परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: kapālaṃ brahmaṇo rudraḥ sarveṣāmeva paśyatām | hastātpatantamālokya nanarta parayā mudā
verses.translation: O Visnu, I have been engaged in subduing you either through humility or through force, by Rudra the lord of gods, the lord of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Visnu, I have been engaged in subduing you either through humility or through force, by Rudra the lord of gods, the lord of all.
verses.science: समस्त वृत्तान्त कह सुनाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विधेः कपालं नामुञ्चत्करमत्यन्तदुस्सहम् । परस्य भ्रमतः क्वापि तत्काश्यां क्षणतोऽपतत्
verses.transliteration: vidheḥ kapālaṃ nāmuñcatkaramatyantadussaham | parasya bhramataḥ kvāpi tatkāśyāṃ kṣaṇato'patat
verses.translation: After tearing to pieces a single demon you roar by your arrogance. Actually you are free from slumber only because you are endowed with a digit of his power.
verses.hindi: सुरभि नामक पलीके गर्भसे अवतार ग्रहण किया
verses.commentary: Sense: After tearing to pieces a single demon you roar by your arrogance. Actually you are free from slumber only because you are endowed with a digit of his power.
verses.science: सुरभि नामक पलीके गर्भसे अवतार ग्रहण किया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शूलिनो ब्रह्मणो हत्या नापैति स्म च या क्वचित् । सा काश्यां क्षणतो नष्टा तस्मात्सेव्या हि काशिका
verses.transliteration: śūlino brahmaṇo hatyā nāpaiti sma ca yā kvacit | sā kāśyāṃ kṣaṇato naṣṭā tasmātsevyā hi kāśikā
verses.translation: O Nrsiriiha, if you consider lord Siva as a mere living being you are ignorant, very arrogant and full of aberrations in every respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Nrsiriiha, if you consider lord Siva as a mere living being you are ignorant, very arrogant and full of aberrations in every respect.
verses.science: बहुत प्रसन्‍न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कपालमोचनं काश्यां यः स्मरेत्तीर्थमुत्तमम् । इहान्यत्रापि यत्पापं क्षिप्रं तस्य प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: kapālamocanaṃ kāśyāṃ yaḥ smarettīrthamuttamam | ihānyatrāpi yatpāpaṃ kṣipraṃ tasya praṇaśyati
verses.translation: O Visnu, like the potter's wheel you are forcibly induced by Siva when you take the different incarnations. You are always dependent on him.
verses.hindi: रक्षाके लिये सदा स्वर्गमें विराजमान हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O Visnu, like the potter's wheel you are forcibly induced by Siva when you take the different incarnations. You are always dependent on him.
verses.science: रक्षाके लिये सदा स्वर्गमें विराजमान हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य तीर्थप्रवरे स्नानं कृत्वा विधानतः । तर्पयित्वा पितॄन्देवान्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: āgatya tīrthapravare snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | tarpayitvā pitṝndevānmucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: Your skull, left by you in the midst of the necklace of Siva, while you.had assumed the form of a tortoise, is still there. None who is burnt is bound. Is it your partial forgetfulness that in your body as a Boar your fangs were felled by the slayer of Taraka
verses.commentary: Sense: Your skull, left by you in the midst of the necklace of Siva, while you.had assumed the form of a tortoise, is still there. None who is burnt is bound. Is it your partial forgetfulness that in your body as a Boar your fangs were felled by the slayer of Taraka
verses.science: सदा रमण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कपालमोचनं तीर्थं पुरस्कृत्वा तु भैरवः । तत्रैव तस्थौ भक्तानां भक्षयन्नघसन्ततिम्
verses.transliteration: kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ puraskṛtvā tu bhairavaḥ | tatraiva tasthau bhaktānāṃ bhakṣayannaghasantatim
verses.translation: You were burnt by the fire of the Trident, O Visvaksena. At the time of Daksa's sacrifice your head was cut off by me brilliant in form.
verses.hindi: कपालमोचन नामक तीर्थको समादृतकर भैरव भक्तोंके पापसमूहका भक्षण करते हुए वहींपर विराजमान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: You were burnt by the fire of the Trident, O Visvaksena. At the time of Daksa's sacrifice your head was cut off by me brilliant in form.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु मार्गस्य मासस्य परमेश्वरः । आविर्बभूव सल्लीलो भैरवात्मा सतां प्रियः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu mārgasya māsasya parameśvaraḥ | āvirbabhūva sallīlo bhairavātmā satāṃ priyaḥ
verses.translation: O Vi?nu, the fifth head of Brahma your son, which was cut, has not been set right even now. It is for¬ gotten by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?nu, the fifth head of Brahma your son, which was cut, has not been set right even now. It is for¬ gotten by you.
verses.science: प्रदान करनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षासिताष्टम्यां कालभैरवसन्निधौ । उपोष्य जागरं कुर्वन्महापापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: mārgaśīrṣāsitāṣṭamyāṃ kālabhairavasannidhau | upoṣya jāgaraṃ kurvanmahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: This versf as well as the fourth foot of the previous verse is defective.
verses.hindi: तथा सम्पूर्ण मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: This versf as well as the fourth foot of the previous verse is defective.
verses.science: तथा सम्पूर्ण मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्रापि नरो भक्त्या तद् व्रतं यः करिष्यति । सजागरं महापापैर्मुक्तो यास्यति सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: anyatrāpi naro bhaktyā tad vrataṃ yaḥ kariṣyati | sajāgaraṃ mahāpāpairmukto yāsyati sadgatim
verses.translation: In a battle you were defeated by Dadhica along with the gods.** How can it be forgotten by you while scratching your head?
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: In a battle you were defeated by Dadhica along with the gods.** How can it be forgotten by you while scratching your head?
verses.science: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेकजन्मनियुतैर्यत्कृतं जन्तुभिस्त्वघम् । तत्सर्वं विलयं याति कालभैरवदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: anekajanmaniyutairyatkṛtaṃ jantubhistvagham | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kālabhairavadarśanāt
verses.translation: O discus-armed one, you are fond of your discus but you have forgotten whence you got it and by whom it was made.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां एकादशावतारवर्णन॑ नामाष्टादशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O discus-armed one, you are fond of your discus but you have forgotten whence you got it and by whom it was made.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां एकादशावतारवर्णन॑ नामाष्टादशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कालभैरवभक्तानां पातकानि करोति यः । स मूढो दुःखितो भूत्वा पुनर्दुर्गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: kālabhairavabhaktānāṃ pātakāni karoti yaḥ | sa mūḍho duḥkhito bhūtvā punardurgatimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Whatever worlds I have seized, in them, you lie down in the ocean, overcome by sleep. How can you then be a Sattvika?
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever worlds I have seized, in them, you lie down in the ocean, overcome by sleep. How can you then be a Sattvika?
verses.science: वर्णन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरेऽपि ये भक्ता नो भक्ताः कालभैरवे । ते लभन्ते महादुःखं काश्यां चैव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: viśveśvare'pi ye bhaktā no bhaktāḥ kālabhairave | te labhante mahāduḥkhaṃ kāśyāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: From you to a blade of grass, every thing expands and develops only through Rudra's power. Professing to possess power you have been deluded by the fire all round.
verses.hindi: जो काशीमें रहकर विश्वेश्वरमें तो भक्ति करते हैं, परंतु कालभैरवकी भक्ति नहीं करते, वे विशेषरूपसे महादुःखको प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: From you to a blade of grass, every thing expands and develops only through Rudra's power. Professing to possess power you have been deluded by the fire all round.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यामुषित्वा यो भैरवं न भजेन्नरः । तस्य पापानि वर्द्धन्ते शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāmuṣitvā yo bhairavaṃ na bhajennaraḥ | tasya pāpāni varddhante śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī
verses.translation: Lord Siva manifests himself in between heaven and earth, Indra and Agni, Yama and Varuna, in the heart of darkness and in the light of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva manifests himself in between heaven and earth, Indra and Agni, Yama and Varuna, in the heart of darkness and in the light of the moon.
verses.science: मुझे श्रेष्ठ पुत्र प्रदान करेंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालराजं न यः काश्यां प्रतिभूताष्टमीकुजम् । भजेत्तस्य क्षयं पुण्यं कृष्णपक्षे यथा शशी
verses.transliteration: kālarājaṃ na yaḥ kāśyāṃ pratibhūtāṣṭamīkujam | bhajettasya kṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe yathā śaśī
verses.translation: Thus taking everything in consideration you sub¬ due yourself by yourself. O Man-lion, O wise one, keep your¬ self safe.
verses.hindi: जो मंगलवार, चतुर्दशी तथा अष्टमीके दिन काशीमें कालराजका भजन नहीं करता है, उसका पुण्य कृष्णपक्षके चन्द्रमाके समान क्षीण हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus taking everything in consideration you sub¬ due yourself by yourself. O Man-lion, O wise one, keep your¬ self safe.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं ब्रह्महत्यापनोदकम् । भैरवोत्पत्तिसंज्ञं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmahatyāpanodakam | bhairavotpattisaṃjñaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Otherwise death will befall you like a thunderbolt on a stump due to the fury of the lord in the form of Bhairava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Otherwise death will befall you like a thunderbolt on a stump due to the fury of the lord in the form of Bhairava.
verses.science: विष्णुसे ब्रह्माजीने दुःख निवेदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बन्धनागारसंस्थोऽपि प्राप्तोऽपि विपदं पराम् । प्रादुर्भावं भैरवस्य श्रुत्वा मुच्येत सङ्कटात्
verses.transliteration: bandhanāgārasaṃstho'pi prāpto'pi vipadaṃ parām | prādurbhāvaṃ bhairavasya śrutvā mucyeta saṅkaṭāt
verses.translation: After saying this and observing the view of the Man-lion, Virabhadra the furious form of Siva, stopped. He was not afraid of anyone.
verses.hindi: शिवजीको प्रणाम करके उनकी स्तुति कौ
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and observing the view of the Man-lion, Virabhadra the furious form of Siva, stopped. He was not afraid of anyone.
verses.science: शिवजीको प्रणाम करके उनकी स्तुति कौ। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Then in a trice the form of Virabhadra became invisible. The splendour of Lord Siva was neither golden nor fiery, neither lunar nor solar. It resembled neither the lightning nor the moon. It was beyond comparison. The forms of brilliance were merged in Siva.
verses.hindi: स्थिति तथा प्रलय करनेवाले माने गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in a trice the form of Virabhadra became invisible. The splendour of Lord Siva was neither golden nor fiery, neither lunar nor solar. It resembled neither the lightning nor the moon. It was beyond comparison. The forms of brilliance were merged in Siva.
verses.science: स्थिति तथा प्रलय करनेवाले माने गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Then in a trice the form of Virabhadra became invisible. The splendour of Lord Siva was neither golden nor fiery, neither lunar nor solar. It resembled neither the lightning nor the moon. It was beyond comparison. The forms of brilliance were merged in Siva.
verses.hindi: संशयको दूरकर मुझे अभीष्ट वर दीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in a trice the form of Virabhadra became invisible. The splendour of Lord Siva was neither golden nor fiery, neither lunar nor solar. It resembled neither the lightning nor the moon. It was beyond comparison. The forms of brilliance were merged in Siva.
verses.science: संशयको दूरकर मुझे अभीष्ट वर दीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । नृसिंहचरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । विध्वंसी दक्षयज्ञस्य वीरभद्राह्वयः प्रभोः । अवतारश्च विज्ञेयः शिवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.10. daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | nṛsiṃhacaritavarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | vidhvaṃsī dakṣayajñasya vīrabhadrāhvayaḥ prabhoḥ | avatāraśca vijñeyaḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Even as all the gods stood watching with the auspi¬ cious shouts of victory. Lord Siva became manifest in the form the Annihilator.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as all the gods stood watching with the auspi¬ cious shouts of victory. Lord Siva became manifest in the form the Annihilator.
verses.science: अपने स्थानपर चले आये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सतीचरित्रे कथितं चरितं तस्य कृत्स्नशः । श्रुतं त्वयापि बहुधा नातः प्रोक्तं सुविस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: satīcaritre kathitaṃ caritaṃ tasya kṛtsnaśaḥ | śrutaṃ tvayāpi bahudhā nātaḥ proktaṃ suvistarāt
verses.translation: O lord Siva, Brahma, Vi?nu, Indra, the Moon, the gods, the sages, and the Daityas are born of you.
verses.hindi: उन्हें शिवांश जानकर पूर्ण रूपसे शान्त हो गया
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, Brahma, Vi?nu, Indra, the Moon, the gods, the sages, and the Daityas are born of you.
verses.science: उन्हें शिवांश जानकर पूर्ण रूपसे शान्त हो गया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं मुनिश्रेष्ठ भवत्स्नेहाद् ब्रवीमि तत् । शार्दूलाख्यावतारं च शङ्करस्य प्रभोः शृणु
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ muniśreṣṭha bhavatsnehād bravīmi tat | śārdūlākhyāvatāraṃ ca śaṅkarasya prabhoḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Then the gods freed from their distress began to sing the glory of this story. With their eyes blooming with wonder they returned the way they came.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gods freed from their distress began to sing the glory of this story. With their eyes blooming with wonder they returned the way they came.
verses.science: मुक्त भी कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवेन देवानां हितार्थं रूपमद्भुतम् । शारभं च धृतं दिव्यं ज्वलज्ज्वालासमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: sadāśivena devānāṃ hitārthaṃ rūpamadbhutam | śārabhaṃ ca dhṛtaṃ divyaṃ jvalajjvālāsamaprabham
verses.translation: He understood the real meaning of sacred lord. He followed the conduct of the virtuous. He was highly skilled in Siva ethics. He was the foremost among the knowers of worldly conventions.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंके द्वारा प्रदत्त वरोंको उन्होंने प्राप्त किया
verses.commentary: Sense: He understood the real meaning of sacred lord. He followed the conduct of the virtuous. He was highly skilled in Siva ethics. He was the foremost among the knowers of worldly conventions.
verses.science: ऋषियोंके द्वारा प्रदत्त वरोंको उन्होंने प्राप्त किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवावतारा अमिताः सद्भक्तहितकारकाः । सङ्ख्या न शक्यते कर्तुं तेषां च मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śivāvatārā amitāḥ sadbhaktahitakārakāḥ | saṅkhyā na śakyate kartuṃ teṣāṃ ca munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The six acts enjoined on a Brihmana are mentioned in MS lo. 75:
verses.commentary: Sense: The six acts enjoined on a Brihmana are mentioned in MS lo. 75:
verses.science: साथ उनकी सुखदायी मित्रता करवायी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशस्य च ताराणां रेणुकानां क्षितेस्तथा । आसाराणां च वृद्धेन बहुकल्पैः कदापि हि
verses.transliteration: ākāśasya ca tārāṇāṃ reṇukānāṃ kṣitestathā | āsārāṇāṃ ca vṛddhena bahukalpaiḥ kadāpi hi
verses.translation: When a long time elapsed in that manner lucismati the wife of that Brahmana who observed all rites spoje to her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a long time elapsed in that manner lucismati the wife of that Brahmana who observed all rites spoje to her husband.
verses.science: वालिका वध कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्ख्या विशक्यते कर्तुं सुप्राज्ञैर्बहुजन्मभिः । न वै शिवावताराणां सत्यं जानीहि मद्वचः
verses.transliteration: saṅkhyā viśakyate kartuṃ suprājñairbahujanmabhiḥ | na vai śivāvatārāṇāṃ satyaṃ jānīhi madvacaḥ
verses.translation: "O Lord, by your favour, all pleasures which women could expect have been enjoyed by me in your company.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, by your favour, all pleasures which women could expect have been enjoyed by me in your company.
verses.science: सीताकी खोजमें लग गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथापि च यथाबुद्ध्या कथयामि यथाश्रुतम् । चरित्रं शारभं दिव्यं परमैश्वर्यसूचकम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi ca yathābuddhyā kathayāmi yathāśrutam | caritraṃ śārabhaṃ divyaṃ paramaiśvaryasūcakam
verses.translation: O Lord, still a desire has been lurking in my heart for a long time.!♦ is proper to all householders. You shall grant it to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, still a desire has been lurking in my heart for a long time.!♦ is proper to all householders. You shall grant it to me.
verses.science: बड़ी शीघ्रतासे लॉघकर वहाँ गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जयश्च विजयश्चैव भवद्भिः शापितौ यदा । तदा दितिसुतौ द्वौ तावभूतां कश्यपान्मुने
verses.transliteration: jayaśca vijayaścaiva bhavadbhiḥ śāpitau yadā | tadā ditisutau dvau tāvabhūtāṃ kaśyapānmune
verses.translation: O gentle lady of beautiful hips ever desirous of my welfare, what is there that cannot be granted to you? O lucky one, you may ask for it. I shall grant it to you with¬ out ielay.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र ही उनके शोकको दूर कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady of beautiful hips ever desirous of my welfare, what is there that cannot be granted to you? O lucky one, you may ask for it. I shall grant it to you with¬ out ielay.
verses.science: शीघ्र ही उनके शोकको दूर कर दिया। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुश्चाद्यो हिरण्याक्षोऽनुजो बली । देवर्षिपार्षदौ जातौ तौ द्वावपि दितेः सुतौ
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipuścādyo hiraṇyākṣo'nujo balī | devarṣipārṣadau jātau tau dvāvapi diteḥ sutau
verses.translation: He had a thousand hands and wore matted hair. His head was adorned by the crescent moon. He appeared like a bird with wings and beak. His body was fierce and fully developed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a thousand hands and wore matted hair. His head was adorned by the crescent moon. He appeared like a bird with wings and beak. His body was fierce and fully developed.
verses.science: समुद्रसे उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्व्युद्धारे विधात्रा व प्रार्थितो हि पुरा प्रभुः । हिरण्याक्षं जघानासौ विष्णुर्वाराहरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: pṛthvyuddhāre vidhātrā va prārthito hi purā prabhuḥ | hiraṇyākṣaṃ jaghānāsau viṣṇurvārāharūpadhṛk
verses.translation: His fangs were very sharp. Adamantine claws were his weapons. His neck was black in colour. He had huge arms and four legs. He was blazing like fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: His fangs were very sharp. Adamantine claws were his weapons. His neck was black in colour. He had huge arms and four legs. He was blazing like fire.
verses.science: संन्यासपद्धतिका संवर्धन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं श्रुत्वा भ्रातरं वीरं निहतं प्राणसन्निभम् । चुकोप हरयेऽतीव हिरण्यकशिपुर्मुने
verses.transliteration: taṃ śrutvā bhrātaraṃ vīraṃ nihataṃ prāṇasannibham | cukopa haraye'tīva hiraṇyakaśipurmune
verses.translation: His fangs and lips were clearly visible. He was pro¬ ducing a hissing sound of Hurhkara. Siva of such a form appeared in sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: His fangs and lips were clearly visible. He was pro¬ ducing a hissing sound of Hurhkara. Siva of such a form appeared in sight.
verses.science: धर्मकी परीक्षा भी ली। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणामयुतं तप्त्वा ब्रह्मणो वरमाप सः । न कश्चिन्मारयेन्मां वै त्वत्सृष्टाविति तुष्टतः
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇāmayutaṃ taptvā brahmaṇo varamāpa saḥ | na kaścinmārayenmāṃ vai tvatsṛṣṭāviti tuṣṭataḥ
verses.translation: At his very vision Visnu lost his strength and exploit. He assumed a lustre of the flickering glow-worm beneath the sun. *
verses.commentary: Sense: At his very vision Visnu lost his strength and exploit. He assumed a lustre of the flickering glow-worm beneath the sun. *
verses.science: आख्यानको आप सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शोणिताख्यपुरं गत्वा देवानाहूय सर्वतः । त्रिलोकीं स्ववशे कृत्वा चक्रे राज्यमकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: śoṇitākhyapuraṃ gatvā devānāhūya sarvataḥ | trilokīṃ svavaśe kṛtvā cakre rājyamakaṇṭakam
verses.translation: Like a vulture seizing a serpent he fearlessly caught hold of Visnu, lifted him up and fell him to the ground. At the time of flight he was excessively oppressed,
verses.hindi: व वह हिरण्यकशिपु शोणितपुर नामक पुरमें जाकर चारों हरे देवताओंको बुलाकर त्रिलोकीको अपने वशमें करके निष्कण्टक राज्य करने लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a vulture seizing a serpent he fearlessly caught hold of Visnu, lifted him up and fell him to the ground. At the time of flight he was excessively oppressed,

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिकदनं चक्रे सर्वधर्मविलोपकः । द्विजपीडाकरः पापी हिरण्यकशिपुर्मुने
verses.transliteration: devarṣikadanaṃ cakre sarvadharmavilopakaḥ | dvijapīḍākaraḥ pāpī hiraṇyakaśipurmune
verses.translation: All the gods followed him eulogising him with the words of obeisance. Brahma and other sages bowed to him with reverence and love.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the gods followed him eulogising him with the words of obeisance. Brahma and other sages bowed to him with reverence and love.
verses.science: साथ ले उनके समीप गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्लादेन स्वपुत्रेण हरिभक्तेन दैत्यराट् । यदा विद्वेषमकरोद्धरिर्वैरी विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: prahlādena svaputreṇa haribhaktena daityarāṭ | yadā vidveṣamakaroddharirvairī viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: After eulogising Mrda with the hundred and eight names of the lord, Nrsirhha requested lord larabha again.
verses.hindi: लिये उन्होंने वहाँ बहुत विलम्ब कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising Mrda with the hundred and eight names of the lord, Nrsirhha requested lord larabha again.
verses.science: लिये उन्होंने वहाँ बहुत विलम्ब कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सभास्तम्भात्तदा विष्णुरभूदाविर्द्रुतं मने । सन्ध्यायां क्रोधमापन्नो नृसिंहवपुषा ततः
verses.transliteration: sabhāstambhāttadā viṣṇurabhūdāvirdrutaṃ mane | sandhyāyāṃ krodhamāpanno nṛsiṃhavapuṣā tataḥ
verses.translation: "O great lord, whenever my ignorant mind be¬ comes defiled by arrogance, it shall be removed by you alone.**
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great lord, whenever my ignorant mind be¬ comes defiled by arrogance, it shall be removed by you alone.**
verses.science: लिये शीघ्रतासे प्रकट हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा मुनिशार्दूल करालं नृहरेर्वपुः । प्रजज्वालातिभयदं त्रासयन्दैत्यसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: sarvathā muniśārdūla karālaṃ nṛharervapuḥ | prajajvālātibhayadaṃ trāsayandaityasattamān
verses.translation: Within a trice Virabhadra made his powerful body powerless and dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within a trice Virabhadra made his powerful body powerless and dead.
verses.science: नहीं तो प्रलय हो जायगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहेन तदा दैत्या निहताश्चैव तत्क्षणम् । हिरण्यकशिपुश्चाथ युद्धं चक्रे सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃhena tadā daityā nihatāścaiva tatkṣaṇam | hiraṇyakaśipuścātha yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other gods eulogised lord Siva who had assumed the form of a Sarabha and who was the sole benefactor of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: नृसिंहने उसी क्षण सभी दैत्योंका संहार कर डाला और तब [ दैत्योंके संहारको देखकर] हिरण्यकशिपुने उनसे अत्यन्त भयानक युद्ध किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma and other gods eulogised lord Siva who had assumed the form of a Sarabha and who was the sole benefactor of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: महायुद्धं तयोरासीन्मुहूर्त्तं मुनिसत्तमाः । विकरालं च भयदं सर्वेषां रोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: mahāyuddhaṃ tayorāsīnmuhūrttaṃ munisattamāḥ | vikarālaṃ ca bhayadaṃ sarveṣāṃ romaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: O lord of all, you alone create and protect Brahma
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of all, you alone create and protect Brahma
verses.science: आप उनका दूसरा चरित्र सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सायं चकर्ष देवेशो देहल्यां दैत्यपुङ्गवम् । व्योम्नि देवेषु पश्यत्सु नृसिंहश्च रमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sāyaṃ cakarṣa deveśo dehalyāṃ daityapuṅgavam | vyomni deveṣu paśyatsu nṛsiṃhaśca rameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Since you annihilate the world, you are called Hara by the learned. Since Visnu was curbed and caught hold of by you, you are called Hara by the learned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since you annihilate the world, you are called Hara by the learned. Since Visnu was curbed and caught hold of by you, you are called Hara by the learned.
verses.science: बसुदेवके पुत्ररूपमें अवतरित हुए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोत्सङ्गे च तं कृत्वा नखैस्तदुदरं द्रुतम् । विदार्य मारयामास पश्यतां त्रिदिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: athotsaṅge ca taṃ kṛtvā nakhaistadudaraṃ drutam | vidārya mārayāmāsa paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām
verses.translation: Vou are the great Purusa, Siva, lord of all, leader of the gods, the soul of the indigent, of a mind without aberrations. You are the great Brahman, the goal of the good.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vou are the great Purusa, Siva, lord of all, leader of the gods, the soul of the indigent, of a mind without aberrations. You are the great Brahman, the goal of the good.
verses.science: ब्राह्मणोंकी रक्षा की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हते हिरण्यकशिपौ नृसिंहेनैव विष्णुना । जगत्स्वास्थ्यं तदा लेभे न वै देवा विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: hate hiraṇyakaśipau nṛsiṃhenaiva viṣṇunā | jagatsvāsthyaṃ tadā lebhe na vai devā viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: You are the kinsman of the distressed, the ocean of mercy, of wonderful sports, the vision of the great soul, the intelligent, the Immense Cosmic Being, the all-pervasive, the truth, the Existence, knowledge and Bliss as the charac¬ teristics.
verses.hindi: इच्छासे वे (दुर्वासा) मुनि कृष्णके पास पहुँचे
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the kinsman of the distressed, the ocean of mercy, of wonderful sports, the vision of the great soul, the intelligent, the Immense Cosmic Being, the all-pervasive, the truth, the Existence, knowledge and Bliss as the charac¬ teristics.
verses.science: इच्छासे वे (दुर्वासा) मुनि कृष्णके पास पहुँचे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रह्लादो विस्मयं गतः । लक्ष्मीश्च विस्मयं प्राप्ता रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं हरेः
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo neduḥ prahlādo vismayaṃ gataḥ | lakṣmīśca vismayaṃ prāptā rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā'dbhutaṃ hareḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the gods, iva, the great God, spoke to the gods and the great ancient sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of the gods, iva, the great God, spoke to the gods and the great ancient sages.
verses.science: उस रथका वहन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हतो यद्यपि दैत्येन्द्रस्तथापि न परं सुखम् । ययुर्देवा नृसिंहस्य ज्वाला सा न निवर्तिता
verses.transliteration: hato yadyapi daityendrastathāpi na paraṃ sukham | yayurdevā nṛsiṃhasya jvālā sā na nivartitā
verses.translation: Just as water poured into water, or milk poured into milk, or ghee poured into ghee becomes one with those
verses.hindi: वज्र्के समान अंगवाला होनेका वर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as water poured into water, or milk poured into milk, or ghee poured into ghee becomes one with those
verses.science: वज्र्के समान अंगवाला होनेका वर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तया च व्याकुलं जातं सर्वं चैव जगत्पुनः । देवाश्च दुःखमापन्नाः किं भविष्यति वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: tayā ca vyākulaṃ jātaṃ sarvaṃ caiva jagatpunaḥ | devāśca duḥkhamāpannāḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyati vā punaḥ
verses.translation: He shall be prayed and bowed by my devotees aspiring achievements. He is the foremost of my devotees and the granter of boons.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करके उनकी लज्जाको ढँक दिया था
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be prayed and bowed by my devotees aspiring achievements. He is the foremost of my devotees and the granter of boons.
verses.science: प्रदान करके उनकी लज्जाको ढँक दिया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं च वदन्तस्ते भयादू दूरमुपस्थिताः । नृसिंहक्रोधजज्वालाव्याकुलाः पद्मभूमुखाः
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ ca vadantaste bhayādū dūramupasthitāḥ | nṛsiṃhakrodhajajvālāvyākulāḥ padmabhūmukhāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the lordly king of birds of great strength, vanished there itself even as all the gods were watching.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the lordly king of birds of great strength, vanished there itself even as all the gods were watching.
verses.science: प्रभावसे द्रौपदीने पाण्डबोंको सुखी बनाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्रादं प्रेषयामासुस्तच्छान्त्यै निकटं हरेः । सर्वान्मिलित्वा प्रह्लादः प्रार्थितो गतवांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: prahrādaṃ preṣayāmāsustacchāntyai nikaṭaṃ hareḥ | sarvānmilitvā prahlādaḥ prārthito gatavāṃstadā
verses.translation: Lord Virabhadra, the leader of the Ganas, of great strength, peeled off the hide of the Man-lion and went to the mountain taking it with him.
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्णको सन्देश देकर उनका नाश करवाया
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Virabhadra, the leader of the Ganas, of great strength, peeled off the hide of the Man-lion and went to the mountain taking it with him.
verses.science: श्रीकृष्णको सन्देश देकर उनका नाश करवाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उरसाऽऽलिङ्गयामास तं नृसिंहः कृपानिधिः । हृदयं शीतलं जातं रुड्ज्वाला न निवर्त्तिता
verses.transliteration: urasā''liṅgayāmāsa taṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ | hṛdayaṃ śītalaṃ jātaṃ ruḍjvālā na nivarttitā
verses.translation: From that time Siva began to wear the hide of
verses.commentary: Sense: From that time Siva began to wear the hide of
verses.science: रीतिके अनुसार संन्यासपद्धतिकी स्थापना की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथापि न निवृता रुड्ज्वाला नरहरेर्यदा । दुःखं प्राप्तास्ततो देवाः शङ्कर शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tathāpi na nivṛtā ruḍjvālā narahareryadā | duḥkhaṃ prāptāstato devāḥ śaṅkara śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the great narrative, which being sacred has the flavour of the Vedas, will realise all hk desires
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the great narrative, which being sacred has the flavour of the Vedas, will realise all hk desires
verses.science: कामनाओंको देनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्माद्या मुनयस्तथा । शङ्करं स्तवयामासुर्लोकानां सुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā surāḥ sarve brahmādyā munayastathā | śaṅkaraṃ stavayāmāsurlokānāṃ sukhahetave
verses.translation: It subdues misery, yields the fruits of desires and is the abode of auspicious features. It removes premature death, confers intelligence and destroys enemies.
verses.hindi: लोकमें एवं परलोकमें सुखी रहता है
verses.commentary: Sense: It subdues misery, yields the fruits of desires and is the abode of auspicious features. It removes premature death, confers intelligence and destroys enemies.
verses.science: लोकमें एवं परलोकमें सुखी रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल । पाहि नः शरणापन्नान्सर्वान्देवाञ्जगन्ति च
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala | pāhi naḥ śaraṇāpannānsarvāndevāñjaganti ca
verses.translation: This great form of Siva in the form of Sarabha shall be made public only among the leading devotees of Siva.
verses.hindi: देवता बोले--हे देवदेव! हे महादेव! हे शरणागतवत्सल ! शरणमें आये हुए हम सभी देवताओं तथा लोकोंकी रक्षा कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: This great form of Siva in the form of Sarabha shall be made public only among the leading devotees of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु सदाशिव । पूर्वं दुःखं यदा जातं तदा ते रक्षिता वयम्
verses.transliteration: namaste'stu namaste'stu namaste'stu sadāśiva | pūrvaṃ duḥkhaṃ yadā jātaṃ tadā te rakṣitā vayam
verses.translation: This shall be read and listened to only by them with their soul dedicated to Siva. It then confers the nine¬ fold devotion. It is divine. It purifies the inner mind and sense.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक उन्‍नीसवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: This shall be read and listened to only by them with their soul dedicated to Siva. It then confers the nine¬ fold devotion. It is divine. It purifies the inner mind and sense.
verses.science: वर्णन नामक उन्‍नीसवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रो मथितश्चैव रत्नानां च विभागशः । कृते देवैस्तदा शम्भो गृहीतं गरलं त्वया
verses.transliteration: samudro mathitaścaiva ratnānāṃ ca vibhāgaśaḥ | kṛte devaistadā śambho gṛhītaṃ garalaṃ tvayā
verses.translation: This shall be read during the festivals of Siva, during the eighth and fourteenth Tithis, and at the instal¬ lation of the idol. It then causes the presence of Siva.
verses.hindi: तत्सर्व चरितं विप्र श्रुणु सर्वसुखावहम्॥ २  उस सम्पूर्ण चरित्रका श्रवण कौजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: This shall be read during the festivals of Siva, during the eighth and fourteenth Tithis, and at the instal¬ lation of the idol. It then causes the presence of Siva.
verses.science: तत्सर्व चरितं विप्र श्रुणु सर्वसुखावहम्॥ २ उस सम्पूर्ण चरित्रका श्रवण कौजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्षिताः स्म तदा नाथ नीलकण्ठ इति श्रुतः । विषं पास्यसि नो चेत्त्वं भस्मीभूतास्तदाखिलाः
verses.transliteration: rakṣitāḥ sma tadā nātha nīlakaṇṭha iti śrutaḥ | viṣaṃ pāsyasi no cettvaṃ bhasmībhūtāstadākhilāḥ
verses.translation: When there is danger from thieves, tigers, lions, one's own or enemy kings, during commotions earth¬ quakes and robberies, dust storms, when there is the fall of meteors, when there is draught or too much of rain—during all these occasions he who reads this with purity becomes a great devotee of Siva steady in his rites and very learned.
verses.wordMeaning: When there is danger from thieves, tigers, lions, one's own or enemy kings, during commotions earth¬ quakes and robberies, dust storms, when there is the fall of meteors,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When there is danger from thieves, tigers, lions, one's own or enemy kings, during commotions earth¬ quakes and robberies, dust storms, when there is the fall of meteors,…
verses.science: उत्सर्ग कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसिद्धं च यदा यस्य दुःखं च जायते प्रभो । तदा त्वन्नाममात्रेण सर्वं दुःखं विलीयते
verses.transliteration: prasiddhaṃ ca yadā yasya duḥkhaṃ ca jāyate prabho | tadā tvannāmamātreṇa sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vilīyate
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this without any spe¬ cific desire and performs the rites of Siva attains Rudra's region and becomes a follower of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this without any spe¬ cific desire and performs the rites of Siva attains Rudra's region and becomes a follower of Rudra.
verses.science: स्थापित. कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं नृहरिज्वालापीडितान्नः सदाशिव । तां त्वं शमयितुं देव शक्तोऽसीति सुनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ nṛharijvālāpīḍitānnaḥ sadāśiva | tāṃ tvaṃ śamayituṃ deva śakto'sīti suniścitam
verses.translation: O sage, after attaining Rudra's region he rejoices with Rudra. Then he becomes one with Rudra by the mercy of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after attaining Rudra's region he rejoices with Rudra. Then he becomes one with Rudra by the mercy of Siva.
verses.science: कानके माध्यमसे स्थापित कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति स्तुतस्तदा देवैः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्माऽभयं दत्त्वा परं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti stutastadā devaiḥ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ | pratyuvāca prasannātmā'bhayaṃ dattvā paraṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, listen lovingly to the narrative of the moon-crestcd lord $iva how he was bom willingly in tlie house ofVivanara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Brahma, listen lovingly to the narrative of the moon-crestcd lord $iva how he was bom willingly in tlie house ofVivanara.
verses.science: नामसे प्रकट हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । स्वस्थानं गच्छत सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मादयोऽभयाः । शमयिष्यामि यद्दुःखं सर्वथा हि व्रतं मम
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | svasthānaṃ gacchata surāḥ sarve brahmādayo'bhayāḥ | śamayiṣyāmi yadduḥkhaṃ sarvathā hi vrataṃ mama
verses.translation: On the beautiful banks of Narmada in the city of Dharmapura, formerly there lived a devotee of Siva, a soul, the sage Vivanara.
verses.hindi: छोटा फल जानकर निगल गये थे
verses.commentary: Sense: On the beautiful banks of Narmada in the city of Dharmapura, formerly there lived a devotee of Siva, a soul, the sage Vivanara.
verses.science: छोटा फल जानकर निगल गये थे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: गतो मच्छरणं यस्तु तस्य दुःखं क्षयं गतम् । मत्प्रियः शरणापन्नः प्राणेभ्योऽपि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gato maccharaṇaṃ yastu tasya duḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam | matpriyaḥ śaraṇāpannaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After pondering over the good qualities of an ideal housewife, Viivanara married with due rites the daughter of Kala who was really worthy of him.
verses.hindi: जो भी मेरी शरणमें आता है, उसका दुःख नष्ट हो जाता है; क्योंकि शरणागत मुझे प्राणोंसे भी अधिक प्रिय हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: After pondering over the good qualities of an ideal housewife, Viivanara married with due rites the daughter of Kala who was really worthy of him.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा तदा देवा ह्यानन्दम्परमं गताः । यथागतं तथा जग्मुः स्मरन्तः शङ्करं मुदा
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti śrutvā tadā devā hyānandamparamaṃ gatāḥ | yathāgataṃ tathā jagmuḥ smarantaḥ śaṅkaraṃ mudā
verses.translation: The five daily sacrifices to be performed by a householder
verses.commentary: Sense: The five daily sacrifices to be performed by a householder
verses.science: हनुमानूजीके साथ निवास करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of her husband she who thought her husband to be a deity was delighted. Joining her palms in reverence she humbly said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of her husband she who thought her husband to be a deity was delighted. Joining her palms in reverence she humbly said.
verses.science: लेकर रामचन्द्रके पास लौटने लगे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of her husband she who thought her husband to be a deity was delighted. Joining her palms in reverence she humbly said.
verses.hindi: मारकर वहाँ लंकामें महान् उपद्रव किया
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of her husband she who thought her husband to be a deity was delighted. Joining her palms in reverence she humbly said.
verses.science: मारकर वहाँ लंकामें महान् उपद्रव किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । शरभावतारवर्णनम् १ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर्मतिं चक्रे कृपालयः । महातेजो नृसिंहाख्यं संहर्त्तुं परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.11. ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śarabhāvatāravarṇanam 1 | nandīśvara uvāca | evamabhyarthito devairmatiṃ cakre kṛpālayaḥ | mahātejo nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ saṃharttuṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing her words that Brahmin of pure rites entered into mystic trance for a short while and thought in his heart thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words that Brahmin of pure rites entered into mystic trance for a short while and thought in his heart thus.
verses.science: करके समुद्रमें कूद पड़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदूर्ध्वं स्मृतवान् रुद्रो वीरभद्रं महाबलम् । आत्मनो भैरवं रूपं प्राह प्रलयकारकम्
verses.transliteration: tadūrdhvaṃ smṛtavān rudro vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam | ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ prāha pralayakārakam
verses.translation: If any one worships the Viresvara phallic image for a year with great devotion he obtains longevity, cherished desires, sons and other things.
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्‍्तमें परम मोक्षको प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one worships the Viresvara phallic image for a year with great devotion he obtains longevity, cherished desires, sons and other things.
verses.science: भोगकर अन्‍्तमें परम मोक्षको प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम ततः सद्यो गणानामग्रणीर्हसन् । साट्टहासैर्गणवरैरुत्पतद्भिरितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: ājagāma tataḥ sadyo gaṇānāmagraṇīrhasan | sāṭṭahāsairgaṇavarairutpatadbhiritastataḥ
verses.translation: Coolness in the water, heat in the fire, the scor¬ ching nature in the sun and the pleasing gentleness in the moon, fragrance in the flower and the ghee in the milk— just, in that manner, O Siva, you are the essense in the world. Hence I resort to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coolness in the water, heat in the fire, the scor¬ ching nature in the sun and the pleasing gentleness in the moon, fragrance in the flower and the ghee in the milk— just, in that manner, O Siva, you are the essense in the world. Hence I resort to you.
verses.science: पृथ्वीपर अवतरित हुए। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहरूपैरत्युग्रैः कोटिभिः परिवारितः । माद्यद्भिरभितो वीरैर्नृत्यद्भिश्च मुदान्वितैः
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃharūpairatyugraiḥ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ | mādyadbhirabhito vīrairnṛtyadbhiśca mudānvitaiḥ
verses.translation: O intelligent one, I shall become your son in Sucimati. I shall be known as Grhapati, pure and loved by all gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, I shall become your son in Sucimati. I shall be known as Grhapati, pure and loved by all gods.
verses.science: सम्पन्न पर्वतश्रेष्ठ मन्दराचलके समीप गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडद्भिश्च महावीरैर्ब्रह्माद्यैः कन्दुकैरिव । अदृष्टपूर्वैरन्यैश्च वेष्टितो वीरवन्दितः
verses.transliteration: krīḍadbhiśca mahāvīrairbrahmādyaiḥ kandukairiva | adṛṣṭapūrvairanyaiśca veṣṭito vīravanditaḥ
verses.translation: Then at the conjunction of stars when Jupiter was in the centre, when the Lagna was auspicious, when the good planets stood in pairs, Siva, the giver of happiness to all, was born as the son of Sucimatl. His face resembled the moon. The lamps in the lying-in-chamber were dim¬ med by his bodily lustre. The lord, the destroyer of mis¬ fortunes and the bestower of happiness to the dwellers of the Earth, the nether worlds and the heaven was born as the son. The smoke exuding therefrom became the perfume to sweeten the breath of the quarters. The immense clouds showered flowers of pleasing fragrance. The divine drums were sounded and the quarters were brightened up.
verses.hindi: देखकर उन्हें सुखपूर्वक यथास्थान ले गये
verses.wordMeaning: Then at the conjunction of stars when Jupiter was in the centre, when the Lagna was auspicious, when the good planets stood in pairs, Siva, the giver of happiness to all, was born as the son of Sucimatl. His face resembled the moon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the conjunction of stars when Jupiter was in the centre, when the Lagna was auspicious, when the good planets stood in pairs, Siva, the giver of happiness to all, was born as the son of Sucimatl. His face resembled the moon.…
verses.science: देखकर उन्हें सुखपूर्वक यथास्थान ले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्तज्वलनज्वालो विलसल्लोचनत्रयः । अशस्त्रो हि जटाजूटी ज्वलद् बालेन्दुमण्डितः
verses.transliteration: kalpāntajvalanajvālo vilasallocanatrayaḥ | aśastro hi jaṭājūṭī jvalad bālendumaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: The visitors praised the infant. They were at the height of their joy. They spoke in unison "O what a beauty! What a splendour! All the characteristic signs are there in all the limbs. How fortunate is Sucimati! Siva himself is born. What is surprising in this? Siva has in¬ carnated in all devotees. Siva has been worshipped by her." Then they took leave of Visvanara and departed.
verses.wordMeaning: The visitors praised the infant. They were at the height of their joy. They spoke in unison "O what a beauty! What a splendour! All the characteristic signs are there in all the limbs. How fortunate is Sucimati! Siva himself is born.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The visitors praised the infant. They were at the height of their joy. They spoke in unison "O what a beauty! What a splendour! All the characteristic signs are there in all the limbs. How fortunate is Sucimati! Siva himself is born.…
verses.science: नाम द्वार्विशेष ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुवलयाकारतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राङ्कुरद्वयः । आखण्डलधनुःखण्डसन्निभभ्रूलतान्वितः
verses.transliteration: bālenduvalayākāratīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāṅkuradvayaḥ | ākhaṇḍaladhanuḥkhaṇḍasannibhabhrūlatānvitaḥ
verses.translation: In his ninth year, Narada came there to see Grhapati, son of Visvanari, and found him engaged in ser¬ ving his parents.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his ninth year, Narada came there to see Grhapati, son of Visvanari, and found him engaged in ser¬ ving his parents.
verses.science: गम्भीर वाणीमें कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रचण्डहुङ्कारबधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः । नीलमेघाञ्जनश्यामो भीषणः श्मश्रुलोऽद्भुतः
verses.transliteration: mahāpracaṇḍahuṅkārabadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ | nīlameghāñjanaśyāmo bhīṣaṇaḥ śmaśrulo'dbhutaḥ
verses.translation: The divine sage reached the hut of Visvanara, received due hospitality and seated himself. Eagerly he enquired of his health.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine sage reached the hut of Visvanara, received due hospitality and seated himself. Eagerly he enquired of his health.
verses.science: अपराधको क्षमा कौजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वाद्यखण्डमखण्डाभ्यां भ्रामयंस्त्रिशिखं मुहुः । वीरभद्रोऽपि भगवान्वीरशक्तिविजृम्भितः
verses.transliteration: vādyakhaṇḍamakhaṇḍābhyāṃ bhrāmayaṃstriśikhaṃ muhuḥ | vīrabhadro'pi bhagavānvīraśaktivijṛmbhitaḥ
verses.translation: He remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and mentioned to Visvanara the future fortune and activities of his son.
verses.hindi: जिसके कारण आज आपने मेरे साथ युद्ध किया 2
verses.commentary: Sense: He remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and mentioned to Visvanara the future fortune and activities of his son.
verses.science: जिसके कारण आज आपने मेरे साथ युद्ध किया 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं विज्ञापयामास किमत्र स्मृतिकारणम् । आज्ञापय जगत्स्वामिन् प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa kimatra smṛtikāraṇam | ājñāpaya jagatsvāmin prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi
verses.translation: After thinking like this, the sage Visvanara of liberal heart who strictly adhered to the principle of mono¬ gamy spoke to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking like this, the sage Visvanara of liberal heart who strictly adhered to the principle of mono¬ gamy spoke to her.
verses.science: श्रीरमजीके पास गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य महेशानो वीरभद्रोक्तमादरात् । विलोक्य वचनं प्रीत्या प्रोवाच खलदण्डधृक्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya maheśāno vīrabhadroktamādarāt | vilokya vacanaṃ prītyā provāca khaladaṇḍadhṛk
verses.translation: After consoling his wife, the sage set out for pen¬ ance to the city of Varana- • where Lord Jiva himself is stationed.
verses.commentary: Sense: After consoling his wife, the sage set out for pen¬ ance to the city of Varana- • where Lord Jiva himself is stationed.
verses.science: लाकर समुद्रपर पुल बाधा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । अकाले भयमुत्पन्नं देवानामपि भैरवम् । ज्वलितः स नृसिंहाग्निः शमयैनं दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | akāle bhayamutpannaṃ devānāmapi bhairavam | jvalitaḥ sa nṛsiṃhāgniḥ śamayainaṃ durāsadam
verses.translation: Reaching Varanasi immediately and seeing Mani- karnika"®, he was freed from three distresses acquired in the course of hundreds of births.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reaching Varanasi immediately and seeing Mani- karnika"®, he was freed from three distresses acquired in the course of hundreds of births.
verses.science: लंकाको घेरकर राक्षसोंसे युद्ध किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सान्त्वयन् बोधयादौ तं तेन किन्नोपशाम्यति । ततो मत्परमं भावं भैरवं सम्प्रदर्शय
verses.transliteration: sāntvayan bodhayādau taṃ tena kinnopaśāmyati | tato matparamaṃ bhāvaṃ bhairavaṃ sampradarśaya
verses.translation: He saw Visvevara and other phallic images. He performed ablutions in all holy ditches, wells, tanks and lakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw Visvevara and other phallic images. He performed ablutions in all holy ditches, wells, tanks and lakes.
verses.science: और सम्पूर्ण सेनाकी रक्षा कौ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मं संहृत्य सूक्ष्मेण स्थूलं स्थूलेन तेजसा । वशमानय वन्हिं त्वं वीरभद्र ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmaṃ saṃhṛtya sūkṣmeṇa sthūlaṃ sthūlena tejasā | vaśamānaya vanhiṃ tvaṃ vīrabhadra mamājñayā
verses.translation: He bDwed to all Vinayakas and Sarva Gauri. He worshipped Kalaraja Bhairava who devours sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He bDwed to all Vinayakas and Sarva Gauri. He worshipped Kalaraja Bhairava who devours sins.
verses.science: देवताओंको सुखी बनाया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्यादिष्टो गणाध्यक्षो प्रशान्तं वपुरास्थितः । जगाम रंहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते नरकेसरी
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityādiṣṭo gaṇādhyakṣo praśāntaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ | jagāma raṃhasā tatra yatrāste narakesarī
verses.translation: Strenuously he eulogised Dandanayaka and other Ganas, Adikeava and others. He propitiated Ke.-iava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Strenuously he eulogised Dandanayaka and other Ganas, Adikeava and others. He propitiated Ke.-iava.
verses.science: अपने स्थानपर ला दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्बोधयामास वीरभद्रो हरो हरिम् । उवाच वाक्यमीशानः पितापुत्रमिवौरसम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sambodhayāmāsa vīrabhadro haro harim | uvāca vākyamīśānaḥ pitāputramivaurasam
verses.translation: He bowed to Lolarka and other suns again and again. Without lethargy he offered balls of rice in all the holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: He bowed to Lolarka and other suns again and again. Without lethargy he offered balls of rice in all the holy centres.
verses.science: एवं नाना प्रकारकी लीलाएँ कीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र उवाच । जगत्सुखाय भगवन्नवतीर्णोऽसि माधव । स्थित्यर्थं त्वं प्रयुक्तोऽसि परेशः परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadra uvāca | jagatsukhāya bhagavannavatīrṇo'si mādhava | sthityarthaṃ tvaṃ prayukto'si pareśaḥ parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: He satiated sages and brahmins by means of *-'feed- ing thousand" and other rites. With devotion he propitiated the phallic images of Siva by means of great worship and service.
verses.commentary: Sense: He satiated sages and brahmins by means of *-'feed- ing thousand" and other rites. With devotion he propitiated the phallic images of Siva by means of great worship and service.
verses.science: भक्तोंका उद्धार करनेवाले थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जन्तुचक्रं भगवता प्रच्छन्नं मत्स्यरूपिणा । पुच्छेनैव समाबध्य भ्रमन्नेकार्णवे पुरा
verses.transliteration: jantucakraṃ bhagavatā pracchannaṃ matsyarūpiṇā | pucchenaiva samābadhya bhramannekārṇave purā
verses.translation: Thinking thus for a moment, the intelligent sage Visvanara praised the VireSa form of Siva which confers the blessings of a son immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus for a moment, the intelligent sage Visvanara praised the VireSa form of Siva which confers the blessings of a son immediately.
verses.science: संहार करनेवाले तथा भक्तवत्सल थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्षि कूर्मरूपेण वाराहेणोद्धृता मही । अनेन हरिरूपेण हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः
verses.transliteration: bibharṣi kūrmarūpeṇa vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī | anena harirūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ
verses.translation: Innumerable thousands of Siddhas have derived the fulfilment of their desire from the worship of Siva. Hence Virea is famous as the fruit-yielding phallic image.
verses.commentary: Sense: Innumerable thousands of Siddhas have derived the fulfilment of their desire from the worship of Siva. Hence Virea is famous as the fruit-yielding phallic image.
verses.science: फल देनेवाला है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वामनेन बलिर्बद्धस्त्वया विक्रमता पुनः । त्वमेव सर्वभूतानां प्रभवः प्रभुरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: vāmanena balirbaddhastvayā vikramatā punaḥ | tvameva sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhavaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ
verses.translation: T too shall worship Virea here thrice a day and shall ere long acquire a son as desired by my wife.
verses.hindi: झ््ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां हनुमदवतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम विंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: T too shall worship Virea here thrice a day and shall ere long acquire a son as desired by my wife.
verses.science: झ््ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां हनुमदवतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम विंशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि लोकस्य दुःखं किञ्चित्प्रजायते । तदा तदावतीर्णस्त्वं करिष्यसि निरामयम्
verses.transliteration: yadā yadā hi lokasya duḥkhaṃ kiñcitprajāyate | tadā tadāvatīrṇastvaṃ kariṣyasi nirāmayam
verses.translation: After thinking like this, the intelligent brahmin,
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking like this, the intelligent brahmin,
verses.science: वर्णन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नाधिकस्त्वत्समोऽप्यस्ति हरे शिवपरायणः । त्वया वेदाश्च धर्माश्च शुभमार्गे प्रतिष्ठिताः
