verses.transliteration: nādhikastvatsamo'pyasti hare śivaparāyaṇaḥ | tvayā vedāśca dharmāśca śubhamārge pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: For a month he lived on a single meal *a day. For another month he took only the night-meal. He spent another month taking only the food he got without begging. He spent another month without any food. For another month he took only milk. For another month he took only fruits and vegetables. For another month he ate only a handful of gingelly seeds. For another month he took liquid diet. For another month he took only Pailcagavya. For another month he performed the Gandrayana rite. For an¬ other month he drank water from the tip of Kua grass and for another month he had air alone as his food.
verses.wordMeaning: For a month he lived on a single meal *a day. For another month he took only the night-meal. He spent another month taking only the food he got without begging. He spent another month without any food. For another month he took only milk.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For a month he lived on a single meal *a day. For another month he took only the night-meal. He spent another month taking only the food he got without begging. He spent another month without any food. For another month he took only milk.…
verses.science: मनुष्यके समान लीला करने लगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थमवतारोऽयं निहतः स हि दानवः । हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव प्रह्लादोऽपि सुरक्षितः
verses.transliteration: yadarthamavatāro'yaṃ nihataḥ sa hi dānavaḥ | hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva prahlādo'pi surakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus for a full year he performed the wonderful penance. He worshipped the excellent VireSa thrice a day.
verses.hindi: जिसके लिये आपका यह अवतार हुआ है, वह दानव हिरण्यकशिपु मार डाला गया और प्रह्मादकी भी रक्षा हो गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus for a full year he performed the wonderful penance. He worshipped the excellent VireSa thrice a day.

verses.sanskrit: अतीव घोरं भगवन्नरसिंहवपुस्तव । उपसंहर विश्वात्मंस्त्वमेव मम सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: atīva ghoraṃ bhagavannarasiṃhavapustava | upasaṃhara viśvātmaṃstvameva mama sannidhau
verses.translation: On the thirteenth month while he was going to Virea after taking bath in the Gahga river very early in the morning, the sage saw a child of eight years smeared with ashes all over the body, in the middle of the phallic image.
verses.hindi: उन्मत्त वेषमें शिवजीकी आज्ञासे द्वारपर आयीं
verses.commentary: Sense: On the thirteenth month while he was going to Virea after taking bath in the Gahga river very early in the morning, the sage saw a child of eight years smeared with ashes all over the body, in the middle of the phallic image.
verses.science: उन्मत्त वेषमें शिवजीकी आज्ञासे द्वारपर आयीं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः शान्तया गिरा । ततोऽधिकं महाघोरं कोपं चक्रे महामदः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ śāntayā girā | tato'dhikaṃ mahāghoraṃ kopaṃ cakre mahāmadaḥ
verses.translation: The child had eyes as long as his ears. He had ruddy lips. He had matted hair of beautiful tawny colour. He was naked and had a smiling face.
verses.commentary: Sense: The child had eyes as long as his ears. He had ruddy lips. He had matted hair of beautiful tawny colour. He was naked and had a smiling face.
verses.science: उन्हें बाहर जानेसे रोका। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च महाघोरं कठिनं वचनं तदा । वीरभद्रं महावीरं दंष्ट्राभिर्भीषयन्मुने
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca mahāghoraṃ kaṭhinaṃ vacanaṃ tadā | vīrabhadraṃ mahāvīraṃ daṃṣṭrābhirbhīṣayanmune
verses.translation: He had all the dress and features proper to child¬ hood. He seemed intelligent. He was reciting hymns from the Vedas. He was laughing sp>ortively.
verses.hindi: गयीं और उन अम्बिकाने उन्हें शाप दे दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: He had all the dress and features proper to child¬ hood. He seemed intelligent. He was reciting hymns from the Vedas. He was laughing sp>ortively.
verses.science: गयीं और उन अम्बिकाने उन्हें शाप दे दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंह उवाच । आगतोऽसि यतस्तत्र गच्छ त्वं मा हितं वद । इदानीं संहरिष्यामि जगदेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃha uvāca | āgato'si yatastatra gaccha tvaṃ mā hitaṃ vada | idānīṃ saṃhariṣyāmi jagadetaccarācaram
verses.translation: The contented Vaivanara eulogised iSiva, the great bliss in the form of child by means of eight verses that gave expression to his desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The contented Vaivanara eulogised iSiva, the great bliss in the form of child by means of eight verses that gave expression to his desire.
verses.science: तुम पृथ्वीपर मनुष्यरूप धारण करो। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संहर्तुर्न हि संहारः स्वतो वा परतोऽपि वा । शासिनं मम सर्वत्र शास्ता कोऽपि न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃharturna hi saṃhāraḥ svato vā parato'pi vā | śāsinaṃ mama sarvatra śāstā ko'pi na vidyate
verses.translation: O Siva, you alone are the creator and annihilator of every thing. In the different forms you are of single form and formless. Just as the inner virtue is only one though it may seem to be many. Hence I do not resort to any one except you.
verses.hindi: पार्वतीकी इस लीलासे भेरव अत्यन्त दुखी हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, you alone are the creator and annihilator of every thing. In the different forms you are of single form and formless. Just as the inner virtue is only one though it may seem to be many. Hence I do not resort to any one except you.
verses.science: पार्वतीकी इस लीलासे भेरव अत्यन्त दुखी हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादेन सकलमभयं हि प्रवर्तते । अहं हि सर्वशक्तीनां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: matprasādena sakalamabhayaṃ hi pravartate | ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ
verses.translation: The snake in the rope, the silver in the oyster shell, the water in the mirage —like that when he is known, the whole world vanishes and Sat alone remains. I resort to that great lod.
verses.commentary: Sense: The snake in the rope, the silver in the oyster shell, the water in the mirage —like that when he is known, the whole world vanishes and Sat alone remains. I resort to that great lod.
verses.science: बेताल नामसे उत्पन्न हुए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा । तत्तद्विद्धि गणाध्यक्ष मम तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā | tattadviddhi gaṇādhyakṣa mama tejovijṛmbhitam
verses.translation: You the earless perceive sound; you the noseless perceive fragrance; you the footless come from far; you the eyeless see; you the tongueless perceive the taste. Who knows you really? Hence I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: You the earless perceive sound; you the noseless perceive fragrance; you the footless come from far; you the eyeless see; you the tongueless perceive the taste. Who knows you really? Hence I seek refuge in you.
verses.science: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवताः परमार्थज्ञं मामेव परमं विदुः । मदंशाः शक्तिसम्पन्ना ब्रह्मशक्रादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: devatāḥ paramārthajñaṃ māmeva paramaṃ viduḥ | madaṃśāḥ śaktisampannā brahmaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: O lord, even the Vedas do not know you directly, nor Visnu, nor the Creator of every thing, nor the leading Yogins, nor Indra and other gods. Only a devotee knows. Hence I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: समस्त देवगण मुझे ही परमार्थको जाननेवाला तथा परमत्रह्म कहते हैं और ब्रह्मा एवं इन्द्रादि समस्त देवगण मेरे ही अंश तथा [मुझसे ही] शक्तिसम्पन्न हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, even the Vedas do not know you directly, nor Visnu, nor the Creator of every thing, nor the leading Yogins, nor Indra and other gods. Only a devotee knows. Hence I seek refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: मन्नाभिकमलाज्जातः पुरा ब्रह्मा जगत्करः । सर्वाधिकः स्वतन्त्रश्च कर्ता हर्ताखिलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: mannābhikamalājjātaḥ purā brahmā jagatkaraḥ | sarvādhikaḥ svatantraśca kartā hartākhileśvaraḥ
verses.translation: You have no spiritual lineage; you are unborn; you arc immortal, formless without any prescribed conduct or native land. Still you are the lord of three worlds and you fulfil all our desires. I worship you.
verses.hindi: जगत्कर्ता ब्रह्मा भी पूर्व समयमें मेरे नाभिकमलसे उत्पन्न हुए थे। मैं ही सबसे अधिक, स्वतन्त्र, कर्ता, हर्ता तथा अखिलेश्वर हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: You have no spiritual lineage; you are unborn; you arc immortal, formless without any prescribed conduct or native land. Still you are the lord of three worlds and you fulfil all our desires. I worship you.

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु मत्परं तेजः किं पुनः श्रोतुमिच्छसि । अतो मां शरणं प्राप्य गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ tu matparaṃ tejaḥ kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi | ato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: Everything originates from you. You are all-in-all, O enemy of Kama, you are the lord of Gauri; you are naked and quiescent; you are old, youthful and the child. Whatever is, you arc that. There is no source of your origin. I bow to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything originates from you. You are all-in-all, O enemy of Kama, you are the lord of Gauri; you are naked and quiescent; you are old, youthful and the child. Whatever is, you arc that. There is no source of your origin. I bow to you.
verses.science: वृषेश्वर नामक उत्तम अवतारको सुनें। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अवेहि परमं भावमिदम्भूतं गणेश्वर । मामकं सकलं विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: avehi paramaṃ bhāvamidambhūtaṃ gaṇeśvara | māmakaṃ sakalaṃ viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: After eulogising thus, when the brahmin fell on the ground with the joined hands, the boy became the aged of the aged and spoke delightedly to the brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising thus, when the brahmin fell on the ground with the joined hands, the boy became the aged of the aged and spoke delightedly to the brahmin.
verses.science: ग्रहण करनेका विचार किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालोऽस्म्यहं लोकविनाशहेतु- र्लोकान्समाहर्तुमहं प्रवृत्तः । मृत्योर्मृत्युं विद्धि मां वीरभद्र जीवन्त्येते मत्प्रसादेन देवाः
verses.transliteration: kālo'smyahaṃ lokavināśahetu- rlokānsamāhartumahaṃ pravṛttaḥ | mṛtyormṛtyuṃ viddhi māṃ vīrabhadra jīvantyete matprasādena devāḥ
verses.translation: O ViSvanara, O excellent sage, O brahmin, pro-
verses.hindi: किस उपायसे उस क्षीरसागरका मन्थन किया जाय
verses.commentary: Sense: O ViSvanara, O excellent sage, O brahmin, pro-
verses.science: किस उपायसे उस क्षीरसागरका मन्थन किया जाय। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । साहङ्कारं वचः श्रुत्वा हरेरमितविक्रमः । विहस्योवाच सावज्ञं ततो विस्फुरिताधरः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | sāhaṅkāraṃ vacaḥ śrutvā hareramitavikramaḥ | vihasyovāca sāvajñaṃ tato visphuritādharaḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted and contented sage Vivanara stood up and replied to iva who had assumed the form of a boy.
verses.hindi: असुरोंको आश्वस्त करती हुई कहने लगी--
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted and contented sage Vivanara stood up and replied to iva who had assumed the form of a boy.
verses.science: असुरोंको आश्वस्त करती हुई कहने लगी--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र उवाच । किन्न जानासि विश्वेशं संहर्तारं पिनाकिनम् । असद्वादो विवादश्च विनाशस्त्वयि केवलः
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadra uvāca | kinna jānāsi viśveśaṃ saṃhartāraṃ pinākinam | asadvādo vivādaśca vināśastvayi kevalaḥ
verses.translation: Why do you speak forcing me in the pity-provok¬ ing task of imploration? O lord Siva, after knowing this, please do as you wish.
verses.hindi: वीरभद्र बोले--क्या आप संसारके ईश्वर तथा संहारकर्ता पिनाकधारी शिवकों नहीं जानते हैं? आपमें केवल मिथ्या वाद-विवाद भरा पड़ा है, जो कि आपके विनाशका कारण है
verses.commentary: Sense: Why do you speak forcing me in the pity-provok¬ ing task of imploration? O lord Siva, after knowing this, please do as you wish.

verses.sanskrit: तवान्योन्यावताराणि कानि शेषाणि साम्प्रतम् । कृतानि येन केनैव कथाशेषो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tavānyonyāvatārāṇi kāni śeṣāṇi sāmpratam | kṛtāni yena kenaiva kathāśeṣo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On hearing the upright words of Viivanara of pure rites, the lord in the form of a child, spoke smilingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the upright words of Viivanara of pure rites, the lord in the form of a child, spoke smilingly.
verses.science: मिलकर आदरपूर्वक मन्थन कीजिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दोषं तं वद येन त्वमवस्थामीदृशीं गतः । तेन संहारदक्षेण दक्षिणाशेषमेष्यसि
verses.transliteration: doṣaṃ taṃ vada yena tvamavasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ | tena saṃhāradakṣeṇa dakṣiṇāśeṣameṣyasi
verses.translation: O pious one, the desire that you have cherished in your heart regarding lucismati will be certainly realised ere long.
verses.hindi: आप उस दोषको बताइये, जिससे आप इस दशाको प्राप्त हुए हैं। संसारके संहारमें प्रवीण होनेके कारण कहीं ऐसा न हो कि उसकी दक्षिणा आपको ही प्राप्त हो जाय
verses.commentary: Sense: O pious one, the desire that you have cherished in your heart regarding lucismati will be certainly realised ere long.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमान्रुद्रस्त्वयि वीर्यं समाहितम् । त्वन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: prakṛtistvaṃ pumānrudrastvayi vīryaṃ samāhitam | tvannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The hymn of eight verses of desire—Abhilasastaka —that you recited now, when recited thrice a day for a year in the vicinity of i§iva will yield all desires.
verses.hindi: तथा असुरोंने बलपूर्वक उसे उखाड़ लिया
verses.commentary: Sense: The hymn of eight verses of desire—Abhilasastaka —that you recited now, when recited thrice a day for a year in the vicinity of i§iva will yield all desires.
verses.science: तथा असुरोंने बलपूर्वक उसे उखाड़ लिया। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: जगत्त्रयीसर्जनार्थं शङ्करं नीललोहितम् । ललाटेऽचिन्तयत्सोऽयं तपस्युग्रे च संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: jagattrayīsarjanārthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam | lalāṭe'cintayatso'yaṃ tapasyugre ca saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The recitation of this hymn yields sons, grandsons and wealth. It is conducive to the mollification of everything and quells all mishaps.
verses.hindi: क्षीण बलवाले वे उसे ले जानेमें असमर्थ हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The recitation of this hymn yields sons, grandsons and wealth. It is conducive to the mollification of everything and quells all mishaps.
verses.science: क्षीण बलवाले वे उसे ले जानेमें असमर्थ हो गये। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: तल्ललाटादभूच्छम्भुः सृष्ट्यर्थे तेन भूषणम् । अतोऽहं देवदेवस्य तस्य भैरवरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: tallalāṭādabhūcchambhuḥ sṛṣṭyarthe tena bhūṣaṇam | ato'haṃ devadevasya tasya bhairavarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: If an issueless man gets up early in the morning, takes his bath, worships $iva*s phallic image, recites this hymn and continues the practice for a year, he will surely secure a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: If an issueless man gets up early in the morning, takes his bath, worships $iva*s phallic image, recites this hymn and continues the practice for a year, he will surely secure a son.
verses.science: जगदीश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्संहारे नियुक्तोऽस्मि विनयेन बलेन च । देवदेवेन रुद्रेण सकलप्रभुणा हरे
verses.transliteration: tvatsaṃhāre niyukto'smi vinayena balena ca | devadevena rudreṇa sakalaprabhuṇā hare
verses.translation: The Abhilasastaka hymn shall not be taught to common people. It shall be preserved carefully as a secret mantra. It makes the most barren lady deliver of a child.
verses.hindi: तटपर ले जाकर जलमें डाल दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: The Abhilasastaka hymn shall not be taught to common people. It shall be preserved carefully as a secret mantra. It makes the most barren lady deliver of a child.
verses.science: तटपर ले जाकर जलमें डाल दिया। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एकं रक्षो विदार्यैव तच्छक्तिकलया युतः । अहङ्कारावलेपेन गर्जसि त्वमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ rakṣo vidāryaiva tacchaktikalayā yutaḥ | ahaṅkārāvalepena garjasi tvamatandritaḥ
verses.translation: This hymn recited by a woman or a m.'in with
verses.commentary: Sense: This hymn recited by a woman or a m.'in with
verses.science: मन्थन करने लगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपकारो हि साधूनां सुखाय किल सम्मतः । उपकारो ह्यसाधूनामपकाराय केवलम्
verses.transliteration: upakāro hi sādhūnāṃ sukhāya kila sammataḥ | upakāro hyasādhūnāmapakārāya kevalam
verses.translation: With great delight the brahmin returned home and told his beloved wife all thos: details.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great delight the brahmin returned home and told his beloved wife all thos: details.
verses.science: हाथियोंके राजा ऐरावतको ग्रहण किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यन्नृसिंह महेशानं पुनर्भूतं तु मन्यसे । तर्ह्यज्ञानी महागर्वी विकारी सर्वथा भवान्
verses.transliteration: yannṛsiṃha maheśānaṃ punarbhūtaṃ tu manyase | tarhyajñānī mahāgarvī vikārī sarvathā bhavān
verses.translation: On hearing it, Sucimati, the wife of the brahmin, rejoiced much and being full of love she praised her good fortune.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, Sucimati, the wife of the brahmin, rejoiced much and being full of love she praised her good fortune.
verses.science: चन्द्रमाको मस्तकपर स्वेच्छासे धारण किया। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: न त्वं स्रष्टा न संहर्ता भर्तापि न नृसिंहक । परतन्त्रो विमूढात्मा न स्वतन्त्रो हि कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: na tvaṃ sraṣṭā na saṃhartā bhartāpi na nṛsiṃhaka | paratantro vimūḍhātmā na svatantro hi kutracit
verses.translation: She became pregnant in due course. The brahmin performed the rite of impregnation® duly.
verses.hindi: हे नूसिंह! आप न रष्टा हैं, न भर्ता हैं और न संहारकर्ता ही हैं, आप किसी भी प्रकार स्वतन्त्र नहीं हैं, आप परतन्त्र एवं विमूढ़ चित्तवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: She became pregnant in due course. The brahmin performed the rite of impregnation® duly.

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रवच्छक्त्या प्रेरितोऽसि पिनाकिना । नानावतारकर्ता त्वं तदधीनः सदा हरे
verses.transliteration: kulālacakravacchaktyā prerito'si pinākinā | nānāvatārakartā tvaṃ tadadhīnaḥ sadā hare
verses.translation: Before the stir and throb of the child in the womb was felt, the learned Brahmin performed the holy rite of Puihsavana* in the manner prescribed in the Grhyasutras for the growth of embryo's manliness.
verses.hindi: हे हरे! आप महादेवकी शक्तिसे ही कुलालचक्रकी भाँति प्रेरित हैं और सदा उन्हींके अधीन रहकर अनेक अवतार धारण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Before the stir and throb of the child in the womb was felt, the learned Brahmin performed the holy rite of Puihsavana* in the manner prescribed in the Grhyasutras for the growth of embryo's manliness.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि तव निक्षिप्तं कपालं कूर्मरूपिणः । हरहारलतामध्ये दग्धं कश्चिन्न बध्यते
verses.transliteration: adyāpi tava nikṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ kūrmarūpiṇaḥ | harahāralatāmadhye dagdhaṃ kaścinna badhyate
verses.translation: Then in the eighth month he performed the holy rite of Simanta® which is conducive to the growth of the embryo and which facilitates easy delivery of the child.
verses.hindi: [हे हरे!] कूर्मावतारके समय [बारम्बार मन्दराचलके द्वारा घर्षित होनेसे] झुलसे हुए कपालको किसीने धारण नहीं किया। तुम्हारेद्वारा त्यागा गया वह कपाल आज भी शिवजीकी हारलता (मुण्डमाला)- में विद्यमान है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the eighth month he performed the holy rite of Simanta® which is conducive to the growth of the embryo and which facilitates easy delivery of the child.

verses.sanskrit: विस्मृतिः किं तदंशेन दंष्ट्रोत्पातनपीडितम् । वाराहविघ्नहस्तेऽद्य याक्रोशन्तारकारिणा
verses.transliteration: vismṛtiḥ kiṃ tadaṃśena daṃṣṭrotpātanapīḍitam | vārāhavighnahaste'dya yākrośantārakāriṇā
verses.translation: The rivers became transparent as also the minds of living beings. The darkness of evil dwindled and the Rajas was stripped of its quality or of its dust.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers became transparent as also the minds of living beings. The darkness of evil dwindled and the Rajas was stripped of its quality or of its dust.
verses.science: देवासुर नामक भयानक संग्राम हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दग्धोऽसि पश्य शूलाग्नेर्विष्वक्सेनच्छलाद्भवान् । दक्षयज्ञे शिरश्छिन्नं मया तेजःस्वरूपिणा
verses.transliteration: dagdho'si paśya śūlāgnerviṣvaksenacchalādbhavān | dakṣayajñe śiraśchinnaṃ mayā tejaḥsvarūpiṇā
verses.translation: The living creatures were endowed with Sattva quality. There was a shower of nectar. People began to talk sweet and pleasant words.
verses.hindi: एवं पृथ्वीके विवरोंमें प्रवेश कर गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The living creatures were endowed with Sattva quality. There was a shower of nectar. People began to talk sweet and pleasant words.
verses.science: एवं पृथ्वीके विवरोंमें प्रवेश कर गये। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि तव पुत्रस्य ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः । छिन्नं न सज्जितं भूयो हरे तद्विस्मृतं त्वया
verses.transliteration: adyāpi tava putrasya brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ | chinnaṃ na sajjitaṃ bhūyo hare tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā
verses.translation: Rambha and other celestial damsels arrived with auspicious articles in their hands. Thousands of Vidyadharis, Kinnaris, Goddesses, the womenfolk of Gan- dharvas, serpents and Yaksas of sweet voice flocked singing auspicious songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rambha and other celestial damsels arrived with auspicious articles in their hands. Thousands of Vidyadharis, Kinnaris, Goddesses, the womenfolk of Gan- dharvas, serpents and Yaksas of sweet voice flocked singing auspicious songs.
verses.science: हैत्योंका पीछा किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्जितस्त्वं दधीचेन सङ्ग्रामे समरुद्गणः । कण्डूयमाने शिरसि कथं तद्विस्मृतं त्वया
verses.transliteration: nirjitastvaṃ dadhīcena saṅgrāme samarudgaṇaḥ | kaṇḍūyamāne śirasi kathaṃ tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā
verses.translation: The following sages came there—Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Angiras, Vasitha, KaiSyapa, Agastya, Vibhanda sou of Mantjavi, Lomasa, Romacaraa, Bharadvaja, Gautama, Bhrgu, Galava, Garga, Jatukarna, Paraara, Apastamba, Yajftavalkya, Daka, Valmtki, Mud- gala, Satatapa Likhita, Silada, Sahkha, Uficchabhuk, Jama- dagni, Sarhvarta, Matahga, Bharata, ArhSuman, Vyasa Katyayana, Kutsa, Saunaka, Susruta, Suka, Ryaifnga, Dur- vasas, Suci, Narada, Tumburu, Uttaiika, Vamadeva, Pavana, Asita, Devala, Salankayana, Harita, Visvamitra, Bhargava, Mfkundu with his son, Parvata, Daruka, Dhaumya, Upa* manyu Vatsa and others came to the happy hermitage of Vi.svanara for the auspicious Santi ceremony. The daugh¬ ters of the sages too came there.
verses.wordMeaning: The following sages came there—Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Angiras, Vasitha, KaiSyapa, Agastya, Vibhanda sou of Mantjavi, Lomasa, Romacaraa, Bharadvaja, Gautama, Bhrgu, Galava, Garga, Jatukarna, Paraara, Apastamba, Yajftavalkya, Daka, Valmtki, Mud- gala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following sages came there—Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Angiras, Vasitha, KaiSyapa, Agastya, Vibhanda sou of Mantjavi, Lomasa, Romacaraa, Bharadvaja, Gautama, Bhrgu, Galava, Garga, Jatukarna, Paraara, Apastamba, Yajftavalkya, Daka, Valmtki, Mud- gala,…
verses.science: उन्होंने वहाँ शान्ति प्राप्त की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं विक्रमतो यस्य चक्रपाणे तव प्रियम् । कुतः प्राप्तं कृतं केन त्वया तदपि विस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: cakraṃ vikramato yasya cakrapāṇe tava priyam | kutaḥ prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ kena tvayā tadapi vismṛtam
verses.translation: Brahma came there with Bfhaspati. Lord Viriu came riding on Ganida as vehicle. The bull-bannered lord came there with Gauri, Nandin, Bhrngi and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma came there with Bfhaspati. Lord Viriu came riding on Ganida as vehicle. The bull-bannered lord came there with Gauri, Nandin, Bhrngi and others.
verses.science: उपद्रव करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये मया सकला लोका गृहीतास्त्वं पयोनिधौ । निद्रापरवशः शेषे स कथं सात्त्विको भवान्
verses.transliteration: ye mayā sakalā lokā gṛhītāstvaṃ payonidhau | nidrāparavaśaḥ śeṣe sa kathaṃ sāttviko bhavān
verses.translation: Mahendra and other gods the Nagas residing in the nether regions came there. Taking gems with them many great oceans and rivers came there.
verses.hindi: मैंने तो सम्पूर्ण लोकोंको धारण कर रखा है और तुम क्षीरसागरमें निद्राके परवश होकर सोते रहते हो, ऐसी स्थितिमें तुम सात्त्विक कैसे हो ?2
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahendra and other gods the Nagas residing in the nether regions came there. Taking gems with them many great oceans and rivers came there.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं रुद्रशक्तिविजृम्भितम् । शक्तिमानभितस्त्वं च ह्यनलात्त्वं विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: tvadādistambaparyantaṃ rudraśaktivijṛmbhitam | śaktimānabhitastvaṃ ca hyanalāttvaṃ vimohitaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of immobile beings came there in the forms of the mobile beings. During the great festivities then there was an untimely flood of moonlight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of immobile beings came there in the forms of the mobile beings. During the great festivities then there was an untimely flood of moonlight.
verses.science: उनकी स्तुति की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्तेजसो हि माहात्म्यं पुमान्द्रष्टुं न हि क्षमः । अस्थूला ये प्रपश्यन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tattejaso hi māhātmyaṃ pumāndraṣṭuṃ na hi kṣamaḥ | asthūlā ye prapaśyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Brahma himself performed the postnatal rite* after bowing to the infant. In consonance with his form and beauty he gave him the nae** of Grhapati on the eleventh day in accordance with injunctions, repeating the Vedic mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma himself performed the postnatal rite* after bowing to the infant. In consonance with his form and beauty he gave him the nae** of Grhapati on the eleventh day in accordance with injunctions, repeating the Vedic mantras.
verses.science: सन्त्रस्त सम्पूर्ण लोकोंकी रक्षा कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्यावापृथिव्या इन्द्राग्नेर्यमस्य वरुणस्य च । ध्वान्तोदरे शशाङ्के च जनित्वा परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dyāvāpṛthivyā indrāgneryamasya varuṇasya ca | dhvāntodare śaśāṅke ca janitvā parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After conlerring blessings on everyone by reciting the mantras from the four Vedas, Brahma left the place while riding on the swan.
verses.hindi: स्थित हैं और उनके साथ स्थित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: After conlerring blessings on everyone by reciting the mantras from the four Vedas, Brahma left the place while riding on the swan.
verses.science: स्थित हैं और उनके साथ स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालोऽसि त्वं महाकालः कालकालो महेश्वरः । अतस्त्वमुग्रकलया मृत्योर्मृत्युर्भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: kālo'si tvaṃ mahākālaḥ kālakālo maheśvaraḥ | atastvamugrakalayā mṛtyormṛtyurbhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: After affording proper safeguards for the child in accordance with worldly conventions Siva returned to his abode on his vehicle along with Visnu.
verses.hindi: देवताओं तथा ब्रह्माने शिवजीकी बहुत स्तुति की
verses.commentary: Sense: After affording proper safeguards for the child in accordance with worldly conventions Siva returned to his abode on his vehicle along with Visnu.
verses.science: देवताओं तथा ब्रह्माने शिवजीकी बहुत स्तुति की। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरोऽद्य त्वक्षरो वीरो वीरो विश्वावकः प्रभुः । उपहन्ता ज्वरं भीमो मृगः पक्षी हिरण्मयः
verses.transliteration: sthiro'dya tvakṣaro vīro vīro viśvāvakaḥ prabhuḥ | upahantā jvaraṃ bhīmo mṛgaḥ pakṣī hiraṇmayaḥ
verses.translation: The eternal Veda says—' A person conquers the worlds through a son '. Hence all householders wish for a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal Veda says—' A person conquers the worlds through a son '. Hence all householders wish for a son.
verses.science: नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शास्ता शेषस्य जगतस्तत्त्वं नैव चतुर्मुखः । नान्ये च केवलं शम्भुः सर्वशास्ता न संशयः
verses.transliteration: śāstā śeṣasya jagatastattvaṃ naiva caturmukhaḥ | nānye ca kevalaṃ śambhuḥ sarvaśāstā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In the fourth month the rite of "crossing the
verses.hindi: प्रविष्टो बिवरं तत्र रवान्॥ १  उस पातालके विवरमें प्रवेश किया
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fourth month the rite of "crossing the
verses.science: प्रविष्टो बिवरं तत्र रवान्॥ १ उस पातालके विवरमें प्रवेश किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं सर्वं समालोक्य संहारात्मानमात्मना । न विनष्टं त्वमात्मानं कुरु हे नृहरेऽबुध
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya saṃhārātmānamātmanā | na vinaṣṭaṃ tvamātmānaṃ kuru he nṛhare'budha
verses.translation: The knower rites performed the Karnavedha rite*® under the constellation of Srav<ina. In order to enhance his brahminical splendour he made him perform an auspicious Vrata*® in his fifth year.
verses.hindi: प्रकम्पो हि बभूवाथ सर्वेषां पुरवासिनाम्॥ २  एज सभी नगरवासियोंको कैँंपकँपी होने लगी
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower rites performed the Karnavedha rite*® under the constellation of Srav<ina. In order to enhance his brahminical splendour he made him perform an auspicious Vrata*® in his fifth year.
verses.science: प्रकम्पो हि बभूवाथ सर्वेषां पुरवासिनाम्॥ २ एज सभी नगरवासियोंको कैँंपकँपी होने लगी। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नो चेदिदानीं क्रोधस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः । वज्राशनिरिव स्थाणौ त्वयि मृत्युः पतिष्यति
verses.transliteration: no cedidānīṃ krodhasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ | vajrāśaniriva sthāṇau tvayi mṛtyuḥ patiṣyati
verses.translation: After celebrating theUpakarma rite,®® the intelligent sage taught him the Vedas. The boy learned the Vedas for a year with their ancillaries. He learnt the Padapaha and Kramapatha of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After celebrating theUpakarma rite,®® the intelligent sage taught him the Vedas. The boy learned the Vedas for a year with their ancillaries. He learnt the Padapaha and Kramapatha of the Vedas.
verses.science: श्रृंगोंसे उन्हें विदीर्ण करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा वीरभद्रोऽपि विररामाकुतोभयः । दृष्ट्वा नृसिंहाभिप्रायं क्रोधमूर्त्तिश्शिवस्य सः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā vīrabhadro'pi virarāmākutobhayaḥ | dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhābhiprāyaṃ krodhamūrttiśśivasya saḥ
verses.translation: Evincing his humility and other qualities, the competent youth grasped the lore almost by himself but for¬ mally through the preceptor just as a medium.
verses.hindi: गर्जना करके शिवजीके निकट जा पहुँचे
verses.commentary: Sense: Evincing his humility and other qualities, the competent youth grasped the lore almost by himself but for¬ mally through the preceptor just as a medium.
verses.science: गर्जना करके शिवजीके निकट जा पहुँचे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The rite of feeding the child for the first time is performed in the sixth, eighth, ninth, tenth or even at the expiry of a year. But the right occasion is when the child's teeth come out
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of feeding the child for the first time is performed in the sixth, eighth, ninth, tenth or even at the expiry of a year. But the right occasion is when the child's teeth come out
verses.science: इस कृत्यसे विरत हो जाइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The rite of feeding the child for the first time is performed in the sixth, eighth, ninth, tenth or even at the expiry of a year. But the right occasion is when the child's teeth come out
verses.hindi: आपका स्मरण तो विश्वका तारण करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of feeding the child for the first time is performed in the sixth, eighth, ninth, tenth or even at the expiry of a year. But the right occasion is when the child's teeth come out
verses.science: आपका स्मरण तो विश्वका तारण करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । शरभावतारवर्णनम् २ । सनत्कुमार उवाच । नन्दीश्वर महाप्राज्ञ विज्ञातं तदनन्तरम् । ममोपरि कृपां कृत्वा प्रीत्या त्वं तद्वदाधुना
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.12. dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śarabhāvatāravarṇanam 2 | sanatkumāra uvāca | nandīśvara mahāprājña vijñātaṃ tadanantaram | mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā prītyā tvaṃ tadvadādhunā
verses.translation: The rite of shaving, cutting the hair and nails is peifoimed to remove the impurities and impart g'od health. This is done at the end of first year or before the expiry of the third >ear.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of shaving, cutting the hair and nails is peifoimed to remove the impurities and impart g'od health. This is done at the end of first year or before the expiry of the third >ear.
verses.science: यह वचन कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः क्रोधविह्वलः । निनदन्ननुवेगेन तं ग्रहीतुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ | ninadannanuvegena taṃ grahītuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: On seeing his parents excessively grieved, <hc boy Gfhapati, a part of Siva, smiled and said.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले---वीरभद्गके इस प्रकारके कहनेपर नृसिंह क्रोधसे व्याकुल हो गये और गर्जन करते हुए बड़े वेगसे उन्हें पकड़नेके लिये उद्यत हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his parents excessively grieved, <hc boy Gfhapati, a part of Siva, smiled and said.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रान्तरे महाघोरं प्रत्यक्षभयकारणम् । गगनव्यापि दुर्धर्षं शैवतेजः समुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: atrāntare mahāghoraṃ pratyakṣabhayakāraṇam | gaganavyāpi durdharṣaṃ śaivatejaḥ samudbhavam
verses.translation: O son, seek refuge in that Siva, the amulet of protection of the universe, the sole creator of Indra, Acyuta, Brahma and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, seek refuge in that Siva, the amulet of protection of the universe, the sole creator of Indra, Acyuta, Brahma and others.
verses.science: अस्त्रोंका निर्माण कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रस्य तद्रूमदृश्यं तु ततः क्षणात् । तद्वै हिरण्मयं सौम्यं न सौरं नाग्निसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadrasya tadrūmadṛśyaṃ tu tataḥ kṣaṇāt | tadvai hiraṇmayaṃ saumyaṃ na sauraṃ nāgnisambhavam
verses.translation: "O Indra, O enemy of Vrtra, I know you as armed with the thunderbolt. I do not want a boon from you. Siva is the grantor of boon to me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Indra, O enemy of Vrtra, I know you as armed with the thunderbolt. I do not want a boon from you. Siva is the grantor of boon to me."
verses.science: रुद्रस्वरूपका ध्यान करती रहूँगी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न तडिच्चन्द्रसदृशमनौपम्यं महेश्वरम् । तदा तेजांसि सर्वाणि तस्मिंल्लीनानि शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: na taḍiccandrasadṛśamanaupamyaṃ maheśvaram | tadā tejāṃsi sarvāṇi tasmiṃllīnāni śaṅkare
verses.translation: Neither Indra, nor the thunderbolt, nor even the god of death is powerful to molest my devotee. You have been terrified by me alone in the form of Indra.
verses.hindi: महान् लीला की; है सन्मुने! उसे आप सुनें
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Indra, nor the thunderbolt, nor even the god of death is powerful to molest my devotee. You have been terrified by me alone in the form of Indra.
verses.science: महान् लीला की; है सन्मुने! उसे आप सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न तद्व्योमं महत्तेजो व्यक्तान्तश्चाभवत्ततः । रुद्रसाधारणं चैव चिह्नितं विकृताकृति
verses.transliteration: na tadvyomaṃ mahattejo vyaktāntaścābhavattataḥ | rudrasādhāraṇaṃ caiva cihnitaṃ vikṛtākṛti
verses.translation: O gentle one, I shall grant you the boon. I confer the title of Agni on you. I authorise you to grant boons to whatever deity you think fit.
verses.hindi: हुई पद्मा नामक अति मनोहर युवतीको देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle one, I shall grant you the boon. I confer the title of Agni on you. I authorise you to grant boons to whatever deity you think fit.
verses.science: हुई पद्मा नामक अति मनोहर युवतीको देखा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्संहाररूपेण सुव्यक्तं परमेश्वरः । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: tatassaṃhārarūpeṇa suvyaktaṃ parameśvaraḥ | paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: O Agni, you will be moving in the midst of all mortals. Acquire kingship as the guardian of the quarter in the south-east.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, you will be moving in the midst of all mortals. Acquire kingship as the guardian of the quarter in the south-east.
verses.science: राजा अनरण्यके पास गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रबाहुर्जटिलश्चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखरः । समृद्धोग्रशरीरेण पक्षाभ्यां चञ्चुना द्विजः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabāhurjaṭilaścandrārddhakṛtaśekharaḥ | samṛddhograśarīreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ cañcunā dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The phallic image installed by you will be known by your name. It will be known as Agnisvara and it will be conducive to the enhancement of all splendour.
verses.hindi: मधुपर्क आदि प्रदानकर भक्तिपूर्वक उनकी पूजा की
verses.commentary: Sense: The phallic image installed by you will be known by your name. It will be known as Agnisvara and it will be conducive to the enhancement of all splendour.
verses.science: मधुपर्क आदि प्रदानकर भक्तिपूर्वक उनकी पूजा की। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतितीक्ष्णो महादंष्ट्रो वज्रतुल्यनखायुधः । कण्ठे कालो महाबाहुश्चतुष्पाद्वह्निसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: atitīkṣṇo mahādaṃṣṭro vajratulyanakhāyudhaḥ | kaṇṭhe kālo mahābāhuścatuṣpādvahnisannibhaḥ
verses.translation: The devotees of Agnisvara need not fear lightning and fire. They will never suffer from impaired digestion or premature death.
verses.hindi: राजा मौन हो गये और कुछ बोल न सके
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotees of Agnisvara need not fear lightning and fire. They will never suffer from impaired digestion or premature death.
verses.science: राजा मौन हो गये और कुछ बोल न सके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: युगान्तोद्यतजीमूतभीमगम्भीरनिःस्वनः । महाकुपितकृत्याग्निव्यावृत्तनयनत्रयः
verses.transliteration: yugāntodyatajīmūtabhīmagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ | mahākupitakṛtyāgnivyāvṛttanayanatrayaḥ
verses.translation: The ceremony of boring the cars of the child is performed as precaution against hydrocele and hernia. Cp Susruia, CikitsA 19. ai.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला मैं  अब अपने लोकको जाऊँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: The ceremony of boring the cars of the child is performed as precaution against hydrocele and hernia. Cp Susruia, CikitsA 19. ai.
verses.science: करनेवाला मैं अब अपने लोकको जाऊँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्पष्टदंष्ट्राधरोष्ठश्च हुङ्कारैः संयुतो हरः । ईदृग्विधस्वरूपश्च ह्युग्र आविर्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: spaṣṭadaṃṣṭrādharoṣṭhaśca huṅkāraiḥ saṃyuto haraḥ | īdṛgvidhasvarūpaśca hyugra āvirbabhūva ha
verses.translation: Examining closely the palate, tongue etc. (of the boy) the intelligent Narada spoke to Visvanara, urged by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Examining closely the palate, tongue etc. (of the boy) the intelligent Narada spoke to Visvanara, urged by Siva.
verses.science: चक्रको यहीं रहने दीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिस्तद्दर्शनादेव विनष्टबलविक्रमः । बिभ्रद्धामसहस्रांशोरधः खद्योतविभ्रमम्
verses.transliteration: haristaddarśanādeva vinaṣṭabalavikramaḥ | bibhraddhāmasahasrāṃśoradhaḥ khadyotavibhramam
verses.translation: "O sage Visvanara, listen. I shall mention the detailed characteristic marks of your son. Your son Jbears good marks on every limb. He possesses all good signs.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sage Visvanara, listen. I shall mention the detailed characteristic marks of your son. Your son Jbears good marks on every limb. He possesses all good signs.
verses.science: अत्यन्त भयंकर है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ विभ्रम्य पक्षाभ्यां नाभिपादान्विदारयन् । पादान्बबन्ध पुच्छेन बाहुभ्यां बाहुमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: atha vibhramya pakṣābhyāṃ nābhipādānvidārayan | pādānbabandha pucchena bāhubhyāṃ bāhumaṇḍalam
verses.translation: But fate alone must guard this boy duly, this boy who has all good qualities, who is characterised by all good features and who is possessed of all pure digits in their entirety.
verses.commentary: Sense: But fate alone must guard this boy duly, this boy who has all good qualities, who is characterised by all good features and who is possessed of all pure digits in their entirety.
verses.science: विष्णुको प्रदान किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिन्दन्नुरसि बाहुभ्यां निजग्राह हरो हरिम् । ततो जगाम गगनं देवैस्सह महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: bhindannurasi bāhubhyāṃ nijagrāha haro harim | tato jagāma gaganaṃ devaissaha maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: This child should be protected with all effort?. When the fate is adverse, even good qualities assume the state of defects.
verses.commentary: Sense: This child should be protected with all effort?. When the fate is adverse, even good qualities assume the state of defects.
verses.science: आपलोगोंका कल्याण होगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहसैवाभयाद्विष्णुं स हि श्येन इवोरगम् । उत्क्षिप्योत्क्षिप्य सङ्गृह्य निपात्य च निपात्य च
verses.transliteration: sahasaivābhayādviṣṇuṃ sa hi śyena ivoragam | utkṣipyotkṣipya saṅgṛhya nipātya ca nipātya ca
verses.translation: In the twelfth month from now 1 suspect a great danger to him from lightning and fire." After saying this Narada returned to heaven the way he had come.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twelfth month from now 1 suspect a great danger to him from lightning and fire." After saying this Narada returned to heaven the way he had come.
verses.science: स्वेच्छासे आप लोग करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उड्डीयोड्डीय भगवान्पक्षघातविमोहितम् । हरीं हरस्तं वृषभं विवेशानन्त ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: uḍḍīyoḍḍīya bhagavānpakṣaghātavimohitam | harīṃ harastaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ viveśānanta īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the revelation of Narada, Visvanara and his wife considered it a terrible bolt from the blue.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the revelation of Narada, Visvanara and his wife considered it a terrible bolt from the blue.
verses.science: देवतागण अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुयान्तं सुराः सर्वे नमोवाक्येन तुष्टुवुः । प्रणेमुः सादरं प्रीत्या ब्रह्माद्याश्च मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: anuyāntaṃ surāḥ sarve namovākyena tuṣṭuvuḥ | praṇemuḥ sādaraṃ prītyā brahmādyāśca munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: He shouted "O I am doomed!" He beat his chest. Excited by the grief about his son he fell into a great swoon.
verses.hindi: गये तथा संसार सुखी हो गया
verses.commentary: Sense: He shouted "O I am doomed!" He beat his chest. Excited by the grief about his son he fell into a great swoon.
verses.science: गये तथा संसार सुखी हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नीयमानः परवशो दीनवक्त्रः कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टाव परमेशानं हरिस्तं ललिताक्षरैः
verses.transliteration: nīyamānaḥ paravaśo dīnavaktraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ haristaṃ lalitākṣaraiḥ
verses.translation: The grief-stricken Suci§mati too lamented much. Her senses were benumbed and she. lamented aloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grief-stricken Suci§mati too lamented much. Her senses were benumbed and she. lamented aloud.
verses.science: शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नाम्नामष्टशतेनैव स्तुत्वा तं मृडमेव च । पुनश्च प्रार्थयामास नृसिंहः शरभेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nāmnāmaṣṭaśatenaiva stutvā taṃ mṛḍameva ca | punaśca prārthayāmāsa nṛsiṃhaḥ śarabheśvaram
verses.translation: On hearing her loud lamentation, Visvanara woke up from his swoon. He cried aloud "What is this? What is this? Where is Gfhapati my vital breath who stands
verses.hindi: शिवावतारवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her loud lamentation, Visvanara woke up from his swoon. He cried aloud "What is this? What is this? Where is Gfhapati my vital breath who stands
verses.science: शिवावतारवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा ममाज्ञेयं मतिः स्याद्गर्वदूषिता । तदा तदाऽपनेतव्या त्वयैव परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: yadā yadā mamājñeyaṃ matiḥ syādgarvadūṣitā | tadā tadā'panetavyā tvayaiva parameśvara
verses.translation: Time and pitiable fickle existence cannot affect me, whose body is guarded by the dust-particles of your feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Time and pitiable fickle existence cannot affect me, whose body is guarded by the dust-particles of your feet.
verses.science: पहले ब्रह्माजीसे सुना था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवं विज्ञापयन्प्रीत्या शङ्करं नरकेसरी । नत्वाशक्तोऽभवद्विष्णुर्जीवितान्तपराजितः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evaṃ vijñāpayanprītyā śaṅkaraṃ narakesarī | natvāśakto'bhavadviṣṇurjīvitāntaparājitaḥ
verses.translation: O my parents, please listen to my vow. If I am your true son, I will do that whereby death itself will be terrified.
verses.commentary: Sense: O my parents, please listen to my vow. If I am your true son, I will do that whereby death itself will be terrified.
verses.science: निवासभूत पिप्पलादचरित्रको सुनना चाहता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वक्त्रं शेषगात्रान्तं कृत्वा सर्वस्वविग्रहम् । शक्तियुक्तं तदीयाङ्गं वीरभद्रः क्षणात्ततः
verses.transliteration: tadvaktraṃ śeṣagātrāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvasvavigraham | śaktiyuktaṃ tadīyāṅgaṃ vīrabhadraḥ kṣaṇāttataḥ
verses.translation: I shall propitiate lord Siva, the conqueror of death, the omniscient and the bestower of all to the good. I shall perform the Japa of Mahakala. O parents, I am telling you the truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall propitiate lord Siva, the conqueror of death, the omniscient and the bestower of all to the good. I shall perform the Japa of Mahakala. O parents, I am telling you the truth.
verses.science: शिलादपुत्र प्रसन्‍नचित्त होकर कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवाः शारभं रूपमास्थितम् । तुष्टुवुः शङ्करं देवं सर्वलोकैकशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | atha brahmādayo devāḥ śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitam | tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ sarvalokaikaśaṅkaram
verses.translation: On hearing his words the aged branmin couple were freed of their distress by the untimely showers of nectar. They then spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words the aged branmin couple were freed of their distress by the untimely showers of nectar. They then spoke.
verses.science: पराजित कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ देवा ऊचुः । ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रचन्द्रादिसुराः सर्वे महर्षयः । दितिजाद्याः सम्प्रसूताः त्वत्तः सर्वे महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: || devā ūcuḥ | brahmaviṣṇvindracandrādisurāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ | ditijādyāḥ samprasūtāḥ tvattaḥ sarve maheśvara
verses.translation: A great means has oeen suggested by you to dis¬ pel our distress, that of the propitiation of lord Siva, the conqueror of death.
verses.hindi: देवता बोले--हे महेश्वर! ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-इन्द्र- चन्द्रमा आदि समस्त देवता, महर्षि एवं दैत्य आदि- सबके सब आपसे ही उत्पन्न हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: A great means has oeen suggested by you to dis¬ pel our distress, that of the propitiation of lord Siva, the conqueror of death.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेन्द्रांश्च सूर्याद्यानसुरान्सुरान् । त्वं वै सृजसि पास्यत्सि त्वमेव सकलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇumahendrāṃśca sūryādyānasurānsurān | tvaṃ vai sṛjasi pāsyatsi tvameva sakaleśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O dear, haven't you heard that the slayer of the Tripuras protected, in days of yore, Svetaketu who was bound by the noose of Kala?
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, haven't you heard that the slayer of the Tripuras protected, in days of yore, Svetaketu who was bound by the noose of Kala?
verses.science: महान् तेजस्वी है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतो हरसि संसारं हर इत्युच्यते बुधैः । निगृहीतो हरिर्यस्माद्धर इत्युच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: yato harasi saṃsāraṃ hara ityucyate budhaiḥ | nigṛhīto hariryasmāddhara ityucyate budhaiḥ
verses.translation: He protected the three worlds by drinking ofT the
verses.commentary: Sense: He protected the three worlds by drinking ofT the
verses.science: करके मुनीश्वरसे यह वाक्य कहा--। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यतो बिभर्षि सकलं विभज्य तनुमष्टधा । अतोऽस्मान्पाहि भगवन् सुरान् दानैरभीप्सितैः
verses.transliteration: yato bibharṣi sakalaṃ vibhajya tanumaṣṭadhā | ato'smānpāhi bhagavan surān dānairabhīpsitaiḥ
verses.translation: With the wheel raised up by the line drawn with his beautiful toe he killed the haughty Jalandhara who had deprived the three worlds of their pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the wheel raised up by the line drawn with his beautiful toe he killed the haughty Jalandhara who had deprived the three worlds of their pleasure.
verses.science: आपकी शरणमें आये हुए हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं महापुरुषः शम्भुः सर्वेशः सुरनायकः । निःस्वात्मा निर्विकारात्मा परब्रह्म सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ mahāpuruṣaḥ śambhuḥ sarveśaḥ suranāyakaḥ | niḥsvātmā nirvikārātmā parabrahma satāṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: He burnt the Tripuras, who were haughty and
verses.hindi: ध्यान करके अपना शरीर छोड़ दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: He burnt the Tripuras, who were haughty and
verses.science: ध्यान करके अपना शरीर छोड़ दिया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दीनबन्धुर्दयासिन्धुरद्भुतोतिः परात्मदृक् । प्राज्ञो विराट् विभुः सत्यः सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: dīnabandhurdayāsindhuradbhutotiḥ parātmadṛk | prājño virāṭ vibhuḥ satyaḥ saccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Even as Brahma and others were watching, he
verses.hindi: होने लगी और सभी लोग आश्चर्यचकित हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as Brahma and others were watching, he
verses.science: होने लगी और सभी लोग आश्चर्यचकित हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचः शम्भुर्देवानां परमेश्वरः । उवाच तान् सुरान्देवामहर्षींश्च पुरातनान्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya vacaḥ śambhurdevānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | uvāca tān surāndevāmaharṣīṃśca purātanān
verses.translation: Thus he secured the permission of his parents. He bowed at their feet and circumambulated them. He then pacified them and started.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he secured the permission of his parents. He bowed at their feet and circumambulated them. He then pacified them and started.
verses.science: समान वृत्रासुरका सिर काट दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा जलं जले क्षिप्तं क्षीरे क्षीरं घृते घृतम् । एक एव तदा विष्णुः शिवे लीनो न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: yathā jalaṃ jale kṣiptaṃ kṣīre kṣīraṃ ghṛte ghṛtam | eka eva tadā viṣṇuḥ śive līno na cānyathā
verses.translation: He reached Kali inaccessible even to Brahma, Visnu and others. He reached Kail that dispels all recur¬ ring distress, that is protected by Vilvcia, that shines with the celestial river Gaiiga as with a necklace round its neck, that shines splendidly by the presence of Parvati, the consorl of Siva and of wonderful qualities. After reaching Kali he went to Manikarika at the outset. After taking bath in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras he saw Lord Vilvelvara** with palms joined and head bent in reverence. The intelligent brahmin was greatly delighted. He bowed to lord Siva who instils life into and protects the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: He reached Kali inaccessible even to Brahma, Visnu and others. He reached Kail that dispels all recur¬ ring distress, that is protected by Vilvcia, that shines with the celestial river Gaiiga as with a necklace round its neck, that shines splendidly by the presence of Parvati,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He reached Kali inaccessible even to Brahma, Visnu and others. He reached Kail that dispels all recur¬ ring distress, that is protected by Vilvcia, that shines with the celestial river Gaiiga as with a necklace round its neck, that shines splendidly by the presence of Parvati,…
verses.science: ऊपर फूलोंकी वर्षा होने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एको विष्णुर्नृसिंहात्मा सदर्पश्च महाबलः । जगत्संहारकरणे प्रवृत्तो नरकेसरी
verses.transliteration: eko viṣṇurnṛsiṃhātmā sadarpaśca mahābalaḥ | jagatsaṃhārakaraṇe pravṛtto narakesarī
verses.translation: Seeing that phallic image of Siva again and again he was delighted in his heart and thought—'Undoubtedly this is possessed of great bliss."
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that phallic image of Siva again and again he was delighted in his heart and thought—'Undoubtedly this is possessed of great bliss."
verses.science: अवतारको आदरपूर्वक सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थनीयो नमस्तस्मै मद्भक्तैः सिद्धिकारिभिः । मद्भक्तप्रवरश्चैव मद्भक्तवरदायकः
verses.transliteration: prārthanīyo namastasmai madbhaktaiḥ siddhikāribhiḥ | madbhaktapravaraścaiva madbhaktavaradāyakaḥ
verses.translation: By the nectarine juice of bliss he concluded the sacred rite. Then on an auspicious day he installed the phallic image, the bestower of all benefits. He adopted austere rites difficult to be performed by those who have no control over themselves. He filled pots with the water of the Ganga strained and purified by means of a cloth. Every day he bathed the phallic image with hundred and eight potfulls of water. Then he put a garland of blue lotus round the deity.
verses.wordMeaning: By the nectarine juice of bliss he concluded the sacred rite. Then on an auspicious day he installed the phallic image, the bestower of all benefits. He adopted austere rites difficult to be performed by those who have no control over themselves.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By the nectarine juice of bliss he concluded the sacred rite. Then on an auspicious day he installed the phallic image, the bestower of all benefits. He adopted austere rites difficult to be performed by those who have no control over themselves.…
verses.science: जायँ--ऐसा उन्होंने कहा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् पक्षिराजो महाबलः । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | etāvaduktvā bhagavān pakṣirājo mahābalaḥ | paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: He wreathed the garlands with a thousand and eight flowers. He ate fruits, roots and bulbous roots once in a fortnight or a month.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रसहित उन सभी देवताओंको शाप दे दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: He wreathed the garlands with a thousand and eight flowers. He ate fruits, roots and bulbous roots once in a fortnight or a month.
verses.science: इन्द्रसहित उन सभी देवताओंको शाप दे दिया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रोऽपि भगवान्गणाध्यक्षो महाबलः । नृसिंहकृत्तिं निष्कृष्य समादाय ययौ गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadro'pi bhagavāngaṇādhyakṣo mahābalaḥ | nṛsiṃhakṛttiṃ niṣkṛṣya samādāya yayau girim
verses.translation: The courageous devotee spent six months by eat¬ ing withered leaves. The remaining six months he spent drinking drops of water or simply breathing.
verses.commentary: Sense: The courageous devotee spent six months by eat¬ ing withered leaves. The remaining six months he spent drinking drops of water or simply breathing.
verses.science: काष्ठोंकी चिता बनायी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहकृत्तिवसनस्तदाप्रभृति शङ्करः । तद्वक्त्रं मुण्डमालायां नायकत्वेन कल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃhakṛttivasanastadāprabhṛti śaṅkaraḥ | tadvaktraṃ muṇḍamālāyāṃ nāyakatvena kalpitam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, thus a year in the life of that noble soul passed by, performing the penance with the devoted mind resting only in Siva.
verses.hindi: मुनिकी पत्नी क्षणभरके लिये विस्मित हो गयीं
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmins, thus a year in the life of that noble soul passed by, performing the penance with the devoted mind resting only in Siva.
verses.science: मुनिकी पत्नी क्षणभरके लिये विस्मित हो गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवा निरातङ्काः कीर्तयन्तः कथामिमाम् । विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: tato devā nirātaṅkāḥ kīrtayantaḥ kathāmimām | vismayotphullanayanā jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam
verses.translation: In the twelfth year of his life, the thunderbolt- armed Indra approached him as if fulfilling the utterance of Narada.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twelfth year of his life, the thunderbolt- armed Indra approached him as if fulfilling the utterance of Narada.
verses.science: साक्षात् रुद्रका अवतार था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं परमाख्यानं पुण्यं वेदरसान्वितम् । पठति शृणुयाच्चैव सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ puṇyaṃ vedarasānvitam | paṭhati śṛṇuyāccaiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He said—brahmin, I am Indra, I am delighted at your holy rites. Ask for the boon you wish to have. I shall give you whatever desire you have in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said—brahmin, I am Indra, I am delighted at your holy rites. Ask for the boon you wish to have. I shall give you whatever desire you have in your mind.
verses.science: अपने हृदयमें स्थापित कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यमारोग्यम्पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् । सर्वविघ्नप्रशमनं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamārogyampuṣṭivarddhanam | sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of lord Indra, the son of the sage spoke these words boldly and sweetly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of lord Indra, the son of the sage spoke these words boldly and sweetly.
verses.science: अत्यन्त प्रेमपूर्वक्त कहने लगी--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुःखप्रशमनं वाञ्छासिद्धिदं मङ्गलालयम् । अपमृत्युहरं बुद्धिप्रदं शत्रुविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhapraśamanaṃ vāñchāsiddhidaṃ maṅgalālayam | apamṛtyuharaṃ buddhipradaṃ śatruvināśanam
verses.translation: O Paramour of Ahalya® O wicked one, O enemy of mountains, O chastiser of Paka, it is quite clear that I shall not ask any other god except Siva for a boon.
verses.hindi: और आनन्दपूर्वक शिवजीकी सेवा करने लगीं
verses.commentary: Sense: O Paramour of Ahalya® O wicked one, O enemy of mountains, O chastiser of Paka, it is quite clear that I shall not ask any other god except Siva for a boon.
verses.science: और आनन्दपूर्वक शिवजीकी सेवा करने लगीं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु शरभाकारं परं रूपं पिनाकिनः । प्रकाशनीयं भक्तेषु शङ्करस्य चरेषु वै
verses.transliteration: idaṃ tu śarabhākāraṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ pinākinaḥ | prakāśanīyaṃ bhakteṣu śaṅkarasya careṣu vai
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Indra's eyes turned red with fury. He raised his terrible thunderbolt and threatened the boy with dire consequences.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Indra's eyes turned red with fury. He raised his terrible thunderbolt and threatened the boy with dire consequences.
verses.science: शीघ्रतासे वहाँ आये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तैरेव पठितव्यं च श्रोतव्यं च शिवात्मभिः । नवधाभक्तिदं दिव्यमन्तःकरणबुद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: taireva paṭhitavyaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ ca śivātmabhiḥ | navadhābhaktidaṃ divyamantaḥkaraṇabuddhidam
verses.translation: On seeing the thunderbolt with the flames of light¬ ning, the boy remembered the words of Narad a. He became frightened and fell into a swoon.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the thunderbolt with the flames of light¬ ning, the boy remembered the words of Narad a. He became frightened and fell into a swoon.
verses.science: हाथ जोड़कर उनकी स्तुति की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवोत्सवेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च । पठेत्प्रतिष्ठाकाले तु शिवसन्निधिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: śivotsaveṣu sarveṣu caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca | paṭhetpratiṣṭhākāle tu śivasannidhikāraṇam
verses.translation: Then Siva, the lord of Parvati, the dispeller of darkness appeared in front. As though enlivening him with gentle strokings he said:—"Stand up. Stand up. May good come up to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva, the lord of Parvati, the dispeller of darkness appeared in front. As though enlivening him with gentle strokings he said:—"Stand up. Stand up. May good come up to you."
verses.science: देवेश! प्रसन्‍न होइये '--ऐसा कहा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चौरव्याघ्रनृसिंहात्मकृतराजभयेषु च । अन्येषूत्पातभूकम्पदस्य्वादिपांसुवृष्टिषु
verses.transliteration: cauravyāghranṛsiṃhātmakṛtarājabhayeṣu ca | anyeṣūtpātabhūkampadasyvādipāṃsuvṛṣṭiṣu
verses.translation: Opening his eyes resembling the lotus that had gone to sleep at the end of the day and getting up, he saw Siva shining more brilliantly than hundred suns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Opening his eyes resembling the lotus that had gone to sleep at the end of the day and getting up, he saw Siva shining more brilliantly than hundred suns.
verses.science: अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उल्कापाते महावाते विनावृष्ट्यतिवृष्टिषु । पठेद्यः प्रयतो विद्वान् शिवभक्तो दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: ulkāpāte mahāvāte vināvṛṣṭyativṛṣṭiṣu | paṭhedyaḥ prayato vidvān śivabhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the lord with the eyes in the fore-head, blue-necked, bull-bannered, moon-crested, with Parvati oc¬ cupying the left side, shining with matted hair, armed with the trident and Ajagava bow, possessed of limbs shining white like camphor, clad in the elephant's hide, he recognised the lord as the great God described in the Agamas and statements of his preceptor. He w'as delighted and he evinced the thrill of hair. For a moment he stood motionless like the mount¬ ain Gitrakuta.* He forgot himself like a man suddenly becoming rich. He was unable to eulogise or bow down or plead for anything. Then Siva smiled and said.
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing the lord with the eyes in the fore-head, blue-necked, bull-bannered, moon-crested, with Parvati oc¬ cupying the left side, shining with matted hair, armed with the trident and Ajagava bow, possessed of limbs shining white like camphor, clad in the elephant's hide,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the lord with the eyes in the fore-head, blue-necked, bull-bannered, moon-crested, with Parvati oc¬ cupying the left side, shining with matted hair, armed with the trident and Ajagava bow, possessed of limbs shining white like camphor, clad in the elephant's hide,…
verses.science: लोकचर्यानुसारिण: ॥ ६४ समय व्यतीत हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि निष्कामो व्रतमैश्वरम् । रुद्रलोकं समासाद्य रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi niṣkāmo vratamaiśvaram | rudralokaṃ samāsādya rudrasyānucaro bhavet
verses.translation: O child Grhapati, 1 know that you are frightened
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृर्तीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां पिप्पलादावतारवर्णन॑ नाम चदुर्विशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O child Grhapati, 1 know that you are frightened
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृर्तीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां पिप्पलादावतारवर्णन॑ नाम चदुर्विशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य रुद्रेण सह मोदते । ततः सायुज्यमाप्नोति शिवस्य कृपया मुने
verses.transliteration: rudralokamanuprāpya rudreṇa saha modate | tataḥ sāyujyamāpnoti śivasya kṛpayā mune
verses.translation: The epithet speaks contemptuously of Indra. He is called the seducer of Ahalya—the wife of the sage Gauiama. for which he' was cursed by the sage. As a result of Gautama's imprecation Indra boie a thousand marks resembling a female organ which afterwards that.rd to eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The epithet speaks contemptuously of Indra. He is called the seducer of Ahalya—the wife of the sage Gauiama. for which he' was cursed by the sage. As a result of Gautama's imprecation Indra boie a thousand marks resembling a female organ which afterwards that.rd to eyes.
verses.science: नामक चौबीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and fetching his kinsmen 8iva crowned him as the guardian of the quarter. Even as the parents watched it, l§iva entered his phallic image
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and fetching his kinsmen 8iva crowned him as the guardian of the quarter. Even as the parents watched it, l§iva entered his phallic image
verses.science: पिप्पलादके त्ेजसे आच्छनन हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and fetching his kinsmen 8iva crowned him as the guardian of the quarter. Even as the parents watched it, l§iva entered his phallic image
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and fetching his kinsmen 8iva crowned him as the guardian of the quarter. Even as the parents watched it, l§iva entered his phallic image
verses.science: होकर अपने आश्रममें चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । गृहपत्यवतारवर्णनम् १ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु ब्रह्मसुत प्रीत्या चरितं शशिमौलिनः । सोऽवतीर्णो यथा प्रीत्या विश्वानरगृहे शिवः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.13. trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gṛhapatyavatāravarṇanam 1 | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu brahmasuta prītyā caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ | so'vatīrṇo yathā prītyā viśvānaragṛhe śivaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear, the incarnation of 8iva as fire has been explained to you. This incarnation of liva, the great soul, is famous as Gfhapati also.
verses.hindi: मुनिवर उस नारीके साथ निवास करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear, the incarnation of 8iva as fire has been explained to you. This incarnation of liva, the great soul, is famous as Gfhapati also.
verses.science: मुनिवर उस नारीके साथ निवास करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना गृहपतिः सोऽभूदग्निलोकपतिर्मुने । अग्निरूपस्तैजसश्च सर्वात्मा परमः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nāmnā gṛhapatiḥ so'bhūdagnilokapatirmune | agnirūpastaijasaśca sarvātmā paramaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: After seeing Siva» the crestjewel of all the gods, all of them including Vi$nu devoutly bent their heads and bowed to Visnu with devotion.
verses.hindi: प्रसिद्ध शिवभक्ता महासुन्दरी वेश्या रहती थी
verses.commentary: Sense: After seeing Siva» the crestjewel of all the gods, all of them including Vi$nu devoutly bent their heads and bowed to Visnu with devotion.
verses.science: प्रसिद्ध शिवभक्ता महासुन्दरी वेश्या रहती थी। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायास्तटे रम्ये पुरे नर्मपुरे पुरा । पुरारिभक्तः पुण्यात्माभवद्विश्वानरो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāstaṭe ramye pure narmapure purā | purāribhaktaḥ puṇyātmābhavadviśvānaro muniḥ
verses.translation: Then the Asuras were defeated by the gods in the battle. By drinking nectar the gods had become powerful and gained victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Asuras were defeated by the gods in the battle. By drinking nectar the gods had become powerful and gained victory.
verses.science: उदार बुद्धिवाले वैश्यने मुसकराकर कहा--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमे निष्ठो ब्रह्मयज्ञरतः सदा । शाण्डिल्यगोत्रः शुचिमान्ब्रह्मतेजोनिधिर्वशी
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryāśrame niṣṭho brahmayajñarataḥ sadā | śāṇḍilyagotraḥ śucimānbrahmatejonidhirvaśī
verses.translation: Saying this, Siva in the form of Yakfa, the goal of the good, placed a blade of grass before them and dispel¬ led their arrogance.
verses.hindi: सेवकोंसे अपने भवनके बाहर चिता बनवायी
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying this, Siva in the form of Yakfa, the goal of the good, placed a blade of grass before them and dispel¬ led their arrogance.
verses.science: सेवकोंसे अपने भवनके बाहर चिता बनवायी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाताखिलशास्त्रार्थः सदाचाररतः सदा । शैवाचारप्रवीणोऽति लौकिकाचारविद्वरः
verses.transliteration: vijñātākhilaśāstrārthaḥ sadācārarataḥ sadā | śaivācārapravīṇo'ti laukikācāravidvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the Yaksanitha blessed the gods enlightened them with various instructions and vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: घोर भयसे छुड़ाइये, आपको नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Yaksanitha blessed the gods enlightened them with various instructions and vanished there itself.
verses.science: घोर भयसे छुड़ाइये, आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चित्ते विचार्य गृहिणीगुणान्विश्वानरः शुभान् । उदुवाह विधानेन स्वोचितां कुलकन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: citte vicārya gṛhiṇīguṇānviśvānaraḥ śubhān | uduvāha vidhānena svocitāṃ kulakanyakām
verses.translation: A brahmin attains the sacred splendour of Brahman; Katriya becomes victorious; a Vaiiya becomes lord of wealth and a Sudra attains happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: A brahmin attains the sacred splendour of Brahman; Katriya becomes victorious; a Vaiiya becomes lord of wealth and a Sudra attains happiness.
verses.science: बनमें प्रकट हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निशुश्रूषणरतः पञ्चयज्ञपरायणः । षट्कर्मनिरतो नित्यं देवपित्रतिथिप्रियः
verses.transliteration: agniśuśrūṣaṇarataḥ pañcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ | ṣaṭkarmanirato nityaṃ devapitratithipriyaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, on hearing the misery of the gods their father Kasyapa whose mind was attached to Siva, was much distressed.
verses.hindi: वे प्रतिदिन अग्निशुश्रूषा, पंचयज्ञ तथा षट्कर्ममें संलग्न रहते थे और देवता, पितर एवं अतिथियोंका पूजन करते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, on hearing the misery of the gods their father Kasyapa whose mind was attached to Siva, was much distressed.

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुतिथे काले गते तस्याग्रजन्मनः । भार्या शुचिष्मती नाम भर्तारं प्राह सुव्रता
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahutithe kāle gate tasyāgrajanmanaḥ | bhāryā śuciṣmatī nāma bhartāraṃ prāha suvratā
verses.translation: O sage, tne sage consoled and encouraged them. With his mind regaining calmness he joyously went to Kali presided over by lord Vilvesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, tne sage consoled and encouraged them. With his mind regaining calmness he joyously went to Kali presided over by lord Vilvesvara.
verses.science: तुम्हारा बल कहाँ है ?। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: नाथ भोगा मया सर्वे भुक्ता वै त्वत्प्रसादतः । स्त्रीणां समुचिता ये स्युः त्वां समेत्य मुदावहाः
verses.transliteration: nātha bhogā mayā sarve bhuktā vai tvatprasādataḥ | strīṇāṃ samucitā ye syuḥ tvāṃ sametya mudāvahāḥ
verses.translation: Taking his ceremonial bath in the waters of the Gahga and performing due rites, he worshipped Lord Vil> velvara, lord of the universe, accompanied by Parvatl.
verses.hindi: आक्रमणको भी रोकनेमें सक्षम न हो सके
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking his ceremonial bath in the waters of the Gahga and performing due rites, he worshipped Lord Vil> velvara, lord of the universe, accompanied by Parvatl.
verses.science: आक्रमणको भी रोकनेमें सक्षम न हो सके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं मे प्रार्थितं नाथ चिराय हृदि संस्थितम् । गृहस्थानां समुचितं त्वमेतद्दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ me prārthitaṃ nātha cirāya hṛdi saṃsthitam | gṛhasthānāṃ samucitaṃ tvametaddātumarhasi
verses.translation: People of steady Sattvika quality and control over their sense-organs, who enter fire, or women endowed with Sattva quality become as lustrous as fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: People of steady Sattvika quality and control over their sense-organs, who enter fire, or women endowed with Sattva quality become as lustrous as fire.
verses.science: तथा पद्माके सुखको बढ़ानेवाले थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानर उवाच । किमदेयं हि सुश्रोणि तव प्रियहितैषिणी । तत्प्रार्थय महाभागे प्रयच्छाम्यविलम्बितम्
verses.transliteration: viśvānara uvāca | kimadeyaṃ hi suśroṇi tava priyahitaiṣiṇī | tatprārthaya mahābhāge prayacchāmyavilambitam
verses.translation: Brahmins performing Agnihotra regularly, Brahma- carins maintaining sacrificial fires, and those who stay amidst five fires become as splendrous as fire in the region of fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmins performing Agnihotra regularly, Brahma- carins maintaining sacrificial fires, and those who stay amidst five fires become as splendrous as fire in the region of fire.
verses.science: पिप्पलादने अनेक प्रकारकी लीलाएँ कीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महेशितुः प्रसादेन मम किञ्चिन्न दुर्लभम् । इहामुत्र च कल्याणि सर्वकल्याणकारिणः
verses.transliteration: maheśituḥ prasādena mama kiñcinna durlabham | ihāmutra ca kalyāṇi sarvakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who makes gifts of bundles of fuel during winter for alleviating chillness or he who makes fire-bricks (of cow-dung) stays with fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes gifts of bundles of fuel during winter for alleviating chillness or he who makes fire-bricks (of cow-dung) stays with fire.
verses.science: पीड़ित नहीं करता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचः पत्युस्तस्य सा पतिदेवता । उवाच हृष्टवदना करौ बद्ध्वा विनीतिका
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya vacaḥ patyustasya sā patidevatā | uvāca hṛṣṭavadanā karau baddhvā vinītikā
verses.translation: He who faithfully f>erforms the rites ol' cremation for the unclaimed bodies or he who urges others to do so, himself being incapable, is honoured in the region of fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who faithfully f>erforms the rites ol' cremation for the unclaimed bodies or he who urges others to do so, himself being incapable, is honoured in the region of fire.
verses.science: पीड़ाको नष्ट करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुचिष्मत्युवाच । वरयोग्यास्मि चेन्नाथ यदि देयो वरो मम । महेशसदृशं पुत्रं देहि नान्यं वरं वृणे
verses.transliteration: śuciṣmatyuvāca | varayogyāsmi cennātha yadi deyo varo mama | maheśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe
verses.translation: All unholy things become pure the moment they come into contact with lire. Therefore fire is called Purifier.
