verses.commentary: Sense: All unholy things become pure the moment they come into contact with lire. Therefore fire is called Purifier.
verses.science: पूर्ण हो जाती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणः स शुचिव्रतः । क्षणं समाधिमाधाय हृद्येतत्समचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇaḥ sa śucivrataḥ | kṣaṇaṃ samādhimādhāya hṛdyetatsamacintayat
verses.translation: The incense, the lights, the food offerings, milk, curd, ghee and sugarcane juice—all these go unto the dwel¬ lers of heaven when offered into the fire here.
verses.hindi: पिप्पलादके रूपमें साक्षात् शिवजी अवतरित हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: The incense, the lights, the food offerings, milk, curd, ghee and sugarcane juice—all these go unto the dwel¬ lers of heaven when offered into the fire here.
verses.science: पिप्पलादके रूपमें साक्षात् शिवजी अवतरित हुए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो किं मे तया तन्व्या प्रार्थितं ह्यतिदुर्लभम् । मनोरथपथाद्दूरमस्तु वा स हि सर्वकृत्
verses.transliteration: aho kiṃ me tayā tanvyā prārthitaṃ hyatidurlabham | manorathapathāddūramastu vā sa hi sarvakṛt
verses.translation: O great sage, listen to the Yakevara incarnation of iSiva, that dispels the arrogance of the arrogant and lets the devotion of e good flourish.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण करनेवाला तथा शिवभक्तिको बढ़ानेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, listen to the Yakevara incarnation of iSiva, that dispels the arrogance of the arrogant and lets the devotion of e good flourish.
verses.science: पूर्ण करनेवाला तथा शिवभक्तिको बढ़ानेवाला है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवास्या मुखे स्थित्वा वाक्स्वरूपेण शम्भुना । व्याहृतं कोऽन्यथा कर्तुमुत्सहेत भवेदिदम्
verses.transliteration: tenaivāsyā mukhe sthitvā vāksvarūpeṇa śambhunā | vyāhṛtaṃ ko'nyathā kartumutsaheta bhavedidam
verses.translation: Formerly, the powerful gods and the Daityas moti¬ vated by the desire to gain their selfish ends churned the milk ocean for achieving nectar.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शवर्रसंहितायां पिप्पलादाववार-चरितवर्णन॑ नाम पदञ्चविंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the powerful gods and the Daityas moti¬ vated by the desire to gain their selfish ends churned the milk ocean for achieving nectar.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शवर्रसंहितायां पिप्पलादाववार-चरितवर्णन॑ नाम पदञ्चविंशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: इति सञ्चिन्त्य स मुनिर्विश्वानर उदारधीः । ततः प्रोवाच तां पत्नीमेकपत्नीव्रते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: iti sañcintya sa munirviśvānara udāradhīḥ | tataḥ provāca tāṃ patnīmekapatnīvrate sthitaḥ
verses.translation: When the churning of the milk ocean started as the gods and demons wanted nectar, poison blazing as the fire of dissolution came out at first.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the churning of the milk ocean started as the gods and demons wanted nectar, poison blazing as the fire of dissolution came out at first.
verses.science: नामक पच्चीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थमाश्वास्य तां पत्नीं जगाम तपसे मुनिः । यत्र विश्वेश्वरः साक्षात्काशीनाथोऽधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | itthamāśvāsya tāṃ patnīṃ jagāma tapase muniḥ | yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣātkāśīnātho'dhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: O dear, at the sight of it, the gods and the daityas
verses.hindi: नामक अवतारका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ; आप सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, at the sight of it, the gods and the daityas
verses.science: नामक अवतारका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ; आप सुनिये। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य वाराणसीं तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा तां मणिकर्णिकाम् । तत्याज तापत्रितयमपि जन्मशतार्जितम्
verses.transliteration: prāpya vārāṇasīṃ tūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ maṇikarṇikām | tatyāja tāpatritayamapi janmaśatārjitam
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva favourably disposed to the devotees, quaffed off the terrible poison afflicting gods and Asuras.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने शीघ्र ही वारणसी पहुँचकर मणिकर्णिकाका दर्शन करके अपने सैकड़ों जन्मोंके अर्जित तीनों तापोंसे मुक्ति प्राप्त कर ली
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord Siva favourably disposed to the devotees, quaffed off the terrible poison afflicting gods and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि लिङ्गानि विश्वेशप्रमुखानि च । स्नात्वा सर्वेषु कुण्डेषु वापीकूपसरस्सु च
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi liṅgāni viśveśapramukhāni ca | snātvā sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu vāpīkūpasarassu ca
verses.translation: The lord retained obliquely the acute poison that he drank, in his neck. He shone much thereby and became Blue-necked.
verses.hindi: तथा भस्म एवं रुद्राक्ष धारण करती थी
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord retained obliquely the acute poison that he drank, in his neck. He shone much thereby and became Blue-necked.
verses.science: तथा भस्म एवं रुद्राक्ष धारण करती थी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा विनायकान्सर्वान्गौरीं शर्वां प्रणम्य च । सम्पूज्य कालराजं च भैरवं पापभक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: natvā vināyakānsarvāngaurīṃ śarvāṃ praṇamya ca | sampūjya kālarājaṃ ca bhairavaṃ pāpabhakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Released from the burning sensation of the poison thanks to the blessings of Siva, the gods and the Asuras began to churn again.
verses.hindi: यशका गान करती हुई नृत्य करती थी
verses.commentary: Sense: Released from the burning sensation of the poison thanks to the blessings of Siva, the gods and the Asuras began to churn again.
verses.science: यशका गान करती हुई नृत्य करती थी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दण्डनायकमुख्यांश्च गणान्स्तुत्वा प्रयत्नतः । आदिकेशवमुख्यांश्च केशवं परितोष्य च
verses.transliteration: daṇḍanāyakamukhyāṃśca gaṇānstutvā prayatnataḥ | ādikeśavamukhyāṃśca keśavaṃ paritoṣya ca
verses.translation: O sage, many gems came out of it, but O sage, it was the nectar that the gods and the Danavas prized much.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, many gems came out of it, but O sage, it was the nectar that the gods and the Danavas prized much.
verses.science: प्रेमपूर्वक उच्च स्वरमें हँसती थी। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लोलार्कमुखसूर्यांश्च प्रणम्य स पुनः पुनः । कृत्वा च पिण्डदानानि सर्वतीर्थेष्वतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: lolārkamukhasūryāṃśca praṇamya sa punaḥ punaḥ | kṛtvā ca piṇḍadānāni sarvatīrtheṣvatandritaḥ
verses.translation: Not the Asuras, but the gods drank the nectar, thanks to the favour of Visnu. Then a great battle ensued between them inflicting pain on both.
verses.hindi: उस वानरके साथ सदा नृत्य किया करता था
verses.commentary: Sense: Not the Asuras, but the gods drank the nectar, thanks to the favour of Visnu. Then a great battle ensued between them inflicting pain on both.
verses.science: उस वानरके साथ सदा नृत्य किया करता था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रभोजनाद्यैश्च मुनीन्विप्रान्प्रतर्प्य च । महापूजोपचारैश्च लिङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabhojanādyaiśca munīnviprānpratarpya ca | mahāpūjopacāraiśca liṅgānyabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: A mutual clash occurred between the gods and the Danavas, O sage. The moon was eclipsed by Rahu and fled in terror of Rahu.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mutual clash occurred between the gods and the Danavas, O sage. The moon was eclipsed by Rahu and fled in terror of Rahu.
verses.science: करनेके लिये उसके घर आये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असकृच्चिन्तयामास किं लिङ्गं क्षिप्रसिद्धिदम् । यत्र निश्चलतामेति तपस्तनयकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: asakṛccintayāmāsa kiṃ liṅgaṃ kṣiprasiddhidam | yatra niścalatāmeti tapastanayakāmyayā
verses.translation: He went to the abode of Siva extremely agitated by fe-»r and sought Siva's protection. Saying "Protect me O Lord, protect me" he bowed to the lord and eulogised him.
verses.hindi: आसक्त, जययुक्त तथा शैव वेश धारण किये हुए थे
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to the abode of Siva extremely agitated by fe-»r and sought Siva's protection. Saying "Protect me O Lord, protect me" he bowed to the lord and eulogised him.
verses.science: आसक्त, जययुक्त तथा शैव वेश धारण किये हुए थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं विचार्य स मुनिरिति विश्वानरः सुधीः । क्षिप्रं पुत्रप्रदं लिङ्गं वीरेशं प्रशशंस ह
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇaṃ vicārya sa muniriti viśvānaraḥ sudhīḥ | kṣipraṃ putrapradaṃ liṅgaṃ vīreśaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha
verses.translation: Lord Siva, the bestower of protection to the good, and favourably disposed to his devotees, wore the moon on his head as the latter had sought refuge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva, the bestower of protection to the good, and favourably disposed to his devotees, wore the moon on his head as the latter had sought refuge.
verses.science: आदरसहित अपने स्थानमें बैठाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्याताः सहस्राणि सिद्धाः सिद्धिं गतास्ततः । सिद्धलिङ्गमिति ख्यातं तस्माद्वीरेश्वरं परम्
verses.transliteration: asaṅkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi siddhāḥ siddhiṃ gatāstataḥ | siddhaliṅgamiti khyātaṃ tasmādvīreśvaraṃ param
verses.translation: Then Rahu too, came there. He bowed to and eulogised lord Siva with reverence by means of sweet v/ords.
verses.hindi: वह वेश्या चकित होकर उनसे कहने लगी
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rahu too, came there. He bowed to and eulogised lord Siva with reverence by means of sweet v/ords.
verses.science: वह वेश्या चकित होकर उनसे कहने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरेश्वरं महालिङ्गमब्दमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः । आयुर्मनोरथं सर्वं पुत्रादिकमनेकशः
verses.transliteration: vīreśvaraṃ mahāliṅgamabdamabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ | āyurmanorathaṃ sarvaṃ putrādikamanekaśaḥ
verses.translation: Realising his desire, Siva fixed on to his neck his head that had been formerly cut off by Vi|nu, and that was known as Ketu.
verses.hindi: रहा है; यह तो दिव्य स्त्रियोंके योग्य आभूषण है
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising his desire, Siva fixed on to his neck his head that had been formerly cut off by Vi|nu, and that was known as Ketu.
verses.science: रहा है; यह तो दिव्य स्त्रियोंके योग्य आभूषण है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहमप्यत्र वीरेशं समाराध्य त्रिकालतः । आशु पुत्रमवाप्स्यामि यथाभिलषितं स्त्रिया
verses.transliteration: ahamapyatra vīreśaṃ samārādhya trikālataḥ | āśu putramavāpsyāmi yathābhilaṣitaṃ striyā
verses.translation: The text of the fourth frot ol this vrrse is corrupt.
verses.hindi: इसको धारण करो; किंतु इसका क्या मूल्य दोगी 2
verses.commentary: Sense: The text of the fourth frot ol this vrrse is corrupt.
verses.science: इसको धारण करो; किंतु इसका क्या मूल्य दोगी 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति कृत्वा मतिं धिरो विप्रो विश्वानरः कृती । चन्द्रकूपजले स्नात्वा जग्राह नियमं व्रती
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti kṛtvā matiṃ dhiro vipro viśvānaraḥ kṛtī | candrakūpajale snātvā jagrāha niyamaṃ vratī
verses.translation: Deluded by Siva's Maya, Viu and others became very haughty. Their strength began to take root and sprout within them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by Siva's Maya, Viu and others became very haughty. Their strength began to take root and sprout within them.
verses.science: है; इसमें संशय नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकाहारोऽभवन्मासं मासं नक्ताशनोऽभवत् । अयाचिताशनो मासं मासं त्यक्ताशनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ekāhāro'bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ naktāśano'bhavat | ayācitāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ tyaktāśanaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, then Lord Siva, the suppressor of arro¬ gance, became a Yaka. He hastened to the place, O sage, where the gods were stationed.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने एक मासपर्यन्त दिनमें एकाहार, एक मास- पर्यन्त रात्रिमें एकाहार, एक मासपर्यन्त अयाचित आहार पुनः एक मासतक निराहार रहकर तप किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, then Lord Siva, the suppressor of arro¬ gance, became a Yaka. He hastened to the place, O sage, where the gods were stationed.

verses.sanskrit: पयोव्रतोऽभवन्मासं मासं शाकफलाशनः । मासं मुष्टितिलाहारो मासं पानीयभोजनः
verses.transliteration: payovrato'bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ śākaphalāśanaḥ | māsaṃ muṣṭitilāhāro māsaṃ pānīyabhojanaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Vinu and all other gods arrogant in their minds, lord Siva, the lord of Yaksas and the suppressor of arrogance spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Vinu and all other gods arrogant in their minds, lord Siva, the lord of Yaksas and the suppressor of arrogance spoke.
verses.science: हृदयका स्पर्श करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्याशनो मासं मासं चान्द्रायणव्रती । मासं कुशाग्रजलभुग्मासं श्वसनभक्षणः
verses.transliteration: pañcagavyāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ cāndrāyaṇavratī | māsaṃ kuśāgrajalabhugmāsaṃ śvasanabhakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O ye gods, why have you all assembled here. What is your goal? Tell me the reason as I ask unto you.
verses.hindi: रक्षा करना और यलपूर्वक इसे छिपाकर रखना
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye gods, why have you all assembled here. What is your goal? Tell me the reason as I ask unto you.
verses.science: रक्षा करना और यलपूर्वक इसे छिपाकर रखना। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमब्दमितं कालं तताप स तपोऽद्भुतम् । त्रिकालमर्चयद्भक्त्या वीरेशं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evamabdamitaṃ kālaṃ tatāpa sa tapo'dbhutam | trikālamarcayadbhaktyā vīreśaṃ liṅgamuttamam
verses.translation: O lord, a terrible battle took place here wherein all the Asuras were killed. The few that remained fled away.
verses.hindi: नाट्यशालाके मध्यमें रखकर घरमें प्रवेश किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, a terrible battle took place here wherein all the Asuras were killed. The few that remained fled away.
verses.science: नाट्यशालाके मध्यमें रखकर घरमें प्रवेश किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ त्रयोदशे मासि स्नात्वा त्रिपथगाम्भसि । प्रत्यूष एव वीरेशं यावदायाति स द्विजः
verses.transliteration: atha trayodaśe māsi snātvā tripathagāmbhasi | pratyūṣa eva vīreśaṃ yāvadāyāti sa dvijaḥ
verses.translation: We are great heroes and powerful slayers of the Daityas. How insignificant in strength are those Daityas in front of us!
verses.commentary: Sense: We are great heroes and powerful slayers of the Daityas. How insignificant in strength are those Daityas in front of us!
verses.science: चारों ओरसे आवृत कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तावद्विलोकयाञ्चक्रे मध्ये लिङ्गं तपोधनः । विभूतिभूषणं बालमष्टवर्षाकृतिं शिशुम्
verses.transliteration: tāvadvilokayāñcakre madhye liṅgaṃ tapodhanaḥ | vibhūtibhūṣaṇaṃ bālamaṣṭavarṣākṛtiṃ śiśum
verses.translation: On hearing the arrogant words of those gods, lord Siva, the suppressor of arrogance, in the form of Yaka said.
verses.hindi: व्याकुलतासे उठकर बन्दरको बन्धनमुक्त कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the arrogant words of those gods, lord Siva, the suppressor of arrogance, in the form of Yaka said.
verses.science: व्याकुलतासे उठकर बन्दरको बन्धनमुक्त कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आकर्णायतनेत्रं च सुरक्तदशनच्छदम् । चारुपिङ्गजटामौलिं नग्न प्रहसिताननम्
verses.transliteration: ākarṇāyatanetraṃ ca suraktadaśanacchadam | cārupiṅgajaṭāmauliṃ nagna prahasitānanam
verses.translation: O ye gods, you listen to my words with attention. I shall tell you the truth that will dispel arrogance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye gods, you listen to my words with attention. I shall tell you the truth that will dispel arrogance.
verses.science: जाननेके लिये मरनेका विचार किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शैशवोचितनेपथ्यधारिणं चितिधारिणम् । पठन्तं श्रुतिसूक्तानि हसन्तं च स्वलीलया
verses.transliteration: śaiśavocitanepathyadhāriṇaṃ citidhāriṇam | paṭhantaṃ śrutisūktāni hasantaṃ ca svalīlayā
verses.translation: If you are proud and think that you know your strength to be great, O gods, split this blade of grass placed by me, with your own weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you are proud and think that you know your strength to be great, O gods, split this blade of grass placed by me, with your own weapons.
verses.science: और प्राणोंको त्याग दूँगा। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमालोक्य मुदं प्राप्य रोमकञ्चुकितो मुनिः । प्रोच्चचार हृदालापान्नमोऽस्त्विति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tamālokya mudaṃ prāpya romakañcukito muniḥ | proccacāra hṛdālāpānnamo'stviti punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Then Visnu and other gods professing to be heroic exerted their manliness and hurled their respective weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Visnu and other gods professing to be heroic exerted their manliness and hurled their respective weapons.
verses.science: देखते-देखते अग्निमें प्रवेश कर गये। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषप्रदैः पद्यैरष्टभिर्बालरूपिणम् । तुष्टाव परमानन्दं शम्भुं विश्वानरः कृती
verses.transliteration: abhilāṣapradaiḥ padyairaṣṭabhirbālarūpiṇam | tuṣṭāva paramānandaṃ śambhuṃ viśvānaraḥ kṛtī
verses.translation: But the weapons of the gods, were rendered fruitless before the power of Siva, the destroyer of the arrogance of the deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the weapons of the gods, were rendered fruitless before the power of Siva, the destroyer of the arrogance of the deluded.
verses.science: युक्त वचन कहने लगी--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानर उवाच । एकं ब्रह्मैवाद्वितीयं समस्तं सत्यं सत्यं नेह नानास्ति किञ्चित् । एको रुद्रो न द्वितीयोऽवतस्थे तस्मादेकं त्वां प्रपद्ये महेशम्
verses.transliteration: viśvānara uvāca | ekaṃ brahmaivādvitīyaṃ samastaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ neha nānāsti kiñcit | eko rudro na dvitīyo'vatasthe tasmādekaṃ tvāṃ prapadye maheśam
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice arose that dispelled the surprise of the gods—"O gods this Yaksa is Siva who removes the arrogance of the arrogant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a celestial voice arose that dispelled the surprise of the gods—"O gods this Yaksa is Siva who removes the arrogance of the arrogant.
verses.science: वैश्यकी धर्मसम्मत पत्नी रहूँगी। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता हर्त्ता त्वं हि सर्वस्य शम्भो नानारूपेष्वेकरूपोऽप्यरूपः । यद्वत्प्रत्यग्धर्म एकोऽप्यनेक- स्तस्मान्नान्यं त्वां विनेशं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: kartā harttā tvaṃ hi sarvasya śambho nānārūpeṣvekarūpo'pyarūpaḥ | yadvatpratyagdharma eko'pyaneka- stasmānnānyaṃ tvāṃ vineśaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: Deluded by the power of his illusion you have become arrogant and have not realised lord Siva, who is the very knowledge embodied.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by the power of his illusion you have become arrogant and have not realised lord Siva, who is the very knowledge embodied.
verses.science: अमिनिमें प्रवेश करूँगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रज्जौ सर्पः शुक्तिकायां च रौप्यं नैरः पूरस्तन्मृगाख्ये मरीचौ । यद्यत्सद्वद्विष्वगेव प्रपञ्चो यस्मिन् ज्ञाते तं प्रपद्ये महेशम्
verses.transliteration: rajjau sarpaḥ śuktikāyāṃ ca raupyaṃ nairaḥ pūrastanmṛgākhye marīcau | yadyatsadvadviṣvageva prapañco yasmin jñāte taṃ prapadye maheśam
verses.translation: O hearing the celestial voice they became divested of their arrogance. They had realised Yaksevara. They bowed to and eulogised him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O hearing the celestial voice they became divested of their arrogance. They had realised Yaksevara. They bowed to and eulogised him.
verses.science: उसमें प्रवेश करनेको उद्यत हुई। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तोये शैत्यं दाहकत्वं च वह्नौ तापो भानौ शीतभानौ प्रसादः । पुष्पे गन्धो दुग्धमध्येऽपि सर्पि- र्यत्तच्छम्भो त्वं ततस्त्वां प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: toye śaityaṃ dāhakatvaṃ ca vahnau tāpo bhānau śītabhānau prasādaḥ | puṣpe gandho dugdhamadhye'pi sarpi- ryattacchambho tvaṃ tatastvāṃ prapadye
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, the dispeller of arrogance, O Yaksevara of great sports, O lord, your Maya is wonderful.
verses.hindi: हे शम्भो! जिस प्रकार जलमें शीतलता, अग्निमें दाहकता, सूर्यमें ताप, चन्द्रमामें आह्नादकत्व, पुष्पमें गन्ध एवं दुग्धमें घृत व्याप्त रंहता है, उसी प्रकार सर्वत्र आप ही व्याप्त हैं, अतः मैं आपकी शरण प्राप्त करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the gods, the dispeller of arrogance, O Yaksevara of great sports, O lord, your Maya is wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दं गृह्णास्यश्रवास्त्वं हि जिघ्र- स्यघ्राणस्त्वं व्यङ्घ्रिरायासि दूरात् । व्यक्षः पश्येस्त्वं रसज्ञोऽप्यजिह्वः कस्त्वां सम्यग्वेत्त्यतस्त्वां प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: śabdaṃ gṛhṇāsyaśravāstvaṃ hi jighra- syaghrāṇastvaṃ vyaṅghrirāyāsi dūrāt | vyakṣaḥ paśyestvaṃ rasajño'pyajihvaḥ kastvāṃ samyagvettyatastvāṃ prapadye
verses.translation: Even now we are deluded by this Maya of yours in the form of Yaksa. Hence, separated from you we began to speak arrogantly before you.
verses.hindi: हुईके समान उसी प्रकार खड़ी रह गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: Even now we are deluded by this Maya of yours in the form of Yaksa. Hence, separated from you we began to speak arrogantly before you.
verses.science: हुईके समान उसी प्रकार खड़ी रह गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नो वेद त्वामीश साक्षाद्धि वेदो नो वा विष्णुर्नो विधाताखिलस्य । नो योगीन्द्रा नेन्द्रमुख्याश्च देवा भक्तो वेद त्वामतस्त्वां प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: no veda tvāmīśa sākṣāddhi vedo no vā viṣṇurno vidhātākhilasya | no yogīndrā nendramukhyāśca devā bhakto veda tvāmatastvāṃ prapadye
verses.translation: O lord, thanks to your grace, alone, knowledge has dawned on us. O Siva, you alone are the creator, sustainer and annihilator, none else.
verses.hindi: निमित्त मैं वैश्य बनकर तुम्हारे पास आया था
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, thanks to your grace, alone, knowledge has dawned on us. O Siva, you alone are the creator, sustainer and annihilator, none else.
verses.science: निमित्त मैं वैश्य बनकर तुम्हारे पास आया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नो ते गोत्रं नेश जन्मापि नाख्या नो वा रूपं नैव शीलं न देशः । इत्थम्भूतोऽपीश्वरस्त्वं त्रिलोक्याः सर्वान्कामान्पूरयेस्त्वं भजे त्वाम्
verses.transliteration: no te gotraṃ neśa janmāpi nākhyā no vā rūpaṃ naiva śīlaṃ na deśaḥ | itthambhūto'pīśvarastvaṃ trilokyāḥ sarvānkāmānpūrayestvaṃ bhaje tvām
verses.translation: You alone arc the initiator and the withdrawer of all powers. You are lord of all, the threat soul, the unchanging, the unrivalled.
verses.hindi: हे ईश! आपका न तो गोत्र है, न जन्म है, न आपका नाम है, न आपका रूप है, न शील है एवं न देश। ऐसा होते हुए भी आप तीनों लोकोंके स्वामी हैं और आप समस्त मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करते हैं, अतः मैं आपका भजन करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone arc the initiator and the withdrawer of all powers. You are lord of all, the threat soul, the unchanging, the unrivalled.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तः सर्वं त्वं हि सर्वं स्मरारे त्वं गौरीशस्त्वं च नग्नोऽतिशान्तः । त्वं वै वृद्धस्त्वं युवा त्वं च बाल- स्तत्त्वं यत्किं नान्यतस्त्वां नतोऽहम्
verses.transliteration: tvattaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ smarāre tvaṃ gaurīśastvaṃ ca nagno'tiśāntaḥ | tvaṃ vai vṛddhastvaṃ yuvā tvaṃ ca bāla- stattvaṃ yatkiṃ nānyatastvāṃ nato'ham
verses.translation: In the form of YakeSvara you have removed our arrogance. With sympathy and kindness we think we have been blessed by you.
verses.hindi: शाणाधाक्रुएपारशा 0 एक 49940 42. गरिणा हे कामशत्रो ! सब कुछ आपसे है और आप ही सब कुछ हैं, आप पार्वतीपति हैं, आप दिगम्बर एवं अत्यन्त शान्त हैं। आप वृद्ध, युवा और बालक हैं। कौन ऐसा पदार्थ है, जो आप नहीं हैं, अतः मैं आपको नमस्कार करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: In the form of YakeSvara you have removed our arrogance. With sympathy and kindness we think we have been blessed by you.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । स्तुत्वेति विप्रो निपपात भूमौ सम्बद्धपाणिर्भवतीह यावत् । तावत्स बालोऽखिलवृद्धवृद्धः प्रोवाच भूदेवमतीव हृष्टः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | stutveti vipro nipapāta bhūmau sambaddhapāṇirbhavatīha yāvat | tāvatsa bālo'khilavṛddhavṛddhaḥ provāca bhūdevamatīva hṛṣṭaḥ
verses.translation: Thus has been described the pleasant incarnation of Siva called Yakelvara that bestows pleasure, satisfaction and protection of the good.
verses.hindi: ताः सर्वाश्च तया सार्थ निनाय स्व॑ परं पदम्॥ ६२  सबको अपने परम पदकी प्राप्ति करायी
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus has been described the pleasant incarnation of Siva called Yakelvara that bestows pleasure, satisfaction and protection of the good.
verses.science: ताः सर्वाश्च तया सार्थ निनाय स्व॑ परं पदम्॥ ६२ सबको अपने परम पदकी प्राप्ति करायी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बाल उवाच । विश्वानर मुनिश्रेष्ठ भूदेवाहं त्वयाद्य वै । तोषितः सुप्रसन्नात्मा वृणीष्व वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bāla uvāca | viśvānara muniśreṣṭha bhūdevāhaṃ tvayādya vai | toṣitaḥ suprasannātmā vṛṇīṣva varamuttamam
verses.translation: The intelligent man who listens to or narrates this with devotion attains all desires. Then he attains salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent man who listens to or narrates this with devotion attains all desires. Then he attains salvation.
verses.science: सदा आनन्द देनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय हृष्टात्मा मुनिर्विश्वानरः कृती । प्रत्यब्रवीन्मुनिश्रेष्ठः शङ्करं बालरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: tata utthāya hṛṣṭātmā munirviśvānaraḥ kṛtī | pratyabravīnmuniśreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkaraṃ bālarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Now listen to the first ten incarnations of Siva beginning with that of Mahakala. They are resorted to with devotion and explained in Upasanakanda.
verses.hindi: महानन्दाको परम सुख देनेवाला तथा अद्भुत है
verses.commentary: Sense: Now listen to the first ten incarnations of Siva beginning with that of Mahakala. They are resorted to with devotion and explained in Upasanakanda.
verses.science: महानन्दाको परम सुख देनेवाला तथा अद्भुत है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानर उवाच । महेश्वर किमज्ञातं सर्वज्ञस्य तव प्रभो । सर्वान्तरात्मा भगवान् शर्वः सर्वप्रदो भवान्
verses.transliteration: viśvānara uvāca | maheśvara kimajñātaṃ sarvajñasya tava prabho | sarvāntarātmā bhagavān śarvaḥ sarvaprado bhavān
verses.translation: The concept of god (in the male form) and his Energy (in the female form) is not pecnliar to Siva-cult alone. It belongs to almost every god—Vifnu, firahmft, Indra and others. It is found in pairs—Siva-lSivl, ViOu-Vaistiav!, Brahmi-BrahmSpi, Indra-IndifiiiT. The Present chapter mentions the eluent incarnations of $iva and their re- pective lergies.
verses.hindi: च्यवते न स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्॥ ६५  और परलोकमें उत्तम गति प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The concept of god (in the male form) and his Energy (in the female form) is not pecnliar to Siva-cult alone. It belongs to almost every god—Vifnu, firahmft, Indra and others. It is found in pairs—Siva-lSivl, ViOu-Vaistiav!, Brahmi-BrahmSpi, Indra-IndifiiiT.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The concept of god (in the male form) and his Energy (in the female form) is not pecnliar to Siva-cult alone. It belongs to almost every god—Vifnu, firahmft, Indra and others. It is found in pairs—Siva-lSivl, ViOu-Vaistiav!, Brahmi-BrahmSpi, Indra-IndifiiiT.…
verses.science: च्यवते न स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्॥ ६५ और परलोकमें उत्तम गति प्राप्त करता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: याच्ञां प्रति नियुक्तं मां किं ब्रूषे दैन्यकारिणीम् । इति ज्ञात्वा महेशान यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: yācñāṃ prati niyuktaṃ māṃ kiṃ brūṣe dainyakāriṇīm | iti jñātvā maheśāna yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: The ten incarnations of Siva are pleasing as they confer worldly pleasures and salvation. They bestow every¬ thing on good devotees.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां वैश्यनाथाह्यय-शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षड़्विंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The ten incarnations of Siva are pleasing as they confer worldly pleasures and salvation. They bestow every¬ thing on good devotees.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां वैश्यनाथाह्यय-शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षड़्विंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवो विश्वानरस्य हि । शुचिः शुचिव्रतस्याथ शुचिं स्मित्वाब्रवीच्छिशुः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasya devo viśvānarasya hi | śuciḥ śucivratasyātha śuciṃ smitvābravīcchiśuḥ
verses.translation: These ten incarnations of Siva the great soul bestow different kinds of pleasures on those who always resort to them without aberrations.
verses.hindi: शिवावतारका वर्णन नामक छब्बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: These ten incarnations of Siva the great soul bestow different kinds of pleasures on those who always resort to them without aberrations.
verses.science: शिवावतारका वर्णन नामक छब्बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वया शुचे शुचिष्मत्यां योऽभिलाषः कृतो हृदि । अचिरेणैव कालेन स भविष्यत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tvayā śuce śuciṣmatyāṃ yo'bhilāṣaḥ kṛto hṛdi | acireṇaiva kālena sa bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: O sage, the glory of the ten in:amations of Siva has thus been described. It bestows all desires as explained in the Tantraiastra and other treatises.
verses.hindi: द्विजेश्वरावतारका वर्णन करता हूँ, उसे सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the glory of the ten in:amations of Siva has thus been described. It bestows all desires as explained in the Tantraiastra and other treatises.
verses.science: द्विजेश्वरावतारका वर्णन करता हूँ, उसे सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रत्वमेष्यामि शुचिष्मत्यां महामते । ख्यातो गृहपतिर्नाम्ना शुचिः सर्वामरप्रियः
verses.transliteration: tava putratvameṣyāmi śuciṣmatyāṃ mahāmate | khyāto gṛhapatirnāmnā śuciḥ sarvāmarapriyaḥ
verses.translation: The different Saktis are considered in such activi¬ ties as destroying enemies etc. They punish the wicked and enhance brahminical splendour.
verses.hindi: हे महामते! मैं शुचिष्मतीके गर्भसे आपके पुत्ररूपमें जन्म लूँगा और शुद्धात्मा तथा सभी देवताओंको प्रिय मैं गृहपति नामसे प्रसिद्ध होऊँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: The different Saktis are considered in such activi¬ ties as destroying enemies etc. They punish the wicked and enhance brahminical splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषाष्टकं पुण्यं स्तोत्रमेतत्त्वयेरितम् । अब्दत्रिकालपठनात्कामदं शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: abhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ stotrametattvayeritam | abdatrikālapaṭhanātkāmadaṃ śivasannidhau
verses.translation: O Brahmin, thus I have explained to you the ten incarnations of Siva along with his Sakti, beginning with Mahakala. They are all auspicious.
verses.hindi: परम साध्वी कीर्तिमालिनी उनकी पत्नी हुई
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmin, thus I have explained to you the ten incarnations of Siva along with his Sakti, beginning with Mahakala. They are all auspicious.
verses.science: परम साध्वी कीर्तिमालिनी उनकी पत्नी हुई। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्स्तोत्रप्रपठनं पुत्रपौत्रधनप्रदम् । सर्वशान्तिकरं चापि सर्वापत्तिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etatstotraprapaṭhanaṃ putrapautradhanapradam | sarvaśāntikaraṃ cāpi sarvāpattivināśanam
verses.translation: He who reads this sacred narrative during the festivals of Siva, with great devotion becomes a great favou¬ rite of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads this sacred narrative during the festivals of Siva, with great devotion becomes a great favou¬ rite of Siva.
verses.science: साथ विहार करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गापवर्गसम्पत्तिकारकं नात्र संशयः । सर्वस्तोत्रसमं ह्येतत्सर्वकामप्रदं सदा
verses.transliteration: svargāpavargasampattikārakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | sarvastotrasamaṃ hyetatsarvakāmapradaṃ sadā
verses.translation: The devotees of Siva maintaining their respective duties and listening to this narrative become especially happy and devoted to Siva.
verses.hindi: तात!' चिल्लाते हुए उन दोनोंको देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotees of Siva maintaining their respective duties and listening to this narrative become especially happy and devoted to Siva.
verses.science: तात!' चिल्लाते हुए उन दोनोंको देखा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय सुस्नातो लिङ्गमभ्यर्च्य शाम्भवम् । वर्षं जपन्निदं स्तोत्रमपुत्रः पुत्रवान्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prātarutthāya susnāto liṅgamabhyarcya śāmbhavam | varṣaṃ japannidaṃ stotramaputraḥ putravānbhavet
verses.translation: Listen to the eleven excellent incarnations of liva on hearing which obstacles due to intimate contact with worldly objects etc. do not torment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the eleven excellent incarnations of liva on hearing which obstacles due to intimate contact with worldly objects etc. do not torment.
verses.science: इस प्रकार कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषाष्टकमिदं न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् । गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन महावन्ध्याप्रसूतिकृत्
verses.transliteration: abhilāṣāṣṭakamidaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit | gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mahāvandhyāprasūtikṛt
verses.translation: Formerly Indra and other gods defeated by the Asuras left their capital Amaravati* due to fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly Indra and other gods defeated by the Asuras left their capital Amaravati* due to fear.
verses.science: प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेणापि नियमाल्लिङ्गसन्निधौ । अब्दं जप्तमिदं स्तोत्रं पुत्रदं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: striyā vā puruṣeṇāpi niyamālliṅgasannidhau | abdaṃ japtamidaṃ stotraṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The gods harrassed by the Daityas went to Kayapa. Highly agitated, they bowed down to him with palms joined and shoulders drooping.
verses.hindi: लेकर बड़ी शीघ्रताके साथ वहाँसे भाग गया
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods harrassed by the Daityas went to Kayapa. Highly agitated, they bowed down to him with palms joined and shoulders drooping.
verses.science: लेकर बड़ी शीघ्रताके साथ वहाँसे भाग गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे शम्भुर्बालरूपः सतां गतिः । सोऽपि विश्वानरो विप्रो हृष्टात्मा स्वगृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvāntardadhe śambhurbālarūpaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ | so'pi viśvānaro vipro hṛṣṭātmā svagṛhaṃ yayau
verses.translation: After eulogising well, the gods made tbe submission respectfully. They intimated to him their misery due to that defeat.
verses.hindi: गतिका आश्रय लेकर बारंबार रोने लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising well, the gods made tbe submission respectfully. They intimated to him their misery due to that defeat.
verses.science: गतिका आश्रय लेकर बारंबार रोने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: A long time elapsed, O sage, as he boldly per¬ formed penance with his mind attached to the lotus-like feet of Siva
verses.commentary: Sense: A long time elapsed, O sage, as he boldly per¬ formed penance with his mind attached to the lotus-like feet of Siva
verses.science: जीवित रहनेसे क्या लाभ है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: A long time elapsed, O sage, as he boldly per¬ formed penance with his mind attached to the lotus-like feet of Siva
verses.hindi: वे ऐसा नहीं करते तो मृतकके समान हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: A long time elapsed, O sage, as he boldly per¬ formed penance with his mind attached to the lotus-like feet of Siva
verses.science: वे ऐसा नहीं करते तो मृतकके समान हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । गृहपत्यवतारवर्णनम् २ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । स विप्रो गृहमागत्य महाहर्षसमन्वितः । प्रियायै कथयामास तद्वृत्तान्तमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.14. caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gṛhapatyavatāravarṇanam 2 | nandīśvara uvāca | sa vipro gṛhamāgatya mahāharṣasamanvitaḥ | priyāyai kathayāmāsa tadvṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: In order to grant the boon to that sage whose mind was devoted to his feet, Siva, kinsman of the distressed and goal of the good, appeared in front of him.
verses.hindi: भिखारी होना कहीं अधिक श्रेष्ठ है
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to grant the boon to that sage whose mind was devoted to his feet, Siva, kinsman of the distressed and goal of the good, appeared in front of him.
verses.science: भिखारी होना कहीं अधिक श्रेष्ठ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रपत्नी सा मुदं प्राप शुचिष्मती । अतीव प्रेमसंयुक्ता प्रशशंस विधिं निजम्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā viprapatnī sā mudaṃ prāpa śuciṣmatī | atīva premasaṃyuktā praśaśaṃsa vidhiṃ nijam
verses.translation: These are the eleven Rudras born of Surabh! (I) Kapalin (2) Pingala (3) Bhima (4) Virupaka (5) Vi- lohita (6) Sastj* (7) Ajapad (8) Ahirbudhnya (9) Siva (10) Ganda and (11) Bhava. They were born for the aid to the gods. They are identical with Siva and the cause of happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the eleven Rudras born of Surabh! (I) Kapalin (2) Pingala (3) Bhima (4) Virupaka (5) Vi- lohita (6) Sastj* (7) Ajapad (8) Ahirbudhnya (9) Siva (10) Ganda and (11) Bhava. They were born for the aid to the gods. They are identical with Siva and the cause of happiness.
verses.science: अप्सराएँ नाचने तथा गाने लगीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालेन तद्योषिदन्तर्वत्नी बभूव ह । विधिवद् विहिते तेन गर्भाधानाख्यकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: atha kālena tadyoṣidantarvatnī babhūva ha | vidhivad vihite tena garbhādhānākhyakarmaṇi
verses.translation: He decided in his mind thus—, **let that sole great lord, whoever he is, who is free from aberrations, grant me the boon of a son.**
verses.commentary: Sense: He decided in his mind thus—, **let that sole great lord, whoever he is, who is free from aberrations, grant me the boon of a son.**
verses.science: नामक सत्ताईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुंसवनं तेन स्पन्दनात्प्राग्विपश्चिता । गृह्योक्तविधिना सम्यक् कृतं पुंस्त्वविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: tataḥ puṃsavanaṃ tena spandanātprāgvipaścitā | gṛhyoktavidhinā samyak kṛtaṃ puṃstvavivṛddhaye
verses.translation: The surprised brahmin, the humble son of Brah¬ ma spoke to those deities Brahma, Visnu and Siva, with palms.joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: है, वह हो, मैं घरके बाहर ही रहूँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: The surprised brahmin, the humble son of Brah¬ ma spoke to those deities Brahma, Visnu and Siva, with palms.joined in reverence.
verses.science: है, वह हो, मैं घरके बाहर ही रहूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सीमन्तोऽथाष्टमे मासे गर्भरूपसमृद्धिकृत् । सुखप्रसवसिद्धौ च तेनाकरि क्रियाविदा
verses.transliteration: sīmanto'thāṣṭame māse garbharūpasamṛddhikṛt | sukhaprasavasiddhau ca tenākari kriyāvidā
verses.translation: The king Ambarisa, a scion of the solar dynasty, was tested by him. O great sage, listen to that story.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king Ambarisa, a scion of the solar dynasty, was tested by him. O great sage, listen to that story.
verses.science: रूपसे प्राप्त करोगे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: अथातः शुभतारासु ताराधिपवराननः । केन्द्रे गुरौ शुभे लग्ने सुग्रहेषु युगेषु च
verses.transliteration: athātaḥ śubhatārāsu tārādhipavarānanaḥ | kendre gurau śubhe lagne sugraheṣu yugeṣu ca
verses.translation: The king had the firm resolve that he would per¬ form the rite of breaking fast on the Dvadai day.
verses.hindi: वह लिंग अचलेश--इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The king had the firm resolve that he would per¬ form the rite of breaking fast on the Dvadai day.
verses.science: वह लिंग अचलेश--इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टदीपनिर्वाणः सर्वारिष्टविनाशकृत् । तनयो नाम तस्यां तु शुचिष्मत्यां बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭadīpanirvāṇaḥ sarvāriṣṭavināśakṛt | tanayo nāma tasyāṃ tu śuciṣmatyāṃ babhūva ha
verses.translation: Coming to know of his regular observance the excellent sage Durvasas, born of Siva's part approached him writh many disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coming to know of his regular observance the excellent sage Durvasas, born of Siva's part approached him writh many disciples.
verses.science: विवाह नलके साथ करवाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्वः समस्तसुखदो भूर्भुवःस्वर्न्निवासिनाम् । गन्धवाहनवाहाश्च दिग्वधूर्मुखवाससः
verses.transliteration: śarvaḥ samastasukhado bhūrbhuvaḥsvarnnivāsinām | gandhavāhanavāhāśca digvadhūrmukhavāsasaḥ
verses.translation: Then the sage Durvasas went away for his cere¬ monial ablution, accompanied by his disciples In order to test the king, the sage purposely delayed there.
verses.hindi: अद्भुत तथा निश्चय ही मुक्तिदायक है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sage Durvasas went away for his cere¬ monial ablution, accompanied by his disciples In order to test the king, the sage purposely delayed there.
verses.science: अद्भुत तथा निश्चय ही मुक्तिदायक है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इष्टगन्धप्रसूनौघैर्ववृषुस्ते घनाघनाः । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रसेदुः सर्वतो दिशः
verses.transliteration: iṣṭagandhaprasūnaughairvavṛṣuste ghanāghanāḥ | devadundubhayo neduḥ praseduḥ sarvato diśaḥ
verses.translation: Realising that there would be violation of sacred injunction otherwise, the king took in a small quantity of water and waited for the arrival of the sage.
verses.hindi: इृह् सर्वसु्ं भुकत्वा सो5न्ते शिवपुरं ब्रजेत्॥ ४१  शिवलोकको प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that there would be violation of sacred injunction otherwise, the king took in a small quantity of water and waited for the arrival of the sage.
verses.science: इृह् सर्वसु्ं भुकत्वा सो5न्ते शिवपुरं ब्रजेत्॥ ४१ शिवलोकको प्राप्त करता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परितः सरितः स्वच्छा भूतानां मानसैः सह । तमोऽताम्यत्तु नितरां रजोऽपि विरजोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: paritaḥ saritaḥ svacchā bhūtānāṃ mānasaiḥ saha | tamo'tāmyattu nitarāṃ rajo'pi virajo'bhavat
verses.translation: On seeing lord Siva, the delighted Kayapa bowed to him with palms joined in reverence. Kayapa, the pro¬ genitor of the gods, eulogised him with contentment in his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing lord Siva, the delighted Kayapa bowed to him with palms joined in reverence. Kayapa, the pro¬ genitor of the gods, eulogised him with contentment in his mind.
verses.science: प्रकार विचार करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वाः सत्त्वसमायुक्ताः सुधावृष्टिर्बभूव वै । कल्याणी सर्वथा वाणी प्राणिनः प्रियवत्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: sattvāḥ sattvasamāyuktāḥ sudhāvṛṣṭirbabhūva vai | kalyāṇī sarvathā vāṇī prāṇinaḥ priyavatyabhūt
verses.translation: O lord Siva, lord of the gods, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge in you, you are the lord of all, the great soul, achievable only through meditation, the un¬ equalled and unchanging.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, lord of the gods, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge in you, you are the lord of all, the great soul, achievable only through meditation, the un¬ equalled and unchanging.
verses.science: भयंकर पापका भागी होना पड़ा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रम्भामुख्या अप्सरसो मङ्गलद्रव्यपाणयः । विद्याधर्यश्च किन्नर्यस्तथामर्यः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: rambhāmukhyā apsaraso maṅgaladravyapāṇayaḥ | vidyādharyaśca kinnaryastathāmaryaḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: O lord Siva, you are the restrainer of evil forces. You are the goal of the good, kinsman of the distressed, ocean of mercy and intellectually efficient in protecting your devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, you are the restrainer of evil forces. You are the goal of the good, kinsman of the distressed, ocean of mercy and intellectually efficient in protecting your devotees.
verses.science: सान्त्वना देते हुए कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वोरगयक्षाणां सुमानियः शुभस्वराः । गायन्त्यो मङ्गलं गीतं तत्राजग्मुरनेकशः
verses.transliteration: gandharvoragayakṣāṇāṃ sumāniyaḥ śubhasvarāḥ | gāyantyo maṅgalaṃ gītaṃ tatrājagmuranekaśaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, these gods are your own. They are espe¬ cially devoted to you. Now they are defeated by the Asuras. Save them from distress.
verses.hindi: चाहता हूँ, इसे मुझे दे दीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, these gods are your own. They are espe¬ cially devoted to you. Now they are defeated by the Asuras. Save them from distress.
verses.science: चाहता हूँ, इसे मुझे दे दीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरत्रिः पुलहः पुलस्त्यः क्रतुरङ्गिराः । वसिष्ठः कश्यपोऽगस्त्यो विभाण्डो माण्डवीसुतः
verses.transliteration: marīciratriḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kraturaṅgirāḥ | vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo'gastyo vibhāṇḍo māṇḍavīsutaḥ
verses.translation: Even Visnu cannot move in this matter. He has frequently pressed you for this job. The gods have sought refuge in me intimating their misfortune.
verses.hindi: दान करनेवाला तो कहीं नहीं होता
verses.commentary: Sense: Even Visnu cannot move in this matter. He has frequently pressed you for this job. The gods have sought refuge in me intimating their misfortune.
verses.science: दान करनेवाला तो कहीं नहीं होता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोमशो रोमचरणो भरद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः । भृगुस्तु गालवो गर्गो जातूकर्ण्यः पराशरः
verses.transliteration: lomaśo romacaraṇo bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ | bhṛgustu gālavo gargo jātūkarṇyaḥ parāśaraḥ
verses.translation: O lord of the chiefs of the gods, O destroyer of the miseries of the gods, it is for this that I have performed this penance and resorted to you. My purpose has now been fulfilled by you since you are pleased.
verses.hindi: दूर नहीं किया जा सकता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the chiefs of the gods, O destroyer of the miseries of the gods, it is for this that I have performed this penance and resorted to you. My purpose has now been fulfilled by you since you are pleased.
verses.science: दूर नहीं किया जा सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्बो याज्ञवल्क्यो दक्षवाल्मीकिमुद्गलाः । शातातपश्च लिखितः शिलादः शङ्ख उञ्छभुक्
verses.transliteration: āpastambo yājñavalkyo dakṣavālmīkimudgalāḥ | śātātapaśca likhitaḥ śilādaḥ śaṅkha uñchabhuk
verses.translation: O lord, I have sought refuge in you by all means O lord, please fulfill my desire. Please dispel the misery of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I have sought refuge in you by all means O lord, please fulfill my desire. Please dispel the misery of the gods.
verses.science: नरककी प्राप्ति होगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निश्च संवर्तो मतङ्गो भरतोंऽशुमान् । व्यासः कात्यायनः कुत्सः शौनकः सुश्रुतः शुकः
verses.transliteration: jamadagniśca saṃvarto mataṅgo bharatoṃ'śumān | vyāsaḥ kātyāyanaḥ kutsaḥ śaunakaḥ suśrutaḥ śukaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, I too am much distressed at the misfortune of my sons. O lord, make me happy. You are the source of succour to the heaven-dwellers.
verses.hindi: ऐसा करनेसे मेरी कीर्ति भी बढ़ेगी
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, I too am much distressed at the misfortune of my sons. O lord, make me happy. You are the source of succour to the heaven-dwellers.
verses.science: ऐसा करनेसे मेरी कीर्ति भी बढ़ेगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋष्यशृङ्गोऽथ दुर्वासाः शुचिर्नारदतुम्बुरु । उत्तङ्को वामदेवश्च पवनोऽसितदेवलौ
verses.transliteration: ṛṣyaśṛṅgo'tha durvāsāḥ śucirnāradatumburu | uttaṅko vāmadevaśca pavano'sitadevalau
verses.translation: O lord l§iva, do help the gods always lest the harassment by the Asuras should afflict them.
verses.hindi: साथ अपनी पत्नीका दान कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord l§iva, do help the gods always lest the harassment by the Asuras should afflict them.
verses.science: साथ अपनी पत्नीका दान कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सालङ्कायनहारीतौ विश्वामित्रोऽथ भार्गवः । मृकण्डः सह पुत्रेण पर्वतो दारुकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sālaṅkāyanahārītau viśvāmitro'tha bhārgavaḥ | mṛkaṇḍaḥ saha putreṇa parvato dārukastathā
verses.translation: On being thus requested, lord, 6iva said "So be it'* and even as he was watching he vanished' there.
verses.hindi: गिरनेको उद्यत हुए उन राजाकों रोक दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus requested, lord, 6iva said "So be it'* and even as he was watching he vanished' there.
verses.science: गिरनेको उद्यत हुए उन राजाकों रोक दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धौम्योपमन्युवत्साद्या मुनयो मुनिकन्यकाः । तच्छान्त्यर्थं समाजग्मुर्धन्यं विश्वानराश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: dhaumyopamanyuvatsādyā munayo munikanyakāḥ | tacchāntyarthaṃ samājagmurdhanyaṃ viśvānarāśramam
verses.translation: Those Rudras, born of Kayapa, rendering help to the gods, slew the Daityas in the battle. They were heroes of great strength and exploit.
verses.hindi: अन्य मुनिगण भी स्तुति करते हुए वहाँ आ पहुँचे
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Rudras, born of Kayapa, rendering help to the gods, slew the Daityas in the battle. They were heroes of great strength and exploit.
verses.science: अन्य मुनिगण भी स्तुति करते हुए वहाँ आ पहुँचे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा बृहस्पतियुतो देवो गरुडवाहनः । नन्दिभृङ्गिसमायुक्तो गौर्या सह वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: brahmā bṛhaspatiyuto devo garuḍavāhanaḥ | nandibhṛṅgisamāyukto gauryā saha vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: By the grace of those Rudras, the gods conquered the Asuras and were rid of fear. Indra and other gods had peace of mind and ruled over their own kingdom.
verses.hindi: गद्गद वाणीसे शिवजीकी स्तुति करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: By the grace of those Rudras, the gods conquered the Asuras and were rid of fear. Indra and other gods had peace of mind and ruled over their own kingdom.
verses.science: गद्गद वाणीसे शिवजीकी स्तुति करने लगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रमुख्या गीर्वाणा नागाः पातालवासिनः । रत्नान्यादाय बहुशः ससरित्का महाब्धयः
verses.transliteration: mahendramukhyā gīrvāṇā nāgāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ | ratnānyādāya bahuśaḥ sasaritkā mahābdhayaḥ
verses.translation: Those Rudras favourably disposed towards their devotees took up their residence in the north-eastern city of Isana. Experts in different kinds of sports they sport about there always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Rudras favourably disposed towards their devotees took up their residence in the north-eastern city of Isana. Experts in different kinds of sports they sport about there always.
verses.science: सबको सदा अपना पार्श्ववर्ती बनायें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरा जङ्गमं रूपं धृत्वायाताः सहस्रशः । महामहोत्सवे तस्मिन् बभूवाकालकौमुदी
verses.transliteration: sthāvarā jaṅgamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvāyātāḥ sahasraśaḥ | mahāmahotsave tasmin babhūvākālakaumudī
verses.translation: The Rudras glorified as their followers and retainers are crores in number. They are stationed everywhere in the three worlds, undividedly.
verses.hindi: आपके समीप निवासकी याचना करती हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rudras glorified as their followers and retainers are crores in number. They are stationed everywhere in the three worlds, undividedly.
verses.science: आपके समीप निवासकी याचना करती हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्म स्वयं तस्य कृतवान्विधिरानतः । श्रुतिं विचार्य तद्रूपं नाम्ना गृहपतिस्त्वयम्
verses.transliteration: jātakarma svayaṃ tasya kṛtavānvidhirānataḥ | śrutiṃ vicārya tadrūpaṃ nāmnā gṛhapatistvayam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the eleven Rudra incarnations of Siva, pleasing to all the worlds have been described to you.
verses.hindi: इच्छित वर देकर क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus the eleven Rudra incarnations of Siva, pleasing to all the worlds have been described to you.
verses.science: इच्छित वर देकर क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति नाम ददौ तस्मै देयमेकादशेऽहनि । नामकर्मविधानेन तदर्थं श्रुतिमुच्चरन्
verses.transliteration: iti nāma dadau tasmai deyamekādaśe'hani | nāmakarmavidhānena tadarthaṃ śrutimuccaran
verses.translation: He who listens to or reads this with pious heart enjoys all pleasures here and attains liberation hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to or reads this with pious heart enjoys all pleasures here and attains liberation hereafter.
verses.science: पूजनकर शिवपदको प्राप्त हुए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्निगममन्त्रोक्तैराशीर्भिरभिनन्द्य च । समयाद्धं समारुह्य सर्वेषां च पितामहः
verses.transliteration: caturnigamamantroktairāśīrbhirabhinandya ca | samayāddhaṃ samāruhya sarveṣāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The names of eleven Rudras differ in different Pur&as. Born of Surabhi from Kaiypa, residing in the North eastern regions, these were directed to protect the gods against the Asuras. The Pur&nas speak of Rudras emanated from these and stationed in the three worlds for carrying out the task of protecting the good against the wicked.
verses.hindi: राजा भद्रायुको परम सुख प्राप्त हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The names of eleven Rudras differ in different Pur&as. Born of Surabhi from Kaiypa, residing in the North eastern regions, these were directed to protect the gods against the Asuras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The names of eleven Rudras differ in different Pur&as. Born of Surabhi from Kaiypa, residing in the North eastern regions, these were directed to protect the gods against the Asuras.…
verses.science: राजा भद्रायुको परम सुख प्राप्त हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा बालोचितां रक्षां लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रितः । आरुह्य यानं स्वं धाम हरोऽपि हरिणा ययौ
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā bālocitāṃ rakṣāṃ laukikīṃ gatimāśritaḥ | āruhya yānaṃ svaṃ dhāma haro'pi hariṇā yayau
verses.translation: O great sage, now listen lovingly to another story of 8iva, how Siva was born as Durvasas for the maintenance of virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, now listen lovingly to another story of 8iva, how Siva was born as Durvasas for the maintenance of virtue.
verses.science: सुननेवाला शिवपदको प्राप्त होता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो रूपमहो तेजस्त्वहो सर्वाङ्गलक्षणम् । अहो शुचिष्मतीभाग्यमाविरासीत्स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: aho rūpamaho tejastvaho sarvāṅgalakṣaṇam | aho śuciṣmatībhāgyamāvirāsītsvayaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: At the direction of Brahma he went to the moun¬ tain Rksakula accompanied by his wife in order to per¬ form penance there, with the desire to get son.
verses.hindi: है और परलोकमें उत्तम गति प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: At the direction of Brahma he went to the moun¬ tain Rksakula accompanied by his wife in order to per¬ form penance there, with the desire to get son.
verses.science: है और परलोकमें उत्तम गति प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवा किमिदं चित्रं शर्वभक्तजनेष्वहो । स्वयमाविरभूद् रुद्रो यतो रुद्रस्तदर्चितः
verses.transliteration: athavā kimidaṃ citraṃ śarvabhaktajaneṣvaho | svayamāvirabhūd rudro yato rudrastadarcitaḥ
verses.translation: On the banks of the river Nirvindhya,*® the sage who had controlled his breath and had freed himself from mutually clashing emotions performed a great penance for a hundred years.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां द्विजेशाख्य-शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तर्विशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: On the banks of the river Nirvindhya,*® the sage who had controlled his breath and had freed himself from mutually clashing emotions performed a great penance for a hundred years.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां द्विजेशाख्य-शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तर्विशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुवन्तस्तेऽन्योऽन्यं सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः । विश्वानरं समापृच्छ्य जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: iti stuvantaste'nyo'nyaṃ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ | viśvānaraṃ samāpṛcchya jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam
verses.translation: A long time elapsed while he performed the holy penance. A holy flame of fire came out of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: A long time elapsed while he performed the holy penance. A holy flame of fire came out of him.
verses.science: अवतारका वर्णन करूँगा, आप सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः पुत्रं समीहन्ते गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनः । पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: ataḥ putraṃ samīhante gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ | putreṇa lokāñjayati śrutireṣā sanātanī
verses.translation: O great sage, the worlds were almost burnt by that flame. Indra and other gods and the celestial sages too were afflicted by it.
verses.hindi: पूजा करते थे। वे दोनों महाशिवभक्त थे
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, the worlds were almost burnt by that flame. Indra and other gods and the celestial sages too were afflicted by it.
verses.science: पूजा करते थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रस्य गृहं शून्यमपुत्रस्यार्जनं वृथा । अपुत्रस्य तपश्छिन्नं नो पवित्रत्यपुत्रतः
verses.transliteration: aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyamaputrasyārjanaṃ vṛthā | aputrasya tapaśchinnaṃ no pavitratyaputrataḥ
verses.translation: Then, highly distressed by that flame, O sage, Indra and other gods and the sages hastened to the abode of Bra¬ hma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, highly distressed by that flame, O sage, Indra and other gods and the sages hastened to the abode of Bra¬ hma.
verses.science: व्यवस्थाहेतु बहुत दूर चला गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न पुत्रात्परमो लाभो न पुत्रात्परमं सुखम् । न पुत्रात्परमं मित्रं परत्रेह च कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: na putrātparamo lābho na putrātparamaṃ sukham | na putrātparamaṃ mitraṃ paratreha ca kutracit
verses.translation: After bowing to and eulogising Brahma the gods mentioned to him their grief. O dear, Brahma immediately went to Vi9nu*s region along with the god.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to and eulogising Brahma the gods mentioned to him their grief. O dear, Brahma immediately went to Vi9nu*s region along with the god.
verses.science: यतीश्वरकी पूजा की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रमोऽथ चतुर्थेऽस्य मासि पित्रा कृतो गृहात् । अन्नप्राशनमब्दार्द्धे चूडाब्दे चार्थवत्कृता
verses.transliteration: niṣkramo'tha caturthe'sya māsi pitrā kṛto gṛhāt | annaprāśanamabdārddhe cūḍābde cārthavatkṛtā
verses.translation: O sage, after reaching there along with the gods Brahma bowed to and eulogised Viu and mentioned his endless grief to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after reaching there along with the gods Brahma bowed to and eulogised Viu and mentioned his endless grief to him.
verses.science: प्रेमपूर्वक्त दीनवचन कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्णवेधं ततः कृत्वा श्रवणर्क्षे स कर्मवित् । ब्रह्मतेजोभिवृद्ध्यर्थं पञ्चमेऽब्दे व्रतं ददौ
verses.transliteration: karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śravaṇarkṣe sa karmavit | brahmatejobhivṛddhyarthaṃ pañcame'bde vrataṃ dadau
verses.translation: Vifou too, accompanied by Brahma and the gods hastened to Rudra's abode. After reaching it he bowed to and eulogised lord iSiva.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद उस कर्मवित्ताने श्रवणनक्षत्रमें कर्णवेध करके उसके ब्रह्मतेजकी अभिवृद्धिके लिये पाँच वर्षकी अवस्थामें यज्ञोपतवीत-संस्कार किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Vifou too, accompanied by Brahma and the gods hastened to Rudra's abode. After reaching it he bowed to and eulogised lord iSiva.

verses.sanskrit: उपाकर्म ततः कृत्वा वेदानध्यापयत्सुधीः । त्र्यब्दं वेदान्स विधिनाध्यैष्ट साङ्गपदक्रमान्
verses.transliteration: upākarma tataḥ kṛtvā vedānadhyāpayatsudhīḥ | tryabdaṃ vedānsa vidhinādhyaiṣṭa sāṅgapadakramān
verses.translation: After eulogising him Vifnu mentioned to Siva his grief caused by the flame due to the penance of Atri.
verses.hindi: फिर यहाँ आपका निवास किस प्रकार सम्भव है 2
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising him Vifnu mentioned to Siva his grief caused by the flame due to the penance of Atri.
verses.science: फिर यहाँ आपका निवास किस प्रकार सम्भव है 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्याजातं समस्तं च साक्षिमात्रं गुरोर्मुखात् । विनयादिगुणानाविष्कुर्वञ्जग्राह शक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: vidyājātaṃ samastaṃ ca sākṣimātraṃ gurormukhāt | vinayādiguṇānāviṣkurvañjagrāha śaktimān
verses.translation: O sage, thus gathering there, together, Brahma, Viiu and Siva consulted one another about the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: प्रतिभाशाली उस बालकने गुरु पिताके मुखसे समस्त विद्याएँ अपने विनय आदि गुणोंको प्रकाशित करते हुए मात्र साक्षिभावसे ग्रहण कर लिया
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, thus gathering there, together, Brahma, Viiu and Siva consulted one another about the welfare of the worlds.
verses.science: मत कीजिये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽथ नवमे वर्षे पित्रोः शुश्रूषणे रतम् । वैश्वानरं गृहपतिं द्रष्टुमायाच्च नारदः
verses.transliteration: tato'tha navame varṣe pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratam | vaiśvānaraṃ gṛhapatiṃ draṣṭumāyācca nāradaḥ
verses.translation: The three deities Brahma and others, foremost among the bestowers of boons, went to the hermitage of Atri immediately to grant him the boon.
verses.hindi: तदुपरान्त नौवें वर्षमें माता-पिताकी सेवामें निरत गृहपति तथा उसके पिता विश्वानरको देखनेके लिये नारदजी [वहाँ] आये
verses.commentary: Sense: The three deities Brahma and others, foremost among the bestowers of boons, went to the hermitage of Atri immediately to grant him the boon.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानरोटजं प्राप्य देवर्षिस्तं तु कौतुकी । अपृच्छत्कुशलं तत्र गृहीतार्घासनः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: viśvānaroṭajaṃ prāpya devarṣistaṃ tu kautukī | apṛcchatkuśalaṃ tatra gṛhītārghāsanaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: On seeing them marked by their respective charac¬ teristic signs, the excellent sage Atri bowed to and eulogised them respectfully by uttering pleasing words.
verses.hindi: जगह गमन भी अपने अधर्मका कारण होगा
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them marked by their respective charac¬ teristic signs, the excellent sage Atri bowed to and eulogised them respectfully by uttering pleasing words.
verses.science: जगह गमन भी अपने अधर्मका कारण होगा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वं च तद्भाग्यं पुत्रधर्मं च सम्मुखे । विश्वानरं समवदत्स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarvaṃ ca tadbhāgyaṃ putradharmaṃ ca sammukhe | viśvānaraṃ samavadatsmṛtvā śivapadāmbujam
verses.translation: O Brahma, O Vinu, O Siva, you are worthy of being worshipped by the three worlds. You are lords and masters and the cause of creation, maintenance and annihi¬ lation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahma, O Vinu, O Siva, you are worthy of being worshipped by the three worlds. You are lords and masters and the cause of creation, maintenance and annihi¬ lation.
verses.science: घरसे बाहर स्थित हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो मुनिना बालः पित्रोराज्ञामवाप्य सः । प्रणम्य नारदं श्रीमान् भक्त्या प्रह्व उपाविशत
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityukto muninā bālaḥ pitrorājñāmavāpya saḥ | praṇamya nāradaṃ śrīmān bhaktyā prahva upāviśata
verses.translation: Accompanied by my wife, I meditated only on a single lord for obtaining a son, that lord whoever he may be, who is famous as Ivara.
verses.hindi: नन्दीएवर बोले--[ हे सनत्कुमार ! तदुपरान्त ] मुनि नारदजीके द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जानेपर वह शोभासम्पन्न बालक माता-पिताकी आज्ञा प्राप्तकर भक्तिपूर्वक उनको नग्रतासे प्रणमकर बैठ गया
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by my wife, I meditated only on a single lord for obtaining a son, that lord whoever he may be, who is famous as Ivara.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । वैश्वानर समभ्येहि ममोत्सङ्गे निषीद भोः । लक्षणानि परीक्षेऽहं पाणिं दर्शय दक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | vaiśvānara samabhyehi mamotsaṅge niṣīda bhoḥ | lakṣaṇāni parīkṣe'haṃ pāṇiṃ darśaya dakṣiṇam
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the three deities replied "O great sage, what has occurred is in accordance with what you have conceived.
verses.hindi: उस वनेचर भीलको देखकर बड़ा दुखी हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the three deities replied "O great sage, what has occurred is in accordance with what you have conceived.
verses.science: उस वनेचर भीलको देखकर बड़ा दुखी हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वं हि तालुजिह्वादि नारदः । विश्वानरं समवदच्छिवप्रेरणया सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tato dṛṣṭvā tu sarvaṃ hi tālujihvādi nāradaḥ | viśvānaraṃ samavadacchivapreraṇayā sudhīḥ
verses.translation: We three are great lords and equally leading among the granters of boons. Hence three sons originating from our parts will be born to you.
verses.hindi: कृतकृत्य हो गये। जो इस प्रकार इनकी मृत्यु हुई
verses.commentary: Sense: We three are great lords and equally leading among the granters of boons. Hence three sons originating from our parts will be born to you.
verses.science: कृतकृत्य हो गये। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । विश्वानर मुने वच्मि शृणु पुत्राङ्कमादरात् । सर्वाङ्गस्वङ्कवान्पुत्रो महालक्षणवानयम्
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | viśvānara mune vacmi śṛṇu putrāṅkamādarāt | sarvāṅgasvaṅkavānputro mahālakṣaṇavānayam
verses.translation: They will be known in the world as enhancers of
verses.hindi: कराइये; क्योंकि यही स्त्रियोंका सनातनधर्म है
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be known in the world as enhancers of
verses.science: कराइये; क्योंकि यही स्त्रियोंका सनातनधर्म है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु सर्वगुणोपेतं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् । सम्पूर्णनिर्मलकलं पालयेद्विधुवद्विधिः
verses.transliteration: kintu sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam | sampūrṇanirmalakalaṃ pālayedvidhuvadvidhiḥ
verses.translation: After securing the boon, the sage joyously returned to his hermitage accompanied by Anasuya. O sage, he was delighted and he experienced the bliss of the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing the boon, the sage joyously returned to his hermitage accompanied by Anasuya. O sage, he was delighted and he experienced the bliss of the supreme Brahman.
verses.science: प्रविष्ट होनेके लिये उद्यत हुई। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन रक्षणीयस्त्वसौ शिशुः । गुणोऽपि दोषतां याति वक्रीभूते विधातरि
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena rakṣaṇīyastvasau śiśuḥ | guṇo'pi doṣatāṃ yāti vakrībhūte vidhātari
verses.translation: Then Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the delighted ex¬ ponents of different kinds of sports, took their incarnations as the sons of his wife.
verses.hindi: करते हुए शिवजी उस भीलनी से कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the delighted ex¬ ponents of different kinds of sports, took their incarnations as the sons of his wife.
verses.science: करते हुए शिवजी उस भीलनी से कहने लगे--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्केऽस्य द्वादशे वर्षे प्रत्यूहो विद्युदग्नितः । इत्युक्त्वा नारदोऽगच्छद्देवलोकं यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅke'sya dvādaśe varṣe pratyūho vidyudagnitaḥ | ityuktvā nārado'gacchaddevalokaṃ yathāgatam
verses.translation: Siva by becoming Durvasas, the enhancer of Brah- minical splendour, tested the piety of many people. He was merciful.
verses.hindi: उसको कुछ भी स्मरण नहीं रहा
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva by becoming Durvasas, the enhancer of Brah- minical splendour, tested the piety of many people. He was merciful.
verses.science: उसको कुछ भी स्मरण नहीं रहा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: () base king, after inviting but without feeding me you ha''e taken in water. I shall show you the fruit thereof, her I am the chastiser of the wicked.
verses.commentary: Sense: () base king, after inviting but without feeding me you ha''e taken in water. I shall show you the fruit thereof, her I am the chastiser of the wicked.
verses.science: शिवावतारचरितवर्णन॑ नामाष्यविंशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: () base king, after inviting but without feeding me you ha''e taken in water. I shall show you the fruit thereof, her I am the chastiser of the wicked.
verses.commentary: Sense: () base king, after inviting but without feeding me you ha''e taken in water. I shall show you the fruit thereof, her I am the chastiser of the wicked.
verses.science: नामक अट्ठाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । गृहपत्यवतारवर्णनम् ३ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । विश्वानरः सपत्नीकः तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदेरितम् । तदेवं मन्यमानोऽभूद्वज्रपातं सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.15. pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | gṛhapatyavatāravarṇanam 3 | nandīśvara uvāca | viśvānaraḥ sapatnīkaḥ tacchrutvā nāraderitam | tadevaṃ manyamāno'bhūdvajrapātaṃ sudāruṇam
verses.translation: In the meantime an unembodied celestial voice spoke to Amljarisa, the noble soul, the devotee of Brahma and Visi i
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime an unembodied celestial voice spoke to Amljarisa, the noble soul, the devotee of Brahma and Visi i
verses.science: उत्तम शिवावतारका श्रवण कीजिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हा हतोऽस्मीति वचसा हृदयं समताडयत् । मूर्च्छामवाप महतीं पुत्रशोकसमाकुलः
verses.transliteration: hā hato'smīti vacasā hṛdayaṃ samatāḍayat | mūrcchāmavāpa mahatīṃ putraśokasamākulaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Kfna slew the wicked, the great sinners, those who harassed the brahmins and the knaves. He pro* tected all good men and brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Kfna slew the wicked, the great sinners, those who harassed the brahmins and the knaves. He pro* tected all good men and brahmins.
verses.science: कृष्णदर्शन पुरुषसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुचिष्मत्यपि दुःखार्ता रुरोदातीव दुस्सहम् । अतिस्वरेण हारावैरत्यन्तं व्याकुलेन्द्रिया
verses.transliteration: śuciṣmatyapi duḥkhārtā rurodātīva dussaham | atisvareṇa hārāvairatyantaṃ vyākulendriyā
verses.translation: Out of love. Lord Siva rendered great help to Rama. O brahmin, listen to the whole of that story which is pleasing to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of love. Lord Siva rendered great help to Rama. O brahmin, listen to the whole of that story which is pleasing to all.
verses.science: ब्राह्मणोंके सहित सद्गति प्राप्त करोगे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वार्तनादमिति विश्वनरोऽपि मोहं हित्वोत्थितः किमिति किं त्विति किं किमेतत् । उच्चैर्वदन् गृहपतिः क्व स मे बहिस्थः प्राणोऽन्तरात्मनिलयस्सकलेन्द्रियेशः
verses.transliteration: śrutvārtanādamiti viśvanaro'pi mohaṃ hitvotthitaḥ kimiti kiṃ tviti kiṃ kimetat | uccairvadan gṛhapatiḥ kva sa me bahisthaḥ prāṇo'ntarātmanilayassakalendriyeśaḥ
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Rama, O dear, the intel¬ ligent and leading monkey Hanumat went out in search of
verses.hindi: प्रभु शिवने कुछ भी उत्तर नहीं दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the behest of Rama, O dear, the intel¬ ligent and leading monkey Hanumat went out in search of
verses.science: प्रभु शिवने कुछ भी उत्तर नहीं दिया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो दृष्ट्वा स पितरौ बहुशोकसमावृतौ । स्मित्वोवाच गृहपतिः सबालः शङ्करांशजः
verses.transliteration: tato dṛṣṭvā sa pitarau bahuśokasamāvṛtau | smitvovāca gṛhapatiḥ sabālaḥ śaṅkarāṃśajaḥ
verses.translation: At his behest, the powerful hero, gathered many mountains through the hosts of monkeys and built a bridge in the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his behest, the powerful hero, gathered many mountains through the hosts of monkeys and built a bridge in the ocean.
verses.science: लेकर लवणसमुद्रमें फेंक दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहपतिरुवाच । हे मातस्तात किं जातं कारणं तद्वदाधुना । किमर्थं रुदितोऽत्यर्थं त्रासस्तादृक् कुतो हि वाम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhapatiruvāca | he mātastāta kiṃ jātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadvadādhunā | kimarthaṃ rudito'tyarthaṃ trāsastādṛk kuto hi vām
verses.translation: O great sage, once the supreme god Siva and the great goddess Parvati became desirous of indulging in sports.
verses.hindi: सर्वरक्षक वे महेश्वर दयाद्र हो उठे
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, once the supreme god Siva and the great goddess Parvati became desirous of indulging in sports.
verses.science: सर्वरक्षक वे महेश्वर दयाद्र हो उठे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न मां कृतवपुस्त्राणं भवच्चरणरेणुभिः । कालः कलयितुं शक्तो वराकी चञ्चलाल्पिका
verses.transliteration: na māṃ kṛtavapustrāṇaṃ bhavaccaraṇareṇubhiḥ | kālaḥ kalayituṃ śakto varākī cañcalālpikā
verses.translation: He who listens to and narrates this story with devotion and purity of mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to and narrates this story with devotion and purity of mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.
verses.science: कल्याणको प्राप्त करेगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिज्ञां शृणुतां तातौ यदि वां तनयो ह्यहम् । करिष्येऽहं तथा येन मृत्युस्त्रस्तो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: pratijñāṃ śṛṇutāṃ tātau yadi vāṃ tanayo hyaham | kariṣye'haṃ tathā yena mṛtyustrasto bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O great sage, O intelligent son of Brahml, listen to the excellent Vreia incarnation of l§iva that perfonned pood sports and that destroyed the {*rrogance of Vi?9u.
verses.hindi: करनेके लिये आपने ही मुझे यहाँ भेजा है
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, O intelligent son of Brahml, listen to the excellent Vreia incarnation of l§iva that perfonned pood sports and that destroyed the {*rrogance of Vi?9u.
verses.science: करनेके लिये आपने ही मुझे यहाँ भेजा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युञ्जयं समाराध्य सर्वज्ञं सर्वदं सताम् । जपिष्यामि महाकालं सत्यं तातौ वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtyuñjayaṃ samārādhya sarvajñaṃ sarvadaṃ satām | japiṣyāmi mahākālaṃ satyaṃ tātau vadāmyaham
verses.translation: Formerly all the gods and Asuras, distressed by the fear of old age and death made alliance with each other and became desirous of taking gems from the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly all the gods and Asuras, distressed by the fear of old age and death made alliance with each other and became desirous of taking gems from the ocean.
verses.science: ब्राह्मणीसे भिक्षुरूपधारी शिवने कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य जारितौ द्विजदम्पती । अकालामृतवर्षौघैर्गततापौ तदोचतुः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasya jāritau dvijadampatī | akālāmṛtavarṣaughairgatatāpau tadocatuḥ
verses.translation: O king, this discus had been given to Visnu by Si\a. It is low blazing against Durvasas. Quieten it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, this discus had been given to Visnu by Si\a. It is low blazing against Durvasas. Quieten it.
verses.science: उत्तम राज्यका भोग करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
