verses.sanskrit: द्विजदम्पती ऊचतुः । पुनर्ब्रूहि पुनर्ब्रूहि कीदृक् कीदृक् पुनर्वद । कालः कलयितुं नालं वराकी चञ्चलास्ति का
verses.transliteration: dvijadampatī ūcatuḥ | punarbrūhi punarbrūhi kīdṛk kīdṛk punarvada | kālaḥ kalayituṃ nālaṃ varākī cañcalāsti kā
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying thus, the celestial voice stopped. Ambarisa too eulogised the sage who was the part of iva himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, after saying thus, the celestial voice stopped. Ambarisa too eulogised the sage who was the part of iva himself.
verses.science: इच्छासे नभगने उनसे स्नेहपूर्वक कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आवयोस्तापनाशाय महोपायस्त्वयेरितः । मृत्युञ्जयाख्यदेवस्य समाराधनलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: āvayostāpanāśāya mahopāyastvayeritaḥ | mṛtyuñjayākhyadevasya samārādhanalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: If I possess the merit of charity and sacrifice, if my spiritual duty has been well performed by me, and if our family considers brahmins godly, let the weapon of Vi$nu turn calni.
verses.hindi: उन्हींको ग्रहण करो, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: If I possess the merit of charity and sacrifice, if my spiritual duty has been well performed by me, and if our family considers brahmins godly, let the weapon of Vi$nu turn calni.
verses.science: उन्हींको ग्रहण करो, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वच्च शरणं शम्भोर्नातः परतरं हि तत् । मनोरथपथातीतकारिणः पापहारिणः
verses.transliteration: tadvacca śaraṇaṃ śambhornātaḥ parataraṃ hi tat | manorathapathātītakāriṇaḥ pāpahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: If our lord, favourably disposed to his devotees, is delighted with my devotion let this missile SudarSana become quite calm.
verses.hindi: भाइयोंने मुझे छोड़कर सारा राज्य बाँट लिया
verses.commentary: Sense: If our lord, favourably disposed to his devotees, is delighted with my devotion let this missile SudarSana become quite calm.
verses.science: भाइयोंने मुझे छोड़कर सारा राज्य बाँट लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किं न श्रुतं त्वया तात श्वेतकेतुं यथा पुरा । पाशितं कालपाशेन ररक्ष त्रिपुरान्तकः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā tāta śvetaketuṃ yathā purā | pāśitaṃ kālapāśena rarakṣa tripurāntakaḥ
verses.translation: While be eulogised in front of Durvasas, the discus Sudarana that originally belonged to Siva became calm in all respects. Knowing him to be biva's part, the king Ambaiisa, who had regained the composure of mind bowed to the sage whom he realised as Siva's incarnation come there to test his vow.
verses.wordMeaning: While be eulogised in front of Durvasas, the discus Sudarana that originally belonged to Siva became calm in all respects. Knowing him to be biva's part, the king Ambaiisa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: While be eulogised in front of Durvasas, the discus Sudarana that originally belonged to Siva became calm in all respects. Knowing him to be biva's part, the king Ambaiisa,…
verses.science: पुत्रको धीरज बँधाते हुए कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिलादतनयं मृत्युग्रस्तमष्टाब्दमात्रकम् । शिवो निजजनं चक्रे नन्दिनं विश्वनन्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: śilādatanayaṃ mṛtyugrastamaṣṭābdamātrakam | śivo nijajanaṃ cakre nandinaṃ viśvanandinam
verses.translation: O sage, I;have narrated the story of Durvasas in the course of his test of Ambarlia. O great sage, listen to another story of his.
verses.hindi: ठीक उपाय बताता हूँ, तुम श्रवण करो
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, I;have narrated the story of Durvasas in the course of his test of Ambarlia. O great sage, listen to another story of his.
verses.science: ठीक उपाय बताता हूँ, तुम श्रवण करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदमथनोद्भूतं प्रलयानलसन्निभम् । पीत्वा हालाहलं घोरमरक्षद्भुवनत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodamathanodbhūtaṃ pralayānalasannibham | pītvā hālāhalaṃ ghoramarakṣadbhuvanatrayam
verses.translation: O sage, through the condition stipulated by Kala in the form of a sage he conducted the test of Rama, son of Daaratha.
verses.hindi: बतलाओ, जिससे वह यज्ञ शुद्ध हो सके
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, through the condition stipulated by Kala in the form of a sage he conducted the test of Rama, son of Daaratha.
verses.science: बतलाओ, जिससे वह यज्ञ शुद्ध हो सके। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरं महादर्पं हृतत्रैलोक्यसम्पदम् । रुचिराङ्गुष्ठरेखोत्थचक्रेण निजघान यः
verses.transliteration: jalandharaṃ mahādarpaṃ hṛtatrailokyasampadam | rucirāṅguṣṭharekhotthacakreṇa nijaghāna yaḥ
verses.translation: The story has been diversely narrated and spread in the world by the sages. It is known by all means to the scholars. Hence it is not mentioned in detail by me.
verses.hindi: बचा हुआ धन तुम्हें दे देंगे
verses.commentary: Sense: The story has been diversely narrated and spread in the world by the sages. It is known by all means to the scholars. Hence it is not mentioned in detail by me.
verses.science: बचा हुआ धन तुम्हें दे देंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य एकेषुनिपातोत्थज्वलनैस्त्रिपुरम्पुरा । त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यसम्मूढं शोषयामास भानुना
verses.transliteration: ya ekeṣunipātotthajvalanaistripurampurā | trailokyaiśvaryasammūḍhaṃ śoṣayāmāsa bhānunā
verses.translation: Knowing his promise steady and resolute, the sage was highly delighted. The delighted sage Durvasas granted him the desired boons.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान देनेके लिये वे प्रकट हुए थे
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing his promise steady and resolute, the sage was highly delighted. The delighted sage Durvasas granted him the desired boons.
verses.science: ज्ञान देनेके लिये वे प्रकट हुए थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कामं दृष्टिनिपातेन त्रैलोक्यविजयोर्जितम् । निनायानङ्गपदवीं वीक्ष्यमाणेष्वजादिषु
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ dṛṣṭinipātena trailokyavijayorjitam | nināyānaṅgapadavīṃ vīkṣyamāṇeṣvajādiṣu
verses.translation: He had tested the resoluteness of lord Krfna too. O excellent sage, listen to that also. I shall tell you that story also.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had tested the resoluteness of lord Krfna too. O excellent sage, listen to that also. I shall tell you that story also.
verses.science: लिये उनसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं ब्रह्माद्यैककर्तारं मेघवाहनमच्युतम् । प्रयाहि पुत्र शरणं विश्वरक्षामणिं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ brahmādyaikakartāraṃ meghavāhanamacyutam | prayāhi putra śaraṇaṃ viśvarakṣāmaṇiṃ śivam
verses.translation: Krna, son of Vasudcva, showed great devotion to Brahmins. Everyday he fed many br ahmin s with many juicy articles.
verses.hindi: तब आप इसे लेनेसे मुझे क्यों मना करते हैं 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Krna, son of Vasudcva, showed great devotion to Brahmins. Everyday he fed many br ahmin s with many juicy articles.
verses.science: तब आप इसे लेनेसे मुझे क्यों मना करते हैं 2। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । पित्रोरनुज्ञां प्राप्येति प्रणम्य चरणौ तयोः । प्रादक्षिण्यमुपावृत्य बह्वाश्वास्य विनिर्ययौ
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | pitroranujñāṃ prāpyeti praṇamya caraṇau tayoḥ | prādakṣiṇyamupāvṛtya bahvāśvāsya viniryayau
verses.translation: He tied Kfna and his consort Rukmini to the chariot and sat hiinself in the chariot. Kfna bore the chariot delightfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: He tied Kfna and his consort Rukmini to the chariot and sat hiinself in the chariot. Kfna bore the chariot delightfully.
verses.science: स्थितिको समझकर उससे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्य काशीं दुष्प्रापां ब्रह्मनारायणादिभिः । महासंवर्त्तसन्तापहन्त्रीं विश्वेशपालिताम्
verses.transliteration: samprāpya kāśīṃ duṣprāpāṃ brahmanārāyaṇādibhiḥ | mahāsaṃvarttasantāpahantrīṃ viśveśapālitām
verses.translation: As the piece of cloth reached him being carried by the current, the sage covered his private parts with it. He was therefore pleased with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the piece of cloth reached him being carried by the current, the sage covered his private parts with it. He was therefore pleased with her.
verses.science: इच्छाके परे है ही क्या!। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्धुन्या हारयष्ट्येव राजितां कण्ठभूमिषु । विचित्रगुणशालिन्या हरपत्न्या विराजिताम्
verses.transliteration: svardhunyā hārayaṣṭyeva rājitāṃ kaṇṭhabhūmiṣu | vicitraguṇaśālinyā harapatnyā virājitām
verses.translation: He granted her the boon of ever increasing folds of cloth. Later, Draupadi made the Pa 9 <jlavas happy due to that boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He granted her the boon of ever increasing folds of cloth. Later, Draupadi made the Pa 9 <jlavas happy due to that boon.
verses.science: होकर विनयपूर्वक कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र प्राप्य स विप्रेशः प्राग्ययौ मणिकर्णिकाम् । तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन दृष्ट्वा विश्वेश्वरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tatra prāpya sa vipreśaḥ prāgyayau maṇikarṇikām | tatra snātvā vidhānena dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ prabhum
verses.translation: That holy sage gave directive to Vi?nu and des¬ troyed two wicked kings who had insulted him in the form of two young ones of swans.
verses.hindi: विषयमें कहना ही क्या--ऐसा मेरे पिताने कहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: That holy sage gave directive to Vi?nu and des¬ troyed two wicked kings who had insulted him in the form of two young ones of swans.
verses.science: विषयमें कहना ही क्या--ऐसा मेरे पिताने कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साञ्जलिर्नतशीर्षोऽसौ महानन्दान्वितः सुधीः । त्रैलोक्यप्राणसन्त्राणकारिणं प्रणनाम ह
verses.transliteration: sāñjalirnataśīrṣo'sau mahānandānvitaḥ sudhīḥ | trailokyaprāṇasantrāṇakāriṇaṃ praṇanāma ha
verses.translation: By his excellent brahminical splendour he estab¬ lished the path of renunciation in the world in accordance with the order and injunctions of the sacred lore.
verses.commentary: Sense: By his excellent brahminical splendour he estab¬ lished the path of renunciation in the world in accordance with the order and injunctions of the sacred lore.
verses.science: झुकाकर आपको प्रसन्‍न करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्यालोक्य तल्लिङ्गं तुतोष हृदये मुहुः । परमानन्दकन्दाढ्यं स्फुटमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ālokyālokya talliṅgaṃ tutoṣa hṛdaye muhuḥ | paramānandakandāḍhyaṃ sphuṭametanna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: By instructions and enlightenment he uplifted many. By imparting knowledge he made many liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: By instructions and enlightenment he uplifted many. By imparting knowledge he made many liberated.
verses.science: स्तुति करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो न मत्तो धन्योऽस्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । यदद्राक्षिषमद्याहं श्रीमद्विश्वेश्वरं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: aho na matto dhanyo'sti trailokye sacarācare | yadadrākṣiṣamadyāhaṃ śrīmadviśveśvaraṃ vibhum
verses.translation: Thus the sage Durvasas had a variegated and
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sage Durvasas had a variegated and
verses.science: प्रेमपूर्वक हँसते हुए नभगसे कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मम भाग्योदयायैव नारदेन महर्षिणा । पुरागत्य तथोक्तं यत्कृतकृत्योऽस्म्यहं ततः
verses.transliteration: mama bhāgyodayāyaiva nāradena maharṣiṇā | purāgatya tathoktaṃ yatkṛtakṛtyo'smyahaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: He who hears or reads the story of Durvasas with devotion and joy will be happy here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who hears or reads the story of Durvasas with devotion and joy will be happy here and hereafter.
verses.science: सनातन ब्रह्मका उपदेश करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्यानन्दामृतरसैर्विधाय स हि पारणम् । ततः शुभेऽह्नि संस्थाप्य लिङ्गं सर्वहितप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityānandāmṛtarasairvidhāya sa hi pāraṇam | tataḥ śubhe'hni saṃsthāpya liṅgaṃ sarvahitapradam
verses.translation: O sage, henceforth listen lovingly to the story of Hanumat, how!§iva performed excellent sports in that form.
verses.hindi: यज्ञशेष सामग्रीको तुम मेरी कृपासे ग्रहण करो
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, henceforth listen lovingly to the story of Hanumat, how!§iva performed excellent sports in that form.
verses.science: यज्ञशेष सामग्रीको तुम मेरी कृपासे ग्रहण करो। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: जग्राह नियमान्घोरान् दुष्करानकृतात्मभिः । अष्टोत्तरशतैः कुम्भैः पूर्णैर्गङ्गाऽम्भसा शुभैः
verses.transliteration: jagrāha niyamānghorān duṣkarānakṛtātmabhiḥ | aṣṭottaraśataiḥ kumbhaiḥ pūrṇairgaṅgā'mbhasā śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Once lord Siva of wonderful sports saw Visnu in the form of an enchantress with glittering qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once lord Siva of wonderful sports saw Visnu in the form of an enchantress with glittering qualities.
verses.science: वहींपर अन्तर्धान हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संस्नाप्य वाससा पूतैः पूतात्मा प्रत्यहं शिवम् । नीलोत्पलमयीं मालां समर्पयति सोऽन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsnāpya vāsasā pūtaiḥ pūtātmā pratyahaṃ śivam | nīlotpalamayīṃ mālāṃ samarpayati so'nvaham
verses.translation: As if hit by the arrows of Cupid, Siva let fall his semen dislodged from its seat, for Rama's work.
verses.commentary: Sense: As if hit by the arrows of Cupid, Siva let fall his semen dislodged from its seat, for Rama's work.
verses.science: अपने-अपने धामको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाधिकसहस्रैस्तु सुमनोभिर्विनिर्मिताम् । स पक्षे वाथ वा मासे कन्दमूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭādhikasahasraistu sumanobhirvinirmitām | sa pakṣe vātha vā māse kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Eagerly urged by him mentally for Rama's work, the seven celestial sages retained that semen in a leaf.
verses.hindi: कविर्भवति मन्त्रज्ञो गतिमन्ते लभेत्पराम्॥ ५९  जाता है और अन्तमें परमगति प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Eagerly urged by him mentally for Rama's work, the seven celestial sages retained that semen in a leaf.
verses.science: कविर्भवति मन्त्रज्ञो गतिमन्ते लभेत्पराम्॥ ५९ जाता है और अन्तमें परमगति प्राप्त करता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शीर्णपर्णाशनैर्धीरः षण्मासं सम्बभूव सः । षण्मासं वायुभक्षोऽभूत्षण्मासं जलबिन्दुभुक्
verses.transliteration: śīrṇaparṇāśanairdhīraḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ sambabhūva saḥ | ṣaṇmāsaṃ vāyubhakṣo'bhūtṣaṇmāsaṃ jalabindubhuk
verses.translation: At the request of the gods he left it. Knowing him to be an incarnation of Siva of great power the gods and the sages granted him boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the request of the gods he left it. Knowing him to be an incarnation of Siva of great power the gods and the sages granted him boons.
verses.science: क़ष्णदर्शनशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नामेकोनत्रिंशो3 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्षद्वयं तस्य व्यतिक्रान्तं महात्मनः । शिवैकमनसो विप्रास्तप्यमानस्य नारद
verses.transliteration: evaṃ varṣadvayaṃ tasya vyatikrāntaṃ mahātmanaḥ | śivaikamanaso viprāstapyamānasya nārada
verses.translation: Highly delighted he approached his mother and eagerly told her everything in detail.
verses.hindi: कृष्णदर्शन जिवावतारवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly delighted he approached his mother and eagerly told her everything in detail.
verses.science: कृष्णदर्शन जिवावतारवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: जन्मतो द्वादशे वर्षे तद्वचो नारदेरितम् । सत्यं करिष्यन्निव तमभ्यगात्कुलिशायुधः
verses.transliteration: janmato dvādaśe varṣe tadvaco nāraderitam | satyaṃ kariṣyanniva tamabhyagātkuliśāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: At her behest the bold monkey went to the sun
verses.hindi: जो इन्द्रके घमण्डको नष्ट करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: At her behest the bold monkey went to the sun
verses.science: जो इन्द्रके घमण्डको नष्ट करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च वरं ब्रूहि दद्मि त्वन्मनसि स्थितम् । अहं शतक्रतुर्विप्र प्रसन्नोऽस्मि शुभव्रतैः
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca varaṃ brūhi dadmi tvanmanasi sthitam | ahaṃ śatakraturvipra prasanno'smi śubhavrataiḥ
verses.translation: The excellent monkey, a part of Siva approached Sugriva, a part of the sun, at his behest, after getting the permission of his mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent monkey, a part of Siva approached Sugriva, a part of the sun, at his behest, after getting the permission of his mother.
verses.science: आकारवाले एक भयंकर पुरुषको देखा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य महेन्द्रस्य वाक्यं मुनिकुमारकः । उवाच मधुरं धीरः कीर्तयन्मधुराक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya mahendrasya vākyaṃ munikumārakaḥ | uvāca madhuraṃ dhīraḥ kīrtayanmadhurākṣaram
verses.translation: Sugriva who had been exiled by his elder brother Bali who enjoyed his (Sugriva's) wife, stayed on the mountain Rsyamuka® along with Hanumat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sugriva who had been exiled by his elder brother Bali who enjoyed his (Sugriva's) wife, stayed on the mountain Rsyamuka® along with Hanumat.
verses.science: ने जानकर उससे पूछा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहपतिरुवाच । मघवन् वृत्रशत्रो त्वां जाने कुलिशपाणिनम् । नाहं वृणे वरं त्वत्तः शङ्करो वरदोऽस्ति मे
verses.transliteration: gṛhapatiruvāca | maghavan vṛtraśatro tvāṃ jāne kuliśapāṇinam | nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvattaḥ śaṅkaro varado'sti me
verses.translation: The intelligent monkey born of a part of Siva became Sugriva's minister and did everything beneficial to him in every respect.
verses.hindi: क्या नाम है ? तुम मुझे ठीक-ठीक शीघ्र बताओ
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent monkey born of a part of Siva became Sugriva's minister and did everything beneficial to him in every respect.
verses.science: क्या नाम है ? तुम मुझे ठीक-ठीक शीघ्र बताओ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच । न मत्तः शङ्करस्त्वन्यो देवदेवोऽस्म्यहं शिशो । विहाय बालिशत्वं त्वं वरं याचस्व मा चिरम्
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca | na mattaḥ śaṅkarastvanyo devadevo'smyahaṃ śiśo | vihāya bāliśatvaṃ tvaṃ varaṃ yācasva mā ciram
verses.translation: He made him enter into a pleasing alliance with Rama who came there along with his brother and who was sad because his wife had been abducted by Ravana.
verses.hindi: साथ लेकर उनके दर्शनहेतु जा रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: He made him enter into a pleasing alliance with Rama who came there along with his brother and who was sad because his wife had been abducted by Ravana.
verses.science: साथ लेकर उनके दर्शनहेतु जा रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहपतिरुवाच । गच्छाहल्यापतेऽसाधो गोत्रारे पाकशासन । न प्रार्थये पशुपतेरन्यं देवान्तरं स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhapatiruvāca | gacchāhalyāpate'sādho gotrāre pākaśāsana | na prārthaye paśupateranyaṃ devāntaraṃ sphuṭam
verses.translation: There he performed wonderful exploits and handed over the excellent token of recognition of his lord Rama to Sita.
verses.commentary: Sense: There he performed wonderful exploits and handed over the excellent token of recognition of his lord Rama to Sita.
verses.science: इच्छासे कुछ नहीं बोले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । उद्यम्य कुलिशं घोरं भीषयामास बालकम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | udyamya kuliśaṃ ghoraṃ bhīṣayāmāsa bālakam
verses.translation: Narrating the endeavours of Rama for the pro¬ tection of her life, the heroic leader of monkeys dispelled the
verses.commentary: Sense: Narrating the endeavours of Rama for the pro¬ tection of her life, the heroic leader of monkeys dispelled the
verses.science: धमकाते हुए कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा बालको वज्रं विद्युज्ज्वालासमाकुलम् । स्मरन्नारदवाक्यं च मुमूर्च्छ भयविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā bālako vajraṃ vidyujjvālāsamākulam | smarannāradavākyaṃ ca mumūrccha bhayavihvalaḥ
verses.translation: Taking a token from her he turned back to go towards Rama. On the way he broke Ravaija's park and killed many Rak?asas.
verses.hindi: देखकर शीघ्र ही उनका स्तम्भन कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking a token from her he turned back to go towards Rama. On the way he broke Ravaija's park and killed many Rak?asas.
verses.science: देखकर शीघ्र ही उनका स्तम्भन कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ गौरीपतिः शम्भुराविरासीत्तमोनुदः । उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते स्पर्शैः सञ्जीवयन्निव
verses.transliteration: atha gaurīpatiḥ śambhurāvirāsīttamonudaḥ | uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te sparśaiḥ sañjīvayanniva
verses.translation: At the same time he killed Ravana s son also along with many Rakfasas. That fearless monkey of great exploits wrought a havoc there.
verses.hindi: जलाते हुए शीघ्र ही प्रज्बलित हो उठे
verses.commentary: Sense: At the same time he killed Ravana s son also along with many Rakfasas. That fearless monkey of great exploits wrought a havoc there.
verses.science: जलाते हुए शीघ्र ही प्रज्बलित हो उठे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: उन्मील्य नेत्रकमले सुप्ते इव दिनक्षये । अपश्यदग्रे चोत्थाय शम्भुमर्कशताधिकम्
verses.transliteration: unmīlya netrakamale supte iva dinakṣaye | apaśyadagre cotthāya śambhumarkaśatādhikam
verses.translation: R?yamukagiri, associated with the life of RSma, is placed in the
verses.commentary: Sense: R?yamukagiri, associated with the life of RSma, is placed in the
verses.science: शीघ्रतासे उन्हें प्रणाम किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भाले लोचनमालोक्य कण्ठेकालं वृषध्वजम् । वामाङ्गसन्निविष्टाद्रितनयं चन्द्रशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: bhāle locanamālokya kaṇṭhekālaṃ vṛṣadhvajam | vāmāṅgasanniviṣṭādritanayaṃ candraśekharam
verses.translation: The identification of LahkS b controversial. Acco present context. Laftka, the capital
verses.hindi: कीजिये; क्रोध नहीं, बल्कि प्रेम कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: The identification of LahkS b controversial. Acco present context. Laftka, the capital
verses.science: कीजिये; क्रोध नहीं, बल्कि प्रेम कीजिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कपर्देन विराजन्तं त्रिशूलाजगवायुधम् । स्फुरत्कर्पूरगौराङ्गं परिणद्धगजाजिनम्
verses.transliteration: kapardena virājantaṃ triśūlājagavāyudham | sphuratkarpūragaurāṅgaṃ pariṇaddhagajājinam
verses.translation: O sage, when the powerful Ravana bound him with oil-dripping cloths and set fire to them, the mon¬ key, a part of l$iva himself, jumped about and marking that a pretext burnt the city of Lanka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, when the powerful Ravana bound him with oil-dripping cloths and set fire to them, the mon¬ key, a part of l$iva himself, jumped about and marking that a pretext burnt the city of Lanka.
verses.science: जलानेके लिये आ रही है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिज्ञाय महादेवं गुरुवाक्यत आगमात् । हर्षबाष्पाकुलासन्नकण्ठरोमाञ्चकञ्चुकः
verses.transliteration: parijñāya mahādevaṃ guruvākyata āgamāt | harṣabāṣpākulāsannakaṇṭharomāñcakañcukaḥ
verses.translation: After burning Lanka except the mansion of Bi- bhiana, the heroic leader of monkeys jumped into the ocean.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले उन प्रभुने हँसते हुए कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning Lanka except the mansion of Bi- bhiana, the heroic leader of monkeys jumped into the ocean.
verses.science: करनेवाले उन प्रभुने हँसते हुए कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं च गिरिवत्तस्थौ चित्रकृत्रिमपुत्रकः । यथा तथा सुसम्पन्नो विस्मृत्यात्मानमेव च
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇaṃ ca girivattasthau citrakṛtrimaputrakaḥ | yathā tathā susampanno vismṛtyātmānameva ca
verses.translation: Thereby extinguishing the 6re from his tail he reached the other shore. Not at all tired or grieved the monkey born of a part of Siva approached Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby extinguishing the 6re from his tail he reached the other shore. Not at all tired or grieved the monkey born of a part of Siva approached Rama.
verses.science: भक्तवत्सल नामको सार्थक कौजिये। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: न स्तोतुं न नमस्कर्तुं किञ्चिद्विज्ञप्तुमेव च । यदा स न शशाकालं तदा स्मित्वाह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: na stotuṃ na namaskartuṃ kiñcidvijñaptumeva ca | yadā sa na śaśākālaṃ tadā smitvāha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The rapid and excellent monkey Hanumat reached Rama's side without delay and handed over the crest-jewel of Sita.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rapid and excellent monkey Hanumat reached Rama's side without delay and handed over the crest-jewel of Sita.
verses.science: देवगुरुसे कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । शिशो गृहपते शक्राद्वज्रोद्यतकरादहो । ज्ञातं भीतोऽसि मा भैषीर्जिज्ञासा ते मया कृता
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | śiśo gṛhapate śakrādvajrodyatakarādaho | jñātaṃ bhīto'si mā bhaiṣīrjijñāsā te mayā kṛtā
verses.translation: Securing his boon of victory, he crossed the ocean, surrounded Lanka with the monkeyL and fought against the Rakasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing his boon of victory, he crossed the ocean, surrounded Lanka with the monkeyL and fought against the Rakasas.
verses.science: प्रसन्‍नतापूर्वक अपने स्थानको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मम भक्तस्य नो शक्रो न वज्रं चान्तकोऽपि च । प्रभवेदिन्द्ररूपेण मयैव त्वं बिभीषितः
verses.transliteration: mama bhaktasya no śakro na vajraṃ cāntako'pi ca | prabhavedindrarūpeṇa mayaiva tvaṃ bibhīṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The heroic Hanumat slew many Asuras and pro tected Rama's army. He enlivened Laksmana by the medici¬ nal herb Sahjlvani when he was wounded by Meghanada's javelin.
verses.hindi: नामक अवतारका वर्णन आपसे कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Hanumat slew many Asuras and pro tected Rama's army. He enlivened Laksmana by the medici¬ nal herb Sahjlvani when he was wounded by Meghanada's javelin.
verses.science: नामक अवतारका वर्णन आपसे कर दिया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: वरं ददामि ते भद्र त्वमग्निपदभाग्भव । सर्वेषामेव देवानां वरदस्त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: varaṃ dadāmi te bhadra tvamagnipadabhāgbhava | sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ varadastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: The lordly son of Siva made Rama and Lak$mana happy in every respect. He protected the entire army.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lordly son of Siva made Rama and Lak$mana happy in every respect. He protected the entire army.
verses.science: अवधूतेश्वरशिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम त्रिंशोठ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां त्वमग्नेऽन्तश्चरो भव । धर्मराजेन्द्रयोर्मध्ये दिगीशो राज्यमाप्नुहि
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tvamagne'ntaścaro bhava | dharmarājendrayormadhye digīśo rājyamāpnuhi
verses.translation: The untiring monkey destroyed Ravana, his family and his followers. The monkey, the storehouse of great strength made the gods happy.
verses.hindi: अवधूतेश्वरशिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The untiring monkey destroyed Ravana, his family and his followers. The monkey, the storehouse of great strength made the gods happy.
verses.science: अवधूतेश्वरशिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वयेदं स्थापितं लिङ्गं तव नाम्ना भविष्यति । अग्नीश्वर इति ख्यातं सर्वतेजोविबृंहणम्
verses.transliteration: tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati | agnīśvara iti khyātaṃ sarvatejovibṛṃhaṇam
verses.translation: He slew the demon Mahiravana and brought Raina and Laksmana Brom his place to their own after guar¬ ding them well.
verses.hindi: प्रेम करनेवाला सत्यरथ नामक एक राजा था
verses.commentary: Sense: He slew the demon Mahiravana and brought Raina and Laksmana Brom his place to their own after guar¬ ding them well.
verses.science: प्रेम करनेवाला सत्यरथ नामक एक राजा था। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीश्वरस्य भक्तानां न भयं विद्युदग्निभिः । अग्निमान्द्यभयं नैव नाकालमरणं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: agnīśvarasya bhaktānāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyudagnibhiḥ | agnimāndyabhayaṃ naiva nākālamaraṇaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: The leading monkey quickly carried out the tasks of Rama by all means, made the Asuras bow down and submit and performed various sports.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रिय वीरोंके साथ उस राजाका घोर युद्ध हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading monkey quickly carried out the tasks of Rama by all means, made the Asuras bow down and submit and performed various sports.
verses.science: क्षत्रिय वीरोंके साथ उस राजाका घोर युद्ध हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीश्वरं समभ्यर्च्य काश्यां सर्वसमृद्धिदम् । अन्यत्रापि मृतो दैवाद्वह्निलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: agnīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kāśyāṃ sarvasamṛddhidam | anyatrāpi mṛto daivādvahniloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Himself a leader of devotees, he made Sita and Rama happy. He, the lord of monkeys, established the cult of devotion to Rama in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Himself a leader of devotees, he made Sita and Rama happy. He, the lord of monkeys, established the cult of devotion to Rama in the world.
verses.science: होकर मन्त्रियोंके साथ भाग गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वानीय तद्बन्धून्पित्रोश्च परिपश्यतोः । दिक्पतित्वेऽभिषिच्याग्निं तत्र लिङ्गे शिवोऽविशत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvānīya tadbandhūnpitrośca paripaśyatoḥ | dikpatitve'bhiṣicyāgniṃ tatra liṅge śivo'viśat
verses.translation: Thus O dear, the excellent story of Hanumat has been narrated to you. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It yields the fruits of all desires.
verses.hindi: समय वहाँपर एक स्वच्छ सरोवरको देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus O dear, the excellent story of Hanumat has been narrated to you. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It yields the fruits of all desires.
verses.science: समय वहाँपर एक स्वच्छ सरोवरको देखा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमग्न्यवतारस्ते वर्णितो मे जनार्दनः । नाम्ना गृहपतिस्तात शङ्करस्य परात्मनः
verses.transliteration: itthamagnyavatāraste varṇito me janārdanaḥ | nāmnā gṛhapatistāta śaṅkarasya parātmanaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to this or narrates this with devotion and purity of mind enjoys all desires here and attains liberation hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this or narrates this with devotion and purity of mind enjoys all desires here and attains liberation hereafter.
verses.science: दिव्य पुत्रको जन्म दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चित्रहोत्रपुरी रम्या सुखदार्चिष्मती वरा । जातवेदसि ये भक्ता ते तत्र निवसन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: citrahotrapurī ramyā sukhadārciṣmatī varā | jātavedasi ye bhaktā te tatra nivasanti vai
verses.translation: O sage, O son of the self-born Brahma, listen to the great incarnation of lord l§iva, which yields all desires to the hearer.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, O son of the self-born Brahma, listen to the great incarnation of lord l§iva, which yields all desires to the hearer.
verses.science: सरोवरके किनारे रोने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशं ये कुर्युर्दृढसत्त्वा जितेन्द्रियाः । स्त्रियो वा सत्त्वसम्पन्नास्ते सर्वेऽप्यग्नितेजसः
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśaṃ ye kuryurdṛḍhasattvā jitendriyāḥ | striyo vā sattvasampannāste sarve'pyagnitejasaḥ
verses.translation: Keeping Bhairava as the watch-man they went in¬ side. Acting like human beings they were lovingly served by many attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Keeping Bhairava as the watch-man they went in¬ side. Acting like human beings they were lovingly served by many attendants.
verses.science: बहुत विचार करने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्ररता विप्राः स्थापिता ब्रह्मचारिणः । पश्चाग्निवर्त्तिनोऽप्येवमग्निलोकेऽग्निवर्चसः
verses.transliteration: agnihotraratā viprāḥ sthāpitā brahmacāriṇaḥ | paścāgnivarttino'pyevamagniloke'gnivarcasaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, indulging in different sports of their choice for a long time, the lordly deities were highly delighted.
verses.hindi: है, अहो, हैवबल बड़ा प्रबल है ।
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, indulging in different sports of their choice for a long time, the lordly deities were highly delighted.
verses.science: है, अहो, हैवबल बड़ा प्रबल है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: शीते शीतापनुत्त्यै यस्त्वेधोभारान्प्रयच्छति । कुर्यादग्नीष्टिकां वाथ स वसेदग्निसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: śīte śītāpanuttyai yastvedhobhārānprayacchati | kuryādagnīṣṭikāṃ vātha sa vasedagnisannidhau
verses.translation: The independent goddess Parvati sportively assumed the form of a mad woman and with the permission of her lord came near to the door in that form itself.
verses.hindi: पूछूँ। मुझे तो इसपर बहुत ही दया आ रही है
verses.commentary: Sense: The independent goddess Parvati sportively assumed the form of a mad woman and with the permission of her lord came near to the door in that form itself.
verses.science: पूछूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनाथस्याग्निसंस्कारं यः कुर्याच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः । अशक्तः प्रेरयेदन्यं सोऽग्निलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: anāthasyāgnisaṃskāraṃ yaḥ kuryācchraddhayānvitaḥ | aśaktaḥ prerayedanyaṃ so'gniloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Fascinated by her charming form Bhairava glanced at her as at a woman and prevented her from going out.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fascinated by her charming form Bhairava glanced at her as at a woman and prevented her from going out.
verses.science: भक्तवत्सल शिवजीने बड़ी दया की। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरेको द्विजातीनां निःश्रेयसकरः परः । गुरुर्देवो व्रतं तीर्थं सर्वमग्निर्विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: agnireko dvijātīnāṃ niḥśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ | gururdevo vrataṃ tīrthaṃ sarvamagnirviniścitam
verses.translation: O sage, viewed at very closely by Bhairava, the goddess Parvati became furious and cursed him.
verses.hindi: उस समय भिक्षुकका रूप धारण कर लिया
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, viewed at very closely by Bhairava, the goddess Parvati became furious and cursed him.
verses.science: उस समय भिक्षुकका रूप धारण कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपावनानि सर्वाणि वह्निसंसर्गतः क्षणात् । पावनानि भवन्त्येव तस्माद्यः पावकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: apāvanāni sarvāṇi vahnisaṃsargataḥ kṣaṇāt | pāvanāni bhavantyeva tasmādyaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O base man, since you glanced at me as at a woman, O Bhairava, be born as a human being on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O base man, since you glanced at me as at a woman, O Bhairava, be born as a human being on the earth.
verses.science: सन्देहग्रस्त ब्राह्मणी विद्यमान थी। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरात्मा ह्ययं साक्षान्निश्चयो ह्याशुशुक्षणिः । मांसग्रासान्पचेत्कुक्षौ स्त्रीणां नो मांसपेशिकाम्
verses.transliteration: antarātmā hyayaṃ sākṣānniścayo hyāśuśukṣaṇiḥ | māṃsagrāsānpacetkukṣau strīṇāṃ no māṃsapeśikām
verses.translation: O great sage, hastening to that place, Siva con¬ soled Bhairava. Indeed, the lord is very expert in the various forms of consolation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, hastening to that place, Siva con¬ soled Bhairava. Indeed, the lord is very expert in the various forms of consolation.
verses.science: महातेजस्वी शिशुका पालन-पोषण करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तैजसी शाम्भवी मूर्तिः प्रत्यक्षा दहनात्मिका । कर्त्री हर्त्री पालयित्री विनैतां किं विलोक्यते
verses.transliteration: taijasī śāmbhavī mūrtiḥ pratyakṣā dahanātmikā | kartrī hartrī pālayitrī vinaitāṃ kiṃ vilokyate
verses.translation: Due to her curse, and as a result of Siva's will, O sage, Bhairava descended to the earth in human birth under the name of Vaitala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to her curse, and as a result of Siva's will, O sage, Bhairava descended to the earth in human birth under the name of Vaitala.
verses.science: प्रेमके साथ आदरपूर्वक उनसे पूछा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चित्रभानुरयं साक्षान्नेत्रं त्रिभुवनेशितुः । अन्धे तमोमये लोके विनैनं कः प्रकाशनः
verses.transliteration: citrabhānurayaṃ sākṣānnetraṃ tribhuvaneśituḥ | andhe tamomaye loke vinainaṃ kaḥ prakāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Urged by his friendship lord Siva also incarnated on the earth along with Siva. He indulged in good sports and followed worldly conventions.
verses.hindi: और यहाँ आये हुए आप कौन हैं 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by his friendship lord Siva also incarnated on the earth along with Siva. He indulged in good sports and followed worldly conventions.
verses.science: और यहाँ आये हुए आप कौन हैं 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धूपप्रदीपनैवेद्यपयोदधिघृतैक्षवम् । एतद्भुक्तं निषेवन्ते सर्वे दिवि दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: dhūpapradīpanaivedyapayodadhighṛtaikṣavam | etadbhuktaṃ niṣevante sarve divi divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, thus the story of Mahesa has been narrated to you. It is excellent, conducive to wealth, fame and longevity and yields all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus the story of Mahesa has been narrated to you. It is excellent, conducive to wealth, fame and longevity and yields all desires.
verses.science: शिशु पूर्वजन्ममें आपका भक्त था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "With what shall the churning be carried out lor the attainment of our object?" thus the gods and the Asuras were quite dismayed.
verses.hindi: कह रहा हूँ। है अनघे ! तुम प्रेमपूर्वक इसे सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: "With what shall the churning be carried out lor the attainment of our object?" thus the gods and the Asuras were quite dismayed.
verses.science: कह रहा हूँ। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: "With what shall the churning be carried out lor the attainment of our object?" thus the gods and the Asuras were quite dismayed.
verses.hindi: उसकी माताकी मृत्युके विषयमें उससे कहा
verses.commentary: Sense: "With what shall the churning be carried out lor the attainment of our object?" thus the gods and the Asuras were quite dismayed.
verses.science: उसकी माताकी मृत्युके विषयमें उससे कहा। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । यक्षेश्वरावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । यक्षेश्वरावतारं च शृणु शम्भोर्मुनीश्वर । गर्विणं गर्वहन्तारं सतां भक्तिविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.16. ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | yakṣeśvarāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | yakṣeśvarāvatāraṃ ca śṛṇu śambhormunīśvara | garviṇaṃ garvahantāraṃ satāṃ bhaktivivarddhanam
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice with the rumbling sound of clouds spoke to the gods and the daityas as a result of diva's wish and consoled them.
verses.hindi: जन्मसे अनाथ एवं बन्धुरहित हो गया है 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a celestial voice with the rumbling sound of clouds spoke to the gods and the daityas as a result of diva's wish and consoled them.
verses.science: जन्मसे अनाथ एवं बन्धुरहित हो गया है 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवाश्च दैत्याश्च पीयूषार्थं महाबलाः । क्षीरोदधिं ममन्थुस्ते सुकृतस्वार्थसन्धयः
verses.transliteration: purā devāśca daityāśca pīyūṣārthaṃ mahābalāḥ | kṣīrodadhiṃ mamanthuste sukṛtasvārthasandhayaḥ
verses.translation: There also emerged—Dhanvantari the m.oon> the Parijata tree, the horse Uccairavas, the elephant AirS- vata, wine, the bow of Visnu, the conch, the cow Kamadhenu, the jewel Kaustubha and the nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: There also emerged—Dhanvantari the m.oon> the Parijata tree, the horse Uccairavas, the elephant AirS- vata, wine, the bow of Visnu, the conch, the cow Kamadhenu, the jewel Kaustubha and the nectar.
verses.science: सारे ऐश्वर्यसे रहित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मथ्यमानेऽमृते पूर्वं क्षीराब्धेः सुरदानवैः । अग्नेः समुत्थितं तस्माद्विषं कालानलप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: mathyamāne'mṛte pūrvaṃ kṣīrābdheḥ suradānavaiḥ | agneḥ samutthitaṃ tasmādviṣaṃ kālānalaprabham
verses.translation: Indra and other gods, O dear, overwhelmed by 2§iva*s illusion and harassed by the Daityas sought refuge in Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra and other gods, O dear, overwhelmed by 2§iva*s illusion and harassed by the Daityas sought refuge in Siva.
verses.science: सम्पूर्ण मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा निखिला देवा दैत्याश्च भयविह्वलाः । विद्रुत्य तरसा तात शम्भोस्ते शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nikhilā devā daityāśca bhayavihvalāḥ | vidrutya tarasā tāta śambhoste śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: The Daityas were deluded by the gods and Vi|nu the great soul. Those that survived entered the nethjbr regions.
verses.hindi: उनसे क्षीरका समुद्र प्राप्त कर लूँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: The Daityas were deluded by the gods and Vi|nu the great soul. Those that survived entered the nethjbr regions.
verses.science: उनसे क्षीरका समुद्र प्राप्त कर लूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं शङ्करं सर्वे सर्वदेवशिखामणिम् । प्रणम्य तुष्टुवुर्भक्त्या साच्युता नतमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ śaṅkaraṃ sarve sarvadevaśikhāmaṇim | praṇamya tuṣṭuvurbhaktyā sācyutā natamastakāḥ
verses.translation: Vinu begot of them sons of great exploits and valour, experts in various kinds of warfare, shaking 'file entire earth.
verses.hindi: सारा चराचर लोक प्रज्वलित हो उठा
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinu begot of them sons of great exploits and valour, experts in various kinds of warfare, shaking 'file entire earth.
verses.science: सारा चराचर लोक प्रज्वलित हो उठा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । पपौ विषं महाघोरं सुरासुरगणार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ | papau viṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ surāsuragaṇārdanam
verses.translation: Those sons ofViu of great strength and valour wrought great havoc both in heaven and earth causing misery to all.
verses.hindi: सारा अभीष्ट प्रदान करूँगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sons ofViu of great strength and valour wrought great havoc both in heaven and earth causing misery to all.
verses.science: सारा अभीष्ट प्रदान करूँगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पतिं तं विषमं कण्ठे निदधे विषमुल्बणम् । रेजे तेनाति स विभुर्नीलकण्ठो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: patiṃ taṃ viṣamaṃ kaṇṭhe nidadhe viṣamulbaṇam | reje tenāti sa vibhurnīlakaṇṭho babhūva ha
verses.translation: On seeing the great harm done to the worlds the gods and the sages approached Brahma and informed him of this after bowing to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the great harm done to the worlds the gods and the sages approached Brahma and informed him of this after bowing to him.
verses.science: मुझ इन्द्रको नहीं पहचानते हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरासुरगणा ममन्थुः पुनरेव तम् । विषदाहविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवानुग्रहतोऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ surāsuragaṇā mamanthuḥ punareva tam | viṣadāhavinirmuktāḥ śivānugrahato'khilāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it Brahma took them to the mountain Kailasa. On seeing Siva there he bowed to him again and again along with the gods.
verses.hindi: कल्याण करूँगा। तुम गुणरहित शिवको छोड़ो
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it Brahma took them to the mountain Kailasa. On seeing Siva there he bowed to him again and again along with the gods.
verses.science: कल्याण करूँगा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहूनि रत्नानि निस्सृतानि ततो मुने । अमृतं च पदार्थं हि सुरदानवयोर्मुने
verses.transliteration: tato bahūni ratnāni nissṛtāni tato mune | amṛtaṃ ca padārthaṃ hi suradānavayormune
verses.translation: Saying *'0 lord Siva, be victorious, O Lord of all**, he eulogised him with various hymns with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down.
verses.hindi: भी ईश्वर उन रुद्रको नहीं जानते
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying *'0 lord Siva, be victorious, O Lord of all**, he eulogised him with various hymns with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down.
verses.science: भी ईश्वर उन रुद्रको नहीं जानते। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं पपुः केवलं देवा नासुराः कृपया हरेः । ततो बभूव सुमहद्रत्नं तेषां मिथोऽकदम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ papuḥ kevalaṃ devā nāsurāḥ kṛpayā hareḥ | tato babhūva sumahadratnaṃ teṣāṃ mitho'kadam
verses.translation: O gods, O Asuras, churn the milk*ocean. Undoubted¬ ly a factual test of your strength will take place.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, O Asuras, churn the milk*ocean. Undoubted¬ ly a factual test of your strength will take place.
verses.science: सुखी होंगे, यह बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वन्द्वयुद्धं बभूवाथ देवदानवयोर्मुने । तत्र राहुभयाच्चन्द्रो विदुद्राव तदर्दितः
verses.transliteration: dvandvayuddhaṃ babhūvātha devadānavayormune | tatra rāhubhayāccandro vidudrāva tadarditaḥ
verses.translation: Make Mandara your churning rod and Vasuki your churning rope. Unitedly you carry on the churning with firm devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Make Mandara your churning rod and Vasuki your churning rope. Unitedly you carry on the churning with firm devotion.
verses.science: हँसते हुए उससे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जगाम सदनं शम्भोः शरण भयविह्वलः । सुप्रणम्य च तुष्टाव पाहि पाहीति संवदन्
verses.transliteration: jagāma sadanaṃ śambhoḥ śaraṇa bhayavihvalaḥ | supraṇamya ca tuṣṭāva pāhi pāhīti saṃvadan
verses.translation: O excellent sage, on hearing the celestial voice the gods and the Asuras exerted themselves in carrying out the plan.
verses.hindi: होकर इस उत्तम चरित्रका श्रवण करो
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, on hearing the celestial voice the gods and the Asuras exerted themselves in carrying out the plan.
verses.science: होकर इस उत्तम चरित्रका श्रवण करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सतामभयदः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । दध्रे शिरसि चन्द्रं स विभुः शरणमागतम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ satāmabhayadaḥ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ | dadhre śirasi candraṃ sa vibhuḥ śaraṇamāgatam
verses.translation: Allying together they went straight to the excellent mountain Mandara of golden splendour and of diverse lustre.
verses.hindi: वह पूर्वजन्ममें पाण्ड्य देशका श्रेष्ठ राजा था
verses.commentary: Sense: Allying together they went straight to the excellent mountain Mandara of golden splendour and of diverse lustre.
verses.science: वह पूर्वजन्ममें पाण्ड्य देशका श्रेष्ठ राजा था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथागतस्तदा राहुस्तुष्टाव सुप्रणम्य तम् । शङ्करं सकलाधीशं वाग्भिरिष्टाभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: athāgatastadā rāhustuṣṭāva supraṇamya tam | śaṅkaraṃ sakalādhīśaṃ vāgbhiriṣṭābhirādarāt
verses.translation: After propitiating l3iva and after obtaining his consent they tried to uproot the Mandara in their desire to take it to the milk-ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating l3iva and after obtaining his consent they tried to uproot the Mandara in their desire to take it to the milk-ocean.
verses.science: प्रजाको प्रसन्‍न रखता था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुस्तन्मतमाज्ञाय तच्छिरांस्यच्युतेन ह । पुरा छिन्नानि वै केतुसंज्ञानि निदधे गले
verses.transliteration: śambhustanmatamājñāya tacchirāṃsyacyutena ha | purā chinnāni vai ketusaṃjñāni nidadhe gale
verses.translation: O sage, uprooting and lifting it by means of their arms they went to the milk-ocean. Their strength failing they became incapable of taking it up to the sea.
verses.hindi: तभी नगरमें बड़ा भयानक शब्द हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, uprooting and lifting it by means of their arms they went to the milk-ocean. Their strength failing they became incapable of taking it up to the sea.
verses.science: तभी नगरमें बड़ा भयानक शब्द हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो युद्धेऽसुराः सर्वे देवैश्चैव पराजिताः । पीत्वामृतं सुराः सर्वे जय प्रापुर्महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: tato yuddhe'surāḥ sarve devaiścaiva parājitāḥ | pītvāmṛtaṃ surāḥ sarve jaya prāpurmahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Slipping from their arms the Mandara became very heavy suddenly and fell over the gods and the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Slipping from their arms the Mandara became very heavy suddenly and fell over the gods and the Asuras.
verses.science: घरसे बाहर निकल पड़ा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुप्रभृतयः सर्वे बभूवुश्चातिगर्विताः । बलानि चाङ्कुरन्तोऽन्तः शिवमायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuprabhṛtayaḥ sarve babhūvuścātigarvitāḥ | balāni cāṅkuranto'ntaḥ śivamāyāvimohitāḥ
verses.translation: Failing in their effort the gods and the Asuras broke down. After regaining consciousness they eulogised the lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: निर्दयताके साथ उसका सिर कटवा दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Failing in their effort the gods and the Asuras broke down. After regaining consciousness they eulogised the lord of the universe.
verses.science: निर्दयताके साथ उसका सिर कटवा दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शङ्करो देवः सर्वाधीशोऽथ गर्वहा । यक्षो भूत्वा जगामाशु यत्र देवाः स्थिता मुने
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śaṅkaro devaḥ sarvādhīśo'tha garvahā | yakṣo bhūtvā jagāmāśu yatra devāḥ sthitā mune
verses.translation: At his wish in their next attempt' they lifted up the mountain. They took it to the northern shore of the ocean and hurled it into the waters.
verses.hindi: किया, जिससे वह मंगलहीन हो गया
verses.commentary: Sense: At his wish in their next attempt' they lifted up the mountain. They took it to the northern shore of the ocean and hurled it into the waters.
verses.science: किया, जिससे वह मंगलहीन हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् दृष्ट्वाच्युतमुखान्देवान्यक्षपतिः स वै । महागर्वाढ्यमनसा महेशः प्राह गर्वहा
verses.transliteration: sarvān dṛṣṭvācyutamukhāndevānyakṣapatiḥ sa vai | mahāgarvāḍhyamanasā maheśaḥ prāha garvahā
verses.translation: Then both the gods and the Asuras made Vasuld the churning rope. Desirous of taking the excellent articles they churned the milk-ocean.
verses.hindi: समय ही उसका वध कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Then both the gods and the Asuras made Vasuld the churning rope. Desirous of taking the excellent articles they churned the milk-ocean.
verses.science: समय ही उसका वध कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वर उवाच । किमर्थं संस्थिता यूयमत्र सर्वे सुरा मिथः । किमु काष्ठाखिलं ब्रुत कारणं मेऽनु पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: yakṣeśvara uvāca | kimarthaṃ saṃsthitā yūyamatra sarve surā mithaḥ | kimu kāṣṭhākhilaṃ bruta kāraṇaṃ me'nu pṛcchate
verses.translation: From the sprays and drops that sprang up at the outcome of nectar, many damsels of wonderful beauty were born.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले मनुष्य दरिद्र हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: From the sprays and drops that sprang up at the outcome of nectar, many damsels of wonderful beauty were born.
verses.science: करनेवाले मनुष्य दरिद्र हो जाते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । अभूदत्र महान्देव रणः परमदारुणः । असुरा नाशिताः सर्वेऽवशिष्टा विद्रुता गताः
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | abhūdatra mahāndeva raṇaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ | asurā nāśitāḥ sarve'vaśiṣṭā vidrutā gatāḥ
verses.translation: Their faces resembled the full moon in the Autumn; their lustre was as glittering and dazzling as fire, lightning or the sun and they were bedecked in divine Jewels, necklaces, bracelets and bangles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their faces resembled the full moon in the Autumn; their lustre was as glittering and dazzling as fire, lightning or the sun and they were bedecked in divine Jewels, necklaces, bracelets and bangles.
verses.science: उत्कृष्ट स्वरूप दिखाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वयं सर्वे महावीरा दैत्यघ्ना बलवत्तराः । अग्रेऽस्माकं कियन्तस्ते दैत्याः क्षुद्रबलाः सदा
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ sarve mahāvīrā daityaghnā balavattarāḥ | agre'smākaṃ kiyantaste daityāḥ kṣudrabalāḥ sadā
verses.translation: Sprinkling the ten quarters by the water of necta¬ rine beauty they seemed to madden the world by their beauteous glances.
verses.hindi: गदगद वाणीमें उन प्रभुकी स्तुति करने लगी
verses.commentary: Sense: Sprinkling the ten quarters by the water of necta¬ rine beauty they seemed to madden the world by their beauteous glances.
verses.science: गदगद वाणीमें उन प्रभुकी स्तुति करने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां सुराणां गर्वगर्भितम् । गर्वहासौ महादेवो यक्षरूपो वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ surāṇāṃ garvagarbhitam | garvahāsau mahādevo yakṣarūpo vaco'bravīt
verses.translation: They emerged in crores from the nectar sprays. Then the nectar that wards off old age and death came out.
verses.hindi: वे भगवान् शिव शीघ्र ही वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: They emerged in crores from the nectar sprays. Then the nectar that wards off old age and death came out.
verses.science: वे भगवान् शिव शीघ्र ही वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वर उवाच । हे सुरा निखिला यूयं मद्वचः शृणुतादरात् । यथार्थं वच्मि नासत्यं सर्वगर्वापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣeśvara uvāca | he surā nikhilā yūyaṃ madvacaḥ śṛṇutādarāt | yathārthaṃ vacmi nāsatyaṃ sarvagarvāpahārakam
verses.translation: Visiju kept for himself Lak§ml, the conch, Kaus¬ tubha and the sword; the Sun chose the divine horse Uccail- 4ravas for himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visiju kept for himself Lak§ml, the conch, Kaus¬ tubha and the sword; the Sun chose the divine horse Uccail- 4ravas for himself.
verses.science: राजपुत्रका पालन करने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गर्वमेनं न कुरुत कर्ता हर्तापरः प्रभुः । विस्मृताश्च महेशानं कथयध्वं वृथा बलाः
verses.transliteration: garvamenaṃ na kuruta kartā hartāparaḥ prabhuḥ | vismṛtāśca maheśānaṃ kathayadhvaṃ vṛthā balāḥ
verses.translation: With great eagerness the husband of Saci, the lord of the gods, took Parijata the excellent tree and AirSvata the lordly eleohant.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great eagerness the husband of Saci, the lord of the gods, took Parijata the excellent tree and AirSvata the lordly eleohant.
verses.science: घरमें बढ़ने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकं चेत्स हि मदो जानतां स्वबलं महत् । मत्स्थापितं तृणमिदं छिन्त स्वास्त्रैश्च तैः सुराः
verses.transliteration: yuṣmākaṃ cetsa hi mado jānatāṃ svabalaṃ mahat | matsthāpitaṃ tṛṇamidaṃ chinta svāstraiśca taiḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: For the protection of the gods, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, voluntarily retained the Kala- kuta in his neck and held the moon on his forehead.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the protection of the gods, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, voluntarily retained the Kala- kuta in his neck and held the moon on his forehead.
verses.science: शिवजीका पूजन करने लगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वैकं तृणं तेषां निचिक्षेप पुरस्ततः । जह्रे सर्वमदं यक्षरूप ईशः सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvaikaṃ tṛṇaṃ teṣāṃ nicikṣepa purastataḥ | jahre sarvamadaṃ yakṣarūpa īśaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, deluded by the illusion of Siva, the Daityas accepted Sura (wine) and the common people took Dhanvantari (the physician).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, deluded by the illusion of Siva, the Daityas accepted Sura (wine) and the common people took Dhanvantari (the physician).
verses.science: अकण्टक राज्य करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सर्वे सुरा विष्णुप्रमुखा वीरमानिनः । कृत्वा स्वपौरुषं तत्र स्वायुधानि विचिक्षिपुः
verses.transliteration: atha sarve surā viṣṇupramukhā vīramāninaḥ | kṛtvā svapauruṣaṃ tatra svāyudhāni vicikṣipuḥ
verses.translation: The great sages took the cow Kamadhenu. The damsels, the enchantresses became common to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sages took the cow Kamadhenu. The damsels, the enchantresses became common to all.
verses.science: वह ब्राह्मणपुत्र उसका भाई हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासन् विफलान्याशु तान्यस्त्राणि दिवौकसाम् । शिवप्रभावतस्तेषां मूढगर्वापहारिणः
verses.transliteration: tatrāsan viphalānyāśu tānyastrāṇi divaukasām | śivaprabhāvatasteṣāṃ mūḍhagarvāpahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: A great battle for the possession of Amfta ensued between the gods and the Asuras who desired to conquer each other and who were agitated in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great battle for the possession of Amfta ensued between the gods and the Asuras who desired to conquer each other and who were agitated in their minds.
verses.science: सुखोपभोग करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथासीत्तु नभोवाणी देवविस्मयहारिणी । यक्षोऽयं शङ्करो देवाः सर्वगर्वापहारकः
verses.transliteration: athāsīttu nabhovāṇī devavismayahāriṇī | yakṣo'yaṃ śaṅkaro devāḥ sarvagarvāpahārakaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu, the most excellent of those who wield Maya assuming the form of a woman Mohini deluded the Asuras and made the gods drink it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu, the most excellent of those who wield Maya assuming the form of a woman Mohini deluded the Asuras and made the gods drink it.
verses.science: शिवपुरको जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता हर्ता तथा भर्तायमेव परमेश्वरः । एतद्बलेन बलिनो जीवाः सर्वेऽन्यथा न हि
verses.transliteration: kartā hartā tathā bhartāyameva parameśvaraḥ | etadbalena balino jīvāḥ sarve'nyathā na hi
verses.translation: The leading Daityas approached her and said— "Make us drink this nectar. Let there be no break in the lines.**
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भिक्षुवर्याह्शिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Daityas approached her and said— "Make us drink this nectar. Let there be no break in the lines.**
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भिक्षुवर्याह्शिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य मायाप्रभावाद् वै मोहिताः स्वप्रभुं शिवम् । मदतो बुबुधुर्नैवाद्यापि बोधतनुं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: asya māyāprabhāvād vai mohitāḥ svaprabhuṃ śivam | madato bubudhurnaivādyāpi bodhatanuṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Ail those Daityas and Danavas deluded by Siva*s Maya said thus and gave the nectar to Visnu in disguise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ail those Daityas and Danavas deluded by Siva*s Maya said thus and gave the nectar to Visnu in disguise.
verses.science: नामक डइकतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा नभोवाणीं बुबुधुस्ते गतस्मयाः । यक्षेश्वरं प्रणेमुश्च तुष्टुवुश्च तमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti śrutvā nabhovāṇīṃ bubudhuste gatasmayāḥ | yakṣeśvaraṃ praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca tamīśvaram
verses.translation: In the meantime on seeing the damsels bom of Amrta, the leading Danavas took them to their abodes ac¬ cording to their convenience.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime on seeing the damsels bom of Amrta, the leading Danavas took them to their abodes ac¬ cording to their convenience.
verses.science: करूँगा, आप श्रवण कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । देवदेव महादेव सर्वगर्वापहारक । यक्षेश्वर महालील माया तेऽत्यद्भुता प्रभो
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | devadeva mahādeva sarvagarvāpahāraka | yakṣeśvara mahālīla māyā te'tyadbhutā prabho
verses.translation: The cities built by the architect Maya for those women were divine, hundred times more beautiful than heaven. They were well fortified by terrible machines.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cities built by the architect Maya for those women were divine, hundred times more beautiful than heaven. They were well fortified by terrible machines.
verses.science: उत्पन्न हुआ था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मोहिता माययाद्यापि तव यक्षस्वरूपिणः । सगर्वमभिभाषन्तस्त्वत्पुरो हि पृथङ्मयाः
verses.transliteration: mohitā māyayādyāpi tava yakṣasvarūpiṇaḥ | sagarvamabhibhāṣantastvatpuro hi pṛthaṅmayāḥ
verses.translation: The daityas made those cities well guarded and set off for fighting after taking this pledge touching their chests. *
verses.commentary: Sense: The daityas made those cities well guarded and set off for fighting after taking this pledge touching their chests. *
verses.science: ३ लगा, हैवयोगसे वह दरिद्र था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं ज्ञानमायातं तवैव कृपया प्रभो । कर्ता हर्ता च भर्ता च त्वमेवान्यो न शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ jñānamāyātaṃ tavaiva kṛpayā prabho | kartā hartā ca bhartā ca tvamevānyo na śaṅkara
verses.translation: "We will never touch these women if we were to be defeated by the gods.** After saying this, the heroic Daityas became eager to fight.
verses.hindi: गयी और मातासे बारंबार दूध माँगने लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: "We will never touch these women if we were to be defeated by the gods.** After saying this, the heroic Daityas became eager to fight.
verses.science: गयी और मातासे बारंबार दूध माँगने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव सर्वशक्तीनां सर्वेषां हि प्रवर्तकः । निवर्तकश्च सर्वेशः परमात्माव्ययोऽद्वयः
verses.transliteration: tvameva sarvaśaktīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ hi pravartakaḥ | nivartakaśca sarveśaḥ paramātmāvyayo'dvayaḥ
verses.translation: They roared like lions. Severally they blew their conches as if filling the sky and propitiating the clouds.
verses.hindi: फुसलाकर वह कृत्रिम दूध उसे दे दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: They roared like lions. Severally they blew their conches as if filling the sky and propitiating the clouds.
verses.science: फुसलाकर वह कृत्रिम दूध उसे दे दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वरस्वरूपेण सर्वेषां नो मदो हृतः । कृतो मन्यामहे तत्तेऽनुग्रहो हि कृपालुना
verses.transliteration: yakṣeśvarasvarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ no mado hṛtaḥ | kṛto manyāmahe tatte'nugraho hi kṛpālunā
verses.translation: A terrible fight ensued between the gods and the Asuras. The unrivalled battle between the gods and Asuras is famous in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: A terrible fight ensued between the gods and the Asuras. The unrivalled battle between the gods and Asuras is famous in the three worlds.
verses.science: इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथो स यक्षनाथोऽनुगृह्य वै सकलान् सुरान् । विबोध्य विविधैर्वाक्यैस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: atho sa yakṣanātho'nugṛhya vai sakalān surān | vibodhya vividhairvākyaistatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Protected by Vinu, the gods gained victory. The Daityas fled and those who remained were killed by Vifu and his associate gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Protected by Vinu, the gods gained victory. The Daityas fled and those who remained were killed by Vifu and his associate gods.
verses.science: करो, सब भला ही होगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स वर्णितः शम्भोरवतारः सुखावहः । यक्षेश्वराख्यः सुखदः सतां तुष्टोऽभयङ्करः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa varṇitaḥ śambhoravatāraḥ sukhāvahaḥ | yakṣeśvarākhyaḥ sukhadaḥ satāṃ tuṣṭo'bhayaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The powerful Vinu armed with his diseus chased them even after they had gone to the ultimate end of Patala* excessively frightened.
verses.hindi: उससे विदा ले तप करनेके लिये चल पड़ा
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful Vinu armed with his diseus chased them even after they had gone to the ultimate end of Patala* excessively frightened.
verses.science: उससे विदा ले तप करनेके लिये चल पड़ा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानममलं सर्वगर्वापहारकम् । सतां सुशान्तिदं नित्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: idamākhyānamamalaṃ sarvagarvāpahārakam | satāṃ suśāntidaṃ nityaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: In the meantime Viiiu saw those damsels bom of nectar sprays who were haughty due to their divine beauty and whose faces resembled the full moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Viiiu saw those damsels bom of nectar sprays who were haughty due to their divine beauty and whose faces resembled the full moon.
verses.science: उनका पूजन करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा सुधीः पुमान् । सर्वकामानवाप्नोति ततश्च लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā sudhīḥ pumān | sarvakāmānavāpnoti tataśca labhate gatim
verses.translation: Fascinated by the Cupid's arrows Vi 9 i;iu attained highest pleasure only there. He began to indulge in sexual dalliance with those women of exquisite beauty.
verses.hindi: हुए उसने बहुत कालपर्यन्त घोर तप किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Fascinated by the Cupid's arrows Vi 9 i;iu attained highest pleasure only there. He began to indulge in sexual dalliance with those women of exquisite beauty.
verses.science: हुए उसने बहुत कालपर्यन्त घोर तप किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: For the protection of the worlds and for the redemption of Vi?riu, Siva was eulogised thus by Brahma, the gods and the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the protection of the worlds and for the redemption of Vi?riu, Siva was eulogised thus by Brahma, the gods and the sages.
verses.science: ब्रह्मा-विष्णु आदि देवोंसे श्रेष्ठ हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: For the protection of the worlds and for the redemption of Vi?riu, Siva was eulogised thus by Brahma, the gods and the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the protection of the worlds and for the redemption of Vi?riu, Siva was eulogised thus by Brahma, the gods and the sages.
verses.science: मुझे वर प्रदान करेंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । शिवदशावतारवर्णनम् । शृण्वथो गिरिशस्याद्यावतारान् दशसङ्ख्यकान् । महाकालमुखान् भक्त्योपासनाकाण्डसेवितान्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.17. saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivadaśāvatāravarṇanam | śṛṇvatho giriśasyādyāvatārān daśasaṅkhyakān | mahākālamukhān bhaktyopāsanākāṇḍasevitān
verses.translation: Then lord Siva, the ocean of mercy, realising the havoc caused by the sons of Vinu assumed the form of a bull.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Siva, the ocean of mercy, realising the havoc caused by the sons of Vinu assumed the form of a bull.
verses.science: अन्य देवतासे वरदान नहीं माँगूँगा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्यो हि महाकालो भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदः सताम् । शक्तिस्तत्र महाकाली भक्तेप्सितफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: tatrādyo hi mahākālo bhuktimuktipradaḥ satām | śaktistatra mahākālī bhaktepsitaphalapradā
verses.translation: Unable to bear the onslaught, Vi$nu deluded by Maya was exhausted and utterly shattered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unable to bear the onslaught, Vi$nu deluded by Maya was exhausted and utterly shattered.
verses.science: स्वेच्छापूर्वक भक्ष्यादि भोगोंका भोग करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तारनामा द्वितीयश्च ताराशक्तिस्तथैव सा । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदौ चोभौ स्वसेवकसुखप्रदौ
verses.transliteration: tāranāmā dvitīyaśca tārāśaktistathaiva sā | bhuktimuktipradau cobhau svasevakasukhapradau
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, O ocean of mercy, O lord Siva, I had been deluded by your Maya and my mind had been confused.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the gods, O ocean of mercy, O lord Siva, I had been deluded by your Maya and my mind had been confused.
verses.science: भी प्रदान करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भुवनेशो हि बालाह्वस्तृतीयः परिकीर्तितः । भुवनेशी शिवा तत्र बालाह्वा सुखदा सताम्
verses.transliteration: bhuvaneśo hi bālāhvastṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | bhuvaneśī śivā tatra bālāhvā sukhadā satām
verses.translation: O lord, I fought with you, Siva. Taking pity on me, O lord, let this offence be excu.sed.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I fought with you, Siva. Taking pity on me, O lord, let this offence be excu.sed.
verses.science: भी प्रेमपूर्वक माँगो। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीविद्येशः षोडशाह्वः श्रीर्विद्या षोडशी शिवा । चतुर्थो भक्तसुखदो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: śrīvidyeśaḥ ṣoḍaśāhvaḥ śrīrvidyā ṣoḍaśī śivā | caturtho bhaktasukhado bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing those piteous words of Vi 9 ]?iu, lord Siva favourably disposed to his devotees spoke to Vinu.
verses.hindi: तेजस्वी, दिव्यज्ञानी तथा महाप्रभु हो जाओ
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on hearing those piteous words of Vi 9 ]?iu, lord Siva favourably disposed to his devotees spoke to Vinu.
verses.science: तेजस्वी, दिव्यज्ञानी तथा महाप्रभु हो जाओ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमो भैरवः ख्यातः सर्वदा भक्तकामदः । भैरवी गिरिजा तत्र सदुपासककामदा
verses.transliteration: pañcamo bhairavaḥ khyātaḥ sarvadā bhaktakāmadaḥ | bhairavī girijā tatra sadupāsakakāmadā
verses.translation: Why don't you realise yourself as one whose ex¬ ploit is dependent on me. You should not have indulged in sexual dalliance there. You should have refrained from all misdeeds.
verses.hindi: दक्षता तथा अपना पद भी प्रदान किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Why don't you realise yourself as one whose ex¬ ploit is dependent on me. You should not have indulged in sexual dalliance there. You should have refrained from all misdeeds.
verses.science: दक्षता तथा अपना पद भी प्रदान किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नमस्तकनामासौ शिवः षष्ठः प्रकीर्तितः । भक्तकामप्रदा चैव गिरिजा छिन्नमस्तका
verses.transliteration: chinnamastakanāmāsau śivaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | bhaktakāmapradā caiva girijā chinnamastakā
verses.translation: Why should your intellect be subservient to lust? That you should indulge in dalliance with women does not behove you, O lord of gods. Remember the task of uplifting the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why should your intellect be subservient to lust? That you should indulge in dalliance with women does not behove you, O lord of gods. Remember the task of uplifting the universe.
verses.science: महादेवकी स्तुति की। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धूमवान् सप्तमः शम्भुः सर्वकामफलप्रदः । धूमवती शिवा तत्र सदुपासककामदा
verses.transliteration: dhūmavān saptamaḥ śambhuḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ | dhūmavatī śivā tatra sadupāsakakāmadā
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Siva that imparted knowledge Vi$nu was ashamed of himself and then he spoke to lord Siva respectfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of Siva that imparted knowledge Vi$nu was ashamed of himself and then he spoke to lord Siva respectfully.
verses.science: सुनते ही उपमन्युसे कहा--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवावतारः सुखदो ह्यष्टमो बगलामुखः । शक्तिस्तत्र महानन्दा विख्याता बगलामुखी
verses.transliteration: śivāvatāraḥ sukhado hyaṣṭamo bagalāmukhaḥ | śaktistatra mahānandā vikhyātā bagalāmukhī
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vi?nu, lord Siva the protector of virtue in the guise of a bull, replied to Vi??u again.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vi?nu, lord Siva the protector of virtue in the guise of a bull, replied to Vi??u again.
verses.science: शिव वहींपर अन्तर्हिंत हो गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवावतारो मातङ्गो नवमः परिकीर्तितः । मातङ्गी तत्र शर्वाणी सर्वकामफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: śivāvatāro mātaṅgo navamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | mātaṅgī tatra śarvāṇī sarvakāmaphalapradā
verses.translation: Then bellowing in the form of a Bull, the PinSka- bearing lord entered the crevice and shouted terribly.
verses.hindi: शरीर छोड़ देता है, वह शिवलोकको जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then bellowing in the form of a Bull, the PinSka- bearing lord entered the crevice and shouted terribly.
verses.science: शरीर छोड़ देता है, वह शिवलोकको जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दशमः कमलः शम्भुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः । कमला गिरिजा तत्र स्वभक्तपरिपालिनी
verses.transliteration: daśamaḥ kamalaḥ śambhurbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ | kamalā girijā tatra svabhaktaparipālinī
verses.translation: At his bellowing sound, cities and towns crumbled down and all the citizens trembled.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his bellowing sound, cities and towns crumbled down and all the citizens trembled.
verses.science: अपना यह शरीर त्याग दूँगा। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: एते दशमिताः शैवा अवताराः सुखप्रदाः । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदाश्चैव भक्तानां सर्वदा सताम्
verses.transliteration: ete daśamitāḥ śaivā avatārāḥ sukhapradāḥ | bhuktimuktipradāścaiva bhaktānāṃ sarvadā satām
verses.translation: Then the bull attacked Vi?nu's sons wielding their bows for fighting, deluded by Siva's Maya and proud of their great strength and exploit.
verses.hindi: शिवजीके ये दस अवतार हैं, जो सज्जनों एवं भक्तोंको सर्वदा सुख देनेवाले तथा उन्हें भुक्ति एवं मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the bull attacked Vi?nu's sons wielding their bows for fighting, deluded by Siva's Maya and proud of their great strength and exploit.

verses.sanskrit: एते दशावतारा हि शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । नानासुखप्रदा नित्यं सेवतां निर्विकारतः
verses.transliteration: ete daśāvatārā hi śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ | nānāsukhapradā nityaṃ sevatāṃ nirvikārataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the sons of Vinu became furious. Those heroes roared loudly and rushed against Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, the sons of Vinu became furious. Those heroes roared loudly and rushed against Siva.
verses.science: उन मुनिने घोर शब्द किया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दशावताराणां माहात्म्यं वर्णितं मुने । सर्वकामप्रदं ज्ञेयं तन्त्रशास्त्रादिगर्भितम्
