verses.transliteration: etaddaśāvatārāṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ varṇitaṃ mune | sarvakāmapradaṃ jñeyaṃ tantraśāstrādigarbhitam
verses.translation: When their limbs were split by Rudra, they swoon* ed and lost their lives. They were immediately destroyed.
verses.hindi: करते हुए उपमन्यु स्थित हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: When their limbs were split by Rudra, they swoon* ed and lost their lives. They were immediately destroyed.
verses.science: करते हुए उपमन्यु स्थित हो गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतासामादिशक्तीनामद्भुतो महिमा मुने । सर्वकामप्रदो ज्ञेयस्तत्रंशास्त्रादिगर्भितः
verses.transliteration: etāsāmādiśaktīnāmadbhuto mahimā mune | sarvakāmaprado jñeyastatraṃśāstrādigarbhitaḥ
verses.translation: When they were killed Visnu the foremost of the strong came out shouting loudly and hastened towards Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were killed Visnu the foremost of the strong came out shouting loudly and hastened towards Siva.
verses.science: आग्नेयी धारणाको रोक दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शत्रुमारणकार्यादौ तत्तच्छक्तिः परा मता । खलदण्डकरी नित्यं ब्रह्मतेजोविवर्द्धिनी
verses.transliteration: śatrumāraṇakāryādau tattacchaktiḥ parā matā | khaladaṇḍakarī nityaṃ brahmatejovivarddhinī
verses.translation: On seeing Siva in the form of the bull going along
verses.hindi: शिवजीके आदेशसे नन्दीने बीचमें ही पकड़ लिया
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Siva in the form of the bull going along
verses.science: शिवजीके आदेशसे नन्दीने बीचमें ही पकड़ लिया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तास्ते मया ब्रह्मन्नवतारा महेशितुः । सशक्तिका दशमिता महाकालमुखाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktāste mayā brahmannavatārā maheśituḥ | saśaktikā daśamitā mahākālamukhāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Then the infuriated Siva, the highly powerful one in the form of a bull stood like a mountain and caught hold of all those missiles of Viu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the infuriated Siva, the highly powerful one in the form of a bull stood like a mountain and caught hold of all those missiles of Viu.
verses.science: शिवजीको दण्डवत् प्रणाम करने लगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवपर्वेसु सर्वेषु योऽधीते भक्तितत्परः । एतदाख्यानममलं सोऽतिशम्भुप्रियो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śaivaparvesu sarveṣu yo'dhīte bhaktitatparaḥ | etadākhyānamamalaṃ so'tiśambhupriyo bhavet
verses.translation: O sage, shouting furiously, lord Siva in the form of a bull shook the three worlds terribly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, shouting furiously, lord Siva in the form of a bull shook the three worlds terribly.
verses.science: सूँघकर उन्हें वर प्रदान किये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चस्वी क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् । धनाधिपो हि वैश्यः स्याच्छूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasvī kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet | dhanādhipo hi vaiśyaḥ syācchūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The lord leaped up suddenly and kicked the in¬ furiated Visnu who was deluded and could not realise him. The lord then tore him with his horns.
verses.hindi: मैंने परीक्षा कर ली कि तुम हमारे दृढ़ भक्त हो
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord leaped up suddenly and kicked the in¬ furiated Visnu who was deluded and could not realise him. The lord then tore him with his horns.
verses.science: मैंने परीक्षा कर ली कि तुम हमारे दृढ़ भक्त हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शाङ्करा निजधर्मस्थाः शृण्वन्तश्चरितं त्विदम् । सुखिनः स्युर्विशेषेण शिवभक्ता भवन्तु च
verses.transliteration: śāṅkarā nijadharmasthāḥ śṛṇvantaścaritaṃ tvidam | sukhinaḥ syurviśeṣeṇa śivabhaktā bhavantu ca
verses.translation: 'JThen on realising that Siva himself had come in the form of a Bull, Vinu spoke in a shrill voice with droop¬ ing shoulders and palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'JThen on realising that Siva himself had come in the form of a Bull, Vinu spoke in a shrill voice with droop¬ ing shoulders and palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: तुम सर्वदा कुमार बने रहोगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: I shall give you a discus more terrible than the sun at the time of dissolution and more efficacious than the words of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall give you a discus more terrible than the sun at the time of dissolution and more efficacious than the words of Siva.
verses.science: मातासे सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: I shall give you a discus more terrible than the sun at the time of dissolution and more efficacious than the words of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall give you a discus more terrible than the sun at the time of dissolution and more efficacious than the words of Siva.
verses.science: सुख प्राप्त करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । एकादशावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एकादशवतारान्वै शृण्वथो शाङ्करान्वरान् । यान् श्रुत्वा न हि बाध्येत बाधासत्यादिसम्भवा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.18. aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | ekādaśāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | ekādaśavatārānvai śṛṇvatho śāṅkarānvarān | yān śrutvā na hi bādhyeta bādhāsatyādisambhavā
verses.translation: After saying this Siva created another blazing dis¬ cus, as lustrous as the Kala hre, for the destruction of the wicked.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this Siva created another blazing dis¬ cus, as lustrous as the Kala hre, for the destruction of the wicked.
verses.science: सुख प्रदान करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सर्वे सुराः शक्रमुखा दैत्यपराजिताः । त्यक्त्वामरावतीं भीत्यापलायन्त निजां पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: purā sarve surāḥ śakramukhā daityaparājitāḥ | tyaktvāmarāvatīṃ bhītyāpalāyanta nijāṃ purīm
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with purity enjoys all pleasures here and attains salva¬ tion hereafter. So also is the case with him who reads or teaches this to intelligent men.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with purity enjoys all pleasures here and attains salva¬ tion hereafter. So also is the case with him who reads or teaches this to intelligent men.
verses.science: भावकी परीक्षा करनेका विचार किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यप्रपीडिता देवा जग्मुस्ते कश्यपान्तिकम् । बध्वा करान्नतस्कन्धाः प्रणेमुस्तं सुविह्वलम्
verses.transliteration: daityaprapīḍitā devā jagmuste kaśyapāntikam | badhvā karānnataskandhāḥ praṇemustaṃ suvihvalam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods Brahma, the grand¬ father of the worlds, mentioned the details of what Tvatr was desirous of doing.
verses.hindi: कहती हूँ, इसमें किंचिन्मात्र भी असत्य नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the gods Brahma, the grand¬ father of the worlds, mentioned the details of what Tvatr was desirous of doing.
verses.science: कहती हूँ, इसमें किंचिन्मात्र भी असत्य नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुनुत्वा तं सुराः सर्वे कृत्वा विज्ञप्तिमादरात् । सर्वं निवेदयामासुः स्वदुःखं तत्पराजयम्
verses.transliteration: sunutvā taṃ surāḥ sarve kṛtvā vijñaptimādarāt | sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsuḥ svaduḥkhaṃ tatparājayam
verses.translation: Then the king of gods, accompanied by the gods bent upon achieving his own object, and most efficient in polity spoke to the great sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the king of gods, accompanied by the gods bent upon achieving his own object, and most efficient in polity spoke to the great sage.
verses.science: महान् क्रोध उत्पन्न हुआ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स कश्यपस्तात तत्पिता शिवसक्तधीः । तदाकर्ण्यामराकं वै दुःखितोऽभून्न चाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa kaśyapastāta tatpitā śivasaktadhīḥ | tadākarṇyāmarākaṃ vai duḥkhito'bhūnna cādhikam
verses.translation: All of us, the gods and the sages are oppressed by Tvastr. We seek refuge in you, worthy of refuge, a great devotee of Siva and a liberal donor.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of us, the gods and the sages are oppressed by Tvastr. We seek refuge in you, worthy of refuge, a great devotee of Siva and a liberal donor.
verses.science: परिताप हो रहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तानाश्वास्य मुनिः सोऽथ धैर्यमाधाय शान्तधीः । काशीं जगाम सुप्रीत्या विश्वेश्वरपुरीं मुने
verses.transliteration: tānāśvāsya muniḥ so'tha dhairyamādhāya śāntadhīḥ | kāśīṃ jagāma suprītyā viśveśvarapurīṃ mune
verses.translation: O brahmin, give us your bones of adamanatine strength. I shall make my thunderbolt with your love and kill the demon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, give us your bones of adamanatine strength. I shall make my thunderbolt with your love and kill the demon.
verses.science: मनोरथको पूर्ण करेंगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाम्भसि ततः स्नात्वा कृत्वा तं विधिमादरात् । विश्वेश्वरं समानर्च साम्बं सर्वेश्वरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāmbhasi tataḥ snātvā kṛtvā taṃ vidhimādarāt | viśveśvaraṃ samānarca sāmbaṃ sarveśvaraṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Thus requested, the sage fond of helping others meditated on lord Siva and abandoned his body.
verses.hindi: शिव ब्रह्मके रूपमें निर्गुण एवं अव्यय कहे जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, the sage fond of helping others meditated on lord Siva and abandoned his body.
verses.science: शिव ब्रह्मके रूपमें निर्गुण एवं अव्यय कहे जाते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवलिङ्गं सुसंस्थाप्य चकार विपुलं तपः । शम्भुमुद्दिश्य सुप्रीत्या देवानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: śivaliṅgaṃ susaṃsthāpya cakāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | śambhumuddiśya suprītyā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Immediately he reached Brahma's region with his bondage of actions quashed. There was a shower of flowers and the people were agreeably surprised.
verses.hindi: साथ पुनः सम्भाषण न हो सके
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately he reached Brahma's region with his bondage of actions quashed. There was a shower of flowers and the people were agreeably surprised.
verses.science: साथ पुनः सम्भाषण न हो सके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महान्कालो व्यतीयाय तपतस्तस्य वै मुने । शिवपादाम्बुजासक्तमनसो धैर्यशालिनः
verses.transliteration: mahānkālo vyatīyāya tapatastasya vai mune | śivapādāmbujāsaktamanaso dhairyaśālinaḥ
verses.translation: Indra then called the divine cow Surabhi to lick up the marrow etc. He directed Visvakarman to make the weapon with the bones.
verses.hindi: नीचेकी ओर मुख की हुई उनसे कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra then called the divine cow Surabhi to lick up the marrow etc. He directed Visvakarman to make the weapon with the bones.
verses.science: नीचेकी ओर मुख की हुई उनसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रादुरभूच्छम्भुर्वरं दातुं तदर्षये । स्वपदासक्तमनसे दीनबन्धुः सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: atha prādurabhūcchambhurvaraṃ dātuṃ tadarṣaye | svapadāsaktamanase dīnabandhuḥ satāṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: He gave the discus, as lustruous as ten thousand fierce suns, to Vi§nu, the great Atman, the protector of the gods and the leading sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave the discus, as lustruous as ten thousand fierce suns, to Vi§nu, the great Atman, the protector of the gods and the leading sages.
verses.science: मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरं ब्रूहीति चोवाच सुप्रसन्नो महेश्वरः । कश्यपं मुनिशार्दूलं स्वभक्तं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: varaṃ brūhīti covāca suprasanno maheśvaraḥ | kaśyapaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ svabhaktaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: After securing another SudarSana discus of more brilliance, Vinu the foremost of intelligent gods spoke to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing another SudarSana discus of more brilliance, Vinu the foremost of intelligent gods spoke to the gods.
verses.science: शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाथ तं महेशानं स प्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टाव कश्यपो हृष्टो देवतातः प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvātha taṃ maheśānaṃ sa praṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ | tuṣṭāva kaśyapo hṛṣṭo devatātaḥ prasannadhīḥ
verses.translation: "O ye gods, you listen to my statement eagerly. You must act accordingly and immediately. It will be to your advantage.
verses.hindi: इ॒ति श्रीशिव की शतरुद्रसंहितायां सुरेश्वराख्यशिवावतारचरितवर्णन नाम द्वात्रिशो3 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: "O ye gods, you listen to my statement eagerly. You must act accordingly and immediately. It will be to your advantage.
verses.science: इ॒ति श्रीशिव की शतरुद्रसंहितायां सुरेश्वराख्यशिवावतारचरितवर्णन नाम द्वात्रिशो3 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कश्यप उवाच । देवदेव महेशान शरणागतवत्सल । सर्वेश्वः परमात्मा त्वं ध्यानगम्योऽद्वयोऽव्ययः
verses.transliteration: kaśyapa uvāca | devadeva maheśāna śaraṇāgatavatsala | sarveśvaḥ paramātmā tvaṃ dhyānagamyo'dvayo'vyayaḥ
verses.translation: There are many youthful maidens in the nether regions exquisitely dressed. Any one of you can go and in¬ dulge in sexual dalliance with them.**
verses.hindi: कश्यपजी बोले--हे देवदेव! हे महेशान! हे शरणागतवत्सल ! आप सर्वेश्वर, परमात्मा, ध्यानगम्य, अद्वितीय तथा अविनाशी हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: There are many youthful maidens in the nether regions exquisitely dressed. Any one of you can go and in¬ dulge in sexual dalliance with them.**

verses.sanskrit: बलनिग्रहकर्ता त्वं महेश्वर सतां गतिः । दीनबन्धुर्दयासिन्धुर्भक्तरक्षणदक्षधीः
verses.transliteration: balanigrahakartā tvaṃ maheśvara satāṃ gatiḥ | dīnabandhurdayāsindhurbhaktarakṣaṇadakṣadhīḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Visnu the valorous gods
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Visnu the valorous gods
verses.science: अत्यन्त प्रेमपूर्वक सुनिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एते सुरास्त्वदीया हि त्वद्भक्ताश्च विशेषतः । दैत्यैः पराजिताश्चाथ पाहि तान्दुःखितान् प्रभो
verses.transliteration: ete surāstvadīyā hi tvadbhaktāśca viśeṣataḥ | daityaiḥ parājitāścātha pāhi tānduḥkhitān prabho
verses.translation: Knowing their intention then, lord Siva angrily cursed all the eight** types of the gods.
verses.hindi: हिमालयद्ठारा मेनाके गर्भसे पार्वती नामसे उत्पन्न हुईं
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing their intention then, lord Siva angrily cursed all the eight** types of the gods.
verses.science: हिमालयद्ठारा मेनाके गर्भसे पार्वती नामसे उत्पन्न हुईं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: असमर्थो रमेशोऽपि दुःखदस्ते मुहुर्मुहुः । अतः सुरा मच्छरणा वेदयन्तोऽसुखं च तत्
verses.transliteration: asamartho rameśo'pi duḥkhadaste muhurmuhuḥ | ataḥ surā maccharaṇā vedayanto'sukhaṃ ca tat
verses.translation: ''Excepting a quiescent sage and the Danavas born of my parts whoever enters this place shall die in a trice.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''Excepting a quiescent sage and the Danavas born of my parts whoever enters this place shall die in a trice.
verses.science: अत्यन्त निर्दोष तप करने लगीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदर्थं देवदेवेश देवदुःखविनाशक । तत्पूरितुं तपोनिष्ठां प्रसन्नार्थं तवासदम्
verses.transliteration: tadarthaṃ devadeveśa devaduḥkhavināśaka | tatpūrituṃ taponiṣṭhāṃ prasannārthaṃ tavāsadam
verses.translation: After hearing these terrible words which are con¬ ducive to the increase of the benefit of human beings, the gods thus restrained by Rudra returned to their own abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing these terrible words which are con¬ ducive to the increase of the benefit of human beings, the gods thus restrained by Rudra returned to their own abodes.
verses.science: तपः:स्थानपर सप्तर्षियोंको भेजा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शरणं ते प्रपन्नोऽस्मि सर्वथाहं महेश्वर । कामं मे पूरय स्वामिन्देवदुःखं विनाशय
verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ te prapanno'smi sarvathāhaṃ maheśvara | kāmaṃ me pūraya svāmindevaduḥkhaṃ vināśaya
verses.translation: Lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, returned to his mountain after carrying out the task of the gods in the guise of a bull.
verses.hindi: उनके तपकी परीक्षा की, किंतु वे सफल नहीं हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, returned to his mountain after carrying out the task of the gods in the guise of a bull.
verses.science: उनके तपकी परीक्षा की, किंतु वे सफल नहीं हुए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रदुःखैश्च देवेश दुःखितोऽहं विशेषतः । सुखिनं कुरु मामीश सहायस्त्वं दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: putraduḥkhaiśca deveśa duḥkhito'haṃ viśeṣataḥ | sukhinaṃ kuru māmīśa sahāyastvaṃ divaukasām
verses.translation: Thus the bull incarnation of Siva that dispelled Vinu's delusion and caused happiness to the three worlds, has been narrated.
verses.hindi: तथा उनकी आज्ञा लेकर स्वर्गलोक चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the bull incarnation of Siva that dispelled Vinu's delusion and caused happiness to the three worlds, has been narrated.
verses.science: तथा उनकी आज्ञा लेकर स्वर्गलोक चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा मम सुतो नाथ देवा यक्षाः पराजिताः । दैत्यैर्महाबलैः शम्भो सुरानन्दप्रदो भव
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā mama suto nātha devā yakṣāḥ parājitāḥ | daityairmahābalaiḥ śambho surānandaprado bhava
verses.translation: O intelligent one, listen with very great pleasure to the Pippalada incarnation of Siva that is excellent and that inspires devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, listen with very great pleasure to the Pippalada incarnation of Siva that is excellent and that inspires devotion.
verses.science: ब्रह्मचारीका स्वरूप धारण किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सदैवास्तु महेशान सर्वलेखसहायकः । यथा दैत्यकृता बाधा न बाधेत सुरान्प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sadaivāstu maheśāna sarvalekhasahāyakaḥ | yathā daityakṛtā bādhā na bādheta surānprabho
verses.translation: In the fight with Kuva, Viu and other gods were defeated by this sage who had the support of Siva and they were cursed.
verses.hindi: हे महेश्वर। हे प्रभो! जिस प्रकार इन देवताओंक दैत्योंके द्वार की जानेवाली बाधा पीड़ित न करे, उस प्रकार आप सदा सभी देवताओंके सहायक बनें
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fight with Kuva, Viu and other gods were defeated by this sage who had the support of Siva and they were cursed.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तस्य तु सर्वेशस्तथेति प्रोच्य शङ्करः । पश्यतस्तस्य भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktasya tu sarveśastatheti procya śaṅkaraḥ | paśyatastasya bhagavāṃstatraivāntardadhe haraḥ
verses.translation: The great lord, an expert in different kinds of sports and extremely brilliant was born of her in the name of Pippalada.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord, an expert in different kinds of sports and extremely brilliant was born of her in the name of Pippalada.
verses.science: दृष्टिसे प्रसन्‍न हो शीघ्रतासे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपोऽपि महाहृष्टः स्वस्थानमगमद् द्रुतम् । देवेभ्यः कथयामास सर्ववृत्तान्तमादरात्
verses.transliteration: kaśyapo'pi mahāhṛṣṭaḥ svasthānamagamad drutam | devebhyaḥ kathayāmāsa sarvavṛttāntamādarāt
verses.translation: On hearing these wonderful words of Nandiivara, the excellent sage Sanatkumara spoke with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these wonderful words of Nandiivara, the excellent sage Sanatkumara spoke with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down.
verses.science: करनेवाला हूँ, इसमें संशय नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शङ्करः शर्वः सत्यं कर्तुं स्वकं वचः । सुरभ्यां कश्यपाज्जज्ञे एकादशस्वरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ śarvaḥ satyaṃ kartuṃ svakaṃ vacaḥ | surabhyāṃ kaśyapājjajñe ekādaśasvarūpavān
verses.translation: O Nandiivara, O intelligent one, you are blessed in that you have assumed the form of Rudra himself. O dear, you are my excellent preceptor. This wonderful story has been narrated by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Nandiivara, O intelligent one, you are blessed in that you have assumed the form of Rudra himself. O dear, you are my excellent preceptor. This wonderful story has been narrated by you.
verses.science: सन्निकट स्थित हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवस्तदासीद् वै सर्वं शिवमयं त्वभूत् । आसन्हृष्टाः सुराश्चाथ मुनिना कश्यपेन च
verses.transliteration: mahotsavastadāsīd vai sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ tvabhūt | āsanhṛṣṭāḥ surāścātha muninā kaśyapena ca
verses.translation: O son of Silida, from my father Brahma, the acc¬ ount of the battle with Kuva and the defeat of Viu has already been heard by me. So also the curse has been heard by me.
verses.hindi: और अत्यन्त अशेभनीय कार्य दिखायी पड़ रहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Silida, from my father Brahma, the acc¬ ount of the battle with Kuva and the defeat of Viu has already been heard by me. So also the curse has been heard by me.
verses.science: और अत्यन्त अशेभनीय कार्य दिखायी पड़ रहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कपाली पिङ्गलो भीमो विरूपाक्षो विलोहितः । शास्ताजपादहिर्बुध्न्यश्शम्भुश्चण्डो भवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kapālī piṅgalo bhīmo virūpākṣo vilohitaḥ | śāstājapādahirbudhnyaśśambhuścaṇḍo bhavastathā
verses.translation: On hearing these auspicious words of the son of
verses.hindi: जन्म भारतवर्षमें हिमालयके घरमें हुआ है
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these auspicious words of the son of
verses.science: जन्म भारतवर्षमें हिमालयके घरमें हुआ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकादशैते रुद्रास्तु सुरभीतनयाः स्मृताः । देवकार्यार्थमुत्पन्नाः शिवरूपाः सुखास्पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekādaśaite rudrāstu surabhītanayāḥ smṛtāḥ | devakāryārthamutpannāḥ śivarūpāḥ sukhāspadam
verses.translation: O great sage, once Indra and other gods were defeated by the Daityas who had the support of the demon Vrtra.
verses.hindi: मैंने योगके द्वारा अपना शरीर त्याग दिया था
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, once Indra and other gods were defeated by the Daityas who had the support of the demon Vrtra.
verses.science: मैंने योगके द्वारा अपना शरीर त्याग दिया था। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: ते रुद्राः काश्यपा वीरा महाबलपराक्रमाः । दैत्यान् जघ्नुश्च सङ्ग्रामे देवसाहाय्यकारिणः
verses.transliteration: te rudrāḥ kāśyapā vīrā mahābalaparākramāḥ | daityān jaghnuśca saṅgrāme devasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: All the gods had formerly kept their respective weapons in the hermitage of Dadhica. Hence they were immediately defeated.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the gods had formerly kept their respective weapons in the hermitage of Dadhica. Hence they were immediately defeated.
verses.science: त्याग करके चले गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्रुद्रकृपया देवा दैत्यान् जित्वा च निर्भयाः । चक्रुः स्वराज्यं सर्वे ते शक्राद्याः स्वस्थमानसाः
verses.transliteration: tadrudrakṛpayā devā daityān jitvā ca nirbhayāḥ | cakruḥ svarājyaṃ sarve te śakrādyāḥ svasthamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Then the harassed gods and the sages along with Indra immediately went to Brahma's region and narrated their distress to him.
verses.hindi: संयत होकर तप करनेके लिये यहाँ आयी हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the harassed gods and the sages along with Indra immediately went to Brahma's region and narrated their distress to him.
verses.science: संयत होकर तप करनेके लिये यहाँ आयी हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि ते महारुद्राः सर्वे शिवस्वरूपकाः । देवानां रक्षणार्थाय विराजन्ते सदा दिवि
verses.transliteration: adyāpi te mahārudrāḥ sarve śivasvarūpakāḥ | devānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya virājante sadā divi
verses.translation: This Asura has been created by Tvastr by means of his penance in order to kill you. The name of that Asura is Vrtra. He is of great brilliance and the leader of all Daityas.
verses.hindi: आज भी शिवस्वरूप वे सभी महारुद्र देवताओंकी रक्षाके लिये सदा स्वर्गमें विराजमान हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: This Asura has been created by Tvastr by means of his penance in order to kill you. The name of that Asura is Vrtra. He is of great brilliance and the leader of all Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: ऐशान्यां पुरि ते वासं चक्रिरे भक्तवत्सलाः । विरमन्ते सदा तत्र नानालीलाविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: aiśānyāṃ puri te vāsaṃ cakrire bhaktavatsalāḥ | viramante sadā tatra nānālīlāviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: You shall make such efforts as would ensure his death. O intelligent one, listen to the means thereof. For the sake of virtue I shall tell you the same.
verses.hindi: वस्तुतः पतिरूपमें प्राप्त करना चाहती हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: You shall make such efforts as would ensure his death. O intelligent one, listen to the means thereof. For the sake of virtue I shall tell you the same.
verses.science: वस्तुतः पतिरूपमें प्राप्त करना चाहती हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषामनुचरा रुद्राः कोटिशः परिकीर्तिताः । सर्वत्र संस्थितास्तत्र त्रिलोकेष्वभिभागशः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmanucarā rudrāḥ koṭiśaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | sarvatra saṃsthitāstatra trilokeṣvabhibhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: You all request for his bones. He will undoubtedly give them to you. Make the thunderbolt staff therewith and kill Vrtra without hesitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: You all request for his bones. He will undoubtedly give them to you. Make the thunderbolt staff therewith and kill Vrtra without hesitation.
verses.science: कठोर तप कर रही हो 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते वर्णितास्तातावताराः शङ्करस्य वै । एकादशमिता रुद्राः सर्वलोकसुखावहाः
verses.transliteration: iti te varṇitāstātāvatārāḥ śaṅkarasya vai | ekādaśamitā rudrāḥ sarvalokasukhāvahāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, Indra accompa¬ nied by his preceptor and other gods went immediately to the excellent hermitage of Dadhici.
verses.hindi: है तात! इस प्रकार मैंने आपसे शंकरजीके अवतारोंका वर्णन किया; ये एकादश रुद्र सबको सुख प्रदान करनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma, Indra accompa¬ nied by his preceptor and other gods went immediately to the excellent hermitage of Dadhici.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानममलं सर्वपापप्रणाशकम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: idamākhyānamamalaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśakam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam
verses.translation: There Indra saw the sage in the company of Suvarca. Along with the preceptor and other gods he humbly and respectfully bowed to him with palms joined in reverence,
verses.hindi: आगे पुनः अनेक प्रकारसे अपनी निन्‍्दा की
verses.commentary: Sense: There Indra saw the sage in the company of Suvarca. Along with the preceptor and other gods he humbly and respectfully bowed to him with palms joined in reverence,
verses.science: आगे पुनः अनेक प्रकारसे अपनी निन्‍्दा की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयात्तात श्रावयेद्वै समाहितः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा ततो मुक्तिं लभेत सः
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāttāta śrāvayedvai samāhitaḥ | iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā tato muktiṃ labheta saḥ
verses.translation: On realising his intention the sage, the most ex¬ cellent of scholars sent his wife Suvarca to the inner apart¬ ments of the hermitage.
verses.hindi: आपका वध नहीं कर रही हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: On realising his intention the sage, the most ex¬ cellent of scholars sent his wife Suvarca to the inner apart¬ ments of the hermitage.
verses.science: आपका वध नहीं कर रही हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: With his backbone he made the thunderbolt, arrow and the missile called Brahmasiras. With the other bones he made many other weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his backbone he made the thunderbolt, arrow and the missile called Brahmasiras. With the other bones he made many other weapons.
verses.science: आकर अनेक प्रकारके वचन कहे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: With his backbone he made the thunderbolt, arrow and the missile called Brahmasiras. With the other bones he made many other weapons.
verses.hindi: लिये कोई भी वस्तु मुझे अदेय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: With his backbone he made the thunderbolt, arrow and the missile called Brahmasiras. With the other bones he made many other weapons.
verses.science: लिये कोई भी वस्तु मुझे अदेय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । दुर्वासश्चरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथान्यच्चरितं शम्भोः शृणु प्रीत्या महामुने । यथा बभूव दुर्वासाः शङ्करो धर्महेतवे
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.19. ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | durvāsaścaritavarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | athānyaccaritaṃ śambhoḥ śṛṇu prītyā mahāmune | yathā babhūva durvāsāḥ śaṅkaro dharmahetave
verses.translation: O sage, flourishing with Siva's brilliance, the in¬ furiated Indra lifted the thunderbolt and rushed against Vrtra like Rudra rushing against the.god of death.
verses.hindi: देखे मेरा एक-एक क्षण युगके समान बीत रहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, flourishing with Siva's brilliance, the in¬ furiated Indra lifted the thunderbolt and rushed against Vrtra like Rudra rushing against the.god of death.
verses.science: देखे मेरा एक-एक क्षण युगके समान बीत रहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपुत्रो बभूवातितपस्वी ब्रह्मवित्प्रभुः । अनसूयापतिर्धीमान्ब्रह्माज्ञाप्रतिपालकः
verses.transliteration: brahmaputro babhūvātitapasvī brahmavitprabhuḥ | anasūyāpatirdhīmānbrahmājñāpratipālakaḥ
verses.translation: O gentle lady, later on, you may do as you please. It is the command of Brahmfi that a pregnant woman should not bum herself.
verses.hindi: हैं और मैं सर्वदा आपकी भक्त हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, later on, you may do as you please. It is the command of Brahmfi that a pregnant woman should not bum herself.
verses.science: हैं और मैं सर्वदा आपकी भक्त हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुनिर्देशाद् ब्रह्मणो हि सस्त्रीकः पुत्रकाम्यया । स त्र्यक्षकुलनामानं ययौ च तपसे गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: sunirdeśād brahmaṇo hi sastrīkaḥ putrakāmyayā | sa tryakṣakulanāmānaṃ yayau ca tapase girim
verses.translation: On seeing him there, incarnated as the sage's son, they bowed to him with palms joined in reverence and made obeisances.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him there, incarnated as the sage's son, they bowed to him with palms joined in reverence and made obeisances.
verses.science: हास करते हुए देखा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणानायम्य विधिवन्निर्विन्ध्यातटिनीतटे । तपश्चचार सुमहद् अद्वन्द्वोऽब्दशतं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: prāṇānāyamya vidhivannirvindhyātaṭinītaṭe | tapaścacāra sumahad advandvo'bdaśataṃ muniḥ
verses.translation: Not identified, tiff. See F. 600 note.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not identified, tiff. See F. 600 note.
verses.science: कहिये, वे आपलोगोंका कार्य करेंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य एक ईश्वरः कश्चिदविकारी महाप्रभुः । स मे पुत्रवरं दद्यादिति निश्चितमानसः
verses.transliteration: ya eka īśvaraḥ kaścidavikārī mahāprabhuḥ | sa me putravaraṃ dadyāditi niścitamānasaḥ
verses.translation: If Saturn were to disregard my instruction and harass men, he will undoubtedly be reduced to ashes."
verses.hindi: उन्होंने अपने मनमें निश्चय किया कि जो एकमात्र अविकारी अनिर्वचनीय महाप्रभु ईश्वर हैं, वे मुझे श्रेष्ठ पुत्र प्रदान करेंगे
verses.commentary: Sense: If Saturn were to disregard my instruction and harass men, he will undoubtedly be reduced to ashes."

verses.sanskrit: बहुकालो व्यतीयाय तस्मिंस्तपति सत्तपः । आविर्बभूव तस्मात्तु शुचिर्ज्वाला महीयसी
verses.transliteration: bahukālo vyatīyāya tasmiṃstapati sattapaḥ | āvirbabhūva tasmāttu śucirjvālā mahīyasī
verses.translation: Thus that prostitute indulging in these delighthil pranks and pursuing devotional service* to Siva was very happy always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus that prostitute indulging in these delighthil pranks and pursuing devotional service* to Siva was very happy always.
verses.science: बलको रोक नहीं सके। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: तयासन्निखिला लोका दग्धप्राया मुनीश्वराः । तथा सुरर्षयः सर्वे पीडिता वासवादयः
verses.transliteration: tayāsannikhilā lokā dagdhaprāyā munīśvarāḥ | tathā surarṣayaḥ sarve pīḍitā vāsavādayaḥ
verses.translation: O beloved harlot, if your words are true, let it be as you say. I shall give you the gemset bangle. Be my wife for three days and nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved harlot, if your words are true, let it be as you say. I shall give you the gemset bangle. Be my wife for three days and nights.
verses.science: फल प्रदान करनेवाला है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सर्वे वासवाद्या सुराश्च मुनयो मुने । ब्रह्मस्थानं ययुः शीघ्रं तज्ज्वालातिप्रपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: atha sarve vāsavādyā surāśca munayo mune | brahmasthānaṃ yayuḥ śīghraṃ tajjvālātiprapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: After repeating this for three times, with the moon and the sun as witnesses, MahSnandS touched his heart with pleasure.
verses.hindi: लेकर सुखपूर्वक अपना समय बिताने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: After repeating this for three times, with the moon and the sun as witnesses, MahSnandS touched his heart with pleasure.
verses.science: लेकर सुखपूर्वक अपना समय बिताने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा नुत्वा विधिं देवाः तत्स्वदुःखं न्यवेदयन् । ब्रह्मा सह सुरैस्तात विष्णुलोकं ययावरम्
verses.transliteration: natvā nutvā vidhiṃ devāḥ tatsvaduḥkhaṃ nyavedayan | brahmā saha suraistāta viṣṇulokaṃ yayāvaram
verses.translation: After giving her the gemset bangle that merchant handed to her a gemset phallic image and spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving her the gemset bangle that merchant handed to her a gemset phallic image and spoke thus.
verses.science: महामुनि दुर्वासा पाण्डवोंके निकट गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा रमानाथं नत्वा नुत्वा विधिः सुरैः । स्वदुःखं तत्समाचख्यौ विष्णवेऽनन्तकं मुने
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā ramānāthaṃ natvā nutvā vidhiḥ suraiḥ | svaduḥkhaṃ tatsamācakhyau viṣṇave'nantakaṃ mune
verses.translation: O dear, thus this story of Vftra's slaughter is related to you as arising from the context. Now listen respect¬ fully to the incarnation of Siva as Pippalada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus this story of Vftra's slaughter is related to you as arising from the context. Now listen respect¬ fully to the incarnation of Siva as Pippalada.
verses.science: शीघ्र ही कैलासपर्वतपर चलता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुश्च विधिना देवै रुद्रस्थानं ययौ द्रुतम् । हरं प्रणम्य तत्रैत्य तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuśca vidhinā devai rudrasthānaṃ yayau drutam | haraṃ praṇamya tatraitya tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: At the behest of her lord Suvarca the chaste wife of the sage Dadhici the noble soul went to the inner apart¬ ments of the hermitage.
verses.hindi: आप मेरे पति हों--ऐसा पार्वतीने शिवसे कहा
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of her lord Suvarca the chaste wife of the sage Dadhici the noble soul went to the inner apart¬ ments of the hermitage.
verses.science: आप मेरे पति हों--ऐसा पार्वतीने शिवसे कहा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वा बहुतया विष्णुः स्वदुःखं च न्यवेदयत् । शर्वं ज्वालासमुद्भूतमत्रेश्च तपसः परम्
verses.transliteration: stutvā bahutayā viṣṇuḥ svaduḥkhaṃ ca nyavedayat | śarvaṃ jvālāsamudbhūtamatreśca tapasaḥ param
verses.translation: At the behest of her husband she finished her household duties and came there, 'fhe pitiable lady could n(}t see her lord there.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of her husband she finished her household duties and came there, 'fhe pitiable lady could n(}t see her lord there.
verses.science: देवताओंका कार्य सम्पन्न किया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तत्र समेतास्तु ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । मुने सम्मन्त्रयाञ्चक्रुरन्योऽन्यं जगतां हितम्
verses.transliteration: atha tatra sametāstu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | mune sammantrayāñcakruranyo'nyaṃ jagatāṃ hitam
verses.translation: Afler ccaning there and seeing the most inauspicious occurrence there, O excellent sage, the surprised Suvarca spoke to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afler ccaning there and seeing the most inauspicious occurrence there, O excellent sage, the surprised Suvarca spoke to the gods.
verses.science: सद्गति प्राप्त करेगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा ब्रह्मादयो देवास्त्रयस्ते वरदर्षभाः । जग्मुस्तदाश्रमं शीघ्रं वरं दातुं तदर्षये
verses.transliteration: tadā brahmādayo devāstrayaste varadarṣabhāḥ | jagmustadāśramaṃ śīghraṃ varaṃ dātuṃ tadarṣaye
verses.translation: The chaste lady, on realising that all this was the action of the gods, became angry. The infuriated wife of the excellent sage, Suvarca, cursed them.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ब्रह्मचारिशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयस्त्रिशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The chaste lady, on realising that all this was the action of the gods, became angry. The infuriated wife of the excellent sage, Suvarca, cursed them.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ब्रह्मचारिशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयस्त्रिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वचिह्नचिह्नितांस्तान्स दृष्ट्वात्रिर्मुनिसत्तमः । प्रणनाम च तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: svacihnacihnitāṃstānsa dṛṣṭvātrirmunisattamaḥ | praṇanāma ca tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirādarāt
verses.translation: **Ah! the gods are very wicked. They are covetous, stupid but very skiful in manipulating their own affairs. Let them all, inclusive of Indra, become beasts from today.**
verses.commentary: Sense: **Ah! the gods are very wicked. They are covetous, stupid but very skiful in manipulating their own affairs. Let them all, inclusive of Indra, become beasts from today.**
verses.science: नामक तेंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स विस्मितो विप्रस्तानुवाच कृताञ्जलिः । ब्रह्मपुत्रो विनीतात्मा ब्रह्मविष्णुहराभिधान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa vismito viprastānuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ | brahmaputro vinītātmā brahmaviṣṇuharābhidhān
verses.translation: Suvarca, a woman saint and the beloved wife of the sage cursed the gods inclusive of Indra thus.
verses.hindi: उन्हें भलीभाँति प्रणमकर वे कहने लगीं--
verses.commentary: Sense: Suvarca, a woman saint and the beloved wife of the sage cursed the gods inclusive of Indra thus.
verses.science: उन्हें भलीभाँति प्रणमकर वे कहने लगीं--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिरुवाच । हे ब्रह्मन् हे हरे रुद्र पूज्यास्त्रिजगतां मताः । प्रभवश्चेश्वराः सृष्टिरक्षासंहारकारकाः
verses.transliteration: atriruvāca | he brahman he hare rudra pūjyāstrijagatāṃ matāḥ | prabhavaśceśvarāḥ sṛṣṭirakṣāsaṃhārakārakāḥ
verses.translation: That chaste lady desired to go to the worlds of her husband. With the sacred twigs, the noble lady prepared the funeral pyre.
verses.hindi: तो मेरे पति बनें और मेरे ऊपर कृपा करें
verses.commentary: Sense: That chaste lady desired to go to the worlds of her husband. With the sacred twigs, the noble lady prepared the funeral pyre.
verses.science: तो मेरे पति बनें और मेरे ऊपर कृपा करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एक एव मया ध्यात ईश्वरः पुत्रहेतवे । यः कश्चिदीश्वरः ख्यातो जगतां स्वस्त्रिया सह
verses.transliteration: eka eva mayā dhyāta īśvaraḥ putrahetave | yaḥ kaścidīśvaraḥ khyāto jagatāṃ svastriyā saha
verses.translation: Then a pleasant celestial voice urged by liva spoke to Suvarcfi, consoling her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a pleasant celestial voice urged by liva spoke to Suvarcfi, consoling her.
verses.science: गृहस्थाश्रम पूरी तरहसे सफल करें। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यूयं त्रयस्सुराः कस्मादागता वरदर्षभाः । एतन्मे संशयं छित्त्वा ततो दत्तेप्सितं वरम्
verses.transliteration: yūyaṃ trayassurāḥ kasmādāgatā varadarṣabhāḥ | etanme saṃśayaṃ chittvā tato dattepsitaṃ varam
verses.translation: O intelligent lady, do not carry out this calami¬ tous task. Listen to my weighty words, llie semen of the sage is in your womb. Develop it carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent lady, do not carry out this calami¬ tous task. Listen to my weighty words, llie semen of the sage is in your womb. Develop it carefully.
verses.science: मेरा पाणिग्रहण करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य प्रत्यूचुस्ते सुरास्त्रयः । यादृक्कृतस्ते सङ्कल्पस्तथैवाभून्मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vacastasya pratyūcuste surāstrayaḥ | yādṛkkṛtaste saṅkalpastathaivābhūnmunīśvara
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying this the celestial voice stopped. On bearing that voice the wife of the sage was surprised for a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, after saying this the celestial voice stopped. On bearing that voice the wife of the sage was surprised for a moment.
verses.science: देखनेके लिये प्रसन्‍नतापूर्वक गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वयं त्रयो भवेशानाः समाना वरदर्षभाः । अस्मदंशभवास्तस्माद्भविष्यन्ति सुतास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ trayo bhaveśānāḥ samānā varadarṣabhāḥ | asmadaṃśabhavāstasmādbhaviṣyanti sutāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: That great chaste lady, Suvarcfi, desirous of attain¬ ing the world of her husband sat down and broke open her belly with a stone.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great chaste lady, Suvarcfi, desirous of attain¬ ing the world of her husband sat down and broke open her belly with a stone.
verses.science: मंगलाचार कराया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विदिता भुवने सर्वे पित्रोः कीर्तिविवर्द्धनाः । इत्युक्त्वा त्रयो देवाः स्वधामानि ययुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: viditā bhuvane sarve pitroḥ kīrtivivarddhanāḥ | ityuktvā trayo devāḥ svadhāmāni yayurmudā
verses.translation: The foetus of the child of the great sage, ofbril-
verses.commentary: Sense: The foetus of the child of the great sage, ofbril-
verses.science: मनोहर गान करने लगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वरं लब्ध्वा मुनिः सोऽथ जगाम स्वाश्रमं मुदा । युतोऽनुसूयया प्रीतो ब्रह्मानन्दप्रदो मुने
verses.transliteration: varaṃ labdhvā muniḥ so'tha jagāma svāśramaṃ mudā | yuto'nusūyayā prīto brahmānandaprado mune
verses.translation: On seeing her son of divine form, the beloved wife of the sage Suvarca realised in her mind that it was the incarnation of Rudra himself. The geat chaste lady became delighted, bowed to him and eulogised him. O great sage, that form of the child was impressed on her heart.
verses.hindi: हो गये और मेना भी मोहित हो उठीं
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her son of divine form, the beloved wife of the sage Suvarca realised in her mind that it was the incarnation of Rudra himself. The geat chaste lady became delighted, bowed to him and eulogised him. O great sage, that form of the child was impressed on her heart.
verses.science: हो गये और मेना भी मोहित हो उठीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ ब्रह्मा हरिः शम्भुरवतेरुः स्त्रियां ततः । पुत्ररूपैः प्रसन्नास्ते नानालीलाप्रकाशकाः
verses.transliteration: atha brahmā hariḥ śambhuravateruḥ striyāṃ tataḥ | putrarūpaiḥ prasannāste nānālīlāprakāśakāḥ
verses.translation: Suvarca of pure vision, the mother, desirous of going to her husband's region, smilingly and lovingly spoke to her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suvarca of pure vision, the mother, desirous of going to her husband's region, smilingly and lovingly spoke to her son.
verses.science: देनेके लिये गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विधेरंशाद्विधुर्जज्ञेऽनसूयायां मुनीश्वरात् । आविर्बभूवोदधितः क्षिप्तो देवैः स एव हि
verses.transliteration: vidheraṃśādvidhurjajñe'nasūyāyāṃ munīśvarāt | āvirbabhūvodadhitaḥ kṣipto devaiḥ sa eva hi
verses.translation: O dear, O lord Siva, O fortunate one, stay near this holy fig tree for a long time. Be the bestower of hap¬ piness to all.
verses.hindi: उत्तम नृत्य तथा गान करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, O lord Siva, O fortunate one, stay near this holy fig tree for a long time. Be the bestower of hap¬ piness to all.
verses.science: उत्तम नृत्य तथा गान करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरंशात् स्त्रियां तस्यामत्रेर्दत्तो व्यजायत । संन्यासपद्धतिर्येन वर्द्धिता परमा मुने
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoraṃśāt striyāṃ tasyāmatrerdatto vyajāyata | saṃnyāsapaddhatiryena varddhitā paramā mune
verses.translation: Out of affection allow me to go to the region of my husband. Staying there along with my husband I shall meditate on you in the form of Rudra.
verses.hindi: हे मुने! विष्णुके अंशसे अत्रिके द्वारा उन अनसूयासे दत्तात्रेय उत्पन्न हुए, जिन्होंने सर्वोत्तम संन्यासपद्धतिका संवर्धन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of affection allow me to go to the region of my husband. Staying there along with my husband I shall meditate on you in the form of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासा मुनिशार्दूलः शिवांशान्मुनिसत्तम । जज्ञे तस्यां स्त्रियामत्रेर्वरधर्मप्रवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: durvāsā muniśārdūlaḥ śivāṃśānmunisattama | jajñe tasyāṃ striyāmatrervaradharmapravartakaḥ
verses.translation: After speaking thus to her son that chaste lady Suvarca followed her husband by means of the great trans¬ cendental meditation.
verses.hindi: उस भिक्षुकको सामने आँगनमें स्थित देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: After speaking thus to her son that chaste lady Suvarca followed her husband by means of the great trans¬ cendental meditation.
verses.science: उस भिक्षुकको सामने आँगनमें स्थित देखा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा रुद्रश्च दुर्वासा ब्रह्मतेजोविवर्द्धनः । चक्रे धर्मपरीक्षां च बहूनां स दयापरः
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā rudraśca durvāsā brahmatejovivarddhanaḥ | cakre dharmaparīkṣāṃ ca bahūnāṃ sa dayāparaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime the delighted gods inclusive of Indra, hurriedly came there along with the sages as though invited there.
verses.hindi: निकालनेके लिये अपने सेवकोंको आज्ञा दी
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the delighted gods inclusive of Indra, hurriedly came there along with the sages as though invited there.
verses.science: निकालनेके लिये अपने सेवकोंको आज्ञा दी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यवंशे समुत्पन्नो योऽम्बरीषो नृपोऽभवत् । तत्परीक्षामकार्षीत्स तां शृणु त्वं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: sūryavaṃśe samutpanno yo'mbarīṣo nṛpo'bhavat | tatparīkṣāmakārṣītsa tāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: Vinu and Brahmi too, accompanied by their attendants came over there to see Siva who had taken in¬ carnation in the world through SuvarcS and Dadhici.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinu and Brahmi too, accompanied by their attendants came over there to see Siva who had taken in¬ carnation in the world through SuvarcS and Dadhici.
verses.science: अपना अनन्त प्रभाव दिखलाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽम्बरीषो नृपवरः सप्तद्वीपरसापतिः । नियमं हि चकारासावेकादश्यां व्रते दृढम्
verses.transliteration: so'mbarīṣo nṛpavaraḥ saptadvīparasāpatiḥ | niyamaṃ hi cakārāsāvekādaśyāṃ vrate dṛḍham
verses.translation: The sons of Gandharvas sang. Kinnaras and other players played on instruments. The gods showered flowers.
verses.hindi: और अन्य कुछ भी ग्रहण नहीं किया
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Gandharvas sang. Kinnaras and other players played on instruments. The gods showered flowers.
verses.science: और अन्य कुछ भी ग्रहण नहीं किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकादश्या व्रतं कृत्वा द्वादश्यां चैव पारणाम् । करिष्यामीति सुदृढसङ्कल्पस्तु नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśyā vrataṃ kṛtvā dvādaśyāṃ caiva pāraṇām | kariṣyāmīti sudṛḍhasaṅkalpastu narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: After consecrating the refulgent child and the fig tree who became tlie father of Rudra, Vi§nu and other gods eulogised him again.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: After consecrating the refulgent child and the fig tree who became tlie father of Rudra, Vi§nu and other gods eulogised him again.
verses.science: शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा तन्नियमं तस्य दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः । तदन्तिकं गतः शिष्यैर्बहुभिः शङ्करांशजः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā tanniyamaṃ tasya durvāsā munisattamaḥ | tadantikaṃ gataḥ śiṣyairbahubhiḥ śaṅkarāṃśajaḥ
verses.translation: The delighted Brahma named him Pippalada. Visu and the gods said "O lord of the gods be pleased'*.
verses.hindi: शिवजीमें उन दोनोंकी उत्कट भक्ति हो गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted Brahma named him Pippalada. Visu and the gods said "O lord of the gods be pleased'*.
verses.science: शिवजीमें उन दोनोंकी उत्कट भक्ति हो गयी। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पारणे द्वादशीं स्वल्पां ज्ञात्वा यावत्स भोजनम् । कर्त्तुं व्यवसितस्तावदागतं स न्यमन्त्रयत्
verses.transliteration: pāraṇe dvādaśīṃ svalpāṃ jñātvā yāvatsa bhojanam | karttuṃ vyavasitastāvadāgataṃ sa nyamantrayat
verses.translation: After saying this and making great jubilation, Brahma, Visnu and the gods went to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and making great jubilation, Brahma, Visnu and the gods went to their respective abodes.
verses.science: विधानके साथ किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नानार्थमगमद्दुर्वासाः शिष्यसंयुतः । विलम्बं कृतवांस्तत्र परीक्षार्थं मुनिर्बहु
verses.transliteration: tataḥ snānārthamagamaddurvāsāḥ śiṣyasaṃyutaḥ | vilambaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra parīkṣārthaṃ munirbahu
verses.translation: Then Rudra, the great lord in the form of Pippalada, performed a penance for a long time at the foot of the fig tree, with a desire to bestow benefit on the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rudra, the great lord in the form of Pippalada, performed a penance for a long time at the foot of the fig tree, with a desire to bestow benefit on the worlds.
verses.science: नाम चतुस्त्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मविघ्नं तदा ज्ञात्वा स नृपः शास्त्रशासनात् । जलं प्राश्यास्थितस्तत्र तदागमनकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: dharmavighnaṃ tadā jñātvā sa nṛpaḥ śāstraśāsanāt | jalaṃ prāśyāsthitastatra tadāgamanakāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: As Pippalada, following the convention of the world, performed the penance, a long time passed by.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Pippalada, following the convention of the world, performed the penance, a long time passed by.
verses.science: नामक चॉतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दुर्वासा मुनिरागतः । कृताशनं नृपं ज्ञात्वा परीक्षार्थं धृताकृतिः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra durvāsā munirāgataḥ | kṛtāśanaṃ nṛpaṃ jñātvā parīkṣārthaṃ dhṛtākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: After arranging and establishing Dharma with a desire for its good foundation, lord Siva performed great sports. O good sage, listen to that.
verses.commentary: Sense: After arranging and establishing Dharma with a desire for its good foundation, lord Siva performed great sports. O good sage, listen to that.
verses.science: आदरपूर्वक परस्पर मन्त्रणा को। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चुक्रोधाति नृपे तस्मिन्परीक्षार्थं वृषस्य सः । प्रोवाच वचनं तूग्रं स मुनिः शङ्करांशजः
verses.transliteration: cukrodhāti nṛpe tasminparīkṣārthaṃ vṛṣasya saḥ | provāca vacanaṃ tūgraṃ sa muniḥ śaṅkarāṃśajaḥ
verses.translation: Once while going to the river Pu?pabhadra*' for his ablution, the great sage saw the beautiful youthful maiden Padma, a part of Siva herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once while going to the river Pu?pabhadra*' for his ablution, the great sage saw the beautiful youthful maiden Padma, a part of Siva herself.
verses.science: रत्नगर्भा--यह नाम व्यर्थ हो जायगा। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासा उवाच । मां निमन्त्र्य नृपाभोज्य जलं पीतं त्वयाधम । दर्शयामि फलं तस्य दुष्टदण्डधरो ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: durvāsā uvāca | māṃ nimantrya nṛpābhojya jalaṃ pītaṃ tvayādhama | darśayāmi phalaṃ tasya duṣṭadaṇḍadharo hyaham
verses.translation: Desirous of getting her, the sage traversing the world and an expert in following the established conventions went to the abode of king Anaranya, her father.
verses.hindi: दुर्वासा बोले--हे अधम नृप! तुमने मुझे निमन्त्रण देकर बिना भोजन कराये ही जल पी लिया। मैं तुम्हें उसका फल दिखाता हूँ; क्योंकि में दुष्टोंको दण्ड देनेवाला हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of getting her, the sage traversing the world and an expert in following the established conventions went to the abode of king Anaranya, her father.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षो नृपं दग्धुं समुद्यतः । समुत्तस्थौ द्रुतं चक्रं तत्स्थं रक्षार्थमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣo nṛpaṃ dagdhuṃ samudyataḥ | samuttasthau drutaṃ cakraṃ tatsthaṃ rakṣārthamaiśvaram
verses.translation: On seeing him, the awe-struck king of men bowed to him. Offering him Madhuparka* he worshipped him devotedly.
verses.hindi: इतना कहकर क्रोधसे लाल नेत्रोंवाले वे ज्यों ही राजाको भस्म करनेके लिये उद्यत हुए, इतनेमें हो राजाके भीतर रहनेवाला ईश्वरका चक्र उनकी रक्षाके लिये शीघ्रतासे प्रकट हो गया
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, the awe-struck king of men bowed to him. Offering him Madhuparka* he worshipped him devotedly.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजज्वालाति तं चक्रं मुनिं दग्धुं सुदर्शनम् । शिवरूपं तमज्ञात्वा शिवमायाविमोहितम्
verses.transliteration: prajajvālāti taṃ cakraṃ muniṃ dagdhuṃ sudarśanam | śivarūpaṃ tamajñātvā śivamāyāvimohitam
verses.translation: The sage accepted everything with regard and requested for the hand his daughter. Thereupon the king was unable to say anything. He was silent.
verses.hindi: सर्व निवेदयामासुस्तद्वृत्तं पुरतो विधे:॥ १३  लोगोंने ब्रह्मके आगे सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage accepted everything with regard and requested for the hand his daughter. Thereupon the king was unable to say anything. He was silent.
verses.science: सर्व निवेदयामासुस्तद्वृत्तं पुरतो विधे:॥ १३ लोगोंने ब्रह्मके आगे सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे व्योमवाण्युवाचाशरीरिणी । अम्बरीषं महात्मानं ब्रह्मभक्तं च वैष्णवम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vyomavāṇyuvācāśarīriṇī | ambarīṣaṃ mahātmānaṃ brahmabhaktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam
verses.translation: The sage repeated the request, saying "Give me your daughter devoutly. Otherwise I will reduce everything to ashes along with you."
verses.hindi: प्रणामकर उन लोगोंने सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage repeated the request, saying "Give me your daughter devoutly. Otherwise I will reduce everything to ashes along with you."
verses.science: प्रणामकर उन लोगोंने सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्योमवाण्युवाच । सुदर्शनमिदं चक्रं हरये शम्भुनार्पितम् । शान्तं कुरु प्रज्वलितमद्य दुर्वाससे नृप
verses.transliteration: vyomavāṇyuvāca | sudarśanamidaṃ cakraṃ haraye śambhunārpitam | śāntaṃ kuru prajvalitamadya durvāsase nṛpa
verses.translation: O great sage, then all the people of the king were enveloped by the brilliance of Pippalada, son of Dadhici.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, then all the people of the king were enveloped by the brilliance of Pippalada, son of Dadhici.
verses.science: साथ शीघ्र हिमालयसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासायं शिवः साक्षात्स चक्रं हरयेऽर्पितम् । एवं साधारणमुनिं न जानीहि नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: durvāsāyaṃ śivaḥ sākṣātsa cakraṃ haraye'rpitam | evaṃ sādhāraṇamuniṃ na jānīhi nṛpottama
verses.translation: After marrying Padma, the daughter of the king and a part of Siva, the sage Pippalada joyously took her to his hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: After marrying Padma, the daughter of the king and a part of Siva, the sage Pippalada joyously took her to his hermitage.
verses.science: करना चाहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तव धर्मपरीक्षार्थमागतोऽयं मुनीश्वरः । शरणं याहि तस्याशु भविष्यत्यन्यथा लयः
verses.transliteration: tava dharmaparīkṣārthamāgato'yaṃ munīśvaraḥ | śaraṇaṃ yāhi tasyāśu bhaviṣyatyanyathā layaḥ
verses.translation: After going to the hermitage the aged excellent sage stayed there with that woman. The sage was not too indulgent.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going to the hermitage the aged excellent sage stayed there with that woman. The sage was not too indulgent.
verses.science: उपहास ही करेंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च नभोवाणी विरराम मुनीश्वर । अस्तावीत्स हरांशं तमम्बरीषोऽपि चादरात्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā ca nabhovāṇī virarāma munīśvara | astāvītsa harāṃśaṃ tamambarīṣo'pi cādarāt
verses.translation: Then the daughter of Anaranya served the sage with devotion, in mind, word and deed, like LaksmI serving Vi?nu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the daughter of Anaranya served the sage with devotion, in mind, word and deed, like LaksmI serving Vi?nu.
verses.science: तथा सदा अज्ञात गतिवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीष उवाच । यद्यस्ति दत्तमिष्टं च स्वधर्मो वा स्वनुष्ठितः । कुलं नो विप्रदैवं चेद्धरेरस्त्रं प्रशाम्यतु
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣa uvāca | yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṃ ca svadharmo vā svanuṣṭhitaḥ | kulaṃ no vipradaivaṃ ceddharerastraṃ praśāmyatu
verses.translation: Then the excellent sage Pippalada, a part of Siva, became a young man by means of his divine sport and sported with that young lady.
verses.hindi: कहकर शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the excellent sage Pippalada, a part of Siva, became a young man by means of his divine sport and sported with that young lady.
verses.science: कहकर शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि नो भगवान्प्रीतो मद्भक्तो भक्तवत्सलः । सुदर्शनमिदं चास्त्रं प्रशाम्यतु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yadi no bhagavānprīto madbhakto bhaktavatsalaḥ | sudarśanamidaṃ cāstraṃ praśāmyatu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Ten noble sons, all of them great sons, were born to the sage. They were equal to their father and increased the pleasure of Padma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ten noble sons, all of them great sons, were born to the sage. They were equal to their father and increased the pleasure of Padma.
verses.science: हमें क्या करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति स्तुवति रुद्राग्रे शैवं चक्रं सुदर्शनम् । अशाम्यत्सर्वथा ज्ञात्वा तं शिवांशं सुलब्धधीः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti stuvati rudrāgre śaivaṃ cakraṃ sudarśanam | aśāmyatsarvathā jñātvā taṃ śivāṃśaṃ sulabdhadhīḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the harassment by the planet Saturn of every one irremediably, the sympathetic lord lovingly granted a boon to all the world.
verses.hindi: नन्दीशएवर बोले--हे मुनीश्वर! इस प्रकार रुद्रांशभूत दुर्वासाके आगे अम्बरीषके स्तुति करनेपर [ आकाशवाणीसे] प्रेरित बुद्धिवाला वह शैव सुदर्शन चक्र उन्हें शिवांश जानकर पूर्ण रूपसे शान्त हो गया
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the harassment by the planet Saturn of every one irremediably, the sympathetic lord lovingly granted a boon to all the world.

verses.sanskrit: अथाम्बरीषः स नृपः प्रणनाम च तं मुनिम् । शिवावतारं संज्ञाय स्वपरीक्षार्थमागतम्
verses.transliteration: athāmbarīṣaḥ sa nṛpaḥ praṇanāma ca taṃ munim | śivāvatāraṃ saṃjñāya svaparīkṣārthamāgatam
verses.translation: "For sixteen years from birth no man will have that affliction. Similarly to the devotees of Siva too. This word of mine is true.
verses.commentary: Sense: "For sixteen years from birth no man will have that affliction. Similarly to the devotees of Siva too. This word of mine is true.
verses.science: वर्णन आपसे किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नो बभूवाथ स मुनिः शङ्करांशजः । भुक्त्वा तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा स्वाभीष्टं स्वालयं ययौ
verses.transliteration: suprasanno babhūvātha sa muniḥ śaṅkarāṃśajaḥ | bhuktvā tasmai varaṃ dattvā svābhīṣṭaṃ svālayaṃ yayau
verses.translation: O dear, thus, afraid of him the excellent planet Saturn, though in aberration, does not afflict men at anytime.
verses.hindi: ह्ति मा हक शतरुद्रसंहितायां साधुद्विजशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम पश्ञत्रिशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus, afraid of him the excellent planet Saturn, though in aberration, does not afflict men at anytime.
verses.science: ह्ति मा हक शतरुद्रसंहितायां साधुद्विजशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम पश्ञत्रिशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषपरीक्षायां दुर्वासश्चरितं मुने । प्रोक्तामन्यच्चरित्रं त्वं शृणु तस्य मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣaparīkṣāyāṃ durvāsaścaritaṃ mune | proktāmanyaccaritraṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu tasya munīśvara
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated to you the good story of the great sage Pippal&da who had assumed the form of p human being in the course of his divine sports. Hie story yields the fruit of all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have narrated to you the good story of the great sage Pippal&da who had assumed the form of p human being in the course of his divine sports. Hie story yields the fruit of all desires.
verses.science: नामक पेंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्दाशरथेश्चक्रे परीक्षां नियमेन वै । मुनिरूपेण कालेन यः कृतो नियमो मुने
verses.transliteration: punardāśaratheścakre parīkṣāṃ niyamena vai | munirūpeṇa kālena yaḥ kṛto niyamo mune
verses.translation: These three—Gidhi, Kauiika and die great sie Pippal&da quell the affliction of 9ani on being remembered.
verses.commentary: Sense: These three—Gidhi, Kauiika and die great sie Pippal&da quell the affliction of 9ani on being remembered.
verses.science: नामक श्रेष्ठ अवतारको सुनें। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तदैव मुनिना तेन सौमित्रिः प्रेषितो हठात् । तं तत्याज द्रुतं रामो बन्धुं पणवशान्मुने
verses.transliteration: tadaiva muninā tena saumitriḥ preṣito haṭhāt | taṃ tatyāja drutaṃ rāmo bandhuṃ paṇavaśānmune
verses.translation: For the dissolution of the affliction of Saturn, the man who reads or Ustens devoutly to the story of Pippal&da along with that of Padml attains all desires in diis world.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the dissolution of the affliction of Saturn, the man who reads or Ustens devoutly to the story of Pippal&da along with that of Padml attains all desires in diis world.
verses.science: समक्ष प्रकट हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा कथा विदिता लोके मुनिभिर्बहुधोदिता । नातो मे विस्तरात्प्रोक्ता ज्ञाता यत्सर्वथा बुधैः
verses.transliteration: sā kathā viditā loke munibhirbahudhoditā | nāto me vistarātproktā jñātā yatsarvathā budhaiḥ
verses.translation: O dear sage, listen to me. 1 shall tell you about Vaiiyan&tha, the incarnation of Siva, the supreme soul that yields great bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear sage, listen to me. 1 shall tell you about Vaiiyan&tha, the incarnation of Siva, the supreme soul that yields great bliss.
verses.science: प्रसन्‍नचित्त होकर उनकी स्तुति की। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नियमं सुदृढं दृष्ट्वा सुप्रसन्नोऽभवन्मुनिः । दुर्वासाः सप्रसन्नात्मा वरं तस्मै प्रदत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: niyamaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ dṛṣṭvā suprasanno'bhavanmuniḥ | durvāsāḥ saprasannātmā varaṃ tasmai pradattavān
verses.translation: She always worshipped Siva and Pihrvad with great joy. She was interested in recounting the names of Siva. She used to wear ashes and Rudrak.
verses.hindi: प्रभु शंकरने द्रोणाचार्यसे ' वर माँगो '--ऐसा कहा
verses.commentary: Sense: She always worshipped Siva and Pihrvad with great joy. She was interested in recounting the names of Siva. She used to wear ashes and Rudrak.
verses.science: प्रभु शंकरने द्रोणाचार्यसे ' वर माँगो '--ऐसा कहा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्णनियमस्यापि परीक्षां स चकार ह । तां शृणु त्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कथयामि कथां च ताम्
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣṇaniyamasyāpi parīkṣāṃ sa cakāra ha | tāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ muniśreṣṭha kathayāmi kathāṃ ca tām
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva, the lord of the universe she used to dance with great devotion and sing the great glory of Siva.
verses.hindi: अपने अंशसे उत्पन्न एक पुत्र दीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Siva, the lord of the universe she used to dance with great devotion and sing the great glory of Siva.
verses.science: अपने अंशसे उत्पन्न एक पुत्र दीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मप्रार्थनया विष्णुर्वसुदेवसुतोऽभवत् । धराभारावतारार्थं साधूनां रक्षणाय च
verses.transliteration: brahmaprārthanayā viṣṇurvasudevasuto'bhavat | dharābhārāvatārārthaṃ sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca
verses.translation: She kept a monkey and a cock which she decorated with Rudrikas. She made them dance singing herself and clapping her hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: She kept a monkey and a cock which she decorated with Rudrikas. She made them dance singing herself and clapping her hands.
verses.science: पुत्रके रूपमें उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा दुष्टान्महापापान् ब्रह्मद्रोहकरान्खलान् । ररक्ष निखिलान्साधून्ब्राह्मणान्कृष्णनामभाक्
verses.transliteration: hatvā duṣṭānmahāpāpān brahmadrohakarānkhalān | rarakṣa nikhilānsādhūnbrāhmaṇānkṛṣṇanāmabhāk
verses.translation: On seeing them dance, she, engrossed in devotion to Siva, used to laugh lovingly along with her friends and attendants.
verses.hindi: थीं और वे शत्रुपक्षका विनाश करनेवाले थे
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them dance, she, engrossed in devotion to Siva, used to laugh lovingly along with her friends and attendants.
verses.science: थीं और वे शत्रुपक्षका विनाश करनेवाले थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभक्तिं चकाराति स कृष्णो वसुदेवजः । नित्यं हि भोजयामास सुरसान्ब्राह्मणान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: brahmabhaktiṃ cakārāti sa kṛṣṇo vasudevajaḥ | nityaṃ hi bhojayāmāsa surasānbrāhmaṇānbahūn
verses.translation: The monkey, as a result of her instruction, danced before her, like a boy bedecked in Rudrik$as as ear-rings, and shoulderlets.
verses.hindi: करके उन कौरवोंपर विजय प्राप्त की
verses.commentary: Sense: The monkey, as a result of her instruction, danced before her, like a boy bedecked in Rudrik$as as ear-rings, and shoulderlets.
verses.science: करके उन कौरवोंपर विजय प्राप्त की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभक्तो विशेषेण कृष्णश्चेति प्रथामगात् । सन्द्रष्टुकामः स मुनिः कृष्णान्तिकमगान्मुने
verses.transliteration: brahmabhakto viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇaśceti prathāmagāt | sandraṣṭukāmaḥ sa muniḥ kṛṣṇāntikamagānmune
verses.translation: O excellent sage, a long time thus elapsed when she was quite happy performing her devotional service to Siva.
verses.hindi: रहा है, मैं इसे नहीं जान पा रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, a long time thus elapsed when she was quite happy performing her devotional service to Siva.
verses.science: रहा है, मैं इसे नहीं जान पा रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मिणीसहितं कृष्णं सन्नं कृत्वा रथे स्वयम् । संयोज्य संस्थितो वाहं सुप्रसन्न उवाह तम्
verses.transliteration: rukmiṇīsahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sannaṃ kṛtvā rathe svayam | saṃyojya saṃsthito vāhaṃ suprasanna uvāha tam
verses.translation: Once Siva assumed the form of a merchant and vidted her house to test her. He had assumed the auspi¬ cious form of a devotee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once Siva assumed the form of a merchant and vidted her house to test her. He had assumed the auspi¬ cious form of a devotee.
verses.science: करते हुए आदरपूर्वक अर्जुससे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुनी रथात्समुत्तीर्य दृष्ट्वा तां दृढतां पराम् । तस्मै भूत्वा सुप्रसन्नो वज्राङ्गत्ववरं ददौ
verses.transliteration: munī rathātsamuttīrya dṛṣṭvā tāṃ dṛḍhatāṃ parām | tasmai bhūtvā suprasanno vajrāṅgatvavaraṃ dadau
verses.translation: He had smeared ashes all over his body. Round his wrist was tied an excellent bangle set wiUi gems.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had smeared ashes all over his body. Round his wrist was tied an excellent bangle set wiUi gems.
verses.science: ही अश्वत्थामापर छोड़ा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्युनद्यामेकदा स्नानं कुर्वन्नग्नो बभूव ह । लज्जितोऽभून्मुनिश्रेष्ठो दुर्वासाः कौतुकी मुने
verses.transliteration: dyunadyāmekadā snānaṃ kurvannagno babhūva ha | lajjito'bhūnmuniśreṣṭho durvāsāḥ kautukī mune
verses.translation: The beautiful prostitute worshipped and welcomed the visitor with great joy. She made him sit with great respect.
verses.hindi: हे मुने। एक समय गंगाजीमें स्नान करते हुए मुनिश्रेष्ठ दुर्वासा नग्न हों गये थे; उस समर्य बे कौतुकी मुनि लज्जाका अनुभव करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: The beautiful prostitute worshipped and welcomed the visitor with great joy. She made him sit with great respect.

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञात्वा द्रौपदी स्नानं कुर्वती तत्र चादरात् । तल्लज्जां छादयामास भिन्नस्वाञ्चलदानतः
verses.transliteration: tajjñātvā draupadī snānaṃ kurvatī tatra cādarāt | tallajjāṃ chādayāmāsa bhinnasvāñcaladānataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the excellent bangle round his wrist she coveted the same. In great surprise she said.
verses.hindi: करते हैं तथा संहार करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the excellent bangle round his wrist she coveted the same. In great surprise she said.
verses.science: करते हैं तथा संहार करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदादाय प्रवाहेनागतं स्वनिकटं मुनिः । तेनाच्छाद्य स्वगुह्यं च तस्यै तुष्टो बभूव सः
verses.transliteration: tadādāya pravāhenāgataṃ svanikaṭaṃ muniḥ | tenācchādya svaguhyaṃ ca tasyai tuṣṭo babhūva saḥ
verses.translation: This bangle set with great gems arouncf your arm captivates my mind. It is worthy of being an ornament of a celestial damsel.
verses.commentary: Sense: This bangle set with great gems arouncf your arm captivates my mind. It is worthy of being an ornament of a celestial damsel.
verses.science: बालकको विनष्ट करनेका निश्चय किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्रौपद्यै च वरं प्रादात्तदञ्चलविवर्द्धनम् । पाण्डवान्सुखिनश्चक्रे द्रौपदी तद्वरात्पुनः
verses.transliteration: draupadyai ca varaṃ prādāttadañcalavivarddhanam | pāṇḍavānsukhinaścakre draupadī tadvarātpunaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that she wished for the bangle set with nine gems, the liberal-minded merchant spoke smilingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that she wished for the bangle set with nine gems, the liberal-minded merchant spoke smilingly.
verses.science: श्रीकृष्णकी स्तुति करने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हंसडिम्भौ नृपौ कौचित्स्वावमानकरौ खलौ । दत्त्वा निदेशं च हरेर्नाशयामास स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: haṃsaḍimbhau nṛpau kaucitsvāvamānakarau khalau | dattvā nideśaṃ ca harernāśayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: If your mind wishes for this excellent gemset ornament you can have it with pleasure. But what is the price you are willing to pay?
verses.commentary: Sense: If your mind wishes for this excellent gemset ornament you can have it with pleasure. But what is the price you are willing to pay?
verses.science: अश्वत्थामा उदास हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मतेजो विशेषेण स्थापयामास भूतले । संन्यासपद्धतिं चैव यथाशास्त्रविधिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: brahmatejo viśeṣeṇa sthāpayāmāsa bhūtale | saṃnyāsapaddhatiṃ caiva yathāśāstravidhikramam
verses.translation: We are prostitutes flirting here and there and not chaste ladies. Undoubtedly the regular practice observed in our family is harlotry.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने पृथ्वीपर विशेषरूपसे ब्रह्मतज और शास्त्रकी रीतिके अनुसार संन्यासपद्धतिकी स्थापना की
verses.commentary: Sense: We are prostitutes flirting here and there and not chaste ladies. Undoubtedly the regular practice observed in our family is harlotry.

verses.sanskrit: बहूनुद्धारयामास सूपदेशं विबोध्य च । ज्ञानं दत्त्वा विशेषेण बहून्मुक्तांश्चकार सः
verses.transliteration: bahūnuddhārayāmāsa sūpadeśaṃ vibodhya ca | jñānaṃ dattvā viśeṣeṇa bahūnmuktāṃścakāra saḥ
verses.translation: If I take the bangle from you I shall be your wife for three full days and nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: If I take the bangle from you I shall be your wife for three full days and nights.
verses.science: उन्हें अनेक प्रकारके वर दिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं चक्रे स दुर्वासा विचित्रं चरितं बहु । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं शृण्वतः सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ cakre sa durvāsā vicitraṃ caritaṃ bahu | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ śṛṇvataḥ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: In this deal the witnesses arc the moon and the sun. Repeat three times "True" and touch my heart, O beloved.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन दुर्वासाने अनेक विचित्र चरित्र किये। [दुर्वासाका] यह चरित्र श्रवण करनेवालेको धन, यश तथा आयु प्रदान करनेवाला और सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंको देनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: In this deal the witnesses arc the moon and the sun. Repeat three times "True" and touch my heart, O beloved.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या दुर्वासश्चरितं मुदा । श्रावयेद्वा परान् यश्च स सुखीह परत्र च
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā durvāsaścaritaṃ mudā | śrāvayedvā parān yaśca sa sukhīha paratra ca
verses.translation: O lord, I shall be your wife for three days and carry out all wifely duties. This is true. This is undoubtedly true.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I shall be your wife for three days and carry out all wifely duties. This is true. This is undoubtedly true.
verses.science: नामक छत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: During the night she had her sexual union with the merchant who behaved like a libertine. She then went to sleep on the couch brilliant with a soH; bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the night she had her sexual union with the merchant who behaved like a libertine. She then went to sleep on the couch brilliant with a soH; bed.
verses.science: स्नान करनेहेतु भेज दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: During the night she had her sexual union with the merchant who behaved like a libertine. She then went to sleep on the couch brilliant with a soH; bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the night she had her sexual union with the merchant who behaved like a libertine. She then went to sleep on the couch brilliant with a soH; bed.
verses.science: लगाकर उन सभीको तृप्त किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
