verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । हनुमदवतारचरित्रवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अतः परं शृणु प्रीत्या हनुमच्चरितं मुने । यथा चकाराशु हरो लीलास्तद्रूपतो वराः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.20. viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | hanumadavatāracaritravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇu prītyā hanumaccaritaṃ mune | yathā cakārāśu haro līlāstadrūpato varāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, then at midnight, at the will of the lordly merchant, suddenly there arose a fire'® in the middle of the dancing platform.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, then at midnight, at the will of the lordly merchant, suddenly there arose a fire'® in the middle of the dancing platform.
verses.science: समय दुःखसे निवृत्त हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चकार सुहितं प्रीत्या रामस्य परमेश्वरः । तत्सर्वं चरितं विप्र शृणु सर्वसुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: cakāra suhitaṃ prītyā rāmasya parameśvaraḥ | tatsarvaṃ caritaṃ vipra śṛṇu sarvasukhāvaham
verses.translation: O excellent sage, on seeing him enter die pyre, the harlot was dismayed. The youthful maiden sympathised with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, on seeing him enter die pyre, the harlot was dismayed. The youthful maiden sympathised with him.
verses.science: कृपा करनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्समये शम्भुरद्भुतोतिकरः प्रभुः । ददर्श मोहिनीरूपं विष्णोः स हि वसेद्गुणः
verses.transliteration: ekasminsamaye śambhuradbhutotikaraḥ prabhuḥ | dadarśa mohinīrūpaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa hi vasedguṇaḥ
verses.translation: When Siva, lord of Parvad, favourably disposedto his devotees said thus, the harlot Mahananda replied to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Siva, lord of Parvad, favourably disposedto his devotees said thus, the harlot Mahananda replied to Siva.
verses.science: उत्तम मन्त्र प्रदान करेंगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्रे स्वं क्षुभितं शम्भुः कामबाणहतो यथा । स्वं वीर्यं पातयामास रामकार्यार्थमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: cakre svaṃ kṣubhitaṃ śambhuḥ kāmabāṇahato yathā | svaṃ vīryaṃ pātayāmāsa rāmakāryārthamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: In that beautiful forest, the king sported about along with his beloved who protected those who sought refuge in her.
verses.hindi: दर्शन प्राप्तकर हमलोग आनन्दित रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: In that beautiful forest, the king sported about along with his beloved who protected those who sought refuge in her.
verses.science: दर्शन प्राप्तकर हमलोग आनन्दित रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वीर्यं स्थापयामासुः पत्रे सप्तर्षयश्च ते । प्रेरिता मनसा तेन रामकार्यार्थमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tadvīryaṃ sthāpayāmāsuḥ patre saptarṣayaśca te | preritā manasā tena rāmakāryārthamādarāt
verses.translation: Then, in order to test his steadfastness* and pety, lord iSiva carried out his'sports there itself along with Sivi*
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, in order to test his steadfastness* and pety, lord iSiva carried out his'sports there itself along with Sivi*
verses.science: धर्मराजने उनसे यह पूछा--। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तैर्गौतमसुतायां तद्वीर्यं शम्भोर्महर्षिभिः । कर्णद्वारा तथाञ्जन्यां रामकार्यार्थमाहितम्
verses.transliteration: tairgautamasutāyāṃ tadvīryaṃ śambhormaharṣibhiḥ | karṇadvārā tathāñjanyāṃ rāmakāryārthamāhitam
verses.translation: Siva and Siva in their own divine sports assumed the form of a brahmin couple and created an illu8(Hy tm* with their M3yi.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! मैं आपसे जो पूछता हूँ, उसे बताइये
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva and Siva in their own divine sports assumed the form of a brahmin couple and created an illu8(Hy tm* with their M3yi.
verses.science: हे प्रभो! मैं आपसे जो पूछता हूँ, उसे बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च समये तस्माद्धनूमानिति नामभाक् । शम्भुर्जज्ञे कपितनुर्महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tataśca samaye tasmāddhanūmāniti nāmabhāk | śambhurjajñe kapitanurmahābalaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Not far from the place where the king stood diey beg<in running in great fright on being pursued by the tier. They cried and shouted too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not far from the place where the king stood diey beg<in running in great fright on being pursued by the tier. They cried and shouted too.
verses.science: है, अन्य किसीको नहीं 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हनूमान्स कपीशानः शिशुरेव महाबलः । रविबिम्बं बभक्षाशु ज्ञात्वा लघुफलं प्रगे
verses.transliteration: hanūmānsa kapīśānaḥ śiśureva mahābalaḥ | ravibimbaṃ babhakṣāśu jñātvā laghuphalaṃ prage
verses.translation: O dear, the king Bhadriyu, the leading Kfatriya worthy of being sought refuge in, saw both of them highly distressed and lamenting.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, the king Bhadriyu, the leading Kfatriya worthy of being sought refuge in, saw both of them highly distressed and lamenting.
verses.science: अधिक दु:ख प्राप्त हुआ था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवप्रार्थनया तं सोऽत्यजज्ज्ञात्वा महाबलम् । शिवावतारं च प्राप वरान्दत्तान् सुरर्षभिः
verses.transliteration: devaprārthanayā taṃ so'tyajajjñātvā mahābalam | śivāvatāraṃ ca prāpa varāndattān surarṣabhiḥ
verses.translation: O leading sage, the illusory brahmin couple, ex¬ tremely terrified, spoke to the king Bhadrfiyu.
verses.hindi: तब देवताओंकी प्रार्थनासे उन्होंने सूर्यको उगल दिया। उन्हें महाबली शिवावतार जानकर देवताओं तथा ऋषियोंके द्वारा प्रदत्त वरोंको उन्होंने प्राप्त किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sage, the illusory brahmin couple, ex¬ tremely terrified, spoke to the king Bhadrfiyu.

verses.sanskrit: स्वजनन्यन्तिकं प्रागादथ सोऽतिप्रहर्षितः । हनूमान्सर्वमाचख्यौ तस्यै तद् वृत्तमादरात्
verses.transliteration: svajananyantikaṃ prāgādatha so'tipraharṣitaḥ | hanūmānsarvamācakhyau tasyai tad vṛttamādarāt
verses.translation: The blazing fire helped by a forceful wind envel¬ oped the dancing platform all of a sudden.
verses.hindi: कमलोंका स्मरण करके पाण्डवोंसे यह कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: The blazing fire helped by a forceful wind envel¬ oped the dancing platform all of a sudden.
verses.science: कमलोंका स्मरण करके पाण्डवोंसे यह कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञया ततो धीरः सर्वविद्यामयत्नतः । सूर्यात्पपाठ स कपिर्गत्वा नित्यं तदन्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: tadājñayā tato dhīraḥ sarvavidyāmayatnataḥ | sūryātpapāṭha sa kapirgatvā nityaṃ tadantikam
verses.translation: Freed from the bondage the monkey in its fear ran here and there along with the cock and scattered sparks of fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Freed from the bondage the monkey in its fear ran here and there along with the cock and scattered sparks of fire.
verses.science: उत्तम सामर्थ्य प्राप्त कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याज्ञया तदंशत्य सुग्रीवस्यान्तिकं ययौ । मातुराज्ञामनुप्राप्य रुद्रांशः कपिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sūryājñayā tadaṃśatya sugrīvasyāntikaṃ yayau | māturājñāmanuprāpya rudrāṃśaḥ kapisattamaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the phallic image burnt along with the pillar and smashed utterly, the prostitute and the mer¬ chant felt endless distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the phallic image burnt along with the pillar and smashed utterly, the prostitute and the mer¬ chant felt endless distress.
verses.science: करते हुए वहाँ आये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठभ्रात्रा वालिना हि स्वस्त्रीभोक्त्रा तिरस्कृतः । ऋष्यमूकगिरौ तेन न्यवसत्स हनूमता
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhabhrātrā vālinā hi svastrībhoktrā tiraskṛtaḥ | ṛṣyamūkagirau tena nyavasatsa hanūmatā
verses.translation: On seeing the phallic image as it were his very soul burnt, the lordly merchant desired to end his life in order to know her mentality.
verses.hindi: और कहा कि हम धन्य हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the phallic image as it were his very soul burnt, the lordly merchant desired to end his life in order to know her mentality.
verses.science: और कहा कि हम धन्य हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभूत्स सुकण्ठस्य मन्त्री कपिवरः सुधीः । सर्वथा सुहितं चक्रे सुग्रीवस्य हरांशजः
verses.transliteration: tato'bhūtsa sukaṇṭhasya mantrī kapivaraḥ sudhīḥ | sarvathā suhitaṃ cakre sugrīvasya harāṃśajaḥ
verses.translation: In great despair and sorrow the merchant told her in grief. Lord l§iva who had assumed a human body just for pleasure indulged in different sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: In great despair and sorrow the merchant told her in grief. Lord l§iva who had assumed a human body just for pleasure indulged in different sports.
verses.science: आपके दर्शनसे तृप्त हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागतेन सभ्रात्रा हृतभार्येण दुःखिना । कारयामास रामेण तस्य सख्यं सुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāgatena sabhrātrā hṛtabhāryeṇa duḥkhinā | kārayāmāsa rāmeṇa tasya sakhyaṃ sukhāvaham
verses.translation: "O my beloved, when the phallic image is smashed and burnt I do not desire to live. I am telling you the truth. There is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O my beloved, when the phallic image is smashed and burnt I do not desire to live. I am telling you the truth. There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: निश्चित रूपसे चला जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घातयामास रामश्च वालिनं कपिकुञ्जरम् । भ्रातृपत्न्याश्च भोक्तारं पापिनं वीरमानिनम्
verses.transliteration: ghātayāmāsa rāmaśca vālinaṃ kapikuñjaram | bhrātṛpatnyāśca bhoktāraṃ pāpinaṃ vīramāninam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, prepare a pyre for me immediately through your servants. With my mind fixed in Siva, I shall enter the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, prepare a pyre for me immediately through your servants. With my mind fixed in Siva, I shall enter the fire.
verses.science: दीनजनोंका परिपालन करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामाज्ञया तात हनूमान्वानरेश्वरः । स सीतान्वेषणं चक्रे बहुभिर्वानरैः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tato rāmājñayā tāta hanūmānvānareśvaraḥ | sa sītānveṣaṇaṃ cakre bahubhirvānaraiḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: Read for in the printed Skt. text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Read for in the printed Skt. text.
verses.science: सत्यका लोप नहीं होने दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा लङ्कागतां सीतां गतस्तत्र कपीश्वरः । द्रुतमुल्लङ्घ्य सिन्धुं तमनिस्तीर्यं परैः स वै
verses.transliteration: jñātvā laṅkāgatāṃ sītāṃ gatastatra kapīśvaraḥ | drutamullaṅghya sindhuṃ tamanistīryaṃ paraiḥ sa vai
verses.translation: Even if Brahma, Indra, Viu and others were to
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if Brahma, Indra, Viu and others were to
verses.science: त्याग नहीं करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्रेऽद्भुतचरित्रं स तत्र विक्रमसंयुतम् । अभिज्ञानं ददौ प्रीत्या सीतायै स्वप्रभोर्वरम्
verses.transliteration: cakre'dbhutacaritraṃ sa tatra vikramasaṃyutam | abhijñānaṃ dadau prītyā sītāyai svaprabhorvaram
verses.translation: On realising his tenacious decision the harlot was much distressed. Outside her house she caused the pyre to be made through her servants.
verses.hindi: प्रति पक्षपात उचित कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: On realising his tenacious decision the harlot was much distressed. Outside her house she caused the pyre to be made through her servants.
verses.science: प्रति पक्षपात उचित कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सीताशोकं जहाराशु स वीरः कपिनायकः । श्रावयित्वा रामवृत्तं तत्प्राणावनकारकम्
verses.transliteration: sītāśokaṃ jahārāśu sa vīraḥ kapināyakaḥ | śrāvayitvā rāmavṛttaṃ tatprāṇāvanakārakam
verses.translation: The miserable harlot remembered the sacred vow and said piteously glancing at all her kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: The miserable harlot remembered the sacred vow and said piteously glancing at all her kinsmen.
verses.science: आपलोग धर्मात्मा एवं सत्यवादी हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदभिज्ञानमादाय निवृत्तो रामसन्निधिम् । रावणाराममाहत्य जघान बहुराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: tadabhijñānamādāya nivṛtto rāmasannidhim | rāvaṇārāmamāhatya jaghāna bahurākṣasān
verses.translation: Taking the gemset bangle I had taken the pledge that I shall be the avowed wife of this merchant for three days.
verses.hindi: शुभ होगा, इसमें सन्देहकी आवश्यकता नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the gemset bangle I had taken the pledge that I shall be the avowed wife of this merchant for three days.
verses.science: शुभ होगा, इसमें सन्देहकी आवश्यकता नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदैव रावणसुतं हत्वा सबहुराक्षसम् । स महोपद्रवं चक्रे महोतिस्तत्र निर्भयः
verses.transliteration: tadaiva rāvaṇasutaṃ hatvā sabahurākṣasam | sa mahopadravaṃ cakre mahotistatra nirbhayaḥ
verses.translation: Truthful preceptors have ordained that a wife shall observe her duty. If I do likewise my truthfulness will not be marred.
verses.hindi: बार निरन्तर दुःख ही दे रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Truthful preceptors have ordained that a wife shall observe her duty. If I do likewise my truthfulness will not be marred.
verses.science: बार निरन्तर दुःख ही दे रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा दग्धो रावणेनावगुण्ठ्य वसनानि च । तैलाभ्यक्तानि सुदृढं महाबलवता मुने
verses.transliteration: yadā dagdho rāvaṇenāvaguṇṭhya vasanāni ca | tailābhyaktāni sudṛḍhaṃ mahābalavatā mune
verses.translation: Although prevented by her kinsmen the harlot was obstinate in her resolve. The woman eager in the attainment of Satyaloka decided on giving up her life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although prevented by her kinsmen the harlot was obstinate in her resolve. The woman eager in the attainment of Satyaloka decided on giving up her life.
verses.science: पुनः उस देवमार्गका उपदेश कीजिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्प्लुत्योत्प्लुत्य च तदा महादेवांशजः कपिः । ददाह लङ्कां निखिलां कृत्वा व्याजं तमेव हि
verses.transliteration: utplutyotplutya ca tadā mahādevāṃśajaḥ kapiḥ | dadāha laṅkāṃ nikhilāṃ kṛtvā vyājaṃ tameva hi
verses.translation: She gifted away her property to leading brahmins. She meditated on Sadiiiva. She circumambulated the fire thrice and stood ready to enter it.
verses.hindi: ध्यान करके पाण्डवोंसे प्रेमपूर्वक कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: She gifted away her property to leading brahmins. She meditated on Sadiiiva. She circumambulated the fire thrice and stood ready to enter it.
verses.science: ध्यान करके पाण्डवोंसे प्रेमपूर्वक कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वा लङ्कां वञ्चयित्वा विभीषणगृहं ततः । अपतद्वारिधौ वीरस्ततः स कपिकुञ्जरः
verses.transliteration: dagdhvā laṅkāṃ vañcayitvā vibhīṣaṇagṛhaṃ tataḥ | apatadvāridhau vīrastataḥ sa kapikuñjaraḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the three-eyed lord of the gods, deco¬ rated by the moon's digit, and as brilliant as crores of moons, suns and fires she stood as if stimned and firightened.
verses.hindi: मैं भी सदाशिवकी उपासना करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the three-eyed lord of the gods, deco¬ rated by the moon's digit, and as brilliant as crores of moons, suns and fires she stood as if stimned and firightened.
verses.science: मैं भी सदाशिवकी उपासना करता हूँ। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वपुच्छं तत्र निर्वाप्य प्राप तस्य परन्तटम् । अखिन्नः स ययौ रामसन्निधिं गिरिशांशजः
verses.transliteration: svapucchaṃ tatra nirvāpya prāpa tasya parantaṭam | akhinnaḥ sa yayau rāmasannidhiṃ giriśāṃśajaḥ
verses.translation: The lord caught hold of the hands of the frigh¬ tened and agitated lady, stunned, trembling and shedding tears. He consoled her and spoke.
verses.hindi: सेवा न करनेके कारण ही सारा दुःख होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord caught hold of the hands of the frigh¬ tened and agitated lady, stunned, trembling and shedding tears. He consoled her and spoke.
verses.science: सेवा न करनेके कारण ही सारा दुःख होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अविलम्बेन सुजवो हनूमान् कपिसत्तमः । रामोपकण्ठमागत्य ददौ सीताशिरोमणिम्
verses.transliteration: avilambena sujavo hanūmān kapisattamaḥ | rāmopakaṇṭhamāgatya dadau sītāśiromaṇim
verses.translation: With my magic 1 produced the blazing fire and burnt your dancing platform. After burning the gemset phallic image I entered fire myself.
verses.hindi: रक्षक सर्वोत्कृष्ट परब्रह्म शिवका दर्शन प्राप्त करो
verses.commentary: Sense: With my magic 1 produced the blazing fire and burnt your dancing platform. After burning the gemset phallic image I entered fire myself.
verses.science: रक्षक सर्वोत्कृष्ट परब्रह्म शिवका दर्शन प्राप्त करो। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तदाज्ञया वीरः सिन्धौ सेतुमबन्धयत् । वानरैः स समानीय बहून् गिरिवरान् बली
verses.transliteration: tatastadājñayā vīraḥ sindhau setumabandhayat | vānaraiḥ sa samānīya bahūn girivarān balī
verses.translation: But you remembered the promise and entered the fire along with me. Hence I shall give you such pleasures as are inaccessible to gods.
verses.hindi: वह पूजा तथा ध्यान करनेयोग्य है
verses.commentary: Sense: But you remembered the promise and entered the fire along with me. Hence I shall give you such pleasures as are inaccessible to gods.
verses.science: वह पूजा तथा ध्यान करनेयोग्य है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र ततो रामस्तर्तुकामो यथा ततः । शिवलिङ्गं समानर्च प्रतिष्ठाप्य जयेप्सया
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra tato rāmastartukāmo yathā tataḥ | śivaliṅgaṃ samānarca pratiṣṭhāpya jayepsayā
verses.translation: O beaudiiil lady of good hips, whatever you wish I shsdl give you. I am delighted by your devotion. There is nothing which cannot be given to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beaudiiil lady of good hips, whatever you wish I shsdl give you. I am delighted by your devotion. There is nothing which cannot be given to you.
verses.science: हैं-यह बात सुनिश्चित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वरात्स जयं प्राप्य वरं तीर्त्वोदधिं ततः । लङ्कामावृत्य कपिभी रणं चक्रे स राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: tadvarātsa jayaṃ prāpya varaṃ tīrtvodadhiṃ tataḥ | laṅkāmāvṛtya kapibhī raṇaṃ cakre sa rākṣasaiḥ
verses.translation: I have no desire for enjoyment on die earth, in the heaven or in the nether worlds. I do not desire any¬ thing except the touch of your lotus-like feet.
verses.hindi: स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं व्यासश्षान्तर्दथे क्षणात्॥ ६८  व्यास क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: I have no desire for enjoyment on die earth, in the heaven or in the nether worlds. I do not desire any¬ thing except the touch of your lotus-like feet.
verses.science: स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं व्यासश्षान्तर्दथे क्षणात्॥ ६८ व्यास क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जघानाथासुरान्वीरो रामसैन्यं ररक्ष सः । शक्तिक्षतं लक्ष्मणं च सञ्जीविन्या ह्यजीवयत्
verses.transliteration: jaghānāthāsurānvīro rāmasainyaṃ rarakṣa saḥ | śaktikṣataṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca sañjīvinyā hyajīvayat
verses.translation: My servants, my maids and my kinsmen are in¬ terested in seeing you. They have dedicated everything to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: My servants, my maids and my kinsmen are in¬ terested in seeing you. They have dedicated everything to you.
verses.science: व्यासोपदेशवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा सुखिनं चक्रे सरामं लक्ष्मणं हि सः । सर्वसैन्यं ररक्षासौ महादेवात्मजः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarvathā sukhinaṃ cakre sarāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ hi saḥ | sarvasainyaṃ rarakṣāsau mahādevātmajaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Take them all along with me to your great region and quash the terrible fear of rebirth. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार महादेवके पुत्र प्रभु उन हनुमानजीने लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामजीको सब प्रकारसे सुखी बनाया और सम्पूर्ण सेनाकी रक्षा कौ
verses.commentary: Sense: Take them all along with me to your great region and quash the terrible fear of rebirth. Obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: रावणं परिवाराढ्यं नाशयामास विश्रमः । सुखीचकार देवान्स महाबलग्रहः कपिः
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇaṃ parivārāḍhyaṃ nāśayāmāsa viśramaḥ | sukhīcakāra devānsa mahābalagrahaḥ kapiḥ
verses.translation: Appreciating her words, the great Siva cook all of them to his great region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Appreciating her words, the great Siva cook all of them to his great region.
verses.science: तेजश्चातुलमावहन्॥ १ लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महीरावणसंज्ञं स हत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम् । तत्स्थानादानयामास स्वस्थानं परिपाल्य च
verses.transliteration: mahīrāvaṇasaṃjñaṃ sa hatvā rāmaṃ salakṣmaṇam | tatsthānādānayāmāsa svasthānaṃ paripālya ca
verses.translation: Thus I have described to you the great incarna*
verses.hindi: होंगे; क्योंकि अर्जुनका तेज बढ़ा हुआ है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have described to you the great incarna*
verses.science: होंगे; क्योंकि अर्जुनका तेज बढ़ा हुआ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रामकार्यं चकाराशु सर्वथा कपिपुङ्गवः । असुरान्नमयामास नानालीलां चकार च
verses.transliteration: rāmakāryaṃ cakārāśu sarvathā kapipuṅgavaḥ | asurānnamayāmāsa nānālīlāṃ cakāra ca
verses.translation: He who listens to this story with devotion and narrates it with purity never swerves from his duties. He attains salvation hereafter.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन कपिपुंगवने सब प्रकारसे श्रीरामका कार्य शीघ्र ही सम्पन्न किया, असुरोंका वध किया एवं नाना प्रकारकी लीलाएँ कीं
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this story with devotion and narrates it with purity never swerves from his duties. He attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयामास भूलोके रामभक्तिं कपीश्वरः । स्वयं भक्तवरो भूत्वा सीतारामसुखप्रदः
verses.transliteration: sthāpayāmāsa bhūloke rāmabhaktiṃ kapīśvaraḥ | svayaṃ bhaktavaro bhūtvā sītārāmasukhapradaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, listen, I shall expound to you the incarna¬ tion of Siva the great soul as Dvijevara (a leading Brah¬ min) along with liva. It is pleasing to the good.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, listen, I shall expound to you the incarna¬ tion of Siva the great soul as Dvijevara (a leading Brah¬ min) along with liva. It is pleasing to the good.
verses.science: आदरपूर्वक वहाँ भेज दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मणप्राणदाता च सर्वदेवमदापहः । रुद्रावतारो भगवान्भक्तोद्धारकरः स वै
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇaprāṇadātā ca sarvadevamadāpahaḥ | rudrāvatāro bhagavānbhaktoddhārakaraḥ sa vai
verses.translation: O dear, I have already described to you the excellent king Bhadrayu whom liva blessed in the form of a bull. In order to test his steadfastness and piety the lord manifested himself again in the form of a leading brahmin. I shall mention that same story.
verses.hindi: और भगवान् शंकरजी आपका कल्याण करें
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, I have already described to you the excellent king Bhadrayu whom liva blessed in the form of a bull. In order to test his steadfastness and piety the lord manifested himself again in the form of a leading brahmin. I shall mention that same story.
verses.science: और भगवान् शंकरजी आपका कल्याण करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हनुमान्स महावीरो रामकार्यकरः सदा । रामदूताभिधो लोके दैत्यघ्नो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: hanumānsa mahāvīro rāmakāryakaraḥ sadā | rāmadūtābhidho loke daityaghno bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: Conquering the enemies through the power of 9 - abha in battle, Bhadrayu attained the throne,- O dear.
verses.hindi: हुए परस्पर मिलकर वहाँ निवास करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: Conquering the enemies through the power of 9 - abha in battle, Bhadrayu attained the throne,- O dear.
verses.science: हुए परस्पर मिलकर वहाँ निवास करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात हनुमच्चरितं वरम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ tāta hanumaccaritaṃ varam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O brahmin, the chaste lady Kirtimalini, daughter of Gandrahgada and Simantini, became his wife.
verses.hindi: भी धीरज कैसे रह सकता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, the chaste lady Kirtimalini, daughter of Gandrahgada and Simantini, became his wife.
verses.science: भी धीरज कैसे रह सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्कामान् अन्ते मोक्षं लभेत्परम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | sa bhuktvehākhilānkāmān ante mokṣaṃ labhetparam
verses.translation: This Ghaptrr has a close resemblance with the second canto of K&Udasa's Raghuvaihia.
verses.hindi: आपके दर्शनमात्रसे सारा दुःख नष्ट हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: This Ghaptrr has a close resemblance with the second canto of K&Udasa's Raghuvaihia.
verses.science: आपके दर्शनमात्रसे सारा दुःख नष्ट हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing the lamentation of the pair, the great king of great heroism immediately took up his bow, but the rushing tiger of Mayic origin, Seized the brahmin's wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the lamentation of the pair, the great king of great heroism immediately took up his bow, but the rushing tiger of Mayic origin, Seized the brahmin's wife.
verses.science: तुम्हें शोकका त्याग करना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing the lamentation of the pair, the great king of great heroism immediately took up his bow, but the rushing tiger of Mayic origin, Seized the brahmin's wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the lamentation of the pair, the great king of great heroism immediately took up his bow, but the rushing tiger of Mayic origin, Seized the brahmin's wife.
verses.science: दुःखरूपी कामनाओंका भोग करता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२१. एकविंशोऽध्यायः । महेशावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ प्रीत्या शृणु मुनेऽवतारं परमं प्रभोः । शङ्करस्यात्मभूपुत्र शृण्वतां सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.21. ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | maheśāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | atha prītyā śṛṇu mune'vatāraṃ paramaṃ prabhoḥ | śaṅkarasyātmabhūputra śṛṇvatāṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: The terrible tiger grasped the woman even as she was lamenting—"O lord, O husband, O Siva, O, preceptor of the universe."
verses.commentary: Sense: The terrible tiger grasped the woman even as she was lamenting—"O lord, O husband, O Siva, O, preceptor of the universe."
verses.science: पीड़ा प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकदा मुनिशार्दूल गिरिजाशङ्करावुभौ । विहर्तुकामौ सञ्जातौ स्वेच्छया परमेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: ekadā muniśārdūla girijāśaṅkarāvubhau | vihartukāmau sañjātau svecchayā parameśvarau
verses.translation: Kings protect the distressed people who seek refuge in them with their very lives and assets. They are the knowers of virtue. Without that they are like a dead body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings protect the distressed people who seek refuge in them with their very lives and assets. They are the knowers of virtue. Without that they are like a dead body.
verses.science: निरादर करते हुए कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भैरवं द्वारपालं च कृत्वाभ्यन्तरमागतौ । नानासखिगणैः प्रीत्या सेवितौ नरशीलितौ
verses.transliteration: bhairavaṃ dvārapālaṃ ca kṛtvābhyantaramāgatau | nānāsakhigaṇaiḥ prītyā sevitau naraśīlitau
verses.translation: Better death than life that does nbt protect the distressed. A mendicant is better than a rich householder who does not pcMsess charitable nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: Better death than life that does nbt protect the distressed. A mendicant is better than a rich householder who does not pcMsess charitable nature.
verses.science: ब्रह्मचारीका यहाँ क्‍या प्रयोजन है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चिरं विहृत्य तत्र द्वौ स्वतन्त्रौ परमेश्वरौ । बभूवतुः प्रसन्नौ तौ नानालीलाकरौ मुने
verses.transliteration: ciraṃ vihṛtya tatra dvau svatantrau parameśvarau | babhūvatuḥ prasannau tau nānālīlākarau mune
verses.translation: Better to swallow poison or enter fire than cease to protect the oppressed, the helpless and the poor.
verses.hindi: शत्रुओंसे पीड़ित मुझे विजय प्रदान करें
verses.commentary: Sense: Better to swallow poison or enter fire than cease to protect the oppressed, the helpless and the poor.
verses.science: शत्रुओंसे पीड़ित मुझे विजय प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोन्मत्ताकृतिर्देवी स्वतन्त्रा लीलया शिवा । आगता द्वारि तद्रूपा प्रभोराज्ञामवाप सा
verses.transliteration: athonmattākṛtirdevī svatantrā līlayā śivā | āgatā dvāri tadrūpā prabhorājñāmavāpa sā
verses.translation: On hearing his lamentation and the decrial of his prowess, the king thought within himself thus—
verses.hindi: ये सब निश्चय ही युद्धमें दुर्जय हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his lamentation and the decrial of his prowess, the king thought within himself thus—
verses.science: ये सब निश्चय ही युद्धमें दुर्जय हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां देवीं भैरवः सोऽथ नारीदृष्ट्या विलोक्य च । निषिषेध बहिर्गन्तुं तद्रूपेण विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ devīṃ bhairavaḥ so'tha nārīdṛṣṭyā vilokya ca | niṣiṣedha bahirgantuṃ tadrūpeṇa vimohitaḥ
verses.translation: "Alas, my manliness is lost today due to the adverse fate. Today my fame has been quashed. Great sin has been acquired.
verses.hindi: असाध्य हैं; तो भी अपने हितकी बात सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas, my manliness is lost today due to the adverse fate. Today my fame has been quashed. Great sin has been acquired.
verses.science: असाध्य हैं; तो भी अपने हितकी बात सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारीदृष्ट्या सुदृष्टा सा भैरवेण यदा मुने । क्रुद्धाभवच्छिवा देवी तं शशाप तदाऽम्बिका
verses.transliteration: nārīdṛṣṭyā sudṛṣṭā sā bhairaveṇa yadā mune | kruddhābhavacchivā devī taṃ śaśāpa tadā'mbikā
verses.translation: The hereditary virtue has been smothered. I am unfortunate and confused in mind. Certainly my riches, my kingdom, my longevity will dwindle.
verses.hindi: हैं, इसलिये अब तुम शिव-मन्त्रका जप करो
verses.commentary: Sense: The hereditary virtue has been smothered. I am unfortunate and confused in mind. Certainly my riches, my kingdom, my longevity will dwindle.
verses.science: हैं, इसलिये अब तुम शिव-मन्त्रका जप करो। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवोवाच । नारीदृष्ट्या पश्यसि त्वं यतो मां पुरुषाधम । अतो भव धरायां हि मानुषस्त्वं च भैरव
verses.transliteration: śivovāca | nārīdṛṣṭyā paśyasi tvaṃ yato māṃ puruṣādhama | ato bhava dharāyāṃ hi mānuṣastvaṃ ca bhairava
verses.translation: By surrendering my own life,, lovable though it is,
verses.commentary: Sense: By surrendering my own life,, lovable though it is,
verses.science: भगवान् शिवकी उपासना करते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थं यदाभवच्छप्तो भैरवः शिवया मुने । हाहाकारो महानासीद्दुःखमाप स लीलया
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | itthaṃ yadābhavacchapto bhairavaḥ śivayā mune | hāhākāro mahānāsīdduḥkhamāpa sa līlayā
verses.translation: ComiNire Ragbu. II. 53.
verses.commentary: Sense: ComiNire Ragbu. II. 53.
verses.science: देकर वात्सल्यपूर्वक अर्जुनसे पुन: कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च शङ्करः शीघ्रं तमागत्य मुनीश्वर । आश्वासयद्भैरवं हि नानानुनयकोविदः
verses.transliteration: tataśca śaṅkaraḥ śīghraṃ tamāgatya munīśvara | āśvāsayadbhairavaṃ hi nānānunayakovidaḥ
verses.translation: The king struck the tiger with sharp arrows; but it was not at all affected by them. It stood like a lofty moun¬ tain, which is not affected by showers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king struck the tiger with sharp arrows; but it was not at all affected by them. It stood like a lofty moun¬ tain, which is not affected by showers.
verses.science: प्रकारका कार्य मनुष्यको करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छापाद्भैरवः सोऽथ क्षिताववतरन्मुने । मनुष्ययोन्यां वैतालसंज्ञकः शङ्ककरेच्छया
verses.transliteration: tacchāpādbhairavaḥ so'tha kṣitāvavataranmune | manuṣyayonyāṃ vaitālasaṃjñakaḥ śaṅkakarecchayā
verses.translation: The powerful tiger, not at all pained by the mis¬ siles of the king, seized the woman forcibly and ran away in a hurry.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful tiger, not at all pained by the mis¬ siles of the king, seized the woman forcibly and ran away in a hurry.
verses.science: उपासनामें तत्पर हो गये। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्स्नेहतः शिवः सोऽपि क्षिताववतरद्विभुः । शिवया सह सल्लीलो लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tatsnehataḥ śivaḥ so'pi kṣitāvavataradvibhuḥ | śivayā saha sallīlo laukikīṃ gatimāśritaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing his wife seized by the tiger, the brahmin was much bewildered and following the way of the world cried again and again.
verses.hindi: कहकर वे शीघ्र ही इन्द्रके समीप गये
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his wife seized by the tiger, the brahmin was much bewildered and following the way of the world cried again and again.
verses.science: कहकर वे शीघ्र ही इन्द्रके समीप गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महेशाह्वः शिवश्चासीच्छारदा गिरिजा मुने । सुलीलां चक्रतुः प्रीत्या नानालीलाविशारदौ
verses.transliteration: maheśāhvaḥ śivaścāsīcchāradā girijā mune | sulīlāṃ cakratuḥ prītyā nānālīlāviśāradau
verses.translation: After crying for some time that btahmin who was
verses.hindi: अब जैसा उचित हो, आप वैसा कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: After crying for some time that btahmin who was
verses.science: अब जैसा उचित हो, आप वैसा कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात महेशचरितं वरम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ tāta maheśacaritaṃ varam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O king, where are your great weapons? Where is your great bow diat professes to protect? Where is your strength of ten or twelve thousand great elephants?
verses.hindi: विदाकर स्वयं वहाँ जानेका विचार किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, where are your great weapons? Where is your great bow diat professes to protect? Where is your strength of ten or twelve thousand great elephants?
verses.science: विदाकर स्वयं वहाँ जानेका विचार किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्भोगानन्ते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | sa bhuktvehākhilānbhogānante mokṣamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: All these have become futile, for you are incom¬ petent to meet the onslaught of wild animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these have become futile, for you are incom¬ petent to meet the onslaught of wild animals.
verses.science: पुन: यह वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmin, I am a base KLatriya bereft of strengdi. You take pity on me. O intelligent one, do not grieve. 1 shall give you what you desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmin, I am a base KLatriya bereft of strengdi. You take pity on me. O intelligent one, do not grieve. 1 shall give you what you desire.
verses.science: इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmin, I am a base KLatriya bereft of strengdi. You take pity on me. O intelligent one, do not grieve. 1 shall give you what you desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmin, I am a base KLatriya bereft of strengdi. You take pity on me. O intelligent one, do not grieve. 1 shall give you what you desire.
verses.science: ४ अपने भवनको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२२. द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः । विष्णूपद्रववृषावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु ब्रह्मसुत प्राज्ञ वृषेशाख्यं मुनीश्वर । शिवावतारं सल्लीलं हरिगर्वहरं वरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.22. dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | viṣṇūpadravavṛṣāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu brahmasuta prājña vṛṣeśākhyaṃ munīśvara | śivāvatāraṃ sallīlaṃ harigarvaharaṃ varam
verses.translation: This kingdom, this queen, this body d* mine, every¬ thing is subservient to you. What is die greatest thing that you desire?
verses.hindi: तपस्तेपे संयतात्मा शिवमुद्दिश्य तद्विधम्॥ ६५ करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: This kingdom, this queen, this body d* mine, every¬ thing is subservient to you. What is die greatest thing that you desire?
verses.science: तपस्तेपे संयतात्मा शिवमुद्दिश्य तद्विधम्॥ ६५ करने लगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवासुराः सर्वे जरामृत्युभयार्दिताः । परस्परं च सन्धाय रत्नान्यादित्सवोऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: purā devāsurāḥ sarve jarāmṛtyubhayārditāḥ | parasparaṃ ca sandhāya ratnānyāditsavo'bhavan
verses.translation: Then from the sky divine showers of flowers fell. The divine instruments were played. The celestial damsels sang and danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then from the sky divine showers of flowers fell. The divine instruments were played. The celestial damsels sang and danced.
verses.science: ध्वनि दसों दिशाओंमें सुनायी पड़ी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरासुराः सर्वे क्षीरोदं सागरोत्तमम् । उद्यता मथितुं तं च बभूवुर्मुनिनन्दन
verses.transliteration: tataḥ surāsurāḥ sarve kṣīrodaṃ sāgarottamam | udyatā mathituṃ taṃ ca babhūvurmuninandana
verses.translation: Read ITRff for i** die printed Skt. text.
verses.hindi: है ? तुम मुझ सेनापतिको यहाँ अकेला मत समझो
verses.commentary: Sense: Read ITRff for i** die printed Skt. text.
verses.science: है ? तुम मुझ सेनापतिको यहाँ अकेला मत समझो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आसन् शुचिस्मिताः सर्वे केनेदं मन्थनं भवेत् । स्वकार्यसिद्धये तस्य ब्रह्मन्निति सुरासुराः
verses.transliteration: āsan śucismitāḥ sarve kenedaṃ manthanaṃ bhavet | svakāryasiddhaye tasya brahmanniti surāsurāḥ
verses.translation: It can be identified with the ))resent Abu, a lacred hill of the Western India, lying in the Sirohi state of Rajijutana.
verses.hindi: आयेगा, तब मैं उसको इसका फल दिखाऊँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: It can be identified with the ))resent Abu, a lacred hill of the Western India, lying in the Sirohi state of Rajijutana.
verses.science: आयेगा, तब मैं उसको इसका फल दिखाऊँगा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा नभोगता वाणी मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वना । उवाच देवान्दैत्यांश्चश्वासयन्तीश्वराज्ञया
verses.transliteration: tadā nabhogatā vāṇī meghagambhīraniḥsvanā | uvāca devāndaityāṃścaśvāsayantīśvarājñayā
verses.translation: Thus fighting strenuously and although very strox, the Bhilla was devoured the bts of prey wfaioh seized him forcibly, as dioiigh indted by his own adverse fate.
verses.hindi: कर दिया; केवल उनका शरीर शेष रह गया
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus fighting strenuously and although very strox, the Bhilla was devoured the bts of prey wfaioh seized him forcibly, as dioiigh indted by his own adverse fate.
verses.science: कर दिया; केवल उनका शरीर शेष रह गया। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: नभोवाण्युवाच । हे देवा असुराश्चैव मन्थध्वं क्षीरसागरम् । भवतां बलबुद्धिर्हि भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: nabhovāṇyuvāca | he devā asurāścaiva manthadhvaṃ kṣīrasāgaram | bhavatāṃ balabuddhirhi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva yielding the greatest bliss she felt the highest pleasure. She did not remember any¬ thing.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Siva yielding the greatest bliss she felt the highest pleasure. She did not remember any¬ thing.
verses.science: धारण करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्दरं चैव मन्थानं रज्जुं कुरुत वासुकिम् । मिथः सर्वे मिलित्वा तु मन्थनं कुरुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: mandaraṃ caiva manthānaṃ rajjuṃ kuruta vāsukim | mithaḥ sarve militvā tu manthanaṃ kurutādarāt
verses.translation: This Bhilla will be born as Nala, the son of Vira- sena> in the excellent city of Niadha.* There is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Bhilla will be born as Nala, the son of Vira- sena> in the excellent city of Niadha.* There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: देनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । नभोगतां तदा वाणीं निशम्याथ सुरासुराः । उद्योगं चक्रिरे सर्वे तत्कर्तुं मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | nabhogatāṃ tadā vāṇīṃ niśamyātha surāsurāḥ | udyogaṃ cakrire sarve tatkartuṃ munisattama
verses.translation: you will be born in the illustrious city of Vidarbha'* as the daughter of king Bhima. You will be famous as Dama- yanti endowed with all good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: you will be born in the illustrious city of Vidarbha'* as the daughter of king Bhima. You will be famous as Dama- yanti endowed with all good qualities.
verses.science: आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुसन्धायाखिलास्ते वै मन्दरं पर्वतोत्तमम् । कनकाभं च सरलं नानाशोभार्चितं ययुः
verses.transliteration: susandhāyākhilāste vai mandaraṃ parvatottamam | kanakābhaṃ ca saralaṃ nānāśobhārcitaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: After coming together you will enjoy royal plea¬ sures. You will attain salvation too, inaccessible even to leading Yogins.
verses.hindi: वे सब आपसमें मिलकर सोनेके समान कान्तिवाले, ऋजुकाय तथा नाना प्रकारकी शोभासे सम्पन्न पर्वतश्रेष्ठ मन्दराचलके समीप गये
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming together you will enjoy royal plea¬ sures. You will attain salvation too, inaccessible even to leading Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसाद्य गिरीशं तं तदाज्ञप्ताः सुरासुराः । बलादुत्पाटयामासुर्नेतुकामाः पयोऽर्णवम्
verses.transliteration: suprasādya girīśaṃ taṃ tadājñaptāḥ surāsurāḥ | balādutpāṭayāmāsurnetukāmāḥ payo'rṇavam
verses.translation: What can a blind man do with a mirror? Of what avail is a house to him who lives on alms? WThat can a fool do with a book? Of what avail is wealth to him who is bereft of his wife?
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठ॒ृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां किराताववारवर्णनप्रसंगेठ जुनितपोवर्णन नामाष्यविंशेठ ध्यायः
verses.commentary: Sense: What can a blind man do with a mirror? Of what avail is a house to him who lives on alms? WThat can a fool do with a book? Of what avail is wealth to him who is bereft of his wife?
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठ॒ृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां किराताववारवर्णनप्रसंगेठ जुनितपोवर्णन नामाष्यविंशेठ ध्यायः। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: भुजैरुत्पाट्य ते सर्वे जग्मुः क्षीरार्णवं मुने । अशक्ता अभवंस्तत्र तमानेतुं हतौजसः
verses.transliteration: bhujairutpāṭya te sarve jagmuḥ kṣīrārṇavaṃ mune | aśaktā abhavaṃstatra tamānetuṃ hataujasaḥ
verses.translation: Hence 1 who am not satiated with the enjoyment of pleasures but I whose wife is snatched away desire your crowned queen. Let her be given to me.
verses.hindi: अर्जुनका तपवर्णन नामक अड़तीसवो अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence 1 who am not satiated with the enjoyment of pleasures but I whose wife is snatched away desire your crowned queen. Let her be given to me.
verses.science: अर्जुनका तपवर्णन नामक अड़तीसवो अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्भुजैः स परिभ्रष्टः पतितो मन्दरो गिरिः । सहसातिगुरुः सद्यो देवदैत्योपरि ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tadbhujaiḥ sa paribhraṣṭaḥ patito mandaro giriḥ | sahasātiguruḥ sadyo devadaityopari dhruvam
verses.translation: I can give all my assets to the extent of the earth, my kingdom, horses and elephants and even my body to any¬ one but never can I give away my wife.
verses.hindi: करके उत्तम भक्तिसे शिवका ध्यान करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: I can give all my assets to the extent of the earth, my kingdom, horses and elephants and even my body to any¬ one but never can I give away my wife.
verses.science: करके उत्तम भक्तिसे शिवका ध्यान करने लगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं भग्नोद्यमा भग्नाः सम्बभूवुः सुरासुराः । चेतनाः प्राप्य च ततस्तुष्टुवुर्जगदीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhagnodyamā bhagnāḥ sambabhūvuḥ surāsurāḥ | cetanāḥ prāpya ca tatastuṣṭuvurjagadīśvaram
verses.translation: Let it be the terrible sin of the slaughter of a brahmin; let it be the sin of sipping wine, I shall quell it with my power of penance. What then the sin of enjoying another man's wife?
verses.commentary: Sense: Let it be the terrible sin of the slaughter of a brahmin; let it be the sin of sipping wine, I shall quell it with my power of penance. What then the sin of enjoying another man's wife?
verses.science: और सावधान होकर कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदिच्छयोद्यताः सर्वे पुनरुत्थाप्य तं गिरिम् । निचिक्षिपुर्जले नीत्वा क्षीरोदस्योत्तरे तटे
verses.transliteration: tadicchayodyatāḥ sarve punarutthāpya taṃ girim | nicikṣipurjale nītvā kṣīrodasyottare taṭe
verses.translation: Hence give me your wife. I have no otfier desire. Certainly you will go to hell by your inability to protect the oppressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence give me your wife. I have no otfier desire. Certainly you will go to hell by your inability to protect the oppressed.
verses.science: इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरासुरगणा रज्जुं कृत्वा च वासुकिम् । रत्नान्यादातुकामास्ते ममन्थुः क्षीरसागरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ surāsuragaṇā rajjuṃ kṛtvā ca vāsukim | ratnānyādātukāmāste mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram
verses.translation: At the words of the brahmin, the frightened king
verses.hindi: लौटकर वे अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: At the words of the brahmin, the frightened king
verses.science: लौटकर वे अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदे मथ्यमाने तु श्रीः स्वर्लोकमहेश्वरी । समुद्भूता समुद्राच्च भृगुपुत्री हरिप्रिया
verses.transliteration: kṣīrode mathyamāne tu śrīḥ svarlokamaheśvarī | samudbhūtā samudrācca bhṛguputrī haripriyā
verses.translation: Hence I shall give my wife to this deserving brail* min and escape sin. Immediately thereafter I shall enter fire. My fame then shall be known."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence I shall give my wife to this deserving brail* min and escape sin. Immediately thereafter I shall enter fire. My fame then shall be known."
verses.science: मनमें विचार करने लगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरिः शशाङ्कश्च पारिजातो महाद्रुमः । उच्चैःश्रवाश्च तुरगो गज ऐरावतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dhanvantariḥ śaśāṅkaśca pārijāto mahādrumaḥ | uccaiḥśravāśca turago gaja airāvatastathā
verses.translation: After deciding mentally like this, he kindled a blaz¬ ing fire. He called the brahmin and gifted away his Wifb with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: After deciding mentally like this, he kindled a blaz¬ ing fire. He called the brahmin and gifted away his Wifb with water.
verses.science: दुर्योधनका कोई हितकारी मित्र है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरा हरिधनुः शङ्खो गावः कामदुघास्ततः । कौस्तुभाख्यो मणिश्चैव तथा पीयूषमेव च
verses.transliteration: surā haridhanuḥ śaṅkho gāvaḥ kāmadughāstataḥ | kaustubhākhyo maṇiścaiva tathā pīyūṣameva ca
verses.translation: He took the ceremonial bath and became pure. He bowed to gods went round die fire thrice and meditated on iSiva with pure mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: He took the ceremonial bath and became pure. He bowed to gods went round die fire thrice and meditated on iSiva with pure mind.
verses.science: पृथक् भाव बताया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च मथ्यमाने तु कालकूटं महाविषम् । युगान्तानलभं जातं सुरासुरभयावहम्
verses.transliteration: punaśca mathyamāne tu kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣam | yugāntānalabhaṃ jātaṃ surāsurabhayāvaham
verses.translation: The king saw in front of him the five-faced, the three-eyed lord with die Pinaka in his hand, bedecked by the digit of the moon, with hanging matted hair shed¬ ding tawny lustre, having the brilliance of a crore of mid¬ day blazing suns, white as the lotus stalk fibre, wearing the hide of the elephant, with his head drenched by the waves of Ganga, having the necklaces of great serpents, bedecked in coronet, waistband, shoulderlet and shining bangles, holding in his hands, the trident, the sword, the missile Khatvanga, the dagger, the shield, the deer, the mystic sign of protection, the eight articles of worship and the Pinaka, seated on his bull and blue-necked.
verses.wordMeaning: The king saw in front of him the five-faced, the three-eyed lord with die Pinaka in his hand, bedecked by the digit of the moon, with hanging matted hair shed¬ ding tawny lustre, having the brilliance of a crore of mid¬ day blazing suns, white as the lotus stalk fibre,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The king saw in front of him the five-faced, the three-eyed lord with die Pinaka in his hand, bedecked by the digit of the moon, with hanging matted hair shed¬ ding tawny lustre, having the brilliance of a crore of mid¬ day blazing suns, white as the lotus stalk fibre,…
verses.science: चढ़ाकर खड़े हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पीयूषजन्मकाले तु बिन्दवो ये बहिर्गताः । तेभ्यः कान्ताः समुद्भूता बह्वयो ह्यद्भुतदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: pīyūṣajanmakāle tu bindavo ye bahirgatāḥ | tebhyaḥ kāntāḥ samudbhūtā bahvayo hyadbhutadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: Vinu, Brahma, Indra and other gods excluding Nfirada and other sages too came there eulogising.
verses.hindi: वे सभी उन शब्दोंसे व्याकुल हो उठे
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinu, Brahma, Indra and other gods excluding Nfirada and other sages too came there eulogising.
verses.science: वे सभी उन शब्दोंसे व्याकुल हो उठे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शरत्पूर्णेन्दुवदनास्तडित्सूर्यानलप्रभाः । हारकेयूरकटकैर्दिव्यरत्नैरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: śaratpūrṇenduvadanāstaḍitsūryānalaprabhāḥ | hārakeyūrakaṭakairdivyaratnairalaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The vision of the lord increased his pleasure. The incessant tear-drops smeared his body. He had horripilation and choked throat. With palms joined in reverence, he eulo¬ gised the lord.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले तथा सुख देनेवाले कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The vision of the lord increased his pleasure. The incessant tear-drops smeared his body. He had horripilation and choked throat. With palms joined in reverence, he eulo¬ gised the lord.
verses.science: करनेवाले तथा सुख देनेवाले कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लावण्यामृततोयेन ताः सिञ्चन्त्यो दिशो दश । जगदुन्मादयन्त्येव भ्रूभङ्गायतवीक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: lāvaṇyāmṛtatoyena tāḥ siñcantyo diśo daśa | jagadunmādayantyeva bhrūbhaṅgāyatavīkṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The supreme lord, the storehouse of mercy and
verses.commentary: Sense: The supreme lord, the storehouse of mercy and
verses.science: स्थिर रखना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कोटिशस्ताः समुत्पन्नास्त्वमृतात्कामनिस्सृताः । ततोऽमृतं समुत्पन्नं जरामृत्युनिवारणम्
verses.transliteration: koṭiśastāḥ samutpannāstvamṛtātkāmanissṛtāḥ | tato'mṛtaṃ samutpannaṃ jarāmṛtyunivāraṇam
verses.translation: **0 king, I am satisfied with your devotion more than your piety. Mention the boon that you as well as your wife wbh to choose. I shall undoubtedly give it to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: **0 king, I am satisfied with your devotion more than your piety. Mention the boon that you as well as your wife wbh to choose. I shall undoubtedly give it to you.
verses.science: हुए शिवजीकी स्तुति कौ। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीं शङ्खं कौस्तुभं च खड्गं जग्राह केशवः । जग्राहार्को हयं दिव्यमुच्चैःश्रवसमादरात्
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīṃ śaṅkhaṃ kaustubhaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ | jagrāhārko hayaṃ divyamuccaiḥśravasamādarāt
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the lord> the king Bhadrayu eulogised and bowed to the lord with bent head.
verses.hindi: प्रणनाम शिवं भूयस्तुष्टाव च पुनः पुनः॥ ५३  बार-बार उनकी स्तुति की
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the lord> the king Bhadrayu eulogised and bowed to the lord with bent head.
verses.science: प्रणनाम शिवं भूयस्तुष्टाव च पुनः पुनः॥ ५३ बार-बार उनकी स्तुति की। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पारिजातं तरुवरमैरावतमिभेश्वरम् । शचीपतिश्च जग्राह निर्जरेशो महादरात्
verses.transliteration: pārijātaṃ taruvaramairāvatamibheśvaram | śacīpatiśca jagrāha nirjareśo mahādarāt
verses.translation: O lord, since out of pity you wbh to accord me a boon, I choose it as a great devotee'* does from his lord, the granter of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, since out of pity you wbh to accord me a boon, I choose it as a great devotee'* does from his lord, the granter of boons.
verses.science: गूकहैत्यवधो नामेकोनचत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कालकूटं शशाङ्कं च देवत्राणाय शङ्करः । स्वकण्ठे धृतवान् शम्भुः स्वेच्छया भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: kālakūṭaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ ca devatrāṇāya śaṅkaraḥ | svakaṇṭhe dhṛtavān śambhuḥ svecchayā bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: O great god, my fiither Vajrabfihu with his wife, O lord, 1 a servant at your feet, along with my wife, the VaiSya Padmikara and his son Sanaya, O great lord, make all of us residents near you.
verses.hindi: भक्तवत्सल तथा कल्याणकारी शिवजीने देवताओंकी रक्षाके लिये कण्ठमें [ महाभयंकर] कालकूट विषको तथा चन्द्रमाको [ मस्तकपर] स्वेच्छासे धारण किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, my fiither Vajrabfihu with his wife, O lord, 1 a servant at your feet, along with my wife, the VaiSya Padmikara and his son Sanaya, O great lord, make all of us residents near you.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्याः सुराख्यां रमणीमीश्वराजविमोहिताः । जगृहुः सकला व्यास सर्वे धन्वन्तरिं जनाः
verses.transliteration: daityāḥ surākhyāṃ ramaṇīmīśvarājavimohitāḥ | jagṛhuḥ sakalā vyāsa sarve dhanvantariṃ janāḥ
verses.translation: Then the queen, his wife, Kirtimalini propitiated Siva with devotion and requested for an excellent boon.
verses.hindi: ईश्वरकी मायासे मोहित हुए दैत्योंने आनन्द प्रदान करनेवाली मदिरा ग्रहण की। फिर हे व्यास! सभी मनुष्योंने धन्वन्तरि बैद्यको ग्रहण किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the queen, his wife, Kirtimalini propitiated Siva with devotion and requested for an excellent boon.

verses.sanskrit: जगृहुर्मुनयः सर्वे कामधेनुं मुनीश्वराः । सामान्यतस्त्रियस्ताश्च स्थिता आसन्विमोहिकाः
verses.transliteration: jagṛhurmunayaḥ sarve kāmadhenuṃ munīśvarāḥ | sāmānyatastriyastāśca sthitā āsanvimohikāḥ
verses.translation: O supreme God, Gandrahgada my father and Simantini my mother, I request the two to be joyously staying near you for ever.
verses.hindi: सभी मुनिगणोंने कामधेनुको ग्रहण किया और मोहित करनेवाली वे स्त्रियाँ सामान्य रूपसे स्थित रहीं
verses.commentary: Sense: O supreme God, Gandrahgada my father and Simantini my mother, I request the two to be joyously staying near you for ever.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतार्थं महायुद्धं सम्बभूव जयैषिणाम् । सुराणामसुराणां च मिथः सङ्क्षुब्धचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: amṛtārthaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ sambabhūva jayaiṣiṇām | surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca mithaḥ saṅkṣubdhacetasām
verses.translation: The delighted lord of Gauri, favourably disposed to his devotees said—**Let it be so'* and granted them the boon they desired and then vanished in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted lord of Gauri, favourably disposed to his devotees said—**Let it be so'* and granted them the boon they desired and then vanished in a moment.
verses.science: तपोनिरत व्यक्ति छल नहीं करते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हृतं सोमं च दैतेयैर्बलाद्देवान्विजित्य च । बलिप्रभृतिभिर्व्यास युगान्ताग्न्यर्कसुप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: hṛtaṃ somaṃ ca daiteyairbalāddevānvijitya ca | baliprabhṛtibhirvyāsa yugāntāgnyarkasuprabhaiḥ
verses.translation: Acquiring the grace of the trident-bearing lord, BhadrSyu, enjoyed several pleasures lovingly in the company of Kirtim&lin!.
verses.hindi: तुम्हें इस तपस्याका फल कैसे मिलेगा 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Acquiring the grace of the trident-bearing lord, BhadrSyu, enjoyed several pleasures lovingly in the company of Kirtim&lin!.
verses.science: तुम्हें इस तपस्याका फल कैसे मिलेगा 2। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाः शङ्करमापन्ना विह्वलाः शिवमायया । सर्वे शक्रादयस्तात दैतेयैरर्दिता बलात्
verses.transliteration: devāḥ śaṅkaramāpannā vihvalāḥ śivamāyayā | sarve śakrādayastāta daiteyairarditā balāt
verses.translation: Unimpeded in the exercise of his power he ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years. Then he entrusted his son with the kingdom and went to l§iva*s presence.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारी यह तपस्या अशुभ करनेवाली है
verses.commentary: Sense: Unimpeded in the exercise of his power he ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years. Then he entrusted his son with the kingdom and went to l§iva*s presence.
verses.science: तुम्हारी यह तपस्या अशुभ करनेवाली है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तदमृतं यत्नात्स्त्रीस्वरूपेण मायया । शिवाज्ञया रमेशेन दैत्येभ्यश्च हृतं मुने
verses.transliteration: tatastadamṛtaṃ yatnātstrīsvarūpeṇa māyayā | śivājñayā rameśena daityebhyaśca hṛtaṃ mune
verses.translation: The king GandrShgada and the queen Simantinl devoutly worshipped liva and attained his feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king GandrShgada and the queen Simantinl devoutly worshipped liva and attained his feet.
verses.science: स्वामीसे माँग लो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपाययत्सुरांस्तांश्च मोहिनी स्त्रीस्वरूपधृक् । मोहयित्वासुरान्सर्वान्हरिर्मायाविनां वरः
verses.transliteration: apāyayatsurāṃstāṃśca mohinī strīsvarūpadhṛk | mohayitvāsurānsarvānharirmāyāvināṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: ' Thus the great incarnation of lord Siva as Dvi- jelvara has been described by me. It was the bestower of great bliss on Bhadrayu.
verses.hindi: करते हुए मर्यादित वाक्य कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Thus the great incarnation of lord Siva as Dvi- jelvara has been described by me. It was the bestower of great bliss on Bhadrayu.
verses.science: करते हुए मर्यादित वाक्य कहने लगे--। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा निकटमेतस्या ऊचिरे दैत्यपुङ्गवाः । पाययस्व सुधामेतां माभूद्भेदोऽत्र पङ्क्तिषु
verses.transliteration: gatvā nikaṭametasyā ūcire daityapuṅgavāḥ | pāyayasva sudhāmetāṃ mābhūdbhedo'tra paṅktiṣu
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this holy narrative of Dvijea incarnation of Siva of pious fame, goes to Siva's region.
verses.hindi: तुम हो, मैं उसे अच्छी तरह जानता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this holy narrative of Dvijea incarnation of Siva of pious fame, goes to Siva's region.
verses.science: तुम हो, मैं उसे अच्छी तरह जानता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्त्वा ददुस्तस्मै विष्णवे छलरूपिणे । ते दैत्या दानवाः सर्वे शिवमायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: etaduktvā dadustasmai viṣṇave chalarūpiṇe | te daityā dānavāḥ sarve śivamāyāvimohitāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to this every day or narrates this with attentive mind does not swerve from his duty and attains salvation hereafter.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर शिवमायासे मोहित हुए उन सभी दैत्यों एवं दानवोंने कपटरूपधारी उन विष्णुको वह अमृत दे दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this every day or narrates this with attentive mind does not swerve from his duty and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दृष्ट्वा स्त्रियो दानवपुङ्गवाः । अनयन्नमृतोद्भूता यथास्थानं यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare dṛṣṭvā striyo dānavapuṅgavāḥ | anayannamṛtodbhūtā yathāsthānaṃ yathāsukham
verses.translation: O intelligent sage, listen. 1 shall explain the in¬ carnation of great bliss named YatinStha, of Siva the supreme soul.
verses.hindi: अपेक्षा है तो वह आकर मुझसे क्यों नहीं माँगता ?
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent sage, listen. 1 shall explain the in¬ carnation of great bliss named YatinStha, of Siva the supreme soul.
verses.science: अपेक्षा है तो वह आकर मुझसे क्यों नहीं माँगता ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तासां पुराणि दिव्यानि स्वर्गाच्छतगुणान्यपि । घोरैर्यन्त्रैः सुगुप्तानि मयमायाकृतानि च
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ purāṇi divyāni svargācchataguṇānyapi | ghorairyantraiḥ suguptāni mayamāyākṛtāni ca
verses.translation: O great sage, on the mountain Arbuda* there lived a hunter Ahuka of BhUla tribe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, on the mountain Arbuda* there lived a hunter Ahuka of BhUla tribe.
verses.science: सुनकर उस भीलने कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरक्षितानि सर्वाणि कृत्वा युद्धाय निर्ययुः । अस्पृष्टवक्षसो दैत्याः कृत्वा समयमेव हि
verses.transliteration: surakṣitāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā yuddhāya niryayuḥ | aspṛṣṭavakṣaso daityāḥ kṛtvā samayameva hi
verses.translation: His wife Ahuki observed some good rites. Both of them were great devotees of Siva and worshipped Siva.
verses.hindi: है नन्‍्दी-श्चर कक ॥ ३०  सुखपूर्वक रहो, अन्यथा कष्ट प्राप्त करोगे
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife Ahuki observed some good rites. Both of them were great devotees of Siva and worshipped Siva.
verses.science: है नन्‍्दी-श्चर कक ॥ ३० सुखपूर्वक रहो, अन्यथा कष्ट प्राप्त करोगे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: न स्पृशामः स्त्रियश्चेमा यदि देवैर्विनिर्जिताः । इत्युक्त्वा ते महावीरा दैत्याः सर्वे युयुत्सवः
verses.transliteration: na spṛśāmaḥ striyaścemā yadi devairvinirjitāḥ | ityuktvā te mahāvīrā daityāḥ sarve yuyutsavaḥ
verses.translation: In. the meantime towards the evening, Siva assumed the ((uise of an ascetic and came to his house to test hiy"
verses.hindi: गणेन पाण्डवस्तं हि है च शहड्डूरम्॥ ३१  स्मरण करते हुए उस भीलसे कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: In. the meantime towards the evening, Siva assumed the ((uise of an ascetic and came to his house to test hiy"
verses.science: गणेन पाण्डवस्तं हि है च शहड्डूरम्॥ ३१ स्मरण करते हुए उस भीलसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादं ततश्चक्रुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक् । पूरयन्त इवाकाशं तर्पयन्तो बलाहकान्
verses.transliteration: siṃhanādaṃ tataścakruḥ śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛthakpṛthak | pūrayanta ivākāśaṃ tarpayanto balāhakān
verses.translation: The lord of the house that intelligent man too came back then and lovingly worshipped the leading stscetic.
verses.hindi: और गीदड़का युद्ध उपहासास्पद होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of the house that intelligent man too came back then and lovingly worshipped the leading stscetic.
verses.science: और गीदड़का युद्ध उपहासास्पद होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं बभूव देवानामसुरैः सह भीकरम् । देवासुराख्यमतुलं प्रसिद्धं भुवनत्रये
verses.transliteration: yuddhaṃ babhūva devānāmasuraiḥ saha bhīkaram | devāsurākhyamatulaṃ prasiddhaṃ bhuvanatraye
verses.translation: In order to test his feelings, 8iva in the guise of an ascetic, indulging in great sports lovingly said to him in a piteous tone.
verses.hindi: जाओ और जैसी तुम्हारी इच्छा हो, वैसा करो
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to test his feelings, 8iva in the guise of an ascetic, indulging in great sports lovingly said to him in a piteous tone.
verses.science: जाओ और जैसी तुम्हारी इच्छा हो, वैसा करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जयं प्रापुः सुराः सर्वे विष्णुना परिरक्षिताः । दैत्याः पलायितास्तत्र हताः सामरविष्णुना
verses.transliteration: jayaṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve viṣṇunā parirakṣitāḥ | daityāḥ palāyitāstatra hatāḥ sāmaraviṣṇunā
verses.translation: O Bhilla, give me some place here to stay today. I shall by all means leave in the next morning, you will be blessed for ever.
verses.hindi: साथ जहाँ अर्जुन थे, वहाँ आये
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bhilla, give me some place here to stay today. I shall by all means leave in the next morning, you will be blessed for ever.
verses.science: साथ जहाँ अर्जुन थे, वहाँ आये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दैत्याः सम्मोहिता देवैर्विष्णुना च महात्मना । हतावशिष्टाः पातालं विविशुर्विवराणि च
verses.transliteration: daityāḥ sammohitā devairviṣṇunā ca mahātmanā | hatāvaśiṣṭāḥ pātālaṃ viviśurvivarāṇi ca
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the ascetic wanted to leave. By that time, considering the trend of thought of her husband the Bhilli said.
verses.hindi: देखकर धनुष-बाण लेकर सामने आ गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the ascetic wanted to leave. By that time, considering the trend of thought of her husband the Bhilli said.
verses.science: देखकर धनुष-बाण लेकर सामने आ गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुवव्राज तान्विष्णुश्चक्रपाणिर्महाबलः । पातालं परमं गत्वा संस्थितान्भीतभीतवत्
verses.transliteration: anuvavrāja tānviṣṇuścakrapāṇirmahābalaḥ | pātālaṃ paramaṃ gatvā saṃsthitānbhītabhītavat
verses.translation: O lord, give him room to stay. Do not turn out a guest. Consider the duty of a householder or virtue will be affected.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, give him room to stay. Do not turn out a guest. Consider the duty of a householder or virtue will be affected.
verses.science: सन्देश उन्हें कहलवाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुर्ददर्शामृतसम्भवाः । कान्ताः पूर्णेन्दुवदना दिव्यलावण्यगर्विताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare viṣṇurdadarśāmṛtasambhavāḥ | kāntāḥ pūrṇenduvadanā divyalāvaṇyagarvitāḥ
verses.translation: You stay in the house along with the ascetic. I shall remain outside with immense weapons.
verses.hindi: कार्यके लिये इस समय क्यों मरना चाहते हो 2
verses.commentary: Sense: You stay in the house along with the ascetic. I shall remain outside with immense weapons.
verses.science: कार्यके लिये इस समय क्यों मरना चाहते हो 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्मोहितः कामबाणैर्लेभे तत्रैव निर्वृतिम् । ताभिश्च वरनारीभिः क्रीडमानो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: sammohitaḥ kāmabāṇairlebhe tatraiva nirvṛtim | tābhiśca varanārībhiḥ krīḍamāno babhūva ha
verses.translation: On hearing the virtuous and auspicious words of his wife, the Bhilla thought thus.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे हाथसे आज पृथ्वी भी चली जायगी
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the virtuous and auspicious words of his wife, the Bhilla thought thus.
verses.science: तुम्हारे हाथसे आज पृथ्वी भी चली जायगी। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यः पुत्रानजनयद्विष्णुर्वरपराक्रमान् । महीं सर्वां कम्पयन्तो नानायुद्धविशारदान्
verses.transliteration: tābhyaḥ putrānajanayadviṣṇurvaraparākramān | mahīṃ sarvāṃ kampayanto nānāyuddhaviśāradān
verses.translation: *'How can I stay in the house after keeping my wife out. It will be sinful on my part if the ascetic goes elsewhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: *'How can I stay in the house after keeping my wife out. It will be sinful on my part if the ascetic goes elsewhere.
verses.science: सेनासहित अर्जुनके पास आये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो वै हरिपुत्रास्ते महाबलपराक्रमाः । महोपद्रवमाचेरुः स्वर्गे भुवि च दुःखदम्
verses.transliteration: tato vai hariputrāste mahābalaparākramāḥ | mahopadravamāceruḥ svarge bhuvi ca duḥkhadam
verses.translation: After thinking thus and insisting on it, he kept both of them within the house joyously, himself stayed out¬ side the house keeping all the weapons beside him.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिवमहाएुराणे ततीयायां शतर्रसंहितायां किरातावतारवर्णने भिल्‍्लाजुनसंवादों नाम चत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus and insisting on it, he kept both of them within the house joyously, himself stayed out¬ side the house keeping all the weapons beside him.
verses.science: इति श्रीजिवमहाएुराणे ततीयायां शतर्रसंहितायां किरातावतारवर्णने भिल्‍्लाजुनसंवादों नाम चत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकोपद्रवमालक्ष्य निर्जरा मुनयोऽथ वै । चक्रुर्निवेदननं तेषां ब्रह्मणे प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: lokopadravamālakṣya nirjarā munayo'tha vai | cakrurnivedananaṃ teṣāṃ brahmaṇe praṇipatya ca
verses.translation: During the night the cruel beasts of prey tormen¬ ted him- He too strenuously withstood them to the extent of his ability.
verses.hindi: भील-अर्जुन-संवाद नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: During the night the cruel beasts of prey tormen¬ ted him- He too strenuously withstood them to the extent of his ability.
verses.science: भील-अर्जुन-संवाद नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वादाय तान्ब्रह्मा ययौ कैलासपर्वतम् । तत्र दृष्ट्वा शिवं देवं प्रणनाम पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvādāya tānbrahmā yayau kailāsaparvatam | tatra dṛṣṭvā śivaṃ devaṃ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Getting up in the morning the ascetic saw the Bhilla of the forest devoured by the beasts of prey. He fislt much dejected at it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting up in the morning the ascetic saw the Bhilla of the forest devoured by the beasts of prey. He fislt much dejected at it.
verses.science: प्रणाम किया और उनसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः । जय देव महादेव सर्वस्वामिन्निति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stotrairnataskandhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | jaya deva mahādeva sarvasvāminniti bruvan
verses.translation: O ascetic, why are you sorry? What has happened is for good. Blessed and contented is he since the death has happened in this manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ascetic, why are you sorry? What has happened is for good. Blessed and contented is he since the death has happened in this manner.
verses.science: शिवजीसे कहने लगे--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । देवदेव महादेव लोकान् रक्षाखिलान्प्रभो । उपद्रुतान्विष्णुपुत्रैः पातालस्थैर्विकारिभिः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | devadeva mahādeva lokān rakṣākhilānprabho | upadrutānviṣṇuputraiḥ pātālasthairvikāribhiḥ
verses.translation: O ascetic, reducing myself to ashes, I too shall follow him. Be pleased to arrange for the pyre. This is the eternal duty of women.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ascetic, reducing myself to ashes, I too shall follow him. Be pleased to arrange for the pyre. This is the eternal duty of women.
verses.science: भक्तोंपर दया करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारीष्वमृतभूतासु संसक्तात्मा हरिर्विभो । पाताले तिष्ठतीदानीं रमते हि विकारवान्
verses.transliteration: nārīṣvamṛtabhūtāsu saṃsaktātmā harirvibho | pātāle tiṣṭhatīdānīṃ ramate hi vikāravān
verses.translation: On hearing her words which he thought to be proper, the ascetic arranged the pyre. She entered the pyre dutifully.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words which he thought to be proper, the ascetic arranged the pyre. She entered the pyre dutifully.
verses.science: सद्धक्तियुक्त स्तुति करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थं बहुस्तुतः शम्भुर्ब्रह्मणा सर्षिनिर्जरैः । लोकसंरक्षणार्थाय विष्णोरानयनाय च
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | itthaṃ bahustutaḥ śambhurbrahmaṇā sarṣinirjaraiḥ | lokasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya viṣṇorānayanāya ca
verses.translation: In the meantime 8iva himself appeared before her and >oke praising her lovingly blessed lady, O blessed lady.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime 8iva himself appeared before her and >oke praising her lovingly blessed lady, O blessed lady.'*
verses.science: सहस्रमुख आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् शम्भुः कृपासिन्धुर्महेश्वरः । तदुपद्रवमाज्ञाय वृषरूपो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān śambhuḥ kṛpāsindhurmaheśvaraḥ | tadupadravamājñāya vṛṣarūpo babhūva ha
verses.translation: O sinless lady, mention the boon you wish to have. I am pleased with your conduct. There is nothing which cannot be granted to you. 1 am utterly subservient to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sinless lady, mention the boon you wish to have. I am pleased with your conduct. There is nothing which cannot be granted to you. 1 am utterly subservient to you.
verses.science: आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The incarnation of Siva as the swan adept in the art of intelligence, was the bestower of great bliss to Dama¬ yanti as well as to Nala.
verses.hindi: माँगो, मैं तुम्हें वह सब कुछ दूँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: The incarnation of Siva as the swan adept in the art of intelligence, was the bestower of great bliss to Dama¬ yanti as well as to Nala.
verses.science: माँगो, मैं तुम्हें वह सब कुछ दूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The incarnation of Siva as the swan adept in the art of intelligence, was the bestower of great bliss to Dama¬ yanti as well as to Nala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The incarnation of Siva as the swan adept in the art of intelligence, was the bestower of great bliss to Dama¬ yanti as well as to Nala.
verses.science: शिवके सन्निकट स्थित हो गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । वृषेश्वरसंज्ञकशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततो वृषभरूपेण गर्जमानः पिनाकधृक् । प्रविष्टो विवरं तत्र निनदन्भैरवान् रवान्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.23. trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vṛṣeśvarasaṃjñakaśivāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | tato vṛṣabharūpeṇa garjamānaḥ pinākadhṛk | praviṣṭo vivaraṃ tatra ninadanbhairavān ravān
verses.translation: This great and holy narrative of Siva's incarnation of illustrious fame as swan is wonderful and indeed the bes¬ tower of sidvation
verses.commentary: Sense: This great and holy narrative of Siva's incarnation of illustrious fame as swan is wonderful and indeed the bes¬ tower of sidvation
verses.science: और यह वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निपेतुस्तस्य निनदैः पुराणि नगराणि च । प्रकम्पो हि बभूवाथ सर्वेषां पुरवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nipetustasya ninadaiḥ purāṇi nagarāṇi ca | prakampo hi babhūvātha sarveṣāṃ puravāsinām
verses.translation: O sage, on seeing his brothers Ik$vaku and others having taken their shares, Nabhaga desirous of his share told them affectionately.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on seeing his brothers Ik$vaku and others having taken their shares, Nabhaga desirous of his share told them affectionately.
