verses.science: इसकी पूजा की थी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो वृषो हरेः पुत्रान्सङ्ग्रामोद्यतकार्मुकान् । शिवमायाविमूढात्ममहाबलपराक्रमान्
verses.transliteration: tato vṛṣo hareḥ putrānsaṅgrāmodyatakārmukān | śivamāyāvimūḍhātmamahābalaparākramān
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his father, Nabhaga who considered truth as virtue went eagerly where the excellent sacrifice was on.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his father, Nabhaga who considered truth as virtue went eagerly where the excellent sacrifice was on.
verses.science: नामक स्थानमें स्वयं प्रतिष्ठित हुए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिपुत्रास्ततस्तेऽथ प्राकुप्यन्मुनिसत्तम । प्रदुद्रुवुः प्रगर्ज्योच्चैर्वीराः शङ्करसम्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: hariputrāstataste'tha prākupyanmunisattama | pradudruvuḥ pragarjyoccairvīrāḥ śaṅkarasammukham
verses.translation: O Nabhaga, the lord has come in that form in order to bless you. Go there. Propitiate him properly,
verses.commentary: Sense: O Nabhaga, the lord has come in that form in order to bless you. Go there. Propitiate him properly,
verses.science: भक्तोंके मनोरथको पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आयातांस्तान्हरेः पुत्रान् रुद्रो वृषभरूपधृक् । प्राकुप्यद्विष्णुपुत्रांश्च खुरैः शृङ्गैर्व्यदारयत्
verses.transliteration: āyātāṃstānhareḥ putrān rudro vṛṣabharūpadhṛk | prākupyadviṣṇuputrāṃśca khuraiḥ śṛṅgairvyadārayat
verses.translation: Request him to forgive your fault. Bow to him well and eulogise him. That Siva alone is the lord of all, the lord of sacrifice, the lord of everything.
verses.hindi: कराता है, वह जीवन्मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Request him to forgive your fault. Bow to him well and eulogise him. That Siva alone is the lord of all, the lord of sacrifice, the lord of everything.
verses.science: कराता है, वह जीवन्मुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विदारिताङ्गा रुद्रेण सर्वे हरिसुताश्च ते । नष्टा द्रुतं सन्बभूवुर्गतप्राणा विचेतसः
verses.transliteration: vidāritāṅgā rudreṇa sarve harisutāśca te | naṣṭā drutaṃ sanbabhūvurgataprāṇā vicetasaḥ
verses.translation: Vinu, Brahma and other gods, Siddhas and the sages, O dear, arc competent in their respective duties only due to his blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinu, Brahma and other gods, Siddhas and the sages, O dear, arc competent in their respective duties only due to his blessings.
verses.science: प्राप्तकर कैवल्यमोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु विष्णुर्बलवतां वरः । निष्क्रम्याथ प्रगर्ज्योच्चैर्ययौ शीघ्रं हरान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: hateṣu teṣu putreṣu viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ | niṣkramyātha pragarjyoccairyayau śīghraṃ harāntikam
verses.translation: O foremost of my sons, go there quickly. Do not delay. Propitiate the great god, the lord of all by every means.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला तथा घुश्माको आनन्द देनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: O foremost of my sons, go there quickly. Do not delay. Propitiate the great god, the lord of all by every means.
verses.science: करनेवाला तथा घुश्माको आनन्द देनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं प्रव्रजन्तं हतविष्णुसुतं वृषम् । शरैः सन्ताडयामास दिव्यैरस्त्रैश्च केशवः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ pravrajantaṃ hataviṣṇusutaṃ vṛṣam | śaraiḥ santāḍayāmāsa divyairastraiśca keśavaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, Manu Sraddhadeva, sent his son immediately to Siva. After approaching him and bowing to him with palms joined in reverence and head bent down, the delighted Nabhaga of great intellect spoke to him humbly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Manu Sraddhadeva, sent his son immediately to Siva. After approaching him and bowing to him with palms joined in reverence and head bent down, the delighted Nabhaga of great intellect spoke to him humbly.
verses.science: सरोवरमें ज्योतिर्लिग-स्वरूपसे स्थित हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धो महादेवो वृषरूपी मदाबलः । अस्त्राणि तानि विष्णोश्च जग्रास गिरिगोचरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho mahādevo vṛṣarūpī madābalaḥ | astrāṇi tāni viṣṇośca jagrāsa girigocaraḥ
verses.translation: O lord, my father says that whatever there is in the three worlds is yours to be sure. What then, about the wealth left over in a sacrifice?
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, my father says that whatever there is in the three worlds is yours to be sure. What then, about the wealth left over in a sacrifice?
verses.science: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ कृत्वा महाकोपं वृषात्मा स महेश्वरः । विननाद महाघोरं कम्पयंस्त्रिजगन्मुने
verses.transliteration: atha kṛtvā mahākopaṃ vṛṣātmā sa maheśvaraḥ | vinanāda mahāghoraṃ kampayaṃstrijaganmune
verses.translation: He who narrates or listens to the auspicious story of incarnation of Yatinatha hariisa, attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: स बै ममात्मभूतश्र मद्धक्त: कार्यकारक:॥ ५७  हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He who narrates or listens to the auspicious story of incarnation of Yatinatha hariisa, attains the greatest goal.
verses.science: स बै ममात्मभूतश्र मद्धक्त: कार्यकारक:॥ ५७ हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्प्लुत्य तरसा खुरैः शृङ्गैर्व्यदारयत् । विष्णुं क्रोधाकुलं मूढमजानन्तं निजं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: tata utplutya tarasā khuraiḥ śṛṅgairvyadārayat | viṣṇuṃ krodhākulaṃ mūḍhamajānantaṃ nijaṃ harim
verses.translation: The city of Nidha or Naiadha associated with King Nala can be identified with Nalapura, modern Narwar situated on the river KSlisindhu to the south-west of Gwalior.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Nidha or Naiadha associated with King Nala can be identified with Nalapura, modern Narwar situated on the river KSlisindhu to the south-west of Gwalior.
verses.science: नाना प्रकारका धर्माचरण कराते रहो। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शिथिलात्मा हि व्यथिताङ्गो बभूव ह । तत्प्रहारमसह्याशु हरिर्मायाविमोहितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śithilātmā hi vyathitāṅgo babhūva ha | tatprahāramasahyāśu harirmāyāvimohitaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing this narrative of Siva in the forms of an ascetic and a swan, the hearer enjoys all pleasures here and goes to Siva*» abode hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing this narrative of Siva in the forms of an ascetic and a swan, the hearer enjoys all pleasures here and goes to Siva*» abode hereafter.
verses.science: आश्रमको चले गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गतगर्वो हरिश्चैव विचेता गतचेतनः । ज्ञातवान् परमेशानं विहरन्तं वृषात्मना
verses.transliteration: gatagarvo hariścaiva vicetā gatacetanaḥ | jñātavān parameśānaṃ viharantaṃ vṛṣātmanā
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, listen lo the description of the great incarnation of Siva, the excellent Krsnadarana who gave perfect wisdom to Nabhaga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sanatkumara, listen lo the description of the great incarnation of Siva, the excellent Krsnadarana who gave perfect wisdom to Nabhaga.
verses.science: अर्जुनके दर्शनसे सुखकी प्राप्ति हुई। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ विज्ञाय गौरीशमागतं वृषरूपतः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: atha vijñāya gaurīśamāgataṃ vṛṣarūpataḥ | prāha gambhīrayā vācā nataskandhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Iksvaku and others were the sons of Sraddhadeva' of whom Nabhaga, was the ninth. His son was Nabhaga.
verses.hindi: भी उस वृत्तान्त-श्रवणसे तृप्त नहीं हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Iksvaku and others were the sons of Sraddhadeva' of whom Nabhaga, was the ninth. His son was Nabhaga.
verses.science: भी उस वृत्तान्त-श्रवणसे तृप्त नहीं हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिरुवाच । देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो । मायया ते महेशान मोहितोऽहं विमूढधीः
verses.transliteration: hariruvāca | devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho | māyayā te maheśāna mohito'haṃ vimūḍhadhīḥ
verses.translation: Nabhaga the son of Manu, highly intelligent, and with perfect control of his sense-organs stayed in the abode of his preceptors for studies for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nabhaga the son of Manu, highly intelligent, and with perfect control of his sense-organs stayed in the abode of his preceptors for studies for a long time.
verses.science: अवश्य ही हमलोगोंकी विजय होगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतं युद्धं त्वयेशेन स्वनाथेन मया प्रभो । कृपां कृत्वा मयि स्वामिन्सोऽपराधो हि सह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ tvayeśena svanāthena mayā prabho | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mayi svāminso'parādho hi sahyatām
verses.translation: During this interval Iksvaku and other sons had their due shares in the property without leaving any share for Nabhaga.
verses.hindi: जानकर हर्षित हुए और कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: During this interval Iksvaku and other sons had their due shares in the property without leaving any share for Nabhaga.
verses.science: जानकर हर्षित हुए और कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरेर्दीनतया मुने । भगवान् शङ्करः प्राह रमेशं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā harerdīnatayā mune | bhagavān śaṅkaraḥ prāha rameśaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of their father, the shrewd sons took their shares and enjoyed the kingdom with out any misery. They were fortunate.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of their father, the shrewd sons took their shares and enjoyed the kingdom with out any misery. They were fortunate.
verses.science: प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हे विष्णो हे महाबुद्धे कथं मां ज्ञातवान्न हि । युद्धं कृतं कृतस्तेऽद्य ज्ञानं सर्वं च विस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: he viṣṇo he mahābuddhe kathaṃ māṃ jñātavānna hi | yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaste'dya jñānaṃ sarvaṃ ca vismṛtam
verses.translation: According to this PurSoa, Sraddhadeva had several sons, Ik|v&ku and others, of whom Nabhaga was the ninth. Nabhaga had a son named Nabhaga. The latter had a son named Ambarifa. Pargiter omits Sr&dd- badeva and Nabhaga and mentions NabhSga instead of Nftbhaga as the father of Ambarifa.
verses.wordMeaning: According to this PurSoa, Sraddhadeva had several sons, Ik|v&ku and others, of whom Nabhaga was the ninth. Nabhaga had a son named Nabhaga. The latter had a son named Ambarifa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: According to this PurSoa, Sraddhadeva had several sons, Ik|v&ku and others, of whom Nabhaga was the ninth. Nabhaga had a son named Nabhaga. The latter had a son named Ambarifa.…
verses.science: इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं किन्न जानासि मदधीनपराक्रमम् । त्वया नात्र रतिः कार्या निवर्तस्व कुचारतः
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ kinna jānāsi madadhīnaparākramam | tvayā nātra ratiḥ kāryā nivartasva kucārataḥ
verses.translation: After learning the Vedas with their sections and sub-sections, in due course, the Brahmacarin Nabhga returned.
verses.hindi: दर्शन तथा स्पर्शसे पुरुषोंका कल्याण करनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: After learning the Vedas with their sections and sub-sections, in due course, the Brahmacarin Nabhga returned.
verses.science: दर्शन तथा स्पर्शसे पुरुषोंका कल्याण करनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कामाधीनं कथं ज्ञानं स्त्रीषु सक्तो विहारकृत् । नोचितं तव देवेश स्मरणं विश्वतारणम्
verses.transliteration: kāmādhīnaṃ kathaṃ jñānaṃ strīṣu sakto vihārakṛt | nocitaṃ tava deveśa smaraṇaṃ viśvatāraṇam
verses.translation: O my brothers you have taken your shares duly without leaving anything for me. I have now come for my share. Please give me mine.
verses.hindi: आप इन स्त्रियोंमें आसक्त होकर विहार कर रहे हैं; भला कामी पुरुषको ज्ञान किस प्रकार रह सकता है ? हे देवेश ! यह आपके लिये उचित नहीं है, क्योंकि आपका स्मरण तो विश्वका तारण करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: O my brothers you have taken your shares duly without leaving anything for me. I have now come for my share. Please give me mine.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा शम्भुवचनं विज्ञानप्रदमादरात् । व्रीड्यन्स्वमनसा विष्णुः प्राह वाचं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tacchutvā śambhuvacanaṃ vijñānapradamādarāt | vrīḍyansvamanasā viṣṇuḥ prāha vācaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Then we had forgotten to allow your share. We shall certainly do it now. Our father is your share. Take him.
verses.hindi: भोग तथा मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then we had forgotten to allow your share. We shall certainly do it now. Our father is your share. Take him.
verses.science: भोग तथा मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । ममात्र विद्यते चक्रं तद् गृहीत्वेतदादरात् । गमिष्यामि स्वलोकं तं त्वदाज्ञापरिपालकः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuruvāca | mamātra vidyate cakraṃ tad gṛhītvetadādarāt | gamiṣyāmi svalokaṃ taṃ tvadājñāparipālakaḥ
verses.translation: On bearing the words of his brothers Nabhaga was surprised. He approached his father and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On bearing the words of his brothers Nabhaga was surprised. He approached his father and said.
verses.science: भक्तोंके द्वारा संस्तुत हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य महेशानो वचनं वैष्णवं हरः । प्रत्युवाच वृषात्मा हि वृषरक्षः पुनर्हरिम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tadākarṇya maheśāno vacanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ haraḥ | pratyuvāca vṛṣātmā hi vṛṣarakṣaḥ punarharim
verses.translation: O father, my brothers have taken their shares leaving me out. I had been to the preceptor's abode for study as a student.
verses.commentary: Sense: O father, my brothers have taken their shares leaving me out. I had been to the preceptor's abode for study as a student.
verses.science: निःसन्देह मुक्ति प्रदान करता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: न विलम्बः प्रकर्त्तव्यो गन्तव्यमित आशु ते । मच्छासनाद्धरे लोके चक्रमत्रैव तिष्ठताम्
verses.transliteration: na vilambaḥ prakarttavyo gantavyamita āśu te | macchāsanāddhare loke cakramatraiva tiṣṭhatām
verses.translation: When I returned I asked them to allot my share; they replied that you are my share. I have now come for that purpose.
verses.hindi: है, जो भक्तोंको इच्छित फल देनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: When I returned I asked them to allot my share; they replied that you are my share. I have now come for that purpose.
verses.science: है, जो भक्तोंको इच्छित फल देनेवाला है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: सन्तानादित्यसंस्थानाच्छिवत्ववचनादपि । अहं घोरतरं तस्माच्चक्रमन्यद्ददामि ते
verses.transliteration: santānādityasaṃsthānācchivatvavacanādapi | ahaṃ ghorataraṃ tasmāccakramanyaddadāmi te
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing his words, his father 8raddha- deva was surprised. He consoled his son who was devoted to truth and virtue.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण करनेवाले वे महादेव आविर्भूत हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on hearing his words, his father 8raddha- deva was surprised. He consoled his son who was devoted to truth and virtue.
verses.science: पूर्ण करनेवाले वे महादेव आविर्भूत हुए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्त्वा हरोऽलेखीद्दिव्यं कालानलप्रभम् । परं चक्रं प्रदीप्तं हि सर्वदुष्टविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etaduktvā haro'lekhīddivyaṃ kālānalaprabham | paraṃ cakraṃ pradīptaṃ hi sarvaduṣṭavināśanam
verses.translation: O dear, do not pay heed to what they said. It was only to deceive you. I am not a share by any means, an instrument Of enjoyment.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, do not pay heed to what they said. It was only to deceive you. I am not a share by any means, an instrument Of enjoyment.
verses.science: भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णवे प्रददौ चक्रं घोरार्कायुतसुप्रभम् । सर्वामरमुनीन्द्राणां रक्षकाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: viṣṇave pradadau cakraṃ ghorārkāyutasuprabham | sarvāmaramunīndrāṇāṃ rakṣakāya mahātmane
verses.translation: Still since I have been given as a share by the deceitful persons I shall tell you the means of livelihood. Hear attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still since I have been given as a share by the deceitful persons I shall tell you the means of livelihood. Hear attentively.
verses.science: परमेश्वर ज्योतिर्लिगोंका वर्णन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा सुदर्शनं चान्यञ्चक्रं परमदीप्तिमत् । उवाच विबुधांस्तत्र विष्णुर्बुद्धिमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: labdhvā sudarśanaṃ cānyañcakraṃ paramadīptimat | uvāca vibudhāṃstatra viṣṇurbuddhimatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: The intelligent Ahgirasa brahmins are performing a sacrifice. Every sixth day the rites are marred.
verses.hindi: अर्चनसे भक्तोंके मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent Ahgirasa brahmins are performing a sacrifice. Every sixth day the rites are marred.
verses.science: अर्चनसे भक्तोंके मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेववरा यूयं मद्वाक्यं शृणुतादरात् । कर्तव्यं तत्तथा शीघ्रं ततः शं वो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sarvadevavarā yūyaṃ madvākyaṃ śṛṇutādarāt | kartavyaṃ tattathā śīghraṃ tataḥ śaṃ vo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O wise Nabhaga, you go there and praise them.
verses.hindi: सुदक्षिण नामक भक्त राजाकी रक्षा की थी
verses.commentary: Sense: O wise Nabhaga, you go there and praise them.
verses.science: सुदक्षिण नामक भक्त राजाकी रक्षा की थी। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्या वराङ्गनास्सन्ति पाताले यौवनान्विताः । ताभिः सार्द्धं महाक्रीडां यः करोतु करोतु सः
verses.transliteration: divyā varāṅganāssanti pātāle yauvanānvitāḥ | tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ mahākrīḍāṃ yaḥ karotu karotu saḥ
verses.translation: O sage, in that sacrifice during the diurnal rites the intelligent son of Manu recited two Vaivadeva suktas clearly.
verses.hindi: है एवं भोग तथा मोक्षको देनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, in that sacrifice during the diurnal rites the intelligent son of Manu recited two Vaivadeva suktas clearly.
verses.science: है एवं भोग तथा मोक्षको देनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा केशवाद्वाक्यं शूरास्त्रिदशयोनयः । प्रवेष्टुकामाः पातालं बभूवुर्विष्णुना सह
verses.transliteration: tacchutvā keśavādvākyaṃ śūrāstridaśayonayaḥ | praveṣṭukāmāḥ pātālaṃ babhūvurviṣṇunā saha
verses.translation: Lord Siva desirous of testing Nabhaga the son of Manu approached from north and said.
verses.hindi: इनकी नित्य ही पूजा करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva desirous of testing Nabhaga the son of Manu approached from north and said.
verses.science: इनकी नित्य ही पूजा करते हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: विचारमथ विज्ञाय तं तदा भगवान्हरः । क्रोधाच्छापं ददौ घोरं देवयोन्यष्टकस्य च
verses.transliteration: vicāramatha vijñāya taṃ tadā bhagavānharaḥ | krodhācchāpaṃ dadau ghoraṃ devayonyaṣṭakasya ca
verses.translation: O man, who are you that take away my assets and wealth? Who has sent you here? Tell me the whole truth.
verses.hindi: मुमुक्षुओंको वहाँपर मुक्ति प्रदान कर रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O man, who are you that take away my assets and wealth? Who has sent you here? Tell me the whole truth.
verses.science: मुमुक्षुओंको वहाँपर मुक्ति प्रदान कर रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हर उवाच । वर्जयित्वा मुनिं शान्तं दानवान्वा मदंशजम् । इदं यः प्रविशेत्स्थानं तस्य स्यान्निधनं क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: hara uvāca | varjayitvā muniṃ śāntaṃ dānavānvā madaṃśajam | idaṃ yaḥ praviśetsthānaṃ tasya syānnidhanaṃ kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: On heaving his words, O dear, the poet Nabhaga, son of Manu humbly replied to the Puru§a Kr§nadarana.
verses.hindi: निर्लिप्त रहकर कैवल्यपदके भागी होते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On heaving his words, O dear, the poet Nabhaga, son of Manu humbly replied to the Puru§a Kr§nadarana.
verses.science: निर्लिप्त रहकर कैवल्यपदके भागी होते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यमिदं घोरं मनुष्यहितवर्धनम् । प्रत्याख्यातास्तु रुद्रेण देवाः स्वगृहमाययुः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vākyamidaṃ ghoraṃ manuṣyahitavardhanam | pratyākhyātāstu rudreṇa devāḥ svagṛhamāyayuḥ
verses.translation: This wealth of the sacrifice has been given to me by the sages. Why do you, O Kr...adarsana prevent me from taking it.
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंके हितको बढ़ानेवाले शिवजीके इस घोर वाक्यको सुनकर तथा उनके द्वारा निषेध करनेपर देवतागण अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: This wealth of the sacrifice has been given to me by the sages. Why do you, O Kr...adarsana prevent me from taking it.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्त्रीलः परो विष्णुः शिवेन प्रतिशासितः । स्वर्लोकमगमद् व्यास स्वास्थ्यं प्राप जगच्च तत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ strīlaḥ paro viṣṇuḥ śivena pratiśāsitaḥ | svarlokamagamad vyāsa svāsthyaṃ prāpa jagacca tat
verses.translation: On hearing these truthful words uttered by Nabhaga, the delighted purusa KrnadarSana spoke.
verses.hindi: निश्चय ही यह भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these truthful words uttered by Nabhaga, the delighted purusa KrnadarSana spoke.
verses.science: निश्चय ही यह भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृषेश्वरोऽपि भगवान् शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । इत्थं कृत्वा देवकार्यं जगाम स्वगिरीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vṛṣeśvaro'pi bhagavān śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ | itthaṃ kṛtvā devakāryaṃ jagāma svagirīśvaram
verses.translation: O dear, in our dispute the ultimate authority is yoitf father. Go to him and ask him. What he says will be true and final.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, in our dispute the ultimate authority is yoitf father. Go to him and ask him. What he says will be true and final.
verses.science: वहींपर स्थित हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृषेश्वरावतारस्तु वर्णितः शङ्करस्य च । विष्णुमोहहरः शर्वः त्रैलोक्यसुखकारकः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣeśvarāvatārastu varṇitaḥ śaṅkarasya ca | viṣṇumohaharaḥ śarvaḥ trailokyasukhakārakaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the wise Nabhaga son of Manu, approached his father anxiously, O sage, and asked him about what he said.
verses.hindi: यह रामचन्द्रके द्वारा स्थापित किया गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the wise Nabhaga son of Manu, approached his father anxiously, O sage, and asked him about what he said.
verses.science: यह रामचन्द्रके द्वारा स्थापित किया गया है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रमिदमाख्यानं शत्रुबाधाहरं परम् । स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: pavitramidamākhyānaṃ śatrubādhāharaṃ param | svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ satām
verses.translation: On hearing what his son said, Manu iSraddha- deva remembered the lotus-like fbet of Siva and afler re¬ collecting spoke to him.
verses.hindi: जानेपर उनको विजयका वरदान दिया था
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing what his son said, Manu iSraddha- deva remembered the lotus-like fbet of Siva and afler re¬ collecting spoke to him.
verses.science: जानेपर उनको विजयका वरदान दिया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वै समाहितः । तथा पठिति यो हीदं पाठयेत् सुधियो नरान् । स भुक्त्वा सकलान् कामान् अन्ते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvai samāhitaḥ | tathā paṭhiti yo hīdaṃ pāṭhayet sudhiyo narān | sa bhuktvā sakalān kāmān ante mokṣamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Undoubtedly lord Siva deserves everything. What then of the wealth left over in a sacrifice? More depends on the lord's wish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly lord Siva deserves everything. What then of the wealth left over in a sacrifice? More depends on the lord's wish.
verses.science: सेतुबन्धमें स्थित हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The pure-souled Sraddhadeva too with head bent
verses.hindi: और भोग तथा मोक्षको प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure-souled Sraddhadeva too with head bent
verses.science: और भोग तथा मोक्षको प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The pure-souled Sraddhadeva too with head bent
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure-souled Sraddhadeva too with head bent
verses.science: नामक संहिताका वर्णन कर दिया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । पिप्पलादावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । पिप्पलादाख्यमपरमवतारं महेशितुः । शृणु प्राज्ञ महाप्रीत्या भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.24. caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | pippalādāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | pippalādākhyamaparamavatāraṃ maheśituḥ | śṛṇu prājña mahāprītyā bhaktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: In the meantime, Visnu, Brahma, Indra and the gods, Siddhas and the sages came there.
verses.hindi: उसके बाद वह मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Visnu, Brahma, Indra and the gods, Siddhas and the sages came there.
verses.science: उसके बाद वह मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः पुरा गदितो विप्रो दधीचिर्मुनिसत्तमः । महाशैवः सुप्रतापी च्यावनिर्भृगुवंशजः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ purā gadito vipro dadhīcirmunisattamaḥ | mahāśaivaḥ supratāpī cyāvanirbhṛguvaṃśajaḥ
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, listen to the first incarnation of the great lord, named Avadhutevara, who dispelled the ar¬ rogance of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Brahma, listen to the first incarnation of the great lord, named Avadhutevara, who dispelled the ar¬ rogance of Indra.
verses.science: नामक संहिताका वर्णन कर दिया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षुवेण सह सङ्ग्रामे येन विष्णुः पराजितः । सनिर्जरोऽथ संशप्तो महेश्वरसहायिना
verses.transliteration: kṣuveṇa saha saṅgrāme yena viṣṇuḥ parājitaḥ | sanirjaro'tha saṃśapto maheśvarasahāyinā
verses.translation: O you fool, even though I am asking, you are not giving me any answer. Hence I am going so kill you with' my thunderbolt. O wicked fellow, who is there to protect you?
verses.commentary: Sense: O you fool, even though I am asking, you are not giving me any answer. Hence I am going so kill you with' my thunderbolt. O wicked fellow, who is there to protect you?
verses.hindi: उसके बाद वह मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.science: उसके बाद वह मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी महाभागा सुवर्चा नाम नामतः । महापतिव्रता साध्वी यया शप्ता दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: tasya patnī mahābhāgā suvarcā nāma nāmataḥ | mahāpativratā sādhvī yayā śaptā divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: O great god, lord of the distressed, please raise me up, who have fallen at your feet. Do not be furious. Be kind and loving.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, lord of the distressed, please raise me up, who have fallen at your feet. Do not be furious. Be kind and loving.
verses.science: द्रादशज्योतिर्लिज्रावतारवर्णन॑ नाम द्विचत्वारिशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तस्यां महादेवो नानालीलाविशारदः । प्रादुर्बभूव तेजस्वी पिप्पलादेति नामतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttasyāṃ mahādevo nānālīlāviśāradaḥ | prādurbabhūva tejasvī pippalādeti nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Then that fire originating from the eye in the forehead of Siva and cast off into the briny sea became a boy immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that fire originating from the eye in the forehead of Siva and cast off into the briny sea became a boy immediately.
verses.hindi: द्वादशज्योतिर्लिगावतारवर्णन नामक बयालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.science: द्वादशज्योतिर्लिगावतारवर्णन नामक बयालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य मुनिश्रेष्ठो नन्दीश्वरवचोऽद्भुतम् । सनत्कुमारः प्रोवाच नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityākarṇya muniśreṣṭho nandīśvaravaco'dbhutam | sanatkumāraḥ provāca nataskandhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: The king of Vidarbha had a terrible fight with them. But his armies were destroyed and he was killed by Salvas due to adverse fate.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of Vidarbha had a terrible fight with them. But his armies were destroyed and he was killed by Salvas due to adverse fate.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । नन्दीश्वर महाप्राज्ञ साक्षाद् रुद्रस्वरूपधृक् । धन्यस्त्वं सद्गुरुस्तात श्रावितेयं कथाद्भुता
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | nandīśvara mahāprājña sākṣād rudrasvarūpadhṛk | dhanyastvaṃ sadgurustāta śrāviteyaṃ kathādbhutā
verses.translation: The thirsty mother, the wife of the king, entered the lake for drinking water but as willed by fate she was devoured by a crocodile in the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thirsty mother, the wife of the king, entered the lake for drinking water but as willed by fate she was devoured by a crocodile in the water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षुवेण सह सङ्ग्रामे श्रुतो विष्णुपराजयः । ब्रह्मणा मे पुरा तात तच्छापश्च शिलादज
verses.transliteration: kṣuveṇa saha saṅgrāme śruto viṣṇuparājayaḥ | brahmaṇā me purā tāta tacchāpaśca śilādaja
verses.translation: The son bereft of father and mother, distressed by hunger and thirst at the time of birth, cried out.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son bereft of father and mother, distressed by hunger and thirst at the time of birth, cried out.
verses.hindi: हे शिलादपुत्र! हे तात! क्षुवके साथ संग्राममें विष्णुको जिस प्रकार शिवभक्त दधीचिने पराजित किया था तथा उन्हें शाप दिया था, उस कथाको मैंने पहले ब्रह्माजीसे सुना था

verses.sanskrit: अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि देवशापं सुवर्चया । दत्तं पश्चात् पिप्पलादचरितं मङ्गलायनम्
verses.transliteration: adhunā śrotumicchāmi devaśāpaṃ suvarcayā | dattaṃ paścāt pippalādacaritaṃ maṅgalāyanam
verses.translation: A wandering beggar woman came there acciden¬ tally, urged mentally by Siva, the dispeller of fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: A wandering beggar woman came there acciden¬ tally, urged mentally by Siva, the dispeller of fear.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वाथ शैलादिर्विधिपुत्रवचः शुभम् । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śrutvātha śailādirvidhiputravacaḥ śubham | pratyuvāca prasannātmā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam
verses.translation: They were jubilant. They joined their palms In reverence. With great devotion they severally bowed down and eulogised.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were jubilant. They joined their palms In reverence. With great devotion they severally bowed down and eulogised.
verses.science: द्रादशज्योतिर्लिज्रावतारवर्णन॑ नाम द्विचत्वारिशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एकदा निर्जराः सर्वे वासवाद्या मुनीश्वर । वृत्रासुरसहायैश्च दैत्यैरासन्पराजिताः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ekadā nirjarāḥ sarve vāsavādyā munīśvara | vṛtrāsurasahāyaiśca daityairāsanparājitāḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted Rudra, Krnadarana glanced at them with sympathetic eyes and smilingly spoke to Nabhaga.
verses.hindi: द्वादशज्योतिर्लिगावतारवर्णन नामक बयालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted Rudra, Krnadarana glanced at them with sympathetic eyes and smilingly spoke to Nabhaga.
verses.science: द्वादशज्योतिर्लिगावतारवर्णन नामक बयालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वानि स्वानि वरास्त्राणि दधीचस्याश्रमेऽखिलाः । निःक्षिप्य सहसा सद्योऽभवन् देवाः पराजिताः
verses.transliteration: svāni svāni varāstrāṇi dadhīcasyāśrame'khilāḥ | niḥkṣipya sahasā sadyo'bhavan devāḥ parājitāḥ
verses.translation: Hence I am delighted with your holy rites. Sympathetically I ata conferring on you the eternal Brahman, the perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence I am delighted with your holy rites. Sympathetically I ata conferring on you the eternal Brahman, the perfect knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा सर्वे सुराः सेन्द्रा वध्यमानास्तथर्षयः । ब्रह्मलोकं गताः शीघ्रं प्रोचुः स्वं व्यसनं च तत्
verses.transliteration: tadā sarve surāḥ sendrā vadhyamānāstatharṣayaḥ | brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ śīghraṃ procuḥ svaṃ vyasanaṃ ca tat
verses.translation: Be great aiifi wise, O Nabhaga, along with the brahmins immediately.'; Take all this wealth granted by me out of compassion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be great aiifi wise, O Nabhaga, along with the brahmins immediately.'; Take all this wealth granted by me out of compassion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा देववचनं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । सर्वं शशंस तत्त्वेन त्वष्टुश्चैव चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā devavacanaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | sarvaṃ śaśaṃsa tattvena tvaṣṭuścaiva cikīrṣitam
verses.translation: O intelligent one, enjoy all pleasures without any aberration. By my grace you will attain the good goal along with the brahmin sacrificers.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, enjoy all pleasures without any aberration. By my grace you will attain the good goal along with the brahmin sacrificers.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भवद्वधार्थं जनितस्त्वष्ट्रायं तपसा सुराः । वृत्रो नाम महातेजाः सर्वदैत्याधिपो महान्
verses.transliteration: bhavadvadhārthaṃ janitastvaṣṭrāyaṃ tapasā surāḥ | vṛtro nāma mahātejāḥ sarvadaityādhipo mahān
verses.translation: ' O dear, after saying this, lord $iva, favourably disposed to truth, vanished there itself even as all were watching.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' O dear, after saying this, lord $iva, favourably disposed to truth, vanished there itself even as all were watching.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रयत्नः क्रियतां भवेदस्य वधो यथा । तत्रोपायं शृणु प्राज्ञ धर्महेतोर्वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: atha prayatnaḥ kriyatāṃ bhavedasya vadho yathā | tatropāyaṃ śṛṇu prājña dharmahetorvadāmi te
verses.translation: Vijnu, Brahma, the gods and all others, O ex¬ cellent sage, went to their respective abodes after joyously bowing to that direction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vijnu, Brahma, the gods and all others, O ex¬ cellent sage, went to their respective abodes after joyously bowing to that direction.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महामुनिर्दधीचिर्यः स तपस्वी जितेन्द्रियः । लेभे शिवं समाराध्य वज्रास्थित्ववरं पुरा
verses.transliteration: mahāmunirdadhīciryaḥ sa tapasvī jitendriyaḥ | lebhe śivaṃ samārādhya vajrāsthitvavaraṃ purā
verses.translation: iSraddhadeva too, accompanied by his son, went joyously to his abode. After enjoying extensive pleasures he went to Siva's city in the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: iSraddhadeva too, accompanied by his son, went joyously to his abode. After enjoying extensive pleasures he went to Siva's city in the end.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्थीन्येव याचध्वं स दास्यति न संशयः । निर्माय तैर्दण्डवज्रं वृत्रं जहि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tasyāsthīnyeva yācadhvaṃ sa dāsyati na saṃśayaḥ | nirmāya tairdaṇḍavajraṃ vṛtraṃ jahi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O Brahmin, the incarnation of Siva, named Kr$nadarlana, bestower of bliss on Nabhaga, has been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O Brahmin, the incarnation of Siva, named Kr$nadarlana, bestower of bliss on Nabhaga, has been narrated to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा ब्रह्मवचनं शक्रो गुरुसमन्वितः । आगच्छत्सामरः सद्यो दधीच्याश्रममुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tacchrutvā brahmavacanaṃ śakro gurusamanvitaḥ | āgacchatsāmaraḥ sadyo dadhīcyāśramamuttamam
verses.translation: The intelligent man who remembers this narrative both in the morning and in the evening becomes wise and knower of mantras. He attains the greatest goal in the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent man who remembers this narrative both in the morning and in the evening becomes wise and knower of mantras. He attains the greatest goal in the end.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तत्र मुनिं शक्रः सुवर्चान्वितमादरात् । ननाम साञ्जलिर्नम्रः सगुरुः सामरश्च तम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tatra muniṃ śakraḥ suvarcānvitamādarāt | nanāma sāñjalirnamraḥ saguruḥ sāmaraśca tam
verses.translation: O sage, formerly Indra accompanied by Bfhaspati and the other gods went to Kailasa in order to see Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, formerly Indra accompanied by Bfhaspati and the other gods went to Kailasa in order to see Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदभिप्रायमाज्ञाय स मुनिर्बुधसत्तमः । स्वपत्नीं प्रेषयामास सुवर्चां स्वाश्रमान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tadabhiprāyamājñāya sa munirbudhasattamaḥ | svapatnīṃ preṣayāmāsa suvarcāṃ svāśramāntaram
verses.translation: On knowing that Brhaspati and Indra wer6 coming and in order to test their mind in their eagerness to see him, the lord indulging in different kinds of sports as¬ sumed the form of an Avadhuta. He was naked. He looked fierce and had the lustre of blazing fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Brhaspati and Indra wer6 coming and in order to test their mind in their eagerness to see him, the lord indulging in different kinds of sports as¬ sumed the form of an Avadhuta. He was naked. He looked fierce and had the lustre of blazing fire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्स देवराजश्च सामरः स्वार्थसाधकः । अर्थशास्त्रपरो भूत्वा मुनीशं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatassa devarājaśca sāmaraḥ svārthasādhakaḥ | arthaśāstraparo bhūtvā munīśaṃ vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: The Avadhuta, the goal of the good, blocked their way. He stood there with matted hair hanging loosely, and the whole feature shining brilliantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Avadhuta, the goal of the good, blocked their way. He stood there with matted hair hanging loosely, and the whole feature shining brilliantly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच । त्वष्ट्रा विप्रकृताः सर्वे वयं देवास्तथर्षयः । शरण्यं त्वां महाशैवं दातारं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: śakra uvāca | tvaṣṭrā viprakṛtāḥ sarve vayaṃ devāstatharṣayaḥ | śaraṇyaṃ tvāṃ mahāśaivaṃ dātāraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: Passing that way towards Siva, Bfhaspati and Indra saw the gigantic figure of wonderful features on the way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Passing that way towards Siva, Bfhaspati and Indra saw the gigantic figure of wonderful features on the way.
verses.hindi: शक्र बोले--[हे मुने!] हम देवताओं तथा ऋषियोंको यह त्वष्टा बड़ा दुःख दे रहा है। इसलिये हमलोग महाशिवभक्त, शरणागतवत्सल तथा महादानी आपकी शरणमें आये हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: स्वास्थीनि देहि नो विप्र महावज्रमयानि हि । अस्थ्ना ते स्वपविं कृत्वा हनिष्यामि सुरद्रुहम्
verses.transliteration: svāsthīni dehi no vipra mahāvajramayāni hi | asthnā te svapaviṃ kṛtvā haniṣyāmi suradruham
verses.translation: Who are you? Whence have you come in this form of a naked Avadhuta? What is your true name? Tell me quickly and factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who are you? Whence have you come in this form of a naked Avadhuta? What is your true name? Tell me quickly and factually.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तेन स मुनिः परोपकरणे रतः । ध्यात्वा शिवं स्वनाथं हि विससर्ज कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktastena sa muniḥ paropakaraṇe rataḥ | dhyātvā śivaṃ svanāthaṃ hi visasarja kalevaram
verses.translation: Is iSiva in his abode? Or has he gone out? I am now going to see him along with my preceptor and the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Is iSiva in his abode? Or has he gone out? I am now going to see him along with my preceptor and the gods.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रके द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जानेपर परोपकारपरायण उन मुनिने अपने स्वामी शिवका ध्यान करके [अपना] शरीर छोड़ दिया

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोकं गतः सद्यः स मुनिर्ध्वस्तबन्धनः । पुष्पवृष्टिरभूत्तत्र सर्वे विस्मयमागताः
verses.transliteration: brahmalokaṃ gataḥ sadyaḥ sa munirdhvastabandhanaḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttatra sarve vismayamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Indra asked him again; but Siva whose ways are unknown, who was in the naked form and who was the creator of fanciful things did not say anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra asked him again; but Siva whose ways are unknown, who was in the naked form and who was the creator of fanciful things did not say anything.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ गां सुरभिं शक्र आहूयाशु ह्यलेहयत् । अस्त्रनिर्मितये त्वाष्ट्रं निर्दिदेश तदस्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: atha gāṃ surabhiṃ śakra āhūyāśu hyalehayat | astranirmitaye tvāṣṭraṃ nirdideśa tadasthibhiḥ
verses.translation: Again Indra, the lord of heaven and the master of the three worlds, asked him. The great Yogn of great sports remained silent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again Indra, the lord of heaven and the master of the three worlds, asked him. The great Yogn of great sports remained silent.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा तदाज्ञप्तश्चक्लृपेऽस्त्राणि कृत्स्नशः । तदस्थिभिर्वज्रमयैः सुदृढैः शिववर्चसा
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā tadājñaptaścaklṛpe'strāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ | tadasthibhirvajramayaiḥ sudṛḍhaiḥ śivavarcasā
verses.translation: Though asked by Indra again and again thus, lord Siva remained silent desirous of quelling the arrogance of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though asked by Indra again and again thus, lord Siva remained silent desirous of quelling the arrogance of Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वंशोद्भवैर्वज्रं शरो ब्रह्मशिरस्तथा । अन्यास्थिभिर्बहूनि स्वपराण्यस्त्राणि निर्ममे
verses.transliteration: tasya vaṃśodbhavairvajraṃ śaro brahmaśirastathā | anyāsthibhirbahūni svaparāṇyastrāṇi nirmame
verses.translation: Then the lord of the gods proud of his suzerainty over the three worlds became furious and said rebuking the lord having matted hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord of the gods proud of his suzerainty over the three worlds became furious and said rebuking the lord having matted hair.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रो वज्रमुद्यम्य वर्द्धितः शिववर्चसा । वृत्रमभ्यद्रवत्क्रुद्धो मुने रुद्र इवान्तकम्
verses.transliteration: tamindro vajramudyamya varddhitaḥ śivavarcasā | vṛtramabhyadravatkruddho mune rudra ivāntakam
verses.translation: Afler saying this and staring at him in fury Indra raised his thunderbolt in order to kill the naked persori.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afler saying this and staring at him in fury Indra raised his thunderbolt in order to kill the naked persori.
verses.hindi: हे मुने। तदनन्तर शिवजीके तेजसे वृद्धिको प्राप्त इन्द्र उस वज़्को उठाकर बड़े वेगसे वृत्रासुरपर क्रोध करके इस प्रकार दौड़े, मानो रुद्र यमकी ओर दौड़ रहे हों

verses.sanskrit: ततः शक्रः सुसन्नद्धस्तेन वज्रेण स द्रुतम् । उच्चकर्त शिरो वार्त्रं गिरिशृङ्गमिवौजसा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śakraḥ susannaddhastena vajreṇa sa drutam | uccakarta śiro vārtraṃ giriśṛṅgamivaujasā
verses.translation: On seeing Indra lifting up the thunderbolt, Siva made his hand stunned.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Indra lifting up the thunderbolt, Siva made his hand stunned.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा समुत्सवस्तात बभूव त्रिदिवौकसाम् । तुष्टुवुर्निर्जराः शक्रं पेतुः कुसुमवृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: tadā samutsavastāta babhūva tridivaukasām | tuṣṭuvurnirjarāḥ śakraṃ petuḥ kusumavṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.translation: Then that Puru$a, furious and terrific, with terrible eyes, blazed with his brilliance as though he would burn everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that Puru$a, furious and terrific, with terrible eyes, blazed with his brilliance as though he would burn everything.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात प्रसङ्गाच्चरितं त्विदम् । पिप्पलादावतारं मे शृणु शम्भोर्महादरात्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ tāta prasaṅgāccaritaṃ tvidam | pippalādāvatāraṃ me śṛṇu śambhormahādarāt
verses.translation: The lord of iSaci burnt within himself due to the anger resulting from the benumbed state of his hand like a serpent whose fury had been curbed by a magical formula.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of iSaci burnt within himself due to the anger resulting from the benumbed state of his hand like a serpent whose fury had been curbed by a magical formula.
verses.hindi: हे तात! मैंने प्रसंगवश आपसे इस चरित्रका वर्णन किया। अब आप मुझसे शिवजीके पिप्पलाद- अवतारको आदरपूर्वक सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चा सा मुनेः पत्नी दधीचस्य महात्मनः । ययौ स्वमाश्रमाभ्यन्तस्तदाज्ञप्ता पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: suvarcā sā muneḥ patnī dadhīcasya mahātmanaḥ | yayau svamāśramābhyantastadājñaptā pativratā
verses.translation: On seeing the Purusa blazing thus in his own brilliance Brhaspati knew him to be Siva and bowed to him soon.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Purusa blazing thus in his own brilliance Brhaspati knew him to be Siva and bowed to him soon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य तत्र सा दृष्ट्वा न पतिं स्वं तपस्विनी । गृहकार्यं च सा कृत्वाखिलं पतिनिदेशतः
verses.transliteration: āgatya tatra sā dṛṣṭvā na patiṃ svaṃ tapasvinī | gṛhakāryaṃ ca sā kṛtvākhilaṃ patinideśataḥ
verses.translation: Brhaspati of liberal mind kept his palms joined together and prostrated on the ground like a staff and eu¬ logised him with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati of liberal mind kept his palms joined together and prostrated on the ground like a staff and eu¬ logised him with devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम पुनस्तत्र पश्यन्ती बह्वशोभनम् । देवांश्च तान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुवर्चा विस्मिताभवत्
verses.transliteration: ājagāma punastatra paśyantī bahvaśobhanam | devāṃśca tānmuniśreṣṭha suvarcā vismitābhavat
verses.translation: O great god, lord of the gods, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge in you, O lord of Gaurl, be pleased. O lord of all, obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, lord of the gods, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge in you, O lord of Gaurl, be pleased. O lord of all, obeisance be to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा च तत्सर्वमिदं सुराणां कृत्यं तदानीं च चुकोप साध्वी । ददौ तदा शापमतीव रुष्टा तेषां सुवर्चा ऋषिवर्यभार्या
verses.transliteration: jñātvā ca tatsarvamidaṃ surāṇāṃ kṛtyaṃ tadānīṃ ca cukopa sādhvī | dadau tadā śāpamatīva ruṣṭā teṣāṃ suvarcā ṛṣivaryabhāryā
verses.translation: Even Brahma, Visnu and others are all deluded by your Maya, They do not know you really. If at all they know, it is only by your blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even Brahma, Visnu and others are all deluded by your Maya, They do not know you really. If at all they know, it is only by your blessings.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चोवाच । अहो सुरा द्रुष्टतराश्च सर्वे स्वकार्यदक्षा ह्यबुधाश्च लुब्धाः । तस्माच्च सर्वे पशवो भवन्तु सेन्द्राश्च मेऽद्यप्रभृतीत्युवाच
verses.transliteration: suvarcovāca | aho surā druṣṭatarāśca sarve svakāryadakṣā hyabudhāśca lubdhāḥ | tasmācca sarve paśavo bhavantu sendrāśca me'dyaprabhṛtītyuvāca
verses.translation: After eulogising lord Siva, Brhaspati made Indra fill at his feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising lord Siva, Brhaspati made Indra fill at his feet.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं शापं ददौ तेषां सुराणां सा तपस्विनी । सशक्राणां च सर्वेषां सुवर्चा मुनिकामिनी
verses.transliteration: evaṃ śāpaṃ dadau teṣāṃ surāṇāṃ sā tapasvinī | saśakrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ suvarcā munikāminī
verses.translation: O dear, then the liberal-minded preceptor of the gods, Brhaspati, the intelligent one, bowed humbly and spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, then the liberal-minded preceptor of the gods, Brhaspati, the intelligent one, bowed humbly and spoke thus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुगन्तुं पतेर्लोकमथेच्छत्सा पतिव्रता । चितां चक्रे समेधोभिः सुपवित्रैर्मनस्विनी
verses.transliteration: anugantuṃ paterlokamathecchatsā pativratā | citāṃ cakre samedhobhiḥ supavitrairmanasvinī
verses.translation: O great god, be satisfied. Save Indra who has sought refuge in you. Fire originating from your eye in the forehead i.s coming out.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, be satisfied. Save Indra who has sought refuge in you. Fire originating from your eye in the forehead i.s coming out.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो नभोगिरा प्राह सुवर्चां तां मुनिप्रियाम् । आश्वासयन्ती गिरिशप्रेरिता सुखदायिनी
verses.transliteration: tato nabhogirā prāha suvarcāṃ tāṃ munipriyām | āśvāsayantī giriśapreritā sukhadāyinī
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brhaspati, the lord in the form of Avadhuta, the ocean of mercy, indulging in good sports, laughingly said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brhaspati, the lord in the form of Avadhuta, the ocean of mercy, indulging in good sports, laughingly said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशवाण्युवाच । साहसं न कुरु प्राज्ञे शृणु मे परमं वचः । मुनितेजस्त्वदुदरे तदुत्पादय यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: ākāśavāṇyuvāca | sāhasaṃ na kuru prājñe śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | munitejastvadudare tadutpādaya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: How can I withhold the fiic that has come out of
verses.commentary: Sense: How can I withhold the fiic that has come out of
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वाभीष्टचरणं देवि कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि । सगर्भा न दहेद् गात्रमिति ब्रह्मनिदेशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svābhīṣṭacaraṇaṃ devi kartuṃ tvamarhasi | sagarbhā na dahed gātramiti brahmanideśanam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of 8iva, Bfhaspati with his mind agitated due to fright spoke again with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of 8iva, Bfhaspati with his mind agitated due to fright spoke again with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा सा नभोवाणी विरराम मुनीश्वर । तां श्रुत्वा सा मुनेः पत्नी विस्मिताभूत्क्षणं च सा
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā sā nabhovāṇī virarāma munīśvara | tāṃ śrutvā sā muneḥ patnī vismitābhūtkṣaṇaṃ ca sā
verses.translation: O lord, devotees are always to be pitied. O Siva, thus make your name Bhaktavatsala true.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, devotees are always to be pitied. O Siva, thus make your name Bhaktavatsala true.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चा सा महासाध्वी पतिलोकमभीप्सती । उपविश्याश्मना भूयः सोदरं विददार ह
verses.transliteration: suvarcā sā mahāsādhvī patilokamabhīpsatī | upaviśyāśmanā bhūyaḥ sodaraṃ vidadāra ha
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, it behoves you to cast off this fire elsewhere. Please lift up Indra since you arc the up- lifter of all devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the gods, it behoves you to cast off this fire elsewhere. Please lift up Indra since you arc the up- lifter of all devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्गतो जठरात्तस्या गर्भो मुनिवरस्य सः । महादिव्यतनुर्दीप्तो भासयंश्च दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: nirgato jaṭharāttasyā garbho munivarasya saḥ | mahādivyatanurdīpto bhāsayaṃśca diśo daśa
verses.translation: Thus requested by Brhaspati, Siva who bore the name of Bhaktavatsala, the delighted soul and the dispcller of the distress of those who bow down, replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by Brhaspati, Siva who bore the name of Bhaktavatsala, the delighted soul and the dispcller of the distress of those who bow down, replied.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद् रुद्रावतारोऽसौ दधीचिवरतेजसः । प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं तात स्वलीलाकरणे क्षमः
verses.transliteration: sākṣād rudrāvatāro'sau dadhīcivaratejasaḥ | prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ tāta svalīlākaraṇe kṣamaḥ
verses.translation: O preceptor of the gods, I am pleased with you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor of the gods, I am pleased with you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा स्वसुतं दिव्यं स्वरूपं मुनिकामिनी । सुवर्चाज्ञाय मनसा साक्षाद् रुद्रावतारकम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā svasutaṃ divyaṃ svarūpaṃ munikāminī | suvarcājñāya manasā sākṣād rudrāvatārakam
verses.translation: I shall cast off this fire which has cofne out of the eye in my forehead, and which is unbearable to the gods, so that it will not afflict Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall cast off this fire which has cofne out of the eye in my forehead, and which is unbearable to the gods, so that it will not afflict Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टाभून्महासाध्वी प्रणम्याशु नुनाव सा । स्वहृदि स्थापयामास तत्स्वरूपं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭābhūnmahāsādhvī praṇamyāśu nunāva sā | svahṛdi sthāpayāmāsa tatsvarūpaṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: After saying this he took the wonderful fire, origi¬ nating from his eye in the forehead in his hand and cast it off into the briny sea.®
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this he took the wonderful fire, origi¬ nating from his eye in the forehead in his hand and cast it off into the briny sea.®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चा तनयं तं च प्रहस्य विमलेक्षणा । जननी प्राह सुप्रीत्या पतिलोकमभीप्सती
verses.transliteration: suvarcā tanayaṃ taṃ ca prahasya vimalekṣaṇā | jananī prāha suprītyā patilokamabhīpsatī
verses.translation: He became tbc lord of Asuras known as Jalandhara and Sindhuputra (Son of the Sea). At the request of the gods, lord Siva slew him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He became tbc lord of Asuras known as Jalandhara and Sindhuputra (Son of the Sea). At the request of the gods, lord Siva slew him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चोवाच । हे तात परमेशान चिरं तिष्ठास्य सन्निधौ । अश्वत्थस्य महाभाग सर्वेषां सुखदो भवेः
verses.transliteration: suvarcovāca | he tāta parameśāna ciraṃ tiṣṭhāsya sannidhau | aśvatthasya mahābhāga sarveṣāṃ sukhado bhaveḥ
verses.translation: It refers to the briny ocean lying to the west of Bhfirata.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the briny ocean lying to the west of Bhfirata.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मामाज्ञापय सुप्रीत्या पतिलोकाय चाधुना । तत्रस्थाहं च पतिना त्वां ध्याये रुद्ररूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: māmājñāpaya suprītyā patilokāya cādhunā | tatrasthāhaṃ ca patinā tvāṃ dhyāye rudrarūpiṇam
verses.translation: After carrying out this task §iva, the benefactor of the worlds in the form of Avadhuta, vanished from there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After carrying out this task §iva, the benefactor of the worlds in the form of Avadhuta, vanished from there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्येवं सा बभाषेऽथ सुवर्चा तनयं प्रति । पतिमन्वगमत्साध्वी परमेण समाधिना
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityevaṃ sā babhāṣe'tha suvarcā tanayaṃ prati | patimanvagamatsādhvī parameṇa samādhinā
verses.translation: The gods became happy and fearless. Bfhaspati and Indra became free from terror and attained supreme happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods became happy and fearless. Bfhaspati and Indra became free from terror and attained supreme happiness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं दधीचपत्नी सा पतिना सङ्गता मुने । शिवलोकं समासाद्य सिषेवे शङ्करं मुदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dadhīcapatnī sā patinā saṅgatā mune | śivalokaṃ samāsādya siṣeve śaṅkaraṃ mudā
verses.translation: After seeing the lord for which they had come there, Brhaspati and Indra returned to their respective abodes joyous and contented.
verses.commentary: Sense: After seeing the lord for which they had come there, Brhaspati and Indra returned to their respective abodes joyous and contented.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सेन्द्राश्च मुनिभिः सह । तत्राजग्मुस्त्वरा तात आहूता इव हर्षिताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devāḥ sendrāśca munibhiḥ saha | tatrājagmustvarā tāta āhūtā iva harṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the incarnation Avadhute§vara of lord Siva has been narrated by me. It yields the highest bliss and punishes the wicked.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the incarnation Avadhute§vara of lord Siva has been narrated by me. It yields the highest bliss and punishes the wicked.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिर्ब्रह्मा च सुप्रीत्यावतीर्णं शङ्करं भुवि । सुवर्चायां दधीचाद्वा ययतुः स्वगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: harirbrahmā ca suprītyāvatīrṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bhuvi | suvarcāyāṃ dadhīcādvā yayatuḥ svagaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: He who listens to this or narrates this with atten¬ tive mind enjoys all pleasures and attains the goal of Siva in the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this or narrates this with atten¬ tive mind enjoys all pleasures and attains the goal of Siva in the end.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दृष्ट्वावतीर्णं तं मुनिपुत्रत्वमागतम् । रुद्रं सर्वे प्रणेमुश्च तुष्टुवुर्बद्धपाणयः
verses.transliteration: tatra dṛṣṭvāvatīrṇaṃ taṃ muniputratvamāgatam | rudraṃ sarve praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvurbaddhapāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sage, I shall now narrate the incarna¬ tion of Siva in which he dispelled the suspicion of a brahmin woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, I shall now narrate the incarna¬ tion of Siva in which he dispelled the suspicion of a brahmin woman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सवो महानासीद्देवानां मुनिसत्तम । नेदुर्दुन्दुभयस्तत्र नर्तक्यो ननृतुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: tadotsavo mahānāsīddevānāṃ munisattama | nedurdundubhayastatra nartakyo nanṛturmudā
verses.translation: O sage, as the king ruled over the kingdom virtuously observing piety to Siva, a long time elapsed very happily.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, as the king ruled over the kingdom virtuously observing piety to Siva, a long time elapsed very happily.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जगुर्गन्धर्वपुत्राश्च किन्नरा वाद्यवादकाः । वादयामासुरमराः पुष्पवृष्टिं च चक्रिरे

verses.commentary: Sense: At your behest I shall nourish and bring up this boy as though he is my own son. There shall be no; doubt in this. You have come here by my good fortune.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथानादृत्य मद्वाक्यं कुर्यात्पीडां शनिः क्वचित् । तेषां नृणां तदा स स्याद्भस्मसान्न हि संशयः
verses.transliteration: athānādṛtya madvākyaṃ kuryātpīḍāṃ śaniḥ kvacit | teṣāṃ nṛṇāṃ tadā sa syādbhasmasānna hi saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Read »TfSrCI for of tho printed Ski. text.
