verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्भयतस्तात विकृतोऽपि शनैश्चरः । तेषां न कुरुते पीडां कदाचिद् ग्रहसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: iti tadbhayatastāta vikṛto'pi śanaiścaraḥ | teṣāṃ na kurute pīḍāṃ kadācid grahasattamaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, O excellent mendicant, again and again the thought occurs to me that you are Siva, the ocean of mercy and this infant had been your devotee formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, O excellent mendicant, again and again the thought occurs to me that you are Siva, the ocean of mercy and this infant had been your devotee formerly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति लीलामनुष्यस्य पिप्पलादस्य सन्मुने । कथितं सुचरित्रं ते सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti līlāmanuṣyasya pippalādasya sanmune | kathitaṃ sucaritraṃ te sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: Through some defect in his past actions he has attained this plight. After experiencing it he will surely attain glory, thanks to your bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through some defect in his past actions he has attained this plight. After experiencing it he will surely attain glory, thanks to your bliss.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गाधिश्च कौशिकश्चैव पिप्पलादो महामुनिः । शनैश्चरकृतां पीडां नाशयन्ति स्मृतास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: gādhiśca kauśikaścaiva pippalādo mahāmuniḥ | śanaiścarakṛtāṃ pīḍāṃ nāśayanti smṛtāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin lady, listen with pleasure to the an¬ tecedents of this boy. O sinless one, I shall mention all the details to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin lady, listen with pleasure to the an¬ tecedents of this boy. O sinless one, I shall mention all the details to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलादस्य चरितं पद्माचरितसंयुतम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सुभक्त्या भुवि मानवः
verses.transliteration: pippalādasya caritaṃ padmācaritasaṃyutam | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi subhaktyā bhuvi mānavaḥ
verses.translation: She came here in the morning and gave birth to this boy. Due to thirst she got into the lake and as fate would have it, was seized by the crocodile.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came here in the morning and gave birth to this boy. Due to thirst she got into the lake and as fate would have it, was seized by the crocodile.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शनिपीडाविनाशार्थमेतच्चरितमुत्तमम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: śanipīḍāvināśārthametaccaritamuttamam | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thus he narrated to her all the details, the manner of his birth, the death of his father in the battle and that of his mother due to the crocodile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he narrated to her all the details, the manner of his birth, the death of his father in the battle and that of his mother due to the crocodile.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो मुनिवरो ज्ञानी महाशैवः सतां प्रियः । अस्य पुत्रो महेशानः पिप्पलादाख्य आत्मवान्
verses.transliteration: dhanyo munivaro jñānī mahāśaivaḥ satāṃ priyaḥ | asya putro maheśānaḥ pippalādākhya ātmavān
verses.translation: O great sage, then the brahmin lady who was surprised asked the mendicant of perfect knowledge in the form of a Siddha, again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, then the brahmin lady who was surprised asked the mendicant of perfect knowledge in the form of a Siddha, again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं स्वर्ग्यं कुग्रहदोषहृत् । सर्वकामप्रदं तात शिवभक्तिविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idamākhyānamanaghaṃ svargyaṃ kugrahadoṣahṛt | sarvakāmapradaṃ tāta śivabhaktivivarddhanam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the brahmin wife, the delighted mendicant, lord Siva himself, said laughingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of the brahmin wife, the delighted mendicant, lord Siva himself, said laughingly.
verses.hindi: हे तात! यह आख्यान निष्पाप, स्वर्गको देनेवाला, क्रूर ग्रहोंके दोषको नष्ट करनेवाला, सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाला तथा शिवभक्तिको बढ़ानेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus their activities have been narrated to you. People having no devotion to Siva and not worshipping him attain poverty,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus their activities have been narrated to you. People having no devotion to Siva and not worshipping him attain poverty,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus their activities have been narrated to you. People having no devotion to Siva and not worshipping him attain poverty,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus their activities have been narrated to you. People having no devotion to Siva and not worshipping him attain poverty,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । वैश्यनाथाह्वयशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । अवतारं परानन्दं वैश्यनाथाह्वयं मुने
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.26. ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vaiśyanāthāhvayaśivāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi śivasya paramātmanaḥ | avatāraṃ parānandaṃ vaiśyanāthāhvayaṃ mune
verses.translation: O brahmin lady, hence your son has incurred poverty. Seek refuge in S'va in order to ward off that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin lady, hence your son has incurred poverty. Seek refuge in S'va in order to ward off that sin.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिग्रामे पुरा काचिन्महानन्देति विश्रुता । बभूव वारवनिता शिवभक्ता सुसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: nandigrāme purā kācinmahānandeti viśrutā | babhūva vāravanitā śivabhaktā susundarī
verses.translation: O sage, after a year had elapsed, the prince once went to a forest along with the brahmin boy. There a Gandharva came by chance and gave his daughter in mar¬ riage to the prince. The prince ruled over the kingdom without any check or hindrance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after a year had elapsed, the prince once went to a forest along with the brahmin boy. There a Gandharva came by chance and gave his daughter in mar¬ riage to the prince. The prince ruled over the kingdom without any check or hindrance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महाविभवसम्पन्ना सुधनाढ्या महोज्ज्वला । नानारत्नपरिच्छिन्नशृङ्गाररसनिर्भरा
verses.transliteration: mahāvibhavasampannā sudhanāḍhyā mahojjvalā | nānāratnaparicchinnaśṛṅgārarasanirbharā
verses.translation: After drinking the artificial milk given by his mother the boy said "O, this is not milk" and cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After drinking the artificial milk given by his mother the boy said "O, this is not milk" and cried again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसङ्गीतविद्यासु निपुणातिमनोहरा । तस्या गेयेन हृष्यन्ति राज्ञ्यो राजान एव च
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṅgītavidyāsu nipuṇātimanoharā | tasyā geyena hṛṣyanti rājñyo rājāna eva ca
verses.translation: Parvati took the form of Saci. The Ganas became the gods, Nandin became the elephant Airavata. Everything belonging to Siva became that of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parvati took the form of Saci. The Ganas became the gods, Nandin became the elephant Airavata. Everything belonging to Siva became that of Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समानर्च सदा साम्बं सा वेश्या शङ्करं मुदा । शिवनामजपासक्ता भस्मरुद्राक्षभूषणा
verses.transliteration: samānarca sadā sāmbaṃ sā veśyā śaṅkaraṃ mudā | śivanāmajapāsaktā bhasmarudrākṣabhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: I choose the boon from that deity whom the knowers of reality consider free from causations, disputes and the bestower of the principles of Sahkhya and Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: I choose the boon from that deity whom the knowers of reality consider free from causations, disputes and the bestower of the principles of Sahkhya and Yoga.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवं सम्पूज्य सा नित्यं सेवन्ती जगदीश्वरम् । ननर्त परया भक्त्या गायन्ती शिवसद्यशः
verses.transliteration: śivaṃ sampūjya sā nityaṃ sevantī jagadīśvaram | nanarta parayā bhaktyā gāyantī śivasadyaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Dear Upamanyu, I am pleased with your ex¬ cellent behaviour. O brahmin sage, you are very firm in your devotion. I just desired to know you thoroughly.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dear Upamanyu, I am pleased with your ex¬ cellent behaviour. O brahmin sage, you are very firm in your devotion. I just desired to know you thoroughly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षैर्भूषयित्वैकं मर्कटं चैव कुक्कुटम् । करतालैश्च गीतैश्च सदा नर्तयति स्म सा
verses.transliteration: rudrākṣairbhūṣayitvaikaṃ markaṭaṃ caiva kukkuṭam | karatālaiśca gītaiśca sadā nartayati sma sā
verses.translation: After granting him the boons, lord Siva took him with both the hands, sniffed at his head and showed him to the goodess saying: "This is your son."
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting him the boons, lord Siva took him with both the hands, sniffed at his head and showed him to the goodess saying: "This is your son."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यमानौ च तौ दृष्ट्वा शिवभक्तिरता च सा । वेश्या स्म विहसत्युच्चैः प्रेम्णा सर्वसखीयुता
verses.transliteration: nṛtyamānau ca tau dṛṣṭvā śivabhaktiratā ca sā | veśyā sma vihasatyuccaiḥ premṇā sarvasakhīyutā
verses.translation: Listening with pleasure and placing her hands on his head she granted him the everlasting status of a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listening with pleasure and placing her hands on his head she granted him the everlasting status of a son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षैः कृतकेयूरकर्णाभरणमण्डना । मर्कटः शिक्षया तस्याः पुरो नृत्यति बालवत्
verses.transliteration: rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtakeyūrakarṇābharaṇamaṇḍanā | markaṭaḥ śikṣayā tasyāḥ puro nṛtyati bālavat
verses.translation: She gave him undecaying, compressed ocean of milk, the prosperity and power of yoga, the undying knowledge of Brahman and the great assets.
verses.commentary: Sense: She gave him undecaying, compressed ocean of milk, the prosperity and power of yoga, the undying knowledge of Brahman and the great assets.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिखासम्बद्धरुद्राक्षः कुक्कुटः कपिना सह । नित्यं ननर्त नृत्यज्ञः पश्यतां हितमावहन्
verses.transliteration: śikhāsambaddharudrākṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ kapinā saha | nityaṃ nanarta nṛtyajñaḥ paśyatāṃ hitamāvahan
verses.translation: Let the worship of Siva be performed by these two sons. Only after the investiture with the sacred *'read will Siva bestow glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the worship of Siva be performed by these two sons. Only after the investiture with the sacred *'read will Siva bestow glory.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं सा कुर्वती वेश्या कौतुकं परमादरात् । शिवभक्तिरता नित्यं महानन्दभराभवत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sā kurvatī veśyā kautukaṃ paramādarāt | śivabhaktiratā nityaṃ mahānandabharābhavat
verses.translation: After instructing her thus, Siva in the form of a mendicant, favourably disposed towards his devotees, revealed his real self to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After instructing her thus, Siva in the form of a mendicant, favourably disposed towards his devotees, revealed his real self to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवभक्तिं प्रकुर्वन्त्या वेश्याया मुनिसत्तम । बहुकालो व्यतीयाय तस्याः परमसौख्यतः
verses.transliteration: śivabhaktiṃ prakurvantyā veśyāyā munisattama | bahukālo vyatīyāya tasyāḥ paramasaukhyataḥ
verses.translation: Even as the brahmin lady stood watching, Siva who had taken the form of a mendicant vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the brahmin lady stood watching, Siva who had taken the form of a mendicant vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: हे मुनिसत्तम! इस प्रकार शिवभक्ति करती हैः उस वेश्याका सुखपूर्वक बहुत समय व्यतीत गया

verses.sanskrit: एकदा च गृहे तस्या वैश्यो भूत्वा शिवः स्वयम् । परीक्षितुं च तद्भावमाजगाम शुभो व्रती
verses.transliteration: ekadā ca gṛhe tasyā vaiśyo bhūtvā śivaḥ svayam | parīkṣituṃ ca tadbhāvamājagāma śubho vratī
verses.translation: When the mendicant disappeared, the care-free brahmin woman took that boy and her son home.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the mendicant disappeared, the care-free brahmin woman took that boy and her son home.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुण्ड्रविलसद्भालो रुद्राक्षाभरणः कृती । शिवनामजपासक्तो जटिलः शैववेषभृत्
verses.transliteration: tripuṇḍravilasadbhālo rudrākṣābharaṇaḥ kṛtī | śivanāmajapāsakto jaṭilaḥ śaivaveṣabhṛt
verses.translation: She took up residence in the beautiful city Eka- cakra®** and nourished the prince and her own son with excellent food.
verses.commentary: Sense: She took up residence in the beautiful city Eka- cakra®** and nourished the prince and her own son with excellent food.
verses.hindi: वे कृती (वैश्यरूप शिव) त्रिपुण्ड्से शोभायमान मस्तकवाले, रुद्राक्षे आभरणवाले, शिवनाम जपनेमें आसक्त, जययुक्त तथा शैव वेश धारण किये हुए थे

verses.sanskrit: स बिभ्रद्भस्मनिचयं प्रकोष्ठे वरकङ्कणम् । महारत्नपरिस्तीर्णं राजते परकौतुकी
verses.transliteration: sa bibhradbhasmanicayaṃ prakoṣṭhe varakaṅkaṇam | mahāratnaparistīrṇaṃ rājate parakautukī
verses.translation: Their sacred rites and the investiture with the sacred thread were performed by the brahmins. They grew up thus devoted to the worship of Siva in their own house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their sacred rites and the investiture with the sacred thread were performed by the brahmins. They grew up thus devoted to the worship of Siva in their own house.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमागतं सुसम्पूज्य सा वेश्या परया मुदा । स्वस्थाने सादरं वैश्यं सुन्दरी हि न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration: tamāgataṃ susampūjya sā veśyā parayā mudā | svasthāne sādaraṃ vaiśyaṃ sundarī hi nyaveśayat
verses.translation: O dear, at the behest of the sage Sandilya they observed vows and restraints and performed the worship of Siva during dusk.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, at the behest of the sage Sandilya they observed vows and restraints and performed the worship of Siva during dusk.
verses.hindi: उन आये हुए वैश्यकी भलीभाँति पूजा करके उस सुन्दरी वेश्याने बड़े आनन्दके साथ उनको आदरसहित अपने स्थानमें बैठाया

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रकोष्ठे वरं वीक्ष्य कङ्कणं सुमनोहरम् । तस्मिञ्जातस्पृहा सा च तं प्रोवाच सुविस्मिता
verses.transliteration: tatprakoṣṭhe varaṃ vīkṣya kaṅkaṇaṃ sumanoharam | tasmiñjātaspṛhā sā ca taṃ provāca suvismitā
verses.translation: Once when the prince went to the river for his bath without the brahmin boy, he found an excellent pot of treasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once when the prince went to the river for his bath without the brahmin boy, he found an excellent pot of treasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महानन्दोवाच । महारत्नमयश्चायं कङ्कणस्त्वत्करे स्थितः । मनो हरति मे सद्यो दिव्यस्त्रीभूषणोचितः
verses.transliteration: mahānandovāca | mahāratnamayaścāyaṃ kaṅkaṇastvatkare sthitaḥ | mano harati me sadyo divyastrībhūṣaṇocitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus four months elapsed as the two boys con¬ tinued their worship of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus four months elapsed as the two boys con¬ tinued their worship of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तां नवरत्नाढ्ये सस्पृहां करभूषणे । वीक्ष्योदारमतिर्वैश्यः सस्मितं समभाषत
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti tāṃ navaratnāḍhye saspṛhāṃ karabhūṣaṇe | vīkṣyodāramatirvaiśyaḥ sasmitaṃ samabhāṣata
verses.translation: As they continued the worship of Siva again with great joy, a year elapsed in the very same house.
verses.commentary: Sense: As they continued the worship of Siva again with great joy, a year elapsed in the very same house.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यनाथ उवाच । अस्मिन् रत्नवरे दिव्ये सस्पृहं यदि ते मनः । त्वमेवाधत्स्व सुप्रीत्या मौल्यमस्य ददासि किम्
verses.transliteration: vaiśyanātha uvāca | asmin ratnavare divye saspṛhaṃ yadi te manaḥ | tvamevādhatsva suprītyā maulyamasya dadāsi kim
verses.translation: He considered the brahman lady who brought him up as his mother and the brahmin boy as his brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: He considered the brahman lady who brought him up as his mother and the brahmin boy as his brother.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेश्योवाच । वयं हि स्वैरचारिण्यो वेश्यास्तु न पतिव्रताः । अस्मत्कुलोचितो धर्मो व्यभिचारो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: veśyovāca | vayaṃ hi svairacāriṇyo veśyāstu na pativratāḥ | asmatkulocito dharmo vyabhicāro na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In name of Dharmagupta he continued to propi¬ tiate the lord of gods and enjoyed pleasures along with the princess in the kingdom of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: In name of Dharmagupta he continued to propi¬ tiate the lord of gods and enjoyed pleasures along with the princess in the kingdom of Vidarbha.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्येतदखिलं चित्तं गृह्णाति करभूषणम् । दिनत्रयमहोरात्रं पत्नी तव भवाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yadyetadakhilaṃ cittaṃ gṛhṇāti karabhūṣaṇam | dinatrayamahorātraṃ patnī tava bhavāmyaham
verses.translation: Thus the incarnation of Siva as the Bhik§uvarya bestowing happiness on the prince Dharmagupta has been narrated by me now-
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the incarnation of Siva as the Bhik§uvarya bestowing happiness on the prince Dharmagupta has been narrated by me now-
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्य उवाच । तथास्तु यदि ते सत्यं वचनं वीरवल्लभे । ददामि रत्नवलयं त्रिरात्रं भव मे वधूः
verses.transliteration: vaiśya uvāca | tathāstu yadi te satyaṃ vacanaṃ vīravallabhe | dadāmi ratnavalayaṃ trirātraṃ bhava me vadhūḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to this talc or narrates this to others with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and goes to the region of Siva hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this talc or narrates this to others with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and goes to the region of Siva hereafter.
verses.hindi: वैश्य बोले--हे वीरवल्लभे! “बहुत अच्छा '; यदि तुम्हारा वचन सत्य है, तो मैं [यह] रत्नकंकण देता हूँ और तुम तीन राततकके लिये मेरी पत्नी बन जाओ

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्व्यवहारे तु प्रमाणं शशिभास्करौ । त्रिवारं सत्यमित्युक्त्वा हृदयं मे स्पृश प्रिये
verses.transliteration: etasminvyavahāre tu pramāṇaṃ śaśibhāskarau | trivāraṃ satyamityuktvā hṛdayaṃ me spṛśa priye
verses.translation: O dear, listen, I shall narrate the incarnation of Siva, the great soul, as Indra in which he was beneScial to Dhaumya's elder brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, listen, I shall narrate the incarnation of Siva, the great soul, as Indra in which he was beneScial to Dhaumya's elder brother.
verses.hindi: हे प्रिये! इस व्यवहारमें सूर्य तथा चन्द्रमा साक्षी हैं; यह सत्य है--ऐसा तीन बार कहकर तुम मेरे हृदयका स्पर्श करो

verses.sanskrit: वेश्योवाच । दिनत्रयमहोरात्रं पत्नी भूत्वा तव प्रभो । सहधर्मं चरामीति सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: veśyovāca | dinatrayamahorātraṃ patnī bhūtvā tava prabho | sahadharmaṃ carāmīti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The intelligent son of Vyaghrapada, Upamanyu, the beloved of the good, became the son of a sage in another birth. He achieved great attainments then.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent son of Vyaghrapada, Upamanyu, the beloved of the good, became the son of a sage in another birth. He achieved great attainments then.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा हि महानन्दा त्रिवारं शशिभास्करौ । प्रमाणीकृत्य सुप्रीत्या सा तद् हृदयमस्पृशत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā hi mahānandā trivāraṃ śaśibhāskarau | pramāṇīkṛtya suprītyā sā tad hṛdayamaspṛśat
verses.translation: Upamanyu, the son of Vyaghrapada, while yet a small child stayed in his uncle's house along with his mother. Due to adverse fate he was very poor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Upamanyu, the son of Vyaghrapada, while yet a small child stayed in his uncle's house along with his mother. Due to adverse fate he was very poor.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यै स वैश्यस्तु प्रदत्त्वा रत्नकङ्कणम् । लिङ्गं रत्नमयं तस्य हस्ते दत्त्वेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: atha tasyai sa vaiśyastu pradattvā ratnakaṅkaṇam | liṅgaṃ ratnamayaṃ tasya haste dattvedamabravīt
verses.translation: Once he tasted a little milk in his uncle's hermitage. Approaching his mother he implored for milk, yearning for it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once he tasted a little milk in his uncle's hermitage. Approaching his mother he implored for milk, yearning for it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यनाथ उवाच । इदं रत्नमयं लिङ्गं शैवं मत्प्राणदवल्लभम् । रक्षणीयं त्वया कान्ते गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vaiśyanātha uvāca | idaṃ ratnamayaṃ liṅgaṃ śaivaṃ matprāṇadavallabham | rakṣaṇīyaṃ tvayā kānte gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son the pitiable mother went in and thought of a proper means to satisfy the child.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her son the pitiable mother went in and thought of a proper means to satisfy the child.
verses.hindi: वैश्यनाथ बोले--हे कान्ते! यह रत्नजरित शिवलिंग मुझे प्राणोंसे भी अधिक प्रिय है; तुम इसकी रक्षा करना और यलपूर्वक इसे छिपाकर रखना

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमस्त्विति सा प्रोच्य लिङ्गमादाय रत्नजम् । नाट्यमण्डपिकामध्ये निधाय प्राविशद् गृहम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamastviti sā procya liṅgamādāya ratnajam | nāṭyamaṇḍapikāmadhye nidhāya prāviśad gṛham
verses.translation: She ground some seeds and grains she got by gleaning, into a paste with water. She gave this artificial milk to her son after fondling and coaxing him.
verses.commentary: Sense: She ground some seeds and grains she got by gleaning, into a paste with water. She gave this artificial milk to her son after fondling and coaxing him.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--उस वेश्याने 'ऐसा ही होगा'-- इस प्रकार कहकर रत्नजटित लिंग लेकर और उसे नाट्यशालाके मध्यमें रखकर घरमें प्रवेश किया

verses.sanskrit: सा तेन सङ्गता रात्रौ वैश्येन विटधर्मिणा । सुखं सुष्वाप पर्यङ्के मृदुतल्पोपशोभिते
verses.transliteration: sā tena saṅgatā rātrau vaiśyena viṭadharmiṇā | sukhaṃ suṣvāpa paryaṅke mṛdutalpopaśobhite
verses.translation: On hearing the cry of her son, she wiped off his lotus-like eyes and said in grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the cry of her son, she wiped off his lotus-like eyes and said in grief.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशीथसमये मुने वैश्यपतीच्छया । अकस्मादुत्थिता वाणी नृत्यमण्डपिकान्तरे
verses.transliteration: tato niśīthasamaye mune vaiśyapatīcchayā | akasmādutthitā vāṇī nṛtyamaṇḍapikāntare
verses.translation: How can we the dwellers of the forest for ever have milk? Without the grace of Siva we can never have milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: How can we the dwellers of the forest for ever have milk? Without the grace of Siva we can never have milk.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रज्वलितो वह्निः सुसमीरसहायवान् । नाट्यमण्डपिकां तात तामेव सहसावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: mahāprajvalito vahniḥ susamīrasahāyavān | nāṭyamaṇḍapikāṃ tāta tāmeva sahasāvṛṇot
verses.translation: O son, only that can be attained what we had dedicated to Siva in our previous birth. We need not worry in this matter.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, only that can be attained what we had dedicated to Siva in our previous birth. We need not worry in this matter.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मण्डपे दह्यमाने तु सहसोत्थाय सम्भ्रमात् । मर्कटं मोचयामास सा वेश्या तत्र बन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: maṇḍape dahyamāne tu sahasotthāya sambhramāt | markaṭaṃ mocayāmāsa sā veśyā tatra bandhanāt
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his mother, the son of Vyaghrapada excessively fond of his mother, freed of his grief, replied to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his mother, the son of Vyaghrapada excessively fond of his mother, freed of his grief, replied to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स मर्कटो मुक्तबन्धः कुक्कुटेन सहामुना । भिया दूरं हि दुद्राव विधूयाग्निकणान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: sa markaṭo muktabandhaḥ kukkuṭena sahāmunā | bhiyā dūraṃ hi dudrāva vidhūyāgnikaṇānbahūn
verses.translation: "O blessed mother, do not grieve. Cast off this sorrow. If Siva is the benefactor, everything will result in welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O blessed mother, do not grieve. Cast off this sorrow. If Siva is the benefactor, everything will result in welfare.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तम्भेन सह निर्दग्धं तल्लिङ्गं शकलीकृतम् । दृष्ट्वा वेश्या स वैश्यश्च दुरन्तं दुःखमापतुः
verses.transliteration: stambhena saha nirdagdhaṃ talliṅgaṃ śakalīkṛtam | dṛṣṭvā veśyā sa vaiśyaśca durantaṃ duḥkhamāpatuḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus with pleasure and repeating "Let there be a welfare*', he bowed to his mother and left her. He began to perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus with pleasure and repeating "Let there be a welfare*', he bowed to his mother and left her. He began to perform penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ह्यात्मसमं लिङ्गं दग्धं वैश्यपतिस्तदा । ज्ञातुं तद्भावमन्तःस्थं मरणाय मतिं दधे
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā hyātmasamaṃ liṅgaṃ dagdhaṃ vaiśyapatistadā | jñātuṃ tadbhāvamantaḥsthaṃ maraṇāya matiṃ dadhe
verses.translation: It was on the mountain Himavat that he went to perform his penance with pure mind taking nothing in except air. He installed!§iva's phallic image of clay after making a pedestal for it with eight bricks. He invoked Siva along with Parvati into the phallic image with devotion. He repeated the five-syllabled mantra.® The boy worshipped Siva with leaves, flowers and other things.
verses.wordMeaning: It was on the mountain Himavat that he went to perform his penance with pure mind taking nothing in except air. He installed!§iva's phallic image of clay after making a pedestal for it with eight bricks. He invoked Siva along with Parvati into the phallic image with devotion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was on the mountain Himavat that he went to perform his penance with pure mind taking nothing in except air. He installed!§iva's phallic image of clay after making a pedestal for it with eight bricks. He invoked Siva along with Parvati into the phallic image with devotion.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निविश्येऽतितरां खेदाद्वैश्यस्तामाह दुःखिताम् । नानालीलो महेशानः कौतुकान्नरदेहवान्
verses.transliteration: niviśye'titarāṃ khedādvaiśyastāmāha duḥkhitām | nānālīlo maheśānaḥ kautukānnaradehavān
verses.translation: He meditated on Siva along with Parvati repeating the five-syllabled mantra. Worshipping thus he performed great penance for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: He meditated on Siva along with Parvati repeating the five-syllabled mantra. Worshipping thus he performed great penance for a long time.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यपतिरुवाच । शिवलिङ्गे तु निर्भिन्ने दग्धे महत्प्राणवल्लभे । सत्यं वच्मि न सन्देहो नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: vaiśyapatiruvāca | śivaliṅge tu nirbhinne dagdhe mahatprāṇavallabhe | satyaṃ vacmi na sandeho nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe
verses.translation: O sage, due to the penance of the boy Upamanyu, the great soul, the whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings blazed as it were.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, due to the penance of the boy Upamanyu, the great soul, the whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings blazed as it were.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चितां कारय मे भद्रे स्वभृत्यैस्त्वं वरैर्लघु । शिवे मनः समावेश्य प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: citāṃ kāraya me bhadre svabhṛtyaistvaṃ varairlaghu | śive manaḥ samāveśya pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam
verses.translation: In the meantime, requested by Visnu aud others, Siva assumed the form of Indra in order to test his devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, requested by Visnu aud others, Siva assumed the form of Indra in order to test his devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्ण्वाद्या वारयेयुः समेत्य माम् । तथाप्यस्मिन् क्षणे भद्रे प्रविशामि त्यजाम्यसून्
verses.transliteration: yadi brahmendraviṣṇvādyā vārayeyuḥ sametya mām | tathāpyasmin kṣaṇe bhadre praviśāmi tyajāmyasūn
verses.translation: Then Siva accompanied by Parvati and the Ganas, and assuming the form of Indra went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva accompanied by Parvati and the Ganas, and assuming the form of Indra went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तमेवं दृढनिर्बन्धं सा विज्ञाय सुदुःखिता । स्वभृत्यैः कारयामास चितां स्वभवनाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tamevaṃ dṛḍhanirbandhaṃ sā vijñāya suduḥkhitā | svabhṛtyaiḥ kārayāmāsa citāṃ svabhavanād bahiḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, in order to test his devotion, Siva in the form of India, spoke to the boy in a grave tone.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, in order to test his devotion, Siva in the form of India, spoke to the boy in a grave tone.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स वैश्यः शिव एक एव प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य समिद्धमग्निम् । विवेश पश्यत्सु नरेषु धीरः सुकौतुकी सङ्गतिभावमिच्छुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa vaiśyaḥ śiva eka eva pradakṣiṇīkṛtya samiddhamagnim | viveśa paśyatsu nareṣu dhīraḥ sukautukī saṅgatibhāvamicchuḥ
verses.translation: **0 boy of good rites,,1 am pleased with you and your penance. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall give you whatever you desire. There is no doubt about this."
verses.commentary: Sense: **0 boy of good rites,,1 am pleased with you and your penance. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall give you whatever you desire. There is no doubt about this."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सा तद्गतिं वेश्या महानन्दातिविस्मिता । अनुतापं च युवती प्रपेदे मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sā tadgatiṃ veśyā mahānandātivismitā | anutāpaṃ ca yuvatī prapede munisattama
verses.translation: On hearing it Indra said—"You do not know me
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it Indra said—"You do not know me
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा दुःखिता वेश्या स्मृत्वा धर्म सुनिर्मलम् । सर्वान्बन्धुजनान्वीक्ष्य बभाषे करुणं वचः
verses.transliteration: atha sā duḥkhitā veśyā smṛtvā dharma sunirmalam | sarvānbandhujanānvīkṣya babhāṣe karuṇaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, be my devotee. Worship me alone on every occasion. I shall grant you every benefit. Leave off Rudra devoid of attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin sage, be my devotee. Worship me alone on every occasion. I shall grant you every benefit. Leave off Rudra devoid of attributes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महानन्दोवाच । रत्नकङ्कणमादाय मया सत्यमुदाहृतम् । दिनत्रयमहं पत्नी वैश्यस्यामुष्य सम्मता
verses.transliteration: mahānandovāca | ratnakaṅkaṇamādāya mayā satyamudāhṛtam | dinatrayamahaṃ patnī vaiśyasyāmuṣya sammatā
verses.translation: Enough of Rudra devoid of attributes. What pur¬ pose of yourg can be achieved by his worship? He is out of the caste of ihe gods. He has become a Pisaca.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enough of Rudra devoid of attributes. What pur¬ pose of yourg can be achieved by his worship? He is out of the caste of ihe gods. He has become a Pisaca.
verses.hindi: महानन्दा बोली--मैंने इस वैश्यसे रत्नकंकण लेकर सत्य वचन कहा था कि मैं तीन दिनतक इस वैश्यकी धर्मसम्मत पत्नी रहूँगी

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मत्कृतेनायं मृतो वैश्यः शिवव्रती । तस्मादहं प्रवेक्ष्यामि सहानेन हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā matkṛtenāyaṃ mṛto vaiśyaḥ śivavratī | tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi sahānena hutāśanam
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the son of the sage con¬ sidered them an obstacle to his austerities. Repeating the five-s' llabled mantra he told him who had come to create obs'acles.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words, the son of the sage con¬ sidered them an obstacle to his austerities. Repeating the five-s' llabled mantra he told him who had come to create obs'acles.
verses.hindi: मेरे द्वारा किये गये कर्मसे यह शिवद्रतधारी वैश्य मृत्युको प्राप्त हुआ है, अतः मैं भी इसके साथ अमिनिमें प्रवेश करूँगी

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मचारिणीत्युक्तमाचार्यैः सत्यवादिभिः । एवं कृते मम प्रीत्या सत्यं मयि न नश्यतु
verses.transliteration: svadharmacāriṇītyuktamācāryaiḥ satyavādibhiḥ | evaṃ kṛte mama prītyā satyaṃ mayi na naśyatu
verses.translation: All this has been mentioned by you indulging in insult of Siva. Incidentally you have mentioned that Siva, the lord of the gods, is attributeless as well as Pisaca.
verses.commentary: Sense: All this has been mentioned by you indulging in insult of Siva. Incidentally you have mentioned that Siva, the lord of the gods, is attributeless as well as Pisaca.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्याश्रयः परो धर्मः सत्येन परमा गतिः । सत्येन स्वर्गमोक्षौ च सत्ये सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: satyāśrayaḥ paro dharmaḥ satyena paramā gatiḥ | satyena svargamokṣau ca satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: You do not know Siva, lord of the chiefs of gods, the father and progenitor of Brahma, Vtsnu and Mahe!5a and greater than Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: You do not know Siva, lord of the chiefs of gods, the father and progenitor of Brahma, Vtsnu and Mahe!5a and greater than Prakrti.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति सा दृढनिर्बन्धा वार्यमाणापि बन्धुभिः । सत्यलोपभिया नारी प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं मनो दधे
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti sā dṛḍhanirbandhā vāryamāṇāpi bandhubhiḥ | satyalopabhiyā nārī prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ mano dadhe
verses.translation: I choose the boon from that deity, whom the philo¬ sophers call eternal, the single, the multitude, separate from the existent and non-existent and the unmanifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: I choose the boon from that deity, whom the philo¬ sophers call eternal, the single, the multitude, separate from the existent and non-existent and the unmanifest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वं द्विजमुख्येभ्यो दत्त्वा ध्यात्वा सदाशिवम् । तमग्निं त्रिःपरिक्रम्य प्रवेशाभिमुखी ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasvaṃ dvijamukhyebhyo dattvā dhyātvā sadāśivam | tamagniṃ triḥparikramya praveśābhimukhī hyabhūt
verses.translation: I do not wish to take a boon from you or Bra¬ hma or Visnu. Nor do I want any boon from any other god. Let Siva be the bestower of boons on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I do not wish to take a boon from you or Bra¬ hma or Visnu. Nor do I want any boon from any other god. Let Siva be the bestower of boons on me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां पतन्तीं समिद्धेऽग्नौ स्वपदार्पितमानसाम् । वारयामास विश्वात्मा प्रादुर्भूतः स वै शिवः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ patantīṃ samiddhe'gnau svapadārpitamānasām | vārayāmāsa viśvātmā prādurbhūtaḥ sa vai śivaḥ
verses.translation: O enemy of mountains, listen to my feeling in
verses.commentary: Sense: O enemy of mountains, listen to my feeling in
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा तं विलोक्याखिलदेवदेवं त्रिलोचनं चन्द्रकलावतंसम् । शशाङ्कसूर्यानलकोटिभासं स्तब्धेव भीतेव तथैव तस्थौ
verses.transliteration: sā taṃ vilokyākhiladevadevaṃ trilocanaṃ candrakalāvataṃsam | śaśāṅkasūryānalakoṭibhāsaṃ stabdheva bhīteva tathaiva tasthau
verses.translation: O base god, let it be that I had yearned for milk. I shall kill you by Siva's missile and then leave off my mortal frame,
verses.commentary: Sense: O base god, let it be that I had yearned for milk. I shall kill you by Siva's missile and then leave off my mortal frame,
verses.hindi: सब देवताओंके भी देव, तीन नेत्रोंवाले, कलासे शोभित, करोड़ों चन्द्रमा-सूर्य-अग्निके समान प्रकाशवाले उन शिवको देखकर वह स्तब्ध तथा डरी हुईके समान उसी प्रकार खड़ी रह गयी

verses.sanskrit: तां विह्वलां सुवित्रस्तां वेपमानां जडीकृताम् । समाश्वास्य गलद्बाष्पां करौ धृत्वाब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ vihvalāṃ suvitrastāṃ vepamānāṃ jaḍīkṛtām | samāśvāsya galadbāṣpāṃ karau dhṛtvābravīdvacaḥ
verses.translation: He took some ashes from the receptacle and in¬ voked it with the mantra Aghorastra, The sage, thereafter discharged it against Indra and roared.
verses.commentary: Sense: He took some ashes from the receptacle and in¬ voked it with the mantra Aghorastra, The sage, thereafter discharged it against Indra and roared.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । सत्यं धर्मं च धैर्यं च भक्तिं च मयि निश्चलाम् । परीक्षितुं त्वत्सकाशं वैश्यो भूत्वाहमागतः
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | satyaṃ dharmaṃ ca dhairyaṃ ca bhaktiṃ ca mayi niścalām | parīkṣituṃ tvatsakāśaṃ vaiśyo bhūtvāhamāgataḥ
verses.translation: Remembering the feet of Siva, his favourite deity, he got ready to burn himself. He stood there bearing the fiery pose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering the feet of Siva, his favourite deity, he got ready to burn himself. He stood there bearing the fiery pose.
verses.hindi: शिवजी बोले--तुम्हारे सत्य, धर्म, धैर्य तथा मुझमें तुम्हागी निश्वल भक्तिकी परीक्षा करनेके निमित्त मैं वैश्य बनकर तुम्हारे पास आया था

verses.sanskrit: माययाग्निं समुद्दीप्य दग्धं ते नाट्यमण्डपम् । दग्धं कृत्वा रत्नलिङ्गं प्रविष्टोऽहं हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: māyayāgniṃ samuddīpya dagdhaṃ te nāṭyamaṇḍapam | dagdhaṃ kṛtvā ratnaliṅgaṃ praviṣṭo'haṃ hutāśanam
verses.translation: At the behest of Siva, Nandin the favourite of Siva delightedly caught hold of the Aghorastra discharged by him, in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Siva, Nandin the favourite of Siva delightedly caught hold of the Aghorastra discharged by him, in the middle.
verses.hindi: मैंने अपनी मायासे अग्निको प्रदीप्तकर तुम्हारे नाट्यमण्डपको जलाया है और रत्लनलिंगको दग्ध करके मैं अग्निमें प्रविष्ट हुआ हूँ

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वं सत्यमनुस्मृत्य प्रविष्टाग्निं मया सहा । अतस्ते सम्प्रदास्यामि भोगांस्त्रिदशदुर्लभान्
verses.transliteration: sā tvaṃ satyamanusmṛtya praviṣṭāgniṃ mayā sahā | ataste sampradāsyāmi bhogāṃstridaśadurlabhān
verses.translation: Assuming his own form with the moon for his crest, lord Siva revealed it to the brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming his own form with the moon for his crest, lord Siva revealed it to the brahmin.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यदिच्छसि सुश्रोणि तदेव हि ददामि ते । त्वद्भक्त्याहं प्रसन्नोऽस्मि तवादेयं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: yadyadicchasi suśroṇi tadeva hi dadāmi te | tvadbhaktyāhaṃ prasanno'smi tavādeyaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: The lord then showed him a thousand milk oceans, the ocean of curds and the ocean of different food¬ stuffs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord then showed him a thousand milk oceans, the ocean of curds and the ocean of different food¬ stuffs.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति ब्रुवति गौरीशे शङ्करे भक्तवत्सले । महानन्दा च सा वेश्या शङ्करं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti bruvati gaurīśe śaṅkare bhaktavatsale | mahānandā ca sā veśyā śaṅkaraṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: The drums were sounded in the heaven. There was a shower of flowers. All the ten quarters were covered by Brahma, Visnu and other gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: The drums were sounded in the heaven. There was a shower of flowers. All the ten quarters were covered by Brahma, Visnu and other gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेश्योवाच । न मे वाञ्छास्ति भोगेषु भूमौ स्वर्गे रसातले । तव पादाम्बुजस्पर्शादन्यत्किञ्चिन्न कामये
verses.transliteration: veśyovāca | na me vāñchāsti bhogeṣu bhūmau svarge rasātale | tava pādāmbujasparśādanyatkiñcinna kāmaye
verses.translation: In the meantime the smiling lord Siva called him
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the smiling lord Siva called him
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये मे भृत्याश्च दास्यश्च ये चान्ये मम बान्धवाः । सर्वे त्वद्दर्शनपरास्त्वयि सन्न्यस्तवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: ye me bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye cānye mama bāndhavāḥ | sarve tvaddarśanaparāstvayi sannyastavṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: Enjoy the pleasure of eating sumptuously for¬ ever along with your kinsmen. Be ever happy and free from misery. Be devoted to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enjoy the pleasure of eating sumptuously for¬ ever along with your kinsmen. Be ever happy and free from misery. Be devoted to me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानेतान्मया सार्धं निनीयात्मपरं पदम् । पुनर्जन्मभयं घोरं विमोचय नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sarvānetānmayā sārdhaṃ ninīyātmaparaṃ padam | punarjanmabhayaṃ ghoraṃ vimocaya namo'stu te
verses.translation: O fortunate Upamanyu, you have been made eternally my son today. Parvati, here, is your mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fortunate Upamanyu, you have been made eternally my son today. Parvati, here, is your mother.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततः स तस्या वचनं प्रतिनन्द्य महेश्वरः । ताः सर्वाश्च तया सार्धं निनाय स्वं परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tataḥ sa tasyā vacanaṃ pratinandya maheśvaraḥ | tāḥ sarvāśca tayā sārdhaṃ nināya svaṃ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: O great sage, thousands of oceans of milk, curd, ghee and honey, and of different foodstuffs I grant you lovingly. Accept them. I confer on you the state of a god and the eternal chieftainship of Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, thousands of oceans of milk, curd, ghee and honey, and of different foodstuffs I grant you lovingly. Accept them. I confer on you the state of a god and the eternal chieftainship of Ganas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यनाथावतारस्ते वर्णितः परमो मया । महानन्दासुखकरो भक्तानन्दप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: vaiśyanāthāvatāraste varṇitaḥ paramo mayā | mahānandāsukhakaro bhaktānandapradaḥ sadā
verses.translation: I, l§iva, am your father and she, Parvati, is your mother. Choose your boons whatever you desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: I, l§iva, am your father and she, Parvati, is your mother. Choose your boons whatever you desire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं चरित्रं परमं पवित्रं सतां च सर्वप्रदमाशु दिव्यम् । शिवावतारस्य विशाम्पतेर्महा- नन्दामहासौख्यकरं विचित्रम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ caritraṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ satāṃ ca sarvapradamāśu divyam | śivāvatārasya viśāmpatermahā- nandāmahāsaukhyakaraṃ vicitram
verses.translation: Be unaging and undying and free from misery. You will be famous, brilliant and endowed with divine knowledge. You will be a great lord."
verses.commentary: Sense: Be unaging and undying and free from misery. You will be famous, brilliant and endowed with divine knowledge. You will be a great lord."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं यः शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । च्यवते न स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | cyavate na svadharmātsa paratra labhate gatim
verses.translation: Then considering his great penance, the de¬ lighted!§iva gave ten boons to the sage Upamanyu. He bestowed on him the knowledge of Siva and his rites. He instructed him in the vows of Siva. He gave him fluency of speech and efficiency. He bestowed his own region on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then considering his great penance, the de¬ lighted!§iva gave ten boons to the sage Upamanyu. He bestowed on him the knowledge of Siva and his rites. He instructed him in the vows of Siva. He gave him fluency of speech and efficiency. He bestowed his own region on him.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage requested the lord of the gods affer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted sage requested the lord of the gods affer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage requested the lord of the gods affer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted sage requested the lord of the gods affer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । द्विजेशाख्यशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । द्विजेश्वरावतारं च सशिवं सुखदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.27. saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dvijeśākhyaśivāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi śivasya paramātmanaḥ | dvijeśvarāvatāraṃ ca saśivaṃ sukhadaṃ satām
verses.translation: O lord of gods, be pleased. O supreme lord, be pleased. Grant me the greatest devotion unto you, divine and unswerving.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, be pleased. O supreme lord, be pleased. Grant me the greatest devotion unto you, divine and unswerving.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः पूर्वं वर्णितस्तात भद्रायुर्नृपसत्तमः । यस्मिन्नृषभरूपेणानुग्रहं कृतवाञ्छिवः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ pūrvaṃ varṇitastāta bhadrāyurnṛpasattamaḥ | yasminnṛṣabharūpeṇānugrahaṃ kṛtavāñchivaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with purity of mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains Siva's goal hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with purity of mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains Siva's goal hereafter.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्धर्मस्य परीक्षार्थं पुनराविर्बभूव सः । द्विजेश्वरस्वरूपेण तदेव कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: taddharmasya parīkṣārthaṃ punarāvirbabhūva saḥ | dvijeśvarasvarūpeṇa tadeva kathayāmyaham
verses.translation: There he saw the goddess Parvati, seated on the dais surrounded by her friends. She appeared like the pure digit of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: There he saw the goddess Parvati, seated on the dais surrounded by her friends. She appeared like the pure digit of the moon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभस्य प्रभावेण शत्रूञ्जित्वा रणे प्रभुः । प्राप्तसिंहासनस्तात भद्रायुः सम्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: ṛṣabhasya prabhāveṇa śatrūñjitvā raṇe prabhuḥ | prāptasiṃhāsanastāta bhadrāyuḥ sambabhūva ha
verses.translation: Mentally, verbally and through activities too, Siva has been chosen by me as my husband. I am telling you the truth and not falsehood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mentally, verbally and through activities too, Siva has been chosen by me as my husband. I am telling you the truth and not falsehood.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्राङ्गदस्य तनया सीमन्तिन्याः शुभाङ्गजा । पत्नी तस्याभवद् ब्रह्मन्सुसाध्वी कीर्तिमालिनी
verses.transliteration: candrāṅgadasya tanayā sīmantinyāḥ śubhāṅgajā | patnī tasyābhavad brahmansusādhvī kīrtimālinī
verses.translation: You do not know Siva, You are averse to Siva. Since I had already welcomed and honoured you I am now distressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: You do not know Siva, You are averse to Siva. Since I had already welcomed and honoured you I am now distressed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स भद्रायुः कदाचित्स्वप्रियया गहनं वनम् । प्राविशत्संविहारार्थं वसन्तसमये मुने
verses.transliteration: sa bhadrāyuḥ kadācitsvapriyayā gahanaṃ vanam | prāviśatsaṃvihārārthaṃ vasantasamaye mune
verses.translation: After assuming that divine form which Parvati was meditating upon, Siva spoke to her as she stood face downwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: After assuming that divine form which Parvati was meditating upon, Siva spoke to her as she stood face downwards.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मिन्वने रम्ये विजहार स भूपतिः । शरणागतपालिन्या तया स्वप्रियया सह
verses.transliteration: atha tasminvane ramye vijahāra sa bhūpatiḥ | śaraṇāgatapālinyā tayā svapriyayā saha
verses.translation: O sage, when goddess Parvatl, daughter of Him- avat, performed the pious penance in order to attain Siva, after going to the forest, Siva was much delighted at her austerity. He approached to test her conduct and out of pleasure to grant her the desired boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, when goddess Parvatl, daughter of Him- avat, performed the pious penance in order to attain Siva, after going to the forest, Siva was much delighted at her austerity. He approached to test her conduct and out of pleasure to grant her the desired boon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तद्धर्मदृढतां प्रतीक्षन्परमेश्वरः । लीलां चकार तत्रैव शिवया सह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: atha taddharmadṛḍhatāṃ pratīkṣanparameśvaraḥ | līlāṃ cakāra tatraiva śivayā saha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon shall be granted to me, O Siva, you be my lord and husband. Please take pity on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon shall be granted to me, O Siva, you be my lord and husband. Please take pity on me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवा शिवश्च भूत्वोभौ तद्वने द्विजदम्पती । व्याघ्रं मायामयं कृत्वाविर्भूतौ निजलीलया
verses.transliteration: śivā śivaśca bhūtvobhau tadvane dvijadampatī | vyāghraṃ māyāmayaṃ kṛtvāvirbhūtau nijalīlayā
verses.translation: With your permission I shall go to my father's abode. O lord, you shall approach my father.
verses.commentary: Sense: With your permission I shall go to my father's abode. O lord, you shall approach my father.
verses.hindi: शिवजी और पार्वतीजी द्विजदम्पती बनकर तथा अपनी लीलासे एक मायामय व्याप्रको बनाकर ञ्स बनमें प्रकट हुए

verses.sanskrit: अथाविदूरे तस्यैव द्रवन्तौ भयविह्वलौ । अन्वीयमानौ व्याघ्रेण रुदन्तौ तौ बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: athāvidūre tasyaiva dravantau bhayavihvalau | anvīyamānau vyāghreṇa rudantau tau babhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: O great god, give me great faith in persons de¬ voted to you, the state of being your servant, your great affection and your constant presence.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, give me great faith in persons de¬ voted to you, the state of being your servant, your great affection and your constant presence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ विद्धौ च तौ तात भद्रायुः स महीपतिः । ददर्श क्रन्दमानौ हि शरण्यः क्षत्रियर्षभः
verses.transliteration: atha viddhau ca tau tāta bhadrāyuḥ sa mahīpatiḥ | dadarśa krandamānau hi śaraṇyaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the delighted excellent brahmin Upamanyu eulogised great lord with words choked in de¬ light.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the delighted excellent brahmin Upamanyu eulogised great lord with words choked in de¬ light.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तौ मुनिशार्दूल स्वमायाद्विजदम्पती । भद्रायुषं महाराजमूचतुर्भयविह्वलौ
verses.transliteration: atha tau muniśārdūla svamāyādvijadampatī | bhadrāyuṣaṃ mahārājamūcaturbhayavihvalau
verses.translation: Thus requested,!§iva, the lord of all, replied
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested,!§iva, the lord of all, replied
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजदम्पती ऊचतुः । पाहि पाहि महाराज नावुभौ धर्मवित्तम । एष आयाति शार्दूलो जग्धुमावां महाप्रभो
verses.transliteration: dvijadampatī ūcatuḥ | pāhi pāhi mahārāja nāvubhau dharmavittama | eṣa āyāti śārdūlo jagdhumāvāṃ mahāprabho
verses.translation: O dear Upamanyu, O sinless one, you are blessed. You are especially my devotee. Whatever has been chosen by you has been given to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear Upamanyu, O sinless one, you are blessed. You are especially my devotee. Whatever has been chosen by you has been given to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एष हिंस्रः कालसमः सर्वप्राणिभयङ्करः । यावन्न खादति प्राप्य तावन्नौ रक्ष धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: eṣa hiṃsraḥ kālasamaḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkaraḥ | yāvanna khādati prāpya tāvannau rakṣa dharmavit
verses.translation: Be unaging and undying and free from misery. Be respectable to all, free from aberrations and the foremost among devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be unaging and undying and free from misery. Be respectable to all, free from aberrations and the foremost among devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थमाक्रन्दितं श्रुत्वा तयोश्च नृपतीश्वरः । अति शीघ्रं महावीरः स यावद्धनुराददे
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | itthamākranditaṃ śrutvā tayośca nṛpatīśvaraḥ | ati śīghraṃ mahāvīraḥ sa yāvaddhanurādade
verses.translation: O excellent brahmin, yon will have undwindling kinsmen, family and race. Your devotion to me will be permanent.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmin, yon will have undwindling kinsmen, family and race. Your devotion to me will be permanent.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तावदभ्येत्य शार्दूलः त्वरमाणोऽतिमायिकः । स तस्य द्विजवर्यस्य मध्ये जग्राह तां वधूम्
verses.transliteration: tāvadabhyetya śārdūlaḥ tvaramāṇo'timāyikaḥ | sa tasya dvijavaryasya madhye jagrāha tāṃ vadhūm
verses.translation: O sage, I shall be ever present in your hermitage. Stay at ease. Do not be anxious.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, I shall be ever present in your hermitage. Stay at ease. Do not be anxious.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हे नाथ नाथ हे कान्त हा शम्भो हा जगद्गुरो । इति रोरूयमानां तां व्याघ्रो जग्रास भीषणः
verses.transliteration: he nātha nātha he kānta hā śambho hā jagadguro | iti rorūyamānāṃ tāṃ vyāghro jagrāsa bhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and granting him all excellent boons, the lord vanished from there, accompanied by Parvatl and the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and granting him all excellent boons, the lord vanished from there, accompanied by Parvatl and the Ganas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तावत्स राजा निशितैर्भल्लैर्व्याघ्रमताडयत् । न स तैर्विव्यथे किञ्चिद्गिरीन्द्र इव वृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: tāvatsa rājā niśitairbhallairvyāghramatāḍayat | na sa tairvivyathe kiñcidgirīndra iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: After receiving excellent boons, the delighted Upamanyu went to the abode of his mother and described everything to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After receiving excellent boons, the delighted Upamanyu went to the abode of his mother and described everything to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स शार्दूलो महासत्त्वो राज्ञः स्वैरकृतव्यथः । बलादाकृष्य तां नारीमपाक्रमत सत्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa śārdūlo mahāsattvo rājñaḥ svairakṛtavyathaḥ | balādākṛṣya tāṃ nārīmapākramata satvaraḥ
verses.translation: O dear, thus, the incarnation of Siva the great
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus, the incarnation of Siva the great
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रेणापहृतां नारीं वीक्ष्य विप्रोऽतिविस्मितः । लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रित्य रुरोदाति मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vyāghreṇāpahṛtāṃ nārīṃ vīkṣya vipro'tivismitaḥ | laukikīṃ gatimāśritya rurodāti muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, listen to the incarnation of Siva the great soul. It is named Jatila and is very sanctifying.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sanatkumara, listen to the incarnation of Siva the great soul. It is named Jatila and is very sanctifying.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुदित्वा चिरकालं च स विप्रो माययेश्वरः । भद्रायुषं महीपालं प्रोवाच मदहारकः
verses.transliteration: ruditvā cirakālaṃ ca sa vipro māyayeśvaraḥ | bhadrāyuṣaṃ mahīpālaṃ provāca madahārakaḥ
verses.translation: Desiring to attain Siva as her husband, she went to the dense forest and performed a pure penance. She was attended upon by two of her friends.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desiring to attain Siva as her husband, she went to the dense forest and performed a pure penance. She was attended upon by two of her friends.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजेश्वर उवाच । राजन् क्व ते महास्त्राणि क्व ते त्राणं महद्धनुः । क्व ते द्वादशसाहस्रमहानागयुतं बलम्
verses.transliteration: dvijeśvara uvāca | rājan kva te mahāstrāṇi kva te trāṇaṃ mahaddhanuḥ | kva te dvādaśasāhasramahānāgayutaṃ balam
verses.translation: In order to test her penance, Siva an expert in various kinds of sports sent the seven sages®® to the penance grove of Parvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to test her penance, Siva an expert in various kinds of sports sent the seven sages®® to the penance grove of Parvati.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किं ते खड्गेन शङ्खेन किं ते मन्त्रास्त्रविद्यया । किं सत्त्वेन महास्त्राणां किं प्रभावेण भूयसा
verses.transliteration: kiṃ te khaḍgena śaṅkhena kiṃ te mantrāstravidyayā | kiṃ sattvena mahāstrāṇāṃ kiṃ prabhāveṇa bhūyasā
verses.translation: The sages went there and thoroughly tested her. As she was strenuous in her effort they could not dissuade her from her penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages went there and thoroughly tested her. As she was strenuous in her effort they could not dissuade her from her penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं विफलं जातं यच्चान्यत्त्वयि तिष्ठति । यस्त्वं वनौकसां घातं न निवारयितुं क्षमः
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaṃ viphalaṃ jātaṃ yaccānyattvayi tiṣṭhati | yastvaṃ vanaukasāṃ ghātaṃ na nivārayituṃ kṣamaḥ
verses.translation: They returned and bowed to Siva. After mention¬ ing all the details to him and obtaining his permission they returned to heaven eagerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: They returned and bowed to Siva. After mention¬ ing all the details to him and obtaining his permission they returned to heaven eagerly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रस्यायं परो धर्मो क्षताच्च परिरक्षणम् । तस्मिन्कुलोचिते धर्मे नष्टे त्वज्जीवितेन किम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasyāyaṃ paro dharmo kṣatācca parirakṣaṇam | tasminkulocite dharme naṣṭe tvajjīvitena kim
verses.translation: When they had gone to their abodes, lord Siva, the cause of excellent sports, desired to test Siva's activity himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they had gone to their abodes, lord Siva, the cause of excellent sports, desired to test Siva's activity himself.
verses.hindi: [प्रजाजनोंको ] क्षीण होनेसे बचाना क्षत्रियका परम धर्म है। उस कुलधर्मके नष्ट हो जानेपर तुम्हारे जीवित रहनेसे क्या लाभ है ?

verses.sanskrit: आर्तानां शरणाप्तानां त्राणं कुर्वन्ति पार्थिवाः । प्राणैरर्थैश्च धर्मज्ञास्तद्विना च मृतोपमाः
verses.transliteration: ārtānāṃ śaraṇāptānāṃ trāṇaṃ kurvanti pārthivāḥ | prāṇairarthaiśca dharmajñāstadvinā ca mṛtopamāḥ
verses.translation: The seven sages are: Marici, Atri, AAgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, K.ratu and Vasitha. See note.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sages are: Marici, Atri, AAgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, K.ratu and Vasitha. See note.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आर्तत्राणविहीनानां जीवितान्मरणं वरम् । धनिनां दानहीनानां गार्हस्थ्याद्भिक्षुता वरम्
verses.transliteration: ārtatrāṇavihīnānāṃ jīvitānmaraṇaṃ varam | dhanināṃ dānahīnānāṃ gārhasthyādbhikṣutā varam
verses.translation: Then the lord assumed the pleasant, self-controlled and wonderful form of a student-ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord assumed the pleasant, self-controlled and wonderful form of a student-ascetic.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरं विषाशनं प्राज्ञैर्वरमग्निप्रवेशनम् । कृपणानामनाथानां दीनानामपरक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ viṣāśanaṃ prājñairvaramagnipraveśanam | kṛpaṇānāmanāthānāṃ dīnānāmaparakṣaṇāt
verses.translation: He looked very old and had assumed the body of a brahmin. He was shining with brilliance. He had a staff and an umbrella. He was mentally delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: He looked very old and had assumed the body of a brahmin. He was shining with brilliance. He had a staff and an umbrella. He was mentally delighted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थं विलपितं तस्य स्ववीर्यस्य च गर्हणम् । निशम्य नृपतिः शोकादात्मन्येवमचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | itthaṃ vilapitaṃ tasya svavīryasya ca garhaṇam | niśamya nṛpatiḥ śokādātmanyevamacintayat
verses.translation: Assuming this form of a Jaila (one with matted hair), the delighted Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees went to the penance-grove of Parvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming this form of a Jaila (one with matted hair), the delighted Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees went to the penance-grove of Parvati.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो मे पौरुषं नष्टमद्य दैवविपर्ययात् । अद्य कीर्तिश्च मे नष्टा पातकं प्राप्तमुत्कटम्
verses.transliteration: aho me pauruṣaṃ naṣṭamadya daivaviparyayāt | adya kīrtiśca me naṣṭā pātakaṃ prāptamutkaṭam
verses.translation: On seeing the brahmin visitor of wonderful splendour, quiet with hairy limbs, bearing the staff and hide of deer, the aged bachelor with matted hair and the water-pot, she welcomed and worshipped him with all the articles of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the brahmin visitor of wonderful splendour, quiet with hairy limbs, bearing the staff and hide of deer, the aged bachelor with matted hair and the water-pot, she welcomed and worshipped him with all the articles of worship.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मः कुलोचितो नष्टो मन्दभाग्यस्य दुर्मतेः । नूनं मे सम्पदो राज्यमायुष्यं क्षयमेष्यति
verses.transliteration: dharmaḥ kulocito naṣṭo mandabhāgyasya durmateḥ | nūnaṃ me sampado rājyamāyuṣyaṃ kṣayameṣyati
verses.translation: The goddess Parvati enquired after the health of that aged bachelor respectfully after worshipping him with great joy.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess Parvati enquired after the health of that aged bachelor respectfully after worshipping him with great joy.
verses.hindi: मुझ अभागे तथा दुर्बद्धिका कुलोचित धर्म ने हो गया। निश्चय ही [इस प्रकारके पापके कारण] मेरी सम्पत्तियों, राज्य और आयुका भी नाश हा जायगा

verses.sanskrit: अद्य चैनं द्विजन्मानं हतदारं शुचार्दितम् । हतशोकं करिष्यामि दत्त्वा प्राणानतिप्रियान्
verses.transliteration: adya cainaṃ dvijanmānaṃ hatadāraṃ śucārditam | hataśokaṃ kariṣyāmi dattvā prāṇānatipriyān
verses.translation: "O most excellent one among the knowers of the Vedas, who are you, please, in the guise of a student-ascetic and whence have you come illuminating this forest?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O most excellent one among the knowers of the Vedas, who are you, please, in the guise of a student-ascetic and whence have you come illuminating this forest?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति निश्चित्य मनसा स भद्रायुर्नृपोत्तमः । पतित्वा पादयोस्तस्य बभाषे परिसान्त्वयन्
verses.transliteration: iti niścitya manasā sa bhadrāyurnṛpottamaḥ | patitvā pādayostasya babhāṣe parisāntvayan
verses.translation: On being asked thus by Parvati, that brahmin replied immediately with great pleasure in order to test the feelings of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked thus by Parvati, that brahmin replied immediately with great pleasure in order to test the feelings of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरुवाच । कृपां कृत्वा मयि ब्रह्मन् क्षत्रबन्धौ हतौजसि । शोकन्त्यज महाप्राज्ञ दास्याम्यद्य तु वाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: bhadrāyuruvāca | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mayi brahman kṣatrabandhau hataujasi | śokantyaja mahāprājña dāsyāmyadya tu vāñchitam
verses.translation: I am a brahmin bachelor going about here and there as I please. I am a saint pleasing and helping others undoubtedly.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am a brahmin bachelor going about here and there as I please. I am a saint pleasing and helping others undoubtedly.
