verses.sanskrit: इदं राज्यमियं राज्ञी ममेदं च कलेवरम् । त्वदधीनमिदं सर्वं किन्तेऽभिलषितं वरम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ rājyamiyaṃ rājñī mamedaṃ ca kalevaram | tvadadhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ kinte'bhilaṣitaṃ varam
verses.translation: In your fresh youth, the means of good enjoyment and the cause of happiness through all requisite articles of pleasure, you are performing this penance in vain.
verses.commentary: Sense: In your fresh youth, the means of good enjoyment and the cause of happiness through all requisite articles of pleasure, you are performing this penance in vain.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच । किमादर्शेन चान्धस्य किं गृहेर्भैक्ष्यजीविनः । किं पुस्तकेन मूढस्य निस्त्रीकस्य धनेन किम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca | kimādarśena cāndhasya kiṃ gṛherbhaikṣyajīvinaḥ | kiṃ pustakena mūḍhasya nistrīkasya dhanena kim
verses.translation: Who are you? Whose daughter are you? Why are you performing a penance in this desolate forest? Your penance is such as cannot be outdone even by sages of elevated souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who are you? Whose daughter are you? Why are you performing a penance in this desolate forest? Your penance is such as cannot be outdone even by sages of elevated souls.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽहं हतपत्नीको भुक्तभोगो न कर्हिचित् । इमान्तवाग्रमहिषीं कामये दीयतामिति
verses.transliteration: ato'haṃ hatapatnīko bhuktabhogo na karhicit | imāntavāgramahiṣīṃ kāmaye dīyatāmiti
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Parvati laughed and spoke to the excellent student ascetic with reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Parvati laughed and spoke to the excellent student ascetic with reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरुवाच दाता रसान्तवित्तस्य राज्यस्य गजवाजिनाम् । आत्मदेहस्य कस्यापि कलत्रस्य न कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: bhadrāyuruvāca dātā rasāntavittasya rājyasya gajavājinām | ātmadehasya kasyāpi kalatrasya na karhicit
verses.translation: O sage, O brahmin bachelor, listen to the details of my wife. I am born in Bharata in the house of Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, O brahmin bachelor, listen to the details of my wife. I am born in Bharata in the house of Himavat.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परदारोपभोगेन यत्पापं समुपार्जितम् । न तत्क्षालयितुं शक्यं प्रायश्चित्तशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: paradāropabhogena yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam | na tatkṣālayituṃ śakyaṃ prāyaścittaśatairapi
verses.translation: O brahmin, in this birth too, Siva came my way due to merit but he reduced Kama to ashes, abandoned me and went away.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, in this birth too, Siva came my way due to merit but he reduced Kama to ashes, abandoned me and went away.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच । आस्तां ब्रह्मवधं घोरमपि मद्यनिषेवणम् । तपसा विधमिष्यामि किं पुनः पारदारिकम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca | āstāṃ brahmavadhaṃ ghoramapi madyaniṣevaṇam | tapasā vidhamiṣyāmi kiṃ punaḥ pāradārikam
verses.translation: For the close similarity of ideas and verbal expressions in verses 20 to 61, see Kalidasa's Kumira V., also RudrasamhitS, Ffirvati- kharjda, Cbs 26, 27.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the close similarity of ideas and verbal expressions in verses 20 to 61, see Kalidasa's Kumira V., also RudrasamhitS, Ffirvati- kharjda, Cbs 26, 27.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रयच्छ भार्यां स्वामियां कामो न मेऽपरः । अरक्षणाद्भयार्तानां गन्तासि निरयं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātprayaccha bhāryāṃ svāmiyāṃ kāmo na me'paraḥ | arakṣaṇādbhayārtānāṃ gantāsi nirayaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: Leaving off Indra and other gods, Vi?nu and Brahma I wish to obtain iSiva as my husband really.
verses.commentary: Sense: Leaving off Indra and other gods, Vi?nu and Brahma I wish to obtain iSiva as my husband really.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति विप्रगिरा भीतश्चिन्तयामास पार्थिवः । अरक्षणान्महापापं पत्नीदानं ततो वरम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti vipragirā bhītaścintayāmāsa pārthivaḥ | arakṣaṇānmahāpāpaṃ patnīdānaṃ tato varam
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing these firm words of Parvat! that Jatila Rudra laughingly spoke again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on hearing these firm words of Parvat! that Jatila Rudra laughingly spoke again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः पत्नीं द्विजाग्र्याय दत्त्वा निर्मुक्तकिल्बिषः । सद्यो वह्निं प्रवेक्ष्यामि कीर्तिश्च विदिता भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ patnīṃ dvijāgryāya dattvā nirmuktakilbiṣaḥ | sadyo vahniṃ pravekṣyāmi kīrtiśca viditā bhavet
verses.translation: O gentle lady, O daughter of Himavat, what is this idea that has struck you? You are performing this great penance for obtaining Iiva after leaving off all the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, O daughter of Himavat, what is this idea that has struck you? You are performing this great penance for obtaining Iiva after leaving off all the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति निश्चित्य मनसा समुज्ज्वाल्य हुताशनम् । तमाहूय द्विजं चक्रे पत्नीदानं सहोदकम्
verses.transliteration: iti niścitya manasā samujjvālya hutāśanam | tamāhūya dvijaṃ cakre patnīdānaṃ sahodakam
verses.translation: I know that iSiva. Listen. I shall tell you that bull-bannered Siva wears matted hair and is ill-mannered.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know that iSiva. Listen. I shall tell you that bull-bannered Siva wears matted hair and is ill-mannered.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं स्नातः शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रणम्य विबुधेश्वरान् । तमग्निं त्रिः परिक्रम्य शिवं दध्यौ समाहितः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ snātaḥ śucirbhūtvā praṇamya vibudheśvarān | tamagniṃ triḥ parikramya śivaṃ dadhyau samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: O gentle lady, your features etc. and those of Siva are ill-matched. I do not like this. But do as you please.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, your features etc. and those of Siva are ill-matched. I do not like this. But do as you please.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद स्वयं स्नान करके पवित्र हो देवेश्वरोंको प्रणामकर उस अग्निकी तीन बार प्रदक्षिणा करके समाहितचित्त हो, उन्होंने शिवजीका ध्यान किया

verses.sanskrit: तमथाग्निं पतिष्यन्तं स्वपदासक्तचेतसम् । प्रत्यषेधत विश्वेशः प्रादुर्भूतो द्विजेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tamathāgniṃ patiṣyantaṃ svapadāsaktacetasam | pratyaṣedhata viśveśaḥ prādurbhūto dvijeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, Siva in the guise of a student- ascetic rebuked himself in her presence in order to test her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Siva in the guise of a student- ascetic rebuked himself in her presence in order to test her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमीश्वरं पञ्चमुखं त्रिनेत्रं पिनाकिनं चन्द्रकलावतंसम् । प्रलम्बपिङ्गांशुजटाकलापं मध्याह्नसद्भास्करकोटितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: tamīśvaraṃ pañcamukhaṃ trinetraṃ pinākinaṃ candrakalāvataṃsam | pralambapiṅgāṃśujaṭākalāpaṃ madhyāhnasadbhāskarakoṭitejasam
verses.translation: On hearing his intolerable words, Parvati replied extremely infuriated at him who was engrossed in insulting liva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his intolerable words, Parvati replied extremely infuriated at him who was engrossed in insulting liva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मृणालगौरं गजचर्मवाससं गङ्गातरङ्गोक्षितमौलिदेशकम् । नागेन्द्रहारावलिकण्ठभूषणं किरीटकाञ्च्यङ्गदकङ्कणोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: mṛṇālagauraṃ gajacarmavāsasaṃ gaṅgātaraṅgokṣitamaulideśakam | nāgendrahārāvalikaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ kirīṭakāñcyaṅgadakaṅkaṇojjvalam
verses.translation: Till now I thought that you would be some one fit to be killed. But now it is quite clear that you are not to be killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Till now I thought that you would be some one fit to be killed. But now it is quite clear that you are not to be killed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शूलासिखट्वाङ्गकुठारचर्म- मृगाभयाष्टाङ्गपिनाकहस्तम् । वृषोपरिस्थं शितिकण्ठभूषणं प्रोद्भूतमग्रे स नृपो ददर्श
verses.transliteration: śūlāsikhaṭvāṅgakuṭhāracarma- mṛgābhayāṣṭāṅgapinākahastam | vṛṣoparisthaṃ śitikaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ prodbhūtamagre sa nṛpo dadarśa
verses.translation: You are some foolish knave in the guise of a student-ascetic. O fool, l§iva has been insulted by you. Hence, I am infuriated.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are some foolish knave in the guise of a student-ascetic. O fool, l§iva has been insulted by you. Hence, I am infuriated.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽम्बराद् द्रुतं पेतुर्दिव्याः कुसुमवृष्टयः । प्रणेदुर्देवतूर्य्याणि देव्यश्च ननृतुर्जगुः
verses.transliteration: tato'mbarād drutaṃ peturdivyāḥ kusumavṛṣṭayaḥ | praṇedurdevatūryyāṇi devyaśca nanṛturjaguḥ
verses.translation: The accumulated merits of the person who insults Siva without knowing reality are reduced to ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The accumulated merits of the person who insults Siva without knowing reality are reduced to ashes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्राजग्मुः स्तूयमाना हरिर्ब्रह्मा तथासुराः । इन्द्रादयो नारदाद्या मुनयश्चापरेऽपि च
verses.transliteration: tatrājagmuḥ stūyamānā harirbrahmā tathāsurāḥ | indrādayo nāradādyā munayaścāpare'pi ca
verses.translation: One should perform, expiation after touching a Siva-hater.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should perform, expiation after touching a Siva-hater.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, इन्द्रादि देवता, नारदादि महर्षि तथा अन्य मुनिगण भी स्तुति करते हुए वहाँ आ पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सवो महानासीत्तत्र भक्तिप्रवर्धनः । सति पश्यति भूपाले भक्तिनम्रीकृताञ्जलौ
verses.transliteration: tadotsavo mahānāsīttatra bhaktipravardhanaḥ | sati paśyati bhūpāle bhaktinamrīkṛtāñjalau
verses.translation: O wicked fellow, you said I know Siva. Certainly he is not known to you. Siva alone is the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O wicked fellow, you said I know Siva. Certainly he is not known to you. Siva alone is the great lord.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्दर्शनानन्दविजृम्भिताशयः प्रवृद्धबाष्पाम्बुविलिप्तगात्रः । प्रहृष्टरोमा स हि गद्गदाक्षरस्तुष्टाव गीर्भिर्मुकुलीकृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: taddarśanānandavijṛmbhitāśayaḥ pravṛddhabāṣpāmbuviliptagātraḥ | prahṛṣṭaromā sa hi gadgadākṣarastuṣṭāva gīrbhirmukulīkṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Assuming many guises through his Maya,*Rudra may appear in any form. But the beloved of the good, having no aberrations, lavishly bestows all desired things on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming many guises through his Maya,*Rudra may appear in any form. But the beloved of the good, having no aberrations, lavishly bestows all desired things on me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्स भगवान् राज्ञा संस्तुतः परमेश्वरः । प्रसन्नः सह पार्वत्या तमुवाच दयानिधिः
verses.transliteration: tatassa bhagavān rājñā saṃstutaḥ parameśvaraḥ | prasannaḥ saha pārvatyā tamuvāca dayānidhiḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, Parvati expatiated on Siva's principle, where Siva was explained as attributeless and un> changing performing the penance of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Parvati expatiated on Siva's principle, where Siva was explained as attributeless and un> changing performing the penance of Brahman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजंस्ते परितुष्टोऽहं भक्त्या त्वद्धर्मतोऽधिकम् । वरं ब्रूहि सपत्नीकम्प्रयच्छामि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: rājaṃste parituṣṭo'haṃ bhaktyā tvaddharmato'dhikam | varaṃ brūhi sapatnīkamprayacchāmi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing her words, the brahmin began to say something; but by that time, Parvati whose mind was attached to Siva and who was averse to Siva being insulted, immediately spoke to her friend Vijaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words, the brahmin began to say something; but by that time, Parvati whose mind was attached to Siva and who was averse to Siva being insulted, immediately spoke to her friend Vijaya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तव भावपरीक्षार्थं द्विजो भूत्वाहमागतः । व्याघ्रेण या परिग्रस्ता साक्षाद्देवी शिवा हि सा
verses.transliteration: tava bhāvaparīkṣārthaṃ dvijo bhūtvāhamāgataḥ | vyāghreṇa yā parigrastā sākṣāddevī śivā hi sā
verses.translation: Friend, this base brahmin must be prevented. He is going to speak again. He is sure to insult Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Friend, this base brahmin must be prevented. He is going to speak again. He is sure to insult Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रो मायामयो यस्ते शरैरक्षत विग्रहः । धीरतान् द्रष्टुकामस्ते पत्नीं याचितवानहम्
verses.transliteration: vyāghro māyāmayo yaste śarairakṣata vigrahaḥ | dhīratān draṣṭukāmaste patnīṃ yācitavānaham
verses.translation: A rebuker of Siva shall be slain by all means by Siva's attendants. If he happens to be a brahmin he shall be abandoned. He shall go away from that place imme¬ diately.
verses.commentary: Sense: A rebuker of Siva shall be slain by all means by Siva's attendants. If he happens to be a brahmin he shall be abandoned. He shall go away from that place imme¬ diately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य प्रभोर्वाक्यं स भद्रायुर्महीपतिः । पुनः प्रणम्य संस्तूय स्वामिनं नतकोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya prabhorvākyaṃ sa bhadrāyurmahīpatiḥ | punaḥ praṇamya saṃstūya svāminaṃ natako'bravīt
verses.translation: This wicked fellow will insult Siva again. Being a brahmin he cannot be killed. He shall be abandoned. He should not even be looked at.
verses.commentary: Sense: This wicked fellow will insult Siva again. Being a brahmin he cannot be killed. He shall be abandoned. He should not even be looked at.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--प्रभुका यह वचन सुनकर उन्हें पुनः प्रणमकर तथा उनकी स्तुति करके विनग्र होकर वे राजा भद्रायु स्वामी [शिव]-से कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरुवाच । एक एव वरो नाथ यद्भवान्परमेश्वरः । भवतापप्रतप्तस्य मम प्रत्यक्षतां गतः
verses.transliteration: bhadrāyuruvāca | eka eva varo nātha yadbhavānparameśvaraḥ | bhavatāpaprataptasya mama pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Let us leave this place and go elsewhere. Do not delay, lest there should be any further talk with this igno¬ rant man.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let us leave this place and go elsewhere. Do not delay, lest there should be any further talk with this igno¬ rant man.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्ददासि पुनर्नाथ वरं स्वकृपया प्रभो । वृणेऽहं परमं त्वत्तो वरं हि वरदर्षभात्
verses.transliteration: yaddadāsi punarnātha varaṃ svakṛpayā prabho | vṛṇe'haṃ paramaṃ tvatto varaṃ hi varadarṣabhāt
verses.translation: ''O Parvati, where are you going, leaving me? You cannot be forsaken by me. You have been tested by me O faultless one, you are really steady in your devotion to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O Parvati, where are you going, leaving me? You cannot be forsaken by me. You have been tested by me O faultless one, you are really steady in your devotion to me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वज्रबाहुः पिता मे हि सपत्नीको महेश्वर । सपत्नीकस्त्वहं नाथ सदा त्वत्पादसेवकः
verses.transliteration: vajrabāhuḥ pitā me hi sapatnīko maheśvara | sapatnīkastvahaṃ nātha sadā tvatpādasevakaḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of knowing your feelings I have ap¬ proached you in the guise of a student-asectic and spoke these diverse words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of knowing your feelings I have ap¬ proached you in the guise of a student-asectic and spoke these diverse words.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यः पद्माकरो नाम तत्पुत्रः सनयाभिधः । सर्वानेतान्महेशान सदा त्वं पार्श्वगान्कुरु
verses.transliteration: vaiśyaḥ padmākaro nāma tatputraḥ sanayābhidhaḥ | sarvānetānmaheśāna sadā tvaṃ pārśvagānkuru
verses.translation: O Parvati, I am delighted at your steady devotion. Mention the boon that you have cherished in your mind. There is nothing that cannot be given to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Parvati, I am delighted at your steady devotion. Mention the boon that you have cherished in your mind. There is nothing that cannot be given to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ राज्ञी च तत्पत्नी प्रमत्ता कीर्तिमालिनी । भक्त्या प्रसाद्य गिरिशं ययाचे वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | atha rājñī ca tatpatnī pramattā kīrtimālinī | bhaktyā prasādya giriśaṃ yayāce varamuttamam
verses.translation: O loving lady, I have been made your slave from now onwards by means of your penance. Due to your beauty, even a moment seems to expand into a Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O loving lady, I have been made your slave from now onwards by means of your penance. Due to your beauty, even a moment seems to expand into a Yoga.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्युवाच । चन्द्राङ्गदो मम पिता माता सीमन्तिनी च मे । तयोर्याचे महादेव त्वत्पाश्वे सन्निधिं मुदा
verses.transliteration: rājñyuvāca | candrāṅgado mama pitā mātā sīmantinī ca me | tayoryāce mahādeva tvatpāśve sannidhiṃ mudā
verses.translation: Leave off your bashfulness. You are my eternal wife. O beloved, come on, I shall go to my hilly abode along with you.**
verses.commentary: Sense: Leave off your bashfulness. You are my eternal wife. O beloved, come on, I shall go to my hilly abode along with you.**
verses.hindi: रानी बोली--हे महादेव! मेरे पिता चन्द्रांग और मेरी माता सीमन्तिनी--इन दोनोंके लिये रस आपके समीप निवासकी याचना करती हूँ

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमस्त्विति गौरीशः प्रसन्नो भक्तवत्सलः । तयोः कामवरान्दत्त्वा क्षणादन्तर्हितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamastviti gaurīśaḥ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ | tayoḥ kāmavarāndattvā kṣaṇādantarhito'bhavat
verses.translation: When the lord of gods said thus, Parvati rejoiced much. Whatever misery she experienced in performing the penance, she cast off immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord of gods said thus, Parvati rejoiced much. Whatever misery she experienced in performing the penance, she cast off immediately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरपि सुप्रीत्या प्रसादं प्राप्य शूलिनः । सहितः कीर्तिमालिन्या बुभुजे विषयान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: bhadrāyurapi suprītyā prasādaṃ prāpya śūlinaḥ | sahitaḥ kīrtimālinyā bubhuje viṣayānbahūn
verses.translation: On seeing that divine form of Siva, Parvati replied to the lord with face lowered due to bashfulness.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that divine form of Siva, Parvati replied to the lord with face lowered due to bashfulness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वर्षायुतं राज्यमव्याहतपराक्रमः । राज्यं विक्षिप्य तनये जगाम शिवसन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā varṣāyutaṃ rājyamavyāhataparākramaḥ | rājyaṃ vikṣipya tanaye jagāma śivasannidhim
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if you have pity on me, be my lord and husband."
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if you have pity on me, be my lord and husband."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्राङ्गदोऽपि राजेन्द्रो राज्ञी सीमन्तिनी च सा । भक्त्या सम्पूज्य गिरिशं जग्मतुः शाम्भवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: candrāṅgado'pi rājendro rājñī sīmantinī ca sā | bhaktyā sampūjya giriśaṃ jagmatuḥ śāmbhavaṃ padam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the incarnation of Siva in the form of a student-ascctic wherein he tested the feelings of Parvati has been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus the incarnation of Siva in the form of a student-ascctic wherein he tested the feelings of Parvati has been narrated to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजेश्वरावतारस्ते वर्णितः परमो मया । महेश्वरस्य भद्रायुपरमानन्ददः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: dvijeśvarāvatāraste varṇitaḥ paramo mayā | maheśvarasya bhadrāyuparamānandadaḥ prabho
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to the incarna* tion of lord Siva, the great soul, as Sunartaka nata.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to the incarna* tion of lord Siva, the great soul, as Sunartaka nata.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो [सनत्कुमार !] इस प्रकार मैंने आपसे शिवजीके श्रेष्ठ द्विजेश्वरावतारका वर्णन किया, जिससे राजा भद्रायुको परम सुख प्राप्त हुआ

verses.sanskrit: इदं चरित्रं परमं पवित्रं शिवावतारस्य पवित्रकीर्त्तेः । द्विजेशसंज्ञस्य महाद्भुतं हि शृण्वन्पठन् शम्भुपदं प्रयाति
verses.transliteration: idaṃ caritraṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ śivāvatārasya pavitrakīrtteḥ | dvijeśasaṃjñasya mahādbhutaṃ hi śṛṇvanpaṭhan śambhupadaṃ prayāti
verses.translation: O sage, the delighted Siva revealed his real form to her and told Parvatl, "Mention the boon you wish to have."
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the delighted Siva revealed his real form to her and told Parvatl, "Mention the boon you wish to have."
verses.hindi: पवित्र कीर्तिवाले द्विजेशसंज्ञक शिवावतारके इस परम पवित्र तथा अत्यन्त अद्भुत चरित्रको पढ़ने तथा सुननेवाला शिवपदको प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । न श्चोतति स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | na ścotati svadharmātsa paratra labhate gatim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva and on seeing his excellent form, Parvati was delighted. She spoke to him after paying her homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Siva and on seeing his excellent form, Parvati was delighted. She spoke to him after paying her homage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O lord Siva, it behoves to marry me with due rites for the fulfilment of the task of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, it behoves to marry me with due rites for the fulfilment of the task of the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O lord Siva, it behoves to marry me with due rites for the fulfilment of the task of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, it behoves to marry me with due rites for the fulfilment of the task of the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । यतिनाथब्रह्महंसाह्वयशिवावतारचरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु प्राज्ञ प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । अवतारं परानन्दं यतिनाथाह्वयं मुने
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.28. aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | yatināthabrahmahaṃsāhvayaśivāvatāracaritavarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu prājña pravakṣyāmi śivasya paramātmanaḥ | avatāraṃ parānandaṃ yatināthāhvayaṃ mune
verses.translation: O lord, you are without aberrations. Please fulfil my desires. You are favourably disposed to the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are without aberrations. Please fulfil my desires. You are favourably disposed to the devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्बुदाचलसंज्ञे तु पर्वते भिल्लवंशजः । आहुकश्च तदभ्याशे वसति स्म मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: arbudācalasaṃjñe tu parvate bhillavaṃśajaḥ | āhukaśca tadabhyāśe vasati sma munīśvara
verses.translation: He did not accept those gems. He wished to have Parvati for his alms. Eagerly he began to dance and sing again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He did not accept those gems. He wished to have Parvati for his alms. Eagerly he began to dance and sing again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पत्नी ह्याहुका नाम बभूव किल सुव्रता । उभावपि महाशैवावास्तां तौ शिवपूजकौ
verses.transliteration: tatpatnī hyāhukā nāma babhūva kila suvratā | ubhāvapi mahāśaivāvāstāṃ tau śivapūjakau
verses.translation: Our Parvatl who has performed a hard penance shall be given to him", thinking thus they became extreme¬ ly devoted to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our Parvatl who has performed a hard penance shall be given to him", thinking thus they became extreme¬ ly devoted to Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चित्समये भिल्लः शिवभक्तिरतः सदा । आहारार्थं स्वपत्न्याश्च सुदूरं स गतो मुने
verses.transliteration: kasmiṃścitsamaye bhillaḥ śivabhaktirataḥ sadā | āhārārthaṃ svapatnyāśca sudūraṃ sa gato mune
verses.translation: O preceptor, if the mountain gives his daughter to Siva 'with great faith he will attain salvation. Lei him stay on the Earth itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor, if the mountain gives his daughter to Siva 'with great faith he will attain salvation. Lei him stay on the Earth itself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र गेहे भिल्लस्य शङ्करः । भूत्वा यतिवपुः सायं परीक्षार्थं समाययौ
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra gehe bhillasya śaṅkaraḥ | bhūtvā yativapuḥ sāyaṃ parīkṣārthaṃ samāyayau
verses.translation: Or you all, including Indra, go to Brahma's region. Tell him all your details. He will carry out your work.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or you all, including Indra, go to Brahma's region. Tell him all your details. He will carry out your work.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे तत्राजगाम स गृहाधिपः । पूजनं च यतीशस्य चकार प्रेमतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare tatrājagāma sa gṛhādhipaḥ | pūjanaṃ ca yatīśasya cakāra premataḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words and reflecting thereon, the gods went to Brahma's assembly. They submitted all the details to Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words and reflecting thereon, the gods went to Brahma's assembly. They submitted all the details to Brahma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्भावस्य परीक्षार्थं यतिरूपः स शङ्करः । महालीलातरः प्रीत्या भीतः प्रोवाच दीनगीः
verses.transliteration: tadbhāvasya parīkṣārthaṃ yatirūpaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ | mahālīlātaraḥ prītyā bhītaḥ provāca dīnagīḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their words and reflecting deeply Brahma told them—''I shall not censure him, for that will yield misery to us and dispel out happiness for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words and reflecting deeply Brahma told them—''I shall not censure him, for that will yield misery to us and dispel out happiness for ever.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतिनाथ उवाच । अद्य स्थलं निवासार्थं देहि मे प्रातरेव हि । यास्यामि सर्वथा भिल्ल स्वस्ति स्यात्तव सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: yatinātha uvāca | adya sthalaṃ nivāsārthaṃ dehi me prātareva hi | yāsyāmi sarvathā bhilla svasti syāttava sarvadā
verses.translation: O gods, you go to Kailasa and propitiate Siva. Reques! that lord to go to the abode of Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, you go to Kailasa and propitiate Siva. Reques! that lord to go to the abode of Himavat.
verses.hindi: यतिनाथ बोले--हे भिल्ल! तुम मुझे आज रहनेके लिये स्थान दो और प्रातःकाल होते ही मैं सर्वथा चला जाऊँगा, तुम्हारा सर्वदा कल्याण हो

verses.sanskrit: भिल्ल उवाच । सत्यं प्रोक्तं त्वया स्वामिन् शृणु मद्वचनं च ते । अति स्वल्पं स्थलं मे हि स्यान्निवासः कथं तव
verses.transliteration: bhilla uvāca | satyaṃ proktaṃ tvayā svāmin śṛṇu madvacanaṃ ca te | ati svalpaṃ sthalaṃ me hi syānnivāsaḥ kathaṃ tava
verses.translation: Let him approach the lord of mountains and cen¬ sure himself. Censuring others is conducive to destruction and censuring oneself is conducive to glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him approach the lord of mountains and cen¬ sure himself. Censuring others is conducive to destruction and censuring oneself is conducive to glory.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तः स यतिस्तेन गमनाय मतिं दधे । तावद्भिल्ल्या वचः प्रोक्तं स्वामिनं संविचार्य वै
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktaḥ sa yatistena gamanāya matiṃ dadhe | tāvadbhillyā vacaḥ proktaṃ svāminaṃ saṃvicārya vai
verses.translation: After making her beauty fruitful, Parvatl returned
verses.commentary: Sense: After making her beauty fruitful, Parvatl returned
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिल्ल्युवाच । स्वामिन्देहि यतेः स्थानं विमुखं कुरु मातिथिम् । गृहधर्मं विचार्य त्वमन्यथा धर्मसङ्क्षयः
verses.transliteration: bhillyuvāca | svāmindehi yateḥ sthānaṃ vimukhaṃ kuru mātithim | gṛhadharmaṃ vicārya tvamanyathā dharmasaṅkṣayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing Parvati's return, Himavat accompanied by his attendants and his wife Mena joyously came to see his daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing Parvati's return, Himavat accompanied by his attendants and his wife Mena joyously came to see his daughter.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थीयतां ते गृहाभ्यन्तः सुखेन यतिना सह । अहं बहिः स्थितिं कुर्यामायुधानि बृहन्त्यपि
verses.transliteration: sthīyatāṃ te gṛhābhyantaḥ sukhena yatinā saha | ahaṃ bahiḥ sthitiṃ kuryāmāyudhāni bṛhantyapi
verses.translation: On seeing her delighted, both of them received her suitably wiihin the house and glad at heart celebrated the event with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her delighted, both of them received her suitably wiihin the house and glad at heart celebrated the event with pleasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भिल्ल्या धर्मान्वितं शिवम् । स्वपत्न्या मनसा तेन भिल्लेन च विचारितम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhillyā dharmānvitaṃ śivam | svapatnyā manasā tena bhillena ca vicāritam
verses.translation: Then Mena joyously stayed for a while in the yard with her daughter and Himavat went to the Ganges for a bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Mena joyously stayed for a while in the yard with her daughter and Himavat went to the Ganges for a bath.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियं बहिश्च निष्कास्य कथं स्थेयं मया गृहे । यतेरन्यत्र गमनमधर्मकरमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: striyaṃ bahiśca niṣkāsya kathaṃ stheyaṃ mayā gṛhe | yateranyatra gamanamadharmakaramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees and indulging in good sports, assumed the form of a dancer and approached Menaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees and indulging in good sports, assumed the form of a dancer and approached Menaka.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वयमप्युचितं नैव सर्वथा गृहमेधिनः । यद्भावि तद्भवेदेव मया स्थेयं गृहाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: dvayamapyucitaṃ naiva sarvathā gṛhamedhinaḥ | yadbhāvi tadbhavedeva mayā stheyaṃ gṛhād bahiḥ
verses.translation: He held the horn in his left hand and the small drum in his right. He carried a bundle of patched garments on his back. He wore a red cloth. He appeared to be an expert in dance and music.
verses.commentary: Sense: He held the horn in his left hand and the small drum in his right. He carried a bundle of patched garments on his back. He wore a red cloth. He appeared to be an expert in dance and music.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्याग्रहं तदा कृत्वा गृहान्तः स्थाप्य तौ मुदा । स्वायुधानि च संस्थाप्य भिल्लोऽतिष्ठद् गृहाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: ityāgrahaṃ tadā kṛtvā gṛhāntaḥ sthāpya tau mudā | svāyudhāni ca saṃsthāpya bhillo'tiṣṭhad gṛhād bahiḥ
verses.translation: Then the lord in the form of a dancer performed various dances joyously in the yard of Menaka and sang sweetly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord in the form of a dancer performed various dances joyously in the yard of Menaka and sang sweetly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ तं पशवः क्रूराः हिंसकाः समपीडयन् । तेनापि च यथाशक्ति कृतो यत्नो महांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: rātrau taṃ paśavaḥ krūrāḥ hiṃsakāḥ samapīḍayan | tenāpi ca yathāśakti kṛto yatno mahāṃstadā
verses.translation: He blew on the horn and played on Damaru pro¬ ducing sweet notes. With great pleasure he exhibited a variety of splendid sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: He blew on the horn and played on Damaru pro¬ ducing sweet notes. With great pleasure he exhibited a variety of splendid sports.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं यत्नं प्रकुर्वाणः स भिल्लो बलवानपि । प्रारब्धात्प्रेरितैर्हिंस्रैर्बलादासीच्च भक्षितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yatnaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ sa bhillo balavānapi | prārabdhātpreritairhiṃsrairbalādāsīcca bhakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The citizens including men, women, children and old women gathered there suddenly to see him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The citizens including men, women, children and old women gathered there suddenly to see him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय स यतिर्दृष्ट्वा हिंस्रैश्च भक्षितम् । भिल्लं वनेचरं तं वै दुःखितोऽभूदतीव हि
verses.transliteration: prātarutthāya sa yatirdṛṣṭvā hiṃsraiśca bhakṣitam | bhillaṃ vanecaraṃ taṃ vai duḥkhito'bhūdatīva hi
verses.translation: O sage, hearing the sweet song and witnessing the splendid dance, the people were fascinated and Mena too was highly delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, hearing the sweet song and witnessing the splendid dance, the people were fascinated and Mena too was highly delighted.
verses.hindi: प्रातःकाल उठकर संन्यासी हिंस्र जन्तुओंसे भक्षित उस वनेचर भीलको देखकर बड़ा दुखी हुआ

verses.sanskrit: दुखितं तं यतिं दृष्ट्वा भिल्ली सा दुःखितापि हि । धैर्यात्स्वदुःखं संहृत्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: dukhitaṃ taṃ yatiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhillī sā duḥkhitāpi hi | dhairyātsvaduḥkhaṃ saṃhṛtya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
verses.translation: In the meantime the lord of the mountains re¬ turned from the Ganges. He saw the mendicant in the form of a man standing before him in the yard.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the lord of the mountains re¬ turned from the Ganges. He saw the mendicant in the form of a man standing before him in the yard.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिल्ल्युवाच । किमर्थं क्रियते दुःखं भद्रं जातं यतेऽधुना । धन्योऽयं कृतकृत्यश्च यज्जातो मृत्युरीदृशः
verses.transliteration: bhillyuvāca | kimarthaṃ kriyate duḥkhaṃ bhadraṃ jātaṃ yate'dhunā | dhanyo'yaṃ kṛtakṛtyaśca yajjāto mṛtyurīdṛśaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing from Mena all the details he too was infuriated. He ordered his attendants to drive out the mendicant.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing from Mena all the details he too was infuriated. He ordered his attendants to drive out the mendicant.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहं चैनं गमिष्यामि भस्म भूत्वानले यते । चितां कारय सुप्रीत्या स्त्रीणां धर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ cainaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhasma bhūtvānale yate | citāṃ kāraya suprītyā strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sage, no one could drive him out. He was blazing and brilliant like a big fire and could not be touched.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, no one could drive him out. He was blazing and brilliant like a big fire and could not be touched.
verses.hindi: हे यते! अब मैं भी इन्हींके साथ अग्निमें भस्म होकर सती हो जाऊँगी, आप प्रेमपूर्वक चिता तैयार कराइये; क्योंकि यही स्त्रियोंका सनातनधर्म है

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हितं मत्वा स्वयं यतिः । चितां व्यरचयत्सा हि प्रविवेश स्वधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hitaṃ matvā svayaṃ yatiḥ | citāṃ vyaracayatsā hi praviveśa svadharmataḥ
verses.translation: O dear, then that mendicant, an expert in differ¬ ent sports, exhibited his infinite power to the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, then that mendicant, an expert in differ¬ ent sports, exhibited his infinite power to the mountain.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे साक्षात्पुरः प्रादुरभूच्छिवः । धन्ये धन्ये इति प्रीत्या प्रशंसस्तां हरोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare sākṣātpuraḥ prādurabhūcchivaḥ | dhanye dhanye iti prītyā praśaṃsastāṃ haro'bravīt
verses.translation: Immediately the mountain saw him assuming the form of Visnu, then the form of Brahma and in a trice that of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately the mountain saw him assuming the form of Visnu, then the form of Brahma and in a trice that of the sun.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हर उवाच । वरं ब्रूहि प्रसन्नोऽस्मि त्वदाचरणतोऽनघे । तवादेयं न वै किञ्चिद् वश्योऽहं ते विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: hara uvāca | varaṃ brūhi prasanno'smi tvadācaraṇato'naghe | tavādeyaṃ na vai kiñcid vaśyo'haṃ te viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: O dear, then he saw him in the excessively wonderful form of Siva accompanied by Parvatl. He was exquisitely handsome and brilliant. He was laughing.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, then he saw him in the excessively wonderful form of Siva accompanied by Parvatl. He was exquisitely handsome and brilliant. He was laughing.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छुत्वा शम्भुवचनं परमानन्ददायकम् । सुखं प्राप्तं विशेषेण न किञ्चित्स्मरणं ययौ
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tacchutvā śambhuvacanaṃ paramānandadāyakam | sukhaṃ prāptaṃ viśeṣeṇa na kiñcitsmaraṇaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Thus he saw him in various forms. He was much surprised and extremely delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he saw him in various forms. He was much surprised and extremely delighted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्गतिमालक्ष्य सुप्रसन्नो हरोऽभवत् । उवाच च पुनः शम्भुर्वरं ब्रूहीति तां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadgatimālakṣya suprasanno haro'bhavat | uvāca ca punaḥ śambhurvaraṃ brūhīti tāṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Then the leading mendicant of good sports beg¬ ged for Durga as his alms, of her (Mena) and of him (the mountain). He did not accept anything else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the leading mendicant of good sports beg¬ ged for Durga as his alms, of her (Mena) and of him (the mountain). He did not accept anything else.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । अयं यतिश्च मद्रूपो हंसरूपो भविष्यति । परजन्मनि वां प्रीत्या संयोगं कारयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | ayaṃ yatiśca madrūpo haṃsarūpo bhaviṣyati | parajanmani vāṃ prītyā saṃyogaṃ kārayiṣyati
verses.translation: Then lord Siva in the form of the mendicant, urged by Durga's words vanished and went away to his abode suddenly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Siva in the form of the mendicant, urged by Durga's words vanished and went away to his abode suddenly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिल्लश्च वीरसेनस्य नैषधे नगरे वरे । महान्पुत्रो नलो नाम भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhillaśca vīrasenasya naiṣadhe nagare vare | mahānputro nalo nāma bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Perfect knowledge then dawned on Mena and the lord of mountains. They thought: "The lord Siva has deceived us and returned to his abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect knowledge then dawned on Mena and the lord of mountains. They thought: "The lord Siva has deceived us and returned to his abode.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सुता भीमराजस्य वैदर्भे नगरेऽनघे । दमयन्ती च विख्याता भविष्यसि गुणान्विता
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ sutā bhīmarājasya vaidarbhe nagare'naghe | damayantī ca vikhyātā bhaviṣyasi guṇānvitā
verses.translation: Thence after performing great sports, Siva per¬ formed the marriage rites duly with Parvati delighting all devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thence after performing great sports, Siva per¬ formed the marriage rites duly with Parvati delighting all devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: युवां चोभौ मिलित्वा च राजभोगं सुविस्तरम् । भुक्त्वा मुक्तिं च योगीन्द्रैर्लप्स्येथे दुर्लभां ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: yuvāṃ cobhau militvā ca rājabhogaṃ suvistaram | bhuktvā muktiṃ ca yogīndrairlapsyethe durlabhāṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the incarnation of Siva as Sunart- aka nata in which the desire of Parvati was fulfilled has been explained to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus the incarnation of Siva as Sunart- aka nata in which the desire of Parvati was fulfilled has been explained to you by me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च स्वयं शम्भुर्लिङ्गरूपोऽभवत्तदा । तस्मान्न चलितो धर्मादचलेश इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā ca svayaṃ śambhurliṅgarūpo'bhavattadā | tasmānna calito dharmādacaleśa iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the pious narrative of great value has been
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the pious narrative of great value has been
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--ऐसा कहकर शिवजी उसी समय लिंगरूपमें प्रकट हो गये। [उनके द्वारा परीक्षा करनेपर] भील धर्मसे विचलित नहीं हुआ, इसलिये वह लिंग अचलेश--इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स भिल्ल आहुकश्चापि वीरसेनसुतोऽभवत् । नैषधे नगरे तात नलनामा महानृपः
verses.transliteration: sa bhilla āhukaścāpi vīrasenasuto'bhavat | naiṣadhe nagare tāta nalanāmā mahānṛpaḥ
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatlcumara, listen to the incarnation of Siva, the supreme soul, as Brahmin in the garb of a saint.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatlcumara, listen to the incarnation of Siva, the supreme soul, as Brahmin in the garb of a saint.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आहुका सा महाभिल्ली भीमस्य तनयाभवत् । वैदर्भे नगरे राज्ञो दमयन्तीति विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: āhukā sā mahābhillī bhīmasya tanayābhavat | vaidarbhe nagare rājño damayantīti viśrutā
verses.translation: On realising the excellent devotion of Mena and Himavat towards Siva, the gods became worried and they consulted one another eagerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On realising the excellent devotion of Mena and Himavat towards Siva, the gods became worried and they consulted one another eagerly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतिनाथाह्वयः सोऽपि हंसरूपोऽभवच्छिवः । विवाहं कारयामास दमयन्त्या नलेन वै
verses.transliteration: yatināthāhvayaḥ so'pi haṃsarūpo'bhavacchivaḥ | vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa damayantyā nalena vai
verses.translation: If the mountain were to give his daughter to Siva with undiluted devotion, certainly he will attain salvation immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the mountain were to give his daughter to Siva with undiluted devotion, certainly he will attain salvation immediately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वसत्काररूपेण महापुण्येन शङ्करः । हंसरूपं विधायैव ताभ्यां सुखमदात्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pūrvasatkārarūpeṇa mahāpuṇyena śaṅkaraḥ | haṃsarūpaṃ vidhāyaiva tābhyāṃ sukhamadātprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He will cast off the stationary state of a mountain and assume a divine form. After giving his daughter in marriage to the trident-bearing lord he will go to Siva's region.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will cast off the stationary state of a mountain and assume a divine form. After giving his daughter in marriage to the trident-bearing lord he will go to Siva's region.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवो हंसावतारो हि नानावार्ताविचक्षणः । दमयन्त्या नलस्यापि परमानन्ददायकः
verses.transliteration: śivo haṃsāvatāro hi nānāvārtāvicakṣaṇaḥ | damayantyā nalasyāpi paramānandadāyakaḥ
verses.translation: With the blessings of Siva he will attain identity in form with the great god. He will enjoy all great plea¬ sures there and then attain liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the blessings of Siva he will attain identity in form with the great god. He will enjoy all great plea¬ sures there and then attain liberation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं चरितं परमं पवित्रं शिवावतारस्य पवित्रकीर्तेः । यतीशसंज्ञस्य महाद्भुतं हि हंसाह्वयस्यापि विमुक्तिदं हि
verses.transliteration: idaṃ caritaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ śivāvatārasya pavitrakīrteḥ | yatīśasaṃjñasya mahādbhutaṃ hi haṃsāhvayasyāpi vimuktidaṃ hi
verses.translation: O sage, after discussing like this, the gods went to the abode of their preceptor. In order to achieve their self-interest they submitted to the preceptor thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after discussing like this, the gods went to the abode of their preceptor. In order to achieve their self-interest they submitted to the preceptor thus.
verses.hindi: पवित्र कीर्तिवाले यतीश्वर नामक तथा हँस नामक शिवावतारका यह चरित्र अत्यन्त पवित्र, परम अद्भुत तथा निश्चय ही मुक्तिदायक है

verses.sanskrit: यतीशब्रह्महंसाख्यावतारचरितं शुभम् । शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्यो हि स लभेत परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yatīśabrahmahaṃsākhyāvatāracaritaṃ śubham | śṛṇuyācchrāvayedyo hi sa labheta parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: O preceptor, please go to the abode of Himavat for the accomplishment of our task. Reproach lord Siva and try to prevent the mountain's excessive devotion to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor, please go to the abode of Himavat for the accomplishment of our task. Reproach lord Siva and try to prevent the mountain's excessive devotion to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: idamākhyānamanaghaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhaktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, he thought over that and spoke to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the gods, he thought over that and spoke to them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैतच्चरितं शम्भोर्यतिहंसस्वरूपयोः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: śrutvaitaccaritaṃ śambhoryatihaṃsasvarūpayoḥ | iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā so'nte śivapuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: O gods, one of you shall go to the mountain for achieving the end. I am incapable of doing it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, one of you shall go to the mountain for achieving the end. I am incapable of doing it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, lord l§iva ac¬ cepted their proposal. He laughingly consoled the gods and made them return without worry.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the gods, lord l§iva ac¬ cepted their proposal. He laughingly consoled the gods and made them return without worry.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, lord l§iva ac¬ cepted their proposal. He laughingly consoled the gods and made them return without worry.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the gods, lord l§iva ac¬ cepted their proposal. He laughingly consoled the gods and made them return without worry.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । कृष्णदर्शनशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार शम्भोस्त्ववतारं परमं शृणु । नभगज्ञानदं कृष्णदर्शनाह्वयमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.29. ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kṛṣṇadarśanaśivāvatāravarṇanam | nandīśvara uvāca | sanatkumāra śambhostvavatāraṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu | nabhagajñānadaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanāhvayamuttamam
verses.translation: He assumed the form of a brahmin Saint. He held a staff and an umbrella. He wore divine garments. A brilliant caste mark shone on his forehead. He had tied a lalagrama stone round his neck and held a string of crystal beads in his hand. He frequently repeated the names of
verses.commentary: Sense: He assumed the form of a brahmin Saint. He held a staff and an umbrella. He wore divine garments. A brilliant caste mark shone on his forehead. He had tied a lalagrama stone round his neck and held a string of crystal beads in his hand. He frequently repeated the names of

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखा आसन् श्राद्धदेवसुताश्च ये । नभगस्तत्र नवमो नाभागस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākupramukhā āsan śrāddhadevasutāśca ye | nabhagastatra navamo nābhāgastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then Siva performed great sports delighting the devotees. He married Parvati aud carried out the task of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva performed great sports delighting the devotees. He married Parvati aud carried out the task of the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषः सुतस्तस्य विष्णुभक्तो बभूव सः । यस्योपरि प्रसन्नोऽभूद्दुर्वासा ब्रह्मभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣaḥ sutastasya viṣṇubhakto babhūva saḥ | yasyopari prasanno'bhūddurvāsā brahmabhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Drona, Siva said, "So be it." O dear sage, the lord who bestows happiness, theii vanished.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Drona, Siva said, "So be it." O dear sage, the lord who bestows happiness, theii vanished.
verses.hindi: उनके पुत्र अम्बरीष थे। वे विष्णुजीके भक्त हुए, जिनकी ब्राह्मणभक्तिसे दुर्वासाजी उनपर प्रसन्न हुए थे

verses.sanskrit: पितामहोऽम्बरीषस्य नभगो यः प्रकीर्तितः । तच्चरितं शृणु मुने यस्मै ज्ञानमदाच्छिवः
verses.transliteration: pitāmaho'mbarīṣasya nabhago yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | taccaritaṃ śṛṇu mune yasmai jñānamadācchivaḥ
verses.translation: He discharged the divine missile Brahmairas on Arjuna. Then a fierce splendour enveloping all the quarters manifested itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He discharged the divine missile Brahmairas on Arjuna. Then a fierce splendour enveloping all the quarters manifested itself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नभगो मनुपुत्रस्तु पठनार्थं सुबुद्धिमान् । चक्रे गुरुकुले वासं बहुकालं जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: nabhago manuputrastu paṭhanārthaṃ subuddhimān | cakre gurukule vāsaṃ bahukālaṃ jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Then meditating on Siva mentally, bowing to and eulogising him, Krsna understood that to be the missile of the son of Drona.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then meditating on Siva mentally, bowing to and eulogising him, Krsna understood that to be the missile of the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये ते वै इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखाः सुताः । तस्मै भागमकल्प्यैव भेजुर्भागान्निजान्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye te vai ikṣvākupramukhāḥ sutāḥ | tasmai bhāgamakalpyaiva bhejurbhāgānnijānkramāt
verses.translation: Depending upon the cooking-pot given by the sun, the Pandavas spent their time happily.
verses.commentary: Sense: Depending upon the cooking-pot given by the sun, the Pandavas spent their time happily.

verses.transliteration: svaṃ svaṃ bhāgaṃ gṛhītvā te bubhujū rājyamuttamam | aviṣādaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pitrādeśātsubuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, Durvasas the leading sage was induced by Suyodhana to go to the Paijdavas in order to deceive them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, Durvasas the leading sage was induced by Suyodhana to go to the Paijdavas in order to deceive them.

verses.translation: Accompanied by his ten thousand disciples he ap¬ proached them and asked for foodstuffs and other things for his disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his ten thousand disciples he ap¬ proached them and asked for foodstuffs and other things for his disciples.

verses.transliteration: bhrātṛnvilokya nabhago vibhaktānsakalānnijān | dāyārthī prāha tānsnehādikṣvākupramukhānmune
verses.translation: After accepting it, Durvisas and other sages and saints were sent by the Pandavas for their ablution.
verses.commentary: Sense: After accepting it, Durvisas and other sages and saints were sent by the Pandavas for their ablution.

verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvāca | bhrātaro'bhaktakaṃ mahyaṃ dāyaṃ kṛtvā yathātatham | sarve vibhaktāḥ suprītyā svadāyārthāgatāya ca

verses.sanskrit: तदा विस्मृतमस्माभिरिदानीं पितरं तव । विभजामो वयं भागं तं गृहाण न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tadā vismṛtamasmābhiridānīṃ pitaraṃ tava | vibhajāmo vayaṃ bhāgaṃ taṃ gṛhāṇa na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, Himavai and his attendants stood up and then prostrated before him. They performed A§tahga salvation on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा भ्रातृवचनं नभगः परविस्मृतः । तदोपकण्ठमागत्य पितरं समभाषत
verses.transliteration: tacchutvā bhrātṛvacanaṃ nabhagaḥ paravismṛtaḥ | tadopakaṇṭhamāgatya pitaraṃ samabhāṣata
verses.translation: Then the lord of mountains asked him "Who are you please?" The brahmin Yogin replied immediately with reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord of mountains asked him "Who are you please?" The brahmin Yogin replied immediately with reverence.

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । हे तात भ्रातरः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा मां न्यभजंश्च ते । पठनार्थं गतश्चाहं ब्रह्मचारी गुरोः कुले
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvāca | he tāta bhrātaraḥ sarve tyaktvā māṃ nyabhajaṃśca te | paṭhanārthaṃ gataścāhaṃ brahmacārī guroḥ kule
verses.translation: O niouniain, I am a devotee of Visnu known as Sadhudvija. I possess true vision. I am omniscient and I assist others. By the power of the preceptor I can go everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: O niouniain, I am a devotee of Visnu known as Sadhudvija. I possess true vision. I am omniscient and I assist others. By the power of the preceptor I can go everywhere.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत आगत्य मे पृष्टा दायदानार्थमादरात् । ते त्वामूचुर्विभागं मे तदर्थमहमागतः
verses.transliteration: tata āgatya me pṛṣṭā dāyadānārthamādarāt | te tvāmūcurvibhāgaṃ me tadarthamahamāgataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent mountain, by my divine knowledge, I have known something while I was in my abode. Listen. I shall mention the same with pleasure to you without any arrogance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent mountain, by my divine knowledge, I have known something while I was in my abode. Listen. I shall mention the same with pleasure to you without any arrogance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य पिता तं प्राह विस्मितः । आश्वास्य श्राद्धदेवः स सत्यधर्मरतं मुने
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tadākarṇya vacastasya pitā taṃ prāha vismitaḥ | āśvāsya śrāddhadevaḥ sa satyadharmarataṃ mune
verses.translation: O lord of mountains, see for yourself. He has no single relative. You can verify your relatives and your beloved.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of mountains, see for yourself. He has no single relative. You can verify your relatives and your beloved.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--हे मुने ! उनका वचन सुनकर विस्मित हुए पिता श्राद्धदेवने सत्यधर्ममें निरत अपने पुत्रको धीरज बँधाते हुए कहा--

verses.sanskrit: मनुरुवाच । तदुक्तं मादृथास्तात प्रतारणकरं हि तत् । न ह्यहं परमं दायं सर्वथा भोगसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: manuruvāca | taduktaṃ mādṛthāstāta pratāraṇakaraṃ hi tat | na hyahaṃ paramaṃ dāyaṃ sarvathā bhogasādhanam
verses.translation: Ask Mena and others excluding Parvati. O mount¬ ain, the patient never likes *he medicine but relishes undesir¬ able diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ask Mena and others excluding Parvati. O mount¬ ain, the patient never likes *he medicine but relishes undesir¬ able diet.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि दायभावेन दत्तोऽहं तैः प्रतारिभिः । तव वै जीवनोपायं वदामि शृणु तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tathāpi dāyabhāvena datto'haṃ taiḥ pratāribhiḥ | tava vai jīvanopāyaṃ vadāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ
verses.translation: He is without support. He is unattached. He is ugly, devoid of attributes and unchanging. He is hideous. He resides in the cremation ground. He is naked and handles serpents He smears ashes as decoration. Serpents twine round his head. He has fallen from all stages of life. His ways are ever unknown.

verses.transliteration: satramāṅgirasā viprāḥ kurvantyadya sumedhasaḥ | tatra karmaṇi muhyanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣaṣṭhamahaḥ prati
verses.translation: After saying these factual statements insulting to Siva, Siva of diverse sports, quickly returned to his 5bode.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying these factual statements insulting to Siva, Siva of diverse sports, quickly returned to his 5bode.
