verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्वं गच्छ नभग तान् सुशंस महाकवे । सूक्ते द्वे वैश्वदेवे हि सत्रं शुद्धं हि तद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tvaṃ gaccha nabhaga tān suśaṃsa mahākave | sūkte dve vaiśvadeve hi satraṃ śuddhaṃ hi tadbhavet
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the brahmin, they thought thus—"What can we do with regard to him who is engrossed in adverse things?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the brahmin, they thought thus—"What can we do with regard to him who is engrossed in adverse things?"
verses.hindi: अतः हे नभग! हे महाकवे! तुम वहाँ जाओ और जाकर विश्वेदेवसम्बन्धी दो सूक्तोंको उन्हें बतलाओ, जिससे वह यज्ञ शुद्ध हो सके

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मणि समाप्ते हि स्वर्यान्तो ब्राह्मणाश्च ते । धनं दास्यन्ति ते तुष्टाः स्वसत्रपरिशेषितम्
verses.transliteration: tatkarmaṇi samāpte hi svaryānto brāhmaṇāśca te | dhanaṃ dāsyanti te tuṣṭāḥ svasatrapariśeṣitam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the incarnation of lord Siva as Sadhu- vesadvija, that carried out the task of the gods has been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus the incarnation of lord Siva as Sadhu- vesadvija, that carried out the task of the gods has been narrated to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य पितुर्वाक्यं नभगः सत्यसारवान् । जगाम तत्र सुप्रीत्या यत्र तत्सत्रमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tadākarṇya piturvākyaṃ nabhagaḥ satyasāravān | jagāma tatra suprītyā yatra tatsatramuttamam
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this pious narrative, conducive to heaven and longevity, becomes happy and attains salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this pious narrative, conducive to heaven and longevity, becomes happy and attains salvation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदाहः कर्मणि मुने सत्रे तस्मिन्स मानवः । सूक्ते द्वे वैश्वदेवे हि प्रोवाच स्पष्टतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tadāhaḥ karmaṇi mune satre tasminsa mānavaḥ | sūkte dve vaiśvadeve hi provāca spaṣṭataḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to the incarnation of lord Siva, the great soul Asvatthaman.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to the incarnation of lord Siva, the great soul Asvatthaman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समाप्ते कर्मणि ततो विप्रा आङ्गिरसाश्च ते । तस्मै दत्त्वा ययुः स्वर्गं स्वं स्वं सत्रावशेषितम्
verses.transliteration: samāpte karmaṇi tato viprā āṅgirasāśca te | tasmai dattvā yayuḥ svargaṃ svaṃ svaṃ satrāvaśeṣitam
verses.translation: O sage, though a part of the celestial sage of great intellect Brhaspati, the self-possessed and prudent Drona was born of Bharadvaja but not of any womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, though a part of the celestial sage of great intellect Brhaspati, the self-possessed and prudent Drona was born of Bharadvaja but not of any womb.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्तदा स्वीकरिष्यन्तं सुसत्रपरिशेषितम् । विज्ञाय गिरिशः सद्य आविर्भूतः सदूतिकृत्
verses.transliteration: tattadā svīkariṣyantaṃ susatrapariśeṣitam | vijñāya giriśaḥ sadya āvirbhūtaḥ sadūtikṛt
verses.translation: Learned men knew Drona as the most excellent, skilful in the lore of archery as well as the Vedas, of varie¬ gated activities, and as one who made his race flourish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men knew Drona as the most excellent, skilful in the lore of archery as well as the Vedas, of varie¬ gated activities, and as one who made his race flourish.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरः श्रीमान्पुरुषः कृष्णदर्शनः । भावं समीक्षितुं भागं दातुं ज्ञानं परं च तत्
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgasundaraḥ śrīmānpuruṣaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaḥ | bhāvaṃ samīkṣituṃ bhāgaṃ dātuṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ ca tat
verses.translation: The most excellent brahmin Drona performed an elaborate penance with Siva in view for obtaining a son in order to help the Kauravas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent brahmin Drona performed an elaborate penance with Siva in view for obtaining a son in order to help the Kauravas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथो स शङ्करः शम्भुः परीक्षाकर ईश्वरः । उवाचोत्तरतोऽभ्येत्य नभगं तं हि मानवम्
verses.transliteration: atho sa śaṅkaraḥ śambhuḥ parīkṣākara īśvaraḥ | uvācottarato'bhyetya nabhagaṃ taṃ hi mānavam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, then the delighted lord Siva, favourably dispensed lo his devotees, appeared in front of Drona.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, then the delighted lord Siva, favourably dispensed lo his devotees, appeared in front of Drona.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । कस्त्वं गृह्णासि पुरुष ममेदं वास्तुकं वसु । प्रेषितः केन तत्सर्वं सत्यं वद ममाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | kastvaṃ gṛhṇāsi puruṣa mamedaṃ vāstukaṃ vasu | preṣitaḥ kena tatsarvaṃ satyaṃ vada mamāgrataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, the brahmin Drona whose heart was highly delighted bow'ed to him with palms joined in reverence and eulogised him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, the brahmin Drona whose heart was highly delighted bow'ed to him with palms joined in reverence and eulogised him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा तद्वचस्तात मानवो नभगः कविः । प्रत्युवाच विनीतात्मा पुरुषं कृष्णदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tacchrutvā tadvacastāta mānavo nabhagaḥ kaviḥ | pratyuvāca vinītātmā puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam
verses.translation: Satisfied and pleased with his eulogy and penance, lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees told Drona—-"Mention the boon you wish to choose".
verses.commentary: Sense: Satisfied and pleased with his eulogy and penance, lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees told Drona—-"Mention the boon you wish to choose".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । ममेदमृषिभिर्दत्तं वसु यज्ञगतं खलु । कथं वारयसे मां त्वं गृह्णतं कृष्णदर्शन
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvāca | mamedamṛṣibhirdattaṃ vasu yajñagataṃ khalu | kathaṃ vārayase māṃ tvaṃ gṛhṇataṃ kṛṣṇadarśana
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva, Drona bowed low and said—"Please give me a son born of your part who will be invincible to every one and who will be very power¬ ful.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Siva, Drona bowed low and said—"Please give me a son born of your part who will be invincible to every one and who will be very power¬ ful.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । आकर्ण्य नाभगं वाक्यमिदं सत्यमुदीरितम् । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पुरुषः कृष्णदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ākarṇya nābhagaṃ vākyamidaṃ satyamudīritam | pratyuvāca prasannātmā puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: Drona returned to his abode highly delighted and free from illusion. He joyously narrated all the details to his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drona returned to his abode highly delighted and free from illusion. He joyously narrated all the details to his wife.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णदर्शन उवाच । विवादेऽस्मिन्हि नौ तात प्रमाणं जनकस्तव । याहि तं पृच्छ स ब्रूयात्तत्प्रमाणं तु सत्यतः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇadarśana uvāca | vivāde'sminhi nau tāta pramāṇaṃ janakastava | yāhi taṃ pṛccha sa brūyāttatpramāṇaṃ tu satyataḥ
verses.translation: Taking the due opportunity, lord Siva, the anmhi- lator of all and very powerful was born as Drona's son through a part of himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the due opportunity, lord Siva, the anmhi- lator of all and very powerful was born as Drona's son through a part of himself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य नभगो मानवः कविः । आगच्छत्पितरं प्रीत्या तदुक्तं पृष्टवान्मुने
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tadākarṇya vacastasya nabhago mānavaḥ kaviḥ | āgacchatpitaraṃ prītyā taduktaṃ pṛṣṭavānmune
verses.translation: O sage, he became well known as A-Vatthaman on the earth. He was heroic, had lotus-like eyes and he could reduce the strength of his enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, he became well known as A-Vatthaman on the earth. He was heroic, had lotus-like eyes and he could reduce the strength of his enemy.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रोदितं समाकर्ण्य श्राद्धदेवः स वै मनुः । स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं प्राप्तस्मृतिरुवाच तम्
verses.transliteration: putroditaṃ samākarṇya śrāddhadevaḥ sa vai manuḥ | smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojaṃ prāptasmṛtiruvāca tam
verses.translation: Securing the permission and behest of his father that famous hero helped the Kauravas in the Mahabharata war.
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing the permission and behest of his father that famous hero helped the Kauravas in the Mahabharata war.
verses.hindi: तब उन श्राद्धदेव मनुने पुत्रकी बात सुनकर शिवजीके चरणकमलोंका स्मरण किया और बस्त स्थितिको समझकर उससे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: मनुरुवाच । हे तात शृणु मद्वाक्यं स देवः पुरुषः शिवः । तस्यैव सकलं वस्तु यज्ञप्राप्तं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: manuruvāca | he tāta śṛṇu madvākyaṃ sa devaḥ puruṣaḥ śivaḥ | tasyaiva sakalaṃ vastu yajñaprāptaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: By resorting to that powerful hero, Bhisma and other Kauravas became invincible even to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to that powerful hero, Bhisma and other Kauravas became invincible even to the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अध्वरोर्वरितं वस्तु रुद्रभागः प्रकीर्तितः । इत्यपि प्राज्ञवादो हि क्वचिज्जातस्तदिच्छया
verses.transliteration: adhvarorvaritaṃ vastu rudrabhāgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ityapi prājñavādo hi kvacijjātastadicchayā
verses.translation: Fearing him, the Pandavas, though they were gieat heroes and very skilful, became incapable of conquering the Kauravas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fearing him, the Pandavas, though they were gieat heroes and very skilful, became incapable of conquering the Kauravas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स देव ईश्वरः सर्वं वस्त्वर्हति न संशयः । यज्ञावशिष्टं किमुत परे तस्येच्छया विभोः
verses.transliteration: sa deva īśvaraḥ sarvaṃ vastvarhati na saṃśayaḥ | yajñāvaśiṣṭaṃ kimuta pare tasyecchayā vibhoḥ
verses.translation: At the instance of Krsna, Arjuna perfoimed the severe penance of Siva and obtained a dicine missile due to Siva's boon. He then conquered the Kauiavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of Krsna, Arjuna perfoimed the severe penance of Siva and obtained a dicine missile due to Siva's boon. He then conquered the Kauiavas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहार्थमायातस्तव तद्रूपतः प्रभुः । तत्र त्वं गच्छ नभग प्रसन्नं कुरु सत्यतः
verses.transliteration: anugrahārthamāyātastava tadrūpataḥ prabhuḥ | tatra tvaṃ gaccha nabhaga prasannaṃ kuru satyataḥ
verses.translation: O sage, although the great hero Avatthaman was
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, although the great hero Avatthaman was
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षमापय स्वापराधं सुप्रणम्य स्तुतिं कुरु । सर्वप्रभुः स एवेशो यज्ञाधीशोऽखिलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kṣamāpaya svāparādhaṃ supraṇamya stutiṃ kuru | sarvaprabhuḥ sa eveśo yajñādhīśo'khileśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He destroyed the sons of Pandavas though they were trained in warfare by Krsna and other great heroes. He had the strength that could not be withstood bv the enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He destroyed the sons of Pandavas though they were trained in warfare by Krsna and other great heroes. He had the strength that could not be withstood bv the enemy.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुब्रह्मादयो देवाः सिद्धाः सर्वर्षयोऽपि हि । तदनुग्रहतस्तात समर्थाः सर्वकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: viṣṇubrahmādayo devāḥ siddhāḥ sarvarṣayo'pi hi | tadanugrahatastāta samarthāḥ sarvakarmaṇi
verses.translation: On seeing Arjuna dejected by the death of his son but rushing on him along with Krsna he fled away from the battle-field.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Arjuna dejected by the death of his son but rushing on him along with Krsna he fled away from the battle-field.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किम्बहूक्त्यात्मजश्रेष्ठ गच्छ तत्राशु माचिरम् । प्रसादय महादेवं सर्वथा सकलेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kimbahūktyātmajaśreṣṭha gaccha tatrāśu māciram | prasādaya mahādevaṃ sarvathā sakaleśvaram
verses.translation: Know this to be the most powerful Brfihma missile of Asvatthaman. There is no other missile to counteract this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know this to be the most powerful Brfihma missile of Asvatthaman. There is no other missile to counteract this.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स मनुः श्राद्धदेवश्च तनयं द्रुतम् । प्रेषयामास निकटं शम्भोः सोऽपि समेत्य तम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā sa manuḥ śrāddhadevaśca tanayaṃ drutam | preṣayāmāsa nikaṭaṃ śambhoḥ so'pi sametya tam
verses.translation: Immediately think of Siva, your loul, the protector of the devotees who liad given you a weapon capable of every action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately think of Siva, your loul, the protector of the devotees who liad given you a weapon capable of every action.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नभगश्च प्रणम्याशु साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः । प्रोवाच सुप्रसन्नात्मा विनयेन महामतिः
verses.transliteration: nabhagaśca praṇamyāśu sāñjalirnatamastakaḥ | provāca suprasannātmā vinayena mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Counteract the fiery splendour of the Brahma missile with your Saiva missile. After saying this Krsna himself meditated on Siva for that purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Counteract the fiery splendour of the Brahma missile with your Saiva missile. After saying this Krsna himself meditated on Siva for that purpose.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । इदं तवेश सर्वं हि वस्तु त्रिभुवने हि यत् । इत्याह मे पिता नूनं किमुताध्वरशेषितम्
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvāca | idaṃ taveśa sarvaṃ hi vastu tribhuvane hi yat | ityāha me pitā nūnaṃ kimutādhvaraśeṣitam
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing the words of Krsna. Aijuna remembered Siva, touched water, bowed to Siva and dis¬ charged the Saiva missile.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on hearing the words of Krsna. Aijuna remembered Siva, touched water, bowed to Siva and dis¬ charged the Saiva missile.
verses.hindi: नभग बोले--हे ईश ! इन तीनों लोकोंमें जो भी वस्तु है, सब आपकी ही वस्तु है, फिर यज्ञशेष वस्तुके विषयमें कहना ही क्या--ऐसा मेरे पिताने कहा है

verses.sanskrit: अजानता मया नाथ यदुक्तं तद्वचो भ्रमात् । अपराधं त्वं क्षमस्व शिरसा त्वां प्रसादये
verses.transliteration: ajānatā mayā nātha yaduktaṃ tadvaco bhramāt | aparādhaṃ tvaṃ kṣamasva śirasā tvāṃ prasādaye
verses.translation: O great sage, although the Brahmasiras missile
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, although the Brahmasiras missile
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा नभगः सोऽतिदीनधीस्तु कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टाव तं महेशानं कृष्णदर्शनमानतः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā nabhagaḥ so'tidīnadhīstu kṛtāñjaliḥ | tuṣṭāva taṃ maheśānaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanamānataḥ
verses.translation: Do not consider this very surprising in Siva who is full of wondrous things and who, the unborn, creates, protects and annihilates the entire universe by his own power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do not consider this very surprising in Siva who is full of wondrous things and who, the unborn, creates, protects and annihilates the entire universe by his own power.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धदेवोऽपि शुद्धात्मा नतकः साञ्जलिः सुधीः । तुष्टाव तं प्रभुं नत्वा स्वापराधं क्षमापयन्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhadevo'pi śuddhātmā natakaḥ sāñjaliḥ sudhīḥ | tuṣṭāva taṃ prabhuṃ natvā svāparādhaṃ kṣamāpayan
verses.translation: O sage, knowing that this happened by the in¬ fluence of Siva, Avatthaman, born of Siva's part and delighted in heart at Siva's wish, was not at all sorry.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, knowing that this happened by the in¬ fluence of Siva, Avatthaman, born of Siva's part and delighted in heart at Siva's wish, was not at all sorry.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र विष्णुब्रह्मादयः सुराः । वासवाद्याः समाजग्मुः सिद्धाश्च मुनयोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra viṣṇubrahmādayaḥ surāḥ | vāsavādyāḥ samājagmuḥ siddhāśca munayo'pi hi
verses.translation: Then the son of Drona wishing the world to be rid of Pandava lineage desired to kill the child in the womb of Uttara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the son of Drona wishing the world to be rid of Pandava lineage desired to kill the child in the womb of Uttara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवं प्रकुर्वन्तः सुकृताञ्जलयोऽखिलाः । तुष्टुवुर्नतका भक्त्या सुप्रणम्य पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: mahotsavaṃ prakurvantaḥ sukṛtāñjalayo'khilāḥ | tuṣṭuvurnatakā bhaktyā supraṇamya pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: The powerful A4vatthaman hurled the excessively lustrous Brahma-missile that could not be countermanded by any other missile, aiming it at the womb of Uttara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful A4vatthaman hurled the excessively lustrous Brahma-missile that could not be countermanded by any other missile, aiming it at the womb of Uttara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ रुद्रः प्रसन्नात्मा कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य तान् । उवाच नभगं प्रीत्या सस्मितं कृष्णदर्शनः

verses.translation: Then Uttara the daughter-in-law of Arjuna, burning within due to that missile and agitated in the mind eu¬ logised Krsna, the lord of Laksmi.

verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇadarśana uvāca | yatte pitāvadaddharmyaṃ vākyaṃ tattu tathaiva hi | tvayāpi satyamuktaṃ tat sādhustvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his missile—the brilliant Sudari5ana, bestowed on him by Siva for his protection, he saved her at the behest of Siva.

verses.transliteration: ato'haṃ suprasanno'smi sarvathā suvratena te | dadāmi kṛpayā te hi jñānaṃ brahma sanātanam
verses.translation: Avatthaman then knew that Krsna had assumed his form at the behest of Siva and did it as he was the fore¬ most among the devotees of Siva, slowly refrained from the thought of destroying Uttara.

verses.translation: Then the leading devotee of Siva, the delighted Krsna, made all the Panavas fall at the feet of Asvat- thaman for pleasing him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the leading devotee of Siva, the delighted Krsna, made all the Panavas fall at the feet of Asvat- thaman for pleasing him.

verses.translation: Then Aiivatthaman, son of Drona, highly delighted in the mind, blessed the Panclavas and Krsna with various boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Aiivatthaman, son of Drona, highly delighted in the mind, blessed the Panclavas and Krsna with various boons.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तात भगवान्स रुद्रः सत्यवत्सलः । सर्वेषां पश्यतां तेषां तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः

verses.translation: O e.xccllent sage, incarnating thus on the earth in the form of Drona's son, lord Siva performed various sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: O e.xccllent sage, incarnating thus on the earth in the form of Drona's son, lord Siva performed various sports.

verses.translation: The incarnation in the form of AiSvatthSman of lord Siva has been explained to you. It is the cause of all Siddhis and it fulfils all desires of the devotees.

verses.transliteration: itthaṃ te kīrtito brahmannavatāraḥ śivasya hi | kṛṣṇadarśananāmā vai nabhagānandadāyakaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion or narrates it with pure mind attains all Siddhis here and attains Siya's abode hereafter.

verses.transliteration: idamākhyānamanaghaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ satām | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vāpi sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O intelligent one, listen to the incarnation of the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva as Kirata who killed Muka and delightedly granted the boon to Arjuna.

verses.translation: On hearing what he had said, O great sflge, the Pantavas were very sad and in their distress spoke to one another.

verses.transliteration: avadhūtasvarūpo'bhūnnānālīlākaraḥ prabhuḥ | digambaro mahābhīmo jvaladagnisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, I have mentioned the truth. Even in the forest misery is being inflicted on us incessantly by the wicked and the evil-minded Kauravas again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शक्रो मुनेऽपृच्छत्स्वाधिकारेण दुर्मदः । पुरुषं तं स्वमार्गान्तः स्थितमज्ञाय शङ्करम्

verses.translation: But one shall repeat the lore of Indra at the out¬ set with steady mind. For a Ksatriya of great lustre this alone is conducive to welfare.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थाने संस्थितः शम्भुः किं वान्यत्र गतोऽधुना । दर्शनार्थं हि तस्याहं गच्छामि सगुरुः सुरैः
verses.transliteration: svasthāne saṃsthitaḥ śambhuḥ kiṃ vānyatra gato'dhunā | darśanārthaṃ hi tasyāhaṃ gacchāmi saguruḥ suraiḥ
verses.translation: Hence let Atjuna repeat the lore of Indra at first, steadily. In the beginning the lord will test him and will like to be satisfied with the test.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence let Atjuna repeat the lore of Indra at first, steadily. In the beginning the lord will test him and will like to be satisfied with the test.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शक्रेणेत्थं स पृष्टश्च किञ्चिन्नोवाच पूरुषः । लीलागृहीतदेहः स शङ्करो मदहा प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | śakreṇetthaṃ sa pṛṣṭaśca kiñcinnovāca pūruṣaḥ | līlāgṛhītadehaḥ sa śaṅkaro madahā prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On coming to know that the disciples were fully satisfied Durvasas went away. By the grace of Krna, the Pandavas were freed from a difficult situation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know that the disciples were fully satisfied Durvasas went away. By the grace of Krna, the Pandavas were freed from a difficult situation.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--[हे सनत्कुमार!] इन्द्रके द्वारा इस प्रकार पूछे जानेपर लीलासे [अवधूत] देहधारी तथा अहंकारको चूर्ण करनेवाले उन पुरुषरूप प्रभु शिवने कुछ भी उत्तर नहीं दिया

verses.sanskrit: शक्रः पुनरपृच्छत्तं नोवाच स दिगम्बरः । अविज्ञातगतिः शम्भुर्महाकौतुककारकः
verses.transliteration: śakraḥ punarapṛcchattaṃ novāca sa digambaraḥ | avijñātagatiḥ śambhurmahākautukakārakaḥ
verses.translation: Then they asked Krsna "O lord, what will happen now? A very powerful enemy has arisen. What shall be done at this moment.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they asked Krsna "O lord, what will happen now? A very powerful enemy has arisen. What shall be done at this moment.'*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुरन्दरोऽपृच्छ्त् त्रैलोक्याधिपतिः स्वराट् । तूष्णीमास महायोगी महालीलाकरः स वै
verses.transliteration: punaḥ purandaro'pṛccht trailokyādhipatiḥ svarāṭ | tūṣṇīmāsa mahāyogī mahālīlākaraḥ sa vai
verses.translation: O sage, on being asked thus by the Pancja- vas, lord Krsna remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on being asked thus by the Pancja- vas, lord Krsna remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke to them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं पुनः पुनः पृष्टः शक्रेण स दिगम्बरः । नोवाच किञ्चिद्भगवान् शक्रदर्पजिघांसया
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śakreṇa sa digambaraḥ | novāca kiñcidbhagavān śakradarpajighāṃsayā
verses.translation: O excellent Pandavas, now listen to the details of my experience involving service to Siva. After hearing you shall act accordingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Pandavas, now listen to the details of my experience involving service to Siva. After hearing you shall act accordingly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ चुक्रोध देवेशस्त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यगर्वितः । उवाच वचनं क्रोधात्तं निर्भर्त्स्य जटाधरम्
verses.transliteration: atha cukrodha deveśastrailokyaiśvaryagarvitaḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ krodhāttaṃ nirbhartsya jaṭādharam
verses.translation: I went to Dvaraka to conquer my enemies. After obeying the instructions of noble Upamanyu I pro¬ pitiated lord Siva. I propitiated him for seven months in the excellent mountain Batuka.*® Thus Siva was pleased with me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I went to Dvaraka to conquer my enemies. After obeying the instructions of noble Upamanyu I pro¬ pitiated lord Siva. I propitiated him for seven months in the excellent mountain Batuka.*® Thus Siva was pleased with me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच । पृच्छमानोऽपि रे मूढ नोत्तरं दत्तवानसि । अतस्त्वां हन्मि वज्रेण कस्ते त्रातास्ति दुर्मते
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca | pṛcchamāno'pi re mūḍha nottaraṃ dattavānasi | atastvāṃ hanmi vajreṇa kaste trātāsti durmate
verses.translation: Standing there himself he fulfilled all my desires. By his power I acquired excellent efficiency in everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing there himself he fulfilled all my desires. By his power I acquired excellent efficiency in everything.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युदीर्य ततो वज्री सन्निरीक्ष्य क्रुधा हि तम् । हन्तुं दिगम्बरं वज्रमुद्यतं स चकार ह
verses.transliteration: ityudīrya tato vajrī sannirīkṣya krudhā hi tam | hantuṃ digambaraṃ vajramudyataṃ sa cakāra ha
verses.translation: The lord, the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation is propitiated by me even now. You too serve Siv:. who is the bestower of happiness to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation is propitiated by me even now. You too serve Siv:. who is the bestower of happiness to all.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वज्रहस्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा शक्रं शीघ्रं सदाशिवः । चकार स्तम्भनं तस्य वज्रपातस्य शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: vajrahastaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ śīghraṃ sadāśivaḥ | cakāra stambhanaṃ tasya vajrapātasya śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus and cheering the Pandavas, Kr?na vanished from there and remembering the lotus:cet of Siva he hastened to Dvaraka.*®
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus and cheering the Pandavas, Kr?na vanished from there and remembering the lotus:cet of Siva he hastened to Dvaraka.*®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स पुरुषः क्रुद्धः करालाक्षो भयङ्करः । द्रुतमेव प्रजज्वाल तेजसा प्रदहन्निव
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa puruṣaḥ kruddhaḥ karālākṣo bhayaṅkaraḥ | drutameva prajajvāla tejasā pradahanniva
verses.translation: Pandavas then sent a Bhilla to test the virtues and the strength of Duryodhana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pandavas then sent a Bhilla to test the virtues and the strength of Duryodhana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बाहुप्रतिष्टम्भभुवा मन्युनान्तः शचीपतिः । समदह्यत भोगीव मन्त्ररुद्धपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: bāhupratiṣṭambhabhuvā manyunāntaḥ śacīpatiḥ | samadahyata bhogīva mantraruddhaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: He understood the prosperity, rise and the virtues of Duryodhana and returned to the Pancjlavas again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He understood the prosperity, rise and the virtues of Duryodhana and returned to the Pancjlavas again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिस्त्वेनं प्रज्वलन्तं स्वतेजसा । पुरुषं तं धियामास प्रणनाम हरं द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā bṛhaspatistvenaṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā | puruṣaṃ taṃ dhiyāmāsa praṇanāma haraṃ drutam
verses.translation: What shall be done now? Where shall we go? Though we can fight now we have been restrained by the bonds of truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: What shall be done now? Where shall we go? Though we can fight now we have been restrained by the bonds of truth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा ततो गुरुरुदारधीः । दण्डवत्कौ पुनर्नत्वा प्रभुं तुष्टाव भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā tato gururudāradhīḥ | daṇḍavatkau punarnatvā prabhuṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime Vyasa came there with the ashes decorating his forehead, with Rudraksa as an orna¬ ment and well bedecked in matted hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Vyasa came there with the ashes decorating his forehead, with Rudraksa as an orna¬ ment and well bedecked in matted hair.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरुवाच । देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल । प्रसन्नो भव गौरीश सर्वेश्वर नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: gururuvāca | devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala | prasanno bhava gaurīśa sarveśvara namo'stu te
verses.translation: When they saw him they were delighted and they stood up to welcome him. Offering him a seat of deer-hide brightened by Kusa grass they waited in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they saw him they were delighted and they stood up to welcome him. Offering him a seat of deer-hide brightened by Kusa grass they waited in front of him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मायया मोहिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादयोऽपि ते । त्वां न जानन्ति तत्त्वेन जानन्ति त्वदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: māyayā mohitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇvādayo'pi te | tvāṃ na jānanti tattvena jānanti tvadanugrahāt
verses.translation: *'0 holy lord, by seeing you, we are all satisfied. We have attained the fruits of our austerities and our diverse charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: *'0 holy lord, by seeing you, we are all satisfied. We have attained the fruits of our austerities and our diverse charitable gifts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । बृहस्पतिरिति स्तुत्वा स तदा शङ्करं प्रभुम् । पादयोः पातयामास तस्येशस्य पुरन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | bṛhaspatiriti stutvā sa tadā śaṅkaraṃ prabhum | pādayoḥ pātayāmāsa tasyeśasya purandaram
verses.translation: O grandfather, by seeing you, all our misery has disappeared, the misery that had been inflicted on us by the wicked people of ruthless activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: O grandfather, by seeing you, all our misery has disappeared, the misery that had been inflicted on us by the wicked people of ruthless activities.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तात सुराचार्यः कृताञ्जलिरुदारधीः । बृहस्पतिरुवाचेदं प्रश्रयावनतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tatastāta surācāryaḥ kṛtāñjalirudāradhīḥ | bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ praśrayāvanataḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: Misery disappears at your sight. Was there ever a time when it did not disappear? We know it truly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Misery disappears at your sight. Was there ever a time when it did not disappear? We know it truly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच । दीनानाथ महादेव प्रणतं तव पादयोः । समुद्धर च मां तत्त्वं क्रोधं न प्रणयं कुरु
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca | dīnānātha mahādeva praṇataṃ tava pādayoḥ | samuddhara ca māṃ tattvaṃ krodhaṃ na praṇayaṃ kuru
verses.translation: When a person reaches the hermitage of a sage
verses.commentary: Sense: When a person reaches the hermitage of a sage
verses.hindi: बृहस्पति बोले--हे दीननाथ! हे महादेव! मैं आपके चरणोंमें पड़ा हूँ, आप मेरा और इनका उद्धार कीजिये; क्रोध नहीं, बल्कि प्रेम कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो भव महादेव पाहीन्द्रं शरणागतम् । वह्निरेष समायाति भालनेत्रसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo bhava mahādeva pāhīndraṃ śaraṇāgatam | vahnireṣa samāyāti bhālanetrasamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Poverty, the cause of misery, will surely be dis¬ pelled. Such is the nature of great men. In the fulfilment of desires they are equal to the wish-yielding Kalpa tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: Poverty, the cause of misery, will surely be dis¬ pelled. Such is the nature of great men. In the fulfilment of desires they are equal to the wish-yielding Kalpa tree.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य गुरोर्वाक्यमवधूताकृतिः प्रभुः । उवाच करुणासिन्धुर्विहसन् स सदूतिकृत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityākarṇya gurorvākyamavadhūtākṛtiḥ prabhuḥ | uvāca karuṇāsindhurvihasan sa sadūtikṛt
verses.translation: Thus the qualities of the great shall be observed
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the qualities of the great shall be observed
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--देवगुरुका यह वचन सुनकर अवधूत आकृतिवाले, करुणासिन्धु, उत्तम लीला करनेवाले उन प्रभुने हँसते हुए कहा--

verses.sanskrit: अवधूत उवाच । क्रोधाच्च निस्सृतं तेजो धारयामि स्वनेत्रतः । कथं हि कञ्चुकीं सर्पः सन्धत्ते चोज्झितां पुनः
verses.transliteration: avadhūta uvāca | krodhācca nissṛtaṃ tejo dhārayāmi svanetrataḥ | kathaṃ hi kañcukīṃ sarpaḥ sandhatte cojjhitāṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The difference between the small and the great
verses.commentary: Sense: The difference between the small and the great
verses.hindi: अवधूत बोले--मैं क्रोधके कारण अपने नेत्रसे निकले हुए तेजको किस प्रकार धारण करूँ? क्या सर्प कंचुकीका त्याग करनेके उपरान्त पुनः उसे धारण कर सकता है

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शङ्करस्य बृहस्पतिः । उवाच साञ्जलिर्भूयो भयव्याकुलमानसः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasya śaṅkarasya bṛhaspatiḥ | uvāca sāñjalirbhūyo bhayavyākulamānasaḥ
verses.translation: By your mere arrival our minds are satisfied. Give us instructions whereby our misery can be dispelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: By your mere arrival our minds are satisfied. Give us instructions whereby our misery can be dispelled.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच । हे देव भगवन्भक्ता अनुकम्प्याः सदैव हि । भक्तवत्सलनामेति स्वं सत्यं कुरु शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca | he deva bhagavanbhaktā anukampyāḥ sadaiva hi | bhaktavatsalanāmeti svaṃ satyaṃ kuru śaṅkara
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the Pandavas the great sage Vyasa was delighted in the mind and said thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the Pandavas the great sage Vyasa was delighted in the mind and said thus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेप्तुमन्यत्र देवेश स्वतेजोऽत्युग्रमर्हसि । उद्धर्ता सर्वभक्तानां समुद्धर पुरन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: kṣeptumanyatra deveśa svatejo'tyugramarhasi | uddhartā sarvabhaktānāṃ samuddhara purandaram
verses.translation: O Pandavas, you need not be over-anxious. You are all blessed and contented. You have not let truth slip by.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pandavas, you need not be over-anxious. You are all blessed and contented. You have not let truth slip by.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो गुरुणा रुद्रो भक्तवत्सलनामभाक् । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा सुरेज्यं प्रणतार्तिहा
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityukto guruṇā rudro bhaktavatsalanāmabhāk | pratyuvāca prasannātmā surejyaṃ praṇatārtihā
verses.translation: The noble nature of the good remains unchanged even at death. They do not forsake virtue. They fruitfully resort to Truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The noble nature of the good remains unchanged even at death. They do not forsake virtue. They fruitfully resort to Truth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्र उवाच । प्रीतस्तेऽहं सुराचार्य ददामि वरमुत्तमम् । इन्द्रस्य जीवदानेन जीवेति त्वं प्रथां व्रज
verses.transliteration: rudra uvāca | prītaste'haṃ surācārya dadāmi varamuttamam | indrasya jīvadānena jīveti tvaṃ prathāṃ vraja
verses.translation: As far as we are concerned, you and the Kauravas ought to be equal. Still our partiality is towards the virtuous. This partiality is approved by the learned.
verses.commentary: Sense: As far as we are concerned, you and the Kauravas ought to be equal. Still our partiality is towards the virtuous. This partiality is approved by the learned.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्भूतोऽनलो योऽयं भालनेत्रात्सुरासहः । एनं त्यक्ष्याम्यहं दूरे यथेन्द्रं नैव पीडयेत्
verses.transliteration: samudbhūto'nalo yo'yaṃ bhālanetrātsurāsahaḥ | enaṃ tyakṣyāmyahaṃ dūre yathendraṃ naiva pīḍayet
verses.translation: Undoubtedly you and they arc his sons when your real father is dead. You are noble souls and hence you deserve to be viewed sympathetically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly you and they arc his sons when your real father is dead. You are noble souls and hence you deserve to be viewed sympathetically.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स करे धृत्वा स्वतेजोऽनलमद्भुतम् । भालनेत्रसमुद्भूतं प्राक्षिपल्लवणाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā sa kare dhṛtvā svatejo'nalamadbhutam | bhālanetrasamudbhūtaṃ prākṣipallavaṇāmbhasi
verses.translation: Whatever has happened cannot be otherwise. He is wicked while all of you are virtuous and truthful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever has happened cannot be otherwise. He is wicked while all of you are virtuous and truthful.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथो शिवस्य तत्तेजो भालनेत्रसमुद्भवम् । क्षिप्तं च लवणाम्भोधौ सद्यो बालो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: atho śivasya tattejo bhālanetrasamudbhavam | kṣiptaṃ ca lavaṇāmbhodhau sadyo bālo babhūva ha
verses.translation: Hence evil will befall only him in the end, to be sure. The seed that has been sown will germinate into a sprout.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence evil will befall only him in the end, to be sure. The seed that has been sown will germinate into a sprout.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स जलन्धरनामाभूत्सिन्धुपुत्रोऽसुरेश्वरः । तं जघान महेशानो देवप्रार्थनया प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sa jalandharanāmābhūtsindhuputro'sureśvaraḥ | taṃ jaghāna maheśāno devaprārthanayā prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Hence you need not feel distressed at all. Welfare will dawn on you. You need not entertain any doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence you need not feel distressed at all. Welfare will dawn on you. You need not entertain any doubt.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं कृत्वा सुचरितं शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः । अवधूतस्वरूपेण ततश्चान्तर्हितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ kṛtvā sucaritaṃ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ | avadhūtasvarūpeṇa tataścāntarhito'bhavat
verses.translation: Thus the paQ(javas were consoled and cheered by Vyasa. Yudhi$thira and others then spoke these woitls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the paQ(javas were consoled and cheered by Vyasa. Yudhi$thira and others then spoke these woitls.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुः सकला देवाः सुखिनश्चातिनिर्भयाः । गुरुशक्रौ भयान्मुक्तौ जग्मतुः सुखमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: babhūvuḥ sakalā devāḥ sukhinaścātinirbhayāḥ | guruśakrau bhayānmuktau jagmatuḥ sukhamuttamam
verses.translation: O holy lord, please dispel our distress. Something auspicious shall be bestowed upon us. We have been advised by Kfsna that Siva shall be propitiated always.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, please dispel our distress. Something auspicious shall be bestowed upon us. We have been advised by Kfsna that Siva shall be propitiated always.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थे गमनोद्युक्तौ दर्शनं प्राप्य तस्य तौ । कृतार्थौ गुरुशक्रौ हि स्वस्थानं जग्मतुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: yadarthe gamanodyuktau darśanaṃ prāpya tasya tau | kṛtārthau guruśakrau hi svasthānaṃ jagmaturmudā
verses.translation: We have committed a blunder in not following his advice. May divine lead be given to us again now.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have committed a blunder in not following his advice. May divine lead be given to us again now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अवधूतेश्वराह्वोऽवतारस्ते कथितो मया । परमेशस्य परमानन्ददः खलदण्डदः
verses.transliteration: avadhūteśvarāhvo'vatāraste kathito mayā | parameśasya paramānandadaḥ khaladaṇḍadaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the delighted Vyasa, remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke to the Pandavas with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words, the delighted Vyasa, remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke to the Pandavas with pleasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं यशस्यं स्वर्ग्यमेव च । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: idamākhyānamanaghaṃ yaśasyaṃ svargyameva ca | bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O Pandavas, of virtuous mind, listen to my words. It has been truly stated by Kr$na. Siva is being served by me too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pandavas, of virtuous mind, listen to my words. It has been truly stated by Kr$na. Siva is being served by me too.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवगतिं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā so'nte śivagatiṃ labhet
verses.translation: Let him be served by you with pleasure. Un¬ equalled happiness shall always follow. It is only by not serving Siva that miseries crop up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him be served by you with pleasure. Un¬ equalled happiness shall always follow. It is only by not serving Siva that miseries crop up.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The great sage gave him the rules of procedure for a king. The liberal-minded Vyasa thus spoke to Arjuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sage gave him the rules of procedure for a king. The liberal-minded Vyasa thus spoke to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: The great sage gave him the rules of procedure for a king. The liberal-minded Vyasa thus spoke to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । भिक्षुवर्याह्वशिवावतार चरित्रवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ वक्ष्ये मुनिश्रेष्ठ शम्भोः शृण्ववतारकम् । स्वभक्तदयया विप्र नारीसन्देहभञ्जकम्

verses.translation: O Arjuna, start from here and go this way to the beautiful mountain Indrakila.* There standing beside the river Ganga perform the penance well.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Arjuna, start from here and go this way to the beautiful mountain Indrakila.* There standing beside the river Ganga perform the penance well.

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्सत्यरथो नाम्ना विदर्भविषये नृपः । धर्मात्मा सत्यशीलश्च महाशैवजनप्रियः
verses.transliteration: āsītsatyaratho nāmnā vidarbhaviṣaye nṛpaḥ | dharmātmā satyaśīlaśca mahāśaivajanapriyaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sage, remaining there they spoke to one another. Listen. "Even in misery, if there is a meeting with beloved persons it lessens sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, remaining there they spoke to one another. Listen. "Even in misery, if there is a meeting with beloved persons it lessens sorrow.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य राज्ञः सुधर्मेण महीं पालयतो मुने । महान्कालो व्यतीयाय सुखेन शिवधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: tasya rājñaḥ sudharmeṇa mahīṃ pālayato mune | mahānkālo vyatīyāya sukhena śivadharmataḥ
verses.translation: Harilcandra, son of Trisahku and ki of the solar race, had to suffer at the hands of the relentless sage VisvUmitra to whom he gave away his kingdom, son, wife, life and everything as the sacrificial gift.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harilcandra, son of Trisahku and ki of the solar race, had to suffer at the hands of the relentless sage VisvUmitra to whom he gave away his kingdom, son, wife, life and everything as the sacrificial gift.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्तस्य राज्ञस्तु शाल्वैश्च पुररोधिभिः । महान् रणो बभूवाथ बहुसैन्यैर्बलोद्धतैः
verses.transliteration: kadācittasya rājñastu śālvaiśca purarodhibhiḥ | mahān raṇo babhūvātha bahusainyairbaloddhataiḥ
verses.translation: We are scorched by his splendour and have come near you. We have told you the details. Please do what is proper.
verses.commentary: Sense: We are scorched by his splendour and have come near you. We have told you the details. Please do what is proper.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स विदर्भनृपः कृत्वा सार्धं तैर्दारुणं रणम् । प्रनष्टोरुबलः शाल्वैर्निहतो दैवयोगतः
verses.transliteration: sa vidarbhanṛpaḥ kṛtvā sārdhaṃ tairdāruṇaṃ raṇam | pranaṣṭorubalaḥ śālvairnihato daivayogataḥ
verses.translation: Avatthaman, son of Droria and a part of Rudra, is extremely invincible. But they can be withstood through me. Listen to what is wholesome to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Avatthaman, son of Droria and a part of Rudra, is extremely invincible. But they can be withstood through me. Listen to what is wholesome to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नृपे हते युद्धे शाल्वैस्तु भयविह्वलाः । सैनिका हतशेषाश्च मन्त्रिभिः सह दुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration: tasminnṛpe hate yuddhe śālvaistu bhayavihvalāḥ | sainikā hataśeṣāśca mantribhiḥ saha dudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Like a great sage, he stood on the sole of a single foot. He fixed one of his eyes at the sun and stood repeating the mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a great sage, he stood on the sole of a single foot. He fixed one of his eyes at the sun and stood repeating the mantra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.translation: I remember the words of my preceptor now—"O king, a person causing misery shall be killed by • you by all means. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: I remember the words of my preceptor now—"O king, a person causing misery shall be killed by • you by all means. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गता शोकसन्तप्ता सा राजमहिषी शनैः । प्राचीं दिशं ययौ दूरं स्मरन्तीशपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: nirgatā śokasantaptā sā rājamahiṣī śanaiḥ | prācīṃ diśaṃ yayau dūraṃ smarantīśapadāmbujam
verses.translation: He can convert poison into nectar and nectar
verses.commentary: Sense: He can convert poison into nectar and nectar
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रभाते सा राज्ञी ददर्श विमलं सरः । अतीता दूरमध्वानं दयया शङ्करस्य हि
verses.transliteration: atha prabhāte sā rājñī dadarśa vimalaṃ saraḥ | atītā dūramadhvānaṃ dayayā śaṅkarasya hi
verses.translation: Devotees of yore and future devotees must keep their mind steady after considering all those aspects whether one is in affluent circumstances or not, whether death is imminent or not or whether people praise or censure. Misery is quelled. 8iva is always the bestower of happiness through the merit and sin of individuals. Sometimes 8iva makes us miserable in order to test us.
verses.wordMeaning: Devotees of yore and future devotees must keep their mind steady after considering all those aspects whether one is in affluent circumstances or not, whether death is imminent or not or whether people praise or censure. Misery is quelled.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devotees of yore and future devotees must keep their mind steady after considering all those aspects whether one is in affluent circumstances or not, whether death is imminent or not or whether people praise or censure. Misery is quelled.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य प्रिया राज्ञः सन्तप्ता सुकुमारिणी । निवासार्थं सरस्तीरे छायावृक्षमुपाश्रयत्
verses.transliteration: tatrāgatya priyā rājñaḥ santaptā sukumāriṇī | nivāsārthaṃ sarastīre chāyāvṛkṣamupāśrayat
verses.translation: The invisible lore will be beneficial to you. He gave him the blessings thus. The sage then spoke to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The invisible lore will be beneficial to you. He gave him the blessings thus. The sage then spoke to all.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दैववशाद्राज्ञी मुहूर्त्ते सद्गुणान्विते । असूत तनयं दिव्यं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra daivavaśādrājñī muhūrtte sadguṇānvite | asūta tanayaṃ divyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
verses.translation: May all the excellent kings stand by virtue. The
verses.commentary: Sense: May all the excellent kings stand by virtue. The
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तज्जननी दैवात्तृषिताति नृपाङ्गना । सरोऽवतीर्णा पानार्थं ग्रस्ता ग्राहेण पाथसि
verses.transliteration: atha tajjananī daivāttṛṣitāti nṛpāṅganā | saro'vatīrṇā pānārthaṃ grastā grāheṇa pāthasi
verses.translation: Blessing the Pandavas thus and remembering the lotus-like feet of Siva, the great sage Vyasa vanished in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blessing the Pandavas thus and remembering the lotus-like feet of Siva, the great sage Vyasa vanished in a moment.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स सुतो जातमात्रस्तु क्षुत्पिपासार्दितो भृशम् । रुरोद च सरस्तीरे विनष्टपितृमातृकः
verses.transliteration: sa suto jātamātrastu kṣutpipāsārdito bhṛśam | ruroda ca sarastīre vinaṣṭapitṛmātṛkaḥ
verses.translation: Arjuna then appeared very brilliant and lustrous assuming unequalled splendour by means of Siva mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arjuna then appeared very brilliant and lustrous assuming unequalled splendour by means of Siva mantra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्वने क्रन्दमाने जातमात्रे सुते मुने । कृपान्वितो महेशोऽभूदन्तर्यामी स रक्षकः
verses.transliteration: tasminvane krandamāne jātamātre sute mune | kṛpānvito maheśo'bhūdantaryāmī sa rakṣakaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Arjuna the Pandavas were convinced. "Surely success will be ours, since Arjuna has achieved an extensive splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Arjuna the Pandavas were convinced. "Surely success will be ours, since Arjuna has achieved an extensive splendour.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रेरिता मनसा काचिदीशेन त्रासहारिणा । अकस्मादागता तत्र भ्रमन्ती भैक्ष्यजीविनी
verses.transliteration: preritā manasā kācidīśena trāsahāriṇā | akasmādāgatā tatra bhramantī bhaikṣyajīvinī
verses.translation: The task can be achieved only by you and not by anyone else. It appears so through the words of Vyasa. Make your life fruitful."
verses.commentary: Sense: The task can be achieved only by you and not by anyone else. It appears so through the words of Vyasa. Make your life fruitful."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वेकहायनं बालं वहन्ती विधवा निजम् । अनाथमेकं क्रन्दन्तं शिशुं तत्र ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: sā tvekahāyanaṃ bālaṃ vahantī vidhavā nijam | anāthamekaṃ krandantaṃ śiśuṃ tatra dadarśa ha
verses.translation: After saying this, all of them, dejected by the im¬ pending separation, reluctantly bade farewell to Arjuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, all of them, dejected by the im¬ pending separation, reluctantly bade farewell to Arjuna.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा दृष्ट्वा तत्र तं बालं वने निर्मनुजे मुने । विस्मिताति द्विजस्त्री सा चिचिन्त हृदये बहु
verses.transliteration: sā dṛṣṭvā tatra taṃ bālaṃ vane nirmanuje mune | vismitāti dvijastrī sā cicinta hṛdaye bahu
verses.translation: The grief-stricken, chaste DraupadI, controlling her tears, bade farewell to Arjuna and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grief-stricken, chaste DraupadI, controlling her tears, bade farewell to Arjuna and said.
verses.hindi: हे मुने! उस बालकको निर्जन वनमें देखकर वह ब्राह्मणी अत्यन्त आश्चर्यचकित हो अपने हृदयमें बहुत विचार करने लगी

verses.sanskrit: अहो सुमहदाश्चर्यमिदं दृष्टं मयाधुना । असम्भाव्यमकथ्यं च सर्वथा मनसा गिरा
verses.transliteration: aho sumahadāścaryamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayādhunā | asambhāvyamakathyaṃ ca sarvathā manasā girā
verses.translation: O king, you shall strenuously act according to the instructions of Vyasa. May your path be auspicious. May iiva be the benefactor.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, you shall strenuously act according to the instructions of Vyasa. May your path be auspicious. May iiva be the benefactor.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अच्छिन्ननाभिनालोऽयं रसायां केवलं शिशुः । शेते मातृविहीनश्च क्रन्दंस्तेजस्विनां वरः
verses.transliteration: acchinnanābhinālo'yaṃ rasāyāṃ kevalaṃ śiśuḥ | śete mātṛvihīnaśca krandaṃstejasvināṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: After bidding farewell to Arjuna lovingly all those five, remained there, highly distressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bidding farewell to Arjuna lovingly all those five, remained there, highly distressed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य पित्रादयः केऽपि न सन्तीह सहायिनः । कारणं किं बभूवाथ ह्यहो दैवबलं महत्
verses.transliteration: asya pitrādayaḥ ke'pi na santīha sahāyinaḥ | kāraṇaṃ kiṃ babhūvātha hyaho daivabalaṃ mahat
verses.translation: O great sage, while the Pandavas were thus in grief, the excellent sage Vyasa, the ocean of mercy, arrived there.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, while the Pandavas were thus in grief, the excellent sage Vyasa, the ocean of mercy, arrived there.
verses.hindi: यहाँ तो इसकी सहायता करनेवाले इसके माता- पिता आदि कोई नहीं हैं, इसमें क्या कारण हो सकता है, अहो, दैवबल बड़ा प्रबल है

verses.sanskrit: न जाने कस्य पुत्रोऽयमस्य ज्ञातात्र कोऽपि न । यतः पृच्छाम्यस्य जन्म जाता च करुणा मयि
verses.transliteration: na jāne kasya putro'yamasya jñātātra ko'pi na | yataḥ pṛcchāmyasya janma jātā ca karuṇā mayi
verses.translation: The Pandavas honoured and bowed to him with respect after offering him a seat. In their misery they joined their palms in reverence and spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pandavas honoured and bowed to him with respect after offering him a seat. In their misery they joined their palms in reverence and spoke.
verses.hindi: यह न जाने किसका पुत्र है, इसे जाननेवाला भी यहाँ कोई नहीं है, जिससे इसके जन्मके विषयमें मैं पूछूँ। मुझे तो इसपर बहुत ही दया आ रही है

verses.sanskrit: इच्छाम्येनं पोषितुं हि बालमौरसपुत्रवत् । संस्प्रष्टुं नोत्सहेऽज्ञात्वा कुलजन्मादि चास्य वै
verses.transliteration: icchāmyenaṃ poṣituṃ hi bālamaurasaputravat | saṃspraṣṭuṃ notsahe'jñātvā kulajanmādi cāsya vai
verses.translation: O holy lord, O excellent sage, we are burning in grief but on seeing you we derive consolation and pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, O excellent sage, we are burning in grief but on seeing you we derive consolation and pleasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति सञ्चिन्त्यमानायां तस्यां विप्रवरस्त्रियाम् । कृपां चकार महतीं शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti sañcintyamānāyāṃ tasyāṃ vipravarastriyām | kṛpāṃ cakāra mahatīṃ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, O brahmin sage, please stay here for sometime and dispel our grief. By your very sight our miseries are dispelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, O brahmin sage, please stay here for sometime and dispel our grief. By your very sight our miseries are dispelled.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दध्रे भिक्षुस्वरूपं हि महालीलो महेश्वरः । सर्वथा भक्तसुखदो निरुपाधिः स्वयं सदा
verses.transliteration: dadhre bhikṣusvarūpaṃ hi mahālīlo maheśvaraḥ | sarvathā bhaktasukhado nirupādhiḥ svayaṃ sadā
verses.translation: Thus requested, the excellent sage stayed there for their happiness, dispelling their grief by narrating various legends.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, the excellent sage stayed there for their happiness, dispelling their grief by narrating various legends.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्राजगाम सहसा स भिक्षुः परमेश्वरः । यत्रास्ति सन्देहवती द्विजस्त्री ज्ञातुमिच्छती
verses.transliteration: tatrājagāma sahasā sa bhikṣuḥ parameśvaraḥ | yatrāsti sandehavatī dvijastrī jñātumicchatī
verses.translation: O good sage, in the course of conversation pursued w'ith Vyasa, Yudhisthira bowed to him humbly and spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: O good sage, in the course of conversation pursued w'ith Vyasa, Yudhisthira bowed to him humbly and spoke.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्यस्वरूपोऽसावविज्ञातगतिः प्रभुः । तामाह विप्रवनितां विहस्य करुणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuvaryasvarūpo'sāvavijñātagatiḥ prabhuḥ | tāmāha vipravanitāṃ vihasya karuṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sage, listen. I seek for the alleviation of our grief. O intelligent one, 1 am putting this humble * question. O lord, you shall kindly explain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, listen. I seek for the alleviation of our grief. O intelligent one, 1 am putting this humble * question. O lord, you shall kindly explain.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्य उवाच । सन्देहं कुरु नो चित्ते विप्रभामिनि मा खिद । रक्षैनं बालकं प्रीत्या सुपवित्रं स्वपुत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuvarya uvāca | sandehaṃ kuru no citte viprabhāmini mā khida | rakṣainaṃ bālakaṃ prītyā supavitraṃ svaputrakam
verses.translation: Has anyone formerly suffered this sort of grief? Verily we alone have had it. None else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Has anyone formerly suffered this sort of grief? Verily we alone have had it. None else.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन शिशुना श्रेयः प्राप्स्यसे न चिरात्परम् । पुष्णीहि सर्वथा ह्येनं महातेजस्विनं शिशुम्
verses.transliteration: anena śiśunā śreyaḥ prāpsyase na cirātparam | puṣṇīhi sarvathā hyenaṃ mahātejasvinaṃ śiśum
verses.translation: Formerly, Nala,®* the king of Ni?adha, the noble soul, had experienced a misery more than yours.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Nala,®* the king of Ni?adha, the noble soul, had experienced a misery more than yours.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तवन्तं तं भिक्षुस्वरूपं करुणानिधिम् । सा विप्रवनिता शम्भुं प्रीत्या पप्रच्छ सादरम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktavantaṃ taṃ bhikṣusvarūpaṃ karuṇānidhim | sā vipravanitā śambhuṃ prītyā papraccha sādaram
verses.translation: A great calamity and distress befell king Harican- dra.*3 It cannot be adequately described. It makes others too distressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great calamity and distress befell king Harican- dra.*3 It cannot be adequately described. It makes others too distressed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विप्रवनितोवाच । त्वदाज्ञयैनं बालं हि रक्षिष्यामि स्वपुत्रवत् । पोक्ष्यामि नात्र सन्देहो मद्भाग्यात्त्वमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: vipravanitovāca | tvadājñayainaṃ bālaṃ hi rakṣiṣyāmi svaputravat | pokṣyāmi nātra sandeho madbhāgyāttvamihāgataḥ
verses.translation: O Panglavas, even Rama** had to suffer that misery on hearing which men and women would be greatly affected.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Panglavas, even Rama** had to suffer that misery on hearing which men and women would be greatly affected.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथापि ज्ञातुमिच्छामि विशेषेण तु तत्त्वतः । कोऽयं कस्य सुतश्चायं कस्त्वमत्र समागतः
verses.transliteration: tathāpi jñātumicchāmi viśeṣeṇa tu tattvataḥ | ko'yaṃ kasya sutaścāyaṃ kastvamatra samāgataḥ
verses.translation: When days come and go, when burdens of tasks are born in plenty, the life nears its end everyday. But man does not realize it.
verses.commentary: Sense: When days come and go, when burdens of tasks are born in plenty, the life nears its end everyday. But man does not realize it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुहुर्मम समायाति ज्ञानं भिक्षुवर प्रभो । त्वं शिवः करुणासिन्धुस्त्वद्भक्तोऽयं शिशुः पुरा
verses.transliteration: muhurmama samāyāti jñānaṃ bhikṣuvara prabho | tvaṃ śivaḥ karuṇāsindhustvadbhakto'yaṃ śiśuḥ purā
verses.translation: Thus the brothers spent their time by various talks, discussions and schemes of all sorts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the brothers spent their time by various talks, discussions and schemes of all sorts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: केनचित्कर्मदोषेण सम्प्राप्तोऽयं दशामिमाम् । तद्भुक्त्वा परमं श्रेयः प्राप्स्यते त्वदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: kenacitkarmadoṣeṇa samprāpto'yaṃ daśāmimām | tadbhuktvā paramaṃ śreyaḥ prāpsyate tvadanugrahāt
verses.translation: He assumed dress and features according to his instructions. He curbed his sense organs and the mind and stood steady.
verses.commentary: Sense: He assumed dress and features according to his instructions. He curbed his sense organs and the mind and stood steady.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वन्माययैव साहं वै मार्गभ्रष्टा विमोहिता । आगता प्रेषिता त्वत्तो ह्यस्य रक्षणहेतुतः
verses.transliteration: tvanmāyayaiva sāhaṃ vai mārgabhraṣṭā vimohitā | āgatā preṣitā tvatto hyasya rakṣaṇahetutaḥ
verses.translation: RSma, son of Daiaratha, had to roam into the lorest for fourteen years owing to the jealousy of Kaikcyi who urged her husband Dasaratha to install her son Bharata and to send Rama into exile.
verses.commentary: Sense: RSma, son of Daiaratha, had to roam into the lorest for fourteen years owing to the jealousy of Kaikcyi who urged her husband Dasaratha to install her son Bharata and to send Rama into exile.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तद्दर्शनप्राप्तविज्ञानां विप्रकामिनीम् । ज्ञातुकामां विशेषेण प्रोचे भिक्षुतनुः शिवः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti taddarśanaprāptavijñānāṃ viprakāminīm | jñātukāmāṃ viśeṣeṇa proce bhikṣutanuḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: In the Vedas Dasyus are represented as the aboriginal tribes¬ men who contended with the immigrant Aryans and were overpowered by the latter. In the Pur&nas the term Dasyu means a barbarian, a robber or an outcaste.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Vedas Dasyus are represented as the aboriginal tribes¬ men who contended with the immigrant Aryans and were overpowered by the latter. In the Pur&nas the term Dasyu means a barbarian, a robber or an outcaste.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--शिवजीके दर्शनसे ज्ञानको प्राप्त हुई तथा विशेषरूपसे जाननेकी इच्छावाली उस ब्राह्मणीसे भिक्षुरूपधारी शिवने कहा--

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्य उवाच । शृणु प्रीत्या विप्रपत्नि बालस्यास्य पुरेहितम् । सर्वमन्यस्य सुप्रीत्या वक्ष्यते तत्त्वतोऽनघे
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuvarya uvāca | śṛṇu prītyā viprapatni bālasyāsya purehitam | sarvamanyasya suprītyā vakṣyate tattvato'naghe
verses.translation: He made a clay idol of Siva even and beautiful. In front of it he stood in meditation on the excellent heap of splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made a clay idol of Siva even and beautiful. In front of it he stood in meditation on the excellent heap of splendour.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुतो विदर्भराजस्य शिवभक्तस्य धीमतः । अयं सत्यरथस्यैव स्वधर्मनिरतस्य हि
verses.transliteration: suto vidarbharājasya śivabhaktasya dhīmataḥ | ayaṃ satyarathasyaiva svadharmaniratasya hi
verses.translation: He took baths thrice a day. He performed various sorts of worship. He performed the Upasti form of worship of Siva again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He took baths thrice a day. He performed various sorts of worship. He performed the Upasti form of worship of Siva again and again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शृणु सत्यरथो राजा हतः शाल्वे रणे परैः । तत्पत्नी निशि सुव्यग्रा निर्ययौ स्वगृहाद् द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu satyaratho rājā hataḥ śālve raṇe paraiḥ | tatpatnī niśi suvyagrā niryayau svagṛhād drutam
verses.translation: Indra's spies saw the splendour-column coming out of his head. They were frightened by it. They thought within themselves—"When did he come in? Indra must be informed." Saying so they went to Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra's spies saw the splendour-column coming out of his head. They were frightened by it. They thought within themselves—"When did he come in? Indra must be informed." Saying so they went to Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असूत तनयं चैनं समायाता प्रगेऽत्र हि । सरोऽवतीर्णा तृषया ग्रस्ता ग्राहेण दैवतः
verses.transliteration: asūta tanayaṃ cainaṃ samāyātā prage'tra hi | saro'vatīrṇā tṛṣayā grastā grāheṇa daivataḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, we do not know who it is. Some one is performing a penance in the forest, a god, a sage, the sun or the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, we do not know who it is. Some one is performing a penance in the forest, a god, a sage, the sun or the fire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्य समुत्पत्तिं तत्पितुः सङ्गरे मृतिम् । तन्मातृमरणं ग्राहात्सर्वं तस्यै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti tasya samutpattiṃ tatpituḥ saṅgare mṛtim | tanmātṛmaraṇaṃ grāhātsarvaṃ tasyai nyavedayat
verses.translation: Thus informed by the spies, Indra, the enemy of mountains, understood whatever his son Arjuna desired to do. He dismissed them and decided to go there to test him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus informed by the spies, Indra, the enemy of mountains, understood whatever his son Arjuna desired to do. He dismissed them and decided to go there to test him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा ब्राह्मणी चैव विस्मिताति मुनीश्वर । पुनः पप्रच्छ तं भिक्षुं ज्ञानिनं सिद्धरूपकम्
verses.transliteration: atha sā brāhmaṇī caiva vismitāti munīśvara | punaḥ papraccha taṃ bhikṣuṃ jñāninaṃ siddharūpakam
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, Indra, the lord of!§aci, as¬ sumed the form of an elderly brahmin bachelor and went there to test him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, Indra, the lord of!§aci, as¬ sumed the form of an elderly brahmin bachelor and went there to test him.
verses.hindi: हे मुनीश्वर ! तब वह ब्राह्मणी अत्यन्त विस्मित हुई और उसने ज्ञानी तथा सिद्धस्वरूप उन भिक्षुकसे पुनः पूछा--

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्युवाच । स राजोऽस्य पिता भिक्षो वरभोगान्तरैव हि । कस्माच्छाल्वैः स्वरिपुभिः स्वल्पेहैश्च विघातितः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇyuvāca | sa rājo'sya pitā bhikṣo varabhogāntaraiva hi | kasmācchālvaiḥ svaripubhiḥ svalpehaiśca vighātitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him come, Arjuna worshipped him. After eulogising him he stood in front of him and said— "Whence do you come now? Please tell me"
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him come, Arjuna worshipped him. After eulogising him he stood in front of him and said— "Whence do you come now? Please tell me"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्मादस्य शिशोर्माता ग्राहेणाशु सुभक्षिता । यस्मादनाथोऽयं जातो विबन्धुश्चैव जन्मतः
verses.transliteration: kasmādasya śiśormātā grāheṇāśu subhakṣitā | yasmādanātho'yaṃ jāto vibandhuścaiva janmataḥ
verses.translation: The lord of gods thus requested by him spoke with a hint at testing his courage, out of love.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of gods thus requested by him spoke with a hint at testing his courage, out of love.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्मात्सुतो ममापीह सुदरिद्रो हि भिक्षुकः । भवेत्कथं सुखं भिक्षो पुत्रयोरनयोर्वद
verses.transliteration: kasmātsuto mamāpīha sudaridro hi bhikṣukaḥ | bhavetkathaṃ sukhaṃ bhikṣo putrayoranayorvada
verses.translation: O dear, why do you perform the penance in your prime of youth? Is it for salvation or for victory? In every respect this penance of yours is useless.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, why do you perform the penance in your prime of youth? Is it for salvation or for victory? In every respect this penance of yours is useless.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा स भिक्षुः परमेश्वरः । विप्रपत्न्याः प्रसन्नात्मा प्रोवाच विहसँश्च ताम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhikṣuḥ parameśvaraḥ | viprapatnyāḥ prasannātmā provāca vihasam̐śca tām
verses.translation: Thus questioned by him he informed him of every¬ thing. On hearing that the brahmin spoke again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus questioned by him he informed him of every¬ thing. On hearing that the brahmin spoke again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्य उवाच । विप्रपत्नि विशेषेण सर्वप्रश्नान्वदामि ते । शृणु त्वं सावधानेन चरित्रमिदमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuvarya uvāca | viprapatni viśeṣeṇa sarvapraśnānvadāmi te | śṛṇu tvaṃ sāvadhānena caritramidamuttamam
verses.translation: O bachelor, go hence. Do you wish to cause my downfall? Of what use is this to you a bachelor?
verses.commentary: Sense: O bachelor, go hence. Do you wish to cause my downfall? Of what use is this to you a bachelor?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अमुष्य बालस्य पिता स विदर्भमहीपतिः । पूर्वजन्मनि पाण्ड्योऽसौ बभूव नृपसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: amuṣya bālasya pitā sa vidarbhamahīpatiḥ | pūrvajanmani pāṇḍyo'sau babhūva nṛpasattamaḥ
verses.translation: *'0 dear, O Arjuna of great intellect, choose your boon, whatever you wish in your mind. There is nothing which cannot be given to you.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: *'0 dear, O Arjuna of great intellect, choose your boon, whatever you wish in your mind. There is nothing which cannot be given to you.'*
verses.hindi: विदर्भ देशका राजा, जो इस बालकका पिता था वह पूर्वजन्ममें पाण्ड्य देशका श्रेष्ठ राजा था

verses.sanskrit: स शैवनृपतिर्धर्मात्पालयन्निखिलां महीम् । स्वप्रजां रञ्जयामास सर्वोपद्रवनाशनः
verses.transliteration: sa śaivanṛpatirdharmātpālayannikhilāṃ mahīm | svaprajāṃ rañjayāmāsa sarvopadravanāśanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Indra, Arjuna replied "O father, bless me with victory. I am afflicted by enemies in every respect."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Indra, Arjuna replied "O father, bless me with victory. I am afflicted by enemies in every respect."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्स हि सर्वेशं प्रदोषे पर्यपूजयत् । त्रयोदश्यां निराहारो दिवानक्तव्रती शिवम्
verses.transliteration: kadācitsa hi sarveśaṃ pradoṣe paryapūjayat | trayodaśyāṃ nirāhāro divānaktavratī śivam
verses.translation: Your enemies, Duryodhana and others arc very powerful. Drona, Bhlma, Kara and others arc certainly invincible.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your enemies, Duryodhana and others arc very powerful. Drona, Bhlma, Kara and others arc certainly invincible.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पूजयतः शम्भुं प्रदोषे गिरिशं रते । महान् शब्दो बभूवाथ विकटः सर्वथा पुरे
verses.transliteration: tasya pūjayataḥ śambhuṃ pradoṣe giriśaṃ rate | mahān śabdo babhūvātha vikaṭaḥ sarvathā pure
verses.translation: I, Brahma and others, Vinu the bestower of boons and those who crave for victory are the devotees of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: I, Brahma and others, Vinu the bestower of boons and those who crave for victory are the devotees of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमाकर्ण्य रवं सोऽथ राजा त्यक्तशिवार्चनः । रिप्वागमनशङ्कातो निर्ययौ भवनाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: tamākarṇya ravaṃ so'tha rājā tyaktaśivārcanaḥ | ripvāgamanaśaṅkāto niryayau bhavanād bahiḥ
verses.translation: Now onwards leave that mantra and worship Siva with devotion through the rules laid down for the worship of his clay phallic image and by contemplating on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now onwards leave that mantra and worship Siva with devotion through the rules laid down for the worship of his clay phallic image and by contemplating on him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तस्यामात्यो महाबली । गृहीतशत्रुसामन्तो राजान्तिकमुपाययौ
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu tasyāmātyo mahābalī | gṛhītaśatrusāmanto rājāntikamupāyayau
verses.translation: O Bharata, by your devotional feelings and modes of service, you worship Siva. Your achievement will be unshakable. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bharata, by your devotional feelings and modes of service, you worship Siva. Your achievement will be unshakable. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
