verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुसामन्तं महाक्रोधेन विह्वलः । अविचार्य वृषन्तस्य शिरश्छेदमकारयत्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā śatrusāmantaṃ mahākrodhena vihvalaḥ | avicārya vṛṣantasya śiraśchedamakārayat
verses.translation: After saying this he called out his spies and said— "All of you shall be cautious and attentive in protecting him always. "
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this he called out his spies and said— "All of you shall be cautious and attentive in protecting him always. "
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असमाप्येशपूजां तामशुचिर्नष्टधीर्नृपः । रात्रौ चकार सुप्रीत्या भोजनं नष्टमङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: asamāpyeśapūjāṃ tāmaśucirnaṣṭadhīrnṛpaḥ | rātrau cakāra suprītyā bhojanaṃ naṣṭamaṅgalaḥ
verses.translation: Thus alerting his spies for the protection to be accorded to Arjuna, Indra spoke again to Arjuna with his.'eart full of fondness and afl'ection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus alerting his spies for the protection to be accorded to Arjuna, Indra spoke again to Arjuna with his.'eart full of fondness and afl'ection.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विदर्भे सोऽभवद्राजा जन्मनीह शिवव्रती । शिवार्चनान्तरायेण परैर्भोगान्तरे हतः
verses.transliteration: vidarbhe so'bhavadrājā janmanīha śivavratī | śivārcanāntarāyeṇa parairbhogāntare hataḥ
verses.translation: O Gentle one, O terrifier of enemies, you shall not commit blunders in the administration of your kingdom. This mantra will be conducive to your glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Gentle one, O terrifier of enemies, you shall not commit blunders in the administration of your kingdom. This mantra will be conducive to your glory.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पिता यः पूर्वभवे सोऽस्मिञ्जन्मनि तत्सुतः । अयमेव हतैश्वर्यः शिवपूजाव्यतिक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tatpitā yaḥ pūrvabhave so'smiñjanmani tatsutaḥ | ayameva hataiśvaryaḥ śivapūjāvyatikramāt
verses.translation: Always courage shall be maintained by an aspirant. Siva the protector will give you riches and the fruits of your desire. This is undoubtedly true.
verses.commentary: Sense: Always courage shall be maintained by an aspirant. Siva the protector will give you riches and the fruits of your desire. This is undoubtedly true.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य माता पूर्वभवे सपत्नीं छद्मनाहरत् । भक्षिता तेन पापेन ग्राहेणास्मिन् भवे हि सा
verses.transliteration: asya mātā pūrvabhave sapatnīṃ chadmanāharat | bhakṣitā tena pāpena grāheṇāsmin bhave hi sā
verses.translation: After giving the boon to Arjuna, the lord of gods remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and went to his abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving the boon to Arjuna, the lord of gods remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and went to his abode.
verses.hindi: इसकी माताने पूर्वजन्ममें अपनी सौतको छलसे मरवा दिया था, उस पापसे इस जन्ममें उसे ग्राहने निगल लिया

verses.sanskrit: एषा प्रवृत्तिरेतेषां भवत्यै परिकीर्तिता । अनर्चितशिवा भक्त्या प्राप्नुवन्ति दरिद्रताम्
verses.transliteration: eṣā pravṛttireteṣāṃ bhavatyai parikīrtitā | anarcitaśivā bhaktyā prāpnuvanti daridratām
verses.translation: The heroic Arjuna bowing to the lord of gods, performed the penance with controlled mind with Siva as his goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Arjuna bowing to the lord of gods, performed the penance with controlled mind with Siva as his goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एष ते तनयः पूर्वजन्मनि ब्राह्मणोत्तमः । प्रतिग्रहैर्वयो निन्ये न यज्ञाद्यैः सुकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: eṣa te tanayaḥ pūrvajanmani brāhmaṇottamaḥ | pratigrahairvayo ninye na yajñādyaiḥ sukarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: He performed the ablution duly, and the Nyasa (the mystic placing of fingers etc.) in accordance with the Gastric injunctions. He performed the meditation of Siva with great devotion in the manner explained by Vyasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the ablution duly, and the Nyasa (the mystic placing of fingers etc.) in accordance with the Gastric injunctions. He performed the meditation of Siva with great devotion in the manner explained by Vyasa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतो दारिद्र्यमापन्नः पुत्रस्ते द्विजभामिनि । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं शरणं शङ्करं व्रज
verses.transliteration: ato dāridryamāpannaḥ putraste dvijabhāmini | taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vraja
verses.translation: Repeating the five-syllabled mantra of Siva the most excellent of all the mantras and mentally remembering Siva with pleasure he performed the penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating the five-syllabled mantra of Siva the most excellent of all the mantras and mentally remembering Siva with pleasure he performed the penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एताभ्यां खलु बालाभ्यां शिवपूजा विधीयताम् । उपवीतानन्तरं हि शिवः श्रेयः करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: etābhyāṃ khalu bālābhyāṃ śivapūjā vidhīyatām | upavītānantaraṃ hi śivaḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati
verses.translation: After saying this the gods eulogised him in different ways. Fixing their eyes to his feet they stood there in agony.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the gods eulogised him in different ways. Fixing their eyes to his feet they stood there in agony.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तामुपदिश्याथ भिक्षुवर्यतनुः शिवः । स्वरूपं दर्शयामास परमं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | iti tāmupadiśyātha bhikṣuvaryatanuḥ śivaḥ | svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa paramaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their words the lord of benevolent mind, the delighted Siva laughingly spoke thus to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words the lord of benevolent mind, the delighted Siva laughingly spoke thus to the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा विप्रवनिता ज्ञात्वा तं शङ्करं प्रभुम् । सुप्रणम्य हि तुष्टाव प्रेम्णा गद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration: atha sā vipravanitā jñātvā taṃ śaṅkaraṃ prabhum | supraṇamya hi tuṣṭāva premṇā gadgadayā girā
verses.translation: O gods, you go to your abodcj. Undoubtedly I shall carry out your task in every respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, you go to your abodcj. Undoubtedly I shall carry out your task in every respect.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् शम्भुर्धृतभिक्षुतनुर्द्रुतम् । पश्यन्त्या विप्रपन्त्यास्तु तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān śambhurdhṛtabhikṣutanurdrutam | paśyantyā viprapantyāstu tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Siva, they became as¬ sured. They therefore returned to their abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of Siva, they became as¬ sured. They therefore returned to their abodes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मिन् गते भिक्षौ विश्रब्धा ब्राह्मणी च सा । तमर्भकं समादाय सस्वपुत्रा गृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration: atha tasmin gate bhikṣau viśrabdhā brāhmaṇī ca sā | tamarbhakaṃ samādāya sasvaputrā gṛhaṃ yayau
verses.translation: He may be one of those come here to wreak ven¬ geance. Or he may be some friend of Duryodhana acting for his welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: He may be one of those come here to wreak ven¬ geance. Or he may be some friend of Duryodhana acting for his welfare.
verses.hindi: भिक्षुकके चले जानेपर ब्राह्मणीको विश्वास हो गया और उस लड़केको लेकर वह अपने पुत्रसहित घर चली गयी

verses.sanskrit: एकचक्राह्वये रम्ये ग्राम्ये कृतनिकेतना । स्वपुत्रं राजपुत्रं च वरान्नैश्च व्यवर्धयत्
verses.transliteration: ekacakrāhvaye ramye grāmye kṛtaniketanā | svaputraṃ rājaputraṃ ca varānnaiśca vyavardhayat
verses.translation: The conduct declares the family, the body declares the diet, the mode of speech declares the amount of learning and the eye indicates the affection.
verses.commentary: Sense: The conduct declares the family, the body declares the diet, the mode of speech declares the amount of learning and the eye indicates the affection.
verses.hindi: एकचक्रा नामक रमणीय ग्राममें निवास करती हुई वह ब्राह्मणी उत्तम अन्नोंसे अपने पुत्र तथा राजपुत्रका पालन करने लगी

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः कृतसंस्कारौ कृतोपनयनौ च तौ । ववृधाते स्वगेहे च शिवपूजनतत्परौ
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtasaṃskārau kṛtopanayanau ca tau | vavṛdhāte svagehe ca śivapūjanatatparau
verses.translation: The battle between Arjuna and.iva disguised as Kirata over the possession of an arrow that killed the t)oar, as described in Chs, 39, 40, 41 here, forms the main theme of Bharavi's Kiiatarjunlya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The battle between Arjuna and.iva disguised as Kirata over the possession of an arrow that killed the t)oar, as described in Chs, 39, 40, 41 here, forms the main theme of Bharavi's Kiiatarjunlya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तौ शाण्डिल्यमुनेस्तात निदेशान्नियमस्थितौ । प्रदोषे चक्रतुः शम्भोः पूजां कृत्वा व्रतं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tau śāṇḍilyamunestāta nideśānniyamasthitau | pradoṣe cakratuḥ śambhoḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ śubham
verses.translation: Cp. Pafleatantra I. 44.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cp. Pafleatantra I. 44.
verses.hindi: हे तात! वे दोनों ही शाण्डिल्य मुनिकी आज्ञासे नियममें तत्पर होकर शुभ व्रत करके प्रदोषकालमें शिवजीका पूजन करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद् द्विजपुत्रेण विनासौ राजनन्दनः । नद्यां स्नातुं गतः प्राप निधानकलशं वरम्
verses.transliteration: kadācid dvijaputreṇa vināsau rājanandanaḥ | nadyāṃ snātuṃ gataḥ prāpa nidhānakalaśaṃ varam
verses.translation: In regard to him my sense-organs are excited. He must be an enemy. Undoubtedly he shall be killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: In regard to him my sense-organs are excited. He must be an enemy. Undoubtedly he shall be killed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं पूजयतोः शम्भुं राजद्विजकुमारयोः । सुखेनैव व्यतीयाय तयोर्मासचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pūjayatoḥ śambhuṃ rājadvijakumārayoḥ | sukhenaiva vyatīyāya tayormāsacatuṣṭayam
verses.translation: In the meantime, Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees, assumed the wonderful form of an efficient hunter and came there along with his Ganas in order to slay that Daitya, to protect Arjuna as well as to test his devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees, assumed the wonderful form of an efficient hunter and came there along with his Ganas in order to slay that Daitya, to protect Arjuna as well as to test his devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमर्चयतोः शम्भुं भूयोऽपि परया मुदा । सम्वत्सरो व्यतीयाय तस्मिन्नेव तयोर्गृहे
verses.transliteration: evamarcayatoḥ śambhuṃ bhūyo'pi parayā mudā | samvatsaro vyatīyāya tasminneva tayorgṛhe
verses.translation: The hunter had tucked up his lion-cloth and folded up I§iva*s banner. His body was lined with the white ash. He held a bow and arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hunter had tucked up his lion-cloth and folded up I§iva*s banner. His body was lined with the white ash. He held a bow and arrows.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्वत्सरे व्यतिक्रान्ते स राजतनयो मुने । गत्वा वनान्ते विप्रेण शिवस्यानुग्रहाद्विभोः
verses.transliteration: samvatsare vyatikrānte sa rājatanayo mune | gatvā vanānte vipreṇa śivasyānugrahādvibhoḥ
verses.translation: He carried the quiver suspended over his back. The Ganas too assumed the form of hunters. Siva too became the chief of Bhillas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He carried the quiver suspended over his back. The Ganas too assumed the form of hunters. Siva too became the chief of Bhillas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मादागतां तत्र दत्तां तज्जनकेन ह । विवाह्य गन्धर्वसुतां चक्रे राज्यमकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: akasmādāgatāṃ tatra dattāṃ tajjanakena ha | vivāhya gandharvasutāṃ cakre rājyamakaṇṭakam
verses.translation: The Commander-in-Ghief started various sounds. The grunting sound of the boar too spread over the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Commander-in-Ghief started various sounds. The grunting sound of the boar too spread over the quarters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: या विप्रवनिता पूर्वं तमपुष्णात्स्वपुत्रवत् । सैव माताभवत्तस्य स भ्राता द्विजनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: yā vipravanitā pūrvaṃ tamapuṣṇātsvaputravat | saiva mātābhavattasya sa bhrātā dvijanandanaḥ
verses.translation: Vya too has mentioned and the gods too. Siva is mentioned as the benefactor. Siva is the cause of happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vya too has mentioned and the gods too. Siva is mentioned as the benefactor. Siva is the cause of happiness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमाराध्य देवेशं धर्मगुप्ताह्वयः स वै । विदर्भविषये राज्ञ्या तया भोगं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: itthamārādhya deveśaṃ dharmaguptāhvayaḥ sa vai | vidarbhaviṣaye rājñyā tayā bhogaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: Vya too has mentioned and the gods too. Siva is mentioned as the benefactor. Siva is the cause of happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vya too has mentioned and the gods too. Siva is mentioned as the benefactor. Siva is the cause of happiness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्यावतारस्ते वर्णितश्च मयाधुना । शिवस्य धर्मगुप्ताह्वनृपबालसुखप्रदः
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuvaryāvatāraste varṇitaśca mayādhunā | śivasya dharmaguptāhvanṛpabālasukhapradaḥ
verses.translation: Even in dreams, misery does not befall those who worship him with devotion. If it happens at all, it is due to their previous activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even in dreams, misery does not befall those who worship him with devotion. If it happens at all, it is due to their previous activities.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतदाख्यानमनघं पवित्रं पावनं महत् । धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां साधनं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: etadākhyānamanaghaṃ pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ mahat | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: That must happen whether big or small. The fault is particularly that of the action that has begun to fructify.
verses.commentary: Sense: That must happen whether big or small. The fault is particularly that of the action that has begun to fructify.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य एतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्कामान् सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: ya etacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | sa bhuktvehākhilānkāmān so'nte śivapuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Or iva may dispel the misery by his will, after one has experienced the fruits of one's action big or small.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or iva may dispel the misery by his will, after one has experienced the fruits of one's action big or small.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: In order to protect Arjuna, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, came there closely pursuing the boar. Between the two the animal rushed on and then halted. A wonderful horn was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to protect Arjuna, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, came there closely pursuing the boar. Between the two the animal rushed on and then halted. A wonderful horn was seen.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: In order to protect Arjuna, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, came there closely pursuing the boar. Between the two the animal rushed on and then halted. A wonderful horn was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to protect Arjuna, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, came there closely pursuing the boar. Between the two the animal rushed on and then halted. A wonderful horn was seen.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । सुरेश्वरावतारस्ते धौम्याग्रजहितावहम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ 3.32. dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | nandīśvara uvāca | śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi śivasya paramātmanaḥ | sureśvarāvatāraste dhaumyāgrajahitāvaham
verses.translation: Then both of them discharged the arrow. Siva's arrow hit the tail, Arjuna's arrow hit the snout.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then both of them discharged the arrow. Siva's arrow hit the tail, Arjuna's arrow hit the snout.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रपादसुतो धीमानुपमन्युः सतां प्रियः । जन्मान्तरेण संसिद्धः प्राप्तो मुनिकुमारताम्
verses.transliteration: vyāghrapādasuto dhīmānupamanyuḥ satāṃ priyaḥ | janmāntareṇa saṃsiddhaḥ prāpto munikumāratām
verses.translation: O forest-roamer, what do you say without under¬ standing? You are a fool. This arrow had been discharged by me just now. How can it be yours?
verses.commentary: Sense: O forest-roamer, what do you say without under¬ standing? You are a fool. This arrow had been discharged by me just now. How can it be yours?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उवास मातुलगृहे स मात्रा शिशुरेव हि । उपमन्युर्व्याघ्रपादिः स्याद्दरिद्रश्च दैवतः
verses.transliteration: uvāsa mātulagṛhe sa mātrā śiśureva hi | upamanyurvyāghrapādiḥ syāddaridraśca daivataḥ
verses.translation: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. Your words are not true. O forest*wanderer, I know you. You are true to the caste in which you are born.
verses.commentary: Sense: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. Your words are not true. O forest*wanderer, I know you. You are true to the caste in which you are born.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्क्षीरमत्यल्पं पीतवान्मातुलाश्रमे । ययाचे मातरं प्रीत्या बहुशो दुग्धलालसः
verses.transliteration: kadācitkṣīramatyalpaṃ pītavānmātulāśrame | yayāce mātaraṃ prītyā bahuśo dugdhalālasaḥ
verses.translation: You have heard my words. You shall see my strength now. O Bhilla, return to your master. Do as vou pleas#*.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have heard my words. You shall see my strength now. O Bhilla, return to your master. Do as vou pleas#*.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचनं तन्माता च तपस्विनी । सान्तः प्रविश्याथ तदा शुभोपायमरीरचत्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā putravacanaṃ tanmātā ca tapasvinī | sāntaḥ praviśyātha tadā śubhopāyamarīracat
verses.translation: Lord f>iva, a Kirata, heard the message and approached Arjuna along with his army.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord f>iva, a Kirata, heard the message and approached Arjuna along with his army.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उञ्छवृत्त्यर्जितान्बीजान्पिष्ट्वालोड्य जलेन तान् । उपलाल्य सुतं तस्मै सा ददौ कृत्रिमं पयः
verses.transliteration: uñchavṛttyarjitānbījānpiṣṭvāloḍya jalena tān | upalālya sutaṃ tasmai sā dadau kṛtrimaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: Then Arjuna came to the ground, remembered the lous-like feet of Siva and caught hold of his feet deriving sufficient strength, thanks to his meditation on Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Arjuna came to the ground, remembered the lous-like feet of Siva and caught hold of his feet deriving sufficient strength, thanks to his meditation on Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं दुग्धं मात्रा दत्तं स बालकः । नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चारुदत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: pītvā ca kṛtrimaṃ dugdhaṃ mātrā dattaṃ sa bālakaḥ | naitatkṣīramiti prāha mātaraṃ cārudatpunaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and lifting Arjuna with his own hands, the lord rid him of his bashfulness through his own lordly qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and lifting Arjuna with his own hands, the lord rid him of his bashfulness through his own lordly qualities.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सुतस्य रुदितं प्राह सा दुःखिता सुतम् । सम्मार्ज्य नेत्रे पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sutasya ruditaṃ prāha sā duḥkhitā sutam | sammārjya netre putrasya karābhyāṃ kamalākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: O ten-armed one, Obeisance to you the great soul. Obeisance to you holding the drum and the skull in your hands. Obeisance to you, the one wearing a garland of skulls.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ten-armed one, Obeisance to you the great soul. Obeisance to you holding the drum and the skull in your hands. Obeisance to you, the one wearing a garland of skulls.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मातोवाच । क्षीरमत्र कुतोऽस्माकं वने निवसतां सदा । प्रसादेन विना शम्भोः पयः प्राप्तिर्भवेन्न हि
verses.transliteration: mātovāca | kṣīramatra kuto'smākaṃ vane nivasatāṃ sadā | prasādena vinā śambhoḥ payaḥ prāptirbhavenna hi
verses.translation: Obeisance to you with the body refulgent like pure crystal and pure camphpr, obeisance to you with the Pinaka in your hand, obeisance to the bearer of the excellent Trident.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you with the body refulgent like pure crystal and pure camphpr, obeisance to you with the Pinaka in your hand, obeisance to the bearer of the excellent Trident.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मनि यत्कृत्यं शिवमुद्दिश्य हे सुत । तदेव लभ्यते नूनं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: pūrvajanmani yatkṛtyaṃ śivamuddiśya he suta | tadeva labhyate nūnaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Siva's arrow hit the tail and stopped at the snout. It struck the ground and entered it. Arjuna's arrow pierced through the body. It came out of the tail and fell at its side. The boar who was a Daitya fell dead on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva's arrow hit the tail and stopped at the snout. It struck the ground and entered it. Arjuna's arrow pierced through the body. It came out of the tail and fell at its side. The boar who was a Daitya fell dead on the ground.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति मातृवचः श्रुत्वा व्याघ्रपादिः स बालकः । प्रत्युवाच विशोकात्मा मातरं मातृवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: iti mātṛvacaḥ śrutvā vyāghrapādiḥ sa bālakaḥ | pratyuvāca viśokātmā mātaraṃ mātṛvatsalaḥ
verses.translation: The gods were much delighted. They showered flowers. Bowing down and eulogising they cried shouts of victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods were much delighted. They showered flowers. Bowing down and eulogising they cried shouts of victory.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शोकेनालमिमं मातः शम्भुर्यद्यस्ति शङ्करः । त्यज शोकं महाभागे सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: śokenālamimaṃ mātaḥ śambhuryadyasti śaṅkaraḥ | tyaja śokaṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On seeing the cruel form of the Daitya, Siva was glad and Arjuna was happy.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the cruel form of the Daitya, Siva was glad and Arjuna was happy.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शृणु मातर्वचो मेऽद्य महादेवोऽस्ति चेत्क्वचित् । चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu mātarvaco me'dya mahādevo'sti cetkvacit | cirādvā hyacirādvāpi kṣīrodaṃ sādhayāmyaham
verses.translation: With an excessively happy mind Arjuna said— ''O this is a huge Daitya. He had assumed this wonderful form and had come here to kill me. But I have been saved by Siva. Lord Siva has given me keen intelligence. There is no doubt in this."
verses.commentary: Sense: With an excessively happy mind Arjuna said— ''O this is a huge Daitya. He had assumed this wonderful form and had come here to kill me. But I have been saved by Siva. Lord Siva has given me keen intelligence. There is no doubt in this."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स शिशुः प्रीत्या शिवं मेऽस्त्वित्युदीर्य च । विसृज्य तां सुप्रणम्य तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | ityuktvā sa śiśuḥ prītyā śivaṃ me'stvityudīrya ca | visṛjya tāṃ supraṇamya tapaḥ kartuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: After thinking thus Arjuna repeated Siva's name. He bowed to Siva and eulogised him again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus Arjuna repeated Siva's name. He bowed to Siva and eulogised him again and again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्पर्वतगतः वायुभक्षः समाहितः । अष्टेष्टकाभिः प्रासादं कृत्वा लिङ्गं च मृन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: himavatparvatagataḥ vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ | aṣṭeṣṭakābhiḥ prāsādaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca mṛnmayam
verses.translation: O omni*'cient Sanatkumara, listen to the sport of the great soul Siva full of affection for the devotee and to the test of its stability.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omni*'cient Sanatkumara, listen to the sport of the great soul Siva full of affection for the devotee and to the test of its stability.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रावाह्य शिवं साम्बं भक्त्या पञ्चाक्षरेण ह । पत्रपुष्पादिभिर्वन्यैः समानर्च शिशुः स वै
verses.transliteration: tatrāvāhya śivaṃ sāmbaṃ bhaktyā pañcākṣareṇa ha | patrapuṣpādibhirvanyaiḥ samānarca śiśuḥ sa vai
verses.translation: Siva immediately sent his attendant to fetch the arrow. The Arjuna too came there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva immediately sent his attendant to fetch the arrow. The Arjuna too came there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा शिवं च तं साम्बं जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् । समभ्यर्च्य चिरं कालं चचार परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: dhyātvā śivaṃ ca taṃ sāmbaṃ japanpañcākṣaraṃ manum | samabhyarcya ciraṃ kālaṃ cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: The Gana and Arjuna reached the place simultane¬ ously for the arrow. Arjuna rebuked him and took up his arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gana and Arjuna reached the place simultane¬ ously for the arrow. Arjuna rebuked him and took up his arrow.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तस्य बालस्य ह्युपमन्योर्महात्मनः । चराचरं च भुवनं प्रदीपितमभून्मुने
verses.transliteration: tapasā tasya bālasya hyupamanyormahātmanaḥ | carācaraṃ ca bhuvanaṃ pradīpitamabhūnmune
verses.translation: The Gaa said—excellent sage, why do you take this arrow? The arrow is mine. Leave it off."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gaa said—excellent sage, why do you take this arrow? The arrow is mine. Leave it off."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शम्भुर्विष्ण्वाद्यैः प्रार्थितः प्रभुः । परीक्षितुं च तद्भक्तिं शक्ररूपोऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare śambhurviṣṇvādyaiḥ prārthitaḥ prabhuḥ | parīkṣituṃ ca tadbhaktiṃ śakrarūpo'bhavattadā
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thus addressed by the Gana of the Bhilla, Arjuna remembered Siva and spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, thus addressed by the Gana of the Bhilla, Arjuna remembered Siva and spoke.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवा शचीस्वरूपाभूद्गणाः सर्वेऽभवन्सुराः । ऐरावतगजो नन्दी सर्वमेव च तन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: śivā śacīsvarūpābhūdgaṇāḥ sarve'bhavansurāḥ | airāvatagajo nandī sarvameva ca tanmayam
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the leader of the Ganas laughed and spoke to Arjuna who was in the garb of a sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the leader of the Ganas laughed and spoke to Arjuna who was in the garb of a sage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः साम्बः शिवः शक्रस्वरूपः सगणो द्रुतम् । जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुमुपमन्योस्तदाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sāmbaḥ śivaḥ śakrasvarūpaḥ sagaṇo drutam | jagāmānugrahaṃ kartumupamanyostadāśramam
verses.translation: O sage, listen. You arc a sage in disguise. You are not a true sage. You do not perform penance. People are being deceived by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, listen. You arc a sage in disguise. You are not a true sage. You do not perform penance. People are being deceived by you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षितुं च तद्भक्तिं शक्ररूपधरो हरः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा बालकं तं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: parīkṣituṃ ca tadbhaktiṃ śakrarūpadharo haraḥ | prāha gambhīrayā vācā bālakaṃ taṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: How can a saint utter a lie? Do not take me to be single-handed. Know me to be the commander-in-chief.
verses.commentary: Sense: How can a saint utter a lie? Do not take me to be single-handed. Know me to be the commander-in-chief.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरेश्वर उवाच । तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वरं ब्रूहि तपसानेन सुव्रत । ददामि चेच्छितान्कामान् सर्वान्नात्रास्ति संशयः
verses.transliteration: sureśvara uvāca | tuṣṭo'smi te varaṃ brūhi tapasānena suvrata | dadāmi cecchitānkāmān sarvānnātrāsti saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, why do you wish to lose the fruit of your penance? Truly have I heard that penance is marrfcd
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, why do you wish to lose the fruit of your penance? Truly have I heard that penance is marrfcd
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स वै तेन शक्ररूपेण शम्भुना । वरयामि शिवे भक्तिमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa vai tena śakrarūpeṇa śambhunā | varayāmi śive bhaktimityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: If you do not give up this arrow you will be an ungrateful fellow. It was certainly to save you that my master discharged this arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you do not give up this arrow you will be an ungrateful fellow. It was certainly to save you that my master discharged this arrow.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्निशम्य हरिः प्राह मां न जानासि लेखपम् । त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tanniśamya hariḥ prāha māṃ na jānāsi lekhapam | trailokyādhipatiṃ śakraṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: Your enemy has been killed by him and you have kept the arrow to yourself. Very ungrateful indeed arc you. You are making your own penance fruitless.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your enemy has been killed by him and you have kept the arrow to yourself. Very ungrateful indeed arc you. You are making your own penance fruitless.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तो भव विप्रर्षे मामेवार्चय सर्वदा । ददामि सर्वं भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: madbhakto bhava viprarṣe māmevārcaya sarvadā | dadāmi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ te tyaja rudraṃ ca nirguṇam
verses.translation: You do not speak the truth. What you wish to gfain thereby? If you have any need for the arrow, you may approach my master and request him.
verses.commentary: Sense: You do not speak the truth. What you wish to gfain thereby? If you have any need for the arrow, you may approach my master and request him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रेण निर्गुणेनालं किं ते कार्यं भविष्यति । देवजातिबहिर्भूतो यः पिशाचत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: rudreṇa nirguṇenālaṃ kiṃ te kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati | devajātibahirbhūto yaḥ piśācatvamāgataḥ
verses.translation: He can give you many similar arrows. My master is here. Why don't you request him?
verses.commentary: Sense: He can give you many similar arrows. My master is here. Why don't you request him?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा स मुनेः पुत्रो जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् । मन्यमानो धर्मविघ्नं प्राह तं कर्तुमागतम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | tacchrutvā sa muneḥ putro japanpañcākṣaraṃ manum | manyamāno dharmavighnaṃ prāha taṃ kartumāgatam
verses.translation: Unmindful of his hc'p to you, you wish him harm. This does not behove you. Eschew this fickleness.'
verses.commentary: Sense: Unmindful of his hc'p to you, you wish him harm. This does not behove you. Eschew this fickleness.'
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । त्वयैवं कथितं सर्वं भवनिन्दारतेन वै । प्रसङ्गाद्देवदेवस्य निर्गुणत्वं पिशाचता
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | tvayaivaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhavanindāratena vai | prasaṅgāddevadevasya nirguṇatvaṃ piśācatā
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Arjuna, son of Pftha, was angry. After remembering Iiva, he spoke these measured words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Arjuna, son of Pftha, was angry. After remembering Iiva, he spoke these measured words.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न जानासि वै रुद्रं सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरम् । ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जनकं प्रकृतेः परम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ na jānāsi vai rudraṃ sarvadeveśvareśvaram | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ janakaṃ prakṛteḥ param
verses.translation: I am a king. You are a thief. How can a war be pursued? I must fight with people equal in strength to me, never with base people.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am a king. You are a thief. How can a war be pursued? I must fight with people equal in strength to me, never with base people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सदसद् वयक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः । नित्यमेकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sadasad vayaktamavyaktaṃ yamāhurbrahmavādinaḥ | nityamekamanekaṃ ca varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham
verses.translation: Your master will be only like you. We are the benevolent donors and you the forest-dwellers, thieves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your master will be only like you. We are the benevolent donors and you the forest-dwellers, thieves.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हेतुवादविनिर्मुक्तं साङ्ख्ययोगार्थदं परम् । यमुशन्ति हि तत्त्वज्ञा वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: hetuvādavinirmuktaṃ sāṅkhyayogārthadaṃ param | yamuśanti hi tattvajñā varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham
verses.translation: How can the king of foresters be requested by me now? O forest-wanderer, why don't you beg the arrow of me?
verses.commentary: Sense: How can the king of foresters be requested by me now? O forest-wanderer, why don't you beg the arrow of me?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति शम्भोः परं तत्त्वं सर्वकारणकारणत् । ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवानां श्रेष्ठो गुणपराद्विभोः
verses.transliteration: nāsti śambhoḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇat | brahmaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ śreṣṭho guṇaparādvibhoḥ
verses.translation: I shall readily give you the arrows. Certainly I have many. If a king docs not give what is taken, your objection may come up.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall readily give you the arrows. Certainly I have many. If a king docs not give what is taken, your objection may come up.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाहं वृणे वरं त्वत्तो न विष्णोर्ब्रह्मणोऽपि वा । नान्यस्मादमराद्वापि शङ्करो वरदोऽस्तु मे
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvatto na viṣṇorbrahmaṇo'pi vā | nānyasmādamarādvāpi śaṅkaro varado'stu me
verses.translation: Why should there be a long talk? Let your master come and fight with me. Defeating me in the battle,
verses.commentary: Sense: Why should there be a long talk? Let your master come and fight with me. Defeating me in the battle,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन वच्मि तत्त्वं मतं स्वकम् । न प्रार्थये पशुपतेरन्यं देवादिकं स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena vacmi tattvaṃ mataṃ svakam | na prārthaye paśupateranyaṃ devādikaṃ sphuṭam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Arjuna who derived his strength from the mercy of lord Siva the forester spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Arjuna who derived his strength from the mercy of lord Siva the forester spoke these words.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मद्भावं शृणु गोत्रारे मयाद्यानुमितं त्विदम् । भवान्तरे कृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य चेत्
verses.transliteration: madbhāvaṃ śṛṇu gotrāre mayādyānumitaṃ tvidam | bhavāntare kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrutā nindā bhavasya cet
verses.translation: You are ignorant. You are not a sage. Why do you invite death? Give up the arrow and stay here happily or you will come ito grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are ignorant. You are not a sage. Why do you invite death? Give up the arrow and stay here happily or you will come ito grief.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव सन्त्यजेत् । स्वदेहं तन्निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śrutvā nindāṃ bhavasyātha tatkṣaṇādeva santyajet | svadehaṃ tannihatyāśu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Thus challenged by the forester who derived his strength from Siva and who was a Gana, Arjuna, son of Pandu remembered!§iva and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus challenged by the forester who derived his strength from Siva and who was a Gana, Arjuna, son of Pandu remembered!§iva and said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आस्तां तावन्ममेच्छेयं क्षीरं प्रति सुराधम । निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतत्कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: āstāṃ tāvanmameccheyaṃ kṣīraṃ prati surādhama | nihatya tvāṃ śivāstreṇa tyajāmyetatkalevaram
verses.translation: O forester, listen attentively to my words. If your master comes here I shall show my strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: O forester, listen attentively to my words. If your master comes here I shall show my strength.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वोपमन्युस्तं मर्तुं व्यवसितः स्वयम् । क्षीरे वाच्छामपि त्यक्त्वा निहन्तुं शक्रमुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktvopamanyustaṃ martuṃ vyavasitaḥ svayam | kṣīre vācchāmapi tyaktvā nihantuṃ śakramudyataḥ
verses.translation: It does not behove me to fight with you. I shall fight with your master. The fight between a lion and a jackal is very ridiculous.
verses.commentary: Sense: It does not behove me to fight with you. I shall fight with your master. The fight between a lion and a jackal is very ridiculous.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भस्मादाय तदाधारादघोस्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् । विसृज्य शक्रमुद्दिश्य ननाद स मुनिस्तदा
verses.transliteration: bhasmādāya tadādhārādaghostrābhimantritam | visṛjya śakramuddiśya nanāda sa munistadā
verses.translation: O sage, thus addressed by Arjuna, the Bhilla returned to the place where the general Kirata, the incarnation of l§iva, stood.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, thus addressed by Arjuna, the Bhilla returned to the place where the general Kirata, the incarnation of l§iva, stood.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा स्वेष्टपदद्वन्द्वं स्वदेहं दग्धुमुद्यतः । आग्नेयीं धारणां बिभ्रदुपमन्युरवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā sveṣṭapadadvandvaṃ svadehaṃ dagdhumudyataḥ | āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ bibhradupamanyuravasthitaḥ
verses.translation: He mentioned Arjunas talk in detail to lord Siva, the great soul in the form of Bhilla.
verses.commentary: Sense: He mentioned Arjunas talk in detail to lord Siva, the great soul in the form of Bhilla.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान् शक्ररूपवान् । वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vyavasite vipre bhagavān śakrarūpavān | vārayāmāsa saumyena dhāraṇāṃ tasya yoginaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Kirata with his army, Arjuna, son of Pandu, look up his bow and arrows and faced him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Kirata with his army, Arjuna, son of Pandu, look up his bow and arrows and faced him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्विसृष्टमघोरास्त्रं नन्दीश्वरनियोगतः । जगृहे मध्यतः क्षिप्तं नन्दी शङ्करवल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tadvisṛṣṭamaghorāstraṃ nandīśvaraniyogataḥ | jagṛhe madhyataḥ kṣiptaṃ nandī śaṅkaravallabham
verses.translation: Then Kirata sent the messenger again and
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Kirata sent the messenger again and
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वरूपमेव भगवानास्थाय परमेश्वरः । दर्शयामास विप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: svarūpameva bhagavānāsthāya parameśvaraḥ | darśayāmāsa viprāya bālendukṛtaśekharam
verses.translation: O sage, sec this army coming. Give up the arrow and go away. Why do you seek death for a trifle.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, sec this army coming. Give up the arrow and go away. Why do you seek death for a trifle.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्णवसहस्रं च दध्यादेरर्णवं तथा । भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं तस्मै दर्शयामास स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kṣīrārṇavasahasraṃ ca dadhyāderarṇavaṃ tathā | bhakṣyabhojyārṇavaṃ tasmai darśayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: What the lord said, the Gana of Siva mentioned that to Arjuna in detail after approaching him.
verses.commentary: Sense: What the lord said, the Gana of Siva mentioned that to Arjuna in detail after approaching him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स ददृशे शम्भुर्देव्या सार्धं वृषोपरि । गणेश्वरैस्त्रिशूलाद्यैर्दिव्यास्त्रैरपि संवृतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa dadṛśe śambhurdevyā sārdhaṃ vṛṣopari | gaṇeśvaraistriśūlādyairdivyāstrairapi saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that, Arjuna replied to the messenger "You shall tell your general that the reverse of what he says will happen to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that, Arjuna replied to the messenger "You shall tell your general that the reverse of what he says will happen to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिवि दुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह । विष्णुब्रह्मेन्द्रप्रमुखैर्देवैश्छन्ना दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha | viṣṇubrahmendrapramukhairdevaiśchannā diśo daśa
verses.translation: If I were to give up the arrow that belongs to me I shall be the cause of ignominy to my family.
verses.commentary: Sense: If I were to give up the arrow that belongs to me I shall be the cause of ignominy to my family.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोपमन्युरानन्दसमुद्रोर्मिभिरावृतः । पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा
verses.transliteration: athopamanyurānandasamudrormibhirāvṛtaḥ | papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktinamreṇa cetasā
verses.translation: Well may my brothers be distressed. Let all my knowledge be fruitless. So, come on to fight with me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Well may my brothers be distressed. Let all my knowledge be fruitless. So, come on to fight with me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये तत्र सस्मितो भगवान्भवः । एह्येहीति समाहूय मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय ददौ वरान्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye tatra sasmito bhagavānbhavaḥ | ehyehīti samāhūya mūrdhnyāghrāya dadau varān
verses.translation: Thus replied by Arjuna the Bhilla returned to his master and conveyed all that Arjuna had said.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus replied by Arjuna the Bhilla returned to his master and conveyed all that Arjuna had said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टोऽस्मि त्वदाचरणतो वरात् । दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया जिज्ञासितोऽधुना
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | vatsopamanyo tuṣṭo'smi tvadācaraṇato varāt | dṛḍhabhakto'si viprarṣe mayā jijñāsito'dhunā
verses.translation: On seeing him comci Arjuna meditated on Siva and fought with him a terrible battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him comci Arjuna meditated on Siva and fought with him a terrible battle.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोगान्यथाकामं बान्धवैर्भुङ्क्ष्व सर्वदा । सुखी भव सदा दुःखनिर्मुक्तो भक्तिमान्मम
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhogānyathākāmaṃ bāndhavairbhuṅkṣva sarvadā | sukhī bhava sadā duḥkhanirmukto bhaktimānmama
verses.translation: Arjuna split the arrows discharged by Kirata and his ganas. Then he thought upon Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arjuna split the arrows discharged by Kirata and his ganas. Then he thought upon Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्यो महाभाग तवाम्बैषा हि पार्वती । मया पुत्रीकृतो ह्यद्य कुमारत्वं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyo mahābhāga tavāmbaiṣā hi pārvatī | mayā putrīkṛto hyadya kumāratvaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: When distressed by him, the Ganas fled to the quarters. Then Siva summoned the chief Ganas. But they did not respond to his call.
verses.commentary: Sense: When distressed by him, the Ganas fled to the quarters. Then Siva summoned the chief Ganas. But they did not respond to his call.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दुग्धदध्याज्यमधुनामर्णवाश्च सहस्रशः । भक्ष्यभोज्यादिवस्तूनामर्णवाश्चाखिलास्तथा
verses.transliteration: dugdhadadhyājyamadhunāmarṇavāśca sahasraśaḥ | bhakṣyabhojyādivastūnāmarṇavāścākhilāstathā
verses.translation: Siva and Arjuna of great strength and exploit fought each other with various weapons of war.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva and Arjuna of great strength and exploit fought each other with various weapons of war.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं दत्ता मया प्रीत्या त्वं गृह्णीष्व महामुने । अमरत्वं तथा दत्तं गाणपत्यं च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: tubhyaṃ dattā mayā prītyā tvaṃ gṛhṇīṣva mahāmune | amaratvaṃ tathā dattaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ ca śāśvatam
verses.translation: Taking pity on him Siva approached Arjuna, but Arjuna hit him heavily.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking pity on him Siva approached Arjuna, but Arjuna hit him heavily.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पिताहं ते महादेवो माता ते जगदम्बिका । वरान्वरय सुप्रीत्या मनोऽभिलषितान्परान्
verses.transliteration: pitāhaṃ te mahādevo mātā te jagadambikā | varānvaraya suprītyā mano'bhilaṣitānparān
verses.translation: Siva split the weapons of Arjuna as well as his armour. Aijuna stood in his bare body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva split the weapons of Arjuna as well as his armour. Aijuna stood in his bare body.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजरश्चामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः । यशस्वी वरतेजस्वी दिव्यज्ञानी महाप्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhava tvaṃ duḥkhavarjitaḥ | yaśasvī varatejasvī divyajñānī mahāprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Although afflicted by fear, Arjuna remembered Siva and fought a duel with the general spiritedly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although afflicted by fear, Arjuna remembered Siva and fought a duel with the general spiritedly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ शम्भुः प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा तस्य तपो महत् । पुनर्दश वरान्दिव्यान्मुनये ह्यूपमन्यवे
verses.transliteration: atha śambhuḥ prasannātmā smṛtvā tasya tapo mahat | punardaśa varāndivyānmunaye hyūpamanyave
verses.translation: The earth along with the oceans shook due to their fight. "What will happen now?" Thinking thus, the gods were distressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth along with the oceans shook due to their fight. "What will happen now?" Thinking thus, the gods were distressed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रतं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं व्रतयोगं च तत्त्वतः । ददौ तस्मै प्रवक्तृत्वं पाटवं च निजं पदम्म्
verses.transliteration: vrataṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ vratayogaṃ ca tattvataḥ | dadau tasmai pravaktṛtvaṃ pāṭavaṃ ca nijaṃ padamm
verses.translation: In the meantime, lord Siva stood in mid-air and fought. Arjuna too did likewise.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, lord Siva stood in mid-air and fought. Arjuna too did likewise.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं दत्त्वा महादेवः कराभ्यामुपगृह्य तम् । मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय सुतस्तेऽयमिति देव्यै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dattvā mahādevaḥ karābhyāmupagṛhya tam | mūrdhnyāghrāya sutaste'yamiti devyai nyavedayat
verses.translation: Flying at each other, lord Siva and the earthly king Arjuna fought with each other. On seeing that wonder¬ ful battle the gods were surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flying at each other, lord Siva and the earthly king Arjuna fought with each other. On seeing that wonder¬ ful battle the gods were surprised.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवी च शृण्वती प्रीत्या मूर्ध्नि देशे कराम्बुजम् । विन्यस्य प्रददौ तस्मै कुमारपदमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: devī ca śṛṇvatī prītyā mūrdhni deśe karāmbujam | vinyasya pradadau tasmai kumārapadamakṣayam
verses.translation: Catching hold of his feet, Arjuna whirled him. Lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his disciples, laughed indulging in divine sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: Catching hold of his feet, Arjuna whirled him. Lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his disciples, laughed indulging in divine sports.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीराब्धिमपि साकारं क्षीरस्वादुकरोदधिः । उपास्थाय ददौ तस्मै पिण्डीभूतमनश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kṣīrābdhimapi sākāraṃ kṣīrasvādukarodadhiḥ | upāsthāya dadau tasmai piṇḍībhūtamanaśvaram
verses.translation: Then Siva smiled and revealed his wonderful auspicious form as he is always well disposed to his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva smiled and revealed his wonderful auspicious form as he is always well disposed to his devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: योगैश्वर्यं सदा तुष्टं ब्रह्मविद्यामनश्वराम् । समृद्धिं परमां तस्मै ददौ सन्तुष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: yogaiśvaryaṃ sadā tuṣṭaṃ brahmavidyāmanaśvarām | samṛddhiṃ paramāṃ tasmai dadau santuṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that beautiful form, the form of the excellent supreme being as mentioned in the Vedas, Sastras and Puranas, the form which Vyasa had advised him to meditate upon, the form which bestows all Siddhis, the form of Siva, Arjuna was abashed and surprised much.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that beautiful form, the form of the excellent supreme being as mentioned in the Vedas, Sastras and Puranas, the form which Vyasa had advised him to meditate upon, the form which bestows all Siddhis, the form of Siva, Arjuna was abashed and surprised much.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्दिव्यान्कुमारत्वं च सर्वदा । तस्माच्छिवाच्च तस्याश्च शिवाया मुदितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: so'pi labdhvā varāndivyānkumāratvaṃ ca sarvadā | tasmācchivācca tasyāśca śivāyā mudito'bhavat
verses.translation: "Ha, this is Siva, this is Siva who has been chosen by me as my lord, the lord of the three worlds him¬ self. O what a thing have I committed now!
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ha, this is Siva, this is Siva who has been chosen by me as my lord, the lord of the three worlds him¬ self. O what a thing have I committed now!
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नचेतस्कः सुप्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः । ययाचे स वरं प्रीत्या देवदेवान्महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasannacetaskaḥ supraṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ | yayāce sa varaṃ prītyā devadevānmaheśvarāt
verses.translation: After thinking thus within himself he joined his palms in reverence and bending his head he bowed to the lord with pleasure. Then he spoke in a delighted manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus within himself he joined his palms in reverence and bending his head he bowed to the lord with pleasure. Then he spoke in a delighted manner.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | prasīda devadeveśa prasīda parameśvara | svabhaktiṃ dehi paramāṃ divyāmavyabhicāriṇīm
verses.translation: O great god, O lord of gods, O Siva the merciful, O lord of all, my fault shall be forgiven by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, O lord of gods, O Siva the merciful, O lord of all, my fault shall be forgiven by you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धां देहि महादेव स्वसम्बन्धिषु मे सदा । स्वदास्यं परमं स्नेहं स्वसान्निध्यं च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: śraddhāṃ dehi mahādeva svasambandhiṣu me sadā | svadāsyaṃ paramaṃ snehaṃ svasānnidhyaṃ ca sarvadā
verses.translation: What you have done? By concealing your own form you have deceived me now. Fie on me who fought with you, my master, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: What you have done? By concealing your own form you have deceived me now. Fie on me who fought with you, my master, O lord.

verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktvā prasannātmā harṣagadgadayā girā | tuṣṭāva sa mahādevamupamanyurdvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Thus Arjuna, son of Panqlu, repented. He fell at the feet of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Arjuna, son of Panqlu, repented. He fell at the feet of lord Siva.

verses.translation: Cheering up in various ways the delighted lord Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees, replied to Arjuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cheering up in various ways the delighted lord Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees, replied to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । वत्सोपमन्यो धन्यस्त्वं मम भक्तो विशेषतः । सर्वं दत्तं मया ते हि यद् वृतं भवतानघ
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | vatsopamanyo dhanyastvaṃ mama bhakto viśeṣataḥ | sarvaṃ dattaṃ mayā te hi yad vṛtaṃ bhavatānagha
verses.translation: O Arjuna, do not worry yourself. You are a great devotee of mine. I have done this just to test you. Give up your sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Arjuna, do not worry yourself. You are a great devotee of mine. I have done this just to test you. Give up your sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: अजरश्चामरश्च त्वं सर्वदा दुःखवर्जितः । सर्वपूज्यो निर्विकारी भक्तानां प्रवरो भव

verses.translation: Delighting Arjuna, son of Pandu, honoured by
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighting Arjuna, son of Pandu, honoured by

verses.sanskrit: अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती
verses.transliteration: akṣayā bāndhavāścaiva kulaṃ gotraṃ ca te sadā | bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha mayi bhaktiśca śāśvatī
verses.translation: O Arjuna, foremost among the sons of Pandu, 1 am delighted. Choose your boon. By your hits and blows I have been worshipped by you. I consider it so.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Arjuna, foremost among the sons of Pandu, 1 am delighted. Choose your boon. By your hits and blows I have been worshipped by you. I consider it so.

verses.sanskrit: सान्निध्यं चाश्रये नित्यं करिष्यामि मुने तव । तिष्ठ वत्स यथाकामं नोत्कण्ठां च करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: sānnidhyaṃ cāśraye nityaṃ kariṣyāmi mune tava | tiṣṭha vatsa yathākāmaṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ ca kariṣyasi
verses.translation: This has been done by my own will. I'he fault is not yours. There is nothing which cannot be given to you. Choose whatever you desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been done by my own will. I'he fault is not yours. There is nothing which cannot be given to you. Choose whatever you desire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तस्मै दत्त्वा वरान्वरान् । साम्बश्च सगणः सद्यस्तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca | evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstasmai dattvā varānvarān | sāmbaśca sagaṇaḥ sadyastatraivāntardadhe prabhuḥ
verses.translation: In order to establish the rule of your fame among your enemies what you have done is auspicious. You shall not be struck with grief. Eschew all your feebleness.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to establish the rule of your fame among your enemies what you have done is auspicious. You shall not be struck with grief. Eschew all your feebleness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युः प्रसन्नात्मा प्राप्य शम्भोर्वरान्वरान् । जगाम जननीस्थानं मात्रे सर्वमवर्णयत्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuḥ prasannātmā prāpya śambhorvarānvarān | jagāma jananīsthānaṃ mātre sarvamavarṇayat
verses.translation: Thus addressed by lord Siva, Arjuna stood care¬ fully and spoke to Siva with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by lord Siva, Arjuna stood care¬ fully and spoke to Siva with devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं तृतीया शतरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā tasya jananī mahāharṣamavāpa sā | sarvapūjyo'bhavatso'pi sukhaṃ prāpādhikaṃ sadā

verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the son of Pandu eulogised Siva the great lord, devotedly, in the manner approved of by the Vedas.

verses.commentary: Sense: O blue-necked one, obeisance to you. Obeisance to Sadyojata. O bull-bannered one, obeisance to you with Parvati as your left half.

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of splendid, reddish feet, worthy to be served by Nandin and other Ganas. Obeisance to you, the chief of Ganas.

verses.translation: Obeisance to one in the form of Ganea, followed by Karttikeya. Obeisance to the bestower of devotion and salvation to the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: सा गत्वा गहनेऽरण्ये तेपे सुविमलं तपः । शङ्करं पतिमिच्छन्ती सखीभ्यां संयुता शिवा
verses.transliteration: sā gatvā gahane'raṇye tepe suvimalaṃ tapaḥ | śaṅkaraṃ patimicchantī sakhībhyāṃ saṃyutā śivā
verses.translation: O sage, the twelve incarnations of the supreme soul are wholly delightful to all men for seeing and touching.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the twelve incarnations of the supreme soul are wholly delightful to all men for seeing and touching.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तपः सुपरीक्षार्थं सप्तर्षीन्प्रैषयच्छिवः । तपःस्थानं तु पार्वत्या नानालीलाविशारदः
verses.transliteration: tattapaḥ suparīkṣārthaṃ saptarṣīnpraiṣayacchivaḥ | tapaḥsthānaṃ tu pārvatyā nānālīlāviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, lord Siva manifested himself from his earthen phallic image devoutly installed by Brahma and he fulfilled the desires of the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, lord Siva manifested himself from his earthen phallic image devoutly installed by Brahma and he fulfilled the desires of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: ते गत्वा तत्र मुनयः परीक्षां चक्रुरादरात् । तस्याः सुयत्नतो नैव समर्था ह्यभवंश्च ते

verses.translation: All desires fructify at the sight and touch of the great lord. Thereafter salvation too is attained.
verses.commentary: Sense: All desires fructify at the sight and touch of the great lord. Thereafter salvation too is attained.

verses.transliteration: tatrāgatya śivaṃ natvā vṛttāntaṃ ca nivedya tat | tadājñāṃ samanuprāpya svarlokaṃ jagmurādarāt
verses.translation: The man who performs the ablution of
