verses.science: तथा वेष भिन्‍न-भिन्‍न रूपमें बदल जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: They shall conclude the worship with the remarks, "Let the worship be complete." This alone is their work. Nothing else.
verses.hindi: नगरको शिवजीने पुरुषके समीप भेज दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: They shall conclude the worship with the remarks, "Let the worship be complete." This alone is their work. Nothing else.
verses.science: नगरको शिवजीने पुरुषके समीप भेज दिया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: They shall conclude the worship with the remarks, "Let the worship be complete." This alone is their work. Nothing else.
verses.commentary: Sense: They shall conclude the worship with the remarks, "Let the worship be complete." This alone is their work. Nothing else.
verses.science: बहुत कालपर्यन्त तप किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । चन्द्रभालपशुपतिनाथलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग धन्यस्त्वं शिवसक्तधीः । महाबलस्य लिङ्गस्य श्रावितेयं कथाद्भुता
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.11. ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | candrabhālapaśupatināthaliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | sūta sūta mahābhāga dhanyastvaṃ śivasaktadhīḥ | mahābalasya liṅgasya śrāviteyaṃ kathādbhutā
verses.translation: O great sages, the greatness of Jyotirlingas cannot be adequately described even in hundreds of years. Still I shall tell you.
verses.hindi: समय कुछ भी दिखायी नहीं पड़ता था
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, the greatness of Jyotirlingas cannot be adequately described even in hundreds of years. Still I shall tell you.
verses.science: समय कुछ भी दिखायी नहीं पड़ता था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दधीचमूर्तिस्तत्रैव समर्च्या विधिपूर्वकम् । शिवप्रीत्यर्थमेवाशु तीर्थयात्राफलार्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: dadhīcamūrtistatraiva samarcyā vidhipūrvakam | śivaprītyarthamevāśu tīrthayātrāphalārthibhiḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, the greatness of Jyotirlingas cannot be adequately described even in hundreds of years. Still I shall tell you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, the greatness of Jyotirlingas cannot be adequately described even in hundreds of years. Still I shall tell you.
verses.science: नाभिकमलसे ब्रह्मा प्रकट हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरस्यां दिशायां च शिवलिङ्गानि यानि च । तेषां माहात्म्यमनघं वद त्वं पापनाशकम्
verses.transliteration: uttarasyāṃ diśāyāṃ ca śivaliṅgāni yāni ca | teṣāṃ māhātmyamanaghaṃ vada tvaṃ pāpanāśakam
verses.translation: Being subjected to the force of destiny the moon did not accept his advice. Infatuated of Rohini he neglected others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being subjected to the force of destiny the moon did not accept his advice. Infatuated of Rohini he neglected others.
verses.science: प्रसन्‍नतापूर्वक शिवजीसे कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । शृणुतादरतो विप्रा औत्तराणां विशेषतः । माहात्म्यं शिवलिङ्गानां प्रवदामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | śṛṇutādarato viprā auttarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ | māhātmyaṃ śivaliṅgānāṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ
verses.translation: Just as he cursed him, the moon contracted consumption within a trice. When he was wasted away there was a great hue and cry.
verses.hindi: लोकानामुपकारार्थ तस्थौ तत्रापि सर्वराट्॥ ३९  लोकोपकारार्थ वहाँ भी निवास करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as he cursed him, the moon contracted consumption within a trice. When he was wasted away there was a great hue and cry.
verses.science: लोकानामुपकारार्थ तस्थौ तत्रापि सर्वराट्॥ ३९ लोकोपकारार्थ वहाँ भी निवास करने लगे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णं क्षेत्रमपरं महापातकनाशनम् । महावनं च तत्रास्ति पवित्रमतिविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: gokarṇaṃ kṣetramaparaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | mahāvanaṃ ca tatrāsti pavitramativistaram
verses.translation: O sage, the gods and the sages became extremely agitated and felt miserable—"What shall be done? What will happen now?*'
verses.hindi: तदारभ्य च सा काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठठटराभवत्॥ ४०  काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठ हो गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the gods and the sages became extremely agitated and felt miserable—"What shall be done? What will happen now?*'
verses.science: तदारभ्य च सा काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठठटराभवत्॥ ४० काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठ हो गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रास्ति चन्द्रभालाख्यं शिवलिङ्गमनुत्तमम् । रावणेन समानीतं सद्भक्त्या सर्वसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāsti candrabhālākhyaṃ śivaliṅgamanuttamam | rāvaṇena samānītaṃ sadbhaktyā sarvasiddhidam
verses.translation: Informed and implored by the moon, Indra and other gods, Vasistha and other sages sought refuge in Brahma.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चूदुर्ध्या कोरिरसंहितायां विश्वेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कार्यों खागमनवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विश्ो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Informed and implored by the moon, Indra and other gods, Vasistha and other sages sought refuge in Brahma.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चूदुर्ध्या कोरिरसंहितायां विश्वेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कार्यों खागमनवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विश्ो5 ध्याय:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तत्र स्थितिर्वैद्यनाथस्येव मुनीश्वराः । सर्वलोकहितार्थाय करुणासागरस्य च
verses.transliteration: tasya tatra sthitirvaidyanāthasyeva munīśvarāḥ | sarvalokahitārthāya karuṇāsāgarasya ca
verses.translation: O sage, after approaching him in their great agitation they bowed to and eulogised Brahma and mentioned everything to him.
verses.hindi: आगमनवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after approaching him in their great agitation they bowed to and eulogised Brahma and mentioned everything to him.
verses.science: आगमनवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं कृत्वा तु गोकर्णे चन्द्रभालं समर्च्य च । शिवलोकमवाप्नोति सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ kṛtvā tu gokarṇe candrabhālaṃ samarcya ca | śivalokamavāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Many unholy deeds have been committed by the wicked moon. O sages, O gods, may the early misdeeds of the moon be heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many unholy deeds have been committed by the wicked moon. O sages, O gods, may the early misdeeds of the moon be heard.
verses.science: ज्योतिर्लिंग-का प्रभाव हमलोगोंसे कहिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभालस्य लिङ्गस्य महिमा परमाद्भुतः । न शक्यो वर्णितुं व्यासाद्भक्तिस्नेहरतस्य हि
verses.transliteration: candrabhālasya liṅgasya mahimā paramādbhutaḥ | na śakyo varṇituṃ vyāsādbhaktisneharatasya hi
verses.translation: The wicked fellow went to Brhaspati's house and abducted his w'ife Tara. He then allied himself with the Daityas.
verses.hindi: माहात्म्यका वर्णन करता हूँ, आपलोग सुनें
verses.commentary: Sense: The wicked fellow went to Brhaspati's house and abducted his w'ife Tara. He then allied himself with the Daityas.
verses.science: माहात्म्यका वर्णन करता हूँ, आपलोग सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभालमहादेवलिङ्गस्य महिमा महान् । यथाकथञ्चित्सम्प्रोक्तः परलिङ्गस्य वै शृणु
verses.transliteration: candrabhālamahādevaliṅgasya mahimā mahān | yathākathañcitsamproktaḥ paraliṅgasya vai śṛṇu
verses.translation: Having sought refuge in the Daityas he fought against the god though forbidden by me and Atri. Then the moon restored Tara to Brhaspati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having sought refuge in the Daityas he fought against the god though forbidden by me and Atri. Then the moon restored Tara to Brhaspati.
verses.science: पूर्णरूपसे कहनेकी कृपा करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दाधीचं शिवलिङ्गं तु मिश्रर्षिवरतीर्थके । दधीचिना मुनीशेन सुप्रीत्या च प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: dādhīcaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ tu miśrarṣivaratīrthake | dadhīcinā munīśena suprītyā ca pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: O brahmins, please listen, I shall narrate its great¬ ness and origin succinctly in the manner I have heard from my good preceptor, to the extent of my intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, please listen, I shall narrate its great¬ ness and origin succinctly in the manner I have heard from my good preceptor, to the extent of my intellect.
verses.science: त्रिशूलपर धारण कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा च तत्तीर्थे स्नात्वा सम्यग्विधानतः । शिवलिङ्गं समर्चेद्वै दाधीचेश्वरमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā ca tattīrthe snātvā samyagvidhānataḥ | śivaliṅgaṃ samarcedvai dādhīceśvaramādarāt
verses.translation: O great sages, his daughters, twenty-seven in number, Avini and others, were given in marriage to the moon by Daka, the great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, his daughters, twenty-seven in number, Avini and others, were given in marriage to the moon by Daka, the great soul.
verses.science: करोड़ योजन बताया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा परत्र गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ | iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā paratra gatimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: On securing the moon as their lord, those daughters shone extraordinarily. The moon too, on securing them shone incessantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On securing the moon as their lord, those daughters shone extraordinarily. The moon too, on securing them shone incessantly.
verses.science: नहीं करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नैमिषारण्यतीर्थे तु निखिलर्षिप्रतिष्ठितम् । ऋषीश्वरमिति ख्यातं शिवलिङ्गं सुखप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: naimiṣāraṇyatīrthe tu nikhilarṣipratiṣṭhitam | ṛṣīśvaramiti khyātaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ sukhapradam
verses.translation: The jewel shines with gold and the gold shines with the jewel. Now listen to what happened in due course.
verses.hindi: शिवजी उसे अपने त्रिशूलपर धारण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The jewel shines with gold and the gold shines with the jewel. Now listen to what happened in due course.
verses.science: शिवजी उसे अपने त्रिशूलपर धारण करते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्दर्शनात्पूजनाच्च जनानां पापिनामपि । भुक्तिर्मुक्तिश्च तेषां तु परत्रेह मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: taddarśanātpūjanācca janānāṃ pāpināmapi | bhuktirmuktiśca teṣāṃ tu paratreha munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Out of his twenty-seven wives he did not love any one so much at anytime as he loved Rohinl.
verses.hindi: सर्वोत्तम सायुज्य मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of his twenty-seven wives he did not love any one so much at anytime as he loved Rohinl.
verses.science: सर्वोत्तम सायुज्य मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हत्याहरणतीर्थे तु शिवलिङ्गमघापहम् । पूजनीयं विशेषेण हत्याकोटिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: hatyāharaṇatīrthe tu śivaliṅgamaghāpaham | pūjanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa hatyākoṭivināśanam
verses.translation: The others became distressed and sought refuge in their father. After going to him they mentioned their misery to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The others became distressed and sought refuge in their father. After going to him they mentioned their misery to him.
verses.science: हत्याओंको विनष्ट करनेवाली है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवप्रयागतीर्थे तु ललितेश्वरनामकम् । शिवलिङ्गं सदा पूज्यं नरैः सर्वाघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: devaprayāgatīrthe tu laliteśvaranāmakam | śivaliṅgaṃ sadā pūjyaṃ naraiḥ sarvāghanāśanam
verses.translation: O storehouse of digits, you are born of a noble family. How can you cherish oddity in your affection towards your dependents?
verses.hindi: यह नगरी सर्वदा भोग एवं मोक्षको देनेवाली है
verses.commentary: Sense: O storehouse of digits, you are born of a noble family. How can you cherish oddity in your affection towards your dependents?
verses.science: यह नगरी सर्वदा भोग एवं मोक्षको देनेवाली है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नयपालाख्यपुर्यां तु प्रसिद्धायां महीतले । लिङ्गं पशुपतीशाख्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: nayapālākhyapuryāṃ tu prasiddhāyāṃ mahītale | liṅgaṃ paśupatīśākhyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: After requesting the moon, his son-in-law, thus, Daksa returned to his abode fully assured.
verses.commentary: Sense: After requesting the moon, his son-in-law, thus, Daksa returned to his abode fully assured.
verses.science: शंकरसे यह वचन कहा था--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरोभागस्वरूपेण शिवलिङ्गं तदस्ति हि । तत्कथां वर्णयिष्यामि केदारेश्वरवर्णने
verses.transliteration: śirobhāgasvarūpeṇa śivaliṅgaṃ tadasti hi | tatkathāṃ varṇayiṣyāmi kedāreśvaravarṇane
verses.translation: The moon did not act according to his advice being deluded by Siva's Maya which deludes the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon did not act according to his advice being deluded by Siva's Maya which deludes the universe.
verses.science: यही प्रार्थना करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदारान्मुक्तिनाथाख्यं शिवलिङ्गं महाद्भुतम् । दर्शनादर्चनात्तस्य भुक्तिर्मुक्तिश्च लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: tadārānmuktināthākhyaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ mahādbhutam | darśanādarcanāttasya bhuktirmuktiśca labhyate
verses.translation: On hearing it the skilful Daka returned to the moon excessively distressed. He politely asked the moon to mend his ways.
verses.hindi: हैं और ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णु आदिके द्वारा सेवनीय हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it the skilful Daka returned to the moon excessively distressed. He politely asked the moon to mend his ways.
verses.science: हैं और ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णु आदिके द्वारा सेवनीय हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं लिङ्गवर्णनमुत्तमम् । चतुर्दिक्षु मुनिश्रेष्ठाः किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: iti vaśca samākhyātaṃ liṅgavarṇanamuttamam | caturdikṣu muniśreṣṭhāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchatha
verses.translation: O moon, listen. Although requested repeatedly you did not pay heed to my rntreatics. Hence, fall a prey to the wasting disease.
verses.hindi: आपका ध्यान करता हुआ यहीं निवास करूँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: O moon, listen. Although requested repeatedly you did not pay heed to my rntreatics. Hence, fall a prey to the wasting disease.
verses.science: आपका ध्यान करता हुआ यहीं निवास करूँगा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: But he said, "If she casts off the foetus I shall accept her." When they asked her whose child she bore in the womb, she replied that the foetus grew out of the seed of the moon. O excellent sages, I then removed the foetus and urged by me, she was accepted by him.
verses.hindi: ब्रत धारणकर सर्वदा यहाँ निवास करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: But he said, "If she casts off the foetus I shall accept her." When they asked her whose child she bore in the womb, she replied that the foetus grew out of the seed of the moon. O excellent sages, I then removed the foetus and urged by me, she was accepted by him.
verses.science: ब्रत धारणकर सर्वदा यहाँ निवास करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: But he said, "If she casts off the foetus I shall accept her." When they asked her whose child she bore in the womb, she replied that the foetus grew out of the seed of the moon. O excellent sages, I then removed the foetus and urged by me, she was accepted by him.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष देनेवाले श्रेष्ठ पाशुपतव्रतका आचरण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: But he said, "If she casts off the foetus I shall accept her." When they asked her whose child she bore in the womb, she replied that the foetus grew out of the seed of the moon. O excellent sages, I then removed the foetus and urged by me, she was accepted by him.
verses.science: मोक्ष देनेवाले श्रेष्ठ पाशुपतव्रतका आचरण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । लिङ्गस्वरूपकारणवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत जानासि सकलं वस्तु व्यासप्रसादतः । तवाज्ञातं न विद्येत तस्मात्पृच्छामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.12. dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | liṅgasvarūpakāraṇavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | sūta jānāsi sakalaṃ vastu vyāsaprasādataḥ | tavājñātaṃ na vidyeta tasmātpṛcchāmahe vayam
verses.translation: Let the moon go to the auspicious serine at Prabhasa along with the gods. Let him propitiate Siva there according to Nlftyufijaya rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the moon go to the auspicious serine at Prabhasa along with the gods. Let him propitiate Siva there according to Nlftyufijaya rites.
verses.science: लगता है, उसे तुम सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा ऋषिपत्न्यस्ताः परं त्रासमुपागताः । विह्वला विस्मिताश्चान्याः समाजग्मुस्तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣipatnyastāḥ paraṃ trāsamupāgatāḥ | vihvalā vismitāścānyāḥ samājagmustathā punaḥ
verses.translation: Let the moon go to the auspicious serine at Prabhasa along with the gods. Let him propitiate Siva there according to Nlftyufijaya rites.
verses.hindi: जो विशेषता है, उसे तुम ध्यानसे सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the moon go to the auspicious serine at Prabhasa along with the gods. Let him propitiate Siva there according to Nlftyufijaya rites.
verses.science: जो विशेषता है, उसे तुम ध्यानसे सुनो। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं च पूज्यते लोके तत्त्वया कथितं च यत् । तत्तथैव न चान्यद्वा कारणं विद्यते त्विह
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ ca pūjyate loke tattvayā kathitaṃ ca yat | tattathaiva na cānyadvā kāraṇaṃ vidyate tviha
verses.hindi: मर जानेपर प्राणीको अमृतत्वकी प्राप्ति होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Cp. VS. 3. 60.
verses.science: मर जानेपर प्राणीको अमृतत्वकी प्राप्ति होती है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: बाणरूपा श्रुता लोके पार्वती शिववल्लभा । एतत्किं कारणं सूत कथय त्वं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: bāṇarūpā śrutā loke pārvatī śivavallabhā | etatkiṃ kāraṇaṃ sūta kathaya tvaṃ yathāśrutam
verses.translation: Thus seeing the fruit of that high order, the sages and the gods joyously bowed to Jiva and took the moon now freed from wastage. Circumambulating and praising that holy centre they returned to their abodes. The moon resumed his former activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus seeing the fruit of that high order, the sages and the gods joyously bowed to Jiva and took the moon now freed from wastage. Circumambulating and praising that holy centre they returned to their abodes. The moon resumed his former activity.
verses.science: भयंकर कालको बिताने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । कल्पभेदकथा चैव श्रुता व्यासान्मया द्विजाः । तामेव कथयाम्यद्य श्रूयतामृषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | kalpabhedakathā caiva śrutā vyāsānmayā dvijāḥ | tāmeva kathayāmyadya śrūyatāmṛṣisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Then they returned again to Jiva. After bowing to him and taking leave of him they returned to their abodes.
verses.hindi: सह लेते हैं, किंतु दूसरोंके दु:खको दूर करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they returned again to Jiva. After bowing to him and taking leave of him they returned to their abodes.
verses.science: सह लेते हैं, किंतु दूसरोंके दु:खको दूर करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा दारुवने जातं यद् वृत्तं तु द्विजन्मनाम् । तदेव श्रूयतां सम्यक् कथयामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: purā dāruvane jātaṃ yad vṛttaṃ tu dvijanmanām | tadeva śrūyatāṃ samyak kathayāmi yathāśrutam
verses.translation: Hence O holy lord, be kind to us and narrate the third Jyotirlihga to us now.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O holy lord, be kind to us and narrate the third Jyotirlihga to us now.
verses.science: ऐसा कहकर उन्होंने धमकाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुनाम वनं श्रेष्ठं तत्रासन् ऋषिसत्तमाः । शिवभक्ताः सदा नित्यं शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: dārunāma vanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatrāsan ṛṣisattamāḥ | śivabhaktāḥ sadā nityaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Thanks to the power of their merit, happiness in¬ creased on the earth even as the moon waxes incessantly in the bright half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the power of their merit, happiness in¬ creased on the earth even as the moon waxes incessantly in the bright half of the month.
verses.science: यह कार्य पूरा कर दें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालं शिवपूजां च कुर्वन्ति स्म निरन्तरम् । नानाविधैः स्तवैर्दिव्यैस्तुष्टुवुस्ते मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: trikālaṃ śivapūjāṃ ca kurvanti sma nirantaram | nānāvidhaiḥ stavairdivyaistuṣṭuvuste munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Their good qualities too flourished delighting and pleasing all. That city was enveloped in the brahminical splendour.
verses.hindi: अहितकारक फलको नहीं ग्रहण किया जाता
verses.commentary: Sense: Their good qualities too flourished delighting and pleasing all. That city was enveloped in the brahminical splendour.
verses.science: अहितकारक फलको नहीं ग्रहण किया जाता। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ते कदाचिद्वने याताः समिधाहरणाय च । सर्वे द्विजर्षभाः शैवाः शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: te kadācidvane yātāḥ samidhāharaṇāya ca | sarve dvijarṣabhāḥ śaivāḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, let the excellent event that happened in the meantime be heard. I shall narrate it in the manner I have heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, let the excellent event that happened in the meantime be heard. I shall narrate it in the manner I have heard.
verses.science: है, आपलोग भलीभाँति विचार करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे साक्षाच्छङ्करो नीललोहितः । विरूपं च समास्थाय परीक्षार्थं समागतः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare sākṣācchaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ | virūpaṃ ca samāsthāya parīkṣārthaṃ samāgataḥ
verses.translation: Thanks to the grant of boons by Brahma he con¬ sidered the whole univcr.se insignificant. The gods were defeated by him and ousted from their places and positions.
verses.hindi: परम हितकर ही होगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the grant of boons by Brahma he con¬ sidered the whole univcr.se insignificant. The gods were defeated by him and ousted from their places and positions.
verses.science: परम हितकर ही होगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: दिगम्बरोऽतितेजस्वी भूतिभूषणभूषितः । स चेष्टामकरोद्दुष्टां हस्ते लिङ्गं विधारयन्
verses.transliteration: digambaro'titejasvī bhūtibhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | sa ceṣṭāmakarodduṣṭāṃ haste liṅgaṃ vidhārayan
verses.translation: What has happened cannot be reversed. I shall tell you the means to be adopted now. Listen attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: What has happened cannot be reversed. I shall tell you the means to be adopted now. Listen attentively.
verses.science: ही (प्रकारके कर्म) समान हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मनसा च प्रियं तेषां कर्तुं वै वनवासिनाम् । जगाम तद्वनं प्रीत्या भक्तप्रीतो हरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: manasā ca priyaṃ teṣāṃ kartuṃ vai vanavāsinām | jagāma tadvanaṃ prītyā bhaktaprīto haraḥ svayam
verses.translation: Let him perform the penance incessantly sitting before the lord. The delighted Siva will cure him from consumption afterwards.
verses.hindi: अवश्य मुक्त हो जाते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him perform the penance incessantly sitting before the lord. The delighted Siva will cure him from consumption afterwards.
verses.science: अवश्य मुक्त हो जाते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आलिलिङ्गुस्तथा चान्याः करं धृत्वा तथापराः । परस्परं तु सङ्घर्षात्सम्मग्नास्ताः स्त्रियस्तदा
verses.transliteration: āliliṅgustathā cānyāḥ karaṃ dhṛtvā tathāparāḥ | parasparaṃ tu saṅgharṣātsammagnāstāḥ striyastadā
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, the gods and sages returned to the place where Daksa and the moon were present.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma, the gods and sages returned to the place where Daksa and the moon were present.
verses.science: अधिक मोक्षप्रद है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव समये ऋषिवर्याः समागमन् । विरुद्धं तं च ते दृष्ट्वा दुःखिताः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva samaye ṛṣivaryāḥ samāgaman | viruddhaṃ taṃ ca te dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ
verses.translation: The gods and the sages consoled Daksa and took the moon to Prabhasa.They invoked the sacred waters of Saiasvati and other rivers and performed the worship of the earthen phallic image in accordance with the Mrtyufljaya rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods and the sages consoled Daksa and took the moon to Prabhasa.They invoked the sacred waters of Saiasvati and other rivers and performed the worship of the earthen phallic image in accordance with the Mrtyufljaya rites.
verses.science: अधिकारी हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा दुःखमनुप्राप्ताः कोऽयं कोऽयं तथाब्रुवन् । समस्ता ऋषयस्ते वै शिवमायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: tadā duḥkhamanuprāptāḥ ko'yaṃ ko'yaṃ tathābruvan | samastā ṛṣayaste vai śivamāyāvimohitāḥ
verses.translation: The gods and the sages of pious mind left the moon at Prabhasa and joyously returned to their abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods and the sages of pious mind left the moon at Prabhasa and joyously returned to their abodes.
verses.science: ध्यान करते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा च नोक्तवान् किञ्चित्सोऽवधूतो दिगम्बरः । ऊचुस्तं पुरुषं भीमं तदा ते परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: yadā ca noktavān kiñcitso'vadhūto digambaraḥ | ūcustaṃ puruṣaṃ bhīmaṃ tadā te paramarṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The moon performed the penance incessantly for six months. He worshipped the bull-bannered deity with the Mrtyufijaya mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon performed the penance incessantly for six months. He worshipped the bull-bannered deity with the Mrtyufijaya mantra.
verses.science: बन्धन नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वया विरुद्धं क्रियते वेदमार्गविलोपि यत् । ततस्त्वदीयं तल्लिङ्गं पततां पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: tvayā viruddhaṃ kriyate vedamārgavilopi yat | tatastvadīyaṃ talliṅgaṃ patatāṃ pṛthivītale
verses.translation: The moon repeated the Mytyufljaya** mantra a hundred million times. He meditated on the lord Mj-tyufljaya with his mind unruffled.
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon repeated the Mytyufljaya** mantra a hundred million times. He meditated on the lord Mj-tyufljaya with his mind unruffled.
verses.science: मेरी उपासना करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ते तु तदा तैश्च लिङ्गं च पतितं क्षणात् । अवधूतस्य तस्याशु शिवस्याद्भुतरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityukte tu tadā taiśca liṅgaṃ ca patitaṃ kṣaṇāt | avadhūtasya tasyāśu śivasyādbhutarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: O moon, may there be welfare to you. Choose your boon, whatever you desire in your mind. I am pleased with you. I shall grant you an excellent boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O moon, may there be welfare to you. Choose your boon, whatever you desire in your mind. I am pleased with you. I shall grant you an excellent boon.
verses.science: मुझमें ही लीन रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तल्लिङ्गं चाग्निवत्सर्वं यद्ददाह पुरा स्थितम् । यत्र यत्र च तद्याति तत्र तत्र दहेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: talliṅgaṃ cāgnivatsarvaṃ yaddadāha purā sthitam | yatra yatra ca tadyāti tatra tatra dahetpunaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, what is not
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, what is not
verses.science: एवं मोक्ष देनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पाताले च गतं तच्च स्वर्गे चापि तथैव च । भूमौ सर्वत्र तद्यातं न कुत्रापि स्थिरं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: pātāle ca gataṃ tacca svarge cāpi tathaiva ca | bhūmau sarvatra tadyātaṃ na kutrāpi sthiraṃ hi tat
verses.translation: Pardon my faults. Remain benevolent to me always. When he had said thus Siva spbke lo him again.
verses.hindi: दोनों कर्मोसे मनुष्यलोकमें जन्म कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: Pardon my faults. Remain benevolent to me always. When he had said thus Siva spbke lo him again.
verses.science: दोनों कर्मोसे मनुष्यलोकमें जन्म कहा गया है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकाश्च व्याकुला जाता ऋषयस्तेऽतिदुःखिताः । न शर्म लेभिरे केचिद्देवाश्च ऋषयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: lokāśca vyākulā jātā ṛṣayaste'tiduḥkhitāḥ | na śarma lebhire keciddevāśca ṛṣayastathā
verses.translation: O moon, let your digit decline day by day in one fortnight and increase steadily in another.
verses.hindi: हो जाता है, तब मुक्ति होती है, यह सत्य है
verses.commentary: Sense: O moon, let your digit decline day by day in one fortnight and increase steadily in another.
verses.science: हो जाता है, तब मुक्ति होती है, यह सत्य है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न ज्ञातस्तु शिवो यैस्तु ते सर्वे च सुरर्षयः । दुःखिता मिलिताः शीघ्रं ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: na jñātastu śivo yaistu te sarve ca surarṣayaḥ | duḥkhitā militāḥ śīghraṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, when this happened the delighted gods and the sages came there quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, when this happened the delighted gods and the sages came there quickly.
verses.science: बन्धनमें डालनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा च ते सर्वे नत्वा स्तुत्वा विधिं द्विजाः । तत्सर्वमवदन् वृत्तं ब्रह्मणे सृष्टिकारिणे
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā ca te sarve natvā stutvā vidhiṃ dvijāḥ | tatsarvamavadan vṛttaṃ brahmaṇe sṛṣṭikāriṇe
verses.translation: After coming there they offered benedictory bless¬ ings to the moon. They joined their palms in reverence and bowed to Siva. They prayed to him devotionally.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming there they offered benedictory bless¬ ings to the moon. They joined their palms in reverence and bowed to Siva. They prayed to him devotionally.
verses.science: विद्वजन क्रियमाण कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शिवमायाविमोहितान् । ज्ञात्वा तान् शङ्करं नत्वा प्रोवाच ऋषिसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śivamāyāvimohitān | jñātvā tān śaṅkaraṃ natvā provāca ṛṣisattamān
verses.translation: O great god, O lord of gods, obeisance be to you. O Siva, O lord, be stable here along with Uma.
verses.hindi: क्रियमाण कर्मका नाश हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O great god, O lord of gods, obeisance be to you. O Siva, O lord, be stable here along with Uma.
verses.science: क्रियमाण कर्मका नाश हो जाता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । ज्ञातारश्च भवन्तो वै कुर्वते गर्हितं द्विजाः । अज्ञातारो यदा कुर्युः किं पुनः कथ्यते पुनः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | jñātāraśca bhavanto vai kurvate garhitaṃ dvijāḥ | ajñātāro yadā kuryuḥ kiṃ punaḥ kathyate punaḥ
verses.translation: Then the moon eulogised the lord with good devo¬ tion first in the Nirguna and then in the Saguna form.
verses.hindi: हृति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्थ्या कोटिरुद्रसंहितायां काशीविश्वेश्वरज्योतिर्लिड़माहात््यवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the moon eulogised the lord with good devo¬ tion first in the Nirguna and then in the Saguna form.
verses.science: हृति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्थ्या कोटिरुद्रसंहितायां काशीविश्वेश्वरज्योतिर्लिड़माहात््यवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: विरुद्ध्यैवं शिवं देवं कुशलं कः समीहते । मध्याह्नसमये यो वै नातिथिं च परामृशेत्
verses.transliteration: viruddhyaivaṃ śivaṃ devaṃ kuśalaṃ kaḥ samīhate | madhyāhnasamaye yo vai nātithiṃ ca parāmṛśet
verses.translation: Siva was delighted with the gods. For increas¬ ing the glory and greatness of the region and the moon, Siva stayed there in the name, of Somesvara. He became famous in the three worlds. O brahmins, by worship Siva becomes the destroyer of ailments such as consumption, leprosy etc.
verses.hindi: माहात्यवर्णन नामक तेईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Siva was delighted with the gods. For increas¬ ing the glory and greatness of the region and the moon, Siva stayed there in the name, of Somesvara. He became famous in the three worlds. O brahmins, by worship Siva becomes the destroyer of ailments such as consumption,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva was delighted with the gods. For increas¬ ing the glory and greatness of the region and the moon, Siva stayed there in the name, of Somesvara. He became famous in the three worlds. O brahmins, by worship Siva becomes the destroyer of ailments such as consumption,…
verses.science: माहात्यवर्णन नामक तेईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव सुकृतं नीत्वा स्वीयं च दुष्कृतं पुनः । संस्थाप्य चातिथिर्याति किं पुनः शिवमेव वा
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva sukṛtaṃ nītvā svīyaṃ ca duṣkṛtaṃ punaḥ | saṃsthāpya cātithiryāti kiṃ punaḥ śivameva vā
verses.translation: Incurable diseases like consumption arc entirely eradicated if a person takes ablutions there for six months.
verses.hindi: उनकी परम धार्मिक अहल्या नामकी पत्नी थी
verses.commentary: Sense: Incurable diseases like consumption arc entirely eradicated if a person takes ablutions there for six months.
verses.science: उनकी परम धार्मिक अहल्या नामकी पत्नी थी। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यावल्लिङ्गं स्थिरं नैव जगतां त्रितये शुभम् । जायते न तदा क्वापि सत्यमेतद्वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yāvalliṅgaṃ sthiraṃ naiva jagatāṃ tritaye śubham | jāyate na tadā kvāpi satyametadvadāmyaham
verses.translation: A pious man attains the fruit of circumambulating
verses.hindi: वहाँ उन्होंने दस हजार वर्षतक तप किया
verses.commentary: Sense: A pious man attains the fruit of circumambulating
verses.science: वहाँ उन्होंने दस हजार वर्षतक तप किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिश्च तथा कार्यं यथा स्वास्थ्यं भवेदिह । शिवलिङ्गस्य ऋषयो मनसा संविचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhiśca tathā kāryaṃ yathā svāsthyaṃ bhavediha | śivaliṅgasya ṛṣayo manasā saṃvicāryatām
verses.translation: He who makes pilgrimage to this place attains the fruits of whatever he miglil have had in view. There is no doubt about this.
verses.hindi: पानी कहाँसे दिखायी दे सकता था!
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes pilgrimage to this place attains the fruits of whatever he miglil have had in view. There is no doubt about this.
verses.science: पानी कहाँसे दिखायी दे सकता था!। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते प्रणम्योचुर्ब्रह्माणमृषयश्च वै । किमस्माभिर्विधे कार्यं तत्कार्यं त्वं समादिश
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktāste praṇamyocurbrahmāṇamṛṣayaśca vai | kimasmābhirvidhe kāryaṃ tatkāryaṃ tvaṃ samādiśa
verses.translation: O great sages, thus the details of the origin of Soinesa have been narrated to you. Somesvara has originated thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, thus the details of the origin of Soinesa have been narrated to you. Somesvara has originated thus.
verses.science: उस स्थानपर उत्तम तप किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तश्च मुनीशैस्तैः सर्वलोकपितामहः । मुनीशांस्तांस्तदा ब्रह्मा स्वयं प्रोवाच वै तदा
verses.transliteration: ityuktaśca munīśaistaiḥ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ | munīśāṃstāṃstadā brahmā svayaṃ provāca vai tadā
verses.translation: He w'ho listens to this origin or narrates it to others attains all desires and becomes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: हूँ, वर माँगो, मैं तुम्हें बर दूँगा
verses.commentary: Sense: He w'ho listens to this origin or narrates it to others attains all desires and becomes rid of all sins.
verses.science: हूँ, वर माँगो, मैं तुम्हें बर दूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । आराध्य गिरिजां देवीं प्रार्थयन्तु सुराः शिवाम् । योनिरूपा भवेच्चेद्वै तदा तत्स्थिरतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | ārādhya girijāṃ devīṃ prārthayantu surāḥ śivām | yonirūpā bhaveccedvai tadā tatsthiratāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Hereafter 1 shall explain the origin of Mallikarjuna on hearing which the devotee becomes intelligent and rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! इसपर उन वरुणने मुनिसे कहा--
verses.commentary: Sense: Hereafter 1 shall explain the origin of Mallikarjuna on hearing which the devotee becomes intelligent and rid of all sins.
verses.science: हे द्विजो! इसपर उन वरुणने मुनिसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्विधिं प्रवदाम्यद्य सर्वे शृणुत सत्तमाः । तामेव कुरुत प्रेम्णा प्रसन्ना सा भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tadvidhiṃ pravadāmyadya sarve śṛṇuta sattamāḥ | tāmeva kuruta premṇā prasannā sā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The story of Kumara has already been mentioned by me. I.shall e.xplain it again. It is divine and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: मैं आपके लिये प्रदान कर सकूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Kumara has already been mentioned by me. I.shall e.xplain it again. It is divine and destructive of all sins.
verses.science: मैं आपके लिये प्रदान कर सकूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भमेकं च संस्थाप्य कृत्वाष्टदलमुत्तमम् । दूर्वायवाङ्कुरैस्तीर्थोदकमापूरयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: kumbhamekaṃ ca saṃsthāpya kṛtvāṣṭadalamuttamam | dūrvāyavāṅkuraistīrthodakamāpūrayettataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it, Kumfira bowed to his parents and went to the mountain KrauHca*'*' though forbidden by his parents.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, Kumfira bowed to his parents and went to the mountain KrauHca*'*' though forbidden by his parents.
verses.science: मुनियोंमें श्रेष्ठ गौतम ऋषिसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदमन्त्रैस्ततस्तं वै कुम्भं चैवाभिमन्त्रयेत् । श्रुत्युक्तविधिना तस्य पूजां कृत्वा शिवं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: vedamantraistatastaṃ vai kumbhaṃ caivābhimantrayet | śrutyuktavidhinā tasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ smaran
verses.translation: O beloved, why are you distressed O Parvati, do not be grieved. O beautiful lady, our son will certainly return. Let not your excessive grief overpower you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, why are you distressed O Parvati, do not be grieved. O beautiful lady, our son will certainly return. Let not your excessive grief overpower you.
verses.science: गया श्राद्ध--यह सब अक्षय होगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तल्लिङ्गं तज्जलेनाभिषेचयेत्परमर्षयः । शतरुद्रियमन्त्रैस्तु प्रोक्षितं शान्तिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: talliṅgaṃ tajjalenābhiṣecayetparamarṣayaḥ | śatarudriyamantraistu prokṣitaṃ śāntimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: When the distressed Parvati did not pay heed to his advic:e, the celestial sages were sent to Karttika by iva.
verses.hindi: भी दूसरोंका उपकारकर सुख प्राप्त किया
verses.commentary: Sense: When the distressed Parvati did not pay heed to his advic:e, the celestial sages were sent to Karttika by iva.
verses.science: भी दूसरोंका उपकारकर सुख प्राप्त किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गिरिजायोनिरूपं च बाणं स्थाप्य शुभं पुनः । तत्र लिङ्गं च तत्स्थाप्यं पुनश्चैवाभिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: girijāyonirūpaṃ ca bāṇaṃ sthāpya śubhaṃ punaḥ | tatra liṅgaṃ ca tatsthāpyaṃ punaścaivābhimantrayet
verses.translation: The gods and the sages, accompanied by their at¬ tendants went there joyously to bring back Kumara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods and the sages, accompanied by their at¬ tendants went there joyously to bring back Kumara.
verses.science: पाते हैं, नीच लोग नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धैश्चन्दनैश्चैव पुष्पधूपादिभिस्तथा । नैवेद्यादिकपूजाभिस्तोषयेत्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sugandhaiścandanaiścaiva puṣpadhūpādibhistathā | naivedyādikapūjābhistoṣayetparameśvaram
verses.translation: They went there and bowed to Kuinara, implored him in many ways and requested him humbly and respect¬ fully.
verses.hindi: तथा छोटोंकी सेवासे लघुता प्राप्त होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: They went there and bowed to Kuinara, implored him in many ways and requested him humbly and respect¬ fully.
verses.science: तथा छोटोंकी सेवासे लघुता प्राप्त होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपातैः स्तवैः पुण्यैर्वाद्यैर्गानैस्तथा पुनः । ततः स्वस्त्ययनं कृत्वा जयेति व्याहरेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: praṇipātaiḥ stavaiḥ puṇyairvādyairgānaistathā punaḥ | tataḥ svastyayanaṃ kṛtvā jayeti vyāharettathā
verses.translation: Agitated by great pride Kumara did not care for the importunities of the gods and sages, intermingled with Siva's behest.
verses.hindi: रहना अस्थिलाभ करानेवाला कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: Agitated by great pride Kumara did not care for the importunities of the gods and sages, intermingled with Siva's behest.
verses.science: रहना अस्थिलाभ करानेवाला कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नो भव देवेश जगदाह्लादकारक । कर्ता पालयिता त्वं च संहर्ता त्वं निरक्षरः
verses.transliteration: prasanno bhava deveśa jagadāhlādakāraka | kartā pālayitā tvaṃ ca saṃhartā tvaṃ nirakṣaraḥ
verses.translation: When he did not return, goddess Parvati felt severely the pangs of separation from her son. Siva too was extremely miserable.
verses.hindi: उपकारमें कुशल होते हैं, ऐसे अन्य कोई नहीं हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: When he did not return, goddess Parvati felt severely the pangs of separation from her son. Siva too was extremely miserable.
verses.science: उपकारमें कुशल होते हैं, ऐसे अन्य कोई नहीं हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जगदादिर्जगद्योनिर्जगदन्तर्गतोऽपि च । शान्तो भव महेशान सर्वांल्लोकांश्च पालय
verses.transliteration: jagadādirjagadyonirjagadantargato'pi ca | śānto bhava maheśāna sarvāṃllokāṃśca pālaya
verses.translation: Coming to know of the arrival of his parents, from the top of the mountain Kumara went thirtysix kilo¬ metres further out of disregard for their love.
verses.hindi: इन चार पुण्यस्तम्भोंने पृथ्वीको धारण किया है
verses.commentary: Sense: Coming to know of the arrival of his parents, from the top of the mountain Kumara went thirtysix kilo¬ metres further out of disregard for their love.
verses.science: इन चार पुण्यस्तम्भोंने पृथ्वीको धारण किया है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते विधौ स्वास्थ्यं भविष्यति न संशयः । विकारो न त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन्भविष्यति सुखं सदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte vidhau svāsthyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | vikāro na triloke'sminbhaviṣyati sukhaṃ sadā
verses.translation: When he went further on the Krauiica hill, iva and Parvati stayed behind assuming the fiery form.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he went further on the Krauiica hill, iva and Parvati stayed behind assuming the fiery form.
verses.science: वहाँ उत्पन्न हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते द्विजा देवाः प्रणिपत्य पितामहम् । शिवं तं शरणं प्राप्ताः सर्वलोकसुखेप्सया
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktāste dvijā devāḥ praṇipatya pitāmaham | śivaṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ sarvalokasukhepsayā
verses.translation: Out of filial affection they used to visit Kumara on the concluding day of every fortnight.
verses.hindi: अनेक पशु-पक्षी एवं बहुत-से जीव भी पहुँच गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of filial affection they used to visit Kumara on the concluding day of every fortnight.
verses.science: अनेक पशु-पक्षी एवं बहुत-से जीव भी पहुँच गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूजितः परया भक्त्या प्रार्थितः शङ्करस्तदा । सुप्रसन्नस्ततो भूत्वा तानुवाच महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā prārthitaḥ śaṅkarastadā | suprasannastato bhūtvā tānuvāca maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Siva goes there on Amavasya day and Parvati on the Full Moon day.
verses.hindi: वहाँ दुःख देनेवाली अनावृष्टि नहीं रह गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva goes there on Amavasya day and Parvati on the Full Moon day.
verses.science: वहाँ दुःख देनेवाली अनावृष्टि नहीं रह गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वर उवाच । हे देवा ऋषयः सर्वे मद्वचः शृणुतादरात् । योनिरूपेण मल्लिङ्गं धृतं चेत्स्यात्तदा सुखम्
verses.transliteration: maheśvara uvāca | he devā ṛṣayaḥ sarve madvacaḥ śṛṇutādarāt | yonirūpeṇa malliṅgaṃ dhṛtaṃ cetsyāttadā sukham
verses.translation: From that day onwards: that phallic image of Siva born of Mallikarjima became famous in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that day onwards: that phallic image of Siva born of Mallikarjima became famous in the three worlds.
verses.science: निवास करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्वतीं च विना नान्या लिङ्गं धारयितुं क्षमा । तया धृतं च मल्लिङ्गं द्रुतं शान्तिं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: pārvatīṃ ca vinā nānyā liṅgaṃ dhārayituṃ kṣamā | tayā dhṛtaṃ ca malliṅgaṃ drutaṃ śāntiṃ gamiṣyati
verses.translation: He who sees that phallic image becomes rid of all sins and attains all desires. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: उस वनमें पूर्ण आनन्द व्याप्त हो गया
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees that phallic image becomes rid of all sins and attains all desires. There is no doubt about it.
verses.science: उस वनमें पूर्ण आनन्द व्याप्त हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिभिर्देवैः सुप्रसन्नैर्मुनीश्वराः । गृहीत्वा चैव ब्रह्माणं गिरिजा प्रार्थिता तदा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tacchrutvā ṛṣibhirdevaiḥ suprasannairmunīśvarāḥ | gṛhītvā caiva brahmāṇaṃ girijā prārthitā tadā
verses.translation: His misery disappears. He obtains supreme hap¬ piness. He never suffers from the distress of rebirth in the mother's womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: His misery disappears. He obtains supreme hap¬ piness. He never suffers from the distress of rebirth in the mother's womb.
verses.science: गौतमप्रथाववर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्विशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नां गिरिजां कृत्वा वृषभध्वजमेव च । पूर्वोक्तं च विधिं कृत्वा स्थापितं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prasannāṃ girijāṃ kṛtvā vṛṣabhadhvajameva ca | pūrvoktaṃ ca vidhiṃ kṛtvā sthāpitaṃ liṅgamuttamam
verses.translation: Thus the second Jyotirlihga Mallika has been narrated. It is the bestower of happiness and the welfare to the world.
verses.hindi: गौतमप्रभाववर्णन नामक चौबीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the second Jyotirlihga Mallika has been narrated. It is the bestower of happiness and the welfare to the world.
verses.science: गौतमप्रभाववर्णन नामक चौबीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन देवाश्च ऋषयस्तथा । चक्रुः प्रसन्नां गिरिजां शिवं च धर्महेतवे
verses.transliteration: mantroktena vidhānena devāśca ṛṣayastathā | cakruḥ prasannāṃ girijāṃ śivaṃ ca dharmahetave
verses.translation: O Suta, you know everything by Vyasa's favour. We are never satiated by hearing about the Jyotirlihgas.
verses.hindi: हाथमें कमण्डलु लेकर भक्तिपूर्वक वहाँ पहुँचे
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, you know everything by Vyasa's favour. We are never satiated by hearing about the Jyotirlihgas.
verses.science: हाथमें कमण्डलु लेकर भक्तिपूर्वक वहाँ पहुँचे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: समानर्चुर्विशेषेण सर्वे देवर्षयः शिवम् । ब्रह्मा विष्णुः परे चैव त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: samānarcurviśeṣeṇa sarve devarṣayaḥ śivam | brahmā viṣṇuḥ pare caiva trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: O brahmins, if 1 remain in the company of you all, the glorious ones, I am blessed and contented. Blessed indeed is the association of saintly men.
verses.hindi: उलटे-सीधे वह सारा समाचार निवेदन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, if 1 remain in the company of you all, the glorious ones, I am blessed and contented. Blessed indeed is the association of saintly men.
verses.science: उलटे-सीधे वह सारा समाचार निवेदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नः शिवो जातः शिवा च जगदम्बिका । धृतं तया च तल्लिङ्गं तेन रूपेण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: suprasannaḥ śivo jātaḥ śivā ca jagadambikā | dhṛtaṃ tayā ca talliṅgaṃ tena rūpeṇa vai tadā
verses.translation: Hence, considering it my good fortune, I shall nar¬ rate the sanctifying sin-destroying divine story. Please listen to this story respectfully.
verses.hindi: महर्षिगण गौतमके ऊपर क्रुद्ध हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, considering it my good fortune, I shall nar¬ rate the sanctifying sin-destroying divine story. Please listen to this story respectfully.
verses.science: महर्षिगण गौतमके ऊपर क्रुद्ध हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकानां स्थापिते लिङ्गे कल्याणं चाभवत्तदा । प्रसिद्धं चैव तल्लिङ्गं त्रिलोक्यामभवद् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: lokānāṃ sthāpite liṅge kalyāṇaṃ cābhavattadā | prasiddhaṃ caiva talliṅgaṃ trilokyāmabhavad dvijāḥ
verses.translation: An excellent brahmin engrossed in the performance of auspicious rites lived there. He studied the Vedas and performed the Vedic rites.
verses.hindi: पूजन एवं उपहारोंद्वारा गणेशनीकी आराधना की
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent brahmin engrossed in the performance of auspicious rites lived there. He studied the Vedas and performed the Vedic rites.
verses.science: पूजन एवं उपहारोंद्वारा गणेशनीकी आराधना की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हाटकेशमिति ख्यातं तच्छिवाशिवमित्यपि । पूजनात्तस्य लोकानां सुखं भवति सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: hāṭakeśamiti khyātaṃ tacchivāśivamityapi | pūjanāttasya lokānāṃ sukhaṃ bhavati sarvathā
verses.translation: The brahmin maintained sacrificial fires. He was the devotee of Siva. Everyday he worshipped the idol of Siva.
verses.hindi: गये और यह वचन कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmin maintained sacrificial fires. He was the devotee of Siva. Everyday he worshipped the idol of Siva.
verses.science: गये और यह वचन कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इह सर्वसमृद्धिः स्यान्नानासुखवहाधिका । परत्र परमा मुक्तिर्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: iha sarvasamṛddhiḥ syānnānāsukhavahādhikā | paratra paramā muktirnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he had four sons like him. They were not inferior to their parents and they were ever en¬ gaged in the worship of Siva,
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, he had four sons like him. They were not inferior to their parents and they were ever en¬ gaged in the worship of Siva,
verses.science: महर्षियोंने कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever Vcdic rites were there in the shrines and holy centres were stopped by him. Dharma was exiled to a distant place.
verses.hindi: नहीं है, आप लोग दूसरा वरदान माँगिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever Vcdic rites were there in the shrines and holy centres were stopped by him. Dharma was exiled to a distant place.
verses.science: नहीं है, आप लोग दूसरा वरदान माँगिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever Vcdic rites were there in the shrines and holy centres were stopped by him. Dharma was exiled to a distant place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever Vcdic rites were there in the shrines and holy centres were stopped by him. Dharma was exiled to a distant place.
verses.science: ऋषियोंसे उदासीन मनसे कहा--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । बटुकोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । यथाभवल्लिङ्गरूपः सम्पूज्यस्त्रिभवे शिवः । तथोक्तं वा द्विजाः प्रीत्या किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.13. trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | baṭukotpattivarṇanam | sūta uvāca | yathābhavalliṅgarūpaḥ sampūjyastribhave śivaḥ | tathoktaṃ vā dvijāḥ prītyā kimanyacchrotumicchatha
verses.translation: "There is a beautiful city.Vvanti." Thinking that what the Asura did, hear.
verses.hindi: हुई वह गाय यव तथा धान चरने लगी
verses.commentary: Sense: "There is a beautiful city.Vvanti." Thinking that what the Asura did, hear.
verses.science: हुई वह गाय यव तथा धान चरने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । अन्धकेश्वरलिङ्गस्य महिमानं वद प्रभो । तथान्यच्छिवलिङ्गानां प्रीत्या वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | andhakeśvaraliṅgasya mahimānaṃ vada prabho | tathānyacchivaliṅgānāṃ prītyā vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the brahmins, the sons of
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, the brahmins, the sons of
verses.science: क्या करना चाहिए ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । पुराब्धिगर्तमाश्रित्य वसन् दैत्योऽन्धकासुरः । स्ववशं कारयामास त्रैलोक्यं सुरसूदनः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | purābdhigartamāśritya vasan daityo'ndhakāsuraḥ | svavaśaṃ kārayāmāsa trailokyaṃ surasūdanaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing to the benefactor of the worlds, the
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to the benefactor of the worlds, the
verses.science: भक्तिपूर्वक प्रणाम करके पुन: कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गर्ताच्च निःसृत्य पीडयित्वा पुनः प्रजाः । प्राविशच्च तदा दैत्यस्तं गर्तं सुपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tasmādgartācca niḥsṛtya pīḍayitvā punaḥ prajāḥ | prāviśacca tadā daityastaṃ gartaṃ suparākramaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen with interest to the devotion enhancing greatness of Mahakala, the protector of the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, listen with interest to the devotion enhancing greatness of Mahakala, the protector of the devotees.
verses.science: स्वरूपसे मेरे समीप निवास कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च दुःखिताः सर्वे शिवं प्रार्थ्य पुनःपुनः । सर्वं निवेदयामासुः स्वदुःखं च मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: devāśca duḥkhitāḥ sarve śivaṃ prārthya punaḥpunaḥ | sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsuḥ svaduḥkhaṃ ca munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing his city thus attacked by the kings, the king Candrasena sought refuge in Mahakalesvara.
verses.hindi: ड्र्ति जड़ 22 को मिकक कोटिरद्रसंहितायां त्यंबकेश्वरमाहात्प्यवर्णन॑ नाम बड्विंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his city thus attacked by the kings, the king Candrasena sought refuge in Mahakalesvara.
verses.science: ड्र्ति जड़ 22 को मिकक कोटिरद्रसंहितायां त्यंबकेश्वरमाहात्प्यवर्णन॑ नाम बड्विंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां देवानां परमेश्वरः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा दुष्टहन्ता सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tadākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ devānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | pratyuvāca prasannātmā duṣṭahantā satāṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: When the son did not come away even after being dragged and struck she threw the image far off and spoiled his worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the son did not come away even after being dragged and struck she threw the image far off and spoiled his worship.
verses.science: स्थानका नाम कुशावर्त रखा। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । घातयिष्यामि तं दैत्यमन्धकं सुरसूदनम् । सैन्यं च नीयतान्देवा ह्यायामि च गणैः सह
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | ghātayiṣyāmi taṃ daityamandhakaṃ surasūdanam | sainyaṃ ca nīyatāndevā hyāyāmi ca gaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: The king who had concluded the observance of rites during the night came there immediately and saw the refulgence of the cowherd's son in propitiating Siva.
verses.hindi: लिये उसने दूसरे प्रकारका तप करना प्रारम्भ किया
verses.commentary: Sense: The king who had concluded the observance of rites during the night came there immediately and saw the refulgence of the cowherd's son in propitiating Siva.
verses.science: लिये उसने दूसरे प्रकारका तप करना प्रारम्भ किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गर्तादन्धके हि देवर्षिद्रुहि भीकरे । निःसृते च तदा तस्मिन्देवा गर्तमुपाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tasmādgartādandhake hi devarṣidruhi bhīkare | niḥsṛte ca tadā tasmindevā gartamupāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Then they went to the house of the cowherdess. They praised her good fortune with divine blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they went to the house of the cowherdess. They praised her good fortune with divine blessings.
verses.science: हुई, उसे विस्तारसे कहिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दैत्याश्च देवताश्चैव युद्धं चक्रुः सुदारुणम् । शिवानुग्रहतो देवाः प्रबलाश्चाभवँस्तदा
verses.transliteration: daityāśca devatāścaiva yuddhaṃ cakruḥ sudāruṇam | śivānugrahato devāḥ prabalāścābhavam̐stadā
verses.translation: They were welcomed and honoured by Gandrasena there. Seated on a very worthy seat they congratulated him and were surprised.
verses.hindi: पत्नीसे कहा और वह बहुत आनन्दित हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: They were welcomed and honoured by Gandrasena there. Seated on a very worthy seat they congratulated him and were surprised.
verses.science: पत्नीसे कहा और वह बहुत आनन्दित हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवैश्च पीडितः सोऽपि यावद्गर्तमुपागतः । तावच्छूलेन सम्प्रोतः शिवेन परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: devaiśca pīḍitaḥ so'pi yāvadgartamupāgataḥ | tāvacchūlena samprotaḥ śivena paramātmanā
verses.translation: Accompanied by a vast army, the great Asura
verses.hindi: क्षण उन ऋषिके देखते-देखते मर गयी
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by a vast army, the great Asura
verses.science: क्षण उन ऋषिके देखते-देखते मर गयी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रत्यश्च तदा शम्भुं ध्यात्वा सम्प्रार्थयत्तदा । अन्तकाले च त्वां दृष्ट्वा तादृशो भवति क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tatratyaśca tadā śambhuṃ dhyātvā samprārthayattadā | antakāle ca tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśo bhavati kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: After reaching the place, that great knave, that hater of brahmins called four hefty Daityas to him and said these words.
verses.hindi: कहाँ जाऊँ? मुझे गोवधका पाप लग गया
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the place, that great knave, that hater of brahmins called four hefty Daityas to him and said these words.
verses.science: कहाँ जाऊँ? मुझे गोवधका पाप लग गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं संस्तुतः सोऽपि प्रसन्नः शङ्करस्तदा । उवाच वचनं तत्र वरं ब्रूहि ददामि ते
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ saṃstutaḥ so'pi prasannaḥ śaṅkarastadā | uvāca vacanaṃ tatra varaṃ brūhi dadāmi te
verses.translation: Why don't the wicked brahmins do as I say? Ali these, engaged in Vedic rites and rituals are worthy of being punished by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why don't the wicked brahmins do as I say? Ali these, engaged in Vedic rites and rituals are worthy of being punished by me.
verses.science: वचनोंसे उन्हें कष्ट देने लगीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा स दैत्यः पुनरब्रवीत् । सुप्रणम्य शिवं स्तुत्वा सत्त्वभावमुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sa daityaḥ punarabravīt | supraṇamya śivaṃ stutvā sattvabhāvamupāśritaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Daityas, the gods and the kings in the world have been defeated by me. Why should not the brahmins be kept in my control?
verses.hindi: निन्‍दा करके बार-बार उन्हें धिक्कारने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Daityas, the gods and the kings in the world have been defeated by me. Why should not the brahmins be kept in my control?
verses.science: निन्‍दा करके बार-बार उन्हें धिक्कारने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश स्वभक्तिं देहि मे शुभाम् । कृपां कृत्वा विशेषेण संस्थितो भव चेह वै
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca | yadi prasanno deveśa svabhaktiṃ dehi me śubhām | kṛpāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa saṃsthito bhava ceha vai
verses.translation: If they wish to live happily let them abandon the rites of Siva and the rituals of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: If they wish to live happily let them abandon the rites of Siva and the rituals of the Vedas.
verses.science: देखकर सचैल (वस्त्रसहित) स्नान करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तेन दैत्यं तं तद्गर्ते चाक्षिपद्धरः । स्वयं तत्र स्थितो लिङ्गरूपोऽसौ लोककाम्यया
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktastena daityaṃ taṃ tadgarte cākṣipaddharaḥ | svayaṃ tatra sthito liṅgarūpo'sau lokakāmyayā
verses.translation: On hearing this and receiving the instruction the four Daityas besieged the four quarters of the city like the fires of dissolution.
verses.hindi: विलम्बं कुरु नैव त्वं धेनुहन्पापकारक ॥ ४०  करो
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this and receiving the instruction the four Daityas besieged the four quarters of the city like the fires of dissolution.
verses.science: विलम्बं कुरु नैव त्वं धेनुहन्पापकारक ॥ ४० करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकेशं च तल्लिङ्गं नित्यं यः पूजयेन्नरः । षण्मासाज्जायते तस्य वाञ्छासिद्धिर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: andhakeśaṃ ca talliṅgaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pūjayennaraḥ | ṣaṇmāsājjāyate tasya vāñchāsiddhirna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On coming to know of the intent of the Daityas, the brahmins were not at all distressed because they were engaged in meditating on Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know of the intent of the Daityas, the brahmins were not at all distressed because they were engaged in meditating on Siva.
verses.science: बहुत अधिक दु:ख देने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृत्त्यर्थं पूजयेल्लिङ्गं लोकस्य हितकारकम् । षण्मासं यो द्विजश्चैव स वै देवलकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vṛttyarthaṃ pūjayelliṅgaṃ lokasya hitakārakam | ṣaṇmāsaṃ yo dvijaścaiva sa vai devalakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Resorting to courage, the brahmins did not move even a line's breadth from meditation. With liva to help who can remain in distress?
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to courage, the brahmins did not move even a line's breadth from meditation. With liva to help who can remain in distress?
verses.science: तुम्हारा कोई अधिकार नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवलकश्चैव स भवेदिह वै तदा । देवलकश्च यः प्रोक्तो नाधिकारो द्विजस्य हि
verses.transliteration: yathā devalakaścaiva sa bhavediha vai tadā | devalakaśca yaḥ prokto nādhikāro dvijasya hi
verses.translation: In the meantime, the whole of that auspicious city was overrun by them. The people were harassed and they rushed against the brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, the whole of that auspicious city was overrun by them. The people were harassed and they rushed against the brahmins.
verses.science: प्रार्थना करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ देवलकश्च कः प्रोक्तः किं कार्यं तस्य विद्यते । तत्त्वं वद महाप्राज्ञ लोकानां हितहेतवे
verses.transliteration: || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || devalakaśca kaḥ proktaḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ tasya vidyate | tattvaṃ vada mahāprājña lokānāṃ hitahetave
verses.translation: O holy lords, what shall be done? The wicked Asuras have come. People are tortured. They have come very near.
verses.hindi: हो सके, वह उपाय आपलोग बतायें
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lords, what shall be done? The wicked Asuras have come. People are tortured. They have come very near.
verses.science: हो सके, वह उपाय आपलोग बतायें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । दधीचिर्नाम विप्रो यो धर्मिष्ठो वेदपारगः । शिवभक्तिरतो नित्यं शिवशास्त्रपरायणः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | dadhīcirnāma vipro yo dharmiṣṭho vedapāragaḥ | śivabhaktirato nityaṃ śivaśāstraparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Listen, wc do not have an army to frighten the wicked Asuras. We do not have weapons to drive them back.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, wc do not have an army to frighten the wicked Asuras. We do not have weapons to drive them back.
verses.science: प्रायश्चित्त करो। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रस्तथा ह्यासीत्स्मृतो नाम्ना सुदर्शनः । तस्य भार्या दुकूला च नाम्ना दुष्टकुलोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: tasya putrastathā hyāsītsmṛto nāmnā sudarśanaḥ | tasya bhāryā dukūlā ca nāmnā duṣṭakulodbhavā
verses.translation: The general dishonour and insult reflect.s on him who supports us. Moreover, what can happen to Siva who is omnipotent?
verses.hindi: झति श्रीजशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्ध्या कोटिरसंहितायां गौतमव्यवस्थावर्णं नाम पञ्जविंशो5 ध्यायः
verses.commentary: Sense: The general dishonour and insult reflect.s on him who supports us. Moreover, what can happen to Siva who is omnipotent?
verses.science: झति श्रीजशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्ध्या कोटिरसंहितायां गौतमव्यवस्थावर्णं नाम पञ्जविंशो5 ध्यायः। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वशे स च भर्तासीत्तस्य पुत्रचतुष्टयम् । सोऽपि नित्यं शिवस्यैव पूजां च स्म करोत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: tadvaśe sa ca bhartāsīttasya putracatuṣṭayam | so'pi nityaṃ śivasyaiva pūjāṃ ca sma karotyasau
verses.translation: Let lord Siva protect us from the terror of the Asuras. Except Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees there is no other refuge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let lord Siva protect us from the terror of the Asuras. Except Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees there is no other refuge.
verses.science: नामक पतच्चीसवाँ अध्याय यूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दधीचेस्तु तदा ह्यासीद् ग्रामान्तरनिवेशनम् । ज्ञातिसंयोगतश्चैव ज्ञातिभिर्न स मोचितः
verses.transliteration: dadhīcestu tadā hyāsīd grāmāntaraniveśanam | jñātisaṃyogataścaiva jñātibhirna sa mocitaḥ
verses.translation: Emboldened thus they performed the worship of Siva's earthern idol. They sat firmly engaged in meditation. On seeing them thus the mighty Dusana shouted "Let them be killed. Let them be bound." But the brahmins, the sons of Vedapriya engrossed in meditation on Siva did not hear the shouts.
verses.wordMeaning: Emboldened thus they performed the worship of Siva's earthern idol. They sat firmly engaged in meditation. On seeing them thus the mighty Dusana shouted "Let them be killed. Let them be bound." But the brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Emboldened thus they performed the worship of Siva's earthern idol. They sat firmly engaged in meditation. On seeing them thus the mighty Dusana shouted "Let them be killed. Let them be bound." But the brahmins,…
verses.science: प्रसन्‍न हूँ, आप वर माँगिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कथयित्वा च पुत्रं स शिवभक्तिरतो भव । इत्युक्त्वा स गतो मुक्तो दधीचिः शैवसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kathayitvā ca putraṃ sa śivabhaktirato bhava | ityuktvā sa gato mukto dadhīciḥ śaivasattamaḥ
verses.translation: When the wicked Daitya desired to kill the brahmins, the spot near the Parthiva idol caved in with a loud report.,
verses.commentary: Sense: When the wicked Daitya desired to kill the brahmins, the spot near the Parthiva idol caved in with a loud report.,
verses.science: भक्तिपूर्वक स्तुति करने लगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनस्तत्पुत्रोऽपि शिवपूजां चकार ह । एवं चिरतरः कालो व्यतीयाय मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sudarśanastatputro'pi śivapūjāṃ cakāra ha | evaṃ cirataraḥ kālo vyatīyāya munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: From the chasm thus created, Siva rose up assuming a hideous form. He became famous as Mahakala, the slayer of the wicked and the goal of the good.
verses.hindi: लगे--हे देव! आप मुझे पापरहित करें
verses.commentary: Sense: From the chasm thus created, Siva rose up assuming a hideous form. He became famous as Mahakala, the slayer of the wicked and the goal of the good.
verses.science: लगे--हे देव! आप मुझे पापरहित करें। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं च शिवरात्रिश्च समायाता कदाचन । तस्यां चोपोषिताः सर्वे स्वयं संयोगतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ca śivarātriśca samāyātā kadācana | tasyāṃ copoṣitāḥ sarve svayaṃ saṃyogatastadā
verses.translation: "I am Mahakala (the great god of death) risen up against the wicked like you. O sinful one, go away, leave the presence of these brahmins."
verses.hindi: निश्चय ही आपके साथ छल किया है
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am Mahakala (the great god of death) risen up against the wicked like you. O sinful one, go away, leave the presence of these brahmins."
verses.science: निश्चय ही आपके साथ छल किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूजां कृत्वा गतः सोऽपि सुदर्शन इति स्मृतः । स्त्रीसङ्गं शिवरात्रौ तु कृत्वा पुनरिहागतः
verses.transliteration: pūjāṃ kṛtvā gataḥ so'pi sudarśana iti smṛtaḥ | strīsaṅgaṃ śivarātrau tu kṛtvā punarihāgataḥ
verses.translation: After saying this Siva reduced Dusana and his army, to ashes immediately with a mere sound of Hum.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this Siva reduced Dusana and his army, to ashes immediately with a mere sound of Hum.
verses.science: पापी हो सकते हैं ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न स्नानं तेन च कृतं तद्रात्र्यां शिवपूजनम् । तेन तत्कर्मपाकेन क्रुद्धः प्रोवाच शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: na snānaṃ tena ca kṛtaṃ tadrātryāṃ śivapūjanam | tena tatkarmapākena kruddhaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Dusana and a portion of his army too were killed by Siva the great soul. A part of the army fled.
verses.hindi: हैं, इनका कोई प्रायश्चित्त नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Dusana and a portion of his army too were killed by Siva the great soul. A part of the army fled.
verses.science: हैं, इनका कोई प्रायश्चित्त नहीं है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वर उवाच । शिवरात्र्यां त्वया दुष्ट सेवनं च स्त्रियाः कृतम् । अस्नातेन मदीया च कृता पूजाविवेकिना
verses.transliteration: maheśvara uvāca | śivarātryāṃ tvayā duṣṭa sevanaṃ ca striyāḥ kṛtam | asnātena madīyā ca kṛtā pūjāvivekinā
verses.translation: Divine drums were sounded. Shower of flowers fell. Viu, Brahma and other gods came there.
verses.hindi: उनसे ऋषियोंके बहुतसे दुश्चरित्रोंका वर्णन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: Divine drums were sounded. Shower of flowers fell. Viu, Brahma and other gods came there.
verses.science: उनसे ऋषियोंके बहुतसे दुश्चरित्रोंका वर्णन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा चैवं कृतं यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं जडतां व्रज । ममास्पृश्यो भव त्वं च दूरतो दर्शनं कुरु
verses.transliteration: jñātvā caivaṃ kṛtaṃ yasmāttasmāttvaṃ jaḍatāṃ vraja | mamāspṛśyo bhava tvaṃ ca dūrato darśanaṃ kuru
verses.translation: After consoling the brahmins the delighted Siva asked the Brahmins to choose the boon they wished to have.
verses.hindi: ही मेरा बहुत बड़ा स्वार्थ सिद्ध हुआ है
verses.commentary: Sense: After consoling the brahmins the delighted Siva asked the Brahmins to choose the boon they wished to have.
verses.science: ही मेरा बहुत बड़ा स्वार्थ सिद्ध हुआ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति शप्तो महेशेन दाधीचिः स सुदर्शनः । जडत्वं प्राप्तवान्सद्यः शिवमायाविमोहितः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śapto maheśena dādhīciḥ sa sudarśanaḥ | jaḍatvaṃ prāptavānsadyaḥ śivamāyāvimohitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it, the devout brahmins with palms joined in reverence and heads bent down bowed to Siva and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, the devout brahmins with palms joined in reverence and heads bent down bowed to Siva and said.
verses.science: देखकर शीघ्र ही उनसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये विप्रा दधीचिः शैवसत्तमः । ग्रामान्तरात्समायातो वृत्तान्तं श्रुतवाँश्च सः
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye viprā dadhīciḥ śaivasattamaḥ | grāmāntarātsamāyāto vṛttāntaṃ śrutavām̐śca saḥ
verses.translation: O lord, the chastiser of the wicked, O Siva, grant us liberation from the ocean of worldly existence. O Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the chastiser of the wicked, O Siva, grant us liberation from the ocean of worldly existence. O Siva.
verses.science: आप उत्तम वरदान माँगिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवेन भर्त्सितः सोऽपि दुःखितोऽभूदतीव हि । रुरोद हा हतोऽस्मीति दुःखेन सुतकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: śivena bhartsitaḥ so'pi duḥkhito'bhūdatīva hi | ruroda hā hato'smīti duḥkhena sutakarmaṇā
verses.translation: O Siva, you shall stay here itself for the protection of the people. O lord Siva, save those who see you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, you shall stay here itself for the protection of the people. O lord Siva, save those who see you.
verses.science: शिवजीसे यह वचन कहा--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनःपुनरुवाचेति स दधीचिः सतां मतः । अनेनेदं कुपुत्रेण हतं मे कुलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: punaḥpunaruvāceti sa dadhīciḥ satāṃ mataḥ | anenedaṃ kuputreṇa hataṃ me kulamuttamam
verses.translation: Requested thus, Siva remained in that auspicious chasm for the protection of his devotees after granting them the goal of the good.
verses.hindi: जैसा उन लोगोंने निर्णय दिया है, वही होने दीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Requested thus, Siva remained in that auspicious chasm for the protection of his devotees after granting them the goal of the good.
verses.science: जैसा उन लोगोंने निर्णय दिया है, वही होने दीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स पुत्रोऽपि हतो भार्यां पुंश्चलीमुक्तवान्द्रुतम् । पश्चात्तापमनुप्राप्य स्वपित्रा परिभर्त्सितः
verses.transliteration: sa putro'pi hato bhāryāṃ puṃścalīmuktavāndrutam | paścāttāpamanuprāpya svapitrā paribhartsitaḥ
verses.translation: The brahmins attained salvation. The supporting base of Siva in the form of Lihga extended to 3 kilometres in each of the four directions.
verses.hindi: नरकमें गिरते हुए मुझे भी आप पवित्र कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmins attained salvation. The supporting base of Siva in the form of Lihga extended to 3 kilometres in each of the four directions.
verses.science: नरकमें गिरते हुए मुझे भी आप पवित्र कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पित्रा गिरिजा तत्र पूजिता विधिभिर्वरैः । सुयत्नतो महाभक्त्या स्वपुत्रसुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: tatpitrā girijā tatra pūjitā vidhibhirvaraiḥ | suyatnato mahābhaktyā svaputrasukhahetave
verses.translation: O brahmins, Siva became famous as Mahakales- vara. On seeing this image no one will have misery even in dreams.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, Siva became famous as Mahakales- vara. On seeing this image no one will have misery even in dreams.
