verses.commentary: Sense: O Sadaiva, save the living beings from the ocean of world!/ existence. O Siva, carry out the task of your devotees. I request you again and again.
verses.science: कारिणी शक्तिसे संयुक्त। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजान ऊचुः । अयं राजा चन्द्रसेनः शिवभक्तोऽतिदुर्जयः । उज्जयिन्या महाकालपुर्याः पतिरनाकुलः
verses.transliteration: rājāna ūcuḥ | ayaṃ rājā candrasenaḥ śivabhakto'tidurjayaḥ | ujjayinyā mahākālapuryāḥ patiranākulaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by ViSvanatha, Siva the sovereign ruler of all, stayed there for rendering help to the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by ViSvanatha, Siva the sovereign ruler of all, stayed there for rendering help to the people.
verses.science: परम तपः--उत्कृष्ट तपस्यास्वरूप। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशाः शिशवो यस्य पुर्यां सन्ति शिवव्रताः । स राजा चन्द्रसेनस्तु महाशङ्करसेवकः
verses.transliteration: īdṛśāḥ śiśavo yasya puryāṃ santi śivavratāḥ | sa rājā candrasenastu mahāśaṅkarasevakaḥ
verses.translation: KaSi became the most excellent centre for all since Siva came to Kai.
verses.commentary: Sense: KaSi became the most excellent centre for all since Siva came to Kai.
verses.science: मन और वाणीके अविषय। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नूनमस्य विरोधेन शिवः क्रोधं करिष्यति । तत्क्रोधाद्धि वयं सर्वे भविष्यामो विनष्टकाः
verses.transliteration: nūnamasya virodhena śivaḥ krodhaṃ kariṣyati | tatkrodhāddhi vayaṃ sarve bhaviṣyāmo vinaṣṭakāḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall explain neatly and succinctly the splendid greatness of Varanasi and Vi5ve5vara. May it be listened to.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall explain neatly and succinctly the splendid greatness of Varanasi and Vi5ve5vara. May it be listened to.
verses.science: महाबलः:--महान् उत्साह और बलसे सम्पन्न। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनेन राज्ञा वै मिलापः कार्य एव हि । एवं सति महेशानः करिष्यति कृपां पराम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādanena rājñā vai milāpaḥ kārya eva hi | evaṃ sati maheśānaḥ kariṣyati kṛpāṃ parām
verses.translation: Once goddess Parvati asked Siva with great joy about the greatness of the two Avimuktas—Kasi and VHve4- vara, out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once goddess Parvati asked Siva with great joy about the greatness of the two Avimuktas—Kasi and VHve4- vara, out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.science: एवं श्रेष्ठ कान्तिसे सम्पन्न। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति निश्चित्य ते भूपास्त्यक्तवैराः सदाशयाः । सर्वे बभूवुः सुप्रीता न्यस्तशस्त्रास्त्रपाणयः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti niścitya te bhūpāstyaktavairāḥ sadāśayāḥ | sarve babhūvuḥ suprītā nyastaśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: It behoves you to explain the greatness of this shrine entirely | taking pity on me and desiring the benefit of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to explain the greatness of this shrine entirely | taking pity on me and desiring the benefit of the worlds.
verses.science: भी प्रकाश देनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विविशुस्ते पुरीं रम्यां महाकालस्य भूभृतः । महाकालं समानर्चुश्चन्द्रसेनानुमोदिताः
verses.transliteration: viviśuste purīṃ ramyāṃ mahākālasya bhūbhṛtaḥ | mahākālaṃ samānarcuścandrasenānumoditāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words oi the goddess, the lord of the gods, the lord of the universe, replied to hei* for the pleasure of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words oi the goddess, the lord of the gods, the lord of the universe, replied to hei* for the pleasure of all living beings.
verses.science: नन्‍्दी नामक वृषभपर सवार होनेवाले। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते गोपवनितागेहं जग्मुर्महीभृतः । प्रशंसन्तश्च तद्भाग्यं सर्वे दिव्यमहोदयम्
verses.transliteration: tataste gopavanitāgehaṃ jagmurmahībhṛtaḥ | praśaṃsantaśca tadbhāgyaṃ sarve divyamahodayam
verses.translation: What, gentle lady, has been asked by you is splendid. It is auspicious and pleasing to the people. I shall explain as a matter of fact the greatness of the two Avimuktas.
verses.commentary: Sense: What, gentle lady, has been asked by you is splendid. It is auspicious and pleasing to the people. I shall explain as a matter of fact the greatness of the two Avimuktas.
verses.science: स्वरूप तीर्थको देनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ते तत्र चन्द्रसेनेन प्रत्युद्गम्याभिपूजिताः । महार्हविष्टरगताः प्रत्यनन्दन् सुविस्मिताः
verses.transliteration: te tatra candrasenena pratyudgamyābhipūjitāḥ | mahārhaviṣṭaragatāḥ pratyanandan suvismitāḥ
verses.translation: In this holy centre, the Siddhas have always taken to my holy rites. They hold different phallic images. They yearn to attain my world.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this holy centre, the Siddhas have always taken to my holy rites. They hold different phallic images. They yearn to attain my world.
verses.science: अखिलब्रह्माण्ड-स्वरूप। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोपसूनोः प्रसादात्तत्प्रादुर्भूतं शिवालयम् । संवीक्ष्य शिवलिङ्गं च शिवे चक्रुः परां मतिम्
verses.transliteration: gopasūnoḥ prasādāttatprādurbhūtaṃ śivālayam | saṃvīkṣya śivaliṅgaṃ ca śive cakruḥ parāṃ matim
verses.translation: Those who have conquered themselves and controlled their sense>organs pursue the great Paupata Yoga which is explained in the Vedas, yielding worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered themselves and controlled their sense>organs pursue the great Paupata Yoga which is explained in the Vedas, yielding worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.science: भगवती शिवाके आश्रय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते गोपशिशवे प्रीता निखिलभूभुजः । ददुर्बहूनि वस्तूनि तस्मै शिवकृपार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: tataste gopaśiśave prītā nikhilabhūbhujaḥ | dadurbahūni vastūni tasmai śivakṛpārthinaḥ
verses.translation: They must be known as liberated souls, no matter where they die. They are sure to attain salvation. This decisive word has been uttered by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: They must be known as liberated souls, no matter where they die. They are sure to attain salvation. This decisive word has been uttered by me.
verses.science: संसारचक्रको धारण करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये ये सर्वेषु देशेषु गोपास्तिष्ठन्ति भूरिशः । तेषां तमेव राजानं चक्रिरे सर्वपार्थिवाः
verses.transliteration: ye ye sarveṣu deśeṣu gopāstiṣṭhanti bhūriśaḥ | teṣāṃ tameva rājānaṃ cakrire sarvapārthivāḥ
verses.translation: Here in this excellent holy centre Avimukta, there is one special thing to be noted. O goddess, O great Sakti, Iease listen attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here in this excellent holy centre Avimukta, there is one special thing to be noted. O goddess, O great Sakti, Iease listen attentively.
verses.science: रविलोचनः--सूर्यरूप नेत्रवाले। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे सर्वैस्त्रिदशैरभिपूजितः । प्रादुर्बभूव तेजस्वी हनूमान् वानरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: athāsminnantare sarvaistridaśairabhipūjitaḥ | prādurbabhūva tejasvī hanūmān vānareśvaraḥ
verses.translation: People of all castes, of all stages of life, whether childin, youths or the aged, if they die in this city, are undoubtedly liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: People of all castes, of all stages of life, whether childin, youths or the aged, if they die in this city, are undoubtedly liberated.
verses.science: परम पावन हैं, ऐसे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ते तस्याभिगमादेव राजानो जातसम्भ्रमाः । प्रत्युत्थाय नमश्चकुर्भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: te tasyābhigamādeva rājāno jātasambhramāḥ | pratyutthāya namaścakurbhaktinamrātmamūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: O bra hmin s, whether pure or impure, whether virgin or married, whether widow or barren, whether suffering from menstrual disorders or defects or whether recently delivered of a child, of whatever nature she may be, if she
verses.commentary: Sense: O bra hmin s, whether pure or impure, whether virgin or married, whether widow or barren, whether suffering from menstrual disorders or defects or whether recently delivered of a child, of whatever nature she may be, if she
verses.science: रुचिराष्रदः--सुन्दर बाजूबन्द धारण करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये समासीनः पूजितः प्लवगेश्वरः । गोपात्मजं तमालिङ्ग्य राज्ञो वीक्ष्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ madhye samāsīnaḥ pūjitaḥ plavageśvaraḥ | gopātmajaṃ tamāliṅgya rājño vīkṣyedamabravīt
verses.translation: The sweat-born, (lice, bugs etc.) the egg-born (birds), the germinating ones (plants and trees) and the embryo-born (mammals) these living beings do not attain salvation elsewhere as they do at this place.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sweat-born, (lice, bugs etc.) the egg-born (birds), the germinating ones (plants and trees) and the embryo-born (mammals) these living beings do not attain salvation elsewhere as they do at this place.
verses.science: अतिशय भयदायक पराक्रमसे युक्त। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हनूमानुवाच । सर्वे शृण्वन्तु भद्रं वो राजानो ये च देहिनः । ऋते शिवं नान्यतमो गतिरस्ति शरीरिणाम्
verses.transliteration: hanūmānuvāca | sarve śṛṇvantu bhadraṃ vo rājāno ye ca dehinaḥ | ṛte śivaṃ nānyatamo gatirasti śarīriṇām
verses.translation: There is no dependence on culture, nor that on meditation at anytime, nor that on repetition of names, nor that on adoration, nor that even on noble nativity.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no dependence on culture, nor that on meditation at anytime, nor that on repetition of names, nor that on adoration, nor that even on noble nativity.
verses.science: भक्तलोकधृक्--भक्तजनोंके आश्रय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं गोपसुतो दिष्ट्या शिवपूजां विलोक्य च । अमन्त्रेणापि सम्पूज्य शिवं शिवमवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ gopasuto diṣṭyā śivapūjāṃ vilokya ca | amantreṇāpi sampūjya śivaṃ śivamavāptavān
verses.translation: Whoever may be the man staying in my holy centre, whatever may be the manner of his death, if he dies here, he certainly attains salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whoever may be the man staying in my holy centre, whatever may be the manner of his death, if he dies here, he certainly attains salvation.
verses.science: देवशत्रुओंका संहार करनेवाले। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एष भक्तवरः शम्भोर्गोपानां कीर्तिवर्धनः । इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगानन्ते मोक्षमवाप्स्यति
verses.transliteration: eṣa bhaktavaraḥ śambhorgopānāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ | iha bhuktvākhilānbhogānante mokṣamavāpsyati
verses.translation: Any being, enjoying pleasures at his will, sleeping, sporting or performing different activities, attains salvation if he casts off his life at Avimukta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Any being, enjoying pleasures at his will, sleeping, sporting or performing different activities, attains salvation if he casts off his life at Avimukta.
verses.science: स्वयंज्योतिस्तनुज्योतिरात्मज्योतिरचञज्चलः ॥ ६६ रहित। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य वंशेऽष्टमो भावी नन्दो नाम महायशाः । प्राप्स्यते तस्य पुत्रत्वं कृष्णो नारायणः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: asya vaṃśe'ṣṭamo bhāvī nando nāma mahāyaśāḥ | prāpsyate tasya putratvaṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Hence the people resort to Kai with every strenuous effort. The sages meditate on Sadariva in the form of his phallic image.
verses.hindi: ही जिनका दर्शन होता है, ऐसे
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the people resort to Kai with every strenuous effort. The sages meditate on Sadariva in the form of his phallic image.
verses.science: ही जिनका दर्शन होता है, ऐसे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन्नेष गोपकुमारकः । नाम्ना श्रीकर इत्युच्चैर्लोकख्यातिं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti loke'sminneṣa gopakumārakaḥ | nāmnā śrīkara ityuccairlokakhyātiṃ gamiṣyati
verses.translation: O beloved, I distribute the different fruits among different men who perform penance with those ends in view.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, I distribute the different fruits among different men who perform penance with those ends in view.
verses.science: पदाश्रय:--स्वाधिष्ठान चक्रके आश्रय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवमुक्त्वाञ्जनीसूनुः शिवरूपो हरीश्वरः । सर्वान् राज्ञश्चन्द्रसेनं कृपादृष्ट्या ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | evamuktvāñjanīsūnuḥ śivarūpo harīśvaraḥ | sarvān rājñaścandrasenaṃ kṛpādṛṣṭyā dadarśa ha
verses.translation: Brahma along with the gods and the sages, Vi$nu, the sun, and all other noble souls perform my worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma along with the gods and the sages, Vi$nu, the sun, and all other noble souls perform my worship.
verses.science: धनके स्वामी कुबेर। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मै श्रीकराय गोपपुत्राय धीमते । उपादिदेश सुप्रीत्या शिवाचारं शिवप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: atha tasmai śrīkarāya gopaputrāya dhīmate | upādideśa suprītyā śivācāraṃ śivapriyam
verses.translation: He who dies in this holy centre does not get rebirth even if he happens to be a person whose mind is drawn towards sensual pleasures or who has eschewed interest in virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dies in this holy centre does not get rebirth even if he happens to be a person whose mind is drawn towards sensual pleasures or who has eschewed interest in virtue.
verses.science: नागहारधृक्ू--सर्पमय हार धारण करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हनूमानथ सुप्रीतः सर्वेषां पश्यतां द्विजाः । चन्द्रसेनं श्रीकरं च तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: hanūmānatha suprītaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ dvijāḥ | candrasenaṃ śrīkaraṃ ca tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: What then, if they aie free from attachment, devoid of arrogance, possessd of Sattvaic nature, blessed ones devoted to me and not initiating evil activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: What then, if they aie free from attachment, devoid of arrogance, possessd of Sattvaic nature, blessed ones devoted to me and not initiating evil activities.
verses.science: सत्यपराक्रम:--सच्चे पराक्रमी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं सर्वे च महीपालाः संहृष्टाः प्रतिपूजिताः । चन्द्रसेनं समामन्त्र्य प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ sarve ca mahīpālāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pratipūjitāḥ | candrasenaṃ samāmantrya pratijagmuryathāgatam
verses.translation: O Parvati, there are many phallic forms installed by my devotees. They yield all desires and bestow salvation too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Parvati, there are many phallic forms installed by my devotees. They yield all desires and bestow salvation too.
verses.science: ६१०. विक्रमोन्नत:--पराक्रममें बढ़े-चढ़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकरोऽपि महातेजा उपदिष्टो हनूमता । ब्राह्मणैः सह धर्मज्ञैश्चक्रे शम्भोः समर्हणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīkaro'pi mahātejā upadiṣṭo hanūmatā | brāhmaṇaiḥ saha dharmajñaiścakre śambhoḥ samarhaṇam
verses.translation: If a sinless man dies, he attains salvation immediately. If a sinner dies here he assumes multitudes of births.
verses.hindi: निदाधस्तपनो मेघः स्वक्षः परपुरक्षयः॥८०  त्रिपुररूप शत्रुनगरीपर विजय पानेवाले
verses.commentary: Sense: If a sinless man dies, he attains salvation immediately. If a sinner dies here he assumes multitudes of births.
verses.science: निदाधस्तपनो मेघः स्वक्षः परपुरक्षयः॥८० त्रिपुररूप शत्रुनगरीपर विजय पानेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसेनो महाराजः श्रीकरो गोपबालकः । उभावपि परप्रीत्या महाकालं च भेजतुः
verses.transliteration: candraseno mahārājaḥ śrīkaro gopabālakaḥ | ubhāvapi paraprītyā mahākālaṃ ca bhejatuḥ
verses.translation: He attains salvation only after experiencing tortures. He who commits sins in the holy centre of Avimukta, experiences tortures at the hands of Bhairava for ten thousand years and then attains salvation, O beauti¬ ful lady.
verses.commentary: Sense: He attains salvation only after experiencing tortures. He who commits sins in the holy centre of Avimukta, experiences tortures at the hands of Bhairava for ten thousand years and then attains salvation, O beauti¬ ful lady.
verses.science: बीजोंकी प्राप्ति करानेवाला शरत्काल। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालेन श्रीकरः सोऽपि चन्द्रसेनश्च भूपतिः । समाराध्य महाकालं भेजतुः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: kālena śrīkaraḥ so'pi candrasenaśca bhūpatiḥ | samārādhya mahākālaṃ bhejatuḥ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Thus the course of events in regard to one who commits sins has been narrated to you. A man should realise this and worship Avimukta properly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the course of events in regard to one who commits sins has been narrated to you. A man should realise this and worship Avimukta properly.
verses.science: जगत्को निगल जानेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधो महाकालः शिवलिङ्गः सतां गतिः । सर्वथा दुष्टहन्ता च शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidho mahākālaḥ śivaliṅgaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ | sarvathā duṣṭahantā ca śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: The birth will be good or evil in accordance widi the predominance or deficiency of the one or the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: The birth will be good or evil in accordance widi the predominance or deficiency of the one or the other.
verses.science: चतुर पुरुषोंके प्रिय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं पवित्रं परमं रहस्यं सर्वसौख्यदम् । आख्यानं कथितं स्वर्ग्यं शिवभक्तिविवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ sarvasaukhyadam | ākhyānaṃ kathitaṃ svargyaṃ śivabhaktivivardhanam
verses.translation: O great goddess, the action that causes bondage is said to be threefold as mentioned in the Karmakd section of the Vedas. It is (1) hoarded (Saficita) (2) the current (Kriyamana) and (3) that which has started yielding results (Prarabdha).
verses.commentary: Sense: O great goddess, the action that causes bondage is said to be threefold as mentioned in the Karmakd section of the Vedas. It is (1) hoarded (Saficita) (2) the current (Kriyamana) and (3) that which has started yielding results (Prarabdha).
verses.science: अचर सम्पूर्ण रूपवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: If Kai had been visited with devotion in the pre¬ vious birth, the person in the present birth reaches Ka5i and dies there and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: If Kai had been visited with devotion in the pre¬ vious birth, the person in the present birth reaches Ka5i and dies there and not otherwise.
verses.science: गम्भीर नाद करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: If Kai had been visited with devotion in the pre¬ vious birth, the person in the present birth reaches Ka5i and dies there and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: If Kai had been visited with devotion in the pre¬ vious birth, the person in the present birth reaches Ka5i and dies there and not otherwise.
verses.science: ब्रह्माजीसे रुद्ररूपमें उत्पन्न। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । ओङ्कारेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग श्राविता ह्यद्भुता कथा । महाकालाख्यलिङ्गस्य निजभक्तसुरक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.18. aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | oṅkāreśvarajyotirliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | sūta sūta mahābhāga śrāvitā hyadbhutā kathā | mahākālākhyaliṅgasya nijabhaktasurakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: If after reaching Ka§i a man takes his ceremonial bath in the Ganges, the two types of actions viz. the current and the hoarded are destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: If after reaching Ka§i a man takes his ceremonial bath in the Ganges, the two types of actions viz. the current and the hoarded are destroyed.
verses.science: सर्वभूतमहेश्वर: --सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके परमेश्वर। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं चतुर्थं च कृपया वद वित्तम । ओंङ्कारे परमेशस्य सर्वपातकहारिणः
verses.transliteration: jyotirliṅgaṃ caturthaṃ ca kṛpayā vada vittama | oṃṅkāre parameśasya sarvapātakahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the drought, the sages and the brahmins spent the horrible time in meditation and performing Pranayamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the drought, the sages and the brahmins spent the horrible time in meditation and performing Pranayamas.
verses.science: दान और वृद्धि करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । ओंङ्कारे परमेशाख्यं लिङ्गमासीद्यथा द्विजाः । तथा वक्ष्यामि वः प्रीत्या श्रूयतां परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | oṃṅkāre parameśākhyaṃ liṅgamāsīdyathā dvijāḥ | tathā vakṣyāmi vaḥ prītyā śrūyatāṃ paramarṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Then lord Varuna the king of waters spoke to Gautama, the excellent sage, eager to help others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Varuna the king of waters spoke to Gautama, the excellent sage, eager to help others.
verses.science: निवारण करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चित्समये चात्र नारदो भगवान्मुनिः । गोकर्णाख्यं शिवं गत्वा सिषेवे परभक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: kasmiṃścitsamaye cātra nārado bhagavānmuniḥ | gokarṇākhyaṃ śivaṃ gatvā siṣeve parabhaktimān
verses.translation: O great sage, let there be a perennial supply of water in this ditch that has become sacred. This will be¬ come famous on the earth by your name.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, let there be a perennial supply of water in this ditch that has become sacred. This will be¬ come famous on the earth by your name.
verses.science: महामणि कौस्तुभादिरूप। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स आगतो विन्ध्यं नगेशं मुनिसत्तमः । तत्रैव पूजितस्तेन बहुमानपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa āgato vindhyaṃ nageśaṃ munisattamaḥ | tatraiva pūjitastena bahumānapuraḥsaram
verses.translation: Charitable gifts made here, rites performed here, penance pursued here, the sacrifices done here for the gods and the raddha offered to the manes, everything will be imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Charitable gifts made here, rites performed here, penance pursued here, the sacrifices done here for the gods and the raddha offered to the manes, everything will be imperishable.
verses.science: तथा सत्पुरुषोंक आश्रय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मयि सर्वं विद्यते च न न्यूनं हि कदाचन । इति भावं समास्थाय संस्थितो नारदाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: mayi sarvaṃ vidyate ca na nyūnaṃ hi kadācana | iti bhāvaṃ samāsthāya saṃsthito nāradāgrataḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord eulogised by that sage vanished. After rendering help to others, the sage Gautama too was happy.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the lord eulogised by that sage vanished. After rendering help to others, the sage Gautama too was happy.
verses.science: विश्वृद्डल:--बन्धनरहित। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्मानं तत्तदा श्रुत्वा नारदो मानहा ततः । निःश्वस्य संस्थितस्तत्र श्रुत्वा विन्ध्योऽब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration: tanmānaṃ tattadā śrutvā nārado mānahā tataḥ | niḥśvasya saṃsthitastatra śrutvā vindhyo'bravīdidam
verses.translation: Man attains fruits in accordance with the nature of the man one serves. Loftiness is achieved by serving the great and meanness by serving the mean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Man attains fruits in accordance with the nature of the man one serves. Loftiness is achieved by serving the great and meanness by serving the mean.
verses.science: महाभुज:--बड़ी बाँहवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्य उवाच । किं न्यूनं च त्वया दृष्टं मयि निः श्वासकारणम् । तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्स महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: vindhya uvāca | kiṃ nyūnaṃ ca tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ mayi niḥ śvāsakāraṇam | tacchrutvā nārado vākyamabravītsa mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: Trees, gold, sandal paste and the sugarcane exist for the enjoyment of the people. Men similarly competoit arc very rare in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trees, gold, sandal paste and the sugarcane exist for the enjoyment of the people. Men similarly competoit arc very rare in the world.
verses.science: ९८६. रसप्रिय:--ब्रह्मानन्दरसके प्रेमी। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । विद्यते त्वयि सर्वं हि मेरुरुच्चतरः पुनः । देवेष्वपि विभागोऽस्य न तवास्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | vidyate tvayi sarvaṃ hi meruruccataraḥ punaḥ | deveṣvapi vibhāgo'sya na tavāsti kadācana
verses.translation: A kind man, a man unpufied by arrogance a person habitually helping others and a person with peri*.;ct control over his sense-organs, these are the four holy pillars that support the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: A kind man, a man unpufied by arrogance a person habitually helping others and a person with peri*.;ct control over his sense-organs, these are the four holy pillars that support the earth.
verses.science: रात्रिके स्वामी चन्द्रमारूप। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा नारदस्तस्माज्जगाम च यथागतम् । विन्ध्यश्च परितप्तो वै धिग्वै मे जीवितादिकम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā nāradastasmājjagāma ca yathāgatam | vindhyaśca paritapto vai dhigvai me jīvitādikam
verses.translation: Then his sins are reduced to ashes. Hence a man shall resort to K&li. That certainly debars Karmans to fructify.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then his sins are reduced to ashes. Hence a man shall resort to K&li. That certainly debars Karmans to fructify.
verses.science: ७५८. नागभूषण:--नागहारसे विभूषित। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरं तथा शम्भुमाराध्य च तपाम्यहम् । इति निश्चित्य मनसा शङ्करं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: viśveśvaraṃ tathā śambhumārādhya ca tapāmyaham | iti niścitya manasā śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Man's actions are classified into three categories, viz. (i) past actions still unfructified, (ii) past actions beginning to fructify
verses.commentary: Sense: Man's actions are classified into three categories, viz. (i) past actions still unfructified, (ii) past actions beginning to fructify
verses.science: मृडो नट:--सुखदायक एवं ताण्डवनृत्यकारी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जगाम तत्र सुप्रीत्या ह्योङ्कारो यत्र वै स्वयम् । चकार च पुनस्तत्र शिवमूर्तिं च पार्थिवीम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma tatra suprītyā hyoṅkāro yatra vai svayam | cakāra ca punastatra śivamūrtiṃ ca pārthivīm
verses.translation: If both the desire for worldly enjoyment and salvation are fulfilled at Prayaga, the fruit of salvation derived from residence in Kaii is likely to be in vain. If only the fruit of salvation is the goal, the fruits of Prayaga are likely to be in vain.***
verses.commentary: Sense: If both the desire for worldly enjoyment and salvation are fulfilled at Prayaga, the fruit of salvation derived from residence in Kaii is likely to be in vain. If only the fruit of salvation is the goal, the fruits of Prayaga are likely to be in vain.***
verses.science: ७८२. अनामय:--रोग-शोकसे रहित। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य च तदा शम्भुं षण्मासं स निरन्तरम् । न चचाल तपःस्थानाच्छिवध्यानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: ārādhya ca tadā śambhuṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ sa nirantaram | na cacāla tapaḥsthānācchivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Hence at my behest, Vinu creates something afresh and accords him the fruit as mentally conceived by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence at my behest, Vinu creates something afresh and accords him the fruit as mentally conceived by him.
verses.science: सत्यपरायण:--सत्यनिष्ठ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विन्ध्यतपो दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्नः पार्वतीपतिः । स्वरूपं दर्शयामास दुर्लभं योगिनामपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vindhyatapo dṛṣṭvā prasannaḥ pārvatīpatiḥ | svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa durlabhaṃ yogināmapi
verses.translation: O excellent sages, such things constitute the great* ness of KaI and VisveSvara yielding worldly pleasures and salvation to the good.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, such things constitute the great* ness of KaI and VisveSvara yielding worldly pleasures and salvation to the good.
verses.science: शस्त्रधारियोंमें श्रेष्ठ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नः स तदोवाच ब्रूहि त्वं मनसेप्सितम् । तपसा ते प्रसन्नोऽस्मि भक्तानामीप्सितप्रदः
verses.transliteration: prasannaḥ sa tadovāca brūhi tvaṃ manasepsitam | tapasā te prasanno'smi bhaktānāmīpsitapradaḥ
verses.translation: Hereafter I shall explain the greatness of Tryaih* baka on hearing which a man gets rid of his sins altogether.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hereafter I shall explain the greatness of Tryaih* baka on hearing which a man gets rid of his sins altogether.
verses.science: --शोकका नाश करने-वाले। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्य उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश बुद्धिं देहि यथेप्सिताम् । स्वकार्यसाधिनीं शम्भो त्वं सदा भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: vindhya uvāca | yadi prasanno deveśa buddhiṃ dehi yathepsitām | svakāryasādhinīṃ śambho tvaṃ sadā bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: The holy Prayiga yields worldly desiret as well as emanci* uation; the holy KSlI grants emancipation only. For him who desires Doth the worldly enjoyment and emancipation, Kfili is useless, for he can get these at PraySsa. For him wno desires emancipation alone prayiga is of no avail, for he can get the same at KSI.
verses.wordMeaning: The holy Prayiga yields worldly desiret as well as emanci* uation; the holy KSlI grants emancipation only. For him who desires Doth the worldly enjoyment and emancipation, Kfili is useless, for he can get these at PraySsa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy Prayiga yields worldly desiret as well as emanci* uation; the holy KSlI grants emancipation only. For him who desires Doth the worldly enjoyment and emancipation, Kfili is useless, for he can get these at PraySsa.…
verses.science: विशाम्पति:-- प्रजाओंके पालक। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान् शम्भुश्चिचेत हृदये चिरम् । परोपतापदं विन्ध्यो वरमिच्छति मूढधीः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tacchrutvā bhagavān śambhuściceta hṛdaye ciram | paropatāpadaṃ vindhyo varamicchati mūḍhadhīḥ
verses.translation: A penance extending to ten thousand years was performed by him on the Brahmagiri'*® mountain in the southern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: A penance extending to ten thousand years was performed by him on the Brahmagiri'*® mountain in the southern quarter.
verses.science: चालवाले, ८४१. वयः--गरुड़ पक्षी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि यदेतस्मै वरदानं भवेच्छुभम् । मद्दत्तं परदुःखाय वरदानं यथा न हि
verses.transliteration: kiṃ karomi yadetasmai varadānaṃ bhavecchubham | maddattaṃ paraduḥkhāya varadānaṃ yathā na hi
verses.translation: O great ones of good rites, once a terrible drought lasting for a hundred years occurred there. All the people were put to great distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great ones of good rites, once a terrible drought lasting for a hundred years occurred there. All the people were put to great distress.
verses.science: सदागति:--निरन्तर गतिशील वायुदेवता। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तथापि दत्तवान् शम्भुस्तस्मै तद्वरमुत्तमम् । विन्ध्य पर्वतराज त्वं यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tathāpi dattavān śambhustasmai tadvaramuttamam | vindhya parvatarāja tvaṃ yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: Then the sages and other men, the beasts, birds and the deer of the forest went to the different quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sages and other men, the beasts, birds and the deer of the forest went to the different quarters.
verses.science: प्रिय:--ब्राह्मणोंके प्रेमी। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं च समये देवा ऋषयश्चामलाशयाः । सम्पूज्य शङ्करं तत्र स्थातव्यमिति चाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ca samaye devā ṛṣayaścāmalāśayāḥ | sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ tatra sthātavyamiti cābruvan
verses.translation: Gautama himself performed an auspicions penance of Varuna for six months engrossed in Pranayama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gautama himself performed an auspicions penance of Varuna for six months engrossed in Pranayama.
verses.science: समस्त ऋतुओंको बदलते रहनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा देववचनं प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः । तथैव कृतवान्प्रीत्या लोकानां सुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā devavacanaṃ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tathaiva kṛtavānprītyā lokānāṃ sukhahetave
verses.translation: Then Varuna came there to grant him the boon. He said —'T am delighted. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall grant it.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Varuna came there to grant him the boon. He said —'T am delighted. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall grant it.'*
verses.science: दुष्टोंके ऐश्वर्यका नाश करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारं चैव यल्लिङ्गमेकं तच्च द्विधा गतम् । प्रणवे चैव ओङ्कारनामासीत्स सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāraṃ caiva yalliṅgamekaṃ tacca dvidhā gatam | praṇave caiva oṅkāranāmāsītsa sadāśivaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, then Gautama requested him for rain. Then Varuna replied to the sage.
verses.hindi: अनेकरूप होकर अनेक प्रकारके कर्म करनेवाले
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, then Gautama requested him for rain. Then Varuna replied to the sage.
verses.science: अनेकरूप होकर अनेक प्रकारके कर्म करनेवाले। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवे चैव यज्जातं तदासीत्परमेश्वरः । भक्ताभीष्टप्रदौ चोभौ भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pārthive caiva yajjātaṃ tadāsītparameśvaraḥ | bhaktābhīṣṭapradau cobhau bhuktimuktipradau dvijāḥ
verses.translation: How can I countermand the behest of the gods? Please ask for something else. You are a wise man. I shall grant it.
verses.commentary: Sense: How can I countermand the behest of the gods? Please ask for something else. You are a wise man. I shall grant it.
verses.science: प्रीतिवर्धन:--प्रेम बढ़ानेवाले। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पूजां च तदा चक्रुर्देवाश्च ऋषयस्तथा । प्रापुर्वराननेकांश्च सन्तोष्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: tatpūjāṃ ca tadā cakrurdevāśca ṛṣayastathā | prāpurvarānanekāṃśca santoṣya vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Varuna the great Atman, Gautama, eager to help others spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Varuna the great Atman, Gautama, eager to help others spoke thus.
verses.science: यशोधन:--सुयशके धनी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्वस्थानं ययुर्देवा विन्ध्योऽपि मुदितोऽधिकम् । कार्यं साधितवान्स्वीयं परितापं जहौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: svasvasthānaṃ yayurdevā vindhyo'pi mudito'dhikam | kāryaṃ sādhitavānsvīyaṃ paritāpaṃ jahau dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon is to be granted to me, you shall grant it according to my desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon is to be granted to me, you shall grant it according to my desire.
verses.science: श्रुतिप्रकाश: श्रुतिमानेकबन्धुरनेककृत्॥ ११९ पदार्थोकी सृष्टि करनेवाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य एवं पूजयेच्छम्भुं मातृगर्भं वसेन्न हि । यदभीष्टं फलं तच्च प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ya evaṃ pūjayecchambhuṃ mātṛgarbhaṃ vasenna hi | yadabhīṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tacca prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Since you are the lord of waters, you shall give
verses.commentary: Sense: Since you are the lord of waters, you shall give
verses.science: भूतभावन:--भूतोंके उत्पादक। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातमोङ्कारप्रभवे फलम् । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि केदारं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | etatte sarvamākhyātamoṅkāraprabhave phalam | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kedāraṃ liṅgamuttamam
verses.translation: Requested thus by Gautama, Varuna said—"Please dig a ditch here".
verses.commentary: Sense: Requested thus by Gautama, Varuna said—"Please dig a ditch here".
verses.science: नित्यशान्तिपरायण:--निरन्तर शान्त। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he sowed different food-grains and bar¬ leys there itself for the performance of his sacrifice.
verses.hindi: महर्भधुत॑ सुखकरं तदेव थ्रृणुतादरात्॥ १३४  किया, उसे आदरसे सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he sowed different food-grains and bar¬ leys there itself for the performance of his sacrifice.
verses.science: महर्भधुत॑ सुखकरं तदेव थ्रृणुतादरात्॥ १३४ किया, उसे आदरसे सुनिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he sowed different food-grains and bar¬ leys there itself for the performance of his sacrifice.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चुर्थ्या कोटिर्ंसंहितायां शिवसहस्ननामवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्ञत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he sowed different food-grains and bar¬ leys there itself for the performance of his sacrifice.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चुर्थ्या कोटिर्ंसंहितायां शिवसहस्ननामवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्ञत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । केदारेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । नरनारायणाख्यौ याववतारौ हरेर्द्विजाः । तेपाते भारते खण्डे बदर्याश्रम एव हि
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.19. ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kedāreśvarajyotirliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | naranārāyaṇākhyau yāvavatārau harerdvijāḥ | tepāte bhārate khaṇḍe badaryāśrama eva hi
verses.translation: Different kinds of food-grains, trees, flowers and fruits were produced in plenty there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different kinds of food-grains, trees, flowers and fruits were produced in plenty there.
verses.science: नामक पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां सम्प्रार्थितः शम्भुः पार्थिवे पूजनाय वै । आयाति नित्यं तल्लिङ्गे भक्ताधीनतया शिवः
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ samprārthitaḥ śambhuḥ pārthive pūjanāya vai | āyāti nityaṃ talliṅge bhaktādhīnatayā śivaḥ
verses.translation: The infuriated sages of crooked intellect worshipped Ganeiia with various articles of worship in order to put ob¬ stacle in the activity of Gautama.
verses.hindi: करे, तो वह कल्याणको प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated sages of crooked intellect worshipped Ganeiia with various articles of worship in order to put ob¬ stacle in the activity of Gautama.
verses.science: करे, तो वह कल्याणको प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं पूजयतोः शम्भुं तयोर्विष्ण्ववतारयोः । चिरकालो व्यतीयाय शैवयोर्धर्मपुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pūjayatoḥ śambhuṃ tayorviṣṇvavatārayoḥ | cirakālo vyatīyāya śaivayordharmaputrayoḥ
verses.translation: This has been decisively said by Brahma—"A wicked man never attains saintly nature nor does a saintly man assume perversion at any time."
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been decisively said by Brahma—"A wicked man never attains saintly nature nor does a saintly man assume perversion at any time."
verses.science: देखते अन्तर्धान हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्समये तत्र प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरो मे व्रियतामिति
verses.transliteration: ekasminsamaye tatra prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ | pratyuvāca prasanno'smi varo me vriyatāmiti
verses.translation: Formerly when you were distressed by starvation, the sage Gautama afforded you happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly when you were distressed by starvation, the sage Gautama afforded you happiness.
verses.science: उपदेश भी करते रहे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च तदा तेन नरो नारायणः स्वयम् । ऊचतुर्वचनं तत्र लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: ityukte ca tadā tena naro nārāyaṇaḥ svayam | ūcaturvacanaṃ tatra lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Now you intend to inflict misery on him. This is not proper. Please think over this in all aspects.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद आपलोग और क्‍या पूछना चाहते हैं 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Now you intend to inflict misery on him. This is not proper. Please think over this in all aspects.
verses.science: इसके बाद आपलोग और क्‍या पूछना चाहते हैं 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नरनारायणावूचतुः । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरस्त्वया । स्थीयतां स्वेन रूपेण पूजार्थं शङ्कर स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: naranārāyaṇāvūcatuḥ | yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varastvayā | sthīyatāṃ svena rūpeṇa pūjārthaṃ śaṅkara svayam
verses.translation: Deluded by your women-folk you never cared to act by my advice. There is no doubt that mv advice will be beneficial to him at the end.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिक्महापुराणे चतुर्ध्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां शिवसहस्रनामस्तोत्रफलवर्णन॑ नाम पट्त्रिंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by your women-folk you never cared to act by my advice. There is no doubt that mv advice will be beneficial to him at the end.
verses.science: हति श्रीशिक्महापुराणे चतुर्ध्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां शिवसहस्रनामस्तोत्रफलवर्णन॑ नाम पट्त्रिंशोउ ध्याय:। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तु तदा ताभ्यां केदारे हिमसंश्रये । स्वयं च शङ्करस्तस्थौ ज्योतीरूपो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktastu tadā tābhyāṃ kedāre himasaṃśraye | svayaṃ ca śaṅkarastasthau jyotīrūpo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Certainly the excellent sage will render happiness unto you. Deception is not proper. Please choose anothei boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Certainly the excellent sage will render happiness unto you. Deception is not proper. Please choose anothei boon.
verses.science: नामक छत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां च पूजितश्चैव सर्वदुःखभयापहः । लोकानामुपकारार्थं भक्तानां दर्शनाय वै
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ ca pūjitaścaiva sarvaduḥkhabhayāpahaḥ | lokānāmupakārārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ darśanāya vai
verses.translation: Gautaima did not know the evil intention of the
verses.hindi: सुननेवालोंको भोग तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Gautaima did not know the evil intention of the
verses.science: सुननेवालोंको भोग तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं स्थितस्तदा शम्भुः केदारेश्वरसंज्ञकः । भक्ताभीष्टप्रदो नित्यं दर्शनादर्चनादपि
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ sthitastadā śambhuḥ kedāreśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | bhaktābhīṣṭaprado nityaṃ darśanādarcanādapi
verses.translation: O great sages, hear what happened in the mean¬ time as a result of the influence of those wicked sages by the granting of the boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, hear what happened in the mean¬ time as a result of the influence of those wicked sages by the granting of the boon.
verses.science: उन्होंने समस्त मनोरथोंको प्राप्त किया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च पूजयन्तीह ऋषयश्च पुरातनाः । मनोऽभीष्टफलं ते ते सुप्रसन्नान्महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: devāśca pūjayantīha ṛṣayaśca purātanāḥ | mano'bhīṣṭaphalaṃ te te suprasannānmaheśvarāt
verses.translation: On hearing of it, the sages came there in thousands. Many beasts, birds and other living beings flocked there.
verses.hindi: मेरा नेत्र कमलके समान नहीं है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing of it, the sages came there in thousands. Many beasts, birds and other living beings flocked there.
verses.science: मेरा नेत्र कमलके समान नहीं है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भवस्य पूजनान्नित्यं बदर्याश्रमवासिनः । प्राप्नुवन्ति यतः सो हि भक्ताभीष्टप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhavasya pūjanānnityaṃ badaryāśramavāsinaḥ | prāpnuvanti yataḥ so hi bhaktābhīṣṭapradaḥ sadā
verses.translation: The forest became very beautiful, the most excellent on the surface of the world. In view of this imperishable contact the drought was not distressing.
verses.commentary: Sense: The forest became very beautiful, the most excellent on the surface of the world. In view of this imperishable contact the drought was not distressing.
verses.science: उनकी स्तुति की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिनं हि समारभ्य केदारेश्वर एव च । पूजितो येन भक्त्या वै दुःखं स्वप्नेऽपि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: taddinaṃ hi samārabhya kedāreśvara eva ca | pūjito yena bhaktyā vai duḥkhaṃ svapne'pi durlabham
verses.translation: The sages in the forest were engaged in auspicious rites. They stayed there along with their disciples, children and womenfolk.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages in the forest were engaged in auspicious rites. They stayed there along with their disciples, children and womenfolk.
verses.science: शीघ्र ही अवतरित हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो वै हि पाण्डवान्दृष्ट्वा माहिषं रूपमास्थितः । मायामास्थाय तत्रैव पलायनपरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: yo vai hi pāṇḍavāndṛṣṭvā māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | māyāmāsthāya tatraiva palāyanaparo'bhavat
verses.translation: They sowed food-grains for their livelihood. There was great joy and bliss in that forest, thanks to the power of Gautama.
verses.hindi: क्‍ नामक उत्तम चक्र देता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: They sowed food-grains for their livelihood. There was great joy and bliss in that forest, thanks to the power of Gautama.
verses.science: क्‍ नामक उत्तम चक्र देता हूँ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: धृतश्च पाण्डवैस्तत्र ह्यवाङ्मुखतया स्थितः । पुच्छं चैव धृतं तैस्तु प्रार्थितश्च पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: dhṛtaśca pāṇḍavaistatra hyavāṅmukhatayā sthitaḥ | pucchaṃ caiva dhṛtaṃ taistu prārthitaśca punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, once Gautama sent his disdples there for water. Carrying out his orders they reached the spot with the water-pots in their hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, once Gautama sent his disdples there for water. Carrying out his orders they reached the spot with the water-pots in their hands.
verses.science: विष्णुने यह वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्रूपेण स्थितस्तत्र भक्तवत्सलनामभाक् । नयपाले शिरोभागो गतस्तद्रूपतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tadrūpeṇa sthitastatra bhaktavatsalanāmabhāk | nayapāle śirobhāgo gatastadrūpataḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Many of the womenfolk who had assembled there for water saw the disciples of Gautama who had come for water. They prevented them from taking water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many of the womenfolk who had assembled there for water saw the disciples of Gautama who had come for water. They prevented them from taking water.
verses.science: मुझे यह बताइये 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव पूजनान्नित्यमाज्ञां चैवाप्यदात्तथा । पूजितश्च स्वयं शम्भुस्तत्र तस्थौ वरानदात्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva pūjanānnityamājñāṃ caivāpyadāttathā | pūjitaśca svayaṃ śambhustatra tasthau varānadāt
verses.translation: **We are the wives of the sages. We shall take water first. You stand far off. You can take water after¬ wards.'* Thus they rebuked them.
verses.commentary: Sense: **We are the wives of the sages. We shall take water first. You stand far off. You can take water after¬ wards.'* Thus they rebuked them.
verses.science: देवताओंके सहायक विष्णुसे कहने लगे--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा गतास्ते तु पाण्डवा मुदितास्तदा । लब्ध्वा चित्तेप्सितं सर्वं विमुक्ताः सर्वदुःखतः
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvā gatāste tu pāṇḍavā muditāstadā | labdhvā cittepsitaṃ sarvaṃ vimuktāḥ sarvaduḥkhataḥ
verses.translation: The disciples returned and informed- the wife of
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciples returned and informed- the wife of
verses.science: सहस््ननामका पाठ करना चाहिए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नित्यं हरः साक्षात्क्षेत्रे केदारसंज्ञके । भारतीभिः प्रजाभिश्च तथैव परिपूज्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra nityaṃ haraḥ sākṣātkṣetre kedārasaṃjñake | bhāratībhiḥ prajābhiśca tathaiva paripūjyate
verses.translation: The other women, the wives of the sages, became infuriated and rebuked her. They returned to their huts with evil intentions lurking in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other women, the wives of the sages, became infuriated and rebuked her. They returned to their huts with evil intentions lurking in their minds.
verses.science: प्रयत्नपूर्वक सर्वदा धारण कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रत्यं वलयं यो वै ददाति हरवल्लभः । हररूपान्तिकं तच्च हररूपसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tatratyaṃ valayaṃ yo vai dadāti haravallabhaḥ | hararūpāntikaṃ tacca hararūpasamanvitam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the great sages became furious with Gautama as it was destined to be.
verses.hindi: भी दुःख नहीं होगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, the great sages became furious with Gautama as it was destined to be.
verses.science: भी दुःख नहीं होगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव रूपं दृष्ट्वा च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । जीवन्मुक्तो भवेत्सोऽपि यो गतो बदरीवने
verses.transliteration: tathaiva rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | jīvanmukto bhavetso'pi yo gato badarīvane
verses.translation: *T am pleased with you. Mention the boon you wish to choose. What shall I do?'* On hearing his words the sages said then.
verses.commentary: Sense: *T am pleased with you. Mention the boon you wish to choose. What shall I do?'* On hearing his words the sages said then.
verses.science: स्पर्श करके पुनः उनसे कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रूपं नरस्यैव तथा नारायणस्य हि । केदारेश्वरशम्भोश्च मुक्तिभागी न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ narasyaiva tathā nārāyaṇasya hi | kedāreśvaraśambhośca muktibhāgī na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On being requested thus, the elephant-faced deity,'** the goal of the good, laughed and said gently enlightening them.
verses.hindi: निश्चित रूपसे वशमें कर लिया है
verses.commentary: Sense: On being requested thus, the elephant-faced deity,'** the goal of the good, laughed and said gently enlightening them.
verses.science: निश्चित रूपसे वशमें कर लिया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: केदारेशस्य भक्ता ये मार्गस्थास्तस्य वै मृताः । तेऽपि मुक्ता भवन्त्येव नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: kedāreśasya bhaktā ye mārgasthāstasya vai mṛtāḥ | te'pi muktā bhavantyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: According misery to the people who had rendered
verses.commentary: Sense: According misery to the people who had rendered
verses.science: हाथ जोड़कर यह वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र प्रीतियुक्तः केदारेशं प्रपूज्य च । तत्रत्यमुदकं पीत्वा पुनर्जन्म न विन्दति
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra prītiyuktaḥ kedāreśaṃ prapūjya ca | tatratyamudakaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vindati
verses.translation: On the elephant'faced Gane 4 a, see 5 P. Rudra. Kuznfira. ch 17.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the elephant'faced Gane 4 a, see 5 P. Rudra. Kuznfira. ch 17.
verses.science: आगे भी करते रहें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: खण्डेऽस्मिन् भारते विप्रा नरनारायणेश्वरः । केदारेशः प्रपूज्यश्च सर्वैर्जीवैः सुभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: khaṇḍe'smin bhārate viprā naranārāyaṇeśvaraḥ | kedāreśaḥ prapūjyaśca sarvairjīvaiḥ subhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Excellent results arc sought after performing. penance. No harm is sought after voluntarily eschewing
verses.hindi: न हो, मैं अन्य और कुछ नहीं चाहता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Excellent results arc sought after performing. penance. No harm is sought after voluntarily eschewing
verses.science: न हो, मैं अन्य और कुछ नहीं चाहता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य खण्डस्य स स्वामी सर्वेशोऽपि विशेषतः । सर्वकामप्रदः शम्भुः केदाराख्यो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: asya khaṇḍasya sa svāmī sarveśo'pi viśeṣataḥ | sarvakāmapradaḥ śambhuḥ kedārākhyo na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Even after hearing these words, the excellent sages, still deluded in their intellect, spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after hearing these words, the excellent sages, still deluded in their intellect, spoke these words.
verses.science: स्पर्श किया और कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वचः समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टमृषिसत्तमाः । श्रुत्वा पापं हरेत्सर्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: etadvacaḥ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭamṛṣisattamāḥ | śrutvā pāpaṃ haretsarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: ''O lord, this must be done by you. Not other¬ wise.'* Gancia who was thus implored spoke.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला होगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O lord, this must be done by you. Not other¬ wise.'* Gancia who was thus implored spoke.
verses.science: करनेवाला होगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, staggering and faltering, the cow, as a result of the boon began to eat the food-grains and barleys.
verses.hindi: उन्हींकी कृपासे सदा विश्वको सृष्टि करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, staggering and faltering, the cow, as a result of the boon began to eat the food-grains and barleys.
verses.science: उन्हींकी कृपासे सदा विश्वको सृष्टि करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, staggering and faltering, the cow, as a result of the boon began to eat the food-grains and barleys.
verses.hindi: अहल्या भी शिवकी पूजा करनेवाली हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, staggering and faltering, the cow, as a result of the boon began to eat the food-grains and barleys.
verses.science: अहल्या भी शिवकी पूजा करनेवाली हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । भीमासुरकृतोपद्रववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं भैमशङ्करम् । यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वाभीष्टं लभेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.20. viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | bhīmāsurakṛtopadravavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ bhaimaśaṅkaram | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvābhīṣṭaṃ labhennaraḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime Gautama happened to come there casually. Compassionate by nature, he warded off the cow with a bunch of grass blades.
verses.hindi: याज्ञवल्क्य, जैमिनि एवं गर्ग भी महाशैब हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Gautama happened to come there casually. Compassionate by nature, he warded off the cow with a bunch of grass blades.
verses.science: याज्ञवल्क्य, जैमिनि एवं गर्ग भी महाशैब हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कामरूपाभिधे देशे शङ्करो लोककाम्यया । अवतीर्णः स्वयं साक्षात्कल्याणसुखभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: kāmarūpābhidhe deśe śaṅkaro lokakāmyayā | avatīrṇaḥ svayaṃ sākṣātkalyāṇasukhabhājanam
verses.translation: The excellent sage Gautama excessively distressed by this regrettable incident spent half of month thus and then requested.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent sage Gautama excessively distressed by this regrettable incident spent half of month thus and then requested.
verses.science: पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थमवतीर्णोऽसौ शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः । शृणुतादरतस्तच्च कथयामि मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yadarthamavatīrṇo'sau śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ | śṛṇutādaratastacca kathayāmi munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and circumambulating the mountain, the excellent sage made earthen phallic images of Siva and worshipped them.
verses.hindi: यच्छावयसि नस्तात महेश्वरकथां शुभाम्॥ १  महेश्वरकी कल्याणकारी कथा सुना रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and circumambulating the mountain, the excellent sage made earthen phallic images of Siva and worshipped them.
verses.science: यच्छावयसि नस्तात महेश्वरकथां शुभाम्॥ १ महेश्वरकी कल्याणकारी कथा सुना रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भीमो नाम महोवीर्यो राक्षसोऽभूत्पुरा द्विजाः । दुःखदः सर्वभूतानां धर्मध्वंसकरः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhīmo nāma mahovīryo rākṣaso'bhūtpurā dvijāḥ | duḥkhadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmadhvaṃsakaraḥ sadā
verses.translation: After saying this, O brahmins, lord Siva, the bcs- tower of happiness to the good and chastiser of the wicked told him their evil actions in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, O brahmins, lord Siva, the bcs- tower of happiness to the good and chastiser of the wicked told him their evil actions in detail.
verses.science: 'फल समर्पितकर विसर्जन करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भकर्णात्समुत्पन्नः कर्कट्यां सुमहाबलः । सह्ये च पर्वते सोऽपि मात्रावासं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇātsamutpannaḥ karkaṭyāṃ sumahābalaḥ | sahye ca parvate so'pi mātrāvāsaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: Siva too then spoke—Gahga, listen. You are beneficial to all. At my behest> sanctify Gautama also/'
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva too then spoke—Gahga, listen. You are beneficial to all. At my behest> sanctify Gautama also/'
verses.science: चतुर्दशीको उपवास करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भकर्णे च रामेण हते लोकभयङ्करे । राक्षसी पुत्रसंयुक्ता सह्येऽतिष्ठत्स्वयं तदा
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇe ca rāmeṇa hate lokabhayaṅkare | rākṣasī putrasaṃyuktā sahye'tiṣṭhatsvayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Thereafter Vinu, Brahma and other gods eulogised them joyously joining their palms and drooping down their shoulders.
verses.hindi: स्त्रीने उससे कहा--हे बनेचर  हमें भोजन दो
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Vinu, Brahma and other gods eulogised them joyously joining their palms and drooping down their shoulders.
verses.science: स्त्रीने उससे कहा--हे बनेचर हमें भोजन दो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स बाल एकदा भीमः कर्कटीं मातरं द्विजाः । पप्रच्छ च खलो लोकदुःखदो भीमविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: sa bāla ekadā bhīmaḥ karkaṭīṃ mātaraṃ dvijāḥ | papraccha ca khalo lokaduḥkhado bhīmavikramaḥ
verses.translation: Gahga there became famous as Gautami. The phallic image became famous by the name Trymbaka. Both are destructive of great sins.
verses.hindi: सब कुछ सत्यमें ही प्रतिष्ठित है
verses.commentary: Sense: Gahga there became famous as Gautami. The phallic image became famous by the name Trymbaka. Both are destructive of great sins.
verses.science: सब कुछ सत्यमें ही प्रतिष्ठित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भीम उवाच । मातर्मे कः पिता कुत्र कथं वैकाकिनी स्थिता । ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं यथार्थं त्वं वदाधुना
verses.transliteration: bhīma uvāca | mātarme kaḥ pitā kutra kathaṃ vaikākinī sthitā | jñātumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ yathārthaṃ tvaṃ vadādhunā
verses.translation: From that time onwards whenever Jupiter enters Leo, the holy rivers, sacred centres and the gods come there.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that time onwards whenever Jupiter enters Leo, the holy rivers, sacred centres and the gods come there.
verses.science: हरिणीने पुन: यह वचन कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं पृष्टा तदा तेन पुत्रेण राक्षसी च सा । उवाच पुत्रं सा दुष्टा श्रूयतां कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | evaṃ pṛṣṭā tadā tena putreṇa rākṣasī ca sā | uvāca putraṃ sā duṣṭā śrūyatāṃ kathayāmyaham
verses.translation: The holy lakes Pukara, and others, the sacred river Gahga and others, Vasudeva and other gods stay on the banks of the Gautami river.
verses.hindi: अथम प्रहर बिना निद्राके बीत गया
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy lakes Pukara, and others, the sacred river Gahga and others, Vasudeva and other gods stay on the banks of the Gautami river.
verses.science: अथम प्रहर बिना निद्राके बीत गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्कट्युवाच । पिता ते कुम्भकर्णश्च रावणानुज एव च । रामेण मारितः सोऽयं भ्रात्रा सह महाबलः
verses.transliteration: karkaṭyuvāca | pitā te kumbhakarṇaśca rāvaṇānuja eva ca | rāmeṇa māritaḥ so'yaṃ bhrātrā saha mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The sages and their wicked wives who were hiding there began to shout, '*0 see, what is done by Gautama."
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages and their wicked wives who were hiding there began to shout, '*0 see, what is done by Gautama."
verses.science: तथा मुनिश्रेष्ठ हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रागतः कदाचिद्वै कुम्भकर्णः स राक्षसः । मद्भोगं कृतवांस्तात प्रसह्य बलवान्पुरा
verses.transliteration: atrāgataḥ kadācidvai kumbhakarṇaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ | madbhogaṃ kṛtavāṃstāta prasahya balavānpurā
verses.translation: O brahmins, the bewildered Gautama called Ahalya and spoke with a dejected, distressed mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the bewildered Gautama called Ahalya and spoke with a dejected, distressed mind.
verses.science: उपासक माने गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लङ्कां स गतवान् मां च त्यक्त्वात्रैव महाबलः । मया न दृष्टा सा लङ्का ह्यत्रैव निवसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: laṅkāṃ sa gatavān māṃ ca tyaktvātraiva mahābalaḥ | mayā na dṛṣṭā sā laṅkā hyatraiva nivasāmyaham
verses.translation: O gentle lady, what has happened? How did it happen? Certainly lord Siva is angry. What should be dene? Where shall we go? The sin of slaughter has befallen me.
verses.hindi: गरुड़ आदि पक्षी भी शिवभक्त हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, what has happened? How did it happen? Certainly lord Siva is angry. What should be dene? Where shall we go? The sin of slaughter has befallen me.
verses.science: गरुड़ आदि पक्षी भी शिवभक्त हुए हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पिता मे कर्कटो नाम माता मे पुष्कसी मता । भर्ता मम विराधो हि रामेण निहतः पुरा
verses.transliteration: pitā me karkaṭo nāma mātā me puṣkasī matā | bhartā mama virādho hi rāmeṇa nihataḥ purā
verses.translation: In the meantime the brahmins reproached Gautama. The wives of the brahmins tormented Ahalya with threats.
verses.hindi: सहित नित्य शिवपूजामें निरत रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the brahmins reproached Gautama. The wives of the brahmins tormented Ahalya with threats.
verses.science: सहित नित्य शिवपूजामें निरत रहते हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पित्रोः पार्श्वे स्थिता चाहं निहते स्वामिनि प्रिये । पितरौ मे मृतौ चात्र ऋषिणा भस्मसात्कृतौ
verses.transliteration: pitroḥ pārśve sthitā cāhaṃ nihate svāmini priye | pitarau me mṛtau cātra ṛṣiṇā bhasmasātkṛtau
verses.translation: The evil-minded disciples and sons of the brah¬ mins reviled at Gautama repeating the words, "Fie on you."
verses.hindi: धारणकर विशेष रूपसे शिवपूजन करते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: The evil-minded disciples and sons of the brah¬ mins reviled at Gautama repeating the words, "Fie on you."
verses.science: धारणकर विशेष रूपसे शिवपूजन करते थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्षणार्थं गतौ तत्र क्रुद्धेन सुमहात्मना । सुतीक्ष्णेन सुतपसागस्त्यशिष्येण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: bhakṣaṇārthaṃ gatau tatra kruddhena sumahātmanā | sutīkṣṇena sutapasāgastyaśiṣyeṇa vai tadā
verses.translation: As long as you stay in the midst of the hermitage, the sacrificial fires and the manes will not accept our gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as you stay in the midst of the hermitage, the sacrificial fires and the manes will not accept our gifts.
verses.science: भी शिवपूजन करनेवाले थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साहमेकाकिनी जाता दुःखिता पर्वते पुरा । निवसामि स्म दुःखार्ता निरालम्बा निराश्रया
verses.transliteration: sāhamekākinī jātā duḥkhitā parvate purā | nivasāmi sma duḥkhārtā nirālambā nirāśrayā
verses.translation: Hence, O sinner, O slayer of a cow, go somewhere else along with your followers. Do not delay.
verses.hindi: निरन्तर सुखका भोग करनेवाले हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O sinner, O slayer of a cow, go somewhere else along with your followers. Do not delay.
verses.science: निरन्तर सुखका भोग करनेवाले हुए हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये ह्यत्र राक्षसो रावणानुजः । आगत्य कृतवान् सङ्गं मां विहाय गतो हि सः
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye hyatra rākṣaso rāvaṇānujaḥ | āgatya kṛtavān saṅgaṃ māṃ vihāya gato hi saḥ
verses.translation: Beaten and reproachad by the wicked persons Gautama spoke these words—sages, I am going away from here. I shall stay somewhere else.
verses.hindi: जो प्रीतिसे शिवका पूजन करते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: Beaten and reproachad by the wicked persons Gautama spoke these words—sages, I am going away from here. I shall stay somewhere else.
verses.science: जो प्रीतिसे शिवका पूजन करते थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वं च समुत्पन्नो महाबलपराक्रमः । अवलम्ब्य पुनस्त्वां च कालक्षेपं करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tatastvaṃ ca samutpanno mahābalaparākramaḥ | avalambya punastvāṃ ca kālakṣepaṃ karomyaham
verses.translation: Beaten and reproachad by the wicked persons Gautama spoke these words—sages, I am going away from here. I shall stay somewhere else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beaten and reproachad by the wicked persons Gautama spoke these words—sages, I am going away from here. I shall stay somewhere else.
verses.science: रूपसे शिवजीके पूजक थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या भीमो भीमपराक्रमः । क्रुद्धश्च चिन्तयामास किं करोमि हरिं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasyā bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ | kruddhaśca cintayāmāsa kiṃ karomi hariṃ prati
verses.translation: After saying this, Gautama went out of that place. Going a kroSa he made his hermitage there with their per¬ mission.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Gautama went out of that place. Going a kroSa he made his hermitage there with their per¬ mission.
verses.science: प्रेमपूर्वक्क शिवकी पूजा करती थीं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पितानेन हतो मे हि तथा मातामहा अपि । विराधश्च हतोऽनेन दुःखं बहुतरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: pitānena hato me hi tathā mātāmahā api | virādhaśca hato'nena duḥkhaṃ bahutaraṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: I am to be pitied by you. Please tell me how my sin can be wiped off. I shall do as you bid me.
verses.hindi: ये उत्तम ब्रतवाले पुत्र उत्पन्न हुएु
verses.commentary: Sense: I am to be pitied by you. Please tell me how my sin can be wiped off. I shall do as you bid me.
verses.science: ये उत्तम ब्रतवाले पुत्र उत्पन्न हुएु। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्रोऽहं भवेयं चेद्धरिं तं पीडयाम्यहम् । इति कृत्वा मतिं भीमस्तपस्तप्तुं महद्ययौ
verses.transliteration: tatputro'haṃ bhaveyaṃ ceddhariṃ taṃ pīḍayāmyaham | iti kṛtvā matiṃ bhīmastapastaptuṃ mahadyayau
verses.translation: Thus requested the brahmins did not say anything. When they were implored humbly they met separately and remained aloof.
verses.hindi: भाइयोंसहित नित्य पार्थिवपूजन किया करते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested the brahmins did not say anything. When they were implored humbly they met separately and remained aloof.
verses.science: भाइयोंसहित नित्य पार्थिवपूजन किया करते थे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं च समुद्दिश्य वर्षाणां च सहस्रकम् । मनसा ध्यानमाश्रित्य तपश्चक्रे महत्तदा
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ ca samuddiśya varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam | manasā dhyānamāśritya tapaścakre mahattadā
verses.translation: Gautama stood far off. Bowing down to the sages he humbly asked them what he should do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gautama stood far off. Bowing down to the sages he humbly asked them what he should do.
verses.science: शिवलिंगका पूजन किया करते थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वबाहुश्चैकपादः सूर्ये दृष्टिं दधत्पुरा । संस्थितः स बभूवाथ भीमो राक्षसपुत्रकः
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvabāhuścaikapādaḥ sūrye dṛṣṭiṃ dadhatpurā | saṃsthitaḥ sa babhūvātha bhīmo rākṣasaputrakaḥ
verses.translation: "Without expiation purity cannot be attained. Hence, for the sake of purification you shall perform the rites of atonement.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Without expiation purity cannot be attained. Hence, for the sake of purification you shall perform the rites of atonement.
verses.science: मोक्षको प्राप्त किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरसस्तस्य सञ्जातं तेजः परमदारुणम् । तेन दग्धास्तदा देवा ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: śirasastasya sañjātaṃ tejaḥ paramadāruṇam | tena dagdhāstadā devā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Go round the earth three times announcing your sin. After returning to this place perform the holy Vrata for a month.
verses.hindi: नहुषश्च महाशैव: शिवपूजारतो ह्ाभूतू॥ ४४ पूजामें तत्पर रहते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: Go round the earth three times announcing your sin. After returning to this place perform the holy Vrata for a month.
verses.science: नहुषश्च महाशैव: शिवपूजारतो ह्ाभूतू॥ ४४ पूजामें तत्पर रहते थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य वेधसं भक्त्या तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तवैः । दुःखं निवेदयाञ्चक्रुर्ब्रह्मणे ते सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya vedhasaṃ bhaktyā tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ | duḥkhaṃ nivedayāñcakrurbrahmaṇe te savāsavāḥ
verses.translation: If you go round this mountain Brahmagiri hundred and one times you can attain purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you go round this mountain Brahmagiri hundred and one times you can attain purity.
verses.science: कामनाएं पूर्ण कीं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । ब्रह्मन्वै रक्षसस्तेजो लोकान्पीडितुमुद्यतम् । यत्प्रार्थ्यते च दुष्टेन तत्त्वं देहि वरं विधे
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | brahmanvai rakṣasastejo lokānpīḍitumudyatam | yatprārthyate ca duṣṭena tattvaṃ dehi varaṃ vidhe
verses.translation: Or you fetch water from Ganga and perform the ceremonial ablution. Propitiate lord l§iva making a crore of his phallic images.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or you fetch water from Ganga and perform the ceremonial ablution. Propitiate lord l§iva making a crore of his phallic images.
verses.science: अपने वशमें कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नो चेदद्य वयं दग्धास्तीव्रतत्तेजसा पुनः । यास्यामः सङ्क्षयं सर्वे तस्मात्तं देहि प्रार्थितम्
verses.transliteration: no cedadya vayaṃ dagdhāstīvratattejasā punaḥ | yāsyāmaḥ saṅkṣayaṃ sarve tasmāttaṃ dehi prārthitam
verses.translation: At the outset, you circumambulate this mountain eleven times. Taking bath in Ganga you will become pure thereafter.
verses.hindi: शाड्डरं चरितं दिव्यं क्रिमन्यत्प्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥ ५५  क्या पूछना चाहते हैं ?
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset, you circumambulate this mountain eleven times. Taking bath in Ganga you will become pure thereafter.
verses.science: शाड्डरं चरितं दिव्यं क्रिमन्यत्प्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥ ५५ क्या पूछना चाहते हैं ?। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । जगाम च वरं दातुं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | jagāma ca varaṃ dātuṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
verses.translation: Performing the ablution of the earthen phallic image of Siva with a hundred potful of water, the expiatory rite will be completed." When he was thus urged by the sages he said in the affirmative.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां देवरर्षिनृपशैवत्ववर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing the ablution of the earthen phallic image of Siva with a hundred potful of water, the expiatory rite will be completed." When he was thus urged by the sages he said in the affirmative.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां देवरर्षिनृपशैवत्ववर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूहि यत्ते मनसि वर्तते । इति श्रुत्वा विधेर्वाक्यमब्रवीद्राक्षसो हि सः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | prasanno'smi varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi vartate | iti śrutvā vidhervākyamabravīdrākṣaso hi saḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, at the behest of your honours I shall worship the earthen phallic image of Siva and also circumambulate the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, at the behest of your honours I shall worship the earthen phallic image of Siva and also circumambulate the mountain.
verses.science: नामक सैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: भीम उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरस्त्वया । अतुलं च बलं मेऽद्य देहि त्वं कमलासन
verses.transliteration: bhīma uvāca | yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varastvayā | atulaṃ ca balaṃ me'dya dehi tvaṃ kamalāsana
verses.translation: The chaste lady Ahalya too acted accordingly. Their disciples and the disciples of their disciples rendered service to them.
verses.hindi: केन ब्रतेन सन्तुष्टो भुक्तिं मुक्ति च यच्छसि ॥ तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करते हैं ?
verses.commentary: Sense: The chaste lady Ahalya too acted accordingly. Their disciples and the disciples of their disciples rendered service to them.
verses.science: केन ब्रतेन सन्तुष्टो भुक्तिं मुक्ति च यच्छसि ॥ तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करते हैं ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तु नमश्चक्रे ब्रह्मणे स हि राक्षसः । ब्रह्मा चापि तदा तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा गृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā tu namaścakre brahmaṇe sa hi rākṣasaḥ | brahmā cāpi tadā tasmai varaṃ dattvā gṛhaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Then the gladdened Siva, the storehouse of mercy said—"O great sage, mention the boon you wish to choose. I am delighted with your devotion."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gladdened Siva, the storehouse of mercy said—"O great sage, mention the boon you wish to choose. I am delighted with your devotion."
verses.science: ब्रतोंको प्रयलपूर्वक करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
