verses.transliteration: brahmaṇaśca dine sā hi na vinaśyati niścitam | tadā śivastriśūlena dadhāti munayaśca tām
verses.translation: What evil deeds the extremely wicked Ravana will not do? Where shall we go, being harassed by the wicked fellow?
verses.commentary: Sense: What evil deeds the extremely wicked Ravana will not do? Where shall we go, being harassed by the wicked fellow?
verses.science: होनेपर महत्त्वहीन हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च ब्रह्मणा सृष्टौ कृतायां स्थाप्यते द्विजाः । कर्मणां कर्षणाच्चैव काशीति परिपठ्यते
verses.transliteration: punaśca brahmaṇā sṛṣṭau kṛtāyāṃ sthāpyate dvijāḥ | karmaṇāṃ karṣaṇāccaiva kāśīti paripaṭhyate
verses.translation: O gods, give up your sorrow. I shall plan out and go. By the mercy of Siva, I shall carry out the task of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, give up your sorrow. I shall plan out and go. By the mercy of Siva, I shall carry out the task of the gods.
verses.science: पूजन-स्मरण आदि करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं काश्यां तिष्ठति सर्वदा । मुक्तिदातृ च लोकानां महापातकिनामपि
verses.transliteration: avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ kāśyāṃ tiṣṭhati sarvadā | muktidātṛ ca lokānāṃ mahāpātakināmapi
verses.translation: Thus saying, the celestial sage went to Ravana*s abode. After receiving the formal welcome he spoke with great pleasure.
verses.hindi: साक्षात्कार होने लगता है--यह निश्चित है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus saying, the celestial sage went to Ravana*s abode. After receiving the formal welcome he spoke with great pleasure.
verses.science: साक्षात्कार होने लगता है--यह निश्चित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्र प्राप्यते मुक्तिः सारूप्यादिर्मुनीश्वराः । अत्रैव प्राप्यते जीवैः सायुज्या मुक्तिरुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: anyatra prāpyate muktiḥ sārūpyādirmunīśvarāḥ | atraiva prāpyate jīvaiḥ sāyujyā muktiruttamā
verses.translation: excellent Rakasa, you are a blessed sage, a great devotee of Siva. At your sight today my mind is much delighted.
verses.hindi: समान रहता है, वह ज्ञानवान् कहा जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: excellent Rakasa, you are a blessed sage, a great devotee of Siva. At your sight today my mind is much delighted.
verses.science: समान रहता है, वह ज्ञानवान् कहा जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: येषां क्वापि गतिर्नास्ति तेषां वाराणसी पुरी । पञ्चक्रोशी महापुण्या हत्याकोटिविनाशनी
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī purī | pañcakrośī mahāpuṇyā hatyākoṭivināśanī
verses.translation: Please narrate the details how you propitiate Siva. Thus asked by him Ravana replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please narrate the details how you propitiate Siva. Thus asked by him Ravana replied.
verses.science: संसारसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अमरा मरणं सर्वे वाञ्छन्तीह परे च के । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा चैषा सर्वदा शङ्करप्रिया
verses.transliteration: amarā maraṇaṃ sarve vāñchantīha pare ca ke | bhuktimuktipradā caiṣā sarvadā śaṅkarapriyā
verses.translation: O great sage, after going to Kailasa for penance, I performed a severe penance for a long time.
verses.hindi: उन्हें यत्लपूर्वक बुद्धिसे धारण करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, after going to Kailasa for penance, I performed a severe penance for a long time.
verses.science: उन्हें यत्लपूर्वक बुद्धिसे धारण करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा च श्लाघते चामुं विष्णुः सिद्धाश्च योगिनः । मुनयश्च तथैवान्ये त्रिलोकस्था जनाः सदा
verses.transliteration: brahmā ca ślāghate cāmuṃ viṣṇuḥ siddhāśca yoginaḥ | munayaśca tathaivānye trilokasthā janāḥ sadā
verses.translation: Standing in the midst of five fires during the summer, lying on the bare ground during rains and staying inside water during the winter I performed three-fold penance.
verses.hindi: उत्तम ज्ञान प्राप्तकर सन्तुष्ट हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing in the midst of five fires during the summer, lying on the bare ground during rains and staying inside water during the winter I performed three-fold penance.
verses.science: उत्तम ज्ञान प्राप्तकर सन्तुष्ट हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काश्याश्च महिमानं वै वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि । शक्नोम्यहं न सर्वं हि यथाशक्ति ब्रुवे ततः
verses.transliteration: kāśyāśca mahimānaṃ vai vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi | śaknomyahaṃ na sarvaṃ hi yathāśakti bruve tataḥ
verses.translation: I then became angry. I dug a ditch in the ground and kindled fire. I made earthen idols. By waving lights in the course of worship I worshipped Siva with scents, sandal paste, incense and food-offerings.
verses.hindi: स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्भोगानन्ते परगतिं लभेतू॥ ५९  करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: I then became angry. I dug a ditch in the ground and kindled fire. I made earthen idols. By waving lights in the course of worship I worshipped Siva with scents, sandal paste, incense and food-offerings.
verses.science: स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्भोगानन्ते परगतिं लभेतू॥ ५९ करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कैलासस्य पतिर्यो वै ह्यन्तः सत्त्वो बहिस्तमाः । कालाग्निर्नामतः ख्यातो निर्गुणो गुणवान्भवः । प्रणिपातैरनेकैश्च वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: kailāsasya patiryo vai hyantaḥ sattvo bahistamāḥ | kālāgnirnāmataḥ khyāto nirguṇo guṇavānbhavaḥ | praṇipātairanekaiśca vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
verses.translation: By such different modes and various other means lord Siva was worshipped by me according to the rules laid down in the Sastras.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्ध्या कोटिर्रसंहितायां ज्ञाननिरूपणं नाम त्रिचत्वारिशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: By such different modes and various other means lord Siva was worshipped by me according to the rules laid down in the Sastras.
verses.science: इति श्रीजिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्ध्या कोटिर्रसंहितायां ज्ञाननिरूपणं नाम त्रिचत्वारिशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्र उवाच । विश्वेश्वर महेशान त्वदीयोऽस्मि न संशयः । कृपां कुरु महादेव मयि त्वं साम्ब आत्मजे
verses.transliteration: rudra uvāca | viśveśvara maheśāna tvadīyo'smi na saṃśayaḥ | kṛpāṃ kuru mahādeva mayi tvaṃ sāmba ātmaje
verses.translation: "Fie upon my body. Fie upon my strength. Fie upon my penance'*. Saying this I performed several sacrifices in the fire that had been kept there.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Fie upon my body. Fie upon my strength. Fie upon my penance'*. Saying this I performed several sacrifices in the fire that had been kept there.
verses.science: नाम्रक तैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थातव्यं च सदात्रैव लोकानां हितकाम्यया । तारयस्व जगन्नाथ प्रार्थयामि जगत्पते
verses.transliteration: sthātavyaṃ ca sadātraiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | tārayasva jagannātha prārthayāmi jagatpate
verses.translation: Then I thought—"I will cast off my body into the fire". Thereafter I cut off my heads one by one, purified them and offered them to the fire. Thus nine heads were offered by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I thought—"I will cast off my body into the fire". Thereafter I cut off my heads one by one, purified them and offered them to the fire. Thus nine heads were offered by me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । अविमुक्तोऽपि दान्तात्मा तं सम्प्रार्थ्य पुनः पुनः । नेत्राश्रूणि प्रमुच्यैव प्रीतः प्रोवाच शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | avimukto'pi dāntātmā taṃ samprārthya punaḥ punaḥ | netrāśrūṇi pramucyaiva prītaḥ provāca śaṅkaram
verses.translation: The lord favourably disposed towards his devotees immediately spoke to me, "I am delighted. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall grant you what you desire in your mind.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord favourably disposed towards his devotees immediately spoke to me, "I am delighted. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall grant you what you desire in your mind.*'
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्त उवाच । देवदेव महादेव कालामयसुभेषज । त्वं त्रिलोकपतिः सत्यं सेव्यो ब्रह्माच्युतादिभिः
verses.transliteration: avimukta uvāca | devadeva mahādeva kālāmayasubheṣaja | tvaṃ trilokapatiḥ satyaṃ sevyo brahmācyutādibhiḥ
verses.translation: When lord Siva said this I euloged and bowed to him with palms joined in great devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: When lord Siva said this I euloged and bowed to him with palms joined in great devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काश्यां पुर्यां त्वया देव राजधानी प्रगृह्यताम् । मया ध्यानितया स्थेयमचिन्त्यसुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: kāśyāṃ puryāṃ tvayā deva rājadhānī pragṛhyatām | mayā dhyānitayā stheyamacintyasukhahetave
verses.translation: Then I requested the lord, "O lord of gods, if you arc pleased nothing will be inaccessible to me? Please give me unequalled strength."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I requested the lord, "O lord of gods, if you arc pleased nothing will be inaccessible to me? Please give me unequalled strength."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तिदाता भवानेह कामदश्च न चापरः । तस्मात्त्वमुपकाराय तिष्ठोमासहितः सदा
verses.transliteration: muktidātā bhavāneha kāmadaśca na cāparaḥ | tasmāttvamupakārāya tiṣṭhomāsahitaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Reinstating my heads like a physician they were glanced at by Siva, the supreme soul with unfailing benign look.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reinstating my heads like a physician they were glanced at by Siva, the supreme soul with unfailing benign look.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवान्भवाब्धेरखिलांस्तारय त्वं सदाशिव । भक्तकार्यं कुरु हर प्रार्थयामि पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: jīvānbhavābdherakhilāṃstāraya tvaṃ sadāśiva | bhaktakāryaṃ kuru hara prārthayāmi punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Then, requested by me, Siva stayed there per¬ manently in the name of VaidyanatheSvara. He has now become famous in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, requested by me, Siva stayed there per¬ manently in the name of VaidyanatheSvara. He has now become famous in the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं प्रार्थितस्तेन विश्वनाथेन शङ्करः । लोकानामुपकारार्थं तस्थौ तत्रापि सर्वराट्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ prārthitastena viśvanāthena śaṅkaraḥ | lokānāmupakārārthaṃ tasthau tatrāpi sarvarāṭ
verses.translation: Lord Siva in the form of Jyotirlinga confers world¬ ly pleasures and salvation by his sight and worship. He is the benefactor of all in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva in the form of Jyotirlinga confers world¬ ly pleasures and salvation by his sight and worship. He is the benefactor of all in the world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्दिनं हि समारभ्य हरः काश्यामुपागतः । तदारभ्य च सा काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठतराभवत्
verses.transliteration: yaddinaṃ hi samārabhya haraḥ kāśyāmupāgataḥ | tadārabhya ca sā kāśī sarvaśreṣṭhatarābhavat
verses.translation: May this be heard, O excellent Rakasa, I shall tell you what is beneficial to you. You shall do as I say and not otherwise at any cost.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this be heard, O excellent Rakasa, I shall tell you what is beneficial to you. You shall do as I say and not otherwise at any cost.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing it, Siva said "What has happened?'* Siva laughed and replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it, Siva said "What has happened?'* Siva laughed and replied.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing it, Siva said "What has happened?'* Siva laughed and replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it, Siva said "What has happened?'* Siva laughed and replied.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । काशीविश्वेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । एवं वाराणसी पुण्या यदि सूत महापुरी । तत्प्रभावं वदास्माकमविमुक्तस्य च प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.23. trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kāśīviśveśvarajyotirliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | evaṃ vārāṇasī puṇyā yadi sūta mahāpurī | tatprabhāvaṃ vadāsmākamavimuktasya ca prabho
verses.translation: You have got the return of favouring your disciple, indeed. Something good has happened through this disciple, now that an unequalled strength has been bestowed on a quiet soul who is a great hero.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have got the return of favouring your disciple, indeed. Something good has happened through this disciple, now that an unequalled strength has been bestowed on a quiet soul who is a great hero.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । वक्ष्ये सङ्क्षेपतः सम्यग्वाराणस्याः सुशोभनम् । विश्वेश्वरस्य माहात्म्यं श्रूयतां च मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | vakṣye saṅkṣepataḥ samyagvārāṇasyāḥ suśobhanam | viśveśvarasya māhātmyaṃ śrūyatāṃ ca munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Staying there, the Raksasa Daruka and his wife Daruka terrorised the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Staying there, the Raksasa Daruka and his wife Daruka terrorised the people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्पार्वती देवी शङ्करं परया मुदा । लोककामनयापृच्छन्माहात्म्यमविमुक्तयोः
verses.transliteration: kadācitpārvatī devī śaṅkaraṃ parayā mudā | lokakāmanayāpṛcchanmāhātmyamavimuktayoḥ
verses.translation: On seeing them the Raksasas began to ponder. They consulted with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them the Raksasas began to ponder. They consulted with one another.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच । अस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः । ममोपरि कृपां कृत्वा लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: pārvatyuvāca | asya kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ | mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: For fear of the sage's curse, Raksasas did not come on the earth. They moved about in the waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: For fear of the sage's curse, Raksasas did not come on the earth. They moved about in the waters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । देव्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो जगत्प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाच भवानीं तां जीवानां प्रियहेतवे
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | devyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo jagatprabhuḥ | pratyuvāca bhavānīṃ tāṃ jīvānāṃ priyahetave
verses.translation: If on any day he could not worship Siva he did not take his food. The Vai4ya performed the worship of Siva there in the prison also.
verses.commentary: Sense: If on any day he could not worship Siva he did not take his food. The Vai4ya performed the worship of Siva there in the prison also.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परमेश्वर उवाच । साधु पृष्टं त्वया भद्रे लोकानां सुखदं शुभम् । कथयामि यथार्थं वै माहात्म्यमविमुक्तयोः
verses.transliteration: parameśvara uvāca | sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhadre lokānāṃ sukhadaṃ śubham | kathayāmi yathārthaṃ vai māhātmyamavimuktayoḥ
verses.translation: The event that happened thereafter, the story of the moon-crested lord, O great sages, please listen to with attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: The event that happened thereafter, the story of the moon-crested lord, O great sages, please listen to with attention.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं गुह्यतमं क्षेत्रं सदा वाराणसी मम । सर्वेषामेव जन्तूना हेतुर्मोक्षस्य सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: idaṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ sadā vārāṇasī mama | sarveṣāmeva jantūnā heturmokṣasya sarvathā
verses.translation: Once an attendant of the wicked Raksasa saw the beautiful form of Siva in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once an attendant of the wicked Raksasa saw the beautiful form of Siva in front of him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्सिद्धाः सदा क्षेत्रे मदीयं व्रतमाश्रिताः । नानालिङ्गधरा नित्यं मम लोकाभिकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: asminsiddhāḥ sadā kṣetre madīyaṃ vratamāśritāḥ | nānāliṅgadharā nityaṃ mama lokābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The king of the Raksasas, Daruka, though very powerful was excited much. He hastened to the Vaisya and asked him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of the Raksasas, Daruka, though very powerful was excited much. He hastened to the Vaisya and asked him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यस्यन्ति महायोगं जितात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः । परं पाशुपतं श्रौतं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: abhyasyanti mahāyogaṃ jitātmāno jitendriyāḥ | paraṃ pāśupataṃ śrautaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: He replied "I do not know." On hearing it the
verses.commentary: Sense: He replied "I do not know." On hearing it the
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रोचते मे सदा वासो वाराणस्यां महेश्वरि । हेतुना येन सर्वाणि विहाय शृणु तद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: rocate me sadā vāso vārāṇasyāṃ maheśvari | hetunā yena sarvāṇi vihāya śṛṇu tad dhruvam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva with a veiled hint, lord Siva considered Ravana ungrateful. He cursed him for being arrogant of his strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Siva with a veiled hint, lord Siva considered Ravana ungrateful. He cursed him for being arrogant of his strength.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो मे भक्तश्च विज्ञानी तावुभौ मुक्तिभागिनौ । तीर्थापेक्षा च न तयोर्विहिताविहिते समौ
verses.transliteration: yo me bhaktaśca vijñānī tāvubhau muktibhāginau | tīrthāpekṣā ca na tayorvihitāvihite samau
verses.translation: O Ravana, O base devotee, O wicked-minded, do not be arrogant. A destroyer of the arrogance of your mighty hands will come soon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Ravana, O base devotee, O wicked-minded, do not be arrogant. A destroyer of the arrogance of your mighty hands will come soon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्मुक्तौ तु तौ ज्ञेयौ यत्र कुत्रापि वै मृतौ । प्राप्नुतो मोक्षमाश्वेव मयोक्तं निश्चितं वचः
verses.transliteration: jīvanmuktau tu tau jñeyau yatra kutrāpi vai mṛtau | prāpnuto mokṣamāśveva mayoktaṃ niścitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: What thus happened there Narada too heard. Ravana delighted in his mind returned to his abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: What thus happened there Narada too heard. Ravana delighted in his mind returned to his abode.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र तीर्थे विशेषोऽस्त्यविमुक्ताख्ये परोत्तमे । श्रूयतां तत्त्वया देवि परशक्ते सुचित्तया
verses.transliteration: atra tīrthe viśeṣo'styavimuktākhye parottame | śrūyatāṃ tattvayā devi paraśakte sucittayā
verses.translation: Coming to a firm decision, the mighty Ravana, deluded of his own strength, destroyed the arrogance of his enemies and brought the whole universe under his control.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coming to a firm decision, the mighty Ravana, deluded of his own strength, destroyed the arrogance of his enemies and brought the whole universe under his control.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वर्णा आश्रमाश्च बालयौवनवार्धकाः । अस्यां पुर्यां म्रुताश्चेत्स्युर्मुक्ता एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sarve varṇā āśramāśca bālayauvanavārdhakāḥ | asyāṃ puryāṃ mrutāścetsyurmuktā eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the divine weapons and great strength secured at the behest of Siva, there was none to counter¬ challenge Ravana in fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the divine weapons and great strength secured at the behest of Siva, there was none to counter¬ challenge Ravana in fight.

verses.translation: ''If we can go let us go. Why ponder over it? O gentle lady, we shall go and stay there permanently in in the waters."
verses.commentary: Sense: ''If we can go let us go. Why ponder over it? O gentle lady, we shall go and stay there permanently in in the waters."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भैरवीं यातनां प्राप्य वर्षाणामयुते पुनः । ततो मोक्षमवाप्नोति भुक्त्वा पापं च सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: bhairavīṃ yātanāṃ prāpya varṣāṇāmayute punaḥ | tato mokṣamavāpnoti bhuktvā pāpaṃ ca sundari
verses.translation: In the meantime the people who had been tor¬ tured by the Raksasas formerly came there for fighting, accompanied by the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the people who had been tor¬ tured by the Raksasas formerly came there for fighting, accompanied by the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते च समाख्याता पापाचारे च या गतिः । एवं ज्ञात्वा नरः सम्यक्सेवयेदविमुक्तकम्
verses.transliteration: iti te ca samākhyātā pāpācāre ca yā gatiḥ | evaṃ jñātvā naraḥ samyaksevayedavimuktakam
verses.translation: In their dilemma the Raksasas resorted to the boon granted by Parvati. They took their belongings to the city in the ocean. The demoness shouted cries of victory to the goddess and flew like the w'inged king of mountains.*' She then stayed fearlessly in the middle of the ocean. The follower of Siva accompanied by her attendants rejoiced much.
verses.wordMeaning: In their dilemma the Raksasas resorted to the boon granted by Parvati. They took their belongings to the city in the ocean. The demoness shouted cries of victory to the goddess and flew like the w'inged king of mountains.*' She then stayed fearlessly in the middle of the ocean.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In their dilemma the Raksasas resorted to the boon granted by Parvati. They took their belongings to the city in the ocean. The demoness shouted cries of victory to the goddess and flew like the w'inged king of mountains.*' She then stayed fearlessly in the middle of the ocean.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतकर्मक्षयो नास्ति कल्पकोटिशतैरपि । अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtakarmakṣayo nāsti kalpakoṭiśatairapi | avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham
verses.translation: Staying in the city inside the ocean, the sportive Raksasas became happy and fearless.
verses.commentary: Sense: Staying in the city inside the ocean, the sportive Raksasas became happy and fearless.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: केवलं चाशुभं कर्म नरकाय भवेदिह । शुभं स्वर्गाय जायेत द्वाभ्यां मानुष्यमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: kevalaṃ cāśubhaṃ karma narakāya bhavediha | śubhaṃ svargāya jāyeta dvābhyāṃ mānuṣyamīritam
verses.translation: They abducted travellers in the boats and impri¬ soned them in the city. They killed some of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They abducted travellers in the boats and impri¬ soned them in the city. They killed some of them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जन्म सम्यगसम्यक् च न्यूनाधिक्ये भवेदिह । उभयोश्च क्षयो मुक्तिर्भवेत्सत्यं हि पार्वति
verses.transliteration: janma samyagasamyak ca nyūnādhikye bhavediha | ubhayośca kṣayo muktirbhavetsatyaṃ hi pārvati
verses.translation: According to thf: Piiranir tradition mountains had wings, at will and destroyrd those towns and villages which refused gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to thf: Piiranir tradition mountains had wings, at will and destroyrd those towns and villages which refused gifts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्म च त्रिविधं प्रोक्तं कर्मकाण्डे महेश्वरि । सञ्चितं क्रियमाणं च प्रारब्धं चेति बन्धकृत्
verses.transliteration: karma ca trividhaṃ proktaṃ karmakāṇḍe maheśvari | sañcitaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ ca prārabdhaṃ ceti bandhakṛt
verses.translation: Staying there fearlessly, thanks to the boon granted by Parvati, the Raksasas worked havoc as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Staying there fearlessly, thanks to the boon granted by Parvati, the Raksasas worked havoc as before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मसमुद्भूतं सञ्चितं समुदाहृतम् । भुज्यते च शरीरेण प्रारब्धं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvajanmasamudbhūtaṃ sañcitaṃ samudāhṛtam | bhujyate ca śarīreṇa prārabdhaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: O great sages, the people had the terror*in the waters now incessantly in the manner they had fear on land before.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, the people had the terror*in the waters now incessantly in the manner they had fear on land before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन जन्मना यच्च क्रियते कर्म साम्प्रतम् । शुभाशुभं च देवेशि क्रियमाणं विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: anena janmanā yacca kriyate karma sāmpratam | śubhāśubhaṃ ca deveśi kriyamāṇaṃ vidurbudhāḥ
verses.translation: Sometimes the Rak?asl came out of the city in the water and blocked the path to the land in order to harass the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sometimes the Rak?asl came out of the city in the water and blocked the path to the land in order to harass the people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धकर्मणो भोगात्क्षयश्चैव न चान्यथा । उपायेन द्वयोर्नाशः कर्मणोः पूजनादिना
verses.transliteration: prārabdhakarmaṇo bhogātkṣayaścaiva na cānyathā | upāyena dvayornāśaḥ karmaṇoḥ pūjanādinā
verses.translation: In the meantime several beautiful boats arrived there all full of people.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime several beautiful boats arrived there all full of people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां कर्मणां नाशो नास्ति काशीं पुरीं विना । सर्वं च सुलभं तीर्थं दुर्लभा काशिका पुरी
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ nāśo nāsti kāśīṃ purīṃ vinā | sarvaṃ ca sulabhaṃ tīrthaṃ durlabhā kāśikā purī
verses.translation: On seeing those boats the wicked Raksasas were delighted much. Rushing at the people on board they bound them forcefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing those boats the wicked Raksasas were delighted much. Rushing at the people on board they bound them forcefully.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मकृतं चेद्वै काशीदर्शनमादरात् । तदा काशीं च सम्प्राप्य लभेन्मृत्युं न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ cedvai kāśīdarśanamādarāt | tadā kāśīṃ ca samprāpya labhenmṛtyuṃ na cānyathā
verses.translation: The naughty Raksasas came to the city taking those people with them. They fettered them and put them in prisons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The naughty Raksasas came to the city taking those people with them. They fettered them and put them in prisons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काशीं प्राप्य नरो यस्तु गङ्गायां स्नानमाचरेत् । तदा च क्रियमाणस्य सञ्चितस्यापि सङ्क्षयः
verses.transliteration: kāśīṃ prāpya naro yastu gaṅgāyāṃ snānamācaret | tadā ca kriyamāṇasya sañcitasyāpi saṅkṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The people thus bound in fetters and imprisoned became very unhappy. They were rebuked again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The people thus bound in fetters and imprisoned became very unhappy. They were rebuked again and again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धं न विना भोगं नश्यतीति सुनिश्चितम् । मृतिश्च तस्य सञ्जाता तदा तस्य क्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prārabdhaṃ na vinā bhogaṃ naśyatīti suniścitam | mṛtiśca tasya sañjātā tadā tasya kṣayo bhavet
verses.translation: He never remained without the worship of Siva. In every respect he followed the sacred rites of Siva. Bhasma and Rudraksa were his ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: He never remained without the worship of Siva. In every respect he followed the sacred rites of Siva. Bhasma and Rudraksa were his ornaments.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं चैव कृता काशी पश्चात्पापं समाचरेत् । तद्बीजेन बलवता नीयते काशिका पुनः
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ caiva kṛtā kāśī paścātpāpaṃ samācaret | tadbījena balavatā nīyate kāśikā punaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he taught the mantra of Siva and the mode of worshipping the earthen phallic image to several of his fellow-prisoners.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, he taught the mantra of Siva and the mode of worshipping the earthen phallic image to several of his fellow-prisoners.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा सर्वाणि पापानि भस्मसाच्च भवन्ति हि । तस्मात्काशीं नरः सेवेत्कर्मनिर्मूलनीं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tadā sarvāṇi pāpāni bhasmasācca bhavanti hi | tasmātkāśīṃ naraḥ sevetkarmanirmūlanīṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: They performed there the worship of Siva duly in the manner they saw and heard. It yielded them their desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: They performed there the worship of Siva duly in the manner they saw and heard. It yielded them their desires.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽपि ब्राह्मणो येन काश्यां संवासितः प्रिये । काशीवासमवाप्यैव ततो मुक्तिं स विन्दति
verses.transliteration: eko'pi brāhmaṇo yena kāśyāṃ saṃvāsitaḥ priye | kāśīvāsamavāpyaiva tato muktiṃ sa vindati
verses.translation: Some of them stayed in meditation taking up excellent postures. Some of them joyously performed the mental worship of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them stayed in meditation taking up excellent postures. Some of them joyously performed the mental worship of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काश्यां यो वै मृतश्चैव तस्य जन्म पुनर्न हि । समुद्दिश्य प्रयागे च मृतस्य कामनाफलम्
verses.transliteration: kāśyāṃ yo vai mṛtaścaiva tasya janma punarna hi | samuddiśya prayāge ca mṛtasya kāmanāphalam
verses.translation: O gre.at sages, the direct worship of Siva was perfor¬ med by the leader then in accordance with the rites of worshipping the earthen phallic image.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gre.at sages, the direct worship of Siva was perfor¬ med by the leader then in accordance with the rites of worshipping the earthen phallic image.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संयोगश्च तयोश्चेत्स्यात्काशीजन्यं फलं वृथा । यदि न प्राप्यते तच्च तीर्थराजफलं वृथा
verses.transliteration: saṃyogaśca tayoścetsyātkāśījanyaṃ phalaṃ vṛthā | yadi na prāpyate tacca tīrtharājaphalaṃ vṛthā
verses.translation: Those who did not know the great rite remained meditating on iva with the hvQ-syllabled mantra 'Namah Sivaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who did not know the great rite remained meditating on iva with the hvQ-syllabled mantra 'Namah Sivaya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मच्छासनाद्विष्णुः सृष्टिं साक्षाद्धि नूतनाम् । विधाय मनसोद्दिष्टां तत्सिद्धिं यच्छति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānmacchāsanādviṣṇuḥ sṛṣṭiṃ sākṣāddhi nūtanām | vidhāya manasoddiṣṭāṃ tatsiddhiṃ yacchati dhruvam
verses.translation: The leading Vaisya Supriya, a favourite of Siva, performed the worship of Siva by mental meditation
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Vaisya Supriya, a favourite of Siva, performed the worship of Siva by mental meditation
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्यादि बहुमाहात्म्यं काश्या वै मुनिसत्तमाः । तथा विश्वेश्वरस्यापि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityādi bahumāhātmyaṃ kāśyā vai munisattamāḥ | tathā viśveśvarasyāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ satām
verses.translation: Siva in the form mentioned before took up every¬ thing directly. The Vaisya was aware that his offerings were taken by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva in the form mentioned before took up every¬ thing directly. The Vaisya was aware that his offerings were taken by Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं त्र्यम्बकस्य च । यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते मानवः क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ tryambakasya ca | yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavaḥ kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: O great sages, even as the Vaisya continued to perform the worship of Siva, six months passed by without hindrance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, even as the Vaisya continued to perform the worship of Siva, six months passed by without hindrance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Siva, save me. O lord of gods, save me. O Siva, save me now froir. this wicked Raksasa. O lord of the three worlds, O slayer of the wicked, O one favourably disposed towards his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, save me. O lord of gods, save me. O Siva, save me now froir. this wicked Raksasa. O lord of the three worlds, O slayer of the wicked, O one favourably disposed towards his devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O Siva, save me. O lord of gods, save me. O Siva, save me now froir. this wicked Raksasa. O lord of the three worlds, O slayer of the wicked, O one favourably disposed towards his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, save me. O lord of gods, save me. O Siva, save me now froir. this wicked Raksasa. O lord of the three worlds, O slayer of the wicked, O one favourably disposed towards his devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । गौतमप्रभाववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । श्रूयतामृषयः श्रेष्ठाः कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् । कथयामि यथा व्यासात्सद्गुरोश्च श्रुता मया
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.24. caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | gautamaprabhāvavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | śrūyatāmṛṣayaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm | kathayāmi yathā vyāsātsadgurośca śrutā mayā
verses.translation: O lord, you alone are my entire possession. I belong to you. I am subservient to you. O lord, my very life is always in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you alone are my entire possession. I belong to you. I am subservient to you. O lord, my very life is always in you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा ऋषिवरश्चासीद्गौतमो नाम विश्रुतः । अहल्या नाम तस्यासीत्पत्नी परमधार्मिकी
verses.transliteration: purā ṛṣivaraścāsīdgautamo nāma viśrutaḥ | ahalyā nāma tasyāsītpatnī paramadhārmikī
verses.translation: "Your words will be true at the end of this Yuga. Till then, I think, there can be the Tamasaic crea¬ tions as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Your words will be true at the end of this Yuga. Till then, I think, there can be the Tamasaic crea¬ tions as well.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्यां दिशि हि यो गिरिर्ब्रह्मेति संज्ञकः । तत्र तेन तपस्तप्तं वर्षाणामयुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi hi yo girirbrahmeti saṃjñakaḥ | tatra tena tapastaptaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Parvati's strength will grow to be complete. The Mlecchas of the forest will become pious and auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parvati's strength will grow to be complete. The Mlecchas of the forest will become pious and auspicious.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिच्च ह्यनावृष्टिरभवत्तत्र सुव्रताः । वर्षाणां च शतं रौद्री लोका दुःखमुपागताः
verses.transliteration: kadācicca hyanāvṛṣṭirabhavattatra suvratāḥ | varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃ raudrī lokā duḥkhamupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Hereafter I shall explain how the phallic image Ramevara originated formerly. O sages, listen to it respect¬ fully.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hereafter I shall explain how the phallic image Ramevara originated formerly. O sages, listen to it respect¬ fully.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आर्द्रं च पल्लवं न स्म दृश्यते पृथिवीतले । कुतो जलं विदृश्येत जीवानां प्राणधारकम्
verses.transliteration: ārdraṃ ca pallavaṃ na sma dṛśyate pṛthivītale | kuto jalaṃ vidṛśyeta jīvānāṃ prāṇadhārakam
verses.translation: Formerly, Visnu the favourite of the good, took his incarnation as Rama on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Visnu the favourite of the good, took his incarnation as Rama on the earth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा ते मुनयश्चैव मनुष्याः पशवस्तथा । पक्षिणश्च मृगास्तत्र गताश्चैव दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: tadā te munayaścaiva manuṣyāḥ paśavastathā | pakṣiṇaśca mṛgāstatra gatāścaiva diśo daśa
verses.translation: O brahmins, Rama's wife Sita, the daughter of Janaka, was kidnapped by Ravana the wielder of great Maya and taken to his abode in Lanka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, Rama's wife Sita, the daughter of Janaka, was kidnapped by Ravana the wielder of great Maya and taken to his abode in Lanka.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा चर्षयो विप्राः प्राणायामपरायणाः । ध्यानेन च तदा केचित्कालं निन्युः सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā carṣayo viprāḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ | dhyānena ca tadā kecitkālaṃ ninyuḥ sudāruṇam
verses.translation: Searching for her, Rama went to the city called Kikindha.' Having alliance with Sugriva for his benefit he killed Bali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Searching for her, Rama went to the city called Kikindha.' Having alliance with Sugriva for his benefit he killed Bali.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमोऽपि स्वयं तत्र वरुणार्थे तपः शुभम् । चकार चैव षण्मासं प्राणायामपरायणः
verses.transliteration: gautamo'pi svayaṃ tatra varuṇārthe tapaḥ śubham | cakāra caiva ṣaṇmāsaṃ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After staying there for sometime, he held consul¬ tations with Laksmana, Sugriva and others eager to find her out.
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying there for sometime, he held consul¬ tations with Laksmana, Sugriva and others eager to find her out.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च वरुणस्तस्मै वरं दातुं समागतः । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूहि ददामि च वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataśca varuṇastasmai varaṃ dātuṃ samāgataḥ | prasanno'smi varaṃ brūhi dadāmi ca vaco'bravīt
verses.translation: The prince Rama sent the monkeys, the chief of whom was Hanumat, to various directions in order to find her out.
verses.commentary: Sense: The prince Rama sent the monkeys, the chief of whom was Hanumat, to various directions in order to find her out.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च गौतमस्तं वै वृष्टिं च प्रार्थयत्तदा । ततः स वरुणस्तं वै प्रत्युवाच मुनिं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tataśca gautamastaṃ vai vṛṣṭiṃ ca prārthayattadā | tataḥ sa varuṇastaṃ vai pratyuvāca muniṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Thus implored, Siva appeared out of the crevice with an excellent temple with four doors.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored, Siva appeared out of the crevice with an excellent temple with four doors.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरुण उवाच । देवाज्ञां च समुल्लङ्घ्य कथं कुर्यामहं च ताम् । अन्यत्प्रार्थय सुज्ञोऽसि यदहं करवाणि ते
verses.transliteration: varuṇa uvāca | devājñāṃ ca samullaṅghya kathaṃ kuryāmahaṃ ca tām | anyatprārthaya sujño'si yadahaṃ karavāṇi te
verses.translation: Seeing in its midst the wonderfully brilliant form f)f Siva along with his attendants he worshipped him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing in its midst the wonderfully brilliant form f)f Siva along with his attendants he worshipped him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येतद्वचनं तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः । परोपकारी तच्छ्रुत्वा गौतमो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityetadvacanaṃ tasya varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ | paropakārī tacchrutvā gautamo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: On being worshipped, Siva became delighted. He gave him the Pa<upata missile. He immediately slew all the Raksasas with all their attendants and adjuncts. He saved thus his devotee. Indeed 8iva is the slayer of the wicked.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being worshipped, Siva became delighted. He gave him the Pa<upata missile. He immediately slew all the Raksasas with all their attendants and adjuncts. He saved thus his devotee. Indeed 8iva is the slayer of the wicked.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम । यदहं प्रार्थयाम्यद्य कर्तव्यं हि त्वया तथा
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca | yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | yadahaṃ prārthayāmyadya kartavyaṃ hi tvayā tathā
verses.translation: After killing all of them, Siva the creator of his Oracles and who assumes bodies in the course of sports granted a boon to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing all of them, Siva the creator of his Oracles and who assumes bodies in the course of sports granted a boon to the forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतस्त्वं जलराशीशस्तस्माद्देयं जलं मम । अक्षयं सर्वदेवेश दिव्यं नित्यफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yatastvaṃ jalarāśīśastasmāddeyaṃ jalaṃ mama | akṣayaṃ sarvadeveśa divyaṃ nityaphalapradam
verses.translation: Let there never be people of the Tamasaic quali¬ ties. Let there be excellent sages, the propounders and the followers of the iaiva cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let there never be people of the Tamasaic quali¬ ties. Let there be excellent sages, the propounders and the followers of the iaiva cult.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति सम्प्रार्थितस्तेन वरुणो गौतमेन वै । उवाच वचनं तस्मै गर्तश्च क्रियतां त्वया
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti samprārthitastena varuṇo gautamena vai | uvāca vacanaṃ tasmai gartaśca kriyatāṃ tvayā
verses.translation: In the meantime the RaksasT Dfiruka dejected in her mind, eulogised Parvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the RaksasT Dfiruka dejected in her mind, eulogised Parvati.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च कृतस्तेन गर्तो हस्तप्रमाणतः । जलेन पूरितस्तेन दिव्येन वरुणेन सः
verses.transliteration: ityukte ca kṛtastena garto hastapramāṇataḥ | jalena pūritastena divyena varuṇena saḥ
verses.translation: 'I'hc goddess being pleased said "What shall 1 do?" She replied-"Let my race be protected by you".
verses.commentary: Sense: 'I'hc goddess being pleased said "What shall 1 do?" She replied-"Let my race be protected by you".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच मुनिं देवो वरुणो हि जलाधिपः । गौतमं मुनिशार्दूलं परोपकृतिशालिनम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca muniṃ devo varuṇo hi jalādhipaḥ | gautamaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ paropakṛtiśālinam
verses.translation: "I shall protect your race. I say this truth to you." Saying this the Goddess quairelied with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall protect your race. I say this truth to you." Saying this the Goddess quairelied with Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरुण उवाच । अक्षयं च जलं तेऽस्तु तीर्थभूतं महामुने । तव नाम्ना च विख्यातं क्षितावेतद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: varuṇa uvāca | akṣayaṃ ca jalaṃ te'stu tīrthabhūtaṃ mahāmune | tava nāmnā ca vikhyātaṃ kṣitāvetadbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On seeing the goddess furious, the lord, bound by the boon granted by him, replied with pleasure. "Do as you please".
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the goddess furious, the lord, bound by the boon granted by him, replied with pleasure. "Do as you please".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र दत्तं हुतं तप्तं सुराणां यजनं कृतम् । पितॄणां च कृतं श्राद्धं सर्वमेवाक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: atra dattaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ surāṇāṃ yajanaṃ kṛtam | pitṝṇāṃ ca kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvamevākṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her husband Siva, the delighted Parvati laughed and spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her husband Siva, the delighted Parvati laughed and spoke these words.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तान्तर्दधे देवः स्तुतस्तेन महर्षिणा । गौतमोऽपि सुखं प्राप कृत्वान्योपकृतिं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktāntardadhe devaḥ stutastena maharṣiṇā | gautamo'pi sukhaṃ prāpa kṛtvānyopakṛtiṃ muniḥ
verses.translation: Otherwise the dissolution will lake place even now. O Siva, let the words uttered by me be proved true. O lord, I belong to you. I depend on you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Otherwise the dissolution will lake place even now. O Siva, let the words uttered by me be proved true. O lord, I belong to you. I depend on you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महतो ह्याश्रयः पुंसां महत्त्वायोपजायते । महान्तस्तत्स्वरूपं च पश्यन्ति नेतरेऽशुभाः
verses.transliteration: mahato hyāśrayaḥ puṃsāṃ mahattvāyopajāyate | mahāntastatsvarūpaṃ ca paśyanti netare'śubhāḥ
verses.translation: These wives of the Raksasas will give birth to sons. I have permitted all of them to live jointly in the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: These wives of the Raksasas will give birth to sons. I have permitted all of them to live jointly in the forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यादृङ्नरं च सेवेत तादृशं फलमश्नुते । महतः सेवयोच्चत्वं क्षुद्रस्य क्षुद्रतां तथा
verses.transliteration: yādṛṅnaraṃ ca seveta tādṛśaṃ phalamaśnute | mahataḥ sevayoccatvaṃ kṣudrasya kṣudratāṃ tathā
verses.translation: O beloved, if you say so, please listen to my words. I will stay in this forest with pleasure for protecting the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, if you say so, please listen to my words. I will stay in this forest with pleasure for protecting the devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सिंहस्य मन्दिरे सेवा मुक्ताफलकरी मता । शृगालमन्दिरे सेवा त्वस्थिलाभकरी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: siṃhasya mandire sevā muktāphalakarī matā | śṛgālamandire sevā tvasthilābhakarī smṛtā
verses.translation: He who maintains the discipline of rites and activities prescribed for different castes and has a sight of me with pleasure here will become an emperor.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who maintains the discipline of rites and activities prescribed for different castes and has a sight of me with pleasure here will become an emperor.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमानां स्वभावोऽयं परदुःखासहिष्णुता । स्वयं दुःखं च सम्प्राप्तं मन्यतेऽन्यस्य वार्यते
verses.transliteration: uttamānāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇutā | svayaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca samprāptaṃ manyate'nyasya vāryate
verses.translation: Or, at the end of the recurring cycle qf Kali or in the beginning of Kfta Age, the leading king equipped with a vast army, famous in the name of Virasena son of Mahasena, will have a sight of me. He will be a very
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, at the end of the recurring cycle qf Kali or in the beginning of Kfta Age, the leading king equipped with a vast army, famous in the name of Virasena son of Mahasena, will have a sight of me. He will be a very
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाश्च हाटकं चैव चन्दनं चेक्षुकस्तथा । एते भुवि परार्थे च दक्षा एवं न केचन
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāśca hāṭakaṃ caiva candanaṃ cekṣukastathā | ete bhuvi parārthe ca dakṣā evaṃ na kecana
verses.translation: Exchanging pleasantries thus, the couple, O brah¬ mins, indulging in great sports remained there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Exchanging pleasantries thus, the couple, O brah¬ mins, indulging in great sports remained there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दयालुरमदस्पर्श उपकारी जितेन्द्रियः । एतैश्च पुण्यस्तम्भैस्तु चतुर्भिर्धार्यते मही
verses.transliteration: dayāluramadasparśa upakārī jitendriyaḥ | etaiśca puṇyastambhaistu caturbhirdhāryate mahī
verses.translation: The Jyotirlihga form of Siva came to be known as Nagesvara. Goddess Siva became Nagesvarl. Both of them are favourites of the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Jyotirlihga form of Siva came to be known as Nagesvara. Goddess Siva became Nagesvarl. Both of them are favourites of the devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च गौतमस्तत्र जलं प्राप्य सुदुर्लभम् । नित्यनैमित्तिकं कर्म चकार विधिवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tataśca gautamastatra jalaṃ prāpya sudurlabham | nityanaimittikaṃ karma cakāra vidhivattadā
verses.translation: O intelligent one, how will VIrasena go to Daruka vana and worship Siva? Please narrate it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, how will VIrasena go to Daruka vana and worship Siva? Please narrate it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्रीहीन् यवांश्चैव नीवारानप्यनेकधा । वापयामास तत्रैव हवनार्थं मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato vrīhīn yavāṃścaiva nīvārānapyanekadhā | vāpayāmāsa tatraiva havanārthaṃ munīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Worshipping the earthen image of the lord, Virasena performed a severe penance, lasting for twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worshipping the earthen image of the lord, Virasena performed a severe penance, lasting for twelve years.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धान्यानि विविधानीह वृक्षाश्च विविधास्तथा । पुष्पाणि च फलान्येव ह्यासंस्तत्राप्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: dhānyāni vividhānīha vṛkṣāśca vividhāstathā | puṣpāṇi ca phalānyeva hyāsaṃstatrāpyanekaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then Siva, the delighted lord of the gods, became visible to him and said:—Make a fish-like canoe of wood. Coat it with tin and other metals. O Virasena, I shall create Yogamaya and give it to you. Enter the canoe accompanied by Yogamaya and your men. Proceed to the island in the Western ocean.'® Enter the crevice made by me. Perform the worship of Nagevara. Thereafter secure the missile PaiSupata and slay the Raksasi and others. When I appear before you; you will not remain deficient in anything.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Siva, the delighted lord of the gods, became visible to him and said:—Make a fish-like canoe of wood. Coat it with tin and other metals. O Virasena, I shall create Yogamaya and give it to you. Enter the canoe accompanied by Yogamaya and your men.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Siva, the delighted lord of the gods, became visible to him and said:—Make a fish-like canoe of wood. Coat it with tin and other metals. O Virasena, I shall create Yogamaya and give it to you. Enter the canoe accompanied by Yogamaya and your men.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषयश्चान्ये तत्रायाताः सहस्रशः । पशवः पक्षिणश्चान्ये जीवाश्च बहवोऽगमन्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā ṛṣayaścānye tatrāyātāḥ sahasraśaḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścānye jīvāśca bahavo'gaman
verses.translation: After saying this to Virasena and bestowing his mercy on everyone lord Siva, the destroyer of miseries, vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to Virasena and bestowing his mercy on everyone lord Siva, the destroyer of miseries, vanished there itself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वनं सुन्दरं ह्यासीत्पृथिव्यां मण्डले परम् । तदक्षयजलायोगादनावृष्टिर्न दुःखदा
verses.transliteration: tadvanaṃ sundaraṃ hyāsītpṛthivyāṃ maṇḍale param | tadakṣayajalāyogādanāvṛṣṭirna duḥkhadā
verses.translation: Having received the boon form Siva the supreme soul, Virasena became competent to do everything, of course.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having received the boon form Siva the supreme soul, Virasena became competent to do everything, of course.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयोऽपि वने तत्र शुभकर्मपरायणाः । वासं चक्रुरनेके च शिष्यभार्यासुतान्विताः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo'pi vane tatra śubhakarmaparāyaṇāḥ | vāsaṃ cakruraneke ca śiṣyabhāryāsutānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Sfc P. ij7;j note.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sfc P. ij7;j note.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धान्यानि वापयामासुः कालक्रमणहेतवे । आनन्दस्तद्वने ह्यासीत्प्रभावाद्गौतमस्य च
verses.transliteration: dhānyāni vāpayāmāsuḥ kālakramaṇahetave | ānandastadvane hyāsītprabhāvādgautamasya ca
verses.translation: He who listens to the origin of Nagcsa respect¬ fully attains all desires. He becomes intelligent. And his sins are destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the origin of Nagcsa respect¬ fully attains all desires. He becomes intelligent. And his sins are destroyed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, accompanied by Hanuman the chief of monkeys, Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkey chiefs of
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, accompanied by Hanuman the chief of monkeys, Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkey chiefs of
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, accompanied by Hanuman the chief of monkeys, Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkey chiefs of
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, accompanied by Hanuman the chief of monkeys, Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkey chiefs of
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । गौतमव्यवस्थावर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । कदाचिद्गौतमेनैव जलार्थं प्रेषिता निजाः । शिष्यास्तत्र गता भक्त्या कमण्डलुकरा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.25. pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | gautamavyavasthāvarṇanam | sūta uvāca | kadācidgautamenaiva jalārthaṃ preṣitā nijāḥ | śiṣyāstatra gatā bhaktyā kamaṇḍalukarā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Reaching there, Rama the favourite of Siva stationed himself on the shore, being served by the monkeys and his brother Laksmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reaching there, Rama the favourite of Siva stationed himself on the shore, being served by the monkeys and his brother Laksmana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यान् जलसमीपे तु गतान्दृष्ट्वा न्यषेधयन् । जलार्थमागतास्तत्र चर्षिपत्न्योऽप्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyān jalasamīpe tu gatāndṛṣṭvā nyaṣedhayan | jalārthamāgatāstatra carṣipatnyo'pyanekaśaḥ
verses.translation: O lord Siva, O great lord, always favourably
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, O great lord, always favourably
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिपत्न्यो वयं पूर्वं ग्रहीष्यामो विदूरतः । पश्चाच्चैव जलं ग्राह्यमित्येवं पर्यभर्त्सयन्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣipatnyo vayaṃ pūrvaṃ grahīṣyāmo vidūrataḥ | paścāccaiva jalaṃ grāhyamityevaṃ paryabhartsayan
verses.translation: Securing the blessing of victory granted by Siva and receiving the permission of the lord he prayed again with palms joined in reverence and head bent down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing the blessing of victory granted by Siva and receiving the permission of the lord he prayed again with palms joined in reverence and head bent down.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परावृत्य तदा तैश्च ऋषिपत्न्यै निवेदितम् । सा चापि तान्समादाय समाश्वास्य च तैः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: parāvṛtya tadā taiśca ṛṣipatnyai niveditam | sā cāpi tānsamādāya samāśvāsya ca taiḥ svayam
verses.translation: He used to reproach her saying, *'0 gentle lady, there is no son, no mother, no father, no lor. Every one is selfishly inclined in the world, there is no doubt about this. Know this particularly with a keen intellect. Do not be aggrieved. O gentle lady, misery shall be eschewed by you, certainly. O one of auspicious rites, you shall not pester me like this everyday." After enlightening her, he became intciested in the worship of the lord. He was perfectly contented. He did not feel the misery or joy of mutually contrary interests.
verses.wordMeaning: He used to reproach her saying, *'0 gentle lady, there is no son, no mother, no father, no lor. Every one is selfishly inclined in the world, there is no doubt about this. Know this particularly with a keen intellect. Do not be aggrieved. O gentle lady,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He used to reproach her saying, *'0 gentle lady, there is no son, no mother, no father, no lor. Every one is selfishly inclined in the world, there is no doubt about this. Know this particularly with a keen intellect. Do not be aggrieved. O gentle lady,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जलं नीत्वा ददौ तस्मै गौतमाय तपस्विनी । नित्यं निर्वाहयामास जलेन ऋषिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: jalaṃ nītvā dadau tasmai gautamāya tapasvinī | nityaṃ nirvāhayāmāsa jalena ṛṣisattamaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing it the husband sighed deeply. Remember¬ ing the lotus-like feet of Siva he spoke to his beloved.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it the husband sighed deeply. Remember¬ ing the lotus-like feet of Siva he spoke to his beloved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ताश्चैवमृषिपत्न्यस्तु क्रुद्धास्तां पर्यभर्त्सयन् । परावृत्य गताः सर्वास्तूटजान्कुटिलाशयाः
verses.transliteration: tāścaivamṛṣipatnyastu kruddhāstāṃ paryabhartsayan | parāvṛtya gatāḥ sarvāstūṭajānkuṭilāśayāḥ
verses.translation: Thus implored by her, Sudharma married that lady Ghuma with due ceremonies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored by her, Sudharma married that lady Ghuma with due ceremonies.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वाम्यग्रे विपरीतं च तद्वृत्तं निखिलं ततः । दुष्टाशयाभिः स्त्रीभिश्च ताभिर्वै विनिवेदितम्
verses.transliteration: svāmyagre viparītaṃ ca tadvṛttaṃ nikhilaṃ tataḥ | duṣṭāśayābhiḥ strībhiśca tābhirvai viniveditam
verses.translation: After marrying her he requested Sudeha, "O my pious beloved, this is your younger sister. You must bring her up."
verses.commentary: Sense: After marrying her he requested Sudeha, "O my pious beloved, this is your younger sister. You must bring her up."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तासां वचः श्रुत्वा भाविकर्मवशात्तदा । गौतमाय च सङ्क्रुद्धाश्चासंस्ते परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: atha tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhāvikarmavaśāttadā | gautamāya ca saṅkruddhāścāsaṃste paramarṣayaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, Sudharma, the most excellent devotee of Siva, pursued his sacred rites to the utmost with his mind leaning towards virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Sudharma, the most excellent devotee of Siva, pursued his sacred rites to the utmost with his mind leaning towards virtue.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नार्थं गौतमस्यैव नानापूजोपहारकैः । गणेशं पूजयामासुः सङ्क्रुद्धास्ते कुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: vighnārthaṃ gautamasyaiva nānāpūjopahārakaiḥ | gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ saṅkruddhāste kubuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: Sudeha served her sister like a hired wench eschewing all opposition and lovingly nurtured her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sudeha served her sister like a hired wench eschewing all opposition and lovingly nurtured her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आविर्बभूव च तदा प्रसन्नो हि गणेश्वरः । उवाच वचनं तत्र भक्ताधीनः फलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: āvirbabhūva ca tadā prasanno hi gaṇeśvaraḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ tatra bhaktādhīnaḥ phalapradaḥ
verses.translation: "Alas where has Janaki gone? When will she meet me. The ocean is very deep. The army of the monkeys is to be taken across. The Raksasa of great strength and valour, the uplifter of the mountain Kailasa has resorted to his stronghold Lanka. His son is Indrajit, the conqueror of Indra. Thus thought Rama in the company of Laksmana standing on the shore itself. He was appeased by Ahgada and other monkeys.
