verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूत यूयं किं करवाण्यहम् । तदीयं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयस्तेऽब्रुवंस्तदा
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśa uvāca | prasanno'smi varaṃ brūta yūyaṃ kiṃ karavāṇyaham | tadīyaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayaste'bruvaṃstadā
verses.translation: Then Rama the excellent devotee of Siva, desirous of water, lovingly spoke to his brother Laksmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rama the excellent devotee of Siva, desirous of water, lovingly spoke to his brother Laksmana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । त्वया यदि वरो देयो गौतमः स्वाश्रमाद बहिः । निष्काश्यमानो ऋषिभिः परिभर्त्स्य तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | tvayā yadi varo deyo gautamaḥ svāśramāda bahiḥ | niṣkāśyamāno ṛṣibhiḥ paribhartsya tathā kuru
verses.translation: O brother Laksmana, lord of heroes, I am thirsty. I desire water. You get some water quickly through some monkey.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brother Laksmana, lord of heroes, I am thirsty. I desire water. You get some water quickly through some monkey.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स एवं प्रार्थितस्तैस्तु विहस्य वचनं पुनः । प्रोवाचेभमुखः प्रीत्या बोधयंस्तान्सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | sa evaṃ prārthitastaistu vihasya vacanaṃ punaḥ | provācebhamukhaḥ prītyā bodhayaṃstānsatāṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it the monkeys ran in all directions. They brought water, bowed to Rama and standing before him said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it the monkeys ran in all directions. They brought water, bowed to Rama and standing before him said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । श्रूयतामृषयः सर्वे युक्तं न क्रियतेऽधुना । अपराधं विना तस्मै क्रुध्यतां हानिरेव च
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśa uvāca | śrūyatāmṛṣayaḥ sarve yuktaṃ na kriyate'dhunā | aparādhaṃ vinā tasmai krudhyatāṃ hānireva ca
verses.translation: O lord, at your behest we have brought excellent water, sweet, cool and refreshing. Please take it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, at your behest we have brought excellent water, sweet, cool and refreshing. Please take it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपस्कृतं पुरा यैस्तु तेभ्यो दुःखं हितं न हि । यदा च दीयते दुःखं तदा नाशो भवेदिह
verses.transliteration: upaskṛtaṃ purā yaistu tebhyo duḥkhaṃ hitaṃ na hi | yadā ca dīyate duḥkhaṃ tadā nāśo bhavediha
verses.translation: When Rama, the devotee of Siva, took the water and was about to drink it, it occurred to him at the will of l§iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Rama, the devotee of Siva, took the water and was about to drink it, it occurred to him at the will of l§iva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशं च तपः कृत्वा साध्यते फलमुत्तमम् । शुभं फलं स्वयं हित्वा साध्यते नाहितं पुनः
verses.transliteration: īdṛśaṃ ca tapaḥ kṛtvā sādhyate phalamuttamam | śubhaṃ phalaṃ svayaṃ hitvā sādhyate nāhitaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: "1 have not yet had the sight of Siva, the great lord, the bestower of all bliss. How can the water be taken in?'*
verses.commentary: Sense: "1 have not yet had the sight of Siva, the great lord, the bestower of all bliss. How can the water be taken in?'*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा तस्य ते मुनिसत्तमाः । बुद्धिमोहं तदा प्राप्ता इदमेव वचोऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tasya te munisattamāḥ | buddhimohaṃ tadā prāptā idameva vaco'bruvan
verses.translation: After saying this, he drank water and then
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, he drank water and then
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ कर्तव्यं हि त्वया स्वामिन्निदमेव न चान्यथा । इत्युक्तस्तु तदा देवो गणेशो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || kartavyaṃ hi tvayā svāminnidameva na cānyathā | ityuktastu tadā devo gaṇeśo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: He worshipped Siva performing all the sixteen ancillary services like invocation etc. with devotion according to the rules obtaining.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped Siva performing all the sixteen ancillary services like invocation etc. with devotion according to the rules obtaining.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । असाधुः साधुतां चैव साधुश्चासाधुतां तथा । कदाचिदपि नाप्नोति ब्रह्मोक्तमिति निश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśa uvāca | asādhuḥ sādhutāṃ caiva sādhuścāsādhutāṃ tathā | kadācidapi nāpnoti brahmoktamiti niścitam
verses.translation: After propitiating him with obeisances, divine
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating him with obeisances, divine
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा च भवतां दुःखं जातं चानशनात्पुरा । तदा सुखं प्रदत्तं वै गौतमेन महर्षिणा
verses.transliteration: yadā ca bhavatāṃ duḥkhaṃ jātaṃ cānaśanātpurā | tadā sukhaṃ pradattaṃ vai gautamena maharṣiṇā
verses.translation: O Bhavatarana (one who takes devotees across the ocan of worldly existence), this ocean is very deep. The Raksasa Ravana is heroic and mighty.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bhavatarana (one who takes devotees across the ocan of worldly existence), this ocean is very deep. The Raksasa Ravana is heroic and mighty.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं वै भवद्भिश्च तस्मै दुःखं प्रदीयते । नैतद्युक्ततमं लोके सर्वथा सुविचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ vai bhavadbhiśca tasmai duḥkhaṃ pradīyate | naitadyuktatamaṃ loke sarvathā suvicāryatām
verses.translation: In that, O lord of good rites, help must be rendered to me. O lord, without your help my purpose is difficult to be achieved.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that, O lord of good rites, help must be rendered to me. O lord, without your help my purpose is difficult to be achieved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबलान्मोहिता यूयं न मे वाक्यं करिष्यथ । एतद्धिततमं तस्य भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: strībalānmohitā yūyaṃ na me vākyaṃ kariṣyatha | etaddhitatamaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Sadasiva, I too am your slave, in every respect subservient to you. Considering this, you shall be partial to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sadasiva, I too am your slave, in every respect subservient to you. Considering this, you shall be partial to me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्चायमृषिश्रेष्ठो दास्यते वः सुखं ध्रुवम् । तारणं न च युक्तं स्याद्वरमन्यं वृणीत वै
verses.transliteration: punaścāyamṛṣiśreṣṭho dāsyate vaḥ sukhaṃ dhruvam | tāraṇaṃ na ca yuktaṃ syādvaramanyaṃ vṛṇīta vai
verses.translation: After praying and bowing to the lord again and again, he repeated loudly, "O Siva, be victorious, be victorious" and eulogised Siva. Repealing the mantras and meditating, he performed the worship again and danced before the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: After praying and bowing to the lord again and again, he repeated loudly, "O Siva, be victorious, be victorious" and eulogised Siva. Repealing the mantras and meditating, he performed the worship again and danced before the lord.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं तेन गणेशेन महात्मना । यद्यप्युक्तमृषिभ्यश्च तदप्येते न मेनिरे
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ vacanaṃ tena gaṇeśena mahātmanā | yadyapyuktamṛṣibhyaśca tadapyete na menire
verses.translation: With the heart drenched with devotional love he produced the throat-sound. Lord l§iva was much delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the heart drenched with devotional love he produced the throat-sound. Lord l§iva was much delighted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्ताधीनतया सोऽथ शिवपुत्रोऽब्रवीत्तदा । उदासीनेन मनसा तानृषीन्दुष्टशेमुषीन्
verses.transliteration: bhaktādhīnatayā so'tha śivaputro'bravīttadā | udāsīnena manasā tānṛṣīnduṣṭaśemuṣīn
verses.translation: Assuming the pure form as mentioned and
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming the pure form as mentioned and
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । भवद्भिः प्रार्थ्यते यच्च करिष्येऽहं तथा खलु । पश्चाद्भावि भवेदेव इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे पुनः
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśa uvāca | bhavadbhiḥ prārthyate yacca kariṣye'haṃ tathā khalu | paścādbhāvi bhavedeva ityuktvāntardadhe punaḥ
verses.translation: Then, satisfied in his heart with Rama's devotion lord Siva said—"O Rama, may there be welfare to you. Mention the boon you wish to have."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, satisfied in his heart with Rama's devotion lord Siva said—"O Rama, may there be welfare to you. Mention the boon you wish to have."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमः स न जानाति मुनीनां वै दुराशयम् । आनन्दमनसा नित्यं पत्न्या कर्म चकार तत्
verses.transliteration: gautamaḥ sa na jānāti munīnāṃ vai durāśayam | ānandamanasā nityaṃ patnyā karma cakāra tat
verses.translation: On seeing that form, they became sanctified. Rama himself, interested in Saiva cult, performed the worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that form, they became sanctified. Rama himself, interested in Saiva cult, performed the worship.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे च यज्जातं चरित्रं वरयोगतः । तद्दुष्टर्षिप्रभावात्तु श्रूयतां तन्मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tadantare ca yajjātaṃ caritraṃ varayogataḥ | tadduṣṭarṣiprabhāvāttu śrūyatāṃ tanmunīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Eulogising in diverse ways and bowing to Siva joyously he requested for his victory in the imminent fight with Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eulogising in diverse ways and bowing to Siva joyously he requested for his victory in the imminent fight with Ravana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्य च केदारे तत्रासन्व्रीहयो यवाः । गणेशस्तत्र गौर्भूत्वा जगाम किल दुर्बला
verses.transliteration: gautamasya ca kedāre tatrāsanvrīhayo yavāḥ | gaṇeśastatra gaurbhūtvā jagāma kila durbalā
verses.translation: Delighted in his heart at Ram's devotion, lord Siva said lovingly—"O great king, may you be victorious".
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted in his heart at Ram's devotion, lord Siva said lovingly—"O great king, may you be victorious".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कम्पमाना च सा गत्वा तत्र तद्वरयोगतः । व्रीहीन्सम्भक्षयामास यवांश्च मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kampamānā ca sā gatvā tatra tadvarayogataḥ | vrīhīnsambhakṣayāmāsa yavāṃśca munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: O Siva, if you arc pleased, you shall stay here, O lord, to sanctify the worlds and to render help to the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, if you arc pleased, you shall stay here, O lord, to sanctify the worlds and to render help to the people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दैवाद् गौतमस्तत्र चागतः । स दयालुस्तृणस्तम्बैर्वारयामास तां तदा
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare daivād gautamastatra cāgataḥ | sa dayālustṛṇastambairvārayāmāsa tāṃ tadā
verses.translation: Thus implored Siva took up the phallic image named RameSvara. It is now famous on the surface of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored Siva took up the phallic image named RameSvara. It is now famous on the surface of the world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तृणस्तम्बेन सा स्पृष्टा पपात पृथिवीतले । मृता च तत्क्षणादेव तदृषेः पश्यतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tṛṇastambena sā spṛṣṭā papāta pṛthivītale | mṛtā ca tatkṣaṇādeva tadṛṣeḥ paśyatastadā
verses.translation: He who performs the ablution of Siva with the waters of the divine Gahga and worships Ramcsvara with great devotion becomes a living liberated soul indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs the ablution of Siva with the waters of the divine Gahga and worships Ramcsvara with great devotion becomes a living liberated soul indeed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश्छन्नरूपास्ते ऋषिपत्न्यस्तथाशुभाः । ऊचुस्तत्र तदा सर्वे किं कृतं गौतमेन च
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaśchannarūpāste ṛṣipatnyastathāśubhāḥ | ūcustatra tadā sarve kiṃ kṛtaṃ gautamena ca
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the next Jyotirlinga to be mentioned is 6hu4mela. May its greatness be listened to.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, the next Jyotirlinga to be mentioned is 6hu4mela. May its greatness be listened to.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमोऽपि तथाहल्यामाहूयासीत्सुविस्मितः । उवाच दुःखतो विप्रा दूयमानेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: gautamo'pi tathāhalyāmāhūyāsītsuvismitaḥ | uvāca duḥkhato viprā dūyamānena cetasā
verses.translation: The excellent brahmin Sudharma worshipped gods and guests. He was devotedly attached to the Vedic path and scrupulously maintained the sacrificial fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent brahmin Sudharma worshipped gods and guests. He was devotedly attached to the Vedic path and scrupulously maintained the sacrificial fires.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । किं जातं च कथं देवि कुपितः परमेश्वरः । किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं हत्या च समुपस्थिता
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca | kiṃ jātaṃ ca kathaṃ devi kupitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ hatyā ca samupasthitā
verses.translation: He had the brilliance of the Sun. He performed Sandhya prayers thrice a day. He taught disciples and was an expert in the Vedas and Sastras both.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had the brilliance of the Sun. He performed Sandhya prayers thrice a day. He taught disciples and was an expert in the Vedas and Sastras both.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्रा गौतमं पर्यभर्त्सयन् । विप्रपत्न्यस्तथाहल्यां दुर्वचोभिर्व्यथां ददुः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | etasminnantare viprā gautamaṃ paryabhartsayan | viprapatnyastathāhalyāṃ durvacobhirvyathāṃ daduḥ
verses.translation: A long period in his life thus passed when he continued his religious rites but no son was born to him. His wife's menstrual periods were fruitless. She did not conceive.
verses.commentary: Sense: A long period in his life thus passed when he continued his religious rites but no son was born to him. His wife's menstrual periods were fruitless. She did not conceive.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बुद्धयश्च तच्छिष्याः सुतास्तेषां तथैव च । गौतमं परिभर्त्स्यैव प्रत्यूचुर्धिग्वचो मुहुः
verses.transliteration: durbuddhayaśca tacchiṣyāḥ sutāsteṣāṃ tathaiva ca | gautamaṃ paribhartsyaiva pratyūcurdhigvaco muhuḥ
verses.translation: He did not grieve over this because he realised the*reality of different things. He knew that the soul is the uplifter of the soul and the soul is the sanctifier of the soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He did not grieve over this because he realised the*reality of different things. He knew that the soul is the uplifter of the soul and the soul is the sanctifier of the soul.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । मुखं न दर्शनीयं ते गम्यतां गम्यतामिति । दृष्ट्वा गोघ्नमुखं सद्यः सचैलं स्नानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | mukhaṃ na darśanīyaṃ te gamyatāṃ gamyatāmiti | dṛṣṭvā goghnamukhaṃ sadyaḥ sacailaṃ snānamācaret
verses.translation: Thinking thus he did not feel aggrieved even mentally. But Sudeha was distressed for not having a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus he did not feel aggrieved even mentally. But Sudeha was distressed for not having a son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यावदाश्रममध्ये त्वं तावदेव हविर्भुजः । पितरश्च न गृह्णन्ति ह्यस्मद्दत्तं हि किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: yāvadāśramamadhye tvaṃ tāvadeva havirbhujaḥ | pitaraśca na gṛhṇanti hyasmaddattaṃ hi kiñcana
verses.translation: Everyday she implored her learned husband to strive for the acquisition of a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday she implored her learned husband to strive for the acquisition of a son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गच्छान्यतस्त्वं च परिवारसमन्वितः । विलम्बं कुरु नैव त्वं धेनुहन्पापकारक
verses.transliteration: tasmādgacchānyatastvaṃ ca parivārasamanvitaḥ | vilambaṃ kuru naiva tvaṃ dhenuhanpāpakāraka
verses.translation: Once Sudeha went to the neighbour's house for a friendly chat but a quarrel arose there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once Sudeha went to the neighbour's house for a friendly chat but a quarrel arose there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा ते च तं सर्वे पाषाणैः समताडयन् । व्यथां ददुरतीवास्मै त्वहल्यां च दुरुक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā te ca taṃ sarve pāṣāṇaiḥ samatāḍayan | vyathāṃ daduratīvāsmai tvahalyāṃ ca duruktibhiḥ
verses.translation: O sonless woman, why are you arrogant? I have i son who will inherit my wealth. But there is none to inherit your property.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sonless woman, why are you arrogant? I have i son who will inherit my wealth. But there is none to inherit your property.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ताडितो भर्त्सितो दुष्टैर्गौतमो गिरमब्रवीत् । इतो गच्छामि मुनयो ह्यन्यत्र निवसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tāḍito bhartsito duṣṭairgautamo giramabravīt | ito gacchāmi munayo hyanyatra nivasāmyaham
verses.translation: Undoubtedly the king will confiscate your estate. O barren woman, fie upon you, upon your wealth, upon your honour and prestige.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly the king will confiscate your estate. O barren woman, fie upon you, upon your wealth, upon your honour and prestige.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा गौतमस्तस्मात्स्थानाच्च निर्गतस्तदा । गत्वा क्रोशं तदा चक्रे ह्याश्रमं तदनुज्ञया
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā gautamastasmātsthānācca nirgatastadā | gatvā krośaṃ tadā cakre hyāśramaṃ tadanujñayā
verses.translation: Thus reproached by her she returned home depressed. She narrated to her husband all what her neigh¬ bour had said to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus reproached by her she returned home depressed. She narrated to her husband all what her neigh¬ bour had said to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यावच्चैवाभिशापो वै तावत्कार्यं न किञ्चन । न कर्मण्यधिकारोऽस्ति दैवे पित्र्येऽथ वैदिके
verses.transliteration: yāvaccaivābhiśāpo vai tāvatkāryaṃ na kiñcana | na karmaṇyadhikāro'sti daive pitrye'tha vaidike
verses.translation: Thus pacified and consoled again and again by her husband she did not stop worrying. She again pleaded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus pacified and consoled again and again by her husband she did not stop worrying. She again pleaded.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मासार्धं च ततो नीत्वा मुनीन्सम्प्रार्थयत्तदा । गौतमो मुनिवर्यः स तेन दुःखेन दुखितः
verses.transliteration: māsārdhaṃ ca tato nītvā munīnsamprārthayattadā | gautamo munivaryaḥ sa tena duḥkhena dukhitaḥ
verses.translation: You are my husband. Somehow you shall beget a son. O excellent among men, otherwise I.shall cast off this body.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are my husband. Somehow you shall beget a son. O excellent among men, otherwise I.shall cast off this body.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । अनुकम्प्यो भवद्भिश्च कथ्यतां क्रियते मया । यथा मदीयं पापं च गच्छत्विति निवेद्यताम्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca | anukampyo bhavadbhiśca kathyatāṃ kriyate mayā | yathā madīyaṃ pāpaṃ ca gacchatviti nivedyatām
verses.translation: On hearing what she said, Sudharma the excellent brahmin, harassed by her importunities, mentally remembered Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing what she said, Sudharma the excellent brahmin, harassed by her importunities, mentally remembered Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते तदा विप्रा नोचुश्चैव परस्परम् । अत्यन्तं सेवया पृष्टा मिलिता ह्येकतः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktāste tadā viprā nocuścaiva parasparam | atyantaṃ sevayā pṛṣṭā militā hyekataḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: The alert brahmin offered two flowers to the sacrificial lire. He thought in his mind that the right side flower would yield a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert brahmin offered two flowers to the sacrificial lire. He thought in his mind that the right side flower would yield a son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो दूरतः स्थित्वा नत्वा तानृषिसत्तमान् । पप्रच्छ विनयाविष्टः किं कार्यं हि मयाधुना
verses.transliteration: gautamo dūrataḥ sthitvā natvā tānṛṣisattamān | papraccha vinayāviṣṭaḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ hi mayādhunā
verses.translation: Making this as a condition the brahmin told his wife. '-You shall lake one of these* two flowers to decide about the acquisition of a son"
verses.commentary: Sense: Making this as a condition the brahmin told his wife. '-You shall lake one of these* two flowers to decide about the acquisition of a son"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते मुनिना तेन गौतमेन महात्मना । मिलिताः सकलास्ते वै मुनयो वाक्यमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: ityukte muninā tena gautamena mahātmanā | militāḥ sakalāste vai munayo vākyamabruvan
verses.translation: She thought "I will surely have a son. Let (he insignia flower come to me." Then she bowed to Siva and the sacrificial fire." After praying again she picked up one of the flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: She thought "I will surely have a son. Let (he insignia flower come to me." Then she bowed to Siva and the sacrificial fire." After praying again she picked up one of the flowers.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । निष्कृतिं हि विना शुद्धिर्जायते न कदाचन । तस्मात्त्वं देहशुद्ध्यर्थं प्रायश्चित्तं समाचर
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | niṣkṛtiṃ hi vinā śuddhirjāyate na kadācana | tasmāttvaṃ dehaśuddhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācara
verses.translation: After saying so and giving up hope himself, the brahmin became engaged in sacred rites and meditation on Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying so and giving up hope himself, the brahmin became engaged in sacred rites and meditation on Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवारं पृथिवीं सर्वां क्रम पापं प्रकाशयन् । पुनरागत्य चात्रैव चर मासव्रतं तथा
verses.transliteration: trivāraṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ krama pāpaṃ prakāśayan | punarāgatya cātraiva cara māsavrataṃ tathā
verses.translation: Yearning for a son Sudeha did not leave off her pleadings. With palms joined in reverence and bending her head she lovingly said to her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yearning for a son Sudeha did not leave off her pleadings. With palms joined in reverence and bending her head she lovingly said to her husband.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतमेकोत्तरं चैव ब्रह्मणोऽस्य गिरेस्तथा । प्रक्रमणं विधायैवं शुद्धिस्ते च भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: śatamekottaraṃ caiva brahmaṇo'sya girestathā | prakramaṇaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ śuddhiste ca bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Let there be no son born of me. With my consent you shall take another wife. Undoubtedly she will bear you a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let there be no son born of me. With my consent you shall take another wife. Undoubtedly she will bear you a son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवा त्वं समानीय गङ्गास्नानं समाचर । पार्थिवानां तथा कोटिं कृत्वा देवं निषेवय
verses.transliteration: athavā tvaṃ samānīya gaṅgāsnānaṃ samācara | pārthivānāṃ tathā koṭiṃ kṛtvā devaṃ niṣevaya
verses.translation: Requested thus by his beloved wife, that brahmin the most excellent of the devotees of Siva and fond of sacred rites spoke to hcf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Requested thus by his beloved wife, that brahmin the most excellent of the devotees of Siva and fond of sacred rites spoke to hcf.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायां च ततः स्नात्वा पुतश्चैव भविष्यसि । पुरा दश तथा चैकं गिरेस्त्वं क्रमणं कुरु
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyāṃ ca tataḥ snātvā putaścaiva bhaviṣyasi | purā daśa tathā caikaṃ girestvaṃ kramaṇaṃ kuru
verses.translation: Our miseries have gone ofT, O beloved, do not
verses.commentary: Sense: Our miseries have gone ofT, O beloved, do not
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतकुम्म्भैस्तथा स्नात्वा पार्थिवं निष्कृतिर्भवेत् । इति तैरॄषिभिः प्रोक्तस्तथेत्योमिति तद्वचः
verses.transliteration: śatakummbhaistathā snātvā pārthivaṃ niṣkṛtirbhavet | iti tairṝṣibhiḥ proktastathetyomiti tadvacaḥ
verses.translation: Although prevented thus, she brought her mother's younger daughter to her house and said to her husband "Take her."
verses.commentary: Sense: Although prevented thus, she brought her mother's younger daughter to her house and said to her husband "Take her."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवानां तथा पूजां गिरेः प्रक्रमणं तथा । करिष्यामि मुनिश्रेष्ठा आज्ञया श्रीमतामिह
verses.transliteration: pārthivānāṃ tathā pūjāṃ gireḥ prakramaṇaṃ tathā | kariṣyāmi muniśreṣṭhā ājñayā śrīmatāmiha
verses.translation: Now you say that she must be my beloved wife. But should she give birth to a son you will begin to be jealous of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now you say that she must be my beloved wife. But should she give birth to a son you will begin to be jealous of her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सर्षिवर्यश्च कृत्वा प्रक्रमणं गिरेः । पूजयामास निर्माय पार्थिवान्मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā sarṣivaryaśca kṛtvā prakramaṇaṃ gireḥ | pūjayāmāsa nirmāya pārthivānmunisattamaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, when thus warned by her husband, Sudeha joined her palms in reverence and spoke to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, when thus warned by her husband, Sudeha joined her palms in reverence and spoke to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहल्या च ततः साध्वी तच्च सर्वं चकार सा । शिष्याश्च प्रतिशिष्याश्च चक्रुः सेवां तयोस्तदा
verses.transliteration: ahalyā ca tataḥ sādhvī tacca sarvaṃ cakāra sā | śiṣyāśca pratiśiṣyāśca cakruḥ sevāṃ tayostadā
verses.translation: "O excellent brahmin, I will not be jealous of my own sister. Please marry her and beget a son. I urge upon you."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O excellent brahmin, I will not be jealous of my own sister. Please marry her and beget a son. I urge upon you."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: According to the sacred rules Ghusma rendered devotional services to these images and threw them in the neighbouring lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the sacred rules Ghusma rendered devotional services to these images and threw them in the neighbouring lake.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: According to the sacred rules Ghusma rendered devotional services to these images and threw them in the neighbouring lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the sacred rules Ghusma rendered devotional services to these images and threw them in the neighbouring lake.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । त्र्यम्बकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । एवं कृते तु ऋषिणा सस्त्रीकेन द्विजाः शिवः । आविर्बभूव सशिवः प्रसन्नः सगणस्तदा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.26. ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | tryambakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | evaṃ kṛte tu ṛṣiṇā sastrīkena dvijāḥ śivaḥ | āvirbabhūva saśivaḥ prasannaḥ sagaṇastadā
verses.translation: Thus she performed the wish-yielding worship of Siva every day leaving them off and invoking them again in accordance with the rules of devotional service.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus she performed the wish-yielding worship of Siva every day leaving them off and invoking them again in accordance with the rules of devotional service.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रसन्नः सशिवो वरं ब्रूहि महामुने । प्रसन्नोऽहं सुभक्त्या त इत्युवाच कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: atha prasannaḥ saśivo varaṃ brūhi mahāmune | prasanno'haṃ subhaktyā ta ityuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ
verses.translation: The husband too loved the elder more than he loved the younger. Still the elder wife retained dirt in her mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The husband too loved the elder more than he loved the younger. Still the elder wife retained dirt in her mind.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा तत्सुन्दरं रूपं दृष्ट्वा शम्भोर्महात्मनः । प्रणम्य शङ्करं भक्त्या स्तुतिं चक्रे मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: tadā tatsundaraṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā śambhormahātmanaḥ | praṇamya śaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā stutiṃ cakre mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: The senior wife, though delighted inwardly, showed great distress outwardly saying "O I am doomed!"
verses.commentary: Sense: The senior wife, though delighted inwardly, showed great distress outwardly saying "O I am doomed!"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वा बहु प्रणम्येशं बद्धाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः । निष्पापं कुरु मां देवाब्रवीदिति स गौतमः
verses.transliteration: stutvā bahu praṇamyeśaṃ baddhāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ | niṣpāpaṃ kuru māṃ devābravīditi sa gautamaḥ
verses.translation: Harm has been done by her. Why should you render help to her? Sudeha the perpetrator of wicked deeds must be killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harm has been done by her. Why should you render help to her? Sudeha the perpetrator of wicked deeds must be killed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य गौतमस्य महात्मनः । सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा शिवो वाक्यमुपाददे
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityākarṇya vacastasya gautamasya mahātmanaḥ | suprasannataro bhūtvā śivo vākyamupādade
verses.translation: They will have good wives, plenty of wealth, longevity and skill in everything. They will be learned and liberal. They will attain worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will have good wives, plenty of wealth, longevity and skill in everything. They will be learned and liberal. They will attain worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । धन्योऽसि कृतकृत्योऽसि निष्पापोऽसि सदा मुने । एतैर्दुष्टैः किल त्वं च छलितोऽसि खलात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | dhanyo'si kṛtakṛtyo'si niṣpāpo'si sadā mune | etairduṣṭaiḥ kila tvaṃ ca chalito'si khalātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this narrative of Jyotirlihgas gets rid of sins and attains worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this narrative of Jyotirlihgas gets rid of sins and attains worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयदर्शनाल्लोका निष्पापाश्च भवन्ति हि । किं पुनस्त्वं सपापोऽसि मद्भक्तिनिरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: tvadīyadarśanāllokā niṣpāpāśca bhavanti hi | kiṃ punastvaṃ sapāpo'si madbhaktinirataḥ sadā
verses.translation: O great sages, on hearing the words of Suta the sages praised him and spoke desiring the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, on hearing the words of Suta the sages praised him and spoke desiring the welfare of the worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपद्रवस्त्वयि मुने यैः कृतस्तु दुरात्मभिः । ते पापाश्च दुराचारा हत्यावन्तस्त एव हि
verses.transliteration: upadravastvayi mune yaiḥ kṛtastu durātmabhiḥ | te pāpāśca durācārā hatyāvantasta eva hi
verses.translation: O Suta, you know everything. Hence we ask you. O holy lord, please narrate the greatness of the phallic image Harisvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, you know everything. Hence we ask you. O holy lord, please narrate the greatness of the phallic image Harisvara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां दर्शनादन्ये पापिष्ठाः सम्भवन्तु च । कृतघ्नाश्च तथा जाता नैतेषां निष्कृतिः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ darśanādanye pāpiṣṭhāḥ sambhavantu ca | kṛtaghnāśca tathā jātā naiteṣāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit
verses.translation: O great sages, may the auspicious story of Hari- £vara be heard, how SudarSana was acquired by Viu formerly from Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, may the auspicious story of Hari- £vara be heard, how SudarSana was acquired by Viu formerly from Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तस्मै तेषां दुश्चरितं तदा । बहूवाच प्रभुर्विप्राः सत्कदोऽसत्सु दण्डदः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā śaṅkarastasmai teṣāṃ duścaritaṃ tadā | bahūvāca prabhurviprāḥ satkado'satsu daṇḍadaḥ
verses.translation: Performing the worship of Siva thus regularly
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing the worship of Siva thus regularly
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्वोक्तमिति स श्रुत्वा सुविस्मितमना ऋषिः । सुप्रणम्य शिवं भक्त्या साञ्जलिः पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śarvoktamiti sa śrutvā suvismitamanā ṛṣiḥ | supraṇamya śivaṃ bhaktyā sāñjaliḥ punarabravīt
verses.translation: Then Sudeha grew fiercely jealous of her. Her heart which was cool and quiet before began to blaze like fire now.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Sudeha grew fiercely jealous of her. Her heart which was cool and quiet before began to blaze like fire now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । ऋषिभिस्तैर्महेशान ह्युपकारः कृतो महान् । यद्येवं न कृतं तैस्तु दर्शनं ते कुतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca | ṛṣibhistairmaheśāna hyupakāraḥ kṛto mahān | yadyevaṃ na kṛtaṃ taistu darśanaṃ te kuto bhavet
verses.translation: O great sages, may the despicable event that followed, causing misery, be heard with attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, may the despicable event that followed, causing misery, be heard with attention.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्ते ऋषयो यैस्तु मह्यं शुभतरं कृतम् । तद्दुराचरणादेव मम स्वार्थो महानभूत्
verses.transliteration: dhanyāste ṛṣayo yaistu mahyaṃ śubhataraṃ kṛtam | taddurācaraṇādeva mama svārtho mahānabhūt
verses.translation: On seeing the son of the younger sister, the elder sister was much distressed. Unable to see her pleasure she became inimical.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the son of the younger sister, the elder sister was much distressed. Unable to see her pleasure she became inimical.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा सुप्रसन्नो महेश्वरः । गौतमं प्रत्युवाचाशु कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य च
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā suprasanno maheśvaraḥ | gautamaṃ pratyuvācāśu kṛpādṛṣṭyā vilokya ca
verses.translation: Her people celebrated the birth of a son continual¬ ly. But she could not bear the sight of the beautiful child.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her people celebrated the birth of a son continual¬ ly. But she could not bear the sight of the beautiful child.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । ऋषिर्धन्योऽसि विप्रेन्द्र ऋषिश्रेष्ठतरोऽसि वै । ज्ञात्वा मां सुप्रसन्नं हि वृणु त्वं वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | ṛṣirdhanyo'si viprendra ṛṣiśreṣṭhataro'si vai | jñātvā māṃ suprasannaṃ hi vṛṇu tvaṃ varamuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing the son, a great favourite of the parents and endowed with all good qualities, her heart began to blaze like fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the son, a great favourite of the parents and endowed with all good qualities, her heart began to blaze like fire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । गौतमोऽपि विचार्यैवं लोके विश्रुतमित्युत । अन्यथा न भवेदेव तस्मादुक्तं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | gautamo'pi vicāryaivaṃ loke viśrutamityuta | anyathā na bhavedeva tasmāduktaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: In the meantime many brahmins came there offer¬ ing their daughters in marriage. Sudharma celebrated the marriage of his son*duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime many brahmins came there offer¬ ing their daughters in marriage. Sudharma celebrated the marriage of his son*duly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निश्चित्यैवं मुनिश्रेष्ठो गौतमः शिवभक्तिमान् । साञ्जलिर्नतशीर्षो हि शङ्करं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: niścityaivaṃ muniśreṣṭho gautamaḥ śivabhaktimān | sāñjalirnataśīrṣo hi śaṅkaraṃ vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: On seeing that, Sudeha blazed furiously in her mind- Extremely distressed she began to lament, "O I am doomed."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that, Sudeha blazed furiously in her mind- Extremely distressed she began to lament, "O I am doomed."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । सत्यं नाथ ब्रवीषि त्वं तथापि पञ्चभिः कृतम् । नान्यथा भवतीत्यत्र यज्जातं जायतां तु तत्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca | satyaṃ nātha bravīṣi tvaṃ tathāpi pañcabhiḥ kṛtam | nānyathā bhavatītyatra yajjātaṃ jāyatāṃ tu tat
verses.translation: When the daughter-in-law came to the house and
verses.commentary: Sense: When the daughter-in-law came to the house and
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश गङ्गा च दीयतां मम । कुरु लोकोपकारं हि नमस्तेऽस्तु नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: yadi prasanno deveśa gaṅgā ca dīyatāṃ mama | kuru lokopakāraṃ hi namaste'stu namo'stu te
verses.translation: "These are your own son and daughter-in-law not mine.** But the daughter-in-law considered Sudeha her mother-in-law and the son considered her his mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: "These are your own son and daughter-in-law not mine.** But the daughter-in-law considered Sudeha her mother-in-law and the son considered her his mother.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा वचनं तस्य धृत्वा वै पादपङ्कजम् । नमश्चकार देवेशं गौतमो लोककाम्यया
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā vacanaṃ tasya dhṛtvā vai pādapaṅkajam | namaścakāra deveśaṃ gautamo lokakāmyayā
verses.translation: One day the senior wife Sudeha, extremely dis¬ tressed in her heart, thought how she could subdue her misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: One day the senior wife Sudeha, extremely dis¬ tressed in her heart, thought how she could subdue her misery.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु शङ्करो देवः पृथिव्याश्च दिवश्च सः । सारं चैव समुद्धृत्य रक्षितं पूर्वमेव तत्
verses.transliteration: tatastu śaṅkaro devaḥ pṛthivyāśca divaśca saḥ | sāraṃ caiva samuddhṛtya rakṣitaṃ pūrvameva tat
verses.translation: Certainly the fire in my heart can be tranqullised only through the tears of Ghusma caused by her misery and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Certainly the fire in my heart can be tranqullised only through the tears of Ghusma caused by her misery and not otherwise.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विवाहे ब्रह्मणा दत्तमवशिष्टं च किञ्चन । तत्तस्मै दत्तवान् शम्भुर्मुनये भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: vivāhe brahmaṇā dattamavaśiṣṭaṃ ca kiñcana | tattasmai dattavān śambhurmunaye bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: So I shall kill her son today, the son that speaks pleasing words to her. What is destined to happen shall happen. This is my final decision.
verses.commentary: Sense: So I shall kill her son today, the son that speaks pleasing words to her. What is destined to happen shall happen. This is my final decision.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाजलं तदा तत्र स्त्रीरूपमभवत्परम् । तस्याश्चैव ऋषिश्रेष्ठः स्तुतिं कृत्वा नतिं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgājalaṃ tadā tatra strīrūpamabhavatparam | tasyāścaiva ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ stutiṃ kṛtvā natiṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: O brahmins, the inimical nature among co-wives is extremely ruthless and suicidal. The wicked and the mean do not ponder what shall be done or not done.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the inimical nature among co-wives is extremely ruthless and suicidal. The wicked and the mean do not ponder what shall be done or not done.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । धन्यासि कृतकृत्यासि पावितं भुवनं त्वया । मां च पावय गङ्गे त्वं पतन्तं निरये ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca | dhanyāsi kṛtakṛtyāsi pāvitaṃ bhuvanaṃ tvayā | māṃ ca pāvaya gaṅge tvaṃ patantaṃ niraye dhruvam
verses.translation: The senior wife cut off the limbs of Ghusma's son at night. Strong that she was shc,took them to the lake where the earthen images of Siva were usually, hurled by Ghuiima. After casting off the limbs into the lake she returned and slept.
verses.commentary: Sense: The senior wife cut off the limbs of Ghusma's son at night. Strong that she was shc,took them to the lake where the earthen images of Siva were usually, hurled by Ghuiima. After casting off the limbs into the lake she returned and slept.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । शम्भुश्चापि तदोवाच सर्वेषां हितकृच्छृणु । गङ्गे गौतममेनं त्वं पावयस्व मदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | śambhuścāpi tadovāca sarveṣāṃ hitakṛcchṛṇu | gaṅge gautamamenaṃ tvaṃ pāvayasva madājñayā
verses.translation: In the morning Ghusma got up and performed her. daily household duties- Sudharma too performed his daily sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the morning Ghusma got up and performed her. daily household duties- Sudharma too performed his daily sacred rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शम्भोश्च गौतमस्य च । उवाचैव शिवं गङ्गा शिवशक्तिर्हि पावनी
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vacastasya śambhośca gautamasya ca | uvācaiva śivaṃ gaṅgā śivaśaktirhi pāvanī
verses.translation: In the meantime the senior wife too got up and performed her duties with great pleasure, now that the fire in her heart had been tranquillised.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the senior wife too got up and performed her duties with great pleasure, now that the fire in her heart had been tranquillised.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । ऋषिं तु पावयित्वाहं परिवारयुतं प्रभो । गमिष्यामि निजस्थानं वचः सत्यं ब्रवीमि ह
verses.transliteration: gaṅgovāca | ṛṣiṃ tu pāvayitvāhaṃ parivārayutaṃ prabho | gamiṣyāmi nijasthānaṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi ha
verses.translation: Getting up in the morning, the daughter-in-law saw to her horror the bed wet with blood and a few scattered pieces of the body,
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting up in the morning, the daughter-in-law saw to her horror the bed wet with blood and a few scattered pieces of the body,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तं गङ्गया तत्र महेशो भक्तवत्सलः । लोकोपकरणार्थाय पुनर्गङ्गां वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktaṃ gaṅgayā tatra maheśo bhaktavatsalaḥ | lokopakaraṇārthāya punargaṅgāṃ vaco'bravīt
verses.translation: She told her mother-in-law, "where has your son gone? The bed is wet with blood. Pieces of the body arc also seen."
verses.commentary: Sense: She told her mother-in-law, "where has your son gone? The bed is wet with blood. Pieces of the body arc also seen."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । त्वया स्थातव्यमत्रैवाव्रजेद्यावत्कलिर्युगः । वैवस्वतो मनुर्देवि ह्यष्टाविंशत्तमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | tvayā sthātavyamatraivāvrajedyāvatkaliryugaḥ | vaivasvato manurdevi hyaṣṭāviṃśattamo bhavet
verses.translation: The daughter-in-law fond of her husband began to lament—"O I am doomed. O my mother of holy rites, who has perpetrated this wicked deed?"
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter-in-law fond of her husband began to lament—"O I am doomed. O my mother of holy rites, who has perpetrated this wicked deed?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य स्वामिनः शङ्करस्य तत् । प्रत्युवाच पुनर्गङ्गा पावनी सा सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasya svāminaḥ śaṅkarasya tat | pratyuvāca punargaṅgā pāvanī sā saridvarā
verses.translation: Ghusma heard the pitiable lamentation of her daughter-in-law but did not leave off her sacred rite, the daily worship of Siva's earthen image.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ghusma heard the pitiable lamentation of her daughter-in-law but did not leave off her sacred rite, the daily worship of Siva's earthen image.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । माहात्म्यमधिकं चेत्स्यान्मम स्वामिन्महेश्वर । सर्वेभ्यश्च तदा स्थास्ये धरायां त्रिपुरान्तक
verses.transliteration: gaṅgovāca | māhātmyamadhikaṃ cetsyānmama svāminmaheśvara | sarvebhyaśca tadā sthāsye dharāyāṃ tripurāntaka
verses.translation: Her mind did not exhibit any agitation. The husband too remained calm till the completion of the sacred rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her mind did not exhibit any agitation. The husband too remained calm till the completion of the sacred rite.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किञ्चान्यच्च शृणु स्वामिन्वपुषा सुन्दरेण ह । तिष्ठ त्वं मत्समीपे वै सगणः साम्बिकः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: kiñcānyacca śṛṇu svāminvapuṣā sundareṇa ha | tiṣṭha tvaṃ matsamīpe vai sagaṇaḥ sāmbikaḥ prabho
verses.translation: "He who has given this boy will protect him too. The annihilator of Kala, the goal of the good, is famous as a favourite of his devotee. Our protector, the sole lord, iSiva is like a gardener. He separates those whom he has united. What can I gain by worrying over it?" Realising this truth, being emboldened in dedicating herself to Siva she did not grieve much.
verses.wordMeaning: "He who has given this boy will protect him too. The annihilator of Kala, the goal of the good, is famous as a favourite of his devotee. Our protector, the sole lord, iSiva is like a gardener. He separates those whom he has united.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "He who has given this boy will protect him too. The annihilator of Kala, the goal of the good, is famous as a favourite of his devotee. Our protector, the sole lord, iSiva is like a gardener. He separates those whom he has united.…

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । लोकोपकरणार्थाय पुनर्गङ्गां वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | evaṃ tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ | lokopakaraṇārthāya punargaṅgāṃ vaco'bravīt
verses.translation: Taking the day's earthly phallic images she went towards the bank of the lake repeating the names of Siva, maintaining the normalcy of her mind as afore.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the day's earthly phallic images she went towards the bank of the lake repeating the names of Siva, maintaining the normalcy of her mind as afore.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । धन्यासि श्रूयतां गङ्गे ह्यहं भिन्नस्त्वया न हि । तथापि स्थीयते ह्यत्र स्थीयतां च त्वयापि हि
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | dhanyāsi śrūyatāṃ gaṅge hyahaṃ bhinnastvayā na hi | tathāpi sthīyate hyatra sthīyatāṃ ca tvayāpi hi
verses.translation: When she cast off the earthen phallic images and returned she saw her son standing on the bank of the lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: When she cast off the earthen phallic images and returned she saw her son standing on the bank of the lake.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा स्वामिनः परमेशितुः । प्रसन्नमानसा भूत्वा गङ्गा च प्रत्यपूजयत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā svāminaḥ parameśituḥ | prasannamānasā bhūtvā gaṅgā ca pratyapūjayat
verses.translation: I shall meet my mother. After dying I have been
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall meet my mother. After dying I have been
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवा ऋषयश्च पुरातनाः । सुतीर्थान्यप्यनेकानि क्षेत्राणि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devā ṛṣayaśca purātanāḥ | sutīrthānyapyanekāni kṣetrāṇi vividhāni ca
verses.translation: O brahmins, on seeing her son restored to life the mother was not delighted as she was not distressed before.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on seeing her son restored to life the mother was not delighted as she was not distressed before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.27. saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | tryambakeśvarajyotirliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | gaṅgā ca jalarūpeṇa kuto jātā vada prabho | tanmāhātmyaṃ viśeṣeṇa kuto jātaṃ vada prabho
verses.translation: O lord, be merciful. We are very much afflicted by the Daityas. Where shall we go? What shall we do? We have resorted to you, for you are worthy of seeking refuge by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, be merciful. We are very much afflicted by the Daityas. Where shall we go? What shall we do? We have resorted to you, for you are worthy of seeking refuge by us.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यैर्विप्रैर्गौतमायैव दुःखं दत्तं दुरात्मभिः । तेषां किं च ततो जातमुच्यतां व्याससद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: yairviprairgautamāyaiva duḥkhaṃ dattaṃ durātmabhiḥ | teṣāṃ kiṃ ca tato jātamucyatāṃ vyāsasadguro

verses.commentary: Sense: Re[>cating every name, he worshipped Siva, favour¬ ably disposed towards those who seek refuge in himt with a lotus flower.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं सम्प्रार्थिता गङ्गा गौतमेन तदा स्वयम् । ब्रह्मणश्च गिरेर्विप्रा द्रुतं तस्मादवातरत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | evaṃ samprārthitā gaṅgā gautamena tadā svayam | brahmaṇaśca girerviprā drutaṃ tasmādavātarat
verses.translation: May this be heard, O great sages. I shall now re¬ count the hymn of thousand names of Siva, whereby Siva was satisfied.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this be heard, O great sages. I shall now re¬ count the hymn of thousand names of Siva, whereby Siva was satisfied.

verses.sanskrit: औदुम्बरस्य शाखायास्तत्प्रवाहो विनिःसृतः । तत्र स्नानं मुदा चक्रे गौतमो विश्रुतो मुनिः

verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus, he plucked out his eye and repeated the last name Sarvasattvavalambana. Full of emotion he worshipped and eulogised Siva.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाद्वारं च तन्नाम प्रसिद्धमभवत्तदा । सर्वपापहरं रम्यं दर्शनान्मुनिसत्तमाः

verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, O benefactor of the worlds, listen. Please tell me what I shall meditate upon and what I shall recite for the destruction of the distress.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus asked by him,!§iva becoming t satisfied and delighted in his mind spoke to Vinu who helped the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मा मेति गौतमस्तत्र व्याजहार वचो द्रुतम् । मुहुर्मुहुः स्तुवन् गङ्गां साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः
verses.transliteration: mā meti gautamastatra vyājahāra vaco drutam | muhurmuhuḥ stuvan gaṅgāṃ sāñjalirnatamastakaḥ
verses.translation: For the attainment of your desires you shall hold this discus always. O Visnu this is the best of all discuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the attainment of your desires you shall hold this discus always. O Visnu this is the best of all discuses.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । इमे च श्रीमदान्धाश्च साधवो वाप्यसाधवः । एतत्पुण्यप्रभावेण दर्शनं दीयतां त्वया

verses.translation: O gods, I shall carry out your task after propitiating Siva. These powerful enemies shall be conquered with great effort.

verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षय्यं कल्पयामास जलं वरुणदायया । ततो व्रीहीन् यवांश्चैव वापयामास भूरिशः

verses.commentary: Sense: On receiving it Visnu slew the powerful demons immediately with the discus without any strain.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भिन्नमतयो गां कृत्वा कृत्रिमां द्विजाः । तद्धान्यभक्षणासक्तां चक्रुस्तां कुटिलाशयाः
verses.transliteration: tataste bhinnamatayo gāṃ kṛtvā kṛtrimāṃ dvijāḥ | taddhānyabhakṣaṇāsaktāṃ cakrustāṃ kuṭilāśayāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the pious sages, Suta spoke after remembering the lotus-likc feet of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the pious sages, Suta spoke after remembering the lotus-likc feet of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वधान्यभक्षणासक्तां गां दृष्ट्वा गौतमस्तदा । तृणेन ताडयामास शनैस्तां सन्निवारयन्
verses.transliteration: svadhānyabhakṣaṇāsaktāṃ gāṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamastadā | tṛṇena tāḍayāmāsa śanaistāṃ sannivārayan

verses.sanskrit: गौर्हता गौतमेनेति तदा ते कुटिलाशयाः । एकत्रीभूय तत्रत्याः सकला ऋषयोऽवदन्
verses.transliteration: gaurhatā gautameneti tadā te kuṭilāśayāḥ | ekatrībhūya tatratyāḥ sakalā ṛṣayo'vadan

verses.sanskrit: ततः स गौतमो ज्ञात्वा तां गां क्रोधसमाकुलः । शशाप तानृषीन् सर्वान् गौतमो मुनिसत्तमः

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । यूयं सर्वे दुरात्मानो दुःखदा मे विशेषतः । शिवभक्तस्य सततं स्युर्वेदविमुखाः सदा

verses.translation: Thus Viou eulogised Siva with the thousand names. Siva was prayed to and worshipped with lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Viou eulogised Siva with the thousand names. Siva was prayed to and worshipped with lotuses.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति वेदोक्ते सत्कर्मणि विशेषतः । मा भूयाद्भवतां श्रद्धा शैवमार्गे विमुक्तिदे
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti vedokte satkarmaṇi viśeṣataḥ | mā bhūyādbhavatāṃ śraddhā śaivamārge vimuktide
verses.translation: O brahmins, then the enthusiastic Siva performed something wonderful and pleasing. Listen to that attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, then the enthusiastic Siva performed something wonderful and pleasing. Listen to that attentively.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति दुर्मार्गे तत्र श्रद्धा भवेत्तु वः । मोक्षमार्गविहीने हि सदा श्रुतिबहिर्मुखे
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti durmārge tatra śraddhā bhavettu vaḥ | mokṣamārgavihīne hi sadā śrutibahirmukhe
verses.translation: On hearing the eulogy made by Vinu consisting of the hymn of his thousand divine names lord Siva became delighted*
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the eulogy made by Vinu consisting of the hymn of his thousand divine names lord Siva became delighted*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति भालानि मृल्लिप्तानि भवन्तु वः । स्रंसध्वं नरके यूयं भालमृल्लेपना द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti bhālāni mṛlliptāni bhavantu vaḥ | sraṃsadhvaṃ narake yūyaṃ bhālamṛllepanā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: In order to test Vi?nu, Siva, the lord of the worlds concealed one of the lotus-flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to test Vi?nu, Siva, the lord of the worlds concealed one of the lotus-flowers.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तो मा भविष्यन्तु शिवैकपरदैवताः । अन्यदेव समत्वेन जानन्तु शिवमद्वयम्

verses.translation: He thought within himself "Where could the lotus- flower have gone? If it has gone, let it go for good. Is not my own eye a lotus?
verses.commentary: Sense: He thought within himself "Where could the lotus- flower have gone? If it has gone, let it go for good. Is not my own eye a lotus?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मा भूयाद्भवतां प्रीतिः शिवपूजादिकर्मणि । शिवनिष्ठेषु भक्तेषु शिवपर्वसु सर्वदा

verses.translation: On seeing Vi§nu in that attitude, Visnu the preceptor of the universe appeared before him and forbade him do that.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Vi§nu in that attitude, Visnu the preceptor of the universe appeared before him and forbade him do that.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्य दत्ता मया शापा यावन्तो दुःखदायकाः । तावन्तः सन्तु भवतां सन्ततावपि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: adya dattā mayā śāpā yāvanto duḥkhadāyakāḥ | tāvantaḥ santu bhavatāṃ santatāvapi sarvadā

verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva descended from the pedestal of that earthern phallic image installed by Viinu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अशैवाः सन्तु भवतां पुत्रपौत्रादयो द्विजाः । पुत्रैः सहैव तिष्ठन्तु भवन्तो नरके ध्रुवम्
