verses.translation: Bowing to Siva, rising up in the form of a mass of splendour as mentioned before, Visnu stood in front of him and eulogised him particularly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bowing to Siva, rising up in the form of a mass of splendour as mentioned before, Visnu stood in front of him and eulogised him particularly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो भवन्तु चाण्डाला दुःखदारिद्र्यपीडिताः । शठा निन्दाकराः सर्वे तप्तमुद्राङ्किताः सदा
verses.transliteration: tato bhavantu cāṇḍālā duḥkhadāridryapīḍitāḥ | śaṭhā nindākarāḥ sarve taptamudrāṅkitāḥ sadā
verses.translation: Looking mercifully at Visnu, who stood before him with palms joined in reverence, the delighted lord Siva laughingly said then.
verses.commentary: Sense: Looking mercifully at Visnu, who stood before him with palms joined in reverence, the delighted lord Siva laughingly said then.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति शप्त्वा मुनीन् सर्वान् गौतमः स्वाश्रमं ययौ । शिवभक्तिं चकाराति स बभूव सुपावनः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śaptvā munīn sarvān gautamaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau | śivabhaktiṃ cakārāti sa babhūva supāvanaḥ
verses.translation: O Vinu, all the desires in your mind, particularly the task of the gods have been understood by me. Indeed you are engaged in the task of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vinu, all the desires in your mind, particularly the task of the gods have been understood by me. Indeed you are engaged in the task of the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तैः खिन्नहृदया ऋषयस्तेऽखिला द्विजाः । काञ्च्यां चक्रुर्निवासं हि शैवधर्मबहिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: tatastaiḥ khinnahṛdayā ṛṣayaste'khilā dvijāḥ | kāñcyāṃ cakrurnivāsaṃ hi śaivadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: In the list of one thovisand names of iSiva, this name stands at the end. There beinR no lotus left for the propitiation of 8iva in this name (one lotus having been coijccaled by lord Siva himself for the test) ViijQU plucked off his own eye and offered the.'same to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the list of one thovisand names of iSiva, this name stands at the end. There beinR no lotus left for the propitiation of 8iva in this name (one lotus having been coijccaled by lord Siva himself for the test) ViijQU plucked off his own eye and offered the.'same to Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्राश्चाभवन्सर्वे शैवधर्मबहिष्कृताः । अग्रे तद्वद्भविष्यन्ति कलौ बहुजनाः खलाः
verses.transliteration: tatputrāścābhavansarve śaivadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ | agre tadvadbhaviṣyanti kalau bahujanāḥ khalāḥ
verses.translation: For the achievement of the task of the gods and for the destruction of the Daityas without strain, I shall give the auspicious discus Sudar4ana to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the achievement of the task of the gods and for the destruction of the Daityas without strain, I shall give the auspicious discus Sudar4ana to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्तमशेषेण तद्वृत्तं मुनिसत्तमाः । पूर्ववृत्तमपि प्राज्ञाः श्रुतं सर्वैस्तु चादरात्
verses.transliteration: iti proktamaśeṣeṇa tadvṛttaṃ munisattamāḥ | pūrvavṛttamapi prājñāḥ śrutaṃ sarvaistu cādarāt
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, for your benefit ponder over this form, pleasing to all the worlds, which has seen by you (now ).
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the gods, for your benefit ponder over this form, pleasing to all the worlds, which has seen by you (now ).
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातो गौतम्याश्च समुद्भवः । माहात्म्यमुत्तमं चैव सर्वपापहरं परम्
verses.transliteration: iti vaśca samākhyāto gautamyāśca samudbhavaḥ | māhātmyamuttamaṃ caiva sarvapāpaharaṃ param
verses.translation: If this discus, this form and this hymn of thousand names is remembered in the battlefield it will quell the misery of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: If this discus, this form and this hymn of thousand names is remembered in the battlefield it will quell the misery of the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकस्य च माहात्म्यं ज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्य कीर्तितम् । यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tryambakasya ca māhātmyaṃ jyotirliṅgasya kīrtitam | yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O one of good rites, thanks to my blessings, all those who listen to this will achieve their desires without serious dangers.
verses.commentary: Sense: O one of good rites, thanks to my blessings, all those who listen to this will achieve their desires without serious dangers.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि वैद्यनाथेश्वरस्य हि । ज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्य माहात्म्यं श्रूयतां पापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vaidyanātheśvarasya hi | jyotirliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ śrūyatāṃ pāpahārakam
verses.translation: Vi?nu purified himself and accepted it facing the north. After making obeisance to lord Siva, Vi?nu spoke these words to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi?nu purified himself and accepted it facing the north. After making obeisance to lord Siva, Vi?nu spoke these words to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Delighted in his mind, §iva spoke thus to Vi?rui and touched him with his hands. Iiva then told him again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted in his mind, §iva spoke thus to Vi?rui and touched him with his hands. Iiva then told him again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Delighted in his mind, §iva spoke thus to Vi?rui and touched him with his hands. Iiva then told him again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted in his mind, §iva spoke thus to Vi?rui and touched him with his hands. Iiva then told him again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । वैद्यनाथेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णम् । सूत उवाच । रावणो राक्षसश्रेष्ठो मानी मानपरायणः । आरराध हरं भक्त्या कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.28. aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vaidyanātheśvarajyotirliṅgamāhātmyavarṇam | sūta uvāca | rāvaṇo rākṣasaśreṣṭho mānī mānaparāyaṇaḥ | ārarādha haraṃ bhaktyā kailāse parvatottame
verses.translation: O most excellent of gods, I am the granier of the boons. Choose the boons you desire to have. O one of good rites, I am attracted by your devotion and by this hymn as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: O most excellent of gods, I am the granier of the boons. Choose the boons you desire to have. O one of good rites, I am attracted by your devotion and by this hymn as well.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आराधितः कियत्कालं न प्रसन्नो हरो यदा । तदा चान्यत्तपश्चक्रे प्रसादार्थं शिवस्य सः
verses.transliteration: ārādhitaḥ kiyatkālaṃ na prasanno haro yadā | tadā cānyattapaścakre prasādārthaṃ śivasya saḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, you have put the question properly. I shall narrate the charming story of l§iva. It is eonducive to the attainment of worldly pleasures and salvation by those who listen to it. May it be heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, you have put the question properly. I shall narrate the charming story of l§iva. It is eonducive to the attainment of worldly pleasures and salvation by those who listen to it. May it be heard.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चायं हिमवतः सिद्धिस्थानस्य वै गिरेः । पौलस्त्यो रावणः श्रीमान् दक्षिणे वृक्षखण्डके
verses.transliteration: tataścāyaṃ himavataḥ siddhisthānasya vai gireḥ | paulastyo rāvaṇaḥ śrīmān dakṣiṇe vṛkṣakhaṇḍake
verses.translation: The subordinate gods, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and others are worshippers of Siva. Similarly the Asuras of noble minds are the worshippers of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subordinate gods, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and others are worshippers of Siva. Similarly the Asuras of noble minds are the worshippers of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ गर्तं वरं कृत्वा तत्राग्निं स्थाप्य स द्विजाः । तत्सन्निधौ शिवं स्थाप्य हवनं स चकार ह
verses.transliteration: bhūmau gartaṃ varaṃ kṛtvā tatrāgniṃ sthāpya sa dvijāḥ | tatsannidhau śivaṃ sthāpya havanaṃ sa cakāra ha
verses.translation: As directed by Rsyasrhga this excellent king, devoted to Siva performed the sacrifice called Putrc?ti*
verses.commentary: Sense: As directed by Rsyasrhga this excellent king, devoted to Siva performed the sacrifice called Putrc?ti*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्यस्थो वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः । शीते जलान्तरस्थो हि त्रिधा चक्रे तपश्च सः
verses.transliteration: grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ | śīte jalāntarastho hi tridhā cakre tapaśca saḥ
verses.translation: Yayati realised his desires due to Siva's worship. He begot five sons all interested in Siva cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yayati realised his desires due to Siva's worship. He begot five sons all interested in Siva cult.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चकारैवं बहु तपो न प्रसन्नस्तदापि हि । परमात्मा महेशानो दुराराध्यो दुरात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: cakāraivaṃ bahu tapo na prasannastadāpi hi | paramātmā maheśāno durārādhyo durātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: There arc many rites yielding worldly pleasures and salvation. The most important among them are ten in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: There arc many rites yielding worldly pleasures and salvation. The most important among them are ten in number.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिरांसि छित्त्वा च पूजनं शङ्करस्य वै । प्रारब्धं दैत्यपतिना रावणेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śirāṃsi chittvā ca pūjanaṃ śaṅkarasya vai | prārabdhaṃ daityapatinā rāvaṇena mahātmanā
verses.translation: In the dark half of the month of Magha, Sivaratri is specifically glorified. The lite of Sivaratri is performed when the Caturdasi extends up-to mid-night. The observance of the rite on that Tithi quells the sin of even a crore of human slaughters.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the dark half of the month of Magha, Sivaratri is specifically glorified. The lite of Sivaratri is performed when the Caturdasi extends up-to mid-night. The observance of the rite on that Tithi quells the sin of even a crore of human slaughters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । रे रे रावण दुर्भक्त मा गर्वं वह दुर्मते । शीघ्रं च तव हस्तानां दर्पघ्नश्च भवेदिह
verses.transliteration: mahādeva uvāca | re re rāvaṇa durbhakta mā garvaṃ vaha durmate | śīghraṃ ca tava hastānāṃ darpaghnaśca bhavediha
verses.translation: In the dark half of the month of Magha, Sivaratri is specifically glorified. The lite of Sivaratri is performed when the Caturdasi extends up-to mid-night. The observance of the rite on that Tithi quells the sin of even a crore of human slaughters.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the dark half of the month of Magha, Sivaratri is specifically glorified. The lite of Sivaratri is performed when the Caturdasi extends up-to mid-night. The observance of the rite on that Tithi quells the sin of even a crore of human slaughters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं च शिरश्छिन्नं विधिना शिवपूजने । एवं सत्क्रमतस्तेन छिन्नानि नव वै यदा
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṃ ca śiraśchinnaṃ vidhinā śivapūjane | evaṃ satkramatastena chinnāni nava vai yadā
verses.translation: After this affirmation the devotee shall collect the articles of worship. The phallic image shall be taken from a good place by the devotee himself at night by going there. The phallic image shall be that which is prescribed in the Agamas. The materials of worship shall be placed on a good spot near Siva either to the South or to the West. Then the devotee shall take bath again duly.
verses.wordMeaning: After this affirmation the devotee shall collect the articles of worship. The phallic image shall be taken from a good place by the devotee himself at night by going there. The phallic image shall be that which is prescribed in the Agamas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After this affirmation the devotee shall collect the articles of worship. The phallic image shall be taken from a good place by the devotee himself at night by going there. The phallic image shall be that which is prescribed in the Agamas.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्नवशिष्टे तु प्रसन्नः शङ्करस्तदा । आविर्बभूव तत्रैव सन्तुष्टो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: ekasminnavaśiṣṭe tu prasannaḥ śaṅkarastadā | āvirbabhūva tatraiva santuṣṭo bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: The undercloth and the usual cloth shall be pure. 'I'hc devotee shall perform the Acamana thrice and begin worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: The undercloth and the usual cloth shall be pure. 'I'hc devotee shall perform the Acamana thrice and begin worship.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरांसि पूर्ववत्कृत्वा नीरुजानि तथा प्रभुः । मनोरथं ददौ तस्मै चातुलं बलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śirāṃsi pūrvavatkṛtvā nīrujāni tathā prabhuḥ | manorathaṃ dadau tasmai cātulaṃ balamuttamam
verses.translation: Urged thus the delighted Visriu bowed to the lord of gods and spoke with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged thus the delighted Visriu bowed to the lord of gods and spoke with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादं तस्य सम्प्राप्य रावणः स च राक्षसः । प्रत्युवाच शिवं शम्भुं नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: prasādaṃ tasya samprāpya rāvaṇaḥ sa ca rākṣasaḥ | pratyuvāca śivaṃ śambhuṃ nataskandhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: O lord, you shall be equally merciful to others as well just as you are merciful to me now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you shall be equally merciful to others as well just as you are merciful to me now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रावण उवाच । प्रसन्नो भव देवेश लङ्कां च त्वां नयाम्यहम् । सफलं कुरु मे कामं त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇa uvāca | prasanno bhava deveśa laṅkāṃ ca tvāṃ nayāmyaham | saphalaṃ kuru me kāmaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the extremely sympathetic lord touched him. Then the moon-crested deity spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words, the extremely sympathetic lord touched him. Then the moon-crested deity spoke.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तश्च तदा तेन शम्भुर्वै रावणेन सः । प्रत्युवाच विचेतस्कः सङ्कटं परमं गतः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktaśca tadā tena śambhurvai rāvaṇena saḥ | pratyuvāca vicetaskaḥ saṅkaṭaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: O Vi?nu, your devotion to me will always remain firm. Be worthy of the reverence and worship of all gods in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?nu, your devotion to me will always remain firm. Be worthy of the reverence and worship of all gods in the world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । श्रूयतां राक्षसश्रेष्ठ वचो मे सारवत्तया । नीयतां स्वगृहे मे हि सद्भक्त्या लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | śrūyatāṃ rākṣasaśreṣṭha vaco me sāravattayā | nīyatāṃ svagṛhe me hi sadbhaktyā liṅgamuttamam
verses.translation: O great sages, after saying this, lord Siva, the lord of the gods, vanished there itself even as Visnu was watching.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, after saying this, lord Siva, the lord of the gods, vanished there itself even as Visnu was watching.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ लिङ्गं यदा त्वं च स्थापयिष्यसि यत्र वै । स्थास्यत्यत्र न सन्देहो यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: bhūmau liṅgaṃ yadā tvaṃ ca sthāpayiṣyasi yatra vai | sthāsyatyatra na sandeho yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: After securing the auspicious discus and hearing the words of Siva, lord Vi§nu was extremely delighted in his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing the auspicious discus and hearing the words of Siva, lord Vi§nu was extremely delighted in his mind.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तः शम्भुना तेन रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । तथेति तत्समादाय जगाम भवनं निजम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktaḥ śambhunā tena rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ | tatheti tatsamādāya jagāma bhavanaṃ nijam
verses.translation: Meditating on Siva, he repeated the hymn incessantly and instructed the devotees too in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditating on Siva, he repeated the hymn incessantly and instructed the devotees too in this.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आसीन्मूत्रोत्सर्गकामो मार्गे हि शिवमायया । तत्स्तम्भितुं न शक्तोऽभूत्पौलस्त्यो रावणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: āsīnmūtrotsargakāmo mārge hi śivamāyayā | tatstambhituṃ na śakto'bhūtpaulastyo rāvaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent ones, thus I have narrated the story in accordance with your enquiry. It destroys the sins of those who listen to it. What then do you wish to ask?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ones, thus I have narrated the story in accordance with your enquiry. It destroys the sins of those who listen to it. What then do you wish to ask?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैकं तत्र वै गोपं प्रार्थ्य लिङ्गं ददौ च तत् । मुहूर्तके ह्यतिक्रान्ते गोपोऽभूद्विकलस्तदा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvaikaṃ tatra vai gopaṃ prārthya liṅgaṃ dadau ca tat | muhūrtake hyatikrānte gopo'bhūdvikalastadā
verses.translation: O Suta, O fortunate Suta, you are endowed with knowledge, O one of good rites. Please narrate the story of Siva again in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, O fortunate Suta, you are endowed with knowledge, O one of good rites. Please narrate the story of Siva again in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ संस्थापयामास तद्भारेणातिपीडितः । तत्रैव तत्स्थितं लिङ्गं वज्रसारसमुद्भवम् । सर्वकामप्रदं चैव दर्शनात्पापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmau saṃsthāpayāmāsa tadbhāreṇātipīḍitaḥ | tatraiva tatsthitaṃ liṅgaṃ vajrasārasamudbhavam | sarvakāmapradaṃ caiva darśanātpāpahārakam
verses.translation: The ancient kings, sages and gods propitiated that excellent deity Siva alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ancient kings, sages and gods propitiated that excellent deity Siva alone.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैद्यनाथेश्वरं नाम्ना तल्लिङ्गमभवन्मुने । प्रसिद्धं त्रिषु लोकेषु भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: vaidyanātheśvaraṃ nāmnā talliṅgamabhavanmune | prasiddhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhuktimuktipradaṃ satām
verses.translation: O Narada, listen. I shall narrate the excellent story of Siva with pleasure out of affection to you. It des¬ troys great sins
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narada, listen. I shall narrate the excellent story of Siva with pleasure out of affection to you. It des¬ troys great sins
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गमिदं श्रेष्ठं दर्शनात्पूजनादपि । सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं मुक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: jyotirliṅgamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ darśanātpūjanādapi | sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ muktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: Visnu, accompanied by Laksmi, performed the worship of Siva. Thanks to the mercy of lord Siva, he attained all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu, accompanied by Laksmi, performed the worship of Siva. Thanks to the mercy of lord Siva, he attained all desires.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिँलिङ्गे स्थिते तत्र सर्वलोकहिताय वै । रावणः स्वगृहं गत्वा वरं प्राप्य महोत्तमम् । प्रियायै सर्वमाचख्यौ सुखेनाति महासुरः
verses.transliteration: tasmim̐liṅge sthite tatra sarvalokahitāya vai | rāvaṇaḥ svagṛhaṃ gatvā varaṃ prāpya mahottamam | priyāyai sarvamācakhyau sukhenāti mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: I, the grandfather of the worlds, am a worshipper of Siva. Thanks to his mercy that I create the worlds always.
verses.commentary: Sense: I, the grandfather of the worlds, am a worshipper of Siva. Thanks to his mercy that I create the worlds always.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा सकला देवाः शक्राद्या मुनयस्तथा । परस्परं समामन्त्र्य शिवासक्तधियोऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā sakalā devāḥ śakrādyā munayastathā | parasparaṃ samāmantrya śivāsaktadhiyo'malāḥ
verses.translation: My sons, the great sages, always worship Siva. Many other sages also do so.
verses.commentary: Sense: My sons, the great sages, always worship Siva. Many other sages also do so.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्काले सुराः सर्वे हरिब्रह्मादयो मुने । आजग्मुस्तत्र सुप्रीत्या पूजां चक्रुर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasminkāle surāḥ sarve haribrahmādayo mune | ājagmustatra suprītyā pūjāṃ cakrurviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: O Narada, particularly you are a worshipper of Siva. The seven sages, * Vasita and others too are the wor¬ shippers of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narada, particularly you are a worshipper of Siva. The seven sages, * Vasita and others too are the wor¬ shippers of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं तं तदा दृष्ट्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य च ते सुराः । वैद्यनाथेति सम्प्रोच्य नत्वा नुत्वा दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaṃ taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā pratiṣṭhāpya ca te surāḥ | vaidyanātheti samprocya natvā nutvā divaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: The great chaste lady Arundhati, Lopamudra, and Ahalya the wife of Gautama, do also worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great chaste lady Arundhati, Lopamudra, and Ahalya the wife of Gautama, do also worship Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । तस्मिँल्लिङ्गे स्थिते तत्र रावणे च गृहं गते । किं चरित्रमभूत्तात ततस्तद्वद विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | tasmim̐lliṅge sthite tatra rāvaṇe ca gṛhaṃ gate | kiṃ caritramabhūttāta tatastadvada vistarāt
verses.translation: These sages, viz.—Durvasas, KauiSika, Sakti, Dadhici, Gautama, Kanada, JIva, Bhargava, Vaiampayana, ParaSara and Vyasa are the worshippers of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: These sages, viz.—Durvasas, KauiSika, Sakti, Dadhici, Gautama, Kanada, JIva, Bhargava, Vaiampayana, ParaSara and Vyasa are the worshippers of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । रावणोऽपि गृहं गत्वा वरं प्राप्य महोत्तमम् । प्रियायै सर्वमाचख्यौ मुमोदाति महासुरः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | rāvaṇo'pi gṛhaṃ gatvā varaṃ prāpya mahottamam | priyāyai sarvamācakhyau mumodāti mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: Sukra, Saunaka and others are the worshippers of Siva. There are many other sages, excellent sages, who worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra, Saunaka and others are the worshippers of Siva. There are many other sages, excellent sages, who worship Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा सकलं देवाः शक्राद्या मुनयस्तथा । परस्परं समूचुस्ते समुद्विग्ना मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā sakalaṃ devāḥ śakrādyā munayastathā | parasparaṃ samūcuste samudvignā munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Aditi, the mother of the gods, performed the worship of Siva in earthen phallic idols every day. She is a lady engaged in Siva's devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aditi, the mother of the gods, performed the worship of Siva in earthen phallic idols every day. She is a lady engaged in Siva's devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवादय ऊचुः ॥ रावणोऽयं दुरात्मा हि देवद्रोही खलः कुधीः । शिवाद् वरं च सम्प्राप्य दुःखं दास्यति नोऽति सः
verses.transliteration: devādaya ūcuḥ || rāvaṇo'yaṃ durātmā hi devadrohī khalaḥ kudhīḥ | śivād varaṃ ca samprāpya duḥkhaṃ dāsyati no'ti saḥ
verses.translation: Indra and other guardians of the quarters, Vasus,** Maharajika gods, Sadhyas are the worshippers of Jiva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra and other guardians of the quarters, Vasus,** Maharajika gods, Sadhyas are the worshippers of Jiva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किं कुर्मः क्व च गच्छामः किं भविष्यति वा पुनः । दुष्टश्च दक्षतां प्राप्तः किं किं नो साधयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyati vā punaḥ | duṣṭaśca dakṣatāṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ kiṃ no sādhayiṣyati
verses.translation: O sage, the Daitya Hiranyakaipu, his ' sons and younger brother, as well as Virocana and Bali worship Siva every day,
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the Daitya Hiranyakaipu, his ' sons and younger brother, as well as Virocana and Bali worship Siva every day,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति दुःखं समापन्नाः शक्राद्या मुनयः सुराः । नारदं च समाहूय पप्रच्छुर्विकलास्तदा
verses.transliteration: iti duḥkhaṃ samāpannāḥ śakrādyā munayaḥ surāḥ | nāradaṃ ca samāhūya papracchurvikalāstadā
verses.translation: O great sage, the two gods, the Sun and the Moon who started two lines of kings on the earth are devoted to the service of Siva always along with their descendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, the two gods, the Sun and the Moon who started two lines of kings on the earth are devoted to the service of Siva always along with their descendants.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । सर्वं कार्यं समर्थोऽसि कर्तुं त्वं मुनिसत्तम । उपायं कुरु देवर्षे देवानां दुःखनाशने
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | sarvaṃ kāryaṃ samartho'si kartuṃ tvaṃ munisattama | upāyaṃ kuru devarṣe devānāṃ duḥkhanāśane
verses.translation: O sage, the self-born Brahma and other Manus performed the worship of Siva and they were in the guise of Siva too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the self-born Brahma and other Manus performed the worship of Siva and they were in the guise of Siva too.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रावणोऽयं महादुष्टः किं किं नैव करिष्यति । क्व यास्यामो वयं चात्र दुष्टेनापीडिता वयम्
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo'yaṃ mahāduṣṭaḥ kiṃ kiṃ naiva kariṣyati | kva yāsyāmo vayaṃ cātra duṣṭenāpīḍitā vayam
verses.translation: Priyavrata, his son Uttanapada, and his son and successors, were kings worshipping Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata, his son Uttanapada, and his son and successors, were kings worshipping Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । दुःखं त्यजत भो देवा युक्तिं कृत्वा च याम्यहम् । देवकार्यं करिष्यामि कृपया शङ्करस्य वै
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | duḥkhaṃ tyajata bho devā yuktiṃ kṛtvā ca yāmyaham | devakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi kṛpayā śaṅkarasya vai
verses.translation: Dhruva, R.sabha, Bharata, his brothers the nine Yogins and others too were worshippers of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhruva, R.sabha, Bharata, his brothers the nine Yogins and others too were worshippers of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स तु देवर्षिरगमद्रावणालयम् । सत्कारं समनुप्राप्य प्रीत्योवाचाखिलं च तत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā sa tu devarṣiragamadrāvaṇālayam | satkāraṃ samanuprāpya prītyovācākhilaṃ ca tat
verses.translation: Vaivasvata's sons, Tarkjya, Iksvaku and other kings, were always devoted to the worship of Siva and enjoyed happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaivasvata's sons, Tarkjya, Iksvaku and other kings, were always devoted to the worship of Siva and enjoyed happiness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । राक्षसोत्तम धन्यस्त्वं शैववर्यस्तपोधन । त्वां दृष्ट्वा च मनो मेऽद्य प्रसन्नमति रावण
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | rākṣasottama dhanyastvaṃ śaivavaryastapodhana | tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mano me'dya prasannamati rāvaṇa
verses.translation: Kakutstha, Mandhata, Sagara, Mucukunda, Hari- candra and Kalma$anghri were all excellent devotees of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kakutstha, Mandhata, Sagara, Mucukunda, Hari- candra and Kalma$anghri were all excellent devotees of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्ववृत्तं ब्रूह्यशेषेण शिवाराधनसम्भवम् । इति पृष्टस्तदा तेन रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: svavṛttaṃ brūhyaśeṣeṇa śivārādhanasambhavam | iti pṛṣṭastadā tena rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: Bhagiratha and other kings, many excellent kings are known as worshippers of Siva assuming the guise of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhagiratha and other kings, many excellent kings are known as worshippers of Siva assuming the guise of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रावण उवाच । गत्वा मया तु कैलासे तपोऽर्थं च महामुने । तत्रैव बहुकालं वै तपस्तप्तं सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇa uvāca | gatvā mayā tu kailāse tapo'rthaṃ ca mahāmune | tatraiva bahukālaṃ vai tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam
verses.translation: The great king Khatvanga, who helped the gods, worshipped the earthen idol of Siva always.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great king Khatvanga, who helped the gods, worshipped the earthen idol of Siva always.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा न शङ्करस्तुष्टस्ततश्च परिवर्तितम् । आगत्य वृक्षखण्डे वै पुनस्तप्तं मया मुने
verses.transliteration: yadā na śaṅkarastuṣṭastataśca parivartitam | āgatya vṛkṣakhaṇḍe vai punastaptaṃ mayā mune
verses.translation: At the behest of the sage Vasistha, Dasaratha particularly worshipped the earthen idol of Siva for obtain¬ ing sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the sage Vasistha, Dasaratha particularly worshipped the earthen idol of Siva for obtain¬ ing sons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्ये तु वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः । शीते जलान्तरस्थो हि कृतं चैव त्रिधा तपः
verses.transliteration: grīṣme pañcāgnimadhye tu varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ | śīte jalāntarastho hi kṛtaṃ caiva tridhā tapaḥ
verses.translation: Urged by Rsyasrnga, Kausalya, the beloved queen of Dasaratha joyously performed the worship of the earthen idol of Siva for the acquisition of a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by Rsyasrnga, Kausalya, the beloved queen of Dasaratha joyously performed the worship of the earthen idol of Siva for the acquisition of a son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं मया कृतं तत्र तपोऽत्युग्रं मुनीश्वर । तथापि शङ्करो मह्यं न प्रसन्नोऽभवन्मनाक्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ tatra tapo'tyugraṃ munīśvara | tathāpi śaṅkaro mahyaṃ na prasanno'bhavanmanāk
verses.translation: O excellent sage, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi the beloved queens, performed the worship of Siva with pleasure for the acquisition of good sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi the beloved queens, performed the worship of Siva with pleasure for the acquisition of good sons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा मया तु क्रुद्धेन भूमौ गर्तं विधाय च । तत्राग्निं च समाधाय पार्थिवं च प्रकल्प्य च
verses.transliteration: tadā mayā tu kruddhena bhūmau gartaṃ vidhāya ca | tatrāgniṃ ca samādhāya pārthivaṃ ca prakalpya ca
verses.translation: O sage, they obtained auspicious sons of great valour and prowess who followed the path of the good. It was due to the favour of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, they obtained auspicious sons of great valour and prowess who followed the path of the good. It was due to the favour of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धैश्च चन्दनैश्चैव धूपैश्च विविधैस्तदा । नैवेद्यैः पूजितः शम्भुरारार्तिकविधानतः
verses.transliteration: gandhaiśca candanaiścaiva dhūpaiśca vividhaistadā | naivedyaiḥ pūjitaḥ śambhurārārtikavidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Siva, Visnu himself was born of the ladies in four different forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the behest of Siva, Visnu himself was born of the ladies in four different forms.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपातैः स्तवैः पुण्यैस्तोषितः शङ्करो मया । गीतैर्नृत्यैश्च वाद्यैश्च मुखाङ्गुलिसमर्पणैः
verses.transliteration: praṇipātaiḥ stavaiḥ puṇyaistoṣitaḥ śaṅkaro mayā | gītairnṛtyaiśca vādyaiśca mukhāṅgulisamarpaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Rama performed the worship of the earthen idol every day in the company of his brothers. He wore Bhasma and Rudraksa and followed the Siva-cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama performed the worship of the earthen idol every day in the company of his brothers. He wore Bhasma and Rudraksa and followed the Siva-cult.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतैश्च विविधैश्चान्यैरुपायैर्भूरिभिर्मुने । शास्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन पूजितो भगवान् हरः
verses.transliteration: etaiśca vividhaiścānyairupāyairbhūribhirmune | śāstroktena vidhānena pūjito bhagavān haraḥ
verses.translation: O sage, the kings born of his family worshipped the earthen idol of Siva along with their followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the kings born of his family worshipped the earthen idol of Siva along with their followers.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न तुष्टः सम्मुखो जातो यदा च भगवान् हरः । तदाहं दुःखितोऽभूवं तपसोऽप्राप्य सत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: na tuṣṭaḥ sammukho jāto yadā ca bhagavān haraḥ | tadāhaṃ duḥkhito'bhūvaṃ tapaso'prāpya satphalam
verses.translation: O sage, the great king Sudyumna, the son of a sage, became a woman along with his attendants as a result of Siva's curse for the sake of his beloved.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the great king Sudyumna, the son of a sage, became a woman along with his attendants as a result of Siva's curse for the sake of his beloved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धिक् शरीरं बलं चैव धिक् तपःकरणं मम । इत्युक्त्वा तु मया तत्र स्थापितेऽग्नौ हुतं बहु
verses.transliteration: dhik śarīraṃ balaṃ caiva dhik tapaḥkaraṇaṃ mama | ityuktvā tu mayā tatra sthāpite'gnau hutaṃ bahu
verses.translation: Thanks to the worship of the earthen image of Siva, he became an excellent man again. By remaining a
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the worship of the earthen image of Siva, he became an excellent man again. By remaining a
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्चेति विचार्यैव त्यक्षाम्यग्नौ निजां तनुम् । सञ्छिन्नानि शिरांस्येव तस्मिन् प्रज्वलिते शुचौ
verses.transliteration: punaśceti vicāryaiva tyakṣāmyagnau nijāṃ tanum | sañchinnāni śirāṃsyeva tasmin prajvalite śucau
verses.translation: Then he forsook the kingdom and engaged himself in the Siva-cult assuming the guise of $iva. By virtue of devotion he attained salvation inaccessible to others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he forsook the kingdom and engaged himself in the Siva-cult assuming the guise of $iva. By virtue of devotion he attained salvation inaccessible to others.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुच्छित्वैकैकशस्तानि कृत्वा शुद्धानि सर्वशः । शङ्करायार्पितान्येव नवसङ्ख्यानि वै मया
verses.transliteration: succhitvaikaikaśastāni kṛtvā śuddhāni sarvaśaḥ | śaṅkarāyārpitānyeva navasaṅkhyāni vai mayā
verses.translation: His son Pururavas, a great king, was a worship¬ per of lord 3iva. His son Bharata performed the great worship of Siva always. Nahusa, a great devotee was interested in the worship of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son Pururavas, a great king, was a worship¬ per of lord 3iva. His son Bharata performed the great worship of Siva always. Nahusa, a great devotee was interested in the worship of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यावच्च दशमं छेत्तुं प्रारब्धमृषिसत्तम । तावदाविरभूत्तत्र ज्योतीरूपो हरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yāvacca daśamaṃ chettuṃ prārabdhamṛṣisattama | tāvadāvirabhūttatra jyotīrūpo haraḥ svayam
verses.translation: Yadu and others, the five sons of Yayati were the worshippers of Siva. Thanks to the power of the worship of Siva, they realised all their desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu and others, the five sons of Yayati were the worshippers of Siva. Thanks to the power of the worship of Siva, they realised all their desires.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मा मेति व्याहरत् प्रीत्या द्रुतं वै भक्तवत्सलः । प्रसन्नश्च वरं ब्रूहि ददामि मनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: mā meti vyāharat prītyā drutaṃ vai bhaktavatsalaḥ | prasannaśca varaṃ brūhi dadāmi manasepsitam
verses.translation: Other fortunate persons of his race and of other races, O sage, worshipped Siva and obtained worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other fortunate persons of his race and of other races, O sage, worshipped Siva and obtained worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च तदा तेन मया दृष्टो महेश्वरः । प्रणतः संस्तुतश्चैव करौ बध्वा सुभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: ityukte ca tadā tena mayā dṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | praṇataḥ saṃstutaścaiva karau badhvā subhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: After securing several divine boons from Siva who was delighted, lord Krsna brought the entire universe under his control.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing several divine boons from Siva who was delighted, lord Krsna brought the entire universe under his control.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा वृतं मयैतच्च देहि मे ह्यतुलं बलम् । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश दुर्लभं किं भवेन्मम
verses.transliteration: tadā vṛtaṃ mayaitacca dehi me hyatulaṃ balam | yadi prasanno deveśa durlabhaṃ kiṃ bhavenmama
verses.translation: Thanks to that merit, the forester became Nala. He became a great emperor and the husband of Damayanti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to that merit, the forester became Nala. He became a great emperor and the husband of Damayanti.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवेन परितुष्टेन सर्वं दत्तं कृपालुना । मह्यं मनोऽभिलषितं गिरा प्रोच्य तथास्त्विति
verses.transliteration: śivena parituṣṭena sarvaṃ dattaṃ kṛpālunā | mahyaṃ mano'bhilaṣitaṃ girā procya tathāstviti
verses.translation: O dear, thus I have narrated the divine story of Siva as.asked by you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus I have narrated the divine story of Siva as.asked by you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अमोघया सुदृष्ट्या वै वैद्यवद्योजितानि मे । शिरांसि सन्धयित्वा तु दृष्टानि परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: amoghayā sudṛṣṭyā vai vaidyavadyojitāni me | śirāṃsi sandhayitvā tu dṛṣṭāni paramātmanā
verses.translation: O dear, you are blessed and contented. Your
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, you are blessed and contented. Your
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते तदा तत्र शरीरं पूर्ववन्मम । जातं तस्य प्रसादाच्च सर्वं प्राप्तं फलं मया
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte tadā tatra śarīraṃ pūrvavanmama | jātaṃ tasya prasādācca sarvaṃ prāptaṃ phalaṃ mayā
verses.translation: O Suta, although this matter has been heard
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, although this matter has been heard

verses.sanskrit: तदा च प्रार्थितो मे संस्थितोऽसौ वृषभध्वजः । वैद्यनाथेश्वरो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोऽभूज्जगत्त्रये

verses.translation: O disciple of Vyasa, obeisance be to you. Please

verses.commentary: Sense: On a certain occasion they asked Siva, the great soul. ''What rite satisfies you to bestow worldly pleasures and salvation?"

verses.translation: Those who have mastered the text *'Jabalasruti** have mentioned ten sacred rites of Siva. These rites shall

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । श्रूयतां राक्षसश्रेष्ठ कथयामि हितं तव । त्वया तदेव कर्त्तव्यं मदुक्तं नान्यथा क्वचित्

verses.translation: On Atami days (the eighth day in the lunar fortnight) meals shall be taken only at night. O Visnu, on Kalastami day food shall be eschewed altogether.
verses.commentary: Sense: On Atami days (the eighth day in the lunar fortnight) meals shall be taken only at night. O Visnu, on Kalastami day food shall be eschewed altogether.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयोक्तं यच्छिवेनैव हितं दत्तं ममाधुना । तत्सर्वं च त्वया सत्यं न मन्तव्यं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: tvayoktaṃ yacchivenaiva hitaṃ dattaṃ mamādhunā | tatsarvaṃ ca tvayā satyaṃ na mantavyaṃ kadācana

verses.commentary: Sense: O Vinu, on the eleventh day in the bright lunar fortnight, food during the day is forbidden. O Vi?nu, on the eleventh day in the dark half food shall be taken at night after my worship.

verses.transliteration: ayaṃ vai vikṛtiṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ kiṃ naiva bravīti ca | satyaṃ naiva bhavettadvai kathaṃ jñeyaṃ priyo'si me
verses.translation: On the thirteenth day in the bright half, food shall be taken at night, In the dark half, it is forbidden to those who follow Siva's rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the thirteenth day in the bright half, food shall be taken at night, In the dark half, it is forbidden to those who follow Siva's rites.

verses.sanskrit: इति गत्वा पुनः कार्यं कुरु त्वं ह्यहिताय वै । कैलासोद्धरणे यत्नः कर्तव्यश्च त्वया पुनः

verses.commentary: Sense: O Visrm, in both the halves on every Monday, food shall be taken only during the night bv the followers of Siva-cult.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि चैवोद्धृतश्चायं कैलासो हि भविष्यति । तदैव सफलं सर्वं भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yadi caivoddhṛtaścāyaṃ kailāso hi bhaviṣyati | tadaiva saphalaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In all these rites, excellent brahmin devotees of Siva shall be fed according to one's ability for the completion of the sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all these rites, excellent brahmin devotees of Siva shall be fed according to one's ability for the completion of the sacred rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववत्स्थापयित्वा त्वं पुनरागच्छ वै सुखम् । निश्चयं परमं गत्वा यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: pūrvavatsthāpayitvā tvaṃ punarāgaccha vai sukham | niścayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: The sacred rites shall always be performed regularly by the brahmins. By abandoning these Vratas, brahmins become robbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacred rites shall always be performed regularly by the brahmins. By abandoning these Vratas, brahmins become robbers.

The four vratas that bring about salvation are the worship of Siva, the repetition of Rudra Mantra by way of Japa, observance of fast in Siva's temple and death in Varanasi. That salvation is eternal.

verses.translation: Rising in the morning, the intelligent man with great delight, shall perform his daily routine of bath with care.

verses.commentary: Sense: If he knows the sacred verses, he shall make earthen images of excellent type. After performing the daily routine he shall worship the earthen image.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुका राक्षसी काचित्पार्वतीवरदर्पिता । दारुकश्च पतिस्तस्या बभूव बलवत्तरः
verses.transliteration: dārukā rākṣasī kācitpārvatīvaradarpitā | dārukaśca patistasyā babhūva balavattaraḥ
verses.translation: He shall worship the bull-bannered deity by reciting the mantra imparted by the preceptor. Or he shall worship Sadasiva by means of Namamantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the bull-bannered deity by reciting the mantra imparted by the preceptor. Or he shall worship Sadasiva by means of Namamantras.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बहुभी राक्षसैस्तत्र चकार कदनं सताम् । यज्ञध्वंसं च लोकानां धर्मध्वंसं तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: bahubhī rākṣasaistatra cakāra kadanaṃ satām | yajñadhvaṃsaṃ ca lokānāṃ dharmadhvaṃsaṃ tadākarot
verses.translation: The devotee shall worship lord Siva particular!) with the leaves of the Bilva tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall worship lord Siva particular!) with the leaves of the Bilva tree.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे सागरे तस्य वनं सर्वसमृद्धिमत् । योजनानां षोडशभिर्विस्तृतं सर्वतो दिशम्
verses.transliteration: paścime sāgare tasya vanaṃ sarvasamṛddhimat | yojanānāṃ ṣoḍaśabhirvistṛtaṃ sarvato diśam
verses.translation: When the sun rises he shall take his bath and then worship Siva. The ablution of the deity shall be performed with devout services and adorations.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun rises he shall take his bath and then worship Siva. The ablution of the deity shall be performed with devout services and adorations.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुका स्वविलासार्थं यत्र गच्छति तद्वनम् । भूम्या च तरुभिस्तत्र सर्वोपकरणैर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: dārukā svavilāsārthaṃ yatra gacchati tadvanam | bhūmyā ca tarubhistatra sarvopakaraṇairyutam
verses.translation: O sages, may the concluding rite be heard with devotion and respect. By performing it, the Vrata certainly becomes complete.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, may the concluding rite be heard with devotion and respect. By performing it, the Vrata certainly becomes complete.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुकायै ददौ देवी तद्वनस्यावलोकनम् । प्रयाति तद्वनं सा हि पत्या सह यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: dārukāyai dadau devī tadvanasyāvalokanam | prayāti tadvanaṃ sā hi patyā saha yadṛcchayā
verses.translation: The devotee shall make an idol of Siva accoin- panied by Uma, of gold a pala in weight. According to his capacity the weight may be reduced to half of a pala. Siva shall be on the left side and Siva on the right. The devotee shall worship the idol at night.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall make an idol of Siva accoin- panied by Uma, of gold a pala in weight. According to his capacity the weight may be reduced to half of a pala. Siva shall be on the left side and Siva on the right. The devotee shall worship the idol at night.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थित्वा तदा सोऽपि सर्वेषां च भयं ददौ । दारुको राक्षसः पत्न्या तया दारुकया सह
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitvā tadā so'pi sarveṣāṃ ca bhayaṃ dadau | dāruko rākṣasaḥ patnyā tayā dārukayā saha
verses.translation: He shall keep awake during the night performing worship in the different 3-hour periods and singing songs of prayer or devoutly dancing.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall keep awake during the night performing worship in the different 3-hour periods and singing songs of prayer or devoutly dancing.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे पीडिता लोका और्वस्य शरणं ययुः । नत्वा प्रीत्या विशेषेण तमूचुर्नतमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: te sarve pīḍitā lokā aurvasya śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | natvā prītyā viśeṣeṇa tamūcurnatamastakāḥ
verses.translation: After performing the worship thus in accordance with the injunctions he shall propitiate the lord. He shall worship again in the morning and perform Homa duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the worship thus in accordance with the injunctions he shall propitiate the lord. He shall worship again in the morning and perform Homa duly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोका ऊचुः । महर्षे शरणं देहि नो चेद्दुष्टैश्च मारिताः । सर्वं कर्तुं समर्थोऽसि तेजसा दीप्तिमानसि
verses.transliteration: lokā ūcuḥ | maharṣe śaraṇaṃ dehi no cedduṣṭaiśca māritāḥ | sarvaṃ kartuṃ samartho'si tejasā dīptimānasi
verses.translation: He shall perform the Prajapatya rites according to his ability. With pleasure he shall feed brahmJ is and with devotion he shall make charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the Prajapatya rites according to his ability. With pleasure he shall feed brahmJ is and with devotion he shall make charitable gifts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्व्यां न वर्तते कश्चित्त्वां विना शरणं च नः । यामो यस्य समीपे तु स्थित्वा सुखमवाप्नुमः
verses.transliteration: pṛthvyāṃ na vartate kaścittvāṃ vinā śaraṇaṃ ca naḥ | yāmo yasya samīpe tu sthitvā sukhamavāpnumaḥ
verses.translation: Al.er making the earthen image, he shall install it thereafter. The devotee shall propitiate the bull-bannered lord, with several hymns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Al.er making the earthen image, he shall install it thereafter. The devotee shall propitiate the bull-bannered lord, with several hymns.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाः सर्वे पलायन्ते विदूरतः । त्वयि शैवं सदा तेजो विभाति ज्वलनो यथा
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasāḥ sarve palāyante vidūrataḥ | tvayi śaivaṃ sadā tejo vibhāti jvalano yathā
verses.translation: The glory of the Vrata shall be proclaimed by the intelligent devotee. It shall be heard by the devotee desiring the completion of the Vrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glory of the Vrata shall be proclaimed by the intelligent devotee. It shall be heard by the devotee desiring the completion of the Vrata.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं प्रार्थितो लोकैरौर्वो हि मुनिसत्तमः । शोचमानः शरण्यश्च रक्षायै हि वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ prārthito lokairaurvo hi munisattamaḥ | śocamānaḥ śaraṇyaśca rakṣāyai hi vaco'bravīt
verses.translation: Thus four different idols shall be made for the four 3-hour periods. They shall be duly invoked and duly dismissed. All the intermediary rites.shall also be performed. He shall keep awake with pleasure and jubilation. In the morning he shall take bath again. After installing the idol, he shall perform the worship.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus four different idols shall be made for the four 3-hour periods. They shall be duly invoked and duly dismissed. All the intermediary rites.shall also be performed. He shall keep awake with pleasure and jubilation. In the morning he shall take bath again.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus four different idols shall be made for the four 3-hour periods. They shall be duly invoked and duly dismissed. All the intermediary rites.shall also be performed. He shall keep awake with pleasure and jubilation. In the morning he shall take bath again.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: और्व उवाच । पृथिव्यां यदि रक्षांसि हिंस्युर्वै प्राणिनस्तदा । स्वयं प्राणैर्वियुज्येयू राक्षसा बलवत्तराः
verses.transliteration: aurva uvāca | pṛthivyāṃ yadi rakṣāṃsi hiṃsyurvai prāṇinastadā | svayaṃ prāṇairviyujyeyū rākṣasā balavattarāḥ
verses.translation: After concluding the rites and bowing to Siva again and again he shall pray to him with p.ilms joined in devotion and shoulders drooping down.
verses.commentary: Sense: After concluding the rites and bowing to Siva again and again he shall pray to him with p.ilms joined in devotion and shoulders drooping down.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा यज्ञाश्च हन्येरंस्तदा प्राणैर्वियोजिताः । भवन्तु राक्षसाः सर्वे सत्यमेतन्मयोच्यते
verses.transliteration: yadā yajñāśca hanyeraṃstadā prāṇairviyojitāḥ | bhavantu rākṣasāḥ sarve satyametanmayocyate
verses.translation: "O great God, the rite I have started at your behest has been performed and concluded. It has become excellent. O lord, the idol is being ritualistically dismissed now. O lord of gods O Siva, be satisfied with the Vrata that I have performed strenuously. Please be merciful to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great God, the rite I have started at your behest has been performed and concluded. It has become excellent. O lord, the idol is being ritualistically dismissed now. O lord of gods O Siva, be satisfied with the Vrata that I have performed strenuously. Please be merciful to me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा वचनं तेभ्यः समाश्वास्य प्रजाः पुनः । तपश्चकार विविधमौर्वो लोकसुखावहः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā vacanaṃ tebhyaḥ samāśvāsya prajāḥ punaḥ | tapaścakāra vividhamaurvo lokasukhāvahaḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall offer a handful of flowers to Siva and make charitable gifts. After making obeisance to Siva formally he shall conclude the rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall offer a handful of flowers to Siva and make charitable gifts. After making obeisance to Siva formally he shall conclude the rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवास्तदा ते विज्ञाय शापस्य कारणं हि तत् । युद्धाय च समुद्योगं चक्रुर्देवारिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: devāstadā te vijñāya śāpasya kāraṇaṃ hi tat | yuddhāya ca samudyogaṃ cakrurdevāribhiḥ saha
verses.translation: O Vi?nu, during the first 3-hour period the devotee shall worship with great devotion the earthen phallic image duly installed by way of good devotional services.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?nu, during the first 3-hour period the devotee shall worship with great devotion the earthen phallic image duly installed by way of good devotional services.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्चैव प्रयत्नैश्च नानायुधधराः सुराः । सर्वे शक्रादयस्तत्र युद्धार्थं समुपागताः
verses.transliteration: sarvaiścaiva prayatnaiśca nānāyudhadharāḥ surāḥ | sarve śakrādayastatra yuddhārthaṃ samupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Siva shall always be worshipped with the five
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva shall always be worshipped with the five
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तान्दृष्ट्वा राक्षसास्तत्र विचारे तत्पराः पुनः । बभूवुस्तेऽखिला दुष्टा मिथो ये यत्र संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tāndṛṣṭvā rākṣasāstatra vicāre tatparāḥ punaḥ | babhūvuste'khilā duṣṭā mitho ye yatra saṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: After offering the materials the steady water-pouring shall be made. The intelligent devotee shall consecrate the materials of worship with the steady pouring of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering the materials the steady water-pouring shall be made. The intelligent devotee shall consecrate the materials of worship with the steady pouring of water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसा ऊचुः । किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं सङ्कटं समुपागताः । युद्ध्यते म्रियते चैव युद्ध्यते न विहन्यते
verses.transliteration: rākṣasā ūcuḥ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ saṅkaṭaṃ samupāgatāḥ | yuddhyate mriyate caiva yuddhyate na vihanyate
verses.translation: He shall worship Siva, both Nirguna and Saguna, by the steady pouring of water, reciting the 108 mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Siva, both Nirguna and Saguna, by the steady pouring of water, reciting the 108 mantras.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव स्थीयते चेद्वै भक्ष्यते किं परस्परम् । दुःखं हि सर्वथा जातं क एनं विनिवारयेत्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva sthīyate cedvai bhakṣyate kiṃ parasparam | duḥkhaṃ hi sarvathā jātaṃ ka enaṃ vinivārayet
verses.translation: The worship of Siva the supreme soul shall be performed with sandal-paste, unbroken rice-grains and black gingelly seeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The worship of Siva the supreme soul shall be performed with sandal-paste, unbroken rice-grains and black gingelly seeds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । विचार्येति च ते तत्र दारुकाद्याश्च राक्षसाः । उपायं न विजानन्तो दुःखं प्राप्ताः सदा हि वै
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | vicāryeti ca te tatra dārukādyāśca rākṣasāḥ | upāyaṃ na vijānanto duḥkhaṃ prāptāḥ sadā hi vai
verses.translation: Again Siva shall be worshipped with lotus and and Karavira flowers. The devotee shall offer the flowers with the eight Namamantras to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again Siva shall be worshipped with lotus and and Karavira flowers. The devotee shall offer the flowers with the eight Namamantras to Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुका राक्षसी चापि ज्ञात्वा दुःखं समागतम् । भवान्याश्च वरं तं च कथयामास सा तदा
verses.transliteration: dārukā rākṣasī cāpi jñātvā duḥkhaṃ samāgatam | bhavānyāśca varaṃ taṃ ca kathayāmāsa sā tadā
verses.translation: They are Bhava, Sarva, Rudra, Pasupati, Ugra, Mahat, Bhima and Hana.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Bhava, Sarva, Rudra, Pasupati, Ugra, Mahat, Bhima and Hana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुकोवाच । मया ह्याराधिता पूर्वं भवपत्नी वरं ददौ । वनं गच्छ निजैः सार्धं यत्र गन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: dārukovāca | mayā hyārādhitā pūrvaṃ bhavapatnī varaṃ dadau | vanaṃ gaccha nijaiḥ sārdhaṃ yatra gantuṃ tvamicchasi
verses.translation: When the names are used for worship they shall be prefixed with,"Om" and then the names shall be put in the Dative case. The incense and the lamps shall be used. The food-offering shall be made thereafter.]
verses.commentary: Sense: When the names are used for worship they shall be prefixed with,"Om" and then the names shall be put in the Dative case. The incense and the lamps shall be used. The food-offering shall be made thereafter.]
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वरश्च मया प्राप्तः कथं दुःखं विषह्यते । जले वनं च नीत्वा वै सुखं स्थेयं तु राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: tadvaraśca mayā prāptaḥ kathaṃ duḥkhaṃ viṣahyate | jale vanaṃ ca nītvā vai sukhaṃ stheyaṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ
verses.translation: In the first 3-hour period the intelligent devotee shall make cooked rice as food-offering. Half a cocoanut, and Tambula shall be offered afterwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the first 3-hour period the intelligent devotee shall make cooked rice as food-offering. Half a cocoanut, and Tambula shall be offered afterwards.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्या हर्षमागताः । ऊचुः सर्वे मिथस्ते हि राक्षसा निर्भयास्तदा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasyā harṣamāgatāḥ | ūcuḥ sarve mithaste hi rākṣasā nirbhayāstadā
verses.translation: Obeisance and meditation shall follow and the mantra taught by the preceptor shall be used for Japa. Or the devotee shall propitiate Siva by means of the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance and meditation shall follow and the mantra taught by the preceptor shall be used for Japa. Or the devotee shall propitiate Siva by means of the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्येयं कृतकृत्येयं राज्ञ्या वै जीविताः स्वयम् । नत्वा तस्यै च तत्सर्वं कथयामासुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: dhanyeyaṃ kṛtakṛtyeyaṃ rājñyā vai jīvitāḥ svayam | natvā tasyai ca tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsurādarāt
verses.translation: The devotee shall exhibit the mystic gesture of cow and offer Tarpana with pure water. He shall then feed five Brahmins or more in accordance with his capacity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall exhibit the mystic gesture of cow and offer Tarpana with pure water. He shall then feed five Brahmins or more in accordance with his capacity.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि गन्तुं भवेच्छक्तिर्गम्यतां किं विचार्यते । तत्र गत्वा जले देवि सुखं स्थास्याम नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: yadi gantuṃ bhavecchaktirgamyatāṃ kiṃ vicāryate | tatra gatvā jale devi sukhaṃ sthāsyāma nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then till the end of that 3-hour period festivities shall be observed. After dedicating the fruit of the worship to the deity himself, the ritualistic dismissal shall be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then till the end of that 3-hour period festivities shall be observed. After dedicating the fruit of the worship to the deity himself, the ritualistic dismissal shall be performed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे लोका देवैः सार्धं समागताः । युद्धाय विविधैर्दुःखैः पीडिता राक्षसैः पुरा
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare lokā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ samāgatāḥ | yuddhāya vividhairduḥkhaiḥ pīḍitā rākṣasaiḥ purā
verses.translation: Then in the second 3-hour period Samkalpa rites shall be performed duly as before. Or the Samkalpa rite
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the second 3-hour period Samkalpa rites shall be performed duly as before. Or the Samkalpa rite
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पीडिताश्च तदा तस्या भवान्या बलमाश्रिताः । समग्रं नगरं नीत्वा जलस्थलसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: pīḍitāśca tadā tasyā bhavānyā balamāśritāḥ | samagraṃ nagaraṃ nītvā jalasthalasamanvitam
verses.translation: After performing the worship with the materials as before, the Jaladhara shall be offered. Then the devotee shall worship!§iva with gingelly seeds, barley grains and lotii«' flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the worship with the materials as before, the Jaladhara shall be offered. Then the devotee shall worship!§iva with gingelly seeds, barley grains and lotii«' flowers.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जय जयेति देव्यास्तु स्तुतिमुच्चार्य राक्षसी । तत उड्डीयनं कृत्वा सपक्षो गिरिराड्यथा
verses.transliteration: jaya jayeti devyāstu stutimuccārya rākṣasī | tata uḍḍīyanaṃ kṛtvā sapakṣo girirāḍyathā
verses.translation: The Arghya shall be offered with citron fruit. The Naivedya shall consist of milk pudding. O Vinu, the repetition of the mantra shall be twice as that of the previous one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Arghya shall be offered with citron fruit. The Naivedya shall consist of milk pudding. O Vinu, the repetition of the mantra shall be twice as that of the previous one.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रस्य च मध्ये सा संस्थिता निर्भया तदा । सकलैः परिवारैश्च मुमुदेति शिवानुगा
verses.transliteration: samudrasya ca madhye sā saṃsthitā nirbhayā tadā | sakalaiḥ parivāraiśca mumudeti śivānugā
verses.translation: Then the brahmins shall be fed sumptuously. Other rites shall be performd as before till the end of the second 3-hour period,of time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the brahmins shall be fed sumptuously. Other rites shall be performd as before till the end of the second 3-hour period,of time.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सिन्धौ च ते स्थित्वा नगरे च विलासिनः । राक्षसाश्च सुखं प्रापुर्निर्भयाश्च विजह्रिरे
verses.transliteration: tatra sindhau ca te sthitvā nagare ca vilāsinaḥ | rākṣasāśca sukhaṃ prāpurnirbhayāśca vijahrire
verses.translation: In the third 3-hour period the worship shall be done as before. But instead of barley, wheat grains shall be used and the flowers of the sun-plant shall be offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the third 3-hour period the worship shall be done as before. But instead of barley, wheat grains shall be used and the flowers of the sun-plant shall be offered.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसाश्च पृथिव्यां वै नाजग्मुश्च कदाचन । मुनेः शापभयादेव बभ्रमुस्ते चले तदा
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāśca pṛthivyāṃ vai nājagmuśca kadācana | muneḥ śāpabhayādeva babhramuste cale tadā
verses.translation: The waving of light, as part of worship, shall be per¬ formed with camphor. The Arghya shall consist of the pome¬ granate. The Japa repetition shall be thrice that of the pre¬ vious.
verses.commentary: Sense: The waving of light, as part of worship, shall be per¬ formed with camphor. The Arghya shall consist of the pome¬ granate. The Japa repetition shall be thrice that of the pre¬ vious.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नौषु स्थितान् जनान्नीत्वा नगरे तत्र तांस्तदा । चिक्षिपुर्बन्धनागारे कांश्चिज्जघ्नुस्तदा हि ते
verses.transliteration: nauṣu sthitān janānnītvā nagare tatra tāṃstadā | cikṣipurbandhanāgāre kāṃścijjaghnustadā hi te
verses.translation: When the fourth 3-hour period arrives the ritualistic dismissal of the previous worship shall be performed. The worship shall be performed duly with due ritualistic ges¬ tures.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the fourth 3-hour period arrives the ritualistic dismissal of the previous worship shall be performed. The worship shall be performed duly with due ritualistic ges¬ tures.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा पुनः पीडां चक्रुस्ते राक्षसास्तदा । तत्र स्थिता भवान्याश्च वरदानाच्च निर्भयाः
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā punaḥ pīḍāṃ cakruste rākṣasāstadā | tatra sthitā bhavānyāśca varadānācca nirbhayāḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall worship lord Siva with black gram, green gram, Priyahgu grains or any of the seven cereals, the flowers of Sahkhi and the leaves of Bilva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall worship lord Siva with black gram, green gram, Priyahgu grains or any of the seven cereals, the flowers of Sahkhi and the leaves of Bilva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वं स्थले लोके भयं चासीन्निरन्तरम् । तथा भयं जले तेषामासीन्नित्यं मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yathā pūrvaṃ sthale loke bhayaṃ cāsīnnirantaram | tathā bhayaṃ jale teṣāmāsīnnityaṃ munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The Naivedya shall be offered with different sweets or cooked black gram and rice in order to propitiate Sada- Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Naivedya shall be offered with different sweets or cooked black gram and rice in order to propitiate Sada- Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद्राक्षसी सा च निःसृता नगराज्जले । रुद्ध्वा मार्गं स्थिता लोकपीडार्थं धरणौ च हि
verses.transliteration: kadācidrākṣasī sā ca niḥsṛtā nagarājjale | ruddhvā mārgaṃ sthitā lokapīḍārthaṃ dharaṇau ca hi
verses.translation: O Vijou, Arghya shall be offered to Siva with the plantain fruit or with different types of fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vijou, Arghya shall be offered to Siva with the plantain fruit or with different types of fruits.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र नावो बहुतराः शुभाः । आगता बहुधा तत्र सर्वतो लोकसंवृताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra nāvo bahutarāḥ śubhāḥ | āgatā bahudhā tatra sarvato lokasaṃvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The exclient man shall perform the mantra japa twice in number of that on the previous occasion. The intelli¬ gent devotee shall decide on the number of brahmins to be fed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The exclient man shall perform the mantra japa twice in number of that on the previous occasion. The intelli¬ gent devotee shall decide on the number of brahmins to be fed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ता नावश्च तदा दृष्ट्वा हर्षं सम्प्राप्य राक्षसाः । द्रुतं गत्वा हि तत्रस्थान्वेगात्सन्दध्रिरे खलाः
verses.transliteration: tā nāvaśca tadā dṛṣṭvā harṣaṃ samprāpya rākṣasāḥ | drutaṃ gatvā hi tatrasthānvegātsandadhrire khalāḥ
verses.translation: Till day-break the devotee shall pass time in songs of prayer, musical instruments, devotional dances and other festivities along with his fellow devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Till day-break the devotee shall pass time in songs of prayer, musical instruments, devotional dances and other festivities along with his fellow devotees.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आजग्मुर्नगरं ते च तानादाय महाबलाः । चिक्षिपुर्बन्धनागारे बद्ध्वा हि निगडैर्दृढैः
verses.transliteration: ājagmurnagaraṃ te ca tānādāya mahābalāḥ | cikṣipurbandhanāgāre baddhvā hi nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ
verses.translation: Charitable gifts shall be offered, brahmins and ascetics shall be fed with different dishes, their number
verses.commentary: Sense: Charitable gifts shall be offered, brahmins and ascetics shall be fed with different dishes, their number
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बद्धास्ते निगडैर्लोकाः संस्थिता बन्धनालये । अतीव दुःखमाजग्मुर्भर्त्सितास्ते मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: baddhāste nigaḍairlokāḥ saṃsthitā bandhanālaye | atīva duḥkhamājagmurbhartsitāste muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: After making obeisance to Siva, handful of flowers shall be offered. The skilful devotee shall then pray after eulogising the lord with the mantras:—
verses.commentary: Sense: After making obeisance to Siva, handful of flowers shall be offered. The skilful devotee shall then pray after eulogising the lord with the mantras:—
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये च योऽधीशः स वैश्यः सुप्रियाभिधः । शिवप्रियः शुभाचारः शैवश्चासीत्सदातनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ madhye ca yo'dhīśaḥ sa vaiśyaḥ supriyābhidhaḥ | śivapriyaḥ śubhācāraḥ śaivaścāsītsadātanaḥ
verses.translation: "O Mrda, the storehouse of mercy, knowing that I belong to you, my very life is embedded in you and my mind is dedicated to you, please do what is proper.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Mrda, the storehouse of mercy, knowing that I belong to you, my very life is embedded in you and my mind is dedicated to you, please do what is proper.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विना च शिवपूजां वै न तिष्ठति कदाचन । सर्वथा शिवधर्मा हि भस्मरुद्राक्षभूषणः
verses.transliteration: vinā ca śivapūjāṃ vai na tiṣṭhati kadācana | sarvathā śivadharmā hi bhasmarudrākṣabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of living beings, be favourable to me viewing sympathetically at the Japa and worship conducted by me with the requisite knowledge or in ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of living beings, be favourable to me viewing sympathetically at the Japa and worship conducted by me with the requisite knowledge or in ignorance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि पूजा न जाता चेन्न भुनक्ति तदा तु सः । अतस्तत्रापि वैश्योऽसौ चकार शिवपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: yadi pūjā na jātā cenna bhunakti tadā tu saḥ | atastatrāpi vaiśyo'sau cakāra śivapūjanam
verses.translation: May lord 8iva the bestower of happiness be pleased with the fruit arising out of this fast and other rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: May lord 8iva the bestower of happiness be pleased with the fruit arising out of this fast and other rites.
