verses.sanskrit: कारागृहगतः सोऽपि बहूंश्चाशिक्षयत्तदा । शिवमन्त्रं च पूजां च पार्थिवीमृषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kārāgṛhagataḥ so'pi bahūṃścāśikṣayattadā | śivamantraṃ ca pūjāṃ ca pārthivīmṛṣisattamāḥ
verses.translation: O lord Siva, may your worship flourish in my family always. Let me not be born in the family where you arc not a deity."
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Siva, may your worship flourish in my family always. Let me not be born in the family where you arc not a deity."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे च तदा तत्र शिवपूजां स्वकामदाम् । चक्रिरे विधिवत्तत्र यथादृष्टं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: te sarve ca tadā tatra śivapūjāṃ svakāmadām | cakrire vidhivattatra yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam
verses.translation: After offering Puspafijali and accepting the Tilakas and blessings from the brahmins, the devotee shall ritualis- tically dismiss the deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering Puspafijali and accepting the Tilakas and blessings from the brahmins, the devotee shall ritualis- tically dismiss the deity.

verses.sanskrit: केचित्तत्र स्थिता ध्याने बद्ध्वासनमनुत्तमम् । मानसीं शिवपूजां च केचिच्चक्रुर्मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: kecittatra sthitā dhyāne baddhvāsanamanuttamam | mānasīṃ śivapūjāṃ ca keciccakrurmudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: This Vrata shall be performed with great devotion every month. After performing the concluding rite, the devotee shall reap the fruit with subsidiary benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Vrata shall be performed with great devotion every month. After performing the concluding rite, the devotee shall reap the fruit with subsidiary benefits.

verses.sanskrit: तदाधीशेन तत्रैव प्रत्यक्षं शिवपूजनम् । कृतं च पार्थिवस्यैव विधानेन मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tadādhīśena tatraiva pratyakṣaṃ śivapūjanam | kṛtaṃ ca pārthivasyaiva vidhānena munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: After hearing these beneficial and wonderful words of Siva, Visnu returned to his abode. Thereafter this excellent rite became popular among the people desiring welfare of their sou
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing these beneficial and wonderful words of Siva, Visnu returned to his abode. Thereafter this excellent rite became popular among the people desiring welfare of their sou

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च ये न जानन्ति विधानं स्मरणं परम् । नमः शिवाय मन्त्रेण ध्यायन्तः शङ्करं स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: anye ca ye na jānanti vidhānaṃ smaraṇaṃ param | namaḥ śivāya mantreṇa dhyāyantaḥ śaṅkaraṃ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Please narrate the Udyapana (formal concluding) of the rite of Sivaralri as a result of which Siva himself becomes delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please narrate the Udyapana (formal concluding) of the rite of Sivaralri as a result of which Siva himself becomes delighted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रियो नाम यश्चासीद्वैश्यवर्यः शिवप्रियः । ध्यायँश्च मनसा तत्र चकार शिवपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: supriyo nāma yaścāsīdvaiśyavaryaḥ śivapriyaḥ | dhyāyam̐śca manasā tatra cakāra śivapūjanam
verses.translation: The auspicious Sivaratrivrata shall be performed for fourteen years. On the TrayodaSi day only one meal shall be taken and a complete fast shall be observed on the Gaturdasi day.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious Sivaratrivrata shall be performed for fourteen years. On the TrayodaSi day only one meal shall be taken and a complete fast shall be observed on the Gaturdasi day.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तरूपी शम्भुश्च प्रत्यक्षं सर्वमाददे । सोऽपि स्वयं न जानाति गृह्यते न शिवेन वै
verses.transliteration: yathoktarūpī śambhuśca pratyakṣaṃ sarvamādade | so'pi svayaṃ na jānāti gṛhyate na śivena vai
verses.translation: On the Sivaratri day after performing the routine, the devotee shall go to the temple of Siva and peribrm worship. He shall make the mystical diagram famous in the three worlds by the name of Gaurltilaka.**®
verses.commentary: Sense: On the Sivaratri day after performing the routine, the devotee shall go to the temple of Siva and peribrm worship. He shall make the mystical diagram famous in the three worlds by the name of Gaurltilaka.**®

verses.sanskrit: एवं च क्रियमाणस्य वैश्यस्य शिवपूजनम् । व्यतीयुस्तत्र षण्मासा निर्विघ्नेन मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ca kriyamāṇasya vaiśyasya śivapūjanam | vyatīyustatra ṣaṇmāsā nirvighnena munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Gauritilaka, Liftgatobhadra and Sarvatobhadra (Verses 5 and 6) are the circular diagrams of particular type depicting the positions of the deities to lie Invoked therein for oficring worsltip, propitiation, eulogy etc,
verses.commentary: Sense: Gauritilaka, Liftgatobhadra and Sarvatobhadra (Verses 5 and 6) are the circular diagrams of particular type depicting the positions of the deities to lie Invoked therein for oficring worsltip, propitiation, eulogy etc,

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं च यज्जातं चरितं शशिमौलिनः । तच्छृणुध्वमृषिश्रेष्ठाः सावधानेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ ca yajjātaṃ caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ | tacchṛṇudhvamṛṣiśreṣṭhāḥ sāvadhānena cetasā
verses.translation: As in the Prajapatya rite, auspicious water-pots shall be placed wrapped in cloth, with a cocoanut above and the Daksina in.
verses.commentary: Sense: As in the Prajapatya rite, auspicious water-pots shall be placed wrapped in cloth, with a cocoanut above and the Daksina in.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Saying "May Siva be pleased**, he shall make the gift of a cow and a calf together with the essential requisites to the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying "May Siva be pleased**, he shall make the gift of a cow and a calf together with the essential requisites to the preceptor.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Saying "May Siva be pleased**, he shall make the gift of a cow and a calf together with the essential requisites to the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying "May Siva be pleased**, he shall make the gift of a cow and a calf together with the essential requisites to the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । नागेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गोद्भवमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । कदाचित्सेवकस्तस्य राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः । तदग्रे सुन्दरं रूपं शङ्करस्य ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.30. triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | nāgeśvarajyotirliṅgodbhavamāhātmyavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | kadācitsevakastasya rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ | tadagre sundaraṃ rūpaṃ śaṅkarasya dadarśa ha
verses.translation: He shall offer to him the waterpot and the Siva idol with all ornaments, placing them on a' bullock.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer to him the waterpot and the Siva idol with all ornaments, placing them on a' bullock.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै निवेदितं राज्ञे राक्षसानां यथार्थकम् । सर्वं तच्चरितं तेन सकौतुकमथाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmai niveditaṃ rājñe rākṣasānāṃ yathārthakam | sarvaṃ taccaritaṃ tena sakautukamathādbhutam
verses.translation: Thinking thus, the hunter went near a pond. He stood near the path leading to water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus, the hunter went near a pond. He stood near the path leading to water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजापि तत्र चागत्य राक्षसानां स दारुकः । विह्वलः सबलः शीघ्रं पर्यपृच्छच्च तं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: rājāpi tatra cāgatya rākṣasānāṃ sa dārukaḥ | vihvalaḥ sabalaḥ śīghraṃ paryapṛcchacca taṃ śivam
verses.translation: The earth stays steady through truth. The ocean is steady through truth. The water flows steadily through truth. Everything is founded on truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth stays steady through truth. The ocean is steady through truth. The water flows steadily through truth. Everything is founded on truth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारुक उवाच । किं ध्यायसि हि वैश्य त्वं सत्यं वद ममाग्रतः । एवं सति न मृत्युस्ते मम वाक्यं च नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: dāruka uvāca | kiṃ dhyāyasi hi vaiśya tvaṃ satyaṃ vada mamāgrataḥ | evaṃ sati na mṛtyuste mama vākyaṃ ca nānyathā
verses.translation: "O hunter, listen. I shall explain. If a person breaks his words he forfeits his merits. If I do not return let me be smeared with the sin that accrues to such people who forsake their legally wedded wife and cohabit with another, who transgress the Vcdic virtue and follow an imaginary and fictitious cult; who profess to be devoted to Visnu and censure Siva, who perform the K$ayaha rites of their parents on a Sunyatithi day and who add insult to injury."

verses.commentary: Sense: "O hunter, listen. I shall explain. If a person breaks his words he forfeits his merits. If I do not return let me be smeared with the sin that accrues to such people who forsake their legally wedded wife and cohabit with another,…

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तेनोक्तं च न जानामि तच्छ्रुत्वा कुपितः स वै । राक्षसान्प्रेरयामास हन्यतां राक्षसा अयम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tenoktaṃ ca na jānāmi tacchrutvā kupitaḥ sa vai | rākṣasānprerayāmāsa hanyatāṃ rākṣasā ayam
verses.translation: I am blessed that I am well-nourished and enough to satisfy your needs. Of a person everything is useless if his body is of no avail.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am blessed that I am well-nourished and enough to satisfy your needs. Of a person everything is useless if his body is of no avail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदुक्तास्ते तदा हन्तुं नानायुधधरा गताः । द्रुतं तं वैश्यशार्दूलं शङ्करासक्तचेतसम्
verses.transliteration: taduktāste tadā hantuṃ nānāyudhadharā gatāḥ | drutaṃ taṃ vaiśyaśārdūlaṃ śaṅkarāsaktacetasam
verses.translation: If a person does not help others though he is capable of it, all his efficiency is vain. He will fall into hell after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person does not help others though he is capable of it, all his efficiency is vain. He will fall into hell after death.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तानागतांस्तदा दृष्ट्वा भयवित्रस्तलोचनः । शिवं सस्मार सुप्रीत्या तन्नामानि जगौ मुहुः
verses.transliteration: tānāgatāṃstadā dṛṣṭvā bhayavitrastalocanaḥ | śivaṃ sasmāra suprītyā tannāmāni jagau muhuḥ
verses.translation: But I must entrust my young ones to the care of their mother. I shall console them and return again."
verses.commentary: Sense: But I must entrust my young ones to the care of their mother. I shall console them and return again."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यपतिरुवाच । पाहि शङ्कर देवेश पाहि शम्भो शिवेति च । दुष्टादस्मात्त्रिलोकेश खलहन् भक्तवत्सल
verses.transliteration: vaiśyapatiruvāca | pāhi śaṅkara deveśa pāhi śambho śiveti ca | duṣṭādasmāttrilokeśa khalahan bhaktavatsala
verses.translation: O stag, every animal that came here has gone after promising in the manner that you have done nov,. They have not yet come. You too are in distress now and want to go under a false pretext. How, then, will I have my livelihood?
verses.commentary: Sense: O stag, every animal that came here has gone after promising in the manner that you have done nov,. They have not yet come. You too are in distress now and want to go under a false pretext. How, then, will I have my livelihood?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वं च भवानद्य मम देव त्वमेव हि । त्वदधीनस्त्वदीयोऽहं त्वत्प्राणः सर्वदा प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sarvasvaṃ ca bhavānadya mama deva tvameva hi | tvadadhīnastvadīyo'haṃ tvatprāṇaḥ sarvadā prabho
verses.translation: O hunter, listen, I shall explain. I do not utter
verses.commentary: Sense: O hunter, listen, I shall explain. I do not utter
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति सम्प्रार्थितः शम्भुर्विवरान्निर्गतस्तदा । भवनेनोत्तमेनाथ चतुर्द्वारयुतेन च
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti samprārthitaḥ śambhurvivarānnirgatastadā | bhavanenottamenātha caturdvārayutena ca
verses.translation: He shall pray to lord Siva the great lord with great pleasure, with palms joined in reverence, with shoulders drooping and words choked with emotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall pray to lord Siva the great lord with great pleasure, with palms joined in reverence, with shoulders drooping and words choked with emotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मध्य ज्योतिःस्वरूपं च शिवरूपं तदद्भुतम् । परिवारसमायुक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापूजयत्स वै
verses.transliteration: madhya jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ ca śivarūpaṃ tadadbhutam | parivārasamāyuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpūjayatsa vai
verses.translation: "O great lord, lord of the gods, favourably dis¬ posed to the devotees, be merciful to me, thanks to this Vrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great lord, lord of the gods, favourably dis¬ posed to the devotees, be merciful to me, thanks to this Vrata.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूजितश्च तदा शम्भुः प्रसन्नो ह्यभवत्स्वयम् । अस्त्रं पाशुपतं नाम दत्त्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: pūjitaśca tadā śambhuḥ prasanno hyabhavatsvayam | astraṃ pāśupataṃ nāma dattvā rākṣasapuṅgavān
verses.translation: Japa and worship and other things have been performed partly in ignorance and partly with knowledge by me. May these be fruitful, O Siva, by your mercy."
verses.commentary: Sense: Japa and worship and other things have been performed partly in ignorance and partly with knowledge by me. May these be fruitful, O Siva, by your mercy."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जघान सोपकरणांस्तान्सर्वान्सगणान्द्रुतम् । अरक्षच्च स्वभक्तं वै दुष्टहा स हि शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: jaghāna sopakaraṇāṃstānsarvānsagaṇāndrutam | arakṣacca svabhaktaṃ vai duṣṭahā sa hi śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: After saying this the flower-offering shall be made to Siva the great soul. He shall make obeisance and pray again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the flower-offering shall be made to Siva the great soul. He shall make obeisance and pray again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वांस्तांश्च तदा हत्वा वरं प्रादाद्वनस्य च । अत्यद्भुतकरः शम्भुः स्वलीलात्तसुविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sarvāṃstāṃśca tadā hatvā varaṃ prādādvanasya ca | atyadbhutakaraḥ śambhuḥ svalīlāttasuvigrahaḥ
verses.translation: O Suta, we are extremely delighted on hearing your words. Please narrate the excellent Vrata in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, we are extremely delighted on hearing your words. Please narrate the excellent Vrata in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्वने सदा वर्णधर्मा वै सम्भवन्तु च । ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां हि तथैव च
verses.transliteration: asminvane sadā varṇadharmā vai sambhavantu ca | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ hi tathaiva ca
verses.translation: May this be heard, O sages. I shall narrate the ancient story of the hunter*® which destroys all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this be heard, O sages. I shall narrate the ancient story of the hunter*® which destroys all sins.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भवन्त्वत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तामसा न कदाचन । शिवधर्मप्रवक्तारः शिवधर्मप्रवर्तकाः
verses.transliteration: bhavantvatra muniśreṣṭhāstāmasā na kadācana | śivadharmapravaktāraḥ śivadharmapravartakāḥ
verses.translation: Everyday he used to go to the forest incessantly and kill deer. There in the forest he committed thefts also in various ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday he used to go to the forest incessantly and kill deer. There in the forest he committed thefts also in various ways.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एतस्मिन्समये सा वै राक्षसी दारुकाह्वया । देव्याः स्तुतिं चकारासौ पार्वत्या दीनमानसा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | etasminsamaye sā vai rākṣasī dārukāhvayā | devyāḥ stutiṃ cakārāsau pārvatyā dīnamānasā
verses.translation: Thr slory of the cruel hunter and his change of heart for the better is found with minor variations in details in the PadmapuiSta also.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thr slory of the cruel hunter and his change of heart for the better is found with minor variations in details in the PadmapuiSta also.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना च तदा देवी किं करोमीत्युवाच हि । साप्युवाच पुनस्तत्र वंशो मे रक्ष्यतां त्वया
verses.transliteration: prasannā ca tadā devī kiṃ karomītyuvāca hi | sāpyuvāca punastatra vaṃśo me rakṣyatāṃ tvayā
verses.translation: Thus requested he took up his bow and started im¬ mediately for hunting deer. He roamed here and there in the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested he took up his bow and started im¬ mediately for hunting deer. He roamed here and there in the forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्षयिष्यामि ते वंशं सत्यं च कथ्यते मया । इत्युक्त्वा च शिवेनैव विग्रहं सा चकार ह
verses.transliteration: rakṣayiṣyāmi te vaṃśaṃ satyaṃ ca kathyate mayā | ityuktvā ca śivenaiva vigrahaṃ sā cakāra ha
verses.translation: "What shall I do? Where shall I go? Nothing has been obtained by me. What will happen to my parents and my children at home? Then there is my wife too. What will happen to her? I must go home only with something in my hand. It is impossible to face them empty-handed."
verses.commentary: Sense: "What shall I do? Where shall I go? Nothing has been obtained by me. What will happen to my parents and my children at home? Then there is my wife too. What will happen to her? I must go home only with something in my hand. It is impossible to face them empty-handed."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवोऽपि कुपितां देवीं दृष्ट्वा वरवशः प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाचेति सुप्रीत्या यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: śivo'pi kupitāṃ devīṃ dṛṣṭvā varavaśaḥ prabhuḥ | pratyuvāceti suprītyā yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: "Some animal is sure to come here. I shall kill it and go home with pleasure. My purpose will be served fully.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Some animal is sure to come here. I shall kill it and go home with pleasure. My purpose will be served fully.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य स्वपतेः शङ्करस्य वै । सुप्रसन्ना विहस्याशु पार्वती वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasya svapateḥ śaṅkarasya vai | suprasannā vihasyāśu pārvatī vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: Thinking thus the hunter climbed up a Bilva tree, taking some water with him. He sat on its branch.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus the hunter climbed up a Bilva tree, taking some water with him. He sat on its branch.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच । भवदीयं वचस्तथ्यं युगान्ते सम्भविष्यति । तावच्च तामसी सृष्टिर्भवत्विति मतं मम
verses.transliteration: pārvatyuvāca | bhavadīyaṃ vacastathyaṃ yugānte sambhaviṣyati | tāvacca tāmasī sṛṣṭirbhavatviti mataṃ mama
verses.translation: With hunger and thirst oppressing him he waited and thought. "When will some animal come here? When shall I kill it?"
verses.commentary: Sense: With hunger and thirst oppressing him he waited and thought. "When will some animal come here? When shall I kill it?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा प्रलयः स्याद्वै सत्यं मे व्याहृतं शिव । प्रमाणीक्रियतां नाथ त्वदीयास्मि त्वदाश्रया
verses.transliteration: anyathā pralayaḥ syādvai satyaṃ me vyāhṛtaṃ śiva | pramāṇīkriyatāṃ nātha tvadīyāsmi tvadāśrayā
verses.translation: During the first part of the night a thirsty hind came there springing and jumping timidly.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the first part of the night a thirsty hind came there springing and jumping timidly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इयं च दारुका देवी राक्षसी शक्तिका मम । बलिष्ठा राक्षसीनां च रक्षोराज्यं प्रशास्तु च
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ ca dārukā devī rākṣasī śaktikā mama | baliṣṭhā rākṣasīnāṃ ca rakṣorājyaṃ praśāstu ca
verses.translation: When he did this, some water (that he had with him) got spilt and a few leaves of the Bilva tree fell down. There was a phallic idol of Siva beneath the tree. Hence this became his worship for the first part of the night. As a result of this his sin was dissolved.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he did this, some water (that he had with him) got spilt and a few leaves of the Bilva tree fell down. There was a phallic idol of Siva beneath the tree. Hence this became his worship for the first part of the night. As a result of this his sin was dissolved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इमा राक्षसपत्न्यस्तु प्रसविष्यन्ति पुत्रकान् । ते सर्वे मिलिताश्चैव वने वासाय मे मताः
verses.transliteration: imā rākṣasapatnyastu prasaviṣyanti putrakān | te sarve militāścaiva vane vāsāya me matāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the noise, the hind became frightened. It was much distressed on seeing the hunter. It spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the noise, the hind became frightened. It was much distressed on seeing the hunter. It spoke thus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा पार्वत्याः स्वस्त्रियाः प्रभुः । प्रसन्नमानसो भूत्वा शङ्करो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā pārvatyāḥ svastriyāḥ prabhuḥ | prasannamānaso bhūtvā śaṅkaro vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: "O hunter, what is it that you jjropose to do?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O hunter, what is it that you jjropose to do?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । इति ब्रवीषि त्वं वै चेच्छृणु मद्वचनं प्रिये । स्थास्याम्यस्मिन्वने प्रीत्या भक्तानां पालनाय च
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | iti bravīṣi tvaṃ vai cecchṛṇu madvacanaṃ priye | sthāsyāmyasminvane prītyā bhaktānāṃ pālanāya ca
verses.translation: "My family is starving today. I shall satisfy their hunger by killing you." On hearing these terrible words and seeing that ruthless knave, the hind thought "What shall I do? Where shall I go? Well, I shall use a trick, " thinking thus the hind spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: "My family is starving today. I shall satisfy their hunger by killing you." On hearing these terrible words and seeing that ruthless knave, the hind thought "What shall I do? Where shall I go? Well, I shall use a trick, " thinking thus the hind spoke.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र मे वर्णधर्मस्थो दर्शनं प्रीतिसंयुतम् । करिष्यति च यो वै स चक्रवर्ती भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: atra me varṇadharmastho darśanaṃ prītisaṃyutam | kariṣyati ca yo vai sa cakravartī bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: But all my infant fawns are in the hermitage. I shall intrust them to the care of my sister or husband and return.
verses.commentary: Sense: But all my infant fawns are in the hermitage. I shall intrust them to the care of my sister or husband and return.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा कलिपर्याये सत्यस्यादौ नृपेश्वरः । महासेनयुतो यो वै वीरसेनेति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: anyathā kaliparyāye satyasyādau nṛpeśvaraḥ | mahāsenayuto yo vai vīraseneti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: O forest-roamer, do not take my words to be lies. Undoubtedly I will come again to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O forest-roamer, do not take my words to be lies. Undoubtedly I will come again to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स मे भक्त्यातिविक्रान्तो दर्शनं मे करिष्यति । दर्शनं मे स कृत्वैव चक्रवर्ती भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sa me bhaktyātivikrānto darśanaṃ me kariṣyati | darśanaṃ me sa kṛtvaiva cakravartī bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: When the hunter did not accept its proposal even after being implored thus, the bewildered and frightened hind spoke again:—
verses.commentary: Sense: When the hunter did not accept its proposal even after being implored thus, the bewildered and frightened hind spoke again:—
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं दम्पती तौ च कृत्वा हास्यं परस्परम् । स्थितौ तत्र स्वयं साक्षान्महोतीकारकौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ dampatī tau ca kṛtvā hāsyaṃ parasparam | sthitau tatra svayaṃ sākṣānmahotīkārakau dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. I take this vow. After going home if I do not return to you let me be smeared with the sin that these people have viz—A brahmin who sells the Vedas, one who docs not offer Sandhya prayers, women who transgress the commands of their husbands and do various rites, an undgrateful person, a person who is averse to fviva. a person w'ho illtreats others, who violates Virtue, a person committing breach (if trust, and a person who deceives others.
verses.wordMeaning: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. I take this vow. After going home if I do not return to you let me be smeared with the sin that these people have viz—A brahmin who sells the Vedas, one who docs not offer Sandhya prayers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. I take this vow. After going home if I do not return to you let me be smeared with the sin that these people have viz—A brahmin who sells the Vedas, one who docs not offer Sandhya prayers,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्वरूपो हि नाम्ना नागेश्वरः शिवः । नागेश्वरी शिवा देवी बभूव च सतां प्रियौ
verses.transliteration: jyotirliṅgasvarūpo hi nāmnā nāgeśvaraḥ śivaḥ | nāgeśvarī śivā devī babhūva ca satāṃ priyau
verses.translation: When the hind made these promises the hunter believed it and said "Go home'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the hind made these promises the hunter believed it and said "Go home'*.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । वीरसेनः कथं तत्र यास्यते दारुकावने । कथमर्चिष्यति शिवं त्वं तद्वद महामते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | vīrasenaḥ kathaṃ tatra yāsyate dārukāvane | kathamarciṣyati śivaṃ tvaṃ tadvada mahāmate
verses.translation: The delighted hind drank water and wnt to its hermitage. By that time the first part of the night came to a close and the hunter did not have a wink of sleep.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted hind drank water and wnt to its hermitage. By that time the first part of the night came to a close and the hunter did not have a wink of sleep.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । निषधे सुन्दरे देशे क्षत्रियाणां कुले च सः । महासेनसुतो वीरसेनश्चैव शिवप्रियः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | niṣadhe sundare deśe kṣatriyāṇāṃ kule ca saḥ | mahāsenasuto vīrasenaścaiva śivapriyaḥ
verses.translation: The sister of the hind, not able to see it and so distressed came there in search of that hind. It too was thirsty.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sister of the hind, not able to see it and so distressed came there in search of that hind. It too was thirsty.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवेशार्चनं कृत्वा तपः परमदुष्करम् । चकार वीरसेनो वै वर्षाणां द्वादशावधिः
verses.transliteration: pārthiveśārcanaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ paramaduṣkaram | cakāra vīraseno vai varṣāṇāṃ dvādaśāvadhiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the hind, the Bhilla drew the bow and was about to shoot the arrow. As before, water and Bilva leaves fell on Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the hind, the Bhilla drew the bow and was about to shoot the arrow. As before, water and Bilva leaves fell on Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो देवेशः प्रत्यक्षं प्राह शङ्करः । काष्ठस्य मत्स्यिकां कृत्वा त्रपुधातुविलेपनाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno deveśaḥ pratyakṣaṃ prāha śaṅkaraḥ | kāṣṭhasya matsyikāṃ kṛtvā trapudhātuvilepanām
verses.translation: Incidentally it became the worship of the second part of the night. It was pleasing to the hunter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Incidentally it became the worship of the second part of the night. It was pleasing to the hunter.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विधाय योगमायां च दास्यामि वीरसेनक । तां गृहीत्वा प्रविश्यैनं नौभिः सह व्रजाधुना
verses.transliteration: vidhāya yogamāyāṃ ca dāsyāmi vīrasenaka | tāṃ gṛhītvā praviśyainaṃ naubhiḥ saha vrajādhunā
verses.translation: The hind asked "O forest-roamer what are you doing?" After seeing him, the hunter replied as before. On hearing it, the hind said again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hind asked "O forest-roamer what are you doing?" After seeing him, the hunter replied as before. On hearing it, the hind said again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वं तत्र गत्वा च विवरे च कृते मया । प्रविश्य च तदा पूजां कृत्वा नागेश्वरस्य च
verses.transliteration: tatastvaṃ tatra gatvā ca vivare ca kṛte mayā | praviśya ca tadā pūjāṃ kṛtvā nāgeśvarasya ca
verses.translation: "O hunter, listen. I am blessed. My life is fruitful. A service can be rendered through this evanescent body. But my fawns, young ones, are in the house. I shall entrust them to the care of my husband and come again."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O hunter, listen. I am blessed. My life is fruitful. A service can be rendered through this evanescent body. But my fawns, young ones, are in the house. I shall entrust them to the care of my husband and come again."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः पाशुपतं प्राप्य हत्वा च राक्षसीमुखान् । मयि दृष्टे तदा किञ्चिन्न्यूनं ते न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pāśupataṃ prāpya hatvā ca rākṣasīmukhān | mayi dṛṣṭe tadā kiñcinnyūnaṃ te na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "I do not agree to what you say. Undoubtedly I am going to kill you." On hearing that the hind said on the oath of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I do not agree to what you say. Undoubtedly I am going to kill you." On hearing that the hind said on the oath of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्याश्च बलं चैव सम्पूर्णं वै भविष्यति । अन्ये च म्लेच्छरूपा ये भविष्यन्ति वने शुभाः
verses.transliteration: pārvatyāśca balaṃ caiva sampūrṇaṃ vai bhaviṣyati | anye ca mleccharūpā ye bhaviṣyanti vane śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Implored by the hind, the hunter said to the hind, "go." It drank water and delightedly went away to its hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Implored by the hind, the hunter said to the hind, "go." It drank water and delightedly went away to its hermitage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तत्र वीरसेनं हि दुःखहा । कृत्वा कृपां च महतीं तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā śaṅkarastatra vīrasenaṃ hi duḥkhahā | kṛtvā kṛpāṃ ca mahatīṃ tatraivāntardadhe prabhuḥ
verses.translation: By that time the second part of the night too came to a close without a winlc of sleep to the hunter. When the third part arrived, the stag who was bewildered by the delay caused by the hind came there in search of it. The hunter saw it standing on the path leading to water.
verses.commentary: Sense: By that time the second part of the night too came to a close without a winlc of sleep to the hunter. When the third part arrived, the stag who was bewildered by the delay caused by the hind came there in search of it. The hunter saw it standing on the path leading to water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति दत्तवरः सोऽपि शिवेन परमात्मना । शक्तः सर्वं तदा कर्तुं सम्बभूव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: iti dattavaraḥ so'pi śivena paramātmanā | śaktaḥ sarvaṃ tadā kartuṃ sambabhūva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, while he attempted to do this, a few Biiva leaves fell on Siva as a result of his Prarabdha.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, while he attempted to do this, a few Biiva leaves fell on Siva as a result of his Prarabdha.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं नागेश्वरो देव उत्पन्नो ज्योतिषां पतिः । लिङ्गरूपस्त्रिलोकस्य सर्वकामप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nāgeśvaro deva utpanno jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ | liṅgarūpastrilokasya sarvakāmapradaḥ sadā
verses.translation: In view of this, the worship of the third part of that night became realised due to his good fortune. Siva's merciful nature was evident in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of this, the worship of the third part of that night became realised due to his good fortune. Siva's merciful nature was evident in this.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्यः शृणुयान्नित्यं नागेशोद्भवमादरात् । सर्वान्कामानियाद्धीमान्महापातकनाशनान्
verses.transliteration: etadyaḥ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ nāgeśodbhavamādarāt | sarvānkāmāniyāddhīmānmahāpātakanāśanān
verses.translation: On hearing the noise the stag asked, "what are you doing?" The hunter replied "I am going to kill you for the sake of my family."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the noise the stag asked, "what are you doing?" The hunter replied "I am going to kill you for the sake of my family."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth, in not helping despite the ability, in breaking cocoanut on Parvan days, in taking forbidden food, in taking food before worshipping Siva or without applying Bhasma.
verses.wordMeaning: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth, in not helping despite the ability, in breaking cocoanut on Parvan days, in taking forbidden food, in taking food before worshipping Siva or without applying Bhasma.
verses.wordMeaning: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । रामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि लिङ्गं रामेश्वराभिधम् । उत्पन्नं च यथा पूर्वमृषयः शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || caturthī koṭirudrasaṃhitā 4.31. ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | rāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi liṅgaṃ rāmeśvarābhidham | utpannaṃ ca yathā pūrvamṛṣayaḥ śṛṇutādarāt
verses.translation: On hearing these words the hunter said "Gk) and return quickly." Thus permitted by the hunter, the hunter drank water and went away.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words the hunter said "Gk) and return quickly." Thus permitted by the hunter, the hunter drank water and went away.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा विष्णुः पृथिव्यां चावततार सतां प्रियः
verses.transliteration: purā viṣṇuḥ pṛthivyāṃ cāvatatāra satāṃ priyaḥ
verses.translation: The deer are blessed. Though devoid of know¬ ledge, they are ready to help others by offering their own bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deer are blessed. Though devoid of know¬ ledge, they are ready to help others by offering their own bodies.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सीता हृता विप्रा रावणेनोरुमायिना । प्रापिता स्वगृहं सा हि लङ्कायां जनकात्मजा
verses.transliteration: tatra sītā hṛtā viprā rāvaṇenorumāyinā | prāpitā svagṛhaṃ sā hi laṅkāyāṃ janakātmajā
verses.translation: He will make alliance with you. Go-operating with my devotee your mind indulged in rendering service to me, you will attain salvation rare to others.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will make alliance with you. Go-operating with my devotee your mind indulged in rendering service to me, you will attain salvation rare to others.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्वेषणपरस्तस्याः किष्किन्धाख्यां पुरीमगात् । सुग्रीवहितकृद्भूत्वा वालिनं सञ्जघान ह
verses.transliteration: anveṣaṇaparastasyāḥ kiṣkindhākhyāṃ purīmagāt | sugrīvahitakṛdbhūtvā vālinaṃ sañjaghāna ha
verses.translation: Brahma and others are dependent on the attributes. Siva is beyond the attributes. He is free from aberrations. He is the great Brahman, the fourth deity, greater than Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma and others are dependent on the attributes. Siva is beyond the attributes. He is free from aberrations. He is the great Brahman, the fourth deity, greater than Prakrti.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थित्वा कियत्कालं तदन्वेषणतत्परः । सुग्रीवाद्यैर्लक्ष्मणेन विचारं कृतवान्स वै
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitvā kiyatkālaṃ tadanveṣaṇatatparaḥ | sugrīvādyairlakṣmaṇena vicāraṃ kṛtavānsa vai
verses.translation: O brahmins, devotion and knowledge®* are essentially non-different from each other as explained by Siva. Hence, they should not be differentiated. Happiness befalls him who observes them always.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, devotion and knowledge®* are essentially non-different from each other as explained by Siva. Hence, they should not be differentiated. Happiness befalls him who observes them always.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कपीन् सम्प्रेषयामास चतुर्दिक्षु नृपात्मजः । हनुमत्प्रमुखान् रामस्तदन्वेषणहेतवे
verses.transliteration: kapīn sampreṣayāmāsa caturdikṣu nṛpātmajaḥ | hanumatpramukhān rāmastadanveṣaṇahetave
verses.translation: Hence, O great sages, devotion to lord Siva shall be practised. There is no doubt in this that everything is realisable solely through devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O great sages, devotion to lord Siva shall be practised. There is no doubt in this that everything is realisable solely through devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ ज्ञात्वा गतां लङ्कां सीतां कपिवराननात् । सीताचूडामणिं प्राप्य मुमुदे सोऽति राघवः
verses.transliteration: atha jñātvā gatāṃ laṅkāṃ sītāṃ kapivarānanāt | sītācūḍāmaṇiṃ prāpya mumude so'ti rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, what has been asked by you has been explained. There is no doubt in this that on hearing this, one is rid of his sin completely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, what has been asked by you has been explained. There is no doubt in this that on hearing this, one is rid of his sin completely.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सकपीशस्तदा रामो लक्ष्मणेन युतो द्विजाः । सुग्रीवप्रमुखैः पुण्यैर्वानरैर्बलवत्तरैः
verses.transliteration: sakapīśastadā rāmo lakṣmaṇena yuto dvijāḥ | sugrīvapramukhaiḥ puṇyairvānarairbalavattaraiḥ
verses.translation: Devotion and realization are separate (41.17) but not con* tradictory terms. The two paths leading to the goal of liberation are complementary, running parallel to each other.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मैरष्टादशाख्यैश्च ययौ तीरं पयोनिधेः । दक्षिणे सागरे यो वै दृश्यते लवणाकरः
verses.transliteration: padmairaṣṭādaśākhyaiśca yayau tīraṃ payonidheḥ | dakṣiṇe sāgare yo vai dṛśyate lavaṇākaraḥ
verses.translation: Masters of the Vedas and Vedanta know that which originates from the Nirguna great soul as tlfe one termed Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Masters of the Vedas and Vedanta know that which originates from the Nirguna great soul as tlfe one termed Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य स्वयं रामो वेलायां संस्थितो हि सः । वानरैः सेव्यमानस्तु लक्ष्मणेन शिवप्रियः
verses.transliteration: tatrāgatya svayaṃ rāmo velāyāṃ saṃsthito hi saḥ | vānaraiḥ sevyamānastu lakṣmaṇena śivapriyaḥ
verses.translation: All these animals who had promised in good faith, met at the hermitage. Hearing the news of one another in its entirety they decided that they should go because they were bound by the promise. They consoled the fawns and became eager to go back.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these animals who had promised in good faith, met at the hermitage. Hearing the news of one another in its entirety they decided that they should go because they were bound by the promise. They consoled the fawns and became eager to go back.

verses.sanskrit: हा जानकि कुतो याता कदा चेयं मिलिष्यति । अगाधः सागरश्चैवातार्या सेना च वानरी

verses.commentary: Sense: The senior hind spoke to its mate "O stag, without you, how can the young fawns stay here? O lord, it was I who promised at the outset. So I shall go. Both of you stay here."

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसो गिरिधर्ता च महाबलपराक्रमः । लङ्काख्यो दुर्गमो दुर्ग इन्द्रजित्तनयोऽस्य वै
verses.transliteration: rākṣaso giridhartā ca mahābalaparākramaḥ | laṅkākhyo durgamo durga indrajittanayo'sya vai
verses.translation: On hearing those words the junior hind spoke "1 am your servant. Hence I go. You shall stay here."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words the junior hind spoke "1 am your servant. Hence I go. You shall stay here."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं स विचार्यैव तटे स्थित्वा सलक्ष्मणः । आश्वासितो वनौकोभिरङ्गदादिपुरः सरैः
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ sa vicāryaiva taṭe sthitvā salakṣmaṇaḥ | āśvāsito vanaukobhiraṅgadādipuraḥ saraiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it, the stag said—"I am going there. Both of you stay here. Infants are guarded and looked after by their mothers."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, the stag said—"I am going there. Both of you stay here. Infants are guarded and looked after by their mothers."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र राघवः शैवसत्तमः । उवाच भ्रातरं प्रीत्या जलार्थी लक्ष्मणाभिधम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra rāghavaḥ śaivasattamaḥ | uvāca bhrātaraṃ prītyā jalārthī lakṣmaṇābhidham
verses.translation: On hearing the words of their husband the two hinds did not consider it righteous. They lovingly told their husband, "Fie upon that life in widowhood."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of their husband the two hinds did not consider it righteous. They lovingly told their husband, "Fie upon that life in widowhood."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराम उवाच । भ्रातर्लक्ष्मण वीरेशाहं जलार्थी पिपासितः । तदानय द्रुतं पाथो वानरैः कैश्चिदेव हि

verses.translation: Then all of them consoled their fawns and en¬ trusted them to the care of their neighbours. They went to the place where the hunter was waiting-
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all of them consoled their fawns and en¬ trusted them to the care of their neighbours. They went to the place where the hunter was waiting-
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा वानरास्तत्र ह्यधावन्त दिशो दश । नीत्वा जलं च ते प्रोचुः प्रणिपत्य पुरः स्थिताः

verses.translation: The fawns too seeing all these followed them thinking. ''Let what befalls them happen to us as well."
verses.commentary: Sense: The fawns too seeing all these followed them thinking. ''Let what befalls them happen to us as well."

verses.sanskrit: वानरा ऊचुः । जलं च गृह्यतां स्वामिन्नानीतं तत्त्वदाज्ञया । महोत्तमं च सुस्वादु शीतलं प्राणतर्पणम्

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य तान् । तच्छ्रुत्वा रामचन्द्रोऽसौ स्वयं जग्राह तज्जलम्

verses.sanskrit: न कृतं दर्शनं शम्भोर्गृह्यते च जलं कथम् । स्वस्वामिनः परेशस्य सर्वानन्दप्रदस्य वै

verses.translation: What have I achieved despite being born as a human being? I have nourished my body by torturing others.

verses.commentary: Sense: I reared my family by committing many sins every day. Alas! what will be my fate after committing all these sins?

verses.commentary: Sense: Sins have been committed by me ever since my birth. What goal shall I attain? "Fie, Fic upon my life!**

verses.translation: Acquiring perfect knowledge thus, he withdrew the arrow and explained—'*0 excellent deer! you are all blessed. You can safely go back.**

verses.translation: When he said this, Siva became delighted. He revealed his form that is worshipped and honoured by the good.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he said this, Siva became delighted. He revealed his form that is worshipped and honoured by the good.

verses.commentary: Sense: Your race will flourish without any calamity. O hunter, certainly lord Rama praised even by the gods will come to your house.

verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityevaṃ sa ca samprārthya namaskṛtya punaḥ punaḥ | tadā jaya jayetyuccairudghoṣaiḥ śaṅkareti ca
verses.translation: In the meantime, having viewed §iva, the deer bowed to him and attained liberation from their birth as deer.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, having viewed §iva, the deer bowed to him and attained liberation from their birth as deer.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुत्वा शिवं तत्र मन्त्रध्यानपरायणः । पुनः पूजां ततः कृत्वा स्वाम्यग्रे स ननर्त ह
verses.transliteration: iti stutvā śivaṃ tatra mantradhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | punaḥ pūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā svāmyagre sa nanarta ha
verses.translation: They attained divine bodies, ascended the aerial chariot and went away. Released from curse at the very sight of Siva they attained heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: They attained divine bodies, ascended the aerial chariot and went away. Released from curse at the very sight of Siva they attained heaven.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रेमविक्लिन्नहृदयो गल्लनादं यदाकरोत् । तदा च शङ्करो देवः सुप्रसन्नो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: premaviklinnahṛdayo gallanādaṃ yadākarot | tadā ca śaṅkaro devaḥ suprasanno babhūva ha
verses.translation: Siva became Vyadhesvara on the Arbuda'®® mount¬ ain. Viewing and worshipping this phallic idol bestows worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva became Vyadhesvara on the Arbuda'®® mount¬ ain. Viewing and worshipping this phallic idol bestows worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गः सपरिवारश्च ज्योतीरूपो महेश्वरः । यथोक्तरूपममलं कृत्वाविरभवद् द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sāṅgaḥ saparivāraśca jyotīrūpo maheśvaraḥ | yathoktarūpamamalaṃ kṛtvāvirabhavad drutam
verses.translation: From that day onwards the hunter attained godly pleasures and being favoured by the god attained Sayujya*® salvation with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that day onwards the hunter attained godly pleasures and being favoured by the god attained Sayujya*® salvation with Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सन्तुष्टहृदयो रामभक्त्या महेश्वरः । शिवमस्तु वरं ब्रूहि रामेति स तदाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ santuṣṭahṛdayo rāmabhaktyā maheśvaraḥ | śivamastu varaṃ brūhi rāmeti sa tadābravīt
verses.translation: Even after performing this rite in utter ignorance he attained Sayujya; what about those who are endowed with devotion? They will surely attain complete identity with the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after performing this rite in utter ignorance he attained Sayujya; what about those who are endowed with devotion? They will surely attain complete identity with the lord.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्रूपं च तदा दृष्टवा सर्वे पूतास्ततः स्वयम् । कृतवान् राघवः पूजां शिवधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: tadrūpaṃ ca tadā dṛṣṭavā sarve pūtāstataḥ svayam | kṛtavān rāghavaḥ pūjāṃ śivadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After considering all Sastras, and the sacred rites enjoined by these Sivaratrivrata, has been glorified as the most excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: After considering all Sastras, and the sacred rites enjoined by these Sivaratrivrata, has been glorified as the most excellent.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिं च विविधां कृत्वा प्रणिपत्य शिवं मुदा । जयं च प्रार्थयामास रावणाजौ तदात्मनः
verses.transliteration: stutiṃ ca vividhāṃ kṛtvā praṇipatya śivaṃ mudā | jayaṃ ca prārthayāmāsa rāvaṇājau tadātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Different Vratas, various holy centres, gifts of variegated nature, diverse sacrifices, different austerities and many forms of Japas, are not equal to Sivaratrivrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different Vratas, various holy centres, gifts of variegated nature, diverse sacrifices, different austerities and many forms of Japas, are not equal to Sivaratrivrata.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नहृदयो रामभक्त्या महेश्वरः । जयोऽस्तु ते महाराज प्रीत्या स पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasannahṛdayo rāmabhaktyā maheśvaraḥ | jayo'stu te mahārāja prītyā sa punarabravīt
verses.translation: Hence this auspicious Vrata shall be performed
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence this auspicious Vrata shall be performed
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवदत्तं जयं प्राप्य ह्यनुज्ञां समवाप्य च । पुनश्च प्रार्थयामास साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः
verses.transliteration: śivadattaṃ jayaṃ prāpya hyanujñāṃ samavāpya ca | punaśca prārthayāmāsa sāñjalirnatamastakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated the auspicious §ivai'atri Vrata entirely. It is famous as the chief of sacred rites. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have narrated the auspicious §ivai'atri Vrata entirely. It is famous as the chief of sacred rites. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराम उवाच । त्वया स्थेयमिह स्वामिंल्लोकानां पावनाय च । परेषामुपकारार्थं यदि तुष्टोऽसि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: śrīrāma uvāca | tvayā stheyamiha svāmiṃllokānāṃ pāvanāya ca | pareṣāmupakārārthaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si śaṅkara
verses.translation: O great sages, only Siva can bestow liberation. Brahma and others cannot do that. They shall be known as bestowers of virtue, wealth and love.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, only Siva can bestow liberation. Brahma and others cannot do that. They shall be known as bestowers of virtue, wealth and love.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तु शिवस्तत्र लिङ्गरूपोऽभवत्तदा । रामेश्वरश्च नाम्ना वै प्रसिद्धो जगतीतले
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktastu śivastatra liṅgarūpo'bhavattadā | rāmeśvaraśca nāmnā vai prasiddho jagatītale
verses.translation: O great sages, Siva's form is twofold: Saguna and Nirguna as explained in the Vedas. It is that from which the entire universe originates, by which it is protected and in which it merges and by whom all this has been pervaded.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, Siva's form is twofold: Saguna and Nirguna as explained in the Vedas. It is that from which the entire universe originates, by which it is protected and in which it merges and by whom all this has been pervaded.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रामस्तु तत्प्रभावाद्वै सिन्धुमुत्तीर्य चाञ्जसा । रावणादीन्निहत्याशु राक्षसान्प्राप तां प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: rāmastu tatprabhāvādvai sindhumuttīrya cāñjasā | rāvaṇādīnnihatyāśu rākṣasānprāpa tāṃ priyām
verses.translation: O brahmins, good people attain it when knowledge of Siva rises up or when they worship him with deep devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, good people attain it when knowledge of Siva rises up or when they worship him with deep devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रामेश्वरस्य महिमाद्भुतोऽभूद्भुवि चातुलः । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदश्चैव सर्वदा भक्तकामदः
verses.transliteration: rāmeśvarasya mahimādbhuto'bhūdbhuvi cātulaḥ | bhuktimuktipradaścaiva sarvadā bhaktakāmadaḥ
verses.translation: Devotion to Siva, characterised by sprouting pure love, is the mother of perfect knowledge. It is easy of access by means of his benevolence. It yields worldly pleasures and salvation too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devotion to Siva, characterised by sprouting pure love, is the mother of perfect knowledge. It is easy of access by means of his benevolence. It yields worldly pleasures and salvation too.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यगङ्गाजलेनैव स्नापयिष्यति यः शिवम् । रामेश्वरं च सद्भक्त्या स जीवन्मुक्त एव हि
verses.transliteration: divyagaṅgājalenaiva snāpayiṣyati yaḥ śivam | rāmeśvaraṃ ca sadbhaktyā sa jīvanmukta eva hi
verses.translation: Devotion is of various types. O brahmins, it is both Sagupa and Nirguna Whatever is legitimate and
verses.commentary: Sense: Devotion is of various types. O brahmins, it is both Sagupa and Nirguna Whatever is legitimate and
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगान्देवानां दुर्लभानपि । अन्ते प्राप्य परं ज्ञानं कैवल्यं प्राप्नुयाद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: iha bhuktvākhilānbhogāndevānāṃ durlabhānapi | ante prāpya paraṃ jñānaṃ kaivalyaṃ prāpnuyād dhruvam
verses.translation: Learned men consider devotion to be of different sorts, such as ordained and non-ordained. Since they are of various types they are not explained in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men consider devotion to be of different sorts, such as ordained and non-ordained. Since they are of various types they are not explained in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं ज्योतिर्लिगं शिवस्य तु । रामेश्वराभिधं दिव्यं शृण्वतां पापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: iti vaśca samākhyātaṃ jyotirligaṃ śivasya tu | rāmeśvarābhidhaṃ divyaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpahārakam
verses.translation: Differentiated by the differences in those who observe ravana (listening) etc. both these are of nine sub¬ divisions each. Without his favour they are difficult of performance and with His favour they can easily be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Differentiated by the differences in those who observe ravana (listening) etc. both these are of nine sub¬ divisions each. Without his favour they are difficult of performance and with His favour they can easily be performed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu famous as Narayana slept there enveloped by Maya. The Prakrti is known as Narayani (belonging to Narayana.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu famous as Narayana slept there enveloped by Maya. The Prakrti is known as Narayani (belonging to Narayana.)

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu famous as Narayana slept there enveloped by Maya. The Prakrti is known as Narayani (belonging to Narayana.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu famous as Narayana slept there enveloped by Maya. The Prakrti is known as Narayani (belonging to Narayana.)
