verses.translation: Dependence on dowry, servitude to women, non- protection of the womenfolk, carrying on affairs with women through fraudulent means.
verses.hindi: जगतू अन्नमय है अर्थात् अन्नका ही परिणाम है
verses.commentary: Sense: Dependence on dowry, servitude to women, non- protection of the womenfolk, carrying on affairs with women through fraudulent means.
verses.science: जगतू अन्नमय है अर्थात् अन्नका ही परिणाम है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: कामेन स्वसहायेन प्रबलेन मनोभुवा । सर्वः प्रधर्षितो वीरो विष्ण्वादिप्रबलोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: kāmena svasahāyena prabalena manobhuvā | sarvaḥ pradharṣito vīro viṣṇvādiprabalo'pi hi
verses.translation: Using bullock constantly as a vehicle through wild jungles, Uccatana (exorcising) and Abhicara (black magic) acceptance of grains as gift, working as a physician.
verses.hindi: आहारकी ही विशेष आकांक्षा रखते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Using bullock constantly as a vehicle through wild jungles, Uccatana (exorcising) and Abhicara (black magic) acceptance of grains as gift, working as a physician.
verses.science: आहारकी ही विशेष आकांक्षा रखते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवमायाप्रभावेणाभूद्धरिः काममोहितः । परस्त्रीधर्षणं चक्रे बहुवारं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: śivamāyāprabhāveṇābhūddhariḥ kāmamohitaḥ | parastrīdharṣaṇaṃ cakre bahuvāraṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: Engagement in sacred rites to satisfy the palate or the sexual urge, teaching only the text of the Vedas (not the meaning).
verses.hindi: लेपसे नष्ट होता है, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Engagement in sacred rites to satisfy the palate or the sexual urge, teaching only the text of the Vedas (not the meaning).
verses.science: लेपसे नष्ट होता है, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्त्रिदशपो भूत्वा गौतमस्त्रीविमोहितः । पापं चकार दुष्टात्मा शापं प्राप मुनेस्तदा
verses.transliteration: indrastridaśapo bhūtvā gautamastrīvimohitaḥ | pāpaṃ cakāra duṣṭātmā śāpaṃ prāpa munestadā
verses.translation: For the comparison of the Piincipal and subsidiary sins as mentioned in the previous and present chapters, see Manu Ch. ii. The treatment of the subject in.P is more elaborate.
verses.hindi: अग्निसे तप्त हुए सभी प्राणी मर जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: For the comparison of the Piincipal and subsidiary sins as mentioned in the previous and present chapters, see Manu Ch. ii. The treatment of the subject in.P is more elaborate.
verses.science: अग्निसे तप्त हुए सभी प्राणी मर जाते हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पावकोऽपि जगच्छ्रेष्ठो मोहितः शिवमायया । कामाधीनः कृतो गर्वात्ततस्तेनैव चोद्धृतः
verses.transliteration: pāvako'pi jagacchreṣṭho mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | kāmādhīnaḥ kṛto garvāttatastenaiva coddhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Eschewing of Brahma and other Vratas and adop¬ tion of ther modes and customs, learning of spurious holy lore, engagement in hair-splitting arguments.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होता है, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing of Brahma and other Vratas and adop¬ tion of ther modes and customs, learning of spurious holy lore, engagement in hair-splitting arguments.
verses.science: प्राप्त होता है, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जगत्प्राणोऽपि गर्वेण मोहितः शिवमायया । कामेन निर्जितो व्यास चक्रेऽन्यस्त्रीरतिं पुरा
verses.transliteration: jagatprāṇo'pi garveṇa mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | kāmena nirjito vyāsa cakre'nyastrīratiṃ purā
verses.translation: Those who have ceased to perform sacrifices to the gods and the manes, those who have abandoned their duties and rites, persons of evil conduct, atheists, sinners, and habitual liars.
verses.hindi: तथा महात्मा ब्राह्मणको अन्नका दान करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have ceased to perform sacrifices to the gods and the manes, those who have abandoned their duties and rites, persons of evil conduct, atheists, sinners, and habitual liars.
verses.science: तथा महात्मा ब्राह्मणको अन्नका दान करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डरश्मिस्तु मार्तण्डो मोहितः शिवमायया । कामाकुलो बभूवाशु दृष्ट्वाश्वीं हयरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍaraśmistu mārtaṇḍo mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | kāmākulo babhūvāśu dṛṣṭvāśvīṃ hayarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: He who indulges in sexual intercourse during new moon and full moon days during day time, or in the vagi¬ nal passages of animals, or through other passages or emits semen in water, or cohabits with a woman in her monthly course.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who indulges in sexual intercourse during new moon and full moon days during day time, or in the vagi¬ nal passages of animals, or through other passages or emits semen in water, or cohabits with a woman in her monthly course.
verses.science: संचित कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रश्च मोहितः शम्भोर्मायया कामसङ्कुलः । गुरुपत्नीं जहाराथ युतस्तेनैव चोद्धृतः
verses.transliteration: candraśca mohitaḥ śambhormāyayā kāmasaṅkulaḥ | gurupatnīṃ jahārātha yutastenaiva coddhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those who shatter the hopes of obtaining wives, sons and friends; those who speak displeasing words; ruth¬ less persons and those who break agreements.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who shatter the hopes of obtaining wives, sons and friends; those who speak displeasing words; ruth¬ less persons and those who break agreements.
verses.science: व्यक्तिको बहुत पुण्य मिलता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं तु मित्रावरुणौ घोरे तपसि संस्थितौ । मोहितौ तावपि मुनी शिवमायाविमोहितौ
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ tu mitrāvaruṇau ghore tapasi saṃsthitau | mohitau tāvapi munī śivamāyāvimohitau
verses.translation: Those who damage or demolish lakes, wells or water causeways; he who serves different kinds of food among persons sitting in the same row.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who damage or demolish lakes, wells or water causeways; he who serves different kinds of food among persons sitting in the same row.
verses.science: तथा देश नहीं पूछना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशीं तरुणीं दृष्ट्वा कामुकौ सम्बभूवतुः । मित्रः कुम्भे जहौ रेतो वरुणोऽपि तथा जले
verses.transliteration: urvaśīṃ taruṇīṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmukau sambabhūvatuḥ | mitraḥ kumbhe jahau reto varuṇo'pi tathā jale
verses.translation: The foregoing are some of the minor sins. Men or women guilty of the same are minor sinners, I shall mention some others also. Listen.
verses.commentary: Sense: The foregoing are some of the minor sins. Men or women guilty of the same are minor sinners, I shall mention some others also. Listen.
verses.science: आनन्दपूर्वक स्वर्गमें निवास करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः कुम्भात्समुत्पन्नो वसिष्ठो मित्रसम्भवः । अगस्त्यो वरुणाज्जातो वडवाग्निसमद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumbhātsamutpanno vasiṣṭho mitrasambhavaḥ | agastyo varuṇājjāto vaḍavāgnisamadyutiḥ
verses.translation: Those who cause injury to cows, brahmins, vir¬ gins, master, friends or ascetics are sure to go to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who cause injury to cows, brahmins, vir¬ gins, master, friends or ascetics are sure to go to hell.
verses.science: प्रकाशित होते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षश्च मोहितः शम्भोर्मायया ब्रह्मणः सुतः । भ्रातृभिः स भगिन्यां वै भोक्तुकामोऽभवत्पुरा
verses.transliteration: dakṣaśca mohitaḥ śambhormāyayā brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | bhrātṛbhiḥ sa bhaginyāṃ vai bhoktukāmo'bhavatpurā
verses.translation: Those who undergo agony due to another man's wife; those who have an eye on another man's wealth; those who steal that and those who make use of false weights.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who undergo agony due to another man's wife; those who have an eye on another man's wealth; those who steal that and those who make use of false weights.
verses.science: विशेषरूपसे श्रेष्ठ कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा च बहुवारं हि मोहितः शिवमायया । अभवद्भोक्तुकामश्च स्वसुतायां परासु च
verses.transliteration: brahmā ca bahuvāraṃ hi mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | abhavadbhoktukāmaśca svasutāyāṃ parāsu ca
verses.translation: Those who cause misery to brahmins by means of kicks and blows; the brahmins who serve iSudra women and drink wine due to passion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who cause misery to brahmins by means of kicks and blows; the brahmins who serve iSudra women and drink wine due to passion.
verses.science: अन्नादिका दान करना चाहिए। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: च्यवनोऽपि महायोगी मोहितः शिवमायया । सुकन्यया विजह्रे स कामासक्तो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: cyavano'pi mahāyogī mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | sukanyayā vijahre sa kāmāsakto babhūva ha
verses.translation: Those who are cruel and engaged in sinful acts; those who arc fond of violence and those who perform Dana, Yajfia and other rites as a profession for livelihood.
verses.hindi: पढ़ाता है, वह समृद्धिशाली हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are cruel and engaged in sinful acts; those who arc fond of violence and those who perform Dana, Yajfia and other rites as a profession for livelihood.
verses.science: पढ़ाता है, वह समृद्धिशाली हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपः शिवमायातो मोहितः कामसङ्कुलः । ययाचे कन्यकां मोहाद्धन्वनो नृपतेः पुरा
verses.transliteration: kaśyapaḥ śivamāyāto mohitaḥ kāmasaṅkulaḥ | yayāce kanyakāṃ mohāddhanvano nṛpateḥ purā
verses.translation: Those who evacuate their bowels in cowpens, streets, near water and fire, shades of trees, mountains, parks and temples.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who evacuate their bowels in cowpens, streets, near water and fire, shades of trees, mountains, parks and temples.
verses.science: नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गरुडः शाण्डिलीं कन्यां नेतुकामः सुमोहितः । विज्ञातस्तु तया सद्यो दग्धपक्षो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: garuḍaḥ śāṇḍilīṃ kanyāṃ netukāmaḥ sumohitaḥ | vijñātastu tayā sadyo dagdhapakṣo babhūva ha
verses.translation: Those who block roads by means of bamboos, bricks, logs of wood, horns or poles and those who violate the boundaries of others' fields.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who block roads by means of bamboos, bricks, logs of wood, horns or poles and those who violate the boundaries of others' fields.
verses.science: सम्पूर्ण कुलको तार देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विभाण्डको मुनिर्नारीं दृष्ट्वा कामवशं गतः । ऋष्यशृङ्गसुतस्तस्य मृग्यां जातः शिवाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: vibhāṇḍako munirnārīṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ | ṛṣyaśṛṅgasutastasya mṛgyāṃ jātaḥ śivājñayā
verses.translation: Those who make counterfeit documents, those who are engaged in fraudulent activities, those who indulge in fraud in dealing in food and clothing and in law suits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who make counterfeit documents, those who are engaged in fraudulent activities, those who indulge in fraud in dealing in food and clothing and in law suits.
verses.science: कभी नहीं प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमश्च मुनिः शम्भोर्मायामोहितमानसः । दृष्ट्वा शारद्वतीं नग्नां रराम क्षुभितस्तया
verses.transliteration: gautamaśca muniḥ śambhormāyāmohitamānasaḥ | dṛṣṭvā śāradvatīṃ nagnāṃ rarāma kṣubhitastayā
verses.translation: The maker, buyer and seller of bows, weapons and darts, he who is merciless to servants and he who ill-treats animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: The maker, buyer and seller of bows, weapons and darts, he who is merciless to servants and he who ill-treats animals.
verses.science: कोर्तिका उत्तम हेतु होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रेतः स्कन्नं दधार स्वं द्रोण्यां चैव स तापसः । तस्माच्च कलशाज्जातो द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: retaḥ skannaṃ dadhāra svaṃ droṇyāṃ caiva sa tāpasaḥ | tasmācca kalaśājjāto droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens slowly to the words of liars, who is traitor to masters, friends and teachers, a cheat, a fickle- minded and a rogue
verses.hindi: ऊराया, उसका पुण्य अनन्त होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens slowly to the words of liars, who is traitor to masters, friends and teachers, a cheat, a fickle- minded and a rogue
verses.science: ऊराया, उसका पुण्य अनन्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पराशरो महायोगी मोहितः शिवमायया । मत्स्योदर्या च चिक्रीडे कुमार्या दाशकन्यया
verses.transliteration: parāśaro mahāyogī mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | matsyodaryā ca cikrīḍe kumāryā dāśakanyayā
verses.translation: Those who leave their wives, sons, friends, child¬ ren, the aged, lean and sick persons, servants, guests and kinsmen hungry but take food themselves.
verses.hindi: निर्माणकर्ताको उत्तम लक्ष्मी प्रदान करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who leave their wives, sons, friends, child¬ ren, the aged, lean and sick persons, servants, guests and kinsmen hungry but take food themselves.
verses.science: निर्माणकर्ताको उत्तम लक्ष्मी प्रदान करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो बभूवाथ मोहितः शिवमायया । रेमे मेनकया व्यास वने कामवशं गतः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro babhūvātha mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | reme menakayā vyāsa vane kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: He who sumptuously feeds himself on delicacie.s but does not give any tiling to biahmins, shall be known as Vrthapaka (a man of fruitless cooking). He is despised by those who propound Brahman.
verses.hindi: स्थावर प्राणी जलाशयका आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sumptuously feeds himself on delicacie.s but does not give any tiling to biahmins, shall be known as Vrthapaka (a man of fruitless cooking). He is despised by those who propound Brahman.
verses.science: स्थावर प्राणी जलाशयका आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठेन विरोधं तु कृतवान्नष्टचेतनः । पुनः शिवप्रसादाच्च ब्राह्मणोऽभूत्स एव वै
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhena virodhaṃ tu kṛtavānnaṣṭacetanaḥ | punaḥ śivaprasādācca brāhmaṇo'bhūtsa eva vai
verses.translation: Those who voluntarily decide to perform certain rites with self-imposed checks and restraints but leave them off because they have not conquered their sense-organs; those who renounce but again come back to householder's life; breakers of the idols of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who voluntarily decide to perform certain rites with self-imposed checks and restraints but leave them off because they have not conquered their sense-organs; those who renounce but again come back to householder's life; breakers of the idols of Siva.
verses.science: मिलता है--ऐसा विद्वानोंने कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रावणो वैश्रवाः कामी बभूव शिवमायया । सीतां जह्रे कुबुद्धिस्तु मोहितो मृत्युमाप च
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo vaiśravāḥ kāmī babhūva śivamāyayā | sītāṃ jahre kubuddhistu mohito mṛtyumāpa ca
verses.translation: Cruel persons who beat cows and bulls; suppress them; do not feed them properly and let them alone weak and feeble.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cruel persons who beat cows and bulls; suppress them; do not feed them properly and let them alone weak and feeble.
verses.science: लगानेके महत्त्वका श्रवण कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्मुनिवरो मोहितः शिवमायया । भ्रातृपत्न्या वशी रेमे भरद्वाजस्ततोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatirmunivaro mohitaḥ śivamāyayā | bhrātṛpatnyā vaśī reme bharadvājastato'bhavat
verses.translation: Those who ill-treat bullocks with weighty burden; those who make them draw heavily-laden carts; those who do not let them off free for lei.sure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who ill-treat bullocks with weighty burden; those who make them draw heavily-laden carts; those who do not let them off free for lei.sure.
verses.science: प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति मायाप्रभावो हि शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । वर्णितस्ते मया व्यास किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: iti māyāprabhāvo hi śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ | varṇitaste mayā vyāsa kimanyacchrotumicchasi
verses.translation: Those who do not rear cows and bullocks pro¬ perly, let them starve; ill treat them with heavy burdens; do not treat their wounds and bruises are called the killers of cows. They arc sure to fall into hell.
verses.hindi: धर्मसम्बन्धसे साक्षात् पुत्र ही कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not rear cows and bullocks pro¬ perly, let them starve; ill treat them with heavy burdens; do not treat their wounds and bruises are called the killers of cows. They arc sure to fall into hell.
verses.science: धर्मसम्बन्धसे साक्षात् पुत्र ही कहे गये हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: There'is no doubt that the brahmins who take monetary gifts from an unjust king fall into terrible hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: There'is no doubt that the brahmins who take monetary gifts from an unjust king fall into terrible hells.
verses.science: साथ आनन्द प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: There'is no doubt that the brahmins who take monetary gifts from an unjust king fall into terrible hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: There'is no doubt that the brahmins who take monetary gifts from an unjust king fall into terrible hells.
verses.science: प्रकारके अर्थोका साधन है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । महापातकवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । ये पापनिरता जीवा महानरकहेतवः । भगवंस्तान् समाचक्ष्व ब्रह्मपुत्र नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.5. pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ | mahāpātakavarṇanam | vyāsa uvāca | ye pāpaniratā jīvā mahānarakahetavaḥ | bhagavaṃstān samācakṣva brahmaputra namo'stu te
verses.translation: The king who confiscates the properties of brahmins unjustly and passes them on to others certainly falls into hell.
verses.hindi: सौभाग्य एवं रूप प्राप्त होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The king who confiscates the properties of brahmins unjustly and passes them on to others certainly falls into hell.
verses.science: सौभाग्य एवं रूप प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । ये पापनिरता जीवा महानरकहेतवः । ते समासेन कथ्यन्ते सावधानतया शृणु
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | ye pāpaniratā jīvā mahānarakahetavaḥ | te samāsena kathyante sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu
verses.translation: There are no living beings who do not go to Yama's abode. The result of the action must of necessity be undergone. Let that be considered.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे प्ञम्यामुमासंहितायां तपोमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: There are no living beings who do not go to Yama's abode. The result of the action must of necessity be undergone. Let that be considered.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे प्ञम्यामुमासंहितायां तपोमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रीद्रव्यसङ्कल्पश्चेतसानिष्टचिन्तनम् । अकार्याभिनिवेशश्च चतुर्धा कर्म मानसम्
verses.transliteration: parastrīdravyasaṅkalpaścetasāniṣṭacintanam | akāryābhiniveśaśca caturdhā karma mānasam
verses.translation: They go on, burnt and scorched by lightning falls and pierced through by heavy showers of arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: They go on, burnt and scorched by lightning falls and pierced through by heavy showers of arrows.
verses.science: सुननेमात्रसे ही प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अविबद्धप्रलापत्वमसत्यं चाप्रियं च यत् । परोक्षतश्च पैशुन्यं चतुर्धा कर्म वाचिकम्
verses.transliteration: avibaddhapralāpatvamasatyaṃ cāpriyaṃ ca yat | parokṣataśca paiśunyaṃ caturdhā karma vācikam
verses.translation: The hands of some are tied behind and they are hit in the belly. Others are completely bound with iron fetters. Still others are nailed in their hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hands of some are tied behind and they are hit in the belly. Others are completely bound with iron fetters. Still others are nailed in their hands.
verses.science: नामक तेरहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अभक्ष्यभक्षणं हिंसा मिथ्याकार्यनिवेशनम् । परस्वानामुपादानं चतुर्धा कर्म कायिकम्
verses.transliteration: abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ hiṃsā mithyākāryaniveśanam | parasvānāmupādānaṃ caturdhā karma kāyikam
verses.translation: The noses of others arc bored and ropes arc tied through them and they are dragged. Similarly others have their cheeks and lips bored and are dragged by ropes.
verses.hindi: गृहनन्तो वै पवित्राणि तारयन्ति स्वमेव तम्॥ २ और दान देनेवाले दोनोंका उद्धार करनेवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The noses of others arc bored and ropes arc tied through them and they are dragged. Similarly others have their cheeks and lips bored and are dragged by ropes.
verses.science: गृहनन्तो वै पवित्राणि तारयन्ति स्वमेव तम्॥ २ और दान देनेवाले दोनोंका उद्धार करनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतद् द्वादशविधं कर्म प्रोक्तं त्रिसाधनम् । अस्य भेदान् पुनर्वक्ष्ये येषां फलमनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: ityetad dvādaśavidhaṃ karma proktaṃ trisādhanam | asya bhedān punarvakṣye yeṣāṃ phalamanantakam
verses.translation: The tips of the hands and the legs of some arc cut off. The ears, noses and lips of others are cut. The penis and the scrotum of some are cut. A few others have all their limbs and joints cut.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tips of the hands and the legs of some arc cut off. The ears, noses and lips of others are cut. The penis and the scrotum of some are cut. A few others have all their limbs and joints cut.
verses.science: किंतु सरस्वतीदान सबसे बढ़कर है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये द्विषन्ति महादेवं संसारार्णवतारकम् । सुमहत्पातकं तेषां निरयार्णवगामिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ye dviṣanti mahādevaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam | sumahatpātakaṃ teṣāṃ nirayārṇavagāminām
verses.translation: Pushed, pierced and thrust by spears and arrows some run about helplessly here and there shrieking and squealing.
verses.hindi: मणि तथा कपिला गाय--ये दस महादान हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Pushed, pierced and thrust by spears and arrows some run about helplessly here and there shrieking and squealing.
verses.science: मणि तथा कपिला गाय--ये दस महादान हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये शिवज्ञानवक्तारं निन्दन्ति च तपस्विनम् । गुरून् पितॄनथोन्मत्तास्ते यान्ति निरयार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: ye śivajñānavaktāraṃ nindanti ca tapasvinam | gurūn pitṝnathonmattāste yānti nirayārṇavam
verses.translation: Those who had not made any charitable gifts in the world feel thirsty along this path and vainly beg for water, feeling hungry they beg for food; oppressed by sun¬ shine they beg for shade and distressed with chillness they request for fire. They vainly beg for happiness. But those who had made charitable gilts in the world have all the food and drink necessary for this journey and go ahead to Yama's abode happily.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who had not made any charitable gifts in the world feel thirsty along this path and vainly beg for water, feeling hungry they beg for food; oppressed by sun¬ shine they beg for shade and distressed with chillness they request for fire. They vainly beg for happiness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who had not made any charitable gifts in the world feel thirsty along this path and vainly beg for water, feeling hungry they beg for food; oppressed by sun¬ shine they beg for shade and distressed with chillness they request for fire. They vainly beg for happiness.…
verses.science: हैं--ऐसा मैंने सुना है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवनिन्दा गुरोर्निन्दा शिवज्ञानस्य दूषणम् । देवद्रव्यापहरणं द्विजद्रव्यविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śivanindā gurornindā śivajñānasya dūṣaṇam | devadravyāpaharaṇaṃ dvijadravyavināśanam
verses.translation: Having thus traversed the path they finally reach the city of the dead with great hardship. They are then ushered into the presence of Yama by the emissaries after due announcement.
verses.hindi: होकर परम गतिको प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Having thus traversed the path they finally reach the city of the dead with great hardship. They are then ushered into the presence of Yama by the emissaries after due announcement.
verses.science: होकर परम गतिको प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरन्ति ये च सम्मूढाश्शिवज्ञानस्य पुस्तकम् । महान्ति पातकान्याहुरनन्तफलदानि षट्
verses.transliteration: haranti ye ca sammūḍhāśśivajñānasya pustakam | mahānti pātakānyāhuranantaphaladāni ṣaṭ
verses.translation: Sin accrues to the fierce robbers ind to those cohabiting with other men's wives. It accrues to the king who indulges in amorous sports with other's women.
verses.hindi: वह सब कुछ तपस्यासे प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Sin accrues to the fierce robbers ind to those cohabiting with other men's wives. It accrues to the king who indulges in amorous sports with other's women.
verses.science: वह सब कुछ तपस्यासे प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाभिनन्दन्ति ये दृष्ट्वा शिवपूजां प्रकल्पिताम् । न नमन्त्यर्चितं दृष्ट्वा शिवलिङ्गं स्तुवन्ति न
verses.transliteration: nābhinandanti ye dṛṣṭvā śivapūjāṃ prakalpitām | na namantyarcitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śivaliṅgaṃ stuvanti na
verses.translation: If the king does not discriminate between a non¬ thief and a thief and kills the wrong person he is sure to fall in hell.
verses.hindi: परमेश्वर शिवजी प्राप्त नहीं हो सकते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: If the king does not discriminate between a non¬ thief and a thief and kills the wrong person he is sure to fall in hell.
verses.science: परमेश्वर शिवजी प्राप्त नहीं हो सकते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथेष्टचेष्टा निःशङ्काः सन्तिष्ठन्ते रमन्ति च । उपचारविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवाग्रे गुरुसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: yatheṣṭaceṣṭā niḥśaṅkāḥ santiṣṭhante ramanti ca | upacāravinirmuktāḥ śivāgre gurusannidhau
verses.translation: If people steal even a small quantity of these things they will fall into hell—ghee, oil, food and drink, honey, flesh, wine, toddy, jaggery, sugarcane, vegetables, milk, curds, roots, fruits, grass, firewood, leaves, flowers, medicine, shoes, umbrella, cart, seat, waterpot, copper, tin, lead, weapon, conch, and aquatic products, medicinal con-
verses.hindi: पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है और तर जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: If people steal even a small quantity of these things they will fall into hell—ghee, oil, food and drink, honey, flesh, wine, toddy, jaggery, sugarcane, vegetables, milk, curds, roots, fruits, grass, firewood, leaves, flowers, medicine, shoes, umbrella, cart, seat, waterpot,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If people steal even a small quantity of these things they will fall into hell—ghee, oil, food and drink, honey, flesh, wine, toddy, jaggery, sugarcane, vegetables, milk, curds, roots, fruits, grass, firewood, leaves, flowers, medicine, shoes, umbrella, cart, seat, waterpot,…
verses.science: पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है और तर जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थानसंस्कारपूजां च ये न कुर्वन्ति पर्वसु । विधिवद्वा गुरूणां च कर्मयोगव्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: sthānasaṃskārapūjāṃ ca ye na kurvanti parvasu | vidhivadvā gurūṇāṃ ca karmayogavyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: There are other similar things the stealing of which even in small quantities causes fall into hell.
verses.hindi: तथा अन्य लोग भी तपस्यापरायण रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other similar things the stealing of which even in small quantities causes fall into hell.
verses.science: तथा अन्य लोग भी तपस्यापरायण रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये त्यजन्ति शिवाचारं शिवभक्तान्द्विषन्ति च । असम्पूज्य शिवज्ञानं येऽधीयन्ते लिखन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye tyajanti śivācāraṃ śivabhaktāndviṣanti ca | asampūjya śivajñānaṃ ye'dhīyante likhanti ca
verses.translation: At the behest of Yama the sinners go to the world o.f Yama in their bodies, which are dragged by Yama's terrible emissaries and are subjected to grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Yama the sinners go to the world o.f Yama in their bodies, which are dragged by Yama's terrible emissaries and are subjected to grief.
verses.science: आनन्द प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यायतः प्रयच्छन्ति शृण्वन्त्युच्चारयन्ति च । विक्रीडन्ति च लोभेन कुज्ञाननियमेन च
verses.transliteration: anyāyataḥ prayacchanti śṛṇvantyuccārayanti ca | vikrīḍanti ca lobhena kujñānaniyamena ca
verses.translation: For those who regularly observe restraints and disciplined life but who err slightly due to oversight, the preceptor is the chastiser through expiatory rites and not Yama as explained by learned men.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमा, नक्षत्र एवं ग्रह प्रकाशित होते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: For those who regularly observe restraints and disciplined life but who err slightly due to oversight, the preceptor is the chastiser through expiatory rites and not Yama as explained by learned men.
verses.science: चन्द्रमा, नक्षत्र एवं ग्रह प्रकाशित होते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: असंस्कृतप्रदेशेषु यथेष्टं स्वापयन्ति च । शिवज्ञानकथाक्षेपं यः कृत्वान्यत्प्रभाषते
verses.transliteration: asaṃskṛtapradeśeṣu yatheṣṭaṃ svāpayanti ca | śivajñānakathākṣepaṃ yaḥ kṛtvānyatprabhāṣate
verses.translation: Hence one should perform expiatory rites for the commission of sins. If the sin is not consumed it will not perish even in hundreds of crores of Kalpas.
verses.hindi: तपसैव सुख ऐसा वेदवेत्ताओंने कहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one should perform expiatory rites for the commission of sins. If the sin is not consumed it will not perish even in hundreds of crores of Kalpas.
verses.science: तपसैव सुख ऐसा वेदवेत्ताओंने कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रवीति च यः सत्यं न प्रदानं करोति च । अशुचिर्वाऽशुचिस्थाने यः प्रवक्ति शृणोति च
verses.transliteration: na bravīti ca yaḥ satyaṃ na pradānaṃ karoti ca | aśucirvā'śucisthāne yaḥ pravakti śṛṇoti ca
verses.translation: As a result of the four kinds of sins, all living beings go to Yamaloka. They are helpless.
verses.hindi: सौभाग्य॑ चैव तपसा प्राप्यते सर्वदा सुखम्॥ ५१  सर्वदा तपस्यासे ही प्राप्त होते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of the four kinds of sins, all living beings go to Yamaloka. They are helpless.
verses.science: सौभाग्य॑ चैव तपसा प्राप्यते सर्वदा सुखम्॥ ५१ सर्वदा तपस्यासे ही प्राप्त होते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुपूजामकृत्वैव यः शास्त्रं श्रोतुमिच्छति । न करोति च शुश्रूषामाज्ञां च भक्तिभावतः
verses.transliteration: gurupūjāmakṛtvaiva yaḥ śāstraṃ śrotumicchati | na karoti ca śuśrūṣāmājñāṃ ca bhaktibhāvataḥ
verses.translation: It shall be known to all living beings whether in the womb, in the process of birth, as children, <outh or middling whether women, man or a eunuch.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be known to all living beings whether in the womb, in the process of birth, as children, <outh or middling whether women, man or a eunuch.
verses.science: बात त्रैलोक्यमें प्रसिद्ध है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाभिनन्दति तद्वाक्यमुत्तरं च प्रयच्छति । गुरुकर्मण्यसाध्यं यत्तदुपेक्षां करोति च
verses.transliteration: nābhinandati tadvākyamuttaraṃ ca prayacchati | gurukarmaṇyasādhyaṃ yattadupekṣāṃ karoti ca
verses.translation: Here the result of the auspicious and the inaus¬ picious actions of all embodied beings is being considered by Gitragupta Vasistha and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here the result of the auspicious and the inaus¬ picious actions of all embodied beings is being considered by Gitragupta Vasistha and others.
verses.science: श्रण्वध्ययनमाहात्म्य॑ तपसो5धिकमुत्तमम्॥ ५४ अध्ययनकी महिमाको सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुमार्तमशक्तं च विदेशं प्रस्थितं तथा । वैरिभिः परिभूतं वा यः सन्त्यजति पापकृत्
verses.transliteration: gurumārtamaśaktaṃ ca videśaṃ prasthitaṃ tathā | vairibhiḥ paribhūtaṃ vā yaḥ santyajati pāpakṛt
verses.translation: Men who have performed auspicious rites who are of gentle minds, endowed with the quality of compassion, go to Yama's abode through the gentle entrance at the East.
verses.hindi: माहमत््यवर्णण नामक बारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who have performed auspicious rites who are of gentle minds, endowed with the quality of compassion, go to Yama's abode through the gentle entrance at the East.
verses.science: माहमत््यवर्णण नामक बारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्भार्यापुत्रमित्रेषु यश्चावज्ञां करोति च । एवं सुवाचकस्यापि गुरोर्धर्मानुदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: tadbhāryāputramitreṣu yaścāvajñāṃ karoti ca | evaṃ suvācakasyāpi gurordharmānudarśinaḥ
verses.translation: Sinners, habitually performing sinful actions and devoid of charitable nature, pass through the terrible path and enter Yama's abode by the southern gate.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sinners, habitually performing sinful actions and devoid of charitable nature, pass through the terrible path and enter Yama's abode by the southern gate.
verses.science: दोनोंका समान फल होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतानि खलु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिसत्तम । सुमहत्पातकान्याहुः शिवनिन्दासमानि च
verses.transliteration: etāni khalu sarvāṇi karmāṇi munisattama | sumahatpātakānyāhuḥ śivanindāsamāni ca
verses.translation: It must be known that the multiformed city of Yama'-*®® is situated at a distance of eightysix thousand Yojanas from the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: It must be known that the multiformed city of Yama'-*®® is situated at a distance of eightysix thousand Yojanas from the Earth.
verses.science: सदा पुराणका अध्ययन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः । महापातकिनस्त्वेते तत्संयोगी च पञ्चमः
verses.transliteration: brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ | mahāpātakinastvete tatsaṃyogī ca pañcamaḥ
verses.translation: To men of auspicious deeds it appears to be very near, but to the sinners who go along the terrible path it is situated far off.
verses.hindi: पतनातू त्रायते यस्मात् तस्मात्पात्रमुदाहतम्॥ ५  उसे पात्र कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: To men of auspicious deeds it appears to be very near, but to the sinners who go along the terrible path it is situated far off.
verses.science: पतनातू त्रायते यस्मात् तस्मात्पात्रमुदाहतम्॥ ५ उसे पात्र कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधाल्लोभाद्भयाद् द्वेषाद्ब्राह्मणस्य वधे तु यः । मर्मान्तिकं महादोषमुक्त्वा स ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: krodhāllobhādbhayād dveṣādbrāhmaṇasya vadhe tu yaḥ | marmāntikaṃ mahādoṣamuktvā sa brahmahā bhavet
verses.translation: Somewhere the cross-roads are full of sharp iron pieces, elsewhere there is a forest-fire; in other places these are hot rocks; in some places snow spreads over it.
verses.hindi: तथा अश्वमेधयज्ञके फलको प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Somewhere the cross-roads are full of sharp iron pieces, elsewhere there is a forest-fire; in other places these are hot rocks; in some places snow spreads over it.
verses.science: तथा अश्वमेधयज्ञके फलको प्राप्त करता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणं यः समाहूय दत्त्वा यश्चाददाति च । निर्दोषं दूषयेद्यस्तु स नरो ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaṃ yaḥ samāhūya dattvā yaścādadāti ca | nirdoṣaṃ dūṣayedyastu sa naro brahmahā bhavet
verses.translation: Some places are full of fine sand where the persons sink up to the neck; elsewhere it is full of stinking muddy water and some places arc covered with burning balls of dry cowdung.
verses.hindi: आगे आनेवाली दस पीढ़ियोंका उद्धार कर देता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Some places are full of fine sand where the persons sink up to the neck; elsewhere it is full of stinking muddy water and some places arc covered with burning balls of dry cowdung.
verses.science: आगे आनेवाली दस पीढ़ियोंका उद्धार कर देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्च विद्याभिमानेन निस्तेजयति सुद्विजम् । उदासीनं सभामध्ये ब्रह्महा स प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: yaśca vidyābhimānena nistejayati sudvijam | udāsīnaṃ sabhāmadhye brahmahā sa prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: Different places are infested with different terrible beasts of prey such as lions, wolves, tigers and huge pythons or terrible mosquitoes or huge leeches.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different places are infested with different terrible beasts of prey such as lions, wolves, tigers and huge pythons or terrible mosquitoes or huge leeches.
verses.science: पुराण-ग्रन्थके वाचनसे होते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मिथ्यागुणैर्य आत्मानं नयत्युत्कर्षतां बलात् । गुणानपि निरुद्वास्य स च वै ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mithyāguṇairya ātmānaṃ nayatyutkarṣatāṃ balāt | guṇānapi nirudvāsya sa ca vai brahmahā bhavet
verses.translation: Terrible flies, extremely poisonous serpents, herds of elephants in rut mad and mighty, crushing everything under their feet infest the paths.
verses.commentary: Sense: Terrible flies, extremely poisonous serpents, herds of elephants in rut mad and mighty, crushing everything under their feet infest the paths.
verses.science: भेदनकर ब्रह्मलोकको जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गवां वृषाभिभूतानां द्विजानां गुरुपूर्वकम् । यः समाचरते विघ्नं तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम्
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ vṛṣābhibhūtānāṃ dvijānāṃ gurupūrvakam | yaḥ samācarate vighnaṃ tamāhurbrahmaghātakam
verses.translation: The persons who go that way are tortured and hara.ssed by big boars digging and butting against the path with their sharp fangs, buffaloes with sharp horns, all sorts of beasts of prey, terrible evil spirits like Dakinis, horrible Raksasas and pernicious diseases.
verses.hindi: भोग करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: The persons who go that way are tortured and hara.ssed by big boars digging and butting against the path with their sharp fangs, buffaloes with sharp horns, all sorts of beasts of prey, terrible evil spirits like Dakinis, horrible Raksasas and pernicious diseases.
verses.science: भोग करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजगवां भूमिं प्रदत्तां हरते तु यः । प्रनष्टामपि कालेन तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम्
verses.transliteration: devadvijagavāṃ bhūmiṃ pradattāṃ harate tu yaḥ | pranaṣṭāmapi kālena tamāhurbrahmaghātakam
verses.translation: They are without any shelter when fierce gusts of wind raising huge columns of dust blow sharply against them or showers of massive stones smother them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are without any shelter when fierce gusts of wind raising huge columns of dust blow sharply against them or showers of massive stones smother them.
verses.science: प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजस्वहरणमन्यायेनार्जितं तु यत् । ब्रह्महत्यासमं ज्ञेयं पातकं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: devadvijasvaharaṇamanyāyenārjitaṃ tu yat | brahmahatyāsamaṃ jñeyaṃ pātakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: They are scorched and burnt by the showers of burning coal, the falling terrible thunderbolts and meteors.
verses.hindi: कथां पौराणिकों शैवीं भक्त्या श्रृण्वन्तु ते सदा ॥ २५  कथा सुननी चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: They are scorched and burnt by the showers of burning coal, the falling terrible thunderbolts and meteors.
verses.science: कथां पौराणिकों शैवीं भक्त्या श्रृण्वन्तु ते सदा ॥ २५ कथा सुननी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधीत्य यो द्विजो वेदं ब्रह्मज्ञानं शिवात्मकम् । यदि त्यजति यो मूढः सुरापानस्य तत्समम्
verses.transliteration: adhītya yo dvijo vedaṃ brahmajñānaṃ śivātmakam | yadi tyajati yo mūḍhaḥ surāpānasya tatsamam
verses.translation: They cry when heavy showers of dust envelop them. They tremble with fear ever and anon at the terrible rumbling sounds of massive clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They cry when heavy showers of dust envelop them. They tremble with fear ever and anon at the terrible rumbling sounds of massive clouds.
verses.science: ही शिवकी कथाका श्रवण करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिद्धि व्रतं गृह्य नियमं यजनं तथा । सन्त्यागः पञ्चयज्ञानां सुरापानस्य तत्समम्
verses.transliteration: yatkiñciddhi vrataṃ gṛhya niyamaṃ yajanaṃ tathā | santyāgaḥ pañcayajñānāṃ surāpānasya tatsamam
verses.translation: They are split by the shower of sharp weapons and drenched with acid-currents as they go on.
verses.hindi: सुनते हैं, उनकी दुर्गति नहीं होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: They are split by the shower of sharp weapons and drenched with acid-currents as they go on.
verses.science: सुनते हैं, उनकी दुर्गति नहीं होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पितृमातृपरित्यागः कूटसाक्ष्यं द्विजानृतम् । आमिषं शिवभक्तानामभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛmātṛparityāgaḥ kūṭasākṣyaṃ dvijānṛtam | āmiṣaṃ śivabhaktānāmabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇam
verses.translation: They shrink and wither when oppressed by the rough and chill wind all round.
verses.hindi: मनोरम फल है, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: They shrink and wither when oppressed by the rough and chill wind all round.
verses.science: मनोरम फल है, इसमें संशय नहीं है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वने निरपराधानां प्राणिनां चापघातनम् । द्विजार्थं प्रक्षिपेत्साधुर्न धर्मार्थं नियोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: vane niraparādhānāṃ prāṇināṃ cāpaghātanam | dvijārthaṃ prakṣipetsādhurna dharmārthaṃ niyojayet
verses.translation: All those foolish persons who habitually sin are led through such paths by the terrible emissaries of Yam \ forcefully, in canying out his behests.—the paths that are terrible, devoid of feeding, devoid of basic support, im-
verses.commentary: Sense: All those foolish persons who habitually sin are led through such paths by the terrible emissaries of Yam \ forcefully, in canying out his behests.—the paths that are terrible, devoid of feeding, devoid of basic support, im-
verses.science: अजर-अमर हो जाता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: गवां मार्गे वने ग्रामे यैश्चैवाग्निः प्रदीयते । इति पापानि घोराणि ब्रह्महत्यासमानि च
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ mārge vane grāme yaiścaivāgniḥ pradīyate | iti pāpāni ghorāṇi brahmahatyāsamāni ca
verses.translation: They are lonely, devoid of friends and relatives. They are dependent on others. They bewail their evil actions. They cry again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are lonely, devoid of friends and relatives. They are dependent on others. They bewail their evil actions. They cry again and again.
verses.science: और पुराण-शास्त्रका श्रवण करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दीनसर्वस्वहरणं नरस्त्रीगजवाजिनाम् । गोभूरजतवस्त्राणामौषधीनां रसस्य च
verses.transliteration: dīnasarvasvaharaṇaṃ narastrīgajavājinām | gobhūrajatavastrāṇāmauṣadhīnāṃ rasasya ca
verses.translation: They have by this time become ghosts. They have no cloth on. Their throats, lips and palates are parched. They are frightened of terror. They are hungry and feel a burning sensation all over.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have by this time become ghosts. They have no cloth on. Their throats, lips and palates are parched. They are frightened of terror. They are hungry and feel a burning sensation all over.
verses.science: लिये प्रयत्वपूर्वक पुराणोंको सुनना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनागरुकर्पूरकस्तूरीपट्टवाससाम् । विक्रयस्त्वविपत्तौ यः कृतो ज्ञानाद् द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: candanāgarukarpūrakastūrīpaṭṭavāsasām | vikrayastvavipattau yaḥ kṛto jñānād dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Some are bound with fetters and forced to keep their legs lifted up. They are dragged again and again by the extraordinarily powerful emissaries of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are bound with fetters and forced to keep their legs lifted up. They are dragged again and again by the extraordinarily powerful emissaries of Yama.
verses.science: इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तन्यासापहरणं रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् । कन्यानां वरयोग्यानामदानं सदृशे वरे
verses.transliteration: hastanyāsāpaharaṇaṃ rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtam | kanyānāṃ varayogyānāmadānaṃ sadṛśe vare
verses.translation: Others with downcast faces are against the chest. They are distressed. They are dragged with a rope fastened to their tresses.
verses.hindi: सूर्गण हीना इब जीवलोका:॥ ४२  सूर्यके बिना जीवलोक आलोकयुक्त नहीं होता
verses.commentary: Sense: Others with downcast faces are against the chest. They are distressed. They are dragged with a rope fastened to their tresses.
verses.science: सूर्गण हीना इब जीवलोका:॥ ४२ सूर्यके बिना जीवलोक आलोकयुक्त नहीं होता। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रमित्रकलत्रेषु गमनं भगिनीषु च । कुमारीसाहसं घोरमद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम्
verses.transliteration: putramitrakalatreṣu gamanaṃ bhaginīṣu ca | kumārīsāhasaṃ ghoramadyapastrīniṣevaṇam
verses.translation: Men in supine position are dragged along the thorny path or that covered with burning coal, by means of a goad clutching at their foreheads.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पशञ्चम्यामुमासंहितायां पुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोदशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Men in supine position are dragged along the thorny path or that covered with burning coal, by means of a goad clutching at their foreheads.
verses.science: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पशञ्चम्यामुमासंहितायां पुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोदशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सवर्णायाश्च गमनं गुरुभार्यासमं स्मृतम् । महापापानि चोक्तानि शृणु त्वमुपपातकम्
verses.transliteration: savarṇāyāśca gamanaṃ gurubhāryāsamaṃ smṛtam | mahāpāpāni coktāni śṛṇu tvamupapātakam
verses.translation: A few others are dragged with a noose tied round their necks. They go ahead in distress. Others are dragged by ropes. Their tongues are pierced through by goads.
verses.hindi: सह + तारयन्ति च॥ ९ देना चाहिए, ये आत्माका उद्धार करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: A few others are dragged with a noose tied round their necks. They go ahead in distress. Others are dragged by ropes. Their tongues are pierced through by goads.
verses.science: सह + तारयन्ति च॥ ९ देना चाहिए, ये आत्माका उद्धार करते हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Yama tells them—"You are noble souls duly blessed, since you have performed what is ordained in the Vedas. Good deeds that are conducive to divine happiness have been performed by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama tells them—"You are noble souls duly blessed, since you have performed what is ordained in the Vedas. Good deeds that are conducive to divine happiness have been performed by you.
verses.science: असिपत्रवनको नहीं देखते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Yama tells them—"You are noble souls duly blessed, since you have performed what is ordained in the Vedas. Good deeds that are conducive to divine happiness have been performed by you.
verses.hindi: कृपणतासे रहित होकर दान करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama tells them—"You are noble souls duly blessed, since you have performed what is ordained in the Vedas. Good deeds that are conducive to divine happiness have been performed by you.
verses.science: कृपणतासे रहित होकर दान करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । पापभेदवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । द्विजद्रव्यापहरणमपि दायव्यतिक्रमः । अतिमानोऽतिकोपश्च दाम्भिकत्वं कृतघ्नता
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.6. ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | pāpabhedavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | dvijadravyāpaharaṇamapi dāyavyatikramaḥ | atimāno'tikopaśca dāmbhikatvaṃ kṛtaghnatā
verses.translation: Ascend the celestial aerial chariot and go to heaven to enjoy the pleasures in the company of celestial damsels and fulfil your cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascend the celestial aerial chariot and go to heaven to enjoy the pleasures in the company of celestial damsels and fulfil your cherished desires.
verses.science: नरकोंको नहीं देखता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तविषयासक्तिः कार्पण्यं साधुमत्सरम् । परदाराभिगमनं साधुकन्यासु दूषणम्
verses.transliteration: atyantaviṣayāsaktiḥ kārpaṇyaṃ sādhumatsaram | paradārābhigamanaṃ sādhukanyāsu dūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Similarly, the infuriated great lord Gitragupta, the knower of virtuousness, at the behest and instruction of Yamaraja imparts the following advice to the kings who proud of their might had committed many misdeeds and had been brought near him ultimately.
verses.hindi: दानानां तन्ममाख्याहि मानुषाणां हितार्थतः॥ 2९  मनुष्योंक हितके लिये उस दानको आप मुझसे कहें
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the infuriated great lord Gitragupta, the knower of virtuousness, at the behest and instruction of Yamaraja imparts the following advice to the kings who proud of their might had committed many misdeeds and had been brought near him ultimately.
verses.science: दानानां तन्ममाख्याहि मानुषाणां हितार्थतः॥ 2९ मनुष्योंक हितके लिये उस दानको आप मुझसे कहें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता यया च परिविद्यते । तयोर्दानं च कन्यायास्तयोरेव च याजनम्
verses.transliteration: parivittiḥ parivettā yayā ca parividyate | tayordānaṃ ca kanyāyāstayoreva ca yājanam
verses.translation: The next eight cells are Trikona, Paficakona, Sudirgha, Akhilartida, Sama, Bhimabala, Atyugra and the eighth Diptapraya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The next eight cells are Trikona, Paficakona, Sudirgha, Akhilartida, Sama, Bhimabala, Atyugra and the eighth Diptapraya.
verses.science: पातालके मूल स्थानमें स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रमतरूणां च पुष्पारामविनाशनम् । यः पीडामाश्रमस्थानामाचरेदल्पिकामपि
verses.transliteration: śivāśramatarūṇāṃ ca puṣpārāmavināśanam | yaḥ pīḍāmāśramasthānāmācaredalpikāmapi
verses.translation: Then they are again smeared with glowing acid more unbearable than fire.
verses.hindi: सदानृतं वर्देद्स्तु स नरो याति रौरवम्॥ ७  है
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they are again smeared with glowing acid more unbearable than fire.
verses.science: सदानृतं वर्देद्स्तु स नरो याति रौरवम्॥ ७ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सभृत्यपरिवारस्य पशुधान्यधनस्य च । कुप्यधान्यपशुस्तेयमपां व्यापावनं तथा
verses.transliteration: sabhṛtyaparivārasya paśudhānyadhanasya ca | kupyadhānyapaśusteyamapāṃ vyāpāvanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: In the terrible hell Asitalavana they arc cut into pieces. Their limbs are pierced through with needles. They are staked on to heated spearheads.
verses.hindi: चित्तमें पाप -का संक्रमण भी नहीं होता
verses.commentary: Sense: In the terrible hell Asitalavana they arc cut into pieces. Their limbs are pierced through with needles. They are staked on to heated spearheads.
verses.science: चित्तमें पाप -का संक्रमण भी नहीं होता। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञारामतडागानां दारापत्यस्य विक्रयम् । तीर्थयात्रोपवासानां व्रतोपनयकर्मिणाम्
verses.transliteration: yajñārāmataḍāgānāṃ dārāpatyasya vikrayam | tīrthayātropavāsānāṃ vratopanayakarmiṇām
verses.translation: They are tied tightly with ropes and arc rolled on rocks and harassed. They are cast into deep gloomy wells. They are subjected to bee-bites.
verses.hindi: समुद्र हैं, इन सभीके मध्यमें जम्बूद्वीप स्थित है
verses.commentary: Sense: They are tied tightly with ropes and arc rolled on rocks and harassed. They are cast into deep gloomy wells. They are subjected to bee-bites.
verses.science: समुद्र हैं, इन सभीके मध्यमें जम्बूद्वीप स्थित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीधनान्युपजीवन्ति स्त्रीभिरत्यन्तनिर्जिताः । अरक्षणं च नारीणां मायया स्त्रीनिषेवणम्
verses.transliteration: strīdhanānyupajīvanti strībhiratyantanirjitāḥ | arakṣaṇaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ māyayā strīniṣevaṇam
verses.translation: When their bodies are cut, bitten and gnawed by worms in a hundred places, they are hurled into wells of pun¬ gent acid.
verses.commentary: Sense: When their bodies are cut, bitten and gnawed by worms in a hundred places, they are hurled into wells of pun¬ gent acid.
verses.science: ऊँचाईमें सुमेरुपर्वतसे मिले हुए हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालागताप्रदानं च धान्यवृद्ध्युपसेवनम् । निन्दिताच्च धनादानं पण्यानां कूटजीवनम्
verses.transliteration: kālāgatāpradānaṃ ca dhānyavṛddhyupasevanam | ninditācca dhanādānaṃ paṇyānāṃ kūṭajīvanam
verses.translation: In the blazing hell the distressed sinners, shriek and run about here and there scorched by its flames.
verses.hindi: और उत्तरमें सुपाश््व नामक पर्वत स्थित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: In the blazing hell the distressed sinners, shriek and run about here and there scorched by its flames.
verses.science: और उत्तरमें सुपाश््व नामक पर्वत स्थित हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: विषमारणमन्त्राणां सततं वृषवाहनम् । उच्चाटनाभिचारं च धान्यादानं भिषक्क्रिया
verses.transliteration: viṣamāraṇamantrāṇāṃ satataṃ vṛṣavāhanam | uccāṭanābhicāraṃ ca dhānyādānaṃ bhiṣakkriyā
verses.translation: People are clubbed and tied together with mouths resting on shoulders and hands brought through the hollow and tied with nooses and ropes to the back. Such bundles of bodies are seen in the Mahajvala undergoing tortures.
verses.commentary: Sense: People are clubbed and tied together with mouths resting on shoulders and hands brought through the hollow and tied with nooses and ropes to the back. Such bundles of bodies are seen in the Mahajvala undergoing tortures.
verses.science: ओर फैल जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वाकामोपभोगार्थं यस्यारम्भः सुकर्मसु । मूलेनाध्यापको नित्यं वेदज्ञानादिकं च यत्
verses.transliteration: jihvākāmopabhogārthaṃ yasyārambhaḥ sukarmasu | mūlenādhyāpako nityaṃ vedajñānādikaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: After enjoying pleasures there, in the end when the merit is exhausted return to this place for reaping the fruit of what little evil you may have committed."
verses.hindi: उसके समान नहीं बताया गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying pleasures there, in the end when the merit is exhausted return to this place for reaping the fruit of what little evil you may have committed."
verses.science: उसके समान नहीं बताया गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्म्यादिव्रतसन्त्यागश्चान्याचारनिषेवणम् । असच्छास्त्राधिगमनं शुष्कतर्कावलम्बनम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmyādivratasantyāgaścānyācāraniṣevaṇam | asacchāstrādhigamanaṃ śuṣkatarkāvalambanam
verses.translation: Men who have been virtuous are treated as friends by Yama. They see Yama with a gentle face,
verses.hindi: बनकर उस दाताके पास उपस्थित होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who have been virtuous are treated as friends by Yama. They see Yama with a gentle face,
verses.science: बनकर उस दाताके पास उपस्थित होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाग्निगुरुसाधूनां निन्दा या ब्राह्मणस्य च । प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा राज्ञां मण्डलिनामपि
verses.transliteration: devāgnigurusādhūnāṃ nindā yā brāhmaṇasya ca | pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā rājñāṃ maṇḍalināmapi
verses.translation: Men who have been guilty of cruelties sec him in a terrible form. His face is terrible with curved fangs. His eyes are cruel with knit eyebrows. The hair on his head stand lifted up. He has a big moustache. His lips arc pouted and they throb. He has eighteen hands* He is furious. He resembles black collyrium. His uplifted hands hold all w'capons. He threatens with punishment. He is seated on a great buffalo. His eyes resemble blazing fire. He wears red garlands and garments. He is as tali as
verses.wordMeaning: Men who have been guilty of cruelties sec him in a terrible form. His face is terrible with curved fangs. His eyes are cruel with knit eyebrows. The hair on his head stand lifted up. He has a big moustache. His lips arc pouted and they throb.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who have been guilty of cruelties sec him in a terrible form. His face is terrible with curved fangs. His eyes are cruel with knit eyebrows. The hair on his head stand lifted up. He has a big moustache. His lips arc pouted and they throb.…
verses.science: तरहके पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्सन्नपितृदेवेज्याः स्वकर्मत्यागिनश्च ये । दुःशीला नास्तिकाः पापाः सदा वासत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: utsannapitṛdevejyāḥ svakarmatyāginaśca ye | duḥśīlā nāstikāḥ pāpāḥ sadā vāsatyavādinaḥ
verses.translation: He appears ready to swallow even great mountains. He appears to vomit fire. Very near him is Mftyu, whose lustre is like that of black fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He appears ready to swallow even great mountains. He appears to vomit fire. Very near him is Mftyu, whose lustre is like that of black fire.
verses.science: निस्सन्देह स्वर्गको जाता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पर्वकाले दिवा वाप्सु वियोनौ पशुयोनिषु । रजस्वलाया योनौ च मैथुनं यः समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: parvakāle divā vāpsu viyonau paśuyoniṣu | rajasvalāyā yonau ca maithunaṃ yaḥ samācaret
verses.translation: AH of them are heroic and terrible. They have curved snouts. They bear shafts, quivers and bows and weapons of various sorts.
verses.commentary: Sense: AH of them are heroic and terrible. They have curved snouts. They bear shafts, quivers and bows and weapons of various sorts.
verses.science: नष्ट कर देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुत्रमित्रसम्प्राप्ते आशाच्छेदकराश्च ये । जनस्याप्रियवक्तारः क्रूराः समयभेदिनः
verses.transliteration: strīputramitrasamprāpte āśācchedakarāśca ye | janasyāpriyavaktāraḥ krūrāḥ samayabhedinaḥ
verses.translation: The attendants of Yama are innumerable. They arc great heroes. They have complexions like the black collyrium. They appear terrifying with weapons lifted up.
verses.hindi: कृताकृतं॑ यत्सुकृतं समेतु॥ ३०  पुण्यरूप हो जाय
verses.commentary: Sense: The attendants of Yama are innumerable. They arc great heroes. They have complexions like the black collyrium. They appear terrifying with weapons lifted up.
verses.science: कृताकृतं॑ यत्सुकृतं समेतु॥ ३० पुण्यरूप हो जाय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भेत्ता तडागकूपानां विक्रतारो रसस्य च । एकपङ्क्तिस्थितानां च पाकभेदं करोति यः
verses.transliteration: bhettā taḍāgakūpānāṃ vikratāro rasasya ca | ekapaṅktisthitānāṃ ca pākabhedaṃ karoti yaḥ
verses.translation: The sinners see Yama terrific to behold, surround¬ ed by his attendants and they see Citragupta too equally terrible.
verses.hindi: प्रदान न करे, ऐसा करनेसे उद्धार नहीं होता
verses.commentary: Sense: The sinners see Yama terrific to behold, surround¬ ed by his attendants and they see Citragupta too equally terrible.
verses.science: प्रदान न करे, ऐसा करनेसे उद्धार नहीं होता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतैः स्त्रीनराः पापैरुपपातकिनः स्मृताः । युक्ता एभिस्तथान्येऽपि शृणु तांस्तु ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: ityetaiḥ strīnarāḥ pāpairupapātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ | yuktā ebhistathānye'pi śṛṇu tāṃstu bravīmi te
verses.translation: Yama rebukes and reproaches the sinners. Lord Citragupta enlightens them with statements on virtue.
verses.hindi: हत्वा पापं दिवं तिष्ठेद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दशश ॥ ३२  कालतक स्वर्गलोकमें वास करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama rebukes and reproaches the sinners. Lord Citragupta enlightens them with statements on virtue.
verses.science: हत्वा पापं दिवं तिष्ठेद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दशश ॥ ३२ कालतक स्वर्गलोकमें वास करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये गोब्राह्मणकन्यानां स्वामिमित्रतपस्विनाम् । विनाशयन्ति कार्याणि ते नरा नारकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ye gobrāhmaṇakanyānāṃ svāmimitratapasvinām | vināśayanti kāryāṇi te narā nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O ye sinners, of evil actions, stealers of other man's riches, outragers of the modesty of other's wives, arrogant by your comeliness and might, why was sin
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्ञम्यागुमासंहितायां सामान्यदानवर्णन॑ नाम चरर्दशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye sinners, of evil actions, stealers of other man's riches, outragers of the modesty of other's wives, arrogant by your comeliness and might, why was sin
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्ञम्यागुमासंहितायां सामान्यदानवर्णन॑ नाम चरर्दशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रियाभितप्यन्ते ये परद्रव्यसूचकाः । परद्रव्यहरा नित्यं तौलमिथ्यानुसारकाः
verses.transliteration: parastriyābhitapyante ye paradravyasūcakāḥ | paradravyaharā nityaṃ taulamithyānusārakāḥ
verses.translation: Why do you lament now? You are being tortured by your own actions. Reap the fruits thereof. This is not the fault of anyone else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why do you lament now? You are being tortured by your own actions. Reap the fruits thereof. This is not the fault of anyone else.
verses.science: नामक चोदहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजदुःखकरा ये च प्रहारं चोद्धरन्ति ये । सेवन्ते तु द्विजाः शूद्रां सुरां बध्नन्ति कामतः
verses.transliteration: dvijaduḥkhakarā ye ca prahāraṃ coddharanti ye | sevante tu dvijāḥ śūdrāṃ surāṃ badhnanti kāmataḥ
verses.translation: O ye wicked kings, who had tyrannised over and repressed your subjects, why were misdeeds committed for your rule of a very short duration?
verses.hindi: एकस्मादपि सर्वेषां दानानां तद्ददामि ते॥ २  लेता है, उसे मैं आपसे कहता हूँ, आप सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye wicked kings, who had tyrannised over and repressed your subjects, why were misdeeds committed for your rule of a very short duration?
verses.science: एकस्मादपि सर्वेषां दानानां तद्ददामि ते॥ २ लेता है, उसे मैं आपसे कहता हूँ, आप सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये पापनिरताः क्रूराः येऽपि हिंसाप्रिया नराः । वृत्त्यर्थं येऽपि कुर्वन्ति दानयज्ञादिकाः क्रियाः
verses.transliteration: ye pāpaniratāḥ krūrāḥ ye'pi hiṃsāpriyā narāḥ | vṛttyarthaṃ ye'pi kurvanti dānayajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ
verses.translation: O kings, let the fruits be reaped now (of the evil actions) in having punished your subjects unjusticiably due to vour fascination for kingly pleasures. You have misused your might.
verses.hindi: होनेके लिये यह दान अवश्य करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O kings, let the fruits be reaped now (of the evil actions) in having punished your subjects unjusticiably due to vour fascination for kingly pleasures. You have misused your might.
verses.science: होनेके लिये यह दान अवश्य करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोष्ठाग्निजलरथ्यासु तरुच्छायानगेषु च । त्यजन्ति ये पुरीषाद्यानारामायतनेषु च
verses.transliteration: goṣṭhāgnijalarathyāsu tarucchāyānageṣu ca | tyajanti ye purīṣādyānārāmāyataneṣu ca
verses.translation: I see that might quelled, the might that suppressed the subjects. How will you fare when you too are subjected to the same treatment by the emissaries of Yama?
verses.hindi: देवैमुंदे माधवम् ॥ विष्णुपदको प्राप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: I see that might quelled, the might that suppressed the subjects. How will you fare when you too are subjected to the same treatment by the emissaries of Yama?
verses.science: देवैमुंदे माधवम् ॥ विष्णुपदको प्राप्त करता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लज्जाश्रमप्रासादेषु मद्यपानरताश्च ये । कृतकेलिभुजङ्गाश्च रन्ध्रान्वेषणतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: lajjāśramaprāsādeṣu madyapānaratāśca ye | kṛtakelibhujaṅgāśca randhrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ
verses.translation: The kings who are treated with these and other similar taunts by Yama bewail their own lot and stand silent.
verses.hindi: इसे सुनकर व्यक्ति पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings who are treated with these and other similar taunts by Yama bewail their own lot and stand silent.
verses.science: इसे सुनकर व्यक्ति पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वंशेष्टकाशिलाकाष्ठैः शृङ्गैः शङ्कुभिरेव च । ये मार्गमनुरुन्धन्ति परसीमां हरन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: vaṃśeṣṭakāśilākāṣṭhaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ śaṅkubhireva ca | ye mārgamanurundhanti parasīmāṃ haranti ye
verses.translation: After having proclaimed their evil actions, Yama, Dharmaraja speaks to the messengers thus, for wiping off the sins of those kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: After having proclaimed their evil actions, Yama, Dharmaraja speaks to the messengers thus, for wiping off the sins of those kings.
verses.science: आप सावधान होकर सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कूटशासनकर्तारः कूटकर्मक्रियारताः । कूटपाकान्नवस्त्राणां कूटसंव्यवहारिणः
verses.transliteration: kūṭaśāsanakartāraḥ kūṭakarmakriyāratāḥ | kūṭapākānnavastrāṇāṃ kūṭasaṃvyavahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: O Canda, O Mnhacanda, seize these kings forci¬ bly and purify them giadu;»lly in the fires of hell.
verses.hindi: ऊँचाई क्रमश: एककी अपेक्षा दुगुनी है
verses.commentary: Sense: O Canda, O Mnhacanda, seize these kings forci¬ bly and purify them giadu;»lly in the fires of hell.
verses.science: ऊँचाई क्रमश: एककी अपेक्षा दुगुनी है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धनुषः शस्त्रशल्यानां कर्ता यः क्रयविक्रयी । निर्दयोऽतीव भृत्येषु पशूनां दमनश्च यः
verses.transliteration: dhanuṣaḥ śastraśalyānāṃ kartā yaḥ krayavikrayī | nirdayo'tīva bhṛtyeṣu paśūnāṃ damanaśca yaḥ
verses.translation: Then they immediately catch hold of |hc kings by their feet, whirl them with great velocity, throw them up and when they fall they catch them again and dash them against a heated rock. They are thus felled like great trees smitten with the thunderbolt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they immediately catch hold of |hc kings by their feet, whirl them with great velocity, throw them up and when they fall they catch them again and dash them against a heated rock. They are thus felled like great trees smitten with the thunderbolt.
verses.science: सम्पूर्ण जगत्को धारण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मिथ्या प्रवदतो वाच आकर्णयति यः शनैः । स्वामिमित्रगुरुद्रोही मायावी चपलः शठः
verses.transliteration: mithyā pravadato vāca ākarṇayati yaḥ śanaiḥ | svāmimitragurudrohī māyāvī capalaḥ śaṭhaḥ
verses.translation: Then the man sheds blood through his ears. He is wholly shattered. He becomes unconscious and motionless.
verses.hindi: सिद्ध, देवता तथा ऋषिगण उनकी पूजा करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the man sheds blood through his ears. He is wholly shattered. He becomes unconscious and motionless.
verses.science: सिद्ध, देवता तथा ऋषिगण उनकी पूजा करते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ये भार्यापुत्रमित्राणि बालवृद्धकृशातुरान् । भृत्यानतिथिबन्धूंश्च त्यक्त्वाश्नन्ति बुभुक्षितान्
verses.transliteration: ye bhāryāputramitrāṇi bālavṛddhakṛśāturān | bhṛtyānatithibandhūṃśca tyaktvāśnanti bubhukṣitān
verses.translation: At the end of the seventh nether-world Tala, there are twentyeight Narakakotis situated in terrible darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the seventh nether-world Tala, there are twentyeight Narakakotis situated in terrible darkness.
verses.science: एक कुण्डलको धारणकर शोभायमान हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वयं मिष्टमश्नाति विप्रेभ्यो न प्रयच्छति । वृथापाकः स विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हितः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ svayaṃ miṣṭamaśnāti viprebhyo na prayacchati | vṛthāpākaḥ sa vijñeyo brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ
verses.translation: The tenth beneath the previous is Cana. Mahacanta is lower still. Candakolahala is another. Pracanda, Gandanayika, Padma, Padmavatl, Bhita, Bhima, Bhlsana- nayika and Vajra arc terrible, very terrible.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tenth beneath the previous is Cana. Mahacanta is lower still. Candakolahala is another. Pracanda, Gandanayika, Padma, Padmavatl, Bhita, Bhima, Bhlsana- nayika and Vajra arc terrible, very terrible.
verses.science: आदरपूर्वक उनकी पूजा करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नियमान् स्वयमादाय ये त्यजन्त्यजितेन्द्रियाः । प्रव्रज्यावासिता ये च हरस्यास्यप्रभेदकाः
verses.transliteration: niyamān svayamādāya ye tyajantyajitendriyāḥ | pravrajyāvāsitā ye ca harasyāsyaprabhedakāḥ
verses.translation: For each of these cells there are five officers-in charge. Now I shall mention the names of the hells of each of these ceils. Understand them well.
verses.commentary: Sense: For each of these cells there are five officers-in charge. Now I shall mention the names of the hells of each of these ceils. Understand them well.
verses.science: उनके पराक्रमका वर्णन कौन करेगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये ताडयन्ति गां क्रूरा दमयन्ते मुहुर्मुहुः । दुर्बलान्ये न पुष्णन्ति सततं ये त्यजन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye tāḍayanti gāṃ krūrā damayante muhurmuhuḥ | durbalānye na puṣṇanti satataṃ ye tyajanti ca
verses.translation: There are cool and hot hells. The first five are the leading hells. The hells are named thus: Sughora $umah3tik:.fAa, Sahjivana, Mahatamas, Viloma, Vilopa
verses.commentary: Sense: There are cool and hot hells. The first five are the leading hells. The hells are named thus: Sughora $umah3tik:.fAa, Sahjivana, Mahatamas, Viloma, Vilopa
verses.science: उपजातियाँ निवास करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पीडयन्त्यतिभारेणासहन्तं वाहयन्ति च । योजयन्त्यकृताहारान्न विमुञ्चन्ति संयतान्
verses.transliteration: pīḍayantyatibhāreṇāsahantaṃ vāhayanti ca | yojayantyakṛtāhārānna vimuñcanti saṃyatān
verses.translation: Thus for twentyeight cells there are five officers in charge of each. Raurava and other hells are thus hundred and more. The great zones of hell are forty hundreds. Thus O Vyasa, I have described the hells to you. The enumeration arotincs detachment from the sin. Now listen to the pangs of sinners.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus for twentyeight cells there are five officers in charge of each. Raurava and other hells are thus hundred and more. The great zones of hell are forty hundreds. Thus O Vyasa, I have described the hells to you. The enumeration arotincs detachment from the sin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus for twentyeight cells there are five officers in charge of each. Raurava and other hells are thus hundred and more. The great zones of hell are forty hundreds. Thus O Vyasa, I have described the hells to you. The enumeration arotincs detachment from the sin.…
verses.science: स्वर्गसे भी अधिक रमणीय हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये भारक्षतरोगार्तान् गोवृषांश्च क्षुधातुरान् । न पालयन्ति यत्नेन गोघ्नास्ते नारकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ye bhārakṣatarogārtān govṛṣāṃśca kṣudhāturān | na pālayanti yatnena goghnāste nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: In the hellish hres, the sinners are roasted and dried up by diverse tortures till their action is exhausted completely.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the hellish hres, the sinners are roasted and dried up by diverse tortures till their action is exhausted completely.
verses.science: पातालके समान कौन लोक है !। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृषाणां वृषणान्ये च पापिष्ठा गालयन्ति च । वाहयन्ति च गां वन्ध्यां महानारकिनो नराः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣāṇāṃ vṛṣaṇānye ca pāpiṣṭhā gālayanti ca | vāhayanti ca gāṃ vandhyāṃ mahānārakino narāḥ
verses.translation: Just as metals are melted in fire to remove their impurities so also sinners are put in hells in order to remove their sins.
verses.hindi: रहता है, यहाँ केवल मणियोंके तेज विद्यमान हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as metals are melted in fire to remove their impurities so also sinners are put in hells in order to remove their sins.
verses.science: रहता है, यहाँ केवल मणियोंके तेज विद्यमान हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आशया समनुप्राप्तान् क्षुत्तृष्णाश्रमकर्शितान् । अतिथींश्च तथानाथान् स्वतन्त्रान् गृहमागतान्
verses.transliteration: āśayā samanuprāptān kṣuttṛṣṇāśramakarśitān | atithīṃśca tathānāthān svatantrān gṛhamāgatān
verses.translation: The hands are tightly tied and the men are battered. Then they are suspended from the branches of tall trees by the attendants ofYama.
verses.hindi: ४ समयका ज्ञान भी नहीं रहता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The hands are tightly tied and the men are battered. Then they are suspended from the branches of tall trees by the attendants ofYama.
verses.science: ४ समयका ज्ञान भी नहीं रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्नाभिलाषान् दीनान्वा बालवृद्धकृशातुरान् । नानुकम्पन्ति ये मूढास्ते यान्ति नरकार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: annābhilāṣān dīnānvā bālavṛddhakṛśāturān | nānukampanti ye mūḍhāste yānti narakārṇavam
verses.translation: Then they are pushed by the servants till they begin to oscillate a Yojana unconscious by their rapidity.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्चम्यामुगासंहितायां ब्रह्माण्डकथने पाताललोकवर्णनं॑ नाम पञ्चदशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they are pushed by the servants till they begin to oscillate a Yojana unconscious by their rapidity.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्चम्यामुगासंहितायां ब्रह्माण्डकथने पाताललोकवर्णनं॑ नाम पञ्चदशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहेष्वर्था निवर्तन्ते श्मशानादपि बान्धवाः । सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चैव गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: gṛheṣvarthā nivartante śmaśānādapi bāndhavāḥ | sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ caiva gacchantamanugacchati
verses.translation: Even as they are suspended in mid air, iron hundred Bharas in weight is tied to their feet by the emissaries of Yama.
verses.hindi: पाताललोकवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as they are suspended in mid air, iron hundred Bharas in weight is tied to their feet by the emissaries of Yama.
verses.science: पाताललोकवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अजाविको माहिषिकः सामुद्रो वृषलीपतिः । शूद्रवत्क्षत्रवृत्तिश्च नारकी स्याद् द्विजाधमः
verses.transliteration: ajāviko māhiṣikaḥ sāmudro vṛṣalīpatiḥ | śūdravatkṣatravṛttiśca nārakī syād dvijādhamaḥ
verses.translation: Afflicted by such a heavy weight the sinners begin to think about their evil actions and keep quiet and motion¬ less.
verses.hindi: मत्तो मुनिवरश्रेष्ठ पच्यन्ते यत्र पापिन:॥ ९  दु:ख भोगते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Afflicted by such a heavy weight the sinners begin to think about their evil actions and keep quiet and motion¬ less.
verses.science: मत्तो मुनिवरश्रेष्ठ पच्यन्ते यत्र पापिन:॥ ९ दु:ख भोगते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिल्पिनः कारवो वैद्या हेमकारा नृपध्वजाः । भृतकाः कूटसंयुक्ताः सर्वे ते नारकाः स्मृताः
