verses.transliteration: śilpinaḥ kāravo vaidyā hemakārā nṛpadhvajāḥ | bhṛtakāḥ kūṭasaṃyuktāḥ sarve te nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Then the sinners are beaten with goads of fiery colour and terrible iron rods by the terrible servants of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sinners are beaten with goads of fiery colour and terrible iron rods by the terrible servants of Yama.
verses.science: “नल आप सावधान होकर सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चोचितमतिक्रम्य स्वेच्छयैवाहरेत्करम् । नरके पच्यते सोऽपि योऽपि दण्डरुचिर्नरः
verses.transliteration: yaścocitamatikramya svecchayaivāharetkaram | narake pacyate so'pi yo'pi daṇḍarucirnaraḥ
verses.translation: Their limbs are cut and smothered, gradually torn and severed and smeared with molten metal. They are then roasted like brinjal in red-hot iron cauldrons. They are then cast into wells full of filth, swarms of worms or in tanks full of putrid fat and blood. They are eaten by worm and crows with beaks strong as iron.
verses.hindi: ता तप्तकुम्भ नामक नरकमें जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Their limbs are cut and smothered, gradually torn and severed and smeared with molten metal. They are then roasted like brinjal in red-hot iron cauldrons. They are then cast into wells full of filth, swarms of worms or in tanks full of putrid fat and blood.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their limbs are cut and smothered, gradually torn and severed and smeared with molten metal. They are then roasted like brinjal in red-hot iron cauldrons. They are then cast into wells full of filth, swarms of worms or in tanks full of putrid fat and blood.…
verses.science: ता तप्तकुम्भ नामक नरकमें जाता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्कोचकै रुचिक्रीतैस्तस्करैश्च प्रपीड्यते । यस्य राज्ञः प्रजा राष्ट्रे पच्यते नरकेषु सः
verses.transliteration: utkocakai rucikrītaistaskaraiśca prapīḍyate | yasya rājñaḥ prajā rāṣṭre pacyate narakeṣu saḥ
verses.translation: Dogs, mosquitoes, wolves and tigers of terrible and hideous faces too devour them. They are roasted like fish over glowing heaps of coal.
verses.hindi: तप्तलोह नामक नरकमें दुःख भोगते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Dogs, mosquitoes, wolves and tigers of terrible and hideous faces too devour them. They are roasted like fish over glowing heaps of coal.
verses.science: तप्तलोह नामक नरकमें दुःख भोगते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ये द्विजाः परिगृह्णन्ति नृपस्यान्यायवर्तिनः । ते प्रयान्ति तु घोरेषु नरकेषु न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye dvijāḥ parigṛhṇanti nṛpasyānyāyavartinaḥ | te prayānti tu ghoreṣu narakeṣu na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Due to their sinful actions men are pierced through with sharp spears. They are put in oil extracting machines called Cakra and crushed like gingelly seeds and beaten into pulp. They are fried in iron cauldrons red hot in the blazing sunlight.
verses.hindi: मूर्ख लालाभक्ष नामक नरकमें जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to their sinful actions men are pierced through with sharp spears. They are put in oil extracting machines called Cakra and crushed like gingelly seeds and beaten into pulp. They are fried in iron cauldrons red hot in the blazing sunlight.
verses.science: मूर्ख लालाभक्ष नामक नरकमें जाता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यायात्समुपादाय द्विजेभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति । प्रजाभ्यः पच्यते सोऽपि नरकेषु नृपो यथा
verses.transliteration: anyāyātsamupādāya dvijebhyo yaḥ prayacchati | prajābhyaḥ pacyate so'pi narakeṣu nṛpo yathā
verses.translation: They are fried in boiling oil in cauldrons again and again. Their tongues, chests and feet are struck in many ways.
verses.hindi: चलाते हैं, वे कृमि नामक नरकमें जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: They are fried in boiling oil in cauldrons again and again. Their tongues, chests and feet are struck in many ways.
verses.science: चलाते हैं, वे कृमि नामक नरकमें जाते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पारदारिकचौराणां चण्डानां विद्यते त्वघम् । परदाररतस्यापि राज्ञो भवति नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: pāradārikacaurāṇāṃ caṇḍānāṃ vidyate tvagham | paradāraratasyāpi rājño bhavati nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Here the tortures to the body are very severe. Men thus go from one hell to another and are tortured in all the hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here the tortures to the body are very severe. Men thus go from one hell to another and are tortured in all the hells.
verses.science: वहिज्वाल नामक नरकमें जाते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अचौरं चौरवत्पश्येच्चौरं वाचौररूपिणम् । अविचार्य नृपस्तस्माद् घातयन्नरकं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: acauraṃ cauravatpaśyeccauraṃ vācaurarūpiṇam | avicārya nṛpastasmād ghātayannarakaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: O vyasa, terrible tortures are inflicted in diverse ways in all the hells by Yama's emissaries. They are grievous and painful to every part of the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: O vyasa, terrible tortures are inflicted in diverse ways in all the hells by Yama's emissaries. They are grievous and painful to every part of the body.
verses.science: नामक नरकमें जाते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: घृततैलान्नपानानि मधुमांससुरासवम् । गुडेक्षुशाकदुग्धानि दधिमूलफलानि च
verses.transliteration: ghṛtatailānnapānāni madhumāṃsasurāsavam | guḍekṣuśākadugdhāni dadhimūlaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Their mouths are filled with the burning coals and again with acid red hot, copper hot clarified butter and oil and they are beaten afterwards.
verses.hindi: यातना भोगते हुए पड़े रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Their mouths are filled with the burning coals and again with acid red hot, copper hot clarified butter and oil and they are beaten afterwards.
verses.science: यातना भोगते हुए पड़े रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तृणं काष्ठं पत्रपुष्पमौषधं चात्मभोजनम् । उपानत्छत्रशकटमासनं च कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ patrapuṣpamauṣadhaṃ cātmabhojanam | upānatchatraśakaṭamāsanaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum
verses.translation: They are filled with faeces and worms and arc forced to embrace the red hot fierce iron-silk cotton tree.
verses.hindi: नीचेकी ओर मुख किये हुए देखते रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: They are filled with faeces and worms and arc forced to embrace the red hot fierce iron-silk cotton tree.
verses.science: नीचेकी ओर मुख किये हुए देखते रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ताम्रसीसत्रपुः शस्त्रं शङ्खाद्यं च जलोद्भवम् । वाद्यं च वैणवं चान्यद्गृहोपस्करणानि च
verses.transliteration: tāmrasīsatrapuḥ śastraṃ śaṅkhādyaṃ ca jalodbhavam | vādyaṃ ca vaiṇavaṃ cānyadgṛhopaskaraṇāni ca
verses.translation: They are then beaten on the back with heated hammer. Their heads and their limbs are crushed with too blunt tooth-edged strong scissors. They are thus tortured by their own actions. Their flesh is eaten and their blood is drunk by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are then beaten on the back with heated hammer. Their heads and their limbs are crushed with too blunt tooth-edged strong scissors. They are thus tortured by their own actions. Their flesh is eaten and their blood is drunk by them.
verses.science: नामस्मरणरूप प्रायश्चित्त सबसे श्रेष्ठ है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: और्ण्णकार्पासकौशेयपट्टसूत्रोद्भवानि च । स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि वस्त्राणि ये लोभाद्धि हरन्ति च
verses.transliteration: aurṇṇakārpāsakauśeyapaṭṭasūtrodbhavāni ca | sthūlasūkṣmāṇi vastrāṇi ye lobhāddhi haranti ca
verses.translation: Those who fed and nurtured only themselves and never made any gift of food or drink are crushed with iron rods like sugarcane.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who fed and nurtured only themselves and never made any gift of food or drink are crushed with iron rods like sugarcane.
verses.science: स्मरण ही सर्वोत्तम प्रायश्चित्त है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि चान्यानि द्रव्याणि विविधानि च । नरकेषु ध्रुवं यान्ति चापहृत्याल्पकानि च
verses.transliteration: evamādīni cānyāni dravyāṇi vividhāni ca | narakeṣu dhruvaṃ yānti cāpahṛtyālpakāni ca
verses.translation: Tossed about many times their bodies do not perish but are severely pained. They become u.sed to bear the pleasure or pain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tossed about many times their bodies do not perish but are severely pained. They become u.sed to bear the pleasure or pain.
verses.science: नरकमें नहीं पड़ता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वा यद्वा परद्रव्यमपि सर्षपमात्रकम् । अपहृत्य नरा यान्ति नरकं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tadvā yadvā paradravyamapi sarṣapamātrakam | apahṛtya narā yānti narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In the hell Nirucchvasa they are forced to stand without breathing, for a long time. In the hell Ucchvasa they are hit and thrashed in a house of sand.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग सुख तथा समृद्धिके लिये होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: In the hell Nirucchvasa they are forced to stand without breathing, for a long time. In the hell Ucchvasa they are hit and thrashed in a house of sand.
verses.science: स्वर्ग सुख तथा समृद्धिके लिये होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमाद्यैर्नरः पापैरुत्क्रान्तिसमनन्तरम् । शरीरयातनार्थाय सर्वाकारमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: evamādyairnaraḥ pāpairutkrāntisamanantaram | śarīrayātanārthāya sarvākāramavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: In the hell Raurava they arc made to cry and inflicted pain by various tortures. Due to the tortures in the hell, Maharaurava, even great men cry.
verses.hindi: न दुःख देनेवाली है और न सुख देनेवाली
verses.commentary: Sense: In the hell Raurava they arc made to cry and inflicted pain by various tortures. Due to the tortures in the hell, Maharaurava, even great men cry.
verses.science: न दुःख देनेवाली है और न सुख देनेवाली। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यमलोकं व्रजन्त्येते शरीरेण यमाज्ञया । यमदूतैर्महाघोरैर्नीयमानाः सुदुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: yamalokaṃ vrajantyete śarīreṇa yamājñayā | yamadūtairmahāghorairnīyamānāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ
verses.translation: They arc beaten on the faces, feet anus, skull,
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc beaten on the faces, feet anus, skull,
verses.science: ही तत्त्वका बोध कराता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्याणामधर्मनिरतात्मनाम् । धर्मराजः स्मृतः शास्ता सुघोरैर्विविधैर्वधैः
verses.transliteration: devatiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāmadharmaniratātmanām | dharmarājaḥ smṛtaḥ śāstā sughorairvividhairvadhaiḥ
verses.translation: They are again and again rolled on hot sand. Cast into boiling marsh of creatures they make harsh shrie¬ king sounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are again and again rolled on hot sand. Cast into boiling marsh of creatures they make harsh shrie¬ king sounds.
verses.science: पदार्थ नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नियमाचारयुक्तानां प्रमादात्स्खलितात्मनाम् । प्रायश्चित्तैर्गुरुः शास्ता न बुधैरिष्यते यमः
verses.transliteration: niyamācārayuktānāṃ pramādātskhalitātmanām | prāyaścittairguruḥ śāstā na budhairiṣyate yamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, in the hell kumbhipaka sinners of ruthless misdeeds are fried in unbearable boiling oil.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे पश्मम्याग॒मासंहितायां ब्रह्माण्डवर्णने नरकोद्वारवर्ण॑ नाम ब्रोडशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, in the hell kumbhipaka sinners of ruthless misdeeds are fried in unbearable boiling oil.
verses.science: जति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे पश्मम्याग॒मासंहितायां ब्रह्माण्डवर्णने नरकोद्वारवर्ण॑ नाम ब्रोडशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पारदारिकचौराणामन्यायव्यवहारिणाम् । नृपतिः शासकः प्रोक्तः प्रच्छन्नानां स धर्म्मराट्
verses.transliteration: pāradārikacaurāṇāmanyāyavyavahāriṇām | nṛpatiḥ śāsakaḥ proktaḥ pracchannānāṃ sa dharmmarāṭ
verses.translation: The sinners are felled and dragged along various torturing places again and again in the hell named Lalabhaka.
verses.hindi: वरकोद्धारवर्णन नामक स्रोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The sinners are felled and dragged along various torturing places again and again in the hell named Lalabhaka.
verses.science: वरकोद्धारवर्णन नामक स्रोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् कृतस्य पापस्य प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् । नाभुक्तस्यान्यथा नाशः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: tasmāt kṛtasya pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret | nābhuktasyānyathā nāśaḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: Sinners devoid of merit are beaten by Yama*s servants. They are hurled into the torturous hell Sucimukha.
verses.hindi: मण्डलं च भुवः सम्यक् सप्तद्वीपादिसंयुतम्॥ ९  वर्णन करते हुए मुझसे भलीभाँति सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Sinners devoid of merit are beaten by Yama*s servants. They are hurled into the torturous hell Sucimukha.
verses.science: मण्डलं च भुवः सम्यक् सप्तद्वीपादिसंयुतम्॥ ९ वर्णन करते हुए मुझसे भलीभाँति सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः करोति स्वयं कर्म कारयेच्चानुमोदयेत् । कायेन मनसा वाचा तस्य पापगतिः फलम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ karoti svayaṃ karma kārayeccānumodayet | kāyena manasā vācā tasya pāpagatiḥ phalam
verses.translation: They are put into iron pots. They breathe hard and slow. They are scorched by great fire, as if by their own sins.
verses.hindi: है-ये सभी द्वीप सात समुद्रोंसे घिरे हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: They are put into iron pots. They breathe hard and slow. They are scorched by great fire, as if by their own sins.
verses.science: है-ये सभी द्वीप सात समुद्रोंसे घिरे हुए हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Dragged and rolled through rough and coarse rocks, beaten and burnt like straw, the sinners of ruthless conduct, are tortured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dragged and rolled through rough and coarse rocks, beaten and burnt like straw, the sinners of ruthless conduct, are tortured.
verses.science: ननन्‍्दनवन बताया गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Dragged and rolled through rough and coarse rocks, beaten and burnt like straw, the sinners of ruthless conduct, are tortured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dragged and rolled through rough and coarse rocks, beaten and burnt like straw, the sinners of ruthless conduct, are tortured.
verses.science: कर्णिकाके केसरके समान स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । नरकलोकमार्गयमदूतस्वरूपवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । अथ पापैर्नरा यान्ति यमलोकं चतुर्विधैः । सन्त्रासजननं घोरं विवशाः सर्वदेहिनः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.7. saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | narakalokamārgayamadūtasvarūpavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | atha pāpairnarā yānti yamalokaṃ caturvidhaiḥ | santrāsajananaṃ ghoraṃ vivaśāḥ sarvadehinaḥ
verses.translation: The worms eat through their bodies with their sharp mouths and teeth. With their bodies gradually hurled over swarms of worms, heaps of putrid flesh and bones they stay there distressed, dejected and crushed between two mountains
verses.hindi: आदि पर्वत दक्षिणमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The worms eat through their bodies with their sharp mouths and teeth. With their bodies gradually hurled over swarms of worms, heaps of putrid flesh and bones they stay there distressed, dejected and crushed between two mountains
verses.science: आदि पर्वत दक्षिणमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थैर्जायमानैश्च बालैस्तरुणमध्यमैः । स्त्रीपुन्नपुंसकैर्जीवैर्ज्ञातव्यं सर्वजन्तुषु
verses.transliteration: garbhasthairjāyamānaiśca bālaistaruṇamadhyamaiḥ | strīpunnapuṃsakairjīvairjñātavyaṃ sarvajantuṣu
verses.translation: Their bodies are smeared with corrosive substances such as acid etc. Tortures are acute and grievous in all the hells.
verses.hindi: विंध्यश्च पारियात्रशच सप्तात्र कुलपर्वता:॥ ८ एवं पारियात्र-ये सात कुलपर्वत हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Their bodies are smeared with corrosive substances such as acid etc. Tortures are acute and grievous in all the hells.
verses.science: विंध्यश्च पारियात्रशच सप्तात्र कुलपर्वता:॥ ८ एवं पारियात्र-ये सात कुलपर्वत हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुभाशुभफलं चात्र देहिनां संविचार्यते । चित्रगुप्तादिभिः सर्वैः वसिष्ठप्रमुखैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śubhāśubhaphalaṃ cātra dehināṃ saṃvicāryate | citraguptādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ vasiṣṭhapramukhaistathā
verses.translation: He who serves the cow thus with faith and reverence deserves to maintain the sacrificial fires. He who forsakes it is drowned in the hell Tamisra. Hence after offering Bali to these at the door, the householder shall medi¬ tate for a short while.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्‍न होकर इन नदियोंका जल पीते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He who serves the cow thus with faith and reverence deserves to maintain the sacrificial fires. He who forsakes it is drowned in the hell Tamisra. Hence after offering Bali to these at the door, the householder shall medi¬ tate for a short while.
verses.science: प्रसन्‍न होकर इन नदियोंका जल पीते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: न केचित्प्राणिनः सन्ति ये न यान्ति यमक्षयम् । अवश्यं हि कृतं कर्म भोक्तव्यं तद्विचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: na kecitprāṇinaḥ santi ye na yānti yamakṣayam | avaśyaṃ hi kṛtaṃ karma bhoktavyaṃ tadvicāryatām
verses.translation: Auspicious or inauspicious, one has of necessity to reap the fruit of actions committed by him without thinking. I shall now mention those sacred rites that yield happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Auspicious or inauspicious, one has of necessity to reap the fruit of actions committed by him without thinking. I shall now mention those sacred rites that yield happiness.
verses.science: यह सभी लोकोंकी धात्री है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये शुभकर्माणः सौम्यचित्ता दयान्विताः । ते नरा यान्ति सौम्येन पूर्वं यमनिकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: tatra ye śubhakarmāṇaḥ saumyacittā dayānvitāḥ | te narā yānti saumyena pūrvaṃ yamaniketanam
verses.translation: By giving water for washing the feet one goes along the path full of water. He who gifts oils for massaging the feet goes on horseback along that way.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving water for washing the feet one goes along the path full of water. He who gifts oils for massaging the feet goes on horseback along that way.
verses.science: प्रतिष्ठित किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनः पापकर्माणः पापा दानविवर्जिताः । ते घोरेण पथा यान्ति दक्षिणेन यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: ye punaḥ pāpakarmāṇaḥ pāpā dānavivarjitāḥ | te ghoreṇa pathā yānti dakṣiṇena yamālayam
verses.translation: He who gives food to a suppliant brahmin in distress actually makes an excellent deposit facilititing his benefit in the other world.
verses.hindi: चाहिए, जिससे नरकमें न जाना पड़े
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives food to a suppliant brahmin in distress actually makes an excellent deposit facilititing his benefit in the other world.
verses.science: चाहिए, जिससे नरकमें न जाना पड़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनानामतीत्य तत् । वैवस्वतपुरं ज्ञेयं नानारूपमवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāmatītya tat | vaivasvatapuraṃ jñeyaṃ nānārūpamavasthitam
verses.translation: A householder, desirous of prosperity shall worship a brahmin who has approached him at the proper time for his livelihood, or who is travel-weary and comes to his house as a guest.
verses.commentary: Sense: A householder, desirous of prosperity shall worship a brahmin who has approached him at the proper time for his livelihood, or who is travel-weary and comes to his house as a guest.
verses.science: जन्मको व्यर्थ कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समीपस्थमिवाभाति नराणां पुण्यकर्मणाम् । पापिनामतिदूरस्थं यथा रौद्रेण गच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: samīpasthamivābhāti narāṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām | pāpināmatidūrasthaṃ yathā raudreṇa gacchatām
verses.translation: O Vyasa, a giver of food, of good conduct and free from malice, is honoured. A gift of food never goes in- vain be it to a dog or a person who cooks dogs. If a person eschews anger that surges up he derives happiness here and hereafter. He should not encourage it even if it is natural. One shall try to eschew it somehow.
verses.wordMeaning: O Vyasa, a giver of food, of good conduct and free from malice, is honoured. A gift of food never goes in- vain be it to a dog or a person who cooks dogs. If a person eschews anger that surges up he derives happiness here and hereafter.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, a giver of food, of good conduct and free from malice, is honoured. A gift of food never goes in- vain be it to a dog or a person who cooks dogs. If a person eschews anger that surges up he derives happiness here and hereafter.…
verses.science: ही आत्माको ठगा है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णकण्टकयुक्तेन शर्कराविचितेन च । क्षुरधारानिभैस्तीक्ष्णैः पाषाणै रचितेन च
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇakaṇṭakayuktena śarkarāvicitena ca | kṣuradhārānibhaistīkṣṇaiḥ pāṣāṇai racitena ca
verses.translation: He who gives food to a weary, unknown traveller, without feeling distressed for the same will derive prosperity.
verses.hindi: यह अध्रुव शरीर तो नष्ट होनेवाला ही है
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives food to a weary, unknown traveller, without feeling distressed for the same will derive prosperity.
verses.science: यह अध्रुव शरीर तो नष्ट होनेवाला ही है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्पङ्केन महता जलौकाभिश्च सङ्कुलैः । लोहसूचीनिभैर्दर्भैः सम्पन्नेन पथा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kvacitpaṅkena mahatā jalaukābhiśca saṅkulaiḥ | lohasūcīnibhairdarbhaiḥ sampannena pathā kvacit
verses.translation: They are kept with face down and legs up and
verses.hindi: पर्वत पश्चिम भागमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: They are kept with face down and legs up and
verses.science: पर्वत पश्चिम भागमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तटप्रायातिविषमैः पर्वतैर्वृक्षसङ्कुलैः । प्रतप्ताङ्गारयुक्तेन यान्ति मार्गेण दुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: taṭaprāyātiviṣamaiḥ parvatairvṛkṣasaṅkulaiḥ | prataptāṅgārayuktena yānti mārgeṇa duḥkhitāḥ
verses.translation: Red hot iron clubs are thrust into their mouths. They are helplessly forced to gnaw at it. They arc then beaten with iron threshing rods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Red hot iron clubs are thrust into their mouths. They are helplessly forced to gnaw at it. They arc then beaten with iron threshing rods.
verses.science: उत्तरमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्विषमगर्तैश्च क्वचिल्लोष्ठैः सुदुष्करैः । सुतप्तबालुकाभिश्च तथा तीक्ष्णैश्च शङ्कुभिः
verses.transliteration: kvacidviṣamagartaiśca kvacilloṣṭhaiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ | sutaptabālukābhiśca tathā tīkṣṇaiśca śaṅkubhiḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, thus the sinners of misdeeds are cooked and scorched in hells. I shall now describe their various modes of undergoing the tortures of hell.
verses.hindi: पश्चिममें चश्षु और उत्तरमें भद्रा नदी बहती है
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, thus the sinners of misdeeds are cooked and scorched in hells. I shall now describe their various modes of undergoing the tortures of hell.
verses.science: पश्चिममें चश्षु और उत्तरमें भद्रा नदी बहती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेकशाखाविततैर्व्याप्तं वंशवनैः क्वचित् । कष्टेन तमसा मार्गेणानालम्बेन कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: anekaśākhāvitatairvyāptaṃ vaṃśavanaiḥ kvacit | kaṣṭena tamasā mārgeṇānālambena kutracit
verses.translation: He who follows false scriptures goes to the hell Dvijihva. He is tortured by the tongue-like ploughshares extending to one and a half kilometres.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who follows false scriptures goes to the hell Dvijihva. He is tortured by the tongue-like ploughshares extending to one and a half kilometres.
verses.science: आकारमें विराजमान है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अयः शृङ्गाटकैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्वचिद्दावाग्निना पुनः । क्वचित्तप्तशिलाभिश्च क्वचिद्व्याप्तं हिमेन च
verses.transliteration: ayaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaistīkṣṇaiḥ kvaciddāvāgninā punaḥ | kvacittaptaśilābhiśca kvacidvyāptaṃ himena ca
verses.translation: The mouth of the man who had been cruel to his parents and had reproached them is filled with faeces and worms and he is beaten.
verses.hindi: मनोहर केसर पर्वत भलीभाँति अवस्थित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The mouth of the man who had been cruel to his parents and had reproached them is filled with faeces and worms and he is beaten.
verses.science: मनोहर केसर पर्वत भलीभाँति अवस्थित हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्वालुकया व्याप्तमाकण्ठान्तः प्रवेशया । क्वचिद्दुष्टाम्बुना व्याप्तं क्वचिच्च करिषाग्निना
verses.transliteration: kvacidvālukayā vyāptamākaṇṭhāntaḥ praveśayā | kvacidduṣṭāmbunā vyāptaṃ kvacicca kariṣāgninā
verses.translation: Men who defile the temple of Siva, the park surrounding it and the wells, tanks and lakes therein, in various ways such as playing there, applying oil and unguents over the body, drinking bouts, taking food, indulgence in sexual inter¬ course, game of dice etc. are tortured by being crushed in the sugercane-cruohing machine and other mechanical contrivances. They are scorched in hellish fire till the final day of dissolution.
verses.wordMeaning: Men who defile the temple of Siva, the park surrounding it and the wells, tanks and lakes therein, in various ways such as playing there, applying oil and unguents over the body, drinking bouts, taking food, indulgence in sexual inter¬ course, game of dice etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who defile the temple of Siva, the park surrounding it and the wells, tanks and lakes therein, in various ways such as playing there, applying oil and unguents over the body, drinking bouts, taking food, indulgence in sexual inter¬ course, game of dice etc.…
verses.science: क्रीड़ा करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित् सिहैर्वृकैर्व्याघ्रैर्मशकैश्च सुदारुणैः । क्वचिन्महाजलौकाभिः क्वचिच्चाजगरैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kvacit sihairvṛkairvyāghrairmaśakaiśca sudāruṇaiḥ | kvacinmahājalaukābhiḥ kvaciccājagaraistathā
verses.translation: Sinners who indulge in illicit union with other's wives are forced to embrace red-hot iron images of those women with whom they had illicit relation and struck in various ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sinners who indulge in illicit union with other's wives are forced to embrace red-hot iron images of those women with whom they had illicit relation and struck in various ways.
verses.science: वर्षोकी स्थिर आयुवाली होती हैं। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: मक्षिकाभिश्च रौद्राभिः क्वचित् सर्पैर्विषोल्बणैः । मत्तमातङ्गयूथैश्च बलोन्मत्तैः प्रमाथिभिः
verses.transliteration: makṣikābhiśca raudrābhiḥ kvacit sarpairviṣolbaṇaiḥ | mattamātaṅgayūthaiśca balonmattaiḥ pramāthibhiḥ
verses.translation: Images of those men are made of red hot iron and the erring women are forced to embrace those images. They cry and shriek.
verses.hindi: शतशः सन्त क्षुद्राश्न तासु क्रीडेच्छुभो जन: ॥ ४४  उत्तम लोग विहार करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Images of those men are made of red hot iron and the erring women are forced to embrace those images. They cry and shriek.
verses.science: शतशः सन्त क्षुद्राश्न तासु क्रीडेच्छुभो जन: ॥ ४४ उत्तम लोग विहार करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पन्थानमुल्लिखद्भिश्च सूकरैस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रिभिः । तीक्ष्णशृङ्गैश्च महिषैः सर्वभूतैश्च श्वापदैः
verses.transliteration: panthānamullikhadbhiśca sūkaraistīkṣṇadaṃṣṭribhiḥ | tīkṣṇaśṛṅgaiśca mahiṣaiḥ sarvabhūtaiśca śvāpadaiḥ
verses.translation: Those who listen to the censure of good people are punished thus: ears filled with red hot pins of
verses.hindi: जम्बूद्वीपवर्षवर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who listen to the censure of good people are punished thus: ears filled with red hot pins of
verses.science: जम्बूद्वीपवर्षवर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: डाकिनीभिश्च रौद्राभिर्विकरालैश्च राक्षसैः । व्याधिभिश्च महाघोरैः पीड्यमाना व्रजन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: ḍākinībhiśca raudrābhirvikarālaiśca rākṣasaiḥ | vyādhibhiśca mahāghoraiḥ pīḍyamānā vrajanti hi
verses.translation: The hands of those sinners who touch other's wives are filled with red hot fillings.
verses.hindi: उत्तरे तु समुद्रस्थ भारती यत्र संसृति:॥ भारतवर्षका वर्णन करूँगा, जहाँ भारती सृष्टि है
verses.commentary: Sense: The hands of those sinners who touch other's wives are filled with red hot fillings.
verses.science: उत्तरे तु समुद्रस्थ भारती यत्र संसृति:॥ भारतवर्षका वर्णन करूँगा, जहाँ भारती सृष्टि है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महाधूलिविमिश्रेण महाचण्डेन वायुना । महापाषाणवर्षेण हन्यमाना निराश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: mahādhūlivimiśreṇa mahācaṇḍena vāyunā | mahāpāṣāṇavarṣeṇa hanyamānā nirāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: The faces of men who show wry faces with knit eye-brows to their parents are scratched from end to end with sharp pikes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The faces of men who show wry faces with knit eye-brows to their parents are scratched from end to end with sharp pikes.
verses.science: पापोंका नाश करनेवाला जानना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्विद्युत्प्रपातेन दह्यमाना व्रजन्ति च । महता बाणवर्षेण विध्यमानाश्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kvacidvidyutprapātena dahyamānā vrajanti ca | mahatā bāṇavarṣeṇa vidhyamānāśca sarvataḥ
verses.translation: The organs wherewith men defile or harass women are respectively tortured.
verses.hindi: विन्ध्योद्धवा महानद्य: सर्वपापहरा: शुभाः॥ १०  जो सम्पूर्ण पापोंका हरण करती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The organs wherewith men defile or harass women are respectively tortured.
verses.science: विन्ध्योद्धवा महानद्य: सर्वपापहरा: शुभाः॥ १० जो सम्पूर्ण पापोंका हरण करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पतद्भिर्वज्रपातैश्च उल्कापातैश्च दारुणैः । प्रदीप्ताङ्गारवर्षेण दह्यमानाश्च सन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: patadbhirvajrapātaiśca ulkāpātaiśca dāruṇaiḥ | pradīptāṅgāravarṣeṇa dahyamānāśca santi hi
verses.translation: If people take food without first offering it to the gods, firegod, preceptors and brahmins, their tongues and mouths are pierced through and filled with hundreds of red- hot nails of iron.
verses.commentary: Sense: If people take food without first offering it to the gods, firegod, preceptors and brahmins, their tongues and mouths are pierced through and filled with hundreds of red- hot nails of iron.
verses.science: भयका हरण करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महता पांसुवर्षेण पूर्यमाणा रुदन्ति च । महामेघरवैर्घोरैस्त्रस्यन्ते च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: mahatā pāṃsuvarṣeṇa pūryamāṇā rudanti ca | mahāmegharavairghoraistrasyante ca muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: If men, out of greed, pluck and sniff at flowers of the temple parks, or wear them on their heads,*®* their heads arc covered with iron spikes and their noses are filled with plenty of acid and other things.
verses.commentary: Sense: If men, out of greed, pluck and sniff at flowers of the temple parks, or wear them on their heads,*®* their heads arc covered with iron spikes and their noses are filled with plenty of acid and other things.
verses.science: मलयाचलसे निकली हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निशितायुधवर्षेण भिद्यमानाश्च सर्वतः । महाक्षाराम्बुधाराभिः सिच्यमाना व्रजन्ति च
verses.transliteration: niśitāyudhavarṣeṇa bhidyamānāśca sarvataḥ | mahākṣārāmbudhārābhiḥ sicyamānā vrajanti ca
verses.translation: Red-hot three-pointed iron rods are thrust and pushed through the chest, neck, tongue, tooth-joints, palate, lips, nostrils and all the limb-joints of those persons who slander and censure the noble-preacher of virtue, devotees of the gods, fire-god and preceptor as well as the eternal scriptural texts.
verses.wordMeaning: Red-hot three-pointed iron rods are thrust and pushed through the chest, neck, tongue, tooth-joints, palate, lips, nostrils and all the limb-joints of those persons who slander and censure the noble-preacher of virtue, devotees of the gods,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Red-hot three-pointed iron rods are thrust and pushed through the chest, neck, tongue, tooth-joints, palate, lips, nostrils and all the limb-joints of those persons who slander and censure the noble-preacher of virtue, devotees of the gods,…
verses.science: नदियाँ शुक्तिमान् पर्वतसे निकली हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महीशीतेन मरुता रूक्षेण परुषेण च । समन्ताद् बाध्यमानाश्च शुष्यन्ते सङ्कुचन्ति च
verses.transliteration: mahīśītena marutā rūkṣeṇa paruṣeṇa ca | samantād bādhyamānāśca śuṣyante saṅkucanti ca
verses.translation: The crevices of the body are filled with corrosive acid. Severe tortures are inflicted all over the body.
verses.hindi: इन नदियों तथा अन्य सरोवरोंका जल पीते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The crevices of the body are filled with corrosive acid. Severe tortures are inflicted all over the body.
verses.science: इन नदियों तथा अन्य सरोवरोंका जल पीते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं मार्गेण रौद्रेण पाथेयरहितेन च । निरालम्बेन दुर्गेण निर्जलेन समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ mārgeṇa raudreṇa pātheyarahitena ca | nirālambena durgeṇa nirjalena samantataḥ
verses.translation: In all hells various tortures of grievous nature are inflicted on hands and feet.
verses.hindi: चारों युग होते हैं, अन्य द्वीपोंमें ये नहीं होते
verses.commentary: Sense: In all hells various tortures of grievous nature are inflicted on hands and feet.
verses.science: चारों युग होते हैं, अन्य द्वीपोंमें ये नहीं होते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विषमेणैव महता निर्जनापाश्रयेण च । तमोरूपेण कष्टेन सर्वदुष्टाश्रयेण च
verses.transliteration: viṣameṇaiva mahatā nirjanāpāśrayeṇa ca | tamorūpeṇa kaṣṭena sarvaduṣṭāśrayeṇa ca
verses.translation: As a result of the previous tortures their minds and all sense-organs are put to great misery. Those who, despite being rich do not make monetary gifts due to greed, and those who dishonour guests visiting their houses at the proper time, commit sins and fall into dirty hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of the previous tortures their minds and all sense-organs are put to great misery. Those who, despite being rich do not make monetary gifts due to greed, and those who dishonour guests visiting their houses at the proper time, commit sins and fall into dirty hell.
verses.science: यतिलोग तपस्या करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नीयन्ते देहिनः सर्वे ये मूढाः पापकर्मिणः । यमदूतैर्महाघोरैस्तदाज्ञाकारिभिर्बलात्
verses.transliteration: nīyante dehinaḥ sarve ye mūḍhāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ | yamadūtairmahāghoraistadājñākāribhirbalāt
verses.translation: He who is dark and he who is multi-coloured— these two are the obstacles to the path of Yama. To these two dogs®** I am offering this oblation. Let them take this oblation. Let the pious crows in the direction of Vanina (west), of Vayu (north-west), of Yama (south) and of Nairrti (south-west), accept this oblation of mine". Those who offer this Bali with Siva's mantras, after worshipping Siva with devotion and performing Homa duly* do not face Yama. They go straight to heaven. Hence this oblation shall be offered daily. A square mystic diagram is made and sweet
verses.wordMeaning: He who is dark and he who is multi-coloured— these two are the obstacles to the path of Yama. To these two dogs®** I am offering this oblation. Let them take this oblation. Let the pious crows in the direction of Vanina (west), of Vayu (north-west),…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is dark and he who is multi-coloured— these two are the obstacles to the path of Yama. To these two dogs®** I am offering this oblation. Let them take this oblation. Let the pious crows in the direction of Vanina (west), of Vayu (north-west),…
verses.science: अतिरिक्त अन्य सभी भोगभूमियाँ हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकाकिनः पराधीना मित्रबन्धुविवर्जिताः । शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्माणि रुदन्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: ekākinaḥ parādhīnā mitrabandhuvivarjitāḥ | śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi rudantaśca muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: The text mentions the two dogs and crows to whom the offer- irigs shall be made in favour of the departed spirit. It inentions the cow that takes the spirits across Vaitaraal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The text mentions the two dogs and crows to whom the offer- irigs shall be made in favour of the departed spirit. It inentions the cow that takes the spirits across Vaitaraal.
verses.science: उत्तम पर्वत हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रेता भूत्वा विवस्त्राश्च शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकाः । असौम्या भयभीताश्च दह्यमानाः क्षुधान्विताः
verses.transliteration: pretā bhūtvā vivastrāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ | asaumyā bhayabhītāśca dahyamānāḥ kṣudhānvitāḥ
verses.translation: One shall feed the hungry guest staying in the same village with auspicious food, in accordance with his ability and with the same dishes as he partakes of himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall feed the hungry guest staying in the same village with auspicious food, in accordance with his ability and with the same dishes as he partakes of himself.
verses.science: इस ट्वीपका नाम शाल्मलीद्वीप है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: बद्धाः शृङ्खलया केचिदुत्ता नपादका नराः । कृष्यन्ते कृष्यमाणाश्च यमदूतैर्बलोत्कटैः
verses.transliteration: baddhāḥ śṛṅkhalayā keciduttā napādakā narāḥ | kṛṣyante kṛṣyamāṇāśca yamadūtairbalotkaṭaiḥ
verses.translation: If a guest turns back from a house disappointed he takes away all the merits of the householder and leaves his own sins behind.
verses.hindi: वे सब पवित्र तथा शीतल जलवाली हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: If a guest turns back from a house disappointed he takes away all the merits of the householder and leaves his own sins behind.
verses.science: वे सब पवित्र तथा शीतल जलवाली हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: उरसाधोमुखाश्चान्ये घृष्यमाणाः सुदुःखिताः । केशपाशनिबन्धेन सङ्कृष्यन्ते च रज्जुना
verses.transliteration: urasādhomukhāścānye ghṛṣyamāṇāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ | keśapāśanibandhena saṅkṛṣyante ca rajjunā
verses.translation: A man eating delicious food by himself stays in the hdl for a long time fettered in the body and pierced in the tongue with force.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोंसे सदा भगवान् शिवका यजन करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: A man eating delicious food by himself stays in the hdl for a long time fettered in the body and pierced in the tongue with force.
verses.science: यज्ञोंसे सदा भगवान् शिवका यजन करते हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ललाटे चाङ्कुशेनान्ये भिन्ना दुष्यन्ति देहिनः । उत्तानाः कण्टकपथा क्वचिदङ्गारवर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: lalāṭe cāṅkuśenānye bhinnā duṣyanti dehinaḥ | uttānāḥ kaṇṭakapathā kvacidaṅgāravartmanā
verses.translation: Bits of his own flesh, of the size of a small gingelly seed, arc cut off from his body and are given to him for eating. Blood is similarly taken and given for drinking. He is then beaten with whips. Thus he is tor¬ mented with hunger and thirst.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bits of his own flesh, of the size of a small gingelly seed, arc cut off from his body and are given to him for eating. Blood is similarly taken and given for drinking. He is then beaten with whips. Thus he is tor¬ mented with hunger and thirst.
verses.science: तथा जरा-रोगसे रहित है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: पश्चाद् बाहुनिबद्धाश्च जठरेण प्रपीडिताः । पूरिताः शृङ्खलाभिश्च हस्तयोश्च सुकीलिताः
verses.transliteration: paścād bāhunibaddhāśca jaṭhareṇa prapīḍitāḥ | pūritāḥ śṛṅkhalābhiśca hastayośca sukīlitāḥ
verses.translation: These and similar things constitute the terrible
verses.commentary: Sense: These and similar things constitute the terrible
verses.science: एक-दूसरेसे द्विगुण विस्तारवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीवापाशेन कृष्यन्ते प्रयान्त्यन्ये सुदुःखिताः । जिह्वाङ्कुशप्रवेशेन रज्ज्वाकृष्यन्त एव ते
verses.transliteration: grīvāpāśena kṛṣyante prayāntyanye suduḥkhitāḥ | jihvāṅkuśapraveśena rajjvākṛṣyanta eva te
verses.translation: The gifts offered to the principal gods, manes, subsidiary gods, and human beings with the utterance of words PTSandrT
verses.commentary: Sense: The gifts offered to the principal gods, manes, subsidiary gods, and human beings with the utterance of words PTSandrT
verses.science: जल कभी घटता नहीं है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: नासाभेदेन रज्ज्वा च त्वाकृष्यन्ते तथापरे । भिन्नाः कपोलयो रज्ज्वा कृष्यन्तेऽन्ये तथौष्ठयोः
verses.transliteration: nāsābhedena rajjvā ca tvākṛṣyante tathāpare | bhinnāḥ kapolayo rajjvā kṛṣyante'nye tathauṣṭhayoḥ
verses.translation: There may be a person who has done more sin than good or a person who has done more good than evil. Now listen to the result of their actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: There may be a person who has done more sin than good or a person who has done more good than evil. Now listen to the result of their actions.
verses.science: जल भी ऊपरको उठता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नाग्रपादहस्ताश्च छिन्नकर्णोष्ठनासिकाः । सञ्छिन्नशिश्नवृषणाः छिन्नभिन्नाङ्गसन्धयः
verses.transliteration: chinnāgrapādahastāśca chinnakarṇoṣṭhanāsikāḥ | sañchinnaśiśnavṛṣaṇāḥ chinnabhinnāṅgasandhayaḥ
verses.translation: On the other hand a man of more good actions is not distressed by a few sufferings due to small sins just as a rich householder is not distressed by hunger when he fasts for a day.
verses.hindi: तथा शुक्लपक्षमें न्‍्यूनाधिक्य होता रहता है
verses.commentary: Sense: On the other hand a man of more good actions is not distressed by a few sufferings due to small sins just as a rich householder is not distressed by hunger when he fasts for a day.
verses.science: तथा शुक्लपक्षमें न्‍्यूनाधिक्य होता रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आभिद्यमानाः कुन्तैश्च भिद्यमानाश्च सायकैः । इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तः क्रन्दमाना निराश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: ābhidyamānāḥ kuntaiśca bhidyamānāśca sāyakaiḥ | itaścetaśca dhāvantaḥ krandamānā nirāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: There are great sins in the world which shatter a man into hundreds of pieces like a mountain struck down by thunderbolt.
verses.hindi: यह सभी प्रकारके प्राणियोंसे रहित है
verses.commentary: Sense: There are great sins in the world which shatter a man into hundreds of pieces like a mountain struck down by thunderbolt.
verses.science: यह सभी प्रकारके प्राणियोंसे रहित है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुद्गरैर्लोहदण्डैश्च हन्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः । कण्टकैर्विविधैर्घोरैर्ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: mudgarairlohadaṇḍaiśca hanyamānā muhurmuhuḥ | kaṇṭakairvividhairghorairjvalanārkasamaprabhaiḥ
verses.translation: Those who commit sins go along (he path to Yama with great misery. O holy lord, now narrate the righteous deeds which render pleasure in the path of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who commit sins go along (he path to Yama with great misery. O holy lord, now narrate the righteous deeds which render pleasure in the path of Yama.
verses.science: दस हजार योजन है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भिन्दिपालैर्विभिद्यन्ते स्रवतः पूयशोणितम् । शकृता कृमिदिग्धाश्च नीयन्ते विवशा नराः
verses.transliteration: bhindipālairvibhidyante sravataḥ pūyaśoṇitam | śakṛtā kṛmidigdhāśca nīyante vivaśā narāḥ
verses.translation: Men who perform auspicious rites here, whose minds are gentle and who are merciful pass through the terrible path of Yama happily.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who perform auspicious rites here, whose minds are gentle and who are merciful pass through the terrible path of Yama happily.
verses.science: सम्द्वी पवर्णन॑ नामाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: याचमानाश्च सलिलमन्नं वापि बुभुक्षिताः । छायां प्रार्थयमानाश्च शीतार्ताश्चानलं पुनः
verses.transliteration: yācamānāśca salilamannaṃ vāpi bubhukṣitāḥ | chāyāṃ prārthayamānāśca śītārtāścānalaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: He who makes gifts of sandals of leather or wood to leading brahmins goes happily to the abode of Yama on a great horse.
verses.hindi: सप्तद्वीपर्णन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes gifts of sandals of leather or wood to leading brahmins goes happily to the abode of Yama on a great horse.
verses.science: सप्तद्वीपर्णन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दानहीनाः प्रयान्त्येवं प्रार्थयन्तः सुखं नराः । गृहीतदानपाथेयाः सुखं यान्ति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: dānahīnāḥ prayāntyevaṃ prārthayantaḥ sukhaṃ narāḥ | gṛhītadānapātheyāḥ sukhaṃ yānti yamālayam
verses.translation: By making gifts of umbrella they go holding an umbrella. By making gifts of palanquin he goes by means of a chariot.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी है, उसीको भूलोक कहा जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: By making gifts of umbrella they go holding an umbrella. By making gifts of palanquin he goes by means of a chariot.
verses.science: पृथ्वी है, उसीको भूलोक कहा जाता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं न्यायेन कष्टेन प्राप्ताः प्रेतपुरं यदा । प्रज्ञापितास्ततो दूतैर्निवेश्यन्ते यमाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nyāyena kaṣṭena prāptāḥ pretapuraṃ yadā | prajñāpitāstato dūtairniveśyante yamāgrataḥ
verses.translation: By making giBs of beds tind seats he goes with ample rest. Those who make shady parks or those who plant trees on the wayside go without wearine.ss even in the hottest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making giBs of beds tind seats he goes with ample rest. Those who make shady parks or those who plant trees on the wayside go without wearine.ss even in the hottest region.
verses.science: ऐसा जानना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये शुभकर्माणस्तांस्तु सम्मानयेद्यमः । स्वागतासनदानेन पाद्यार्घ्येण प्रियेण च
verses.transliteration: tatra ye śubhakarmāṇastāṃstu sammānayedyamaḥ | svāgatāsanadānena pādyārghyeṇa priyeṇa ca
verses.translation: Men making flower gardens go by the aerial chariot Puspaka. Makers of temples feel at home on the way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men making flower gardens go by the aerial chariot Puspaka. Makers of temples feel at home on the way.
verses.science: निवास करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्या यूयं महात्मानो निगमोदितकारिणः । यैश्च दिव्यसुखार्थाय भवद्भिः सुकृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyā yūyaṃ mahātmāno nigamoditakāriṇaḥ | yaiśca divyasukhārthāya bhavadbhiḥ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: The founders of hermitages of ascetics and Rest houses for the orphans feel as if they play in the house.
verses.commentary: Sense: The founders of hermitages of ascetics and Rest houses for the orphans feel as if they play in the house.
verses.science: तापरहित होकर रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य दिव्यस्त्रीभोगभूषितम् । स्वर्गं गच्छध्वममलं सर्वकामसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ vimānamāruhya divyastrībhogabhūṣitam | svargaṃ gacchadhvamamalaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam
verses.translation: Worshippers of the gods, fire-god brahmins and their parents go along that path as they please. They are honoured on the way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worshippers of the gods, fire-god brahmins and their parents go along that path as they please. They are honoured on the way.
verses.science: मनुष्य निवास करते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगानन्ते पुण्यस्य सङ्क्षयात् । यत्किञ्चिदल्पमशुभं पुनस्तदिह भोक्ष्यथ
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānante puṇyasya saṅkṣayāt | yatkiñcidalpamaśubhaṃ punastadiha bhokṣyatha
verses.translation: Those who gift lamps, go brightly illuminating all the ten quarters. By giving dwellings and asylums they go without ailments on the way.
verses.hindi: ऊपर अन्य कोई लोक हैं अथवा नहीं
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who gift lamps, go brightly illuminating all the ten quarters. By giving dwellings and asylums they go without ailments on the way.
verses.science: ऊपर अन्य कोई लोक हैं अथवा नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मात्मानो नरा ये च मित्रभूता इवात्मनः । सौम्यं मुखं प्रपश्यन्ति धर्मराजनमेव च
verses.transliteration: dharmātmāno narā ye ca mitrabhūtā ivātmanaḥ | saumyaṃ mukhaṃ prapaśyanti dharmarājanameva ca
verses.translation: Those who habitually serve their preceptors go without difficulty. They get ample rest on the way. Those who gift musical instruments to brahmins go happily feeling at home on the way.
verses.hindi: आया हुआ मैं आपसे उनका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who habitually serve their preceptors go without difficulty. They get ample rest on the way. Those who gift musical instruments to brahmins go happily feeling at home on the way.
verses.science: आया हुआ मैं आपसे उनका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनः क्रूरकर्माणस्ते पश्यन्ति भयानकम् । दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं भृकुटीकुटिलेक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ye punaḥ krūrakarmāṇaste paśyanti bhayānakam | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhṛkuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam
verses.translation: Givers of cows go along the path flourishing with all their desires. They get those food-stuflfs and drinks which they give away here, on that path also.
verses.commentary: Sense: Givers of cows go along the path flourishing with all their desires. They get those food-stuflfs and drinks which they give away here, on that path also.
verses.science: शिवप्रिया गोमाताएँ निवास करती हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वकेशं महाश्मश्रुमूर्ध्वप्रस्फुरिताधरम् । अष्टादशभुजं क्रुद्धं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvakeśaṃ mahāśmaśrumūrdhvaprasphuritādharam | aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ kruddhaṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam
verses.translation: O Vyasa, Yama never comes near the man who always makes gifts of water for washing the feet, oil for massa¬ ging, lamps, foodstufls and dwellings.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, Yama never comes near the man who always makes gifts of water for washing the feet, oil for massa¬ ging, lamps, foodstufls and dwellings.
verses.science: लोकवर्णन॑ नामैकोनविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वायुधोद्धृतकरं सर्वदण्डेन तर्जयन् । महामहिषमारूढं दीप्ताग्निसमलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāyudhoddhṛtakaraṃ sarvadaṇḍena tarjayan | mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaṃ dīptāgnisamalocanam
verses.translation: By making gifts of gold and gems he crosses all impassable hurdles. By gifting silver and oxen he goes to Yamaloka happily.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making gifts of gold and gems he crosses all impassable hurdles. By gifting silver and oxen he goes to Yamaloka happily.
verses.science: नामक उननीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरं महामेरुमिवोच्छ्रितम् । प्रलयाम्बुदनिर्घोषं पिबन्निव महोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: raktamālyāmbaradharaṃ mahāmerumivocchritam | pralayāmbudanirghoṣaṃ pibanniva mahodadhim
verses.translation: By these and similar charitable gifts people go happily to Yama's abode. They attain different pleasures in the heaven.
verses.hindi: जहाँ जाकर शिवभक्त मनुष्य फिर नहीं लौटते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: By these and similar charitable gifts people go happily to Yama's abode. They attain different pleasures in the heaven.
verses.science: जहाँ जाकर शिवभक्त मनुष्य फिर नहीं लौटते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रसन्तमिव शैलेन्द्रमुद्गिरन्तमिवानलम् । मृत्युश्चैव समीपस्थः कालानलसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: grasantamiva śailendramudgirantamivānalam | mṛtyuścaiva samīpasthaḥ kālānalasamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: Food gives blood, flesh, fat and semen and out of semen living beings are born. Hence the universe is identical with food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Food gives blood, flesh, fat and semen and out of semen living beings are born. Hence the universe is identical with food.
verses.science: तथा पवित्र ब्रतको प्रीतिपूर्वक सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालश्चाञ्जनसङ्काशः कृतान्तश्च भयानकः । मारी चोग्रमहामारी कालरात्रिश्च दारुणा
verses.transliteration: kālaścāñjanasaṅkāśaḥ kṛtāntaśca bhayānakaḥ | mārī cogramahāmārī kālarātriśca dāruṇā
verses.translation: Hungry men are not delighted even if they possess these things viz—gold, gems, horses, elephants, women, garlands, sandal paste and the like.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hungry men are not delighted even if they possess these things viz—gold, gems, horses, elephants, women, garlands, sandal paste and the like.
verses.science: सब प्रकारसे सर्वदा वन्दनीय हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विविधा व्याधयः कुष्ठा नानारूपा भयावहाः । शक्तिशूलाङ्कुशधराः पाशचक्रासिपाणयः
verses.transliteration: vividhā vyādhayaḥ kuṣṭhā nānārūpā bhayāvahāḥ | śaktiśūlāṅkuśadharāḥ pāśacakrāsipāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: All persons, the child in the womb, the new born babe, the child, the middle aged man, the old man, the gods, the danavas or Raksasas desire food.
verses.hindi: हैं, मेरे इस वचनको सत्य जानिये
verses.commentary: Sense: All persons, the child in the womb, the new born babe, the child, the middle aged man, the old man, the gods, the danavas or Raksasas desire food.
verses.science: हैं, मेरे इस वचनको सत्य जानिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वज्रतुण्डधरा रौद्राः क्षुरतूणधनुर्द्धराः । नानायुधधराः सर्वे महावीरा भयङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: vajratuṇḍadharā raudrāḥ kṣuratūṇadhanurddharāḥ | nānāyudhadharāḥ sarve mahāvīrā bhayaṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: All embodied beings die when scorched by the fire of hunger. That is why it is glorified that there is great merit in the charitable gift of food.
verses.commentary: Sense: All embodied beings die when scorched by the fire of hunger. That is why it is glorified that there is great merit in the charitable gift of food.
verses.science: दुर्लभ फल प्राप्त किया है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्याता महावीराः कालाञ्जनसमप्रभाः । सर्वायुधोद्यतकरा यमदूता भयानकाः
verses.transliteration: asaṅkhyātā mahāvīrāḥ kālāñjanasamaprabhāḥ | sarvāyudhodyatakarā yamadūtā bhayānakāḥ
verses.translation: If a man performs holy and sacred rites after being nourished with the food gifted by someone, the merit of the sacred rites is shared half and half by the two—namely by the giver of food and the performer of the rites. There is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man performs holy and sacred rites after being nourished with the food gifted by someone, the merit of the sacred rites is shared half and half by the two—namely by the giver of food and the performer of the rites. There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: साधन जानना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन परिचारेण वृतं तं घोरदर्शनम् । यमं पश्यन्ति पापिष्ठाश्चित्रगुप्तं च भीषणम्
verses.transliteration: anena paricāreṇa vṛtaṃ taṃ ghoradarśanam | yamaṃ paśyanti pāpiṣṭhāścitraguptaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: The giver of charitable gift of food obtains here and hereafter whatever means of pleasure there are in the three worlds such as gems, women and vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The giver of charitable gift of food obtains here and hereafter whatever means of pleasure there are in the three worlds such as gems, women and vehicles.
verses.science: मनुष्योंका तप तामस होता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्भर्त्सयति चात्यन्तं यमस्तान्पापकर्मणः । चित्रगुप्तश्च भगवान् धर्मवाक्यैः प्रबोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: nirbhartsayati cātyantaṃ yamastānpāpakarmaṇaḥ | citraguptaśca bhagavān dharmavākyaiḥ prabodhayet
verses.translation: Even by putting one's family to inconvenience and trouble one should give food to a mendicant brahmin of noble soul, if one wishes for one's prosperity.
verses.hindi: माया उसे अज्ञानसे मोहित कर लेती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Even by putting one's family to inconvenience and trouble one should give food to a mendicant brahmin of noble soul, if one wishes for one's prosperity.
verses.science: माया उसे अज्ञानसे मोहित कर लेती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Gift of food and drink whether to a 8udra or to a brahmin is equally excellent. One should not ask the spiritual lineage,*®* branch of the Vedas*® or the country of the recipient.
verses.hindi: होनेपर कौन धेर्य धारण कर सकता है 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Gift of food and drink whether to a 8udra or to a brahmin is equally excellent. One should not ask the spiritual lineage,*®* branch of the Vedas*® or the country of the recipient.
verses.science: होनेपर कौन धेर्य धारण कर सकता है 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Gift of food and drink whether to a 8udra or to a brahmin is equally excellent. One should not ask the spiritual lineage,*®* branch of the Vedas*® or the country of the recipient.
verses.hindi: खर्चके लिये इस धनका दान क्यों नहीं करता ?
verses.commentary: Sense: Gift of food and drink whether to a 8udra or to a brahmin is equally excellent. One should not ask the spiritual lineage,*®* branch of the Vedas*® or the country of the recipient.
verses.science: खर्चके लिये इस धनका दान क्यों नहीं करता ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । नरकलोकवर्णनम् । चित्रगुप्त उवाच । भो भो दुष्कृतकर्माणः परद्रव्यापहारकाः । गर्विता रूपवीर्येण परदारावमर्दकाः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.8. aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | narakalokavarṇanam | citragupta uvāca | bho bho duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ paradravyāpahārakāḥ | garvitā rūpavīryeṇa paradārāvamardakāḥ
verses.translation: He who gives food when begged by a brahmin, goes to the highest heaven and remains there till the final
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives food when begged by a brahmin, goes to the highest heaven and remains there till the final
verses.science: पगपर लाभ होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यत् स्वयं क्रियते कर्म तदिदं भुज्यते पुनः । तत्किमात्मोपघातार्थं भवद्भिर्दुष्कृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yat svayaṃ kriyate karma tadidaṃ bhujyate punaḥ | tatkimātmopaghātārthaṃ bhavadbhirduṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: If a man wishes to go to the city of Yama in the aerial chariot, he shall necessarily make these special gifts.
verses.hindi: करता है, मैं वह सब आपसे कहता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man wishes to go to the city of Yama in the aerial chariot, he shall necessarily make these special gifts.
verses.science: करता है, मैं वह सब आपसे कहता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं किं प्रलप्यध्वं पीड्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः । भुज्यन्तां स्वानि कर्माणि नास्ति दोषो हि कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ kiṃ pralapyadhvaṃ pīḍyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ | bhujyantāṃ svāni karmāṇi nāsti doṣo hi kasyacit
verses.translation: Trees honour and worship the gods through flowers, the Pitfs through fruits, and the guests through shade.
verses.hindi: तथा गर्भमें उसकी स्थितिका वर्णन कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Trees honour and worship the gods through flowers, the Pitfs through fruits, and the guests through shade.
verses.science: तथा गर्भमें उसकी स्थितिका वर्णन कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एवं ते पृथिवीपालाः सम्प्राप्तास्तत्समीपतः । स्वकीयैः कर्मभिघौरैर्दुष्कर्मबलदर्पिणः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | evaṃ te pṛthivīpālāḥ samprāptāstatsamīpataḥ | svakīyaiḥ karmabhighaurairduṣkarmabaladarpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Men who never utter a lie whether for their own sake, or for other's sake, or even for their own son's sake, do go to heaven.
verses.hindi: स्थित जीव भी जठराग्निसे पकाया जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who never utter a lie whether for their own sake, or for other's sake, or even for their own son's sake, do go to heaven.
verses.science: स्थित जीव भी जठराग्निसे पकाया जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तानपि क्रोधसंयुक्तश्चित्रगुप्तो महाप्रभुः । संशिक्षयति धर्मज्ञो यमराजानुशिक्षया
verses.transliteration: tānapi krodhasaṃyuktaścitragupto mahāprabhuḥ | saṃśikṣayati dharmajño yamarājānuśikṣayā
verses.translation: Those who have never performed penance do not attain Brahmaloka; lord iSiva is not accessible to those who have never performed penance.
verses.hindi: किस प्रकार शुद्ध हो सकता है 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have never performed penance do not attain Brahmaloka; lord iSiva is not accessible to those who have never performed penance.
verses.science: किस प्रकार शुद्ध हो सकता है 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चित्रगुप्त उवाच । भो भो नृपा दुराचाराः प्रजाविध्वंसकारिणः । अल्पकालस्य राज्यस्य कृते किं दुष्कृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: citragupta uvāca | bho bho nṛpā durācārāḥ prajāvidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ | alpakālasya rājyasya kṛte kiṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: After deciding on a particular thing, if a man performs penance he attains it here as well as hereafter.
verses.hindi: शरीर भला शुद्ध किस प्रकार हो सकता है 2
verses.commentary: Sense: After deciding on a particular thing, if a man performs penance he attains it here as well as hereafter.
verses.science: शरीर भला शुद्ध किस प्रकार हो सकता है 2। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: राज्यभोगेन मोहेन बलादन्यायतः प्रजाः । यद्दण्डिताः फलं तस्य भुज्यतामधुना नृपाः
verses.transliteration: rājyabhogena mohena balādanyāyataḥ prajāḥ | yaddaṇḍitāḥ phalaṃ tasya bhujyatāmadhunā nṛpāḥ
verses.translation: The wine-addict, the defiler of other women, the brahmin-slayer, the defiler of teacher's bed overcome all sins through penance and get rid of them.
verses.hindi: हाथ किस प्रकार पवित्र रह सकता है ?2
verses.commentary: Sense: The wine-addict, the defiler of other women, the brahmin-slayer, the defiler of teacher's bed overcome all sins through penance and get rid of them.
verses.science: हाथ किस प्रकार पवित्र रह सकता है ?2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्व तद्राज्यं कलत्रं च यदर्थमशुभं कृतम् । तत्सर्वं सम्परित्यज्य यूयमेकाकिनः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: kva tadrājyaṃ kalatraṃ ca yadarthamaśubhaṃ kṛtam | tatsarvaṃ samparityajya yūyamekākinaḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: iSiva, the lord of all, the eternal Vifiu, Brahmfi, fire god, Indra and others are endowed with penance. The eighty-eight thousand sages of sublimated semen rejoice in heaven through penance, along with the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: iSiva, the lord of all, the eternal Vifiu, Brahmfi, fire god, Indra and others are endowed with penance. The eighty-eight thousand sages of sublimated semen rejoice in heaven through penance, along with the gods.
verses.science: निर्मल नहीं हो सकती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्यामि तद्बलं नष्टं येन विध्वंसिताः प्रजाः । यमदूतैर्योज्यमाना अधुना कीदृशं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: paśyāmi tadbalaṃ naṣṭaṃ yena vidhvaṃsitāḥ prajāḥ | yamadūtairyojyamānā adhunā kīdṛśaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Kingdoms are achieved through penance. Indra,
verses.hindi: संसार इससे विरक्त नहीं होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Kingdoms are achieved through penance. Indra,
verses.science: संसार इससे विरक्त नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैरुपलब्धा यमेन ते । स्वानि कर्माणि शोचन्ति तूष्णीं तिष्ठन्ति पार्थिवाः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | evaṃ bahuvidhairvākyairupalabdhā yamena te | svāni karmāṇi śocanti tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhanti pārthivāḥ
verses.translation: The garden of a food-giver acquires the fruits of his cherished desire as the brahmins do in the highest heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The garden of a food-giver acquires the fruits of his cherished desire as the brahmins do in the highest heaven.
verses.science: यमराजसे भय नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति कर्म समुद्दिश्य नृपाणां धर्मराड् यमः । तत्पापपङ्कशुद्ध्यर्थमिदं दूतान् ब्रवीति च
verses.transliteration: iti karma samuddiśya nṛpāṇāṃ dharmarāḍ yamaḥ | tatpāpapaṅkaśuddhyarthamidaṃ dūtān bravīti ca
verses.translation: O sage, O great sage, listen to the divine regions which are created in the heaven by the gifts of food, for the givor of food.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष-साधन एवं पुण्यसमूहका एकमात्र स्थान हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, O great sage, listen to the divine regions which are created in the heaven by the gifts of food, for the givor of food.
verses.science: मोक्ष-साधन एवं पुण्यसमूहका एकमात्र स्थान हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यमराज उवाच । भो भोश्चण्ड महाचण्ड गृहीत्वा नृपतीन्बलात् । नियमेन विशुद्यध्वं क्रमेण नरकाग्निषु
verses.transliteration: yamarāja uvāca | bho bhoścaṇḍa mahācaṇḍa gṛhītvā nṛpatīnbalāt | niyamena viśudyadhvaṃ krameṇa narakāgniṣu
verses.translation: The abodes of those noble souls in the heaven shine in various shapes and arc equipped with every desirable object.
verses.hindi: अन्य कोई उपाय नहीं दिखायी देता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The abodes of those noble souls in the heaven shine in various shapes and arc equipped with every desirable object.
verses.science: अन्य कोई उपाय नहीं दिखायी देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । ततः शीघ्रं समादाय नृपान् सङ्गृह्य पादयोः । भ्रामयित्वा तु वेगेन निक्षिप्योर्ध्वं प्रगृह्य च
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | tataḥ śīghraṃ samādāya nṛpān saṅgṛhya pādayoḥ | bhrāmayitvā tu vegena nikṣipyordhvaṃ pragṛhya ca
verses.translation: The trees bear the fruits of all desires. The golden lakes in the mansions, the auspicious wells and tanks are all excellent.
verses.hindi: शजिवभकत्या महाप्राज्ञ भुक्तिं मुक्ति च विन्दति॥ ५४  तथा मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees bear the fruits of all desires. The golden lakes in the mansions, the auspicious wells and tanks are all excellent.
verses.science: शजिवभकत्या महाप्राज्ञ भुक्तिं मुक्ति च विन्दति॥ ५४ तथा मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वप्रायेण महतातीव तप्ते शिलातले । आस्फालयन्ति तरसा वज्रेणेव महाद्रुमान्
verses.transliteration: sarvaprāyeṇa mahatātīva tapte śilātale | āsphālayanti tarasā vajreṇeva mahādrumān
verses.translation: The auspicious drinks of various varieties are proclaimed. There are huge mountains of food-stuffs, gar¬ ments and ornaments.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां मनुविशेषकथनं नाम विंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious drinks of various varieties are proclaimed. There are huge mountains of food-stuffs, gar¬ ments and ornaments.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां मनुविशेषकथनं नाम विंशो5 ध्याय:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स रक्तं श्रोत्रेण स्रवते जर्जरीकृतः । निःसंज्ञः स तदा देही निश्चेष्टः सम्प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa raktaṃ śrotreṇa sravate jarjarīkṛtaḥ | niḥsaṃjñaḥ sa tadā dehī niśceṣṭaḥ samprajāyate
verses.translation: Milk flows in rivers there. There are huge mountains of ghee. The palaces are white in colour. Beds are brilliant like gold.
verses.hindi: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत पाँचवीं उमासंहितामें मन॒विशेषकथन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Milk flows in rivers there. There are huge mountains of ghee. The palaces are white in colour. Beds are brilliant like gold.
verses.science: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत पाँचवीं उमासंहितामें मन॒विशेषकथन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स वायुना स्पृष्टः स तैरुज्जीवितः पुनः । ततः पापविशुद्ध्यर्थं क्षिपन्ति नरकार्णवे
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa vāyunā spṛṣṭaḥ sa tairujjīvitaḥ punaḥ | tataḥ pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṣipanti narakārṇave
verses.translation: The giver of food goes to these regions. One should be a giver of food if one wishes for one's own good in this or in the other world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The giver of food goes to these regions. One should be a giver of food if one wishes for one's own good in this or in the other world.
verses.science: जाते हैं, यह मुझे बतायें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिसङ्ख्याभिः क्षित्यधः सप्तकोटयः । सप्तमस्य तलस्यान्ते घोरे तमसि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyābhiḥ kṣityadhaḥ saptakoṭayaḥ | saptamasya talasyānte ghore tamasi saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: These regions of the meritorious givers of food are very brilliant. Hence food shall be given as gift by the people.
verses.hindi: ४  भ्रष्ट होकर क्षत्रियत्वका सेवन करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: These regions of the meritorious givers of food are very brilliant. Hence food shall be given as gift by the people.
verses.science: ४ भ्रष्ट होकर क्षत्रियत्वका सेवन करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घोराख्या प्रथमा कोटिः सुघोरा तदधः स्थिता । अतिघोरा महाघोरा घोररूपा च पञ्चमी
verses.transliteration: ghorākhyā prathamā koṭiḥ sughorā tadadhaḥ sthitā | atighorā mahāghorā ghorarūpā ca pañcamī
verses.translation: Even after committing a great sin if a man gives food to the needy he becomes rid of all sins. He goes to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after committing a great sin if a man gives food to the needy he becomes rid of all sins. He goes to heaven.
verses.science: स्थानकी रक्षा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठी तलातलाख्या च सप्तमी च भयानका । अष्टमी कालरात्रिश्च नवमी च भयोत्कटा
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhī talātalākhyā ca saptamī ca bhayānakā | aṣṭamī kālarātriśca navamī ca bhayotkaṭā
verses.translation: The eight gifts are honoured most in the land of the dead viz food, drink, horse, cow, garments, bed, umbrella and seat.
verses.hindi: है, वह पुन: क्षत्रिय हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight gifts are honoured most in the land of the dead viz food, drink, horse, cow, garments, bed, umbrella and seat.
verses.science: है, वह पुन: क्षत्रिय हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशमी तदधश्चण्डा महाचण्डा ततोऽप्यधः । चण्डकोलाहला चान्या प्रचण्डा चण्डनायिका
verses.transliteration: daśamī tadadhaścaṇḍā mahācaṇḍā tato'pyadhaḥ | caṇḍakolāhalā cānyā pracaṇḍā caṇḍanāyikā
verses.translation: This sacred narrative gives instances of the virtue of gifts of foodstuflTs; whoever reads this or teaches this to others flourishes indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sacred narrative gives instances of the virtue of gifts of foodstuflTs; whoever reads this or teaches this to others flourishes indeed.
verses.science: ब्राह्मणत्वकी रक्षा करनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्मा पद्मावती भीता भीमा भीषणनायिका । कराला विकराला च वज्रा विंशतिमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: padmā padmāvatī bhītā bhīmā bhīṣaṇanāyikā | karālā vikarālā ca vajrā viṃśatimā smṛtā
verses.translation: O great sage, if a person listens to this or nar¬ rates this at the performance of Sraddha to brahmins, it results in a never-ending gift of food to the Pitri.
verses.hindi: वक्ताओंमें श्रेष् आप उसका वर्णन कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, if a person listens to this or nar¬ rates this at the performance of Sraddha to brahmins, it results in a never-ending gift of food to the Pitri.
verses.science: वक्ताओंमें श्रेष् आप उसका वर्णन कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकोणा पञ्चकोणा च सुदीर्घा चाखिलार्तिदा । समा भीमबलाभोग्रा दीप्तप्रायेति चाष्टमी
verses.transliteration: trikoṇā pañcakoṇā ca sudīrghā cākhilārtidā | samā bhīmabalābhogrā dīptaprāyeti cāṣṭamī
verses.translation: Hence one should make gifts of drinking water¬ sheds lovingly and unrestrictedly. Making of water bases, tanks etc. is the cause of great bliss.
verses.hindi: उसका वर्णन मैं आपसे करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one should make gifts of drinking water¬ sheds lovingly and unrestrictedly. Making of water bases, tanks etc. is the cause of great bliss.
verses.science: उसका वर्णन मैं आपसे करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते नामतः प्रोक्ता घोरा नरककोटयः । अष्टाविंशतिरेवैताः पापानां यातनात्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: iti te nāmataḥ proktā ghorā narakakoṭayaḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatirevaitāḥ pāpānāṃ yātanātmikāḥ
verses.translation: A well that abounds in water removes half of the sin of the man who causes it to be dug.
verses.hindi: गये यज्ञका फल प्राप्त होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: A well that abounds in water removes half of the sin of the man who causes it to be dug.
verses.science: गये यज्ञका फल प्राप्त होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तासां क्रमेण विज्ञेयाः पञ्च पञ्चैव नायकाः । प्रत्येकं सर्वकोटीनां नामतः सन्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ krameṇa vijñeyāḥ pañca pañcaiva nāyakāḥ | pratyekaṃ sarvakoṭīnāṃ nāmataḥ sannibodhata
verses.translation: If cows drink and good men and brahmins make use of the water in a water-base dug by a man, the whole family is redeemed.
verses.hindi: देता है, वह वीर स्वर्गसे नहीं लौटता है
verses.commentary: Sense: If cows drink and good men and brahmins make use of the water in a water-base dug by a man, the whole family is redeemed.
verses.science: देता है, वह वीर स्वर्गसे नहीं लौटता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रौरवः प्रथमस्तेषां रुदन्ते यत्र देहिनः । महारौरवपीडाभिर्महान्तोऽपि रुदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: rauravaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ rudante yatra dehinaḥ | mahārauravapīḍābhirmahānto'pi rudanti ca
verses.translation: He who dig a lake attains an endless merit. The wise say that it is the fruit of virtue, wealth and love.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dig a lake attains an endless merit. The wise say that it is the fruit of virtue, wealth and love.
verses.science: स्वर्गसे नहीं लौटता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः शीतं तथा चोष्णं पञ्चाद्या नायकाः स्मृताः । सुघोरः सुमहातीक्ष्णस्तथा सञ्जीवनः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śītaṃ tathā coṣṇaṃ pañcādyā nāyakāḥ smṛtāḥ | sughoraḥ sumahātīkṣṇastathā sañjīvanaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The gods, human beings, Gandharvas, Pitfs, ser¬ pents, Rakasas and the immobile beings depend upon water bases.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods, human beings, Gandharvas, Pitfs, ser¬ pents, Rakasas and the immobile beings depend upon water bases.
verses.science: करना बहुत ही कठिन है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
