verses.sanskrit: महातमो विलोमश्च विलोपश्चापि कण्टकः । तीव्रवेगः करालश्च विकरालः प्रकम्पनः
verses.transliteration: mahātamo vilomaśca vilopaścāpi kaṇṭakaḥ | tīvravegaḥ karālaśca vikarālaḥ prakampanaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma says that the benefit of the sacred rite Agnihotra is derived by a man in the lake dug by whom there is plenty of water in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: चाहिए और जिसे छोड़ देना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma says that the benefit of the sacred rite Agnihotra is derived by a man in the lake dug by whom there is plenty of water in the rainy season.
verses.science: चाहिए और जिसे छोड़ देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महावक्रश्च कालश्च कालसूत्रः प्रगर्जनः । सूचीमुखः सुनेतिश्च खादकः सुप्रपीडनः
verses.transliteration: mahāvakraśca kālaśca kālasūtraḥ pragarjanaḥ | sūcīmukhaḥ sunetiśca khādakaḥ suprapīḍanaḥ
verses.translation: O sage Vyasa, the merit accruing from the dig¬ ging of water bases, excellent and pleasing to all living beings, has been narrated to you. Now listen to the merits of planting trees.
verses.hindi: - जृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यागुमासंहितायां रणफ़लवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage Vyasa, the merit accruing from the dig¬ ging of water bases, excellent and pleasing to all living beings, has been narrated to you. Now listen to the merits of planting trees.
verses.science: - जृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यागुमासंहितायां रणफ़लवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भीपाकसुपाकौ च क्रकचश्चातिदारुणः । अङ्गारराशिभवनं मेदोऽसृक्प्रहितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: kumbhīpākasupākau ca krakacaścātidāruṇaḥ | aṅgārarāśibhavanaṃ medo'sṛkprahitastataḥ
verses.translation: If a man plants trees in the forests, he enables his ancestors and the successors of his family, to gain redemption. Hence one should plant trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man plants trees in the forests, he enables his ancestors and the successors of his family, to gain redemption. Hence one should plant trees.
verses.science: नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णतुण्डश्च शकुनिर्महासंवर्तकः क्रतुः । तप्तजन्तुः पङ्कलेपः प्रतिमांसस्त्रपूद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇatuṇḍaśca śakunirmahāsaṃvartakaḥ kratuḥ | taptajantuḥ paṅkalepaḥ pratimāṃsastrapūdbhavaḥ
verses.translation: The Kinnaras, the serpents, the Raksasas, the gods, the Gandharvas, the human beings and the sages depend upon trees.
verses.hindi: जो मुमुक्षुजनके संसाररूप बन्धनको काटनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kinnaras, the serpents, the Raksasas, the gods, the Gandharvas, the human beings and the sages depend upon trees.
verses.science: जो मुमुक्षुजनके संसाररूप बन्धनको काटनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्वासः सुनिरुच्छ्वासो सुदीर्घः कूटशाल्मलिः । दुरिष्टः सुमहावादः प्रवाहः सुप्रतापनः
verses.transliteration: ucchvāsaḥ sunirucchvāso sudīrghaḥ kūṭaśālmaliḥ | duriṣṭaḥ sumahāvādaḥ pravāhaḥ supratāpanaḥ
verses.translation: While in bloom or when they bear fruits, the trees delight human beings. They are as sons by way of virtue in this world and hereafter.
verses.hindi: प्रेरित हुई अग्नि जलको उष्ण करती है
verses.commentary: Sense: While in bloom or when they bear fruits, the trees delight human beings. They are as sons by way of virtue in this world and hereafter.
verses.science: प्रेरित हुई अग्नि जलको उष्ण करती है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो मेघो वृषः शाल्मः सिंहव्याघ्रगजाननाः । श्वसूकराजमहिषघूककोकवृकाननाः
verses.transliteration: tato megho vṛṣaḥ śālmaḥ siṃhavyāghragajānanāḥ | śvasūkarājamahiṣaghūkakokavṛkānanāḥ
verses.translation: These people never fail to attain heaven—viz. the digger of lakes, the planter of trees, the brahmin who performs sacrifices and those who speak truth.
verses.hindi: प्राण रससे उन नाड़ियोंको सन्तृप्त करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: These people never fail to attain heaven—viz. the digger of lakes, the planter of trees, the brahmin who performs sacrifices and those who speak truth.
verses.science: प्राण रससे उन नाड़ियोंको सन्तृप्त करता है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्राहकुम्भीननक्राख्याः सर्पकूर्माख्यवायसाः । गृध्रोलूकहलौकाख्याः शार्दूलक्रथकर्कटाः
verses.transliteration: grāhakumbhīnanakrākhyāḥ sarpakūrmākhyavāyasāḥ | gṛdhrolūkahalaukākhyāḥ śārdūlakrathakarkaṭāḥ
verses.translation: Penance, sacrifice, merit, the worship of the gods, sages and the Pitys, the Waters, theVidyas—all these things are established in truth.
verses.hindi: सभी अंकुरसन्धियाँ जोड़ बन जाती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Penance, sacrifice, merit, the worship of the gods, sages and the Pitys, the Waters, theVidyas—all these things are established in truth.
verses.science: सभी अंकुरसन्धियाँ जोड़ बन जाती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मण्डूकः पूतिवक्त्राश्च रक्ताक्षः पूतिमृत्तिकाः । कणधूम्रस्तथाग्निश्च कृमिगन्धिवपुस्तथा
verses.transliteration: maṇḍūkaḥ pūtivaktrāśca raktākṣaḥ pūtimṛttikāḥ | kaṇadhūmrastathāgniśca kṛmigandhivapustathā
verses.translation: By upholding truth the people can attain the benefits of keeping up the traditions of all the Vedas and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: By upholding truth the people can attain the benefits of keeping up the traditions of all the Vedas and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all holy centres.
verses.science: प्रकट हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीध्रश्चाप्रतिष्ठश्च रुधिराभः श्वभोजनः । लालाभक्षान्त्रभक्षौ च सर्वभक्षः सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: agnīdhraścāpratiṣṭhaśca rudhirābhaḥ śvabhojanaḥ | lālābhakṣāntrabhakṣau ca sarvabhakṣaḥ sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: When weighed against truth in a balance, a thou¬ sand hdrse-sacrifices and a hundred thousand other sacrifices do not equal it. Truth alone excels.
verses.hindi: अंगोंमें जो सन्धियाँ हैं--ये सब उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: When weighed against truth in a balance, a thou¬ sand hdrse-sacrifices and a hundred thousand other sacrifices do not equal it. Truth alone excels.
verses.science: अंगोंमें जो सन्धियाँ हैं--ये सब उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कण्टकः सुविशालश्च विकटः कटपूतनः । अम्बरीषः कटाहश्च कष्टा वैतरणी नदी
verses.transliteration: kaṇṭakaḥ suviśālaśca vikaṭaḥ kaṭapūtanaḥ | ambarīṣaḥ kaṭāhaśca kaṣṭā vaitaraṇī nadī
verses.translation: The gods, the Pitrs, the human beings, the serpents, the Rakasas and the worlds including the mobile and immobile beings are delighted by Truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods, the Pitrs, the human beings, the serpents, the Rakasas and the worlds including the mobile and immobile beings are delighted by Truth.
verses.science: उदरमें स्थित रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुतप्तलोहशयन एकपादः प्रपूरणः । असितालवनं घोरमस्थिभङ्गः सुपूरणः
verses.transliteration: sutaptalohaśayana ekapādaḥ prapūraṇaḥ | asitālavanaṃ ghoramasthibhaṅgaḥ supūraṇaḥ
verses.translation: After performing very difficult penance, it is by depending solely on Truth, by maintaining truthful virtue that the sages have attained Siddhis and reached heaven.
verses.hindi: सुख, दुःख, निद्रा एवं स्वप्नको जानने लगता है
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing very difficult penance, it is by depending solely on Truth, by maintaining truthful virtue that the sages have attained Siddhis and reached heaven.
verses.science: सुख, दुःख, निद्रा एवं स्वप्नको जानने लगता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विलातसोऽसुयन्त्रोपि कूटपाशः प्रमर्दनः । महाचूरर्णोऽसुचूर्णोऽपि तप्तलोहमयं तथा
verses.transliteration: vilātaso'suyantropi kūṭapāśaḥ pramardanaḥ | mahācūrarṇo'sucūrṇo'pi taptalohamayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The sages have attained heaven travelling in aerial chariots along with the celestial damsels. Truth shall be ever spoken, for there is nothing greater than Truth.
verses.hindi: हुआ जीव भी बड़े दु:ःखसे स्थित रहता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages have attained heaven travelling in aerial chariots along with the celestial damsels. Truth shall be ever spoken, for there is nothing greater than Truth.
verses.science: हुआ जीव भी बड़े दु:ःखसे स्थित रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतः क्षुरधारा च तथा यमलपर्वतः । मूत्रविष्ठाश्रुकूपश्च क्षारकूपश्च शीतलः
verses.transliteration: parvataḥ kṣuradhārā ca tathā yamalaparvataḥ | mūtraviṣṭhāśrukūpaśca kṣārakūpaśca śītalaḥ
verses.translation: In the deep, extensive and pure eddy, the holy centre of Truth, one shall mentally take one*s ceremonial ablution. That i$ said to be the highest bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the deep, extensive and pure eddy, the holy centre of Truth, one shall mentally take one*s ceremonial ablution. That i$ said to be the highest bliss.
verses.science: सर्वदा व्याकुल रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुसलोलूखलं यन्त्रं शिलाशकटलाङ्गलम् । तालपत्रासिगहनं महाशकटमण्डपम्
verses.transliteration: musalolūkhalaṃ yantraṃ śilāśakaṭalāṅgalam | tālapatrāsigahanaṃ mahāśakaṭamaṇḍapam
verses.translation: The Veda's, the sacrifices and the Mantras exist in
verses.hindi: तथा बहुत संकट देनेवाला होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The Veda's, the sacrifices and the Mantras exist in
verses.science: तथा बहुत संकट देनेवाला होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्मोहमस्थिभङ्गश्च तप्तश्चलमयोगुडम् । बहुदुःखं महाक्लेशः कश्मलं समलं मलात्
verses.transliteration: sammohamasthibhaṅgaśca taptaścalamayoguḍam | bahuduḥkhaṃ mahākleśaḥ kaśmalaṃ samalaṃ malāt
verses.translation: O ascetic, please explain again with special em¬ phasis on the fruit of penance for the brahmins as well as other castes.
verses.hindi: प्रहार होनेसे उन पापियोंको दुःख होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O ascetic, please explain again with special em¬ phasis on the fruit of penance for the brahmins as well as other castes.
verses.science: प्रहार होनेसे उन पापियोंको दुःख होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हालाहलो विरूपश्च स्वरूपश्च यमानुगः । एकपादस्त्रिपादश्च तीव्रश्चाचीवरं तमः
verses.transliteration: hālāhalo virūpaśca svarūpaśca yamānugaḥ | ekapādastripādaśca tīvraścācīvaraṃ tamaḥ
verses.translation: I shall explain the section on penance which is the means of achieving all the objects of desire, very difficult to be performed even by brahmins. Please listen even as I explain.
verses.hindi: अपवित्र शरीररूपी घर कर्मबन्धनसे विनिर्मित है
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain the section on penance which is the means of achieving all the objects of desire, very difficult to be performed even by brahmins. Please listen even as I explain.
verses.science: अपवित्र शरीररूपी घर कर्मबन्धनसे विनिर्मित है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिरित्येते क्रमशः पञ्चपञ्चकम् । कोटीनामानुपूर्व्येण पञ्च पञ्चैव नायकाः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāviṃśatirityete kramaśaḥ pañcapañcakam | koṭīnāmānupūrvyeṇa pañca pañcaiva nāyakāḥ
verses.translation: Heaven, fame and love arc achieved through penance. Penance is the means of achievement for all objects.
verses.hindi: डति श्रीशिवमहाएरणे पदश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां देहोत्पत्तिवर्ण॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Heaven, fame and love arc achieved through penance. Penance is the means of achievement for all objects.
verses.science: डति श्रीशिवमहाएरणे पदश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां देहोत्पत्तिवर्ण॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: रौरवाय प्रबोध्यन्ते नरकाणां शतं स्मृतम् । चत्वारिंशच्च तत्प्रोक्तं महानरकमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: rauravāya prabodhyante narakāṇāṃ śataṃ smṛtam | catvāriṃśacca tatproktaṃ mahānarakamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: One achieves great things through penance. One attains salvation, knowledge, perfect wisdom, good fortune and beauty by penance.
verses.hindi: है, इसलिये इसे अपवित्र कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: One achieves great things through penance. One attains salvation, knowledge, perfect wisdom, good fortune and beauty by penance.
verses.science: है, इसलिये इसे अपवित्र कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते व्यास सम्प्रोक्ता नरकस्य स्थितिर्मया । प्रसङ्ख्यानाच्च वैराग्यं शृणु पापगतिं च ताम्
verses.transliteration: iti te vyāsa samproktā narakasya sthitirmayā | prasaṅkhyānācca vairāgyaṃ śṛṇu pāpagatiṃ ca tām
verses.translation: Man obtains different things through penance; he gets everything, whatever he wishes in his mind through penance.
verses.hindi: अधिक अपवित्र और क्या हो सकता है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: Man obtains different things through penance; he gets everything, whatever he wishes in his mind through penance.
verses.science: अधिक अपवित्र और क्या हो सकता है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Knowledge, perfect wisdom, health, beauty, good fortune and perpetual happiness are the offshoots of penance.
verses.hindi: कौन-सा कारण बताया जा सकता है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowledge, perfect wisdom, health, beauty, good fortune and perpetual happiness are the offshoots of penance.
verses.science: कौन-सा कारण बताया जा सकता है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Knowledge, perfect wisdom, health, beauty, good fortune and perpetual happiness are the offshoots of penance.
verses.hindi: भावदुष्ट होनेपर वह शुद्ध नहीं होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowledge, perfect wisdom, health, beauty, good fortune and perpetual happiness are the offshoots of penance.
verses.science: भावदुष्ट होनेपर वह शुद्ध नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । नरकगतिवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । एषु पापाः प्रपच्यन्ते शोष्यन्ते नरकाग्निषु । यातनाभिर्विचित्राभिरास्वकर्मक्षयाद् भृशम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.9. navamo'dhyāyaḥ | narakagativarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | eṣu pāpāḥ prapacyante śoṣyante narakāgniṣu | yātanābhirvicitrābhirāsvakarmakṣayād bhṛśam
verses.translation: O great sage, the Ksatriya king Visvamitra,*®* the son of Gadhi, became a brahmin through penance. This is well known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: खाल कभी शुद्ध हो सकती है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, the Ksatriya king Visvamitra,*®* the son of Gadhi, became a brahmin through penance. This is well known in the three worlds.
verses.science: खाल कभी शुद्ध हो सकती है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वमलप्रक्षयाद्यद्वदग्नौ धास्यन्ति धातवः । तत्र पापक्षयात्पापा नराः कर्मानुरूपतः
verses.transliteration: svamalaprakṣayādyadvadagnau dhāsyanti dhātavaḥ | tatra pāpakṣayātpāpā narāḥ karmānurūpataḥ
verses.translation: That man derives the fruit of horse-sacrifice, and realises all his cherished desires without wastage, both here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: अपना परम कल्याण नहीं देखता है
verses.commentary: Sense: That man derives the fruit of horse-sacrifice, and realises all his cherished desires without wastage, both here and hereafter.
verses.science: अपना परम कल्याण नहीं देखता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुगाढं हस्तयोर्बद्ध्वा ततः शृङ्खलया नराः । महावृक्षाग्रशाखासु लम्ब्यन्ते यमकिङ्करैः
verses.transliteration: sugāḍhaṃ hastayorbaddhvā tataḥ śṛṅkhalayā narāḥ | mahāvṛkṣāgraśākhāsu lambyante yamakiṅkaraiḥ
verses.translation: O sage, by listening to the story of Siva one derives the benefit and merit derived from ablution in the sacred rivers and from gifting away a crore of cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, by listening to the story of Siva one derives the benefit and merit derived from ablution in the sacred rivers and from gifting away a crore of cows.
verses.science: अशक्तत्वाहुराधपैभत्यैश् किया जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते सर्वयत्नेन क्षिप्ता दोलन्ति किङ्करैः । दोम्यन्तश्चातिवेगेन विसंज्ञा यान्ति योजनम्
verses.transliteration: tataste sarvayatnena kṣiptā dolanti kiṅkaraiḥ | domyantaścātivegena visaṃjñā yānti yojanam
verses.translation: Hence indeed, the Puranas shall be assiduously listened to for the achievement of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence indeed, the Puranas shall be assiduously listened to for the achievement of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.science: वशमें रहती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षस्थितानां च लोहभारशतं पुनः । पादयोर्बध्यते तेषां यमदूतैर्महाबलैः
verses.transliteration: antarikṣasthitānāṃ ca lohabhāraśataṃ punaḥ | pādayorbadhyate teṣāṃ yamadūtairmahābalaiḥ
verses.translation: These things shall be given everyday to those who beg for them—viz. oxen, cows, umbrella, cloth, pairs of shoes, drink and food.
verses.commentary: Sense: These things shall be given everyday to those who beg for them—viz. oxen, cows, umbrella, cloth, pairs of shoes, drink and food.
verses.science: और क्या सुनना चाहते हैं ?2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन भारेण महता प्रभृशं ताडिता नराः । ध्यायन्ति स्वानि कर्माणि तूष्णीं तिष्ठन्ति निश्चलाः
verses.transliteration: tena bhāreṇa mahatā prabhṛśaṃ tāḍitā narāḥ | dhyāyanti svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhanti niścalāḥ
verses.translation: There are ten great gifts—viz. gold, gingelly seeds, elephants, virgins, servant-maid, house, chariot, jewels, the tawny coloured cow and ordinary cows.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्ञम्यागुमासंहितायां स्त्रीस्वभाववर्णन॑ नाग चदुर्विशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: There are ten great gifts—viz. gold, gingelly seeds, elephants, virgins, servant-maid, house, chariot, jewels, the tawny coloured cow and ordinary cows.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्ञम्यागुमासंहितायां स्त्रीस्वभाववर्णन॑ नाग चदुर्विशो5 ध्याय:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽङ्कुशैरग्निवर्णैर्लोहदण्डैश्च दारुणैः । हन्यन्ते किङ्करैघोरैः समन्तात्पापकर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: tato'ṅkuśairagnivarṇairlohadaṇḍaiśca dāruṇaiḥ | hanyante kiṅkaraighoraiḥ samantātpāpakarmiṇaḥ
verses.translation: After taking all these a brahmin of great wisdom enables the donee to cross the ocean of worldly existence as well as himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking all these a brahmin of great wisdom enables the donee to cross the ocean of worldly existence as well as himself.
verses.science: नामक चौबीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन वह्नेरपि विशेषतः । समन्ततः प्रलिप्यन्ते तीव्रेण तु पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena vahnerapi viśeṣataḥ | samantataḥ pralipyante tīvreṇa tu punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: If men make gifts of gold with pious mind, the gods bestow the same on him. Thus I have heard.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा नानाकथां दिव्यां प्रसन्‍ना सुप्रणम्य तम्॥ २  भी शंकरको प्रणामकर उनसे यही पूछा था
verses.commentary: Sense: If men make gifts of gold with pious mind, the gods bestow the same on him. Thus I have heard.
verses.science: श्रुत्वा नानाकथां दिव्यां प्रसन्‍ना सुप्रणम्य तम्॥ २ भी शंकरको प्रणामकर उनसे यही पूछा था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्रुतेनात्यन्तलिप्तेन कृत्ताङ्गा जर्जरीकृताः । पुनर्विदार्य चाङ्गानि शिरसः प्रभृति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: drutenātyantaliptena kṛttāṅgā jarjarīkṛtāḥ | punarvidārya cāṅgāni śirasaḥ prabhṛti kramāt
verses.translation: If plots of lands are given along with gold it is praiseworthy. They become liberated from all sins and attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: तो छ: मासके भीतर मृत्युको जानना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: If plots of lands are given along with gold it is praiseworthy. They become liberated from all sins and attain the greatest goal.
verses.science: तो छ: मासके भीतर मृत्युको जानना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृन्ताकवत्प्रपच्यन्ते तप्तलोहकटाहकैः । विष्ठापूर्णे तथा कूपे कृमीणां निचये पुनः
verses.transliteration: vṛntākavatprapacyante taptalohakaṭāhakaiḥ | viṣṭhāpūrṇe tathā kūpe kṛmīṇāṃ nicaye punaḥ
verses.translation: O intelligent one, thus the excellent glory of penance has been mentioned to you. Now listen to the glory of the study of the Vedas which is far more excellent than penance itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, thus the excellent glory of penance has been mentioned to you. Now listen to the glory of the study of the Vedas which is far more excellent than penance itself.
verses.science: ऐसा हमलोग कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मेदोऽसृक्पूयपूर्णायां वाप्यां क्षिप्यन्ति ते पुनः । भक्ष्यन्ते कृमिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्लोहतुण्डैश्च वायसैः
verses.transliteration: medo'sṛkpūyapūrṇāyāṃ vāpyāṃ kṣipyanti te punaḥ | bhakṣyante kṛmibhistīkṣṇairlohatuṇḍaiśca vāyasaiḥ
verses.translation: The sage V'Uvamitra vvas the son of Gathln or G&dhi of the Kusika race descended from Kusika. He is called Gdhi'ja and Oidhi- nandana. He was born a ksatriya but by intense austerities raised him¬ self to the Bruhniaia caste and became one of the seven great sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage V'Uvamitra vvas the son of Gathln or G&dhi of the Kusika race descended from Kusika. He is called Gdhi'ja and Oidhi- nandana. He was born a ksatriya but by intense austerities raised him¬ self to the Bruhniaia caste and became one of the seven great sages.
verses.science: अन्य भाव रखती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्वभिर्देंशैर्वृकैर्व्याघ्रै रौद्रैश्च विकृताननैः । पच्यन्ते मत्स्यवच्चापि प्रदीप्ताङ्गारराशिषु
verses.transliteration: śvabhirdeṃśairvṛkairvyāghrai raudraiśca vikṛtānanaiḥ | pacyante matsyavaccāpi pradīptāṅgārarāśiṣu
verses.translation: By teaching the Veda, an excellent brahmin attains twice the merit that he attains by studying it.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य रुचिपूर्वक नहीं खा सकता है
verses.commentary: Sense: By teaching the Veda, an excellent brahmin attains twice the merit that he attains by studying it.
verses.science: मनुष्य रुचिपूर्वक नहीं खा सकता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नाः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैश्च नराः पापेन कर्मणा । तैलयन्त्रेषु चाक्रम्य घोरैः कर्मभिरात्मनः
verses.transliteration: bhinnāḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiśca narāḥ pāpena karmaṇā | tailayantreṣu cākramya ghoraiḥ karmabhirātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The universe will go without light if the moon and the sun were not present. The same will happen if the Puraias too, O sage, were not.
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe will go without light if the moon and the sun were not present. The same will happen if the Puraias too, O sage, were not.
verses.science: मिलनेवाले लोक प्राप्त होते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तिला इव प्रपीड्यन्ते चक्राख्ये जनपिण्डकाः । भ्रज्यन्ते चातपे तप्तलोहभाण्डेष्वनेकधा
verses.transliteration: tilā iva prapīḍyante cakrākhye janapiṇḍakāḥ | bhrajyante cātape taptalohabhāṇḍeṣvanekadhā
verses.translation: A Puranist enlightens the people through iSastras, the people who are in distress in the hell due to ignorance. Hence he shall be worshipped.
verses.hindi: ऐसे केलेके वृक्षकी भाँति यह नि:सार है
verses.commentary: Sense: A Puranist enlightens the people through iSastras, the people who are in distress in the hell due to ignorance. Hence he shall be worshipped.
verses.science: ऐसे केलेके वृक्षकी भाँति यह नि:सार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तैलपूर्णकटाहेषु सुतप्तेषु पुनःपुनः । बहुधा पच्यते जिह्वा प्रपीड्योरसि पादयोः
verses.transliteration: tailapūrṇakaṭāheṣu sutapteṣu punaḥpunaḥ | bahudhā pacyate jihvā prapīḍyorasi pādayoḥ
verses.translation: Among all the deserving men the knower of Purana is the most excellent. He is considered worthy because he saves people from fall
verses.hindi: निर्मल बुद्धिसे युक्त हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Among all the deserving men the knower of Purana is the most excellent. He is considered worthy because he saves people from fall
verses.science: निर्मल बुद्धिसे युक्त हो जाता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यातनाश्च महत्योऽत्र शरीरस्याति सर्वतः । निःशेषनरकेष्वेवं क्रमन्ति क्रमशो नराः
verses.transliteration: yātanāśca mahatyo'tra śarīrasyāti sarvataḥ | niḥśeṣanarakeṣvevaṃ kramanti kramaśo narāḥ
verses.translation: Never shall a Puranist be considered an ordinary man. A preceptor proficient in Purana is omniscient. He is Brahma, Vi$nu and Siva.
verses.hindi: मानकर इसे दृढ़तासे पकड़े रहता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Never shall a Puranist be considered an ordinary man. A preceptor proficient in Purana is omniscient. He is Brahma, Vi$nu and Siva.
verses.science: मानकर इसे दृढ़तासे पकड़े रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नरकेषु च सर्वेषु विचित्रा यमयातनाः । याम्यैश्च दीयते व्यास सर्वाङ्गेषु सुकष्टदाः
verses.transliteration: narakeṣu ca sarveṣu vicitrā yamayātanāḥ | yāmyaiśca dīyate vyāsa sarvāṅgeṣu sukaṣṭadāḥ
verses.translation: For the welfare here and hereafter, wealth food- grain, gold, different clothes etc. shall be given to a Puranist as gift.
verses.hindi: महाकष्टदायक जन्म-दु:खका वर्णन मैंने कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: For the welfare here and hereafter, wealth food- grain, gold, different clothes etc. shall be given to a Puranist as gift.
verses.science: महाकष्टदायक जन्म-दु:खका वर्णन मैंने कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलदङ्गारमादाय मुखमापूर्य ताड्यते । ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन ताम्रेण च पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: jvaladaṅgāramādāya mukhamāpūrya tāḍyate | tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena tāmreṇa ca punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: The good man who out of pleasure gives auspicious things to a Purai;iist who is a deserving person, attains the greatest salvation.
verses.hindi: ममतावश लाखों लोग इसमें बँधे रह गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The good man who out of pleasure gives auspicious things to a Purai;iist who is a deserving person, attains the greatest salvation.
verses.science: ममतावश लाखों लोग इसमें बँधे रह गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घृतेनात्यन्ततप्तेन तदा तैलेन तन्मुखम् । इतस्ततः पीडयित्वा भृशमापूर्य हन्यते
verses.transliteration: ghṛtenātyantataptena tadā tailena tanmukham | itastataḥ pīḍayitvā bhṛśamāpūrya hanyate
verses.translation: Listen to the merit that a person derives from lands, cows, chariots, elephants and good horses to a deserving person.
verses.hindi: कर देनेवाले दुःखसे नष्ट हो जाती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the merit that a person derives from lands, cows, chariots, elephants and good horses to a deserving person.
verses.science: कर देनेवाले दुःखसे नष्ट हो जाती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्ठाभिः कृमिभिश्चापि पूर्यमाणाः क्वचित् क्वचित् । परिष्वजन्ति चात्युग्रां प्रदीप्तां लोहशाल्मलीम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṭhābhiḥ kṛmibhiścāpi pūryamāṇāḥ kvacit kvacit | pariṣvajanti cātyugrāṃ pradīptāṃ lohaśālmalīm
verses.translation: He who gives him a good fertile and well ploughed land facilitates the redemption of the members of his family upto ten generations before him and after him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives him a good fertile and well ploughed land facilitates the redemption of the members of his family upto ten generations before him and after him.
verses.science: गर्भकलेश प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हन्यन्ते पृष्ठदेशे च पुनर्दीप्तैर्महाघनैः । दन्तुरेणादिकुण्ठेन क्रकचेन बलीसया
verses.transliteration: hanyante pṛṣṭhadeśe ca punardīptairmahāghanaiḥ | dantureṇādikuṇṭhena krakacena balīsayā
verses.translation: After enjoying all the pleasures here, he becomes endowed with a divine body on death and goes to iSivaloka, by a divine aerial chariot.
verses.hindi: नहीं कर पाते, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है!
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying all the pleasures here, he becomes endowed with a divine body on death and goes to iSivaloka, by a divine aerial chariot.
verses.science: नहीं कर पाते, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है!। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरःप्रभृति पीड्यन्ते घोरैः कर्मभिरात्मजैः । खाद्यन्ते च स्वमांसानि पीयते शोणितं स्वकम्
verses.transliteration: śiraḥprabhṛti pīḍyante ghoraiḥ karmabhirātmajaiḥ | khādyante ca svamāṃsāni pīyate śoṇitaṃ svakam
verses.translation: The gods are not satisfied so much with sacrifices, Prokaakas (immolations of animals at the sacrifices), oblations and floral worships as with the recitation of book.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods are not satisfied so much with sacrifices, Prokaakas (immolations of animals at the sacrifices), oblations and floral worships as with the recitation of book.
verses.science: भक्षण भी करता रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं पानं न दत्तं यैः सर्वदा स्वात्मपोषकैः । इक्षुवत्ते प्रपीड्यन्ते जर्जरीकृत्य मुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: annaṃ pānaṃ na dattaṃ yaiḥ sarvadā svātmapoṣakaiḥ | ikṣuvatte prapīḍyante jarjarīkṛtya mudgaraiḥ
verses.translation: Listen to the meritorious benefits of that man who
verses.hindi: नहीं करता, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है!
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the meritorious benefits of that man who
verses.science: नहीं करता, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है!। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असितालवने घोरे छिद्यन्ते खण्डशस्ततः । सूचीभिर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गाः तप्तशूलाग्ररोपिताः
verses.transliteration: asitālavane ghore chidyante khaṇḍaśastataḥ | sūcībhirbhinnasarvāṅgāḥ taptaśūlāgraropitāḥ
verses.translation: The man derives the benefit of Rajasuyae®** and Avamedhas. Piercing through the sun's sphere he goes to to the Brahmaloka
verses.hindi: बादमें उसके निरन्तर प्राप्त न होनेपर सुख कहाँ 2
verses.commentary: Sense: The man derives the benefit of Rajasuyae®** and Avamedhas. Piercing through the sun's sphere he goes to to the Brahmaloka
verses.science: बादमें उसके निरन्तर प्राप्त न होनेपर सुख कहाँ 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सञ्चाल्यमाना बहुशः क्लिश्यन्ते न म्रियन्ति च । तथा च तच्छरीराणि सुखदुःखसहानि च
verses.transliteration: sañcālyamānā bahuśaḥ kliśyante na mriyanti ca | tathā ca taccharīrāṇi sukhaduḥkhasahāni ca
verses.translation: After remaining there for hundreds of Kalpas he becomes a king on the earth. He enjoys the pleasures without pinpricks. No hesitation need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: मनमें आने ही न दिया जाय)
verses.commentary: Sense: After remaining there for hundreds of Kalpas he becomes a king on the earth. He enjoys the pleasures without pinpricks. No hesitation need be entertained in this regard.
verses.science: मनमें आने ही न दिया जाय)। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देहादुत्पाट्य मांसानि भिद्यन्ते स्वैश्च मुद्गरैः । दन्तुराकृतिभिर्घोरैर्यमदूतैर्बलोत्कटैः
verses.transliteration: dehādutpāṭya māṃsāni bhidyante svaiśca mudgaraiḥ | danturākṛtibhirghorairyamadūtairbalotkaṭaiḥ
verses.translation: He who performs Japas in front of the deity obtains that benefit which is mentioned as the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तिको भी होता है, ऐसा विद्वजन कहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs Japas in front of the deity obtains that benefit which is mentioned as the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.
verses.science: व्यक्तिको भी होता है, ऐसा विद्वजन कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निरुच्छ्वासे निरुच्छ्वासास्तिष्ठन्ति नरके चिरम् । उत्ताड्यन्ते तथोच्छ्वासे वालुकासदने नराः
verses.transliteration: nirucchvāse nirucchvāsāstiṣṭhanti narake ciram | uttāḍyante tathocchvāse vālukāsadane narāḥ
verses.translation: Hence arrangements shall be assiduously made for the reciting of the book. Listening to it with devotion and love yields the fruit of all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: मानना चाहिए, उनमें उससे अधिक सुख नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence arrangements shall be assiduously made for the reciting of the book. Listening to it with devotion and love yields the fruit of all cherished desires.
verses.science: मानना चाहिए, उनमें उससे अधिक सुख नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रौरवे रोदमानाश्च पीड्यन्ते विविधैर्वधैः । महारौरवपीडाभिर्महान्तोऽपि रुदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: raurave rodamānāśca pīḍyante vividhairvadhaiḥ | mahārauravapīḍābhirmahānto'pi rudanti ca
verses.translation: Man becomes free from sins on listening to Siva- purana. After enjoying immense pleasures he attains the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: सुख नहीं है--ऐसा पंचचूडाने कहा था
verses.commentary: Sense: Man becomes free from sins on listening to Siva- purana. After enjoying immense pleasures he attains the world of Siva.
verses.science: सुख नहीं है--ऐसा पंचचूडाने कहा था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पत्सु वक्त्रे गुदे मुण्डे नेत्रयोश्चैव मस्तके । निहन्यन्ते घनैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुतप्तैर्लोहशङ्कुभिः
verses.transliteration: patsu vaktre gude muṇḍe netrayoścaiva mastake | nihanyante ghanaistīkṣṇaiḥ sutaptairlohaśaṅkubhiḥ
verses.translation: Merely by listening to the story of Siva one derives the merit similar to that resulting from Rajasuya and a hundred Agnitoma rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Merely by listening to the story of Siva one derives the merit similar to that resulting from Rajasuya and a hundred Agnitoma rites.
verses.science: कार्योमें अक्षम हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुतप्तवालुकायां तु प्रयोज्यन्ते मुहुर्मुहुः । जन्तुपङ्के भृशं तप्ते क्षिप्ताः क्रन्दन्ति विस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sutaptavālukāyāṃ tu prayojyante muhurmuhuḥ | jantupaṅke bhṛśaṃ tapte kṣiptāḥ krandanti visvaram
verses.translation: Those who constantly listen to Siva's story that sanctifies the worlds are not mere human beings, they are Rudras. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: अशक्तः साधितु तस्माद्मुवा धर्म समाचरेत्॥ ६५  यौवनावस्थामें ही धर्माचरण कर लेना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who constantly listen to Siva's story that sanctifies the worlds are not mere human beings, they are Rudras. There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: अशक्तः साधितु तस्माद्मुवा धर्म समाचरेत्॥ ६५ यौवनावस्थामें ही धर्माचरण कर लेना चाहिए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भीपाकेषु पच्यन्ते तप्ततैलेषु वै मुने । पापिनः क्रूरकर्माणोऽसह्येषु सर्वथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: kumbhīpākeṣu pacyante taptataileṣu vai mune | pāpinaḥ krūrakarmāṇo'sahyeṣu sarvathā punaḥ
verses.translation: Sages consider the dust in the lotus-feet of those
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages consider the dust in the lotus-feet of those
verses.science: हु: खवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: लालाभक्षेषु पापास्ते पात्यन्ते दुःखदेषु वै । नानास्थानेषु च तथा नरकेषु पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: lālābhakṣeṣu pāpāste pātyante duḥkhadeṣu vai | nānāsthāneṣu ca tathā narakeṣu punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Let those embodied beings who desire to attain salvation listen always the Puranic story of Siva with devotion.
verses.hindi: बाल्याद्यवस्थादु:खवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Let those embodied beings who desire to attain salvation listen always the Puranic story of Siva with devotion.
verses.science: बाल्याद्यवस्थादु:खवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सूचीमुखे महाक्लेशे नरके पात्यते नरः । पापी पुण्यविहीनश्च ताड्यते यमकिङ्करैः
verses.transliteration: sūcīmukhe mahākleśe narake pātyate naraḥ | pāpī puṇyavihīnaśca tāḍyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, he who regularly listens to Siva*s story crosses the ocean of worldly existence after burning away the great forest of Karman.
verses.hindi: तन्मे ब्रृहे समासेन यदि तुष्टोउसि में मुने॥ १  कहा है, उसे संक्षेपमें मुझसे कहिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, he who regularly listens to Siva*s story crosses the ocean of worldly existence after burning away the great forest of Karman.
verses.science: तन्मे ब्रृहे समासेन यदि तुष्टोउसि में मुने॥ १ कहा है, उसे संक्षेपमें मुझसे कहिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोहकुम्भे विनिःक्षिप्ताः श्वसन्तश्च शनैः शनैः । महाग्निना प्रपच्यन्ते स्वपापैरेव मानवाः
verses.transliteration: lohakumbhe viniḥkṣiptāḥ śvasantaśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | mahāgninā prapacyante svapāpaireva mānavāḥ
verses.translation: No mishap befalls those men who listen to Siva*s story even for a Muhurta, or half that time or even for a moment with devotion.
verses.hindi: अस्थ श्रवणमात्रेण भरवेद्वैराग्यमुत्तमम्॥ २ सुनने-मात्रसे उत्तम वैराग्य हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: No mishap befalls those men who listen to Siva*s story even for a Muhurta, or half that time or even for a moment with devotion.
verses.science: अस्थ श्रवणमात्रेण भरवेद्वैराग्यमुत्तमम्॥ २ सुनने-मात्रसे उत्तम वैराग्य हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृढं रज्ज्वादिभिर्बद्ध्वा प्रपीड्यन्ते शिलासु च । क्षिप्यन्ते चान्धकूपेषु दश्यन्ते भ्रमरैर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: dṛḍhaṃ rajjvādibhirbaddhvā prapīḍyante śilāsu ca | kṣipyante cāndhakūpeṣu daśyante bhramarairbhṛśam
verses.translation: O sage, certainly the fruit derived from listening to Sivapurana is the same as that derived from making all charitable gifts or from performing all sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, certainly the fruit derived from listening to Sivapurana is the same as that derived from making all charitable gifts or from performing all sacrifices.
verses.science: नहीं करनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृमिभिर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गाः शतशो जर्जरीकृताः । सुतीक्ष्णक्षारकूपेषु क्षिप्यन्ते तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: kṛmibhirbhinnasarvāṅgāḥ śataśo jarjarīkṛtāḥ | sutīkṣṇakṣārakūpeṣu kṣipyante tadanantaram
verses.translation: O Vyasa, especially in the age of Kali there is no greater virtue aimed at salvation and meditation than listening to the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, especially in the age of Kali there is no greater virtue aimed at salvation and meditation than listening to the Puranas.
verses.science: प्रश्नोंका उत्तर दूँगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महाज्वालेऽत्र नरके पापाः क्रन्दन्ति दुःखिताः । इतश्चेतश्च धावन्ति दह्यमानास्तदर्चिषा
verses.transliteration: mahājvāle'tra narake pāpāḥ krandanti duḥkhitāḥ | itaścetaśca dhāvanti dahyamānāstadarciṣā
verses.translation: Siva has created the nectarine juice in the form of Pur&a for the benefit of men of poor intellect in the Kali age who have eschewed virtue and good conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva has created the nectarine juice in the form of Pur&a for the benefit of men of poor intellect in the Kali age who have eschewed virtue and good conduct.
verses.science: आप जानते ही हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठे चानीय तुण्डाभ्यां विन्यस्तस्कन्धयोजिते । तयोर्मध्येन वाकृष्य बाहुपृष्ठेन गाढतः
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhe cānīya tuṇḍābhyāṃ vinyastaskandhayojite | tayormadhyena vākṛṣya bāhupṛṣṭhena gāḍhataḥ
verses.translation: Only one person becomes free from old age and death by drinking the nectar Amfta. But by drinking the nectarine story of Siva the entire family becomes free from death and old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only one person becomes free from old age and death by drinking the nectar Amfta. But by drinking the nectarine story of Siva the entire family becomes free from death and old age.
verses.science: कामनासे उससे पुनः कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बद्धाः परस्परं सर्वे सुभृशं पाशरज्जुभिः । बद्धपिण्डास्तु दृश्यन्ते महाज्वाले तु यातनाः
verses.transliteration: baddhāḥ parasparaṃ sarve subhṛśaṃ pāśarajjubhiḥ | baddhapiṇḍāstu dṛśyante mahājvāle tu yātanāḥ
verses.translation: O dear, one instantaneously attains by listening to the Puriiias that salvation which mentonoua ascetics and performers of sacrifices derive.
verses.hindi: अतः है सुमध्यमे ! तुम उसे बताओ
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, one instantaneously attains by listening to the Puriiias that salvation which mentonoua ascetics and performers of sacrifices derive.
verses.science: अतः है सुमध्यमे ! तुम उसे बताओ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रज्जुभिर्वेष्टिताश्चैव प्रलिप्ताः कर्दमेन च । करीषतुषवह्नौ च पच्यन्ते न म्रियन्ति च
verses.transliteration: rajjubhirveṣṭitāścaiva praliptāḥ kardamena ca | karīṣatuṣavahnau ca pacyante na mriyanti ca
verses.translation: Man attains, thanks to listening to the Puranas, that benefit which is attained by sacrifices, charitable gifts, penances and pilgrimages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Man attains, thanks to listening to the Puranas, that benefit which is attained by sacrifices, charitable gifts, penances and pilgrimages.
verses.science: साथकी अभिलाषा करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णचरितास्ते हि कर्कशासु शिलासु च । आस्फाल्य शतशः पापाः पच्यन्ते तृणवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: sutīkṣṇacaritāste hi karkaśāsu śilāsu ca | āsphālya śataśaḥ pāpāḥ pacyante tṛṇavattataḥ
verses.translation: If there be no purana showing the path of Dharma, there will be no person observing Vrata or interested in the life hereafter.
verses.hindi: ऐसी स्त्रियोंक लिये अगम्य नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: If there be no purana showing the path of Dharma, there will be no person observing Vrata or interested in the life hereafter.
verses.science: ऐसी स्त्रियोंक लिये अगम्य नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शरीराभ्यन्तरगतैः प्रभूतैः कृमिभिर्नराः । भक्ष्यन्ते तीक्ष्णवदनैरात्मदेहक्षयाद् भृशम्
verses.transliteration: śarīrābhyantaragataiḥ prabhūtaiḥ kṛmibhirnarāḥ | bhakṣyante tīkṣṇavadanairātmadehakṣayād bhṛśam
verses.translation: He who listens to at least one among the thirty six Puranas*® or reads it with devotion is liberated. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: संयोगसे ही अनुकूल हो सकती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to at least one among the thirty six Puranas*® or reads it with devotion is liberated. There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: संयोगसे ही अनुकूल हो सकती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृमीणां निचये क्षिप्ताः पूयमांसास्थिराशिषु । तिष्ठन्त्युद्विग्नहृदयाः पर्वताभ्यां निपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: kṛmīṇāṃ nicaye kṣiptāḥ pūyamāṃsāsthirāśiṣu | tiṣṭhantyudvignahṛdayāḥ parvatābhyāṃ nipīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: Ten charitable gifts are called great gifts and are praiseworthy. They shall be given to deserving persons every day. They enable the soul to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ten charitable gifts are called great gifts and are praiseworthy. They shall be given to deserving persons every day. They enable the soul to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.science: अवयव विहल हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तप्तेन वज्रलेपेन शरीरमनुलिप्यते । अधोमुखोर्ध्वपादश्च तातप्यन्ते स्म वह्निना
verses.transliteration: taptena vajralepena śarīramanulipyate | adhomukhordhvapādaśca tātapyante sma vahninā
verses.translation: The charitable gifts of gold, cow and land, O excellent brahmin, arc very holy. Those who make them redeem themselves.
verses.hindi: प्रिय स्वामीके भी वशमें नहीं रहती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The charitable gifts of gold, cow and land, O excellent brahmin, arc very holy. Those who make them redeem themselves.
verses.science: प्रिय स्वामीके भी वशमें नहीं रहती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वदनान्तःप्रविन्यस्तां सुप्रतप्तामयोगदाम् । ते खादन्ति पराधीनास्तैस्ताड्यन्ते च मुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: vadanāntaḥpravinyastāṃ suprataptāmayogadām | te khādanti parādhīnāstaistāḍyante ca mudgaraiḥ
verses.translation: There arc gifts of gold, cows and land, by making these excellent gifts one is liberated from sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: There arc gifts of gold, cows and land, by making these excellent gifts one is liberated from sins.
verses.science: तुल्य हो सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं व्यास कुकर्माणो नरकेषु पचन्ति हि । वर्णयामि विवर्णत्वं तेषां तत्त्वाय कर्मिणाम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vyāsa kukarmāṇo narakeṣu pacanti hi | varṇayāmi vivarṇatvaṃ teṣāṃ tattvāya karmiṇām
verses.translation: Tuladanas are highly praised like the gifts of cows.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् स्त्रियोंके ये दोष स्वाभाविक हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Tuladanas are highly praised like the gifts of cows.
verses.science: अर्थात् स्त्रियोंके ये दोष स्वाभाविक हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: One shall make the charitable gift of forest with due observance of rules and pious mind. The wealth shall be earned by justiciable means. The donee shall be devoid of stinginess associated with affluence.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall make the charitable gift of forest with due observance of rules and pious mind. The wealth shall be earned by justiciable means. The donee shall be devoid of stinginess associated with affluence.
verses.science: भीतर मृत्युको जान लेना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: One shall make the charitable gift of forest with due observance of rules and pious mind. The wealth shall be earned by justiciable means. The donee shall be devoid of stinginess associated with affluence.
verses.hindi: मासके भीतर मृत्यु जान लेना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall make the charitable gift of forest with due observance of rules and pious mind. The wealth shall be earned by justiciable means. The donee shall be devoid of stinginess associated with affluence.
verses.science: मासके भीतर मृत्यु जान लेना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । नरकगतिभोगवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । मिथ्यागमं प्रवृत्तस्तु द्विजिह्वाख्यं च गच्छति । जिह्वार्धकोशविस्तीर्णहलैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्रपीड्यते
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.10. daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | narakagatibhogavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | mithyāgamaṃ pravṛttastu dvijihvākhyaṃ ca gacchati | jihvārdhakośavistīrṇahalaistīkṣṇaiḥ prapīḍyate
verses.translation: With a Prastha measure of gingelly seeds an image of a cow endowed with all qualities shall be made. The calf shall be made of gold. It shall be divine in shape and it shall possess all characteristics. The mystic diagram of the eight-petalled lotus shall be made with auspicious Vermillion and raw rice grains. The devotee shall worship Hudra an d all other gods there with great devotion. After the worship the cow and the calf shall be given to a brahmin along with
verses.hindi: उसका जीवन छ: मासतक ही रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: With a Prastha measure of gingelly seeds an image of a cow endowed with all qualities shall be made. The calf shall be made of gold. It shall be divine in shape and it shall possess all characteristics.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With a Prastha measure of gingelly seeds an image of a cow endowed with all qualities shall be made. The calf shall be made of gold. It shall be divine in shape and it shall possess all characteristics.…
verses.science: उसका जीवन छ: मासतक ही रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्भर्त्सयति यः क्रूरो मातरं पितरं गुरुम् । विष्ठाभिः कृमिमिश्राभिर्मुखमापूर्य हन्यते
verses.transliteration: nirbhartsayati yaḥ krūro mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum | viṣṭhābhiḥ kṛmimiśrābhirmukhamāpūrya hanyate
verses.translation: A man becomes the lord of the seven worlds, with a fraction of the benefit that he obtains when the whole uni¬ verse is given as a gift.
verses.hindi: लोकानां च हितार्थाय किमन्यच्छोतुमिच्छसि ॥ ७५  अब और क्या सुनना चाहती हो ?
verses.commentary: Sense: A man becomes the lord of the seven worlds, with a fraction of the benefit that he obtains when the whole uni¬ verse is given as a gift.
verses.science: लोकानां च हितार्थाय किमन्यच्छोतुमिच्छसि ॥ ७५ अब और क्या सुनना चाहती हो ?। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ये शिवायतनारामवापीकूपतडागकान् । विद्रवन्ति द्विजस्थानं नरास्तत्र रमन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye śivāyatanārāmavāpīkūpataḍāgakān | vidravanti dvijasthānaṃ narāstatra ramanti ca
verses.translation: The power of his virility cannot be adequately described even by the ambitious gods nor can his form be known.
verses.hindi: अग्निप्रेरित शब्द सुनायी पड़ने लगता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The power of his virility cannot be adequately described even by the ambitious gods nor can his form be known.
verses.science: अग्निप्रेरित शब्द सुनायी पड़ने लगता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: कामायोद्वर्तनाभ्यङ्ग स्नानपानाम्बुभोजनम् । क्रीडनं मैथुनं द्यूतमाचरन्ति मदोद्धताः
verses.transliteration: kāmāyodvartanābhyaṅga snānapānāmbubhojanam | krīḍanaṃ maithunaṃ dyūtamācaranti madoddhatāḥ
verses.translation: There the Daityas and serpents rejoice and enjoy pleasures. It is by performing penances that Danavas and Siddha beings attain the same.
verses.hindi: हैं, तो यह सब मुझे बताइये
verses.commentary: Sense: There the Daityas and serpents rejoice and enjoy pleasures. It is by performing penances that Danavas and Siddha beings attain the same.
verses.science: हैं, तो यह सब मुझे बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पेचिरे विविधैर्धोरैरिक्षुयन्त्रादिपीडनैः । निरयाग्निषु पच्यन्ते यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: pecire vividhairdhorairikṣuyantrādipīḍanaiḥ | nirayāgniṣu pacyante yāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Those who are arrogant in the freshness of youth, who transgress the bounds of decency, who are unclean and who maintain themselves on the earnings of unchaste women go to Kymya hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are arrogant in the freshness of youth, who transgress the bounds of decency, who are unclean and who maintain themselves on the earnings of unchaste women go to Kymya hell.
verses.science: आधे मुहूर्ततक उनका ध्यान करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन तेनैव रूपेण ताड्यन्ते पारदारिकाः । गाढमालिङ्ग्य ते नारीं सुतप्तां लोहनिर्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: tena tenaiva rūpeṇa tāḍyante pāradārikāḥ | gāḍhamāliṅgya te nārīṃ sutaptāṃ lohanirmitām
verses.translation: Immovable beings—plants etc. and movable beings worms, insects, birds, beasts, righteous men, gods and liberated beings, all these are equal in number in heaven as also in hell. A sinner who is averse to the performance of expiatory rites goes to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immovable beings—plants etc. and movable beings worms, insects, birds, beasts, righteous men, gods and liberated beings, all these are equal in number in heaven as also in hell. A sinner who is averse to the performance of expiatory rites goes to hell.
verses.science: किंचिन्मात्र भी सुखकर नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाकाराश्च पुरुषाः प्रज्वलन्ति समन्ततः । दुश्चारिणीं स्त्रियं गाढमालिङ्गन्ति रुदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: pūrvākārāśca puruṣāḥ prajvalanti samantataḥ | duścāriṇīṃ striyaṃ gāḍhamāliṅganti rudanti ca
verses.translation: Svayambhuva Manu has ordained expiatory rites for great sins and small expiatory rites for small sins in the Kali age
verses.commentary: Sense: Svayambhuva Manu has ordained expiatory rites for great sins and small expiatory rites for small sins in the Kali age
verses.science: छायिक॑ यच्छिवाख्यम्॥ ३९ शिवस्वरूप हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ये शृण्वन्ति सतां निन्दां तेषां कर्णप्रपूरणम् । अग्निवर्णैरयःकीलैस्तप्तैस्ताम्रादिनिर्मितैः
verses.transliteration: ye śṛṇvanti satāṃ nindāṃ teṣāṃ karṇaprapūraṇam | agnivarṇairayaḥkīlaistaptaistāmrādinirmitaiḥ
verses.translation: Of the many rites mentioned by way of expiation the remembrance of iSiva is the greatest.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिक्महाएराणे पञ्ञम्याय॒मासंहितायां कालवच्जनशिवप्राप्तिवर्ण॑ नाम सप्तविशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Of the many rites mentioned by way of expiation the remembrance of iSiva is the greatest.
verses.science: इति श्रीजिक्महाएराणे पञ्ञम्याय॒मासंहितायां कालवच्जनशिवप्राप्तिवर्ण॑ नाम सप्तविशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रपुसीसारकूटाद्भिः क्षीरेण च पुनःपुनः । सुतप्ततीक्ष्णतैलेन वज्रलेपेन वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: trapusīsārakūṭādbhiḥ kṣīreṇa ca punaḥpunaḥ | sutaptatīkṣṇatailena vajralepena vā punaḥ
verses.translation: If a person commits a sin but repents after com¬ mitting it, it is also an expiation. There also the remem¬ brance of Siva is the greatest expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person commits a sin but repents after com¬ mitting it, it is also an expiation. There also the remem¬ brance of Siva is the greatest expiation.
verses.science: नामक सत्ताईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रमादापूर्य कर्णांस्तु नरकेषु च यातनाः । अनुक्रमेण सर्वेषु भवन्त्येताः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: kramādāpūrya karṇāṃstu narakeṣu ca yātanāḥ | anukrameṇa sarveṣu bhavantyetāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, even after committing sins, the man enjoys in the heaven along with his kinsmen and friends as long as fourteen Indras rule over it
verses.hindi: रहता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, even after committing sins, the man enjoys in the heaven along with his kinsmen and friends as long as fourteen Indras rule over it
verses.science: रहता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियाणामप्येवं क्रमात्पापेन यातनाः । भवन्ति घोराः प्रत्येकं शरीरेण कृतेन च
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyāṇāmapyevaṃ kramātpāpena yātanāḥ | bhavanti ghorāḥ pratyekaṃ śarīreṇa kṛtena ca
verses.translation: If any one makes the gift of a tawny cow along with its calf adorning the horns with gold, the hoofs with silver and endowed with other characteristics and also gives a bell metal vessel, that cow returns to him in the form of the wish-yielding celestial cow. O Vyasa, the donee is thus blessed both here and hereafer.
verses.wordMeaning: If any one makes the gift of a tawny cow along with its calf adorning the horns with gold, the hoofs with silver and endowed with other characteristics and also gives a bell metal vessel, that cow returns to him in the form of the wish-yielding celestial cow. O Vyasa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one makes the gift of a tawny cow along with its calf adorning the horns with gold, the hoofs with silver and endowed with other characteristics and also gives a bell metal vessel, that cow returns to him in the form of the wish-yielding celestial cow. O Vyasa,…
verses.science: प्राप्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्शदोषेण ये मूढाः स्पृशन्ति च परस्त्रियम् । तेषां करोऽग्निवर्णाभिः पांसुभिः पूर्यते भृशम्
verses.transliteration: sparśadoṣeṇa ye mūḍhāḥ spṛśanti ca parastriyam | teṣāṃ karo'gnivarṇābhiḥ pāṃsubhiḥ pūryate bhṛśam
verses.translation: One shall make gifts of such things to a man of good qualities, such thing as he likes most in the world, as are very dear to him in the house and as are wished for by him to be his permanent possessions.
verses.hindi: चाहिए कि छ: मासमें उसकी मृत्यु हो जायगी
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall make gifts of such things to a man of good qualities, such thing as he likes most in the world, as are very dear to him in the house and as are wished for by him to be his permanent possessions.
verses.science: चाहिए कि छ: मासमें उसकी मृत्यु हो जायगी। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां क्षारादिभिः सर्वैः शरीरमनुलिप्यते । यातनाश्च महाकष्टाः सर्वेषु नरकेषु च
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ kṣārādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ śarīramanulipyate | yātanāśca mahākaṣṭāḥ sarveṣu narakeṣu ca
verses.translation: Gift" of anything equal in weight to the giver is the most excellent of all gifts. If he wishes for his prosperity he shall ascend the weighing balance.
verses.hindi: चिह्लोंको कह रहा हूँ, तुम सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: Gift" of anything equal in weight to the giver is the most excellent of all gifts. If he wishes for his prosperity he shall ascend the weighing balance.
verses.science: चिह्लोंको कह रहा हूँ, तुम सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्ति पित्रोर्भृकुटिं करनेत्राणि ये नराः । वक्त्राणि तेषां सान्तानि कीर्यन्ते शङ्कुभिर्दृढम्
verses.transliteration: kurvanti pitrorbhṛkuṭiṃ karanetrāṇi ye narāḥ | vaktrāṇi teṣāṃ sāntāni kīryante śaṅkubhirdṛḍham
verses.translation: Even after committing sins if a man makes the gi)'t of weighing balance he becomes free from all sins and goes to heaven.
verses.hindi: पड़े, तब वह  व्यक्ति आधे महीनेमें मर जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after committing sins if a man makes the gi)'t of weighing balance he becomes free from all sins and goes to heaven.
verses.science: पड़े, तब वह व्यक्ति आधे महीनेमें मर जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यैरिन्द्रियैर्नरा ये च विकुर्वन्ति परस्त्रियम् । इन्द्रियाणि च तेषां वै विकुर्वन्ति तथैव च
verses.transliteration: yairindriyairnarā ye ca vikurvanti parastriyam | indriyāṇi ca teṣāṃ vai vikurvanti tathaiva ca
verses.translation: (The following shall be recited before making the gift). **May the presiding deity of the weighing balance remove the sin committed by me physically, mentally or verbally during the day. night, the twilights, midday, the close of the night or in any of the three times. May the presiding deity of the balance, lord Siva, enemy of the cupid, remove all the sins done by me, whether as a boy or a
verses.wordMeaning: (The following shall be recited before making the gift). **May the presiding deity of the weighing balance remove the sin committed by me physically, mentally or verbally during the day. night, the twilights, midday, the close of the night or in any of the three times.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (The following shall be recited before making the gift). **May the presiding deity of the weighing balance remove the sin committed by me physically, mentally or verbally during the day. night, the twilights, midday, the close of the night or in any of the three times.…
verses.science: मासपर्यन्त जीवित रहता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परदारांश्च पश्यन्ति लुब्धाः स्तब्धेन चक्षुषा । सूचीभिश्चाग्निवर्णाभिस्तेषां नेत्रप्रपूरणम्
verses.transliteration: paradārāṃśca paśyanti lubdhāḥ stabdhena cakṣuṣā | sūcībhiścāgnivarṇābhisteṣāṃ netraprapūraṇam
verses.translation: The presiding deity shall be made after reciting the above formula It shall not be given to a single person. There is no benefit in it. It shall be distributed among many brahmins.
verses.hindi: कालतवेत्ता पुरुष उसे छ: मासकी आयुवाला समझें
verses.commentary: Sense: The presiding deity shall be made after reciting the above formula It shall not be given to a single person. There is no benefit in it. It shall be distributed among many brahmins.
verses.science: कालतवेत्ता पुरुष उसे छ: मासकी आयुवाला समझें। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: क्षाराद्यैश्च क्रमात्सर्वा इहैव यमयातनाः । भवन्ति मुनिशार्दूल सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kṣārādyaiśca kramātsarvā ihaiva yamayātanāḥ | bhavanti muniśārdūla satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, he who makes this excellent gift of the presiding deity of the balance destroys his sins and attains heaven He stays there as long as the fourteen Indras rule over ii.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, he who makes this excellent gift of the presiding deity of the balance destroys his sins and attains heaven He stays there as long as the fourteen Indras rule over ii.
verses.science: शास्त्रविधिसे विचार किया जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाग्निगुरुविप्रेभ्यश्चानिवेद्य प्रभुञ्जते । लोहकीलशतैस्तप्तैस्तज्जिह्वास्यं च पूर्यते
verses.transliteration: devāgniguruviprebhyaścānivedya prabhuñjate | lohakīlaśataistaptaistajjihvāsyaṃ ca pūryate
verses.translation: For the benefit of human beings tell me that which when given as gift makes it possible to derive the benefit of all gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the benefit of human beings tell me that which when given as gift makes it possible to derive the benefit of all gifts.
verses.science: मासानू सप्त विजानीयात्वड्घस्त्रांश्चाप्युदाहरेत्॥ ५८ चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये देवारामपुष्पाणि लोभात्सङ्गृह्य पाणिना । जिघ्रन्ति च नरा भूयः शिरसा धारयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye devārāmapuṣpāṇi lobhātsaṅgṛhya pāṇinā | jighranti ca narā bhūyaḥ śirasā dhārayanti ca
verses.translation: Listen. I shall mention that gift on giving which, at the proper time, men obtain the benefit of all the gifts
verses.hindi: अष्टादश दिनान्यत्र कथितं साधकेश्वरि॥ ६४ अठारह दिनतक जीवन शेष कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen. I shall mention that gift on giving which, at the proper time, men obtain the benefit of all the gifts
verses.science: अष्टादश दिनान्यत्र कथितं साधकेश्वरि॥ ६४ अठारह दिनतक जीवन शेष कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्यते शिरस्तेषां तप्तैर्लोहस्य शङ्कुभिः । नासिका चातिबहुलैस्ततः क्षारादिभिर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: āpūryate śirasteṣāṃ taptairlohasya śaṅkubhiḥ | nāsikā cātibahulaistataḥ kṣārādibhirbhṛśam
verses.translation: The man who gifts away the universe sports in the abode of the gods along with his kinsmen as long as the moon and the sun are in the sky or the earth is steady or every one in the abode of the heaven-dwellers is favourable. Afterwards, for rejoicing, he attains the region of Vifu which is difficult of access even to the gods.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यामुमासंहितायां कालज्ञानवर्णन॑ नाम पद्जविंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: The man who gifts away the universe sports in the abode of the gods along with his kinsmen as long as the moon and the sun are in the sky or the earth is steady or every one in the abode of the heaven-dwellers is favourable. Afterwards, for rejoicing,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who gifts away the universe sports in the abode of the gods along with his kinsmen as long as the moon and the sun are in the sky or the earth is steady or every one in the abode of the heaven-dwellers is favourable. Afterwards, for rejoicing,…
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यामुमासंहितायां कालज्ञानवर्णन॑ नाम पद्जविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ये निन्दन्ति महात्मानं वाचकं धर्मदेशिकम् । देवाग्निगुरुभक्तांश्च धर्मशास्त्रं च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: ye nindanti mahātmānaṃ vācakaṃ dharmadeśikam | devāgnigurubhaktāṃśca dharmaśāstraṃ ca śāśvatam
verses.translation: O holy lord, please explain the universe, its extent,
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, please explain the universe, its extent,
verses.science: नामक यच्चीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषामुरसि कण्ठे च जिह्वायां दन्तसन्धिषु । तालुन्योष्ठे नासिकायां मूर्ध्नि सर्वाङ्गसन्धिषु
verses.transliteration: teṣāmurasi kaṇṭhe ca jihvāyāṃ dantasandhiṣu | tālunyoṣṭhe nāsikāyāṃ mūrdhni sarvāṅgasandhiṣu
verses.translation: O sage, listen. 1 shall explain how high and..fapw extensive is the universe. On hearing it succinctly one gets rid of sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, listen. 1 shall explain how high and..fapw extensive is the universe. On hearing it succinctly one gets rid of sins.
verses.science: प्राप्त्कर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निवर्णास्तु तप्ताश्च त्रिशाखा लोहशङ्कवः । आखिद्यन्ते च बहुशः स्थानेष्वेतेषु मुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: agnivarṇāstu taptāśca triśākhā lohaśaṅkavaḥ | ākhidyante ca bahuśaḥ sthāneṣveteṣu mudgaraiḥ
verses.translation: Brahma creates the universe consisting of the four> teen** worlds. O dear, I shall succinctly explain that in proper order. Listen to it assiduously.
verses.hindi: और परोपकारके लिये शरीर धारण किये हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma creates the universe consisting of the four> teen** worlds. O dear, I shall succinctly explain that in proper order. Listen to it assiduously.
verses.science: और परोपकारके लिये शरीर धारण किये हुए हैं। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन पूर्यते हि समन्ततः । यातनाश्च महत्यो वै शरीरस्याति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena pūryate hi samantataḥ | yātanāśca mahatyo vai śarīrasyāti sarvataḥ
verses.translation: The nether worlds are seven only. The upper worlds are also seven. The height of the universe is twice as such and it stands in the middle of water.
verses.hindi: सर्पको शीघ्र ही नष्ट कर देते हैं, उसे तुम सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: The nether worlds are seven only. The upper worlds are also seven. The height of the universe is twice as such and it stands in the middle of water.
verses.science: सर्पको शीघ्र ही नष्ट कर देते हैं, उसे तुम सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अशेषनरकेष्वेव क्रमन्ति क्रमशः पुनः । ये गृह्णन्ति परद्रव्यं पद्भ्यां विप्रं स्पृशन्ति च
verses.transliteration: aśeṣanarakeṣveva kramanti kramaśaḥ punaḥ | ye gṛhṇanti paradravyaṃ padbhyāṃ vipraṃ spṛśanti ca
verses.translation: Even the gods and the Asuras are incompetent to describe the attributes of Sesa who is worshipped by the gods, sages and the Ganas and who is called as Ananib by the Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the gods and the Asuras are incompetent to describe the attributes of Sesa who is worshipped by the gods, sages and the Ganas and who is called as Ananib by the Siddhas.
verses.science: विलीन भी हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवोपकरणं गां च ज्ञानादिलिखितं च यत् । हस्तपादादिभिस्तेषामापूर्यन्ते समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: śivopakaraṇaṃ gāṃ ca jñānādilikhitaṃ ca yat | hastapādādibhisteṣāmāpūryante samantataḥ
verses.translation: He has a thousand hoods. By means of the thousand jewels on his hoods, he illuminates all the quarters. He has the brilliant ornament Svastika.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has a thousand hoods. By means of the thousand jewels on his hoods, he illuminates all the quarters. He has the brilliant ornament Svastika.
verses.science: भूतोंको ठीक-ठीक जानो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नरकेषु च सर्वेषु विचित्रा बहुयातनाः । भवन्ति बहुशः कष्टाः पाणिपादसमुद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: narakeṣu ca sarveṣu vicitrā bahuyātanāḥ | bhavanti bahuśaḥ kaṣṭāḥ pāṇipādasamudbhavāḥ
verses.translation: He has only a single ear>ring. He has a crown and wears garlands. His eyes are rolling due to inebriation. He shines like a white fiery mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has only a single ear>ring. He has a crown and wears garlands. His eyes are rolling due to inebriation. He shines like a white fiery mountain.
verses.science: हुए गुणोंपर विचार करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवायतनपर्यन्ते देवारामेषु कुत्रचित् । समुत्सृजन्ति ये पापाः पुरीषं मूत्रमेव च
verses.transliteration: śivāyatanaparyante devārāmeṣu kutracit | samutsṛjanti ye pāpāḥ purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca
verses.translation: He is worshipped by the gold-complexioned
verses.hindi: जीतते हैं, वह सब मुझसे कहिये 2
verses.commentary: Sense: He is worshipped by the gold-complexioned
verses.science: जीतते हैं, वह सब मुझसे कहिये 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां शिश्नं सवृषणं चूर्ण्यते लोहमुद्गरैः । सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिस्तथा त्वापूर्यते पुनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ cūrṇyate lohamudgaraiḥ | sūcībhiragnivarṇābhistathā tvāpūryate punaḥ
verses.translation: Holding the sphere ol' the earth on his back, Sea, the lord of Bhutas stands at the root of Pa tala. He is wor¬ shipped for his endless attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Holding the sphere ol' the earth on his back, Sea, the lord of Bhutas stands at the root of Pa tala. He is wor¬ shipped for his endless attributes.
verses.science: योगाभ्यास करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षारेण महता तीव्रेण च पुनः पुनः । द्रुतेन पूर्यते गाढं गुदे शिश्ने च देहिनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṣāreṇa mahatā tīvreṇa ca punaḥ punaḥ | drutena pūryate gāḍhaṃ gude śiśne ca dehinaḥ
verses.translation: Who will adequately express his prowess? The series of his hoods, pink with the jewels go round the entire earth like a garland of flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who will adequately express his prowess? The series of his hoods, pink with the jewels go round the entire earth like a garland of flowers.
verses.science: शीघ्र नष्ट कर देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनः सर्वेन्द्रियाणां च यस्माद्दुःखं प्रजायते । धने सत्यपि ये दानं न प्रयच्छन्ति तृष्णया
verses.transliteration: manaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ ca yasmādduḥkhaṃ prajāyate | dhane satyapi ye dānaṃ na prayacchanti tṛṣṇayā
verses.translation: With his eyes rolling due to inebriation when Sesa stretches himself, the earth quakes along with all its mountains, oceans and forests.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his eyes rolling due to inebriation when Sesa stretches himself, the earth quakes along with all its mountains, oceans and forests.
verses.science: ध्यान करते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतिथिं चावमन्यन्ते काले प्राप्ते गृहाश्रमे । तस्मात्ते दुष्कृतं प्राप्य गच्छन्ति निरयेऽशुचौ
verses.transliteration: atithiṃ cāvamanyante kāle prāpte gṛhāśrame | tasmātte duṣkṛtaṃ prāpya gacchanti niraye'śucau
verses.translation: O excellent sage, each of the nether worlds extends to ten thousand Yojanas. The seven nether worlds are Atala, Vitala, Sutala, Rasatala, Tala, Talatala and the Patala. The seven worlds are beneath the earth. So say the learned people.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, each of the nether worlds extends to ten thousand Yojanas. The seven nether worlds are Atala, Vitala, Sutala, Rasatala, Tala, Talatala and the Patala. The seven worlds are beneath the earth. So say the learned people.
verses.science: यथार्थरूपसे उसका वर्णन करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: येऽन्नं दत्त्वा हि भुञ्जन्ति न श्वभ्यः सह वायसैः । तेषां च विवृतं वक्त्रं कीलकद्वयताडितम्
verses.transliteration: ye'nnaṃ dattvā hi bhuñjanti na śvabhyaḥ saha vāyasaiḥ | teṣāṃ ca vivṛtaṃ vaktraṃ kīlakadvayatāḍitam
verses.translation: Danavas, Daiteyas, Serpents, and Rak$asas of the Daitya origin reside there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Danavas, Daiteyas, Serpents, and Rak$asas of the Daitya origin reside there.
verses.science: करनेवाला तथा उत्तम होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृमिभिः प्राणिभिश्चोग्रैर्लोहतुण्डैश्च वायसैः । उपद्रवैर्बहुविधैरुग्रैरन्तः प्रपीड्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛmibhiḥ prāṇibhiścograirlohatuṇḍaiśca vāyasaiḥ | upadravairbahuvidhairugrairantaḥ prapīḍyate
verses.translation: Narada who came to heaven from the nether region announced in the middle of the celestial assembly that the nether worlds are more beautiful than heaven.
verses.hindi: तथा मारणमें वह प्रयोग करनेयोग्य है
verses.commentary: Sense: Narada who came to heaven from the nether region announced in the middle of the celestial assembly that the nether worlds are more beautiful than heaven.
verses.science: तथा मारणमें वह प्रयोग करनेयोग्य है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्यामश्च शबलश्चैव यममार्गानुरोधकौ । यौ स्तस्ताभ्यां प्रयच्छामि तौ गृह्णीतामिमं बलिम्
verses.transliteration: śyāmaśca śabalaścaiva yamamārgānurodhakau | yau stastābhyāṃ prayacchāmi tau gṛhṇītāmimaṃ balim
verses.translation: There, in all sorts of ornaments, lustrous jewels are present. They are white and delightful. What is there equal to it?
verses.commentary: Sense: There, in all sorts of ornaments, lustrous jewels are present. They are white and delightful. What is there equal to it?
verses.science: प्रदान करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये वा वरुणवायव्या याम्या नैरृत्यवायसाः । वायसाः पुण्यकर्माणस्ते प्रगृह्णन्तु मे बलिम्
verses.transliteration: ye vā varuṇavāyavyā yāmyā nairṛtyavāyasāḥ | vāyasāḥ puṇyakarmāṇaste pragṛhṇantu me balim
verses.translation: There during the daytime there are no sun's
verses.commentary: Sense: There during the daytime there are no sun's
verses.science: है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवामभ्यर्च्य यत्नेन हुत्वाग्नौ विधिपूर्वकम् । शैवैर्मन्त्रैर्बलिं ये च ददन्ते न च ते यमम्
verses.transliteration: śivāmabhyarcya yatnena hutvāgnau vidhipūrvakam | śaivairmantrairbaliṃ ye ca dadante na ca te yamam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, all sorts of foodstuffs and drinks are consumed there by extremely joyous persons. The time that passes by is not known there at all.
verses.hindi: तुमसे कहा, अब और कया सुनना चाहती हो ?2
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, all sorts of foodstuffs and drinks are consumed there by extremely joyous persons. The time that passes by is not known there at all.
verses.science: तुमसे कहा, अब और कया सुनना चाहती हो ?2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति त्रिदिवं यान्ति तस्माद्दद्याद्दिनेदिने । मण्डलं चतुरस्रं तु कृत्वा गन्धादिवासितम्
verses.transliteration: paśyanti tridivaṃ yānti tasmāddadyāddinedine | maṇḍalaṃ caturasraṃ tu kṛtvā gandhādivāsitam
verses.translation: The cooings of the male cuckoo are there. Lotuses are there. There are lotus-ponds. There are rivers and lakes. Each of them is more excellent than the other.
verses.hindi: शति श्रीश्षिवमहाएुराणे पश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां कालवञ्नवर्णन॑ नाम बड्विंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The cooings of the male cuckoo are there. Lotuses are there. There are lotus-ponds. There are rivers and lakes. Each of them is more excellent than the other.
verses.science: शति श्रीश्षिवमहाएुराणे पश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां कालवञ्नवर्णन॑ नाम बड्विंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तर्यर्थमीशान्यां प्राच्यामिन्द्राय निःक्षिपेत् । याम्यां यमाय वारुण्यां सुदक्षोमाय दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: dhanvantaryarthamīśānyāṃ prācyāmindrāya niḥkṣipet | yāmyāṃ yamāya vāruṇyāṃ sudakṣomāya dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: There the ornaments are very brilliant. The un¬ guents are sweet-smelling. O brahmin, the sound of Vinas, flutes and Mrdahgas can be heard there. There arc scmg everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: There the ornaments are very brilliant. The un¬ guents are sweet-smelling. O brahmin, the sound of Vinas, flutes and Mrdahgas can be heard there. There arc scmg everywhere.
verses.science: नामक छब्बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पितृभ्यस्तु विनिःक्षिप्य प्राच्यामर्यमणं ततः । धातुश्चैव विधातुश्च द्वारदेशे विनिःक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhyastu viniḥkṣipya prācyāmaryamaṇaṃ tataḥ | dhātuścaiva vidhātuśca dvāradeśe viniḥkṣipet
verses.translation: O excellent sage, above the nether regions, are the hells where the sinners are scorched. Listen to their descrip¬ tion from me.
verses.hindi: वायुस्वरूप हो जाता है, उसको सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, above the nether regions, are the hells where the sinners are scorched. Listen to their descrip¬ tion from me.
