verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects live on these Varija mountains which are very beautiful and golden. Free from terror, they are accompanied by their friends and the gods.
verses.science: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्याग॒मासंहितायां मन्वन्तरकीर्तने वैवस्वतवर्णनं नाम पद्ञत्रिशो5 ध्याय:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरापः परदारी च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः । तपसा तरते सर्वं सर्वतश्च विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: surāpaḥ paradārī ca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ | tapasā tarate sarvaṃ sarvataśca vimuñcati
verses.translation: Brahmins, Katriyas, VaUyas and iSudras live there in their due order. There are seven great rivers and thousands of other small rivers there.
verses.hindi: वैवस्वतवर्णन नायक पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmins, Katriyas, VaUyas and iSudras live there in their due order. There are seven great rivers and thousands of other small rivers there.
verses.science: वैवस्वतवर्णन नायक पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपि सर्वेश्वरः स्थाणुर्विष्णुश्चैव सनातनः । ब्रह्मा हुताशनः शक्रो ये चान्ये तपसान्विताः
verses.transliteration: api sarveśvaraḥ sthāṇurviṣṇuścaiva sanātanaḥ | brahmā hutāśanaḥ śakro ye cānye tapasānvitāḥ
verses.translation: They are Gauri, Kumudvati, Sandhya, RaiSi, Mano* java, Santi and Pudsi'ika and they make others drink their holy water.
verses.hindi: विशालकाय, धेर्यशाली एवं क्षत्रिय धर्ममें तत्पर थे
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Gauri, Kumudvati, Sandhya, RaiSi, Mano* java, Santi and Pudsi'ika and they make others drink their holy water.
verses.science: विशालकाय, धेर्यशाली एवं क्षत्रिय धर्ममें तत्पर थे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् । तपसा दिवि मोदन्ते समेता दैवतैः सह
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām | tapasā divi modante sametā daivataiḥ saha
verses.translation: The lord in the form of Yogarudra is worship¬ ped there. The ocean of curds and whey is surrounded by l§akadvipa'* twice as large. The mountains are seven. Listen to their names from me. In the east is the mountain Udaya- giri. In the south is the mountain Jaladhara. The Astagiri is in the west and Avikea in the north. The great tree is Sa there, worshipped by Siddhas and Gandharvas.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord in the form of Yogarudra is worship¬ ped there. The ocean of curds and whey is surrounded by l§akadvipa'* twice as large. The mountains are seven. Listen to their names from me. In the east is the mountain Udaya- giri. In the south is the mountain Jaladhara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord in the form of Yogarudra is worship¬ ped there. The ocean of curds and whey is surrounded by l§akadvipa'* twice as large. The mountains are seven. Listen to their names from me. In the east is the mountain Udaya- giri. In the south is the mountain Jaladhara.…
verses.science: और प्रियत्रत नामवाले थे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसा लभ्यते राज्यं स च शक्रः सुरेश्वरः । तपसापालयत्सर्वमहन्यहनि वृत्रहा
verses.transliteration: tapasā labhyate rājyaṃ sa ca śakraḥ sureśvaraḥ | tapasāpālayatsarvamahanyahani vṛtrahā
verses.translation: The countries are very sacred populated by the people of all the four castes. The rivers too are very holy, dispelling all terror due to sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The countries are very sacred populated by the people of all the four castes. The rivers too are very holy, dispelling all terror due to sins.
verses.science: इडा नामक कन्या उत्पन्न हुई। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ देवौ सर्वलोकहिते रतौ । तपसैव प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा
verses.transliteration: sūryācandramasau devau sarvalokahite ratau | tapasaiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā
verses.translation: They are Sukumari, Kumari, Nalini, Veouka, Ikfu, Reuka and Gabhasti.
verses.hindi: उन प्रजापति मनुसे यह धर्मसम्मत बात कही--
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Sukumari, Kumari, Nalini, Veouka, Ikfu, Reuka and Gabhasti.
verses.science: उन प्रजापति मनुसे यह धर्मसम्मत बात कही--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न चास्ति तत्सुखं लोके यद्विना तपसा किल । तपसैव सुखं सर्वमिति वेदविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: na cāsti tatsukhaṃ loke yadvinā tapasā kila | tapasaiva sukhaṃ sarvamiti vedavido viduḥ
verses.translation: It is surrounded on all sides by the milk-ocean
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surrounded on all sides by the milk-ocean
verses.science: सत्यसे प्रसन्न हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं विज्ञानमारोग्यं रूपवत्त्वं तथैव च । सौभाग्यं चैव तपसा प्राप्यते सर्वदा सुखम्
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vijñānamārogyaṃ rūpavattvaṃ tathaiva ca | saubhāgyaṃ caiva tapasā prāpyate sarvadā sukham
verses.translation: The Dvipa and the Varsas are of similar shapes namely gyrated. Men live there up to ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: बुधने उसे संगके लिये आमन्त्रित किया
verses.commentary: Sense: The Dvipa and the Varsas are of similar shapes namely gyrated. Men live there up to ten thousand years.
verses.science: बुधने उसे संगके लिये आमन्त्रित किया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसा सृज्यते विश्वं ब्रह्मा विश्वं विना श्रमम् । पाति विष्णुर्हरोऽप्यत्ति धत्ते शेषोऽखिलां महीम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā sṛjyate viśvaṃ brahmā viśvaṃ vinā śramam | pāti viṣṇurharo'pyatti dhatte śeṣo'khilāṃ mahīm
verses.translation: They are free from ailment. They are not un- happy. They are devoid of passion and hatred. Evil is never approved of by them. O sage, nor do they imprison or kill anyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are free from ailment. They are not un- happy. They are devoid of passion and hatred. Evil is never approved of by them. O sage, nor do they imprison or kill anyone.
verses.science: पूछनेहेतु ब्रह्मलोकमें गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो गाधिसुतस्तपसैव महामुने । क्षत्रियोऽथाभवद्विप्रः प्रसिद्धं त्रिभवे त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro gādhisutastapasaiva mahāmune | kṣatriyo'thābhavadvipraḥ prasiddhaṃ tribhave tvidam
verses.translation: O great sage, in the Dhatakikhana and the Maha- vita in the Puskaradvipa, the holy fig tree is the excellent abode of Brahma.
verses.hindi: इसका कुछ भी पता न लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, in the Dhatakikhana and the Maha- vita in the Puskaradvipa, the holy fig tree is the excellent abode of Brahma.
verses.science: इसका कुछ भी पता न लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तं ते महाप्राज्ञ तपोमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । शृण्वध्ययनमाहात्म्यं तपसोऽधिकमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktaṃ te mahāprājña tapomāhātmyamuttamam | śṛṇvadhyayanamāhātmyaṃ tapaso'dhikamuttamam
verses.translation: Brahma resides there, worshipped by gods and Asuras. Pukara is surrounded by the ocean of sweet water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma resides there, worshipped by gods and Asuras. Pukara is surrounded by the ocean of sweet water.
verses.science: अभिप्राय निवेदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, therefore, along with this universe the earth is fifty crores of Yojanas in extent inclusive of all the continents and mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, therefore, along with this universe the earth is fifty crores of Yojanas in extent inclusive of all the continents and mountains.
verses.science: सभी दिशाओंको फैल गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, therefore, along with this universe the earth is fifty crores of Yojanas in extent inclusive of all the continents and mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, therefore, along with this universe the earth is fifty crores of Yojanas in extent inclusive of all the continents and mountains.
verses.science: करता हूँ, आपलोग आदरपूर्वक सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । पुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । तपस्तपति योऽरण्ये वन्यमूलफलाशनः । योऽधीते ऋचमेकां हि फलं स्यात्तत्समं मुने
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.13. trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | purāṇamāhātmyavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | tapastapati yo'raṇye vanyamūlaphalāśanaḥ | yo'dhīte ṛcamekāṃ hi phalaṃ syāttatsamaṃ mune
verses.translation: The extent to which the rays of the sun and the moon shine and illuminate is the size of the earth. It is called Bhuloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent to which the rays of the sun and the moon shine and illuminate is the size of the earth. It is called Bhuloka.
verses.science: युद्धके मदसे उन्मत्त रहते थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतेरध्ययनात्पुण्यं यदाप्नोति द्विजोत्तमः । तदध्यापनतश्चापि द्विगुणं फलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: śruteradhyayanātpuṇyaṃ yadāpnoti dvijottamaḥ | tadadhyāpanataścāpi dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute
verses.translation: It is surrounded by water ten times as large all round the fire, wind, ether and darkness. It is encom¬ passed by the elements and the principle of Mahat, eight times as large. There surrounded by the Mahat and Fra- dhana is stationed the Purusa. The supreme soul is infinite. He is therefore called eternal since he has no limitation.
verses.wordMeaning: It is surrounded by water ten times as large all round the fire, wind, ether and darkness. It is encom¬ passed by the elements and the principle of Mahat, eight times as large. There surrounded by the Mahat and Fra- dhana is stationed the Purusa. The supreme soul is infinite.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surrounded by water ten times as large all round the fire, wind, ether and darkness. It is encom¬ passed by the elements and the principle of Mahat, eight times as large. There surrounded by the Mahat and Fra- dhana is stationed the Purusa. The supreme soul is infinite.…
verses.science: शशाद वनकी ओर चला गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जगद्यथा निरालोकं जायतेऽशशिभास्करम् । विना तथा पुराणं ह्यध्येयमस्मान्मुने सदा
verses.transliteration: jagadyathā nirālokaṃ jāyate'śaśibhāskaram | vinā tathā purāṇaṃ hyadhyeyamasmānmune sadā
verses.translation: O Vyasa, son of Paraara, listen with pleasure to the auspicious salvation and the holy rite of pious devotees and the sacred rite of ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, son of Paraara, listen with pleasure to the auspicious salvation and the holy rite of pious devotees and the sacred rite of ascetics.
verses.science: समीप निवास करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तप्यमानं सदाज्ञानान्निरये योऽपि शास्त्रतः । सम्बोधयति लोकं तं तस्मात् पूज्यः पुराणगः
verses.transliteration: tapyamānaṃ sadājñānānniraye yo'pi śāstrataḥ | sambodhayati lokaṃ taṃ tasmāt pūjyaḥ purāṇagaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, but he does not know that these are only reflections in a mirror, not real substances. Just as the gingelly seeds are crushed to yield oil he gets himself crushed to yield things of pleasure. He madly rushes after them deluded by false knowledge. Some one seems to tell him, *'Go on quickly."
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, but he does not know that these are only reflections in a mirror, not real substances. Just as the gingelly seeds are crushed to yield oil he gets himself crushed to yield things of pleasure. He madly rushes after them deluded by false knowledge.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, but he does not know that these are only reflections in a mirror, not real substances. Just as the gingelly seeds are crushed to yield oil he gets himself crushed to yield things of pleasure. He madly rushes after them deluded by false knowledge.…
verses.science: सशरीर स्वर्ग भेज दिया। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां चैव पात्राणां मध्ये श्रेष्ठः पुराणवित् । पतनात् त्रायते यस्मात् तस्मात्पात्रमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ caiva pātrāṇāṃ madhye śreṣṭhaḥ purāṇavit | patanāt trāyate yasmāt tasmātpātramudāhṛtam
verses.translation: Even to the god and the Asuras the birth as human being is very rare to be achieved. After attaining the same he should do such things as would prevent his fall in the hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even to the god and the Asuras the birth as human being is very rare to be achieved. After attaining the same he should do such things as would prevent his fall in the hell.
verses.science: बतानेकी कृपा करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मर्त्यबुद्धिर्न कर्तव्या पुराणज्ञे कदाचन । पुराणज्ञः सर्ववेत्ता ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्हरो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: martyabuddhirna kartavyā purāṇajñe kadācana | purāṇajñaḥ sarvavettā brahmā viṣṇurharo guruḥ
verses.translation: Human birth has virtue as its root. It shall achieve all objects. Even if there is no endeavour to achieve any special aim after getting human birth at least one should preserve the root.
verses.commentary: Sense: Human birth has virtue as its root. It shall achieve all objects. Even if there is no endeavour to achieve any special aim after getting human birth at least one should preserve the root.
verses.science: बाहुका राज्य उन्हें दे दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धनं धान्यं हिरण्यं च वासांसि विविधानि च । देयं पुराणविज्ञाय परत्रेह च शर्मणे
verses.transliteration: dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca | deyaṃ purāṇavijñāya paratreha ca śarmaṇe
verses.translation: Who can be a more senseless man than one who does not strive for the welfare of the soul after attaining the rare birth as a brahmin in the course of human birth?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who can be a more senseless man than one who does not strive for the welfare of the soul after attaining the rare birth as a brahmin in the course of human birth?
verses.science: ईर्ष्यावश उसे विष दे दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो ददाति महाप्रीत्या पुराणज्ञाय सज्जनः । पात्राय शुभवस्तूनि स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yo dadāti mahāprītyā purāṇajñāya sajjanaḥ | pātrāya śubhavastūni sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: One should continue to perform virtuous rites as long as the health and normalcy of the body is maintained. A sick man is not eager to perform anything even when urged by others.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should continue to perform virtuous rites as long as the health and normalcy of the body is maintained. A sick man is not eager to perform anything even when urged by others.
verses.science: महामुनिकी सेवा करने लगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महीं गां वा स्यन्दनांश्च गजानश्वांश्च शोभनान् । यः प्रयच्छति पात्राय तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: mahīṃ gāṃ vā syandanāṃśca gajānaśvāṃśca śobhanān | yaḥ prayacchati pātrāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: If anyone does not try to achieve the permanent through the non-permanent body, the p>ermanent is lost for him and the non-permanent has already perished.'
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone does not try to achieve the permanent through the non-permanent body, the p>ermanent is lost for him and the non-permanent has already perished.'
verses.science: राजा सगरने जन्म लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयान्सर्वकामांश्च परत्रेह च जन्मनि । अश्वमेधमखस्यापि स फलं लभते पुमान्
verses.transliteration: akṣayānsarvakāmāṃśca paratreha ca janmani | aśvamedhamakhasyāpi sa phalaṃ labhate pumān
verses.translation: The sun's sphere is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas from the earth. The moon is situated thousands of Yojanas from this earth and a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun's sphere is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas from the earth. The moon is situated thousands of Yojanas from this earth and a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sun.
verses.science: तथा गौओंका दान करते थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महीं ददाति यस्तस्मै कृष्टां फलवतीं शुभाम् । स तारयति वै वंश्यान्दश पूर्वान् दशापरान्
verses.transliteration: mahīṃ dadāti yastasmai kṛṣṭāṃ phalavatīṃ śubhām | sa tārayati vai vaṃśyāndaśa pūrvān daśāparān
verses.translation: The spheres of the planets are entirely situated above the moon along with the stars about ten thousand Yojanas one above the other.
verses.hindi: जो सुना था, उसे संक्षेपमें कह दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: The spheres of the planets are entirely situated above the moon along with the stars about ten thousand Yojanas one above the other.
verses.science: जो सुना था, उसे संक्षेपमें कह दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इह भुक्त्वाखिलान् कामानन्ते दिव्यशरीरवान् । विमानेन च दिव्येन शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: iha bhuktvākhilān kāmānante divyaśarīravān | vimānena ca divyena śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The sphere of the seven sages (The Ursa Major) is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas above it. The Pole Star (Dhruva) is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas above the sages.
verses.hindi: बलशाली वृषध्न हाथमें तलवार लेकर दौड़े
verses.commentary: Sense: The sphere of the seven sages (The Ursa Major) is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas above it. The Pole Star (Dhruva) is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas above the sages.
verses.science: बलशाली वृषध्न हाथमें तलवार लेकर दौड़े। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: न यज्ञैस्तुष्टिमायान्ति देवाः प्रोक्षणकैरपि । बलिभिः पुष्पपूजाभिर्यथा पुस्तकवाचनैः
verses.transliteration: na yajñaistuṣṭimāyānti devāḥ prokṣaṇakairapi | balibhiḥ puṣpapūjābhiryathā pustakavācanaiḥ
verses.translation: The seven sons are—Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana, Kapila, Asuri, Vohu and PaficaSikha.
verses.hindi: राजाको देखकर भयभीत हो भाग गया
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sons are—Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana, Kapila, Asuri, Vohu and PaficaSikha.
verses.science: राजाको देखकर भयभीत हो भाग गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शम्भोरायतने यस्तु कारयेद्धर्मपुस्तकम् । विष्णोरर्कस्य कस्यापि शृणु तस्यापि तत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: śambhorāyatane yastu kārayeddharmapustakam | viṣṇorarkasya kasyāpi śṛṇu tasyāpi tatphalam
verses.translation: Two hundred thousand Yojanas above Jupiter, Saturn is stationed. These are the seven planets that stay in their respective zodiacs.
verses.hindi: व्याप्रको मरा जानकर अपने स्थानको लौट गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Two hundred thousand Yojanas above Jupiter, Saturn is stationed. These are the seven planets that stay in their respective zodiacs.
verses.science: व्याप्रको मरा जानकर अपने स्थानको लौट गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयाश्वमेधानां फलमाप्नोति मानवः । सूर्यलोकं च भित्त्वाशु ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ | sūryalokaṃ ca bhittvāśu brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The seven sages (Ursa Major) are stationed eleven hundred thousand Yojanas above the planet Saturn. The Dhruva star is said to be stationed fourteen hundred thousand Yojanas above the great star.
verses.hindi: मरा हुआ देखा, तब वे बड़े दुखी हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sages (Ursa Major) are stationed eleven hundred thousand Yojanas above the planet Saturn. The Dhruva star is said to be stationed fourteen hundred thousand Yojanas above the great star.
verses.science: मरा हुआ देखा, तब वे बड़े दुखी हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा कल्पशतान्यत्र राजा भवति भूतले । भुङ्क्ते निष्कण्टकं भोगान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sthitvā kalpaśatānyatra rājā bhavati bhūtale | bhuṅkte niṣkaṇṭakaṃ bhogānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Eighty four thousand Yojanas from Tapoloka is stationed the Satyaloka. It is known as Brahmaloka where the pure-minded, perfectly wise Brahmacarins engaged in truthful virtue stay. Men who go there from the earth also stay there.
verses.hindi: इृह भुक्त्वा सुखं दिव्यं मुक्ति पाप सुदुर्लभाम्॥ ६१  सुख भोगकर परम दुर्लभ मुक्ति प्राप्त की
verses.commentary: Sense: Eighty four thousand Yojanas from Tapoloka is stationed the Satyaloka. It is known as Brahmaloka where the pure-minded, perfectly wise Brahmacarins engaged in truthful virtue stay. Men who go there from the earth also stay there.
verses.science: इृह भुक्त्वा सुखं दिव्यं मुक्ति पाप सुदुर्लभाम्॥ ६१ सुख भोगकर परम दुर्लभ मुक्ति प्राप्त की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य यत्फलं समुदाहृतम् । तत्फलं समावाप्नोति देवाग्रे यो जपं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhasahasrasya yatphalaṃ samudāhṛtam | tatphalaṃ samāvāpnoti devāgre yo japaṃ caret
verses.translation: See P. 88 note.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीशिवयहाएुराणे पश्ञम्यायुमासंहितायां मनुनवपुत्रवशवर्णनं॑ नाम षट्ब्रिंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.explanation: जति श्रीशिवयहाएुराणे पश्ञम्यायुमासंहितायां मनुनवपुत्रवशवर्णनं॑ नाम षट्ब्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जति श्रीशिवयहाएुराणे पश्ञम्यायुमासंहितायां मनुनवपुत्रवशवर्णनं॑ नाम षट्ब्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां शम्भोरायतने शुभे । नान्यत्प्रीतिकरं शम्भोस्तथान्येषां दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ śambhorāyatane śubhe | nānyatprītikaraṃ śambhostathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām
verses.translation: la the Bhuvarloka, the sages of great Siddhis stay in the form of gods. In the Svargaloka, the gods, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Vasus, the twin Alvins, Viivedevas, Rudras, Sadhyas, Nagas, Khagas etc. stay. Above that are the nine planets and above them are the seven sages free from sins.
verses.hindi: वशवर्णन नामक छत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: la the Bhuvarloka, the sages of great Siddhis stay in the form of gods. In the Svargaloka, the gods, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Vasus, the twin Alvins, Viivedevas, Rudras, Sadhyas, Nagas, Khagas etc. stay.…
verses.commentary: Sense: la the Bhuvarloka, the sages of great Siddhis stay in the form of gods. In the Svargaloka, the gods, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Vasus, the twin Alvins, Viivedevas, Rudras, Sadhyas, Nagas, Khagas etc. stay.…
verses.science: वशवर्णन नामक छत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कार्यं पुस्तकवाचनम् । तथास्य श्रवणं प्रेम्णा सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryaṃ pustakavācanam | tathāsya śravaṇaṃ premṇā sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O sage, thus the seven worlds have been mentioned to you. The Patalas too are also seven. Thus the universe has been explained to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, thus the seven worlds have been mentioned to you. The Patalas too are also seven. Thus the universe has been explained to you.
verses.science: वह अयोध्याका राजा हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणश्रवणात् शम्भोर्निष्पापो जायते नरः । भुक्त्वा भोगान् सुविपुलान् शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: purāṇaśravaṇāt śambhorniṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ | bhuktvā bhogān suvipulān śivalokamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This eternal is the cause of all. O sage, it is the great Prakrti. From that infinite of unmanifest origin thousands and hundreds of thousands of cosmic eggs are born. The self-known great soul contains everything just as the wood contains latent fire, the gingelly seed the latent oil and the milk the latent ghee. From this primor¬ dial seed emerge all those beginning with Mahat and ending with Vilena. Then the gods and others are born. Then are born birds, their progenies and the seeds of others.
verses.hindi: पुत्रा: पद्चद्श स्मृता:॥ ५  उसके पन्द्रह पुत्र कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: This eternal is the cause of all. O sage, it is the great Prakrti. From that infinite of unmanifest origin thousands and hundreds of thousands of cosmic eggs are born. The self-known great soul contains everything just as the wood contains latent fire,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This eternal is the cause of all. O sage, it is the great Prakrti. From that infinite of unmanifest origin thousands and hundreds of thousands of cosmic eggs are born. The self-known great soul contains everything just as the wood contains latent fire,…
verses.science: पुत्रा: पद्चद्श स्मृता:॥ ५ उसके पन्द्रह पुत्र कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयेन यत्पुण्यमग्निष्टोमशतेन च । तत्पुण्यं लभते शम्भोः कथाश्रवणमात्रतः
verses.transliteration: rājasūyena yatpuṇyamagniṣṭomaśatena ca | tatpuṇyaṃ labhate śambhoḥ kathāśravaṇamātrataḥ
verses.translation: When the tree comes out of seed it does not suffer any depreciation or diminution. Just as fire appears from the solar stone coming in contact of the sun so also the creation takes place. I§iva has no desire for it. As a result of the contact of Siva with Sakti, the gods and others are born naturally.
verses.hindi: लिये उसीमें शयन कर रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: When the tree comes out of seed it does not suffer any depreciation or diminution. Just as fire appears from the solar stone coming in contact of the sun so also the creation takes place. I§iva has no desire for it. As a result of the contact of Siva with Sakti,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the tree comes out of seed it does not suffer any depreciation or diminution. Just as fire appears from the solar stone coming in contact of the sun so also the creation takes place. I§iva has no desire for it. As a result of the contact of Siva with Sakti,…
verses.science: लिये उसीमें शयन कर रहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थावगाहेन गवां कोटिप्रदानतः । तत् फलं लभते शम्भोः कथाश्रवणतो मुने
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthāvagāhena gavāṃ koṭipradānataḥ | tat phalaṃ labhate śambhoḥ kathāśravaṇato mune
verses.translation: They spring up through their own action. Siva manifests himself as Branna, Vifu and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: They spring up through their own action. Siva manifests himself as Branna, Vifu and Rudra.
verses.science: कुवलाश्व उनको दे दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये शृण्वन्ति कथां शम्भोः सदा भुवनपावनीम् । ते मनुष्या न मन्तव्या रुद्रा एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye śṛṇvanti kathāṃ śambhoḥ sadā bhuvanapāvanīm | te manuṣyā na mantavyā rudrā eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Every thing springs up from him and finally merges in him. Siva is sung as the performer of all activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every thing springs up from him and finally merges in him. Siva is sung as the performer of all activities.
verses.science: लिये उत्तंकके साथ चल दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वतां शिवसत्कीर्तिं सतां कीर्तयतां च ताम् । पादाम्बुजरजांस्येव तीर्थानि मुनयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇvatāṃ śivasatkīrtiṃ satāṃ kīrtayatāṃ ca tām | pādāmbujarajāṃsyeva tīrthāni munayo viduḥ
verses.translation: O sage Sanatkumara, O omniscient, please clear my doubts. Are there worlds above this universe?
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage Sanatkumara, O omniscient, please clear my doubts. Are there worlds above this universe?
verses.science: साथ उसमें प्रवेश कर गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्तुं निःश्रेयसं स्थानं येऽभिवाञ्छन्ति देहिनः । कथां पौराणिकीं शैवीं भक्त्या शृण्वन्तु ते सदा
verses.transliteration: gantuṃ niḥśreyasaṃ sthānaṃ ye'bhivāñchanti dehinaḥ | kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śaivīṃ bhaktyā śṛṇvantu te sadā
verses.translation: O great sage, there are worlds above the universe. Please listen. I shall explain them clearly but briefly.
verses.hindi: कहते हुए उसकी प्रशंसा करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, there are worlds above the universe. Please listen. I shall explain them clearly but briefly.
verses.science: कहते हुए उसकी प्रशंसा करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कथां पौराणिकीं श्रोतुं यद्यशक्तः सदा भवेत् । नियतात्मा प्रतिदिनं शृणुयाद्वा मुहूर्तकम्
verses.transliteration: kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śrotuṃ yadyaśaktaḥ sadā bhavet | niyatātmā pratidinaṃ śṛṇuyādvā muhūrtakam
verses.translation: Beyond that shines the excessively divine world of Uma, where l§akti—2§iva, the mother of the three deities shines.
verses.hindi: समसुद्रका जल भी ऊपर उठने लगता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Beyond that shines the excessively divine world of Uma, where l§akti—2§iva, the mother of the three deities shines.
verses.science: समसुद्रका जल भी ऊपर उठने लगता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रतिदिनं श्रोतुमशक्तो मानवो भवेत् । पुण्यमासादिषु मुने शृणुयाच्छाङ्करीं कथाम्
verses.transliteration: yadi pratidinaṃ śrotumaśakto mānavo bhavet | puṇyamāsādiṣu mune śṛṇuyācchāṅkarīṃ kathām
verses.translation: The eternal Sivaloka is above that. Here lord Siva, the great Brahman, shines. He is indestructible, exces¬ sively divine and endowed with great brilliance. He is the lord of all, greater than the three attributes. He is the proge¬ nitor of the three deities.
verses.hindi: उस धुन्धु राक्षषके समीप पहुँच गया
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal Sivaloka is above that. Here lord Siva, the great Brahman, shines. He is indestructible, exces¬ sively divine and endowed with great brilliance. He is the lord of all, greater than the three attributes. He is the proge¬ nitor of the three deities.
verses.science: उस धुन्धु राक्षषके समीप पहुँच गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवीं कथां हि शृण्वानः पुरुषो हि मुनीश्वर । स निस्तरति संसारं दग्ध्वा कर्ममहाटवीम्
verses.transliteration: śaivīṃ kathāṃ hi śṛṇvānaḥ puruṣo hi munīśvara | sa nistarati saṃsāraṃ dagdhvā karmamahāṭavīm
verses.translation: O dear, thus the situation of the entire universe is narrated to you. What more do you wish to hear about the position of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, thus the situation of the entire universe is narrated to you. What more do you wish to hear about the position of the worlds.
verses.science: अक्षयलोककी प्राप्तिका भी वरदान दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कथां शैवीं मुहूर्तं वा तदर्धं वा क्षणं च वा । ये शृण्वन्ति नरा भक्त्या न तेषां दुर्गतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kathāṃ śaivīṃ muhūrtaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ ca vā | ye śṛṇvanti narā bhaktyā na teṣāṃ durgatirbhavet
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, O the most excellent of the good, explain the acquisition of that by attaining which men endowed with devotion to Siva do not return again.
verses.hindi: हुआ, जो सदा धर्ममें संलग्न रहता था
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumara, O the most excellent of the good, explain the acquisition of that by attaining which men endowed with devotion to Siva do not return again.
verses.science: हुआ, जो सदा धर्ममें संलग्न रहता था। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्पुण्यं सर्वदानेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु वा मुने । शम्भोः पुराणश्रवणात्तत्फलं निश्चलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu sarvayajñeṣu vā mune | śambhoḥ purāṇaśravaṇāttatphalaṃ niścalaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Those who perform holy rites, who are endowed with very pious penance and who always worship Siva should be honoured in every way always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who perform holy rites, who are endowed with very pious penance and who always worship Siva should be honoured in every way always.
verses.science: सत्यव्रतने महर्षिके उस पुत्रकों छुड़ाया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतः कलौ व्यास पुराणश्रवणादृते । परो धर्मो न पुंसां हि मुक्तिध्यानपरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣataḥ kalau vyāsa purāṇaśravaṇādṛte | paro dharmo na puṃsāṃ hi muktidhyānaparaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have not performed austerities do not go to Siva's region which is free from ailments. O great sage, penance alone leads to Siva's blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have not performed austerities do not go to Siva's region which is free from ailments. O great sage, penance alone leads to Siva's blessings.
verses.science: नाम गलबंधान्महातपा: ॥ ५९ विख्यात हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणश्रवणं शम्भोर्नामसङ्कीर्तनं तथा । कल्पद्रुमफलं रम्यं मनुष्याणां न संशयः
verses.transliteration: purāṇaśravaṇaṃ śambhornāmasaṅkīrtanaṃ tathā | kalpadrumaphalaṃ ramyaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The gods and Ganas rejoice in heaven due to penance. So also the sages and the ascetics. Know my statement to be true.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीश्षिकमहापुराणे अ्यम्यायुमासहितायां मनुवंशवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods and Ganas rejoice in heaven due to penance. So also the sages and the ascetics. Know my statement to be true.
verses.science: जति श्रीश्षिकमहापुराणे अ्यम्यायुमासहितायां मनुवंशवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिशोउ ध्याय:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कलौ दुर्मेधसां पुंसां धर्माचारोज्झितात्मनाम् । हिताय विदधे शम्भुः पुराणाख्यं सुधारसम्
verses.transliteration: kalau durmedhasāṃ puṃsāṃ dharmācārojjhitātmanām | hitāya vidadhe śambhuḥ purāṇākhyaṃ sudhārasam
verses.translation: Every thing can be achieved through penance, whether it is difficult to be sustained, or propitiated or is burdensome or difficult to be transgressed. Penance cannot be transgressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every thing can be achieved through penance, whether it is difficult to be sustained, or propitiated or is burdensome or difficult to be transgressed. Penance cannot be transgressed.
verses.science: नामक सैतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽजरामरः स्याद्वै पिबन्नेवामृतं पुमान् । शम्भोः कथामृतापानात् कुलमेवाजरामरम्
verses.transliteration: eko'jarāmaraḥ syādvai pibannevāmṛtaṃ pumān | śambhoḥ kathāmṛtāpānāt kulamevājarāmaram
verses.translation: Brahma stays steady in his penance. So aNo Vi|nu and Siva. All the gods and the goddesses have attained rare benefits through penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma stays steady in his penance. So aNo Vi|nu and Siva. All the gods and the goddesses have attained rare benefits through penance.
verses.science: पत्नीका भरण- पोषण करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: या गतिः पुण्यशीलानां यज्विनां च तपस्विनाम् । सा गतिः सहसा तात पुराणश्रवणात्खलु
verses.transliteration: yā gatiḥ puṇyaśīlānāṃ yajvināṃ ca tapasvinām | sā gatiḥ sahasā tāta purāṇaśravaṇātkhalu
verses.translation: Their result too is threefold, achievable by the
verses.commentary: Sense: Their result too is threefold, achievable by the
verses.science: आश्रमके समीप रख देता था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानावाप्तिर्यदा न स्याद्योगशास्त्राणि यत्नतः । अध्येतव्यानि पौराणं शास्त्रं श्रोतव्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: jñānāvāptiryadā na syādyogaśāstrāṇi yatnataḥ | adhyetavyāni paurāṇaṃ śāstraṃ śrotavyameva ca
verses.translation: The Sattvika penance is the most excellent. It makes righteous intellect firm and steady. It has following characteristics—performance of ceremonial ablution, worship, Japa, sacrifice, scrupulous purity and cleanliness, non-violence, sacred rites, observance of fasts, silence, control of the sense- organs, pure intelligence, learning, truthfulness, refraining from anger, charitable gifts, forgiveness, suppression of the sense-organs, mercifulness, digging of wells, tanks and lakes, building of mansions for public cause observing Kfcchra, Candrayana and other rites, Yajrias, pilgrimages, hermitages, holy places and other acts pleasing to sensible persons. O Vyasa, good virtue is the cause of Siva's devotion. Cele¬ bration of the day of sun's transit, the conjunction of equinoxes the Nadamukta, Dhyana or meditation shall be in all the three occasions. It is the retention of the mind in the bril¬ liance. Pranayama is three-fold viz. Recaka, Puraka and Kumbhaka. This along with the knowledge of the course of the veins, withdrawal or obstruction of senses are the means of perfect knowledge and the achievement of the eight siddhis, Anima, etc.
verses.hindi: राज्य तथा अन्तःपुरकी रक्षा करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: The Sattvika penance is the most excellent. It makes righteous intellect firm and steady. It has following characteristics—performance of ceremonial ablution, worship, Japa, sacrifice, scrupulous purity and cleanliness, non-violence, sacred rites, observance of fasts, silence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sattvika penance is the most excellent. It makes righteous intellect firm and steady. It has following characteristics—performance of ceremonial ablution, worship, Japa, sacrifice, scrupulous purity and cleanliness, non-violence, sacred rites, observance of fasts, silence,…
verses.science: राज्य तथा अन्तःपुरकी रक्षा करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पापं सङ्क्षीयते नित्यं धर्मश्चैव विवर्धते । पुराणश्रवणाज्ज्ञानी न संसारं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: pāpaṃ saṅkṣīyate nityaṃ dharmaścaiva vivardhate | purāṇaśravaṇājjñānī na saṃsāraṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: In the state of trance there are various stages such as the stage of the log of wood, the stage of the dead and the stage of Harita. All these are destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: जानेपर भी मुनि वसिष्ठने मना नहीं किया था
verses.commentary: Sense: In the state of trance there are various stages such as the stage of the log of wood, the stage of the dead and the stage of Harita. All these are destructive of all sins.
verses.science: जानेपर भी मुनि वसिष्ठने मना नहीं किया था। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतएव पुराणानि श्रोतव्यानि प्रयत्नतः । धर्मार्थकामलाभाय मोक्षमार्गाप्तये तथा
verses.transliteration: ataeva purāṇāni śrotavyāni prayatnataḥ | dharmārthakāmalābhāya mokṣamārgāptaye tathā
verses.translation: These five are the prosperities of royal glory- women, bed, drink, good garments unguents and incense, and the chewing of betel leaves.
verses.commentary: Sense: These five are the prosperities of royal glory- women, bed, drink, good garments unguents and incense, and the chewing of betel leaves.
verses.science: शंकुकों अवश्य नष्ट कर देता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञैर्दानैस्तपोभिस्तु यत्फलं तीर्थसेवया । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति पुराणश्रवणान्नरः
verses.transliteration: yajñairdānaistapobhistu yatphalaṃ tīrthasevayā | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti purāṇaśravaṇānnaraḥ
verses.translation: The forms of various pleasures arc—blocks of gold, copper, houses, gems, cows, scholarship in the Vedas and Sastras, ornaments, ability to sing and dance, conches, Vii;>as, Mrdangas, lordly elephants, umbrellas and chowrira. Man yearning for these takes delight in these.
verses.hindi: होकर उस त्रिशंकुको वर प्रदान किया
verses.commentary: Sense: The forms of various pleasures arc—blocks of gold, copper, houses, gems, cows, scholarship in the Vedas and Sastras, ornaments, ability to sing and dance, conches, Vii;>as, Mrdangas, lordly elephants, umbrellas and chowrira. Man yearning for these takes delight in these.
verses.science: होकर उस त्रिशंकुको वर प्रदान किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न भवेयुः पुराणानि धर्ममार्गेक्षणानि तु । यद्यत्र यद् व्रती स्थाता कोऽत्र पारत्रिकीं कथाम्
verses.transliteration: na bhaveyuḥ purāṇāni dharmamārgekṣaṇāni tu | yadyatra yad vratī sthātā ko'tra pāratrikīṃ kathām
verses.translation: In spite of realising this he moves up and down in the world like the water-raising wheel. He takes various births in the mobile and immobile forms of life. He is distressed throughout.
verses.commentary: Sense: In spite of realising this he moves up and down in the world like the water-raising wheel. He takes various births in the mobile and immobile forms of life. He is distressed throughout.
verses.science: चक्रवर्ती राजाके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशति पुराणानां मध्येऽप्येकं शृणोति यः । पठेद्वा भक्तियुक्तस्तु स मुक्तो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍviṃśati purāṇānāṃ madhye'pyekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ | paṭhedvā bhaktiyuktastu sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After the transmigration through various forms of life ultimately he attains the rare human birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the transmigration through various forms of life ultimately he attains the rare human birth.
verses.science: नामक पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यो न दृष्टः सुखदो हि मार्गः पुराणमार्गो हि सदा वरिष्ठः । शास्त्रं विना सर्वमिदं न भाति सूर्येण हीना इव जीवलोकाः
verses.transliteration: anyo na dṛṣṭaḥ sukhado hi mārgaḥ purāṇamārgo hi sadā variṣṭhaḥ | śāstraṃ vinā sarvamidaṃ na bhāti sūryeṇa hīnā iva jīvalokāḥ
verses.translation: If anyone does not strive for salvation even after obtaining human birth which is capable of achieving heaven and salvation, surely he bemoans his lot for a long time, when dead.
verses.hindi: रहा हूँ, आप एकाग्रचित्त होकर सुनें
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone does not strive for salvation even after obtaining human birth which is capable of achieving heaven and salvation, surely he bemoans his lot for a long time, when dead.
verses.science: रहा हूँ, आप एकाग्रचित्त होकर सुनें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: A man who has taken the packet of fooding with him by virtue of giving charitable gifts, goes to Yama's abode without difficulty. Otherwise the creature suffers on the way without the packet of food.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who has taken the packet of fooding with him by virtue of giving charitable gifts, goes to Yama's abode without difficulty. Otherwise the creature suffers on the way without the packet of food.
verses.science: उस आमगनेयास्त्रकी शिक्षा ग्रहण को। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: A man who has taken the packet of fooding with him by virtue of giving charitable gifts, goes to Yama's abode without difficulty. Otherwise the creature suffers on the way without the packet of food.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who has taken the packet of fooding with him by virtue of giving charitable gifts, goes to Yama's abode without difficulty. Otherwise the creature suffers on the way without the packet of food.
verses.science: उनका वध करनेसे रोक दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । सामान्यदानवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । शस्तानि घोरदानानि महादानानि नित्यशः । पात्रेभ्यस्तु प्रदेयानि आत्मानं तारयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.14. caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | sāmānyadānavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | śastāni ghoradānāni mahādānāni nityaśaḥ | pātrebhyastu pradeyāni ātmānaṃ tārayanti ca
verses.translation: O Kaleya, they gain at every step whose merits are full and perfect and who go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kaleya, they gain at every step whose merits are full and perfect and who go to heaven.
verses.science: केशोंको विरूप कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यदानं गोदानं भूमिदानं द्विजोत्तम । गृह्णन्तो वै पवित्राणि तारयन्ति स्वमेव तम्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ dvijottama | gṛhṇanto vai pavitrāṇi tārayanti svameva tam
verses.translation: Cp. Rv. X. QO. I8
verses.commentary: Sense: Cp. Rv. X. QO. I8
verses.science: सर्वक्मके अनरण्य नामक पुत्र हुए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णदानं गोदानं पृथिवीदानमेव च । एतानि श्रेष्ठदानानि कृत्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ pṛthivīdānameva ca | etāni śreṣṭhadānāni kṛtvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: The king, or prince or the general who heroically fights and is killed by Katriya attains everlasting regions.
verses.hindi: एक सन्देह है, उसे मैं आपके समक्ष कहता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: The king, or prince or the general who heroically fights and is killed by Katriya attains everlasting regions.
verses.science: एक सन्देह है, उसे मैं आपके समक्ष कहता हूँ। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुलादानानि शस्तानि गावः पृथ्वी सरस्वती । द्वे तु तुल्यबले शस्ते ह्यधिका च सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: tulādānāni śastāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī | dve tu tulyabale śaste hyadhikā ca sarasvatī
verses.translation: Even a slayer of a brahmin fighting for his master
verses.hindi: सुनाते हुए प्रेमपूर्वक्क्‍ यह वचन कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a slayer of a brahmin fighting for his master
verses.science: सुनाते हुए प्रेमपूर्वक्क्‍ यह वचन कहने लगे--। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नित्य ह्यनुडुहो गावच्छत्रं वस्त्रमुपानहौ । देयानि याचमानेभ्यः पानमन्नं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: nitya hyanuḍuho gāvacchatraṃ vastramupānahau | deyāni yācamānebhyaḥ pānamannaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The goal realised by the person who dies for the brahmins, cows and his master, being killed by carnivorous beasts or tusked beasts is excellent. It yields him extensive and never>ending benefits.
verses.hindi: मुझसे कहा है, उसे आपसे मैं कह रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: The goal realised by the person who dies for the brahmins, cows and his master, being killed by carnivorous beasts or tusked beasts is excellent. It yields him extensive and never>ending benefits.
verses.science: मुझसे कहा है, उसे आपसे मैं कह रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पविहितो योऽर्थो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदीयते । अर्थिभ्योऽपीडितेभ्यश्च मनस्वी तेन जायते
verses.transliteration: saṅkalpavihito yo'rtho brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyate | arthibhyo'pīḍitebhyaśca manasvī tena jāyate
verses.translation: A man may be competent to perform hundreds of sacrifices, but it is very difficult to renounce his own body in a righteous war.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man may be competent to perform hundreds of sacrifices, but it is very difficult to renounce his own body in a righteous war.
verses.science: अनुसरण करती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कनकं च तिला नागाः कन्या दासी गृहं रथः । मणयः कपिला गावो महादानानि वै दश
verses.transliteration: kanakaṃ ca tilā nāgāḥ kanyā dāsī gṛhaṃ rathaḥ | maṇayaḥ kapilā gāvo mahādānāni vai daśa
verses.translation: Now I shall explain clearly the eternal virtue concerning war, as to who can be attacked and hit and who shall be spared.
verses.hindi: उत्तम वर देता हूँ, तुम उसे ग्रहण करो
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall explain clearly the eternal virtue concerning war, as to who can be attacked and hit and who shall be spared.
verses.science: उत्तम वर देता हूँ, तुम उसे ग्रहण करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वैतानि सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानवित्सदा । वदान्यांस्तारयेत्सद्यो ह्यात्मानं च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvaitāni sarvāṇi brāhmaṇo jñānavitsadā | vadānyāṃstārayetsadyo hyātmānaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Even if a brahmin well-versed in Vedanta doctrine were to attack one violently with lethal weapons one can fight him in return. He will not become guilty of brahmini- cide thereby.®**
verses.hindi: तद् बूहि भरतश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि वर्तते॥२८  उसे माँगो
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if a brahmin well-versed in Vedanta doctrine were to attack one violently with lethal weapons one can fight him in return. He will not become guilty of brahmini- cide thereby.®**
verses.science: तद् बूहि भरतश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि वर्तते॥२८ उसे माँगो। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णं ये प्रयच्छन्ति नराः शुद्धेन चेतसा । देवतास्तं प्रयच्छन्ति समन्तादिति मे श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti narāḥ śuddhena cetasā | devatāstaṃ prayacchanti samantāditi me śrutam
verses.translation: Even a murderer shall not be attacked and killed if he is thirsty and begs for water. O Vyasa, by killing the sick and the distressed even in battle a man becomes guilty of brahminicide.
verses.hindi: पूछता हूँ, आप उसका उत्तर दें
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a murderer shall not be attacked and killed if he is thirsty and begs for water. O Vyasa, by killing the sick and the distressed even in battle a man becomes guilty of brahminicide.
verses.science: पूछता हूँ, आप उसका उत्तर दें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि देवताः सर्वाः सुवर्णं च हुताशनः । तस्मात् सुवर्णं दत्त्वा च दत्ताः स्युः सर्वदेवताः
verses.transliteration: agnirhi devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca hutāśanaḥ | tasmāt suvarṇaṃ dattvā ca dattāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ
verses.translation: Realising this, man should perform meritorious rites and avoid sinful activities. Thanks to the merit one attains godhood. A person devoid of merit goes to hell.
verses.hindi: काम्बोजोंका सारा सिर मुंडवाकर उन्हें छोड़ दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising this, man should perform meritorious rites and avoid sinful activities. Thanks to the merit one attains godhood. A person devoid of merit goes to hell.
verses.science: काम्बोजोंका सारा सिर मुंडवाकर उन्हें छोड़ दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वीदानं महाश्रेष्ठं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । सौवर्णं च विशेषेण यत्कृतं पृथुना पुरा
verses.transliteration: pṛthvīdānaṃ mahāśreṣṭhaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | sauvarṇaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa yatkṛtaṃ pṛthunā purā
verses.translation: They who take.refuge in Siva, lord of the gods, even slightly, do not see the terrible Yama nor the terrible hell.
verses.hindi: स्वाध्याय एवं वषट्कारसे रहित कर दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: They who take.refuge in Siva, lord of the gods, even slightly, do not see the terrible Yama nor the terrible hell.
verses.science: स्वाध्याय एवं वषट्कारसे रहित कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दीयमानां प्रपश्यन्ति पृथ्वीं रुक्मसमन्विताम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti pṛthvīṃ rukmasamanvitām | sarvapāpavinirmuktāste yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: But at the behest of Siva, due to sins and great delusions, those men stay there for sometime and then go to the region of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: But at the behest of Siva, due to sins and great delusions, those men stay there for sometime and then go to the region of Siva.
verses.science: एक घोड़ेका संस्कार कराया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यच्च प्रवक्ष्यामि दानं सर्वोत्तमं मुने । कान्तारं यन्न पश्यन्ति यमस्य बहुदुःखदम्
verses.transliteration: athānyacca pravakṣyāmi dānaṃ sarvottamaṃ mune | kāntāraṃ yanna paśyanti yamasya bahuduḥkhadam
verses.translation: The verse with slight variations occurs in Pane. MitraprApti (Verse 141).
verses.hindi: दति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यायुमासंहितायां सत्यव्रतादिसगरपर्यन्तवंशवर्णन॑ नामाष्टात्रिशों5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The verse with slight variations occurs in Pane. MitraprApti (Verse 141).
verses.science: दति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यायुमासंहितायां सत्यव्रतादिसगरपर्यन्तवंशवर्णन॑ नामाष्टात्रिशों5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात् कान्तारदानं हि विधिना शुद्धमानसः । न्यायार्जितेन द्रव्येण वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: kuryāt kāntāradānaṃ hi vidhinā śuddhamānasaḥ | nyāyārjitena dravyeṇa vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: But those who have taken refuge in lord Siva wholly are not smeared with sin like the leaf of the lotus with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: But those who have taken refuge in lord Siva wholly are not smeared with sin like the leaf of the lotus with water.
verses.science: नामक अड़तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तिलप्रस्थमयीं कृत्वा धेनुं सर्वगुणान्विताम् । धेनुवत्सं सुवर्णं च सुदिव्यं सर्वलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tilaprasthamayīṃ kṛtvā dhenuṃ sarvaguṇānvitām | dhenuvatsaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca sudivyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, they who repeat the names of Siva need not be afraid of hell or Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, they who repeat the names of Siva need not be afraid of hell or Yama.
verses.science: उन्हें वर प्रदान किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्ममष्टदलं कृत्वा कुङ्कुमाक्ताक्षतैः शुभैः । पूजयेत्तत्र रुद्रादीन्सर्वान्देवान्सुभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā kuṅkumāktākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ | pūjayettatra rudrādīnsarvāndevānsubhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: The two syllables **Siva** constitute the packet of fooding for the journey to the other world; it is the means of salvation, free from worries and is the abode of all merits.
verses.hindi: अलग सभी बालक बीजरूपसे वर्तमान थे
verses.commentary: Sense: The two syllables **Siva** constitute the packet of fooding for the journey to the other world; it is the means of salvation, free from worries and is the abode of all merits.
verses.science: अलग सभी बालक बीजरूपसे वर्तमान थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूज्य तां दद्याद् ब्राह्मणाय स्वशक्तितः । सरत्नां सहिरण्यां च सर्वाभरणभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sampūjya tāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya svaśaktitaḥ | saratnāṃ sahiraṇyāṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām
verses.translation: Formerly Pulkaa committed thousands of murders of Brahmins but on hearing the sacred name Siva, he attained salvation.
verses.hindi: पंचजन नामक पुत्र बादमें राजा हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly Pulkaa committed thousands of murders of Brahmins but on hearing the sacred name Siva, he attained salvation.
verses.science: पंचजन नामक पुत्र बादमें राजा हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो नक्तं समश्नीयाद्दीपान् दद्यात्तु विस्तरात् । कार्तिक्यामिति कर्तव्यं पूर्णिमायां प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tato naktaṃ samaśnīyāddīpān dadyāttu vistarāt | kārtikyāmiti kartavyaṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Hence a sensible man shall enhance his devotion to Siva incessantly. O intelligent one, one attains worldly pleasures and salvation due to the devotion to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence a sensible man shall enhance his devotion to Siva incessantly. O intelligent one, one attains worldly pleasures and salvation due to the devotion to Siva.
verses.science: पुत्र वीर्यवान्ू अयुताजितू हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं यः कुरुते सम्यग्विधानेन स्वशक्तितः । यममार्गभयं घोरं नरकं च न पश्यति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyagvidhānena svaśaktitaḥ | yamamārgabhayaṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ ca na paśyati
verses.translation: O Kaleya, men fall off their status due to evil deeds. Hence, after attaining the high status, the learned man shall preserve it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kaleya, men fall off their status due to evil deeds. Hence, after attaining the high status, the learned man shall preserve it.
verses.science: नलके परम सुहृद् थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापान्यशेषाणि सबन्धुः ससुहृज्जनः । दिवि सङ्क्रीडते व्यास यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pāpānyaśeṣāṇi sabandhuḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ | divi saṅkrīḍate vyāsa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: Due to his resorting to evil, the foolish fellow goes
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to his resorting to evil, the foolish fellow goes
verses.science: लोकोंका संग्रह किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विधितो गोश्च दानं वै सर्वोत्तममिह स्मृतम् । न तेन सदृशं व्यास परं दानं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: vidhito gośca dānaṃ vai sarvottamamiha smṛtam | na tena sadṛśaṃ vyāsa paraṃ dānaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Hence after attaining the highest status one should not err or destroy it. Even in the face of adversity one shall always preserve his status.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence after attaining the highest status one should not err or destroy it. Even in the face of adversity one shall always preserve his status.
verses.science: पुत्र निषध हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रयच्छते यः कपिलां सवत्सां स्वर्णशृङ्गिकाम् । कांस्यपात्रां रौप्यखुरां सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम्
verses.transliteration: prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ savatsāṃ svarṇaśṛṅgikām | kāṃsyapātrāṃ raupyakhurāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām
verses.translation: After attaining the auspicious brahminhood if a person disrespects brahminhood and does not differentiate between what could be eaten and what could not be eaten he becomes a Katriya.
verses.hindi: पुण्डरीक और उनके पुत्र क्षेमधन्वा कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining the auspicious brahminhood if a person disrespects brahminhood and does not differentiate between what could be eaten and what could not be eaten he becomes a Katriya.
verses.science: पुण्डरीक और उनके पुत्र क्षेमधन्वा कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तैर्गुणैः कामदुघा भूत्वा सा गौरुपैति तम् । प्रदातारं नरं व्यास परत्रेह च जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: taistairguṇaiḥ kāmadughā bhūtvā sā gaurupaiti tam | pradātāraṃ naraṃ vyāsa paratreha ca janmani
verses.translation: I shall explain to you entirely that which gives a higher caste whereby an intelligent 8udra becomes a Vaiya.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain to you entirely that which gives a higher caste whereby an intelligent 8udra becomes a Vaiya.
verses.science: देवानीकके पुत्र राजा अहीनगु थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यदिष्टतमं लोके तदस्ति दयितं गृहे । तत्तद् गुणवते देयं तदेवाक्षयमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke tadasti dayitaṃ gṛhe | tattad guṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣayamicchatā
verses.translation: Being born a 8udra, one shall take up the duties of 8udra as ordained, viz, the due service to the people of the other three castes.
verses.hindi: हुआ। बलके पुत्रका नाम स्थल था
verses.commentary: Sense: Being born a 8udra, one shall take up the duties of 8udra as ordained, viz, the due service to the people of the other three castes.
verses.science: हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तुलापुरुषदानं हि दानानां दानमुत्तमम् । तुलासंरोहणं कार्यं यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: tulāpuruṣadānaṃ hi dānānāṃ dānamuttamam | tulāsaṃrohaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Strictly observing his rites, speaking truth and controlling the sense-organs he derives vast pleasures of heaven. He becomes a favourite of the gods.
verses.hindi: जायगा और पुन: ब्राह्म सत्ययुगमें बढ़ेगा
verses.commentary: Sense: Strictly observing his rites, speaking truth and controlling the sense-organs he derives vast pleasures of heaven. He becomes a favourite of the gods.
verses.science: जायगा और पुन: ब्राह्म सत्ययुगमें बढ़ेगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्कृत्वा मुच्यते पापैर्वधबन्धकृतोद्भवैः । तुलादानं महत्पुण्यं सर्वपापक्षयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: yatkṛtvā mucyate pāpairvadhabandhakṛtodbhavaiḥ | tulādānaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṅkaram
verses.translation: O great sage, brahminhood is very difiicult to achieve. It is attained by men who undergo hardships.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, brahminhood is very difiicult to achieve. It is attained by men who undergo hardships.
verses.science: पुण्य प्रदान करनेवाली है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापान्यशेषाणि तुलादानं करोति यः । सर्वैस्तु पातकैर्मुक्तः स दिवं यात्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pāpānyaśeṣāṇi tulādānaṃ karoti yaḥ | sarvaistu pātakairmuktaḥ sa divaṃ yātyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, you have mentioned about the glory. O foremost among the eloquent, I wish to hear this. Please men don.
verses.hindi: प्रजावानेति सायुज्यमिह भुक्त्वा सुखं परम्॥ ४६  करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, you have mentioned about the glory. O foremost among the eloquent, I wish to hear this. Please men don.
verses.science: प्रजावानेति सायुज्यमिह भुक्त्वा सुखं परम्॥ ४६ करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पापं कृतं यद्दिवसे निशायां द्विसन्ध्ययोर्मध्यदिने निशान्ते । कालत्रये कायमनोवचोभिः तुलापुमान्वै तदपाकरोति
verses.transliteration: pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ yaddivase niśāyāṃ dvisandhyayormadhyadine niśānte | kālatraye kāyamanovacobhiḥ tulāpumānvai tadapākaroti
verses.translation: The hero who offers battle subduing the army of the enemy attains virtue, wealth and fame. He achieves the fruit of a sacrifice with due gifts and the three aims of life, virtue, wealth and love. He who faces the enemy, kills him and gets on to the enemy's chariot goes to Vinuloka. He who is not defeated in war, nor killed in it attains the fruit of four horse-sacrifices.
verses.wordMeaning: The hero who offers battle subduing the army of the enemy attains virtue, wealth and fame. He achieves the fruit of a sacrifice with due gifts and the three aims of life, virtue, wealth and love. He who faces the enemy,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The hero who offers battle subduing the army of the enemy attains virtue, wealth and fame. He achieves the fruit of a sacrifice with due gifts and the three aims of life, virtue, wealth and love. He who faces the enemy,…
verses.science: नामक उनतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: बालेन वृद्धेन मया हि यूना विजानता ज्ञानपरेण पापम् । तत्सर्वमेवाशु कृतं मदीयं तुलापुमान् वै हरतु स्मरारिः
verses.transliteration: bālena vṛddhena mayā hi yūnā vijānatā jñānapareṇa pāpam | tatsarvamevāśu kṛtaṃ madīyaṃ tulāpumān vai haratu smarāriḥ
verses.translation: He who dies in the war-front without surrender¬ ing his weapons attains heaven from which there is no return.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dies in the war-front without surrender¬ ing his weapons attains heaven from which there is no return.
verses.science: एवं अति पवित्र कथा सुनायी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पात्रे प्रयुक्तं द्रविणं मयाद्य प्रमाणपूर्णं निहितं तुलायाम् । तेनैव सार्धं तु ममावशेषं कृताकृतं यत्सुकृतं समेतु
verses.transliteration: pātre prayuktaṃ draviṇaṃ mayādya pramāṇapūrṇaṃ nihitaṃ tulāyām | tenaiva sārdhaṃ tu mamāvaśeṣaṃ kṛtākṛtaṃ yatsukṛtaṃ sametu
verses.translation: He attains as many worlds as the number of his hairs split by arrows in the battle. All of these will be wish-yielding and eternal.
verses.hindi: अपने वंशजका निरन्तर कल्याण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He attains as many worlds as the number of his hairs split by arrows in the battle. All of these will be wish-yielding and eternal.
verses.science: अपने वंशजका निरन्तर कल्याण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एवमुच्चार्य तं दद्यात् द्विजेभ्यः सर्वदा हितः । नैकस्यापि प्रदातव्यं न निस्तारस्ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | evamuccārya taṃ dadyāt dvijebhyaḥ sarvadā hitaḥ | naikasyāpi pradātavyaṃ na nistārastato bhavet
verses.translation: O Vyasa, both here and hereafter he will have heroic seat, heroic bed, heroic status and heroic stability always.
verses.hindi: यह सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, both here and hereafter he will have heroic seat, heroic bed, heroic status and heroic stability always.
verses.science: यह सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ददात्येवं तु यो व्यास तुलापुरुषमुत्तमम् । हत्वा पापं दिव्यं तिष्ठेद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: dadātyevaṃ tu yo vyāsa tulāpuruṣamuttamam | hatvā pāpaṃ divyaṃ tiṣṭhedyāvadindrāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: Those who die for the protection of cows, brah¬ mins, status and the master go happily to the other woild like virtuous persons.*
verses.hindi: नहीं होता, इसे मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who die for the protection of cows, brah¬ mins, status and the master go happily to the other woild like virtuous persons.*
verses.science: नहीं होता, इसे मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After considering all this, an intelligent man shall strenuously indulge in battles. He will achieve the purpose of his life and rejoice here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: मैंने राजासे पूछा, तब वे उसे कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: After considering all this, an intelligent man shall strenuously indulge in battles. He will achieve the purpose of his life and rejoice here and hereafter.
verses.science: मैंने राजासे पूछा, तब वे उसे कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: After considering all this, an intelligent man shall strenuously indulge in battles. He will achieve the purpose of his life and rejoice here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: After considering all this, an intelligent man shall strenuously indulge in battles. He will achieve the purpose of his life and rejoice here and hereafter.
verses.science: तब उन धर्मवेत्ताने मुझसे कहा--। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । पाताललोकवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । येनैकेन हि दत्तेन सर्वेषां प्राप्यते फलम् । दानानां तन्ममाख्याहि मानुषाणां हितार्थतः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.15. pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | pātālalokavarṇanam | vyāsa uvāca | yenaikena hi dattena sarveṣāṃ prāpyate phalam | dānānāṃ tanmamākhyāhi mānuṣāṇāṃ hitārthataḥ
verses.translation: According to the laws of the caste as laid down in the DharmaSistras, the profession of hghting is assigned exclusively to the people of Katriya caste. But 3 P. probably following the contemporary practice allows it for all the castes.
verses.hindi: अन्दरसे आते हुए किसी विशाल विमानको देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the laws of the caste as laid down in the DharmaSistras, the profession of hghting is assigned exclusively to the people of Katriya caste. But 3 P. probably following the contemporary practice allows it for all the castes.
verses.science: अन्दरसे आते हुए किसी विशाल विमानको देखा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । शृणु काले प्रदत्ताद्वै फलं विन्दन्ति मानवाः । एकस्मादपि सर्वेषां दानानां तद्वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu kāle pradattādvai phalaṃ vindanti mānavāḥ | ekasmādapi sarveṣāṃ dānānāṃ tadvadāmi te
verses.translation: The hair of the body and flesh are produced from the blood. The hair on the head and the sinews arc produced from the flesh. From the sinews the bones are produced. The nails and marrow are produced from the bones.
verses.hindi: दृष्टि देकर शीघ्र ही योगगतिको प्राप्त हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The hair of the body and flesh are produced from the blood. The hair on the head and the sinews arc produced from the flesh. From the sinews the bones are produced. The nails and marrow are produced from the bones.
verses.science: दृष्टि देकर शीघ्र ही योगगतिको प्राप्त हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दानानामुत्तमं दानं ब्रह्माण्डं खलु मानवैः । दातव्यं मुक्तिकामैस्तु संसारोत्तारणाय वै
verses.transliteration: dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ khalu mānavaiḥ | dātavyaṃ muktikāmaistu saṃsārottāraṇāya vai
verses.translation: "I am dead and born many times In these different births I have seen many types of wombs.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होकर वहीं विहार करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am dead and born many times In these different births I have seen many types of wombs.
verses.science: प्राप्त होकर वहीं विहार करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डे सकले दत्ते यत्फलं लभते नरः । तदेकभावादाप्नोति सप्तलोकाधिपो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍe sakale datte yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | tadekabhāvādāpnoti saptalokādhipo bhavet
verses.translation: For him staying inside the womb the misery is equal to, nay, more than the misery of a person incessantly pierced by means of redhot needles.
verses.commentary: Sense: For him staying inside the womb the misery is equal to, nay, more than the misery of a person incessantly pierced by means of redhot needles.
verses.science: अभ्यास करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ नभसि वा यावत् स्थिरा मेदिनी तावत्सोऽपि नरः स्वबान्धवयुतः स्वर्गौकसामोकसि । सर्वेष्वेव मनोनुगेषु ककुभिर्ब्रह्माण्डदः क्रीडते पश्चाद्याति पदं सुदुर्लभतरं देवैर्मुदे माधवम्
verses.transliteration: yāvaccandradivākarau nabhasi vā yāvat sthirā medinī tāvatso'pi naraḥ svabāndhavayutaḥ svargaukasāmokasi | sarveṣveva manonugeṣu kakubhirbrahmāṇḍadaḥ krīḍate paścādyāti padaṃ sudurlabhataraṃ devairmude mādhavam
verses.translation: Getting crushed in the vaginal passage as if with¬ in a machine is a misery more grievous than the stay within the womb. O VySsa, this takes place in regard to dic sinnen and not the virtuous.
verses.hindi: छिद्रदर्शक, स्वतन्त्र और सुयज्ञ नामवाले हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting crushed in the vaginal passage as if with¬ in a machine is a misery more grievous than the stay within the womb. O VySsa, this takes place in regard to dic sinnen and not the virtuous.
verses.science: छिद्रदर्शक, स्वतन्त्र और सुयज्ञ नामवाले हुए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । भगवन् ब्रहि ब्रह्माण्डं यत्प्रमाणं यदात्मकम् । यदाधारं यथाभूतं येन मे प्रत्ययो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca | bhagavan brahi brahmāṇḍaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ yadātmakam | yadādhāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ yena me pratyayo bhavet
verses.translation: Just as the gingelly seeds pressed in the oil machine become a worthless residue, so also the body becomes a waste being crushed by the muscular walls of the vaginal passage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the gingelly seeds pressed in the oil machine become a worthless residue, so also the body becomes a waste being crushed by the muscular walls of the vaginal passage.
verses.science: सम्पूर्ण सौभाग्यका पात्र हो जाऊँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । मुने शृणु प्रवक्ष्यामि यदुत्सेधं तु विस्तरम् । ब्रह्माण्डं तत्तु सङ्क्षेपाच्छ्रुत्वा पापात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | mune śṛṇu pravakṣyāmi yadutsedhaṃ tu vistaram | brahmāṇḍaṃ tattu saṅkṣepācchrutvā pāpātpramucyate
verses.translation: This body in the womb is in an unenviable position. The hands and legs are like suspended pillars. Sinews tie them up in various ways. The whole body is smeared with dirty blood and flesh. It is the receptacle of faeces and urine. It is covered with hairs and nails. It is sickly and an abode of ailments. The only great opening is the mouth. It has eight small apertures like windows. The two lips are like two doors. The tongue is the bolt for them. The body is sick due to its thirst for pleasures. It is subservient to passion and hatred and utterly deluded. The various limbs overlap one another. It is surrounded by the embryonic membrane. With very great pain and difficulty it has to come out of the vaginal passage. It is drenched with urine, blood and faeces. It comes out as from a sheath. It is a mass of skeleton.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे प्रिय तथा हितैषी मन्त्री होवें
verses.wordMeaning: This body in the womb is in an unenviable position. The hands and legs are like suspended pillars. Sinews tie them up in various ways. The whole body is smeared with dirty blood and flesh. It is the receptacle of faeces and urine. It is covered with hairs and nails.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This body in the womb is in an unenviable position. The hands and legs are like suspended pillars. Sinews tie them up in various ways. The whole body is smeared with dirty blood and flesh. It is the receptacle of faeces and urine. It is covered with hairs and nails.…
verses.science: तुम्हारे प्रिय तथा हितैषी मन्त्री होवें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्तत्कारणमव्यक्तं व्यक्तं शिवमनामयम् । तस्मात्सञ्जायते ब्रह्मा द्विधाभूताद्धि कालतः
verses.transliteration: yattatkāraṇamavyaktaṃ vyaktaṃ śivamanāmayam | tasmātsañjāyate brahmā dvidhābhūtāddhi kālataḥ
verses.translation: The bones are three hundred and sixty in number. There are five hundred muscles. The body is covered with thirtyfive million hairs.
verses.hindi: मन्त्री होनेके लिये अपनी बात की थी
verses.commentary: Sense: The bones are three hundred and sixty in number. There are five hundred muscles. The body is covered with thirtyfive million hairs.
verses.science: मन्त्री होनेके लिये अपनी बात की थी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डं सृजति ब्रह्मा चतुर्दशभवात्मकम् । तद्वच्मि क्रमतस्तात समासाच्छृणु यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍaṃ sṛjati brahmā caturdaśabhavātmakam | tadvacmi kramatastāta samāsācchṛṇu yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The hairs are subtle and gross, visible and in¬ visible. The veins and vessels within the body too are so many in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hairs are subtle and gross, visible and in¬ visible. The veins and vessels within the body too are so many in number.
verses.science: कह रहा हूँ, उसे सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पातालानि तु सप्तैव भुवनानि तथोर्ध्वतः । उच्छ्रायो द्विगुणस्तस्य जलमध्ये स्थितस्य च
verses.transliteration: pātālāni tu saptaiva bhuvanāni tathordhvataḥ | ucchrāyo dviguṇastasya jalamadhye sthitasya ca
verses.translation: Cp. Manu viii, 350, 35*.
verses.hindi: अग्निके समान तेजोमय प्रतीत हो रहा था
verses.commentary: Sense: Cp. Manu viii, 350, 35*.
verses.science: अग्निके समान तेजोमय प्रतीत हो रहा था। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्याधारः स्थितो नागः स च विष्णुः प्रकीर्तितः । ब्रह्मणो वचसां हेतोर्बिभर्ति सकलं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: tasyādhāraḥ sthito nāgaḥ sa ca viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ | brahmaṇo vacasāṃ hetorbibharti sakalaṃ tvidam
verses.translation: O dear, O great sage, for realizing the worldly detachment please mention the detailed mode of the birth of living beings and their stay in the womb.
verses.hindi: यह मेरा नाम कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, O great sage, for realizing the worldly detachment please mention the detailed mode of the birth of living beings and their stay in the womb.
verses.science: यह मेरा नाम कहा गया है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शेषस्यास्य गुणान् वक्तुं न शक्ता देवदानवाः । योऽनन्तः पठ्यते सिद्धैर्देवर्षिगणपूजितः
verses.transliteration: śeṣasyāsya guṇān vaktuṃ na śaktā devadānavāḥ | yo'nantaḥ paṭhyate siddhairdevarṣigaṇapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, listen succinctly to the essence of the sacred lore. I shall explain the excellent mode of worldly detachment which removes the bondage with the world, of a man desirous of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, listen succinctly to the essence of the sacred lore. I shall explain the excellent mode of worldly detachment which removes the bondage with the world, of a man desirous of liberation.
verses.science: यथार्थ रूपसे कहिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरः सहस्रयुक्तः स सर्वा विद्योतयन्दिशः । फणामणिसहस्रेण स्वस्तिकामलभूषणः
verses.transliteration: śiraḥ sahasrayuktaḥ sa sarvā vidyotayandiśaḥ | phaṇāmaṇisahasreṇa svastikāmalabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: When we cook rice the process is as follows. In the cooking vessel the rice and water remain separate. Water is above fire. The rice is above water. The wind slowly blows against the fire beneath the water. The fre kindled by the wind makes the water boil.
