verses.commentary: Sense: When we cook rice the process is as follows. In the cooking vessel the rice and water remain separate. Water is above fire. The rice is above water. The wind slowly blows against the fire beneath the water. The fre kindled by the wind makes the water boil.
verses.science: तत्त्वपूर्वक कहता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मदाघूर्णितनेत्रोऽसौ साग्निः श्वेत इवाचलः । स्रग्वी किरीटी ह्याभाति यः सदैवैककुण्डलः
verses.transliteration: madāghūrṇitanetro'sau sāgniḥ śveta ivācalaḥ | sragvī kirīṭī hyābhāti yaḥ sadaivaikakuṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: The rice with hot-boiling water all round it be¬ comes cooked. When cooked it becomes separated into sediment and juice.
verses.hindi: तुमलोग पितर होओगे, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: The rice with hot-boiling water all round it be¬ comes cooked. When cooked it becomes separated into sediment and juice.
verses.science: तुमलोग पितर होओगे, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साभ्रगङ्गाप्रवाहेण श्वेतशैलोपशोभितः । नीलवासा मदोद्रिक्तः कैलासाद्रिरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: sābhragaṅgāpravāheṇa śvetaśailopaśobhitaḥ | nīlavāsā madodriktaḥ kailāsādririvāparaḥ
verses.translation: (More or less a similar process takes place in the body.) The sediment in the body consists of twelve forms of waste matter. These are split and sent out of the body. The juice matter circulates in the body. Man gets nourished through it.
verses.commentary: Sense: (More or less a similar process takes place in the body.) The sediment in the body consists of twelve forms of waste matter. These are split and sent out of the body. The juice matter circulates in the body. Man gets nourished through it.
verses.science: पिता-पुत्रके रूपमें पृथ्वीपर प्रसिद्ध हुए। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: लाङ्गलासक्तहस्ताग्रो बिभ्रन्मुसलमुत्तमम् । योऽर्च्यते नागकन्याभिः स्वर्णवर्णाभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: lāṅgalāsaktahastāgro bibhranmusalamuttamam | yo'rcyate nāgakanyābhiḥ svarṇavarṇābhirādarāt
verses.translation: The ears, the eyes, the nose, the tongue, the teeth, the penis, the anus, and the nails are the receptacles of dirt secreted by them. The phlegm, the sweat, the fiateces and the urine—these together make up the twelve.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां श्राद्धकल्पे पितृप्रभाववर्णन॑ नाम चत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The ears, the eyes, the nose, the tongue, the teeth, the penis, the anus, and the nails are the receptacles of dirt secreted by them. The phlegm, the sweat, the fiateces and the urine—these together make up the twelve.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां श्राद्धकल्पे पितृप्रभाववर्णन॑ नाम चत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कर्षणात्मको रुद्रो विषानलशिखोज्ज्वलः । कल्पान्ते निष्क्रमन्ते यद्वक्त्रेभ्योऽग्निशिखा मुहुः । दग्ध्वा जगत्त्रयं शान्ता भवन्तीत्यनुशुश्रुमः
verses.transliteration: saṅkarṣaṇātmako rudro viṣānalaśikhojjvalaḥ | kalpānte niṣkramante yadvaktrebhyo'gniśikhā muhuḥ | dagdhvā jagattrayaṃ śāntā bhavantītyanuśuśrumaḥ
verses.translation: All the vessels scattered all over the body are joined centrally at the heart. These vessels shall be under¬ stood to convey Rasa. O sage, I shall mention their process of working.
verses.hindi: पितृप्रभाववर्णन नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: All the vessels scattered all over the body are joined centrally at the heart. These vessels shall be under¬ stood to convey Rasa. O sage, I shall mention their process of working.
verses.science: पितृप्रभाववर्णन नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते पातालमूलस्थः सशेषः क्षितिमण्डलम् । बिभ्रत्स्वपृष्ठे भूतेशः शेषोऽशेषगुणार्चितः
verses.transliteration: āste pātālamūlasthaḥ saśeṣaḥ kṣitimaṇḍalam | bibhratsvapṛṣṭhe bhūteśaḥ śeṣo'śeṣaguṇārcitaḥ
verses.translation: Praa (the vital air) places the subtle lymph at the mouths of the vessels, llien it fills the entire vessels with the lymph,
verses.commentary: Sense: Praa (the vital air) places the subtle lymph at the mouths of the vessels, llien it fills the entire vessels with the lymph,
verses.science: उन्हींका यजन करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वीर्यप्रभावश्च साकाङ्क्षैस्त्रिदशैरपि । न हि वर्णयितुं शक्यः स्वरूपं ज्ञातुमेव वा
verses.transliteration: tasya vīryaprabhāvaśca sākāṅkṣaistridaśairapi | na hi varṇayituṃ śakyaḥ svarūpaṃ jñātumeva vā
verses.translation: Thus filled, the vessels circulate all over the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus filled, the vessels circulate all over the
verses.science: विशेष रूपसे पितृभक्ति करनी चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते कुसुममालेव फणामणिशिखारुणा । यस्यैषा सकला पृथ्वी कस्तद्वीर्यं वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: āste kusumamāleva phaṇāmaṇiśikhāruṇā | yasyaiṣā sakalā pṛthvī kastadvīryaṃ vadiṣyati
verses.translation: An alternative cause of marrow, the semen itself becomes progeny. Thus the twelvefold ihetabolism of bood is explained.
verses.hindi: अनुसार कार्य भी किया करते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: An alternative cause of marrow, the semen itself becomes progeny. Thus the twelvefold ihetabolism of bood is explained.
verses.science: अनुसार कार्य भी किया करते थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा विजृम्भतेऽनन्तो मदाघूर्णितलोचनः । तदा चलति भूरेषा साद्रितोयाधिकानना
verses.transliteration: yadā vijṛmbhate'nanto madāghūrṇitalocanaḥ | tadā calati bhūreṣā sādritoyādhikānanā
verses.translation: The semen is secreted from the food eaten From the semen, the birth of another body is made possible. When the semen unalloyed is deposited in the vaginal passage during the prescribed period of cohabitation after the monthly menses, then the semen blown by the vital wind mingles with the blood of the woman. At the time when the semen is discharged the individual soul with the causal body or unit of sense-organs etc. enters the vaginal passage fully covered and urged by its past actions. The semen and blood in the unified state become foetus in a day.
verses.hindi: चराते-चराते वे अन्यायमें प्रवत्त हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: The semen is secreted from the food eaten From the semen, the birth of another body is made possible. When the semen unalloyed is deposited in the vaginal passage during the prescribed period of cohabitation after the monthly menses,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The semen is secreted from the food eaten From the semen, the birth of another body is made possible. When the semen unalloyed is deposited in the vaginal passage during the prescribed period of cohabitation after the monthly menses,…
verses.science: चराते-चराते वे अन्यायमें प्रवत्त हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशसाहस्रमेकैकं पातालं मुनिसत्तम । अतलं वितलं चैव सुतलं च रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: daśasāhasramekaikaṃ pātālaṃ munisattama | atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiva sutalaṃ ca rasātalam
verses.translation: In five nights the foetus assumes the shape cf bubbles and the bubbly mass becomes muscuiar mass in seven nights.
verses.hindi: बचानेमें भी वे दोनों समर्थ नहीं हो सके
verses.commentary: Sense: In five nights the foetus assumes the shape cf bubbles and the bubbly mass becomes muscuiar mass in seven nights.
verses.science: बचानेमें भी वे दोनों समर्थ नहीं हो सके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तलं तलातलं चाग्र्यं पातालं सप्तमं मतम् । भूमेरधः सप्तलोका इमे ज्ञेया विचक्षणैः
verses.transliteration: talaṃ talātalaṃ cāgryaṃ pātālaṃ saptamaṃ matam | bhūmeradhaḥ saptalokā ime jñeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Within two months the following parts oi the body are formulated in order Viz. the neck, the head the shoulders, the backbone, the belly, hands and feet, the sides the lips etc. Within three months all the joints are completed.
verses.hindi: प्रकुर्वन्तो हि श्राद्ध तु सर्व एवं समाहिता:॥ १७  करो
verses.commentary: Sense: Within two months the following parts oi the body are formulated in order Viz. the neck, the head the shoulders, the backbone, the belly, hands and feet, the sides the lips etc. Within three months all the joints are completed.
verses.science: प्रकुर्वन्तो हि श्राद्ध तु सर्व एवं समाहिता:॥ १७ करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्रायो द्विगुणश्चैषां सर्वेषां रत्नभूमयः । रत्नवन्तोऽथ प्रासादा भूमयो हेमसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: ucchrāyo dviguṇaścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ ratnabhūmayaḥ | ratnavanto'tha prāsādā bhūmayo hemasambhavāḥ
verses.translation: Within the fourth month the fingers are duly formed. The mouth, nose, and cars are ready within the fifth month.
verses.hindi: हमलोगोंको वधजन्य अधर्म भी नहीं होगा
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the fourth month the fingers are duly formed. The mouth, nose, and cars are ready within the fifth month.
verses.science: हमलोगोंको वधजन्य अधर्म भी नहीं होगा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषु दानवदैतेया नागानां जातयस्तथा । निवसन्ति महानागा राक्षसा दैत्यसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: teṣu dānavadaiteyā nāgānāṃ jātayastathā | nivasanti mahānāgā rākṣasā daityasambhavāḥ
verses.translation: Within six months the row of teeth, the private parts and the nails and the orifice of the cars take shape.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध किया और उसे उपयोगमें ले लिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Within six months the row of teeth, the private parts and the nails and the orifice of the cars take shape.
verses.science: श्राद्ध किया और उसे उपयोगमें ले लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राह स्वर्गसदोमध्ये पातालानीति नारदः । स्वर्लोकादति रम्याणि तेभ्योऽसावागतो दिवि
verses.transliteration: prāha svargasadomadhye pātālānīti nāradaḥ | svarlokādati ramyāṇi tebhyo'sāvāgato divi
verses.translation: The rectum, or the penis of the vaginal passage and the navel too arc formulated* Within the seventh
verses.commentary: Sense: The rectum, or the penis of the vaginal passage and the navel too arc formulated* Within the seventh
verses.science: बछड़ेको ग्रहण कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नानाभूषणभूषाश्च मणयो यत्र सुप्रभाः । आह्लादकारिणः शुभ्राः पातालं केन तत्समम्
verses.transliteration: nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣāśca maṇayo yatra suprabhāḥ | āhlādakāriṇaḥ śubhrāḥ pātālaṃ kena tatsamam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thus the complete child with all the limbs stays in the womb covered by the embryonic skin.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, thus the complete child with all the limbs stays in the womb covered by the embryonic skin.
verses.science: अपकर्म-से उन गोहत्यारोंको पाप लगा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाताले कस्य न प्रीतिरितश्चेतश्च शोभिते । देत्यदानवकन्याभिर्विमुक्तस्याभिजायते
verses.transliteration: pātāle kasya na prītiritaścetaśca śobhite | detyadānavakanyābhirvimuktasyābhijāyate
verses.translation: The child increases and develops day by day, stealthily taking in the food of the mother, of all the six tastes, through the umbilical cord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The child increases and develops day by day, stealthily taking in the food of the mother, of all the six tastes, through the umbilical cord.
verses.science: (मृत्यु)-को प्राप्त हुए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: दिवार्करश्मयो यत्र न भवन्ति विधोर्निशि । न शीतमातपो यत्र मणितेजोऽत्र केवलम्
verses.transliteration: divārkaraśmayo yatra na bhavanti vidhorniśi | na śītamātapo yatra maṇitejo'tra kevalam
verses.translation: Then the soul complete in this body recollects all the pleasures and sorrows and every thing done by it former¬ ly as if in a dream.
verses.hindi: मनस्वी तथा धर्मप्रवीण सात पुत्र हुए्
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the soul complete in this body recollects all the pleasures and sorrows and every thing done by it former¬ ly as if in a dream.
verses.science: मनस्वी तथा धर्मप्रवीण सात पुत्र हुए्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यान्नपानानि भुज्यन्ते मुदितैर्भृशम् । यत्र न ज्ञायते कालो गतोऽपि मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhojyānnapānāni bhujyante muditairbhṛśam | yatra na jñāyate kālo gato'pi munisattama
verses.translation: This time when I am born and consecrated I shall strive for welfare by means of this body so that I may not have to stay in another womb in future.
verses.hindi: तथा क्षमाशील हो वनमें विचरण करते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: This time when I am born and consecrated I shall strive for welfare by means of this body so that I may not have to stay in another womb in future.
verses.science: तथा क्षमाशील हो वनमें विचरण करते थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुंस्कोकिलरुतं यत्र पद्मानि कमलाकराः । नद्यः सरांसि रम्याणि मनोज्ञान्यम्बराणि च
verses.transliteration: puṃskokilarutaṃ yatra padmāni kamalākarāḥ | nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ramyāṇi manojñānyambarāṇi ca
verses.translation: So thinks the child in the womb "As soon as 1 am released from this womb I shall seek Siva's perfect knowledge that repels all worldly existence."
verses.hindi: होनेके लिये उसीको बुद्धिमें रखते थे
verses.commentary: Sense: So thinks the child in the womb "As soon as 1 am released from this womb I shall seek Siva's perfect knowledge that repels all worldly existence."
verses.science: होनेके लिये उसीको बुद्धिमें रखते थे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूषणान्यतिशुभ्राणि गन्धाढ्यं चानुलेपनम् । वीणावेणुमृदङ्गानां स्वना गेयानि च द्विज
verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇānyatiśubhrāṇi gandhāḍhyaṃ cānulepanam | vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgānāṃ svanā geyāni ca dvija
verses.translation: Troubled and tormented by the distress in the womb as a result of his past actions the individual soul stays there pondering over the means of liberation.
verses.hindi: तथा अशुभ दोनोंसे मुक्त हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Troubled and tormented by the distress in the womb as a result of his past actions the individual soul stays there pondering over the means of liberation.
verses.science: तथा अशुभ दोनोंसे मुक्त हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दैत्योरगैश्च भुज्यन्ते पाताले वै सुखानि च । तपसा समवाप्नोति दानवैः सिद्धमानवैः
verses.transliteration: daityoragaiśca bhujyante pātāle vai sukhāni ca | tapasā samavāpnoti dānavaiḥ siddhamānavaiḥ
verses.translation: Just as a traveller surrounded by huge impassable mountains on all sides stands helplessly in his distress, so also the creature in the womb enveloped by the embryonic skin stays miserably.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a traveller surrounded by huge impassable mountains on all sides stands helplessly in his distress, so also the creature in the womb enveloped by the embryonic skin stays miserably.
verses.science: ज्ञान तथा जातिको प्राप्त किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, O highly intelligent sage, listen to the impurity of the body and the greatness of good feelings. I shall explain briefly.
verses.hindi: तब उनमेंसे सुमना नामक पक्षी बोला--
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, O highly intelligent sage, listen to the impurity of the body and the greatness of good feelings. I shall explain briefly.
verses.science: तब उनमेंसे सुमना नामक पक्षी बोला--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, O highly intelligent sage, listen to the impurity of the body and the greatness of good feelings. I shall explain briefly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, O highly intelligent sage, listen to the impurity of the body and the greatness of good feelings. I shall explain briefly.
verses.science: पितरोंके निमित्त श्राद्ध किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । नरकोद्धारवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । तेषां मूर्धोपरिष्टाद्वै नरकांस्तान् श्रुणुष्व च । मत्तो मुनिवरश्रेष्ठ पच्यन्ते यत्र पापिनः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.16. ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | narakoddhāravarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | teṣāṃ mūrdhopariṣṭādvai narakāṃstān śruṇuṣva ca | matto munivaraśreṣṭha pacyante yatra pāpinaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a pot, full of faeces cannot become pure even when washed outside, so alsc the body washed outside cannot become pure. Hence it is impure.
verses.hindi: अब दूसरा क्‍या सुनना चाहते हैं 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a pot, full of faeces cannot become pure even when washed outside, so alsc the body washed outside cannot become pure. Hence it is impure.
verses.science: अब दूसरा क्‍या सुनना चाहते हैं 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रौरवः शूकरो रोधस्तालो विवसनस्तथा । महाज्वालस्तप्तकुम्भो लवणोऽपि विलोहितः
verses.transliteration: rauravaḥ śūkaro rodhastālo vivasanastathā | mahājvālastaptakumbho lavaṇo'pi vilohitaḥ
verses.translation: Neither heaven nor salvation can be attained by a man of vicious emotion even if he immolates himself in the holy fire. The only result will be that his body is entirely burnt off.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither heaven nor salvation can be attained by a man of vicious emotion even if he immolates himself in the holy fire. The only result will be that his body is entirely burnt off.
verses.science: आख्यानका भलीभाँति पाठ करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैतरणी पूयवहा कृमिशः कृमिभोजनः । असिपत्रवनं घोरं लालाभक्षश्च दारुणः
verses.transliteration: vaitaraṇī pūyavahā kṛmiśaḥ kṛmibhojanaḥ | asipatravanaṃ ghoraṃ lālābhakṣaśca dāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Hundreds and thousands of mofiarchs who had been in bondage had attained the greatest world on reaching the Nirmamatva (not-my-ness) state.
verses.hindi: ही नावसे यमुनाके उस पार ले चलो
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundreds and thousands of mofiarchs who had been in bondage had attained the greatest world on reaching the Nirmamatva (not-my-ness) state.
verses.science: ही नावसे यमुनाके उस पार ले चलो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा पूयवहः प्रायो वन्हिज्वालो ह्यधःशिराः । सन्दंशः कालसूत्रश्च तमश्चावीचिरोधनः
verses.transliteration: tathā pūyavahaḥ prāyo vanhijvālo hyadhaḥśirāḥ | sandaṃśaḥ kālasūtraśca tamaścāvīcirodhanaḥ
verses.translation: The infant boy may remain somewhere very hungry and thirsty, or lying somewhere he may be crying or he may be eating or drinking faeces and the urine due to delusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The infant boy may remain somewhere very hungry and thirsty, or lying somewhere he may be crying or he may be eating or drinking faeces and the urine due to delusion.
verses.science: कारण वह बेदव्यास कहा गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्वभोजनोऽथ रुष्टश्च महारौरवशाल्मली । इत्याद्या बहवस्तत्र नरका दुःखदायकाः
verses.transliteration: śvabhojano'tha ruṣṭaśca mahārauravaśālmalī | ityādyā bahavastatra narakā duḥkhadāyakāḥ
verses.translation: Then, he feels misery from malice and rivalry.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, he feels misery from malice and rivalry.
verses.science: मध्यमेश्वर कहे जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रतस्य लोपका ये च स्वाश्रमाद्विच्युताश्च ये । सन्दंशयातनामध्ये पतन्ति भृशदारुणे
verses.transliteration: vratasya lopakā ye ca svāśramādvicyutāśca ye | sandaṃśayātanāmadhye patanti bhṛśadāruṇe
verses.translation: During nights he does not get proper sleep be¬ cause he is scorched by the fire of lust. Where is pleasure even during the day because he is worried over the ways and means of earning wealth?
verses.commentary: Sense: During nights he does not get proper sleep be¬ cause he is scorched by the fire of lust. Where is pleasure even during the day because he is worried over the ways and means of earning wealth?
verses.science: शिवका गाणपत्यपद प्राप्त किया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पच्यन्ते तेषु पुरुषाः पापकर्मरतास्तु ये । क्रमाद्वक्ष्ये तु तान् व्यास सावधानतया शृणु
verses.transliteration: pacyante teṣu puruṣāḥ pāpakarmaratāstu ye | kramādvakṣye tu tān vyāsa sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu
verses.translation: The drops of semen of a man whose mind is dwelling on women do not bring him pleasure. They arc like his own sweat drops, mere dirt.
verses.hindi: मध्यमेश्वरकी कृपासे विद्याओंमें पारंगत हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The drops of semen of a man whose mind is dwelling on women do not bring him pleasure. They arc like his own sweat drops, mere dirt.
verses.science: मध्यमेश्वरकी कृपासे विद्याओंमें पारंगत हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कूटसाक्ष्यं तु यो वक्ति विना विप्रान् सुरांश्च गाः । सदानृतं वदेद्यस्तु स नरो याति रौरवम्
verses.transliteration: kūṭasākṣyaṃ tu yo vakti vinā viprān surāṃśca gāḥ | sadānṛtaṃ vadedyastu sa naro yāti rauravam
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by Paficacuda that there is not even a particle of pleasure in women who are the store¬ houses of all blemishes and who are creatures unsubstantial.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been mentioned by Paficacuda that there is not even a particle of pleasure in women who are the store¬ houses of all blemishes and who are creatures unsubstantial.
verses.science: पूजनका नियम ग्रहण किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूणहा स्वर्णहर्ता च गोरोधी विश्वघातकः । सुरापो ब्रह्महन्ता च परद्रव्यापहारकः
verses.transliteration: bhrūṇahā svarṇahartā ca gorodhī viśvaghātakaḥ | surāpo brahmahantā ca paradravyāpahārakaḥ
verses.translation: Due to honour and disrespect, due to union with and separation from the beloved people youth is soon devoured by old age. Where is pleasure without torment?
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to honour and disrespect, due to union with and separation from the beloved people youth is soon devoured by old age. Where is pleasure without torment?
verses.science: कर्ता, पालक और हर्ता हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्तत्सङ्गी स वै याति मृतो व्यास गुरोर्वधात् । तप्तकुम्भे स्वसुर्मातुर्गोश्चैव दुहितुस्तथा
verses.transliteration: yastatsaṅgī sa vai yāti mṛto vyāsa gurorvadhāt | taptakumbhe svasurmāturgoścaiva duhitustathā
verses.translation: The youth of women and men which had been mutually pleasurable formerly is not so now when it is over¬ whelmed by old age, when the body is rendered shattered and rickety by wrinkles, grey hairs and baldness and when the man is incompetent to perform any serious task.
verses.commentary: Sense: The youth of women and men which had been mutually pleasurable formerly is not so now when it is over¬ whelmed by old age, when the body is rendered shattered and rickety by wrinkles, grey hairs and baldness and when the man is incompetent to perform any serious task.
verses.science: लिप्त नहीं हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साध्व्या विक्रयकृच्चाथ वार्द्धकी केशविक्रयी । तप्तलोहेषु पच्यन्ते यश्च भक्तं परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: sādhvyā vikrayakṛccātha vārddhakī keśavikrayī | taptaloheṣu pacyante yaśca bhaktaṃ parityajet
verses.translation: Even after taking in the sanctifying Paficagavya, Havis (Ghee oblation) etc. the body becomes impure the next moment. What else is more impure than this body?
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after taking in the sanctifying Paficagavya, Havis (Ghee oblation) etc. the body becomes impure the next moment. What else is more impure than this body?
verses.science: नामैकचत्वारिशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अवमन्ता गुरूणां यः पश्चाद्भोक्ता नराधमः । देवदूषयिता चैव देवविक्रयिकश्च यः
verses.transliteration: avamantā gurūṇāṃ yaḥ paścādbhoktā narādhamaḥ | devadūṣayitā caiva devavikrayikaśca yaḥ
verses.translation: Even after taking in sweet, fragrant and delicious foodstuffs and drinks the body becomes impure quickly. What else is more impure than this.
verses.hindi: सप्तव्याधयतिवर्णन नामक इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after taking in sweet, fragrant and delicious foodstuffs and drinks the body becomes impure quickly. What else is more impure than this.
verses.science: सप्तव्याधयतिवर्णन नामक इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अगम्यगामी यश्चान्ते याति सप्तबलं द्विज । चौरो गोघ्नो हि पतितो मर्यादादूषकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: agamyagāmī yaścānte yāti saptabalaṃ dvija | cauro goghno hi patito maryādādūṣakastathā
verses.translation: O men, don*t you see dirty and foetal matter coming out of your bodies day by day. How can the recq;>tacle of such matter be pure.?
verses.hindi: कि जात॑ तु ततो बूहि कृपया मुनिसत्तम॥ १  हुआ, कृपया आप बताइये 2
verses.commentary: Sense: O men, don*t you see dirty and foetal matter coming out of your bodies day by day. How can the recq;>tacle of such matter be pure.?
verses.science: कि जात॑ तु ततो बूहि कृपया मुनिसत्तम॥ १ हुआ, कृपया आप बताइये 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजपितृद्वेष्टा रत्नदूषयिता च यः । स याति कृमिभक्षं वै कृमीनत्ति दुरिष्टिकृत्
verses.transliteration: devadvijapitṛdveṣṭā ratnadūṣayitā ca yaḥ | sa yāti kṛmibhakṣaṃ vai kṛmīnatti duriṣṭikṛt
verses.translation: Like the perennial flow' of the springs of a moun¬ tain the vessels of the body discharge phlegm, urine, faeces and other types of filth. How can that body become clean?
verses.hindi: वायुभक्षण करते हुए तप करने लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the perennial flow' of the springs of a moun¬ tain the vessels of the body discharge phlegm, urine, faeces and other types of filth. How can that body become clean?
verses.science: वायुभक्षण करते हुए तप करने लगा। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पितृदेवसुरान् यस्तु पर्यश्नाति नराधमः । लालाभक्षं स यात्यज्ञो यः शास्त्रकूटकृन्नरः
verses.transliteration: pitṛdevasurān yastu paryaśnāti narādhamaḥ | lālābhakṣaṃ sa yātyajño yaḥ śāstrakūṭakṛnnaraḥ
verses.translation: After touching the tips of the vessels of one's own body the hand is washed with sand and water. Still the persons who are slaves to this filthy body do not feel.
verses.hindi: प्रदायक वैज्राज नामसे विशेष प्रसिद्ध हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: After touching the tips of the vessels of one's own body the hand is washed with sand and water. Still the persons who are slaves to this filthy body do not feel.
verses.science: प्रदायक वैज्राज नामसे विशेष प्रसिद्ध हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चान्त्यजेन संसेव्यो ह्यसद्ग्राही तु यो द्विजः । अयाज्ययाजकश्चैव तथैवाभक्ष्यभक्षकः
verses.transliteration: yaścāntyajena saṃsevyo hyasadgrāhī tu yo dvijaḥ | ayājyayājakaścaiva tathaivābhakṣyabhakṣakaḥ
verses.translation: Inspite of being smeared and sanctified assiduously by sweet scents, incense and other things the body does not eschew its nature like the curved tail of a dog.
verses.commentary: Sense: Inspite of being smeared and sanctified assiduously by sweet scents, incense and other things the body does not eschew its nature like the curved tail of a dog.
verses.science: नामवाले सात निष्पाप महात्मा हुए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रुधिरौघे पतन्त्येते सोमविक्रयिणश्च ये । मधुहा ग्रामहा याति क्रूरां वैतरणीं नदीम्
verses.transliteration: rudhiraughe patantyete somavikrayiṇaśca ye | madhuhā grāmahā yāti krūrāṃ vaitaraṇīṃ nadīm
verses.translation: Just as an object, naturally black, cannot become white by any means, so also the physical body does not be¬ come clean though it is scrubbed and cleaned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as an object, naturally black, cannot become white by any means, so also the physical body does not be¬ come clean though it is scrubbed and cleaned.
verses.science: और अध्वर्यु हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नवयौवनमत्ताश्च मर्यादाभेदिनश्च ये । ते कृम्यं यान्त्यशौचाश्च कुलटाजीविनश्च ये
verses.transliteration: navayauvanamattāśca maryādābhedinaśca ye | te kṛmyaṃ yāntyaśaucāśca kulaṭājīvinaśca ye
verses.translation: Though he smells his own noxious odour, though he sees his own dirt, no man becomes detached and keeps his hand on his nose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though he smells his own noxious odour, though he sees his own dirt, no man becomes detached and keeps his hand on his nose.
verses.science: और सांसारिक दोषोंके ज्ञाता थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असिपत्रवनं याति वृक्षच्छेदी वृथैव यः । क्षुरभ्रका मृगव्याधा वह्निज्वाले पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: asipatravanaṃ yāti vṛkṣacchedī vṛthaiva yaḥ | kṣurabhrakā mṛgavyādhā vahnijvāle patanti te
verses.translation: In the midst of the entire universe, the body alone is the most unclean. By touching its filthy limbs even the pure becomes impure.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the midst of the entire universe, the body alone is the most unclean. By touching its filthy limbs even the pure becomes impure.
verses.science: आपका निर्वाह हो जायगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रष्टाचारो हि यो विप्रः क्षत्रियो वैश्य एव च । यात्यन्ते द्विज तत्रैव यः श्वपाकेषु वह्निदः
verses.transliteration: bhraṣṭācāro hi yo vipraḥ kṣatriyo vaiśya eva ca | yātyante dvija tatraiva yaḥ śvapākeṣu vahnidaḥ
verses.translation: But let him be cleaned with all the waters of the Ganga, with heaps of sand resembling a mountain or let him observe purificatory rites till death, if a man has wicked feelings and emotions he can never be purified.
verses.commentary: Sense: But let him be cleaned with all the waters of the Ganga, with heaps of sand resembling a mountain or let him observe purificatory rites till death, if a man has wicked feelings and emotions he can never be purified.
verses.science: श्लोकका अध्ययनकर कृतकृत्य हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीर्यं स्वप्नेषु स्कन्देयुर्ये नरा ब्रह्मचारिणः । पुत्रा नाध्यापिता यैश्च ते पतन्ति श्वभोजने
verses.transliteration: vīryaṃ svapneṣu skandeyurye narā brahmacāriṇaḥ | putrā nādhyāpitā yaiśca te patanti śvabhojane
verses.translation: We assert that a man of vicious instinct and feeling never becomes pure though he may indulge in ablu> lions throughout his life with all the waters of the Gahgfi and a mountain of sand.
verses.commentary: Sense: We assert that a man of vicious instinct and feeling never becomes pure though he may indulge in ablu> lions throughout his life with all the waters of the Gahgfi and a mountain of sand.
verses.science: विनष्ट हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च नरकाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः । येषु दुष्कृतकर्माणः पच्यन्ते यातनागताः
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca narakāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | yeṣu duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ pacyante yātanāgatāḥ
verses.translation: If a man of defiled emotion gets himself burnt after entering a huge blazing fire kindled by sprinkling ghee and oil and with flames of circular motion he does not become pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man of defiled emotion gets himself burnt after entering a huge blazing fire kindled by sprinkling ghee and oil and with flames of circular motion he does not become pure.
verses.science: नामक बयालीसबाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव पापान्येतानि तथान्यानि सहस्रशः । भुज्यन्ते यानि पुरुषैर्नरकान्तरगोचरैः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva pāpānyetāni tathānyāni sahasraśaḥ | bhujyante yāni puruṣairnarakāntaragocaraiḥ
verses.translation: Fishes stay in the holy Ganga and other sacred rivers. Flocks of birds stay in the temple. They do not attain any special benefit from the ceremonial ablutions and charitable gifts since they are devoid of holy feelings.
verses.hindi: सुननेके बाद क्या करना चाहिए, यह भी बताइये 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Fishes stay in the holy Ganga and other sacred rivers. Flocks of birds stay in the temple. They do not attain any special benefit from the ceremonial ablutions and charitable gifts since they are devoid of holy feelings.
verses.science: सुननेके बाद क्या करना चाहिए, यह भी बताइये 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धं च कर्म कुर्वन्ति ये नराः । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा निरये तु पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramaviruddhaṃ ca karma kurvanti ye narāḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācā niraye tu patanti te
verses.translation: Feelings are different in the mind even if the objects are not different. The same woman is looked at in one way by the son and in another way by the husband.
verses.hindi: और असनतापूर्वक उन्हें दक्षिणा देनी चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Feelings are different in the mind even if the objects are not different. The same woman is looked at in one way by the son and in another way by the husband.
verses.science: और असनतापूर्वक उन्हें दक्षिणा देनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधःशिरोभिर्दृश्यन्ते नारका दिवि दैवतैः । देवानधोमुखान् सर्वानधः पश्यन्ति नारकाः
verses.transliteration: adhaḥśirobhirdṛśyante nārakā divi daivataiḥ | devānadhomukhān sarvānadhaḥ paśyanti nārakāḥ
verses.translation: O observe the great fortune in the difference of emotions. The man, though embraced, does not love the woman who is devoid of the feelings of love.
verses.hindi: पुराणं निगमार्थाढ्यं पुण्यदं हृदयं श्रुतेः॥ ८  सुनना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O observe the great fortune in the difference of emotions. The man, though embraced, does not love the woman who is devoid of the feelings of love.
verses.science: पुराणं निगमार्थाढ्यं पुण्यदं हृदयं श्रुतेः॥ ८ सुनना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थावराः कृमयोऽब्जाश्च पक्षिणः पशवो नराः । धार्मिकास्त्रिदशास्तद्वन्मोक्षिणश्च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: sthāvarāḥ kṛmayo'bjāśca pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo narāḥ | dhārmikāstridaśāstadvanmokṣiṇaśca yathākramam
verses.translation: If the three emotions, passion etc. were to create worries in the mind no one would relish different delicious or fragrant stuffs.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिव्यहापुराणे पञ्चम्यागुमासंहितायां व्यासपजनप्रकारों नाम त्रिचत्वारिशो:ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: If the three emotions, passion etc. were to create worries in the mind no one would relish different delicious or fragrant stuffs.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिव्यहापुराणे पञ्चम्यागुमासंहितायां व्यासपजनप्रकारों नाम त्रिचत्वारिशो:ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यावन्तो जन्तवः स्वर्गे तावन्तो नरकौकसः । पापकृद्याति नरकं प्रायश्चित्तपराङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: yāvanto jantavaḥ svarge tāvanto narakaukasaḥ | pāpakṛdyāti narakaṃ prāyaścittaparāṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Performing Japas, sacrifices and eulogies after purifying the soul with pure emotions a man acquires perfect knowledge and after death he attains the worlds of persons who perform many sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing Japas, sacrifices and eulogies after purifying the soul with pure emotions a man acquires perfect knowledge and after death he attains the worlds of persons who perform many sacrifices.
verses.science: नामक तैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरूणि गुरुभिश्चैव लघूनि लघुभिस्तथा । प्रायश्चित्तानि कालेय मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: gurūṇi gurubhiścaiva laghūni laghubhistathā | prāyaścittāni kāleya manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt
verses.translation: The purification and removal of the sliminess and bad odour of the faeces and urine of ignorance and passion of men is effected by the pure water of knowledgeand the clay of detachment from the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purification and removal of the sliminess and bad odour of the faeces and urine of ignorance and passion of men is effected by the pure water of knowledgeand the clay of detachment from the world.
verses.science: कृतार्थ कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यानि तेषामशेषाणां कर्माण्युक्तानि तेषु वै । प्रायश्चित्तमशेषेण हरानुस्मरणं परम्
verses.transliteration: yāni teṣāmaśeṣāṇāṃ karmāṇyuktāni teṣu vai | prāyaścittamaśeṣeṇa harānusmaraṇaṃ param
verses.translation: An intelligent man shall understand that the body is defective and faulty. He shall be disinterested in such emotions as revolve round the pleasures of the body. With the mind in restraint and intellect delighted he sur¬ mounts the worldly existence and becomes a living liberated soul. He who firmly grasps the inner stump of the plantain tree of worldly existence is not liberated.
verses.hindi: सूत उवाच महान् सन्देह है, आप उसे दूर कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: An intelligent man shall understand that the body is defective and faulty. He shall be disinterested in such emotions as revolve round the pleasures of the body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: An intelligent man shall understand that the body is defective and faulty. He shall be disinterested in such emotions as revolve round the pleasures of the body.…
verses.science: सूत उवाच महान् सन्देह है, आप उसे दूर कीजिये। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं तु तस्यैकं यस्य पुंसः प्रजायते । कृते पापेऽनुतापोऽपि शिवसंस्मरणं परम्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ tu tasyaikaṃ yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate | kṛte pāpe'nutāpo'pi śivasaṃsmaraṇaṃ param
verses.translation: What little recollection the child had while within the womb perishes when his misery develops further on being crushed by the muscular walls of the vaginal passage as if within a machine.
verses.hindi: इस समय यमुना पार करना चाहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: What little recollection the child had while within the womb perishes when his misery develops further on being crushed by the muscular walls of the vaginal passage as if within a machine.
verses.science: इस समय यमुना पार करना चाहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरमवाप्नोति मध्याह्नादिषु संस्मरन् । प्रातर्निशि च सन्ध्यायां क्षीणपापो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: māheśvaramavāpnoti madhyāhnādiṣu saṃsmaran | prātarniśi ca sandhyāyāṃ kṣīṇapāpo bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: A great fever overtakes him as soon as the ex¬ ternal air touches him or delusion overwhelms him.
verses.hindi: आप ऐसा निन्दनीय कर्म क्‍यों कर रहे हैं 2
verses.commentary: Sense: A great fever overtakes him as soon as the ex¬ ternal air touches him or delusion overwhelms him.
verses.science: आप ऐसा निन्दनीय कर्म क्‍यों कर रहे हैं 2। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तिं प्रयाति स्वर्गं वा समस्तक्लेशसङ्क्षयम् । शिवस्य स्मरणादेव तस्य शम्भोरुमापतेः
verses.transliteration: muktiṃ prayāti svargaṃ vā samastakleśasaṅkṣayam | śivasya smaraṇādeva tasya śambhorumāpateḥ
verses.translation: Due to that fever a great fascination overpowers him and deludes him. After being deluded he soon suffers from the loss of memory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to that fever a great fascination overpowers him and deludes him. After being deluded he soon suffers from the loss of memory.
verses.science: दोनोंका संग कैसे सम्भव है?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पापन्तरायो विप्रेन्द्र जपहोमार्चनादि च । भवत्येव न कुत्रापि त्रैलोक्ये मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: pāpantarāyo viprendra japahomārcanādi ca | bhavatyeva na kutrāpi trailokye munisattama
verses.translation: Loss of memory leads to forgetfulness of all pre¬ vious activities. The creature soon begins to love the present birth.
verses.hindi: गये, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है।
verses.commentary: Sense: Loss of memory leads to forgetfulness of all pre¬ vious activities. The creature soon begins to love the present birth.
verses.science: गये, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरे मतिर्यस्य जपहोमार्चनादिषु । यत्पुण्यं तत्कृतं तेन देवेन्द्रत्वादिकं फलम्
verses.transliteration: maheśvare matiryasya japahomārcanādiṣu | yatpuṇyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ tena devendratvādikaṃ phalam
verses.translation: The passionate and deluded world does not engage in activides beneficial to itself. It does not realise itself nor others nor even the deity.
verses.hindi: चलती, तबतक आप धैर्य धारण कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: The passionate and deluded world does not engage in activides beneficial to itself. It does not realise itself nor others nor even the deity.
verses.science: चलती, तबतक आप धैर्य धारण कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुमान्न नरकं याति यः स्मरेद् भक्तितो मुने । अहर्निशं शिवं तस्मात् स क्षीणाशेषपातकः
verses.transliteration: pumānna narakaṃ yāti yaḥ smared bhaktito mune | aharniśaṃ śivaṃ tasmāt sa kṣīṇāśeṣapātakaḥ
verses.translation: O good sage, though he has ears man does not
verses.commentary: Sense: O good sage, though he has ears man does not
verses.science: तथा मनोरम कामिनी बना दिया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नरकस्वर्गसंज्ञे वै पापपुण्ये द्विजोत्तम । ययोस्त्वेकं तु दुःखायान्यत्सुखायोद्भवाय च
verses.transliteration: narakasvargasaṃjñe vai pāpapuṇye dvijottama | yayostvekaṃ tu duḥkhāyānyatsukhāyodbhavāya ca
verses.translation: Walking slowly on the level, even path he falters at every step. Even when he has intellect, even when he is enlightened by scholars he does not understand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Walking slowly on the level, even path he falters at every step. Even when he has intellect, even when he is enlightened by scholars he does not understand.
verses.science: तुम्हारी वन्दना करेंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदेव प्रीतये भूत्वा पुनर्दुःखाय जायते । तत्स्माद्दुःखात्मकं नास्ति न च किञ्चित्सुखात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tadeva prītaye bhūtvā punarduḥkhāya jāyate | tatsmādduḥkhātmakaṃ nāsti na ca kiñcitsukhātmakam
verses.translation: Thereby, urged and prompted by great greed he suffers pain and distress in the world. His intellect no longer remembers the sins he committed which he remembered in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby, urged and prompted by great greed he suffers pain and distress in the world. His intellect no longer remembers the sins he committed which he remembered in the womb.
verses.science: सुन्दर पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनसः परिणामोऽयं सुखदुःखोपलक्षणः । ज्ञानमेव परं ब्रह्म ज्ञानं तत्त्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: manasaḥ pariṇāmo'yaṃ sukhaduḥkhopalakṣaṇaḥ | jñānameva paraṃ brahma jñānaṃ tattvāya kalpate
verses.translation: This great divine Sastra has been narrated by Siva in the context of penance as a means to achieving heaven and salvation,
verses.commentary: Sense: This great divine Sastra has been narrated by Siva in the context of penance as a means to achieving heaven and salvation,
verses.science: तेजोराशिवाला था। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानात्मकमिदं विश्वं सकलं सचराचरम् । परविज्ञानतः किञ्चित् विद्यते न परं मुने
verses.transliteration: jñānātmakamidaṃ viśvaṃ sakalaṃ sacarācaram | paravijñānataḥ kiñcit vidyate na paraṃ mune
verses.translation: Even when the perfect knowledge of Siva that leads to the achievement of desire is available, it is really a great surprise if people do not strive for its attainment in their own interest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when the perfect knowledge of Siva that leads to the achievement of desire is available, it is really a great surprise if people do not strive for its attainment in their own interest.
verses.science: तीर्थमें चला गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतन्मयाख्यातं सर्वं नरकमण्डलम् । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतं मण्डलं भुवः
verses.transliteration: evametanmayākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ narakamaṇḍalam | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāmprataṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ
verses.translation: During childhood when the rite of earboring is performed or when the parents beat him or when he feels difficulty in learning the alphabet it is surprising that the stupid fellow does not strive for his welfare, even after seeing and somehow surmounting the miseries of boyhood.
verses.hindi: यत्रास्ते परम लिंग॑ मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकम्॥ ७७  मध्यमेश्वर नामक श्रेष्ठ लिंग है
verses.commentary: Sense: During childhood when the rite of earboring is performed or when the parents beat him or when he feels difficulty in learning the alphabet it is surprising that the stupid fellow does not strive for his welfare, even after seeing and somehow surmounting the miseries of boyhood.
verses.science: यत्रास्ते परम लिंग॑ मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकम्॥ ७७ मध्यमेश्वर नामक श्रेष्ठ लिंग है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, if you are pleased with me you shall nar« rate succinctly what was mentioned by Paficacuda viz., that women are despicable.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, if you are pleased with me you shall nar« rate succinctly what was mentioned by Paficacuda viz., that women are despicable.
verses.science: ऋमनाओंको पूर्ण करते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, if you are pleased with me you shall nar« rate succinctly what was mentioned by Paficacuda viz., that women are despicable.
verses.hindi: आपको मैं हृदयमें धारण करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, if you are pleased with me you shall nar« rate succinctly what was mentioned by Paficacuda viz., that women are despicable.
verses.science: आपको मैं हृदयमें धारण करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । जम्बूद्वीपवर्षवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । पाराशर्य सुसङ्क्षेपाच्छृणु त्वं वदतो मम । मण्डलं च भुवः सम्यक् सप्तद्वीपादिसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.17. saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | jambūdvīpavarṣavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | pārāśarya susaṅkṣepācchṛṇu tvaṃ vadato mama | maṇḍalaṃ ca bhuvaḥ samyak saptadvīpādisaṃyutam
verses.translation: I shall explain the nature of women as it is. O dear, listen to it, merely by hearing which excellent detach* ment results.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain the nature of women as it is. O dear, listen to it, merely by hearing which excellent detach* ment results.
verses.science: +रमात्मा उन महेश्वरको नमस्कार करता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूः प्लक्षः शाल्मलिश्च कुशः क्रौञ्चश्च शाककः । पुष्करः सप्तमः सर्वे समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: jambūḥ plakṣaḥ śālmaliśca kuśaḥ krauñcaśca śākakaḥ | puṣkaraḥ saptamaḥ sarve samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: It may be wrong to make a false statement. There is no defect in speaking the truth. Know this, O lady of good waist and speak the truth.
verses.hindi: तस्माद् ब्राह्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं प्रथम मुने॥ १२५ पुराणको इसीलिये ब्रह्मपुरण कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: It may be wrong to make a false statement. There is no defect in speaking the truth. Know this, O lady of good waist and speak the truth.
verses.science: तस्माद् ब्राह्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं प्रथम मुने॥ १२५ पुराणको इसीलिये ब्रह्मपुरण कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लवणेक्षुरसौ सर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलाशयाः । जम्बुद्वीपः समस्तानामेतेषां मध्यतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: lavaṇekṣurasau sarpirdadhidugdhajalāśayāḥ | jambudvīpaḥ samastānāmeteṣāṃ madhyataḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Because they indulge in sexual intercourse as they please they are fickleminded, of evil deeds and emotionally incomprehensible even to an intelligent man.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because they indulge in sexual intercourse as they please they are fickleminded, of evil deeds and emotionally incomprehensible even to an intelligent man.
verses.science: नामक चोवालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापि मेरुः कालेय मध्ये कनकपर्वतः । प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्ताद्योजनैस्तस्य चोच्छ्रयः
verses.transliteration: tasyāpi meruḥ kāleya madhye kanakaparvataḥ | praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastādyojanaistasya cocchrayaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, thanks to your grace, everything has been understood by me and pondered over, such as your due worship, O lord, and the mantra befitting the same.
verses.hindi: तुम मूर्ख प्राणीके समान प्रीति क्यों करते हो ?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, thanks to your grace, everything has been understood by me and pondered over, such as your due worship, O lord, and the mantra befitting the same.
verses.science: तुम मूर्ख प्राणीके समान प्रीति क्यों करते हो ?। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुरशीतिमानैस्तैर्द्वात्रिंशन्मूर्ध्नि विस्तृतः । भूमिपृष्ठस्थशैलोऽयं विस्तरस्तस्य सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: caturaśītimānaistairdvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ | bhūmipṛṣṭhasthaśailo'yaṃ vistarastasya sarvataḥ
verses.translation: here 's par?ly*s'5 he face, ears, eye* or
verses.commentary: Sense: here 's par?ly*s'5 he face, ears, eye* or
verses.science: और कहने लगे--'/तुम कौन हो ?'। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मूले षोडशसाहस्त्र कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः । हिमवान् हेमकूटश्च निषधश्चास्य दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: mūle ṣoḍaśasāhastra karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ | himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: O gentle lady, if a man does not hear the sound accompanying a shrill cry, immediately, death within six months shall be declared by those who understand Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, if a man does not hear the sound accompanying a shrill cry, immediately, death within six months shall be declared by those who understand Kala.
verses.science: परमेश्वरीकी स्तुति करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नीलः श्वेतश्च शृङ्गी च उत्तरे वर्षपर्वताः । दशसाहस्रिका ह्येते रत्नवन्तोऽरुणप्रभाः
verses.transliteration: nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgī ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ | daśasāhasrikā hyete ratnavanto'ruṇaprabhāḥ
verses.translation: When in contact with the light of the sun, moon or fire if a man does not see the brilliant lustre, if he sees everything black he will remain alive only for six months more.
verses.commentary: Sense: When in contact with the light of the sun, moon or fire if a man does not see the brilliant lustre, if he sees everything black he will remain alive only for six months more.
verses.science: कीजिये, रक्षा कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रयोजनोत्सेधास्तावद्विस्तारिणश्च ते । भारतं प्रथमं वर्षं ततः किम्पुरुषं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrayojanotsedhāstāvadvistāriṇaśca te | bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kimpuruṣaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: O beloved, O goddess, if the left hand throbs for seven days, there is no doubt that he will live only for a month more.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, O goddess, if the left hand throbs for seven days, there is no doubt that he will live only for a month more.
verses.science: देवीको प्रणाम करता हूँ। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिवर्षं ततोऽन्यद्वै मेरोर्दक्षिणतो मुने । रम्यकं चोत्तरे पार्श्वे तस्यांशे तु हिरण्मयम्
verses.transliteration: harivarṣaṃ tato'nyadvai merordakṣiṇato mune | ramyakaṃ cottare pārśve tasyāṃśe tu hiraṇmayam
verses.translation: If the limbs unfold and expand, if the palate dries up, there is no doubt that he will live only for a month more.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the limbs unfold and expand, if the palate dries up, there is no doubt that he will live only for a month more.
verses.science: प्राप्त होनेपर संहार करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे कुरवश्चैव यथा वै भारतं तथा । नवसाहस्रमेकैकमेतेषां मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: uttare kuravaścaiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā | navasāhasramekaikameteṣāṃ munisattama
verses.translation: O sage, women are light-minded. They are at the root of all troubles. Attachment towards them should not be pursued by wakeful persons who desire liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, women are light-minded. They are at the root of all troubles. Attachment towards them should not be pursued by wakeful persons who desire liberation.
verses.science: क्योंकि मैं भक्तोंके अधीन हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इलावृतं तु तन्मध्ये तन्मध्ये मेरुरुच्छ्रितः । मेरोश्चतुर्दिशं तत्र नवसाहस्रमुच्छ्रितम्
verses.transliteration: ilāvṛtaṃ tu tanmadhye tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ | meroścaturdiśaṃ tatra navasāhasramucchritam
verses.translation: In this respect they quote an ancient tradition, the conversation of NSrada with the unchaste woman Paficacud*
verses.hindi: मुझे क्‍यों नियुक्त कर रहे हैं ?
verses.commentary: Sense: In this respect they quote an ancient tradition, the conversation of NSrada with the unchaste woman Paficacud*
verses.science: मुझे क्‍यों नियुक्त कर रहे हैं ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इलावृतमृषिश्रेष्ठ चत्वारश्चात्र पर्वताः । विष्कम्भा रचिता मेरोर्योजिताः पुनरुच्छ्रिताः
verses.transliteration: ilāvṛtamṛṣiśreṣṭha catvāraścātra parvatāḥ | viṣkambhā racitā meroryojitāḥ punarucchritāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, while the intelligent celestial sage Nkrada was Meandering in the worlds he saw the beautiful celestial damsel Paficacud.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, while the intelligent celestial sage Nkrada was Meandering in the worlds he saw the beautiful celestial damsel Paficacud.
verses.science: मन्द मुसकराकर कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे हि मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः । विपुलः पश्चिमे भागे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: pūrve hi mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ | vipulaḥ paścime bhāge supārśvaścottare sthitaḥ
verses.translation: The excellent sage Narada asked the beautiful woman, the Apsaras—"O lady of beautiful waist, I have a certain doubt. Please explain it to me."
verses.hindi: रूपसे शीघ्र ही पूर्ण होगी, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent sage Narada asked the beautiful woman, the Apsaras—"O lady of beautiful waist, I have a certain doubt. Please explain it to me."
verses.science: रूपसे शीघ्र ही पूर्ण होगी, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदम्बो जम्बुवृक्षश्च पिप्पलो वट एव च । एकादशशतायामाः पादपा गिरिकेतवः
verses.transliteration: kadambo jambuvṛkṣaśca pippalo vaṭa eva ca | ekādaśaśatāyāmāḥ pādapā giriketavaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin, thus addressed the excellent celestial damsel replied—'*lf you consider me competent and if there is a proper subject, I shall explain."
verses.hindi: पाठ करनेसे सारी मनोकामनाएँ पूर्ण होंगी
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, thus addressed the excellent celestial damsel replied—'*lf you consider me competent and if there is a proper subject, I shall explain."
verses.science: पाठ करनेसे सारी मनोकामनाएँ पूर्ण होंगी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपस्य नाम्नो वै हेतुं शृणु महामुने । विराजन्ते महावृक्षास्तत्स्वभावं वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: jambūdvīpasya nāmno vai hetuṃ śṛṇu mahāmune | virājante mahāvṛkṣāstatsvabhāvaṃ vadāmi te
verses.translation: O gentle lady, I shall never engage you in a sub¬ ject beyond your scope. O lady of slender waist, I wish m hear from you the nature of women.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, I shall never engage you in a sub¬ ject beyond your scope. O lady of slender waist, I wish m hear from you the nature of women.
verses.science: मोक्षकों देनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महागजप्रमाणानि जम्ब्वास्तस्याः फलानि च । पतन्ति भूभृतः पृष्ठे शीर्यमाणानि सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: mahāgajapramāṇāni jambvāstasyāḥ phalāni ca | patanti bhūbhṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe śīryamāṇāni sarvataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of that celestial sage the excellent Apsaras replied to that lord of sages, Narada the excellent sage.
verses.hindi: वर्ष जप्तमिद स्तोत्र बुद्धिं विद्यां च वर्धयेत्॥ १९ उसकी विद्या एवं बुद्धिमें वृद्धि होगी
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of that celestial sage the excellent Apsaras replied to that lord of sages, Narada the excellent sage.
verses.science: वर्ष जप्तमिद स्तोत्र बुद्धिं विद्यां च वर्धयेत्॥ १९ उसकी विद्या एवं बुद्धिमें वृद्धि होगी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रसेन तेषां विख्याता तत्र जम्बूनदीति वै । परितो वर्तते तत्र पीयते तन्निवासिभिः
verses.transliteration: rasena teṣāṃ vikhyātā tatra jambūnadīti vai | parito vartate tatra pīyate tannivāsibhiḥ
verses.translation: "O sage listen, being a woman I cannot censure women. You already know what women are and what their nature is.
verses.hindi: 5 -प- “ यश । करते हुए शिवप्रेममें निमग्न हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sage listen, being a woman I cannot censure women. You already know what women are and what their nature is.
verses.science: 5 -प- “ यश। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न स्वेदो न च दौर्गन्ध्यं न जरा चेन्द्रियग्रहः । तस्यास्तटे स्थितानां तु जनानां तन्न जायते
verses.transliteration: na svedo na ca daurgandhyaṃ na jarā cendriyagrahaḥ | tasyāstaṭe sthitānāṃ tu janānāṃ tanna jāyate
verses.translation: O celestial sage, it does not behove you to urge me in such a question.'* After saying this the excellent Apsaras Paficacu<a kept quiet.
verses.hindi: कुरु निर्वचन॑ तेषामिदानीं वेदवित्तम॥ १२३  निर्वचन कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, it does not behove you to urge me in such a question.'* After saying this the excellent Apsaras Paficacu<a kept quiet.
verses.science: कुरु निर्वचन॑ तेषामिदानीं वेदवित्तम॥ १२३ निर्वचन कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तीरमृत्स्नां च सम्प्राप्य सुखवायुविशोषिताम् । जाम्बूनदाख्यं भवति सुवर्णं सिद्धभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tīramṛtsnāṃ ca samprāpya sukhavāyuviśoṣitām | jāmbūnadākhyaṃ bhavati suvarṇaṃ siddhabhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: On hearing her excellent statement the most excel¬ lent of the celestial sages replied to her with a desire for the benefit of the worlds.
verses.hindi: नन्दिकेश्वरमुद्दिश्य स यदाह ब्रवीमि ततू॥ १२४  दिया था, उसीको मैं कह रहा हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her excellent statement the most excel¬ lent of the celestial sages replied to her with a desire for the benefit of the worlds.
verses.science: नन्दिकेश्वरमुद्दिश्य स यदाह ब्रवीमि ततू॥ १२४ दिया था, उसीको मैं कह रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भद्राश्वं पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालं च पश्चिमे । वर्षे द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठ तयोर्मध्य इलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhadrāśvaṃ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālaṃ ca paścime | varṣe dve tu muniśreṣṭha tayormadhya ilāvṛtam
verses.translation: Thus prompted, the sweet-smiling lady, resolved and immediately began to explain truthfully the permanent defects of women.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्पादं समाख्यातं पुराणं च द्वितीयकम्॥ १२६ दूसरा पद्मपुराण कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus prompted, the sweet-smiling lady, resolved and immediately began to explain truthfully the permanent defects of women.
verses.science: तस्मात्पादं समाख्यातं पुराणं च द्वितीयकम्॥ १२६ दूसरा पद्मपुराण कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वनं चैत्ररथं पूर्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः । विभ्राजं पश्चिमे तद्वदुत्तरे नन्दनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ | vibhrājaṃ paścime tadvaduttare nandanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: They might have husbands of good knowledge, of ample wealth, of great comeliness and pleasing to them. But when they get opportunities for erring, they do not wait.
verses.commentary: Sense: They might have husbands of good knowledge, of ample wealth, of great comeliness and pleasing to them. But when they get opportunities for erring, they do not wait.
verses.science: भी माना जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अरुणोदं महाभद्रं शीतोदं मानसं स्मृतम् । सरांस्येतानि चत्वारि देवभोग्यानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: aruṇodaṃ mahābhadraṃ śītodaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtam | sarāṃsyetāni catvāri devabhogyāni sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Women love only those persons who solicit their company, who approach them intimately aud who render them a little bit of service.**
verses.hindi: शैवमेतत्पुराणं हि पुराणज्ञा वदन्ति च॥ १२८  न्षरित्र है, उसे पुराणज्ञ शिवपुराण कहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Women love only those persons who solicit their company, who approach them intimately aud who render them a little bit of service.**
verses.science: शैवमेतत्पुराणं हि पुराणज्ञा वदन्ति च॥ १२८ न्षरित्र है, उसे पुराणज्ञ शिवपुराण कहते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शीताञ्जनः कुरुङ्गश्च कुररो माल्यवांस्तथा । एकैकप्रमुखा मेरोः पूर्वतः केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: śītāñjanaḥ kuruṅgaśca kuraro mālyavāṃstathā | ekaikapramukhā meroḥ pūrvataḥ kesarācalāḥ
verses.translation: Paj&ca. Mitrabheda 143.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paj&ca. Mitrabheda 143.
verses.science: लिंगपुराण कहा जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकूटः शिशिरश्चैव पतङ्गो रुचकस्तथा । निषधः कपिलाद्याश्च दक्षिणे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: trikūṭaḥ śiśiraścaiva pataṅgo rucakastathā | niṣadhaḥ kapilādyāśca dakṣiṇe kesarācalāḥ
verses.translation: Women usually do not observe the limitations of conventional decency. If at all they stand by them with their husbands it is because no man makes advances to them or because they are afraid of their husbands.*®*
verses.commentary: Sense: Women usually do not observe the limitations of conventional decency. If at all they stand by them with their husbands it is because no man makes advances to them or because they are afraid of their husbands.*®*
verses.science: मत्स्यपुराण है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सिनीवासः कुसुम्भश्च कपिलो नारदस्तथा । नागादयश्च गिरयः पश्चिमे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: sinīvāsaḥ kusumbhaśca kapilo nāradastathā | nāgādayaśca girayaḥ paścime kesarācalāḥ
verses.translation: Even women of noble families aspire for the life of lascivious women who in their prime of youth adorned with lovable ornaments and beautiful wearing garments move about frivolously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even women of noble families aspire for the life of lascivious women who in their prime of youth adorned with lovable ornaments and beautiful wearing garments move about frivolously.
verses.science: अठारहवाँ ब्रह्माण्डपुराण कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचूडोऽथ ऋषभो हंसो नाम महीधरः । कालञ्जराद्याश्च तथा उत्तरे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacūḍo'tha ṛṣabho haṃso nāma mahīdharaḥ | kālañjarādyāśca tathā uttare kesarācalāḥ
verses.translation: Even the women who are honoured well, loved intimately and looked after with care become attached to hunchbacks, blind men, imbeciles and dwarfs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the women who are honoured well, loved intimately and looked after with care become attached to hunchbacks, blind men, imbeciles and dwarfs.
verses.science: पुराणोंका निर्वचन सुना। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मेरोरुपरि मध्ये हि शातकौम्भं विधेः पुरम् । चतुर्दशसहस्राणि योजनानि च सङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: merorupari madhye hi śātakaumbhaṃ vidheḥ puram | caturdaśasahasrāṇi yojanāni ca saṅkhyayā
verses.translation: O celestial sage, they become attached to lame and even despicable persons. O great sage, there is none in the world who cannot be approached by women with solici¬ tations of lust.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, they become attached to lame and even despicable persons. O great sage, there is none in the world who cannot be approached by women with solici¬ tations of lust.
verses.science: इसमें सन्देह मत कीजिये। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टानां लोकपालानां परितस्तदनुक्रमात् । यथादिशं यथारूपं पुरोऽष्टावुपकल्पिताः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ paritastadanukramāt | yathādiśaṃ yathārūpaṃ puro'ṣṭāvupakalpitāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin, if women do not get men for their dalliance they begin to indulge in abnormal sexual activity with one another. They do not stand by their husbands.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, if women do not get men for their dalliance they begin to indulge in abnormal sexual activity with one another. They do not stand by their husbands.
verses.science: ऋषिलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां च ब्रह्मणः पुर्यां प्लावयित्वेन्दुमण्डलम् । विष्णुपादविनिष्क्रान्ता गङ्गा पतति वै नदी
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ puryāṃ plāvayitvendumaṇḍalam | viṣṇupādaviniṣkrāntā gaṅgā patati vai nadī
verses.translation: Women become desperate when they do not get men, when they are afraid of servants, when they arc frightened of being killed or imprisoned.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां व्यासोत्यत्तिवर्णन॑ नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Women become desperate when they do not get men, when they are afraid of servants, when they arc frightened of being killed or imprisoned.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां व्यासोत्यत्तिवर्णन॑ नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सीता चालकनन्दा च चक्षुर्भद्रा च वै क्रमात् । सा तत्र पतिता दिक्षु चतुर्धा प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sītā cālakanandā ca cakṣurbhadrā ca vai kramāt | sā tatra patitā dikṣu caturdhā pratyapadyata
verses.translation: Gp. Ibid. Mitrabhrda 144.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gp. Ibid. Mitrabhrda 144.
verses.science: महान् चरित्र पूछते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सीता पूर्वेण शैलं हि नन्दा चैव तु दक्षिणे । सा चक्षुः पश्चिमे चैव भद्रा चोत्तरतो व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: sītā pūrveṇa śailaṃ hi nandā caiva tu dakṣiṇe | sā cakṣuḥ paścime caiva bhadrā cottarato vrajet
verses.translation: Gp. Ibid. Mitrabheda 138.
verses.hindi: भाग्यहीन ही रहते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Gp. Ibid. Mitrabheda 138.
verses.science: भाग्यहीन ही रहते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गिरीनतीत्य सकलांश्चतुर्दिक्षु महाम्बुधिम् । सा ययौ प्रयता भूता गङ्गा त्रिपथगामिनी
verses.transliteration: girīnatītya sakalāṃścaturdikṣu mahāmbudhim | sā yayau prayatā bhūtā gaṅgā tripathagāminī
verses.translation: On seeing a man fresh and clean from his bath with his body perfumed with sweet scents, the vaginal passage of women begins to exude like water dripping from a leather bag.
verses.hindi: , उसीक़ो मैं आपसे कह रहा हूँ, सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing a man fresh and clean from his bath with his body perfumed with sweet scents, the vaginal passage of women begins to exude like water dripping from a leather bag.
verses.science: , उसीक़ो मैं आपसे कह रहा हूँ, सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुनीलनिषधौ यौ तौ माल्यवद्गन्धमादनौ । तेषां मध्यगतो मेरुः कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: sunīlaniṣadhau yau tau mālyavadgandhamādanau | teṣāṃ madhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Women do not brook their husbands who may give all that they love, who may honour and console them and who may look after them well.
verses.hindi: घोड़ेपर चढ़कर घने वनमें चला गया
verses.commentary: Sense: Women do not brook their husbands who may give all that they love, who may honour and console them and who may look after them well.
verses.science: घोड़ेपर चढ़कर घने वनमें चला गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भारतः केतुमालश्च भद्राश्वः कुरवस्तथा । पत्राणि लोकपद्मस्य मर्यादालोकपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: bhārataḥ ketumālaśca bhadrāśvaḥ kuravastathā | patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādālokaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: Women do not remain satisfied and contented so much with simple loves and pleasures and with ornaments and money as with illicit love pursued by them with other men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women do not remain satisfied and contented so much with simple loves and pleasures and with ornaments and money as with illicit love pursued by them with other men.
verses.science: पीड़ा नहीं पहुँचाते थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जठरं देवकूटश्च आयामे दक्षिणोत्तरे । गन्धमादनकैलासौ पूर्वपश्चिमतो गतौ
verses.transliteration: jaṭharaṃ devakūṭaśca āyāme dakṣiṇottare | gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvapaścimato gatau
verses.translation: Women can be kept equally balanced against all these put together viz., god of death, Yama, Antaka, Patala, the submarine fire, the sharp edge of razor, poison, serpent and fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women can be kept equally balanced against all these put together viz., god of death, Yama, Antaka, Patala, the submarine fire, the sharp edge of razor, poison, serpent and fire.
verses.science: होकर निवास करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वपश्चिमतो मेरोर्निषधो नीलपर्वतः । दक्षिणोत्तरमायातौ कर्णिकान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: pūrvapaścimato merorniṣadho nīlaparvataḥ | dakṣiṇottaramāyātau karṇikāntarvyavasthitau
verses.translation: Ever since the five elements, the world, the men and women were created by Brahma, O Narada, the defect lies in women always.
verses.hindi: उपभोग इस समय शत्रु कर रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since the five elements, the world, the men and women were created by Brahma, O Narada, the defect lies in women always.
verses.science: उपभोग इस समय शत्रु कर रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जठराद्याः स्थिता मेरोर्येषां द्वौ द्वौ व्यवस्थितौ । केसराः पर्वता एते श्वेताद्याः सुमनोरमाः
verses.transliteration: jaṭharādyāḥ sthitā meroryeṣāṃ dvau dvau vyavasthitau | kesarāḥ parvatā ete śvetādyāḥ sumanoramāḥ
verses.translation: O Vyasa, thus the nature of women as mentioned by PafLcacuda has been narrated to you. What other cause of detachment do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, thus the nature of women as mentioned by PafLcacuda has been narrated to you. What other cause of detachment do you wish to hear?
verses.science: प्रकार अपना राज्य प्राप्त करूँ ?2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शैलानामन्तरे द्रोण्यः सिद्धचारणसेविताः । सुरम्याणि तथा तासु काननानि पुराणि च
verses.transliteration: śailānāmantare droṇyaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ | suramyāṇi tathā tāsu kānanāni purāṇi ca
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumira, O sage, the nature of women has been heard by me from you. Please narrate the knowledge of Kala with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumira, O sage, the nature of women has been heard by me from you. Please narrate the knowledge of Kala with pleasure.
verses.science: राजासे कहने लगा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां चैव देवानां यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् । क्रीडन्ति देवदैतेयाः शैलप्रायेष्वहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ yakṣagandharvarakṣasām | krīḍanti devadaiteyāḥ śailaprāyeṣvaharniśam
verses.translation: Formerly, this very same thing Parvati asked lord Siva after hearing various divine stories and delightedly bowing to him.
verses.hindi: धनलोभके कारण मेरा त्याग कर दिया है
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, this very same thing Parvati asked lord Siva after hearing various divine stories and delightedly bowing to him.
verses.science: धनलोभके कारण मेरा त्याग कर दिया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मिणामालया ह्येते भौमाः स्वर्गाः प्रकीर्तिताः । न तेषु पापकर्तारो यान्ति पश्यन्ति कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: dharmiṇāmālayā hyete bhaumāḥ svargāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | na teṣu pāpakartāro yānti paśyanti kutracit
verses.translation: But still, O lord, a doubt regarding the wheel of time lingers in my mind. What are the signs of death? What is the extent of life?
verses.hindi: कारण मेरा मन अत्यन्त मोहग्रस्त हो रहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: But still, O lord, a doubt regarding the wheel of time lingers in my mind. What are the signs of death? What is the extent of life?
verses.science: कारण मेरा मन अत्यन्त मोहग्रस्त हो रहा है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यानि किम्पुरुषादीनि वर्षाण्यष्टौ महामुने । न तेषु शोको नापत्त्यो नोद्वेगः क्षुद्भयादिकम्
verses.transliteration: yāni kimpuruṣādīni varṣāṇyaṣṭau mahāmune | na teṣu śoko nāpattyo nodvegaḥ kṣudbhayādikam
verses.translation: O lord, please tell me everything if I am your
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, please tell me everything if I am your
verses.science: मोहमें डाल देती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थाः प्रजा निरातङ्काः सर्वदुःखविवर्जिताः । दशद्वादशवर्षाणां सहस्राणि स्थिरायुषः
verses.transliteration: svasthāḥ prajā nirātaṅkāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ | daśadvādaśavarṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi sthirāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: O beloved, I shall tell you the truth, the astra that is the most excellent of all, by which, O goddess, men can understand their time of death.
verses.hindi: फिर मनुष्योंकी तो बात ही क्‍या ?2
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, I shall tell you the truth, the astra that is the most excellent of all, by which, O goddess, men can understand their time of death.
verses.science: फिर मनुष्योंकी तो बात ही क्‍या ?2। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतत्रेतादिकाश्चैव भौमान्यम्भांसि सर्वतः । न तेषु वर्षते देवस्तेषु स्थानेषु कल्पना
verses.transliteration: kṛtatretādikāścaiva bhaumānyambhāṃsi sarvataḥ | na teṣu varṣate devasteṣu sthāneṣu kalpanā
verses.translation: The day, the fortnight, the month, the season, the transit of the sun and the year can be known by mear.; of the subtle or gross, external or internal signs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The day, the fortnight, the month, the season, the transit of the sun and the year can be known by mear.; of the subtle or gross, external or internal signs.
verses.science: करता है, दूसरा कोई नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तस्वेतेषु नद्यश्च सुजाताः स्वर्णवालुकाः । शतशः सन्ति क्षुद्राश्च तासु क्रीडेच्छुभो जनः
verses.transliteration: saptasveteṣu nadyaśca sujātāḥ svarṇavālukāḥ | śataśaḥ santi kṣudrāśca tāsu krīḍecchubho janaḥ
verses.translation: O Uma, O beautiful lady, I shai! tell that to you factually now, for the weFerecf the people a'-d h-'inglng about their detachment from the world.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न हुईं? है मुने! कृपाकर मुझसे कहिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O Uma, O beautiful lady, I shai! tell that to you factually now, for the weFerecf the people a'-d h-'inglng about their detachment from the world.
verses.science: उत्पन्न हुईं? है मुने! कृपाकर मुझसे कहिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O beautiful lady, if the tongue becomes thick and the teeth begin to exude, death takes place within six months. The same may be inferred through these signs.
verses.hindi: शान्ति, क्षान्ति, क्षुवा और दया हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady, if the tongue becomes thick and the teeth begin to exude, death takes place within six months. The same may be inferred through these signs.
verses.science: शान्ति, क्षान्ति, क्षुवा और दया हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O beautiful lady, if the tongue becomes thick and the teeth begin to exude, death takes place within six months. The same may be inferred through these signs.
