verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady, if the tongue becomes thick and the teeth begin to exude, death takes place within six months. The same may be inferred through these signs.
verses.science: लक्ष्मीरूपसे स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । सप्तद्वीपवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । वक्ष्येऽहं भारतं वर्षं हिमाद्रेश्चैव दक्षिणे । उत्तरे तु समुद्रस्य भारती यत्र संसृतिः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.18. aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | saptadvīpavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | vakṣye'haṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ himādreścaiva dakṣiṇe | uttare tu samudrasya bhāratī yatra saṃsṛtiḥ
verses.translation: If a man does not see himself reflected in water, oil, ghee or in the mirror or if he sees with dis¬ torted flesh or features he will live only for six months more. This shall be declared by the expert. O goddess, now listen to other signs whereby death can be inferred.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man does not see himself reflected in water, oil, ghee or in the mirror or if he sees with dis¬ torted flesh or features he will live only for six months more. This shall be declared by the expert. O goddess, now listen to other signs whereby death can be inferred.
verses.science: व्याप्त होकर स्थित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नवयोजनसाहस्रो विस्तारोऽस्य महामुने । स्वर्गापवर्गयोः कर्मभूमिरेषा स्मृता बुधैः
verses.transliteration: navayojanasāhasro vistāro'sya mahāmune | svargāpavargayoḥ karmabhūmireṣā smṛtā budhaiḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, one can see Kala within his two hands, the left and the right. It has been directly narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, one can see Kala within his two hands, the left and the right. It has been directly narrated.
verses.science: नामक पैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः सम्प्राप्यते पुम्भिः स्वर्गो नरक एव च । भारतस्यापि वर्षस्य नव भेदान् ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: ataḥ samprāpyate pumbhiḥ svargo naraka eva ca | bhāratasyāpi varṣasya nava bhedān bravīmi te
verses.translation: O fair lady, the attributes and the aberrations of the seasons constitute that in the right-hand practices. This shall be known by those who understand the motion of vital airs.
verses.hindi: लोकोंको व्याप्त करती हुई देवीको देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: O fair lady, the attributes and the aberrations of the seasons constitute that in the right-hand practices. This shall be known by those who understand the motion of vital airs.
verses.science: लोकोंको व्याप्त करती हुई देवीको देखा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नः कसेरुश्च ताम्रवर्णो गभस्तिमान् । नागद्वीपस्तथा सौम्यो गन्धर्वस्त्वथ वारुणः
verses.transliteration: indradyumnaḥ kaseruśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān | nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gandharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: If for eleven days, he lives for one year nine months and eight days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If for eleven days, he lives for one year nine months and eight days.
verses.science: महालक्ष््यवतारवर्णन॑ नाम षट्चत्वारिशो ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अयं तु नवमस्तेषां द्वीपः सागरसम्भृतः । योजनानां सहस्रं तु द्वीपोऽयं दक्षिणोत्तरः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ tu navamasteṣāṃ dvīpaḥ sāgarasambhṛtaḥ | yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu dvīpo'yaṃ dakṣiṇottaraḥ
verses.translation: The right path-practice has been mentioned to you. I shall now tell you about the middle one. The respiration with frequency on one part of the face makes him live for one day. Thus the time for death for a dying person has been mentioned by the experts.
verses.hindi: कहा है, उसे अब आप सुनिये
verses.commentary: Sense: The right path-practice has been mentioned to you. I shall now tell you about the middle one. The respiration with frequency on one part of the face makes him live for one day. Thus the time for death for a dying person has been mentioned by the experts.
verses.science: कहा है, उसे अब आप सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे किराता यस्य स्युर्दक्षिणे यवनाः स्थिताः । पश्चिमे च तथा ज्ञेया उत्तरे हि तपस्विनः
verses.transliteration: pūrve kirātā yasya syurdakṣiṇe yavanāḥ sthitāḥ | paścime ca tathā jñeyā uttare hi tapasvinaḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, listen. I shall explain it for the bene¬ fit of the Yogins. The perfect knowledge shall not be imparted to anyone and everyone.
verses.hindi: और युद्धमें दोनों ही पक्षोंसे तीखे बाण बरसने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, listen. I shall explain it for the bene¬ fit of the Yogins. The perfect knowledge shall not be imparted to anyone and everyone.
verses.science: और युद्धमें दोनों ही पक्षोंसे तीखे बाण बरसने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या मध्ये शूद्राश्च भूयशः । इज्यायुद्धपणासेवा वर्तयन्तो व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā madhye śūdrāśca bhūyaśaḥ | ijyāyuddhapaṇāsevā vartayanto vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: Sinners of crooked intellect deluded by the noose of Kala, fastened into death's bondage do not realise Sabda- brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sinners of crooked intellect deluded by the noose of Kala, fastened into death's bondage do not realise Sabda- brahman.
verses.science: जैसे प्रतीत हो रहे थे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः सुदामा चर्क्षपर्वतः । विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तात्र कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ sudāmā carkṣaparvataḥ | vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: Attracted by him the virgins of Yakas and Gandharvas give him great Siddhis as desired by him or out of their own accord.
verses.hindi: सरस्वती प्रादुर्भाववर्णन नामक अड़वालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Attracted by him the virgins of Yakas and Gandharvas give him great Siddhis as desired by him or out of their own accord.
verses.science: सरस्वती प्रादुर्भाववर्णन नामक अड़वालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदस्मृतिपुराणाद्याः पारियात्रोद्भवा मुने । सर्वपापहरा ज्ञेया दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि
verses.transliteration: vedasmṛtipurāṇādyāḥ pāriyātrodbhavā mune | sarvapāpaharā jñeyā darśanātsparśanādapi
verses.translation: All principles are understood by one who medit¬ ates on Vaiha Nada. One who meditates on Dundubhi is devoid of old age and death.
verses.hindi: लगे-यह क्या है, यह क्‍या है !
verses.commentary: Sense: All principles are understood by one who medit¬ ates on Vaiha Nada. One who meditates on Dundubhi is devoid of old age and death.
verses.science: लगे-यह क्या है, यह क्‍या है !। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सुरसाद्याश्च सप्तान्याश्च सहस्रशः । विन्ध्योद्भवा महानद्यः सर्वपापहराः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: narmadā surasādyāśca saptānyāśca sahasraśaḥ | vindhyodbhavā mahānadyaḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: If a man sees his shadow without the head or if he does not see the shadow at all he will not live for one full month thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man sees his shadow without the head or if he does not see the shadow at all he will not live for one full month thereafter.
verses.science: नारायणको जगाइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोदावरीभीमरथीतापीप्रमुखनिम्नगाः । गिरेर्विनिर्गता ऋक्षात्सद्यः पापभयापहाः
verses.transliteration: godāvarībhīmarathītāpīpramukhanimnagāḥ | girervinirgatā ṛkṣātsadyaḥ pāpabhayāpahāḥ
verses.translation: O Parvati, the signs of death evinced by bodily limbs have been explained. O gentle lady, I shall now mention the extraneous signs. Listen.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Parvati, the signs of death evinced by bodily limbs have been explained. O gentle lady, I shall now mention the extraneous signs. Listen.
verses.science: ब्रह्माजीके समक्ष स्थित हो गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सह्यपादोद्भवा नद्यः कृष्णावेण्यादिकास्तथा । कृतमालाताम्रपर्णीप्रमुखा मलयोद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: sahyapādodbhavā nadyaḥ kṛṣṇāveṇyādikāstathā | kṛtamālātāmraparṇīpramukhā malayodbhavāḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, if the zone of the sun or the moon appears devoid of rays or like the trumpet flower, the man dies within half a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, if the zone of the sun or the moon appears devoid of rays or like the trumpet flower, the man dies within half a month.
verses.science: हैत्योंको देखा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रियामा चर्षिकुल्याद्या महेन्द्रप्रभवाः स्मृताः । ऋषिकुल्या कुमार्याद्याः शुक्तिमत्पादसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: triyāmā carṣikulyādyā mahendraprabhavāḥ smṛtāḥ | ṛṣikulyā kumāryādyāḥ śuktimatpādasambhavāḥ
verses.translation: If a person does not see the star Arundhatil or the
verses.hindi: सकूँ, मैं तुम दोनोंसे अन्य वर नहीं माँगता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person does not see the star Arundhatil or the
verses.science: सकूँ, मैं तुम दोनोंसे अन्य वर नहीं माँगता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नानाजनपदास्तेषु मण्डलेषु वसन्ति वै । आसां पिबन्ति पानीयं सरःसु विविधेषु च
verses.transliteration: nānājanapadāsteṣu maṇḍaleṣu vasanti vai | āsāṃ pibanti pānīyaṃ saraḥsu vividheṣu ca
verses.translation: If a person does not see the star Utathya or the Polar star or the solar zone or has delusion of quarters on seeing the planet he dies within six months.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person does not see the star Utathya or the Polar star or the solar zone or has delusion of quarters on seeing the planet he dies within six months.
verses.science: दोनोंका वध कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि भारते वर्षे युगान्यासन् महामुने । कृतादीनि न चान्येषु द्वीपेषु प्रभवन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: catvāri bhārate varṣe yugānyāsan mahāmune | kṛtādīni na cānyeṣu dvīpeṣu prabhavanti hi
verses.translation: If a man sees rainbow at night or the fall of the meteor at midday or if he is surrounded by vultures and crows he lives only for six months more.
verses.hindi: अपनी जंघापर रखकर उनके सिर काट दिये
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man sees rainbow at night or the fall of the meteor at midday or if he is surrounded by vultures and crows he lives only for six months more.
verses.science: अपनी जंघापर रखकर उनके सिर काट दिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दानानि चात्र दीयन्ते सुकृतैश्चात्र याज्ञिकैः । तपस्तपन्ति यतयः परलोकार्थमादरात्
verses.transliteration: dānāni cātra dīyante sukṛtaiścātra yājñikaiḥ | tapastapanti yatayaḥ paralokārthamādarāt
verses.translation: If the great Bear and the Milky way are not seen in the sky, know him to live for only six months more. This shall be declared by the experts.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the great Bear and the Milky way are not seen in the sky, know him to live for only six months more. This shall be declared by the experts.
verses.science: उत्पत्तिका वृत्तान्त सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतो हि कर्मभूरेषा जम्बूद्वीपे महामुने । अत्रापि भारतं श्रेष्ठमतोऽन्या भोगभूमयः
verses.transliteration: yato hi karmabhūreṣā jambūdvīpe mahāmune | atrāpi bhārataṃ śreṣṭhamato'nyā bhogabhūmayaḥ
verses.translation: If any person sees the sun or the moon suddenly seized by Rahu, or the wheel of quarters whirling, he dies within six months definitely.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any person sees the sun or the moon suddenly seized by Rahu, or the wheel of quarters whirling, he dies within six months definitely.
verses.science: शरीर धारणकर प्रकट होती हैं। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिल्लभते मर्त्यः सहस्रैर्मुनिसत्तम । अत्र जन्मसहस्राणां मानुष्यं पुण्यसञ्चयैः
verses.transliteration: kadācillabhate martyaḥ sahasrairmunisattama | atra janmasahasrāṇāṃ mānuṣyaṃ puṇyasañcayaiḥ
verses.translation: Surely the person dies soon within a month if a crow or a dove attacks him and settles on his head.
verses.hindi: लीलया सापि भक्तानां गुणवर्णनहेतवे ॥ ७८  उनके गुणोंका गान करते रहें
verses.commentary: Sense: Surely the person dies soon within a month if a crow or a dove attacks him and settles on his head.
verses.science: लीलया सापि भक्तानां गुणवर्णनहेतवे ॥ ७८ उनके गुणोंका गान करते रहें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गापवर्गास्पदमार्गभूते धन्यास्तु ते भारतभूमिभागे । गायन्ति देवाः किल गीतकानि भवन्ति भूयः पुरुषाः सुरास्ते
verses.transliteration: svargāpavargāspadamārgabhūte dhanyāstu te bhāratabhūmibhāge | gāyanti devāḥ kila gītakāni bhavanti bhūyaḥ puruṣāḥ surāste
verses.translation: Thus the evil portents of an external nature have been explained to you. For the benefit of human beings 1 shall mention succinctly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the evil portents of an external nature have been explained to you. For the benefit of human beings 1 shall mention succinctly.
verses.science: महाकालिकाववारवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्जचत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: विहृत्य शम्भोः परमात्मरूपे । फलानि सर्वाणि तु कर्मजानि यास्याम्यहं तत्तनुतां हि तस्य
verses.transliteration: vihṛtya śambhoḥ paramātmarūpe | phalāni sarvāṇi tu karmajāni yāsyāmyahaṃ tattanutāṃ hi tasya
verses.translation: O beautiful goddess, in brief there are two fort¬ nights. In these one shall take bath and be clear, remember the lord with controlled senses.
verses.hindi: चकार राज्य स्वलोंके महेन्द्रासनसंस्थितः॥ २  लोकमें इन्द्रासनपर बैठकर राज्य करने लगा
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful goddess, in brief there are two fort¬ nights. In these one shall take bath and be clear, remember the lord with controlled senses.
verses.science: चकार राज्य स्वलोंके महेन्द्रासनसंस्थितः॥ २ लोकमें इन्द्रासनपर बैठकर राज्य करने लगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आप्स्यन्ति धन्याः खलु ते मनुष्याः सुखैर्युताः कर्मणि सन्निविष्टाः । जनुर्हि येषां खलु भारतेऽस्ति ते स्वर्गमोक्षोभयलाभवन्तः
verses.transliteration: āpsyanti dhanyāḥ khalu te manuṣyāḥ sukhairyutāḥ karmaṇi sanniviṣṭāḥ | janurhi yeṣāṃ khalu bhārate'sti te svargamokṣobhayalābhavantaḥ
verses.translation: He shall wash his hands with red lac juice and milk. He shall hold scents and fragrant flowers in the hands and try to forestall his good or bad luck.
verses.hindi: उपाय सोचें, आप दोनों हमलोगोंके प्रभु हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall wash his hands with red lac juice and milk. He shall hold scents and fragrant flowers in the hands and try to forestall his good or bad luck.
verses.science: उपाय सोचें, आप दोनों हमलोगोंके प्रभु हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लक्षयोजनविस्तारः समस्तपरिमण्डलः । जम्बूद्वीपो मया ख्यातः क्षारोदधिसुसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: lakṣayojanavistāraḥ samastaparimaṇḍalaḥ | jambūdvīpo mayā khyātaḥ kṣārodadhisusaṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O beloved, beginning with the little finger and ending with the thumb, one should make the Nyasa (mystical placing) of each of the Tithis on each knot. Thus the two hands together will cover the mouth Keep the hands in the cuplike form and sit facing the east.
verses.hindi: तथान्येषां च देवानां शरीरान्निर्गत॑ महः॥ १९  शरीरसे तेज निकला
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, beginning with the little finger and ending with the thumb, one should make the Nyasa (mystical placing) of each of the Tithis on each knot. Thus the two hands together will cover the mouth Keep the hands in the cuplike form and sit facing the east.
verses.science: तथान्येषां च देवानां शरीरान्निर्गत॑ महः॥ १९ शरीरसे तेज निकला। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संवेष्ट्य क्षारमुदधिं शतसाहस्रसम्मितम् । ततो हि द्विगुणो ब्रह्मन् प्लक्षद्वीपः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: saṃveṣṭya kṣāramudadhiṃ śatasāhasrasammitam | tato hi dviguṇo brahman plakṣadvīpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: The devotee then should repeat the Navatmaka mantra one hundred and eight times. Then he shall scrutinise every one of the knots in the fingers of both the hands.
verses.hindi: अप॒श्यंस्त्रिदशा: सर्वे दुर्गाध्यानपरायणा:॥ १२  तेजसमूहको दसों दिशाओंमें देदीप्यमान देखा
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee then should repeat the Navatmaka mantra one hundred and eight times. Then he shall scrutinise every one of the knots in the fingers of both the hands.
verses.science: अप॒श्यंस्त्रिदशा: सर्वे दुर्गाध्यानपरायणा:॥ १२ तेजसमूहको दसों दिशाओंमें देदीप्यमान देखा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गोमन्तश्चैव चन्द्रश्च नारदो दर्दुरस्तथा । सोमकः सुमनाः शैलो वैभ्राजश्चैव सत्तमः
verses.transliteration: gomantaścaiva candraśca nārado dardurastathā | somakaḥ sumanāḥ śailo vaibhrājaścaiva sattamaḥ
verses.translation: The Skt. text of the first pSda of this verse is defective.
verses.hindi: याम्येन बाला अभवन्वैष्णवेन च बाहब:॥ १४  भुजाएँ उत्पन्न हुईं
verses.commentary: Sense: The Skt. text of the first pSda of this verse is defective.
verses.science: याम्येन बाला अभवन्वैष्णवेन च बाहब:॥ १४ भुजाएँ उत्पन्न हुईं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाचलेषु रम्येषु सहिताः सततं प्रजाः । वसन्ति देवगन्धर्वा वर्षेष्वेतेषु नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: varṣācaleṣu ramyeṣu sahitāḥ satataṃ prajāḥ | vasanti devagandharvā varṣeṣveteṣu nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: O beloved, if the devotee sees a line in the form of a bee in a particular knot he shall understand *that the death will take place on the Tithi represented by that knot*
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, if the devotee sees a line in the form of a bee in a particular knot he shall understand *that the death will take place on the Tithi represented by that knot*
verses.science: करनेका मनमें विचार किया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नाधयो व्याधयो वापि जनानां तत्र कुत्रचित् । दश वर्षसहस्राणि तत्र जीवन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: nādhayo vyādhayo vāpi janānāṃ tatra kutracit | daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tatra jīvanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: Now I shall succinctly mention the time of death. O beloved, listen. On the basis of hearing the sound he shall know the result.
verses.hindi: तथा पाश धारण करनेवाले वरुणने पाश दिया
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall succinctly mention the time of death. O beloved, listen. On the basis of hearing the sound he shall know the result.
verses.science: तथा पाश धारण करनेवाले वरुणने पाश दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुतप्ता शिखी चैव पापघ्नी त्रिदिवा कृपा । अमृता सुकृता चैव सप्तैवात्र च निम्नगाः
verses.transliteration: anutaptā śikhī caiva pāpaghnī tridivā kṛpā | amṛtā sukṛtā caiva saptaivātra ca nimnagāḥ
verses.translation: iva calculates time by three paths: Lefl, right and middle.
verses.hindi: ऊँचे स्वस्से बार-बार अट्टहासपूर्वक गर्जना कौ
verses.commentary: Sense: iva calculates time by three paths: Lefl, right and middle.
verses.science: ऊँचे स्वस्से बार-बार अट्टहासपूर्वक गर्जना कौ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षुद्रनद्यस्तथा शैलास्तत्र सन्ति सहस्रशः । ताः पिबन्ति सुसंहृष्टा नदीर्जनपदास्तु ते
verses.transliteration: kṣudranadyastathā śailāstatra santi sahasraśaḥ | tāḥ pibanti susaṃhṛṣṭā nadīrjanapadāstu te
verses.translation: Beginning with the fiflh and ending with the twentyfifth are the calculations of sound according to the left-hand practices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning with the fiflh and ending with the twentyfifth are the calculations of sound according to the left-hand practices.
verses.science: देवगणोंने जय-जयकार किया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न तत्रापि युगावस्था यथा स्थानेषु सप्तसु । त्रेतायुगसमः कालः सर्वदैव महामुने
verses.transliteration: na tatrāpi yugāvasthā yathā sthāneṣu saptasu | tretāyugasamaḥ kālaḥ sarvadaiva mahāmune
verses.translation: O fair lady, Bhutarandhra (?) the quarters and the banner are the sounds in the left hand practices.
verses.hindi: युक्त होकर संग्रामके लिये उद्यत हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: O fair lady, Bhutarandhra (?) the quarters and the banner are the sounds in the left hand practices.
verses.science: युक्त होकर संग्रामके लिये उद्यत हो गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विप्रक्षत्रियवैश्यास्ते शूद्राश्च मुनिसत्तम । कल्पवृक्षसमानस्तु तन्मध्ये सुमहातरुः
verses.transliteration: viprakṣatriyavaiśyāste śūdrāśca munisattama | kalpavṛkṣasamānastu tanmadhye sumahātaruḥ
verses.translation: When Ida and other Nadis respire for five days consecutively, you shall know that the person will die within that year. If these respire for ten days he lives for a year. If they respire for fifteen days he will die after a year. If for twenty days he lives for six months. If the left respires for twenty five days he lives for three months; if for twentysix days, two months.
verses.hindi: महावीर शस्त्र धारण किये हुए वहाँ पहुँच गये
verses.wordMeaning: When Ida and other Nadis respire for five days consecutively, you shall know that the person will die within that year. If these respire for ten days he lives for a year. If they respire for fifteen days he will die after a year. If for twenty days he lives for six months.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Ida and other Nadis respire for five days consecutively, you shall know that the person will die within that year. If these respire for ten days he lives for a year. If they respire for fifteen days he will die after a year. If for twenty days he lives for six months.…
verses.science: महावीर शस्त्र धारण किये हुए वहाँ पहुँच गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षस्तन्नामसंज्ञो वै प्लक्षद्वीपो द्विजोत्तम । इज्यते तत्र भगवान् शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः
verses.transliteration: plakṣastannāmasaṃjño vai plakṣadvīpo dvijottama | ijyate tatra bhagavān śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: If it respires for twentyseven days incessantly he lives for a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: If it respires for twentyseven days incessantly he lives for a month.
verses.science: बार प्रहार करना आरम्भ किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्च भगवान् ब्रह्मा यन्त्रैर्मन्त्रैश्च वैदिकैः । सङ्क्षेपेण तथा भूयः शाल्मलिं त्वं निशामय
verses.transliteration: hariśca bhagavān brahmā yantrairmantraiśca vaidikaiḥ | saṅkṣepeṇa tathā bhūyaḥ śālmaliṃ tvaṃ niśāmaya
verses.translation: This shall be knoivn in accordance with the left- hand practices. If in the right he lives for four days only.
verses.commentary: Sense: This shall be knoivn in accordance with the left- hand practices. If in the right he lives for four days only.
verses.science: किनारोंको तोड़कर इधर-उधर बहने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तवर्षाणि तत्रैव तेषां नामानि मे शृणु । श्वेतोऽथ हरितश्चैव जीमूतो रोहितस्तथा
verses.transliteration: saptavarṣāṇi tatraiva teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu | śveto'tha haritaścaiva jīmūto rohitastathā
verses.translation: O goddess, these sixteen are mentioned as stationed in four places. I shall now mention their extent factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, these sixteen are mentioned as stationed in four places. I shall now mention their extent factually.
verses.science: वधका उपाय किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैकलो मानसश्चैव सुप्रभः सप्तमो मुने । शाल्मलेन तु वृक्षेण द्वीपः शाल्मलिसंज्ञकः
verses.transliteration: vaikalo mānasaścaiva suprabhaḥ saptamo mune | śālmalena tu vṛkṣeṇa dvīpaḥ śālmalisaṃjñakaḥ
verses.translation: Beginning with six days and calculating duly it happens as mentioned in the left path.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning with six days and calculating duly it happens as mentioned in the left path.
verses.science: मायावी खड्गधारी पुरुष हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणेन समुद्रेण सततं संवृतः स्थितः । वर्षाभिव्यञ्जका नद्यस्तासां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: dviguṇena samudreṇa satataṃ saṃvṛtaḥ sthitaḥ | varṣābhivyañjakā nadyastāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu
verses.translation: If it respires for six days, he lives for two yean eight months smd eight days. You shall know that.
verses.commentary: Sense: If it respires for six days, he lives for two yean eight months smd eight days. You shall know that.
verses.science: प्रहार करना आरम्भ किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्ला रक्ता हिरण्या च चन्द्रा शुभ्रा विमोचना । निवृत्तिः सप्तमी तासां पुण्यतोयाः सुशीतलाः
verses.transliteration: śuklā raktā hiraṇyā ca candrā śubhrā vimocanā | nivṛttiḥ saptamī tāsāṃ puṇyatoyāḥ suśītalāḥ
verses.translation: If it respires for seven days he lives for (Mie year ■even months and six days, to be sure.
verses.commentary: Sense: If it respires for seven days he lives for (Mie year ■even months and six days, to be sure.
verses.science: समान गम्भीर वाणीमें कहने लगीं--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तैव तानि वर्षाणि चतुर्वर्णैर्युतानि च । भगवन्तं सदा शम्भुं यजन्ते विविधैर्मखैः
verses.transliteration: saptaiva tāni varṣāṇi caturvarṇairyutāni ca | bhagavantaṃ sadā śambhuṃ yajante vividhairmakhaiḥ
verses.translation: If it flows for eight days, he lives for two years four months and twenty-four days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If it flows for eight days, he lives for two years four months and twenty-four days.
verses.science: सामने टिक नहीं सकता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवानां तत्र सान्निध्यमतीव सुमनोरमे । एष द्वीपः समुद्रेण सुरोदेन समावृतः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ tatra sānnidhyamatīva sumanorame | eṣa dvīpaḥ samudreṇa surodena samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: If for nine days, he lives for three months, twice two months, and twelve days (i.e. seven months and twelve days).
verses.hindi: भयंकर त्रिशूलसे उसके कण्ठपर प्रहार किया
verses.commentary: Sense: If for nine days, he lives for three months, twice two months, and twelve days (i.e. seven months and twelve days).
verses.science: भयंकर त्रिशूलसे उसके कण्ठपर प्रहार किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणेन कुशद्वीपः समन्ताद् बाह्यतः स्थितः । वसन्ति तत्र दैतेया मनुजैः सह दानवाः
verses.transliteration: dviguṇena kuśadvīpaḥ samantād bāhyataḥ sthitaḥ | vasanti tatra daiteyā manujaiḥ saha dānavāḥ
verses.translation: The time of the previous days has been mentioned before. But the intervening days of the month may be calculated thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The time of the previous days has been mentioned before. But the intervening days of the month may be calculated thus.
verses.science: उत्पत्तिका वृत्तान्त श्रवण कौजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव देवगन्धर्वा यक्षाः किम्पुरुषादयः । वर्णास्तत्रैव चत्वारो निजानुष्ठानतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva devagandharvā yakṣāḥ kimpuruṣādayaḥ | varṇāstatraiva catvāro nijānuṣṭhānatatparāḥ
verses.translation: If for twelve days he lives for one year seven months and six days.
verses.hindi: म्रहालक्ष्मीका अवतारवर्णन नामक छियालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: If for twelve days he lives for one year seven months and six days.
verses.science: म्रहालक्ष्मीका अवतारवर्णन नामक छियालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव च कुशद्वीपे ब्रह्माणं च जनार्दनम् । यजन्ति च तथेशानं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tatraiva ca kuśadvīpe brahmāṇaṃ ca janārdanam | yajanti ca tatheśānaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: If for thirteen days he lives for one year four months and twentyfour days. When the Praijia flows in the left side for fourteen days he lives for one year, six months and twentyfour days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If for thirteen days he lives for one year four months and twentyfour days. When the Praijia flows in the left side for fourteen days he lives for one year, six months and twentyfour days.
verses.science: तथा श्रीविद्याको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुशेशयो हरिश्चैव द्युतिमान् पुष्पवांस्तथा । मणिद्रुमो हेमशैलः सप्तमो मन्दराचलः
verses.transliteration: kuśeśayo hariścaiva dyutimān puṣpavāṃstathā | maṇidrumo hemaśailaḥ saptamo mandarācalaḥ
verses.translation: If for fifteen days he lives for nine months and twentyfour days.
verses.hindi: है। आप धूमावतीको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: If for fifteen days he lives for nine months and twentyfour days.
verses.science: है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नद्यश्च सप्त तासां तु नामानि शृणु तत्त्वतः । धूतपापा शिवा चैव पवित्रा सम्मितिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nadyaśca sapta tāsāṃ tu nāmāni śṛṇu tattvataḥ | dhūtapāpā śivā caiva pavitrā sammitistathā
verses.translation: If for sixteen days he lives for ten months and twentyfour days.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है, आप घोराकृतिको नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: If for sixteen days he lives for ten months and twentyfour days.
verses.science: नमस्कार है, आप घोराकृतिको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्या दम्भा मही चान्या सर्वपापहरास्त्विमाः । अन्याः सहस्रशः सन्ति शुभापो हेमवालुकाः
verses.transliteration: vidyā dambhā mahī cānyā sarvapāpaharāstvimāḥ | anyāḥ sahasraśaḥ santi śubhāpo hemavālukāḥ
verses.translation: If for seventeen days he dies within nine months. O fond of devotees, eighteen days too are mentioned here.
verses.hindi: करनेवाली आप रुद्राणीको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: If for seventeen days he dies within nine months. O fond of devotees, eighteen days too are mentioned here.
verses.science: करनेवाली आप रुद्राणीको बार-बार नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुशद्वीपे कुशस्तम्बो घृतोदेन समावृतः । क्रौञ्चद्वीपो महाभाग श्रूयतां चापरो महान्
verses.transliteration: kuśadvīpe kuśastambo ghṛtodena samāvṛtaḥ | krauñcadvīpo mahābhāga śrūyatāṃ cāparo mahān
verses.translation: O goddess, if for eighteen days he lives for eight months and twdve days.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, if for eighteen days he lives for eight months and twdve days.
verses.science: बार-बार नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणेन समुद्रेण दधिमण्डेन चावृतः । वर्षाचला महाबुद्धे तेषां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: dviguṇena samudreṇa dadhimaṇḍena cāvṛtaḥ | varṣācalā mahābuddhe teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu
verses.translation: If for twentythree days, know for certain that he lives for five months i.e. 4 months and 24-f-6 days=5 months. If for twenty-four days he lives for three months and eighteen days. All this I have narrated to you in brief.
verses.hindi: देवता मेरी स्तुति कर रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: If for twentythree days, know for certain that he lives for five months i.e. 4 months and 24-f-6 days=5 months. If for twenty-four days he lives for three months and eighteen days. All this I have narrated to you in brief.
verses.science: देवता मेरी स्तुति कर रहे हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चश्च वामनश्चैव तृतीयश्चान्धकारकः । दिवावृतिर्मनश्चैव पुण्डरीकश्च दुन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: krauñcaśca vāmanaścaiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ | divāvṛtirmanaścaiva puṇḍarīkaśca dundubhiḥ
verses.translation: If for ten days, he dies immediately. If for thirty days he dies in five days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If for ten days, he dies immediately. If for thirty days he dies in five days.
verses.science: लोकमें मातंगी कही जाती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निवसन्ति निरातङ्का वर्षशैलेषु तेषु वै । सर्वसौवर्णरम्येषु सुहृद्देवगणैः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: nivasanti nirātaṅkā varṣaśaileṣu teṣu vai | sarvasauvarṇaramyeṣu suhṛddevagaṇaiḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, if it respires incessantly for thirtyone days, he lives for three days.
verses.hindi: पुरुषरत्न हैं और वह स्त्रीरत्न है
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, if it respires incessantly for thirtyone days, he lives for three days.
verses.science: पुरुषरत्न हैं और वह स्त्रीरत्न है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चानुक्रमोदिताः । सन्ति तत्र महानद्यः सप्तान्यास्तु सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānukramoditāḥ | santi tatra mahānadyaḥ saptānyāstu sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: When Ravi Nid> respires thirtytwo breaiths he lives for two days; there is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Ravi Nid> respires thirtytwo breaiths he lives for two days; there is no doubt in this.
verses.science: उसे यलपूर्वक मेरे पास लाओ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौरी कुमुद्वती चैव सन्ध्या रात्रिर्मनोजवा । शान्तिश्च पुण्डरीका च याः पिबन्ति पयः शुभम्
verses.transliteration: gaurī kumudvatī caiva sandhyā rātrirmanojavā | śāntiśca puṇḍarīkā ca yāḥ pibanti payaḥ śubham
verses.translation: O goddess, this Kalacakra pertaining to the dying person has been mentioned to you for the benefit of the worlds. What more do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: यज्ञभागको मैं स्वयं ग्रहण करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, this Kalacakra pertaining to the dying person has been mentioned to you for the benefit of the worlds. What more do you wish to hear?
verses.science: यज्ञभागको मैं स्वयं ग्रहण करता हूँ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: भगवान् पूज्यते तत्र योगरुद्रस्वरूपवान् । दधिमण्डोदकश्चापि शाकद्वीपेन संवृतः
verses.transliteration: bhagavān pūjyate tatra yogarudrasvarūpavān | dadhimaṇḍodakaścāpi śākadvīpena saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, the perfect knowledge of KLala has been mentioned by you. Now please mention the dodging of Kala by a Yogin, factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the perfect knowledge of KLala has been mentioned by you. Now please mention the dodging of Kala by a Yogin, factually.
verses.science: छोटे भाईका सेवन करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणेनाद्रयः सप्त तेषां नामानि मे शृणु । पूर्वे तत्रोदयगिरिर्जलधारः परे यतः
verses.transliteration: dviguṇenādrayaḥ sapta teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu | pūrve tatrodayagirirjaladhāraḥ pare yataḥ
verses.translation: Kala follows upon the track of all creatures. O lord, now taking pity on me, please mention how the Kala that has come does not deceive. O bestower of happiness, please mention it, for the benefit of Yogins.
verses.hindi: सुनकर शिवप्राणप्रिया वे महामाया कहने लगीं--
verses.commentary: Sense: Kala follows upon the track of all creatures. O lord, now taking pity on me, please mention how the Kala that has come does not deceive. O bestower of happiness, please mention it, for the benefit of Yogins.
verses.science: सुनकर शिवप्राणप्रिया वे महामाया कहने लगीं--। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठतोऽस्तगिरिश्चैव ह्यविकेशश्च केसरी । शाकस्तत्र महावृक्षः सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितः
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhato'stagiriścaiva hyavikeśaśca kesarī | śākastatra mahāvṛkṣaḥ siddhagandharvasevitaḥ
verses.translation: O Goddess Siva listen. I shall explain briefly what I have been asked by you for the benefit of all men.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess Siva listen. I shall explain briefly what I have been asked by you for the benefit of all men.
verses.science: युक्त मैं तुम्हें मार डालूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पुण्या जनपदाश्चातुर्वर्ण्यसमन्विताः । नद्यश्चात्र महापुण्याः सर्वपापभयापहाः
verses.transliteration: tatra puṇyā janapadāścāturvarṇyasamanvitāḥ | nadyaścātra mahāpuṇyāḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahāḥ
verses.translation: Kfita of terrible fmrm, Ae awful sole lord of the gods, perishes while taking them to the Ether He was burnt
verses.hindi: मैं युद्धके बिना वहाँ जाना असम्भव समझती हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Kfita of terrible fmrm, Ae awful sole lord of the gods, perishes while taking them to the Ether He was burnt
verses.science: मैं युद्धके बिना वहाँ जाना असम्भव समझती हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमारी कुमारी च नलिनी वेणुका तथा । इक्षुश्च रेणुका चैव गभस्तिः सप्तमी तथा
verses.transliteration: sukumārī kumārī ca nalinī veṇukā tathā | ikṣuśca reṇukā caiva gabhastiḥ saptamī tathā
verses.translation: On hearing this from Siva, the preceptor of the three worlds, Gauri laughed and said ''Please tell me the truth. How is this Kala killed? By whom is it killed? Siva told her immediately "O moon-faced lady, those who are sinless Yogins hurl the serpent Kala entirely. Listen to that with concentration."
verses.hindi: डाला और जो शेष बचे, वे सब भाग गये
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this from Siva, the preceptor of the three worlds, Gauri laughed and said ''Please tell me the truth. How is this Kala killed? By whom is it killed? Siva told her immediately "O moon-faced lady, those who are sinless Yogins hurl the serpent Kala entirely.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this from Siva, the preceptor of the three worlds, Gauri laughed and said ''Please tell me the truth. How is this Kala killed? By whom is it killed? Siva told her immediately "O moon-faced lady, those who are sinless Yogins hurl the serpent Kala entirely.…
verses.science: डाला और जो शेष बचे, वे सब भाग गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्याः सहस्रशस्तत्र क्षुद्रनद्यो महामुने । महीधरास्तथा सन्ति शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: anyāḥ sahasraśastatra kṣudranadyo mahāmune | mahīdharāstathā santi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: O beautiful lady, the physical body consists of five elements. It arises from them and merges in them. It is always endowed with their attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady, the physical body consists of five elements. It arises from them and merges in them. It is always endowed with their attributes.
verses.science: चबाता हुआ अत्यन्त क्रोधित हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्महानिर्न तेष्वस्ति स्वर्गादागत्य मानवाः । वर्षेषु तेषु पृथिवीं विहरन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: dharmahānirna teṣvasti svargādāgatya mānavāḥ | varṣeṣu teṣu pṛthivīṃ viharanti parasparam
verses.translation: Each of the elements merges into the other in order. Earth has five attributes. Water has four. Fire has three. Wind has only two. Ether has only one. The attributes of the earth and other elements can be mentioned thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of the elements merges into the other in order. Earth has five attributes. Water has four. Fire has three. Wind has only two. Ether has only one. The attributes of the earth and other elements can be mentioned thus.
verses.science: गये, जहाँ देवी स्थित थीं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपे तु वै सूर्यः प्रीत्या जनपदैः सदा । यथोक्तैरिज्यते सम्यक्कर्मभिर्नियतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpe tu vai sūryaḥ prītyā janapadaiḥ sadā | yathoktairijyate samyakkarmabhirniyatātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The five attributes are sound, touch, colour, taste and smell. When it is relieved of its attributes the element perishes.
verses.hindi: कर रसमय सत्य वचन कहने लगीं--
verses.commentary: Sense: The five attributes are sound, touch, colour, taste and smell. When it is relieved of its attributes the element perishes.
verses.science: कर रसमय सत्य वचन कहने लगीं--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदेनावृतः सोऽपि द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । क्षीराब्धिः सर्वतो व्यास पुष्कराख्येन संवृतः
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ so'pi dviguṇena samantataḥ | kṣīrābdhiḥ sarvato vyāsa puṣkarākhyena saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Hence O goddess, the partial attributesrfhall be thought of by the Yogin as&iduously if he is desirous of conquering K51a.
verses.hindi: बैठ जाओ और युद्धके लिये आओ
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O goddess, the partial attributesrfhall be thought of by the Yogin as&iduously if he is desirous of conquering K51a.
verses.science: बैठ जाओ और युद्धके लिये आओ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणेन महावर्षस्तत्र ख्यातोऽत्र मानसः । योजनानां सहस्राणि ऊर्ध्वं पञ्चाशदुच्छ्रितः
verses.transliteration: dviguṇena mahāvarṣastatra khyāto'tra mānasaḥ | yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ūrdhvaṃ pañcāśaducchritaḥ
verses.translation: The knower of Yoga shah practise it taking breath normally sitting on a good bed. If he practises in darkness he shall not keep any lamp. He shall practise when people are asleep.
verses.hindi: अत प्रापन्परं लोक॑ यँल्‍लोकं यान्ति तज्जना:॥ ६६  देवीके भक्त प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of Yoga shah practise it taking breath normally sitting on a good bed. If he practises in darkness he shall not keep any lamp. He shall practise when people are asleep.
verses.science: अत प्रापन्परं लोक॑ यँल्‍लोकं यान्ति तज्जना:॥ ६६ देवीके भक्त प्राप्त करते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तानि चैव तु लक्षाणि सर्वतो वलयाकृतिः । पुष्करद्वीपवलयं मध्येन विभजन्निव
verses.transliteration: tāni caiva tu lakṣāṇi sarvato valayākṛtiḥ | puṣkaradvīpavalayaṃ madhyena vibhajanniva
verses.translation: When the ears are closed with the index finger for a short while a kind of sound is heard as that of a blazing fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the ears are closed with the index finger for a short while a kind of sound is heard as that of a blazing fire.
verses.science: नाम सप्तचत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव वलयाकारा द्वीपवर्षसमाकृतिः । दशवर्षसहस्राणि तत्र जीवन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tenaiva valayākārā dvīpavarṣasamākṛtiḥ | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tatra jīvanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: The practice of Yoga quells all ailments, fevers and many other distressing ills.*
verses.hindi: बध नामक सैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The practice of Yoga quells all ailments, fevers and many other distressing ills.*
verses.science: बध नामक सैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: निरामया वीतशोका रागद्वेषविवर्जिताः । अधर्मो न मतस्तेषां न बन्धवधकौ मुने
verses.transliteration: nirāmayā vītaśokā rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ | adharmo na matasteṣāṃ na bandhavadhakau mune
verses.translation: He who visualises the form of death for two Ghatikas conquers death and lust and can roam about as he pleases.**'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visualises the form of death for two Ghatikas conquers death and lust and can roam about as he pleases.**'
verses.science: सुननेकी इच्छावाले मुझे इसे बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यानृते न तस्यास्तां सदैव वसतिः सदा । तुल्यवेषास्तु मनुजा हेमवर्णैकरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: satyānṛte na tasyāstāṃ sadaiva vasatiḥ sadā | tulyaveṣāstu manujā hemavarṇaikarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: He becomes omniscient and omniseer. He attains all Siddhis.' If the Yogin hears the sound resembling that of the rain-bearing cloud he becomes rid of worldly bondage immediately. He then becomes the subtlest of all Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He becomes omniscient and omniseer. He attains all Siddhis.' If the Yogin hears the sound resembling that of the rain-bearing cloud he becomes rid of worldly bondage immediately. He then becomes the subtlest of all Yogins.
verses.science: लिये प्रस्थान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्षश्चायं तु कालेय भौमः स्वर्गोपमोपमः । सर्वस्य सुखदः कालो जरारोगविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: varṣaścāyaṃ tu kāleya bhaumaḥ svargopamopamaḥ | sarvasya sukhadaḥ kālo jarārogavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: O Goddess' thus the order and procedure of the meditation of Sabdabrahman has been narrated to you. Just
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess' thus the order and procedure of the meditation of Sabdabrahman has been narrated to you. Just
verses.science: युद्धभूमिमें पहुँचे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करे धातकीखण्डे महावीते महामुने । न्यग्रोधं पुष्करद्वीपे ब्रह्मणः स्थानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: puṣkare dhātakīkhaṇḍe mahāvīte mahāmune | nyagrodhaṃ puṣkaradvīpe brahmaṇaḥ sthānamuttamam
verses.translation: The vrrse does not suit the context.
verses.commentary: Sense: The vrrse does not suit the context.
verses.science: गलगल ध्वनि करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निवसते ब्रह्मा पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः । स्वादूदकेनाम्बुधिना पुष्करः परिवेष्टितः
verses.transliteration: tasminnivasate brahmā pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ | svādūdakenāmbudhinā puṣkaraḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ
verses.translation: The Sltt text of the first pida of this verse is defective.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sltt text of the first pida of this verse is defective.
verses.science: समान आकाशमार्गमें उड़ने लगे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं द्वीपाः समुद्रैस्तु सप्त सप्तभिरावृताः । द्वीपाश्चैव समुद्राश्च समाना द्विगुणैः परैः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dvīpāḥ samudraistu sapta saptabhirāvṛtāḥ | dvīpāścaiva samudrāśca samānā dviguṇaiḥ paraiḥ
verses.translation: If after attaining the Sabdabrahman he were to aspire for other things he will be hitting the sky with his fist, he will be loving hunger and thirst.
verses.commentary: Sense: If after attaining the Sabdabrahman he were to aspire for other things he will be hitting the sky with his fist, he will be loving hunger and thirst.
verses.science: वृष्टि करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उक्तातिरिक्तता तेषां समुद्रेषु समानि वै । पयांसि सर्वदाल्पत्वं जायन्ते न कदाचन
verses.transliteration: uktātiriktatā teṣāṃ samudreṣu samāni vai | payāṃsi sarvadālpatvaṃ jāyante na kadācana
verses.translation: After knowing the great Brahman, the cause of salvation, the bestower of happiness, the non-external, the imperishable, freed from all limitations, nothing else need be aspired after.
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing the great Brahman, the cause of salvation, the bestower of happiness, the non-external, the imperishable, freed from all limitations, nothing else need be aspired after.
verses.science: संग्राम करने लगा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थालीस्थमग्निसंयोगादधःस्थं मुनिसत्तम । तथेन्दुवृद्धौ सलिलमूर्ध्वगं भवति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: sthālīsthamagnisaṃyogādadhaḥsthaṃ munisattama | tathenduvṛddhau salilamūrdhvagaṃ bhavati dhruvam
verses.translation: One remains in the world as long as he has not obtained the supreme abode. When the great reality is understood he is released from the bondage of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: One remains in the world as long as he has not obtained the supreme abode. When the great reality is understood he is released from the bondage of life.
verses.science: सांसारिक स्त्री कदापि नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उदयास्तमने त्विन्दोर्वर्धन्त्यापो ह्रसन्ति च । अतो न्यूनातिरिक्ताश्च पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः
verses.transliteration: udayāstamane tvindorvardhantyāpo hrasanti ca | ato nyūnātiriktāśca pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ
verses.translation: After conquering sleep and idleness—the great enemies and the great obstacles and sitting in a comfortable posture one should practise Sabdabrahman for ever. Even if he is an old man of hundred years he will gain health and virility and the power of stopping the decay of the body and of con¬ quering death. He shall then continue the practice as long as he is alive.
verses.wordMeaning: After conquering sleep and idleness—the great enemies and the great obstacles and sitting in a comfortable posture one should practise Sabdabrahman for ever.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After conquering sleep and idleness—the great enemies and the great obstacles and sitting in a comfortable posture one should practise Sabdabrahman for ever.…
verses.science: यौवनकी उद्गमस्वरूपा पार्वती विराजमान थीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपां वृद्धिक्षयौ दृष्टौ शतशस्तु दशोत्तरम् । समुद्राणां मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां कथितं तव
verses.transliteration: apāṃ vṛddhikṣayau dṛṣṭau śataśastu daśottaram | samudrāṇāṃ muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ kathitaṃ tava
verses.translation: Proof of belief is visible even in an old man. Why not then in a youthful man? O beloved goddess,
verses.hindi: तो कवच उतारकर हमलोगोंका युद्ध हो
verses.commentary: Sense: Proof of belief is visible even in an old man. Why not then in a youthful man? O beloved goddess,
verses.science: तो कवच उतारकर हमलोगोंका युद्ध हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भोजनं पुष्करद्वीपे प्रजाः सर्वाः सदैव हि । खण्डस्य कुर्वते विप्र तत्र स्वयमुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: bhojanaṃ puṣkaradvīpe prajāḥ sarvāḥ sadaiva hi | khaṇḍasya kurvate vipra tatra svayamupasthitam
verses.translation: Hence the Sabdas are ninefold as explained by those who know the science of breath. I shall explain them assiduously in the proper order according to the Siddhi of Nada.
verses.hindi: गये पंखवाला पर्वत गिर पड़ता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the Sabdas are ninefold as explained by those who know the science of breath. I shall explain them assiduously in the proper order according to the Siddhi of Nada.
verses.science: गये पंखवाला पर्वत गिर पड़ता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वादूदकस्य पुरतो नास्ति लोकस्य संस्थितिः । सौवर्णी द्विगुणा भूमिः सर्वजन्तुविवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: svādūdakasya purato nāsti lokasya saṃsthitiḥ | sauvarṇī dviguṇā bhūmiḥ sarvajantuvivarjitā
verses.translation: They are Gho9a (sound of the soft consonant) Kaihsya(sound of bell metal) Srnga (sound of horn) Ghat (bell) Vina (lute) Vamlaja (flute) Dundubhi (drum) Sankha (conch) and Meghagarjita (the rumbling thunder).
verses.hindi: भयभीत होकर दसों दिशाओंमें भाग गये
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Gho9a (sound of the soft consonant) Kaihsya(sound of bell metal) Srnga (sound of horn) Ghat (bell) Vina (lute) Vamlaja (flute) Dundubhi (drum) Sankha (conch) and Meghagarjita (the rumbling thunder).
verses.science: भयभीत होकर दसों दिशाओंमें भाग गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकालोकस्ततः शैलः सहस्राण्यचलो हि सः । उच्छ्रयेण हि तावन्ति योजनायुतविस्तृतः
verses.transliteration: lokālokastataḥ śailaḥ sahasrāṇyacalo hi saḥ | ucchrayeṇa hi tāvanti yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing all these sounds, one shall practise Tumkara? Meditating thus for ever the Yogin is not affected by either virtue or sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing all these sounds, one shall practise Tumkara? Meditating thus for ever the Yogin is not affected by either virtue or sins.
verses.science: प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमश्चाण्डकटाहेन सेयमुर्वी महामुने । पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तारा सद्वीपा समहीधरा
verses.transliteration: tamaścāṇḍakaṭāhena seyamurvī mahāmune | pañcāśatkoṭivistārā sadvīpā samahīdharā
verses.translation: O goddess, what others do not hear the Yogin hears
verses.hindi: पार्वतीके अंशसे उत्पन्न सरस्वती कही गयी हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, what others do not hear the Yogin hears
verses.science: पार्वतीके अंशसे उत्पन्न सरस्वती कही गयी हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारभूता सर्वेषां सर्वभूतगुणाधिका । सेयं धात्री च कालेय सर्वेषां जगतामिला
verses.transliteration: ādhārabhūtā sarveṣāṃ sarvabhūtaguṇādhikā | seyaṃ dhātrī ca kāleya sarveṣāṃ jagatāmilā
verses.translation: From him the sound of conquest of death rises up in seven days. O goddess, it is of nine varieties. I shall mention it factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him the sound of conquest of death rises up in seven days. O goddess, it is of nine varieties. I shall mention it factually.
verses.science: सरस्वती प्रादुर्भाववर्णन॑ नामाष्टचत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O pretty lady, is there anything impossible for one who meditates with single-minded devotion the Tumk&ra form of Brahman? He becomes omniscient and visualiser of all. He moves about assuming any form he wishes. He is not affected by aberrations. He is Siva himself. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: न शेकुस्ते यदा ज्ञातुं तदेन्द्र: स्ववमभ्यगात्॥ १८  उसके पास गये
verses.wordMeaning: O pretty lady, is there anything impossible for one who meditates with single-minded devotion the Tumk&ra form of Brahman? He becomes omniscient and visualiser of all. He moves about assuming any form he wishes. He is not affected by aberrations. He is Siva himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O pretty lady, is there anything impossible for one who meditates with single-minded devotion the Tumk&ra form of Brahman? He becomes omniscient and visualiser of all. He moves about assuming any form he wishes. He is not affected by aberrations. He is Siva himself.…
verses.science: न शेकुस्ते यदा ज्ञातुं तदेन्द्र: स्ववमभ्यगात्॥ १८ उसके पास गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O pretty lady, is there anything impossible for one who meditates with single-minded devotion the Tumk&ra form of Brahman? He becomes omniscient and visualiser of all. He moves about assuming any form he wishes. He is not affected by aberrations. He is Siva himself. There is no doubt in this.
verses.wordMeaning: O pretty lady, is there anything impossible for one who meditates with single-minded devotion the Tumk&ra form of Brahman? He becomes omniscient and visualiser of all. He moves about assuming any form he wishes. He is not affected by aberrations. He is Siva himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O pretty lady, is there anything impossible for one who meditates with single-minded devotion the Tumk&ra form of Brahman? He becomes omniscient and visualiser of all. He moves about assuming any form he wishes. He is not affected by aberrations. He is Siva himself.…
verses.science: परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणी महामायाने कहा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१९. एकोनविशोऽध्यायः । लोकवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । रविचन्द्रमसोर्यावन्मयूखा भासयन्ति हि । तावत्प्रमाणा पृथिवी भूलोकः स तु गीयते
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.19. ekonaviśo'dhyāyaḥ | lokavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | ravicandramasoryāvanmayūkhā bhāsayanti hi | tāvatpramāṇā pṛthivī bhūlokaḥ sa tu gīyate
verses.translation: O goddess, thus the form of Sabdabrahman with its nine aspects has been wholly narrated to you. What else do yuu wish to hear?
verses.hindi: मदग्रे गर्वितुं किंचित्का कथान्यसुपर्वणाम्॥ २७ देवताओंकी तो बात ही क्‍या है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, thus the form of Sabdabrahman with its nine aspects has been wholly narrated to you. What else do yuu wish to hear?
verses.science: मदग्रे गर्वितुं किंचित्का कथान्यसुपर्वणाम्॥ २७ देवताओंकी तो बात ही क्‍या है ?। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूमेर्योजनलक्षे तु संस्थितं रविमण्डलम् । योजनानां सहस्राणि सदैव परिसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: bhūmeryojanalakṣe tu saṃsthitaṃ ravimaṇḍalam | yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sadaiva parisaṅkhyayā
verses.translation: O g<iddess, by a single retention of vital airs, a brahmin attains the benefit accruing to him by the penance
verses.hindi: करें, अन्यथा सभी लोक अवश्य नष्ट हो जायँगे
verses.commentary: Sense: O g<iddess, by a single retention of vital airs, a brahmin attains the benefit accruing to him by the penance
verses.science: करें, अन्यथा सभी लोक अवश्य नष्ट हो जायँगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शशिनस्तु प्रमाणाय जगतः परिचक्षते । रवेरूर्ध्वं शशी तस्थौ लक्षयोजनसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: śaśinastu pramāṇāya jagataḥ paricakṣate | raverūrdhvaṃ śaśī tasthau lakṣayojanasaṅkhyayā
verses.translation: They do not sec even when they gaze at it; even while listening they are no better than deaf. Deluded by sins they are like blind men in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: They do not sec even when they gaze at it; even while listening they are no better than deaf. Deluded by sins they are like blind men in the world.
verses.science: शस्त्रयुक्त हो प्रकट हो गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहाणां मण्डलं कृत्स्नं विधोरुपरि संस्थितम् । सनक्षत्रं सहस्राणि दशैव परितोपरि
verses.transliteration: grahāṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vidhorupari saṃsthitam | sanakṣatraṃ sahasrāṇi daśaiva paritopari
verses.translation: The tip of the tongue touches the tip»of the uvula. The hands are clasped in the form of a white lotus. Drawn by him the nectar falls drop by drop. When he attains the great region he delights even the deities. This is the essential substance enabling one to cross the ocean of worldly existence, surmount all sins, cross the Kala along with the star. He by whom the limbs have been drenched with the nectar never dies. He is devoid of hunger and thirst.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे पतञ्चम्याग॒मासंहितायां शवाक्ष्याहवतारवर्णन॑ नाम पद्चाशत्तमो5 ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: The tip of the tongue touches the tip»of the uvula. The hands are clasped in the form of a white lotus. Drawn by him the nectar falls drop by drop. When he attains the great region he delights even the deities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The tip of the tongue touches the tip»of the uvula. The hands are clasped in the form of a white lotus. Drawn by him the nectar falls drop by drop. When he attains the great region he delights even the deities.…
verses.science: जति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे पतञ्चम्याग॒मासंहितायां शवाक्ष्याहवतारवर्णन॑ नाम पद्चाशत्तमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: बुधस्तस्मादथो काव्यस्तस्माद्भौमस्य मण्डलम् । बृहस्पतिस्तदूर्ध्वं तु तस्योपरि शनैश्चरः
verses.transliteration: budhastasmādatho kāvyastasmādbhaumasya maṇḍalam | bṛhaspatistadūrdhvaṃ tu tasyopari śanaiścaraḥ
verses.translation: If he can see the shadow in the sky in a white- coloured form and begins to meditate on Siva, the great cause with single-minded attention, he attains Brahman then. This has been mentioned by the experts. In this state he is rid of Brahminicide and other sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he can see the shadow in the sky in a white- coloured form and begins to meditate on Siva, the great cause with single-minded attention, he attains Brahman then. This has been mentioned by the experts. In this state he is rid of Brahminicide and other sins.
verses.science: प्रतिष्ठा करनेसे होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षिमण्डलं तस्माल्लक्षेणैकेन संस्थितम् । ऋषिभ्यस्तु सहस्राणां शतादूर्ध्वं ध्रुवः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ tasmāllakṣeṇaikena saṃsthitam | ṛṣibhyastu sahasrāṇāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ dhruvaḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: If he finds the shadow-person headless, the entire power of oral expression of practising Yogin becomes elimi¬ nated within six months.
verses.hindi: उसके पुण्यकी गणना नहीं की जा सकती है
verses.commentary: Sense: If he finds the shadow-person headless, the entire power of oral expression of practising Yogin becomes elimi¬ nated within six months.
verses.science: उसके पुण्यकी गणना नहीं की जा सकती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मेढीभूतः स यस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य वै ध्रुवः । भूर्भुवः स्वरिति ज्ञेयं भुव ऊर्ध्वं ध्रुवादवाक्
verses.transliteration: meḍhībhūtaḥ sa yastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ | bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti jñeyaṃ bhuva ūrdhvaṃ dhruvādavāk
verses.translation: (Practising still further and) seeing the shadow- person perfectly and keeping it within the Atman through the Atman, O goddess, the aspirant shall repeat the nine- syllabled Mantra in the heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Practising still further and) seeing the shadow- person perfectly and keeping it within the Atman through the Atman, O goddess, the aspirant shall repeat the nine- syllabled Mantra in the heart.
verses.science: परमलोकको प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकयोजनकोटिस्तु यत्र ते कल्पवासिनः । ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं महर्लोकः सप्तैते ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: ekayojanakoṭistu yatra te kalpavāsinaḥ | dhruvādūrdhvaṃ maharlokaḥ saptaite brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: If a year passes by there will be nothing that the repeater of the mantra cannot achieve. He attains the eight Siddhis, Anima and others and the ability to walk through the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a year passes by there will be nothing that the repeater of the mantra cannot achieve. He attains the eight Siddhis, Anima and others and the ability to walk through the sky.
verses.science: सी वस्तु दुर्लभ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनकश्च सनन्दश्च तृतीयश्च सनातनः । कपिलश्चासुरिश्चैव वोढुः पञ्चशिखस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ | kapilaścāsuriścaiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā
verses.translation: An unknowable figure in the form of a curling
verses.commentary: Sense: An unknowable figure in the form of a curling
verses.science: तो देवीके साक्षात् गण हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टात्ततः शुक्रो द्विलक्षाभ्यन्तरे स्थितः । द्विलक्षयोजनं तस्मादधः सोमसुतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭāttataḥ śukro dvilakṣābhyantare sthitaḥ | dvilakṣayojanaṃ tasmādadhaḥ somasutaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: A Yogin attains the region of wind arising from the Yogic Ether. O lord, if you are delighted let me hear from you.
verses.hindi: जगत॒को मोहनेवाली (महामाया) भी मैं ही हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: A Yogin attains the region of wind arising from the Yogic Ether. O lord, if you are delighted let me hear from you.
verses.science: जगत॒को मोहनेवाली (महामाया) भी मैं ही हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विलक्षयोजनं तस्मादूर्ध्वं भौमः स्थितो मुने । द्विलक्षयोजनं तस्मादूर्ध्वं जीवः स्थितो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: dvilakṣayojanaṃ tasmādūrdhvaṃ bhaumaḥ sthito mune | dvilakṣayojanaṃ tasmādūrdhvaṃ jīvaḥ sthito guruḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, desirous of the welfare of Yogins I had explained everything as to how wind became a symbol for the Yogins desirous of conquering Kala.
verses.hindi: व्यर्थ ही अपनेको सर्वेश समझते हो
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, desirous of the welfare of Yogins I had explained everything as to how wind became a symbol for the Yogins desirous of conquering Kala.
verses.science: व्यर्थ ही अपनेको सर्वेश समझते हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विलक्षयोजनं जीवादूर्ध्वं सौरिर्व्यवस्थितः । एते सप्त ग्रहाः प्रोक्ताः स्व स्व राशौ व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: dvilakṣayojanaṃ jīvādūrdhvaṃ saurirvyavasthitaḥ | ete sapta grahāḥ proktāḥ sva sva rāśau vyavasthitā
verses.translation: Knowing the day through that, the Yogin stays engaged in Pranayama. O pretty woman, within half a month he conquers the Kala that has already come upon him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing the day through that, the Yogin stays engaged in Pranayama. O pretty woman, within half a month he conquers the Kala that has already come upon him.
verses.science: मुझ सनातनी प्रकृतिकी आराधना करो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलक्षैर्योजनतः सप्तोर्ध्वमृषयः स्थिताः । विश्वलक्षैर्योजनतो ध्रुवस्थितिरुदाहृता
verses.transliteration: rudralakṣairyojanataḥ saptordhvamṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ | viśvalakṣairyojanato dhruvasthitirudāhṛtā
verses.translation: The wind within the heart kindles the fire. It is favourable to the fire. It blows within and without. It is all pervasive. It is great and it spreads everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind within the heart kindles the fire. It is favourable to the fire. It blows within and without. It is all pervasive. It is great and it spreads everywhere.
verses.science: हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्गुणोत्तरे चार्धे जनलोकात्तपः स्मृतम् । वैराजा यत्र देवा वै स्थिता दाहविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: caturguṇottare cārdhe janalokāttapaḥ smṛtam | vairājā yatra devā vai sthitā dāhavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: Knowledge, perfect knowledge, zeal, everything is activised by wind. He who has conquered it has conquered the universe.
verses.hindi: यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण परम॑ पदमश्नुते॥ ४३  परमपद प्राप्त होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowledge, perfect knowledge, zeal, everything is activised by wind. He who has conquered it has conquered the universe.
verses.science: यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण परम॑ पदमश्नुते॥ ४३ परमपद प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षड्गुणेन तपोलोकात्सत्यलोको व्यवस्थितः । ब्रह्मलोकः स विज्ञेयो वसन्त्यमलचेतसः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍguṇena tapolokātsatyaloko vyavasthitaḥ | brahmalokaḥ sa vijñeyo vasantyamalacetasaḥ
verses.translation: With a desire to prevent old age and death, the Yogin engaged in the practice of Yoga, meditation and retention shall stay in the state of Dharana.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a desire to prevent old age and death, the Yogin engaged in the practice of Yoga, meditation and retention shall stay in the state of Dharana.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे पश्चम्याग॒मासंहितायामुमाप्रादुर्भाववर्णन॑ नामेकोनपज्ञाशत्तमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यधर्मरताश्चैव ज्ञानिनो ब्रह्मचारिणः । यद्गामिनोऽथ भूलोकान्निवसन्ति हि मानवाः
verses.transliteration: satyadharmaratāścaiva jñānino brahmacāriṇaḥ | yadgāmino'tha bhūlokānnivasanti hi mānavāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, the blacksmith blows air into the bellows and does his job by means of the wind. The -Yogin shall also practise similarly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the blacksmith blows air into the bellows and does his job by means of the wind. The -Yogin shall also practise similarly.
verses.science: नामक उनचासवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: भुवर्लोके तु संसिद्धा मुनयो देवरूपिणः । स्वर्गलोके सुरादित्या मरुतो वसवोऽश्विनौ
verses.transliteration: bhuvarloke tu saṃsiddhā munayo devarūpiṇaḥ | svargaloke surādityā maruto vasavo'śvinau
verses.translation: The lord of thousands, the lord of thousand eyes, hands and feet encompasses the universe and stands ten Ahgulas above.2*®
verses.hindi: होता था, उससे पृथ्वीपर सौ वर्षकी अनावृष्टि हुई
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of thousands, the lord of thousand eyes, hands and feet encompasses the universe and stands ten Ahgulas above.2*®
verses.science: होता था, उससे पृथ्वीपर सौ वर्षकी अनावृष्टि हुई। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवास्तथा रुद्राः साध्या नागाः खगादयः । नवग्रहास्ततस्तत्र ऋषयो वीतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration: viśvedevāstathā rudrāḥ sādhyā nāgāḥ khagādayaḥ | navagrahāstatastatra ṛṣayo vītakalmaṣāḥ
verses.translation: Holding the breath one shall repeat the Gayatri Mantra along with his Siras (Oih) and Vyahrtis thrice. That is called Pranayama.
verses.hindi: हो गये और वृक्ष तथा लताएँ सूख गयीं
verses.commentary: Sense: Holding the breath one shall repeat the Gayatri Mantra along with his Siras (Oih) and Vyahrtis thrice. That is called Pranayama.
verses.science: हो गये और वृक्ष तथा लताएँ सूख गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त महालोकाः कालेय कथितास्तव । पातालानि च सप्तैव ब्रह्माण्डस्य च विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mahālokāḥ kāleya kathitāstava | pātālāni ca saptaiva brahmāṇḍasya ca vistaraḥ
verses.translation: Planets like the sun and the moon are evolved and dissolved. Bm (hose who are devoted to Yoga and meditation do not return still.
verses.hindi: देखकर देवता योगमाया महेश्वरीके शरणमें गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Planets like the sun and the moon are evolved and dissolved. Bm (hose who are devoted to Yoga and meditation do not return still.
verses.science: देखकर देवता योगमाया महेश्वरीके शरणमें गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दधिवृक्षफलं यद्वद् वृत्तिश्चोर्ध्वमधस्तथा । एतदण्डकटाहेन सर्वतो वै समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: dadhivṛkṣaphalaṃ yadvad vṛttiścordhvamadhastathā | etadaṇḍakaṭāhena sarvato vai samāvṛtam
verses.translation: The brahmin who gets up at daybreak and performs a Pranayama quells his sins and goes to firahma's region.
verses.hindi: माताके अतिरिक्त लोकमें उसे कौन सह सकता है ।
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmin who gets up at daybreak and performs a Pranayama quells his sins and goes to firahma's region.
verses.science: माताके अतिरिक्त लोकमें उसे कौन सह सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशगुणेन पयसा सर्वतस्तत्समावृतम् । वह्निना वायुना चापि नभसा तमसा तथा
verses.transliteration: daśaguṇena payasā sarvatastatsamāvṛtam | vahninā vāyunā cāpi nabhasā tamasā tathā
verses.translation: He can assume the form of a Siddha. He gets lustre, intelligence, exploits, valour, happiness and the speed of the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: He can assume the form of a Siddha. He gets lustre, intelligence, exploits, valour, happiness and the speed of the wind.
verses.science: लोगोंको सुखी बनाया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूतादिनापि महता दिग्गुणोत्तरवेष्टितः । महान्तं च समावृत्य प्रधानं पुरुषः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: bhūtādināpi mahatā digguṇottaraveṣṭitaḥ | mahāntaṃ ca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, I have thus narrated the Siddhi through the wind that the Yogin attains from fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, I have thus narrated the Siddhi through the wind that the Yogin attains from fire.
verses.science: फल-मूल धारण की हुई थीं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तस्य न तस्यास्ति सङ्ख्यापि परमात्मनः । तेनानन्त इति ख्यातः प्रमाणं नास्ति वै यतः
verses.transliteration: anantasya na tasyāsti saṅkhyāpi paramātmanaḥ | tenānanta iti khyātaḥ pramāṇaṃ nāsti vai yataḥ
verses.translation: The aspirant sits in the comfortable posture in a place free from noise. In the middle place he illuminates the brilliance accompanied by the lustre of the moon and the sun.
verses.hindi: तथा समस्त औषधियाँ तृप्त हो गयीं
verses.commentary: Sense: The aspirant sits in the comfortable posture in a place free from noise. In the middle place he illuminates the brilliance accompanied by the lustre of the moon and the sun.
verses.science: तथा समस्त औषधियाँ तृप्त हो गयीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हेतुभूतः समस्तस्य प्रकृतिः सा परा मुने । अण्डानां तु सहस्राणां सहस्राण्ययुतानि च
verses.transliteration: hetubhūtaḥ samastasya prakṛtiḥ sā parā mune | aṇḍānāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca
verses.translation: The 'Yogin who illuminates the fire existing between the eyebrows, alertfully can see in darkness with¬ out lamps to be sure.
verses.hindi: और पृथ्वीतलपर शाक तथा फल-मूल उगने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: The 'Yogin who illuminates the fire existing between the eyebrows, alertfully can see in darkness with¬ out lamps to be sure.
verses.science: और पृथ्वीतलपर शाक तथा फल-मूल उगने लगे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशानां प्रभूतानि तस्मादव्यक्तजन्मनः । दारुण्यग्निस्तिले तैलं पयःसु च यथा घृतम्
verses.transliteration: īdṛśānāṃ prabhūtāni tasmādavyaktajanmanaḥ | dāruṇyagnistile tailaṃ payaḥsu ca yathā ghṛtam
verses.translation: The Yogin presses the eyes with the fingers a little and strives to sec the star and meditate on it for a muhurta or half that time with concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogin presses the eyes with the fingers a little and strives to sec the star and meditate on it for a muhurta or half that time with concentration.
verses.science: भोज्य वस्तुओंको प्रस्तुत किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथासौ परमात्मा वै सर्वं व्याप्यात्मवेदनः । आदिबीजात्प्रसुवते ततस्तेभ्यः परेऽण्डजाः
verses.transliteration: tathāsau paramātmā vai sarvaṃ vyāpyātmavedanaḥ | ādibījātprasuvate tatastebhyaḥ pare'ṇḍajāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter while meditating in darkness he sees the bright lustre of Siva in colours white, red, yellow, black and the rainbow colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter while meditating in darkness he sees the bright lustre of Siva in colours white, red, yellow, black and the rainbow colour.
verses.science: आपलोगोंका कौन-सा कार्य करूँ ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यः पुत्रास्तथान्येषां बीजान्यन्यानि वै ततः । महदादियोविशेषान्तास्तद्भवन्ति सुरादयः
verses.transliteration: tebhyaḥ putrāstathānyeṣāṃ bījānyanyāni vai tataḥ | mahadādiyoviśeṣāntāstadbhavanti surādayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that brilliance on a par with the rising sun stationed in the forehead between the eyebrows, the Yogin can assume any form of body he chooses and plays about as he wishes.
verses.hindi: हरण किये गये वेदोंको हमें उपलब्ध कराइये
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that brilliance on a par with the rising sun stationed in the forehead between the eyebrows, the Yogin can assume any form of body he chooses and plays about as he wishes.
verses.science: हरण किये गये वेदोंको हमें उपलब्ध कराइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बीजाद् वृक्षप्ररोहेण यथा नापचयस्तरोः । सूर्यकान्तमणेः सूर्याद्यद्वद्वह्निः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: bījād vṛkṣapraroheṇa yathā nāpacayastaroḥ | sūryakāntamaṇeḥ sūryādyadvadvahniḥ prajāyate
verses.translation: B> rqseated practice the Yogin gains various powers—subduing the senses, entry into other bodies, the attainment of eight Siddhis Apima and others, mental vision, hearing from far, perfect knowledge, invisibility assuming multiibrms, and the ability to walk through the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: B> rqseated practice the Yogin gains various powers—subduing the senses, entry into other bodies, the attainment of eight Siddhis Apima and others, mental vision, hearing from far, perfect knowledge, invisibility assuming multiibrms, and the ability to walk through the sky.
verses.science: ही आपलोगोंको वेद प्रदान करूँगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत्सञ्जायते सृष्टिः शिवस्तत्रः न कामयेत् । शिवशक्तिसमायोगे देवाद्याः प्रभवन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: tadvatsañjāyate sṛṣṭiḥ śivastatraḥ na kāmayet | śivaśaktisamāyoge devādyāḥ prabhavanti hi
verses.translation: Persons endowed with Vcdic studies, eiqierts in different Sfistras and the perfectly wise too become deluded when subservient to the force of the previous Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons endowed with Vcdic studies, eiqierts in different Sfistras and the perfectly wise too become deluded when subservient to the force of the previous Karmans.
verses.science: पुरीकों घेर लिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा स्वकर्मणैकेन प्ररोहमुपयान्ति वै । ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्राश्च स शिवः परिगीयते
verses.transliteration: tathā svakarmaṇaikena prarohamupayānti vai | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudrāśca sa śivaḥ parigīyate
verses.translation: I know the great Purusa of the colour of the sun beyond all darkness. By knowing him alone can one sur¬ mount death. There is no other path to go.***
verses.commentary: Sense: I know the great Purusa of the colour of the sun beyond all darkness. By knowing him alone can one sur¬ mount death. There is no other path to go.***
verses.science: समान पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादुद्धरते सर्वं यस्मिंश्च लयमेष्यति । कर्ता क्रियाणां सर्वासां स शिवः परिगीयते
verses.transliteration: tasmāduddharate sarvaṃ yasmiṃśca layameṣyati | kartā kriyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ sa śivaḥ parigīyate
verses.translation: Thus the excellent mode of Yoga of the fire has been explained to you, how the Yogin conquers death and attains immoriality.
verses.hindi: है। आप विश्वमाताको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the excellent mode of Yoga of the fire has been explained to you, how the Yogin conquers death and attains immoriality.
verses.science: है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
