verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ छिन्धि मे संशयं महत् । सन्ति लोका हि ब्रह्माण्डादुपरिष्टान्न वा मुने
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca | sanatkumāra sarvajña chindhi me saṃśayaṃ mahat | santi lokā hi brahmāṇḍādupariṣṭānna vā mune
verses.translation: shall now explain a greater method of Yogic practice to ward off death. O goddess, listen with attention and concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: shall now explain a greater method of Yogic practice to ward off death. O goddess, listen with attention and concentration.
verses.science: नहीं कर सकते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । ब्रह्माण्डादुपरिष्टाच्च सन्ति लोका मुनीश्वर । तान् शृणु त्वं विशेषेण वच्मि तेऽहं समागतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | brahmāṇḍādupariṣṭācca santi lokā munīśvara | tān śṛṇu tvaṃ viśeṣeṇa vacmi te'haṃ samāgataḥ
verses.translation: This Yogin, O goddess, forms the fourth one, the other three being the Bhutas, the Yogins and the meditators. This devotee practising the fourth method sits in a comfortable posture in a convenient spot with pure mind. He keeps his body straight. His hands are clasped together cuplike. He shapes the mouth like a beak and drinks in the wind slowly. The water-drops clinging to his palate begin to exude. They are life-givers. He inhales them through the wind. Drinking this nectarine cool water daily he will never be subservient to death. He gels a divine body and great brilliance. He becomes free from hunger and thirst.
verses.wordMeaning: This Yogin, O goddess, forms the fourth one, the other three being the Bhutas, the Yogins and the meditators. This devotee practising the fourth method sits in a comfortable posture in a convenient spot with pure mind. He keeps his body straight.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Yogin, O goddess, forms the fourth one, the other three being the Bhutas, the Yogins and the meditators. This devotee practising the fourth method sits in a comfortable posture in a convenient spot with pure mind. He keeps his body straight.…
verses.science: शत्रुओंका नाश हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विधिलोकात्परो लोको वैकुण्ठ इति विश्रुतः । विराजते महादीप्त्या यत्र विष्णुः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: vidhilokātparo loko vaikuṇṭha iti viśrutaḥ | virājate mahādīptyā yatra viṣṇuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: In strength he becomes equal to an elephant; in speed he vies with a horse; he has the keen sight of Garuda; he can hear from a distance. He has dark curly ringlets of hair. His complexion is as fair as that of Gandharvas and Vidyadharas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In strength he becomes equal to an elephant; in speed he vies with a horse; he has the keen sight of Garuda; he can hear from a distance. He has dark curly ringlets of hair. His complexion is as fair as that of Gandharvas and Vidyadharas.
verses.science: व्यग्र होकर दौड़ पड़ती हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपरिष्टात्कौमारो लोको हि परमाद्भुतः । सेनानीः शम्भुतनयो राजते यत्र सुप्रभः
verses.transliteration: tasyopariṣṭātkaumāro loko hi paramādbhutaḥ | senānīḥ śambhutanayo rājate yatra suprabhaḥ
verses.translation: He lives for a hundred years by the calculation of the time of gods. He attains equality with Bfhaspati. By practising this Yoga he can traverse in the sky or any where he likes. He can always remain happy.
verses.hindi: प्राणोंको भी न्‍्योछावर कर सकती हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: He lives for a hundred years by the calculation of the time of gods. He attains equality with Bfhaspati. By practising this Yoga he can traverse in the sky or any where he likes. He can always remain happy.
verses.science: प्राणोंको भी न्‍्योछावर कर सकती हूँ। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः परमुमालोको महादिव्यो विराजते । यत्र शक्तिर्विभात्येका त्रिदेवजननी शिवा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paramumāloko mahādivyo virājate | yatra śaktirvibhātyekā tridevajananī śivā
verses.translation: O fair lady, I shall now explain another mode which is strenuously guarded even by gods. Please listen to it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fair lady, I shall now explain another mode which is strenuously guarded even by gods. Please listen to it.
verses.science: ' भीमादेवी '--यह नाम विख्यात होगा। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: परात्परा हि प्रकृती रजःसत्त्वतमोमयी । निर्गुणा च स्वयं देवी निर्विकारा शिवात्मिका
verses.transliteration: parātparā hi prakṛtī rajaḥsattvatamomayī | nirguṇā ca svayaṃ devī nirvikārā śivātmikā
verses.translation: The Yogin shall practise curving the tongue to¬ wards the palate. After sometime he can carry it to the uvula.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogin shall practise curving the tongue to¬ wards the palate. After sometime he can carry it to the uvula.
verses.science: निस्सन्देह कल्याण करूँगी। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपरिष्टाद्विज्ञेयः शिवलोकः सनातनः । अविनाशी महादिव्यो महाशोभान्वितः सदा
verses.transliteration: tasyopariṣṭādvijñeyaḥ śivalokaḥ sanātanaḥ | avināśī mahādivyo mahāśobhānvitaḥ sadā
verses.hindi: एक ही सत्ताका प्रतिपादन होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Cp VS. 31. 18.
verses.science: एक ही सत्ताका प्रतिपादन होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विराजते परं ब्रह्म यत्र शम्भुर्महेश्वरः । त्रिदेवजनकः स्वामी सर्वेषां त्रिगुणात्परः
verses.transliteration: virājate paraṃ brahma yatra śambhurmaheśvaraḥ | tridevajanakaḥ svāmī sarveṣāṃ triguṇātparaḥ
verses.translation: When touched it begins to exude cool nectar. By drinking in this the Yogin attains immortality.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वारुदत्मृजास्तप्ता या नवाहं महेश्वरी॥ ५२  नौ दिनोंतक रुदन किया
verses.commentary: Sense: When touched it begins to exude cool nectar. By drinking in this the Yogin attains immortality.
verses.science: दृष्ट्वारुदत्मृजास्तप्ता या नवाहं महेश्वरी॥ ५२ नौ दिनोंतक रुदन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत ऊर्ध्वं न लोकाश्च गोलोकस्तत्समीपतः । गोमातरः सुशीलाख्यास्तत्र सन्ति शिवप्रिया
verses.transliteration: tata ūrdhvaṃ na lokāśca golokastatsamīpataḥ | gomātaraḥ suśīlākhyāstatra santi śivapriyā
verses.translation: O daughter of the mountain, the earth possessing these four types of Yogins can bestow happiness on the entire universe. What a man creates in dream the Yogin is competent to create in heaven. This is only a part of what the four can do.
verses.commentary: Sense: O daughter of the mountain, the earth possessing these four types of Yogins can bestow happiness on the entire universe. What a man creates in dream the Yogin is competent to create in heaven. This is only a part of what the four can do.
verses.science: नामक पचासवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पालः कृष्णनामा हि राजते शङ्कराज्ञया । प्रतिष्ठितः शिवेनैव शक्त्या स्वच्छन्दचारिणा
verses.transliteration: tatpālaḥ kṛṣṇanāmā hi rājate śaṅkarājñayā | pratiṣṭhitaḥ śivenaiva śaktyā svacchandacāriṇā
verses.translation: Hence the earth united with mantras, penances, Vratas, restraints, medicinal herbs and Yogic practice becomes lovable to men endowed with humility, polity and sacred virtues. The primordial lord of all living beings does not become shaken when associating with the four Yogins. I shall now explain in accordance with the injunctions the Chayapurusa (the shadowy person) who is called iSiva.
verses.hindi: प्रोक्त सनत्कुमारेण व्यासाय च महात्मने॥ २  कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the earth united with mantras, penances, Vratas, restraints, medicinal herbs and Yogic practice becomes lovable to men endowed with humility, polity and sacred virtues. The primordial lord of all living beings does not become shaken when associating with the four Yogins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the earth united with mantras, penances, Vratas, restraints, medicinal herbs and Yogic practice becomes lovable to men endowed with humility, polity and sacred virtues. The primordial lord of all living beings does not become shaken when associating with the four Yogins.…
verses.science: प्रोक्त सनत्कुमारेण व्यासाय च महात्मने॥ २ कहा था। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवलोकोऽद्भुतो व्यास निराधारो मनोहरः । तथानिर्वचनीयश्च नानावस्तुविराजितः
verses.transliteration: śivaloko'dbhuto vyāsa nirādhāro manoharaḥ | tathānirvacanīyaśca nānāvastuvirājitaḥ
verses.translation: O great lord of the gods, the way of dodging K&la has been narrated; the form of l§abdabrahman and the excellent characteristics of Yoga have been mentioned. The reference to the shadow-person has been made by you in brief. Please explain in detail with a desire for the welfare of Yogins.
verses.hindi: पराशक्तेः पर गुप्तं रहस्यं श्रृणुतादरात्॥ ३  गुप्त रहस्यको आपलोग आदरपूर्वक सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: O great lord of the gods, the way of dodging K&la has been narrated; the form of l§abdabrahman and the excellent characteristics of Yoga have been mentioned. The reference to the shadow-person has been made by you in brief.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O great lord of the gods, the way of dodging K&la has been narrated; the form of l§abdabrahman and the excellent characteristics of Yoga have been mentioned. The reference to the shadow-person has been made by you in brief.…
verses.science: पराशक्तेः पर गुप्तं रहस्यं श्रृणुतादरात्॥ ३ गुप्त रहस्यको आपलोग आदरपूर्वक सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्तु तदधिष्ठाता सर्वदेवशिरोमणिः । विष्णुब्रह्महरैः सेव्यः परमात्मा निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: śivastu tadadhiṣṭhātā sarvadevaśiromaṇiḥ | viṣṇubrahmaharaiḥ sevyaḥ paramātmā nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, listen. I shall explain the characteri¬ stics of the Chayapurusa, on knowing which man becomes released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, listen. I shall explain the characteri¬ stics of the Chayapurusa, on knowing which man becomes released from all sins.
verses.science: मोक्षको देनेवाले कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथिता तात सर्वब्रह्माण्डसंस्थितिः । तदूर्ध्वं लोकसंस्थानं किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitā tāta sarvabrahmāṇḍasaṃsthitiḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ lokasaṃsthānaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi
verses.translation: The aspirant wears garlands and white cloth. He makes himself fragrant white scents, incense and other things. O fair lady, he then sits with his back to the sun or the moon remembering the great mantra that bestows the bene¬ fits of all desires and that consists of the nine units solidified into one. He then glances at his own shadow.
verses.wordMeaning: The aspirant wears garlands and white cloth. He makes himself fragrant white scents, incense and other things. O fair lady,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The aspirant wears garlands and white cloth. He makes himself fragrant white scents, incense and other things. O fair lady,…
verses.science: मणिद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this. I mention the truth to you. The man attains the fruit derivable from all sacrifices, O goddess, as well as the benefit of making chari¬ table gifts and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all the holy centres. O goddess, of what avail is speaking much? He attains all cherished desires.
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this. I mention the truth to you. The man attains the fruit derivable from all sacrifices, O goddess, as well as the benefit of making chari¬ table gifts and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all the holy centres. O goddess,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this. I mention the truth to you. The man attains the fruit derivable from all sacrifices, O goddess, as well as the benefit of making chari¬ table gifts and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all the holy centres. O goddess,…
verses.science: शिवाके साक्षात् गण हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this. I mention the truth to you. The man attains the fruit derivable from all sacrifices, O goddess, as well as the benefit of making chari¬ table gifts and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all the holy centres. O goddess, of what avail is speaking much? He attains all cherished desires.
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this. I mention the truth to you. The man attains the fruit derivable from all sacrifices, O goddess, as well as the benefit of making chari¬ table gifts and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all the holy centres. O goddess,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this. I mention the truth to you. The man attains the fruit derivable from all sacrifices, O goddess, as well as the benefit of making chari¬ table gifts and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all the holy centres. O goddess,…
verses.science: उमालोक प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । मनुविशेषकथनम् । व्यास उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ तत्प्राप्तिं वद सत्तम । यद् गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते शिवभक्तियुता नराः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.20. viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | manuviśeṣakathanam | vyāsa uvāca | sanatkumāra sarvajña tatprāptiṃ vada sattama | yad gatvā na nivartante śivabhaktiyutā narāḥ
verses.translation: Hence a sensible person shall cultivate this know¬ ledge as well as Yoga. Siddhi is attained by practice. Yoga is enhanced by practice.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, वे उमालोक प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence a sensible person shall cultivate this know¬ ledge as well as Yoga. Siddhi is attained by practice. Yoga is enhanced by practice.
verses.science: करते हैं, वे उमालोक प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । पराशरसुत व्यास शृणु प्रीत्या शुभां गतिम् । व्रतं हि शुद्धभक्तानां तथा शुद्धं तपस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | parāśarasuta vyāsa śṛṇu prītyā śubhāṃ gatim | vrataṃ hi śuddhabhaktānāṃ tathā śuddhaṃ tapasvinām
verses.translation: O sage, listen to the divine story that destroys all sins; the variegated story that is being described by me; the story full of meaning and well known details.
verses.hindi: नियमेन शिवा तस्मै सर्वमिष्टं प्रयच्छति॥ ५८  अभ्ीष्ट फल प्रदान करती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, listen to the divine story that destroys all sins; the variegated story that is being described by me; the story full of meaning and well known details.
verses.science: नियमेन शिवा तस्मै सर्वमिष्टं प्रयच्छति॥ ५८ अभ्ीष्ट फल प्रदान करती हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ये शिवं शुद्धकर्माणः सुशुद्धतपसान्विताः । समर्चयन्ति तं नित्यं वन्द्यास्ते सर्वथान्वहम्
verses.transliteration: ye śivaṃ śuddhakarmāṇaḥ suśuddhatapasānvitāḥ | samarcayanti taṃ nityaṃ vandyāste sarvathānvaham
verses.translation: The excessively brilliant creator created seven mental sons, the sages, Marici, Atri, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and Vasistha.®
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively brilliant creator created seven mental sons, the sages, Marici, Atri, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and Vasistha.®
verses.science: नामैकपशञ्चाशत्तमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नातप्ततपसो यान्ति शिवलोकमनामयम् । शिवानुग्रहसद्धेतुस्तप एव महामुने
verses.transliteration: nātaptatapaso yānti śivalokamanāmayam | śivānugrahasaddhetustapa eva mahāmune
verses.translation: Manu 1. 23.
verses.hindi: लोग मणिद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.explanation: लोग मणिद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: लोग मणिद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसा दिवि मोदन्ते प्रत्यक्षं देवतागणाः । ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव सत्यं जानीह मद्वचः
verses.transliteration: tapasā divi modante pratyakṣaṃ devatāgaṇāḥ | ṛṣayo munayaścaiva satyaṃ jānīha madvacaḥ
verses.translation: The intelligent Satarupa bore the Vairaja Purusa two sons Priyavrata and Uttanapada of heroic prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent Satarupa bore the Vairaja Purusa two sons Priyavrata and Uttanapada of heroic prowess.
verses.science: गणना कौन कर सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुदुर्द्धरं दुराराध्यं सुदूरं दुरतिक्रमम् । तत्सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: sudurddharaṃ durārādhyaṃ sudūraṃ duratikramam | tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam
verses.translation: Caksusa Manu begot Varuna of Puskarini. O excellent sage, from Manu of great prowess, in Nadala the daughter of the patriarch Vaisyajanma (?) were born ten sons viz Puru, Masa, Satadyurona, Tapasvin, Satyavit, Kavi, Agnistoma, Atiratra, Atimanyu and Suyasas. To Puru, Agneyi bore six sons of great lustre viz Ahga, Sumanas, Khyati, Srti, Angiras and Gaya. Sunitha, wife of Aiiga, bore him a son Vena.
verses.wordMeaning: Caksusa Manu begot Varuna of Puskarini. O excellent sage, from Manu of great prowess, in Nadala the daughter of the patriarch Vaisyajanma (?) were born ten sons viz Puru, Masa, Satadyurona, Tapasvin, Satyavit, Kavi, Agnistoma, Atiratra, Atimanyu and Suyasas. To Puru,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Caksusa Manu begot Varuna of Puskarini. O excellent sage, from Manu of great prowess, in Nadala the daughter of the patriarch Vaisyajanma (?) were born ten sons viz Puru, Masa, Satadyurona, Tapasvin, Satyavit, Kavi, Agnistoma, Atiratra, Atimanyu and Suyasas. To Puru,…
verses.science: परमेश्वरीको स्नान कराना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुस्थितस्तपसि ब्रह्मा नित्यं विष्णुर्हरस्तथा । देवा देव्योऽखिलाः प्राप्तास्तपसा दुर्लभं फलम्
verses.transliteration: susthitastapasi brahmā nityaṃ viṣṇurharastathā | devā devyo'khilāḥ prāptāstapasā durlabhaṃ phalam
verses.translation: Due to the misbehaviour of Vena the pious sages became very furious and killed him by very huhkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the misbehaviour of Vena the pious sages became very furious and killed him by very huhkara.
verses.science: बत्तियोंसे देवीकी आरती करनी चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: येन येन हि भावेन स्थित्वा यत्क्रियते तपः । ततः सम्प्राप्यतेऽसौ तैरिह लोके न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yena yena hi bhāvena sthitvā yatkriyate tapaḥ | tataḥ samprāpyate'sau tairiha loke na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Sarasvata Sages were requested by Sunitha for the birth of a son. They then churned and pressed his right hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarasvata Sages were requested by Sunitha for the birth of a son. They then churned and pressed his right hand.
verses.science: जगज्ननीका पूजन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकं राजसं चैव तामसं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् । विज्ञेयं हि तपो व्यास सर्वसाधनसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam | vijñeyaṃ hi tapo vyāsa sarvasādhanasādhanam
verses.translation: Prthu, son of Vena, the ancestor of all Ksatriyas protected the earth. He was the first lord of Earth, the first among those anointed in the Rajasuya sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prthu, son of Vena, the ancestor of all Ksatriyas protected the earth. He was the first lord of Earth, the first among those anointed in the Rajasuya sacrifice.
verses.science: भगवतीका ध्यान करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकं दैवतानां हि यतीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् । राजसं दानवानां हि मनुष्याणां तथैव च । तामसं राक्षसानां हि नराणां क्रूरकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikaṃ daivatānāṃ hi yatīnāmūrdhvaretasām | rājasaṃ dānavānāṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | tāmasaṃ rākṣasānāṃ hi narāṇāṃ krūrakarmaṇām
verses.translation: O goddess, I have mentioned that all which bestows the benefit'of worldly pleasures and salvation. What other tenet do you propose? Tell me, I shall tell you the truth.
verses.hindi: लोग मणिद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, I have mentioned that all which bestows the benefit'of worldly pleasures and salvation. What other tenet do you propose? Tell me, I shall tell you the truth.
verses.science: लोग मणिद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधं तत्फलं प्रोक्तं मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः । जपो ध्यानं तु देवानामर्चनं भक्तितः शुभम्
verses.transliteration: trividhaṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ | japo dhyānaṃ tu devānāmarcanaṃ bhaktitaḥ śubham
verses.translation: O great sagu, on hearing these words of Sanat- kumara, son of Brahma, the words bestowing the knowledge of truth, Vyasa, son of Par5Sara, was much delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sagu, on hearing these words of Sanat- kumara, son of Brahma, the words bestowing the knowledge of truth, Vyasa, son of Par5Sara, was much delighted.
verses.science: गणना कौन कर सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकं तद्धि निर्दिष्टमशेषफलसाधकम् । इह लोके परे चैव मनोऽभिप्रेतसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikaṃ taddhi nirdiṣṭamaśeṣaphalasādhakam | iha loke pare caiva mano'bhipretasādhanam
verses.translation: Tlie extremely delighted Vy&sa, bowed again smd again to the omniscient son of Brahm&, Sanatkumara, the storehouse of mercy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tlie extremely delighted Vy&sa, bowed again smd again to the omniscient son of Brahm&, Sanatkumara, the storehouse of mercy.
verses.science: परमेश्वरीको स्नान कराना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कामनाफलमुद्दिश्य राजसं तप उच्यते । निजदेहं सुसम्पीड्य देहशोषकदुःसहैः
verses.transliteration: kāmanāphalamuddiśya rājasaṃ tapa ucyate | nijadehaṃ susampīḍya dehaśoṣakaduḥsahaiḥ
verses.translation: O sages, then the great sage Vyasa, eulogised
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, then the great sage Vyasa, eulogised
verses.science: बत्तियोंसे देवीकी आरती करनी चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तामसमुद्दिष्टं मनोऽभिप्रेतसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: tapastāmasamuddiṣṭaṃ mano'bhipretasādhanam
verses.translation: O great sage, I am satisfied. The position of Brahma has been assigned to me. Obeisance be to you. You are blessed. You are the most excellent of all knowers of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, I am satisfied. The position of Brahma has been assigned to me. Obeisance be to you. You are blessed. You are the most excellent of all knowers of Brahman.
verses.science: जगज्ननीका पूजन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं सात्त्विकं विद्याद्धर्मबुद्धिश्च निश्चला । स्नानं पूजा जपो होमः शुद्धशौचमहिंसनम्
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ sāttvikaṃ vidyāddharmabuddhiśca niścalā | snānaṃ pūjā japo homaḥ śuddhaśaucamahiṃsanam
verses.translation: After eulogising the great sage the son of Brahma, Vyasa, the grandson of Brahma, kept silent. He was extremely delighted. He was Ailed with great bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising the great sage the son of Brahma, Vyasa, the grandson of Brahma, kept silent. He was extremely delighted. He was Ailed with great bliss.
verses.science: भगवतीका ध्यान करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रतोपवासचर्या च मौनमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दानं क्षान्तिर्दमो दया
verses.transliteration: vratopavāsacaryā ca maunamindriyanigrahaḥ | dhīrvidyā satyamakrodho dānaṃ kṣāntirdamo dayā
verses.translation: O launaka, Sanatkumara, son of Brahma, took leave of him. Worshipped by Vyasa he returned to his abode. Vya too left for his abode with his mind full of delight.
verses.hindi: पके हुए फल अर्पित करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O launaka, Sanatkumara, son of Brahma, took leave of him. Worshipped by Vyasa he returned to his abode. Vya too left for his abode with his mind full of delight.
verses.science: पके हुए फल अर्पित करना चाहिए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वापीकूपतडागादेः प्रासादस्य च कल्पना । कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं यज्ञः सुतीर्थान्याश्रमाः पुनः
verses.transliteration: vāpīkūpataḍāgādeḥ prāsādasya ca kalpanā | kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ yajñaḥ sutīrthānyāśramāḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, thus I have described to you the conversation between Sanatkumara and Vyasa, It deals with truth. It is pleasing. It enhances knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, thus I have described to you the conversation between Sanatkumara and Vyasa, It deals with truth. It is pleasing. It enhances knowledge.
verses.science: निर्मल हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्थानानि चैतानि सुखदानि मनीषिणाम् । सुधर्मः परमो व्यास शिवभक्तेश्च कारणम्
verses.transliteration: dharmasthānāni caitāni sukhadāni manīṣiṇām | sudharmaḥ paramo vyāsa śivabhakteśca kāraṇam
verses.translation: The great narrative of the conversation of Sanatkumara and Vyasa has been heard by me as narrated by you. It has bestowed the knowledge of truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great narrative of the conversation of Sanatkumara and Vyasa has been heard by me as narrated by you. It has bestowed the knowledge of truth.
verses.science: प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्रान्तिविषुवद्योगो नादमुक्ते नियुज्यताम् । ध्यानं त्रिकालिकं ज्योतिरुन्मनीभावधारणा
verses.transliteration: saṅkrāntiviṣuvadyogo nādamukte niyujyatām | dhyānaṃ trikālikaṃ jyotirunmanībhāvadhāraṇā
verses.translation: Now I wish to hear about the creation of Brahma, the manner of its origin and the way in which you heard it from Vyasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I wish to hear about the creation of Brahma, the manner of its origin and the way in which you heard it from Vyasa.
verses.science: शिवसहित जगद्धात्रीका पूजन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रेचकः पूरकः कुम्भः प्राणायामस्त्रिधा स्मृतः । नाडीसञ्चारविज्ञानं प्रत्याहारनिरोधनम्
verses.transliteration: recakaḥ pūrakaḥ kumbhaḥ prāṇāyāmastridhā smṛtaḥ | nāḍīsañcāravijñānaṃ pratyāhāranirodhanam
verses.translation: He who teaches or hears this story repeatedly sustains his family and is honoured in the world of heaven.
verses.hindi: लिये कुछ भी असाध्य नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: He who teaches or hears this story repeatedly sustains his family and is honoured in the world of heaven.
verses.science: लिये कुछ भी असाध्य नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयं तदधो बुद्धिरणिमाद्यष्टसंयुतम् । पूर्वोत्तमं समुद्दिष्टं परज्ञानप्रसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: turīyaṃ tadadho buddhiraṇimādyaṣṭasaṃyutam | pūrvottamaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ parajñānaprasādhanam
verses.translation: Purusa is eternal and he is of the nature of Sat and Asat as Pradhana and Purusa. The creator of the worlds created Pradhana after becoming Purusa. He created the Creator of all living beings devoted to Narayana. O great sage, understand him to be Brahma of immeasurable strength and prowess.
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa is eternal and he is of the nature of Sat and Asat as Pradhana and Purusa. The creator of the worlds created Pradhana after becoming Purusa. He created the Creator of all living beings devoted to Narayana. O great sage,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa is eternal and he is of the nature of Sat and Asat as Pradhana and Purusa. The creator of the worlds created Pradhana after becoming Purusa. He created the Creator of all living beings devoted to Narayana. O great sage,…
verses.science: रथके मध्यमें बैठी हुई हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठावस्था मृतावस्था हरिता वेति कीर्तिताः । नानोपलब्धयो ह्येताः सर्वपापप्रणाशनाः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhāvasthā mṛtāvasthā haritā veti kīrtitāḥ | nānopalabdhayo hyetāḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanāḥ
verses.translation: O leading sage, obeisance to that Self-born being from whom the Kalpas and all beings originate.
verses.hindi: उपभोग करके अन्तमें देवीके धामको जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sage, obeisance to that Self-born being from whom the Kalpas and all beings originate.
verses.science: उपभोग करके अन्तमें देवीके धामको जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नारी शय्या तथा पानं वस्त्रधूपविलेपनम् । ताम्बूलभक्षणं पञ्च राजैश्वर्यविभूतयः
verses.transliteration: nārī śayyā tathā pānaṃ vastradhūpavilepanam | tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ pañca rājaiśvaryavibhūtayaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing to that Purusa, lord Hiranyagarbha, I shall explain the excellent mode of creation again.
verses.hindi: जाती हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to that Purusa, lord Hiranyagarbha, I shall explain the excellent mode of creation again.
verses.science: जाती हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हेमभारस्तथा ताम्रं गृहाश्च रत्नधेनवः । पाण्डित्यं वेदशास्त्राणां गीतनृत्यविभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: hemabhārastathā tāmraṃ gṛhāśca ratnadhenavaḥ | pāṇḍityaṃ vedaśāstrāṇāṃ gītanṛtyavibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Being self-born himself the lord, desirous of creating various subjects, created only the waters first. He then instilled virility into them.
verses.hindi: गया अपना राज्य प्राप्त किया था
verses.commentary: Sense: Being self-born himself the lord, desirous of creating various subjects, created only the waters first. He then instilled virility into them.
verses.science: गया अपना राज्य प्राप्त किया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खवीणामृदङ्गाश्च गजेन्द्रः छ्त्रचामरे । भोगरूपाणि चैतानि एभिः सक्तोऽनुरज्यते
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhavīṇāmṛdaṅgāśca gajendraḥ chtracāmare | bhogarūpāṇi caitāni ebhiḥ sakto'nurajyate
verses.translation: Manu X, 8,
verses.explanation: मुक्त होकर मोक्षका भागी हुआ। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: मुक्त होकर मोक्षका भागी हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आदर्शवन्मुने स्नेहैस्तिलवत्स निपीड्यते । अरं गच्छेति चाप्येनं कुरुते ज्ञानमोहितः
verses.transliteration: ādarśavanmune snehaistilavatsa nipīḍyate | araṃ gaccheti cāpyenaṃ kurute jñānamohitaḥ
verses.translation: The Egg floating in the water assumed golden colour. Brahma himself famous as the self-born was born there,®
verses.commentary: Sense: The Egg floating in the water assumed golden colour. Brahma himself famous as the self-born was born there,®
verses.science: प्रदान करनेवाली और कल्याणकारिणी है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जानन्नपीह संसारे भ्रमते घटियन्त्रवत् । सर्वयोनिषु दुःखार्तः स्थावरेषु चरेषु च
verses.transliteration: jānannapīha saṃsāre bhramate ghaṭiyantravat | sarvayoniṣu duḥkhārtaḥ sthāvareṣu careṣu ca
verses.translation: After staying there for a year, lord Hiranyagarbha, dichotomised that egg and created heaven and earth.*
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying there for a year, lord Hiranyagarbha, dichotomised that egg and created heaven and earth.*
verses.science: गतिको प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं योनिषु सर्वासु प्रतिक्रम्य भ्रमेण त । कालान्तरवशाद्याति मानुष्यमतिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yoniṣu sarvāsu pratikramya bhrameṇa ta | kālāntaravaśādyāti mānuṣyamatidurlabham
verses.translation: Fourteen worlds were created including those above and below. With the intervening space between those two pieces the lord created the ether.®
verses.hindi: शा प लभत्येव छत .ाशयः है, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Fourteen worlds were created including those above and below. With the intervening space between those two pieces the lord created the ether.®
verses.science: शा प लभत्येव छत .ाशयः है, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्युत्क्रमेणापि मानुष्यं प्राप्यते पुण्यगौरवात् । विचित्रा गतयः प्रोक्ताः कर्मणां गुरुलाघवात्
verses.transliteration: vyutkrameṇāpi mānuṣyaṃ prāpyate puṇyagauravāt | vicitrā gatayaḥ proktāḥ karmaṇāṃ gurulāghavāt
verses.translation: He created the earth floating in the waters and the ten quarters in the firmament. Then he created the mind, the speech, love and anger and the sexual delight.
verses.hindi: श्रोतव्या पठितव्या च शिवभक्तिमभीप्सुभि: ॥ ८८  पाठ करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: He created the earth floating in the waters and the ten quarters in the firmament. Then he created the mind, the speech, love and anger and the sexual delight.
verses.science: श्रोतव्या पठितव्या च शिवभक्तिमभीप्सुभि: ॥ ८८ पाठ करना चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्यं च समासाद्य स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधनम् । नाचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयः स मृतः शोचते चिरम्
verses.transliteration: mānuṣyaṃ ca samāsādya svargamokṣaprasādhanam | nācaratyātmanaḥ śreyaḥ sa mṛtaḥ śocate ciram
verses.translation: They have been decisively termed the seven Brahmas in the Puranas. Brahma again created the Rudras arising from anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have been decisively termed the seven Brahmas in the Puranas. Brahma again created the Rudras arising from anger.
verses.science: नामक इक्यावनवों अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: देवासुराणां सर्वेषां मानुष्यं चातिदुर्लभम् । तत्सम्प्राप्य तथा कुर्यान्न गच्छेन्नरकं यथा
verses.transliteration: devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ mānuṣyaṃ cātidurlabham | tatsamprāpya tathā kuryānna gacchennarakaṃ yathā
verses.translation: He created the sage Sanatkumara too, the eldest of all. They are thus seven born. The Rudras were born afterwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created the sage Sanatkumara too, the eldest of all. They are thus seven born. The Rudras were born afterwards.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गापवर्गलाभाय यदि नास्ति समुद्यमः । दुर्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं वृथा तज्जन्म कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: svargāpavargalābhāya yadi nāsti samudyamaḥ | durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ vṛthā tajjanma kīrtitam
verses.translation: Sanatkumara stays with controlled brilliance. From them seven great families originated, all being divine and worshipped by the celestial sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanatkumara stays with controlled brilliance. From them seven great families originated, all being divine and worshipped by the celestial sages.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य मूलं मानुष्यं चतुर्वर्गस्य कीर्तितम् । सम्प्राप्य धर्मतो व्यास तद्यत्नादनुपालयेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasya mūlaṃ mānuṣyaṃ caturvargasya kīrtitam | samprāpya dharmato vyāsa tadyatnādanupālayet
verses.translation: Endowed with sacred rites they were born along with the other Sages. The lightning, the thunderbolt, the red clouds and the rainbow were created.
verses.commentary: Sense: Endowed with sacred rites they were born along with the other Sages. The lightning, the thunderbolt, the red clouds and the rainbow were created.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्ममूलं हि मानुष्यं लब्ध्वा सर्वार्थसाधकम् । यदि लाभाय यत्नः स्यान्मूलं रक्षेत्स्वयं ततः
verses.transliteration: dharmamūlaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ labdhvā sarvārthasādhakam | yadi lābhāya yatnaḥ syānmūlaṃ rakṣetsvayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: He created water at the outset. He created the rain-bearing cloud. He created the Rks, the Yajus and the Samans for facilitating Yajfias.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created water at the outset. He created the rain-bearing cloud. He created the Rks, the Yajus and the Samans for facilitating Yajfias.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्येऽपि च विप्रत्वं यः प्राप्य खलु दुर्लभम् । नाचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयः कोऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः
verses.transliteration: mānuṣye'pi ca vipratvaṃ yaḥ prāpya khalu durlabham | nācaratyātmanaḥ śreyaḥ ko'nyastasmādacetanaḥ
verses.translation: With these he worshipped the gods worthy of being adored. This is what we had heard. He created the gods
verses.commentary: Sense: With these he worshipped the gods worthy of being adored. This is what we had heard. He created the gods
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपानामेव सर्वेषां कर्मभूरियमुच्यते । इतः स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च प्राप्यते समुपार्जितः
verses.transliteration: dvīpānāmeva sarveṣāṃ karmabhūriyamucyate | itaḥ svargaśca mokṣaśca prāpyate samupārjitaḥ
verses.translation: Ibid. I. 10.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid. I. 10.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देशेऽस्मिन् भारते वर्षे प्राप्य मानुष्यमध्रुवम् । न कुर्यादात्मनः श्रेयस्तेनात्मा खलु वञ्चितः
verses.transliteration: deśe'smin bhārate varṣe prāpya mānuṣyamadhruvam | na kuryādātmanaḥ śreyastenātmā khalu vañcitaḥ
verses.translation: Ibid I. 9.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभूमिरियं विप्र फलभूमिरसौ स्मृता । इह यत्क्रियते कर्म स्वर्गे तदनुभुज्यते
verses.transliteration: karmabhūmiriyaṃ vipra phalabhūmirasau smṛtā | iha yatkriyate karma svarge tadanubhujyate
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid. I. 13-14.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यावत्स्वास्थ्यं शरीरस्य तावद्धर्मं समाचरेत् । अस्वस्थश्चोदितोऽप्यन्यैर्न किञ्चित्कर्तुमुत्सहेत्
verses.transliteration: yāvatsvāsthyaṃ śarīrasya tāvaddharmaṃ samācaret | asvasthaścodito'pyanyairna kiñcitkartumutsahet
verses.translation: Martu adds Pracetas, Bhygu and NSrada Ibid. i. 35.
verses.commentary: Sense: Martu adds Pracetas, Bhygu and NSrada Ibid. i. 35.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अध्रुवेण शरीरेण ध्रुवं यो न प्रसाधयेत् । ध्रुवं तस्य परिभ्रष्टमध्रुवं नष्टमेव च
verses.transliteration: adhruveṇa śarīreṇa dhruvaṃ yo na prasādhayet | dhruvaṃ tasya paribhraṣṭamadhruvaṃ naṣṭameva ca
verses.translation: Living beings high and low were born of his limbs as the patriarch Apava generated the creation of the aquatic beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Living beings high and low were born of his limbs as the patriarch Apava generated the creation of the aquatic beings.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आयुषः खण्डखण्डानि निपतन्ति तदग्रतः । अहोरात्रोपदेशेन किमर्थं नावबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: āyuṣaḥ khaṇḍakhaṇḍāni nipatanti tadagrataḥ | ahorātropadeśena kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyate
verses.translation: When the beings created did not increase he dicho¬ tomised his body and became man and woman.®
verses.commentary: Sense: When the beings created did not increase he dicho¬ tomised his body and became man and woman.®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा न ज्ञायते मृत्युः कदा कस्य भविष्यति । आकस्मिके हि मरणे धृतिं विन्दति कस्तथा
verses.transliteration: yadā na jñāyate mṛtyuḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati | ākasmike hi maraṇe dhṛtiṃ vindati kastathā
verses.translation: The creations of Visnu were not born of womb. They were long-lived, famous, blessed and possessed of progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creations of Visnu were not born of womb. They were long-lived, famous, blessed and possessed of progeny.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परित्यज्य यदा सर्वमेकाकी यास्यति ध्रुवम् । न ददाति कदा कस्मात्पाथेयार्थमिदं धनम्
verses.transliteration: parityajya yadā sarvamekākī yāsyati dhruvam | na dadāti kadā kasmātpātheyārthamidaṃ dhanam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thus the premeval creation has been narrated to you on knowing which one attains his cherished goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, thus the premeval creation has been narrated to you on knowing which one attains his cherished goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परलोकस्य पाथेयं मोक्षोपायमनामयम् । पुण्यसङ्घैकनिलयं शिव इत्यक्षरद्वयम्

verses.sanskrit: शिवनामैव संसारमहारोगैकशामकम् । नान्यत्संसाररोगस्य शामकं दृश्यते मया
verses.transliteration: śivanāmaiva saṃsāramahārogaikaśāmakam | nānyatsaṃsārarogasya śāmakaṃ dṛśyate mayā
verses.translation: Dharma's daughter, the virtuously born beautiful woman named Suniti was the mother of Dhruva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यासहस्राणि पुरा कृत्वा तु पुल्कसः । शिवेति नाम विमलं श्रुत्वा मोक्षं गतः पुरा

verses.commentary: Sense: Even as a child Dhruva performed penance for three thousand divine years wishing for an imperishable status.

verses.transliteration: tasmādvivardhayedbhaktimīśvare satataṃ budhaḥ | śivabhaktyā mahāprājña bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati
verses.translation: Lord Brahma, being delighted gave him a stable position as his own, facing the seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma, being delighted gave him a stable position as his own, facing the seven sages.

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ

verses.translation: Sikhandini gave birth to a son Pracinabarhis. While he roamed on the earth Kusa grasses had their tips towards the East.

verses.translation: The daughter of the lord of the Ocean was duly married by him. The great lord, shone all the more when he had a wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter of the lord of the Ocean was duly married by him. The great lord, shone all the more when he had a wife.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियो जायते यज्ञैः संस्कृतैरात्तदक्षिणैः । अधीते स्वर्गमन्विच्छंस्त्रेताग्निशरणं सदा
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyo jāyate yajñaiḥ saṃskṛtairāttadakṣiṇaiḥ | adhīte svargamanvicchaṃstretāgniśaraṇaṃ sadā
verses.translation: Ten sons were born to Pracinabarhis the great sacrificer, of his wife Samudratanaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ten sons were born to Pracinabarhis the great sacrificer, of his wife Samudratanaya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आर्द्रहस्तपदो नित्यं क्षितिं धर्मेण पालयेत् । ऋतुकालाभिगामी च स्वभार्यां धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: ārdrahastapado nityaṃ kṣitiṃ dharmeṇa pālayet | ṛtukālābhigāmī ca svabhāryāṃ dharmatatparaḥ
verses.translation: They were Pracetas by name. They had mastered the science of archery. Together they practised virtue and performed penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Pracetas by name. They had mastered the science of archery. Together they practised virtue and performed penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य भूतेभ्यो दीयतामिति । गोब्राह्मणात्मनोऽर्थं हि सङ्ग्रामाभिहतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya bhūtebhyo dīyatāmiti | gobrāhmaṇātmano'rthaṃ hi saṅgrāmābhihato bhavet
verses.translation: They lay sunk in the waters of the ocean for ten thousand years, repeating the Japa of Rudragita and medita¬ ting on!§iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: They lay sunk in the waters of the ocean for ten thousand years, repeating the Japa of Rudragita and medita¬ ting on!§iva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनाग्निमन्त्रपूतात्मा क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणो भवेत् । विधितो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा याजकस्तु प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: tenāgnimantrapūtātmā kṣatriyo brāhmaṇo bhavet | vidhito brāhmaṇo bhūtvā yājakastu prajāyate
verses.translation: While they were performing penance trees grew on the earth. When the Earth stood unprotectea there was a great destruction of subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: While they were performing penance trees grew on the earth. When the Earth stood unprotectea there was a great destruction of subjects.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मनिरतो नित्यं सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः । प्राप्यते विपुलः स्वर्गो देवानामपि वल्लभः
verses.transliteration: svakarmanirato nityaṃ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ | prāpyate vipulaḥ svargo devānāmapi vallabhaḥ
verses.translation: O great king, after attaining boons when, they returned they saw the trees. They were furious and wanted to burn them by the power of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great king, after attaining boons when, they returned they saw the trees. They were furious and wanted to burn them by the power of penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणत्वं हि दुष्प्राप्यं कृच्छ्रेण साध्यते नरैः । ब्राह्मण्यात्सकलं प्राप्य मोक्षं चापि मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇatvaṃ hi duṣprāpyaṃ kṛcchreṇa sādhyate naraiḥ | brāhmaṇyātsakalaṃ prāpya mokṣaṃ cāpi munīśvara
verses.translation: The Pracetasas created fire and wind from their mouths. The wind uprooted the trees and the fire burnt them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pracetasas created fire and wind from their mouths. The wind uprooted the trees and the fire burnt them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणो धर्मतत्परः । साधनं सर्ववर्गस्य रक्षेद् ब्राह्मण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇo dharmatatparaḥ | sādhanaṃ sarvavargasya rakṣed brāhmaṇyamuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing the destruction of trees and observing that only a few trees were left, the valorous king Soma approached them and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the destruction of trees and observing that only a few trees were left, the valorous king Soma approached them and said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । सङ्ग्रामस्येह माहात्म्यं त्वयोक्तं मुनिसत्तम । एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं ब्रूहि त्वं वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca | saṅgrāmasyeha māhātmyaṃ tvayoktaṃ munisattama | etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ brūhi tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: O Pracinabarhisas, O kings, subdue your anger. This daughter of the trees, Anubhuta, is a woman of fair com¬ plexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pracinabarhisas, O kings, subdue your anger. This daughter of the trees, Anubhuta, is a woman of fair com¬ plexion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा विपुलदक्षिणैः । न तत्फलमवाप्नोति सङ्ग्रामे यदवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairiṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ | na tatphalamavāpnoti saṅgrāme yadavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: With half your brilliance, and with half my brilli¬ ance this king full of Brahma's brilliance will make the sub¬ jects flourish.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half your brilliance, and with half my brilli¬ ance this king full of Brahma's brilliance will make the sub¬ jects flourish.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति तत्त्वविदः प्राहुर्यज्ञकर्मविदः सदा । तस्मात्तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्फलं शस्त्रजीविनाम्
verses.transliteration: iti tattvavidaḥ prāhuryajñakarmavidaḥ sadā | tasmāttatte pravakṣyāmi yatphalaṃ śastrajīvinām
verses.translation: Then at the instance of Soma the Pracetasas lovingly took the fair-complexioned lady, daughter of trees, as their wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the instance of Soma the Pracetasas lovingly took the fair-complexioned lady, daughter of trees, as their wife.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मलाभोऽर्थलाभश्च यशोलाभस्तथैव च । यः शूरो वाञ्छते युद्धं विमृदन् परवाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: dharmalābho'rthalābhaśca yaśolābhastathaiva ca | yaḥ śūro vāñchate yuddhaṃ vimṛdan paravāhinīm
verses.translation: After creating mentally the mobile and immobile beings, the bipeds and the quadrupeds, Daksa began creation though copulatory process.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating mentally the mobile and immobile beings, the bipeds and the quadrupeds, Daksa began creation though copulatory process.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य धर्मार्थकामाश्च यज्ञश्चैव सदक्षिणः । परं ह्यभिमुखं दत्त्वा तद्यानं योऽधिरोहति
verses.transliteration: tasya dharmārthakāmāśca yajñaścaiva sadakṣiṇaḥ | paraṃ hyabhimukhaṃ dattvā tadyānaṃ yo'dhirohati
verses.translation: In accordance with the Sastric injunctions, he virtuously married the daughter of Virana the partriarch, the chaste lady Virani.
verses.commentary: Sense: In accordance with the Sastric injunctions, he virtuously married the daughter of Virana the partriarch, the chaste lady Virani.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुलोके स जायेत यश्च युद्धेऽपराजितः । अश्वमेधानवाप्नोति चतुरो न मृतः स चेत्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuloke sa jāyeta yaśca yuddhe'parājitaḥ | aśvamedhānavāpnoti caturo na mṛtaḥ sa cet
verses.translation: He begot of her ten thousand sons Haryasvas. At the instance of Narada they became detached from the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: He begot of her ten thousand sons Haryasvas. At the instance of Narada they became detached from the world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु शस्त्रमनुत्सृज्य म्रियते वाहिनीमुखे । सम्मुखो वर्तते शूरः स स्वर्गान्न निवर्तते
verses.transliteration: yastu śastramanutsṛjya mriyate vāhinīmukhe | sammukho vartate śūraḥ sa svargānna nivartate
verses.translation: On hearing of it Daksa again begot of her a thousand sons SubalaSvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing of it Daksa again begot of her a thousand sons SubalaSvas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजा वा राजपुत्रो वा सेनापतिरथापि वा । हतः क्षात्रेण यः शूरस्तस्य लोकोऽक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: rājā vā rājaputro vā senāpatirathāpi vā | hataḥ kṣātreṇa yaḥ śūrastasya loko'kṣayo bhavet
verses.translation: Thanks to the instructions of the same sage they too followed the footsteps of their brothers. Unattached and following the path of mendicants they never returned to their parents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the instructions of the same sage they too followed the footsteps of their brothers. Unattached and following the path of mendicants they never returned to their parents.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति तस्य रोमाणि भिद्यन्तेऽस्त्रैर्महाहवे । तावतो लभते लोकान् सर्वकामदुघाऽक्षयान्
verses.transliteration: yāvanti tasya romāṇi bhidyante'strairmahāhave | tāvato labhate lokān sarvakāmadughā'kṣayān
verses.translation: On hearing of it he became very furious and cursed the sage thus— O wretch, fond of quarrels, you will never stay permanently anywhere. *
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing of it he became very furious and cursed the sage thus— O wretch, fond of quarrels, you will never stay permanently anywhere. *
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरासनं वीरशय्या वीरस्थानस्थितिः स्थिरा । सर्वदा भवति व्यास इह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: vīrāsanaṃ vīraśayyā vīrasthānasthitiḥ sthirā | sarvadā bhavati vyāsa iha loke paratra ca
verses.translation: Repeated. See Ch. 31. VefScs 14.13.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated. See Ch. 31. VefScs 14.13.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे च स्थानस्वाम्यर्थमेव च । ये मृतास्ते सुखं यान्ति यथा सुकृतिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca sthānasvāmyarthameva ca | ye mṛtāste sukhaṃ yānti yathā sukṛtinastathā
verses.translation: Consoled by Brahma, O great sage he afterwards created women endowed with qualities and in the form of great flames.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Consoled by Brahma, O great sage he afterwards created women endowed with qualities and in the form of great flames.®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः कश्चिद् ब्राह्मणं हत्वा पश्चात्प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । तत्रासौ स्वपतेर्युद्धे स स्वर्गान्न निवर्तते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kaścid brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā paścātprāṇān parityajet | tatrāsau svapateryuddhe sa svargānna nivartate
verses.translation: O great brahmin, the subjects thereafter were born of sexual union. The creation prior to this was through mental concepts, visualisation and touch.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great brahmin, the subjects thereafter were born of sexual union. The creation prior to this was through mental concepts, visualisation and touch.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादैर्दन्तिभिश्चैव हतस्य गतिरुत्तमा । द्विजगोस्वामिनामर्थे भवेद्विपुलदाक्षया
verses.transliteration: kravyādairdantibhiścaiva hatasya gatiruttamā | dvijagosvāmināmarthe bhavedvipuladākṣayā
verses.translation: O Suta, it behoves you to clear this doubt of mine. This is also surprising how he attained the status of of the father-in-law of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, it behoves you to clear this doubt of mine. This is also surprising how he attained the status of of the father-in-law of Soma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्नोत्विह समर्थश्च यष्टुं क्रतुशतैरपि । आत्मदेहपरित्यागः कर्तुं युधि सुदुष्करः
verses.transliteration: śaknotviha samarthaśca yaṣṭuṃ kratuśatairapi | ātmadehaparityāgaḥ kartuṃ yudhi suduṣkaraḥ
verses.translation: Birth and destruction happen everyday among the mortals. O sage, in every Kalpa these, Daksa and others are born again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Birth and destruction happen everyday among the mortals. O sage, in every Kalpa these, Daksa and others are born again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं पुण्यतमं स्वर्ग्यं रूपज्ञं सर्वतोमुखम् । सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां क्षत्रियस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yuddhaṃ puṇyatamaṃ svargyaṃ rūpajñaṃ sarvatomukham | sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ kṣatriyasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He who knows this mode of creation of Daka of the mobile and immobile beings becomes endowed with pro¬ geny and longevity. After death he is honoured in the heavenly region.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows this mode of creation of Daka of the mobile and immobile beings becomes endowed with pro¬ geny and longevity. After death he is honoured in the heavenly region.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भृशं चैव प्रवक्ष्यामि युद्धधर्मं सनातनम् । यादृशाय प्रहर्तव्यं यादृशं परिवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhṛśaṃ caiva pravakṣyāmi yuddhadharmaṃ sanātanam | yādṛśāya prahartavyaṃ yādṛśaṃ parivarjayet
verses.translation: The Verses 47, 48 are repeatecL See Gh. 31. Verses 17, 18.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Verses 47, 48 are repeatecL See Gh. 31. Verses 17, 18.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आततायिनमायान्तमपि वेदान्तङ्गं द्विजम् । जिघांसन्तं जिघांसेत्तु न तेन ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ātatāyinamāyāntamapi vedāntaṅgaṃ dvijam | jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsettu na tena brahmahā bhavet
verses.translation: O son of Suta, tell me quickly about the details of the creation of the gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Suta, tell me quickly about the details of the creation of the gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakasas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हन्तव्योऽपि न हन्तव्यः पानीयं यश्च याचते । रणे हत्वातुरा व्यास स नरो ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: hantavyo'pi na hantavyaḥ pānīyaṃ yaśca yācate | raṇe hatvāturā vyāsa sa naro brahmahā bhavet
verses.translation: When the creation did not multiply, the patriarch asked the daughter of Virana, endowed with penance, for the purpose of creation
verses.commentary: Sense: When the creation did not multiply, the patriarch asked the daughter of Virana, endowed with penance, for the purpose of creation
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्याधितं दुर्बलं बालं स्त्र्यनाथौ कृपणं ध्रुवम् । धनुर्भग्नं छिन्नगुणं हत्वा वै ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vyādhitaṃ durbalaṃ bālaṃ stryanāthau kṛpaṇaṃ dhruvam | dhanurbhagnaṃ chinnaguṇaṃ hatvā vai brahmahā bhavet
verses.translation: He created different people by the process of copulation. O intelligent one, listen to them. I shall ex¬ plain in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created different people by the process of copulation. O intelligent one, listen to them. I shall ex¬ plain in brief.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विचार्य सद्धीमान् भवेत्प्रीत्याः रणप्रियः । स जन्मनः फलं प्राप्य परत्रेह प्रमोदते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vicārya saddhīmān bhavetprītyāḥ raṇapriyaḥ | sa janmanaḥ phalaṃ prāpya paratreha pramodate
verses.translation: Uniting with her, the powerful patriarch begot of Virini five thousand sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uniting with her, the powerful patriarch begot of Virini five thousand sons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Ever since, O sage, if a brother goes in quest of a brother he perishes. That should not be done by any learned man.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since, O sage, if a brother goes in quest of a brother he perishes. That should not be done by any learned man.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Ever since, O sage, if a brother goes in quest of a brother he perishes. That should not be done by any learned man.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since, O sage, if a brother goes in quest of a brother he perishes. That should not be done by any learned man.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२२. द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः । देहोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । विधिं तात वदेदानीं जीवजन्म विधानतः । गर्भे स्थितिं च तस्यापि वैराग्यार्थं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.22. dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dehotpattivarṇanam | vyāsa uvāca | vidhiṃ tāta vadedānīṃ jīvajanma vidhānataḥ | garbhe sthitiṃ ca tasyāpi vairāgyārthaṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: Realising that his sons had perished, the patriarch Daksa cursed the noble soul Narada in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that his sons had perished, the patriarch Daksa cursed the noble soul Narada in anger.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । शृणु व्यास समासेन शास्त्रसारमशेषतः । वदिष्यामि सुवैराग्यं मुमुक्षोर्भवबन्धकृत्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa samāsena śāstrasāramaśeṣataḥ | vadiṣyāmi suvairāgyaṃ mumukṣorbhavabandhakṛt
verses.translation: His sons were Sakha, Visakha and Naigameya. The son of Krttikas was called Karttikeya,®
verses.commentary: Sense: His sons were Sakha, Visakha and Naigameya. The son of Krttikas was called Karttikeya,®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पाकपात्रस्य मध्ये तु पृथगन्नं पृथग्जलम् । अग्नेरूर्ध्वं जलं स्थाप्यं तदन्नं च जलोपरि
verses.transliteration: pākapātrasya madhye tu pṛthagannaṃ pṛthagjalam | agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpyaṃ tadannaṃ ca jalopari
verses.translation: Diptis of immeasurable splendour became the children of the twentyseven women of sacred rites and the wives of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Diptis of immeasurable splendour became the children of the twentyseven women of sacred rites and the wives of Soma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जलस्याधः स चाग्निर्हि स्थितोऽग्निं धमते शनैः । वायुना धम्यमानोऽग्निरत्युष्णं कुरुते जलम्
verses.transliteration: jalasyādhaḥ sa cāgnirhi sthito'gniṃ dhamate śanaiḥ | vāyunā dhamyamāno'gniratyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalam
verses.translation: The story of Bana has already been heard by you. In the battle Krna was delighted with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Bana has already been heard by you. In the battle Krna was delighted with him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदन्नमुष्णतोयेन समन्तात्पच्यते पुनः । द्विधा भवति तत्पक्वं पृथक्किट्टं पृथग्रसः
verses.transliteration: tadannamuṣṇatoyena samantātpacyate punaḥ | dvidhā bhavati tatpakvaṃ pṛthakkiṭṭaṃ pṛthagrasaḥ
verses.translation: Tamra the beloved of Kasyapa gave birth to horses, camels and donkeys. Thus the family of Tamra has been described to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tamra the beloved of Kasyapa gave birth to horses, camels and donkeys. Thus the family of Tamra has been described to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मासैश्चतुर्भिरङ्गुल्यः प्रजायन्ते यथाक्रमम् । मुखं नासा च कर्णौ मासैः पञ्चभिरेव च
verses.transliteration: māsaiścaturbhiraṅgulyaḥ prajāyante yathākramam | mukhaṃ nāsā ca karṇau māsaiḥ pañcabhireva ca
verses.translation: Vinata had two sons Aruna and Garuda. The latter was the most excellent among birds. He was terrible by virtue of his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinata had two sons Aruna and Garuda. The latter was the most excellent among birds. He was terrible by virtue of his activities.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मलैर्द्वादशभिः किट्टं भिन्नं देहाद्बहिर्भवेत् । रसस्तु देहे सरति स पुष्टस्तेन जायते
verses.transliteration: malairdvādaśabhiḥ kiṭṭaṃ bhinnaṃ dehādbahirbhavet | rasastu dehe sarati sa puṣṭastena jāyate
verses.translation: Anayusa's sons were fifty. They were very strong. The chief amongst them were Bala, Vrtta, Viksara and Brhan.
verses.commentary: Sense: Anayusa's sons were fifty. They were very strong. The chief amongst them were Bala, Vrtta, Viksara and Brhan.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्णाक्षिनासिका जिह्वा दन्ताः शिश्नो गुदं नखाः । मलाश्रयः कफः स्वेदो विण्मूत्रं द्वादश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: karṇākṣināsikā jihvā dantāḥ śiśno gudaṃ nakhāḥ | malāśrayaḥ kaphaḥ svedo viṇmūtraṃ dvādaśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Surabhi gave birth to rabbits and buffaloes; Ila to trees, creepers, spreading vines and all kinds of grass; Khasa gave birth to Yaksa and Raksasas, Muni gave birth to the celestial damsels. Arista gave birth to serpents more ex¬ cellent than human beings in their power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surabhi gave birth to rabbits and buffaloes; Ila to trees, creepers, spreading vines and all kinds of grass; Khasa gave birth to Yaksa and Raksasas, Muni gave birth to the celestial damsels. Arista gave birth to serpents more ex¬ cellent than human beings in their power.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पद्मे प्रतिबद्धाश्च सर्वनाड्यः समन्ततः । ज्ञेया रसप्रवाहिन्यस्तत्प्रकारं ब्रुवे मुने
verses.transliteration: hṛtpadme pratibaddhāśca sarvanāḍyaḥ samantataḥ | jñeyā rasapravāhinyastatprakāraṃ bruve mune
verses.translation: O great sages, thus the descendants of Kasyapa have been explained to you. They had hundreds of sons and grandsons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, thus the descendants of Kasyapa have been explained to you. They had hundreds of sons and grandsons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तासां मुखेषु तं सूक्ष्मं प्राणः स्थापयेत् रसम् । रसेन तेन नाडीस्ताः प्राणं पूरयते पुनः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ mukheṣu taṃ sūkṣmaṃ prāṇaḥ sthāpayet rasam | rasena tena nāḍīstāḥ prāṇaṃ pūrayate punaḥ
verses.translation: Such is the creation as mentioned in the Man- vantara, Svarocisa, O dear. Now I shall describe the creation as evolved by Brahman while oflering oblations in the ela¬ borate Varuna sacrifice in the great Vaivasvata Manvantara. All the Brahmarsis born in the beginning, Pitamaha made his mental sons. When a great fight ensued between the gods and the Danavas, Diti lost all her sons. She approached Kasyapa and propitiated him. The delighted Kasyapa asked her to choose a boon as she pleased. She chose the boon that she be favoured with a son of immeasurable power capable of slaying Indra.
verses.wordMeaning: Such is the creation as mentioned in the Man- vantara, Svarocisa, O dear. Now I shall describe the creation as evolved by Brahman while oflering oblations in the ela¬ borate Varuna sacrifice in the great Vaivasvata Manvantara. All the Brahmarsis born in the beginning,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Such is the creation as mentioned in the Man- vantara, Svarocisa, O dear. Now I shall describe the creation as evolved by Brahman while oflering oblations in the ela¬ borate Varuna sacrifice in the great Vaivasvata Manvantara. All the Brahmarsis born in the beginning,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रयान्ति सम्पूर्णाः ताश्च देहं समन्ततः । ततः स नाडीमध्यस्थः शरीरेणात्मना रसः
verses.transliteration: punaḥ prayānti sampūrṇāḥ tāśca dehaṃ samantataḥ | tataḥ sa nāḍīmadhyasthaḥ śarīreṇātmanā rasaḥ
verses.translation: "O wretch, fond of quarrels, you will never stay anywhere permanently. Qiiarrel will always occur among the people where you happen to be present."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O wretch, fond of quarrels, you will never stay anywhere permanently. Qiiarrel will always occur among the people where you happen to be present."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पच्यते पच्यमानाच्च भवेत्पाकद्वयं पुनः । त्वक् तया वेष्ट्यते पूर्वं रुधिरं च प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: pacyate pacyamānācca bhavetpākadvayaṃ punaḥ | tvak tayā veṣṭyate pūrvaṃ rudhiraṃ ca prajāyate
verses.translation: We have heard that Daksa the patriarch was consoled by Brahma afterwards and that he begot of Virini sixty daughters.'
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that Daksa the patriarch was consoled by Brahma afterwards and that he begot of Virini sixty daughters.'
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्ताल्लोमानि मांसं च केशाः स्नायुश्च मांसतः । स्नायुतश्च तथास्थीनि नखा मज्जास्थिसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: raktāllomāni māṃsaṃ ca keśāḥ snāyuśca māṃsataḥ | snāyutaśca tathāsthīni nakhā majjāsthisambhavāḥ
verses.translation: He gave ten of them to Dharma; thirteen to Kayapa; twentyseven to the moon and four to Aristanemi.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave ten of them to Dharma; thirteen to Kayapa; twentyseven to the moon and four to Aristanemi.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मज्जाकारणवैकल्यं शुक्रं हि प्रसवात्मकम् । इति द्वादशधान्नस्य परिणामः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: majjākāraṇavaikalyaṃ śukraṃ hi prasavātmakam | iti dvādaśadhānnasya pariṇāmaḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Two to the son of Brahma, two to Ahgiras and two to the learned Kr<ai5va. Now listen to their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two to the son of Brahma, two to Ahgiras and two to the learned Kr<ai5va. Now listen to their names.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रोऽन्नाज्जायते शुक्राद्दिव्यदेहस्य सम्भवः । ऋतुकाले यदा शुक्रं निर्दोषं योनिसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: śukro'nnājjāyate śukrāddivyadehasya sambhavaḥ | ṛtukāle yadā śukraṃ nirdoṣaṃ yonisaṃsthitam
verses.translation: O sage, the wives of Dharma are Arundhati, Vasu, Yami, Lamba, Bhanu, Marutvati, Sahkalpa, Muhurta, Sadhya and Visva. Now listen to their children. Vive- devas are the sons of Visva, and Sadhya gave birth to Sadh/as.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the wives of Dharma are Arundhati, Vasu, Yami, Lamba, Bhanu, Marutvati, Sahkalpa, Muhurta, Sadhya and Visva. Now listen to their children. Vive- devas are the sons of Visva, and Sadhya gave birth to Sadh/as.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा तद् वायुसंस्पृष्टं स्त्रीरक्तेनैकतां व्रजेत् । विसर्गकाले शुक्रस्य जीवः कारणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: tadā tad vāyusaṃspṛṣṭaṃ strīraktenaikatāṃ vrajet | visargakāle śukrasya jīvaḥ kāraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: Marutvats were born of Marutvati, Vasus were born of Vasu; the suns were born of Bhanu and the Muhurtajas were born of Muhurta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marutvats were born of Marutvati, Vasus were born of Vasu; the suns were born of Bhanu and the Muhurtajas were born of Muhurta.

verses.sanskrit: संवृतः प्रविशेद्योनिं कर्मभिः स्वैर्नियोजितः । तच्छुक्ररक्तमेकस्थमेकाहात्कललं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃvṛtaḥ praviśedyoniṃ karmabhiḥ svairniyojitaḥ | tacchukraraktamekasthamekāhātkalalaṃ bhavet

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चरात्रेण कललं बुद्बुदाकारतां व्रजेत् । बुद्बुदः सप्तरात्रेण मांसपेशी भवेत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: pañcarātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudākāratāṃ vrajet | budbudaḥ saptarātreṇa māṃsapeśī bhavet punaḥ
verses.translation: Aya, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anila, Anala, Pratyusa and Prabhasa are the eight Vasus by name.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aya, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anila, Anala, Pratyusa and Prabhasa are the eight Vasus by name.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीवा शिरश्च स्कन्धौ च पृष्ठवंशस्तथोदरम् । पाणिपादं तथा पार्श्वे कटिर्गात्रं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: grīvā śiraśca skandhau ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśastathodaram | pāṇipādaṃ tathā pārśve kaṭirgātraṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Aya's sons arc Vaitanda, Srama, Santa and Muni. Dhruva's son was lord Kala influencing the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aya's sons arc Vaitanda, Srama, Santa and Muni. Dhruva's son was lord Kala influencing the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: द्विमासाभ्यन्तरेणैव क्रमशः शम्भवेदिह । त्रिभिर्मासैः प्रजायन्ते सर्वे ह्यङ्कुरसन्धयः
verses.transliteration: dvimāsābhyantareṇaiva kramaśaḥ śambhavediha | tribhirmāsaiḥ prajāyante sarve hyaṅkurasandhayaḥ
verses.translation: Manohara's sons were Sasira, Prana and
verses.commentary: Sense: Manohara's sons were Sasira, Prana and

verses.sanskrit: दन्तपङ्क्तिस्तथा गुह्यं जायन्ते च नखाः पुनः । कर्णयोस्तु भवेच्छिद्रं षण्मासाभ्यन्तरेण तु
verses.transliteration: dantapaṅktistathā guhyaṃ jāyante ca nakhāḥ punaḥ | karṇayostu bhavecchidraṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tu
verses.translation: Brhaspati's sister was a woman of excellence, well-versed in Yoga and she traversed the entire world maintaining celibacy. She became the wife ot Prabhasa the eighth of Vasus. O fortunate one, Viwakarman the patriarch was born of him.'
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati's sister was a woman of excellence, well-versed in Yoga and she traversed the entire world maintaining celibacy. She became the wife ot Prabhasa the eighth of Vasus. O fortunate one, Viwakarman the patriarch was born of him.'

verses.sanskrit: पायुर्मेहमुपस्थं च नाभिश्चाभ्युपजायते । सन्धयो ये च गात्रेषु मासैर्जायन्ति सप्तभिः
verses.transliteration: pāyurmehamupasthaṃ ca nābhiścābhyupajāyate | sandhayo ye ca gātreṣu māsairjāyanti saptabhiḥ
verses.translation: He built the aerial chariots of all god s. He is a great Atman whose craft is emulated and made use of by men too.
verses.commentary: Sense: He built the aerial chariots of all god s. He is a great Atman whose craft is emulated and made use of by men too.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसम्पूर्णः परिपक्वः स तिष्ठति । उदरे मातुराच्छन्नो जरायौ मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: aṅgapratyaṅgasampūrṇaḥ paripakvaḥ sa tiṣṭhati | udare māturācchanno jarāyau munisattama
verses.translation: According to another version his wife Sarupa gave birth to crores of Rudras such as Raivata, Aja, Bhava, Bhima, Varna, Ugra, Vrsakapi, Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Bahurupa, Mahat etc. Eleven of them are important. O sage, listen to their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to another version his wife Sarupa gave birth to crores of Rudras such as Raivata, Aja, Bhava, Bhima, Varna, Ugra, Vrsakapi, Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Bahurupa, Mahat etc. Eleven of them are important. O sage, listen to their names.

verses.sanskrit: मातुराहारचौर्येण षड्विधेन रसेन तु । नाभिनालनिबद्धेन वर्द्धते स दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: māturāhāracauryeṇa ṣaḍvidhena rasena tu | nābhinālanibaddhena varddhate sa dine dine
verses.translation: The patriarch Viivakarma, son of Vasu Prabhasa, was the craftsman of the gods ancl entrusted with the work of building chariots, ornaments, palac<'s etc. MP 5. 27-V8, Sec note 295.
verses.commentary: Sense: The patriarch Viivakarma, son of Vasu Prabhasa, was the craftsman of the gods ancl entrusted with the work of building chariots, ornaments, palac<'s etc. MP 5. 27-V8, Sec note 295.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्मृतिं लभेज्जीवः सम्पूर्णेऽस्मिन् शरीरके । सुखं दुःखं विजानाति निद्रास्वप्नं पुराकृतम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ smṛtiṃ labhejjīvaḥ sampūrṇe'smin śarīrake | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vijānāti nidrāsvapnaṃ purākṛtam
verses.translation: These eleven are the Rudras, lords of the three worlds viz: — Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Tvastr, the powerful Rudrahara of many forms, Tryambaka, Aparajita, Vr§akapi, ambhu, Kapardin and Raivata.®
verses.commentary: Sense: These eleven are the Rudras, lords of the three worlds viz: — Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Tvastr, the powerful Rudrahara of many forms, Tryambaka, Aparajita, Vr§akapi, ambhu, Kapardin and Raivata.®

verses.sanskrit: मृतश्चाहं पुनर्जातो जातश्चाहं पुनर्मृतः । नानायोनिसहस्राणि मया दृष्टानि जायता
verses.transliteration: mṛtaścāhaṃ punarjāto jātaścāhaṃ punarmṛtaḥ | nānāyonisahasrāṇi mayā dṛṣṭāni jāyatā
verses.translation: Thus a hundred Rudras of immense prowess have been mentioned to you. Now listen to the names of Kayapa's wives, O excellent sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus a hundred Rudras of immense prowess have been mentioned to you. Now listen to the names of Kayapa's wives, O excellent sage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधुना जातमात्रोऽहं प्राप्तसंस्कार एव च । श्रेयोऽमुना करिष्यामि येन गर्भे न सम्भवः
verses.transliteration: adhunā jātamātro'haṃ prāptasaṃskāra eva ca | śreyo'munā kariṣyāmi yena garbhe na sambhavaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin, they are Aditi, Surasa, Aristela, Danti, Surabhi, Vinata, Ila, Tamra, Krodhavasa, Kadru and Muni. Now listen to the names of their sons. In the previous excellent Manvantara twelve excellent gods were born.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, they are Aditi, Surasa, Aristela, Danti, Surabhi, Vinata, Ila, Tamra, Krodhavasa, Kadru and Muni. Now listen to the names of their sons. In the previous excellent Manvantara twelve excellent gods were born.
