verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थश्चिन्तयन्नेवमहं गर्भाद्विनिःसृतः । अन्वेष्यामि शिवज्ञानं संसारविनिवर्तकम्
verses.transliteration: garbhasthaścintayannevamahaṃ garbhādviniḥsṛtaḥ | anveṣyāmi śivajñānaṃ saṃsāravinivartakam
verses.translation: They are Tusitas. During the intervening period of the Vaivasvata and Gaksusa Manvantaras they consulted one another for the welfare of the worlds. After meeting together they spoke — "We will enter Aditi and be born. This will happen for the welfare of the gods." After con¬ ferring they were born of Aditi daughter of Daksa and Kasyapa son of Marici. Visnu and Indra were born again.
verses.wordMeaning: They are Tusitas. During the intervening period of the Vaivasvata and Gaksusa Manvantaras they consulted one another for the welfare of the worlds. After meeting together they spoke — "We will enter Aditi and be born.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं स गर्भदुःखेन महता परिपीडितः । जीवः कर्मवशादास्ते मोक्षोपायं विचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa garbhaduḥkhena mahatā paripīḍitaḥ | jīvaḥ karmavaśādāste mokṣopāyaṃ vicintayan
verses.translation: They along with Aryaman, Dhatr, Tvastr, Pusan, Vivasvat, Savitr, Mitravaruna, Arhsa, Bhaga and Atilejas are the twelve Adityas. Those who were born before as Tusitas were born again as the twelve Adityas in the Gaksusa Manvantara, O aunaka thus the names of Aditi's sons have been mentioned to you. •

verses.sanskrit: यथा गिरिवराक्रान्तः कश्चिद्दुःखेन तिष्ठति । तथा जरायुणा देही दुःखं तिष्ठति वेष्टितः
verses.transliteration: yathā girivarākrāntaḥ kaścidduḥkhena tiṣṭhati | tathā jarāyuṇā dehī duḥkhaṃ tiṣṭhati veṣṭitaḥ
verses.translation: The children of Aristanemi's wives were shcteen in number. "O celestial sage, the learned Krsava had many sons. Four of them are known as Devapraharana. O sage, in his wife Arcis, Dhumrakesa too was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The children of Aristanemi's wives were shcteen in number. "O celestial sage, the learned Krsava had many sons. Four of them are known as Devapraharana. O sage, in his wife Arcis, Dhumrakesa too was born.

verses.sanskrit: पतितः सागरे यद्वद्दुःखमास्ते समाकुलः । गर्भोदकेन सिक्ताङ्गः सर्वदाकुलितस्तदा
verses.transliteration: patitaḥ sāgare yadvadduḥkhamāste samākulaḥ | garbhodakena siktāṅgaḥ sarvadākulitastadā
verses.translation: Two wives were Svadha and Sati of whom Svadha was the elder and Sati the younger. Svadha gave birth to the Pitrs and Sati to the Atharvarigirasaveda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two wives were Svadha and Sati of whom Svadha was the elder and Sati the younger. Svadha gave birth to the Pitrs and Sati to the Atharvarigirasaveda.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोहकुम्भे यथा न्यस्तः पच्यते कश्चिदग्निना । गर्भकुम्भे तथा क्षिप्तः पच्यते जठराग्निना
verses.transliteration: lohakumbhe yathā nyastaḥ pacyate kaścidagninā | garbhakumbhe tathā kṣiptaḥ pacyate jaṭharāgninā
verses.translation: At the end of a thousand Yugas these will be born again. All the groups of the gods are ihirtythree.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of a thousand Yugas these will be born again. All the groups of the gods are ihirtythree.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिर्निर्भिन्नस्य निरन्तरम् । यद्दुःखं जायते तस्य तत्र संस्थस्य चाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: sūcībhiragnivarṇābhirnirbhinnasya nirantaram | yadduḥkhaṃ jāyate tasya tatra saṃsthasya cādhikam
verses.translation: Just as the sun rises and sets every day so also the groups of gods are born in every Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the sun rises and sets every day so also the groups of gods are born in every Yuga.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गर्भावासात्परं दुःखं कष्टं नैवास्ति कुत्रचित् । देहिनां दुःखबहुलं सुघोरमतिसङ्कटम्
verses.transliteration: garbhāvāsātparaṃ duḥkhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ naivāsti kutracit | dehināṃ duḥkhabahulaṃ sughoramatisaṅkaṭam
verses.translation: We have heard that Hiranyakasipu and Hiranyaksa were born as the sons of Dili and Kasyapa.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that Hiranyakasipu and Hiranyaksa were born as the sons of Dili and Kasyapa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्सुमहद्दुःखं पापिनां परिकीर्तितम् । केवलं धर्मबुध्दीनां सप्तमासैर्भवः सदा
verses.transliteration: ityetatsumahadduḥkhaṃ pāpināṃ parikīrtitam | kevalaṃ dharmabudhdīnāṃ saptamāsairbhavaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Siihhika their daughter became the wife of Vipra- citti. The four sons of Hiranyakasipu were famous for their strength and prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siihhika their daughter became the wife of Vipra- citti. The four sons of Hiranyakasipu were famous for their strength and prowess.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गर्भात्सुदुर्लभं दुःखं योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात् । भवेत्पापात्मनां व्यास न हि धर्मयुतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: garbhātsudurlabhaṃ duḥkhaṃ yoniyantranipīḍanāt | bhavetpāpātmanāṃ vyāsa na hi dharmayutātmanām
verses.translation: They are Anuhrada, Hrada, Sariihrada and Prahlada. The youngest Prahlada wai a devotee of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Anuhrada, Hrada, Sariihrada and Prahlada. The youngest Prahlada wai a devotee of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: इक्षुवत्पीड्यमानस्य यन्त्रेणैव समन्ततः । शिरसा ताड्यमानस्य पापमुद्गरकेण च
verses.transliteration: ikṣuvatpīḍyamānasya yantreṇaiva samantataḥ | śirasā tāḍyamānasya pāpamudgarakeṇa ca
verses.translation: Puloman and Mahisa were the sons of Anuhrada born of Surya. Hrada's wife Dhamani gave birth to Vatapi and Ilvala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Puloman and Mahisa were the sons of Anuhrada born of Surya. Hrada's wife Dhamani gave birth to Vatapi and Ilvala.

verses.sanskrit: यन्त्रेण पीडिता यद्वन्निःसाराः स्स्युस्तिलाः क्षणात् । तथा शरीरं निस्सारं योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात्
verses.transliteration: yantreṇa pīḍitā yadvanniḥsārāḥ ssyustilāḥ kṣaṇāt | tathā śarīraṃ nissāraṃ yoniyantranipīḍanāt
verses.translation: Samhrada's wife Ryti gave birth to Paftcajana. Virocana was the son of Prahlada. Bali was born of his queen Devi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samhrada's wife Ryti gave birth to Paftcajana. Virocana was the son of Prahlada. Bali was born of his queen Devi.

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिपादतुलास्तम्भं स्नायुबन्धेन यन्त्रितम् । रक्तमांसमृदालिप्तं विण्मूत्रद्रव्यभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: asthipādatulāstambhaṃ snāyubandhena yantritam | raktamāṃsamṛdāliptaṃ viṇmūtradravyabhājanam
verses.translation: O great sage, Bali begot hundred sons of his wife Asana. He was a great devotee of Siva. He engaged himself in the activities of devotion to Siva. He was chari¬ tably inclined and liberal-minded. He attained meritorious fame and austerity. His son Bana was foremost among the devotees of Siva. By propititing Siva he attained the leader¬ ship of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: केशरोमनखच्छन्नं रोगायतनमातुरम् । वदनैकमहाद्वारं गवाक्षाष्टकभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: keśaromanakhacchannaṃ rogāyatanamāturam | vadanaikamahādvāraṃ gavākṣāṣṭakabhūṣitam
verses.translation: Prabha was the daughter of Svarbhanu. Sad was the daughter of Puloman. So also Upadanavi, Hayasira and Sarmistha were daughters of Vrsaparvan. Puloma and Pulomika were the daughters of Vaisvanara. They were the wives of Kasyapa son of Marici and had many heroic sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prabha was the daughter of Svarbhanu. Sad was the daughter of Puloman. So also Upadanavi, Hayasira and Sarmistha were daughters of Vrsaparvan. Puloma and Pulomika were the daughters of Vaisvanara. They were the wives of Kasyapa son of Marici and had many heroic sons.

verses.sanskrit: ओष्ठद्वयकपाटं च तथा जिह्वार्गलान्वितम् । भोगतृष्णातुरं मूढं रागद्वेषवशानुगम्
verses.transliteration: oṣṭhadvayakapāṭaṃ ca tathā jihvārgalānvitam | bhogatṛṣṇāturaṃ mūḍhaṃ rāgadveṣavaśānugam
verses.translation: Kalakhanjas, the powerful sons of Puloma, lived in Hiranyapura.® They could not be killed either by the Danavas or by the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalakhanjas, the powerful sons of Puloma, lived in Hiranyapura.® They could not be killed either by the Danavas or by the gods.

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तिताङ्गप्रत्यङ्गं जरायुपरिवेष्टितम् । सङ्कटेनाविविक्तेन योनिमार्गेण निर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvartitāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ jarāyupariveṣṭitam | saṅkaṭenāviviktena yonimārgeṇa nirgatam
verses.translation: Vipracitti's sons, born of Sirhhika, were later killed by Arjuna by the grace of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vipracitti's sons, born of Sirhhika, were later killed by Arjuna by the grace of Brahma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्ररक्तसिक्ताङ्गं विकोशिकसमुद्भवम् । अस्थिपञ्जरविख्यातमस्मिन् ज्ञेयं कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: viṇmūtraraktasiktāṅgaṃ vikośikasamudbhavam | asthipañjaravikhyātamasmin jñeyaṃ kalevaram
verses.translation: Due to the intermixture of Daityas and Danavas the.se sons became valorous and famous as Saimhikeyas. They arc thirteen in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the intermixture of Daityas and Danavas the.se sons became valorous and famous as Saimhikeyas. They arc thirteen in number.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतत्रयं षष्ट्यधिकं पञ्च पेशीशतानि च । सार्धाभिस्तिसृभिश्छन्नं समन्ताद्रोमकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ pañca peśīśatāni ca | sārdhābhistisṛbhiśchannaṃ samantādromakoṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: They were the very powerful Rahu and Salya, Bala, Mahabala, Vatapi, Namuci, Ilvala, Svasrpa, Ajika, Naraka, Kalanabha, Saramana and Sarakalpa. These in¬ creased their races.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the very powerful Rahu and Salya, Bala, Mahabala, Vatapi, Namuci, Ilvala, Svasrpa, Ajika, Naraka, Kalanabha, Saramana and Sarakalpa. These in¬ creased their races.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं स्थूलसूक्ष्माभिर्दृश्यादृश्या हि ताः स्मृताः । एतावतीभिर्नाडीभिः कोटिभिस्तत्समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ sthūlasūkṣmābhirdṛśyādṛśyā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ | etāvatībhirnāḍībhiḥ koṭibhistatsamantataḥ
verses.translation: Many sons and grandsons were born of them increas¬ ing the race of Danu. Being innumerable they are not mentioned in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many sons and grandsons were born of them increas¬ ing the race of Danu. Being innumerable they are not mentioned in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्वेदमधुभिर्याभिरन्तस्थः स्रवते बहिः । द्वात्रिंशद्दशनाः प्रोक्ता विंशतिश्च नखाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: asvedamadhubhiryābhirantasthaḥ sravate bahiḥ | dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ proktā viṃśatiśca nakhāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: In the family of Sarhhrada the Daiteyas Nivatakavacas and Maruts were born and they were purified by penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the family of Sarhhrada the Daiteyas Nivatakavacas and Maruts were born and they were purified by penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पित्तस्य कुडवं ज्ञेयं कफस्याथाढकं स्मृतम् । वसायाश्च पलं विंशत्तदर्धं कपिलस्य च
verses.transliteration: pittasya kuḍavaṃ jñeyaṃ kaphasyāthāḍhakaṃ smṛtam | vasāyāśca palaṃ viṃśattadardhaṃ kapilasya ca
verses.translation: Sanmukha and others are glorified as the sons of Tamra. Kaki, iSyeni, Bhasi, Sugrivi, Suki, Grdhrika, Asvi, and
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanmukha and others are glorified as the sons of Tamra. Kaki, iSyeni, Bhasi, Sugrivi, Suki, Grdhrika, Asvi, and

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चार्द्धं तु तुला ज्ञेया पलानि दश मेदसः । पलत्रयं महारक्तं मज्जायाश्च चतुर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: pañcārddhaṃ tu tulā jñeyā palāni daśa medasaḥ | palatrayaṃ mahāraktaṃ majjāyāśca caturguṇam
verses.translation: This city of the Pauloina.s and Kalakhanjas (or Kalakeyas) as mentioned in the Mhabliarata (Vana P. GLXXIII. 13) and the Kathasaritsagara (XLV. 135) stood on the sca-routc leading to PalSla. Its exact locus remains still unidentified.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रोऽर्द्धं कुडवं ज्ञेयं तद्बीजं देहिनां बलम् । मांसस्य चैकपिण्डेन पलसाहस्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śukro'rddhaṃ kuḍavaṃ jñeyaṃ tadbījaṃ dehināṃ balam | māṃsasya caikapiṇḍena palasāhasramucyate
verses.translation: Syienl gave birth to vultures, Bhasi to Bhasas Grdhri to Grdhrakas. SukI gave birth to parrots and Sugrlvl to auspicious birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Syienl gave birth to vultures, Bhasi to Bhasas Grdhri to Grdhrakas. SukI gave birth to parrots and Sugrlvl to auspicious birds.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं पलशतं ज्ञेयं विण्मूत्रं यत्प्रमाणतः । अञ्जलयश्च चत्वारश्चत्वारो मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: raktaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ yatpramāṇataḥ | añjalayaśca catvāraścatvāro munisattama
verses.translation: Surasa gave birth to a thousand serpents of immeasurable power. They had many hoods. They were powerful enough to traverse the sky, the important among them were the kings Sesa, Vasuki and Taksaka, Airavata, Mahapadma, Kambala and Asvatara. The sons of Aila were Padma, Karkotaka, Dhanafijaya, Mahanila, Mahakarna, Dhrtarastra, Balahaka, Kuhara, Puspadanta, Durmukha, Sumukha, Khararoman, Kharapani and many others.

verses.sanskrit: इति देहगृहं ह्येतन्नित्यस्यानित्यमात्मनः । अविशुद्धं विशुद्धस्य कर्मबन्धाद्विनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: iti dehagṛhaṃ hyetannityasyānityamātmanaḥ | aviśuddhaṃ viśuddhasya karmabandhādvinirmitam
verses.translation: Krodhavasa gave birth to many who. were the fanged animals and birds both of land and water. Vara's sons were animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krodhavasa gave birth to many who. were the fanged animals and birds both of land and water. Vara's sons were animals.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The pious fair-comlexioned lady conceived. She began to observe celibacy and other restraints.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pious fair-comlexioned lady conceived. She began to observe celibacy and other restraints.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The pious fair-comlexioned lady conceived. She began to observe celibacy and other restraints.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pious fair-comlexioned lady conceived. She began to observe celibacy and other restraints.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । देहाशुचित्वबाल्याद्यवस्थादुःखवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । शृणु व्यास महाबुद्धे देहस्याशुचितां मुने । महत्त्वं च स्वभावस्य समासात्कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.23. trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dehāśucitvabālyādyavasthāduḥkhavarṇanam | sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa mahābuddhe dehasyāśucitāṃ mune | mahattvaṃ ca svabhāvasya samāsātkathayāmyaham
verses.translation: \fter impregnating Diti, Kasyapa of noble sacred rites went away satisfied for the performance of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: \fter impregnating Diti, Kasyapa of noble sacred rites went away satisfied for the performance of penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रशोणितसंयोगाद्देहः सञ्जायते यतः । नित्यं विण्मूत्रसम्पूर्णस्तेनायमशुचिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śukraśoṇitasaṃyogāddehaḥ sañjāyate yataḥ | nityaṃ viṇmūtrasampūrṇastenāyamaśuciḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After crowning Prthu the son of Vena in the emperorship, Brahma began to assign the kingdoms in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: After crowning Prthu the son of Vena in the emperorship, Brahma began to assign the kingdoms in due order.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथान्तर्विष्ठया पूर्णः शुचिमान्न बहिर्घटः । शोध्यमानो हि देहोऽयं तेनायमशुचिस्ततः
verses.transliteration: yathāntarviṣṭhayā pūrṇaḥ śucimānna bahirghaṭaḥ | śodhyamāno hi deho'yaṃ tenāyamaśucistataḥ
verses.translation: He crowned the indefatigable son of Parjanya the patriarch, Hiranyaroman, in the kingdom in the north.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned the indefatigable son of Parjanya the patriarch, Hiranyaroman, in the kingdom in the north.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्याति पवित्राणि पञ्चगव्यं हवींषि च । अशुचित्वं क्षणाद्यान्ति किमन्यदशुचिस्ततः
verses.transliteration: samprāpyāti pavitrāṇi pañcagavyaṃ havīṃṣi ca | aśucitvaṃ kṣaṇādyānti kimanyadaśucistataḥ
verses.translation: O sage, the second Manvantara has been men¬ tioned by me. I shall explain the third one. Know it factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the second Manvantara has been men¬ tioned by me. I shall explain the third one. Know it factually.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हृद्यान्यप्यन्नपानानि यं प्राप्य सुरभीणि च । अशुचित्वं प्रयान्त्याशु किमन्यदशुचिस्ततः
verses.transliteration: hṛdyānyapyannapānāni yaṃ prāpya surabhīṇi ca | aśucitvaṃ prayāntyāśu kimanyadaśucistataḥ
verses.translation: !§aradvat son of Gautama, Gautama, Krpa, Kauika, Galava, Ruru and Kayapa will be future seven sages. The future gods are three in number as mentioned by Svayambhu. They are the sons of the noble-souled KaSyapa the son of Marici. Bali the son of Virocana will become their Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: !§aradvat son of Gautama, Gautama, Krpa, Kauika, Galava, Ruru and Kayapa will be future seven sages. The future gods are three in number as mentioned by Svayambhu. They are the sons of the noble-souled KaSyapa the son of Marici. Bali the son of Virocana will become their Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हे जनाः किन्न पश्यन्ति यन्निर्याति दिने दिने । स्वदेहात्कश्मलं पूतिस्तदाधारः कथं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: he janāḥ kinna paśyanti yanniryāti dine dine | svadehātkaśmalaṃ pūtistadādhāraḥ kathaṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: The groups of gods are three in number as
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of gods are three in number as
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देहः सशोध्यमानोऽपि पञ्चगव्यकुशाम्बुभिः । घृष्यमाण इवाङ्गारो निर्मलत्वं न गच्छति
verses.transliteration: dehaḥ saśodhyamāno'pi pañcagavyakuśāmbubhiḥ | ghṛṣyamāṇa ivāṅgāro nirmalatvaṃ na gacchati
verses.translation: Lord Rudra annihilates them I shall explain it at the end of Vaivasvata Kalpa. Thus I have mentioned all about the Manvantaras to you. It is a,holy narrative condu- sive to wealth and increase of the family.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Rudra annihilates them I shall explain it at the end of Vaivasvata Kalpa. Thus I have mentioned all about the Manvantaras to you. It is a,holy narrative condu- sive to wealth and increase of the family.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्रोतांसि यस्य सततं प्रभवन्ति गिरेरिव । कफमूत्रपुरीषाद्यैः स देहः शुध्यते कथम्
verses.transliteration: srotāṃsi yasya satataṃ prabhavanti gireriva | kaphamūtrapurīṣādyaiḥ sa dehaḥ śudhyate katham
verses.translation: Due to the unbearable heat of her husband she in her prime of youth was dissatisfied.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the unbearable heat of her husband she in her prime of youth was dissatisfied.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाशुचिनिधानस्य शरीरस्य न विद्यते । शुचिरेकः प्रदेशोऽपि विण्मूत्रस्य दृतेरिव
verses.transliteration: sarvāśucinidhānasya śarīrasya na vidyate | śucirekaḥ pradeśo'pi viṇmūtrasya dṛteriva
verses.translation: Being scorched and not being able to hear the brilliance of the lustrous sun, the fair-complexioned lady was excited and sorrowful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being scorched and not being able to hear the brilliance of the lustrous sun, the fair-complexioned lady was excited and sorrowful.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्वात्मदेहस्रोतांसि मृत्तोयैः शोध्यते करः । तथाप्यशुचिभाण्डस्य न विभ्रश्यति किं करः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭvātmadehasrotāṃsi mṛttoyaiḥ śodhyate karaḥ | tathāpyaśucibhāṇḍasya na vibhraśyati kiṃ karaḥ
verses.translation: Indra waited for finding out a weak point in her. He found one such when the period of hundred years was short by a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra waited for finding out a weak point in her. He found one such when the period of hundred years was short by a year.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कायः सुगन्धधूपाद्यैर्यत्नेनापि सुसंस्कृतः । न जहाति स्वभावं स श्वपुच्छमिव नामितम्
verses.transliteration: kāyaḥ sugandhadhūpādyairyatnenāpi susaṃskṛtaḥ | na jahāti svabhāvaṃ sa śvapucchamiva nāmitam
verses.translation: Due to the gravity of the event destined to happen, once Diti did not wash her feet. She went to sleep with head hanging down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the gravity of the event destined to happen, once Diti did not wash her feet. She went to sleep with head hanging down.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा जात्यैव कृष्णोर्थः शुक्लः स्स्यान्नह्युपायतः । संशोद्ध्यमानापि तथा भवेन्मूर्तिर्न निर्मला
verses.transliteration: yathā jātyaiva kṛṣṇorthaḥ śuklaḥ ssyānnahyupāyataḥ | saṃśoddhyamānāpi tathā bhavenmūrtirna nirmalā
verses.translation: In the meantime Indra entered her belly with the thunderbolt. He cut off the foetus into seven pieces.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Indra entered her belly with the thunderbolt. He cut off the foetus into seven pieces.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जिघ्रन्नपि स्वदुर्गन्धं पश्यन्नपि स्वकं मलम् । न विरज्येत लोकोऽयं पीडयन्नपि नासिकाम्
verses.transliteration: jighrannapi svadurgandhaṃ paśyannapi svakaṃ malam | na virajyeta loko'yaṃ pīḍayannapi nāsikām
verses.translation: While being split into seven the foetus began to cry in seven different tones. Indra told the foetus "Do not cry, Do not cry" repeatedly. He cut them again but they did not die.
verses.commentary: Sense: While being split into seven the foetus began to cry in seven different tones. Indra told the foetus "Do not cry, Do not cry" repeatedly. He cut them again but they did not die.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो मोहस्य माहात्म्यं येनेदं छादितं जगत् । शीघ्रं पश्यन् स्वकं दोषं कायस्य न विरज्यते
verses.transliteration: aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ yenedaṃ chāditaṃ jagat | śīghraṃ paśyan svakaṃ doṣaṃ kāyasya na virajyate
verses.translation: O sage, being felled down they told him with
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, being felled down they told him with
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेहस्य विगन्धेन न विरज्येत यो नरः । विरागकारणं तस्य किमेतदुपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: svadehasya vigandhena na virajyeta yo naraḥ | virāgakāraṇaṃ tasya kimetadupadiśyate
verses.translation: For full details of the legend see MP. Ch. 7.
verses.commentary: Sense: For full details of the legend see MP. Ch. 7.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्यैव जगन्मध्ये देह एवाशुचिर्भवेत् । तन्मलावयवस्पर्शाच्छुचिरप्यशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasyaiva jaganmadhye deha evāśucirbhavet | tanmalāvayavasparśācchucirapyaśucirbhavet
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, at the will of Siva, they eschewed their Daitya nature. They were accepted by Indra with due fraternity.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin sage, at the will of Siva, they eschewed their Daitya nature. They were accepted by Indra with due fraternity.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धलेपापनोदार्थ शौचं देहस्य कीर्तितम् । द्वयस्यापगमाच्छुद्धिः शुद्धस्पर्शाद्विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: gandhalepāpanodārtha śaucaṃ dehasya kīrtitam | dvayasyāpagamācchuddhiḥ śuddhasparśādviśudhyati
verses.translation: In the name of Maruts they became gods of great prowess. Thus traversing the sky the fortynine Maruts be¬ came assistants of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the name of Maruts they became gods of great prowess. Thus traversing the sky the fortynine Maruts be¬ came assistants of Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातोयेन सर्वेण मृद्भारैः पर्वतोपमैः । आमृत्योराचरेच्छौचं भावदुष्टो न शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātoyena sarveṇa mṛdbhāraiḥ parvatopamaiḥ | āmṛtyorācarecchaucaṃ bhāvaduṣṭo na śudhyati
verses.translation: When they flourished, Visnu the patriarch, offered them kingdoms beginning with Prthu. Listen to that.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they flourished, Visnu the patriarch, offered them kingdoms beginning with Prthu. Listen to that.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थस्नानैस्तपोभिर्वा दुष्टात्मा नैव शुध्यति । श्वदृतिः क्षालिता तीर्थे किं शुद्धिमधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: tīrthasnānaistapobhirvā duṣṭātmā naiva śudhyati | śvadṛtiḥ kṣālitā tīrthe kiṃ śuddhimadhigacchati
verses.translation: O great sage, I have explained the creation of living beings to you. Listen to the division of kingdoms. I shall explain that duly now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, I have explained the creation of living beings to you. Listen to the division of kingdoms. I shall explain that duly now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्भावप्रदुष्टस्य विशतोऽपि हुताशनम् । न स्वर्गो नापवर्गश्च देहनिर्दहनं परम्
verses.transliteration: antarbhāvapraduṣṭasya viśato'pi hutāśanam | na svargo nāpavargaśca dehanirdahanaṃ param
verses.translation: He crowned Soma in the kingdom of birds,
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Soma in the kingdom of birds,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेण गाङ्गेन जलेन सम्यङ् मृत्पर्वतेनाप्यथ भावदुष्टः । आजन्मनः स्नानपरो मनुष्यो न शुध्यतीत्येव वयं वदामः
verses.transliteration: sarveṇa gāṅgena jalena samyaṅ mṛtparvatenāpyatha bhāvaduṣṭaḥ | ājanmanaḥ snānaparo manuṣyo na śudhyatītyeva vayaṃ vadāmaḥ
verses.translation: He crowned Varuna in the kingdom of waters; Vairavana as the lord of kings; Visnu as the lord of Aditvas and Pavaka as the lord of Vasus.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Varuna in the kingdom of waters; Vairavana as the lord of kings; Visnu as the lord of Aditvas and Pavaka as the lord of Vasus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्वाल्य वह्निं घृततैलसिक्तं प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखं महान्तम् । प्रविश्य दग्धस्त्वपि भावदुष्टो न धर्ममाप्नोति फलं न चान्यत्
verses.transliteration: prajvālya vahniṃ ghṛtatailasiktaṃ pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhaṃ mahāntam | praviśya dagdhastvapi bhāvaduṣṭo na dharmamāpnoti phalaṃ na cānyat
verses.translation: He crowned Daksa as the lord of patriarchs, Indra as the lord of Maruts, and Prahlada of great strength as the lord of Daityas and Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Daksa as the lord of patriarchs, Indra as the lord of Maruts, and Prahlada of great strength as the lord of Daityas and Danavas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गादितीर्थेषु वसन्ति मत्स्या देवालये पक्षिगणाश्च नित्यम् । भावोज्झितास्ते न फलं लभन्ते तीर्थावगाहाच्च तथैव दानात्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāditīrtheṣu vasanti matsyā devālaye pakṣigaṇāśca nityam | bhāvojjhitāste na phalaṃ labhante tīrthāvagāhācca tathaiva dānāt
verses.translation: He crowned Vaivasvata Yama in the kingdom of Pitrs, Matrs, Vratas, Mantras and cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Vaivasvata Yama in the kingdom of Pitrs, Matrs, Vratas, Mantras and cows.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भावशुद्धिः परं शौचं प्रमाणे सर्वकर्मसु । अन्यथालिङ्ग्यते कान्ता भावेन दुहितान्यथा
verses.transliteration: bhāvaśuddhiḥ paraṃ śaucaṃ pramāṇe sarvakarmasu | anyathāliṅgyate kāntā bhāvena duhitānyathā
verses.translation: He crowned the trident-bearing Siva, in the king¬ dom of Yaksas, Raksasas, kings, goblins and ghosts.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned the trident-bearing Siva, in the king¬ dom of Yaksas, Raksasas, kings, goblins and ghosts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनसो भिद्यते वृत्तिरभिन्नेष्वपि वस्तुषु । अन्यथैव सुतं नारी चिन्तयत्यन्यथा पतिम्
verses.transliteration: manaso bhidyate vṛttirabhinneṣvapi vastuṣu | anyathaiva sutaṃ nārī cintayatyanyathā patim
verses.translation: He crowned Himavat as the lord of mountains, the ocean of rivers, the tiger of deer and Bull as the 'lord of cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Himavat as the lord of mountains, the ocean of rivers, the tiger of deer and Bull as the 'lord of cows.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्यध्वमस्य भावस्य महाभाग्यमशेषतः । परिष्वक्तोऽपि यन्नार्या भावहीनं न कामयेत्
verses.transliteration: paśyadhvamasya bhāvasya mahābhāgyamaśeṣataḥ | pariṣvakto'pi yannāryā bhāvahīnaṃ na kāmayet
verses.translation: He crowned the banyan tree in the kingdom of plants and trees. Thus the kingdom was assigned every¬ where by the lord of subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned the banyan tree in the kingdom of plants and trees. Thus the kingdom was assigned every¬ where by the lord of subjects.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाद्याद्विविधमन्नाद्यं भक्ष्याणि सुरभीणि च । यदि चिन्तां समाधत्ते चित्ते कामादिषु त्रिषु
verses.transliteration: nādyādvividhamannādyaṃ bhakṣyāṇi surabhīṇi ca | yadi cintāṃ samādhatte citte kāmādiṣu triṣu
verses.translation: The lord of the universe, the soul of all, established the son of patriarch Vairaja in the kingdom in the east.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of the universe, the soul of all, established the son of patriarch Vairaja in the kingdom in the east.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृह्यते तेन भावेन नरो भावाद्विमुच्यते । भावतः शुचि शुद्धात्मा स्वर्गं मोक्षं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: gṛhyate tena bhāvena naro bhāvādvimucyate | bhāvataḥ śuci śuddhātmā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati
verses.translation: Similarly, O great king, he established Sudhanvan, son of Kardama, the patriarch, in the kingdom in the south.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, O great king, he established Sudhanvan, son of Kardama, the patriarch, in the kingdom in the south.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भावेनैकात्मशुद्धात्मा दहन् जुह्वन् स्तुवन् मृतः । ज्ञानावाप्तेरवाप्याशु लोकान् सुबहुयाजिनाम्
verses.transliteration: bhāvenaikātmaśuddhātmā dahan juhvan stuvan mṛtaḥ | jñānāvāpteravāpyāśu lokān subahuyājinām
verses.translation: The lord directed and assigned the unfailing noble- minded son of Rajas, Ketumat as the king in the kingdom in the west.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord directed and assigned the unfailing noble- minded son of Rajas, Ketumat as the king in the kingdom in the west.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानामलाम्भसा पुंसां सद्वैराग्यमृदा पुनः । अविद्यारागविण्मूत्रलेपगन्धविशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: jñānāmalāmbhasā puṃsāṃ sadvairāgyamṛdā punaḥ | avidyārāgaviṇmūtralepagandhaviśodhanam
verses.translation: O great sage, six Manus have already been mentioned to you viz. Svayambhuva, Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa, Raivata and Gakua. The present Manu is called Vaivasvata, O great sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, six Manus have already been mentioned to you viz. Svayambhuva, Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa, Raivata and Gakua. The present Manu is called Vaivasvata, O great sage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतच्छरीरं हि निसर्गादशुचि स्मृतम् । त्वङ्मात्रसारं निःसारं कदलीसारसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: evametaccharīraṃ hi nisargādaśuci smṛtam | tvaṅmātrasāraṃ niḥsāraṃ kadalīsārasannibham
verses.translation: The Manus of future are Savarni, Raucya, Brahmasavarni, Dharmasavarni, Rudrasavarni, Devasavarni and Indraasvarni. All these constitute the Manus of the past, present and future. These have been enumerated by me as I have heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Manus of future are Savarni, Raucya, Brahmasavarni, Dharmasavarni, Rudrasavarni, Devasavarni and Indraasvarni. All these constitute the Manus of the past, present and future. These have been enumerated by me as I have heard.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वैवं दोषवद्देहं यः प्राज्ञः शिथिलो भवेत् । देहभोगोद्भवाद्भावाच्छमचित्तः प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: jñātvaivaṃ doṣavaddehaṃ yaḥ prājñaḥ śithilo bhavet | dehabhogodbhavādbhāvācchamacittaḥ prasannadhīḥ
verses.translation: O sage, these fourteen Manvantaras extending over the period past, present and the future have been mentioned to you. A Kalpa consisting of a thousand Yugas is constituted by these.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, these fourteen Manvantaras extending over the period past, present and the future have been mentioned to you. A Kalpa consisting of a thousand Yugas is constituted by these.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतिक्रामति संसारं जीवन्मुक्तः प्रजायते । संसारङ्कदलीसारदृढग्राह्यवतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: so'tikrāmati saṃsāraṃ jīvanmuktaḥ prajāyate | saṃsāraṅkadalīsāradṛḍhagrāhyavatiṣṭhate
verses.translation: O Saunaka, listen. I shall explain the sages, their sons and the gods; all are famous. Listen with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Saunaka, listen. I shall explain the sages, their sons and the gods; all are famous. Listen with pleasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतन्महाकष्टं जन्मदुःखं प्रकीर्तितम् । पुंसामज्ञानदोषेण नानाकर्मवशेन च
verses.transliteration: evametanmahākaṣṭaṃ janmaduḥkhaṃ prakīrtitam | puṃsāmajñānadoṣeṇa nānākarmavaśena ca
verses.translation: Marici, Atri, the holy lord Ahgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulastya and Vasistha — these seven are Brahma's sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici, Atri, the holy lord Ahgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulastya and Vasistha — these seven are Brahma's sons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्लोकार्धेन तु वक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं ग्रन्थकोटिभिः । ममेति परमं दुःखं न ममेति परं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: ślokārdhena tu vakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ granthakoṭibhiḥ | mameti paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ na mameti paraṃ sukham
verses.translation: O sage, the seven sages are in the northern quarter. In the Svayambhuva Manvantara there were the gods named Yamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the seven sages are in the northern quarter. In the Svayambhuva Manvantara there were the gods named Yamas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बहवोऽपीह राजानः परं लोकमितो गताः । निर्ममत्वसमेतास्तु बद्धाः शतसहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: bahavo'pīha rājānaḥ paraṃ lokamito gatāḥ | nirmamatvasametāstu baddhāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The ten noble-souled sons of Svayambhuva Manu were — Agnidhra, Agnibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyoti§mat, Dhrtimat, Havya, Savana and Subhra. O great sage, the Indra there was Yajfia.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ten noble-souled sons of Svayambhuva Manu were — Agnidhra, Agnibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyoti§mat, Dhrtimat, Havya, Savana and Subhra. O great sage, the Indra there was Yajfia.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थस्य स्मृतिर्यासीत्सा च तस्य प्रणश्यति । सम्मूर्छितेन दुःखेन योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात्
verses.transliteration: garbhasthasya smṛtiryāsītsā ca tasya praṇaśyati | sammūrchitena duḥkhena yoniyantranipīḍanāt
verses.translation: Thus O dear, the first divine Manvantara has been mentioned to you. I shall explain the second one. Know as it is.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus O dear, the first divine Manvantara has been mentioned to you. I shall explain the second one. Know as it is.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बाह्येन वायुना वास्य मोहसङ्गेन देहिनः । स्पृष्टमात्रेण घोरेण ज्वरः समुपजायते
verses.transliteration: bāhyena vāyunā vāsya mohasaṅgena dehinaḥ | spṛṣṭamātreṇa ghoreṇa jvaraḥ samupajāyate
verses.translation: In the second Svarocisa Manvantara these must be known as the great sages, viz-Orjastambha, Parastambha, Rsabha, Vasumat, Jyotismat, Dyutimat and the seventh Rocismat. Then the Indra was Rocana. The gods were known as Tusitas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second Svarocisa Manvantara these must be known as the great sages, viz-Orjastambha, Parastambha, Rsabha, Vasumat, Jyotismat, Dyutimat and the seventh Rocismat. Then the Indra was Rocana. The gods were known as Tusitas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन ज्वरेण महता सम्मोहश्च प्रजायते । सम्मूढस्य स्मृतिभ्रंशः शीघ्रं सञ्जायते पुनः
verses.transliteration: tena jvareṇa mahatā sammohaśca prajāyate | sammūḍhasya smṛtibhraṃśaḥ śīghraṃ sañjāyate punaḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, the ten noble-minded sons of Svarocisa Manu, all of great heroism and exploits were Harighna, Sukrti, Jyotis, Ayomurti, Ayasmaya, Prathita, Manasyu, Nabha and Surya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, the ten noble-minded sons of Svarocisa Manu, all of great heroism and exploits were Harighna, Sukrti, Jyotis, Ayomurti, Ayasmaya, Prathita, Manasyu, Nabha and Surya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतिभ्रंशात्ततस्तस्य स्मृतिर्न्नो पूर्वकर्मणः । रतिः सञ्जायते तूर्णं जन्तोस्तत्रैव जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: smṛtibhraṃśāttatastasya smṛtirnno pūrvakarmaṇaḥ | ratiḥ sañjāyate tūrṇaṃ jantostatraiva janmani
verses.translation: Vasisjha's seven sons famous as Vasisthas and Hiranyagarbha's sons of great splendour known as Orjas are mentioned as the sages. Uttama the Manu had ten sons, O great sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasisjha's seven sons famous as Vasisthas and Hiranyagarbha's sons of great splendour known as Orjas are mentioned as the sages. Uttama the Manu had ten sons, O great sage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्तो मूढश्च लोकोऽयं न कार्ये सम्प्रवर्तते । न चात्मानं विजानाति न परं न च दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: rakto mūḍhaśca loko'yaṃ na kārye sampravartate | na cātmānaṃ vijānāti na paraṃ na ca daivatam
verses.translation: They were Isa, Crjita, Crja, Madhu, Madhava Suci, Sukravaha, Nabhasa, Nabha and Rsabha. The gods were Satyavedaruta and others. O sage, the Indra then was Satyajit. He was the ruler of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Isa, Crjita, Crja, Madhu, Madhava Suci, Sukravaha, Nabhasa, Nabha and Rsabha. The gods were Satyavedaruta and others. O sage, the Indra then was Satyajit. He was the ruler of the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति परं श्रेयः सति कर्णेऽपि सन्मुने । न पश्यति परं श्रेयः सति चक्षुषि तत्क्षमे
verses.transliteration: na śṛṇoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati karṇe'pi sanmune | na paśyati paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi tatkṣame
verses.translation: The great third Manvantara has been explained. O sage, listen. I shall mention the fourth Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great third Manvantara has been explained. O sage, listen. I shall mention the fourth Manvantara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समे पथि शनैर्गच्छन् स्खलतीव पदे पदे । सत्यां बुद्धौ न जानाति बोध्यमानो बुधैरपि
verses.transliteration: same pathi śanairgacchan skhalatīva pade pade | satyāṃ buddhau na jānāti bodhyamāno budhairapi
verses.translation: The seven sages were Gargya, Prthu, Vagmin, Janya, Dhata, Kapinaka and the seventh Kapivat. The groups of gods were Satyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sages were Gargya, Prthu, Vagmin, Janya, Dhata, Kapinaka and the seventh Kapivat. The groups of gods were Satyas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संसारे क्लिश्यते तेन गर्भलोभवशानुगः । गर्भस्मृतेन पापेन समुज्झितमतिः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: saṃsāre kliśyate tena garbhalobhavaśānugaḥ | garbhasmṛtena pāpena samujjhitamatiḥ pumān
verses.translation: The Indra there was TriSikha. O sage, listen to the names of Manu's sons. The ten sons of great rites of the Mam' Tamasa were Dyutipota, Sautapasya, Tapahula, Tapana, Taporali, Akalmasa, Dhanvin, Khadgin, Mahat and Rsi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Indra there was TriSikha. O sage, listen to the names of Manu's sons. The ten sons of great rites of the Mam' Tamasa were Dyutipota, Sautapasya, Tapahula, Tapana, Taporali, Akalmasa, Dhanvin, Khadgin, Mahat and Rsi.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं महत्परं दिव्यं शास्त्रमुक्तं शिवेन तु । तपसः कथनार्थाय स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ mahatparaṃ divyaṃ śāstramuktaṃ śivena tu | tapasaḥ kathanārthāya svargamokṣaprasādhanam
verses.translation: The fourth Manvantara of Tamasa Manu has been mentioned to you. O dear, now listen to the great fifth Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fourth Manvantara of Tamasa Manu has been mentioned to you. O dear, now listen to the great fifth Manvantara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये सत्यस्मिन् शिवे ज्ञाने सर्वकामार्थसाधने । न कुर्वन्त्यात्मनः श्रेयस्तदेव महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: ye satyasmin śive jñāne sarvakāmārthasādhane | na kurvantyātmanaḥ śreyastadeva mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: Devabahu, Jaya, the sage VedaSiras, Hiran- yaroman, Parjanya, Drdhva Bahu, Somapa — Thcse and others constituted the seven sages. They were engaged in truth. The gods were Bhutarajasas of the nature of performing penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devabahu, Jaya, the sage VedaSiras, Hiran- yaroman, Parjanya, Drdhva Bahu, Somapa — Thcse and others constituted the seven sages. They were engaged in truth. The gods were Bhutarajasas of the nature of performing penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तेन्द्रियवृत्तित्वाद् बाल्ये दुःखं महत्पुनः । इच्छन्नपि न शक्नोति वक्तुं कर्तुं प्रतिक्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktendriyavṛttitvād bālye duḥkhaṃ mahatpunaḥ | icchannapi na śaknoti vaktuṃ kartuṃ pratikriyām
verses.translation: Osage, Arjuna, Pahktivindhya and others shall be known as his sons. They are endowed with great penance. They stay on the mountain Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Osage, Arjuna, Pahktivindhya and others shall be known as his sons. They are endowed with great penance. They stay on the mountain Meru.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दन्तोत्थाने महद्दुःखमल्पेन व्याधिना तथा । बालरोगैश्च विविधैः पीडा बालग्रहैरपि
verses.transliteration: dantotthāne mahadduḥkhamalpena vyādhinā tathā | bālarogaiśca vividhaiḥ pīḍā bālagrahairapi
verses.translation: The future Manus in this Kalpa will be seven. The future great sages will also be seven in each Manvantara in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The future Manus in this Kalpa will be seven. The future great sages will also be seven in each Manvantara in the heaven.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्क्षुत्तृट्परीताङ्गः क्वचित्तिष्ठति संरटन् । विण्मूत्रभक्षणाद्यं च मोहाद् बालः समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: kvacitkṣuttṛṭparītāṅgaḥ kvacittiṣṭhati saṃraṭan | viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇādyaṃ ca mohād bālaḥ samācaret
verses.translation: Rama, Vyasa, Atrcya, Diptimat, SubahuSruta, Bharadvaja, and the lustrous Asvatthaman son of Drona will be seven sages in this Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, Vyasa, Atrcya, Diptimat, SubahuSruta, Bharadvaja, and the lustrous Asvatthaman son of Drona will be seven sages in this Manvantara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कौमारे कर्णपीडायां मातापित्रोश्च साधनैः । अक्षराध्ययनाद्यैश्च नानादुःखं प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: kaumāre karṇapīḍāyāṃ mātāpitrośca sādhanaiḥ | akṣarādhyayanādyaiśca nānāduḥkhaṃ pravartate
verses.translation: O iSaunaka, the future ten sons of Savarni the Manu will be Visahga, Avanivat, Sumanta, Dhrtimat, Vasu, Suri, Sura, Visnu, Raja and Sumati. Thus the eighth Manvantara has been mentioned. Now listen to the ninth Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O iSaunaka, the future ten sons of Savarni the Manu will be Visahga, Avanivat, Sumanta, Dhrtimat, Vasu, Suri, Sura, Visnu, Raja and Sumati. Thus the eighth Manvantara has been mentioned. Now listen to the ninth Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: बाल्ये दुःखमतीत्यैव पश्यन्नपि विमूढधीः । न कुर्वीतात्मनः श्रेयस्तदत्र महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: bālye duḥkhamatītyaiva paśyannapi vimūḍhadhīḥ | na kurvītātmanaḥ śreyastadatra mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: I shall mention Dakasavarni Manu at the out¬ set. Listen. Medhatithi, Paulastya, Vasu, Kasyapa, Jyoti§mat, Bhargava, Dhrtimat, Ahgiras, Savana son of Vasijha, Havya son of Atri, and Pulaha — these seven are the sages in the Rauhita Manvantara. O great sage, the groups of gods are three.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention Dakasavarni Manu at the out¬ set. Listen. Medhatithi, Paulastya, Vasu, Kasyapa, Jyoti§mat, Bhargava, Dhrtimat, Ahgiras, Savana son of Vasijha, Havya son of Atri, and Pulaha — these seven are the sages in the Rauhita Manvantara. O great sage,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तेन्द्रियवृत्तित्वात्कामरोगप्रपीडनात् । तदप्राप्ते तु सततं कुतः सौख्यं तु यौवने
verses.transliteration: pravṛttendriyavṛttitvātkāmarogaprapīḍanāt | tadaprāpte tu satataṃ kutaḥ saukhyaṃ tu yauvane
verses.translation: They are the sons of the patriarch Rohita, son
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the sons of the patriarch Rohita, son

verses.sanskrit: ईर्ष्यया च महद्दुःखं मोहाद्रक्तस्य तस्य च । नेत्रस्य कुपितस्येव त्यागी दुःखाय केवलम्
verses.transliteration: īrṣyayā ca mahadduḥkhaṃ mohādraktasya tasya ca | netrasya kupitasyeva tyāgī duḥkhāya kevalam
verses.translation: In the tenth Manvantara of the second Savarni the following arc the sages, viz. Havi$mat, Pulaha, Prakfti, Bhargava, Aya, Mukti, Atreya and the imperishable Vasi$tha along with the seven great sages viz, ' Paulastya, Prayati, Bhamara, Kasyapa, Angira, Anenasa, and Satya. Those known as Dvi§imant are the groups of gods.
verses.wordMeaning: In the tenth Manvantara of the second Savarni the following arc the sages, viz. Havi$mat, Pulaha, Prakfti, Bhargava, Aya, Mukti, Atreya and the imperishable Vasi$tha along with the seven great sages viz, ' Paulastya, Prayati, Bhamara, Kasyapa, Angira, Anenasa, and Satya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the tenth Manvantara of the second Savarni the following arc the sages, viz. Havi$mat, Pulaha, Prakfti, Bhargava, Aya, Mukti, Atreya and the imperishable Vasi$tha along with the seven great sages viz, ' Paulastya, Prayati, Bhamara, Kasyapa, Angira, Anenasa, and Satya.…

verses.sanskrit: न रात्रौ विन्दते निद्रां कामाग्निपरिवेदितः । दिवापि च कुतः सौख्यमर्थोपार्जनचिन्तया
verses.transliteration: na rātrau vindate nidrāṃ kāmāgnipariveditaḥ | divāpi ca kutaḥ saukhyamarthopārjanacintayā
verses.translation: Sambhu, MaheiSvara himself is as their Indra. The ten sons of the Maim are Aksatvat, Uttamaujas, Bhuriena the powerful, Satanika, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna, Suvarca and Arcis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sambhu, MaheiSvara himself is as their Indra. The ten sons of the Maim are Aksatvat, Uttamaujas, Bhuriena the powerful, Satanika, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna, Suvarca and Arcis.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीष्वध्यासितचित्तस्य ये पुंसः शुक्रबिन्दवः । ते सुखाय न मन्यन्ते स्वेदजा इव ते तथा
verses.transliteration: strīṣvadhyāsitacittasya ye puṃsaḥ śukrabindavaḥ | te sukhāya na manyante svedajā iva te tathā
verses.translation: In the eleventh Manvantara of the third Savarni there arc seven sages. Understand them as they are glorified by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the eleventh Manvantara of the third Savarni there arc seven sages. Understand them as they are glorified by me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृमिभिस्तुद्यमानस्य कुष्ठिनो वानरस्य च । कण्डूयनाभितापेन यद्भवेत् स्त्रीषु तद्विदः
verses.transliteration: kṛmibhistudyamānasya kuṣṭhino vānarasya ca | kaṇḍūyanābhitāpena yadbhavet strīṣu tadvidaḥ
verses.translation: Havismat Kasyapa, Vapusmat Varuna, Atreya, Vasistha, Anaya, Angiras, Carudhrsya, Paulastya, Nihsvara, Taijasa Agni. The first seven are the sages and the last three groups are of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Havismat Kasyapa, Vapusmat Varuna, Atreya, Vasistha, Anaya, Angiras, Carudhrsya, Paulastya, Nihsvara, Taijasa Agni. The first seven are the sages and the last three groups are of gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यादृशं मन्यते सौख्यं गण्डे पूतिविनिर्गमात् । तादृशं स्त्रीषु मन्तव्यं नाधिकं तासु विद्यते
verses.transliteration: yādṛśaṃ manyate saukhyaṃ gaṇḍe pūtivinirgamāt | tādṛśaṃ strīṣu mantavyaṃ nādhikaṃ tāsu vidyate
verses.translation: There are the sons of Brahma known as
verses.commentary: Sense: There are the sons of Brahma known as
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्रस्य समुत्सर्गात्सुखं भवति यादृशम् । तादृशं स्त्रीषु विज्ञेयं मूढैः कल्पितमन्यथा
verses.transliteration: viṇmūtrasya samutsargātsukhaṃ bhavati yādṛśam | tādṛśaṃ strīṣu vijñeyaṃ mūḍhaiḥ kalpitamanyathā
verses.translation: Now know the seven sages of the fourth
verses.commentary: Sense: Now know the seven sages of the fourth
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारीष्ववस्तुभूतासु सर्वदोषाश्रयासु च । नाणुमात्रं सुखं तासु कथितं पञ्चचूडया
verses.transliteration: nārīṣvavastubhūtāsu sarvadoṣāśrayāsu ca | nāṇumātraṃ sukhaṃ tāsu kathitaṃ pañcacūḍayā
verses.translation: The Indra then is Rtadhamain. He is the
verses.commentary: Sense: The Indra then is Rtadhamain. He is the
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्माननावमानाभ्यां वियोगेनेष्टसङ्गमात् । यौवनं जरया ग्रस्तं क्व सौख्यमनुपद्रवम्
verses.transliteration: sammānanāvamānābhyāṃ viyogeneṣṭasaṅgamāt | yauvanaṃ jarayā grastaṃ kva saukhyamanupadravam
verses.translation: In the fourteenth Manvantara of Satya Manu the seven sages are Agnidhra Kayapa, Magadha, Paulastya Atibahya Bhargava, 3uci Angirasa, Yukta Atreya, *Ajita grandson of Vasitha* and Pulaha. They are the final seven sages. The gods are the holy Caksusas. 3uci will become In<;Jra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fourteenth Manvantara of Satya Manu the seven sages are Agnidhra Kayapa, Magadha, Paulastya Atibahya Bhargava, 3uci Angirasa, Yukta Atreya, *Ajita grandson of Vasitha* and Pulaha. They are the final seven sages. The gods are the holy Caksusas. 3uci will become In<;Jra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वलीपलितखालित्यैः शिथिलिकृतविग्रहम् । सर्वक्रियास्वशक्तिं च जरया जर्जरीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: valīpalitakhālityaiḥ śithilikṛtavigraham | sarvakriyāsvaśaktiṃ ca jarayā jarjarīkṛtam
verses.translation: Afier getting up early in the morning the repeti¬ tion of the names of these sages of the past and future increases the happiness of men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afier getting up early in the morning the repeti¬ tion of the names of these sages of the past and future increases the happiness of men.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसयौवनं हृद्यमन्योऽन्यस्य प्रियं पुरा । तदेव जरया ग्रस्तमनयोरपि न प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: strīpuṃsayauvanaṃ hṛdyamanyo'nyasya priyaṃ purā | tadeva jarayā grastamanayorapi na priyam
verses.translation: O great sage, listen. The groups of gods are five. The sons of this Manu are — Tarangabhiru, Budhna, Tanugra, Anugra, Abhimanin Pravina, Viu, Sankrandana, Tejasvin, and Sabala.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, listen. The groups of gods are five. The sons of this Manu are — Tarangabhiru, Budhna, Tanugra, Anugra, Abhimanin Pravina, Viu, Sankrandana, Tejasvin, and Sabala.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपूर्ववत्स्वमात्मानं जरया परिवर्तितम् । यः पश्यन्नपि रज्येत कोऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः
verses.transliteration: apūrvavatsvamātmānaṃ jarayā parivartitam | yaḥ paśyannapi rajyeta ko'nyastasmādacetanaḥ
verses.translation: These were mentioned to Vyasa by Sanatkumara of great splendour. When the thousand Yugas are complete they, of good penance, return to Brahmaloka when their task of protecting the people is over. Each Manvantara consists of seventy one Yugas with some period left over.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were mentioned to Vyasa by Sanatkumara of great splendour. When the thousand Yugas are complete they, of good penance, return to Brahmaloka when their task of protecting the people is over. Each Manvantara consists of seventy one Yugas with some period left over.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जराभिभूतः पुरुषः पुत्रीपुत्रादिबान्धवैः । असक्तत्वाद्दुराधर्षैर्भृत्यैश्च परिभूयते
verses.transliteration: jarābhibhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ putrīputrādibāndhavaiḥ | asaktatvāddurādharṣairbhṛtyaiśca paribhūyate
verses.translation: These fourteen Manus are glorified. In each Man¬ vantara there is re-creation after annihilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: These fourteen Manus are glorified. In each Man¬ vantara there is re-creation after annihilation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्ममर्थं च कामं वा मोक्षं वातिजरातुरः । अशक्तः साधितुं तस्माद्युवा धर्मं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ vā mokṣaṃ vātijarāturaḥ | aśaktaḥ sādhituṃ tasmādyuvā dharmaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: There all the living beings are burnt by the sun's rays. O sage, all of them enter Visnu at the end of Kalpas along with the Adityas. Vinu then creates all living beings. This happens again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: There all the living beings are burnt by the sun's rays. O sage, all of them enter Visnu at the end of Kalpas along with the Adityas. Vinu then creates all living beings. This happens again and again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the brilliance of the sun as unbearable as the fire at the final dissolution she created Ghaya of herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the brilliance of the sun as unbearable as the fire at the final dissolution she created Ghaya of herself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the brilliance of the sun as unbearable as the fire at the final dissolution she created Ghaya of herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the brilliance of the sun as unbearable as the fire at the final dissolution she created Ghaya of herself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । स्त्रीस्वभाववर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । कुत्सितं योषिदर्थं यत्सम्प्रोक्तं पञ्चचूडया । तन्मे ब्रूहि समासेन यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे मुने
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.24. caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | strīsvabhāvavarṇanam | vyāsa uvāca | kutsitaṃ yoṣidarthaṃ yatsamproktaṃ pañcacūḍayā | tanme brūhi samāsena yadi tuṣṭo'si me mune
verses.translation: She of illusory form told Sarhjfia: "O sweet-smiled auspicious lady, what shall I do for you, please tell me".
verses.commentary: Sense: She of illusory form told Sarhjfia: "O sweet-smiled auspicious lady, what shall I do for you, please tell me".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । स्त्रीणां स्वभावं वक्ष्यामि शृणु विप्र यथातथम् । यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण भवेद्वैराग्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | strīṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu vipra yathātatham | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa bhavedvairāgyamuttamam
verses.translation: Her words will come up true and you will also be saved. Have no doubt, O deer, cheer up your mind, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her words will come up true and you will also be saved. Have no doubt, O deer, cheer up your mind, O lord.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियो मूलं हि दोषाणां लघुचित्ताः सदा मुने । तदासक्तिर्न कर्तव्या मोक्षेप्सुभिरतन्द्रितैः
verses.transliteration: striyo mūlaṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ laghucittāḥ sadā mune | tadāsaktirna kartavyā mokṣepsubhiratandritaiḥ
verses.translation: This incident distressed the mind of Yama. As pious king he gladdened the subjects virtuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: This incident distressed the mind of Yama. As pious king he gladdened the subjects virtuously.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । नारदस्य च संवादं पुंश्चल्या पञ्चचूडया
verses.transliteration: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam | nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ puṃścalyā pañcacūḍayā
verses.translation: I am approaching them. I shall never be interested in sinful things.** After saying this, the chaste lady approached Mitra and Varuna and spoke with palms joined in reverence "O great sages, I am born in the sacri¬ fice of Manu through your parts. I have come to you. Please tell me. What I can do for you. O lord, create >ther sons so that your race may flourish."
verses.wordMeaning: I am approaching them. I shall never be interested in sinful things.** After saying this, the chaste lady approached Mitra and Varuna and spoke with palms joined in reverence "O great sages, I am born in the sacri¬ fice of Manu through your parts. I have come to you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I am approaching them. I shall never be interested in sinful things.** After saying this, the chaste lady approached Mitra and Varuna and spoke with palms joined in reverence "O great sages, I am born in the sacri¬ fice of Manu through your parts. I have come to you.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकान् परिचरन् धीमान् देवर्षिर्नारदः पुरा । ददर्शाप्सरसं बालां पञ्चचूडामनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: lokān paricaran dhīmān devarṣirnāradaḥ purā | dadarśāpsarasaṃ bālāṃ pañcacūḍāmanuttamām
verses.translation: When the chaste lady born in the sacrifice of Manu said, the sages Mitra and Varuna spoke thus respect¬ fully.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the chaste lady born in the sacrifice of Manu said, the sages Mitra and Varuna spoke thus respect¬ fully.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छाप्सरसं सुभ्रूं नारदो मुनिसत्तमः । संशयो हृदि मे कश्चित्तन्मे ब्रूहि सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: papracchāpsarasaṃ subhrūṃ nārado munisattamaḥ | saṃśayo hṛdi me kaścittanme brūhi sumadhyame
verses.translation: O virtuous beautiful lady of fair complexion, both of us are pleased with your self-control, humility and truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O virtuous beautiful lady of fair complexion, both of us are pleased with your self-control, humility and truth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु सा विप्रं प्रत्युवाच वराप्सरा । विषये सति वक्ष्यामि समर्थां मन्यसेऽथ माम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu sā vipraṃ pratyuvāca varāpsarā | viṣaye sati vakṣyāmi samarthāṃ manyase'tha mām
verses.translation: O blessed lady, you will attain our fame. You alone will become the son establishing the family of Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O blessed lady, you will attain our fame. You alone will become the son establishing the family of Manu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । न त्वामविषये भद्रे नियोक्ष्यामि कथञ्चन । स्त्रीणां स्वभावमिच्छामि त्वत्तः श्रोतुं सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | na tvāmaviṣaye bhadre niyokṣyāmi kathañcana | strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi tvattaḥ śrotuṃ sumadhyame
verses.translation: You will be famous in the three worlds as Sudyumna, beloved of the universe, virtuous in conduct and enhancer of the race of Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will be famous in the three worlds as Sudyumna, beloved of the universe, virtuous in conduct and enhancer of the race of Manu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवर्षेरप्सरोत्तमा । प्रत्युवाच मुनीशं तं देवर्षिं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | etacchrutvā vacastasya devarṣerapsarottamā | pratyuvāca munīśaṃ taṃ devarṣiṃ munisattamam
verses.translation: After bearing the son Pururavas she became Sudyu- mna as a result of!§iva's grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bearing the son Pururavas she became Sudyu- mna as a result of!§iva's grace.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चचूडोवाच । मुने शृणु न शक्या स्त्री सती वै निन्दितुं स्त्रिया । विदितास्ते स्त्रियो याश्च यादृश्यश्च स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: pañcacūḍovāca | mune śṛṇu na śakyā strī satī vai nindituṃ striyā | viditāste striyo yāśca yādṛśyaśca svabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: "Welfare unto you. I go to my father's house alone. Indeed you have to stay in this house without aberration.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Welfare unto you. I go to my father's house alone. Indeed you have to stay in this house without aberration.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न मामर्हसि देवर्षे नियोक्तुं प्रश्नमीदृशम् । इत्युक्त्वा साभवत्तूष्णीं पञ्चचूडाप्सरोवरा
verses.transliteration: na māmarhasi devarṣe niyoktuṃ praśnamīdṛśam | ityuktvā sābhavattūṣṇīṃ pañcacūḍāpsarovarā
verses.translation: These two well-behaved sons and this pretty girl should be happily protected if you wish to please me."
verses.commentary: Sense: These two well-behaved sons and this pretty girl should be happily protected if you wish to please me."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवर्षिवर्यो हि श्रुत्वा तद्वाक्यमुत्तमम् । प्रत्युवाच पुनस्तां वै लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: atha devarṣivaryo hi śrutvā tadvākyamuttamam | pratyuvāca punastāṃ vai lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: "O lady, I shall brook their misdeeds even as much as pulling out my hair. I shall make no complaint to you. O goddess, you can go away happily."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lady, I shall brook their misdeeds even as much as pulling out my hair. I shall make no complaint to you. O goddess, you can go away happily."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । मृषावादे भवेद्दोषः सत्ये दोषो न विद्यते । इति जानीहि सत्यं त्वं वदातस्तत्सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | mṛṣāvāde bhaveddoṣaḥ satye doṣo na vidyate | iti jānīhi satyaṃ tvaṃ vadātastatsumadhyame
verses.translation: Ashamed on being addressed thus, the lady went to her father's house but was rebuked by him. He urged her again and again to return to her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ashamed on being addressed thus, the lady went to her father's house but was rebuked by him. He urged her again and again to return to her husband.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इत्युक्ता सा कृतमती रभसा चारुहासिनी । स्त्रीदोषान् शाश्वतान्सत्यान् भाषितुं सम्प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | ityuktā sā kṛtamatī rabhasā cāruhāsinī | strīdoṣān śāśvatānsatyān bhāṣituṃ sampracakrame
verses.translation: She assumed the form of a mare. Going to Northern Kurus she wandered among the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: She assumed the form of a mare. Going to Northern Kurus she wandered among the people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चचूडोवाच । कुलीना नाथवन्त्यश्च रूपवन्त्यश्च योषितः । मर्यादाषु न तिष्ठन्ति स दोषः स्त्रीषु नारद
verses.transliteration: pañcacūḍovāca | kulīnā nāthavantyaśca rūpavantyaśca yoṣitaḥ | maryādāṣu na tiṣṭhanti sa doṣaḥ strīṣu nārada
verses.translation: Though requested by Sarfijfta, Ghaya did not love the elder children. She loved her own son more and fondled him always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though requested by Sarfijfta, Ghaya did not love the elder children. She loved her own son more and fondled him always.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न स्त्रीभ्यः किञ्चिदन्यद्वै पापीयस्तरमस्ति हि । स्त्रियो मूलं हि पापानां तथा त्वमपि वेत्थ ह
verses.transliteration: na strībhyaḥ kiñcidanyadvai pāpīyastaramasti hi | striyo mūlaṃ hi pāpānāṃ tathā tvamapi vettha ha
verses.translation: The younger brother Yama could not hear that. He did not forgive. Ever since childhood he was furious and and ill-tempered due to the gravity of what was destined to happen later.
verses.commentary: Sense: The younger brother Yama could not hear that. He did not forgive. Ever since childhood he was furious and and ill-tempered due to the gravity of what was destined to happen later.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समाज्ञातानर्थवतः प्रतिरूपान् यथेप्सितान् । पतीनन्तरमासाद्य नालं नार्यः प्रतीक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration: samājñātānarthavataḥ pratirūpān yathepsitān | patīnantaramāsādya nālaṃ nāryaḥ pratīkṣitum
verses.translation: Due to excessive anger she cursed — "Let your leg fall off". Yama approached his father with palms joined in reverence and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to excessive anger she cursed — "Let your leg fall off". Yama approached his father with palms joined in reverence and said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: असद्धर्मस्त्वयं स्त्रीणामस्माकं भवति प्रभो । पापीयसो नरान् यद्वै लज्जां त्यक्त्वा भजामहे
verses.transliteration: asaddharmastvayaṃ strīṇāmasmākaṃ bhavati prabho | pāpīyaso narān yadvai lajjāṃ tyaktvā bhajāmahe
verses.translation: "I was agitated due to Chaya's words. I am sorry and frightened of the curse. I had only said that a mother shall have impartial and equal love for all her children. She has lost affection for us. She nurtures only the youngest one. Hence I raised my foot. It behoves you to forgive me. O lord of gods, O foremost among the refulgent ones, I have been cursed by my mother. O lord of rays, let not my leg fall off by your grace."
verses.wordMeaning: "I was agitated due to Chaya's words. I am sorry and frightened of the curse. I had only said that a mother shall have impartial and equal love for all her children. She has lost affection for us. She nurtures only the youngest one. Hence I raised my foot.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "I was agitated due to Chaya's words. I am sorry and frightened of the curse. I had only said that a mother shall have impartial and equal love for all her children. She has lost affection for us. She nurtures only the youngest one. Hence I raised my foot.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियं च यः प्रार्थयते सन्निकर्षं च गच्छति । ईषच्च कुरुते सेवां तमेवेच्छन्ति योषितः
verses.transliteration: striyaṃ ca yaḥ prārthayate sannikarṣaṃ ca gacchati | īṣacca kurute sevāṃ tamevecchanti yoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: O son, there shall be a great cause for this. That was why you too who know virtue and speak the truth had been infuriated.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, there shall be a great cause for this. That was why you too who know virtue and speak the truth had been infuriated.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनर्थित्वान्मनुष्याणां भयात्पतिजनस्य च । मर्यादायाममर्यादाः स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: anarthitvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātpatijanasya ca | maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying thus to his son Yama, the sun angrily spoke to Chaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, after saying thus to his son Yama, the sun angrily spoke to Chaya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नासां कश्चिदमान्योऽस्ति नासां वयसि निश्चयः । सुरूपं वा कुरूपं वा पुमांसमुपभुञ्जते
verses.transliteration: nāsāṃ kaścidamānyo'sti nāsāṃ vayasi niścayaḥ | surūpaṃ vā kurūpaṃ vā pumāṃsamupabhuñjate
verses.translation: O beloved wife, O evil-minded angry lady, what it is that you have done? Why do you love one son more? You shall tell me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved wife, O evil-minded angry lady, what it is that you have done? Why do you love one son more? You shall tell me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न भयादथ वाक्रोशान्नार्थहेतोः कथञ्चन । न ज्ञातिकुलसम्बन्धात् स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: na bhayādatha vākrośānnārthahetoḥ kathañcana | na jñātikulasambandhāt striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the sun she told him the truth. Scorched by him she consoled him thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the sun she told him the truth. Scorched by him she consoled him thus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यौवने वर्तमानानामिष्टाभरणवाससाम् । नारीणां स्वैरवृत्तीनां स्पृहयन्ति कुलस्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: yauvane vartamānānāmiṣṭābharaṇavāsasām | nārīṇāṃ svairavṛttīnāṃ spṛhayanti kulastriyaḥ
verses.translation: I shall change your form. I shall make it pleasingly brilliant.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall change your form. I shall make it pleasingly brilliant.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: या हि शश्वद् बहुमता रक्ष्यन्ते दयिताः स्त्रियः । अपि ताः सम्प्रसज्जन्ते कुब्जान्धजडवामने
verses.transliteration: yā hi śaśvad bahumatā rakṣyante dayitāḥ striyaḥ | api tāḥ samprasajjante kubjāndhajaḍavāmane
verses.translation: The sage Tvastr put him on the turner's lathe and sharpened him further. His blazing form was slightly redu¬ ced in brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage Tvastr put him on the turner's lathe and sharpened him further. His blazing form was slightly redu¬ ced in brilliance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पङ्गुष्वपि च देवर्षे ये चान्ये कुत्सिता नराः । स्त्रीणामगम्यो लोकेषु नास्ति कश्चिन्महामुने
verses.transliteration: paṅguṣvapi ca devarṣe ye cānye kutsitā narāḥ | strīṇāmagamyo lokeṣu nāsti kaścinmahāmune
verses.translation: He assumed the form of a horse and approached her for sexual indulgence with her who could not be overwhel¬ med by any living being due to her lustre and observance of restraint.
verses.commentary: Sense: He assumed the form of a horse and approached her for sexual indulgence with her who could not be overwhel¬ med by any living being due to her lustre and observance of restraint.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि पुंसां गतिर्ब्रह्मन् कथञ्चिन्नोपपद्यते । अप्यन्योऽन्यं प्रवर्तन्ते न च तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: yadi puṃsāṃ gatirbrahman kathañcinnopapadyate | apyanyo'nyaṃ pravartante na ca tiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu
verses.translation: O sage, in the course of the sexual activity she suspected him to be another man. Hence she received the semen through the mouth into the nostril.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, in the course of the sexual activity she suspected him to be another man. Hence she received the semen through the mouth into the nostril.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अलाभात्पुरुषाणां च भयात्परिजनस्य च । वधबन्धभयाच्चैव ता भग्नाशा हि योषितः
verses.transliteration: alābhātpuruṣāṇāṃ ca bhayātparijanasya ca | vadhabandhabhayāccaiva tā bhagnāśā hi yoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Thence were born the twin gods ASvins, the fore¬ most among physicians. They are known as Nasatyas and Dasras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thence were born the twin gods ASvins, the fore¬ most among physicians. They are known as Nasatyas and Dasras.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चलस्वभाव दुश्चेष्टा दुर्गाह्या भावतस्तथा । प्राज्ञस्य पुरुषस्येह यथा रतिपरिग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: calasvabhāva duśceṣṭā durgāhyā bhāvatastathā | prājñasya puruṣasyeha yathā ratiparigrahāt
verses.translation: The sun showed his pleasingly splendid form to them. On seeing her husband she was extremely delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun showed his pleasingly splendid form to them. On seeing her husband she was extremely delighted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाग्निस्तुष्यति काष्ठानां नापगानां महोदधि । नान्तकः सर्वभूतानां न पुंसां वामलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: nāgnistuṣyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhi | nāntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocanāḥ
verses.translation: The chaste lady returned to the house with her husband with the face beaming with pleasure. The pair rejoiced more than before.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chaste lady returned to the house with her husband with the face beaming with pleasure. The pair rejoiced more than before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदमन्यच्च देवर्षे रहस्यं सर्वयोषिताम् । दृष्ट्वैव पुरुषं सद्यो योनिः प्रक्लिद्यते स्त्रियाः
verses.transliteration: idamanyacca devarṣe rahasyaṃ sarvayoṣitām | dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣaṃ sadyo yoniḥ praklidyate striyāḥ
verses.translation: Yama of great lustre attained the lordship of the names and the guardianship of the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama of great lustre attained the lordship of the names and the guardianship of the quarters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुस्नातं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सुगन्धं मलवर्जितम् । योनिः प्रक्लिद्यते स्त्रीणां दृतेः पात्रादिवोदकम्
verses.transliteration: susnātaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sugandhaṃ malavarjitam | yoniḥ praklidyate strīṇāṃ dṛteḥ pātrādivodakam
