verses.translation: Savarni Manu became the patriarch. In the Savarnika Manvantara he will become the future Manu by virtue of his action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savarni Manu became the patriarch. In the Savarnika Manvantara he will become the future Manu by virtue of his action.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कायानामपि दातारं कर्त्तारं मानसान्त्वयोः । रक्षितारं न मृष्यन्ति भर्तारं परमं स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: kāyānāmapi dātāraṃ karttāraṃ mānasāntvayoḥ | rakṣitāraṃ na mṛṣyanti bhartāraṃ paramaṃ striyaḥ
verses.translation: The lord is performing penance even today on the top of Meru*i. Their younger sister, the famous Yami, became the most excellent river Yamuna, the sanctifier of all the worlds. He is called Savarni Manu in the world. He who listens to or retains in memory this origin of the gods attains great fame. Should he suffer from any adversity he will be rid of it.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord is performing penance even today on the top of Meru*i. Their younger sister, the famous Yami, became the most excellent river Yamuna, the sanctifier of all the worlds. He is called Savarni Manu in the world.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord is performing penance even today on the top of Meru*i. Their younger sister, the famous Yami, became the most excellent river Yamuna, the sanctifier of all the worlds. He is called Savarni Manu in the world.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न कामभोगात्परमान्नालङ्कारार्थसञ्चयात् । तथा हितं न मन्यन्ते यथा रतिपरिग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: na kāmabhogātparamānnālaṅkārārthasañcayāt | tathā hitaṃ na manyante yathā ratiparigrahāt
verses.translation: Nine sons all equal to him were born of Vaivasvata Manu. Later they became very lofty, bold and devoted to the virtues of Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nine sons all equal to him were born of Vaivasvata Manu. Later they became very lofty, bold and devoted to the virtues of Ksatriyas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकः शमनो मृत्युः पातालं वडवामुखम् । क्षुरधारा विषं सर्पो वह्निरित्येकतः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: antakaḥ śamano mṛtyuḥ pātālaṃ vaḍavāmukham | kṣuradhārā viṣaṃ sarpo vahnirityekataḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: They were Ik§vaku, Sibi, Nabhaga, Dhrsta, Saryati, Nariyanta, Nabhaga, Karusa and Priyavrata.**
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Ik§vaku, Sibi, Nabhaga, Dhrsta, Saryati, Nariyanta, Nabhaga, Karusa and Priyavrata.**
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतश्च भूतानि महान्ति पञ्च यतश्च लोको विहितो विधात्रा । यतः पुमांसः प्रमदाश्च निर्मिताः सदैव दोषः प्रमदासु नारद
verses.transliteration: yataśca bhūtāni mahānti pañca yataśca loko vihito vidhātrā | yataḥ pumāṃsaḥ pramadāśca nirmitāḥ sadaiva doṣaḥ pramadāsu nārada
verses.translation: Desirous of sons, Manu the patriarch performed a sacrifice. O great sage, when no sons were born as a result of the sacrifice, the famous Ila was born, wearing divine garments, bedecked in divine ornaments and with a
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of sons, Manu the patriarch performed a sacrifice. O great sage, when no sons were born as a result of the sacrifice, the famous Ila was born, wearing divine garments, bedecked in divine ornaments and with a
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या नारदस्तुष्टमानसः । तथ्यं मत्वा ततस्तद्वै विरक्तोऽभूद्धि तासु च
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasyā nāradastuṣṭamānasaḥ | tathyaṃ matvā tatastadvai virakto'bhūddhi tāsu ca
verses.translation: See not and note.
verses.commentary: Sense: See not and note.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स्त्रीस्वभावस्ते पञ्चचूडोक्त आदरात् । वैराग्यकारणं व्यास किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ strīsvabhāvaste pañcacūḍokta ādarāt | vairāgyakāraṇaṃ vyāsa kimanyacchrotumarhasi
verses.translation: She spoke these words to the patriafch desirous of a son — "O foremost among the eloquent, I am born of the parts of Mitra and Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: She spoke these words to the patriafch desirous of a son — "O foremost among the eloquent, I am born of the parts of Mitra and Varuna.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, when Manu passed away, the earth was divided into ten regions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, when Manu passed away, the earth was divided into ten regions.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, when Manu passed away, the earth was divided into ten regions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, when Manu passed away, the earth was divided into ten regions.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । कालज्ञानवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ त्वत्सकाशान्मया मुने । स्त्रीस्वभावः श्रुतः प्रीत्या कालज्ञानं वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.25. pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kālajñānavarṇanam | vyāsa uvāca | sanatkumāra sarvajña tvatsakāśānmayā mune | strīsvabhāvaḥ śrutaḥ prītyā kālajñānaṃ vadasva me
verses.translation: Iksvaku the eldest son got the central territory. At the instance of Vasistha, Sudyumna gave the virtuous territory Pratisthana'*** to Pururavas. O grart sages, Sudy¬ umna had the characteristics of both man and woman. The Sakas were the sons of Narisyanta. Nabhaga's son Ambari§a got the region Blaka* and so was known as Bahleya. Saryati had a son and a daughter. The son was known as Anarta and the daughter as Sukanya who later became the wife of Gyavana. Anarta's son was Raibhya known also as Raivata.
verses.wordMeaning: Iksvaku the eldest son got the central territory. At the instance of Vasistha, Sudyumna gave the virtuous territory Pratisthana'*** to Pururavas. O grart sages, Sudy¬ umna had the characteristics of both man and woman. The Sakas were the sons of Narisyanta.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Iksvaku the eldest son got the central territory. At the instance of Vasistha, Sudyumna gave the virtuous territory Pratisthana'*** to Pururavas. O grart sages, Sudy¬ umna had the characteristics of both man and woman. The Sakas were the sons of Narisyanta.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इदमेव पुरापृच्छत् पार्वती परमेश्वरम् । श्रुत्वा नानाकथां दिव्यां प्रसन्ना सुप्रणम्य तम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | idameva purāpṛcchat pārvatī parameśvaram | śrutvā nānākathāṃ divyāṃ prasannā supraṇamya tam
verses.translation: Thus commanded, the king bowed to him and went to that city. On realising that many Yugas had elapsed he was surprised along with his daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus commanded, the king bowed to him and went to that city. On realising that many Yugas had elapsed he was surprised along with his daughter.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच । भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन ज्ञातं मे सकलं मतम् । यथार्चनं तु ते देव यैर्मन्त्रैश्च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: pārvatyuvāca | bhagavaṃstvatprasādena jñātaṃ me sakalaṃ matam | yathārcanaṃ tu te deva yairmantraiśca yathāvidhi
verses.translation: See note yo.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note yo.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि संशयस्त्वेकः कालचक्रं प्रति प्रभो । मृत्युचिह्नं यथा देव किं प्रमाणं यथायुषः
verses.transliteration: adyāpi saṃśayastvekaḥ kālacakraṃ prati prabho | mṛtyucihnaṃ yathā deva kiṃ pramāṇaṃ yathāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: Kuvalasva had hundred sons who were excellent archers. He was entrusted with the kingdom by his father. After transferring the royal glory to the son the king entered the forest. But Uttahka prevented him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuvalasva had hundred sons who were excellent archers. He was entrusted with the kingdom by his father. After transferring the royal glory to the son the king entered the forest. But Uttahka prevented him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं कथय मे नाथ यद्यहं तव वल्लभा । इति पृष्टस्तया देव्या प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ kathaya me nātha yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā | iti pṛṣṭastayā devyā pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "O holy lord, O excellent brahmin, I have already laid aside my weapons. Here is my son who will surely destroy Dhundhu."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, O excellent brahmin, I have already laid aside my weapons. Here is my son who will surely destroy Dhundhu."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । सत्यं ते कथयिष्यामि शास्त्रं सर्वोत्तमं प्रिये । येन शास्त्रेण देवेशि नरैः कालः प्रबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | satyaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi śāstraṃ sarvottamaṃ priye | yena śāstreṇa deveśi naraiḥ kālaḥ prabudhyate
verses.translation: After killing the aquatic demon of huge body
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the aquatic demon of huge body
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहः पक्षं तथा मासमृतुं चायनवत्सरौ । स्थूलसूक्ष्मगतैश्चिह्नैर्बहिरन्तर्गतैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ahaḥ pakṣaṃ tathā māsamṛtuṃ cāyanavatsarau | sthūlasūkṣmagataiścihnairbahirantargataistathā
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, due to that sinful misdeed Indra did not rain in his kingdom for twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin sage, due to that sinful misdeed Indra did not rain in his kingdom for twelve years.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन सुन्दरि । लोकानामुपकारार्थं वैराग्यार्थमुमेऽधुना
verses.transliteration: tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena sundari | lokānāmupakārārthaṃ vairāgyārthamume'dhunā
verses.translation: O sage, he killed deer, boars and buffaloes of the forest and he cast off their flesh near the hermitage of ViSvamitra.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, he killed deer, boars and buffaloes of the forest and he cast off their flesh near the hermitage of ViSvamitra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मात्पाण्डुरं देहमूर्ध्वरागं समन्ततः । तदा मृत्युं विजानीयात्षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे प्रिये
verses.transliteration: akasmātpāṇḍuraṃ dehamūrdhvarāgaṃ samantataḥ | tadā mṛtyuṃ vijānīyātṣaṇmāsābhyantare priye
verses.translation: In virtue of his being the priest and the teacher the sage Vasistha looked after the holy centres, cows, clans and the harem.
verses.commentary: Sense: In virtue of his being the priest and the teacher the sage Vasistha looked after the holy centres, cows, clans and the harem.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखं कर्णौ तथा चक्षुर्जिह्वास्तम्भो यदा भवेत् । तदा मृत्युं विजानीयात्षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे प्रिये
verses.transliteration: mukhaṃ karṇau tathā cakṣurjihvāstambho yadā bhavet | tadā mṛtyuṃ vijānīyātṣaṇmāsābhyantare priye
verses.translation: In the territory*® of Anarta he got the city KuSasthali which was extremely brilliant and was the seventh among seven cities.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the territory*® of Anarta he got the city KuSasthali which was extremely brilliant and was the seventh among seven cities.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रौरवानुगतं भद्रे ध्वनिं नाकर्णयेद् द्रुतम् । षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे मृत्युर्ज्ञातव्यः कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: rauravānugataṃ bhadre dhvaniṃ nākarṇayed drutam | ṣaṇmāsābhyantare mṛtyurjñātavyaḥ kālavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: He had a hundred sons of whom the eldest and the most excellent was Kakudmin. He was brilliant, strong, virtuous and a protector of brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a hundred sons of whom the eldest and the most excellent was Kakudmin. He was brilliant, strong, virtuous and a protector of brahmins.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रविसोमाग्निसंयोगाद्यदोद्योतं न पश्यति । कृष्णं सर्वं समस्तं च षण्मासं जीवितं तथा
verses.transliteration: ravisomāgnisaṃyogādyadodyotaṃ na paśyati | kṛṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ samastaṃ ca ṣaṇmāsaṃ jīvitaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The king Kakudmin the lord of all went to
verses.commentary: Sense: The king Kakudmin the lord of all went to
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वामहस्तो यदा देवि सप्ताहं स्पन्दते प्रिये । जीवितं तु तदा तस्य मासमेकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vāmahasto yadā devi saptāhaṃ spandate priye | jīvitaṃ tu tadā tasya māsamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Then he bowed to Brahma the great Atman, humbly and with palms joined in reverence told him about his mission.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he bowed to Brahma the great Atman, humbly and with palms joined in reverence told him about his mission.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उन्मीलयन्ति गात्राणि तालुकं शुष्यते यदा । जीवितं तु तदा तस्य मासमेकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: unmīlayanti gātrāṇi tālukaṃ śuṣyate yadā | jīvitaṃ tu tadā tasya māsamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his purpose the patriarch Brahma laughed. Addressing the great king Kakudmin, he said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his purpose the patriarch Brahma laughed. Addressing the great king Kakudmin, he said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नासा तु स्रवते यस्य त्रिदोषे पक्षजीवितम् । वक्त्रं कण्ठं च शुष्येत षण्मासान्ते गतायुषः
verses.transliteration: nāsā tu sravate yasya tridoṣe pakṣajīvitam | vaktraṃ kaṇṭhaṃ ca śuṣyeta ṣaṇmāsānte gatāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: Listen, O King Kakudmin, O lord of the earth, son of Raibhya, to my words with attention. I shall tell you the truth particularly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O King Kakudmin, O lord of the earth, son of Raibhya, to my words with attention. I shall tell you the truth particularly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलजिह्वा भवेद्यस्य द्विजाः क्लिद्यन्ति भामिनि । षण्मासाज्जायते मृत्युश्चिह्नैस्तैरुपलक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: sthūlajihvā bhavedyasya dvijāḥ klidyanti bhāmini | ṣaṇmāsājjāyate mṛtyuścihnaistairupalakṣayet
verses.translation: All those bridegrooms you had in view have been killed by the efflux of time. Even their family is extinct. Time is the devourer of everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those bridegrooms you had in view have been killed by the efflux of time. Even their family is extinct. Time is the devourer of everything.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अम्बुतैलघृतस्थं तु दर्पणे वरवर्णिनि । न पश्यति यदात्मानं विकृतं पलमेव च
verses.transliteration: ambutailaghṛtasthaṃ tu darpaṇe varavarṇini | na paśyati yadātmānaṃ vikṛtaṃ palameva ca
verses.translation: O king, your city too has been destroyed by Punyajanas, the Rak$asas. It is now the twenty-eighth Dvapara Yuga and the city has been rebuilt by Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, your city too has been destroyed by Punyajanas, the Rak$asas. It is now the twenty-eighth Dvapara Yuga and the city has been rebuilt by Krsna.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षण्मासायुः स विज्ञेयः कालचक्रं विजानता । अन्यच्च शृणु देवेशि येन मृत्युर्विबुद्ध्यते
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇmāsāyuḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kālacakraṃ vijānatā | anyacca śṛṇu deveśi yena mṛtyurvibuddhyate
verses.translation: In the name of Dvaravati because it has many entrances, it is very beautiful. It is protected by the Bhojas, Vrnis and Andhaka.s with Krsna as their leader.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the name of Dvaravati because it has many entrances, it is very beautiful. It is protected by the Bhojas, Vrnis and Andhaka.s with Krsna as their leader.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरोहीनां यदा छायां स्वकीयामुपलक्षयेत् । अथवा छायया हीनो मासमेकं न जीवति
verses.transliteration: śirohīnāṃ yadā chāyāṃ svakīyāmupalakṣayet | athavā chāyayā hīno māsamekaṃ na jīvati
verses.translation: O king, now go there and give this daughter of yours to Baladeva the son of Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, now go there and give this daughter of yours to Baladeva the son of Vasudeva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आङ्गिकानि मयोक्तानि मृत्युचिह्नानि पार्वति । बाह्यस्थानि ब्रुवे भद्रे चिह्नानि शृणु साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: āṅgikāni mayoktāni mṛtyucihnāni pārvati | bāhyasthāni bruve bhadre cihnāni śṛṇu sāmpratam
verses.translation: Then he gave his daughter, the youthful maiden, Revati to Bala the brother of Kfsna in conformity with the Slutric rituals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he gave his daughter, the youthful maiden, Revati to Bala the brother of Kfsna in conformity with the Slutric rituals.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रश्मिहीनं यदा देवि भवेत्सोमार्कमण्डलम् । दृश्यते पाटलाकारं मासार्धेन विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: raśmihīnaṃ yadā devi bhavetsomārkamaṇḍalam | dṛśyate pāṭalākāraṃ māsārdhena vipadyate
verses.translation: Then he, the great lord, went to the celestial summit of Meru and propitiated Siva observing penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he, the great lord, went to the celestial summit of Meru and propitiated Siva observing penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धतीं महायानमिन्दुं लक्षणवर्जितम् । अदृष्टतारको योऽसौ मासमेकं स जीवति
verses.transliteration: arundhatīṃ mahāyānaminduṃ lakṣaṇavarjitam | adṛṣṭatārako yo'sau māsamekaṃ sa jīvati
verses.translation: Raivata stayed in Brahma's region for many Yugas. He returned to the mortal world as a young man. This is my great doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Raivata stayed in Brahma's region for many Yugas. He returned to the mortal world as a young man. This is my great doubt.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टे ग्रहे च दिङ्मोहः षण्मासाज्जायते ध्रुवम् । उतथ्यं न ध्रुवं पश्येद्यदि वा रविमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭe grahe ca diṅmohaḥ ṣaṇmāsājjāyate dhruvam | utathyaṃ na dhruvaṃ paśyedyadi vā ravimaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Therefore the king did not attain old age or death, nor his daughter. After consulting Brahma about the bridegroom he returned still a young man.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore the king did not attain old age or death, nor his daughter. After consulting Brahma about the bridegroom he returned still a young man.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ धनुर्यदा पश्येन्मध्याह्ने चोल्कपातनम् । वेष्ट्यते गृध्रकाकैश्च षण्मासायुर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: rātrau dhanuryadā paśyenmadhyāhne colkapātanam | veṣṭyate gṛdhrakākaiśca ṣaṇmāsāyurna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Going to the divine city Dvaravati*' rebuilt by Krsna, he got his daughter married to Bala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Going to the divine city Dvaravati*' rebuilt by Krsna, he got his daughter married to Bala.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयः स्वर्गपन्थाश्च दृश्यन्ते नैव चाम्बरे । षण्मासायुर्विजनीयात्पुरुषैः कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ svargapanthāśca dṛśyante naiva cāmbare | ṣaṇmāsāyurvijanīyātpuruṣaiḥ kālavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: Hundred sons were born to that virtuous great lord. Through many wives Krsna too had innumerable sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundred sons were born to that virtuous great lord. Through many wives Krsna too had innumerable sons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकस्माद्राहुणा ग्रस्तं सूर्यं वा सोममेव च । दिक्चक्रं भ्रान्तवत्पश्येत्षण्मासान्म्रियते स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: akasmādrāhuṇā grastaṃ sūryaṃ vā somameva ca | dikcakraṃ bhrāntavatpaśyetṣaṇmāsānmriyate sphuṭam
verses.translation: Thus the race of Saryati has been narrated to you. O brahmins, I shall succinctly mention the details of others too. Listen attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the race of Saryati has been narrated to you. O brahmins, I shall succinctly mention the details of others too. Listen attentively.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नीलाभिर्मक्षिकाभिश्च ह्यकस्माद् वेष्ट्यते पुमान् । मासमेकं हि तस्यायुर्ज्ञातव्यं परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: nīlābhirmakṣikābhiśca hyakasmād veṣṭyate pumān | māsamekaṃ hi tasyāyurjñātavyaṃ paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: Nabhaga had a son Dhrsfa. After establishing the Ksatriya race and performing the brahminical rites he attained brahminhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nabhaga had a son Dhrsfa. After establishing the Ksatriya race and performing the brahminical rites he attained brahminhood.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृध्रः काकः कपोतश्च शिरश्चाक्रम्य तिष्ठति । शीघ्रं तु म्रियते जन्तुर्मासैकेन न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gṛdhraḥ kākaḥ kapotaśca śiraścākramya tiṣṭhati | śīghraṃ tu mriyate janturmāsaikena na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Dhrsta's race originally Ksatriya became brahmin family on the earth. Karusa's descendants the Karusas were Ksatriyas, insubjugable in war.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhrsta's race originally Ksatriya became brahmin family on the earth. Karusa's descendants the Karusas were Ksatriyas, insubjugable in war.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं चारिष्टभेदस्तु बाह्यस्थः समुदाहृतः । मानुषाणां हितार्थाय सङ्क्षेपेण वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ cāriṣṭabhedastu bāhyasthaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | mānuṣāṇāṃ hitārthāya saṅkṣepeṇa vadāmyaham
verses.translation: Once due to an error in his charitable gift of a cow, prompted by his own sins and crooked intellect, he became a chameleon.and was redeemed by Srikrsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once due to an error in his charitable gift of a cow, prompted by his own sins and crooked intellect, he became a chameleon.and was redeemed by Srikrsna.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तयोरुभयोर्देवि यथा कालं विजानते । वामदक्षिणयोर्मध्ये प्रत्यक्षं चेत्युदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: hastayorubhayordevi yathā kālaṃ vijānate | vāmadakṣiṇayormadhye pratyakṣaṃ cetyudāhṛtam
verses.translation: Once a tiger entered the cowshed to attack the cows. On hearing the shrieks of the cows he woke up. Strong that he was he seized a sword to kill it and started.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once a tiger entered the cowshed to attack the cows. On hearing the shrieks of the cows he woke up. Strong that he was he seized a sword to kill it and started.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं पक्षौ स्थितौ द्वौ तु समासात्सुरसुन्दरि । शुचिर्भूत्वा स्मरन्देवं सुस्नातः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pakṣau sthitau dvau tu samāsātsurasundari | śucirbhūtvā smarandevaṃ susnātaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the lord armed with a sword the frigh¬ tened tiger slipped away. Not knowing it and mistaking a reddish brown cow as the tiger he hit it with his sword on its head.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the lord armed with a sword the frigh¬ tened tiger slipped away. Not knowing it and mistaking a reddish brown cow as the tiger he hit it with his sword on its head.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्य दुग्धेनालक्तकेन विमर्दयेत् । गन्धैः पुष्पैः करौ कृत्वा मृगयेच्च शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: hastau prakṣālya dugdhenālaktakena vimardayet | gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ karau kṛtvā mṛgayecca śubhāśubham
verses.translation: Due to rain and gust of wind in the night he was deluded. Thinking, that the tiger had been killed he returned to his place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to rain and gust of wind in the night he was deluded. Thinking, that the tiger had been killed he returned to his place.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठामादितः कृत्वा यावदङ्गुष्ठकं प्रिये । पर्वत्रयक्रमेणैव हस्तयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: kaniṣṭhāmāditaḥ kṛtvā yāvadaṅguṣṭhakaṃ priye | parvatrayakrameṇaiva hastayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: When the night dawned into day he got up and went there. He saw only the cow killed and not the tiger. He felt dejected.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the night dawned into day he got up and went there. He saw only the cow killed and not the tiger. He felt dejected.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपदादि विन्यस्य तिथिं प्रतिपदादितः । सम्पुटाकारहस्तौ तु पूर्वदिङ्मुखसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: pratipadādi vinyasya tithiṃ pratipadāditaḥ | sampuṭākārahastau tu pūrvadiṅmukhasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing about the incident and realising that he had committed a sin unconsciously and not wilfully, the preceptor cursed him — "Become a Sudra, not a Ksatriya."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the incident and realising that he had committed a sin unconsciously and not wilfully, the preceptor cursed him — "Become a Sudra, not a Ksatriya."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मरेन्नवात्मकं मन्त्रं यावदष्टोत्तरं शतम् । निरीक्षयेत्ततो हस्तौ प्रतिपर्वणि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: smarennavātmakaṃ mantraṃ yāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | nirīkṣayettato hastau pratiparvaṇi yatnataḥ
verses.translation: On being cursed by his preceptor, the family priest out of anger, Prsadhra started from there and went to the great forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being cursed by his preceptor, the family priest out of anger, Prsadhra started from there and went to the great forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्पर्वणि सा रेखा दृश्यते भृङ्गसन्निभा । तत्तिथौ हि मृतिर्ज्ञेया कृष्णे शुक्ले तथा प्रिये
verses.transliteration: tasminparvaṇi sā rekhā dṛśyate bhṛṅgasannibhā | tattithau hi mṛtirjñeyā kṛṣṇe śukle tathā priye
verses.translation: Dejected by sufferings he became detached and practised Yoga. He burnt himself in conflagration and attained the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dejected by sufferings he became detached and practised Yoga. He burnt himself in conflagration and attained the greatest goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधुना नादजं वक्ष्ये सङ्क्षेपात्काललक्षणम् । गमागमं विदित्वा तु कर्म कुर्याञ्छृणु प्रिये
verses.transliteration: adhunā nādajaṃ vakṣye saṅkṣepātkālalakṣaṇam | gamāgamaṃ viditvā tu karma kuryāñchṛṇu priye
verses.translation: Before them O brahmins, there were no kings in Aryavarta. Of them the eldest was Vikuksi. He became the king of Ayodhya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Before them O brahmins, there were no kings in Aryavarta. Of them the eldest was Vikuksi. He became the king of Ayodhya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मविज्ञानं सुश्रोणि चारं ज्ञात्वा तु यत्नतः । क्षणं त्रुटिर्लवं चैव निमेषं काष्ठकालिकम्
verses.transliteration: ātmavijñānaṃ suśroṇi cāraṃ jñātvā tu yatnataḥ | kṣaṇaṃ truṭirlavaṃ caiva nimeṣaṃ kāṣṭhakālikam
verses.translation: Listen to one of his misdeeds. He wanted to perform Sraddha but before performing the same he ate a rabbit and came to be known as 6asada. Abandoned by Ikfvaku, he entered a forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to one of his misdeeds. He wanted to perform Sraddha but before performing the same he ate a rabbit and came to be known as 6asada. Abandoned by Ikfvaku, he entered a forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तकं त्वहोरात्रं पक्षमासर्तुवत्सरम् । अब्दं युगं तथा कल्पं महाकल्पं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: muhūrtakaṃ tvahorātraṃ pakṣamāsartuvatsaram | abdaṃ yugaṃ tathā kalpaṃ mahākalpaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: They all became kings and protectors of the northern country. Ayodha's son was the powerful king Kakutstha.
verses.commentary: Sense: They all became kings and protectors of the northern country. Ayodha's son was the powerful king Kakutstha.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स हरते कालः परिपाट्या सदाशिवः । वामदक्षिणमध्ये तु पथि त्रयमिदं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa harate kālaḥ paripāṭyā sadāśivaḥ | vāmadakṣiṇamadhye tu pathi trayamidaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Listen. You shall protect the earth virtuously. O king, only when protected by you can the earth be relieved of excitement and sorrow. It does not behove you to go to the forest. There is a Danava, proud of his strength near my hermitage, in the snow-covered wilderness, full of sea-sand. He is indestructible even* to the gods. He has a huge body and is very strong.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen. You shall protect the earth virtuously. O king, only when protected by you can the earth be relieved of excitement and sorrow. It does not behove you to go to the forest. There is a Danava, proud of his strength near my hermitage, in the snow-covered wilderness,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen. You shall protect the earth virtuously. O king, only when protected by you can the earth be relieved of excitement and sorrow. It does not behove you to go to the forest. There is a Danava, proud of his strength near my hermitage, in the snow-covered wilderness,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिनानि पञ्च चारभ्य पञ्चविंशद्दिनावधि । वामाचारगतौ नादः प्रमाणं कथितं तव
verses.transliteration: dināni pañca cārabhya pañcaviṃśaddināvadhi | vāmācāragatau nādaḥ pramāṇaṃ kathitaṃ tava
verses.translation: He stays underground concealed by the sand. The terrible Raksasa son of the demon Madhu is Dhundhu by name.
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays underground concealed by the sand. The terrible Raksasa son of the demon Madhu is Dhundhu by name.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूतरन्ध्रं दिशश्चैव ध्वजश्च वरवर्णिनि । वामचारगतौ नादः प्रमाणं कालवेदिनः
verses.transliteration: bhūtarandhraṃ diśaścaiva dhvajaśca varavarṇini | vāmacāragatau nādaḥ pramāṇaṃ kālavedinaḥ
verses.translation: He stays there performing a terrible penance for the destruction of the worlds. At the end of every year he exhales terribly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays there performing a terrible penance for the destruction of the worlds. At the end of every year he exhales terribly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋतोर्विकारभूताश्च गुणास्तत्रैव भामिनि । प्रमाणं दक्षिणं प्रोक्तं ज्ञातव्यं प्राणवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: ṛtorvikārabhūtāśca guṇāstatraiva bhāmini | pramāṇaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ proktaṃ jñātavyaṃ prāṇavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: When he exhales, the whole world including mountains, forests and wilderness, quakes. Blazing flames with pink smoke smoulder everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he exhales, the whole world including mountains, forests and wilderness, quakes. Blazing flames with pink smoke smoulder everywhere.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूतसङ्ख्या यदा प्राणान्वहन्ते च इडादयः । वर्षस्याभ्यन्तरे तस्य जीवितं हि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhūtasaṅkhyā yadā prāṇānvahante ca iḍādayaḥ | varṣasyābhyantare tasya jīvitaṃ hi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O king, I cannot stay in my hermitage. O strong one with huge arms ward him off desiring the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O king, I cannot stay in my hermitage. O strong one with huge arms ward him off desiring the welfare of the worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशघस्रप्रवाहेण ह्यब्दमानं स जीवति । पञ्चदशप्रवाहेण ह्यब्दमेकं गतायुषम्
verses.transliteration: daśaghasrapravāheṇa hyabdamānaṃ sa jīvati | pañcadaśapravāheṇa hyabdamekaṃ gatāyuṣam
verses.translation: Let the wordls become happy and peaceful after he had been killed by you. O lord of earth, you alone can slay him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the wordls become happy and peaceful after he had been killed by you. O lord of earth, you alone can slay him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विंशद्दिनप्रवाहेण षण्मासं लक्षयेत्तदा । पञ्चविंशद्दिनमितं वहते वामनाडिका
verses.transliteration: viṃśaddinapravāheṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ lakṣayettadā | pañcaviṃśaddinamitaṃ vahate vāmanāḍikā
verses.translation: O sinless one, a great boon has been granted to you. Visnu will heighten your splendour by his own splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sinless one, a great boon has been granted to you. Visnu will heighten your splendour by his own splendour.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवितं तु तदा तस्य त्रिमासं हि गतायुषः । षड्विंशद्दिनमानेन मासद्वयमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: jīvitaṃ tu tadā tasya trimāsaṃ hi gatāyuṣaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśaddinamānena māsadvayamudāhṛtam
verses.translation: Great virtue accrues from the protection of the subjects. A similar opportunity is wanting in the forest. Let not your mind be directed that way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Great virtue accrues from the protection of the subjects. A similar opportunity is wanting in the forest. Let not your mind be directed that way.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशद्दिनमितं वहते त्वत्यविश्रमा । मासमेकं समाख्यातं जीवितं वामगोचरे
verses.transliteration: saptaviṃśaddinamitaṃ vahate tvatyaviśramā | māsamekaṃ samākhyātaṃ jīvitaṃ vāmagocare
verses.translation: O leading king, nowhere such a virtue exists as it does in the protection of the subjects. This has been pursued by the saintly kings of yore.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, nowhere such a virtue exists as it does in the protection of the subjects. This has been pursued by the saintly kings of yore.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्प्रमाणं विज्ञेयं वामवायुप्रमाणतः । सव्येतरे दिनान्येव चत्वारश्चानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: etatpramāṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ vāmavāyupramāṇataḥ | savyetare dinānyeva catvāraścānupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested the saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the task of thwarting Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested the saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the task of thwarting Dhundhu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुस्स्थाने स्थिता देवि षोडशैताः प्रकीर्तिताः । तेषां प्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतं हि यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: catussthāne sthitā devi ṣoḍaśaitāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | teṣāṃ pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi sāmprataṃ hi yathārthataḥ
verses.translation: Having said thus and instructed his son the king proceeded with penance. Kuvalasva accompanied by Uttahka went to fight with Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having said thus and instructed his son the king proceeded with penance. Kuvalasva accompanied by Uttahka went to fight with Dhundhu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षड्दिनान्यादितः कृत्वा सङ्ख्यायाश्च यथाविधि । एतदन्तर्गते चैव वामरन्ध्रे प्रकाशितम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍdinānyāditaḥ kṛtvā saṅkhyāyāśca yathāvidhi | etadantargate caiva vāmarandhre prakāśitam
verses.translation: At the approach of Uttahka and for the benefit of the worlds, lord Vi§nu entered him with his splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the approach of Uttahka and for the benefit of the worlds, lord Vi§nu entered him with his splendour.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षड्दिनानि यदा रूढं द्विवर्षं च स जीवति । मासानष्टौ विजानीयाद्दिनान्यष्टौ च तानि तु
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍdināni yadā rūḍhaṃ dvivarṣaṃ ca sa jīvati | māsānaṣṭau vijānīyāddinānyaṣṭau ca tāni tu
verses.translation: When the invincible Kuvalasva started there was a loud shout in the heaven. "This glorious prince v/ill slay Dhundhu."
verses.commentary: Sense: When the invincible Kuvalasva started there was a loud shout in the heaven. "This glorious prince v/ill slay Dhundhu."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाः सप्तदशे चैव विद्धि वर्षं न संशयः । सप्तमासान्विजानीयाद्दिनैः षड्भिर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: prāṇāḥ saptadaśe caiva viddhi varṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | saptamāsānvijānīyāddinaiḥ ṣaḍbhirna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The gods surrounded him with garlands of flowers. They praised him saying "Be victorious. Be long-lived."
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods surrounded him with garlands of flowers. They praised him saying "Be victorious. Be long-lived."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टघस्रप्रभेदेन द्विवर्षं हि स जीवति । चतुर्मासा हि विज्ञेयाश्चतुर्विंशद्दिनावधि
verses.transliteration: aṣṭaghasraprabhedena dvivarṣaṃ hi sa jīvati | caturmāsā hi vijñeyāścaturviṃśaddināvadhi
verses.translation: The most excellent among the victorious, the king went there accompanied by his sons. He caused an ocean *o be dug in the midst of that vast expanse of sand.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent among the victorious, the king went there accompanied by his sons. He caused an ocean *o be dug in the midst of that vast expanse of sand.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा नवदिनं प्राणा वहन्त्येव त्रिमासकम् । मासद्वयं च द्वे मासे दिना द्वादश कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: yadā navadinaṃ prāṇā vahantyeva trimāsakam | māsadvayaṃ ca dve māse dinā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: O brahminical sage, heightened in strength by the splendour of Visu he became very brilliant and stronger.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahminical sage, heightened in strength by the splendour of Visu he became very brilliant and stronger.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववत्कथिता ये तु कालं तेषां तु पूर्वकम् । अवान्तरदिना ये तु तेन मासेन कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: pūrvavatkathitā ye tu kālaṃ teṣāṃ tu pūrvakam | avāntaradinā ye tu tena māsena kathyate
verses.translation: He appeared to consume all the worlds out of fury in the fire emerging from his mouth. Water too gushed out from him as from the moon-stone at the moonrise.
verses.commentary: Sense: He appeared to consume all the worlds out of fury in the fire emerging from his mouth. Water too gushed out from him as from the moon-stone at the moonrise.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकादशप्रवाहेण वर्षमेकं स जीवति । मासा नव तथा प्रोक्ता दिनान्यष्टमितान्यपि
verses.transliteration: ekādaśapravāheṇa varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati | māsā nava tathā proktā dinānyaṣṭamitānyapi
verses.translation: The hundred sons were scorched and burnt in the fire. O great sage, among them only three survived.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hundred sons were scorched and burnt in the fire. O great sage, among them only three survived.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशेन प्रवाहेण वर्षमेकं स जीवति । मासान् सप्त विजानीयात्षड्घस्रांश्चाप्युदाहरेत्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśena pravāheṇa varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati | māsān sapta vijānīyātṣaḍghasrāṃścāpyudāharet
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, then the king of great splen¬ dour rushed at the very powerful Raksasa, the brahmin- slayer Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, then the king of great splen¬ dour rushed at the very powerful Raksasa, the brahmin- slayer Dhundhu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाडी यदा च वहति त्रयोदशदिनावधि । संवत्सरं भवेत्तस्य चतुर्मासाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: nāḍī yadā ca vahati trayodaśadināvadhi | saṃvatsaraṃ bhavettasya caturmāsāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The king quaffed off the gushing water through fiery arrows and quelled the fire through water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king quaffed off the gushing water through fiery arrows and quelled the fire through water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विशद्दिनं शेषं जीवितं च न संशयः । प्राणवाहा यदा वामे चतुर्द्दशदिनानि तु
verses.transliteration: caturviśaddinaṃ śeṣaṃ jīvitaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ | prāṇavāhā yadā vāme caturddaśadināni tu
verses.translation: O great sage, Uttanka granted him boons. He gave him never-ending wealth and invincibility to enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, Uttanka granted him boons. He gave him never-ending wealth and invincibility to enemies.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरं भवेत्तस्य मासाः षट् च प्रकीर्तिताः । चतुर्विंशद्दिनान्येव जीवितं च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraṃ bhavettasya māsāḥ ṣaṭ ca prakīrtitāḥ | caturviṃśaddinānyeva jīvitaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He blessed him with interest in virtue, perpetual residence in the heaven and the imperishable world to his sons who were killed in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: He blessed him with interest in virtue, perpetual residence in the heaven and the imperishable world to his sons who were killed in the battle.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चदशप्रवाहेण नव मासान्स जीवति । चतुर्विशद्दिनान्येव कथितं कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: pañcadaśapravāheṇa nava māsānsa jīvati | caturviśaddinānyeva kathitaṃ kālavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: Three of his sons survived. The eldest of them
verses.commentary: Sense: Three of his sons survived. The eldest of them
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षोडशाहप्रवाहेण दशमासान्स जीवति । चतुर्विशद्दिनाधिक्यं कथितं कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśāhapravāheṇa daśamāsānsa jīvati | caturviśaddinādhikyaṃ kathitaṃ kālavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: He had two daughters Haimavati and Dr$advati honoured by the good. She was famous in the three worlds. Her son was Prasenajit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had two daughters Haimavati and Dr$advati honoured by the good. She was famous in the three worlds. Her son was Prasenajit.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तदशप्रवाहेण नवमासैर्गतायुषम् । अष्टादश दिनान्यत्र कथितं साधकेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: saptadaśapravāheṇa navamāsairgatāyuṣam | aṣṭādaśa dinānyatra kathitaṃ sādhakeśvari
verses.translation: Prasenajit had a chaste wife Gauri.®® She was cursed by her husband and turned into the river Bahuda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prasenajit had a chaste wife Gauri.®® She was cursed by her husband and turned into the river Bahuda.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वामचारं यदा देवि ह्यष्टादशदिनावधिः । जीवितं चाष्टमासं तु घस्रा द्वादश कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: vāmacāraṃ yadā devi hyaṣṭādaśadināvadhiḥ | jīvitaṃ cāṣṭamāsaṃ tu ghasrā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Salabindu's daughter the chaste Gaitrarathi was his wife. She was the eldest sister of ten thousand brothers. Mandhata begot of her two sons, Purukutsa, the knower of sacred rites and Mucukunda the righteous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salabindu's daughter the chaste Gaitrarathi was his wife. She was the eldest sister of ten thousand brothers. Mandhata begot of her two sons, Purukutsa, the knower of sacred rites and Mucukunda the righteous.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशद्दिनान्यत्र निश्चयेनावधारय । प्राणवाहो यदा देवि त्रयोविंशद्दिनावधिः
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśaddinānyatra niścayenāvadhāraya | prāṇavāho yadā devi trayoviṃśaddināvadhiḥ
verses.translation: He was evil-minded. Whenever sacred mantras were recited he put obstacles. After the marriage was cele¬ brated he abducted the brides of others with force, out of lust, delusion, fun or arrogance. He abducted the virgins to satisfy his lust. The king Trayyaruni forsook him for such evil practices. Infuriated he called him a disgraceful wretch.
verses.wordMeaning: He was evil-minded. Whenever sacred mantras were recited he put obstacles. After the marriage was cele¬ brated he abducted the brides of others with force, out of lust, delusion, fun or arrogance. He abducted the virgins to satisfy his lust.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He was evil-minded. Whenever sacred mantras were recited he put obstacles. After the marriage was cele¬ brated he abducted the brides of others with force, out of lust, delusion, fun or arrogance. He abducted the virgins to satisfy his lust.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारः कथिता मासाः षड्दिनानि तथोत्तरे । चतुर्विंशप्रवाहेण त्रीन्मासांश्च स जीवति
verses.transliteration: catvāraḥ kathitā māsāḥ ṣaḍdināni tathottare | caturviṃśapravāheṇa trīnmāsāṃśca sa jīvati
verses.translation: When cast-off he asked his father where to go. The king asked him to stay with the outcastes.
verses.commentary: Sense: When cast-off he asked his father where to go. The king asked him to stay with the outcastes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिनान्यत्र दशाष्टौ स संहरन्त्येव चारतः । अवान्तरदिने यस्तु सङ्क्षेपात्ते प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: dinānyatra daśāṣṭau sa saṃharantyeva cārataḥ | avāntaradine yastu saṅkṣepātte prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Cast off by his father the righteous king and pro¬ tector, the heroic Satyavrata lived with the outcastes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cast off by his father the righteous king and pro¬ tector, the heroic Satyavrata lived with the outcastes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वामचारः समाख्यातो दक्षिणं शृणु साम्प्रतम् । अष्टाविंशप्रवाहेण तिथिमानेन जीवति
verses.transliteration: vāmacāraḥ samākhyāto dakṣiṇaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam | aṣṭāviṃśapravāheṇa tithimānena jīvati
verses.translation: Becoming detached due to the activities of his son, the king Trayyaruni forsook everything and went to the forest in order to perform penance to propitiate Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Becoming detached due to the activities of his son, the king Trayyaruni forsook everything and went to the forest in order to perform penance to propitiate Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवाहेण दशाहेन तत्संस्थेन विपद्यते । त्रिंशद्धस्रप्रवाहेन पञ्चाहेन विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: pravāheṇa daśāhena tatsaṃsthena vipadyate | triṃśaddhasrapravāhena pañcāhena vipadyate
verses.translation: Vi4vamitra of great penance abandoned his wife in that land and performed extensive penance in the marshy foreshore of the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi4vamitra of great penance abandoned his wife in that land and performed extensive penance in the marshy foreshore of the ocean.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकत्रिंशद्यदा देवि वहते च निरन्तरम् । दिनत्रयं तदा तस्य जीवितं हि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ekatriṃśadyadā devi vahate ca nirantaram | dinatrayaṃ tadā tasya jīvitaṃ hi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: His wife tied her middle son round her neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows in order to sustain the other children.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife tied her middle son round her neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows in order to sustain the other children.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशत्प्राणसङ्ख्या च यदा हि वहते रविः । तदा तु जीवितं तस्य द्विदिनं हि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dvātriṃśatprāṇasaṅkhyā ca yadā hi vahate raviḥ | tadā tu jīvitaṃ tasya dvidinaṃ hi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her offering her own son, tied round her neck, for sale, Satyavrata released him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her offering her own son, tied round her neck, for sale, Satyavrata released him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणः कथितः प्राणो मध्यस्थं कथयामि ते । एकभागगतो वायुप्रवाहो मुखमण्डले
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaḥ kathitaḥ prāṇo madhyasthaṃ kathayāmi te | ekabhāgagato vāyupravāho mukhamaṇḍale
verses.translation: The mighty Satyabrata sustained him just to satisfy Visvamitra and out of human sympathy.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty Satyabrata sustained him just to satisfy Visvamitra and out of human sympathy.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धावमानप्रवाहेण दिनमेकं स जीवति । चक्रमेतत्परासोर्हि पुराविद्भिरुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: dhāvamānapravāheṇa dinamekaṃ sa jīvati | cakrametatparāsorhi purāvidbhirudāhṛtam
verses.translation: Ever since then, that son of sage Visvamitra came to be called Galava because he was tied round the neck. He too performed great penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, that son of sage Visvamitra came to be called Galava because he was tied round the neck. He too performed great penance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं देवि कालचक्रं गतायुषः । लोकानां च हितार्थाय किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ devi kālacakraṃ gatāyuṣaḥ | lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kimanyacchrotumicchasi
verses.translation: By his devotion to Visvamitra his compassionate nature and his vow, Satyavrata nurtured and looked after ViSvamitra's wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: By his devotion to Visvamitra his compassionate nature and his vow, Satyavrata nurtured and looked after ViSvamitra's wife.

verses.sanskrit: ५.२६ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.26 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Vasistha had not prevented the father from exiling the son from the kingdom because there was sufficient cause for the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha had not prevented the father from exiling the son from the kingdom because there was sufficient cause for the same.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Vasistha had not prevented the father from exiling the son from the kingdom because there was sufficient cause for the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha had not prevented the father from exiling the son from the kingdom because there was sufficient cause for the same.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । कालवञ्चनवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । कथितं तु त्वया देव कालज्ञानं यथार्थतः । कालस्य वञ्चनं ब्रूहि यथा तत्त्वेन योगिनः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.26. ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kālavañcanavarṇanam | devyuvāca | kathitaṃ tu tvayā deva kālajñānaṃ yathārthataḥ | kālasya vañcanaṃ brūhi yathā tattvena yoginaḥ
verses.translation: Only for the satisfaction of his father did he do the same thinking that the family customs should remain unviolated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only for the satisfaction of his father did he do the same thinking that the family customs should remain unviolated.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालस्तु सन्निकृष्टो हि वर्तते सर्वजन्तुषु । यथा चास्य न मृत्युश्च वञ्चते कालमागतम्
verses.transliteration: kālastu sannikṛṣṭo hi vartate sarvajantuṣu | yathā cāsya na mṛtyuśca vañcate kālamāgatam
verses.translation: He defeated 6akas,' Bahudakas, Paradas'** taga:i|;ias* and Khaias. He established a good religious cult and ruled over the earth virtuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: He defeated 6akas,' Bahudakas, Paradas'** taga:i|;ias* and Khaias. He established a good religious cult and ruled over the earth virtuously.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा कथय मे देव प्रीतिं कृत्वा ममोपरि । योगिनां च हिताय त्वं ब्रूहि सर्वसुखप्रद
verses.transliteration: tathā kathaya me deva prītiṃ kṛtvā mamopari | yogināṃ ca hitāya tvaṃ brūhi sarvasukhaprada
verses.translation: See No. 35 above.
verses.commentary: Sense: See No. 35 above.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि पृष्टोऽहं यत्त्वया शिवे । समासेन च सर्वेषां मानुषाणां हितार्थतः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pṛṣṭo'haṃ yattvayā śive | samāsena ca sarveṣāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ hitārthataḥ
verses.translation: Aurva performed the postnatal rites of that prince. He taught him Vedas and Sastras and instructed him in the use of missiles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aurva performed the postnatal rites of that prince. He taught him Vedas and Sastras and instructed him in the use of missiles.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यापस्तथा तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च । एतेषां हि समायोगः शरीरं पाञ्चभौतिकम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca | eteṣāṃ hi samāyogaḥ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam
verses.translation: Thus conquering the earth virtuously the king instituted a horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus conquering the earth virtuously the king instituted a horse-sacrifice.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वया स चोक्तः कथया जनाना- मदृष्टरूपः प्रचरिष्यसीति । दृष्टस्त्वया तत्र महाप्रभावः प्रभोर्वरात्ते पुनरुत्थितश्च
verses.transliteration: tvayā sa coktaḥ kathayā janānā- madṛṣṭarūpaḥ pracariṣyasīti | dṛṣṭastvayā tatra mahāprabhāvaḥ prabhorvarātte punarutthitaśca
verses.translation: In order to search out the horse, king Sagara caused the country around dug up through his sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to search out the horse, king Sagara caused the country around dug up through his sons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धि योगिना नित्यं स्वस्वकालेंऽशजा गुणाः । चिन्तनीयाः प्रयत्नेन देवि कालजिगीषुणा
verses.transliteration: tasmāddhi yoginā nityaṃ svasvakāleṃ'śajā guṇāḥ | cintanīyāḥ prayatnena devi kālajigīṣuṇā
verses.translation: As he woke up from trance all but four of the sixty thousand sons were burnt by the fire from his eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he woke up from trance all but four of the sixty thousand sons were burnt by the fire from his eyes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एष ते कथितो देवि शब्दब्रह्मविधिक्रमः । पलालमिव धान्यार्थी त्यजेद्बन्धमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: eṣa te kathito devi śabdabrahmavidhikramaḥ | palālamiva dhānyārthī tyajedbandhamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The four who were spared were Harsaketu, Suketu, Dharmaratha and Paficajana. They became the kings es¬ tablishing his line.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four who were spared were Harsaketu, Suketu, Dharmaratha and Paficajana. They became the kings es¬ tablishing his line.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घोषं कांस्यं तथा शृङ्गं घण्टां वीणादिवंशजान् । दुन्दुभिं शङ्खशब्दं तु नवमं मेघगर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: ghoṣaṃ kāṃsyaṃ tathā śṛṅgaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ vīṇādivaṃśajān | dundubhiṃ śaṅkhaśabdaṃ tu navamaṃ meghagarjitam
verses.translation: Lord Visnu granted him five boons, viz. flourishing family, intelligence, fame, the ocean as son and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu granted him five boons, viz. flourishing family, intelligence, fame, the ocean as son and wealth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतो वंशनादं तु सर्वतत्त्वं प्रजायते । दुन्दुभिं ध्यायमानस्तु जरामृत्युविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyato vaṃśanādaṃ tu sarvatattvaṃ prajāyate | dundubhiṃ dhyāyamānastu jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: By that virtue he attained the fatherhood of ocean. He regained the sacrificial horse from the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: By that virtue he attained the fatherhood of ocean. He regained the sacrificial horse from the ocean.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशस्तु ततो व्यापी सर्वेषां सर्वगः स्थितः । आकाशे तु विलीयन्ते सम्भवन्ति पुनस्ततः
verses.transliteration: ākāśastu tato vyāpī sarveṣāṃ sarvagaḥ sthitaḥ | ākāśe tu vilīyante sambhavanti punastataḥ
verses.translation: They were put in jars of ghee and nurtured by nursing maidens. They became princes and enhanced the delight of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were put in jars of ghee and nurtured by nursing maidens. They became princes and enhanced the delight of all.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वियोगे तु सदा कस्य स्वं धाम प्रतिपेदिरे । तस्या न स्थिरता चास्ति सन्निपातस्य सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: viyoge tu sadā kasya svaṃ dhāma pratipedire | tasyā na sthiratā cāsti sannipātasya sundari
verses.translation: When they were burnt by Kapila one Paflcajana became king.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were burnt by Kapila one Paflcajana became king.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानिनोऽपि तथा तत्र तपोमन्त्रबलादपि । ते सर्वे सुविजानन्ति सर्वमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: jñānino'pi tathā tatra tapomantrabalādapi | te sarve suvijānanti sarvametanna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Paflcajana begot a son ArhSumat whose son was Dilipa. Dilipa*s son was Bharatha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paflcajana begot a son ArhSumat whose son was Dilipa. Dilipa*s son was Bharatha.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । खं तेन यन्नश्यति घोररूपः कालः करालस्त्रिदिवैकनाथः । दग्धस्त्वया त्वं पुनरेव तुष्टः स्तोत्रैः स्तुतः स्वां प्रकृतिं स लेभे
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | khaṃ tena yannaśyati ghorarūpaḥ kālaḥ karālastridivaikanāthaḥ | dagdhastvayā tvaṃ punareva tuṣṭaḥ stotraiḥ stutaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ sa lebhe
verses.translation: 'Rtuparna's on was Anuparna. His son was IVIitrasaha who was known as Kalmaiapada also.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Rtuparna's on was Anuparna. His son was IVIitrasaha who was known as Kalmaiapada also.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदद्य भोः काल इहास्थि किञ्चित् निहन्यते येन वदस्व तन्मे । त्वं योगिवर्यः प्रभुरात्मतन्त्रः परोपकारात्ततनुर्महेश
verses.transliteration: tadadya bhoḥ kāla ihāsthi kiñcit nihanyate yena vadasva tanme | tvaṃ yogivaryaḥ prabhurātmatantraḥ paropakārāttatanurmaheśa
verses.translation: During the twelve years of famine and drought Satyavrata observed his vow. When there was no meat available the prince saw the wish-yielding cow of Vasistha. O sage, the king who observed the ten tenets®® of Dharma
verses.commentary: Sense: During the twelve years of famine and drought Satyavrata observed his vow. When there was no meat available the prince saw the wish-yielding cow of Vasistha. O sage, the king who observed the ten tenets®® of Dharma
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । न हन्यते देववरैस्तु दैत्यैः सयक्षरक्षोरगमानुषैश्च । ये योगिनो ध्यानपराः सदेहा भवन्ति ते घ्नन्ति सुखेन कालम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | na hanyate devavaraistu daityaiḥ sayakṣarakṣoragamānuṣaiśca | ye yogino dhyānaparāḥ sadehā bhavanti te ghnanti sukhena kālam
verses.translation: Cp. Manu. VI. 01
verses.commentary: Sense: Cp. Manu. VI. 01
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा त्रिभुवनगुरोः प्राह गौरी विहस्य सत्यं त्वं मे वद कथमसौ हन्यते येन कालः । शम्भुस्तामाह सद्यो हिमकरवदने योगिनो ये क्षिपन्ति कालव्यालं सकलमनघास्तच्छृणुष्वैकचित्ताः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca | etacchrutvā tribhuvanaguroḥ prāha gaurī vihasya satyaṃ tvaṃ me vada kathamasau hanyate yena kālaḥ | śambhustāmāha sadyo himakaravadane yogino ye kṣipanti kālavyālaṃ sakalamanaghāstacchṛṇuṣvaikacittāḥ
verses.translation: If the two iron stakes thrust by me fail I shall fix another cruel one.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the two iron stakes thrust by me fail I shall fix another cruel one.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । पञ्चभूतात्मको देहः सदा युक्तस्तु तद्गुणैः । उत्पाद्यते वरारोहे तद्विलीनो हि पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | pañcabhūtātmako dehaḥ sadā yuktastu tadguṇaiḥ | utpādyate varārohe tadvilīno hi pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: He called him Trisanku and ever since he is known as Trisanku. When Visvamitra returned he was plea¬ sed with Trisanku for having maintained his family during his absence. When pressed to choose a boon the prince chose it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He called him Trisanku and ever since he is known as Trisanku. When Visvamitra returned he was plea¬ sed with Trisanku for having maintained his family during his absence. When pressed to choose a boon the prince chose it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशाज्जायते वायुर्वायोस्तेजश्च जायते । तेजसोऽम्बु विनिर्द्दिष्टं तस्माद्धि पृथिवी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ākāśājjāyate vāyurvāyostejaśca jāyate | tejaso'mbu vinirddiṣṭaṃ tasmāddhi pṛthivī bhavet
verses.translation: Ever as the gods and Visistha were watching, the saintly lord Viivamitra made him ascend heaven in his physi¬ cal body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever as the gods and Visistha were watching, the saintly lord Viivamitra made him ascend heaven in his physi¬ cal body.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि गच्छन्ति क्रमशः परम् । धरा पञ्चगुणा प्रोक्ता ह्यापश्चैव चतुर्गुणाः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni gacchanti kramaśaḥ param | dharā pañcaguṇā proktā hyāpaścaiva caturguṇāḥ
verses.translation: His wife Satyaratha, hailing from the family of Kekayas* bore him a son who was named Hari5candra.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife Satyaratha, hailing from the family of Kekayas* bore him a son who was named Hari5candra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगुणं च तथा तेजो वायुर्द्विगुण एव च । शब्दैकगुणमाकाशं पृथिव्यादिषु कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: triguṇaṃ ca tathā tejo vāyurdviguṇa eva ca | śabdaikaguṇamākāśaṃ pṛthivyādiṣu kīrtitam
verses.translation: Haihayas and Talajanghas removed that king. O brahmin, he was very virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haihayas and Talajanghas removed that king. O brahmin, he was very virtuous.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः । विजहाति गुणं स्वं स्वं तदा भूतं विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ | vijahāti guṇaṃ svaṃ svaṃ tadā bhūtaṃ vipadyate
verses.translation: Securing fiery missiles from Bhargava king Sagara
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing fiery missiles from Bhargava king Sagara
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा गुणं विगृह्णाति प्रादुर्भूतं तदुच्यते । एवं जानीहि देवेशि पञ्चभूतानि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tadā guṇaṃ vigṛhṇāti prādurbhūtaṃ taducyate | evaṃ jānīhi deveśi pañcabhūtāni tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Kekayas lived between the Jhelum and the-Beas and had their capital at Glrivraja (Girijak or Jaiaipur) pn the Jhelum.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kekayas lived between the Jhelum and the-Beas and had their capital at Glrivraja (Girijak or Jaiaipur) pn the Jhelum.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । कथं जेजीयते कालो योगिभिर्योगवित्प्रभो । ध्यानेन चाथ मन्त्रेण तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | kathaṃ jejīyate kālo yogibhiryogavitprabho | dhyānena cātha mantreṇa tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me
verses.translation: O sage, listen with attention. I shall narrate what Vaiampayana said on being asked by Janamejaya, son of PSriksita.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, listen with attention. I shall narrate what Vaiampayana said on being asked by Janamejaya, son of PSriksita.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि योगिनां हितकाम्यया । परज्ञानप्रकथनं न देयं यस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yogināṃ hitakāmyayā | parajñānaprakathanaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit
verses.translation: O dear, O lord of the subjects, the kingdom of Bahu who indulged in vices was captured by Haihayas and Talajahghas and the iSakas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, O lord of the subjects, the kingdom of Bahu who indulged in vices was captured by Haihayas and Talajahghas and the iSakas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्दधानाय दातव्यं भक्तियुक्ताय धीमते । अनास्तिकाय शुद्धाय धर्मनित्याय भामिनि
verses.transliteration: śraddadhānāya dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya dhīmate | anāstikāya śuddhāya dharmanityāya bhāmini
verses.translation: Five groups of Rakasas are mentioned, viz. — Yavanas,*® Paradas,®* Kambojas,® Pahlavas*' and Bahudakas.**
verses.commentary: Sense: Five groups of Rakasas are mentioned, viz. — Yavanas,*® Paradas,®* Kambojas,® Pahlavas*' and Bahudakas.**
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुश्वासेन सुशय्यायां योगं युञ्जीत योगवित् । दीपं विनान्धकारे तु प्रजाः सुप्तेषु धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: suśvāsena suśayyāyāṃ yogaṃ yuñjīta yogavit | dīpaṃ vināndhakāre tu prajāḥ supteṣu dhārayet
verses.translation: These constituted one of the five clans of Haihayas, the other
verses.commentary: Sense: These constituted one of the five clans of Haihayas, the other
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तर्जन्या पिहितौ कर्णौ पीडयित्वा मुहूर्त्तकम् । तस्मात्संश्रूयते शब्दस्तुदन्वह्निसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tarjanyā pihitau karṇau pīḍayitvā muhūrttakam | tasmātsaṃśrūyate śabdastudanvahnisamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Haihayas foimed a branch of the Yadavas who ruled at Mahistnati (Mod. Mandhita in the Nimar District, M.P.) on the Narmada river.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haihayas foimed a branch of the Yadavas who ruled at Mahistnati (Mod. Mandhita in the Nimar District, M.P.) on the Narmada river.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्यातो भुक्तमेवं हि चावसन्नं क्षणादपि । सर्वरोगान्निहत्याशु ज्वरोपद्रवकान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: sandhyāto bhuktamevaṃ hi cāvasannaṃ kṣaṇādapi | sarvarogānnihatyāśu jvaropadravakānbahūn
verses.translation: Paradas are identical with the Parthians who lived in the Khorasam region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paradas are identical with the Parthians who lived in the Khorasam region.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चोपलक्षयेन्नित्यमाकारं घटिकाद्वयम् । जित्वा मृत्युं तथा कामं स्वेच्छया पर्यटेदिह
verses.transliteration: yaścopalakṣayennityamākāraṃ ghaṭikādvayam | jitvā mṛtyuṃ tathā kāmaṃ svecchayā paryaṭediha
verses.translation: The Taganas or Tahganas had their headquarters at TafigaS- pura near jyotirmatha in Garhwal (Ep. Ind. Vol. XXXI. ).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Taganas or Tahganas had their headquarters at TafigaS- pura near jyotirmatha in Garhwal (Ep. Ind. Vol. XXXI. ).
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् । यथा नदति खेऽब्दो हि प्रावृडद्भिः सुसंयतः
verses.transliteration: sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt | yathā nadati khe'bdo hi prāvṛḍadbhiḥ susaṃyataḥ
verses.translation: According to Al-Biruni, the Khasas were a Himalayan tribe now represented by the Khakkas of Kashmir.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Al-Biruni, the Khasas were a Himalayan tribe now represented by the Khakkas of Kashmir.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं श्रुत्वा मुच्यते योगी सद्यः संसारबन्धनात् । ततः स योगिभिर्न्नित्यं सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: taṃ śrutvā mucyate yogī sadyaḥ saṃsārabandhanāt | tataḥ sa yogibhirnnityaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmataro bhavet
verses.translation: Yavanas are identical with the Indo-Greeks who settled in the northwestern part of India and adjoining lands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yavanas are identical with the Indo-Greeks who settled in the northwestern part of India and adjoining lands.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शब्दब्रह्म त्विदं प्राप्य ये केचिदन्यकाङ्क्षिणः । घ्नन्ति ते मुष्टिनाकाशं कामयन्ते क्षुधां तृषाम्
verses.transliteration: śabdabrahma tvidaṃ prāpya ye kecidanyakāṅkṣiṇaḥ | ghnanti te muṣṭinākāśaṃ kāmayante kṣudhāṃ tṛṣām
verses.translation: Kimbojas lived in the land between the Rajauri Valley in Kashmir and the Hindukush mountains. Some scholars locate the tri near Badakhshan beyond the Hindukush.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kimbojas lived in the land between the Rajauri Valley in Kashmir and the Hindukush mountains. Some scholars locate the tri near Badakhshan beyond the Hindukush.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा परमिदं ब्रह्म सुखदं मुक्तिकारणम् । अबाह्यमक्षरं चैव सर्वोपाधिविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā paramidaṃ brahma sukhadaṃ muktikāraṇam | abāhyamakṣaraṃ caiva sarvopādhivivarjitam
verses.translation: Bahudakas remain unidentified.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahudakas remain unidentified.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मोहिताः कालपाशेन मृत्युपाशवशङ्गताः । शब्दब्रह्म न जानन्ति पापिनस्ते कुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: mohitāḥ kālapāśena mṛtyupāśavaśaṅgatāḥ | śabdabrahma na jānanti pāpinaste kubuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: O king, these five groups of Rakasas pursuing activities of exploit on behalf of the Haihayas seized the kingdom of Bahu and gave it to the Haihayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, these five groups of Rakasas pursuing activities of exploit on behalf of the Haihayas seized the kingdom of Bahu and gave it to the Haihayas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तावद् भ्रमन्ति संसारे यावद्धाम न विन्दते । विदिते तु परे तत्त्वे मुच्यते जन्मबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: tāvad bhramanti saṃsāre yāvaddhāma na vindate | vidite tu pare tattve mucyate janmabandhanāt
verses.translation: Having lost the kingdom, Bahu went to the forest along with his wife. Distressed that he was he abandoned his life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having lost the kingdom, Bahu went to the forest along with his wife. Distressed that he was he abandoned his life.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निद्रालस्यं महाविघ्नं जित्वा शत्रुं प्रयत्नतः । सुखासने स्थितो नित्यं शब्दब्रह्माभ्यसन्निति
verses.transliteration: nidrālasyaṃ mahāvighnaṃ jitvā śatruṃ prayatnataḥ | sukhāsane sthito nityaṃ śabdabrahmābhyasanniti
verses.translation: One of his wives belonging to the house ofYadu followed him in pregnancy. Due to jealousy as a result of her expected son before her, the co-wife administered poison to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: One of his wives belonging to the house ofYadu followed him in pregnancy. Due to jealousy as a result of her expected son before her, the co-wife administered poison to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतवृद्धः पुमांल्लब्ध्वा यावदायुः समभ्यसेत् । मृत्युञ्जयवपुस्तम्भ आरोग्यं वायुवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: śatavṛddhaḥ pumāṃllabdhvā yāvadāyuḥ samabhyaset | mṛtyuñjayavapustambha ārogyaṃ vāyuvarddhanam
verses.translation: She made the funeral pyre of her husband ready and was about to enter the fire, Aurva Bhargava mercifully prevented her.
verses.commentary: Sense: She made the funeral pyre of her husband ready and was about to enter the fire, Aurva Bhargava mercifully prevented her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्ययो दृश्यते वृद्धे किं पुनस्तरुणे जने । न चोङ्कारो न मन्त्रोऽपि नैव बीजं न चाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: pratyayo dṛśyate vṛddhe kiṃ punastaruṇe jane | na coṅkāro na mantro'pi naiva bījaṃ na cākṣaram
verses.translation: The queen stayed in his hermitage for the sake of her child in the womb. She served the sage, mentally remem¬ bering Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The queen stayed in his hermitage for the sake of her child in the womb. She served the sage, mentally remem¬ bering Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनाहतमनुच्चार्यं शब्दब्रह्म शिवं परम् । ध्यायन्ते देवि सततं सुधियो यत्नतः प्रिये
