verses.transliteration: anāhatamanuccāryaṃ śabdabrahma śivaṃ param | dhyāyante devi satataṃ sudhiyo yatnataḥ priye
verses.translation: Once when the Muhurta and the Lagna were good when the five planets were ascendant the child was born along with the poison administered to the queen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once when the Muhurta and the Lagna were good when the five planets were ascendant the child was born along with the poison administered to the queen.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छब्दा नव प्रोक्ताः प्राणविद्भिस्तु लक्षिताः । तान् प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्नेन नादसिद्धिमनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tasmācchabdā nava proktāḥ prāṇavidbhistu lakṣitāḥ | tān pravakṣyāmi yatnena nādasiddhimanukramāt
verses.translation: In that auspicious Lagna, O excellent sage, the king Sagara, of mighty arms, was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that auspicious Lagna, O excellent sage, the king Sagara, of mighty arms, was born.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नव शब्दान् परित्यज्य तुङ्कारं तु समभ्यसेत् । ध्यायन्नेवं सदा योगी पुण्यैः पापैर्न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: nava śabdān parityajya tuṅkāraṃ tu samabhyaset | dhyāyannevaṃ sadā yogī puṇyaiḥ pāpairna lipyate
verses.translation: The blessed Sagara, earnestly learnt the lore of the fiery missile, in accordance with the rules of procedure, the missile that is unbearable even to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: The blessed Sagara, earnestly learnt the lore of the fiery missile, in accordance with the rules of procedure, the missile that is unbearable even to the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति यदा शृण्वन्योगाभ्यासेन देविके । म्रियतेऽभ्यसमानस्तु योगी तिष्ठेद्दिवानिशम्
verses.transliteration: na śṛṇoti yadā śṛṇvanyogābhyāsena devike | mriyate'bhyasamānastu yogī tiṣṭheddivāniśam
verses.translation: The infuriated Sagaras, equipped with this mira¬ culous and other weapons and with his own natural strength, killed the Haihayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated Sagaras, equipped with this mira¬ culous and other weapons and with his own natural strength, killed the Haihayas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादुत्पद्यते शब्दो मृत्युजित्सप्तभिर्दिनैः । स वै नवविधो देवि तं ब्रवीमि यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: tasmādutpadyate śabdo mṛtyujitsaptabhirdinaiḥ | sa vai navavidho devi taṃ bravīmi yathārthataḥ
verses.translation: This Sagara became foremost among the famous, earned fame in all the worlds and established piety on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Sagara became foremost among the famous, earned fame in all the worlds and established piety on the earth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं नदते घोषमात्मशुद्धिकरं परम् । सर्वव्याधिहरं नादं वश्याकर्षणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ nadate ghoṣamātmaśuddhikaraṃ param | sarvavyādhiharaṃ nādaṃ vaśyākarṣaṇamuttamam
verses.translation: Then the Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas and Pahlavas, being destroyed sought refuge in Vasistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas and Pahlavas, being destroyed sought refuge in Vasistha.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं नदते कांस्यं स्तम्भयेत् प्राणिनां गतिम् । विषं भूतग्रहान् सर्वान् बध्नीयान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ nadate kāṃsyaṃ stambhayet prāṇināṃ gatim | viṣaṃ bhūtagrahān sarvān badhnīyānnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After deceitfully compelling them to enter into an agreement, Vasi?tha of great brilliance offered them freedom from fear and brought them to king Sagara.
verses.commentary: Sense: After deceitfully compelling them to enter into an agreement, Vasi?tha of great brilliance offered them freedom from fear and brought them to king Sagara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं नदते शृङ्गमभिचारि नियोजयेत् । विद्विडुच्चाटने शत्रोर्मारणे च प्रयोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ nadate śṛṅgamabhicāri niyojayet | vidviḍuccāṭane śatrormāraṇe ca prayojayet
verses.translation: At the instance of his priest Sagara maintained
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of his priest Sagara maintained
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घण्टानादं चतुर्थं तु वदते परमेश्वरः । आकर्षः सर्वदेवानां किं पुनर्मानुषा भुवि
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭānādaṃ caturthaṃ tu vadate parameśvaraḥ | ākarṣaḥ sarvadevānāṃ kiṃ punarmānuṣā bhuvi
verses.translation: He released the 6akas after shaving off half of their heads. Complete tonsure was assigned to Yavanas and Kambojas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He released the 6akas after shaving off half of their heads. Complete tonsure was assigned to Yavanas and Kambojas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षगन्धर्वकन्याश्च तस्याकृष्टा ददन्ति हि । यथेप्सितां महासिद्धिं योगिने कामतोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: yakṣagandharvakanyāśca tasyākṛṣṭā dadanti hi | yathepsitāṃ mahāsiddhiṃ yogine kāmato'pi vā
verses.translation: Paradas were given close hair-cut and Pahlavas were asked to grow beard and moustache. All of them were deprived of the right of the Vedic study and the use of Vaitkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paradas were given close hair-cut and Pahlavas were asked to grow beard and moustache. All of them were deprived of the right of the Vedic study and the use of Vaitkara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वीणा तु पञ्चमो नादः श्रूयते योगिभिः सदा । तस्मादुत्पद्यते देवि दूरादर्शनमेव हि
verses.transliteration: vīṇā tu pañcamo nādaḥ śrūyate yogibhiḥ sadā | tasmādutpadyate devi dūrādarśanameva hi
verses.translation: All those Ksatriyas who had been deprived of virtue were re-instated in piety. The entire earth was con¬ quered by him virtuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those Ksatriyas who had been deprived of virtue were re-instated in piety. The entire earth was con¬ quered by him virtuously.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खशब्देन देवेशि कामरूपं प्रपद्यते । योगिनो मेघनादेन न विपत्सङ्गमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhaśabdena deveśi kāmarūpaṃ prapadyate | yogino meghanādena na vipatsaṅgamo bhavet
verses.translation: He performed a hundred horse-sacrifices and became famous. He acquired wealth bestowed by Siva. He propitiated the deities by performing the sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed a hundred horse-sacrifices and became famous. He acquired wealth bestowed by Siva. He propitiated the deities by performing the sacred rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैकमनसा नित्यं तुङ्कारं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् । किमसाध्यं न तस्यास्ति यथामति वरानने
verses.transliteration: yaścaikamanasā nityaṃ tuṅkāraṃ brahmarūpiṇam | kimasādhyaṃ na tasyāsti yathāmati varānane
verses.translation: Sagara had two wives. They had wiped off their sins by penance. When Aurva the sage was propitiated by them he granted them a boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sagara had two wives. They had wiped off their sins by penance. When Aurva the sage was propitiated by them he granted them a boon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च कामरूपी व्रजत्यसौ । न विकारैः प्रयुज्येत शिव एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca kāmarūpī vrajatyasau | na vikāraiḥ prayujyeta śiva eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: One of them chose the boon of sixty thousand sons. The other chose one son who would maintain the line of succession in the race.
verses.commentary: Sense: One of them chose the boon of sixty thousand sons. The other chose one son who would maintain the line of succession in the race.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते परमेशानि शब्दब्रह्मस्वरूपकम् । नवधा सर्वमाख्यातं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: etatte parameśāni śabdabrahmasvarūpakam | navadhā sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
verses.translation: Having received the boon of heroic sons she gave birth to a big gourd of seeds which were separated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having received the boon of heroic sons she gave birth to a big gourd of seeds which were separated.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.२७ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.27 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: His story has been described in the Puranas. It is famous in the Ramayaina. It has not been mentioned here in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: His story has been described in the Puranas. It is famous in the Ramayaina. It has not been mentioned here in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: His story has been described in the Puranas. It is famous in the Ramayaina. It has not been mentioned here in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: His story has been described in the Puranas. It is famous in the Ramayaina. It has not been mentioned here in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । कालवञ्चनशिवप्राप्तिवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । वायोस्तु पदमाप्नोति योगाकाशसमुद्भवम् । तन्मे सर्वं समाचक्ष्व प्रसन्नस्त्वं यदि प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.27. saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kālavañcanaśivaprāptivarṇanam | devyuvāca | vāyostu padamāpnoti yogākāśasamudbhavam | tanme sarvaṃ samācakṣva prasannastvaṃ yadi prabho
verses.translation: At the end of Kali he will revive the extinct solar race along with the contemporary sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of Kali he will revive the extinct solar race along with the contemporary sages.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । पुरा मे सर्वमाख्यातं योगिनां हितकाम्यया । कालं जिगाय यः सम्यग्वायोर्लिङ्गं यथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | purā me sarvamākhyātaṃ yogināṃ hitakāmyayā | kālaṃ jigāya yaḥ samyagvāyorliṅgaṃ yathā bhavet
verses.translation: Reading and listening to this creation of Vivasvat,
verses.commentary: Sense: Reading and listening to this creation of Vivasvat,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन ज्ञात्वा दिनं योगी प्राणायामपरः स्थितः । स जयत्यागतं कालं मासार्धेनैव सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: tena jñātvā dinaṃ yogī prāṇāyāmaparaḥ sthitaḥ | sa jayatyāgataṃ kālaṃ māsārdhenaiva sundari
verses.translation: Men desirous of benefits perform 6raddhas, keeping in view, the father, the grandfather and the great¬ grandfather in three balls of rice. O Yudhi§thira, the manes bless the man desirous of piety with piety, desirous of progeny with progeny and desirous of nourishment with nourishment.
verses.wordMeaning: Men desirous of benefits perform 6raddhas, keeping in view, the father, the grandfather and the great¬ grandfather in three balls of rice. O Yudhi§thira, the manes bless the man desirous of piety with piety,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Men desirous of benefits perform 6raddhas, keeping in view, the father, the grandfather and the great¬ grandfather in three balls of rice. O Yudhi§thira, the manes bless the man desirous of piety with piety,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हृत्स्थो वायुः सदा वह्नेर्दीपकः सोऽनुपावकः । स बाह्याभ्यन्तरो व्यापी वायुः सर्वगतो महान्
verses.transliteration: hṛtstho vāyuḥ sadā vahnerdīpakaḥ so'nupāvakaḥ | sa bāhyābhyantaro vyāpī vāyuḥ sarvagato mahān
verses.translation: When he had said this, I saluted him with palms joined in reverence and said — "O bes tower of honour, if you are pleased, I am content. I ask you a question. Please answer it.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he had said this, I saluted him with palms joined in reverence and said — "O bes tower of honour, if you are pleased, I am content. I ask you a question. Please answer it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानविज्ञानमुत्साहः सर्वं वायोः प्रवर्तते । येनेह निर्जितो वायुस्तेन सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: jñānavijñānamutsāhaḥ sarvaṃ vāyoḥ pravartate | yeneha nirjito vāyustena sarvamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: He said to me — "Tell me. If you wish I shall grant it to you". When I asked him again the king told me.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said to me — "Tell me. If you wish I shall grant it to you". When I asked him again the king told me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गतागता निवर्तन्ते चन्द्रसूर्यादयो ग्रहाः । अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते योगध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: gatāgatā nivartante candrasūryādayo grahāḥ | adyāpi na nivartante yogadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: O dear, listen. I shall explain your question factually. The entire "Pitrkalpa" has been heard by me from Markandeya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, listen. I shall explain your question factually. The entire "Pitrkalpa" has been heard by me from Markandeya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भुवोर्मध्ये ललाटस्थं बालार्कसमतेजसम् । तं विदित्वा तु कामाङ्गी क्रीडते कामरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: bhuvormadhye lalāṭasthaṃ bālārkasamatejasam | taṃ viditvā tu kāmāṅgī krīḍate kāmarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: O dear, what you ask me now I had asked the sage Markandeya. He, the knower of sacred rites, replied to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, what you ask me now I had asked the sage Markandeya. He, the knower of sacred rites, replied to me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धारणायां सदा तिष्ठेज्जरामृत्युजिघांसया । योगी योगरतः सम्यग्धारणाध्यानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇāyāṃ sadā tiṣṭhejjarāmṛtyujighāṃsayā | yogī yogarataḥ samyagdhāraṇādhyānatatparaḥ
verses.translation: O king listen. Once as I looked up into the sky, I saw a great aerial chariot coming over the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king listen. Once as I looked up into the sky, I saw a great aerial chariot coming over the mountain.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोहकारो यथा भस्त्रामापूर्यमुखतो मुने । साधयेद्वायुना कर्म तद्वद्योगी समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: lohakāro yathā bhastrāmāpūryamukhato mune | sādhayedvāyunā karma tadvadyogī samabhyaset
verses.translation: I saw in the aerial chariot a great blazing mass of splendour as brilliant as glowing coal and very pleasing to the mind having nothing to excel, it. I saw a man of th size of a thumb lying therein. He was very brilliant as if fire had been placed over fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: I saw in the aerial chariot a great blazing mass of splendour as brilliant as glowing coal and very pleasing to the mind having nothing to excel, it. I saw a man of th size of a thumb lying therein. He was very brilliant as if fire had been placed over fire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवः सहस्रको नेत्रपादहस्तसहस्रकः । पृथवीं हि सर्वमावृत्य सोऽग्रे तिष्ठेद्दशाङ्गुलम्
verses.transliteration: devaḥ sahasrako netrapādahastasahasrakaḥ | pṛthavīṃ hi sarvamāvṛtya so'gre tiṣṭheddaśāṅgulam
verses.translation: I bowed to him. With my head bent down, I asked the holy lord. "O holy lord, how may we know you?"
verses.commentary: Sense: I bowed to him. With my head bent down, I asked the holy lord. "O holy lord, how may we know you?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं शिरसा सार्द्धं जपेद् व्याहृतिपूर्विकाम् । त्रिवारमायतप्राणाः प्राणायामः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ śirasā sārddhaṃ japed vyāhṛtipūrvikām | trivāramāyataprāṇāḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: The pious soul told me "you have not that penance
verses.commentary: Sense: The pious soul told me "you have not that penance
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतमब्दं तपस्तप्त्वा कुशाग्रापः पिबेद् द्विजः । तदाप्नोति फलं देवि प्राणानां धारणैकया
verses.transliteration: śatamabdaṃ tapastaptvā kuśāgrāpaḥ pibed dvijaḥ | tadāpnoti phalaṃ devi prāṇānāṃ dhāraṇaikayā
verses.translation: These are the kings of Iksvaku family who had gone before. Now listen to the future kings of this family, the most excellent of those who know sacred virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the kings of Iksvaku family who had gone before. Now listen to the future kings of this family, the most excellent of those who know sacred virtue.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो द्विजः कल्यमुत्थाय प्राणायामैकमाचरेत् । सर्वं पापं निहन्त्याशु ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo dvijaḥ kalyamutthāya prāṇāyāmaikamācaret | sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nihantyāśu brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Bfhadbala's son will be Brhadrana. Urukriya will be his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bfhadbala's son will be Brhadrana. Urukriya will be his son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: योऽतन्द्रितः सदैकान्ते प्रणायामपरो भवेत् । जरां मृत्युं विनिर्जित्य वायुगः खेचरीति सः
verses.transliteration: yo'tandritaḥ sadaikānte praṇāyāmaparo bhavet | jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ vinirjitya vāyugaḥ khecarīti saḥ
verses.translation: His son will be Vatsavrddha. His son will be Prativyoman. Bhanu will be his son whose son will be Divarka, lord of a vast army.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son will be Vatsavrddha. His son will be Prativyoman. Bhanu will be his son whose son will be Divarka, lord of a vast army.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धस्य भजते रूपं कान्तिं मेधां पराक्रमम् । शौर्यं वायुसमो गत्या सौख्यं श्लाघ्यं परं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: siddhasya bhajate rūpaṃ kāntiṃ medhāṃ parākramam | śauryaṃ vāyusamo gatyā saukhyaṃ ślāghyaṃ paraṃ sukham
verses.translation: His son will be a great hero, Sahadeva. His son will be Brhadava. The powerful Bhanumat will be his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son will be a great hero, Sahadeva. His son will be Brhadava. The powerful Bhanumat will be his son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कथितमशेषं वायोः सिद्धिं यदाप्नुते योगी । यत्तेजसोऽपि लभते तत्ते वक्ष्यामि देवेशि
verses.transliteration: etatkathitamaśeṣaṃ vāyoḥ siddhiṃ yadāpnute yogī | yattejaso'pi labhate tatte vakṣyāmi deveśi
verses.translation: The powerful Pratikasva will be the son of Bhanumat. King Supratika will be his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful Pratikasva will be the son of Bhanumat. King Supratika will be his son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा सुखासने स्वे शेते जनवचनहीने तु । शशिरवियुतया तेजः प्रकाशयन्मध्यमे देशे
verses.transliteration: sthitvā sukhāsane sve śete janavacanahīne tu | śaśiraviyutayā tejaḥ prakāśayanmadhyame deśe
verses.translation: Marudeva born of an auspicious star will be his son; his son will be Puskara; his son Antariksa; his son Sutapas; his son the heroic Mitrajit; his son Brhadbhaja and his son Barhinaman; his son Krtafljaya; his son Ranaft- jaya; his son Saftjaya; Sakya his son, Suddhoda his son, Langala his son; his son Prasenajit; his son will be Sudraka; Runaka his son; Suratha his son and Sumitra his son. There¬ after the family becomes extinct.
verses.wordMeaning: Marudeva born of an auspicious star will be his son; his son will be Puskara; his son Antariksa; his son Sutapas; his son the heroic Mitrajit; his son Brhadbhaja and his son Barhinaman; his son Krtafljaya; his son Ranaft- jaya; his son Saftjaya; Sakya his son, Suddhoda his son,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Marudeva born of an auspicious star will be his son; his son will be Puskara; his son Antariksa; his son Sutapas; his son the heroic Mitrajit; his son Brhadbhaja and his son Barhinaman; his son Krtafljaya; his son Ranaft- jaya; his son Saftjaya; Sakya his son, Suddhoda his son,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वह्निगतं भ्रूमध्ये प्रकाशते यस्त्वतन्द्रितो योगी । दीपैर्हीनध्वान्ते पश्येन्न्यूनमसंशयं लोके
verses.transliteration: vahnigataṃ bhrūmadhye prakāśate yastvatandrito yogī | dīpairhīnadhvānte paśyennyūnamasaṃśayaṃ loke
verses.translation: The family of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra, the family with kings of variegated exploits, sacred rites and virtuous practice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The family of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra, the family with kings of variegated exploits, sacred rites and virtuous practice.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नेत्रे करशाखाभिः किञ्चित्सम्पीड्य यत्नतो योगी । तारं पश्यन्ध्यायेन्मुहूर्तमर्द्धं तमे९कभावोऽपि
verses.transliteration: netre karaśākhābhiḥ kiñcitsampīḍya yatnato yogī | tāraṃ paśyandhyāyenmuhūrtamarddhaṃ tame9kabhāvo'pi
verses.translation: Reaching upto Sumitra the king in the Kali age that auspicious race will become merged in outside families. It will flourish again in the Krta age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reaching upto Sumitra the king in the Kali age that auspicious race will become merged in outside families. It will flourish again in the Krta age.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु तमसि ध्यायन्पश्यति ज्योतिरैश्वरम् । श्वेतं रक्तं तथा पीतं कृष्णमिन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम्
verses.transliteration: tatastu tamasi dhyāyanpaśyati jyotiraiśvaram | śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇamindradhanuṣprabham
verses.translation: These are the kings in the solar race who made profuse monetary gifts. Those mainly mentioned belong to Ikvaku's family.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the kings in the solar race who made profuse monetary gifts. Those mainly mentioned belong to Ikvaku's family.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कारणप्रशमावेशं परकायप्रवेशनम् । अणिमादिगुणावाप्तिर्मनसा चावलोकनम्
verses.transliteration: kāraṇapraśamāveśaṃ parakāyapraveśanam | aṇimādiguṇāvāptirmanasā cāvalokanam
verses.translation: On hearing about the excellent solar race of Sraddhadeva, the sage Saunaka respectfully asked Suta.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the excellent solar race of Sraddhadeva, the sage Saunaka respectfully asked Suta.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दूरश्रवणविज्ञानमदृश्यं बहुरूपधृक् । सतताभ्यासयोगेन खेचरत्वं प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: dūraśravaṇavijñānamadṛśyaṃ bahurūpadhṛk | satatābhyāsayogena khecaratvaṃ prajāyate
verses.translation: O Suta, disciple of Vyasa, of long life, obeisance be to you. A divine and pious story has been narrated to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, disciple of Vyasa, of long life, obeisance be to you. A divine and pious story has been narrated to us.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्ना नानाशास्त्रविशारदाः । ज्ञानिनोऽपि विमुह्यन्ते पूर्वकर्मवशानुगाः
verses.transliteration: śrutādhyayanasampannā nānāśāstraviśāradāḥ | jñānino'pi vimuhyante pūrvakarmavaśānugāḥ
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by you that Sraddhadeva is the progenitor of the solar race. I have a doubt therein which I shall mention before you.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been mentioned by you that Sraddhadeva is the progenitor of the solar race. I have a doubt therein which I shall mention before you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्तोऽपि न पश्यन्ति शृण्वाना बधिरा यथा । यथान्धा मानुषा लोके मूढाः पापविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: paśyanto'pi na paśyanti śṛṇvānā badhirā yathā | yathāndhā mānuṣā loke mūḍhāḥ pāpavimohitāḥ
verses.translation: How did the sun become Sraddhadeva? 1 wish to hear this. Please clear this doubt with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the sun become Sraddhadeva? 1 wish to hear this. Please clear this doubt with pleasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्त- मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् । तमेव विदित्वातिमृत्युमेति नान्यः पन्था विद्यते प्रायणाय
verses.transliteration: vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahānta- mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt | tameva viditvātimṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate prāyaṇāya
verses.translation: O holy lord, please mention the glory and the bene¬ fit of iSraddha rite whereby the manes are pleased and bless the performer with prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, please mention the glory and the bene¬ fit of iSraddha rite whereby the manes are pleased and bless the performer with prosperity.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एष ते कथितः सम्यक्तेजसो विधिरुत्तमः । कालं जित्वा यथा योगी चामरत्वं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: eṣa te kathitaḥ samyaktejaso vidhiruttamaḥ | kālaṃ jitvā yathā yogī cāmaratvaṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: I wish to hear this too, namely the creation par ex¬ cellence of the manes. O intelligent one, please mention this particularly. Have mercy on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to hear this too, namely the creation par ex¬ cellence of the manes. O intelligent one, please mention this particularly. Have mercy on me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनः परतरं वक्ष्ये यथा मृत्युर्न जायते । सावधानतया देवि शृणुष्वैकाग्रमानसा
verses.transliteration: punaḥ parataraṃ vakṣye yathā mṛtyurna jāyate | sāvadhānatayā devi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasā
verses.translation: O Saunaka, I shall mention everything concerning the creation of the manes. This was narrated to the intelligent Markandeya by Sanatkumara. I shall mention it to you. It bestows the benefit of all cherished desires. Bhisma the fore¬ most of the virtuous lying on the beS of arrows was requested by Yudhisthira to whom he spoke thus.
verses.wordMeaning: O Saunaka, I shall mention everything concerning the creation of the manes. This was narrated to the intelligent Markandeya by Sanatkumara. I shall mention it to you. It bestows the benefit of all cherished desires.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Saunaka, I shall mention everything concerning the creation of the manes. This was narrated to the intelligent Markandeya by Sanatkumara. I shall mention it to you. It bestows the benefit of all cherished desires.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तुरीया देवि भूतानां योगिनां ध्यानिनां तथा । सुखासने यथास्थानं योगी नियतमानसः
verses.transliteration: turīyā devi bhūtānāṃ yogināṃ dhyānināṃ tathā | sukhāsane yathāsthānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the question of Yudhisthira, Bhima the knower of Dharma spoke with pleasure even as every one was listening.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the question of Yudhisthira, Bhima the knower of Dharma spoke with pleasure even as every one was listening.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समुन्नतशरीरोऽपि स बद्ध्वा करसम्पुटम् । चञ्च्वाकारेण वक्त्रेण पिबन्वायुं शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: samunnataśarīro'pi sa baddhvā karasampuṭam | cañcvākāreṇa vaktreṇa pibanvāyuṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: O Yudhisthira, those who perform Sraddha rites with pleasure delight everyone through them as a result of the favour of the manes.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yudhisthira, those who perform Sraddha rites with pleasure delight everyone through them as a result of the favour of the manes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्रवन्ति क्षणादापस्तालुस्था जीवदायिकाः । ता जिघ्रेद्वायुनादायामृतं तच्छीतलं जलम्
verses.transliteration: prasravanti kṣaṇādāpastālusthā jīvadāyikāḥ | tā jighredvāyunādāyāmṛtaṃ tacchītalaṃ jalam
verses.translation: How do the 6raddhas go to the manes? How those in the hell can derive the benefit?
verses.commentary: Sense: How do the 6raddhas go to the manes? How those in the hell can derive the benefit?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ननुदिनं योगी न मृत्युवशगो भवेत् । दिव्यकायो महातेजाः पिपासाक्षुद्विवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: pibannanudinaṃ yogī na mṛtyuvaśago bhavet | divyakāyo mahātejāḥ pipāsākṣudvivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: I have heard that even the gods worship the manes. I wish to hear this. Please mention this in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have heard that even the gods worship the manes. I wish to hear this. Please mention this in detail.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बलेन नागस्तुरगो जवेन दृष्ट्या सुपर्णः सुश्रुतिस्तु दूरात् । आकुञ्चिताकुण्डलिकृष्णकेशो गन्धर्वविद्याधरतुल्यवर्णः
verses.transliteration: balena nāgasturago javena dṛṣṭyā suparṇaḥ suśrutistu dūrāt | ākuñcitākuṇḍalikṛṣṇakeśo gandharvavidyādharatulyavarṇaḥ
verses.translation: O suppressor of enemies, in this context, I shall narrate an event as I have heard from my father who had left this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O suppressor of enemies, in this context, I shall narrate an event as I have heard from my father who had left this world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवेन्नरो वर्षशतं सुराणां सुमेधसा वाक्पतिना समत्वम् । एवं चरन् खेचरतां प्रयाति यथेष्टचारी सुखितः सदैव
verses.transliteration: jīvennaro varṣaśataṃ surāṇāṃ sumedhasā vākpatinā samatvam | evaṃ caran khecaratāṃ prayāti yatheṣṭacārī sukhitaḥ sadaiva
verses.translation: At the time of 6raddha, the ball of rice for my father was kept ready by me. My father split the ground and requested me to offer the same into his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of 6raddha, the ball of rice for my father was kept ready by me. My father split the ground and requested me to offer the same into his hand.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि विधानं यत्सुरैरपि । गोपितं तु प्रयत्नेन तच्छृणुष्व वरानने
verses.transliteration: punaranyatpravakṣyāmi vidhānaṃ yatsurairapi | gopitaṃ tu prayatnena tacchṛṇuṣva varānane
verses.translation: "O sinless one, O most excellent of the descendants of Bharata, gladdened by me my father spoke in sweet words.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sinless one, O most excellent of the descendants of Bharata, gladdened by me my father spoke in sweet words.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समाकुञ्च्याभ्यसेद्योगी रसनां तालुकं प्रति । किञ्चित्कालान्तरेणैव क्रमात्प्राप्नोति लम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: samākuñcyābhyasedyogī rasanāṃ tālukaṃ prati | kiñcitkālāntareṇaiva kramātprāpnoti lambikām
verses.translation: O most excellent of men, I only tested you. I have been redeemed by you the knower of sacred rites and a good scholar. I have been blessed with a real heir in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O most excellent of men, I only tested you. I have been redeemed by you the knower of sacred rites and a good scholar. I have been blessed with a real heir in you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रस्रवते सा तु संस्पृष्टा शीतलां सुधाम् । पिबन्नेव सदा योगी सोऽमरत्वं हि गच्छति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasravate sā tu saṃspṛṣṭā śītalāṃ sudhām | pibanneva sadā yogī so'maratvaṃ hi gacchati
verses.translation: What the king does by virtuous or authoritative rites, the subjects too emulate, taking them to be backed by precedent.
verses.commentary: Sense: What the king does by virtuous or authoritative rites, the subjects too emulate, taking them to be backed by precedent.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रेफाग्रं लम्बकाग्रं करतलघटनं शुभ्रपद्मस्य बिन्दो- स्तेनाकृष्टा सुधेयं पतति परपदे देवतानन्दकारी । सारं संसारतारं कृतकलुषतरं कालतारं सतारं येनेदं प्लाविताङ्गं स भवति न मृतः क्षुत्पिपासाविहीनः
verses.transliteration: rephāgraṃ lambakāgraṃ karatalaghaṭanaṃ śubhrapadmasya bindo- stenākṛṣṭā sudheyaṃ patati parapade devatānandakārī | sāraṃ saṃsāratāraṃ kṛtakaluṣataraṃ kālatāraṃ satāraṃ yenedaṃ plāvitāṅgaṃ sa bhavati na mṛtaḥ kṣutpipāsāvihīnaḥ
verses.translation: O most excellent of the descendants of Bharata, listen to the eternal virtues of the Vedas. Proof of the Vedic rite has been shown by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O most excellent of the descendants of Bharata, listen to the eternal virtues of the Vedas. Proof of the Vedic rite has been shown by you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एभिर्युक्ता चतुर्भिः क्षितिधरतनये योगिभिर्वै धरैषा धैर्यान्नित्यं कुतोऽन्तः सकलमपि जगद्यत्सुखप्रापणाय । स्वप्ने देही विधत्ते सकलमपि सदा मानयन्यच्च दुःखं स्वर्गे ह्येवं धरित्र्याः प्रभवति च ततो वा स किञ्चिच्चतुर्णाम्
verses.transliteration: ebhiryuktā caturbhiḥ kṣitidharatanaye yogibhirvai dharaiṣā dhairyānnityaṃ kuto'ntaḥ sakalamapi jagadyatsukhaprāpaṇāya | svapne dehī vidhatte sakalamapi sadā mānayanyacca duḥkhaṃ svarge hyevaṃ dharitryāḥ prabhavati ca tato vā sa kiñciccaturṇām
verses.translation: Being delighted I shall grant you excellent boons lovingly. Accept them. They are difficult to obtain in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being delighted I shall grant you excellent boons lovingly. Accept them. They are difficult to obtain in the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मन्त्रैस्तपोभिर्व्रतनियमयुतैरौषधैर्योगयुक्ता धात्री रक्ता मनुष्यैर्नयविनययुतैर्धर्मविद्भिः क्रमेण । भूतानामादि देवो न हि भवति चलः संयुतो वै चतुर्णां तस्मादेवं प्रवक्ष्ये विधिमनुगदितं छायिकं यच्छिवाख्यम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānmantraistapobhirvrataniyamayutairauṣadhairyogayuktā dhātrī raktā manuṣyairnayavinayayutairdharmavidbhiḥ krameṇa | bhūtānāmādi devo na hi bhavati calaḥ saṃyuto vai caturṇāṃ tasmādevaṃ pravakṣye vidhimanugaditaṃ chāyikaṃ yacchivākhyam
verses.translation: Death will have no hold on you as long as you wish to live. With your permission it may be effective again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Death will have no hold on you as long as you wish to live. With your permission it may be effective again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.२८ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.28 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: My seven brothers are invincible and their families are established. But we pursue the rites of ascetics restraining the Atman in the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: My seven brothers are invincible and their families are established. But we pursue the rites of ascetics restraining the Atman in the Atman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: My seven brothers are invincible and their families are established. But we pursue the rites of ascetics restraining the Atman in the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: My seven brothers are invincible and their families are established. But we pursue the rites of ascetics restraining the Atman in the Atman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । छायापुरुषदर्शनवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । देवदेव महादेव कथितं कालवञ्चनम् । शब्दब्रह्मस्वरूपं च योगलक्षणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.28. aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | chāyāpuruṣadarśanavarṇanam | devyuvāca | devadeva mahādeva kathitaṃ kālavañcanam | śabdabrahmasvarūpaṃ ca yogalakṣaṇamuttamam
verses.translation: Since you have piously performed penance with a desire for my vision I have appeared before you. Welfare be to you. What wish of yours shall I carry out?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Since you have piously performed penance with a desire for my vision I have appeared before you. Welfare be to you. What wish of yours shall I carry out?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कथितं ते समासेन छायिकं ज्ञानमुत्तमम् । विस्तरेण समाख्याहि योगिनां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: kathitaṃ te samāsena chāyikaṃ jñānamuttamam | vistareṇa samākhyāhi yogināṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: In the Sraddha of the Pitrs, undoubtedly the per¬ former will propitiate Soma who being delighted and enhan¬ ced by the offering shall gladden the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Sraddha of the Pitrs, undoubtedly the per¬ former will propitiate Soma who being delighted and enhan¬ ced by the offering shall gladden the worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि छायापुरुषलक्षणम् । यज्ज्ञात्वा पुरुषः सम्यक्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca | śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi chāyāpuruṣalakṣaṇam | yajjñātvā puruṣaḥ samyaksarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Their names which indicate their activities are Vagdusta (defiled in speech), Krodhana (angry), Hirhsra (violent), Pisuna (backbiter), Kavi(poet), Svasrsa (self-creating) and Pitivartin (worshipping the pitrs)
verses.commentary: Sense: Their names which indicate their activities are Vagdusta (defiled in speech), Krodhana (angry), Hirhsra (violent), Pisuna (backbiter), Kavi(poet), Svasrsa (self-creating) and Pitivartin (worshipping the pitrs)
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यं हि पृष्ठतः कृत्वा सोमं वा वरवर्णिनि । शुक्लाम्बरधरः स्त्रग्वी गन्धधूपादिवासितः
verses.transliteration: sūryaṃ hi pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā somaṃ vā varavarṇini | śuklāmbaradharaḥ stragvī gandhadhūpādivāsitaḥ
verses.translation: At the instance of their preceptor they looked
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of their preceptor they looked
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संस्मरेन्मे महामन्त्रं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । नवात्मकं पिण्डभूतं स्वां छायां सन्निरीक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃsmarenme mahāmantraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | navātmakaṃ piṇḍabhūtaṃ svāṃ chāyāṃ sannirīkṣayet
verses.translation: O descendant of Bharata, once in their course of
verses.commentary: Sense: O descendant of Bharata, once in their course of
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विवाहो बन्धुनाशः स्याद्द्वितुण्डे चैव क्षुद्भयम् । विकटौ नश्यते भार्या विजङ्घे धनमेव हि
verses.transliteration: vivāho bandhunāśaḥ syāddvituṇḍe caiva kṣudbhayam | vikaṭau naśyate bhāryā vijaṅghe dhanameva hi
verses.translation: The brahmin Pitrvartin who performed Sraddha everyday with devotion to the Pitrs spoke to them angrily.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmin Pitrvartin who performed Sraddha everyday with devotion to the Pitrs spoke to them angrily.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोत्यत्र न सन्देहः सत्यं वै कथितं मया । सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्स्नात्वा दत्त्वा दानानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: prāpnotyatra na sandehaḥ satyaṃ vai kathitaṃ mayā | sarvatīrtheṣu yatsnātvā dattvā dānāni sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: If performed thus, the cow will attain piety undoub¬ tedly. By worshipping Pitrs we shall not be affected by sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: If performed thus, the cow will attain piety undoub¬ tedly. By worshipping Pitrs we shall not be affected by sin.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तमामन्त्र्य पूजितस्तेन शौनकः । ययौ स्वधाम सुप्रीतो व्यासोऽपि प्रीतमानसः
verses.transliteration: brahmaputrastamāmantrya pūjitastena śaunakaḥ | yayau svadhāma suprīto vyāso'pi prītamānasaḥ
verses.translation: O descendant of Bharata, on being advised thus, they all sprinkled the cow with sacred water, dedicated it to the Pitrs and used it as their food.
verses.commentary: Sense: O descendant of Bharata, on being advised thus, they all sprinkled the cow with sacred water, dedicated it to the Pitrs and used it as their food.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तां पुनराकाशे श्वेतवर्णस्वरूपिणीम् । स पश्यत्येकभावस्तु शिवं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tāṃ punarākāśe śvetavarṇasvarūpiṇīm | sa paśyatyekabhāvastu śivaṃ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: After eating the cow they said to the preceptor saying — "The cow is killed by a tiger. Let the calf be accepted.**
verses.commentary: Sense: After eating the cow they said to the preceptor saying — "The cow is killed by a tiger. Let the calf be accepted.**
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मप्राप्तिर्भवेत्तस्य कालविद्भिरितीरितम् । ब्रह्महत्यादिकैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: brahmaprāptirbhavettasya kālavidbhiritīritam | brahmahatyādikaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The sage akcepted the calf with great distress. The killers of the cow became sinful by their false reverence and service.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage akcepted the calf with great distress. The killers of the cow became sinful by their false reverence and service.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरोहीनं यदा पश्येत्षड्भिर्मासैर्भवेत्क्षयः । समस्तं वाङ्मयं तस्य योगिनस्तु यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: śirohīnaṃ yadā paśyetṣaḍbhirmāsairbhavetkṣayaḥ | samastaṃ vāṅmayaṃ tasya yoginastu yathā tathā
verses.translation: O dear, in due course, when their term of life ex¬ pired the seven brothers passed away.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, in due course, when their term of life ex¬ pired the seven brothers passed away.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्ले धर्मं विजानीयात्कृष्णे पापं विनिर्दिशेत् । रक्ते बन्धं विजानीयात्पीते विद्विषमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: śukle dharmaṃ vijānīyātkṛṣṇe pāpaṃ vinirdiśet | rakte bandhaṃ vijānīyātpīte vidviṣamādiśet
verses.translation: They were reborn as the sons of a hunter as a result of their cruelty, violence, being ignoble towards the preceptor and their over-indulgence in fierce violence. They were reborn in the country of Daarnas.** They were strong, intelligent and experts in piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were reborn as the sons of a hunter as a result of their cruelty, violence, being ignoble towards the preceptor and their over-indulgence in fierce violence. They were reborn in the country of Daarnas.** They were strong, intelligent and experts in piety.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पादाभावे विदेशः स्यादित्येतत्कथितं मया । तद्विचार्यं प्रयत्त्नेन पुरुषेण महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: pādābhāve videśaḥ syādityetatkathitaṃ mayā | tadvicāryaṃ prayattnena puruṣeṇa maheśvari
verses.translation: When he said this I told him — *'0 holy lord, listen. Please narrate factually the original creation of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he said this I told him — *'0 holy lord, listen. Please narrate factually the original creation of the Pitrs.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक्तं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सन्निवेश्यात्मनात्मनि । जपेन्नवात्मकं मन्त्रं हृदयं मे महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: samyaktaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sanniveśyātmanātmani | japennavātmakaṃ mantraṃ hṛdayaṃ me maheśvari
verses.translation: When requested thus he said to me. Listen to everything factually. O dear one, I shall explain to you the auspicious creation of the Pitrs truthfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: When requested thus he said to me. Listen to everything factually. O dear one, I shall explain to you the auspicious creation of the Pitrs truthfully.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरे विगते मन्त्री तन्नास्ति यन्न साधयेत् । अणिमादिगुणानष्टौ खेचरत्वं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: vatsare vigate mantrī tannāsti yanna sādhayet | aṇimādiguṇānaṣṭau khecaratvaṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: Formerly Brahma created the gods and said to them, "Worship me". But they who sought benefits eschewed him and worshipped the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly Brahma created the gods and said to them, "Worship me". But they who sought benefits eschewed him and worshipped the Atman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि शक्तिं ज्ञातुं दुरासदाम् । प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते लोके ज्ञानिनामग्रतः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: punaranyatpravakṣyāmi śaktiṃ jñātuṃ durāsadām | pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate loke jñānināmagrataḥ sthitam
verses.translation: They were cursed by Brahma thus. You will be deluded and become senseless". Hence unable to know any thing and being insensible they bowed to Pitamaha and said "Please bless us." Being requested thus he said to them for the sake of expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were cursed by Brahma thus. You will be deluded and become senseless". Hence unable to know any thing and being insensible they bowed to Pitamaha and said "Please bless us." Being requested thus he said to them for the sake of expiation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञेया लिख्यते लोके या सर्पीकृतकुण्डली । सा मात्रा यानसंस्थापि दृश्यते न च पठ्यते
verses.transliteration: ajñeyā likhyate loke yā sarpīkṛtakuṇḍalī | sā mātrā yānasaṃsthāpi dṛśyate na ca paṭhyate
verses.translation: "Ask your sons. You will then attain perfect knowledge". Urged thus the senseless ones asked their sons boldly.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ask your sons. You will then attain perfect knowledge". Urged thus the senseless ones asked their sons boldly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डमूर्ध्निगा या च स्तुता वेदैस्तु नित्यशः । जननी सर्वविद्यानां गुप्तविद्येति गीयते
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍamūrdhnigā yā ca stutā vedaistu nityaśaḥ | jananī sarvavidyānāṃ guptavidyeti gīyate
verses.translation: They were asked to perform expiatory rites. O sinless one, the gods were thus addressed by the sons. "Let the sons be approached." The gods who had been cursed by Bnahma told him that the sons had gone away. Then Brahma told the gods thus "O gods, lUten, You are not Brahmavadins, the believers in Brahma's cult.
verses.wordMeaning: They were asked to perform expiatory rites. O sinless one, the gods were thus addressed by the sons. "Let the sons be approached." The gods who had been cursed by Bnahma told him that the sons had gone away. Then Brahma told the gods thus "O gods, lUten,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were asked to perform expiatory rites. O sinless one, the gods were thus addressed by the sons. "Let the sons be approached." The gods who had been cursed by Bnahma told him that the sons had gone away. Then Brahma told the gods thus "O gods, lUten,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: खेचरा सा विनिर्दिष्टा सर्वप्राणिषु संस्थिता । दृश्यादृश्याचला नित्या व्यक्ताव्यक्ता सनातनी
verses.transliteration: khecarā sā vinirdiṣṭā sarvaprāṇiṣu saṃsthitā | dṛśyādṛśyācalā nityā vyaktāvyaktā sanātanī
verses.translation: O dwellers of heaven, let the gods and the Pitfs worship one another with great delight. This will confer the cherished desires."
verses.commentary: Sense: O dwellers of heaven, let the gods and the Pitfs worship one another with great delight. This will confer the cherished desires."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अवर्णा वर्णसंयुक्ता प्रोच्यते बिन्दुमालिनी । तां पश्यन्सर्वदा योगी कृतकृत्योऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: avarṇā varṇasaṃyuktā procyate bindumālinī | tāṃ paśyansarvadā yogī kṛtakṛtyo'bhijāyate
verses.translation: Sanatkumara said: — O great sage, then their doubts were cleared. With delight they became the mutual bestowers of happiness at the instance of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanatkumara said: — O great sage, then their doubts were cleared. With delight they became the mutual bestowers of happiness at the instance of Brahma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थकृतस्नानाद्भवेद्दानस्य यत्फलम् । सर्वयज्ञफलं यच्च मालिन्या दर्शनात्तदा
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthakṛtasnānādbhaveddānasya yatphalam | sarvayajñaphalaṃ yacca mālinyā darśanāttadā
verses.translation: Then the gods said ''Since you addressed us as sons you will undoubtedly become Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gods said ''Since you addressed us as sons you will undoubtedly become Pitrs.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां देवि यज्ञानां यत्फलं तल्लभेत्पुमान् । किं बहूक्त्या महेशानि सर्वान्कामान्समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ devi yajñānāṃ yatphalaṃ tallabhetpumān | kiṃ bahūktyā maheśāni sarvānkāmānsamaśnute
verses.translation: They will delight the ocean, the mountain and the forest, all consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. Those who desire nourishment and perform Sraddha rites are given nourishment by the Pitrs who are propitiated. Those who give three Pinzas in the Sraddha mentioning the names and Gotras delight the Pitrs wherever they be and are looked after by them.
verses.wordMeaning: They will delight the ocean, the mountain and the forest, all consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. Those who desire nourishment and perform Sraddha rites are given nourishment by the Pitrs who are propitiated.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They will delight the ocean, the mountain and the forest, all consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. Those who desire nourishment and perform Sraddha rites are given nourishment by the Pitrs who are propitiated.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माज्ज्ञानं यथायोगमभ्यसेत्सततं बुधः । अभ्यासाज्जायते सिद्धिर्योगोऽभ्यासात्प्रवर्धते
verses.transliteration: tasmājjñānaṃ yathāyogamabhyasetsatataṃ budhaḥ | abhyāsājjāyate siddhiryogo'bhyāsātpravardhate
verses.translation: Let these words be truthful. Whether gods or Pitrs we are father and sons successively. Thus the Pitrs who became sons virtuously were famous in the world as mutual beneficiaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let these words be truthful. Whether gods or Pitrs we are father and sons successively. Thus the Pitrs who became sons virtuously were famous in the world as mutual beneficiaries.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संवित्तिर्लभ्यतेऽभ्यासादभ्यासान्मोक्षमश्नुते । अभ्यासः सततं कार्यो धीमता मोक्षकारणम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvittirlabhyate'bhyāsādabhyāsānmokṣamaśnute | abhyāsaḥ satataṃ kāryo dhīmatā mokṣakāraṇam
verses.translation: O foremost among the performers of penance, the Pitfs in the heaven are seven in number. Four of them are embodied and three bodiless.
verses.commentary: Sense: O foremost among the performers of penance, the Pitfs in the heaven are seven in number. Four of them are embodied and three bodiless.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्कथितं देवि भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् । किमन्यत्पृच्छ्यते तत्त्वं वद सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: ityetatkathitaṃ devi bhuktimuktiphalapradam | kimanyatpṛcchyate tattvaṃ vada satyaṃ bravīmi te
verses.translation: The primordial groups of gods, brahmins and others worship them. With the power of their Yoga they streng¬ then and gladden Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial groups of gods, brahmins and others worship them. With the power of their Yoga they streng¬ then and gladden Soma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मपुत्रवचनं परमार्थदम् । प्रसन्नोऽभूदति व्यासः पाराशर्यो मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti śrutvā brahmaputravacanaṃ paramārthadam | prasanno'bhūdati vyāsaḥ pārāśaryo munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Hence people shall offer Sraddhas especially to the Yogins. A silver vessel or a vessel with silver when offered with Svadha, delights the Pitrs. When the sun is in the northern transit he shall make offerings in the fire or in its absence in water. He shall propitiate fire-god. Soma or Yama. Those whq delight the Pitys with devotion are delighted by Pitrs. The Pitfs bestow nourishment, offspring, heaven, health and other desired objects.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence people shall offer Sraddhas especially to the Yogins. A silver vessel or a vessel with silver when offered with Svadha, delights the Pitrs. When the sun is in the northern transit he shall make offerings in the fire or in its absence in water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence people shall offer Sraddhas especially to the Yogins. A silver vessel or a vessel with silver when offered with Svadha, delights the Pitrs. When the sun is in the northern transit he shall make offerings in the fire or in its absence in water.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारं सर्वज्ञं ब्रह्मपुत्रं कृपानिधिम् । व्यासः परमसन्तुष्टः प्रणनाम मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāraṃ sarvajñaṃ brahmaputraṃ kṛpānidhim | vyāsaḥ paramasantuṣṭaḥ praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: O sage, the rites of Pits are better than the rites of the gods. O brahmin sage, since you are a devotee of the Pitrs you shall be free from old age and death.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the rites of Pits are better than the rites of the gods. O brahmin sage, since you are a devotee of the Pitrs you shall be free from old age and death.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुष्टाव तं व्यासः कालेयः स मुनीश्वरः । सनत्कुमारं मुनयः सुरविज्ञानसागरम्
verses.transliteration: tatastuṣṭāva taṃ vyāsaḥ kāleyaḥ sa munīśvaraḥ | sanatkumāraṃ munayaḥ suravijñānasāgaram
verses.translation: O sage, the goal attained by devotion to the Pitrs is not attained by the practices of Yoga. O great sage, so devotion to the Pitrs shall be pursued with care.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the goal attained by devotion to the Pitrs is not attained by the practices of Yoga. O great sage, so devotion to the Pitrs shall be pursued with care.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । कृतार्थोऽहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मत्वं मे त्वया कृतम् । नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु धन्यस्त्वं ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca | kṛtārtho'haṃ muniśreṣṭha brahmatvaṃ me tvayā kṛtam | namaste'stu namaste'stu dhanyastvaṃ brahmavittamaḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus and immediately bestowing the vision of perfect knowledge the lord of the gods disappeared.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus and immediately bestowing the vision of perfect knowledge the lord of the gods disappeared.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति स्तुत्वा स कालेयो ब्रह्मपुत्रं महामुनिम् । तूष्णीं बभूव सुप्रीतः परमानन्दनिर्भरः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | iti stutvā sa kāleyo brahmaputraṃ mahāmunim | tūṣṇīṃ babhūva suprītaḥ paramānandanirbharaḥ
verses.translation: O Bhisma, listen again. Formerly, even after
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bhisma, listen again. Formerly, even after
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति मे वर्णितो विप्राः सुखदः परमार्थयुक् । सनत्कुमारकालेयसंवादो ज्ञानवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: iti me varṇito viprāḥ sukhadaḥ paramārthayuk | sanatkumārakāleyasaṃvādo jñānavardhanaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, the sons of Kaurika became the disciples of Garga. When their father had expired they went in exile.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, the sons of Kaurika became the disciples of Garga. When their father had expired they went in exile.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.२९ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.29 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Recollecting the event of their death the forcst- roamers became forbearers, free from Dvandvas and averse to taking gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recollecting the event of their death the forcst- roamers became forbearers, free from Dvandvas and averse to taking gifts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Recollecting the event of their death the forcst- roamers became forbearers, free from Dvandvas and averse to taking gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recollecting the event of their death the forcst- roamers became forbearers, free from Dvandvas and averse to taking gifts.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । आदिसर्गवर्णनम् । शौनक उवाच । श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानं यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् । सनत्कुमारकालेयसंवादं परमार्थदम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.29. ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | ādisargavarṇanam | śaunaka uvāca | śrutaṃ me mahadākhyānaṃ yattvayā parikīrtitam | sanatkumārakāleyasaṃvādaṃ paramārthadam
verses.translation: The hunters performed auspicious rites, and holy deeds, disassociating themselves from the wicked. They had the power of the memory of the previous birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hunters performed auspicious rites, and holy deeds, disassociating themselves from the wicked. They had the power of the memory of the previous birth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि यथा सर्गस्तु ब्रह्मणः । समुत्पन्नं तु मे ब्रूहि यथा व्यासाच्च ते श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ato'haṃ śrotumicchāmi yathā sargastu brahmaṇaḥ | samutpannaṃ tu me brūhi yathā vyāsācca te śrutam
verses.translation: They had performed the!§raddha for the Pitrs with due rituals. They retained memory of previous noble birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had performed the!§raddha for the Pitrs with due rituals. They retained memory of previous noble birth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । मुने शृणु कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् । कथ्यमानां मया चित्रां बह्वर्थां श्रुतविस्तराम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | mune śṛṇu kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm | kathyamānāṃ mayā citrāṃ bahvarthāṃ śrutavistarām
verses.translation: After renouncing action by the Yogic practices why do you long for such a boon? Hence hear my statement.
verses.commentary: Sense: After renouncing action by the Yogic practices why do you long for such a boon? Hence hear my statement.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैनां पाठयेत्तां च शृणुयाद्वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः । स्ववंशधारणं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yaścaināṃ pāṭhayettāṃ ca śṛṇuyādvāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | svavaṃśadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O dear, you will become a king in the excellent city of Kampilya.*' These too will be your ministers who will not go astray.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, you will become a king in the excellent city of Kampilya.*' These too will be your ministers who will not go astray.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषो यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् । प्रधानपुरुषो भूत्वा निर्ममे लोकभावनः
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣo yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam | pradhānapuruṣo bhūtvā nirmame lokabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: The three did not speak about the kingdom to their four comrades. Being delighted Sumanas said again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three did not speak about the kingdom to their four comrades. Being delighted Sumanas said again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि स्वयम्भूर्भगवान् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः । अप एव ससर्जादौ तासु वीर्यमवासृजत्
verses.transliteration: so'pi svayambhūrbhagavān sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ | apa eva sasarjādau tāsu vīryamavāsṛjat
verses.translation: Due to their favour you will attain merit. You have sprinkled the cow and offered it to the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to their favour you will attain merit. You have sprinkled the cow and offered it to the Pitrs.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजायन्ते क्रियावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः । विद्युतोऽशनिमेघांश्च रोहितेन्द्रधनूंषि च
verses.transliteration: prajāyante kriyāvanto maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ | vidyuto'śanimeghāṃśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca
verses.translation: We shall acquire knowledge which shall work as the means of Yoga for all. This statement is bold and spirited and is quoted as a verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: We shall acquire knowledge which shall work as the means of Yoga for all. This statement is bold and spirited and is quoted as a verse.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां नारायणपरायणम् । तं वै विद्धि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्माणममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam | taṃ vai viddhi muniśreṣṭha brahmāṇamamitaujasam
verses.translation: After attaining human life you will attain "Yoga". After saying this the learned bird Sumanas became silent.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining human life you will attain "Yoga". After saying this the learned bird Sumanas became silent.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादकल्पयत्कल्पाः समग्राः शुचयो यतः । भवन्ति मुनिशार्दूल नमस्तस्मै स्वयम्भुवे
verses.transliteration: yasmādakalpayatkalpāḥ samagrāḥ śucayo yataḥ | bhavanti muniśārdūla namastasmai svayambhuve
verses.translation: Thus I have menioned their story to you. What more do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have menioned their story to you. What more do you wish to hear?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै हिरण्यगर्भाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च । नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि भूयः सर्गमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmai hiraṇyagarbhāya puruṣāyeśvarāya ca | namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ sargamanuttamam
verses.translation: Markandeya of great intellect, O foremost among the devotees of the Pitrs what happened after that? O excel¬ lent sage, please tell me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Markandeya of great intellect, O foremost among the devotees of the Pitrs what happened after that? O excel¬ lent sage, please tell me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा स्रष्टा हरिः पाता संहर्ता च महेश्वरः । तस्य सर्गस्य नान्योऽस्ति काले काले तथा गते
verses.transliteration: brahmā sraṣṭā hariḥ pātā saṃhartā ca maheśvaraḥ | tasya sargasya nānyo'sti kāle kāle tathā gate
verses.translation: Those seven traversers of the lake Manasa engaged in sacred rites and Yoga got their bodies withered up taking in only air and water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those seven traversers of the lake Manasa engaged in sacred rites and Yoga got their bodies withered up taking in only air and water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः । अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ | ayanaṃ tasya tāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever sacred rites they had heard in the pre¬ ceptor's hermitage in the previous births were retained in their minds. So also the goal of non-return to this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever sacred rites they had heard in the pre¬ ceptor's hermitage in the previous births were retained in their minds. So also the goal of non-return to this world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यवर्णमभवत्तदण्डमुदकेशयम् । तत्र जज्ञे स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूरिति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyavarṇamabhavattadaṇḍamudakeśayam | tatra jajñe svayaṃ brahmā svayambhūriti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: They performed their penance, had their food and finally cast off their lives on that mountain. O descen¬ dant of Bharata, O king, the different places where they fell dead arc still seen in the same manner on the mount Kalafijara.® Thanks to their activities neither auspi-
verses.commentary: Sense: They performed their penance, had their food and finally cast off their lives on that mountain. O descen¬ dant of Bharata, O king, the different places where they fell dead arc still seen in the same manner on the mount Kalafijara.® Thanks to their activities neither auspi-
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानुषित्वा परिवत्सरम् । तदण्डमकरोद् द्वैधं दिवं भूमिं च निर्ममे
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānuṣitvā parivatsaram | tadaṇḍamakarod dvaidhaṃ divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirmame
verses.translation: The Western Dasarr.a comprised the Eastern Malwa including the kingdom of Bhopal with its capital at Vidisa while the eastern Disirna formed a par< of Chattictjarh district in the Madhya Pradesh (B.H.D. Sec. III).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Western Dasarr.a comprised the Eastern Malwa including the kingdom of Bhopal with its capital at Vidisa while the eastern Disirna formed a par< of Chattictjarh district in the Madhya Pradesh (B.H.D. Sec. III).
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधोऽधोर्ध्वं प्रयुक्तानि भुवनानि चतुर्द्दश । तयोः शकलयोर्मध्य आकाशममृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: adho'dhordhvaṃ prayuktāni bhuvanāni caturddaśa | tayoḥ śakalayormadhya ākāśamamṛjatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Sec note 128.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sec note 128.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु परिप्लवां पृथ्वीं दिशश्च दशधा दधे । तत्र काले मनो वाचं कामक्रोधावथो रतिम्
verses.transliteration: apsu pariplavāṃ pṛthvīṃ diśaśca daśadhā dadhe | tatra kāle mano vācaṃ kāmakrodhāvatho ratim
verses.translation: On an island in an auspicious spot the seven be¬ came aquatic birds. They were reborn as Cakravaka birds in a life that is neither auspicious nor inauspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: On an island in an auspicious spot the seven be¬ came aquatic birds. They were reborn as Cakravaka birds in a life that is neither auspicious nor inauspicious.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । वसिष्ठं तु महातेजाः सोऽसृजत्सप्त मानसान्
verses.transliteration: marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum | vasiṣṭhaṃ tu mahātejāḥ so'sṛjatsapta mānasān
verses.translation: They abandoned the contact with their mates. They were like sages practising sacred rites, free from associations and Egotistic feelings. They remained calm. They did not accept gifts. They were free from Dvandvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They abandoned the contact with their mates. They were like sages practising sacred rites, free from associations and Egotistic feelings. They remained calm. They did not accept gifts. They were free from Dvandvas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्त बह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः । ततोऽसृजत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रान् क्रोधसमुद्भवान्
verses.transliteration: sapta bahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ | tato'sṛjatpunarbrahmā rudrān krodhasamudbhavān
verses.translation: They were birds only in name. They were holy bachelors delighted in renunciation. They were birds practising sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were birds only in name. They were holy bachelors delighted in renunciation. They were birds practising sacred rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारं च ऋषिं सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजम् । सप्त चैते प्रजायन्ते पश्चाद्रुद्राश्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāraṃ ca ṛṣiṃ sarveṣāmapi pūrvajam | sapta caite prajāyante paścādrudrāśca sarvataḥ
verses.translation: They could remember their previous births. They grew old even as they were bachelors. They remained to¬ gether free from aberrations and performed good rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: They could remember their previous births. They grew old even as they were bachelors. They remained to¬ gether free from aberrations and performed good rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः सनत्कुमारस्तु तेजः सङ्क्षिप्य तिष्ठति । तेषां सप्त महावंशा दिव्या देवर्षिपूजिताः
verses.transliteration: ataḥ sanatkumārastu tejaḥ saṅkṣipya tiṣṭhati | teṣāṃ sapta mahāvaṃśā divyā devarṣipūjitāḥ
verses.translation: When they were born as brahmins they acted falsely to their preceptor. Still in their birth as birds they attained knowledge as a result of the Sraddha they had performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were born as brahmins they acted falsely to their preceptor. Still in their birth as birds they attained knowledge as a result of the Sraddha they had performed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पयांसि च ससर्जादौ पर्जन्यं च ससर्ज ह । ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि निर्ममे यज्ञसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: payāṃsi ca sasarjādau parjanyaṃ ca sasarja ha | ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye
verses.translation: The knowledge of Brahma practised by the ancients or found in the preceptors' families stands as of yore even today. One shall practise that knowledge there¬ fore.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge of Brahma practised by the ancients or found in the preceptors' families stands as of yore even today. One shall practise that knowledge there¬ fore.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यांस्तैरयजन्देवानित्येवमनुशुश्रुम । मुखाद्देवानजनयत्पितॄंश्चैवाथ वक्षसः । प्रजनाच्च मनुष्यान्वै जघनान्निर्ममेऽसुरान्
verses.transliteration: pūjyāṃstairayajandevānityevamanuśuśruma | mukhāddevānajanayatpitṝṃścaivātha vakṣasaḥ | prajanācca manuṣyānvai jaghanānnirmame'surān
verses.translation: They were of noble birth and were named Svatantra. Suyajfia, Sumanas, Suvak§uddha and the fifth one Ghidradaraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were of noble birth and were named Svatantra. Suyajfia, Sumanas, Suvak§uddha and the fifth one Ghidradaraka.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे । आपवस्य प्रजासर्गं सृजतो हि प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire | āpavasya prajāsargaṃ sṛjato hi prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: While they were practising sacred rites an auspicious event happened there. O great sage, please listen to that.
verses.commentary: Sense: While they were practising sacred rites an auspicious event happened there. O great sage, please listen to that.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सृज्यमानाः प्रजाश्चैव नावर्धन्त यदा तदा । द्विधा कृत्वात्मनो देहं स्त्री चैव पुरुषोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sṛjyamānāḥ prajāścaiva nāvardhanta yadā tadā | dvidhā kṛtvātmano dehaṃ strī caiva puruṣo'bhavat
verses.translation: The prosperous king of Nipas,** endowed with strength, and accompanied by his harem entered that forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The prosperous king of Nipas,** endowed with strength, and accompanied by his harem entered that forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ससृजेऽथ प्रजाः सर्वा महिम्ना व्याप्य विश्वतः । विराजमसृजद्विष्णुः स सृष्टः पुरुषं विराट्
verses.transliteration: sasṛje'tha prajāḥ sarvā mahimnā vyāpya viśvataḥ | virājamasṛjadviṣṇuḥ sa sṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaṃ virāṭ
verses.translation: The Cakravaka Svatantra yearned much, on seeing the happy king endowed with the glory of the king¬ dom pass along.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Cakravaka Svatantra yearned much, on seeing the happy king endowed with the glory of the king¬ dom pass along.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं तं मनुं विद्धि मनोरन्तरमेव च । स वैराजः प्रजाः सर्वाः ससर्ज पुरुषः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ taṃ manuṃ viddhi manorantarameva ca | sa vairājaḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ sasarja puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: I have become weary with the observance of fasts and steady penance. If there is a merit accruing from penance or the observance of checks and restraints lei me become like him the abode of fortune and bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have become weary with the observance of fasts and steady penance. If there is a merit accruing from penance or the observance of checks and restraints lei me become like him the abode of fortune and bliss.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारायणविसर्गस्य प्रजास्तस्याप्ययोनिजः । आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमान्धन्यः प्रजावांश्चाभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇavisargasya prajāstasyāpyayonijaḥ | āyuṣmān kīrtimāndhanyaḥ prajāvāṃścābhavattataḥ
verses.translation: Then two of his comrades said. "We shall be your ministers, your delighters and well-wishers."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then two of his comrades said. "We shall be your ministers, your delighters and well-wishers."
