verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादिसर्गस्ते वर्णितो मुनिसत्तम । आदिसर्गं विदित्वैवं यथेष्टां प्राप्नुयाद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ityevamādisargaste varṇito munisattama | ādisargaṃ viditvaivaṃ yatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyādgatim
verses.translation: After saying "So be it", the Yogic soul attained his goal. The two Cakravakas replied to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying "So be it", the Yogic soul attained his goal. The two Cakravakas replied to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.३० ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.30 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Without taking in any food, breathing in only air he began to perform a great penance in the spot where those comrades were present.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without taking in any food, breathing in only air he began to perform a great penance in the spot where those comrades were present.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Without taking in any food, breathing in only air he began to perform a great penance in the spot where those comrades were present.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without taking in any food, breathing in only air he began to perform a great penance in the spot where those comrades were present.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सर्गवर्णनम् १ । सूत उवाच । संसृष्टासु प्रजास्वेव आपवोऽथ प्रजापतिः । लेभे वै पुरुषः पत्नीं शतरूपामयोनिजाम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.30. triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sargavarṇanam 1 | sūta uvāca | saṃsṛṣṭāsu prajāsveva āpavo'tha prajāpatiḥ | lebhe vai puruṣaḥ patnīṃ śatarūpāmayonijām
verses.translation: Then that forest Vibhraja shone splendidly. It became very famous as the bestower of Yogic Siddhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that forest Vibhraja shone splendidly. It became very famous as the bestower of Yogic Siddhi.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपवस्य महिम्ना तु दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठतः । धर्मेणैव महात्मा स शतरूपाप्यजायत
verses.transliteration: āpavasya mahimnā tu divamāvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ | dharmeṇaiva mahātmā sa śatarūpāpyajāyata
verses.translation: By repeating the names of Siva, one gets rid ol all sins soon. As soon as the name Siva, the lord of the gods, is uttered sins are quelled like an unbaked pot in water, O great sage. In proportion to the sins committed and in order to quell them the Japa of Siva's names shall be per¬ formed by the faithful. In order to achieve the fruits of all desires too, this Japa shall be performed accordingly.
verses.wordMeaning: By repeating the names of Siva, one gets rid ol all sins soon. As soon as the name Siva, the lord of the gods, is uttered sins are quelled like an unbaked pot in water, O great sage.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By repeating the names of Siva, one gets rid ol all sins soon. As soon as the name Siva, the lord of the gods, is uttered sins are quelled like an unbaked pot in water, O great sage.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा तु वर्षशतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम् । भर्तारं दीप्ततपसं पुरुषं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sā tu varṣaśataṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram | bhartāraṃ dīptatapasaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyapadyata
verses.translation: That great Yogin who had never been fascinated evei on seeing the beauty of the celestial damsels became ovffwhelmed by lust towards her, in the circumstances.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great Yogin who had never been fascinated evei on seeing the beauty of the celestial damsels became ovffwhelmed by lust towards her, in the circumstances.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स वै स्वायम्भुवो जज्ञे पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते । तस्यैकसप्ततियुगं मन्वन्तरमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: sa vai svāyambhuvo jajñe puruṣo manurucyate | tasyaikasaptatiyugaṃ manvantaramihocyate
verses.translation: Afflicted by lust the sage caught hold of her again. On seeing him bent upon seizing her she said agun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afflicted by lust the sage caught hold of her again. On seeing him bent upon seizing her she said agun.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैराजात्पुरुषाद्वीरा शतरूपा व्यजायत । प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ वीरकायामजायताम्
verses.transliteration: vairājātpuruṣādvīrā śatarūpā vyajāyata | priyavratottānapādau vīrakāyāmajāyatām
verses.translation: Listen to me O beloved girl, all your desires will be fulfilled. A son of great fame of Visnu's part will be born to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to me O beloved girl, all your desires will be fulfilled. A son of great fame of Visnu's part will be born to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतः स्थानमात्मसमं प्रभुः । अचलं चैव पुरतः सप्तर्षीणां प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmai brahmā dadau prītaḥ sthānamātmasamaṃ prabhuḥ | acalaṃ caiva purataḥ saptarṣīṇāṃ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: O comely lady, your son will be the author of the Puranas, the classifier of the Vedas and renowned in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O comely lady, your son will be the author of the Puranas, the classifier of the Vedas and renowned in the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अवतारः स विष्णोर्हि प्रजापालनहेतवे । धर्मसंरक्षणार्थाय दुष्टानां दण्डहेतवे
verses.transliteration: avatāraḥ sa viṣṇorhi prajāpālanahetave | dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya duṣṭānāṃ daṇḍahetave
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying this and enjoying the beautiful lass, the sage, an expert in Yoga, took his bath in the Yamuna and went away quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, after saying this and enjoying the beautiful lass, the sage, an expert in Yoga, took his bath in the Yamuna and went away quickly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चरत्सु पृथ्व्यामभवंश्च महीरुहाः । अरक्ष्यमाणायां पृथ्व्यां बभूवाथ प्रजाक्षयः
verses.transliteration: tapaścaratsu pṛthvyāmabhavaṃśca mahīruhāḥ | arakṣyamāṇāyāṃ pṛthvyāṃ babhūvātha prajākṣayaḥ
verses.translation: She conceived and immediately gave birth in an island on the Yamuna** to a son with the lustre of the sun and resembling Kamadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: She conceived and immediately gave birth in an island on the Yamuna** to a son with the lustre of the sun and resembling Kamadeva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अचरांश्च चरांश्चैव द्विपदोऽथ चतुष्पदः । संसृज्य मनसा दक्षो मैथुनीं सृष्टिमारभत्
verses.transliteration: acarāṃśca carāṃścaiva dvipado'tha catuṣpadaḥ | saṃsṛjya manasā dakṣo maithunīṃ sṛṣṭimārabhat
verses.translation: Immediately after birth the brilliant sage spoke to his mother "O mother, go as you please and I also go at my will
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately after birth the brilliant sage spoke to his mother "O mother, go as you please and I also go at my will
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र प्रजा मैथुनसम्भवाः । सङ्कल्पाद्दर्शनात्स्पर्शात्पूर्वेषां सृष्टिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti viprendra prajā maithunasambhavāḥ | saṅkalpāddarśanātsparśātpūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭirucyate
verses.translation: O mother, whenever you have some work, whenever you desire in your mind, please remember me. Immediately I shall come to you to fulfil your desire."
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, whenever you have some work, whenever you desire in your mind, please remember me. Immediately I shall come to you to fulfil your desire."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काम्या नाम महाभागा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । काम्यापुत्रास्त्रयस्त्वासन्संराट्साक्षिरविट्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kāmyā nāma mahābhāgā kardamasya prajāpateḥ | kāmyāputrāstrayastvāsansaṃrāṭsākṣiraviṭprabhuḥ
verses.translation: P. 1082 note.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपादोऽजनयत्पुत्रान् शक्रसमान् प्रभुः । ध्रुवं च तनयं दिव्यमात्मानन्दसुवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: uttānapādo'janayatputrān śakrasamān prabhuḥ | dhruvaṃ ca tanayaṃ divyamātmānandasuvarcasam
verses.translation: p. 1314 note.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्य कन्या सुश्रोणी सुनीतिर्नाम विश्रुता । उत्पन्ना चापि धर्मेण ध्रुवस्य जननी तथा
verses.transliteration: dharmasya kanyā suśroṇī sunītirnāma viśrutā | utpannā cāpi dharmeṇa dhruvasya jananī tathā
verses.translation: P. 1229 note.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवो वर्षसहस्राणि त्रीणि दिव्यानि कानने । तपस्तेपे स बालस्तु प्रार्थयन्स्थानमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: dhruvo varṣasahasrāṇi trīṇi divyāni kānane | tapastepe sa bālastu prārthayansthānamavyayam
verses.translation: After reaching the holy centre of Varanasi and visiting Manikarnika the great sage discarded the sin accu¬ mulated in crores of birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the holy centre of Varanasi and visiting Manikarnika the great sage discarded the sin accu¬ mulated in crores of birth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पुष्टिश्च धान्यश्च ध्रुवात्पुत्रौ व्यजायताम् । पुष्टिरेवं समुत्थायाः पञ्चपुत्रानकल्मषान्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt puṣṭiśca dhānyaśca dhruvātputrau vyajāyatām | puṣṭirevaṃ samutthāyāḥ pañcaputrānakalmaṣān
verses.translation: They were reborn in Kampilya as seven noble souls Brahmadatta and others. All of them were free from sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were reborn in Kampilya as seven noble souls Brahmadatta and others. All of them were free from sins.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रिपुं रिपुञ्जयं विप्रं वृकलं वृषतेजसम् । रिपोरेवं च महिषी चाक्षुषं सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ vipraṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛṣatejasam | riporevaṃ ca mahiṣī cākṣuṣaṃ sarvatodiśam
verses.translation: Four of them had the memory of their previous births but three of them were deluded. That Svatantra of great Yogic power was now called Brahmadatta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four of them had the memory of their previous births but three of them were deluded. That Svatantra of great Yogic power was now called Brahmadatta.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनत्पुष्करिण्यां वरुणं चाक्षुषो मनुः । मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां महौजसः
verses.transliteration: ajījanatpuṣkariṇyāṃ varuṇaṃ cākṣuṣo manuḥ | manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Chidradarsin and Sunctra were the masters of the Vedas and Vedahgas. They were born as sons of brahmins well-versed in the Vedas. They had the memory of the previous births.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chidradarsin and Sunctra were the masters of the Vedas and Vedahgas. They were born as sons of brahmins well-versed in the Vedas. They had the memory of the previous births.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कन्यायां हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः । पुरुर्मासः शतद्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवित्कविः
verses.transliteration: kanyāyāṃ hi muniśreṣṭha vairājasya prajāpateḥ | pururmāsaḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavitkaviḥ
verses.translation: Pancala and Pundarlka established their sons in the house and went to forest. There they attained the great goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pancala and Pundarlka established their sons in the house and went to forest. There they attained the great goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमोऽतिरात्रश्चातिमन्युः सुयशा दश । पूरोरजनयत्पुत्रान् षडाग्नेयी महाप्रभान्
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomo'tirātraścātimanyuḥ suyaśā daśa | pūrorajanayatputrān ṣaḍāgneyī mahāprabhān
verses.translation: O descendant of Bharata, Brahmadatta's wife
verses.commentary: Sense: O descendant of Bharata, Brahmadatta's wife
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गं सुमनसं ख्यातिं सृतिमङ्गिरसं गयम् । अङ्गात्सुनीथा भार्या वै वेनमेकमसूयत
verses.transliteration: aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ khyātiṃ sṛtimaṅgirasaṃ gayam | aṅgātsunīthā bhāryā vai venamekamasūyata
verses.translation: The other three Gakravaka comrades were born as brahmin sons in the family of a poor man, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other three Gakravaka comrades were born as brahmin sons in the family of a poor man, O king.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपचारेण वेनस्य कोपस्तेषां महानभूत् । हुङ्कारेणैव तं जघ्नुर्मुनयो धर्मतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: apacāreṇa venasya kopasteṣāṃ mahānabhūt | huṅkāreṇaiva taṃ jaghnurmunayo dharmatatparāḥ
verses.translation: They were engaged in Yogic practice. They took leave of one another, bowed at the lotus-like feet of Siva and set out.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were engaged in Yogic practice. They took leave of one another, bowed at the lotus-like feet of Siva and set out.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रजार्थमृषयः प्रार्थिताश्च सुनीथया । सारस्वतास्तदा तस्य ममन्थुर्दक्षिणं करम्
verses.transliteration: atha prajārthamṛṣayaḥ prārthitāśca sunīthayā | sārasvatāstadā tasya mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ karam
verses.translation: The enthusiasts desiring freedom from rebirth resort to Siya's feet. May those feet of Siva destroy sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The enthusiasts desiring freedom from rebirth resort to Siya's feet. May those feet of Siva destroy sins.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेनस्य पाणौ मथिते सम्बभूव ततः पृथुः । स धन्वी कवची जातस्तेजसादित्यसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: venasya pāṇau mathite sambabhūva tataḥ pṛthuḥ | sa dhanvī kavacī jātastejasādityasannibhaḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, if any physical, mental or verbal sin is committed, one shall read this narrative with full devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, if any physical, mental or verbal sin is committed, one shall read this narrative with full devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथुर्वैन्यस्तदा पृथ्वीमरक्षत्क्षत्रपूर्वजः । राजसूयाभिषिक्तानामाद्यः स वसुधापतिः
verses.transliteration: pṛthurvainyastadā pṛthvīmarakṣatkṣatrapūrvajaḥ | rājasūyābhiṣiktānāmādyaḥ sa vasudhāpatiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or hears this for prosperity is liberated from sins and attains.salvation. There is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or hears this for prosperity is liberated from sins and attains.salvation. There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्चैव समुत्पन्नौ निपुणौ सूतमागधौ । तेनेयं गौर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ दुग्धा सर्वहिताय वै
verses.transliteration: tasmāccaiva samutpannau nipuṇau sūtamāgadhau | teneyaṃ gaurmuniśreṣṭha dugdhā sarvahitāya vai
verses.translation: O Suta having Vya as preceptor, please tell me now the mode of worshipping the preceptor. What shall be done at the end of listening to the holy book? Please mention that also.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta having Vya as preceptor, please tell me now the mode of worshipping the preceptor. What shall be done at the end of listening to the holy book? Please mention that also.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां वृत्तिदश्चाभूद्देवर्षिसुररक्षसाम् । मनुष्याणां विशेषेण शतयज्ञकरो नृपः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ vṛttidaścābhūddevarṣisurarakṣasām | manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa śatayajñakaro nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing the story the devotee shall worship the preceptor duly with devotion. Delighted in mind he shall make liberal gifts duly to the preceptor at the conclusion of the holy book.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the story the devotee shall worship the preceptor duly with devotion. Delighted in mind he shall make liberal gifts duly to the preceptor at the conclusion of the holy book.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथोः पुत्रौ तु जज्ञाते धर्मज्ञौ भुवि पार्थिवौ । विजिताश्वश्च हर्यक्षो महावीरौ सुविश्रुतौ
verses.transliteration: pṛthoḥ putrau tu jajñāte dharmajñau bhuvi pārthivau | vijitāśvaśca haryakṣo mahāvīrau suviśrutau
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall bow to the propounder and worship him duly. Gifts of ornaments for hands and ears and fine garments shall be made.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent devotee shall bow to the propounder and worship him duly. Gifts of ornaments for hands and ears and fine garments shall be made.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डिनी चाजनयत्पुत्रं प्राचीनबर्हिषम् । प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य पृथिवीतलचारिणः
verses.transliteration: śikhaṇḍinī cājanayatputraṃ prācīnabarhiṣam | prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya pṛthivītalacāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: After the worship of Siva he shall present to the preceptor a cow and its calf. He shall make a book-seat with gold, a Pala in weight and cover it with a good doth. The manuscript of the holy book written in beautiful hand shall be placed on it and given to the preceptor. The in¬ telligent devotee will be liberated from worldly bondage.
verses.wordMeaning: After the worship of Siva he shall present to the preceptor a cow and its calf. He shall make a book-seat with gold, a Pala in weight and cover it with a good doth. The manuscript of the holy book written in beautiful hand shall be placed on it and given to the preceptor.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After the worship of Siva he shall present to the preceptor a cow and its calf. He shall make a book-seat with gold, a Pala in weight and cover it with a good doth. The manuscript of the holy book written in beautiful hand shall be placed on it and given to the preceptor.…

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतनया तेन धर्मतः सुविवाहिता । रेजेऽधिकतरं राजा कृतदारो महाप्रभुः
verses.transliteration: samudratanayā tena dharmataḥ suvivāhitā | reje'dhikataraṃ rājā kṛtadāro mahāprabhuḥ
verses.translation: O sage, a village, an elephant or a horse or other things shall be given as possible to the noble preceptor who
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, a village, an elephant or a horse or other things shall be given as possible to the noble preceptor who
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतनयायास्तु दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः । बभूवुस्तनया दिव्या बहुयज्ञकरस्य वै
verses.transliteration: samudratanayāyāstu daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ | babhūvustanayā divyā bahuyajñakarasya vai
verses.translation: O sage, the Purana full of the meanings of the Vedas, the heart of the Vedas, the meritorious holy book shall be listened to with devotion and in accordance with the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the Purana full of the meanings of the Vedas, the heart of the Vedas, the meritorious holy book shall be listened to with devotion and in accordance with the rules.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे प्राचेतसा नाम्ना धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः । अपृथग्धर्माचरणास्तेऽतप्यन्त महत्तपः
verses.transliteration: sarve prācetasā nāmnā dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ | apṛthagdharmācaraṇāste'tapyanta mahattapaḥ
verses.translation: O Suta of great intellect, O store-house of mercy, please narrate the birth of Vyasa. O holy lord, please satisfy our curiosity. Vyasa's mother is known as Satyavati. She was married to king Santanu. How was Vyasa the great Yogin born of her from Parasara? There is a great doubt in regard to that. It behoves you to remove that doubt.
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta of great intellect, O store-house of mercy, please narrate the birth of Vyasa. O holy lord, please satisfy our curiosity. Vyasa's mother is known as Satyavati. She was married to king Santanu.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta of great intellect, O store-house of mercy, please narrate the birth of Vyasa. O holy lord, please satisfy our curiosity. Vyasa's mother is known as Satyavati. She was married to king Santanu.…

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः । रुद्रगीतं जपन्तश्च शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ | rudragītaṃ japantaśca śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The righteous soul spoke to the ferryman who was taking his meals "Take me across the Yamuna quickly in your boat".
verses.commentary: Sense: The righteous soul spoke to the ferryman who was taking his meals "Take me across the Yamuna quickly in your boat".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा तु निवृत्तास्ते तपसो लब्धसद्वराः । चुक्रुधुर्मुनिशार्दूल दग्धुकामास्तपोबलाः
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā tu nivṛttāste tapaso labdhasadvarāḥ | cukrudhurmuniśārdūla dagdhukāmāstapobalāḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of clasping the beautiful daughter of the
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of clasping the beautiful daughter of the
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राचेतसा मुखेभ्यस्ते प्रासृजन्नग्निमारुतौ । वृक्षानुन्मूल्य वायुस्तानदहद्धव्यवाहनः
verses.transliteration: prācetasā mukhebhyaste prāsṛjannagnimārutau | vṛkṣānunmūlya vāyustānadahaddhavyavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: The wide-eyed lass spoke to him smilingly — "O sage of controlled speech, why do you intend to perpetrate this despicable deed?
verses.commentary: Sense: The wide-eyed lass spoke to him smilingly — "O sage of controlled speech, why do you intend to perpetrate this despicable deed?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षक्षयं ततो दृष्ट्वा किञ्चिच्छेषेषु शाखिषु । उपगम्याब्रवीदेतान् राजा सोमः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣakṣayaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā kiñciccheṣeṣu śākhiṣu | upagamyābravīdetān rājā somaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: O most intelligent one, you are born of the beauti¬ ful family ofVasi§tha. O brahmin, I am the daughter of a Nijada. How can our union be proper?
verses.commentary: Sense: O most intelligent one, you are born of the beauti¬ ful family ofVasi§tha. O brahmin, I am the daughter of a Nijada. How can our union be proper?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोम उवाच । कोपं यच्छत राजानः सर्वे प्राचीनबर्हिषः । अनुभूतानुकन्येयं वृक्षाणां वरवर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: soma uvāca | kopaṃ yacchata rājānaḥ sarve prācīnabarhiṣaḥ | anubhūtānukanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ varavarṇinī
verses.translation: Then she thought within: *Tf this Yogin engages himself in the vicious act there is none in the world to prevent him due to his power of inflicting curse.**

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यं जानता सा तु धृता गर्भेण वै मया । भार्या वोऽस्तु महाभागाः सोमवंशविवर्धिनी

verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking in the mind thus she said to the great sage — "O holy lord, please forbear till I take you to the other bank."

verses.sanskrit: अस्यामुत्पत्स्यते विद्वान् दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः । सृष्टिकर्ता महातेजा ब्रह्मपुत्रः पुरातनः

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकं तेजसार्धेन मम चानेन तेजसा । ब्रह्मतेजोमयो भूपः प्रजाः संवर्धयिष्यति

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वानयुतं तस्यां सुतान् पुण्यानजीजनत् । ते विरक्ता बभूवुश्च नारदस्योपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: haryaśvānayutaṃ tasyāṃ sutān puṇyānajījanat | te viraktā babhūvuśca nāradasyopadeśataḥ

verses.translation: On hearing the words uttered by her, the leading sage immediately created a screen of snow, thanks to the strength of his merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words uttered by her, the leading sage immediately created a screen of snow, thanks to the strength of his merit.

verses.transliteration: te'pi bhrātṛpathā yātāstanmunerupadeśataḥ | nāgaman pitṛsānnidhyaṃ viraktā bhikṣumārgiṇaḥ
verses.translation: When the sheet of mist.spread and it looked just
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sheet of mist.spread and it looked just

verses.sanskrit: स मैथुनेन धर्मेण ससर्ज विविधाः प्रजाः । ताः शृणु त्वं महाप्राज्ञ कथयामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: sa maithunena dharmeṇa sasarja vividhāḥ prajāḥ | tāḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ mahāprājña kathayāmi samāsataḥ
verses.translation: I too shall worship lord MadhyameiSvara and attain the power to compose the Puranas immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: I too shall worship lord MadhyameiSvara and attain the power to compose the Puranas immediately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां पुत्रसहस्राणि वीरिण्यां पञ्च वीर्यवान् । आश्रित्य जनयामास दक्ष एव प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ putrasahasrāṇi vīriṇyāṃ pañca vīryavān | āśritya janayāmāsa dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: "O lord of gods, O fortunate one who are favour¬ ably disposed to the refugees, O lord inaccessible to words, mind and activities, and the one that are invisible even to the Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord of gods, O fortunate one who are favour¬ ably disposed to the refugees, O lord inaccessible to words, mind and activities, and the one that are invisible even to the Yogins.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतान् सृष्टांस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह वै मुनिः । सत्रे स तु समुत्पन्नो नारदः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: etān sṛṣṭāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha vai muniḥ | satre sa tu samutpanno nāradaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Uma, the Vedas too do not realise 'our greatness. You alone are the creator of the universe, itic sustainer and the annihilator too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Uma, the Vedas too do not realise 'our greatness. You alone are the creator of the universe, itic sustainer and the annihilator too.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । भुवो मानमजानन्तः कथं सृष्टिं करिष्यथ । सर्वे हि बालिशाः किं हि सृष्टिकर्तुं समुद्यताः
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca | bhuvo mānamajānantaḥ kathaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kariṣyatha | sarve hi bāliśāḥ kiṃ hi sṛṣṭikartuṃ samudyatāḥ
verses.translation: You are the first and foremost of all gods. You
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the first and foremost of all gods. You
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपत्न्यो मुने त्वेतास्तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु । विश्वेदेवास्तु विश्वायाः साध्यान्साध्या व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: dharmapatnyo mune tvetāstāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu | viśvedevāstu viśvāyāḥ sādhyānsādhyā vyajāyata
verses.translation: You alone are the great Brahman; the under of the knot of Maya, unsullied by the three attributes as the leaf of the lotus unaffected by water.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the great Brahman; the under of the knot of Maya, unsullied by the three attributes as the leaf of the lotus unaffected by water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यूषस्य त्वभूत्पुत्र ऋषिर्नाम्ना तु देवलः । द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि प्रजावन्तौ मनीषिणौ
verses.transliteration: pratyūṣasya tvabhūtputra ṛṣirnāmnā tu devalaḥ | dvau putrau devalasyāpi prajāvantau manīṣiṇau
verses.translation: You have neither birth nor conduct of life. You have neither a native land nor a family. Even so you are the lord of the three worlds. You fulfil the desires of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have neither birth nor conduct of life. You have neither a native land nor a family. Even so you are the lord of the three worlds. You fulfil the desires of the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतवान्वा कश्यपाद्वै पुंसां सृष्टिर्भविष्यति । दक्षस्यैव दुहितृषु तस्मात्तानब्रवीत्तु सः
verses.transliteration: śrutavānvā kaśyapādvai puṃsāṃ sṛṣṭirbhaviṣyati | dakṣasyaiva duhitṛṣu tasmāttānabravīttu saḥ
verses.translation: Neither Brahma nor Visnu nor the gods including Indra nor the leading Yogins know your reality. We worship you of such features.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Brahma nor Visnu nor the gods including Indra nor the leading Yogins know your reality. We worship you of such features.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजानन्तः कथं सृष्टिं बालिशा वै करिष्यथ । दिशं काञ्चिदजानन्तस्तस्माद्विज्ञाय तां भुवम्
verses.transliteration: ajānantaḥ kathaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ bāliśā vai kariṣyatha | diśaṃ kāñcidajānantastasmādvijñāya tāṃ bhuvam
verses.translation: Everything originates from you. You are all — the lord of Gauri, the slayer of the Tripuras, a boy, a youth, an aged man. I unite you with my heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything originates from you. You are all — the lord of Gauri, the slayer of the Tripuras, a boy, a youth, an aged man. I unite you with my heart.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ताः प्रययुः सर्वे आशां विज्ञातुमोजसा । तदन्तं न हि सम्प्राप्य न निवृत्ताः पितुर्गृहम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve āśāṃ vijñātumojasā | tadantaṃ na hi samprāpya na nivṛttāḥ piturgṛham
verses.translation: Obeisance to lord Siva, who deserves the worship of devotees, Obeisance to the Ancient Being; to Siva the great Atman,"
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to lord Siva, who deserves the worship of devotees, Obeisance to the Ancient Being; to Siva the great Atman,"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञात्वा जनयामास पुनः पञ्चशतान् सुतान् । तानुवाच पुनः सोऽपि नारदः सर्वदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: tajjñātvā janayāmāsa punaḥ pañcaśatān sutān | tānuvāca punaḥ so'pi nāradaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: After eulogising thus when the sage Vyasa prostrated on the ground the delighted boy spoke to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising thus when the sage Vyasa prostrated on the ground the delighted boy spoke to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तेऽपि तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निर्याताः सर्वतोदिशम् । सुबलाश्वा दक्षसुता हर्यश्वा इव ते पुरा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | te'pi tadvacanaṃ śrutvā niryātāḥ sarvatodiśam | subalāśvā dakṣasutā haryaśvā iva te purā
verses.translation: P. 1327 note,

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तं पुष्करं प्राप्य गतास्तेऽपि पराभवम् । अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः
verses.transliteration: anantaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāpya gatāste'pi parābhavam | adyāpi na nivartante samudrebhya ivāpagāḥ
verses.translation: This peak of the Himfdayas has not been identified so far.
verses.commentary: Sense: This peak of the Himfdayas has not been identified so far.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति वै भ्राता भ्रातुरन्वेषणे रतः । प्रयातो नश्यति मुने तन्न कार्यं विपश्चिता
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti vai bhrātā bhrāturanveṣaṇe rataḥ | prayāto naśyati mune tanna kāryaṃ vipaścitā
verses.translation: P. 1254 note.,

verses.transliteration: tāṃścāpi naṣṭān vijñāya putrāndakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ | sa ca krodhāddadau śāpaṃ nāradāya mahātmane
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: कुत्रचिन्न लभस्वेति संस्थितिं कलहप्रिय । तव सान्निध्यतो लोके भवेच्च कलहः सदा
verses.transliteration: kutracinna labhasveti saṃsthitiṃ kalahapriya | tava sānnidhyato loke bhavecca kalahaḥ sadā
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सान्त्वितोऽथ विधात्रा हि स दक्षस्तु प्रजापतिः । कन्याः षष्ट्यसृजत्पश्चाद्वीरिण्यामिति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sāntvito'tha vidhātrā hi sa dakṣastu prajāpatiḥ | kanyāḥ ṣaṣṭyasṛjatpaścādvīriṇyāmiti naḥ śrutam
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । सप्तविंशति सोमाय चतस्रोऽरिष्टनेमिने
verses.transliteration: dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa | saptaviṃśati somāya catasro'riṣṭanemine
verses.translation: P. 1081 note.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: द्वे चैवं ब्रह्मपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तदा । द्वे कृशाश्वाय विदुषे तासां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: dve caivaṃ brahmaputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tadā | dve kṛśāśvāya viduṣe tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu
verses.translation: A sacred place near Ajmer famous for the lake Puskara
verses.commentary: Sense: A sacred place near Ajmer famous for the lake Puskara
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धती वसुर्यामिर्लम्बा भानुर्मरुत्वती । सङ्कल्पा च मुहूर्ता च सन्ध्या विश्वा च वै मुने
verses.transliteration: arundhatī vasuryāmirlambā bhānurmarutvatī | saṅkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sandhyā viśvā ca vai mune
verses.translation: P. 1 254 note

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वत्यां मरुत्वन्तो वसोस्तु वसवस्तथा । भानोस्तु भानवः सर्वे मुहूर्तायां मुहूर्तजाः
verses.transliteration: marutvatyāṃ marutvanto vasostu vasavastathā | bhānostu bhānavaḥ sarve muhūrtāyāṃ muhūrtajāḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping devoutly Visvcsa and other Lihgas he began to think frequently— "What is that Lihga that bestows Siddhi instantaneously and worshipping whom the great god, we shall be able to attain all lores and by whose blessings I may have the power to compose the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping devoutly Visvcsa and other Lihgas he began to think frequently— "What is that Lihga that bestows Siddhi instantaneously and worshipping whom the great god, we shall be able to attain all lores and by whose blessings I may have the power to compose the Puranas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लम्बायाश्चैव घोषोऽथ नागवीथी च यामिजा । पृथिवीविषमस्तस्यामरुन्धत्यामजायत
verses.transliteration: lambāyāścaiva ghoṣo'tha nāgavīthī ca yāmijā | pṛthivīviṣamastasyāmarundhatyāmajāyata
verses.translation: There are crores of Lihgas; from the midst of these what shall I instal, what shall I resort so? Gan it be Ohkaranatha, or Krttivasevara or Kedarea, or KameSa, or Candresa, or Trilocana, or Kalesa, or Vrddhakalesa, or Kalae:%vara, or Jycstl\csa, or Jambukesa, or Jaigisavyesvara, or Dasasvamedhesana, or Drumacandesa, or Drkkesa or Garudesa or Ganesvara, or Prasannavadanesa, or Dharmesa, or Tarakesvara or Nandikesa or Nivasea, or Patrlsa, or Priti- kevara, or Parvatesa, or Pasupati, or Haakewara or Brhaspatisvara, or Tilabhandesa or Bharabhutesvara, or Mahaksmlsvara or Marutea, or Moksesa, or Ganges or Narmadesvara, or Krsnesa, or Paramesana, or Ratnesvara, or Yamunesa, or Lahgalisa, or Vifvesvara or AvimukteSvara, or or Vialakslia, or Vyaghrevara, or Varahesa, or Vidyevara or Varunea, or VidhiSa, or Har«kesesvara, or Bhavanisa, or Kapardisa, or Kandukea or AjeSvara or Visvakarmesvara, or Viresvara, or Nadea, or Kapilesa, or Bhuvanesvara, or Vaskulisa or Mahadeva, or SiddhHvara or VisvedeveSvara or Virabhadresa or Bhairavesvara, or Amrtesa; or Satina or ParvatiSvara or Siddhelvara,Matahgesa or Bhutisvara, or Asa- hisa, Prakaesa, or Kotirudresvara, or Madalase:5vara, or Tilaparnesvara, Hiranyagarbhesa or shall it be Madhyame4- vara?"

verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पायास्तु सत्यात्मा जज्ञे सङ्कल्प एव हि । अयादयो वसोः पुत्रा अष्टौ तान् शृणु शौनक
verses.transliteration: saṅkalpāyāstu satyātmā jajñe saṅkalpa eva hi | ayādayo vasoḥ putrā aṣṭau tān śṛṇu śaunaka
verses.translation: Pondering thus, Vyasa, devoted to Siva with his mind steady in meditation, thought for a short while.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pondering thus, Vyasa, devoted to Siva with his mind steady in meditation, thought for a short while.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अयो धुवश्च सोमश्च धरश्चैवानिलोऽनलः । प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवाऽष्टौ च नामतः
verses.transliteration: ayo dhuvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilo'nalaḥ | pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavā'ṣṭau ca nāmataḥ
verses.translation: '*0 I remember it now. I had forgotten it
verses.commentary: Sense: '*0 I remember it now. I had forgotten it
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अयस्य पुत्रो वैतण्डः श्रमः शान्तो मुनिस्तथा । ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान् कालो लोकभावनः
verses.transliteration: ayasya putro vaitaṇḍaḥ śramaḥ śānto munistathā | dhruvasya putro bhagavān kālo lokabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: Hence lord Madhyamesvara shall be resorted to. Many brahmins have attained Siddhis by propitiating Him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence lord Madhyamesvara shall be resorted to. Many brahmins have attained Siddhis by propitiating Him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य भगवान् वर्चा वर्चस्वी येन जायते । धरस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यवहस्तथा
verses.transliteration: somasya bhagavān varcā varcasvī yena jāyate | dharasya putro draviṇo hutahavyavahastathā
verses.translation: Kubera became the lord of wealth; Vamadeva the head of the devotees of Siva; the childless Khatvahga was blessed with children.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kubera became the lord of wealth; Vamadeva the head of the devotees of Siva; the childless Khatvahga was blessed with children.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरायाः शिशिरः प्राणोऽथ रमणस्तथा । अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या यस्याः पुत्राः पुरोजवः
verses.transliteration: manoharāyāḥ śiśiraḥ prāṇo'tha ramaṇastathā | anilasya śivā bhāryā yasyāḥ putrāḥ purojavaḥ
verses.translation: The celestial damsel Candrabhama of cuckoo¬ like sweet voice was merged into the Linga even as she was dancing emotionally.
verses.commentary: Sense: The celestial damsel Candrabhama of cuckoo¬ like sweet voice was merged into the Linga even as she was dancing emotionally.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अविज्ञातगतिश्चैव द्वौ पुत्रावनिलस्य तु । अग्निपुत्रः कुमारस्तु शरस्तम्बे श्रियावृते
verses.transliteration: avijñātagatiścaiva dvau putrāvanilasya tu | agniputraḥ kumārastu śarastambe śriyāvṛte
verses.translation: Srikara, son of the cowherdess, resorted to Madhyamesvara and attained the chieftainship of the Ganas of the benevolent Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srikara, son of the cowherdess, resorted to Madhyamesvara and attained the chieftainship of the Ganas of the benevolent Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च पृष्ठतः । अपत्यं कृत्तिकानां तु कार्तिकेय इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ | apatyaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu kārtikeya iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thanks to the favour of Madhyamesvara the two gods Sukra and Brhaspati honoured and respected by the Asuras and gods became the master of all lore.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the favour of Madhyamesvara the two gods Sukra and Brhaspati honoured and respected by the Asuras and gods became the master of all lore.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी । योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नं समन्ताद्व्यचरत्तदा
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatestu bhaginī varastrī brahmacāriṇī | yogasiddhā jagatkṛtsnaṃ samantādvyacarattadā
verses.translation: After resolving thus the sage Vyasa, son of Satyavall, took his bath in the waters of the Ganga and performed the sacred rites and observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: After resolving thus the sage Vyasa, son of Satyavall, took his bath in the waters of the Ganga and performed the sacred rites and observances.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य च । विश्वकर्मा महाभाग तस्य जज्ञे प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca | viśvakarmā mahābhāga tasya jajñe prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Sometimes he took in only leaves, sometimes he lived on fruit and vegetable diet, sometimes on wind or water and sometimes he observed complete fast and performed the sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sometimes he took in only leaves, sometimes he lived on fruit and vegetable diet, sometimes on wind or water and sometimes he observed complete fast and performed the sacred rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वार्धकिः । भूषणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ता शिल्पवतां वरः
verses.transliteration: kartā śilpasahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāṃ ca vārdhakiḥ | bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kartā śilpavatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Thus by these observances of restraints the holy
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus by these observances of restraints the holy
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वासां विमानानि देवतानां चकार ह । मनुष्याश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvāsāṃ vimānāni devatānāṃ cakāra ha | manuṣyāścopajīvanti yasya śilpaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: A long time elasped thus. One day early in the morning the sage was returning after his bath in the waters of the Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: A long time elasped thus. One day early in the morning the sage was returning after his bath in the waters of the Gahga.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रैवतोऽजो भवो भीमो वाम उग्रो वृषाकपिः । अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यो बहुरूपो महानिति
verses.transliteration: raivato'jo bhavo bhīmo vāma ugro vṛṣākapiḥ | ajaikapādahirbudhnyo bahurūpo mahāniti
verses.translation: The holy sage saw lord Madhyamesvara, the bestower of desires of the devotees, in the midst of the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy sage saw lord Madhyamesvara, the bestower of desires of the devotees, in the midst of the Lihga.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सरूपायां प्रसूतस्य स्त्रियां रुद्रश्च कोटिशः । तत्रैकादशमुख्यास्तु तन्नामानि मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: sarūpāyāṃ prasūtasya striyāṃ rudraśca koṭiśaḥ | tatraikādaśamukhyāstu tannāmāni mune śṛṇu
verses.translation: The moonlight of the autumnal crescent moon
verses.commentary: Sense: The moonlight of the autumnal crescent moon
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यस्त्वष्टा रुद्रश्च वीर्यवान् । हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यम्बकश्चापराजितः
verses.transliteration: ajaikapādahirbudhnyastvaṣṭā rudraśca vīryavān | haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaścāparājitaḥ
verses.translation: He had assumed the form of a five-year-old boy with eyes extending upto his ears. His lips were as red as the coral. He was wearing ornaments befitting a boy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had assumed the form of a five-year-old boy with eyes extending upto his ears. His lips were as red as the coral. He was wearing ornaments befitting a boy.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृषाकपिश्च शम्भुश्च कपर्दी रैवतस्तथा । एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣākapiśca śambhuśca kapardī raivatastathā | ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The lustre of his body subdued the arrogance
verses.commentary: Sense: The lustre of his body subdued the arrogance
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतं त्वेवं समाख्यातं रुद्राणाममितौजसाम् । शृणु कश्यपपत्नीनां नामानि मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: śataṃ tvevaṃ samākhyātaṃ rudrāṇāmamitaujasām | śṛṇu kaśyapapatnīnāṃ nāmāni munisattama
verses.translation: On seeing Siva, the lord of Uma, the shoreless ocean of mercy, known for his fondness of devotees and easily propitiated with delighted pleasing face, inaccessible even to the Yogins, the kinsman of the distressed and the Git-formed lord, the sage sang the song of prayer with words choked with devotion.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Siva, the lord of Uma, the shoreless ocean of mercy, known for his fondness of devotees and easily propitiated with delighted pleasing face, inaccessible even to the Yogins, the kinsman of the distressed and the Git-formed lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Siva, the lord of Uma, the shoreless ocean of mercy, known for his fondness of devotees and easily propitiated with delighted pleasing face, inaccessible even to the Yogins, the kinsman of the distressed and the Git-formed lord,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.३२ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.32 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage Vyasa of great penance stood up and replied — "O lord what h hidden from you the omniscient?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted sage Vyasa of great penance stood up and replied — "O lord what h hidden from you the omniscient?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage Vyasa of great penance stood up and replied — "O lord what h hidden from you the omniscient?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted sage Vyasa of great penance stood up and replied — "O lord what h hidden from you the omniscient?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । कश्यपवंशवर्णनम् १ । सूत उवाच । अदितिर्दितिश्च सुरसारिष्टेला दनुरेव च । सुरभिर्विनता चैव ताम्रा क्रोधवशा खशा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.32. dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | kaśyapavaṃśavarṇanam 1 | sūta uvāca | aditirditiśca surasāriṣṭelā danureva ca | surabhirvinatā caiva tāmrā krodhavaśā khaśā
verses.translation: You are the immanent Soul and bestower of everything. Why does the lord force me for begging which is the cause of misery?
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the immanent Soul and bestower of everything. Why does the lord force me for begging which is the cause of misery?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूर्मुनिश्च विप्रेन्द्र तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु । पूर्वमन्वन्तरे श्रेष्ठे द्वादशासन्सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kadrūrmuniśca viprendra tāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu | pūrvamanvantare śreṣṭhe dvādaśāsansurottamāḥ
verses.translation: Another Purana composed by ParaSara and en¬ lightening the details of Vi§nu is called Vaisnava Purana. It is said to be composed by Vyasa since there is no difference between father and son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another Purana composed by ParaSara and en¬ lightening the details of Vi§nu is called Vaisnava Purana. It is said to be composed by Vyasa since there is no difference between father and son.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तुषिता नाम तेऽन्योन्यमूचुर्वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे । उपस्थिते सुयशसश्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: tuṣitā nāma te'nyonyamūcurvaivasvate'ntare | upasthite suyaśasaścākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: O foremost among those who know Brahman, we wish to hear from you the beautiful story of the mother of the universe, the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O foremost among those who know Brahman, we wish to hear from you the beautiful story of the mother of the universe, the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: हिताय सर्वलोकानां समागम्य परस्परम् । आगच्छत द्रुतं देवा अदितिं च प्रविश्य वै
verses.transliteration: hitāya sarvalokānāṃ samāgamya parasparam | āgacchata drutaṃ devā aditiṃ ca praviśya vai
verses.translation: Which excellent man will abandon her whose very remembrance bestows all the four aims of life without any strain?
verses.commentary: Sense: Which excellent man will abandon her whose very remembrance bestows all the four aims of life without any strain?

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरे प्रसूयामः सतां श्रेयो भविष्यति । एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: manvantare prasūyāmaḥ satāṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati | evamuktāstu te sarve cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: I do not know what plight they are in, after the ruination of the kingdom. My heroic soldiers, very enthusiastic in the battle, slayers of enemies, now serve another king. Huge elephants like mountains, horses fast as wind have gone away. Is the traditional treasury accu¬ mulated by my ancestors well guarded or not? Thus the very virtuous king became much deluded.
verses.wordMeaning: I do not know what plight they are in, after the ruination of the kingdom. My heroic soldiers, very enthusiastic in the battle, slayers of enemies, now serve another king. Huge elephants like mountains, horses fast as wind have gone away.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I do not know what plight they are in, after the ruination of the kingdom. My heroic soldiers, very enthusiastic in the battle, slayers of enemies, now serve another king. Huge elephants like mountains, horses fast as wind have gone away.…

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशतिर्याः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्योऽथ सुव्रताः । तासामपत्यान्यभवन्दीप्तयोऽमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: saptaviṃśatiryāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyo'tha suvratāḥ | tāsāmapatyānyabhavandīptayo'mitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime a certain VaiSya came there. The king asked him — "Sir, who are you? Why have you come here? Why do you appear to be very morose and dejected? Please tell me this, now."
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime a certain VaiSya came there. The king asked him — "Sir, who are you? Why have you come here? Why do you appear to be very morose and dejected? Please tell me this, now."

verses.sanskrit: संह्रादस्य कृतिर्भार्यासूत पञ्चजनं ततः । विरोचनस्तु प्राह्रादिर्देव्यां तस्याभवद् बलिः
verses.transliteration: saṃhrādasya kṛtirbhāryāsūta pañcajanaṃ tataḥ | virocanastu prāhrādirdevyāṃ tasyābhavad baliḥ
verses.translation: "O king, I am a Vaiiya Samadhi, born of a rich family. Out of greed for my wealth I have been abandoned by my wife, sons and others. 1 am depressed by my past Karman. O king, I have come here to the forest. I am worried about my sons, grandsons, wife, brothers, their sons and friends. O lord, ocean of mercy, I am in dark about their welfare.

verses.sanskrit: पुलोमिका पुलोमा च वैश्वानरसुते उभे । बह्वपत्ये महावीर्ये मारीचेस्तु परिग्रहा त्
verses.transliteration: pulomikā pulomā ca vaiśvānarasute ubhe | bahvapatye mahāvīrye mārīcestu parigrahā t
verses.translation: O king, words pregnant with substantial sense have been uttered by you. Still my mind is deluded by the tie of love.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, words pregnant with substantial sense have been uttered by you. Still my mind is deluded by the tie of love.

verses.sanskrit: गृध्रिकाश्वी ह्युलूकी च ताम्राकन्याः प्रकीर्तिताः । काकी काकानजनयदुलूकी प्रत्युलूककान्
verses.transliteration: gṛdhrikāśvī hyulūkī ca tāmrākanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | kākī kākānajanayadulūkī pratyulūkakān
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the king and the VaiSya, both of them equally deluded then approached the sage Medhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, the king and the VaiSya, both of them equally deluded then approached the sage Medhas.

verses.sanskrit: शशांस्तु जनयामास सुररभिर्महिषांस्तथा । इला वृक्षाँल्लता वल्लीस्तृणजातीस्तु सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: śaśāṃstu janayāmāsa surarabhirmahiṣāṃstathā | ilā vṛkṣām̐llatā vallīstṛṇajātīstu sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous king accompanied by the chief of the Vaisyas bowed his head to the leading Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous king accompanied by the chief of the Vaisyas bowed his head to the leading Yogin.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मारीचात्कश्यपाज्जातास्तेऽदित्यां दक्षकन्यया । तत्र विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च जज्ञाते पुनरेव हि
verses.transliteration: mārīcātkaśyapājjātāste'dityāṃ dakṣakanyayā | tatra viṣṇuśca śakraśca jajñāte punareva hi
verses.translation: This Vaiiya has been expelled from his house by his people, wife and others. Still his sense of affinity and kinship with them does not go off.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Vaiiya has been expelled from his house by his people, wife and others. Still his sense of affinity and kinship with them does not go off.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्यमा चैव धाता च त्वष्टा पूषा तथैव च । विवस्वान् सविता चैव मित्रावरुण एव च
verses.transliteration: aryamā caiva dhātā ca tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathaiva ca | vivasvān savitā caiva mitrāvaruṇa eva ca
verses.translation: The great Maya in the form of the eternal Sakti is the material cause of the universe. It is this that drags the minds of all and makes them deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Maya in the form of the eternal Sakti is the material cause of the universe. It is this that drags the minds of all and makes them deluded.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अंशो भगश्चातितेजा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वमासन्ये तुषिताः सुराः
verses.transliteration: aṃśo bhagaścātitejā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ | cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvamāsanye tuṣitāḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: O lord, Brahma and other gods deluded by this Maya do not realise the truth. What then is the story of men?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, Brahma and other gods deluded by this Maya do not realise the truth. What then is the story of men?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरैव तस्यान्तरे तु आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः । इति प्रोक्तानि क्रमशोऽदित्यपत्यानि शौनक
verses.transliteration: puraiva tasyāntare tu ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ | iti proktāni kramaśo'dityapatyāni śaunaka
verses.translation: That alone, Paramesvari of three attributes, creates the universe; she alone sustains it and she alone destroys it at the proper time.
verses.commentary: Sense: That alone, Paramesvari of three attributes, creates the universe; she alone sustains it and she alone destroys it at the proper time.

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमिपत्नीनामपत्यानीह षोडश । बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश्चतस्रो विद्युतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭanemipatnīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa | bahuputrasya viduṣaścatasro vidyutaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Vyaa of pious mind, lord Siva who had assumed the form of boy smiled 'no
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Vyaa of pious mind, lord Siva who had assumed the form of boy smiled 'no

verses.sanskrit: कृशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षे देवप्रहरणाः स्मृताः । भार्म्यायामर्चिषि मुने धूम्रकेशस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kṛśāśvasya tu devarṣe devapraharaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | bhārmyāyāmarciṣi mune dhūmrakeśastathaiva ca
verses.translation: O most excellent of those who know brahman, the desire you have cherished in your heart will undoubtedly be realised ere long.
verses.commentary: Sense: O most excellent of those who know brahman, the desire you have cherished in your heart will undoubtedly be realised ere long.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधा सती च द्वे पत्न्यौ स्वधा ज्येष्ठा सती परा । स्वधासूत पितॄन् वेदमथर्वाङ्गिरसं सती
verses.transliteration: svadhā satī ca dve patnyau svadhā jyeṣṭhā satī parā | svadhāsūta pitṝn vedamatharvāṅgirasaṃ satī
verses.translation: I the immanent lord shall station myself in your throat, O brahmin, and shall make you compose the Itihasa and the Puranas efficiently.
verses.commentary: Sense: I the immanent lord shall station myself in your throat, O brahmin, and shall make you compose the Itihasa and the Puranas efficiently.

verses.transliteration: ete yugasahasrānte jāyante punareva hi | sarvadevanikāyāśca trayastriṃśattu kāmajāḥ
verses.translation: The holy hymn "Abhila§a§taka" (Eight Verses

verses.sanskrit: यथा सूर्यस्य नित्यं हि उदयास्तमयाविह । एवं देवानिकास्ते च सम्भवन्ति युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: yathā sūryasya nityaṃ hi udayāstamayāviha | evaṃ devānikāste ca sambhavanti yuge yuge
verses.translation: Even a fool, getting up early in the morning taking his bath, worshipping the linga of Siva and reciting this hymn for a year shall attain the status of Brhaspati ( preceptor of the gods. )
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a fool, getting up early in the morning taking his bath, worshipping the linga of Siva and reciting this hymn for a year shall attain the status of Brhaspati ( preceptor of the gods. )

verses.sanskrit: दित्यां बभूवतुः पुत्रौ कश्यपादिति नः श्रुतम् । हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव हिरण्याक्षश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: dityāṃ babhūvatuḥ putrau kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutam | hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva hiraṇyākṣaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: This hymn repeatedly recited for a year in the presence of the Linga whether by a woman or a man, duly observing restraints, shall increase the intellect and learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: This hymn repeatedly recited for a year in the presence of the Linga whether by a woman or a man, duly observing restraints, shall increase the intellect and learning.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहिका ह्यभवत्कन्या विप्रचित्तेः परिग्रहः । हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राश्चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः
verses.transliteration: siṃhikā hyabhavatkanyā vipracitteḥ parigrahaḥ | hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Vyasa who thus secured the boon from the great lord Madhyamesvara composed the eighteen Puranas spor¬ tively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa who thus secured the boon from the great lord Madhyamesvara composed the eighteen Puranas spor¬ tively.

verses.sanskrit: अनुह्रादश्च ह्रादश्च संह्रादश्चैव वीर्यवान् । प्रह्रादश्चानुजस्तत्र विष्णुभक्तिविचारधीः
verses.transliteration: anuhrādaśca hrādaśca saṃhrādaścaiva vīryavān | prahrādaścānujastatra viṣṇubhaktivicāradhīḥ
verses.translation: The eighteen Puranas Brahma, Padma. Vaisnava, 8aiva, Bhagavata, Bhavisya, Naradiya, Markandeya, Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Lainga, Varaha, Vamana Kaurma, Matsya, Garuda, Skanda and Brahmanda are conducive to fame and merit to those who listen to the glory of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eighteen Puranas Brahma, Padma. Vaisnava, 8aiva, Bhagavata, Bhavisya, Naradiya, Markandeya, Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Lainga, Varaha, Vamana Kaurma, Matsya, Garuda, Skanda and Brahmanda are conducive to fame and merit to those who listen to the glory of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनुह्रादस्य सूर्यायां पुलोमा महिषस्तथा । ह्रादस्य धमनिर्भार्यासूत वातापिमिल्वलम्
verses.transliteration: anuhrādasya sūryāyāṃ pulomā mahiṣastathā | hrādasya dhamanirbhāryāsūta vātāpimilvalam
verses.translation: You have enumerated the eighteen Puranas. O foremost among the knowers of the Vedas please define them now.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have enumerated the eighteen Puranas. O foremost among the knowers of the Vedas please define them now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीदशनायां मुनीश्वर । बलिरासीन्महाशैवः शिवभक्तिपरायणः
verses.transliteration: baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīdaśanāyāṃ munīśvara | balirāsīnmahāśaivaḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Those who know the Puraas speak that purana as Siva Purana wherein there are many stories of Siva in its earlier and later forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who know the Puraas speak that purana as Siva Purana wherein there are many stories of Siva in its earlier and later forms.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दानशील उदारश्च पुण्यकीर्तितपाः स्मृतः । तत्पुत्रो बाणनामा यः सोऽपि शैववरः सुधीः । यः सन्तोष्य शिवं सम्यग्गाणपत्यमवाप ह
