verses.translation: Where the stories of the goddess Durga are mentioned, it is said to be Bhagavata Purana as well as Devlpurana.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: Where the stories of the goddess Durga are mentioned, it is said to be Bhagavata Purana as well as Devlpurana.'*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा कथा श्रुतपूर्वा ते बाणस्य हि महात्मनः । कृष्णं यः समरे वीरः सुप्रसन्नं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: sā kathā śrutapūrvā te bāṇasya hi mahātmanaḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ yaḥ samare vīraḥ suprasannaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: The Purana narrated by Narada is called Naradiya. The seventh Purapa is called, O Tancli, Markandeya because the great sage Markandeya is the speaker therein. Since it is related to the fire-god, the Purana is called Agneya. Since it recounts future events the Purana is called the Bhaviya Purana.
verses.wordMeaning: The Purana narrated by Narada is called Naradiya. The seventh Purapa is called, O Tancli, Markandeya because the great sage Markandeya is the speaker therein. Since it is related to the fire-god, the Purana is called Agneya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purana narrated by Narada is called Naradiya. The seventh Purapa is called, O Tancli, Markandeya because the great sage Markandeya is the speaker therein. Since it is related to the fire-god, the Purana is called Agneya.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्याक्षसुताः पञ्च पण्डिताः सुमहाबलाः । कुकुरः शकुनिश्चैव भूतसन्तापनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ pañca paṇḍitāḥ sumahābalāḥ | kukuraḥ śakuniścaiva bhūtasantāpanastathā
verses.translation: O sage, the twelfth Purana Varaha is so called because it contains the story of Varaha, the great Boar. In the Skanda Purana the speaker is lord Siva himself and the listener is Skanda. In the Vamana Purana the story of Vamana (the Dwarf-god) is mentioned. The Kurma Purana contains the story of Kurma (the tortoise-god). The Matsya Purana is so called because it is expounded by Matsya. The Garuda Purana is so called because the speaker is Garuda himself. Since the story of the entire cosmic egg is mentioned, the last Purana is called Brahmanda Purana. SUta said: —
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, the twelfth Purana Varaha is so called because it contains the story of Varaha, the great Boar. In the Skanda Purana the speaker is lord Siva himself and the listener is Skanda. In the Vamana Purana the story of Vamana (the Dwarf-god) is mentioned.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the twelfth Purana Varaha is so called because it contains the story of Varaha, the great Boar. In the Skanda Purana the speaker is lord Siva himself and the listener is Skanda. In the Vamana Purana the story of Vamana (the Dwarf-god) is mentioned.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महानादश्च विक्रान्तः कालनाभस्तथैव च । इत्युक्ता दितिपुत्राश्च दनोः पुत्रान् मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: mahānādaśca vikrāntaḥ kālanābhastathaiva ca | ityuktā ditiputrāśca danoḥ putrān mune śṛṇu
verses.translation: Accordinp to §P., the Saiviie Purpna Devibhagavata, and not the Visi[iuite Purana 'Mahabhagavata' belongs to the eighteen Furipas See Winternitz H.I.L. Vol i Pt. IJ P -87.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accordinp to §P., the Saiviie Purpna Devibhagavata, and not the Visi[iuite Purana 'Mahabhagavata' belongs to the eighteen Furipas See Winternitz H.I.L. Vol i Pt. IJ P -87.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभवन्दनुपुत्राश्च शतं तीव्रपराक्रमाः । अयोमुखः शम्बरश्च कपोलो वामनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: abhavandanuputrāśca śataṃ tīvraparākramāḥ | ayomukhaḥ śambaraśca kapolo vāmanastathā
verses.translation: O brahmin, you shall not entertain a doubt as to why Satyavati had sexual intercourse with Paraara and Santanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, you shall not entertain a doubt as to why Satyavati had sexual intercourse with Paraara and Santanu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरः पुलोमा च विद्रावणमहाशिरौ । स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānaraḥ pulomā ca vidrāvaṇamahāśirau | svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca vipracittiśca vīryavān
verses.translation: This wondrous birth has sufficient reasons behind it. In the story of great men the good qualities shall be grasped by the intelligent people.
verses.commentary: Sense: This wondrous birth has sufficient reasons behind it. In the story of great men the good qualities shall be grasped by the intelligent people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते सर्वे दनोः पुत्राः कश्यपादनुजज्ञिरे । एषां पुत्रीः शृणु मुने प्रसङ्गाद्वच्मि तेऽनघ
verses.transliteration: ete sarve danoḥ putrāḥ kaśyapādanujajñire | eṣāṃ putrīḥ śṛṇu mune prasaṅgādvacmi te'nagha
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this great secret is rid of all sins and is honoured in the world of sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this great secret is rid of all sins and is honoured in the world of sages.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभार्नोस्तु प्रभा कन्या पुलोम्नस्तु शची सुता । उपदानवी हयशिरा शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी
verses.transliteration: svabhārnostu prabhā kanyā pulomnastu śacī sutā | upadānavī hayaśirā śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī
verses.translation: The beautiful episode of Siva with various in¬ cidental anecdotes and narratives of various incarnations, is heard. It yields both worldly pleasures and salvation to men.
verses.commentary: Sense: The beautiful episode of Siva with various in¬ cidental anecdotes and narratives of various incarnations, is heard. It yields both worldly pleasures and salvation to men.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तयोः पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिर्दानवनन्दनाः । मरीचिर्जनयामास महता तपसान्विताः
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ putrasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭirdānavanandanāḥ | marīcirjanayāmāsa mahatā tapasānvitāḥ
verses.translation: The first primordial Sakti of Siva the great Brahman, who is called Uma, is the great mother of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first primordial Sakti of Siva the great Brahman, who is called Uma, is the great mother of the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पौलोमाः कालखञ्जाश्च दानवानां महाबलाः । अवध्या देवतानां च हिरण्यपुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: paulomāḥ kālakhañjāśca dānavānāṃ mahābalāḥ | avadhyā devatānāṃ ca hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Her two incarnations — Sati and Haimavati, have been heard, O intelligent Suta. Please mention her other in¬ carnations too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her two incarnations — Sati and Haimavati, have been heard, O intelligent Suta. Please mention her other in¬ carnations too.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पितामहप्रसादेन ये हताः सव्यसाचिना । सिंहिकायामथोत्पन्ना विप्रचित्तेः सुतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: pitāmahaprasādena ye hatāḥ savyasācinā | siṃhikāyāmathotpannā vipracitteḥ sutāstathā
verses.translation: Which intelligent man will be reluctant to hear the good attributes of the glorious mother? Wise men never abandon them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Which intelligent man will be reluctant to hear the good attributes of the glorious mother? Wise men never abandon them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यदानवसंयोगाज्जातास्तीव्रपराक्रमाः । सैंहिकेया इति ख्यातास्त्रयोदश महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: daityadānavasaṃyogājjātāstīvraparākramāḥ | saiṃhikeyā iti khyātāstrayodaśa mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: You are all blessed and contented noble souls in as
verses.commentary: Sense: You are all blessed and contented noble souls in as
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राहुः शल्यो सुबलिनो बलश्चैव महाबलः । वातापिर्नमुचिश्चैवाथेल्वलः स्वसृपस्तथा
verses.transliteration: rāhuḥ śalyo subalino balaścaiva mahābalaḥ | vātāpirnamuciścaivāthelvalaḥ svasṛpastathā
verses.translation: Sages consider the dust-particles of the feet of those who listen, narrate and inquire about it, on a par with holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages consider the dust-particles of the feet of those who listen, narrate and inquire about it, on a par with holy centres.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजिको नरकश्चैव कालनाभस्तथैव च । शरमाणः शरः कल्प एते वंशविवर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: ajiko narakaścaiva kālanābhastathaiva ca | śaramāṇaḥ śaraḥ kalpa ete vaṃśavivardhanāḥ
verses.translation: Blessed and contented are they, their parents and their family, whose mind is merged in the goddess, the great Knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blessed and contented are they, their parents and their family, whose mind is merged in the goddess, the great Knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च दनुवंशविवर्द्धनाः । बहवश्च समुद्भूता विस्तरत्वान्न वर्णिताः
verses.transliteration: eṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca danuvaṃśavivarddhanāḥ | bahavaśca samudbhūtā vistaratvānna varṇitāḥ
verses.translation: Those who do not eulogise the goddess of the gods, the cause of all causes are deluded by the attributes of Maya. They are unfortunate. There is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not eulogise the goddess of the gods, the cause of all causes are deluded by the attributes of Maya. They are unfortunate. There is no doubt in this.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संह्रादस्य तु दैतेया निवातकवचाः कुले । उत्पन्ना मरुतस्तस्मिंस्तपसा भावितात्मनः
verses.transliteration: saṃhrādasya tu daiteyā nivātakavacāḥ kule | utpannā marutastasmiṃstapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Those who do not worship the great goddess, the ocean of the juice of mercy, fall in the blind well in the form of the cruel worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not worship the great goddess, the ocean of the juice of mercy, fall in the blind well in the form of the cruel worldly existence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षण्मुखाद्या महासत्त्वास्ताम्रायाः परिकीर्तिताः । काकी श्येनी च भासी च सुग्रीवी च शुकी तथा
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇmukhādyā mahāsattvāstāmrāyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | kākī śyenī ca bhāsī ca sugrīvī ca śukī tathā
verses.translation: Abandoning the goddess and resorting to another deity is as bad as abandoning the Gahga and resorting to water in the desert for the sake of satisfaction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abandoning the goddess and resorting to another deity is as bad as abandoning the Gahga and resorting to water in the desert for the sake of satisfaction.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्येनी श्येनांस्तथा भासी भासान्गृद्धी तु गृध्रकान् । शुकी शुकानजनयत्सुग्रीवी शुभपक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: śyenī śyenāṃstathā bhāsī bhāsāngṛddhī tu gṛdhrakān | śukī śukānajanayatsugrīvī śubhapakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly in the Svarocisa Manvantara there was a king Viratha. Suratha his son was of great strength and exploit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly in the Svarocisa Manvantara there was a king Viratha. Suratha his son was of great strength and exploit.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अश्वानुष्ट्रान् गर्दभांश्च ताम्रा च कश्यपप्रिया । जनयामास चेत्येवं ताम्रावंशः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: aśvānuṣṭrān gardabhāṃśca tāmrā ca kaśyapapriyā | janayāmāsa cetyevaṃ tāmrāvaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: They laid siege to his capital Kola.'® The king had a terrible war with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They laid siege to his capital Kola.'® The king had a terrible war with them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विनतायाश्च पुत्रौ द्वावरुणो गरुडस्तथा । सुपर्णः पततां श्रेष्ठो दारुणः स्वेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: vinatāyāśca putrau dvāvaruṇo garuḍastathā | suparṇaḥ patatāṃ śreṣṭho dāruṇaḥ svena karmaṇā
verses.translation: The king went to another city of his along with his ministers. There too he was defeated by his enemies who had a large following.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king went to another city of his along with his ministers. There too he was defeated by his enemies who had a large following.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरसायाः सहस्रं तु सर्पाणाममितौजसाम् । अनेकशिरसां तेषां खेचराणां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: surasāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu sarpāṇāmamitaujasām | anekaśirasāṃ teṣāṃ khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: His ministers and officers became inimical to him due to adverse fate. They took away all the wealth from the treasury.
verses.commentary: Sense: His ministers and officers became inimical to him due to adverse fate. They took away all the wealth from the treasury.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: येषां प्रधाना राजानः शेषवासुकितक्षकाः । ऐरावतो महापद्मः कम्बलाश्वतरावुभौ
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ pradhānā rājānaḥ śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ | airāvato mahāpadmaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau
verses.translation: The king left his city pretending to go out for hunting. Alone he got up on a horse and went to the dense forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king left his city pretending to go out for hunting. Alone he got up on a horse and went to the dense forest.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऐलापत्रस्तथा पद्मः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ । महानीलमहाकर्णौ धृतराष्ट्रो बलाहकः
verses.transliteration: ailāpatrastathā padmaḥ karkoṭakadhanañjayau | mahānīlamahākarṇau dhṛtarāṣṭro balāhakaḥ
verses.translation: Going about here and there, the king saw the hermitage of a great sage. It was shining all round with flower gardens. Everywhere the sound of Vedic hymns was heard. All the animals there were quiet and peaceful. The disciples and the disciples of their disciples moved here and there.
verses.wordMeaning: Going about here and there, the king saw the hermitage of a great sage. It was shining all round with flower gardens. Everywhere the sound of Vedic hymns was heard. All the animals there were quiet and peaceful.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Going about here and there, the king saw the hermitage of a great sage. It was shining all round with flower gardens. Everywhere the sound of Vedic hymns was heard. All the animals there were quiet and peaceful.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुहरः पुष्पदन्तश्च दुर्मुखः सुमुखस्तथा । बहुशः खररोमा च पाणिरित्येवमादयः
verses.transliteration: kuharaḥ puṣpadantaśca durmukhaḥ sumukhastathā | bahuśaḥ khararomā ca pāṇirityevamādayaḥ
verses.translation: O intelligent one, tigers and other ferocious and powerful animals did not harass the animals of less strength in that hermitage, thanks to the power of the leading brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, tigers and other ferocious and powerful animals did not harass the animals of less strength in that hermitage, thanks to the power of the leading brahmin.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गणाः क्रोधवशायाश्च तस्याः सर्वे च दंष्ट्रिणः । अण्डजाः पक्षिणोऽब्जाश्च वराह्याः पशवो मताः
verses.transliteration: gaṇāḥ krodhavaśāyāśca tasyāḥ sarve ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ | aṇḍajāḥ pakṣiṇo'bjāśca varāhyāḥ paśavo matāḥ
verses.translation: Once the king began to think anxiously — "Alas, my kingdom has been seized by my haughty enemies. I am unfortunate. My intellect is confounded. I have lost my splendour. The kingdom which had been well guarded by my ancestors is now enjoyed by my enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once the king began to think anxiously — "Alas, my kingdom has been seized by my haughty enemies. I am unfortunate. My intellect is confounded. I have lost my splendour. The kingdom which had been well guarded by my ancestors is now enjoyed by my enemies.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनायुषायाः पुत्राश्च पञ्चाशच्च महाबलाः । अभवन्बलवृक्षौ च विक्षरोऽथ बृहंस्तथा
verses.transliteration: anāyuṣāyāḥ putrāśca pañcāśacca mahābalāḥ | abhavanbalavṛkṣau ca vikṣaro'tha bṛhaṃstathā
verses.translation: My hereditary ministers and counsellors have left me. I do not know which king they serve now.
verses.commentary: Sense: My hereditary ministers and counsellors have left me. I do not know which king they serve now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: खशा तु यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा । अरिष्टासूत सर्पांश्च प्रभा वै मानवोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: khaśā tu yakṣarakṣāṃsi munirapsarasastathā | ariṣṭāsūta sarpāṃśca prabhā vai mānavottamān
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence the king spoke to the sage: — "O holy lord, it behoves you now to dispel our delusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence the king spoke to the sage: — "O holy lord, it behoves you now to dispel our delusion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तितास्ते मुनीश्वर । येषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāste munīśvara | yeṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Abandoned by the royal lory I have resorted to this dense forest. Still I am not content and happy since my kingdom has been taken away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abandoned by the royal lory I have resorted to this dense forest. Still I am not content and happy since my kingdom has been taken away.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.३३ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.33 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: When the whole universe had been one great expanse of water,'® a vast sea, when Kesava, the king of Yogins, resorted to Yogic slumber and was sleeping on Sesa, two Asuras were born of the dirt in the ears of Visnu. They became notorious on the surface of the world in the names of Madhu and Kaitabha.
verses.wordMeaning: When the whole universe had been one great expanse of water,'® a vast sea, when Kesava, the king of Yogins, resorted to Yogic slumber and was sleeping on Sesa, two Asuras were born of the dirt in the ears of Visnu.…

verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ

They became notorious on the surface of the world in the names of Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३३. त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः । कश्यपवंशवर्णनम् २ । सूत उवाच । एष मन्वन्तरे तात सर्गः स्वारोचिषे स्मृतः । वैवस्वते तु महति वारुणे वित ते क्रतौ
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.33. trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ | kaśyapavaṃśavarṇanam 2 | sūta uvāca | eṣa manvantare tāta sargaḥ svārociṣe smṛtaḥ | vaivasvate tu mahati vāruṇe vita te kratau
verses.translation: They were terrible with huge bodies. They had the dazzling brilliance of the sun at the time of dissolution They had huge jaw bones. Their faces were hideous with curved fangs. They seemed to devour all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were terrible with huge bodies. They had the dazzling brilliance of the sun at the time of dissolution They had huge jaw bones. Their faces were hideous with curved fangs. They seemed to devour all the worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जुह्वानस्य ब्रह्मणो वै प्रजासर्ग इहोच्यते । पूर्वं यानथ ब्रह्मर्षीनुत्पन्नान् सप्त मानसान्
verses.transliteration: juhvānasya brahmaṇo vai prajāsarga ihocyate | pūrvaṃ yānatha brahmarṣīnutpannān sapta mānasān
verses.translation: See P. 224 note.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्वै कल्पयामास स्वयमेव पितामहः । तेषां विरोधो देवानां दानवानां महाॠषे
verses.transliteration: putrānvai kalpayāmāsa svayameva pitāmahaḥ | teṣāṃ virodho devānāṃ dānavānāṃ mahāṝṣe
verses.translation: On seeing the earth covered by a great expanse of ocean they spoke to Keiava: — *'Kill us in a spot where the earth is not covered with water."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the earth covered by a great expanse of ocean they spoke to Keiava: — *'Kill us in a spot where the earth is not covered with water."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दितिर्विनष्टपुत्रा तु कश्यपं समुपस्थिता । स कश्यपः प्रसन्नात्मा सम्गयगाराधितस्तया
verses.transliteration: ditirvinaṣṭaputrā tu kaśyapaṃ samupasthitā | sa kaśyapaḥ prasannātmā samgayagārādhitastayā
verses.translation: O king, thus I have told you about the origin of Kalika. O intelligent one, listen to the origin of Maha- lakfmi now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, thus I have told you about the origin of Kalika. O intelligent one, listen to the origin of Maha- lakfmi now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरेणच्छन्दयामास सा च वव्रे वरं तदा । पुत्रमिन्द्रवधार्थाय समर्थममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: vareṇacchandayāmāsa sā ca vavre varaṃ tadā | putramindravadhārthāya samarthamamitaujasam
verses.translation: Although free from aberrations, and devoid of forms and features, goddess Uma manifested herself in different Yugas for the destruction of the distress of the gods, after assuming different forms and features.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although free from aberrations, and devoid of forms and features, goddess Uma manifested herself in different Yugas for the destruction of the distress of the gods, after assuming different forms and features.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं दितिरर्वाक्षिरास्तदा । निद्रामाहारयामास भाविनोऽर्थस्य गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucaṃ ditirarvākṣirāstadā | nidrāmāhārayāmāsa bhāvino'rthasya gauravāt
verses.translation: Thus I have described to you her manifestation in bodily form whose wish alone manifests as everything efficaciously. Thus she conducts her sports in that way and thereby gives chance to her devotees to describe her attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have described to you her manifestation in bodily form whose wish alone manifests as everything efficaciously. Thus she conducts her sports in that way and thereby gives chance to her devotees to describe her attributes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वीरुधां चैव नक्षत्रग्रहयोस्तथा । यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: dvijānāṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva nakṣatragrahayostathā | yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva somaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: That king of Danavas defeated all the gods in battle and ruled over the kingdom of heaven seated on the throne of lord Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king of Danavas defeated all the gods in battle and ruled over the kingdom of heaven seated on the throne of lord Indra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः । उदीच्यां दिशि राजानं दुर्धर्षं सोऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: tathā hiraṇyaromāṇaṃ parjanyasya prajāpateḥ | udīcyāṃ diśi rājānaṃ durdharṣaṃ so'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: The defeated gods sought refuge in Brahma. With them Brahma went to the place where Visnu and Siva* were present.
verses.commentary: Sense: The defeated gods sought refuge in Brahma. With them Brahma went to the place where Visnu and Siva* were present.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्यै च वरं प्रादात्प्रार्थितं सुमहातपाः । ब्रह्मचर्य्यादिनियमं प्राह चैव शतं समाः
verses.transliteration: sa tasyai ca varaṃ prādātprārthitaṃ sumahātapāḥ | brahmacaryyādiniyamaṃ prāha caiva śataṃ samāḥ
verses.translation: After reaching there and bowing to l§iva and Vi|nu the gods narrated all their woeful tale in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching there and bowing to l§iva and Vi|nu the gods narrated all their woeful tale in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: धारयामास गर्भं तु शुचिः सा वरवर्णिनी । ब्रह्मचर्य्यादिनियमं दितिर्दध्रे तथैव वै
verses.transliteration: dhārayāmāsa garbhaṃ tu śuciḥ sā varavarṇinī | brahmacaryyādiniyamaṃ ditirdadhre tathaiva vai
verses.translation: O lords, we are harassed by the wicked Mahia, We have been ousted from heaven after our defeat in the battle-field.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lords, we are harassed by the wicked Mahia, We have been ousted from heaven after our defeat in the battle-field.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वाधाय सो दित्यां गर्भं तं शंसितव्रतः । जगाम कश्यपस्तप्तुं तपः संहृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: tatastvādhāya so dityāṃ garbhaṃ taṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ | jagāma kaśyapastaptuṃ tapaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: We are wandering in this world of mortals with-
verses.commentary: Sense: We are wandering in this world of mortals with-

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्चैवान्तरं प्रेप्सुः सोऽभवत्पाकशासनः । ऊनवर्षे शते चास्या ददर्शान्तरमेव सः
verses.transliteration: tasyāścaivāntaraṃ prepsuḥ so'bhavatpākaśāsanaḥ | ūnavarṣe śate cāsyā dadarśāntarameva saḥ
verses.translation: The word 'Vrsakapi' in the dual form signifies Visnu and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word 'Vrsakapi' in the dual form signifies Visnu and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शक्रस्तस्याः कुक्षिं प्रविश्य सः । वज्रपाणिस्तु तं गर्भं सप्तधा हि न्यकृन्तत
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare śakrastasyāḥ kukṣiṃ praviśya saḥ | vajrapāṇistu taṃ garbhaṃ saptadhā hi nyakṛntata
verses.translation: note. For details see Agrawal. MP — A Study P a66, 321. We find a rock-cut image of Ekaruava at Udayagirife 400 A. D.)

verses.sanskrit: स पाट्यमानो गर्भोऽथ वज्रेण प्ररुरोद ह । रुदन्तं सप्तधैकैकं मा रोदीरिति तान्पुनः । चकर्त वज्रपाणिस्तान्नेव मम्रुस्तथापि ते
verses.transliteration: sa pāṭyamāno garbho'tha vajreṇa praruroda ha | rudantaṃ saptadhaikaikaṃ mā rodīriti tānpunaḥ | cakarta vajrapāṇistānneva mamrustathāpi te
verses.translation: On seeing the lotus-seated deity in the umbilical lotus*® of the lord, the two Asuras® shouted "Hey, who arc you?** and attempted to kill him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the lotus-seated deity in the umbilical lotus*® of the lord, the two Asuras® shouted "Hey, who arc you?** and attempted to kill him.

verses.sanskrit: ते तमूचुः पाट्यमानाः सर्वे प्राञ्जलयो मुने । नो जिघांससि किं शक्र भ्रातरो मरुतस्तव
verses.transliteration: te tamūcuḥ pāṭyamānāḥ sarve prāñjalayo mune | no jighāṃsasi kiṃ śakra bhrātaro marutastava
verses.translation: On seeing the two Daityas and observing that Visnu was still lying in the vast milky ocean,** Brahma eulogised ParameSvari.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the two Daityas and observing that Visnu was still lying in the vast milky ocean,** Brahma eulogised ParameSvari.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण स्वीकृतास्ते हि भ्रातृत्वे सर्व एव च । तत्यजुर्द्दैत्यभावं ते विप्रर्षे शङ्करेच्छया
verses.transliteration: indreṇa svīkṛtāste hi bhrātṛtve sarva eva ca | tatyajurddaityabhāvaṃ te viprarṣe śaṅkarecchayā
verses.translation: O Mahamaya, save me, save me, O goddess favourably disposed to those who seek refuge in you, O mother of the universe, save me from these Daityas of hideous features.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahamaya, save me, save me, O goddess favourably disposed to those who seek refuge in you, O mother of the universe, save me from these Daityas of hideous features.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मरुतो नाम ते देवा बभूवुः सुमहाबलाः । खगा एकोनपञ्चाशत्सहाया वज्रपाणिनः
verses.transliteration: maruto nāma te devā babhūvuḥ sumahābalāḥ | khagā ekonapañcāśatsahāyā vajrapāṇinaḥ
verses.translation: I bow to the great Maya, the Yogic slumber, Uma, Sati, Kalaratri, Maharatri, Moharatri, greater than the greatest, the mother of the three deities, the eternal, the bestowcr of the fruits of the cherished desires of the devotees, the protectress of the gods and the ocean of mercy.
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to the great Maya, the Yogic slumber, Uma, Sati, Kalaratri, Maharatri, Moharatri, greater than the greatest, the mother of the three deities, the eternal, the bestowcr of the fruits of the cherished desires of the devotees,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to the great Maya, the Yogic slumber, Uma, Sati, Kalaratri, Maharatri, Moharatri, greater than the greatest, the mother of the three deities, the eternal, the bestowcr of the fruits of the cherished desires of the devotees,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषामेव प्रवृद्धानां हरिः प्रादात्प्रजापतिः । क्रमशस्तानि राज्यानि पृथुपूर्वं शृणुष्व तत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāmeva pravṛddhānāṃ hariḥ prādātprajāpatiḥ | kramaśastāni rājyāni pṛthupūrvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat
verses.translation: O Mother, you are Svaha, Svadha, Hri, the un¬ alloyed intellect, Tuti (satisfaction), Pusti nourishment), Sand (peace), Kanti (forbearance), Ksudha (hunger) and mercy itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mother, you are Svaha, Svadha, Hri, the un¬ alloyed intellect, Tuti (satisfaction), Pusti nourishment), Sand (peace), Kanti (forbearance), Ksudha (hunger) and mercy itself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टः पुरुषो वीरः कृष्णो जिष्णुः प्रजापतिः । पर्जन्यस्तु धनाध्यक्षस्तस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭaḥ puruṣo vīraḥ kṛṣṇo jiṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ | parjanyastu dhanādhyakṣastasya sarvamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: O mother, you are the Maya of Vi§nu, the very consciousness, the great Sakti, Lajja ( bashfulness ) and Tr?na ( thirst).
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, you are the Maya of Vi§nu, the very consciousness, the great Sakti, Lajja ( bashfulness ) and Tr?na ( thirst).
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूतसर्गमिमं सम्यगवोचं ते महामुने । विभागं शृणु राज्यानां क्रमशस्तं ब्रुवेऽधुना
verses.transliteration: bhūtasargamimaṃ samyagavocaṃ te mahāmune | vibhāgaṃ śṛṇu rājyānāṃ kramaśastaṃ bruve'dhunā
verses.translation: You arc Bhranti (Illusion). You appear in the form of Smrti (Memory): you stay assuming the form of mother. You are LaksmI in the house of those who engage themselves in meritorious activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Bhranti (Illusion). You appear in the form of Smrti (Memory): you stay assuming the form of mother. You are LaksmI in the house of those who engage themselves in meritorious activities.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिच्याधिराज्ये तु पृथुं वैन्यं पितामहः । ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि व्यादेष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: abhiṣicyādhirājye tu pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ pitāmahaḥ | tataḥ krameṇa rājyāni vyādeṣṭumupacakrame
verses.translation: Sprung from the ears of Viriu while he was, asleep at the end of a Kalpa, Madhu and Kaitabha were about to kill Brahma but were killed by Vi;pu. Prof. Agrawal however offers a symbolical interpretation of Madhu and Kaitabha as Rajas and Tamas-
verses.commentary: Sense: Sprung from the ears of Viriu while he was, asleep at the end of a Kalpa, Madhu and Kaitabha were about to kill Brahma but were killed by Vi;pu. Prof. Agrawal however offers a symbolical interpretation of Madhu and Kaitabha as Rajas and Tamas-
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपां तु वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् । आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम्
verses.transliteration: apāṃ tu varuṇaṃ rājye rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum | ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnāmatha pāvakam
verses.translation: Youare Jati (Birth), Vytti (cause of activity) and VySpti (pervasiveness. ) You pervade everything in the form of intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Youare Jati (Birth), Vytti (cause of activity) and VySpti (pervasiveness. ) You pervade everything in the form of intelligence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु मरुतामथ वासवम् । दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ tu marutāmatha vāsavam | daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca prahlādamamitaujasam
verses.translation: O Mother, please delude these unthwartable Asuras. O origin of the universe, please waken Vi§9u the unborn lord."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mother, please delude these unthwartable Asuras. O origin of the universe, please waken Vi§9u the unborn lord."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च यमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् । मातॄणां च व्रतानां च मन्त्राणां च तथा गवाम्
verses.transliteration: vaivasvataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca yamaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat | mātṝṇāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ ca tathā gavām
verses.translation: O king, on being requested by Brahma for the destruction of Madhu and Kaifabha, the mother of the universe, the great Vidya, the presiding deity of all Vidyas, Sakti the enchantress of the three worlds manifested herself as Mahikali on the twelfth Tithi of the bright half of the month of Phalguna.
verses.wordMeaning: O king, on being requested by Brahma for the destruction of Madhu and Kaifabha, the mother of the universe, the great Vidya, the presiding deity of all Vidyas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, on being requested by Brahma for the destruction of Madhu and Kaifabha, the mother of the universe, the great Vidya, the presiding deity of all Vidyas,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पार्थिवानां तथैव च । सर्वभूतपिशाचानां गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca | sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ giriśaṃ śūlapāṇinam
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice arose: — "O lotus-seated one, do not be afraid. I shall remove the thorn after killing Madhu and Kaitabha in the battle."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a celestial voice arose: — "O lotus-seated one, do not be afraid. I shall remove the thorn after killing Madhu and Kaitabha in the battle."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनामथ सागरम् । मृगाणामथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं तु गवामपि
verses.transliteration: śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nadīnāmatha sāgaram | mṛgāṇāmatha śārdūlaṃ govṛṣaṃ tu gavāmapi
verses.translation: After saying this and coming out of the eyes, mouth etc. of Vijnu, the great Maya stood before Brahma of unmanifested birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and coming out of the eyes, mouth etc. of Vijnu, the great Maya stood before Brahma of unmanifested birth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पतीनां वृक्षाणां वटं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् । इति दत्तं प्रजेशेन राज्यं सर्वत्र वै क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vanaspatīnāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vaṭaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat | iti dattaṃ prajeśena rājyaṃ sarvatra vai kramāt
verses.translation: Vijnu, the lord of gods stood up and saw in front of him the Daityas Madhu and Kaitabha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vijnu, the lord of gods stood up and saw in front of him the Daityas Madhu and Kaitabha.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वस्यां दिशि पुत्रं तु वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः । स्थापयामास सर्वात्मा राज्ये विश्वपतिर्विभुः
verses.transliteration: pūrvasyāṃ diśi putraṃ tu vairājasya prajāpateḥ | sthāpayāmāsa sarvātmā rājye viśvapatirvibhuḥ
verses.translation: A battle ensued between Visnu of unequalled splendour and the two Daityas lasting for five thousand years. Then there ensued a hand-to-hand fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: A battle ensued between Visnu of unequalled splendour and the two Daityas lasting for five thousand years. Then there ensued a hand-to-hand fight.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव मुनिशार्दूल कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । दक्षिणस्यां तथा पुत्रं सुधन्वानमचीक्लृपत्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva muniśārdūla kardamasya prajāpateḥ | dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathā putraṃ sudhanvānamacīklṛpat
verses.translation: Deluded by the powerful great Maya, the excellent Danava spoke to the lord Vi?nu — "Ask for whatever boon you desire to choose."
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by the powerful great Maya, the excellent Danava spoke to the lord Vi?nu — "Ask for whatever boon you desire to choose."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमायां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम् । केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं व्यादिशत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: paścimāyāṃ diśi tathā rajasaḥ putramacyutam | ketumantaṃ mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ vyādiśatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: If you are pleased with me grant me this boon that I may kill you. I do not request for any other boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you are pleased with me grant me this boon that I may kill you. I do not request for any other boon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य विस्तारमाख्यातं पृथोर्वैन्यस्य शौनक । महर्ध्यै तदधिष्ठानं पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: tasya vistāramākhyātaṃ pṛthorvainyasya śaunaka | mahardhyai tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: After giving his consent the lord lifted up his dazzling discus, placed their heads on his loins and cut them off.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving his consent the lord lifted up his dazzling discus, placed their heads on his loins and cut them off.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.३४ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.34 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Hence it behoves you to save us the gods who have sought refuge in you. O lords, please think of the means of killing him immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence it behoves you to save us the gods who have sought refuge in you. O lords, please think of the means of killing him immediately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Hence it behoves you to save us the gods who have sought refuge in you. O lords, please think of the means of killing him immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence it behoves you to save us the gods who have sought refuge in you. O lords, please think of the means of killing him immediately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३४. चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सर्वमन्वतरानुर्कार्तनम् । शौनक उवाच । मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि विस्तरेणानुकीर्तय । यावन्तो मनवश्चैव श्रोतुमिच्छामि तानहम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.34. catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | sarvamanvatarānurkārtanam | śaunaka uvāca | manvantarāṇi sarvāṇi vistareṇānukīrtaya | yāvanto manavaścaiva śrotumicchāmi tānaham
verses.translation: On hearing the gods, Vi§nu and Siva were very angry. Their eyes rolled through anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the gods, Vi§nu and Siva were very angry. Their eyes rolled through anger.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स्वायम्भुवो मनुश्चैव ततः स्वारोचिषस्तथा । उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tataḥ svārociṣastathā | uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā
verses.translation: Kala gave her a sword and a shining shield, the milk ocean a beautiful necklace, two fresh pieces of cloth, the crest-jewel, car-rings, bangles, crescent-shaped ornaments, beautiful anklets, shoulder-pieces, a necklace and finger-rings. Visvakarman gave her a beautiful axe and the ocean various weapons, an impenetrable armour, a beauti¬ ful garland and a lotus.
verses.wordMeaning: Kala gave her a sword and a shining shield, the milk ocean a beautiful necklace, two fresh pieces of cloth, the crest-jewel, car-rings, bangles, crescent-shaped ornaments, beautiful anklets, shoulder-pieces, a necklace and finger-rings.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kala gave her a sword and a shining shield, the milk ocean a beautiful necklace, two fresh pieces of cloth, the crest-jewel, car-rings, bangles, crescent-shaped ornaments, beautiful anklets, shoulder-pieces, a necklace and finger-rings.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते च मनवः षट् ते सम्प्रोक्ता मुनिपुङ्गव । वैवस्वतो मुनिश्रेष्ठ साम्प्रतं मनुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ete ca manavaḥ ṣaṭ te samproktā munipuṅgava | vaivasvato muniśreṣṭha sāmprataṃ manurucyate
verses.translation: Different weapons and missiles hurled by the hosts of enemies were rendered futile instantaneously by the power of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different weapons and missiles hurled by the hosts of enemies were rendered futile instantaneously by the power of the goddess.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णिश्च मनुश्चैव ततो रौच्यस्तथा परः । तथैव ब्रह्मसावर्णिश्चत्वारो मनवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sāvarṇiśca manuścaiva tato raucyastathā paraḥ | tathaiva brahmasāvarṇiścatvāro manavastathā
verses.translation: Wielding Maya, he became a lion. Soon as Ambika tried to cut off his head he became armed with a sword.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wielding Maya, he became a lion. Soon as Ambika tried to cut off his head he became armed with a sword.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव धर्मसावर्णी रुद्रसावर्णिरेव च । देवसावर्णिराख्यात इन्द्रसावर्णिरेव च
verses.transliteration: tathaiva dharmasāvarṇī rudrasāvarṇireva ca | devasāvarṇirākhyāta indrasāvarṇireva ca
verses.translation: Still he continued to fight. His head was cut off with the sword and he was felled down on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still he continued to fight. His head was cut off with the sword and he was felled down on the ground.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरस्यां दिशि तथा मुने सप्तर्षयस्तथा । यामा नाम तथा देवा आसन्स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: uttarasyāṃ diśi tathā mune saptarṣayastathā | yāmā nāma tathā devā āsansvāyambhuve'ntare
verses.translation: Crying "Alas! Alas" loudly, his followers, afraid of the battle fled from the scene shouting "Save us, O save us'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Crying "Alas! Alas" loudly, his followers, afraid of the battle fled from the scene shouting "Save us, O save us'.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयोऽत्र समाख्याताः कीर्त्यमानान्निबोध मे । औत्तमेया ऋषिश्रेष्ठ दश पुत्रा मनोः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo'tra samākhyātāḥ kīrtyamānānnibodha me | auttameyā ṛṣiśreṣṭha daśa putrā manoḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The god Indra and others, eulogised the goddess. The Gandharvas sang songs; the celestial damsels danced,
verses.commentary: Sense: The god Indra and others, eulogised the goddess. The Gandharvas sang songs; the celestial damsels danced,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेन्द्रो विभुनामा च त्रैलोक्याधिपतिस्तथा । रैवताख्यो मनुस्तत्र ज्ञेयस्तामससोदरः
verses.transliteration: tatrendro vibhunāmā ca trailokyādhipatistathā | raivatākhyo manustatra jñeyastāmasasodaraḥ
verses.translation: O king, thus the origin of MahalaksmI has been narrated to you. Now listen to the origin of Sarasvati with a calm mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, thus the origin of MahalaksmI has been narrated to you. Now listen to the origin of Sarasvati with a calm mind.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णेश्च मनोः पुत्रा भविष्या दश शौनक । इहाष्टमं हि कथितं नवमं चान्तरं शृणु
verses.transliteration: sāvarṇeśca manoḥ putrā bhaviṣyā daśa śaunaka | ihāṣṭamaṃ hi kathitaṃ navamaṃ cāntaraṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: The gods aflflicted and harassed by them went to Himalaya and saluted the mother of all living beings, the bestower of all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods aflflicted and harassed by them went to Himalaya and saluted the mother of all living beings, the bestower of all desires.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शतानीको निरामित्रो वृषसेनो जयद्रथः । भूरिद्युम्नः सुवर्चार्चिर्दश त्वेते मनोः सुताः
verses.transliteration: śatānīko nirāmitro vṛṣaseno jayadrathaḥ | bhūridyumnaḥ suvarcārcirdaśa tvete manoḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: O goddess Durga, Victory be to you. O, beloved of your kinsmen, be victorious. Obeisance to you, the cause of the protection of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess Durga, Victory be to you. O, beloved of your kinsmen, be victorious. Obeisance to you, the cause of the protection of the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिराश्चैव धृतिमान् पौलस्त्यो हव्यवांस्तु यः । पौलहस्तत्त्वदर्शी च भार्गवश्च निरुत्सवः
verses.transliteration: aṅgirāścaiva dhṛtimān paulastyo havyavāṃstu yaḥ | paulahastattvadarśī ca bhārgavaśca nirutsavaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the bestower of salvation, obeisance to the great mother, the cause of the creation, sustenance and annihilation of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the bestower of salvation, obeisance to the great mother, the cause of the creation, sustenance and annihilation of the world.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवतानां गणाः प्रोक्ताः शृणु पञ्च महामुने । तुरङ्गभीरुर्बुध्नश्च तनुग्रोऽनुग्र एव च
verses.transliteration: devatānāṃ gaṇāḥ proktāḥ śṛṇu pañca mahāmune | turaṅgabhīrurbudhnaśca tanugro'nugra eva ca
verses.translation: O goddess of the form of Kalika, Tara. Ghinnamasta, Srividya, Obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess of the form of Kalika, Tara. Ghinnamasta, Srividya, Obeisance to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं सर्वं मन्वन्तरसमुद्भवम् । विसर्गं पुण्यमाख्यानं धन्यं कुलविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ manvantarasamudbhavam | visargaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ dhanyaṃ kulavivarddhanam
verses.translation: O goddess of the worlds, of the form of Bhairava, obeisance to you. Obeisance to Bagalamukhi (s tork- faced ). Obeisance, to Dhumavati.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess of the worlds, of the form of Bhairava, obeisance to you. Obeisance to Bagalamukhi (s tork- faced ). Obeisance, to Dhumavati.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतीता वर्तमानाश्च तथैवानागताश्च ये । कीर्तिता मनवश्चापि मयैवैते यथा श्रुताः
verses.transliteration: atītā vartamānāśca tathaivānāgatāśca ye | kīrtitā manavaścāpi mayaivaite yathā śrutāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the goddess vanished. Ganda and Munda — the attendants of Sumbha and Nisumba saw the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the goddess vanished. Ganda and Munda — the attendants of Sumbha and Nisumba saw the goddess.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुने चतुर्दशैतानि त्रिकालानुगतानि ते । प्रोक्तानि निर्मितः कल्पो युगसाहस्रपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: mune caturdaśaitāni trikālānugatāni te | proktāni nirmitaḥ kalpo yugasāhasraparyayaḥ
verses.translation: She has the brilliance of lightning. She wears precious garments. Her breasts are elevated within her bodice. She holds excellent weapons with her eight uplifted arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has the brilliance of lightning. She wears precious garments. Her breasts are elevated within her bodice. She holds excellent weapons with her eight uplifted arms.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषींस्तेषां प्रवक्ष्यामि पुत्त्रान् देवगणांस्तथा । शृणु शौनक सुप्रीत्या क्रमशस्तान्यशस्विनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṃsteṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi puttrān devagaṇāṃstathā | śṛṇu śaunaka suprītyā kramaśastānyaśasvinaḥ
verses.translation: C) messenger, you speak the truth, not the lie. But I have taken a vow that I shall endeavour to make one alone as my husband who can shake off my pride, who can conquer me in the battle. None else.
verses.commentary: Sense: C) messenger, you speak the truth, not the lie. But I have taken a vow that I shall endeavour to make one alone as my husband who can shake off my pride, who can conquer me in the battle. None else.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरत्रिर्भगवानङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः । पुलस्त्यश्च वसिष्ठश्च सप्तैते ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: marīciratrirbhagavānaṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | pulastyaśca vasiṣṭhaśca saptaite brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Hence you convey my words to Sumbha and Niumbha. Let cither do whatever is proper in this matter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence you convey my words to Sumbha and Niumbha. Let cither do whatever is proper in this matter.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश्च मेधा मेधातिथिर्वसुः । ज्योतिष्मान्धृतिमान्हव्यः सवनः शुभ्र एव च
verses.transliteration: āgnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ | jyotiṣmāndhṛtimānhavyaḥ savanaḥ śubhra eva ca
verses.translation: Then a great splendour issued forth from the mouths of the infuriated Visnu and Siva and from the bodies of other gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a great splendour issued forth from the mouths of the infuriated Visnu and Siva and from the bodies of other gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवस्य पुत्रास्ते मनोर्दश महात्मनः । कीर्तिता मुनिशार्दूल तत्रेन्द्रो यज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: svāyambhuvasya putrāste manordaśa mahātmanaḥ | kīrtitā muniśārdūla tatrendro yajña ucyate
verses.translation: The gods who were devoted to meditation on Durga saw the mass of splendour blazing in all the ten directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods who were devoted to meditation on Durga saw the mass of splendour blazing in all the ten directions.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं कथितं तात दिव्यं मन्वतरं तथा । द्वितीयं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ kathitaṃ tāta divyaṃ manvataraṃ tathā | dvitīyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tannibodha yathātatham
verses.translation: That highly terrible splendour issuing forth from the bodies of the gods joined together and became a woman Mahisamardini herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: That highly terrible splendour issuing forth from the bodies of the gods joined together and became a woman Mahisamardini herself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जस्तम्भः परस्तम्भ ऋषभो वसुमांस्तथा । ज्योतिष्मान् द्युतिमांश्चैव रोचिष्मान् सप्तमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ūrjastambhaḥ parastambha ṛṣabho vasumāṃstathā | jyotiṣmān dyutimāṃścaiva rociṣmān saptamastathā
verses.translation: Her dazzlingly brilliant face constituted the splendour of Siva, the hairs the splendour of Yama and the arms the splendour of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her dazzlingly brilliant face constituted the splendour of Siva, the hairs the splendour of Yama and the arms the splendour of Visnu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते महर्षयो ज्ञेयास्तत्रेन्द्रो रोचनस्तथा । देवाश्च तुषिता नाम स्मृताः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: ete maharṣayo jñeyāstatrendro rocanastathā | devāśca tuṣitā nāma smṛtāḥ svārociṣeṃ'tare
verses.translation: Her breasts were formulated by the splendour of the moon; the waist by that of Indra; the calves and thighs by that ol' Varuna; the hips by that of the earth; the feet by that of Brahma; the toes by that of the sun; the fingers by that of Indra; the nose by that of Kubera; the teeth by that of the patriarch; the eyes by that of fire; the eyebrows by that of the dusk; the ears by that of the wind, her other limbs by that of other heaven-dwellers. Thus the goddess manifested herself on the lotus-seat.
verses.wordMeaning: Her breasts were formulated by the splendour of the moon; the waist by that of Indra; the calves and thighs by that ol' Varuna; the hips by that of the earth; the feet by that of Brahma; the toes by that of the sun; the fingers by that of Indra; the nose by that of Kubera;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Her breasts were formulated by the splendour of the moon; the waist by that of Indra; the calves and thighs by that ol' Varuna; the hips by that of the earth; the feet by that of Brahma; the toes by that of the sun; the fingers by that of Indra; the nose by that of Kubera;…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिघ्नः सुकृतिर्ज्योतिरयोमूर्तिरयस्मयः । प्रथितश्च मनस्युश्च नभः सूर्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: harighnaḥ sukṛtirjyotirayomūrtirayasmayaḥ | prathitaśca manasyuśca nabhaḥ sūryastathaiva ca
verses.translation: On seeing her thus formulated by the mass of splendour of the gods, they attained great delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her thus formulated by the mass of splendour of the gods, they attained great delight.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषस्य पुत्रास्ते मनोर्दश महात्मनः । कीर्तिता मुनिशार्दूल महावीर्यपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: svārociṣasya putrāste manordaśa mahātmanaḥ | kīrtitā muniśārdūla mahāvīryaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: Observing that she had no weapons, Brahma and other gods decided to make her fully equipped with weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Observing that she had no weapons, Brahma and other gods decided to make her fully equipped with weapons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयमेतत्कथितं मुने मन्वन्तरं मया । तृतीयं तव वक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyametatkathitaṃ mune manvantaraṃ mayā | tṛtīyaṃ tava vakṣyāmi tannibodha yathātatham
verses.translation: Then lord Siva offered her a spear; Lord Krpa gave her a discus; Varuna conch and noose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Siva offered her a spear; Lord Krpa gave her a discus; Varuna conch and noose.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठपुत्राः सप्तासन्वासिष्ठा इति विश्रुताः । हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुता ऊर्जा नाम महौजसः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaputrāḥ saptāsanvāsiṣṭhā iti viśrutāḥ | hiraṇyagarbhasya sutā ūrjā nāma mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: The fire-god gave her Sakti; the wind-god a bow and a quiver full of arrows; Indra the thunderbolt and a bell; Yama a big staff; Prajapati a garland of beads; Brahma a water-pot and the sun the lustrous hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire-god gave her Sakti; the wind-god a bow and a quiver full of arrows; Indra the thunderbolt and a bell; Yama a big staff; Prajapati a garland of beads; Brahma a water-pot and the sun the lustrous hair.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इष ऊर्जित ऊर्जश्च मधुर्माधव एव च । शुचिः शुक्रवहश्चैव नभसो नभ एव च
verses.transliteration: iṣa ūrjita ūrjaśca madhurmādhava eva ca | śuciḥ śukravahaścaiva nabhaso nabha eva ca
verses.translation: Himavat gave her a lion and gems of various sorts. Kubera a vessel filled with wine. Sesa a Nagahira of wonderful workmanship, studded with various precious gems.
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavat gave her a lion and gems of various sorts. Kubera a vessel filled with wine. Sesa a Nagahira of wonderful workmanship, studded with various precious gems.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभस्तत्र देवाश्च सत्यवेदश्रुतादयः । तत्रेन्द्रः सत्यजिन्नाम त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर्मुने
verses.transliteration: ṛṣabhastatra devāśca satyavedaśrutādayaḥ | tatrendraḥ satyajinnāma trailokyādhipatirmune
verses.translation: Thus honoured, the goddesss with these and other similar objects, ornaments, weapons etc. shouted loudly again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus honoured, the goddesss with these and other similar objects, ornaments, weapons etc. shouted loudly again and again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयमेतत्परमं मन्वतरमुदाहृतम् । मन्वतरं चतुर्थं ते कथयामि मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyametatparamaṃ manvataramudāhṛtam | manvataraṃ caturthaṃ te kathayāmi mune śṛṇu
verses.translation: The four oceans shook and rolled. The earth quaked. Cries of victory were shouted by "the gods harassed by Mahisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four oceans shook and rolled. The earth quaked. Cries of victory were shouted by "the gods harassed by Mahisa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गार्ग्यः पृथुस्तथा वाग्मी जयो धाता कपीनकः । कपीवान् सप्त ऋषयः सत्या देवगणास्तथा
verses.transliteration: gārgyaḥ pṛthustathā vāgmī jayo dhātā kapīnakaḥ | kapīvān sapta ṛṣayaḥ satyā devagaṇāstathā
verses.translation: Then the gods eulogised the great Sakti, Ambika in the form of MahalaksmI with words choked with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gods eulogised the great Sakti, Ambika in the form of MahalaksmI with words choked with devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेन्द्रस्त्रिशिखो ज्ञेयो मनुपुत्रान्मुने शृणु । द्यूतिपोतः सौतपस्यस्तपः शूलश्च तापनः
verses.transliteration: tatrendrastriśikho jñeyo manuputrānmune śṛṇu | dyūtipotaḥ sautapasyastapaḥ śūlaśca tāpanaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the world agitated, the enemies of the gods got up with uplifted arms and with their armies ready for war.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the world agitated, the enemies of the gods got up with uplifted arms and with their armies ready for war.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपोरतिरकल्माषो धन्वी खड्गी महानृषिः । तामसस्य स्मृता एते दश पुत्रा महाव्रताः
verses.transliteration: taporatirakalmāṣo dhanvī khaḍgī mahānṛṣiḥ | tāmasasya smṛtā ete daśa putrā mahāvratāḥ
verses.translation: The infuriated Mahisa rushed at the direction of the sound and saw the goddess who had pervaded the three worlds with her beautiful lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated Mahisa rushed at the direction of the sound and saw the goddess who had pervaded the three worlds with her beautiful lustre.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तामसस्यान्तरं चैव मनोर्मे कथितं तव । चतुर्थं पञ्चमं तात शृणु मन्वन्तरं परम्
verses.transliteration: tāmasasyāntaraṃ caiva manorme kathitaṃ tava | caturthaṃ pañcamaṃ tāta śṛṇu manvantaraṃ param
verses.translation: In the meantime, crores of great heroes led by Mahisasura came there with weapons..
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, crores of great heroes led by Mahisasura came there with weapons..
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवबाहुर्जयश्चैव मुनिर्वेदशिरास्तथा । हिरण्यरोमा पर्जन्य ऊर्ध्वबाहुश्च सोमपाः
verses.transliteration: devabāhurjayaścaiva munirvedaśirāstathā | hiraṇyaromā parjanya ūrdhvabāhuśca somapāḥ
verses.translation: Ciksura, Camara, Udagra, Karala, Uddhafa, Bakala; Tamra, Ugrasya, Ugravirya, Bidala, Andhaka, Durdhara, Durmukha, Trinetra Mahahanu — these and many others, heroic and efficient in battle, came there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ciksura, Camara, Udagra, Karala, Uddhafa, Bakala; Tamra, Ugrasya, Ugravirya, Bidala, Andhaka, Durdhara, Durmukha, Trinetra Mahahanu — these and many others, heroic and efficient in battle, came there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यनेत्ररताश्चान्ये एते सप्तर्षयोऽपरे । देवाश्च भूतरजसस्तपःप्रकृतयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: satyanetraratāścānye ete saptarṣayo'pare | devāśca bhūtarajasastapaḥprakṛtayastathā
verses.translation: As they, the masters of weapons and missiles,
verses.commentary: Sense: As they, the masters of weapons and missiles,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनः पङ्क्तिविन्ध्यो वा दयायास्तनयामुने । महता तपसा युक्ता मेरुपृष्ठे वसन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: arjunaḥ paṅktivindhyo vā dayāyāstanayāmune | mahatā tapasā yuktā merupṛṣṭhe vasanti hi
verses.translation: Then the goddess hit and struck the hosts of enemies Gik$ura and others with her club, arrows, spear, iSakti and axe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the goddess hit and struck the hosts of enemies Gik$ura and others with her club, arrows, spear, iSakti and axe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रुचेः प्रजापतिः पुत्रो रौच्यो नाम मनुः स्मृतः । भूत्या चोत्पादितो देव्यां भौत्यो नामाभवत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: ruceḥ prajāpatiḥ putro raucyo nāma manuḥ smṛtaḥ | bhūtyā cotpādito devyāṃ bhautyo nāmābhavatsutaḥ
verses.translation: When his armies fell the demon Mahisa struggled with the hosts of soldiers that issued from the breath of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: When his armies fell the demon Mahisa struggled with the hosts of soldiers that issued from the breath of the goddess.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनागताश्च सप्तैते कल्पेऽस्मिन् मनवः स्मृताः । अनागताश्च सप्तैव स्मृता दिवि महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: anāgatāśca saptaite kalpe'smin manavaḥ smṛtāḥ | anāgatāśca saptaiva smṛtā divi maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: He kicked some with the hoofs, hit some with the horns and others with his tail and snout.
verses.commentary: Sense: He kicked some with the hoofs, hit some with the horns and others with his tail and snout.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपोऽत्रिर्वसिष्टश्च विश्वामित्रोऽथ गौतमः । जमदग्नीभरद्वाजः सत्रैते ॠष्यः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kaśyapo'trirvasiṣṭaśca viśvāmitro'tha gautamaḥ | jamadagnībharadvājaḥ satraite ṝṣyaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: After slaying the Ganas the chief of Asuras rushed at the lion of the goddess in order to kill it. Then she be¬ came wrathful.
verses.commentary: Sense: After slaying the Ganas the chief of Asuras rushed at the lion of the goddess in order to kill it. Then she be¬ came wrathful.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रामो व्यासस्तथात्रेयो दीप्तिमान्सुबहुश्रुतः । भरद्वाजस्तथा द्रौणिरश्वत्थामा महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: rāmo vyāsastathātreyo dīptimānsubahuśrutaḥ | bharadvājastathā drauṇiraśvatthāmā mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: He of great virility thrashed the ground with his hoofs, uprooted a mountain with his horns, hurled it and shouted.
verses.commentary: Sense: He of great virility thrashed the ground with his hoofs, uprooted a mountain with his horns, hurled it and shouted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्यात्मजश्चैव शरद्वान् गौतमः कृपः । कौशिको गालवश्चैव रुरुः कश्यप एव च
verses.transliteration: gautamasyātmajaścaiva śaradvān gautamaḥ kṛpaḥ | kauśiko gālavaścaiva ruruḥ kaśyapa eva ca
verses.translation: O excellent king, heavy mountains hurled by him as he rushed all round fell in the battle-ground from the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, heavy mountains hurled by him as he rushed all round fell in the battle-ground from the sky.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त महात्मानो भविष्या मुनिसत्तमाः । देवाश्चानागतास्तत्र त्रयः प्रोक्ताः स्वयम्भुवा
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mahātmāno bhaviṣyā munisattamāḥ | devāścānāgatāstatra trayaḥ proktāḥ svayambhuvā
verses.translation: Clouds split by his horns were shattered to pieces. The ocean struck at with his tail throbbed and splashed water beyond the shores all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: Clouds split by his horns were shattered to pieces. The ocean struck at with his tail throbbed and splashed water beyond the shores all round.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मारीचेश्चैव पुत्रास्ते कश्यपस्य महात्मनः । तेषां विरोचनसुतो बलिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: mārīceścaiva putrāste kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ | teṣāṃ virocanasuto balirindro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On seeing the demon Mahisa thus infuriated, Ambika, the protectress of the gods, became ready to kill him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the demon Mahisa thus infuriated, Ambika, the protectress of the gods, became ready to kill him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विषांङ्गश्चावनीवांश्च सुमन्तो धृतिमान्वसुः । सूरिः सुराख्यो विष्णुश्च राजा सुमतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: viṣāṃṅgaścāvanīvāṃśca sumanto dhṛtimānvasuḥ | sūriḥ surākhyo viṣṇuśca rājā sumatireva ca
verses.translation: She took up a noose and hurled it at him. She bound the Asura Mahisa. Then the demon abandoned his assumed guise.
verses.commentary: Sense: She took up a noose and hurled it at him. She bound the Asura Mahisa. Then the demon abandoned his assumed guise.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं दक्षसावर्णि प्रवक्ष्यामि मनुं शृणु । मेधातिथिश्च पौलस्त्यो वसुः कश्यप एव च
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ dakṣasāvarṇi pravakṣyāmi manuṃ śṛṇu | medhātithiśca paulastyo vasuḥ kaśyapa eva ca
verses.translation: She then struck him with the arrows, as he stood there with the sword and shield. He then became an elephant and struck at the lion with his trnk.
verses.commentary: Sense: She then struck him with the arrows, as he stood there with the sword and shield. He then became an elephant and struck at the lion with his trnk.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मान् भार्गवश्चैव धृतिमानङ्गिरास्तथा । सवनश्चैव वासिष्ठ आत्रेयो हव्य एव च
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmān bhārgavaścaiva dhṛtimānaṅgirāstathā | savanaścaiva vāsiṣṭha ātreyo havya eva ca
verses.translation: The goddess cut off his hand with her sword. The ucmon then assumed his original form.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess cut off his hand with her sword. The ucmon then assumed his original form.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुलहः सप्त इत्येते ऋषयो रौहितेऽन्तरे । देवतानां गणास्तत्र त्रय एव महामुने
verses.transliteration: pulahaḥ sapta ityete ṛṣayo rauhite'ntare | devatānāṃ gaṇāstatra traya eva mahāmune
verses.translation: He then agitated three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings. Then, Candika of great honour and exploit became infuriated.
verses.commentary: Sense: He then agitated three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings. Then, Candika of great honour and exploit became infuriated.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षपुत्रस्य पुत्रास्ते रोहितस्य प्रजापतेः । धृष्टकेतुर्दीप्तकेतुः पञ्चहस्तो निराकृतिः
verses.transliteration: dakṣaputrasya putrāste rohitasya prajāpateḥ | dhṛṣṭaketurdīptaketuḥ pañcahasto nirākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: She drank the beverage again and again. With eyes rolliug she laughed aloud. The haughty Asura too, proud of his strength and exploit, roared.
verses.commentary: Sense: She drank the beverage again and again. With eyes rolliug she laughed aloud. The haughty Asura too, proud of his strength and exploit, roared.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथुश्रवा भूरिद्युम्नो ऋचीको बृहतो गयः । प्रथमस्य तु सावर्णेर्नव पुत्रा महौजसः
verses.transliteration: pṛthuśravā bhūridyumno ṛcīko bṛhato gayaḥ | prathamasya tu sāvarṇernava putrā mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: He uprooted the mountains and hurled them at her. She too reduced them to powder and struck them with arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: He uprooted the mountains and hurled them at her. She too reduced them to powder and struck them with arrows.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशमे त्वथ पर्याये द्वितीयस्यान्तरे मनोः । हविष्मान् पौलहश्चैव प्रकृतिश्चैव भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: daśame tvatha paryāye dvitīyasyāntare manoḥ | haviṣmān paulahaścaiva prakṛtiścaiva bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: With her face reddened as a result of the inebria¬ tion after drinking wine, and with her scn-scs excited, she spoke in a tone as majestic as the rumbling of the clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her face reddened as a result of the inebria¬ tion after drinking wine, and with her scn-scs excited, she spoke in a tone as majestic as the rumbling of the clouds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपोमुक्तिस्तथात्रेयो वासिष्ठश्चाव्ययः स्मृतः । पौलस्त्यः प्रयतिश्चैव भामारश्चैव काश्यपः
verses.transliteration: āpomuktistathātreyo vāsiṣṭhaścāvyayaḥ smṛtaḥ | paulastyaḥ prayatiścaiva bhāmāraścaiva kāśyapaḥ
verses.translation: "O stupid fellow, O demon of ruined intellect, why are you stubborn in vain? None of the Asuras in the three worlds can stand before me".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O stupid fellow, O demon of ruined intellect, why are you stubborn in vain? None of the Asuras in the three worlds can stand before me".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरानेनसः सत्यः सप्तैते परमर्षयः । देवतानां गणाश्चापि द्विषिमन्तश्च ये स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: aṅgirānenasaḥ satyaḥ saptaite paramarṣayaḥ | devatānāṃ gaṇāścāpi dviṣimantaśca ye smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Thus saying the goddess pounced on him, stamped on his neck and pierced him with her fierce spear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus saying the goddess pounced on him, stamped on his neck and pierced him with her fierce spear.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषामिन्द्रः स्मृतः शम्भुस्त्वयमेव महेश्वरः । अक्षत्वानुत्तमौजाश्च भूरिषेणश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: teṣāmindraḥ smṛtaḥ śambhustvayameva maheśvaraḥ | akṣatvānuttamaujāśca bhūriṣeṇaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: Pressed with her foot and overwhelmed by her might the Asura seemed as good as half dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pressed with her foot and overwhelmed by her might the Asura seemed as good as half dead.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकादशे तु पर्याये तृतीयस्यान्तरे मनोः । तस्यापि सप्त ऋषयः कीर्त्यमानान्निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: ekādaśe tu paryāye tṛtīyasyāntare manoḥ | tasyāpi sapta ṛṣayaḥ kīrtyamānānnibodha me
verses.translation: Obeisance to Tripurasundari, to Matahgi, to Ajita (the unconquered) and to Vijaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Tripurasundari, to Matahgi, to Ajita (the unconquered) and to Vijaya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हविष्मान् कश्यपश्चापि वपुष्मांश्चैव वारुणः । आत्रेयोऽथ वसिष्ठश्च ह्यनयस्त्वङ्गिरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: haviṣmān kaśyapaścāpi vapuṣmāṃścaiva vāruṇaḥ | ātreyo'tha vasiṣṭhaśca hyanayastvaṅgirāstathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to Jaya, Mahgala Vilasini, to you of the form of milking maid and of terrible form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Jaya, Mahgala Vilasini, to you of the form of milking maid and of terrible form.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चारुधृष्यश्च पौलस्त्यो निःस्वरोऽग्निस्तु तैजसः । सप्तैते ऋषयः प्रोक्तास्त्रयो देवगणाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: cārudhṛṣyaśca paulastyo niḥsvaro'gnistu taijasaḥ | saptaite ṛṣayaḥ proktāstrayo devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O goddess, of the form of the unconquered, of permanent form, the protectress of those who seek refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, O goddess, of the form of the unconquered, of permanent form, the protectress of those who seek refuge in you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्तु सुतास्ते हि त इमे वैधृताः स्मृताः । सर्वगश्च सुशर्मा च देवानीकस्तु क्षेमकः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇastu sutāste hi ta ime vaidhṛtāḥ smṛtāḥ | sarvagaśca suśarmā ca devānīkastu kṣemakaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the one knowable through Vedanta; obeisance to you the great soul, the heroine of infinite worlds of this universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the one knowable through Vedanta; obeisance to you the great soul, the heroine of infinite worlds of this universe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दृढेषुः खण्डको दर्शः कुहुर्बाहुर्मनोः स्मृताः । सावर्णस्य तु पुत्रा वै तृतीयस्य नव स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: dṛḍheṣuḥ khaṇḍako darśaḥ kuhurbāhurmanoḥ smṛtāḥ | sāvarṇasya tu putrā vai tṛtīyasya nava smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Eulogised thus by the gods the delighted goddess the bestower of boons, spoke, to the gods — "Who is being eulogised by you here?*'
verses.commentary: Sense: Eulogised thus by the gods the delighted goddess the bestower of boons, spoke, to the gods — "Who is being eulogised by you here?*'
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थस्य तु सावर्णेरृषीन्सप्त निबोध मे । द्युतिर्वसिष्ठपुत्रश्च आत्रेयः सुतपास्तथा
