verses.transliteration: caturthasya tu sāvarṇerṛṣīnsapta nibodha me | dyutirvasiṣṭhaputraśca ātreyaḥ sutapāstathā
verses.translation: Then a virgin came out of the body of the goddess. Even as they were winking she spoke to the goddess with great reverence. '
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a virgin came out of the body of the goddess. Even as they were winking she spoke to the goddess with great reverence. '
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरास्तपसो मूर्तिस्तपस्वी कश्यपस्तथा । तपोधनश्च पौलस्त्यः पुलहश्च तपोरतिः
verses.transliteration: aṅgirāstapaso mūrtistapasvī kaśyapastathā | tapodhanaśca paulastyaḥ pulahaśca taporatiḥ
verses.translation: **0 mother, this eulogy is addressed to me by the heaven-dwellers harassed by the powerful Daityas!§umbha and Nisumbha."
verses.commentary: Sense: **0 mother, this eulogy is addressed to me by the heaven-dwellers harassed by the powerful Daityas!§umbha and Nisumbha."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवः सप्तमस्तेषां विज्ञेयः तपसो निधिः । पञ्च देवगणाः प्रोक्ता मानसा ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: bhārgavaḥ saptamasteṣāṃ vijñeyaḥ tapaso nidhiḥ | pañca devagaṇāḥ proktā mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Since she emerged out of the inner vestures of her body she is called KauSikl. The destroyer of the Asura Sumbha is being sung in that name.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since she emerged out of the inner vestures of her body she is called KauSikl. The destroyer of the Asura Sumbha is being sung in that name.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋतधामा तदिन्द्रो हि त्रिलोकी राज्यकृत्सुखी । द्वादशे चैव पर्याये भाव्ये रौच्यान्तरे मुने
verses.transliteration: ṛtadhāmā tadindro hi trilokī rājyakṛtsukhī | dvādaśe caiva paryāye bhāvye raucyāntare mune
verses.translation: She addressed the gods — "All of you stay here fearlessly. I shall carry out your task without any strain.
verses.commentary: Sense: She addressed the gods — "All of you stay here fearlessly. I shall carry out your task without any strain.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निष्प्रपञ्चस्तथात्रेयो निर्देहः कश्यपस्तथा । सुतपाश्चैव वासिष्ठः सप्तैवैते महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: niṣprapañcastathātreyo nirdehaḥ kaśyapastathā | sutapāścaiva vāsiṣṭhaḥ saptaivaite maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her beautiful form pleasing to the eyes they were fascinated. They lost their consciousness and fell on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her beautiful form pleasing to the eyes they were fascinated. They lost their consciousness and fell on the ground.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रय एव गणाः प्रोक्ता देवतानां स्वयम्भुवा । दिवस्पतिस्तमिन्द्रो वै विचित्रश्चित्र एव च
verses.transliteration: traya eva gaṇāḥ proktā devatānāṃ svayambhuvā | divaspatistamindro vai vicitraścitra eva ca
verses.translation: Returning to their king they narrated the details to him "O king, a certain beautiful lady hitherto unseen has been seen by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Returning to their king they narrated the details to him "O king, a certain beautiful lady hitherto unseen has been seen by us.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नयो धर्मो धृतोन्ध्रश्च सुनेत्रः क्षत्रवृद्धकः । निर्भयः सुतपा द्रोणो मनो रौच्यस्य ते सुताः
verses.transliteration: nayo dharmo dhṛtondhraśca sunetraḥ kṣatravṛddhakaḥ | nirbhayaḥ sutapā droṇo mano raucyasya te sutāḥ
verses.translation: Seated on a lion, on the beautiful peak of the Himavat she was served by the virgins of the gods with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated on a lion, on the beautiful peak of the Himavat she was served by the virgins of the gods with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनुस्त्रयोदशो भाव्यो देवसावर्णिरात्मवान् चित्रसेनविचित्राद्या देवसावर्णिदेहजाः
verses.transliteration: manustrayodaśo bhāvyo devasāvarṇirātmavān citrasenavicitrādyā devasāvarṇidehajāḥ
verses.translation: They massaged her feet and hands, decorated her tresses, and applied collyrium to her eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: They massaged her feet and hands, decorated her tresses, and applied collyrium to her eyes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सुकर्मसुत्रामसंज्ञा इन्द्रो दिवस्पतिः निर्मोकतत्त्वदर्शाद्या भविष्यन्त्युषयस्तदा
verses.transliteration: devāḥ sukarmasutrāmasaṃjñā indro divaspatiḥ nirmokatattvadarśādyā bhaviṣyantyuṣayastadā
verses.translation: A certain damsel held out the mirror to her face. Another handed over the betel-leaf along with cloves and cardamom.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain damsel held out the mirror to her face. Another handed over the betel-leaf along with cloves and cardamom.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशे तु पर्याये भौत्यस्यैवान्तरे मनोः । आग्नीध्रः काश्यपश्चैव पौलस्त्यो मागधश्च यः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśe tu paryāye bhautyasyaivāntare manoḥ | āgnīdhraḥ kāśyapaścaiva paulastyo māgadhaśca yaḥ
verses.translation: Some picked up the fallen dice and stood in front of her. Some bedecked her body with ornaments and clothes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some picked up the fallen dice and stood in front of her. Some bedecked her body with ornaments and clothes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवोऽप्यतिवाह्यश्च शुचिराङ्गिरसस्तथा । युक्तश्चैव तथात्रेयः शुक्रो वाशिष्ठ एव च
verses.transliteration: bhārgavo'pyativāhyaśca śucirāṅgirasastathā | yuktaścaiva tathātreyaḥ śukro vāśiṣṭha eva ca
verses.translation: Her calves and thighs are like the stem of the plantain tree. Her nose is like that of a parrot. Her arms are like serpents and creepers. She wears a beautiful girdle. The anklets round her feet are jingling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her calves and thighs are like the stem of the plantain tree. Her nose is like that of a parrot. Her arms are like serpents and creepers. She wears a beautiful girdle. The anklets round her feet are jingling.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजितः पुलहश्चैव ह्यन्त्याः सप्तर्षयश्च ते । पवित्राश्चाक्षुषा देवाः शुचिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: ajitaḥ pulahaścaiva hyantyāḥ saptarṣayaśca te | pavitrāścākṣuṣā devāḥ śucirindro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Pearl necklaces heave over her breasts rendered fragrant with the musk. Necklaces shine round her neck. She was sporting about bedecked in chaplets.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pearl necklaces heave over her breasts rendered fragrant with the musk. Necklaces shine round her neck. She was sporting about bedecked in chaplets.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां कल्य उत्थाय कीर्तनात्सुखमेधते । अतीतानागतानां वै महर्षीणां नरैः सदा
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ kalya utthāya kīrtanātsukhamedhate | atītānāgatānāṃ vai maharṣīṇāṃ naraiḥ sadā
verses.translation: She has semi-circular marks on her forehead. She wears ear-rings set with gems. Her plaited hair arc pretty. The wide three eyes bedeck her face.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has semi-circular marks on her forehead. She wears ear-rings set with gems. Her plaited hair arc pretty. The wide three eyes bedeck her face.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतिमानी प्रवीणश्च विष्णुः सङ्क्रन्दनस्तथा । तेजस्वी सबलश्चैव भौत्यस्त्वेते मनोः सुता
verses.transliteration: atimānī pravīṇaśca viṣṇuḥ saṅkrandanastathā | tejasvī sabalaścaiva bhautyastvete manoḥ sutā
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Ganda and Munda that great demon Sumbha sent a messenger Sugriva to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Ganda and Munda that great demon Sumbha sent a messenger Sugriva to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भूयोऽपि भगवान् रुद्रः संहर्ता काल एव हि । कल्पान्ते तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य वै
verses.transliteration: bhūyo'pi bhagavān rudraḥ saṃhartā kāla eva hi | kalpānte tatpravakṣyāmi manorvaivasvatasya vai
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Ganda and Munda that great demon Sumbha sent a messenger Sugriva to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Ganda and Munda that great demon Sumbha sent a messenger Sugriva to her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भौमस्यैवाधिकारे वै पूर्णे कल्पस्तु पूर्यते । इत्येतेऽनागतातीता मनवः कीर्तिता मया
verses.transliteration: bhaumasyaivādhikāre vai pūrṇe kalpastu pūryate | ityete'nāgatātītā manavaḥ kīrtitā mayā
verses.translation: "O messenger, there is a certain beautiful lady on the snow-capped mountain. Mentioning these words of mine she shall be strenuously brought here'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O messenger, there is a certain beautiful lady on the snow-capped mountain. Mentioning these words of mine she shall be strenuously brought here'*.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उक्ताः सनत्कुमारेण व्यासायामिततेजसा । पूर्णे युगसहस्रान्ते परिपाल्य स्वधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: uktāḥ sanatkumāreṇa vyāsāyāmitatejasā | pūrṇe yugasahasrānte paripālya svadharmataḥ
verses.translation: Thus urged by him, the exccllant Danava Sugriva went to Himacala and spoke to the great goddess, the mother of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus urged by him, the exccllant Danava Sugriva went to Himacala and spoke to the great goddess, the mother of the universe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाभिस्तपसा युक्ता ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजन्ति ते । युगानि सप्रतिस्त्वेकं साग्राण्यन्तरमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: prajābhistapasā yuktā brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te | yugāni sapratistvekaṃ sāgrāṇyantaramucyate
verses.translation: O gentle lady, the Daitya Sumbha and his brother Nisumbha are very strong and valorous. They are famous in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, the Daitya Sumbha and his brother Nisumbha are very strong and valorous. They are famous in the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशैते मनवः कीर्तिताः कीर्तिवर्धनाः । मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु संहारान्ते पुनर्भवः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśaite manavaḥ kīrtitāḥ kīrtivardhanāḥ | manvantareṣu sarveṣu saṃhārānte punarbhavaḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, I am a messenger of Kumbha. I have come with his message to which you will listen please.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, I am a messenger of Kumbha. I have come with his message to which you will listen please.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यमन्तरं तेषां वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि । पूर्णे शतसहस्रे तु कल्पो निःशेष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: na śakyamantaraṃ teṣāṃ vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi | pūrṇe śatasahasre tu kalpo niḥśeṣa ucyate
verses.translation: "I have defeated Indra aud others in the battle and taken away their jewels. I enjoy the share of the gods offered to them in the sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I have defeated Indra aud others in the battle and taken away their jewels. I enjoy the share of the gods offered to them in the sacrifices.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वाणि भूतानि दग्धान्यादित्यरश्मिभिः । ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा सदादित्यगणैर्मुने
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvāṇi bhūtāni dagdhānyādityaraśmibhiḥ | brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā sadādityagaṇairmune
verses.translation: You are a jewel among women, more precious than ether jewels. Resort to me or to my younger brothet* exhibiting your loving emotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are a jewel among women, more precious than ether jewels. Resort to me or to my younger brothet* exhibiting your loving emotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठ हरिं नारायणं परम् । स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां कल्पान्तेषु पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: praviśanti suraśreṣṭha hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param | sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kalpānteṣu punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the message of iSumbha conveyed by the messenger the Mahamaya, the beloved consort of Siva, spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the message of iSumbha conveyed by the messenger the Mahamaya, the beloved consort of Siva, spoke.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ५.३५ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5.35 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the report of the messenger lumbha of stern rule angrily said to Dhumraksa, the foremost of his generals.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the report of the messenger lumbha of stern rule angrily said to Dhumraksa, the foremost of his generals.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the report of the messenger lumbha of stern rule angrily said to Dhumraksa, the foremost of his generals.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the report of the messenger lumbha of stern rule angrily said to Dhumraksa, the foremost of his generals.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३५. पचत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । मन्वन्तरकीर्तने वैवस्वतवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । विवस्वान् कश्यपाज्जज्ञे दाक्षायण्यां महाऋषेः । तस्य भार्याभवत्संज्ञा त्वाष्ट्री देवी सुरेणुका
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.35. pacatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | manvantarakīrtane vaivasvatavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | vivasvān kaśyapājjajñe dākṣāyaṇyāṃ mahāṛṣeḥ | tasya bhāryābhavatsaṃjñā tvāṣṭrī devī sureṇukā
verses.translation: O Dhumraksa, there is a beautiful lady on the snow-capped Himalaya mountain. Go quickly and fetch her here. O excellent Asura, do not be afraid of this expedition. If she wishes to fight, you shall fight strenuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Dhumraksa, there is a beautiful lady on the snow-capped Himalaya mountain. Go quickly and fetch her here. O excellent Asura, do not be afraid of this expedition. If she wishes to fight, you shall fight strenuously.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुनेऽसहिष्णुना तेन तेजसा दुस्सहेन च । भर्तृरूपेण नातुष्यद्रूपयौवनशालिनी
verses.transliteration: mune'sahiṣṇunā tena tejasā dussahena ca | bhartṛrūpeṇa nātuṣyadrūpayauvanaśālinī
verses.translation: Lord Siva, the great Brahman, the eternal god is without a second. Even the Vedas do not understand his reality. What then of Visnu and others?
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva, the great Brahman, the eternal god is without a second. Even the Vedas do not understand his reality. What then of Visnu and others?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य हि तद्रूपमसहिष्णुः सुतेजसः । दह्यमाना तदोद्वेगमकरोद्वरवर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: ādityasya hi tadrūpamasahiṣṇuḥ sutejasaḥ | dahyamānā tadodvegamakarodvaravarṇinī
verses.translation: O king, on hearing that the leading Daityas had been killed, the great Asura of commendable valour ordered his invincible followers who were thrilled at the very mention of the war.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, on hearing that the leading Daityas had been killed, the great Asura of commendable valour ordered his invincible followers who were thrilled at the very mention of the war.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषेऽस्यां त्रीण्यपत्यानि जनयामास भास्करः । संज्ञायां तु मनुः पूर्वं श्राद्धदेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣe'syāṃ trīṇyapatyāni janayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ | saṃjñāyāṃ tu manuḥ pūrvaṃ śrāddhadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Neighing horses hailing from exalted lands, with big ornaments round their necks, expert in the knowledge of their gaits planted their legs on the heads of elephants and flew like birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neighing horses hailing from exalted lands, with big ornaments round their necks, expert in the knowledge of their gaits planted their legs on the heads of elephants and flew like birds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यमश्च यमुना चैव यमलौ सम्बभूवतुः । एवं हि त्रीण्यपत्यानि तस्यां जातानि सूर्यतः
verses.transliteration: yamaśca yamunā caiva yamalau sambabhūvatuḥ | evaṃ hi trīṇyapatyāni tasyāṃ jātāni sūryataḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus the great Asura became silent. Ganiika spoke to him — "O foolish Asura, why do you prattle in vain? Either fight or else return to Patala.*
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus the great Asura became silent. Ganiika spoke to him — "O foolish Asura, why do you prattle in vain? Either fight or else return to Patala.*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: छायोवाच । आकेशग्रहणाद्देवि सहिष्येऽहं सुदुष्कृतम् । नाख्यास्यामि मतं तुभ्यं गच्छ देवि यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: chāyovāca | ākeśagrahaṇāddevi sahiṣye'haṃ suduṣkṛtam | nākhyāsyāmi mataṃ tubhyaṃ gaccha devi yathāsukham
verses.translation: The heroic demon, becoming infuriated, made a wonderful shower of arrows on the battle-field just as masses of clouds shower water during rains.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic demon, becoming infuriated, made a wonderful shower of arrows on the battle-field just as masses of clouds shower water during rains.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शप्तोऽहमस्मि देवेश जनन्या तपतांवर । तव प्रसादाच्चरणो न पतेन्मम गोपते
verses.transliteration: śapto'hamasmi deveśa jananyā tapatāṃvara | tava prasādāccaraṇo na patenmama gopate
verses.translation: Along with his arrogant followers the demon fought with sharp wxapons as spears, axes, iron clubs,
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with his arrogant followers the demon fought with sharp wxapons as spears, axes, iron clubs,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रूपं निवर्तयाम्यद्य तव कान्तं करोम्यहम् । सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वापगतः क्रोधो मार्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ nivartayāmyadya tava kāntaṃ karomyaham | sūta uvāca | tacchrutvāpagataḥ krodho mārtaṇḍasya vivasvataḥ
verses.translation: In that war great elephants looking like black mountains with foreheads pierced ran here and there. Tlie banners of Sumbha and Nisumbha white like flying cranes fluttered here and there.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that war great elephants looking like black mountains with foreheads pierced ran here and there. Tlie banners of Sumbha and Nisumbha white like flying cranes fluttered here and there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनुः प्रजापतिस्त्वासीत्सावर्णिः स तपोधनः । भाव्यः स कर्मणा तेन मनोः सावर्णिकेऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: manuḥ prajāpatistvāsītsāvarṇiḥ sa tapodhanaḥ | bhāvyaḥ sa karmaṇā tena manoḥ sāvarṇike'ntare
verses.translation: The demons were shattered by Kalika like fishes. The dreadful horses were beheaded and killed in the battle. The other demons were devoured by the lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The demons were shattered by Kalika like fishes. The dreadful horses were beheaded and killed in the battle. The other demons were devoured by the lion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तुलं तु तद्रूपं दृष्ट्वा संज्ञा विवस्वतः । असहन्ती ततश्छायामात्मनः सासृजच्छुभाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvartulaṃ tu tadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjñā vivasvataḥ | asahantī tataśchāyāmātmanaḥ sāsṛjacchubhām
verses.translation: In the battlefield streams of blood flowed. The dead soldiers floated. Their tresses of hair resembled the moss. Their upper cloths resembled the white foam.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the battlefield streams of blood flowed. The dead soldiers floated. Their tresses of hair resembled the moss. Their upper cloths resembled the white foam.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मायामयी तु सा संज्ञामवोचद्भक्तितः सुभे । किं करोमीह कार्यं ते कथयस्व शुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: māyāmayī tu sā saṃjñāmavocadbhaktitaḥ subhe | kiṃ karomīha kāryaṃ te kathayasva śucismite
verses.translation: A great fight ensued where soldiers of equal rank fought with one another. The cavalrymen fought their counterpart; the elephant-riders with those on elephants: the charioteers with those on chariots and the footsoldicrs with footsoldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great fight ensued where soldiers of equal rank fought with one another. The cavalrymen fought their counterpart; the elephant-riders with those on elephants: the charioteers with those on chariots and the footsoldicrs with footsoldiers.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञोवाच अहं यास्यामि भद्रं ते ममैव भवनं पितुः । त्वयैतद्भवने सत्यं वस्तव्यं निर्विकारतः
verses.transliteration: saṃjñovāca ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhadraṃ te mamaiva bhavanaṃ pituḥ | tvayaitadbhavane satyaṃ vastavyaṃ nirvikārataḥ
verses.translation: Then Nisumbha thought to himself — "A terrible period has set in now. Even a poor man may become rich and rich man poor if the time is adverse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Nisumbha thought to himself — "A terrible period has set in now. Even a poor man may become rich and rich man poor if the time is adverse.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इमौ मे बालकौ साधू कन्या चेयं सुमध्यमा । पालनीयाः सुखेनैव मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: imau me bālakau sādhū kanyā ceyaṃ sumadhyamā | pālanīyāḥ sukhenaiva mama cedicchasi priyam
verses.translation: A senseless fellow may become intelligent and an intelligent man dull. A wicked man may be praised by the noble. The great and the powerful may be vanquished. The weak may come out victorious in the war.
verses.commentary: Sense: A senseless fellow may become intelligent and an intelligent man dull. A wicked man may be praised by the noble. The great and the powerful may be vanquished. The weak may come out victorious in the war.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ता साऽगमद्देवी व्रीडिता सन्निधौ पितुः । पित्रा निर्भर्त्सिता तत्र नियुक्ता सा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktā sā'gamaddevī vrīḍitā sannidhau pituḥ | pitrā nirbhartsitā tatra niyuktā sā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus directed the Daitya Dhumraksa went to Himalaya and spoke to the goddess who was a part of Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus directed the Daitya Dhumraksa went to Himalaya and spoke to the goddess who was a part of Uma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अगच्छद्वडवा भूत्वाच्छाद्य रूपं ततः स्वकम् । कुरुंस्तदोत्तरान् प्राप्य नृणान्येव चचार ह
verses.transliteration: agacchadvaḍavā bhūtvācchādya rūpaṃ tataḥ svakam | kuruṃstadottarān prāpya nṛṇānyeva cacāra ha
verses.translation: "O lady, approach my lord. Otherwise I shall kill you. I am accompanied by sixtythousand Asuras"
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lady, approach my lord. Otherwise I shall kill you. I am accompanied by sixtythousand Asuras"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञां तां तु रविर्मत्वा छायायां सुसुतं तदा । जनयामास सावर्णिं मनुं वै सविता किल
verses.transliteration: saṃjñāṃ tāṃ tu ravirmatvā chāyāyāṃ susutaṃ tadā | janayāmāsa sāvarṇiṃ manuṃ vai savitā kila
verses.translation: "O hero, you are commissioned by the king <if Daityas. If you kill rnc what can I do for you? But I consider it impoisiblc to go without a fight."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O hero, you are commissioned by the king <if Daityas. If you kill rnc what can I do for you? But I consider it impoisiblc to go without a fight."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञानु प्रार्थिता छाया सा स्वपुत्रेऽपि नित्यशः । चकाराभ्यधिकं स्नेहं न तथा पूर्वजे सुते
verses.transliteration: saṃjñānu prārthitā chāyā sā svaputre'pi nityaśaḥ | cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ na tathā pūrvaje sute
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the Danava Dhumraksa rushed at her but was burnt with a mere Hunkara uttered by her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the Danava Dhumraksa rushed at her but was burnt with a mere Hunkara uttered by her.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनुस्तस्याक्षमत्तं यमस्तं नैव चक्षमे । स सरोषस्तु बाल्याच्च भाविनोऽर्थस्य गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: manustasyākṣamattaṃ yamastaṃ naiva cakṣame | sa saroṣastu bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya gauravāt
verses.translation: He sent the Asuras-Ca, Munda and Raktabija in order. The Daityas, thus ordered, went to the spot where Ambika was stationed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He sent the Asuras-Ca, Munda and Raktabija in order. The Daityas, thus ordered, went to the spot where Ambika was stationed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: छायां सन्तर्जयामास पदा वैवस्वतो यमः । तं शशाप ततः क्रोधाच्छाया तु कलुषीकृता
verses.transliteration: chāyāṃ santarjayāmāsa padā vaivasvato yamaḥ | taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ krodhācchāyā tu kaluṣīkṛtā
verses.translation: On seeing the goddess seated on a lion, possessed of Anima®® and other Siddhis and dazzling the quarters with her brilliance, the leading Danavas said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the goddess seated on a lion, possessed of Anima®® and other Siddhis and dazzling the quarters with her brilliance, the leading Danavas said.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चरणः पततामेष तवेति भृशरोषतः । यमस्ततः पितुः सर्वं प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: caraṇaḥ patatāmeṣa taveti bhṛśaroṣataḥ | yamastataḥ pituḥ sarvaṃ prāñjaliḥ pratyavedayat
verses.translation: *'0 lady, hasten to approach Sumbha and Niumbha. Otherwise we shall kill you along with your Ganas and your lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: *'0 lady, hasten to approach Sumbha and Niumbha. Otherwise we shall kill you along with your Ganas and your lion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भृशं शापभयोद्विग्नः संज्ञावाक्यैर्विचेष्टितः । मात्रा स्नेहेन सर्वेषु वर्तितव्यं सुतेषु वै
verses.transliteration: bhṛśaṃ śāpabhayodvignaḥ saṃjñāvākyairviceṣṭitaḥ | mātrā snehena sarveṣu vartitavyaṃ suteṣu vai
verses.translation: O lady, choose him as your husband. He is eu¬ logised by the guardians of the quarters and others. You will attain a great bliss rare to attain by the gods.**
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady, choose him as your husband. He is eu¬ logised by the guardians of the quarters and others. You will attain a great bliss rare to attain by the gods.**
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहमस्मास्वपाकृत्य कनीयांसं बिभर्ति सा । तस्मान्मयोद्यतः पादस्तद्भवान् क्षन्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: snehamasmāsvapākṛtya kanīyāṃsaṃ bibharti sā | tasmānmayodyataḥ pādastadbhavān kṣantumarhati
verses.translation: On hearing these words the goddess Amba smiled and spoke interesting and truthful words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words the goddess Amba smiled and spoke interesting and truthful words.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सवितोवाच । असंशयं पुत्र महद्भविष्यत्यत्र कारणम् । येन त्वामाविशत्क्रोधो धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम्
verses.transliteration: savitovāca | asaṃśayaṃ putra mahadbhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam | yena tvāmāviśatkrodho dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam
verses.translation: I am His subtle Prakrti. How can I choose another as my husband? Even if she is overwhelmed by love does a lioness choose a jackal as her mate?
verses.commentary: Sense: I am His subtle Prakrti. How can I choose another as my husband? Even if she is overwhelmed by love does a lioness choose a jackal as her mate?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यते तन्मिथ्या वै कर्तुं मातृवचस्तव । कृमयो मांसमादाय गमिष्यन्ति महीतले
verses.transliteration: na śakyate tanmithyā vai kartuṃ mātṛvacastava | kṛmayo māṃsamādāya gamiṣyanti mahītale
verses.translation: A female elephant does not take an ass nor does a leopardess take a hare. O Daityas, overcome by the Serpent of Death you speak in vain.
verses.commentary: Sense: A female elephant does not take an ass nor does a leopardess take a hare. O Daityas, overcome by the Serpent of Death you speak in vain.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यं भविता सत्यं त्वं च त्रातौ भविष्यसि । कुरु तात न सन्देहं मनश्चाश्वास्य स्वं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tadvākyaṃ bhavitā satyaṃ tvaṃ ca trātau bhaviṣyasi | kuru tāta na sandehaṃ manaścāśvāsya svaṃ prabho
verses.translation: Descend to Patala*® all of you. If you have the power, fight.'* On hearing her provocative words the Asuras said to one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Descend to Patala*® all of you. If you have the power, fight.'* On hearing her provocative words the Asuras said to one another.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तनयं सूर्यो यमसंज्ञं मुनीश्वर । आदित्यश्चाब्रवीत्तान्त्तु छायां क्रोधसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā tanayaṃ sūryo yamasaṃjñaṃ munīśvara | ādityaścābravīttānttu chāyāṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: *'We do not kill you as you are a woman. But if you desire for battle be ready with your lion."
verses.commentary: Sense: *'We do not kill you as you are a woman. But if you desire for battle be ready with your lion."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य उवाच । हे प्रिये कुमते चण्डि किं त्वयाचरितं किल । किन्तु मेऽभ्यधिकः स्नेह एतदाख्यातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: sūrya uvāca | he priye kumate caṇḍi kiṃ tvayācaritaṃ kila | kintu me'bhyadhikaḥ sneha etadākhyātumarhasi
verses.translation: While they spoke thus the fight ensued. The arrows rained in the battle, sharp arrows from either side.
verses.commentary: Sense: While they spoke thus the fight ensued. The arrows rained in the battle, sharp arrows from either side.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । सा रवेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा यथातथ्यं न्यवेदयत् । निर्दग्धा कामरविणा सान्त्वयामास वै तदा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | sā ravervacanaṃ śrutvā yathātathyaṃ nyavedayat | nirdagdhā kāmaraviṇā sāntvayāmāsa vai tadā
verses.translation: Thus fighting with them sportively the goddess slew the Asura along with Ganda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus fighting with them sportively the goddess slew the Asura along with Ganda and Munda.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सूर्याऽगात्तवष्टुरन्तिकम् पप्रच्छ तं क्व संज्ञेति त्वष्टा सूर्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāstad vacanaṃ śrutvā sūryā'gāttavaṣṭurantikam papraccha taṃ kva saṃjñeti tvaṣṭā sūryamathābravīt
verses.translation: Though they had an inimical feeling these enemies of the gods attained in the end that world which her followers go to.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though they had an inimical feeling these enemies of the gods attained in the end that world which her followers go to.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टोवाच । तवातितेजसा दग्धा इदं रूपं न शोभते । असहन्ती च तत्संज्ञा वने वसति शाद्वले
verses.transliteration: tvaṣṭovāca | tavātitejasā dagdhā idaṃ rūpaṃ na śobhate | asahantī ca tatsaṃjñā vane vasati śādvale
verses.translation: According to the Puranic Mythology it is the seventh region esrending from the earth below.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the Puranic Mythology it is the seventh region esrending from the earth below.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्लाघ्या योगबलोपेता योगमासाद्य गोपते । अनुकूलस्तु देवेश सन्दिश्यात्ममयं मतम्
verses.transliteration: ślāghyā yogabalopetā yogamāsādya gopate | anukūlastu deveśa sandiśyātmamayaṃ matam
verses.translation: O holy lord, O brahmin, what did Kumbha, the suppressor of the gods, do on hearing that Dhumraka, Canca and Raktabija were killed by the goddess? Please tell me this now. I desire to hear the purifying tale of the goddess, the cause of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, O brahmin, what did Kumbha, the suppressor of the gods, do on hearing that Dhumraka, Canca and Raktabija were killed by the goddess? Please tell me this now. I desire to hear the purifying tale of the goddess, the cause of the universe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमिमारोप्य तत्तेजः शातयामास वै मुनिः । ततो विभ्राजितं रूपं तेजसा संवृतेन च
verses.transliteration: bhramimāropya tattejaḥ śātayāmāsa vai muniḥ | tato vibhrājitaṃ rūpaṃ tejasā saṃvṛtena ca
verses.translation: At my behest the Daityas born of the race of Kalaka®' have all assembled here with their armies and along with Kalakeyas,** Mauryas,** Daurhrdas*® and others. Let them march on with hopes of victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: At my behest the Daityas born of the race of Kalaka®' have all assembled here with their armies and along with Kalakeyas,** Mauryas,** Daurhrdas*® and others. Let them march on with hopes of victory.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतं कान्ततरं रूपं त्वष्ट्रा तच्छुशुभे तदा । ततोऽधियोगमास्थाय स्वां भार्यां हि ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ kāntataraṃ rūpaṃ tvaṣṭrā tacchuśubhe tadā | tato'dhiyogamāsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ hi dadarśa ha
verses.translation: After ordering the demons, Sumbha and Nisumbha mounted on their chariots and set out. Their armies too followed them like swarms of moths rising up from a mountain definitely for their destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: After ordering the demons, Sumbha and Nisumbha mounted on their chariots and set out. Their armies too followed them like swarms of moths rising up from a mountain definitely for their destruction.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधृष्यां सर्वभूतानां तेजसा नियमेन च । सोऽश्वरूपं समास्थाय गत्वा तां मैथुनेच्छया
verses.transliteration: adhṛṣyāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejasā niyamena ca | so'śvarūpaṃ samāsthāya gatvā tāṃ maithunecchayā
verses.translation: Mrdafigas, Mardalas, Bherikas Dindimas, Jhar- jharas and Anakas were sounded. The warmongers rejoiced in the battle-ground. Those who were afraid fled away for their life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mrdafigas, Mardalas, Bherikas Dindimas, Jhar- jharas and Anakas were sounded. The warmongers rejoiced in the battle-ground. Those who were afraid fled away for their life.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनाय विचेष्टन्तीं परपुंसोऽभिशङ्कया । मुखतो नासिकायां तु शुक्रं तद्व्यदधान्मुने
verses.transliteration: maithunāya viceṣṭantīṃ parapuṃso'bhiśaṅkayā | mukhato nāsikāyāṃ tu śukraṃ tadvyadadhānmune
verses.translation: Clad in their martial dress the soldiers came in their healthy spirits to the battleground. Holding various weapons and missiles they teased one another each eager for his victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Clad in their martial dress the soldiers came in their healthy spirits to the battleground. Holding various weapons and missiles they teased one another each eager for his victory.

verses.sanskrit: देवौ ततः प्रजायेतामश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ । नासत्यौ तौ च दस्रौ च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनावपि
verses.transliteration: devau tataḥ prajāyetāmaśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau | nāsatyau tau ca dasrau ca smṛtau dvāvaśvināvapi
verses.translation: Soldiers on elephants, looked at the enemy with
verses.commentary: Sense: Soldiers on elephants, looked at the enemy with

verses.sanskrit: तां तु कान्तेन रूपेण दर्शयामास भास्करः । आत्मानं सा तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टा पतिमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tu kāntena rūpeṇa darśayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ | ātmānaṃ sā tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭā patimādarāt
verses.translation: In respect of this Hiuse no detaiU are avjiilable either from the MB. or the Punirab.
verses.commentary: Sense: In respect of this Hiuse no detaiU are avjiilable either from the MB. or the Punirab.

verses.sanskrit: पत्या तेन गृहं प्रागात्स्वं सती मुदितानना । मुमुदातेऽथ तौ प्रीत्या दम्पती पूर्वतोधिकम्
verses.transliteration: patyā tena gṛhaṃ prāgātsvaṃ satī muditānanā | mumudāte'tha tau prītyā dampatī pūrvatodhikam
verses.translation: Kalakeyas, d 'scendants of Kaiaka wife of Kasyapa, arc often mentioned as powerful di'mons in the MB. and the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalakeyas, d 'scendants of Kaiaka wife of Kasyapa, arc often mentioned as powerful di'mons in the MB. and the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: यमस्तु कर्मणा तेन भृशं पीडितमानसः । धर्मेण रञ्जयामास धर्मराज इमा प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: yamastu karmaṇā tena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ | dharmeṇa rañjayāmāsa dharmarāja imā prajāḥ
verses.translation: Daurhfdas are the descendants of the Asura Durhfda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daurhfdas are the descendants of the Asura Durhfda.

verses.sanskrit: लेभे स कर्मणा तेन धर्मराजो महाद्युतिः । पितॄणामाधिपत्यं च लोकपालत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: lebhe sa karmaṇā tena dharmarājo mahādyutiḥ | pitṝṇāmādhipatyaṃ ca lokapālatvameva ca
verses.translation: The sound arising from the guns rose up repeatedly making the gods tremble. A great darkne.ss enveloped the sky. Even the chariot of the sun was not visible.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sound arising from the guns rose up repeatedly making the gods tremble. A great darkne.ss enveloped the sky. Even the chariot of the sun was not visible.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुपृष्ठे तपो घोरमद्यापि चरते प्रभुः । यवीयसी तयोर्या तु यमी कन्या यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: merupṛṣṭhe tapo ghoramadyāpi carate prabhuḥ | yavīyasī tayoryā tu yamī kanyā yaśasvinī
verses.translation: On seeing the army of the enemy advancing thus, Ambika kept her bow well-strung. She sounded her bell that distressed the enemy. The lion too shook his manes and roared.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the army of the enemy advancing thus, Ambika kept her bow well-strung. She sounded her bell that distressed the enemy. The lion too shook his manes and roared.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभवत्सा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यमुना लोकपा वनी । मनुरित्युच्यते लोके सावर्णिरिति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: abhavatsā saricchreṣṭhā yamunā lokapā vanī | manurityucyate loke sāvarṇiriti cocyate
verses.translation: Seeing her bedecked in fine ornaments, holding weapons and stationed on the Himalaya mountain Nisumbha spoke words full of sentiments like a man clever in under¬ standing the emotions of beautiful women.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing her bedecked in fine ornaments, holding weapons and stationed on the Himalaya mountain Nisumbha spoke words full of sentiments like a man clever in under¬ standing the emotions of beautiful women.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं जन्म देवानां शृणुयाद्धारयेत्तु वा । आपदं प्राप्य मुच्येत प्राप्नुयात्सुमहद्यशः
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ janma devānāṃ śṛṇuyāddhārayettu vā | āpadaṃ prāpya mucyeta prāpnuyātsumahadyaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Even a petal of the Malati (Jasmine) flower thrown on the beautiful body of women like you may distress you. O goddess, how will you carry on a terrible war with the self-same handsome body of yours?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "Even a petal of the Malati (Jasmine) flower thrown on the beautiful body of women like you may distress you. O goddess, how will you carry on a terrible war with the self-same handsome body of yours?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Heroes do not come to the battlefield for turning back. But how can I attain victory in a battle with this lady who has destroyed my entire host?
verses.commentary: Sense: Heroes do not come to the battlefield for turning back. But how can I attain victory in a battle with this lady who has destroyed my entire host?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Heroes do not come to the battlefield for turning back. But how can I attain victory in a battle with this lady who has destroyed my entire host?
verses.commentary: Sense: Heroes do not come to the battlefield for turning back. But how can I attain victory in a battle with this lady who has destroyed my entire host?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३६. षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । मनुनवपुत्रवंशवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यासन्पुत्रा वै नव तत्समाः । पश्चान्महोन्नता धीराः क्षत्रधर्मपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.36. ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | manunavaputravaṃśavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | manorvaivasvatasyāsanputrā vai nava tatsamāḥ | paścānmahonnatā dhīrāḥ kṣatradharmaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: After thinking thus and sitting in a great chariot
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus and sitting in a great chariot

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुः शिबिनाभागौ धृष्टः शर्यातिरेव च । नरिष्यन्तोऽथ नाभागः करूषश्च प्रियव्रतः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākuḥ śibinābhāgau dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireva ca | nariṣyanto'tha nābhāgaḥ karūṣaśca priyavrataḥ
verses.translation: She lifted up her trident and struck the great Asura. He fell down unconscious shaking heaven and earth along with the ocean like a mountain whose wings had been chopped off by Indra.**
verses.commentary: Sense: She lifted up her trident and struck the great Asura. He fell down unconscious shaking heaven and earth along with the ocean like a mountain whose wings had been chopped off by Indra.**

verses.sanskrit: अकरोत्पुत्रकामस्तु मनुरिष्टिं प्रजापतिः । अनुत्पन्नेषु पुत्रेषु तत्रेष्ट्यां मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: akarotputrakāmastu manuriṣṭiṃ prajāpatiḥ | anutpanneṣu putreṣu tatreṣṭyāṃ munipuṅgavaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gods were proud and haughty. They boasted — "We are blessed. What can the Asuras do to us

verses.sanskrit: सा हि दिव्याम्बरधरा दिव्याभरणभूषिता । दिव्यसंहनना चैवमिला जज्ञे हि विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: sā hi divyāmbaradharā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | divyasaṃhananā caivamilā jajñe hi viśrutā
verses.translation: The wind-god went silently to the assembly of Indi a. There he narrated the details of his discomfiture.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind-god went silently to the assembly of Indi a. There he narrated the details of his discomfiture.

verses.sanskrit: तामिडेत्येव होवाच मनुर्दण्डधरस्तथा । अनुगच्छस्व मामेति तमिडा प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tāmiḍetyeva hovāca manurdaṇḍadharastathā | anugacchasva māmeti tamiḍā pratyuvāca ha
verses.translation: The great Brahman, the great light in the form of the two Pranavas, I alone am. I am all. There is none other beside me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Brahman, the great light in the form of the two Pranavas, I alone am. I am all. There is none other beside me.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मयुक्तमिदं वाक्यं पुत्रकामं प्रजापतिम् । इडोवाच । मित्रावरुणयोरंशैर्जातास्मि वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: dharmayuktamidaṃ vākyaṃ putrakāmaṃ prajāpatim | iḍovāca | mitrāvaruṇayoraṃśairjātāsmi vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: Since then the gods began to propitiate her as
verses.commentary: Sense: Since then the gods began to propitiate her as
