verses.sanskrit: तयोः सकाशं यास्यामि न मेऽधर्मे रुचिर्भवेत् । एवमुक्त्वा सती सा तु मित्रावरुणयोस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ sakāśaṃ yāsyāmi na me'dharme rucirbhavet | evamuktvā satī sā tu mitrāvaruṇayostataḥ
verses.translation: O Suta, the most excellent of the story-tellers, we are not satiated even as we hear different nectarine stories narrated by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, the most excellent of the story-tellers, we are not satiated even as we hear different nectarine stories narrated by you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गत्वान्तिकं वरारोहा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् । अंशैस्तु युवयोर्जाता मनुयज्ञे महामुनी
verses.transliteration: gatvāntikaṃ varārohā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt | aṃśaistu yuvayorjātā manuyajñe mahāmunī
verses.translation: The most powerful son of Ruru, famous as Durgama secured the four Vedas as a result of the boon granted by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most powerful son of Ruru, famous as Durgama secured the four Vedas as a result of the boon granted by Brahma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आगता भवतोरन्ति ब्रूतं किं करवाणि वाम् । अन्यान् पुत्रान् सृज विभो तैर्वंशस्ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: āgatā bhavatoranti brūtaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi vām | anyān putrān sṛja vibho tairvaṃśaste bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Securing this strength that cannot be thwarted even by the gods he wrought havoc on the earth, making the gods tremble in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing this strength that cannot be thwarted even by the gods he wrought havoc on the earth, making the gods tremble in heaven.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तां तथावादिनीं साध्वीमिडां मन्वध्वरोद्भवाम् । मित्रावरुणनामानौ मुनी ऊचतुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | tāṃ tathāvādinīṃ sādhvīmiḍāṃ manvadhvarodbhavām | mitrāvaruṇanāmānau munī ūcaturādarāt
verses.translation: He addressed her thus — "O goddess, of what avail is it if the mercenary soldiers are killed? If you desire to fight, let both of us clad m martial dress fight with each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He addressed her thus — "O goddess, of what avail is it if the mercenary soldiers are killed? If you desire to fight, let both of us clad m martial dress fight with each other.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणावूचतुः । अनेन तव धर्मज्ञे प्रश्रयेण दमेन च । सत्येन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतौ द्वौ वरवर्णिनि
verses.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇāvūcatuḥ | anena tava dharmajñe praśrayeṇa damena ca | satyena caiva suśroṇi prītau dvau varavarṇini
verses.translation: The goddess addressed Kli then — "Seethe foolish ambition of the two Asuras. Time the instigator of good and bad actions renders the mind work in a different way when adversity is imminent."
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess addressed Kli then — "Seethe foolish ambition of the two Asuras. Time the instigator of good and bad actions renders the mind work in a different way when adversity is imminent."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आवयोस्त्वं महाभागे ख्यातिं चैव गमिष्यसि । मनोर्वंशकरः पुत्रस्त्वमेव च भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: āvayostvaṃ mahābhāge khyātiṃ caiva gamiṣyasi | manorvaṃśakaraḥ putrastvameva ca bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Then Nisumbha attacked Candika as well as Kali with thousands of arrows. With the volleys of her arrows Siva split into a thousand pieces the arrows discharged by the Asura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Nisumbha attacked Candika as well as Kali with thousands of arrows. With the volleys of her arrows Siva split into a thousand pieces the arrows discharged by the Asura.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्न इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । जगत्प्रियो धर्मशीलौ मनुवंशविवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: sudyumna iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ | jagatpriyo dharmaśīlau manuvaṃśavivardhanaḥ
verses.translation: He then lifted up his lustrous sword along with the shield and struck the lion on its head. With her g;reat sword she split it too as the woodcutters do to a tree with the axe.
verses.commentary: Sense: He then lifted up his lustrous sword along with the shield and struck the lion on its head. With her g;reat sword she split it too as the woodcutters do to a tree with the axe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । निवृत्ता सा तु तच्छ्रुत्वा गच्छन्ती पितुरन्तिके । बुधेनान्तरमासाद्य मैथुनायोपमन्त्रिता
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | nivṛttā sā tu tacchrutvā gacchantī piturantike | budhenāntaramāsādya maithunāyopamantritā
verses.translation: Prepared to die the heroic Asura seized a mace and rushed at her. She reduced the mace into powder with the edge of her trident. The demon shattered the trident with another mace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prepared to die the heroic Asura seized a mace and rushed at her. She reduced the mace into powder with the edge of her trident. The demon shattered the trident with another mace.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोमपुत्रात्ततो जज्ञे तस्यां राजा पुरूरवाः । पुत्रोऽतिसुन्दरः प्राज्ञ उर्वशीपतिरुन्नतः
verses.transliteration: somaputrāttato jajñe tasyāṃ rājā purūravāḥ | putro'tisundaraḥ prājña urvaśīpatirunnataḥ
verses.translation: Then she struck Nisumbha with her sharp, terrible serpentine poisonous arrows that were accustomed to drink the blood of Asuras and brought him down to the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then she struck Nisumbha with her sharp, terrible serpentine poisonous arrows that were accustomed to drink the blood of Asuras and brought him down to the earth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जनयित्वा च सा तत्र पुरूरवसमादरात् । पुत्रं शिवप्रसादात्तु पुनः सुद्युम्नतां गतः
verses.transliteration: janayitvā ca sā tatra purūravasamādarāt | putraṃ śivaprasādāttu punaḥ sudyumnatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: When his younger brother of great honour and strength fell Sumbha was furious. The eight-armed demon seated himself in a chariot and came to the place where Siva was present.
verses.commentary: Sense: When his younger brother of great honour and strength fell Sumbha was furious. The eight-armed demon seated himself in a chariot and came to the place where Siva was present.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्नस्य तु दायादास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः । उत्कलश्च गयश्चापि विनताश्वश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: sudyumnasya tu dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ | utkalaśca gayaścāpi vinatāśvaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: She blew the conch Arindama, produced unbear¬ able bow-twang; the lion shaking its manes roared. The whole sky reverberated with the threefold round.
verses.commentary: Sense: She blew the conch Arindama, produced unbear¬ able bow-twang; the lion shaking its manes roared. The whole sky reverberated with the threefold round.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्कलस्योत्कला विप्रा विनताश्वस्य पश्चिमा । दिक्पूर्वा मुनिशार्दूल गयस्य तु गया स्मृता
verses.transliteration: utkalasyotkalā viprā vinatāśvasya paścimā | dikpūrvā muniśārdūla gayasya tu gayā smṛtā
verses.translation: Then the mother of the universe laughed bois¬ terously making all the demons tremble with fear. The gods shouted cries of "Victory" when she challenged the Asuras in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the mother of the universe laughed bois¬ terously making all the demons tremble with fear. The gods shouted cries of "Victory" when she challenged the Asuras in the battle.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टे तु मनौ तात दिवाकरतनुं तदा । दशधा तत्र तत्क्षेत्रमकरोत्पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭe tu manau tāta divākaratanuṃ tadā | daśadhā tatra tatkṣetramakarotpṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: The king of Daityas hurled a spear of shining flames which was struck down by a meteor. Siva shattered the arrows discharged by Sumbha. He too split the arrows discharged by Siva into a thousand pieces.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of Daityas hurled a spear of shining flames which was struck down by a meteor. Siva shattered the arrows discharged by Sumbha. He too split the arrows discharged by Siva into a thousand pieces.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुः श्रेष्ठदायादो मध्यदेशमवाप्तवान् । वसिष्ठवचनादासीत्प्रतिष्ठानं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākuḥ śreṣṭhadāyādo madhyadeśamavāptavān | vasiṣṭhavacanādāsītpratiṣṭhānaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Suffering the pain arising from the trident, the powerful demon, the suppressor of the gods, created ten thousand hands and struck Kali and Candika along with the Hon, by means of his discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suffering the pain arising from the trident, the powerful demon, the suppressor of the gods, created ten thousand hands and struck Kali and Candika along with the Hon, by means of his discus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठां धर्मराज्यस्य सुद्युम्नोऽथ ततो ददौ । तत्पुरूरवसे प्रादाद् राज्यं प्राप्य महायशाः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhāṃ dharmarājyasya sudyumno'tha tato dadau | tatpurūravase prādād rājyaṃ prāpya mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Splitting sportively the discus hurled by him, she hurt and struck the Asura with the trident. Thus both of them met their death at the lotus-hands of Siva that sanctify the universe and attained the great region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Splitting sportively the discus hurled by him, she hurt and struck the Asura with the trident. Thus both of them met their death at the lotus-hands of Siva that sanctify the universe and attained the great region.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मानवो यो मुनिश्रेष्ठाः स्त्रीपुंसोर्लक्षणः प्रभुः । नरिष्यन्ताच्छकाः पुत्रा नभगस्य सुतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: mānavo yo muniśreṣṭhāḥ strīpuṃsorlakṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | nariṣyantācchakāḥ putrā nabhagasya suto'bhavat
verses.translation: When the powerful Nisumbha, and Sumbha of terrible exploit were killed the Daityas entered Patala.®®
verses.commentary: Sense: When the powerful Nisumbha, and Sumbha of terrible exploit were killed the Daityas entered Patala.®®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषस्तु बाह्लेयो बाह्लकं क्षेत्रामाप्तवान् । शर्यातेर्मिथुनं त्वासीदानर्तो नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣastu bāhleyo bāhlakaṃ kṣetrāmāptavān | śaryātermithunaṃ tvāsīdānarto nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Others were devoured by Kali's lion. The remain¬ ing Asuras being excessively frightened fled in the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others were devoured by Kali's lion. The remain¬ ing Asuras being excessively frightened fled in the quarters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रः सुकन्या कन्या च या पत्नी च्यवनस्य हि । आनर्तस्य हि दायादो रैभ्यो नाम स रैवतः
verses.transliteration: putraḥ sukanyā kanyā ca yā patnī cyavanasya hi | ānartasya hi dāyādo raibhyo nāma sa raivataḥ
verses.translation: The rivers with clear water flowed along their paths; the winds blew very gentle to the touch; the sky be¬ came clear,
verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers with clear water flowed along their paths; the winds blew very gentle to the touch; the sky be¬ came clear,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आनर्तविषये यस्य पुरी नाम कुशस्थली । महादिव्या सप्तपुरीमध्ये या सप्तमी मता
verses.transliteration: ānartaviṣaye yasya purī nāma kuśasthalī | mahādivyā saptapurīmadhye yā saptamī matā
verses.translation: Sacrifices were revived by the gods and the sages, Lord Indra and the gods felt blissful again,
verses.commentary: Sense: Sacrifices were revived by the gods and the sages, Lord Indra and the gods felt blissful again,
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीत्ककुद्मी ज्येष्ठ उत्तमः । तेजस्वी सुबलः पारो धर्मिष्ठो ब्रह्मपालकः
verses.transliteration: tasya putraśataṃ tvāsītkakudmī jyeṣṭha uttamaḥ | tejasvī subalaḥ pāro dharmiṣṭho brahmapālakaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, this story of Uma is holy and meri¬ torious. It describes the destruction of the king of Daityas. He who regularly reads this with faith enjoys all worldly pleasures inaccessible even to the gods and attains the abode of Uma hereafter by the very grace of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, this story of Uma is holy and meri¬ torious. It describes the destruction of the king of Daityas. He who regularly reads this with faith enjoys all worldly pleasures inaccessible even to the gods and attains the abode of Uma hereafter by the very grace of the goddess.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ककुद्मिनस्तु सञ्जाता रेवती नाम कन्यका । महालावण्यसंयुक्ता दिव्यलक्ष्मीरिवापरा
verses.transliteration: kakudminastu sañjātā revatī nāma kanyakā | mahālāvaṇyasaṃyuktā divyalakṣmīrivāparā
verses.translation: See P. 643 note.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रष्टुं कन्यावरं राजा ककुद्मी कन्यया सह । ब्रह्मलोके विधेः सम्यक्सर्वाधीशो जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: praṣṭuṃ kanyāvaraṃ rājā kakudmī kanyayā saha | brahmaloke vidheḥ samyaksarvādhīśo jagāma ha
verses.translation: O Suta, the most excellent among the omniscients please mention the incarnation of Uma, the goddess of all the worlds and the mother ofSarasvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, the most excellent among the omniscients please mention the incarnation of Uma, the goddess of all the worlds and the mother ofSarasvati.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आवर्तमाने गान्धर्वे स्थितो लब्धक्षणः क्षणम् । शुश्राव तत्र गान्धर्वं नर्तने ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिके
verses.transliteration: āvartamāne gāndharve sthito labdhakṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇam | śuśrāva tatra gāndharvaṃ nartane brahmaṇo'ntike
verses.translation: O sagos, listen lovingly to the great story, the per¬ fect knowledge of which alone helps man to attain the great goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sagos, listen lovingly to the great story, the per¬ fect knowledge of which alone helps man to attain the great goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तभूतं तत्काले गतं बहुयुगं तदा । न किञ्चिद् बुबुधे राजा ककुद्मी मुनयः स तु
verses.transliteration: muhūrtabhūtaṃ tatkāle gataṃ bahuyugaṃ tadā | na kiñcid bubudhe rājā kakudmī munayaḥ sa tu
verses.translation: Of our unbearable prowess, the Asuras are afraid. They have gone to Patala saying, "Run, run".
verses.commentary: Sense: Of our unbearable prowess, the Asuras are afraid. They have gone to Patala saying, "Run, run".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदासौ विधिमानम्य स्वाभिप्रायं कृताञ्जलिः । न्यवेदयद्विनीतात्मा ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: tadāsau vidhimānamya svābhiprāyaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ | nyavedayadvinītātmā brahmaṇe paramātmane
verses.translation: Then all of them proclaimed thus; "Wonderful is the strength, splendour and good luck of the gods that has redu( ed the race of the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all of them proclaimed thus; "Wonderful is the strength, splendour and good luck of the gods that has redu( ed the race of the Daityas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदभिप्रायमाकर्ण्य स प्रहस्य प्रजापतिः । ककुद्मिनं महाराजं समाभाष्य समब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tadabhiprāyamākarṇya sa prahasya prajāpatiḥ | kakudminaṃ mahārājaṃ samābhāṣya samabravīt
verses.translation: Then a mass of splendour appeared, at the unpre¬ cedented sight of which the gods were surpiised.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a mass of splendour appeared, at the unpre¬ cedented sight of which the gods were surpiised.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । शृणु राजन् रैभ्यसुत ककुद्मिन् पृथिवीपते । मद्वचः प्रीतितः सत्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | śṛṇu rājan raibhyasuta kakudmin pṛthivīpate | madvacaḥ prītitaḥ satyaṃ pravakṣyāmi viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Ignorant of the real glory and the intention of the goddess to quell their arrogance, the Asuras said with choking throats "What is this? What is this?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Ignorant of the real glory and the intention of the goddess to quell their arrogance, the Asuras said with choking throats "What is this? What is this?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कालेन संहृतास्ते वै वरा ये ते कृता हृदि । न तद्गोत्रं हि तत्रास्ति कालः सर्वस्य भक्षकः
verses.transliteration: kālena saṃhṛtāste vai varā ye te kṛtā hṛdi | na tadgotraṃ hi tatrāsti kālaḥ sarvasya bhakṣakaḥ
verses.translation: Then the lord Indra ordered the gods — "Go ye all and examine it and ascertain what it is."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord Indra ordered the gods — "Go ye all and examine it and ascertain what it is."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्पुर्यपि हता पुण्यजनैः सा राक्षसैर्नृप । अष्टाविंशद्वापरेऽद्य कृष्णेन निर्मिता पुनः
verses.transliteration: tvatpuryapi hatā puṇyajanaiḥ sā rākṣasairnṛpa | aṣṭāviṃśadvāpare'dya kṛṣṇena nirmitā punaḥ
verses.translation: Urged by Indra, the wind-god approached splen¬ dour and addressed it, "Who are you?" The splendour too put the same question to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by Indra, the wind-god approached splen¬ dour and addressed it, "Who are you?" The splendour too put the same question to him.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृता द्वारावती नाम्ना बहुद्वारा मनोरमा । भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकैर्गुप्ता वासुदेवपुरोगमैः
verses.transliteration: kṛtā dvārāvatī nāmnā bahudvārā manoramā | bhojavṛṣṇyandhakairguptā vāsudevapurogamaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus asked by the big mass of splendour the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus asked by the big mass of splendour the
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्गच्छ तत्र प्रीतात्मा वासुदेवाय कन्यकाम् । बलदेवाय देहि त्वमिमां स्वतनयां नृप
verses.transliteration: tadgaccha tatra prītātmā vāsudevāya kanyakām | baladevāya dehi tvamimāṃ svatanayāṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Everything in the universe, mobile or immobile, is woven like warp and woof into me. I am the support of everything. I move the entire universe.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything in the universe, mobile or immobile, is woven like warp and woof into me. I am the support of everything. I move the entire universe.'*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्यादिष्टो नृपोऽयं तं नत्वा तां च पुरीं गतः । गतान् बहून्युगान् ज्ञात्वा विस्मितः कन्यया युतः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityādiṣṭo nṛpo'yaṃ taṃ natvā tāṃ ca purīṃ gataḥ | gatān bahūnyugān jñātvā vismitaḥ kanyayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: Then the great splendour said; — ''If you are com¬ petent to move, O wind-god, please move this blade of grass I have set before you. Move it as you please."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the great splendour said; — ''If you are com¬ petent to move, O wind-god, please move this blade of grass I have set before you. Move it as you please."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु युवतीं कन्यां तां च स्वां सुविधानतः । कृष्णभ्रात्रे बलायाशु प्रादात्तत्र स रेवतीम्
verses.transliteration: tatastu yuvatīṃ kanyāṃ tāṃ ca svāṃ suvidhānataḥ | kṛṣṇabhrātre balāyāśu prādāttatra sa revatīm
verses.translation: Then wind-god put forth all his efforts. But the blade of grass did not stir from its position. Then he was put to shame.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then wind-god put forth all his efforts. But the blade of grass did not stir from its position. Then he was put to shame.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो जगाम शिखरं मेरोर्दिव्यं महाप्रभुः । शिवमाराधयामास स नृपस्तपसि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tato jagāma śikharaṃ merordivyaṃ mahāprabhuḥ | śivamārādhayāmāsa sa nṛpastapasi sthitaḥ
verses.translation: "False is our pride that we are the lords. In fact we are helpless, insignificant creatures."
verses.commentary: Sense: "False is our pride that we are the lords. In fact we are helpless, insignificant creatures."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । तत्र स्थितो बहुयुगं ब्रह्मलोके स रेवतः । युवैवागान्मर्त्यलोकमेतन्नः संशयो महान्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | tatra sthito bahuyugaṃ brahmaloke sa revataḥ | yuvaivāgānmartyalokametannaḥ saṃśayo mahān
verses.translation: Then Indra sent all the gods. When they could not realise anything Indra himself went there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Indra sent all the gods. When they could not realise anything Indra himself went there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । न जरा क्षुत्पिपासा वा विकारास्तत्र सन्ति वै । अपमृत्युर्न केषाञ्चिन्मुनयो ब्रह्मणोंऽतिके
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | na jarā kṣutpipāsā vā vikārāstatra santi vai | apamṛtyurna keṣāñcinmunayo brahmaṇoṃ'tike
verses.translation: On seeing Indra come, the unbearable splendour vanished immediately. Indra was surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Indra come, the unbearable splendour vanished immediately. Indra was surprised.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतो न राजा सम्प्राप जरां मृत्युं च सा सुता । स युवैवागतस्तत्र सम्मन्त्र्य तनयावरम्
verses.transliteration: ato na rājā samprāpa jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ ca sā sutā | sa yuvaivāgatastatra sammantrya tanayāvaram
verses.translation: Then Indra thought to himself again and again — "I seek refuge in him alone whose conduct is such as this."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Indra thought to himself again and again — "I seek refuge in him alone whose conduct is such as this."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा द्वारावतीं दिव्यां पुरीं कृष्णविनिर्मिताम् । विवाहं कारयामास कन्यायाः स बलेन हि
verses.transliteration: gatvā dvārāvatīṃ divyāṃ purīṃ kṛṣṇavinirmitām | vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa kanyāyāḥ sa balena hi
verses.translation: In the meantime, in order to bless them am'* remove their arrogance, Siva, the embodied form of unde ceitful mercy, existence, knowledge and bliss, manifested her¬ self on the ninth day of the bright half of the month Caitra when the sun was in the middle of the day.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, in order to bless them am'* remove their arrogance, Siva, the embodied form of unde ceitful mercy, existence, knowledge and bliss, manifested her¬ self on the ninth day of the bright half of the month Caitra when the sun was in the middle of the day.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीद्धार्मिकस्य महाप्रभोः । कृष्णस्यापि सुता जाता बहुस्त्रीभ्योऽमितास्ततः
verses.transliteration: tasya putraśataṃ tvāsīddhārmikasya mahāprabhoḥ | kṛṣṇasyāpi sutā jātā bahustrībhyo'mitāstataḥ
verses.translation: Shining among the mass of.splendour she bright¬ ened the quarters with her brilliance. She enlightened the god.s, saying "I alone am Brahman."
verses.commentary: Sense: Shining among the mass of.splendour she bright¬ ened the quarters with her brilliance. She enlightened the god.s, saying "I alone am Brahman."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्ववायो महांस्तत्र द्वयोरपि महात्मनोः । क्षत्रिया दिक्षु सर्वासु गता हृष्टाः सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: anvavāyo mahāṃstatra dvayorapi mahātmanoḥ | kṣatriyā dikṣu sarvāsu gatā hṛṣṭāḥ sudhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: In her four hands she held boons, noose, goad and the mystic gesture of protection. She was served by the Vedas and looked beautiful and proud of her blooming youth.
verses.commentary: Sense: In her four hands she held boons, noose, goad and the mystic gesture of protection. She was served by the Vedas and looked beautiful and proud of her blooming youth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्तो हि शर्यातेर्वंशोऽन्येषां वदाम्यहम् । मानवानां हि सङ्क्षेपाच्छृणुतादरतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: iti prokto hi śaryātervaṃśo'nyeṣāṃ vadāmyaham | mānavānāṃ hi saṅkṣepācchṛṇutādarato dvijāḥ
verses.translation: She wore red garments and red garlands. Red sandal paste was smeared over her body. She was as dazzling as a crore of cupids. Her lustre was that of a crorc moons.
verses.commentary: Sense: She wore red garments and red garlands. Red sandal paste was smeared over her body. She was as dazzling as a crore of cupids. Her lustre was that of a crorc moons.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाभागो दिष्टपुत्रोऽभूत्स तु ब्राह्मणतां गतः । स्वक्षत्रवंशं संस्थाप्य ब्रह्मकर्मभिरावृतः
verses.transliteration: nābhāgo diṣṭaputro'bhūtsa tu brāhmaṇatāṃ gataḥ | svakṣatravaṃśaṃ saṃsthāpya brahmakarmabhirāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The great Maya, in the form of the immanent soul of all, the cosmic witness of all living beings, and the great Brahman, spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Maya, in the form of the immanent soul of all, the cosmic witness of all living beings, and the great Brahman, spoke.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टाद्धार्ष्टमभूत्क्षत्रं ब्रह्मभूयं गतं क्षितौ । करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः
verses.transliteration: dhṛṣṭāddhārṣṭamabhūtkṣatraṃ brahmabhūyaṃ gataṃ kṣitau | karūṣasya tu kārūṣāḥ kṣatriyā yuddhadurmadāḥ
verses.translation: Neither Brahma nor Visnu nor $iva the slayer of
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Brahma nor Visnu nor $iva the slayer of
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नृगो यो मनुपुत्रस्तु महादाता विशेषतः । नानावसूनां सुप्रीत्या विप्रेभ्यश्च गवां तथा
verses.transliteration: nṛgo yo manuputrastu mahādātā viśeṣataḥ | nānāvasūnāṃ suprītyā viprebhyaśca gavāṃ tathā
verses.translation: Though devoid of form 1 possess forms. I consti¬ tute all principles. I am eternal and my attributes cannot be disputed. I am both the cause and the effect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though devoid of form 1 possess forms. I consti¬ tute all principles. I am eternal and my attributes cannot be disputed. I am both the cause and the effect.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोदानव्यत्ययाद्यस्तु स्वकुबुद्ध्या स्वपापतः । कृकलासत्वमापन्नः श्रीकृष्णेन समुद्धृतः
verses.transliteration: godānavyatyayādyastu svakubuddhyā svapāpataḥ | kṛkalāsatvamāpannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇena samuddhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Sometimes I have the form of a woman, sometimes of a man. Sometimes both. I am goddess assuming all forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sometimes I have the form of a woman, sometimes of a man. Sometimes both. I am goddess assuming all forms.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैकोऽभूत्सुतः श्रेष्ठः प्रयातिर्धर्मवित्तथा । इति श्रुतं मया व्यासात्तत्प्रोक्तं हि समासतः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiko'bhūtsutaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prayātirdharmavittathā | iti śrutaṃ mayā vyāsāttatproktaṃ hi samāsataḥ
verses.translation: I am the creator, the protector and the destroyer of the world. I am the enchantress of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the creator, the protector and the destroyer of the world. I am the enchantress of the universe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वृषघ्नस्तु मनोः पुत्रो गोपालो गुरुणा कृतः । पालयामास गा यत्तो रात्र्यां वीरासनव्रतः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣaghnastu manoḥ putro gopālo guruṇā kṛtaḥ | pālayāmāsa gā yatto rātryāṃ vīrāsanavrataḥ
verses.translation: All the Saktis — Kali, Lak$mi and Sarasvati as well as others are born of my parts. So also the arts originate from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Saktis — Kali, Lak$mi and Sarasvati as well as others are born of my parts. So also the arts originate from me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स एकदागतं गोष्ठे व्याघ्रं गा हिंसितुं बली । श्रुत्वा गोक्रन्दनं बुद्धो हन्तुं तं खड्गधृग्ययौ
verses.transliteration: sa ekadāgataṃ goṣṭhe vyāghraṃ gā hiṃsituṃ balī | śrutvā gokrandanaṃ buddho hantuṃ taṃ khaḍgadhṛgyayau
verses.translation: Just as a magician makes the wooden doll of a woman dance so also I the goddess make all living beings dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a magician makes the wooden doll of a woman dance so also I the goddess make all living beings dance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजानन्नहनद्बभ्रोः शिरः शार्दूलशङ्कया । निश्चक्राम सभीर्व्याघ्रो दृष्ट्वा तं खड्गिनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: ajānannahanadbabhroḥ śiraḥ śārdūlaśaṅkayā | niścakrāma sabhīrvyāghro dṛṣṭvā taṃ khaḍginaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Being afraid of me the wind blows, the fire-god burns and the guardians of the quarters carry on their duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being afraid of me the wind blows, the fire-god burns and the guardians of the quarters carry on their duties.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्यमानो हतं व्याघ्रं स्वस्थानं स जगाम ह । रात्र्यां तस्यां भ्रमापन्नो वर्षवातविनष्टधीः
verses.transliteration: manyamāno hataṃ vyāghraṃ svasthānaṃ sa jagāma ha | rātryāṃ tasyāṃ bhramāpanno varṣavātavinaṣṭadhīḥ
verses.translation: Independent that I am, I sportively bestow victory on the gods sometimes and on the Daily as sometimes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Independent that I am, I sportively bestow victory on the gods sometimes and on the Daily as sometimes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्युष्टायां निशि चोत्थाय प्रगे तत्र गतो हि सः । अद्राक्षीत्स हतां बभ्रुं न व्याघ्रं दुःखितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: vyuṣṭāyāṃ niśi cotthāya prage tatra gato hi saḥ | adrākṣītsa hatāṃ babhruṃ na vyāghraṃ duḥkhito'bhavat
verses.translation: O gods, endowed with devotion, realise this and eschew your arrogance, worship me, the eternal Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, endowed with devotion, realise this and eschew your arrogance, worship me, the eternal Prakrti.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद्वृत्तमाज्ञाय तं शशाप कृतागसम् । अकामतो विचार्येति शूद्रो भव न क्षत्रियः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tadvṛttamājñāya taṃ śaśāpa kṛtāgasam | akāmato vicāryeti śūdro bhava na kṣatriyaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the merciful words of the goddess, the gods eulogised her, with their shoulders drooping with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the merciful words of the goddess, the gods eulogised her, with their shoulders drooping with devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं शप्तस्तु गुरुणा कुलाचार्येण कोपतः । निःसृतश्च पृषध्रस्तु जगाम विपिनं महत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ śaptastu guruṇā kulācāryeṇa kopataḥ | niḥsṛtaśca pṛṣadhrastu jagāma vipinaṃ mahat
verses.translation: O goddess of the universe, forgive us. O goddess, be pleased. O mother, let us not be arrogant again. Please be merciful.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess of the universe, forgive us. O goddess, be pleased. O mother, let us not be arrogant again. Please be merciful.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्विण्णः स तु कष्टेन विरक्तोऽभूत्स योगवान् । वनाग्नौ दग्धदेहश्च जगाम परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: nirviṇṇaḥ sa tu kaṣṭena virakto'bhūtsa yogavān | vanāgnau dagdhadehaśca jagāma paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: O Brahmins, thus I have narrated to you the menifestation of Uma. By only hearing this men attain the great region.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmins, thus I have narrated to you the menifestation of Uma. By only hearing this men attain the great region.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कविः पुत्रो मनोः प्राज्ञः शिवानुग्रहतोऽभवत् । इह भुक्त्वा सुखं दिव्यं मुक्तिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: kaviḥ putro manoḥ prājñaḥ śivānugrahato'bhavat | iha bhuktvā sukhaṃ divyaṃ muktiṃ prāpa sudurlabhām
verses.translation: O intelligent one, all of us are anxious to hear the episode of Durga every day. Please tell us another wonderful tale of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, all of us are anxious to hear the episode of Durga every day. Please tell us another wonderful tale of the goddess.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: None offered charitable gifts; none performed penances; there was neither worship nor sacrifice. Then a great drought befell the earth extending to a period of a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: None offered charitable gifts; none performed penances; there was neither worship nor sacrifice. Then a great drought befell the earth extending to a period of a hundred years.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: None offered charitable gifts; none performed penances; there was neither worship nor sacrifice. Then a great drought befell the earth extending to a period of a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: None offered charitable gifts; none performed penances; there was neither worship nor sacrifice. Then a great drought befell the earth extending to a period of a hundred years.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३७. सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । मनुवंशवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । पूर्वतस्तु मनोर्जज्ञे इक्ष्वाकुर्घ्राणतः सुतः । तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीदिक्ष्वाकोर्भूरिदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.37. saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | manuvaṃśavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | pūrvatastu manorjajñe ikṣvākurghrāṇataḥ sutaḥ | tasya putraśataṃ tvāsīdikṣvākorbhūridakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Rivers, oceans, tanks, wells and lakes dried. Trees and plants withered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rivers, oceans, tanks, wells and lakes dried. Trees and plants withered.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुरस्तादभवन्नार्यावर्ते नृपा द्विजाः । तेषां विकुक्षिर्ज्येष्ठस्तु सोऽयोध्यायां नृपोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ purastādabhavannāryāvarte nṛpā dvijāḥ | teṣāṃ vikukṣirjyeṣṭhastu so'yodhyāyāṃ nṛpo'bhavat
verses.translation: To the learned and the gods she distributed the
verses.commentary: Sense: To the learned and the gods she distributed the
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्म शृणु तत्प्रीत्या यज्जातं वंशतो विधेः । श्राद्धकर्मणि चोद्दिष्टो ह्यकृते श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: tatkarma śṛṇu tatprītyā yajjātaṃ vaṃśato vidheḥ | śrāddhakarmaṇi coddiṣṭo hyakṛte śrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Then the goddess struck Durgama with the edge of her trident. He fell on the earth like an uprooted tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the goddess struck Durgama with the edge of her trident. He fell on the earth like an uprooted tree.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयित्वा शशं शीघ्रं शशादत्वमतो गतः । इक्ष्वाकुणा परित्यक्तः शशादो वनमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayitvā śaśaṃ śīghraṃ śaśādatvamato gataḥ | ikṣvākuṇā parityaktaḥ śaśādo vanamāviśat
verses.translation: Even a moment appears to be a Yuga if I do not see you since I look at you as my own children for whom I am ready even to lay down my life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a moment appears to be a Yuga if I do not see you since I look at you as my own children for whom I am ready even to lay down my life.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकौ संस्थिते राजा वसिष्ठवचनादभूत् । शकुनिप्रमुखास्तस्य पुत्राः पञ्चदश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākau saṃsthite rājā vasiṣṭhavacanādabhūt | śakunipramukhāstasya putrāḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O Dvaipayana of great intellect, listen to the full description I am going to give of the secret that you ask.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Dvaipayana of great intellect, listen to the full description I am going to give of the secret that you ask.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरापथदेशस्य रक्षितारो महीक्षितः । अयोधस्य तु दायादः ककुत्स्थो नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: uttarāpathadeśasya rakṣitāro mahīkṣitaḥ | ayodhasya tu dāyādaḥ kakutstho nāma vīryavān
verses.translation: O leading sage, by installing the goddess the merit derived is a crorc times mare than that derived by establish¬ ing the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sage, by installing the goddess the merit derived is a crorc times mare than that derived by establish¬ ing the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अरिनाभः ककुत्स्थस्य पृथुरेतस्य वै सुतः । विष्टराश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस्तस्मादिन्द्रः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: arinābhaḥ kakutsthasya pṛthuretasya vai sutaḥ | viṣṭarāśvaḥ pṛthoḥ putrastasmādindraḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The merit cannot be calculated of the man who instals the Pari caya tana®® deities with Ambika in the centre and the other four in the four quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The merit cannot be calculated of the man who instals the Pari caya tana®® deities with Ambika in the centre and the other four in the four quarters.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य युवनाश्वस्तु श्रावस्तस्य प्रजापतिः । जज्ञे श्रावस्तकः प्राज्ञः श्रावस्ती येन निर्मिता । श्रावस्तस्य तु दायादो बृहदश्वो महायशाः
verses.transliteration: indrasya yuvanāśvastu śrāvastasya prajāpatiḥ | jajñe śrāvastakaḥ prājñaḥ śrāvastī yena nirmitā | śrāvastasya tu dāyādo bṛhadaśvo mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: One attains great merit by repeating the names ofVisnu a crore times during the solar and lunar eclipses, a hundred crore times by repeating the names of Siva, a crore times by repeating the names of Sridevi, a crore times by building the palace for the goddess. To the man who instals the image of the goddess, mother of the universe, identical with the three Vedas there is nothing inaccessible, thanks to the merit of the glorious mother. His sons, grandsons and others flourish. All his sins perish.
verses.wordMeaning: One attains great merit by repeating the names ofVisnu a crore times during the solar and lunar eclipses, a hundred crore times by repeating the names of Siva, a crore times by repeating the names of Sridevi, a crore times by building the palace for the goddess.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One attains great merit by repeating the names ofVisnu a crore times during the solar and lunar eclipses, a hundred crore times by repeating the names of Siva, a crore times by repeating the names of Sridevi, a crore times by building the palace for the goddess.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: युवनाश्वः सुतस्तस्य कुवलाश्वश्च तत्सुतः । स हि धुन्धुवधाद्भूतो धुन्धुमारो नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yuvanāśvaḥ sutastasya kuvalāśvaśca tatsutaḥ | sa hi dhundhuvadhādbhūto dhundhumāro nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: Even those who desire mentally the installation of the excellent image attain the great region of Uma inaccessi¬ ble even to the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even those who desire mentally the installation of the excellent image attain the great region of Uma inaccessi¬ ble even to the sage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुवलाश्वस्य पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम् । बभूवाथ पिता राज्ये कुवलाश्वं न्ययोजयत्
verses.transliteration: kuvalāśvasya putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām | babhūvātha pitā rājye kuvalāśvaṃ nyayojayat
verses.translation: On seeing the misery of the distressed subjects the gods sought refuge in the Yogic Maya, Mahevari.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the misery of the distressed subjects the gods sought refuge in the Yogic Maya, Mahevari.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रसङ्क्रामितश्रीको वनं राजा समाविशत् । तमुत्तङ्कोऽथ राजर्षिः प्रयान्तं प्रत्यवारयत्
verses.transliteration: putrasaṅkrāmitaśrīko vanaṃ rājā samāviśat | tamuttaṅko'tha rājarṣiḥ prayāntaṃ pratyavārayat
verses.translation: O Mahamaya, save all your people. Check your fury or the worlds will be ruined.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahamaya, save all your people. Check your fury or the worlds will be ruined.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्क उवाच । भवता रक्षणं कार्यं पृथिव्या धर्मतः शृणु । त्वया हि पृथिवी राजन् रक्ष्यमाणा महात्मना
verses.transliteration: uttaṅka uvāca | bhavatā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ pṛthivyā dharmataḥ śṛṇu | tvayā hi pṛthivī rājan rakṣyamāṇā mahātmanā
verses.translation: O ocean of mercy, O suppor tress of the distress¬ ed, kill this demon too just as you have killed Sumbha, Nisumbha. Dhumraksa, Canda, Muncjla, Raktabija, Madhu, Kaiabha and Mahisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ocean of mercy, O suppor tress of the distress¬ ed, kill this demon too just as you have killed Sumbha, Nisumbha. Dhumraksa, Canda, Muncjla, Raktabija, Madhu, Kaiabha and Mahisa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति निरुद्विग्ना नारण्यं गन्तुमर्हसि । ममाश्रमसमीपे तु समेषु मरुधन्वसु
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati nirudvignā nāraṇyaṃ gantumarhasi | mamāśramasamīpe tu sameṣu marudhanvasu
verses.translation: Boys are guilty of offence at every step but who on earth brooks it except the mother?
verses.commentary: Sense: Boys are guilty of offence at every step but who on earth brooks it except the mother?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रवालुकापूर्णे दानवो बलदर्पितः । देवतानामवध्यो हि महाकायो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: samudravālukāpūrṇe dānavo baladarpitaḥ | devatānāmavadhyo hi mahākāyo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: When miseries afflict the gods and the brahmins you incarnate for the welfare of the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: When miseries afflict the gods and the brahmins you incarnate for the welfare of the people.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्भूमिगतस्तत्र वालुकान्तर्हितः स्थितः । राक्षसस्य मधोः पुत्रो धुन्धुनामा सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: antarbhūmigatastatra vālukāntarhitaḥ sthitaḥ | rākṣasasya madhoḥ putro dhundhunāmā sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the distress of the gods the merciful goddess revealed to them her form possessed of many eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the distress of the gods the merciful goddess revealed to them her form possessed of many eyes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शेते लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम् । संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते स निश्वासं विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: śete lokavināśāya tapa āsthāya dāruṇam | saṃvatsarasya paryante sa niśvāsaṃ vimuñcati
verses.translation: The goddess w'ith her lotus-face beaming with delight held in her four hands the bow, the arrows, the lotus and different fruits and roots.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess w'ith her lotus-face beaming with delight held in her four hands the bow, the arrows, the lotus and different fruits and roots.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा तदा भूश्चलति सशैलवनकानना । सविस्फुलिङ्गं साङ्गारं सधूममतिदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: yadā tadā bhūścalati saśailavanakānanā | savisphuliṅgaṃ sāṅgāraṃ sadhūmamatidāruṇam
verses.translation: On seeing her people scorched and distressed, the goddess was dejected. With her eyes full of mercy she cried for nine days and nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her people scorched and distressed, the goddess was dejected. With her eyes full of mercy she cried for nine days and nights.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन रायन्न शक्नोमि तस्मिन्न् स्थातुं स्व आश्रमे । तं मारय महाबाहो लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tena rāyanna śaknomi tasminn sthātuṃ sva āśrame | taṃ māraya mahābāho lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: The tears took the forms of thousands of water- currents released from her eyes. The worlds, the plants and medicinal herbs were delighted by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tears took the forms of thousands of water- currents released from her eyes. The worlds, the plants and medicinal herbs were delighted by them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्त्वद्य तस्मिन् विनिहते त्वया । त्वं हि तस्य वधायैव समर्थः पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: lokāḥ svasthā bhavantvadya tasmin vinihate tvayā | tvaṃ hi tasya vadhāyaiva samarthaḥ pṛthivīpate
verses.translation: They turned into the rivers and oceans of deep waters. Vegetables, roots and fruits grew on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: They turned into the rivers and oceans of deep waters. Vegetables, roots and fruits grew on the earth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना च वरो दत्तो मह्य पूर्वयुगेऽनघ । तेजसा स्वेन ते विष्णुस्तेज आप्याययिष्यति
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā ca varo datto mahya pūrvayuge'nagha | tejasā svena te viṣṇusteja āpyāyayiṣyati
verses.translation: All including the gods, brahmins and men were satisiied. Then the goddess said — "What else shall I do for you?"
verses.commentary: Sense: All including the gods, brahmins and men were satisiied. Then the goddess said — "What else shall I do for you?"
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पालने हि महान् धर्मः प्रजानामिह दृश्यते । न तथा दृश्यतेऽरण्ये मा तेऽभूद् बुद्धिरीदृशी
verses.transliteration: pālane hi mahān dharmaḥ prajānāmiha dṛśyate | na tathā dṛśyate'raṇye mā te'bhūd buddhirīdṛśī
verses.translation: The gods then gathered together and said, "The people have been rendered happy and satisfied. O goddess, be pleased and redeem the Vedas taken by Durgama.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods then gathered together and said, "The people have been rendered happy and satisfied. O goddess, be pleased and redeem the Vedas taken by Durgama.'*
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशो न हि राजेन्द्र क्वचिद्धर्मः प्रविद्यते । प्रजानां पालने यादृक् पुरा राजर्षिभिः कृतः
verses.transliteration: īdṛśo na hi rājendra kvaciddharmaḥ pravidyate | prajānāṃ pālane yādṛk purā rājarṣibhiḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After saying "So be it" she said. "Go ye all to yotir abodes. Ere long I shall give you the Vedas."
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying "So be it" she said. "Go ye all to yotir abodes. Ere long I shall give you the Vedas."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो राजर्षिरुत्तङ्केन महात्मना । कुवलाश्वं सुतं प्रादात्तस्मै धुन्धुनिवारणे
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto rājarṣiruttaṅkena mahātmanā | kuvalāśvaṃ sutaṃ prādāttasmai dhundhunivāraṇe
verses.translation: Then the joyous gods returned to their abodes after
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the joyous gods returned to their abodes after
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्न्यस्तशस्त्रोऽहमयं तु तनयो मम । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ धुन्धुमारो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhagavannyastaśastro'hamayaṃ tu tanayo mama | bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha dhundhumāro na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: V Then a great bustle arose in the three regions heaven, earth and sky. On hearing it the son of Ruru besieged the city immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: V Then a great bustle arose in the three regions heaven, earth and sky. On hearing it the son of Ruru besieged the city immediately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा पुत्रमादिश्य ययौ स तपसे नृपः । कुवलाश्वश्च सोत्तङ्को ययौ धुन्धुविनिग्रहे
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā putramādiśya yayau sa tapase nṛpaḥ | kuvalāśvaśca sottaṅko yayau dhundhuvinigrahe
verses.translation: Then after creating a big circle of splendour all round for the protection of the gods, Siva herself came out of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after creating a big circle of splendour all round for the protection of the gods, Siva herself came out of it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमाविशत्तदा विष्णुर्भगवांस्तेजसा प्रभुः । उत्तङ्कस्य नियोगाद्वै लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tamāviśattadā viṣṇurbhagavāṃstejasā prabhuḥ | uttaṅkasya niyogādvai lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: A great battle ensued between the goddess and the Daitya. Both showered arrows in the battle, piercing the armour of each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great battle ensued between the goddess and the Daitya. Both showered arrows in the battle, piercing the armour of each other.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रयाते दुर्धर्षे दिवि शब्दो महानभूत् । एष श्रीमान्नृपसुतो धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasminprayāte durdharṣe divi śabdo mahānabhūt | eṣa śrīmānnṛpasuto dhundhumāro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: In the meantime ten beautiful forms came out of Kali Viz Tara, Ghinnamasta, Srividya, Bhuvanesvari, Bhairavi, Bagala, Dhumra, Srimattripurasundarl, Matahgi and Mahavidya with weapons in their hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime ten beautiful forms came out of Kali Viz Tara, Ghinnamasta, Srividya, Bhuvanesvari, Bhairavi, Bagala, Dhumra, Srimattripurasundarl, Matahgi and Mahavidya with weapons in their hands.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यैर्माल्यैश्च तं देवाः समन्तात्समवारयन् । प्रशंसां चक्रिरे तस्य जय जीवेति वादिनः
verses.transliteration: divyairmālyaiśca taṃ devāḥ samantātsamavārayan | praśaṃsāṃ cakrire tasya jaya jīveti vādinaḥ
verses.translation: Then appeared innumerable mothers of divine forms, wearing the digit of the moon and with a lustre resembling the splendour of lightning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then appeared innumerable mothers of divine forms, wearing the digit of the moon and with a lustre resembling the splendour of lightning.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा जयतां श्रेष्ठस्तनयैः सह पार्थिवः । समुद्रं खनयामास वालुकार्णवमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā jayatāṃ śreṣṭhastanayaiḥ saha pārthivaḥ | samudraṃ khanayāmāsa vālukārṇavamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: Then a terrible combat ensued between the Asuras and the mothers. The army of the son of Ruru, consisting of a hundred Aksauhinis was killed in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a terrible combat ensued between the Asuras and the mothers. The army of the son of Ruru, consisting of a hundred Aksauhinis was killed in the battle.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नारायणस्य विप्रर्षेस्तेजसाप्यायितस्तु सः । बभूव सुमहातेजा भूयो बलसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇasya viprarṣestejasāpyāyitastu saḥ | babhūva sumahātejā bhūyo balasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus after killing him the goddess redeemed the four Vedas and gave them to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus after killing him the goddess redeemed the four Vedas and gave them to the gods.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रैः खनद्भिस्तु वालुकान्तर्गतस्तु सः । धुन्धुरासादितो ब्रह्मन् दिशमाश्रित्य पश्चि माम्
verses.transliteration: tasya putraiḥ khanadbhistu vālukāntargatastu saḥ | dhundhurāsādito brahman diśamāśritya paści mām
verses.translation: O Ambika, for our welfare that form of infinite eyes was assumed by you. Hence sages will glorify you as!atak.s!.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Ambika, for our welfare that form of infinite eyes was assumed by you. Hence sages will glorify you as!atak.s!.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखजेनाग्निना क्रोधाल्लोकान् संवर्तयन्निव । वारि सुस्राव वेगेन विधोः कधिरिवोदये
verses.transliteration: mukhajenāgninā krodhāllokān saṃvartayanniva | vāri susrāva vegena vidhoḥ kadhirivodaye
verses.translation: Since the worlds were sustained by you with vege¬ tables sprouting from your body, you will be famous as Sakambharl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the worlds were sustained by you with vege¬ tables sprouting from your body, you will be famous as Sakambharl.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽनलैरभिहतं दग्धं पुत्रशतं हि तत् । त्रय एवावशिष्टाश्च तेषु मध्ये मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: tato'nalairabhihataṃ dagdhaṃ putraśataṃ hi tat | traya evāvaśiṣṭāśca teṣu madhye munīśvara
verses.translation: O Siva, since you killed the Daitya Durgama you will be known as Durga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, since you killed the Daitya Durgama you will be known as Durga.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स राजा विप्रेन्द्र राक्षसं तं महाबलम् । आससाद महातेजा धुन्धुं विप्रविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā viprendra rākṣasaṃ taṃ mahābalam | āsasāda mahātejā dhundhuṃ vipravināśanam
verses.translation: O Yogic slumber, O Mahabala, O bestower of knowledge, O the mother of the universe, Obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yogic slumber, O Mahabala, O bestower of knowledge, O the mother of the universe, Obeisance be to you.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वारिमयं वेगमापीय स नराधिपः । वह्निबाणेन वह्निं तु शमयामास वारिणा
verses.transliteration: tasya vārimayaṃ vegamāpīya sa narādhipaḥ | vahnibāṇena vahniṃ tu śamayāmāsa vāriṇā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the heroine of infinite universes known as the supreme goddess in the Mahavakyas as Tat- tvamasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the heroine of infinite universes known as the supreme goddess in the Mahavakyas as Tat- tvamasi.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं निहत्य महाकायं बलेनोदकराक्षसम् । उत्तङ्कस्येक्षयामास कृतं कर्म नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: taṃ nihatya mahākāyaṃ balenodakarākṣasam | uttaṅkasyekṣayāmāsa kṛtaṃ karma narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: O Mother, we who are unaware ot your power and greatness, cannot adequately eulogise you who are inaccessi¬ ble through words, mind or body and whose eyes are the sun and the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mother, we who are unaware ot your power and greatness, cannot adequately eulogise you who are inaccessi¬ ble through words, mind or body and whose eyes are the sun and the moon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्कस्तु वरं प्रादात्तस्मै राज्ञे महामुने । अददच्चाक्षयं वित्तं शत्रुभिश्चापराजयम्
verses.transliteration: uttaṅkastu varaṃ prādāttasmai rājñe mahāmune | adadaccākṣayaṃ vittaṃ śatrubhiścāparājayam
verses.translation: Who else will bestow mercy on seeing us the gods except the great goddess Sataksi the mother?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who else will bestow mercy on seeing us the gods except the great goddess Sataksi the mother?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मे मतिं च सततं स्वर्गे वासं तथाक्षयम् । पुत्राणां चाक्षयं लोकं रक्षसा ये तु संहताः
verses.transliteration: dharme matiṃ ca satataṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam | putrāṇāṃ cākṣayaṃ lokaṃ rakṣasā ye tu saṃhatāḥ
verses.translation: Effort shall be made by you so that the three worlds will not be pestered continuously with obstacles and our enemies shall be destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Effort shall be made by you so that the three worlds will not be pestered continuously with obstacles and our enemies shall be destroyed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयः शिष्टाः दृढाश्वः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते । हंसाश्वकपिलाश्वौ च कुमारौ तत्कनीयसौ
verses.transliteration: tasya putrāstrayaḥ śiṣṭāḥ dṛḍhāśvaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate | haṃsāśvakapilāśvau ca kumārau tatkanīyasau
verses.translation: Just as the cows run about in excitement quickly on seeing their calves in distress, so also I, Sati, am excited on seeing you in distress and run about.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the cows run about in excitement quickly on seeing their calves in distress, so also I, Sati, am excited on seeing you in distress and run about.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धौन्धुमारिर्दृढाश्वो यो हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः । हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भोऽभूत्पुत्रो धर्मरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: dhaundhumārirdṛḍhāśvo yo haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ | haryaśvasya nikumbho'bhūtputro dharmarataḥ sadā
verses.translation: No worry or anxious thought need be entertained by you endowed with devotion as long as I stand by you destroying your distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: No worry or anxious thought need be entertained by you endowed with devotion as long as I stand by you destroying your distress.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संहताश्वो निकुम्भस्य पुत्रो रणविशारदः । अक्षाश्वश्च कृताश्वश्च संहताश्वसुतौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saṃhatāśvo nikumbhasya putro raṇaviśāradaḥ | akṣāśvaśca kṛtāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasutau dvijāḥ
verses.translation: In the manner I have killed the Daiiyas I shall kill the Asuras. You need not entertain any doubt in this regard. Truth, I am speaking the truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the manner I have killed the Daiiyas I shall kill the Asuras. You need not entertain any doubt in this regard. Truth, I am speaking the truth.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य हैमवती भार्या सतां मान्या दृषद्वती । विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पुत्रस्तस्याः प्रसेनजित्
verses.transliteration: tasya haimavatī bhāryā satāṃ mānyā dṛṣadvatī | vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu putrastasyāḥ prasenajit
verses.translation: I shall be born of the womb in the lamily of cowherds as the daughter of Yasoda wife of Nanda, when Sumbha and Nisumbha will be born as Daityas. I shall kill the demons and become famous. Men will therefore call me Nandaja.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of the womb in the lamily of cowherds as the daughter of Yasoda wife of Nanda, when Sumbha and Nisumbha will be born as Daityas. I shall kill the demons and become famous. Men will therefore call me Nandaja.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लेभे प्रसेनजिद्भार्यां गौरीं नाम पतिव्रताम् । अभिशप्ता तु सा भर्त्रा नदी सा बाहुदा कृता
verses.transliteration: lebhe prasenajidbhāryāṃ gaurīṃ nāma pativratām | abhiśaptā tu sā bhartrā nadī sā bāhudā kṛtā
verses.translation: Since I shall be taking the form of a bee and killing the demon Aruna, men will glorify me as Bhramari
verses.commentary: Sense: Since I shall be taking the form of a bee and killing the demon Aruna, men will glorify me as Bhramari
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो महानासीद्युवनाश्वो महीपतिः । मान्धाता युवनाश्वस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya putro mahānāsīdyuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ | māndhātā yuvanāśvasya triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Again I shall take a terrible form and devour the Raksasas. I shall then be famous as Bhima Devi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again I shall take a terrible form and devour the Raksasas. I shall then be famous as Bhima Devi.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चैत्ररथी भार्या शशबिन्दुसुताऽभवत् । पतिव्रता च ज्येष्ठा च भ्रातॄणामयुतस्य सा
verses.transliteration: tasya caitrarathī bhāryā śaśabindusutā'bhavat | pativratā ca jyeṣṭhā ca bhrātṝṇāmayutasya sā
verses.translation: The goddess Sataksi, Sakambhari and Durga are identical. In all the three the individual is the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess Sataksi, Sakambhari and Durga are identical. In all the three the individual is the same.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुत्पादयामास मान्धाता द्वौ सुतौ तदा । पुरुकुत्सं च धर्मज्ञं मुचुकुन्दं च धार्मिकम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāmutpādayāmāsa māndhātā dvau sutau tadā | purukutsaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ mucukundaṃ ca dhārmikam
verses.translation: O blessed disciple of Vyasa, O Suta the most excellent among the knowers of the Puranas, we wish to hear some other story of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O blessed disciple of Vyasa, O Suta the most excellent among the knowers of the Puranas, we wish to hear some other story of the lord.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरुकुत्ससुतस्त्वासीद्विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुणिः कविः । तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारोऽभून्महाबली
verses.transliteration: purukutsasutastvāsīdvidvāṃstrayyāruṇiḥ kaviḥ | tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro'bhūnmahābalī
verses.translation: We wish to hear the most excellent sacred rites of Uma, the mother of the universe, those which were narrated to Vyasa the great Atman by Sanatkumara
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear the most excellent sacred rites of Uma, the mother of the universe, those which were narrated to Vyasa the great Atman by Sanatkumara
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां विघ्रं चक्रे महात्मभिः । येन भार्या हृता पूर्वं कृतोद्वाहः परस्य वै
verses.transliteration: pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ vighraṃ cakre mahātmabhiḥ | yena bhāryā hṛtā pūrvaṃ kṛtodvāhaḥ parasya vai
verses.translation: All of you are blessed great souls; steady in your devotional rites to the goddess. Now listen devotedly to the well-guarded secret of the great Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you are blessed great souls; steady in your devotional rites to the goddess. Now listen devotedly to the well-guarded secret of the great Sakti.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बलात्कामाच्च मोहाच्च संहर्षाच्च यदोत्कटात् । जहार कन्यां कामाच्च कस्यचित्पुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: balātkāmācca mohācca saṃharṣācca yadotkaṭāt | jahāra kanyāṃ kāmācca kasyacitpuravāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, O intelligent son of Brahma, I wish to hear the wonderful holy rites of Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient Sanatkumara, O intelligent son of Brahma, I wish to hear the wonderful holy rites of Uma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मसङ्गिनं तं तु राजा त्रय्यारुणिस्त्यजन् । अपध्वंसेति बहुशोऽवदत्क्रोधसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: adharmasaṅginaṃ taṃ tu rājā trayyāruṇistyajan | apadhvaṃseti bahuśo'vadatkrodhasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Three paths of the glorious mother have been narrated which yield both worldly pleasures and salvation. They are paths of knowledge, holy rites and devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three paths of the glorious mother have been narrated which yield both worldly pleasures and salvation. They are paths of knowledge, holy rites and devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पितरं सोऽब्रवीन्द् दुष्टः क्व गच्छामीति वै तदा । वस श्वपाकनिकटे राजा प्राहेति तं तदा
verses.transliteration: pitaraṃ so'bravīnd duṣṭaḥ kva gacchāmīti vai tadā | vasa śvapākanikaṭe rājā prāheti taṃ tadā
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the chief reason of liberation is the Yoga. Kriyayoga is the greatest means of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, the chief reason of liberation is the Yoga. Kriyayoga is the greatest means of liberation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स हि सत्यव्रतस्तेन श्वपाकवसथान्तिके । पित्रा त्यक्तोऽवसद्वीरो धर्मपालेन भूभुजा
verses.transliteration: sa hi satyavratastena śvapākavasathāntike | pitrā tyakto'vasadvīro dharmapālena bhūbhujā
verses.translation: One shall know the Maya as Pralqrti and the wielder of Maya as the eternal Brahman. After realising the identity of the two one is released from the world by bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall know the Maya as Pralqrti and the wielder of Maya as the eternal Brahman. After realising the identity of the two one is released from the world by bondage.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रय्यारुणी राजा विरक्तः पुत्रकर्मणा । स शङ्करतपः कर्तुं सर्वं त्यक्त्वा वनं ययौ
verses.transliteration: tatastrayyāruṇī rājā viraktaḥ putrakarmaṇā | sa śaṅkaratapaḥ kartuṃ sarvaṃ tyaktvā vanaṃ yayau
verses.translation: O Vyasa, listen to the merit of the person who builds a temple to the goddess either of stone or of wood or of mud. He who builds a temple to the goddess attains the benefit which a person who worships every day through Yoga attains in plenty. That virtuous soul who builds the temple for the glorious mother enables a thousand past and a thousand future members of his family to attain liberation.
verses.wordMeaning: O Vyasa, listen to the merit of the person who builds a temple to the goddess either of stone or of wood or of mud. He who builds a temple to the goddess attains the benefit which a person who worships every day through Yoga attains in plenty.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vyasa, listen to the merit of the person who builds a temple to the goddess either of stone or of wood or of mud. He who builds a temple to the goddess attains the benefit which a person who worships every day through Yoga attains in plenty.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्य स्वविषये नावर्षत्पाकशासनः । समा द्वादश विप्रर्षे तेनाधर्मेण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: tatastasya svaviṣaye nāvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ | samā dvādaśa viprarṣe tenādharmeṇa vai tadā
verses.translation: The sins committed by a person in a crore of births, whether they be small or big, are quelled at the very moment when the foimdation for temple of the glorious mother is laid.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sins committed by a person in a crore of births, whether they be small or big, are quelled at the very moment when the foimdation for temple of the glorious mother is laid.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दारांस्तस्य तु विषये विश्वामित्रो महातपाः । सन्त्यज्य सागरानूपे चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: dārāṃstasya tu viṣaye viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ | santyajya sāgarānūpe cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious great Amba is the most excellent among all the deities just as Ganga and Sona among the rivers, the earth in forbearance, the ocean in majesty and the sun among the planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious great Amba is the most excellent among all the deities just as Ganga and Sona among the rivers, the earth in forbearance, the ocean in majesty and the sun among the planets.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी गले बद्ध्वा मध्यमं पुत्रमौरसम् । शेषस्य भरणार्थाय व्यक्रीणाद्गोशतेन च
verses.transliteration: tasya patnī gale baddhvā madhyamaṃ putramaurasam | śeṣasya bharaṇārthāya vyakrīṇādgośatena ca
verses.translation: Not identifijcd.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not identifijcd.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां तु दृष्ट्वा गले बद्धं विक्रीणन्तीं स्वमात्मजम् । महर्षिपुत्रं धर्मात्मा मोचयामास तं तदा
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā gale baddhaṃ vikrīṇantīṃ svamātmajam | maharṣiputraṃ dharmātmā mocayāmāsa taṃ tadā
verses.translation: He who makes idols with the full complement of characteristics fearlessly attains indeed the great, region of Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes idols with the full complement of characteristics fearlessly attains indeed the great, region of Uma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रतो महाबाहुर्भरणं तस्य चाकरोत् । विश्वामित्रस्य तुष्ट्यर्थमनुक्रोशार्थमेव च
verses.transliteration: satyavrato mahābāhurbharaṇaṃ tasya cākarot | viśvāmitrasya tuṣṭyarthamanukrośārthameva ca
verses.translation: After installing the image of the goddess, in the auspicious stars, planets and the season, man becomes con¬ tented and blessed by the favour of the Yogamaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After installing the image of the goddess, in the auspicious stars, planets and the season, man becomes con¬ tented and blessed by the favour of the Yogamaya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदारभ्य स पुत्रस्तु विश्वामित्रस्य वै मुनेः । अभवद्गालवो नाम गलबन्धान्महातपाः
verses.transliteration: tadārabhya sa putrastu viśvāmitrasya vai muneḥ | abhavadgālavo nāma galabandhānmahātapāḥ
verses.translation: After installing an auspicious image of the goddess one can redeem the men of one's family both of the past and the future.
verses.commentary: Sense: After installing an auspicious image of the goddess one can redeem the men of one's family both of the past and the future.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have resorted only to the goddess the cause of the universe, are not or4inary men. They are the Ganas of the Goddess herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have resorted only to the goddess the cause of the universe, are not or4inary men. They are the Ganas of the Goddess herself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have resorted only to the goddess the cause of the universe, are not or4inary men. They are the Ganas of the Goddess herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have resorted only to the goddess the cause of the universe, are not or4inary men. They are the Ganas of the Goddess herself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं पञ्ञम्युमासंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३८. अष्टात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सत्यव्रतादिसगरपर्यन्तवंशवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । सत्यव्रतस्तु तद्भक्त्या कृपया च प्रतिज्ञया । विश्वामित्रकलत्रं च पोषयामास वै तदा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 5.38. aṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | satyavratādisagaraparyantavaṃśavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | satyavratastu tadbhaktyā kṛpayā ca pratijñayā | viśvāmitrakalatraṃ ca poṣayāmāsa vai tadā
verses.translation: Those who repeat the two syllables "U-ma" day and night, sitting, sleeping or moving become Siva's Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who repeat the two syllables "U-ma" day and night, sitting, sleeping or moving become Siva's Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा मृगान्वराहांश्च महिषांश्च वनेचरान् । विश्वामित्राश्रमाभ्याशे तन्मांसं चाक्षिपन्मुने
verses.transliteration: hatvā mṛgānvarāhāṃśca mahiṣāṃśca vanecarān | viśvāmitrāśramābhyāśe tanmāṃsaṃ cākṣipanmune
verses.translation: Jananisukta, Srisukta or Devisukta shall be recited or Mulamantra shall be chanted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jananisukta, Srisukta or Devisukta shall be recited or Mulamantra shall be chanted.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं गां चैव गात्रं च तथैवान्तःपुरं मुनिः । याज्योपाध्यायसंयोगाद्वसिष्ठः पर्यरक्षत
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ gāṃ caiva gātraṃ ca tathaivāntaḥpuraṃ muniḥ | yājyopādhyāyasaṃyogādvasiṣṭhaḥ paryarakṣata
verses.translation: In accordance with the wealth that one has, one shall perform the festival of chanoi which is extremely pleasing to the goddess, on the third day of the bright half of the month of Adha.
verses.commentary: Sense: In accordance with the wealth that one has, one shall perform the festival of chanoi which is extremely pleasing to the goddess, on the third day of the bright half of the month of Adha.

verses.transliteration: satyavratasya vākyādvā bhāvino'rthasya vai balāt | vasiṣṭho'bhyadhikaṃ manyuṃ dhārayāmāsa nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Rites such as Umaniahesvara and others are alsc pleasing to the goddess. They shall be performed devotedly by those who are desirous of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rites such as Umaniahesvara and others are alsc pleasing to the goddess. They shall be performed devotedly by those who are desirous of salvation.
