verses.commentary: Sense: He shall wash hands, feet and perform Acamana twice remembering Om. He shall face the north and clean his teeth always with leaves or grass except on the eleventh and the New-moon day. He shall rinse the mouth by gargling twelve times.
verses.science: यतियोंको ही देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकारादिषु वर्णेषु व्यापकं चोत्तरोत्तरम् । व्याप्यं त्वधस्तनं वर्णमेवं सर्वत्र भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: akārādiṣu varṇeṣu vyāpakaṃ cottarottaram | vyāpyaṃ tvadhastanaṃ varṇamevaṃ sarvatra bhāvayet
verses.translation: After performing Acamana twice he shall clean the hips with water and clay. At the time of dawn he shall take his bath using clay.
verses.hindi: तीर्थयात्राके प्रसंगसे पृथ्वीपर भ्रमण करने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Acamana twice he shall clean the hips with water and clay. At the time of dawn he shall take his bath using clay.
verses.science: तीर्थयात्राके प्रसंगसे पृथ्वीपर भ्रमण करने लगे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्यादीशानपर्यन्तान्यकारादिषु पञ्चसु । स्थितानि पञ्च ब्रह्माणि तानि मन्मूर्त्तयः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sadyādīśānaparyantānyakārādiṣu pañcasu | sthitāni pañca brahmāṇi tāni manmūrttayaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: The bath and the Sandhya prayers shall be per- formed with thoughts on the preceptor and me. The pro¬ cedure of bath is not detailed here for fear of prolixity. That
verses.commentary: Sense: The bath and the Sandhya prayers shall be per- formed with thoughts on the preceptor and me. The pro¬ cedure of bath is not detailed here for fear of prolixity. That
verses.science: और शिवजीके धामको चले गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ कलाः समाख्याता अकारे सद्यजाः शिवे । उकारे वामरूपिण्यस्त्रयोदश समीरिताः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau kalāḥ samākhyātā akāre sadyajāḥ śive | ukāre vāmarūpiṇyastrayodaśa samīritāḥ
verses.translation: Joining the palms so as to from the Sahkhamudra
verses.commentary: Sense: Joining the palms so as to from the Sahkhamudra
verses.science: प्रणवार्धपद्धतिवर्णन॑ नाम नवमी5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टावघोररूपिण्यो मकारे संस्थिताः कलाः । बिन्दौ चतस्रः सम्भूताः कलाः पुरुषगोचराः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāvaghorarūpiṇyo makāre saṃsthitāḥ kalāḥ | bindau catasraḥ sambhūtāḥ kalāḥ puruṣagocarāḥ
verses.translation: He shall go to the bank and wash the lom-cloth. He shall perform the Acamana twice. Repeating the Pranava he shall sprinkle water over the towel and wipe off the body.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक नौंवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall go to the bank and wash the lom-cloth. He shall perform the Acamana twice. Repeating the Pranava he shall sprinkle water over the towel and wipe off the body.
verses.science: वर्णन नामक नौंवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नादे पञ्च समाख्याताः कला ईशानसम्भवाः । षड्विधैक्यानुसन्धानात्प्रपञ्चात्मकतोच्यते
verses.transliteration: nāde pañca samākhyātāḥ kalā īśānasambhavāḥ | ṣaḍvidhaikyānusandhānātprapañcātmakatocyate
verses.translation: He shall wipe off his face first and then the head and other parts of the body standing by the side of the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall wipe off his face first and then the head and other parts of the body standing by the side of the preceptor.
verses.science: तो हमलोगोंने भुला दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रो यन्त्रं देवता च प्रपञ्चो गुरुरेव च । शिष्यश्च षट्पदार्थानामेषामर्थं शृणु प्रिये
verses.transliteration: mantro yantraṃ devatā ca prapañco gurureva ca | śiṣyaśca ṣaṭpadārthānāmeṣāmarthaṃ śṛṇu priye
verses.translation: A pure loin-cloth shall be tied with its string with the knot on the left side. Then he shall smear his body with the ashes. O daughter of the mountain, now I tell you the procedure thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: A pure loin-cloth shall be tied with its string with the knot on the left side. Then he shall smear his body with the ashes. O daughter of the mountain, now I tell you the procedure thereof.
verses.science: महर्षियोंके द्वारा निर्दिष्ट आसनपर बैठे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चवर्णसमष्टिः स्यान्मन्त्रः पूर्वमुदाहृतः । स एव यन्त्रतां प्राप्तो वक्ष्ये तन्मण्डलक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: pañcavarṇasamaṣṭiḥ syānmantraḥ pūrvamudāhṛtaḥ | sa eva yantratāṃ prāpto vakṣye tanmaṇḍalakramam
verses.translation: After performing the Acamana twice he shall take the ashes repeating the Sadyadi mantra'®. Then repeating the mantras "Agniriti"* he shall touch the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Acamana twice he shall take the ashes repeating the Sadyadi mantra'®. Then repeating the mantras "Agniriti"* he shall touch the body.
verses.science: प्रकार कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यन्त्रं तु देवतारूपं देवता विश्वरूपिणी । विश्वरूपो गुरुः प्रोक्तः शिष्यो गुरुवपुः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yantraṃ tu devatārūpaṃ devatā viśvarūpiṇī | viśvarūpo guruḥ proktaḥ śiṣyo guruvapuḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Repeating the mantra "Apo vai — he shall mix the ashes with water. He shall make two balls of the pasted ashes with the mantras "Om Apo Jyotl"® and "Ma Nastokc"' — He shall divide one of the balls into five, O goddess, and apply each respectively to the head, face, chest, private parts and the feet.
verses.hindi: उद्देश्यसे आया हूँ, उसका वृत्तान्त आपलोग सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: Repeating the mantra "Apo vai — he shall mix the ashes with water. He shall make two balls of the pasted ashes with the mantras "Om Apo Jyotl"® and "Ma Nastokc"' — He shall divide one of the balls into five, O goddess, and apply each respectively to the head, face, chest,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating the mantra "Apo vai — he shall mix the ashes with water. He shall make two balls of the pasted ashes with the mantras "Om Apo Jyotl"® and "Ma Nastokc"' — He shall divide one of the balls into five, O goddess, and apply each respectively to the head, face, chest,…
verses.science: उद्देश्यसे आया हूँ, उसका वृत्तान्त आपलोग सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ओमितीदं सर्वमिति सर्वं ब्रह्मेति च श्रुतेः । वाच्यवाचकसम्बन्धोऽप्ययमेवार्थ ईरितः
verses.transliteration: omitīdaṃ sarvamiti sarvaṃ brahmeti ca śruteḥ | vācyavācakasambandho'pyayamevārtha īritaḥ
verses.translation: He shall repeat the mantra beginning with "Isana* — " and ending with "Sadya." After applying the ashes he shall repeat Om touching all the parts of the body. He shall wash his hands, feet and take the other ball. Ador¬ ing as before he shall apply three parallel lines on the forehead repeating the mantra 'Tryayusa'* and the 'Tryambaka'.**' He shall apply the same on the chest with the Pranava and on the shoulders with "Orh Namah Sivaya."
verses.wordMeaning: He shall repeat the mantra beginning with "Isana* — " and ending with "Sadya." After applying the ashes he shall repeat Om touching all the parts of the body. He shall wash his hands, feet and take the other ball.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall repeat the mantra beginning with "Isana* — " and ending with "Sadya." After applying the ashes he shall repeat Om touching all the parts of the body. He shall wash his hands, feet and take the other ball.…
verses.science: आपलोगोंसे कह रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारो मणिपूरश्च हृदयं तु ततः परम् । विशुद्धिराज्ञा च ततः शक्तिः शान्तिरिति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ādhāro maṇipūraśca hṛdayaṃ tu tataḥ param | viśuddhirājñā ca tataḥ śaktiḥ śāntiriti kramāt
verses.translation: Uttering Paftrikarana mantra, the scholarly ascetic shall think of his preceptor. In the manner as explained hereafter he shall perform six Pranayamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttering Paftrikarana mantra, the scholarly ascetic shall think of his preceptor. In the manner as explained hereafter he shall perform six Pranayamas.
verses.science: महीनेका समय उस क्षेत्रमें बिताया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थानान्येतानि देवेशि शान्त्यतीतं परात्परम् । अधिकारी भवेद्यस्य वैराग्यं जायते दृढम्
verses.transliteration: sthānānyetāni deveśi śāntyatītaṃ parātparam | adhikārī bhavedyasya vairāgyaṃ jāyate dṛḍham
verses.translation: Touching the navel, the joints of the arms and the back in order he shall wash both the hands duly and perform Acamana twice. He shall take some water in the right hand and cover it with the left hand. Pranava is then repeated twelve times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Touching the navel, the joints of the arms and the back in order he shall wash both the hands duly and perform Acamana twice. He shall take some water in the right hand and cover it with the left hand. Pranava is then repeated twelve times.
verses.science: आकाशवाणी विरत गयी। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: विषयः स्यामहं देवि जीवब्रह्मैक्यभावनात् । सम्बन्धं शृणु देवेशि विषयः सम्यगीरितः
verses.transliteration: viṣayaḥ syāmahaṃ devi jīvabrahmaikyabhāvanāt | sambandhaṃ śṛṇu deveśi viṣayaḥ samyagīritaḥ
verses.translation: Sprinkling this water thrice on the head he shall drink water thrice meditating on Ohkara — Siva with
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां सूतोपदेशो नाम दशमोउध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Sprinkling this water thrice on the head he shall drink water thrice meditating on Ohkara — Siva with
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां सूतोपदेशो नाम दशमोउध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवात्मनो मया सार्धमैक्यस्य प्रणवस्य च । वाच्यवाचकभावोऽत्र संवन्धः समुदीरितः
verses.transliteration: jīvātmano mayā sārdhamaikyasya praṇavasya ca | vācyavācakabhāvo'tra saṃvandhaḥ samudīritaḥ
verses.translation: VS. iG. iG
verses.hindi: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीजशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत छठी कैलाससंहितामें सूतोपदेश नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.explanation: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीजशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत छठी कैलाससंहितामें सूतोपदेश नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीजशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत छठी कैलाससंहितामें सूतोपदेश नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रतादिनिरतः शान्तस्तपस्वी विजितेन्द्रियः । शौचाचारसमायुक्तो भूदेवो वेदनिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: vratādinirataḥ śāntastapasvī vijitendriyaḥ | śaucācārasamāyukto bhūdevo vedaniṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: VS. 3. 6j
verses.hindi: ऐसा आपने इस समय प्रदर्शित कर दिया
verses.explanation: ऐसा आपने इस समय प्रदर्शित कर दिया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ऐसा आपने इस समय प्रदर्शित कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विषयेषु विरक्तः सन्नैहिकामुष्मिकेषु च । देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च सद्भक्तश्च शिवव्रती
verses.transliteration: viṣayeṣu viraktaḥ sannaihikāmuṣmikeṣu ca | devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sadbhaktaśca śivavratī
verses.translation: After performing the Japa of Gayatri hundred and eight times, he shall offer Tarpana twelve times. After per¬ forming the Acamana he shall perform Pranayama thrice.
verses.hindi: चाहते हैं, अत: आप प्रेमपूर्वक उसे कहिये
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Japa of Gayatri hundred and eight times, he shall offer Tarpana twelve times. After per¬ forming the Acamana he shall perform Pranayama thrice.
verses.science: चाहते हैं, अत: आप प्रेमपूर्वक उसे कहिये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञं वेदान्तज्ञानपारगम् । आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य यतिं मतिमतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaṃ vedāntajñānapāragam | ācāryamupasaṅgamya yatiṃ matimatāṃ varam
verses.translation: He shall enter it duly placing the right foot at first. Inside the Mandapa there, he, the intelligent ascetic, shall draw the mystic diagram in due order.
verses.hindi: एवं प्रणवस्वरूप आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall enter it duly placing the right foot at first. Inside the Mandapa there, he, the intelligent ascetic, shall draw the mystic diagram in due order.
verses.science: एवं प्रणवस्वरूप आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घदण्डप्रणामाद्यैस्तोषयेद्यत्नतः सुधीः । शान्त्यादिगुणसंयुक्तः शिष्यः सौशील्यवान्वरः
verses.transliteration: dīrghadaṇḍapraṇāmādyaistoṣayedyatnataḥ sudhīḥ | śāntyādiguṇasaṃyuktaḥ śiṣyaḥ sauśīlyavānvaraḥ
verses.translation: The ground.shall be tested duly on the basis of smell, colour and taste. In a spot pleasing to the mind the space above shall be covered with a canopy, the ground below shall be scrubbed and cleaned so much as to appear like the surface of a mirror. A square of sides two Aratnis each shall be drawn.
verses.wordMeaning: The ground.shall be tested duly on the basis of smell, colour and taste. In a spot pleasing to the mind the space above shall be covered with a canopy, the ground below shall be scrubbed and cleaned so much as to appear like the surface of a mirror.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground.shall be tested duly on the basis of smell, colour and taste. In a spot pleasing to the mind the space above shall be covered with a canopy, the ground below shall be scrubbed and cleaned so much as to appear like the surface of a mirror.…
verses.science: एवं गुह्मशास्त्रवेत्ताको बार-बार नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो गुरुः स शिवः प्रोक्तो यः शिवः स गुरुः स्मृतः । इति निश्चित्य मनसा स्वविचारं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo guruḥ sa śivaḥ prokto yaḥ śivaḥ sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ | iti niścitya manasā svavicāraṃ nivedayet
verses.translation: Make small squares within the width of a palm-leaf each. Thus there shall be thirteen equal squares in each column.
verses.commentary: Sense: Make small squares within the width of a palm-leaf each. Thus there shall be thirteen equal squares in each column.
verses.science: आप स्कन्दको सर्वदा नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्धानुज्ञस्तु गुरुणा द्वादशाहं पयोव्रती । समुद्रतीरे नद्यां च पर्वते वा शिवालये
verses.transliteration: labdhānujñastu guruṇā dvādaśāhaṃ payovratī | samudratīre nadyāṃ ca parvate vā śivālaye
verses.translation: The ascetic shall put the piece of palm leaf inside the square and sit facing the west. Towards the east a strong coloured thread shall be fixed. Threads shall be put in all the four directions. Thus there will be one hundred and sixtynine squares. The middle square is the pericarp. The squares adjoining it around in the outside, eight in number, are called eight petals.
verses.hindi: एवं बारह रूपोंवाले आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The ascetic shall put the piece of palm leaf inside the square and sit facing the west. Towards the east a strong coloured thread shall be fixed. Threads shall be put in all the four directions. Thus there will be one hundred and sixtynine squares.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic shall put the piece of palm leaf inside the square and sit facing the west. Towards the east a strong coloured thread shall be fixed. Threads shall be put in all the four directions. Thus there will be one hundred and sixtynine squares.…
verses.science: एवं बारह रूपोंवाले आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लपक्षे तु पञ्चम्यामेकादश्यां तथापि वा । प्रातः स्नात्वा तु शुद्धात्मा कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: śuklapakṣe tu pañcamyāmekādaśyāṃ tathāpi vā | prātaḥ snātvā tu śuddhātmā kṛtanityakriyaḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: All the petals shall be made white completely. The pericarp shall be made yellow in colour and a red circle shall be drawn within. O goddess, beginning with the petal ofindra to the right hand side the bordering lines shall be coloured alternatively black and red.
verses.hindi: असुरोंका वध करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: All the petals shall be made white completely. The pericarp shall be made yellow in colour and a red circle shall be drawn within. O goddess, beginning with the petal ofindra to the right hand side the bordering lines shall be coloured alternatively black and red.
verses.science: असुरोंका वध करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुमाहूय विधिना नान्दीश्राद्धं विधाय च । क्षौरं च कारयित्वाथ कक्षोपस्थविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: gurumāhūya vidhinā nāndīśrāddhaṃ vidhāya ca | kṣauraṃ ca kārayitvātha kakṣopasthavivarjitam
verses.translation: The Yantra illuminating the meaning of the Pranava shall be written inside the pericarp. The pedestal shall be drawn beneath. Srikantha shall be drawn above it. Amaresa shall be drawn above it and Mahakala in the middle. On the top of it the staff and beyond that Isvara shall be drawn.
verses.wordMeaning: The Yantra illuminating the meaning of the Pranava shall be written inside the pericarp. The pedestal shall be drawn beneath. Srikantha shall be drawn above it. Amaresa shall be drawn above it and Mahakala in the middle.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yantra illuminating the meaning of the Pranava shall be written inside the pericarp. The pedestal shall be drawn beneath. Srikantha shall be drawn above it. Amaresa shall be drawn above it and Mahakala in the middle.…
verses.science: रहनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: केशश्मश्रुनखानां वै स्नात्वा नियतमानसः । सक्तुं प्राश्याथ सायाह्ने स्नात्वा सन्ध्यामुपास्य च
verses.transliteration: keśaśmaśrunakhānāṃ vai snātvā niyatamānasaḥ | saktuṃ prāśyātha sāyāhne snātvā sandhyāmupāsya ca
verses.translation: The Piflia shall be coloured blue. 8rikantha ii yellow, Amaresa in red, and Mahakala in black.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Piflia shall be coloured blue. 8rikantha ii yellow, Amaresa in red, and Mahakala in black.
verses.science: आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सायमौपासनं कृत्वा गुरुणा सहितो द्विजः । शास्त्रोक्तदक्षिणां दत्त्वा शिवाय गुरुरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: sāyamaupāsanaṃ kṛtvā guruṇā sahito dvijaḥ | śāstroktadakṣiṇāṃ dattvā śivāya gururūpiṇe
verses.translation: The scholarly ascetic shall make the staff smoky coloured and lvara white in colour. After di awing the Yantra the red one (Amaresa) shall be cnccnnpassed by Sadya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholarly ascetic shall make the staff smoky coloured and lvara white in colour. After di awing the Yantra the red one (Amaresa) shall be cnccnnpassed by Sadya.
verses.science: कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: होमद्रव्याणि सम्पाद्य स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः । अग्निमाधाय विधिवल्लौकिकादिविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: homadravyāṇi sampādya svasūtroktavidhānataḥ | agnimādhāya vidhivallaukikādivibhedataḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, only through the Nada Isana shall be known. The rows of its residence shall be taken in order from the south-east one.
verses.hindi: कृपा है, जो आप मुझसे ऐसा कह रहे हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, only through the Nada Isana shall be known. The rows of its residence shall be taken in order from the south-east one.
verses.science: कृपा है, जो आप मुझसे ऐसा कह रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निस्तु यः कुर्यात्प्राजापत्येष्टिनाहिते । श्रौते वैश्वानरे सम्यक् सर्ववेदसदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: āhitāgnistu yaḥ kuryātprājāpatyeṣṭināhite | śraute vaiśvānare samyak sarvavedasadakṣiṇam
verses.translation: The four squares at the four corners, O beauti¬ ful lady, shall be painted white. The first four letters a, a i and i shall be written with red minerals and these four are conceived as doors. The two squares adjacent to each of these four shall be painted yellow.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four squares at the four corners, O beauti¬ ful lady, shall be painted white. The first four letters a, a i and i shall be written with red minerals and these four are conceived as doors. The two squares adjacent to each of these four shall be painted yellow.
verses.science: इस दुस्साहसको क्षमा कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथाग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य ब्राह्मणः प्रव्रजेद् गृहात् । श्रपयित्वा चरुं तस्मिन्समिदन्नाज्यभेदतः
verses.transliteration: athāgnimātmanyāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed gṛhāt | śrapayitvā caruṃ tasminsamidannājyabhedataḥ
verses.translation: With purity of mind he shall draw the letter 'ha* in the middle along with the Bindu. In the south-west square of this lotus he shall draw another red lotus with yellow filaments and pericarp. The third letter of the class of Sa along with the sixth vowel and the fouitcenlh vowel de¬ corated with Bindu and Nada is, O gentle lady, the excellent Bija which shall be written in the middle of the lotus.
verses.wordMeaning: With purity of mind he shall draw the letter 'ha* in the middle along with the Bindu. In the south-west square of this lotus he shall draw another red lotus with yellow filaments and pericarp.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With purity of mind he shall draw the letter 'ha* in the middle along with the Bindu. In the south-west square of this lotus he shall draw another red lotus with yellow filaments and pericarp.…
verses.science: है, परिपूर्णस्वरूप आपको नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषेणैव सूक्तेन हुत्वा प्रत्यृचमात्मवान् । हुत्वा च सौविष्टकृतीं स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः
verses.transliteration: pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena hutvā pratyṛcamātmavān | hutvā ca sauviṣṭakṛtīṃ svasūtroktavidhānataḥ
verses.translation: In the north-east.square of the lotus another lotus shall be drawn with the third letter of the class of "ka'*
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाले, व्यापक और सबके स्वामी हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: In the north-east.square of the lotus another lotus shall be drawn with the third letter of the class of "ka'*
verses.science: धारण करनेवाले, व्यापक और सबके स्वामी हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वोपरिष्टात्तन्त्रं च तेनाग्नेरुत्तरे बुधः । स्थित्वासने जपेन्मौनी चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरे । यावद् ब्राह्ममुहूर्त्तं तु गायत्रीं दृढमानसः
verses.transliteration: hutvopariṣṭāttantraṃ ca tenāgneruttare budhaḥ | sthitvāsane japenmaunī cailājinakuśottare | yāvad brāhmamuhūrttaṃ tu gāyatrīṃ dṛḍhamānasaḥ
verses.translation: The most excellent of the knowers of the rules shall make the leaves red in colour. Outside the leaves the cavities shall be filled with black colour.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे प्रष्ठयां कैलाससंहितायां वामदेवब्रह्मवर्णन॑ नामैकादशो: ध्याय
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent of the knowers of the rules shall make the leaves red in colour. Outside the leaves the cavities shall be filled with black colour.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे प्रष्ठयां कैलाससंहितायां वामदेवब्रह्मवर्णन॑ नामैकादशो: ध्याय। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नात्वा यथापूर्वं श्रपयित्वा चरुं ततः । पौरुषं सूक्तमारभ्य विरजान्तं हुनेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ snātvā yathāpūrvaṃ śrapayitvā caruṃ tataḥ | pauruṣaṃ sūktamārabhya virajāntaṃ huned budhaḥ
verses.translation: The south-east square and others, four in number, shall be filled with white paint. With six Hindus a six-sided figure shall be drawn in black in the east.
verses.commentary: Sense: The south-east square and others, four in number, shall be filled with white paint. With six Hindus a six-sided figure shall be drawn in black in the east.
verses.science: नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवमतेनापि शौनकादिमतेन वा । तत्र मुख्यं वामदेव्यं गर्भयुक्तो यतो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: vāmadevamatenāpi śaunakādimatena vā | tatra mukhyaṃ vāmadevyaṃ garbhayukto yato muniḥ
verses.translation: To the south it shall be painted red. In the north a triangle is painted in white. In the west a crescent moon is painted in yellow.
verses.hindi: परमभक्त हैं तथा शिवज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south it shall be painted red. In the north a triangle is painted in white. In the west a crescent moon is painted in yellow.
verses.science: परमभक्त हैं तथा शिवज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: होमशेषं समाप्याथ प्रातरौपासनं हुनेत् । ततोऽग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य प्रातः सन्ध्यमुपास्य च
verses.transliteration: homaśeṣaṃ samāpyātha prātaraupāsanaṃ hunet | tato'gnimātmanyāropya prātaḥ sandhyamupāsya ca
verses.translation: The four Bijas shall be written in the squares in order. The Hindu shall be drawn in the east in white. In the south is painted in black the letter U; in the north, letter ma' is painted in red; in the west letter 'a' is painted yellow; thus the four letters are written.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four Bijas shall be written in the squares in order. The Hindu shall be drawn in the east in white. In the south is painted in black the letter U; in the north, letter ma' is painted in red; in the west letter 'a' is painted yellow; thus the four letters are written.
verses.science: करनेवाले आपसे कह रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सवितर्युदिते पश्चात्सावित्रीं प्राविशेत्क्रमात् । एषणानां त्रयं त्यक्त्वा प्रेषमुच्चार्य च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: savitaryudite paścātsāvitrīṃ prāviśetkramāt | eṣaṇānāṃ trayaṃ tyaktvā preṣamuccārya ca kramāt
verses.translation: In the second row from the top O beautiful lady, one shall begin. The first four squares are respectively pain¬ ted yellow, white, red and black. Below that the four arc painted white, blue, yellow and red respectively. O good-faced lady, below that in the triangle it shall be painted red white and yellow.
verses.wordMeaning: In the second row from the top O beautiful lady, one shall begin. The first four squares are respectively pain¬ ted yellow, white, red and black. Below that the four arc painted white, blue, yellow and red respectively. O good-faced lady,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second row from the top O beautiful lady, one shall begin. The first four squares are respectively pain¬ ted yellow, white, red and black. Below that the four arc painted white, blue, yellow and red respectively. O good-faced lady,…
verses.science: प्रणवात्मक तत्त्वको कहूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिखोपवीते सन्त्यज्य कटिसूत्रादिकं ततः । विसृज्य प्राङ्मुखो गच्छेदुत्तराशामुखोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: śikhopavīte santyajya kaṭisūtrādikaṃ tataḥ | visṛjya prāṅmukho gaccheduttarāśāmukho'pi vā
verses.translation: O goddess, from the south to the north the same procedure shall be adopted. In its external row it shall be painted from the east to the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, from the south to the north the same procedure shall be adopted. In its external row it shall be painted from the east to the middle.
verses.science: भगवान् परमेश्वरने ऐसा कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृह्णीयाद्दण्डकौपीनाद्युचितं लोकवर्तने । विरक्तश्चेन गृह्णीयाल्लोकवृत्तिविचारणे
verses.transliteration: gṛhṇīyāddaṇḍakaupīnādyucitaṃ lokavartane | viraktaścena gṛhṇīyāllokavṛttivicāraṇe
verses.translation: The colours arc yellow, red, black, blue, white and yellow. O beloved, from the south-east onwards colours are red, blue, white, red, black and red. Thus the colours of the six squares are mentioned: from the south to the cast; from the south-west to the south-east; from the west to the south; from the north-west to the south-west; from the north to the west; from the north-east, to the north-west. O goddess, thus the procedure of the diagram has been men¬ tioned to you. Having drawn the diagram thus the ascetic with restrained mind shall worship the sun with devotion.
verses.wordMeaning: The colours arc yellow, red, black, blue, white and yellow. O beloved, from the south-east onwards colours are red, blue, white, red, black and red. Thus the colours of the six squares are mentioned: from the south to the cast; from the south-west to the south-east;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The colours arc yellow, red, black, blue, white and yellow. O beloved, from the south-east onwards colours are red, blue, white, red, black and red. Thus the colours of the six squares are mentioned: from the south to the cast; from the south-west to the south-east;…
verses.science: हैं--ऐसा वेदने कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरोः समीपं गत्वाथ दण्डवत्प्रणमेत्त्रयम् । समुत्थाय ततस्तिष्ठेद् गुरुपादसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: guroḥ samīpaṃ gatvātha daṇḍavatpraṇamettrayam | samutthāya tatastiṣṭhed gurupādasamīpataḥ
verses.translation: Outside he shall adore in order the diagrams of triangle circle and square repeating Om. He shall fill the conch with fragrant pure water repeating the Pranava. He shall place the conch on the diagrams and worship it with scents, flowers etc. repeating the Pranava seven times. After repeating the mantra he shall show the Dhenumudra and 6ahkhamudra. He shall sprinkle it with the Astra mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: Outside he shall adore in order the diagrams of triangle circle and square repeating Om. He shall fill the conch with fragrant pure water repeating the Pranava. He shall place the conch on the diagrams and worship it with scents, flowers etc. repeating the Pranava seven times.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Outside he shall adore in order the diagrams of triangle circle and square repeating Om. He shall fill the conch with fragrant pure water repeating the Pranava. He shall place the conch on the diagrams and worship it with scents, flowers etc. repeating the Pranava seven times.…
verses.science: पूजामें तत्पर हो जाय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो गुरुः समादाय विरजानलजं सितम् । भस्म तेनैव तं शिष्यं समुद्धूत्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: tato guruḥ samādāya virajānalajaṃ sitam | bhasma tenaiva taṃ śiṣyaṃ samuddhūtya yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Of this mantra of the glorious sun the sage is Devabhaga, the metre is Gayatri, the deity is the sun. The six-organed Nyasa shall be made with 'Hram' etc. Then he sprinkles the Padma not within the purview of Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of this mantra of the glorious sun the sage is Devabhaga, the metre is Gayatri, the deity is the sun. The six-organed Nyasa shall be made with 'Hram' etc. Then he sprinkles the Padma not within the purview of Agni.
verses.science: कह रहा हूँ; सावधानीपूर्वक सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैस्त्रिपुण्ड्रं धारयेत्ततः । हृत्पङ्कजे समासीनं मां त्वया सह चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: agnirityādibhirmantraistripuṇḍraṃ dhārayettataḥ | hṛtpaṅkaje samāsīnaṃ māṃ tvayā saha cintayet
verses.translation: Th icjcl indicates the basic mantra of Siva: sff
verses.hindi: करके उनसे अपना विचार प्रकट करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Th icjcl indicates the basic mantra of Siva: sff
verses.science: करके उनसे अपना विचार प्रकट करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तं निधाय शिरसि शिष्यस्य प्रीतमानसः । ऋष्यादिसहितं तस्य दक्षकर्णे समुच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: hastaṃ nidhāya śirasi śiṣyasya prītamānasaḥ | ṛṣyādisahitaṃ tasya dakṣakarṇe samuccaret
verses.translation: He shall worship the lower lid of Maya and and the upper lid of Vidya. Thereafter Sattva, Rajas and Tamas shall be worshipped in order. In the quarters begin¬ ning with the east and in the middle he shall worship the following: — Dipta, Suksma, Jaya, Bhadra, Vibhuti, Vimala, Amogha, Vaidyuta, Sarvatomukhasahjfla, Kandanala, Susira, then Tantukanfakas, then the root lid, filament, (light) and Sakalatman, the five-knotted pericarp and the petals, then the filaments, Brahma, Visnu, Rudra and Atman. After worshipping the inner Atman in the great Atman of knowledge he shall worship the Yogapitha called the Saura. The knower of the root shall conceive the idol as stationed on the pedestal.
verses.hindi: बदेतां प्राप्नुयावेति तौ च ब्राह्मणपुद्भवौं॥ ५८  वाक्य कहना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He shall worship the lower lid of Maya and and the upper lid of Vidya. Thereafter Sattva, Rajas and Tamas shall be worshipped in order. In the quarters begin¬ ning with the east and in the middle he shall worship the following: — Dipta, Suksma, Jaya, Bhadra, Vibhuti, Vimala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the lower lid of Maya and and the upper lid of Vidya. Thereafter Sattva, Rajas and Tamas shall be worshipped in order. In the quarters begin¬ ning with the east and in the middle he shall worship the following: — Dipta, Suksma, Jaya, Bhadra, Vibhuti, Vimala,…
verses.science: बदेतां प्राप्नुयावेति तौ च ब्राह्मणपुद्भवौं॥ ५८ वाक्य कहना चाहिए। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं त्रिःप्रकारं तु ततस्तस्यार्थमादिशेत् । षड्विधार्थं परिज्ञानसहितं गुरुसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: praṇavaṃ triḥprakāraṃ tu tatastasyārthamādiśet | ṣaḍvidhārthaṃ parijñānasahitaṃ gurusattamaḥ
verses.translation: The ascetic sits checking the vital breath with the root from the root. With the power of its splendour he raises the 6akti through the path of the Pingala nerve of the sun stationed in the circle. He causes it to come out with the handful of flowers. Of Siva whose body is as red as the Vermillion, who has his wife as his left half, who is wearing Rudraksa garland and holding a noose, a club called Khatvanga, a skull, a goad, a lotus a conch and a discus; who has four faces, twelve eyes and a spear within the lotus of his heart, he utters the Pranava first and then Hram, Hrim and Sah.
verses.hindi: ३ सत्यवसुसंज्ञका: विश्वेदेवा: नान्‍्दीमुखाः भूर्भुव: स्व: इदं वः पाद्यं पादावनेजनं पादप्रक्षालन वृद्धि:
verses.wordMeaning: The ascetic sits checking the vital breath with the root from the root. With the power of its splendour he raises the 6akti through the path of the Pingala nerve of the sun stationed in the circle. He causes it to come out with the handful of flowers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic sits checking the vital breath with the root from the root. With the power of its splendour he raises the 6akti through the path of the Pingala nerve of the sun stationed in the circle. He causes it to come out with the handful of flowers.…
verses.science: ३ सत्यवसुसंज्ञका: विश्वेदेवा: नान्‍्दीमुखाः भूर्भुव: स्व: इदं वः पाद्यं पादावनेजनं पादप्रक्षालन वृद्धि:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विषट्प्रकारं स गुरुं प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । तदधीनो भवेन्नित्यं वेदान्तं सम्यगभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: dviṣaṭprakāraṃ sa guruṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat | tadadhīno bhavennityaṃ vedāntaṃ samyagabhyaset
verses.translation: Thereafter he invokes the sun along with the light and power saying 'I invoke obeisance'. He shows the mystic signs of Sthapana etc. After performing the Nyiisa of the limbs with the mantra Hram, Hrim, Hrum and conceiv¬ ing the five services O great goddess, he shall worship thrice the six organs in the filaments of the lotus.
verses.hindi: स्व: इद वः पाद्य॑ पादावनेजनं पादप्रक्षालनं वृद्धि:
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he invokes the sun along with the light and power saying 'I invoke obeisance'. He shows the mystic signs of Sthapana etc. After performing the Nyiisa of the limbs with the mantra Hram, Hrim, Hrum and conceiv¬ ing the five services O great goddess,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he invokes the sun along with the light and power saying 'I invoke obeisance'. He shows the mystic signs of Sthapana etc. After performing the Nyiisa of the limbs with the mantra Hram, Hrim, Hrum and conceiv¬ ing the five services O great goddess,…
verses.science: स्व: इद वः पाद्य॑ पादावनेजनं पादप्रक्षालनं वृद्धि:। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मामेव चिन्तयेन्नित्यं परमात्मानमात्मनि । विशुद्धे निर्विकारे वै ब्रह्मसाक्षिणमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: māmeva cintayennityaṃ paramātmānamātmani | viśuddhe nirvikāre vai brahmasākṣiṇamavyayam
verses.translation: In the second covering the four deities shall be worshipped in the south-east, north-east south-west and the north-west. O Parvati, from east to north at the roots of the petals Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu and-Ravi.shall be worshipped in order. O beloved, in the third covering, Arka, Brahma, Rudra and Visnu shall be worshipped in the north-cast and
verses.hindi: आप लोग मेरे ऊपर कृपा करें '
verses.wordMeaning: In the second covering the four deities shall be worshipped in the south-east, north-east south-west and the north-west. O Parvati, from east to north at the roots of the petals Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu and-Ravi.shall be worshipped in order. O beloved, in the third covering,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second covering the four deities shall be worshipped in the south-east, north-east south-west and the north-west. O Parvati, from east to north at the roots of the petals Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu and-Ravi.shall be worshipped in order. O beloved, in the third covering,…
verses.science: आप लोग मेरे ऊपर कृपा करें '। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शमादिधर्मनिरतो वेदान्तज्ञानपारगः । अत्राधिकारी स प्रोक्तो यतिर्विगतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: śamādidharmanirato vedāntajñānapāragaḥ | atrādhikārī sa prokto yatirvigatamatsaraḥ
verses.translation: In the middle of the leaves from the east onwards he shall worship the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupitre, Venus, Saturn and Rahu.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of the leaves from the east onwards he shall worship the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupitre, Venus, Saturn and Rahu.
verses.science: लिये इसे जल-अक्षतसहित दे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पुण्डरीकं विरजं विशोकं विशदं परम् । अष्टपत्रं केशराढ्यं कर्णिकोपरि शोभितम्
verses.transliteration: hṛtpuṇḍarīkaṃ virajaṃ viśokaṃ viśadaṃ param | aṣṭapatraṃ keśarāḍhyaṃ karṇikopari śobhitam
verses.translation: Or he shall worship the twelve Adityas in the second covering and worship the twelve signs of zodiac in the third covering.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall worship the twelve Adityas in the second covering and worship the twelve signs of zodiac in the third covering.
verses.science: संन्यासविधिवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिमारभ्य त्रितत्वान्तमयं पदम् । विचिन्त्य मध्यतस्तस्य दहरं व्योम भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: ādhāraśaktimārabhya tritatvāntamayaṃ padam | vicintya madhyatastasya daharaṃ vyoma bhāvayet
verses.translation: He shall worship the seven oceans*-* and seven Gahgas** on its outer side and then the sages, gods, gandharvas, serpents, celestial damsels, the village chiefs, the Yaksas, Yatudhanas, the seven horses in the form of the Vedas and the Balakhilyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the seven oceans*-* and seven Gahgas** on its outer side and then the sages, gods, gandharvas, serpents, celestial damsels, the village chiefs, the Yaksas, Yatudhanas, the seven horses in the form of the Vedas and the Balakhilyas.
verses.science: आदि पूजन-सामग्रियोंको एकत्रित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मां त्वया सह । चिन्तयेन्मध्यतस्तस्य नित्यमुद्युक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāṃ tvayā saha | cintayenmadhyatastasya nityamudyuktamānasaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping the sun of three coverings and then arranging the square diagram with pious attention he shall place a copper vessel that can hold a prastha of water on its stand. He shall fill it with pure water rendered fragrant with flowers. He shall worship it with scents, flowers and kneel on the ground. The arghya vessel shall be lifted upto the middle of the eyebrows.
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping the sun of three coverings and then arranging the square diagram with pious attention he shall place a copper vessel that can hold a prastha of water on its stand. He shall fill it with pure water rendered fragrant with flowers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the sun of three coverings and then arranging the square diagram with pious attention he shall place a copper vessel that can hold a prastha of water on its stand. He shall fill it with pure water rendered fragrant with flowers.…
verses.science: गायत्रीमन्त्रका जप करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधोपासकस्य मल्लोकगतिमेव च । मत्तो विज्ञानमासाद्य मत्सायुज्यफलं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhopāsakasya mallokagatimeva ca | matto vijñānamāsādya matsāyujyaphalaṃ priye
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of the colour of vcrmillion, of good disc wearing diamond for the ornament, having eyes resembling lotus, of good lotus and cause of Brahma, Indra and Visnu. O lord, be pleased to accept this holy arghya oflfered by me along with the red powder, cloured water, garland, vermilion, kusa grass, flowers and a golden pot.
verses.hindi: गयी है; इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you of the colour of vcrmillion, of good disc wearing diamond for the ornament, having eyes resembling lotus, of good lotus and cause of Brahma, Indra and Visnu. O lord, be pleased to accept this holy arghya oflfered by me along with the red powder, cloured water,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you of the colour of vcrmillion, of good disc wearing diamond for the ornament, having eyes resembling lotus, of good lotus and cause of Brahma, Indra and Visnu. O lord, be pleased to accept this holy arghya oflfered by me along with the red powder, cloured water,…
verses.science: गयी है; इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.science: त्रिगुणात्मिका, निर्गुणा एवं अजा हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.science: नरकमें यातना प्राप्त करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न होकर उसीमें लीन होती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.science: उत्पन्न होकर उसीमें लीन होती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । संन्यासाचारवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि संन्यासाह्निककर्म च । तव स्नेहान्महादेवि सम्प्रदायानुरोधतः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā 6.4. caturtho'dhyāyaḥ | saṃnyāsācāravarṇanam | īśvara uvāca | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃnyāsāhnikakarma ca | tava snehānmahādevi sampradāyānurodhataḥ
verses.translation: With these Bijas duly uttered the scholarly ascetic shall bow to the preceptor and the lord of Ganas stationed on the arms and thighs.
verses.commentary: Sense: With these Bijas duly uttered the scholarly ascetic shall bow to the preceptor and the lord of Ganas stationed on the arms and thighs.
verses.science: राजाधिराज तथा महाबीजस्वरूप है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त्त उत्थाय शिरसि श्वेतपङ्कजे । सहस्रारे समासीनं गुरुं सञ्चिन्तयेद्यतिः
verses.transliteration: brāhme muhūrtta utthāya śirasi śvetapaṅkaje | sahasrāre samāsīnaṃ guruṃ sañcintayedyatiḥ
verses.translation: O Goddess, the sage practising the mantra shall make the Nyasa of the Kavaca in the eyes and the forehead with an attentive mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, the sage practising the mantra shall make the Nyasa of the Kavaca in the eyes and the forehead with an attentive mind.
verses.science: परिज्ञानसहित विस्तारपूर्वक बता रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं द्विनेत्रं वरदाभये । दधानं शिवसद्भावमेवात्मनि मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ dvinetraṃ varadābhaye | dadhānaṃ śivasadbhāvamevātmani manoharam
verses.translation: After meditating thus and worshipping with scents and other services, he shall worship Nandin, the chief of the harem in the right wing of the eastern doors, with the lustre of the golden hill bedecked in ornaments with the crescent moon constituting his coronet, of gentle aspect, with three eyes and four arms, holding a trident, a hind, an axe and a golden staff, with his face lustrous as the moon's disc or as the face of a monkey. To his north he shall worship his wife Suyasa, the daughter of the Maruts of good riles, engaged in bedecking mother Siva's feet duly with scents, flowers and other services.
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating thus and worshipping with scents and other services, he shall worship Nandin, the chief of the harem in the right wing of the eastern doors, with the lustre of the golden hill bedecked in ornaments with the crescent moon constituting his coronet,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating thus and worshipping with scents and other services, he shall worship Nandin, the chief of the harem in the right wing of the eastern doors, with the lustre of the golden hill bedecked in ornaments with the crescent moon constituting his coronet,…
verses.science: सर्वेश्वर--यह उत्तम तिरोधानचक्र है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भावोपनीतैः सम्पूज्य गन्धादिभिरनुक्रमात् । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा नमस्कुर्याद् गुरुं ततः
verses.transliteration: bhāvopanītaiḥ sampūjya gandhādibhiranukramāt | baddhāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā namaskuryād guruṃ tataḥ
verses.explanation: चिहनोंको धारण करनेवाले हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: चिहनोंको धारण करनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रातःप्रभृति सायान्ते सायादि प्रातरन्ततः । यत्करोमि महादेव तदस्तु तव पूजनम्
verses.transliteration: prātaḥprabhṛti sāyānte sāyādi prātarantataḥ | yatkaromi mahādeva tadastu tava pūjanam
verses.translation: From the Adhara Sakti to the seat of the sacred lore the devotee shall repeat the mantra. sfir:
verses.commentary: Sense: From the Adhara Sakti to the seat of the sacred lore the devotee shall repeat the mantra. sfir:
verses.science: तथा प्रद्युम्न नामसे विख्यात है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिविज्ञाप्य गुरवे लब्धानुज्ञस्ततो गुरोः । निरुद्धप्राण आसीनो विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: prativijñāpya gurave labdhānujñastato guroḥ | niruddhaprāṇa āsīno vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Uttering the mantra beginning with *'I rcson to Sadyojata" and ending with Om repeating the Nada arising from the Adhara and concluding at the Brahma- randhra, along with the twelve knots he shall meditate on the lord in Onkara, pure as crystal, the unsullied, the imperishable, the cause of creation, identical with the worlds, stationed within and without, pervading all, smaller than the smallest and greater than the greatest, visible to the devotees without strain, the unchanging incompre¬ hensible to the gods, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others, the essence of the Vedas, declared as invisible, by the learned devoid of beginning, middle and end and the panacea for all worldly ills.
verses.wordMeaning: Uttering the mantra beginning with *'I rcson to Sadyojata" and ending with Om repeating the Nada arising from the Adhara and concluding at the Brahma- randhra, along with the twelve knots he shall meditate on the lord in Onkara, pure as crystal, the unsullied, the imperishable,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttering the mantra beginning with *'I rcson to Sadyojata" and ending with Om repeating the Nada arising from the Adhara and concluding at the Brahma- randhra, along with the twelve knots he shall meditate on the lord in Onkara, pure as crystal, the unsullied, the imperishable,…
verses.science: मुखरूप हैं और.पृथ्वीतत्त्वके नायक हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: मूलादिब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तं षट्चक्रं परिचिन्तयेत् । विद्युत्कोटिसमप्रख्यं सर्वतेजोमयं परम्
verses.transliteration: mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ paricintayet | vidyutkoṭisamaprakhyaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ param
verses.translation: After meditating on him thus with concentra¬ tion, the devotee shall perform obeisance after showing different mystic signs and performing the rites of invocation, installation, concentration and observance. He shall meditate on lord Siva himself, of Sakala and Niskala forms.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भाद्यस्यैव व्यष्टिरूपं चुद ह चतुर्मुख, रक्तवर्ण तथा रजोगुणवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating on him thus with concentra¬ tion, the devotee shall perform obeisance after showing different mystic signs and performing the rites of invocation, installation, concentration and observance. He shall meditate on lord Siva himself, of Sakala and Niskala forms.
verses.science: हिरण्यगर्भाद्यस्यैव व्यष्टिरूपं चुद ह चतुर्मुख, रक्तवर्ण तथा रजोगुणवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेन्मां च सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहम् । निर्गुणं परमं ब्रह्म सदाशिवमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye cintayenmāṃ ca saccidānandavigraham | nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ brahma sadāśivamanāmayam
verses.translation: After meditating thus, O goddess, he shall meditate on you as Manonmani to my left. Repeating the mantra "Gaurirmimiya"* preceded by the Pranava he shall invoke you as before and perform the rites ending with prostration. The sage of pious concentrated mind shall meditate on you, O goddess.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भ, विराट, पुरुष और काल नामवाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating thus, O goddess, he shall meditate on you as Manonmani to my left. Repeating the mantra "Gaurirmimiya"* preceded by the Pranava he shall invoke you as before and perform the rites ending with prostration.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating thus, O goddess, he shall meditate on you as Manonmani to my left. Repeating the mantra "Gaurirmimiya"* preceded by the Pranava he shall invoke you as before and perform the rites ending with prostration.…
verses.science: हिरण्यगर्भ, विराट, पुरुष और काल नामवाले हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहमस्मीति मतिमान्मदैक्यमनुभूय च । बहिर्निर्गत्य च ततो दूरं गच्छेद्यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: so'hamasmīti matimānmadaikyamanubhūya ca | bahirnirgatya ca tato dūraṃ gacchedyathāsukham
verses.translation: You have the lustre of the blooming lotus, eyes expansive and wide, face lustrous as the full moon, curly dark hair, complexion of the brilliant blue lotus, crest decorated with the semicircular moon, breasts rounded, plump protruding, smooth and stout, slender middle large buttocks and fine yellow garment. You arc endowed with ornaments. In your forehead you have a shining Tilaka. Flowers of various colours decorate your braid of hair. Your feature befits your nature. Your face is bent
verses.wordMeaning: You have the lustre of the blooming lotus, eyes expansive and wide, face lustrous as the full moon, curly dark hair, complexion of the brilliant blue lotus, crest decorated with the semicircular moon, breasts rounded, plump protruding, smooth and stout,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You have the lustre of the blooming lotus, eyes expansive and wide, face lustrous as the full moon, curly dark hair, complexion of the brilliant blue lotus, crest decorated with the semicircular moon, breasts rounded, plump protruding, smooth and stout,…
verses.science: और परिवार-सुखको प्रदान करनेवाला है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्य मतिमाञ्छिरो नासिकया सह । विशोध्य देहं विधिवत्तृणमाधाय भूतले
verses.transliteration: vastreṇācchādya matimāñchiro nāsikayā saha | viśodhya dehaṃ vidhivattṛṇamādhāya bhūtale
verses.translation: He shall bow to Durga and Ksctrapala also, with palms joined in reverence. He shall repeal "Orn Astraya Phat" six times and wipe olf his hands.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि वाचक और वाच्यमें कुछ भी भेद नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall bow to Durga and Ksctrapala also, with palms joined in reverence. He shall repeal "Orn Astraya Phat" six times and wipe olf his hands.
verses.science: क्योंकि वाचक और वाच्यमें कुछ भी भेद नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहीतशिश्न उत्थाय ततो गच्छेज्जलाशयम् । उद्धृत्य वार्यथान्यायं शौचं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītaśiśna utthāya tato gacchejjalāśayam | uddhṛtya vāryathānyāyaṃ śaucaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ
verses.translation: He shall recite the mentra "Apasai pantu"'-' and repeat "Astraya Pha," Clapping the palms tlirice and kicking thrice he shall remove the obstacle's; he shall ga/c at tlie heaven-dwellers, the skyfarers.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall recite the mentra "Apasai pantu"'-' and repeat "Astraya Pha," Clapping the palms tlirice and kicking thrice he shall remove the obstacle's; he shall ga/c at tlie heaven-dwellers, the skyfarers.
verses.science: उपासना करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तौ पादौ च संशोध्य द्विराचम्योमिति स्मरन् । उत्तराभिमुखो मौनी दन्तधावनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: hastau pādau ca saṃśodhya dvirācamyomiti smaran | uttarābhimukho maunī dantadhāvanamācaret
verses.translation: He shall meditate on the supierne god of the form of cit in the middle of lunar sphere of cit wiihin the great lotus of thousand petals, full-blown and stationed in the twelve (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on the supierne god of the form of cit in the middle of lunar sphere of cit wiihin the great lotus of thousand petals, full-blown and stationed in the twelve (?)
verses.science: प्रणवकी उपासना करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तृणपर्णैः सदा कुर्यादमामेकादशीं विना । अपां द्वादशगण्डूषैर्मुखं संशोधयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: tṛṇaparṇaiḥ sadā kuryādamāmekādaśīṃ vinā | apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣairmukhaṃ saṃśodhayettataḥ
verses.translation: For sixteem, sixty-four and thiity-two seconds he shall perform Puraka, Kumbhaka and Recaka through Sosa Daha and Plava.
verses.commentary: Sense: For sixteem, sixty-four and thiity-two seconds he shall perform Puraka, Kumbhaka and Recaka through Sosa Daha and Plava.
verses.science: शिवजीका ध्यान करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विराचम्य मृदा तोयैः कटिशौचं विधाय च । अरुणोदयकाले तु स्नानं कुर्यान्मृदा सह
verses.transliteration: dvirācamya mṛdā toyaiḥ kaṭiśaucaṃ vidhāya ca | aruṇodayakāle tu snānaṃ kuryānmṛdā saha
verses.translation: After retaining the breath as mentioned in his particular Veda through wind, fire, water etc. he shall bring the nerve which is at the Mula to the cerebral aper-
verses.commentary: Sense: After retaining the breath as mentioned in his particular Veda through wind, fire, water etc. he shall bring the nerve which is at the Mula to the cerebral aper-
verses.science: प्रणवके तात्पर्यकों भी समझाये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं संस्मृत्य मां चैव स्नानसन्ध्याद्यमाचरेत् । विस्तारभयतो नोक्तमत्र द्रष्टव्यमन्यतः
verses.transliteration: guruṃ saṃsmṛtya māṃ caiva snānasandhyādyamācaret | vistārabhayato noktamatra draṣṭavyamanyataḥ
verses.translation: The Yogin with mental concentration shall ponder over the Matrka. He shall fix the developed Matrka through the Pranava externally. He shall carry out nourish¬ ment etc. with restricted vital breath. Thinking upon Siva in the mind he shall dedicate himself quietly.
verses.hindi: उनकी आज्ञाके बिना अन्य कर्म न करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogin with mental concentration shall ponder over the Matrka. He shall fix the developed Matrka through the Pranava externally. He shall carry out nourish¬ ment etc. with restricted vital breath. Thinking upon Siva in the mind he shall dedicate himself quietly.
verses.science: उनकी आज्ञाके बिना अन्य कर्म न करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: आबध्य शङ्खमुद्रां च प्रणवेनाभिषेचयेत् । शिरसि द्वादशावृत्त्या तदर्धं वा तदर्धकम्
verses.transliteration: ābadhya śaṅkhamudrāṃ ca praṇavenābhiṣecayet | śirasi dvādaśāvṛttyā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam
verses.translation: Beginning with the two thumbs and ending with the palms, the hands are wiped off. O goddess. Saying 'Om' he shall begin the Nyasa of the hands.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्‍न्यासविधिनाम त्रयोदशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning with the two thumbs and ending with the palms, the hands are wiped off. O goddess. Saying 'Om' he shall begin the Nyasa of the hands.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्‍न्यासविधिनाम त्रयोदशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तीरमागत्य कौपीनं प्रक्षाल्याचम्य च द्विधा । प्रोक्षयेत्प्रणवेनैव वस्त्रमङ्गोपमार्जनम्
verses.transliteration: tīramāgatya kaupīnaṃ prakṣālyācamya ca dvidhā | prokṣayetpraṇavenaiva vastramaṅgopamārjanam
verses.translation: He shall perform the Nyasa starting with the thumb of the right hand and ending with the little finger of the left hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the Nyasa starting with the thumb of the right hand and ending with the little finger of the left hand.
verses.science: नामक तेरहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखं प्रथमतो मृज्य शिर आरभ्य सर्वतः । तेनैव मार्जयेद्देहं स्थित्वा च गुरुसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: mukhaṃ prathamato mṛjya śira ārabhya sarvataḥ | tenaiva mārjayeddehaṃ sthitvā ca gurusannidhau
verses.translation: Everywhere 'A', 'U', 'M' with the Bindu, and the mantra ending with Namah shall be uttered and the Nyasa of the hand in the heart etc. be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everywhere 'A', 'U', 'M' with the Bindu, and the mantra ending with Namah shall be uttered and the Nyasa of the hand in the heart etc. be performed.
verses.science: आये हुए मुझपर अनुग्रह कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आबध्याद् वामतः शुद्धं कौपीनं च सडोरकम् । ततः सन्धारयेद्भस्म तद्विधिः प्रोच्यतेऽद्रिजे
verses.transliteration: ābadhyād vāmataḥ śuddhaṃ kaupīnaṃ ca saḍorakam | tataḥ sandhārayedbhasma tadvidhiḥ procyate'drije
verses.translation: After uttering 'A' at the outset the identity of Brahman and Atman shall be practised. The mantras ending with 'De' and 'Namah' shall be utilised in the heart.
verses.hindi: महान् भय उत्पन्न करनेवाला वचन कहने लगे
verses.commentary: Sense: After uttering 'A' at the outset the identity of Brahman and Atman shall be practised. The mantras ending with 'De' and 'Namah' shall be utilised in the heart.
verses.science: महान् भय उत्पन्न करनेवाला वचन कहने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विराचम्य समादाय भस्म सद्यादिमन्त्रतः । अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैरभिमन्त्र्य स्पृशेत्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: dvirācamya samādāya bhasma sadyādimantrataḥ | agnirityādibhirmantrairabhimantrya spṛśettanum
verses.translation: The different organs, faces and digits shall be fixed in the five Brahmans. Isana's five digits shall be fixed in the head, face, heart, private parts and the feet. The four digits of the Purusa shall be fixed in the four faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: The different organs, faces and digits shall be fixed in the five Brahmans. Isana's five digits shall be fixed in the head, face, heart, private parts and the feet. The four digits of the Purusa shall be fixed in the four faces.
verses.science: अर्थात् को कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपोवेत्यभिमन्त्र्याथ जलं तेनैव सेचयेत् । ओमापोज्योतिरित्युक्त्वा मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: āpovetyabhimantryātha jalaṃ tenaiva secayet | omāpojyotirityuktvā mānastoketi mantrataḥ
verses.translation: Thus making the Nyasa of the thirtycight Kalas the intelligent knower of Pranava shall proceed with the Nyasa of Pranava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus making the Nyasa of the thirtycight Kalas the intelligent knower of Pranava shall proceed with the Nyasa of Pranava.
verses.science: वस्तुत: भेद नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्मर्द्य कवलद्वन्द्वं कुर्यादेकं तु पञ्चधा । शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेषु परमेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: sammardya kavaladvandvaṃ kuryādekaṃ tu pañcadhā | śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu parameśvari
verses.translation: After making the Nyasa in the arms, elbows, wrists, sides, belly, calves, feet and the back, the devotee, an expert in the Nyasa, shall perform Haihsanyasa, O lady enligh¬ tener of the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making the Nyasa in the arms, elbows, wrists, sides, belly, calves, feet and the back, the devotee, an expert in the Nyasa, shall perform Haihsanyasa, O lady enligh¬ tener of the great Atman.
verses.science: ईशानदेवके चतुर्व्यूहके रूपमें स्थित हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानादि समारभ्य सद्यान्तं पञ्चभिः क्रमात् । उद्धूल्य कवलं पश्चात्प्रणवेनाभिषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: īśānādi samārabhya sadyāntaṃ pañcabhiḥ kramāt | uddhūlya kavalaṃ paścātpraṇavenābhiṣecayet
verses.translation: The ascetic devotee shall make the square 'diagram to his left and worship it with Om. He shall place the conch and the rni.ssile, with its stand and worship it with the Pranava after filling it with the water scented with the sandal paste. He ''hall worship it with the scents and flowers and repeat Pranava seven times. He shall show the mystic sign of the cow and the conch making a square diagram in front and a semicircle in the middle, a triangle, hexagon and a circle within each in order. After worshipping the diagram with scents, and flowers, he shall place within it the vessel of Arghya on its stand and worship it with scents, repeating the Pranava. He shall pour holy watci* and fill it.
verses.wordMeaning: The ascetic devotee shall make the square 'diagram to his left and worship it with Om. He shall place the conch and the rni.ssile, with its stand and worship it with the Pranava after filling it with the water scented with the sandal paste.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic devotee shall make the square 'diagram to his left and worship it with Om. He shall place the conch and the rni.ssile, with its stand and worship it with the Pranava after filling it with the water scented with the sandal paste.…
verses.science: पृथक् स्थिति व्यष्टि कहलाती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गं च ततो हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्यान्यत्समाहरेत् सम्मर्द्य पूर्ववत्तत्तु त्रिपुण्ड्रांस्तेन धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgaṃ ca tato hastau prakṣālyānyatsamāharet sammardya pūrvavattattu tripuṇḍrāṃstena dhārayet
verses.translation: In the vessel, O good-faced lady, tips of Kusa grass, raw i ice grains, barley, other grains, gingelly seeds, ghee- fried object, flowers and ashes too shall be put. It shall be
verses.hindi: परब्रह्मस्वरूप, सूक्ष्म, निर्विकार तथा अनामय है
verses.commentary: Sense: In the vessel, O good-faced lady, tips of Kusa grass, raw i ice grains, barley, other grains, gingelly seeds, ghee- fried object, flowers and ashes too shall be put. It shall be
verses.science: परब्रह्मस्वरूप, सूक्ष्म, निर्विकार तथा अनामय है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: नाभौ बाह्वोः सन्धिषु च पृष्ठे चैव यथाक्रमम् । प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च ततो द्विराचम्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: nābhau bāhvoḥ sandhiṣu ca pṛṣṭhe caiva yathākramam | prakṣālya hastau ca tato dvirācamya yathāvidhi
verses.translation: After saying "Orh gum gurubhyah namah" he shall invoke the preceptor and meditate on him as seated facing the south, with a delightful face, looking gentle and cryjtal pure, showing the mystic gestures of boons and protection with his hands in the form and features of Iiva but with two eyes.
verses.hindi: होनेसे परम पद कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: After saying "Orh gum gurubhyah namah" he shall invoke the preceptor and meditate on him as seated facing the south, with a delightful face, looking gentle and cryjtal pure,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying "Orh gum gurubhyah namah" he shall invoke the preceptor and meditate on him as seated facing the south, with a delightful face, looking gentle and cryjtal pure,…
verses.science: होनेसे परम पद कहा जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चीकरणमुच्चार्य भावयेत्स्वगुरुं बुधः । वक्ष्यमाणप्रकारेण प्राणायामान्षडाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: pañcīkaraṇamuccārya bhāvayetsvaguruṃ budhaḥ | vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa prāṇāyāmānṣaḍācaret
verses.translation: After meditating thus he shall w r.ship Ganapati with scents, flowers etc. in the proper order assigning him a.'•cat on the lotus to the south-west of the mystical diagram with the mantra "Gananantva"'25 After invoking the lord he shall meditate on him with concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating thus he shall w r.ship Ganapati with scents, flowers etc. in the proper order assigning him a.'•cat on the lotus to the south-west of the mystical diagram with the mantra "Gananantva"'25 After invoking the lord he shall meditate on him with concentration.
verses.science: देते हैं-ऐसा वेद कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षहस्तेन सङ्गृह्य जलं वामेन पाणिना । समाच्छाद्य द्विषड्वारं प्रणवेनाभिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣahastena saṅgṛhya jalaṃ vāmena pāṇinā | samācchādya dviṣaḍvāraṃ praṇavenābhimantrayet
verses.translation: Ide shall be conceived as icd in complexion with a huge body bedecked in ornaments holding a noose, a goad, boons and teeth, with elephantine face destroying the hindrances and obstacles of his devotees. After meditating thus Jie shall Worship him with scents, flowers and other services. After ofTcring him the Naivedya of plantain fruits, coconuts, mango fruits and sweet balls he shall make obeisance to the god.
verses.wordMeaning: Ide shall be conceived as icd in complexion with a huge body bedecked in ornaments holding a noose, a goad, boons and teeth, with elephantine face destroying the hindrances and obstacles of his devotees. After meditating thus Jie shall Worship him with scents,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ide shall be conceived as icd in complexion with a huge body bedecked in ornaments holding a noose, a goad, boons and teeth, with elephantine face destroying the hindrances and obstacles of his devotees. After meditating thus Jie shall Worship him with scents,…
verses.science: ही प्रपंच कहलाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रियायुषैस्त्र्यम्बकैश्च प्रणवेन शिवेन च । शिरस्यथ ललाटे च वक्षसि स्कन्ध एव च
verses.transliteration: triyāyuṣaistryambakaiśca praṇavena śivena ca | śirasyatha lalāṭe ca vakṣasi skandha eva ca
verses.translation: Repeating Skandagayatri he shall meditate on Kumara shining as the rising sun, seated on the peacock, with four arms and splendid limbs, bedecked in coronet hol¬ ding mystic signs of boons and protection, a spear and a cock'"® as well.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पष्ख्यां कैलाससंहितायां धिवरूपप्रणववर्णन॑ नाम चुर्दशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating Skandagayatri he shall meditate on Kumara shining as the rising sun, seated on the peacock, with four arms and splendid limbs, bedecked in coronet hol¬ ding mystic signs of boons and protection, a spear and a cock'"® as well.
verses.science: जति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पष्ख्यां कैलाससंहितायां धिवरूपप्रणववर्णन॑ नाम चुर्दशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्रिवारं सम्प्रोक्ष्य शिरसि त्रिः पिबेत्ततः । समाहितेन मनसा ध्यायन्नोङ्कारमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ trivāraṃ samprokṣya śirasi triḥ pibettataḥ | samāhitena manasā dhyāyannoṅkāramīśvaram
verses.translation: Repeating Skandagayatri he shall meditate on Kumara shining as the rising sun, seated on the peacock, with four arms and splendid limbs, bedecked in coronet hol¬ ding mystic signs of boons and protection, a spear and a cock'"® as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating Skandagayatri he shall meditate on Kumara shining as the rising sun, seated on the peacock, with four arms and splendid limbs, bedecked in coronet hol¬ ding mystic signs of boons and protection, a spear and a cock'"® as well.
verses.science: नामक चोदहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सौरमण्डलमध्यस्थं सर्वतेजोमयं परम् । अष्टबाहुं चतुर्वक्त्रमर्द्धनारीकमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: sauramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ param | aṣṭabāhuṃ caturvaktramarddhanārīkamadbhutam
verses.translation: He shall sprinkle the diagram with the water from the conch veiled by the Astrarnantra. Then the scat, stand etc. shall be conceived in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall sprinkle the diagram with the water from the conch veiled by the Astrarnantra. Then the scat, stand etc. shall be conceived in the proper order.
verses.science: विस्तारके रूपमें देहभावसे स्थित है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाश्चर्यगुणोपेतं सर्वालङ्कारशोभितम् । एवं ध्यात्वाथ विधिवद्दद्यादर्घ्यत्रयं ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvāścaryaguṇopetaṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitam | evaṃ dhyātvātha vidhivaddadyādarghyatrayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Adharma etc. shall be conceived from the east to the north in due order. He.shall conceive its body with the lustre of the jewel Lajavarta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adharma etc. shall be conceived from the east to the north in due order. He.shall conceive its body with the lustre of the jewel Lajavarta.
verses.science: मिलकर एक हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टोत्तरशतं जप्त्वा द्विषड्वारं तु तर्पयेत् । पुनराचम्य विधिवत्प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā dviṣaḍvāraṃ tu tarpayet | punarācamya vidhivatprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret
verses.translation: The lower and upper lids, the bulbous root, the stem, the neck, the petals and the pericarp shall be t onecived in order and worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lower and upper lids, the bulbous root, the stem, the neck, the petals and the pericarp shall be t onecived in order and worshipped.
verses.science: 'संहार' नामक चक्र है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पूजासदनमागच्छेन्मनसा संस्मरन् शिवम् । द्वारमासाद्य प्रक्षाल्य पादौ मौनी द्विराचमेत्
verses.transliteration: pūjāsadanamāgacchenmanasā saṃsmaran śivam | dvāramāsādya prakṣālya pādau maunī dvirācamet
verses.translation: He shall conceive the eight Siddhis in the petals, the Saktis in the filaments, the eight Rudras, Varna and others from the east, all round in order; the Vaiiagya in the pericarp and the nine Saktis in the Bijas, Varna and others alone begin¬ ning with the cast and ending with ManonmanI, the Dharma of Liva in the bulbous root, the Saivite knowledge in the stem and the zones of fire, sun and the moon above the pericarp.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall conceive the eight Siddhis in the petals, the Saktis in the filaments, the eight Rudras, Varna and others from the east, all round in order; the Vaiiagya in the pericarp and the nine Saktis in the Bijas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall conceive the eight Siddhis in the petals, the Saktis in the filaments, the eight Rudras, Varna and others from the east, all round in order; the Vaiiagya in the pericarp and the nine Saktis in the Bijas,…
verses.science: और लोकपर अनुग्रह करनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशेद्विधिना तत्र दक्षपादपुरःसरम् । मण्डपान्तः सुधीस्तत्र मण्डलं रचयेत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: praviśedvidhinā tatra dakṣapādapuraḥsaram | maṇḍapāntaḥ sudhīstatra maṇḍalaṃ racayetkramāt
verses.translation: The science of the Atman, and the trio of principles named Siva shall be conceived thereafter. Above these seats he shall conceive the seat of the deity shining with
verses.commentary: Sense: The science of the Atman, and the trio of principles named Siva shall be conceived thereafter. Above these seats he shall conceive the seat of the deity shining with
verses.science: शिवसायुज्य प्रदान करनेवाला है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.hindi: है। यह सुन्दर पद पितामहसे अधिष्ठित है
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.science: है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.science: उसे ही ब्रह्माण्ड जानना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam
verses.translation: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.hindi: होकर निरन्तर लीला करते रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.science: होकर निरन्तर लीला करते रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । संन्यासमण्डलविधिवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । परीक्ष्य विधिवद्भूमिं गन्धवर्णरसादिभिः । मनोभिलषिते तत्र वितानवितताम्बरे
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā 6.5. pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ | saṃnyāsamaṇḍalavidhivarṇanam | īśvara uvāca | parīkṣya vidhivadbhūmiṃ gandhavarṇarasādibhiḥ | manobhilaṣite tatra vitānavitatāmbare
verses.translation: He shall offer water for Acamana once again saying "Rudraya Namah" (obeisance to Rudra). He shall offer well consecrated scent saying "Kalaya Namah.
verses.hindi: शक्तिमानू शिवरूप ही है--यह सुनिश्चित है
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer water for Acamana once again saying "Rudraya Namah" (obeisance to Rudra). He shall offer well consecrated scent saying "Kalaya Namah.
verses.science: शक्तिमानू शिवरूप ही है--यह सुनिश्चित है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रलिप्ते महीपृष्ठे दर्पणोदरसन्निभे । अरत्नियुग्ममानेन चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: supralipte mahīpṛṣṭhe darpaṇodarasannibhe | aratniyugmamānena caturasraṃ prakalpayet
