verses.translation: Nandin shall be worshipped to the south and Mahakala to the north of it, BhrngiSa to the west of the southern door. Vinayaka shall be worshipped in the square to the east of that with scents; Vrsabha in the northwest and Guha in the southern square. To the east of the northern door the following eight shall be worshipped in accordance with the rules of circumambulation. They are Bhava, l§arva, Isana, Rudra, Pasupati, Ugra, Bhima and Mahadeva. Such is the worship in the third Avarana.
verses.wordMeaning: Nandin shall be worshipped to the south and Mahakala to the north of it, BhrngiSa to the west of the southern door. Vinayaka shall be worshipped in the square to the east of that with scents; Vrsabha in the northwest and Guha in the southern square.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Nandin shall be worshipped to the south and Mahakala to the north of it, BhrngiSa to the west of the southern door. Vinayaka shall be worshipped in the square to the east of that with scents; Vrsabha in the northwest and Guha in the southern square.…
verses.science: आनन्द उदित होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तालपत्रं समादाय तत्समायामविस्तरम् । तस्मिन्भागान्प्रकुर्वीत त्रयोदशसमां कलाम्
verses.transliteration: tālapatraṃ samādāya tatsamāyāmavistaram | tasminbhāgānprakurvīta trayodaśasamāṃ kalām
verses.translation: Ibid. 13. 4.
verses.hindi: डति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे पष्ठ्या कैलाससंहितायां शिवतत्त्ववर्णं नाम षोडशो5 ध्यायः
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid. 13. 4.
verses.science: डति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे पष्ठ्या कैलाससंहितायां शिवतत्त्ववर्णं नाम षोडशो5 ध्यायः। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पत्रं तत्र निःक्षिप्य पश्चिमाभिमुखः स्थितः । तत्पूर्वभागे सुदृढं सूत्रमादाय रञ्जितम्
verses.transliteration: tatpatraṃ tatra niḥkṣipya paścimābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ | tatpūrvabhāge sudṛḍhaṃ sūtramādāya rañjitam
verses.translation: He shall prostrate with eight parts of the body touching the ground. Endowed with great devotion he shall perform circumambulation again, make obeisance once more.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall prostrate with eight parts of the body touching the ground. Endowed with great devotion he shall perform circumambulation again, make obeisance once more.
verses.science: इनमें विरोध मत समझिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राक् प्रत्यग् दक्षिणोदक् च चतुर्दिशि निपातयेत् । सूत्राणि देवदेवेशि नवषष्ट्युत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: prāk pratyag dakṣiṇodak ca caturdiśi nipātayet | sūtrāṇi devadeveśi navaṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ śatam
verses.translation: While sitting there, he shall adore the lord with the eight names. Then he shall pray thus: "O lord Siva, good or bad whatever I have done is your great service." After saying this, flowers shall be offered along with the water from the conch. After worshipping him who is worthy of worship he shall repeat the eight names with significant meaning. O goddess, I shall tell you the same because of your devotion to me.
verses.wordMeaning: While sitting there, he shall adore the lord with the eight names. Then he shall pray thus: "O lord Siva, good or bad whatever I have done is your great service." After saying this, flowers shall be offered along with the water from the conch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: While sitting there, he shall adore the lord with the eight names. Then he shall pray thus: "O lord Siva, good or bad whatever I have done is your great service." After saying this, flowers shall be offered along with the water from the conch.…
verses.science: पुरुषरूप विश्व शिवशक्तिस्वरूप है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कोष्ठानि स्युस्ततस्तस्य मध्यकोष्ठं तु कर्णिका । कोष्ठाष्टकं बहिस्तस्य दलाष्टकमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: koṣṭhāni syustatastasya madhyakoṣṭhaṃ tu karṇikā | koṣṭhāṣṭakaṃ bahistasya dalāṣṭakamihocyate
verses.translation: VS. II. 39
verses.explanation: भाँति शिवस्वरूप हो जाता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: भाँति शिवस्वरूप हो जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दलानि श्वेतवर्णात्रि समग्राणि प्रकल्पयेत् । पीतरूपां कर्णिकां च कृत्वारक्तं च वृत्तकम्
verses.transliteration: dalāni śvetavarṇātri samagrāṇi prakalpayet | pītarūpāṃ karṇikāṃ ca kṛtvāraktaṃ ca vṛttakam
verses.translation: The following eight names indicate Siva — Siva, Mahevara, Rudra, Visnu, Pitamaha, Sariisaravaidya, Saravajfia, Paramatman.
verses.hindi: रूपसे महान् आत्मावाला हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The following eight names indicate Siva — Siva, Mahevara, Rudra, Visnu, Pitamaha, Sariisaravaidya, Saravajfia, Paramatman.
verses.science: रूपसे महान् आत्मावाला हो जाता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: वनभिद्दलदक्षं तु समारभ्य सुरेश्वरि । रक्तकृष्णाः क्रमेणैव दलसन्धीन्विचित्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: vanabhiddaladakṣaṃ tu samārabhya sureśvari | raktakṛṣṇāḥ krameṇaiva dalasandhīnvicitrayet
verses.translation: The five names of Sadaiiiva are dependent on their condition. If the condition alters the name too alters.
verses.hindi: शक्तिसे काट दूँगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: The five names of Sadaiiiva are dependent on their condition. If the condition alters the name too alters.
verses.science: शक्तिसे काट दूँगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकायां लिखेद् यन्त्रं प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकम् । अधः पीठं समालिख्य श्रीकण्ठं च तदूर्ध्वतः
verses.transliteration: karṇikāyāṃ likhed yantraṃ praṇavārthaprakāśakam | adhaḥ pīṭhaṃ samālikhya śrīkaṇṭhaṃ ca tadūrdhvataḥ
verses.translation: Even when words are transferred there are condi¬ tions again. The first five names denote things other than Atman.
verses.hindi: लोकोपकारकरणे विचरन्तीह लिये ही इस लोकमें विचरण करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when words are transferred there are condi¬ tions again. The first five names denote things other than Atman.
verses.science: लोकोपकारकरणे विचरन्तीह लिये ही इस लोकमें विचरण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदुपर्यमरेशं च महाकालं च मध्यतः । तन्मस्तकस्थं दण्डं च तत ईश्वरमालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: taduparyamareśaṃ ca mahākālaṃ ca madhyataḥ | tanmastakasthaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca tata īśvaramālikhet
verses.translation: He shall offer raw grains saying "Kalavikaranaya Namah". He.shall offer flowers, saying Balavikaranaya Namah"
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायागुप्रासनायूर्त्तिवर्णं नाम पञ्ञदशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer raw grains saying "Kalavikaranaya Namah". He.shall offer flowers, saying Balavikaranaya Namah"
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायागुप्रासनायूर्त्तिवर्णं नाम पञ्ञदशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्यामेन पीठं पीतेन श्रीकण्ठं च विचित्रयेत् । अमरेशं महाकालं रक्तं कृष्णं च तौ क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: śyāmena pīṭhaṃ pītena śrīkaṇṭhaṃ ca vicitrayet | amareśaṃ mahākālaṃ raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca tau kramāt
verses.translation: He shall offer incense assiduously saying "Balaya Namah". "He shall offer good lamp saying "Bala- pramathanaya Namah."
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer incense assiduously saying "Balaya Namah". "He shall offer good lamp saying "Bala- pramathanaya Namah."
verses.science: नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात्सुधूम्रं दण्डं च धवलं चेश्वरं बुधः । एवं यन्त्रं समालिख्य रक्तं सद्येन वेष्टयेत्
verses.transliteration: kuryātsudhūmraṃ daṇḍaṃ ca dhavalaṃ ceśvaraṃ budhaḥ | evaṃ yantraṃ samālikhya raktaṃ sadyena veṣṭayet
verses.translation: Along with the Vedas including their six ancillarics, Matrka, Pranava and Siva joined with Siva, he shall show mystic signs to me and to you, O good-complexioned lady. First he shall render service to me, then to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with the Vedas including their six ancillarics, Matrka, Pranava and Siva joined with Siva, he shall show mystic signs to me and to you, O good-complexioned lady. First he shall render service to me, then to you.
verses.science: आदरपूर्वक पूछने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदुत्थेनैव नादेन भिन्द्यादीशानमीश्वरि । तद्बाह्यपङ्क्तीर्गृह्णीयादाग्नेयादिक्रमेण वै
verses.transliteration: tadutthenaiva nādena bhindyādīśānamīśvari | tadbāhyapaṅktīrgṛhṇīyādāgneyādikrameṇa vai
verses.translation: When he offers things and performs rites to you he shall use the feminine gender. O Parvati, none but this is the difference. After performing meditation and worship duly in accordence with the rules the expert devotee shall begin the Avarana Puja.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he offers things and performs rites to you he shall use the feminine gender. O Parvati, none but this is the difference. After performing meditation and worship duly in accordence with the rules the expert devotee shall begin the Avarana Puja.
verses.science: हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कोष्ठानि कोणभागेषु चत्वार्येतानि सुन्दरि । शुक्लेनापूर्य वर्णादि चतुष्कं रक्तधातुभिः
verses.transliteration: koṣṭhāni koṇabhāgeṣu catvāryetāni sundari | śuklenāpūrya varṇādi catuṣkaṃ raktadhātubhiḥ
verses.hindi: कृपातस्तव देवेश दृढज्ञानी भवाम्यहम्॥ १२  ज्ञानी हो जाऊँ
verses.explanation: कृपातस्तव देवेश दृढज्ञानी भवाम्यहम्॥ १२ ज्ञानी हो जाऊँ। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: कृपातस्तव देवेश दृढज्ञानी भवाम्यहम्॥ १२ ज्ञानी हो जाऊँ। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्य तानि चत्वारि द्वाराणि परिकल्पयेत् । ततस्तत्पार्श्वयोर्द्वन्द्वं पीतेनैव प्रपूरयेत्
verses.transliteration: āpūrya tāni catvāri dvārāṇi parikalpayet | tatastatpārśvayordvandvaṃ pītenaiva prapūrayet
verses.translation: O goddess, there are five Avarapas here. The five Avarana-worships shall be performed thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, there are five Avarapas here. The five Avarana-worships shall be performed thus.
verses.science: मुखवाले प्रभु कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयकोष्ठमध्ये तु पीताभे चतुरस्रके । अष्टपत्रं लिखेत्पद्मं रक्ताभं पीतकर्णिकम्
verses.transliteration: āgneyakoṣṭhamadhye tu pītābhe caturasrake | aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ raktābhaṃ pītakarṇikam
verses.translation: Where they had been previoushy worshipped, the lords GaneSa and Karttikeyu shall be worshipped in order.
verses.hindi: अत: उनकी बात नहीं सुननी चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Where they had been previoushy worshipped, the lords GaneSa and Karttikeyu shall be worshipped in order.
verses.science: अत: उनकी बात नहीं सुननी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हकारं विलिखेन्मध्ये बिन्दुयुक्तं समाहितः । पद्मस्य नैरृते कोष्ठे चतुरस्रं तदा लिखेत्
verses.transliteration: hakāraṃ vilikhenmadhye binduyuktaṃ samāhitaḥ | padmasya nairṛte koṣṭhe caturasraṃ tadā likhet
verses.translation: The five Brahmans shall be worshipped in order in the north-east, east, south, north and west. The devotee shall worship the six ancillaries then. He shall worship the eye and Astra in the southeast, northeast, southwest, north¬ west and in the middle. Thus the first Avarana is mentioned. Now listen to the second Avarana.
verses.wordMeaning: The five Brahmans shall be worshipped in order in the north-east, east, south, north and west. The devotee shall worship the six ancillaries then. He shall worship the eye and Astra in the southeast, northeast, southwest, north¬ west and in the middle.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The five Brahmans shall be worshipped in order in the north-east, east, south, north and west. The devotee shall worship the six ancillaries then. He shall worship the eye and Astra in the southeast, northeast, southwest, north¬ west and in the middle.…
verses.science: शब्द ही ग्रहण करनेयोग्य है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्ममष्टदलं रक्तं पीतकिञ्जल्ककर्णिकम् । शवर्गस्य तृतीयं तु षष्ठस्वरसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: padmamaṣṭadalaṃ raktaṃ pītakiñjalkakarṇikam | śavargasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhasvarasamanvitam
verses.translation: He shall worship Ananta in the petal in the east; the Suksma in the South; Sivottama in the west; Ekanetra in the north; Ekarudra in the northeast; the Trinity in the southeast; l§rikantha in the south-west and 6ikhan<iSa in the north-west.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Ananta in the petal in the east; the Suksma in the South; Sivottama in the west; Ekanetra in the north; Ekarudra in the northeast; the Trinity in the southeast; l§rikantha in the south-west and 6ikhan<iSa in the north-west.
verses.science: स्त्रीभावको सूचित करती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशस्वरोपेतं बिन्दुनादविभूषितम् । एतद् बीजवरं भद्रे पद्ममध्ये समालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: caturdaśasvaropetaṃ bindunādavibhūṣitam | etad bījavaraṃ bhadre padmamadhye samālikhet
verses.translation: In the second Avarana he shall worship the Empe¬ rors. (Now the third Avarana). The devotee shall worship Vjreana in the middle of the eastern door.
verses.hindi: प्रकाश भी मलिन अर्थात् मन्द हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second Avarana he shall worship the Empe¬ rors. (Now the third Avarana). The devotee shall worship Vjreana in the middle of the eastern door.
verses.science: प्रकाश भी मलिन अर्थात् मन्द हो जाता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्मस्येशानकोष्ठे तु तथा पद्मं समालिखेत् । कवर्गस्य तृतीयं तु पञ्चमस्वरसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: padmasyeśānakoṣṭhe tu tathā padmaṃ samālikhet | kavargasya tṛtīyaṃ tu pañcamasvarasaṃyutam
verses.translation: After invoking Lord Siva with the mantra "Yo Vedadau Svarab"*® he shall worship.him in the lotus above the pericarp in the east.
verses.commentary: Sense: After invoking Lord Siva with the mantra "Yo Vedadau Svarab"*® he shall worship.him in the lotus above the pericarp in the east.
verses.science: तथा सर्वात्मकताका प्रतिपादन होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विलिखेन्मध्यतस्तस्य बिन्दुं कण्ठे स्वलङ्कृतम् । तद्बाह्यपङ्क्तित्रितये पूर्वादिपरितः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vilikhenmadhyatastasya binduṃ kaṇṭhe svalaṅkṛtam | tadbāhyapaṅktitritaye pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: He shall worship Lord Siva in the eastern, ViveSa in the southern, Parameiana in the northern and Sarvea in the western petal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Lord Siva in the eastern, ViveSa in the southern, Parameiana in the northern and Sarvea in the western petal.
verses.science: विश्वप्रतीति 'ब्रह्म' शब्दसे व्यवहृत होती है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कोष्ठानि पञ्च गृह्णीयाद्गिरिराजसुते शिवे । मध्ये तु कर्णिकां कुर्यात्पीतां रक्तं च वृत्तकम्
verses.transliteration: koṣṭhāni pañca gṛhṇīyādgirirājasute śive | madhye tu karṇikāṃ kuryātpītāṃ raktaṃ ca vṛttakam
verses.translation: He shall worship Rudra in the south after invoking him with Rk "A vo rajanam*'*® in the petals and the pericarp with scents, flowers etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Rudra in the south after invoking him with Rk "A vo rajanam*'*® in the petals and the pericarp with scents, flowers etc.
verses.science: वाच्यार्थ हैं-ऐसा ही निर्णय है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दलानि रक्तवर्णानि कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः । दलबाह्ये तु कृष्णेन रन्ध्राणि परिपूरयेत्
verses.transliteration: dalāni raktavarṇāni kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ | dalabāhye tu kṛṣṇena randhrāṇi paripūrayet
verses.translation: Siva shall be worshipped in the east; Hara in the south; Mfda in the north and Bhava in the petal in the western quarter. They shall be worshipped in this order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva shall be worshipped in the east; Hara in the south; Mfda in the north and Bhava in the petal in the western quarter. They shall be worshipped in this order.
verses.science: शिवसूत्र कहा गया है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयादीनि चत्वारि शुक्लेनैव प्रपूरयेत् । पूर्वे षड्बिन्दुसहितं षट्कोणं कृष्णमालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: āgneyādīni catvāri śuklenaiva prapūrayet | pūrve ṣaḍbindusahitaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ kṛṣṇamālikhet
verses.translation: He shall worship Vasudeva in the east; Aniruddha in the south; Samkarsana in the north and Pradyumna in the west.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Vasudeva in the east; Aniruddha in the south; Samkarsana in the north and Pradyumna in the west.
verses.science: स्नेहवश बता रहा हूँ, सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्तवर्णं दक्षिणतस्त्रिकोणं चोत्तरे ततः । श्वेताभमर्द्धचन्द्रं च पीतवर्णं च पश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: raktavarṇaṃ dakṣiṇatastrikoṇaṃ cottare tataḥ | śvetābhamarddhacandraṃ ca pītavarṇaṃ ca paścime
verses.translation: The knower of Mantras shall invoke Brahma with the mantra "Hiranyagarbhah Samavartata"®® etc. and worship him in the lotus to the west.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of Mantras shall invoke Brahma with the mantra "Hiranyagarbhah Samavartata"®® etc. and worship him in the lotus to the west.
verses.science: पाँचवाँ मिथुन पृथ्वी है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुरस्रं क्रमात्तेषु लिखेद्बीजं चतुष्टयम् । पूर्वे बिन्दुं समालिख्य शुभ्रं कृष्णं तु दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: caturasraṃ kramātteṣu likhedbījaṃ catuṣṭayam | pūrve binduṃ samālikhya śubhraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: He shall worship Hiranyagarbha in the east; Viraja in the south; Puskara in the north and Kala in the west.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Hiranyagarbha in the east; Viraja in the south; Puskara in the north and Kala in the west.
verses.science: विद्यात्मक-तत्त्व समझना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उकारमुत्तरे रक्तं मकारं पश्चिमे ततः । अकारं पीतमेवं तु कृत्वा वर्णचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: ukāramuttare raktaṃ makāraṃ paścime tataḥ | akāraṃ pītamevaṃ tu kṛtvā varṇacatuṣṭayam
verses.translation: (Now the fifth Avarana). In the topmost row the Lokapalas shall be worshipped in different spots beginning with the last and proceeding in the manner of circumambula- tion. The following ten are the Bijas for the Lokapalas: — Ranta (ending with 'Ra'), Panta (ending with 'Pa'), Jflanta (ending with 'Jfta') Lanta (ending with 'La') twice, Apurvaka ( beginning with 'A'), Santa (ending with 'Sa'), Santa (ending with 'Sa') Vedadya (Pranava) and SriBija. He shall worship the Lokapalas with these Bijas. He shall worship Brahma and Visnu in accordance with the rules and proper means of service in the north, south-west, south and north-east. He shall worship Devesa in the outer lines of the fifth Avarana.
verses.wordMeaning: (Now the fifth Avarana). In the topmost row the Lokapalas shall be worshipped in different spots beginning with the last and proceeding in the manner of circumambula- tion. The following ten are the Bijas for the Lokapalas: — Ranta (ending with 'Ra'), Panta (ending with 'Pa'),…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Now the fifth Avarana). In the topmost row the Lokapalas shall be worshipped in different spots beginning with the last and proceeding in the manner of circumambula- tion. The following ten are the Bijas for the Lokapalas: — Ranta (ending with 'Ra'), Panta (ending with 'Pa'),…
verses.science: उक्त श्रुतिका प्रादुर्भाव हुआ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोर्ध्वपङ्क्त्यधः पङ्क्तौ समारभ्य च सुन्दरि । पीतं श्वेतं च रक्तं च कृष्णं चेति चतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvordhvapaṅktyadhaḥ paṅktau samārabhya ca sundari | pītaṃ śvetaṃ ca raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam
verses.translation: He shall worship trident in the north-east, thunder¬ bolt in the east; axe in the south-east; arrow in the south; sword in the south-west; noose in the west; goad in the north¬ west and bow in the north.
verses.hindi: होनेपर भी ये सहैव भासित होती रहती हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship trident in the north-east, thunder¬ bolt in the east; axe in the south-east; arrow in the south; sword in the south-west; noose in the west; goad in the north¬ west and bow in the north.
verses.science: होनेपर भी ये सहैव भासित होती रहती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदधो धवलं श्यामं पीतं रक्तं चतुष्टयम् । अधस्त्रिकोणके रक्तं शुक्लं पीतं वरानने
verses.transliteration: tadadho dhavalaṃ śyāmaṃ pītaṃ raktaṃ catuṣṭayam | adhastrikoṇake raktaṃ śuklaṃ pītaṃ varānane
verses.hindi: करनेवाली है, उस कलाका नाम 'राग' है
verses.explanation: करनेवाली है, उस कलाका नाम 'राग' है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: करनेवाली है, उस कलाका नाम 'राग' है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं दक्षिणमारभ्य कुर्यात्सोमान्तमीश्वरि । तद्बाह्यपङ्क्तौ पूर्वादिमध्यमान्तं विचित्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dakṣiṇamārabhya kuryātsomāntamīśvari | tadbāhyapaṅktau pūrvādimadhyamāntaṃ vicitrayet
verses.translation: For the satisfaction of Siva, the knower of the rules shall worship Ketrapala of Rudra facing the west, in accor¬ dance with the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the satisfaction of Siva, the knower of the rules shall worship Ketrapala of Rudra facing the west, in accor¬ dance with the rules.
verses.science: नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पीतं रक्तं च कृष्णं च श्यामं श्वेतं च पीतकम् । आग्रेयादि समारभ्य रक्तं श्यामं सितं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: pītaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca śyāmaṃ śvetaṃ ca pītakam | āgreyādi samārabhya raktaṃ śyāmaṃ sitaṃ priye
verses.translation: All these shall be thought of as standing with palms joined in reverence, their faces beaming with smile and glan¬ cing at the lord and the goddess with devotion always.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these shall be thought of as standing with palms joined in reverence, their faces beaming with smile and glan¬ cing at the lord and the goddess with devotion always.
verses.science: सन्देह तत्त्वत: दूर कीजिये। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं कृष्णं च रक्तं च षट्कमेव प्रकीर्तितम् । दक्षिणाद्यं महेशानि पूर्वावधि समीरितम्
verses.transliteration: raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca raktaṃ ca ṣaṭkameva prakīrtitam | dakṣiṇādyaṃ maheśāni pūrvāvadhi samīritam
verses.translation: After performing the Avarana worship thus, the devotee shall worship the lord of the gods again for allaying his mental disturbance. He shall know Pranava as Siva.
verses.hindi: जनक, ब्रह्म एवं सच्चिदानन्द स्वरूपवाले हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Avarana worship thus, the devotee shall worship the lord of the gods again for allaying his mental disturbance. He shall know Pranava as Siva.
verses.science: जनक, ब्रह्म एवं सच्चिदानन्द स्वरूपवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नैरृताद्यं तु विज्ञेयमाग्नेयावधि चेश्वरि । वारुणं तु समारभ्य दक्षिणावधि चेरितम्
verses.transliteration: nairṛtādyaṃ tu vijñeyamāgneyāvadhi ceśvari | vāruṇaṃ tu samārabhya dakṣiṇāvadhi ceritam
verses.translation: After worshipping duly thus with scents and other services he shall offer Naivedya prepared in the proper manner.
verses.hindi: मायासे संकुचितरूप धारणकर पुरुषरूप हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping duly thus with scents and other services he shall offer Naivedya prepared in the proper manner.
verses.science: मायासे संकुचितरूप धारणकर पुरुषरूप हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वायव्याद्यं महादेवि नैरृतावधि चेरितम् । सोमाद्यं परमेशानि वारुणावधि चेरितम्
verses.transliteration: vāyavyādyaṃ mahādevi nairṛtāvadhi ceritam | somādyaṃ parameśāni vāruṇāvadhi ceritam
verses.translation: He shall give water for Acamana and the Arghya as before, and then offer Tambula and water in accordance with the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall give water for Acamana and the Arghya as before, and then offer Tambula and water in accordance with the rules.
verses.science: क्रमशः तन्मात्राएँ उत्पन्न होती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाद्यं तु विज्ञेयं वायव्यावधि चाम्बिके । इत्युक्तो मण्डलविधिर्मया तुभ्यं च पार्वति
verses.transliteration: īśānādyaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ vāyavyāvadhi cāmbike | ityukto maṇḍalavidhirmayā tubhyaṃ ca pārvati
verses.translation: After performing Nirajana the balance of ihe worship shall be completed. After meditating on the lord and the goddess he shall repeat the mantra hundred and eight times.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Nirajana the balance of ihe worship shall be completed. After meditating on the lord and the goddess he shall repeat the mantra hundred and eight times.
verses.science: उनके कार्य कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं मण्डलमालिख्य नियतात्मा यतिः स्वतः । सौरपूजां प्रकुर्वीत स हि तद्वस्तुतत्परः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ maṇḍalamālikhya niyatātmā yatiḥ svataḥ | saurapūjāṃ prakurvīta sa hi tadvastutatparaḥ
verses.translation: Then he shall stand up with a handful of flowers, O Goddess, meditate on lord Siva with the mantra beginning with "Yo devanam"®' and ending with "Yo vedadau svarah proktah". The handful of flowers shall be dedicated and he shall perform circumambulation thrice.
verses.hindi: कह रहा हूँ, उसे सावधान होकर आदरपूर्वक सुनें
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall stand up with a handful of flowers, O Goddess, meditate on lord Siva with the mantra beginning with "Yo devanam"®' and ending with "Yo vedadau svarah proktah". The handful of flowers shall be dedicated and he shall perform circumambulation thrice.
verses.science: कह रहा हूँ, उसे सावधान होकर आदरपूर्वक सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads. As the enjoyer he becomes merged in Prakrti. He who is beyond this Purusa is named Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: विचरण करते हुए आप अक्षय सुख प्राप्त करें
verses.wordMeaning: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads.…
verses.science: विचरण करते हुए आप अक्षय सुख प्राप्त करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads. As the enjoyer he becomes merged in Prakrti. He who is beyond this Purusa is named Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: त्पादारविन्दविहरन्मधुपत्वमाप ॥ ४९  समान आस्वादन करते हुए तत्त्वज्ञ हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads.…
verses.science: त्पादारविन्दविहरन्मधुपत्वमाप ॥ ४९ समान आस्वादन करते हुए तत्त्वज्ञ हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam
verses.translation: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads. As the enjoyer he becomes merged in Prakrti. He who is beyond this Purusa is named Mahesvara.
verses.wordMeaning: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads.…
verses.science: सृष्टिकथनं नाम सप्तदशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । अन्न्यासपद्धतौ न्यासवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । दक्षिणे मण्डलस्याथ वैयाघ्रं चर्म शोभनम् । आस्तीर्य शुद्धतोयेन प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā 6.6. ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | annyāsapaddhatau nyāsavarṇanam | īśvara uvāca | dakṣiṇe maṇḍalasyātha vaiyāghraṃ carma śobhanam | āstīrya śuddhatoyena prokṣayedastramantrataḥ
verses.translation: He is rightly termed Mahesvara because Prakfti and Purusa are subservient to him. Or Maya is the principle with the three attributes which is imperishable. Know that Maya is the Prakrti and Mayin ( the wielder of Maya) is Mahesvara who is eternal and the releaser from Maya. Hence the name MaheSvara is applicable to him.
verses.hindi: सृष्टिकथन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: He is rightly termed Mahesvara because Prakfti and Purusa are subservient to him. Or Maya is the principle with the three attributes which is imperishable. Know that Maya is the Prakrti and Mayin ( the wielder of Maya) is Mahesvara who is eternal and the releaser from Maya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is rightly termed Mahesvara because Prakfti and Purusa are subservient to him. Or Maya is the principle with the three attributes which is imperishable. Know that Maya is the Prakrti and Mayin ( the wielder of Maya) is Mahesvara who is eternal and the releaser from Maya.…
verses.science: सृष्टिकथन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य पश्चादाधारमुद्धरेत् । तत्पश्चाच्छक्तिकमलं चतुर्थ्यन्तं नमोऽन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya paścādādhāramuddharet | tatpaścācchaktikamalaṃ caturthyantaṃ namo'ntakam
verses.translation: After wiping the Liiiga with a piece of cloth he shall put a flower on the top. After installing the Linga on the pedestal he shall perform the worship of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: After wiping the Liiiga with a piece of cloth he shall put a flower on the top. After installing the Linga on the pedestal he shall perform the worship of the sun.
verses.science: चारों ओर अभिवेष्टित कर दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनुमेवं समुच्चार्य स्थित्वा तस्मिन्नुदङ्मुखः । प्राणानायम्य विधिवत्प्रणवोच्चारपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: manumevaṃ samuccārya sthitvā tasminnudaṅmukhaḥ | prāṇānāyamya vidhivatpraṇavoccārapūrvakam
verses.translation: When shall we see the excellent sage again? His sight dispels the vast miseries of worldly existence. May the great sage appear again as a result of the merit accruing from the worship of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: When shall we see the excellent sage again? His sight dispels the vast miseries of worldly existence. May the great sage appear again as a result of the merit accruing from the worship of lord Siva.
verses.science: करते हुए उसका पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैर्भस्म सन्धारयेत्ततः । शिरसि श्रीगुरुं नत्वा मण्डलं रचयेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: agnirityādibhirmantrairbhasma sandhārayettataḥ | śirasi śrīguruṃ natvā maṇḍalaṃ racayetpunaḥ
verses.translation: O intelligent sages, you all who have fulfilled your vows are blessed. I have come for your sake. Please listen in details.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent sages, you all who have fulfilled your vows are blessed. I have come for your sake. Please listen in details.
verses.science: जलसे दोनों हाथोंको धो डाले। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकोणवृत्तं बाह्ये तु चतुरस्रात्मकं क्रमात् । अभ्यर्च्योमिति साधारं स्थाप्य शङ्खं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: trikoṇavṛttaṃ bāhye tu caturasrātmakaṃ kramāt | abhyarcyomiti sādhāraṃ sthāpya śaṅkhaṃ samarcayet
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Suta, the sages were delighted in their minds. They bowed to the sage Vyasa again and again and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Suta, the sages were delighted in their minds. They bowed to the sage Vyasa again and again and said.
verses.science: पाँच आतिवाहिक देवता आते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्य शुद्धतोयेन प्रणवेन सुगन्धिना । अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणवेन च सप्तधा
verses.transliteration: āpūrya śuddhatoyena praṇavena sugandhinā | abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇavena ca saptadhā
verses.translation: Om, obeisance to the meaning of the Pranava, to the enterpreter of the Pranava, to the Bija of the letters of the Pranava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om, obeisance to the meaning of the Pranava, to the enterpreter of the Pranava, to the Bija of the letters of the Pranava.
verses.science: महादेवजीका चिन्तन एवं पूजन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्त्र्य ततस्तस्मिन्धेनुमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत् । शङ्खमुद्रां च तेनैव प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: abhimantrya tatastasmindhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet | śaṅkhamudrāṃ ca tenaiva prokṣayedastramantrataḥ
verses.translation: This prayer sharpens intelligence, enhances devotion to Siva, increases longevity, imparts health and affluence and yields all desires always.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे षष्ठयां कैलाससंहितायां यतीनामेकादशाहकृत्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: This prayer sharpens intelligence, enhances devotion to Siva, increases longevity, imparts health and affluence and yields all desires always.
verses.science: इृति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे षष्ठयां कैलाससंहितायां यतीनामेकादशाहकृत्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं गन्धपुष्पादिपूजोपकरणानि च । प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा ऋष्यादिकमथाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādipūjopakaraṇāni ca | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādikamathācaret
verses.translation: The eternal Sruti says, "Verily all this is Om; Om is Brahman. Everything is Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal Sruti says, "Verily all this is Om; Om is Brahman. Everything is Brahman.
verses.science: आनन्द प्रदान करनेवाला हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य श्रीसौरमन्त्रस्य देवभाग ऋषिस्ततः । छन्दो गायत्रमित्युक्तं देवः सूर्यो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: asya śrīsauramantrasya devabhāga ṛṣistataḥ | chando gāyatramityuktaṃ devaḥ sūryo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O commander of the gods, obeisance to you, the lord of the gods and of ascetics. Obeisance to you the perfect one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O commander of the gods, obeisance to you, the lord of the gods and of ascetics. Obeisance to you the perfect one.
verses.science: मोक्षदायक चरणोंका दर्शन किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवता स्यात्षडङ्गानि ह्रामित्यादीनि विन्यसेत् । ततः सम्प्रोक्षयेत्पद्ममस्त्रेणाग्नेरगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: devatā syātṣaḍaṅgāni hrāmityādīni vinyaset | tataḥ samprokṣayetpadmamastreṇāgneragocaram
verses.translation: The word Rud means misery or cause of misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Rud means misery or cause of misery.
verses.science: पावनी कथा उत्पन्न हुई। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्समर्चयेद्विद्वान् प्रभूतां विमलामपि । सारां चाथ समाराध्य पूर्वादिपरतः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tasminsamarcayedvidvān prabhūtāṃ vimalāmapi | sārāṃ cātha samārādhya pūrvādiparataḥ kramāt
verses.translation: A pathologist diagnoses correctly and cures illness through medicines. Similarly Siva the cause of dissolu¬ tion, sustenance and origin of the world as well as the router of the gross is called the physician of the world by those who know the nature of the principles.
verses.hindi: पृततः प्राह प्रसन्‍तस्तान् शिवासक्तमना बुध:॥ ३  प्रसन्‍न होकर उनसे कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: A pathologist diagnoses correctly and cures illness through medicines. Similarly Siva the cause of dissolu¬ tion, sustenance and origin of the world as well as the router of the gross is called the physician of the world by those who know the nature of the principles.
verses.science: पृततः प्राह प्रसन्‍तस्तान् शिवासक्तमना बुध:॥ ३ प्रसन्‍न होकर उनसे कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालाग्निरुद्रं च शक्तिमाधारसंज्ञिताम् । अनन्तं पृथिवीं चैव रत्नद्वीपं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: atha kālāgnirudraṃ ca śaktimādhārasaṃjñitām | anantaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva ratnadvīpaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Atoms enveloped by the dirt of the ocean of Maya do not know the gross and subtle things that occur in the three periods of time even when they have the sense- organs for imbibing the five-fold knowledge. But SadaSiva knows every existent object naturally, even though he has no sense-organs yielding the knowledge of all existent objects. Hence he is called omniscient.
verses.hindi: सभी “लोग उन दोनोंके संवादको पुन: सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: Atoms enveloped by the dirt of the ocean of Maya do not know the gross and subtle things that occur in the three periods of time even when they have the sense- organs for imbibing the five-fold knowledge. But SadaSiva knows every existent object naturally,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Atoms enveloped by the dirt of the ocean of Maya do not know the gross and subtle things that occur in the three periods of time even when they have the sense- organs for imbibing the five-fold knowledge. But SadaSiva knows every existent object naturally,…
verses.science: सभी “लोग उन दोनोंके संवादको पुन: सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्य वृक्षोद्यानं च गृहं मणिमयं ततः । रक्तपीठं च सम्पूज्य पादेषु प्रागुपक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: saṅkalya vṛkṣodyānaṃ ca gṛhaṃ maṇimayaṃ tataḥ | raktapīṭhaṃ ca sampūjya pādeṣu prāgupakramāt
verses.translation: After eulogising Mahadeva, identical with Pranava, the imperishable and offering gifts on the head of Isana, he worships the lord with the purity of mind, by means of the pranava. He shall then take a handful of flowers, join palms in reverence, inhale through the left nostril, identifying the inhaled air with Siva and exhale through the right nostril bidding the ritualistic adieu to the goddess. He shall realise the identity of Siva with himself. "I am Siva alone.** He shall make the ritualistic dismissal of the deities conceived in the heart.
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising Mahadeva, identical with Pranava, the imperishable and offering gifts on the head of Isana, he worships the lord with the purity of mind, by means of the pranava. He shall then take a handful of flowers, join palms in reverence, inhale through the left nostril,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising Mahadeva, identical with Pranava, the imperishable and offering gifts on the head of Isana, he worships the lord with the purity of mind, by means of the pranava. He shall then take a handful of flowers, join palms in reverence, inhale through the left nostril,…
verses.science: विनयपूर्वक पुन: पूछा--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च चतुष्टयम् । अधर्माद्यग्निकोणादिकोणेषु च समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca catuṣṭayam | adharmādyagnikoṇādikoṇeṣu ca samarcayet
verses.translation: After worshipping the lore and the preceptor he shall fix in the heart the mantras o the conch and the vessel of Arghya.
verses.hindi: इन्हें उपदेशमें अधिकार क्‍यों नहीं है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the lore and the preceptor he shall fix in the heart the mantras o the conch and the vessel of Arghya.
verses.science: इन्हें उपदेशमें अधिकार क्‍यों नहीं है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मायाधश्छदनं पश्चाद्विद्योर्ध्वच्छदनं ततः । सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव समभ्यर्च्य यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: māyādhaśchadanaṃ paścādvidyordhvacchadanaṃ tataḥ | sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva samabhyarcya yathākramam
verses.translation: After consigning the remnants of the floral offerings to Ganesa in the north-east quarter he shall restrain
verses.hindi: तथा पार्वतीका ध्यान करते हुए कहने लगे--
verses.commentary: Sense: After consigning the remnants of the floral offerings to Ganesa in the north-east quarter he shall restrain
verses.science: तथा पार्वतीका ध्यान करते हुए कहने लगे--। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वादिदिक्षु मध्ये च दीप्तां सूक्ष्मां जयामपि । भद्रां विभूतिं विमलाममोघां वैद्युतामपि
verses.transliteration: pūrvādidikṣu madhye ca dīptāṃ sūkṣmāṃ jayāmapi | bhadrāṃ vibhūtiṃ vimalāmamoghāṃ vaidyutāmapi
verses.translation: O beloved, he shall worship it, as mentiond above. He shall pour water from Argha above on the top of Linga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, he shall worship it, as mentiond above. He shall pour water from Argha above on the top of Linga.
verses.science: ऐसे आसनपर बैठे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतोमुखसंज्ञां च कन्दनालं तथैव च । सुषिरं च ततस्तं तु कण्टकांस्तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatomukhasaṃjñāṃ ca kandanālaṃ tathaiva ca | suṣiraṃ ca tatastaṃ tu kaṇṭakāṃstadanantaram
verses.translation: After worshipping it with Pranava he shall offer incense and the lamp. After propitiating Ganda in the north*east he shall offer Nirmalya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping it with Pranava he shall offer incense and the lamp. After propitiating Ganda in the north*east he shall offer Nirmalya.
verses.science: सुगन्धित पुष्पोंसे उसकी पूजा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मूलच्छदनकिञ्जल्कप्रकाशसकलात्मनः । पञ्चग्रन्थिकर्णिकां च दलानि तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: mūlacchadanakiñjalkaprakāśasakalātmanaḥ | pañcagranthikarṇikāṃ ca dalāni tadanantaram
verses.translation: The Linga and the altar shall be washed with the filtered water. Repeating the Pranava he shall put a flower on the top of the Liiiga. He shall mentally con¬ ceive everythig from the Adhara Sakti to the seat of the holy lore and install the supreme god.
verses.hindi: प्रवालगोमेदके चर पञ्ञरलमिदं स्मृतम्॥ २८  गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: The Linga and the altar shall be washed with the filtered water. Repeating the Pranava he shall put a flower on the top of the Liiiga. He shall mentally con¬ ceive everythig from the Adhara Sakti to the seat of the holy lore and install the supreme god.
verses.science: प्रवालगोमेदके चर पञ्ञरलमिदं स्मृतम्॥ २८ गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: केशरान् ब्रह्मविष्णू च रुद्रमात्मानमेव च । अन्तरात्मानमपि च ज्ञानात्मपरमात्मनि
verses.transliteration: keśarān brahmaviṣṇū ca rudramātmānameva ca | antarātmānamapi ca jñānātmaparamātmani
verses.translation: He shall perform the ablution of the lord with Pafleagavya etc. or with holy water rendered fragrant with scented articles repeating the mantras from the Rg or Samaveda such as 'Pavamana' 'Rudra' 'Nila' or 'Tvarita' along with the five Brahmans. The Pranava or the name of Siva can be used as mantra. The ablution shall be made with the Arghya water repeating the Pranava.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform the ablution of the lord with Pafleagavya etc. or with holy water rendered fragrant with scented articles repeating the mantras from the Rg or Samaveda such as 'Pavamana' 'Rudra' 'Nila' or 'Tvarita' along with the five Brahmans.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the ablution of the lord with Pafleagavya etc. or with holy water rendered fragrant with scented articles repeating the mantras from the Rg or Samaveda such as 'Pavamana' 'Rudra' 'Nila' or 'Tvarita' along with the five Brahmans.…
verses.science: उन देवोंका आवाहनकर पूजा करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य पश्चात्सौराख्यं योगपीठं समर्चयेत् । पीठोपरि समाकल्प्य मूर्त्तिं मूलेन मूलवित्
verses.transliteration: sampūjya paścātsaurākhyaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ samarcayet | pīṭhopari samākalpya mūrttiṃ mūlena mūlavit
verses.translation: He shall worship the Adharasakti and Ananta beneath the pedestal. After worshipping the throne duly with the lower and upper lid he shall worship Skanda on the foot of the Pijha. After conceiving me in the Linga he shall worship me along with you.
verses.hindi: तानि धारय चित्ते हि स ब्रूयादिति संस्फुटम् ॥ ४७  करे
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the Adharasakti and Ananta beneath the pedestal. After worshipping the throne duly with the lower and upper lid he shall worship Skanda on the foot of the Pijha. After conceiving me in the Linga he shall worship me along with you.
verses.science: तानि धारय चित्ते हि स ब्रूयादिति संस्फुटम् ॥ ४७ करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्धप्राण आसीनो मूलेनैव स्वमूलतः । शक्तिमुत्थाप्य तत्तेन प्रभावात्पिङ्गलाध्वना
verses.transliteration: niruddhaprāṇa āsīno mūlenaiva svamūlataḥ | śaktimutthāpya tattena prabhāvātpiṅgalādhvanā
verses.translation: The ascedc shall think on me with devotion in accordance with the rules. O beloved, thus I have narrated to you a great secret that shall be guarded assiduously. It shall not be imparted to any one and everyone. It shall be
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्यासप्रद्धतों शिष्यकरणविधिनमाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascedc shall think on me with devotion in accordance with the rules. O beloved, thus I have narrated to you a great secret that shall be guarded assiduously. It shall not be imparted to any one and everyone. It shall be
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्यासप्रद्धतों शिष्यकरणविधिनमाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाञ्जलौ निर्गमय्य मण्डलस्थस्य भास्वतः । सिन्दूरारुणदेहस्य वामार्धदयितस्य च
verses.transliteration: puṣpāñjalau nirgamayya maṇḍalasthasya bhāsvataḥ | sindūrāruṇadehasya vāmārdhadayitasya ca
verses.translation: It shall be given to a person devoted to his preceptor, who is calm and who engages in Yoga for attaining me. The foolish fellow who transgresses my directives and gives this away is my enemy. Surely he will go to hell. O goddess, imparting it to my devotee he will become my favourite. After enjoying all pleasures here he shall attain my presence.
verses.hindi: पिष्यकरणविधि नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: It shall be given to a person devoted to his preceptor, who is calm and who engages in Yoga for attaining me. The foolish fellow who transgresses my directives and gives this away is my enemy. Surely he will go to hell. O goddess,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be given to a person devoted to his preceptor, who is calm and who engages in Yoga for attaining me. The foolish fellow who transgresses my directives and gives this away is my enemy. Surely he will go to hell. O goddess,…
verses.science: पिष्यकरणविधि नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षस्रक्पाशखट्वाङ्गकपालाङ्कुशपङ्कजम् । शङ्खं चक्रं दधानस्य चतुर्वक्त्रस्य लोचनैः
verses.transliteration: akṣasrakpāśakhaṭvāṅgakapālāṅkuśapaṅkajam | śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ dadhānasya caturvaktrasya locanaiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this speech of Siva, the goddess eulogised the lord with various hymns containing the purport of the Vcdic mantras. She bowed at the feet of her lord. O excellent sages, she rejoiced with a delighted heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this speech of Siva, the goddess eulogised the lord with various hymns containing the purport of the Vcdic mantras. She bowed at the feet of her lord. O excellent sages, she rejoiced with a delighted heart.
verses.science: परमेश्वर ही 'अहम्' पदके अर्थभूत हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजितस्य द्वादशभिस्तस्य हृत्पङ्कजोदरे । प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य ह्रां ह्रीं सस्तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: rājitasya dvādaśabhistasya hṛtpaṅkajodare | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya hrāṃ hrīṃ sastadanantaram
verses.translation: After saying this, the excellent sage of great penance, the son of Parasara, worshipped and honoured with intent devotion by the sages and propounder of the Vedas, thought of the mount Kailasa and left that hermitage. Delighted in their hearts, at the end of the sacrifice they too worshipped the moon-crested god and the goddess Uma wi»h great devotion. They engaged themselves in Yogic practices of restraint etc. and continued to meditate on Siva.
verses.hindi: सर्वरूपता स्पष्ट ही सूचित होती है
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the excellent sage of great penance, the son of Parasara, worshipped and honoured with intent devotion by the sages and propounder of the Vedas, thought of the mount Kailasa and left that hermitage. Delighted in their hearts,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the excellent sage of great penance, the son of Parasara, worshipped and honoured with intent devotion by the sages and propounder of the Vedas, thought of the mount Kailasa and left that hermitage. Delighted in their hearts,…
verses.science: सर्वरूपता स्पष्ट ही सूचित होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशशक्तिसहितं मार्तण्डं च ततः परम् । आवाहयामि नम इत्यावाह्यावाहनाख्यया
verses.transliteration: prakāśaśaktisahitaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ ca tataḥ param | āvāhayāmi nama ityāvāhyāvāhanākhyayā
verses.translation: On knowing vonr love for the lord and realising that you are his favountc devotee, this secret of secrets has been narrated to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing vonr love for the lord and realising that you are his favountc devotee, this secret of secrets has been narrated to you by me.
verses.science: करनेवाले विद्वानोंने कहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुद्रया स्थापनाद्याश्च मुद्राः सन्दर्शयेत्ततः । विन्यस्याङ्गानि ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रूं अन्तेन मनुना ततः
verses.transliteration: mudrayā sthāpanādyāśca mudrāḥ sandarśayettataḥ | vinyasyāṅgāni hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ antena manunā tataḥ
verses.translation: This secret lore dear to Siva shall be given by you only to ascetics of quiet minds, devotees of Siva's feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: This secret lore dear to Siva shall be given by you only to ascetics of quiet minds, devotees of Siva's feet.
verses.science: अर्थ यहाँ अभीष्ट है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चोपचारान्सङ्कल्प्य मूलेनाभ्यर्चयेत् त्रिधा । केशरेषु च पद्मस्य षडङ्गानि महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: pañcopacārānsaṅkalpya mūlenābhyarcayet tridhā | keśareṣu ca padmasya ṣaḍaṅgāni maheśvari
verses.translation: After saying this the blessed Suta, most excellent of Pauranikas, wandered over the earth, visiting the holy centres.
verses.hindi: अर्थ किया जाता है, वह औपचारिक है
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the blessed Suta, most excellent of Pauranikas, wandered over the earth, visiting the holy centres.
verses.science: अर्थ किया जाता है, वह औपचारिक है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वह्नीशरक्षोवायूनां परितः क्रमतः सुधीः । द्वितीयावरणे पूज्याश्चतस्रो मूर्तयः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vahnīśarakṣovāyūnāṃ paritaḥ kramataḥ sudhīḥ | dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāścatasro mūrtayaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: After securing this great secret from Suta, the sages remained in Kai and attained Siva's abode by attaining salvation.
verses.hindi: शिव ही सम्पूर्ण तत्त्वसमुदायका प्राण हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing this great secret from Suta, the sages remained in Kai and attained Siva's abode by attaining salvation.
verses.science: शिव ही सम्पूर्ण तत्त्वसमुदायका प्राण हूँ। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाद्युत्तरपर्यन्तं दलमूलेषु पार्वति । आदित्यो भास्करो भानू रविश्चेत्यनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pūrvādyuttaraparyantaṃ dalamūleṣu pārvati | ādityo bhāskaro bhānū raviścetyanupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: When Suta had left, the wondering sages thought and spoke to one another — "What the great sage said about Vamadeva's opinion has been forgotten. This is indeed dis¬ tressing to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Suta had left, the wondering sages thought and spoke to one another — "What the great sage said about Vamadeva's opinion has been forgotten. This is indeed dis¬ tressing to us.
verses.science: इसका आदरपूर्वक उपदेश करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्को ब्रह्मा तथा रुद्रो विष्णुश्चेति पुनः प्रिये । ईशानादिषु सम्पूज्यास्तृतीयावरणे पुनः
verses.transliteration: arko brahmā tathā rudro viṣṇuśceti punaḥ priye | īśānādiṣu sampūjyāstṛtīyāvaraṇe punaḥ
verses.translation: The sages who were worried with these thoughts worshipped Suta in the lotus of their heart and stayed there being eager to see him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages who were worried with these thoughts worshipped Suta in the lotus of their heart and stayed there being eager to see him.
verses.science: शिष्योंकों भी मस्तक झुकाये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोमं कुजं बुधं जीवं कविं मन्दं तमस्तमः । समन्ततो यजेदेतान्पूर्वादिदलमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: somaṃ kujaṃ budhaṃ jīvaṃ kaviṃ mandaṃ tamastamaḥ | samantato yajedetānpūrvādidalamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: At the end of a year, the sage, engaged in devo¬ tional activities of Siva, the wise propounder of the meaning to the Puranas, came to Kasi again.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of a year, the sage, engaged in devo¬ tional activities of Siva, the wise propounder of the meaning to the Puranas, came to Kasi again.
verses.science: उसे शिष्य बनाओ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवा द्वादशादित्यान्द्वितीयावरणे यजेत् । तृतीयावरणे चैव राशीन्द्वादश पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: athavā dvādaśādityāndvitīyāvaraṇe yajet | tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva rāśīndvādaśa pūjayet
verses.translation: On seeing Suta coming, the sages delighted in their minds, worshipped him duly rising up and offering seat and Arghya.
verses.hindi: आश्रय ले सुखी रहो, सुखी रहो ।'
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Suta coming, the sages delighted in their minds, worshipped him duly rising up and offering seat and Arghya.
verses.science: आश्रय ले सुखी रहो, सुखी रहो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तसागरगङ्गाश्च बहिरस्य समन्ततः । ऋषीन्देवांश्च गन्धर्वान्पन्नगानप्सरोगणान्
verses.transliteration: saptasāgaragaṅgāśca bahirasya samantataḥ | ṛṣīndevāṃśca gandharvānpannagānapsarogaṇān
verses.translation: He too congratulated the sages with a smiling face. With pleasure he took the bath in the holy waters of the Gahga.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्‍न चित्तसे शिष्यको अपने समान बना दें
verses.commentary: Sense: He too congratulated the sages with a smiling face. With pleasure he took the bath in the holy waters of the Gahga.
verses.science: प्रसन्‍न चित्तसे शिष्यको अपने समान बना दें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामण्यश्च तथा यक्षान्यातुधानांस्तथा हयान् । सप्तच्छन्दोमयांश्चैव बालखिल्यांश्च पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: grāmaṇyaśca tathā yakṣānyātudhānāṃstathā hayān | saptacchandomayāṃścaiva bālakhilyāṃśca pūjayet
verses.translation: He propitiated the sages, the gods and the Pitrs with gingelly seeds and rice grains. He came to the bank and put on his dress after sprinkling it with water.
verses.hindi: जशति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां योगपट्रविधिवर्णन नामैकोनविंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: He propitiated the sages, the gods and the Pitrs with gingelly seeds and rice grains. He came to the bank and put on his dress after sprinkling it with water.
verses.science: जशति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां योगपट्रविधिवर्णन नामैकोनविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्र्यावरणं देवं समभ्यर्च्य दिवाकरम् । विरच्य मण्डलं पश्चाच्चतुरस्रं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tryāvaraṇaṃ devaṃ samabhyarcya divākaram | viracya maṇḍalaṃ paścāccaturasraṃ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He performed the Acamana twice and took the Bhasm i repeating the SadyMi mantras. Wearing the garland
verses.hindi: करनेसे यतिकी तत्क्षण परम शुद्धि होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the Acamana twice and took the Bhasm i repeating the SadyMi mantras. Wearing the garland
verses.science: करनेसे यतिकी तत्क्षण परम शुद्धि होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थाप्य साधारकं ताम्रपात्रं प्रस्थोदविस्तृतम् । पूरयित्वा जलैः शुद्धैर्वासितैः कुसुमादिभिः
verses.transliteration: sthāpya sādhārakaṃ tāmrapātraṃ prasthodavistṛtam | pūrayitvā jalaiḥ śuddhairvāsitaiḥ kusumādibhiḥ
verses.translation: With great devotion he eulogised, bowed to and worshipped lord Siva and Uma along with his sons and chief Ganas.
verses.hindi: वस्त्र पहने हुए ही क्षौरकर्म कराये
verses.commentary: Sense: With great devotion he eulogised, bowed to and worshipped lord Siva and Uma along with his sons and chief Ganas.
verses.science: वस्त्र पहने हुए ही क्षौरकर्म कराये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्जानुभ्यामवनिं गतः । अर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय भ्रूमध्यान्तं समुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairjānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ | arghyapātraṃ samādāya bhrūmadhyāntaṃ samuddharet
verses.translation: He worshipped Kalabhairava in accordance with the rules after circumambulating him thrice. He prostrated five times and circumambutaled again. Thinking upon his lotus-feet he eulogised him again with the great hymn.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped Kalabhairava in accordance with the rules after circumambulating him thrice. He prostrated five times and circumambutaled again. Thinking upon his lotus-feet he eulogised him again with the great hymn.
verses.science: क्षुरेको पुनः प्रक्षालित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ब्रूयादिमं मन्त्रं सावित्रं सर्वसिद्धिदम् । शृणु तच्च महादेवि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सदा
verses.transliteration: tato brūyādimaṃ mantraṃ sāvitraṃ sarvasiddhidam | śṛṇu tacca mahādevi bhuktimuktipradaṃ sadā
verses.translation: He performed the Japa of the sacred Pancak?ari lore one thousand and eight times. Standing in front of lord Siva's image he begged for forgiveness. After worship¬ ping him he took his seat in the the middle of Muktimandapa offered by the sages who had mastered the Vedas.
verses.hindi: हाथ-पैरके नाखून भी कटवा लेना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the Japa of the sacred Pancak?ari lore one thousand and eight times. Standing in front of lord Siva's image he begged for forgiveness. After worship¬ ping him he took his seat in the the middle of Muktimandapa offered by the sages who had mastered the Vedas.
verses.science: हाथ-पैरके नाखून भी कटवा लेना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सिन्दूरवर्णाय सुमण्डलाय नमोऽस्तु वज्राभरणाय तुभ्यम् । पद्माभनेत्राय सपङ्कजाय ब्रह्मेन्द्रनारायणकारणाय
verses.transliteration: sindūravarṇāya sumaṇḍalāya namo'stu vajrābharaṇāya tubhyam | padmābhanetrāya sapaṅkajāya brahmendranārāyaṇakāraṇāya
verses.translation: When all had taken their seats after due obeisance with the recital of the mantras he spoke in accents that in¬ creased the piety of the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all had taken their seats after due obeisance with the recital of the mantras he spoke in accents that in¬ creased the piety of the sages.
verses.science: उसका प्रोक्षण तथा अभिमन्त्रण करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सरक्तचूर्णं ससुवर्णतोयं स्रक्कुङ्कुमाढ्यं सकुशं सपुष्पम् । प्रदत्तमादाय सहेमपात्रं प्रशस्तमर्घ्यं भगवन्प्रसीद
verses.transliteration: saraktacūrṇaṃ sasuvarṇatoyaṃ srakkuṅkumāḍhyaṃ sakuśaṃ sapuṣpam | pradattamādāya sahemapātraṃ praśastamarghyaṃ bhagavanprasīda
verses.translation: After telling you the meaning of the Pranava I went on a pilgp'image. Now hear the details.
verses.commentary: Sense: After telling you the meaning of the Pranava I went on a pilgp'image. Now hear the details.
verses.science: जलमें प्रवेश करे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो दत्त्वा तदर्घ्यं सूर्यमूर्तये । नमस्कुर्यादिमं मन्त्रं पठित्वा सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tato dattvā tadarghyaṃ sūryamūrtaye | namaskuryādimaṃ mantraṃ paṭhitvā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmans, after starting from here I went to the southern ocean. I took bath therein and worshipped the goddess l§iva, Kanyakumari. On my return I came to the river Suvarnamukhari®.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmans, after starting from here I went to the southern ocean. I took bath therein and worshipped the goddess l§iva, Kanyakumari. On my return I came to the river Suvarnamukhari®.
verses.science: पंचांग प्रणाम करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय साम्बाय सगणायादिहेतवे । रुद्राय विष्णवे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे च त्रिमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śivāya sāmbāya sagaṇāyādihetave | rudrāya viṣṇave tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe ca trimūrtaye
verses.translation: I reached the wonderful city on the Kalahasti!§aila. I took my bath in the waters of SuvarnamukharP®®and performed Tarpana to the gods and the sages. Remembering Siva with the mystic signs I worshipped Kalahastisa with the lustre of the lunar stone, the lord with the face directed to the west, the wonderful lord of five faces, the lord who
verses.hindi: करे, किंतु दूषित अन्न कभी ग्रहण न करे
verses.wordMeaning: I reached the wonderful city on the Kalahasti!§aila. I took my bath in the waters of SuvarnamukharP®®and performed Tarpana to the gods and the sages. Remembering Siva with the mystic signs I worshipped Kalahastisa with the lustre of the lunar stone,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I reached the wonderful city on the Kalahasti!§aila. I took my bath in the waters of SuvarnamukharP®®and performed Tarpana to the gods and the sages. Remembering Siva with the mystic signs I worshipped Kalahastisa with the lustre of the lunar stone,…
verses.science: करे, किंतु दूषित अन्न कभी ग्रहण न करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा नमस्कृत्य स्वासने समवस्थितः । ऋष्यादिकं पुनः कृत्वा करं संशोध्य वारिणा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā namaskṛtya svāsane samavasthitaḥ | ṛṣyādikaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā karaṃ saṃśodhya vāriṇā
verses.translation: This sacred river of South India issues from the Agaslya mountain, flows in the North Arcot district near Kalahasti mountain and falls into the southern sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sacred river of South India issues from the Agaslya mountain, flows in the North Arcot district near Kalahasti mountain and falls into the southern sea.
verses.science: हैं, पाँचवाँ कोई अन्य नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च भस्म सन्धार्य पूर्वोक्तेनैव वर्त्मना । न्यासजातं प्रकुर्वीत शिवभावविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: punaśca bhasma sandhārya pūrvoktenaiva vartmanā | nyāsajātaṃ prakurvīta śivabhāvavivṛddhaye
verses.translation: O great sages, I spent four months there by the favour of the goddess — the bud of the flower of knowledge.
verses.hindi: कर्म यतियोंके लिये सर्वथा वर्जित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I spent four months there by the favour of the goddess — the bud of the flower of knowledge.
verses.science: कर्म यतियोंके लिये सर्वथा वर्जित हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चोपचारैः सम्पूज्य शिरसा श्रीगुरुं बुधः । प्रणवं श्रीचतुर्थ्यन्तं नमोऽन्तं प्रणमेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya śirasā śrīguruṃ budhaḥ | praṇavaṃ śrīcaturthyantaṃ namo'ntaṃ praṇamettataḥ
verses.translation: Once I spread the cloth, deerskin and the Kusa grass on the seat. Seated on it silently with restrained mind I entered into the mystic trance. "I am Siva the solidified knowledge and bliss, the perfect one for ever." This realisation dawned in my heart and I was free from agitation.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां क्षौरस्नानविधिवर्णन॑ नाम विंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Once I spread the cloth, deerskin and the Kusa grass on the seat. Seated on it silently with restrained mind I entered into the mystic trance. "I am Siva the solidified knowledge and bliss,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Once I spread the cloth, deerskin and the Kusa grass on the seat. Seated on it silently with restrained mind I entered into the mystic trance. "I am Siva the solidified knowledge and bliss,…
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां क्षौरस्नानविधिवर्णन॑ नाम विंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चात्मकं बिन्दुयुतं पञ्चमस्वरसंयुतम् । तदेवं बिन्दुसहितं पञ्चमस्वरवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: pañcātmakaṃ binduyutaṃ pañcamasvarasaṃyutam | tadevaṃ bindusahitaṃ pañcamasvaravarjitam
verses.translation: Then my preceptor, the ocean of meicy, resem¬ bling the dark cloud, with matted tawny hair resembling the lightning, the tall sage bearing the water-pot and staff and wearing the antelope's skin, with the body turned white with the ashes having all auspicious marks with the Tripundra shining on the forehead, decorated with Rudraksa garlands and the two lotus-like wide eyes gleaming, appeared in the lotus of my heart. Thereafter I swooned soon, O theists, this was the wonderful incident indeed.
verses.wordMeaning: Then my preceptor, the ocean of meicy, resem¬ bling the dark cloud, with matted tawny hair resembling the lightning, the tall sage bearing the water-pot and staff and wearing the antelope's skin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then my preceptor, the ocean of meicy, resem¬ bling the dark cloud, with matted tawny hair resembling the lightning, the tall sage bearing the water-pot and staff and wearing the antelope's skin,…
verses.science: नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमस्वरसंयुक्तं मन्त्रीशं च सबिन्दुकम् । उद्धृत्य बिन्दुसहितं संवर्तकमथोद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: pañcamasvarasaṃyuktaṃ mantrīśaṃ ca sabindukam | uddhṛtya bindusahitaṃ saṃvartakamathoddharet
verses.translation: Then I opened my eyes and cried. The tears I shed quashed out like a mountain stream.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I opened my eyes and cried. The tears I shed quashed out like a mountain stream.
verses.science: करनेवाला नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतैरेवं क्रमाद्बीजैरुद्धृतैः प्रणमेद् बुधः । भुजयोरूरुयुग्मे च गुरुं गणपतिं तथा
verses.transliteration: etairevaṃ kramādbījairuddhṛtaiḥ praṇamed budhaḥ | bhujayorūruyugme ca guruṃ gaṇapatiṃ tathā
verses.translation: "O blessed.son of Suta, go to Varanasi; the sages whom you had instructed before, are desirous of the plca- •sure of your arrival. They are on fast theretoo." After saying this the voice stopped.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O blessed.son of Suta, go to Varanasi; the sages whom you had instructed before, are desirous of the plca- •sure of your arrival. They are on fast theretoo." After saying this the voice stopped.
verses.science: रहस्यको कहने लगे--। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गां च क्षेत्रपालं च बद्धाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः । ओमस्त्राय फडित्युक्त्वा करौ संशोध्य षट् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: durgāṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ ca baddhāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ | omastrāya phaḍityuktvā karau saṃśodhya ṣaṭ kramāt
verses.translation: I got up immediately and circumambulated the lord and the goddess with devotion. I bowed and prostrated for twelve times. Considering it the order of my preceptor
verses.commentary: Sense: I got up immediately and circumambulated the lord and the goddess with devotion. I bowed and prostrated for twelve times. Considering it the order of my preceptor
verses.science: शिवभक्तिसमन्वित शिष्यको ही देना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपसर्पन्त्विति प्रोच्य प्रणवं तदनन्तरम् । अस्त्राय फडिति प्रोच्य पार्ष्णिघातत्रयेण तु
verses.transliteration: apasarpantviti procya praṇavaṃ tadanantaram | astrāya phaḍiti procya pārṣṇighātatrayeṇa tu
verses.translation: O Siita, O blessed Suta, you are our excellent preceptor. We ask you if there be your blessing for us, your faithful disciples, as it has been shown by you who are always affectionate to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siita, O blessed Suta, you are our excellent preceptor. We ask you if there be your blessing for us, your faithful disciples, as it has been shown by you who are always affectionate to us.
verses.science: जन्म ग्रहण करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य विघ्नान्भूयिष्ठान्करतालत्रयेण तु । अन्तरिक्षगतान्दृष्ट्वा विलोक्य दिवि संस्थितान्
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtya vighnānbhūyiṣṭhānkaratālatrayeṇa tu | antarikṣagatāndṛṣṭvā vilokya divi saṃsthitān
verses.translation: Now we are eager to hear it reverentially and devotedly, O ocean of mercy. It behoves you to narrate it with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now we are eager to hear it reverentially and devotedly, O ocean of mercy. It behoves you to narrate it with pleasure.
verses.science: शंकर उसपर अनुग्रह करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्धप्राण आसीनो हंसमन्त्रमनुस्मरन् । हृदिस्थं जीवचैतन्यं ब्रह्मनाड्या समानयेत्
verses.transliteration: niruddhaprāṇa āsīno haṃsamantramanusmaran | hṛdisthaṃ jīvacaitanyaṃ brahmanāḍyā samānayet
verses.translation: On hearing this, Suta was thrilled with delight. After making obeisance to lord Siva, the preceptor of pre¬ ceptors, to the goddess-mother of the trio and to his preceptor Vya with devotion he spoke in a majestic tone delighting the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, Suta was thrilled with delight. After making obeisance to lord Siva, the preceptor of pre¬ ceptors, to the goddess-mother of the trio and to his preceptor Vya with devotion he spoke in a majestic tone delighting the sages.
verses.science: उल्लसित जटाओंवाला बना देते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्तः स्थविशदे सहस्रारमहाम्बुजे । चिच्चन्द्रमण्डलान्तःस्थं चिद्रूपं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśāntaḥ sthaviśade sahasrāramahāmbuje | ciccandramaṇḍalāntaḥsthaṃ cidrūpaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: O sages, hail to you. May you remain happy always; devotees of Siva steady-minded and propagators of devotion to Siva,
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, hail to you. May you remain happy always; devotees of Siva steady-minded and propagators of devotion to Siva,
verses.science: भावनावाला हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शोषदाहप्लवान्कुर्याद्रेचकादि क्रमेण तु । सषोडशचतुष्षष्टिद्वात्रिंशद्गणनायुतैः
verses.transliteration: śoṣadāhaplavānkuryādrecakādi krameṇa tu | saṣoḍaśacatuṣṣaṣṭidvātriṃśadgaṇanāyutaiḥ
verses.translation: That wonderful thing has been heard from the lotus-like mouth of the preceptor. This was not mentioned by me before, being afraid of revealing a secret.
verses.commentary: Sense: That wonderful thing has been heard from the lotus-like mouth of the preceptor. This was not mentioned by me before, being afraid of revealing a secret.
verses.science: चक्करसे दूर रहती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वाय्वग्निसलिलार्णैस्तैः स्ववेदाद्यैरनुक्रमात् । प्राणानायम्य मूलस्थां कुण्डलीं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रगाम्
verses.transliteration: vāyvagnisalilārṇaistaiḥ svavedādyairanukramāt | prāṇānāyamya mūlasthāṃ kuṇḍalīṃ brahmarandhragām
verses.translation: Indeed you arc highly fortunate devotees of Siva
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed you arc highly fortunate devotees of Siva
verses.science: शान्तिका विधान बताया जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आनीय द्वादशान्तःस्थसहस्राराम्बुजोदरे । चिच्चन्द्रमण्डलोद्भूतपरमामृतधारया
verses.transliteration: ānīya dvādaśāntaḥsthasahasrārāmbujodare | ciccandramaṇḍalodbhūtaparamāmṛtadhārayā
verses.translation: Formerly in the Rathantara kalpa the sage Vamadeva, roaming over the earth, entered KumaraSikhara,®' the southern summit of Meru where the peacock-vehicled lord Karttikeya, son of Siva, stays joyously. The sage was a liberated soul even while he was in the womb. He was the most-honoured among the knowers of Siva's cult. He knew the reality, and the principles of the Vedas, Agamas, Puranas and other sacred scriptures. He knew the births and activities of all living beings, gods, Asuras, mortals and others. The ashes made his body white. He was bedecked in the knots of matted hair. He had no permanent abode, no desire, no egotism and none of the mutually opposing feelings and emotions. He was unclad. He was very wise like Siva him¬ self. He was surrounded by the leading sages who were like him and who had become his disciples. He sanctified the earth by the pious touch of his feet. His heart dwelt in the great splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly in the Rathantara kalpa the sage Vamadeva, roaming over the earth, entered KumaraSikhara,®' the southern summit of Meru where the peacock-vehicled lord Karttikeya, son of Siva, stays joyously. The sage was a liberated soul even while he was in the womb.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly in the Rathantara kalpa the sage Vamadeva, roaming over the earth, entered KumaraSikhara,®' the southern summit of Meru where the peacock-vehicled lord Karttikeya, son of Siva, stays joyously. The sage was a liberated soul even while he was in the womb.…
verses.science: सावधान होकर सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संसिक्तायां तनौ भूयः शुद्धदेहः सुभावनः । सोऽहमित्यवतीर्याथ स्वात्मानं हृदयाम्बुजे
verses.transliteration: saṃsiktāyāṃ tanau bhūyaḥ śuddhadehaḥ subhāvanaḥ | so'hamityavatīryātha svātmānaṃ hṛdayāmbuje
verses.translation: Lord Karttikeya, the hero possessed of the power of knowledge, the suppressor of the Asuras, stays there along with Gajavalli and bowed to by all the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Karttikeya, the hero possessed of the power of knowledge, the suppressor of the Asuras, stays there along with Gajavalli and bowed to by all the gods.
verses.science: उसके शरीरको अलंकृत करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मन्यावेश्य चात्मानममृतं सृतिधारया । प्राणप्रतिष्ठां विधिवत्कुर्यादत्र समाहितः
verses.transliteration: ātmanyāveśya cātmānamamṛtaṃ sṛtidhārayā | prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivatkuryādatra samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Near the lord there is a lake Skandasaras®* as vast as an ocean with plenty of deep, sweet, cool, clear water of wonderful attributes. The sage Vamadeva took his bath there along with his disciples. He saw Skanda seated on the summit attended by the sages, shining like the rising sun, with the peacock as his vehicle. He had four arms and splendid body. He was bedecked in coronet and other ornaments. He was reverentially attended by two excellent Saktis. He held Sakti and a cock. He showed the mystic gestures of boons and protection with his hands. On seeing Skanda the sage worshipped him with devotion and began to eulogise him.
