verses.wordMeaning: Near the lord there is a lake Skandasaras®* as vast as an ocean with plenty of deep, sweet, cool, clear water of wonderful attributes. The sage Vamadeva took his bath there along with his disciples. He saw Skanda seated on the summit attended by the sages,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Near the lord there is a lake Skandasaras®* as vast as an ocean with plenty of deep, sweet, cool, clear water of wonderful attributes. The sage Vamadeva took his bath there along with his disciples. He saw Skanda seated on the summit attended by the sages,…
verses.science: कमण्डलु अर्पित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकाग्रमानसो योगी विमृश्यात्तां च मातृकाम् । पुटितां प्रणवेनाथ न्यसेद्बाह्ये च मातृकाम्
verses.transliteration: ekāgramānaso yogī vimṛśyāttāṃ ca mātṛkām | puṭitāṃ praṇavenātha nyasedbāhye ca mātṛkām
verses.translation: This lake formed of the waters of the Kumara hill lying to the south of Meru remains unidentified.
verses.hindi: भेदन करे  इसके बाद उस गड्ढेको पाट दे
verses.commentary: Sense: This lake formed of the waters of the Kumara hill lying to the south of Meru remains unidentified.
verses.science: भेदन करे इसके बाद उस गड्ढेको पाट दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च संयतप्राणः कुर्याद् दृष्ट्यादिकं बुधः । शङ्करं संस्मरंश्चित्ते संन्यसेच्च विमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: punaśca saṃyataprāṇaḥ kuryād dṛṣṭyādikaṃ budhaḥ | śaṅkaraṃ saṃsmaraṃścitte saṃnyasecca vimatsaraḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord in the form of the purport of the Upanisad, to their enterpreter and the' knower of their purport.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord in the form of the purport of the Upanisad, to their enterpreter and the' knower of their purport.
verses.science: तुलसीदलोंसे उनकी पूजा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवस्य ऋषिर्ब्रह्मा देवि गायत्रमीरितम् । छन्दोऽत्र देवताहं वै परमात्मा सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: praṇavasya ṛṣirbrahmā devi gāyatramīritam | chando'tra devatāhaṃ vai paramātmā sadāśivaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Guha, to the deity concealed in the cavities of the hearts of all living beings. Obeisance to the secret one of secret form. Obeisance to the knower of the secret sacred lore.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Guha, to the deity concealed in the cavities of the hearts of all living beings. Obeisance to the secret one of secret form. Obeisance to the knower of the secret sacred lore.
verses.science: परिक्रमा करके नमस्कार करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकारो बीजमाख्यातमुकारः शक्तिरुच्यते । मकारः कीलकं प्रोक्तं मोक्षार्थे विनियुज्यते
verses.transliteration: akāro bījamākhyātamukāraḥ śaktirucyate | makāraḥ kīlakaṃ proktaṃ mokṣārthe viniyujyate
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the minutest of the minute, the greatest of the great, the knower of the greater and the lesser, the lord in the form of the great Atman.
verses.hindi: यतीनां मुनिवर्याथैकादशाहविधिं श्रूणु॥ ६६  यतियोंके एकादशाहकी विधि सुनो
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the minutest of the minute, the greatest of the great, the knower of the greater and the lesser, the lord in the form of the great Atman.
verses.science: यतीनां मुनिवर्याथैकादशाहविधिं श्रूणु॥ ६६ यतियोंके एकादशाहकी विधि सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठद्वयमारभ्य तलान्तं परिमार्जयेत् । ओमित्युक्त्वाथ देवेशि करन्यासं समारभेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhadvayamārabhya talāntaṃ parimārjayet | omityuktvātha deveśi karanyāsaṃ samārabhet
verses.translation: Obeisance to Skanda; to the lord of splendour as red as tluit of the sun in the form of Skanda; to the lord who wears the coronets adorned with the garlands of the flowers of the divine Mandara tree.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां यतीनां मरणानन्तरदशाहपर्यन्तकृत्यवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Skanda; to the lord of splendour as red as tluit of the sun in the form of Skanda; to the lord who wears the coronets adorned with the garlands of the flowers of the divine Mandara tree.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां यतीनां मरणानन्तरदशाहपर्यन्तकृत्यवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षहस्तस्थिताङ्गुष्ठं समारभ्य यथाक्रमम् । वामहस्तकनिष्ठान्तं विन्यसेत्पूर्ववत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: dakṣahastasthitāṅguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya yathākramam | vāmahastakaniṣṭhāntaṃ vinyasetpūrvavatkramāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to the disciple of Siva; to the son of Siva, to the bestower of bliss and happiness, to the beloved of Siva; to the storehouse of pleasure of Siva and Siva.
verses.hindi: कृत्यवर्णन नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the disciple of Siva; to the son of Siva, to the bestower of bliss and happiness, to the beloved of Siva; to the storehouse of pleasure of Siva and Siva.
verses.science: कृत्यवर्णन नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अकारमप्युकारं च मकारं बिन्दुसंयुतम् । नमोऽन्तं प्रोच्य सर्वत्र हृदयादौ न्यसेदथ
verses.transliteration: akāramapyukāraṃ ca makāraṃ bindusaṃyutam | namo'ntaṃ procya sarvatra hṛdayādau nyasedatha
verses.translation: Obeisance to the son of the Gahga, to the intelligent Karttikcya, to the noble son of Uma, lying in the grove of Sara plants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the son of the Gahga, to the intelligent Karttikcya, to the noble son of Uma, lying in the grove of Sara plants.
verses.science: देवेश्वरी देवियोंके रूपमें पूजन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अकारं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य ब्रह्मात्मानमथाचरेत् । ङेऽन्तं नमोऽन्तं हृदये विनियुज्यात्तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: akāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya brahmātmānamathācaret | ṅe'ntaṃ namo'ntaṃ hṛdaye viniyujyāttathā punaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the six-faced god of siv imperishable bodies to the one who interprets in six ways, to the lord whose form is beyond the sixfold path.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the six-faced god of siv imperishable bodies to the one who interprets in six ways, to the lord whose form is beyond the sixfold path.
verses.science: उनका स्नानकर्म सम्पन्न कराना चाहिए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: उकारं विष्णुसहितं शिरोदेशे प्रविन्यसेत् । मकारं रुद्रसहितं शिखायां तु प्रविन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: ukāraṃ viṣṇusahitaṃ śirodeśe pravinyaset | makāraṃ rudrasahitaṃ śikhāyāṃ tu pravinyaset
verses.translation: O soul of the twelve (?) obeisance be to you with twelve wide eyes, with twelve uplifted arms and twelve types of weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O soul of the twelve (?) obeisance be to you with twelve wide eyes, with twelve uplifted arms and twelve types of weapons.
verses.science: उन सबका यथोचितरूपसे वरण करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा मुनिर्मन्त्री कवचं नेत्रमस्तके । विन्यसेद्देवदेवेशि सावधानेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā munirmantrī kavacaṃ netramastake | vinyaseddevadeveśi sāvadhānena cetasā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the four-armed lord, to the calm lord who bears Sakii and a cock, to the bestower of boons; the learned or to one with a bird in his hand. Obeisance to the splitter of the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the four-armed lord, to the calm lord who bears Sakii and a cock, to the bestower of boons; the learned or to one with a bird in his hand. Obeisance to the splitter of the Asuras.
verses.science: सम्मुख भोजन कराये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गवक्त्रकलाभेदात्पञ्च ब्रह्माणि विन्यसेत् । शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेष्वेतानि विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅgavaktrakalābhedātpañca brahmāṇi vinyaset | śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣvetāni vinyaset
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this divine prayer to Skanda, uttered by Vamadeva, attains the supreme goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this divine prayer to Skanda, uttered by Vamadeva, attains the supreme goal.
verses.science: बताता हूँ, आदरपूर्वक सुनो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानस्य कलाः पञ्च पञ्चस्वेतेषु च क्रमात् । ततश्चतुर्षु वक्त्रेषु पुरुषस्य कला अपि
verses.transliteration: īśānasya kalāḥ pañca pañcasveteṣu ca kramāt | tataścaturṣu vaktreṣu puruṣasya kalā api
verses.translation: O brahmins, after eulogising lord commander- in-chief of the gods thus, circumambulating him thrice and prostrating on the ground Vamadeva bowed to him once again and went round him. Then he stood bowing down with humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, after eulogising lord commander- in-chief of the gods thus, circumambulating him thrice and prostrating on the ground Vamadeva bowed to him once again and went round him. Then he stood bowing down with humility.
verses.science: नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय यूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: चतस्रः प्रणिधातव्याः पूर्वादिक्रमयोगतः । हृत्कण्ठांसेषु नाभौ च कुक्षौ पृष्ठे च वक्षसि
verses.transliteration: catasraḥ praṇidhātavyāḥ pūrvādikramayogataḥ | hṛtkaṇṭhāṃseṣu nābhau ca kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasi
verses.translation: O sage, you are the chief of Yogins, perfect and free from avarice. There is nothing for people like you which has to be solicited.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, you are the chief of Yogins, perfect and free from avarice. There is nothing for people like you which has to be solicited.
verses.science: अननका भोजन कराये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अघोरस्य कलाश्चाष्टौ पूजनीया यथाक्रमम् । पश्चात् त्रयोदशकलाः पायुमेढ्रोरुजानुषु
verses.transliteration: aghorasya kalāścāṣṭau pūjanīyā yathākramam | paścāt trayodaśakalāḥ pāyumeḍhrorujānuṣu
verses.translation: Still saintly men like you move about in the world for upholding virtue and blessing the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still saintly men like you move about in the world for upholding virtue and blessing the worlds.
verses.science: ऐसा कहकर कुशोंका स्पर्श करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घास्फिक्कटिपार्श्वेषु वामदेवस्य भावयेत् । सद्यस्यापि कलाश्चाष्टौ नेत्रेषु च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: jaṅghāsphikkaṭipārśveṣu vāmadevasya bhāvayet | sadyasyāpi kalāścāṣṭau netreṣu ca yathākramam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Skanda, the sage Vamadeva, bowed with humility and spoke in a tone as majestic as the sound of clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Skanda, the sage Vamadeva, bowed with humility and spoke in a tone as majestic as the sound of clouds.
verses.science: रूपमें चिन्तन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तितास्ताः कलाश्चैवं पादयोरपि हस्तयोः । प्राणे शिरसि बाह्वोश्च कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: kīrtitāstāḥ kalāścaivaṃ pādayorapi hastayoḥ | prāṇe śirasi bāhvośca kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, you are the great Isa, the bestower of prosjjerity to all and sundry. You arc omniscient; creator of all and the lord bearing all Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are the great Isa, the bestower of prosjjerity to all and sundry. You arc omniscient; creator of all and the lord bearing all Saktis.
verses.science: हो नमस्कार करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टत्रिंशत्कलान्यासमेवं कृत्वा तु सर्वशः । पश्चात्प्रणवविद्धीमान्प्रणवन्यासमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsamevaṃ kṛtvā tu sarvaśaḥ | paścātpraṇavaviddhīmānpraṇavanyāsamācaret
verses.translation: We are insignificant creatures to.speak before you who are great lord. Still it is your blessing that you speak to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: We are insignificant creatures to.speak before you who are great lord. Still it is your blessing that you speak to me.
verses.science: सच्योजातादि पाँच ब्रह्ममन्त्रोंका पाठ करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बाहुद्वये कूर्परयोस्तथा च मणिबन्धयोः । पार्श्वतोदरजङ्घेषु पादयोः पृष्ठतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bāhudvaye kūrparayostathā ca maṇibandhayoḥ | pārśvatodarajaṅgheṣu pādayoḥ pṛṣṭhatastathā
verses.translation: O intelligent one, I have but a particle of wisdom. Urged thus I ask you. My transgression must be excused.
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent one, I have but a particle of wisdom. Urged thus I ask you. My transgression must be excused.
verses.science: व्यासजीके महातेजस्वी शिष्य होंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं प्रणवविन्यासं कृत्वा न्यासविचक्षणः । हंसन्यासं प्रकुर्वीत परमात्मविबोधिनि
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ praṇavavinyāsaṃ kṛtvā nyāsavicakṣaṇaḥ | haṃsanyāsaṃ prakurvīta paramātmavibodhini
verses.translation: Invoked with the mantra he releases the Jiva instantaneously. Hence siddhi is achieved with the mantra Om for Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Invoked with the mantra he releases the Jiva instantaneously. Hence siddhi is achieved with the mantra Om for Siva.
verses.science: योगी शुकदेवजीका पूज्य है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages. He then began to expound the path of welfare well guarded in the Vedas.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages.…
verses.science: शिवका स्तवन किया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages. He then began to expound the path of welfare well guarded in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गमिष्ये भवतां भूयः सत्सम्भाषणमस्तु मे॥ ४६  एवं सत्संगका अवसर प्राप्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages.…
verses.science: गमिष्ये भवतां भूयः सत्सम्भाषणमस्तु मे॥ ४६ एवं सत्संगका अवसर प्राप्त हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam
verses.translation: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages. He then began to expound the path of welfare well guarded in the Vedas.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages.…
verses.science: व्यासादिश्निष्यवर्गकथन नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । शिवध्यानपूजनवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । स्ववामे चतुरस्रं तु मण्डलं परिकल्पयेत् । ओमित्यभ्यर्च्य तस्मिंस्तु शङ्खमस्त्रोपशोधितम्
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā 6.7. saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | śivadhyānapūjanavarṇanam | īśvara uvāca | svavāme caturasraṃ tu maṇḍalaṃ parikalpayet | omityabhyarcya tasmiṃstu śaṅkhamastropaśodhitam
verses.translation: Well done, well done. O fortunate V'madcva, O great sage, you arc a great devotee of Siva and the most excellent of those who possess Siva's knowledge.
verses.hindi: व्यासादिशिष्यवर्गककथनवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Well done, well done. O fortunate V'madcva, O great sage, you arc a great devotee of Siva and the most excellent of those who possess Siva's knowledge.
verses.science: व्यासादिशिष्यवर्गककथनवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थाप्य साधारकं तं तु प्रणवेनार्चयेत्ततः । आपूर्य शुद्धतोयेन चन्दनादिसुगन्धिना
verses.transliteration: sthāpya sādhārakaṃ taṃ tu praṇavenārcayettataḥ | āpūrya śuddhatoyena candanādisugandhinā
verses.translation: The order of instruction shall be mentioned at first. Please hear, O sage, indeed the four castes are well known in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The order of instruction shall be mentioned at first. Please hear, O sage, indeed the four castes are well known in the world.
verses.science: व्यासादिश्निष्यवर्गकथन नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणवेन च सप्तधा । अभिमन्त्र्य ततस्तस्मिन्धेनुमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇavena ca saptadhā | abhimantrya tatastasmindhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet
verses.translation: The group of sense-organs consists of the eye, etc; that of the Bhutas is of four types. In the Pitf Sraddha the fatfier, grandfather and greatgrandfather are included.
verses.commentary: Sense: The group of sense-organs consists of the eye, etc; that of the Bhutas is of four types. In the Pitf Sraddha the fatfier, grandfather and greatgrandfather are included.
verses.hindi: व्यासादिशिष्यवर्गककथनवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.science: व्यासादिशिष्यवर्गककथनवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खमुद्रां च पुरतश्चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत् । तदन्तरेऽर्धचन्द्रं च त्रिकोणं च तदन्तरे
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhamudrāṃ ca purataścaturasraṃ prakalpayet | tadantare'rdhacandraṃ ca trikoṇaṃ ca tadantare
verses.translation: He shall then place cooked nee and othcj food¬ stuffs in well washed plantain leaf cups. I'liey shall be covered with Darbha grass. He shall sprinkle water over them. The leafeups shall be lifved up by the h.inds. He shall offer the food-stuffs into fire saying "Svfdia." The names of the deities shall be used in the dative case. The Mantras "the earth is your vessel,"*' etc. shall be repeated. After worship the devotee.shall say "Na Mama" (not for me). FAeiywherc this is the procedure.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then place cooked nee and othcj food¬ stuffs in well washed plantain leaf cups. I'liey shall be covered with Darbha grass. He shall sprinkle water over them. The leafeups shall be lifved up by the h.inds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then place cooked nee and othcj food¬ stuffs in well washed plantain leaf cups. I'liey shall be covered with Darbha grass. He shall sprinkle water over them. The leafeups shall be lifved up by the h.inds.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षट्कोणं वृत्तमेवेदं मण्डलं परिकल्पयेत् । अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणवेनाथ मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛttamevedaṃ maṇḍalaṃ parikalpayet | abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇavenātha madhyataḥ
verses.translation: He shall take bath and wear a washed and dried cloth. He shall be pure in thought and body. Silently he shall perform Acamana twice and apply ashes duly and perform the Punyahavacana.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take bath and wear a washed and dried cloth. He shall be pure in thought and body. Silently he shall perform Acamana twice and apply ashes duly and perform the Punyahavacana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साधारमर्घ्यपात्रं च स्थाप्य गन्धादिनार्चयेत् । आपूर्य शुद्धतोयेन तस्मिन्पात्रे विनिःक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: sādhāramarghyapātraṃ ca sthāpya gandhādinārcayet | āpūrya śuddhatoyena tasminpātre viniḥkṣipet
verses.translation: With the mentra, *'Gahanam tva" he shall as enjoined invoke lord Ganapati worshipped by the gods. He shall worship him in the south-west.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the mentra, *'Gahanam tva" he shall as enjoined invoke lord Ganapati worshipped by the gods. He shall worship him in the south-west.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुशाग्राण्यक्षतांश्चैव यवव्रीहितिलानपि । आज्यसिद्धार्थपुष्पाणि भसितं च वरानने
verses.transliteration: kuśāgrāṇyakṣatāṃścaiva yavavrīhitilānapi | ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ ca varānane
verses.translation: The same procedure he shall adopt for the other gods, along with their ancillary rites. After these rites beginning with the fire, the Viraja homa of the Atman shall be performed for the purification of the self in the form of twentysix principles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same procedure he shall adopt for the other gods, along with their ancillary rites. After these rites beginning with the fire, the Viraja homa of the Atman shall be performed for the purification of the self in the form of twentysix principles.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातादिभिर्मन्त्रैः षडङ्गैः प्रणवेन च । अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरभिमन्त्र्य च वर्मणा
verses.transliteration: sadyojātādibhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ praṇavena ca | abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairabhimantrya ca varmaṇā
verses.translation: He shall recite the mantra "Saiii mam sincantu Manita."''' He shall warm his hand over the fire repeating the mantra "Ya te Agne'*- and superimpose the fire in his own Atman, abode of the universal soul. He shall perform the morning prayers and pay respects to the sun. He shall enter water upto the navel, perform the Japa of the mantras with pleasure, devotion and steadiness.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall recite the mantra "Saiii mam sincantu Manita."''' He shall warm his hand over the fire repeating the mantra "Ya te Agne'*- and superimpose the fire in his own Atman, abode of the universal soul. He shall perform the morning prayers and pay respects to the sun.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall recite the mantra "Saiii mam sincantu Manita."''' He shall warm his hand over the fire repeating the mantra "Ya te Agne'*- and superimpose the fire in his own Atman, abode of the universal soul. He shall perform the morning prayers and pay respects to the sun.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अवगुण्ठ्यास्त्रमन्त्रेण संरक्षार्थं प्रदर्शयेत् । धेनुमुद्रां च तेनैव प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: avaguṇṭhyāstramantreṇa saṃrakṣārthaṃ pradarśayet | dhenumudrāṃ ca tenaiva prokṣayedastramantrataḥ
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मानं गन्धपुष्पादिपूजोपकरणान्यपि । पद्मस्येशानदिक्पद्मं प्रणवोच्चारपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: svātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādipūjopakaraṇānyapi | padmasyeśānadikpadmaṃ praṇavoccārapūrvakam
verses.translation: All the individuals in the world are deceived by the Maya of Isa. They arc deceived by various sacred scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the individuals in the world are deceived by the Maya of Isa. They arc deceived by various sacred scriptures.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुर्वासनाय नम इत्यासनं परिकल्पयेत् । गुरोर्मूर्तिं च तत्रैव कल्पयेदुपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: gurvāsanāya nama ityāsanaṃ parikalpayet | gurormūrtiṃ ca tatraiva kalpayedupadeśataḥ
verses.translation: They do not know the great lord, the meaning of the Pranava, the Nirguna and Saguna Brahman, the great progenitor of trinity.
verses.commentary: Sense: They do not know the great lord, the meaning of the Pranava, the Nirguna and Saguna Brahman, the great progenitor of trinity.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं गुं गुरुभ्योऽन्ते नमः प्रोच्यापि देशिकम् । समावाह्य ततो ध्यायेद्दक्षिणाभिमुखं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: praṇavaṃ guṃ gurubhyo'nte namaḥ procyāpi deśikam | samāvāhya tato dhyāyeddakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ sthitam
verses.translation: I shall lift up my right hand and swear unto you truth again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall lift up my right hand and swear unto you truth again and again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नमुखं सौम्यं शुद्धस्फटिकनिर्मलम् । वरदाभयहस्तं च द्विनेत्रं शिवविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: suprasannamukhaṃ saumyaṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam | varadābhayahastaṃ ca dvinetraṃ śivavigraham
verses.translation: Siva is declared as the purport of the Pranava in the Sruti and Smfti texts, Puranas and the Agamas; from whom words recede unable to reach him along with the mind; the knower of whose bliss does not have fear from anywhere from whom this entire universe, beginning with Brahma, Vinu and Indra is born at the outset with the groups of sense-organs and elements; that which has no cause anywhere at any time; which neither the lightning nor the sun nor the moon does illuminate; by whose splendour this entire universe is resplendent all round; he who is endowed with prosperity himself in the name of Sai- vesvara; who is worthy of being meditated upon by those who are desirous of salvation; he who is the cause of welfare; who is in the middle of the firmament; who is omnipresent, whose soul is light, who is in the form of splendour, knowledge and.consciousness; whose splendid!§akti is comprehensible only through emotion and who is both Nirguna and Saguna, unsullied and auspicious.
verses.wordMeaning: Siva is declared as the purport of the Pranava in the Sruti and Smfti texts, Puranas and the Agamas; from whom words recede unable to reach him along with the mind; the knower of whose bliss does not have fear from anywhere from whom this entire universe, beginning with Brahma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva is declared as the purport of the Pranava in the Sruti and Smfti texts, Puranas and the Agamas; from whom words recede unable to reach him along with the mind; the knower of whose bliss does not have fear from anywhere from whom this entire universe, beginning with Brahma,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यात्वा यजेद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिरनुक्रमात् । पद्मस्य नैरृते पद्मे गणपत्यासनोपरि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dhyātvā yajedgandhapuṣpādibhiranukramāt | padmasya nairṛte padme gaṇapatyāsanopari
verses.translation: Three types of his form — gross, subtle and causal
verses.commentary: Sense: Three types of his form — gross, subtle and causal
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तिं प्रकल्प्य तत्रैव गणानां त्वेति मन्त्रतः । समावाह्य ततो देवं ध्यायेदेकाग्रमानसः
verses.transliteration: mūrtiṃ prakalpya tatraiva gaṇānāṃ tveti mantrataḥ | samāvāhya tato devaṃ dhyāyedekāgramānasaḥ
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid. 2. 9. 1.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्तवर्णं महाकायं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् । पाशाङ्कुशाक्षाभीष्टं च दधानं करपङ्कजैः
verses.transliteration: raktavarṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | pāśāṅkuśākṣābhīṣṭaṃ ca dadhānaṃ karapaṅkajaiḥ
verses.translation: The unsullied being, the primordial and the eternal lord of all who is stated to be the supreme soul has knowledge and the ritual as his innate nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unsullied being, the primordial and the eternal lord of all who is stated to be the supreme soul has knowledge and the ritual as his innate nature.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गजाननं प्रभुं सर्वविघ्नौघघ्नमुपासितुः । एवं ध्यात्वा यजेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरुपचारकैः
verses.transliteration: gajānanaṃ prabhuṃ sarvavighnaughaghnamupāsituḥ | evaṃ dhyātvā yajedgandhapuṣpādyairupacārakaiḥ
verses.translation: The image of the lord of the gods is Sadaiva himself, the lord with five mantras for his body and the five digits for his physical form. The lord is as bright as crystal, has cool lustre and is delightful. He has five faces, ten arms and fifteen eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The image of the lord of the gods is Sadaiva himself, the lord with five mantras for his body and the five digits for his physical form. The lord is as bright as crystal, has cool lustre and is delightful. He has five faces, ten arms and fifteen eyes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदलीनारिकेलाम्रफललड्डुकपूर्वकम् । नैवेद्यं च समर्प्याथ नमस्कुर्याद्गजाननम्
verses.transliteration: kadalīnārikelāmraphalalaḍḍukapūrvakam | naivedyaṃ ca samarpyātha namaskuryādgajānanam
verses.translation: He the ancient lord has Isana for his coronet; Purusa for his face; Aghora for his heart; Vamadeva for his private parts and Sadya for his foot, is both Sakala and Niskala. The six Saktis, omnisciend# etc. constitute his six limbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: He the ancient lord has Isana for his coronet; Purusa for his face; Aghora for his heart; Vamadeva for his private parts and Sadya for his foot, is both Sakala and Niskala. The six Saktis, omnisciend# etc. constitute his six limbs.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्मस्य वायुदिक्पद्मे सङ्कल्प्य स्कान्दमासनम् । स्कन्दमूर्तिं प्रकल्प्याथ स्कन्दमावाहयेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: padmasya vāyudikpadme saṅkalpya skāndamāsanam | skandamūrtiṃ prakalpyātha skandamāvāhayed budhaḥ
verses.translation: With reference to the six entities. Mantra, etc., I shall explain the Pranava-souled lord in his composite and personal nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: With reference to the six entities. Mantra, etc., I shall explain the Pranava-souled lord in his composite and personal nature.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्चार्य स्कन्दगायत्रीं ध्यायेदथ कुमारकम् । उद्यदादित्यसङ्काशं मयूरवरवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: uccārya skandagāyatrīṃ dhyāyedatha kumārakam | udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ mayūravaravāhanam
verses.translation: The Vedas enjoin rituals for the first three castes. The Sudras arc excluded since their only activity is service.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas enjoin rituals for the first three castes. The Sudras arc excluded since their only activity is service.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं मुकुटादिविभूषितम् । वरदाभयहस्तं च शक्तिकुक्कुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ mukuṭādivibhūṣitam | varadābhayahastaṃ ca śaktikukkuṭadhāriṇam
verses.translation: Nothing but the holy rites of the $rutis and Smrtis shall be performed by the first three castes in their respective stages of life. Following the conduct of life enjoined for difforent stages and castes, excellent sages have attained S.iyujya form of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nothing but the holy rites of the $rutis and Smrtis shall be performed by the first three castes in their respective stages of life. Following the conduct of life enjoined for difforent stages and castes, excellent sages have attained S.iyujya form of liberation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यात्वाथ गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैरनुक्रमात् । सम्पूज्य पूर्वद्वारस्य दक्षशाखामुपाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dhyātvātha gandhādyairupacārairanukramāt | sampūjya pūrvadvārasya dakṣaśākhāmupāśritam
verses.translation: The Sruti says that the sages arc satisfied by Brahmacarya; the gods by sacrifice; and the Pitrs by pro¬ geny.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says that the sages arc satisfied by Brahmacarya; the gods by sacrifice; and the Pitrs by pro¬ geny.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःपुराधिपं साक्षान्नन्दिनं सम्यगर्चयेत् । चामीकराचलप्रख्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: antaḥpurādhipaṃ sākṣānnandinaṃ samyagarcayet | cāmīkarācalaprakhyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: Freed from this threefold debt and entering the Vanaprastha stage the devotee shall bear both pleasure and pain, chillness and heat; shall subjugate the senses, control the diet. The ascetic shall practise restraint and other
verses.commentary: Sense: Freed from this threefold debt and entering the Vanaprastha stage the devotee shall bear both pleasure and pain, chillness and heat; shall subjugate the senses, control the diet. The ascetic shall practise restraint and other
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुमुकुटं सौम्यं त्रिनेत्रं च चतुर्भुजम् । दीप्तशूलमृगीटङ्कं हेमवेत्रधरं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: bālendumukuṭaṃ saumyaṃ trinetraṃ ca caturbhujam | dīptaśūlamṛgīṭaṅkaṃ hemavetradharaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: Thus he becomes pious and free from activities. After eschewing all activites he shall be devoted to the pursuit of knowledge. That alone bestows the fruit of living liberation and identity with Siva. It is most excellent and renders free from aberrations those who have restrained their minds.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus he becomes pious and free from activities. After eschewing all activites he shall be devoted to the pursuit of knowledge. That alone bestows the fruit of living liberation and identity with Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he becomes pious and free from activities. After eschewing all activites he shall be devoted to the pursuit of knowledge. That alone bestows the fruit of living liberation and identity with Siva.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रबिम्बाभवदनं हरिवक्त्रमथापि वा । उत्तरस्यां तथा तस्य भार्यां च मरुतां सुताम्
verses.transliteration: candrabimbābhavadanaṃ harivaktramathāpi vā | uttarasyāṃ tathā tasya bhāryāṃ ca marutāṃ sutām
verses.translation: I shall explain different modes of the same with a desire for blessing the worlds. O intelligent one, it is out of affection for you that I do so. Please listen with attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain different modes of the same with a desire for blessing the worlds. O intelligent one, it is out of affection for you that I do so. Please listen with attention.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुयशां सुव्रतामम्बापादमण्डनतत्पराम् । सम्पूज्य विधिवद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरुपचारकैः
verses.transliteration: suyaśāṃ suvratāmambāpādamaṇḍanatatparām | sampūjya vidhivadgandhapuṣpādyairupacārakaiḥ
verses.translation: The ascetic sha«. approach a preceptor, the most (excellent among intelligenfones; the preceptor who knows ihc principles of sacred scriptures and has mastered the 'edantic knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic sha«. approach a preceptor, the most (excellent among intelligenfones; the preceptor who knows ihc principles of sacred scriptures and has mastered the 'edantic knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्प्रोक्षयेत्पद्मं सास्त्रशङ्खोदबिन्दुभिः । कल्पयेदासनं पश्चादाधारादि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samprokṣayetpadmaṃ sāstraśaṅkhodabindubhiḥ | kalpayedāsanaṃ paścādādhārādi yathākramam
verses.translation: After approaching him in accordance with the tales, the ascetic devotee shall please him assiduously by obeisances, prostration etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching him in accordance with the tales, the ascetic devotee shall please him assiduously by obeisances, prostration etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिं कल्याणीं श्यामां ध्यायेदधो भुवि । तस्याः पुरस्तादुत्कण्ठमनन्तं कुण्डलाकृतिम्
verses.transliteration: ādhāraśaktiṃ kalyāṇīṃ śyāmāṃ dhyāyedadho bhuvi | tasyāḥ purastādutkaṇṭhamanantaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim
verses.translation: Permitted by the preceptor he shall subsist on milk diet and perform rites for twelve days. On the fourth or the tenth day in the bright lunar fortnight he shall take his early morning bath. With pious mind, he shall perform his routine. He shall invite the preceptor and begin the Nandi raddha.
verses.wordMeaning: Permitted by the preceptor he shall subsist on milk diet and perform rites for twelve days. On the fourth or the tenth day in the bright lunar fortnight he shall take his early morning bath. With pious mind, he shall perform his routine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Permitted by the preceptor he shall subsist on milk diet and perform rites for twelve days. On the fourth or the tenth day in the bright lunar fortnight he shall take his early morning bath. With pious mind, he shall perform his routine.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धवलं पञ्चफणिनं लेलिहानमिवाम्बरम् । तस्योपर्यासनं भद्रं कण्ठीरवचतुष्पदम्
verses.transliteration: dhavalaṃ pañcaphaṇinaṃ lelihānamivāmbaram | tasyoparyāsanaṃ bhadraṃ kaṇṭhīravacatuṣpadam
verses.translation: The Vivedevas are Satyavasus. In the Sraddha of the gods, Brahma, Vinu and Siva, in that of the sages, those born of celestial damsels from human beings, in that of the Pitfs, Vasu, Rudra and Aditya, in that of human beings, the four sages, Sanaka and others, in that of the Bhutas the five great elements are included.
verses.wordMeaning: The Vivedevas are Satyavasus. In the Sraddha of the gods, Brahma, Vinu and Siva, in that of the sages, those born of celestial damsels from human beings, in that of the Pitfs, Vasu, Rudra and Aditya, in that of human beings, the four sages, Sanaka and others,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vivedevas are Satyavasus. In the Sraddha of the gods, Brahma, Vinu and Siva, in that of the sages, those born of celestial damsels from human beings, in that of the Pitfs, Vasu, Rudra and Aditya, in that of human beings, the four sages, Sanaka and others,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मो ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च पदानि वै । आग्नेयादिश्वेतपीतरक्तश्यामानि वर्णतः
verses.transliteration: dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca padāni vai | āgneyādiśvetapītaraktaśyāmāni varṇataḥ
verses.translation: In the Maqriraddha, the mother, grandmother and the greatgrandmother are mentioned. In the Sraddha of the Atman the four, viz. himself father, grandfather and
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Maqriraddha, the mother, grandmother and the greatgrandmother are mentioned. In the Sraddha of the Atman the four, viz. himself father, grandfather and

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मादीनि पूर्वादीन्युत्तरान्तान्यनुक्रमात् । राजावर्तमणिप्रख्यान्यस्य गात्राणि भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: adharmādīni pūrvādīnyuttarāntānyanukramāt | rājāvartamaṇiprakhyānyasya gātrāṇi bhāvayet
verses.translation: In every Sraddha a pair of brahmins shall be invited and their feet washed. He shall then perform the Acamana assiduously.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every Sraddha a pair of brahmins shall be invited and their feet washed. He shall then perform the Acamana assiduously.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधोर्ध्वच्छदनं पश्चात्कन्दं नालं च कण्टकान् । दलादिकं कर्णिकां च विभाव्य क्रमशोऽर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: adhordhvacchadanaṃ paścātkandaṃ nālaṃ ca kaṇṭakān | dalādikaṃ karṇikāṃ ca vibhāvya kramaśo'rcayet
verses.translation: He shall pray thus: — "May the dust-particles from the feet of the brahmins sanctify me. They are the cause of prosperity. They destroy all adversities and constitute the bridge on the vast ocean of worldly existence. Like suns they remove the pitch darkness of distress. Like divine cows they meet the desired objects. They are the embodied holy waters in every pilgrim centre," After praying thus he shall bow and prostrate with eight limbs touching the ground. He shall then face the cast and remember the lotus-feet of iSiva.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall pray thus: — "May the dust-particles from the feet of the brahmins sanctify me. They are the cause of prosperity. They destroy all adversities and constitute the bridge on the vast ocean of worldly existence. Like suns they remove the pitch darkness of distress.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall pray thus: — "May the dust-particles from the feet of the brahmins sanctify me. They are the cause of prosperity. They destroy all adversities and constitute the bridge on the vast ocean of worldly existence. Like suns they remove the pitch darkness of distress.…

verses.sanskrit: दलेषु सिद्धयश्चाष्टौ केसरेषु च शक्तिकाः । रुद्रा वामादयस्त्वष्टौ पूर्वादिपरितः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: daleṣu siddhayaścāṣṭau kesareṣu ca śaktikāḥ | rudrā vāmādayastvaṣṭau pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: Wearing the Pavitra in the finger and the sacred thread on the shoulders, being pure and steady he shall perform the Pranayama thrice. Mentioning the Tithi etc. he shall continue — ''As an ancillary rite to my formal renunciation I have to perform eight Sraddhas beginning with the Sraddha of Vivedevas and ending with the Sraddha of Matamaha. I shall perform these with the rules governing the festive rites, with >our permission." After proclaiming the intention he shall cast off the Darbha grass to the north.
verses.wordMeaning: Wearing the Pavitra in the finger and the sacred thread on the shoulders, being pure and steady he shall perform the Pranayama thrice. Mentioning the Tithi etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Wearing the Pavitra in the finger and the sacred thread on the shoulders, being pure and steady he shall perform the Pranayama thrice. Mentioning the Tithi etc.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकायां च वैराग्यं बीजेषु नव शक्तयः । वामाद्या एव पूर्वादि तदन्ते च मनोन्मनी
verses.transliteration: karṇikāyāṃ ca vairāgyaṃ bījeṣu nava śaktayaḥ | vāmādyā eva pūrvādi tadante ca manonmanī
verses.translation: He shall touch water and stand up to begin the formal invitation to the brahmins. With the Pavitra in the hand he shall touch the hands of the brahmins and pro¬ claim:
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall touch water and stand up to begin the formal invitation to the brahmins. With the Pavitra in the hand he shall touch the hands of the brahmins and pro¬ claim:

verses.sanskrit: कन्दे शिवात्मको धर्मो नाले ज्ञानं शिवाश्रयम् । कर्णिकोपरि वाह्नेयं मण्डलं सौरमैन्दवम्
verses.transliteration: kande śivātmako dharmo nāle jñānaṃ śivāśrayam | karṇikopari vāhneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sauramaindavam
verses.translation: "For the sake of Visvedevas I invite you both and conclude. You shall favour me." This is the procedure throughout. After this he shall draw ten Mandalas beginning from the north. He shall worship these with Aksatas and ask the Brahmins to stand there-
verses.commentary: Sense: "For the sake of Visvedevas I invite you both and conclude. You shall favour me." This is the procedure throughout. After this he shall draw ten Mandalas beginning from the north. He shall worship these with Aksatas and ask the Brahmins to stand there-

verses.sanskrit: आत्मविद्या शिवाख्यं च तत्त्वत्रयमतः परम् । सर्वासनोपरि सुखं विचित्रकुसुमोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: ātmavidyā śivākhyaṃ ca tattvatrayamataḥ param | sarvāsanopari sukhaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalam
verses.translation: He shall utter the names of Viivcdcvas in thr vocative case. "Here is water for washing the feet". Sayinj this, he shall offer water from the Darbha grass, flowers and
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall utter the names of Viivcdcvas in thr vocative case. "Here is water for washing the feet". Sayinj this, he shall offer water from the Darbha grass, flowers and

verses.sanskrit: परव्योमावकाशाख्यविद्ययातीव भास्वरम् । परिकल्प्यासनं मूर्त्तेः पुष्पविन्यासपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: paravyomāvakāśākhyavidyayātīva bhāsvaram | parikalpyāsanaṃ mūrtteḥ puṣpavinyāsapūrvakam
verses.translation: "Here is the seat to the brahmin in the form of Visvedevas.'* Saying this he shall offer a few Darbha grass blades. He himself shall stand holding the Darbha grass and say, "In this Nandimukhasraddha for the sake of Visvedevas I invite both of you to be present."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Here is the seat to the brahmin in the form of Visvedevas.'* Saying this he shall offer a few Darbha grass blades. He himself shall stand holding the Darbha grass and say, "In this Nandimukhasraddha for the sake of Visvedevas I invite both of you to be present."

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिमारभ्य शुद्धविद्यासनावधि । Oङ्कारादिचतुर्थ्यन्तं नाममन्त्रं नमोऽन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: ādhāraśaktimārabhya śuddhavidyāsanāvadhi | Oṅkārādicaturthyantaṃ nāmamantraṃ namo'ntakam
verses.translation: Then he shall say "Both of you shall accept my invitation." The two brahmins shall say "We accept."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall say "Both of you shall accept my invitation." The two brahmins shall say "We accept."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्चार्य पूजयेद्विद्वान्सर्वत्रैवं विधिक्रमः । अङ्गवक्त्रकलाभेदात्पञ्च ब्रह्माणि पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: uccārya pūjayedvidvānsarvatraivaṃ vidhikramaḥ | aṅgavaktrakalābhedātpañca brahmāṇi pūrvavat
verses.translation: He shall request the brahmins — "May you bless me. Let the rite be complete. Let rnc attain my desires."
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall request the brahmins — "May you bless me. Let the rite be complete. Let rnc attain my desires."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विन्यसेत्क्रमशो मूर्त्तौ तत्तन्मुद्राविचक्षणः । आवाहयेत्ततो देवं पुष्पाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vinyasetkramaśo mūrttau tattanmudrāvicakṣaṇaḥ | āvāhayettato devaṃ puṣpāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: After repeating the prayer he shall say. I have completed Nandimukhasraddha. Confirm that I have done it. He shall propitiate the leading brahmins, let some water drop from his hand, bow to them, stand up and say to them, let the food be even as nectar. Then with palms joined in reverence he shall pray with pleasure.
verses.wordMeaning: After repeating the prayer he shall say. I have completed Nandimukhasraddha. Confirm that I have done it. He shall propitiate the leading brahmins, let some water drop from his hand, bow to them, stand up and say to them, let the food be even as nectar.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After repeating the prayer he shall say. I have completed Nandimukhasraddha. Confirm that I have done it. He shall propitiate the leading brahmins, let some water drop from his hand, bow to them, stand up and say to them, let the food be even as nectar.…

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामीत्यारभ्योमन्तमुच्चरन् । आधारोत्थितनादं तु द्वादशग्रन्थिभेदतः
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmītyārabhyomantamuccaran | ādhārotthitanādaṃ tu dvādaśagranthibhedataḥ
verses.translation: He shall recite Srirudra, Camaka, and Purusa suktas duly. After meditating on Sadasiva he shall lepcat the Japas of the five Brahmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall recite Srirudra, Camaka, and Purusa suktas duly. After meditating on Sadasiva he shall lepcat the Japas of the five Brahmans.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तमुच्चार्य ध्यायेदोङ्कारगोचरम् । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं देवं निष्कलमक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: brahmarandhrāntamuccārya dhyāyedoṅkāragocaram | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ devaṃ niṣkalamakṣaram
verses.translation: At the end of the meal he.shall recite Rudia Shkta. He shall ask forgiveness of the brahmins. After food he shall offer water.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the meal he.shall recite Rudia Shkta. He shall ask forgiveness of the brahmins. After food he shall offer water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कारणं सर्वलोकानां सर्वलोकमयं परम् । अन्तर्बहिः स्थितं व्याप्य ह्यणोरल्पं महत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kāraṇaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokamayaṃ param | antarbahiḥ sthitaṃ vyāpya hyaṇoralpaṃ mahattamam
verses.translation: Washing his fed and peifoiming the.Xc amana he
verses.commentary: Sense: Washing his fed and peifoiming the.Xc amana he

verses.sanskrit: भक्तानामप्रयत्नेन दृश्यमीश्वरमव्ययम् । ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुरुद्राद्यैरपि देवैरगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktānāmaprayatnena dṛśyamīśvaramavyayam | brahmendraviṣṇurudrādyairapi devairagocaram
verses.commentary: Sense: Apg. 8 121. 8.

verses.sanskrit: वेदसारं च विद्वद्भिरगोचरमिति श्रुतम् । आदिमध्यान्तरहितं भेषजं भवरोगिणाम्
verses.transliteration: vedasāraṃ ca vidvadbhiragocaramiti śrutam | ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām
verses.translation: "I shall perform the rite of offering the Pis as an ancillary to the Nandimukhairaddha." After deciding thus he shall draw nine lines from south to north. He shall place twelve Darbhas with their tips to the east over the lines. These are the five places for the gods Daka and others.
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall perform the rite of offering the Pis as an ancillary to the Nandimukhairaddha." After deciding thus he shall draw nine lines from south to north. He shall place twelve Darbhas with their tips to the east over the lines.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall perform the rite of offering the Pis as an ancillary to the Nandimukhairaddha." After deciding thus he shall draw nine lines from south to north. He shall place twelve Darbhas with their tips to the east over the lines.…

verses.sanskrit: समाहितेन मनसा ध्यात्वैवं परमेश्वरम् । आवाहनं स्थापनं च सन्निरोधं निरीक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: samāhitena manasā dhyātvaivaṃ parameśvaram | āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca sannirodhaṃ nirīkṣaṇam
verses.translation: In these places the aksata grains and water shall be offered silently. In the other places he shall sprinkle water with the mantra "Atra Pitarah",**® and offer the Aksata grains and water for worship. The names of different gods shall be mentioned with the dative case ending. Three Pinzas shall be offered to each in the five places.
verses.wordMeaning: In these places the aksata grains and water shall be offered silently. In the other places he shall sprinkle water with the mantra "Atra Pitarah",**® and offer the Aksata grains and water for worship. The names of different gods shall be mentioned with the dative case ending.…

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारं च कुर्वीत बद्ध्वा मुद्राः पृथक्पृथक् । ध्यायेत्सदाशिवं साक्षाद्देवं सकलनिष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: namaskāraṃ ca kurvīta baddhvā mudrāḥ pṛthakpṛthak | dhyāyetsadāśivaṃ sākṣāddevaṃ sakalaniṣkalam
verses.translation: The Pindas shall be given separately along with Ak?atas for the full efficacy of the Pitrs as explained in the Grhyasutra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pindas shall be given separately along with Ak?atas for the full efficacy of the Pitrs as explained in the Grhyasutra.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं प्रसन्नं शीतलद्युतिम् । विद्युद्वलयसङ्काशं जटामुकुटभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ prasannaṃ śītaladyutim | vidyudvalayasaṅkāśaṃ jaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitam
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Sadaiiiva in the lotus of the heart reciting the verse. By remembering his lotus-like feet he shall give fees to the Brahmins according to his ability. He shall ask forgiveness and bid them farewell. He shall give Pindas to the cows or cast off into running water. After performing "Punyahavacana** he shall take meals with his kinsmen.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Sadaiiiva in the lotus of the heart reciting the verse. By remembering his lotus-like feet he shall give fees to the Brahmins according to his ability. He shall ask forgiveness and bid them farewell.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Sadaiiiva in the lotus of the heart reciting the verse. By remembering his lotus-like feet he shall give fees to the Brahmins according to his ability. He shall ask forgiveness and bid them farewell.…

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलचर्मवसनं किञ्चित्स्मितमुखाम्बुजम् । रक्तपद्मदलप्रख्यपाणिपादतलाधरम्
verses.transliteration: śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ kiñcitsmitamukhāmbujam | raktapadmadalaprakhyapāṇipādatalādharam
verses.translation: After getting up early in the morning next day the devotee shall perform his routine. He shall observe fast, shave hair except in the armpits and the private parts. He shall cut the moustache, the nails and shave his head.
verses.commentary: Sense: After getting up early in the morning next day the devotee shall perform his routine. He shall observe fast, shave hair except in the armpits and the private parts. He shall cut the moustache, the nails and shave his head.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् । दिव्यायुधकरैर्युक्तं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | divyāyudhakarairyuktaṃ divyagandhānulepanam
verses.translation: Except the materials for the homa and the articles of gift for the preceptor — because they are naturally pure, every other article shall be sprinkled with holy water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Except the materials for the homa and the articles of gift for the preceptor — because they are naturally pure, every other article shall be sprinkled with holy water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चवक्त्रं दशभुजं चन्द्रखण्डशिखामणिम् । अस्य पूर्वमुखं सौम्यं बालार्कसदृशप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ candrakhaṇḍaśikhāmaṇim | asya pūrvamukhaṃ saumyaṃ bālārkasadṛśaprabham
verses.translation: He shall make gift to brahmins especially to devotees and to Siva in the form of preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall make gift to brahmins especially to devotees and to Siva in the form of preceptor.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचनारविन्दाढ्यं बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम् । दक्षिणं नीलजीमूतसमानरुचिरप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: trilocanāravindāḍhyaṃ bālendukṛtaśekharam | dakṣiṇaṃ nīlajīmūtasamānaruciraprabham
verses.translation: He shall repeat Vedic mantras along with Orh and recite "Namo Brahmane"*** etc. thrice. Then he shall repeat the mantra "Agnimile purohitam'*,* perform the great rite and repeat. "Agnirvai"**® '*Ise tvorje tva", then repeat the Mantras "Agna ayahi vltaye",*® Sanno dcvirabh! taye"' along with Ma, Ya, Ra, Sa, Ta, Ja, Bha, Na, La, and Ga.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall repeat Vedic mantras along with Orh and recite "Namo Brahmane"*** etc. thrice. Then he shall repeat the mantra "Agnimile purohitam'*,* perform the great rite and repeat. "Agnirvai"**® '*Ise tvorje tva",…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall repeat Vedic mantras along with Orh and recite "Namo Brahmane"*** etc. thrice. Then he shall repeat the mantra "Agnimile purohitam'*,* perform the great rite and repeat. "Agnirvai"**® '*Ise tvorje tva",…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुकुटीकुटिलं घोरं रक्तवृत्तत्रिलोचनम् । दंष्ट्राकरालं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं स्फुरिताधरपल्लवम्
verses.transliteration: bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ ghoraṃ raktavṛttatrilocanam | daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ sphuritādharapallavam
verses.translation: This shall continue for five years. This is the tradition. Then ho shall repeat the text of grammar, Mimarhsa and Vedanta. He shall repeat the names of the gods as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: This shall continue for five years. This is the tradition. Then ho shall repeat the text of grammar, Mimarhsa and Vedanta. He shall repeat the names of the gods as well.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं विद्रुमप्रख्यं नीलालकविभूषितम् । सद्विलासं त्रिनयनं चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: uttaraṃ vidrumaprakhyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam | sadvilāsaṃ trinayanaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam
verses.translation: He shall perform the Japa of Brahma, Indra, Sun, moon, Prajapati Jfianatman and Paramatman with Pranava in the beginning, namah in the end using the dative case. He shall take some flour of fried grain, eat it with Pranava, perform Acamana twice, wash his hands, repeat the mantras mentioned hereafter. He shall repeat the names of Atman, Antaratman, Jnanatman beginning with Pranava and ending with Namah. After repeating the mantra of Atman he shall repeat the mantra of Prajapati.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform the Japa of Brahma, Indra, Sun, moon, Prajapati Jfianatman and Paramatman with Pranava in the beginning, namah in the end using the dative case. He shall take some flour of fried grain, eat it with Pranava, perform Acamana twice, wash his hands,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the Japa of Brahma, Indra, Sun, moon, Prajapati Jfianatman and Paramatman with Pranava in the beginning, namah in the end using the dative case. He shall take some flour of fried grain, eat it with Pranava, perform Acamana twice, wash his hands,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमं पूर्णचन्द्राभं लोचनत्रितयोज्ज्वलम् । चन्द्रलेखाधरं सौम्यं मन्दस्मितमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: paścimaṃ pūrṇacandrābhaṃ locanatritayojjvalam | candralekhādharaṃ saumyaṃ mandasmitamanoharam
verses.translation: He shall then perform the Japa ending with Svaha. Repeating Pranava he shall take in milk, curd and ghee separately thrice and perform Acamana twice. With the mind steady he shall sit firmly facing the east and perform pranayama thrice in accordance with the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then perform the Japa ending with Svaha. Repeating Pranava he shall take in milk, curd and ghee separately thrice and perform Acamana twice. With the mind steady he shall sit firmly facing the east and perform pranayama thrice in accordance with the rules.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमं स्फटिकप्रख्यमिन्दुरेखासमुज्ज्वलम् । अतीव सौम्यमुत्फुल्ललोचनत्रितयोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: pañcamaṃ sphaṭikaprakhyamindurekhāsamujjvalam | atīva saumyamutphullalocanatritayojjvalam
verses.translation: AB.fl.ij. r>- 14}.. RV. i.i.i.
verses.commentary: Sense: AB.fl.ij. r>- 14}.. RV. i.i.i.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे शूलपरशुवज्रखड्गानलोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe śūlaparaśuvajrakhaḍgānalojjvalam
verses.translation: Ibid i I. 4b.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid i I. 4b.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वामे पिनाकनाराचघण्टापाशाङ्कुशोज्ज्वलम् । निवृत्त्या जानुपर्यन्तमानाभि च प्रतिष्ठया
verses.transliteration: vāme pinākanārācaghaṇṭāpāśāṅkuśojjvalam | nivṛttyā jānuparyantamānābhi ca pratiṣṭhayā
verses.translation: Ibid 20 12.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आकण्ठं विद्यया तद्वदाललाटं तु शान्तया । तदूर्ध्वं शान्त्यतीताख्यकलया परया तथा
verses.transliteration: ākaṇṭhaṃ vidyayā tadvadālalāṭaṃ tu śāntayā | tadūrdhvaṃ śāntyatītākhyakalayā parayā tathā
verses.translation: Then at midday he shall take bath. With the mind fully controlled he shall gather materials for worship such as fragrant flowers, Aktas etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at midday he shall take bath. With the mind fully controlled he shall gather materials for worship such as fragrant flowers, Aktas etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाध्वव्यापिनं तस्मात्कलापञ्चकविग्रहम् । ईशानमुकुटं देवं पुरुषास्यं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: pañcādhvavyāpinaṃ tasmātkalāpañcakavigraham | īśānamukuṭaṃ devaṃ puruṣāsyaṃ purātanam
verses.translation: After invoking the elephant-faced lord Ganapati son of Siva, of red colour, huge body, bedecked in ornaments and holding noose, goad, Rudraksa and boon in his lotus-hand he shall worship him at dusk. He shall offer milk pudding (sweet pie), coconut jaggery and other things as Naivedya and also the leaf. After propitiating and bowing to him he shall pray for warding off evil.
verses.wordMeaning: After invoking the elephant-faced lord Ganapati son of Siva, of red colour, huge body, bedecked in ornaments and holding noose, goad, Rudraksa and boon in his lotus-hand he shall worship him at dusk. He shall offer milk pudding (sweet pie),…
verses.commentary: Sense: After invoking the elephant-faced lord Ganapati son of Siva, of red colour, huge body, bedecked in ornaments and holding noose, goad, Rudraksa and boon in his lotus-hand he shall worship him at dusk. He shall offer milk pudding (sweet pie),…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अघोरहृदयं तद्वद्वामगुह्यं महेश्वरम् । सद्यपादं च तन्मूर्तिमष्टत्रिंशत्कलामयम्
verses.transliteration: aghorahṛdayaṃ tadvadvāmaguhyaṃ maheśvaram | sadyapādaṃ ca tanmūrtimaṣṭatriṃśatkalāmayam
verses.translation: Thereafter the rites of sacrifice concluding with the sharing of clarified butter shall be performed in the Aupasana fire according to the rules of one's Grhyasutra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the rites of sacrifice concluding with the sharing of clarified butter shall be performed in the Aupasana fire according to the rules of one's Grhyasutra.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मातृकामयमीशानं पञ्चब्रह्ममयं तथा । Oङ्काराख्यमयं चैव हंसन्यासमयं तथा
verses.transliteration: mātṛkāmayamīśānaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ tathā | Oṅkārākhyamayaṃ caiva haṃsanyāsamayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: After offering the Purnahuti with the three Rks "Bhuh Svaha® and concluding the rites he shall repeat Gayatri assiduously till late in the afternoon.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering the Purnahuti with the three Rks "Bhuh Svaha® and concluding the rites he shall repeat Gayatri assiduously till late in the afternoon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाक्षरमयं देवं षडक्षरमयं तथा । अङ्गषट्कमयं चैव जातिषट्कसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: pañcākṣaramayaṃ devaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramayaṃ tathā | aṅgaṣaṭkamayaṃ caiva jātiṣaṭkasamanvitam
verses.translation: He shall perform the evening prayers after bath and the sacrificial rites and inform his preceptor accordingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the evening prayers after bath and the sacrificial rites and inform his preceptor accordingly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यात्वाथ मद्वामभागे त्वां च मनोन्मनीम् । गौरीमिमाय मन्त्रेण प्रणवाद्येन भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dhyātvātha madvāmabhāge tvāṃ ca manonmanīm | gaurīmimāya mantreṇa praṇavādyena bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: After offering the Caru therein e shall perform Homa with different faggots of sticks, cooked rice and ghee repeating Rudrasukta. He shall conceive Lord Siva in the fire along with Amba and the five Brahmans —Sadyojata etc. He shall remember Gaurl and perform homa with the mantra "Gaurirmimaya*® etc.
verses.wordMeaning: After offering the Caru therein e shall perform Homa with different faggots of sticks, cooked rice and ghee repeating Rudrasukta. He shall conceive Lord Siva in the fire along with Amba and the five Brahmans —Sadyojata etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering the Caru therein e shall perform Homa with different faggots of sticks, cooked rice and ghee repeating Rudrasukta. He shall conceive Lord Siva in the fire along with Amba and the five Brahmans —Sadyojata etc.…

verses.sanskrit: आवाह्य पूर्ववत्कुर्यान्नमस्कारान्तमीश्वरि । ध्यायेत्ततस्त्वां देवेशि समाहितमना मुनिः
verses.transliteration: āvāhya pūrvavatkuryānnamaskārāntamīśvari | dhyāyettatastvāṃ deveśi samāhitamanā muniḥ
verses.translation: He shall perform sacrifice, repeat the mantra "Agnaye svistakrte svaha''®® and then show mystic gestures. Being of steady mind he shall sit on the, seat of cloth, deerskin or Darbha grass to the north of the fire and perform the Gayatri japa silently till the brahma muhurta.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform sacrifice, repeat the mantra "Agnaye svistakrte svaha''®® and then show mystic gestures. Being of steady mind he shall sit on the, seat of cloth, deerskin or Darbha grass to the north of the fire and perform the Gayatri japa silently till the brahma muhurta.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रफुल्लोत्पलपत्राभां विस्तीर्णायतलोचनाम् । पूर्णचन्द्राभवदनां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम्
verses.transliteration: praphullotpalapatrābhāṃ vistīrṇāyatalocanām | pūrṇacandrābhavadanāṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām
verses.commentary: Sense: VS. 3. 5. 37.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यां चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखराम् । अतिवृत्तघनोत्तुङ्गस्निग्धपीनपयोधराम्
verses.transliteration: nīlotpaladalaprakhyāṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharām | ativṛttaghanottuṅgasnigdhapīnapayodharām
verses.commentary: Sense: RV. I. if>4. 41: TB 2. 4. 6. II
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तनुमध्यां पृथुश्रोणीं पीतसूक्ष्मतराम्बराम् । सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नां ललाटतिलकोज्ज्वलाम्
verses.transliteration: tanumadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ pītasūkṣmatarāmbarām | sarvābharaṇasampannāṃ lalāṭatilakojjvalām
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रपुष्पसङ्कीर्णकेशपाशोपशोभिताम् । सर्वतोऽनुगुणाकारां किञ्चिल्लज्जानताननाम्
verses.transliteration: vicitrapuṣpasaṅkīrṇakeśapāśopaśobhitām | sarvato'nuguṇākārāṃ kiñcillajjānatānanām
verses.translation: He shall then take bath. If he is feeble he shall smear.Bhasma only. He shall cook Garu in the fire and pour ghee over it. Thus sanctifying it he shall consign it to the fire. He shall perform the Japa of the Vyahftis, •Rudra Sukta and the five Brahmans. He shall fix his mind in the lotus-feet of Siva. He shall perform the Japa of Prajapati, Indra, Vivedevas and Brahma also, with dative case-endings. Pranava and other mantras shall be repeated ending with Svaha. He shall perform Punyahavacana say Agnye svaha, show mystic gesture in front of the fire. Then he shall repeat Pranaya svaha and offer five Ahutis to Svista- kft fire. He shall repeat Rudrasukta, the five Bfahmans, the Caturvyuha mantras, Homa and mystic gestures in accordance with his Vedic branch.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then take bath. If he is feeble he shall smear.Bhasma only. He shall cook Garu in the fire and pour ghee over it. Thus sanctifying it he shall consign it to the fire. He shall perform the Japa of the Vyahftis, •Rudra Sukta and the five Brahmans.…

verses.translation: He shall say "Let these Tattvas be purified.'* For the purity of the principle — Atman, the mantras 'Aruna- ketukas* shall be repeated. He shall silently perform the Homa with the Garu and ghee and remember the lotus-feet of 6iva. O sage, the principles begin with Prthivi and end with Purusa.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ māṃ tvāṃ ca deveśi dhyātvā niyatamānasaḥ | snāpayecchaṅkhatoyena praṇavaprokṣaṇakramāt
verses.translation: Prthivi, Sound, Speech, Ear — these are five each. The four head, sides, back, belly and the calves shall be added afterwards in the group — skin etc. The Dhatu group consists of seven. Pranas are five in number. Anna etc. are the five sheaths. Mind, Gitta, intellect, ego, Khyati come under Sankalpa. Gunas come after; Prakrti and Purusa follow these. Purusa is the only enjoyer and the five principles are the objects of his enjoyment.

verses.sanskrit: भवे भवे नातिभव इति पाद्यं प्रकल्पयेत् । वामाय नम इत्युक्त्वा दद्यादाचमनीयकम्
verses.transliteration: bhave bhave nātibhava iti pādyaṃ prakalpayet | vāmāya nama ityuktvā dadyādācamanīyakam
verses.translation: O great sage, destiny, time, attachment, Vidya, Kala — this set of five is born of Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, destiny, time, attachment, Vidya, Kala — this set of five is born of Maya.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठाय नम इत्युक्त्वा शुभ्रवस्त्रं प्रकल्पयेत् । श्रेष्ठाय नम इत्युक्त्वा दद्याद्यज्ञोपवीतकम्
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhāya nama ityuktvā śubhravastraṃ prakalpayet | śreṣṭhāya nama ityuktvā dadyādyajñopavītakam
verses.translation: Though sentient, the Purusa is confused in thought, not knowing the five principles. Though superior to nature he falls below Prakrti as the eye of the crow. This set of fie — the pure Vidya Mahesvara, Sadasiva, Sakti and Siva is cal'ed Vidyatattva or Sivatattva. This is implied in the Vedir text "Prajnanam Bi*ahma."

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राय नम इत्युक्त्वा पुनराचमनीयकम् । कालाय नम इत्युक्त्वा गन्धं दद्यात्सुसंस्कृतम्

verses.translation: O Sage, the purity of the principles from Prthivi to Siva is effected through the dissolution of its cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sage, the purity of the principles from Prthivi to Siva is effected through the dissolution of its cause.

verses.sanskrit: कलविकरणाय नमोऽक्षतं च परिकल्पयेत् । बलविकरणाय नम इति पुष्पाणि दापयेत्

verses.sanskrit: बलाय नम इत्युक्त्वा धूपं दद्यात्प्रयत्नतः । बलप्रमथनायेति सुदीपं चैव दापयेत्

verses.sanskrit: मुद्राः प्रदर्शयेन्मह्यं तुभ्यं च वरवर्णिनि । मयि प्रकल्पयेत्पूर्वमुपचारांस्ततस्त्वयि

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं पूजितौ यत्र तत्रैव क्रमशः सुधीः । गन्धाद्यैरर्चयेत्पूर्वं देवौ हेरम्बषण्मुखौ

verses.translation: He shall then foot a short distance more than seven paces facing north or the east. Then the preceptor shall ask him to stop saying, "for your stay and activity in the world, O holy one, accept this loin-cloth and staff." He shall band them over to him with his own hands.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे च ततस्तस्मिन्षडङ्गानि समर्चयेत् । आग्नेये च तथैशाने नैरृते वायुदेशके

verses.translation: Without knowing this I have been deluded by Siva's Maya. I am ignorant of the Pasupata Sastra.

verses.commentary: Sense: I have sought refuge in your lotus-feet. Glancing at me for a long time with your eyes drenched with the nectar of sympathy you shall bless me so that I shall I become free from delusion, drink in the nectarine potion of the knowledge of the feet of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तं पूर्वदिक्पत्रे सूक्ष्मं दक्षिणतस्तथा । शिवोत्तमं पश्चिमत एकनेत्रं तथोत्तरे

verses.sanskrit: एकरुद्रं तथैशाने त्रिमूर्तिं वह्निदिग्दले । श्रीकण्ठं नैरृते वायौ शिखण्डीशं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: ekarudraṃ tathaiśāne trimūrtiṃ vahnidigdale | śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nairṛte vāyau śikhaṇḍīśaṃ samarcayet
verses.translation: O revered sage, you have enquired about the per¬ fect knowledge of Siva in his composite and individual state. O performer of good rites, I shall e.plain that in detail Perfect knowledge comprises the meaning of Pranava by reali¬ sing the unity of six topics.
verses.commentary: Sense: O revered sage, you have enquired about the per¬ fect knowledge of Siva in his composite and individual state. O performer of good rites, I shall e.plain that in detail Perfect knowledge comprises the meaning of Pranava by reali¬ sing the unity of six topics.
