verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयावरणे चैव पूज्यास्ते चक्रवर्तिनः । पूर्वद्वारस्य मध्ये तु वृषेशानं प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva pūjyāste cakravartinaḥ | pūrvadvārasya madhye tu vṛṣeśānaṃ prapūjayet
verses.translation: The first topic is the mantra; the second Yantra; the third deity; the fourth the cosmos; the fifth the preceptor; the si.xth the Atman of the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first topic is the mantra; the second Yantra; the third deity; the fourth the cosmos; the fifth the preceptor; the si.xth the Atman of the disciple.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्दक्षिणे नन्दिनं च महाकालं तदुत्तरे । भृङ्गीशं दक्षिणद्वारपश्चिमे सम्प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: taddakṣiṇe nandinaṃ ca mahākālaṃ taduttare | bhṛṅgīśaṃ dakṣiṇadvārapaścime samprapūjayet
verses.translation: O excellent sage, I shall explain to you the form of the mantra which makes a man possessed of perfect know¬ ledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, I shall explain to you the form of the mantra which makes a man possessed of perfect know¬ ledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पूर्वकोष्ठे गन्धाद्यैः सम्प्रपूज्य विनायकम् । पश्चिमोत्तरकोष्ठे च वृषभं दक्षिणे गुहम्
verses.transliteration: tatpūrvakoṣṭhe gandhādyaiḥ samprapūjya vināyakam | paścimottarakoṣṭhe ca vṛṣabhaṃ dakṣiṇe guham
verses.translation: After dissolving Gayatrl in the Pranava identical with Siva he shall recite the hymn "ahaih vrksasya re- riva."i53
verses.commentary: Sense: After dissolving Gayatrl in the Pranava identical with Siva he shall recite the hymn "ahaih vrksasya re- riva."i53
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरद्वारपूर्वे तु प्रदक्षिणविधानतः । नामाष्टकविधानेन पूजयेदुच्यते हि तत्
verses.transliteration: uttaradvārapūrve tu pradakṣiṇavidhānataḥ | nāmāṣṭakavidhānena pūjayeducyate hi tat
verses.translation: He shall repeat the hymn beginning with "Yah Chandasam Rsabhah"'®* and ending with "gopaya." Then he shall say 1 have got up.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall repeat the hymn beginning with "Yah Chandasam Rsabhah"'®* and ending with "gopaya." Then he shall say 1 have got up.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भवं शर्वं तथेशानं रुद्रं पशुपतिं पुनः । उग्रं भीमं महादेवं तृतीयावरणं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: bhavaṃ śarvaṃ tatheśānaṃ rudraṃ paśupatiṃ punaḥ | ugraṃ bhīmaṃ mahādevaṃ tṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ tvidam
verses.translation: O sage, he shall recite the mantras in the low, medium and high tone beginning with the Pranava in the order of creation, sustenance and dissolution.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, he shall recite the mantras in the low, medium and high tone beginning with the Pranava in the order of creation, sustenance and dissolution.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो वेदादौ स्वर इति समावाह्य महेश्वरम् । पूजयेत्पूर्वदिग्भागे कमले कर्णिकोपरि
verses.transliteration: yo vedādau svara iti samāvāhya maheśvaram | pūjayetpūrvadigbhāge kamale karṇikopari
verses.translation: In this order he shall say Om Bhuh I have renounced. Om Bhuvah I have renounced. Om Suvah I have renounced. Then he shall say the composite Vyahrtis Orn Bhuh, Bhuvah, Suvah.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this order he shall say Om Bhuh I have renounced. Om Bhuvah I have renounced. Om Suvah I have renounced. Then he shall say the composite Vyahrtis Orn Bhuh, Bhuvah, Suvah.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरं पूर्वदिक्पत्रे विश्वेशं दक्षिणे ततः । उत्तरे परमेशानं सर्वेशं पश्चिमे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: īśvaraṃ pūrvadikpatre viśveśaṃ dakṣiṇe tataḥ | uttare parameśānaṃ sarveśaṃ paścime yajet
verses.translation: O sage, he shall say "I have renounced after meditating on Sadasiva in the heart in th»* low, medium and high pitch gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, he shall say "I have renounced after meditating on Sadasiva in the heart in th»* low, medium and high pitch gradually.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे तु यजेद् रुद्रमावोराजानमित्यृचा । आवाह्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः कर्णिकायां दलेषु च
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe tu yajed rudramāvorājānamityṛcā | āvāhya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu ca
verses.translation: After muttering the Presa mantras with attentive mind he shall say "Let all living beings have fearlessness from me, Svaha."
verses.commentary: Sense: After muttering the Presa mantras with attentive mind he shall say "Let all living beings have fearlessness from me, Svaha."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवः पूर्वे दक्षिणतो हर उत्तरतो मृडः । भवः पश्चिमदिक्पत्रे पूज्या एते यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ pūrve dakṣiṇato hara uttarato mṛḍaḥ | bhavaḥ paścimadikpatre pūjyā ete yathākramam
verses.translation: He shall take water in the cupped palms and pour it to the east. He shall uproot the tuft and take out the sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take water in the cupped palms and pour it to the east. He shall uproot the tuft and take out the sacred thread.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे विष्णुमावाह्य गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् । प्रतद्विष्णुरिति प्रोच्य कर्णिकायां दलेषु च
verses.transliteration: uttare viṣṇumāvāhya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet | pratadviṣṇuriti procya karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu ca
verses.translation: Taking the two in the cupped palms along with water he shall say Om Bhuh "Go thou to the ocean'* after uttering Suaha, the name of the wife of the fire. Along with the water in the palms he shall put the two in the water uttering Presa mantras. After performing Acamana thrice he shall come to the bank and cast oil all the clothes.
verses.wordMeaning: Taking the two in the cupped palms along with water he shall say Om Bhuh "Go thou to the ocean'* after uttering Suaha, the name of the wife of the fire. Along with the water in the palms he shall put the two in the water uttering Presa mantras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the two in the cupped palms along with water he shall say Om Bhuh "Go thou to the ocean'* after uttering Suaha, the name of the wife of the fire. Along with the water in the palms he shall put the two in the water uttering Presa mantras.…

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवं पूर्वभागे दक्षिणे चानिरुद्धकम् । सौम्ये सङ्कर्षणं चैव प्रद्युम्नं पश्चिमे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: vāsudevaṃ pūrvabhāge dakṣiṇe cāniruddhakam | saumye saṅkarṣaṇaṃ caiva pradyumnaṃ paścime yajet
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid. 7. 4. 1: 10. 6. i.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं पश्चिमे पद्मे समावाह्य समर्चयेत् । हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तत इति मन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ paścime padme samāvāhya samarcayet | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata iti mantreṇa mantravit
verses.translation: DH a. IV. 17. 27
verses.commentary: Sense: DH a. IV. 17. 27
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भं पूर्वस्यां विराजं दक्षिणे ततः । उत्तरे पुष्करञ्चैव कालं पश्चिमतो यजेत्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaṃ pūrvasyāṃ virājaṃ dakṣiṇe tataḥ | uttare puṣkarañcaiva kālaṃ paścimato yajet
verses.translation: After giving the loin-cloth with its string, and the ochre-coloured robe he shall ask him to wear them. After performing Acamana twice he shall tell the disciple thus "You are the thunderbolt of Indra."®*. After praying and saying "A good companion", he shall take up thestaff.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving the loin-cloth with its string, and the ochre-coloured robe he shall ask him to wear them. After performing Acamana twice he shall tell the disciple thus "You are the thunderbolt of Indra."®*. After praying and saying "A good companion", he shall take up thestaff.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोर्ध्वपङ्क्तौ पूर्वादिप्रदक्षिणविधानतः । तत्तत्स्थानेषु सम्पूज्य लोकपालाननुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sarvordhvapaṅktau pūrvādipradakṣiṇavidhānataḥ | tattatsthāneṣu sampūjya lokapālānanukramāt
verses.translation: He shall approach the preceptor remembering the lotus-like feet of Siva and fall at his feet thrice with fully restrained mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall approach the preceptor remembering the lotus-like feet of Siva and fall at his feet thrice with fully restrained mind.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रान्तं मान्तं तथा क्षान्तं लान्तं वान्तमपूर्वकम् । सान्तं हान्तं च वेदाद्यं श्रीबीजं च दश क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: rāntaṃ māntaṃ tathā kṣāntaṃ lāntaṃ vāntamapūrvakam | sāntaṃ hāntaṃ ca vedādyaṃ śrībījaṃ ca daśa kramāt
verses.translation: Standing up again he shall approach the feet of the preceptor with palms joined in reverence, glancing at his preceptor with love.
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing up again he shall approach the feet of the preceptor with palms joined in reverence, glancing at his preceptor with love.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बीजानि लोकपालानामेतैरेतान्समर्चयेत् । नैरृत्ये चोत्तरे तद्वदीशानस्य च दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: bījāni lokapālānāmetairetānsamarcayet | nairṛtye cottare tadvadīśānasya ca dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: Before the rites are begun he should collect cowdung and make them into balls of the size of a myroba- lan fruit and dry them in sunshine. The balls shall be placed in the sacrificial fire at the advent of homa. At the conclusion of the homa the ashes shall be collected and preserved.
verses.wordMeaning: Before the rites are begun he should collect cowdung and make them into balls of the size of a myroba- lan fruit and dry them in sunshine. The balls shall be placed in the sacrificial fire at the advent of homa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Before the rites are begun he should collect cowdung and make them into balls of the size of a myroba- lan fruit and dry them in sunshine. The balls shall be placed in the sacrificial fire at the advent of homa.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णू च विधिना पूजयेदुपचारकैः । बाह्यरेखासु देवेशि पञ्चमावरणे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇū ca vidhinā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ | bāhyarekhāsu deveśi pañcamāvaraṇe yajet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall take the white ashes of the Viraja fire. Repeating the mantras "Agniriti Bhasma"®' he shall apply the sacred ashes over the body of the disciple from head to foot. Repeating the five mantras "Isana"'®® Tryayusa"®® "Tryambakam Yjamahe®® he shall apply the Tripundra marks too beginning with head.
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor shall take the white ashes of the Viraja fire. Repeating the mantras "Agniriti Bhasma"®' he shall apply the sacred ashes over the body of the disciple from head to foot.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall take the white ashes of the Viraja fire. Repeating the mantras "Agniriti Bhasma"®' he shall apply the sacred ashes over the body of the disciple from head to foot.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्त्रिशूलमीशाने वज्रं माहेन्द्रदिङ्मुखे । परशुं वह्निदिग्भागे याम्ये सायकमर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: śrīmattriśūlamīśāne vajraṃ māhendradiṅmukhe | paraśuṃ vahnidigbhāge yāmye sāyakamarcayet
verses.translation: Then the disciple shall meditate devotedly on Siva, the consort of Uma in the lotus of his heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the disciple shall meditate devotedly on Siva, the consort of Uma in the lotus of his heart.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नैरृते तु यजेत्खड्गं पाशं वरुणगोचरे । अङ्कुशं मारुते भागे पिनाकं चोत्तरे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: nairṛte tu yajetkhaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ varuṇagocare | aṅkuśaṃ mārute bhāge pinākaṃ cottare yajet
verses.translation: Putting his hand on the head of the disciple the preceptor shall utter the Pranava thrice into the right ear of the disciple along with the names of the sage etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Putting his hand on the head of the disciple the preceptor shall utter the Pranava thrice into the right ear of the disciple along with the names of the sage etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाभिमुखं रौद्रं क्षेत्रपालं समर्चयेत् । यथाविधि विधानज्ञः शिवप्रीत्यर्थमेव च
verses.transliteration: paścimābhimukhaṃ raudraṃ kṣetrapālaṃ samarcayet | yathāvidhi vidhānajñaḥ śivaprītyarthameva ca
verses.translation: The excellent preceptor shall be sympathetic and explain Pranava with the knowledge of the six-fold topics.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent preceptor shall be sympathetic and explain Pranava with the knowledge of the six-fold topics.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे चिन्त्याः स्मितमुखाम्बुजाः । सादरं प्रेक्षमाणाश्च देवं देवीं च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve cintyāḥ smitamukhāmbujāḥ | sādaraṃ prekṣamāṇāśca devaṃ devīṃ ca sarvadā
verses.translation: Siras U 5..
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमावरणाभ्यर्चां कृत्वा विक्षेपशान्तये । पुनरभ्यर्च्य देवेशं प्रणवं च शिवं वदेत्
verses.transliteration: itthamāvaraṇābhyarcāṃ kṛtvā vikṣepaśāntaye | punarabhyarcya deveśaṃ praṇavaṃ ca śivaṃ vadet
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद् गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः । उपचर्य ततो दद्यान्नैवेद्यं विधिसाधितम्
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarcya vidhivad gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ | upacarya tato dadyānnaivedyaṃ vidhisādhitam
verses.translation: The disciple shall make obeisance to the pre¬ ceptor by prostrating twelve times. He shall remain subservient to him always. He shall not do anything else.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall make obeisance to the pre¬ ceptor by prostrating twelve times. He shall remain subservient to him always. He shall not do anything else.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनराचमनीयं च दद्यादर्घ्यं यथा पुरा । ततो निवेद्य पानीयं ताम्बूलं चोपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: punarācamanīyaṃ ca dadyādarghyaṃ yathā purā | tato nivedya pānīyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ copadeśataḥ
verses.translation: At his bidding the disciple shall pursue Saivite knowledge in conformity with the Upanisadic doctrine and based on the difference of Saguna and Nirguna.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his bidding the disciple shall pursue Saivite knowledge in conformity with the Upanisadic doctrine and based on the difference of Saguna and Nirguna.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नीराजनादिकं कृत्वा पूजाशेषं समापयेत् । ध्यात्वा देवं च देवीं च मनुमष्टोत्तरं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: nīrājanādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet | dhyātvā devaṃ ca devīṃ ca manumaṣṭottaraṃ japet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall make the disciple perform all the rites in the morning up to the Japa including the practice of hearing etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall make the disciple perform all the rites in the morning up to the Japa including the practice of hearing etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय रचितपुष्पाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः । जपेद् ध्यात्वा महादेवं यो देवानामिति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tata utthāya racitapuṣpāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ | japed dhyātvā mahādevaṃ yo devānāmiti kramāt
verses.translation: The disciple shall perform the worship in the manrlala Kailasaprastai a as enjoined by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall perform the worship in the manrlala Kailasaprastai a as enjoined by Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो वेदादौ स्वरः प्रोक्त इत्यन्तं परमेश्वरि । पुष्पाञ्जलिं ततो दत्त्वा त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: yo vedādau svaraḥ prokta ityantaṃ parameśvari | puṣpāñjaliṃ tato dattvā triḥpradakṣiṇamācaret
verses.translation: If he cannot worship the deity worshipped by his preceptor he shall take up Sivalihga of crystal along with the pedestal.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he cannot worship the deity worshipped by his preceptor he shall take up Sivalihga of crystal along with the pedestal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साष्टाङ्गं प्रणमेत्तं स भक्त्या परमयान्वितः । पुनः प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा प्रणमेत्पुनरेकधा
verses.transliteration: sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamettaṃ sa bhaktyā paramayānvitaḥ | punaḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā praṇametpunarekadhā
verses.translation: "I shall rather cast life and cut off my head than take meals without worshipping Siva."
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall rather cast life and cut off my head than take meals without worshipping Siva."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वासने समभ्यर्च्य देवं नामाष्टकेन च । साधु वासाधु वा कर्म यद्यदाचरितं मया
verses.transliteration: sthitvāsane samabhyarcya devaṃ nāmāṣṭakena ca | sādhu vāsādhu vā karma yadyadācaritaṃ mayā
verses.translation: Thus shall the disciple devoted to Siva take vow in the presence of the preceptor which he shall repeat thrice with a steady mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus shall the disciple devoted to Siva take vow in the presence of the preceptor which he shall repeat thrice with a steady mind.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं भगवञ्छम्भो भवदाराधनं परम् । इति शङ्खोदकेनैव सपुष्पेण समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaṃ bhagavañchambho bhavadārādhanaṃ param | iti śaṅkhodakenaiva sapuṣpeṇa samarpayet
verses.translation: Thus the disciple shall worship Lord Siva every day with devoted and diligent mind, following the path t)f five Avaranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the disciple shall worship Lord Siva every day with devoted and diligent mind, following the path t)f five Avaranas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यं पुनः समभ्यर्च्य सार्थं नामाष्टकं जपेत् । तदेव शृणु देवेशि सम्ब्रुवे तव भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: pūjyaṃ punaḥ samabhyarcya sārthaṃ nāmāṣṭakaṃ japet | tadeva śṛṇu deveśi sambruve tava bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: O Karttikeya, the nectarine ocean of perfect know¬ ledge, son of Siva the lord of gods and the dispeller of distress of the devotees what is perfect knowledge of the sixfold topics that bestows all desires? VVliat are the six topics? What is the perfect knowledge?
verses.commentary: Sense: O Karttikeya, the nectarine ocean of perfect know¬ ledge, son of Siva the lord of gods and the dispeller of distress of the devotees what is perfect knowledge of the sixfold topics that bestows all desires? VVliat are the six topics? What is the perfect knowledge?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam
verses.translation: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । प्रणवार्थपद्धतिवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । शिवो महेश्वरश्चैव रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः । संसारवैद्यः सर्वज्ञः परमात्मेति मुख्यतः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā 6.9. navamo'dhyāyaḥ | praṇavārthapaddhativarṇanam | īśvara uvāca | śivo maheśvaraścaiva rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ | saṃsāravaidyaḥ sarvajñaḥ paramātmeti mukhyataḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I shall now explain the secret topic of the deity. I shall mention it, out of my affection to you, in the manner explained by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, I shall now explain the secret topic of the deity. I shall mention it, out of my affection to you, in the manner explained by Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमिदं नित्यं शिवस्य प्रतिपादकम् । आद्यन्तपञ्चकं तत्र शान्त्यतीताद्यनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ nityaṃ śivasya pratipādakam | ādyantapañcakaṃ tatra śāntyatītādyanukramāt
verses.translation: Nivftti and the Kalas are the offshoots of five Brahmans. They are in the form of subtle elements well known as causes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nivftti and the Kalas are the offshoots of five Brahmans. They are in the form of subtle elements well known as causes.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञा सदाशिवादीनां पञ्चोपाधिपरिग्रहात् । उपाधिविनिवृत्तौ तु यथास्वं विनिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: saṃjñā sadāśivādīnāṃ pañcopādhiparigrahāt | upādhivinivṛttau tu yathāsvaṃ vinivartate
verses.translation: The Tirobhava Gakra consists of the Santikala. This excellent region is presided over by Maheivara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tirobhava Gakra consists of the Santikala. This excellent region is presided over by Maheivara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पदमेव हि तं नित्यमनित्याः पदिनः स्मृताः । पदानां परिवृत्तिः स्यान्मुच्यन्ते पदिनो यतः
verses.transliteration: padameva hi taṃ nityamanityāḥ padinaḥ smṛtāḥ | padānāṃ parivṛttiḥ syānmucyante padino yataḥ
verses.translation: O sage, in the creation of the universe there are five functions of the lord. The present time etc. are the deities there.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, in the creation of the universe there are five functions of the lord. The present time etc. are the deities there.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परिवृत्त्यन्तरे त्वेवं भूयस्तस्याप्युपाधिना । आत्मान्तराभिधानं स्यात्यादाद्यं नामपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: parivṛttyantare tvevaṃ bhūyastasyāpyupādhinā | ātmāntarābhidhānaṃ syātyādādyaṃ nāmapañcakam
verses.translation: O lord, uproot this poisonous tree of doubt arising from ignorance. I shall be enlightened by you so that my mind may become the fertile ground for the growth of monistic knowledge of the Saivite cult. O lord of gods, by your benign favour I shall become wise.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, uproot this poisonous tree of doubt arising from ignorance. I shall be enlightened by you so that my mind may become the fertile ground for the growth of monistic knowledge of the Saivite cult. O lord of gods, by your benign favour I shall become wise.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्तु त्रितयं नाम्नामुपादानादिभेदतः । त्रिविधोपाधिरचनाच्छिव एव तु वर्तते
verses.transliteration: anyattu tritayaṃ nāmnāmupādānādibhedataḥ | trividhopādhiracanācchiva eva tu vartate
verses.translation: In the self-same individual the feeling of Siva and Sakti exists. If there is dirt in the oil or the wick there may be dirt in the light too.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the self-same individual the feeling of Siva and Sakti exists. If there is dirt in the oil or the wick there may be dirt in the light too.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमलसंश्लेषप्रागभावात्स्वभावतः । अत्यन्तपरिशुद्धात्मेत्यतोऽयं शिव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: anādimalasaṃśleṣaprāgabhāvātsvabhāvataḥ | atyantapariśuddhātmetyato'yaṃ śiva ucyate
verses.translation: O sage, people say in the world: he is strong, he ii powerful and in the Vedas too there is a similar expres.«ion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, people say in the world: he is strong, he ii powerful and in the Vedas too there is a similar expres.«ion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवाशेषकल्याणगुणैकघन ईश्वरः । शिव इत्युच्यते सद्भिः शिवतत्त्वार्थवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: athavāśeṣakalyāṇaguṇaikaghana īśvaraḥ | śiva ityucyate sadbhiḥ śivatattvārthavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O sage, sinless ascetics aiming at bliss fix their minds in Siva and attain untainted auspiciousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O sage, sinless ascetics aiming at bliss fix their minds in Siva and attain untainted auspiciousness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतितत्वेभ्यः परा प्रकृतिरुच्यते । प्रकृतेस्तु परं प्राहुः पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: trayoviṃśatitatvebhyaḥ parā prakṛtirucyate | prakṛtestu paraṃ prāhuḥ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: The word Brahman in the Upaniads signifies Atman collectively. It can be traced to the root Brh to in¬ crease or grow.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Brahman in the Upaniads signifies Atman collectively. It can be traced to the root Brh to in¬ crease or grow.

verses.transliteration: śivatattvādibhūmyantaṃ śarīrādi ghaṭādi ca | vyāpyādhitiṣṭhati śivastamādviṣṇurudāhṛtaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: The four Brahmans constitute a Caturvyuha for lord Tsana, the famous Brahman. These five together constitute the composite. O sage, from Purusa to Sadyojfita the four constitute the individual.

verses.sanskrit: जगतः पितृभूतानां शिवो मूर्त्यात्मनामपि । पितृभावेन सर्वेषां पितामह उदीरितः

verses.translation: O sage, there too the deities Sadya etc. are of the form of the great Brahman. The five always bestow happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, there too the deities Sadya etc. are of the form of the great Brahman. The five always bestow happiness.

verses.sanskrit: निदानज्ञो यथा वैद्यो रोगस्य विनिवर्तकः । उपायैर्भेषजैस्तद्वल्लयभोगाधिकारकः
verses.transliteration: nidānajño yathā vaidyo rogasya vinivartakaḥ | upāyairbheṣajaistadvallayabhogādhikārakaḥ
verses.translation: After attaining this region and enjoying vast pleasures along with the lord in the form of Brahman the sages attain equality with Siva at the advent of the great dissolution. They never fall again in the ocean of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining this region and enjoying vast pleasures along with the lord in the form of Brahman the sages attain equality with Siva at the advent of the great dissolution. They never fall again in the ocean of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: अणवो नैव जानन्ति मायार्णवमलावृताः । असत्स्वपि च सर्वेषु सिद्धसर्वार्थवेदिषु

verses.commentary: Sense: O sage of good rites, the set of five Brahmans is the cause of gross cosmos.

verses.translation: The mind, nose, organ of generation, smell and earth, this set of five is pervaded by the Brahman Sadya. The whole universe is identical with the five Brahmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind, nose, organ of generation, smell and earth, this set of five is pervaded by the Brahman Sadya. The whole universe is identical with the five Brahmans.

verses.translation: Dissolution has been classified into three. The first Nitya is the daily slumber of living beings. The second is the conditioned dissolution of Brahma. verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः समर्चयेन्नित्यं पूर्वोक्तविधिना प्रिये । अर्घं समर्पयेल्लिङ्गमूर्द्धन्यर्घ्योदकेन च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samarcayennityaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā priye | arghaṃ samarpayelliṅgamūrddhanyarghyodakena ca
verses.translation: O sage, the deities Bhava etc. are identical with the great Brahman, being the cause of bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the deities Bhava etc. are identical with the great Brahman, being the cause of bliss.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवेन समभ्यर्च्य धूपदीपौ समर्पयेत् । ऐशान्यां चण्डमाराध्य निर्माल्यं च निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: praṇavena samabhyarcya dhūpadīpau samarpayet | aiśānyāṃ caṇḍamārādhya nirmālyaṃ ca nivedayet
verses.translation: This wheel of dissolution has Vidyarupa Kala. This healthy region is presided over by Rudra himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: This wheel of dissolution has Vidyarupa Kala. This healthy region is presided over by Rudra himself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य लिङ्गं वेदीं च वस्त्रपूतैर्जलैस्ततः । निःक्षिप्य पुष्पं शिरसि लिङ्गस्य प्रणवेन तु
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya liṅgaṃ vedīṃ ca vastrapūtairjalaistataḥ | niḥkṣipya puṣpaṃ śirasi liṅgasya praṇavena tu
verses.translation: This set of four consists of Vasudeva, Aniruddha, Sarhkarsana and Pradyumna. This excellent wheel of sus¬ tenance is well known.
verses.commentary: Sense: This set of four consists of Vasudeva, Aniruddha, Sarhkarsana and Pradyumna. This excellent wheel of sus¬ tenance is well known.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिमारभ्य शुद्धविद्यासनावधि । विभाव्य सर्वं मनसा स्थापयेत्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ādhāraśaktimārabhya śuddhavidyāsanāvadhi | vibhāvya sarvaṃ manasā sthāpayetparameśvaram
verses.translation: Sustenance means the protection of the existing universe along with its creator until the completion of the pleasures of the souls, the reapers of the fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sustenance means the protection of the existing universe along with its creator until the completion of the pleasures of the souls, the reapers of the fruit.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्यादिभिर्द्रव्यैर्यथाविभवसम्भृतैः । केवलैर्वा जलैः शुद्धैः सुरभिद्रव्यवासितैः
verses.transliteration: pañcagavyādibhirdravyairyathāvibhavasambhṛtaiḥ | kevalairvā jalaiḥ śuddhaiḥ surabhidravyavāsitaiḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmin, this wheel of sustenance which is per¬ manent is presided over by Vi§nu. It is the highest abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmin, this wheel of sustenance which is per¬ manent is presided over by Vi§nu. It is the highest abode.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पावमानेन रुद्रेण नीलेन त्वरितेन च । ऋग्भिश्च सामभिर्वापि ब्रह्मभिश्चैव पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: pāvamānena rudreṇa nīlena tvaritena ca | ṛgbhiśca sāmabhirvāpi brahmabhiścaiva pañcabhiḥ
verses.translation: Hiranyagarbha, Virat, Purua and Kala, the four constitute his personal form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyagarbha, Virat, Purua and Kala, the four constitute his personal form.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेद्देवदेवेशं प्रणवेन शिवेन च । विशेषार्घ्योदकेनापि प्रणवेनाभिषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ praṇavena śivena ca | viśeṣārghyodakenāpi praṇavenābhiṣecayet
verses.translation: Those who have the knowledge of creation know this to be the function of Brahman. Creation is the process of re-unification of the soul with the body previously annihilated — the body which along with the means, ancillaries and results comes out of Prakrti for gradual enjoyment. It is pleasing as long as it holds good.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have the knowledge of creation know this to be the function of Brahman. Creation is the process of re-unification of the soul with the body previously annihilated — the body which along with the means,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have the knowledge of creation know this to be the function of Brahman. Creation is the process of re-unification of the soul with the body previously annihilated — the body which along with the means,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विशोध्य वाससा पुष्पं लिङ्गमूर्धनि विन्यसेत् । पीठे लिङ्गं समारोप्य सूर्याद्यर्चां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: viśodhya vāsasā puṣpaṃ liṅgamūrdhani vinyaset | pīṭhe liṅgaṃ samāropya sūryādyarcāṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Even in regard to the set of four wheels the Pranava indicates Mahea etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even in regard to the set of four wheels the Pranava indicates Mahea etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्त्यनन्तौ द्वौ पीठाधस्तात्समर्चयेत् । सिंहासनं तदूर्ध्वं तु समभ्यर्च्य यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ādhāraśaktyanantau dvau pīṭhādhastātsamarcayet | siṃhāsanaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu samabhyarcya yathākramam
verses.translation: Although the wheel of the universe with its five constituents: creation etc. has five spokes, it develops and increases by Siva's energy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the wheel of the universe with its five constituents: creation etc. has five spokes, it develops and increases by Siva's energy.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोर्ध्वच्छदनम्पीठपादे स्कन्दं समर्चयेत् । लिङ्गे मूर्तिं समाकल्प्य मां त्वया सह पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: athordhvacchadanampīṭhapāde skandaṃ samarcayet | liṅge mūrtiṃ samākalpya māṃ tvayā saha pūjayet
verses.translation: Because of the immensity of creation it is called Prthu, the resultant of the Saktj of lord Siva of immense splendour and of golden features. The wheel is dependent on golden splendour and is surrounded by water encompassed by fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because of the immensity of creation it is called Prthu, the resultant of the Saktj of lord Siva of immense splendour and of golden features. The wheel is dependent on golden splendour and is surrounded by water encompassed by fire.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग् भक्त्या विधानेन यतिर्मद्ध्यानतत्परः । एवं मया ते कथितमतिगुह्यमिदं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: samyag bhaktyā vidhānena yatirmaddhyānatatparaḥ | evaṃ mayā te kathitamatiguhyamidaṃ priye
verses.translation: Such are the seven sheaths which protect the universe. The expanse of water is ten times more massive than the wheel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such are the seven sheaths which protect the universe. The expanse of water is ten times more massive than the wheel.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् । मम भक्ताय दातव्यं यतये वीतरागिणे
verses.transliteration: gopanīyaṃ prayatnena na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit | mama bhaktāya dātavyaṃ yataye vītarāgiṇe
verses.translation: That 8iva alone accompanied by 8akti performs incessant sports through blessing, disappearance, dissolution, sustenance and creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: That 8iva alone accompanied by 8akti performs incessant sports through blessing, disappearance, dissolution, sustenance and creation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुभक्ताय शान्ताय मदर्थे योगभागिने । ममाज्ञामतिलङ्घ्यैतद्यो ददाति विमूढधीः
verses.transliteration: gurubhaktāya śāntāya madarthe yogabhāgine | mamājñāmatilaṅghyaitadyo dadāti vimūḍhadhīḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this truthful purport enunciated, by the preceptor the leading sage asked him about his doubt concerning the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this truthful purport enunciated, by the preceptor the leading sage asked him about his doubt concerning the great Atman.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स नारकी मम द्रोही भविष्यति न संशयः । मद्भक्तदानाद्देवेशि मत्प्रियश्च भवेद् ध्रुवम् । इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगान्मत्सान्निध्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sa nārakī mama drohī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | madbhaktadānāddeveśi matpriyaśca bhaved dhruvam | iha bhuktvākhilānbhogānmatsānnidhyamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Surely this universe from Sadaiiva to a worm is reflected in male and female forms everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surely this universe from Sadaiiva to a worm is reflected in male and female forms everywhere.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवी महादेवेन भाषितम् । स्तुत्वा तु विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्देवं वेदार्थगर्भितैः
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca | etacchrutvā mahādevī mahādevena bhāṣitam | stutvā tu vividhaiḥ stotrairdevaṃ vedārthagarbhitaiḥ
verses.translation: Is the eternal cause of the universe in the form of a woman, or of a man or a eunuch?
verses.commentary: Sense: Is the eternal cause of the universe in the form of a woman, or of a man or a eunuch?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्पादाब्जयोः पत्युः प्रणामं परमेश्वरी । अतिप्रहृष्टहृदया मुमोद मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śrīmatpādābjayoḥ patyuḥ praṇāmaṃ parameśvarī | atiprahṛṣṭahṛdayā mumoda munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas expatiating on the creation of the universe itself, Visnu, Brahma and other gods and the Siddhas do not know it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas expatiating on the creation of the universe itself, Visnu, Brahma and other gods and the Siddhas do not know it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतिगुह्यमिदं विप्राः प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकम् । शिवज्ञानपरं ह्येतद्भवतामार्तिनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: atiguhyamidaṃ viprāḥ praṇavārthaprakāśakam | śivajñānaparaṃ hyetadbhavatāmārtināśanam
verses.translation: Please explain so that the conflicting views may be resolved into one truthful interpretation. We say — "I know," "I do". This is accepted by all. There is no dispute about this. But I have some doubts. "Is there a form of the Atman or is the Atman identical with the body, sense- organs, mind, intellect and ego? The two are the points of dispute among many.
verses.wordMeaning: Please explain so that the conflicting views may be resolved into one truthful interpretation. We say — "I know," "I do". This is accepted by all. There is no dispute about this. But I have some doubts. "Is there a form of the Atman or is the Atman identical with the body,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Please explain so that the conflicting views may be resolved into one truthful interpretation. We say — "I know," "I do". This is accepted by all. There is no dispute about this. But I have some doubts. "Is there a form of the Atman or is the Atman identical with the body,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलः पाराशर्यो महातपाः । पूजितः परया भक्त्या मुनिभिर्वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityuktvā muniśārdūlaḥ pārāśaryo mahātapāḥ | pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā munibhirvedavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the enquiry of the sage full of Vedantic topics, the lord smiled a little and unfolded the secret.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the enquiry of the sage full of Vedantic topics, the lord smiled a little and unfolded the secret.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कैलासाद्रिमनुस्मृत्य ययौ तस्मात्तपोवनात् । तेऽपि प्रहृष्टहृदयाः सत्रान्ते परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsādrimanusmṛtya yayau tasmāttapovanāt | te'pi prahṛṣṭahṛdayāḥ satrānte parameśvaram
verses.translation: O sage, I shall sympathetically explain the same to you. O son, it is the greatest secret. Please listen to it now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, I shall sympathetically explain the same to you. O son, it is the greatest secret. Please listen to it now.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य परया भक्त्या सोमं सोमार्धशेखरम् । यमादियोगनिरताः शिवध्यानपराभवन्
verses.transliteration: sampūjya parayā bhaktyā somaṃ somārdhaśekharam | yamādiyoganiratāḥ śivadhyānaparābhavan
verses.translation: The arguments in the philosof)hical text books arc extensive beginning with those on Karmans and the principle of existence. But O sage, those arguments shall be listened to with discrimination by a wise person. Then it may yield wisdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The arguments in the philosof)hical text books arc extensive beginning with those on Karmans and the principle of existence. But O sage, those arguments shall be listened to with discrimination by a wise person. Then it may yield wisdom.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गुहाय कथितं ह्येतद्देव्या तेनापि नन्दिने । सनत्कुमारमुनये प्रोवाच भगवान् हि सः
verses.transliteration: guhāya kathitaṃ hyetaddevyā tenāpi nandine | sanatkumāramunaye provāca bhagavān hi saḥ
verses.translation: You have taught many disciples. But among them
verses.commentary: Sense: You have taught many disciples. But among them
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माल्लब्धं मद्गुरुणा व्यासेनामिततेजसा । तस्माल्लब्धमिदं पुण्यं मयापि मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāllabdhaṃ madguruṇā vyāsenāmitatejasā | tasmāllabdhamidaṃ puṇyaṃ mayāpi munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: They indulged in insulting Siva and hence were cursed by the seven sages. Their views should not be heard because they explain false notions.
verses.commentary: Sense: They indulged in insulting Siva and hence were cursed by the seven sages. Their views should not be heard because they explain false notions.

verses.sanskrit: मया वः श्रावितं ह्येतद् गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं परम् । ज्ञात्वा शिवप्रियान्भक्त्या भवतो गिरिशप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: mayā vaḥ śrāvitaṃ hyetad guhyād guhyataraṃ param | jñātvā śivapriyānbhaktyā bhavato giriśapriyam
verses.translation: There is no scope for inference that consists of the five syllogisms. On seeing smoke they say that there is fire too. But here, O sage, the world is the object of per¬ ception. Its cause and support, the great Atman Siva must be known directly. The universe in the form of male and female is directly perceived.

verses.transliteration: bhavadbhirapi dātavyametad guhyaṃ śivapriyam | yatibhyaḥ śāntacittebhyo bhaktebhyaḥ śivapādayoḥ
verses.translation: The physical body consists of six sheaths. The first three are born of the parts of the mother and the other three of the parts of the father. So says the.ruti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The physical body consists of six sheaths. The first three are born of the parts of the mother and the other three of the parts of the father. So says the.ruti.

verses.transliteration: etaduktvā mahābhāgaḥ sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ | tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena cacāra pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: The Sruti speaks of the Brahman as having the form of existence, knowledge and bliss. The word 'existence' is used in order to exclude the 'non-existent'.

verses.transliteration: etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ labdhvā sūtānmunīśvarāḥ | kāśyāmeva samāsīnā muktāḥ śivapadaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: The exclusion of the insentient is effected by the word sentient. Of course the word Git is used in all the three genders but it signifies here a male being. The word Cit in the feminine gender is a synonym of the word knowledge. If it is taken to mean 'Light', it is clear that it illuminates.

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । सूतोपदेशः । व्यास उवाच । गतेऽथ सूते मुनयः सुविस्मिता विचिन्त्य चान्योऽन्यमिदं तु विस्मृतम् । यद्वामदेवस्य मतं मुनीश्वर प्रसूचितं तत्खलु कष्टमद्य नः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā 6.10. daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | sūtopadeśaḥ | vyāsa uvāca | gate'tha sūte munayaḥ suvismitā vicintya cānyo'nyamidaṃ tu vismṛtam | yadvāmadevasya mataṃ munīśvara prasūcitaṃ tatkhalu kaṣṭamadya naḥ
verses.translation: At the instruction of the preceptor, the great mantra is Siva in the form of Sakti. Hence the great mantra is the individual soul too. The individual soul is in the form of Sakti and is a part of Siva. Due to the identity with Siva it attains equality with Siva. In the passage (of ihe Vedas) "Prajfianam Brahma" the meaning of "Prajfianam" is seen.

verses.sanskrit: कदानुभूयान्मुनिवर्यदर्शनं भवाब्धिदुःखौघहरं परं हि तत् । महेश्वराराधनपुण्यतोऽधुना मुनीश्वरः सत्वरमाविरस्तु नः

verses.sanskrit: कालभैरवनाथं च सम्पूज्याथ विधानतः । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पुनस्त्रेधा नत्वा च पञ्चधा

verses.translation: When these reaching the centre of the mind become the object of perception on the part of sense-organs the individual soul enters these, then knows and acts.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्थितेषु सर्वेषु नमस्कृत्य समन्त्रकम् । अथ प्राह मुनीन्द्राणां भाववृद्धिकरं वच
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sthiteṣu sarveṣu namaskṛtya samantrakam | atha prāha munīndrāṇāṃ bhāvavṛddhikaraṃ vaca
verses.translation: It is certain that the union of Siva and Sakti is the great-Atman From Paraakti is born the citsakti. Born of it is the power of bliss. The power of will is born of that. From this is born the power of knowledge and from this is born the power of activity, the fifth one. O sage, the Kalas— Nivrtti etc. are born of these Iraklis.
verses.wordMeaning: It is certain that the union of Siva and Sakti is the great-Atman From Paraakti is born the citsakti. Born of it is the power of bliss. The power of will is born of that. From this is born the power of knowledge and from this is born the power of activity, the fifth one.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is certain that the union of Siva and Sakti is the great-Atman From Paraakti is born the citsakti. Born of it is the power of bliss. The power of will is born of that. From this is born the power of knowledge and from this is born the power of activity, the fifth one.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । धन्या यूयं महाप्राज्ञा मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । भवदर्थमिह प्राप्तोऽहं तद्वृत्तमिदं शृणु
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | dhanyā yūyaṃ mahāprājñā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | bhavadarthamiha prāpto'haṃ tadvṛttamidaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Nada and Bindu are born of cit and Ananda Saktis. O sage, the letter 'ma' is born of Icchasakli. The fifth vowel *U' is born of Jnaiia Sakti and the letter 'A' is born of Kriyasakti. The origin of the Pranava has been mentioned thus. Now listen to the origin of the five Brahmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nada and Bindu are born of cit and Ananda Saktis. O sage, the letter 'ma' is born of Icchasakli. The fifth vowel *U' is born of Jnaiia Sakti and the letter 'A' is born of Kriyasakti. The origin of the Pranava has been mentioned thus. Now listen to the origin of the five Brahmans.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदाहमुपदिश्याथ भवतः प्रणवार्थकम् । गतस्तीर्थाटनार्थाय तद्वृत्तान्तं ब्रवीमि वः
verses.transliteration: yadāhamupadiśyātha bhavataḥ praṇavārthakam | gatastīrthāṭanārthāya tadvṛttāntaṃ bravīmi vaḥ
verses.translation: From these matras (of the pranava) are born the thirty eight Kalas, Santyatitakala is born of Isana; Santikala of Purusa; Vidyakala of Aghora; Pratistha and Nivrtti of Vamadeva and Sadyojata. There are five pairs such as Isana and cit-sakti etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: From these matras (of the pranava) are born the thirty eight Kalas, Santyatitakala is born of Isana; Santikala of Purusa; Vidyakala of Aghora; Pratistha and Nivrtti of Vamadeva and Sadyojata. There are five pairs such as Isana and cit-sakti etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इतो निर्गत्य सम्प्राप्य तीरं दक्षपयोनिधेः । स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य विधिवद्देवीं कन्यामयीं शिवाम् । पुनरागत्य विप्रेन्द्राः सुवर्णमुखरीतटम्
verses.transliteration: ito nirgatya samprāpya tīraṃ dakṣapayonidheḥ | snātvā sampūjya vidhivaddevīṃ kanyāmayīṃ śivām | punarāgatya viprendrāḥ suvarṇamukharītaṭam
verses.translation: O sage, the five elements beginning with the ether are born of this set of five letters of the Pranava which constitute pairs based on the relationship of the word and its meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the five elements beginning with the ether are born of this set of five letters of the Pranava which constitute pairs based on the relationship of the word and its meaning.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकालहस्तिशैलाख्यनगरे परमाद्भुते । सुवर्णमुखरीतोये स्नात्वा देवानृषीनपि
verses.transliteration: śrīkālahastiśailākhyanagare paramādbhute | suvarṇamukharītoye snātvā devānṛṣīnapi
verses.translation: Akasa has the only attribute of sound. The wind has the two: sound and touch. The fire has three: sound, touch and colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Akasa has the only attribute of sound. The wind has the two: sound and touch. The fire has three: sound, touch and colour.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सन्तर्प्य विधिवद्भक्त्या समुद्रं गिरिशं स्मरन् । समर्च्य कालहस्तीशं चन्द्रकान्तसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: santarpya vidhivadbhaktyā samudraṃ giriśaṃ smaran | samarcya kālahastīśaṃ candrakāntasamaprabham
verses.translation: The five Bhutas constitute the universe. Virat is the composite form of all. The universe is thus created.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five Bhutas constitute the universe. Virat is the composite form of all. The universe is thus created.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाभिमुखं पञ्चशिरसं परमाद्भुतम् । सकृद्दर्शनमात्रेण सर्वाघक्षयकारणम्
verses.transliteration: paścimābhimukhaṃ pañcaśirasaṃ paramādbhutam | sakṛddarśanamātreṇa sarvāghakṣayakāraṇam
verses.translation: It begins with the element of the earth and ends with the element of Siva. After merging with each other they merge in the individual soul ultimately.
verses.commentary: Sense: It begins with the element of the earth and ends with the element of Siva. After merging with each other they merge in the individual soul ultimately.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं भुक्तिमुक्तिदं त्रिगुणेश्वरम् । ततश्च परया भक्त्या तस्य दक्षिणगां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ triguṇeśvaram | tataśca parayā bhaktyā tasya dakṣiṇagāṃ śivām
verses.translation: Accompanied by the energy it comes out again for the purpose of creation. It appears in the form of the gross cosmos and functions till the period r)f dissolution.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by the energy it comes out again for the purpose of creation. It appears in the form of the gross cosmos and functions till the period r)f dissolution.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानप्रसूनकलिकां समर्च्य हि जगत्प्रसूम् । श्रीमत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यामष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: jñānaprasūnakalikāṃ samarcya hi jagatprasūm | śrīmatpañcākṣarīṃ vidyāmaṣṭottarasahasrakam
verses.translation: The primeval oozing of Siva who attempts to create the universe at his will is called Sivataitva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The primeval oozing of Siva who attempts to create the universe at his will is called Sivataitva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जप्त्वा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य स्तुत्वा नत्वा मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: japtvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya stutvā natvā muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: In view of its conformity with the atlivilies this alone becomes the principle of his power of will. Between the two laktis of knowledge and activity if the knowledge predominates, the principle is Sadasiva.
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of its conformity with the atlivilies this alone becomes the principle of his power of will. Between the two laktis of knowledge and activity if the knowledge predominates, the principle is Sadasiva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य गिरिं प्रत्यहमादरात् । आमोदतीव मनसि प्रत्यहं नियमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya giriṃ pratyahamādarāt | āmodatīva manasi pratyahaṃ niyamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, know that as Mahesvara Tattva when the activity is predominant. If there is equality between the two Saktis know that as the form ol pure knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, know that as Mahesvara Tattva when the activity is predominant. If there is equality between the two Saktis know that as the form ol pure knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनयन् चतुरो मासानेवं तत्र मुनीश्वराः । ज्ञानप्रसूनकलिकामहादेव्याः प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: anayan caturo māsānevaṃ tatra munīśvarāḥ | jñānaprasūnakalikāmahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ
verses.translation: After withdrawing his form of great glory with the intellect comprehending the dilfercncc between the illusion and reality among various emotions in the form of his own part when Siva becomes the recipient of ail objects through illusion, he is called Purusa, the creator, I'he Vedic text says "Taisr.stva" (after creating it).
verses.wordMeaning: After withdrawing his form of great glory with the intellect comprehending the dilfercncc between the illusion and reality among various emotions in the form of his own part when Siva becomes the recipient of ail objects through illusion, he is called Purusa, the creator,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After withdrawing his form of great glory with the intellect comprehending the dilfercncc between the illusion and reality among various emotions in the form of his own part when Siva becomes the recipient of ail objects through illusion, he is called Purusa, the creator,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकदा तु समास्तीर्य चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् । आसनं परमं तस्मिन् स्थित्वा रुद्धेन्द्रियो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: ekadā tu samāstīrya cailājinakuśottaram | āsanaṃ paramaṃ tasmin sthitvā ruddhendriyo muniḥ
verses.translation: As the magician so also the Yogin has no illusion. Siva is of perfect knowledge and this is revealed by the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the magician so also the Yogin has no illusion. Siva is of perfect knowledge and this is revealed by the preceptor.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समाधिमास्थाय सदा परमानन्दचिद्घनः । परिपूर्णः शिवोऽस्मीति निर्व्यग्रहृदयोऽभवम्
verses.transliteration: samādhimāsthāya sadā paramānandacidghanaḥ | paripūrṇaḥ śivo'smīti nirvyagrahṛdayo'bhavam
verses.translation: The five Saktis of Siva arc: activity, knowledge, completeness, elernality and pervasiveness. Even in their shrinking forms they shine always.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five Saktis of Siva arc: activity, knowledge, completeness, elernality and pervasiveness. Even in their shrinking forms they shine always.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव समये मद्गुरुः करुणानिधिः । नीलजीमूतसङ्काशो विद्युत्पिङ्गजटाधरः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva samaye madguruḥ karuṇānidhiḥ | nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśo vidyutpiṅgajaṭādharaḥ
verses.translation: There is a set of five Tattvas of the individual soul, viz, Kala, Vidya, Raga, Kala and Niyati. Kala is the cause of doing anything. Vidya is the means of certain Tattvas. Raga is the attachment to the sense-objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a set of five Tattvas of the individual soul, viz, Kala, Vidya, Raga, Kala and Niyati. Kala is the cause of doing anything. Vidya is the means of certain Tattvas. Raga is the attachment to the sense-objects.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रांशुः कमण्डलूदण्डकृष्णाजिनधरः स्वयम् । भस्मावदातसर्वाङ्गः सर्वलक्षणलक्षितः
verses.transliteration: prāṃśuḥ kamaṇḍalūdaṇḍakṛṣṇājinadharaḥ svayam | bhasmāvadātasarvāṅgaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: You have mentioned before* that the Purusa is placed beneath the Niyati and is above Prakrii. How is it that you say now that it shrinks in form throtigh Maya and
verses.commentary: Sense: You have mentioned before* that the Purusa is placed beneath the Niyati and is above Prakrii. How is it that you say now that it shrinks in form throtigh Maya and

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुण्ड्रविलसद्भालो रुद्राक्षालङ्कृताकृतिः । पद्मपत्रारुणायामविस्तीर्णनयनद्वयः
verses.transliteration: tripuṇḍravilasadbhālo rudrākṣālaṅkṛtākṛtiḥ | padmapatrāruṇāyāmavistīrṇanayanadvayaḥ
verses.translation: Kailasa S. 13 31-
verses.commentary: Sense: Kailasa S. 13 31-
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूय हृदम्भोजे तदानीमेव सत्वरम् । विमोहितस्तदैवासमेतदद् भुतमास्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: prādurbhūya hṛdambhoje tadānīmeva satvaram | vimohitastadaivāsametadad bhutamāstikāḥ
verses.translation: The omniscient, omnipotent, Siva, the Nirguna lord of all, the progenitor of the three deities, the Brahman, is formed of existence-knowledge-bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: The omniscient, omnipotent, Siva, the Nirguna lord of all, the progenitor of the three deities, the Brahman, is formed of existence-knowledge-bliss.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत उन्मील्य नयने विलापं कृतवानहम् । आसीन्ममाश्रुपातश्च गिरिनिर्झरसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: tata unmīlya nayane vilāpaṃ kṛtavānaham | āsīnmamāśrupātaśca girinirjharasannibhaḥ
verses.translation: That lord Siva himself, out of his own will, through his own Maya appears shrinking in size and be¬ comes Puru§a.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord Siva himself, out of his own will, through his own Maya appears shrinking in size and be¬ comes Puru§a.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव समये श्रुता वागशरीरिणी । व्योम्नो महाद्भुता विप्रास्तामेव शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: etasminneva samaye śrutā vāgaśarīriṇī | vyomno mahādbhutā viprāstāmeva śṛṇutādarāt
verses.translation: The presence in two places of the Purusa is not incompatible. He is the composite of Jflana etc. of both shrinking and intrinsic forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: The presence in two places of the Purusa is not incompatible. He is the composite of Jflana etc. of both shrinking and intrinsic forms.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूतपुत्र महाभाग गच्छ वाराणसीं पुरीम् । तत्रासन्मुनयः पूर्वमुपदिष्टास्त्वयाधुना
verses.transliteration: sūtaputra mahābhāga gaccha vārāṇasīṃ purīm | tatrāsanmunayaḥ pūrvamupadiṣṭāstvayādhunā
verses.translation: The principle of the mind Prakrti consists of Buddhi, Manas and Ahamkara achievable through the Gunas Sattva etc. The Gunas are born of the Prakrti, the Sattvaic from Sattva and so on. From the Gunas the intellect takes its origin. It is the cause of decisiveness in the objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: The principle of the mind Prakrti consists of Buddhi, Manas and Ahamkara achievable through the Gunas Sattva etc. The Gunas are born of the Prakrti, the Sattvaic from Sattva and so on. From the Gunas the intellect takes its origin. It is the cause of decisiveness in the objects.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वदुपागमकल्याणं काङ्क्षन्ते विवशा भृशम् । तिष्ठन्ति ते निराहारा इत्युक्त्वा विरराम सा
verses.transliteration: tvadupāgamakalyāṇaṃ kāṅkṣante vivaśā bhṛśam | tiṣṭhanti te nirāhārā ityuktvā virarāma sā
verses.translation: From Buddhi the principle of intellect is born and from it ego. From the ego the sense-organs of know¬ ledge. The mind has two aspects — thought and doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Buddhi the principle of intellect is born and from it ego. From the ego the sense-organs of know¬ ledge. The mind has two aspects — thought and doubt.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय तरसा देवं देवीं च भक्तितः । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पुनः प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: tata utthāya tarasā devaṃ devīṃ ca bhaktitaḥ | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya punaḥ praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat
verses.translation: The sense-organs are ears, skin, eyes, tongue and nose and the qualities particularly sensed through those organs are sound, touch, colour, taste and smell. The Tanmatras are born from the Vaikarika Aharhkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sense-organs are ears, skin, eyes, tongue and nose and the qualities particularly sensed through those organs are sound, touch, colour, taste and smell. The Tanmatras are born from the Vaikarika Aharhkara.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विषड्वारं गुरोराज्ञां विज्ञाय शिवयोरथ । क्षेत्रान्निर्गत्य तरसा चत्वारिंशद्दिनान्तरे
verses.transliteration: dviṣaḍvāraṃ gurorājñāṃ vijñāya śivayoratha | kṣetrānnirgatya tarasā catvāriṃśaddināntare
verses.translation: They are called subtle principles by the sages. Now understand the organs of activity and their functions.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are called subtle principles by the sages. Now understand the organs of activity and their functions.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आगतोऽस्मि मुनिश्रेष्ठा अनुगृह्णन्तु मामिह । मया किमद्य वक्तव्यं भवन्तस्तद् ब्रुवन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: āgato'smi muniśreṣṭhā anugṛhṇantu māmiha | mayā kimadya vaktavyaṃ bhavantastad bruvantu me
verses.translation: O sage, they are the organs of speech, hand, feet, anus, penis and the vaginal passage. Their functions are speaking, handling, moving, evacuation and the sexual pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, they are the organs of speech, hand, feet, anus, penis and the vaginal passage. Their functions are speaking, handling, moving, evacuation and the sexual pleasure.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति सूतवचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयो हृष्टमानसाः । अवोचन्मुनिशार्दूलं व्यासं नत्वा मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: iti sūtavacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ | avocanmuniśārdūlaṃ vyāsaṃ natvā muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: From them arc born in order the ether, wind, fire, water and the earth, O sage, they are known as the five elements.
verses.commentary: Sense: From them arc born in order the ether, wind, fire, water and the earth, O sage, they are known as the five elements.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ६.११ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 6.11 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O intelligent sage, listen with respect and attention. O sage, in accordance with the Vedic text "Tasmad Vai Etasmad" etc. it is certain that the five Bhutas are born of the Kalas. They are in the form of the gross cosmos. This explains the body of the lord ol Bhutas (Siva). In the order of the coming up of the Tattvas from Siva Tattva to the principle of the earth, O sage, they shall be mentioned as originating from the subtle elements in order.
verses.wordMeaning: O intelligent sage, listen with respect and attention. O sage, in accordance with the Vedic text "Tasmad Vai Etasmad" etc. it is certain that the five Bhutas are born of the Kalas. They are in the form of the gross cosmos. This explains the body of the lord ol Bhutas (Siva).…
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent sage, listen with respect and attention. verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ

This explains the body of the lord ol Bhutas (Siva). In the order of the coming up of the Tattvas from Siva Tattva to the principle of the earth, O sage, they shall be mentioned as originating from the subtle elements in order.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ६.११. एकादशोऽयायः । वामदेवब्रह्मवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ सूत सूत महाभागः त्वमस्मद्गुरुरुत्तमः । अतस्त्वां परिपृच्छामो भवतोऽनुग्रहो यदि
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 6.11. ekādaśo'yāyaḥ | vāmadevabrahmavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || sūta sūta mahābhāgaḥ tvamasmadgururuttamaḥ | atastvāṃ paripṛcchāmo bhavato'nugraho yadi
verses.translation: There shall be identity between the subtle ele¬ ments and the Kalis as causes of the Bhutas. O excellent amAng those who know (he Brahman, know that there is no mutual antagonum here.
verses.commentary: Sense: There shall be identity between the subtle ele¬ ments and the Kalis as causes of the Bhutas. O excellent amAng those who know (he Brahman, know that there is no mutual antagonum here.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धालुषु च शिष्येषु त्वादृशा गुरवः सदा । स्निग्धभावा इतीदं नो दर्शितं भवताधुना
verses.transliteration: śraddhāluṣu ca śiṣyeṣu tvādṛśā guravaḥ sadā | snigdhabhāvā itīdaṃ no darśitaṃ bhavatādhunā
verses.translation: The eight principal mountains arc and 'TTfdrr I
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight principal mountains arc and 'TTfdrr I
