verses.sanskrit: विरजाहोमसमये वामदेवमतं पुरा । सूचितं भवतास्माभिर्न श्रुतं विस्तरान्मुने
verses.transliteration: virajāhomasamaye vāmadevamataṃ purā | sūcitaṃ bhavatāsmābhirna śrutaṃ vistarānmune
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Karttikeya, that quell dualism and produce non-dualistic knowledge the sage be¬ came delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Karttikeya, that quell dualism and produce non-dualistic knowledge the sage be¬ came delighted.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदिदानीं श्रोतुकामाः श्रद्धया परमादरात् । वयं सर्वे कृपासिन्धो प्रीत्या तद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tadidānīṃ śrotukāmāḥ śraddhayā paramādarāt | vayaṃ sarve kṛpāsindho prītyā tadvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: He shall worship it with scents and flowers and show lights and incense. He shall then cover up the conch with Astra and Varma mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship it with scents and flowers and show lights and incense. He shall then cover up the conch with Astra and Varma mantras.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा सूतो हृष्टतनूरुहः । नमस्कृत्य महादेवं गुरोः परतरं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sūto hṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ | namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ guroḥ parataraṃ gurum
verses.translation: The preceptor shall then cover the vessel on the top with the Darbha grass. He shall then make a square to the northeast of the Mandala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall then cover the vessel on the top with the Darbha grass. He shall then make a square to the northeast of the Mandala.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महादेवीं त्रिजननीं गुरुं व्यासं च भक्तितः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा मुनीनाह्लादयन्निदम्
verses.transliteration: mahādevīṃ trijananīṃ guruṃ vyāsaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ | prāha gambhīrayā vācā munīnāhlādayannidam
verses.translation: The precep or shall be seated with the disciple facing the cast and desirous of spiritual knowledge. The preceptor shall tell him — "Be pure in soul."
verses.commentary: Sense: The precep or shall be seated with the disciple facing the cast and desirous of spiritual knowledge. The preceptor shall tell him — "Be pure in soul."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा रथन्तरे कल्पे वामदेवो महामुनिः । गर्भमुक्तः शिवज्ञानविदां गुरुतमः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: purā rathantare kalpe vāmadevo mahāmuniḥ | garbhamuktaḥ śivajñānavidāṃ gurutamaḥ svayam
verses.translation: He shall sit steady in a trance for a short while thinking "I am the preceptor — Siva. He shall open his eyes with the mind favourably disposed towards him and without xcitement glance at the pupil who is sitting with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall sit steady in a trance for a short while thinking "I am the preceptor — Siva. He shall open his eyes with the mind favourably disposed towards him and without xcitement glance at the pupil who is sitting with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं मुकुटादिविभूषितम् । शक्तिरत्नद्वयोपास्यं शक्तिकुक्कुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ mukuṭādivibhūṣitam | śaktiratnadvayopāsyaṃ śaktikukkuṭadhāriṇam
verses.translation: With his hand smeared with the ashes he shall touch the head of the pupil and instruct in his right ear clearly "Hamsah Soham.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: With his hand smeared with the ashes he shall touch the head of the pupil and instruct in his right ear clearly "Hamsah Soham.*'
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशायतनेत्राय द्वादशोद्यतबाहवे । द्वादशायुधधाराय द्वादशात्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: dvādaśāyatanetrāya dvādaśodyatabāhave | dvādaśāyudhadhārāya dvādaśātmannamo'stu te
verses.translation: "The first Ham means Sakti-Soul. Sail means Siva. I am he alone." Thus he shall reveal the meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The first Ham means Sakti-Soul. Sail means Siva. I am he alone." Thus he shall reveal the meaning.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुने त्वं योगिनां मुख्यः परिपूर्णश्च निःस्पृहः । भवादृशां हि लोकेस्मिप्रार्थनीयं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: mune tvaṃ yogināṃ mukhyaḥ paripūrṇaśca niḥspṛhaḥ | bhavādṛśāṃ hi lokesmiprārthanīyaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: After instructing him in the meaning of 'Yah Anu* he shall express clearly the meaning and purport of the statements in the middle. He shall tell him clearly, "O Brahmin, I shall tell you the statements. Listen and retain them in your mind."
verses.commentary: Sense: After instructing him in the meaning of 'Yah Anu* he shall express clearly the meaning and purport of the statements in the middle. He shall tell him clearly, "O Brahmin, I shall tell you the statements. Listen and retain them in your mind."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवसेनापते तुभ्यं देवानाम्पतये नमः । नमो यतीनां पतये परिपूर्णाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: devasenāpate tubhyaṃ devānāmpataye namaḥ | namo yatīnāṃ pataye paripūrṇāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: The meaning of the statement — "Perfect knowledge is Brahman" has already been made known. Paramesvara the Sakti-soul is the meaning of the word Aham.
verses.commentary: Sense: The meaning of the statement — "Perfect knowledge is Brahman" has already been made known. Paramesvara the Sakti-soul is the meaning of the word Aham.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स्वस्त्यस्तु मुनयः सर्वे सुखिनः सन्तु सर्वदा । शिवभक्ताः स्थिरात्मानः शिवभक्तिप्रवर्तकाः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | svastyastu munayaḥ sarve sukhinaḥ santu sarvadā | śivabhaktāḥ sthirātmānaḥ śivabhaktipravartakāḥ
verses.translation: 'A' is the foremost among all letters. It is the greatest splendour 'Siva'. The letter Ha is of the form of firmament. It is glorified as the akti-soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'A' is the foremost among all letters. It is the greatest splendour 'Siva'. The letter Ha is of the form of firmament. It is glorified as the akti-soul.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदतीव विचित्रं हि श्रुतं गुरुमुखाम्बुजात् । इतः पूर्वं मया नोक्तं गुह्यप्राकट्यशङ्कया
verses.transliteration: tadatīva vicitraṃ hi śrutaṃ gurumukhāmbujāt | itaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā noktaṃ guhyaprākaṭyaśaṅkayā
verses.translation: That has been taught before. The devotee shall meditate "I am he" "That you arc;" in this the meaning of "That" has already been explained.
verses.commentary: Sense: That has been taught before. The devotee shall meditate "I am he" "That you arc;" in this the meaning of "That" has already been explained.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यूयं खलु महाभागाः शिवभक्ता दृढव्रताः । इति निश्चित्य युष्माकं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां मुदा
verses.transliteration: yūyaṃ khalu mahābhāgāḥ śivabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ | iti niścitya yuṣmākaṃ vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ mudā
verses.translation: Otherwise there is a likelihood of opposite con¬ ception in "I am he" whereas the word "I" is in the mascu¬ line, the word "That" is in the neuter. Hence due to the in¬ compatibility they cannot be interpreted together. The cause of the universe, of male and female forms, cannot be otherwise. The concept of the meaning of the instruction is: "Thou art that."
verses.wordMeaning: Otherwise there is a likelihood of opposite con¬ ception in "I am he" whereas the word "I" is in the mascu¬ line, the word "That" is in the neuter. Hence due to the in¬ compatibility they cannot be interpreted together. The cause of the universe, of male and female forms,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Otherwise there is a likelihood of opposite con¬ ception in "I am he" whereas the word "I" is in the mascu¬ line, the word "That" is in the neuter. Hence due to the in¬ compatibility they cannot be interpreted together. The cause of the universe, of male and female forms,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदागमपुराणादिसर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्ववित् । देवासुरमनुष्यादिजीवानां जन्मकर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: vedāgamapurāṇādisarvaśāstrārthatattvavit | devāsuramanuṣyādijīvānāṃ janmakarmavit
verses.translation: In the cosmos both subtle and gross are bom the planets: moon, sun stars, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the cosmos both subtle and gross are bom the planets: moon, sun stars, etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भस्मावदातसर्वाङ्गो जटामण्डलमण्डितः । निराश्रयो निःस्पृहश्च निर्द्वन्द्वो निरहङ्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: bhasmāvadātasarvāṅgo jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | nirāśrayo niḥspṛhaśca nirdvandvo nirahaṅkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The deities Brahma, Vifhu, Mahe and others, the various living beings, Indra and other guardians of the quarters, gods, Pitfs Asuras, Rakfasas, human and other mobile beings, beasts, birds, worms, serpents, trees, hedges, creepers and herbs, the eight mountains,*** the seven rivers*** GaAgi and others, the oceans of great prosperity whatever object is there in the world all are established here.
verses.wordMeaning: The deities Brahma, Vifhu, Mahe and others, the various living beings, Indra and other guardians of the quarters, gods, Pitfs Asuras, Rakfasas, human and other mobile beings, beasts, birds, worms, serpents, trees, hedges, creepers and herbs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities Brahma, Vifhu, Mahe and others, the various living beings, Indra and other guardians of the quarters, gods, Pitfs Asuras, Rakfasas, human and other mobile beings, beasts, birds, worms, serpents, trees, hedges, creepers and herbs,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिगम्बरो महाज्ञानी महेश्वर इवापरः । शिष्यभूतैर्मुनीन्द्रैश्च तादृशैः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: digambaro mahājñānī maheśvara ivāparaḥ | śiṣyabhūtairmunīndraiśca tādṛśaiḥ parivāritaḥ
verses.translation: This universe of the form of female and male, of the form of iSiva and Sakti shall deserve attention of learned men like you, experts in the Saiva knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: This universe of the form of female and male, of the form of iSiva and Sakti shall deserve attention of learned men like you, experts in the Saiva knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पर्यटन्पृथिवीमेतां स्वपादस्पर्शपुण्यतः । पवित्रयन्परे धाम्नि निमग्नहृदयोऽन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: paryaṭanpṛthivīmetāṃ svapādasparśapuṇyataḥ | pavitrayanpare dhāmni nimagnahṛdayo'nvaham
verses.translation: O sage, the Sruti says "Think that everything is Brahman, everything is Rudra." Thus Sadaiva is the Atman of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the Sruti says "Think that everything is Brahman, everything is Rudra." Thus Sadaiva is the Atman of the universe.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुमारशिखरं मेरोर्दक्षिणं प्राविशन्मुदा । यत्रास्ते भगवानीशतनयः शिखिवाहनः
verses.transliteration: kumāraśikharaṃ merordakṣiṇaṃ prāviśanmudā | yatrāste bhagavānīśatanayaḥ śikhivāhanaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the concept of thirty eight Kalas the concept of duality is ever present but he who has purified the Atman by the concept "I am Sadaiva" becomes the preceptor Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the concept of thirty eight Kalas the concept of duality is ever present but he who has purified the Atman by the concept "I am Sadaiva" becomes the preceptor Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानशक्तिधरो वीरः सर्वासुरविमर्दनः । गजावल्लीसमायुक्तः सर्वैर्देवैर्नमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: jñānaśaktidharo vīraḥ sarvāsuravimardanaḥ | gajāvallīsamāyuktaḥ sarvairdevairnamaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Such a disciple becomes the preceptor Siva himself. He attains the form of the Yantra, mantra and the cosmic deity itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such a disciple becomes the preceptor Siva himself. He attains the form of the Yantra, mantra and the cosmic deity itself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्कन्दसरो नाम सरः सागरसन्निभम् । शिशिरस्वादुपानीयं स्वच्छागाधबहूदकम्
verses.transliteration: tatra skandasaro nāma saraḥ sāgarasannibham | śiśirasvādupānīyaṃ svacchāgādhabahūdakam
verses.translation: O Brahmin, the disciple whose bondage is severed due to the favour of the preceptor and who is engaged in Siva's worship becomes a lofty soul indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmin, the disciple whose bondage is severed due to the favour of the preceptor and who is engaged in Siva's worship becomes a lofty soul indeed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाश्चर्यगुणोपेतं विद्यते स्वामिसन्निधौ । तत्र स्नात्वा वामदेवः सहशिष्यैर्महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: sarvāścaryaguṇopetaṃ vidyate svāmisannidhau | tatra snātvā vāmadevaḥ sahaśiṣyairmahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: They say that whatever exists whether a composite unit or an analysed piece is the meaning of the Pranava in view of the predominence of the Guas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that whatever exists whether a composite unit or an analysed piece is the meaning of the Pranava in view of the predominence of the Guas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुमारं शिखरासीनं मुनिवृन्दनिषेवितम् । उद्यदादित्यसङ्काशं मयूरवरवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: kumāraṃ śikharāsīnaṃ munivṛndaniṣevitam | udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ mayūravaravāhanam
verses.translation: Out of affection I have expiated the non-dualis-
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of affection I have expiated the non-dualis-
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वरदाभयहस्तं च दृष्ट्वा स्कन्दं मुनीश्वरः । सम्पूज्य परया भक्त्या स्तोतुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: varadābhayahastaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ munīśvaraḥ | sampūjya parayā bhaktyā stotuṃ samupacakrame
verses.translation: If anyone whether a god or a human being, Siddha or Gandharva, out of arrogance considers this statement otherwise, I shall cut off his head evenly with my good trident which is like a black fire to the enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone whether a god or a human being, Siddha or Gandharva, out of arrogance considers this statement otherwise, I shall cut off his head evenly with my good trident which is like a black fire to the enemies.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव उवाच । ॐ नमः प्रणवार्थाय प्रणवार्थविधायिने । प्रणवाक्षरबीजाय प्रण वाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: vāmadeva uvāca | oṃ namaḥ praṇavārthāya praṇavārthavidhāyine | praṇavākṣarabījāya praṇa vāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, you yourself are the most excellent of tnose who know the non-dualistic nature of Siva. You are the guide for good behaviour on the occasion of the instruction of Saivite knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, you yourself are the most excellent of tnose who know the non-dualistic nature of Siva. You are the guide for good behaviour on the occasion of the instruction of Saivite knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तार्थस्वरूपाय वेदान्तार्थविधायिने । वेदान्तार्थविदे नित्यं विदिताय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: vedāntārthasvarūpāya vedāntārthavidhāyine | vedāntārthavide nityaṃ viditāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: An impious ghost got his sins removed by the contact with the ashes on your body. By your grace he attained the supreme goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: An impious ghost got his sins removed by the contact with the ashes on your body. By your grace he attained the supreme goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमो गुहाय भूतानां गुहासु निहिताय च । गुह्याय गुह्यरूपाय गुह्यागमविदे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo guhāya bhūtānāṃ guhāsu nihitāya ca | guhyāya guhyarūpāya guhyāgamavide namaḥ
verses.translation: You are a Siva yogin, an asset to the three worlds. At your benign glance even the individual soul becomes the supreme soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are a Siva yogin, an asset to the three worlds. At your benign glance even the individual soul becomes the supreme soul.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अणोरणीयसे तुभ्यं महतोऽपि महीयसे । नमः परावरज्ञाय परमात्मस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: aṇoraṇīyase tubhyaṃ mahato'pi mahīyase | namaḥ parāvarajñāya paramātmasvarūpiṇe
verses.translation: This great secret is founded in you. You too, abide by the Pranavas alone with respect, faith and devotion and unite them with ParameSvara helping people grasp Saivite conduct including Bhasma and Rudraksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: This great secret is founded in you. You too, abide by the Pranavas alone with respect, faith and devotion and unite them with ParameSvara helping people grasp Saivite conduct including Bhasma and Rudraksa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दाय स्कन्दरूपाय मिहिरारुणतेजसे । नमो मन्दारमालोद्यन्मुकुटादिभृते सदा
verses.transliteration: skandāya skandarūpāya mihirāruṇatejase | namo mandāramālodyanmukuṭādibhṛte sadā
verses.translation: You are iSiva indeed. You follow Saivite conduct and have understood the concept of non-dualism Wandering about for the welfare of the world you will attain an everlasting happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are iSiva indeed. You follow Saivite conduct and have understood the concept of non-dualism Wandering about for the welfare of the world you will attain an everlasting happiness.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवशिष्याय पुत्राय शिवस्य शिवदायिने । शिवप्रियाय शिवयोरानन्दनिधये नमः
verses.transliteration: śivaśiṣyāya putrāya śivasya śivadāyine | śivapriyāya śivayorānandanidhaye namaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing this wonderful cult of Vedanta, explained by Karttikeya the sage became very humble. He bowed many times and prostrated before him. He behaved like a bee hovering round his lotus-like feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing this wonderful cult of Vedanta, explained by Karttikeya the sage became very humble. He bowed many times and prostrated before him. He behaved like a bee hovering round his lotus-like feet.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गाङ्गेयाय नमस्तुभ्यं कार्तिकेयाय धीमते । उमापुत्राय महते शरकाननशायिने
verses.transliteration: gāṅgeyāya namastubhyaṃ kārtikeyāya dhīmate | umāputrāya mahate śarakānanaśāyine
verses.translation: On hearing these words, pregnant with love, of the sages, the delighted Suta, the scholar whose mind is attached to Siva, spoke to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words, pregnant with love, of the sages, the delighted Suta, the scholar whose mind is attached to Siva, spoke to them.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षडक्षरशरीराय षड्विधार्थविधायिने । षडध्वातीतरूपाय षण्मुखाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍakṣaraśarīrāya ṣaḍvidhārthavidhāyine | ṣaḍadhvātītarūpāya ṣaṇmukhāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: You are all blessed. You are the devotees of lord Siva You help all the worlds, O sages, you hear further their conversation.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are all blessed. You are the devotees of lord Siva You help all the worlds, O sages, you hear further their conversation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजाय शान्ताय शक्तिकुक्कुटधारिणे । वरदाभयहस्ताय नमोऽसुरविदारिणे
verses.transliteration: caturbhujāya śāntāya śaktikukkuṭadhāriṇe | varadābhayahastāya namo'suravidāriṇe
verses.translation: After bowing to Karttikeya, son of Siva and eulogising him in various ways the great sage asked him again regarding the principles, with great humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to Karttikeya, son of Siva and eulogising him in various ways the great sage asked him again regarding the principles, with great humility.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गजावल्लीकुचालिप्तकुङ्कुमाङ्कितवक्षसे । नमो गजाननानन्दमहिमानन्दितात्मने
verses.transliteration: gajāvallīkucāliptakuṅkumāṅkitavakṣase | namo gajānanānandamahimānanditātmane
verses.translation: O lord Karttikeya, O ocean of nectar, O knower of all principles, how can the ascetics ot purified souls attain the position of a preceptor?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Karttikeya, O ocean of nectar, O knower of all principles, how can the ascetics ot purified souls attain the position of a preceptor?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिदेवमुनिकिन्नरगीयमान-गाथाविशेषशुचिचिन्तितकीर्त्तिधाम्ने । वृन्दारकामलकिरीटविभूषणस्रक्-पूज्याभिरामपदपङ्कज ते नमोऽस्तु
verses.transliteration: brahmādidevamunikinnaragīyamāna-gāthāviśeṣaśucicintitakīrttidhāmne | vṛndārakāmalakirīṭavibhūṣaṇasrak-pūjyābhirāmapadapaṅkaja te namo'stu
verses.translation: They cannot have the authority to instruct with¬ out a tradition following which the individual souls attain worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They cannot have the authority to instruct with¬ out a tradition following which the individual souls attain worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति स्कन्दस्तवं दिव्यं वामदेवेन भाषितम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: iti skandastavaṃ divyaṃ vāmadevena bhāṣitam | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vamadeva Karttikeya began to explain after thinking upon Siva and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vamadeva Karttikeya began to explain after thinking upon Siva and Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वया त्वविदितं किञ्चिन्नास्ति लोकेषु कुत्रचित् । तथापि तव वक्ष्यामि लोकानुग्रहकारिणः
verses.transliteration: tvayā tvaviditaṃ kiñcinnāsti lokeṣu kutracit | tathāpi tava vakṣyāmi lokānugrahakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: He shall then take the conch with the pedestal and purify it with Bhasma and the Astra mantra. He shall put it before the disciple on the square and worship it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then take the conch with the pedestal and purify it with Bhasma and the Astra mantra. He shall put it before the disciple on the square and worship it.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकेऽस्मिन्पशवः सर्वे नानाशास्त्रविमोहिताः । वञ्चिताः परमेशस्य माययातिविचित्रया
verses.transliteration: loke'sminpaśavaḥ sarve nānāśāstravimohitāḥ | vañcitāḥ parameśasya māyayātivicitrayā
verses.translation: When the disciple has finished the customary obeisance he shall stand humbly and silently like a well be¬ haved disciple. The preceptor shall tell him like this.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the disciple has finished the customary obeisance he shall stand humbly and silently like a well be¬ haved disciple. The preceptor shall tell him like this.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न जानति परं साक्षात्प्रणवार्थं महेश्वरम् । सगुणं निर्गुणं ब्रह्म त्रिदेवजनकं परम्
verses.transliteration: na jānati paraṃ sākṣātpraṇavārthaṃ maheśvaram | saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma tridevajanakaṃ param
verses.translation: After that he shall wash the cloth, the razor etc. with water and clay. The barber also shall be given clay and asked to wash his hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: After that he shall wash the cloth, the razor etc. with water and clay. The barber also shall be given clay and asked to wash his hands.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणं बाहुमुद्धृत्य शपथं प्रब्रवीमि ते । सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं सत्यं सत्यं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumuddhṛtya śapathaṃ prabravīmi te | satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: He shall sprinkle water over it repeating Om seven times. * He shall apply the clay on the palms once in the beginning and thrice afterwards. Then he shall glance at the holy disc of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall sprinkle water over it repeating Om seven times. * He shall apply the clay on the palms once in the beginning and thrice afterwards. Then he shall glance at the holy disc of the sun.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवार्थः शिवः साक्षात्प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तितः । श्रुतिषु स्मृतिशास्त्रेषु पुराणेष्वागमेषु च
verses.transliteration: praṇavārthaḥ śivaḥ sākṣātprādhānyena prakīrtitaḥ | śrutiṣu smṛtiśāstreṣu purāṇeṣvāgameṣu ca
verses.translation: After paying obeisance to Mahesvara, the precep¬ tors, holy centres and others he shall perform the midday rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: After paying obeisance to Mahesvara, the precep¬ tors, holy centres and others he shall perform the midday rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य भासा विभातीदं जगत्सर्वं समन्ततः । सर्वैश्वर्येण सम्पन्नो नाम्ना सर्वेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yasya bhāsā vibhātīdaṃ jagatsarvaṃ samantataḥ | sarvaiśvaryeṇa sampanno nāmnā sarveśvaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: O sage, with great devotion he shall worship $iva accompanied b/ Siva and the bestower of perfect knowledge, the protector of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, with great devotion he shall worship $iva accompanied b/ Siva and the bestower of perfect knowledge, the protector of the three worlds.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रादिषड्विधार्थानामर्थोपन्यासमार्गतः । सा - मा समष्टिव्यष्टिभावार्थं वक्ष्यामि प्रणवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: mantrādiṣaḍvidhārthānāmarthopanyāsamārgataḥ | sā - mā samaṣṭivyaṣṭibhāvārthaṃ vakṣyāmi praṇavātmakam
verses.translation: With steady mind, abiding by his virtuous duties and pure in body, he shall go to good brahmin householders for alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: With steady mind, abiding by his virtuous duties and pure in body, he shall go to good brahmin householders for alms.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा हि साक्षाच्छिवैक्येन जीवन्मुक्तिफलप्रदा । सर्वोत्तमा हि विज्ञेया निर्विकारा यतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: sā hi sākṣācchivaikyena jīvanmuktiphalapradā | sarvottamā hi vijñeyā nirvikārā yatātmanām
verses.translation: He shall divide the alms into five parts and do with them as proper. He shall avoid defiled food.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall divide the alms into five parts and do with them as proper. He shall avoid defiled food.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुरादीन्द्रियग्रामो भूतग्रामश्चतुर्विधः । पितृश्राद्धे पिता तस्य पिता तस्य पिता त्रयः
verses.transliteration: cakṣurādīndriyagrāmo bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ | pitṛśrāddhe pitā tasya pitā tasya pitā trayaḥ
verses.translation: A mendicant shall perform four activities: Purifi¬ catory rites, ablution, begging for alms and resorting to isolated places for meditation. He has no fifth rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mendicant shall perform four activities: Purifi¬ catory rites, ablution, begging for alms and resorting to isolated places for meditation. He has no fifth rite.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृश्याप उत्थाय वरणक्रममारभेत् । पवित्रपाणिः संस्पृश्य पाणी ब्राह्मणयोर्वदेत्
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśyāpa utthāya varaṇakramamārabhet | pavitrapāṇiḥ saṃspṛśya pāṇī brāhmaṇayorvadet
verses.translation: He shall use only four types of begging bowls, that made of dried gourd, or of bamboo, or of wood or of clay. He shall not take any other type of bowl.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall use only four types of begging bowls, that made of dried gourd, or of bamboo, or of wood or of clay. He shall not take any other type of bowl.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः शुद्धकदल्यादिपात्रेषु क्षालितेषु च । अन्नादिभोज्यद्रव्याणि दत्त्वा दर्भैः पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śuddhakadalyādipātreṣu kṣāliteṣu ca | annādibhojyadravyāṇi dattvā darbhaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Six things are forbidden to the ascetics: chewing the betel, using the metallic vessel, emission of semen, white cloth, sleeping during the day and taking meal at night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Six things are forbidden to the ascetics: chewing the betel, using the metallic vessel, emission of semen, white cloth, sleeping during the day and taking meal at night.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षालिताङ्घ्रिराचम्य पिण्डस्थानं व्रजेत्ततः । आसीनः प्राङ्मुखो मौनी प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālitāṅghrirācamya piṇḍasthānaṃ vrajettataḥ | āsīnaḥ prāṅmukho maunī prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret
verses.translation: If they observe the rules they are wise. If they do not they are Raksasas. The ascetic shall never indulge in activities contrary to the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: If they observe the rules they are wise. If they do not they are Raksasas. The ascetic shall never indulge in activities contrary to the rules.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्येद्युः प्रातरुत्थाय कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधीः । उपोष्य क्षौरकर्मादि कक्षोपस्थविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: anyedyuḥ prātarutthāya kṛtanityakriyaḥ sudhīḥ | upoṣya kṣaurakarmādi kakṣopasthavivarjitam
verses.translation: He shall perform the post-shaving ablution assi¬ duously for purity, remembering mentally the supreme Brahman Sada§iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the post-shaving ablution assi¬ duously for purity, remembering mentally the supreme Brahman Sada§iva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आयाहि वीतये शन्नो देवीरभिष्टये । पश्चात्प्रोच्य मयरसतजभनलगैः सह
verses.transliteration: agna āyāhi vītaye śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye | paścātprocya mayarasatajabhanalagaiḥ saha
verses.translation: O sage, thus out of aflfection for you, the rites of post-shaving ablution I have explained to you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, thus out of aflfection for you, the rites of post-shaving ablution I have explained to you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह । आनन्दं यस्य वै विद्वान्न बिभेति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha | ānandaṃ yasya vai vidvānna bibheti kutaścana
verses.translation: The deities employed in activities divide the sphere beginning with the earth into five in the order of fire etc. They then take the ascetic to Sadaiiva's region. Having led him to the honoured feet of the lord, the deities of blessing stand behind the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities employed in activities divide the sphere beginning with the earth into five in the order of fire etc. They then take the ascetic to Sadaiiva's region. Having led him to the honoured feet of the lord, the deities of blessing stand behind the lord.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्माज्जगदिदं सर्वं विधिविष्ण्विन्द्रपूर्वकम् । सह भूतेन्द्रियग्रामैः प्रथमं सम्प्रसूयते
verses.transliteration: yasmājjagadidaṃ sarvaṃ vidhiviṣṇvindrapūrvakam | saha bhūtendriyagrāmaiḥ prathamaṃ samprasūyate
verses.translation: He shall be bathed with water and worshipped with flowers etc. repeating the mantras of Srirudra, Camaka and Rudrasukta in order. The conch shall be placed before him and he shall be sprinkled with the water there¬ in. A flower shall be placed on the head and his body shall be wiped repeating the Pranava. *
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be bathed with water and worshipped with flowers etc. repeating the mantras of Srirudra, Camaka and Rudrasukta in order. The conch shall be placed before him and he shall be sprinkled with the water there¬ in.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be bathed with water and worshipped with flowers etc. repeating the mantras of Srirudra, Camaka and Rudrasukta in order. The conch shall be placed before him and he shall be sprinkled with the water there¬ in.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न सम्प्रसूयते यो वै कुतश्चन कदाचन । यस्मिन्न भासते विद्युन्न च सूर्यो न चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration: na samprasūyate yo vai kutaścana kadācana | yasminna bhāsate vidyunna ca sūryo na candramāḥ
verses.translation: The skull shall be split with a coconut repeating the four mantras beginning with "Ma no Mahantam'" etc. Then the ditch shall be filled.
verses.commentary: Sense: The skull shall be split with a coconut repeating the four mantras beginning with "Ma no Mahantam'" etc. Then the ditch shall be filled.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो वै मुमुक्षुभिर्ध्येयः शम्भुराकाशमध्यगः । सर्वव्यापी प्रकाशात्मा भासरूपो हि चिन्मयः
verses.transliteration: yo vai mumukṣubhirdhyeyaḥ śambhurākāśamadhyagaḥ | sarvavyāpī prakāśātmā bhāsarūpo hi cinmayaḥ
verses.translation: Verily the Vedas mention lord Siva as golden. "Goldcn-armcd" refers to his limbs being golden. Otherwise the lordship cannot be his. In the Chandogya also in the passage "He who is in Jiiva" is mentioned with golden moustache, golden tresses. Everywhere from the nail till the hair he is golden.
verses.wordMeaning: Verily the Vedas mention lord Siva as golden. "Goldcn-armcd" refers to his limbs being golden. Otherwise the lordship cannot be his. In the Chandogya also in the passage "He who is in Jiiva" is mentioned with golden moustache, golden tresses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verily the Vedas mention lord Siva as golden. "Goldcn-armcd" refers to his limbs being golden. Otherwise the lordship cannot be his. In the Chandogya also in the passage "He who is in Jiiva" is mentioned with golden moustache, golden tresses.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य पुंसः परा शक्तिर्भावगम्या मनोहरा । निर्गुणा स्वगुणैरेव निगूढा निष्कला शिवा
verses.transliteration: yasya puṃsaḥ parā śaktirbhāvagamyā manoharā | nirguṇā svaguṇaireva nigūḍhā niṣkalā śivā
verses.translation: I shall tell you me purport of the statement "I am the great Brahman". Please listen.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall tell you me purport of the statement "I am the great Brahman". Please listen.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदीयं त्रिविधं रूपं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं ततः । ध्येयं मुमुक्षुभिर्नित्यं क्रमतो योगिभिर्मुने
verses.transliteration: tadīyaṃ trividhaṃ rūpaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ tataḥ | dhyeyaṃ mumukṣubhirnityaṃ kramato yogibhirmune
verses.translation: He is mentioned as the great Brahman, most sublime and the soul of all: "Para, Apara, Paratpara." The words Rudra, Brahma and Visnu arc mentioned in the Vedas. The lord is greater than these. This is indicated by the word 'Para'.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is mentioned as the great Brahman, most sublime and the soul of all: "Para, Apara, Paratpara." The words Rudra, Brahma and Visnu arc mentioned in the Vedas. The lord is greater than these. This is indicated by the word 'Para'.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निष्कलः सर्वदेवानामादिदेवः सनातनः । ज्ञानक्रियास्वभावो यः परमात्मेति गीयते
verses.transliteration: niṣkalaḥ sarvadevānāmādidevaḥ sanātanaḥ | jñānakriyāsvabhāvo yaḥ paramātmeti gīyate
verses.translation: By pondering over and practising the words of the Vedas, Sastras and the preceptor, Siva, the blissful lord appears in the heart of the pupil.
verses.commentary: Sense: By pondering over and practising the words of the Vedas, Sastras and the preceptor, Siva, the blissful lord appears in the heart of the pupil.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य मूर्त्तिः साक्षात्सदाशिवः । पञ्चमन्त्रतनुर्देवः कलापञ्चकविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: tasya devādhidevasya mūrttiḥ sākṣātsadāśivaḥ | pañcamantratanurdevaḥ kalāpañcakavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, the §ruti says that it has originated from Siva's mouth. am the soul of all", because the great qualities are ever present in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the §ruti says that it has originated from Siva's mouth. am the soul of all", because the great qualities are ever present in me.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशः प्रसन्नः शीतलद्युतिः । पञ्चवक्त्रो दशभुजस्त्रिपञ्चनयनः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ prasannaḥ śītaladyutiḥ | pañcavaktro daśabhujastripañcanayanaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "I am without a second" because there is no other Atman distinct from the self. The statement "indeed all this is Brahman" has been explained before.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am without a second" because there is no other Atman distinct from the self. The statement "indeed all this is Brahman" has been explained before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानमुकुटोपेतः पुरुषास्यः पुरातनः । अघोरहृदयो वामदेवगुह्यप्रदेशवान्
verses.transliteration: īśānamukuṭopetaḥ puruṣāsyaḥ purātanaḥ | aghorahṛdayo vāmadevaguhyapradeśavān
verses.translation: I am complete because of my positive aspect. I am ever liberated. All the souls resorting to my nature are liberated due to my grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am complete because of my positive aspect. I am ever liberated. All the souls resorting to my nature are liberated due to my grace.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्यपादश्च तन्मूर्त्तिः साक्षात्सकलनिष्कलः । सर्व्वज्ञत्वादिषट्शक्तिषडङ्गीकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sadyapādaśca tanmūrttiḥ sākṣātsakalaniṣkalaḥ | sarvvajñatvādiṣaṭśaktiṣaḍaṅgīkṛtavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: "I am he who is Siva, the soul of all and identical with all. I am Harhsa. I am Siva.** This is the meaning of all statements, O Vamadeva, as mentioned by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am he who is Siva, the soul of all and identical with all. I am Harhsa. I am Siva.** This is the meaning of all statements, O Vamadeva, as mentioned by Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादिशक्तिस्फुरितहृत्पङ्कजविराजितः । स्वशक्त्या वामभागे तु मनोन्मन्या विभूषितः
verses.transliteration: śabdādiśaktisphuritahṛtpaṅkajavirājitaḥ | svaśaktyā vāmabhāge tu manonmanyā vibhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall communicate to the pupil the meaning as declared by Siva and explained in the Vedic passages. It establishes the identity of men with Siva Himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall communicate to the pupil the meaning as declared by Siva and explained in the Vedic passages. It establishes the identity of men with Siva Himself.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपदेशक्रमो ह्यादौ वक्तव्यः श्रूयतामयम् । चातुर्व्वर्ण्यं हि लोकेस्मिन्प्रसिद्धम्मानुषे मुने
verses.transliteration: upadeśakramo hyādau vaktavyaḥ śrūyatāmayam | cāturvvarṇyaṃ hi lokesminprasiddhammānuṣe mune
verses.translation: He shall worship it with scents repeating Om. It shall be filled with scented water invoked by Astra mantra and filtered with a cloth. It shall be worshipped with the Pranava Om.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship it with scents repeating Om. It shall be filled with scented water invoked by Astra mantra and filtered with a cloth. It shall be worshipped with the Pranava Om.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रैवर्णिकानामेवात्र श्रुत्याचारसमन्वयः । शुश्रूषामात्रसारा हि शूद्राः श्रुतिबहिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: traivarṇikānāmevātra śrutyācārasamanvayaḥ | śuśrūṣāmātrasārā hi śūdrāḥ śrutibahiṣkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: It shall be worshipped repeating Om seven times. He who makes the slightest slip has to face the greatest terror. So says the Sruti. He shall then address the disciple himself, "Be steady-minded and fearless". Medita¬ ting on the lord he shall continue the worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be worshipped repeating Om seven times. He who makes the slightest slip has to face the greatest terror. So says the Sruti. He shall then address the disciple himself, "Be steady-minded and fearless". Medita¬ ting on the lord he shall continue the worship.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रैवर्णिकानां सर्वेषां स्वस्वाश्रमरतात्मनाम् । श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितो धर्मोऽनुष्ठेयो नापरः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: traivarṇikānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svasvāśramaratātmanām | śrutismṛtyudito dharmo'nuṣṭheyo nāparaḥ kvacit
verses.translation: He shall worship the seat, of the disciple with the rite of "Sadutthapana." After conceiving Siva's seat he shall instal an idol of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the seat, of the disciple with the rite of "Sadutthapana." After conceiving Siva's seat he shall instal an idol of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं कर्म कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यति । इत्युक्तं परमेशेन वेदमार्गप्रदर्शिना
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtyuditaṃ karma kurvansiddhimavāpsyati | ityuktaṃ parameśena vedamārgapradarśinā
verses.translation: He shall fix on the head and the body of the disciple, the five Brahmans, beginning with the head and
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall fix on the head and the body of the disciple, the five Brahmans, beginning with the head and
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारपुण्यैरभ्यर्च्य परमेश्वरम् । तत्सायुज्यं गताः सर्वे बहवो मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramācārapuṇyairabhyarcya parameśvaram | tatsāyujyaṃ gatāḥ sarve bahavo munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: He shall then jjerform the Nyasa of the limbs. The sixteen forms'** of ancillary services beginning with the offer¬ ing of the scat shall also be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then jjerform the Nyasa of the limbs. The sixteen forms'** of ancillary services beginning with the offer¬ ing of the scat shall also be performed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्येण मुनयो देवा यज्ञक्रियाध्वना । पितरः प्रजया तृप्ता इति हि श्रुतिरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryeṇa munayo devā yajñakriyādhvanā | pitaraḥ prajayā tṛptā iti hi śrutirabravīt
verses.translation: Milk pudding shall be offered as Naivedya repeat¬ ing Om Svaha. The rites of offering water for gargling and Acamana, Arghya, incense, lights etc. shall also be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Milk pudding shall be offered as Naivedya repeat¬ ing Om Svaha. The rites of offering water for gargling and Acamana, Arghya, incense, lights etc. shall also be performed.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं ऋणत्रयान्मुक्तो वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गतः । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखादिसहिष्णुर्विजितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ṛṇatrayānmukto vānaprasthāśramaṃ gataḥ | śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhādisahiṣṇurvijitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping with the eight names he shall perform the Japa along with brahmins well-versed in the Vedas. Passages from the Srutis: "The knower of Brah¬ man attains.." "Bhrgu the son of Varuna" "He who of gods"'*' and ending with ''He who is the greatest is Mahes- vara" shall be recited. Taking a garland of Kalhara flowers he shall stand up and recite the "Siddhi Skandha" section in the Paficasika Text of Srivirupak$a. Thereafter thinking thus "This is my fame. I am complete" and feeling favourably disposed towards him the preceptor shall put the garland round the neck of the disciple.
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping with the eight names he shall perform the Japa along with brahmins well-versed in the Vedas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping with the eight names he shall perform the Japa along with brahmins well-versed in the Vedas.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपस्वी विजिताहारो यमाद्यं योगमभ्यसेत् । यथा दृढतरा बुद्धिरविचाल्या भवेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: tapasvī vijitāhāro yamādyaṃ yogamabhyaset | yathā dṛḍhatarā buddhiravicālyā bhavettathā
verses.translation: The caste mark on the forehead and the appli¬ cation of the unguent over the body shall be carried out in accordance with his cultural custom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The caste mark on the forehead and the appli¬ cation of the unguent over the body shall be carried out in accordance with his cultural custom.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्रमेण शुद्धात्मा सर्वकर्म्माणि विन्यसेत् । संन्यस्य सर्वकर्म्माणि ज्ञानपूजापरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ krameṇa śuddhātmā sarvakarmmāṇi vinyaset | saṃnyasya sarvakarmmāṇi jñānapūjāparo bhavet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall assign a name to him prefixed with the title iSripada. He shall offer him an umbrella and sandals. He shall delegate to him the power of oratory, authorise him to accept scat in front since the disciple has now become Siva himself. He shall tell him to be conscious that he is §iva. The preceptor shall make obeisance in accordance with the tradition in the cult.
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor shall assign a name to him prefixed with the title iSripada. He shall offer him an umbrella and sandals. He shall delegate to him the power of oratory, authorise him to accept scat in front since the disciple has now become Siva himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall assign a name to him prefixed with the title iSripada. He shall offer him an umbrella and sandals. He shall delegate to him the power of oratory, authorise him to accept scat in front since the disciple has now become Siva himself.…
