verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रकारमहं वक्ष्ये लोकानुग्रहकाम्यया । तव स्तेहान्महाप्राज्ञ सावधानतया शृणु
verses.transliteration: tatprakāramahaṃ vakṣye lokānugrahakāmyayā | tava stehānmahāprājña sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu
verses.translation: *'From now onwards be engaged in blessing the worlds. Accept a disciple only after testing him for a year. Accept him duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: *'From now onwards be engaged in blessing the worlds. Accept a disciple only after testing him for a year. Accept him duly.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञं वेदान्तज्ञानपारगम् । आचार्यमुपगच्छेत्स यतिर्मतिमतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaṃ vedāntajñānapāragam | ācāryamupagacchetsa yatirmatimatāṃ varam
verses.translation: Eschew the faults of lust etc. and be devoted to meditation on Siva. Associate with those who have inherited good tradition and not with others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschew the faults of lust etc. and be devoted to meditation on Siva. Associate with those who have inherited good tradition and not with others.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्समीपमुपव्रज्य यथाविधि विचक्षणः । दीर्घदण्डप्रणामाद्यैस्तोषयेद्यत्नतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tatsamīpamupavrajya yathāvidhi vicakṣaṇaḥ | dīrghadaṇḍapraṇāmādyaistoṣayedyatnataḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: Till the end of your life never take food without worshipping Siva. Abiding by your devotion to the precep¬ tor be happy, be happy."
verses.commentary: Sense: Till the end of your life never take food without worshipping Siva. Abiding by your devotion to the precep¬ tor be happy, be happy."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो गुरुः स शिवः प्रोक्तो यः शिवः स गुरुः स्मृतः । इति निश्चित्य मनसा स्वविचारं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo guruḥ sa śivaḥ prokto yaḥ śivaḥ sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ | iti niścitya manasā svavicāraṃ nivedayet
verses.translation: In this manner the excellent preceptor, sympathetic and scholarly, shall be favourably inclined towards the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner the excellent preceptor, sympathetic and scholarly, shall be favourably inclined towards the disciple.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्धानुज्ञस्तु गुरुणा द्वादशाहं पयोव्रती । शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यां वा दशम्यां वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: labdhānujñastu guruṇā dvādaśāhaṃ payovratī | śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ vā daśamyāṃ vā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: O Vamadeva, O great sage, out of affection for you the mode of the consecration of the disciple has been mentioned to you though it is a great secret.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vamadeva, O great sage, out of affection for you the mode of the consecration of the disciple has been mentioned to you though it is a great secret.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः स्नात्वा विशुद्धात्मा कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधीः । गुरुमाहूय विधिना नान्दीश्राद्धं समारभेत्
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ snātvā viśuddhātmā kṛtanityakriyaḥ sudhīḥ | gurumāhūya vidhinā nāndīśrāddhaṃ samārabhet
verses.translation: After saying this Karttikeya narrated the procedure of hair-cutting and ablution in detail intending to favour the ascetics (anxious to hear him).
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this Karttikeya narrated the procedure of hair-cutting and ablution in detail intending to favour the ascetics (anxious to hear him).
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवाः सत्यवसुसंज्ञावन्तः प्रकीर्तिताः । देवश्राद्धे ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाः कथितास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: viśvedevāḥ satyavasusaṃjñāvantaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | devaśrāddhe brahmaviṣṇumaheśāḥ kathitāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: O sage Vamadeva I shall now explain the rules of hair-cutting and ablution. These if performed immediately are conducive to great purity of the ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage Vamadeva I shall now explain the rules of hair-cutting and ablution. These if performed immediately are conducive to great purity of the ascetic.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिश्राद्धे तु सम्प्रोक्ता देवक्षेत्रमनुष्यजाः । देवश्राद्धे तु वसुरुद्रादित्याः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiśrāddhe tu samproktā devakṣetramanuṣyajāḥ | devaśrāddhe tu vasurudrādityāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, after the consecration as a disciple he shall observe the other rites and get ready for the tonsorial ceremony.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, after the consecration as a disciple he shall observe the other rites and get ready for the tonsorial ceremony.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो मानुषश्राद्धे सनकाद्या मुनीश्वराः । भूतश्राद्धे पञ्च महाभूतानि च ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: catvāro mānuṣaśrāddhe sanakādyā munīśvarāḥ | bhūtaśrāddhe pañca mahābhūtāni ca tataḥ param
verses.translation: He shall bow to the preceptor and secure permission
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall bow to the preceptor and secure permission
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मातृश्राद्धे मातृपितामह्यौ च प्रपितामही । आत्मश्राद्धे तु चत्वार आत्मा पितृपितामहौ
verses.transliteration: mātṛśrāddhe mātṛpitāmahyau ca prapitāmahī | ātmaśrāddhe tu catvāra ātmā pitṛpitāmahau
verses.translation: Repeating "Sivam** *'l§ivam" he shall sprinkle every object with water. He shall then close his eyes with the ring-finger and the thumb. Repeating the Astra mantra he shall open his eyes and look at the razor and other imp¬ lements of tonsorial rite. Repeating the mantra twelve times he shall sprinkle them with the Astra mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: Repeating "Sivam** *'l§ivam" he shall sprinkle every object with water. He shall then close his eyes with the ring-finger and the thumb. Repeating the Astra mantra he shall open his eyes and look at the razor and other imp¬ lements of tonsorial rite.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating "Sivam** *'l§ivam" he shall sprinkle every object with water. He shall then close his eyes with the ring-finger and the thumb. Repeating the Astra mantra he shall open his eyes and look at the razor and other imp¬ lements of tonsorial rite.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रपितामहनामा च सपत्नीकाः प्रकीर्तिताः । मातामहात्मकश्राद्धे त्रयो मातामहादयः
verses.transliteration: prapitāmahanāmā ca sapatnīkāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | mātāmahātmakaśrāddhe trayo mātāmahādayaḥ
verses.translation: He shall take the razor and cut off a patch of hair on the right side. Then a few hair on the front, then the entire hair shall be shaved off.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take the razor and cut off a patch of hair on the right side. Then a few hair on the front, then the entire hair shall be shaved off.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्राद्धं ब्राह्मणानां युग्मं कृत्वोपकल्पितान् । आहूय पादौ प्रक्षाल्य स्वयमाचम्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pratiśrāddhaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yugmaṃ kṛtvopakalpitān | āhūya pādau prakṣālya svayamācamya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The hair shaven off shall be put on a leaf and not allowed to fall on the ground. The beards, the moustache also shall be shaven. Nails of the hands and feet shall be pared.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hair shaven off shall be put on a leaf and not allowed to fall on the ground. The beards, the moustache also shall be shaven. Nails of the hands and feet shall be pared.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: समस्तसम्पत्समवाप्तिहेतवः, समुत्थितापत्कुलधूमकेतवः । अपारसंसारसमुद्रसेतवः, पुनन्तु मां ब्राह्मणपादरेणवः
verses.transliteration: samastasampatsamavāptihetavaḥ, samutthitāpatkuladhūmaketavaḥ | apārasaṃsārasamudrasetavaḥ, punantu māṃ brāhmaṇapādareṇavaḥ
verses.translation: He shall take clay from the root of Bilva, Asvattha or Tulasi. He shall plunge into water twelve times and come to the bank. He shall place the clay on a pure spot of ground and divide it into three parts. Each part shall be divided into three. It shall be sprinkled with water with the Astra mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall take clay from the root of Bilva, Asvattha or Tulasi. He shall plunge into water twelve times and come to the bank. He shall place the clay on a pure spot of ground and divide it into three parts. Each part shall be divided into three.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take clay from the root of Bilva, Asvattha or Tulasi. He shall plunge into water twelve times and come to the bank. He shall place the clay on a pure spot of ground and divide it into three parts. Each part shall be divided into three.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपद्धनध्वान्तसहस्रभानवः, समीहितार्थार्पणकामधेनवः । समस्ततीर्थाम्बुपवित्रमूर्त्तयो, रक्षन्तु मां ब्राह्मणपादपांसवः
verses.transliteration: āpaddhanadhvāntasahasrabhānavaḥ, samīhitārthārpaṇakāmadhenavaḥ | samastatīrthāmbupavitramūrttayo, rakṣantu māṃ brāhmaṇapādapāṃsavaḥ
verses.translation: Taking a lump of claiy he shall wipe off his hands with it twelve times. Each of the hands shall be separately washed with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking a lump of claiy he shall wipe off his hands with it twelve times. Each of the hands shall be separately washed with water.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति जप्त्वा नमस्कृत्य साष्टाङ्गं भुवि दण्डवत् । स्थित्वा तु प्राङ्मुखः शम्भोः पादाब्जयुगलं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: iti japtvā namaskṛtya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ bhuvi daṇḍavat | sthitvā tu prāṅmukhaḥ śambhoḥ pādābjayugalaṃ smaran
verses.translation: Another lump of clay shall be used similarly for the feet, another lump for the face, another for the arms and so on. After smearing and washing he shall enter water again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another lump of clay shall be used similarly for the feet, another lump for the face, another for the arms and so on. After smearing and washing he shall enter water again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सपवित्रकरः शुद्ध उपवीती दृढासनः । प्राणायामत्रयं कुर्याच्छ्रुत्वा तिथ्यादिकं पुनः
verses.transliteration: sapavitrakaraḥ śuddha upavītī dṛḍhāsanaḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryācchrutvā tithyādikaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Another lump of clay shall be divided into twelve and applied over the beard. He shall then plunge into the water again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another lump of clay shall be divided into twelve and applied over the beard. He shall then plunge into the water again.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मत्संन्यासाङ्गभूतं यद्विश्वेदेवादिकं तथा । श्राद्धमष्टविधं मातामहान्तं पार्वणेन वै
verses.transliteration: matsaṃnyāsāṅgabhūtaṃ yadviśvedevādikaṃ tathā | śrāddhamaṣṭavidhaṃ mātāmahāntaṃ pārvaṇena vai
verses.translation: He shall come to the bank, gargle sixteen times, perforn Acamana twice and Pranayama sixteen times re¬ peating the Pranava.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall come to the bank, gargle sixteen times, perforn Acamana twice and Pranayama sixteen times re¬ peating the Pranava.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विधानेन करिष्यामि युष्मदाज्ञापुरःसरम् । एवं विधाय सङ्कल्पं दर्भानुत्तरतस्त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: vidhānena kariṣyāmi yuṣmadājñāpuraḥsaram | evaṃ vidhāya saṅkalpaṃ darbhānuttaratastyajet
verses.translation: He shall divide another lump of clay into three. With one part he shall purify the hips and feet and perform Acamana twice.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall divide another lump of clay into three. With one part he shall purify the hips and feet and perform Acamana twice.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवार्थ इत्यादि भवद्भ्यां क्षण इत्यपि
verses.transliteration: viśvedevārtha ityādi bhavadbhyāṃ kṣaṇa ityapi
verses.translation: With another lump of clay he shall purify the armpits by means of the hands on the opposite sides. With steady and pure mind the disciple shall take another lump of pure clay and smear his body fromhead to foot with devotion to. the preceptor and eyes fixed in the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: With another lump of clay he shall purify the armpits by means of the hands on the opposite sides. With steady and pure mind the disciple shall take another lump of pure clay and smear his body fromhead to foot with devotion to. the preceptor and eyes fixed in the sun.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादनीय इत्यन्तं सर्वत्रैवं विधिक्रमः । एवं समाप्य वरणं मण्डलानि प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: prasādanīya ityantaṃ sarvatraivaṃ vidhikramaḥ | evaṃ samāpya varaṇaṃ maṇḍalāni prakalpayet
verses.translation: Fixing the staff on the ground he shall stand up and remember his preceptor who has taught him the mantra with devotion strengthened by wisdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fixing the staff on the ground he shall stand up and remember his preceptor who has taught him the mantra with devotion strengthened by wisdom.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उदगारभ्य दश च कृत्वाभ्यर्चनमक्षतैः । तेषु क्रमेण संस्थाप्य ब्राह्मणान् पादयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: udagārabhya daśa ca kṛtvābhyarcanamakṣataiḥ | teṣu krameṇa saṃsthāpya brāhmaṇān pādayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: He shall devoutly remember Samba, Mahesana, l§ahkara, the moon-crested Siva, the lord of prosperity and glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall devoutly remember Samba, Mahesana, l§ahkara, the moon-crested Siva, the lord of prosperity and glory.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवादिनामानि ससंवबोधनमुच्चरेत् । इदं वः पाद्यमिति सकुशपुष्पाक्षतोदकैः
verses.transliteration: viśvedevādināmāni sasaṃvabodhanamuccaret | idaṃ vaḥ pādyamiti sakuśapuṣpākṣatodakaiḥ
verses.translation: He shall prostrate before the preceptor Siva thrice with eight limbs and once with five limbs touching the ground and stand up making obeisance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall prostrate before the preceptor Siva thrice with eight limbs and once with five limbs touching the ground and stand up making obeisance.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यं दत्त्वा स्वयमपि क्षालिताङ्घ्रिरुदङ्मुखः । आचम्य युग्मक्लृप्तांस्तानासनेषूपवेश्य च
verses.transliteration: pādyaṃ dattvā svayamapi kṣālitāṅghrirudaṅmukhaḥ | ācamya yugmaklṛptāṃstānāsaneṣūpaveśya ca
verses.translation: He shall enter the river again and plunge once. Coming up he shall apply the clay on the shoulders in the manner mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall enter the river again and plunge once. Coming up he shall apply the clay on the shoulders in the manner mentioned before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवस्वरूपस्य ब्राह्मणस्येदमासनम् । इति दर्भासनं दत्त्वा दर्भपाणिः स्वयं स्थितः
verses.transliteration: viśvedevasvarūpasya brāhmaṇasyedamāsanam | iti darbhāsanaṃ dattvā darbhapāṇiḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: The remaining clay he shall take up and dissolve it in the water and then apply it all over his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: The remaining clay he shall take up and dissolve it in the water and then apply it all over his body.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नान्दीमुखश्राद्धे विश्वेदेवार्थ इत्यपि । भवद्भ्यां क्षण इत्युक्त्वा क्रियतामिति संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: asminnāndīmukhaśrāddhe viśvedevārtha ityapi | bhavadbhyāṃ kṣaṇa ityuktvā kriyatāmiti saṃvadet
verses.translation: He shall repeat 'Om' thrice and remember the lotus-likc feet of Siva which enable him to cross the ocean of worldly existence.*®®
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall repeat 'Om' thrice and remember the lotus-likc feet of Siva which enable him to cross the ocean of worldly existence.*®®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुतामिति सम्प्रोच्य भवन्ताविति संवदेत् । वदेतां प्राप्नुयावेति तौ च ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवौ
verses.transliteration: prāpnutāmiti samprocya bhavantāviti saṃvadet | vadetāṃ prāpnuyāveti tau ca brāhmaṇapuṅgavau
verses.translation: Repeating Om he shall pour water over his body besmeared with the Bhasma of the Vi raja Homa. He.shall wipe the body, take his bath and apply Bha'ma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating Om he shall pour water over his body besmeared with the Bhasma of the Vi raja Homa. He.shall wipe the body, take his bath and apply Bha'ma.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूर्णमस्तु सङ्कल्पसिद्धिरस्त्विति तान् प्रति । भवन्तोऽनुगृह्णन्त्विति प्रार्थयेद् द्विजपुङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: sampūrṇamastu saṅkalpasiddhirastviti tān prati | bhavanto'nugṛhṇantviti prārthayed dvijapuṅgavān
verses.translation: O sage, then he shall carefully apply Tripundra in accordance with the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, then he shall carefully apply Tripundra in accordance with the rules.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परिस्तीर्य स्वयं तत्र परिषिच्योदकेन च । हस्ताभ्यामवलम्ब्याथ पात्रं प्रत्येकमादरात्
verses.transliteration: paristīrya svayaṃ tatra pariṣicyodakena ca | hastābhyāmavalambyātha pātraṃ pratyekamādarāt
verses.translation: There are no crematory rites for the liberated ascetics. I have heard that they arc buried. O Karttikeya, my preceptor, please mention that rite lovingly. There is none in the three worlds who can explain the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are no crematory rites for the liberated ascetics. I have heard that they arc buried. O Karttikeya, my preceptor, please mention that rite lovingly. There is none in the three worlds who can explain the same.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी ते पात्रमित्यादि कृत्वा तत्र व्यवस्थितान् । देवादींश्च चतुर्थ्यन्ताननूद्याक्षतसंयुतान्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī te pātramityādi kṛtvā tatra vyavasthitān | devādīṃśca caturthyantānanūdyākṣatasaṃyutān
verses.translation: O lord, son of 6iva, considering me as your disciple please tell me lovingly the mode of departure for those who arc liberated from the corporal cage after rea¬ lising perfect identity with the Brahman and who have attained their goal after liberation through the path of Upasana.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, son of 6iva, considering me as your disciple please tell me lovingly the mode of departure for those who arc liberated from the corporal cage after rea¬ lising perfect identity with the Brahman and who have attained their goal after liberation through the path of Upasana.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उदग्गृहीत्वा स्वाहेति देवार्थेऽन्नं यजेत्पुनः । न ममेति वदेदन्ते सर्वत्रायं विधिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: udaggṛhītvā svāheti devārthe'nnaṃ yajetpunaḥ | na mameti vadedante sarvatrāyaṃ vidhikramaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the request of the sage, the son of!§akti, destroyer of demons spoke about the great secret which had been heard from iva. by Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the request of the sage, the son of!§akti, destroyer of demons spoke about the great secret which had been heard from iva. by Bhrgu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्पादपद्मस्मरणाद्यस्य नामजपादपि । न्यूनं कर्म भवेत्पूर्णं तं वन्दे साम्बमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yatpādapadmasmaraṇādyasya nāmajapādapi | nyūnaṃ karma bhavetpūrṇaṃ taṃ vande sāmbamīśvaram
verses.translation: O Brahmin, I shall explain it to you. It shall not be given to any or every one indiscriminately. It shall be given to a calm disciple equipped with devotion to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmin, I shall explain it to you. It shall not be given to any or every one indiscriminately. It shall be given to a calm disciple equipped with devotion to Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति जप्त्वा ततो ब्रूयान्मया कृतमिदं पुनः । नान्दीमुखश्राद्धमिति यथोक्तं च वदेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: iti japtvā tato brūyānmayā kṛtamidaṃ punaḥ | nāndīmukhaśrāddhamiti yathoktaṃ ca vadettataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing fiom his preceptor the lore of Ved¬ anta and Agamas along with the explanation he shall practise Yoga by means of Yama, Niyama etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing fiom his preceptor the lore of Ved¬ anta and Agamas along with the explanation he shall practise Yoga by means of Yama, Niyama etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्विति ब्रूतेति च तान्प्रसाद्य द्विजपुङ्गवान् । विसृज्य स्वकरस्थोदं प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: astviti brūteti ca tānprasādya dvijapuṅgavān | visṛjya svakarasthodaṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat
verses.translation: O sage, practising it regularly the ascetic shall be attached to Pranava and be well-engaged in the meditation on Siva
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, practising it regularly the ascetic shall be attached to Pranava and be well-engaged in the meditation on Siva
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय च ततो ब्रूयादमृतं भवतु द्विजान् । प्रार्थयेच्च परं प्रीत्या कृताञ्जलिरुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: utthāya ca tato brūyādamṛtaṃ bhavatu dvijān | prārthayecca paraṃ prītyā kṛtāñjalirudāradhīḥ
verses.translation: O sage, there are five deities in the forms of messengers who by the favour of Sadasiva are put in the charge of Nandin.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, there are five deities in the forms of messengers who by the favour of Sadasiva are put in the charge of Nandin.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीरुद्रं चमकं सूक्तं पौरुषं च यथाविधि । चित्ते सदाशिवं ध्यात्वा जपेद् ब्रह्माणि पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: śrīrudraṃ camakaṃ sūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ ca yathāvidhi | citte sadāśivaṃ dhyātvā japed brahmāṇi pañca ca
verses.translation: The five deities, O sage, take the souls interested in performing holy rites to the heaven by their merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five deities, O sage, take the souls interested in performing holy rites to the heaven by their merit.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भोजनान्ते रुद्रसूक्तं क्षमापय द्विजान् पुनः । तन्मन्त्रेण ततो दद्यादुत्तरापोशणं पुरः
verses.transliteration: bhojanānte rudrasūktaṃ kṣamāpaya dvijān punaḥ | tanmantreṇa tato dadyāduttarāpośaṇaṃ puraḥ
verses.translation: After enjoying the pleasures in heaven as men¬ tioned, at the diminution of the merit they return to the human realm and take births as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying the pleasures in heaven as men¬ tioned, at the diminution of the merit they return to the human realm and take births as before.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नान्दीमुखोक्तश्राद्धाङ्गं करिष्ये पिण्डदानकम् । इति सङ्कल्प्य दक्षादि समारभ्योदकान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: nāndīmukhoktaśrāddhāṅgaṃ kariṣye piṇḍadānakam | iti saṅkalpya dakṣādi samārabhyodakāntikam
verses.translation: On seeing him come, if he is unattached, Sada- iSiva lord of the gods teaches him the purport of the great mantra; crowns him as the chief of the Ganas and gives him a body similar to his. §iva lord of all, leader of all, blesses him thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him come, if he is unattached, Sada- iSiva lord of the gods teaches him the purport of the great mantra; crowns him as the chief of the Ganas and gives him a body similar to his. §iva lord of all, leader of all, blesses him thus.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नव रेखाः समालिख्य प्रागग्रान्द्वादश क्रमात् । संस्तीर्य दर्भान्दक्षादिदेवादिस्थानपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: nava rekhāḥ samālikhya prāgagrāndvādaśa kramāt | saṃstīrya darbhāndakṣādidevādisthānapañcakam
verses.translation: The ascetic is decorated with the deer-skin, axe, trident and the gesture of offering boons. It has three eyes. His matted locks shine by the splendour of Ganga and the crescent moon. He is seated on a splendid aerial chariot. He is delegated the power of bestowing all desires. If he is attached the lord blesses him with an aerial chariot having the speed of the mind, capable of going everywhere, shining like a crore of suns, cool like a crore of moons, full of vessels with celestial nector and divine water, decorated with divine garments, garlands, unguents and ornaments charming with the sounds of dance, music, Mrdahga and other instruments and surrounded by Rudra virgins. When he has enjoyed all pleasures, when his eagerness for enjoyment subsides lord Siva blesses him imparting to him the purport of the great mantra. He blesses him with immovable trance in the forfn "I am Siva, I am perfect.'' He blesses him with unres¬ tricted Siddhis capable of creating the sun etc. The Siddhis arc in the form of throbbings arising from realisation that he is the slave ol Siva. The preceptor of the world bestows on him the greatest salvation devoid of return even when the life of the lotus-born deity comes to an end.
verses.wordMeaning: The ascetic is decorated with the deer-skin, axe, trident and the gesture of offering boons. It has three eyes. His matted locks shine by the splendour of Ganga and the crescent moon. He is seated on a splendid aerial chariot. He is delegated the power of bestowing all desires.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic is decorated with the deer-skin, axe, trident and the gesture of offering boons. It has three eyes. His matted locks shine by the splendour of Ganga and the crescent moon. He is seated on a splendid aerial chariot. He is delegated the power of bestowing all desires.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तूष्णीं दद्यात्साक्षतोदं त्रिषु स्थानेषु च क्रमात् । स्थानेष्वन्येषु मातृषु मार्ज्जयन्तास्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīṃ dadyātsākṣatodaṃ triṣu sthāneṣu ca kramāt | sthāneṣvanyeṣu mātṛṣu mārjjayantāstataḥ param
verses.translation: They shall recite the statements beginning with Pranava and explain their purport with the pious mind. They shall remind him of Siva.the great Nirguna splendour and make obeisance to him till he expires.
verses.commentary: Sense: They shall recite the statements beginning with Pranava and explain their purport with the pious mind. They shall remind him of Siva.the great Nirguna splendour and make obeisance to him till he expires.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेति पितरः पश्चात्साक्षतोदं समर्च्य च । दद्यात्ततः क्रमेणैव देवादिस्थानपञ्चके
verses.transliteration: atreti pitaraḥ paścātsākṣatodaṃ samarcya ca | dadyāttataḥ krameṇaiva devādisthānapañcake
verses.translation: The procedure of obsequies shall be followed. If their bodies are not cremated they are likely to miss the good goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The procedure of obsequies shall be followed. If their bodies are not cremated they are likely to miss the good goal.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्तद्देवादिनामानि चतुर्थ्यन्तान्युदीर्य च । पिण्डत्रयं ततो दद्यात्प्रत्येकं स्थानपञ्चके
verses.transliteration: tattaddevādināmāni caturthyantānyudīrya ca | piṇḍatrayaṃ tato dadyātpratyekaṃ sthānapañcake
verses.translation: Since they have renounced all their activities and have resorted to Siva, if the king defiles their bodies his kingdom will be ruined.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they have renounced all their activities and have resorted to Siva, if the king defiles their bodies his kingdom will be ruined.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वगृह्योक्तेन मार्गेण दद्यात्पिण्डान्पृथक्पृथक् । दद्यादिदं साक्षतं च पितृसाद्गुण्यहेतवे
verses.transliteration: svagṛhyoktena mārgeṇa dadyātpiṇḍānpṛthakpṛthak | dadyādidaṃ sākṣataṃ ca pitṛsādguṇyahetave
verses.translation: The people of that village too will suffer distress. The following procedure shall be taken up to avoid that default.
verses.commentary: Sense: The people of that village too will suffer distress. The following procedure shall be taken up to avoid that default.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायेत्सदाशिवं देवं हृदयाम्भोजमध्यतः । तत्पादपद्मस्मरणादिति श्लोकं पठन् पुनः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyetsadāśivaṃ devaṃ hṛdayāmbhojamadhyataḥ | tatpādapadmasmaraṇāditi ślokaṃ paṭhan punaḥ
verses.translation: Humbly the king shall begin with "obeisance to Irinya'**® and recite the mantra ending with "obeisance to Amlvatkas".'®
verses.commentary: Sense: Humbly the king shall begin with "obeisance to Irinya'**® and recite the mantra ending with "obeisance to Amlvatkas".'®
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो दक्षिणां च स्वशक्तितः । दत्त्वा क्षमापय च तान् विसृज्य च ततः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtya brāhmaṇebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ | dattvā kṣamāpaya ca tān visṛjya ca tataḥ kramāt
verses.translation: Repeating Om in the end he shall complete the worship of the lord. O great sage, this procedure will quell the defect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating Om in the end he shall complete the worship of the lord. O great sage, this procedure will quell the defect.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डानुत्सृज्य गोग्रासं दद्यान्नो चेज्जले क्षिपेत् । पुण्याहवाचनं कृत्वा भुञ्जीत स्वजनैः सह
verses.transliteration: piṇḍānutsṛjya gogrāsaṃ dadyānno cejjale kṣipet | puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīta svajanaiḥ saha
verses.translation: His sons and relatives shall perform the obsequies according to the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: His sons and relatives shall perform the obsequies according to the rules.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: केशश्मश्रुनखानेव कर्मावधि विसृज्य च । समाष्टिकेशान्विधिवत्कारयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: keśaśmaśrunakhāneva karmāvadhi visṛjya ca | samāṣṭikeśānvidhivatkārayitvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: The loin-cloth shall be taken off and fresh one shall be tied. His body shall be dusted with the ashes in accordance with the rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: The loin-cloth shall be taken off and fresh one shall be tied. His body shall be dusted with the ashes in accordance with the rules.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा धौतपटः शुद्धो द्विराचम्याथ वाग्यतः । भस्म सन्धार्य विधिना कृत्वा पुण्याहवाचनम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā dhautapaṭaḥ śuddho dvirācamyātha vāgyataḥ | bhasma sandhārya vidhinā kṛtvā puṇyāhavācanam
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य सम्प्राप्य शुद्धदेहस्वभावतः । होमद्रव्यार्थमाचार्यदक्षिणार्थं विहाय च
verses.transliteration: tena samprokṣya samprāpya śuddhadehasvabhāvataḥ | homadravyārthamācāryadakṣiṇārthaṃ vihāya ca
verses.translation: Repeating the requisite mantras Rudrak$a garlands shall be worn over the chest, neck, head, arms, wrists and ears in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating the requisite mantras Rudrak$a garlands shall be worn over the chest, neck, head, arms, wrists and ears in order.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्यजातं महेशाय द्विजेभ्यश्च विशेषतः । भक्तेभ्यश्च प्रदायाथ शिवाय गुरुरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: dravyajātaṃ maheśāya dvijebhyaśca viśeṣataḥ | bhaktebhyaśca pradāyātha śivāya gururūpiṇe
verses.translation: After fumigating with incense the body shall be lifted and placed on a rope-swing. It shall be placed on a charming chariot of the form of five Bahmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: After fumigating with incense the body shall be lifted and placed on a rope-swing. It shall be placed on a charming chariot of the form of five Bahmans.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रादि दक्षिणां दत्त्वा प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । दोरकौपीनवसनं दण्डाद्यं क्षालितं भुवि
verses.transliteration: vastrādi dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat | dorakaupīnavasanaṃ daṇḍādyaṃ kṣālitaṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: The chariot shall be decorated with fragrant flowers and garlands with the five Brahma mantras beginning with Sadyojata preceded by Om.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot shall be decorated with fragrant flowers and garlands with the five Brahma mantras beginning with Sadyojata preceded by Om.

verses.translation: The ascetics shall dig a ditch as deep as the staff in a holy spot near a holy tree on the eastern or northern side. They shall sprinkle it with water repeating the Pranava and the Vyahrtis. They shall spread the leaves of the Sami tree and flowers with their tips pointing to the north. Above them Darbha grass shall be spread. His seat whether cloth, deerskin or mat of Darbha grass shall be placed over them. The body shall be sprinkled with Paficagavya with Pranava and Brahma mantras. It shall be bathed with the water from the conch repeating Rudrasukta and the Pranava. A flower shall be placed on the head. Repeating the Svastivacana mantras and Om the body shall be lifted and placed inside the ditch in the Yogic pose facing the cast. It shall be decorated with fragrant flowers and fumigated with incense and fragrant gum resin repeating the mantra ' O Visnu, protect the Havya".

verses.transliteration: tattaddevānsamuddiśya sāṅgaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | evamagnimukhādyaṃ yatkarmatantraṃ pravarttitam
verses.translation: He put the lotus-likc feet of the lord and the god¬ dess on his head. With their blessings he stayed there comfortably.
verses.commentary: Sense: He put the lotus-likc feet of the lord and the god¬ dess on his head. With their blessings he stayed there comfortably.

verses.sanskrit: कालस्वभावो नियतिरिति च श्रुतिरब्रवीत् । एतत्पञ्चकमेवास्य पञ्चकञ्चुकमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kālasvabhāvo niyatiriti ca śrutirabravīt | etatpañcakamevāsya pañcakañcukamucyate
verses.translation: All of you too shall learn the meaning of the Pranava Mahe.svara, the secret of the Vedas, of the Taraka Brahman, the bcsiower ol salvation. Remaining here itself
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you too shall learn the meaning of the Pranava Mahe.svara, the secret of the Vedas, of the Taraka Brahman, the bcsiower ol salvation. Remaining here itself

verses.sanskrit: लोकत्रयपदस्यान्ते व्यापिने परमात्मने । शिवायेदं न मम च पदं ब्रूयादतः परम्
verses.transliteration: lokatrayapadasyānte vyāpine paramātmane | śivāyedaṃ na mama ca padaṃ brūyādataḥ param
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते सुवरोमित्युदीरयेत् । त्रिपादमुच्चरेत्पूर्वं सावित्रीमित्यतः परम्
verses.transliteration: praveśayāmi śabdānte suvaromityudīrayet | tripādamuccaretpūrvaṃ sāvitrīmityataḥ param
verses.translation: "I cause it to enter" — at the end of the words, one should utter "suvar om"; one should first utter the three quarters, and after that "Savitri."

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवः सर्ववेदादिः प्रणवः शिववाचकः । मन्त्राधिराजराजश्च महाबीजं मनुः परः
verses.transliteration: praṇavaḥ sarvavedādiḥ praṇavaḥ śivavācakaḥ | mantrādhirājarājaśca mahābījaṃ manuḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: The pranava is the beginning of all the Vedas; the pranava denotes Shiva; it is the king of kings of mantras, the great seed, the supreme formula.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: समस्तमित्यतो ब्रूयान्मयेति च समब्रवीत् । सदाशिवं हृदि ध्यात्वा मन्दादीति ततो मुने
verses.transliteration: samastamityato brūyānmayeti ca samabravīt | sadāśivaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā mandādīti tato mune
verses.translation: Then one should say "samastam" and "maya," and so he spoke; then, meditating on Sadashiva in the heart, "mandadi," O sage.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: पुनरुत्थाय च शनैः प्रेम्णा पश्यन्गुरुं निजम् । कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तिष्ठेद्गुरुपाद समीपतः
verses.transliteration: punarutthāya ca śanaiḥ premṇā paśyanguruṃ nijam | kṛtāñjalipuṭastiṣṭhedgurupāda samīpataḥ
verses.translation: Rising again slowly, looking with love at his own guru, he should stand with folded hands near the guru's feet.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञया ततः शिष्यो वेदान्तार्थानुसारतः । शिवज्ञानपरो भूयात्सगुणागुणभेदतः
verses.transliteration: tadājñayā tataḥ śiṣyo vedāntārthānusārataḥ | śivajñānaparo bhūyātsaguṇāguṇabhedataḥ
verses.translation: Then, at his command, the disciple should become devoted to the knowledge of Shiva according to the meaning of Vedanta, with the distinction of with and without qualities.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: भूःस्वाहेति त्र्यृचा पूर्णाहुतिं हुत्वा समाप्य च । गायत्रीं प्रजपेद्यावदपराह्णमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: bhūḥsvāheti tryṛcā pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā samāpya ca | gāyatrīṃ prajapedyāvadaparāhṇamatandritaḥ
verses.translation: Having offered the full oblation with the three verses beginning "bhuh svaha" and concluded, one should diligently repeat the Gayatri until the afternoon.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सायन्तनीं सन्ध्यामुपास्य स्नानपूर्वकम् । सायमौपासनं हुत्वा मौनी विज्ञापयेद् गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: atha sāyantanīṃ sandhyāmupāsya snānapūrvakam | sāyamaupāsanaṃ hutvā maunī vijñāpayed gurum
verses.translation: Then, having performed the evening twilight worship preceded by bathing, and made the evening fire offering, he should silently inform his guru.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: श्रपयित्वा चरुं तस्मिन्समिदन्नाज्यभेदतः । जुहुयाद्रौद्रसूक्तेन सद्योजातादिपञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: śrapayitvā caruṃ tasminsamidannājyabhedataḥ | juhuyādraudrasūktena sadyojātādipañcabhiḥ
verses.translation: Having cooked the charu in that fire, he should offer oblations of fuel-sticks, rice and ghee separately with the Raudra Sukta and the five mantras beginning with Sadyojata.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽग्नये स्विष्टकृते स्वाहेति जुहुयात्सकृत् । हुत्वोपरिष्टात्तन्त्रं तु ततोऽग्नेरुत्तरे बुधः

verses.translation: He shall cast olT Darbha grass to the north and not touch it again. Beginning with the west the Mandalas shall be worshipped according to the rules for the rite of "Sadutthapana." Flowers shall be stacked within them like a pedestal with ' Om Hrlrn. I invoke the messenger god¬ dess in the form of fire, obeisance.'' This latter portion is common to the five. The gestures of installation shall be shown severally to each.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वासने जपेन्मौनी चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरे । आब्राह्मं च मुहूर्ते तु गायत्री दृढमानसः
verses.transliteration: sthitvāsane japenmaunī cailājinakuśottare | ābrāhmaṃ ca muhūrte tu gāyatrī dṛḍhamānasaḥ
verses.translation: The Aiiganyasas for the deities shall be performed with Hram, Hrim etc. The messenger goddesses shall have the noose, goad, gestures of fearlessness and wish in their hands. They are as lustrous as the lunar stone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Aiiganyasas for the deities shall be performed with Hram, Hrim etc. The messenger goddesses shall have the noose, goad, gestures of fearlessness and wish in their hands. They are as lustrous as the lunar stone.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ snātvā tvaśaktaścedbhasmanā vā vidhānataḥ | śrapayitvā caruṃ tasminnagnāvevābhidhāritam
verses.translation: They have changed (or enhanced) the hue of the quarters by the lustre of their gemset rings. They wear red garments and shine with lotus-like hands and feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have changed (or enhanced) the hue of the quarters by the lustre of their gemset rings. They wear red garments and shine with lotus-like hands and feet.

verses.translation: They look charming with their faces resembling * the full moon and brilliant with three eyes. They are

verses.sanskrit: जपेद् ब्रह्माणि सन्धार्य चित्तं शिवपदाम्बुजे । प्रजापतिमथेन्द्रं च विश्वेदेवास्ततः परम्

verses.translation: Their waists arc slender and buttocks large. They wear divine red garments. The ruby-scl anklets jingle and
verses.commentary: Sense: Their waists arc slender and buttocks large. They wear divine red garments. The ruby-scl anklets jingle and

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं सचतुर्थ्यन्तं स्वाहान्तान् प्रणवादिकान् । सञ्जप्य वाचयित्वाथ पुण्याहं च ततः परम्

verses.translation: What blessing can be secured from a departed soul? Only from a powerful soul can everything be achieved as from Mahesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: What blessing can be secured from a departed soul? Only from a powerful soul can everything be achieved as from Mahesa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परस्तात्तन्त्रमग्नये स्वाहेत्यग्निमुखावधि । निर्वर्त्य पश्चात्प्राणाय स्वाहेत्यारभ्य पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: parastāttantramagnaye svāhetyagnimukhāvadhi | nirvartya paścātprāṇāya svāhetyārabhya pañcabhiḥ
verses.translation: The five deities capable of all activities and eager to bless others arc accepted by the lord as the bestowers of bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five deities capable of all activities and eager to bless others arc accepted by the lord as the bestowers of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: साज्येन चरुणा पश्चादग्निं स्विष्टकृतं हुनेत् । पुनश्च प्रजपेत्सूक्तं रौद्रं ब्रह्माणि पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: sājyena caruṇā paścādagniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hunet | punaśca prajapetsūktaṃ raudraṃ brahmāṇi pañca ca
verses.translation: After meditating on the auspicious deities eager to bless he shall olfcr Padya at their feet with drops of water from the conch.
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating on the auspicious deities eager to bless he shall olfcr Padya at their feet with drops of water from the conch.

verses.sanskrit: महेशादि चतुर्व्यूहमन्त्रांश्च प्रजपेत्पुनः । हुत्वोपरिष्टात्तन्त्रं तु स्वशाखोक्तेन वर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: maheśādi caturvyūhamantrāṃśca prajapetpunaḥ | hutvopariṣṭāttantraṃ tu svaśākhoktena vartmanā
verses.translation: The water for Acamana shall be offered in their hands and Arghya on their heads. He shall conceive of their ritualistic ablution with the drops of water from the conch.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water for Acamana shall be offered in their hands and Arghya on their heads. He shall conceive of their ritualistic ablution with the drops of water from the conch.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रजुहुयाद्विरजाहोममात्मनः । षड्विंशतत्त्वरूपेस्मिन्देहे लीनस्य शुद्धये
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ prajuhuyādvirajāhomamātmanaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśatattvarūpesmindehe līnasya śuddhaye
verses.translation: Fragrant sandal wood, auspicious.\ksatas and charming fragrant flowers shall also be offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fragrant sandal wood, auspicious.\ksatas and charming fragrant flowers shall also be offered.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वान्येतानि मद्देहे शुध्यन्तामित्यनुस्मरन् । तत्रात्मतत्त्वशुद्ध्यर्थं मन्त्रैरारुणकेतुकैः
verses.transliteration: tattvānyetāni maddehe śudhyantāmityanusmaran | tatrātmatattvaśuddhyarthaṃ mantrairāruṇaketukaiḥ
verses.translation: Fragrant incense and lamp with wicks soaked in ghee shall be offered saying "I dedicate everything." Om should be uttered in the beginning and Namah at the end. Then milk pudding with honey shall be offered along with ghee, sugar, sweet pie and plantain fruits stuffed with jag¬ gery.
verses.wordMeaning: Fragrant incense and lamp with wicks soaked in ghee shall be offered saying "I dedicate everything." Om should be uttered in the beginning and Namah at the end. Then milk pudding with honey shall be offered along with ghee, sugar,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Fragrant incense and lamp with wicks soaked in ghee shall be offered saying "I dedicate everything." Om should be uttered in the beginning and Namah at the end. Then milk pudding with honey shall be offered along with ghee, sugar,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पठ्यमानैः पृथिव्यादिपुरुषान्तं क्रमान्मुने । साज्येन चरुणा मौनी शिवपादाम्बुजं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: paṭhyamānaiḥ pṛthivyādipuruṣāntaṃ kramānmune | sājyena caruṇā maunī śivapādāmbujaṃ smaran
verses.translation: Different articles shall be heaped on separate plantain leaves and rendered fragrant. They shall be sprinkled with water uttering "Bhuh Bhuvah Svah."
verses.commentary: Sense: Different articles shall be heaped on separate plantain leaves and rendered fragrant. They shall be sprinkled with water uttering "Bhuh Bhuvah Svah."
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यादि च शब्दादि वागाद्यं पञ्चकं पुनः । श्रोत्राद्यं च शिरः पार्श्वपृष्ठोदरचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyādi ca śabdādi vāgādyaṃ pañcakaṃ punaḥ | śrotrādyaṃ ca śiraḥ pārśvapṛṣṭhodaracatuṣṭayam
verses.translation: Naivedya shall be offered with; "Om Hrim Svaha". With "Namah" water shall be offered with great devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Naivedya shall be offered with; "Om Hrim Svaha". With "Namah" water shall be offered with great devotion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घां च योजयेत्पश्चात्त्वगाद्यं धातुसप्तकम् । प्राणाद्यं पञ्चकं पश्चादन्नाद्यं कोशपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: jaṅghāṃ ca yojayetpaścāttvagādyaṃ dhātusaptakam | prāṇādyaṃ pañcakaṃ paścādannādyaṃ kośapañcakam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thereafter the rite of Udvasana shall be performed with devotion. The place shall be mopped clean beginning with the east. Then water for gargling and Acamana shall be offered with Arghya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, thereafter the rite of Udvasana shall be performed with devotion. The place shall be mopped clean beginning with the east. Then water for gargling and Acamana shall be offered with Arghya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनश्चित्तं च बुद्धिश्चाहङ्कृतिः ख्यातिरेव च । सङ्कल्पं तु गुणाः पश्चात्प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्ततः
verses.transliteration: manaścittaṃ ca buddhiścāhaṅkṛtiḥ khyātireva ca | saṅkalpaṃ tu guṇāḥ paścātprakṛtiḥ puruṣastataḥ
verses.translation: After offering Tambida, incense and lights, the circumambulation and obeisance shall be performed. The
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering Tambida, incense and lights, the circumambulation and obeisance shall be performed. The
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषस्य तु भोक्तृत्वं प्रतिपन्नस्य भोजने । अन्तरङ्गतया तत्त्वपञ्चकं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: puruṣasya tu bhoktṛtvaṃ pratipannasya bhojane | antaraṅgatayā tattvapañcakaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: "May the glorious mothers be delighted. At the lotus-like feet of Paramesa let them recommend the pro¬ tection of the deceased ascetic who is desirous of attaining the region of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: "May the glorious mothers be delighted. At the lotus-like feet of Paramesa let them recommend the pro¬ tection of the deceased ascetic who is desirous of attaining the region of Siva.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नियतिः कालरागश्च विद्या च तदनन्तरम् । कला च पञ्चकमिदं मयोत्पन्नं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: niyatiḥ kālarāgaśca vidyā ca tadanantaram | kalā ca pañcakamidaṃ mayotpannaṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: After ritualistically dismissing them along the way they had come, the remanents of the Naivedya shall be distributed among the virgins.
verses.commentary: Sense: After ritualistically dismissing them along the way they had come, the remanents of the Naivedya shall be distributed among the virgins.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यादिति माया श्रुतीरिता । तज्जान्येतानि तत्त्वानि श्रुत्युक्तानि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyāditi māyā śrutīritā | tajjānyetāni tattvāni śrutyuktāni na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: It shall be given to the cows or cast off into water: There is no other way of disposal. Parvana and not Ekoddista Sraddha shall be performed for an ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be given to the cows or cast off into water: There is no other way of disposal. Parvana and not Ekoddista Sraddha shall be performed for an ascetic.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अजानन्पञ्चतत्त्वानि विद्वानपि च मूढधीः । निपत्याधस्तात्प्रकृतेरुपरिष्टात्पुमानयम्
verses.transliteration: ajānanpañcatattvāni vidvānapi ca mūḍhadhīḥ | nipatyādhastātprakṛterupariṣṭātpumānayam
verses.translation: The performer of the Parvana shall take his bath, perform Pranayama with pious mind wearing the sacred thread as usual. Wearing the Darbha ring he shall say "On this auspicious Tithi I shall perform the Parvana Jra- ddha." In the place of Asana Darbha grass shall be placed. After Saihkalpa Darbhas shall be cast off to the north. Water shall be touched. He shall invite four 6aiva brahmins who are steady in their rites. The brahmins shall take oil bath after which they shall be made to sit.
verses.wordMeaning: The performer of the Parvana shall take his bath, perform Pranayama with pious mind wearing the sacred thread as usual. Wearing the Darbha ring he shall say "On this auspicious Tithi I shall perform the Parvana Jra- ddha." In the place of Asana Darbha grass shall be placed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The performer of the Parvana shall take his bath, perform Pranayama with pious mind wearing the sacred thread as usual. Wearing the Darbha ring he shall say "On this auspicious Tithi I shall perform the Parvana Jra- ddha." In the place of Asana Darbha grass shall be placed.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काकाक्षिन्यायमाश्रित्य वर्तते पार्श्वतोऽन्वहम् । विद्यातत्त्वमिदं प्रोक्तं शुद्धविद्यामहेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: kākākṣinyāyamāśritya vartate pārśvato'nvaham | vidyātattvamidaṃ proktaṃ śuddhavidyāmaheśvarau
verses.translation: "Ye all shall represent the Visvedevas." After saying this he shall say "obeisance to Atman, Antaratman and Paramatman." Then he shall touch their feet with devo¬ tion.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ye all shall represent the Visvedevas." After saying this he shall say "obeisance to Atman, Antaratman and Paramatman." Then he shall touch their feet with devo¬ tion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवश्च शक्तिश्च शिवश्चेदं तु पञ्चकम् । शिवतत्त्वमिदं ब्रह्मन् प्रज्ञानं ब्रह्म वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: sadāśivaśca śaktiśca śivaścedaṃ tu pañcakam | śivatattvamidaṃ brahman prajñānaṃ brahma vāgyataḥ
verses.translation: The feet of the brahmins shall be washed and they shall be made to sit facing the east. After decorating them with scents, sandal paste etc., they shall be led in front of Siva
verses.commentary: Sense: The feet of the brahmins shall be washed and they shall be made to sit facing the east. After decorating them with scents, sandal paste etc., they shall be led in front of Siva
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यादिशिवान्तं यत्तत्त्वजातं मुनीश्वर । स्वकारणलयद्वारा शुद्धिरस्य विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyādiśivāntaṃ yattattvajātaṃ munīśvara | svakāraṇalayadvārā śuddhirasya vidhīyatām
verses.translation: The ground shall be smeared with cowdung. Darbha grass shall be spread with their tips to the east. He shall perform P» anayama and the rite of saihkalpa "I shall offer the Pinda." He shall then worship the Mantjala Atman, Antaratman and the Paramatman turning the face back. "I am giving these Pindas," saying this he shall offer the Pindas with devotion. Water from the Darbha grass shall be offered. Getting up he shall perform circumambul- ation and the Namaskara.
verses.wordMeaning: The ground shall be smeared with cowdung. Darbha grass shall be spread with their tips to the east. He shall perform P» anayama and the rite of saihkalpa "I shall offer the Pinda." He shall then worship the Mantjala Atman, Antaratman and the Paramatman turning the face back.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground shall be smeared with cowdung. Darbha grass shall be spread with their tips to the east. He shall perform P» anayama and the rite of saihkalpa "I shall offer the Pinda." He shall then worship the Mantjala Atman, Antaratman and the Paramatman turning the face back.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकादशानां मन्त्राणां परस्मैपदपूर्वकम् । शिवज्योतिश्चतुर्थ्यन्तमिदं पदमथोच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: ekādaśānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ parasmaipadapūrvakam | śivajyotiścaturthyantamidaṃ padamathoccaret
verses.translation: After giving gifts to the Brahmins according to the rules he shall offer Narayana Bali at the same spot on the same day.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving gifts to the Brahmins according to the rules he shall offer Narayana Bali at the same spot on the same day.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न ममेति वदेत्पश्चादुद्देशत्याग ईरितः । अतः परं विविद्यैति कर्षोत्कायेति मन्त्रयोः
verses.transliteration: na mameti vadetpaścāduddeśatyāga īritaḥ | ataḥ paraṃ vividyaiti karṣotkāyeti mantrayoḥ
verses.translation: Everywhere Visnu shall be worshipped for protec¬ tion. He shall perform the worship of Visnu and offer milk pudding as Naivcdya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everywhere Visnu shall be worshipped for protec¬ tion. He shall perform the worship of Visnu and offer milk pudding as Naivcdya.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यापकाय पदस्यान्ते परमात्मन इत्यपि । शिवज्योतिश्चतुर्थ्यन्तं विश्वभूतपदं पुनः
verses.transliteration: vyāpakāya padasyānte paramātmana ityapi | śivajyotiścaturthyantaṃ viśvabhūtapadaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: He shall invite twelve brahmins who are masters of the Vedas. He shall worship them in the names of Keava etc. with scents, flowers and Aksatas. He shall propitiate them and offer them shoes, umbrella, cloth, accor¬ ding to the rules. He shall speak to them sweet, auspicious words.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall invite twelve brahmins who are masters of the Vedas. He shall worship them in the names of Keava etc. with scents, flowers and Aksatas. He shall propitiate them and offer them shoes, umbrella, cloth, accor¬ ding to the rules. He shall speak to them sweet,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall invite twelve brahmins who are masters of the Vedas. He shall worship them in the names of Keava etc. with scents, flowers and Aksatas. He shall propitiate them and offer them shoes, umbrella, cloth, accor¬ ding to the rules. He shall speak to them sweet,…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घसनोत्सुकशब्दश्च चतुर्थ्यन्तमथो वदेत् । परस्मैपदमुच्चार्य देवाय पदमुच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: ghasanotsukaśabdaśca caturthyantamatho vadet | parasmaipadamuccārya devāya padamuccaret
verses.translation: He shall spread Darbha grass on the ground with their tips to the east. After saying "Bhuh Svaha, Bhuvah Svaha, Suvah Svaha, Om." He shall offer milk pudding as oblation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall spread Darbha grass on the ground with their tips to the east. After saying "Bhuh Svaha, Bhuvah Svaha, Suvah Svaha, Om." He shall offer milk pudding as oblation.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठस्वेति मन्त्रस्य विश्वरूपाय शब्दतः । पुरुषाय पदं ब्रूयादोंस्वाहेत्यस्य संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭhasveti mantrasya viśvarūpāya śabdataḥ | puruṣāya padaṃ brūyādoṃsvāhetyasya saṃvadet
verses.translation: O great sage, the rite of the eleventh day has been mentioned by me. O brahmin, I shall now explain the twelfthday rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, the rite of the eleventh day has been mentioned by me. O brahmin, I shall now explain the twelfthday rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वशाखोक्तप्रकारेण पुरस्तात्तन्त्रकर्म च । निर्वर्त्य सर्पिषा मिश्रं चरुं प्राश्य पुरोधसे
verses.transliteration: svaśākhoktaprakāreṇa purastāttantrakarma ca | nirvartya sarpiṣā miśraṃ caruṃ prāśya purodhase
verses.translation: In the presence of Paramea they shall be worship¬ ped in accordance with the Paficavarana rites after perfor¬ ming Pranayama. As in the case of Mahasamkalpa he shall perform the Samkalpa rite thus, "I shall perform the worship of the pcrceptor." He shall then touch the Darbhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the presence of Paramea they shall be worship¬ ped in accordance with the Paficavarana rites after perfor¬ ming Pranayama. As in the case of Mahasamkalpa he shall perform the Samkalpa rite thus, "I shall perform the worship of the pcrceptor." He shall then touch the Darbhas.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रदद्याद् दक्षिणां तस्मै हेमादिपरिबृंहिताम् । ब्रह्माणमुद्वास्य ततः प्रातरौपासनं हुनेत्
verses.transliteration: pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tasmai hemādiparibṛṃhitām | brahmāṇamudvāsya tataḥ prātaraupāsanaṃ hunet
verses.translation: After washing his feet and performing Acamana he shall make them sit facing east. Ashes shall be smeared all over the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: After washing his feet and performing Acamana he shall make them sit facing east. Ashes shall be smeared all over the body.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुत इति मन्त्रं जपेन्नरः । याते अग्न इत्यनेन मन्त्रेणाग्नौ प्रताप्य च
verses.transliteration: saṃ mā siñcantu maruta iti mantraṃ japennaraḥ | yāte agna ityanena mantreṇāgnau pratāpya ca
verses.translation: O sage, the eight — Sadasiva etc. shall be meditated upon and the brahmins shall be treated with respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the eight — Sadasiva etc. shall be meditated upon and the brahmins shall be treated with respect.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तमग्नौ समारोप्य स्वात्मन्यद्वैतधामनि । प्राभातिकीं ततः सन्ध्यामुपास्यादित्यमप्यथ
verses.transliteration: hastamagnau samāropya svātmanyadvaitadhāmani | prābhātikīṃ tataḥ sandhyāmupāsyādityamapyatha
verses.translation: He shall then meditate on Paramesthi Guru as Samba with his own name. Paramaguru and Parat Paraguru shall also be meditated upon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then meditate on Paramesthi Guru as Samba with his own name. Paramaguru and Parat Paraguru shall also be meditated upon.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपस्थाय प्रविश्याप्सु नाभिदघ्नं प्रवेशयन् । तन्मन्त्रां पेरजपेत्प्रीत्या निश्चलात्मा समुत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: upasthāya praviśyāpsu nābhidaghnaṃ praveśayan | tanmantrāṃ perajapetprītyā niścalātmā samutsukaḥ
verses.translation: He shall say "Here is the seat" and offer seat. With Om as prefix his name shall be mentioned in the accus¬ ative case with the addition '*1 invoke, obeisance". He shall then offer Padya, Acamana, Arghya, cloth, scents and Aksatas. They shall be decorated with flowers. Their names shall be mentioned in the Dative case with Om prefixed and wor¬ shipped with fragrant flowers. After fumigating with the incense and offering lights he shall say, ' The entire rites of propitiation are over. May they be perfect and complete" and perform obeisance and get up.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall say "Here is the seat" and offer seat. With Om as prefix his name shall be mentioned in the accus¬ ative case with the addition '*1 invoke, obeisance". He shall then offer Padya, Acamana, Arghya, cloth, scents and Aksatas. They shall be decorated with flowers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall say "Here is the seat" and offer seat. With Om as prefix his name shall be mentioned in the accus¬ ative case with the addition '*1 invoke, obeisance". He shall then offer Padya, Acamana, Arghya, cloth, scents and Aksatas. They shall be decorated with flowers.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निस्तु यः कुर्यात्प्राजापत्येष्टिमाहिते । श्रौते वैश्वानरे सम्यक् सर्ववेदसदक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: āhitāgnistu yaḥ kuryātprājāpatyeṣṭimāhite | śraute vaiśvānare samyak sarvavedasadakṣiṇām
verses.translation: Plantain leaves shall be spread and cleaned with water. Pure cooked nice, milk pudding, sweet pies, cooked dal, vegetable dishes, and other food stuffs shall be placed over them along with plantain fruits, coconuts and jaggery. Darbha grass is put under each leaf. These shall be sprinkled and the Parisecana, the sprinkling of foodstuffs shall be performed, lie shall then say "Protect the Havya of Visnu" and make them touch the articles.
verses.wordMeaning: Plantain leaves shall be spread and cleaned with water. Pure cooked nice, milk pudding, sweet pies, cooked dal, vegetable dishes, and other food stuffs shall be placed over them along with plantain fruits, coconuts and jaggery. Darbha grass is put under each leaf.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Plantain leaves shall be spread and cleaned with water. Pure cooked nice, milk pudding, sweet pies, cooked dal, vegetable dishes, and other food stuffs shall be placed over them along with plantain fruits, coconuts and jaggery. Darbha grass is put under each leaf.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथाग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य ब्राह्मणः प्रव्रजेद् गुहात् । सावित्रीप्रथमं पादं सावित्रीमित्युदीर्य च
verses.transliteration: athāgnimātmanyāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed guhāt | sāvitrīprathamaṃ pādaṃ sāvitrīmityudīrya ca
verses.translation: He shall stand up and offer giving water for drinking he shall request them thus, "May Sadauva and others be delighted with me and bestow boons on me".
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall stand up and offer giving water for drinking he shall request them thus, "May Sadauva and others be delighted with me and bestow boons on me".
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूरोमिति च संवदेत् । द्वितीयं पादमुच्चार्य सावित्रीमिति पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: praveśayāmi śabdānte bhūromiti ca saṃvadet | dvitīyaṃ pādamuccārya sāvitrīmiti pūrvavat
verses.translation: He shall then recite the mantra "Ye deva"" etc. and scatter Aksatas. He shall prostrate, stand up and say "Everywhere may there be nectar''.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then recite the mantra "Ye deva"" etc. and scatter Aksatas. He shall prostrate, stand up and say "Everywhere may there be nectar''.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूरोमिति च संवदेत् । तृतीयं पादमुच्चार्य सावित्रीमित्यतः परम्
verses.transliteration: praveśayāmi śabdānte bhūromiti ca saṃvadet | tṛtīyaṃ pādamuccārya sāvitrīmityataḥ param
verses.translation: After saying this to Vamadeva his discij)le blessed by himself, the wise lord Subrahmauya delighted in mind said: —
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to Vamadeva his discij)le blessed by himself, the wise lord Subrahmauya delighted in mind said: —
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूर्भुवः सुवरोमिति । उदीरयेत्परं प्रीत्या निश्चलात्मा मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: praveśayāmi śabdānte bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaromiti | udīrayetparaṃ prītyā niścalātmā munīśvara
verses.translation: For every leading sage there will be four disciples. They will be masters of Vedic study and establish virtuous sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: For every leading sage there will be four disciples. They will be masters of Vedic study and establish virtuous sacred rites.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इयं भगवती साक्षाच्छङ्करार्द्धशरीरिणी । पञ्चवक्त्रा दशभुजा त्रिपञ्चनयनोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ bhagavatī sākṣācchaṅkarārddhaśarīriṇī | pañcavaktrā daśabhujā tripañcanayanojjvalā
verses.translation: The four disciples of Vyasa are Vaihiinpayana, Paila, Jaimini and Sumantu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four disciples of Vyasa are Vaihiinpayana, Paila, Jaimini and Sumantu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नवरत्नकिरीटोद्यच्चन्द्रलेखावतंसिनी । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशा दशायुधधरा शुभा
verses.transliteration: navaratnakirīṭodyaccandralekhāvataṃsinī | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā daśāyudhadharā śubhā
verses.translation: O sage Vamadeva, your disciples are Agasi ya, Pulastya, Pulaha and Kratu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage Vamadeva, your disciples are Agasi ya, Pulastya, Pulaha and Kratu.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हारकेयूरकटककिङ्किणीनूपुरादिभिः । भूषितावयवा दिव्यवसना रत्नभूषणा
verses.transliteration: hārakeyūrakaṭakakiṅkiṇīnūpurādibhiḥ | bhūṣitāvayavā divyavasanā ratnabhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatanamuni, and Sanatsu- j.lta, these great yogins, favourites of Siva, the knowers of the Vedas are the disciples of Sanatkumara. Thus the.se pre¬ ceptors, great preceptors etc. are worthy of being worshipped by the yogin Suka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatanamuni, and Sanatsu- j.lta, these great yogins, favourites of Siva, the knowers of the Vedas are the disciples of Sanatkumara. Thus the.se pre¬ ceptors, great preceptors etc. are worthy of being worshipped by the yogin Suka.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना विधिना देवऋषिगन्धर्वदानवैः । मानवैश्च सदा सेव्या सर्वात्मव्यापिनी शिवा
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā vidhinā devaṛṣigandharvadānavaiḥ | mānavaiśca sadā sevyā sarvātmavyāpinī śivā
verses.translation: This Manala as the seat of the great Jsiva is wonder¬ ful. It is worshipped by the great sages conversant with the essence of Vedanta. It is enveloped by the ether as mentioned in the Vedas. May it be conducive to your satisfaction and the welfare of the world. May it yield glory and prosperity.
verses.wordMeaning: This Manala as the seat of the great Jsiva is wonder¬ ful. It is worshipped by the great sages conversant with the essence of Vedanta. It is enveloped by the ether as mentioned in the Vedas. May it be conducive to your satisfaction and the welfare of the world.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Manala as the seat of the great Jsiva is wonder¬ ful. It is worshipped by the great sages conversant with the essence of Vedanta. It is enveloped by the ether as mentioned in the Vedas. May it be conducive to your satisfaction and the welfare of the world.…
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवस्य देवस्य धर्मपत्नी मनोहरा । जगदम्बा त्रिजननी त्रिगुणा निर्गुणाप्यजा
verses.transliteration: sadāśivasya devasya dharmapatnī manoharā | jagadambā trijananī triguṇā nirguṇāpyajā
verses.translation: Hence an ascetic who treads along this path attains Siva like the rivers that fall into the sea. By the repeated practice of the meditation "I am Siva", the ascetic becomes Siva. He can grant salvation even to the class of beings Brahma etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence an ascetic who treads along this path attains Siva like the rivers that fall into the sea. By the repeated practice of the meditation "I am Siva", the ascetic becomes Siva. He can grant salvation even to the class of beings Brahma etc.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं संविचार्याथ गायत्रीं प्रजपेत्सुधीः । आदिदेवीं च त्रिपदां ब्राह्मणत्वादिदामजाम्
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ saṃvicāryātha gāyatrīṃ prajapetsudhīḥ | ādidevīṃ ca tripadāṃ brāhmaṇatvādidāmajām
verses.translation: After teaching this to. the sage the lord of gods remembered the lotus-like feet of his parents worshipped by the gods. Kumara reached Kailasa of many peaks, Kumara the preceptor who bestows perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: After teaching this to. the sage the lord of gods remembered the lotus-like feet of his parents worshipped by the gods. Kumara reached Kailasa of many peaks, Kumara the preceptor who bestows perfect knowledge.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो ह्यन्यथा जपेत्पापो गायत्रीं शिवरूपिणीम् । स पच्यते महाघोरे नरके कल्पसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: yo hyanyathā japetpāpo gāyatrīṃ śivarūpiṇīm | sa pacyate mahāghore narake kalpasaṅkhyayā
verses.translation: Accompanied by his disciples and making obei¬ sance to the peacock-vehicled lord, Vamadeva too immediately left for the wonderful mountain Kailasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his disciples and making obei¬ sance to the peacock-vehicled lord, Vamadeva too immediately left for the wonderful mountain Kailasa.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा व्याहृतिभ्यः सञ्जाता तास्वेव विलयं गता । ताश्च प्रणवसम्भूता प्रणवे विलयं गताः
verses.transliteration: sā vyāhṛtibhyaḥ sañjātā tāsveva vilayaṃ gatā | tāśca praṇavasambhūtā praṇave vilayaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: After reaching the summit of Kailasa the sage approached Siva. He saw the feet of the lord and the godd¬ ess— the feet that bestow salvation and destroy illusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the summit of Kailasa the sage approached Siva. He saw the feet of the lord and the godd¬ ess— the feet that bestow salvation and destroy illusion.
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवो वा प्रणवो ह्येष प्रणवो वा शिवः स्मृतः । वाच्यवाचकयोर्भेदो नात्यन्तं विद्यते यतः
verses.transliteration: śivo vā praṇavo hyeṣa praṇavo vā śivaḥ smṛtaḥ | vācyavācakayorbhedo nātyantaṃ vidyate yataḥ
verses.translation: Shiva is the pranava, and the pranava is remembered as Shiva, since there is no absolute difference between the denoted and the word that denotes it.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एनमेव महामन्त्रं जीवानां च तनुत्यजाम् । काश्यां संश्राव्य मरणे दत्ते मुक्तिं परां शिवः
verses.transliteration: enameva mahāmantraṃ jīvānāṃ ca tanutyajām | kāśyāṃ saṃśrāvya maraṇe datte muktiṃ parāṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Imparting this very great mantra at death to beings leaving their bodies in Kashi, Shiva gives them supreme liberation.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवं शिवं परमकारणम् । उपासते यतिश्रेष्ठा हृदयाम्भोजमध्यगम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādekākṣaraṃ devaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam | upāsate yatiśreṣṭhā hṛdayāmbhojamadhyagam
verses.translation: Therefore the best of ascetics worship the one-syllabled god Shiva, the supreme cause, abiding in the lotus of the heart.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुमुक्षवोऽपरे धीरा विरक्ता लौकिका नराः । विषयान्मनसा ज्ञात्वोपासते परमं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: mumukṣavo'pare dhīrā viraktā laukikā narāḥ | viṣayānmanasā jñātvopāsate paramaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Other steadfast seekers of liberation, dispassionate worldly men, having understood the objects of sense with the mind, worship the supreme Shiva.
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विलाप्य गायत्रीं प्रणवे शिववाचके । अहं वृक्षस्य रेरिवेत्यनुवाकं जपेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vilāpya gāyatrīṃ praṇave śivavācake | ahaṃ vṛkṣasya rerivetyanuvākaṃ japetpunaḥ
verses.translation: Having thus dissolved the Gayatri into the pranava that denotes Shiva, one should then recite the anuvaka "aham vrikshasya reriva."
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: यश्छन्दसामामृषभ इत्यनुवाकमुपक्रमात् । गोपायान्तं जपन्पश्चादुत्थितोहमितीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: yaśchandasāmāmṛṣabha ityanuvākamupakramāt | gopāyāntaṃ japanpaścādutthitohamitīrayet
verses.translation: Beginning with the anuvaka "yash chhandasam rishabhah" and reciting it up to "gopaya," one should afterwards rise and say "utthito 'ham."
verses.explanation: ॥ समाप्तेयं षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
