verses.sanskrit: तस्मै प्रथमपुत्राय ब्रह्मणे विश्वयोनये । विद्याश्चेमा ददौ पूर्वं विश्वसृष्ट्यर्थमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasmai prathamaputrāya brahmaṇe viśvayonaye | vidyāścemā dadau pūrvaṃ viśvasṛṣṭyarthamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He abridged and classified the Vedas into four groups. He is known as Vedavyasa.
verses.hindi: कृपासे मैंने इस प्रजापतिपदको प्राप्त किया है
verses.commentary: Sense: He abridged and classified the Vedas into four groups. He is known as Vedavyasa.
verses.science: कृपासे मैंने इस प्रजापतिपदको प्राप्त किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पालनाय हरिं देवं रक्षाशक्तिं ददौ ततः । मध्यमं तनयं विष्णुं पातारं ब्रह्मणोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: pālanāya hariṃ devaṃ rakṣāśaktiṃ dadau tataḥ | madhyamaṃ tanayaṃ viṣṇuṃ pātāraṃ brahmaṇo'pi hi
verses.translation: Even if a brahmin knows the four Vedas with their Angas and the Upanisads he is not an expert if he does not know the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if a brahmin knows the four Vedas with their Angas and the Upanisads he is not an expert if he does not know the Puranas.
verses.science: किया जा सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्धविद्येन विधिना प्रजासृष्टिं वितन्वता । प्रथमं सर्वशास्त्राणां पुराणं ब्रह्मणा स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: labdhavidyena vidhinā prajāsṛṣṭiṃ vitanvatā | prathamaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇaṃ brahmaṇā smṛtam
verses.translation: The knowledge of the Vedas shall he enlarged by
verses.hindi: विश्वको अपने अधीन किये हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge of the Vedas shall he enlarged by
verses.science: विश्वको अपने अधीन किये हुए हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरं तु वक्त्रेभ्यो वेदास्तस्य विनिर्गताः । प्रवृत्तिः सर्वशास्त्राणां तन्मुखादभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: anantaraṃ tu vaktrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ | pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tanmukhādabhavattataḥ
verses.translation: Puranas have five characteristics'* — creation, subsi¬ diary creation, genealogy, manvantaras and the chronological account of kings, these are described in every Purina.
verses.commentary: Sense: Puranas have five characteristics'* — creation, subsi¬ diary creation, genealogy, manvantaras and the chronological account of kings, these are described in every Purina.
verses.science: रहकर कालके भी प्रेरक हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदास्य विस्तरं शक्ता नाधिगन्तुं प्रजा भुवि । तदा विद्यासमासार्थं विश्वेश्वरनियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yadāsya vistaraṃ śaktā nādhigantuṃ prajā bhuvi | tadā vidyāsamāsārthaṃ viśveśvaraniyogataḥ
verses.translation: The sages reckon ten Puranas and eight big Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages reckon ten Puranas and eight big Puranas.
verses.science: दर्शनकी आकांक्षा रखते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरान्तेषु विश्वात्मा विष्णुर्विश्वम्भरः प्रभुः । व्यासनाम्ना चरत्यस्मिन्नवतीर्य महीतले
verses.transliteration: dvāparānteṣu viśvātmā viṣṇurviśvambharaḥ prabhuḥ | vyāsanāmnā caratyasminnavatīrya mahītale
verses.translation: Brahma, Padma, Vaisnava, Saiva, Bhagavata, Bhavisya. Naradlya and Markandeya are the eight big Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Padma, Vaisnava, Saiva, Bhagavata, Bhavisya. Naradlya and Markandeya are the eight big Puranas.
verses.science: हैं और सम्भाषणके योग्य हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यस्ताश्च वेदाश्च द्वापरे द्वापरे द्विजाः । निर्मितानि पुराणानि अन्यानि च ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vyastāśca vedāśca dvāpare dvāpare dvijāḥ | nirmitāni purāṇāni anyāni ca tataḥ param
verses.translation: Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Liiiga, Varaha, Skanda, Vamana, Kurma, Matsya, Garuda and Brahmanda are the ten small Puranas. These are the eighteen Puranas in order. Sivapurana, the fourth in the list belongs to Siva and is conducive to the achievement of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Liiiga, Varaha, Skanda, Vamana, Kurma, Matsya, Garuda and Brahmanda are the ten small Puranas. These are the eighteen Puranas in order. Sivapurana, the fourth in the list belongs to Siva and is conducive to the achievement of all objects.
verses.science: द्वारा ही दृश्य है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स पुनर्द्वापरे चास्मिन्कृष्णद्वैपायनाख्यया । अरण्यामिव हव्याशी सत्यवत्यामजायत
verses.transliteration: sa punardvāpare cāsminkṛṣṇadvaipāyanākhyayā | araṇyāmiva havyāśī satyavatyāmajāyata
verses.translation: It contains a hundred thousand verses. It is divided into twelve Sarhhitas. It is created by Siva. All sacred rites are mentioned therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: It contains a hundred thousand verses. It is divided into twelve Sarhhitas. It is created by Siva. All sacred rites are mentioned therein.
verses.science: ज्ञानपूर्विका भक्ति उत्पन्न होती है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्षिप्य स पुनर्वेदांश्चतुर्द्धा कृतवान्मुनिः । सङ्क्षिप्तान् स पुनर्देदान् चक्रेऽष्टादशधा मुनिः । व्यस्तवेदतया लोके वेदव्यास इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: saṅkṣipya sa punarvedāṃścaturddhā kṛtavānmuniḥ | saṅkṣiptān sa punardedān cakre'ṣṭādaśadhā muniḥ | vyastavedatayā loke vedavyāsa iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: Men are classified under three castes in accor¬ dance with their duties. Hence he who wishes for liberation shall resort to Siva alone.
verses.hindi: यद्यपि भक्त स्वरूपत: कर्म करता रहता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Men are classified under three castes in accor¬ dance with their duties. Hence he who wishes for liberation shall resort to Siva alone.
verses.science: यद्यपि भक्त स्वरूपत: कर्म करता रहता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणानां च सङ्क्षिप्तं चतुर्लक्षप्रमाणतः । अद्यापि देवलोके तच्छतकोटिप्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: purāṇānāṃ ca saṅkṣiptaṃ caturlakṣapramāṇataḥ | adyāpi devaloke tacchatakoṭipravistaram
verses.translation: Even the gods can attain liberation by resorting to him alone and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the gods can attain liberation by resorting to him alone and not otherwise.
verses.science: दूसरा गुरुकी अपेक्षा रखनेवाला। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो विद्याच्चतुरो वेदान् साङ्गोपनिषदो द्विजः । न चेत्पुराणं संविद्यान्नैव स स्याद्विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: yo vidyāccaturo vedān sāṅgopaniṣado dvijaḥ | na cetpurāṇaṃ saṃvidyānnaiva sa syādvicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: What I mentioned as the Sivapurana on a par with the Vedas, know its creations as I briefly explain.
verses.hindi: ही शिव-ज्ञानकी प्राप्ति कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: What I mentioned as the Sivapurana on a par with the Vedas, know its creations as I briefly explain.
verses.science: ही शिव-ज्ञानकी प्राप्ति कर लेता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदं समुपबृंहयेत् । बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद्वेदो मामयं प्रहरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet | bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ prahariṣyati
verses.translation: Thus Sivapurana contains a thousand verses.
verses.hindi: हो जानेपर वह शिवके समान हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Sivapurana contains a thousand verses.
verses.science: हो जानेपर वह शिवके समान हो जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च । वंशानुचरितं चैव पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca | vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: On till: rhavacU'iistics. nomcnclaturr and number of the Puranas see Irtroduction to Vol. I.
verses.commentary: Sense: On till: rhavacU'iistics. nomcnclaturr and number of the Puranas see Irtroduction to Vol. I.
verses.science: ञ्से अनुग्रह प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशधा चाष्टधा चैतत्पुराणमुपदिश्यते । बृहत्सूक्ष्मप्रभेदेन मुनिभिस्तत्त्ववित्तमैः
verses.transliteration: daśadhā cāṣṭadhā caitatpurāṇamupadiśyate | bṛhatsūkṣmaprabhedena munibhistattvavittamaiḥ
verses.translation: The first Samhita is Vid yes vara; the second Rudrasarhhita; the third Satanidia. Kotirudra is the fourth. Umasariihita is the fifth; the sixtli is Kailasa. The seventh is Vayavlya. These are only seven conipendiiuns.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first Samhita is Vid yes vara; the second Rudrasarhhita; the third Satanidia. Kotirudra is the fourth. Umasariihita is the fifth; the sixtli is Kailasa. The seventh is Vayavlya. These are only seven conipendiiuns.
verses.science: मुक्ति होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा । भविष्यं नारदीयं च मार्कण्डेयमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā | bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyamataḥ param
verses.translation: Vidyesvara contains two thousand verses, Rudra ten thousand five hundred; Satarudra two thousand one hundred and eighty; Kotirudra two thousand two hun¬ dred and forty; Uma one thousand eight hundred and forty; Kailasa one thousand two hundred and forty and the Vayaviya four thousand verses. Thus is the holy text of Sivapurana.
verses.wordMeaning: Vidyesvara contains two thousand verses, Rudra ten thousand five hundred; Satarudra two thousand one hundred and eighty; Kotirudra two thousand two hun¬ dred and forty; Uma one thousand eight hundred and forty;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vidyesvara contains two thousand verses, Rudra ten thousand five hundred; Satarudra two thousand one hundred and eighty; Kotirudra two thousand two hun¬ dred and forty; Uma one thousand eight hundred and forty;…
verses.science: हुए समस्त क्रियाएँ करनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गं वाराहमेव च । स्कान्दं च वामनं चैव कौर्मं मात्स्यं च गारुडम्
verses.transliteration: āgneyaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgaṃ vārāhameva ca | skāndaṃ ca vāmanaṃ caiva kaurmaṃ mātsyaṃ ca gāruḍam
verses.translation: I shall now begin the Vayaviya containing four thousand veises and consisting of two parts.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now begin the Vayaviya containing four thousand veises and consisting of two parts.
verses.science: एक ही जन्ममें मिल जायगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डं चेति पुण्योऽयं पुराणानामनुक्रमः । तत्र शैवं तुरीयं यच्छार्वं सर्वार्थसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍaṃ ceti puṇyo'yaṃ purāṇānāmanukramaḥ | tatra śaivaṃ turīyaṃ yacchārvaṃ sarvārthasādhakam
verses.translation: This excellent Sastra shall not be uicntiouefl to one who is not conversant with the Vedas nor to one who has no faith noi to one who does not know the Puriinas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent Sastra shall not be uicntiouefl to one who is not conversant with the Vedas nor to one who has no faith noi to one who does not know the Puriinas.
verses.science: कुशोंसे उन्हें विनष्ट कर दिया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रन्थो लक्षप्रमाणं तद्व्यस्तं द्वादशसंहितम् । निर्मितं तच्छिवेनैव तत्र धर्मः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: grantho lakṣapramāṇaṃ tadvyastaṃ dvādaśasaṃhitam | nirmitaṃ tacchivenaiva tatra dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: It shalL be given to a tested virtuous disciple un- conlaininatcd by malice. He shall be a devotee of Siva and a follower of the Saiva cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shalL be given to a tested virtuous disciple un- conlaininatcd by malice. He shall be a devotee of Siva and a follower of the Saiva cult.
verses.science: नैमिषोपाख्यानं नाम तृ्तीयो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तदुक्तेनैव धर्मेण शैवास्त्रैवर्णिका नराः । तस्माद्विमुक्तिमन्विच्छन् शिवमेव समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: taduktenaiva dharmeṇa śaivāstraivarṇikā narāḥ | tasmādvimuktimanvicchan śivameva samāśrayet
verses.translation: Obeisance to the holy sigc Vyasa of brilliant splendour whoso grace has endowed me with the Puranic lore.
verses.hindi: :. नैमिषोपाख्यान नामक तीसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the holy sigc Vyasa of brilliant splendour whoso grace has endowed me with the Puranic lore.
verses.science: :. नैमिषोपाख्यान नामक तीसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तमाश्रित्यैव देवानामपि मुक्तिर्न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tamāśrityaiva devānāmapi muktirna cānyathā
verses.translation: In oi'der to see the eternal creator they went where the lord was staying eulogised by gods and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: In oi'der to see the eternal creator they went where the lord was staying eulogised by gods and Asuras.
verses.science: प्रजापतियोंका यज्ञ था। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदिदं शैवमाख्यातं पुराणं वेदसम्मितम् । तस्य भेदान्समासेन ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: yadidaṃ śaivamākhyātaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitam | tasya bhedānsamāsena bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: It was on the auspicious and charming peak of Meru," where there were plenty of gods and Asuras where Siddhas and Garanas thronged, where Yaksas and Gandharvas freqiuMited, where flocks of birds chirped and crew, which was embellished by jewels and corals and which shone due to streams and rivulets, caves and crevices, bushes and hedges.
verses.wordMeaning: It was on the auspicious and charming peak of Meru," where there were plenty of gods and Asuras where Siddhas and Garanas thronged, where Yaksas and Gandharvas freqiuMited, where flocks of birds chirped and crew,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was on the auspicious and charming peak of Meru," where there were plenty of gods and Asuras where Siddhas and Garanas thronged, where Yaksas and Gandharvas freqiuMited, where flocks of birds chirped and crew,…
verses.science: वहाँ स्वयं वायुदेव आये। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वरं तथा रौद्रं वैनायकमनुत्तमम् । औमं मातृपुराणं च रुद्रैकादशकं तथा
verses.transliteration: vidyeśvaraṃ tathā raudraṃ vaināyakamanuttamam | aumaṃ mātṛpurāṇaṃ ca rudraikādaśakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: It had lofty ramparts and portals made of molten gold. It was embellished by hundreds of main streets, turrets and wooden ceilincrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had lofty ramparts and portals made of molten gold. It was embellished by hundreds of main streets, turrets and wooden ceilincrs.
verses.science: प्रतीक्षा कर रहे हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कैलासं शतरुद्रं च कोटिरुद्राख्यमेव च । सहस्रकोटिरुद्राख्यं वायवीयं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsaṃ śatarudraṃ ca koṭirudrākhyameva ca | sahasrakoṭirudrākhyaṃ vāyavīyaṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: It appeared to lick the sky with crorcs of huge mansions set with precious gems of variegated colours. It was decorated with many such mansions.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appeared to lick the sky with crorcs of huge mansions set with precious gems of variegated colours. It was decorated with many such mansions.
verses.science: अतिरिक्त अन्य कुछ नहीं था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मसंज्ञं पुराणं चेत्येवं द्वादश संहिताः । विद्येशं दशसाहस्रमुदितं ग्रन्थसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: dharmasaṃjñaṃ purāṇaṃ cetyevaṃ dvādaśa saṃhitāḥ | vidyeśaṃ daśasāhasramuditaṃ granthasaṅkhyayā
verses.translation: Lord Brahma resides tlicre along with his coun¬ cillors. Going there the sages.saw the lord, the noble Atman served by the groups of gods and sages. He was shining like pure gold. He was bedecked in all ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma resides tlicre along with his coun¬ cillors. Going there the sages.saw the lord, the noble Atman served by the groups of gods and sages. He was shining like pure gold. He was bedecked in all ornaments.
verses.science: सर्गादि शार्वमैश्वर्थ समासादवदद् विभु:॥ २४ बताया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रं वैनायकं चौमं मातृकाख्यं ततः परम् । प्रत्येकमष्टसाहस्रं त्रयोदशसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: raudraṃ vaināyakaṃ caumaṃ mātṛkākhyaṃ tataḥ param | pratyekamaṣṭasāhasraṃ trayodaśasahasrakam
verses.translation: Accompanied by Sarasvati 'whose body had all auspicious marks who held the chowrics in her hands, he shone a- the sun with his dazzling light.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Sarasvati 'whose body had all auspicious marks who held the chowrics in her hands, he shone a- the sun with his dazzling light.
verses.science: वायुसमागमो नाम चतुर्थो5 ध्याय:। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रकादशकाख्यं यत् कैलासं षट्सहस्रकम् । शतरुद्रं त्रिसाहस्रं कोटिरुद्रं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: raudrakādaśakākhyaṃ yat kailāsaṃ ṣaṭsahasrakam | śatarudraṃ trisāhasraṃ koṭirudraṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: On seeing him the sages were delighted and their eyes and faces shone. With palms joined in reverence and held over their heads they eulogised the leading god.
verses.hindi: वायुसमागम नामक चौथा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him the sages were delighted and their eyes and faces shone. With palms joined in reverence and held over their heads they eulogised the leading god.
verses.science: वायुसमागम नामक चौथा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रैर्नवभिर्युक्तं सर्वार्थज्ञानसंयुतम् । सहस्रकोटिरुद्राख्यमेकादशसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrairnavabhiryuktaṃ sarvārthajñānasaṃyutam | sahasrakoṭirudrākhyamekādaśasahasrakam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you in the form of Trinity, the cause of creation, sustenance and annihilation, the ancient Purusa, Brahma the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you in the form of Trinity, the cause of creation, sustenance and annihilation, the ancient Purusa, Brahma the great Atman.
verses.science: प्रणामकर उनसे पहले पूछा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुस्सहस्रसङ्ख्येयं वायवीयमनुत्तमम् । धर्मसंज्ञं पुराणं यत्तद् द्वादशसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: catussahasrasaṅkhyeyaṃ vāyavīyamanuttamam | dharmasaṃjñaṃ purāṇaṃ yattad dvādaśasahasrakam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity who has Prakrti for his body, who is the cause of quickening Pradhana, who though trans¬ formed into twentythree principles is yet free from aberration.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माजीके शिष्य किस प्रकार हुए ?
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the deity who has Prakrti for his body, who is the cause of quickening Pradhana, who though trans¬ formed into twentythree principles is yet free from aberration.
verses.science: अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माजीके शिष्य किस प्रकार हुए ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदेवं लक्षमुद्दिष्टं शैवं शाखाविभेदतः । पुराणं वेदसारं तद् भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tadevaṃ lakṣamuddiṣṭaṃ śaivaṃ śākhāvibhedataḥ | purāṇaṃ vedasāraṃ tad bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity who has universe for his body, who is stationed within the belly of the universe, who has accomplished his task and whose body is perfectly accom¬ plished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the deity who has universe for his body, who is stationed within the belly of the universe, who has accomplished his task and whose body is perfectly accom¬ plished.
verses.science: प्राप्त करता है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यासेन तत्तु सङ्क्षिप्तं चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रकम् । शैवं तत्र पुराणं वै चतुर्थं सप्तसंहितम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsena tattu saṅkṣiptaṃ caturviṃśatsahasrakam | śaivaṃ tatra purāṇaṃ vai caturthaṃ saptasaṃhitam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity identical with the world, the creator, the sustainer and the annihilator of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the deity identical with the world, the creator, the sustainer and the annihilator of the world.
verses.science: या पशुपति कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वराख्या तत्राद्या द्वितीया रुद्रसंहिता । तृतीया शतरुद्राख्या कोटिरुद्रा चतुर्थिका
verses.transliteration: vidyeśvarākhyā tatrādyā dvitīyā rudrasaṃhitā | tṛtīyā śatarudrākhyā koṭirudrā caturthikā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by the fortunate sages, Brahma spoke to the sages in a majestic tone delighting them.
verses.hindi: क्षराक्षससे परे क्या है ? उसका वर्णन कीजिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised by the fortunate sages, Brahma spoke to the sages in a majestic tone delighting them.
verses.science: क्षराक्षससे परे क्या है ? उसका वर्णन कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमी कथिता चोमा षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता । सप्तमी वायवीयाख्या सप्तैवं संहिता इह
verses.transliteration: pañcamī kathitā comā ṣaṣṭhī kailāsasaṃhitā | saptamī vāyavīyākhyā saptaivaṃ saṃhitā iha
verses.translation: The sages foremost of those who know Brahman spoke with palms joined in reverence, with words couched in humility to lord Brahma who spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages foremost of those who know Brahman spoke with palms joined in reverence, with words couched in humility to lord Brahma who spoke thus.
verses.science: ईश्वर कौन है 2। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वरं द्विसाहस्रं रौद्रं पञ्चशतायुतम् । त्रिंशत्तथा द्विसाहस्रं सार्द्धैकशतमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: vidyeśvaraṃ dvisāhasraṃ raudraṃ pañcaśatāyutam | triṃśattathā dvisāhasraṃ sārddhaikaśatamīritam
verses.translation: O lord, we have been encompassed in deep dark¬ ness. We are distressed. Unable to understand the greatest being we are arguing among ourselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, we have been encompassed in deep dark¬ ness. We are distressed. Unable to understand the greatest being we are arguing among ourselves.
verses.science: दोनोंके प्रेरक ईश्वर हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शतरुद्रं तथा कोटिरुद्रं व्योमयुगाधिकम् । द्विसाहस्रं च द्विशतं तथौमं भूसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: śatarudraṃ tathā koṭirudraṃ vyomayugādhikam | dvisāhasraṃ ca dviśataṃ tathaumaṃ bhūsahasrakam
verses.translation: Indeed you are the creator of the universe. You are the cause of all causes. O lord, there is nothing here not known to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed you are the creator of the universe. You are the cause of all causes. O lord, there is nothing here not known to you.
verses.science: है तथा शिव कौन है ?। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत्साष्टशतं कैलासं भूसहस्रकम् । चत्वारिंशच्च द्विशतं वायवीयमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśatsāṣṭaśataṃ kailāsaṃ bhūsahasrakam | catvāriṃśacca dviśataṃ vāyavīyamataḥ param
verses.translation: Who by indulging in wonderful activities has created the universe? O intelligent lord, please mention it and quell our doubts.
verses.hindi: शिव हो जाता है। वह विशुद्धता ही शिवत्व है
verses.commentary: Sense: Who by indulging in wonderful activities has created the universe? O intelligent lord, please mention it and quell our doubts.
verses.science: शिव हो जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुस्साहस्रसङ्ख्याकमेवं सङ्ख्याविभेदतः । श्रुतं परमपुण्यं तु पुराणं शिवसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: catussāhasrasaṅkhyākamevaṃ saṅkhyāvibhedataḥ | śrutaṃ paramapuṇyaṃ tu purāṇaṃ śivasaṃjñakam
verses.translation: iva stationed in the middle of the ether shall be meditated upon by those desirous of salvation; Siva from whom the words recede not approaching him along with the mind;'** knowing and realising whose bliss-form one has no fear from anywhere; from whom every thing inclusive of Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Indra, the elements, the sense- organs, is born at first, who is the creator, meditator and ultimate cause of all causes; who is not born from anything else at any time; who is endowed with glory and prosperity and who is known as SarveSvara.
verses.wordMeaning: iva stationed in the middle of the ether shall be meditated upon by those desirous of salvation; Siva from whom the words recede not approaching him along with the mind;'** knowing and realising whose bliss-form one has no fear from anywhere;…
verses.commentary: Sense: iva stationed in the middle of the ether shall be meditated upon by those desirous of salvation; Siva from whom the words recede not approaching him along with the mind;'** knowing and realising whose bliss-form one has no fear from anywhere;…
verses.science: दूर हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुःसहस्रकं यत्तु वायवीयमुदीरितम् । तदिदं वर्त्तयिष्यामि भागद्वयसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: catuḥsahasrakaṃ yattu vāyavīyamudīritam | tadidaṃ varttayiṣyāmi bhāgadvayasamanvitam
verses.translation: He rules over all the worlds through the Jivas. He is the only lord Rudra. There is none second to him.
verses.hindi: है और उसका फल तथा आश्रय क्‍या है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: He rules over all the worlds through the Jivas. He is the only lord Rudra. There is none second to him.
verses.science: है और उसका फल तथा आश्रय क्‍या है ?। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नावेदविदुषे वाच्यमिदं शास्त्रमनुत्तमम् । न चैवाश्रद्दधानाय नापुराणविदे तथा
verses.transliteration: nāvedaviduṣe vācyamidaṃ śāstramanuttamam | na caivāśraddadhānāya nāpurāṇavide tathā
verses.translation: He has neither day nor night; neither equals nor superiors. The great knowledge and activity is innate in him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has neither day nor night; neither equals nor superiors. The great knowledge and activity is innate in him.
verses.science: क्षीणमलवाला पुरुष कैसा होता है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षिताय शिष्याय धार्मिकायानसूयवे । प्रदेयं शिवभक्ताय शिवधर्मानुसारिणे
verses.transliteration: parīkṣitāya śiṣyāya dhārmikāyānasūyave | pradeyaṃ śivabhaktāya śivadharmānusāriṇe
verses.translation: By concentrating on him, the person of attvaic feelings becomes the lord himself. At the end the universal illusion recedes from him.
verses.hindi: स्तुतो5पि कु: स्थिति: ॥ ४२  वास्तविक स्थिति कहाँ है?
verses.commentary: Sense: By concentrating on him, the person of attvaic feelings becomes the lord himself. At the end the universal illusion recedes from him.
verses.science: स्तुतो5पि कु: स्थिति: ॥ ४२ वास्तविक स्थिति कहाँ है?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणसंहिता यस्य प्रसादान्मयि वर्तते । नमो भगवते तस्मै व्यासायामिततेजसे
verses.transliteration: purāṇasaṃhitā yasya prasādānmayi vartate | namo bhagavate tasmai vyāsāyāmitatejase
verses.translation: The eternal Sruti says "In whom neither the lightn¬ ing flashes nor the sun blazes nor (he moon sheds light and by whose brilliance this universe comes in the limelight."
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal Sruti says "In whom neither the lightn¬ ing flashes nor the sun blazes nor (he moon sheds light and by whose brilliance this universe comes in the limelight."
verses.science: अवसर नहीं पाता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu, I, Rudra, gods and Asiiras are desirous of seeing him even today by performing great penances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu, I, Rudra, gods and Asiiras are desirous of seeing him even today by performing great penances.
verses.science: पशुपतिके विषयमें बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu, I, Rudra, gods and Asiiras are desirous of seeing him even today by performing great penances.
verses.hindi: ही हो सकता है, पशु और पाश नहीं
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu, I, Rudra, gods and Asiiras are desirous of seeing him even today by performing great penances.
verses.science: ही हो सकता है, पशु और पाश नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । मुनिप्रस्ताववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । पुरा कालेन महता कल्पेऽतीते पुनः पुनः । अस्मिन्नुपस्थिते कल्पे प्रवृत्ते सृष्टिकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.2. dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | muniprastāvavarṇanam | sūta uvāca | purā kālena mahatā kalpe'tīte punaḥ punaḥ | asminnupasthite kalpe pravṛtte sṛṣṭikarmaṇi
verses.translation: Forms in the universe are threefold— the gross, subtle and that \vhi(:h is beyond. The gross is s*>cn by us, the gods and others. The subtle is seen by iht' \og'.r.;. That which is beyond the two, is eternal, knowledge, bliss and the unchanging can be seen by those who dwell in it, are devoted to it and are engaged in the riles concerning it.
verses.wordMeaning: Forms in the universe are threefold— the gross, subtle and that \vhi(:h is beyond. The gross is s*>cn by us, the gods and others. The subtle is seen by iht' \og'.r.;. That which is beyond the two, is eternal, knowledge,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Forms in the universe are threefold— the gross, subtle and that \vhi(:h is beyond. The gross is s*>cn by us, the gods and others. The subtle is seen by iht' \og'.r.;. That which is beyond the two, is eternal, knowledge,…
verses.science: बन्धनसे छुड़ानेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठितायां वार्तायां प्रबुद्धासु प्रजासु च । मुनीनां षट्कुलीयानां ब्रुवतामितरेतरम्
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ vārtāyāṃ prabuddhāsu prajāsu ca | munīnāṃ ṣaṭkulīyānāṃ bruvatāmitaretaram
verses.translation: Some soul may return after the enjoyment of heavenly region and then liberated. Still another soul may be liberated on its way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some soul may return after the enjoyment of heavenly region and then liberated. Still another soul may be liberated on its way.
verses.science: संसारमें अधिष्ठित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं परमिदं नेति विवादः सुमहानभूत् । परस्य दुर्निरूपत्वान्न जातस्तत्र निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ paramidaṃ neti vivādaḥ sumahānabhūt | parasya durnirūpatvānna jātastatra niścayaḥ
verses.translation: There had been many scholarly sages here experts
verses.commentary: Sense: There had been many scholarly sages here experts
verses.science: हे विचक्षण! इसे बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभिजग्मुर्विधातारं द्रष्टुं ब्रह्माणमव्ययम् । यत्रास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: te'bhijagmurvidhātāraṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmāṇamavyayam | yatrāste bhagavān brahmā stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: The sacrifice of the sages functioned evoking wonder in everyone like that of the Vivasrjas formerly who were desirous of creating the universe.
verses.hindi: बलपूर्वक कुछ “और ही कर देता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrifice of the sages functioned evoking wonder in everyone like that of the Vivasrjas formerly who were desirous of creating the universe.
verses.science: बलपूर्वक कुछ “और ही कर देता है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: मेरुशृङ्गे शुभे रम्ये देवदानवसङ्कुले । सिद्धचारणसम्बादे यक्षगन्धर्वसेविते
verses.transliteration: meruśṛṅge śubhe ramye devadānavasaṅkule | siddhacāraṇasambāde yakṣagandharvasevite
verses.translation: After sometime when the Satra had concluded with the distribution of manifold gifts Vayu himself came there at the instance of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: After sometime when the Satra had concluded with the distribution of manifold gifts Vayu himself came there at the instance of Brahma.
verses.science: कार्यसिद्धिमें सफलता नहीं दे पाते। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: विहङ्गसङ्घसङ्घुष्टेमणिविद्रुमभूषिते । निकुञ्जकन्दरदरीगृहानिर्झरशोभिते
verses.transliteration: vihaṅgasaṅghasaṅghuṣṭemaṇividrumabhūṣite | nikuñjakandaradarīgṛhānirjharaśobhite
verses.translation: On seeing him at the hermitage the sages who were busy in a long Satra remembered the words of Brahma and felt unequalled pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him at the hermitage the sages who were busy in a long Satra remembered the words of Brahma and felt unequalled pleasure.
verses.science: समान व्यवहारवाला होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मवनं नाम नानामृगसमाकुलम् । दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmavanaṃ nāma nānāmṛgasamākulam | daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanamāyatam
verses.translation: According to the V«'dic concept they are sons of Rudra but a legend represents their origin in an unborn son of Diti whom Indra dashed in the womb into fortynine pieces and gave the name Maruts.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the V«'dic concept they are sons of Rudra but a legend represents their origin in an unborn son of Diti whom Indra dashed in the womb into fortynine pieces and gave the name Maruts.
verses.science: है, जो अकालिक हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरसामलपानीयपूर्णरम्यसरोवरम् । मत्तभ्रमरसञ्छन्नरम्यपुष्पितपादपम्
verses.transliteration: surasāmalapānīyapūrṇaramyasarovaram | mattabhramarasañchannaramyapuṣpitapādapam
verses.translation: Standing up they welcomed and bowed to him. They offered him a golden seat.
verses.hindi: कालसे ही सब लोग जीवित रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing up they welcomed and bowed to him. They offered him a golden seat.
verses.science: कालसे ही सब लोग जीवित रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तरुणादित्यसङ्काशं तत्र चारु महत्पुरम् । दुर्द्धर्षबलदृप्तानां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: taruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃ tatra cāru mahatpuram | durddharṣabaladṛptānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām
verses.translation: O brahmins, hope you are all quite well, now that this great sacrifice has concluded. Hope that the Asuras, the enemies of the gods, the destroyers of sacrifices do not harass you.
verses.hindi: न अस्थ कालो न च बंधमुक्ती दर्शन कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, hope you are all quite well, now that this great sacrifice has concluded. Hope that the Asuras, the enemies of the gods, the destroyers of sacrifices do not harass you.
verses.science: न अस्थ कालो न च बंधमुक्ती दर्शन कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तप्तजाम्बूनदमयं प्रांशुप्राकारतोरणम् । निर्यूहवलभीकूटप्रतोलीशतमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: taptajāmbūnadamayaṃ prāṃśuprākāratoraṇam | niryūhavalabhīkūṭapratolīśatamaṇḍitam
verses.translation: The achievements of the individual are due to the grace of God. Lord alone is achieved in the end through all the means.
verses.commentary: Sense: The achievements of the individual are due to the grace of God. Lord alone is achieved in the end through all the means.
verses.science: कोई वस्तु जाननेयोग्य नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महार्हमणिचित्राभिर्लेलिहानमिवाम्बरम् । महाभवनकोटीभिरनेकाभिरलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahārhamaṇicitrābhirlelihānamivāmbaram | mahābhavanakoṭībhiranekābhiralaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: Viitue and holy rites constitute the means for the attainment of giace. That is indicated by the Vedas. By practising Dharma the sins and merits are levelled to equality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Viitue and holy rites constitute the means for the attainment of giace. That is indicated by the Vedas. By practising Dharma the sins and merits are levelled to equality.
verses.science: व्यक्ति अपनेमें सतत देखता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निवसति ब्रह्मा सभ्यैः सार्द्धं प्रजापतिः । तत्र गत्वा महात्मानं साक्षाल्लोकपितामहम्
verses.transliteration: tasminnivasati brahmā sabhyaiḥ sārddhaṃ prajāpatiḥ | tatra gatvā mahātmānaṃ sākṣāllokapitāmaham
verses.translation: Contact with grace yields cxtcllence of Dharma. After attaining this excellence the sins of tht individual decline.
verses.commentary: Sense: Contact with grace yields cxtcllence of Dharma. After attaining this excellence the sins of tht individual decline.
verses.science: करके अपना ऐश्वर्य-विस्तार करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुर्मुनयो देवा देवर्षिगणसेवितम् । शुद्धचामीकरप्रख्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: dadṛśurmunayo devā devarṣigaṇasevitam | śuddhacāmīkaraprakhyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: When his sins decline through succession of births the devotion to Sarvesvara and Amba is ncrated along with knowledge.
verses.hindi: करते हैं तथा उनकी अभिवृद्धि करते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: When his sins decline through succession of births the devotion to Sarvesvara and Amba is ncrated along with knowledge.
verses.science: करते हैं तथा उनकी अभिवृद्धि करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नवदनं सौम्यं पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणम् । दिव्यकान्तिसमायुक्तं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: prasannavadanaṃ saumyaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam | divyakāntisamāyuktaṃ divyagandhānulepanam
verses.translation: The grace of the lord varies in accordance with the purity of emotions. Due to grace, cschewment of rites results. Here the eschewment is of the fruits of rites and not the rites themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grace of the lord varies in accordance with the purity of emotions. Due to grace, cschewment of rites results. Here the eschewment is of the fruits of rites and not the rites themselves.
verses.science: शासक, शरणदाता और सुहृद् हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यशुक्लाम्बरधरं दिव्यमालाविभूषितम् । सुरासुरेन्द्रयोगीन्द्रवन्द्यमानपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: divyaśuklāmbaradharaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam | surāsurendrayogīndravandyamānapadāmbujam
verses.translation: As a result of the abandonment of the desire for the fruits of holy rites, the auspicious Saivite virtues are attai¬ ned. This is twofold: that dependent on the preceptor and that which is not.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of the abandonment of the desire for the fruits of holy rites, the auspicious Saivite virtues are attai¬ ned. This is twofold: that dependent on the preceptor and that which is not.
verses.science: हृदय-गुफामें निवास करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणयुक्ताङ्ग्या लब्धचामरहस्तया । भ्राजमानं सरस्वत्या प्रभयेव दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇayuktāṅgyā labdhacāmarahastayā | bhrājamānaṃ sarasvatyā prabhayeva divākaram
verses.translation: In view of the knowledge the man sees the defects in the worldly existence. Thereafter arises non-attachment to the sensual objects and thence Bhava is attained.
verses.hindi: शोकरहित हुआ पुरुष देख पाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of the knowledge the man sees the defects in the worldly existence. Thereafter arises non-attachment to the sensual objects and thence Bhava is attained.
verses.science: शोकरहित हुआ पुरुष देख पाता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणाः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टुवुः सुरपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ | śirasyañjalimādhāya tuṣṭuvuḥ surapuṅgavam
verses.translation: Throiigh Yoga arises the great devotion and then grace of God. By means of the grace the creature is liberated and becomes equal to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Throiigh Yoga arises the great devotion and then grace of God. By means of the grace the creature is liberated and becomes equal to Siva.
verses.science: पापोंसे छूट जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवे । पुरुषाय पुराणाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ | namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ sargasthityantahetave | puruṣāya purāṇāya brahmaṇe paramātmane
verses.translation: The different modes of blessings may not be in the order mentioned. The blessing is based on the ability of the man.
verses.hindi: उरुप परमानन्दमय अमृतका अनुभव करता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The different modes of blessings may not be in the order mentioned. The blessing is based on the ability of the man.
verses.science: उरुप परमानन्दमय अमृतका अनुभव करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमः प्रधानदेहाय प्रधानक्षोभकारिणे । त्रयोविंशतिभेदेन विकृतायाविकारिणे
verses.transliteration: namaḥ pradhānadehāya pradhānakṣobhakāriṇe | trayoviṃśatibhedena vikṛtāyāvikāriṇe
verses.translation: A soul born as a lower species, a soul undergoing torture in hell, a soul achieving a heavenly region may be liberated when the tenure is over.
verses.commentary: Sense: A soul born as a lower species, a soul undergoing torture in hell, a soul achieving a heavenly region may be liberated when the tenure is over.
verses.science: आदि तत्त्वोंका नियमन करते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नमो ब्रह्माण्डदेहाय ब्रह्माण्डोदरवर्तिने । तत्र संसिद्धकार्याय संसिद्धकरणाय च
verses.transliteration: namo brahmāṇḍadehāya brahmāṇḍodaravartine | tatra saṃsiddhakāryāya saṃsiddhakaraṇāya ca
verses.translation: He will tell you what is good for you along with the means. Then you shall go to the holy and auspi¬ cious city of Varanasi where the glorious trident-bearing lord sports about with the goddess for blessing his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will tell you what is good for you along with the means. Then you shall go to the holy and auspi¬ cious city of Varanasi where the glorious trident-bearing lord sports about with the goddess for blessing his devotees.
verses.science: संसार भ्रमित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु सर्वलोकाय सर्वलोकविधायिने । सर्वात्मदेहसंयोगवियोगविधिहेतवे
verses.transliteration: namo'stu sarvalokāya sarvalokavidhāyine | sarvātmadehasaṃyogaviyogavidhihetave
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after seeing the great wonder therein you come to me again. Then I shall tell you the means of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, after seeing the great wonder therein you come to me again. Then I shall tell you the means of salvation.
verses.science: प्राणियोंके साथ प्रवृत्त होता है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव निखिलं सृष्टं संहृतं पालितं जगत् । तथापि मायया नाथ न विद्मस्त्वां पितामह
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva nikhilaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ pālitaṃ jagat | tathāpi māyayā nātha na vidmastvāṃ pitāmaha
verses.translation: Thereby in a single birth, salvation comes within your reach, salvation which sets you free from the bondage of births and transmigrations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby in a single birth, salvation comes within your reach, salvation which sets you free from the bondage of births and transmigrations.
verses.science: विश्वकी रचना हुई है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं ब्रह्मा महाभागैर्महर्षिभिरभिष्टुतः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा मुनीन् प्रह्लादयन्निव
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | evaṃ brahmā mahābhāgairmaharṣibhirabhiṣṭutaḥ | prāha gambhīrayā vācā munīn prahlādayanniva
verses.translation: Now I am releasing this mentally created wheel. The place where its rim gets shattered is auspicious for your penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I am releasing this mentally created wheel. The place where its rim gets shattered is auspicious for your penance.
verses.science: तथा संसार-बन्धनसे छुड़ानेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । ऋषयो हे महाभागा महासत्त्वा महौजसः । किमर्थं सहिताः सर्वे यूयमत्र समागताः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | ṛṣayo he mahābhāgā mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ | kimarthaṃ sahitāḥ sarve yūyamatra samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this Brahma created a mental wheel as bright as the sun. After bowing to lord 8iva he released it.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this Brahma created a mental wheel as bright as the sun. After bowing to lord 8iva he released it.
verses.science: दुःखका अन्त असम्भव है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमेवंवादिनं देवं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मवित्तमाः । वाग्भिर्विनयगर्भाभिः सर्वे प्राञ्जलयोऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tamevaṃvādinaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmavittamāḥ | vāgbhirvinayagarbhābhiḥ sarve prāñjalayo'bruvan
verses.translation: Those delighted brahmins bowed to the lord and pursued the wheel to the place where its rim got shattered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those delighted brahmins bowed to the lord and pursued the wheel to the place where its rim got shattered.
verses.science: मुखसे प्राप्त किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । भगवन्नन्धकारेण महता वयमावृताः । खिन्ना विवदमानाश्च न पश्यामोऽत्र यत्परम्
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ | bhagavannandhakāreṇa mahatā vayamāvṛtāḥ | khinnā vivadamānāśca na paśyāmo'tra yatparam
verses.translation: The wheel thus hurled fell on a smooth charming rock in a certain forest where the water was sweet and clear.
verses.hindi: पुनराददाति॥ ७६  सबको आत्मसात् कर लेते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The wheel thus hurled fell on a smooth charming rock in a certain forest where the water was sweet and clear.
verses.science: पुनराददाति॥ ७६ सबको आत्मसात् कर लेते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सर्वजगद्धाता सर्वकारणकारणम् । त्वया ह्यविदितं नाथ नेह किञ्चन विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi sarvajagaddhātā sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | tvayā hyaviditaṃ nātha neha kiñcana vidyate
verses.translation: That forest became famous as Naimi§a. It is worshipped by the sages. It abounds in Yaksas, Gandharvas, and Vidyadharas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That forest became famous as Naimi§a. It is worshipped by the sages. It abounds in Yaksas, Gandharvas, and Vidyadharas.
verses.science: शिवतत्त्वज्ञनवर्णन॑ नाम षष्ठोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: कः पुमान् सर्वसत्त्वेभ्यः पुराणः पुरुषः परः । विशुद्धः परिपूर्णश्च शाश्वतः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kaḥ pumān sarvasattvebhyaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ | viśuddhaḥ paripūrṇaśca śāśvataḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Indulging in sexual dalliance with Urvasi, Pururavas was moving about in the eighteen islands in the ocean. Urged by fate he came to this place and foolishly spoiled the golden sacrificial altar here. The infuriated sages hurled Kusa grass at him which had the power of thunderbolt and felled him to the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: Indulging in sexual dalliance with Urvasi, Pururavas was moving about in the eighteen islands in the ocean. Urged by fate he came to this place and foolishly spoiled the golden sacrificial altar here.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Indulging in sexual dalliance with Urvasi, Pururavas was moving about in the eighteen islands in the ocean. Urged by fate he came to this place and foolishly spoiled the golden sacrificial altar here.…
verses.science: नामक छठा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: केनैव चित्रकृत्येन प्रथमं सृज्यते जगत् । तत्त्वं वद महाप्राज्ञ स्वसन्देहापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: kenaiva citrakṛtyena prathamaṃ sṛjyate jagat | tattvaṃ vada mahāprājña svasandehāpanuttaye
verses.translation: Formerly the Visvasrja Brahmesa householders desirous of creating the universe began a divine sacrifice here.
verses.hindi: न कालनिरपेक्षं हि क्वचित्किंचन विद्यते॥ ९  कालके बिना कहीं कुछ भी नहीं होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly the Visvasrja Brahmesa householders desirous of creating the universe began a divine sacrifice here.
verses.science: न कालनिरपेक्षं हि क्वचित्किंचन विद्यते॥ ९ कालके बिना कहीं कुछ भी नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं पृष्टस्तदा ब्रह्मा विस्मयस्मेरवीक्षणः । देवानां दानवानां च मुनीनामपि सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pṛṣṭastadā brahmā vismayasmeravīkṣaṇaḥ | devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca munīnāmapi sannidhau
verses.translation: Here persons well-versed in the Vedas refute those who are excluded from Vedic path by their power of argu¬ ments. They speak eloquently.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here persons well-versed in the Vedas refute those who are excluded from Vedic path by their power of argu¬ ments. They speak eloquently.
verses.science: ईश्वरका साक्षात् बल है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय सुचिरं ध्यात्वा रुद्र इत्युच्चरन् गिरिम् । आनन्दक्लिन्नसर्वाङ्गः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration: utthāya suciraṃ dhyātvā rudra ityuccaran girim | ānandaklinnasarvāṅgaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.translation: The fortunate sages of devout rites worshipped lord Siva and began their sacrifice there.
verses.hindi: किये गये कर्मको नहीं मिटा सकता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The fortunate sages of devout rites worshipped lord Siva and began their sacrifice there.
verses.science: किये गये कर्मको नहीं मिटा सकता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: When addressed thus by Vayu, the meditator on Siva, the sages were delighted in their minds. They considered themselves sanctified. They replied thus humbly.
verses.commentary: Sense: When addressed thus by Vayu, the meditator on Siva, the sages were delighted in their minds. They considered themselves sanctified. They replied thus humbly.
verses.science: नमः: परस्मे परमेश्वराय॥ २६ नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: When addressed thus by Vayu, the meditator on Siva, the sages were delighted in their minds. They considered themselves sanctified. They replied thus humbly.
verses.commentary: Sense: When addressed thus by Vayu, the meditator on Siva, the sages were delighted in their minds. They considered themselves sanctified. They replied thus humbly.
verses.science: कालमहिमवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३. तृतीयोऽध्यायः । नैमिषोपाख्यानम् । ब्रह्मोवाच । यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह । आनन्दं यस्य वै विद्वान्न बिभेति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.3. tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | naimiṣopākhyānam | brahmovāca | yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha | ānandaṃ yasya vai vidvānna bibheti kutaścana
verses.translation: Today we have attained bliss; our penances are rendered fruitful since you have come for the increase of our welfare.
verses.hindi: कालमहिमवर्णन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Today we have attained bliss; our penances are rendered fruitful since you have come for the increase of our welfare.
verses.science: कालमहिमवर्णन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्सर्वमिदं ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रेन्द्रपूर्वकम् । सह भूतेन्द्रियैः सर्वैः प्रथमं सम्प्रसूयते
verses.transliteration: yasmātsarvamidaṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrendrapūrvakam | saha bhūtendriyaiḥ sarvaiḥ prathamaṃ samprasūyate
verses.translation: How did you, sir, acquire the knowledge of Siva? Wherefore is your devotion to Siva, the Brahman whose birth is unnianifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did you, sir, acquire the knowledge of Siva? Wherefore is your devotion to Siva, the Brahman whose birth is unnianifest.
verses.science: संक्षेपमें किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कारणानां च यो धाता ध्याता परमकारणम् । न सम्प्रसूयतेऽन्यस्मात्कुतश्चन कदाचन
verses.transliteration: kāraṇānāṃ ca yo dhātā dhyātā paramakāraṇam | na samprasūyate'nyasmātkutaścana kadācana
verses.translation: The Gunas Sativa, R.ijas and Tamas, originate from Prakrti. Like oil in the gingclly seed they are present in the latest form in Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gunas Sativa, R.ijas and Tamas, originate from Prakrti. Like oil in the gingclly seed they are present in the latest form in Prakrti.
verses.science: ब्रह्मा-ये सभी शिवात्मक हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्येण सम्पन्नो नाम्ना सर्वेश्वरः स्वयम् । सर्वैर्मुमुक्षुभिर्ध्येयः शम्भुराकाशमध्यगः
verses.transliteration: sarvaiśvaryeṇa sampanno nāmnā sarveśvaraḥ svayam | sarvairmumukṣubhirdhyeyaḥ śambhurākāśamadhyagaḥ
verses.translation: Covered by and.separated from these bodies this soul resembles tlic disc of the moon in the sky that is covered by and separated from the passing clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Covered by and.separated from these bodies this soul resembles tlic disc of the moon in the sky that is covered by and separated from the passing clouds.
verses.science: संकल्पमात्रेण महेश्वरस्य॥ ४८ है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: योऽग्रे मां विदधे पुत्रं ज्ञानं च प्रहिणोति मे । तत्प्रसादान्मया लब्धं प्राजापत्यमिदं पदम्
verses.transliteration: yo'gre māṃ vidadhe putraṃ jñānaṃ ca prahiṇoti me | tatprasādānmayā labdhaṃ prājāpatyamidaṃ padam
verses.translation: Realising distinction between him and himself and being gratified after resorting to him Pasu can attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising distinction between him and himself and being gratified after resorting to him Pasu can attain immortality.
verses.science: सन्मार्गकों ग्रहण नहीं किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशो वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो य एको दिवि तिष्ठति । येनेदमखिलं पूर्णं पुरुषेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: īśo vṛkṣa iva stabdho ya eko divi tiṣṭhati | yenedamakhilaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: Ibid. 17.
verses.explanation: प्रादर्भाव किस प्रकार कहा गया ?। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: प्रादर्भाव किस प्रकार कहा गया ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एको बहूनां जन्तूनां निष्क्रियाणां च सक्रियः । य एको बहुधा बीजं करोति स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: eko bahūnāṃ jantūnāṃ niṣkriyāṇāṃ ca sakriyaḥ | ya eko bahudhā bījaṃ karoti sa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: I know the unaging ancient omnipresent lord whose birth is denied by those who can expound the know¬ ledge of the Brahman.**®
verses.commentary: Sense: I know the unaging ancient omnipresent lord whose birth is denied by those who can expound the know¬ ledge of the Brahman.**®
verses.science: करूँगा; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवैरेभिरिमांल्लोकान्सर्वानीशो य ईशते । य एको भागवान् रुद्रो न द्वितीयोऽस्ति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: jīvairebhirimāṃllokānsarvānīśo ya īśate | ya eko bhāgavān rudro na dvitīyo'sti kaścana
verses.translation: After annihilating in the end, the lord creates the universe again from the beginning in association with his manifold l§aktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: After annihilating in the end, the lord creates the universe again from the beginning in association with his manifold l§aktis.
verses.science: शक्ति प्रदान की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सदा जनानां हृदये सन्निविष्टोऽपि यः परैः । अलक्ष्यो लक्षयन्विश्वमधितिष्ठति सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: sadā janānāṃ hṛdaye sanniviṣṭo'pi yaḥ paraiḥ | alakṣyo lakṣayanviśvamadhitiṣṭhati sarvadā
verses.translation: The Maya of Siva is the unborn mother of the universe and has variegated colours and shapes. It is white, red and black. She, the unborn, gives birth to man. He, the unborn, resorts to it and gets involved in distress Another Aja, the liberated soul, eschews her after she has been enjoyed.***
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मकी ओर देखा और थोड़ा-सा मुसकराने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: The Maya of Siva is the unborn mother of the universe and has variegated colours and shapes. It is white, red and black. She, the unborn, gives birth to man. He, the unborn, resorts to it and gets involved in distress Another Aja, the liberated soul,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Maya of Siva is the unborn mother of the universe and has variegated colours and shapes. It is white, red and black. She, the unborn, gives birth to man. He, the unborn, resorts to it and gets involved in distress Another Aja, the liberated soul,…
verses.science: ब्रह्मकी ओर देखा और थोड़ा-सा मुसकराने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु कालात्प्रमुक्तानि कारणान्यखिलान्यपि । अनन्तशक्तिरेवैको भगवानधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yastu kālātpramuktāni kāraṇānyakhilānyapi | anantaśaktirevaiko bhagavānadhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Listen to an old anecdote. Formerly we meditated on Prajapati when we were overwhelmed by darkness. We wanted to acquire perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: संख्यारूपस्य कालस्य कः पुनः परमो5वधि:॥ १  संख्यारूप कालकी परम अवधि क्या है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to an old anecdote. Formerly we meditated on Prajapati when we were overwhelmed by darkness. We wanted to acquire perfect knowledge.
verses.science: संख्यारूपस्य कालस्य कः पुनः परमो5वधि:॥ १ संख्यारूप कालकी परम अवधि क्या है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य दिवसो रात्रिर्न समानो न चाधिकः । स्वाभाविकी पराशक्तिर्नित्या ज्ञानक्रिये अपि
verses.transliteration: na yasya divaso rātrirna samāno na cādhikaḥ | svābhāvikī parāśaktirnityā jñānakriye api
verses.translation: The lord Brahma worthy of being sought refuge in, blessed us as we sought refuge in him and 3aid, "O brahmins, Lord Rudra is superior to all. He is the ultimate cause.
verses.hindi: तादृशानां निमेषाणां काष्ठा दश च पञ्ञ च॥ ३  निमेषोंकी एक काष्ठा होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord Brahma worthy of being sought refuge in, blessed us as we sought refuge in him and 3aid, "O brahmins, Lord Rudra is superior to all. He is the ultimate cause.
verses.science: तादृशानां निमेषाणां काष्ठा दश च पञ्ञ च॥ ३ निमेषोंकी एक काष्ठा होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यदिदं क्षरमव्यक्तं यदप्यमृतमक्षरम् । तावुभावक्षरात्मानावेको देवः स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: yadidaṃ kṣaramavyaktaṃ yadapyamṛtamakṣaram | tāvubhāvakṣarātmānāveko devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: Only the devotee sees the lord whose real nature cannot be reflected upon or argued over. Devotion is ac¬ quired through grace and through grace is bliss attained.
verses.hindi: दक्षिणं चायनं रात्रिस्तथोदगय् दिनम्॥ «८  दिन होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Only the devotee sees the lord whose real nature cannot be reflected upon or argued over. Devotion is ac¬ quired through grace and through grace is bliss attained.
verses.science: दक्षिणं चायनं रात्रिस्तथोदगय् दिनम्॥ «८ दिन होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशते तदभिध्यानाद् योजनात्तत्वभावनः । भूयो ह्यस्य पशोरन्ते विश्वमाया निवर्तते
verses.transliteration: īśate tadabhidhyānād yojanāttatvabhāvanaḥ | bhūyo hyasya paśorante viśvamāyā nivartate
verses.translation: Hence, in order to propitiate him perform the Satra. Worship him who is the ultirpate cause, perform Satra in Naimisa extending over a long period.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार कुल ये ही चार युग हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, in order to propitiate him perform the Satra. Worship him who is the ultirpate cause, perform Satra in Naimisa extending over a long period.
verses.science: इस प्रकार कुल ये ही चार युग हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्न भासते विद्युन्न सूर्यो न च चन्द्रमाः । यस्य भासा विभातीदमित्येषा शाश्वती श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: yasminna bhāsate vidyunna sūryo na ca candramāḥ | yasya bhāsā vibhātīdamityeṣā śāśvatī śrutiḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the Satra, by means of his grace Vayu will come there. You will acquire perfect knowledge from his mouth and attain welfare.
verses.hindi: इतने ही वर्षोका सन्ध्यांश होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the Satra, by means of his grace Vayu will come there. You will acquire perfect knowledge from his mouth and attain welfare.
verses.science: इतने ही वर्षोका सन्ध्यांश होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एको देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः । न तस्य परमं किञ्चित्पदं समधिगम्यते
verses.transliteration: eko devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ | na tasya paramaṃ kiñcitpadaṃ samadhigamyate
verses.translation: Commanding thus Brahma sent us all to this place. O fortunate one, we were eagerly awaiting your arrival.
verses.hindi: सत् नामक शिवके एक दिनपर्यन्त रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Commanding thus Brahma sent us all to this place. O fortunate one, we were eagerly awaiting your arrival.
verses.science: सत् नामक शिवके एक दिनपर्यन्त रहते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अयमादिरनाद्यन्तः स्वभावादेव निर्मलः । स्वतन्त्रः परिपूर्णश्च स्वेच्छाधीनश्चराचरः
verses.transliteration: ayamādiranādyantaḥ svabhāvādeva nirmalaḥ | svatantraḥ paripūrṇaśca svecchādhīnaścarācaraḥ
verses.translation: Wc sat and performed the Satra for a thousand divine years. Wc had nothing to wish for except your advent.
verses.hindi: अन्तमें पुनः विश्वकी उत्पत्ति होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Wc sat and performed the Satra for a thousand divine years. Wc had nothing to wish for except your advent.
verses.science: अन्तमें पुनः विश्वकी उत्पत्ति होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्राकृतवपुः श्रीमांल्लक्ष्यलक्षणवर्जितः । अयं मुक्तो मोचकश्च ह्यकालः कालचोदकः
verses.transliteration: aprākṛtavapuḥ śrīmāṃllakṣyalakṣaṇavarjitaḥ | ayaṃ mukto mocakaśca hyakālaḥ kālacodakaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing thus this story of the sages who had performed the satra for a long time Vayu was delighted in his mind and stayed there surrounded by the sages.
verses.hindi: अहस्ते प्रलीयन्ते रात्यन्ते विश्वसंभव:॥ ३९ है, उन महान् शंकरकों नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing thus this story of the sages who had performed the satra for a long time Vayu was delighted in his mind and stayed there surrounded by the sages.
verses.science: अहस्ते प्रलीयन्ते रात्यन्ते विश्वसंभव:॥ ३९ है, उन महान् शंकरकों नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपरिकृतावासः सर्वावासश्च सर्ववित् । षड्विधाध्वमयस्यास्य सर्वस्य जगतः पतिः
verses.transliteration: sarvoparikṛtāvāsaḥ sarvāvāsaśca sarvavit | ṣaḍvidhādhvamayasyāsya sarvasya jagataḥ patiḥ
verses.translation: On being implored by the sages, the lord succinctly narrated the glory of Jiva beginning with creation in order to enhance their piety.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सम्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखण्डे कालप्रभावे त्रिदेवायुर्वर्णन॑ नामाष्टमो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: On being implored by the sages, the lord succinctly narrated the glory of Jiva beginning with creation in order to enhance their piety.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सम्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखण्डे कालप्रभावे त्रिदेवायुर्वर्णन॑ नामाष्टमो5 ध्याय:। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरोत्तरभूतानामुत्तरश्च निरुत्तरः । अनन्तानन्तसन्दोहमकरन्दमध्रुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: uttarottarabhūtānāmuttaraśca niruttaraḥ | anantānantasandohamakarandamadhruvrataḥ
verses.translation: There at the outset the fortunate residents of the Naiinisa bowed duly to lord Vayu and asked him.
verses.hindi: त्रिदेवोंका आयुवर्णन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: There at the outset the fortunate residents of the Naiinisa bowed duly to lord Vayu and asked him.
verses.science: त्रिदेवोंका आयुवर्णन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अखण्डजगदण्डानां पिण्डीकरणपण्डितः । औदार्यवीर्यगाम्भीर्यमाधुर्यमकरालयः
verses.transliteration: akhaṇḍajagadaṇḍānāṃ piṇḍīkaraṇapaṇḍitaḥ | audāryavīryagāmbhīryamādhuryamakarālayaḥ
verses.translation: The twenty-first kalpa shall be known as Svctalohita. In that kalpa the four-faced lord, desirous of creative activity performed a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twenty-first kalpa shall be known as Svctalohita. In that kalpa the four-faced lord, desirous of creative activity performed a penance.
verses.science: सावयव है और कर्तृसापेक्ष है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नैवास्य सदृशं वस्तु नाधिकं चापि किञ्चन । अतुलः सर्वभूतानां राजराजश्च तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: naivāsya sadṛśaṃ vastu nādhikaṃ cāpi kiñcana | atulaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rājarājaśca tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Delighted by his austere penance his father lord Siva, foremost among the handsome assumed the divine form ofabechelor. He became a sage Jveta and uttering divine.words appeared in front of him.
verses.hindi: और सबसे पृथक् तथा अन्वयरहित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted by his austere penance his father lord Siva, foremost among the handsome assumed the divine form ofabechelor. He became a sage Jveta and uttering divine.words appeared in front of him.
verses.science: और सबसे पृथक् तथा अन्वयरहित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन चित्रकृत्येन प्रथमं सृज्यते जगत् । अन्तकाले पुनश्चेदं तस्मिन्प्रलयमेष्यति
verses.transliteration: anena citrakṛtyena prathamaṃ sṛjyate jagat | antakāle punaścedaṃ tasminpralayameṣyati
verses.translation: Having acquired knowledge, the four-faced lord created all living beings — the mobile and immobile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having acquired knowledge, the four-faced lord created all living beings — the mobile and immobile.
verses.science: नहीं कर पाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य भूतानि वश्यानि अयं सर्वनियोजकः । अयं तु परया भक्त्या दृश्यते नान्यथा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: asya bhūtāni vaśyāni ayaṃ sarvaniyojakaḥ | ayaṃ tu parayā bhaktyā dṛśyate nānyathā kvacit
verses.translation: Great and steady devotion shall be applied by a man who wishes for happiness, for the perfect knowledge of the individual soul, illusion and the lord who releases from the bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Great and steady devotion shall be applied by a man who wishes for happiness, for the perfect knowledge of the individual soul, illusion and the lord who releases from the bondage.
verses.science: व्यतीत हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रतानि सर्वदानानि तपांसि नियमास्तथा । कथितानि पुरा सद्भिर्भावार्थं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: vratāni sarvadānāni tapāṃsi niyamāstathā | kathitāni purā sadbhirbhāvārthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Misery arises from ignorance. It is removed by knowledge that is a correct and precise comprehension of objects. Obj(T,t is twofold: sentient and non-sentient. 'riiere is a controller of the two. The three arc called Pasu, PaSa and Pati.
verses.hindi: होकर परस्पर चेष्टाशून्य ओत-प्रोत रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Misery arises from ignorance. It is removed by knowledge that is a correct and precise comprehension of objects. Obj(T,t is twofold: sentient and non-sentient. 'riiere is a controller of the two. The three arc called Pasu, PaSa and Pati.
verses.science: होकर परस्पर चेष्टाशून्य ओत-प्रोत रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चाहं च रुद्रश्च तथान्ये च सुरासुराः । तपोभिरुग्रैरद्यापि तस्य दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: hariścāhaṃ ca rudraśca tathānye ca surāsurāḥ | tapobhirugrairadyāpi tasya darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: On many occasions knoweis of reality call the three by.Aksara, Ksara and Ksaraksarapaia.
verses.hindi: तस्मै नमः सकललोकविलक्षणाय॥ २४  विलक्षण परमेश्वर-को नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: On many occasions knoweis of reality call the three by.Aksara, Ksara and Ksaraksarapaia.
verses.science: तस्मै नमः सकललोकविलक्षणाय॥ २४ विलक्षण परमेश्वर-को नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यः पतितैर्मूढैर्दुर्जनैरपि कुत्सितैः । भक्तैरन्तर्बहिश्चापि पूज्यः सम्भाष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: adṛśyaḥ patitairmūḍhairdurjanairapi kutsitaiḥ | bhaktairantarbahiścāpi pūjyaḥ sambhāṣya eva ca
verses.translation: How does the Maya cover up the pervading one? What for? Why is this covering up of the Purusa? By what is it made tf) recede?
verses.hindi: तथा प्रलयकर्त॒त्ववर्णन नामक नवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: How does the Maya cover up the pervading one? What for? Why is this covering up of the Purusa? By what is it made tf) recede?
verses.science: तथा प्रलयकर्त॒त्ववर्णन नामक नवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तदिदं त्रिविधं रूपं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं ततः परम् । अस्मदाद्यमरैर्दृश्यं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं तु योगिभिः
verses.transliteration: tadidaṃ trividhaṃ rūpaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tataḥ param | asmadādyamarairdṛśyaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tu yogibhiḥ
verses.translation: Even a pervasive can be covered just as Kala etc. that arc pervasive. The cause is Karman alone. The purpose is enjoyment. It recedes when dirt is quelled.
verses.hindi: बुद्धयादयो विशेषान्ता विकाराश्चाभवन् क्रमात्॥ १  सभी विकार क्रमश: उत्पन्न हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a pervasive can be covered just as Kala etc. that arc pervasive. The cause is Karman alone. The purpose is enjoyment. It recedes when dirt is quelled.
verses.science: बुद्धयादयो विशेषान्ता विकाराश्चाभवन् क्रमात्॥ १ सभी विकार क्रमश: उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः परं तु यन्नित्यं ज्ञानमानन्दमव्ययम् । तन्निष्ठैस्तत्परैर्भक्तैर्दृश्यं तद् व्रतमाश्रितैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paraṃ tu yannityaṃ jñānamānandamavyayam | tanniṣṭhaistatparairbhaktairdṛśyaṃ tad vratamāśritaiḥ
verses.translation: Vidya (learning) that reveals the place and acti¬ vity, time and passion these arc the inducing agents. Time is the conditioning factor there; destiny is the controlling factor.
verses.hindi: पितामह--ये तीन जगत्कारणभूत देवता उत्पन्न हुए
verses.commentary: Sense: Vidya (learning) that reveals the place and acti¬ vity, time and passion these arc the inducing agents. Time is the conditioning factor there; destiny is the controlling factor.
verses.science: पितामह--ये तीन जगत्कारणभूत देवता उत्पन्न हुए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बहुनाऽत्र किमुक्तेन गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं परम् । शिवे भक्तिर्न सन्देहस्तया युक्तो विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bahunā'tra kimuktena guhyādguhyataraṃ param | śive bhaktirna sandehastayā yukto vimucyate
verses.translation: Characteristically unmanifest it becomes manifest through Kalas. It is of the form and content of happiness, misery and delusion while being enjoyed. It has the three Gunas.
verses.hindi: अनुवर्तन करते हुए वृद्धिको प्राप्त होते रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Characteristically unmanifest it becomes manifest through Kalas. It is of the form and content of happiness, misery and delusion while being enjoyed. It has the three Gunas.
verses.science: अनुवर्तन करते हुए वृद्धिको प्राप्त होते रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादादेव सा भक्तिः प्रसादो भक्तिसम्भवः । यथा चाङ्कुरतो बीजं बीजतो वा यथाङ्कुरः
verses.transliteration: prasādādeva sā bhaktiḥ prasādo bhaktisambhavaḥ | yathā cāṅkurato bījaṃ bījato vā yathāṅkuraḥ
verses.translation: Happiness and its cause constitute briefly the Satttvaic trait. The Rajasaic trait is its opposite. Stun¬ ned state and delusion are Tamasic tiaits. The Sattvaic movement is upward progress; the Tamasic one is downfall; the middle course is cited as Rajasaic.
verses.commentary: Sense: Happiness and its cause constitute briefly the Satttvaic trait. The Rajasaic trait is its opposite. Stun¬ ned state and delusion are Tamasic tiaits. The Sattvaic movement is upward progress; the Tamasic one is downfall; the middle course is cited as Rajasaic.
verses.science: पहले उत्पन्न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादपूर्विका एव पशोः सर्वत्र सिद्धयः । स एव साधनैरन्ते सर्वैरपि च साध्यते
verses.transliteration: prasādapūrvikā eva paśoḥ sarvatra siddhayaḥ | sa eva sādhanairante sarvairapi ca sādhyate
verses.translation: The separateness of all-pervading lord from the intellect, sense-organs and the body is definite. There is something called Atman. A reason thereof is difficult to understand.
verses.commentary: Sense: The separateness of all-pervading lord from the intellect, sense-organs and the body is definite. There is something called Atman. A reason thereof is difficult to understand.
verses.science: संहार करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादसाधनं धर्मः स च वेदेन दर्शितः । तदभ्यासवशात्साम्यं पूर्वयोः पुण्यपापयोः
verses.transliteration: prasādasādhanaṃ dharmaḥ sa ca vedena darśitaḥ | tadabhyāsavaśātsāmyaṃ pūrvayoḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ
verses.translation: The intellect, the sense-organs and the bodies are not the Atman due to indefinite knowledge and non- eternality.
verses.hindi: विभक्त होनेके कारण बे चतुर्व्यूह कहे जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The intellect, the sense-organs and the bodies are not the Atman due to indefinite knowledge and non- eternality.
verses.science: विभक्त होनेके कारण बे चतुर्व्यूह कहे जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साम्यात्प्रसादसम्पर्को धर्मस्यातिशयस्ततः । धर्मातिशयमासाद्य पशोः पापपरिक्षयः
verses.transliteration: sāmyātprasādasamparko dharmasyātiśayastataḥ | dharmātiśayamāsādya paśoḥ pāpaparikṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence the one who has the cognition of expe¬ rienced objects and comprehends the entire knowables, is sung about in the Vedas and Upanisads as the immanent soul.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, अतः प्रजापति कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the one who has the cognition of expe¬ rienced objects and comprehends the entire knowables, is sung about in the Vedas and Upanisads as the immanent soul.
verses.science: करते हैं, अतः प्रजापति कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रक्षीणपापस्य बहुभिर्जन्मभिः क्रमात् । साम्बे सर्वेश्वरे भक्तिर्ज्ञानपूर्वा प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prakṣīṇapāpasya bahubhirjanmabhiḥ kramāt | sāmbe sarveśvare bhaktirjñānapūrvā prajāyate
verses.translation: This Atman cannot be perceived by the eye nor by any other sense-organ. The great Atman is comprehended only by the enlightened mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Atman cannot be perceived by the eye nor by any other sense-organ. The great Atman is comprehended only by the enlightened mind.
verses.science: यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् स्थित है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भावानुगुणमीशस्य प्रसादो व्यतिरिच्यते । प्रसादात्कर्मसन्त्यागः फलतो न स्वरूपतः
verses.transliteration: bhāvānuguṇamīśasya prasādo vyatiricyate | prasādātkarmasantyāgaḥ phalato na svarūpataḥ
verses.translation: It remains unembodied in the unsteady bodies. It is stable and steady like a stump. It is unchanging. Only the sober, self-pos.scsscd and bold can perceive it by means 01" reflection.
verses.hindi: विकारोंकी सृष्टिकर उन्हें पुन: समेट लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: It remains unembodied in the unsteady bodies. It is stable and steady like a stump. It is unchanging. Only the sober, self-pos.scsscd and bold can perceive it by means 01" reflection.
verses.science: विकारोंकी सृष्टिकर उन्हें पुन: समेट लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्कर्मफलत्यागाच्छिवधर्मान्वयः शुभः । स च गुर्वनपेक्षश्च तदपेक्ष इति द्विधा
verses.transliteration: tasmātkarmaphalatyāgācchivadharmānvayaḥ śubhaḥ | sa ca gurvanapekṣaśca tadapekṣa iti dvidhā
verses.translation: The Purusa becomes happy, mi.serable or delu d on becoming associated with the body — the seed of all adversities caused by his own activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purusa becomes happy, mi.serable or delu d on becoming associated with the body — the seed of all adversities caused by his own activities.
verses.science: क्रमसे विलयको प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रानपेक्षात्सापेक्षो मुख्यः शतगुणाधिकः । शिवधर्मान्वयस्यास्य शिवज्ञानसमन्वयः
