verses.commentary: Sense: Subhavati of sweet smiling face sat in front of Satl and delighted her by playing at the game of dice. Suyaias held the auspicious sandals of the goddess, studded with gems, in the middle of her breasts and served the goddess.
verses.science: रूपमें नहीं जानते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्पादकत्वाद्रजसोऽतिरेका ल्लोकस्य सन्तानविवृद्धिहेतून् । अष्टौ विकारानपि चादिकाले सृष्ट्वा समश्नाति तथान्तकाले
verses.transliteration: utpādakatvādrajaso'tirekā llokasya santānavivṛddhihetūn | aṣṭau vikārānapi cādikāle sṛṣṭvā samaśnāti tathāntakāle
verses.translation: Another lady held the glistening mirror. Another held the fan. Another held the betelbox. Another held the charming parrot.
verses.hindi: अन्तसे रहित उत्कृष्ट महादेवस्वरूप कहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Another lady held the glistening mirror. Another held the fan. Another held the betelbox. Another held the charming parrot.
verses.science: अन्तसे रहित उत्कृष्ट महादेवस्वरूप कहते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यवस्थापितकारणानां या च स्थितिर्या च पुनः प्रवृत्तिः । तत्सर्वमप्राकृतवैभवस्य सङ्कल्पमात्रेण महेश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyavasthāpitakāraṇānāṃ yā ca sthitiryā ca punaḥ pravṛttiḥ | tatsarvamaprākṛtavaibhavasya saṅkalpamātreṇa maheśvarasya
verses.translation: A certain lady held charming fragrant flowers. Another lotus-eyed lady held the repository of ornaments.
verses.hindi: भिन्‍न समष्टि चैतन्यका नाम परब्रह्म है
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain lady held charming fragrant flowers. Another lotus-eyed lady held the repository of ornaments.
verses.science: भिन्‍न समष्टि चैतन्यका नाम परब्रह्म है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O father, the lord at whose bidding everyone from Brahma to the Pi:acas becomes subservient has not been duly worshipped.
verses.hindi: निरक्चननः परममुपेति साम्यम्॥ ३७  समताको. प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O father, the lord at whose bidding everyone from Brahma to the Pi:acas becomes subservient has not been duly worshipped.
verses.science: निरक्चननः परममुपेति साम्यम्॥ ३७ समताको. प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: O father, the lord at whose bidding everyone from Brahma to the Pi:acas becomes subservient has not been duly worshipped.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोगो नाम पञ्ञमो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O father, the lord at whose bidding everyone from Brahma to the Pi:acas becomes subservient has not been duly worshipped.
verses.science: हति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोगो नाम पञ्ञमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । सृष्ट्यादिवर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि कल्पभेदांश्च सर्वशः । तेष्वेवान्तरसर्गं च प्रतिसर्गं च नो वद
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.11. ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | sṛṣṭyādivarṇanam | munaya ūcuḥ | manvantarāṇi sarvāṇi kalpabhedāṃśca sarvaśaḥ | teṣvevāntarasargaṃ ca pratisargaṃ ca no vada
verses.translation: Let that alone. Why did you slight me your eldest daughter in a despicable manner?
verses.hindi: पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोग नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Let that alone. Why did you slight me your eldest daughter in a despicable manner?
verses.science: पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोग नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । कालसङ्ख्याविवृत्तस्य परार्द्धो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः । तावांश्चैवास्य कालोऽन्यस्तस्यान्ते प्रतिसृज्यते
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | kālasaṅkhyāvivṛttasya parārddho brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | tāvāṃścaivāsya kālo'nyastasyānte pratisṛjyate
verses.translation: When Sati rebuked Dak$a and went away, the frightened and agitated Mantras too vanished. The sacrifice became hindered.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Sati rebuked Dak$a and went away, the frightened and agitated Mantras too vanished. The sacrifice became hindered.
verses.science: मोहित नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिवसे दिवसे तस्य ब्रह्मणः पूर्वजन्मनः । चतुर्दश महाभागा मनूनां परिवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: divase divase tasya brahmaṇaḥ pūrvajanmanaḥ | caturdaśa mahābhāgā manūnāṃ parivṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing all the gods assembled there without Siva, Dadhica became angry. He spoke to Dak$a thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing all the gods assembled there without Siva, Dadhica became angry. He spoke to Dak$a thus.
verses.science: आर्ध्य दिया और नमस्कार किया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वादनन्तत्वादज्ञेयत्वाच्च कृत्स्नशः । मन्वन्तराणि कल्पाश्च न शक्या वचनात्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: anāditvādanantatvādajñeyatvācca kṛtsnaśaḥ | manvantarāṇi kalpāśca na śakyā vacanātpṛthak
verses.translation: Even when the sage walked out, the gods did not leave Daksa in view of the inevitability of the disaster that was to take place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when the sage walked out, the gods did not leave Daksa in view of the inevitability of the disaster that was to take place.
verses.science: निहउच्जाल सबका वर्णन कीजिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उक्तेष्वपि च सर्वेषु शृण्वतां वो वचो मम । किमिहास्ति फलं तस्मान्न पृथग वक्तुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: ukteṣvapi ca sarveṣu śṛṇvatāṃ vo vaco mama | kimihāsti phalaṃ tasmānna pṛthaga vaktumutsahe
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the meantime knowing about all this from Siva the goddess urged the lord to destroy the sacri¬ fice of Dak?a.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ २८  करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in the meantime knowing about all this from Siva the goddess urged the lord to destroy the sacri¬ fice of Dak?a.
verses.science: स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ २८ करना चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: य एव खलु कल्पेषु कल्पः सम्प्रति वर्तते । तत्र सङ्क्षिप्य वर्तन्ते सृष्टयः प्रतिसृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: ya eva khalu kalpeṣu kalpaḥ samprati vartate | tatra saṅkṣipya vartante sṛṣṭayaḥ pratisṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.translation: Urged by the goddess the lord created the heroic Virabhadra the chief of Ganas, intending to destroy the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवस्य योगावतारवर्णन॑ नाम नवमो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by the goddess the lord created the heroic Virabhadra the chief of Ganas, intending to destroy the sacrifice.
verses.science: इति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवस्य योगावतारवर्णन॑ नाम नवमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वयं वर्तते कल्पो वाराहो नाम नामतः । अस्मिन्नपि द्विजश्रेष्ठा मनवस्तु चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: yastvayaṃ vartate kalpo vārāho nāma nāmataḥ | asminnapi dvijaśreṣṭhā manavastu caturdaśa
verses.translation: He had a thousand faces, a thousand lotus-like eyes. He was holding a thousand iron clubs, thousands of arrows, spear, axe, mace, bow, discus and the thunderbolt. He looked fierce and terrible. The crescent moon adorned his crest; the thunderbolt illuminated his hands. His hair shone like lightning. He had a huge mouth terrible with the curved fangs and a huge belly. His tongue was like lightnings His lips hung down. His voice sounded like the cloud and th. ocean. He wore the tiger's hide dripping with blood. He car-rings formed circles close to his cheeks. He had adorned his crest with the garlands from the heads of leading gods. He was bedecked in golden shoulderlets and jingling anklets. He was shining with heaps of gems. His chest was covered by necklaces. He was equal in exploit to the great fabulous animal Sarabha, tigers and lions. His gait was gentle and majestic as that of a stately elephant in lut. His lustre was white like conch, cliowrie, Kunda flower, moon and the lotus-stalk. He was.like the snow-capped lord of mountains who had become mobile. Flames surrounded him. Wearing pearl ornaments he shone brilliantly as the fire at the dissolu¬ tion of the world.
verses.hindi: योगावतारवर्णन नामक नौवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: He had a thousand faces, a thousand lotus-like eyes. He was holding a thousand iron clubs, thousands of arrows, spear, axe, mace, bow, discus and the thunderbolt. He looked fierce and terrible. The crescent moon adorned his crest; the thunderbolt illuminated his hands.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a thousand faces, a thousand lotus-like eyes. He was holding a thousand iron clubs, thousands of arrows, spear, axe, mace, bow, discus and the thunderbolt. He looked fierce and terrible. The crescent moon adorned his crest; the thunderbolt illuminated his hands.…
verses.science: योगावतारवर्णन नामक नौवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवादयः सप्त सप्त सावर्णिकादयः । तेषु वैवस्वतो नाम सप्तमो वर्तते मनुः
verses.transliteration: svāyambhuvādayaḥ sapta sapta sāvarṇikādayaḥ | teṣu vaivasvato nāma saptamo vartate manuḥ
verses.translation: That chief of Ganas knelt and bowed. With palms joined in reverence he stood beside the lord of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: That chief of Ganas knelt and bowed. With palms joined in reverence he stood beside the lord of gods.
verses.science: चित्तवाले आपको यथार्थरूपमें उसे बताऊँगा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु सर्गसंहारवृत्तयः । प्रायः समा भवन्तीति तर्कः कार्यो विजानता
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣu sarveṣu sargasaṃhāravṛttayaḥ | prāyaḥ samā bhavantīti tarkaḥ kāryo vijānatā
verses.translation: With his anger he created Bhadra the goddess Kali as a witness of his activities and his companion.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his anger he created Bhadra the goddess Kali as a witness of his activities and his companion.
verses.science: अलंकृत करके अत्यन्त प्रसन्‍न हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकल्पे परावृत्ते प्रवृत्ते कालमारुते । समुन्मूलितमूलेषु वृक्षेषु च वनेषु च
verses.transliteration: pūrvakalpe parāvṛtte pravṛtte kālamārute | samunmūlitamūleṣu vṛkṣeṣu ca vaneṣu ca
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the infuriated Daksa replied angrily "The younger daughters are better than you. They deserve my special reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the infuriated Daksa replied angrily "The younger daughters are better than you. They deserve my special reverence.
verses.science: देनेवाले भगवान् शिव ही हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगन्ति तृणवक्त्रीणि देवे दहति पावके । वृष्ट्या भुवि निषिक्तायां विवेलेष्वर्णवेषु च
verses.transliteration: jaganti tṛṇavaktrīṇi deve dahati pāvake | vṛṣṭyā bhuvi niṣiktāyāṃ viveleṣvarṇaveṣu ca
verses.translation: Their husbands evoke my respect and joy, for they are superior to your husband lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their husbands evoke my respect and joy, for they are superior to your husband lord Siva.
verses.science: अक्षय शरीर प्राप्त है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: दिक्षु सर्वासु मग्नासु वारिपूरे महीयसि । तदद्भिश्चटुलाक्षेपैस्तरङ्गभुजमण्डलैः
verses.transliteration: dikṣu sarvāsu magnāsu vāripūre mahīyasi | tadadbhiścaṭulākṣepaistaraṅgabhujamaṇḍalaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus insulted the infuriated goddess spoke to her father within the hearing of all present there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus insulted the infuriated goddess spoke to her father within the hearing of all present there.
verses.science: समस्त कर्मोंका फल है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धचण्डनृत्येषु ततः प्रलयवारिषु । ब्रह्मा नारायणो भूत्वा सुष्वाप सलिले सुखम्
verses.transliteration: prārabdhacaṇḍanṛtyeṣu tataḥ pralayavāriṣu | brahmā nārāyaṇo bhūtvā suṣvāpa salile sukham
verses.translation: O Dakfa, you insult my husband the lord of the world, whose insult no one has hitherto made.
verses.hindi: ज़िवतत्त्ववर्णन नामक छठाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O Dakfa, you insult my husband the lord of the world, whose insult no one has hitherto made.
verses.science: ज़िवतत्त्ववर्णन नामक छठाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: इमं चोदाहरन्मन्त्रं श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति । तं शृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तदर्थं चाक्षराश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ codāharanmantraṃ ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati | taṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhāstadarthaṃ cākṣarāśrayam
verses.translation: The Sruti says that these are great sinners — viz. a stealer of learning, a traitor to the preceptor and an insulter of the Vedas and of the god. They deserve to be punished.
verses.hindi: होकर भी अनेक रूपमें प्रकाशित होती है
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says that these are great sinners — viz. a stealer of learning, a traitor to the preceptor and an insulter of the Vedas and of the god. They deserve to be punished.
verses.science: होकर भी अनेक रूपमें प्रकाशित होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः । अयनं तस्य ता यस्मात्तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ | ayanaṃ tasya tā yasmāttena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore a terrible punishment befitting the great sin shall be meted out to you by divine intercession.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore a terrible punishment befitting the great sin shall be meted out to you by divine intercession.
verses.science: भी उसीसे उत्पन्न हुई है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोगमयीं निद्रां कुर्वन्तं त्रिदशेश्वरम् । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सिद्धा जनलोकनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: śivayogamayīṃ nidrāṃ kurvantaṃ tridaśeśvaram | baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ siddhā janalokanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Since the lord of gods has not been worshipped by you, know that your family is defiled and ruined.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the lord of gods has not been worshipped by you, know that your family is defiled and ruined.
verses.science: भगवान् शिव शक्तिमान् कहलाते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रैः प्रबोधयामासुः प्रभातसमये सुराः । यथा सृष्ट्यादिसमये ईश्वरं श्रुतयः पुरा
verses.transliteration: stotraiḥ prabodhayāmāsuḥ prabhātasamaye surāḥ | yathā sṛṣṭyādisamaye īśvaraṃ śrutayaḥ purā
verses.translation: After saying thus to her father Sati abandoned her body and without fear went to mountain Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to her father Sati abandoned her body and without fear went to mountain Himavat.
verses.science: मुक्ति विराजती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रबुद्ध उत्थाय शयनात्तोयमध्यगात् । उदैक्षत दिशः सर्वा योगनिद्रालसेक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabuddha utthāya śayanāttoyamadhyagāt | udaikṣata diśaḥ sarvā yoganidrālasekṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious leader of mountains attained the fruit of his merits. It was for her that he had performed penance for a long time.
verses.hindi: भी उनकी कृपासे मुक्त हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious leader of mountains attained the fruit of his merits. It was for her that he had performed penance for a long time.
verses.science: भी उनकी कृपासे मुक्त हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नापश्यत्स तदा किञ्चित्स्वात्मनो व्यतिरेकि यत् । सविस्मय इवासीनः परां चिन्तामुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: nāpaśyatsa tadā kiñcitsvātmano vyatireki yat | savismaya ivāsīnaḥ parāṃ cintāmupāgamat
verses.translation: The goddess blessed the lord of mountains. Through her Yogic Maya and at her own will, she made him her father.
verses.hindi: मुक्त हो जाते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess blessed the lord of mountains. Through her Yogic Maya and at her own will, she made him her father.
verses.science: मुक्त हो जाते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्व सा भगवती या तु मनोज्ञा महती मही । नानाविधमहाशैलनदीनगरकानना
verses.transliteration: kva sā bhagavatī yā tu manojñā mahatī mahī | nānāvidhamahāśailanadīnagarakānanā
verses.translation: On hearing about the departure of the goddess, Siva was angry with Daksa and the sages and cursed them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the departure of the goddess, Siva was angry with Daksa and the sages and cursed them.
verses.science: आदि कर्म शारीरिक सेवा है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं सञ्चिन्तयन्ब्रह्मा बुबुधे नैव भूस्थितिम् । तदा सस्मार पितरं भगवन्तं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sañcintayanbrahmā bubudhe naiva bhūsthitim | tadā sasmāra pitaraṃ bhagavantaṃ trilocanam
verses.translation: O Daksa, since for my sake the sinless Sati had been dishonoured and the other daughters worshipped along with their husbands, these sons-in-law of yours will be born but not of a womb in the sacrifices of Brahma in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. In the Gakusa Manvantara you will become a king as the grandson of Pracinabarhi? and the son of Pracetas.
verses.wordMeaning: O Daksa, since for my sake the sinless Sati had been dishonoured and the other daughters worshipped along with their husbands, these sons-in-law of yours will be born but not of a womb in the sacrifices of Brahma in the Vaivasvata Manvantara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Daksa, since for my sake the sinless Sati had been dishonoured and the other daughters worshipped along with their husbands, these sons-in-law of yours will be born but not of a womb in the sacrifices of Brahma in the Vaivasvata Manvantara.…
verses.science: विषयासक्तिका त्याग करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणाद्देवदेवस्य भवस्यामिततेजसः । ज्ञातवान्सलिले मग्नां धरणीं धरणीपतिः
verses.transliteration: smaraṇāddevadevasya bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ | jñātavānsalile magnāṃ dharaṇīṃ dharaṇīpatiḥ
verses.translation: O wicked one, there also I shall put up obstacles before you in all activities regarding virtue, wealth and love.
verses.commentary: Sense: O wicked one, there also I shall put up obstacles before you in all activities regarding virtue, wealth and love.
verses.science: जिवतत्वकथन नाम सप्तमोठ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो भूमेः समुद्धारं कर्तुकामः प्रजापतिः । जलक्रीडोचितं दिव्यं वाराहं रूपमस्मरत्
verses.transliteration: tato bhūmeḥ samuddhāraṃ kartukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ | jalakrīḍocitaṃ divyaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamasmarat
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Rudra of unmeasured splen¬ dour, Daksa abandoned the body and fell on the ground.
verses.hindi: ज़िवतत्त्वकथन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by Rudra of unmeasured splen¬ dour, Daksa abandoned the body and fell on the ground.
verses.science: ज़िवतत्त्वकथन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: महापर्वतवर्ष्माणं महाजलदनिःस्वनम् । नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं दीप्तशब्दं भयानकम्
verses.transliteration: mahāparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ mahājaladaniḥsvanam | nīlameghapratīkāśaṃ dīptaśabdaṃ bhayānakam
verses.translation: Bhrgu and others were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara in the sacrifice of Brahma bearing the bodies of Varuna.
verses.hindi: मुनीश्वर ! ये सब बातें विस्तारपूर्वक बताइये
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhrgu and others were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara in the sacrifice of Brahma bearing the bodies of Varuna.
verses.science: मुनीश्वर ! ये सब बातें विस्तारपूर्वक बताइये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पीनवृत्तघनस्कन्धं पीनोन्नतकटीतटम् । ह्रस्ववृत्तोरुजङ्घाग्रं सुतीक्ष्णखुरमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: pīnavṛttaghanaskandhaṃ pīnonnatakaṭītaṭam | hrasvavṛttorujaṅghāgraṃ sutīkṣṇakhuramaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Then in the Vaivasvata Manvantara in the virtuous sacrifice of the wicked Daksa the lord created obstacles
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the Vaivasvata Manvantara in the virtuous sacrifice of the wicked Daksa the lord created obstacles
verses.science: प्रति विश्वास उत्पन्न करनेवाला है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्मरागमणिप्रख्यं वृत्तभीषणलोचनम् । वृत्तदीर्घमहागात्रं स्तब्धकर्णस्थलोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: padmarāgamaṇiprakhyaṃ vṛttabhīṣaṇalocanam | vṛttadīrghamahāgātraṃ stabdhakarṇasthalojjvalam
verses.translation: When Himavat was delighted by becoming the father of the mother of the universe by the strength of his penance, when Siva married her and sported with her in his abode on the peak of Himavat when a long time elapsed, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara Daka as the son of Pracetas wanted to perform a horse-sacrifice.
verses.wordMeaning: When Himavat was delighted by becoming the father of the mother of the universe by the strength of his penance, when Siva married her and sported with her in his abode on the peak of Himavat when a long time elapsed,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Himavat was delighted by becoming the father of the mother of the universe by the strength of his penance, when Siva married her and sported with her in his abode on the peak of Himavat when a long time elapsed,…
verses.science: कर ही नहीं सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उदीर्णोच्छ्वासनिःश्वासघूर्णितप्रलयार्णवम् । विस्फुरत्सुसटाच्छन्नकपोलस्कन्धबन्धुरम्
verses.transliteration: udīrṇocchvāsaniḥśvāsaghūrṇitapralayārṇavam | visphuratsusaṭācchannakapolaskandhabandhuram
verses.translation: On the top of Himavat in an auspicious spot at the source of Ganga, frequented by the sages and the Siddhas Dak began his sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the top of Himavat in an auspicious spot at the source of Ganga, frequented by the sages and the Siddhas Dak began his sacrifice.
verses.science: व्यक्तरूपमें प्रकट हुए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मणिभिर्भूषणैश्चित्रैर्महारत्नैः परिष्कृतम् । विराजमानं विद्युद्भिर्मेघसङ्घमिवोन्नतम्
verses.transliteration: maṇibhirbhūṣaṇaiścitrairmahāratnaiḥ pariṣkṛtam | virājamānaṃ vidyudbhirmeghasaṅghamivonnatam
verses.translation: All the gods Indra and others gathered there and thought of going to attend the sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the gods Indra and others gathered there and thought of going to attend the sacrifice.
verses.science: तथा आश्रमोंकी व्यवस्था की। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय विपुलं रूपं वाराहममितं विधिः । पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविवेश रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: āsthāya vipulaṃ rūpaṃ vārāhamamitaṃ vidhiḥ | pṛthivyuddharaṇārthāya praviveśa rasātalam
verses.translation: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, SMhyas, Maruts, Ofmapas, Somapas, Ajyapas, Dhumapas, Alvins, Pitrs, and the other sages came there along with Viu to take part in the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: भगवान् रुद्र वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, SMhyas, Maruts, Ofmapas, Somapas, Ajyapas, Dhumapas, Alvins, Pitrs, and the other sages came there along with Viu to take part in the sacrifice.
verses.science: भगवान् रुद्र वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स तदा शुशुभेऽतीव सूकरो गिरिसन्निभः । लिङ्गाकृतेर्महेशस्य पादमूलं गतो यथा
verses.transliteration: sa tadā śuśubhe'tīva sūkaro girisannibhaḥ | liṅgākṛtermaheśasya pādamūlaṃ gato yathā
verses.translation: Indeed that man incurs great sin who docs not worship those who deserve worship and worships those who do not befit it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed that man incurs great sin who docs not worship those who deserve worship and worships those who do not befit it.
verses.science: हैं, उन भगवान्को नमस्कार है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स सलिले मग्नां पृथिवीं पृथिवीन्धरः । उद्धृत्यालिङ्ग्य दंष्ट्राभ्यामुन्ममज्ज रसातलात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa salile magnāṃ pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīndharaḥ | uddhṛtyāliṅgya daṃṣṭrābhyāmunmamajja rasātalāt
verses.translation: After saying this the sage spoke again to Daka
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the sage spoke again to Daka
verses.science: शान्त शिवको नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सिद्धा जनलोकनिवासिनः । मुमुदुर्ननृतुर्मूर्ध्नि तस्य पुष्पैरवाकिरन्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ siddhā janalokanivāsinaḥ | mumudurnanṛturmūrdhni tasya puṣpairavākiran
verses.translation: I see eleven Rudras armed with tridents and having matted hair. I do not know anyone else as the lord.
verses.hindi: महेश्वरी शिवाने पतिदेवसे उसके विषयमें पूछा
verses.commentary: Sense: I see eleven Rudras armed with tridents and having matted hair. I do not know anyone else as the lord.
verses.science: महेश्वरी शिवाने पतिदेवसे उसके विषयमें पूछा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वपुर्महावराहस्य शुशुभे पुष्पसंवृतम् । पतद्भिरिव खद्योतैः प्राशुरञ्जनपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: vapurmahāvarāhasya śuśubhe puṣpasaṃvṛtam | patadbhiriva khadyotaiḥ prāśurañjanaparvataḥ
verses.translation: What avails worshipping the gods in the sacrifice if the king of sacrifice, Rudra, is not worshipped by you?
verses.hindi: शिष्यास्तेषां प्रशिष्याश्ष शतशो3थ सहस्रशः॥ ५०  « प्रशिष्य हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: What avails worshipping the gods in the sacrifice if the king of sacrifice, Rudra, is not worshipped by you?
verses.science: शिष्यास्तेषां प्रशिष्याश्ष शतशो3थ सहस्रशः॥ ५० « प्रशिष्य हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः संस्थानमानीय वराहो महतीं महीम् । स्वमेव रूपमास्थाय स्थापयामास वै विभुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃsthānamānīya varāho mahatīṃ mahīm | svameva rūpamāsthāya sthāpayāmāsa vai vibhuḥ
verses.translation: I offer this Caru in the golden vessel, sanctified by mantras, after assigning the share to Vi§nu the lord of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भक्त्या चात्यन्नभाविता: ॥ ५१  भावित हो भाग्यवान् पुरुष मुक्त हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: I offer this Caru in the golden vessel, sanctified by mantras, after assigning the share to Vi§nu the lord of sacrifice.
verses.science: भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भक्त्या चात्यन्नभाविता: ॥ ५१ भावित हो भाग्यवान् पुरुष मुक्त हो जाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं च समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां स्थापयन् गिरीन् । भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान् कल्पयामास पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīṃ ca samīkṛtya pṛthivyāṃ sthāpayan girīn | bhūrādyāṃścaturo lokān kalpayāmāsa pūrvavat
verses.translation: "O Daka, since Rudra the lord of the chief of the gods is not propitiated your sacrifice will not be efficacious."
verses.hindi: जति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयरसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवतत्तवज्ञाने व्यासावतारवर्णन नामाष्टमो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Daka, since Rudra the lord of the chief of the gods is not propitiated your sacrifice will not be efficacious."
verses.science: जति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयरसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवतत्तवज्ञाने व्यासावतारवर्णन नामाष्टमो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: इति सह महतीं महीं महीध्रैः प्रलयमहाजलधेरधःस्थमध्यात् । उपरि च विनिवेश्य विश्वकर्मा चरमचरं च जगत्ससर्ज भूयः
verses.transliteration: iti saha mahatīṃ mahīṃ mahīdhraiḥ pralayamahājaladheradhaḥsthamadhyāt | upari ca viniveśya viśvakarmā caramacaraṃ ca jagatsasarja bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the infuriated sage Dadhica left
verses.hindi: प्रसंगमें व्यासावतारवर्णन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the infuriated sage Dadhica left
verses.science: प्रसंगमें व्यासावतारवर्णन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: He submitted to the lord in the company of the goddess. "Please command what task shall I carry out?"
verses.commentary: Sense: He submitted to the lord in the company of the goddess. "Please command what task shall I carry out?"
verses.science: सम्भाषण भी कर सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: He submitted to the lord in the company of the goddess. "Please command what task shall I carry out?"
verses.commentary: Sense: He submitted to the lord in the company of the goddess. "Please command what task shall I carry out?"
verses.science: अवश्य करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । सृष्टिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । सर्गं चिन्तयतस्तस्य तदा वै बुद्धिपूर्वकम् । प्रध्यानकाले मोहस्तु प्रादुर्भूतस्तमोमयः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.12. dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | sṛṣṭivarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | sargaṃ cintayatastasya tadā vai buddhipūrvakam | pradhyānakāle mohastu prādurbhūtastamomayaḥ
verses.translation: Then with a desire to please Parvatl, Siva spoke to the huge-armed Virabhadra in raised sound.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a desire to please Parvatl, Siva spoke to the huge-armed Virabhadra in raised sound.
verses.science: आचारका आश्रय ग्रहण करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमोमोहो महामोहस्तामिस्रश्चान्धसंज्ञितः । अविद्या पञ्चमी चैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tamomoho mahāmohastāmisraścāndhasaṃjñitaḥ | avidyā pañcamī caiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: These had thousand hands holding thousands of weapons and had the lustre of Rudra.
verses.hindi: अष्टधा लक्षण प्राह बताये गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: These had thousand hands holding thousands of weapons and had the lustre of Rudra.
verses.science: अष्टधा लक्षण प्राह बताये गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चधाऽवस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायतस्त्वभिमानिनः । सर्वतस्तमसातीव बीजकुम्भवदावृतः
verses.transliteration: pañcadhā'vasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyatastvabhimāninaḥ | sarvatastamasātīva bījakumbhavadāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then Bhadra stationed in the midst of the Bhadra- ganas in the company of Bhadra shone like Siva in the. midst of Rudraganas in the company of Parvatl.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञानवर्णन नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Bhadra stationed in the midst of the Bhadra- ganas in the company of Bhadra shone like Siva in the. midst of Rudraganas in the company of Parvatl.
verses.science: शिवज्ञानवर्णन नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशः स्तब्धो निःसंज्ञ एव च । तस्मात्तेषां वृता बुद्धिर्मुखानि करणानि च
verses.transliteration: bahirantaścāprakāśaḥ stabdho niḥsaṃjña eva ca | tasmātteṣāṃ vṛtā buddhirmukhāni karaṇāni ca
verses.translation: Mountains crumbled. The earth quaked. Winds rolled and reeled. The ocean was agitated.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्योां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे पंचाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Mountains crumbled. The earth quaked. Winds rolled and reeled. The ocean was agitated.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्योां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे पंचाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्ते संवृतात्मानो नगा मुख्याः प्रकीर्तिताः । तं दृष्ट्वासाधकं ब्रह्मा प्रथमं सर्गमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātte saṃvṛtātmāno nagā mukhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvāsādhakaṃ brahmā prathamaṃ sargamīdṛśam
verses.translation: Then the lords of ganas of mountain-like huge bodies uprooted the sacrificial posts and tied them to the necks of the Hotr priests by means of ropes. They broke and powdered the sacrificial vessels of various shapes and sizes dissolved them in water and hurled all the appendages of the sacrifice In the currents of the Gahga river.
verses.hindi: इवति श्रीजिवमहाएुरणे सप्तम्यां गया पद 34027 दम '॥। कक 'दशो5 ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Then the lords of ganas of mountain-like huge bodies uprooted the sacrificial posts and tied them to the necks of the Hotr priests by means of ropes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lords of ganas of mountain-like huge bodies uprooted the sacrificial posts and tied them to the necks of the Hotr priests by means of ropes.…
verses.science: इवति श्रीजिवमहाएुरणे सप्तम्यां गया पद 34027 दम '॥। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रसन्नमना भूत्वा द्वितीयं सोऽभ्यमन्यत । तस्याभिधायतः सर्गं तिर्य्यक्स्रोतोऽभ्यवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: aprasannamanā bhūtvā dvitīyaṃ so'bhyamanyata | tasyābhidhāyataḥ sargaṃ tiryyaksroto'bhyavarttata
verses.translation: While houses were being dismantled, the women shrieked and cried helplessly "O husband" "O Qhild" "O father" "O brother" "O mother" "O uncle.'*
verses.hindi: आणायाम कर लेना श्रेष्ठ बताया गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: While houses were being dismantled, the women shrieked and cried helplessly "O husband" "O Qhild" "O father" "O brother" "O mother" "O uncle.'*
verses.science: आणायाम कर लेना श्रेष्ठ बताया गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःप्रकाशास्तिर्य्यञ्च आवृताश्च बहिः पुनः । पश्वात्मानस्ततो जाता उत्पथग्राहिणश्च ते
verses.transliteration: antaḥprakāśāstiryyañca āvṛtāśca bahiḥ punaḥ | paśvātmānastato jātā utpathagrāhiṇaśca te
verses.translation: With the end of bk bow he hit Pusan's pearl like row of teeth. Thereafter Pusan could not utter words clearly.
verses.hindi: संस्कार परम पुण्यं शिवेन परिभाषितम्॥ ३  समस्त पापोंका शोधन करनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: With the end of bk bow he hit Pusan's pearl like row of teeth. Thereafter Pusan could not utter words clearly.
verses.science: संस्कार परम पुण्यं शिवेन परिभाषितम्॥ ३ समस्त पापोंका शोधन करनेवाला है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमप्यसाधकं ज्ञात्वा सर्गमन्यममन्यत । तदोर्ध्वस्रोतसो वृत्तो देवसर्गस्तु सात्त्विकः
verses.transliteration: tamapyasādhakaṃ jñātvā sargamanyamamanyata | tadordhvasrotaso vṛtto devasargastu sāttvikaḥ
verses.translation: Bhadra pursued him drawing his great bow, terrible due to the twanging sound of the firm bow-string, and dis¬ charging the arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadra pursued him drawing his great bow, terrible due to the twanging sound of the firm bow-string, and dis¬ charging the arrows.
verses.science: बिना कैसे 'आत्मा' का अनुभव होगा 2। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ते सुखप्रीतिबहुला बहिरन्तश्च नावृताः । प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च स्वभावादेव संज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: te sukhaprītibahulā bahirantaśca nāvṛtāḥ | prakāśā bahirantaśca svabhāvādeva saṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: He sounded the bow by drawing the string to the ears like the thundering cloud. The bowstring, heaven, sky and earth reverberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: He sounded the bow by drawing the string to the ears like the thundering cloud. The bowstring, heaven, sky and earth reverberated.
verses.science: निरन्तर गुरुसेवनमें लगा रहे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिध्यायतोऽव्यक्तादर्वाक्स्रोतस्तु साधकः । मनुष्यनामा सञ्जातः सर्गो दुःखसमुत्कटः
verses.transliteration: tato'bhidhyāyato'vyaktādarvāksrotastu sādhakaḥ | manuṣyanāmā sañjātaḥ sargo duḥkhasamutkaṭaḥ
verses.translation: O chief of Ganas, accompanied by Bhadrakali, destroy the sacrifice of Daksa the son of Pracetas.
verses.hindi: नाम हैं--ज्ञान, क्रिया, चर्या और योग
verses.commentary: Sense: O chief of Ganas, accompanied by Bhadrakali, destroy the sacrifice of Daksa the son of Pracetas.
verses.science: नाम हैं--ज्ञान, क्रिया, चर्या और योग। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशा बहिरन्तस्ते तमोद्रिक्ता रजोऽधिकाः । पञ्चमोऽनुग्रहः सर्गश्चतुर्धा संव्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: prakāśā bahirantaste tamodriktā rajo'dhikāḥ | pañcamo'nugrahaḥ sargaścaturdhā saṃvyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: O chief of Ganas, I shall witness your exploit staying near Raibhya's*" hermitage along with the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O chief of Ganas, I shall witness your exploit staying near Raibhya's*" hermitage along with the goddess.
verses.science: आचरणका नाम चर्या है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: विपर्य्येण शक्त्या च तुष्ट्या सिद्ध्या तथैव च । तेऽपरिग्राहिणः सर्वे संविभागरताः पुनः
verses.transliteration: viparyyeṇa śaktyā ca tuṣṭyā siddhyā tathaiva ca | te'parigrāhiṇaḥ sarve saṃvibhāgaratāḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: In the place Kanakhala there are huge trees near Gahgadvara«« resembling the mountain with the golden peaks like Meru* and Mandara.**® Daksa is holding sacrifice there. Immediately create obstacles in that sacrifice too. Do not delay.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the place Kanakhala there are huge trees near Gahgadvara«« resembling the mountain with the golden peaks like Meru* and Mandara.**® Daksa is holding sacrifice there. Immediately create obstacles in that sacrifice too. Do not delay.
verses.science: भी समभाव रखते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: खादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च भूताद्याः परिकीर्तिताः । प्रथमो महतः सर्गो ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: khādanāścāpyaśīlāśca bhūtādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | prathamo mahataḥ sargo brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: When this was mentioned by the lord, the goddess, daughter of Himavat looked at Virabhadra and Bhadrakal! as does a cow at her calf Embracing him and sniffing at his head as at the head of Subrahmanya-** she smiled and spoke in sweet voic'*
verses.commentary: Sense: When this was mentioned by the lord, the goddess, daughter of Himavat looked at Virabhadra and Bhadrakal! as does a cow at her calf Embracing him and sniffing at his head as at the head of Subrahmanya-** she smiled and spoke in sweet voic'*
verses.science: है, तब “आभ्यन्तर' कहलाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गः स उच्यते । वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargaḥ sa ucyate | vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O dear Bhadra, O blessed one, of great strength and exploit, you are born to carry out the task that pleases me. Wipe off my anger and sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear Bhadra, O blessed one, of great strength and exploit, you are born to carry out the task that pleases me. Wipe off my anger and sorrow.
verses.science: वेदाध्ययन आदि नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष प्रकृतेः सर्गः सम्भृतोऽबुद्धिपूर्वकः । मुख्यसर्गश्चतुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa prakṛteḥ sargaḥ sambhṛto'buddhipūrvakaḥ | mukhyasargaścaturthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: At my bidding O dear, inflict violence in the company of Bhadra. Kill the sacrificer. Let the holy sacrifice be turned into non-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: दूसरी किसी वस्तुके अर्थकों समझना नहीं
verses.commentary: Sense: At my bidding O dear, inflict violence in the company of Bhadra. Kill the sacrificer. Let the holy sacrifice be turned into non-sacrifice.
verses.science: दूसरी किसी वस्तुके अर्थकों समझना नहीं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तिर्य्यक्स्रोतस्तु यः प्रोक्तस्तिर्यग्योनिः स पञ्चमः । तदूर्ध्वस्रोतसः षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tiryyaksrotastu yaḥ proktastiryagyoniḥ sa pañcamaḥ | tadūrdhvasrotasaḥ ṣaṣṭho devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of Siva and Siva of wonderful activities, with bent head, as if it was their blessing, Bhadra bowed to them and left.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Siva and Siva of wonderful activities, with bent head, as if it was their blessing, Bhadra bowed to them and left.
verses.science: सम्भावना नहीं रहती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्वाक् स्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः । अष्टमोऽनुग्रहः सर्गः कौमारो नवमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tato'rvāk srotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ | aṣṭamo'nugrahaḥ sargaḥ kaumāro navamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The infuriated lord Virabhadra, fond of crema¬ tion ground, created from his skin-pores chiefs of Ganas, and from his right hand hundred crores others.
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated lord Virabhadra, fond of crema¬ tion ground, created from his skin-pores chiefs of Ganas, and from his right hand hundred crores others.
verses.science: (छलना)-का ही कारण होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राकृताश्च त्रयः पूर्वे सर्गास्तेऽबुद्धिपूर्वकाः । बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रवर्त्तन्ते मुख्याद्याः पञ्च वैकृताः
verses.transliteration: prākṛtāśca trayaḥ pūrve sargāste'buddhipūrvakāḥ | buddhipūrvaṃ pravarttante mukhyādyāḥ pañca vaikṛtāḥ
verses.translation: See P lO note, 693 note. *
verses.hindi: चाहने लगे हों, वे भक्त भी मुझे प्रिय हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: See P lO note, 693 note. *
verses.science: चाहने लगे हों, वे भक्त भी मुझे प्रिय हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान् । सनन्दं सनकं चैव विद्वांसञ्च सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: agre sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān | sanandaṃ sanakaṃ caiva vidvāṃsañca sanātanam
verses.translation: Then the universe with all its open spaces and crevices was covered with the chiefs of ganas equal in exploit to Bhadra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the universe with all its open spaces and crevices was covered with the chiefs of ganas equal in exploit to Bhadra.
verses.science: कोई लाभ नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च पूर्वमेव प्रजापतिः । सर्वे ते योगिनो ज्ञेया वीतरागा विमत्सराः
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca pūrvameva prajāpatiḥ | sarve te yogino jñeyā vītarāgā vimatsarāḥ
verses.translation: They had spears, tridents and maces, axes, stones and rocks. They resembled deadly fire and Rudra. They had three eyes and matted hair.
verses.hindi: तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति॥ ७२  कभी ओझल नहीं होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: They had spears, tridents and maces, axes, stones and rocks. They resembled deadly fire and Rudra. They had three eyes and matted hair.
verses.science: तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति॥ ७२ कभी ओझल नहीं होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरासक्तमनसो न चक्रुः सृष्टये मतिम् । तेषु सृष्ट्यनपेक्षेषु गतेषु सनकादिषु
verses.transliteration: īśvarāsaktamanaso na cakruḥ sṛṣṭaye matim | teṣu sṛṣṭyanapekṣeṣu gateṣu sanakādiṣu
verses.translation: They flew in hundreds and seated on lions roared loudly like clouds.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तखण्डे शिवभक्तिवर्णं नाम दशमोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: They flew in hundreds and seated on lions roared loudly like clouds.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तखण्डे शिवभक्तिवर्णं नाम दशमोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टुकामः पुनर्ब्रह्मा तताप परमं तपः । तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य न किञ्चित्समवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: sraṣṭukāmaḥ punarbrahmā tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ | tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiñcitsamavarttata
verses.translation: Lord Bhadra surrounded by the Bhadras shone like Kalabhairava surrounded by hundreds of deadly fires at the time of dissolution.
verses.hindi: शिवभक्तिवर्णन नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Bhadra surrounded by the Bhadras shone like Kalabhairava surrounded by hundreds of deadly fires at the time of dissolution.
verses.science: शिवभक्तिवर्णन नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुःखात्क्रोधो व्यजायत । क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration: tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥkhātkrodho vyajāyata | krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ
verses.translation: In their midst, mounted on a lordly bull and with a bull-emblem, lord Bhadra went ahead like Siva seated on Nandin.
verses.hindi: विदुषां द्विजमुख्यानां वर्णधर्मसमासत:॥ १  संक्षेपसे वर्णधर्मका वर्णन करता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: In their midst, mounted on a lordly bull and with a bull-emblem, lord Bhadra went ahead like Siva seated on Nandin.
verses.science: विदुषां द्विजमुख्यानां वर्णधर्मसमासत:॥ १ संक्षेपसे वर्णधर्मका वर्णन करता हूँ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेभ्योऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो भूताः प्रेतास्तदाभवन् । सर्वांस्तानश्रुजान्दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मानमनिन्दत
verses.transliteration: tatastebhyo'śrubindubhyo bhūtāḥ pretāstadābhavan | sarvāṃstānaśrujāndṛṣṭvā brahmātmānamanindata
verses.translation: Bhasita shone by the side of Bhadra like the lord of mountains by the side of Siva.
verses.hindi: लिप्त नहीं होते, जैसे जलसे कमलका पत्ता
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhasita shone by the side of Bhadra like the lord of mountains by the side of Siva.
verses.science: लिप्त नहीं होते, जैसे जलसे कमलका पत्ता। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीव्राऽभवन्मूर्छा क्रोधामर्षसमुद्भवा । मूर्च्छितस्तु जहौ प्राणान्क्रोधाविष्टः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasya tīvrā'bhavanmūrchā krodhāmarṣasamudbhavā | mūrcchitastu jahau prāṇānkrodhāviṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Bhadra too shone in his company as he held the white chowries like the lord with the trident weapon and the crescent moon.
verses.hindi: वैसे ही उनके लिये भी नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadra too shone in his company as he held the white chowries like the lord with the trident weapon and the crescent moon.
verses.science: वैसे ही उनके लिये भी नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राणेश्वरो रुद्रो भगवान्नीललोहितः । प्रसादमतुलं कर्त्तुं प्रादुरासीत्प्रभोर्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāṇeśvaro rudro bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ | prasādamatulaṃ karttuṃ prādurāsītprabhormukhāt
verses.translation: Bhanukampa of great splendour bedecked in gold and jewels blew on the auspicious white conch Bhadra in front of Bhadra.
verses.hindi: समझना चाहिए; इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanukampa of great splendour bedecked in gold and jewels blew on the auspicious white conch Bhadra in front of Bhadra.
verses.science: समझना चाहिए; इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दशधा चैकधा चक्रे स्वात्मानं प्रभुरीश्वरः । ते तेनोक्ता महात्मानो दशधा चैकधा कृताः
verses.transliteration: daśadhā caikadhā cakre svātmānaṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ | te tenoktā mahātmāno daśadhā caikadhā kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The divine drums were sounded with divine tumultuous tone. The clouds in hundreds made showers of flowers on his head.
verses.hindi: र ्टटकको ज्ञानसारार्थसं ग्रह: ॥ सारभूत अर्थका संग्रह प्रकट किया है
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine drums were sounded with divine tumultuous tone. The clouds in hundreds made showers of flowers on his head.
verses.science: र ्टटकको ज्ञानसारार्थसं ग्रह: ॥ सारभूत अर्थका संग्रह प्रकट किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यूयं सृष्टा मया वत्सा लोकानुग्रहकारणात् । तस्मात्सर्वस्य लोकस्य स्थापनाय हिताय च
verses.transliteration: yūyaṃ sṛṣṭā mayā vatsā lokānugrahakāraṇāt | tasmātsarvasya lokasya sthāpanāya hitāya ca
verses.translation: Winds taking up the fragrance of full blown flowers pregnant with honey blew favourbly on their way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Winds taking up the fragrance of full blown flowers pregnant with honey blew favourbly on their way.
verses.science: बाह्य कर्तव्य शेष नहीं रहता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजासन्तानहेतोश्च प्रयतध्वमतन्द्रिताः । एवमुक्ताश्च रुरुदुर्दुद्रुवुश्च समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: prajāsantānahetośca prayatadhvamatandritāḥ | evamuktāśca rurudurdudruvuśca samantataḥ
verses.translation: Then the elated chiefs proud of their strength danced, rejoiced, cried, laughed, spoke and sang.
verses.hindi: हि श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयरसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवज्ञानवर्णन॑ नामैकादशोध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the elated chiefs proud of their strength danced, rejoiced, cried, laughed, spoke and sang.
verses.science: हि श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयरसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवज्ञानवर्णन॑ नामैकादशोध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रोदनाद् द्रावणाच्चैव ते रुद्रा नामतः स्मृताः । येरुद्रास्ते खलु प्राणा ये प्राणास्ते महात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: rodanād drāvaṇāccaiva te rudrā nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ | yerudrāste khalu prāṇā ye prāṇāste mahātmakāḥ
verses.translation: In a moment the strong \rabhadra with his
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण अर्थका साधक कहा गया है
verses.commentary: Sense: In a moment the strong \rabhadra with his
verses.science: सम्पूर्ण अर्थका साधक कहा गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो मृतस्य देवस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । घृणी ददौ पुनः प्राणान् ब्रह्मपुत्रो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato mṛtasya devasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | ghṛṇī dadau punaḥ prāṇān brahmaputro maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the chief of Ganas Bhadra entered like Rudra desirous of burning the worlds at the time of dissolution.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the chief of Ganas Bhadra entered like Rudra desirous of burning the worlds at the time of dissolution.
verses.science: मन्त्रका प्रतिपादन किया है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टवदनो रुद्रः प्राणप्रत्यागमाद्विभोः । अभ्यभाषत विश्वेशो ब्रह्माणं परमं वचः
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭavadano rudraḥ prāṇapratyāgamādvibhoḥ | abhyabhāṣata viśveśo brahmāṇaṃ paramaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Then he saw the great Satra of the gods of great splendour the chief of whom was Visnu. The satra had all the paraphernalia — the flags of various colours etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he saw the great Satra of the gods of great splendour the chief of whom was Visnu. The satra had all the paraphernalia — the flags of various colours etc.
verses.science: वबाचक माना गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मा भैर्माभैर्महाभाग विरिञ्चे जगतां गुरो । मया ते प्राणिताः प्राणाः सुखमुत्तिष्ठ सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: mā bhairmābhairmahābhāga viriñce jagatāṃ guro | mayā te prāṇitāḥ prāṇāḥ sukhamuttiṣṭha suvrata
verses.translation: The rites were performed neatly in accordance with the rules found in the Vedas by the sages who were experts in sacrifices and who performed the rites properly,
verses.commentary: Sense: The rites were performed neatly in accordance with the rules found in the Vedas by the sages who were experts in sacrifices and who performed the rites properly,
verses.science: स्वभावत: निर्मल हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नानुभूतमिव तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं मनोहरम् । हरं निरीक्ष्य शनकैर्नेत्रैः फुल्लाम्बुजप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: svapnānubhūtamiva tacchrutvā vākyaṃ manoharam | haraṃ nirīkṣya śanakairnetraiḥ phullāmbujaprabhaiḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of celestial damsels were there. The Satra was attended by the Apsaras. The sweet sound of flutes and lutes spread and was enhanced by the sound of Vedic hymns.
verses.hindi: बचनोंपर श्रद्धा न करनेवाला पुरुष नरकमें जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of celestial damsels were there. The Satra was attended by the Apsaras. The sweet sound of flutes and lutes spread and was enhanced by the sound of Vedic hymns.
verses.science: बचनोंपर श्रद्धा न करनेवाला पुरुष नरकमें जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा प्रत्यागतप्राणः स्निग्धगम्भीरया गिरा । उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा तमुद्दिश्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tathā pratyāgataprāṇaḥ snigdhagambhīrayā girā | uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā tamuddiśya kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: On seeing all this, the heroic Virabhadra of great exploits roared like a lion or a majestic rumbling cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing all this, the heroic Virabhadra of great exploits roared like a lion or a majestic rumbling cloud.
verses.science: सुभाषित समझना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि दर्शनमात्रेण चानन्दयसि मे मनः । को भवान् विश्वमूर्त्या वा स्थित एकादशात्मकः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi darśanamātreṇa cānandayasi me manaḥ | ko bhavān viśvamūrtyā vā sthita ekādaśātmakaḥ
verses.translation: Then a hurrah of joy, filling the sky and superseding the sound of the ocean was produced by the lords of ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a hurrah of joy, filling the sky and superseding the sound of the ocean was produced by the lords of ganas.
verses.science: होनेके कारण दुर्भाषित कहलाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा व्याजहार महेश्वरः । स्पृशन् कराभ्यां ब्रह्माणं सुसुखाभ्यां सुरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vyājahāra maheśvaraḥ | spṛśan karābhyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ susukhābhyāṃ sureśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Overwhelmed by the great sound the frightened heaven-dwellers ran helter-skelter dropping their garments and ornaments.
verses.hindi: समान कहीं कोई दूसरा मन्त्र नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Overwhelmed by the great sound the frightened heaven-dwellers ran helter-skelter dropping their garments and ornaments.
verses.science: समान कहीं कोई दूसरा मन्त्र नहीं है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मां विद्धि परमात्मानं तव पुत्रत्वमागतम् । एते चैकादश रुद्रास्त्वां सुरक्षितुमागताः
verses.transliteration: māṃ viddhi paramātmānaṃ tava putratvamāgatam | ete caikādaśa rudrāstvāṃ surakṣitumāgatāḥ
verses.translation: "Has the great Meru been burst? Is the earth pierced through? What is this?" the gods# began to scream and shout.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Has the great Meru been burst? Is the earth pierced through? What is this?" the gods# began to scream and shout.
verses.science: है, जैसे वृत्तिसे सूत्र। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तीव्रामिमां मूर्च्छां विधूय मदनुग्रहात् । प्रबुद्धस्व यथापूर्वं प्रजा वै स्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tasmāttīvrāmimāṃ mūrcchāṃ vidhūya madanugrahāt | prabuddhasva yathāpūrvaṃ prajā vai sraṣṭumarhasi
verses.translation: Some abandoned their lives due to fear like lordly elephants in a thick forest on hearing the roar of the lion.
verses.hindi: हिताय सर्वमर्त्यानां द्विजानां तु विशेषत:॥ ३८  द्विजोंक हितके लिये इसे कहा था
verses.commentary: Sense: Some abandoned their lives due to fear like lordly elephants in a thick forest on hearing the roar of the lion.
verses.science: हिताय सर्वमर्त्यानां द्विजानां तु विशेषत:॥ ३८ द्विजोंक हितके लिये इसे कहा था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं भगवता प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मा प्रीतमना ह्यभूत् । नामाष्टकेन विश्वात्मा तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhagavatā prokto brahmā prītamanā hyabhūt | nāmāṣṭakena viśvātmā tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: In the meantime lord Bhadra in the company of Bhadras and the goddess Bhadra reached the brilliant sacri¬ ficial altar.
verses.hindi: पंचाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णन नामक बारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime lord Bhadra in the company of Bhadras and the goddess Bhadra reached the brilliant sacri¬ ficial altar.
verses.science: पंचाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णन नामक बारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । नमस्ते भगवन् रुद्र भास्करामिततेजसे । नमो भवाय देवाय रसायाम्बुमयात्मने । शर्वाय क्षितिरूपाय सदासुरभये नमः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | namaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejase | namo bhavāya devāya rasāyāmbumayātmane | śarvāya kṣitirūpāya sadāsurabhaye namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, Daksa stood steady and firm though he was frightened. He spoke angrily "Who are you? What do you wish?"
verses.hindi: भावितचित्त होकर संसार-बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, Daksa stood steady and firm though he was frightened. He spoke angrily "Who are you? What do you wish?"
verses.science: भावितचित्त होकर संसार-बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशाय वसवे तुभ्यं नमः स्पर्शमयात्मने । पशूनां पतये चैव पावकायातितेजसे । भीमाय व्योमरूपाय शब्दमात्राय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: īśāya vasave tubhyaṃ namaḥ sparśamayātmane | paśūnāṃ pataye caiva pāvakāyātitejase | bhīmāya vyomarūpāya śabdamātrāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the wicked Daksa, Virabhadra of great splendour and of majestically rumbling sound like the cloud smilingly looked at Daksa, the gods and the Rtviks. He spoke the relevent words full of meaning without the least excitement.
verses.hindi: मानव इस विद्याद्वारा कैसे मुक्त हो सकता है ?
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the wicked Daksa, Virabhadra of great splendour and of majestically rumbling sound like the cloud smilingly looked at Daksa, the gods and the Rtviks. He spoke the relevent words full of meaning without the least excitement.
verses.science: मानव इस विद्याद्वारा कैसे मुक्त हो सकता है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उग्रायोग्रस्वरूपाय यजमानात्मने नमः । महाशिवाय सोमाय नमोऽस्त्वमृतमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: ugrāyograsvarūpāya yajamānātmane namaḥ | mahāśivāya somāya namo'stvamṛtamūrtaye
verses.translation: If the share has not been allotted to us in the sacrifice let the reason be mentioned or let the gods fight with me.
verses.hindi: पूजयेन्मां स मुच्येत सात कार्या विचारणा॥ १४  जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: If the share has not been allotted to us in the sacrifice let the reason be mentioned or let the gods fight with me.
verses.science: पूजयेन्मां स मुच्येत सात कार्या विचारणा॥ १४ जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । प्रार्थयामास विश्वेशं गिरा प्रणतिपूर्वया
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | prārthayāmāsa viśveśaṃ girā praṇatipūrvayā
verses.translation: When they were told thus by the chief of Ganas the gods headed by Daksa said — "The mantras are our authorities. We are not the lords."
verses.hindi: मेरा पूजन करता है, वह मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were told thus by the chief of Ganas the gods headed by Daksa said — "The mantras are our authorities. We are not the lords."
verses.science: मेरा पूजन करता है, वह मुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् भूतभव्येश मम पुत्र महेश्वर । सृष्टिहेतोस्त्वमुत्पन्नो ममाङ्गेऽनङ्गनाशन
verses.transliteration: bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa mama putra maheśvara | sṛṣṭihetostvamutpanno mamāṅge'naṅganāśana
verses.translation: The Mantras said — "O gods, your minds are oppressed by Tamas. Hence you do not deserve the first share. Worship lord Siva."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mantras said — "O gods, your minds are oppressed by Tamas. Hence you do not deserve the first share. Worship lord Siva."
verses.science: पूजन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्महति कार्येऽस्मिन् व्यापृतस्य जगत्प्रभो । सहायं कुरु सर्वत्र स्रष्टुमर्हसि सुप्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmānmahati kārye'smin vyāpṛtasya jagatprabho | sahāyaṃ kuru sarvatra sraṣṭumarhasi suprajāḥ
verses.translation: Though advised by the Mantras the gods with deluded minds did not offer the share to Bhadra. They desired to drop him out.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though advised by the Mantras the gods with deluded minds did not offer the share to Bhadra. They desired to drop him out.
verses.science: विस्तार करने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवं प्रार्थितो देवो रुद्रस्त्रिपुरमर्दनः । बाढमित्येव तां वाणीं प्रतिजग्राह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tenaivaṃ prārthito devo rudrastripuramardanaḥ | bāḍhamityeva tāṃ vāṇīṃ pratijagrāha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: When their truthful and wholesome words went in, vain the Mantras turned away from that place and went to the eternal Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: When their truthful and wholesome words went in, vain the Mantras turned away from that place and went to the eternal Brahmaloka.
verses.science: मुद्रा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा हृष्टं तमभिनन्द्य च । स्रष्टुं तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातस्तथान्याश्चासृजत्प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā hṛṣṭaṃ tamabhinandya ca | sraṣṭuṃ tenābhyanujñātastathānyāścāsṛjatprajāḥ
verses.translation: Then the chief of Ganas spoke to the gods headed by Visnu, "You have not accepted the mantras being proud of your strength. Since we have been dishonoured
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the chief of Ganas spoke to the gods headed by Visnu, "You have not accepted the mantras being proud of your strength. Since we have been dishonoured
verses.science: ही इस मन्त्रका देवता हूँ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसः पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सोऽसृजन्मनसैव च । पुरस्तादसृजद् ब्रह्मा धर्मं सङ्कल्पमेव च
verses.transliteration: marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaḥ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum | dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so'sṛjanmanasaiva ca | purastādasṛjad brahmā dharmaṃ saṅkalpameva ca
verses.translation: After saying thus the infuriated lord burnt the sacri¬ ficial altar with the fire of his eyes as Siva had burnt the three Puras.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus the infuriated lord burnt the sacri¬ ficial altar with the fire of his eyes as Siva had burnt the three Puras.*'
verses.science: अंगन्यास होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा द्वादशादौ प्रकीर्तिताः । सह रुद्रेण सम्भूताः पुराणा गृहमेधिनः
verses.transliteration: ityete brahmaṇaḥ putrā dvādaśādau prakīrtitāḥ | saha rudreṇa sambhūtāḥ purāṇā gṛhamedhinaḥ
verses.translation: There were heaps of foodstuffs and beverages; milk flowed like rivers exuding nectar; curds formed smooth slimy slush. Sweet smelling meat and foodstuffs lay in heaps high and low. There were juicy beverages, and foodstuffs to be lapped up. The heroes ate, chewed and scattered them.
verses.hindi: माहात्य्यवर्णन नामक तेरहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: There were heaps of foodstuffs and beverages; milk flowed like rivers exuding nectar; curds formed smooth slimy slush. Sweet smelling meat and foodstuffs lay in heaps high and low. There were juicy beverages, and foodstuffs to be lapped up. The heroes ate,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There were heaps of foodstuffs and beverages; milk flowed like rivers exuding nectar; curds formed smooth slimy slush. Sweet smelling meat and foodstuffs lay in heaps high and low. There were juicy beverages, and foodstuffs to be lapped up. The heroes ate,…
verses.science: माहात्य्यवर्णन नामक तेरहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां द्वादश वंशाः स्युर्दिव्या देवगणान्विताः । प्रजावन्तः क्रियावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ dvādaśa vaṃśāḥ syurdivyā devagaṇānvitāḥ | prajāvantaḥ kriyāvanto maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The heroic Bhadras born of Virabhadra's body hit and split the haughty gods including the guardians oi the quarters by means of discus, thunderbolts, spears, S iktis, nooses, iron clubs, iron rods, swords, axes, Bhindipalas and huge battle-axes
verses.hindi: जाता है, वह सदा निष्फल होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Bhadras born of Virabhadra's body hit and split the haughty gods including the guardians oi the quarters by means of discus, thunderbolts, spears, S iktis, nooses, iron clubs, iron rods, swords, axes, Bhindipalas and huge battle-axes
verses.science: जाता है, वह सदा निष्फल होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवासुरान् पितृन् मनुष्यांश्च चतुष्टयम् । सह रुद्रेण सिसृक्षुरम्भस्येतानि वै विधिः
verses.transliteration: atha devāsurān pitṛn manuṣyāṃśca catuṣṭayam | saha rudreṇa sisṛkṣurambhasyetāni vai vidhiḥ
verses.translation: "Chop olf and split" "Hurl quickly" "Let him be killed" "Take away and strike" "Peel and tear off" such ruthless words full of excitement, usual in wars and jarring to the ears arose from the lords of Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Chop olf and split" "Hurl quickly" "Let him be killed" "Take away and strike" "Peel and tear off" such ruthless words full of excitement, usual in wars and jarring to the ears arose from the lords of Ganas.
verses.science: और तदुपरान्त आज्ञा प्रदान करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स सृष्ट्यर्थं समाधाय ब्रह्मात्मानमयूयुजत् । मुखादजनयद्देवान् पितॄंश्चैवोपपक्षतः
verses.transliteration: sa sṛṣṭyarthaṃ samādhāya brahmātmānamayūyujat | mukhādajanayaddevān pitṝṃścaivopapakṣataḥ
verses.translation: Some rolled their eyes, gnashed their fanglike teeth and bit their lips and palates. They pulled out the sages in the hermitages and killed them. They took away.sacrificial ladles and spoons and hurled them into fire and water. They broke domes, gemset platforms. They sang, shouted and laughed again and again drinking blood-like wine. The leading Ganas danced.
verses.wordMeaning: Some rolled their eyes, gnashed their fanglike teeth and bit their lips and palates. They pulled out the sages in the hermitages and killed them. They took away.sacrificial ladles and spoons and hurled them into fire and water. They broke domes, gemset platforms. They sang,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some rolled their eyes, gnashed their fanglike teeth and bit their lips and palates. They pulled out the sages in the hermitages and killed them. They took away.sacrificial ladles and spoons and hurled them into fire and water. They broke domes, gemset platforms. They sang,…
verses.science: परम गतिको प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जघनादसुरान् सर्वान् प्रजनादपि मानुषान् । अवस्करे क्षुधाविष्टा राक्षसास्तस्य जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: jaghanādasurān sarvān prajanādapi mānuṣān | avaskare kṣudhāviṣṭā rākṣasāstasya jajñire
verses.translation: Pounding up the gods including Indra, the leading Ganas, strong like lordly bulls, elephants and lions, of unriva¬ lled glory, perpetrated hair-raising deeds of destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pounding up the gods including Indra, the leading Ganas, strong like lordly bulls, elephants and lions, of unriva¬ lled glory, perpetrated hair-raising deeds of destruction.
verses.science: है--ऐसा आगमार्थविशारद विद्वानोंका कथन है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रास्तमोरजःप्राया बलिनस्ते निशाचराः । सर्पा यक्षास्तथा भूता गन्धर्वाः सम्प्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: putrāstamorajaḥprāyā balinaste niśācarāḥ | sarpā yakṣāstathā bhūtā gandharvāḥ samprajajñire
verses.translation: The three cities or castles of the Asuras T&raka, VidyunmSli and Maya were received as gifts from Brahma pleased by their prnance. These were destroyed with a single shaft by Siva who was annoyed at their savage activities. I rof Agrawal considers the burnings of Tripur as as historical event.
verses.wordMeaning: The three cities or castles of the Asuras T&raka, VidyunmSli and Maya were received as gifts from Brahma pleased by their prnance. These were destroyed with a single shaft by Siva who was annoyed at their savage activities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three cities or castles of the Asuras T&raka, VidyunmSli and Maya were received as gifts from Brahma pleased by their prnance. These were destroyed with a single shaft by Siva who was annoyed at their savage activities.…
verses.science: कहलाता है--ऐसा क्रमश: समझना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वयांसि पक्षतः सृष्टाः पक्षिणो वक्षसोऽसृजत् । मुखतोऽजांस्तथा पार्श्वादुरगांश्च विनिर्ममे
verses.transliteration: vayāṃsi pakṣataḥ sṛṣṭāḥ pakṣiṇo vakṣaso'sṛjat | mukhato'jāṃstathā pārśvāduragāṃśca vinirmame
verses.translation: The Pramathas rejoiced, struck, ran, prattled, danced, laughed and jumped about.
verses.hindi: करता है, उसका यह जप 'वाचिक ' कहलाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pramathas rejoiced, struck, ran, prattled, danced, laughed and jumped about.
verses.science: करता है, उसका यह जप 'वाचिक ' कहलाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्भ्यां चाश्वान्समातङ्गान् शरभान् गवयान् मृगान् । उष्ट्रानश्वतरांश्चैव न्यङ्कूनन्याश्च जातयः
verses.transliteration: padbhyāṃ cāśvānsamātaṅgān śarabhān gavayān mṛgān | uṣṭrānaśvatarāṃścaiva nyaṅkūnanyāśca jātayaḥ
verses.translation: Some of them evinced a desire to seize the watery clouds, some jumped up to seize the sun; others wished to blow along with the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them evinced a desire to seize the watery clouds, some jumped up to seize the sun; others wished to blow along with the wind.
verses.science: देता, ऐसे जपको “उपांशु” कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: औषध्यः फलमूलानि रोमभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे । गायत्रीं च ऋचं चैव त्रिवृत्साम रथन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: auṣadhyaḥ phalamūlāni romabhyastasya jajñire | gāyatrīṃ ca ṛcaṃ caiva trivṛtsāma rathantaram
verses.translation: Some wielded weapons and rushed through the sky like peaks of mountains; tossed the gods like the Garua toss* ing huge pythons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some wielded weapons and rushed through the sky like peaks of mountains; tossed the gods like the Garua toss* ing huge pythons.
verses.science: मानस” जप कहलाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात् । यजूंषि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दः स्तोमं पञ्चदशं तथा
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomaṃ ca yajñānāṃ nirmame prathamānmukhāt | yajūṃṣi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ stomaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The doors, door-frames and walls of the sacrifi¬ cial mansion were upset; the windows, ceiling frames, the halls were destroyed utterly. The complete edifice of sacrifice crumbled helplessly like a statement without foundation.
verses.hindi: उससे सौगुना अधिक फल देनेवाला है
verses.commentary: Sense: The doors, door-frames and walls of the sacrifi¬ cial mansion were upset; the windows, ceiling frames, the halls were destroyed utterly. The complete edifice of sacrifice crumbled helplessly like a statement without foundation.
verses.science: उससे सौगुना अधिक फल देनेवाला है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्साम तथोक्थं च दक्षिणादसृजन्मुखात् । सामानि जगतीछन्दः स्तोमं सप्तदशं तथा
verses.transliteration: bṛhatsāma tathokthaṃ ca dakṣiṇādasṛjanmukhāt | sāmāni jagatīchandaḥ stomaṃ saptadaśaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The chiefs of gods headed by V:?nu and Indra were terribly afraid. They fled in excessive fright.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chiefs of gods headed by V:?nu and Indra were terribly afraid. They fled in excessive fright.
verses.science: श्रेष्ठ माना गया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैरूप्यमतिरात्रं च पश्चिमादसृजन् मुखात् । एकविंशमथर्वाणमाप्तोर्यामाणमेव च
verses.transliteration: vairūpyamatirātraṃ ca paścimādasṛjan mukhāt | ekaviṃśamatharvāṇamāptoryāmāṇameva ca
verses.translation: Seeing that the gods had fled uninjured and think¬ ing that those who deserved to be punished remained unpu¬ nished the leading Gana became angry.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that the gods had fled uninjured and think¬ ing that those who deserved to be punished remained unpu¬ nished the leading Gana became angry.
verses.science: 'फलदायक होती है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुष्टुभं स वैराजमुत्तरादसृजन्मुखात् । उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: anuṣṭubhaṃ sa vairājamuttarādasṛjanmukhāt | uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire
verses.translation: He took up the all-destroying trident and looked up. He vomittcd flames from his mouth, chased the gods as the lion chases the elephants. His gait as he pursued them resembled that of an elephant in its rut.
verses.commentary: Sense: He took up the all-destroying trident and looked up. He vomittcd flames from his mouth, chased the gods as the lion chases the elephants. His gait as he pursued them resembled that of an elephant in its rut.
verses.science: विश्वासको आस्तिकता कहते हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाः पिशाचा गन्धर्वास्तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः । नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयःपशुमृगोरगाः
verses.transliteration: yakṣāḥ piśācā gandharvāstathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥpaśumṛgoragāḥ
verses.translation: Then he agitated the army of the gods as the lord of elephants in rut stirs up a lake, shedding different hues blue, grey and red. He wore a tiger's skin as his cloth which was inlaid with excellent gold and pearls. Cutting, piercing.
verses.hindi: अथवा पशुतुल्य प्राणीको इसे नहीं बताना
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he agitated the army of the gods as the lord of elephants in rut stirs up a lake, shedding different hues blue, grey and red. He wore a tiger's skin as his cloth which was inlaid with excellent gold and pearls. Cutting, piercing.
verses.science: अथवा पशुतुल्य प्राणीको इसे नहीं बताना। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अव्ययं चैव यदिदं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् । तेषां वै यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्टानि प्रपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: avyayaṃ caiva yadidaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | teṣāṃ vai yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭāni prapedire
verses.translation: As he walked about speedily armed with a spear all alone, the gods thought him to be numbering a thousand. The infuriated Bhadrakali excited by the fight pierced through the gods in the war holding spears shedding flames.
verses.hindi: उनके लिये भी यह मन्त्र निष्फल नहीं होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: As he walked about speedily armed with a spear all alone, the gods thought him to be numbering a thousand. The infuriated Bhadrakali excited by the fight pierced through the gods in the war holding spears shedding flames.
verses.science: उनके लिये भी यह मन्त्र निष्फल नहीं होता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तान्येव ते प्रपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः । हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदु क्रूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते
verses.transliteration: tānyeva te prapadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdu krūre dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte
verses.translation: Bhadra born of Rudra's anger shone in her company as the fire at the time of dissolution with a lustre pale and smoky due to smoke. Pursuing the gods in the course of war, Bhadrakali shone as the flame of fire at the end of the Kalpa that burns the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadra born of Rudra's anger shone in her company as the fire at the time of dissolution with a lustre pale and smoky due to smoke. Pursuing the gods in the course of war, Bhadrakali shone as the flame of fire at the end of the Kalpa that burns the universe.
verses.science: है, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते । महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्थेषु मुक्तिषु
verses.transliteration: tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāttattasya rocate | mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu muktiṣu
verses.translation: Bhadra the leader of Rudragaas angrily kicked the sun and his horse on the head sportively with his left leg. The heroic Ganesvara, Bhadra with self-control hit Pavaka with his swords, Yama with iron-clubs, Rudras with his spear and Varuna with iron clubs.
