Holding the axe he hit Vayu with it and Nirti with big clubs. The war was a sportive game for him. He attacked the gods and the sages antagonistic to 8iva.
verses.hindi: है ऑशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीय्संहितायामुत्तरखण्ड परमगतिको प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadra the leader of Rudragaas angrily kicked the sun and his horse on the head sportively with his left leg. The heroic Ganesvara, Bhadra with self-control hit Pavaka with his swords, Yama with iron-clubs, Rudras with his spear and Varuna with iron clubs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadra the leader of Rudragaas angrily kicked the sun and his horse on the head sportively with his left leg. The heroic Ganesvara, Bhadra with self-control hit Pavaka with his swords, Yama with iron-clubs, Rudras with his spear and Varuna with iron clubs.…
verses.science: है ऑशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीय्संहितायामुत्तरखण्ड परमगतिको प्राप्त होता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विनियोगं च भूतानां धातैव व्यदधत्स्वयम् । नामरूपं च भूतानां प्राकृतानां प्रपञ्चनम्
verses.transliteration: viniyogaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhātaiva vyadadhatsvayam | nāmarūpaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ prākṛtānāṃ prapañcanam
verses.translation: Then the lord cut off the tip of the nose of Sarasvati as well as of the mother of the gods with the tip of his nail.
verses.hindi: रे ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके उत्तरखण्डे पंचाक्षमहिमवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्दशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord cut off the tip of the nose of Sarasvati as well as of the mother of the gods with the tip of his nail.
verses.science: रे ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके उत्तरखण्डे पंचाक्षमहिमवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्दशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदशब्देभ्य एवादौ निर्ममेऽसौ पितामहः । आर्षाणि चैव नामानि याश्च वेदेषु वृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: vedaśabdebhya evādau nirmame'sau pitāmahaḥ | ārṣāṇi caiva nāmāni yāśca vedeṣu vṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: The lord nipped off the right nostril and the nipple of the left breast of Svaha with his nail-end.
verses.hindi: महिमवर्णन न नामक चोदवहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord nipped off the right nostril and the nipple of the left breast of Svaha with his nail-end.
verses.science: महिमवर्णन न नामक चोदवहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्वर्य्यन्ते प्रसूतानां तान्येवैभ्यो ददावजः । यथर्तावृतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्य्यये
verses.transliteration: śarvaryyante prasūtānāṃ tānyevaibhyo dadāvajaḥ | yathartāvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryyaye
verses.translation: The impetuous Bhadra uprooted the eyes of Bhaga large and lustrous like the lotus.
verses.hindi: मन्रसंग्रहणे किज्चित्सूचितं न तु विस्तृतम्॥ २  उसका विस्तृत वर्णन नहीं किया था
verses.commentary: Sense: The impetuous Bhadra uprooted the eyes of Bhaga large and lustrous like the lotus.
verses.science: मन्रसंग्रहणे किज्चित्सूचितं न तु विस्तृतम्॥ २ उसका विस्तृत वर्णन नहीं किया था। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु । इत्येष करणोद्भूतो लोकसर्गः स्वयम्भुवः
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu | ityeṣa karaṇodbhūto lokasargaḥ svayambhuvaḥ
verses.translation: Then the lord stamped the moon with his toe, as though he was only a worm and ground *him on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord stamped the moon with his toe, as though he was only a worm and ground *him on the ground.
verses.science: उसका नाम संस्कार है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: महदाद्यो विशेषान्तो विकारः प्रकृतेः स्वयम् । चन्द्रसूर्यप्रभाजुष्टो ग्रहनक्षत्रमण्डितः
verses.transliteration: mahadādyo viśeṣānto vikāraḥ prakṛteḥ svayam | candrasūryaprabhājuṣṭo grahanakṣatramaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: The infuriated Bhadra cut off the head of Daka and handed it over to Bhadrakali even as Virini, wife of Daksa was lamenting.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्संस्कार एवायं दीक्षेत्यपि च कथ्यते॥ ५  है।इसलिये इस संस्कारको ही दीक्षा भी कहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated Bhadra cut off the head of Daka and handed it over to Bhadrakali even as Virini, wife of Daksa was lamenting.
verses.science: तस्मात्संस्कार एवायं दीक्षेत्यपि च कथ्यते॥ ५ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नदीभिश्च समुद्रैश्च पर्वतैश्च स मण्डितः । परैश्च विविधै रम्यैः स्फीतैर्जनपदैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nadībhiśca samudraiśca parvataiśca sa maṇḍitaḥ | paraiśca vividhai ramyaiḥ sphītairjanapadaistathā
verses.translation: Taking up the head resembling the fruit of a
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking up the head resembling the fruit of a
verses.science: विषयमें निवेदन किया जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् ब्रह्मवनेऽव्यक्तो ब्रह्मा चरति सर्ववित् । अव्यक्तबीजप्रभव ईश्वरानुग्रहे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasmin brahmavane'vyakto brahmā carati sarvavit | avyaktabījaprabhava īśvarānugrahe sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Catching hold of by the neck, Aristanemi, Soma, Dharma, Prajapati Angiras, father of many sons, Krsasva and KaSyapa, the powerful chiefs of Ganas of leonine exploits rebuked and hit them on the heads with fists.
verses.hindi: जा बाय ग शिय्य तिशोनवत। १४  + याके द्वारा शिष्यका शोधन करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Catching hold of by the neck, Aristanemi, Soma, Dharma, Prajapati Angiras, father of many sons, Krsasva and KaSyapa, the powerful chiefs of Ganas of leonine exploits rebuked and hit them on the heads with fists.
verses.science: जा बाय ग शिय्य तिशोनवत। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिस्कन्धमहाशाख इन्द्रियान्तरकोटरः । महाभूतप्रमाणश्च विशेषामलपल्लवः
verses.transliteration: buddhiskandhamahāśākha indriyāntarakoṭaraḥ | mahābhūtapramāṇaśca viśeṣāmalapallavaḥ
verses.translation: Just as in Kaliyuga women of noble families are molested and defiled by paramours forcibly so also the women and the daughters-in-law were molested by Bhutas and Vetalas.
verses.hindi: करे, जो गुरुके गौरवके अनुरूप हो
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as in Kaliyuga women of noble families are molested and defiled by paramours forcibly so also the women and the daughters-in-law were molested by Bhutas and Vetalas.
verses.science: करे, जो गुरुके गौरवके अनुरूप हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मसुपुष्पाढ्यः सुखदुःखफलोदयः । आजीव्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मवृक्षः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmasupuṣpāḍhyaḥ sukhaduḥkhaphalodayaḥ | ājīvyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmavṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the sacrificial spot appeared like a deso¬ late forest. The domes were smashed. The posts were broken. The festivities ended. The hall was burnt. The portals and festoons had crumbled. The army of the gods was uprooted. The sages were killed. The Vedic chant had subsided. The population had dwindled. The distressed women shrieked. The appendages were spoiled.
verses.hindi: गुरुके पूजनसे ही अर क. सगान फल मिलता है॥ २०२१ फल मिलता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sacrificial spot appeared like a deso¬ late forest. The domes were smashed. The posts were broken. The festivities ended. The hall was burnt. The portals and festoons had crumbled. The army of the gods was uprooted. The sages were killed. The Vedic chant had subsided.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sacrificial spot appeared like a deso¬ late forest. The domes were smashed. The posts were broken. The festivities ended. The hall was burnt. The portals and festoons had crumbled. The army of the gods was uprooted. The sages were killed. The Vedic chant had subsided.…
verses.science: गुरुके पूजनसे ही अर क. सगान फल मिलता है॥ २०२१ फल मिलता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्यां मूर्द्धानं तस्य विप्रा वदन्ति खं वै नाभिं चन्द्रसूर्यौ च नेत्रे । दिशः श्रोत्रे चरणौ च क्षितिं च सोऽचिन्त्यात्मा सर्वभूतप्रणेता
verses.transliteration: dyāṃ mūrddhānaṃ tasya viprā vadanti khaṃ vai nābhiṃ candrasūryau ca netre | diśaḥ śrotre caraṇau ca kṣitiṃ ca so'cintyātmā sarvabhūtapraṇetā
verses.translation: When thousands of gods were killed and their bodies lay sprawled on the ground, the chief of Ganas entered the place of sacrificial fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: When thousands of gods were killed and their bodies lay sprawled on the ground, the chief of Ganas entered the place of sacrificial fires.
verses.science: सम्पदा प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वक्त्रात्तस्य ब्राह्मणाः सम्प्रसूताः तद्वक्षसः क्षत्रियाः पूर्वभागात् । वैश्या उरुभ्यां तस्य पद्भ्यां च शूद्राः सर्वे वर्णा गात्रतः सम्प्रसूताः
verses.transliteration: vaktrāttasya brāhmaṇāḥ samprasūtāḥ tadvakṣasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ pūrvabhāgāt | vaiśyā urubhyāṃ tasya padbhyāṃ ca śūdrāḥ sarve varṇā gātrataḥ samprasūtāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that Bhadra resembling the deadly fire had come the sacrifice was afraid of death and fled assuming the form of a deer.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Bhadra resembling the deadly fire had come the sacrifice was afraid of death and fled assuming the form of a deer.
verses.science: घर देवमन्दिर है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the sacrifice thus insulted, Visu was infuriated and got ready for a fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the sacrifice thus insulted, Visu was infuriated and got ready for a fight.
verses.science: प्रेरकोंका अपमान न करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the sacrifice thus insulted, Visu was infuriated and got ready for a fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the sacrifice thus insulted, Visu was infuriated and got ready for a fight.
verses.science: उन्हें प्रसन्‍न करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । ब्रह्मविष्णुसृष्टिकथनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । भवता कथिता सृष्टिर्भवस्य परमात्मनः । चतुर्मुखमुखात्तस्य संशयो नः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.13. trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | brahmaviṣṇusṛṣṭikathanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | bhavatā kathitā sṛṣṭirbhavasya paramātmanaḥ | caturmukhamukhāttasya saṃśayo naḥ prajāyate
verses.translation: At that time a chariot resembling a thousand suns and with the emblem of a bull on the banner cloth appeared in the sky.
verses.hindi: दो वर्ष और वैश्यकी तीन वर्षतक परीक्षा करे
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time a chariot resembling a thousand suns and with the emblem of a bull on the banner cloth appeared in the sky.
verses.science: दो वर्ष और वैश्यकी तीन वर्षतक परीक्षा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देवश्रेष्ठो विरूपाक्षो दीप्तः शूलधरो हरः । कालात्मा भगवान् रुद्रः कपर्दी नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: devaśreṣṭho virūpākṣo dīptaḥ śūladharo haraḥ | kālātmā bhagavān rudraḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Visnu coming and discharging arrows Bhadra took up his bow and showered thousands of arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Visnu coming and discharging arrows Bhadra took up his bow and showered thousands of arrows.
verses.science: गिरकर साष्टांग प्रणाम करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सब्रह्मकमिमं लोकं सविष्णुमपि पावकम् । यः संहरति सङ्क्रुद्धो युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: sabrahmakamimaṃ lokaṃ saviṣṇumapi pāvakam | yaḥ saṃharati saṅkruddho yugānte samupasthite
verses.translation: On seeing their mutual noisy battle the sounds of •Ha-Ha* raised by the aerial wanderers rose in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing their mutual noisy battle the sounds of •Ha-Ha* raised by the aerial wanderers rose in the sky.
verses.science: शिवमन्त्रका उच्चारण करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च प्रणामं कुरुतो भयात् । लोकसङ्कोचकस्यास्य यस्य तौ वशवर्तिनौ
verses.transliteration: yasya brahmā ca viṣṇuśca praṇāmaṃ kuruto bhayāt | lokasaṅkocakasyāsya yasya tau vaśavartinau
verses.translation: The hands of others too became fixed, as the activities of idle men at the start remain unprogressive.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hands of others too became fixed, as the activities of idle men at the start remain unprogressive.
verses.science: मण्डलमें पुन: शिवका पूजन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: योऽयं देवः स्वकादङ्गाद् ब्रह्मविष्णू पुरासृजत् । स एव हि तयोर्नित्यं योगक्षेमकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: yo'yaṃ devaḥ svakādaṅgād brahmaviṣṇū purāsṛjat | sa eva hi tayornityaṃ yogakṣemakaraḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: With the gods with their limbs cut off, the hero shone like Bhairava who had seized people and like Siva who had burnt the three cities.
verses.hindi: विधानवर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: With the gods with their limbs cut off, the hero shone like Bhairava who had seized people and like Siva who had burnt the three cities.
verses.science: विधानवर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स कथं भगवान् रुद्र आदिदेवः पुरातनः । पुत्रत्वमगमच्छम्भुर्ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa kathaṃ bhagavān rudra ādidevaḥ purātanaḥ | putratvamagamacchambhurbrahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Then a terrible stream of flood from the bodies of the warriors began to flow striking terror in the living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a terrible stream of flood from the bodies of the warriors began to flow striking terror in the living beings.
verses.science: शिवमण्डलके समीप जाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिश्च विष्णुश्च रुद्रस्यैतौ परस्परम् । सृष्टौ परस्परस्याङ्गादिति प्रागपि शुश्रुम
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiśca viṣṇuśca rudrasyaitau parasparam | sṛṣṭau parasparasyāṅgāditi prāgapi śuśruma
verses.translation: The ground of the sacrificial rites drenched with the blood shone like the goddess Kausiki who had killed Sumbha with her garments wet with the blood.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground of the sacrificial rites drenched with the blood shone like the goddess Kausiki who had killed Sumbha with her garments wet with the blood.
verses.science: उसे मण्डलका दर्शन कराये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कथं पुनरशेषाणां भूतानां हेतुभूतयोः । गुणप्रधानभावेन प्रादुर्भावः परस्परात्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ punaraśeṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ hetubhūtayoḥ | guṇapradhānabhāvena prādurbhāvaḥ parasparāt
verses.translation: The quarters looked gloomy. Inauspicious wind blew. Ah, the adverse working of the fate. This is a horse- sacrificc. The sacrificer is Daksa himself. Dharma and others are the councillors. The Garuda-bannered deity is the patron. Indra and other gods take their shares directly. Still the sacri¬ ficer, the sacrifice and the priests are beheaded immediately.
verses.hindi: पूजयेद्देवमीशानं॑ जुहुयाच्च शिवानले॥ ४ पूजा कराये और शिवाग्निमें हवन करे
verses.wordMeaning: The quarters looked gloomy. Inauspicious wind blew. Ah, the adverse working of the fate. This is a horse- sacrificc. The sacrificer is Daksa himself. Dharma and others are the councillors. The Garuda-bannered deity is the patron. Indra and other gods take their shares directly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The quarters looked gloomy. Inauspicious wind blew. Ah, the adverse working of the fate. This is a horse- sacrificc. The sacrificer is Daksa himself. Dharma and others are the councillors. The Garuda-bannered deity is the patron. Indra and other gods take their shares directly.…
verses.science: पूजयेद्देवमीशानं॑ जुहुयाच्च शिवानले॥ ४ पूजा कराये और शिवाग्निमें हवन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नापृष्टं भवता किञ्चिन्नाश्रुतं च कथञ्चन । भगवच्छिष्यभूतेन भवता सकलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: nāpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā kiñcinnāśrutaṃ ca kathañcana | bhagavacchiṣyabhūtena bhavatā sakalaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Hence no such action shall be performed that i.s not indicated in the Vedas, and that which excludes Siva and is taken up by the wicked.
verses.hindi: ही साथ सम्पूर्ण योनियोंमें संयुक्त करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence no such action shall be performed that i.s not indicated in the Vedas, and that which excludes Siva and is taken up by the wicked.
verses.science: ही साथ सम्पूर्ण योनियोंमें संयुक्त करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वं वद यथा ब्रह्मा मुनीनामवदद्विभुः । वयं श्रद्धालवस्तात श्रोतुमीश्वरसद्यशः
verses.transliteration: tattvaṃ vada yathā brahmā munīnāmavadadvibhuḥ | vayaṃ śraddhālavastāta śrotumīśvarasadyaśaḥ
verses.translation: The splendid chariot had two horses and four wheels. Several divine weapons and missiles had been kept ready therein. It was embellished with jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The splendid chariot had two horses and four wheels. Several divine weapons and missiles had been kept ready therein. It was embellished with jewels.
verses.science: सहनशीलताकी परीक्षा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । स्थाने पृष्टमिदं विप्रा भवद्भिः प्रश्नकोविदैः । इदमेव पुरा पृष्टो मम प्राह पितामहः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | sthāne pṛṣṭamidaṃ viprā bhavadbhiḥ praśnakovidaiḥ | idameva purā pṛṣṭo mama prāha pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: At the bidding of Siva, Brahma brought the ex¬ cellent chariot to Virabhadra and spoke with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the bidding of Siva, Brahma brought the ex¬ cellent chariot to Virabhadra and spoke with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: उक्त संस्कारकी अधिकारिणी होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा रुद्रसमुद्भवः । यथा च पुनरुत्पत्तिर्ब्रह्मविष्ण्वोः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi yathā rudrasamudbhavaḥ | yathā ca punarutpattirbrahmaviṣṇvoḥ parasparam
verses.translation: "O lord Virabhadra the eternal moon-crested lord commands you to mount the chariot.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे दीक्षाविधाने गुरुमाहत्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्चदशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord Virabhadra the eternal moon-crested lord commands you to mount the chariot.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे दीक्षाविधाने गुरुमाहत्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्चदशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयस्ते कारणात्मानो जाताः साक्षान्महेश्वरात् । चराचरस्य विश्वस्य सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवः
verses.transliteration: trayaste kāraṇātmāno jātāḥ sākṣānmaheśvarāt | carācarasya viśvasya sargasthityantahetavaḥ
verses.translation: O great-armed one, Siva, stationed near the hermitage of R'libhya along with Siva, is witnessing your unbearable exploit.
verses.hindi: गुरुमाहात्म्यवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O great-armed one, Siva, stationed near the hermitage of R'libhya along with Siva, is witnessing your unbearable exploit.
verses.science: गुरुमाहात्म्यवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: परमैश्वर्यसंयुक्ताः परमेश्वरभाविताः । तच्छक्त्याधिष्ठिता नित्यं तत्कार्यकरणक्षमाः
verses.transliteration: paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktāḥ parameśvarabhāvitāḥ | tacchaktyādhiṣṭhitā nityaṃ tatkāryakaraṇakṣamāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words and blessing BrahmS, the heroic leading Gana mounted the divine chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words and blessing BrahmS, the heroic leading Gana mounted the divine chariot.
verses.science: शिष्यका 'समय' नामक संस्कार करे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा नियमिताः पूर्वं त्रयोऽपि त्रिषु कर्मसु । ब्रह्मा सर्गे हरिस्त्राणे रुद्रः संहरणे तथा
verses.transliteration: pitrā niyamitāḥ pūrvaṃ trayo'pi triṣu karmasu | brahmā sarge haristrāṇe rudraḥ saṃharaṇe tathā
verses.translation: In the excellent chariot where Brahmi sat as the charioteer the splendour of Bhadra increased like that of Rudra, the enemy of the Tripuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the excellent chariot where Brahmi sat as the charioteer the splendour of Bhadra increased like that of Rudra, the enemy of the Tripuras.
verses.science: मण्डपका निर्माण करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथाप्यन्योऽन्यमात्सर्यादन्योऽन्यातिशयाशिनः । तपसा तोषयित्वा स्वं पितरं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpyanyo'nyamātsaryādanyo'nyātiśayāśinaḥ | tapasā toṣayitvā svaṃ pitaraṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: Then keeping an excellent conch shining like the
verses.commentary: Sense: Then keeping an excellent conch shining like the
verses.science: अंगुलकी होनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा सर्वात्मना तस्य प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः । ब्रह्मनारायणौ पूर्वं रुद्रः कल्पान्तरेऽसृजत्
verses.transliteration: labdhvā sarvātmanā tasya prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ | brahmanārāyaṇau pūrvaṃ rudraḥ kalpāntare'sṛjat
verses.translation: At the sound of the conch resembling that of the swan, the fire in the belly of the gods blazed with fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the sound of the conch resembling that of the swan, the fire in the belly of the gods blazed with fear.
verses.science: शोभाजनक सामग्रियोंसे सुशोभित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्तरे पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रविष्णू जगन्मयः । विष्णुश्च भगवान् रुद्रं ब्रह्माणमसृजत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: kalpāntare punarbrahmā rudraviṣṇū jaganmayaḥ | viṣṇuśca bhagavān rudraṃ brahmāṇamasṛjatpunaḥ
verses.translation: In an instant the quarters including open spaces and crevices were filled up and thronged with leading Yaksas Vidyadharas, serpents and Siddhas who desired to witness the battle.
verses.hindi: शुभ लक्षणसे युक्त शिवकलशकी स्थापना करे
verses.commentary: Sense: In an instant the quarters including open spaces and crevices were filled up and thronged with leading Yaksas Vidyadharas, serpents and Siddhas who desired to witness the battle.
verses.science: शुभ लक्षणसे युक्त शिवकलशकी स्थापना करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं पुनर्ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं च पुनर्भवः । एवं कल्पेषु कल्पेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ punarbrahmā brahmāṇaṃ ca punarbhavaḥ | evaṃ kalpeṣu kalpeṣu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Then Narayana as the cloud inflicted pain on the Ganas as the cattle, through a geat shower of arrows from his bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Narayana as the cloud inflicted pain on the Ganas as the cattle, through a geat shower of arrows from his bow.
verses.science: ऊपरसे ढक दिया जाय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परस्परेण जायन्ते परस्परहितैषिणः । तत्तत्कल्पान्तवृत्तान्तमधिकृत्य महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: paraspareṇa jāyante parasparahitaiṣiṇaḥ | tattatkalpāntavṛttāntamadhikṛtya maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: He took up the divine bow and slowly drew it like Siva who drew the bow Meru.
verses.hindi: ताड़न करनेके पश्चात् नेत्र-बन्धन खोल दे
verses.commentary: Sense: He took up the divine bow and slowly drew it like Siva who drew the bow Meru.
verses.science: ताड़न करनेके पश्चात् नेत्र-बन्धन खोल दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावः कथ्यते तेषां परस्परसमुद्भवात् । शृणु तेषां कथां चित्रां पुण्यां पापप्रमोचिनीम्
verses.transliteration: prabhāvaḥ kathyate teṣāṃ parasparasamudbhavāt | śṛṇu teṣāṃ kathāṃ citrāṃ puṇyāṃ pāpapramocinīm
verses.translation: Then the chief of Ganas, of fierce valour and glory took an excellent arrow blazing like a serpent.
verses.hindi: उसके मस्तकपर शिवका वरद हाथ रखे
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the chief of Ganas, of fierce valour and glory took an excellent arrow blazing like a serpent.
verses.science: उसके मस्तकपर शिवका वरद हाथ रखे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे तत्पुरुषे वृत्तां ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । पुरा नारायणो नाम कल्पे वै मेघवाहने
verses.transliteration: kalpe tatpuruṣe vṛttāṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | purā nārāyaṇo nāma kalpe vai meghavāhane
verses.translation: His hand in contact with the opening of the quiver for taking up the arrows appeared like a serpent wishing to enter an anthill.
verses.commentary: Sense: His hand in contact with the opening of the quiver for taking up the arrows appeared like a serpent wishing to enter an anthill.
verses.science: साष्टांग प्रणाम करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु मेघो भूत्वावहद्धराम् । तस्य भावं समालक्ष्य विष्णोर्विश्वजगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu megho bhūtvāvahaddharām | tasya bhāvaṃ samālakṣya viṣṇorviśvajagadguruḥ
verses.translation: The arrow lifted and held in the hand shone like the young one of a serpent held within the mouth of a great serpent.
verses.hindi: साथ ही मन्त्रोंका तर्पण भी करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The arrow lifted and held in the hand shone like the young one of a serpent held within the mouth of a great serpent.
verses.science: साथ ही मन्त्रोंका तर्पण भी करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वः सर्वात्मभावेन प्रददौ शक्तिमव्ययाम् । शक्तिं लब्ध्वा तु सर्वात्मा शिवात्सर्वेश्वरात्तदा
verses.transliteration: sarvaḥ sarvātmabhāvena pradadau śaktimavyayām | śaktiṃ labdhvā tu sarvātmā śivātsarveśvarāttadā
verses.translation: With his stout and sharp arrow, the infuriated Bhadra who resembled Rudra, hit the unchanging Visnu on his forehead.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his stout and sharp arrow, the infuriated Bhadra who resembled Rudra, hit the unchanging Visnu on his forehead.
verses.science: चुन: दस आहुतियाँ अग्निमें डाले। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज भगावन् विष्णुर्विश्वं विश्वसृजा सह । विष्णोस्तद्वैभवं दृष्ट्वा सृष्टस्तेन पितामहः
verses.transliteration: sasarja bhagāvan viṣṇurviśvaṃ viśvasṛjā saha | viṣṇostadvaibhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭastena pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Vinu thus insulted and hit on the forehead became angry with the chief of Ganas like a cow or bull becoming angry with the lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinu thus insulted and hit on the forehead became angry with the chief of Ganas like a cow or bull becoming angry with the lion.
verses.science: उसमें ब्राह्मणत्वकी उद्धावना करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईर्ष्यया परया ग्रस्तः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत् । गच्छ विष्णो मया ज्ञातं तव सर्गस्य कारणम् । आवयोरधिकश्चास्ति स रुद्रो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: īrṣyayā parayā grastaḥ prahasannidamabravīt | gaccha viṣṇo mayā jñātaṃ tava sargasya kāraṇam | āvayoradhikaścāsti sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Then he hit the serpent like arm of the chief of Gapas, with a cruel, pointed great arrow resembling the thunderbolt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he hit the serpent like arm of the chief of Gapas, with a cruel, pointed great arrow resembling the thunderbolt.
verses.science: आत्मामें स्थित होनेकी भावना करे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः । स्रष्टा त्वं भगवानाद्यः पालकः परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: tasya devādhidevasya prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ | sraṣṭā tvaṃ bhagavānādyaḥ pālakaḥ paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: The powerful Virabhadra too, with a great velo¬ city discharged an arrow brilliant like ten thousand suns again at his arm.
verses.hindi: यह पूर्णतः प्रकाशित हो रहा है
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful Virabhadra too, with a great velo¬ city discharged an arrow brilliant like ten thousand suns again at his arm.
verses.science: यह पूर्णतः प्रकाशित हो रहा है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहं च तपसाराध्य रुद्रं त्रिदशनायकम् । त्वया सह जगत्सर्वं स्रक्ष्याम्यत्र न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ ca tapasārādhya rudraṃ tridaśanāyakam | tvayā saha jagatsarvaṃ srakṣyāmyatra na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu hit Bhadra. Bhadra hit Visnu. O brahmins both of them hit each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu hit Bhadra. Bhadra hit Visnu. O brahmins both of them hit each other.
verses.science: आहुति दे पूर्णाहुति होम करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विष्णुमुपालभ्य भगवानब्जसम्भवः । एवं विज्ञापयामास तपसा प्राप्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ viṣṇumupālabhya bhagavānabjasambhavaḥ | evaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa tapasā prāpya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: The tumultuous hair-raising fight between the two discharging the arrows on each other in quick success¬ ion then ensued.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tumultuous hair-raising fight between the two discharging the arrows on each other in quick success¬ ion then ensued.
verses.science: मानसिक पूजा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् देवदेवेश विश्वेश्वर महेश्वर । तव वामाङ्गजो विष्णुर्दक्षिणाङ्गभवो ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavan devadeveśa viśveśvara maheśvara | tava vāmāṅgajo viṣṇurdakṣiṇāṅgabhavo hyaham
verses.translation: Then Bhadra hit in the broad chest of Vijjriu with an arrow that shone like the sun and the tip of which blazed like fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Bhadra hit in the broad chest of Vijjriu with an arrow that shone like the sun and the tip of which blazed like fire.
verses.science: ध्यानके साधन भी दे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मया सह जगत्सर्वं तथाप्यसृजदच्युतः । स मत्सरादुपालब्धस्त्वदाश्रयबलान्मया
verses.transliteration: mayā saha jagatsarvaṃ tathāpyasṛjadacyutaḥ | sa matsarādupālabdhastvadāśrayabalānmayā
verses.translation: Acutely hit by the arrow that fell sharply, Vi?ju suffered great pain and fell into swoon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Acutely hit by the arrow that fell sharply, Vi?ju suffered great pain and fell into swoon.
verses.science: शिष्य शिरोधार्य करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मद्भावान्नाधिकस्तेऽतिभावस्त्वयि महेश्वरे । त्वत्त एव समुत्पत्तिरावयोः सदृशी यतः
verses.transliteration: madbhāvānnādhikaste'tibhāvastvayi maheśvare | tvatta eva samutpattirāvayoḥ sadṛśī yataḥ
verses.translation: He regained consciousness instantaneously and got up. He discharged his weapons against Bhadra.
verses.hindi: शिष्य-संस्कारवर्णन नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: He regained consciousness instantaneously and got up. He discharged his weapons against Bhadra.
verses.science: शिष्य-संस्कारवर्णन नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भक्त्या यथापूर्वं प्रसादं कृतवानसि । तथा ममापि तत्सर्वं दातुमर्हसि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: tasya bhaktyā yathāpūrvaṃ prasādaṃ kṛtavānasi | tathā mamāpi tatsarvaṃ dātumarhasi śaṅkara
verses.translation: The chief of the army of Siva stopped all the missiles discharged from Vignu's bow by means of terrible anti-missiles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chief of the army of Siva stopped all the missiles discharged from Vignu's bow by means of terrible anti-missiles.
verses.science: निवृत्तिके लिये षबडध्वशोधन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञापितस्तेन भगवान् भगनेत्रहा । न्यायेन वै ददौ सर्वं तस्यापि स घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: iti vijñāpitastena bhagavān bhaganetrahā | nyāyena vai dadau sarvaṃ tasyāpi sa ghṛṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: Then Visnu with eyes reddened by anger dischar¬ ged an arrow in which his name had been engraved and which had never been obstructed anywhere, against the Gana chief. Showering arrows, lord Bhadra split the arrow into pieces on the way before it reached him.
verses.hindi: संक्षेपसे छः अध्वा कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Visnu with eyes reddened by anger dischar¬ ged an arrow in which his name had been engraved and which had never been obstructed anywhere, against the Gana chief. Showering arrows, lord Bhadra split the arrow into pieces on the way before it reached him.
verses.science: संक्षेपसे छः अध्वा कहे गये हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वैवमीश्वरादेव ब्रह्मा सर्वात्मतां क्षणात् । त्वरमाणोऽथ सङ्गम्य ददर्श पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: labdhvaivamīśvarādeva brahmā sarvātmatāṃ kṣaṇāt | tvaramāṇo'tha saṅgamya dadarśa puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Then within an instant he split the bow with a single arrow and the wings of Garua with the two arrows. This was a wonderful feat. Then by his Yogic powers Vi?9u let loose from his body thousands of terrific gods holding conch, discus and the club. But the mighty Bhadra burnt all of them instantaneously by means of the fire of his eyes like iva who burnt the Tripuras.
verses.wordMeaning: Then within an instant he split the bow with a single arrow and the wings of Garua with the two arrows. This was a wonderful feat. Then by his Yogic powers Vi?9u let loose from his body thousands of terrific gods holding conch, discus and the club.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then within an instant he split the bow with a single arrow and the wings of Garua with the two arrows. This was a wonderful feat. Then by his Yogic powers Vi?9u let loose from his body thousands of terrific gods holding conch, discus and the club.…
verses.science: कलाओंसे व्याप्त हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्णवालये शुभ्रे विमाने सूर्यसन्निभे । हेमरत्नान्विते दिव्ये मनसा तेन निर्मिते
verses.transliteration: kṣīrārṇavālaye śubhre vimāne sūryasannibhe | hemaratnānvite divye manasā tena nirmite
verses.translation: Thus infuriated Visnu raised his discus in a hurry and attempted to hurl it on the hero. On seeing him in front with the discus lifted up, the chief of the Ganas smiled and without any strain made his hand stiff and benumbed. With his limbs turned numb, Vinu became incapable though he was desirous of hurling the unequalled and terrible discus.
verses.hindi: और अशुद्धके भेदसे दो प्रकारका है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus infuriated Visnu raised his discus in a hurry and attempted to hurl it on the hero. On seeing him in front with the discus lifted up, the chief of the Ganas smiled and without any strain made his hand stiff and benumbed. With his limbs turned numb,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus infuriated Visnu raised his discus in a hurry and attempted to hurl it on the hero. On seeing him in front with the discus lifted up, the chief of the Ganas smiled and without any strain made his hand stiff and benumbed. With his limbs turned numb,…
verses.science: और अशुद्धके भेदसे दो प्रकारका है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तभोगशय्यायां शयानं पङ्कजेक्षणम् । चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: anantabhogaśayyāyāṃ śayānaṃ paṅkajekṣaṇam | caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: Gasping for breath with a hand holding the discus he stood idly, immobile like a stone, like the soul without a body, like a bull without a horn or like a lion without its fangs. So stood Vi?nu. On seeing Visnu in a miserable plight the infuriated Indra and other gods took up their wea-
verses.hindi: है। यह भेद और उपभेदोंको छोड़कर साठ है
verses.wordMeaning: Gasping for breath with a hand holding the discus he stood idly, immobile like a stone, like the soul without a body, like a bull without a horn or like a lion without its fangs. So stood Vi?nu.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Gasping for breath with a hand holding the discus he stood idly, immobile like a stone, like the soul without a body, like a bull without a horn or like a lion without its fangs. So stood Vi?nu.…
verses.science: है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रधरं सौम्यं चन्द्रबिम्बसमाननम् । श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं प्रसन्नमधुरस्मितम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ candrabimbasamānanam | śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ prasannamadhurasmitam
verses.translation: On glancing at them as a lion glances at the deer, Bhadra of Rudra's body, the hero surrounded by ex¬ cellent heroes, benumbed them with a boisterous laugh.
verses.commentary: Sense: On glancing at them as a lion glances at the deer, Bhadra of Rudra's body, the hero surrounded by ex¬ cellent heroes, benumbed them with a boisterous laugh.
verses.science: है, जिसके अनेक भेद हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धरामृदुकराम्भोजस्पर्शरक्तपदाम्बुजम् । क्षीरार्णवामृतमिव शयानं योगनिद्रया
verses.transliteration: dharāmṛdukarāmbhojasparśaraktapadāmbujam | kṣīrārṇavāmṛtamiva śayānaṃ yoganidrayā
verses.translation: The right hand of Indra who desired to release the thunderbolt it held remained steady as painted in a picture.
verses.commentary: Sense: The right hand of Indra who desired to release the thunderbolt it held remained steady as painted in a picture.
verses.science: उच्चारणपूर्वक शान्त्यतीत पदमें अंकित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तमसा कालरुद्राख्यं रजसा कनकाण्डजम् । सत्त्वेन सर्वगं विष्णुं निर्गुणत्वे महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tamasā kālarudrākhyaṃ rajasā kanakāṇḍajam | sattvena sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ nirguṇatve maheśvaram
verses.translation: Thus the gods with their efficacy thwarted in the battle were rendered incapable of standing in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the gods with their efficacy thwarted in the battle were rendered incapable of standing in front of him.
verses.science: गुरु होमा-वशिष्ट चरु उसे दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषं ब्रह्मा प्रगल्भमिदमब्रवीत् । ग्रसामि त्वामहं विष्णो त्वमात्मानं यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaṃ brahmā pragalbhamidamabravīt | grasāmi tvāmahaṃ viṣṇo tvamātmānaṃ yathā purā
verses.translation: Frightened by the splendour of Virabhadra they could not stay further in the battle. In that fierce battle they fled even with their benumbed limbs.
verses.hindi: बार आचमन करके शिवमन्त्रका उच्चारण करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Frightened by the splendour of Virabhadra they could not stay further in the battle. In that fierce battle they fled even with their benumbed limbs.
verses.science: बार आचमन करके शिवमन्त्रका उच्चारण करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिबुद्ध्य पितामहम् । उदैक्षत महाबाहुः स्मितमीषच्चकार च
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratibuddhya pitāmaham | udaikṣata mahābāhuḥ smitamīṣaccakāra ca
verses.translation: The mighty Virabhadra hit the fleeing warriors, with sharp arrows like the cloud hitting the mountains with sharp showers.
verses.hindi: बार आचमन करके शिवका स्मरण करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty Virabhadra hit the fleeing warriors, with sharp arrows like the cloud hitting the mountains with sharp showers.
verses.science: बार आचमन करके शिवका स्मरण करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे विष्णुर्ग्रस्तस्तेन महात्मना । सृष्टश्च ब्रह्मणा सद्यो भ्रुवोर्मध्यादयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare viṣṇurgrastastena mahātmanā | sṛṣṭaśca brahmaṇā sadyo bhruvormadhyādayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The multitudinous arms of Virabhadra, resembling iron clubs, shone with their various shining weapons like serpents with fiery flames.
verses.commentary: Sense: The multitudinous arms of Virabhadra, resembling iron clubs, shone with their various shining weapons like serpents with fiery flames.
verses.science: जोड़े हुए शिवमण्डलमें प्रवेश करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे साक्षाद्भगवानिन्दुभूषणः । शक्तिं तयोरपि द्रष्टुमरूपो रूपमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare sākṣādbhagavānindubhūṣaṇaḥ | śaktiṃ tayorapi draṣṭumarūpo rūpamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The hero discharging weapons and missiles shone like Brahma discharging (creating) ail living beings.
verses.hindi: आठ या चौवन आहुतियोंका होम करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The hero discharging weapons and missiles shone like Brahma discharging (creating) ail living beings.
verses.science: आठ या चौवन आहुतियोंका होम करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादमतुलं कर्तुं पुरा दत्तवरस्तयोः । आगच्छत्तत्र यत्रेमौ ब्रह्मनारायणौ स्थितौ
verses.transliteration: prasādamatulaṃ kartuṃ purā dattavarastayoḥ | āgacchattatra yatremau brahmanārāyaṇau sthitau
verses.translation: Just as the sun covers the earth by his rays so the hero enveloped the quarters by means of his arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the sun covers the earth by his rays so the hero enveloped the quarters by means of his arrows.
verses.science: शिष्यको बिठाये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तुष्टुवतुर्देवं प्रीतौ भीतौ च कौतुकात् । प्रणेमतुश्च बहुशो बहुमानेन दूरतः
verses.transliteration: atha tuṣṭuvaturdevaṃ prītau bhītau ca kautukāt | praṇematuśca bahuśo bahumānena dūrataḥ
verses.translation: The arrows of the Gana chieftains embellished with gold and flying in the firmament like lightning became the standard of comparison.
verses.hindi: प्रबुध्योत्थाय गुरुवे स्वप्नं दृष्टं निवेदयेत्॥ ४५  बताये
verses.commentary: Sense: The arrows of the Gana chieftains embellished with gold and flying in the firmament like lightning became the standard of comparison.
verses.science: प्रबुध्योत्थाय गुरुवे स्वप्नं दृष्टं निवेदयेत्॥ ४५ बताये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भवोऽपि भगवानेतावनुगृह्य पिनाकधृक् । सादरं पश्यतोरेव तयोरन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: bhavo'pi bhagavānetāvanugṛhya pinākadhṛk | sādaraṃ paśyatoreva tayorantaradhīyata
verses.translation: The great arrows took away the lives of the gods even as the water snakes squeeze the lives out of the frogs. They drank their blood as though that were wine.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयर्सहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवदीक्षाविधानवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The great arrows took away the lives of the gods even as the water snakes squeeze the lives out of the frogs. They drank their blood as though that were wine.
verses.science: जति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयर्सहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवदीक्षाविधानवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Even after committing great sin, if any one worships Siva with devotion he is liberated from the sin. No hesitation need be made in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after committing great sin, if any one worships Siva with devotion he is liberated from the sin. No hesitation need be made in this respect.
verses.science: वागीश्वरीके गर्भमें निविष्ट करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Even after committing great sin, if any one worships Siva with devotion he is liberated from the sin. No hesitation need be made in this respect.
verses.hindi: भोगप्राप्ति और परा प्रीतिका चिन्तन करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after committing great sin, if any one worships Siva with devotion he is liberated from the sin. No hesitation need be made in this respect.
verses.science: भोगप्राप्ति और परा प्रीतिका चिन्तन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । रुद्राविर्भाववर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । प्रतिकल्पं प्रवक्ष्यामि रुद्राविर्भावकारणम् । यतोऽविच्छिन्नसन्ताना ब्रह्मसृष्टिः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.14. caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ | rudrāvirbhāvavarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | pratikalpaṃ pravakṣyāmi rudrāvirbhāvakāraṇam | yato'vicchinnasantānā brahmasṛṣṭiḥ pravartate
verses.translation: Then the gods including Visnu and the guardians of the quarters pierced by the arrows discharged from the bow of the chief of Ganas and overwhelmed by great pain fled from the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gods including Visnu and the guardians of the quarters pierced by the arrows discharged from the bow of the chief of Ganas and overwhelmed by great pain fled from the battle.
verses.science: साथ सांनिध्य स्थापित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे कल्पे प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माण्डसम्भवः । अवृद्धिहेतोर्भूतानां मुमोह भृशदुःखितः
verses.transliteration: kalpe kalpe prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā brahmā brahmāṇḍasambhavaḥ | avṛddhihetorbhūtānāṃ mumoha bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Rudra the deity of deadly fire; to the slayer of death and Kama; the remover of the heads of the gods and of the wicked-souled Daka.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे षडध्वशुद्धयादिकथन नामाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Rudra the deity of deadly fire; to the slayer of death and Kama; the remover of the heads of the gods and of the wicked-souled Daka.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे षडध्वशुद्धयादिकथन नामाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दुःखप्रशान्त्यर्थं प्रजानां च विवृद्धये । तत्तत्कल्पेषु कालात्मा रुद्रो रुद्रगणाधिपः
verses.transliteration: tasya duḥkhapraśāntyarthaṃ prajānāṃ ca vivṛddhaye | tattatkalpeṣu kālātmā rudro rudragaṇādhipaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him the gods headed by Vi?nu were pleased and awe-struck. They bowed to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him the gods headed by Vi?nu were pleased and awe-struck. They bowed to him.
verses.science: सिद्धियोंक फलको देनेवाला हो। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्दिष्टः परमेशेन महेशो नीललोहितः । पुत्रो भूत्वानुगृह्णाति ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणोऽनुजः
verses.transliteration: nirdiṣṭaḥ parameśena maheśo nīlalohitaḥ | putro bhūtvānugṛhṇāti brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇo'nujaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing them frightened, 8iva the destroyer of the distress of his devotees said laughingly after glancing at Parvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing them frightened, 8iva the destroyer of the distress of his devotees said laughingly after glancing at Parvati.
verses.science: कल्याणदायक होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स एव भगवानीशस्तेजोराशिरनामयः । अनादिनिधनो धाता भूतसङ्कोचको विभुः
verses.transliteration: sa eva bhagavānīśastejorāśiranāmayaḥ | anādinidhano dhātā bhūtasaṅkocako vibhuḥ
verses.translation: O gods, do not be afraid. You are my own subjects. It is only to bless you that the punishment has been meted out to you by the merciful lord.
verses.hindi: विधान किया है, जो उत्तरोत्तर श्रेष्ठ हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods, do not be afraid. You are my own subjects. It is only to bless you that the punishment has been meted out to you by the merciful lord.
verses.science: विधान किया है, जो उत्तरोत्तर श्रेष्ठ हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परमैश्वर्यसंयुक्तः परमेश्वरभावितः । तच्छक्त्याधिष्ठितः शश्वत्तच्चिह्नैरपि चिह्नितः
verses.transliteration: paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktaḥ parameśvarabhāvitaḥ | tacchaktyādhiṣṭhitaḥ śaśvattaccihnairapi cihnitaḥ
verses.translation: The transgression of you the gods has been forgiven by us. When we are infuriated you have neither sustenance nor life.
verses.hindi: मूल, फल और जल--ये आहारके लिये विहित हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The transgression of you the gods has been forgiven by us. When we are infuriated you have neither sustenance nor life.
verses.science: मूल, फल और जल--ये आहारके लिये विहित हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्नामनामा तद्रूपस्तत्कार्यकरणक्षमः । तत्तुल्यव्यवहारश्च तदाज्ञापरिपालकः
verses.transliteration: tannāmanāmā tadrūpastatkāryakaraṇakṣamaḥ | tattulyavyavahāraśca tadājñāparipālakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus spoken to by Siva of unmeasured splendour the gods immediately had their doubts cleared. The gods danced joyously.
verses.hindi: इस साधनमें विशेषरूपसे ऐसा करनेका विधान है
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus spoken to by Siva of unmeasured splendour the gods immediately had their doubts cleared. The gods danced joyously.
verses.science: इस साधनमें विशेषरूपसे ऐसा करनेका विधान है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रादित्यसङ्काशश्चन्द्रावयवभूषणः । भुजङ्गहारकेयूरवलयो मुञ्जमेखलः
verses.transliteration: sahasrādityasaṅkāśaścandrāvayavabhūṣaṇaḥ | bhujaṅgahārakeyūravalayo muñjamekhalaḥ
verses.translation: Becoming delighted and excited in their minds with bliss, the gods began to eulogise Siva.'
verses.commentary: Sense: Becoming delighted and excited in their minds with bliss, the gods began to eulogise Siva.'
verses.science: केवल घृतसे ही आहुति दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरविरिञ्चेन्द्रकपालशकलोज्ज्वलः । गङ्गातुङ्गतरङ्गार्द्रपिङ्गलाननमूर्द्धजः
verses.transliteration: jalandharaviriñcendrakapālaśakalojjvalaḥ | gaṅgātuṅgataraṅgārdrapiṅgalānanamūrddhajaḥ
verses.translation: O lord assuming the forms of Brahma, Vi mu and Rudra through Rajas, Tamas and Sattva you are the creator, protector and the annihilator of the worlds.
verses.hindi: इहलोक और परलोकमें कुछ भी दुर्लभ नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord assuming the forms of Brahma, Vi mu and Rudra through Rajas, Tamas and Sattva you are the creator, protector and the annihilator of the worlds.
verses.science: इहलोक और परलोकमें कुछ भी दुर्लभ नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भग्नदंष्ट्राङ्कुराक्रान्तप्रान्तकान्तधराधरः । सव्यश्रवणपार्श्वान्तमण्डलीकृतकुण्डलः
verses.transliteration: bhagnadaṃṣṭrāṅkurākrāntaprāntakāntadharādharaḥ | savyaśravaṇapārśvāntamaṇḍalīkṛtakuṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: The warriors of the gods with their hair dishevelled
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठामनुसन्‍्धाय तस्यां चापि यथा पुरा॥ २६ उसमें भी पूर्ववत् सब कार्य करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The warriors of the gods with their hair dishevelled
verses.science: प्रतिष्ठामनुसन्‍्धाय तस्यां चापि यथा पुरा॥ २६ उसमें भी पूर्ववत् सब कार्य करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महावृषभनिर्याणो महाजलदनिःस्वनः । महानलसमप्रख्यो महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: mahāvṛṣabhaniryāṇo mahājaladaniḥsvanaḥ | mahānalasamaprakhyo mahābalaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Some fell in adversity with their garments, orna¬ ments, weapons and missiles scattered. Eschewing their pride, arrcance and strength they fell evincing signs of dejection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some fell in adversity with their garments, orna¬ ments, weapons and missiles scattered. Eschewing their pride, arrcance and strength they fell evincing signs of dejection.
verses.science: शिवकी आज्ञा सुना दे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं घोरमहारूपो ब्रह्मपुत्रो महेश्वरः । विज्ञानं ब्रह्मणे दत्त्वा सर्गं सह करोति च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ghoramahārūpo brahmaputro maheśvaraḥ | vijñānaṃ brahmaṇe dattvā sargaṃ saha karoti ca
verses.translation: Destroying Daka's sacrifice, performed in the wrong way, by means of weapons the invincible lord of Ganas shone amidst the leading Gaas like the lion in the midst of bulls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Destroying Daka's sacrifice, performed in the wrong way, by means of weapons the invincible lord of Ganas shone amidst the leading Gaas like the lion in the midst of bulls.
verses.science: उद्धासित कर रही हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् रुद्रप्रसादेन प्रतिकल्पं प्रजापतेः । प्रवाहरूपतो नित्या प्रजासृष्टिः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: tasmād rudraprasādena pratikalpaṃ prajāpateḥ | pravāharūpato nityā prajāsṛṣṭiḥ pravartate
verses.translation: Thus the gods headed by Visnu with their bodies split and mutilated attained a miserable plight and trembled. Only a few of them servived.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the gods headed by Visnu with their bodies split and mutilated attained a miserable plight and trembled. Only a few of them servived.
verses.science: उसकी व्यापकताका अवलोकन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्प्रार्थितः स्रष्टुं ब्रह्मणा नीललोहितः । स्वात्मना सदृशान् सर्वान् ससर्ज मनसा विभुः
verses.transliteration: kadācitprārthitaḥ sraṣṭuṃ brahmaṇā nīlalohitaḥ | svātmanā sadṛśān sarvān sasarja manasā vibhuḥ
verses.translation: The excessively infuriated Pramathas and Gaas urged by Virabhadra seized the warriors frightened of the battle tying their hands, feet, shoulders and bellies by means of strong iron fetters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively infuriated Pramathas and Gaas urged by Virabhadra seized the warriors frightened of the battle tying their hands, feet, shoulders and bellies by means of strong iron fetters.
verses.science: करके अग्निमें तीन आहुतियाँ दे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कान्नीलग्रीवाँस्त्रिलोचनान् । जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् दीप्तशूलवरायुधान्
verses.transliteration: kapardino nirātaṅkānnīlagrīvām̐strilocanān | jarāmaraṇanirmuktān dīptaśūlavarāyudhān
verses.translation: In the meantime Brahma who had secured his favour due to his charioteership, implored Bhadra, the devotee of the daughter of Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Brahma who had secured his favour due to his charioteership, implored Bhadra, the devotee of the daughter of Himavat.
verses.science: ता भूतशुद्धि कर्ममें चिन्तन करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तु सञ्छादितं सर्वं चतुर्दशविधं जगत् । तान्दृष्ट्वा विविधान् रुद्रान् रुद्रमाह पितामहः
verses.transliteration: taistu sañchāditaṃ sarvaṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ jagat | tāndṛṣṭvā vividhān rudrān rudramāha pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, enough of this fury. The gods arc ruined. Please forgive their faults. O you of auspicious rites.**
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, enough of this fury. The gods arc ruined. Please forgive their faults. O you of auspicious rites.**
verses.science: शरीरका निर्माण करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते देवदेवेश मास्राक्षीरीदृशीः प्रजाः । अन्याः सृज त्वं भद्रं ते प्रजा मृत्युसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: namaste devadeveśa māsrākṣīrīdṛśīḥ prajāḥ | anyāḥ sṛja tvaṃ bhadraṃ te prajā mṛtyusamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: Implored thus by Brahma the delighted chief of Gaas became calm.
verses.commentary: Sense: Implored thus by Brahma the delighted chief of Gaas became calm.
verses.science: निवृत्तिकलाका न्यासकर चिन्तन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः प्रहसन्प्राह ब्रह्माणं परमेश्वरः । नास्ति मे तादृशः सर्गः सृज त्वमशुभाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ prahasanprāha brahmāṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ | nāsti me tādṛśaḥ sargaḥ sṛja tvamaśubhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Getting the opportunity through Brahma the gods joined their palms in reverence above their heads and eulogised him by various hymns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting the opportunity through Brahma the gods joined their palms in reverence above their heads and eulogised him by various hymns.
verses.science: शैवी विद्याका उपदेश करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये त्विमे मनसा सृष्टा महात्मानो महाबलाः । चरिष्यन्ति मया सार्द्धं सर्व एव हि याज्ञिकाः
verses.transliteration: ye tvime manasā sṛṣṭā mahātmāno mahābalāḥ | cariṣyanti mayā sārddhaṃ sarva eva hi yājñikāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva the quiescent. Obeisance to the trident-bearing destroyer of sacrifice. Obeisance to Bhadra, the lord of Rudras, the wealth and prosperity of Rudras.
verses.hindi: वित्तशाठ्य॑ न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत् शिवमात्मन: ॥ ६३  करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Siva the quiescent. Obeisance to the trident-bearing destroyer of sacrifice. Obeisance to Bhadra, the lord of Rudras, the wealth and prosperity of Rudras.
verses.science: वित्तशाठ्य॑ न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत् शिवमात्मन: ॥ ६३ करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा विश्वकर्माणं विश्वभूतेश्वरो हरः । सह रुद्रैः प्रजासर्गान्निवृत्तात्माध्यतिष्ठत
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā viśvakarmāṇaṃ viśvabhūteśvaro haraḥ | saha rudraiḥ prajāsargānnivṛttātmādhyatiṣṭhata
verses.translation: O hero, incensurable though we are we have been chastised by you in the war due to our association with this sinner Daka.
verses.hindi: आदिका कथन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O hero, incensurable though we are we have been chastised by you in the war due to our association with this sinner Daka.
verses.science: आदिका कथन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति देवोऽसौ न प्रसूते प्रजाः शुभाः । ऊर्ध्वरेताः स्थितः स्थाणुर्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti devo'sau na prasūte prajāḥ śubhāḥ | ūrdhvaretāḥ sthitaḥ sthāṇuryāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Siva, the omnipresent lord of the worlds, was stand¬ ing in the firmament along with the Ganas.
verses.hindi: इस बातकी सूचना मैं पहले दे चुका हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, the omnipresent lord of the worlds, was stand¬ ing in the firmament along with the Ganas.
verses.science: इस बातकी सूचना मैं पहले दे चुका हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Simantini whose husband had died, O lord, attained unequalled marital bliss by worshipping you. By performing the holy rites on Mondays she bore sons.
verses.hindi: पाकर अन्तमें मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Simantini whose husband had died, O lord, attained unequalled marital bliss by worshipping you. By performing the holy rites on Mondays she bore sons.
verses.science: पाकर अन्तमें मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Simantini whose husband had died, O lord, attained unequalled marital bliss by worshipping you. By performing the holy rites on Mondays she bore sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Simantini whose husband had died, O lord, attained unequalled marital bliss by worshipping you. By performing the holy rites on Mondays she bore sons.
verses.science: क्षरीं चाक्षर- जप करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । शिवशिवास्तुतिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । यदा पुनः प्रजाः सृष्टा न व्यवर्द्धन्त वेधसः । तदा मैथुनजां सृष्टिं ब्रह्मा कर्तुममन्यत
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.15. pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivaśivāstutivarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | yadā punaḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭā na vyavarddhanta vedhasaḥ | tadā maithunajāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā kartumamanyata
verses.translation: The lord gave excellent region to Ankara. You protected Sudarsana from the fear of danger from the hosts of kings.
verses.hindi: बी 040७० माहात्य्य नामक उनीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord gave excellent region to Ankara. You protected Sudarsana from the fear of danger from the hosts of kings.
verses.science: बी 040७० माहात्य्य नामक उनीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: न निर्गतं पुरा यस्मान्नारीणां कुलमीश्वरात् । तेन मैथुनजां सृष्टिं न शशाक पितामहः
verses.transliteration: na nirgataṃ purā yasmānnārīṇāṃ kulamīśvarāt | tena maithunajāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ na śaśāka pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: He restored the goddesses — mothers of the gods who had been punished by the Pramathas and others.
verses.hindi: विशेषादिसंस्कृति नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: He restored the goddesses — mothers of the gods who had been punished by the Pramathas and others.
verses.science: विशेषादिसंस्कृति नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स विदधे बुद्धिमर्थनिश्चयगामिनीम् । प्रजानमेव वृद्ध्यर्थं प्रष्टव्यः परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa vidadhe buddhimarthaniścayagāminīm | prajānameva vṛddhyarthaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ parameśvara
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by Brahma and other gods lord iva, the ocean of mercy, favourably disposed towards the devotees was pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised by Brahma and other gods lord iva, the ocean of mercy, favourably disposed towards the devotees was pleased.
verses.science: नित्यनैमित्तिककर्मवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादेन विना तस्य न वर्द्धेरन्निमाः प्रजाः । एवं सञ्चिन्त्य विश्वात्मा तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: prasādena vinā tasya na varddherannimāḥ prajāḥ | evaṃ sañcintya viśvātmā tapaḥ kartuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: Where did Siva who vanished along with the goddess and his attendants go? Where did he stay? W'hat did he do and not do?
verses.commentary: Sense: Where did Siva who vanished along with the goddess and his attendants go? Where did he stay? W'hat did he do and not do?
verses.science: पात्रोंका शोधन करके द्र॒व्यशुद्धि करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदाद्या परमा शक्तिरनन्ता लोकभाविनी । आद्या सूक्ष्मतरा शुद्धा भावगम्या मनोहरा
verses.transliteration: tadādyā paramā śaktiranantā lokabhāvinī | ādyā sūkṣmatarā śuddhā bhāvagamyā manoharā
verses.translation: The excellent mountain Mandara*® with different caves became the pleasing spot of penance for lord l§iva.
verses.hindi: उन सभी पवित्र द्र॒व्योंको उनमें डाले
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent mountain Mandara*® with different caves became the pleasing spot of penance for lord l§iva.
verses.science: उन सभी पवित्र द्र॒व्योंको उनमें डाले। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणा निष्प्रपञ्चा च निष्कला निरुपप्लवा । निरन्तररता नित्या नित्यमीश्वरपार्श्वगा
verses.transliteration: nirguṇā niṣprapañcā ca niṣkalā nirupaplavā | nirantararatā nityā nityamīśvarapārśvagā
verses.translation: He had performed a great penance for the previlege to support Siva and Siva on his head. After a long time he felt the pleasure of contact with their lotus like feet..
verses.hindi: आदि एवं शीतल मनोज्ञ पुष्प आदि छोड़े
verses.commentary: Sense: He had performed a great penance for the previlege to support Siva and Siva on his head. After a long time he felt the pleasure of contact with their lotus like feet..
verses.science: आदि एवं शीतल मनोज्ञ पुष्प आदि छोड़े। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तया परमया शक्त्या भगवन्तं त्रियम्बकम् । सञ्चिन्त्य हृदये ब्रह्मा तताप परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: tayā paramayā śaktyā bhagavantaṃ triyambakam | sañcintya hṛdaye brahmā tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: The beauty of the mountain canmjt be mentioned in detail by persons with thousand faces even in hundreds of crores of years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The beauty of the mountain canmjt be mentioned in detail by persons with thousand faces even in hundreds of crores of years.
verses.science: प्रोक्षण करके विधिवत् शोधन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तीव्रेण तपसा तस्य युक्तस्य परमेष्ठिनः । अचिरेणैव कालेन पिता सम्प्रतुतोष ह
verses.transliteration: tīvreṇa tapasā tasya yuktasya parameṣṭhinaḥ | acireṇaiva kālena pitā sampratutoṣa ha
verses.translation: The slopes of the mountain abounding in rocks and trees humiliate the universe due to the' perpetual presence of 8iva and Siva.
verses.hindi: आराधना करके उन्हें पूर्वोक्त निर्माल्य अर्पित करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The slopes of the mountain abounding in rocks and trees humiliate the universe due to the' perpetual presence of 8iva and Siva.
verses.science: आराधना करके उन्हें पूर्वोक्त निर्माल्य अर्पित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः केनचिदंशेन मूर्तिमाविश्य कामपि । अर्द्धनारीश्वरो भूत्वा ययौ देवः स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kenacidaṃśena mūrtimāviśya kāmapi | arddhanārīśvaro bhūtvā yayau devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: The mountain renders help to the parents of the worlds with light and clean waters of the streams cool to
verses.hindi: जो शुद्ध विद्यासे अत्यन्त प्रकाशमान हो
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain renders help to the parents of the worlds with light and clean waters of the streams cool to
verses.science: जो शुद्ध विद्यासे अत्यन्त प्रकाशमान हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा परमं देवं तमसः परमव्ययम् । अद्वितीयमनिर्देश्यमदृश्यमकृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ devaṃ tamasaḥ paramavyayam | advitīyamanirdeśyamadṛśyamakṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The storehouse of mercy enabled Medura to cross the ocean of worldly existence. By your miraculous activity you enlivened the husband of iSarada.
verses.commentary: Sense: The storehouse of mercy enabled Medura to cross the ocean of worldly existence. By your miraculous activity you enlivened the husband of iSarada.
verses.science: हों और पाँचवाँ मध्यमें हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकविधातारं सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरम् । सर्वलोकविधायिन्या शक्त्या परमया युतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalokavidhātāraṃ sarvalokeśvareśvaram | sarvalokavidhāyinyā śaktyā paramayā yutam
verses.translation: Destroying the calamity of Bhadrayus you conferred happiness on him. By serving you SauminI became free from worldly bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Destroying the calamity of Bhadrayus you conferred happiness on him. By serving you SauminI became free from worldly bondage.
verses.science: अभिषेकके लिये ऊँचे आसनपर बिठाये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रतर्क्यमनाभासममेयमजरं ध्रुवम् । अचलं निर्गुणं शान्तमनन्तमहिमास्पदम्
verses.transliteration: apratarkyamanābhāsamameyamajaraṃ dhruvam | acalaṃ nirguṇaṃ śāntamanantamahimāspadam
verses.translation: O iJiiva you are Brahma, Visnu and Siva by means of the Gunas Rajas, Sattva and Tanias. With the desire to bless the people you became the creator, sustainer and the annihilator.
verses.commentary: Sense: O iJiiva you are Brahma, Visnu and Siva by means of the Gunas Rajas, Sattva and Tanias. With the desire to bless the people you became the creator, sustainer and the annihilator.
verses.science: जलसे अभिषेक करना चाहिए। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगं सर्वदं सर्वसदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जितम् । सर्वोपमाननिर्मुक्तं शरण्यं शाश्वतं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sarvagaṃ sarvadaṃ sarvasadasadvyaktivarjitam | sarvopamānanirmuktaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ śivam
verses.translation: You are the destroyer of the arrogance and the brilliance of everyone. You are the hidden secret of all lores, the cause of blessings for all.
verses.hindi: एक सौ आठ मनन कट एव पूर्णाहुति दे॥९-१०॥ एवं पूर्णाहुति दे
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the destroyer of the arrogance and the brilliance of everyone. You are the hidden secret of all lores, the cause of blessings for all.
verses.science: एक सौ आठ मनन कट एव पूर्णाहुति दे॥९-१०॥ एवं पूर्णाहुति दे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य दण्डवद् ब्रह्मा समुत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः । श्रद्धाविनयसम्पन्नैः श्राव्यैः संस्कारसंयुतैः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya daṇḍavad brahmā samutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ | śraddhāvinayasampannaiḥ śrāvyaiḥ saṃskārasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord, everything originates from you. You are all. Everything is in you. Save us again Please be merci¬ ful on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, everything originates from you. You are all. Everything is in you. Save us again Please be merci¬ ful on me.
verses.science: शिवसम्बन्धी ज्ञानकी पुस्तक दे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथार्थयुक्तसर्वार्थैर्वेदार्थपरिबृंहितैः । तुष्टाव देवं देवीं च सूक्तैः सूक्ष्मार्थगोचरैः
verses.transliteration: yathārthayuktasarvārthairvedārthaparibṛṃhitaiḥ | tuṣṭāva devaṃ devīṃ ca sūktaiḥ sūkṣmārthagocaraiḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, getting the opportunity Brahma bowed to him with palms joined in reverence and informed the trident-bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, getting the opportunity Brahma bowed to him with palms joined in reverence and informed the trident-bearing lord.
verses.science: राज्य पानेके भी योग्य है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । जय देव महादेव जयेश्वर महेश्वर । जय सर्वगुणश्रेष्ठ जय सर्वसुराधिप
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | jaya deva mahādeva jayeśvara maheśvara | jaya sarvaguṇaśreṣṭha jaya sarvasurādhipa
verses.translation: O lord, be victorious. O destroyer of the distress of your devotees, who else other than you becomes pleased when offences are of this nature?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, be victorious. O destroyer of the distress of your devotees, who else other than you becomes pleased when offences are of this nature?
verses.science: अनन्तर उन्हें शिवज्ञानका उपदेश दे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रकृतिकल्याणि जय प्रकृतिनायिके । जय प्रकृतिदूरे त्वं जय प्रकृतिसुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: jaya prakṛtikalyāṇi jaya prakṛtināyike | jaya prakṛtidūre tvaṃ jaya prakṛtisundari
verses.translation: Those who are killed in battle will regain their souls. When the lord is delighted who will not revive?
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are killed in battle will regain their souls. When the lord is delighted who will not revive?
verses.science: आदिसे सत्कार) करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जयामोघमहामाय जयामोघमनोरथ । जयामोघमहालील जयामोघमहाबल
verses.transliteration: jayāmoghamahāmāya jayāmoghamanoratha | jayāmoghamahālīla jayāmoghamahābala
verses.translation: The fault in the offences committed by the gods, O lord, is actually a blessing because of the weightiness of your acceptance. I consider so.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fault in the offences committed by the gods, O lord, is actually a blessing because of the weightiness of your acceptance. I consider so.
verses.science: कार्य सम्पन्न करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जय विश्वजगन्मातर्जय विश्वजगन्मयि । जय विश्वजगद्धात्रि जय विश्वजगत्सखि
verses.transliteration: jaya viśvajaganmātarjaya viśvajaganmayi | jaya viśvajagaddhātri jaya viśvajagatsakhi
verses.translation: When Brahma implored thus, the lord smiled and glanced at the face of the goddess. As a result of his affection to Brahma who was like a son unto him, the lord revived the gods to life.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तस्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे विशेषादिसंस्कृतिनाम विंशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: When Brahma implored thus, the lord smiled and glanced at the face of the goddess. As a result of his affection to Brahma who was like a son unto him, the lord revived the gods to life.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तस्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे विशेषादिसंस्कृतिनाम विंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: जय शाश्वतिकैश्वर्य जय शाश्वतिकालय । जय शाश्वतिकाकार जय शाश्वतिकानुग
verses.transliteration: jaya śāśvatikaiśvarya jaya śāśvatikālaya | jaya śāśvatikākāra jaya śāśvatikānuga
verses.translation: Lord Brahma made the face of Dak 9a look like the the face of an old goat as a befitting punishment for his sins.
verses.hindi: शिवशास्त्रोदितं कर्म नित्यनैमित्तिकं तथा॥ ९ सुनना चाहता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma made the face of Dak 9a look like the the face of an old goat as a befitting punishment for his sins.
verses.science: शिवशास्त्रोदितं कर्म नित्यनैमित्तिकं तथा॥ ९ सुनना चाहता हूँ। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: जयात्मत्रयनिर्मात्रि जयात्मत्रयपालिनि । जयात्मत्रयसंहर्त्रि जयात्मत्रयनायिके
verses.transliteration: jayātmatrayanirmātri jayātmatrayapālini | jayātmatrayasaṃhartri jayātmatrayanāyike
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, O cause of the blessing for the worlds, O lord, be merciful. Forgive my guilt.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the universe, O cause of the blessing for the worlds, O lord, be merciful. Forgive my guilt.
verses.science: धारण करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जयावलोकनायत्तजगत्कारणबृंहण । जयोपेक्षाकटाक्षोत्थहुतभुग्भुक्तभौतिक
verses.transliteration: jayāvalokanāyattajagatkāraṇabṛṃhaṇa | jayopekṣākaṭākṣotthahutabhugbhuktabhautika
verses.translation: You are the creator, protector and the annihilator of the worlds. This has been known by me particularly. You are the lord of Visnu and all others.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the creator, protector and the annihilator of the worlds. This has been known by me particularly. You are the lord of Visnu and all others.
verses.science: अर्घ्य प्रदान करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जय देवाद्यविज्ञेये स्वात्मसूक्ष्मदृशोज्ज्वले । जय स्थूलात्मशक्त्येशे जय व्याप्तचराचरे
verses.transliteration: jaya devādyavijñeye svātmasūkṣmadṛśojjvale | jaya sthūlātmaśaktyeśe jaya vyāptacarācare
verses.translation: The lord, the storehouse of mercy glanced at the guilty one who was emotionally distressed and smilingly said "Do not fear".
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, the storehouse of mercy glanced at the guilty one who was emotionally distressed and smilingly said "Do not fear".
verses.science: सांगोपांग पूजा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जय नानैकविन्यस्तविश्वतत्त्वसमुच्चय । जयासुरशिरोनिष्ठश्रेष्ठानुगकदम्बक
verses.transliteration: jaya nānaikavinyastaviśvatattvasamuccaya | jayāsuraśironiṣṭhaśreṣṭhānugakadambaka
verses.translation: Saying so and with a desire to please his father Brahma, the lord bestowed on Daksa the imperishable chief- tancy of the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying so and with a desire to please his father Brahma, the lord bestowed on Daksa the imperishable chief- tancy of the Ganas.
verses.science: करके शिवका स्मरण करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जयोपाश्रितसंरक्षासंविधानपटीयसि । जयोन्मूलितसंसारविषवृक्षाङ्कुरोद्गमे
verses.transliteration: jayopāśritasaṃrakṣāsaṃvidhānapaṭīyasi | jayonmūlitasaṃsāraviṣavṛkṣāṅkurodgame
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other gods saluted the lord with palms joined in reverence. In words of humility they eulogised the lord.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सत्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे वि न उततरखणड :
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma and other gods saluted the lord with palms joined in reverence. In words of humility they eulogised the lord.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सत्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे वि न उततरखणड :। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रादेशिकैश्वर्यवीर्यशौर्यविजृम्भण । जय विश्वबहिर्भूत निरस्तपरवैभव
verses.transliteration: jaya prādeśikaiśvaryavīryaśauryavijṛmbhaṇa | jaya viśvabahirbhūta nirastaparavaibhava
verses.translation: O Siva, O lord of the gods of the distressed and the helpless, O great lord, be merciful, forgive our guilt.
verses.hindi: कर्मवर्णन नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, O lord of the gods of the distressed and the helpless, O great lord, be merciful, forgive our guilt.
verses.science: कर्मवर्णन नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रणीतपञ्चार्थप्रयोगपरमामृत । जय पञ्चार्थविज्ञानसुधास्रोतःस्वरूपिणि
verses.transliteration: jaya praṇītapañcārthaprayogaparamāmṛta | jaya pañcārthavijñānasudhāsrotaḥsvarūpiṇi
verses.translation: O protector of sacrifices, O lord of sacrifices, O destroyer of sacrifices, O MaheSana, forgive our guilt.
verses.commentary: Sense: O protector of sacrifices, O lord of sacrifices, O destroyer of sacrifices, O MaheSana, forgive our guilt.
