verses.science: शरीरका सेचन करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: जयातिघोरसंसारमहारोगभिषग्वर । जयानादिमलाज्ञानतमःपटलचन्द्रिके
verses.transliteration: jayātighorasaṃsāramahārogabhiṣagvara | jayānādimalājñānatamaḥpaṭalacandrike
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, O great lord, O nourisher of the vital breath of your devotees, O lord, bestower of punish¬ ment on the wicked, be merciful. Obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the gods, O great lord, O nourisher of the vital breath of your devotees, O lord, bestower of punish¬ ment on the wicked, be merciful. Obeisance be to you.
verses.science: विस्तृतविधिसे न्‍्यासकर्म करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: जय त्रिपुरकालाग्ने जय त्रिपुरभैरवि । जय त्रिगुणनिर्मुक्ते जय त्रिगुणमर्दिनि
verses.transliteration: jaya tripurakālāgne jaya tripurabhairavi | jaya triguṇanirmukte jaya triguṇamardini
verses.translation: O lord, you remove the arrogance of the wicked who do not know you. You arc the protector of the good whose minds are devoted to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you remove the arrogance of the wicked who do not know you. You arc the protector of the good whose minds are devoted to you.
verses.science: कलाओंका न्यास करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रथमसर्वज्ञ जय सर्वप्रबोधिके । जय प्रचुरदिव्याङ्ग जय प्रार्थितदायिनि
verses.transliteration: jaya prathamasarvajña jaya sarvaprabodhike | jaya pracuradivyāṅga jaya prārthitadāyini
verses.translation: Siva favourably disposed to the distressed blessed Brahma and other gods and delightedly granted them boons.
verses.hindi: नित्य-नैमित्तिककर्मवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva favourably disposed to the distressed blessed Brahma and other gods and delightedly granted them boons.
verses.science: नित्य-नैमित्तिककर्मवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्व देव ते परं धाम क्व च तुच्छं च नो वचः । तथापि भगवन् भक्त्या प्रलपन्तं क्षमस्व माम्
verses.transliteration: kva deva te paraṃ dhāma kva ca tucchaṃ ca no vacaḥ | tathāpi bhagavan bhaktyā pralapantaṃ kṣamasva mām
verses.translation: Then the merciful lord who made their fear subside addressed the gods who had sought refuge in him, with words characterised by smile.
verses.hindi: है पप्ड हि आसनकी कल्पना करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the merciful lord who made their fear subside addressed the gods who had sought refuge in him, with words characterised by smile.
verses.science: है पप्ड हि आसनकी कल्पना करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाप्यैवंविधैः सूक्तैर्विश्वकर्मा चतुर्मुखः । नमश्चकार रुद्राय रद्राण्यै च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vijñāpyaivaṃvidhaiḥ sūktairviśvakarmā caturmukhaḥ | namaścakāra rudrāya radrāṇyai ca muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing you all seeking refuge in me your entire guilt and sin committed as if urged by fate, has been excused by us.
verses.hindi: षड्विंशकाभिधानां वा श्रीकंठाख्यामथापि वा॥ १८ षड्विंशका अथवा “श्रीकण्ठ' हो
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing you all seeking refuge in me your entire guilt and sin committed as if urged by fate, has been excused by us.
verses.science: षड्विंशकाभिधानां वा श्रीकंठाख्यामथापि वा॥ १८ षड्विंशका अथवा “श्रीकण्ठ' हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं स्तोत्रवरं पुण्यं ब्रह्मणा समुदीरितम् । अर्द्धनारीश्वरं नाम शिवयोर्हर्षवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ stotravaraṃ puṇyaṃ brahmaṇā samudīritam | arddhanārīśvaraṃ nāma śivayorharṣavarddhanam
verses.translation: O gods headed by Visnu, Brahma and Indra return happily to Devapura* unmindful of the present suppression and without the sense of shame in your minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gods headed by Visnu, Brahma and Indra return happily to Devapura* unmindful of the present suppression and without the sense of shame in your minds.
verses.science: व्याख्यानवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्त्तयेद्भक्त्या यस्य कस्यापि काङ्क्षया । स तत्फलमवाप्नोति शिवयोः प्रीतिकारणात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ kīrttayedbhaktyā yasya kasyāpi kāṅkṣayā | sa tatphalamavāpnoti śivayoḥ prītikāraṇāt
verses.translation: Saying this to the gods lord Siva the destroyer of jthe sacrifice performed by Daksa, along with Siva, his attendants and followers disappeared even as he stood in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying this to the gods lord Siva the destroyer of jthe sacrifice performed by Daksa, along with Siva, his attendants and followers disappeared even as he stood in the firmament.
verses.science: नामक तेईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सकलभुवनभूतभावनाभ्यां जननविनाशविहीनविग्रहाभ्याम् । नरवरयुवतीवपुर्द्धराभ्यां सततमहं प्रणतोऽस्मि शङ्कराभ्याम्
verses.transliteration: sakalabhuvanabhūtabhāvanābhyāṃ jananavināśavihīnavigrahābhyām | naravarayuvatīvapurddharābhyāṃ satatamahaṃ praṇato'smi śaṅkarābhyām
verses.translation: The gods loo returned through the aerial path, free
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods loo returned through the aerial path, free
verses.science: वहां फूल बिखेरे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: In the morning when the sun rises, the mountain embellished with jewels and gems appears to be eager for observing the beauty of his body in a mirror.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the morning when the sun rises, the mountain embellished with jewels and gems appears to be eager for observing the beauty of his body in a mirror.
verses.science: मुद्राएँ बाँधकर दिखाये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: In the morning when the sun rises, the mountain embellished with jewels and gems appears to be eager for observing the beauty of his body in a mirror.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the morning when the sun rises, the mountain embellished with jewels and gems appears to be eager for observing the beauty of his body in a mirror.
verses.science: शब्द और मंगलपाठ करे। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । देवीशक्त्युद्भवः । वायुरुवाच । अथ देवो महादेवो महाजलदनादया । वाचा मधुरगम्भीरशिवदश्लक्ष्णवर्णया
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.16. ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ | devīśaktyudbhavaḥ | vāyuruvāca | atha devo mahādevo mahājaladanādayā | vācā madhuragambhīraśivadaślakṣṇavarṇayā
verses.translation: This king of mountains appears to be honoured with benedictions of victory by the trees that seem to be sages with the twining growths of creepers for the matted hair; through the chirping of vociferous birds, by extending their arms in the form of creepers shaken by the breeze and shedding flowers and tender sprouts.
verses.hindi: संस्नाप्यालिप्य पिष्टाद्ये: स्नापयेदुष्णवारिभि: ॥ ४९ जलसे शिवलिंगको नहलाये
verses.wordMeaning: This king of mountains appears to be honoured with benedictions of victory by the trees that seem to be sages with the twining growths of creepers for the matted hair; through the chirping of vociferous birds,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This king of mountains appears to be honoured with benedictions of victory by the trees that seem to be sages with the twining growths of creepers for the matted hair; through the chirping of vociferous birds,…
verses.science: संस्नाप्यालिप्य पिष्टाद्ये: स्नापयेदुष्णवारिभि: ॥ ४९ जलसे शिवलिंगको नहलाये। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्थसम्पन्नपदया राजलक्षणयुक्तया । अशेषविषयारम्भरक्षाविमलयदक्षया
verses.transliteration: arthasampannapadayā rājalakṣaṇayuktayā | aśeṣaviṣayārambharakṣāvimalayadakṣayā
verses.translation: "If my lord has no pleasure in my complexion Imw is it that I have been held up here so long.
verses.commentary: Sense: "If my lord has no pleasure in my complexion Imw is it that I have been held up here so long.
verses.science: सफलतामें भक्ति ही कारण है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरतरोदारमधुरस्मितपूर्वया । सम्बभाषेसुसम्प्रीतो विश्वकर्माणमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: manoharatarodāramadhurasmitapūrvayā | sambabhāṣesusamprīto viśvakarmāṇamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: That purpose ere long will be revealed to you." On hearing this the goddess, remembered the remark that caused her annoyance and said.
verses.hindi: करता है तो उसे मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: That purpose ere long will be revealed to you." On hearing this the goddess, remembered the remark that caused her annoyance and said.
verses.science: करता है तो उसे मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । वत्स वत्स महाभाग मम पुत्र पितामह । ज्ञातमेव मया सर्वं तव वाक्यस्य गौरवम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | vatsa vatsa mahābhāga mama putra pitāmaha | jñātameva mayā sarvaṃ tava vākyasya gauravam
verses.translation: Even an auspicious lady of a noble family who does not abandon her life incurs the displeasure of her husband and is held despicable by good men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even an auspicious lady of a noble family who does not abandon her life incurs the displeasure of her husband and is held despicable by good men.
verses.science: शिवका पूजन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानामेव वृद्ध्यर्थं तपस्तप्तं त्वयाधुना । तपसानेन तुष्टोऽस्मि ददामि च तवेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: prajānāmeva vṛddhyarthaṃ tapastaptaṃ tvayādhunā | tapasānena tuṣṭo'smi dadāmi ca tavepsitam
verses.translation: I do not wish to have any other colour either at your will or at my choice. I shall propitiate Brahma by penance and become Gauri.
verses.hindi: आदिके। द्वारा मनुष्य मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: I do not wish to have any other colour either at your will or at my choice. I shall propitiate Brahma by penance and become Gauri.
verses.science: आदिके। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा परमोदारं स्वभावमधुरं वचः । ससर्ज वपुषो भागाद्देवीं देववरो हरः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā paramodāraṃ svabhāvamadhuraṃ vacaḥ | sasarja vapuṣo bhāgāddevīṃ devavaro haraḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, Brahma attained his status formerly by my grace. What will you do by invoking him through your pen?'nce?
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, Brahma attained his status formerly by my grace. What will you do by invoking him through your pen?'nce?
verses.science: : दीर्घकालतक भ्रमण करता रहंतां है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुर्ब्रह्मविद्वांसो देवीं दिव्यगुणान्विताम् । परस्य परमां शक्तिं भवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yāmāhurbrahmavidvāṃso devīṃ divyaguṇānvitām | parasya paramāṃ śaktiṃ bhavasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: True that Brahma and other gods acquired their status only from you. Still at your bidding I propitiated Brahma formerly and in the name of Sati I became Dakfa's daughter and attained you, the lord of the worlds, as my husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: True that Brahma and other gods acquired their status only from you. Still at your bidding I propitiated Brahma formerly and in the name of Sati I became Dakfa's daughter and attained you, the lord of the worlds, as my husband.
verses.science: आदाय चाष्टपुष्पाणि पूजामथ समापयेत्॥ ३५ करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्यां न खलु विद्यन्ते जन्ममृत्युजरादयः । या भवानी भवस्याङ्गात्समाविरभवत्किल
verses.transliteration: yasyāṃ na khalu vidyante janmamṛtyujarādayaḥ | yā bhavānī bhavasyāṅgātsamāvirabhavatkila
verses.translation: Thus replied to by the goddess, Siva did not insist on his point as he desired to carry out the task of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus replied to by the goddess, Siva did not insist on his point as he desired to carry out the task of the gods.
verses.science: नामक छब्बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्या वाचो निवर्तन्ते मनसा चेन्द्रियैः सह । सा भर्तुर्वपुषो भागाज्जातेव समदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: yasyā vāco nivartante manasā cendriyaiḥ saha | sā bharturvapuṣo bhāgājjāteva samadṛśyata
verses.translation: Then circumambulating the lord and restraining the pangs of separation she went to the mountain Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then circumambulating the lord and restraining the pangs of separation she went to the mountain Himavat.
verses.science: करके होमकर्म आरम्भ करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: या सा जगदिदं कृत्स्नं महिम्ना व्याप्य तिष्ठति । शरीरिणीव स देवी विचित्रं समलक्ष्यत
verses.transliteration: yā sā jagadidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ mahimnā vyāpya tiṣṭhati | śarīriṇīva sa devī vicitraṃ samalakṣyata
verses.translation: With the various peaks.some facing down, some shooting up and some projecting sideways he appears to jump into the nether worlds, jump up from the ground, fly through the sky in all directions. Through the vast caves he appears to have kept his mouth gaping. He appears to see the universe and dance continuously. His beauty never fades nor wears out. He appears to stretch himself to devour the universe, to drink the ocean; to vomit the darkness within and to cover up the sky with clouds.
verses.wordMeaning: With the various peaks.some facing down, some shooting up and some projecting sideways he appears to jump into the nether worlds, jump up from the ground, fly through the sky in all directions. Through the vast caves he appears to have kept his mouth gaping.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the various peaks.some facing down, some shooting up and some projecting sideways he appears to jump into the nether worlds, jump up from the ground, fly through the sky in all directions. Through the vast caves he appears to have kept his mouth gaping.…
verses.science: आदेशसे सब कुछ करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं जगदिदं चैषा सम्मोहयति मायया । ईश्वरात्सैव जाताऽभूदजाता परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ caiṣā sammohayati māyayā | īśvarātsaiva jātā'bhūdajātā paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: The different abodes have mirror-like surface. The tall shady trees in the hermitages set the blazing sunshine at nought.
verses.commentary: Sense: The different abodes have mirror-like surface. The tall shady trees in the hermitages set the blazing sunshine at nought.
verses.science: ही उपयोग होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न यस्याः परमो भावः सुराणामपि गोचरः । विश्वामरेश्वरी चैव विभक्ता भर्तुरङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: na yasyāḥ paramo bhāvaḥ surāṇāmapi gocaraḥ | viśvāmareśvarī caiva vibhaktā bharturaṅgataḥ
verses.translation: The breezes made cool by their contact with the rivers, tanks and lakes are rendered fruitful by Siva and Siva who roam here and there and enjoy them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The breezes made cool by their contact with the rivers, tanks and lakes are rendered fruitful by Siva and Siva who roam here and there and enjoy them.
verses.science: बीचमें स्थापित करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा परमेशानीं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरीम् । सर्वज्ञां सर्वगां सूक्ष्मां सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśānīṃ sarvalokamaheśvarīm | sarvajñāṃ sarvagāṃ sūkṣmāṃ sadasadvyaktivarjitām
verses.translation: Reaching the garden there along with the goddess, lord iSiva sported about in the divine harem grounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reaching the garden there along with the goddess, lord iSiva sported about in the divine harem grounds.
verses.science: कार्यका विनयपूर्वक विज्ञापन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: परमां निखिलं भासा भासयन्तीमिदं जगत् । प्रणिपत्य महादेवीं प्रार्थयामास वै विराट्
verses.transliteration: paramāṃ nikhilaṃ bhāsā bhāsayantīmidaṃ jagat | praṇipatya mahādevīṃ prārthayāmāsa vai virāṭ
verses.translation: As time elapsed and population increased, two demons were born. They were two brothers Sumbha and Niumbha.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्त सातवा- ललए नाम चतुर्विशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: As time elapsed and population increased, two demons were born. They were two brothers Sumbha and Niumbha.
verses.science: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्त सातवा- ललए नाम चतुर्विशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । देवि देवेन सृष्टोऽहमादौ सर्वजगन्मयि । प्रजासर्गे नियुक्तश्च सृजामि सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | devi devena sṛṣṭo'hamādau sarvajaganmayi | prajāsarge niyuktaśca sṛjāmi sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: As a result of the power of their penance Brahma granted them the boon that they would not be killed by any man in the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of the power of their penance Brahma granted them the boon that they would not be killed by any man in the universe.
verses.science: संक्षेपमें ही कहूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनसा निर्मिताः सर्वे देवि देवादयो मया । न वृद्धिमुपगच्छन्ति सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: manasā nirmitāḥ sarve devi devādayo mayā | na vṛddhimupagacchanti sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma vas requested by them thus — "Our death may take place in a battle with the lady with whom we fall passionately in love. She shall be a virgin born of Siva's part, not from any womb. She should not have ex¬ perienced the sexual contact with any man. Her exploit shall be unthwartable." Brahma had consented to their request.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma vas requested by them thus — "Our death may take place in a battle with the lady with whom we fall passionately in love. She shall be a virgin born of Siva's part, not from any womb. She should not have ex¬ perienced the sexual contact with any man.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma vas requested by them thus — "Our death may take place in a battle with the lady with whom we fall passionately in love. She shall be a virgin born of Siva's part, not from any womb. She should not have ex¬ perienced the sexual contact with any man.…
verses.science: अस्त्रपर्यन्तका पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मिथुनप्रभवामेव कृत्वा सृष्टिमतः परम् । संवर्धयितुमिच्छामि सर्वा एव मम प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: mithunaprabhavāmeva kṛtvā sṛṣṭimataḥ param | saṃvardhayitumicchāmi sarvā eva mama prajāḥ
verses.translation: Ever since, the two demons wrought havoc in the universe. They defeated Indra and other gods in war. They abolished the study of the Vedas and offering to the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since, the two demons wrought havoc in the universe. They defeated Indra and other gods in war. They abolished the study of the Vedas and offering to the gods.
verses.science: लिये अभीष्ट हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न निर्गतं पुरा त्वत्तो नारीणां कुलमव्ययम् । तेन नारीकुलं स्रष्टुं शक्तिर्मम न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: na nirgataṃ purā tvatto nārīṇāṃ kulamavyayam | tena nārīkulaṃ sraṣṭuṃ śaktirmama na vidyate
verses.translation: Then Brahma requested Siva, the lord of the gods for killing them — "It behoves you to bestow on the gods the goddess who will kill l§umbha and Nisumbha. She shall be the Sakti born of the sheath of Siva's colour. She shall be in the form of a virgin devoid of passion. By rebuking her secretly or by infuriating her this shall be arranged.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma requested Siva, the lord of the gods for killing them — "It behoves you to bestow on the gods the goddess who will kill l§umbha and Nisumbha. She shall be the Sakti born of the sheath of Siva's colour. She shall be in the form of a virgin devoid of passion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma requested Siva, the lord of the gods for killing them — "It behoves you to bestow on the gods the goddess who will kill l§umbha and Nisumbha. She shall be the Sakti born of the sheath of Siva's colour. She shall be in the form of a virgin devoid of passion.…
verses.science: शंकरको अर्पित करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां त्वत्तः खलु समुद्भवः । तस्मात्सर्वत्र सर्वेषां सर्वशक्तिप्रदायिनीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ tvattaḥ khalu samudbhavaḥ | tasmātsarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvaśaktipradāyinīm
verses.translation: Thui icquested by Brahma, the lord Nilalohita called Kali in secret outwardly rebuking her while smiling within. The goddess Kali was angry by her allusion to the colour. Derisively and forcibly she spoke to her husband thus.
verses.hindi: दरवाजेके फाटक सोनेके बने हुए हों
verses.commentary: Sense: Thui icquested by Brahma, the lord Nilalohita called Kali in secret outwardly rebuking her while smiling within. The goddess Kali was angry by her allusion to the colour. Derisively and forcibly she spoke to her husband thus.
verses.science: दरवाजेके फाटक सोनेके बने हुए हों। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेव वरदां मायां प्रार्थयामि सुरेश्वरीम् । चराचरविवृद्ध्यर्थमंशेनैकेन सर्वगे
verses.transliteration: tvāmeva varadāṃ māyāṃ prārthayāmi sureśvarīm | carācaravivṛddhyarthamaṃśenaikena sarvage
verses.translation: The life of the lady most beautiful in limbs is in vain though she may possess all other qualities if her husband is not delighted with her.
verses.hindi: उसे शिवका पूजन नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: The life of the lady most beautiful in limbs is in vain though she may possess all other qualities if her husband is not delighted with her.
verses.science: उसे शिवका पूजन नहीं करना चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य मम पुत्रस्य पुत्री भव भवार्दिनि । एवं सा याचिता देवी ब्रह्मणा ब्रह्मयोनिना
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya mama putrasya putrī bhava bhavārdini | evaṃ sā yācitā devī brahmaṇā brahmayoninā
verses.translation: The creation of women rests solely in the enjoyment of her husband. That being the case, where can a woman who is contrary to that be used?
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of women rests solely in the enjoyment of her husband. That being the case, where can a woman who is contrary to that be used?
verses.science: कल्याण प्राप्त करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिमेकां भ्रुवोर्मध्यात् ससर्जात्मसमप्रभाम् । तामाह प्रहसन् प्रेक्ष्य देवदेववरो हरः
verses.transliteration: śaktimekāṃ bhruvormadhyāt sasarjātmasamaprabhām | tāmāha prahasan prekṣya devadevavaro haraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, eschewing this colour censured by you in secret I shall attain another colour or I shall cease to exist myself."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, eschewing this colour censured by you in secret I shall attain another colour or I shall cease to exist myself."
verses.science: बेदे: शास्त्रेवेंदविद्धिर्विचार्य सुविनिश्चितम्॥ ६५ किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं तपसाराध्य कुरु तस्य यथेप्सितम् । तामाज्ञां परमेशस्य शिरसा प्रतिगृह्य सा
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ tapasārādhya kuru tasya yathepsitam | tāmājñāṃ parameśasya śirasā pratigṛhya sā
verses.translation: After saying this she stood up from the bed. Bent upon ijenance she requested for the permission of her lord in words choked with emotion.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवशास्त्रेक्तए॒जनवर्णन नाम पञ्मविंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this she stood up from the bed. Bent upon ijenance she requested for the permission of her lord in words choked with emotion.
verses.science: इति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवशास्त्रेक्तए॒जनवर्णन नाम पञ्मविंशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो वचनाद्देवी दक्षस्य दुहिताऽभवत् । दत्त्वैवमतुलां शक्तिं ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo vacanāddevī dakṣasya duhitā'bhavat | dattvaivamatulāṃ śaktiṃ brahmaṇe brahmarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: Then lord Siva, afraid of a rupture in love, replied to her falling at her feet.
verses.hindi: पूजनवर्णन नामक पचीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Siva, afraid of a rupture in love, replied to her falling at her feet.
verses.science: पूजनवर्णन नामक पचीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: विवेश देहं देवस्य देवश्चान्तरधीयत । तदाप्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन् स्त्रियां भोगः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: viveśa dehaṃ devasya devaścāntaradhīyata | tadāprabhṛti loke'smin striyāṃ bhogaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: "O beloved, why are you angry with me, not know¬ ing that this was only a jocular remark of mine. If I am not delighted with you, where else can I seek delight?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O beloved, why are you angry with me, not know¬ ing that this was only a jocular remark of mine. If I am not delighted with you, where else can I seek delight?
verses.science: सुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजासृष्टिश्च विप्रेन्द्रा मैथुनेन प्रवर्तते । ब्रह्मापि प्राप सानन्दं सन्तोषं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: prajāsṛṣṭiśca viprendrā maithunena pravartate | brahmāpi prāpa sānandaṃ santoṣaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: If I am not delighted with you how can it be proper since you are mother of this universe and I am its father and lord?
verses.commentary: Sense: If I am not delighted with you how can it be proper since you are mother of this universe and I am its father and lord?
verses.science: सानिध्य नहीं हो सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं देव्याः शक्तिसमुद्भवम् । पुण्यवृद्धिकरं श्राव्यं भूतसर्गानुषङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ devyāḥ śaktisamudbhavam | puṇyavṛddhikaraṃ śrāvyaṃ bhūtasargānuṣaṅgataḥ
verses.translation: Is our mutual love generated by Kama? Even before the birth of Kama the universe existed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Is our mutual love generated by Kama? Even before the birth of Kama the universe existed.
verses.science: गौरबवश शिवधामको चला जाता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्तयेन्नित्यं देव्याः शक्तिसमुद्भवम् । पुण्यं सर्वमवाप्नोति पुत्रांश्च लभते शुभान्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ kīrtayennityaṃ devyāḥ śaktisamudbhavam | puṇyaṃ sarvamavāpnoti putrāṃśca labhate śubhān
verses.translation: The mind- born Kama considered me on a par with the gods. While he attempted to tease me I reduced him to ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind- born Kama considered me on a par with the gods. While he attempted to tease me I reduced him to ashes.
verses.science: बराबर नहीं हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics. She performed the very difficult penance. She meditated upon the lotus-like feet of her lord. She conceived the same in Siva's external phallic emblem in accordance with the injunctions. In the three junctions of time every day she worshipped the same with the flowers and fruits of the forest. Thinking thus — "He alone, after assuming the form of Brahma, will grant me the fruit of this penance", she conducted the penance.
verses.wordMeaning: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics.…
verses.science: हाथीके अधरोष्ठके समान हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics. She performed the very difficult penance. She meditated upon the lotus-like feet of her lord. She conceived the same in Siva's external phallic emblem in accordance with the injunctions. In the three junctions of time every day she worshipped the same with the flowers and fruits of the forest. Thinking thus — "He alone, after assuming the form of Brahma, will grant me the fruit of this penance", she conducted the penance.
verses.wordMeaning: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics.…
verses.science: मिट्टी या बालूकी होनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । सृष्टिकथनम् । वायुरुवाच । एवं लब्ध्वा परां शक्तिमीश्वरादेव शाश्वतीम् । मैथुनप्रभवां सृष्टिं कर्तृकामः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.17. saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ | sṛṣṭikathanam | vāyuruvāca | evaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śaktimīśvarādeva śāśvatīm | maithunaprabhavāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kartṛkāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: After some time had elapsed, seeing her performing the penance a huge tiger approached her with wicked inten¬ tion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After some time had elapsed, seeing her performing the penance a huge tiger approached her with wicked inten¬ tion.
verses.science: सब प्रकारके द्र॒व्योंका संग्रह करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमप्यर्द्धतो नारी चार्द्धेन पुरुषोऽभवत् । यार्द्धेन नारी सा तस्माच्छतरूपा व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: svayamapyarddhato nārī cārddhena puruṣo'bhavat | yārddhena nārī sā tasmācchatarūpā vyajāyata
verses.translation: On seeing that Brahma had come along with the gods, the goddess offered him Arghya and received him with words of welcome.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Brahma had come along with the gods, the goddess offered him Arghya and received him with words of welcome.
verses.science: शिवशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण नैमित्तिकविधिक्रमम्॥ १ नैमित्तिकविधिक्रमका वर्णन करूँगा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विराजमसृजद्ब्रह्मा सोऽर्द्धेन पुरुषोऽभवत् । स वै स्वायम्भुवः पूर्वं पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: virājamasṛjadbrahmā so'rddhena puruṣo'bhavat | sa vai svāyambhuvaḥ pūrvaṃ puruṣo manurucyate
verses.translation: Thus requested by Brahma, the goddess, daughter of the mountain, cast off her outer skin and became white.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by Brahma, the goddess, daughter of the mountain, cast off her outer skin and became white.
verses.science: ३ आठ दिशाओंमें क्रमशः पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सा देवी शतरूपा तु तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम् । भर्त्तारं दीप्तयशसं मनुमेवान्वपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sā devī śatarūpā tu tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram | bharttāraṃ dīptayaśasaṃ manumevānvapadyata
verses.translation: I wish to return with my friends keeping him ahead. I seek permission from you the lord of the subjects.
verses.hindi: वैत्तशाल्यं न कुर्वीत भक्तिमान्विभवे सति॥ ८ ९ कंजूसी में करे
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to return with my friends keeping him ahead. I seek permission from you the lord of the subjects.
verses.science: वैत्तशाल्यं न कुर्वीत भक्तिमान्विभवे सति॥ ८ ९ कंजूसी में करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तु शतरूपा सा पुत्रद्वयमसूयत । प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ
verses.transliteration: tasmāttu śatarūpā sā putradvayamasūyata | priyavratottānapādau putrau putravatāṃ varau
verses.translation: For the functioning of the universe you assume some form or other and play about in different aspects. Who knows you factually?
verses.hindi: समता नहीं है; आपकी जय हो, जय हो
verses.commentary: Sense: For the functioning of the universe you assume some form or other and play about in different aspects. Who knows you factually?
verses.science: समता नहीं है; आपकी जय हो, जय हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कन्ये द्वे च महाभागे याभ्यां जातास्त्विमाः प्रजाः । आकूतिरेका विज्ञेया प्रसूतिरपरा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: kanye dve ca mahābhāge yābhyāṃ jātāstvimāḥ prajāḥ | ākūtirekā vijñeyā prasūtiraparā smṛtā
verses.translation: I am not creating and re-creating this universe merely by rny activity since everything gets evolved through command or behest. You arc the great command.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am not creating and re-creating this universe merely by rny activity since everything gets evolved through command or behest. You arc the great command.
verses.science: मेरी कामना सफल करें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवः प्रसूतिं च ददौ दक्षाय तां प्रभुः । रुचेः प्रजापतेश्चैव चाकूतिं समपादयत्
verses.transliteration: svāyambhuvaḥ prasūtiṃ ca dadau dakṣāya tāṃ prabhuḥ | ruceḥ prajāpateścaiva cākūtiṃ samapādayat
verses.translation: On seeing him the goddess spoke again — "O lord, see this tiger. There is no other devotee of mine like him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him the goddess spoke again — "O lord, see this tiger. There is no other devotee of mine like him.
verses.science: ही मेरी मन:कामना पूर्ण करें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आकूत्यां मिथुनं जज्ञे मानसस्य रुचेः शुभम् । यज्ञश्च दक्षिणा चैव याभ्यां संवर्तितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe mānasasya ruceḥ śubham | yajñaśca dakṣiṇā caiva yābhyāṃ saṃvartitaṃ jagat
verses.translation: My penance-grove was guarded by him from wicked hosts. He is greatly devoted to me. In view of his protecting me he is trustworthy. He has left his native place and come here for your favour. If you are pleased with him and if you love me, O god, let him stay at the door of the harem along with the other guards and under the charge of Nandin himself."
verses.wordMeaning: My penance-grove was guarded by him from wicked hosts. He is greatly devoted to me. In view of his protecting me he is trustworthy. He has left his native place and come here for your favour. If you are pleased with him and if you love me, O god,…
verses.commentary: Sense: My penance-grove was guarded by him from wicked hosts. He is greatly devoted to me. In view of his protecting me he is trustworthy. He has left his native place and come here for your favour. If you are pleased with him and if you love me, O god,…
verses.science: मनोवांछित वस्तु प्रदान करें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवसुतायां तु प्रसूत्यां लोकमातरः । चतस्रो विंशतिः कन्या दक्षस्त्वजनयत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: svāyambhuvasutāyāṃ tu prasūtyāṃ lokamātaraḥ | catasro viṃśatiḥ kanyā dakṣastvajanayatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the auspicious, loving and sweet words of the goddess the lord said to him "I am pleased". Immediately he was seen like Ganesa wearing the dress and features of a watchman, holding the cane made of gold and a dagger of serpentine lustre and wearing a bodice set with various gems.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the auspicious, loving and sweet words of the goddess the lord said to him "I am pleased". Immediately he was seen like Ganesa wearing the dress and features of a watchman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the auspicious, loving and sweet words of the goddess the lord said to him "I am pleased". Immediately he was seen like Ganesa wearing the dress and features of a watchman,…
verses.science: वस्तु प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीर्धृतिः पुष्टिस्तुष्टिर्मेधा क्रिया तथा । बुद्धिर्लज्जा वपुः शान्तिस्सिद्धिः कीर्तिस्त्रयोदशी
verses.transliteration: śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā | buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntissiddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśī
verses.translation: The body of that animal of wicked soul became stiff and benumbed when he approached her.
verses.hindi: अग्निमें मण्डलाकार होकर लीन हुए हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The body of that animal of wicked soul became stiff and benumbed when he approached her.
verses.science: अग्निमें मण्डलाकार होकर लीन हुए हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पत्न्यर्थं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः प्रभुः । ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: patnyarthaṃ pratijagrāha dharmo dākṣāyaṇīḥ prabhuḥ | tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīyasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ
verses.translation: Even after seeing the tiger that approached her with wicked intention the goddess did not turn away from her pious thoughts like ordinary people.
verses.hindi: देनेके पश्चात् अग्निमें जलका सेचन करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after seeing the tiger that approached her with wicked intention the goddess did not turn away from her pious thoughts like ordinary people.
verses.science: देनेके पश्चात् अग्निमें जलका सेचन करे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिः सत्यथ सम्भूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा । सन्नतिश्चानसूया च ऊर्जा स्वाहा स्वधा तथा
verses.transliteration: khyātiḥ satyatha sambhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā | sannatiścānasūyā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā
verses.translation: The animal with his body stunned and overwhelmed with hunger, stood there in front of her glancing perpetually at the goddess and thought, "My prey is nothing else.*' Virtually this became his cherished goal.
verses.hindi: जौके तुल्य घीकी धाराकी आहुति दे
verses.commentary: Sense: The animal with his body stunned and overwhelmed with hunger, stood there in front of her glancing perpetually at the goddess and thought, "My prey is nothing else.*' Virtually this became his cherished goal.
verses.science: जौके तुल्य घीकी धाराकी आहुति दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भृगुः शर्वो मरीचिश्च अङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः । पुलस्त्योऽत्रिर्वशिष्ठश्च पावकः पितरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhṛguḥ śarvo marīciśca aṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | pulastyo'trirvaśiṣṭhaśca pāvakaḥ pitarastathā
verses.translation: By this feeling of mercy the threefold dirt of the tiger perished and he realised the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: By this feeling of mercy the threefold dirt of the tiger perished and he realised the goddess.
verses.science: और चन्द्रमाका मुकुट है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ख्यात्याद्या जगृहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः । कामाद्यास्तु यशोऽन्ता ये ते त्रयोदश सूनवः
verses.transliteration: khyātyādyā jagṛhuḥ kanyā munayo munisattamāḥ | kāmādyāstu yaśo'ntā ye te trayodaśa sūnavaḥ
verses.translation: His hunger receded. The benumbed stiflhess subsided. His congenital wickedness disappeared. Content¬ ment set in.
verses.commentary: Sense: His hunger receded. The benumbed stiflhess subsided. His congenital wickedness disappeared. Content¬ ment set in.
verses.science: चण्डका अधिकार हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्य जज्ञिरे तास्तु श्रद्धाद्याः सुसुखोत्तराः । दुःखोत्तराश्च हिंसायामधर्मस्य च सन्ततौ
verses.transliteration: dharmasya jajñire tāstu śraddhādyāḥ susukhottarāḥ | duḥkhottarāśca hiṃsāyāmadharmasya ca santatau
verses.translation: Realising his contentment with great piety he waited upon the goddess as a sudden devotee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising his contentment with great piety he waited upon the goddess as a sudden devotee.
verses.science: सुखपूर्वक शुद्ध अन्न भोजन करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: निकृत्यादय उत्पन्नाः पुत्राश्च धर्मलक्षणाः । नैषां भार्याश्च पुत्रा वा सर्वे त्वनियमाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: nikṛtyādaya utpannāḥ putrāśca dharmalakṣaṇāḥ | naiṣāṃ bhāryāśca putrā vā sarve tvaniyamāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He roamed about the penance-grove as a router of wicked animals and wicked souls.
verses.hindi: पुरुष 'मैं ही शिव हूँ” ऐसी बुद्धि न करे
verses.commentary: Sense: He roamed about the penance-grove as a router of wicked animals and wicked souls.
verses.science: पुरुष 'मैं ही शिव हूँ” ऐसी बुद्धि न करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स एष तामसः सर्गो जज्ञे धर्मनियामकः । या सा दक्षस्य दुहिता रुद्रस्य दयिता सती
verses.transliteration: sa eṣa tāmasaḥ sargo jajñe dharmaniyāmakaḥ | yā sā dakṣasya duhitā rudrasya dayitā satī
verses.translation: The penance of the goddess increased and became gradually acute. Meanwhile the gods sought refuge in Brahma due to the pressure of the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The penance of the goddess increased and became gradually acute. Meanwhile the gods sought refuge in Brahma due to the pressure of the Daityas.
verses.science: सुन्दर शय्या प्रस्तुत करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृनिन्दाप्रसङ्गेन त्यक्त्वा दाक्षायिणीं तनुम् । दक्षं च दक्षभार्य्यां च विनिन्द्य सह बन्धुभिः
verses.transliteration: bhartṛnindāprasaṅgena tyaktvā dākṣāyiṇīṃ tanum | dakṣaṃ ca dakṣabhāryyāṃ ca vinindya saha bandhubhiḥ
verses.translation: The gods submitted to him how 8umbha and Nisumbha inflicted pain on them due to their strength derived from the boons.
verses.hindi: हि हम 7याम॒त्तखण्डे अग्रिकार्यवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तविशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods submitted to him how 8umbha and Nisumbha inflicted pain on them due to their strength derived from the boons.
verses.science: हि हम 7याम॒त्तखण्डे अग्रिकार्यवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तविशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: सा मेनायामाविरभूत्पुत्री हिमवतो गिरेः । रुद्रस्तु तां सतीं दृष्ट्वा रुद्रांस्त्वात्मसमप्रभान्
verses.transliteration: sā menāyāmāvirabhūtputrī himavato gireḥ | rudrastu tāṃ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā rudrāṃstvātmasamaprabhān
verses.translation: Brahma saw the goddess, the mother of this universe, the mother of Trinity, the daughter of the lord of mountains, the foundation of the universe, firmly engaged in penance. On seeing her he was delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma saw the goddess, the mother of this universe, the mother of Trinity, the daughter of the lord of mountains, the foundation of the universe, firmly engaged in penance. On seeing her he was delighted.
verses.science: के सत्ताईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथाऽसृजदसङ्ख्यातांस्तथा कथितमेव च । भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीर्नारायणप्रिया
verses.transliteration: yathā'sṛjadasaṅkhyātāṃstathā kathitameva ca | bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇapriyā
verses.translation: Replying suitably and congratulating her the lotus-born Brahma asked her the purpose of her penance as though he did not know.
verses.hindi: कर्तव्या महती पूजा हाधिका वापि शक्तितः॥ ३  जा शिवकी महापूजा करनी चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Replying suitably and congratulating her the lotus-born Brahma asked her the purpose of her penance as though he did not know.
verses.science: कर्तव्या महती पूजा हाधिका वापि शक्तितः॥ ३ जा शिवकी महापूजा करनी चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवौ धातृविधातारौ मन्वन्तरविधारिणौ । तयोर्वै पुत्रपौत्राद्याः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: devau dhātṛvidhātārau manvantaravidhāriṇau | tayorvai putrapautrādyāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The fruit of the penance has been obtained by you in having obtained lord Siva as your husband, who alone is the lord of all worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fruit of the penance has been obtained by you in having obtained lord Siva as your husband, who alone is the lord of all worlds.
verses.science: मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे नीताः सर्वे ते भार्गवा मताः । मरीचेरपि सम्भूतिः पौर्णमासमसूयत
verses.transliteration: svāyambhuve'ntare nītāḥ sarve te bhārgavā matāḥ | marīcerapi sambhūtiḥ paurṇamāsamasūyata
verses.translation: When at the beginning of creation as men¬ tioned in the Vedas you are born of lord Siva you are the first of my creation, my first-born son.
verses.hindi: ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे तित्यनैमित्तिकर्वि: 225 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: When at the beginning of creation as men¬ tioned in the Vedas you are born of lord Siva you are the first of my creation, my first-born son.
verses.science: ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे तित्यनैमित्तिकर्वि: 225 ध्याय:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कन्याचतुष्टयं चैव महीयांसस्तदन्वयाः । येषां वंशे समुत्पन्नो बहुपुत्रस्य कश्यपः
verses.transliteration: kanyācatuṣṭayaṃ caiva mahīyāṃsastadanvayāḥ | yeṣāṃ vaṃśe samutpanno bahuputrasya kaśyapaḥ
verses.translation: When for multiplying the subjects, Siva was born of your forehead you became my father-in-law and so elder to me.
verses.hindi: नित्यनैमित्तिकविधिवर्णन नामक अद्डाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: When for multiplying the subjects, Siva was born of your forehead you became my father-in-law and so elder to me.
verses.science: नित्यनैमित्तिकविधिवर्णन नामक अद्डाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतिश्चाङ्गिरसः पत्नी जनयामास वै सुतौ । आग्नीध्रं शरभञ्चैव तथा कन्याचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: smṛtiścāṅgirasaḥ patnī janayāmāsa vai sutau | āgnīdhraṃ śarabhañcaiva tathā kanyācatuṣṭayam
verses.translation: When the lord of mountains, my father became your son you became my grandfather, O grandfather of the worlds!
verses.hindi: मन्द मुसकानकी छटा छा रही है
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord of mountains, my father became your son you became my grandfather, O grandfather of the worlds!
verses.science: मन्द मुसकानकी छटा छा रही है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदीयाः पुत्रपौत्राश्च येऽतीतास्ते सहस्रशः । प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यभार्यायां दन्तोऽग्निरभवत्सुतः । पूर्वजन्मनि योऽगस्त्यः स्मृतः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: tadīyāḥ putrapautrāśca ye'tītāste sahasraśaḥ | prītyāṃ pulastyabhāryāyāṃ danto'gnirabhavatsutaḥ | pūrvajanmani yo'gastyaḥ smṛtaḥ svāyambhuve'ntare
verses.translation: How can I inform you, the arranger of worldly existence what happened at the harem with my husband?
verses.hindi: पाश तथा अंकुश उनकी शोभा बढ़ाते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: How can I inform you, the arranger of worldly existence what happened at the harem with my husband?
verses.science: पाश तथा अंकुश उनकी शोभा बढ़ाते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्सन्ततीया बहवः पौलस्त्या इति विश्रुताः । क्षमा तु सुषुवे पुत्रान् पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: tatsantatīyā bahavaḥ paulastyā iti viśrutāḥ | kṣamā tu suṣuve putrān pulahasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, why did you perform a severe penance for this purpose? Was not your wish alone sufficient for that? Indeed this is only your sport
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, why did you perform a severe penance for this purpose? Was not your wish alone sufficient for that? Indeed this is only your sport
verses.science: सद्यपाद॒च॒ तम्मूर्तिमष्ठत्रिंशत्तलामयम्॥ ३२ अड़्तीस कलामयी है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्दमश्चासुरिश्चैव सहिष्णुश्चेति ते त्रयः । त्रेताग्निवर्चसः सर्वे येषां वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: kardamaścāsuriścaiva sahiṣṇuśceti te trayaḥ | tretāgnivarcasaḥ sarve yeṣāṃ vaṃśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: O mother of the universe, your play too benefits the worlds. Hence some benefit pleasing to me may be sought through it.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे काम्यकर्मवर्णन॑ नामेकोनत्रिंशत्तमो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother of the universe, your play too benefits the worlds. Hence some benefit pleasing to me may be sought through it.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे काम्यकर्मवर्णन॑ नामेकोनत्रिंशत्तमो5 ध्याय:। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रतोः क्रतुसमान्भार्या सन्नतिः सुषुवे सुतान् । नैषां भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः
verses.transliteration: kratoḥ kratusamānbhāryā sannatiḥ suṣuve sutān | naiṣāṃ bhāryāśca putrāśca sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ
verses.translation: Two Daityas, 6umbha and Nisumbha to whom I had granted boons have turned arrogant. They are harassing the gods. Their destruction is only through you.
verses.hindi: काम्यकर्मवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Daityas, 6umbha and Nisumbha to whom I had granted boons have turned arrogant. They are harassing the gods. Their destruction is only through you.
verses.science: काम्यकर्मवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिस्तानि सहस्राणि वालखिल्या इति स्मृताः । अनूरोरग्रतो यान्ति परिवार्य्य दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭistāni sahasrāṇi vālakhilyā iti smṛtāḥ | anūroragrato yānti parivāryya divākaram
verses.translation: Do not delay. For a short while be steady. The Sakti that is to be released now shall be their death.
verses.hindi: गन्धाद्यैर्चयेत् पूर्व देवों हेरंबषण्मुखो॥ ९  पजन करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Do not delay. For a short while be steady. The Sakti that is to be released now shall be their death.
verses.science: गन्धाद्यैर्चयेत् पूर्व देवों हेरंबषण्मुखो॥ ९ पजन करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेर्भार्यानसूया च पञ्चात्रेयानसूयत । कन्यकां च श्रुतिं नाम माता शङ्खपदस्य च
verses.transliteration: atrerbhāryānasūyā ca pañcātreyānasūyata | kanyakāṃ ca śrutiṃ nāma mātā śaṅkhapadasya ca
verses.translation: The outer sheath thus cast off became Kauliki who is known as Kali, the virgin with the lustre of the black cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: The outer sheath thus cast off became Kauliki who is known as Kali, the virgin with the lustre of the black cloud.
verses.science: पूजन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यनेत्रश्च हव्यश्च आपोमूर्तिः शनैश्चरः । सोमश्च पञ्चमस्त्वेते पञ्चात्रेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: satyanetraśca havyaśca āpomūrtiḥ śanaiścaraḥ | somaśca pañcamastvete pañcātreyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: She had three traits: gentle, terrible and a mixture of the two. She ha4 three eyes. She was moon-crested. She
verses.hindi: चतुर्थ आवरणका चिन्तन एवं पूजन करे
verses.commentary: Sense: She had three traits: gentle, terrible and a mixture of the two. She ha4 three eyes. She was moon-crested. She
verses.science: चतुर्थ आवरणका चिन्तन एवं पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च ह्यात्रेयाणां महात्मनाम् । स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरेऽतीताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca hyātreyāṇāṃ mahātmanām | svāyambhuve'ntare'tītāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful lion that came there, was given to her as vehicle by the delighted Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful lion that came there, was given to her as vehicle by the delighted Brahma.
verses.science: उनकी शक्तियोंकी पूजा करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जायां तु वसिष्ठस्य पुत्रा वै सप्त जज्ञिरे । ज्यायसी च स्वसा तेषां पुण्डरीका सुमध्यमा
verses.transliteration: ūrjāyāṃ tu vasiṣṭhasya putrā vai sapta jajñire | jyāyasī ca svasā teṣāṃ puṇḍarīkā sumadhyamā
verses.translation: He fixed her abode on the Vindhya mountain. He ordained her worship by the gift of meat, fish, pies and wine.
verses.commentary: Sense: He fixed her abode on the Vindhya mountain. He ordained her worship by the gift of meat, fish, pies and wine.
verses.science: पश्चिममें स्थापन-पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रजोगात्रोर्ध्वबाहू च सवनश्चानयश्च यः । सुतपाः शुक्र इत्येते सप्त सप्तर्षयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: rajogātrordhvabāhū ca savanaścānayaśca yaḥ | sutapāḥ śukra ityete sapta saptarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: That Sakti, approved of by Brahma, the creator of the universe, bowed to her mother Gauri and Brahma in due order. Surrounded by many Saktis equal to her and born of her she proceeded to the Vindhya*®' ready to slay the leading Daityas.
verses.hindi: विद्याओंका सब ओर पूजन करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: That Sakti, approved of by Brahma, the creator of the universe, bowed to her mother Gauri and Brahma in due order. Surrounded by many Saktis equal to her and born of her she proceeded to the Vindhya*®' ready to slay the leading Daityas.
verses.science: विद्याओंका सब ओर पूजन करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोत्राणि नामभिस्तेषां वासिष्ठानां महात्मनाम् । स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरेऽतीतान्यर्बुदानि शतानि च
verses.transliteration: gotrāṇi nāmabhisteṣāṃ vāsiṣṭhānāṃ mahātmanām | svāyambhuve'ntare'tītānyarbudāni śatāni ca
verses.translation: The leading Daityas were killed by her in battle, the Daityas whom the arrows of Kama pierced in the minds and her own arrows split and pierced in the bodies. That battle is not described here as it has been described elsewhere. It can be guessed through other sources as well. I shall resume the present description.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Daityas were killed by her in battle, the Daityas whom the arrows of Kama pierced in the minds and her own arrows split and pierced in the bodies. That battle is not described here as it has been described elsewhere. It can be guessed through other sources as well.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Daityas were killed by her in battle, the Daityas whom the arrows of Kama pierced in the minds and her own arrows split and pierced in the bodies. That battle is not described here as it has been described elsewhere. It can be guessed through other sources as well.…
verses.science: पश्चिममें आवरणसहित रुद्रका पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष ऋषिसर्गस्तु सानुबन्धः प्रकीर्तितः । समासाद्विस्तराद्वक्तुमशक्योऽयमिति द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa ṛṣisargastu sānubandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | samāsādvistarādvaktumaśakyo'yamiti dvijāḥ
verses.translation: After creating Kauiki and handing her over to Brahma, Gauri spoke to Brahma demanding the recompense.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating Kauiki and handing her over to Brahma, Gauri spoke to Brahma demanding the recompense.
verses.science: मूर्तियोंकी पूजा करनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: योऽसौ रुद्रात्मको वह्निब्रह्मणो मानसः सुतः । स्वाहा तस्य प्रिया लेभे पुत्रांस्त्रीनमितौजसः
verses.transliteration: yo'sau rudrātmako vahnibrahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ | svāhā tasya priyā lebhe putrāṃstrīnamitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Is this tiger that has resorted* to me seen by you? He has guarded my penance grove from wicked animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Is this tiger that has resorted* to me seen by you? He has guarded my penance grove from wicked animals.
verses.science: ही विश्वपालक 'मृड' हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पावकः पवमानश्च शुचिरित्येष ते त्रयः । निर्मन्थ्यः पवमानः स्याद्वैद्युतः पावकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śucirityeṣa te trayaḥ | nirmanthyaḥ pavamānaḥ syādvaidyutaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Dedicating his mind to me he worships me without thinking of anything else. There is nothing more pleasing to me than his protection.
verses.hindi: समध्यच्चोत्ते पाश्वें ततो बैकुंठमर्चयेत्॥ ५५  करना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: Dedicating his mind to me he worships me without thinking of anything else. There is nothing more pleasing to me than his protection.
verses.science: समध्यच्चोत्ते पाश्वें ततो बैकुंठमर्चयेत्॥ ५५ करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्ये तपति यश्चासौ शुचिः सौर उदाहृतः । हव्यवाहः कव्यवाहः सहरक्षा इति त्रयः
verses.transliteration: sūrye tapati yaścāsau śuciḥ saura udāhṛtaḥ | havyavāhaḥ kavyavāhaḥ saharakṣā iti trayaḥ
verses.translation: He shall be appointed as an official in my harem. Out of pleasure Siva will grant him the post of Ganevara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be appointed as an official in my harem. Out of pleasure Siva will grant him the post of Ganevara.
verses.science: पश्चात् पंचाक्षरमनत्रका जप करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणां क्रमशः पुत्रा देवपितृसुराश्च ते । एतेषां पुत्रपौत्राश्च चत्वारिंशन्नवैव ते
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāṃ kramaśaḥ putrā devapitṛsurāśca te | eteṣāṃ putrapautrāśca catvāriṃśannavaiva te
verses.translation: Thus addressed, Brahma smiled and told the goddess describing the lion's wicked antecedents as though the goddess was unaware.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, Brahma smiled and told the goddess describing the lion's wicked antecedents as though the goddess was unaware.
verses.science: होते, ऐसा सत्पुरुषोंका कथन है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काम्यनैमित्तिकाजस्रकर्मसु त्रिषु संस्थिताः । सर्वे तपस्विनो ज्ञेयाः सर्वे व्रतभृतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kāmyanaimittikājasrakarmasu triṣu saṃsthitāḥ | sarve tapasvino jñeyāḥ sarve vratabhṛtastathā
verses.translation: O Goddess, animals are cruel. How can your blissful thought be directed to these? Why do you sprinkle nectar in the mouth of the serpent?
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, animals are cruel. How can your blissful thought be directed to these? Why do you sprinkle nectar in the mouth of the serpent?
verses.science: सदस्योंका भी पूजन करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे रुद्रात्मकाश्चैव सर्वे रुद्रपरायणाः । तस्मादग्निमुखे यत्तद् हुतं स्यादेव केनचित्
verses.transliteration: sarve rudrātmakāścaiva sarve rudraparāyaṇāḥ | tasmādagnimukhe yattad hutaṃ syādeva kenacit
verses.translation: Why shall mercy be shown to wicked souls like this? What is the purpose served by one innately sinful?
verses.commentary: Sense: Why shall mercy be shown to wicked souls like this? What is the purpose served by one innately sinful?
verses.science: स्वयं लघुतर हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं रुद्रमुद्दिश्य दत्तं स्यान्नात्र संशयः । इत्येवं निश्चयोऽग्नीनामनुक्रान्तो यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaṃ rudramuddiśya dattaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | ityevaṃ niścayo'gnīnāmanukrānto yathātatham
verses.translation: I narrated his antecedents without realising his devotion. If there be devotion, sins are not effective? Your devotee never perishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: I narrated his antecedents without realising his devotion. If there be devotion, sins are not effective? Your devotee never perishes.
verses.science: उप इसका प्रयोग करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नातिविस्तरतो विप्राः पितृन्वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् । यस्मात्षड् ऋतवस्तेषां स्थानं स्थानाभिमानिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nātivistarato viprāḥ pitṛnvakṣyāmyataḥ param | yasmātṣaḍ ṛtavasteṣāṃ sthānaṃ sthānābhimāninām
verses.translation: What can a man of virtuous rites achieve without depending on your behest? You alone are the unborn, intelligent, ancient goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: What can a man of virtuous rites achieve without depending on your behest? You alone are the unborn, intelligent, ancient goddess.
verses.science: अपना निजी अस्त्र बताया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋतवः पितरस्तस्मादित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः । युष्माद् ऋतुषु सर्वे हि जायन्ते स्थास्नुजङ्गमाः
verses.transliteration: ṛtavaḥ pitarastasmādityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ | yuṣmād ṛtuṣu sarve hi jāyante sthāsnujaṅgamāḥ
verses.translation: You alone constitute Sakti of living beings. Him¬ self incompetent to do anything what will a mere agent do?
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone constitute Sakti of living beings. Him¬ self incompetent to do anything what will a mere agent do?
verses.science: काम्यकर्मवर्णन॑ नाम ब्रिंशो5 ध्याय:। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेते हि पितर आर्तवा इति च श्रुतम् । एवं पितॄणामेतेषामृतुकालाभिमानिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādete hi pitara ārtavā iti ca śrutam | evaṃ pitṝṇāmeteṣāmṛtukālābhimāninām
verses.translation: Innumerable Brahma, Vi§nus and Sivas have passed by. Such innumerable ones are yet to be born, these carry out your behests.
verses.hindi: शैवोंका काम्यकर्मवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: Innumerable Brahma, Vi§nus and Sivas have passed by. Such innumerable ones are yet to be born, these carry out your behests.
verses.science: शैवोंका काम्यकर्मवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैश्वर्या महात्मानस्तिष्ठन्तीहाभ्रसङ्गमात् । आग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदः पितरो द्विविधाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ātmaiśvaryā mahātmānastiṣṭhantīhābhrasaṅgamāt | āgniṣvāttā barhiṣadaḥ pitaro dvividhāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O goddess of the gods without propitiating you the fourfold arms of life cannot be acquired by all of us.
verses.hindi: पेगेश्नरपिद पुण्य कर्म येन समाप्यते॥ १  नामक पुण्यकर्म पूर्णरूपसे सम्पन्न होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess of the gods without propitiating you the fourfold arms of life cannot be acquired by all of us.
verses.science: पेगेश्नरपिद पुण्य कर्म येन समाप्यते॥ १ नामक पुण्यकर्म पूर्णरूपसे सम्पन्न होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयज्वानश्च यज्वानः क्रमात्ते गृहमेधिनः । स्वधाऽसूत पितृभ्यश्च द्वे कन्ये लोकविश्रुते
verses.transliteration: ayajvānaśca yajvānaḥ kramātte gṛhamedhinaḥ | svadhā'sūta pitṛbhyaśca dve kanye lokaviśrute
verses.translation: Since merit and evil have been established by you the mobile and immobile may even be inter-changed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since merit and evil have been established by you the mobile and immobile may even be inter-changed.
verses.science: महासागर हैं, आपकी जय हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मेनां च धरणीं चैव याभ्यां विश्वमिदं धृतम् । अग्निष्वात्तसुता मेना धरणी बर्हिषत्सुता
verses.transliteration: menāṃ ca dharaṇīṃ caiva yābhyāṃ viśvamidaṃ dhṛtam | agniṣvāttasutā menā dharaṇī barhiṣatsutā
verses.translation: You are the primordial and eternal Sakti of Siva the great soul, the lord of the universe, the Sakti without beginning, middle or death.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the primordial and eternal Sakti of Siva the great soul, the lord of the universe, the Sakti without beginning, middle or death.
verses.science: हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मेना हिमवतः पत्नी मैनाकं क्रौञ्चमेव च । गौरीं गङ्गां च सुषुवे भवाङ्गाश्लेषपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: menā himavataḥ patnī mainākaṃ krauñcameva ca | gaurīṃ gaṅgāṃ ca suṣuve bhavāṅgāśleṣapāvanīm
verses.translation: Hence let this wicked tiger too attain the great Siddhi by your blessings. Nothing can prevent it?"
verses.hindi: कोई नहीं है। आपकी जय हो, जय हो
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence let this wicked tiger too attain the great Siddhi by your blessings. Nothing can prevent it?"
verses.science: कोई नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मेरोस्तु धरणी पत्नी दिव्यौषधिसमन्वितम् । मन्दरं सुषुवे पुत्रं चित्रिसुन्दरकन्धरम्
verses.transliteration: merostu dharaṇī patnī divyauṣadhisamanvitam | mandaraṃ suṣuve putraṃ citrisundarakandharam
verses.translation: Thus requested by Brahma after duly reminding her of her great aspect the goddess ceased from her penance.
verses.hindi: जय हो। निर्मल शंकर! आपकी जय हो
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by Brahma after duly reminding her of her great aspect the goddess ceased from her penance.
verses.science: जय हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स एव मन्दरः श्रीमान्मेरुपुत्रस्तपोबलात् । साक्षाच्छ्रीकण्ठनाथस्य शिवस्यावसथं गतः
verses.transliteration: sa eva mandaraḥ śrīmānmeruputrastapobalāt | sākṣācchrīkaṇṭhanāthasya śivasyāvasathaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Then taking leave of the goddess Brahma vanished. The goddess visited her parents Mena, Himavat. She bowed to them and alleviated the pangs of her parents due to her absence. The goddess then proceeded to Mandara talking to her friends about the trees in the penance-grove who had been her loving companions. "They are shedding tears due to their grief at separation, by their scattering flowers, they are crying in distress by the chirping sound of birds seated on their boughs." The goddess was impatient to see her lord. She kept the tiger ahead thinking him as son born of herself, out of affection. With the brilliant lustre of her body she illuminated the quarters. Thus Gauri reached Mandara where lord Siva was staying — the lord who is the creator, protector and annihilator of the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: Then taking leave of the goddess Brahma vanished. The goddess visited her parents Mena, Himavat. She bowed to them and alleviated the pangs of her parents due to her absence.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then taking leave of the goddess Brahma vanished. The goddess visited her parents Mena, Himavat. She bowed to them and alleviated the pangs of her parents due to her absence.…
verses.science: महारथ आपकी जय हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: साऽसूता धरणी भूयस्तिस्रः कन्याश्च विश्रुताः । वेलां च नियतिं चैव तृतीयामपि चायतिम्
verses.transliteration: sā'sūtā dharaṇī bhūyastisraḥ kanyāśca viśrutāḥ | velāṃ ca niyatiṃ caiva tṛtīyāmapi cāyatim
verses.translation: After assuming fair co'nplexion how did the goddess, the daughter of the excellent mountain look at her husband on entering the mansion?
verses.commentary: Sense: After assuming fair co'nplexion how did the goddess, the daughter of the excellent mountain look at her husband on entering the mansion?
verses.science: न समर्थ हो सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आयतिर्नियतिश्चैव पत्न्यौ द्वे भृगुपुत्रयोः । स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे पूर्वं कथितस्ते तदन्वयः
verses.transliteration: āyatirniyatiścaiva patnyau dve bhṛguputrayoḥ | svāyambhuve'ntare pūrvaṃ kathitaste tadanvayaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing ho sooner did she get up than the lord seized her with his hands, embraced her and joyously walked her round. Even when he attempted to make her sit on his lap she sat on the couch. Smilingly he seized her from the couch and made her sit on his lap. Smilingly gazing at her with his wide open eyes as if he would drink her in, the lord initiated the conversation with her by speaking him¬ self first.
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing ho sooner did she get up than the lord seized her with his hands, embraced her and joyously walked her round. Even when he attempted to make her sit on his lap she sat on the couch. Smilingly he seized her from the couch and made her sit on his lap.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing ho sooner did she get up than the lord seized her with his hands, embraced her and joyously walked her round. Even when he attempted to make her sit on his lap she sat on the couch. Smilingly he seized her from the couch and made her sit on his lap.…
verses.science: ३० प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुषुवे सागराद्वेला कन्यामेकामनिन्दिताम् । सवर्णां नाम सामुद्रीं पत्नीं प्राचीनबर्हिषः
verses.transliteration: suṣuve sāgarādvelā kanyāmekāmaninditām | savarṇāṃ nāma sāmudrīṃ patnīṃ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ
verses.translation: Should there be any cause for our mutual dis¬ pleasure as in the case of ignorant fellows, the whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings would cease to exist.
verses.commentary: Sense: Should there be any cause for our mutual dis¬ pleasure as in the case of ignorant fellows, the whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings would cease to exist.
verses.science: मंगलदायिनि आपकी जय हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सामुद्री सुषुवे पुत्रान्दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः । सर्वे प्राचेतसा नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः
verses.transliteration: sāmudrī suṣuve putrāndaśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ | sarve prācetasā nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ
verses.translation: I am stationed on the head of Agni. You are stationed on the head of Soma. This universe in the form of "Agni soma" is presided over by us both.
verses.hindi: है, अत: आपमें ही लीन होगा
verses.commentary: Sense: I am stationed on the head of Agni. You are stationed on the head of Soma. This universe in the form of "Agni soma" is presided over by us both.
verses.science: है, अत: आपमें ही लीन होगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: येषां स्वायम्भुवे दक्षः पुत्रत्वमगमत्पुरा । त्रियम्बकस्य शापेन चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ svāyambhuve dakṣaḥ putratvamagamatpurā | triyambakasya śāpena cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: We move about for the welfare of the universe. We have taken up physical bodies out of our free will. At our separation the universe is left without support.
verses.hindi: आप मुझे प्रार्थित कल्याण प्रदान करें
verses.commentary: Sense: We move about for the welfare of the universe. We have taken up physical bodies out of our free will. At our separation the universe is left without support.
verses.science: आप मुझे प्रार्थित कल्याण प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते ब्रह्मपुत्राणां धर्मादीनां महात्मनाम् । नातिसङ्क्षेपतो विप्रा नातिविस्तरतः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ityete brahmaputrāṇāṃ dharmādīnāṃ mahātmanām | nātisaṅkṣepato viprā nātivistarataḥ kramāt
verses.translation: There is another reason based on Scriptural texts and independent arguments. The universe comprising the mobile and immobile beings is integrated as words to their meaning. You are the nectarine word. I am the nectarine meaning. How can the two nectars become disjointed?
verses.commentary: Sense: There is another reason based on Scriptural texts and independent arguments. The universe comprising the mobile and immobile beings is integrated as words to their meaning. You are the nectarine word. I am the nectarine meaning. How can the two nectars become disjointed?
verses.science: मनोर॒थ पूर्ण करें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णिता वै मया वंशा दिव्या देवगणान्विताः । क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्द्धिभिरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: varṇitā vai mayā vaṃśā divyā devagaṇānvitāḥ | kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharddhibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: You are the lore that makes my conviction possible. I am the object of knowledge on the basis of your conviction. How can we separate in asmuch as we are in the forms of knowledge and object of knowledge?
verses.hindi: मुझे मेरी अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the lore that makes my conviction possible. I am the object of knowledge on the basis of your conviction. How can we separate in asmuch as we are in the forms of knowledge and object of knowledge?
verses.science: मुझे मेरी अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां सन्निवेशोऽयं प्रजापतिसमुद्भवः । न हि शक्यः प्रसङ्ख्यातुं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: prajānāṃ sanniveśo'yaṃ prajāpatisamudbhavaḥ | na hi śakyaḥ prasaṅkhyātuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: Lordship has behest as its core because it is the symbol of freedom. How can there be lordship in me if I am deprived of command?
verses.commentary: Sense: Lordship has behest as its core because it is the symbol of freedom. How can there be lordship in me if I am deprived of command?
verses.science: मेरा मनोरथ प्रदान करें। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञामपि च यो वंशो द्विधा सोऽपि प्रवर्तते । सूर्यवंशः सोमवंश इति पुण्यतमः क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: rājñāmapi ca yo vaṃśo dvidhā so'pi pravartate | sūryavaṃśaḥ somavaṃśa iti puṇyatamaḥ kṣitau
verses.translation: We can never stay apart from each other. It was for accomplishing the task of the gods that I made that joke.
verses.hindi: हुई मुझे मेरी अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें
verses.commentary: Sense: We can never stay apart from each other. It was for accomplishing the task of the gods that I made that joke.
verses.science: हुई मुझे मेरी अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुरम्बरीषश्च ययातिर्नाहुषादयः । पुण्यश्लोकाः श्रुता येऽत्र तेऽपि तद्वंशसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākurambarīṣaśca yayātirnāhuṣādayaḥ | puṇyaślokāḥ śrutā ye'tra te'pi tadvaṃśasambhavāḥ
verses.translation: What is harmful to the living beings does not find room in you. When lord himself spoke thus the goddess, the natural source of love, smiled but did not reply to her hus¬ band. Out of bashfuliiess she did not say anything but gave an accormt, of Kaujiki.
verses.hindi: शासनसे मुझे प्रार्थित वस्तु प्रदान करें
verses.commentary: Sense: What is harmful to the living beings does not find room in you. When lord himself spoke thus the goddess, the natural source of love, smiled but did not reply to her hus¬ band. Out of bashfuliiess she did not say anything but gave an accormt, of Kaujiki.
verses.science: शासनसे मुझे प्रार्थित वस्तु प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च राजऋषयो नानावीर्यसमन्विताः । किं तैः फलमनुत्क्रान्तैरुक्तपूर्वैः पुरातनैः
verses.transliteration: anye ca rājaṛṣayo nānāvīryasamanvitāḥ | kiṃ taiḥ phalamanutkrāntairuktapūrvaiḥ purātanaiḥ
verses.translation: Was not Kau4iki, created by me seen by my lord? Such a girl has never been before in the world nor will ever be.
verses.commentary: Sense: Was not Kau4iki, created by me seen by my lord? Such a girl has never been before in the world nor will ever be.
verses.science: इच्छाको पूर्ण करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: किं चेश्वरकथावृत्तौ यत्र तत्रान्यकीर्तनम् । न सद्भिः सम्मतं मत्वा नोत्सहे बहुभाषितुम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ ceśvarakathāvṛttau yatra tatrānyakīrtanam | na sadbhiḥ sammataṃ matvā notsahe bahubhāṣitum
verses.translation: Brahma will tell you about her prowess, strength, residence on the Vindhya, her victory in the battle with Sumbha and Nisumbha, their death, her blessing to the devotees and her protection of the worlds.
verses.hindi: प्राथितं मे प्रयच्छन्तु परमेश्ररशासनात्॥ ६६  आदेशसे मुझे मेरी प्रार्थित वस्तु प्रदान करें
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma will tell you about her prowess, strength, residence on the Vindhya, her victory in the battle with Sumbha and Nisumbha, their death, her blessing to the devotees and her protection of the worlds.
verses.science: प्राथितं मे प्रयच्छन्तु परमेश्ररशासनात्॥ ६६ आदेशसे मुझे मेरी प्रार्थित वस्तु प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसङ्गादीश्वरस्यैव प्रभावद्योतनादपि । सर्गादयोऽपि कथिता इत्यत्र तत्प्रविस्तरैः
verses.transliteration: prasaṅgādīśvarasyaiva prabhāvadyotanādapi | sargādayo'pi kathitā ityatra tatpravistaraiḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of the goddess who spoke thus tic? friends brought the tiger in their presence.
verses.hindi: आदर करके मुझे अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें
