verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the goddess who spoke thus tic? friends brought the tiger in their presence.
verses.science: आदर करके मुझे अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Then lord Siva with the moon as his ornament made the majestic beautiful Gauri the daughter of the lord of Himavat sit on the conch and embellished her with ornaments.
verses.hindi: फेककृत्य य शिव त प्त ; मझे मंगल प्रदान करे
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Siva with the moon as his ornament made the majestic beautiful Gauri the daughter of the lord of Himavat sit on the conch and embellished her with ornaments.
verses.science: फेककृत्य य शिव त प्त ; मझे मंगल प्रदान करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Then lord Siva with the moon as his ornament made the majestic beautiful Gauri the daughter of the lord of Himavat sit on the conch and embellished her with ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Siva with the moon as his ornament made the majestic beautiful Gauri the daughter of the lord of Himavat sit on the conch and embellished her with ornaments.
verses.science: करके मेरा मंगल करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । सतीदेहत्यागः । ऋषय ऊचुः । देवी दक्षस्य तनया त्यक्त्वा दाक्षायणीं तनुम् । कथं हिमवतः पुत्री मेनायामभवत्पुरा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.18. aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | satīdehatyāgaḥ | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | devī dakṣasya tanayā tyaktvā dākṣāyaṇīṃ tanum | kathaṃ himavataḥ putrī menāyāmabhavatpurā
verses.translation: We wish to hear these things in the proper order. What was it mentioned by the lord while pacifying the goddess? He had said that the universe is in the form of Agnisoma. He had said that it was in the form of words and their meanings. He also mentioned lordship has com¬ mand as its core. You are that command.
verses.wordMeaning: We wish to hear these things in the proper order. What was it mentioned by the lord while pacifying the goddess? He had said that the universe is in the form of Agnisoma. He had said that it was in the form of words and their meanings.…
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear these things in the proper order. What was it mentioned by the lord while pacifying the goddess? He had said that the universe is in the form of Agnisoma. He had said that it was in the form of words and their meanings.…
verses.science: करके मुझे मंगल प्रदान करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कथं च निन्दितो रुद्रो दक्षेण च महात्मना । निमित्तमपि किं तत्र येन स्यान्निन्दितो भवः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ ca nindito rudro dakṣeṇa ca mahātmanā | nimittamapi kiṃ tatra yena syānnindito bhavaḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention briefly how the universe in the form of 'Vag-Artha' can be known through the six pathways.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामृत्तरखण्डे शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention briefly how the universe in the form of 'Vag-Artha' can be known through the six pathways.
verses.science: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामृत्तरखण्डे शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नश्च कथं दक्षो ह्यभिशापाद्भवस्य तु । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वं मनोः प्रब्रूहि मारुत
verses.transliteration: utpannaśca kathaṃ dakṣo hyabhiśāpādbhavasya tu | cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvaṃ manoḥ prabrūhi māruta
verses.translation: All this could be seen only there by the nspirants. He who wishes to purify without realising the mode of pervasion of the paths is a deceiver of purity. He cannot achieve the fruit. His effort is wasted and leads him to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: All this could be seen only there by the nspirants. He who wishes to purify without realising the mode of pervasion of the paths is a deceiver of purity. He cannot achieve the fruit. His effort is wasted and leads him to hell.
verses.science: इन कर्मोंको करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाव शृण्वन्तु कथयिष्यामि दक्षस्य लघुचेतसः । वृत्तं पापात् प्रमादाच्च विश्वामरविदूषणम्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāva śṛṇvantu kathayiṣyāmi dakṣasya laghucetasaḥ | vṛttaṃ pāpāt pramādācca viśvāmaravidūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Even beings including Brahma and PiSacas can assume or cast off their bodies out of their wish. But don't they come under the scope of Karmans?
verses.commentary: Sense: Even beings including Brahma and PiSacas can assume or cast off their bodies out of their wish. But don't they come under the scope of Karmans?
verses.science: हरिविधिमोहवर्णन॑ नाम चतुस्त्रिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सुरासुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । कदाचिद् द्रष्टुमीशानं हिमवच्छिखरं ययुः
verses.transliteration: purā surāsurāḥ sarve siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | kadācid draṣṭumīśānaṃ himavacchikharaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: After creating a dark woman from his neck he killed Daraka. After creating Kausiki out of the outer skin of Gauri, Sumbha and Nisumbha were killed. xhe narrative cn Skanda is found in the Skanda Purana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating a dark woman from his neck he killed Daraka. After creating Kausiki out of the outer skin of Gauri, Sumbha and Nisumbha were killed. xhe narrative cn Skanda is found in the Skanda Purana.
verses.science: करके शयन कराये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवश्च देवी च दिव्यासनगतावुभौ । दर्शनं ददतुस्तेषां देवादीनां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tadā devaśca devī ca divyāsanagatāvubhau | darśanaṃ dadatusteṣāṃ devādīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The submarine fire, not knowing the bull as the lord's vehicle swallowed him. Thereafter the universe be¬ came a vast sheet of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The submarine fire, not knowing the bull as the lord's vehicle swallowed him. Thereafter the universe be¬ came a vast sheet of water.
verses.science: निरन्तर ध्यान करनेयोग्य हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदानीमेव दक्षोऽपि गतस्तत्र सहामरैः । जामातरं हरं द्रष्टुं देवीं चात्मसुतां सतीम्
verses.transliteration: tadānīmeva dakṣo'pi gatastatra sahāmaraiḥ | jāmātaraṃ haraṃ draṣṭuṃ devīṃ cātmasutāṃ satīm
verses.translation: The universe in the form of Pasu and Paa, has to be blessed. The lord endowed with the authority blesses the universe.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् मोक्ष भी हो सकता है
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe in the form of Pasu and Paa, has to be blessed. The lord endowed with the authority blesses the universe.
verses.science: अर्थात् मोक्ष भी हो सकता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदात्मगौरवाद्देवो देव्या दक्षे समागते । देवादिभ्यो विशेषेण न कदाचिदभूत्स्मृतिः
verses.transliteration: tadātmagauravāddevo devyā dakṣe samāgate | devādibhyo viśeṣeṇa na kadācidabhūtsmṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The lord, the commander blesses everything always. If a means is adopted for that, how does Siva become dependant?
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, the commander blesses everything always. If a means is adopted for that, how does Siva become dependant?
verses.science: ऐश्वर्य नहीं सिद्ध होता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तस्याः परं भावमज्ञातुश्चापि केवलम् । पुत्रीत्येवं विमूढस्य तस्यां वैरमजायत
verses.transliteration: tasya tasyāḥ paraṃ bhāvamajñātuścāpi kevalam | putrītyevaṃ vimūḍhasya tasyāṃ vairamajāyata
verses.translation: No blessing can be independent of one that is blessed. Hence the meaning of the word freedom is not characterised by 'not depending on another*.
verses.commentary: Sense: No blessing can be independent of one that is blessed. Hence the meaning of the word freedom is not characterised by 'not depending on another*.
verses.science: कान्ति धूमरहित अंगारके समान है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेनैव वैरेण विधिना च प्रचोदितः । नाजुवाह भवं दक्षो दीक्षितस्तामपि द्विषन्
verses.transliteration: tatastenaiva vaireṇa vidhinā ca pracoditaḥ | nājuvāha bhavaṃ dakṣo dīkṣitastāmapi dviṣan
verses.translation: Tejas functions in two ways, in the form of the sun and of fire. Rasa too functions in the form of the moon and of water.
verses.hindi: आदेशसे ही मेरी इच्छाकी पूर्ति करें
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas functions in two ways, in the form of the sun and of fire. Rasa too functions in the form of the moon and of water.
verses.science: आदेशसे ही मेरी इच्छाकी पूर्ति करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्याञ्जामातरः सर्वानाहूय स यथाक्रमम् । शतशः पुष्कलामर्चाञ्चकार च पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: anyāñjāmātaraḥ sarvānāhūya sa yathākramam | śataśaḥ puṣkalāmarcāñcakāra ca pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Amrta issues from Agni. Agni increases through Amrta. The powerful Agnisoma is beneficent to the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Amrta issues from Agni. Agni increases through Amrta. The powerful Agnisoma is beneficent to the universe.
verses.science: गौरव मानकर. मुझपर अनुग्रह करें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा तान्सङ्गतान् श्रुत्वा नारदस्य मुखात्तदा । ययौ रुद्राय रुद्राणी विज्ञाप्य भवनं पितुः
verses.transliteration: tathā tānsaṅgatān śrutvā nāradasya mukhāttadā | yayau rudrāya rudrāṇī vijñāpya bhavanaṃ pituḥ
verses.translation: The Agni blazes upwards as far as the great Amrta of Soma. The Amrta of Soma flows as far as the support of Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Agni blazes upwards as far as the great Amrta of Soma. The Amrta of Soma flows as far as the support of Agni.
verses.science: इस कार्यको सफल घोषित करें। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सन्निहितं दिव्यं विमानं विश्वतोमुखम् । लक्षणाढ्यं सुखारोहमतिमात्रं मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: atha sannihitaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ viśvatomukham | lakṣaṇāḍhyaṃ sukhārohamatimātraṃ manoharam
verses.translation: The Kalagni supported by Adhara Sakti proceeds upwards. Similarly Soma having its region in Siva-Sakti flows downwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalagni supported by Adhara Sakti proceeds upwards. Similarly Soma having its region in Siva-Sakti flows downwards.
verses.science: कल्याणकामी हों। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रख्यं चित्ररत्नपरिष्कृतम् । मुक्तामयवितानाग्न्यं स्रग्दामसमलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: taptajāmbūnadaprakhyaṃ citraratnapariṣkṛtam | muktāmayavitānāgnyaṃ sragdāmasamalaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: Siva sustains lakti from below and Siva is Sakti- dhara (upholder of Sakti) above. Thus there is nothing not pervaded by Siva and Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva sustains lakti from below and Siva is Sakti- dhara (upholder of Sakti) above. Thus there is nothing not pervaded by Siva and Sakti.
verses.science: सदाशिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तप्तकञ्चननिर्व्यूहं रत्नस्तम्भशतावृतम् । वज्रकल्पितसोपानं विद्रुमस्तम्भतोरणम्
verses.transliteration: taptakañcananirvyūhaṃ ratnastambhaśatāvṛtam | vajrakalpitasopānaṃ vidrumastambhatoraṇam
verses.translation: He who dusts himself with Bhasma repeating the mantra "Agniriii"* etc., if bound becomes free from bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dusts himself with Bhasma repeating the mantra "Agniriii"* etc., if bound becomes free from bondage.
verses.science: माँगकर शेष पूजाकी समाप्ति करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पपट्टपरिस्तीर्णं चित्ररत्नमहासनम् । वज्रजालकिरच्छिद्रमच्छिद्रमणिकुट्टिमम्
verses.transliteration: puṣpapaṭṭaparistīrṇaṃ citraratnamahāsanam | vajrajālakiracchidramacchidramaṇikuṭṭimam
verses.translation: But being drenched all round by having recourse to Yogic union the Bhasma may turn one back from lordship by the shower of Amrta belonging to Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: But being drenched all round by having recourse to Yogic union the Bhasma may turn one back from lordship by the shower of Amrta belonging to Sakti.
verses.science: पाप-मुक्त हो जाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मणिदण्डमनोज्ञेन महावृषभलक्ष्मणा । अलङ्कृतपुरोभागमभ्रशुभ्रेण केतुना
verses.transliteration: maṇidaṇḍamanojñena mahāvṛṣabhalakṣmaṇā | alaṅkṛtapurobhāgamabhraśubhreṇa ketunā
verses.translation: Hence for the conquest of death the drenching with Amrta shall be perpetual. How and wherefore shall one die if the nectarine contact of Siva and Sakti is acquired?
verses.hindi: कदापि अनर्थका भागी नहीं हो सकता
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence for the conquest of death the drenching with Amrta shall be perpetual. How and wherefore shall one die if the nectarine contact of Siva and Sakti is acquired?
verses.science: कदापि अनर्थका भागी नहीं हो सकता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रत्नकञ्चुकगुप्ताङ्गैश्चित्रवेत्रैकपाणिभिः । अधिष्ठितमहाद्वारमप्रधृष्यैर्गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: ratnakañcukaguptāṅgaiścitravetraikapāṇibhiḥ | adhiṣṭhitamahādvāramapradhṛṣyairgaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: He who knows the secret of burning and drenching as mentioned is never reborn after leaving the world, the region of Agnisoma.
verses.hindi: संलग्न रहनेवाला पुरुष प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows the secret of burning and drenching as mentioned is never reborn after leaving the world, the region of Agnisoma.
verses.science: संलग्न रहनेवाला पुरुष प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मृदङ्गतालगीतादिवेणुवीणाविशारदैः । विदग्धवेषभूषैश्च बहुभिः स्त्रीजनैर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: mṛdaṅgatālagītādiveṇuvīṇāviśāradaiḥ | vidagdhaveṣabhūṣaiśca bahubhiḥ strījanairvṛtam
verses.translation: He who burns his body with Saivite lire and dren¬ ches it with the nectar of Sakti and Soma attains immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who burns his body with Saivite lire and dren¬ ches it with the nectar of Sakti and Soma attains immortality.
verses.science: स्तोत्रका पाठ करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आरुरोह महादेवी सह प्रियसखीजनैः । चामारव्यजने तस्या वज्रदण्डमनोहरे
verses.transliteration: āruroha mahādevī saha priyasakhījanaiḥ | cāmāravyajane tasyā vajradaṇḍamanohare
verses.translation: The two words and their meanings arc the trans¬ formations of Prakrti which is form of Siva and Siva.
verses.hindi: शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णण ' नामक इकतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The two words and their meanings arc the trans¬ formations of Prakrti which is form of Siva and Siva.
verses.science: शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णण ' नामक इकतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा रुद्रकन्ये द्वे विवीजतुरुभे शुभे । तदा चामरयोर्मध्ये देव्या वदनमाबभौ
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā rudrakanye dve vivījaturubhe śubhe | tadā cāmarayormadhye devyā vadanamābabhau
verses.translation: The magnificence in the form of word is men¬ tioned as threefold by scholars — gross, subtle and the great. The gross one is what we hear with our ears.
verses.hindi: इष्टसिद्धिकारक कर्म भी फलद नहीं होता
verses.commentary: Sense: The magnificence in the form of word is men¬ tioned as threefold by scholars — gross, subtle and the great. The gross one is what we hear with our ears.
verses.science: इष्टसिद्धिकारक कर्म भी फलद नहीं होता। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्योऽन्यं युध्यतोर्मध्ये हंसयोरिव पङ्कजम् । छत्रं शशिनिभं तस्याश्चूडोपरि सुमालिनी
verses.transliteration: anyo'nyaṃ yudhyatormadhye haṃsayoriva paṅkajam | chatraṃ śaśinibhaṃ tasyāścūḍopari sumālinī
verses.translation: The subtle one is in the form of thought, the one beyond is devoid of thought. The Sakti based on the principle of Siva is Parasakti. In the name of "Sakti Tattva" it is the root cause of all effects. It is the composite unit (Samasti) of all Saktis because it is in association with Juana Sakti and is supported by Iccha sakti. The same is called KundalinI Maya and Suddhadhvaparama. This Sakti is ramified into six paths. The three paths pertain to words and the three pertain to their meanings.
verses.hindi: पता लगनेपर उसे दूर करनेका प्रयत्न करे
verses.wordMeaning: The subtle one is in the form of thought, the one beyond is devoid of thought. The Sakti based on the principle of Siva is Parasakti. In the name of "Sakti Tattva" it is the root cause of all effects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The subtle one is in the form of thought, the one beyond is devoid of thought. The Sakti based on the principle of Siva is Parasakti. In the name of "Sakti Tattva" it is the root cause of all effects.…
verses.science: पता लगनेपर उसे दूर करनेका प्रयत्न करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धृतमुक्तापरिक्षिप्तं बभार प्रेमनिर्भरा । तच्छत्रमुज्ज्वलं देव्या रुरुचे वदनोपरि
verses.transliteration: dhṛtamuktāparikṣiptaṃ babhāra premanirbharā | tacchatramujjvalaṃ devyā ruruce vadanopari
verses.translation: The capacity for merging and enjoyment is posse¬ ssed by all men in accordance with their purity based on the divisions of all Principles. The principles are pervaded by Kalas suitably as in the beginning the great Prakrti is trans¬ formed into five. They are Kala, Nivrtti and others.
verses.wordMeaning: The capacity for merging and enjoyment is posse¬ ssed by all men in accordance with their purity based on the divisions of all Principles. The principles are pervaded by Kalas suitably as in the beginning the great Prakrti is trans¬ formed into five. They are Kala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The capacity for merging and enjoyment is posse¬ ssed by all men in accordance with their purity based on the divisions of all Principles. The principles are pervaded by Kalas suitably as in the beginning the great Prakrti is trans¬ formed into five. They are Kala,…
verses.science: कर्मका फल नहीं मिलता। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपर्यमृतभाण्डस्य मण्डलं शशिनो यथा । अथ चाग्रे समासीना सुस्मितास्या शुभावती
verses.transliteration: uparyamṛtabhāṇḍasya maṇḍalaṃ śaśino yathā | atha cāgre samāsīnā susmitāsyā śubhāvatī
verses.translation: The three paths based on words arc: the path of mantras, the path of words, the path of letters. The three paths based on meanings are the path of universe, the path of principles, the path of Kalas. These are mutually pervaded and pervading.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three paths based on words arc: the path of mantras, the path of words, the path of letters. The three paths based on meanings are the path of universe, the path of principles, the path of Kalas. These are mutually pervaded and pervading.
verses.science: फलकी प्राप्ति देखी जाती है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षद्यूतविनोदेन रमयामास वै सतीम् । सुयशाः पादुके देव्याः शुभे रत्नपरिष्कृते
verses.transliteration: akṣadyūtavinodena ramayāmāsa vai satīm | suyaśāḥ pāduke devyāḥ śubhe ratnapariṣkṛte
verses.translation: The mantras are pervaded by the words consti¬ tuting the statement. The words are pervaded by letters. Learned men call the group of letters a word.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mantras are pervaded by the words consti¬ tuting the statement. The words are pervaded by letters. Learned men call the group of letters a word.
verses.science: 'फलको अवश्य पाता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तनयोरन्तरे कृत्वा तदा देवीमसेवत । अन्या काञ्चनचार्वङ्गी दीप्तं जग्राह दर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: stanayorantare kṛtvā tadā devīmasevata | anyā kāñcanacārvaṅgī dīptaṃ jagrāha darpaṇam
verses.translation: The letters are pervaded by the words because they are obtained there. The words are pervaded by the Tattvas because of their origin from within and without. They are effected by the Tattvas in various ways. Some of the words have cropped up from the middle, some from the §aiva Agamas. Some of Tattvas are those famous in the Sankhya and Yoga systems of Philosophy. Others arc famous in the sacred texts of Siva. The Tattvas arc duly pervaded by Kalas.
verses.hindi: पवित्र वेषभूषा धारण करे और पवित्र रहे
verses.wordMeaning: The letters are pervaded by the words because they are obtained there. The words are pervaded by the Tattvas because of their origin from within and without. They are effected by the Tattvas in various ways. Some of the words have cropped up from the middle,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The letters are pervaded by the words because they are obtained there. The words are pervaded by the Tattvas because of their origin from within and without. They are effected by the Tattvas in various ways. Some of the words have cropped up from the middle,…
verses.science: पवित्र वेषभूषा धारण करे और पवित्र रहे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपरा तालवृन्तं च परा ताम्बूलपेटिकाम् । काचित्क्रीडाशुकं चारु करेऽकुरुत भामिनी
verses.transliteration: aparā tālavṛntaṃ ca parā tāmbūlapeṭikām | kācitkrīḍāśukaṃ cāru kare'kuruta bhāminī
verses.translation: Since in the beginning the primordial Prakrti i?
verses.commentary: Sense: Since in the beginning the primordial Prakrti i?
verses.science: चारों ओरसे आच्छादित कर दे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काचित्तु सुमनोज्ञानि पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च । काचिदाभरणाधारं बभार कमलेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: kācittu sumanojñāni puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca | kācidābharaṇādhāraṃ babhāra kamalekṣaṇā
verses.translation: The undivided Sakti pervades the six paths. She is pervaded by Sivatattva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The undivided Sakti pervades the six paths. She is pervaded by Sivatattva.
verses.science: पाँच आवरणोंकी पूजा करनी चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: काचिच्च पुनरालेपं सुप्रसूनं शुभाञ्जनम् । अन्याश्च सदृशास्तास्ता यथास्वमुचितक्रियाः
verses.transliteration: kācicca punarālepaṃ suprasūnaṃ śubhāñjanam | anyāśca sadṛśāstāstā yathāsvamucitakriyāḥ
verses.translation: The situation of the cosmic egg upto Rudra is purified by Nivrtti. Above that upto the sphere of Avyakta It is purified by Pratisfha.
verses.hindi: वाद्य और कीर्तन आदि भी करने चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: The situation of the cosmic egg upto Rudra is purified by Nivrtti. Above that upto the sphere of Avyakta It is purified by Pratisfha.
verses.science: वाद्य और कीर्तन आदि भी करने चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आवृत्य तां महादेवीमसेवन्त समन्ततः । अतीव शुशुभे तासामन्तरे परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: āvṛtya tāṃ mahādevīmasevanta samantataḥ | atīva śuśubhe tāsāmantare parameśvarī
verses.translation: Some declare that their difference consists in their genders: man and woman. Others say that she is undeta- chably associated with him as the light of the sun. But in the form of cit she is different. The arrangement is that Siva is the great cause and his behest is the great goddess.
verses.hindi: बात और क्या हो सकती है 2
verses.wordMeaning: Some declare that their difference consists in their genders: man and woman. Others say that she is undeta- chably associated with him as the light of the sun. But in the form of cit she is different.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some declare that their difference consists in their genders: man and woman. Others say that she is undeta- chably associated with him as the light of the sun. But in the form of cit she is different.…
verses.science: बात और क्या हो सकती है 2। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तारापरिषदो मध्ये चन्द्रलेखेव शारदी । ततः शङ्खसमुत्थस्य नादस्य समनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tārāpariṣado madhye candralekheva śāradī | tataḥ śaṅkhasamutthasya nādasya samanantaram
verses.translation: Urged by his behest the original unchanging Prakrti becomes threefold in accordance with the three types of effects. It is called Mahamaya, Maya and Triguna Prakfti. It produces the six paths in the form of words and their meanings. The entire universe is thus sixfold. The whole collection of scriptural text is only an extension of this.
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by his behest the original unchanging Prakrti becomes threefold in accordance with the three types of effects. It is called Mahamaya, Maya and Triguna Prakfti. It produces the six paths in the form of words and their meanings. The entire universe is thus sixfold.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by his behest the original unchanging Prakrti becomes threefold in accordance with the three types of effects. It is called Mahamaya, Maya and Triguna Prakfti. It produces the six paths in the form of words and their meanings. The entire universe is thus sixfold.…
verses.science: । जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रास्थानिको महानादः पटहः समताड्यत । ततो मधुरवाद्यानि सह तालोद्यतैः स्वनैः
verses.transliteration: prāsthāniko mahānādaḥ paṭahaḥ samatāḍyata | tato madhuravādyāni saha tālodyataiḥ svanaiḥ
verses.translation: The activities of deities of domestic nature arc curious, dense and inscrutable, even to the gods. They delude our minds.
verses.hindi: ... सिद्धिकर्मवर्णन नामक बत्तीसवाँ अध्यांय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The activities of deities of domestic nature arc curious, dense and inscrutable, even to the gods. They delude our minds.
verses.science: ... सिद्धिकर्मवर्णन नामक बत्तीसवाँ अध्यांय पूर्ण हुआ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनाहतानि सन्नेदुः काहलानां शतानि च । सायुधानां गणेशानां महेशसमतेजसाम्
verses.transliteration: anāhatāni sanneduḥ kāhalānāṃ śatāni ca | sāyudhānāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ maheśasamatejasām
verses.translation: In the union of the principles of Siva and Siva no defect is noticeable. However in their activities the Prakfta feeling is rather prominent.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the union of the principles of Siva and Siva no defect is noticeable. However in their activities the Prakfta feeling is rather prominent.
verses.science: सबकी प्रतिष्ठा हो जाती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि शतान्यष्टौ तदानीं पुरतो ययुः । तेषां मध्ये वृषारूढो गजारूढो यथा गुरुः
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi śatānyaṣṭau tadānīṃ purato yayuḥ | teṣāṃ madhye vṛṣārūḍho gajārūḍho yathā guruḥ
verses.translation: Brahma and others the causes of creation, sustenance and annihilation attain restraint and blessing from Siva and are subservient to him.
verses.hindi: इस लिंग-में शिव किस कारणसे पूजे जाते हैं 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma and others the causes of creation, sustenance and annihilation attain restraint and blessing from Siva and are subservient to him.
verses.science: इस लिंग-में शिव किस कारणसे पूजे जाते हैं 2। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगाम गणपः श्रीमान् सोमनन्दीश्वरार्चितः । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्दिवि दिव्यसुखा घनाः
verses.transliteration: jagāma gaṇapaḥ śrīmān somanandīśvarārcitaḥ | devadundubhayo nedurdivi divyasukhā ghanāḥ
verses.translation: Matsya 3« I In the
verses.hindi: मेरी कृपासे शीघ्र ही दूर हो जायगी
verses.commentary: Sense: Matsya 3« I In the
verses.science: मेरी कृपासे शीघ्र ही दूर हो जायगी। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ननृतुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुमुदुः सिद्धयोगिनः । ससृजुः पुष्पवृष्टिं च वितानोपरि वारिदाः
verses.transliteration: nanṛturmunayaḥ sarve mumuduḥ siddhayoginaḥ | sasṛjuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca vitānopari vāridāḥ
verses.translation: But a physical form docs not fit in with a free being for this basic reason. But the form is an effect of some cause. Lordship has no cause for its being.
verses.hindi: हूँ, मेरे समान ऐश्वर्यशाली कोई नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: But a physical form docs not fit in with a free being for this basic reason. But the form is an effect of some cause. Lordship has no cause for its being.
verses.science: हूँ, मेरे समान ऐश्वर्यशाली कोई नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवगणैश्चान्यैः पथि सर्वत्र सङ्गताः । क्षणादिव पितुर्गेहं प्रविवेश महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: tadā devagaṇaiścānyaiḥ pathi sarvatra saṅgatāḥ | kṣaṇādiva piturgehaṃ praviveśa maheśvarī
verses.translation: Everywhere the greater and the lower Bhavas are mentioned. How can these two be relevant in one place?
verses.commentary: Sense: Everywhere the greater and the lower Bhavas are mentioned. How can these two be relevant in one place?
verses.science: मध्य तथा अन्तसे रहित था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा कुपितो दक्षश्चात्मनः क्षयकारणात् । तस्या यवीयसीभ्योऽपि चक्रे पूजामसत्कृताम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kupito dakṣaścātmanaḥ kṣayakāraṇāt | tasyā yavīyasībhyo'pi cakre pūjāmasatkṛtām
verses.translation: The wise have said that the embodied Atman is Sakala; the unembodied Siva is Niskala. The embodied Atman is presided over by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise have said that the embodied Atman is Sakala; the unembodied Siva is Niskala. The embodied Atman is presided over by Siva.
verses.science: धारणकर नीचेकी ओर गये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा शशिमुखी देवी पितरं सदसि स्थितम् । अम्बिका युक्तमव्यग्रमुवाचाकृपणं वचः
verses.transliteration: tadā śaśimukhī devī pitaraṃ sadasi sthitam | ambikā yuktamavyagramuvācākṛpaṇaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: The assuming of physical bodies out of wish is not consistent with freedom. Such a wish too follows the activities of men.
verses.commentary: Sense: The assuming of physical bodies out of wish is not consistent with freedom. Such a wish too follows the activities of men.
verses.science: क्या है'--ऐसा सोचने लगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्याज्ञावशवर्तिनः । स देवः साम्प्रतं तात विधिना नार्चितः किल
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yasyājñāvaśavartinaḥ | sa devaḥ sāmprataṃ tāta vidhinā nārcitaḥ kila
verses.translation: They consider the assumption of bodies at one's choice on a par with jugglery. It is not beyond the achieve¬ ments derived from Anima and other powers.
verses.hindi: हरिविधिमोहवर्णन नामक चाँंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: They consider the assumption of bodies at one's choice on a par with jugglery. It is not beyond the achieve¬ ments derived from Anima and other powers.
verses.science: हरिविधिमोहवर्णन नामक चाँंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तदास्तां मम ज्यायस्याः पुत्र्याः पूजां किमीदृशीम् । असत्कृतामवज्ञाय कृतवानसि गर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: tadāstāṃ mama jyāyasyāḥ putryāḥ pūjāṃ kimīdṛśīm | asatkṛtāmavajñāya kṛtavānasi garhitam
verses.translation: While Visnu who had assumed the cosmic form was fighting with Dadhica the latter assumed the cosmic form of Visnu.***
verses.commentary: Sense: While Visnu who had assumed the cosmic form was fighting with Dadhica the latter assumed the cosmic form of Visnu.***
verses.science: ब्रह्म ओंकार शअ्रकेट हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तोऽब्रवीदेनां दक्षः क्रोधादमर्षितः । त्वत्तः श्रेष्ठा विशिष्टाश्च पूज्या बालाः सुता मम
verses.transliteration: evamukto'bravīdenāṃ dakṣaḥ krodhādamarṣitaḥ | tvattaḥ śreṣṭhā viśiṣṭāśca pūjyā bālāḥ sutā mama
verses.translation: They say that Siva the supreme cause blesses us all. He curbs and kills the gods. How can he be a blesser of all?
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that Siva the supreme cause blesses us all. He curbs and kills the gods. How can he be a blesser of all?
verses.science: तमोगुणसे आच्छन्न था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तासां तु ये च भर्त्तारस्ते मे बहुमता मुदा । गुणैश्चाप्यधिकाः सर्वे भर्तुस्ते त्र्यम्बकादपि
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ tu ye ca bharttāraste me bahumatā mudā | guṇaiścāpyadhikāḥ sarve bhartuste tryambakādapi
verses.translation: The lord cut off the fifth head*®® of Brahma who stubbornly and repeatedly censured Siva calling him "O son."
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord cut off the fifth head*®® of Brahma who stubbornly and repeatedly censured Siva calling him "O son."
verses.science: भागोंमें विभक्त हो गया। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तब्धात्मा तामसः शर्वः त्वमिमं समुपाश्रिता । तेन त्वामवमन्येऽहं प्रतिकूलो हि मे भवः
verses.transliteration: stabdhātmā tāmasaḥ śarvaḥ tvamimaṃ samupāśritā | tena tvāmavamanye'haṃ pratikūlo hi me bhavaḥ
verses.translation: In the form of a Sarabha he forcefully attacked Visnu the man-lion. Pressing him with his feet he tore off his heart by his sharp claws.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the form of a Sarabha he forcefully attacked Visnu the man-lion. Pressing him with his feet he tore off his heart by his sharp claws.
verses.science: मध्यमें यह लिंग उपस्थित हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तथोक्ता पितरं दक्षं क्रुद्धा देवी तमब्रवीत् । शृण्वतामेव सर्वेषां ये यज्ञसदसि स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tathoktā pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ kruddhā devī tamabravīt | śṛṇvatāmeva sarveṣāṃ ye yajñasadasi sthitāḥ
verses.translation: With the sacrifice of Daksa for a pretext none among the gods or their womenfolk was spared from punish¬ ment by the heroic Vlrabhadra.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: With the sacrifice of Daksa for a pretext none among the gods or their womenfolk was spared from punish¬ ment by the heroic Vlrabhadra.
verses.science: ॥ इस प्रकार पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मान्मम भर्तारमजाताशेषदूषणम् । वाचा दूषयसे दक्ष साक्षाल्लोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: akasmānmama bhartāramajātāśeṣadūṣaṇam | vācā dūṣayase dakṣa sākṣāllokamaheśvaram
verses.translation: The three cities® along with the Dailyas, their womenfolk and chilclivn were made the fuel for the fire from his eyes in an instant by him.
verses.hindi: लिड्डस्यापि च बेरस्थ शिवेन विहित॑ यथा॥ ९ शिवजीने कहा था
verses.commentary: Sense: The three cities® along with the Dailyas, their womenfolk and chilclivn were made the fuel for the fire from his eyes in an instant by him.
verses.science: लिड्डस्यापि च बेरस्थ शिवेन विहित॑ यथा॥ ९ शिवजीने कहा था। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्याचौरो गुरुद्रोही वेदेश्वरविदूषकः । त एते बहुपाप्मानः सर्वे दण्ड्या इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: vidyācauro gurudrohī vedeśvaravidūṣakaḥ | ta ete bahupāpmānaḥ sarve daṇḍyā iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Kama the husband of Rati, the cause of the sexual pleasure of the people was consigned to the fire from his eyes even as the gods were lamenting.
verses.hindi: रात अथवा एक राततक अधिवासन कराये
verses.commentary: Sense: Kama the husband of Rati, the cause of the sexual pleasure of the people was consigned to the fire from his eyes even as the gods were lamenting.
verses.science: रात अथवा एक राततक अधिवासन कराये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादत्युत्कटस्यास्य पापस्य सदृशो भृशम् । सहसा दारुणो दण्डस्तव दैवाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmādatyutkaṭasyāsya pāpasya sadṛśo bhṛśam | sahasā dāruṇo daṇḍastava daivādbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Angrily glancing at some cows walking along the sky and.shedding milk over his head he reduced them to ashes immediately.
verses.hindi: और हा करते हुए उसे शयनस्थानपर ले जाय
verses.commentary: Sense: Angrily glancing at some cows walking along the sky and.shedding milk over his head he reduced them to ashes immediately.
verses.science: और हा करते हुए उसे शयनस्थानपर ले जाय। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वया न पूजितो यस्माद्देवदेवस्त्रियम्बकः । तस्मात्तव कुलं दुष्टं नष्टमित्यवधारय
verses.transliteration: tvayā na pūjito yasmāddevadevastriyambakaḥ | tasmāttava kulaṃ duṣṭaṃ naṣṭamityavadhāraya
verses.translation: The family of cruel demons who desired to kill him was scorched in fire. The chest of Andhaka was pierced with the trident.
verses.hindi: शुद्ध जलसे लिंगको स्नान कराकर क्रमसे पूजन करे
verses.commentary: Sense: The family of cruel demons who desired to kill him was scorched in fire. The chest of Andhaka was pierced with the trident.
verses.science: शुद्ध जलसे लिंगको स्नान कराकर क्रमसे पूजन करे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा पितरं रुष्टा सती सन्त्यक्तसाध्वसा । तदीयां च तनुं त्यक्त्वा हिमवन्तं ययौ गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā pitaraṃ ruṣṭā satī santyaktasādhvasā | tadīyāṃ ca tanuṃ tyaktvā himavantaṃ yayau girim
verses.translation: The detaiU of this episode reir.nin untraced.
verses.commentary: Sense: The detaiU of this episode reir.nin untraced.
verses.science: अनुसार शिवालयका निर्माण करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स पर्वतपरः श्रीमाँल्लब्धपुण्यफलोदयः । तदर्थमेव कृतवान् सुचिरं दुश्चरं तपः
verses.transliteration: sa parvataparaḥ śrīmām̐llabdhapuṇyaphalodayaḥ | tadarthameva kṛtavān suciraṃ duścaraṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: The lord, requested by Brahma for the destruction of the leading Daitya Taraka*** the enemy of Indra, went to his harem on the Mandara mountion.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत रख सारा दपय पाम वदतरिंशोउ ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, requested by Brahma for the destruction of the leading Daitya Taraka*** the enemy of Indra, went to his harem on the Mandara mountion.
verses.science: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत रख सारा दपय पाम वदतरिंशोउ ध्याय:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तमनुगृह्णाति भूधरेश्वरमीश्वरी । स्वेच्छया पितरं चक्रे स्वात्मनो योगमायया
verses.transliteration: tasmāttamanugṛhṇāti bhūdhareśvaramīśvarī | svecchayā pitaraṃ cakre svātmano yogamāyayā
verses.translation: The lord indulged in sexual dalliance with the goddess for a long time. -Due to the excessive sport the earth appeared to sink - into the nether worlds. He deceived his own name and the goddess by withholding the discharge of semen in her. The unbearable semen was discharged into the fire like nectar or the sanctified Havis.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord indulged in sexual dalliance with the goddess for a long time. -Due to the excessive sport the earth appeared to sink - into the nether worlds. He deceived his own name and the goddess by withholding the discharge of semen in her.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord indulged in sexual dalliance with the goddess for a long time. -Due to the excessive sport the earth appeared to sink - into the nether worlds. He deceived his own name and the goddess by withholding the discharge of semen in her.…
verses.science: नामक छत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा गता सती दक्षं विनिन्द्य भयविह्वलम् । तदा तिरोहिता मन्त्रा विहतश्च ततोऽध्वरः
verses.transliteration: yadā gatā satī dakṣaṃ vinindya bhayavihvalam | tadā tirohitā mantrā vihataśca tato'dhvaraḥ
verses.translation: The fire cast it off into Ganga and other places. Svaha who assumed the form of the Krttikas and sported with her husband gathered the parts and deposited them in the Sara plants somewhere on the Meru. Svaha was turned into gold in the process.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire cast it off into Ganga and other places. Svaha who assumed the form of the Krttikas and sported with her husband gathered the parts and deposited them in the Sara plants somewhere on the Meru. Svaha was turned into gold in the process.
verses.science: ध्यानपूर्वक सुना है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदुपश्रुत्य गमनं देव्यास्त्रिपुरुमर्दनः । दक्षाय च ऋषिभ्यश्च चुकोप च शशाप तान्
verses.transliteration: tadupaśrutya gamanaṃ devyāstripurumardanaḥ | dakṣāya ca ṛṣibhyaśca cukopa ca śaśāpa tān
verses.translation: After some time her lustre illuminated quarters and the mountains. Meru itself was turned into gold.
verses.hindi: परम दुर्लभ योगका वर्णन सुनना चाहता हूँ
verses.commentary: Sense: After some time her lustre illuminated quarters and the mountains. Meru itself was turned into gold.
verses.science: परम दुर्लभ योगका वर्णन सुनना चाहता हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादवमता दक्षमत्कृतेऽनागसा सती । पूजिताश्चेतराः सर्वाः स्वसुता भर्तृभिः सह
verses.transliteration: yasmādavamatā dakṣamatkṛte'nāgasā satī | pūjitāścetarāḥ sarvāḥ svasutā bhartṛbhiḥ saha
verses.translation: After a long time the splendour grew into a boy of beautiful and tender limbs, a model for all boys.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a long time the splendour grew into a boy of beautiful and tender limbs, a model for all boys.
verses.science: तारतम्य क्या है ?। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे तस्मात्तव जामातरस्त्वमी । उत्पत्स्यन्ते समं सर्वे ब्रह्मयज्ञेष्वयोनिजाः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate'ntare tasmāttava jāmātarastvamī | utpatsyante samaṃ sarve brahmayajñeṣvayonijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him of charming features, the world of the gods, Asuras and mankind was surprised and fascinated.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him of charming features, the world of the gods, Asuras and mankind was surprised and fascinated.
verses.science: जाती है, उसे 'महायोग' कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भविता मानुषो राजा चाक्षुषस्य त्वमन्वये । प्राचीनबर्हिषः पौत्रः पुत्रश्चापि प्रचेतसः
verses.transliteration: bhavitā mānuṣo rājā cākṣuṣasya tvamanvaye | prācīnabarhiṣaḥ pautraḥ putraścāpi pracetasaḥ
verses.translation: The lord himself came there along with the goddess to sec his son. He took the boy on his lap. The gods and the sages though averse to worldly pleasures glanced at his smiling face. The lord made him play on his chest and enjoyed the fun. The lord and the goddess congratulated each other.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord himself came there along with the goddess to sec his son. He took the boy on his lap. The gods and the sages though averse to worldly pleasures glanced at his smiling face. The lord made him play on his chest and enjoyed the fun.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord himself came there along with the goddess to sec his son. He took the boy on his lap. The gods and the sages though averse to worldly pleasures glanced at his smiling face. The lord made him play on his chest and enjoyed the fun.…
verses.science: विरक्त होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अहं तत्रापि ते विघ्नमाचरिष्यामि दुर्मते । धर्मार्थकामयुक्तेषु कर्मस्वपि पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tatrāpi te vighnamācariṣyāmi durmate | dharmārthakāmayukteṣu karmasvapi punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: RS iv.chs. 1-1(1
verses.commentary: Sense: RS iv.chs. 1-1(1
verses.science: अपनी रुचिके अनुसार आसन। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवं व्याहृतो दक्षो रुद्रेणामिततेजसा । स्वायम्भुवीं तनुं त्यक्त्वा पपात भुवि दुःखितः
verses.transliteration: tenaivaṃ vyāhṛto dakṣo rudreṇāmitatejasā | svāyambhuvīṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā papāta bhuvi duḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: For a brahmin boy whose life came to an end and who sought refuge in him, the lord came there hurriedly and kicked Yama with his foot.
verses.commentary: Sense: For a brahmin boy whose life came to an end and who sought refuge in him, the lord came there hurriedly and kicked Yama with his foot.
verses.science: तारतम्यसे ये भेद बनते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राचेतसो दक्षो जज्ञे वै चाक्षुषेऽन्तरे । प्राचीनबर्हिषः पौत्रः पुत्रश्चैव प्रचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prācetaso dakṣo jajñe vai cākṣuṣe'ntare | prācīnabarhiṣaḥ pautraḥ putraścaiva pracetasām
verses.translation: By means of different activities blissfully beautiful and unknown to the people, the universe has been set to motion frequently.
verses.hindi: वातनर उत्तखण्डे योगगतिवर्णन॑ नाम सम्रत्रिशो5 ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of different activities blissfully beautiful and unknown to the people, the universe has been set to motion frequently.
verses.science: वातनर उत्तखण्डे योगगतिवर्णन॑ नाम सम्रत्रिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वादयोऽपि जाता वै मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य तु । अन्तरे ब्रह्मणो यज्ञे वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvādayo'pi jātā vai manorvaivasvatasya tu | antare brahmaṇo yajñe vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum
verses.translation: The variety of beginningless Karmans cannot be the restraining factor here. The Karman that is the cause is also effected by the lord.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंके संवादमें योगगतिवर्णन नामक सँतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.commentary: Sense: The variety of beginningless Karmans cannot be the restraining factor here. The Karman that is the cause is also effected by the lord.
verses.science: ऋषियोंके संवादमें योगगतिवर्णन नामक सँतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा दक्षस्य धर्मार्थं प्रवृत्तस्य दुरात्मनः । महेशः कृतवान् विघ्नं मनौ वैवस्वते सति
verses.transliteration: tadā dakṣasya dharmārthaṃ pravṛttasya durātmanaḥ | maheśaḥ kṛtavān vighnaṃ manau vaivasvate sati
verses.translation: I shall mention authoritative testimonies in this context quelling your delusions. The wickedness of the wicked is due to the absence of the grace of the lord.
verses.hindi: दशते युझ्ञतां पुंसामन्तराया: प्रकीर्तिता:॥ २  योगमार्गके विष्न कहे गये हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention authoritative testimonies in this context quelling your delusions. The wickedness of the wicked is due to the absence of the grace of the lord.
verses.science: दशते युझ्ञतां पुंसामन्तराया: प्रकीर्तिता:॥ २ योगमार्गके विष्न कहे गये हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Siva in the form of the idol, whereby despite its beings Saguna the Niskala is realised, is called Saivamurti only in a figurative use.
verses.hindi: श्राप्त होती हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva in the form of the idol, whereby despite its beings Saguna the Niskala is realised, is called Saivamurti only in a figurative use.
verses.science: श्राप्त होती हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Siva in the form of the idol, whereby despite its beings Saguna the Niskala is realised, is called Saivamurti only in a figurative use.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva in the form of the idol, whereby despite its beings Saguna the Niskala is realised, is called Saivamurti only in a figurative use.
verses.science: ध्यान अवश्य करते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । वीरभद्रोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । कथं दक्षस्य धर्मार्थं प्रवृत्तस्य दुरात्मनः । महेशः कृतवान् विघ्नमेतदिच्छाम वेदितुम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.19. ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vīrabhadrotpattivarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | kathaṃ dakṣasya dharmārthaṃ pravṛttasya durātmanaḥ | maheśaḥ kṛtavān vighnametadicchāma veditum
verses.translation: The state of being understood through the testimonies alone indicates his nature. Merely on acco mt of this it should not be treated with indifference without the implication.
verses.commentary: Sense: The state of being understood through the testimonies alone indicates his nature. Merely on acco mt of this it should not be treated with indifference without the implication.
verses.science: शिवरूपका अवश्य चिन्तन करना चाहिए। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । विश्वस्य जगतो मातुरपि देव्यास्तपोबलात् । पितृभावमुपागम्य मुदिते हिमवद्गिरौ
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | viśvasya jagato māturapi devyāstapobalāt | pitṛbhāvamupāgamya mudite himavadgirau
verses.translation: Perpetrators of improper actions arc to be decried and despised by a judicious person. Improper action is that which afflicts and harasses the world.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अत मल ध्याय:
verses.commentary: Sense: Perpetrators of improper actions arc to be decried and despised by a judicious person. Improper action is that which afflicts and harasses the world.
verses.science: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अत मल ध्याय:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवेऽपि तत्कृतोद्वाहे हिमवच्छिखरालये । सङ्क्रीडति तया सार्द्धं काले बहुतरे गते
verses.transliteration: deve'pi tatkṛtodvāhe himavacchikharālaye | saṅkrīḍati tayā sārddhaṃ kāle bahutare gate
verses.translation: Even the innate nature of the entities is the cause of what is destined to be. The innate nature does not transform that what perishes. The contact with fire melts only gold and not the coal. Siva liberates those whose ignorance is ripe and not the others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the innate nature of the entities is the cause of what is destined to be. The innate nature does not transform that what perishes. The contact with fire melts only gold and not the coal. Siva liberates those whose ignorance is ripe and not the others.
verses.science: कर्पू्रकान्तिधवलाय. जटाधराय दारिद्धयदुःखदहनाय. नमः: शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते दक्षः प्राचेतसः स्वयम् । अश्वमेधेन यज्ञेन यक्ष्यमाणोऽन्वपद्यत
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate'ntare prāpte dakṣaḥ prācetasaḥ svayam | aśvamedhena yajñena yakṣyamāṇo'nvapadyata
verses.translation: Siva presides over all these, those with single, two and three dirts. Though they arc of non-iva nature they are presided over by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva presides over all these, those with single, two and three dirts. Though they arc of non-iva nature they are presided over by Siva.
verses.science: मातड्ुचर्मवसनाय महेश्वाय दारिक्दुःखदहनाय. नमः शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो हिमवतः पृष्ठे दक्षो वै यज्ञमाहरत् । गङ्गाद्वारे शुभे देशे ऋषिसिद्धनिषेविते
verses.transliteration: tato himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe dakṣo vai yajñamāharat | gaṅgādvāre śubhe deśe ṛṣisiddhaniṣevite
verses.translation: Coming to the conclusion that salvation is not possible without direct knowledge, strive assiduously for the acquisition of practice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coming to the conclusion that salvation is not possible without direct knowledge, strive assiduously for the acquisition of practice.
verses.science: स्वीकार की जाती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तस्मिन्मखे देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः । गमनाय समागम्य बुद्धिमापेदिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: tasya tasminmakhe devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ | gamanāya samāgamya buddhimāpedire tadā
verses.translation: They are all Pasupatas and exponents of the Samhitas. Hundreds and thousands of their descendants have been the pi eceptors of their principles.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are all Pasupatas and exponents of the Samhitas. Hundreds and thousands of their descendants have been the pi eceptors of their principles.
verses.science: शैक्योगवर्णन॑ नामेकरोनचत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याः सह मरुद्गणैः । ऊष्मपाः सोमपाश्चैव आज्यपा धूमपास्तथा
verses.transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ | ūṣmapāḥ somapāścaiva ājyapā dhūmapāstathā
verses.translation: Siva pervades all living beings, the principles and elements. He is wakefully present in the bodies and presides over them. Hence he is called Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva pervades all living beings, the principles and elements. He is wakefully present in the bodies and presides over them. Hence he is called Visnu.
verses.science: नामक उनतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अश्विनौ पितरश्चैव तथा चान्ये महर्षयः । विष्णुना सहिताः सर्वे स्वागता यज्ञभागिनः
verses.transliteration: aśvinau pitaraścaiva tathā cānye maharṣayaḥ | viṣṇunā sahitāḥ sarve svāgatā yajñabhāginaḥ
verses.translation: Siva is called the physician of the universe. Just as the physician who is conversant with the pathology diagnoses and cures the ailment with medicines so also the lord anni¬ hilates the worldly existence along with its roots. He is so called by all those who understand the nature of principles.
verses.wordMeaning: Siva is called the physician of the universe. Just as the physician who is conversant with the pathology diagnoses and cures the ailment with medicines so also the lord anni¬ hilates the worldly existence along with its roots.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva is called the physician of the universe. Just as the physician who is conversant with the pathology diagnoses and cures the ailment with medicines so also the lord anni¬ hilates the worldly existence along with its roots.…
verses.hindi: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तहिंतो5भूत्॥ १  आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.science: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तहिंतो5भूत्॥ १ आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवकुलं सर्वमीश्वरेण विना गतम् । दधीचो मन्युनाविष्टो दक्षमेवमभाषत
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devakulaṃ sarvamīśvareṇa vinā gatam | dadhīco manyunāviṣṭo dakṣamevamabhāṣata
verses.translation: Even when they have the sense-organs for compre¬ hending the ten objects of sensual perception, the atoms do not know the beings gross and subtle, present in the three periods of time, in their entirety because they arc hidden by the particles of dirt in the form of Maya, whereas Sadaiva has not these causes of perception. Even when they are not present, he knows without any strain every object as it is. Hence, he is Sarvajna (omniscient).
verses.wordMeaning: Even when they have the sense-organs for compre¬ hending the ten objects of sensual perception, the atoms do not know the beings gross and subtle, present in the three periods of time, in their entirety because they arc hidden by the particles of dirt in the form of Maya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when they have the sense-organs for compre¬ hending the ten objects of sensual perception, the atoms do not know the beings gross and subtle, present in the three periods of time, in their entirety because they arc hidden by the particles of dirt in the form of Maya,…
verses.science: पकड़कर वे आगे बढ़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच । अप्यपूज्ये चैव पूजा पूज्यानां चाप्यपूजने । नरः पापमवाप्नोति महद्वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dadhīca uvāca | apyapūjye caiva pūjā pūjyānāṃ cāpyapūjane | naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahadvai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Some form, intense with the similarity of Atman, is l§iva*s idol. The other, the great one, the Atman of the Murti is its implication.
verses.hindi: ही कोई प्रवाहरूपा संतति ' ध्यान' कहलाती है
verses.commentary: Sense: Some form, intense with the similarity of Atman, is l§iva*s idol. The other, the great one, the Atman of the Murti is its implication.
verses.science: ही कोई प्रवाहरूपा संतति ' ध्यान' कहलाती है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: असतां सम्मतिर्यत्र सतामवमतिस्तथा । दण्डो देवकृतस्तत्र सद्यः पतति दारुणः
verses.transliteration: asatāṃ sammatiryatra satāmavamatistathā | daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Just as fire cannot be obtained without its being r mounted in the twigs so also Siva is not known or under¬ stood without its being superimposed in the idol.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as fire cannot be obtained without its being r mounted in the twigs so also Siva is not known or under¬ stood without its being superimposed in the idol.
verses.science: स्वीकार की जाती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु विप्रर्षिः पुनर्दक्षमभाषत । पूज्यं तु पशुभर्तारं कस्मान्नार्चयसे प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu viprarṣiḥ punardakṣamabhāṣata | pūjyaṃ tu paśubhartāraṃ kasmānnārcayase prabhum
verses.translation: If some ohe says "Bring fire," only the burning twig is brought. The fire by itself is not brought. In the same way Siva is to be worshipped in the form of the idol.
verses.commentary: Sense: If some ohe says "Bring fire," only the burning twig is brought. The fire by itself is not brought. In the same way Siva is to be worshipped in the form of the idol.
verses.science: शैक्योगवर्णन॑ नामेकरोनचत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । सन्ति मे बहवो रुद्राः शूलहस्ताः कपर्दिनः । एकादशावस्थिता ये नान्यं वेद्मि महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dakṣa uvāca | santi me bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ | ekādaśāvasthitā ye nānyaṃ vedmi maheśvaram
verses.translation: In the form of different idols, phallic etc. and particularly in Area (offerings of flowers etc. ) Siva is worshipped by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the form of different idols, phallic etc. and particularly in Area (offerings of flowers etc. ) Siva is worshipped by us.
verses.science: नामक उनतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच । किमेभिरमरैरन्यैः पूजितैरध्वरे फलम् । राजा चेदध्वरस्यास्य न रुद्रः पूज्यते त्वया
verses.transliteration: dadhīca uvāca | kimebhiramarairanyaiḥ pūjitairadhvare phalam | rājā cedadhvarasyāsya na rudraḥ pūjyate tvayā
verses.translation: The Murtyatmans, Sadasiva and others are presided over by Siva for blessing the worlds.
verses.hindi: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तहिंतो5भूत्॥ १  आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murtyatmans, Sadasiva and others are presided over by Siva for blessing the worlds.
verses.science: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तहिंतो5भूत्॥ १ आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां स्रष्टा यः प्रभुरव्ययः । ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्य कैङ्कर्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ sraṣṭā yaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ | brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yasya kaiṅkaryavādinaḥ
verses.translation: Siva blessess every one. He does not curb any. It is impossible to attribute to Siva those faults which are ysually present in those who kill.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva blessess every one. He does not curb any. It is impossible to attribute to Siva those faults which are ysually present in those who kill.
verses.science: पकड़कर वे आगे बढ़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतीनां परश्चैव पुरुषस्य च यः परः । चिन्त्यते योगविद्वद्भिरृषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: prakṛtīnāṃ paraścaiva puruṣasya ca yaḥ paraḥ | cintyate yogavidvadbhirṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: Surely Srikantha has the overlordship of the universe. Siva presides over the Murti Srikantha in the course of his divine sport.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surely Srikantha has the overlordship of the universe. Siva presides over the Murti Srikantha in the course of his divine sport.
verses.science: शैवयोगवर्णन॑ नामैकोनचत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं परमं ब्रह्म ह्यसच्च सदसच्च यत् । अनादिमध्यनिधनमप्रतर्क्यं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma hyasacca sadasacca yat | anādimadhyanidhanamapratarkyaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Only the gods and others who were faulty were restrained or slain by him as described above. Thereby the gods became sinners and the people free from ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only the gods and others who were faulty were restrained or slain by him as described above. Thereby the gods became sinners and the people free from ailments.
verses.science: नामक उनतालीसबाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यः स्रष्टा चैव संहर्ता भर्ता चैव महेश्वरः । तस्मादन्यं न पश्यामि शङ्करात्मानमध्वरे
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sraṣṭā caiva saṃhartā bhartā caiva maheśvaraḥ | tasmādanyaṃ na paśyāmi śaṅkarātmānamadhvare
verses.translation: The wish of the lord comprises the establishment of rules and conditions. Brahma is the commandment. His order is the mode of direction such as, "This shall be done. This shall not be done."
verses.hindi: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तर्हितो5भूत्॥ ९१ आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.commentary: Sense: The wish of the lord comprises the establishment of rules and conditions. Brahma is the commandment. His order is the mode of direction such as, "This shall be done. This shall not be done."
verses.science: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तर्हितो5भूत्॥ ९१ आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । एतन्मखेशस्य सुवर्णपात्रे हविः समस्तं विधिमन्त्रपूतम् । विष्णोर्नयाम्यप्रतिमस्य भागं प्रभोर्विभज्याहवनीयमद्य
verses.transliteration: dakṣa uvāca | etanmakheśasya suvarṇapātre haviḥ samastaṃ vidhimantrapūtam | viṣṇornayāmyapratimasya bhāgaṃ prabhorvibhajyāhavanīyamadya
verses.translation: The characteristic of a man of good nature is the strict adherence to his directives; the opposite thereof is that of the non-saintly one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic of a man of good nature is the strict adherence to his directives; the opposite thereof is that of the non-saintly one.
verses.science: पकड़कर वे आगे बढ़े। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच । यस्मान्नाराधितो रुद्रः सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरः । तस्माद्दक्ष तवाशेषो यज्ञोऽयं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: dadhīca uvāca | yasmānnārādhito rudraḥ sarvadeveśvareśvaraḥ | tasmāddakṣa tavāśeṣo yajño'yaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The lord does not injure others though guilty, otherwise. Of course, he injures the ignorant by adopting neutrality.
verses.hindi: भरे हुए वृक्ष उसे आच्छादित किये रहते हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord does not injure others though guilty, otherwise. Of course, he injures the ignorant by adopting neutrality.
verses.science: भरे हुए वृक्ष उसे आच्छादित किये रहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं क्रुद्धो दधीचो मुनिसत्तमः । निर्गम्य च ततो देशाज्जगाम स्वकमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā vacanaṃ kruddho dadhīco munisattamaḥ | nirgamya ca tato deśājjagāma svakamāśramam
verses.translation: Hence we shall say that he who inflicts injury
verses.hindi: देकर वे फिर महादेवजीके पास चले गये
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence we shall say that he who inflicts injury
verses.science: देकर वे फिर महादेवजीके पास चले गये। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्गतेऽपि मुनौ तस्मिन्देवा दक्षं न तत्यजुः । अवश्यमनुभावित्वादनर्थस्य तु भाविनः
verses.transliteration: nirgate'pi munau tasmindevā dakṣaṃ na tatyajuḥ | avaśyamanubhāvitvādanarthasya tu bhāvinaḥ
verses.translation: Ruthlcssness cannot be attributed to the surgeon who operates upon the patient. The inducing factor is kind¬ ness alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ruthlcssness cannot be attributed to the surgeon who operates upon the patient. The inducing factor is kind¬ ness alone.
verses.science: नरक प्रदान करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ज्ञात्वैतत्सर्वमीश्वरात् । दग्धुं दक्षाध्वरं विप्रा देवी देवमचोदयत्
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu jñātvaitatsarvamīśvarāt | dagdhuṃ dakṣādhvaraṃ viprā devī devamacodayat
verses.translation: Even neglect and indifference for the opponents who ought to he protected, results in default. He who ought to be protected perishes immediately if neglected despite the capacity of the protector.
verses.hindi: अन्तमें निश्चय ही मोक्ष देता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Even neglect and indifference for the opponents who ought to he protected, results in default. He who ought to be protected perishes immediately if neglected despite the capacity of the protector.
verses.science: अन्तमें निश्चय ही मोक्ष देता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्या सञ्चोदितो देवो दक्षाध्वरजिघांसया । ससर्ज सहसा वीरं वीरभद्रं गणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: devyā sañcodito devo dakṣādhvarajighāṃsayā | sasarja sahasā vīraṃ vīrabhadraṃ gaṇeśvaram
verses.translation: He wno neglects the man worthy of being protected
verses.commentary: Sense: He wno neglects the man worthy of being protected
verses.science: सब प्रकारसे मंगल ही हो। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रवदनं देवं सहस्रकमलेक्षणम् । सहस्रमुद्गरधरं सहस्रशरपाणिकम्
verses.transliteration: sahasravadanaṃ devaṃ sahasrakamalekṣaṇam | sahasramudgaradharaṃ sahasraśarapāṇikam
verses.translation: In reality there are the defects of passion, etc., in the Murtyatmans (Sadaiiva, Brahma and others). Still the defects belong to them alone and not to Siva. There may be flaw in the copper put in fire but due to its contact fire does not fade. If impure things are consigned to fire they do not make the fire impure. Some impure things become pure due to their contact with fire. Similarly Siva does not become impure due to the contact with the Atmans that are to be purified.
verses.wordMeaning: In reality there are the defects of passion, etc., in the Murtyatmans (Sadaiiva, Brahma and others). Still the defects belong to them alone and not to Siva. There may be flaw in the copper put in fire but due to its contact fire does not fade.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In reality there are the defects of passion, etc., in the Murtyatmans (Sadaiiva, Brahma and others). Still the defects belong to them alone and not to Siva. There may be flaw in the copper put in fire but due to its contact fire does not fade.…
verses.science: इसका उपदेश नहीं देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शूलटङ्कगदाहस्तं दीप्तकार्मुकधारिणम् । चक्रवज्रधरं घोरं चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: śūlaṭaṅkagadāhastaṃ dīptakārmukadhāriṇam | cakravajradharaṃ ghoraṃ candrārddhakṛtaśekharam
verses.translation: The prosperity, glory etc. of the Murtyatmans is really that of lord Siva and not of the Atmans. It is the fire, not the fuel, that blazes upwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: The prosperity, glory etc. of the Murtyatmans is really that of lord Siva and not of the Atmans. It is the fire, not the fuel, that blazes upwards.
verses.science: इसका श्रवण करना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुलिशोद्योतितकरं तडिज्ज्वलितमूर्द्धजम् । दंष्ट्राकरालं बिभ्राणं महावक्त्रं महोदरम्
verses.transliteration: kuliśodyotitakaraṃ taḍijjvalitamūrddhajam | daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ mahāvaktraṃ mahodaram
verses.translation: The state of being the coal belongs to the wood and not to the fire. Similarly Sivatva is imposed on wood, stone and clay. But the attributes Maitri, etc., are secondary and they act differently. They are conducive to both good and evil to those who are endowed with qualities. What is both secondary and non- secondary is not wholly conducive to good or evil.
verses.wordMeaning: The state of being the coal belongs to the wood and not to the fire. Similarly Sivatva is imposed on wood, stone and clay. But the attributes Maitri, etc., are secondary and they act differently. They are conducive to both good and evil to those who are endowed with qualities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The state of being the coal belongs to the wood and not to the fire. Similarly Sivatva is imposed on wood, stone and clay. But the attributes Maitri, etc., are secondary and they act differently. They are conducive to both good and evil to those who are endowed with qualities.…
verses.science: साक्षात् दर्शन प्राप्त किया है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्युज्जिह्वं प्रलम्बोष्ठं मेघसागरनिःस्वनम् । वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं महद्रुधिरनिस्रवम्
verses.transliteration: vidyujjihvaṃ pralamboṣṭhaṃ meghasāgaraniḥsvanam | vasānaṃ carma vaiyāghraṃ mahadrudhiranisravam
verses.translation: The sense of the word Upakara ( benevolence) is also Anughraha. Since that too is of beneficent nature Siva is all-benevolent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sense of the word Upakara ( benevolence) is also Anughraha. Since that too is of beneficent nature Siva is all-benevolent.
verses.science: श्रीशिवमहापुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नामैकचत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: गण्डद्वितयसंसृष्टमण्डलीकृतकुण्डलम् । वरामरशिरोमालावलीकलितशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇḍadvitayasaṃsṛṣṭamaṇḍalīkṛtakuṇḍalam | varāmaraśiromālāvalīkalitaśekharam
verses.translation: Everything in the form of sentient and non- sentient is engaged in what is beneficent? But obstructed by
verses.hindi: श्रीजिवमहापुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णण नामक इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण डक
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything in the form of sentient and non- sentient is engaged in what is beneficent? But obstructed by
verses.science: श्रीजिवमहापुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णण नामक इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण डक। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रणन्नूपुरकेयूरमहाकनकभूषितम् । रत्नसञ्चयसन्दीप्तं तारहारावृतोरसम्
verses.transliteration: raṇannūpurakeyūramahākanakabhūṣitam | ratnasañcayasandīptaṃ tārahārāvṛtorasam
verses.translation: Should it be extraneous it may happen to anyone through any cause. But this cause is single due to its nature not being variegated.
verses.hindi: समान धवल वर्णवाले, जटाधारी और दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: Should it be extraneous it may happen to anyone through any cause. But this cause is single due to its nature not being variegated.
verses.science: समान धवल वर्णवाले, जटाधारी और दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महाशरभशार्दूलसिंहैः सदृशविक्रमम् । प्रशस्तमत्तमातङ्गसमानगमनालसम्
verses.transliteration: mahāśarabhaśārdūlasiṃhaiḥ sadṛśavikramam | praśastamattamātaṅgasamānagamanālasam
verses.translation: Though the Atman-hood is common some are bound and some liberated. Among those in bondage some have differing degrees of knowledge and eminence due to their being inclined towards abstinence and enjoyment. Some attain the status of identicality with the lord. Some attain the state of nearness.
verses.wordMeaning: Though the Atman-hood is common some are bound and some liberated. Among those in bondage some have differing degrees of knowledge and eminence due to their being inclined towards abstinence and enjoyment. Some attain the status of identicality with the lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though the Atman-hood is common some are bound and some liberated. Among those in bondage some have differing degrees of knowledge and eminence due to their being inclined towards abstinence and enjoyment. Some attain the status of identicality with the lord.…
verses.science: गड़ाधधाय गजराजविमर्दनाय दारिकद््यदुःखदहनाय. नमः. शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचामरकुन्देन्दुमृणालसदृशप्रभम् । सतुषारमिवाद्रीन्द्रं साक्षाज्जङ्गमतां गतम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacāmarakundendumṛṇālasadṛśaprabham | satuṣāramivādrīndraṃ sākṣājjaṅgamatāṃ gatam
verses.translation: Among those who have attained identicality, some are Sivas. They are stationed on the top of the Adhvas (pathways). Mahesvaras are stationed in the middle; Rudras in the lower region.
verses.hindi: विनाशक' भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those who have attained identicality, some are Sivas. They are stationed on the top of the Adhvas (pathways). Mahesvaras are stationed in the middle; Rudras in the lower region.
verses.science: विनाशक' भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालापरिक्षिप्तं दीप्तमौक्तिकभूषणम् । तेजसा चैव दीव्यन्तं युगान्त इव पावकम्
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālāparikṣiptaṃ dīptamauktikabhūṣaṇam | tejasā caiva dīvyantaṃ yugānta iva pāvakam
verses.translation: In the vicinity too the three are stationed beyond Maya: the Atman is stationed below; the Antarat- man i'* stationed 'n the middle and the Paramatman is stationed beyond. They are Brahma, Vi§nu and Mahesvara. Some Vasus too are stationed in the region of Paramatman.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the vicinity too the three are stationed beyond Maya: the Atman is stationed below; the Antarat- man i'* stationed 'n the middle and the Paramatman is stationed beyond. They are Brahma, Vi§nu and Mahesvara. Some Vasus too are stationed in the region of Paramatman.
verses.science: :खदहनाय. नमः: शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स जानुभ्यां महीं गत्वा प्रणतः प्राञ्जलिस्ततः । पार्श्वतो देवदेवस्य पर्यतिष्ठद् गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa jānubhyāṃ mahīṃ gatvā praṇataḥ prāñjalistataḥ | pārśvato devadevasya paryatiṣṭhad gaṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Some are stationed in the region of Antaratman, some in the region of Atman. In the region of Santyatita Saivas are stationed and in the iSanta region the Mahesvaras are stationed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are stationed in the region of Antaratman, some in the region of Atman. In the region of Santyatita Saivas are stationed and in the iSanta region the Mahesvaras are stationed.
verses.science: आनन्दभूमिवदाय. तमोमयाय दारिद्यदुःखदहनाय. नमः. शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्युना चासृजद्भद्रां भद्रकालीं महेश्वरीम् । आत्मनः कर्मसाक्षित्वे तेन गन्तुं सहैव तु
verses.transliteration: manyunā cāsṛjadbhadrāṃ bhadrakālīṃ maheśvarīm | ātmanaḥ karmasākṣitve tena gantuṃ sahaiva tu
verses.translation: Just as Raudras are stationed in Vidya and the Vaisnavas in Pratistha, so also the Atmans. Brahma and Brahma-born are stationed in Nivrlti.
verses.hindi: लिये तमोगुणाविष्ट होनेवाले तथा दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as Raudras are stationed in Vidya and the Vaisnavas in Pratistha, so also the Atmans. Brahma and Brahma-born are stationed in Nivrlti.
verses.science: लिये तमोगुणाविष्ट होनेवाले तथा दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वावस्थितं वीरभद्रं कालाग्निसन्निभम् । भद्रया सहितं प्राह भद्रमस्त्विति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvāvasthitaṃ vīrabhadraṃ kālāgnisannibham | bhadrayā sahitaṃ prāha bhadramastviti śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The eight groups of Deva-Beings are the chief ones. The human beings constitute the middling. The five Beings birdes etc. constitute the lower ones. Thus there are fourteen Beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight groups of Deva-Beings are the chief ones. The human beings constitute the middling. The five Beings birdes etc. constitute the lower ones. Thus there are fourteen Beings.
verses.science: नेत्रत्रयाय. शुभलक्षणलक्षिताय. दारिद्धयदुःखदहनाय. नम: शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स च विज्ञापयामास सह देव्या महेश्वरम् । आज्ञापय महादेव किं कार्यं करवाण्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sa ca vijñāpayāmāsa saha devyā maheśvaram | ājñāpaya mahādeva kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇyaham
verses.translation: The state of being chief or subsidiary shall be known as the dirt of the worldly being. Just as the food we take in has two states, the undigested and the digested, so the dirt too. When it is undigested the men go lower down; when it is digested they go up. Thus the dirt plays its part in the worldly existence.
verses.hindi: विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The state of being chief or subsidiary shall be known as the dirt of the worldly being. Just as the food we take in has two states, the undigested and the digested, so the dirt too. When it is undigested the men go lower down; when it is digested they go up.…
