verses.commentary: Sense: The state of being chief or subsidiary shall be known as the dirt of the worldly being. Just as the food we take in has two states, the undigested and the digested, so the dirt too. When it is undigested the men go lower down; when it is digested they go up.…
verses.science: विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रिपुरहा प्राह हैमवत्याः प्रियेच्छया । वीरभद्रं महाबाहुं वाचा विपुलनादया
verses.transliteration: tatastripurahā prāha haimavatyāḥ priyecchayā | vīrabhadraṃ mahābāhuṃ vācā vipulanādayā
verses.translation: The individual souls are threefold: those with single dirt, with two dirts and with three dirts. Those with single dirt are the higher ones, those with two dirts the middlings and those with three dirts shall be known as-Uu" meanest. Thus they are stationed in order,
verses.hindi: पुण्येषु. पुण्यभरिताय सुराचिताय दारिद्यदुःखदहनाय नम: शिवाय
verses.commentary: Sense: The individual souls are threefold: those with single dirt, with two dirts and with three dirts. Those with single dirt are the higher ones, those with two dirts the middlings and those with three dirts shall be known as-Uu" meanest. Thus they are stationed in order,
verses.science: पुण्येषु. पुण्यभरिताय सुराचिताय दारिद्यदुःखदहनाय नम: शिवाय। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । प्राचेतसस्य दक्षस्य यज्ञं सद्यो विनाशय । भद्रकाल्या सहासि त्वमेतत्कृत्यं गणेश्वर
verses.transliteration: mahādeva uvāca | prācetasasya dakṣasya yajñaṃ sadyo vināśaya | bhadrakālyā sahāsi tvametatkṛtyaṃ gaṇeśvara
verses.translation: Those with three dirts are presided over by those with two dirts and those in turn are presided over by those with single dirt. Thus is the conditioned difference in the universe.
verses.hindi: तथा दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है
verses.commentary: Sense: Those with three dirts are presided over by those with two dirts and those in turn are presided over by those with single dirt. Thus is the conditioned difference in the universe.
verses.science: तथा दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहमप्यनया सार्द्धं रैभ्याश्रमसपीपतः । स्थित्वा वीक्षे गणेशान विक्रमं तव दुःसहम्
verses.transliteration: ahamapyanayā sārddhaṃ raibhyāśramasapīpataḥ | sthitvā vīkṣe gaṇeśāna vikramaṃ tava duḥsaham
verses.translation: They are the squatters in heaven, atmosphere and earth. They are the gods observing the rites of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the squatters in heaven, atmosphere and earth. They are the gods observing the rites of the gods.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाः कनखले ये तु गङ्गाद्वारसमीपगाः । सुवर्णशृङ्गस्य गिरेर्मेरुमन्दरसन्निभाः
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāḥ kanakhale ye tu gaṅgādvārasamīpagāḥ | suvarṇaśṛṅgasya girermerumandarasannibhāḥ
verses.translation: Thus functions the ailment of worldly existence with the three dirts and their pathological reasons separately, whether ripe or unripe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus functions the ailment of worldly existence with the three dirts and their pathological reasons separately, whether ripe or unripe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे दक्षस्य युज्ञः सम्प्रति वर्तते । सहसा तस्य यज्ञस्य विघातं कुरु मा चिरम्
verses.transliteration: tasminpradeśe dakṣasya yujñaḥ samprati vartate | sahasā tasya yajñasya vighātaṃ kuru mā ciram
verses.translation: In this regard no doubt need be entertained — "Siva can liberate the souls without subjecting them to misery. Why does he then subject them to misery?"
verses.commentary: Sense: In this regard no doubt need be entertained — "Siva can liberate the souls without subjecting them to misery. Why does he then subject them to misery?"
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते सति देवेन देवी हिमगिरीन्द्रजा । भद्रं भद्रां च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वत्सं धेनुरिवौरसम्
verses.transliteration: ityukte sati devena devī himagirīndrajā | bhadraṃ bhadrāṃ ca samprekṣya vatsaṃ dhenurivaurasam
verses.translation: A patient does not become non-patient merely be¬ cause the physician administers medicine. The physician redeems the patient from the sickness through the medicines.
verses.commentary: Sense: A patient does not become non-patient merely be¬ cause the physician administers medicine. The physician redeems the patient from the sickness through the medicines.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आलिङ्ग्य च समाघ्राय मूर्ध्नि षड्वदनं यथा । सस्मिता वचनं प्राह मधुरं मधुरं स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: āliṅgya ca samāghrāya mūrdhni ṣaḍvadanaṃ yathā | sasmitā vacanaṃ prāha madhuraṃ madhuraṃ svayam
verses.translation: Similarly, through the administration of the medi¬ cine in the form of his Ajfia, Siva liberates the souls from misery — the souls innately dirty and innately miserable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, through the administration of the medi¬ cine in the form of his Ajfia, Siva liberates the souls from misery — the souls innately dirty and innately miserable.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । वत्स भद्र महाभाग महाबलपराक्रम । मत्प्रियार्थं त्वमुत्पन्नो मम मन्युं प्रमार्जय
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | vatsa bhadra mahābhāga mahābalaparākrama | matpriyārthaṃ tvamutpanno mama manyuṃ pramārjaya
verses.translation: The wise say just as the magnetic stone causes the movement of the iron filings by its mere proximity, so also Siva causes the movement of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise say just as the magnetic stone causes the movement of the iron filings by its mere proximity, so also Siva causes the movement of the world.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेश्वरमनाहूय यज्ञकर्मरतोऽभवत् । दक्षं वैरेण तं तस्माद्भिन्धि यज्ञं गणेश्वर
verses.transliteration: yajñeśvaramanāhūya yajñakarmarato'bhavat | dakṣaṃ vaireṇa taṃ tasmādbhindhi yajñaṃ gaṇeśvara
verses.translation: Nothing functions without Siva. Everything is induced by him. Still he is not deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nothing functions without Siva. Everything is induced by him. Still he is not deluded.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञलक्ष्मीमलक्ष्मीं त्वं भद्र कृत्वा ममाज्ञया । यजमानं च तं हत्वा वत्स हिंसय भद्रया
verses.transliteration: yajñalakṣmīmalakṣmīṃ tvaṃ bhadra kṛtvā mamājñayā | yajamānaṃ ca taṃ hatvā vatsa hiṃsaya bhadrayā
verses.translation: He who considers otherwise due to delusion is evil- minded. He perishes and that too due to the power of his Sakti. Still he is not defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who considers otherwise due to delusion is evil- minded. He perishes and that too due to the power of his Sakti. Still he is not defiled.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अशेषामिव तामाज्ञां शिवयोश्चित्रकृत्ययोः । मूर्ध्नि कृत्वा नमस्कृत्य भद्रो गन्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: aśeṣāmiva tāmājñāṃ śivayościtrakṛtyayoḥ | mūrdhni kṛtvā namaskṛtya bhadro gantuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: Then the sages were surprised and delighted; their doubts were quelled. They bowed to the lord, the wind-god.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sages were surprised and delighted; their doubts were quelled. They bowed to the lord, the wind-god.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथैष भगवान्क्रुद्धः प्रेतावासकृतालयः । वीरभद्रो महादेवो देव्या मन्युप्रमार्जकः
verses.transliteration: athaiṣa bhagavānkruddhaḥ pretāvāsakṛtālayaḥ | vīrabhadro mahādevo devyā manyupramārjakaḥ
verses.translation: Although he had cleared their doubts he thought that their knowledge was not firmly established. So he said:
verses.commentary: Sense: Although he had cleared their doubts he thought that their knowledge was not firmly established. So he said:
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज रोमकूपेभ्यो रोमजाख्यान् गणेश्वरान् । दक्षिणाद्भुजदेशात्तु शतकोटिगणेश्वरान्
verses.transliteration: sasarja romakūpebhyo romajākhyān gaṇeśvarān | dakṣiṇādbhujadeśāttu śatakoṭigaṇeśvarān
verses.translation: The five activities along with attendant virtuous rites constitute the greatest Dharma. Thereby one attains the direct and indirect knowledge that bestows salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five activities along with attendant virtuous rites constitute the greatest Dharma. Thereby one attains the direct and indirect knowledge that bestows salvation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पादात्तथोरुदेशाच्च पृष्ठात्पार्श्वान्मुखाद्गलात् । गुह्याद् गुल्फाच्छिरोमध्यात्कण्ठादास्यात्तथोदरात्
verses.transliteration: pādāttathorudeśācca pṛṣṭhātpārśvānmukhādgalāt | guhyād gulphācchiromadhyātkaṇṭhādāsyāttathodarāt
verses.translation: The two Dharmas the higher and secondary are mentioned in the Vedas. In the matter of Dharma the Vedas constitute the final authority for us.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two Dharmas the higher and secondary are mentioned in the Vedas. In the matter of Dharma the Vedas constitute the final authority for us.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा गणेश्वरैर्भद्रैर्भद्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः । सञ्छादितमभूत्सर्वं साकाशविवरं जगत्
verses.transliteration: tadā gaṇeśvarairbhadrairbhadratulyaparākramaiḥ | sañchāditamabhūtsarvaṃ sākāśavivaraṃ jagat
verses.translation: The higher dharma upto the practice of Yoga is mentioned in the Vedantic section of the Vedas. The secondary Dharma is mentioned in the Karmakanda section of the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: The higher dharma upto the practice of Yoga is mentioned in the Vedantic section of the Vedas. The secondary Dharma is mentioned in the Karmakanda section of the same.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सहस्रहस्तास्ते सहस्रायुधपाणयः । रुद्रस्यानुचराः सर्वे सर्वे रुद्रसमप्रभाः
verses.transliteration: sarve sahasrahastāste sahasrāyudhapāṇayaḥ | rudrasyānucarāḥ sarve sarve rudrasamaprabhāḥ
verses.translation: The Atmans freed from Pasa are authorised in the higher Dharma and in the other one, every one is authorised.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atmans freed from Pasa are authorised in the higher Dharma and in the other one, every one is authorised.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शूलशक्तिगदाहस्ताष्टङ्कोपलशिलाधराः । कालाग्निरुद्रसदृशास्त्रिनेत्राश्च जटाधराः
verses.transliteration: śūlaśaktigadāhastāṣṭaṅkopalaśilādharāḥ | kālāgnirudrasadṛśāstrinetrāśca jaṭādharāḥ
verses.translation: The greatest Dharma of Siva termed the excellent practice is explained in the Itihasas and the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatest Dharma of Siva termed the excellent practice is explained in the Itihasas and the Puranas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निपेतुर्भृशमाकाशे शतशः सिंहवाहनाः । विनेदुश्च महानादाञ्जलदा इव भद्रजाः
verses.transliteration: nipeturbhṛśamākāśe śataśaḥ siṃhavāhanāḥ | vineduśca mahānādāñjaladā iva bhadrajāḥ
verses.translation: In the Saiva Agamas a detailed explanation of every thing including the consecratory rites is given.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Saiva Agamas a detailed explanation of every thing including the consecratory rites is given.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तैर्भद्रैर्भगवान् भद्रस्तथा परिवृतो बभौ । कालानलशतैर्युक्तो यथान्ते कालभैरवः
verses.transliteration: tairbhadrairbhagavān bhadrastathā parivṛto babhau | kālānalaśatairyukto yathānte kālabhairavaḥ
verses.translation: The independent texts were originally ten but supplemented subsequently by eight more so as to constitute eighteen texts. They are called Kamika etc., and the entire literature is called "Saiva Siddhanta"
verses.commentary: Sense: The independent texts were originally ten but supplemented subsequently by eight more so as to constitute eighteen texts. They are called Kamika etc., and the entire literature is called "Saiva Siddhanta"
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये समारुह्य वृषेन्द्रं वृषभध्वजः । जगाम भगवान् भद्रः शुभ्रमभ्रं यथा भवः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ madhye samāruhya vṛṣendraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | jagāma bhagavān bhadraḥ śubhramabhraṃ yathā bhavaḥ
verses.translation: The Srauta literature consists of a billion verses. In it the Paiupata Vrata and Jfiana are explained.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Srauta literature consists of a billion verses. In it the Paiupata Vrata and Jfiana are explained.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्वृषभमारूढे भद्रे तु भसितप्रभः । बभार मौक्तिकं छत्रं गृहीतसितचामरः
verses.transliteration: tasminvṛṣabhamārūḍhe bhadre tu bhasitaprabhaḥ | babhāra mauktikaṃ chatraṃ gṛhītasitacāmaraḥ
verses.translation: In every circle of Yugas, §iva incarnates as Yogacarya in different places and propagates yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every circle of Yugas, §iva incarnates as Yogacarya in different places and propagates yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तदा शुशुभे पार्श्वे भद्रस्य भसितप्रभः । भगवानिव शैलेन्द्रः पार्श्वे विश्वजगद्गुरोः
verses.transliteration: sa tadā śuśubhe pārśve bhadrasya bhasitaprabhaḥ | bhagavāniva śailendraḥ pārśve viśvajagadguroḥ
verses.translation: The four great sages Ruru, Dadhica, Agastya and the renowned Upamanyu have condensed these principles and propagated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four great sages Ruru, Dadhica, Agastya and the renowned Upamanyu have condensed these principles and propagated them.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि तेन बभौ भद्रः श्वेतचामरपाणिना । बालसोमेन सौम्येन यथा शूलवरायुधः
verses.transliteration: so'pi tena babhau bhadraḥ śvetacāmarapāṇinā | bālasomena saumyena yathā śūlavarāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: The great virtue of Siva mentioned before is four-
verses.commentary: Sense: The great virtue of Siva mentioned before is four-
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दध्मौ शङ्खं सितं भद्रं भद्रस्य पुरतः शुभम् । भानुकम्पो महातेजा हेमरत्नैरलङ्कृतः
verses.transliteration: dadhmau śaṅkhaṃ sitaṃ bhadraṃ bhadrasya purataḥ śubham | bhānukampo mahātejā hemaratnairalaṅkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Through this discernment the stable and perfect knowledge is attained ere long. Siva is delighted with him whose knowledge is well-founded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through this discernment the stable and perfect knowledge is attained ere long. Siva is delighted with him whose knowledge is well-founded.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्दिव्यसङ्कुलनिःस्वनाः । ववृषुः शतशो मूर्ध्नि पुष्पवर्षं बलाहकाः
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo nedurdivyasaṅkulaniḥsvanāḥ | vavṛṣuḥ śataśo mūrdhni puṣpavarṣaṃ balāhakāḥ
verses.translation: Siva, Mahesvara, Rudra, Visnu, Pitamaha, Samsaravaidya, Sarvajfta and Paramatman — these eight names mainly indicate Siva. The first five are the names of the deities presiding over the Kalas, Santyatita etc.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, Mahesvara, Rudra, Visnu, Pitamaha, Samsaravaidya, Sarvajfta and Paramatman — these eight names mainly indicate Siva. The first five are the names of the deities presiding over the Kalas, Santyatita etc.®

verses.sanskrit: फुल्लानां मधुगर्भाणां पुष्पाणां गन्धबन्धवः । मार्गानुकूलसंवाहा ववुश्च पथि मारुताः
verses.transliteration: phullānāṃ madhugarbhāṇāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ gandhabandhavaḥ | mārgānukūlasaṃvāhā vavuśca pathi mārutāḥ
verses.translation: He who is naturally pure is called Siva. He has the antecedent non-existence of the contact of the primordial dirt. Or, he who is full of good attributes and is Isvara is called Siva by good men who propound the Saivite principles.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is naturally pure is called Siva. He has the antecedent non-existence of the contact of the primordial dirt. Or, he who is full of good attributes and is Isvara is called Siva by good men who propound the Saivite principles.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो गणेश्वराः सर्वे मत्ता युद्धबलोद्धताः । ननृतुर्मुमुदुर्नेदुर्जहसुर्जगदुर्जगुः
verses.transliteration: tato gaṇeśvarāḥ sarve mattā yuddhabaloddhatāḥ | nanṛturmumudurnedurjahasurjagadurjaguḥ
verses.translation: The name MaheSvara is explained thus: Prakrti is greater than the twenty-three principles. Purusa the twenty fifth principle is greater than Prakrti. Purusa is Pranava the
verses.commentary: Sense: The name MaheSvara is explained thus: Prakrti is greater than the twenty-three principles. Purusa the twenty fifth principle is greater than Prakrti. Purusa is Pranava the

verses.sanskrit: तदा भद्रगणान्तःस्थो बभौ भद्रः सभद्रया । यथा रुद्रगणान्तः स्थस्त्र्यम्बकोऽम्बिकया सह
verses.transliteration: tadā bhadragaṇāntaḥstho babhau bhadraḥ sabhadrayā | yathā rudragaṇāntaḥ sthastryambako'mbikayā saha
verses.translation: The twentytwo verses (23-44) of this chapter are the same a> the versrs 1-22 of Kailasa S. Gh. r|.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twentytwo verses (23-44) of this chapter are the same a> the versrs 1-22 of Kailasa S. Gh. r|.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणादेव दक्षस्य यज्ञवाटं हिरण्मयम् । प्रविवेश महाबाहुर्वीरभद्रो महानुगः
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇādeva dakṣasya yajñavāṭaṃ hiraṇmayam | praviveśa mahābāhurvīrabhadro mahānugaḥ
verses.translation: See P. 1072 note
verses.explanation: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु दक्षप्रतिपादितस्य क्रतुप्रधानस्य गणप्रधानः । प्रयोगभूमिं प्रविवेश भद्रो रुद्रो यथान्ते भुवनं दिधक्षुः
verses.transliteration: tatastu dakṣapratipāditasya kratupradhānasya gaṇapradhānaḥ | prayogabhūmiṃ praviveśa bhadro rudro yathānte bhuvanaṃ didhakṣuḥ
verses.translation: The explanation of the word Rudra: — 'Rud' means misery and 'Dravayati' means 'routs'. Since the lord quells our misery he is called Rudra.*®* He is Siva, the great cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: The explanation of the word Rudra: — 'Rud' means misery and 'Dravayati' means 'routs'. Since the lord quells our misery he is called Rudra.*®* He is Siva, the great cause.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The Atman shall be taken above to the splendour of Siva beyond the moon stationed in the twelve-petal led lotus of the heart. The mouth is shrunk in size. The body is drenched with the shower of the nectar of the Sakti and merged in their reasons. The Atman is then let down into the heart.
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman shall be taken above to the splendour of Siva beyond the moon stationed in the twelve-petal led lotus of the heart. The mouth is shrunk in size. The body is drenched with the shower of the nectar of the Sakti and merged in their reasons.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The Atman shall be taken above to the splendour of Siva beyond the moon stationed in the twelve-petal led lotus of the heart. The mouth is shrunk in size. The body is drenched with the shower of the nectar of the Sakti and merged in their reasons. The Atman is then let down into the heart.
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman shall be taken above to the splendour of Siva beyond the moon stationed in the twelve-petal led lotus of the heart. The mouth is shrunk in size. The body is drenched with the shower of the nectar of the Sakti and merged in their reasons.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । यज्ञविध्वंसनः । वायुरुवाच । ततो विष्णुप्रधानानां सुराणाममितौजसाम् । ददर्श च महत्सत्रं चित्रध्वजपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.20. viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | yajñavidhvaṃsanaḥ | vāyuruvāca | tato viṣṇupradhānānāṃ surāṇāmamitaujasām | dadarśa ca mahatsatraṃ citradhvajaparicchadam
verses.translation: The devotee then meditates on the great god Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees who is conceived as sitting in the white twelve-petalled lotus beyond the moon, who in the sweet crystal-pure, delighted, cool, lustrous form of Ardhanarisvara, shall be meditated upon. The devotee shall have the mind in normal state. He shall then worship the lord with the eight names of Siva and the sacred flowers.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee then meditates on the great god Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees who is conceived as sitting in the white twelve-petalled lotus beyond the moon, who in the sweet crystal-pure, delighted, cool, lustrous form of Ardhanarisvara, shall be meditated upon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee then meditates on the great god Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees who is conceived as sitting in the white twelve-petalled lotus beyond the moon, who in the sweet crystal-pure, delighted, cool, lustrous form of Ardhanarisvara, shall be meditated upon.…

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्भऋतुसंस्तीर्णं सुसमिद्धहुताशनम् । काञ्चनैर्यज्ञभाण्डैश्च भ्राजिष्णुभिरलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: sudarbhaṛtusaṃstīrṇaṃ susamiddhahutāśanam | kāñcanairyajñabhāṇḍaiśca bhrājiṣṇubhiralaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: On the full moon day also he shall perform similar rites. At the conclusion of the sacrifice the sacred fire shall be extinguished and the ashes gathered assiduously.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the full moon day also he shall perform similar rites. At the conclusion of the sacrifice the sacred fire shall be extinguished and the ashes gathered assiduously.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्यज्ञपटुभिर्यथावत्कर्मकर्तृभिः । विधिना वेददृष्टेन स्वनुष्ठितबहुक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhiryajñapaṭubhiryathāvatkarmakartṛbhiḥ | vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena svanuṣṭhitabahukramam
verses.translation: The ablution shall be performed with golden vessels, filled with Paftcagavya*® collected in accordance with one's capacity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ablution shall be performed with golden vessels, filled with Paftcagavya*® collected in accordance with one's capacity.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाङ्गनासहस्राढ्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम् । वेणुवीणारवैर्जुष्टं वेदघोषैश्च बृंहितम्
verses.transliteration: devāṅganāsahasrāḍhyamapsarogaṇasevitam | veṇuvīṇāravairjuṣṭaṃ vedaghoṣaiśca bṛṃhitam
verses.translation: Then at the end of the worship of the Avaraas, after worsliipping the supreme lord, delicious Havis shall be offered as Naivedya along with ghee and side-dishc.<».
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the end of the worship of the Avaraas, after worsliipping the supreme lord, delicious Havis shall be offered as Naivedya along with ghee and side-dishc.<».
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा दक्षाध्वरं वीरो वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान् । सिंहनादं तदा चक्रे गम्भीरो जलदो यथा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dakṣādhvaraṃ vīro vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān | siṃhanādaṃ tadā cakre gambhīro jalado yathā
verses.translation: Mentally, verbally and physically he shall avoid contact with heretics, fallen men, pointed women in their
verses.commentary: Sense: Mentally, verbally and physically he shall avoid contact with heretics, fallen men, pointed women in their
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः किलकिलाशब्द आकाशं पूरयन्निव । गणेश्वरैः कृतो जज्ञे महान्न्यक्कृतसागरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kilakilāśabda ākāśaṃ pūrayanniva | gaṇeśvaraiḥ kṛto jajñe mahānnyakkṛtasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: He shall always practise forgiveness, charity, mercy non-violence to all living beings. He shall remain content, calm and engaged in meditation and Japa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall always practise forgiveness, charity, mercy non-violence to all living beings. He shall remain content, calm and engaged in meditation and Japa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन महता ग्रस्ताः सर्वे दिवौकसः । दुद्रुवुः परितो भीताः स्रस्तवस्त्रविभूषणाः
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā grastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ | dudruvuḥ parito bhītāḥ srastavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: He shall bathe thrice a day or he shall dust with the ashes instead. He shall perform special worship mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall bathe thrice a day or he shall dust with the ashes instead. He shall perform special worship mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किंस्विद्भग्नो महामेरुः किंस्वित्सन्दीर्यते मही । किमिदं किमिदं वेति जजल्पुस्त्रिदशा भृशम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃsvidbhagno mahāmeruḥ kiṃsvitsandīryate mahī | kimidaṃ kimidaṃ veti jajalpustridaśā bhṛśam
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? A performer of the rite shall not commit any misdeed. If inadvertently he does commit, he shall consider its seriousness or otherwise and perform adequate expiatory rites in the form of worship, sacrifice, Japas etc. Till the conclusion of the Vrata he shall not repeat the mistake.
verses.wordMeaning: Of what avail is much talk? A performer of the rite shall not commit any misdeed. If inadvertently he does commit, he shall consider its seriousness or otherwise and perform adequate expiatory rites in the form of worship, sacrifice, Japas etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail is much talk? A performer of the rite shall not commit any misdeed. If inadvertently he does commit, he shall consider its seriousness or otherwise and perform adequate expiatory rites in the form of worship, sacrifice, Japas etc.…

verses.sanskrit: मृगेन्द्राणां यथा नादं गजेन्द्रा गहने वने । श्रुत्वा तथाविधं केचित्तत्यजुर्जीवितं भयात्
verses.transliteration: mṛgendrāṇāṃ yathā nādaṃ gajendrā gahane vane | śrutvā tathāvidhaṃ kecittatyajurjīvitaṃ bhayāt
verses.translation: He shall make charitable gifts of cows and oxen, perform worship in accordance with her wealth and capacity devoutly and free from any specific desire, for the pleasure of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall make charitable gifts of cows and oxen, perform worship in accordance with her wealth and capacity devoutly and free from any specific desire, for the pleasure of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पर्वताश्च व्यशीर्यन्त चकम्पे च वसुन्धरा । मरुतश्च व्यघूर्णन्त चुक्षुभे मकरालयः
verses.transliteration: parvatāśca vyaśīryanta cakampe ca vasundharā | marutaśca vyaghūrṇanta cukṣubhe makarālayaḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the worship the devotee shall perform Pranayama and concentrate the mind well. He shall perform the japa of the eight names of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the worship the devotee shall perform Pranayama and concentrate the mind well. He shall perform the japa of the eight names of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नयो नैव दीप्यन्ते न च दीप्यति भास्करः । ग्रहाश्च न प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि च तारकाः
verses.transliteration: agnayo naiva dīpyante na ca dīpyati bhāskaraḥ | grahāśca na prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi ca tārakāḥ
verses.translation: He shall perform eight Ahutis in the navel and repeat "Namah" alope with the Purnahuti, offering eight flowers and conclude worship. With a palmful of water he shall dedicate his Atman. By doing this, ere long, the auspi¬ cious knowledge of Pasupata cult is obtained. He acquires its magnificent status and the excellent conduct. Then securing the great Yoga he is liberated. There is no doubt in this.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform eight Ahutis in the navel and repeat "Namah" alope with the Purnahuti, offering eight flowers and conclude worship. With a palmful of water he shall dedicate his Atman. By doing this, ere long, the auspi¬ cious knowledge of Pasupata cult is obtained.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform eight Ahutis in the navel and repeat "Namah" alope with the Purnahuti, offering eight flowers and conclude worship. With a palmful of water he shall dedicate his Atman. By doing this, ere long, the auspi¬ cious knowledge of Pasupata cult is obtained.…

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यज्ञवाटं तदुज्ज्वलम् । सम्प्राप भगवान्भद्रो भद्रैश्च सह भद्रया
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu yajñavāṭaṃ tadujjvalam | samprāpa bhagavānbhadro bhadraiśca saha bhadrayā
verses.translation: O holy lord, we wish to hear of the great Pasupata vrata on performing which Brahma and others have become Palupatas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, we wish to hear of the great Pasupata vrata on performing which Brahma and others have become Palupatas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा भीतभीतोऽपि दक्षो दृढ इव स्थितः । क्रुद्धवद् वचनं प्राह को भवान् किमिहेच्छसि
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītabhīto'pi dakṣo dṛḍha iva sthitaḥ | kruddhavad vacanaṃ prāha ko bhavān kimihecchasi
verses.translation: I shall tell you the great secret, Pasupata vrata
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall tell you the great secret, Pasupata vrata
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षस्य च दुरात्मनः । वीरभद्रो महातेजा मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वनः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣasya ca durātmanaḥ | vīrabhadro mahātejā meghagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ
verses.translation: The time is the month of Ghaitra and the full-moon- day therein. The place is anywhere acceptable to Siva having good characteristics. It shall be auspicious, say, the garden in a holy centre or a forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The time is the month of Ghaitra and the full-moon- day therein. The place is anywhere acceptable to Siva having good characteristics. It shall be auspicious, say, the garden in a holy centre or a forest.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मयन्निव तमालोक्य दक्षं देवांश्च ऋत्विजः । अर्थगर्भमसम्भ्रान्तमवोचदुचितं वचः
verses.transliteration: smayanniva tamālokya dakṣaṃ devāṃśca ṛtvijaḥ | arthagarbhamasambhrāntamavocaducitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: There, first of all, on the thirteenth day he shall perform the special worship after taking his bath and performing the daily rites. He shall take the formal per¬ mission of the preceptor after bowing to him and honouring him. He shall wear pure white cloths. The sacred thread shall be white. He shall wear a garland of white flowers. White unguent shall be measured over the body. He shall be seated on Darbha grass. He shall hold a handful of Darbha grass, sit facing east or the north. After performing the Pranayama three times he shall meditate on the lord and the goddess. By way of submitting to them he shall perform the Sahkalpa saying, 'T am perfoiming this Vrata (of Pasupata) ". The time limit for this Vrata is till death, or twelve years or six years, or three years or twelve months, or six months or three months or a month or twelve days or six days or three days or one day.
verses.wordMeaning: There, first of all, on the thirteenth day he shall perform the special worship after taking his bath and performing the daily rites. He shall take the formal per¬ mission of the preceptor after bowing to him and honouring him. He shall wear pure white cloths.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There, first of all, on the thirteenth day he shall perform the special worship after taking his bath and performing the daily rites. He shall take the formal per¬ mission of the preceptor after bowing to him and honouring him. He shall wear pure white cloths.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र उवाच । वयं ह्यनुचराः सर्वे शर्वस्यामिततेजसः । भागाभिलिप्सया प्राप्ता भागो नः सम्प्रदीयताम्
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadra uvāca | vayaṃ hyanucarāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ | bhāgābhilipsayā prāptā bhāgo naḥ sampradīyatām
verses.translation: He shall arrange the sacrificial fire duly as in the Virajahoma. He shall make the offerings of ghee, sacrificial twigs and caru and perform homa. After the Purnahuti, deserving the purity of the Tattvas, he shall perform the homa with the five-syllabled mantra and the sacrificial twigs.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall arrange the sacrificial fire duly as in the Virajahoma. He shall make the offerings of ghee, sacrificial twigs and caru and perform homa. After the Purnahuti, deserving the purity of the Tattvas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall arrange the sacrificial fire duly as in the Virajahoma. He shall make the offerings of ghee, sacrificial twigs and caru and perform homa. After the Purnahuti, deserving the purity of the Tattvas,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ चेदध्वरेऽस्माकं न भागः परिकल्पितः । कथ्यतां कारणं तत्र युध्यतां वा मयामरैः
verses.transliteration: atha cedadhvare'smākaṃ na bhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ | kathyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra yudhyatāṃ vā mayāmaraiḥ
verses.translation: In the course of the sacrifice -he shall think thus — ''Let the Tat vas in my body be purified." The Tattvas are:— The five elements, the five Tanmatras, the five sense-organs of knowledge, the five organs of activity, the seven Dhatus beginning with the skin, the five vital airs beginning with Prana, mind, intellect, ego, the three Gunas, Prakrti, Puru?a, Raga (passion), Vidya, Kala,'Niyati, Time, Maya, pure Vidya, Mahesvara, Sadasiva, l§akti and Siva Tattva.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of the sacrifice -he shall think thus — ''Let the Tat vas in my body be purified." The Tattvas are:— The five elements, the five Tanmatras, the five sense-organs of knowledge, the five organs of activity, the seven Dhatus beginning with the skin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of the sacrifice -he shall think thus — ''Let the Tat vas in my body be purified." The Tattvas are:— The five elements, the five Tanmatras, the five sense-organs of knowledge, the five organs of activity, the seven Dhatus beginning with the skin,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तास्ते गणेन्द्रेण देवा दक्षपुरोगमाः । ऊचुर्मन्त्राः प्रमाणं नो न वयं प्रभवस्त्विति
verses.transliteration: ityuktāste gaṇendreṇa devā dakṣapurogamāḥ | ūcurmantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ no na vayaṃ prabhavastviti
verses.translation: After performing the Homa with the Viraja
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Homa with the Viraja
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रा ऊचुस्सुरा यूयं मोहोपहतचेतसः । येन प्रथमभागार्हं न यजध्वं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mantrā ūcussurā yūyaṃ mohopahatacetasaḥ | yena prathamabhāgārhaṃ na yajadhvaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: On the morning of the fourteenth day he shall perform everything as mentioned before. On that day he shall observe fast and thus spend the latter part of the day.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the morning of the fourteenth day he shall perform everything as mentioned before. On that day he shall observe fast and thus spend the latter part of the day.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रोक्ता अपि ते देवाः सर्वे सम्मूढचेतसः । भद्राय न ददुर्भागं तत्प्रहाणमभीप्सवः
verses.transliteration: mantroktā api te devāḥ sarve sammūḍhacetasaḥ | bhadrāya na dadurbhāgaṃ tatprahāṇamabhīpsavaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he shall keep matted hair or shave off the hair completely or keep one matted tuft of hair. He shall take bath then. If he is not extremely bashful he shall remain naked thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he shall keep matted hair or shave off the hair completely or keep one matted tuft of hair. He shall take bath then. If he is not extremely bashful he shall remain naked thereafter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा तथ्यं च पथ्यं च स्ववाक्यं तद्वृथाऽभवत् । तदा ततो ययुर्मन्त्रा ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: yadā tathyaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca svavākyaṃ tadvṛthā'bhavat | tadā tato yayurmantrā brahmalokaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Or he can wear ochre robes, hide or barks of trees. Only a single cloth or a single bark garment shall be worn. He shall have the staff and the girdle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he can wear ochre robes, hide or barks of trees. Only a single cloth or a single bark garment shall be worn. He shall have the staff and the girdle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच गणाध्यक्षो देवान् विष्णुपुरोगमान् । मन्त्राः प्रमाणं न कृता युष्माभिर्बलगर्वितैः
verses.transliteration: athovāca gaṇādhyakṣo devān viṣṇupurogamān | mantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ
verses.translation: He shall wash the feet and perform Acamana twice. He shall apply the ashes taken out of the Viraja fire all over his body from head to foot repeating the six mantras beginning with "Agniriti"*®® from the Atharvana texts.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall wash the feet and perform Acamana twice. He shall apply the ashes taken out of the Viraja fire all over his body from head to foot repeating the six mantras beginning with "Agniriti"*®® from the Atharvana texts.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादस्मिन् मखे देवैरित्थं वयमसत्कृताः । तस्माद्वो जीवितैस्सार्द्धमपनेष्यामि गर्वितम्
verses.transliteration: yasmādasmin makhe devairitthaṃ vayamasatkṛtāḥ | tasmādvo jīvitaissārddhamapaneṣyāmi garvitam
verses.translation: Then in the same way he shall dust the body entirely repeating the Pranava Oih and 'Siva'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the same way he shall dust the body entirely repeating the Pranava Oih and 'Siva'.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् क्रुद्धो व्यदहन्नेत्रवह्निना । यज्ञवाटं महाकूटं यथा तिस्रः पुरो हरः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhagavān kruddho vyadahannetravahninā | yajñavāṭaṃ mahākūṭaṃ yathā tisraḥ puro haraḥ
verses.translation: Then repeating the mantra 'Triyayusam' he shall wear Tripunra marks. He shall realise his own Siva-hood and perform 'Sivayoga*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then repeating the mantra 'Triyayusam' he shall wear Tripunra marks. He shall realise his own Siva-hood and perform 'Sivayoga*.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो गणेश्वराः सर्वे पर्वतोदग्रविग्रहाः । यूपानुत्पाट्य होतॄणां कण्ठेष्वाबध्य रज्जुभिः
verses.transliteration: tato gaṇeśvarāḥ sarve parvatodagravigrahāḥ | yūpānutpāṭya hotṝṇāṃ kaṇṭheṣvābadhya rajjubhiḥ
verses.translation: He shall act thus during all the three Sandhyas. This Paupata Vrata yields worldly pleasures and salvation dispelling Pasu-hood.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall act thus during all the three Sandhyas. This Paupata Vrata yields worldly pleasures and salvation dispelling Pasu-hood.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञपात्राणि चित्राणि भित्त्वा सञ्चूर्ण्य वारिणि । गृहीत्वा चैव यज्ञाङ्गं गङ्गास्रोतसि चिक्षिपुः
verses.transliteration: yajñapātrāṇi citrāṇi bhittvā sañcūrṇya vāriṇi | gṛhītvā caiva yajñāṅgaṃ gaṅgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ
verses.translation: Freed from Pau-hood, the devotee shall worship the phallic image of l§iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Freed from Pau-hood, the devotee shall worship the phallic image of l§iva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्यान्नपानानां राशयः पर्वतोपमाः । क्षीरनद्योऽमृतस्रावाः सुस्निग्धदधिकर्दमाः
verses.transliteration: tatra divyānnapānānāṃ rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ | kṣīranadyo'mṛtasrāvāḥ susnigdhadadhikardamāḥ
verses.translation: If capacity permits, an eight-petalled Padma shall be made in gold embellished with the nine precious gems. The pericarp and the filaments shall be furnished.
verses.commentary: Sense: If capacity permits, an eight-petalled Padma shall be made in gold embellished with the nine precious gems. The pericarp and the filaments shall be furnished.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि सुरभीणि च । रसवन्ति च पानानि लेह्यचोष्याणि तानि वै
verses.transliteration: uccāvacāni māṃsāni bhakṣyāṇi surabhīṇi ca | rasavanti ca pānāni lehyacoṣyāṇi tāni vai
verses.translation: In the middle of the pericarp a small crystal phallic image along with its pedestal shall be kept and worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of the pericarp a small crystal phallic image along with its pedestal shall be kept and worshipped.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वीरास्तद्भुञ्जते वक्त्रैर्विलुम्पन्ति क्षिपन्ति च । वज्रैश्चक्रैर्महाशूलैः शक्तिभिः पाशपट्टिशैः
verses.transliteration: vīrāstadbhuñjate vaktrairvilumpanti kṣipanti ca | vajraiścakrairmahāśūlaiḥ śaktibhiḥ pāśapaṭṭiśaiḥ
verses.translation: After installing the phallic image in accordance with the rules with due consecrations the pedestal shall be conceived along with the idol of five faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: After installing the phallic image in accordance with the rules with due consecrations the pedestal shall be conceived along with the idol of five faces.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुसलैरसिभिष्टङ्कैर्भिन्दिपालैः परश्वधैः । उद्धतांस्त्रिदशान्सर्वांल्लोकपालपुरस्सरान्
verses.transliteration: musalairasibhiṣṭaṅkairbhindipālaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ | uddhatāṃstridaśānsarvāṃllokapālapurassarān
verses.translation: The vessels shall contain scents along with cam¬ phor, sandal and saffron and these shall be smeared over the phallic image bedecked in ornaments. He shall worship it with Bilva leaves, red, white and blue lotuses, other fragrant flowers, holy and auspicious leaves, Durva grass of various types, in accordance with their availability and the rules of worship.
verses.wordMeaning: The vessels shall contain scents along with cam¬ phor, sandal and saffron and these shall be smeared over the phallic image bedecked in ornaments. He shall worship it with Bilva leaves, red, white and blue lotuses, other fragrant flowers, holy and auspicious leaves,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The vessels shall contain scents along with cam¬ phor, sandal and saffron and these shall be smeared over the phallic image bedecked in ornaments. He shall worship it with Bilva leaves, red, white and blue lotuses, other fragrant flowers, holy and auspicious leaves,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिभिदुर्बलिनो वीरा वीरभद्राङ्गसम्भवाः । छिन्धि भिन्धि क्षिप क्षिप्रं मार्यतां दार्यतामिति
verses.transliteration: bibhidurbalino vīrā vīrabhadrāṅgasambhavāḥ | chindhi bhindhi kṣipa kṣipraṃ māryatāṃ dāryatāmiti
verses.translation: Showing of lights, incense and the food offerings shall be made to the deity. After offering it to the deity the devotee shall be engaged in auspicious activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Showing of lights, incense and the food offerings shall be made to the deity. After offering it to the deity the devotee shall be engaged in auspicious activities.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हरस्व प्रहरस्वेति पाटयोत्पाटयेति च । संरम्भप्रभवाः क्रूराः शब्दाः श्रवणशङ्कवः
verses.transliteration: harasva praharasveti pāṭayotpāṭayeti ca | saṃrambhaprabhavāḥ krūrāḥ śabdāḥ śravaṇaśaṅkavaḥ
verses.translation: In this Vrata exquisite and pleasing things acquired legitimately, whatever they may be, shall be offered to the deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this Vrata exquisite and pleasing things acquired legitimately, whatever they may be, shall be offered to the deity.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तत्र गणेशानां जज्ञिरे समरोचिताः । विवृत्तनयनाः केचिद् दष्टदंष्ट्रोष्ठतालवः
verses.transliteration: yatra tatra gaṇeśānāṃ jajñire samarocitāḥ | vivṛttanayanāḥ kecid daṣṭadaṃṣṭroṣṭhatālavaḥ
verses.translation: The leaf of the Bilva tree shall never be excluded. A gold lotus is greater than a thousand lotuses. The case of blue lotuses is also on a par with that of Bilva leaves. With regard to the other flowers there is no restriction. They shall be offered just as they are available.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaf of the Bilva tree shall never be excluded. A gold lotus is greater than a thousand lotuses. The case of blue lotuses is also on a par with that of Bilva leaves. verses.sanskrit: आश्रमस्थान् समाकृष्य मारयन्ति तपोधनान् । स्रुवानपहरन्तश्च क्षिपन्तोऽग्निं जलेषु च
verses.transliteration: āśramasthān samākṛṣya mārayanti tapodhanān | sruvānapaharantaśca kṣipanto'gniṃ jaleṣu ca
verses.translation: Sandal, Aguru, etc., along with sugar candy, honey, camphor and the ghee of a tawny-coloured cow can be offered to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sandal, Aguru, etc., along with sugar candy, honey, camphor and the ghee of a tawny-coloured cow can be offered to all.

verses.sanskrit: कलशानपि भिन्दन्तश्छिन्दन्तो मणिवेदिकाः । गायन्तश्च नदन्तश्च हसन्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः । रक्तासवं पिबन्तश्च ननृतुर्गणपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: kalaśānapi bhindantaśchindanto maṇivedikāḥ | gāyantaśca nadantaśca hasantaśca muhurmuhuḥ | raktāsavaṃ pibantaśca nanṛturgaṇapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter series of lights with camphor and wick soaked in ghee shall be offered. Arghya and Acamana shall be offered to every face.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter series of lights with camphor and wick soaked in ghee shall be offered. Arghya and Acamana shall be offered to every face.

verses.transliteration: nirmathya sendrānamarān gaṇendrā vṛṣendranāgendramṛgendrasārāḥ | cakrurbahūnyapratimabhāvāḥ saharṣaromāṇi viceṣṭitāni
verses.translation: In the first (outer column of the mystic diagram) Ganeiia and Karttikeya shall be worshipped. Brahma's body shall also be worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the first (outer column of the mystic diagram) Ganeiia and Karttikeya shall be worshipped. Brahma's body shall also be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दन्ति केचित्प्रहरन्ति केचित् धावन्ति केचित्प्रलपन्ति केचित्
verses.transliteration: nandanti kecitpraharanti kecit dhāvanti kecitpralapanti kecit
verses.translation: In the second Avarana shall be worshipped Vighnesas the Gakravartins. The eight deities*** Bhava and others shall be worshioped in the third Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second Avarana shall be worshipped Vighnesas the Gakravartins. The eight deities*** Bhava and others shall be worshioped in the third Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यन्ति केचिद्विहसन्ति केचित् वल्गन्ति केचित्प्रमथा बलेन
verses.transliteration: nṛtyanti kecidvihasanti kecit valganti kecitpramathā balena
verses.translation: There the eleven deities*** Mahadeva and others shall be worshipped. All the Ganevaras shall be worshipped in the fourth Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: There the eleven deities*** Mahadeva and others shall be worshipped. All the Ganevaras shall be worshipped in the fourth Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: केचिज्जिघृक्षन्ति घनान्स तोयान् केचिद्ग्रहीतुं रविमुत्पतन्ति । केचित्प्रसर्तुं पवनेन सार्द्ध- मिच्छन्ति भीमाः प्रमथा वियत्स्थाः
verses.transliteration: kecijjighṛkṣanti ghanānsa toyān kecidgrahītuṃ ravimutpatanti | kecitprasartuṃ pavanena sārddha- micchanti bhīmāḥ pramathā viyatsthāḥ
verses.translation: Outside the lotus the mystic diagram and in the fifth Avarana shall be worshipped the lords of the ten quarters along with their weapons and followers, the mental sons of Brahma, the luminary bodies, the goddesses and ods, the heaven-walkers, the residents of the netherworlds, the other sages, Yogins, the sacrifices, the birds, the mothers, the Ketrapalas with their Ganas and the universe including the mobile and immobile beings. These shall be worshipped, as they are possessed of Siva's pre-eminence. They shall be worshipped for the pleasure of Siva.
verses.wordMeaning: Outside the lotus the mystic diagram and in the fifth Avarana shall be worshipped the lords of the ten quarters along with their weapons and followers, the mental sons of Brahma, the luminary bodies, the goddesses and ods, the heaven-walkers, the residents of the netherworlds,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Outside the lotus the mystic diagram and in the fifth Avarana shall be worshipped the lords of the ten quarters along with their weapons and followers, the mental sons of Brahma, the luminary bodies, the goddesses and ods, the heaven-walkers, the residents of the netherworlds,…

verses.sanskrit: आक्षिप्य केचिच्च वरायुधानि महाभुजङ्गानिव वैनतेयाः । भ्रमन्ति देवानपि विद्रवन्तः खमण्डले पर्वतकूटकल्पाः
verses.transliteration: ākṣipya kecicca varāyudhāni mahābhujaṅgāniva vainateyāḥ | bhramanti devānapi vidravantaḥ khamaṇḍale parvatakūṭakalpāḥ
verses.translation: The betel with something to chew with to render the mouth fragrant shall be given. After bedecking bnce again with different flowers and ornaments the detailed
verses.commentary: Sense: The betel with something to chew with to render the mouth fragrant shall be given. After bedecking bnce again with different flowers and ornaments the detailed

verses.sanskrit: उत्पाट्य चोत्पाट्य गृहाणि केचित् सजालवातायनवेदिकानि । विक्षिप्य विक्षिप्य जलस्य मध्ये कालाम्बुदाभाः प्रमथा निनेदुः
verses.transliteration: utpāṭya cotpāṭya gṛhāṇi kecit sajālavātāyanavedikāni | vikṣipya vikṣipya jalasya madhye kālāmbudābhāḥ pramathā nineduḥ
verses.translation: A moon-like necklace shall be dedicated to the bedding. Everything done or caused to be done shall be royal in its quality, very pleasing and befitting. The contrary worship shall be avoided. After reciting the Vyapohana hymns the Japa of the five-syllabled Mantra shall be performed.
verses.wordMeaning: A moon-like necklace shall be dedicated to the bedding. Everything done or caused to be done shall be royal in its quality, very pleasing and befitting. The contrary worship shall be avoided.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A moon-like necklace shall be dedicated to the bedding. Everything done or caused to be done shall be royal in its quality, very pleasing and befitting. The contrary worship shall be avoided.…

verses.sanskrit: उद्वर्तितद्वारकपाटकुड्यं विध्वस्तशालावलभीगवाक्षम् । अहो बताभज्यत यज्ञवाट- मनाप्तवद्वाक्यमिवायथार्थम्
verses.transliteration: udvartitadvārakapāṭakuḍyaṃ vidhvastaśālāvalabhīgavākṣam | aho batābhajyata yajñavāṭa- manāptavadvākyamivāyathārtham
verses.translation: After circumambulation and obeisance the devotee shall dedicate himself. 'Then in front of lord he shall worship two brahmin preceptors.
verses.commentary: Sense: After circumambulation and obeisance the devotee shall dedicate himself. 'Then in front of lord he shall worship two brahmin preceptors.

verses.sanskrit: हा नाथ तातेति पितुः सुतेति भ्रातर्ममाम्बेति च मातुलेति । उत्पाट्यमानेषु गृहेषु नार्यो ह्यनाथशब्दान्बहुशः प्रचक्रुः
verses.transliteration: hā nātha tāteti pituḥ suteti bhrātarmamāmbeti ca mātuleti | utpāṭyamāneṣu gṛheṣu nāryo hyanāthaśabdānbahuśaḥ pracakruḥ
verses.translation: After offering Arghya and eight flowers the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed from the phallic idol. After restraining the fire from the fire and ritualistically removing that also, the devotee shall perform the service everyday. Then he shall hand over the phallic idol with the insignia and lotuses to the preceptor. Or he shall install it in the temple of Siva After worshipping the elders, brahmins, Vrata -performers in particular, he shall propitiate brahmin devotees and if possible poor and helpless people also. If he is competent he shall observe fast or take to a diet of fruits and roots. Or he shall have milk for his diet, or live on alms or take single meal everyday only in the night. He shall be pure in body and mind and lie on the bare ground or ashes or grass. He shall wear deerskin or bark garment and observe celibacy. Thus he shall perform the holy rite.
verses.wordMeaning: After offering Arghya and eight flowers the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed from the phallic idol. After restraining the fire from the fire and ritualistically removing that also, the devotee shall perform the service everyday.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering Arghya and eight flowers the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed from the phallic idol. After restraining the fire from the fire and ritualistically removing that also, the devotee shall perform the service everyday.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: In Vaiakha the phallic idol of adamant, in Jye?tha that of an emerald, in A?adha that of pearl, in Sravana that of Sapphire, in Bhadrapada that of ruby, in Alvina that of onyx, in Karttika that of a coral, in Margairia that of lapis lazuli, in Pau$a that of topaz in Maeha that of the sun-stone; in Phalguna that of the moon-stone and in Gaitra that of sun-lone is auspicious. If gems are not available gold shall be substituted in every month.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२१. एकविंशोऽध्यायः । देवदण्डवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । ततस्त्रिदशमुख्यास्ते विष्णुशक्रपुरोगमाः । सर्वे भयपरित्रस्ता दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.21. ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devadaṇḍavarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | tatastridaśamukhyāste viṣṇuśakrapurogamāḥ | sarve bhayaparitrastā dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ
verses.translation: Or he can make the idol as he pleases having all types of flowers. At the conclusion of Vrata after perform¬ ing the daily rites he shall perform the special worship and sacrifice as before. After worshipping the preceptor and the Vratins in particular he shall take the permission from his instructor. Sitting facing the east or the north on a Darbha seat holding Darbha grass in the hands he shall restrain Prana and Apana. He shall make the Japa of the Mula mantra to the extent of his ability; he shall meditate on Siva and Siva. Taking permission and bowing as before he shall say with palms joined in reverence: *'0 lord, at your behest, 1 am concluding this Vrata." After saying thus he shall cast off the Darbhas at the root of the idol towards the north.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he can make the idol as he pleases having all types of flowers. At the conclusion of Vrata after perform¬ ing the daily rites he shall perform the special worship and sacrifice as before.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he can make the idol as he pleases having all types of flowers. At the conclusion of Vrata after perform¬ ing the daily rites he shall perform the special worship and sacrifice as before.…

verses.sanskrit: निजैरदूषितैरङ्गैर्दृष्ट्वा देवानुपद्रुतान् । दण्ड्यानदण्डितान् मत्वा चुकोप गणपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: nijairadūṣitairaṅgairdṛṣṭvā devānupadrutān | daṇḍyānadaṇḍitān matvā cukopa gaṇapuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: How could that infant attain power to propound the sacred doctrine of Siva? How could he realise the existence of Siva and perform the penance?
verses.commentary: Sense: How could that infant attain power to propound the sacred doctrine of Siva? How could he realise the existence of Siva and perform the penance?

verses.transliteration: tatastriśūlamādāya śarvaśaktinibarhaṇam | ūrdhvadṛṣṭirmahābāhurmukhājjvālāḥ samutsṛjan
verses.translation: She had gleaned a few grains which the swee r voiced lady ground into a paste with water. "Come on, sc- dear," she addressed her son and though she was distress at heart she gave him the improvised milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: She had gleaned a few grains which the swee r voiced lady ground into a paste with water. "Come on, sc- dear," she addressed her son and though she was distress at heart she gave him the improvised milk.
