verses.sanskrit: अमरानपि दुद्राव द्विरदानिव केसरी । तानभिद्रवतस्तस्य गमनं सुमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: amarānapi dudrāva dviradāniva kesarī | tānabhidravatastasya gamanaṃ sumanoharam
verses.translation: Eschewing other gods physically, mentally and verbally, worship him alone, with Siva with due devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing other gods physically, mentally and verbally, worship him alone, with Siva with due devotion.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वारणस्येव मत्तस्य जगाम प्रेक्षणीयताम् । ततस्तत्क्षोभयामास महत्सुरबलं बली
verses.transliteration: vāraṇasyeva mattasya jagāma prekṣaṇīyatām | tatastatkṣobhayāmāsa mahatsurabalaṃ balī
verses.translation: Hence eschew all the other Mantras and devote yourself to this five-syllabled mantra. When that is in the mouth nothin? is inaccessible here.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence eschew all the other Mantras and devote yourself to this five-syllabled mantra. When that is in the mouth nothin? is inaccessible here.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महासरोवरं यद्वन्मत्तो वारणयूथपः । विकुर्वन्बहुधा वर्णान्नीलपाण्डुरलोहितान्
verses.transliteration: mahāsarovaraṃ yadvanmatto vāraṇayūthapaḥ | vikurvanbahudhā varṇānnīlapāṇḍuralohitān
verses.translation: The excellent Aghora missile affording protection to the devotees of Siva originates from this mantra. Consi¬ dering this, be devoted to it and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Aghora missile affording protection to the devotees of Siva originates from this mantra. Consi¬ dering this, be devoted to it and not otherwise.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिभ्रद् व्याघ्राजिनं वासो हेमप्रवरतारकम् । छिन्दन् भिन्दन्नुदन् क्लिन्दन्दारयन्प्रमथन्नपि
verses.transliteration: bibhrad vyāghrājinaṃ vāso hemapravaratārakam | chindan bhindannudan klindandārayanpramathannapi
verses.translation: This Bhasma produced in the Vi raja fire was obtained by me from your father. It is excellent and it averts great mishaps.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Bhasma produced in the Vi raja fire was obtained by me from your father. It is excellent and it averts great mishaps.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यचरद्देवसङ्घेषु भद्रोऽग्निरिव कक्षगः । यत्र तत्र महावेगाच्चरन्तं शूलधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: vyacaraddevasaṅgheṣu bhadro'gniriva kakṣagaḥ | yatra tatra mahāvegāccarantaṃ śūladhāriṇam
verses.translation: Accept the Mantra bestowed on you by me. If the Japa of this mantra is performed your protection will be assured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accept the Mantra bestowed on you by me. If the Japa of this mantra is performed your protection will be assured.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमेकं त्रिदशाः सर्वे सहस्रमिव मेनिरे । भद्रकाली च सङ्क्रुद्धा युद्धवृद्धमदोद्धता
verses.transliteration: tamekaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve sahasramiva menire | bhadrakālī ca saṅkruddhā yuddhavṛddhamadoddhatā
verses.translation: The mother directed him thus saying, "May it be auspicious" and allowed him to go. The sage accepted her words with his bent head. Bowing to her he made preparations for performing peniaince. Then the mother said to him, "May the gods do everything auspicious for yo.**
verses.commentary: Sense: The mother directed him thus saying, "May it be auspicious" and allowed him to go. The sage accepted her words with his bent head. Bowing to her he made preparations for performing peniaince. Then the mother said to him, "May the gods do everything auspicious for yo.**
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तज्वालेन शूलेन निर्बिभेद रणे सुरान् । स तया रुरुचे भद्रो रुद्रकोपसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: muktajvālena śūlena nirbibheda raṇe surān | sa tayā ruruce bhadro rudrakopasamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Then he shall eschew the staff, the matted hair,
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall eschew the staff, the matted hair,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभयेव युगान्ताग्निश्चलया धूमधूम्रया । भद्रकाली तदा युद्धे विद्रुतत्रिदशा बभौ
verses.transliteration: prabhayeva yugāntāgniścalayā dhūmadhūmrayā | bhadrakālī tadā yuddhe vidrutatridaśā babhau
verses.translation: He who has resolved to perform this Vrata till death and takes the initiation according'y and performs the rata undistrcssedly is a Naishika.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has resolved to perform this Vrata till death and takes the initiation according'y and performs the rata undistrcssedly is a Naishika.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे शेषानलज्वाला दग्धाविश्वजगद्यथा । तदा सवाजिनं सूर्यं रुद्रान् रुद्रगणाग्रणीः
verses.transliteration: kalpe śeṣānalajvālā dagdhāviśvajagadyathā | tadā savājinaṃ sūryaṃ rudrān rudragaṇāgraṇīḥ
verses.translation: Among those desirous of salvation there is none like him who is so content. The Naisthika who becomes an ascetic is called the excellent Naisthika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those desirous of salvation there is none like him who is so content. The Naisthika who becomes an ascetic is called the excellent Naisthika.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो मूर्ध्नि जघानाशु वामपादेन लीलया । असिभिः पावकं भद्रः पट्टिशैस्तु यमं यमीम्
verses.transliteration: bhadro mūrdhni jaghānāśu vāmapādena līlayā | asibhiḥ pāvakaṃ bhadraḥ paṭṭiśaistu yamaṃ yamīm
verses.translation: He who performs this rite for twelve days or every day is on a par with the Naisthika, his Vrata being too severe.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs this rite for twelve days or every day is on a par with the Naisthika, his Vrata being too severe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रान् दृढेन शूलेन मुद्गरैर्वरुणं दृढैः । परिघैर्निरृतिं वायुं टङ्कैष्टङ्कधरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: rudrān dṛḍhena śūlena mudgarairvaruṇaṃ dṛḍhaiḥ | parighairnirṛtiṃ vāyuṃ ṭaṅkaiṣṭaṅkadharaḥ svayam
verses.translation: A person who applies ghee over his body and performs the rite with devout feelings even for two or three days is also a Naisthika.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who applies ghee over his body and performs the rite with devout feelings even for two or three days is also a Naisthika.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्बिभेद रणे वीरो लीलयैव गणेश्वरः । सर्वान्देवगणान्सद्यो मुनीन् शम्भोर्विरोधिनः
verses.transliteration: nirbibheda raṇe vīro līlayaiva gaṇeśvaraḥ | sarvāndevagaṇānsadyo munīn śambhorvirodhinaḥ
verses.translation: He who performs the excellent Vrata without a rlesiie for the fruit feeling that it is his duty, always dedicating his Arman to l§iva has no one equal to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs the excellent Vrata without a rlesiie for the fruit feeling that it is his duty, always dedicating his Arman to l§iva has no one equal to him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवः सरस्वत्या नासिकाग्रं सुशोभनम् । चिच्छेद करजाग्रेण देवमातुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tato devaḥ sarasvatyā nāsikāgraṃ suśobhanam | ciccheda karajāgreṇa devamātustathaiva ca
verses.translation: A person who has bathed with the ashes is called Bhasmanistha. His faults perish due to the contact of Rhasma fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has bathed with the ashes is called Bhasmanistha. His faults perish due to the contact of Rhasma fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद च कुठारेण बाहुदण्डं विभावसोः । अग्रतो द्व्यङ्गुलां जिह्वामात्तहव्यां लुलाव च
verses.transliteration: ciccheda ca kuṭhāreṇa bāhudaṇḍaṃ vibhāvasoḥ | agrato dvyaṅgulāṃ jihvāmāttahavyāṃ lulāva ca
verses.translation: He who has smeared his body with the ashes, wears Tripundraka with Bhasma and has a Bha.sma bath is Bhasmanistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has smeared his body with the ashes, wears Tripundraka with Bhasma and has a Bha.sma bath is Bhasmanistha.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहादेव्यास्तथा देवो दक्षिणं नासिकापुटम् । चकर्त करजाग्रेण वामं च स्तनचूचुकम्
verses.transliteration: svāhādevyāstathā devo dakṣiṇaṃ nāsikāpuṭam | cakarta karajāgreṇa vāmaṃ ca stanacūcukam
verses.translation: Surely the evil spirits, ghosts and goblins and rf'p\ignant diseases flee at the very proximity of a Bhasma-
verses.commentary: Sense: Surely the evil spirits, ghosts and goblins and rf'p\ignant diseases flee at the very proximity of a Bhasma-
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भगस्य विपुले नेत्रे शतपत्रसमप्रभे । प्रसह्योत्पाटयामास भद्रः परमवेगवान्
verses.transliteration: bhagasya vipule netre śatapatrasamaprabhe | prasahyotpāṭayāmāsa bhadraḥ paramavegavān
verses.translation: Hence one should endeavour in all possible ways to collect Bhasma like wealth after performing the Pasupata vrata and be engaged in Bhasma-bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one should endeavour in all possible ways to collect Bhasma like wealth after performing the Pasupata vrata and be engaged in Bhasma-bath.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूष्णो दशनरेखां च दीप्तां मुक्तावलीमिव । जघान धनुषः कोट्या स तेनास्पष्टवागभूत्
verses.transliteration: pūṣṇo daśanarekhāṃ ca dīptāṃ muktāvalīmiva | jaghāna dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā sa tenāspaṣṭavāgabhūt
verses.translation: How could he attain the perfect knowledge in the course of his observance of penance? How did he secure the protective ashes the virile element of the Rudra fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could he attain the perfect knowledge in the course of his observance of penance? How did he secure the protective ashes the virile element of the Rudra fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चन्द्रमसं देवः पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया । क्षणं कृमिवदाक्रम्य घर्षयामास भूतले
verses.transliteration: tataścandramasaṃ devaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā | kṣaṇaṃ kṛmivadākramya gharṣayāmāsa bhūtale
verses.translation: His penance for the sake of obtaining milk became the gateway to the future grace of lord Siva obtained due to good luck.
verses.commentary: Sense: His penance for the sake of obtaining milk became the gateway to the future grace of lord Siva obtained due to good luck.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिरश्चिच्छेद दक्षस्य भद्रः परमकोपतः । क्रोशन्त्यामेव वैरिण्यां भद्रकाल्यै ददौ च तत्
verses.transliteration: śiraściccheda dakṣasya bhadraḥ paramakopataḥ | krośantyāmeva vairiṇyāṃ bhadrakālyai dadau ca tat
verses.translation: For the similarity of expression and contents of this and the following chapter, see Li Aga 1 07
verses.commentary: Sense: For the similarity of expression and contents of this and the following chapter, see Li Aga 1 07
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रहृष्टा समादाय शिरस्तालफलोपमम् । सा देवी कन्दुकक्रीडां चकार समराङ्गणे
verses.transliteration: tatprahṛṣṭā samādāya śirastālaphalopamam | sā devī kandukakrīḍāṃ cakāra samarāṅgaṇe
verses.translation: Siva granted him perpetual bachelorhood, lord- ship of all the Gaas along with an ocean of milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva granted him perpetual bachelorhood, lord- ship of all the Gaas along with an ocean of milk.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो दक्षस्य यज्ञस्त्री कुशीला भर्तृभिर्यथा । पादाभ्यां चैव हस्ताभ्यां हन्यते स्म गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: tato dakṣasya yajñastrī kuśīlā bhartṛbhiryathā | pādābhyāṃ caiva hastābhyāṃ hanyate sma gaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: His ability to propound the Sivaiistra was also derived from the lord. He rejoiced in attaining the ocean of knowledge from the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: His ability to propound the Sivaiistra was also derived from the lord. He rejoiced in attaining the ocean of knowledge from the sage.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमिनं सोमं धर्मं चैव प्रजापतिम् । बहुपुत्रं चाङ्गिरसं कृशाश्वं काश्यपं तथा
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭaneminaṃ somaṃ dharmaṃ caiva prajāpatim | bahuputraṃ cāṅgirasaṃ kṛśāśvaṃ kāśyapaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Once the boy had tasted some quantity of milk in the hermi age of his uncle. His uncle's son had drunk ample milk to his satiety. The jealous Upamanyu affectionately told his mother thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once the boy had tasted some quantity of milk in the hermi age of his uncle. His uncle's son had drunk ample milk to his satiety. The jealous Upamanyu affectionately told his mother thus.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गले प्रगृह्य बलिनो गणपाः सिंहविक्रमाः । भर्त्सयन्तो भृशं वाग्भिर्निजघ्नुर्मूर्ध्नि मुष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: gale pragṛhya balino gaṇapāḥ siṃhavikramāḥ | bhartsayanto bhṛśaṃ vāgbhirnijaghnurmūrdhni muṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: O mother, my blessed mother, O saintly woman, please give me sweet cow's milk. I shall drink it very hot.
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, my blessed mother, O saintly woman, please give me sweet cow's milk. I shall drink it very hot.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्षिता भूतवेतालैर्दाराः सुतपरिग्रहाः । यथा कलियुगे जारैर्बलेन कुलयोषितः
verses.transliteration: dharṣitā bhūtavetālairdārāḥ sutaparigrahāḥ | yathā kaliyuge jārairbalena kulayoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son, the saintly mother, the wife of Vyaghrapada, was very much distressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her son, the saintly mother, the wife of Vyaghrapada, was very much distressed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्च विध्वस्तकलशं भग्नयूपं गतोत्सवम् । प्रदीपितमहाशालं प्रभिन्नद्वारतोरणम्
verses.transliteration: tacca vidhvastakalaśaṃ bhagnayūpaṃ gatotsavam | pradīpitamahāśālaṃ prabhinnadvāratoraṇam
verses.translation: With love and affection she embraced the son and fondled him. Considering her poverty she became dejected and lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: With love and affection she embraced the son and fondled him. Considering her poverty she became dejected and lamented.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्पाटितसुरानीकं हन्यमानतपोधनम् । प्रशान्तब्रह्मनिर्घोषं प्रक्षीणजनसञ्चयम्
verses.transliteration: utpāṭitasurānīkaṃ hanyamānatapodhanam | praśāntabrahmanirghoṣaṃ prakṣīṇajanasañcayam
verses.translation: The boy Upamanyu could not forget the milk he wanted. He the innocent child of great splendour cried frequently pressing his mother to give him milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: The boy Upamanyu could not forget the milk he wanted. He the innocent child of great splendour cried frequently pressing his mother to give him milk.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रन्दमानातुरस्त्रीकं हताशेषपरिच्छदम् । शून्यारण्यनिभं जज्ञे यज्ञवाटं तदार्दितम्
verses.transliteration: krandamānāturastrīkaṃ hatāśeṣaparicchadam | śūnyāraṇyanibhaṃ jajñe yajñavāṭaṃ tadārditam
verses.translation: On drinking that watery stuff offered as milk, tht excited boy shouted. *0 mother, this is no milk.*
verses.commentary: Sense: On drinking that watery stuff offered as milk, tht excited boy shouted. *0 mother, this is no milk.*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शूलवेगप्ररुग्णाश्च भिन्नबाहूरुवक्षसः । विनिकृत्तोत्तमाङ्गाश्च पेतुरुर्व्यां सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śūlavegaprarugṇāśca bhinnabāhūruvakṣasaḥ | vinikṛttottamāṅgāśca petururvyāṃ surottamāḥ
verses.translation: The distressed mother when she saw the boy thus
verses.commentary: Sense: The distressed mother when she saw the boy thus
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हतेषु तेषु देवेषु पतितेषु सहस्रशः । प्रविवेश गणेशानः क्षणादाहवनीयकम्
verses.transliteration: hateṣu teṣu deveṣu patiteṣu sahasraśaḥ | praviveśa gaṇeśānaḥ kṣaṇādāhavanīyakam
verses.translation: Rivers full of gems whether in heaven or in the nether worlds are never- seen by unlucky people and those devoid of devotion to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rivers full of gems whether in heaven or in the nether worlds are never- seen by unlucky people and those devoid of devotion to Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टमथ तं दृष्ट्वा भद्रं कालाग्निसन्निभम् । दुद्राव मरणाद्भीतो यज्ञो मृगवपुर्धरः
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭamatha taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadraṃ kālāgnisannibham | dudrāva maraṇādbhīto yajño mṛgavapurdharaḥ
verses.translation: Whence can we have milk, we who stay in the forest for ever? O dear, where the sources of milk and where we the forest-dwellers?
verses.commentary: Sense: Whence can we have milk, we who stay in the forest for ever? O dear, where the sources of milk and where we the forest-dwellers?
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स विस्फार्य महच्चापं दृढज्याघोषणभीषणम् । भद्रस्तमभिदुद्राव विक्षिपन्नेव सायकान्
verses.transliteration: sa visphārya mahaccāpaṃ dṛḍhajyāghoṣaṇabhīṣaṇam | bhadrastamabhidudrāva vikṣipanneva sāyakān
verses.translation: Wanting everything and overwhelmed by poverty I, your unfortunate mother, have given you this improvised
verses.commentary: Sense: Wanting everything and overwhelmed by poverty I, your unfortunate mother, have given you this improvised
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आकर्णपूर्णमाकृष्टं धनुरम्बुदसन्निभम् । नादयामास च ज्यां द्यां खं च भूमिं च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣṭaṃ dhanurambudasannibham | nādayāmāsa ca jyāṃ dyāṃ khaṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: You tasted the boiled milk at your uncle's. So when you drank this 'sour stuff you found out on comparison that what I gave you was not milk. When you cry out saying so you make me miserable. Without the grace of Lord Siva you cannot have milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: You tasted the boiled milk at your uncle's. So when you drank this 'sour stuff you found out on comparison that what I gave you was not milk. When you cry out saying so you make me miserable. Without the grace of Lord Siva you cannot have milk.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमुपश्रुत्य सन्नादं हतोऽस्मीत्येव विह्वलम् । शरेणार्धेन वक्रेण स वीरोऽध्वरपूरुषम्
verses.transliteration: tamupaśrutya sannādaṃ hato'smītyeva vihvalam | śareṇārdhena vakreṇa sa vīro'dhvarapūruṣam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his mother, true but
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his mother, true but
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महाभयस्खलत्पादं वेपन्तं विगतत्विषम् । मृगरूपेण धावन्तं विशिरस्कं तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: mahābhayaskhalatpādaṃ vepantaṃ vigatatviṣam | mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṃ viśiraskaṃ tadākarot
verses.translation: O mother, do not feel unhappy; if there is Siva and Siva everything good will result. O blessed lady, eschew your grief,
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, do not feel unhappy; if there is Siva and Siva everything good will result. O blessed lady, eschew your grief,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमीदृशमवज्ञातं दृष्ट्वा वै सूर्यसम्भवम् । विष्णुः परमसङ्क्रुद्धो युद्धायाभवदुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: tamīdṛśamavajñātaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai sūryasambhavam | viṣṇuḥ paramasaṅkruddho yuddhāyābhavadudyataḥ
verses.translation: O mothc«, listen now to my words. If there is lord Siva anywhere sooner or later I shall get an ocean of milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: O mothc«, listen now to my words. If there is lord Siva anywhere sooner or later I shall get an ocean of milk.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाह महावेगात्स्कन्धेन नतसन्धिना । सर्वेषां वयसां राजा गरुडः पन्नगाशनः
verses.transliteration: tamuvāha mahāvegātskandhena natasandhinā | sarveṣāṃ vayasāṃ rājā garuḍaḥ pannagāśanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her highly intelligent son the delighted noble mother replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her highly intelligent son the delighted noble mother replied.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च हतशिष्टा ये देवराजपुरोगमाः । प्रचक्रुस्तस्य साहाय्यं प्राणांस्त्यक्तुमिवोद्यताः
verses.transliteration: devāśca hataśiṣṭā ye devarājapurogamāḥ | pracakrustasya sāhāyyaṃ prāṇāṃstyaktumivodyatāḥ
verses.translation: "Namah Sivaya", this mantra is directly expressive of Siva, the overlord of the gods, the bestower of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Namah Sivaya", this mantra is directly expressive of Siva, the overlord of the gods, the bestower of boons.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना सहितान् देवान् मृगेन्द्रः क्रोष्टुकानिव । दृष्ट्वा जहास भूतेन्द्रो मृगेन्द्र इव विव्यथः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā sahitān devān mṛgendraḥ kroṣṭukāniva | dṛṣṭvā jahāsa bhūtendro mṛgendra iva vivyathaḥ
verses.translation: Those Mantras are also beneficent with regard to those who are authorized therein. At the behest of the lord every one is authorized in this Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Mantras are also beneficent with regard to those who are authorized therein. At the behest of the lord every one is authorized in this Mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ

He worshipped him with the leaves and flowers available in the forest repeating the five-syllabled Mantra with devotion. He performed penance for a long lime,

verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२२. द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः । दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच तस्मिन्नवसरे व्योम्नि समाविरभवद्रथः । सहस्रसूर्यसङ्काशश्चारुचीरवृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.22. dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsavarṇanam | vāyuruvāca tasminnavasare vyomni samāvirabhavadrathaḥ | sahasrasūryasaṅkāśaścārucīravṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Assuming the forms of Raksasa certain ghosts of sages cursed formerly by Marici harassed the lonely, lean boy Upamanyu performing penance though he was an excel¬ lent brahmin devotee of Siva. Thus they caused obstacles to
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming the forms of Raksasa certain ghosts of sages cursed formerly by Marici harassed the lonely, lean boy Upamanyu performing penance though he was an excel¬ lent brahmin devotee of Siva. Thus they caused obstacles to

verses.sanskrit: अश्वरत्नद्वयोदारो रथचक्रचतुष्टयः । सञ्चितानेकदिव्यास्त्रशस्त्ररत्नपरिष्कृतः
verses.transliteration: aśvaratnadvayodāro rathacakracatuṣṭayaḥ | sañcitānekadivyāstraśastraratnapariṣkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Sadaiva accompanied by Uma and assum¬ ing the form of Indra, shone with that umbrella like the Mandara mountain with the disc of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Sadaiva accompanied by Uma and assum¬ ing the form of Indra, shone with that umbrella like the Mandara mountain with the disc of the moon.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापि रथवर्यस्यासीत्स एव हि सारथिः । यश्चैव त्रैपुरे युद्धे पूर्वं शार्वरथे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasyāpi rathavaryasyāsītsa eva hi sārathiḥ | yaścaiva traipure yuddhe pūrvaṃ śārvarathe sthitaḥ
verses.translation: I desire to secure the boon from that lord whom the knowers of truth meditate upon, who bestows the goal of Sarhkhya and Yoga, viz. release.
verses.commentary: Sense: I desire to secure the boon from that lord whom the knowers of truth meditate upon, who bestows the goal of Sarhkhya and Yoga, viz. release.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तं रथवरं ब्रह्मा शासनादेव शूलिनः । हरेः समीपमानीय कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ rathavaraṃ brahmā śāsanādeva śūlinaḥ | hareḥ samīpamānīya kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.translation: The Dundubhi drums were sounded in the heaven. There was a shower of flowers; the ten quarters were filled with the gods, chiefs of whom were Visnu, Brahma and Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Dundubhi drums were sounded in the heaven. There was a shower of flowers; the ten quarters were filled with the gods, chiefs of whom were Visnu, Brahma and Indra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् भद्र भद्राङ्ग भगवानिन्दुभूषणः । आज्ञापयति वीरस्त्वां रथमारोढुमव्ययः
verses.transliteration: bhagavan bhadra bhadrāṅga bhagavānindubhūṣaṇaḥ | ājñāpayati vīrastvāṃ rathamāroḍhumavyayaḥ
verses.translation: He gave him the Pasupata rite, the Paupata knowledge and the peipetual ability to propound and discourse.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave him the Pasupata rite, the Paupata knowledge and the peipetual ability to propound and discourse.

verses.transliteration: raibhyāśramasamīpasthastryambako'mbikayā saha | sampaśyate mahābāho dussahaṃ te parākramam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmin, I shall always be present in your hermitage. Near me you shall always blissfully sport about.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmin, I shall always be present in your hermitage. Near me you shall always blissfully sport about.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स वीरो गणकुञ्जरः । आरुरोह रथं दिव्यमनुगृह्य पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa vīro gaṇakuñjaraḥ | āruroha rathaṃ divyamanugṛhya pitāmaham
verses.translation: On seeing him hairs stood on their ends in the body of Krsna due to delight. Respectfully he circumambulated him thrice and knelt before him. With shoulders drooping and palms joined in reverence he delightfully eulogised him.

verses.transliteration: tathā rathavare tasmin sthite brahmaṇi sārathau | bhadrasya vavṛdhe lakṣmī rudrasyeva puradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: Due to that penance, at the end of a year, lord

verses.transliteration: tasya śaṅkhasya taṃ nādaṃ bhinnasāgarasannibham | śrutvā bhayena devānāṃ jajvāla jaṭharānalaḥ
verses.translation: Though harassed by them he somehow maintained his penance. He uttered "Nama Sivaya" like one in great distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though harassed by them he somehow maintained his penance. He uttered "Nama Sivaya" like one in great distress.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षविद्याधराहीन्द्रैः सिद्धैर्युद्धदिदृक्षुभिः । क्षणेन निबिडीभूताः साकाशविवरा दिशः
verses.transliteration: yakṣavidyādharāhīndraiḥ siddhairyuddhadidṛkṣubhiḥ | kṣaṇena nibiḍībhūtāḥ sākāśavivarā diśaḥ
verses.translation: At the very hearing of that sound the sages who hindered the penance left off that boy and began to serve him.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the very hearing of that sound the sages who hindered the penance left off that boy and began to serve him.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शार्ङ्गेण चापाङ्कात्स नारायणनीरदः । महता बाणवर्षेण तुतोद गणगोवृषम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śārṅgeṇa cāpāṅkātsa nārāyaṇanīradaḥ | mahatā bāṇavarṣeṇa tutoda gaṇagovṛṣam
verses.translation: O sages, the whole universe including the mobile and immobile beings became ignited due to the penance of that brahmin, the noble Upamanyu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, the whole universe including the mobile and immobile beings became ignited due to the penance of that brahmin, the noble Upamanyu.

verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumāyāntaṃ śatadhā bāṇavarṣiṇam | sa cādade dhanurjaitraṃ bhadro bāṇasahasramuk
verses.translation: On hearing them, lord Visnu thought "What is this?" After understanding the reason he immediately went to the Mandara mountain with a desire to see lord Siva. On seeing the lord and bowing to him with palms joined in reverence he said: —

verses.sanskrit: समादाय च तद्दिव्यं धनुः समरभैरवम् । शनैर्विस्फारयामास मेरुं धनुरिवेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: samādāya ca taddivyaṃ dhanuḥ samarabhairavam | śanairvisphārayāmāsa meruṃ dhanuriveśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O lord, a certain brahmin well known as Upam¬ anyu has burnt everything by his penance for obtaining the milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, a certain brahmin well known as Upam¬ anyu has burnt everything by his penance for obtaining the milk.

verses.translation: On hearing the words of Visnu, lord Siva said: — "I shall prevent the boy. You may please go back to your abodes".
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Visnu, lord Siva said: — "I shall prevent the boy. You may please go back to your abodes".

verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaravaraṃ ghoraṃ dīptamāśīviṣopamam | jagrāha gaṇapaḥ śrīmānsvayamugraparākramaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of lord Siva, Visnu the favourite of the gods went to his abode after consoling the gods and others.

verses.translation: Assuming the form of Indra, lord Siva went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.

verses.translation: Glancing at the brahmin who stood steady after saying thus, with palms joined in reverence, Siva in the guise of Indra spoke majestically.

verses.sanskrit: स तु तीव्रप्रपातेन शरेण दृढमाहतः । महतीं रुजमासाद्य निपपात विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: sa tu tīvraprapātena śareṇa dṛḍhamāhataḥ | mahatīṃ rujamāsādya nipapāta vimohitaḥ
verses.translation: You have said all these things in your eagerness to disparage Siva. In that context you have mentioned the Nirgunatva of the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have said all these things in your eagerness to disparage Siva. In that context you have mentioned the Nirgunatva of the great lord.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनः क्षणादिवोत्थाय लब्धसंज्ञस्तदा हरिः । सर्वाण्यपि च दिव्यास्त्राण्यथैनं प्रत्यवासृजत्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ kṣaṇādivotthāya labdhasaṃjñastadā hariḥ | sarvāṇyapi ca divyāstrāṇyathainaṃ pratyavāsṛjat
verses.translation: You do not know Rudra the lord of the chiefs of the gods, the progenitor of Brahma, Visnu and Siva and who is greater than Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: You do not know Rudra the lord of the chiefs of the gods, the progenitor of Brahma, Visnu and Siva and who is greater than Prakrti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स च विष्णुर्धनुर्मुक्तान्सर्वान् शर्वचमूपतिः । सहसा वारयामास घोरैः प्रतिशरैः शरान्
verses.transliteration: sa ca viṣṇurdhanurmuktānsarvān śarvacamūpatiḥ | sahasā vārayāmāsa ghoraiḥ pratiśaraiḥ śarān
verses.translation: I desire to get my boon granted by the lord who is separate from Sat and Asar, who is the unmanifest, as mentioned by the propounders of Brahman and who is eternal, single and multifarious
verses.commentary: Sense: I desire to get my boon granted by the lord who is separate from Sat and Asar, who is the unmanifest, as mentioned by the propounders of Brahman and who is eternal, single and multifarious
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो विष्णुः स्वनामाङ्कं बाणमव्याहतं क्वचित् । ससर्ज क्रोधरक्ताक्षः तमुद्दिश्य गणेश्वरम् । तं बाणं बाणवर्येण भद्रो भद्राह्वयेण तु
verses.transliteration: tato viṣṇuḥ svanāmāṅkaṃ bāṇamavyāhataṃ kvacit | sasarja krodharaktākṣaḥ tamuddiśya gaṇeśvaram | taṃ bāṇaṃ bāṇavaryeṇa bhadro bhadrāhvayeṇa tu
verses.translation: On hearing the censure of Siva, one shall immedia¬ tely abandon one's life and slay that person too. He then attains Siva's region."*
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the censure of Siva, one shall immedia¬ tely abandon one's life and slay that person too. He then attains Siva's region."*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्राप्तमेव भगवान् चिच्छेद शतधा पथि । अथैकेनेषुणा शार्ङ्गं द्वाभ्यां पक्षौ गरुत्मतः
verses.transliteration: aprāptameva bhagavān ciccheda śatadhā pathi | athaikeneṣuṇā śārṅgaṃ dvābhyāṃ pakṣau garutmataḥ
verses.translation: O base god, let my desire for milk wait. After killing you with Siva's missile 1 shall abandon this body of mine.
verses.commentary: Sense: O base god, let my desire for milk wait. After killing you with Siva's missile 1 shall abandon this body of mine.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निमेषादेव चिच्छेद तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् । ततो योगबलाद्विष्णुर्देहाद्देवान् सुदारुणान्
verses.transliteration: nimeṣādeva ciccheda tadadbhutamivābhavat | tato yogabalādviṣṇurdehāddevān sudāruṇān
verses.translation: After saying th'S, Upamanyu, ready to die himself eschewed his desire for milk and got ready to kill Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying th'S, Upamanyu, ready to die himself eschewed his desire for milk and got ready to kill Indra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्तान् विससर्ज सहस्रशः । सर्वांस्तान्क्षणमात्रेण त्रैपुरानिव शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāhastān visasarja sahasraśaḥ | sarvāṃstānkṣaṇamātreṇa traipurāniva śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: He took the ash and reinvigorated it with the Aghotstra mantra. Aiming it at Indra he cast it ofif and
verses.commentary: Sense: He took the ash and reinvigorated it with the Aghotstra mantra. Aiming it at Indra he cast it ofif and
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्ददाह महाबाहुर्नेत्रसृष्टेन वह्निना । ततः क्रुद्धतरो विष्णुश्चक्रमुद्यम्य सत्वरः
verses.transliteration: nirdadāha mahābāhurnetrasṛṣṭena vahninā | tataḥ kruddhataro viṣṇuścakramudyamya satvaraḥ
verses.translation: P. adds after this Verse
verses.commentary: Sense: P. adds after this Verse
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्वीरे समुत्स्रष्टुं तदानीमुद्यतोऽभवत् । तं दृष्ट्वा चक्रमुद्यम्य पुरतः समुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tasminvīre samutsraṣṭuṃ tadānīmudyato'bhavat | taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakramudyamya purataḥ samupasthitam
verses.translation: When the brahmin attempted this, lord Siva disguised as Siva who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga prevented the mis.sile of the Yogin gently.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the brahmin attempted this, lord Siva disguised as Siva who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga prevented the mis.sile of the Yogin gently.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मयन्निव गणेशानो व्यष्टम्भयदयत्नतः । स्तम्भिताङ्गस्तु तच्चक्रं घोरमप्रतिमं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: smayanniva gaṇeśāno vyaṣṭambhayadayatnataḥ | stambhitāṅgastu taccakraṃ ghoramapratimaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, Nandin the favourite of Siva caught in the middle the Aghorastra hurled by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, Nandin the favourite of Siva caught in the middle the Aghorastra hurled by him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इच्छन्नपि समुत्स्रष्टुं न विष्णुरभवत्क्षमः । श्वसन्निवैकमुद्धृत्य बाहुं चक्रसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: icchannapi samutsraṣṭuṃ na viṣṇurabhavatkṣamaḥ | śvasannivaikamuddhṛtya bāhuṃ cakrasamanvitam
verses.translation: Assuming his own form with the crescent moon for his crest, Lord Siva revealed himself to the brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming his own form with the crescent moon for his crest, Lord Siva revealed himself to the brahmin.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतिष्ठदलसो भूत्वा पाषाणामिव निश्चलः । विशरीरो यथा जीवो विशृङ्गो वा यथा वृषः
verses.transliteration: atiṣṭhadalaso bhūtvā pāṣāṇāmiva niścalaḥ | viśarīro yathā jīvo viśṛṅgo vā yathā vṛṣaḥ
verses.translation: The Lord showed to him a thousand oceans of milk, nectar curds, ghee, fruits, foodstuffs and a mountain of sweet pies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord showed to him a thousand oceans of milk, nectar curds, ghee, fruits, foodstuffs and a mountain of sweet pies.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विदंष्ट्रश्च यथा सिंहस्तथा विष्णुरवस्थितः । तं दृष्ट्वा दुर्दशापन्नं विष्णुमिन्द्रादयः सुराः । समुन्नद्धा गणेन्द्रेण मृगेन्द्रेणेव गोवृषाः
verses.transliteration: vidaṃṣṭraśca yathā siṃhastathā viṣṇuravasthitaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā durdaśāpannaṃ viṣṇumindrādayaḥ surāḥ | samunnaddhā gaṇendreṇa mṛgendreṇeva govṛṣāḥ
verses.translation: The lord appeared thus seated on the bull along with the goddess and surrounded by the lords of Ganas and holding the divine missiles, trident etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord appeared thus seated on the bull along with the goddess and surrounded by the lords of Ganas and holding the divine missiles, trident etc.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृहीतायुधा यौद्धुं क्रुद्धाः समुपतस्थिरे । तान्दृष्ट्वा समरे भद्रः क्षुद्रानिव हरिर्मृगान्
verses.transliteration: pragṛhītāyudhā yauddhuṃ kruddhāḥ samupatasthire | tāndṛṣṭvā samare bhadraḥ kṣudrāniva harirmṛgān
verses.translation: Then Upamanyu enveloped by the waves of bliss fell at his feet, his mind made humble with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Upamanyu enveloped by the waves of bliss fell at his feet, his mind made humble with devotion.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद् रुद्रतनुर्वीरो वरवीरगणावृतः । अट्टहासेन घोरेण व्यष्टम्भयदनिन्दितः
verses.transliteration: sākṣād rudratanurvīro varavīragaṇāvṛtaḥ | aṭṭahāsena ghoreṇa vyaṣṭambhayadaninditaḥ
verses.translation: Then the smiling lord Siva called him nearer, kissed him on the head and granted him boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the smiling lord Siva called him nearer, kissed him on the head and granted him boons.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा शतमखस्यापि सवज्रो दक्षिणः करः । सिसृक्षोरेव उद्वज्रश्चित्रीकृत इवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tathā śatamakhasyāpi savajro dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ | sisṛkṣoreva udvajraścitrīkṛta ivābhavat
verses.translation: O fortunate Upamanyu, this goddess Parvati is your mother. You have been adopted as my son. The milk ocean is given to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fortunate Upamanyu, this goddess Parvati is your mother. You have been adopted as my son. The milk ocean is given to you.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषामपि सर्वेषां सरक्ता अपि बाहवः । अलसानामिवारम्भास्तादृशाः प्रतियान्त्युत
verses.transliteration: anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ saraktā api bāhavaḥ | alasānāmivārambhāstādṛśāḥ pratiyāntyuta
verses.translation: O sage, mountains of sweet pies, the ocean of food stuffs, these are given to you. Please take them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, mountains of sweet pies, the ocean of food stuffs, these are given to you. Please take them.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं भगवता तेन व्याहताशेषवैभवात् । अमराः समरे तस्य पुरतः स्थातुमक्षमाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhagavatā tena vyāhatāśeṣavaibhavāt | amarāḥ samare tasya purataḥ sthātumakṣamāḥ
verses.translation: Choose boons as you please. I am delighted. I shall grant you boons. You need not hesitate at all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Choose boons as you please. I am delighted. I shall grant you boons. You need not hesitate at all.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तब्धैरवयवैरेव दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः । स्थितिं च चक्रिरे युद्धे वीरतेजोऽभयाकुलाः
verses.transliteration: stabdhairavayavaireva dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ | sthitiṃ ca cakrire yuddhe vīratejo'bhayākulāḥ
verses.translation: Saying thus lord Siva caught him with his hands, kissed him on the head and handed him over to the goddess saying, "This is your son."
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying thus lord Siva caught him with his hands, kissed him on the head and handed him over to the goddess saying, "This is your son."
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्रुतांस्त्रिदशान्वीरान्वीरभद्रो महाभुजः । विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैएर्मेघो वर्षैरिवाचलान्
verses.transliteration: vidrutāṃstridaśānvīrānvīrabhadro mahābhujaḥ | vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiermegho varṣairivācalān
verses.translation: The goddess received him with pleasure like Guha, placed her hand on his head, granted him the unchan¬ gings status of a Bachelor.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess received him with pleasure like Guha, placed her hand on his head, granted him the unchan¬ gings status of a Bachelor.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बहवस्तस्य वीरस्य बाहवः परिघोपमाः । शस्त्रैश्चकाशिरे दीप्तैः साग्निज्वाला इवोरगाः
verses.transliteration: bahavastasya vīrasya bāhavaḥ parighopamāḥ | śastraiścakāśire dīptaiḥ sāgnijvālā ivoragāḥ
verses.translation: The milk ocean came in an embodied form holding sweet milk in his hands. Approaching the saintly boy he gave him imperishable condensed milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: The milk ocean came in an embodied form holding sweet milk in his hands. Approaching the saintly boy he gave him imperishable condensed milk.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रशस्त्राण्यनेकानि स वीरो विसृजन्बभौ । विसृजन्सर्वभूतानि यथादौ विश्वसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: astraśastrāṇyanekāni sa vīro visṛjanbabhau | visṛjansarvabhūtāni yathādau viśvasambhavaḥ
verses.translation: The goddess, out of delight, gave him the Yogic prosperity, perpetual contentment, imperishable Brahma- Vidya and the greatest affluence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess, out of delight, gave him the Yogic prosperity, perpetual contentment, imperishable Brahma- Vidya and the greatest affluence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा रश्मिभिरादित्यः प्रच्छादयति मेदिनीम् । तथा वीरः क्षणादेव शरैः प्राच्छादयद्दिशः
verses.transliteration: yathā raśmibhirādityaḥ pracchādayati medinīm | tathā vīraḥ kṣaṇādeva śaraiḥ prācchādayaddiśaḥ
verses.translation: The delighted Siva saw the splendour of his penance, granted boons again to the sage Upamanyu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted Siva saw the splendour of his penance, granted boons again to the sage Upamanyu.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: खमण्डले गणेन्द्रस्य शराः कनकभूषिताः । उत्पतन्तस्तडिद्रूपैरुपमानपदं ययुः
verses.transliteration: khamaṇḍale gaṇendrasya śarāḥ kanakabhūṣitāḥ | utpatantastaḍidrūpairupamānapadaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Obtaining the divine boons and the perpetual bachelorhood from Siva and Siva he became joyous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obtaining the divine boons and the perpetual bachelorhood from Siva and Siva he became joyous.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महान्तस्ते सुरगणान् मण्डूकानिव डुण्डुभाः । प्राणैर्वियोजयामासुः पपुश्च रुधिरासवम्
verses.transliteration: mahāntaste suragaṇān maṇḍūkāniva ḍuṇḍubhāḥ | prāṇairviyojayāmāsuḥ papuśca rudhirāsavam
verses.translation: Delighted in his mind he bowed with palms joined in reverence. The brahmin then requested lord Siva for a boon and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted in his mind he bowed with palms joined in reverence. The brahmin then requested lord Siva for a boon and said.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निकृत्तबाहवः केचित्केचिल्लूनवराननाः । पार्श्वे विदारिताः केचिन्निपेतुरमरा भुवि
verses.transliteration: nikṛttabāhavaḥ kecitkecillūnavarānanāḥ | pārśve vidāritāḥ kecinnipeturamarā bhuvi
verses.translation: "O lord of the chiefs of the gods, be pleased. Please grant me devotion to you, great, divine and unflinching.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord of the chiefs of the gods, be pleased. Please grant me devotion to you, great, divine and unflinching.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विशिखोन्मथितैर्गात्रैर्बहुभिश्छिन्नसन्धिभिः । विवृत्तनयनाः केचिन्निपेतुर्भूतले मृताः । गां प्रवेष्टुमिवेच्छन्तः खं गन्तुमिव लिप्सवः
verses.transliteration: viśikhonmathitairgātrairbahubhiśchinnasandhibhiḥ | vivṛttanayanāḥ kecinnipeturbhūtale mṛtāḥ | gāṃ praveṣṭumivecchantaḥ khaṃ gantumiva lipsavaḥ
verses.translation: O great lord, grant me an abiding faith in persons devoted to you. Grant me the great slavery and the perpetual proximity to you,
verses.commentary: Sense: O great lord, grant me an abiding faith in persons devoted to you. Grant me the great slavery and the perpetual proximity to you,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धात्मनिरोधानां व्यलीयन्तः परस्परम् । भूमौ केचित्प्रविविशुः पर्वतानां गुहाः परे
verses.transliteration: alabdhātmanirodhānāṃ vyalīyantaḥ parasparam | bhūmau kecitpraviviśuḥ parvatānāṃ guhāḥ pare
verses.translation: After saying this, Upamanyu the excellent brahmin eulogised the lord in the words choked with delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Upamanyu the excellent brahmin eulogised the lord in the words choked with delight.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपरे जग्मुराकाशं परे च विविशुर्जलम् । तथा सञ्छिन्नसर्वाङ्गैः स वीरस्त्रिदशैर्बभौ
verses.transliteration: apare jagmurākāśaṃ pare ca viviśurjalam | tathā sañchinnasarvāṅgaiḥ sa vīrastridaśairbabhau
verses.translation: "O great lord, O lord of gods, favourably disposed to those who seek refuge in you. O ocean of mercy, be pleased always, O Siva, accompanied by Parvati,
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great lord, O lord of gods, favourably disposed to those who seek refuge in you. O ocean of mercy, be pleased always, O Siva, accompanied by Parvati,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिग्रस्तः प्रजावर्गो भगवानिव भैरवः । दग्धत्रिपुरसंव्यूहस्त्रिपुरारिर्यथाऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: parigrastaḥ prajāvargo bhagavāniva bhairavaḥ | dagdhatripurasaṃvyūhastripurāriryathā'bhavat
verses.translation: Thus requested lord Siva, the granter of boons
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested lord Siva, the granter of boons
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं देवबलं सर्वं दीनं बीभत्सदर्शनम् । गणेश्वरसमुत्पन्नं कृपणं वपुराददे
verses.transliteration: evaṃ devabalaṃ sarvaṃ dīnaṃ bībhatsadarśanam | gaṇeśvarasamutpannaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vapurādade
verses.translation: O dear Upamanyu, I am delighted. Indeed every¬ thing has been granted by me to you. O brahminical sag, you are of steady devotion. I wanted to test you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear Upamanyu, I am delighted. Indeed every¬ thing has been granted by me to you. O brahminical sag, you are of steady devotion. I wanted to test you.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा त्रिदशवीराणामसृक्सलिलवाहिनी । प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा प्राणिनां भयशंसिनी
verses.transliteration: tadā tridaśavīrāṇāmasṛksalilavāhinī | prāvartata nadī ghorā prāṇināṃ bhayaśaṃsinī
verses.translation: Be free from old age, death and misery. Be glorious and endowed with splendour and divine knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be free from old age, death and misery. Be glorious and endowed with splendour and divine knowledge.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुधिरेण परिक्लिन्ना यज्ञभूमिस्तदा बभौ । रक्तार्द्रवसना श्यामा हतशुम्भेव कैशिकी
verses.transliteration: rudhireṇa pariklinnā yajñabhūmistadā babhau | raktārdravasanā śyāmā hataśumbheva kaiśikī
verses.translation: Your kinsmen, your family and spiritual lineage shall be everlasting. O excellent brahmin, your devotion to me shall be permanent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your kinsmen, your family and spiritual lineage shall be everlasting. O excellent brahmin, your devotion to me shall be permanent.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्महति संवृत्ते समरे भृशदारुणे । भयेनेव परित्रस्ता प्रचचाल वसुन्धरा
verses.transliteration: tasminmahati saṃvṛtte samare bhṛśadāruṇe | bhayeneva paritrastā pracacāla vasundharā
verses.translation: Thus granting him the boons lord Siva who had the lustre of a crore suns, vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus granting him the boons lord Siva who had the lustre of a crore suns, vanished there itself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महोर्मिकलिलावर्तश्चुक्षुभे च महोदधिः । पेतुश्चोल्का महोत्पाताः शाखाश्च मुमुचुर्द्रुमाः
verses.transliteration: mahormikalilāvartaścukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ | petuścolkā mahotpātāḥ śākhāśca mumucurdrumāḥ
verses.translation: Securing the boons from the lord, Upamanyu, delighted in his mind, went to his mother's abode and attained the supreme bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing the boons from the lord, Upamanyu, delighted in his mind, went to his mother's abode and attained the supreme bliss.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रसन्ना दिशः सर्वाः पवनश्चाशिवो ववौ । अहो विधिविपर्यासस्त्वश्वमेधोऽयमध्वरः । यजमानः स्वयं दक्षौ ब्रह्मपुत्रप्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: aprasannā diśaḥ sarvāḥ pavanaścāśivo vavau | aho vidhiviparyāsastvaśvamedho'yamadhvaraḥ | yajamānaḥ svayaṃ dakṣau brahmaputraprajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: After narrating how Uparnanyu attained favours from the lord, Vayu got up for the routine observances when the sun reached the middle of the sky. All the sages, the residents of the Naimisa forest, resolved within themselves what topic should be asked. After performing their duties as usual, they saw that the lord Vayu was coming and so sat waiting for him.
verses.wordMeaning: After narrating how Uparnanyu attained favours from the lord, Vayu got up for the routine observances when the sun reached the middle of the sky. All the sages, the residents of the Naimisa forest, resolved within themselves what topic should be asked.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After narrating how Uparnanyu attained favours from the lord, Vayu got up for the routine observances when the sun reached the middle of the sky. All the sages, the residents of the Naimisa forest, resolved within themselves what topic should be asked.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादयः सदस्याश्च रक्षतो गरुडध्वजः । भागांश्च प्रतिगृह्णन्ति साक्षादिन्द्रादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: dharmādayaḥ sadasyāśca rakṣato garuḍadhvajaḥ | bhāgāṃśca pratigṛhṇanti sākṣādindrādayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the observance of the daily routine lord Vayu occupied his assigned seat in the middle of the assembly of the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the observance of the daily routine lord Vayu occupied his assigned seat in the middle of the assembly of the sages.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथापि यजमानस्य यज्ञस्य च सहर्त्विजः । सद्य एव शिरश्छेदः साधु सम्पद्यते फलम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi yajamānasya yajñasya ca sahartvijaḥ | sadya eva śiraśchedaḥ sādhu sampadyate phalam
verses.translation: Vayu, saluted by all the worlds, comfortably seated himself in the seat. Keeping well in his mind the glorious prosperity of the lord, he spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vayu, saluted by all the worlds, comfortably seated himself in the seat. Keeping well in his mind the glorious prosperity of the lord, he spoke thus.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्नावेदनिर्दिष्टं न चेश्वरबहिष्कृतम् । नासत्परिगृहीतं च कर्म कुर्यात्कदाचन
verses.transliteration: tasmānnāvedanirdiṣṭaṃ na ceśvarabahiṣkṛtam | nāsatparigṛhītaṃ ca karma kuryātkadācana
verses.translation: "I resort to that great lord, the unvanquished and the omniscient whose prosperity and glory constitute the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I resort to that great lord, the unvanquished and the omniscient whose prosperity and glory constitute the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वापि सुमहत्पुण्यमिष्ट्वा यज्ञशतैरपि । न तत्फलमवाप्नोति भक्तिहीनो महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: kṛtvāpi sumahatpuṇyamiṣṭvā yajñaśatairapi | na tatphalamavāpnoti bhaktihīno maheśvare
verses.translation: On hearing the auspicious statement the sages of quelled sins spoke these words in order to hear further the details of the lord's glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the auspicious statement the sages of quelled sins spoke these words in order to hear further the details of the lord's glory.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं भक्त्या यजति यः शिवम् । मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ bhaktyā yajati yaḥ śivam | mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: O lord, you have already mentioned the details of Uparnanyu of noble soul, how he attained various favours from the supreme lord by means of the penance performed for the.sake of milk. Formerly, we had heard that this elder
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you have already mentioned the details of Uparnanyu of noble soul, how he attained various favours from the supreme lord by means of the penance performed for the.sake of milk. Formerly, we had heard that this elder

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन वृथा दानं वृथा तपः । वृथा यज्ञो वृथा होमः शिवनिन्दारतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena vṛthā dānaṃ vṛthā tapaḥ | vṛthā yajño vṛthā homaḥ śivanindāratasya tu
verses.translation: Vasudeva, the eternal god, had taken his incarnation out of his own free will. Still he performed the purificatory rites for his body thereby indicating that the human body is worthy of censure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasudeva, the eternal god, had taken his incarnation out of his own free will. Still he performed the purificatory rites for his body thereby indicating that the human body is worthy of censure.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सनारायणकाः सरुद्राः सलोकपालाः समरे सुरौघाः । गणेन्द्रचापच्युतबाणविद्धाः प्रदुद्रुवुर्गाढरुजाभिभूताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sanārāyaṇakāḥ sarudrāḥ salokapālāḥ samare suraughāḥ | gaṇendracāpacyutabāṇaviddhāḥ pradudruvurgāḍharujābhibhūtāḥ
verses.translation: He went to the great sage's hermitage resorted to by other sages, in order to perform a penance for the sake of sons. There he saw the sage Upamanyu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to the great sage's hermitage resorted to by other sages, in order to perform a penance for the sake of sons. There he saw the sage Upamanyu.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चेलुः क्वचित्केचन शीर्णकेशाः सेदुः क्वचित्केचन दीर्घगात्राः । पेतुः क्वचित्केचन भिन्नवक्त्रा नेशुः क्वचित्केचन देववीराः
verses.transliteration: celuḥ kvacitkecana śīrṇakeśāḥ seduḥ kvacitkecana dīrghagātrāḥ | petuḥ kvacitkecana bhinnavaktrā neśuḥ kvacitkecana devavīrāḥ
verses.translation: At the mere vision of the sage, all dirt born of Maya and Karman of Krsna was quelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the mere vision of the sage, all dirt born of Maya and Karman of Krsna was quelled.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: केचिच्च तत्र त्रिदशा विपन्ना विस्रस्तवस्त्राभरणास्त्रशस्त्राः । निपेतुरुद्भासितदीनमुद्रा मदं च दर्पं च बलं च हित्वा
verses.transliteration: kecicca tatra tridaśā vipannā visrastavastrābharaṇāstraśastrāḥ | nipeturudbhāsitadīnamudrā madaṃ ca darpaṃ ca balaṃ ca hitvā
verses.translation: When the dirt of Krsna had been quelled, Upamanyu dusted him with Bhasma repeating the Mantras "Agniriti"®*" etc. He was then made to perform the Pasupata Vrata lasting for twelvemonths. Then the sage imparted to him the excellent knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the dirt of Krsna had been quelled, Upamanyu dusted him with Bhasma repeating the Mantras "Agniriti"®*" etc. He was then made to perform the Pasupata Vrata lasting for twelvemonths. Then the sage imparted to him the excellent knowledge.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सस्मुत्पथप्रस्थितमप्रधृष्यो विक्षिप्य दक्षाध्वरमक्षतास्त्रैः । बभौ गणेशः स गणेश्वराणां मध्ये स्थितः सिंह इवर्षभाणाम्
verses.transliteration: sasmutpathaprasthitamapradhṛṣyo vikṣipya dakṣādhvaramakṣatāstraiḥ | babhau gaṇeśaḥ sa gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ madhye sthitaḥ siṃha ivarṣabhāṇām
verses.translation: Since then the divine Pasupata sages of duly completed rites surrounded him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since then the divine Pasupata sages of duly completed rites surrounded him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated to you how Kfna of wide activities attained knowledge from the great sage and a son from Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have narrated to you how Kfna of wide activities attained knowledge from the great sage and a son from Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated to you how Kfna of wide activities attained knowledge from the great sage and a son from Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have narrated to you how Kfna of wide activities attained knowledge from the great sage and a son from Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । गिरिशानुनयः । वायुरुवाच । इति सञ्छिन्नभिन्नाङ्गा देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः । क्षणात्कष्टां दशामेत्य त्रेसुः स्तोकावशेषिताः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.23. trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | giriśānunayaḥ | vāyuruvāca | iti sañchinnabhinnāṅgā devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ | kṣaṇātkaṣṭāṃ daśāmetya tresuḥ stokāvaśeṣitāḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this everyday, listens to it or narrates it to others attains Vinu's wisdom and rejoices with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this everyday, listens to it or narrates it to others attains Vinu's wisdom and rejoices with him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रस्तांस्तान्समरे वीरान् देवानन्यांश्च वै गणाः । प्रमथाः परमक्रुद्धा वीरभद्रप्रणोदिताः
verses.transliteration: trastāṃstānsamare vīrān devānanyāṃśca vai gaṇāḥ | pramathāḥ paramakruddhā vīrabhadrapraṇoditāḥ
verses.translation: It is only at the behest of the lord that ether pervades all, yields space to the elements. At the bidding of Siva the wind sustains the entire universe, internal and external, under different names of Prana, etc. At the bidding of the lord the firegod bears offerings to the gods and oblations to the Pitrs. It facilitates cooking etc. At his behest the waters enliven all. At the bidding of the lord the earth holds up the universe for ever.
verses.wordMeaning: It is only at the behest of the lord that ether pervades all, yields space to the elements. At the bidding of Siva the wind sustains the entire universe, internal and external, under different names of Prana, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is only at the behest of the lord that ether pervades all, yields space to the elements. At the bidding of Siva the wind sustains the entire universe, internal and external, under different names of Prana, etc.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य च तथा दोषं निगडैरायसैर्दृढैः । बबन्धुः पाणिपादेषु कन्धरेषूदरेषु च
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya ca tathā doṣaṃ nigaḍairāyasairdṛḍhaiḥ | babandhuḥ pāṇipādeṣu kandhareṣūdareṣu ca
verses.translation: The thunderbolt coming into contact with the grass appeared to clash with a steel and fell aside.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thunderbolt coming into contact with the grass appeared to clash with a steel and fell aside.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे ब्रह्मा भद्रमद्रीन्द्रजानुतम् । सारथ्याल्लब्धवात्सल्यः प्रार्थयन् प्रणतोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare brahmā bhadramadrīndrajānutam | sārathyāllabdhavātsalyaḥ prārthayan praṇato'bravīt
verses.translation: There are other bodies as well, called Paflcabrah- mans. There is nothing which is not pervaded by those bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other bodies as well, called Paflcabrah- mans. There is nothing which is not pervaded by those bodies.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अलं क्रोधेन भगवन्नष्टाश्चैते दिवौकसः । प्रसीद क्षम्यतां सर्वं रोमजैः सह सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: alaṃ krodhena bhagavannaṣṭāścaite divaukasaḥ | prasīda kṣamyatāṃ sarvaṃ romajaiḥ saha suvrata
verses.translation: The universe consists of eight Murtis, of the primordial lord of the gods, wherein " lies stretched the universe as the gems and beads in the string.
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe consists of eight Murtis, of the primordial lord of the gods, wherein " lies stretched the universe as the gems and beads in the string.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विज्ञापितस्तेन ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । शमं जगाम सम्प्रीतो गणपस्तस्य गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vijñāpitastena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | śamaṃ jagāma samprīto gaṇapastasya gauravāt
verses.translation: I'he propitiation of Siva bestows protection, blessing and renders help unto all.
verses.commentary: Sense: I'he propitiation of Siva bestows protection, blessing and renders help unto all.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च लब्धावसरा देवदेवस्य मन्त्रिणः । धारयन्तोऽञ्जलीन्मूर्ध्नि तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: devāśca labdhāvasarā devadevasya mantriṇaḥ | dhārayanto'ñjalīnmūrdhni tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ
verses.translation: With j)ious emotions worship Siva who presides over the universe in the form of Astamurti Rudra, the great cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: With j)ious emotions worship Siva who presides over the universe in the form of Astamurti Rudra, the great cause.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय यज्ञहन्त्रे त्रिशूलिने । रुद्रभद्राय रुद्राणां पतये रुद्रभूतये
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | namaḥ śivāya śāntāya yajñahantre triśūline | rudrabhadrāya rudrāṇāṃ pataye rudrabhūtaye
verses.translation: O holy lord, it has been heard how this universe is pervaded by the Murtis of lord Siva, of unmeasured brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, it has been heard how this universe is pervaded by the Murtis of lord Siva, of unmeasured brilliance.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निरुद्ररूपाय कालकामाङ्गहारिणे । देवतानां शिरोहन्त्रे दक्षस्य च दुरात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kālāgnirudrarūpāya kālakāmāṅgahāriṇe | devatānāṃ śirohantre dakṣasya ca durātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Now I wish to know the innate nature of the great lord and the goddess. How is this universe having male and female traits presided over by them
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I wish to know the innate nature of the great lord and the goddess. How is this universe having male and female traits presided over by them
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संसर्गादस्य पापस्य दक्षस्य क्लिष्टकर्मणः । शासिताः समरे वीर त्वया वयमनिन्दिताः
verses.transliteration: saṃsargādasya pāpasya dakṣasya kliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | śāsitāḥ samare vīra tvayā vayamaninditāḥ
verses.translation: O lord Vayu, of the form of Siva, please explain all these things. In the whole of the three worlds there is no other p)erson competent to explain it like you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Vayu, of the form of Siva, please explain all these things. In the whole of the three worlds there is no other p)erson competent to explain it like you.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दग्धाश्चामी वयं सर्वे त्वत्तो भीताश्च भो प्रभो । त्वमेव गतिरस्माकं त्राहि नः शरणागतान्
verses.transliteration: dagdhāścāmī vayaṃ sarve tvatto bhītāśca bho prabho | tvameva gatirasmākaṃ trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the sages, Vayu thought ' upon Siva, and began to explain.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the sages, Vayu thought ' upon Siva, and began to explain.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । तुष्टस्त्वेवं स्तुतो देवान् विसृज्य निगडात्प्रभुः । आनयद्देवदेवस्य समीपममरानिह
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | tuṣṭastvevaṃ stuto devān visṛjya nigaḍātprabhuḥ | ānayaddevadevasya samīpamamarāniha
verses.translation: This excellent and exalted PaSupata knowledge was mentioned to the goddess by lord Siva on the mountain Mandara.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent and exalted PaSupata knowledge was mentioned to the goddess by lord Siva on the mountain Mandara.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवोऽपि तत्र भगवानन्तरिक्षे स्थितः प्रभुः । सगणः सर्वगः शर्वः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: devo'pi tatra bhagavānantarikṣe sthitaḥ prabhuḥ | sagaṇaḥ sarvagaḥ śarvaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: I shall explain it succinctly as imparted to Kfa by Upamanyu. Please hear attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain it succinctly as imparted to Kfa by Upamanyu. Please hear attentively.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा परमेशानं देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः । प्रीता अपि च भीताश्च नमश्चक्रुर्महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśānaṃ devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ | prītā api ca bhītāśca namaścakrurmaheśvaram
verses.translation: Formerly Visnu in the form of bowed to
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly Visnu in the form of bowed to
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तानमरान्भीतान्प्रणतार्तिहरो हरः । इदमाह महादेवः प्रहसन् प्रेक्ष्य पार्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tānamarānbhītānpraṇatārtiharo haraḥ | idamāha mahādevaḥ prahasan prekṣya pārvatīm
verses.translation: O lord, I wish to hear about the divine PaiSupata knowledge as mentioned to the goddess by the lord. I wish to hear about his prosperity and glory entirely.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I wish to hear about the divine PaiSupata knowledge as mentioned to the goddess by the lord. I wish to hear about his prosperity and glory entirely.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । मा भैष्ट त्रिदशाः सर्वे यूयं वै मामिकाः प्रजाः । अनुग्रहार्थमेवेह धृतो दण्डः कृपालुना
verses.transliteration: mahādeva uvāca | mā bhaiṣṭa tridaśāḥ sarve yūyaṃ vai māmikāḥ prajāḥ | anugrahārthameveha dhṛto daṇḍaḥ kṛpālunā
verses.translation: Thus implored by the noble Krsna the glorious Upamanyu bowed to the lord and the goddess and spoke as follows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored by the noble Krsna the glorious Upamanyu bowed to the lord and the goddess and spoke as follows.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भवतां निर्ज्जराणां हि क्षान्तोऽस्माभिर्व्यतिक्रमः । क्रुद्धेष्वस्मासु युष्माकं न स्थितिर्न च जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: bhavatāṃ nirjjarāṇāṃ hi kṣānto'smābhirvyatikramaḥ | kruddheṣvasmāsu yuṣmākaṃ na sthitirna ca jīvitam
verses.translation: Every being beginning with Brahma and ending with immobile beings is called Pa4u in relation to the lord of gods. Every being is subject to worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every being beginning with Brahma and ending with immobile beings is called Pa4u in relation to the lord of gods. Every being is subject to worldly existence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इत्युक्तास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे शर्वेणामिततेजसा । सद्यो विगतसन्देहा ननृतुर्विबुधा मुदा
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | ityuktāstridaśāḥ sarve śarveṇāmitatejasā | sadyo vigatasandehā nanṛturvibudhā mudā
verses.translation: At his behest Prakrti generates Buddhi befitting the Puru§a. Buddhi (cosmic intellect) 'generates Ahankara ( Ego). The ego generates the eleven sense-organs and five Tanmatras. At his bidding the Tanmatras too, create the great Bhutas entirely in their order; the great Bhutas create the physical bodies of all beings from Brahma to the grass. Intellect determines and resolves. Ego feels pride in and
verses.wordMeaning: At his behest Prakrti generates Buddhi befitting the Puru§a. Buddhi (cosmic intellect) 'generates Ahankara ( Ego). The ego generates the eleven sense-organs and five Tanmatras. At his bidding the Tanmatras too, create the great Bhutas entirely in their order;…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नमनसो भूत्वानन्दविह्वलमानसाः । स्तुतिमारेभिरे कर्तुं शङ्करस्य दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: prasannamanaso bhūtvānandavihvalamānasāḥ | stutimārebhire kartuṃ śaṅkarasya divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: The sense-organs grasp their objects and not others and this is due to the divine command of the lord. The organs of activity too do their own duties. Nothing else. It is due to Siva's order that sound, etc. are grasped, speech, etc. are made. Siva's weighty command is not to be transgressed by any.
verses.wordMeaning: The sense-organs grasp their objects and not others and this is due to the divine command of the lord. The organs of activity too do their own duties. Nothing else. It is due to Siva's order that sound, etc. are grasped, speech, etc. are made.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sense-organs grasp their objects and not others and this is due to the divine command of the lord. The organs of activity too do their own duties. Nothing else. It is due to Siva's order that sound, etc. are grasped, speech, etc. are made.…

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । त्वमेव देवाखिललोककर्ता पाता च हर्ता परमेश्वरोऽसि । कविष्णुरुद्राख्यस्वरूपभेदै रजस्तमः सत्त्वधृतात्ममूर्त्ते
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | tvameva devākhilalokakartā pātā ca hartā parameśvaro'si | kaviṣṇurudrākhyasvarūpabhedai rajastamaḥ sattvadhṛtātmamūrtte
verses.translation: In respect of Siva's inviolable command lord Indra protects the gods, kills the Asuras and guards the worlds. By Siva's command lord Varuna rules over the waters and binds those who are to be punished, by means of his noose. At the behest of Siva the lord of wealth, the lord of the Yaksas, distributes wealth to the living beings in accor¬ dance with their merit. At the bidding of Siva, Isana bestows knowledge on the intelligent ones and affords them riches, and curbs the evil-doers.
verses.wordMeaning: In respect of Siva's inviolable command lord Indra protects the gods, kills the Asuras and guards the worlds. By Siva's command lord Varuna rules over the waters and binds those who are to be punished, by means of his noose. At the behest of Siva the lord of wealth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In respect of Siva's inviolable command lord Indra protects the gods, kills the Asuras and guards the worlds. By Siva's command lord Varuna rules over the waters and binds those who are to be punished, by means of his noose. At the behest of Siva the lord of wealth,…
