verses.sanskrit: सर्वमूर्त्ते नमस्तेऽस्तु विश्वभावन पावन । अमूर्त्ते भक्तहेतोर्हि गृहीताकृतिसौख्यद
verses.transliteration: sarvamūrtte namaste'stu viśvabhāvana pāvana | amūrtte bhaktahetorhi gṛhītākṛtisaukhyada
verses.translation: It is at the direction of Siva that the earth is supported by Sesa. The Raudri and Tamasi form of Visnu that brings about destruction is created by the four-faced lord. At his behest, through other forms of his own, he protects the universe and annihilates it in the end. He protects, creates and devours the universe through his own three bodies. At his bidding alone Rudra annihilates the universe in the • end.
verses.wordMeaning: It is at the direction of Siva that the earth is supported by Sesa. The Raudri and Tamasi form of Visnu that brings about destruction is created by the four-faced lord. At his behest, through other forms of his own, he protects the universe and annihilates it in the end.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is at the direction of Siva that the earth is supported by Sesa. The Raudri and Tamasi form of Visnu that brings about destruction is created by the four-faced lord. At his behest, through other forms of his own, he protects the universe and annihilates it in the end.…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रोऽगदो हि देवेश कृपातस्तव शङ्कर । निमज्जनान्मृतः प्राप सुखं मिहिरजाजलिः
verses.transliteration: candro'gado hi deveśa kṛpātastava śaṅkara | nimajjanānmṛtaḥ prāpa sukhaṃ mihirajājaliḥ
verses.translation: The Atman of the universe thus assuming three different forms creates and protects too. Time creates, protects and de-itroys at his behest. At his bidding with the three parts of his splendour, the sun supports the universe, comm¬ ands the shower and rains in the heaven. At the behest of
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman of the universe thus assuming three different forms creates and protects too. Time creates, protects and de-itroys at his behest. At his bidding with the three parts of his splendour, the sun supports the universe, comm¬ ands the shower and rains in the heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atman of the universe thus assuming three different forms creates and protects too. Time creates, protects and de-itroys at his behest. At his bidding with the three parts of his splendour, the sun supports the universe, comm¬ ands the shower and rains in the heaven.…

verses.sanskrit: सीमन्तिनी हतधवा तव पूजनतः प्रभो । सौभाग्यमतुलं प्राप सोमवारव्रतात्सुतान्
verses.transliteration: sīmantinī hatadhavā tava pūjanataḥ prabho | saubhāgyamatulaṃ prāpa somavāravratātsutān
verses.translation: Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Asvins, Maruts, heaven- walkers, Sages, Siddhas, Serpents, human beings, beasts, ani¬ mals, birds, worms, immobile beings, rivers, oceans, moun¬ tains, forests, lakes, Vedas with their ancillaries, the scriptures, the compendiums of mantras, sacrifices, etc., the worlds begin¬ ning with Kalagni and ending with Siva and their over- lords, the innumerable Brahmandas, their coverings, the past, present and future, the quarters, interstices, the different units of time, Kala etc. — all these, whatever is seen or heard in the world, are presided over by the order of Jiva.
verses.wordMeaning: Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Asvins, Maruts, heaven- walkers, Sages, Siddhas, Serpents, human beings, beasts, ani¬ mals, birds, worms, immobile beings, rivers, oceans, moun¬ tains, forests, lakes, Vedas with their ancillaries, the scriptures, the compendiums of mantras, sacrifices,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Asvins, Maruts, heaven- walkers, Sages, Siddhas, Serpents, human beings, beasts, ani¬ mals, birds, worms, immobile beings, rivers, oceans, moun¬ tains, forests, lakes, Vedas with their ancillaries, the scriptures, the compendiums of mantras, sacrifices,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकराय ददौ देवः स्वीयं पदमनुत्तमम् । सुदर्शनमरक्षस्त्वं नृपमण्डलभीतितः
verses.transliteration: śrīkarāya dadau devaḥ svīyaṃ padamanuttamam | sudarśanamarakṣastvaṃ nṛpamaṇḍalabhītitaḥ
verses.translation: O Krsna, listen to the wonderful feat performed by the order of Siva of unmeasured activity and heard by me from the Upanisads.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Krsna, listen to the wonderful feat performed by the order of Siva of unmeasured activity and heard by me from the Upanisads.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मेदुरं तारयामास सदारं च घृणानिधिः । शारदां विधवां चक्रे सधवां क्रियया भवान्
verses.transliteration: meduraṃ tārayāmāsa sadāraṃ ca ghṛṇānidhiḥ | śāradāṃ vidhavāṃ cakre sadhavāṃ kriyayā bhavān
verses.translation: Alter conquering the Asuras in the war formerly, the gods including Indra began to argue with one another "I am the victor, I am the victor".
verses.commentary: Sense: Alter conquering the Asuras in the war formerly, the gods including Indra began to argue with one another "I am the victor, I am the victor".
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुषो विपत्तिं च विच्छिद्य त्वमदाः सुखम् । सौमिनी भवबन्धाद्वै मुक्ताभूत्तव सेवनात्
verses.transliteration: bhadrāyuṣo vipattiṃ ca vicchidya tvamadāḥ sukham | sauminī bhavabandhādvai muktābhūttava sevanāt
verses.translation: Then lord liva assumed the guise of a Yaksa and stood in their midst devoid of his characteristic features in the limbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord liva assumed the guise of a Yaksa and stood in their midst devoid of his characteristic features in the limbs.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । त्वं शम्भो कहरीशाश्च रजस्सत्त्वतमोगुणैः । कर्ता पाता तथा हर्ता जनानुग्रहकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuruvāca | tvaṃ śambho kaharīśāśca rajassattvatamoguṇaiḥ | kartā pātā tathā hartā janānugrahakāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: He set a blade of grass on the ground and told the gods, "He who can deform this grass is the conqueror of the Daityas."
verses.commentary: Sense: He set a blade of grass on the ground and told the gods, "He who can deform this grass is the conqueror of the Daityas."
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगर्वापहारी च सर्वतेजोविलासकः । सर्वविद्यादिगूढश्च सर्वानुग्रहकारकः
verses.transliteration: sarvagarvāpahārī ca sarvatejovilāsakaḥ | sarvavidyādigūḍhaśca sarvānugrahakārakaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the Yaksa, the thunder¬ bolt-bearing consort of Saci became infuriated. Smiling a little he attempted to take up the grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the Yaksa, the thunder¬ bolt-bearing consort of Saci became infuriated. Smiling a little he attempted to take up the grass.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तः सर्वं च त्वं सर्वं त्वयि सर्वं गिरीश्वर । त्राहि त्राहि पुनस्त्राहि कृपां कुरु ममोपरि
verses.transliteration: tvattaḥ sarvaṃ ca tvaṃ sarvaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ girīśvara | trāhi trāhi punastrāhi kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari
verses.translation: When he could not lift it up he hurled his thun¬ derbolt at it in order to cut it.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he could not lift it up he hurled his thun¬ derbolt at it in order to cut it.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः । एवं त्ववसरं प्राप्य व्यज्ञापयत शूलिने
verses.transliteration: athāsminnantare brahmā praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ | evaṃ tvavasaraṃ prāpya vyajñāpayata śūline
verses.translation: Then the guardians of the quarters and the worlds, of great strength exerted themselves and hurled thou¬ sands of their weapons at the grass-blade.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the guardians of the quarters and the worlds, of great strength exerted themselves and hurled thou¬ sands of their weapons at the grass-blade.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । जय देव महादेव प्रणतार्तिविभञ्जन । ईदृशेष्वपराधेषु कोऽन्यस्त्वत्तः प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | jaya deva mahādeva praṇatārtivibhañjana | īdṛśeṣvaparādheṣu ko'nyastvattaḥ prasīdati
verses.translation: The great fire blazed, the fieice wind blew and the
verses.commentary: Sense: The great fire blazed, the fieice wind blew and the
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्धात्मानो भविष्यन्ति ये पुरा निहता मृधे । प्रत्यापत्तिर्न कस्य स्यात्प्रसन्ने परमेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: labdhātmāno bhaviṣyanti ye purā nihatā mṛdhe | pratyāpattirna kasya syātprasanne parameśvare
verses.translation: Thus everything initiated by the gods strenuously against the grass was a flop. O Krna, it was due to the jx)wer of that Yaka alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything initiated by the gods strenuously against the grass was a flop. O Krna, it was due to the jx)wer of that Yaka alone.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदिदं देवदेवानां कृतमन्तुषु दूषणम् । तदिदं भूषणं मन्ये त अङ्गीकारगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: yadidaṃ devadevānāṃ kṛtamantuṣu dūṣaṇam | tadidaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ manye ta aṅgīkāragauravāt
verses.translation: Then the infuriated lord of go Is asked the Yak, "Who are you, sir?" Then even as they were watching, the Yakfa vanished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the infuriated lord of go Is asked the Yak, "Who are you, sir?" Then even as they were watching, the Yakfa vanished.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञाप्यमानस्तु ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । विलोक्य वदनं देव्या देवदेवः स्मयन्निव
verses.transliteration: iti vijñāpyamānastu brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | vilokya vadanaṃ devyā devadevaḥ smayanniva
verses.translation: In the meantime the goddess Haimavati bedecked in divine ornaments, appeared in the sky smiling and shining brilliantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the goddess Haimavati bedecked in divine ornaments, appeared in the sky smiling and shining brilliantly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रभूतस्य वात्सल्याद् ब्रह्मणः पद्मजन्मनः । देवादीनां यथापूर्वमङ्गानि प्रददौ प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: putrabhūtasya vātsalyād brahmaṇaḥ padmajanmanaḥ | devādīnāṃ yathāpūrvamaṅgāni pradadau prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her the wonderstruck gods, Indra and others bowed to her humbly and asked, "Who is this uncommon Yaka?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her the wonderstruck gods, Indra and others bowed to her humbly and asked, "Who is this uncommon Yaka?"
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथाद्यैश्च या देव्यो दण्डिता देवमातरः । तासामपि यथापूर्वाण्यङ्गानि गिरिशो ददौ
verses.transliteration: pramathādyaiśca yā devyo daṇḍitā devamātaraḥ | tāsāmapi yathāpūrvāṇyaṅgāni giriśo dadau
verses.translation: After saying this the great goddess vanished there itself. The surprised gods bowed to her and went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the great goddess vanished there itself. The surprised gods bowed to her and went to heaven.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य भगवानेव स्वयं ब्रह्मा पितामहः । तत्पापानुगुणं चक्रे जरच्छागमुखं मुखम्
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya bhagavāneva svayaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ | tatpāpānuguṇaṃ cakre jaracchāgamukhaṃ mukham
verses.translation: O Kr§na, listen; this universe of the, mobile and immobile beings is pervaded by the Murtyatmans of lord Siva, the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kr§na, listen; this universe of the, mobile and immobile beings is pervaded by the Murtyatmans of lord Siva, the great Atman.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि संज्ञां ततो लब्ध्वा स दृष्ट्वा जीवितः सुधीः । भीतः कृताञ्जलिः शम्भुं तुष्टाव प्रलपन्बहु
verses.transliteration: so'pi saṃjñāṃ tato labdhvā sa dṛṣṭvā jīvitaḥ sudhīḥ | bhītaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ śambhuṃ tuṣṭāva pralapanbahu
verses.translation: Siva presides over all these by means of his own Murtis. His Atman is incomprehensible. This is said by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva presides over all these by means of his own Murtis. His Atman is incomprehensible. This is said by the sages.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । जय देव जगन्नाथ लोकानुग्रहकारक । कृपां कुरु महेशानापराधं मे क्षमस्व ह
verses.transliteration: dakṣa uvāca | jaya deva jagannātha lokānugrahakāraka | kṛpāṃ kuru maheśānāparādhaṃ me kṣamasva ha
verses.translation: These shall be known as his Murtis whereby this universe is pervaded viz: — Brahma, Viu, Rudra, Maheana and Sadaiva.
verses.commentary: Sense: These shall be known as his Murtis whereby this universe is pervaded viz: — Brahma, Viu, Rudra, Maheana and Sadaiva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्त्ता भर्त्ता च हर्ता च त्वमेव जगतां प्रभुः । मया ज्ञातं विशेषेण विष्ण्वादिसकलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: karttā bharttā ca hartā ca tvameva jagatāṃ prabhuḥ | mayā jñātaṃ viśeṣeṇa viṣṇvādisakaleśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The famous Paftcabrahmans,** the bodies of the lord are Isana, Puru$a, Aghora, Vamadeva and Sadyojata.
verses.commentary: Sense: The famous Paftcabrahmans,** the bodies of the lord are Isana, Puru$a, Aghora, Vamadeva and Sadyojata.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव विततं सर्वं व्याप्तं सृष्टं च नाशितम् । न हि त्वदधिकाः केचिदीशास्तेऽच्युतकादयः
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva vitataṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ ca nāśitam | na hi tvadadhikāḥ kecidīśāste'cyutakādayaḥ
verses.translation: His greatest first Murti,!a, presides over the individual soul the enjoyer of Prak|:ti.
verses.commentary: Sense: His greatest first Murti,!a, presides over the individual soul the enjoyer of Prak|:ti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । तं तथा व्याकुलं भीतं प्रलपन्तं कृतागसम् । स्मयन्निवावदत्प्रेक्ष्य मा भैरिति घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | taṃ tathā vyākulaṃ bhītaṃ pralapantaṃ kṛtāgasam | smayannivāvadatprekṣya mā bhairiti ghṛṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: The Murti of Siva the lord having embodied forms, named Tatpurusa, presides over the unmanifest which is worthy of being enjoyed and which is in the form of the support of the Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murti of Siva the lord having embodied forms, named Tatpurusa, presides over the unmanifest which is worthy of being enjoyed and which is in the form of the support of the Gunas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथोक्त्वा ब्रह्मणस्तस्य पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया । गाणपत्यं ददौ तस्मै दक्षायाक्षयमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tathoktvā brahmaṇastasya pituḥ priyacikīrṣayā | gāṇapatyaṃ dadau tasmai dakṣāyākṣayamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The highly venerable Murti Aghora, of the trident- bearing lord, presides over the principle of cosmic intellect consisting of eight parts of Dharma etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly venerable Murti Aghora, of the trident- bearing lord, presides over the principle of cosmic intellect consisting of eight parts of Dharma etc.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवा अभिवन्द्य कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टुवुः प्रश्रया वाचा शङ्करं गिरिजाधिपम्
verses.transliteration: tato brahmādayo devā abhivandya kṛtāñjaliḥ | tuṣṭuvuḥ praśrayā vācā śaṅkaraṃ girijādhipam
verses.translation: Persons who know the Agamas call the Murti Vamadeva as the presiding deity of Ego.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons who know the Agamas call the Murti Vamadeva as the presiding deity of Ego.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादय ऊचुः । जय शङ्कर देवेश दीनानाथ महाप्रभो । कृपां कुरु महेशानापराधं नो क्षमस्व वै
verses.transliteration: brahmādaya ūcuḥ | jaya śaṅkara deveśa dīnānātha mahāprabho | kṛpāṃ kuru maheśānāparādhaṃ no kṣamasva vai
verses.translation: Scholars understand that the Murti Isana is the presiding deity of the ear speech, sound and the all-pervasive ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: Scholars understand that the Murti Isana is the presiding deity of the ear speech, sound and the all-pervasive ether.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मखपाल मखाधीश मखविध्वंसकारक । कृपां कुरु महेशानापराधं नः क्षमस्व वै
verses.transliteration: makhapāla makhādhīśa makhavidhvaṃsakāraka | kṛpāṃ kuru maheśānāparādhaṃ naḥ kṣamasva vai
verses.translation: Experts of the Puranas understand that the Murti Tatpuru9a is the presiding deity of the skin, hand, touch and Vayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Experts of the Puranas understand that the Murti Tatpuru9a is the presiding deity of the skin, hand, touch and Vayu.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव परेशान भक्तप्राणप्रपोषक । दुष्टदण्डप्रदः स्वामिन्कृपां कुरु नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: devadeva pareśāna bhaktaprāṇaprapoṣaka | duṣṭadaṇḍapradaḥ svāminkṛpāṃ kuru namo'stu te
verses.translation: The wise understand that the Murti Aghora is the presiding deity of the eye, leg, colour and fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise understand that the Murti Aghora is the presiding deity of the eye, leg, colour and fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं प्रभो गर्वहर्ता वै दुष्टानां त्वामजानताम् । रक्षको हि विशेषेण सतां त्वत्सक्तचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ prabho garvahartā vai duṣṭānāṃ tvāmajānatām | rakṣako hi viśeṣeṇa satāṃ tvatsaktacetasām
verses.translation: The devotees understand that the Murti Vama¬ deva is the presiding deity of the tongue, anus, taste and the waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotees understand that the Murti Vama¬ deva is the presiding deity of the tongue, anus, taste and the waters.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्भुतं चरितं ते हि निश्चितं कृपया तव । सर्वापराधः क्षन्तव्यो विभवो दीनवत्सलाः
verses.transliteration: adbhutaṃ caritaṃ te hi niścitaṃ kṛpayā tava | sarvāparādhaḥ kṣantavyo vibhavo dīnavatsalāḥ
verses.translation: The five Mfirtis of the lord, the sole causes of prosperity shall be assiduously saluted by men seeking l§reyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five Mfirtis of the lord, the sole causes of prosperity shall be assiduously saluted by men seeking l§reyas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इति स्तुतो महादेवो ब्रह्माद्यैरमरैः प्रभुः । स भक्तवत्सलः स्वामी तुतोष करुणोदधिः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | iti stuto mahādevo brahmādyairamaraiḥ prabhuḥ | sa bhaktavatsalaḥ svāmī tutoṣa karuṇodadhiḥ
verses.translation: These famous eight Murtis®** arc Sarva, Bhava, Rudra, Ugra, Bhima, Pasupati, Isana, and Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: These famous eight Murtis®** arc Sarva, Bhava, Rudra, Ugra, Bhima, Pasupati, Isana, and Mahadeva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चकारानुग्रहं तेषां ब्रह्मादीनां दिवौकसाम् । ददौ वरांश्च सुप्रीत्या शङ्करो दीनवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: cakārānugrahaṃ teṣāṃ brahmādīnāṃ divaukasām | dadau varāṃśca suprītyā śaṅkaro dīnavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: The earth, waters, fire, wind, ether, Ijsetrajfia, the sun and the moon arc presided* over by the eight Murtis, Sarva, etc, of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth, waters, fire, wind, ether, Ijsetrajfia, the sun and the moon arc presided* over by the eight Murtis, Sarva, etc, of the lord.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स च ततस्त्रिदशान् शरणागतान् परमकारुणिकः परमेश्वरः । अनुगतस्मितलक्षणया गिरा शमितसर्वभयः समभाषत
verses.transliteration: sa ca tatastridaśān śaraṇāgatān paramakāruṇikaḥ parameśvaraḥ | anugatasmitalakṣaṇayā girā śamitasarvabhayaḥ samabhāṣata
verses.translation: The Murti of Bhava the great* Atman, in the form of water enlivens the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murti of Bhava the great* Atman, in the form of water enlivens the universe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । यदिदमाग इहाचरितं सुरै- र्विधिनियोगवशादिव यन्त्रितैः । शरणमेव गतानवलोक्य व- स्तदखिलं किल विस्मृतमेव नः
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | yadidamāga ihācaritaṃ surai- rvidhiniyogavaśādiva yantritaiḥ | śaraṇameva gatānavalokya va- stadakhilaṃ kila vismṛtameva naḥ
verses.translation: The Murti of Ritdra having terrilSle form, is stationed all over the universd* intecnally and externally and it consists of fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murti of Ritdra having terrilSle form, is stationed all over the universd* intecnally and externally and it consists of fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदिह यूयमपि प्रकृतं मन- स्यविगणय्य विमर्दमपत्रपाः । हरिविरिञ्चिसुरेन्द्रमुखाः सुखं व्रजत देवपुरं प्रति सम्प्रति
verses.transliteration: tadiha yūyamapi prakṛtaṃ mana- syavigaṇayya vimardamapatrapāḥ | hariviriñcisurendramukhāḥ sukhaṃ vrajata devapuraṃ prati samprati
verses.translation: The Murti of Ugra. in the form of the wind throbs itself and sustains everything and makes everything throb.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murti of Ugra. in the form of the wind throbs itself and sustains everything and makes everything throb.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.transliteration: iti surānabhidhāya sureśvaro nikṛtadakṣakṛtakraturakratuḥ | sa girijānucaraḥ saparicchadaḥ sthita ivāmbaratontaradhāddharaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: The Murti of MaheSa named Isana, otherwise called the sun, illuminates the universe and moves about in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सुरा अपि ते विगतव्यथाः कथितभद्रसुभद्रपराक्रमाः । सपदि खेन सुखेन यथासुखं ययुरनेकमुखाः मघवन्मुखाः

verses.translation: The eighth Murti of the supreme lord Siva is the Atman. It pervades all the Murtis. Hence the universe has Siva as its Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eighth Murti of the supreme lord Siva is the Atman. It pervades all the Murtis. Hence the universe has Siva as its Atman.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । महीधरवरः श्रीमान् मन्दरश्चित्रकन्दरः । दयितो देवदेवस्य निवासस्तपसोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | mahīdharavaraḥ śrīmān mandaraścitrakandaraḥ | dayito devadevasya nivāsastapaso'bhavat
verses.translation: The Bindu comes out of the Nada; from Bindu comes out Sada4iva. From him is born Mahevara and Suddhavidya originates from Mahcvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Bindu comes out of the Nada; from Bindu comes out Sada4iva. From him is born Mahevara and Suddhavidya originates from Mahcvara.

verses.sanskrit: तपो महत्कृतं तेन वोढुं स्वशिरसा शिवौ । चिरेण लब्धं तत्पादपङ्कजस्पर्शजं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: tapo mahatkṛtaṃ tena voḍhuṃ svaśirasā śivau | cireṇa labdhaṃ tatpādapaṅkajasparśajaṃ sukham
verses.translation: All objects of taste are identical with the goddess and Siva is the taster. All lovable objects are identical with Siva and Siva is the lover.
verses.commentary: Sense: All objects of taste are identical with the goddess and Siva is the taster. All lovable objects are identical with Siva and Siva is the lover.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शैलस्य सौन्दर्यं सहस्रवदनैरपि । न शक्यं विस्तराद्वक्तुं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: tasya śailasya saundaryaṃ sahasravadanairapi | na śakyaṃ vistarādvaktuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: The superhuman excellence of the lord which is non-Prakrtika is that from which words recede along with the mind and the sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The superhuman excellence of the lord which is non-Prakrtika is that from which words recede along with the mind and the sense-organs.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्यमप्यस्य सौन्दर्यं न वर्णयितुमुत्सहे । पर्वतान्तरसौन्दर्यं साधारणविधारणात्
verses.transliteration: śakyamapyasya saundaryaṃ na varṇayitumutsahe | parvatāntarasaundaryaṃ sādhāraṇavidhāraṇāt
verses.translation: O scion of the family of Yadu, not knowing his great, nature, never subject to alteration or doubts, some sages call him many though he is one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O scion of the family of Yadu, not knowing his great, nature, never subject to alteration or doubts, some sages call him many though he is one.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु शक्यते वक्तुमस्मिन्पर्वतसुन्दरे । ऋद्ध्या कयापि सौन्दर्यमीश्वरावासयोग्यता
verses.transliteration: idaṃ tu śakyate vaktumasminparvatasundare | ṛddhyā kayāpi saundaryamīśvarāvāsayogyatā
verses.translation: Thus his innate nature, the true form, is being doubted. The sages are unable to determine the true nature of the lord due to the presence of different ideas and beliefs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus his innate nature, the true form, is being doubted. The sages are unable to determine the true nature of the lord due to the presence of different ideas and beliefs.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अत एव हि देवेन देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया । अतीव रमणीयोऽयं गिरिरन्तःपुरीकृतः
verses.transliteration: ata eva hi devena devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā | atīva ramaṇīyo'yaṃ girirantaḥpurīkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On the other hand, only those who have resorted to the lord in all piety know Siva, the great cause, without any strain.**'
verses.commentary: Sense: On the other hand, only those who have resorted to the lord in all piety know Siva, the great cause, without any strain.**'
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मेखलाभूमयस्तस्य विमलोपलपादपाः । शिवयोर्नित्यसान्निध्यान्न्यक्कुर्वन्त्यखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: mekhalābhūmayastasya vimalopalapādapāḥ | śivayornityasānnidhyānnyakkurvantyakhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: As long as the individual does not achieve the realization of the primordial lord who has no lord above him and who is the ruler of the worlds, he remains in misery
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as the individual does not achieve the realization of the primordial lord who has no lord above him and who is the ruler of the worlds, he remains in misery
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पितृभ्यां जगतो नित्यं स्नानपानोपयोगतः । अवाप्तपुण्यसंस्कारः प्रसरद्भिरितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhyāṃ jagato nityaṃ snānapānopayogataḥ | avāptapuṇyasaṃskāraḥ prasaradbhiritastataḥ
verses.translation: Siva has no bondage due to the atoms, effects, Maya, Prakrti, cosmic intellect, ego, mind, sens-eorgans, Tanmatras or the elements,

verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लघुशीतलसंस्पर्शैरच्छाच्छैर्निर्झराम्बुभिः । अधिराज्येन चाद्रीणामद्रीरेषोऽभिषिच्यते

verses.translation: The wheel of Git that undergoei worldly existence along with the wheel of Acit is Auddha and Apara. The other one is Suddha and Para.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wheel of Git that undergoei worldly existence along with the wheel of Acit is Auddha and Apara. The other one is Suddha and Para.

verses.sanskrit: निशासु शिखरप्रान्तर्वर्तिना स शिलोच्चयः । चन्द्रेणाचलसाम्राज्यच्छत्रेणेव विराजते

verses.translation: Both the Git and Acit whether Para or Apara and the lordship of Siva and Siva are natural.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both the Git and Acit whether Para or Apara and the lordship of Siva and Siva are natural.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स शैलश्चञ्चलीभूतैर्बालैश्चामरयोषिताम् । सर्वपर्वतसाम्राज्यचामरैरिव वीज्यते
verses.transliteration: sa śailaścañcalībhūtairbālaiścāmarayoṣitām | sarvaparvatasāmrājyacāmarairiva vījyate
verses.translation: Just as Siva so also the goddess. Just as the goddess so also Siva. No difference shall be thought of between the two as between the moon and the moonlight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as Siva so also the goddess. Just as the goddess so also Siva. No difference shall be thought of between the two as between the moon and the moonlight.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरभ्युदिते भानौ भूधरो रत्नभूषितः । दर्पणे देहसौभाग्यं द्रष्टुकाम इव स्थितः

verses.translation: Just as the moon does not shine without the moonlight so also though existing Siva does not shine without

verses.sanskrit: कूजद्विहङ्गवाचालैर्वातोद्धृतलताभुजैः । विमुक्तपुष्पैः सततं व्यालम्बिमृदुपल्लवैः
verses.transliteration: kūjadvihaṅgavācālairvātoddhṛtalatābhujaiḥ | vimuktapuṣpaiḥ satataṃ vyālambimṛdupallavaiḥ
verses.translation: Just as the sun does not exist without its light nor does the light thereof exist without the sun, so also there is.mutual dependence between Sakti and Saktiman. There is no Sakti without Siva and no Siva without Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the sun does not exist without its light nor does the light thereof exist without the sun, so also there is.mutual dependence between Sakti and Saktiman. There is no Sakti without Siva and no Siva without Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: लताप्रतानजटिलैस्तरुभिस्तापसैरिव । जयाशिषा सहाभ्यर्च्य निषेव्यत इवाद्रिराट्
verses.transliteration: latāpratānajaṭilaistarubhistāpasairiva | jayāśiṣā sahābhyarcya niṣevyata ivādrirāṭ
verses.translation: The Sakti is the primordial and solitary one, of the form of Git and depending on Siva, by means of which Siva can bestow worldly pleasures and salvation and which IS of the same characteristics as Siva, the great Atman through the diverse befitting attribute?, of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sakti is the primordial and solitary one, of the form of Git and depending on Siva, by means of which Siva can bestow worldly pleasures and salvation and which IS of the same characteristics as Siva, the great Atman through the diverse befitting attribute?, of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: अधोमुखैरूर्ध्वमुखैः शृङ्गैस्तिर्यङ्मुखैस्तथा । प्रपतन्निव पाताले भूपृष्ठादुत्पतन्निव
verses.transliteration: adhomukhairūrdhvamukhaiḥ śṛṅgaistiryaṅmukhaistathā | prapatanniva pātāle bhūpṛṣṭhādutpatanniva
verses.translation: The solitary and great Sakti of the form of Git, is of parturient trait. It creates the universe with its manifold ramifications at the will of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The solitary and great Sakti of the form of Git, is of parturient trait. It creates the universe with its manifold ramifications at the will of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परीतः सर्वतो दिक्षु भ्रमन्निव विहायसि । पश्यन्निव जगत्सर्वं नृत्यन्निव निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: parītaḥ sarvato dikṣu bhramanniva vihāyasi | paśyanniva jagatsarvaṃ nṛtyanniva nirantaram
verses.translation: As one unit, as twofold, in hundreds and thou¬ sands Saktis ramify theniselves in their function.
verses.commentary: Sense: As one unit, as twofold, in hundreds and thou¬ sands Saktis ramify theniselves in their function.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गुहामुखैः प्रतिदिनं व्यात्तास्यो विपुलोदरैः । अजीर्णलावण्यतया जृम्भमाण इवाचलः
verses.transliteration: guhāmukhaiḥ pratidinaṃ vyāttāsyo vipulodaraiḥ | ajīrṇalāvaṇyatayā jṛmbhamāṇa ivācalaḥ
verses.translation: At the will of Siva, the great Sakti united with Sivatattva manifests from it at the first creation, like the oil from the gingelly seed.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the will of Siva, the great Sakti united with Sivatattva manifests from it at the first creation, like the oil from the gingelly seed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रसन्निव जगत्सर्वं पिबन्निव पयोनिधिम् । वमन्निव तमोऽन्तस्थं माद्यन्निव खमम्बुदैः
verses.transliteration: grasanniva jagatsarvaṃ pibanniva payonidhim | vamanniva tamo'ntasthaṃ mādyanniva khamambudaiḥ
verses.translation: Then the Sakti being agitated by the Kriya
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Sakti being agitated by the Kriya
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निवासभूमयस्तास्ता दर्पणप्रतिमोदराः । तिरस्कृतातपाः स्निग्धाश्रमच्छायामहीरुहाः
verses.transliteration: nivāsabhūmayastāstā darpaṇapratimodarāḥ | tiraskṛtātapāḥ snigdhāśramacchāyāmahīruhāḥ
verses.translation: Then by the infusion of the infinite, Maya creates Kkla, Niyati, Kala and Vidya and through Kala, Riga and Puni$a.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then by the infusion of the infinite, Maya creates Kkla, Niyati, Kala and Vidya and through Kala, Riga and Puni$a.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सरित्सरस्तडागादिसम्पर्कशिशिरानिलाः । तत्र तत्र निषण्णाभ्यां शिवाभ्यां सफलीकृताः
verses.transliteration: saritsarastaḍāgādisamparkaśiśirānilāḥ | tatra tatra niṣaṇṇābhyāṃ śivābhyāṃ saphalīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: From Miya again originates the manifest con¬ sisting of the three Guas. From this Avyakta the three Gupas become separated.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Miya again originates the manifest con¬ sisting of the three Guas. From this Avyakta the three Gupas become separated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमिमं सर्वतः श्रेष्ठं स्मृत्वा साम्बस्त्रियम्बकः । रैभ्याश्रमसमीपस्थश्चान्तर्धानं गतो ययौ
verses.transliteration: tamimaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ smṛtvā sāmbastriyambakaḥ | raibhyāśramasamīpasthaścāntardhānaṃ gato yayau
verses.translation: The three Guas are Sattva, Rajas and Tamas whereby the entire universe is pervaded. From the Guias, on being agitated and stirred up, the three deities are born as well as Mahat and other Tattvas in due order. At the behest of Siva innumerable seeds are bom. They are presided over by the infinite and other Vidyeas, the Emperors.
verses.wordMeaning: The three Guas are Sattva, Rajas and Tamas whereby the entire universe is pervaded. From the Guias, on being agitated and stirred up, the three deities are born as well as Mahat and other Tattvas in due order. At the behest of Siva innumerable seeds are bom.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three Guas are Sattva, Rajas and Tamas whereby the entire universe is pervaded. From the Guias, on being agitated and stirred up, the three deities are born as well as Mahat and other Tattvas in due order. At the behest of Siva innumerable seeds are bom.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोद्यानमनुप्राप्य देव्या सह महेश्वरः । रराम रमणीयासु देव्यान्तःपुरभूमिषु
verses.transliteration: tatrodyānamanuprāpya devyā saha maheśvaraḥ | rarāma ramaṇīyāsu devyāntaḥpurabhūmiṣu
verses.translation: In accordance with the difference in bodies, Saktis are said to be different. They shall be known as having diverse forms both gross and subtle.
verses.commentary: Sense: In accordance with the difference in bodies, Saktis are said to be different. They shall be known as having diverse forms both gross and subtle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा गतेषु कालेषु प्रवृद्धासु प्रजासु च । दैत्यौ शुम्भनिशुम्भाख्यौ भ्रातरौ सम्बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: tathā gateṣu kāleṣu pravṛddhāsu prajāsu ca | daityau śumbhaniśumbhākhyau bhrātarau sambabhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: The entire universe of the mobile and immobile beings is full of §akti. Kala, the greatest!§akti of the great Atman, is called Para Sakti, and it follows the wish of the lord and creates the mobile and immobile universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe of the mobile and immobile beings is full of §akti. Kala, the greatest!§akti of the great Atman, is called Para Sakti, and it follows the wish of the lord and creates the mobile and immobile universe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां तपोबलाद्दत्तं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । अवध्यत्वं जगत्यस्मिन्पुरुषैरखिलैरपि
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ tapobalāddattaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | avadhyatvaṃ jagatyasminpuruṣairakhilairapi
verses.translation: "This shall be this way." "This shall not be
verses.commentary: Sense: "This shall be this way." "This shall not be
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयोनिजा तु या कन्या ह्यम्बिकांशसमुद्भवा । अजातपुंस्पर्शरतिरविलङ्घ्यपराक्रमा
verses.transliteration: ayonijā tu yā kanyā hyambikāṃśasamudbhavā | ajātapuṃsparśaratiravilaṅghyaparākramā
verses.translation: §akti of activity in the form of conception formu¬ lates and evolves the effect — universe, in the manner wished for and in the manner determined.
verses.commentary: Sense: §akti of activity in the form of conception formu¬ lates and evolves the effect — universe, in the manner wished for and in the manner determined.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तया तु नौ वधः सङ्ख्ये तस्यां कामाभिभूतयोः । इति चाभ्यर्थितो ब्रह्मा ताभ्यां प्राह तथास्त्विति
verses.transliteration: tayā tu nau vadhaḥ saṅkhye tasyāṃ kāmābhibhūtayoḥ | iti cābhyarthito brahmā tābhyāṃ prāha tathāstviti
verses.translation: When the threefold Saktis are risen, the l§akti of parturient traits urged by the Parama Sakti gives birth to the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the threefold Saktis are risen, the l§akti of parturient traits urged by the Parama Sakti gives birth to the universe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति शक्रादीन्विजित्य समरे सुरान् । निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारं जगच्चक्रतुरक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti śakrādīnvijitya samare surān | niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ jagaccakraturakramāt
verses.translation: All men are identical with Siva. All women are identical with Mahesvari. Hence all men and women are their exalted superhuman power.
verses.commentary: Sense: All men are identical with Siva. All women are identical with Mahesvari. Hence all men and women are their exalted superhuman power.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्वधाय देवेशं ब्रह्माभ्यर्थितवान्पुनः । विनिन्द्यापि रहस्यम्बां क्रोधयित्वा यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: tayorvadhāya deveśaṃ brahmābhyarthitavānpunaḥ | vinindyāpi rahasyambāṃ krodhayitvā yathā tathā
verses.translation: Siva's beloved holds all objects to be perceived
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva's beloved holds all objects to be perceived
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वर्णकोशजां शक्तिमकामां कन्यकात्मिकाम् । निशुम्भशुम्भयोर्हन्त्रीं सुरेभ्यो दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tadvarṇakośajāṃ śaktimakāmāṃ kanyakātmikām | niśumbhaśumbhayorhantrīṃ surebhyo dātumarhasi
verses.translation: Goddess Mahesvari holds all objects of reflection. The re flee ter is the all- pervading Lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddess Mahesvari holds all objects of reflection. The re flee ter is the all- pervading Lord himself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्थितो धात्रा भगवान्नीललोहितः । कालीत्याह रहस्यं वां निन्दयन्निव सस्मितः
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarthito dhātrā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ | kālītyāha rahasyaṃ vāṃ nindayanniva sasmitaḥ
verses.translation: Lord's beloved holds all objects to be understood. The undettander is the lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord's beloved holds all objects to be understood. The undettander is the lord himself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धा तदा देवी सुवर्णा वर्णकारणात् । स्मयन्ती चाह भर्तारमसमाधेयया गिरा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddhā tadā devī suvarṇā varṇakāraṇāt | smayantī cāha bhartāramasamādheyayā girā
verses.translation: The lord holds all masculine beings. The goddess holds all feminine beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord holds all masculine beings. The goddess holds all feminine beings.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । ईदृशे मम वर्णेऽस्मिन्न रतिर्भवतोऽस्ति चेत् । एवावन्तं चिरं कालं कथमेषा नियम्यते
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | īdṛśe mama varṇe'sminna ratirbhavato'sti cet | evāvantaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ kathameṣā niyamyate
verses.translation: The beloved of Siva holds all words. The moon- crested lord holds all their meanings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The beloved of Siva holds all words. The moon- crested lord holds all their meanings.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अरत्या वर्तमानोऽपि कथं च रमसे मया । न ह्यशक्यं जगत्यस्मिन्नीश्वरस्य जगत्प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: aratyā vartamāno'pi kathaṃ ca ramase mayā | na hyaśakyaṃ jagatyasminnīśvarasya jagatprabhoḥ
verses.translation: As the flame of the brilliant lamp illuminates the house so also their brilliance pervades the universe and illuminates it.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the flame of the brilliant lamp illuminates the house so also their brilliance pervades the universe and illuminates it.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मारामस्य भवतो रतिर्न सुखसाधनम् । इति हेतोः स्मरो यस्मात्प्रसभं भस्मसात्कृतः
verses.transliteration: svātmārāmasya bhavato ratirna sukhasādhanam | iti hetoḥ smaro yasmātprasabhaṃ bhasmasātkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The great Sruti says that the excellence of the universe from the blade of grass to Siva's Murti is due to their contact.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Sruti says that the excellence of the universe from the blade of grass to Siva's Murti is due to their contact.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: या च नाभिरता भर्तुरपि सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी । सा वृथैव हि जायेत सर्वैरपि गुणान्तरैः
verses.transliteration: yā ca nābhiratā bharturapi sarvāṅgasundarī | sā vṛthaiva hi jāyeta sarvairapi guṇāntaraiḥ
verses.translation: The two who are in the form of all and confer welfare on all shall be worshipped, bowed to and meditated upon always.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two who are in the form of all and confer welfare on all shall be worshipped, bowed to and meditated upon always.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भर्तुर्भोगैकशेषो हि सर्ग एवैष योषिताम् । तथासत्यन्यथा भूता नारी कुत्रोपयुज्यते
verses.transliteration: bharturbhogaikaśeṣo hi sarga evaiṣa yoṣitām | tathāsatyanyathā bhūtā nārī kutropayujyate
verses.translation: O Kr?na, the innate nature of the lord and the goddess has been explained to you by me in accordance with my ability but I have not exhausted it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kr?na, the innate nature of the lord and the goddess has been explained to you by me in accordance with my ability but I have not exhausted it.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वर्णमिमं त्यक्त्वा त्वया रहसि निन्दितम् । वर्णान्तरं भजिष्ये वा न भजिष्यामि वा स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādvarṇamimaṃ tyaktvā tvayā rahasi ninditam | varṇāntaraṃ bhajiṣye vā na bhajiṣyāmi vā svayam
verses.translation: The innate nature of the lord and the goddess is beyond the minds of even great men. How can it be ex¬ plained?
verses.commentary: Sense: The innate nature of the lord and the goddess is beyond the minds of even great men. How can it be ex¬ plained?
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय शयनाद्देवी साचष्ट गद्गदम् । ययाचेऽनुमतिं भर्तुस्तपसे कृतनिश्चया
verses.transliteration: ityuktvotthāya śayanāddevī sācaṣṭa gadgadam | yayāce'numatiṃ bhartustapase kṛtaniścayā
verses.translation: The excellence and superhuman power that has been explained now is based on Prakfti and is great as well. Those who know esoteric secrets understand the secret of non-Prakftika excellence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellence and superhuman power that has been explained now is based on Prakfti and is great as well. Those who know esoteric secrets understand the secret of non-Prakftika excellence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा प्रणयभङ्गेन भीतो भूतपतिः स्वयम् । पादयोः प्रणमन्नेव भवानीं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tathā praṇayabhaṅgena bhīto bhūtapatiḥ svayam | pādayoḥ praṇamanneva bhavānīṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: A person who has understood the superhuman excellence of 8iva and Siva which is the divine medicine to resuscitate the dead on being bitten by the serpent of worldly existence, is not afraid of anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has understood the superhuman excellence of 8iva and Siva which is the divine medicine to resuscitate the dead on being bitten by the serpent of worldly existence, is not afraid of anything.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । अजानती च क्रीडोक्तिं प्रिये किं कुपितासि मे । रतिः कुतो वा जायेत त्वत्तश्चेदरतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | ajānatī ca krīḍoktiṃ priye kiṃ kupitāsi me | ratiḥ kuto vā jāyeta tvattaścedaratirmama
verses.translation: The individual soul who understands factually the Para and the Apara excellences goes beyond the Apara Bhuti and enjoys the Para Bhuti ( the greatest excellence).
verses.commentary: Sense: The individual soul who understands factually the Para and the Apara excellences goes beyond the Apara Bhuti and enjoys the Para Bhuti ( the greatest excellence).
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: माता त्वमस्य जगतः पिताहमधिपस्तथा । कथं तदुपपद्येत त्वत्तो नाभिरतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: mātā tvamasya jagataḥ pitāhamadhipastathā | kathaṃ tadupapadyeta tvatto nābhiratirmama
verses.translation: O Krsna, thus I have explained to you the innate nature of the great souls, Siva and Siva, though it is a secret because you are a qualified devotee of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Krsna, thus I have explained to you the innate nature of the great souls, Siva and Siva, though it is a secret because you are a qualified devotee of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आवयोरभिकामोऽपि किमसौ कामकारितः । यतः कामसमुत्तेः प्रागेव जगदुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: āvayorabhikāmo'pi kimasau kāmakāritaḥ | yataḥ kāmasamutteḥ prāgeva jagadudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: O Krsna of great welfare, so you do not tell others about this. Mention it to people, like you, who arc deserving.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Krsna of great welfare, so you do not tell others about this. Mention it to people, like you, who arc deserving.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्जनानां रतये कामात्मा कल्पितो मया । ततः कथमुपालब्धः कामदाहादहं त्वया
verses.transliteration: pṛthagjanānāṃ rataye kāmātmā kalpito mayā | tataḥ kathamupālabdhaḥ kāmadāhādahaṃ tvayā
verses.translation: He who imparts this Vibhuti of Siva and Siva to qualified and competent men is liberated from the ocean of worldly existence and attains Sayujya®*' bf Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who imparts this Vibhuti of Siva and Siva to qualified and competent men is liberated from the ocean of worldly existence and attains Sayujya®*' bf Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मां वै त्रिदशसामान्यं मन्यमानो मनोभवः । मनाक्परिभवं कुर्वन्मया वै भस्मसात्कृतः
verses.transliteration: māṃ vai tridaśasāmānyaṃ manyamāno manobhavaḥ | manākparibhavaṃ kurvanmayā vai bhasmasātkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: By reciting this, crores of sins perish. Repeated thrice or four times it quells even more.
verses.commentary: Sense: By reciting this, crores of sins perish. Repeated thrice or four times it quells even more.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विहारोऽप्यावयोरस्य जगतस्त्राणकारणात् । ततस्तदर्थं त्वय्यद्य क्रीडोक्तिं कृतवानहम्
verses.transliteration: vihāro'pyāvayorasya jagatastrāṇakāraṇāt | tatastadarthaṃ tvayyadya krīḍoktiṃ kṛtavānaham
verses.translation: All displeasing enemies perish. Friends increase. Learning flourishes. Auspicious intellect functions in Truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: All displeasing enemies perish. Friends increase. Learning flourishes. Auspicious intellect functions in Truth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स चायमचिरादर्थस्तवैवाविष्करिष्यते । क्रोधस्य जनकं वाक्यं हृदि कृत्वेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sa cāyamacirādarthastavaivāviṣkariṣyate | krodhasya janakaṃ vākyaṃ hṛdi kṛtvedamabravīt
verses.translation: He acquires devotion to Siva, Siva, their followers and 'attendants. He acquires whatever is pleasing and all other things undoubtedly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He acquires devotion to Siva, Siva, their followers and 'attendants. He acquires whatever is pleasing and all other things undoubtedly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । श्रुतपूर्वं हि भगवंस्तव चाटुवचो मया । येनैवमतिधीराहमपि प्रागभिवञ्चिता
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | śrutapūrvaṃ hi bhagavaṃstava cāṭuvaco mayā | yenaivamatidhīrāhamapi prāgabhivañcitā
verses.translation: One should recite this with purity of mind, devotion to Siva and full conviction. If due to powerful previous Kar- mans the fruition is prevented, he shall repeat it again. There is nothing inaccessible to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should recite this with purity of mind, devotion to Siva and full conviction. If due to powerful previous Kar- mans the fruition is prevented, he shall repeat it again. There is nothing inaccessible to him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणानप्यप्रिया भर्तुर्नारी या न परित्यजेत् । कुलाङ्गना शुभा सद्भिः कुत्सितैव हि गम्यते
verses.transliteration: prāṇānapyapriyā bharturnārī yā na parityajet | kulāṅganā śubhā sadbhiḥ kutsitaiva hi gamyate
verses.translation: This universe of the mobile and immobile beings is the cosmic body of the lord of the gods. The Pasus do not know it at all due to the intricacy of the Pasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: This universe of the mobile and immobile beings is the cosmic body of the lord of the gods. The Pasus do not know it at all due to the intricacy of the Pasa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूयसी च तवाप्रीतिरगौरमिति मे वपुः । क्रीडोक्तिरपि कालीति घटते कथमन्यथा
verses.transliteration: bhūyasī ca tavāprītiragauramiti me vapuḥ | krīḍoktirapi kālīti ghaṭate kathamanyathā
verses.translation: About the great lord, without beginning or death, some say he is Aparabrahmarupa, some say he is Parabrah- marupa.
verses.commentary: Sense: About the great lord, without beginning or death, some say he is Aparabrahmarupa, some say he is Parabrah- marupa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्भिर्विगर्हितं तस्मात्तव कार्ष्ण्यमसम्मतम् । अनुत्सृज्य तपोयोगात्स्थातुमेवेह नोत्सहे
verses.transliteration: sadbhirvigarhitaṃ tasmāttava kārṣṇyamasammatam | anutsṛjya tapoyogātsthātumeveha notsahe
verses.translation: Delusion usually means Ayathabuddhi (not knowing as it is) in regard to the objects. Vidya is opposite to it where the knowledge is in the true form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delusion usually means Ayathabuddhi (not knowing as it is) in regard to the objects. Vidya is opposite to it where the knowledge is in the true form.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । यद्येवंविधतापस्ते तपसा किं प्रयोजनम् । ममेच्छया स्वेच्छया वा वर्णान्तरवती भव
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | yadyevaṃvidhatāpaste tapasā kiṃ prayojanam | mamecchayā svecchayā vā varṇāntaravatī bhava
verses.translation: The living beings are called Ksara. The Kutasthais called Aksara. Both these are the forms of the lord because they are under his control.
verses.commentary: Sense: The living beings are called Ksara. The Kutasthais called Aksara. Both these are the forms of the lord because they are under his control.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । नेच्छामि भवतो वर्णं स्वयं वा कर्तुमन्यथा । ब्रह्माणं तपसाराध्य क्षिप्रं गौरी भवाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | necchāmi bhavato varṇaṃ svayaṃ vā kartumanyathā | brahmāṇaṃ tapasārādhya kṣipraṃ gaurī bhavāmyaham
verses.translation: Beyond the two is Siva the quiescent. Hence he is Ksaraksarapara. Some say that Siva is the great cause, that he is in the form of the universal as well as the individual and the cause of both. The Samasti is unmani¬ fest, they say and the Vyasti is manifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beyond the two is Siva the quiescent. Hence he is Ksaraksarapara. Some say that Siva is the great cause, that he is in the form of the universal as well as the individual and the cause of both. The Samasti is unmani¬ fest, they say and the Vyasti is manifest.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । मत्प्रसादात्पुरा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वं प्राप्तवान्पुरा । तमाहूय महादेवि तपसा किं करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | matprasādātpurā brahmā brahmatvaṃ prāptavānpurā | tamāhūya mahādevi tapasā kiṃ kariṣyasi
verses.translation: They arc the forms of the lord because they function at his will. Since he is their cause, those who know the meaning of the 'cause' say that Siva the great cause is the cause of both the universal and the individual.
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc the forms of the lord because they function at his will. Since he is their cause, those who know the meaning of the 'cause' say that Siva the great cause is the cause of both the universal and the individual.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । त्वत्तो लब्धपदा एव सर्वे ब्रह्मादयः सुराः । तथाप्याराध्य तपसा ब्रह्माणं त्वन्नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | tvatto labdhapadā eva sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ | tathāpyārādhya tapasā brahmāṇaṃ tvanniyogataḥ
verses.translation: The lord is explained by some as the one who inheres in the form of Jati and Vyakti. That which inheres whole bodies is called Jati. Vyakti is in the form of the separate unit and is the support of Jati. Both are protected by his Ajfia. So the lord is called Jativyaktivapus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord is explained by some as the one who inheres in the form of Jati and Vyakti. That which inheres whole bodies is called Jati. Vyakti is in the form of the separate unit and is the support of Jati. Both are protected by his Ajfia. So the lord is called Jativyaktivapus.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा किल सती नाम्ना दक्षस्य दुहिताऽभवम् । जगतां पतिमेव त्वां पतिं प्राप्तवती तथा
verses.transliteration: purā kila satī nāmnā dakṣasya duhitā'bhavam | jagatāṃ patimeva tvāṃ patiṃ prāptavatī tathā
verses.translation: By some Siva is called Pradljana-Purusa-Vyakta- Kalatman. Pradhana is Prakrti. Purusa is the individual soul. The twenty three principles constitute the Vyakta (manifest) Prakrti. Kala is the sole cause of the transformation of the effected creation. Siva is the lord, creator, activisor, router, and the cause of evolution and dissolution of all these, He is one, the emperor, the unborn.
verses.wordMeaning: By some Siva is called Pradljana-Purusa-Vyakta- Kalatman. Pradhana is Prakrti. Purusa is the individual soul. The twenty three principles constitute the Vyakta (manifest) Prakrti. Kala is the sole cause of the transformation of the effected creation. Siva is the lord, creator,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By some Siva is called Pradljana-Purusa-Vyakta- Kalatman. Pradhana is Prakrti. Purusa is the individual soul. The twenty three principles constitute the Vyakta (manifest) Prakrti. Kala is the sole cause of the transformation of the effected creation. Siva is the lord, creator,…
