verses.sanskrit: एवमद्यापि तपसा तोषयित्वा द्विजं विधिम् । गौरी भवितुमिच्छामि को दोषः कथ्यतामिह
verses.transliteration: evamadyāpi tapasā toṣayitvā dvijaṃ vidhim | gaurī bhavitumicchāmi ko doṣaḥ kathyatāmiha
verses.translation: Some call him the fourth one or the being beyond the fourth one. Some call him devoid of Gunas or possessing Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some call him the fourth one or the being beyond the fourth one. Some call him devoid of Gunas or possessing Gunas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महादेव्या वामदेवः स्मयन्निव । न तां निर्बन्धयामास देवकार्यचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahādevyā vāmadevaḥ smayanniva | na tāṃ nirbandhayāmāsa devakāryacikīrṣayā
verses.translation: Some call him having worldly existence; Others having no worldly existence. Still others call him free, not free, terrible, gentle, passionate, passionless, inactive, active, possessed or devoid of sense-organs, stable, not stable, with colour or no colour, visible, invisible, expressible, inexpressi¬ ble, in the form of word and sound or beyond that, possessed or devoid of thought and knowledge, comprehensible or incomprehensible, great and not great.
verses.wordMeaning: Some call him having worldly existence; Others having no worldly existence. Still others call him free, not free, terrible, gentle, passionate, passionless, inactive, active, possessed or devoid of sense-organs, stable, not stable, with colour or no colour, visible, invisible,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some call him having worldly existence; Others having no worldly existence. Still others call him free, not free, terrible, gentle, passionate, passionless, inactive, active, possessed or devoid of sense-organs, stable, not stable, with colour or no colour, visible, invisible,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: He has no keen desire. He has neither happiness nor unhappiness; neither Karmans nor their after-effects; neither pleasure nor misery as a result of those Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has no keen desire. He has neither happiness nor unhappiness; neither Karmans nor their after-effects; neither pleasure nor misery as a result of those Karmans.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: He has no keen desire. He has neither happiness nor unhappiness; neither Karmans nor their after-effects; neither pleasure nor misery as a result of those Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has no keen desire. He has neither happiness nor unhappiness; neither Karmans nor their after-effects; neither pleasure nor misery as a result of those Karmans.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । देवीगौरत्वप्राप्तिः । वायुरुवाच । ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पतिमम्बा पतिव्रता । नियम्य च वियोगार्तिं जगाम हिमवद्गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.25. pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devīgauratvaprāptiḥ | vāyuruvāca | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya patimambā pativratā | niyamya ca viyogārtiṃ jagāma himavadgirim
verses.translation: He has no connection with the seats of feelings nor with the impressions of actions. He has no contact with enjoyments of pleasures nor with their impressions of the three units of lime — past, present, future
verses.commentary: Sense: He has no connection with the seats of feelings nor with the impressions of actions. He has no contact with enjoyments of pleasures nor with their impressions of the three units of lime — past, present, future
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृतवती पूर्वं देशे यस्मिन्सखीजनैः । तमेव देशमवृणोत्तपसे प्रणयात्पुनः
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ kṛtavatī pūrvaṃ deśe yasminsakhījanaiḥ | tameva deśamavṛṇottapase praṇayātpunaḥ
verses.translation: Hence intelligent men well-versed in the Agamas considering identity between the word and its meaning call the lord as single-syllabled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence intelligent men well-versed in the Agamas considering identity between the word and its meaning call the lord as single-syllabled.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वपितरं दृष्ट्वा मातरं च तयोर्गृहे । प्रणम्य वृत्तं विज्ञाप्य ताभ्यां चानुमता सती
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mātaraṃ ca tayorgṛhe | praṇamya vṛttaṃ vijñāpya tābhyāṃ cānumatā satī
verses.translation: There is no doubt that a child' in the womb, a nascent child, a boy, a young,, old or 'a dying man, a soul in heayen or hell, a fallen or a pious, or a wise man or a fool is immediately released if there is divine grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that a child' in the womb, a nascent child, a boy, a young,, old or 'a dying man, a soul in heayen or hell, a fallen or a pious, or a wise man or a fool is immediately released if there is divine grace.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनस्तपोवनं गत्वा भूषणानि विसृज्य च । स्नात्वा तपस्विनो वेषं कृत्वा परमपावनम्
verses.transliteration: punastapovanaṃ gatvā bhūṣaṇāni visṛjya ca | snātvā tapasvino veṣaṃ kṛtvā paramapāvanam
verses.translation: Then the lord, the sage, superior to procreated the first of the gods Brahma, the Brahmanaspati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord, the sage, superior to procreated the first of the gods Brahma, the Brahmanaspati.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्प्य च महातीव्रं तपः परमदुश्चरम् । सदा मनसि सन्धाय भर्तुश्चरणपङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: saṅkalpya ca mahātīvraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram | sadā manasi sandhāya bhartuścaraṇapaṅkajam
verses.translation: O lord, be pleased to accept our worship. You have the colour of the saffron, the excellent disc and the colourful ornaments of gold. Your eyes resemble the lotus; you hold a lotus and you are the cause of Brahma, Indra and Narayana. The golden vessel is filled with excellent gems and water of brilliant hue. Vermilion and other things, Kusa grass and flowers too are offered.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, be pleased to accept our worship. You have the colour of the saffron, the excellent disc and the colourful ornaments of gold. Your eyes resemble the lotus; you hold a lotus and you are the cause of Brahma, Indra and Narayana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, be pleased to accept our worship. You have the colour of the saffron, the excellent disc and the colourful ornaments of gold. Your eyes resemble the lotus; you hold a lotus and you are the cause of Brahma, Indra and Narayana.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमेव क्षणिके लिङ्गे ध्यात्वा बाह्यविधानतः । त्रिसन्ध्यमभ्यर्चयन्ती वन्यैः पुष्पैः फलादिभिः
verses.transliteration: tameva kṣaṇike liṅge dhyātvā bāhyavidhānataḥ | trisandhyamabhyarcayantī vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to &va the quiescent, the primordial cause, to Rudra accompanied by the Ganas; obeisance to him in the form of the sun, to Visnu, to Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to &va the quiescent, the primordial cause, to Rudra accompanied by the Ganas; obeisance to him in the form of the sun, to Visnu, to Brahma.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स एव ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिमास्थाय तपसः फलम् । प्रदास्यति ममेत्येवं नित्यं कृत्वाऽकरोत्तपः
verses.transliteration: sa eva brahmaṇo mūrtimāsthāya tapasaḥ phalam | pradāsyati mametyevaṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā'karottapaḥ
verses.translation: He who worships Siva thus in the solar disc with pure mind, in the morning, midday and at dusk and offers the excellent Arghya, or bows and reads the verses plea¬ sing to the ears does not find anything inaccessible. If he is a devotee he is certainly liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who worships Siva thus in the solar disc with pure mind, in the morning, midday and at dusk and offers the excellent Arghya, or bows and reads the verses plea¬ sing to the ears does not find anything inaccessible. If he is a devotee he is certainly liberated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा तपश्चरन्तीं तां काले बहुतिथे गते । दृष्टः कश्चिन्महाव्याघ्रो दुष्टभावादुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: tathā tapaścarantīṃ tāṃ kāle bahutithe gate | dṛṣṭaḥ kaścinmahāvyāghro duṣṭabhāvādupāgamat
verses.translation: Hence for the sake of virtue, wealth, love and sal¬ vation, one shall mentally verbally and physically worship Siva in the form of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence for the sake of virtue, wealth, love and sal¬ vation, one shall mentally verbally and physically worship Siva in the form of the sun.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैवोपगतस्यापि तस्यातीव दुरात्मनः । गात्रं चित्रार्पितमिव स्तब्धं तस्याः सकाशतः
verses.transliteration: tathaivopagatasyāpi tasyātīva durātmanaḥ | gātraṃ citrārpitamiva stabdhaṃ tasyāḥ sakāśataḥ
verses.translation: Then the lord stationed in the disc glanced at the gods, revealed the sacred scripture, the sequel to all the Aga- mas and vanished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord stationed in the disc glanced at the gods, revealed the sacred scripture, the sequel to all the Aga- mas and vanished.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वापि तथा व्याघ्रं दुष्टभावादुपागतम् । न पृथग्जनवद्देवी स्वभावेन विविच्यते
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvāpi tathā vyāghraṃ duṣṭabhāvādupāgatam | na pṛthagjanavaddevī svabhāvena vivicyate
verses.translation: He has no cause or maker; he has no beginning no end nor the intervening space. He has no activity or ins¬ trument. He has neither Akarya nor Karya.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has no cause or maker; he has no beginning no end nor the intervening space. He has no activity or ins¬ trument. He has neither Akarya nor Karya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तु विष्टब्धसर्वाङ्गो बुभुक्षापरिपीडितः । ममामिषं ततो नान्यदिति मत्वा निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu viṣṭabdhasarvāṅgo bubhukṣāparipīḍitaḥ | mamāmiṣaṃ tato nānyaditi matvā nirantaram
verses.translation: He has neither kinsman nor non-kinsman; he has no one to check or to urge. He has no lord, preceptor or protector. He has no superior or equal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has neither kinsman nor non-kinsman; he has no one to check or to urge. He has no lord, preceptor or protector. He has no superior or equal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्यमाणः सततं देवीमेव तदाऽनिशम् । अतिष्ठदग्रतस्तस्या उपासनमिवाचरत्
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣyamāṇaḥ satataṃ devīmeva tadā'niśam | atiṣṭhadagratastasyā upāsanamivācarat
verses.translation: He has neither birth nor death; neither expectation nor disinclination. He is not subject to injunctions or prohibitions; he has neither liberation nor bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has neither birth nor death; neither expectation nor disinclination. He is not subject to injunctions or prohibitions; he has neither liberation nor bondage.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्याश्च हृदये नित्यं ममैवायमुपासकः । त्राता च दुष्टसत्त्वेभ्य इति प्रववृते कृपा
verses.transliteration: devyāśca hṛdaye nityaṃ mamaivāyamupāsakaḥ | trātā ca duṣṭasattvebhya iti pravavṛte kṛpā
verses.translation: He never has anything not conducive to welfare or inauspicious. He has everything auspicious since Siva is the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: He never has anything not conducive to welfare or inauspicious. He has everything auspicious since Siva is the great Atman.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्या एव कृपायोगात्सद्यो नष्टमलत्रयः । बभूव सहसा व्याघ्रो देवीं च बुबुधे तदा
verses.transliteration: tasyā eva kṛpāyogātsadyo naṣṭamalatrayaḥ | babhūva sahasā vyāghro devīṃ ca bubudhe tadā
verses.translation: Presiding over everything by means of his Saktis, he is stationed without dropping his intrinsic nature. Hence he is known as Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Presiding over everything by means of his Saktis, he is stationed without dropping his intrinsic nature. Hence he is known as Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न्यवर्तत बुभुक्षा च तस्याङ्गस्तम्भनं तथा । दौरात्म्यं जन्मसिद्धं च तृप्तिश्च समजायत
verses.transliteration: nyavartata bubhukṣā ca tasyāṅgastambhanaṃ tathā | daurātmyaṃ janmasiddhaṃ ca tṛptiśca samajāyata
verses.translation: Since the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by Siva, he is known as
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by Siva, he is known as
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा परमभावेन ज्ञात्वा कार्तार्थ्यमात्मनः । सद्योपासक एवैष सिषेवे परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: tadā paramabhāvena jñātvā kārtārthyamātmanaḥ | sadyopāsaka evaiṣa siṣeve parameśvarīm
verses.translation: He shall be meditated upon in the cavity within the heart as minute as the tip of a hair, with golden hair, and lotus eyes. He is pink and copper-coloured.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be meditated upon in the cavity within the heart as minute as the tip of a hair, with golden hair, and lotus eyes. He is pink and copper-coloured.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुष्टानामपि सत्त्वानां तथान्येषां दुरात्मनाम् । स एव द्रावको भूत्वा विचचार तपोवने
verses.transliteration: duṣṭānāmapi sattvānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ durātmanām | sa eva drāvako bhūtvā vicacāra tapovane
verses.translation: He moves about golden in colour, blue-nccked, both gentle and terrible and a mixure of the both, imperishable, deathless and unchangeable. Such is the great lord, the slayer of the god of death. He is liberated from the sentient and non-sentient. He is greater than the great universe.
verses.wordMeaning: He moves about golden in colour, blue-nccked, both gentle and terrible and a mixure of the both, imperishable, deathless and unchangeable. Such is the great lord, the slayer of the god of death. He is liberated from the sentient and non-sentient.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He moves about golden in colour, blue-nccked, both gentle and terrible and a mixure of the both, imperishable, deathless and unchangeable. Such is the great lord, the slayer of the god of death. He is liberated from the sentient and non-sentient.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपश्च ववृधे देव्यास्तीव्रं तीव्रतरात्मकम् । देवाश्च दैत्यनिर्बन्धाद् ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: tapaśca vavṛdhe devyāstīvraṃ tīvratarātmakam | devāśca daityanirbandhād brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: Since the knowledge and supremacy of Siva excels those of others he excels all the lords of the worlds so say the intelligent persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the knowledge and supremacy of Siva excels those of others he excels all the lords of the worlds so say the intelligent persons.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुर्निवेदनं देवाः स्वदुःखस्यारिपीडनात् । यथा च ददतुः शुम्भनिशुम्भौ वरसम्मदात्
verses.transliteration: cakrurnivedanaṃ devāḥ svaduḥkhasyāripīḍanāt | yathā ca dadatuḥ śumbhaniśumbhau varasammadāt
verses.translation: Undoubtedly the great Siddhi can be acquired by meditation on Pranava that is expressive of Siva and by the performance of its Japa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly the great Siddhi can be acquired by meditation on Pranava that is expressive of Siva and by the performance of its Japa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि श्रुत्वा विधिर्दुःखं सुराणां कृपयान्वितः । आसीद्दैत्यवधायैव स्मृत्वा हेत्वाश्रयां कथाम्
verses.transliteration: so'pi śrutvā vidhirduḥkhaṃ surāṇāṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ | āsīddaityavadhāyaiva smṛtvā hetvāśrayāṃ kathām
verses.translation: In the Upanisads its Matras are four A,U, M and nada.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Upanisads its Matras are four A,U, M and nada.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सामरः प्रार्थितो ब्रह्मा ययौ देव्यास्तपोवनम् । संस्मरन्मनसा देवदुःखमोक्षं स्वयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: sāmaraḥ prārthito brahmā yayau devyāstapovanam | saṃsmaranmanasā devaduḥkhamokṣaṃ svayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Pranava expresses everything through the three Matras in three ways and indicates Sivatman through half a Matra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pranava expresses everything through the three Matras in three ways and indicates Sivatman through half a Matra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श च सुरश्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठे तपसि निष्ठिताम् । प्रतिष्ठामिव विश्वस्य भवानीं परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: dadarśa ca suraśreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhe tapasi niṣṭhitām | pratiṣṭhāmiva viśvasya bhavānīṃ parameśvarīm
verses.translation: His Sakti shall be known as natural and dissimilar to the universe in its characteristics. It is single but appears in many forms like the light of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: His Sakti shall be known as natural and dissimilar to the universe in its characteristics. It is single but appears in many forms like the light of the sun.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ननाम चास्य जगतो मातरं स्वस्य वै हरेः । रुद्रस्य च पितुर्भार्यामार्यामद्रीश्वरात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration: nanāma cāsya jagato mātaraṃ svasya vai hareḥ | rudrasya ca piturbhāryāmāryāmadrīśvarātmajām
verses.translation: Endless arc the Saktis, viz, wiish, knowledge, activity and Maya etc. just like the flames of fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Endless arc the Saktis, viz, wiish, knowledge, activity and Maya etc. just like the flames of fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणमागतं दृष्ट्वा देवी देवगणैः सहः । अर्घ्यं तदर्हं दत्त्वाऽस्मै स्वागताद्यैरुपाचरत्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā devī devagaṇaiḥ sahaḥ | arghyaṃ tadarhaṃ dattvā'smai svāgatādyairupācarat
verses.translation: The Purusas — Sadasiva, Ivaraaud others, Vidyevara Avidyc'ivara and others and Prakrti — greater than the greatest were born of this Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purusas — Sadasiva, Ivaraaud others, Vidyevara Avidyc'ivara and others and Prakrti — greater than the greatest were born of this Sakti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां च प्रत्युपचारोक्तिं पुरस्कृत्याभिनन्द्य च । पप्रच्छ तपसो हेतुमजानन्निव पद्मजः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ ca pratyupacāroktiṃ puraskṛtyābhinandya ca | papraccha tapaso hetumajānanniva padmajaḥ
verses.translation: The goddess enchants and deludes the universe with¬ out any strain through Maya. She releases the Jivas sportively.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess enchants and deludes the universe with¬ out any strain through Maya. She releases the Jivas sportively.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । तीव्रेण तपसानेन देव्या किमिह साध्यते । तपःफलानां सर्वेषां त्वदधीना हि सिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | tīvreṇa tapasānena devyā kimiha sādhyate | tapaḥphalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tvadadhīnā hi siddhayaḥ
verses.translation: With her ramified into twentyseven forms, the lord stands pervading the universe.®** Hence the process of liberation functions.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her ramified into twentyseven forms, the lord stands pervading the universe.®** Hence the process of liberation functions.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैव जगतां भर्ता तमेव परमेश्वरम् । भर्तारमात्मना प्राप्य प्राप्तं च तपसः फलम्
verses.transliteration: yaścaiva jagatāṃ bhartā tameva parameśvaram | bhartāramātmanā prāpya prāptaṃ ca tapasaḥ phalam
verses.translation: Formerly some sages desirous of salvation held a discourse on Brahman. Their minds were pestered by doubts. They began to reflect and ponder. "What is the ultimate
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly some sages desirous of salvation held a discourse on Brahman. Their minds were pestered by doubts. They began to reflect and ponder. "What is the ultimate
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवा सर्वमेवैतत्क्रीडाविलसितं तव । इदं तु चित्रं देवस्य विरहं सहसे कथम्
verses.transliteration: athavā sarvamevaitatkrīḍāvilasitaṃ tava | idaṃ tu citraṃ devasya virahaṃ sahase katham
verses.translation: Then through his grace, the great Yoga and the path of devotion they -can attaih. the supreme divine goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then through his grace, the great Yoga and the path of devotion they -can attaih. the supreme divine goal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । सर्गादौ भवतो देवादुत्पत्तिः श्रूयते यदा । तदा प्रजानां प्रथमस्त्वं मे प्रथमजः सुतः
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | sargādau bhavato devādutpattiḥ śrūyate yadā | tadā prajānāṃ prathamastvaṃ me prathamajaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: In regard to salvation the sequence of knowledge and activity \s not intended because if there is divine grace s'alvation is accessible to everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: In regard to salvation the sequence of knowledge and activity \s not intended because if there is divine grace s'alvation is accessible to everyone.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा पुनः प्रजावृद्ध्यै ललाटाद्भवतो भवः । उत्पन्नोऽभूत्तदा त्वं मे गुरुः श्वशुरभावतः
verses.transliteration: yadā punaḥ prajāvṛddhyai lalāṭādbhavato bhavaḥ | utpanno'bhūttadā tvaṃ me guruḥ śvaśurabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The merciful lord quells different dirts of his devotees though they may be unqualified. He is pleased with their devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The merciful lord quells different dirts of his devotees though they may be unqualified. He is pleased with their devotion.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदाभवद्गिरीन्द्रस्ते पुत्रो मम पिता स्वयम् । तदा पितामहस्त्वं मे जातो लोकपितामह
verses.transliteration: yadābhavadgirīndraste putro mama pitā svayam | tadā pitāmahastvaṃ me jāto lokapitāmaha
verses.translation: This devotion with grace as its antecedent and causing worldly pleasures and salvation cannot be acquired in a single birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: This devotion with grace as its antecedent and causing worldly pleasures and salvation cannot be acquired in a single birth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदीदृशस्य भवतो लोकयात्राविधायिनः । वृत्तमन्तःपुरे भर्त्रा कथयिष्ये कथं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tadīdṛśasya bhavato lokayātrāvidhāyinaḥ | vṛttamantaḥpure bhartrā kathayiṣye kathaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: When the lord of gods is delighted a modicum of devotion is generated in the individual with the conscious¬ ness, "My lord exists". Then he begins to be associated with penance and various Saivite holy rites. After their performance and their frequent practice the devotion becomes greater.
verses.wordMeaning: When the lord of gods is delighted a modicum of devotion is generated in the individual with the conscious¬ ness, "My lord exists". Then he begins to be associated with penance and various Saivite holy rites.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord of gods is delighted a modicum of devotion is generated in the individual with the conscious¬ ness, "My lord exists". Then he begins to be associated with penance and various Saivite holy rites.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुना देहे यश्चायं मम कालिमा । त्यक्त्वा सत्त्वविधानेन गौरी भवितुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunā dehe yaścāyaṃ mama kālimā | tyaktvā sattvavidhānena gaurī bhavitumutsahe
verses.translation: As a result of that a greater grace is acquired. As a result of the grace liberation is attained. A liberated soul enjoys bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of that a greater grace is acquired. As a result of the grace liberation is attained. A liberated soul enjoys bliss.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । एतावता किमर्थेन तीव्रं देवि तपः कृतम् । स्वेच्छैव किमपर्याप्ता क्रीडेयं हि तवेदृशी
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | etāvatā kimarthena tīvraṃ devi tapaḥ kṛtam | svecchaiva kimaparyāptā krīḍeyaṃ hi tavedṛśī
verses.translation: Service with or without the ancillaries is called devotion. It is threefold due to the three means of mind speech and body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Service with or without the ancillaries is called devotion. It is threefold due to the three means of mind speech and body.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडाऽपि च जगन्मातस्तव लोकहिताय वै । अतो ममेष्टमनया फलं किमपि साध्यताम्
verses.transliteration: krīḍā'pi ca jaganmātastava lokahitāya vai | ato mameṣṭamanayā phalaṃ kimapi sādhyatām
verses.translation: In brief they are penance, holy rites, repetition of mantras, meditation and knowledge. Penance is the rite of Gandrayana, etc. What is termed holy rite is the worship of Siva's phallic image. Japa is the repetition of the names of Siva in three ways. Meditation is pondering over Siva. What is mentioned in the Saivite Agamas as perfect knowledge is meant by the word knowledge here.
verses.wordMeaning: In brief they are penance, holy rites, repetition of mantras, meditation and knowledge. Penance is the rite of Gandrayana, etc. What is termed holy rite is the worship of Siva's phallic image. Japa is the repetition of the names of Siva in three ways.…

verses.sanskrit: निशुम्भशुम्भनामानौ दैत्यौ दत्तवरौ मया । दृप्तौ देवान्प्रबाधेते त्वत्तो लब्धस्तयोर्वधः
verses.transliteration: niśumbhaśumbhanāmānau daityau dattavarau mayā | dṛptau devānprabādhete tvatto labdhastayorvadhaḥ
verses.translation: An intelligent man seeking welfare shall avoid too
verses.commentary: Sense: An intelligent man seeking welfare shall avoid too
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अलं विलम्बनेनात्र त्वं क्षणेन स्थिरा भव । शक्तिर्विसृज्यमानाद्य तयोर्मृत्युर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: alaṃ vilambanenātra tvaṃ kṣaṇena sthirā bhava | śaktirvisṛjyamānādya tayormṛtyurbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O lord, r wish to hear about Siva's knowledge expounded by Siva in the Vedasara for the salvation of his devotees. It is incomprehensible to non-devotees, the unintelligent and those who do not practise Yoga. It consists of five topics. It is censured by the unwise stupid persons.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, r wish to hear about Siva's knowledge expounded by Siva in the Vedasara for the salvation of his devotees. It is incomprehensible to non-devotees, the unintelligent and those who do not practise Yoga. It consists of five topics.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाऽभ्यर्थिता चैव देवी गिरिवरात्मजा । त्वक्कोशं सहसोत्सृज्य गौरी सा समजायत
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā'bhyarthitā caiva devī girivarātmajā | tvakkośaṃ sahasotsṛjya gaurī sā samajāyata
verses.translation: It extends to a hundred crores of verses as narra¬ ted by lord Siva. How shall the worship be performed, O lord? Who is authorised in the worship? What are the practices of Jnanayoga etc.? O sage of good rites, it hoves you to narrate all these things in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: It extends to a hundred crores of verses as narra¬ ted by lord Siva. How shall the worship be performed, O lord? Who is authorised in the worship? What are the practices of Jnanayoga etc.? O sage of good rites, it hoves you to narrate all these things in detail.

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वक्कोशात्मनोत्सृष्टा कौशिकी नाम नामतः । काली कालाम्बुदप्रख्या कन्यका समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sā tvakkośātmanotsṛṣṭā kauśikī nāma nāmataḥ | kālī kālāmbudaprakhyā kanyakā samapadyata
verses.translation: I shall succinctly narrate the lore of Siva con¬ densed from the Vedas as narrated by Siva. I shall avoid its praises or condemnations. It is convincing and divine. It can be acquired only by the grace of the preceptor. It is conducive to salvation without any strain. A detailed explanation of the same is impossible.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु मायात्मिका शक्तिर्योगनिद्रा च वैष्णवी । शङ्खचक्रत्रिशूलादिसायुधाष्टमहाभुजा
verses.transliteration: sā tu māyātmikā śaktiryoganidrā ca vaiṣṇavī | śaṅkhacakratriśūlādisāyudhāṣṭamahābhujā
verses.translation: While being born, Brahma saw the lord liis>father. The lord saw and commanded him.
verses.commentary: Sense: While being born, Brahma saw the lord liis>father. The lord saw and commanded him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सौम्या घोरा च मिश्रा च त्रिनेत्रा चन्द्रशेखरा । अजातपुंस्पर्शरतिरधृष्या चातिसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: saumyā ghorā ca miśrā ca trinetrā candraśekharā | ajātapuṃsparśaratiradhṛṣyā cātisundarī
verses.translation: For the sake of sacrifice he. created Soma. From Soma was born the heaven, earth, tire, sun, sacriiR:e,v Visnu' and Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of sacrifice he. created Soma. From Soma was born the heaven, earth, tire, sun, sacriiR:e,v Visnu' and Indra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दत्ता च ब्रह्मणे देव्या शक्तिरेषा सनातनी । निशुम्भस्य च शुम्भस्य निहन्त्री दैत्यसिंहयोः
verses.transliteration: dattā ca brahmaṇe devyā śaktireṣā sanātanī | niśumbhasya ca śumbhasya nihantrī daityasiṃhayoḥ
verses.translation: They and the gods eulogised Rudra with the hymns dedicated to him. The lord stood before the gods with his face beaming with delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: They and the gods eulogised Rudra with the hymns dedicated to him. The lord stood before the gods with his face beaming with delight.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणाऽपि प्रहृष्टेन तस्यै परमशक्तये । प्रबलः केसरी दत्तो वाहनत्वे समागतः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā'pi prahṛṣṭena tasyai paramaśaktaye | prabalaḥ kesarī datto vāhanatve samāgataḥ
verses.translation: The lord took away their knowledge, sportively. The deluded gods asked him, 'Who are youv.Siix?'
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord took away their knowledge, sportively. The deluded gods asked him, 'Who are youv.Siix?'

verses.transliteration: vindhye ca vasatiṃ tasyāḥ pūjāmāsavapūrvakaiḥ | māṃsairmatsyairapūpaiśca nirvartyāsau samādiśat
verses.translation: Lord Rudra said: — "T had been the only primeval being, O gods, I am and I shall be 'There is none except me or separate from me. I alone satisfy the universe through my splendour. There is none supejlior to or equal to me. He who knows me is liberated." After saying, this the lord vanished there itself. Unable to see him the gods began to eulogise him with Samans. They performed the holy rites of Pasupata as prescribed in the Atharvairas Upaniads. They smeared Bhasma all over their bodies.

verses.transliteration: sā caiva sammatā śaktirbrahmaṇo viśvakarmaṇaḥ | praṇamya mātaraṃ gaurīṃ brahmāṇaṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: In order to please them the lord came there witli the Ganas and Uma. The leading. gods saw the lord whom the awakened sinless Yogins of restrained brealh see within their hearts. To the left of lord Siva they saw the beautiful goddess, the greatest akti who followed the wish of the lord. The chiefs of the ganas who had forsaken worldiness and acquired the region of Siva and the Siddhas were also seen. Then the gods eulogised the lord and the goddess with the divine hymns from the Vedas and the Puranas. The delighted bull-bannered lord saw the gods with mercy and spoke sweetly, 'I am delighted.' Ihen, bowing to him the gods asked him about this important topic.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिभिश्चापि तुल्याभिः स्वात्मजाभिरनेकशः । परीता प्रययौ विन्ध्यं दैत्येन्द्रौ हन्तुमुद्यता
verses.transliteration: śaktibhiścāpi tulyābhiḥ svātmajābhiranekaśaḥ | parītā prayayau vindhyaṃ daityendrau hantumudyatā
verses.translation: O lord, ho«v shall they worship you on the earth? What is the path? Who is authorised in the worship?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, ho«v shall they worship you on the earth? What is the path? Who is authorised in the worship?

verses.transliteration: nihatau ca tayā tatra samare daityapuṅgavau | tadbāṇaiḥ kāmabāṇaiśca cchinnabhinnāṅgamānasau
verses.translation: Glancing smilipgly at the goddess, Siva the chief of the gods revealed his terrible form brilliant as the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Glancing smilipgly at the goddess, Siva the chief of the gods revealed his terrible form brilliant as the sun.

verses.transliteration: tadyuddhavistaraścātra na kṛto'nyatra varṇanāt | ūhanīyaṃ parasmācca prastutaṃ varṇayāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: The lord had eight arms and four faces. Half of that form was female. On seeing this wondrous form, Vi?9u and other gods understood the lord as the sun and the goddess as the moon and the remaining parts as elements. They realised the universe of the mobile and immobile beings identical with him. Then they worshipped the lord a«id made obeisance to him.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord had eight arms and four faces. Half of that form was female. On seeing this wondrous form, Vi?9u and other gods understood the lord as the sun and the goddess as the moon and the remaining parts as elements.…

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After a pretty long interval the sacred scripture was forgotten. The goddess seated in the lap of her husband asked him about it.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a pretty long interval the sacred scripture was forgotten. The goddess seated in the lap of her husband asked him about it.

verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । व्याघ्रगतिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । उत्पाद्य कौशिकीं गौरी ब्रह्मणे प्रतिपाद्य ताम् । तस्य प्रत्युपकाराय पितामहमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.26. ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vyāghragativarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | utpādya kauśikīṃ gaurī brahmaṇe pratipādya tām | tasya pratyupakārāya pitāmahamathābravīt
verses.translation: Urged by her, the moon-crested lord narrated to her the sacred scripture — the sequel to all Agamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by her, the moon-crested lord narrated to her the sacred scripture — the sequel to all Agamas.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । दृष्टः किमेष भवता शार्दूलो मदुपाश्रयः । अनेन दुष्टसत्त्वेभ्यो रक्षितं मत्तपोवनम्

verses.translation: They could bear the mutually clashing pairs — extreme cold, heat etc. They were self-possessed and engaged in the benefit of living beings. They were straightforward,
verses.commentary: Sense: They could bear the mutually clashing pairs — extreme cold, heat etc. They were self-possessed and engaged in the benefit of living beings. They were straightforward,

verses.sanskrit: मय्यर्पितमना एष भजते मामनन्यधीः । अस्य संरक्षणादन्यत्प्रियं मम न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: mayyarpitamanā eṣa bhajate māmananyadhīḥ | asya saṃrakṣaṇādanyatpriyaṃ mama na vidyate
verses.translation: Then seeing an opportune moment the goddess asked Siva, the lord of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then seeing an opportune moment the goddess asked Siva, the lord of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: भवितव्यमनेनातो ममान्तःपुरचारिणा । गणेश्वरपदं चास्मै प्रीत्या दास्यति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: bhavitavyamanenāto mamāntaḥpuracāriṇā | gaṇeśvarapadaṃ cāsmai prītyā dāsyati śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: How can the lord be brought under control by slow-witted men who arc not interested in spiritual principles and who do not have self-control?
verses.commentary: Sense: How can the lord be brought under control by slow-witted men who arc not interested in spiritual principles and who do not have self-control?

verses.sanskrit: एनमग्रेसरं कृत्वा सखीभिर्गन्तुमुत्सहे । प्रदीयतामनुज्ञा मे प्रजानां पतिना त्वया
verses.transliteration: enamagresaraṃ kṛtvā sakhībhirgantumutsahe | pradīyatāmanujñā me prajānāṃ patinā tvayā
verses.translation: I cannot be enticed either by holy rites or pcnanct or Japas or postures or knowledge or by any other means except faith.*®®

verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ prahasanbrahmā devīṃ mugdhāmiva smayan | tasya tīvraiḥ purāvṛttairdaurātmyaṃ samavarṇayat
verses.translation: If men have faith in me I can be brought under

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । पशौ देवि मृगाः क्रूराः क्व च तेऽनुग्रहः शुभः । आशीविषमुखे साक्षादमृतं किं निषिच्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | paśau devi mṛgāḥ krūrāḥ kva ca te'nugrahaḥ śubhaḥ | āśīviṣamukhe sākṣādamṛtaṃ kiṃ niṣicyate
verses.translation: Hence faith shall be sought and acquired by him who desires to subject me to his control. Faith supports the duties of the different castes and is generated in him alone who abides by all duties of the castes and stages of life. No one else has faith in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence faith shall be sought and acquired by him who desires to subject me to his control. Faith supports the duties of the different castes and is generated in him alone who abides by all duties of the castes and stages of life. No one else has faith in me.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रमात्रेण सन्नेष दुष्टः कोऽपि निशाचरः । अनेन भक्षिता गावो ब्राह्मणाश्च तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: vyāghramātreṇa sanneṣa duṣṭaḥ ko'pi niśācaraḥ | anena bhakṣitā gāvo brāhmaṇāśca tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: At my bidding, the duties as derived from the Vedas of the various stages in life were mentioned formerly by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: At my bidding, the duties as derived from the Vedas of the various stages in life were mentioned formerly by Brahma.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयंस्तान् यथाकामं कामरूपी चरत्यसौ । अवश्यं खलु भोक्तव्यं फलं पापस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: tarpayaṃstān yathākāmaṃ kāmarūpī caratyasau | avaśyaṃ khalu bhoktavyaṃ phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: That compendium of duties is called Brahma's Dharma. It consists of expensive rites, and is attended with great stress and strain. The fruits are not comparatively plentiful. By resorting to this great Dharma it is possible for those persons of different castes who resort to me without seeking the support of others, and who have attained the rare faith, to attain virtue, love, wealth and salvation.
verses.wordMeaning: That compendium of duties is called Brahma's Dharma. It consists of expensive rites, and is attended with great stress and strain. The fruits are not comparatively plentiful.…

verses.transliteration: ataḥ kiṃ kṛpayā kṛtyamīdṛśeṣu durātmasu | anena devyāḥ kiṃ kṛtyaṃ prakṛtyā kaluṣātmanā
verses.translation: In the revolution of Yugas the trident- bearing lord incarnates himself on the earth and propagates the knowledge for the salvation of his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the revolution of Yugas the trident- bearing lord incarnates himself on the earth and propagates the knowledge for the salvation of his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । यदुक्तं भवता सर्वं तथ्यमस्त्वयमीदृशः । तथापि मां प्रपन्नोऽभून्न त्याज्यो मामुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | yaduktaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ tathyamastvayamīdṛśaḥ | tathāpi māṃ prapanno'bhūnna tyājyo māmupāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Now listen to the incarnations of Vyasa who were masters of Yoga in the different Kalpas: — Rbhu, Satya, Bhargava, Ahgiras, the brahmin Savitr, Satatejas, Dharma as Narayana, Svaraksa, the intelligent Aruni, Krtanjaya, Krtafi- jaya ( the second), Bharadvaja, the wise Gautama, sage Vaca- hsravas, the pious Suksmayani, sage Trnabindu, Ksna, Sakti akteya, Uttara, Jatukarnya, Hari and sage Kr§nadvaipayana.
verses.wordMeaning: Now listen to the incarnations of Vyasa who were masters of Yoga in the different Kalpas: — Rbhu, Satya, Bhargava, Ahgiras, the brahmin Savitr, Satatejas, Dharma as Narayana, Svaraksa, the intelligent Aruni, Krtanjaya, Krtafi- jaya ( the second), Bharadvaja, the wise Gautama,…

verses.transliteration: brahmovāca | asya bhaktimavijñāya prāgvṛttaṃ te niveditam | bhaktiścedasya kiṃ pāpairna te bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: These incarnations of Vyasa are up to the -.end of Dyapara. There are the incarnations as Yogacarya of Siva and their disciples. In different yugas the lord's disciples are four. Their disciples and future disciples are in hundreds and thousands. By their endeavour, these are purified by their devotion and are liberated by their carrying out the behests of Siva in the world.

verses.translation: O lord, please enumerate the incarnations ol §iva as Yogacarya and his disciples in the different circles of Yugas.

verses.transliteration: tvameva vividhā śaktiḥ bhavānāmatha vā svayam | aśaktaḥ karmakaraṇe kartā vā kiṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: Eaeh of these had four disciples of quiet minds. They are from Sveta to Rusya. I shall enumerate them in the proper order.

verses.translation: These are the disciples of the lord, the Yogacarya. Their number is hundred and twelve.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the disciples of the lord, the Yogacarya. Their number is hundred and twelve.

verses.transliteration: tvāmanārādhya deveśi puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | labdhuṃ na śakyamasmābhirapi sarvaiḥ surottamaiḥ
verses.translation: These had become Siddhas by Pasupata rites. They used to dust their bodies with Bhasma. They knew the principles and meanings of the sacred texts. They were masters of the Vedas and Vedahgas.

verses.translation: They were engaged in Siva's hermitage. They were devoted to Siva's lore. They were free from attach¬ ments. Their minds were attached to Siva alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were engaged in Siva's hermitage. They were devoted to Siva's lore. They were free from attach¬ ments. Their minds were attached to Siva alone.

verses.transliteration: samastalokayātrārthaṃ mūrtimāviśya kāmapi | krīḍase vividhairbhāvaiḥ kastvāṃ jānāti tattvataḥ

verses.transliteration: ato duṣkṛtakarmāpi vyāghro'yaṃ tvadanugrahāt | prāpnotu paramāṃ siddhimatra kaḥ pratibandhakaḥ
verses.translation: He who worships Siva everyday after thinking about these and their preceptors attains Sayujya with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who worships Siva everyday after thinking about these and their preceptors attains Sayujya with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

You have incarnated on the earth for breaking the binding cords of men,

verses.translation: You have very pertinently put the question O Krsna. I shall explain it precisely to you of auspicious mind. You as the devotee of Siva arc the person fit to hear it.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have very pertinently put the question O Krsna. I shall explain it precisely to you of auspicious mind. You as the devotee of Siva arc the person fit to hear it.

verses.transliteration: praṇamyāśvāsya bahudhā pitarau virahāsahau | tapaḥ praṇayino devī tapovanamahīruhān
verses.translation: Accompanied by the goddess, the lord went to his beautiful garden on the beautiful mountain Mandara abounding in beautiful caves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by the goddess, the lord went to his beautiful garden on the beautiful mountain Mandara abounding in beautiful caves.

verses.translation: Then Subhavati, the beloved friend of the goddess with a smiling face, brought many full-blown flowers of great beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Subhavati, the beloved friend of the goddess with a smiling face, brought many full-blown flowers of great beauty.

verses.translation: Thereupon §iva, the chief of the gods, seated the goddess on his lap and bedecked her with the flowers. He was much pleased with himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon §iva, the chief of the gods, seated the goddess on his lap and bedecked her with the flowers. He was much pleased with himself.

verses.translation: The gentle ladies bedecked in glittering orna¬ ments working in the harem and the confidential attendants, the chiefs of Ganas served the goddess and the lord, with chowrics in their hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gentle ladies bedecked in glittering orna¬ ments working in the harem and the confidential attendants, the chiefs of Ganas served the goddess and the lord, with chowrics in their hands.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रययौ मन्दरं गौरी यत्र भर्ता महेश्वरः । सर्वेषां जगतां धाता कर्ता पाता विनाशकृत्
verses.transliteration: prayayau mandaraṃ gaurī yatra bhartā maheśvaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ dhātā kartā pātā vināśakṛt
verses.translation: Then pleasing discourses ensued for the diversion of the lord and the goddess and for the succour of the devotees who sought refuge in him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then pleasing discourses ensued for the diversion of the lord and the goddess and for the succour of the devotees who sought refuge in him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, after securing or not securing the duties mentioned by me if my devotee lifts himself up by his efforts, it is an acquisition of what is not acquired supe¬ rior in qualities crores and crores of times. Hence, one shall practise the duties mentioned by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, after securing or not securing the duties mentioned by me if my devotee lifts himself up by his efforts, it is an acquisition of what is not acquired supe¬ rior in qualities crores and crores of times. Hence, one shall practise the duties mentioned by me.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, after securing or not securing the duties mentioned by me if my devotee lifts himself up by his efforts, it is an acquisition of what is not acquired supe¬ rior in qualities crores and crores of times. Hence, one shall practise the duties mentioned by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, after securing or not securing the duties mentioned by me if my devotee lifts himself up by his efforts, it is an acquisition of what is not acquired supe¬ rior in qualities crores and crores of times. Hence, one shall practise the duties mentioned by me.
