verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । देवीशिवमिलनवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । कृत्वा गौरं वपुर्दिव्यं देवी गिरिवरात्मजा । कथं ददर्श भर्तारं प्रविष्टा मन्दिरं सती
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.27. saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | devīśivamilanavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | kṛtvā gauraṃ vapurdivyaṃ devī girivarātmajā | kathaṃ dadarśa bhartāraṃ praviṣṭā mandiraṃ satī
verses.translation: O noble lady, these are my incarnations as Yoga- carya*®® in all the Manvantaras and thousands of generations.
verses.commentary: Sense: O noble lady, these are my incarnations as Yoga- carya*®® in all the Manvantaras and thousands of generations.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशसमये तस्या भवनद्वारगोचरैः । गणेशैः किं कृतं देवस्तां दृष्ट्वा किं तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: praveśasamaye tasyā bhavanadvāragocaraiḥ | gaṇeśaiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ devastāṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃ tadākarot
verses.translation: By Karman my worship shall be understood and 'not such extraneous rites as sacrifice, etc. Tapas or penance is the withering of physical body for my sake and not the rites Kfcchra, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: By Karman my worship shall be understood and 'not such extraneous rites as sacrifice, etc. Tapas or penance is the withering of physical body for my sake and not the rites Kfcchra, etc.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । प्रवक्तुमञ्जसाशक्यः तादृशः परमो रसः । येन प्रणयगर्भेण भावो भाववतां हृतः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | pravaktumañjasāśakyaḥ tādṛśaḥ paramo rasaḥ | yena praṇayagarbheṇa bhāvo bhāvavatāṃ hṛtaḥ
verses.translation: If these eight traits are present even in an out- caste he is equal to a leading brahmin, a sage, a glorious ascetic and a learned scholar. A master of four Vedas is not dearer to me than a Candala''® devoted to me. Things can be given to and taken from him. He shall be worshipped like me. I am not lost to him nor is he lost to me who offers unto me with devotion, even a leaf, a flower, a fruit or mere water.
verses.wordMeaning: If these eight traits are present even in an out- caste he is equal to a leading brahmin, a sage, a glorious ascetic and a learned scholar. A master of four Vedas is not dearer to me than a Candala''® devoted to me. Things can be given to and taken from him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If these eight traits are present even in an out- caste he is equal to a leading brahmin, a sage, a glorious ascetic and a learned scholar. A master of four Vedas is not dearer to me than a Candala''® devoted to me. Things can be given to and taken from him.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वाःस्थैः ससम्भ्रमैरेव देवो देव्यागमोत्सुकः । शङ्कमाना प्रविष्टान्तस्तं च सा समपश्यत
verses.transliteration: dvāḥsthaiḥ sasambhramaireva devo devyāgamotsukaḥ | śaṅkamānā praviṣṭāntastaṃ ca sā samapaśyata
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the eternal Dharma of widows. Holy rites, charitable gifts, penance, purity, lying on the bare ground, taking food only at night, celibacy, ash- bath, water-bath, quietness, silence, forbearance, self-composure in accordance with injunctions, observance of fasts on the eighth, eleventh and fourteenth days and on the full moon days and worship to me. Thus I have succinctly mentioned the eternal virtues of persons of diiferen stages and castes, of brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, ascetics, Brahmacarins, vanaprasthas, householders, iSudras and women, O gentle lady.
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall mention the eternal Dharma of widows. Holy rites, charitable gifts, penance, purity, lying on the bare ground, taking food only at night, celibacy, ash- bath, water-bath, quietness, silence, forbearance, self-composure in accordance with injunctions,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall mention the eternal Dharma of widows. Holy rites, charitable gifts, penance, purity, lying on the bare ground, taking food only at night, celibacy, ash- bath, water-bath, quietness, silence, forbearance, self-composure in accordance with injunctions,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तैः प्रणयभावैश्च भवनान्तरवर्तिभिः । गणेन्द्रैर्वन्दिता वाचा प्रणनाम त्रियम्बकम्
verses.transliteration: taistaiḥ praṇayabhāvaiśca bhavanāntaravartibhiḥ | gaṇendrairvanditā vācā praṇanāma triyambakam
verses.translation: O goddess, I shall be meditated upon along with you for ever. The Japa of six syllables'' shall be performed always. This is the brief compendium of duties as mentioned in the Vedas. 2®*
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, I shall be meditated upon along with you for ever. The Japa of six syllables'' shall be performed always. This is the brief compendium of duties as mentioned in the Vedas. 2®*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य नोत्थिता यावत्तावत्तां परमेश्वरः । प्रगृह्य दोर्भ्यामाश्लिष्य परितः परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: praṇamya notthitā yāvattāvattāṃ parameśvaraḥ | pragṛhya dorbhyāmāśliṣya paritaḥ parayā mudā
verses.translation: Those who possess excellent devotion as a result of good impressions in their souls of previous actions, who possess the physical bodies assumed by themselves, who are purified by the essence of my perfect knowledge and who have become holy due to my grace are not effected by sins as the lotus-leaves are not effected by water whether they be attached to it or not. It may not be possible for them to maintain the duties of the different stages in life. They have neither duties to be performed nor evils to be avoided. They have no trance to be practised, no great goal to be attained. They are not subject to do's and dont's like me.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who possess excellent devotion as a result of good impressions in their souls of previous actions, who possess the physical bodies assumed by themselves,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who possess excellent devotion as a result of good impressions in their souls of previous actions, who possess the physical bodies assumed by themselves,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वाङ्के धर्तुं प्रवृत्तोऽपि सा पर्यङ्के न्यषीदत । पर्यङ्कतो बलाद्देवीं सोऽङ्कमारोप्य सुस्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: svāṅke dhartuṃ pravṛtto'pi sā paryaṅke nyaṣīdata | paryaṅkato balāddevīṃ so'ṅkamāropya susmitām
verses.translation: Just as I have nothing to be achieved since I am perfect, so also they have nothing to be attained because they are contented. It is undoubtedly so.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as I have nothing to be achieved since I am perfect, so also they have nothing to be attained because they are contented. It is undoubtedly so.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सस्मितो विवृतैर्नेत्रैस्तद्वक्त्रं प्रपिबन्निव । तया सम्भाषणायेशः पूर्वभाषितमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sasmito vivṛtairnetraistadvaktraṃ prapibanniva | tayā sambhāṣaṇāyeśaḥ pūrvabhāṣitamabravīt
verses.translation: Just as my injunctions make Brahma and others act so also their injunctions make other men act.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as my injunctions make Brahma and others act so also their injunctions make other men act.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव उवाच । सा दशा च व्यतीता किं तव सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि । यस्यामनुनयोपायः कोऽपि कोपान्न लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: devadeva uvāca | sā daśā ca vyatītā kiṃ tava sarvāṅgasundari | yasyāmanunayopāyaḥ ko'pi kopānna labhyate
verses.translation: Their sins are quelled by their very vision in view of their excellence of good piety and in view of their carrying out my behests.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their sins are quelled by their very vision in view of their excellence of good piety and in view of their carrying out my behests.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छयापि न कालीति नान्यवर्णवतीति च । त्वत्स्वभावहृतं चित्तं सुभ्रु चिन्तावहं मम
verses.transliteration: svecchayāpi na kālīti nānyavarṇavatīti ca | tvatsvabhāvahṛtaṃ cittaṃ subhru cintāvahaṃ mama
verses.translation: O goddess, the knowledge of generations is in¬ accessible to those who are not my devotees, who are devoid of
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, the knowledge of generations is in¬ accessible to those who are not my devotees, who are devoid of
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विस्मृतः परमो भावः कथं स्वेच्छाङ्गयोगतः । न सम्भवन्ति ये तत्र चित्तकालुष्यहेतवः
verses.transliteration: vismṛtaḥ paramo bhāvaḥ kathaṃ svecchāṅgayogataḥ | na sambhavanti ye tatra cittakāluṣyahetavaḥ
verses.translation: The YogSearya incarnations of iiva arc recounted in the previous chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The YogSearya incarnations of iiva arc recounted in the previous chapter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्जनवदन्योऽन्यं विप्रियस्यापि कारणम् । आवयोरपि यद्यस्ति नास्त्येवैतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthagjanavadanyo'nyaṃ vipriyasyāpi kāraṇam | āvayorapi yadyasti nāstyevaitaccarācaram
verses.translation: The Yoga that removes previous sins, belongs only to the unattached who has conquered the group of sense- organs by restraints and observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yoga that removes previous sins, belongs only to the unattached who has conquered the group of sense- organs by restraints and observances.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहमग्निशिरोनिष्ठस्त्वं सोमशिरसि स्थिता । अग्नीषोमात्मकं विश्वमावाभ्यां समधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: ahamagniśironiṣṭhastvaṃ somaśirasi sthitā | agnīṣomātmakaṃ viśvamāvābhyāṃ samadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Detachment gives birth to knowledge. Knowledge facilitates the functioning of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Detachment gives birth to knowledge. Knowledge facilitates the functioning of Yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगद्धिताय चरतोः स्वेच्छाधृतशरीरयोः । आवयोर्विप्रयोगे हि स्यान्निरालम्बनं जगत्
verses.transliteration: jagaddhitāya caratoḥ svecchādhṛtaśarīrayoḥ | āvayorviprayoge hi syānnirālambanaṃ jagat
verses.translation: One conversant with Yoga, though fallen, is surely liberated. The following shall be carefully maintained. Mercy shall be practised along with non-violence. Knowledge shall be acquired. Truth, non-stealing, faith in scriptures and God, self-restraint, teaching, studying, performing sacrifice, presiding over sacrifice, meditation, piety towards God and practice of knowledge. A brahmin who follows all these for the acquisition of the path of knowledge, attains perfect knowledge ere long and secures Yoga top. O beloved, the wise devotee burns the physical body in a trice with the fire of knowledge. Due to my grace, the devotee conversant with Yoga eschews the bondage of the Karmans. Karman is in the nature of both merit and demerit. Both these are hindrances to liberation. The Yogin shall eschew both the merit and demerit.
verses.wordMeaning: One conversant with Yoga, though fallen, is surely liberated. The following shall be carefully maintained. Mercy shall be practised along with non-violence. Knowledge shall be acquired. Truth, non-stealing, faith in scriptures and God, self-restraint, teaching, studying,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One conversant with Yoga, though fallen, is surely liberated. The following shall be carefully maintained. Mercy shall be practised along with non-violence. Knowledge shall be acquired. Truth, non-stealing, faith in scriptures and God, self-restraint, teaching, studying,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति हेत्वन्तरं चात्र शास्त्रयुक्तिविनिश्चितम् । वागर्थमिव चैवैतज्जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: asti hetvantaraṃ cātra śāstrayuktiviniścitam | vāgarthamiva caivaitajjagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: O beloved, at the outset the devotee shall worship me externally by means of Karmayajfia. Then he shall resort to the path of knowledge. Afterwards he shall practise Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, at the outset the devotee shall worship me externally by means of Karmayajfia. Then he shall resort to the path of knowledge. Afterwards he shall practise Yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि वागमृतं साक्षादहमर्थामृतं परम् । द्वयमप्यमृतं कस्माद्वियुक्तमुपपद्यते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi vāgamṛtaṃ sākṣādahamarthāmṛtaṃ param | dvayamapyamṛtaṃ kasmādviyuktamupapadyate
verses.translation: The Yogins who have understood my innate nature by karma-yajfia and who view a clod of earth, a pebble and a gold ingot all alike do not worship me further.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogins who have understood my innate nature by karma-yajfia and who view a clod of earth, a pebble and a gold ingot all alike do not worship me further.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्याप्रत्यायिका त्वं मे वेद्योऽहं प्रत्ययात्तव । विद्यावेद्यात्मनोरेव विश्लेषः कथमावयोः
verses.transliteration: vidyāpratyāyikā tvaṃ me vedyo'haṃ pratyayāttava | vidyāvedyātmanoreva viśleṣaḥ kathamāvayoḥ
verses.translation: A Yogin engaged in the path of knowledge, an excellent sage permanently engaged in Yoga, my devotee enriched by purity of mind, shall attain my Sayujya.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Yogin engaged in the path of knowledge, an excellent sage permanently engaged in Yoga, my devotee enriched by purity of mind, shall attain my Sayujya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न कर्मणा सृजामीदं जगत्प्रतिसृजामि च । सर्वस्याज्ञैकलभ्यत्वादाज्ञात्वं हि गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: na karmaṇā sṛjāmīdaṃ jagatpratisṛjāmi ca | sarvasyājñaikalabhyatvādājñātvaṃ hi garīyasī
verses.translation: Those who have not had sufficient detachment in their minds but have resorted to me are authorised only in Jfiana, Carya and Kriya according to their deserts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have not had sufficient detachment in their minds but have resorted to me are authorised only in Jfiana, Carya and Kriya according to their deserts.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञैकसारमैश्वर्यं यस्मात्स्वातन्त्र्यलक्षणम् । आज्ञया विप्रयुक्तस्य चैश्वर्यं मम कीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: ājñaikasāramaiśvaryaṃ yasmātsvātantryalakṣaṇam | ājñayā viprayuktasya caiśvaryaṃ mama kīdṛśam
verses.translation: My worship shall be known to be two-fold: ex¬ ternal and internal. My adorative service is three-fold, differ¬ ing in view of speech, mind and body.
verses.commentary: Sense: My worship shall be known to be two-fold: ex¬ ternal and internal. My adorative service is three-fold, differ¬ ing in view of speech, mind and body.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न कदाचिदवस्थानमावयोर्विप्रयुक्तयोः । देवानां कार्यमुद्दिश्य लीलोक्तिं कृतवानहम्
verses.transliteration: na kadācidavasthānamāvayorviprayuktayoḥ | devānāṃ kāryamuddiśya līloktiṃ kṛtavānaham
verses.translation: O gentle lady, stability in the Tattvas shall be practised beginning with an external or internal object where the mind feels interested urged by previous impressions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, stability in the Tattvas shall be practised beginning with an external or internal object where the mind feels interested urged by previous impressions.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वयाप्यविदितं नास्ति कथं कुपितवत्यसि । ततस्त्रिलोकरक्षार्थे कोपो मय्यपि ते कृतः
verses.transliteration: tvayāpyaviditaṃ nāsti kathaṃ kupitavatyasi | tatastrilokarakṣārthe kopo mayyapi te kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O gentle lady, the adorative service whether ex¬ ternal or internal shall be attended with devotion. If devoid of devotion, it is the cause of deceit.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, the adorative service whether ex¬ ternal or internal shall be attended with devotion. If devoid of devotion, it is the cause of deceit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदनर्थाय भूतानां न तदस्ति खलु त्वयि । इति प्रियंवदे साक्षादीश्वरे परमेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: yadanarthāya bhūtānāṃ na tadasti khalu tvayi | iti priyaṃvade sākṣādīśvare parameśvare
verses.translation: I am content and pure. What shall be done unto me by men? Externally or internally only devotion is taken into consideration by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am content and pure. What shall be done unto me by men? Externally or internally only devotion is taken into consideration by me.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गारभावसाराणां जन्मभूमिरकृत्रिमा । स्वभर्त्रा ललितं तथ्यमुक्तं मत्वा स्मितोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgārabhāvasārāṇāṃ janmabhūmirakṛtrimā | svabhartrā lalitaṃ tathyamuktaṃ matvā smitottaram
verses.translation: O goddess, resorting to me with the fruit in view is easily feasible since the seeker of the fruit can abandon me in case there is no desired fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, resorting to me with the fruit in view is easily feasible since the seeker of the fruit can abandon me in case there is no desired fruit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लज्जया न किमप्यूचे कौशिकी वर्णनात्परम् । तदेव वर्णयाम्यद्य शृणु देव्याश्च वर्णनम्
verses.transliteration: lajjayā na kimapyūce kauśikī varṇanātparam | tadeva varṇayāmyadya śṛṇu devyāśca varṇanam
verses.translation: O pious lady, I am the bestower of fruits in accor¬ dance with the extent of devotion even to him who, though seeking fruits, keeps his mind well established in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O pious lady, I am the bestower of fruits in accor¬ dance with the extent of devotion even to him who, though seeking fruits, keeps his mind well established in me.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । किं देवेन न सा दृष्टा या सृष्टा कौशिकी मया । तादृशी कन्यका लोके न भूता न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | kiṃ devena na sā dṛṣṭā yā sṛṣṭā kauśikī mayā | tādṛśī kanyakā loke na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Those devotees are dearer to me whose minds are attached to me without reference to fruits but who may later on solicit for favours.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees are dearer to me whose minds are attached to me without reference to fruits but who may later on solicit for favours.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्या वीर्यं बलं विन्ध्यनिलयं विजयं तथा । शुम्भस्य च निशुम्भस्य मारणे च रणे तयोः
verses.transliteration: tasyā vīryaṃ balaṃ vindhyanilayaṃ vijayaṃ tathā | śumbhasya ca niśumbhasya māraṇe ca raṇe tayoḥ
verses.translation: Dearer unto me are those who resort to me with abject helplessness, unmindful of fruition or otherwise due to the impressions of previous actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dearer unto me are those who resort to me with abject helplessness, unmindful of fruition or otherwise due to the impressions of previous actions.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षफलदानं च लोकाय भजते सदा । लोकानां रक्षणं शश्वद् ब्रह्मा विज्ञापयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaphaladānaṃ ca lokāya bhajate sadā | lokānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ śaśvad brahmā vijñāpayiṣyati
verses.translation: Verily, they do not acquire any further gain than acquiring me. O goddess, my gain too is nothing else but acquiring them into my fold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verily, they do not acquire any further gain than acquiring me. O goddess, my gain too is nothing else but acquiring them into my fold.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इति सम्भाषमाणाया देव्या एवाज्ञया तदा । व्याघ्रः सख्या समानीय पुरोऽवस्थापितस्तदा
verses.transliteration: iti sambhāṣamāṇāyā devyā evājñayā tadā | vyāghraḥ sakhyā samānīya puro'vasthāpitastadā
verses.translation: Their piety dedicated unto me due to my blessing is compelled to bestow the fruit on them, the fruit being the great beatitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their piety dedicated unto me due to my blessing is compelled to bestow the fruit on them, the fruit being the great beatitude.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रेक्ष्याह पुनर्देवी देवानीतमुपायतम् । व्याघ्रं पश्य न चानेन सदृशो मदुपासकः
verses.transliteration: taṃ prekṣyāha punardevī devānītamupāyatam | vyāghraṃ paśya na cānena sadṛśo madupāsakaḥ
verses.translation: They mention %bout eight traits for those authorised in Dharma, the noble souls who have dedicated their minds unto me without having recourse to anyone else, those who have favourable disposition to my devotees, who encourage my worship, or offer worship to me themselves or perform all activities of the body for my sake or have interest in listening to my stories, flutter in tones, eyes and limbs, remember me perpetually or surrender to me completely.
verses.wordMeaning: They mention %bout eight traits for those authorised in Dharma, the noble souls who have dedicated their minds unto me without having recourse to anyone else, those who have favourable disposition to my devotees, who encourage my worship,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They mention %bout eight traits for those authorised in Dharma, the noble souls who have dedicated their minds unto me without having recourse to anyone else, those who have favourable disposition to my devotees, who encourage my worship,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन दुष्टसङ्घेभ्यो रक्षितं मत्तपोवनम् । अतीव मम भक्तश्च विश्रब्धश्च स्वरक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: anena duṣṭasaṅghebhyo rakṣitaṃ mattapovanam | atīva mama bhaktaśca viśrabdhaśca svarakṣaṇāt
verses.translation: O goddes!5, I shall now succinctly mention the duties stipulated on the basis of caste for my authorised devotees, the learned brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddes!5, I shall now succinctly mention the duties stipulated on the basis of caste for my authorised devotees, the learned brahmins.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेशं च परित्यज्य प्रसादार्थं समागतः । यदि प्रीतिरभून्मत्तः परां प्रीतिं करोषि मे
verses.transliteration: svadeśaṃ ca parityajya prasādārthaṃ samāgataḥ | yadi prītirabhūnmattaḥ parāṃ prītiṃ karoṣi me
verses.translation: Daily bath thrice, rites in the holy fire, worship of the Lihga, charitable gifts, pious feelings for the lord, mer¬ cifulness everywhere at all times, truthfulness, contentedness, belief in scriptures and God, non-violence to all living beings, bashful modesty, faith, study of scriptures, Yoga, imparting of knowledge to others, commenting on scriptures, celibacy, listening to spiritual topics, austerities, forbearance, purity, wearing of the sacred thread, upper garment and turban,
verses.wordMeaning: Daily bath thrice, rites in the holy fire, worship of the Lihga, charitable gifts, pious feelings for the lord, mer¬ cifulness everywhere at all times, truthfulness, contentedness, belief in scriptures and God, non-violence to all living beings, bashful modesty, faith,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Daily bath thrice, rites in the holy fire, worship of the Lihga, charitable gifts, pious feelings for the lord, mer¬ cifulness everywhere at all times, truthfulness, contentedness, belief in scriptures and God, non-violence to all living beings, bashful modesty, faith,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नित्यमन्तःपुरद्वारि नियोगान्नन्दिनः स्वयम् । रक्षिभिः सह तच्चिह्नैर्वर्ततामयमीश्वर
verses.transliteration: nityamantaḥpuradvāri niyogānnandinaḥ svayam | rakṣibhiḥ saha taccihnairvartatāmayamīśvara
verses.translation: The avoidance of wine and even its smell or of Naivedya is applicable to all castes, especially the Brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The avoidance of wine and even its smell or of Naivedya is applicable to all castes, especially the Brahmins.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । मधुरं प्रणयोदर्कं श्रुत्वा देव्याः शुभं वचः । प्रीतोऽस्मीत्याह तं देवः स चादृश्यत तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | madhuraṃ praṇayodarkaṃ śrutvā devyāḥ śubhaṃ vacaḥ | prīto'smītyāha taṃ devaḥ sa cādṛśyata tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: The traits of Yogins are ten viz: — forbearance, quietude, contentment, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, my knowledge, non-attachment to worldly objects, using Bhasma and refraining from too much adherence to all. The Vanaprasthas have all these traits as also the partaking of alms during the day. The Brahmacarins shall not take food during the nights.
verses.wordMeaning: The traits of Yogins are ten viz: — forbearance, quietude, contentment, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, my knowledge, non-attachment to worldly objects, using Bhasma and refraining from too much adherence to all.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The traits of Yogins are ten viz: — forbearance, quietude, contentment, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, my knowledge, non-attachment to worldly objects, using Bhasma and refraining from too much adherence to all.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिभ्रद्वेत्रलतां हैमीं रत्नचित्रं च कञ्चुकम् । छुरिकामुरगप्रख्यां गणेशो रक्षवेषधृक्
verses.transliteration: bibhradvetralatāṃ haimīṃ ratnacitraṃ ca kañcukam | churikāmuragaprakhyāṃ gaṇeśo rakṣaveṣadhṛk
verses.translation: Teaching, presiding over sacrifices and acceptance of monetary gifts are not prescribed by me for the Ksatriya and the Vaisya class.
verses.commentary: Sense: Teaching, presiding over sacrifices and acceptance of monetary gifts are not prescribed by me for the Ksatriya and the Vaisya class.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्सोमो महादेवो नन्दी चानेन नन्दितः । सोमनन्दीति विख्यातस्तस्मादेष समाख्यया
verses.transliteration: yasmātsomo mahādevo nandī cānena nanditaḥ | somanandīti vikhyātastasmādeṣa samākhyayā
verses.translation: The following are the duties and traits of kings — protection of the people of all castes, slaying of the enemies in battle, chastisement of the wicked and hunting of harmful birds and animals, distrusting everyone everywhere but belief in my Yogins, intercourse with women on proper occasions, maintenance of armies, keeping themselves well informed about the activities of the people through spies spread every¬ where always, wearing weapons, armour dusted with Bhasma. These are in brief the duties of kings following my instruc¬ tions. The characteristics of a Vaisya are cattle-breeding, trad¬ ing and agriculture.
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the duties and traits of kings — protection of the people of all castes, slaying of the enemies in battle, chastisement of the wicked and hunting of harmful birds and animals, distrusting everyone everywhere but belief in my Yogins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the duties and traits of kings — protection of the people of all castes, slaying of the enemies in battle, chastisement of the wicked and hunting of harmful birds and animals, distrusting everyone everywhere but belief in my Yogins,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं देव्याः प्रियं कृत्वा देवश्चार्द्धेन्दुभूषणः । भूषयामास तं दिव्यैर्भूषणै रत्नभूषितैः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ devyāḥ priyaṃ kṛtvā devaścārddhendubhūṣaṇaḥ | bhūṣayāmāsa taṃ divyairbhūṣaṇai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ
verses.translation: Sexual approach only to one's own wife duly wed is prescribed for a householder and celibacy for all the other three, viz. Brahmacarins, Vanaprasthas and Sannyasins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sexual approach only to one's own wife duly wed is prescribed for a householder and celibacy for all the other three, viz. Brahmacarins, Vanaprasthas and Sannyasins.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स गौरीं गिरिशो गिरीन्द्रजां सगौरवां सर्वमनोहरां हरः । पर्यङ्कमारोप्य वराङ्गभूषणै- र्विभूषयामास शशाङ्कभूषणः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa gaurīṃ giriśo girīndrajāṃ sagauravāṃ sarvamanoharāṃ haraḥ | paryaṅkamāropya varāṅgabhūṣaṇai- rvibhūṣayāmāsa śaśāṅkabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: If a woman engages herself in holy rites thereby prejudicing her service to her husband she goes to hell un¬ doubtedly.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a woman engages herself in holy rites thereby prejudicing her service to her husband she goes to hell un¬ doubtedly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Suddenly their bodies may throb and tremble; they may perspire, shed tears; their voice may grow hoarse or cracked; they may have a sensation of great bliss. This may recur again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suddenly their bodies may throb and tremble; they may perspire, shed tears; their voice may grow hoarse or cracked; they may have a sensation of great bliss. This may recur again and again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Suddenly their bodies may throb and tremble; they may perspire, shed tears; their voice may grow hoarse or cracked; they may have a sensation of great bliss. This may recur again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suddenly their bodies may throb and tremble; they may perspire, shed tears; their voice may grow hoarse or cracked; they may have a sensation of great bliss. This may recur again and again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । भस्मतत्त्ववर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । देवीं समादधानेन देवेनेदं किमीरितम् । अग्निषोमात्मकं विश्वं वागर्थात्मकमित्यपि
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.28. aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | bhasmatattvavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | devīṃ samādadhānena devenedaṃ kimīritam | agniṣomātmakaṃ viśvaṃ vāgarthātmakamityapi
verses.translation: The excellent men can be understood by these never- failing indications severally or collectively or by means of the pious feelings of the low, excellent and the middling types.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent men can be understood by these never- failing indications severally or collectively or by means of the pious feelings of the low, excellent and the middling types.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञैकसारमैश्वर्यमाज्ञात्वमिति चोदितम् । तदिदं श्रोतुमिच्छामो यथावदनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: ājñaikasāramaiśvaryamājñātvamiti coditam | tadidaṃ śrotumicchāmo yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall eschew in order the external and internal worships. Through Jnana he shall see the Jneya and then eschew the Jflana also.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall eschew in order the external and internal worships. Through Jnana he shall see the Jneya and then eschew the Jflana also.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । अग्निरित्युच्यते रौद्री घोरा या तैजसी तनुः । सोमः शाक्तोऽमृतमयः शक्तेः शान्तिकरी तनुः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | agnirityucyate raudrī ghorā yā taijasī tanuḥ | somaḥ śākto'mṛtamayaḥ śakteḥ śāntikarī tanuḥ
verses.translation: Persons who have fixed their minds in Siva, good men who have stabilised their intellect will have the great¬ est bliss everywhere both here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons who have fixed their minds in Siva, good men who have stabilised their intellect will have the great¬ est bliss everywhere both here and hereafter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अमृतं यत्प्रतिष्ठा सा तेजो विद्या कला स्वयम् । भूतसूक्ष्मेषु सर्वेषु त एव रसतेजसी
verses.transliteration: amṛtaṃ yatpratiṣṭhā sā tejo vidyā kalā svayam | bhūtasūkṣmeṣu sarveṣu ta eva rasatejasī
verses.translation: The six-syllabled mantra is found in the Veda and Sivagama. It facilitates the understanding of all topics by the devotees of Siva. It consists of very few syllables but is pregnant with meaning. It is the essence of the Vedas. It is conducive to salvation. This expression of auspicious nature is devoid of doubts. It is achieved by the order of Siva. It is attended by many Siddhis. It is divine and delightful to the mind. That expression 'lord Siva' is majestic and deci¬ sive in meaning.
verses.wordMeaning: The six-syllabled mantra is found in the Veda and Sivagama. It facilitates the understanding of all topics by the devotees of Siva. It consists of very few syllables but is pregnant with meaning. It is the essence of the Vedas. It is conducive to salvation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The six-syllabled mantra is found in the Veda and Sivagama. It facilitates the understanding of all topics by the devotees of Siva. It consists of very few syllables but is pregnant with meaning. It is the essence of the Vedas. It is conducive to salvation.…

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधा तेजसो वृत्तिः सूर्यात्मा चानलात्मिका । तथैव रसवृत्तिश्च सोमात्मा च जलात्मिका
verses.transliteration: dvividhā tejaso vṛttiḥ sūryātmā cānalātmikā | tathaiva rasavṛttiśca somātmā ca jalātmikā
verses.translation: The omniscient lord Siva mentioned the mantra, "Om Namah Sivaya" for the acquisition of all topics and mean¬ ings by the embodied beings since it can be easily uttered through the mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The omniscient lord Siva mentioned the mantra, "Om Namah Sivaya" for the acquisition of all topics and mean¬ ings by the embodied beings since it can be easily uttered through the mouth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्युदादिमयं तेजो मधुरादिमयो रसः । तेजोरसविभेदैस्तु धृतमेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: vidyudādimayaṃ tejo madhurādimayo rasaḥ | tejorasavibhedaistu dhṛtametaccarācaram
verses.translation: The first mantra consisting of six syllables is the seed of all lores. It is very subtle but serves a great purpose. It shall be known like the seed of the banyan tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first mantra consisting of six syllables is the seed of all lores. It is very subtle but serves a great purpose. It shall be known like the seed of the banyan tree.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेरमृतनिष्पत्तिरमृतेनाग्निरेधते । अत एव हि विक्रान्तमग्नीषोमं जगद्धितम्
verses.transliteration: agneramṛtaniṣpattiramṛtenāgniredhate | ata eva hi vikrāntamagnīṣomaṃ jagaddhitam
verses.translation: The omniscient lord, the creator of everything, the all-pervasive Siva who is beyond the three attributes, is statio¬ ned in the single-syllabled mantra Om.
verses.commentary: Sense: The omniscient lord, the creator of everything, the all-pervasive Siva who is beyond the three attributes, is statio¬ ned in the single-syllabled mantra Om.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हविषे सस्यसम्पत्तिर्वृष्टिः सस्याभिवृद्धये । वृष्टेरेव हविस्तस्मादग्नीषोमधृतं जगत्
verses.transliteration: haviṣe sasyasampattirvṛṣṭiḥ sasyābhivṛddhaye | vṛṣṭereva havistasmādagnīṣomadhṛtaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The five subtle Brahmans arc stationed in the mantra "Namah Sivaya" occupying one syllable each. Thus in the six-syllabled subtle mantra, Siva in the form of Pafica Brahmans®* is stationed in the way of Expressed and Expressive. Innately Siva is 'Expressed' and the mantra is 'Expressive* due to its comprehensibility.
verses.wordMeaning: The five subtle Brahmans arc stationed in the mantra "Namah Sivaya" occupying one syllable each. Thus in the six-syllabled subtle mantra, Siva in the form of Pafica Brahmans®* is stationed in the way of Expressed and Expressive.…

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरूर्ध्वं ज्वलत्येष यावत्सौम्यं परामृतम् । यावदग्न्यास्पदं सौम्यममृतं च स्रवत्यधः
verses.transliteration: agnirūrdhvaṃ jvalatyeṣa yāvatsaumyaṃ parāmṛtam | yāvadagnyāspadaṃ saumyamamṛtaṃ ca sravatyadhaḥ
verses.translation: See Vayu II. 3. 5.; SRS i. 36.
verses.commentary: Sense: See Vayu II. 3. 5.; SRS i. 36.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अत एव हि कालाग्निरधस्ताच्छक्तिरूर्ध्वतः । यावदादहनं चोर्ध्वमधश्चाप्लावनं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ata eva hi kālāgniradhastācchaktirūrdhvataḥ | yāvadādahanaṃ cordhvamadhaścāplāvanaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Just as anir on piece in conjunction with the fire is no mere iron piece so also they arc not mere human beings. Thanks to my grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as anir on piece in conjunction with the fire is no mere iron piece so also they arc not mere human beings. Thanks to my grace.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्त्यैव धृतः कालाग्निरयमूर्ध्वगः । तथैव निम्नगः सोमः शिवशक्तिपदास्पदः
verses.transliteration: ādhāraśaktyaiva dhṛtaḥ kālāgnirayamūrdhvagaḥ | tathaiva nimnagaḥ somaḥ śivaśaktipadāspadaḥ
verses.translation: A learned man shall not treat these Rudras with
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned man shall not treat these Rudras with

verses.sanskrit: शिवश्चोर्ध्वमधः शक्तिरूर्ध्वं शक्तिरधः शिवः । तदित्थं शिवशक्तिभ्यां नाव्याप्तमिह किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: śivaścordhvamadhaḥ śaktirūrdhvaṃ śaktiradhaḥ śivaḥ | taditthaṃ śivaśaktibhyāṃ nāvyāptamiha kiñcana
verses.translation: Insult offered to them by men of confusixl intellect quells glory, longevity, family and conduct and may cause their fall into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Insult offered to them by men of confusixl intellect quells glory, longevity, family and conduct and may cause their fall into hell.

verses.sanskrit: असकृच्चाग्निना दग्धं जगद्यद्भस्मसात्कृतम् । अग्नेर्वीर्यमिदं चाहुस्तद्वीर्यं भस्म यत्ततः
verses.transliteration: asakṛccāgninā dagdhaṃ jagadyadbhasmasātkṛtam | agnervīryamidaṃ cāhustadvīryaṃ bhasma yattataḥ
verses.translation: All those regions except mine, i.e. those of Brahma, Visnu, Indra, and others who have been uprooted though they may be great souls, are easily to be destroyed like cotton. The prosperity of Buddhi, Prakrti, and Purusa is impure. Hence it shall be eschewed by those who are desi¬ rous of the region beyond Gunas. Of what avail is this talk? By whatever means it may be, fixing of the mind in

verses.sanskrit: यश्चेत्थं भस्मसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा स्नाति च भस्मना । अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैर्बद्धः पाशात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yaścetthaṃ bhasmasadbhāvaṃ jñātvā snāti ca bhasmanā | agnirityādibhirmantrairbaddhaḥ pāśātpramucyate
verses.translation: Thus the brief resume of essential knowledge has been expounded by lord Siva, the great Atman, for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the brief resume of essential knowledge has been expounded by lord Siva, the great Atman, for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर्वीर्यं तु यद्भस्म सोमेनाप्लावितं पुनः । अयोगयुक्त्या प्रकृतेरधिकाराय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: agnervīryaṃ tu yadbhasma somenāplāvitaṃ punaḥ | ayogayuktyā prakṛteradhikārāya kalpate
verses.translation: T.'he Vedas, Sastras, Itihasas, Puranas and other
verses.commentary: Sense: T.'he Vedas, Sastras, Itihasas, Puranas and other
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: योगयुक्त्या तु तद्भस्म प्लाव्यमानं समन्ततः । शाक्तेनामृतवर्षेण चाधिकारान्निवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: yogayuktyā tu tadbhasma plāvyamānaṃ samantataḥ | śāktenāmṛtavarṣeṇa cādhikārānnivartayet
verses.translation: This succinct account contains the six topics, viz., Jfiana, Jheya, Anustheya, Adhikara, Sadhana and Sadhya.
verses.commentary: Sense: This succinct account contains the six topics, viz., Jfiana, Jheya, Anustheya, Adhikara, Sadhana and Sadhya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतो मृत्युञ्जयायेत्थममृतप्लावनं सदा । शिवशक्त्यमृतस्पर्शे लब्धं येन कुतो मृतिः
verses.transliteration: ato mṛtyuñjayāyetthamamṛtaplāvanaṃ sadā | śivaśaktyamṛtasparśe labdhaṃ yena kuto mṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Jnana is the knowledge acquired from the preceptor. Jneya is the Pasa, Pasu and Pati. The Anustheya is the worship of the Lihga. It is the devotee who is autho¬ rised. Sadhana is liva's mantra and Sadhya is the equality with Siva. If one has the knowledge of the epitome of the six topics one has attained omniscience.
verses.wordMeaning: Jnana is the knowledge acquired from the preceptor. Jneya is the Pasa, Pasu and Pati. The Anustheya is the worship of the Lihga. It is the devotee who is autho¬ rised. Sadhana is liva's mantra and Sadhya is the equality with Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Jnana is the knowledge acquired from the preceptor. Jneya is the Pasa, Pasu and Pati. The Anustheya is the worship of the Lihga. It is the devotee who is autho¬ rised. Sadhana is liva's mantra and Sadhya is the equality with Siva.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद दहनं गुह्यं प्लावनं च यथोदितम् । अग्नीषोमपदं हित्वा न स भूयोऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: yo veda dahanaṃ guhyaṃ plāvanaṃ ca yathoditam | agnīṣomapadaṃ hitvā na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva externally at the outset by means of Karmayajfia with devotion and in accordance with one's affluence, the devotee shall afterwards be engaged in inner sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Siva externally at the outset by means of Karmayajfia with devotion and in accordance with one's affluence, the devotee shall afterwards be engaged in inner sacrifice.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवाग्निना तनुं दग्ध्वा शक्तिसौम्यामृतेन यः । प्लावयेद्योगमार्गेण सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: śivāgninā tanuṃ dagdhvā śaktisaumyāmṛtena yaḥ | plāvayedyogamārgeṇa so'mṛtatvāya kalpate
verses.translation: O Krsna, neither within nor without has he ever any duty, he who is contented with the nectar of knowledge and who has identified his Atman with Siva by means of his devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Krsna, neither within nor without has he ever any duty, he who is contented with the nectar of knowledge and who has identified his Atman with Siva by means of his devotion.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हृदि कृत्वेममर्थं वै देवेन समुदाहृतम् । अग्नीषोमात्मकं विश्वं जगदित्यनुरूपतः
verses.transliteration: hṛdi kṛtvemamarthaṃ vai devena samudāhṛtam | agnīṣomātmakaṃ viśvaṃ jagadityanurūpataḥ
verses.translation: Hence one shall fix the mind in Siva by some means or other without performing the rites or performing them internally or externally in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one shall fix the mind in Siva by some means or other without performing the rites or performing them internally or externally in order.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Siva too is beginningless and he is the releaser of persons from the worldly existence. Just as the medicine is naturally antagonistic to ailments so also Siva is antagoni¬ stic to the ills of worldly existence. If the lord of the uni¬ verse had not been in existence, the whole universe would have been gloomy, since the Prakrti is insentient and the Purusa is ignorant. Pradhana, the atom etc. are insentient. They never function as the makers themselves without an in¬ telligent cause. The instruction in virtue and evil, the bond¬ age and salvation, the activity of reflection — in view of all these things the first creation of men would not have been possible without the omniscient lord. Just as the patients will be devoid of joy and be distressed without the physician so also the people would be in distress without the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: Siva too is beginningless and he is the releaser of persons from the worldly existence. Just as the medicine is naturally antagonistic to ailments so also Siva is antagoni¬ stic to the ills of worldly existence. If the lord of the uni¬ verse had not been in existence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva too is beginningless and he is the releaser of persons from the worldly existence. Just as the medicine is naturally antagonistic to ailments so also Siva is antagoni¬ stic to the ills of worldly existence. If the lord of the uni¬ verse had not been in existence,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Siva too is beginningless and he is the releaser of persons from the worldly existence. Just as the medicine is naturally antagonistic to ailments so also Siva is antagoni¬ stic to the ills of worldly existence. If the lord of the uni¬ verse had not been in existence, the whole universe would have been gloomy, since the Prakrti is insentient and the Purusa is ignorant. Pradhana, the atom etc. are insentient. They never function as the makers themselves without an in¬ telligent cause. The instruction in virtue and evil, the bond¬ age and salvation, the activity of reflection — in view of all these things the first creation of men would not have been possible without the omniscient lord. Just as the patients will be devoid of joy and be distressed without the physician so also the people would be in distress without the lord.
