verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । वागर्थात्मकतत्त्ववर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । निवेदयामि जगतो वागर्थात्म्यं कृतं यथा । षडध्ववेदनं सम्यक् समासान्न तु विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.29. ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | vāgarthātmakatattvavarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | nivedayāmi jagato vāgarthātmyaṃ kṛtaṃ yathā | ṣaḍadhvavedanaṃ samyak samāsānna tu vistarāt
verses.translation: iva is devoid of beginning, middle and end. He is the lord innately pure, omniscient and perfect as mentioned in Saivite Agamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: iva is devoid of beginning, middle and end. He is the lord innately pure, omniscient and perfect as mentioned in Saivite Agamas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति कश्चिदशब्दार्थो नापि शब्दो निरर्थकः । ततो हि समये शब्दः सर्वः सर्वार्थबोधकः
verses.transliteration: nāsti kaścidaśabdārtho nāpi śabdo nirarthakaḥ | tato hi samaye śabdaḥ sarvaḥ sarvārthabodhakaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone has stabilised the Mantra "Oiii Namab Sivaya" by frequent practice, he has learnt all, heard all and performed all.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone has stabilised the Mantra "Oiii Namab Sivaya" by frequent practice, he has learnt all, heard all and performed all.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतेः परिणामोऽयं द्विधा शब्दार्थभावना । तामाहुः प्राकृतीं मूर्तिं शिवयोः परमात्मनोः
verses.transliteration: prakṛteḥ pariṇāmo'yaṃ dvidhā śabdārthabhāvanā | tāmāhuḥ prākṛtīṃ mūrtiṃ śivayoḥ paramātmanoḥ
verses.translation: Indeed he who worships me with the five-syllabled mantra becomes liberated if he is in bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed he who worships me with the five-syllabled mantra becomes liberated if he is in bondage.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शब्दात्मिका विभूतिर्या सा त्रिधा कथ्यते बुधैः । स्थूला सूक्ष्मा परा चेति स्थूला या श्रुतिगोचरा
verses.transliteration: śabdātmikā vibhūtiryā sā tridhā kathyate budhaiḥ | sthūlā sūkṣmā parā ceti sthūlā yā śrutigocarā
verses.translation: In order to enhance their achievement Brahma said to me 'O great lord, please bestow the power on my sons.'
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to enhance their achievement Brahma said to me 'O great lord, please bestow the power on my sons.'
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मा चिन्तामयी प्रोक्ता चिन्तया रहिता परा । या शक्तिः सा परा शक्तिः शिवतत्त्वसमाश्रया
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmā cintāmayī proktā cintayā rahitā parā | yā śaktiḥ sā parā śaktiḥ śivatattvasamāśrayā
verses.translation: Thus requested by him, I who had assumed five faces, mentioned the five syllables, to the lotus-born one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by him, I who had assumed five faces, mentioned the five syllables, to the lotus-born one.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानशक्तिसमायोगादिच्छोपोद्बलिका तथा । सर्वशक्तिसमष्ट्यात्मा शक्तितत्त्वसमाख्यया
verses.transliteration: jñānaśaktisamāyogādicchopodbalikā tathā | sarvaśaktisamaṣṭyātmā śaktitattvasamākhyayā
verses.translation: Accepting them with his five faces, the grandfather of the worlds understood me as the great lord, the expressive of great meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accepting them with his five faces, the grandfather of the worlds understood me as the great lord, the expressive of great meaning.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: समस्तकार्यजातस्य मूलप्रकृतितां गता । सैव कुण्डलिनी माया शुद्धाध्वपरमा सती
verses.transliteration: samastakāryajātasya mūlaprakṛtitāṃ gatā | saiva kuṇḍalinī māyā śuddhādhvaparamā satī
verses.translation: After understanding the process of its application in accordance with the rules, the patriarch who achieved the Mantra imparted it along with its meaning to his sons in the exact manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: After understanding the process of its application in accordance with the rules, the patriarch who achieved the Mantra imparted it along with its meaning to his sons in the exact manner.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा विभागस्वरूपैव षडध्वात्मा विजृम्भते । तत्र शब्दास्त्रयोऽध्वानस्त्रयश्चार्थाः समीरिताः
verses.transliteration: sā vibhāgasvarūpaiva ṣaḍadhvātmā vijṛmbhate | tatra śabdāstrayo'dhvānastrayaścārthāḥ samīritāḥ
verses.translation: After securing the excellent Mantra from him, they desired to propitiate me along the way indicated by him. There is a mountain Mujavat on the beautiful peak of Meru. It is my favourite resort, ever glorious and always guarded by my devotees. Eager to create the world they per¬ formed penance there for a thousand years according to the calculation of the gods, taking in only air.
verses.wordMeaning: After securing the excellent Mantra from him, they desired to propitiate me along the way indicated by him. There is a mountain Mujavat on the beautiful peak of Meru. It is my favourite resort, ever glorious and always guarded by my devotees.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing the excellent Mantra from him, they desired to propitiate me along the way indicated by him. There is a mountain Mujavat on the beautiful peak of Meru. It is my favourite resort, ever glorious and always guarded by my devotees.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामपि वै पुंसां नैजशुद्ध्यनुरूपतः । लयभोगाधिकाराः स्युः सर्वतत्त्वविभागतः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapi vai puṃsāṃ naijaśuddhyanurūpataḥ | layabhogādhikārāḥ syuḥ sarvatattvavibhāgataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing their devotion I appeared before them immediately and explained to them all the details, viz., the sage, metre, Kilaka, Bljaakti, deity, Nyasa, the six ancillaries, the limits of the quarters and their application. The aim was to multiply creation through the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing their devotion I appeared before them immediately and explained to them all the details, viz., the sage, metre, Kilaka, Bljaakti, deity, Nyasa, the six ancillaries, the limits of the quarters and their application. The aim was to multiply creation through the sages.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कलाभिस्तानि तत्त्वानि व्याप्तान्येव यथातथम् । परस्याः प्रकृतेरादौ पञ्चधा परिणामतः
verses.transliteration: kalābhistāni tattvāni vyāptānyeva yathātatham | parasyāḥ prakṛterādau pañcadhā pariṇāmataḥ
verses.translation: This mantra is a positive statement and not a parable. How can Siva, who is all-perfect, all-perva¬ sive, innately pure and who blesses the worlds, mention a false theory? As things stand by nature along with their virtues and flaws, and the fruits they are capable of producing, ow can the omniscient being mention untruth? Only one influenced )>y passion, ignorance and other flaws will speak untruth.
verses.wordMeaning: This mantra is a positive statement and not a parable. How can Siva, who is all-perfect, all-perva¬ sive, innately pure and who blesses the worlds, mention a false theory? As things stand by nature along with their virtues and flaws,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This mantra is a positive statement and not a parable. How can Siva, who is all-perfect, all-perva¬ sive, innately pure and who blesses the worlds, mention a false theory? As things stand by nature along with their virtues and flaws,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कलाश्च ता निवृत्त्याद्याः पर्य्याप्ता इति निश्चयः । मन्त्राध्वा च पदाध्वा च वर्णाध्वा चेति शब्दतः
verses.transliteration: kalāśca tā nivṛttyādyāḥ paryyāptā iti niścayaḥ | mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca varṇādhvā ceti śabdataḥ
verses.translation: Those two faults are not present in the lord. How can he then make a wrong statement? Surely therefore the expression that is uttered by iiva, the omniscient without any flaw, is authoritative.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those two faults are not present in the lord. How can he then make a wrong statement? Surely therefore the expression that is uttered by iiva, the omniscient without any flaw, is authoritative.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भुवनाध्वा च तत्त्वाध्वा कलाध्वा चार्थतः क्रमात् । अत्रान्योऽन्यं च सर्वेषां व्याप्यव्यापकतोच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhuvanādhvā ca tattvādhvā kalādhvā cārthataḥ kramāt | atrānyo'nyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vyāpyavyāpakatocyate
verses.translation: Hence, the statements of lord Siva shall be faith¬ fully considered by a learned man. In regard to merits and sins as they are, a person having no faith i' him falls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the statements of lord Siva shall be faith¬ fully considered by a learned man. In regard to merits and sins as they are, a person having no faith i' him falls.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राः सर्वे पदैर्व्याप्ता वाक्यभावात्पदानि च । वर्णैर्वर्णसमूहं हि पदमाहुर्विपश्चितः
verses.transliteration: mantrāḥ sarve padairvyāptā vākyabhāvātpadāni ca | varṇairvarṇasamūhaṃ hi padamāhurvipaścitaḥ
verses.translation: The good statements uttered by the sages quiet and calm for the achievement of heaven and salvation shall be considered 'sacred utterances,'
verses.commentary: Sense: The good statements uttered by the sages quiet and calm for the achievement of heaven and salvation shall be considered 'sacred utterances,'
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णास्तु भुवनैर्व्याप्तास्तेषां तेषूपलम्भनात् । भुवनान्यपि तत्त्वौघैरुत्पत्त्यान्तर्बहिष्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: varṇāstu bhuvanairvyāptāsteṣāṃ teṣūpalambhanāt | bhuvanānyapi tattvaughairutpattyāntarbahiṣkramāt
verses.translation: The utterances that are actuated by passion, hatred, falsehood, anger, lust and greediness are bad. They cause one's fall into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: The utterances that are actuated by passion, hatred, falsehood, anger, lust and greediness are bad. They cause one's fall into hell.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्तानि कारणैस्तत्त्वैरारब्धत्वादनेकशः । अन्तरादुत्थितानीह भुवनानि तु कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: vyāptāni kāraṇaistattvairārabdhatvādanekaśaḥ | antarādutthitānīha bhuvanāni tu kānicit
verses.translation: Even that ugly statement which on being heard brings in welfare and the destruction of lust etc,, should be considered auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even that ugly statement which on being heard brings in welfare and the destruction of lust etc,, should be considered auspicious.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पौराणिकानि चान्यानि विज्ञेयानि शिवागमे । साङ्ख्ययोगप्रसिद्धानि तत्त्वान्यपि च कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: paurāṇikāni cānyāni vijñeyāni śivāgame | sāṅkhyayogaprasiddhāni tattvānyapi ca kānicit
verses.translation: Although there ar many mantras, there is nothing like the holy mantra utteied by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although there ar many mantras, there is nothing like the holy mantra utteied by Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवशास्त्रप्रसिद्धानि ततोऽन्यान्यपि कृत्स्नशः । कलाभिस्तानि तत्त्वानि व्याप्तान्येव यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: śivaśāstraprasiddhāni tato'nyānyapi kṛtsnaśaḥ | kalābhistāni tattvāni vyāptānyeva yathātatham
verses.translation: The Vedas and Sastras along with their ancillaries are present in the six syllables. Hence there is no other mantra equal to this.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas and Sastras along with their ancillaries are present in the six syllables. Hence there is no other mantra equal to this.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परस्याः प्रकृतेरादौ पञ्चधा परिणामतः । कलाश्च ता निवृत्त्याद्या व्याप्ताः पञ्च यथोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: parasyāḥ prakṛterādau pañcadhā pariṇāmataḥ | kalāśca tā nivṛttyādyā vyāptāḥ pañca yathottaram
verses.translation: Whatever texts there are, the texts expounding Siva's knowledge, the repositories of lore, they are the com¬ mentaries of the succinct aphorism, the six-syllabled mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever texts there are, the texts expounding Siva's knowledge, the repositories of lore, they are the com¬ mentaries of the succinct aphorism, the six-syllabled mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यापिकातः पराशक्तिरविभक्ता षडध्वनाम् । परप्रकृतिभावस्य तत्सत्त्वाच्छिवतत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: vyāpikātaḥ parāśaktiravibhaktā ṣaḍadhvanām | paraprakṛtibhāvasya tatsattvācchivatattvataḥ
verses.translation: Of what avail are many mantras and Sastras full of details to one whose heart is firmly established in the mantra "Orii Namah Sivaya?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail are many mantras and Sastras full of details to one whose heart is firmly established in the mantra "Orii Namah Sivaya?"
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्त्यादि च पृथिव्यन्तं शिवतत्त्वसमुद्भवम् । व्याप्तमेकेन तेनैव मृदा कुम्भादिकं यथा
verses.transliteration: śaktyādi ca pṛthivyantaṃ śivatattvasamudbhavam | vyāptamekena tenaiva mṛdā kumbhādikaṃ yathā
verses.translation: A person steady in the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra is released from the cage of sins whether he be a l3udra, base-born, fool or a learned man.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person steady in the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra is released from the cage of sins whether he be a l3udra, base-born, fool or a learned man.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवं तत्परमं धाम यत्प्राप्यं षड्भिरध्वभिः । व्यापिकाऽव्यापिका शक्तिः पञ्चतत्त्वविशोधनात्
verses.transliteration: śaivaṃ tatparamaṃ dhāma yatprāpyaṃ ṣaḍbhiradhvabhiḥ | vyāpikā'vyāpikā śaktiḥ pañcatattvaviśodhanāt
verses.translation: O great lord, how are your devotees liberated in the defiled period of Kali, invincible and untransgressable, when the world is enveloped by the darkness of sin, when people are averse to the practice of holy rites, when the legitimate activities of different castes and stages in life have declined, when great danger is imminent, when the question of the rights of the people is involved in doubts, when deviation from duty is certain, when the continuity of spiri¬ tual instructions is broken and when the order of preceptors and disciples has disappeared?
verses.wordMeaning: O great lord, how are your devotees liberated in the defiled period of Kali, invincible and untransgressable, when the world is enveloped by the darkness of sin, when people are averse to the practice of holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O great lord, how are your devotees liberated in the defiled period of Kali, invincible and untransgressable, when the world is enveloped by the darkness of sin, when people are averse to the practice of holy rites,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्त्या रुद्रपर्यन्तं स्थितिरण्डस्य शोध्यते । प्रतिष्ठया तदूर्ध्वं तु यावदव्यक्तगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: nivṛttyā rudraparyantaṃ sthitiraṇḍasya śodhyate | pratiṣṭhayā tadūrdhvaṃ tu yāvadavyaktagocaram
verses.translation: Men of the Kali age are liberated when their souls are purified by devotion after resorting to my pleasing Mantra of five syllables.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men of the Kali age are liberated when their souls are purified by devotion after resorting to my pleasing Mantra of five syllables.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदूर्ध्वं विद्यया मध्ये यावद्विश्वेश्वरावधि । शान्त्या तदूर्ध्वम्मध्वान्ते विशुद्धिः शान्त्यतीतया
verses.transliteration: tadūrdhvaṃ vidyayā madhye yāvadviśveśvarāvadhi | śāntyā tadūrdhvammadhvānte viśuddhiḥ śāntyatītayā
verses.translation: My five-syllabled Mantra affords protection from the fear of worldly existence to those whose minds are inclined towards me although they may be of distorted outlook, greedy, deceitful, ruthless, ungrateful and defiled by unimagi¬ nable and inexpressible faults, mental, verbal and physical.
verses.wordMeaning: My five-syllabled Mantra affords protection from the fear of worldly existence to those whose minds are inclined towards me although they may be of distorted outlook, greedy, deceitful, ruthless, ungrateful and defiled by unimagi¬ nable and inexpressible faults, mental,…
verses.commentary: Sense: My five-syllabled Mantra affords protection from the fear of worldly existence to those whose minds are inclined towards me although they may be of distorted outlook, greedy, deceitful, ruthless, ungrateful and defiled by unimagi¬ nable and inexpressible faults, mental,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुः परमं व्योम परप्रकृतियोगतः । एतानि पञ्चतत्त्वानि यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yāmāhuḥ paramaṃ vyoma paraprakṛtiyogataḥ | etāni pañcatattvāni yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: O goddess, often I have promised that in this world even a fallen man may become liberated through this Mantra if he happens to be my devotee.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, often I have promised that in this world even a fallen man may become liberated through this Mantra if he happens to be my devotee.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैव सर्वमेवेदं द्रष्टव्यं खलु साधकैः । अध्वव्याप्तिमविज्ञाय शुद्धिं यः कर्तुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration: atraiva sarvamevedaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ khalu sādhakaiḥ | adhvavyāptimavijñāya śuddhiṃ yaḥ kartumicchati
verses.translation: If a fallen man does not deserve holy rites in any respect, the rites performed by him are conducive to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a fallen man does not deserve holy rites in any respect, the rites performed by him are conducive to hell.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स विप्रलम्भकः शुद्धेर्नालं प्रापयितुं फलम् । वृथा परिश्रमस्तस्य निरयायैव केवलम्
verses.transliteration: sa vipralambhakaḥ śuddhernālaṃ prāpayituṃ phalam | vṛthā pariśramastasya nirayāyaiva kevalam
verses.translation: Yes, surely, if the fallen man, under delusion, were to worship me with other mantras, excluding the five-syllabled one, he is sure to fall into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yes, surely, if the fallen man, under delusion, were to worship me with other mantras, excluding the five-syllabled one, he is sure to fall into hell.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिपातसमायोगादृते तत्त्वानि तत्त्वतः । तद्व्याप्तिस्तद्विवृद्धिश्च ज्ञातुमेवं न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: śaktipātasamāyogādṛte tattvāni tattvataḥ | tadvyāptistadvivṛddhiśca jñātumevaṃ na śakyate
verses.translation: Persons who live on water or air and those whose bodies are emaciated due to holy rites do not attain my region through those holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons who live on water or air and those whose bodies are emaciated due to holy rites do not attain my region through those holy rites.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिराज्ञा परा शैवी चिद्रूपा परमेश्वरी । शिवोऽधितिष्ठत्यखिलं यया कारणभूतया
verses.transliteration: śaktirājñā parā śaivī cidrūpā parameśvarī | śivo'dhitiṣṭhatyakhilaṃ yayā kāraṇabhūtayā
verses.translation: But he who worships me even once with devotion repeating the hve-syllabled mantra, attains my region through the weightiness of this Mantra alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who worships me even once with devotion repeating the hve-syllabled mantra, attains my region through the weightiness of this Mantra alone.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नात्मनो नैव मायैषा न विकारो विचारतः । न बन्धो नापि मुक्तिश्च बन्धमुक्तिविधायिनी
verses.transliteration: nātmano naiva māyaiṣā na vikāro vicārataḥ | na bandho nāpi muktiśca bandhamuktividhāyinī
verses.translation: Hence, penances, sacrifices, observances and holy rites are not equal to even a croreth part of the worship with the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, penances, sacrifices, observances and holy rites are not equal to even a croreth part of the worship with the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्यपराकाष्ठा शिवस्याव्यभिचारिणी । समानधर्मिणी तस्य तैस्तैर्भावैर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sarvaiśvaryaparākāṣṭhā śivasyāvyabhicāriṇī | samānadharmiṇī tasya taistairbhāvairviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He who worships me even once with the five- syllabled mantra with or without the Rudra mantra is libe¬ rated even if he is a fallen or a foolish man.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who worships me even once with the five- syllabled mantra with or without the Rudra mantra is libe¬ rated even if he is a fallen or a foolish man.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तयैव गृही सापि तेनैव गृहिणी सदा । तयोरपत्यं यत्कार्यं परप्रकृतिजं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sa tayaiva gṛhī sāpi tenaiva gṛhiṇī sadā | tayorapatyaṃ yatkāryaṃ paraprakṛtijaṃ jagat
verses.translation: O goddess, he who worships me with the six- syllabled or with the five-syllabled mantra, with the Vedic mantra as its ancillary, with devotion to me, is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, he who worships me with the six- syllabled or with the five-syllabled mantra, with the Vedic mantra as its ancillary, with devotion to me, is liberated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स कर्ता कारणं सेति तयोर्भेदो व्यवस्थितः । एक एव शिवः साक्षाद् द्विधाऽसौ समवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: sa kartā kāraṇaṃ seti tayorbhedo vyavasthitaḥ | eka eva śivaḥ sākṣād dvidhā'sau samavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: A fallen man or one not fallen can worship with this mantra. My devotee who has conquered anger may or may not be one who has attained me. One who has attained me is a billion times superior to one who has not attained. Hence one should try to attain me by worshipping me with this mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: A fallen man or one not fallen can worship with this mantra. My devotee who has conquered anger may or may not be one who has attained me. One who has attained me is a billion times superior to one who has not attained.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A fallen man or one not fallen can worship with this mantra. My devotee who has conquered anger may or may not be one who has attained me. One who has attained me is a billion times superior to one who has not attained.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसभावेन तयोर्भेद इत्यपि केचन । अपरे तु परा शक्तिः शिवस्य समवायिनी
verses.transliteration: strīpuṃsabhāvena tayorbheda ityapi kecana | apare tu parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī
verses.translation: He who worships me with this Mantra, being equipped with friendship and other attributes with devotion and celibacy attains similarity to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who worships me with this Mantra, being equipped with friendship and other attributes with devotion and celibacy attains similarity to me.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभेव भानोश्चिद्रूपा भिन्नैवेति व्यवस्थितः । तस्माच्छिवः परो हेतुस्तस्याज्ञा परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: prabheva bhānościdrūpā bhinnaiveti vyavasthitaḥ | tasmācchivaḥ paro hetustasyājñā parameśvarī
verses.translation: At the advent of dissolution when the mobile and immobile beings perish, everything becomes merged in its cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the advent of dissolution when the mobile and immobile beings perish, everything becomes merged in its cause.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तयैव प्रेरिता शैवी मूलप्रकृतिरव्यया । महामाया च माया च प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणेति च
verses.transliteration: tayaiva preritā śaivī mūlaprakṛtiravyayā | mahāmāyā ca māyā ca prakṛtistriguṇeti ca
verses.translation: O goddess, I am the only one staying then. There is no second one anywhere. Then all the Vedas, scriptures etc. are stationed in the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, I am the only one staying then. There is no second one anywhere. Then all the Vedas, scriptures etc. are stationed in the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधा कार्यभेदेन सा प्रसूते षडध्वनः । स वागर्थमयश्चाध्वा षड्विधो निखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: trividhā kāryabhedena sā prasūte ṣaḍadhvanaḥ | sa vāgarthamayaścādhvā ṣaḍvidho nikhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Protected by my Sakti they do not perish. The creation is evolved out of me differently through the Prakrti and the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Protected by my Sakti they do not perish. The creation is evolved out of me differently through the Prakrti and the Atman.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैव विस्तरं प्राहुः शास्त्रजातमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: asyaiva vistaraṃ prāhuḥ śāstrajātamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Then comes a subsidiary dissolution of the forms and attributes. Then lord Narayana assumes the physical body of Maya and lies on the serpent couch in the midst of the water. The five-faced lord Brahma born of his umbilical lotus becomes desirous of creating the three worlds. But having none to assist him he becomes incapable. Hence he creates at the outset the ten sages of unmeasured splendour, his mental sons.
verses.wordMeaning: Then comes a subsidiary dissolution of the forms and attributes. Then lord Narayana assumes the physical body of Maya and lies on the serpent couch in the midst of the water. The five-faced lord Brahma born of his umbilical lotus becomes desirous of creating the three worlds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then comes a subsidiary dissolution of the forms and attributes. Then lord Narayana assumes the physical body of Maya and lies on the serpent couch in the midst of the water. The five-faced lord Brahma born of his umbilical lotus becomes desirous of creating the three worlds.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Now I mention the form of this great mantra. The word 'Namah* shall be uttered at first. It shall be followed by the word 'Sivaya*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I mention the form of this great mantra. The word 'Namah* shall be uttered at first. It shall be followed by the word 'Sivaya*.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Now I mention the form of this great mantra. The word 'Namah* shall be uttered at first. It shall be followed by the word 'Sivaya*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I mention the form of this great mantra. The word 'Namah* shall be uttered at first. It shall be followed by the word 'Sivaya*.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वप्रश्नः । ऋषय ऊचुः । चरितानि विचित्राणि गृह्याणि गहनानि च । दुर्विज्ञेयानि देवैश्च मोहयन्ति मनांसि नः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.30. triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śivatattvapraśnaḥ | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | caritāni vicitrāṇi gṛhyāṇi gahanāni ca | durvijñeyāni devaiśca mohayanti manāṃsi naḥ
verses.translation: It is the goddess, my own expression coming out of my mouth at first. The goddess having the splendour of molten gold, plump, lifted-up breasts, four arms, three arees, and the crescent moon as the crest-jewel. Her hands are as tender as lotuses. She is gentle with the gestures of boon and protection; she is possessed of all characteristics. She is bedecked in ornaments. She is seated on a white lotus. Her tresses are blue and curly.
verses.wordMeaning: It is the goddess, my own expression coming out of my mouth at first. The goddess having the splendour of molten gold, plump, lifted-up breasts, four arms, three arees, and the crescent moon as the crest-jewel. Her hands are as tender as lotuses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the goddess, my own expression coming out of my mouth at first. The goddess having the splendour of molten gold, plump, lifted-up breasts, four arms, three arees, and the crescent moon as the crest-jewel. Her hands are as tender as lotuses.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोस्तत्त्वसम्बन्धे न दोष उपलभ्यते । चरितैः प्राकृतो भावस्तयोरपि विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: śivayostattvasambandhe na doṣa upalabhyate | caritaiḥ prākṛto bhāvastayorapi vibhāvyate
verses.translation: I have made certain rules governing my devotees who are not unduly helpless in regard to all sacred scrip¬ tures.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have made certain rules governing my devotees who are not unduly helpless in regard to all sacred scrip¬ tures.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादयोऽपि लोकानां सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तहेतवः । निग्रहानुग्रहौ प्राप्य शिवस्य वशवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: brahmādayo'pi lokānāṃ sṛṣṭisthityantahetavaḥ | nigrahānugrahau prāpya śivasya vaśavartinaḥ
verses.translation: He shall take bath, sit in a pleasing posture in a sacred spot. He shall meditate on me in his heart along with you and shall remember his preceptor. He shall sit facing the north or the east, observe silence and concentra¬ tion of the mind, purify the five principles by means of Dahana and Plavana rituals. He shall perform the Mantranyasa, make his body worthy and pure, meditate on us restraining Prana and Apana. He shall remember the respective place, form, sage, metre, the presiding deity, BIja, Sakti and the statement. Then he shall perform the Japa of the five-syllab¬ led mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall take bath, sit in a pleasing posture in a sacred spot. He shall meditate on me in his heart along with you and shall remember his preceptor. He shall sit facing the north or the east, observe silence and concentra¬ tion of the mind,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take bath, sit in a pleasing posture in a sacred spot. He shall meditate on me in his heart along with you and shall remember his preceptor. He shall sit facing the north or the east, observe silence and concentra¬ tion of the mind,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवः पुनर्न कस्यापि निग्रहानुग्रहास्पदम् । अतोऽनायत्तमैश्वर्यं तस्यैवेति विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ punarna kasyāpi nigrahānugrahāspadam | ato'nāyattamaiśvaryaṃ tasyaiveti viniścitam
verses.translation: They say that the Japa performed in a temple is a crore of times more efficacious. That performed in my presence is infinite number of times more efficacious. Japa in the presence of the sun, fire, preceptor, moon, lamp, water, brahmins and cows is commended. Sitting east of these is conducive to favourable control; south of these is of the same nature as black magic.
verses.wordMeaning: They say that the Japa performed in a temple is a crore of times more efficacious. That performed in my presence is infinite number of times more efficacious. Japa in the presence of the sun, fire, preceptor, moon, lamp, water, brahmins and cows is commended.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that the Japa performed in a temple is a crore of times more efficacious. That performed in my presence is infinite number of times more efficacious. Japa in the presence of the sun, fire, preceptor, moon, lamp, water, brahmins and cows is commended.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्येवमीदृशैश्वर्यं तत्तु स्वातन्त्र्यलक्षणम् । स्वभावसिद्धं चैतस्य मूर्तिमत्तास्पदं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yadyevamīdṛśaiśvaryaṃ tattu svātantryalakṣaṇam | svabhāvasiddhaṃ caitasya mūrtimattāspadaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Thus the mode of repeating this mantra of five syllables was explained to the goddess by lord Siva himself for the benefit of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the mode of repeating this mantra of five syllables was explained to the goddess by lord Siva himself for the benefit of the worlds.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न मूर्तिश्च स्वतन्त्रस्य घटते मूलहेतुना । मूर्तेरपि च कार्यत्वात्तत्सिद्धिः स्यादहैतुकी
verses.transliteration: na mūrtiśca svatantrasya ghaṭate mūlahetunā | mūrterapi ca kāryatvāttatsiddhiḥ syādahaitukī
verses.translation: The initiation of Siva is that whereby at the mere sight, touch and talk of the preceptor the individual soul gains immediately the consciousness quelling the bondage. It is twofold in view of the difference in the destruction of bondage, viz. acute and more acute.
verses.commentary: Sense: The initiation of Siva is that whereby at the mere sight, touch and talk of the preceptor the individual soul gains immediately the consciousness quelling the bondage. It is twofold in view of the difference in the destruction of bondage, viz. acute and more acute.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र परमो भावोऽपरमश्चान्य उच्यते । परमापरमौ भावौ कथमेकत्र सङ्गतौ
verses.transliteration: sarvatra paramo bhāvo'paramaścānya ucyate | paramāparamau bhāvau kathamekatra saṅgatau
verses.translation: The Sakti form of initiation coupled with know¬ ledge is performed by the preceptor with knowledge for his vision, after entering the body of the disciple along the path of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sakti form of initiation coupled with know¬ ledge is performed by the preceptor with knowledge for his vision, after entering the body of the disciple along the path of Yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निष्फलो हि स्वभावोऽस्य परमः परमात्मनः । स एव सकलः कस्मात्स्वभावो ह्यविपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: niṣphalo hi svabhāvo'sya paramaḥ paramātmanaḥ | sa eva sakalaḥ kasmātsvabhāvo hyaviparyayaḥ
verses.translation: The disciple receives blessing in respect of his lakti,* because the pursuit of Saivite virtue has that as the condition in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple receives blessing in respect of his lakti,* because the pursuit of Saivite virtue has that as the condition in brief.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावो विपरीतश्चेत्स्वतन्त्रः स्वेच्छया यदि । न करोति किमीशानो नित्यानित्यविपर्ययम्
verses.transliteration: svabhāvo viparītaścetsvatantraḥ svecchayā yadi | na karoti kimīśāno nityānityaviparyayam
verses.translation: Hence, observing the symbols for securing Sakti, the preceptor shall purify and consecrate the disciple either by knowledge or by means of rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, observing the symbols for securing Sakti, the preceptor shall purify and consecrate the disciple either by knowledge or by means of rites.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तात्मा सकलः कश्चित्स चान्यो निष्फलः शिवः । शिवेनाधिष्ठितश्चेति सर्वत्र लघु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: mūrtātmā sakalaḥ kaścitsa cānyo niṣphalaḥ śivaḥ | śivenādhiṣṭhitaśceti sarvatra laghu kathyate
verses.translation: She has five colours with beaming discs, viz., yellow, black, smoky, golden and red.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has five colours with beaming discs, viz., yellow, black, smoky, golden and red.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्यात्मैव तदा मूर्तिः शिवस्यास्य भवेदिति । तस्यां मूर्तौ मूर्तिमतोः पारतन्त्र्यं हि निश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: mūrtyātmaiva tadā mūrtiḥ śivasyāsya bhavediti | tasyāṃ mūrtau mūrtimatoḥ pāratantryaṃ hi niścitam
verses.translation: O good-faced lady, the sage of this mantra is Vamadeva; the metre is Pankti; the deity, I am myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O good-faced lady, the sage of this mantra is Vamadeva; the metre is Pankti; the deity, I am myself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा निरपेक्षेण मूर्तिः स्वीक्रियते कथम् । मूर्तिस्वीकरणं तस्मान्मूर्तौ साध्यफलेप्सया
verses.transliteration: anyathā nirapekṣeṇa mūrtiḥ svīkriyate katham | mūrtisvīkaraṇaṃ tasmānmūrtau sādhyaphalepsayā
verses.translation: The several individual sages of the letters are, O good lady, Gautama, Atri, Visvamitra, Angiras and Bharadvaja.
verses.commentary: Sense: The several individual sages of the letters are, O good lady, Gautama, Atri, Visvamitra, Angiras and Bharadvaja.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि स्वेच्छाशरीरत्वं स्वातन्त्र्यायोपपद्यते । स्वेच्छैव तादृशी पुंसां यस्मात्कर्मानुसारिणी
verses.transliteration: na hi svecchāśarīratvaṃ svātantryāyopapadyate | svecchaiva tādṛśī puṃsāṃ yasmātkarmānusāriṇī
verses.translation: The metres severally arc Gayatri, Anustup, Tristup, Brhati and Virat. The deities severally are Indra, Rudra, Visnu, Brahma and Skanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: The metres severally arc Gayatri, Anustup, Tristup, Brhati and Virat. The deities severally are Indra, Rudra, Visnu, Brahma and Skanda.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वीकर्तुं स्वेच्छया देहं हातुं च प्रभवन्त्युत । ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ताः किं ते कर्मातिवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: svīkartuṃ svecchayā dehaṃ hātuṃ ca prabhavantyuta | brahmādayaḥ piśācāntāḥ kiṃ te karmātivartinaḥ
verses.translation: As their places, my faces benning with the one in the east and ending with the one above are taken. They are identiHed with the letters **Na*' etc. in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: As their places, my faces benning with the one in the east and ending with the one above are taken. They are identiHed with the letters **Na*' etc. in order.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इच्छया देहनिर्माणमिन्द्रजालोपमं विदुः । अणिमादिगुणैश्वर्यवशीकारानतिक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: icchayā dehanirmāṇamindrajālopamaṃ viduḥ | aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryavaśīkārānatikramāt
verses.translation: The first, second and the fourth letters are Udatta. The fifth is Svarita and the third is Anudatta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first, second and the fourth letters are Udatta. The fifth is Svarita and the third is Anudatta.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपं दधद्विष्णुर्दधीचेन महर्षिणा । युध्यता समुपालब्धस्तद्रूपं दधता स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpaṃ dadhadviṣṇurdadhīcena maharṣiṇā | yudhyatā samupālabdhastadrūpaṃ dadhatā svayam
verses.translation: The letter "Na" is the head; **Mab" the tuft; "Si" the armour; "Va" the eye; **Ya" the missile. At the end of each letter shall be uttered — Namah, Svaha, Vaat, Hurh, Vauat, Phat.
verses.commentary: Sense: The letter "Na" is the head; **Mab" the tuft; "Si" the armour; "Va" the eye; **Ya" the missile. At the end of each letter shall be uttered — Namah, Svaha, Vaat, Hurh, Vauat, Phat.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्मादधिकस्यापि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । शरीरवत्तयान्यात्मसाधर्म्यं प्रतिभाति नः
verses.transliteration: sarvasmādadhikasyāpi śivasya paramātmanaḥ | śarīravattayānyātmasādharmyaṃ pratibhāti naḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall worship me with Japa, Homa, etc., mentally, verbally and physically through this Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall worship me with Japa, Homa, etc., mentally, verbally and physically through this Mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानुग्राहकं प्राहुः शिवं परमकारणम् । स निर्गृह्णाति देवानां सर्वानुग्राहकः कथम्
verses.transliteration: sarvānugrāhakaṃ prāhuḥ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam | sa nirgṛhṇāti devānāṃ sarvānugrāhakaḥ katham
verses.translation: Let it be in accordance with their intellect, in¬ junction in the scripture, time, inclination, capacity, wealth and their taste.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let it be in accordance with their intellect, in¬ junction in the scripture, time, inclination, capacity, wealth and their taste.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद बहुशो देवो ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः । शिवनिन्दां प्रकुर्वन्तं पुत्रेति कुमतेर्हठात्
verses.transliteration: ciccheda bahuśo devo brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ | śivanindāṃ prakurvantaṃ putreti kumaterhaṭhāt
verses.translation: O Goddess, my worship will lead to salvation when¬ ever, wherever and by whomsover it may be done if it is with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, my worship will lead to salvation when¬ ever, wherever and by whomsover it may be done if it is with devotion.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरपि नृसिंहस्य रभसा शरभाकृतिः । बिभेद पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य हृदयं नखरैः खरैः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇorapi nṛsiṃhasya rabhasā śarabhākṛtiḥ | bibheda padbhyāmākramya hṛdayaṃ nakharaiḥ kharaiḥ
verses.translation: There at the outset, I shall explain the procedure of practising the mantra without which the Japa is futile and with which it is fruitful.
verses.commentary: Sense: There at the outset, I shall explain the procedure of practising the mantra without which the Japa is futile and with which it is fruitful.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवस्त्रीषु च देवेषु दक्षस्याध्वरकारणात् । वीरेण वीरभद्रेण न हि कश्चिददण्डितः
verses.transliteration: devastrīṣu ca deveṣu dakṣasyādhvarakāraṇāt | vīreṇa vīrabhadreṇa na hi kaścidadaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: O good-faced lady, a Japa without the behest of the preceptor, holy rites, faith and the prescribed fees is fruitless though the behest might have been secured.
verses.commentary: Sense: O good-faced lady, a Japa without the behest of the preceptor, holy rites, faith and the prescribed fees is fruitless though the behest might have been secured.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरत्रयं च सस्त्रीकं सदैत्यं सह बालकैः । क्षणेनैकेन देवेन नेत्राग्नेरिन्धनीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: puratrayaṃ ca sastrīkaṃ sadaityaṃ saha bālakaiḥ | kṣaṇenaikena devena netrāgnerindhanīkṛtam
verses.translation: The devotee shall approach the brahmin preceptor who knows the principles, performs Japa, is devoted to meditation and endowed with virtues. He shall strenuously propitiate him mentally, verbally, physically and monetarily. He shall possess the purity of piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall approach the brahmin preceptor who knows the principles, performs Japa, is devoted to meditation and endowed with virtues. He shall strenuously propitiate him mentally, verbally, physically and monetarily. He shall possess the purity of piety.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां रतिहेतुश्च कामो रतिपतिः स्वयम् । क्रोशतामेव देवानां हुतो नेत्रहुताशने
verses.transliteration: prajānāṃ ratihetuśca kāmo ratipatiḥ svayam | krośatāmeva devānāṃ huto netrahutāśane
verses.translation: /V brahmin devotee shall worship the preceptor always strenuously. If he is affluent he shall present devoutly to his preceptor excellent horses, elephants chariots, ornaments, garments, grain and riches.
verses.commentary: Sense: /V brahmin devotee shall worship the preceptor always strenuously. If he is affluent he shall present devoutly to his preceptor excellent horses, elephants chariots, ornaments, garments, grain and riches.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गावश्च कश्चिद्दुग्धौघं स्रवन्त्यो मूर्ध्नि खेचराः । सरुषा प्रेक्ष्य देवेन तत्क्षणे भस्मसात्कृताः
verses.transliteration: gāvaśca kaściddugdhaughaṃ sravantyo mūrdhni khecarāḥ | saruṣā prekṣya devena tatkṣaṇe bhasmasātkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He shall not be stringent about money if he desires to achieve Siddhi for himself. Dedicating himself thereafter along with his possessions to the preceptor and after undeceit- fully worshipping him to his capacity, he shall learn the mantra and derive knowledge in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not be stringent about money if he desires to achieve Siddhi for himself. Dedicating himself thereafter along with his possessions to the preceptor and after undeceit- fully worshipping him to his capacity, he shall learn the mantra and derive knowledge in due order.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरासुरो दीर्णश्चक्रीकृत्य जलं पदा । बद्ध्वानन्तेन यो विष्णुं चिक्षेप शतयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: jalandharāsuro dīrṇaścakrīkṛtya jalaṃ padā | baddhvānantena yo viṣṇuṃ cikṣepa śatayojanam
verses.translation: When the preceptor is satisfied he shall let him stay for a year serving him without arrogance. On an auspicious day thereafter he shall make him take his bath after observing fast. For the sake of purity he shall again be subjected to ablution with vessels full of ghee and sacred water wherein holy materials shall be put. He shall dress him well and bedeck him with fragrant garlands, ornaments and garments. The Puiyaha mantras shall be recited and brahmins worshipped. Then in a holy spot, near the seashore, river bank, cowpen temple or in the house itself, at an auspici¬ ous hour when the day is conducive to achievement, when the conjunctions of stars are devoid of defects, he shall bless him and impart to him my knowledge duly.
verses.wordMeaning: When the preceptor is satisfied he shall let him stay for a year serving him without arrogance. On an auspicious day thereafter he shall make him take his bath after observing fast.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the preceptor is satisfied he shall let him stay for a year serving him without arrogance. On an auspicious day thereafter he shall make him take his bath after observing fast.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमेव जलसन्धायी शूलेनैव जघान सः । तच्चक्रं तपसा लब्ध्वा लब्धवीर्यो हरिः सदा
verses.transliteration: tameva jalasandhāyī śūlenaiva jaghāna saḥ | taccakraṃ tapasā labdhvā labdhavīryo hariḥ sadā
verses.translation: In a secluded spot the preceptor delighted in
verses.commentary: Sense: In a secluded spot the preceptor delighted in
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जिघांसतां सुरारीणां कुलं निर्घृणचेतसाम् । त्रिशूलेनान्धकस्योरः शिखिनैवोपतापितम्
verses.transliteration: jighāṃsatāṃ surārīṇāṃ kulaṃ nirghṛṇacetasām | triśūlenāndhakasyoraḥ śikhinaivopatāpitam
verses.translation: Getting thus the mantra and the permission from the preceptor the disciple shall perform the Sarhkalpa with pure mind and repeat the mantra with the rite of initiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting thus the mantra and the permission from the preceptor the disciple shall perform the Sarhkalpa with pure mind and repeat the mantra with the rite of initiation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठात्कालाङ्गनां सृष्ट्वा दारकोऽपि निपातितः । कौशिकीं जनयित्वा तु गौर्य्यास्त्वक्कोशगोचराम्
verses.transliteration: kaṇṭhātkālāṅganāṃ sṛṣṭvā dārako'pi nipātitaḥ | kauśikīṃ janayitvā tu gauryyāstvakkośagocarām
verses.translation: As long as he lives he shall repeat the mantra one thousand and eight times everyday without thinking of anything else and devotedly attached to it alone. He attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as he lives he shall repeat the mantra one thousand and eight times everyday without thinking of anything else and devotedly attached to it alone. He attains the greatest goal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शुम्भः सह निशुम्भेन प्रापितो मरणं रणे । श्रुतं च महदाख्यानं स्कान्दे स्कन्दसमाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: śumbhaḥ saha niśumbhena prāpito maraṇaṃ raṇe | śrutaṃ ca mahadākhyānaṃ skānde skandasamāśrayam
verses.translation: He who completes the Japa four hundred thousand times with great devotion, taking food only in the nights with full self-control, is said to be a Paurascaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who completes the Japa four hundred thousand times with great devotion, taking food only in the nights with full self-control, is said to be a Paurascaranika.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वधार्थे तारकाख्यस्य दैत्येन्द्रस्येन्द्रविद्विषः । ब्रह्मणाभ्यर्थितो देवो मन्दरान्तःपुरं गतः
verses.transliteration: vadhārthe tārakākhyasya daityendrasyendravidviṣaḥ | brahmaṇābhyarthito devo mandarāntaḥpuraṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Experts in the meanings of Agama texts say that the mental Japa is excellent, the Upaihsu Japa (in a low voice) is the middling. The verbal Japa is of the lowest quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Experts in the meanings of Agama texts say that the mental Japa is excellent, the Upaihsu Japa (in a low voice) is the middling. The verbal Japa is of the lowest quality.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विहृत्य सुचिरं देव्या विहारातिप्रसङ्गतः । रसां रसातलं नीतामिव कृत्वाभिधां ततः
verses.transliteration: vihṛtya suciraṃ devyā vihārātiprasaṅgataḥ | rasāṃ rasātalaṃ nītāmiva kṛtvābhidhāṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: The Japa with Rudra as the presiding deity is the most excellent, that with Visnu as the presiding deity is the middling and that with Brahma as the presiding deity is of '■he lowest quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Japa with Rudra as the presiding deity is the most excellent, that with Visnu as the presiding deity is the middling and that with Brahma as the presiding deity is of '■he lowest quality.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवीं च वञ्चयंस्तस्यां स्ववीर्यमतिदुर्वहम् । अविसृज्य विसृज्याग्नौ हविः पूतमिवामृतम्
verses.transliteration: devīṃ ca vañcayaṃstasyāṃ svavīryamatidurvaham | avisṛjya visṛjyāgnau haviḥ pūtamivāmṛtam
verses.translation: 'rhe muttering of the mantra with high, low or middle accentuation, the words and the letters being clear or otherwise, is called the verbal japa.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'rhe muttering of the mantra with high, low or middle accentuation, the words and the letters being clear or otherwise, is called the verbal japa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गादिष्वपि निक्षिप्य वह्निद्वारा तदंशतः । तत्समाहृत्य शनकैस्तोकं स्तोकमितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgādiṣvapi nikṣipya vahnidvārā tadaṃśataḥ | tatsamāhṛtya śanakaistokaṃ stokamitastataḥ
verses.translation: The Japa performed with the pranayama is Sagarbha Japa. In the first and the last even Agarbha Pranayama is commended.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Japa performed with the pranayama is Sagarbha Japa. In the first and the last even Agarbha Pranayama is commended.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहया कृत्तिकारूपात्स्वभर्त्रा रममाणया । सुवर्णीभूतया न्यस्तं मेरौ शरवणे क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: svāhayā kṛttikārūpātsvabhartrā ramamāṇayā | suvarṇībhūtayā nyastaṃ merau śaravaṇe kvacit
verses.translation: After performing the Pranayama forty times, the intelligent devotee, knowing the meaning of the mantra, shall remember the mantra. If he is unable to repeat so many times he shall repeat as many times as his physical strength permits him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Pranayama forty times, the intelligent devotee, knowing the meaning of the mantra, shall remember the mantra. If he is unable to repeat so many times he shall repeat as many times as his physical strength permits him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सन्दीपयित्वा कालेन तस्य भासा दिशो दश । रञ्जयित्वा गिरीन्सर्वान् काञ्चनीकृत्य मेरुणा
verses.transliteration: sandīpayitvā kālena tasya bhāsā diśo daśa | rañjayitvā girīnsarvān kāñcanīkṛtya meruṇā
verses.translation: He shall perform five, three or one Pranayama
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform five, three or one Pranayama
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चिरेण कालेन सञ्जाते तत्र तेजसि । कुमारे सुकुमाराङ्गे कुमाराणां निदर्शने
verses.transliteration: tataścireṇa kālena sañjāte tatra tejasi | kumāre sukumārāṅge kumārāṇāṃ nidarśane
verses.translation: A rosary containing thirty beads ol' Rudraksa for Japa bestows wealth, containing twentyseven beads yields nourishment, containing twentyfive beads bestows salvation, containing fifteen beads bestows the fruits of black magic.
verses.commentary: Sense: A rosary containing thirty beads ol' Rudraksa for Japa bestows wealth, containing twentyseven beads yields nourishment, containing twentyfive beads bestows salvation, containing fifteen beads bestows the fruits of black magic.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छैशवं स्वरूपं च तस्य दृष्ट्वा मनोहरम् । सह देवासुरैर्लोकैर्विस्मिते च विमोहिते
verses.transliteration: tacchaiśavaṃ svarūpaṃ ca tasya dṛṣṭvā manoharam | saha devāsurairlokairvismite ca vimohite
verses.translation: The thumb used in counting the number bestows salvation. The index finger destroys enemies. The middle finger bestows wealth. The ring finger brings about calmness and peace.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thumb used in counting the number bestows salvation. The index finger destroys enemies. The middle finger bestows wealth. The ring finger brings about calmness and peace.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवोऽपि स्वयमायातः पुत्रदर्शनलालसः । सह देव्याङ्कमारोप्य ततोऽस्य स्मेरमाननम्
verses.transliteration: devo'pi svayamāyātaḥ putradarśanalālasaḥ | saha devyāṅkamāropya tato'sya smeramānanam
verses.translation: If there are hundred and eight beads that rosary is the most excellent. If it has hundred beads it is excellent. If it has fifty beads it is the middling. With fifty- four beads it is good. The Japa shall be performed with these different rosaries. They must not be exhibited to anyone.
verses.wordMeaning: If there are hundred and eight beads that rosary is the most excellent. If it has hundred beads it is excellent. If it has fifty beads it is the middling. With fifty- four beads it is good. The Japa shall be performed with these different rosaries.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If there are hundred and eight beads that rosary is the most excellent. If it has hundred beads it is excellent. If it has fifty beads it is the middling. With fifty- four beads it is good. The Japa shall be performed with these different rosaries.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पीतामृतमिव स्नेहविवशेनान्तरात्मना । देवेष्वपि च पश्यत्सु वीतरागैस्तपस्विभिः
verses.transliteration: pītāmṛtamiva snehavivaśenāntarātmanā | deveṣvapi ca paśyatsu vītarāgaistapasvibhiḥ
verses.translation: The use of little finger in the Japa shall be avoided. In the act ot Japa it is held to be auspicious. The Japa shall be performed by means of the thumb in contact with other fingers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The use of little finger in the Japa shall be avoided. In the act ot Japa it is held to be auspicious. The Japa shall be performed by means of the thumb in contact with other fingers.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्य वक्षःस्थले स्वैरं नर्तयित्वा कुमारकम् । अनुभूय च तत्क्रीडां सम्भाव्य च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: svasya vakṣaḥsthale svairaṃ nartayitvā kumārakam | anubhūya ca tatkrīḍāṃ sambhāvya ca parasparam
verses.translation: West of these is conducive to riches and north of these is peace-bestowing. If Japa is performed in the pre¬ sence of sun, fire, brahmins, gods, preceptors and others one should not turn the face away from them. One should never perform Japa with the turban on, or wearing an armour or a bodice, in the nude, or with the hair dishevelled, or the neck covered, or without the Pavitra in the hand or while impure or while lamenting. While performing Japa the following must be avoided — anger, intoxication sneezing, spitting, yawning and seeing a dog or a lowborn person. If they happen, Acamana shall be performed or I shall be remembered along with you,
verses.wordMeaning: West of these is conducive to riches and north of these is peace-bestowing. If Japa is performed in the pre¬ sence of sun, fire, brahmins, gods, preceptors and others one should not turn the face away from them. One should never perform Japa with the turban on,…
verses.commentary: Sense: West of these is conducive to riches and north of these is peace-bestowing. If Japa is performed in the pre¬ sence of sun, fire, brahmins, gods, preceptors and others one should not turn the face away from them. One should never perform Japa with the turban on,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तन्यमाज्ञापयन्देव्याः पाययित्वामृतोपमम् । तवावतारो जगतां हितायेत्यनुशास्य च
verses.transliteration: stanyamājñāpayandevyāḥ pāyayitvāmṛtopamam | tavāvatāro jagatāṃ hitāyetyanuśāsya ca
verses.translation: Or he shall see the luminary bodies or he shall
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall see the luminary bodies or he shall
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं देवश्च देवी च न तृप्तिमुपजग्मतुः । ततः शक्रेण सन्धाय बिभ्यता तारकासुरात्
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ devaśca devī ca na tṛptimupajagmatuḥ | tataḥ śakreṇa sandhāya bibhyatā tārakāsurāt
verses.translation: Doing the duties prescribed by the Vedas, Sastras and the followers of the Vedas is meant by the word good conduct, nothing else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Doing the duties prescribed by the Vedas, Sastras and the followers of the Vedas is meant by the word good conduct, nothing else.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कारयित्वाऽभिषेकं च सेनापत्ये दिवौकसाम् । पुत्रमन्तरतः कृत्वा देवेन त्रिपुरद्विषः
verses.transliteration: kārayitvā'bhiṣekaṃ ca senāpatye divaukasām | putramantarataḥ kṛtvā devena tripuradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: O beloved, I shall tell you another secret which shall be guarded well. It shall not be mentioned to any one and every one or to an atheist brute.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, I shall tell you another secret which shall be guarded well. It shall not be mentioned to any one and every one or to an atheist brute.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमन्तर्हितेनैव स्कन्दमिन्द्रादिरक्षितम् । तच्छक्त्या क्रौञ्चभेदिन्या युधि कालाग्निकल्पया
verses.transliteration: svayamantarhitenaiva skandamindrādirakṣitam | tacchaktyā krauñcabhedinyā yudhi kālāgnikalpayā
verses.translation: O beloved, in the case of this mantra, the auspi¬ cious hour, date, star, day of the week etc. heed not be taken into consideration too much. It is ever wakeful, not slumbering.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved, in the case of this mantra, the auspi¬ cious hour, date, star, day of the week etc. heed not be taken into consideration too much. It is ever wakeful, not slumbering.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: छेदितं तारकस्यापि शिरः शक्रभिया सह । स्तुतिं चक्रुर्विशेषेण हरिधातृमुखाः सुराः
verses.transliteration: cheditaṃ tārakasyāpi śiraḥ śakrabhiyā saha | stutiṃ cakrurviśeṣeṇa haridhātṛmukhāḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: If one has faith in me, the mantra and the preceptor, the mantra will undoubtedly be achieved whether it is Asadhita or Sadhita.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one has faith in me, the mantra and the preceptor, the mantra will undoubtedly be achieved whether it is Asadhita or Sadhita.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा रक्षोऽधिपः साक्षाद्रावणो बलगर्वितः । उद्धरन्स्वभुजैर्दीर्घैः कैलासं गिरिमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tathā rakṣo'dhipaḥ sākṣādrāvaṇo balagarvitaḥ | uddharansvabhujairdīrghaiḥ kailāsaṃ girimātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Hence a scholarly devotee shall resort to the five- syllabled mantra eschewing other mantras attended with risks in the matter of authorisation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence a scholarly devotee shall resort to the five- syllabled mantra eschewing other mantras attended with risks in the matter of authorisation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदागोऽसहमानस्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः । पदाङ्गुष्ठपरिस्पन्दान्ममज्ज मृदितो भुवि
verses.transliteration: tadāgo'sahamānasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ | padāṅguṣṭhaparispandānmamajja mṛdito bhuvi
verses.translation: Just as, O goddess, I am not achieved even if the other gods are attained but if I am attained the other gods too are attained so also is the case with the Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as, O goddess, I am not achieved even if the other gods are attained but if I am attained the other gods too are attained so also is the case with the Mantras.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बटोः केनचिदर्थेन स्वाश्रितस्य गतायुषः । त्वरयागत्य देवेन पादान्तं गमितोऽन्तकः
verses.transliteration: baṭoḥ kenacidarthena svāśritasya gatāyuṣaḥ | tvarayāgatya devena pādāntaṃ gamito'ntakaḥ
verses.translation: Since this mantra functions without reference to castes, the defects found in the other mantras are not found in this mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since this mantra functions without reference to castes, the defects found in the other mantras are not found in this mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्ववाहनमविज्ञाय वृषेन्द्रं वडवानलः । सगलग्रहमानीतस्ततोऽस्त्येकोदकं जगत्
verses.transliteration: svavāhanamavijñāya vṛṣendraṃ vaḍavānalaḥ | sagalagrahamānītastato'styekodakaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Still this mantra shall not be used for the trivial benefits or against insignificant opponents. Then alone this is very efficacious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still this mantra shall not be used for the trivial benefits or against insignificant opponents. Then alone this is very efficacious.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अलोकविदितैस्तैस्तैर्वृत्तैरानन्दसुन्दरैः । अङ्गहारक्रमेणेदमसकृच्चालितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: alokaviditaistaistairvṛttairānandasundaraiḥ | aṅgahārakrameṇedamasakṛccālitaṃ jagat
verses.translation: He who glorifies this with devotion or listens to it with a pious mind is liberated from all sins and attains the gpreatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who glorifies this with devotion or listens to it with a pious mind is liberated from all sins and attains the gpreatest goal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शान्त एव सदा सर्वमनुगृह्णाति चेच्छिवः । सर्वाणि पूरयेदेव कथं शक्तेन मोचयेत्
verses.transliteration: śānta eva sadā sarvamanugṛhṇāti cecchivaḥ | sarvāṇi pūrayedeva kathaṃ śaktena mocayet
verses.translation: O holy lord, the greatness of the mantra has been mentioned by you as well as the rules governing its practice as found in the Sruti itself. Now I wish to hear the details of Sivasarhskara. While explaining the mode of accepting the mantra it has been slightly indicated.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, the greatness of the mantra has been mentioned by you as well as the rules governing its practice as found in the Sruti itself. Now I wish to hear the details of Sivasarhskara. While explaining the mode of accepting the mantra it has been slightly indicated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिकर्मवैचित्र्यमपि नात्र नियामकम् । कारणं खलु कर्मापि भवेदीश्वरकारितम्
verses.transliteration: anādikarmavaicitryamapi nātra niyāmakam | kāraṇaṃ khalu karmāpi bhavedīśvarakāritam
verses.translation: Well, I shall mention to you the holy and sin-des¬ troying details of consecration as explained by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Well, I shall mention to you the holy and sin-des¬ troying details of consecration as explained by Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन नास्तिक्यं हेतुकारकम् । यथा ह्याशु निवर्तेत तथा कथय मारुत
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena nāstikyaṃ hetukārakam | yathā hyāśu nivarteta tathā kathaya māruta
verses.translation: The initiation as ordained by Siva the great Atman in the Sivagama is threefold — pertaining to liva, Sakti and mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The initiation as ordained by Siva the great Atman in the Sivagama is threefold — pertaining to liva, Sakti and mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The disciple too shall carry out the test of the preceptor through these characteristic symbols and contacts with him during the worship of Siva or through those associated with him or resorting to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple too shall carry out the test of the preceptor through these characteristic symbols and contacts with him during the worship of Siva or through those associated with him or resorting to him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The disciple too shall carry out the test of the preceptor through these characteristic symbols and contacts with him during the worship of Siva or through those associated with him or resorting to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple too shall carry out the test of the preceptor through these characteristic symbols and contacts with him during the worship of Siva or through those associated with him or resorting to him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । ज्ञानोपदेशः । वायुरुवाच । स्थने संशयितं विप्रा भवद्भिर्हेतुचोदितैः । जिज्ञासा हि न नास्तिक्यं साधयेत्साधुबुद्धिषु
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.31. ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | jñānopadeśaḥ | vāyuruvāca | sthane saṃśayitaṃ viprā bhavadbhirhetucoditaiḥ | jijñāsā hi na nāstikyaṃ sādhayetsādhubuddhiṣu
verses.translation: The test for the disciple has in view his worthiness of being taught and for the preceptor the gravity of his pursuit. Hence the disciple shall endeavour in every respect to honour the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: The test for the disciple has in view his worthiness of being taught and for the preceptor the gravity of his pursuit. Hence the disciple shall endeavour in every respect to honour the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमणमत्र वक्ष्यामि सतां मोहनिवर्तकम् । असतां त्वन्यथाभावः प्रसादेन विना प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: pramaṇamatra vakṣyāmi satāṃ mohanivartakam | asatāṃ tvanyathābhāvaḥ prasādena vinā prabhoḥ
verses.translation: He shall continue to propitiate him till he is pleased. If the preceptor is pleased the sins of the disciple are immediately quelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall continue to propitiate him till he is pleased. If the preceptor is pleased the sins of the disciple are immediately quelled.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य परिपूर्णस्य परानुग्रहमन्तरा । न किञ्चिदपि कर्तव्यमिति साधु विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: śivasya paripūrṇasya parānugrahamantarā | na kiñcidapi kartavyamiti sādhu viniścitam
verses.translation: The chaste lady Anasuya abandoned her hus¬ band Atri the excellent sage and propitiated Siva by penance; Draupad! who was not engaged in holy rites of the elders propitiated Narayana by penance and attained the Pantavas as her husbands. In view of the weightiness of Siva's behest, the woman engaged in Saivite virtue does not incur sin as she has no choice of freedom.
verses.wordMeaning: The chaste lady Anasuya abandoned her hus¬ band Atri the excellent sage and propitiated Siva by penance; Draupad! who was not engaged in holy rites of the elders propitiated Narayana by penance and attained the Pantavas as her husbands.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वभाव एव पर्याप्तः परानुग्रहकर्मणि । अन्यथा निःस्वभावेन न किमप्यनुगृह्यते

verses.translation: Paddy or rice grains mixed 'with gingelly seeds and flowers shall be strewn on it and covered with Darbha grass. The water-jar with the necessary characteristics shall be placed thereon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paddy or rice grains mixed 'with gingelly seeds and flowers shall be strewn on it and covered with Darbha grass. The water-jar with the necessary characteristics shall be placed thereon.

verses.transliteration: paraṃ sarvamanugrāhyaṃ paśupāśātmakaṃ jagat | parasyānugrahārthaṃ tu patyurājñāsamanvayaḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall perform the Sarhkalp 'I shall do thus' and with the formal permission, he shall bring the disciple who had been observing fast taking only Havi$ya once and who had taken bath and performed daily rites. The disciple shall continue the Japa of Pranava and meditate on the lord. Auspicious rites shall then be perfor¬ med for him. In the Mandala in front of the western or the southern door he shall be made to sit on the Darbha grass. The disciple shall sit facing the north.
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor shall perform the Sarhkalp 'I shall do thus' and with the formal permission, he shall bring the disciple who had been observing fast taking only Havi$ya once and who had taken bath and performed daily rites.…

verses.sanskrit: पतिराज्ञापकः सर्वमनुगृह्णाति सर्वदा । तदर्थमर्थस्वीकारे परतन्त्रः कथं शिवः
verses.transliteration: patirājñāpakaḥ sarvamanugṛhṇāti sarvadā | tadarthamarthasvīkāre paratantraḥ kathaṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: After sprinkling and striking lightly the disciple and remembering the Atman of the disciple in his own, the preceptor shall drain out the wind that throbs like a flame, through the veins as mentioned. He shall then enter the vein and the heart of the disciple.

verses.translation: Then after instructing him in the §akti mantra,

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुनरनुग्राह्यं परतन्त्रं तदिष्यते । अनुग्रहाद् ऋते तस्य भुक्तिमुक्त्योरनन्वयात्
verses.transliteration: etatpunaranugrāhyaṃ paratantraṃ tadiṣyate | anugrahād ṛte tasya bhuktimuktyorananvayāt
verses.translation: Thus the consecration 'Samaya* has been briefly explained to you. It is the greatest means in attaining the city of Siva himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the consecration 'Samaya* has been briefly explained to you. It is the greatest means in attaining the city of Siva himself.

verses.transliteration: mūrtātmano'pyanugrāhyā śivājñānanivartanāt | ajñānādhiṣṭhitaṃ śambhorna kiñcidiha vidyate
verses.translation: The preceptor, most expert in the procedural code, shall invoke the five Brahmans** on them, repeating the Mulavaras along with Hindu and Nada, and the letters beginning with Namali and ending with Ya. Iana is invoked in the middle jar, Purusa in the eastern, Aghora in the southern, Varna in thfc northern and Sadyojata in the western jar. After performing the rites of protection, mystic gestures and invocation of the jar he shall sacrifice in the Siva fire as before.

verses.translation: The Saktipata doctrine of the iSaivas is concerned with the recep¬ tivity of the disciple or the communicability of the preceptor in receiving or imparting instructions in the principles oi aiva cult.

verses.transliteration: na hyasau niṣkalaḥ sākṣācchivaḥ paramakāraṇam | sākāreṇānubhāvena kenāpyanupalakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: He shall not do any thing without the permission of the preceptor, nor even walk, stand, sleep or eat. Espe¬ cially if the work is performed in the presence of the precep¬ tor it must ncce.ssarily be with his permission.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not do any thing without the permission of the preceptor, nor even walk, stand, sleep or eat. Espe¬ cially if the work is performed in the presence of the precep¬ tor it must ncce.ssarily be with his permission.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमाणगम्यतामात्रं तत्स्वभावोपपादकम् । न तावतात्रोपेक्षाधीरुपलक्षणमन्तरा
verses.transliteration: pramāṇagamyatāmātraṃ tatsvabhāvopapādakam | na tāvatātropekṣādhīrupalakṣaṇamantarā
verses.translation: He becomes a fallen man due to his sins as due to the contact with the sinners. As the price of gold sheds off its impurities when put in fire so also the disciple sheds off his sins due to the contact with the preceptor. As the ghee melts when kept near the fire, so also the sin melts in the presence of the preceptor. As the blazing fire burns the twig whether dry or damp, so also the delighted preceptor burns off his sins.
