verses.sanskrit: आत्मोपमोल्बणं साक्षान्मूर्तिरेव हि काचन । शिवस्य मूर्तिर्मूर्त्यात्मा परस्तस्योपलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ātmopamolbaṇaṃ sākṣānmūrtireva hi kācana | śivasya mūrtirmūrtyātmā parastasyopalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The disciple shall never incite the anger of the preceptor mentally, verbally or physically. Due to his anger the longevity, prosperity, knowledge and sacred rites all these are burnt. The sacrifices of those who incite his anger are futile as also their restraints and observances. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. No man* shall ever make any statement against the preceptor. If out of delusion he were to make such statements he will fall into the Raurava hell.

verses.sanskrit: यथाग्निमानयेत्युक्ते ज्वलत्काष्ठादृते स्वयम् । नाग्निरानीयते तद्वत्पूज्यो मूर्त्यात्मना शिवः
verses.transliteration: yathāgnimānayetyukte jvalatkāṣṭhādṛte svayam | nāgnirānīyate tadvatpūjyo mūrtyātmanā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Two boats can carry each other across the river. A piece of rock cannot take another piece of rock across the river. If the preceptor is nominal, the liberation too is nominal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two boats can carry each other across the river. A piece of rock cannot take another piece of rock across the river. If the preceptor is nominal, the liberation too is nominal.

verses.sanskrit: अत एव हि पूजादौ मूर्त्यात्मपरिकल्पनम् । मूर्त्यात्मनि कृतं साक्षाच्छिव एव कृतं यतः
verses.transliteration: ata eva hi pūjādau mūrtyātmaparikalpanam | mūrtyātmani kṛtaṃ sākṣācchiva eva kṛtaṃ yataḥ
verses.translation: One devoid of principles is inefficient though he may know all means and rules of procedure. The greatest bliss is generated by the sight of the preceptor whose intellect extending upto personal realisation functions in the principle. Hence an intelligent person shall choose one as his preceptor who can impart enlightenment and bliss.

verses.transliteration: liṅgādāvapi tatkṛtyamarcāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | tattanmūrtyātmabhāvena śivo'smābhirupāsyate
verses.translation: The right preceptor shall be.served by the disciples who desire salvation and who are expert in humble conduct to that end. When reali.sation dawns upon him he shall abide in him with stable devotion. He shall never eschew the principles nor neglect them. If neither enlighten¬ ment nor bli.ss is obtained by the disciple even after a year, even slightly, the disciple shall resort to another preceptor.

verses.commentary: Sense: Even though he may resort to another preceptor
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकानुग्रहणायैव शिवेन परमेष्ठिना । सदाशिवादयः सर्वे मूर्त्यात्मनोऽप्यधिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: lokānugrahaṇāyaiva śivena parameṣṭhinā | sadāśivādayaḥ sarve mūrtyātmano'pyadhiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: Having at the outset approached the brahmin preceptor who has mastered the Vedas, who is intelligent, handsome, of pleasant sight, the bestower of protection and merciful, he shall propitiate him and endeavour to delight him mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having at the outset approached the brahmin preceptor who has mastered the Vedas, who is intelligent, handsome, of pleasant sight, the bestower of protection and merciful, he shall propitiate him and endeavour to delight him mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनामेव भोगाय मोक्षाय च विशेषतः । तत्त्वातत्त्वस्वरूपेषु मूर्त्यात्मसु शिवान्वयः
verses.transliteration: ātmanāmeva bhogāya mokṣāya ca viśeṣataḥ | tattvātattvasvarūpeṣu mūrtyātmasu śivānvayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence he shall give the preceptor coins, gems fields, houses, ornaments, garments, vehicles, beds, seats etc. in accordance with his wealth and resources. If he wishes for the great goal he shall not be stringent with regard to wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence he shall give the preceptor coins, gems fields, houses, ornaments, garments, vehicles, beds, seats etc. in accordance with his wealth and resources. If he wishes for the great goal he shall not be stringent with regard to wealth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भोगः कर्मविपाकात्मा सुखदुःखात्मको मतः । न च कर्म शिवेऽस्तीति तस्य भोगः किमात्मकः
verses.transliteration: bhogaḥ karmavipākātmā sukhaduḥkhātmako mataḥ | na ca karma śive'stīti tasya bhogaḥ kimātmakaḥ
verses.translation: After offering these, he shall dedicate to him, himself, his family and all his possessions along with water and remain subservient to him for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering these, he shall dedicate to him, himself, his family and all his possessions along with water and remain subservient to him for ever.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं शिवोऽनुगृह्णाति न निगृह्णाति किञ्चन । निगृह्णतां तु ये दोषाश्शिवे तेषामसम्भवात्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ śivo'nugṛhṇāti na nigṛhṇāti kiñcana | nigṛhṇatāṃ tu ye doṣāśśive teṣāmasambhavāt
verses.translation: Since he has offered himself to Siva as his devotee he shall ever remain so. He will have no rebirth thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he has offered himself to Siva as his devotee he shall ever remain so. He will have no rebirth thereafter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनर्निग्रहाः केचिद् ब्रह्मादिषु निदर्शिताः । तेऽपि लोकहितायैव कृताः श्रीकण्ठमूर्तिना
verses.transliteration: ye punarnigrahāḥ kecid brahmādiṣu nidarśitāḥ | te'pi lokahitāyaiva kṛtāḥ śrīkaṇṭhamūrtinā
verses.translation: The teacher shall test the brahmin disciple for a year, the ksatriya for two years and the vaiya for three years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The teacher shall test the brahmin disciple for a year, the ksatriya for two years and the vaiya for three years.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डस्याधिपत्यं हि श्रीकण्ठस्य न संशयः । श्रीकण्ठाख्यां शिवो मूर्तिं क्रीडतीमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍasyādhipatyaṃ hi śrīkaṇṭhasya na saṃśayaḥ | śrīkaṇṭhākhyāṃ śivo mūrtiṃ krīḍatīmadhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: He shall test the disciples, with commands to give up life and wealth or by engaging the superior devotees in mean tasks and the inferior ones in noble tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall test the disciples, with commands to give up life and wealth or by engaging the superior devotees in mean tasks and the inferior ones in noble tasks.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सदोषा एव देवाद्या निगृहीता यथोदितम् । ततस्तेऽपि विपाप्मानः प्रजाश्चापि गतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: sadoṣā eva devādyā nigṛhītā yathoditam | tataste'pi vipāpmānaḥ prajāścāpi gatajvarāḥ
verses.translation: Even when rebuked or beaten if they do not feel distressed they shall be considered self-controlled and pure and hence deserving consecration in Saiva rituals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when rebuked or beaten if they do not feel distressed they shall be considered self-controlled and pure and hence deserving consecration in Saiva rituals.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहोऽपि स्वरूपेण विदुषां न जुगुप्सितः । अत एव हि दण्ड्येषु दण्डो राज्ञां प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: nigraho'pi svarūpeṇa viduṣāṃ na jugupsitaḥ | ata eva hi daṇḍyeṣu daṇḍo rājñāṃ praśasyate
verses.translation: The decision of the sacred texts is this that brahmin devotees with -the following 'qualifications shall be consecrated properly and enlightened. They shall be non¬ violent, merciful, ever active and alert in mind, free from arrogance, intelligent, devoid of rivalry sweet-tongued, straightforward, soft-hearted, pure, humble, steady, endowed with purity of conduct, and well-behaved in every respect.
verses.wordMeaning: The decision of the sacred texts is this that brahmin devotees with -the following 'qualifications shall be consecrated properly and enlightened. They shall be non¬ violent, merciful, ever active and alert in mind, free from arrogance, intelligent,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The decision of the sacred texts is this that brahmin devotees with -the following 'qualifications shall be consecrated properly and enlightened. They shall be non¬ violent, merciful, ever active and alert in mind, free from arrogance, intelligent,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्सिद्धिरीश्वरत्वेन कार्यवर्गस्य कृत्स्नशः । न स चेदीशतां कुर्याज्जगतः कथमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yatsiddhirīśvaratvena kāryavargasya kṛtsnaśaḥ | na sa cedīśatāṃ kuryājjagataḥ kathamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Women by themselves are not authorised in Saivite consecration. If they are devoted to the lord they can be consecrated at the instance of their husbands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women by themselves are not authorised in Saivite consecration. If they are devoted to the lord they can be consecrated at the instance of their husbands.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशेच्छा च विधातृत्वं विधेराज्ञापनं परम् । आज्ञावश्यमिदं कुर्यान्न कुर्यादिति शासनम्
verses.transliteration: īśecchā ca vidhātṛtvaṃ vidherājñāpanaṃ param | ājñāvaśyamidaṃ kuryānna kuryāditi śāsanam
verses.translation: A widow can be consecrated with the permission of her sons; a virgin with the permission of her father. The purificatory rite for the pathways is not prescribed for Sudra men, particularly the fallen ones and the intercastes. If they have pious feelings for Siva, the purification of sins shall be performed by administering holy washings of his feet.
verses.wordMeaning: A widow can be consecrated with the permission of her sons; a virgin with the permission of her father. The purificatory rite for the pathways is not prescribed for Sudra men, particularly the fallen ones and the intercastes. If they have pious feelings for Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A widow can be consecrated with the permission of her sons; a virgin with the permission of her father. The purificatory rite for the pathways is not prescribed for Sudra men, particularly the fallen ones and the intercastes. If they have pious feelings for Siva,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छासनानुवर्तित्वं साधुभावस्य लक्षणम् । विपरीतमसाधोः स्यान्न सर्वं तत्तु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tacchāsanānuvartitvaṃ sādhubhāvasya lakṣaṇam | viparītamasādhoḥ syānna sarvaṃ tattu dṛśyate
verses.translation: The consccratory rite for people born of Anuloma marriage shall be performed in the manner custo- maiy to the family of the mother. The girl who is authorised in Saivite rites by her father shall be given in marriage only to a devotee of Siva and not to a non-devotee. If inadverten¬ tly she is given in marriage to a non-devotee she shall try to convince her husband about the Saivite faith. If she is unable to do so she shall leave him off and perform holy rites mentally.
verses.wordMeaning: The consccratory rite for people born of Anuloma marriage shall be performed in the manner custo- maiy to the family of the mother. The girl who is authorised in Saivite rites by her father shall be given in marriage only to a devotee of Siva and not to a non-devotee.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The consccratory rite for people born of Anuloma marriage shall be performed in the manner custo- maiy to the family of the mother. The girl who is authorised in Saivite rites by her father shall be given in marriage only to a devotee of Siva and not to a non-devotee.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साधु संरक्षणीयं चेद्विनिवर्त्यमसाधु यत् । निवर्तते च सामादेरन्ते दण्डो हि साधनम्
verses.transliteration: sādhu saṃrakṣaṇīyaṃ cedvinivartyamasādhu yat | nivartate ca sāmāderante daṇḍo hi sādhanam
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? Whoever solely resorts to Siva shall be purified if he is subservient to the preceptor. The rite of consecration does not differ. He who develops consciousness by the mere sight, touch or talk of the preceptor is not faced with failure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail is much talk? Whoever solely resorts to Siva shall be purified if he is subservient to the preceptor. The rite of consecration does not differ. He who develops consciousness by the mere sight, touch or talk of the preceptor is not faced with failure.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हितार्थलक्षणं चेदं दण्डान्तमनुशासनम् । अतो यद्विपरीतं तदहितं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: hitārthalakṣaṇaṃ cedaṃ daṇḍāntamanuśāsanam | ato yadviparītaṃ tadahitaṃ sampracakṣate
verses.translation: The mental consccratory rite which is perfor¬ med along the path of Yoga is not mentioned here. It is a great secret and shall be known straight from the mouth of the preceptor. The consccratory rite with holy rites shall now be mentioned briefly. Its detailed explanation is not possible.
verses.wordMeaning: The mental consccratory rite which is perfor¬ med along the path of Yoga is not mentioned here. It is a great secret and shall be known straight from the mouth of the preceptor. The consccratory rite with holy rites shall now be mentioned briefly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The mental consccratory rite which is perfor¬ med along the path of Yoga is not mentioned here. It is a great secret and shall be known straight from the mouth of the preceptor. The consccratory rite with holy rites shall now be mentioned briefly.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हिते सदा निषण्णानामीश्वरस्य निदर्शनम् । स कथं दुष्यते सद्भिरसतामेव निग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: hite sadā niṣaṇṇānāmīśvarasya nidarśanam | sa kathaṃ duṣyate sadbhirasatāmeva nigrahāt
verses.translation: On an auspicious day, in a pure spot devoid of major defects, the preceptor shall at the outset perform the consecration *Samaya.*
verses.commentary: Sense: On an auspicious day, in a pure spot devoid of major defects, the preceptor shall at the outset perform the consecration *Samaya.*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तकारिणो लोके गर्हणीया विवेकिता । यदुद्वेजयते लोकं तदयुक्तं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: ayuktakāriṇo loke garhaṇīyā vivekitā | yadudvejayate lokaṃ tadayuktaṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: After testing the ground duly by way of smell, colour, taste etc., he shall cause a platform to be constructed along the path mentioned in the science of architecture.
verses.commentary: Sense: After testing the ground duly by way of smell, colour, taste etc., he shall cause a platform to be constructed along the path mentioned in the science of architecture.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोऽपि निग्रहो लोके न च विद्वेषपूर्वकः । न हि द्वेष्टि पिता पुत्रं यो निगृह्याति शिक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvo'pi nigraho loke na ca vidveṣapūrvakaḥ | na hi dveṣṭi pitā putraṃ yo nigṛhyāti śikṣayet
verses.translation: After making the altar, he shall make eight pits in the eight quarters making the chief one in the north-east. It may also be in the west when only the important pit need be dug. It shall be beautified by smearing it with powder.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making the altar, he shall make eight pits in the eight quarters making the chief one in the north-east. It may also be in the west when only the important pit need be dug. It shall be beautified by smearing it with powder.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: माध्यस्थेनापि निग्राह्यान्यो निगृह्णाति मार्गतः । तस्याप्यवश्यं यत्किञ्चिन्नैर्घृण्यमनुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: mādhyasthenāpi nigrāhyānyo nigṛhṇāti mārgataḥ | tasyāpyavaśyaṃ yatkiñcinnairghṛṇyamanuvartate
verses.translation: It shall be decorated with garlands, festoons, banners and canopy. In the middle of the altar a mystic diagram shall be drawn. It shall have auspicious characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be decorated with garlands, festoons, banners and canopy. In the middle of the altar a mystic diagram shall be drawn. It shall have auspicious characteristics.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा न हिनस्त्येव सदोषानप्यसौ परान् । हिनस्ति चायमप्यज्ञान्परं माध्यस्थ्यमाचरन्
verses.transliteration: anyathā na hinastyeva sadoṣānapyasau parān | hinasti cāyamapyajñānparaṃ mādhyasthyamācaran
verses.translation: The powder used for the mystic diagram shall be gold dust mixed with saffron so as to befit for the invoca¬ tion of the lord. If the devotee is poor he can use the powdered Nivara grain mixed with saffron.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powder used for the mystic diagram shall be gold dust mixed with saffron so as to befit for the invoca¬ tion of the lord. If the devotee is poor he can use the powdered Nivara grain mixed with saffron.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दुःखात्मिकां हिंसां कुर्वाणो यः स निर्घृणः । इति निर्बन्धयन्त्येके नियमो नेति चापरे
verses.transliteration: tasmādduḥkhātmikāṃ hiṃsāṃ kurvāṇo yaḥ sa nirghṛṇaḥ | iti nirbandhayantyeke niyamo neti cāpare
verses.translation: The width of the mystic lotus diagram may be one hand or two hands. It may be white or red in colour. The pericarp of the lotus of a hand's width shall be eight angulas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The width of the mystic lotus diagram may be one hand or two hands. It may be white or red in colour. The pericarp of the lotus of a hand's width shall be eight angulas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निदानज्ञस्य भिषजो रुग्णे हिंसां प्रयुञ्जतः । न किञ्चिदपि नैर्घृण्यं घृणैवात्र प्रयोजिका
verses.transliteration: nidānajñasya bhiṣajo rugṇe hiṃsāṃ prayuñjataḥ | na kiñcidapi nairghṛṇyaṃ ghṛṇaivātra prayojikā
verses.translation: The filaments shall be half that length. The rem¬ aining portion is occupied by the eight petals. If the width of the lotus is two hands, the measurements will be doubled.
verses.commentary: Sense: The filaments shall be half that length. The rem¬ aining portion is occupied by the eight petals. If the width of the lotus is two hands, the measurements will be doubled.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: घृणापि न गुणायैव हिंस्रेषु प्रतियोगिषु । तादृशेषु घृणी भ्रान्त्या घृणान्तरितनिर्घृणः
verses.transliteration: ghṛṇāpi na guṇāyaiva hiṃsreṣu pratiyogiṣu | tādṛśeṣu ghṛṇī bhrāntyā ghṛṇāntaritanirghṛṇaḥ
verses.translation: Another diagram shall be made on the altar one hand in width or half of it, to the north-east of the previous one and decorated well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another diagram shall be made on the altar one hand in width or half of it, to the north-east of the previous one and decorated well.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपेक्षापीह दोषाय रक्ष्येषु प्रतियोगिषु । शक्तौ सत्यामुपेक्षातो रक्ष्यः सद्यो विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: upekṣāpīha doṣāya rakṣyeṣu pratiyogiṣu | śaktau satyāmupekṣāto rakṣyaḥ sadyo vipadyate
verses.translation: The water-jar shall be made of gold, silver or copper or it may be earthen. It shall contain scents,flower$.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water-jar shall be made of gold, silver or copper or it may be earthen. It shall contain scents,flower$.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्पस्यास्यगतं पश्यन् यस्तु रक्ष्यमुपेक्षते । दोषाभासान्समुत्प्रेक्ष्य फलतः सोऽपि निर्घृणः
verses.transliteration: sarpasyāsyagataṃ paśyan yastu rakṣyamupekṣate | doṣābhāsānsamutprekṣya phalataḥ so'pi nirghṛṇaḥ
verses.translation: The vessels Bhrngara and Vardhani as well as Sankha and Cakra shall also be put. Except the thread the other thing may consist of lotus petals and leaves. On the northern petal of the lotus conceived as seat shall be placed the Vardhani of the Astraraja (?) with sandal paste and water.
verses.wordMeaning: The vessels Bhrngara and Vardhani as well as Sankha and Cakra shall also be put. Except the thread the other thing may consist of lotus petals and leaves.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The vessels Bhrngara and Vardhani as well as Sankha and Cakra shall also be put. Except the thread the other thing may consist of lotus petals and leaves.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् घृणा गुणायैव सर्वथेति न सम्मतम् । सम्मतं प्राप्तकामित्वं सर्वं त्वन्यदसम्मतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād ghṛṇā guṇāyaiva sarvatheti na sammatam | sammataṃ prāptakāmitvaṃ sarvaṃ tvanyadasammatam
verses.translation: To the east of the diagram the great worship of the lord shall start on the consecrated jar.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the east of the diagram the great worship of the lord shall start on the consecrated jar.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्यात्मस्वपि रागाद्या दोषाः सन्त्येव वस्तुतः । तथापि तेषामेवैते न शिवस्य तु सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: mūrtyātmasvapi rāgādyā doṣāḥ santyeva vastutaḥ | tathāpi teṣāmevaite na śivasya tu sarvathā
verses.translation: What has been mentioned before can be per¬ formed on the seashore, or river-bank, or in the cowpen or on a mountain, or in a temple or in the house or in any other charming place, except the platform. After making the diagram as before and the raised ground for fire the preceptor shall enter the worship chamber with a delighted face. He shall invoke all auspicious things about him. He shall have completed all the daily rites. He shall perform the great worship in the middle of the mystical diagram. He shall invoke Siva again in the water-jar and worship.
verses.wordMeaning: What has been mentioned before can be per¬ formed on the seashore, or river-bank, or in the cowpen or on a mountain, or in a temple or in the house or in any other charming place, except the platform.…
verses.commentary: Sense: What has been mentioned before can be per¬ formed on the seashore, or river-bank, or in the cowpen or on a mountain, or in a temple or in the house or in any other charming place, except the platform.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नावपि समाविष्टं ताम्रं खलु सकालिकम् । इति नाग्निरसौ दुष्येत्ताम्रसंसर्गकारणात्
verses.transliteration: agnāvapi samāviṣṭaṃ tāmraṃ khalu sakālikam | iti nāgnirasau duṣyettāmrasaṃsargakāraṇāt
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the lord the protector of sacrifice facing the west. In the vessel Astravardhani he shall worship the weapon of the lord on 'he south. He shall place the Mantra in the Mantra vessel. Expert in the mantras he shall exhibit the mystic gestures and begin the sacrifice with the mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate upon the lord the protector of sacrifice facing the west. In the vessel Astravardhani he shall worship the weapon of the lord on 'he south. He shall place the Mantra in the Mantra vessel.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate upon the lord the protector of sacrifice facing the west. In the vessel Astravardhani he shall worship the weapon of the lord on 'he south. He shall place the Mantra in the Mantra vessel.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नाग्नेरशुचिसंसर्गादशुचित्वमपेक्षते । अशुचेस्त्वग्निसंयोगाच्छुचित्वमपि जायते
verses.transliteration: nāgneraśucisaṃsargādaśucitvamapekṣate | aśucestvagnisaṃyogācchucitvamapi jāyate
verses.translation: The excellent preceptor shall perform the sacrifice in the sacred fire in the main pit. The other brahmins shall perform the sacrifice all round in the other pits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent preceptor shall perform the sacrifice in the sacred fire in the main pit. The other brahmins shall perform the sacrifice all round in the other pits.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं शोध्यात्मसंसर्गान्न ह्यशुद्धः शिवो भवेत् । शिवसंसर्गतस्त्वेष शोध्यात्मैव हि शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ śodhyātmasaṃsargānna hyaśuddhaḥ śivo bhavet | śivasaṃsargatastveṣa śodhyātmaiva hi śuddhyati
verses.translation: The excellent preceptor shall perform the sacrifice only in the main pit. The number of sacrifices nlade by the others is half or one fourth of those of the chief priest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent preceptor shall perform the sacrifice only in the main pit. The number of sacrifices nlade by the others is half or one fourth of those of the chief priest.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयस्यग्नौ समाविष्टे दाहोऽग्नेरेव नायसः । मूर्त्तात्मन्येवमैश्वर्यमीश्वरस्यैव नात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: ayasyagnau samāviṣṭe dāho'gnereva nāyasaḥ | mūrttātmanyevamaiśvaryamīśvarasyaiva nātmanām
verses.translation: Some shall recite the Vedic mantras or auspicious hymns. Some shall perform the Japa duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some shall recite the Vedic mantras or auspicious hymns. Some shall perform the Japa duly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि काष्ठं ज्वलत्यूर्ध्वमग्निरेव ज्वलत्यसौ । काष्ठस्याङ्गारता नाग्नेरेवमत्रापि योज्यताम् । अत एव जगत्यस्मिन्काष्ठपाषाणमृत्स्वपि
verses.transliteration: na hi kāṣṭhaṃ jvalatyūrdhvamagnireva jvalatyasau | kāṣṭhasyāṅgāratā nāgnerevamatrāpi yojyatām | ata eva jagatyasminkāṣṭhapāṣāṇamṛtsvapi
verses.translation: Dance, music, instrumental as well as vocal, and other auspicious conventional rites shall be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dance, music, instrumental as well as vocal, and other auspicious conventional rites shall be performed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवावेशवशादेव शिवत्वमुपचर्यते । मैत्र्यादयो गुणा गौणास्तस्मात्ते भिन्नवृत्तयः । तैर्गुणैरुपरक्तानां दोषाय च गुणाय च
verses.transliteration: śivāveśavaśādeva śivatvamupacaryate | maitryādayo guṇā gauṇāstasmātte bhinnavṛttayaḥ | tairguṇairuparaktānāṃ doṣāya ca guṇāya ca
verses.translation: 'O lord of the chief of gods be pleased. O lord, ocean of mercy, please enter my body mercifully and release me from the bondage*.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O lord of the chief of gods be pleased. O lord, ocean of mercy, please enter my body mercifully and release me from the bondage*.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु गौणमगौणं च तत्सर्वमनुगृह्णतः । न गुणाय न दोषाय शिवस्य गुणवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: yattu gauṇamagauṇaṃ ca tatsarvamanugṛhṇataḥ | na guṇāya na doṣāya śivasya guṇavṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall stand facing the cast and sprinkle the water from the vessel Proksani, on his haed as the disciple sits straight with palms joined in reverence. He shall lightly touch with flowers the eyes of the disciple and bind them with a strip of new silk cloth repeating the mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor shall stand facing the cast and sprinkle the water from the vessel Proksani, on his haed as the disciple sits straight with palms joined in reverence.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall stand facing the cast and sprinkle the water from the vessel Proksani, on his haed as the disciple sits straight with palms joined in reverence.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न चानुग्रहशब्दार्थं गौणमाहुर्विपश्चितः । संसारमोचनं किं तु शैवमाज्ञामयं हितम्
verses.transliteration: na cānugrahaśabdārthaṃ gauṇamāhurvipaścitaḥ | saṃsāramocanaṃ kiṃ tu śaivamājñāmayaṃ hitam
verses.translation: Then he shall make the disciple enter the Manapa through the door and circumambulate thrice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall make the disciple enter the Manapa through the door and circumambulate thrice.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हितं तदाज्ञाकरणं यद्धितं तदनुग्रहः । सर्वं हिते नियुञ्जानः सर्वानुग्रहकारकः
verses.transliteration: hitaṃ tadājñākaraṇaṃ yaddhitaṃ tadanugrahaḥ | sarvaṃ hite niyuñjānaḥ sarvānugrahakārakaḥ
verses.translation: Then after offering a handful of flowers with a piece of gold to the lord he shall prostrate on the ground facing the cast or the north.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after offering a handful of flowers with a piece of gold to the lord he shall prostrate on the ground facing the cast or the north.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्तूपकारशब्दार्थस्तमप्याहुरनुग्रहम् । तस्यापि हितरूपत्वाच्छिवः सर्वोपकारकः
verses.transliteration: yastūpakāraśabdārthastamapyāhuranugraham | tasyāpi hitarūpatvācchivaḥ sarvopakārakaḥ
verses.translation: Then as before, the preceptor shall sprinkle the water on his head and strew flowers. The bandage around his eyes shall be removed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then as before, the preceptor shall sprinkle the water on his head and strew flowers. The bandage around his eyes shall be removed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हिते सदा नियुक्तं तु सर्वं चिदचिदात्मकम् । स्वभावप्रतिबन्धं तत्समं न लभते हितम्
verses.transliteration: hite sadā niyuktaṃ tu sarvaṃ cidacidātmakam | svabhāvapratibandhaṃ tatsamaṃ na labhate hitam
verses.translation: After seeing the Mandala, he shall bow to the lord again with palms joined in reverence. The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the Mandala and to his left on a Darbha grass seat. After propitiating the lord, the preceptor shall place his auspicious hand over his head.
verses.wordMeaning: After seeing the Mandala, he shall bow to the lord again with palms joined in reverence. The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the Mandala and to his left on a Darbha grass seat. After propitiating the lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After seeing the Mandala, he shall bow to the lord again with palms joined in reverence. The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the Mandala and to his left on a Darbha grass seat. After propitiating the lord,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा विकासयत्येव रविः पद्मानि भानुभिः । समं न विकसन्त्येव स्वस्वभावानुरोधतः
verses.transliteration: yathā vikāsayatyeva raviḥ padmāni bhānubhiḥ | samaṃ na vikasantyeva svasvabhāvānurodhataḥ
verses.translation: Uttering the mantra of Siva, the preceptor, identical with iSiva, shall place his hand refulgent with l§aivite splendour, on the head of the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttering the mantra of Siva, the preceptor, identical with iSiva, shall place his hand refulgent with l§aivite splendour, on the head of the disciple.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावोऽपि हि भावानां भाविनोऽर्थस्य कारणम् । न हि स्वभावो नश्यन्तमर्थं कर्तृषु साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: svabhāvo'pi hi bhāvānāṃ bhāvino'rthasya kāraṇam | na hi svabhāvo naśyantamarthaṃ kartṛṣu sādhayet
verses.translation: With the same hand the preceptor shall touch
verses.commentary: Sense: With the same hand the preceptor shall touch
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमेव नाङ्गारं द्रावयत्यग्निसङ्गमः । एवं पक्वमलानेव मोचयेन्न शिवः परान्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇameva nāṅgāraṃ drāvayatyagnisaṅgamaḥ | evaṃ pakvamalāneva mocayenna śivaḥ parān
verses.translation: He shall worship the lord duly and perform three Ahutis. He shall sit as before. The preceptor shall touch the disciple with the tips of the Darbha grass. By means of his Vidya he shall enter the Atman. After bowing to the lord he shall perform the rite of Nadisandhan?.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the lord duly and perform three Ahutis. He shall sit as before. The preceptor shall touch the disciple with the tips of the Darbha grass. By means of his Vidya he shall enter the Atman. After bowing to the lord he shall perform the rite of Nadisandhan?.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यथा भवितुं योग्यं तत्तथा न भवेत्स्वयम् । विना भावनया कर्ता स्वतन्त्रः सन्ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yadyathā bhavituṃ yogyaṃ tattathā na bhavetsvayam | vinā bhāvanayā kartā svatantraḥ santato bhavet
verses.translation: He shall perform the rite of Prananirgama as mentioned in Siva Sastras. Remembering the mystical entry into the body of the disciple he shall perform the Tarpana rite with the mantras. For the Tarpana he shall offer thrice the ten Ahutis with the ancillary mantras. After offering the Purnahuti, the expert preceptor shall offer again ten Ahutis repeating the Mulamantra, by way of expiation.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform the rite of Prananirgama as mentioned in Siva Sastras. Remembering the mystical entry into the body of the disciple he shall perform the Tarpana rite with the mantras. For the Tarpana he shall offer thrice the ten Ahutis with the ancillary mantras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the rite of Prananirgama as mentioned in Siva Sastras. Remembering the mystical entry into the body of the disciple he shall perform the Tarpana rite with the mantras. For the Tarpana he shall offer thrice the ten Ahutis with the ancillary mantras.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावविमलो यद्वत्सर्वानुग्राहकः शिवः । स्वभावमलिनास्तद्वदात्मनो जीवसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: svabhāvavimalo yadvatsarvānugrāhakaḥ śivaḥ | svabhāvamalināstadvadātmano jīvasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: Worshipping the lord of the gods again and per¬ forming the Acamana the preceptor shall perform Homa duly and uplift the disciple from his caste. If he is a vaiya he is first lifted into a katriya. Then performing these rites the preceptor shall lift him into a brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worshipping the lord of the gods again and per¬ forming the Acamana the preceptor shall perform Homa duly and uplift the disciple from his caste. If he is a vaiya he is first lifted into a katriya. Then performing these rites the preceptor shall lift him into a brahmin.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा संसरन्त्येते नियमान्न शिवः कथम् । कर्ममायानुबन्धोऽस्य संसारः कथ्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: anyathā saṃsarantyete niyamānna śivaḥ katham | karmamāyānubandho'sya saṃsāraḥ kathyate budhaiḥ
verses.translation: After entering his consciousness that appears to him like a blue spot he shall meditate on it as blazing with its brilliance free from dirt.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering his consciousness that appears to him like a blue spot he shall meditate on it as blazing with its brilliance free from dirt.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुबन्धोऽयमस्यैव न शिवस्येति हेतुमान् । स हेतुरात्मनामेव निजो नागन्तुको मलः
verses.transliteration: anubandho'yamasyaiva na śivasyeti hetumān | sa heturātmanāmeva nijo nāgantuko malaḥ
verses.translation: After breathing in the vein repeating the mantra and showing the Saihhara mudra ( the gesture of annihilation ) he shall refill it with Puraka for uniting the Atmans. Now ' taking it again with Kumbhaka as with Recaka before, he shall place it in the heart of the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: After breathing in the vein repeating the mantra and showing the Saihhara mudra ( the gesture of annihilation ) he shall refill it with Puraka for uniting the Atmans. Now ' taking it again with Kumbhaka as with Recaka before, he shall place it in the heart of the disciple.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आगन्तुकत्वे कस्यापि भाव्यं केनापि हेतुना । योऽयं हेतुरसावेकस्त्वविचित्रस्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: āgantukatve kasyāpi bhāvyaṃ kenāpi hetunā | yo'yaṃ heturasāvekastvavicitrasvabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: After touching him and giving him the sacred thread secured from Siva he shall offer three Ahutis and the Purnahuti thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: After touching him and giving him the sacred thread secured from Siva he shall offer three Ahutis and the Purnahuti thereafter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मतायाः समत्वेऽपि बद्धा मुक्ताः परे यतः । बद्धेष्वेव पुनः केचिल्लयभोगाधिकारतः
verses.transliteration: ātmatāyāḥ samatve'pi baddhā muktāḥ pare yataḥ | baddheṣveva punaḥ kecillayabhogādhikārataḥ
verses.translation: Wiping off the water over his body and wearing a white cloth, he shall perform the Acamana. Fully bedecked he shall go to the Mandapa with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wiping off the water over his body and wearing a white cloth, he shall perform the Acamana. Fully bedecked he shall go to the Mandapa with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानैश्वर्यादिवैषम्यं भजन्ते सोत्तराधराः । केचिन्मूर्त्यात्मतां यान्ति केचिदासन्नगोचराः
verses.transliteration: jñānaiśvaryādivaiṣamyaṃ bhajante sottarādharāḥ | kecinmūrtyātmatāṃ yānti kecidāsannagocarāḥ
verses.translation: He shall make him sit as before on the Kua seat and worship the lord in the Mandala. He shall perform the Karanyasa rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall make him sit as before on the Kua seat and worship the lord in the Mandala. He shall perform the Karanyasa rite.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्यात्मसु शिवाः केचिदध्वनां मूर्द्धसु स्थिताः । मध्ये महेश्वरा रुद्रास्त्वर्वाचीनपदे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: mūrtyātmasu śivāḥ kecidadhvanāṃ mūrddhasu sthitāḥ | madhye maheśvarā rudrāstvarvācīnapade sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Meditating on the lord he shall take Bhasma in both the hands and smear it over the body of the disciple repeating Siva's names.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditating on the lord he shall take Bhasma in both the hands and smear it over the body of the disciple repeating Siva's names.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आसन्नेऽपि च मायायाः परस्मात्कारणात्त्रयम् । तत्राप्यात्मा स्थितोऽधस्तादन्तरात्मा च मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: āsanne'pi ca māyāyāḥ parasmātkāraṇāttrayam | tatrāpyātmā sthito'dhastādantarātmā ca madhyataḥ
verses.translation: He shall then perform the rites of Dahana and Plavana and conclude with the rite of Matrkanyasa. Medi¬ tating on Siva's seat and invoking him on the head of the disciple he shall mentally worship him in the prescribed manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then perform the rites of Dahana and Plavana and conclude with the rite of Matrkanyasa. Medi¬ tating on Siva's seat and invoking him on the head of the disciple he shall mentally worship him in the prescribed manner.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परस्तात्परमात्मेति ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । वर्तन्ते वसवः केचित्परमात्मपदाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: parastātparamātmeti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | vartante vasavaḥ kecitparamātmapadāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence he shall pray to the lord. 'Stay here permanently'. After submitting this he shall remember him shining with refulgent splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence he shall pray to the lord. 'Stay here permanently'. After submitting this he shall remember him shining with refulgent splendour.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरात्मपदे केचित्केचिदात्मपदे तथा । शान्त्यतीतपदे शैवाः शान्ते माहेश्वरे ततः
verses.transliteration: antarātmapade kecitkecidātmapade tathā | śāntyatītapade śaivāḥ śānte māheśvare tataḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva and securing his behest in the form of Siva he shall slowly mutter Siva's Mantra into the ear of the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Siva and securing his behest in the form of Siva he shall slowly mutter Siva's Mantra into the ear of the disciple.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्यायां तु यथा रौद्राः प्रतिष्ठायां तु वैष्णवाः । निवृत्तौ च तथात्मानो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माङ्गयोनयः
verses.transliteration: vidyāyāṃ tu yathā raudrāḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavāḥ | nivṛttau ca tathātmāno brahmā brahmāṅgayonayaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of the preceptor he shall repeat the mantra with palms joined in reverence and mind con¬ centrating on it.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the preceptor he shall repeat the mantra with palms joined in reverence and mind con¬ centrating on it.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवयोन्यष्टकं मुख्यं मानुष्यमथ मध्यमम् । पक्ष्यादयोऽधमाः पञ्च योनयस्ताश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: devayonyaṣṭakaṃ mukhyaṃ mānuṣyamatha madhyamam | pakṣyādayo'dhamāḥ pañca yonayastāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: After briefly explaining to him the syllabic mean¬ ing of the mantra, the preceptor shall advise him about the form of the lord and instruct him in different postures.
verses.commentary: Sense: After briefly explaining to him the syllabic mean¬ ing of the mantra, the preceptor shall advise him about the form of the lord and instruct him in different postures.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तराधरभावोऽपि ज्ञेयः संसारिणो मलः । यथाऽऽमभावो मुक्तस्य पूर्वं पश्चात्तु पक्वता
verses.transliteration: uttarādharabhāvo'pi jñeyaḥ saṃsāriṇo malaḥ | yathā''mabhāvo muktasya pūrvaṃ paścāttu pakvatā
verses.translation: Then at the behest of the preceptor, in the presence of aivite fire and the preceptor, the disciple shall think with devotion and repeat the statement of initiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the behest of the preceptor, in the presence of aivite fire and the preceptor, the disciple shall think with devotion and repeat the statement of initiation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मलोऽप्यामश्च पक्वश्च भवेत्संसारकारणम् । आमे त्वधरता पुंसां पक्वे तूत्तरता क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: malo'pyāmaśca pakvaśca bhavetsaṃsārakāraṇam | āme tvadharatā puṃsāṃ pakve tūttaratā kramāt
verses.translation: 'Better to abandon life, better to cut off the head than to take food without worshipping the threc-cycd lord.*
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Better to abandon life, better to cut off the head than to take food without worshipping the threc-cycd lord.*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्वात्मानस्त्रिधा भिन्ना एकद्वित्रिमलाः क्रमात् । अत्रोत्तरा एकमला द्विमला मध्यमा मताः । त्रिमलास्त्वधमा ज्ञेया यथोत्तरमधिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: paśvātmānastridhā bhinnā ekadvitrimalāḥ kramāt | atrottarā ekamalā dvimalā madhyamā matāḥ | trimalāstvadhamā jñeyā yathottaramadhiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: The lord alone will invariably give till the delusion is removed. The disciple shall propitiate the lord with con¬ centrated devotion till delusion is quelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord alone will invariably give till the delusion is removed. The disciple shall propitiate the lord with con¬ centrated devotion till delusion is quelled.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिमलानधितिष्ठन्ति द्विमलैकमलाः क्रमात् । इत्थमौपाधिको भेदो विश्वस्य परिकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: trimalānadhitiṣṭhanti dvimalaikamalāḥ kramāt | itthamaupādhiko bhedo viśvasya parikalpitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the disciple will be known as Samaya in the preceptor's hermitage. He shall carry out the behests of the preceptor and remain subservient to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the disciple will be known as Samaya in the preceptor's hermitage. He shall carry out the behests of the preceptor and remain subservient to him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एकद्वित्रिमलान्सर्वाञ्छिव एकोऽधितिष्ठति । अशिवात्मकमप्येतच्छिवेनाधिष्ठितं यथा
verses.transliteration: ekadvitrimalānsarvāñchiva eko'dhitiṣṭhati | aśivātmakamapyetacchivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ yathā
verses.translation: Then after performing the rite of Karanyasa the preceptor shall take the Bhasma with his own hand and hand it over to the disciple along with the Mulamantra and the Rudrak$a over which the mantra has been repeated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after performing the rite of Karanyasa the preceptor shall take the Bhasma with his own hand and hand it over to the disciple along with the Mulamantra and the Rudrak$a over which the mantra has been repeated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अरुद्रात्मकमित्येवं रुद्रैर्जगदधिष्ठितम् । अण्डान्ता हि महाभूमिः शतरुद्राद्यधिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: arudrātmakamityevaṃ rudrairjagadadhiṣṭhitam | aṇḍāntā hi mahābhūmiḥ śatarudrādyadhiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: The disciple shall take these things from the Saiva preceptor with great respect only at the behest of his family preceptor. Not otherwise,
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall take these things from the Saiva preceptor with great respect only at the behest of his family preceptor. Not otherwise,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मायान्तमन्तरिक्षं तु ह्यमरेशादिभिः क्रमात् । अङ्गुष्ठमात्रपर्यन्तैः समन्तात्सन्ततं ततम्
verses.transliteration: māyāntamantarikṣaṃ tu hyamareśādibhiḥ kramāt | aṅguṣṭhamātraparyantaiḥ samantātsantataṃ tatam
verses.translation: He shall keep on his head everything obtained from the preceptor, with great devotion and preserve it care¬ fully. He shall worship Siva in the hermitage or in his own house.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall keep on his head everything obtained from the preceptor, with great devotion and preserve it care¬ fully. He shall worship Siva in the hermitage or in his own house.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महामायावसाना द्यौर्वाय्वाद्यैर्भुवनाधिपैः । अनाश्रितान्तैरध्वान्तर्वर्त्तिभिः समधिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: mahāmāyāvasānā dyaurvāyvādyairbhuvanādhipaiḥ | anāśritāntairadhvāntarvarttibhiḥ samadhiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall impart to him the 6aivite conduct of life in proportion to his devotion and faith as well as his grasping capacity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall impart to him the 6aivite conduct of life in proportion to his devotion and faith as well as his grasping capacity.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ते हि साक्षाद्दिविषदस्त्वन्तरिक्षसदस्तथा । पृथिवीपद इत्येवं देवा देवव्रतैः स्तुताः
verses.transliteration: te hi sākṣāddiviṣadastvantarikṣasadastathā | pṛthivīpada ityevaṃ devā devavrataiḥ stutāḥ
verses.translation: Understanding of Saivite Agama, reading it and listening to it shall be done at the behest of the preceptor. Not by himself at his will nor from anyone else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understanding of Saivite Agama, reading it and listening to it shall be done at the behest of the preceptor. Not by himself at his will nor from anyone else.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्रिभिर्मलैरामैः पक्वैरेव पृथक्पृथक् । निदानभूतैः संसाररोगः पुंसां प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tribhirmalairāmaiḥ pakvaireva pṛthakpṛthak | nidānabhūtaiḥ saṃsārarogaḥ puṃsāṃ pravartate
verses.translation: Before re-creation after dissolution, the universe remains un¬ manifest in the phallic form of iiva Hence ivais Gudhadeha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Before re-creation after dissolution, the universe remains un¬ manifest in the phallic form of iiva Hence ivais Gudhadeha.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य रोगस्य भैषज्यं ज्ञानमेव न चापरम् । भिषगाज्ञापकः शम्भुः शिवः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: asya rogasya bhaiṣajyaṃ jñānameva na cāparam | bhiṣagājñāpakaḥ śambhuḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: Hereafter the preceptor shall perform the purifica¬ tion of the six pathways after understanding the disciple's capacity, for the sake of liberation from bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hereafter the preceptor shall perform the purifica¬ tion of the six pathways after understanding the disciple's capacity, for the sake of liberation from bondage.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अदुःखेनाऽपि शक्तोऽसौ पशून्मोचयितुं शिवः । कथं दुःखं करोतीति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: aduḥkhenā'pi śakto'sau paśūnmocayituṃ śivaḥ | kathaṃ duḥkhaṃ karotīti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: The six paths*®® are Kala, Tattva, Bhuvana, Varna, Pada and Mantra in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: The six paths*®® are Kala, Tattva, Bhuvana, Varna, Pada and Mantra in brief.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुःखमेव हि सर्वोऽपि संसार इति निश्चितम् । कथं दुःखमदुःखं स्यात्स्वभावो ह्यविपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhameva hi sarvo'pi saṃsāra iti niścitam | kathaṃ duḥkhamaduḥkhaṃ syātsvabhāvo hyaviparyayaḥ
verses.translation: The five Kalas, Nivrtti etc. are the pathway of Kala. The five Kalas pervade the five paths.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five Kalas, Nivrtti etc. are the pathway of Kala. The five Kalas pervade the five paths.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि रोगी ह्यरोगी स्याद्भिषग्भैषज्यकारणात् । रोगार्तं तु भिषग्रोगाद्भैषजैः सुखमुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: na hi rogī hyarogī syādbhiṣagbhaiṣajyakāraṇāt | rogārtaṃ tu bhiṣagrogādbhaiṣajaiḥ sukhamuddharet
verses.translation: The principles from Sivatattva to the earth cons¬ titute the paths of principles. They are twcntysix, both pure and impure.
verses.commentary: Sense: The principles from Sivatattva to the earth cons¬ titute the paths of principles. They are twcntysix, both pure and impure.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्वभावमलिनान्स्वभावाद्दुःखिनः पशून् । स्वाज्ञौषधविधानेन दुःखान्मोचयते शिवः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ svabhāvamalinānsvabhāvādduḥkhinaḥ paśūn | svājñauṣadhavidhānena duḥkhānmocayate śivaḥ
verses.translation: Those beginning with Adhara and ending with Unmana constitute the paths of worlds. They are sixty in number without difference and subsidiary divisions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those beginning with Adhara and ending with Unmana constitute the paths of worlds. They are sixty in number without difference and subsidiary divisions.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न भिषक् कारणं रोगे शिवः संसारकारणम् । इत्येतदपि वैषम्यं न दोषायास्य कल्पते
verses.transliteration: na bhiṣak kāraṇaṃ roge śivaḥ saṃsārakāraṇam | ityetadapi vaiṣamyaṃ na doṣāyāsya kalpate
verses.translation: The fifty letters in the form of Rudras constitute the path of letters. The path of words has many varieties.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fifty letters in the form of Rudras constitute the path of letters. The path of words has many varieties.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुःखे स्वभावसंसिद्धे कथं तत्कारणं शिवः । स्वाभाविको मलः पुंसां स हि संसारयत्यमून्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhe svabhāvasaṃsiddhe kathaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ śivaḥ | svābhāviko malaḥ puṃsāṃ sa hi saṃsārayatyamūn
verses.translation: The path of mantras consisting of subsidiary Mantras is pervaded by the excellent mantra. Just as Siva, the leader of Tattvas, is not included among Tattvas so also the leader of Mantras is not included in the path of Mantra. The Kaladhva pervades and the other Adhvas are pervaded.
verses.wordMeaning: The path of mantras consisting of subsidiary Mantras is pervaded by the excellent mantra. Just as Siva, the leader of Tattvas, is not included among Tattvas so also the leader of Mantras is not included in the path of Mantra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The path of mantras consisting of subsidiary Mantras is pervaded by the excellent mantra. Just as Siva, the leader of Tattvas, is not included among Tattvas so also the leader of Mantras is not included in the path of Mantra.…

verses.sanskrit: संसारकारणं यत्तु मलं मायाद्यचेतनम् । तत्स्वयं न प्रवर्तेत शिवसान्निध्यमन्तरा
verses.transliteration: saṃsārakāraṇaṃ yattu malaṃ māyādyacetanam | tatsvayaṃ na pravarteta śivasānnidhyamantarā
verses.translation: He who does not know that factually should not perform the rite of the six Adhvas. He who has not under¬ stood the form of the six paths cannot understand the order of pervasiveness and is incompetent to perform the rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not know that factually should not perform the rite of the six Adhvas. He who has not under¬ stood the form of the six paths cannot understand the order of pervasiveness and is incompetent to perform the rite.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा मणिरयस्कान्तः सान्निध्यादुपकारकः । अयसश्चलतस्तद्वच्छिवोऽप्यस्येति सूरयः
verses.transliteration: yathā maṇirayaskāntaḥ sānnidhyādupakārakaḥ | ayasaścalatastadvacchivo'pyasyeti sūrayaḥ
verses.translation: After making the pits and the Mandapa as before, to the east he shall make the mystic diagram measuring two hastas for keeping the water-jar on. The preceptor shall perform his routine rites and enter the Mandapa with his dis¬ ciples to begin the worship of Siva as before. Milk pudding shall be made with rice measuring not less than one Adhaka. Half of that shall be offered to the lord as Naivedya and the remaining shall be kept reserved for Homa. In the

verses.sanskrit: न निवर्तयितुं शक्यं सान्निध्यं सदकारणम् । अधिष्ठाता ततो नित्यमज्ञातो जगतः शिवः
verses.transliteration: na nivartayituṃ śakyaṃ sānnidhyaṃ sadakāraṇam | adhiṣṭhātā tato nityamajñāto jagataḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: In this rite three Ahutis shall be given. With the specific mantras the refulgent deities shall be meditated upon. He shall then take the thrice-spun white threads made by brahmin girls, strung into three and with these bind the tip of the tuft of the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this rite three Ahutis shall be given. With the specific mantras the refulgent deities shall be meditated upon. He shall then take the thrice-spun white threads made by brahmin girls, strung into three and with these bind the tip of the tuft of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: न शिवेन विना किञ्चित्प्रवृत्तमिह विद्यते । तत्प्रेरितमिदं सर्वं तथापि न स मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: na śivena vinā kiñcitpravṛttamiha vidyate | tatpreritamidaṃ sarvaṃ tathāpi na sa muhyati
verses.translation: The thread shall be let loose till the tip of the toe of the disciple standing straight. The Susumna ( the nerve of the backbone) shall be joined with it. The con¬ sciousness shall be invoked with the basic mantra and he shall offer three Ahutis to create its presence. With the flowers he shall strike the chest of the disciple as before and invoke consciousness. It shall then be conceived as placed in the twclve-petalled lotus. The thread shall be joined with the other thread (?) with the Astra and Varma mantras. After veiling the body of the disciple the thread shall be meditated upon (?)

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिराज्ञात्मिका तस्य नियन्त्री विश्वतोमुखी । तया ततमिदं शश्वत्तथापि स न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: śaktirājñātmikā tasya niyantrī viśvatomukhī | tayā tatamidaṃ śaśvattathāpi sa na duṣyati
verses.translation: It shall then be imagined that the three strings
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall then be imagined that the three strings

verses.sanskrit: अनिदं प्रथमं सर्वमीशितव्यं स ईश्वरः । ईशनाच्च तदीयाज्ञा तथापि स न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: anidaṃ prathamaṃ sarvamīśitavyaṃ sa īśvaraḥ | īśanācca tadīyājñā tathāpi sa na duṣyati
verses.translation: After striking the disciple on the head and the thread worne on the body he shall bedeck the sutra in the Santyatita Pada, repeating the mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After striking the disciple on the head and the thread worne on the body he shall bedeck the sutra in the Santyatita Pada, repeating the mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: योऽन्यथा मन्यते मोहात्स विनश्यति दुर्मतिः । तच्छक्तिवैभवादेव तथापि स न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: yo'nyathā manyate mohātsa vinaśyati durmatiḥ | tacchaktivaibhavādeva tathāpi sa na duṣyati
verses.translation: In this manner after offering the Ahutis of Sarftyatita upto the end of Nivftti he shall perform three Ahutis and worship Siva in the Mandala.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner after offering the Ahutis of Sarftyatita upto the end of Nivftti he shall perform three Ahutis and worship Siva in the Mandala.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे व्योम्नः श्रुता वागशरीरिणी । सत्यमोममृतं सौम्यमित्याविरभवत्स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vyomnaḥ śrutā vāgaśarīriṇī | satyamomamṛtaṃ saumyamityāvirabhavatsphuṭam
verses.translation: The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the lord facing the north, on the Mandala strewn with Darbha grass. He shall give him the rice soaked in ghee left after the Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the lord facing the north, on the Mandala strewn with Darbha grass. He shall give him the rice soaked in ghee left after the Homa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो हृष्टतराः सर्वे विनष्टाशेषसंशयाः । मुनयो विस्मयाविष्टाः प्रणेमुः पवनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tato hṛṣṭatarāḥ sarve vinaṣṭāśeṣasaṃśayāḥ | munayo vismayāviṣṭāḥ praṇemuḥ pavanaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: The disciple shall take the Caru offered by the preceptor, and eat it repeating the name Siva. After per¬ forming the Acamana twice he shall repeat the mantra of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall take the Caru offered by the preceptor, and eat it repeating the name Siva. After per¬ forming the Acamana twice he shall repeat the mantra of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा विगतसन्देहान्कृत्वापि पवनो मुनीन् । नैते प्रतिष्ठितज्ञाना इति मत्वैवमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathā vigatasandehānkṛtvāpi pavano munīn | naite pratiṣṭhitajñānā iti matvaivamabravīt
verses.translation: The preceptor shall give him the Paftcagavya on the other Mandala. The disciple shall drink it upto his capacity, perform the Acamana twice and remember §iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall give him the Paftcagavya on the other Mandala. The disciple shall drink it upto his capacity, perform the Acamana twice and remember §iva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच परोक्षमपरोक्षं च द्विविधं ज्ञानमिष्यते । परोक्षमस्थिरं प्राहुरपरोक्षं तु सुस्थिरम्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca parokṣamaparokṣaṃ ca dvividhaṃ jñānamiṣyate | parokṣamasthiraṃ prāhuraparokṣaṃ tu susthiram
verses.translation: He shall make the disciple sit on a third Mandala as before, and hand over a tooth brush twig having the characteristics mentioned in the scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall make the disciple sit on a third Mandala as before, and hand over a tooth brush twig having the characteristics mentioned in the scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: हेतूपदेशगम्यं यत्तत्परोक्षं प्रचक्षते । अपरोक्षं पुनः श्रेष्ठादनुष्ठानाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: hetūpadeśagamyaṃ yattatparokṣaṃ pracakṣate | aparokṣaṃ punaḥ śreṣṭhādanuṣṭhānādbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The disciple shall sit silently facing the east or the north and clean his teeth with its soft tip.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall sit silently facing the east or the north and clean his teeth with its soft tip.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नापरोक्षादृते मोक्ष इति कृत्वा विनिश्चयम् । श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानसिद्ध्यर्थं प्रयतध्वमतन्द्रिताः
verses.transliteration: nāparokṣādṛte mokṣa iti kṛtvā viniścayam | śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānasiddhyarthaṃ prayatadhvamatandritāḥ
verses.translation: The seeker of welfare shall never even think of transgressing the commands of the preceptor, because only he who carries out the behests of the preceptor attains the wealth of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seeker of welfare shall never even think of transgressing the commands of the preceptor, because only he who carries out the behests of the preceptor attains the wealth of knowledge.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: If the cast-off tooth brush is seen by the
