verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । किं तच्छ्रेष्ठमनुष्ठानं मोक्षो येनापरोक्षितः । तत्तस्य साधनं चाद्य वक्तुमर्हसि मारुत
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.32. dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | kiṃ tacchreṣṭhamanuṣṭhānaṃ mokṣo yenāparokṣitaḥ | tattasya sādhanaṃ cādya vaktumarhasi māruta
verses.translation: Then he shall strike the disciple and whisper the name of Siva into his ears. He shall make him settle to the south of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall strike the disciple and whisper the name of Siva into his ears. He shall make him settle to the south of the lord.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । शैवो हि परमो धर्मः श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानशब्दितः । यत्रापरोक्षो लक्ष्येत साक्षान्मोक्षप्रदः शिवः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | śaivo hi paramo dharmaḥ śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānaśabditaḥ | yatrāparokṣo lakṣyeta sākṣānmokṣapradaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: For the accomplishment of the spiritual knowledge he shall worship and bow to the lord. After performing the homa he shall remember it as developed.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the accomplishment of the spiritual knowledge he shall worship and bow to the lord. After performing the homa he shall remember it as developed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तु पञ्चविधो ज्ञेयः पञ्चभिः पर्वभिः क्रमात् । क्रियातपोजपध्यानज्ञानात्मभिरनुत्तरैः
verses.transliteration: sa tu pañcavidho jñeyaḥ pañcabhiḥ parvabhiḥ kramāt | kriyātapojapadhyānajñānātmabhiranuttaraiḥ
verses.translation: Then after invoking Pratistha and performing everything as previously mentioned he shall conceive its pervasion and the pervading Vagisani.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after invoking Pratistha and performing everything as previously mentioned he shall conceive its pervasion and the pervading Vagisani.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तैरेव सोत्तरैः सिद्धो धर्मस्तु परमो मतः । परोक्षमपरोक्षं च ज्ञानं यत्र च मोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: taireva sottaraiḥ siddho dharmastu paramo mataḥ | parokṣamaparokṣaṃ ca jñānaṃ yatra ca mokṣadam
verses.translation: On the other side beyond the six pathways he shall think of the greatest Iakti of iva that pervades the pathways and that" equals a crore of suns.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the other side beyond the six pathways he shall think of the greatest Iakti of iva that pervades the pathways and that" equals a crore of suns.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परमोऽपरमश्चोभौ धर्मौ हि श्रुतिचोदितौ । धर्मशब्दाभिधेयेऽर्थे प्रमाणं श्रुतिरेव नः
verses.transliteration: paramo'paramaścobhau dharmau hi śruticoditau | dharmaśabdābhidheye'rthe pramāṇaṃ śrutireva naḥ
verses.translation: There at the outset he shall place on the he.ad of the disciple the Santyatita kala. that pervades the pathways; the Santikala on the face; Vidya kala in the spot beginning with the throat and ending with the navel; Pratisfha kala upto the knees; Nivrtti kala beneath it. Thereafter he shall meditate on it.
verses.wordMeaning: There at the outset he shall place on the he.ad of the disciple the Santyatita kala. that pervades the pathways; the Santikala on the face; Vidya kala in the spot beginning with the throat and ending with the navel; Pratisfha kala upto the knees; Nivrtti kala beneath it.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There at the outset he shall place on the he.ad of the disciple the Santyatita kala. that pervades the pathways; the Santikala on the face; Vidya kala in the spot beginning with the throat and ending with the navel; Pratisfha kala upto the knees; Nivrtti kala beneath it.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परमो योगपर्यन्तो धर्मः श्रुतिशिरोगतः । धर्मस्त्वपरमस्तद्वदधः श्रुतिमुखोत्थितः
verses.transliteration: paramo yogaparyanto dharmaḥ śrutiśirogataḥ | dharmastvaparamastadvadadhaḥ śrutimukhotthitaḥ
verses.translation: Worshipping the lord of the gods again he shall submit to Siva — 'Please make whatever has been performed by me a well accomplished thing*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worshipping the lord of the gods again he shall submit to Siva — 'Please make whatever has been performed by me a well accomplished thing*.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपश्वात्माधिकारत्वाद्यो धर्मः परमो मतः । साधारणस्ततोऽन्यस्तु सर्वेषामधिकारतः
verses.transliteration: apaśvātmādhikāratvādyo dharmaḥ paramo mataḥ | sādhāraṇastato'nyastu sarveṣāmadhikārataḥ
verses.translation: Followed by his disciple the preceptor shall pros¬ trate before the lord on the ground. Thereafter he shall ritualistically dismiss him from the Mandala and the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Followed by his disciple the preceptor shall pros¬ trate before the lord on the ground. Thereafter he shall ritualistically dismiss him from the Mandala and the fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स चायं परमो धर्मः परधर्मस्य साधनम् । धर्मशास्त्रादिभिः सम्यक् साङ्ग एवोपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: sa cāyaṃ paramo dharmaḥ paradharmasya sādhanam | dharmaśāstrādibhiḥ samyak sāṅga evopabṛṃhitaḥ
verses.translation: Then those assembled there and worthy of worship shall be duly worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those assembled there and worthy of worship shall be duly worshipped.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवो यः परमो धर्मः श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानशब्दितः । इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां कथञ्चिदुपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: śaivo yaḥ paramo dharmaḥ śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānaśabditaḥ | itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ kathañcidupabṛṃhitaḥ
verses.translation: The members of the assembly including the Rtviks shall be honoured with the gifts. He who desires his welfare shall not be niggardly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The members of the assembly including the Rtviks shall be honoured with the gifts. He who desires his welfare shall not be niggardly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवागमैस्तु सम्पन्नः सहाङ्गोपाङ्गविस्तरः । तत्संस्काराधिकारैश्च सम्यगेवोपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: śaivāgamaistu sampannaḥ sahāṅgopāṅgavistaraḥ | tatsaṃskārādhikāraiśca samyagevopabṛṃhitaḥ
verses.translation: During the night the disciple shall lie on a Darbha mattress covered with an unwashed bed-sheet and consecrated with mantra. While lying he shall meditate on Siva and keep his head to the east.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the night the disciple shall lie on a Darbha mattress covered with an unwashed bed-sheet and consecrated with mantra. While lying he shall meditate on Siva and keep his head to the east.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवागमो हि द्विविधः श्रौतोऽश्रौतश्च संस्कृतः । श्रुतिसारमयः श्रौतः स्वतन्त्र इतरो मतः
verses.transliteration: śaivāgamo hi dvividhaḥ śrauto'śrautaśca saṃskṛtaḥ | śrutisāramayaḥ śrautaḥ svatantra itaro mataḥ
verses.translation: To his tuft the thread has already been tied. Along with that tuft the preceptor shall tie the unwashed bed- sheet. With Varma mantra he shall cover him up. All round him he shall make three lines with gingelly seeds and mustard fully consecrated by Astra mantra. Outside the lines he shall offer oblations to the guardians of the quarters.
verses.wordMeaning: To his tuft the thread has already been tied. Along with that tuft the preceptor shall tie the unwashed bed- sheet. With Varma mantra he shall cover him up. All round him he shall make three lines with gingelly seeds and mustard fully consecrated by Astra mantra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To his tuft the thread has already been tied. Along with that tuft the preceptor shall tie the unwashed bed- sheet. With Varma mantra he shall cover him up. All round him he shall make three lines with gingelly seeds and mustard fully consecrated by Astra mantra.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वतन्त्रो दशधा पूर्वं तथाष्टादशधा पुनः । कामिकादिसमाख्याभिः सिद्धः सिद्धान्तसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: svatantro daśadhā pūrvaṃ tathāṣṭādaśadhā punaḥ | kāmikādisamākhyābhiḥ siddhaḥ siddhāntasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: The disciple shall not take anything in after sett¬ ling down like this. After getting up the next day he shall intimate to the preceptor if he had any dream.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall not take anything in after sett¬ ling down like this. After getting up the next day he shall intimate to the preceptor if he had any dream.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिसारमयो यस्तु शतकोटिप्रविस्तरः । परं पाशुपतं यत्र व्रतं ज्ञानं च कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: śrutisāramayo yastu śatakoṭipravistaraḥ | paraṃ pāśupataṃ yatra vrataṃ jñānaṃ ca kathyate
verses.translation: After completing ablution and other rites the dis¬ ciple shall, at the bidding of the preceptor, go near the Mancjlala of Siva meditating on Siva, with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: After completing ablution and other rites the dis¬ ciple shall, at the bidding of the preceptor, go near the Mancjlala of Siva meditating on Siva, with palms joined in reverence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: युगावर्तेषु शिष्येत योगाचार्यस्वरूपिणा । तत्र तत्रावतीर्णेन शिवेनैव प्रवर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: yugāvarteṣu śiṣyeta yogācāryasvarūpiṇā | tatra tatrāvatīrṇena śivenaiva pravartyate
verses.translation: All rites upto the binding of the eyes shall be
verses.commentary: Sense: All rites upto the binding of the eyes shall be
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्षिप्यास्य प्रवक्तारश्चत्वारः परमर्षयः । रुरुर्दधीचोऽगस्त्यश्च उपमन्युर्महायशाः
verses.transliteration: saṅkṣipyāsya pravaktāraścatvāraḥ paramarṣayaḥ | rururdadhīco'gastyaśca upamanyurmahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: When flowers are strewn by the disciple whose eyes are tied, the preceptor shall tell him the places where the flowers fell.
verses.commentary: Sense: When flowers are strewn by the disciple whose eyes are tied, the preceptor shall tell him the places where the flowers fell.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ते च पाशुपता ज्ञेयाः संहितानां प्रवर्तकाः । तत्सन्ततीया गुरवः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: te ca pāśupatā jñeyāḥ saṃhitānāṃ pravartakāḥ | tatsantatīyā guravaḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall take him to the Mandala where worship had already been performed. As before he shall worship lord Hana and perform homa in the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall take him to the Mandala where worship had already been performed. As before he shall worship lord Hana and perform homa in the fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोक्तः परमो धर्मश्चर्याद्यात्मा चतुर्विधः । तेषु पाशुपतो योगः शिवं प्रत्यक्षयेद् दृढम्
verses.transliteration: tatroktaḥ paramo dharmaścaryādyātmā caturvidhaḥ | teṣu pāśupato yogaḥ śivaṃ pratyakṣayed dṛḍham
verses.translation: If any bad dream had been seen by the disciple,
verses.commentary: Sense: If any bad dream had been seen by the disciple,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठमनुष्ठानं योगः पाशुपतो मतः । तत्राप्युपायको युक्तो ब्रह्मणा स तु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmācchreṣṭhamanuṣṭhānaṃ yogaḥ pāśupato mataḥ | tatrāpyupāyako yukto brahmaṇā sa tu kathyate
verses.translation: The thread tied to the tuft sliall be loosened to hang down as. before, He shall perform the worship of Adhara* based on Nivrttikala and conclude with the worship of Vagisvari with* due homas. He shall bow to Vagina and Satl who pervade Nivftii. He shall worship the lord •in the.. Mandala and make three Ahutis Then the mystical rite of making the simultaneous entry into all types of living beings, shall be pc'formed.
verses.wordMeaning: The thread tied to the tuft sliall be loosened to hang down as. before, He shall perform the worship of Adhara* based on Nivrttikala and conclude with the worship of Vagisvari with* due homas. He shall bow to Vagina and Satl who pervade Nivftii.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The thread tied to the tuft sliall be loosened to hang down as. before, He shall perform the worship of Adhara* based on Nivrttikala and conclude with the worship of Vagisvari with* due homas. He shall bow to Vagina and Satl who pervade Nivftii.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमयो योगः शिवेन परिकल्पितः । तेन योगेन सहसा शैवी प्रज्ञा प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: nāmāṣṭakamayo yogaḥ śivena parikalpitaḥ | tena yogena sahasā śaivī prajñā prajāyate
verses.translation: In order to facilitate the simultaneous entry into all of them, he shall deposit the Atman of the disciple along with his mind into Vagisani duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to facilitate the simultaneous entry into all of them, he shall deposit the Atman of the disciple along with his mind into Vagisani duly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्ञया परमं ज्ञानमचिराल्लभते स्थिरम् । प्रसीदति शिवस्तस्य यस्य ज्ञानं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: prajñayā paramaṃ jñānamacirāllabhate sthiram | prasīdati śivastasya yasya jñānaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: He shall duly perform the mystical rites of nativity, the pursuit of previous actions, straightforwardness and the great pleasure of enjoyment.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall duly perform the mystical rites of nativity, the pursuit of previous actions, straightforwardness and the great pleasure of enjoyment.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादात्परमो योगो यः शिवं चापरोक्षयेत् । शिवापरोक्षात्संसारकारणेन वियुज्यते
verses.transliteration: prasādātparamo yogo yaḥ śivaṃ cāparokṣayet | śivāparokṣātsaṃsārakāraṇena viyujyate
verses.translation: For the sake of redemption and the achievement of birth, longevity, enjoyment and purificatory impressions, the preceptor shall perform three Ahutis and pray to the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of redemption and the achievement of birth, longevity, enjoyment and purificatory impressions, the preceptor shall perform three Ahutis and pray to the lord.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्यान्मुक्तसंसारो मुक्तः शिवसमो भवेत् । ब्रह्मप्रोक्त इत्युपायः स एव पृथगुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ syānmuktasaṃsāro muktaḥ śivasamo bhavet | brahmaprokta ityupāyaḥ sa eva pṛthagucyate
verses.translation: Thus he shall purify his 'body that contains the dirt of enjoyment of pleasures and contact with sensual objects. He shall cut off the three bondages of the disciple,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he shall purify his 'body that contains the dirt of enjoyment of pleasures and contact with sensual objects. He shall cut off the three bondages of the disciple,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवो महेश्वरश्चैव रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः । संसारवैद्यः सर्वज्ञः परमात्मेति मुख्यतः
verses.transliteration: śivo maheśvaraścaiva rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ | saṃsāravaidyaḥ sarvajñaḥ paramātmeti mukhyataḥ
verses.translation: By the complete splitting of the bondage he shall make the disciple clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the complete splitting of the bondage he shall make the disciple clean.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमिदं मुख्यं शिवस्य प्रतिपादकम् । आद्यं तु पञ्चकं ज्ञेयं शान्त्यतीताद्यनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ mukhyaṃ śivasya pratipādakam | ādyaṃ tu pañcakaṃ jñeyaṃ śāntyatītādyanukramāt
verses.translation: After making the Purnahuti in the fire he shall worship Brahma. After performing three Ahutis for him he shall submit to him the behest of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making the Purnahuti in the fire he shall worship Brahma. After performing three Ahutis for him he shall submit to him the behest of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञा सदाशिवादीनां पञ्चोपाधिपरिग्रहात् । उपाधिविनिवृत्तौ तु यथास्वं विनिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: saṃjñā sadāśivādīnāṃ pañcopādhiparigrahāt | upādhivinivṛttau tu yathāsvaṃ vinivartate
verses.translation: 'O Pitamaha, no hindrance shall be placed for this disciple who is going to the great region of Siva. This is the behest of Siva'.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O Pitamaha, no hindrance shall be placed for this disciple who is going to the great region of Siva. This is the behest of Siva'.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पदमेव हि तं नित्यमनित्याः पदिनः स्मृताः । पदानां परिवृत्तौ तु मुच्यन्ते पदिनो यतः
verses.transliteration: padameva hi taṃ nityamanityāḥ padinaḥ smṛtāḥ | padānāṃ parivṛttau tu mucyante padino yataḥ
verses.translation: Thus imploring him, he shall worship and ritualistically dismiss him. He shall worship Mahadeva and perform three Ahutis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus imploring him, he shall worship and ritualistically dismiss him. He shall worship Mahadeva and perform three Ahutis.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिवृत्त्यन्तरे भूयस्तत्पदप्राप्तिरुच्यते । आत्मान्तराभिधानं स्याद्यदाद्यं नामपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: parivṛttyantare bhūyastatpadaprāptirucyate | ātmāntarābhidhānaṃ syādyadādyaṃ nāmapañcakam
verses.translation: Uplifting the Atman of the disciple, as before, when it has been purified by Nivrttikala he shall deposit it in his own Atman. He shall then worship Vagisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uplifting the Atman of the disciple, as before, when it has been purified by Nivrttikala he shall deposit it in his own Atman. He shall then worship Vagisa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्तु त्रितयं नाम्नामुपादानादियोगतः । त्रिविधोपाधिवचनाच्छिव एवानुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: anyattu tritayaṃ nāmnāmupādānādiyogataḥ | trividhopādhivacanācchiva evānuvartate
verses.translation: He shall perform three Ahutis now and ritualistically dismiss him. Returning he shall make it united with Prati$thakala.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform three Ahutis now and ritualistically dismiss him. Returning he shall make it united with Prati$thakala.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमलसंश्लेषः प्रागभावात्स्वभावतः । अत्यन्तं परिशुद्धात्मेत्यतोऽयं शिव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: anādimalasaṃśleṣaḥ prāgabhāvātsvabhāvataḥ | atyantaṃ pariśuddhātmetyato'yaṃ śiva ucyate
verses.translation: Performing the worship and the three Ahutis simultaneously he shall imagine the entry of the Atman of the disciple into the Pratistha Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing the worship and the three Ahutis simultaneously he shall imagine the entry of the Atman of the disciple into the Pratistha Kala.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवाशेषकल्याणगुणैकधन ईश्वरः । शिव इत्युच्यते सद्भिः शिवतत्त्वार्थवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: athavāśeṣakalyāṇaguṇaikadhana īśvaraḥ | śiva ityucyate sadbhiḥ śivatattvārthavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: He shall imagine Vagisani as lustrous as the disc of the full moon. After doing everything as before he shall submit to Visnu the behest of Siva the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall imagine Vagisani as lustrous as the disc of the full moon. After doing everything as before he shall submit to Visnu the behest of Siva the great Atman.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतितत्त्वेभ्यः प्रकृतिर्हि परा मता । प्रकृतेस्तु परं प्राहुः पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: trayoviṃśatitattvebhyaḥ prakṛtirhi parā matā | prakṛtestu paraṃ prāhuḥ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: Performing everything like the ritualistic dismissal of Visnu by means of Vidya he shall think of Prati$(ha and its pervasion and Vagisa too in order. He shall then perform everything concluding with the Purnahuti in the blazing fire as before. Nilarudra shall be invoked and its worship performed. As mentioned before, the behest of the lord shall be carried out.
verses.wordMeaning: Performing everything like the ritualistic dismissal of Visnu by means of Vidya he shall think of Prati$(ha and its pervasion and Vagisa too in order. He shall then perform everything concluding with the Purnahuti in the blazing fire as before.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing everything like the ritualistic dismissal of Visnu by means of Vidya he shall think of Prati$(ha and its pervasion and Vagisa too in order. He shall then perform everything concluding with the Purnahuti in the blazing fire as before.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यं वेदादौ स्वरं प्राहुर्वाच्यवाचकभावतः । वेदैकवेद्ययाथात्म्याद्वेदान्ते च प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vedādau svaraṃ prāhurvācyavācakabhāvataḥ | vedaikavedyayāthātmyādvedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Then the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. For the purpose of quietening him, Vidyakala shall be conceived and its pervasion surveyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. For the purpose of quietening him, Vidyakala shall be conceived and its pervasion surveyed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रकृतिलीनस्य यः परः स महेश्वरः । तदधीनप्रवृत्तित्वात्प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च
verses.transliteration: tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ paraḥ sa maheśvaraḥ | tadadhīnapravṛttitvātprakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca
verses.translation: He shall then as before invoke Vagisi that pervades his Atman, that has the form and features of the early morning sun and that illuminates the ten quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then as before invoke Vagisi that pervades his Atman, that has the form and features of the early morning sun and that illuminates the ten quarters.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथवा त्रिगुणं तत्त्वमुपेयमिदमव्ययम् । मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यान्मायिनं तु महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: athavā triguṇaṃ tattvamupeyamidamavyayam | māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyānmāyinaṃ tu maheśvaram
verses.translation: He shall perform the remaining rites as before. He shall invoke lord iva and propitiate him. After
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the remaining rites as before. He shall invoke lord iva and propitiate him. After
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मायाविक्षोभकोऽनन्तो महेश्वरसमन्वयात् । कालात्मा परमात्मादिः स्थूलः सूक्ष्मः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: māyāvikṣobhako'nanto maheśvarasamanvayāt | kālātmā paramātmādiḥ sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: After ritualistically dismissing the lord he shall lead another Kala to SantyatTtakala and survey its pervasion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After ritualistically dismissing the lord he shall lead another Kala to SantyatTtakala and survey its pervasion.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद् दुःखं दुःखहेतुर्वा तद्रावयति नः प्रभुः । रुद्र इत्युच्यते सद्भिः शिवः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: rud duḥkhaṃ duḥkhaheturvā tadrāvayati naḥ prabhuḥ | rudra ityucyate sadbhiḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: As before he shall meditate on Vilgisa that pervades the Atman as resembling the permanent. Upto the final offering (Purnahuti) everything is as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: As before he shall meditate on Vilgisa that pervades the Atman as resembling the permanent. Upto the final offering (Purnahuti) everything is as before.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वादिभूतपर्यन्तं शरीरादिष्वतन्द्रितः । व्याप्याधितिष्ठति शिवस्ततो रुद्र इतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tattvādibhūtaparyantaṃ śarīrādiṣvatandritaḥ | vyāpyādhitiṣṭhati śivastato rudra itastataḥ
verses.translation: After doing everything in accordance with injunc¬ tions and worshipping Sadasiva he shall submit to him the behest of Siva of unmeasured activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After doing everything in accordance with injunc¬ tions and worshipping Sadasiva he shall submit to him the behest of Siva of unmeasured activity.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगतः पितृभूतानां शिवो मूर्त्यात्मनामपि । पितृभावेन सर्वेषां पितामह उदीरितः
verses.transliteration: jagataḥ pitṛbhūtānāṃ śivo mūrtyātmanāmapi | pitṛbhāvena sarveṣāṃ pitāmaha udīritaḥ
verses.translation: There too, after worshipping iva as before on the head and bowing to Vagisa he shall ritualistically dismiss him.
verses.commentary: Sense: There too, after worshipping iva as before on the head and bowing to Vagisa he shall ritualistically dismiss him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निदानज्ञो यथा वैद्यो रोगस्य विनिवर्तकः । उपायैर्भेषजैस्तद्वल्लयभोगाधिकारतः
verses.transliteration: nidānajño yathā vaidyo rogasya vinivartakaḥ | upāyairbheṣajaistadvallayabhogādhikārataḥ
verses.translation: Sprinkling then the disciple on the head as before with Siva mantra he shall think of the merging of iSantyati- takala in the lakti Tattva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sprinkling then the disciple on the head as before with Siva mantra he shall think of the merging of iSantyati- takala in the lakti Tattva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संसारस्येश्वरो नित्यं समूलस्य निवर्तकः । संसारवैद्य इत्युक्तः सर्वतत्त्वार्थवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: saṃsārasyeśvaro nityaṃ samūlasya nivartakaḥ | saṃsāravaidya ityuktaḥ sarvatattvārthavedibhiḥ
verses.translation: He shall bring the disciple as ptire as the crystal in front of it. After washing the scissors, the preceptor shall cut off the tuft of the disciple as well as his thread in the manner mentioned in the Saivite Scriptures. He shall place it in cowdung and consign it to Siva fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall bring the disciple as ptire as the crystal in front of it. After washing the scissors, the preceptor shall cut off the tuft of the disciple as well as his thread in the manner mentioned in the Saivite Scriptures. He shall place it in cowdung and consign it to Siva fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दशार्थज्ञानसिद्ध्यर्थमिन्द्रियेष्वेषु सत्स्वपि । त्रिकालभाविनो भावान्स्थूलान्सूक्ष्मानशेषतः
verses.transliteration: daśārthajñānasiddhyarthamindriyeṣveṣu satsvapi | trikālabhāvino bhāvānsthūlānsūkṣmānaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Then with the basic mantra ending with Vausat he shall wash the scissors and hands. He shall restore the consciousness of the disciple to his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with the basic mantra ending with Vausat he shall wash the scissors and hands. He shall restore the consciousness of the disciple to his body.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अणवो नैव जानन्ति माययैव मलावृताः । असत्स्वपि च सर्वेषु सर्वार्थज्ञानहेतुषु
verses.transliteration: aṇavo naiva jānanti māyayaiva malāvṛtāḥ | asatsvapi ca sarveṣu sarvārthajñānahetuṣu
verses.translation: The disciple shall take bath and perform Acamana. Good wishes and blessings shall be conferred on him. He shall be brought to the Mandala and made to prostrate. In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the rites due worship shall be performed. The preceptor shall pour three Ahutis by reciting the mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: The disciple shall take bath and perform Acamana. Good wishes and blessings shall be conferred on him. He shall be brought to the Mandala and made to prostrate. In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the rites due worship shall be performed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall take bath and perform Acamana. Good wishes and blessings shall be conferred on him. He shall be brought to the Mandala and made to prostrate. In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the rites due worship shall be performed.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यथावस्थितं वस्तु तत्तथैव सदाशिवः । अयत्नेनैव जानाति तस्मात्सर्वज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yadyathāvasthitaṃ vastu tattathaiva sadāśivaḥ | ayatnenaiva jānāti tasmātsarvajña ucyate
verses.translation: In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the Mantra he shall worship the lord of the gods and pour three Ahutis by muttering the mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the Mantra he shall worship the lord of the gods and pour three Ahutis by muttering the mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मा परमैरेभिर्गुणैर्नित्यसमन्वयात् । स्वस्मात्परात्मविरहात्परमात्मा शिवः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvātmā paramairebhirguṇairnityasamanvayāt | svasmātparātmavirahātparamātmā śivaḥ svayam
verses.translation: He shall pour three Ahutis by repeating the mantra ineiitally. After propitiating Siva there, in the
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall pour three Ahutis by repeating the mantra ineiitally. After propitiating Siva there, in the
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमिदं चैव लब्ध्वाचार्यप्रसादतः । निवृत्त्यादिकलाग्रन्थिं शिवाद्यैः पञ्चनामभिः
verses.transliteration: nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ caiva labdhvācāryaprasādataḥ | nivṛttyādikalāgranthiṃ śivādyaiḥ pañcanāmabhiḥ
verses.translation: 'O lord, due to your grace the, purity of the six pathways of the disciple has been completed. Now, O lord, lead him unto your imperishable abode.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O lord, due to your grace the, purity of the six pathways of the disciple has been completed. Now, O lord, lead him unto your imperishable abode.'
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथास्वं क्रमशश्छित्वा शोधयित्वा यथागुणम् । गुणितैरेव सोद्धातैः निरुद्धैरथापि वा
verses.transliteration: yathāsvaṃ kramaśaśchitvā śodhayitvā yathāguṇam | guṇitaireva soddhātaiḥ niruddhairathāpi vā
verses.translation: After submitting thus to the lord he shall perform every thing as before, from Nadisandhana to the Purnahuti. Then he shall purify the elements
verses.commentary: Sense: After submitting thus to the lord he shall perform every thing as before, from Nadisandhana to the Purnahuti. Then he shall purify the elements
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हृत्कण्ठतालुभ्रूमध्यब्रह्मरन्ध्रसमन्विताम् । छित्त्वा पर्यष्टकाकारं स्वात्मानं च सुषुम्णया
verses.transliteration: hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasamanvitām | chittvā paryaṣṭakākāraṃ svātmānaṃ ca suṣumṇayā
verses.translation: Then, for conducting purity he shall 'meditate on the regions stable or unstable,. hot or cold in the puri¬ ficatory rite of the Bhutas in the form of. unity that is pervaded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, for conducting purity he shall 'meditate on the regions stable or unstable,. hot or cold in the puri¬ ficatory rite of the Bhutas in the form of. unity that is pervaded.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्तः स्थितस्येन्दोर्नीत्वोपरि शिवौजसि । संहृत्य वदनं पश्चाद्यथासंस्करणं लयात्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśāntaḥ sthitasyendornītvopari śivaujasi | saṃhṛtya vadanaṃ paścādyathāsaṃskaraṇaṃ layāt
verses.translation: After cutting off the knot of the Bhutas he shall join the Bhutas on to the great lord Siva, by the path of steady concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: After cutting off the knot of the Bhutas he shall join the Bhutas on to the great lord Siva, by the path of steady concentration.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शाक्तेनामृतवर्षेण संसिक्तायां तनौ पुनः । अवतार्य स्वमात्मानममृतात्माकृतिं हृदि
verses.transliteration: śāktenāmṛtavarṣeṇa saṃsiktāyāṃ tanau punaḥ | avatārya svamātmānamamṛtātmākṛtiṃ hṛdi
verses.translation: He shall purify his body, burn it, and drench it with drops of nectar. Steadying the Atman he shall make his body in consonance with the pure pathways.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall purify his body, burn it, and drench it with drops of nectar. Steadying the Atman he shall make his body in consonance with the pure pathways.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्तःस्थितस्येन्दोः परस्ताच्छ्वेतपङ्कजे । समासीनं महादेवं शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśāntaḥsthitasyendoḥ parastācchvetapaṅkaje | samāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam
verses.translation: With the basic mantra, its Bijas and ancillaries he shall meditate on him in the form of Siva. He shall invoke the lord in the lotus of the heart and worship him.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the basic mantra, its Bijas and ancillaries he shall meditate on him in the form of Siva. He shall invoke the lord in the lotus of the heart and worship him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनारीश्वरं देवं निर्मलं मधुराकृतिम् । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं प्रसन्नं शीतलद्युतिम्
verses.transliteration: ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ nirmalaṃ madhurākṛtim | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ prasannaṃ śītaladyutim
verses.translation: The teacher shall pray for the perpetual presence of iSiva in the disciple. He shall impose good qualities on the disciple posses.sed of Saivite splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The teacher shall pray for the perpetual presence of iSiva in the disciple. He shall impose good qualities on the disciple posses.sed of Saivite splendour.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा हि मानसे देवं स्वस्थचित्तोऽथ मानवः । शिवनामाष्टकेनैव भावपुष्पैः समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: dhyātvā hi mānase devaṃ svasthacitto'tha mānavaḥ | śivanāmāṣṭakenaiva bhāvapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet

verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform three Ahutis praying — 'O lord, be pleased to bestow on him the attributes Anima, etc.*®** Likewise he shall invoke the lord for the presence of these qualities in him, viz: — omniscience, contentment, eternal enlightenment, unviolated 8akti,…

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्चनान्ते तु पुनः प्राणानायम्य मानवः । सम्यक् चित्तं समाधाय शार्वं नामाष्टकं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarccanānte tu punaḥ prāṇānāyamya mānavaḥ | samyak cittaṃ samādhāya śārvaṃ nāmāṣṭakaṃ japet
verses.translation: Then securing permission from the lord and meditating on him in the heart he shall pour water over the disciple from the vessels®®® of Sadyojata etc. in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then securing permission from the lord and meditating on him in the heart he shall pour water over the disciple from the vessels®®® of Sadyojata etc. in order.

verses.sanskrit: नाभौ चाष्टाहुतीर्हुत्वा पूर्णाहुत्या नमस्ततः । अष्टपुष्पप्रदानेन कृत्वाभ्यर्च्चनमन्तिमम्
verses.transliteration: nābhau cāṣṭāhutīrhutvā pūrṇāhutyā namastataḥ | aṣṭapuṣpapradānena kṛtvābhyarccanamantimam
verses.translation: Then after making the disciple sit and worship Siva as before he shall secure permission from the lord and impart Siva's knowledge to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after making the disciple sit and worship Siva as before he shall secure permission from the lord and impart Siva's knowledge to him.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयेत्स्वमात्मानं चुलुकोदकवर्त्मना । एवं कृत्वाचिरादेव ज्ञानं पाशुपतं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: nivedayetsvamātmānaṃ culukodakavartmanā | evaṃ kṛtvācirādeva jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ śubham
verses.translation: He shall impart also the plicated Mantra®'® beginning with Om and ending with Namah and the Saktividya of a similar nature, accompanied by Siva and Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall impart also the plicated Mantra®'® beginning with Om and ending with Namah and the Saktividya of a similar nature, accompanied by Siva and Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: लभते तत्प्रतिष्ठां च वृत्तं चानुत्तमं तथा । योगं च परमं लब्ध्वा मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: labhate tatpratiṣṭhāṃ ca vṛttaṃ cānuttamaṃ tathā | yogaṃ ca paramaṃ labdhvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He shall instruct him in the name of the sage, metre, deity and the efficacy of Siva and Siva, the worship of Siva, his Avarana and the postures.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall instruct him in the name of the sage, metre, deity and the efficacy of Siva and Siva, the worship of Siva, his Avarana and the postures.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: There, after imparting the I&aivitc lore in detail, he shall place this in the disciple's hand with water from the flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, after imparting the I&aivitc lore in detail, he shall place this in the disciple's hand with water from the flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: There, after imparting the I&aivitc lore in detail, he shall place this in the disciple's hand with water from the flowers.

verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.33. trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | paśupativratavidhānavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | bhagavañchrotumicchāmo vrataṃ pāśupataṃ param | brahmādayo'pi yatkṛtvā sarve pāśupatāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: 'By the grace of the supreme lord this great Mantra shall certainly confer on you the Siddhis both of this world and the next one.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'By the grace of the supreme lord this great Mantra shall certainly confer on you the Siddhis both of this world and the next one.'

verses.translation: He shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra, pure in person and mind, with the tuft tied up,

verses.sanskrit: कालश्चैत्री पौर्णमासी देशः शिवपरिग्रहः । क्षेत्रारामाद्यरण्यं वा प्रशस्तः शुभलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: kālaścaitrī paurṇamāsī deśaḥ śivaparigrahaḥ | kṣetrārāmādyaraṇyaṃ vā praśastaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After submitting thus, the preceptor shall bow to Siva again along with the disciple. He shall worship the divine Siva-Agama in the same manner as Siva himself.

verses.transliteration: tatra pūrvaṃ trayodaśyāṃ susnātaḥ sukṛtāhnikaḥ | anujñāpya svamācāryaṃ sampūjya praṇipatya ca

verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, Vidya and Atmatattva — these are the three Tattvas. Siva came out of.*akti and from Siva the Vidya and from Vidya the Atman.

verses.translation: After plunging in, he shall repeat the mantra and think on Siva and l§akti. He shall get up and perform Aca¬ mana. Then he shall pour water over the body with the cow- horn along with Darbha, or with the leaf of a Palana tree, or the lotus leaf or with both the hands, five or three times.

verses.transliteration: darbhāsane samāsīno darbhamuṣṭiṃ pragṛhya ca | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ | dhyātvā devaṃ ca devīṃ ca tadvijñāpanavartmanā
verses.translation: Or it can contain Durva, Apamarga and other articles or mere water. He shall keep that pot over his head. Kneeling down he shall bow to the lord in the tid

verses.sanskrit: व्रतमेतत्करोमीति भवेत्सङ्कल्प्य दीक्षितः । यावच्छरीरपातं वा द्वादशाब्दमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: vratametatkaromīti bhavetsaṅkalpya dīkṣitaḥ | yāvaccharīrapātaṃ vā dvādaśābdamathāpi vā
verses.translation: The letters "Na'* etc. along with the Hindus shall be fixed in order in the fingers. Siva shall be fixed on the palms and on the little fingers.

verses.sanskrit: तदर्धं वा तदर्धं वा मासद्वादशकं तु वा । तदर्धं वा तदर्धं वा मासमेकमथापि वा

verses.translation: After saying this, the preceptor shall worship lord l§iva and secure his formal permission. He shall then impart to the aspirant the Yoga of Siva, the means of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the preceptor shall worship lord l§iva and secure his formal permission. He shall then impart to the aspirant the Yoga of Siva, the means of liberation.

verses.translation: On hearing the instructions of the preceptor, the aspirant disciple shall practise the Mantra before utilising it. This practice of the Mulamantra is called Purascarana since it has to be practised before the rite Viniyoga.

verses.transliteration: tattvānyetāni maddehe śuddhyantāmityanusmaran | pañcabhūtāni tanmātrāḥ pañcakarmendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: A devotee who desires salvation need not practise the mantra too often. If practised moderately it is auspicious here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: A devotee who desires salvation need not practise the mantra too often. If practised moderately it is auspicious here and hereafter.

verses.transliteration: jñānakarmavibhedena pañcakarmavibhāgaśaḥ | tvagādidhātavaḥ sapta pañca prāṇādivāyavaḥ

He shall make his body worthy of Saivite rites along the path mentioned in the Saivite scriptures. He shall worship the lord Nakul- lvara. verses.transliteration: manobuddhirahaṅkhyātirguṇāḥ prakṛtipūruṣau | rāgo vidyākale caiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter his diet shall be limited in quantity and confined to milk pudding and such other as is devoid of salt and acidity. He shall not be violent. He shall be forbearing, quiet and self-possessed for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter his diet shall be limited in quantity and confined to milk pudding and such other as is devoid of salt and acidity. He shall not be violent. He shall be forbearing, quiet and self-possessed for ever.
