verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः पर्वणि चाप्येवं कृत्वा होमावसानतः । उपसंहृत्य रुद्राग्निं गृह्णीयाद्भस्म यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ parvaṇi cāpyevaṃ kṛtvā homāvasānataḥ | upasaṃhṛtya rudrāgniṃ gṛhṇīyādbhasma yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Whether in the course oFpractice or application,
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether in the course oFpractice or application,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च जटिलो मुण्डी शिखैकजट एव वा । भूत्वा स्नात्वा ततो वीतलज्जश्चेत्स्याद्दिगम्बरः
verses.transliteration: tataśca jaṭilo muṇḍī śikhaikajaṭa eva vā | bhūtvā snātvā tato vītalajjaścetsyāddigambaraḥ
verses.translation: The MarKala shall be made as before and after wor¬ shipping the lord he shall, as before, place five water-jars one in each of the four quarters and one in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The MarKala shall be made as before and after wor¬ shipping the lord he shall, as before, place five water-jars one in each of the four quarters and one in the middle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपि काषायवसनश्चर्मचीराम्बरोऽथ वा । एकाम्बरो वल्कली वा भवेद्दण्डी च मेखली
verses.transliteration: api kāṣāyavasanaścarmacīrāmbaro'tha vā | ekāmbaro valkalī vā bhaveddaṇḍī ca mekhalī
verses.translation: Nivrtti Kala shall be installed in the vessel in the east, Piatistha Kala in the vessel in the west; Vidya Kala in the south. Santi Kala in the north and the Para Kala in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nivrtti Kala shall be installed in the vessel in the east, Piatistha Kala in the vessel in the west; Vidya Kala in the south. Santi Kala in the north and the Para Kala in the middle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ पश्चाद् द्विराचम्यात्मनस्तनुम् । सङ्कुलीकृत्य तद्भस्म विरजानलसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya caraṇau paścād dvirācamyātmanastanum | saṅkulīkṛtya tadbhasma virajānalasambhavam
verses.translation: The following rites shall be performed as before, viz. those of Raksa, the Mudrabandha or the gesture of the cow, repetition of mantra over the vessels and the homa till the Purriahuti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following rites shall be performed as before, viz. those of Raksa, the Mudrabandha or the gesture of the cow, repetition of mantra over the vessels and the homa till the Purriahuti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैः षड्भिराथर्वणैः क्रमात् । विमृज्याङ्गानि मूर्द्धादिचरणान्तानि तैः स्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: agnirityādibhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍbhirātharvaṇaiḥ kramāt | vimṛjyāṅgāni mūrddhādicaraṇāntāni taiḥ spṛśet
verses.translation: Then the lord shall be worshipped and his permiss¬ ion obtained ritualislically. He shall make the disciple sit on the seat for the pouring of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord shall be worshipped and his permiss¬ ion obtained ritualislically. He shall make the disciple sit on the seat for the pouring of water.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेन क्रमेणैव समुद्धृत्य च भस्मना । सर्वाङ्गोद्धूलनं कुर्यात्प्रणवेन शिवेन वा
verses.transliteration: tatastena krameṇaiva samuddhṛtya ca bhasmanā | sarvāṅgoddhūlanaṃ kuryātpraṇavena śivena vā
verses.translation: The disciple imagined as the five-fold offering of fruits shall be united with the Kalas and conceived as Siva inasmuch as the mantra has been installed on his body; he shall be worshipped then.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple imagined as the five-fold offering of fruits shall be united with the Kalas and conceived as Siva inasmuch as the mantra has been installed on his body; he shall be worshipped then.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रिपुण्ड्रं रचयेत्त्रियायुषसमाह्वयम् । शिवभावं समागम्य शिवयोगमथाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tatastripuṇḍraṃ racayettriyāyuṣasamāhvayam | śivabhāvaṃ samāgamya śivayogamathācaret
verses.translation: Then the water from the vessels beginning with Nivrtti Kumbha and ending with the middle shall be poured over the disciple repeating the names of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the water from the vessels beginning with Nivrtti Kumbha and ending with the middle shall be poured over the disciple repeating the names of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात् त्रिसन्ध्यमप्येवमेतत्पाशुपतं व्रतम् । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं चैतत्पशुत्वं विनिवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: kuryāt trisandhyamapyevametatpāśupataṃ vratam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitatpaśutvaṃ vinivartayet
verses.translation: Then the preceptor shall place his hand, repeating the Siva mantra on the head of the disciple. The preceptor equipped with the piety towards Siva shall call him Sivacarya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the preceptor shall place his hand, repeating the Siva mantra on the head of the disciple. The preceptor equipped with the piety towards Siva shall call him Sivacarya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पशुत्वं परित्यज्य कृत्वा पाशुपतं व्रतम् । पूजनीयो महादेवो लिङ्गमूर्तिः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tatpaśutvaṃ parityajya kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam | pūjanīyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: He shall be adorned. Then the preceptor shall propitiate him in Sivaman<;j[ala. After performing hundred and eight Ahutis he shall offer the Purnahuti.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be adorned. Then the preceptor shall propitiate him in Sivaman<;j[ala. After performing hundred and eight Ahutis he shall offer the Purnahuti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पद्ममष्टदलं हैमं नवरत्नैरलङ्कृतम् । कर्णिकाकेशरोपेतमासनं परिकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: padmamaṣṭadalaṃ haimaṃ navaratnairalaṅkṛtam | karṇikākeśaropetamāsanaṃ parikalpayet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall worship the lord and pros¬ trate on the ground with palms joined in reverence over the head. He shall submit to the lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall worship the lord and pros¬ trate on the ground with palms joined in reverence over the head. He shall submit to the lord Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विभवे तदभावे तु रक्तं सितमथापि वा । पद्मं तस्याप्यभावे तु केवलं भावनामयम्
verses.transliteration: vibhave tadabhāve tu raktaṃ sitamathāpi vā | padmaṃ tasyāpyabhāve tu kevalaṃ bhāvanāmayam
verses.translation: ''O lord, by your grace this disciple has been made a preceptor by me. O lord, after blessing him, may the divine behest be bestowed on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O lord, by your grace this disciple has been made a preceptor by me. O lord, after blessing him, may the divine behest be bestowed on him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पद्मकर्णिकामध्ये कृत्वा लिङ्गं कनीयसम् । स्फीटिकं पीठिकोपेतं पूजयेद्विधिवत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tatpadmakarṇikāmadhye kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kanīyasam | sphīṭikaṃ pīṭhikopetaṃ pūjayedvidhivatkramāt
verses.translation: Then he shall take the ritualistic permission from Siva. The preceptor shall take the book '*Sivajflana" with both the hands and hand it over to the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall take the ritualistic permission from Siva. The preceptor shall take the book '*Sivajflana" with both the hands and hand it over to the disciple.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठाप्य विधानेन तल्लिङ्गं कृतशोधनम् । परिकल्प्यासनं मूर्तिं पञ्चवक्त्रप्रकारतः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānena talliṅgaṃ kṛtaśodhanam | parikalpyāsanaṃ mūrtiṃ pañcavaktraprakārataḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall give him royal paraphernalia since one who has attained the status of Acarya deserves even a kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall give him royal paraphernalia since one who has attained the status of Acarya deserves even a kingdom.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्यादिभिः पूर्णैर्यथाविभवसम्भृतैः । स्नापयेत्कलशैः पूर्णैरष्टापदसमुद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: pañcagavyādibhiḥ pūrṇairyathāvibhavasambhṛtaiḥ | snāpayetkalaśaiḥ pūrṇairaṣṭāpadasamudbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: Then he shall impart to him the modes of dis¬ cipline followed by elders as mentioned in Saivite sacred literature and as honoured amongst the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall impart to him the modes of dis¬ cipline followed by elders as mentioned in Saivite sacred literature and as honoured amongst the people.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धद्रव्यैः सकर्पूरैश्चन्दनाद्यैः सकुङ्कुमैः । सवेदिकं समालिप्य लिङ्गं भूषणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: gandhadravyaiḥ sakarpūraiścandanādyaiḥ sakuṅkumaiḥ | savedikaṃ samālipya liṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: The preceptor shall test the disciples assiduously through the characteristics mentioned in Saivite scriptures. He shall consecrate them and impart to them the Saivite knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall test the disciples assiduously through the characteristics mentioned in Saivite scriptures. He shall consecrate them and impart to them the Saivite knowledge.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वपत्रैश्च पद्मैश्च रक्तैः श्वेतैस्तथोत्पलैः । नीलोत्पलैस्तथान्यैश्च पुष्पैस्तैस्तैस्सुगन्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: bilvapatraiśca padmaiśca raktaiḥ śvetaistathotpalaiḥ | nīlotpalaistathānyaiśca puṣpaistaistaissugandhibhiḥ
verses.translation: He shall infuse in him all these qualities without difficulty, viz. purity, forbearance, niercifulness, non-covet¬ ousness and absence of jealousy even strenuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall infuse in him all these qualities without difficulty, viz. purity, forbearance, niercifulness, non-covet¬ ousness and absence of jealousy even strenuously.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यैः प्रशस्तैः पत्रैश्च चित्रैर्दूर्वाक्षतादिभिः । समभ्यर्च्य यथालाभं महापूजाविधानतः
verses.transliteration: puṇyaiḥ praśastaiḥ patraiśca citrairdūrvākṣatādibhiḥ | samabhyarcya yathālābhaṃ mahāpūjāvidhānataḥ
verses.translation: After thus urging the disciple he shall ritualistically dismiss Siva from the Mainala. He shall worship the Siva- kumbha, fire and otheis who had been invited there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thus urging the disciple he shall ritualistically dismiss Siva from the Mainala. He shall worship the Siva- kumbha, fire and otheis who had been invited there.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धूपं दीपं तथा चापि नैवेद्यं च समादिशेत् । निवेदयित्वा विभवे कल्याणं च समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā cāpi naivedyaṃ ca samādiśet | nivedayitvā vibhave kalyāṇaṃ ca samācaret
verses.translation: Or the preceptor accompanied by his atten-
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the preceptor accompanied by his atten-
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इष्टानि च विशिष्टानि न्यायेनोपार्जितानि च । सर्वद्रव्याणि देयानि व्रते तस्मिन्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: iṣṭāni ca viśiṣṭāni nyāyenopārjitāni ca | sarvadravyāṇi deyāni vrate tasminviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: After homa the Tarpana rite of the mantra shall be performed. After the blessing of the lord the mantra shall be placed in the hand of the disciple and the remaining rites concluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: After homa the Tarpana rite of the mantra shall be performed. After the blessing of the lord the mantra shall be placed in the hand of the disciple and the remaining rites concluded.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपत्रोत्पलपद्मानां सङ्ख्या साहस्रिकी मता । प्रत्येकमपरा सङ्ख्या शतमष्टोत्तरं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: śrīpatrotpalapadmānāṃ saṅkhyā sāhasrikī matā | pratyekamaparā saṅkhyā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Or beginning with the consecration of the Mantra and concluding with the rite of Abhiseka the rites of the purification of the path shall be performed by the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or beginning with the consecration of the Mantra and concluding with the rite of Abhiseka the rites of the purification of the path shall be performed by the preceptor.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि च विशेषेण न त्यजेद्बिल्वपत्रकम् । हैममेकं परं प्राहुः पद्मं पद्मसहस्रकात्
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi ca viśeṣeṇa na tyajedbilvapatrakam | haimamekaṃ paraṃ prāhuḥ padmaṃ padmasahasrakāt
verses.translation: In the purificatory rite of the three Tattvas the rites mentioned for the Kalas l§antyatita and others shall be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the purificatory rite of the three Tattvas the rites mentioned for the Kalas l§antyatita and others shall be performed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलादिष्वप्येतत्समानं बिल्बपत्रकैः । पुष्पान्तरे न नियमो यथालाभं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: nīlotpalādiṣvapyetatsamānaṃ bilbapatrakaiḥ | puṣpāntare na niyamo yathālābhaṃ nivedayet
verses.translation: Intelligent persons who have mastered Saivite Scrip¬ tures laud the consecration through Sakti after considering that the consecration through Siva is very difficult of access.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intelligent persons who have mastered Saivite Scrip¬ tures laud the consecration through Sakti after considering that the consecration through Siva is very difficult of access.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाङ्गमर्घ्यमुत्कृष्टं धूपालेपौ विशेषतः । चन्दनं वामदेवाख्ये हरितालं च पौरुषे
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāṅgamarghyamutkṛṣṭaṃ dhūpālepau viśeṣataḥ | candanaṃ vāmadevākhye haritālaṃ ca pauruṣe
verses.translation: O Kr§ua, thus the four types of consecratory rites have been narrated to you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kr§ua, thus the four types of consecratory rites have been narrated to you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशाने भसितं केचिदालेपनमितीदृशम् । न धूपमिति मन्यन्ते धूपान्तरविधानतः । सितागुरुमघोराख्ये मुखे कृष्णागुरुं पुनः
verses.transliteration: īśāne bhasitaṃ kecidālepanamitīdṛśam | na dhūpamiti manyante dhūpāntaravidhānataḥ | sitāgurumaghorākhye mukhe kṛṣṇāguruṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, I wish to hear the compulsory and optional rites of those who follow iSaivite conduct of life, as mentioned in Saivite scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, I wish to hear the compulsory and optional rites of those who follow iSaivite conduct of life, as mentioned in Saivite scriptures.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषे गुग्गुलं सद्ये सौम्ये सौगन्धिकं मुखे । ईशानेऽपि ह्युशीरादि देयाद् धूपं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: pauruṣe guggulaṃ sadye saumye saugandhikaṃ mukhe | īśāne'pi hyuśīrādi deyād dhūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He shall rise early in the morning and meditate on the lord and the goddess For performing necessaries he shall go out of the house when the sun has risen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall rise early in the morning and meditate on the lord and the goddess For performing necessaries he shall go out of the house when the sun has risen.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्करामधुकर्पूरकपिलाघृतसंयुतम् । चन्दनागरुकाष्ठाद्यं सामान्यं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: śarkarāmadhukarpūrakapilāghṛtasaṃyutam | candanāgarukāṣṭhādyaṃ sāmānyaṃ sampracakṣate
verses.translation: On the eighth and other days whenever tooth-brush twig is not available he shall gargle twelve times and clean the teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eighth and other days whenever tooth-brush twig is not available he shall gargle twelve times and clean the teeth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्पूरवर्तिराज्याढ्या देया दीपावलिस्ततः । अर्घ्यमाचमनं देयं प्रतिवक्त्रमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: karpūravartirājyāḍhyā deyā dīpāvalistataḥ | arghyamācamanaṃ deyaṃ prativaktramataḥ param
verses.translation: After performing Acamana he shall take bath either in a river or in a pond or in an eddy or in the house itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Acamana he shall take bath either in a river or in a pond or in an eddy or in the house itself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमावरणे पूज्यौ क्रमाद्धेरम्बषण्मुखौ । ब्रह्माङ्गानि ततश्चैव प्रथमावरणेऽर्चिते
verses.transliteration: prathamāvaraṇe pūjyau kramāddherambaṣaṇmukhau | brahmāṅgāni tataścaiva prathamāvaraṇe'rcite
verses.translation: The toilet articles shall be kept on the bank. The dirt of the body shall be washed off. The clay shall be app¬ lied over the body. After taking bath he shall apply cow- dung over the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: The toilet articles shall be kept on the bank. The dirt of the body shall be washed off. The clay shall be app¬ lied over the body. After taking bath he shall apply cow- dung over the body.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयावरणे पूज्या विघ्नेशाश्चक्रवर्तिनः । तृतीयावरणे पूज्या भवाद्या अष्टमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyā vighneśāścakravartinaḥ | tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyā bhavādyā aṣṭamūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: He shall take bath again and abandon the old cloth. Like a king he shall put on new dress.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take bath again and abandon the old cloth. Like a king he shall put on new dress.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महादेवादयस्तत्र तथैकादशमूर्तयः । चतुर्थावरणे पूज्याः सर्व एव गणेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: mahādevādayastatra tathaikādaśamūrtayaḥ | caturthāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Neither a Brahmacarin nor an ascetic nor a widow shall take bath with the scented soaps. They shall not use tooth-brush twig for cleaning the teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither a Brahmacarin nor an ascetic nor a widow shall take bath with the scented soaps. They shall not use tooth-brush twig for cleaning the teeth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बहिरेव तु पद्मस्य पञ्चमावरणे क्रमात् । दशदिक्पतयः पूज्याः सास्त्राः सानुचरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: bahireva tu padmasya pañcamāvaraṇe kramāt | daśadikpatayaḥ pūjyāḥ sāstrāḥ sānucarāstathā
verses.translation: He shall tie his tuft and have the sacred thread in the normal way. He shall enter water and plunge therein. After performing the Acamana he shall take plunge thrice in the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall tie his tuft and have the sacred thread in the normal way. He shall enter water and plunge therein. After performing the Acamana he shall take plunge thrice in the water.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो मानसाः पुत्राः सर्वेऽपि ज्योतिषां गणाः । सर्वा देव्यश्च देवाश्च सर्वे सर्वे च खेचराः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrāḥ sarve'pi jyotiṣāṃ gaṇāḥ | sarvā devyaśca devāśca sarve sarve ca khecarāḥ
verses.translation: Or he shall take the self-bath. That is, one shal' repeat the name Siva. That bath wherein Siva is remem¬ bered is called the self-bath of a Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall take the self-bath. That is, one shal' repeat the name Siva. That bath wherein Siva is remem¬ bered is called the self-bath of a Yogin.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पातालवासिनश्चान्ये सर्वे मुनिगणा अपि । योगिनो हि मखाः सर्वे पतङ्गा मातरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: pātālavāsinaścānye sarve munigaṇā api | yogino hi makhāḥ sarve pataṅgā mātarastathā
verses.translation: In accordance with the rules prescribed in one's code he shall perform the rites of Tarpana for the gods beginning with Acamana and ending with Brahmayajfia.
verses.commentary: Sense: In accordance with the rules prescribed in one's code he shall perform the rites of Tarpana for the gods beginning with Acamana and ending with Brahmayajfia.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रपालाश्च सगणाः सर्वं चैतच्चराचरम् । पूजनीयं शिवप्रीत्या मत्वा शम्भुविभूतिमत्
verses.transliteration: kṣetrapālāśca sagaṇāḥ sarvaṃ caitaccarācaram | pūjanīyaṃ śivaprītyā matvā śambhuvibhūtimat
verses.translation: Meditating on lord Siva stationed in the Mani;iala and worshipping him duly he shall offer Arghya to Siva in the form of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditating on lord Siva stationed in the Mani;iala and worshipping him duly he shall offer Arghya to Siva in the form of the sun.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथावरणपूजान्ते सम्पूज्य परमेश्वरम् । साज्यं सव्यजनं हृद्यं हविर्भक्त्या निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: athāvaraṇapūjānte sampūjya parameśvaram | sājyaṃ savyajanaṃ hṛdyaṃ havirbhaktyā nivedayet
verses.translation: Or after performing what is prescribed in one's own Sutra he shall wash his hands and perform the rite of Karanyasa. He shall make his body united with the Kalas through water taken in the left palm and containing scents and white mustard. He shall then sprinkle water over him through the bunch of Kusa grass repeating the mantras 'Apo hi §tha'*' etc. accompanied by the basic mantra. Sniffing at the water remaining in the left nostril he shall think on lord Siva again.
verses.wordMeaning: Or after performing what is prescribed in one's own Sutra he shall wash his hands and perform the rite of Karanyasa. He shall make his body united with the Kalas through water taken in the left palm and containing scents and white mustard.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or after performing what is prescribed in one's own Sutra he shall wash his hands and perform the rite of Karanyasa. He shall make his body united with the Kalas through water taken in the left palm and containing scents and white mustard.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखवासादिकं दत्त्वा ताम्बूलं सोपदंशकम् । अलङ्कृत्य च भूयोऽपि नानापुष्पविभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: mukhavāsādikaṃ dattvā tāmbūlaṃ sopadaṃśakam | alaṅkṛtya ca bhūyo'pi nānāpuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Taking off the dark-complexioned sin of the body through the left nostril and that outside, he shall conceive it as gone to the rock.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking off the dark-complexioned sin of the body through the left nostril and that outside, he shall conceive it as gone to the rock.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नीराजनान्ते विस्तीर्य पूजाशेषं समापयेत् । चषकं सोपकारं च शयनं च समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: nīrājanānte vistīrya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet | caṣakaṃ sopakāraṃ ca śayanaṃ ca samarpayet
verses.translation: With a handful of red sandal water he shall make a circular Mandala on the ground and embellish it with red powder.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a handful of red sandal water he shall make a circular Mandala on the ground and embellish it with red powder.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसङ्काशहारं च शयनीयं समर्पयेत् । आद्यं नृपोचितं हृद्यं तत्सर्वमनुरूपतः
verses.transliteration: candrasaṅkāśahāraṃ ca śayanīyaṃ samarpayet | ādyaṃ nṛpocitaṃ hṛdyaṃ tatsarvamanurūpataḥ
verses.translation: There he shall worship the sun with the covers along with his ancillaries repeating the mantra "Khakholkaya" for securing happiness.*'®
verses.commentary: Sense: There he shall worship the sun with the covers along with his ancillaries repeating the mantra "Khakholkaya" for securing happiness.*'®
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा च कारयित्वा च हुत्वा च प्रतिपूजनम् । व्योमेशस्तवं जप्त्वा विद्यां पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā ca kārayitvā ca hutvā ca pratipūjanam | vyomeśastavaṃ japtvā vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet
verses.translation: VS. II. 50
verses.explanation: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणां प्रणामं च कृत्वात्मानं समर्पयेत् । ततः पुरस्ताद्देवस्य गुरुविप्रौ च पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇāṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtvātmānaṃ samarpayet | tataḥ purastāddevasya guruviprau ca pūjayet
verses.translation: Khakholk&ya svihi. MahSn. U. 2u. 23.
verses.commentary: Sense: Khakholk&ya svihi. MahSn. U. 2u. 23.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वार्घ्यमष्टौ पुष्पाणि देवमुद्वास्य लिङ्गतः । अग्नेश्चाग्निं सुसंयम्य ह्युद्वास्य च तमप्युत
verses.transliteration: dattvārghyamaṣṭau puṣpāṇi devamudvāsya liṅgataḥ | agneścāgniṃ susaṃyamya hyudvāsya ca tamapyuta
verses.translation: He shall make another Maijiala and worship it with its ancillaries. He shall place there a gold-vessel of the size' of the Prastha*'* current in the Magadha land. He shall fill it with scented water and red sandal along with red fldwers, gingelly seeds, Akatas and Kua grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall make another Maijiala and worship it with its ancillaries. He shall place there a gold-vessel of the size' of the Prastha*'* current in the Magadha land. He shall fill it with scented water and red sandal along with red fldwers, gingelly seeds, Akatas and Kua grass.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यहं च जनस्त्वेवं कुर्यात्सेवां पुरोदिताम् । ततस्तत्साम्बुजं लिङ्गं सर्वोपकरणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: pratyahaṃ ca janastvevaṃ kuryātsevāṃ puroditām | tatastatsāmbujaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitam
verses.translation: Then repeating the basic mantra he shall touch all parts of the body and wear another cloth. After perfor¬ ming Acamana twice he shall sprinkle water over himself eleven times repeating the mantra. He shall wear another cloth, perform Acamana twice and remember Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then repeating the basic mantra he shall touch all parts of the body and wear another cloth. After perfor¬ ming Acamana twice he shall sprinkle water over himself eleven times repeating the mantra. He shall wear another cloth, perform Acamana twice and remember Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: समर्पयेत्स्वगुरवे स्थापयेद्वा शिवालये । सम्पूज्य च गुरून्विप्रान् व्रतिनश्च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: samarpayetsvagurave sthāpayedvā śivālaye | sampūjya ca gurūnviprān vratinaśca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He shall perform Karanyasa again and repeating the mantra he shall apply the Tripundra marks. On the fore¬ head the marks shall be clear, broad and straight. Scented water shall be used to paste the Bhasma.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform Karanyasa again and repeating the mantra he shall apply the Tripundra marks. On the fore¬ head the marks shall be clear, broad and straight. Scented water shall be used to paste the Bhasma.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्तान्द्विजांश्च शक्तश्चेद्दीनानाथांश्च तोषयेत् । स्वयं चानशने शक्तः फलमूलाशनोऽथ वा
verses.transliteration: bhaktāndvijāṃśca śaktaśceddīnānāthāṃśca toṣayet | svayaṃ cānaśane śaktaḥ phalamūlāśano'tha vā
verses.translation: The Rudraka bead with the lustre of gold is excellent. It shall not be cut. What is not worn by others is the most auspicious. To the three castes the colours yellow, red and black are respectively excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rudraka bead with the lustre of gold is excellent. It shall not be cut. What is not worn by others is the most auspicious. To the three castes the colours yellow, red and black are respectively excellent.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पयोव्रतो वा भिक्षाशी भवेदेकाशनस्तथा । नक्तं युक्ताशनो नित्यं भूशय्यानिरतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: payovrato vā bhikṣāśī bhavedekāśanastathā | naktaṃ yuktāśano nityaṃ bhūśayyānirataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: Impure men shall not wear the Rudrak$a bead. Everyone shall take bath twice, twice or once a day accor¬ ding to his strength, and worship the lord seated in a char¬ ming pose in the pedestal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Impure men shall not wear the Rudrak$a bead. Everyone shall take bath twice, twice or once a day accor¬ ding to his strength, and worship the lord seated in a char¬ ming pose in the pedestal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भस्मशायी तृणेशायी चीराजिनधृतोऽथ वा । ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतो नित्यं व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: bhasmaśāyī tṛṇeśāyī cīrājinadhṛto'tha vā | brahmacaryavrato nityaṃ vratametatsamācaret
verses.translation: He shall face the east or the north while meditat¬ ing on the lord and the goddess. He shall worship the pre¬ ceptor and the disciples from Sveta to Nakulia.*'*
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall face the east or the north while meditat¬ ing on the lord and the goddess. He shall worship the pre¬ ceptor and the disciples from Sveta to Nakulia.*'*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अर्कवारे तथार्द्रायां पञ्चदश्यां च पक्षयोः । अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां शक्तस्तूपवसेदपि
verses.transliteration: arkavāre tathārdrāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ ca pakṣayoḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ śaktastūpavasedapi
verses.translation: Again he shall bow to the lord and repeat his eight*" names, viz. Siva, Mahesvara, Rudra, Vi9nu, Pitamaha Samsaravaidya, SarvajAa and Paramatman. Or he shall repeat the name Siva eleven times or more.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again he shall bow to the lord and repeat his eight*" names, viz. Siva, Mahesvara, Rudra, Vi9nu, Pitamaha Samsaravaidya, SarvajAa and Paramatman. Or he shall repeat the name Siva eleven times or more.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाखण्डिपतितोदक्याः सूतकान्त्यजपूर्वकान् । वर्जयेत्सर्वयत्नेन मनसा कर्मणा गिरा
verses.transliteration: pākhaṇḍipatitodakyāḥ sūtakāntyajapūrvakān | varjayetsarvayatnena manasā karmaṇā girā
verses.translation: For the removal of sickness he shall meditate on the mass of splendour at the tip of his tongue. He shall wash his feet and apply sandal paste on his hands. He shall perform Karanyasa after wiping off his hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the removal of sickness he shall meditate on the mass of splendour at the tip of his tongue. He shall wash his feet and apply sandal paste on his hands. He shall perform Karanyasa after wiping off his hands.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षमादानदयासत्याहिंसाशीलः सदा भवेत् । सन्तुष्टश्च प्रशान्तश्च जपध्यानरतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kṣamādānadayāsatyāhiṃsāśīlaḥ sadā bhavet | santuṣṭaśca praśāntaśca japadhyānaratastathā
verses.commentary: Sense: Ibid., I 3a. 23-24.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात्त्रिषवणस्नानं भस्मस्नानमथापि वा । पूजां वैशेषिकीं चैव मनसा वचसा गिरा
verses.transliteration: kuryāttriṣavaṇasnānaṃ bhasmasnānamathāpi vā | pūjāṃ vaiśeṣikīṃ caiva manasā vacasā girā
verses.translation: Nyasa*'* is of thfee types: Sthiti, Utpatti and Laya. The first is for householders, the second for Brahmaca- rins, the third for ascetics, forest-dwellers and widows. For housewives the Sthitinyasa is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nyasa*'* is of thfee types: Sthiti, Utpatti and Laya. The first is for householders, the second for Brahmaca- rins, the third for ascetics, forest-dwellers and widows. For housewives the Sthitinyasa is recommended.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन नाचरेदशिवं व्रती । प्रमादात्तु तथाचारे निरूप्य गुरुलाघवे
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena nācaredaśivaṃ vratī | pramādāttu tathācāre nirūpya gurulāghave
verses.translation: For a virgin Utpatti Nyasa is praiseworthy. I shall now mention the characteristics of the Nyasas. The procedure from the thumb to the little finger is the Sthiti- nyasa. The procedure from the right thumb to the left little finger is the Utpattinya. The reverse is Samhrti(Laya).
verses.commentary: Sense: For a virgin Utpatti Nyasa is praiseworthy. I shall now mention the characteristics of the Nyasas. The procedure from the thumb to the little finger is the Sthiti- nyasa. The procedure from the right thumb to the left little finger is the Utpattinya. The reverse is Samhrti(Laya).
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उचितां निष्कृतिं कुर्यात्पूजाहोमजपादिभिः । आसमाप्तेर्व्रतस्यैवमाचरेन्न प्रमादतः
verses.transliteration: ucitāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kuryātpūjāhomajapādibhiḥ | āsamāptervratasyaivamācarenna pramādataḥ
verses.translation: The Astranyasa shall be made in the ten quarters by means of the Astramantra. The five Kalas — Nivrtti etc. in the form of the five elements along with the lords of the elements and accompanied by their respective symbols shall be fixed in the chest, neck, palate, middle of the eye-brows and the Brahmarandhra. One shall conceive them in the different Bijas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Astranyasa shall be made in the ten quarters by means of the Astramantra. The five Kalas — Nivrtti etc. in the form of the five elements along with the lords of the elements and accompanied by their respective symbols shall be fixed in the chest, neck, palate,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Astranyasa shall be made in the ten quarters by means of the Astramantra. The five Kalas — Nivrtti etc. in the form of the five elements along with the lords of the elements and accompanied by their respective symbols shall be fixed in the chest, neck, palate,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गोदानं च वृषोत्सर्गं कुर्यात्पूजां च सम्पदा । भक्तश्च शिवप्रीत्यर्थं सर्वकामविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: godānaṃ ca vṛṣotsargaṃ kuryātpūjāṃ ca sampadā | bhaktaśca śivaprītyarthaṃ sarvakāmavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: In order to purify them one shall perform the Japa of the five-.syllabled mantra. Restraining the vital breath thrice he shall cut off the knot of the elements lepeating the Astra mantra and showing the mystic gesture of Astra. The Atman urged by the vital breath through the Su$umna vein and going out through the Brahmarandhra shall be united with the l§aivite splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: In order to purify them one shall perform the Japa of the five-.syllabled mantra. Restraining the vital breath thrice he shall cut off the knot of the elements lepeating the Astra mantra and showing the mystic gesture of Astra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to purify them one shall perform the Japa of the five-.syllabled mantra. Restraining the vital breath thrice he shall cut off the knot of the elements lepeating the Astra mantra and showing the mystic gesture of Astra.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सामान्यमेतत्कथितं व्रतस्यास्य समासतः । प्रतिमासं विशेषं च प्रवदामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sāmānyametatkathitaṃ vratasyāsya samāsataḥ | pratimāsaṃ viśeṣaṃ ca pravadāmi yathāśrutam
verses.translation: Afterwards the body is withered up by the wind burnt by the deadly fire. Then upwardly the Kalas are dissolved through the wind. Dissolviqg the burnt body and touching the Kalas with the ocean he shall drench and flood the body through Amftas and keep it in its normal
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards the body is withered up by the wind burnt by the deadly fire. Then upwardly the Kalas are dissolved through the wind. Dissolviqg the burnt body and touching the Kalas with the ocean he shall drench and flood the body through Amftas and keep it in its normal
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैशाखे वज्रलिङ्गं तु ज्येष्ठे मारकतं शुभम् । आषाढे मौक्तिकं विद्याच्छ्रावणे नीलनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: vaiśākhe vajraliṅgaṃ tu jyeṣṭhe mārakataṃ śubham | āṣāḍhe mauktikaṃ vidyācchrāvaṇe nīlanirmitam
verses.translation: In the body consisting of Vidya, he shall join the Atman that has come out of liva in the form of the flame of a lamp. He shall join it through the Brahmarandhra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the body consisting of Vidya, he shall join the Atman that has come out of liva in the form of the flame of a lamp. He shall join it through the Brahmarandhra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मासे भाद्रपदे चैव पद्मरागमयं परम् । आश्विने मासि विद्याद्वै लिङ्गं गोमेदकं वरम्
verses.transliteration: māse bhādrapade caiva padmarāgamayaṃ param | āśvine māsi vidyādvai liṅgaṃ gomedakaṃ varam
verses.translation: After meditating on the Atman that has entered the body, in the lotus of the heart, he shall sprinkle with the shower of nectar the body consisting of Vidya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating on the Atman that has entered the body, in the lotus of the heart, he shall sprinkle with the shower of nectar the body consisting of Vidya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कार्तिक्यां वैद्रुमं लिङ्गं वैदूर्यं मार्गशीर्षके । पुष्परागमयं पौषे माघे द्युमणिजं तथा
verses.transliteration: kārtikyāṃ vaidrumaṃ liṅgaṃ vaidūryaṃ mārgaśīrṣake | puṣparāgamayaṃ pauṣe māghe dyumaṇijaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Then he shall perform the rite of Karanyasa after duly purifying it. Thereafter he shall perform the Dehanya by means of the great Mudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall perform the rite of Karanyasa after duly purifying it. Thereafter he shall perform the Dehanya by means of the great Mudra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: फाल्गुणे चन्द्रकान्तोत्थं चैत्रे तद्व्यत्ययोऽथवा । सर्वमासेषु रत्नानामलाभे हैममेव वा
verses.transliteration: phālguṇe candrakāntotthaṃ caitre tadvyatyayo'thavā | sarvamāseṣu ratnānāmalābhe haimameva vā
verses.translation: After performing the rite of Ahganyasa in the manner mentioned by Siva, he shall perform the Varnanyasa in the joints of hands, feet and other parts of the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the rite of Ahganyasa in the manner mentioned by Siva, he shall perform the Varnanyasa in the joints of hands, feet and other parts of the body.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हैमाभावे राजतं वा ताम्रजं शैलजं तथा । मृण्मयं वा यथालाभं जातुषं चान्यदेव वा
verses.transliteration: haimābhāve rājataṃ vā tāmrajaṃ śailajaṃ tathā | mṛṇmayaṃ vā yathālābhaṃ jātuṣaṃ cānyadeva vā
verses.translation: After the Nyasa of the six limbs accompanied by six types, he shall bind the quarters from the south-east onwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the Nyasa of the six limbs accompanied by six types, he shall bind the quarters from the south-east onwards.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगन्धमयं वाथ लिङ्गं कुर्याद्यथारुचि । व्रतावसानसमये समाचरितनित्यकः
verses.transliteration: sarvagandhamayaṃ vātha liṅgaṃ kuryādyathāruci | vratāvasānasamaye samācaritanityakaḥ
verses.translation: Or he need p>erform only the Nyasa of the five limbs beginning with the head. Similarly the Nyasa of six limbs without the rites of purification etc. of the Bhutas shall be i>erformcd.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he need p>erform only the Nyasa of the five limbs beginning with the head. Similarly the Nyasa of six limbs without the rites of purification etc. of the Bhutas shall be i>erformcd.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वैशेषिकीं पूजां हुत्वा चैव यथा पुरा । सम्पूज्य च तथाचार्यं व्रतिनश्च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vaiśeṣikīṃ pūjāṃ hutvā caiva yathā purā | sampūjya ca tathācāryaṃ vratinaśca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Thus he shall succinctly perform the purification of the body and Atman. Attaining the status of Siva he shall worship Parameivara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he shall succinctly perform the purification of the body and Atman. Attaining the status of Siva he shall worship Parameivara.

verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा शक्तितो मूलं ध्यात्वा साम्बं त्रियम्बकम् । अनुज्ञाप्य यथापूर्वं नमस्कृत्य कृताञ्जलिः

verses.translation: After performing the Nyasa of the letters in the manner of fifty Rudras the five Brahmans shall be fixed in the limbs, face etc. and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Nyasa of the letters in the manner of fifty Rudras the five Brahmans shall be fixed in the limbs, face etc. and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: समुत्सृजामि भगवन् व्रतमेतत्त्वदाज्ञया । इत्युक्त्वा लिङ्गमूलस्थान्दर्भानुत्तरतस्त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: samutsṛjāmi bhagavan vratametattvadājñayā | ityuktvā liṅgamūlasthāndarbhānuttaratastyajet
verses.translation: The Karanyasa may or may not be performed through them. The Brahmans shall be fixed in the head, face, chest, private parts and legs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Karanyasa may or may not be performed through them. The Brahmans shall be fixed in the head, face, chest, private parts and legs.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दण्डजटाचीरमेखला अपि चोत्सृजेत् । पुनराचम्य विधिवत्पञ्चाक्षरमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato daṇḍajaṭācīramekhalā api cotsṛjet | punarācamya vidhivatpañcākṣaramudīrayet
verses.translation: The Kalas of liana are five; these are fixed in the five faces beginning with the one above and ending with the one in the west.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalas of liana are five; these are fixed in the five faces beginning with the one above and ending with the one in the west.

verses.sanskrit: यः कृत्वात्यन्तिकीं दीक्षामादेहान्तमनाकुलः । व्रतमेतत्प्रकुर्वीत स तु वै नैष्ठिकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kṛtvātyantikīṃ dīkṣāmādehāntamanākulaḥ | vratametatprakurvīta sa tu vai naiṣṭhikaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then the four Kalas of Puru$a shall be fixed in the four faces beginning with the' one in the east.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the four Kalas of Puru$a shall be fixed in the four faces beginning with the' one in the east.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽत्याश्रमी च विज्ञेयो महापाशुपतस्तथा । स एव तपतां श्रेष्ठः स एव च महाव्रती
verses.transliteration: so'tyāśramī ca vijñeyo mahāpāśupatastathā | sa eva tapatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sa eva ca mahāvratī
verses.translation: Th" eight Kalas of Aghora shall be fixed in the heart, neck, shoulders, navel, belly, back and the chest; then the thirteen Kalas of Vamadeva are fixed in the anus, penis, thighs, knees, calves, hips, buttocks, side», nose, head and the arms. Thus the experts perform the Nyasa of the thirtyeight Kalas in due order.
verses.wordMeaning: Th" eight Kalas of Aghora shall be fixed in the heart, neck, shoulders, navel, belly, back and the chest; then the thirteen Kalas of Vamadeva are fixed in the anus, penis, thighs, knees, calves, hips, buttocks, side», nose, head and the arms.…

verses.sanskrit: न तेन सदृशः कश्चित्कृतकृत्यो मुमुक्षुषु । यो यतिर्नैष्ठिको जातस्तमाहुर्नैष्ठिकोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścitkṛtakṛtyo mumukṣuṣu | yo yatirnaiṣṭhiko jātastamāhurnaiṣṭhikottamam
verses.translation: Afterwards the experts ofPranava shall per¬ form the Pranavanyasa in the arms, elbows wrists, sides, belly, thighs, calves and the back. After performing the Pranavanyasa thus, the expert devotee shall perform the Hamsanya as mentioned in Saivite scriptures, in the eyes, nostrils, arms, eyes, face, forehead, armpits sides, breasts, hips, hands and heels. Or in the manner of five limbs the Nyasa shall be performed. Then he shall perform the Nyasa of the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: Afterwards the experts ofPranava shall per¬ form the Pranavanyasa in the arms, elbows wrists, sides, belly, thighs, calves and the back. After performing the Pranavanyasa thus, the expert devotee shall perform the Hamsanya as mentioned in Saivite scriptures, in the eyes,…

verses.sanskrit: योऽन्वहं द्वादशाहं वा व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् । सोऽपि नैष्ठिकतुल्यः स्यात्तीव्रव्रतसमन्वयात्
verses.transliteration: yo'nvahaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā vratametatsamācaret | so'pi naiṣṭhikatulyaḥ syāttīvravratasamanvayāt
verses.translation: A person with a desire, even when he enjoys those pleasures becomes more and more attached to lust. If he is without desire he enjoys pleasures in Rudra's abode and after a descent therefrom is reborn as a person engaged in Tapoyajfia. There is no doubt in this. An ascetic enjoys pleasures in Rudra's abode and after a fall therefrom is reborn in the world as a man devoted to Japa and Dhyana. Such a man devoted to Japa and Dhyana, thanks to heir excellence, attains knowledge ere long, and thereby attains Siva*s Sayujya. Hence he becomes a liberated soul even when he is devoted to Karmayajfia at the behest of Siva, if he is without desire. But a person with lust will always be in bondage. Hence one shall be devoted to Dhyana and Jfiana among the five Yajfias.
verses.wordMeaning: A person with a desire, even when he enjoys those pleasures becomes more and more attached to lust. If he is without desire he enjoys pleasures in Rudra's abode and after a descent therefrom is reborn as a person engaged in Tapoyajfia. There is no doubt in this.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person with a desire, even when he enjoys those pleasures becomes more and more attached to lust. If he is without desire he enjoys pleasures in Rudra's abode and after a descent therefrom is reborn as a person engaged in Tapoyajfia. There is no doubt in this.…

verses.sanskrit: घृताक्तो यश्चरेदेतद् व्रतं व्रतपरायणः । द्वित्रैकदिवसं वापि स च कश्चन नैष्ठिकः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtākto yaścaredetad vrataṃ vrataparāyaṇaḥ | dvitraikadivasaṃ vāpi sa ca kaścana naiṣṭhikaḥ
verses.translation: He who has meditation and knowledge crosses the ocean of worldly existence. Dhyanayajfia which is freedom from the defects of violence etc. is a pure mental process for salvation and is therefore the greatest means. Just as the persons working outside the palace are seen not enjoying much of the benefits within the royal palace so also the Karmins. To those who meditate, the subtle body of Ivara becomes visible. But to the Karmins, only the clay, wood etc. are visible. Hence those who are devoted to Dhya¬ nayajfia do not accept deities in the form of stone and day, since they know the reality of Siva.
verses.wordMeaning: He who has meditation and knowledge crosses the ocean of worldly existence. Dhyanayajfia which is freedom from the defects of violence etc. is a pure mental process for salvation and is therefore the greatest means.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has meditation and knowledge crosses the ocean of worldly existence. Dhyanayajfia which is freedom from the defects of violence etc. is a pure mental process for salvation and is therefore the greatest means.…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्यमित्येव निष्कामो यश्चरेद् व्रतमुत्तमम् । शिवार्पितात्मा सततं न तेन सदृशः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kṛtyamityeva niṣkāmo yaścared vratamuttamam | śivārpitātmā satataṃ na tena sadṛśaḥ kvacit
verses.translation: The man who eschews Siva stationed in the Atman and w'orships him externally, resigns the fruit in his hand and licks his elbow. From knowledge, meditation is generated and from meditation knowledge functions better. Through these two, one attains liberation. Hence one shall be devoted to meditation.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मच्छन्नो द्विजो विद्वान्महापातकसम्भवैः । पापैः सुदारुणैः सद्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhasmacchanno dvijo vidvānmahāpātakasambhavaiḥ | pāpaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ sadyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: I shall briefly give a commentary to the rules governing worships mentioned by Siva to Siva in the Saivite scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall briefly give a commentary to the rules governing worships mentioned by Siva to Siva in the Saivite scriptures.

verses.transliteration: rudrāgniryatparaṃ vīryaṃ tadbhasma parikīrtitam | tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu vīryavānbhasmasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: With or without performing the internal worship which is its ancillary and which concludes with the rites in fire, one shall perform the external worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: With or without performing the internal worship which is its ancillary and which concludes with the rites in fire, one shall perform the external worship.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मनिष्ठस्य नश्यन्ति देषा भस्माग्निसङ्गमात् । भस्मस्नानविशुद्धात्मा भस्मनिष्ठ इति स्मृतः

verses.translation: The materials arc mentally conceived and purified. After meditating on Vinayaka and worshipping the lord in accordance with the injunctions, the learned devotee shall propitiate Nandisa and Suyasa in the south and the north and ofier mentally well-conceived seat.

verses.translation: It may be a throne or a yogic scat or lotus-seat equipped with the three principles."*
verses.commentary: Sense: It may be a throne or a yogic scat or lotus-seat equipped with the three principles."*

verses.sanskrit: भूतप्रेतपिशासाश्च रोगाश्चातीव दुस्सहाः । भस्मनिष्ठस्य सान्निध्याद् विद्रवन्ति न संशयः

verses.translation: His hands show the gestures of granting the boon and protection. He holds the deer and an axe. He Kas serpents for necklaces and bangles. His neck is chnnpSlgly blue.
verses.commentary: Sense: His hands show the gestures of granting the boon and protection. He holds the deer and an axe. He Kas serpents for necklaces and bangles. His neck is chnnpSlgly blue.

verses.sanskrit: भासनाद्भसितं प्रोक्तं भस्म कल्मषभक्षणात् । भूतिः भूतिकरी चैव रक्षा रक्षाकरी परम्
verses.transliteration: bhāsanādbhasitaṃ proktaṃ bhasma kalmaṣabhakṣaṇāt | bhūtiḥ bhūtikarī caiva rakṣā rakṣākarī param
verses.translation: Her complexion has the lustre of the petals of a blue lotus. She has the half modn for her coronet. Her breasts are round, weighty, lifted up, smooth nad plump.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her complexion has the lustre of the petals of a blue lotus. She has the half modn for her coronet. Her breasts are round, weighty, lifted up, smooth nad plump.

verses.sanskrit: किमन्यदिह वक्तव्यं भस्ममाहात्म्यकारणम् । व्रती च भस्मना स्नातः स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kimanyadiha vaktavyaṃ bhasmamāhātmyakāraṇam | vratī ca bhasmanā snātaḥ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: She shines with flowers of various colours embellish¬ ing her braid of hair. In fevery respect her features are in consonance with her qualities. Due to bashfulness her face is slightly lowered.
verses.commentary: Sense: She shines with flowers of various colours embellish¬ ing her braid of hair. In fevery respect her features are in consonance with her qualities. Due to bashfulness her face is slightly lowered.

verses.sanskrit: परमास्त्रं च शैवानां भस्मैतत्पारमेश्वरम् । धौम्याग्रजस्य तपसि व्यापदो यन्निवारिताः
verses.transliteration: paramāstraṃ ca śaivānāṃ bhasmaitatpārameśvaram | dhaumyāgrajasya tapasi vyāpado yannivāritāḥ
verses.translation: In her right hand she bears a shining golden lotus. She is seated on a splendid seat with the other hand placed on it like a supporting staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: In her right hand she bears a shining golden lotus. She is seated on a splendid seat with the other hand placed on it like a supporting staff.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कृत्वा पाशुपतव्रतम् । धनवद्भस्म सङ्गृह्य भस्मस्नानरतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena kṛtvā pāśupatavratam | dhanavadbhasma saṅgṛhya bhasmasnānarato bhavet
verses.translation: She splits the Pala. She is in the form of exis¬ tence, knowledge and bliss. After conceiving the lord and the goddess thus and meditating on them in an excellent auspicious seat, the devotee shall worship with piety as flowers along with all types of service. Or he can conceive the form of the lord in any of the following ways: — as $iva, Sadasiva, Mahesvara, or as one havihg the name of twenty- six principles or as rikantha. Just as Mantra Nyasa is performed in the body so also in this form the devotee can meditate on embodied iiva who is beyond Sat and Asat as in the manner of external worship. He shall complete the wor¬ ship mentally.
verses.wordMeaning: She splits the Pala. She is in the form of exis¬ tence, knowledge and bliss. After conceiving the lord and the goddess thus and meditating on them in an excellent auspicious seat, the devotee shall worship with piety as flowers along with all types of service.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She splits the Pala. She is in the form of exis¬ tence, knowledge and bliss. After conceiving the lord and the goddess thus and meditating on them in an excellent auspicious seat, the devotee shall worship with piety as flowers along with all types of service.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyasa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be ar¬ ranged.
verses.commentary: Sense: The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyasa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be ar¬ ranged.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyasa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be ar¬ ranged.
verses.commentary: Sense: The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyasa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be ar¬ ranged.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३४. चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । उपमन्युतपोवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । धौम्याग्रजेन शिशुना क्षीरार्थं हि तपः कृतम् । तस्मात् क्षीरार्णवो दत्तस्तस्मै देवेन शूलिना
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.34. catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | upamanyutapovarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | dhaumyāgrajena śiśunā kṣīrārthaṃ hi tapaḥ kṛtam | tasmāt kṣīrārṇavo dattastasmai devena śūlinā
verses.translation: Darbha grass shall be strewn over and washed by means of sprinkling. After cleaning the vessels he shall sanctify the materials.
verses.commentary: Sense: Darbha grass shall be strewn over and washed by means of sprinkling. After cleaning the vessels he shall sanctify the materials.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स कथं शिशुको लेभे शिवशास्त्रप्रवक्तृताम् । कथं वा शिवसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा तपसि निष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: sa kathaṃ śiśuko lebhe śivaśāstrapravaktṛtām | kathaṃ vā śivasadbhāvaṃ jñātvā tapasi niṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: In the north the wife of the doorkeeper, the daughter of the Maruts, Suya who bedecks the feet of Amba shall be worshipped. He shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of Brahma and worship the Lihga. The remnants of the previous worship shall be removed. It shall be washed..The flower shall be worn on the head for the sake of purity.
verses.wordMeaning: In the north the wife of the doorkeeper, the daughter of the Maruts, Suya who bedecks the feet of Amba shall be worshipped. He shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of Brahma and worship the Lihga. The remnants of the previous worship shall be removed.…

verses.sanskrit: कथं च लब्धविज्ञानस्तपश्चरणपर्वणि । रुद्राग्नेर्यत्परं वीर्यं लभे भस्म स्वरक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ ca labdhavijñānastapaścaraṇaparvaṇi | rudrāgneryatparaṃ vīryaṃ labhe bhasma svarakṣakam
verses.translation: The devotee shall rub the idol with the leaves of Bilva etc. for the removal of the smell. Again he shall bathe it with water. Royal service shall be rendered, such as the appliances of scents myrobalan or turmeric paste. Again the phallic and the embodied image shall be washed with scented water, sprinkled with Kusa grass and flowers or with the water from gold and gemset vessels purified by the chanting of mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall rub the idol with the leaves of Bilva etc. for the removal of the smell. Again he shall bathe it with water. Royal service shall be rendered, such as the appliances of scents myrobalan or turmeric paste.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall rub the idol with the leaves of Bilva etc. for the removal of the smell. Again he shall bathe it with water. Royal service shall be rendered, such as the appliances of scents myrobalan or turmeric paste.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । न ह्येष शिशुकः कश्चित्प्राकृतः कृतवांस्तपः । मुनिवर्यस्य तनयो व्याघ्रपादस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | na hyeṣa śiśukaḥ kaścitprākṛtaḥ kṛtavāṃstapaḥ | munivaryasya tanayo vyāghrapādasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: After offering water for drinking he shall offer Acamana once again. Tambula with five-scented*" spices shall be offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering water for drinking he shall offer Acamana once again. Tambula with five-scented*" spices shall be offered.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्तरेण संसिद्धः केनापि खलु हेतुना । स्वपदप्रच्युतो दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो मुनिकुमारताम्
verses.transliteration: janmāntareṇa saṃsiddhaḥ kenāpi khalu hetunā | svapadapracyuto diṣṭyā prāpto munikumāratām
verses.translation: In the Yoga, meditation, Japa and homa whether external or internal, the Havis of six types shall be given as pure rice or rice mixed with green gram. The milk-pudding mixed with curd or honey-soaked jaggery shall be offered with side-dishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Yoga, meditation, Japa and homa whether external or internal, the Havis of six types shall be given as pure rice or rice mixed with green gram. The milk-pudding mixed with curd or honey-soaked jaggery shall be offered with side-dishes.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महादेवप्रसादस्य भाग्यापन्नस्य भाविनः । दुग्धाभिलाषप्रभवद्वारतामगमत्तपः
verses.transliteration: mahādevaprasādasya bhāgyāpannasya bhāvinaḥ | dugdhābhilāṣaprabhavadvāratāmagamattapaḥ
verses.translation: Water taken from an east-flowing or west- flowing river is excellent for bath and drink. It shall be cool and filtered with a cloth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Water taken from an east-flowing or west- flowing river is excellent for bath and drink. It shall be cool and filtered with a cloth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतः सर्वगणेशत्वं कुमारत्वं च शाश्वतम् । सह दुग्धाब्धिना तस्मै प्रददौ शङ्करः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ sarvagaṇeśatvaṃ kumāratvaṃ ca śāśvatam | saha dugdhābdhinā tasmai pradadau śaṅkaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: The umbrella shall resemble the moon. It shall be embellished with pearls and nine*®* varieties of gems. It shall be divine and charming with a golden handle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The umbrella shall resemble the moon. It shall be embellished with pearls and nine*®* varieties of gems. It shall be divine and charming with a golden handle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ज्ञानागमोऽप्यस्य प्रसादादेव शाङ्करात् । कौमारं हि परं साक्षाज्ज्ञानं शक्तिमयं विदुः
verses.transliteration: tasya jñānāgamo'pyasya prasādādeva śāṅkarāt | kaumāraṃ hi paraṃ sākṣājjñānaṃ śaktimayaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: The chowries shall be white and fine. They shall be embellished with gold. The handle shall be studded with gems. They shall shine like two royal swans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chowries shall be white and fine. They shall be embellished with gold. The handle shall be studded with gems. They shall shine like two royal swans.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवशास्त्रप्रवक्तृत्वमपि तस्य हि तत्कृतम् । कुमारोमुखतो लब्धज्ञानाब्धेरिव नन्दिनः
verses.transliteration: śivaśāstrapravaktṛtvamapi tasya hi tatkṛtam | kumāromukhato labdhajñānābdheriva nandinaḥ
verses.translation: The mirror shall be smooth and polished. Divine sweet smelling unguents shall be smeared over it. It shall be studded with gems all round. It shall be decorated with excellent garlands.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mirror shall be smooth and polished. Divine sweet smelling unguents shall be smeared over it. It shall be studded with gems all round. It shall be decorated with excellent garlands.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं तु कारणं तस्य शिवज्ञानसमन्वये । स्वमातृवचनं साक्षाच्छोकजं क्षीरकारणात्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tasya śivajñānasamanvaye | svamātṛvacanaṃ sākṣācchokajaṃ kṣīrakāraṇāt
verses.translation: He shall wash and sprinkle the vessels®®® of Prok§ani Arghya, Padya and Acamanlya. After examining them he shall pour auspicious water therein. He shall place holy materials of worship there to the extent of their availability.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall wash and sprinkle the vessels®®® of Prok§ani Arghya, Padya and Acamanlya. After examining them he shall pour auspicious water therein. He shall place holy materials of worship there to the extent of their availability.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्क्षीरमत्यल्पं पीतवान्मातुलाश्रमे । ईर्ष्यया मातुलसुतं सन्तृप्तक्षीरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kadācitkṣīramatyalpaṃ pītavānmātulāśrame | īrṣyayā mātulasutaṃ santṛptakṣīramuttamam
verses.translation: The holy materials of worship are many such as gems, silver, gold, scents, flowers, Aksatas, fruits, sprouts and Darbha grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy materials of worship are many such as gems, silver, gold, scents, flowers, Aksatas, fruits, sprouts and Darbha grass.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा स्थितं यथाकामं दृष्ट्वा वै मातुलात्मजम् । उपमन्युर्व्याघ्रपादिः प्रीत्या प्रोवाच मातरम्
verses.transliteration: pītvā sthitaṃ yathākāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai mātulātmajam | upamanyurvyāghrapādiḥ prītyā provāca mātaram
verses.translation: In the water for ablutiop and particularly in that
verses.commentary: Sense: In the water for ablutiop and particularly in that
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । मातर्मातर्महाभागे मम देहि तपस्विनि । गव्यं क्षीरमतिस्वादु नाल्पमुष्णं पिबाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | mātarmātarmahābhāge mama dehi tapasvini | gavyaṃ kṣīramatisvādu nālpamuṣṇaṃ pibāmyaham
verses.translation: Prok;aol, Arghya, P&dya and Acamanlya are the vessels con¬ taining holy water to be used in the religious ceremonies. Prokanl contains water used for sprinkling or consecrating, Arghya for respectful ofTcring, Padya for washing the feet and Acamanlya for supping.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prok;aol, Arghya, P&dya and Acamanlya are the vessels con¬ taining holy water to be used in the religious ceremonies. Prokanl contains water used for sprinkling or consecrating, Arghya for respectful ofTcring, Padya for washing the feet and Acamanlya for supping.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचनं तन्माता च तपस्विनी । व्याघ्रपादस्य महिषी दुःखमापत्तदा च सा
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | tacchrutvā putravacanaṃ tanmātā ca tapasvinī | vyāghrapādasya mahiṣī duḥkhamāpattadā ca sā
verses.translation: Sandal and Uira shall be put in the Padya water. In the Acamsmiya, nutmeg, berry, camphor, Bahumflla, and Tamalaka shall be put, preferably powdered* Cardamom seeds, camphor and sandal can be put in the vessels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sandal and Uira shall be put in the Padya water. In the Acamsmiya, nutmeg, berry, camphor, Bahumflla, and Tamalaka shall be put, preferably powdered* Cardamom seeds, camphor and sandal can be put in the vessels.

verses.sanskrit: उपलाल्याथ सुप्रीत्या पुत्रमालिङ्ग्य सादरम् । दुःखिता विललापाथ स्मृत्वा नैर्धन्यमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: upalālyātha suprītyā putramāliṅgya sādaram | duḥkhitā vilalāpātha smṛtvā nairdhanyamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The following materials shall be put in the Prokani vessel: — KuSa, flowers, Yava grains, Bahumula and Tamalaka along with Bhasma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following materials shall be put in the Prokani vessel: — KuSa, flowers, Yava grains, Bahumula and Tamalaka along with Bhasma.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा पुनः क्षीरमुपमन्युः स बालकः । देहि देहीति तामाह रुद्रन्भूयो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ kṣīramupamanyuḥ sa bālakaḥ | dehi dehīti tāmāha rudranbhūyo mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: Every vessel shall be blessed by chanting the mantras; externally covered by the Varma mantra and protected by Astra mantra. He shall show the Mudra of cow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every vessel shall be blessed by chanting the mantras; externally covered by the Varma mantra and protected by Astra mantra. He shall show the Mudra of cow.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद् हठं सा परिज्ञाय द्विजपत्नी तपस्विनी । शान्तये तद् हठस्याथ शुभोपायमरीरचत्
verses.transliteration: tad haṭhaṃ sā parijñāya dvijapatnī tapasvinī | śāntaye tad haṭhasyātha śubhopāyamarīracat
verses.translation: He shall purify the materials of worship by means of the water from the vessel ProksanI sprinkled on them repeating the basic mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall purify the materials of worship by means of the water from the vessel ProksanI sprinkled on them repeating the basic mantra.

verses.sanskrit: उञ्छवृत्त्यार्जितान्बीजान्स्वयं दृष्ट्वा च सा तदा । बीजपिष्टमथालोड्य तोयेन कलभाषिणी
verses.transliteration: uñchavṛttyārjitānbījānsvayaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sā tadā | bījapiṣṭamathāloḍya toyena kalabhāṣiṇī
verses.translation: If all the vessels are not available the excellent aspirant shall arrange the vessel Prokani in every holy rite. Arghya etc. shall be performed by the water therefrom.
verses.commentary: Sense: If all the vessels are not available the excellent aspirant shall arrange the vessel Prokani in every holy rite. Arghya etc. shall be performed by the water therefrom.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एह्येहि मम पुत्रेति सामपूर्वं ततः सुतम् । आलिङ्ग्यादाय दुःखार्ता प्रददौ कृत्रिमं पयः
verses.transliteration: ehyehi mama putreti sāmapūrvaṃ tataḥ sutam | āliṅgyādāya duḥkhārtā pradadau kṛtrimaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Vinayaka shall be worshipped with various foodstuffs. After that, near the southern doorway he shall duly worship the chief of harem Nandin himself. He resem¬ bles the golden mountain in lustre. He is bedecked in all ornaments. The crescent moon is his coronet. He is gentle. He has three eyes and four arms. He is:he lord bearing shining trident, deer, axe and sharp-pointed baton. His face
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Vinayaka shall be worshipped with various foodstuffs. After that, near the southern doorway he shall duly worship the chief of harem Nandin himself. He resem¬ bles the golden mountain in lustre. He is bedecked in all ornaments. The crescent moon is his coronet.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Vinayaka shall be worshipped with various foodstuffs. After that, near the southern doorway he shall duly worship the chief of harem Nandin himself. He resem¬ bles the golden mountain in lustre. He is bedecked in all ornaments. The crescent moon is his coronet.…

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं क्षीरं मात्रां दत्तं स बालकः । नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चातिविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: pītvā ca kṛtrimaṃ kṣīraṃ mātrāṃ dattaṃ sa bālakaḥ | naitatkṣīramiti prāha mātaraṃ cātivihvalaḥ
verses.translation: With the flower in the hand he shall perform the Japa of the mantra up to the extent of his ability for the purity; through the Mantra Caneja shall be worshipped in the north-east and the Nirmalya given over to him
verses.commentary: Sense: With the flower in the hand he shall perform the Japa of the mantra up to the extent of his ability for the purity; through the Mantra Caneja shall be worshipped in the north-east and the Nirmalya given over to him
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुःखिता सा तदा प्राह सम्प्रेक्ष्याघ्राय मूर्द्धनि । सम्मार्ज्य नेत्र पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलायते
verses.transliteration: duḥkhitā sā tadā prāha samprekṣyāghrāya mūrddhani | sammārjya netra putrasya karābhyāṃ kamalāyate
verses.translation: Thereafter the seats Adhara etc. shall be conceived. The Adhara §akti shall be meditated upon as dark-complexioned and auspicious resting on the ground. In front of Adhara &ikti the serpent of curly form with uplifted neck shall be conceived. He is white in colour with five hoods seeming to lick the sky. Above that is the seat in the form of a lion of four feet. The feet are virtue, knowledge, absence of attachment, glory and prosperity.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the seats Adhara etc. shall be conceived. The Adhara §akti shall be meditated upon as dark-complexioned and auspicious resting on the ground. In front of Adhara &ikti the serpent of curly form with uplifted neck shall be conceived.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the seats Adhara etc. shall be conceived. The Adhara §akti shall be meditated upon as dark-complexioned and auspicious resting on the ground. In front of Adhara &ikti the serpent of curly form with uplifted neck shall be conceived.…

verses.sanskrit: जनन्युवाच । तटिनी रत्नपूर्णास्ताः स्वर्गपातालगोचराः । भाग्यहीना न पश्यन्ति भक्तिहीनाश्च ये शिवे
verses.transliteration: jananyuvāca | taṭinī ratnapūrṇāstāḥ svargapātālagocarāḥ | bhāgyahīnā na paśyanti bhaktihīnāśca ye śive
verses.translation: They are respectively in the south-east, south¬ west, north-west and north-east and are coloured white, red yellow and black. Adharma etc. are in the directions east etc. ending with the north. His bodies shall be conceived resembling the jewel Rajavarta. * Covering for him is the pure white lotus seat.
verses.wordMeaning: They are respectively in the south-east, south¬ west, north-west and north-east and are coloured white, red yellow and black. Adharma etc. are in the directions east etc. ending with the north. His bodies shall be conceived resembling the jewel Rajavarta.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are respectively in the south-east, south¬ west, north-west and north-east and are coloured white, red yellow and black. Adharma etc. are in the directions east etc. ending with the north. His bodies shall be conceived resembling the jewel Rajavarta.…
