verses.sanskrit: राज्यं स्वर्गं च मोक्षं च भोजनं क्षीरसम्भवम् । न लभन्ते प्रियाण्येषां न तुष्यति यदा शिवः
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca bhojanaṃ kṣīrasambhavam | na labhante priyāṇyeṣāṃ na tuṣyati yadā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Its petals are eight in number representing the eight attributes, Anima etc. The filaments are the Rudras Varna etc. in the company of Varna and other Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its petals are eight in number representing the eight attributes, Anima etc. The filaments are the Rudras Varna etc. in the company of Varna and other Saktis.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भवप्रसादजं सर्वं नान्यद्देवप्रसादजम् । अन्यदेवेषु निरता दुःखार्ता विभ्रमन्ति च
verses.transliteration: bhavaprasādajaṃ sarvaṃ nānyaddevaprasādajam | anyadeveṣu niratā duḥkhārtā vibhramanti ca
verses.translation: The seeds too are those Saktis alone Manonmani etc. within. The pericarp is the greatest detachment and the stalk is the Saivite knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seeds too are those Saktis alone Manonmani etc. within. The pericarp is the greatest detachment and the stalk is the Saivite knowledge.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरं तत्र कुतोऽस्माकं वने निवसतां सदा । क्व दुग्धसाधनं वत्स क्व वयं वनवासिनः
verses.transliteration: kṣīraṃ tatra kuto'smākaṃ vane nivasatāṃ sadā | kva dugdhasādhanaṃ vatsa kva vayaṃ vanavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: The bulbous root at the extremity of the pericarp with the three zones shall be used in the iSaivite rites. Over the three zones the three Tattvas, Atman etc. are the seats.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bulbous root at the extremity of the pericarp with the three zones shall be used in the iSaivite rites. Over the three zones the three Tattvas, Atman etc. are the seats.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्स्नाभावेन दारिद्र्यान्मया ते भाग्यहीनया । मिथ्यादुग्धमिदं दत्तं पिष्टमालोड्य वारिणा
verses.transliteration: kṛtsnābhāvena dāridryānmayā te bhāgyahīnayā | mithyādugdhamidaṃ dattaṃ piṣṭamāloḍya vāriṇā
verses.translation: Above the seats shall be conceived the divine seat refulgent with the pure learning or knowledge, very comfor¬ table and covered over by a covering sheet of colours.
verses.commentary: Sense: Above the seats shall be conceived the divine seat refulgent with the pure learning or knowledge, very comfor¬ table and covered over by a covering sheet of colours.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं मातुलगृहे स्वल्पं पीत्वा स्वादु पयः श्रुतम् । ज्ञात्वा स्वादु त्वया पीतं तज्जातीयमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ mātulagṛhe svalpaṃ pītvā svādu payaḥ śrutam | jñātvā svādu tvayā pītaṃ tajjātīyamanusmaran
verses.translation: He shall perform the rites of invocation, installation prevention, surveying and obeisance showing separate Mudras for each.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the rites of invocation, installation prevention, surveying and obeisance showing separate Mudras for each.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दत्तं न पय इत्युक्त्वा रुदन् दुःखीकरोषि माम् । प्रसादेन विना शम्भोः पयस्तव न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: dattaṃ na paya ityuktvā rudan duḥkhīkaroṣi mām | prasādena vinā śambhoḥ payastava na vidyate
verses.translation: After offering Padya, Acamana, Arghya, scents, flowers, incense, light and Tambula, the devotee shall perform the ablution of l§iva and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering Padya, Acamana, Arghya, scents, flowers, incense, light and Tambula, the devotee shall perform the ablution of l§iva and Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पादपङ्कजयोस्तस्य साम्बस्य सगणस्य च । भक्त्या समर्पितं यत्तत्कारणं सर्वसम्पदाम्
verses.transliteration: pādapaṅkajayostasya sāmbasya sagaṇasya ca | bhaktyā samarpitaṃ yattatkāraṇaṃ sarvasampadām
verses.translation: Or after conceiving the seat and the deity thus and uniting it into a complete unit with the five Brahmans and others, repeating the basic mantra, the devotee shall in¬ voke Siva the great cause along with the goddess. The lord is as pure as the crystal, steady and imperishable. He is the
verses.wordMeaning: Or after conceiving the seat and the deity thus and uniting it into a complete unit with the five Brahmans and others, repeating the basic mantra, the devotee shall in¬ voke Siva the great cause along with the goddess. The lord is as pure as the crystal,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or after conceiving the seat and the deity thus and uniting it into a complete unit with the five Brahmans and others, repeating the basic mantra, the devotee shall in¬ voke Siva the great cause along with the goddess. The lord is as pure as the crystal,…

verses.sanskrit: अधुना वसुदोऽस्माभिर्महादेवो न पूजितः । सकामानां यथाकामं यथोक्तफलदायकः
verses.transliteration: adhunā vasudo'smābhirmahādevo na pūjitaḥ | sakāmānāṃ yathākāmaṃ yathoktaphaladāyakaḥ
verses.translation: If the materials are not available whatever is available shall be used. Mere water with chantings of mantra can also be used for the ablution of Siva. The devotee shall faithfully perform the rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the materials are not available whatever is available shall be used. Mere water with chantings of mantra can also be used for the ablution of Siva. The devotee shall faithfully perform the rite.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धनान्युद्दिश्य नास्माभिरितः प्रागर्चितः शिवः । अतो दरिद्राः सञ्जाता वयं तस्मान्न ते पयः
verses.transliteration: dhanānyuddiśya nāsmābhiritaḥ prāgarcitaḥ śivaḥ | ato daridrāḥ sañjātā vayaṃ tasmānna te payaḥ
verses.translation: The water shall be poured with a pot, or couch, or Vardhani or with the hand holding Kua grass and flowers all the time repeating the mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water shall be poured with a pot, or couch, or Vardhani or with the hand holding Kua grass and flowers all the time repeating the mantras.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मनि यद्दत्तं शिवमुद्दिश्य वै सुतः । तदेव लभ्यते नान्यद् विष्णुमुद्दिश्य वा प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvajanmani yaddattaṃ śivamuddiśya vai sutaḥ | tadeva labhyate nānyad viṣṇumuddiśya vā prabhum
verses.translation: The hymns of Pavamana, Rudra, Nila and Tvarita or the hymns of Linga Sukta or the hymns from Athar'aiiras Upanisad or the hymns from the Rgveda or Samaveda relating to Siva or the five Brahmans be used
verses.commentary: Sense: The hymns of Pavamana, Rudra, Nila and Tvarita or the hymns of Linga Sukta or the hymns from Athar'aiiras Upanisad or the hymns from the Rgveda or Samaveda relating to Siva or the five Brahmans be used
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इति मातृवचः श्रुत्वा तथ्यं शोकादिसूचकम् । बालोऽप्यनुतपन्नन्तः प्रगल्भमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | iti mātṛvacaḥ śrutvā tathyaṃ śokādisūcakam | bālo'pyanutapannantaḥ pragalbhamidamabravīt
verses.translation: After performing the rites of ablution to the lord those to the goddess shall be performed. This is what the lord of the gods has ordained.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the rites of ablution to the lord those to the goddess shall be performed. This is what the lord of the gods has ordained.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । शोकेनालमितो मतः साम्बो यद्यस्ति शङ्करः । त्यज शोकं महाभागे सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | śokenālamito mataḥ sāmbo yadyasti śaṅkaraḥ | tyaja śokaṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: When the half*female form of the lord is to be worshipped, no serial order in the performance of rites shall be observed. Similarly in regard to the services rendered to the phallic or the embodied image.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the half*female form of the lord is to be worshipped, no serial order in the performance of rites shall be observed. Similarly in regard to the services rendered to the phallic or the embodied image.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शृणु मातर्वचो मेऽद्य महादेवोऽस्ति चेत् क्वचित् । चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu mātarvaco me'dya mahādevo'sti cet kvacit | cirādvā hyacirādvāpi kṣīrodaṃ sādhayāmyaham
verses.translation: After performing the ablution of the phallic idol it shall be wiped with a pure fragrant cloth. The devotee shall then offer garment and the sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the ablution of the phallic idol it shall be wiped with a pure fragrant cloth. The devotee shall then offer garment and the sacred thread.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य बालकस्य महामतेः । प्रत्युवाच तदा माता सुप्रसन्ना मनस्विनी
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | iti śrutvā vacastasya bālakasya mahāmateḥ | pratyuvāca tadā mātā suprasannā manasvinī
verses.translation: In a big flat vessel made of gold, silver, copper or clay he shall worship the lord with lotuses, seeds, flowers, curd, Akatas, Nandyavarta flowers etc. in the forms of Srivatsa, Svastika, mirror, Vajra, fire etc. Eight lamps shall be lighted all round and one lamp shall be kept in the middle. In these the nine laktis Varna etc. shall be meditated upon and worshipped.
verses.wordMeaning: In a big flat vessel made of gold, silver, copper or clay he shall worship the lord with lotuses, seeds, flowers, curd, Akatas, Nandyavarta flowers etc. in the forms of Srivatsa, Svastika, mirror, Vajra, fire etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In a big flat vessel made of gold, silver, copper or clay he shall worship the lord with lotuses, seeds, flowers, curd, Akatas, Nandyavarta flowers etc. in the forms of Srivatsa, Svastika, mirror, Vajra, fire etc.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मातोवाच । शुभं विचारितं तात त्वया मत्प्रीतिवर्द्धनम् । विलम्बं मा कथास्त्वं हि भज साम्बं सदाशिवम्
verses.transliteration: mātovāca | śubhaṃ vicāritaṃ tāta tvayā matprītivarddhanam | vilambaṃ mā kathāstvaṃ hi bhaja sāmbaṃ sadāśivam
verses.translation: After covering with Kavaca mantra and protec¬ ting with the Astra mantra he shall show the Mudra of cow and lift the vessel with both the hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: After covering with Kavaca mantra and protec¬ ting with the Astra mantra he shall show the Mudra of cow and lift the vessel with both the hands.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्मादधिकोऽस्त्येव शिवः परमकारणम् । तत्कृतं हि जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्माद्यास्तस्य किङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: sarvasmādadhiko'styeva śivaḥ paramakāraṇam | tatkṛtaṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ brahmādyāstasya kiṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: Or only five lamps shall be kept, four in the four quarters and one in the middle, or only one lamp need be lit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or only five lamps shall be kept, four in the four quarters and one in the middle, or only one lamp need be lit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रसादकृतैश्वर्या दासास्तस्य वयं प्रभोः । तं विनान्यं न जानीमः शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tatprasādakṛtaiśvaryā dāsāstasya vayaṃ prabhoḥ | taṃ vinānyaṃ na jānīmaḥ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram
verses.translation: Lifting the vessel, the devotee shall whirl it thrice
verses.commentary: Sense: Lifting the vessel, the devotee shall whirl it thrice
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यान् देवान्न् परित्यज्य कर्मणा मनसा गिरा । तमेव साम्बं सगणं भज भावपुरस्सरम्
verses.transliteration: anyān devānn parityajya karmaṇā manasā girā | tameva sāmbaṃ sagaṇaṃ bhaja bhāvapurassaram
verses.translation: All materials of worship shall be sprinkled with water. Music and dances shall go on. Conceiving the presence of Siva and Siva in the phallic image he shall perform the Japa of Siva according to his ability.
verses.commentary: Sense: All materials of worship shall be sprinkled with water. Music and dances shall go on. Conceiving the presence of Siva and Siva in the phallic image he shall perform the Japa of Siva according to his ability.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य शिवस्य वरदायिनः । साक्षान्नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रोऽयं वाचकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tasya devādhidevasya śivasya varadāyinaḥ | sākṣānnamaḥ śivāyeti mantro'yaṃ vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Circumambulation, obeisance, eulogy, dedication of the self and submission of one's wish shall be humbly made.
verses.commentary: Sense: Circumambulation, obeisance, eulogy, dedication of the self and submission of one's wish shall be humbly made.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकोटिमहामन्त्राः सर्वे सप्रणवाः परे । तस्मिन्नेव विलीयन्ते पुनस्तस्माद्विनिर्गताः
verses.transliteration: saptakoṭimahāmantrāḥ sarve sapraṇavāḥ pare | tasminneva vilīyante punastasmādvinirgatāḥ
verses.translation: Arghya and handful of flowers shall be offered and Mudra shall be shown in accordance with injunctions. Forgiveness shall be prayed and the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. The devotee shall meditate on the lord only in his Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arghya and handful of flowers shall be offered and Mudra shall be shown in accordance with injunctions. Forgiveness shall be prayed and the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. The devotee shall meditate on the lord only in his Atman.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्रसादाश्च ते मन्त्राः स्वाधिकाराद्यपेक्षया । सर्वाधिकारस्त्वेकोऽयं मन्त्र एवेश्वराज्ञया
verses.transliteration: saprasādāśca te mantrāḥ svādhikārādyapekṣayā | sarvādhikārastveko'yaṃ mantra eveśvarājñayā
verses.translation: In distress the offerings are restricted to those beginning with Padya and ending with Tambula, or to those beginning with Arghya, or to mere offering of flowers, but with pious feelings.
verses.commentary: Sense: In distress the offerings are restricted to those beginning with Padya and ending with Tambula, or to those beginning with Arghya, or to mere offering of flowers, but with pious feelings.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा निकृष्टानुत्कृष्टान्सर्वानप्यात्मनः शिवः । क्षमते रक्षितुं तद्वन्मन्त्रोऽयमपि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: yathā nikṛṣṭānutkṛṣṭānsarvānapyātmanaḥ śivaḥ | kṣamate rakṣituṃ tadvanmantro'yamapi sarvadā
verses.translation: If a sinner takes meals freely there is no atone¬ ment for him. If he takes in anything inadvertently he shall vomit it off, take bath and worship the lord and the goddess twice. He shall observe fast thereafter and repeat the names of Siva ten thousand times. He shall observe celibacy also. The next day he shall make a charitable gift of gold to a devotee of Siva. Then he shall perform great worship and sanctify himself.
verses.wordMeaning: If a sinner takes meals freely there is no atone¬ ment for him. If he takes in anything inadvertently he shall vomit it off, take bath and worship the lord and the goddess twice. He shall observe fast thereafter and repeat the names of Siva ten thousand times.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a sinner takes meals freely there is no atone¬ ment for him. If he takes in anything inadvertently he shall vomit it off, take bath and worship the lord and the goddess twice. He shall observe fast thereafter and repeat the names of Siva ten thousand times.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रबलश्च तथा ह्येष मन्त्रो मन्त्रान्तरादपि । सर्वरक्षाक्षमोऽप्येष नापरः कश्चिदिष्यते
verses.transliteration: prabalaśca tathā hyeṣa mantro mantrāntarādapi | sarvarakṣākṣamo'pyeṣa nāparaḥ kaścidiṣyate
verses.translation: What has not been mentioned because I was afraid of losing the sequence of worship, I shall now mention briefly,
verses.commentary: Sense: What has not been mentioned because I was afraid of losing the sequence of worship, I shall now mention briefly,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मन्त्रान्तरांस्त्यक्त्वा पञ्चाक्षरपरो भव । तस्मिन् जिह्वान्तरगते न किञ्चिदिह दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānmantrāntarāṃstyaktvā pañcākṣaraparo bhava | tasmin jihvāntaragate na kiñcidiha durlabham
verses.translation: After offering the light but before offering the Havis, the devotee shall perform the worship of the Avarana; or just when the time of Nirajana has arrived.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering the light but before offering the Havis, the devotee shall perform the worship of the Avarana; or just when the time of Nirajana has arrived.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अघोरास्त्रं च शैवानां रक्षाहेतुरनुत्तमम् । तच्च तत्प्रभवं मत्वा तत्परो भव नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: aghorāstraṃ ca śaivānāṃ rakṣāheturanuttamam | tacca tatprabhavaṃ matvā tatparo bhava nānyathā
verses.translation: Iji the first Avarana of Siva and Siva, the mantra of Rudra etc. upto the Astra shall be used for Japa. The five Brahmans from Isana to Sadyojata shall be meditated upon in the north-east, east, south and north or in the west, south-east, north-east and south-west or in the north-west north-east and in the four quarters. Beyond that he shall perform the Garbhavarana and repeat the mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: Iji the first Avarana of Siva and Siva, the mantra of Rudra etc. upto the Astra shall be used for Japa. The five Brahmans from Isana to Sadyojata shall be meditated upon in the north-east, east, south and north or in the west, south-east,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Iji the first Avarana of Siva and Siva, the mantra of Rudra etc. upto the Astra shall be used for Japa. The five Brahmans from Isana to Sadyojata shall be meditated upon in the north-east, east, south and north or in the west, south-east,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भस्मेदं तु मया लब्धं पितुरेव तवोत्तमम् । विरजानलसंसिद्धं महाव्यापन्निवारणम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmedaṃ tu mayā labdhaṃ pitureva tavottamam | virajānalasaṃsiddhaṃ mahāvyāpannivāraṇam
verses.translation: Or he shall worship everything from the heart to the Astra. Outside he shall worship Indra in the east, Yama in the south, Varuna in the west, Klibera in the north, Isa in the north-east, fire in the south-east, Nirrti in the south-west, Vayu in the north-west, Visnu in the south-west, Brahma in the north-east and the weapons from thunderbolt to the lotus outside the lotus.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall worship everything from the heart to the Astra. Outside he shall worship Indra in the east, Yama in the south, Varuna in the west, Klibera in the north, Isa in the north-east, fire in the south-east, Nirrti in the south-west, Vayu in the north-west,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall worship everything from the heart to the Astra. Outside he shall worship Indra in the east, Yama in the south, Varuna in the west, Klibera in the north, Isa in the north-east, fire in the south-east, Nirrti in the south-west, Vayu in the north-west,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रं च ते मया दत्तं गृहाण मदनुज्ञया । अनेनैवाशु जप्तेन रक्षा तव भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: mantraṃ ca te mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇa madanujñayā | anenaivāśu japtena rakṣā tava bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: He shall worship the famous forms of the lord in the quarters in order. The deities of the Avarana shall be meditated upon as looking at the lord and the goddess with palms joined and seated comfortably. He shall worship the Avarana deities with their names with the word 'Namah' with flowers and bow to them in order. He shall worship the Garbhavarana with its Avarana.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall worship the famous forms of the lord in the quarters in order. The deities of the Avarana shall be meditated upon as looking at the lord and the goddess with palms joined and seated comfortably.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the famous forms of the lord in the quarters in order. The deities of the Avarana shall be meditated upon as looking at the lord and the goddess with palms joined and seated comfortably.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एवं मात्रा समादिश्य शिवमस्त्वित्युदीर्य च । विसृष्टस्तद्वचो मूर्ध्नि कुर्वन्नेव तदा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | evaṃ mātrā samādiśya śivamastvityudīrya ca | visṛṣṭastadvaco mūrdhni kurvanneva tadā muniḥ
verses.translation: Churned curd shall be given with jaggery and
verses.commentary: Sense: Churned curd shall be given with jaggery and
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां प्रणम्यैवमुक्त्वा च तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे । तमाह च तदा माता शुभं कुर्वन्तु ते सुराः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ praṇamyaivamuktvā ca tapaḥ kartuṃ pracakrame | tamāha ca tadā mātā śubhaṃ kurvantu te surāḥ
verses.translation: Gold water with red sandal and flowers thrown in shall be given. A piece of Areca nut soaked in Cardamom juice shall be given. Betel leaves with Khadira etc. shall be given. White and yellow are auspicious. The white lime powder shall be rocky but neither very hard nor defective.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold water with red sandal and flowers thrown in shall be given. A piece of Areca nut soaked in Cardamom juice shall be given. Betel leaves with Khadira etc. shall be given. White and yellow are auspicious. The white lime powder shall be rocky but neither very hard nor defective.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञातस्तया तत्र तपस्तेपे स दुश्चरम् । हिमवत्पर्वतं प्राप्य वायुभक्षः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: anujñātastayā tatra tapastepe sa duścaram | himavatparvataṃ prāpya vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The camphor, Kankola and Jati, if fresh, arc auspicious. As an unguent the sandal shall be in powdered form. The lower stem is better. The musk and saffron shall be pasted. Only fragrant flowers are holy and auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: The camphor, Kankola and Jati, if fresh, arc auspicious. As an unguent the sandal shall be in powdered form. The lower stem is better. The musk and saffron shall be pasted. Only fragrant flowers are holy and auspicious.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टेष्टकाभिः प्रासादं कृत्वा लिङ्गं च मृण्मयम् । तत्रावाह्य महादेवं साम्बं सगणमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭeṣṭakābhiḥ prāsādaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca mṛṇmayam | tatrāvāhya mahādevaṃ sāmbaṃ sagaṇamavyayam
verses.translation: Flowers devoid of smell, of obnoxious smell, defiled, stale and broken at fall shall not be used for the worship of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flowers devoid of smell, of obnoxious smell, defiled, stale and broken at fall shall not be used for the worship of lord Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या पञ्चाक्षरेणैव पुत्रैः पुष्पैर्वनोद्भवैः । समभ्यर्च्य चिरं कालं चचार परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā pañcākṣareṇaiva putraiḥ puṣpairvanodbhavaiḥ | samabhyarcya ciraṃ kālaṃ cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Soft fine cloths and golden ornaments shall be given along with camphor, gum-resin and sandal, well fumi¬ gated and rendered fragrant with flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soft fine cloths and golden ornaments shall be given along with camphor, gum-resin and sandal, well fumi¬ gated and rendered fragrant with flowers.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तपश्चरत्तं तं बालमेकाकिनं कृशम् । उपमन्युं द्विजवरं शिवसंसक्तमानसम्
verses.transliteration: tatastapaścarattaṃ taṃ bālamekākinaṃ kṛśam | upamanyuṃ dvijavaraṃ śivasaṃsaktamānasam
verses.translation: Incense mixed with sandal, gum-resin, camphor, ghee and honey is excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Incense mixed with sandal, gum-resin, camphor, ghee and honey is excellent.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा मरीचिना शप्ताः केचिन्मुनिपिशाचकाः । सम्पीड्य राक्षसैर्भावैस्तपसो विघ्नमाचरन्
verses.transliteration: purā marīcinā śaptāḥ kecinmunipiśācakāḥ | sampīḍya rākṣasairbhāvaistapaso vighnamācaran
verses.translation: Lamps lighted with fragrant ghee from the milk of tawny cows, accompanied by camphor are excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lamps lighted with fragrant ghee from the milk of tawny cows, accompanied by camphor are excellent.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स च तैः पीड्यमानोऽपि तपः कुर्वन्कथञ्चन । सदा नमः शिवायेति क्रोशति स्मार्तनादवत्
verses.transliteration: sa ca taiḥ pīḍyamāno'pi tapaḥ kurvankathañcana | sadā namaḥ śivāyeti krośati smārtanādavat
verses.translation: Paficagavya consisting of sweet milk, curd and ghee all taken from tawny cows is favourite of Siva for bath and drink.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paficagavya consisting of sweet milk, curd and ghee all taken from tawny cows is favourite of Siva for bath and drink.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्नादश्रवणादेव तपसो विघ्नकारिणः । ते तं बालं समुत्सृज्य मुनयः समुपाचरन्
verses.transliteration: tannādaśravaṇādeva tapaso vighnakāriṇaḥ | te taṃ bālaṃ samutsṛjya munayaḥ samupācaran
verses.translation: Seats of ivory framed in gold and set with gems and the covering cloths of various colours shall be used.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seats of ivory framed in gold and set with gems and the covering cloths of various colours shall be used.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तस्य विप्रस्य चोपमन्योर्महात्मनः । चराचरं च मुनयः प्रदीपितमभूज्जगत्
verses.transliteration: tapasā tasya viprasya copamanyormahātmanaḥ | carācaraṃ ca munayaḥ pradīpitamabhūjjagat
verses.translation: Beds shall be comfortable, charming, high and low with soft pillows. They shall be filled with fine cotton.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beds shall be comfortable, charming, high and low with soft pillows. They shall be filled with fine cotton.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ७.१.३४ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 7.1.34 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The bugles shall be charmingly made of gold and decorated with pearls. They shall be capable of produ¬ cing different notes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bugles shall be charmingly made of gold and decorated with pearls. They shall be capable of produ¬ cing different notes.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The bugles shall be charmingly made of gold and decorated with pearls. They shall be capable of produ¬ cing different notes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bugles shall be charmingly made of gold and decorated with pearls. They shall be capable of produ¬ cing different notes.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३५. पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । उपमन्युचरितवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । अथ सर्वे प्रदीप्ताङ्गा वैकुण्ठं प्रययुर्द्रुतम् । प्रणम्याहुश्च तत्सर्वं हरये देवसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.1.35. pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | upamanyucaritavarṇanam | vāyuruvāca | atha sarve pradīptāṅgā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayurdrutam | praṇamyāhuśca tatsarvaṃ haraye devasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Different kinds of drums like Bheri, mjrdahga, Muraja, Timiccha, Pataha shall be used, capable of sounding like' the roaring sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different kinds of drums like Bheri, mjrdahga, Muraja, Timiccha, Pataha shall be used, capable of sounding like' the roaring sea.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं भगवान्पुरुषोत्तमः । किमिदं त्विति सञ्चिन्त्य ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं च सः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ | kimidaṃ tviti sañcintya jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ ca saḥ
verses.translation: Even a poor man urged by devotion, may do what a rich man devoid of devotion will not do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a poor man urged by devotion, may do what a rich man devoid of devotion will not do.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगाम मन्दरं तूर्णं महेश्वरदिदृक्षया । दृष्ट्वा देवं प्रणम्यैवं प्रोवाच सुकृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: jagāma mandaraṃ tūrṇaṃ maheśvaradidṛkṣayā | dṛṣṭvā devaṃ praṇamyaivaṃ provāca sukṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: O 1 shall tell you a great secret. Listen
verses.commentary: Sense: O 1 shall tell you a great secret. Listen
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । भगवन्ब्राह्मणः कश्चिदुपमन्युरिति श्रुतः । क्षीरार्थमदहत्सर्वं तपसा तन्निवारय
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuruvāca | bhagavanbrāhmaṇaḥ kaścidupamanyuriti śrutaḥ | kṣīrārthamadahatsarvaṃ tapasā tannivāraya
verses.translation: So desiring welfare, one shall invariably wor¬ ship Siva, forsaking everything else and dedicating the mind solely to him. The life passes off quickly. Youth goes off rapidly. Sickness approaches all too suddenly. Hence the lord shall be worshipped. Worship Siva before death over¬ takes you, before old age attacks you, before the sense-organs become atrophied and inefficient.
verses.wordMeaning: So desiring welfare, one shall invariably wor¬ ship Siva, forsaking everything else and dedicating the mind solely to him. The life passes off quickly. Youth goes off rapidly. Sickness approaches all too suddenly. Hence the lord shall be worshipped.…
verses.commentary: Sense: So desiring welfare, one shall invariably wor¬ ship Siva, forsaking everything else and dedicating the mind solely to him. The life passes off quickly. Youth goes off rapidly. Sickness approaches all too suddenly. Hence the lord shall be worshipped.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचो विष्णोः प्राह देवो महेश्वरः । शिशुं निवारयिष्यामि तत्त्वं गच्छ स्वमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | iti śrutvā vaco viṣṇoḥ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ | śiśuṃ nivārayiṣyāmi tattvaṃ gaccha svamāśramam
verses.translation: The sacrificial spoons shall be metallic but not of bell metal, iron or lead. These shall be made of sacrifi¬ cial wood as mentioned in Smftis and approved by artisans. The leaves of the Brahma tree shall be holeless. They shall be raised in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrificial spoons shall be metallic but not of bell metal, iron or lead. These shall be made of sacrifi¬ cial wood as mentioned in Smftis and approved by artisans. The leaves of the Brahma tree shall be holeless. They shall be raised in the middle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा शम्भुवचनं स विष्णुर्देववल्लभः । जगामाश्वास्य तान्सर्वान् स्वलोकममरादिकान्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā śambhuvacanaṃ sa viṣṇurdevavallabhaḥ | jagāmāśvāsya tānsarvān svalokamamarādikān
verses.translation: Or it can also be discharged and placed in the umbilicus of the altar and worshipped everyday. Or, bringing the fire along the path prescribed in Saivite scrip¬ tures it shall be conceived as born of the womb of the goddess of speech, consecrated duly and worshipped, Sacri-
verses.commentary: Sense: Or it can also be discharged and placed in the umbilicus of the altar and worshipped everyday. Or, bringing the fire along the path prescribed in Saivite scrip¬ tures it shall be conceived as born of the womb of the goddess of speech, consecrated duly and worshipped, Sacri-

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवः पिनाकी परमेश्वरः । शक्रस्य रूपमास्थाय गन्तुं चक्रे मतिं ततः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devaḥ pinākī parameśvaraḥ | śakrasya rūpamāsthāya gantuṃ cakre matiṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: It shall be made into balls and the balls shall be consigned to Sivagni or other types of fires repeating the basic mantra. The portions over-burnt or under-burnt shall be eschewed and the white ashes shall be gathered and ground into powder. It shall be preserved in receptacles made of metals, wood, clay or stone or any other material. The receptacle of water shall be pure. It shall be kept in a pure auspicious, even place and guarded like valuable wealth.
verses.wordMeaning: It shall be made into balls and the balls shall be consigned to Sivagni or other types of fires repeating the basic mantra. The portions over-burnt or under-burnt shall be eschewed and the white ashes shall be gathered and ground into powder.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be made into balls and the balls shall be consigned to Sivagni or other types of fires repeating the basic mantra. The portions over-burnt or under-burnt shall be eschewed and the white ashes shall be gathered and ground into powder.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ जगाम मुनेस्तु तपोवनं गजवरेण सितेन सदाशिवः । सह सुरासुरसिद्धमहोरगै- रमरराजतनुं स्वयमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: atha jagāma munestu tapovanaṃ gajavareṇa sitena sadāśivaḥ | saha surāsurasiddhamahoragai- ramararājatanuṃ svayamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: It shall not be handed to any undeserving person. It shall not be kept or thrown in any unholy place. If the hands or limbs are dirty it shall not be touched. It shall not be neglected nor shall one jump over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall not be handed to any undeserving person. It shall not be kept or thrown in any unholy place. If the hands or limbs are dirty it shall not be touched. It shall not be neglected nor shall one jump over it.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स वारणश्चारु तदा विभुं तं निवीज्य वालव्यजनेन दिव्यम् । दधार शच्या सहितं सुरेन्द्रं करेण वामेन सितातपत्रम्
verses.transliteration: sa vāraṇaścāru tadā vibhuṃ taṃ nivījya vālavyajanena divyam | dadhāra śacyā sahitaṃ surendraṃ kareṇa vāmena sitātapatram
verses.translation: Hence after taking the ashes it shall be utilised with the mantras on occasions previously mentioned and not other¬ wise. It shall not be given to others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence after taking the ashes it shall be utilised with the mantras on occasions previously mentioned and not other¬ wise. It shall not be given to others.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रराज भगवान्सोमः शक्ररूपी सदाशिवः । तेनातपत्रेण यथा चन्द्रबिम्बेन मन्दरः
verses.transliteration: rarāja bhagavānsomaḥ śakrarūpī sadāśivaḥ | tenātapatreṇa yathā candrabimbena mandaraḥ
verses.translation: All pots and vessels shall be beautiful. Their supporting stands shall be made of gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: All pots and vessels shall be beautiful. Their supporting stands shall be made of gold.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आस्थायैवं हि शक्रस्य स्वरूपं परमेश्वरः । जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुमुपमन्योस्तदाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: āsthāyaivaṃ hi śakrasya svarūpaṃ parameśvaraḥ | jagāmānugrahaṃ kartumupamanyostadāśramam
verses.translation: The temple of Siva shall be made like a royal palace with all the characteristics mentioned in the science of architecture.
verses.commentary: Sense: The temple of Siva shall be made like a royal palace with all the characteristics mentioned in the science of architecture.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा परमेशानं शक्ररूपधरं शिवम् । प्रणम्य शिरसा प्राह महामुनिवरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśānaṃ śakrarūpadharaṃ śivam | praṇamya śirasā prāha mahāmunivaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: It shall be encircled by high walls with the ornamental gateway as lofty as a mountain. It shall be studded with gems. The doors shall be made of gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be encircled by high walls with the ornamental gateway as lofty as a mountain. It shall be studded with gems. The doors shall be made of gold.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । पावितश्चाश्रमः सोऽयं मम देवेश्वर स्वयम् । प्राप्तो यत्त्वं जगन्नाथ भगवन्देवसत्तम
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | pāvitaścāśramaḥ so'yaṃ mama deveśvara svayam | prāpto yattvaṃ jagannātha bhagavandevasattama
verses.translation: It must have a hundred columns of molten gold studded with gems. The canopy shall be embellished with pearls and the festoons at the gateway shall be brightened with corals.
verses.commentary: Sense: It must have a hundred columns of molten gold studded with gems. The canopy shall be embellished with pearls and the festoons at the gateway shall be brightened with corals.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एवमुक्त्वा स्थितं प्रेक्ष्य कृताञ्जलिपुटं द्विजम् । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा शक्ररूपधरो हरः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | evamuktvā sthitaṃ prekṣya kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ dvijam | prāha gambhīrayā vācā śakrarūpadharo haraḥ
verses.translation: Its top shall be decorated with golden domes resembling divine crowns and marked with the lordly missile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its top shall be decorated with golden domes resembling divine crowns and marked with the lordly missile.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच । तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वरं ब्रूहि तपसाऽनेन सुव्रत । ददामि चेप्सितान्सर्वान् धौम्याग्रज महामुने
verses.transliteration: śakra uvāca | tuṣṭo'smi te varaṃ brūhi tapasā'nena suvrata | dadāmi cepsitānsarvān dhaumyāgraja mahāmune
verses.translation: It shall be richly decorated in the border all round by palatial buildings with tall mkiarets, great mansions for the residence of kings, royal highways and excellent halls of assembly situated in the different quarters appearing like an inner rampart.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be richly decorated in the border all round by palatial buildings with tall mkiarets, great mansions for the residence of kings, royal highways and excellent halls of assembly situated in the different quarters appearing like an inner rampart.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन शक्रेण मुनिपुङ्गवः । वरयामि शिवे भक्तिमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | evamuktastadā tena śakreṇa munipuṅgavaḥ | varayāmi śive bhaktimityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: It shall contain thousands of courtezans in dance and music and those adepts in playing on flutes and lutes.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall contain thousands of courtezans in dance and music and those adepts in playing on flutes and lutes.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्निशम्य हरिः प्राह मां न जानासि लेखपम् । त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tanniśamya hariḥ prāha māṃ na jānāsi lekhapam | trailokyādhipatiṃ śakraṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: It shall be guarded by heroic guards and watch-
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall be guarded by heroic guards and watch-
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तो भव विप्रर्षे मामेवार्चय सर्वदा । ददामि सर्वं भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: madbhakto bhava viprarṣe māmevārcaya sarvadā | dadāmi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ te tyaja rudraṃ ca nirguṇam
verses.translation: If one worships without devotion even with legitimately earned wealth he does not derive the benefit thereof. Devotion alone is the main concern.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one worships without devotion even with legitimately earned wealth he does not derive the benefit thereof. Devotion alone is the main concern.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रेण निर्गुणेनापि किं ते कार्यं भविष्यति । देवपङ्क्तिबहिर्भूतो यः पिशाचत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: rudreṇa nirguṇenāpi kiṃ te kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati | devapaṅktibahirbhūto yaḥ piśācatvamāgataḥ
verses.translation: The benefit of even a little or a great service rendered by a poor or a rich man, according to the affluence, to Siva with devotion is the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: The benefit of even a little or a great service rendered by a poor or a rich man, according to the affluence, to Siva with devotion is the same.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा प्राह स मुनिर्जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् । मन्यमानो धर्मविघ्नं प्राह तं कर्तुमागतम्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | tacchrutvā prāha sa munirjapanpañcākṣaraṃ manum | manyamāno dharmavighnaṃ prāha taṃ kartumāgatam
verses.translation: Without this none can go to the divine city of Siva*® through any sort of penances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without this none can go to the divine city of Siva*® through any sort of penances.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । त्वयैवं कथितं सर्वं भवनिन्दारतेन वै । प्रसङ्गादेव देवस्य निर्गुणत्वं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | tvayaivaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhavanindāratena vai | prasaṅgādeva devasya nirguṇatvaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The Japa of Siva's Mantra meditation, Homa, Yajha, penance, learning, charitable gift, study of Vedas— all
verses.commentary: Sense: The Japa of Siva's Mantra meditation, Homa, Yajha, penance, learning, charitable gift, study of Vedas— all
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न जानामि वै रुद्रं सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरम् । ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जनकं प्रकृतेः परम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ na jānāmi vai rudraṃ sarvadeveśvareśvaram | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ janakaṃ prakṛteḥ param
verses.translation: See p. 1940 note
verses.explanation: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सदसद्व्यक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः । नित्यमेकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sadasadvyaktamavyaktaṃ yamāhurbrahmavādinaḥ | nityamekamanekaṃ ca varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham
verses.translation: A person devoid of piety and devotion is not liberated even after doing everything but one with devotion is liberated even without doing anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person devoid of piety and devotion is not liberated even after doing everything but one with devotion is liberated even without doing anything.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हेतुवादविनिर्मुक्तं साङ्ख्ययोगार्थदं परम् । उपासते यं तत्त्वज्ञा वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: hetuvādavinirmuktaṃ sāṅkhyayogārthadaṃ param | upāsate yaṃ tattvajñā varaṃ tasmād vṛṇomyaham
verses.translation: To a devotee of Siva, of what avail arc thousands of Candrayanas,*®* hundreds of Prajapatyas,**® and other monthly fasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: To a devotee of Siva, of what avail arc thousands of Candrayanas,*®* hundreds of Prajapatyas,**® and other monthly fasts.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति शम्भोः परं तत्त्वं सर्वकारणकारणात् । ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवानां स्रष्टुर्गुणपराद्विभोः
verses.transliteration: nāsti śambhoḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇāt | brahmaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ sraṣṭurguṇaparādvibhoḥ
verses.translation: In this world, even non-devotees perform penances in mountain caves for the enjoyment of insignificant pleasures. But only a devotee is liberated through pious feelings.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world, even non-devotees perform penances in mountain caves for the enjoyment of insignificant pleasures. But only a devotee is liberated through pious feelings.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मयाद्यानुमितं महत् । भवान्तरे कृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य चेत्
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena mayādyānumitaṃ mahat | bhavāntare kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrutā nindā bhavasya cet
verses.translation: The Sattvic activity yields salvation. Yogins abide by the Sattvsna. The ritualists perform Rfijasic rites bestowing Siddhis because they are enveloped by Rajas Guna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sattvic activity yields salvation. Yogins abide by the Sattvsna. The ritualists perform Rfijasic rites bestowing Siddhis because they are enveloped by Rajas Guna.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव सन्त्यजेत् । स्वदेहं तन्निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śrutvā nindāṃ bhavasyātha tatkṣaṇādeva santyajet | svadehaṃ tannihatyāśu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Asuras and Rakasas possessing Tamas Guna and men of that ilk worship the lord for securing worldly pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asuras and Rakasas possessing Tamas Guna and men of that ilk worship the lord for securing worldly pleasures.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आस्तां तावन्ममेच्छेयं क्षीरं प्रति सुराधम । निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतं कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: āstāṃ tāvanmameccheyaṃ kṣīraṃ prati surādhama | nihatya tvāṃ śivāstreṇa tyajāmyetaṃ kalevaram
verses.translation: O Kf fa, a low born, a base or a fool, or a fallen man, if he resorts to Siva is worthy of being worshipped by the gods and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kf fa, a low born, a base or a fool, or a fallen man, if he resorts to Siva is worthy of being worshipped by the gods and Asuras.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एवमुक्त्वोपमन्युस्तं मर्तुं व्यवसितः स्वयम् । क्षीरे वाञ्छामपि त्यक्त्वा निहन्तुं शक्रमुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | evamuktvopamanyustaṃ martuṃ vyavasitaḥ svayam | kṣīre vāñchāmapi tyaktvā nihantuṃ śakramudyataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, by all means, one shall worship Siva with devotion alone, since non-devotees secure no benefit from anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by all means, one shall worship Siva with devotion alone, since non-devotees secure no benefit from anywhere.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भस्मादाय तदा घोरमघोरास्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् । विसृज्य शक्रमुद्दिश्य ननाद स मुनिस्तदा
verses.transliteration: bhasmādāya tadā ghoramaghorāstrābhimantritam | visṛjya śakramuddiśya nanāda sa munistadā
verses.translation: Even a slayer of brahmin, a wine-addict, a thief, a defiler of the preceptor's bed, one guilty of matricide or patricide, a murderer of a hero and one guilty of destroying a child in the womb becomes absolved of those sins within twelve years by worshipping Siva with devotion even without mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: Even a slayer of brahmin, a wine-addict, a thief, a defiler of the preceptor's bed, one guilty of matricide or patricide,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a slayer of brahmin, a wine-addict, a thief, a defiler of the preceptor's bed, one guilty of matricide or patricide,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा शम्भुपदद्वन्द्वं स्वदेहं दुग्धुमुद्यतः । आग्नेयीं धारणां बिभ्रदुपमन्युरवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā śambhupadadvandvaṃ svadehaṃ dugdhumudyataḥ | āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ bibhradupamanyuravasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence by all means let even a fallen man worship §iva sustaining himself on alms and conquering the sense- organs. This he shall do if he is a devotee and none else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence by all means let even a fallen man worship §iva sustaining himself on alms and conquering the sense- organs. This he shall do if he is a devotee and none else.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान् भगनेत्रहा । वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vyavasite vipre bhagavān bhaganetrahā | vārayāmāsa saumyena dhāraṇāṃ tasya yoginaḥ
verses.translation: There are many persons who live solely on water or air and who emaciate their bodies by means of holy rites. They cannot attain Sivaloka through these rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are many persons who live solely on water or air and who emaciate their bodies by means of holy rites. They cannot attain Sivaloka through these rites.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्विसृष्टमघोरास्त्रं नन्दीश्वरनियोगतः । जगृहे मध्यतः क्षिप्तं नन्दी शङ्करवल्लभः
verses.transliteration: tadvisṛṣṭamaghorāstraṃ nandīśvaraniyogataḥ | jagṛhe madhyataḥ kṣiptaṃ nandī śaṅkaravallabhaḥ
verses.translation: He who worships Siva even once with devotion repeating the five-syllabled mantra goes to tfie abode of Siva due to the efficacy of the mantra of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who worships Siva even once with devotion repeating the five-syllabled mantra goes to tfie abode of Siva due to the efficacy of the mantra of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वं रूपमेव भगवानास्थाय परमेश्वरः । दर्शयामास शिप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: svaṃ rūpameva bhagavānāsthāya parameśvaraḥ | darśayāmāsa śiprāya bālendukṛtaśekharam
verses.translation: Hence the penances and the sacrifices wherein the entire possession may be given as Dakina, are not equal to even a croreth part of the worship of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the penances and the sacrifices wherein the entire possession may be given as Dakina, are not equal to even a croreth part of the worship of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्णवसहस्रं च पीयूषार्णवमेव वा । दध्यादेरर्णवांश्चैव घृतोदार्णवमेव च
verses.transliteration: kṣīrārṇavasahasraṃ ca pīyūṣārṇavameva vā | dadhyāderarṇavāṃścaiva ghṛtodārṇavameva ca
verses.translation: Whether bound or free, if the devotee worships with the five-syllabled mantra he is liberated. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether bound or free, if the devotee worships with the five-syllabled mantra he is liberated. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: फलार्णवं च बालस्य भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं तथा । अपूपानां गिरिं चैव दर्शयामास स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: phalārṇavaṃ ca bālasya bhakṣyabhojyārṇavaṃ tathā | apūpānāṃ giriṃ caiva darśayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: A devotee of Siva who has conquered anger, whether he has or has not secured grace shall worship the lord with the Suktamantra or the six-syllabled mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A devotee of Siva who has conquered anger, whether he has or has not secured grace shall worship the lord with the Suktamantra or the six-syllabled mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स ददृशे देवो देव्या सार्द्धं वृषोपरि । गणेश्वरैस्त्रिशूलाद्यैर्दिव्यास्त्रैरपि संवृतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa dadṛśe devo devyā sārddhaṃ vṛṣopari | gaṇeśvaraistriśūlādyairdivyāstrairapi saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Hence one shall always worship Siva with devotion repeating the mantras, once, twice or thrice or always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one shall always worship Siva with devotion repeating the mantras, once, twice or thrice or always.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दिवि दुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च । विष्णुब्रह्मेन्द्रप्रमुखैर्देवैश्छन्ना दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca | viṣṇubrahmendrapramukhairdevaiśchannā diśo daśa
verses.translation: Those who worship the lord shall be known as Mahevaras themselves. If one does not worship him through knowledge assisted by the prompting of the soul he suffers for long in the world which is an ocean of misery. Even after attaining the rare human body, if a deluded individual does not worship Siva, his life becomes futile since it does not lead to salvation. After attaining the rare human birth those who worship the lord are excellent and blessed. Their life alone is fruitful.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who worship the lord shall be known as Mahevaras themselves. If one does not worship him through knowledge assisted by the prompting of the soul he suffers for long in the world which is an ocean of misery. Even after attaining the rare human body,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who worship the lord shall be known as Mahevaras themselves. If one does not worship him through knowledge assisted by the prompting of the soul he suffers for long in the world which is an ocean of misery. Even after attaining the rare human body,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथोपमन्युरानन्दसमुद्रोर्मिभिरावृतः । पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा
verses.transliteration: athopamanyurānandasamudrormibhirāvṛtaḥ | papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktinamreṇa cetasā
verses.translation: Those who are devoted to the lord, whose minds are inclined to him and who endeavour to remember the lord are never subjected to misery. The fruit of the worship of Siva is the sufficient wealth, charming houses and women folk seductively bedecked in ornaments. Those who desire great pleasures and kingdom in heaven shall love his lotus feet for ever. Good fortune, handsome and brilliant features, good strength, compassionate and renouncing temperament, heroism, fame in the world — all these are secured by one who wor¬ ships the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are devoted to the lord, whose minds are inclined to him and who endeavour to remember the lord are never subjected to misery. The fruit of the worship of Siva is the sufficient wealth, charming houses and women folk seductively bedecked in ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are devoted to the lord, whose minds are inclined to him and who endeavour to remember the lord are never subjected to misery. The fruit of the worship of Siva is the sufficient wealth, charming houses and women folk seductively bedecked in ornaments.…

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये तत्र सस्मितो भगवान्भवः । एह्येहीति तमाहूय मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय ददौ वरान्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye tatra sasmito bhagavānbhavaḥ | ehyehīti tamāhūya mūrdhnyāghrāya dadau varān
verses.translation: Realising that there is no holy rite in the three worlds, on a par with the worship of Siva, Sadaiva shall be worshipped assiduously. If the worship is conducted in a palace the following rites too shall be performed— sacrifice at
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that there is no holy rite in the three worlds, on a par with the worship of Siva, Sadaiva shall be worshipped assiduously. If the worship is conducted in a palace the following rites too shall be performed— sacrifice at
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यथाकामं बान्धवैर्भुङ्क्ष्व सर्वदा । सुखी भव सदा दुःखान्निर्मुक्तो भक्तिमान्मम
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | bhakṣyabhojyānyathākāmaṃ bāndhavairbhuṅkṣva sarvadā | sukhī bhava sadā duḥkhānnirmukto bhaktimānmama
verses.translation: Performing Homa, the latter part of worship shall be concluded. After conducting the regular rites he shall perform the perpetual festivities, Japa etc. in accordance with the injunction in Saivitc scriptures. In a large metallic vessel shining splendidly with a red lotus the divine Paupata missile shall be invoked and worshipped.
verses.wordMeaning: Performing Homa, the latter part of worship shall be concluded. After conducting the regular rites he shall perform the perpetual festivities, Japa etc. in accordance with the injunction in Saivitc scriptures.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing Homa, the latter part of worship shall be concluded. After conducting the regular rites he shall perform the perpetual festivities, Japa etc. in accordance with the injunction in Saivitc scriptures.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्यो महाभाग तवाम्बैषा हि पार्वती । मया पुत्रीकृतो ह्यद्य दत्तः क्षीरोदकार्णवः
verses.transliteration: upamanyo mahābhāga tavāmbaiṣā hi pārvatī | mayā putrīkṛto hyadya dattaḥ kṣīrodakārṇavaḥ
verses.translation: The vessel shall be carried on the head by a Saivite brahmin well-bedecked. He shall hold a lighted torch. With dances and songs to the accompaniment of auspicious instrumental music the party shall make three circumambu- lations round the palace of the lord The movement shall be neither quick nor slow. Thereafter the devotee shall stand a the door with palms joined in reverence shall take it in and ritualistically dismiss the Astra. After one more circumam- bulation he shall offer eight flowers and conclude the worship.
verses.wordMeaning: The vessel shall be carried on the head by a Saivite brahmin well-bedecked. He shall hold a lighted torch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The vessel shall be carried on the head by a Saivite brahmin well-bedecked. He shall hold a lighted torch.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मधुनश्चार्णवश्चैव दध्यन्नार्णव एव च । आज्यौदनार्णवश्चैव फलाद्यर्णव एव च
verses.transliteration: madhunaścārṇavaścaiva dadhyannārṇava eva ca | ājyaudanārṇavaścaiva phalādyarṇava eva ca
verses.translation: J shall mention the sacrificial rites in the fire to be performed in sacred pits, or raised ground or in altar Fire shall be taken ih an iron vessel or a fresh mud pot ir.
verses.commentary: Sense: J shall mention the sacrificial rites in the fire to be performed in sacred pits, or raised ground or in altar Fire shall be taken ih an iron vessel or a fresh mud pot ir.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपूपगिरयश्चैव भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवस्तथा । एते दत्ता मया ते हि त्वं गृह्णीष्व महामुने
verses.transliteration: apūpagirayaścaiva bhakṣyabhojyārṇavastathā | ete dattā mayā te hi tvaṃ gṛhṇīṣva mahāmune
verses.translation: The pit may be one or two Hastas wide. The altar shall be made in the form of a circle or a square.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pit may be one or two Hastas wide. The altar shall be made in the form of a circle or a square.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पिता तव महादेवो माता वै जगदम्बिका । अमरत्वं मया दत्तं गाणपत्यं च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: pitā tava mahādevo mātā vai jagadambikā | amaratvaṃ mayā dattaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ ca śāśvatam
verses.translation: In the altar he shall make the eight-petalled lotus. It shall be two or four Ahgulas high above the altar.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the altar he shall make the eight-petalled lotus. It shall be two or four Ahgulas high above the altar.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वरान्वरय सुप्रीत्या मनोऽभिलषितान्परान् । प्रसन्नोऽहं प्रदास्यामि नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: varānvaraya suprītyā mano'bhilaṣitānparān | prasanno'haṃ pradāsyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: The altar shall be made with smooth clav. In the middle of the Mekhala to the west or south the passage shall be made like the leaf of the Alvaltha tree or like the lower lip of an elephant. It shall be beautifully made slightly lower than the fire. It shall close in gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: The altar shall be made with smooth clav. In the middle of the Mekhala to the west or south the passage shall be made like the leaf of the Alvaltha tree or like the lower lip of an elephant. It shall be beautifully made slightly lower than the fire. It shall close in gradually.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः कराभ्यामुपगृह्य तम् । मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय सुतस्तेऽयमिति देव्यै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | evamuktvā mahādevaḥ karābhyāmupagṛhya tam | mūrdhnyāghrāya sutaste'yamiti devyai nyavedayat
verses.translation: The Mekhala shall be left out a little where it faces the pit. There is no stipulated height for the altar. It shall be made of clay or sand. The circular ground shall be smeared with cowdung and water. The measurement of the basin is not stipulated. The Kuruja shall be made of clay. The altar shall be smeared with cowdung and water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Mekhala shall be left out a little where it faces the pit. There is no stipulated height for the altar. It shall be made of clay or sand. The circular ground shall be smeared with cowdung and water. The measurement of the basin is not stipulated.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mekhala shall be left out a little where it faces the pit. There is no stipulated height for the altar. It shall be made of clay or sand. The circular ground shall be smeared with cowdung and water. The measurement of the basin is not stipulated.…

verses.sanskrit: देवी च गुहवत्प्रीत्या मूर्ध्नि तस्य कराम्बुजम् । विन्यस्य प्रददौ तस्मै कुमारपदमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: devī ca guhavatprītyā mūrdhni tasya karāmbujam | vinyasya pradadau tasmai kumārapadamavyayam
verses.translation: The seat of fire shall be made after due sprinkling, with Darbhas or flowers. He shall gather the material for the purpose of worship and sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seat of fire shall be made after due sprinkling, with Darbhas or flowers. He shall gather the material for the purpose of worship and sacrifice.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीराब्धिरपि साकारः क्षीरं स्वादु करे दधत् । उपस्थाय ददौ पिण्डीभूतं क्षीरमनश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kṣīrābdhirapi sākāraḥ kṣīraṃ svādu kare dadhat | upasthāya dadau piṇḍībhūtaṃ kṣīramanaśvaram
verses.translation: Things to be washed shall be washed and to be sprinkled shall be sprinkled and purified. Then he shall fetch fire in a supporting vessel. The fire may be one produced from crystals, lens etc. or from wood. It shall be brought from the house of a Vedic scholar. It shall be whirled round the sacrificial pit thrice repeating the Bija mantra of the fire. The fire shall be placed in its seat through the passage or straight in front.
verses.wordMeaning: Things to be washed shall be washed and to be sprinkled shall be sprinkled and purified. Then he shall fetch fire in a supporting vessel. The fire may be one produced from crystals, lens etc. or from wood. It shall be brought from the house of a Vedic scholar.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Things to be washed shall be washed and to be sprinkled shall be sprinkled and purified. Then he shall fetch fire in a supporting vessel. The fire may be one produced from crystals, lens etc. or from wood. It shall be brought from the house of a Vedic scholar.…

verses.sanskrit: योगैश्वर्यं सदा तुष्टिं ब्रह्मविद्यामनश्वराम् । समृद्धिं परमां तस्मै ददौ सन्तुष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: yogaiśvaryaṃ sadā tuṣṭiṃ brahmavidyāmanaśvarām | samṛddhiṃ paramāṃ tasmai dadau santuṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves shall be scrubbed with Darbhas, warmed in the fire, then sprinkled with water in the manner prescribed in his Sutra, repeating the name of Siva. He shall then make offering to the fire with the eight Bija mantras. The seven Bijas for the seven flames are respectively Bhrum, Stum, Brum, Srum, Pum, Drum and Drum.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves shall be scrubbed with Darbhas, warmed in the fire, then sprinkled with water in the manner prescribed in his Sutra, repeating the name of Siva. He shall then make offering to the fire with the eight Bija mantras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves shall be scrubbed with Darbhas, warmed in the fire, then sprinkled with water in the manner prescribed in his Sutra, repeating the name of Siva. He shall then make offering to the fire with the eight Bija mantras.…
