verses.sanskrit: अथ शम्भुः प्रसन्नात्मा दृष्ट्वा तस्य तपो महः । पुनर्ददौ वरं दिव्यं मुनये ह्युपमन्यवे
verses.transliteration: atha śambhuḥ prasannātmā dṛṣṭvā tasya tapo mahaḥ | punardadau varaṃ divyaṃ munaye hyupamanyave
verses.translation: The middle tongue has three flames. The flame in the east is yellow. The flame in the south-east is red; that in the south-west is black and the other one is refulgent. As its name implies it is brilliant. It is the flame in the north¬ west.
verses.commentary: Sense: The middle tongue has three flames. The flame in the east is yellow. The flame in the south-east is red; that in the south-west is black and the other one is refulgent. As its name implies it is brilliant. It is the flame in the north¬ west.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रतं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं व्रतयोगं च तत्त्वतः । ददौ तस्मै प्रवक्तृत्वपाटवं सुचिरं परम्
verses.transliteration: vrataṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ vratayogaṃ ca tattvataḥ | dadau tasmai pravaktṛtvapāṭavaṃ suciraṃ param
verses.translation: After repeating their Bija mantras the tongues shall be mentioned and the rite concluding with Svaha per¬ formed in due order. The Ajya shall be used for Ahuti with the mantras of the tongues one by one. In the middle he shall perform three Ahutis repeating 'Ram Vahnyeti Svaha* either with ghee or with sacrificial twigs. Then the rite of Parisecana shall be performed.
verses.wordMeaning: After repeating their Bija mantras the tongues shall be mentioned and the rite concluding with Svaha per¬ formed in due order. The Ajya shall be used for Ahuti with the mantras of the tongues one by one.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After repeating their Bija mantras the tongues shall be mentioned and the rite concluding with Svaha per¬ formed in due order. The Ajya shall be used for Ahuti with the mantras of the tongues one by one.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्दिव्यान् कुमारत्वं च सर्वदा । तस्माच्छिवाच्च तस्याश्च शिवाया मुदितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: so'pi labdhvā varāndivyān kumāratvaṃ ca sarvadā | tasmācchivācca tasyāśca śivāyā mudito'bhavat
verses.translation: The Ajya Ahuti shall be made with the leaf four Angulas wide, shaped in the form of a Durvapatra. After¬ wards, cooked rice of the size of an Aka shall be offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ajya Ahuti shall be made with the leaf four Angulas wide, shaped in the form of a Durvapatra. After¬ wards, cooked rice of the size of an Aka shall be offered.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नचेतस्कः सुप्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः । ययाचे स वरं विप्रो देवदेवान्महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasannacetaskaḥ supraṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ | yayāce sa varaṃ vipro devadevānmaheśvarāt
verses.translation: Fried grains, mustard seeds, barleys, gingelly seeds, foodstuffs soaked in ghee etc. shall be offered if possible.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fried grains, mustard seeds, barleys, gingelly seeds, foodstuffs soaked in ghee etc. shall be offered if possible.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद परमेश्वर । स्वभक्तिं देहि परमां दिव्यामव्यभिचारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | prasīda devadeveśa prasīda parameśvara | svabhaktiṃ dehi paramāṃ divyāmavyabhicāriṇīm
verses.translation: The number of Ahutis shall be ten, five or three according to capacity. It is enough even if one Ahuti is made.
verses.commentary: Sense: The number of Ahutis shall be ten, five or three according to capacity. It is enough even if one Ahuti is made.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धां देहि महादेव स्वसम्बन्धिषु मे सदा । स्वदास्यं परमं स्नेहं सान्निध्यं चैव सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: śraddhāṃ dehi mahādeva svasambandhiṣu me sadā | svadāsyaṃ paramaṃ snehaṃ sānnidhyaṃ caiva sarvadā
verses.translation: The butter shall be offered with the wooden spoon and the articles with the wooden ladle or with hand. The Homa shall be performed at the divine or saintly spot.
verses.commentary: Sense: The butter shall be offered with the wooden spoon and the articles with the wooden ladle or with hand. The Homa shall be performed at the divine or saintly spot.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्त्वा प्रसन्नात्मा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा । स तुष्टाव महादेवमुपमन्युर्द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: muktvā prasannātmā harṣagadgadayā girā | sa tuṣṭāva mahādevamupamanyurdvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: If full articles are not available only one material shall be offered with devotion. As an expiation he shall per¬ form three Ahutis repeating the mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If full articles are not available only one material shall be offered with devotion. As an expiation he shall per¬ form three Ahutis repeating the mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल । प्रसीद करुणासिन्धो साम्ब शङ्कर सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala | prasīda karuṇāsindho sāmba śaṅkara sarvadā
verses.translation: He shall fill the Sruk with the ghee that has been left after Homa and put a flower on it. The Sruva shall be placed above it upside down along with the Darbha. Through the root of the Darbha the ghee shall fall in drops of the size of a barley grain repeating the mantra ending with Vau§at.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall fill the Sruk with the ghee that has been left after Homa and put a flower on it. The Sruva shall be placed above it upside down along with the Darbha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall fill the Sruk with the ghee that has been left after Homa and put a flower on it. The Sruva shall be placed above it upside down along with the Darbha.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एवमुक्तो महादेवः सर्वेषां च वरप्रदः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मोपमन्युं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | evamukto mahādevaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca varapradaḥ | pratyuvāca prasannātmopamanyuṃ munisattamam
verses.translation: Performing the Purnahuti he shall perform the rite of sprinkling water. He shall ritualistically dismiss the lord and preserve the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing the Purnahuti he shall perform the rite of sprinkling water. He shall ritualistically dismiss the lord and preserve the fire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टोऽस्मि सर्वं दत्तं मया हि ते । दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया विज्ञासितो ह्यसि
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca | vatsopamanyo tuṣṭo'smi sarvaṃ dattaṃ mayā hi te | dṛḍhabhakto'si viprarṣe mayā vijñāsito hyasi
verses.translation: i.e. from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the little finger with both of them stretched.
verses.commentary: Sense: i.e. from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the little finger with both of them stretched.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अजरश्चामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः । यशस्वी तेजसा युक्तो दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhava tvaṃ duḥkhavarjitaḥ | yaśasvī tejasā yukto divyajñānasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Agni shall be conceived in the form of having three feet, seven hands, four horns, two heads and three eyes, as tawny as honey, having the matted hair, with the moon for his crest, of red colour, red garments and red unguents, bedecked in garlands and ornaments, richly equipped with all characteristics, having the sacred thread and three girdles, holding the Sruk and Sruva in the right hand, iron club, fan and the vessel of ghee in the other.
verses.wordMeaning: Agni shall be conceived in the form of having three feet, seven hands, four horns, two heads and three eyes, as tawny as honey, having the matted hair, with the moon for his crest, of red colour, red garments and red unguents, bedecked in garlands and ornaments,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni shall be conceived in the form of having three feet, seven hands, four horns, two heads and three eyes, as tawny as honey, having the matted hair, with the moon for his crest, of red colour, red garments and red unguents, bedecked in garlands and ornaments,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती
verses.transliteration: akṣayā bāndhavāścaiva kulaṃ gotraṃ ca te sadā | bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha mayi bhaktiśca śāśvatī
verses.translation: After meditating on the fire thus with these features he shall perform post-natal rites. The umbilical cord shall be removed and the purificatory rite for the post-natal pollution shall be performed. The rite of naming shall be performed by giving him the title of Sivagni with due Ahuti. The rite of ritualistic dismissal of the parents as well as of tonsure, sacred thread shall be performed till the end of Aptoryama. As a consecratory rite the Homa of ghee-pouring shall be performed. Agni shall be conceived as Svistakrt. With the Bija mantra "Ram" the water shall be sprinkled all round. The worship of Brahma, Visnu, Siva, I§a and of their miraculous missiles shall be performed in due order. Then for the sake of incense and lamp, fire shall be taken out by the expert devotee.
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating on the fire thus with these features he shall perform post-natal rites. The umbilical cord shall be removed and the purificatory rite for the post-natal pollution shall be performed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating on the fire thus with these features he shall perform post-natal rites. The umbilical cord shall be removed and the purificatory rite for the post-natal pollution shall be performed.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सान्निध्यं चाश्रमे नित्यं करिष्यामि द्विजोत्तम । उपकण्ठं मम त्वं वै सानन्दं विहरिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: sānnidhyaṃ cāśrame nityaṃ kariṣyāmi dvijottama | upakaṇṭhaṃ mama tvaṃ vai sānandaṃ vihariṣyasi
verses.translation: The devotee shall collect the materials of wor¬ ship, ghee etc., think of the seat of the lord and the goddess, invoke them in the fire and perform the rites until the
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall collect the materials of wor¬ ship, ghee etc., think of the seat of the lord and the goddess, invoke them in the fire and perform the rites until the

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः । ईशानः स वरान्दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa bhagavān sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ | īśānaḥ sa varāndattvā tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ
verses.translation: The ashes from Sivagni shall be collected and preserved. Similarly the ashes of Agnihotra rite or from the fire connected with the celebration of marriage. The fire shall be ripe, pure and sweet-smelling. The dung shall be of the cow, tawny in colour. It is commendable if collected as it falls from the cow before it reaches the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: The ashes from Sivagni shall be collected and preserved. Similarly the ashes of Agnihotra rite or from the fire connected with the celebration of marriage. The fire shall be ripe, pure and sweet-smelling. The dung shall be of the cow, tawny in colour.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ashes from Sivagni shall be collected and preserved. Similarly the ashes of Agnihotra rite or from the fire connected with the celebration of marriage. The fire shall be ripe, pure and sweet-smelling. The dung shall be of the cow, tawny in colour.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युः प्रसन्नात्मा प्राप्य तस्माद्वराद्वरान् । जगाम जननीस्थानं सुखं प्रापाधिकं च सः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuḥ prasannātmā prāpya tasmādvarādvarān | jagāma jananīsthānaṃ sukhaṃ prāpādhikaṃ ca saḥ
verses.translation: If he collects the dung that has already fallen or the ground the upper and the lower portions shall bt eschewed. The dung shall not be too watery nor too solidi¬ fied nor dried up It shall not emit foul smell.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he collects the dung that has already fallen or the ground the upper and the lower portions shall bt eschewed. The dung shall not be too watery nor too solidi¬ fied nor dried up It shall not emit foul smell.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: समाप्तोऽयं सप्तम्या वायवीयसंहितायाः पूर्वखण्डः ॥ ०७।२ श्रीः ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥ श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥ अथ सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डः प्रारभ्यते । ७.२.१. प्रथमोऽध्यायः । कृष्णपुत्रप्राप्तिवर्णनम् । ॐ नमः समस्त संसारचक्रभ्रमणहेतवे । गौरीकुचतटद्वन्द्वकुङ्कुमाङ्कितवक्षसे
verses.transliteration: samāpto'yaṃ saptamyā vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāḥ pūrvakhaṇḍaḥ || 07|2 śrīḥ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha saptamyāṃ vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍaḥ prārabhyate | 7.2.1. prathamo'dhyāyaḥ | kṛṣṇaputraprāptivarṇanam | oṃ namaḥ samasta saṃsāracakrabhramaṇahetave | gaurīkucataṭadvandvakuṅkumāṅkitavakṣase
verses.translation: The ashes shall be collected before the ritualistic dismissal of the lord. After the rite of the ritualistic dismis¬ sal it becomes Gandabhasma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ashes shall be collected before the ritualistic dismissal of the lord. After the rite of the ritualistic dismis¬ sal it becomes Gandabhasma.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । उक्त्वा भगवतो लब्धं प्रसादादुपमन्युना । नियमादुत्थितो वायुर्मध्ये प्राप्ते दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | uktvā bhagavato labdhaṃ prasādādupamanyunā | niyamādutthito vāyurmadhye prāpte divākare
verses.translation: He shall perform the worship of Siva and Siva by means of fresh blown fragrant flowers and begin the rites as mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the worship of Siva and Siva by means of fresh blown fragrant flowers and begin the rites as mentioned before.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश्चापि ते सर्वे नैमिषारण्यवासिनः । अथायमर्थः प्रष्टव्य इति कृत्वा विनिश्चयम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaścāpi te sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ | athāyamarthaḥ praṣṭavya iti kṛtvā viniścayam
verses.translation: In the month of Sep-October on the full moon day he shall make charitable gifts of milk pudding and cooked rice with grains recently harvested. On the star lSatabhi$ak he shall perform the rites of fire too with the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of Sep-October on the full moon day he shall make charitable gifts of milk pudding and cooked rice with grains recently harvested. On the star lSatabhi$ak he shall perform the rites of fire too with the same.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा यथा स्वकं कृत्यं प्रत्यहं ते यथा पुरा । भगवन्तमुपायान्तं समीक्ष्य समुपाविशन्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā yathā svakaṃ kṛtyaṃ pratyahaṃ te yathā purā | bhagavantamupāyāntaṃ samīkṣya samupāviśan
verses.translation: In the month of Octo-November when the moon is in conjunction with the star Kfttika he shall light a thousand.'amps. In the month of Nov-December on the Ardra star he shall perform the ablution of Siva with ghee.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of Octo-November when the moon is in conjunction with the star Kfttika he shall light a thousand.'amps. In the month of Nov-December on the Ardra star he shall perform the ablution of Siva with ghee.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथासौ नियमस्यान्ते भगवानम्बरोद्भवः । मध्ये मुनिसभायास्तु भेजे कॢप्तं वरासनम्
verses.transliteration: athāsau niyamasyānte bhagavānambarodbhavaḥ | madhye munisabhāyāstu bheje kḷptaṃ varāsanam
verses.translation: Those who are unable to perform the rites on the respective occasions shall perform the festival in the big hall of the temple or perform worship or more.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are unable to perform the rites on the respective occasions shall perform the festival in the big hall of the temple or perform worship or more.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुखासनोपविष्टश्च वायुर्लोकनमस्कृतः । श्रीमद्विभूतिमीशस्य हृदि कृत्वेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sukhāsanopaviṣṭaśca vāyurlokanamaskṛtaḥ | śrīmadvibhūtimīśasya hṛdi kṛtvedamabravīt
verses.translation: On occasions when commendable rites shall be performed, when the mind is afflicted and dejected, when the conduct of life has become defiled, when bad dreams occur, when wicked men are seen, when inauspicious portents occur or when afflicted by great ailments, the devotee shall perform ceremonial ablutions, worships, Japas, meditations, sacrifices and other rites and offer charitable gifts suitably along with Purascarana. When the series of Siva-fire is broken it shall be revived.
verses.wordMeaning: On occasions when commendable rites shall be performed, when the mind is afflicted and dejected, when the conduct of life has become defiled, when bad dreams occur, when wicked men are seen, when inauspicious portents occur or when afflicted by great ailments,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On occasions when commendable rites shall be performed, when the mind is afflicted and dejected, when the conduct of life has become defiled, when bad dreams occur, when wicked men are seen, when inauspicious portents occur or when afflicted by great ailments,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रपद्ये महादेवं सर्वज्ञमपराजितम् । विभूतिः सकलं यस्य चराचरमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: taṃ prapadye mahādevaṃ sarvajñamaparājitam | vibhūtiḥ sakalaṃ yasya carācaramidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Siva bestows salvation on the person who performs his rites thus, perpetually and assiduously, even in a single birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva bestows salvation on the person who performs his rites thus, perpetually and assiduously, even in a single birth.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्याकर्ण्य शुभां वाणीं ऋषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः । विभूतिविस्तरं श्रोतुमूचुस्ते परमं वचः
verses.transliteration: ityākarṇya śubhāṃ vāṇīṃ ṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ | vibhūtivistaraṃ śrotumūcuste paramaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: He who performs in succession the compulsory and optional rites attains the divine and primordial region of lord §iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs in succession the compulsory and optional rites attains the divine and primordial region of lord §iva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । उक्तं भगवता वृत्तमुपमन्योर्महात्मनः । क्षीरार्थेनापि तपसा यत्प्राप्तं परमेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | uktaṃ bhagavatā vṛttamupamanyormahātmanaḥ | kṣīrārthenāpi tapasā yatprāptaṃ parameśvarāt
verses.translation: The man enjoys great pleasures there for mil¬ lions and millions of Kalpas. After some time, falling from there he occupies the regions of Uma, Kumara, Vi?nu, Brahma, Rudra and enjoys the pleasures there as men¬ tioned. Again he goes up and transcends the five regions. Securing knowledge of Siva he attains Siva*s city.

verses.translation: After the rites in the fire have been concluded he shall perform the oblation rite according to the injunctions m the Saivite scriptures or as mentioned in his own Sutra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the rites in the fire have been concluded he shall perform the oblation rite according to the injunctions m the Saivite scriptures or as mentioned in his own Sutra.

verses.translation: Then after conceiving the scat of Vidya on the well-smeared Mapdala he shall instal the sheath of Vidya and worship the same with flowers etc. in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after conceiving the scat of Vidya on the well-smeared Mapdala he shall instal the sheath of Vidya and worship the same with flowers etc. in due order.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं हि तपस्तप्तुं गतस्तस्य महामुनेः । आश्रमं मुनिभिर्दृष्टं दृष्टवांस्तत्र वै मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ hi tapastaptuṃ gatastasya mahāmuneḥ | āśramaṃ munibhirdṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstatra vai munim
verses.translation: Thereafter the venerable persons shall be worshipped and the hungry shall be fed. The devotee shall take the wholesome food at leisure, comfortably.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the venerable persons shall be worshipped and the hungry shall be fed. The devotee shall take the wholesome food at leisure, comfortably.

verses.translation: What has been offered as Naivedya or what is left over he shall partake of, with full faith and not out of covetousness. It shall be for the purity of the Atman. verses.translation: At night he shall perform worship and then make out bed for Siva and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: At night he shall perform worship and then make out bed for Siva and Siva.

verses.translation: He shall offer mentally or physically various food¬ stuffs, garments, unguents flower-garlands, etc. all performed in a charming way.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer mentally or physically various food¬ stuffs, garments, unguents flower-garlands, etc. all performed in a charming way.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षीणमलं कृष्णमुपमन्युर्यथाविधि । भस्मनोद्धूल्य तं मन्त्रैरग्निरित्यादिभिः क्रमात्

verses.translation: The devotee shall go to bed at the feet of the lord and the goddess. The householder shall sleep there with his wife. Others shall sleep alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall go to bed at the feet of the lord and the goddess. The householder shall sleep there with his wife. Others shall sleep alone.

verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ munayaśśaṃsitavratāḥ | divyāḥ pāśupatāḥ sarve parivṛtyopatasthire
verses.translation: Now I shall explain the procedure of rites under certain conditions to be performed by those who follow the iaivite conduct of life in the manner prescribed in the Saivitc scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall explain the procedure of rites under certain conditions to be performed by those who follow the iaivite conduct of life in the manner prescribed in the Saivitc scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गुरुनियोगाद् वै कृष्णः परमशक्तिमान् । तपश्चकार पुत्रार्थं साम्बमुद्दिश्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tato guruniyogād vai kṛṣṇaḥ paramaśaktimān | tapaścakāra putrārthaṃ sāmbamuddiśya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: The great worship shall be performed every month in both the fortnights on the eighth and fourteenth days and on the Full-moon and the New-moon days. It must be performed particularly at the tropical and equinoctial transit of the sun and during the eclipses, according to his capacity.

verses.sanskrit: तपसो तेन वर्षान्ते दृष्टोऽसौ परमेश्वरः । श्रिया परमया युक्तः साम्बश्च सगणः शिवः
verses.transliteration: tapaso tena varṣānte dṛṣṭo'sau parameśvaraḥ | śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sāmbaśca sagaṇaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Every month he shall observe fast for a day and prepare Brahmakurca. He shall perform the ablution of Siva thereby and drink the residue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every month he shall observe fast for a day and prepare Brahmakurca. He shall perform the ablution of Siva thereby and drink the residue.

verses.sanskrit: वरार्थमाविर्भूतस्य हरस्य सुभगाकृतेः । स्तुतिं चकार नत्वाऽसौ कृष्णः सम्यक् कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: varārthamāvirbhūtasya harasya subhagākṛteḥ | stutiṃ cakāra natvā'sau kṛṣṇaḥ samyak kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: The atonement for the murder of a brahmin and other great sins is the drinking of Brahmakurca.*®" There Is no better remedy.
verses.commentary: Sense: The atonement for the murder of a brahmin and other great sins is the drinking of Brahmakurca.*®" There Is no better remedy.

verses.sanskrit: साम्बेन सगणेनापि लब्धवान् युत्रमात्मनः । तपसा तुष्टचित्तेन दत्तं विष्णोः शिवेन वै
verses.transliteration: sāmbena sagaṇenāpi labdhavān yutramātmanaḥ | tapasā tuṣṭacittena dattaṃ viṣṇoḥ śivena vai
verses.translation: In the month of Dcc-Jan. when the moon is in the asterism Pusya he shall perform the rite of Nirajana to the lord. In the month of Jan-February in the Magha star he shall make the charitable gifts of ghee and woollen blanket.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of Dcc-Jan. when the moon is in the asterism Pusya he shall perform the rite of Nirajana to the lord. In the month of Jan-February in the Magha star he shall make the charitable gifts of ghee and woollen blanket.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्साम्बो महादेवः प्रददौ पुत्रमात्मनः । तस्माज्जाम्बवतीसूनुं साम्बं चक्रे स नामतः
verses.transliteration: yasmātsāmbo mahādevaḥ pradadau putramātmanaḥ | tasmājjāmbavatīsūnuṃ sāmbaṃ cakre sa nāmataḥ
verses.translation: In the month of Feb-March in the star Uttara- Phalguni he shall start the great festival. In the month of March-April on the full-moon day and Citra star, he shall perform the Swing-festival duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of Feb-March in the star Uttara- Phalguni he shall start the great festival. In the month of March-April on the full-moon day and Citra star, he shall perform the Swing-festival duly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदेतत्कथितं सर्वं कृष्णस्यामितकर्मणः । महर्षेर्ज्ञानलाभश्च पुत्रलाभश्च शङ्करात्
verses.transliteration: tadetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasyāmitakarmaṇaḥ | maharṣerjñānalābhaśca putralābhaśca śaṅkarāt
verses.translation: In the month of April-May on the full-moon day with the star Visakha he shall make the great temple of flov/ers. In the month of May June on the star Mula he shall offer pot of cold water.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of April-May on the full-moon day with the star Visakha he shall make the great temple of flov/ers. In the month of May June on the star Mula he shall offer pot of cold water.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्तयेन्नित्यं शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेत्तथा । स विष्णोर्ज्ञानमासाद्य तेनैव सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ kīrtayennityaṃ śṛṇuyācchrāvayettathā | sa viṣṇorjñānamāsādya tenaiva saha modate
verses.translation: In the month of June-July on the star Uttara- sadha the rite of investiture with sacred thread shall be per¬ formed. In the month of July- August the mystic diagrams shall be arranged. In the month of Aug-September in the star

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: A devotee who performs half the number of holy rites has this upward and downward journey twice and there¬ after secures knowledge and attains Siva's Sayujya.
verses.commentary: Sense: A devotee who performs half the number of holy rites has this upward and downward journey twice and there¬ after secures knowledge and attains Siva's Sayujya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥ ७.२.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । शिवमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । किं तत्पाशुपतं ज्ञानं कथं पशुपतिः शिवः । कथं धौम्याग्रजः पृष्टः कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || 7.2.2. dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | śivamāhātmyavarṇanam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | kiṃ tatpāśupataṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ paśupatiḥ śivaḥ | kathaṃ dhaumyāgrajaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā

verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व वायो शङ्करविग्रह । त्वत्समो न हि वक्तास्ति त्रैलोक्येष्वपरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vāyo śaṅkaravigraha | tvatsamo na hi vaktāsti trailokyeṣvaparaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: It shall have five Avaranas and shall be very splendid. The Siddhis shall be conceived in the petals. The Rudras along with Saktis shall be conceived in the filaments. The eight deities Varna etc. shall be conceived in the petals beginning with the eastern one; Vairagya in the pericarp, the nine Saktis in the seeds, Saivite holy rite in the bulbous root, knowledge of Siva in the stalk. Above the pericarp the discs of the fire, the sun and the moon shall be con¬ ceived. Beyond that shall be conceived the trio: Siva, Vidyfi and Atma. Above all scats Siva shall be conceived equipped with the flowers of various colours.
verses.wordMeaning: It shall have five Avaranas and shall be very splendid. The Siddhis shall be conceived in the petals. The Rudras along with Saktis shall be conceived in the filaments. The eight deities Varna etc. shall be conceived in the petals beginning with the eastern one;…
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall have five Avaranas and shall be very splendid. The Siddhis shall be conceived in the petals. The Rudras along with Saktis shall be conceived in the filaments. The eight deities Varna etc. shall be conceived in the petals beginning with the eastern one;…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां महर्षीणां प्रभञ्जनः । संस्मृत्य शिवमीशानं प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca | ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ prabhañjanaḥ | saṃsmṛtya śivamīśānaṃ pravaktumupacakrame
verses.translation: Then in the western petal he shall worship lord Siva along with his Sakti. Similarly in the northern petal he shall worship Ekanetra and his Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the western petal he shall worship lord Siva along with his Sakti. Similarly in the northern petal he shall worship Ekanetra and his Sakti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । पुरा साक्षात् महेशेन श्रीकण्ठाख्येन मन्दरे । देव्यै देवेन कथितं ज्ञानं पाशुपतं परम्
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca | purā sākṣāt maheśena śrīkaṇṭhākhyena mandare | devyai devena kathitaṃ jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ param
verses.translation: When the third Avarana has been worshipped thus he shall worship the fourth Avarana outside it after meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the third Avarana has been worshipped thus he shall worship the fourth Avarana outside it after meditation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदेव पृष्टं कृष्णेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना । पशुत्वं च सुरादीनां पतित्वं च शिवस्य च
verses.transliteration: tadeva pṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā | paśutvaṃ ca surādīnāṃ patitvaṃ ca śivasya ca
verses.translation: Hiranyagarbha is the first Brahma resembling the lotus, Kala has the lustre of Jati and collyrium. Purusa resembles the crystal. He has three Gunas: sattva, rajas and tamas. The four are stationed in order in the first Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyagarbha is the first Brahma resembling the lotus, Kala has the lustre of Jati and collyrium. Purusa resembles the crystal. He has three Gunas: sattva, rajas and tamas. The four are stationed in order in the first Avarana.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथोपदिष्टं कृष्णाय मुनिना ह्युपमन्युना । तथा समासतो वक्ष्ये तच्छृणुध्वमतन्द्रिताः
verses.transliteration: yathopadiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇāya muninā hyupamanyunā | tathā samāsato vakṣye tacchṛṇudhvamatandritāḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva the lord of twentysix principles thus to the west of Siva, he shall worship Vaikuntha in the northern side.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Siva the lord of twentysix principles thus to the west of Siva, he shall worship Vaikuntha in the northern side.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरोपमन्युमासीनं विष्णुःकृष्णवपुर्धरः । प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: puropamanyumāsīnaṃ viṣṇuḥkṛṣṇavapurdharaḥ | praṇipatya yathānyāyamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: In the third Avarana, he shall worship the Cakra in the east, the unthwartable missile Narayana in the south, Paficajanya in the west and the bow Sarnga in the north. Thus he shall worship the great Hari — Visva himself after making an idol of Mahavisnu, Sadavisnu, by means of the three Avaranas. After worshipping the four forms of Vi?nu thus in the form of a circle of four, their Saktis too shall be worshipped.
verses.wordMeaning: In the third Avarana, he shall worship the Cakra in the east, the unthwartable missile Narayana in the south, Paficajanya in the west and the bow Sarnga in the north. Thus he shall worship the great Hari — Visva himself after making an idol of Mahavisnu, Sadavisnu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the third Avarana, he shall worship the Cakra in the east, the unthwartable missile Narayana in the south, Paficajanya in the west and the bow Sarnga in the north. Thus he shall worship the great Hari — Visva himself after making an idol of Mahavisnu, Sadavisnu,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि देव्यै देवेन भाषितम् । दिव्यं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं विभूतिं वास्य कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | bhagavañchrotumicchāmi devyai devena bhāṣitam | divyaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ vibhūtiṃ vāsya kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: He shall worship Prabha in the south-east, Saras- vati in the south-west, Ganambika in the north-west and Laksmi in the north-east.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Prabha in the south-east, Saras- vati in the south-west, Ganambika in the north-west and Laksmi in the north-east.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कथं पशुपतिर्देवः पशवः के प्रकीर्तिताः । कैः पाशैस्ते निबध्यन्ते विमुच्यन्ते च ते कथम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ paśupatirdevaḥ paśavaḥ ke prakīrtitāḥ | kaiḥ pāśaiste nibadhyante vimucyante ca te katham
verses.translation: After performing the worship of the sun and other forms as well as their Saktis, he shall worship the lords of the worlds in the same Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the worship of the sun and other forms as well as their Saktis, he shall worship the lords of the worlds in the same Avarana.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इति सञ्चोदितः श्रीमानुपमन्युर्महात्मना । प्रणम्य देवं देवीं च प्राह पुष्टो यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: iti sañcoditaḥ śrīmānupamanyurmahātmanā | praṇamya devaṃ devīṃ ca prāha puṣṭo yathā tathā
verses.translation: After enjoying extensive pleasures he will attain the region of Vidyesvaras. After enjoying the vast pleasures along with Vidyesvaras he will return for once either within or outside the universe. Thereafter he will secure the perfect knowledge of Siva and the great devotion. After attaining identity with iSiva he does not return again.
verses.wordMeaning: After enjoying extensive pleasures he will attain the region of Vidyesvaras. After enjoying the vast pleasures along with Vidyesvaras he will return for once either within or outside the universe. Thereafter he will secure the perfect knowledge of Siva and the great devotion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying extensive pleasures he will attain the region of Vidyesvaras. After enjoying the vast pleasures along with Vidyesvaras he will return for once either within or outside the universe. Thereafter he will secure the perfect knowledge of Siva and the great devotion.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । ब्रह्माद्याः स्थावरान्ताश्च देवदेवस्य शूलिनः । पशवः परिकीर्त्यन्ते संसारवशवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | brahmādyāḥ sthāvarāntāśca devadevasya śūlinaḥ | paśavaḥ parikīrtyante saṃsāravaśavartinaḥ
verses.translation: A person who is devoted to Siva even as the others are devoted to sensual objects shall be liberated whe¬ ther he performs or does not perform the Saivite holy rites. He returns once, twice, or thrice but ultimately does not return.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who is devoted to Siva even as the others are devoted to sensual objects shall be liberated whe¬ ther he performs or does not perform the Saivite holy rites. He returns once, twice, or thrice but ultimately does not return.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पतित्वाद्देवेशः शिवः पशुपतिः स्मृतः । मलमायादिभिः पाशैः स बध्नाति पशून् पतिः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ patitvāddeveśaḥ śivaḥ paśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ | malamāyādibhiḥ pāśaiḥ sa badhnāti paśūn patiḥ
verses.translation: He becomes an emperor and is invested with the right in the Saivite ritual. If one desires welfare one shall seek refuge in Siva and resort to his holy rites. But we do not compel anyone through any means.
verses.commentary: Sense: He becomes an emperor and is invested with the right in the Saivite ritual. If one desires welfare one shall seek refuge in Siva and resort to his holy rites. But we do not compel anyone through any means.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स एव मोचकस्तेषां भक्त्या सम्यगुपासितः । चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानि मायाकर्मगुणा अमी
verses.transliteration: sa eva mocakasteṣāṃ bhaktyā samyagupāsitaḥ | caturviṃśatitattvāni māyākarmaguṇā amī
verses.translation: Neither importunities nor over-discussions arc appealing. The Saivite rites appeal to some others by virtue of the merits they bestow and the previous impressions they invoke if the cause of worldliness in their case is not com¬ petent to help. Hence, if one longs for the welfare of the Atman, one shall ponder over all these things in accordance with his nature and engage himself in the Saivite holy rites.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither importunities nor over-discussions arc appealing. The Saivite rites appeal to some others by virtue of the merits they bestow and the previous impressions they invoke if the cause of worldliness in their case is not com¬ petent to help. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither importunities nor over-discussions arc appealing. The Saivite rites appeal to some others by virtue of the merits they bestow and the previous impressions they invoke if the cause of worldliness in their case is not com¬ petent to help. Hence,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विषया इति कथ्यन्ते पाशा जीवनिबन्धनाः । ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तान् पशून् बद्ध्वा महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: viṣayā iti kathyante pāśā jīvanibandhanāḥ | brahmādistambaparyantān paśūn baddhvā maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Some rites yield benefit here itself. Some yield benefit hereafter. Both of them are of five types. Some rites arc in the form of activities, some in the form of penance, some in the form of Japas, some in the form of meditation, some in the form of all these. Those in the form of activities are the rites of Homa and worship.
verses.wordMeaning: Some rites yield benefit here itself. Some yield benefit hereafter. Both of them are of five types. Some rites arc in the form of activities, some in the form of penance, some in the form of Japas, some in the form of meditation, some in the form of all these.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some rites yield benefit here itself. Some yield benefit hereafter. Both of them are of five types. Some rites arc in the form of activities, some in the form of penance, some in the form of Japas, some in the form of meditation, some in the form of all these.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाशैरेतैः पतिर्देवः कार्यं कारयति स्वकम् । तस्याज्ञया महेशस्य प्रकृतिः पुरुषोचिताम्
verses.transliteration: pāśairetaiḥ patirdevaḥ kāryaṃ kārayati svakam | tasyājñayā maheśasya prakṛtiḥ puruṣocitām
verses.translation: The rites can be fruitful only for those who have all Saktis. Sakti is the behest of Siva the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rites can be fruitful only for those who have all Saktis. Sakti is the behest of Siva the great Atman.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिं प्रसूते सा बुद्धिरहङ्कारमहङ्कृतिः । इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च तन्मात्रापञ्चकं तथा
verses.transliteration: buddhiṃ prasūte sā buddhirahaṅkāramahaṅkṛtiḥ | indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca tanmātrāpañcakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Hence only the brahmin who upholds the behest shall perform the Kamya rites. Now I shall mention the Kamya rites yielding benefit.here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence only the brahmin who upholds the behest shall perform the Kamya rites. Now I shall mention the Kamya rites yielding benefit.here and hereafter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शासनाद्देवदेवस्य शिवस्य शिवदायिनः । तन्मात्राण्यपि तस्यैव शासनेन महीयसा
verses.transliteration: śāsanāddevadevasya śivasya śivadāyinaḥ | tanmātrāṇyapi tasyaiva śāsanena mahīyasā
verses.translation: The internal rites shall be performed by the followers of Siva and the external by the followers of Mahevara. In fact the followers of Siva and of Mahesvara arc not different even as Siva and Mahesvara are not diffe¬ rent. Men engaged in the sacrifice of knowledge are the followers of Siva and seek refuge in him. Those who are engaged in the sacrifice of activities are the followers of MaheSvara. Saivas shall perform internal and the Mahe- svaras external rites.
verses.wordMeaning: The internal rites shall be performed by the followers of Siva and the external by the followers of Mahevara. In fact the followers of Siva and of Mahesvara arc not different even as Siva and Mahesvara are not diffe¬ rent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The internal rites shall be performed by the followers of Siva and the external by the followers of Mahevara. In fact the followers of Siva and of Mahesvara arc not different even as Siva and Mahesvara are not diffe¬ rent.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतान्यशेषाणि भावयन्त्यनुपूर्वशः । ब्रह्मादीनां तृणान्तानां देहिनां देहसङ्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: mahābhūtānyaśeṣāṇi bhāvayantyanupūrvaśaḥ | brahmādīnāṃ tṛṇāntānāṃ dehināṃ dehasaṅgatim
verses.translation: In the rite which is going to be mentioned the procedure is not different. The ground shall be tested through smell, colour and taste. It shall be desirable. A canopy shall be spread above. The ground shall be well-scrubbed and smeared to appear like the surface of a mirror. Along the path, as seen in the sacred scriptures he shall consecrate
verses.wordMeaning: In the rite which is going to be mentioned the procedure is not different. The ground shall be tested through smell, colour and taste. It shall be desirable. A canopy shall be spread above. The ground shall be well-scrubbed and smeared to appear like the surface of a mirror.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the rite which is going to be mentioned the procedure is not different. The ground shall be tested through smell, colour and taste. It shall be desirable. A canopy shall be spread above. The ground shall be well-scrubbed and smeared to appear like the surface of a mirror.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतान्यशेषाणि जनयन्ति शिवाज्ञया । अध्यवस्यति वै बुद्धिरहङ्कारोभिमन्यते
verses.transliteration: mahābhūtānyaśeṣāṇi janayanti śivājñayā | adhyavasyati vai buddhirahaṅkārobhimanyate
verses.translation: An eight'petalled pure lotus along wtth its peri¬ carp shall be drawn by means of gold dust, gem dust etc. gathered according to availability.
verses.commentary: Sense: An eight'petalled pure lotus along wtth its peri¬ carp shall be drawn by means of gold dust, gem dust etc. gathered according to availability.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चित्तं चेतयते चापि मनः सङ्कल्पयत्यपि । श्रोत्रादीनि च गृह्णन्ति शब्दादीन्विषयान् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: cittaṃ cetayate cāpi manaḥ saṅkalpayatyapi | śrotrādīni ca gṛhṇanti śabdādīnviṣayān pṛthak
verses.translation: He shall worship Siva with the five Avaranas
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Siva with the five Avaranas
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वानेव नान्यान् देवस्य दिव्येनाज्ञाबलेन वै । वागादीन्यपि यान्यासंस्तानि कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: svāneva nānyān devasya divyenājñābalena vai | vāgādīnyapi yānyāsaṃstāni karmendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: The southern face has the charming lustre of the blue cloud. The brows are crooked and the face is terrible with three red and circular eyes.,It is terrible with the curved fangs. None dare offend it. His lips throb. The northern face is like a coral, bedecked with blue forelocks. It has charming movements. It has three eyes and the moon bedecks its crest. The western face has three brilliant eyes and the lustre of the full moon. It also wears the digit of the moon. It is gentle and charming with smiles. The
verses.wordMeaning: The southern face has the charming lustre of the blue cloud. The brows are crooked and the face is terrible with three red and circular eyes.,It is terrible with the curved fangs. None dare offend it. His lips throb. The northern face is like a coral,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The southern face has the charming lustre of the blue cloud. The brows are crooked and the face is terrible with three red and circular eyes.,It is terrible with the curved fangs. None dare offend it. His lips throb. The northern face is like a coral,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथास्वं कर्म कुर्वन्ति नान्यत्किञ्चिद् शिवाज्ञया । शब्दादयोऽपि गृह्यन्ते क्रियन्ते वचनादयः
verses.transliteration: yathāsvaṃ karma kurvanti nānyatkiñcid śivājñayā | śabdādayo'pi gṛhyante kriyante vacanādayaḥ
verses.translation: In his right side he shines with the trident, axe, thunderbolt, sword and fire. In his left side he shines brilliantly with the serpent, arrow, bell, noose and goad. The nivrttikala envelops him upto the knee, the pratiijtha- kala to the navel, the Vidyakala to the neck and the Santa- kala to the forehead. Above that he is enveloped by the great lantyatitakala. Thus pervading the five pathways he has the five Kalas constituting his body.
verses.wordMeaning: In his right side he shines with the trident, axe, thunderbolt, sword and fire. In his left side he shines brilliantly with the serpent, arrow, bell, noose and goad. The nivrttikala envelops him upto the knee, the pratiijtha- kala to the navel,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In his right side he shines with the trident, axe, thunderbolt, sword and fire. In his left side he shines brilliantly with the serpent, arrow, bell, noose and goad. The nivrttikala envelops him upto the knee, the pratiijtha- kala to the navel,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अविलङ्घ्या हि सर्वेषामाज्ञा शम्भोर्गरीयसी । अवकाशमशेषाणां भूतानां सम्प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: avilaṅghyā hi sarveṣāmājñā śambhorgarīyasī | avakāśamaśeṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ samprayacchati
verses.translation: The lord has Iana as his coronet. He is the eternal one named Purusa. Aghora constitutes his heart, Vamadeva his private parts and Sadyojata his legs. His form consists of thirtyeight Kalas. The lord consists of the Varnas, letters. He is identical with the five Brahmans. He is of the Omkara form. He is endowed with the Sakti of Hamsa Atman. His lap is enveloped by the Icchasakti. His right side is flanked by Jflana Sakti and the left by KriyaSakti. Sadasiva ih the form Vidya shall be conceived as identical with the trio of Tattvas. The Murti shall be conceived with the basic mantra and everything shall be combined into one unit. Until the Arghya he shall be wor¬ shipped duly with the basic mantra. Siva shall be invoked along with the great Sakti, in the embodied form. The lord devoid of Sat and Asat shall be invoked and worshipped with the five articles of worship.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord has Iana as his coronet. He is the eternal one named Purusa. Aghora constitutes his heart, Vamadeva his private parts and Sadyojata his legs. His form consists of thirtyeight Kalas. The lord consists of the Varnas, letters. He is identical with the five Brahmans.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord has Iana as his coronet. He is the eternal one named Purusa. Aghora constitutes his heart, Vamadeva his private parts and Sadyojata his legs. His form consists of thirtyeight Kalas. The lord consists of the Varnas, letters. He is identical with the five Brahmans.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशः परमेशस्य शासनादेव सर्वगः । प्राणाद्यैश्च तथा नामभेदैरन्तर्बहिर्जगत्
verses.transliteration: ākāśaḥ parameśasya śāsanādeva sarvagaḥ | prāṇādyaiśca tathā nāmabhedairantarbahirjagat
verses.translation: He shall be worshipped with the five brahmans and six ancillaries. With Matfkas repeating the Pranava, he shall worship Siva in the company of Sakti, in the quiet form repeating the mantras. Or he shall worship the lord only with the Siva mantra. Then he shall begin the Pancavarana Puja after offering Padya etc. upto Mukhavasa. But the rite of Prasthapana (bidding the deity farewell) shall not be performed.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be worshipped with the five brahmans and six ancillaries. With Matfkas repeating the Pranava, he shall worship Siva in the company of Sakti, in the quiet form repeating the mantras. Or he shall worship the lord only with the Siva mantra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be worshipped with the five brahmans and six ancillaries. With Matfkas repeating the Pranava, he shall worship Siva in the company of Sakti, in the quiet form repeating the mantras. Or he shall worship the lord only with the Siva mantra.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्ति सर्वं शर्वस्य शासनेन प्रभञ्जनः । हव्यं वहति देवानां कव्यं कव्याशिनामपि
verses.transliteration: bibharti sarvaṃ śarvasya śāsanena prabhañjanaḥ | havyaṃ vahati devānāṃ kavyaṃ kavyāśināmapi
verses.translation: Then in the first Avarana he shall worship the five Brahmans beginning with ISana and ending with Sadyojata along with their Saktis all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the first Avarana he shall worship the five Brahmans beginning with ISana and ending with Sadyojata along with their Saktis all round.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाकाद्यं च करोत्यग्निः परमेश्वरशासनात् । सञ्जीवनाद्यं सर्वस्य कुर्वत्यापस्तदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: pākādyaṃ ca karotyagniḥ parameśvaraśāsanāt | sañjīvanādyaṃ sarvasya kurvatyāpastadājñayā
verses.translation: The six limbs — the heart etc. of Siva and Siva shall be worshipped from the south-east.
verses.commentary: Sense: The six limbs — the heart etc. of Siva and Siva shall be worshipped from the south-east.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वम्भरा जगन्नित्यं धत्ते विश्वेश्वराज्ञया । देवान् यात्यसुरान् हन्ति त्रिलोकमभिरक्षति
verses.transliteration: viśvambharā jagannityaṃ dhatte viśveśvarājñayā | devān yātyasurān hanti trilokamabhirakṣati
verses.translation: Afterwards he may or may not worship the eight Rudras-Vama etc. along with their Saktis all round in order, from the east onwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards he may or may not worship the eight Rudras-Vama etc. along with their Saktis all round in order, from the east onwards.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञया तस्य देवेन्द्रः सर्वैर्देवैरलङ्घ्यया । आधिपत्यमपां नित्यं कुरुते वरुणः सदा
verses.transliteration: ājñayā tasya devendraḥ sarvairdevairalaṅghyayā | ādhipatyamapāṃ nityaṃ kurute varuṇaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Thus, O Krsna, the first Avarana has been men¬ tioned to you. Now listen to the second Avarana with faith.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O Krsna, the first Avarana has been men¬ tioned to you. Now listen to the second Avarana with faith.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाशैर्बध्नाति च यथा दण्ड्यांस्तस्यैव शासनात् । ददाति नित्यं यक्षेन्द्रो द्रविणं द्रविणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pāśairbadhnāti ca yathā daṇḍyāṃstasyaiva śāsanāt | dadāti nityaṃ yakṣendro draviṇaṃ draviṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He shall worship Ananta in the eastern petal and his Sakti to his left. In the southern petal he shall worship Sukma and his Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Ananta in the eastern petal and his Sakti to his left. In the southern petal he shall worship Sukma and his Sakti.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यानुरूपं भूतेभ्यः पुरुषस्यानुशासनात् । करोति सम्पदः शश्वत् ज्ञानं चापि सुमेधसाम्
verses.transliteration: puṇyānurūpaṃ bhūtebhyaḥ puruṣasyānuśāsanāt | karoti sampadaḥ śaśvat jñānaṃ cāpi sumedhasām
verses.translation: Afterwards he shall worship Ekarudra and his Sakti in the north-eastern petal. He shall worship Trimurti and his Sakti in the South-eastern petal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards he shall worship Ekarudra and his Sakti in the north-eastern petal. He shall worship Trimurti and his Sakti in the South-eastern petal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहं चाप्यसाधूनामीशानः शिवशासनात् । धत्ते तु धरणीं मूर्ध्ना शेषः शिवनियोगतः
verses.transliteration: nigrahaṃ cāpyasādhūnāmīśānaḥ śivaśāsanāt | dhatte tu dharaṇīṃ mūrdhnā śeṣaḥ śivaniyogataḥ
verses.translation: He shall worship Srikantha and his Sakti towards his left in the south-western petal. Similarly he shall wor¬ ship SikhancHa and his Sakti in the north-western petal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Srikantha and his Sakti towards his left in the south-western petal. Similarly he shall wor¬ ship SikhancHa and his Sakti in the north-western petal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुस्तामसीं रौद्रीं मूर्तिमन्तकरीं हरेः । सृजत्यशेषमीशस्य शासनाच्चतुराननः
verses.transliteration: yāmāhustāmasīṃ raudrīṃ mūrtimantakarīṃ hareḥ | sṛjatyaśeṣamīśasya śāsanāccaturānanaḥ
verses.translation: In the second Avarana the Gakravartins, in the third Avarana the Astamurtis shall be worshipped along with their Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second Avarana the Gakravartins, in the third Avarana the Astamurtis shall be worshipped along with their Saktis.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्याभिर्मूर्तिभिः स्वाभिः पाति चान्ते निहन्ति च । विष्णुः पालयते विश्वं कालकालस्य शासनात्
verses.transliteration: anyābhirmūrtibhiḥ svābhiḥ pāti cānte nihanti ca | viṣṇuḥ pālayate viśvaṃ kālakālasya śāsanāt
verses.translation: They shall be worshipped in the eight quarters from the east onwards in order. The eight Murtis** in order are Bhava, Sarva, Isana Rudra, Paupati, Ugra, Bhima
verses.commentary: Sense: They shall be worshipped in the eight quarters from the east onwards in order. The eight Murtis** in order are Bhava, Sarva, Isana Rudra, Paupati, Ugra, Bhima
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सृजते त्रसते चापि स्वकाभिस्तनुभिस्त्रिभिः । हरत्यन्ते जगत्सर्वं हरस्तस्यैव शासनात्
verses.transliteration: sṛjate trasate cāpi svakābhistanubhistribhiḥ | haratyante jagatsarvaṃ harastasyaiva śāsanāt
verses.translation: The eleven Murtis are: Mahadeva, l§iva, Rudra, Sankara, Nilalohita, Isana, Vijaya, Bhima, Devadeva, Bhavodbhava and Kapardisa. The first eight shall be wor¬ shipped in the south-eastern quarter onwards. Devadeva shall be worshipped in the eastern petel. Bhavodbhava shall be worshipped either in the north-east or in the south-east. Kapallsa shall be worshipped in their middle.
verses.wordMeaning: The eleven Murtis are: Mahadeva, l§iva, Rudra, Sankara, Nilalohita, Isana, Vijaya, Bhima, Devadeva, Bhavodbhava and Kapardisa. The first eight shall be wor¬ shipped in the south-eastern quarter onwards. Devadeva shall be worshipped in the eastern petel.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eleven Murtis are: Mahadeva, l§iva, Rudra, Sankara, Nilalohita, Isana, Vijaya, Bhima, Devadeva, Bhavodbhava and Kapardisa. The first eight shall be wor¬ shipped in the south-eastern quarter onwards. Devadeva shall be worshipped in the eastern petel.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सृजत्यपि च विश्वात्मा त्रिधा भिन्नस्तु रक्षति । कालः करोति सकलं कालस्संहरति प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: sṛjatyapi ca viśvātmā tridhā bhinnastu rakṣati | kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ kālassaṃharati prajāḥ
verses.translation: In the same Avarana he shall worship the lordly bull in the east, Nandin in the south, Mahakala in the north, Sastr in the south-eastern petal or in the petal to the south of the goddess. He shall worship GaneSa in the south-western petal and Sanmukha in the western petal. He shall worship Jyesjha in the north-western petal, Gauri in the north and Canda in the north-east. He shall worship Munindra between iastr and Nandlsa.
verses.wordMeaning: In the same Avarana he shall worship the lordly bull in the east, Nandin in the south, Mahakala in the north, Sastr in the south-eastern petal or in the petal to the south of the goddess. He shall worship GaneSa in the south-western petal and Sanmukha in the western petal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the same Avarana he shall worship the lordly bull in the east, Nandin in the south, Mahakala in the north, Sastr in the south-eastern petal or in the petal to the south of the goddess. He shall worship GaneSa in the south-western petal and Sanmukha in the western petal.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कालः पालयते विश्वं कालकालस्य शासनात् । त्रिभिरंशैर्जगद्बिभ्रत्तेजोभिर्वृष्टिमादिशन्
verses.transliteration: kālaḥ pālayate viśvaṃ kālakālasya śāsanāt | tribhiraṃśairjagadbibhrattejobhirvṛṣṭimādiśan
verses.translation: He shall worship Pihgala to the north of Mahakala. Then he shall worship Bhrhgisvara in the middle of Sastra and Matr group.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Pihgala to the north of Mahakala. Then he shall worship Bhrhgisvara in the middle of Sastra and Matr group.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दिवि वर्षत्यसौ भानुर्देवदेवस्य शासनात् । पुष्णात्योषधिजातानि भूतान्याह्लादयत्यपि
verses.transliteration: divi varṣatyasau bhānurdevadevasya śāsanāt | puṣṇātyoṣadhijātāni bhūtānyāhlādayatyapi
verses.translation: He shall worship Virabhadra in between the Matrs and Vighnesa. He shall worship goddess Sarasvat! in between Skanda and Vighnesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Virabhadra in between the Matrs and Vighnesa. He shall worship goddess Sarasvat! in between Skanda and Vighnesa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवैश्च पीयते चन्द्रश्चन्द्रभूषणशासनात् । आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: devaiśca pīyate candraścandrabhūṣaṇaśāsanāt | ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau marutastathā
verses.translation: He shall worship goddess Durga in between Ganamba and Canda. In the same Avarana he shall worship the host of Siva's attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship goddess Durga in between Ganamba and Canda. In the same Avarana he shall worship the host of Siva's attendants.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: खेचरा ऋषयस्सिद्धा भोगिनो मनुजा मृगाः । पशवः पक्षिणश्चैव कीटाद्याः स्थावराणि च
verses.transliteration: khecarā ṛṣayassiddhā bhogino manujā mṛgāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva kīṭādyāḥ sthāvarāṇi ca
verses.translation: He shall perform the Japa after due meditation with mental purity, of the female friends of Siva along with the Saktis of Rudra, Pramatha and Bhuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the Japa after due meditation with mental purity, of the female friends of Siva along with the Saktis of Rudra, Pramatha and Bhuta.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नद्यस्समुद्रा गिरयः काननानि सरांसि च । वेदाः साङ्गाश्च शास्त्राणि मन्त्रस्तोममखादयः
verses.transliteration: nadyassamudrā girayaḥ kānanāni sarāṃsi ca | vedāḥ sāṅgāśca śāstrāṇi mantrastomamakhādayaḥ
verses.translation: The sun shall be worshipped in the eastern, Brahma in the southern, Rudra in the western and Vinu in the northern petal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun shall be worshipped in the eastern, Brahma in the southern, Rudra in the western and Vinu in the northern petal.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्न्यादिशिवान्तानि भुवनानि सहाधिपैः । ब्रह्माण्डान्यप्यसङ्ख्यानि तेषामावरणानि च
verses.transliteration: kālāgnyādiśivāntāni bhuvanāni sahādhipaiḥ | brahmāṇḍānyapyasaṅkhyāni teṣāmāvaraṇāni ca
verses.translation: There are separate Avaranas to all the four lords.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are separate Avaranas to all the four lords.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमानान्यतीतानि भविष्यन्त्यपि कृत्स्नशः । दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव कालभेदाः कलादयः
verses.transliteration: vartamānānyatītāni bhaviṣyantyapi kṛtsnaśaḥ | diśaśca vidiśaścaiva kālabhedāḥ kalādayaḥ
verses.translation: They are Diptu, Suksma, Bhadra,'Vibhuti,
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Diptu, Suksma, Bhadra,'Vibhuti,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यच्च किञ्चिज्जगत्यस्मिन् दृश्यते श्रूयतेऽपि वा । तत्सर्वं शङ्करस्याज्ञाबलेन समधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: yacca kiñcijjagatyasmin dṛśyate śrūyate'pi vā | tatsarvaṃ śaṅkarasyājñābalena samadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: The four shall be worshipped in the second Avarana in order from the east to the north and their Saktis afterwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four shall be worshipped in the second Avarana in order from the east to the north and their Saktis afterwards.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञाबलात्तस्य धरा स्थितेह धराधरा वारिधराः समुद्राः । ज्योतिर्गणाः शक्रमुखाश्च देवाः स्थिरं चिरं वा चिदचिद्यदस्ति
verses.transliteration: ājñābalāttasya dharā sthiteha dharādharā vāridharāḥ samudrāḥ | jyotirgaṇāḥ śakramukhāśca devāḥ sthiraṃ ciraṃ vā cidacidyadasti
verses.translation: Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu, Ravi, Arka, Brahma, Rudra and Visnu these are the extensions of Vivasvat in the cast and stationed more so in the south. Bodhini is in the west* and ApyayinI in the north.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu, Ravi, Arka, Brahma, Rudra and Visnu these are the extensions of Vivasvat in the cast and stationed more so in the south. Bodhini is in the west* and ApyayinI in the north.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । अत्याश्चर्यमिदं कृष्ण शम्भोरमितकर्मणः । आज्ञाकृतं शृणुष्वैतच्छ्रुतं श्रुतिमुखे मया
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | atyāścaryamidaṃ kṛṣṇa śambhoramitakarmaṇaḥ | ājñākṛtaṃ śṛṇuṣvaitacchrutaṃ śrutimukhe mayā
verses.translation: shall worship in the second Avarana, Usa,
verses.commentary: Sense: shall worship in the second Avarana, Usa,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा किल सुराः सेन्द्रा विवदन्तः परस्परम् । असुरान्समरे जित्वा जेताहमहमित्युत
verses.transliteration: purā kila surāḥ sendrā vivadantaḥ parasparam | asurānsamare jitvā jetāhamahamityuta
verses.translation: In the third Avarana he shall worship Soma (moon) Ahgaraka (Mars), Budha (Mercury) most excellent among the intelligent, Brhaspati (Jupiter ) of extensive in¬ tellect, Bhargava ( Venus), the storehouse of splendour, Sanaicara (Saturn), Rahu and Ketu the smoke-coloured and terrible.
verses.wordMeaning: In the third Avarana he shall worship Soma (moon) Ahgaraka (Mars), Budha (Mercury) most excellent among the intelligent, Brhaspati (Jupiter ) of extensive in¬ tellect, Bhargava ( Venus), the storehouse of splendour, Sanaicara (Saturn),…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the third Avarana he shall worship Soma (moon) Ahgaraka (Mars), Budha (Mercury) most excellent among the intelligent, Brhaspati (Jupiter ) of extensive in¬ tellect, Bhargava ( Venus), the storehouse of splendour, Sanaicara (Saturn),…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदा महेश्वरस्तेषां मध्यतो वरवेषधृक् । स्वलक्षणैर्विहीनाङ्गः स्वयं यक्ष इवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tadā maheśvarasteṣāṃ madhyato varaveṣadhṛk | svalakṣaṇairvihīnāṅgaḥ svayaṃ yakṣa ivābhavat
verses.translation: Or he shall worship the twelve Adityas in the second Avarana and the twelve Rasis (signs of Zodiac) in the third Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall worship the twelve Adityas in the second Avarana and the twelve Rasis (signs of Zodiac) in the third Avarana.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तानाह सुरानेकं तृणमादाय भूतले । य एतद्विकृतं कर्तुं क्षमते स तु दैत्यजित्
verses.transliteration: sa tānāha surānekaṃ tṛṇamādāya bhūtale | ya etadvikṛtaṃ kartuṃ kṣamate sa tu daityajit
verses.translation: After worshipping the sun in the third Avarana he shall worship Brahma along with the three Avaranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the sun in the third Avarana he shall worship Brahma along with the three Avaranas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा वज्रपाणिः शचीपतिः । किञ्चित् क्रुद्धो विहस्यैनं तृणमादातुमुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: yakṣasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vajrapāṇiḥ śacīpatiḥ | kiñcit kruddho vihasyainaṃ tṛṇamādātumudyataḥ
verses.translation: He shall worship Hiranyagarbha in the east, Virat in the south, Kala in the west and Purusa in the north.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship Hiranyagarbha in the east, Virat in the south, Kala in the west and Purusa in the north.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न तत्तृणमुपदातुं मनसापि च शक्यते । यथा तथापि तच्छेत्तुं वज्रं वज्रधरोऽसृजत्
verses.transliteration: na tattṛṇamupadātuṃ manasāpi ca śakyate | yathā tathāpi tacchettuṃ vajraṃ vajradharo'sṛjat
verses.translation: Sanat, Sanaka, Sananda and Sanatana shall be
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanat, Sanaka, Sananda and Sanatana shall be
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वज्रं निजवज्रेण संसृष्टमिव सर्वतः । तृणेनाभिहतं तेन तिर्यगग्रं पपात ह
verses.transliteration: tadvajraṃ nijavajreṇa saṃsṛṣṭamiva sarvataḥ | tṛṇenābhihataṃ tena tiryagagraṃ papāta ha
verses.translation: He shall then worship the Prajapatis in the third Avarana. The first eight shall be worshipped in the east and the remaining three in order from the cast onwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then worship the Prajapatis in the third Avarana. The first eight shall be worshipped in the east and the remaining three in order from the cast onwards.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चान्ये सुसंरब्धा लोकपाला महाबलाः । ससृजुस्तृणमुद्दिश्य स्वायुधानि सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tataścānye susaṃrabdhā lokapālā mahābalāḥ | sasṛjustṛṇamuddiśya svāyudhāni sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The following are the famous Prajapatis: Dak$a, Ruci, Bhrgu, Marici, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri, Kayapa ahd Vasi§tha. Their wives too shall be worshipped along with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the famous Prajapatis: Dak$a, Ruci, Bhrgu, Marici, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri, Kayapa ahd Vasi§tha. Their wives too shall be worshipped along with them.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजज्ज्वाल महावह्निः प्रचण्डः पवनो ववौ । प्रवृद्धोऽपाम्पतिर्यद्वत्प्रलये समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: prajajjvāla mahāvahniḥ pracaṇḍaḥ pavano vavau | pravṛddho'pāmpatiryadvatpralaye samupasthite
verses.translation: They arc Prasuti, Akuti, Khyati, Sambhuti, Dhrtij Smrti, Ksama, Sannati, Anasuya, Aditi and Arundhatl. These chaste ladies are ever engaged in the worship of Siva. Endowed with glory and prosperity they are very pleasing to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc Prasuti, Akuti, Khyati, Sambhuti, Dhrtij Smrti, Ksama, Sannati, Anasuya, Aditi and Arundhatl. These chaste ladies are ever engaged in the worship of Siva. Endowed with glory and prosperity they are very pleasing to look at.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं देवैः समारब्धं तृणमुद्दिश्य यत्नतः । व्यर्थमासीदहो कृष्ण यक्षस्यात्मबलेन वै
verses.transliteration: evaṃ devaiḥ samārabdhaṃ tṛṇamuddiśya yatnataḥ | vyarthamāsīdaho kṛṣṇa yakṣasyātmabalena vai
verses.translation: He shall worship the four Vedas in the first, the Ttihasas and Puranas in the second Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the four Vedas in the first, the Ttihasas and Puranas in the second Avarana.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदाह यक्षं देवेन्द्रः को भवानित्यमर्षितः । ततः स पश्यतामेव तेषामन्तरधादथ
verses.transliteration: tadāha yakṣaṃ devendraḥ ko bhavānityamarṣitaḥ | tataḥ sa paśyatāmeva teṣāmantaradhādatha
verses.translation: The entire Vedic lore beginning with law codes shall be worshipped in the third Avarana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire Vedic lore beginning with law codes shall be worshipped in the third Avarana.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे हैमवती देवी दिव्यविभूषणा । आविरासीन्नभोरङ्गे शोभमाना शुचिस्मिता
verses.transliteration: tadantare haimavatī devī divyavibhūṣaṇā | āvirāsīnnabhoraṅge śobhamānā śucismitā
verses.translation: The Vedas shall be worshipped beginning with the cast. The other texts shall also be worshipped just as one pleases. They are divided into four or eight and their wor¬ ship performed all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas shall be worshipped beginning with the cast. The other texts shall also be worshipped just as one pleases. They are divided into four or eight and their wor¬ ship performed all round.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः । प्रणम्य यक्षं पप्रच्छुः कोऽसौ यक्षो विलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ | praṇamya yakṣaṃ papracchuḥ ko'sau yakṣo vilakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping Brahma endowed with the three Avaranas, in this manner in the south, he shall worship Rudra in the west along with the Avaranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Brahma endowed with the three Avaranas, in this manner in the south, he shall worship Rudra in the west along with the Avaranas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साऽब्रवीत्सस्मितं देवी स युष्माकमगोचरः । तेनेदं भ्रम्यते चक्रं संसाराख्यं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: sā'bravītsasmitaṃ devī sa yuṣmākamagocaraḥ | tenedaṃ bhramyate cakraṃ saṃsārākhyaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: The five Brahmans and the six limbs are his first Avarana, The second Avarana consists of Vidyesvara. There is difference in regard to the third Avarana: His four forms shall be worshipped beginning with the east.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five Brahmans and the six limbs are his first Avarana, The second Avarana consists of Vidyesvara. There is difference in regard to the third Avarana: His four forms shall be worshipped beginning with the east.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनादौ क्रियते विश्वं तेन संह्रियते पुनः । न तन्नियन्ता कश्चित् स्यात्तेन सर्वं नियम्यते
verses.transliteration: tenādau kriyate viśvaṃ tena saṃhriyate punaḥ | na tanniyantā kaścit syāttena sarvaṃ niyamyate
verses.translation: The lord is possessed of three Gunas. As Siva he shall be worshipped in the east. The Rajasic creator Brahma shall be worshipped as Bhava in the south. The Tamasic Agni shall be worshipped as Hara in the west. The Sattvic bestower of happiness, Visnu shall be worshipped as Mra in the north.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord is possessed of three Gunas. As Siva he shall be worshipped in the east. The Rajasic creator Brahma shall be worshipped as Bhava in the south. The Tamasic Agni shall be worshipped as Hara in the west. The Sattvic bestower of happiness,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord is possessed of three Gunas. As Siva he shall be worshipped in the east. The Rajasic creator Brahma shall be worshipped as Bhava in the south. The Tamasic Agni shall be worshipped as Hara in the west. The Sattvic bestower of happiness,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सा महादेवी तत्रैवान्तरधत्त वै । देवाश्च विस्मिताः सर्वे तां प्रणम्य दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā sā mahādevī tatraivāntaradhatta vai | devāśca vismitāḥ sarve tāṃ praṇamya divaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: In the first Avarana he shall worship Vasudeva in the east, Aniruddha in the south, Pradyumna in the west,
verses.commentary: Sense: In the first Avarana he shall worship Vasudeva in the east, Aniruddha in the south, Pradyumna in the west,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping the fourth Avarana in accordance with the injunctions he shall worship the weapons ot Mahela externally.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the fourth Avarana in accordance with the injunctions he shall worship the weapons ot Mahela externally.
