verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping the fourth Avarana in accordance with the injunctions he shall worship the weapons ot Mahela externally.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the fourth Avarana in accordance with the injunctions he shall worship the weapons ot Mahela externally.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.३. तृतीयोऽध्यायः । ऋष्णायोपमन्योरुपदेशवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । शृणु कृष्ण महेशस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः । मूर्त्यात्मभिस्ततं कृत्स्नं जगदेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.2.3. tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | ṛṣṇāyopamanyorupadeśavarṇanam | upamanyuruvāca | śṛṇu kṛṣṇa maheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ | mūrtyātmabhistataṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagadetaccarācaram
verses.translation: He shall worship the glorious trident in the north-east, thunderbolt in the east, axe in the South-east and the arrow in the south, the sword in the south-west, the noose in the west, the goad in the north-west, the Pinaka in the north, the Ksetrapala in the west. After worshipping the fifth Avarana thus externally he shall worship the great bull in the east along with the mothers of the gods of the Avara¬ nas, either externally or in the fifth Avarana.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall worship the glorious trident in the north-east, thunderbolt in the east, axe in the South-east and the arrow in the south, the sword in the south-west, the noose in the west, the goad in the north-west, the Pinaka in the north, the Ksetrapala in the west.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall worship the glorious trident in the north-east, thunderbolt in the east, axe in the South-east and the arrow in the south, the sword in the south-west, the noose in the west, the goad in the north-west, the Pinaka in the north, the Ksetrapala in the west.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स शिवः सर्वमेवेदं स्वकीयाभिश्च मूर्तिभिः । अधितिष्ठत्यमेयात्मा ह्येतत्सर्वमनुस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sa śivaḥ sarvamevedaṃ svakīyābhiśca mūrtibhiḥ | adhitiṣṭhatyameyātmā hyetatsarvamanusmṛtam
verses.translation: After the eulogy he shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra not less than hundred and eight times. An eager devotee shall perform the Japa more than a thou¬ sand times.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the eulogy he shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra not less than hundred and eight times. An eager devotee shall perform the Japa more than a thou¬ sand times.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो महेशानः सदाशिवः । मूर्तयस्तस्य विज्ञेया याभिर्विश्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro maheśānaḥ sadāśivaḥ | mūrtayastasya vijñeyā yābhirviśvamidaṃ tatam
verses.translation: If any one thinks into the hymn, observes fast on the full moon and the new moon days and recites it on those days or on the eighth or fourteenth day, he.shall derive half the benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one thinks into the hymn, observes fast on the full moon and the new moon days and recites it on those days or on the eighth or fourteenth day, he.shall derive half the benefit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथान्याश्चापि तनवः पञ्च ब्रह्मसमाह्वयाः । तनूभिस्ताभिराव्याप्तमिह किञ्चिन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: athānyāścāpi tanavaḥ pañca brahmasamāhvayāḥ | tanūbhistābhirāvyāptamiha kiñcinna vidyate
verses.translation: O one endowed with infinite splendour, O one of incomparable physical body, the support, and of unarguable greatness, be victorious O one of undisturbed auspiciousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: O one endowed with infinite splendour, O one of incomparable physical body, the support, and of unarguable greatness, be victorious O one of undisturbed auspiciousness.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः पुरुषोऽघोरो वामः सद्यस्तथैव च । ब्रह्माण्येतानि देवस्य मूर्तयः पञ्च विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: īśānaḥ puruṣo'ghoro vāmaḥ sadyastathaiva ca | brahmāṇyetāni devasya mūrtayaḥ pañca viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: O Unsullied one, O one having no other support, O one rising up without cause and of incessantly great bliss, be victorious, O cause of extreme delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Unsullied one, O one having no other support, O one rising up without cause and of incessantly great bliss, be victorious, O cause of extreme delight.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाख्या तु या तस्य मूर्तिराद्या गरीयसी । भोक्तारं प्रकृतेः साक्षात् क्षेत्रज्ञमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: īśānākhyā tu yā tasya mūrtirādyā garīyasī | bhoktāraṃ prakṛteḥ sākṣāt kṣetrajñamadhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Be victorious, O one of excessively great prosperity. O receptacle of excessive mercy, O the sole possession of the free, O one of unequalled affluence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O one of excessively great prosperity. O receptacle of excessive mercy, O the sole possession of the free, O one of unequalled affluence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थाणोस्तत्पुरुषाख्या या मूर्तिर्मूर्तिमतः प्रभोः । गुणाश्रयात्मकं भोग्यमव्यक्तमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sthāṇostatpuruṣākhyā yā mūrtirmūrtimataḥ prabhoḥ | guṇāśrayātmakaṃ bhogyamavyaktamadhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: O lord who have enveloped the universe, O one not enveloped by any one, O one standing superior to all, O one to whom there is no one at all who is superior.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord who have enveloped the universe, O one not enveloped by any one, O one standing superior to all, O one to whom there is no one at all who is superior.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्माद्यष्टाङ्गसंयुक्तं बुद्धितत्त्वं पिनाकिनः । अधितिष्ठत्यघोराख्या मूर्तिरत्यन्तपूजिता
verses.transliteration: dharmādyaṣṭāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ buddhitattvaṃ pinākinaḥ | adhitiṣṭhatyaghorākhyā mūrtiratyantapūjitā
verses.translation: Be victorious, O wonderful one, who are by no means insignificant. O unwounded one: O unchanging one. O immeasurable one, O one uninfluenced by Maya, O one having no emotions, O one devoid of dirt, be victorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O wonderful one, who are by no means insignificant. O unwounded one: O unchanging one. O immeasurable one, O one uninfluenced by Maya, O one having no emotions, O one devoid of dirt, be victorious.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवाह्वयां मूर्तिं महादेवस्य वेधसः । अहङ्कृतेरधिष्ठात्रीमाहुरागमवेदिनः
verses.transliteration: vāmadevāhvayāṃ mūrtiṃ mahādevasya vedhasaḥ | ahaṅkṛteradhiṣṭhātrīmāhurāgamavedinaḥ
verses.translation: O one of great arms, O one of great essence, O one of great attributes, O one of great narratives, O one of great strength, O one of great Maya, O one of great taste, O one of great chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: O one of great arms, O one of great essence, O one of great attributes, O one of great narratives, O one of great strength, O one of great Maya, O one of great taste, O one of great chariot.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्यो जाताह्वयां मूर्तिं शम्भोरमितवर्चसः । मानसः समधिष्ठात्रीं मतिमन्तः प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: sadyo jātāhvayāṃ mūrtiṃ śambhoramitavarcasaḥ | mānasaḥ samadhiṣṭhātrīṃ matimantaḥ pracakṣate
verses.translation: Then the different types of gods shall be wor-
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the different types of gods shall be wor-
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रस्य वाचः शब्दस्य विभोर्व्योम्नस्तथैव च । ईश्वरीमीश्वरस्येमामीशाख्यां हि विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: śrotrasya vācaḥ śabdasya vibhorvyomnastathaiva ca | īśvarīmīśvarasyemāmīśākhyāṃ hi vidurbudhāḥ
verses.translation: The animals, birds, trees, worms and other in¬ significant creatures, men of different forms, deer of the insignificant types, the worlds within the universe, the crores of universes, the innumerable external seed-germs, their worlds, along with their rulers, Rudras stationed in the ten quarters supporting the universe, in fact everything fashioned out of the Gunas or Maya or originating from the 3akti shall be worshipped generally considering their presence on cither side of Siva and Siva. They shall be in the form of Cit and Acit whatever that can be expressed in words.
verses.wordMeaning: The animals, birds, trees, worms and other in¬ significant creatures, men of different forms, deer of the insignificant types, the worlds within the universe, the crores of universes, the innumerable external seed-germs, their worlds, along with their rulers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The animals, birds, trees, worms and other in¬ significant creatures, men of different forms, deer of the insignificant types, the worlds within the universe, the crores of universes, the innumerable external seed-germs, their worlds, along with their rulers,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वक्पाणिस्पर्शवायूनामीश्वरीं मूर्तिमैश्वरीम् । पुरुषाख्यं विदुः सर्वे पुराणार्थविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: tvakpāṇisparśavāyūnāmīśvarīṃ mūrtimaiśvarīm | puruṣākhyaṃ viduḥ sarve purāṇārthaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: They shall be thought of as having their palms joined in reverence, smiling in their faces and glancing devoutly at the lord and the goddess always.
verses.commentary: Sense: They shall be thought of as having their palms joined in reverence, smiling in their faces and glancing devoutly at the lord and the goddess always.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुषश्चरणस्यापि रूपस्याग्नेस्तथैव च । अघोराख्यामधिष्ठात्रीं मूर्तिमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: cakṣuṣaścaraṇasyāpi rūpasyāgnestathaiva ca | aghorākhyāmadhiṣṭhātrīṃ mūrtimāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: After performing the Avarana Puja thus, he shall worship the lord again for quietening distraction and per¬ plexity and utter the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Avarana Puja thus, he shall worship the lord again for quietening distraction and per¬ plexity and utter the five-syllabled mantra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रमनायाश्च पायोश्च रसस्यापां तथैव च । ईश्वरीं वामदेवाख्यां मूर्तिं तन्निरतां विदुः
verses.transliteration: ramanāyāśca pāyośca rasasyāpāṃ tathaiva ca | īśvarīṃ vāmadevākhyāṃ mūrtiṃ tanniratāṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: He shall then offer to Siva and Siva as Nai- vedya the sweet and charming Mahacaru, nectarlike and accompanied by side dishes and vegetables. The Naivedya prepared fjom thirtytwo A<haka measures of grains is com¬ mendable and that prepared with less than one Adhaka measure is the meanest one. After collecting and preparing the Naivedya to the extent of one's affluence he shall offer it with faith.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then offer to Siva and Siva as Nai- vedya the sweet and charming Mahacaru, nectarlike and accompanied by side dishes and vegetables.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then offer to Siva and Siva as Nai- vedya the sweet and charming Mahacaru, nectarlike and accompanied by side dishes and vegetables.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: घ्राणस्य चैवोपस्थस्य गन्धस्य च भुवस्तथा । सद्योज्ञाताह्वयां मूर्तिमीश्वरीं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: ghrāṇasya caivopasthasya gandhasya ca bhuvastathā | sadyojñātāhvayāṃ mūrtimīśvarīṃ sampracakṣate
verses.translation: After offering water for drinking, pickles, Tambula and performing the rite of Nirajana he shall conclude the remaining rites of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: After offering water for drinking, pickles, Tambula and performing the rite of Nirajana he shall conclude the remaining rites of worship.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तयः पञ्च देवस्य वन्दनीयाः प्रयत्नतः । श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैर्नित्यं श्रेयसामेकहेतवः
verses.transliteration: mūrtayaḥ pañca devasya vandanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | śreyo'rthibhirnarairnityaṃ śreyasāmekahetavaḥ
verses.translation: Articles intended for the enjoyment of pleasures shall be excellent ones. The devotee shall not be stingy in spending money for this if he is fairly well to do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Articles intended for the enjoyment of pleasures shall be excellent ones. The devotee shall not be stingy in spending money for this if he is fairly well to do.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवादिदेवस्य मूर्त्यष्टकमयं जगत् । तस्मिन् व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.transliteration: tasya devādidevasya mūrtyaṣṭakamayaṃ jagat | tasmin vyāpya sthitaṃ viśvaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
verses.translation: Good men say that the Kamya rites of the stingy and the stubborn, the indifferent and the defaulter in some items do not yield the benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Good men say that the Kamya rites of the stingy and the stubborn, the indifferent and the defaulter in some items do not yield the benefits.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो भवस्तथा रुद्र उग्रो भीमः पशोः पतिः । ईशानश्च महादेवो मूर्तयश्चाष्ट विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: śarvo bhavastathā rudra ugro bhīmaḥ paśoḥ patiḥ | īśānaśca mahādevo mūrtayaścāṣṭa viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: Hence if he wishes for the achievement of proper benefits he shall perform the Kamya rites attending to all the items scrupulously and avoiding indifference.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence if he wishes for the achievement of proper benefits he shall perform the Kamya rites attending to all the items scrupulously and avoiding indifference.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यम्भोऽग्निमरुद्व्योमक्षेत्रज्ञार्कनिशाकराः । अधिष्ठिता महेशस्य शर्वाद्यैरष्टमूर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: bhūmyambho'gnimarudvyomakṣetrajñārkaniśākarāḥ | adhiṣṭhitā maheśasya śarvādyairaṣṭamūrtibhiḥ
verses.translation: After concluding worship thus and bowing to the lord and the goddess he shall concentrate his mind with devo¬ tion and repeat eulogical hymns.
verses.commentary: Sense: After concluding worship thus and bowing to the lord and the goddess he shall concentrate his mind with devo¬ tion and repeat eulogical hymns.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चराचरात्मकं विश्वं धत्ते विश्वम्भरात्मिका । शार्वी र्शिवाह्वया मूर्तिरिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: carācarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ dhatte viśvambharātmikā | śārvī rśivāhvayā mūrtiriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ
verses.translation: After performing the worship of Vidya and of the preceptor he shall perform the members assembled in the proper order in accordance with prosperity and purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the worship of Vidya and of the preceptor he shall perform the members assembled in the proper order in accordance with prosperity and purity.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जीवनं समस्तस्य जगतः सलिलात्मिकाज् । भावीति गीयते मूर्तिभवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sañjīvanaṃ samastasya jagataḥ salilātmikāj | bhāvīti gīyate mūrtibhavasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Then he shall perform the rite of ritualistic bid¬ ding of farewell to the lord along with Avaranas. He shall give the Man(ala to the preceptor along with the articles used in the rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he shall perform the rite of ritualistic bid¬ ding of farewell to the lord along with Avaranas. He shall give the Man(ala to the preceptor along with the articles used in the rite.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तर्गता विश्वं व्याप्य तेजोमयी शुभा । रौद्री रुद्राव्यया मूर्तिरास्थिता घोररूपिणी
verses.transliteration: bahirantargatā viśvaṃ vyāpya tejomayī śubhā | raudrī rudrāvyayā mūrtirāsthitā ghorarūpiṇī
verses.translation: He can give them to the devotees of Siva or hand them over to the temple,;&vl.
verses.commentary: Sense: He can give them to the devotees of Siva or hand them over to the temple,;&vl.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्पन्दयत्यनिलात्मेदं बिभर्ति स्पन्दते स्वयम् । औग्रीति कथ्यते सद्भिर्मूर्तिरुग्रस्य वेधसः
verses.transliteration: spandayatyanilātmedaṃ bibharti spandate svayam | augrīti kathyate sadbhirmūrtirugrasya vedhasaḥ
verses.translation: Or he shall worship the lord in the Siva-fire with the seven articles of sacrifice after duly worshipping the Avarana deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall worship the lord in the Siva-fire with the seven articles of sacrifice after duly worshipping the Avarana deities.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावकाशदा सर्वव्यापिका गगनात्मिका । मूर्तिर्भीमस्य भीमाख्या भूतवृन्दस्य भेदिका
verses.transliteration: sarvāvakāśadā sarvavyāpikā gaganātmikā | mūrtirbhīmasya bhīmākhyā bhūtavṛndasya bhedikā
verses.translation: A benefit of this world or the nc.xt unattainable through this does not exist anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: A benefit of this world or the nc.xt unattainable through this does not exist anywhere.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मनामधिष्ठात्री सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासिनी । मूर्तिः पशुपतेर्ज्ञेया पशुपाशनिकृन्तनी
verses.transliteration: sarvātmanāmadhiṣṭhātrī sarvakṣetranivāsinī | mūrtiḥ paśupaterjñeyā paśupāśanikṛntanī
verses.translation: Still none shall perform this rite for trivial benefits. A man praying for a small help from a great man demeans himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still none shall perform this rite for trivial benefits. A man praying for a small help from a great man demeans himself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दीपयन्ती जगत्सर्वं दिवाकरसमाह्वया । ईशानाख्या महेशस्य मूर्तिर्दिवि विसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dīpayantī jagatsarvaṃ divākarasamāhvayā | īśānākhyā maheśasya mūrtirdivi visarpati
verses.translation: Hence, an expert man shall perform this rite for the conquests of his enemy or death even if those fruits are not to be secured from any one else whether those fruits are seen or unseen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, an expert man shall perform this rite for the conquests of his enemy or death even if those fruits are not to be secured from any one else whether those fruits are seen or unseen.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आप्याययति यो विश्वममृतांशुर्निशाकरः । महादेवस्य सा मूर्तिर्महादेवसमाह्वया
verses.transliteration: āpyāyayati yo viśvamamṛtāṃśurniśākaraḥ | mahādevasya sā mūrtirmahādevasamāhvayā
verses.translation: When great sins are committed, when there is a terror of great epidemics, famine or any other calamity, this rite shall be performed for the pacification of the evil.
verses.commentary: Sense: When great sins are committed, when there is a terror of great epidemics, famine or any other calamity, this rite shall be performed for the pacification of the evil.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा तस्याष्टमी मूर्तिः शिवस्य परमात्मनः । व्यापिकेतरमूर्तीनां विश्वं तस्मात् शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: ātmā tasyāṣṭamī mūrtiḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ | vyāpiketaramūrtīnāṃ viśvaṃ tasmāt śivātmakam
verses.translation: Hence, a person performing this rite with the conviction that there is no greater protection for the Atman enjoys the benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, a person performing this rite with the conviction that there is no greater protection for the Atman enjoys the benefit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षस्य मूलसेकेन शाखाः पुष्यन्ति वै यथा । शिवस्य पूजया तद्वत्पुष्यत्यस्य वपुर्जगत्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣasya mūlasekena śākhāḥ puṣyanti vai yathā | śivasya pūjayā tadvatpuṣyatyasya vapurjagat
verses.translation: He who reads the hymn with purity of body and mind attains an eighth of the benefit desired.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads the hymn with purity of body and mind attains an eighth of the benefit desired.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभयप्रदानं च सर्वानुग्रहणं तथा । सर्वोपकारकरणं शिवस्याराधनं विदुः
verses.transliteration: sarvābhayapradānaṃ ca sarvānugrahaṇaṃ tathā | sarvopakārakaraṇaṃ śivasyārādhanaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: He who thinks over the meaning, observes rites on Parvan and other days and performs the Japa of this stotra for a month derives full benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who thinks over the meaning, observes rites on Parvan and other days and performs the Japa of this stotra for a month derives full benefit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथेह पुत्रपौत्रादेः प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवेत्पिता । तथा सर्वस्य सम्प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yatheha putrapautrādeḥ prītyā prīto bhavetpitā | tathā sarvasya samprītyā prīto bhavati śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: O Kr?na, I shall tell you the hymn whereby this holy fite of Yogesvara is concluded along the pa h of five Avaranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kr?na, I shall tell you the hymn whereby this holy fite of Yogesvara is concluded along the pa h of five Avaranas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देहिनो यस्य कस्यापि क्रियते यदि निग्रहः । अनिष्टमष्टमूर्तेस्तत्कृतमेव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dehino yasya kasyāpi kriyate yadi nigrahaḥ | aniṣṭamaṣṭamūrtestatkṛtameva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Be victorious, O Siva, the sole lord of the universe, naturally charming one, of the nature of eternal knowledge. You are the principle beyond the region of words and minds O lord, who have transcended the confused universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O Siva, the sole lord of the universe, naturally charming one, of the nature of eternal knowledge. You are the principle beyond the region of words and minds O lord, who have transcended the confused universe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमूर्त्यात्मना विश्वमधिष्ठाय स्थितं शिवम् । भजस्व सर्वभावेन रुद्रं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamūrtyātmanā viśvamadhiṣṭhāya sthitaṃ śivam | bhajasva sarvabhāvena rudraṃ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: O lord, of a naturally pure physical body, O lord of charming activities. O lord, having a great l3akti on a par with yourself, O ocean of pure attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, of a naturally pure physical body, O lord of charming activities. O lord, having a great l3akti on a par with yourself, O ocean of pure attributes.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the great lord, the great cause, the quiescent one, more auspicious than any one else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the great lord, the great cause, the quiescent one, more auspicious than any one else.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥ ७.२.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । गौरीशङ्करविभूतियोगः । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् परमेशस्य शर्वस्यामिततेजसः । मूर्तिभिर्विश्वमेवेदं यथा व्याप्तं तथा श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || 7.2.4. caturtho'dhyāyaḥ | gaurīśaṅkaravibhūtiyogaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | bhagavan parameśasya śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ | mūrtibhirviśvamevedaṃ yathā vyāptaṃ tathā śrutam
verses.translation: The entire universe including the gods and Asuras is subservient into you. Hence who is competent to transgress the behest ordained by you? This devotee is solely dependent on you. Hence, O sir, bless me and bestow on me what I have prayed for.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe including the gods and Asuras is subservient into you. Hence who is competent to transgress the behest ordained by you? This devotee is solely dependent on you. Hence, O sir, bless me and bestow on me what I have prayed for.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथैतत् ज्ञातुमिच्छामि याथात्म्यं परमेशयोः । स्त्रीपुम्भावात्मकं चेदं ताभ्यां कथमधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: athaitat jñātumicchāmi yāthātmyaṃ parameśayoḥ | strīpumbhāvātmakaṃ cedaṃ tābhyāṃ kathamadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: May the holy middle Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is named Aghora resembling colly- rium, who has a terrible physical body, who is identified with the southern face of the lord, who is engaged in the worship of Siva's feet, who abides in the Vidya region and is stationed in the middle of fire, who is the second among Siva's Bijas, who has eight Kalas and has been worshipped along with Sakti to the south of Siva.
verses.wordMeaning: May the holy middle Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is named Aghora resembling colly- rium, who has a terrible physical body, who is identified with the southern face of the lord, who is engaged in the worship of Siva's feet,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the holy middle Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is named Aghora resembling colly- rium, who has a terrible physical body, who is identified with the southern face of the lord, who is engaged in the worship of Siva's feet,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । श्रीमद्विभूतिं शिवयोर्याथात्म्यं च समासतः । वक्ष्ये तद्विस्तराद्वक्तुं भवेनापि न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | śrīmadvibhūtiṃ śivayoryāthātmyaṃ ca samāsataḥ | vakṣye tadvistarādvaktuṃ bhavenāpi na śakyate
verses.translation: Nandi4vara of great splendour, the son ofParvatl is worshipped and revered every day by the gods including
verses.commentary: Sense: Nandi4vara of great splendour, the son ofParvatl is worshipped and revered every day by the gods including
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्ति साक्षान्महादेवी महादेवश्च शक्तिमान् । तयोर्विभूतिलेशो वै सर्वमेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: śakti sākṣānmahādevī mahādevaśca śaktimān | tayorvibhūtileśo vai sarvametaccarācaram
verses.translation: The group of the friends of the goddess has all the characteristics of the goddess. They are accompanied by the daughters of Rudras and Saktis many in number. They have been worshipped in the third Avarana of Siva with great devotion. Let them grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.wordMeaning: The group of the friends of the goddess has all the characteristics of the goddess. They are accompanied by the daughters of Rudras and Saktis many in number. They have been worshipped in the third Avarana of Siva with great devotion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The group of the friends of the goddess has all the characteristics of the goddess. They are accompanied by the daughters of Rudras and Saktis many in number. They have been worshipped in the third Avarana of Siva with great devotion.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वस्तु किञ्चिदचिद्रूपं किञ्चिद्वस्तु चिदात्मकम् । द्वयं शुद्धमशुद्धं च परं चापरमेव च
verses.transliteration: vastu kiñcidacidrūpaṃ kiñcidvastu cidātmakam | dvayaṃ śuddhamaśuddhaṃ ca paraṃ cāparameva ca
verses.translation: May the divine weapons of the lord and the goddess — viz — the trident, thunderbolt, axe, arrow, sword, noose, goad and the excellent weapon Pin aka protect me always at behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the divine weapons of the lord and the goddess — viz — the trident, thunderbolt, axe, arrow, sword, noose, goad and the excellent weapon Pin aka protect me always at behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्संसरति चिच्चक्रमचिच्चक्रसमन्वितम् । तदेवाशुद्धमपरमितरं तु परं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: yatsaṃsarati ciccakramaciccakrasamanvitam | tadevāśuddhamaparamitaraṃ tu paraṃ śubham
verses.translation: The followers of Siva who adhere to the philosophical path, those who perform the Pasupata rites those who observe the holy rites and the Saivite holy men such as Kapalikas — all these are adherents and executors of iSiva's behests. I'hey shall be worshipped by me at the behest of Siva. May these bless me. Let them praise the successful holy rite.
verses.wordMeaning: The followers of Siva who adhere to the philosophical path, those who perform the Pasupata rites those who observe the holy rites and the Saivite holy men such as Kapalikas — all these are adherents and executors of iSiva's behests.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The followers of Siva who adhere to the philosophical path, those who perform the Pasupata rites those who observe the holy rites and the Saivite holy men such as Kapalikas — all these are adherents and executors of iSiva's behests.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपरं च परं चैव द्वयं चिदचिदात्मकम् । शिवस्य च शिवायाश्च स्वाम्यं चैतत्स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: aparaṃ ca paraṃ caiva dvayaṃ cidacidātmakam | śivasya ca śivāyāśca svāmyaṃ caitatsvabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: O Kr§na, what has been mentioned to you is the site which yields benefit here and hereafter. It is a great synthesis of physical rites, penance, Japas and meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kr§na, what has been mentioned to you is the site which yields benefit here and hereafter. It is a great synthesis of physical rites, penance, Japas and meditation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोर्वै वशे विश्वं न विश्वस्य वशे शिवौ । ईशितव्यमिदं यस्मात्तस्माद्विश्वेश्वरौ शिवौ
verses.transliteration: śivayorvai vaśe viśvaṃ na viśvasya vaśe śivau | īśitavyamidaṃ yasmāttasmādviśveśvarau śivau
verses.translation: Then the right hand holds the trident, axe, sword and the thunderbolt. The left hands hold the noose, goad, iron club and the serpent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the right hand holds the trident, axe, sword and the thunderbolt. The left hands hold the noose, goad, iron club and the serpent.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा शिवस्तथा देवी यथा देवी तथा शिवः । नानयोरन्तरं विद्याच्चन्द्रचन्द्रिकयोरिव
verses.transliteration: yathā śivastathā devī yathā devī tathā śivaḥ | nānayorantaraṃ vidyāccandracandrikayoriva
verses.translation: The maximum number of times for Japa is hun¬ dred thousand. According to the benefit desired the number of worship varies from one to three.
verses.commentary: Sense: The maximum number of times for Japa is hun¬ dred thousand. According to the benefit desired the number of worship varies from one to three.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रो न खलु भात्येष यथा चन्द्रिकया विना । न भाति विद्यमानोऽपि तथा शक्त्या विना शिवः
verses.transliteration: candro na khalu bhātyeṣa yathā candrikayā vinā | na bhāti vidyamāno'pi tathā śaktyā vinā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess, the mother of the universe identical with the universe, and of unlimited prosperity. Be victorious, O goddess of incomparable beautiful person.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O goddess, the mother of the universe identical with the universe, and of unlimited prosperity. Be victorious, O goddess of incomparable beautiful person.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रभया हि विना यद्वद्भानुरेष न विद्यते । प्रभा च भानुना तेन सुतरां तदुपाश्रया
verses.transliteration: prabhayā hi vinā yadvadbhānureṣa na vidyate | prabhā ca bhānunā tena sutarāṃ tadupāśrayā
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess transcending speech and mind annihilating the darkness of ignorance, devoid of birth and old age, O one superior to that which is superior to Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O goddess transcending speech and mind annihilating the darkness of ignorance, devoid of birth and old age, O one superior to that which is superior to Kala.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं परस्परापेक्षा शक्तिशक्तिमतोः स्थिता । न शिवेन विना शक्तिर्न शक्त्या च विना शिवः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ parasparāpekṣā śaktiśaktimatoḥ sthitā | na śivena vinā śaktirna śaktyā ca vinā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess stationed in many riles,
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O goddess stationed in many riles,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्तौ यया शिवो नित्यं भक्तौ मुक्तौ च देहिनाम् । आद्या सैका परा शक्तिश्चिन्मयी शिवसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: śaktau yayā śivo nityaṃ bhaktau muktau ca dehinām | ādyā saikā parā śaktiścinmayī śivasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess endowed with divine and auspicious body of auspicious light, O one of auspicious conduct. Be victorious, O goddess, bestowing auspiciousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O goddess endowed with divine and auspicious body of auspicious light, O one of auspicious conduct. Be victorious, O goddess, bestowing auspiciousness.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुरखिलेशस्य तैस्तैरनुगुणैर्गुणैः । समानधर्मिणीमेव शिवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yāmāhurakhileśasya taistairanuguṇairguṇaiḥ | samānadharmiṇīmeva śivasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the goddess possessed of great and auspicious attributes. The universe born from you merges into you alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the goddess possessed of great and auspicious attributes. The universe born from you merges into you alone.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सैका परा च चिद्रूपा शक्तिः प्रसवधर्मिणी । विभज्य बहुधा विश्वं विदधाति शिवेच्छया
verses.transliteration: saikā parā ca cidrūpā śaktiḥ prasavadharmiṇī | vibhajya bahudhā viśvaṃ vidadhāti śivecchayā
verses.translation: Without you even the lord is not competent to bestow the benefats. O goddess of the gods, ever since birth this person has sought refuge in you. Hence, please fulfil the desire of this devotee of yours. Sadasiva, of five faces, ten arms, resembling the pure crystal, having the physical body constituted by the letters, the five Brahmans and the Kalis, the lord who is both Sakala and Niskala, who is endowed with devotion to Siva and who is beyond the Santi Kali, has been worshipped by me with devotion. May he bestow on me what is prayed for by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Without you even the lord is not competent to bestow the benefats. O goddess of the gods, ever since birth this person has sought refuge in you. Hence, please fulfil the desire of this devotee of yours. Sadasiva, of five faces, ten arms, resembling the pure crystal,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Without you even the lord is not competent to bestow the benefats. O goddess of the gods, ever since birth this person has sought refuge in you. Hence, please fulfil the desire of this devotee of yours. Sadasiva, of five faces, ten arms, resembling the pure crystal,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा मूलप्रकृतिर्माया त्रिगुणा च त्रिधा स्मृता । शिवया च विपर्यस्तं यया ततमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sā mūlaprakṛtirmāyā triguṇā ca tridhā smṛtā | śivayā ca viparyastaṃ yayā tatamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: May the Iccha lakti named Sivi seated on the lap of Sadasiva, the mother of all the worlds, grant me what I desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the Iccha lakti named Sivi seated on the lap of Sadasiva, the mother of all the worlds, grant me what I desire.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एकधा च द्विधा चैव तथा शतसहस्रधा । शक्तयः खलु भिद्यन्ते बहुधा व्यवहारतः
verses.transliteration: ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā | śaktayaḥ khalu bhidyante bahudhā vyavahārataḥ
verses.translation: Lords Heramba and Sanmukha arc the beloved sons of Siva and Siva. Their accomplishments are auspicious. They are omniscient. They imbibe the nectar of knowledge. Being content they are mutually aftectionate. They are perpetually honoured by Siva and Siva. They are always respected and revered by Brahma and other gods. They are always ready to protect the worlds. Out of their will they take incarnations with their many different parts. They have been always worshipped thus by me on either side of Siva and Siva. May they grant me what I have prayed for with due deference for their behest.
verses.wordMeaning: Lords Heramba and Sanmukha arc the beloved sons of Siva and Siva. Their accomplishments are auspicious. They are omniscient. They imbibe the nectar of knowledge. Being content they are mutually aftectionate. They are perpetually honoured by Siva and Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lords Heramba and Sanmukha arc the beloved sons of Siva and Siva. Their accomplishments are auspicious. They are omniscient. They imbibe the nectar of knowledge. Being content they are mutually aftectionate. They are perpetually honoured by Siva and Siva.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवेच्छया पराशक्तिः शिवतत्त्वैकतां गता । ततः परिस्फुरत्यादौ सर्गे तैलं तिलादिव
verses.transliteration: śivecchayā parāśaktiḥ śivatattvaikatāṃ gatā | tataḥ parisphuratyādau sarge tailaṃ tilādiva
verses.translation: May the lord grant me what I have prayed for — the lord who resembles the pure crystal, who is called Isana, Sada'iva, the great Atman, who is quiescent, who occupies the firmament transcending the Santikala, who is the final Bija of the five-syllabled mantra equipped with five Kalas
verses.wordMeaning: May the lord grant me what I have prayed for — the lord who resembles the pure crystal, who is called Isana, Sada'iva, the great Atman, who is quiescent, who occupies the firmament transcending the Santikala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the lord grant me what I have prayed for — the lord who resembles the pure crystal, who is called Isana, Sada'iva, the great Atman, who is quiescent, who occupies the firmament transcending the Santikala,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रियाख्यया शक्त्या शक्तौ शक्तिमदुत्थया । तस्यां विक्षोभ्यमाणायामादौ नादः समुद्बभौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kriyākhyayā śaktyā śaktau śaktimadutthayā | tasyāṃ vikṣobhyamāṇāyāmādau nādaḥ samudbabhau
verses.translation: May the lord grant me whai I have prayed for — the lord who is ancient, who is named Purusa, who resembles the rising sun, who is identified with the eastern face of fiva Farame§thin, who is in the form of Santi stationed in the wind, who is engaged in worshipping the feet of Siva, who is the first among Siva-Bijas, who has four Kalas and who has been worshipped by me with devo¬ tion in the east along with Sakti.
verses.wordMeaning: May the lord grant me whai I have prayed for — the lord who is ancient, who is named Purusa, who resembles the rising sun, who is identified with the eastern face of fiva Farame§thin, who is in the form of Santi stationed in the wind,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the lord grant me whai I have prayed for — the lord who is ancient, who is named Purusa, who resembles the rising sun, who is identified with the eastern face of fiva Farame§thin, who is in the form of Santi stationed in the wind,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नादाद्विनिःसृतो बिन्दुर्बिन्दोदेवः सदाशिवः । तस्मान् महेश्वरो जातः शुद्धविद्या महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: nādādviniḥsṛto bindurbindodevaḥ sadāśivaḥ | tasmān maheśvaro jātaḥ śuddhavidyā maheśvarāt
verses.translation: May the holy Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is Varna, who has an excellent dress resem¬ bling saffron powder, who is identified with the northern face of Siva and who is well established in Pratitha, who is stationed in the middle of the zone of water. He is engaged in worshipping the lord. He is the fourth one among Siva- Bijas. He has thirteen Kalas. He has been worshipped along with Sakti to the north of the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: May the holy Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is Varna, who has an excellent dress resem¬ bling saffron powder, who is identified with the northern face of Siva and who is well established in Pratitha, who is stationed in the middle of the zone of water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the holy Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is Varna, who has an excellent dress resem¬ bling saffron powder, who is identified with the northern face of Siva and who is well established in Pratitha, who is stationed in the middle of the zone of water.…

verses.sanskrit: सा वाचामीश्वरी शक्तिर्वागीशाख्या हि शूलिनः । या सा वर्णस्वरूपेण मातृकेऽपि विजृम्भते
verses.transliteration: sā vācāmīśvarī śaktirvāgīśākhyā hi śūlinaḥ | yā sā varṇasvarūpeṇa mātṛke'pi vijṛmbhate
verses.translation: May the great Brahman grant me what I have prayed for— he who is named Sadya having gentle character¬ istics, who is as white as the conch, Kunda flower and the full moon. He is the western face of Siva that is engaged in worshipping Siva's feet, who is established in the Nivrtti region and is stationed in the earth, who is the third one among Siva-Bijas and is endowed with eight Kalas, and who has been worshipped along with* Sakti to the west of the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: May the great Brahman grant me what I have prayed for— he who is named Sadya having gentle character¬ istics, who is as white as the conch, Kunda flower and the full moon. He is the western face of Siva that is engaged in worshipping Siva's feet,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the great Brahman grant me what I have prayed for— he who is named Sadya having gentle character¬ istics, who is as white as the conch, Kunda flower and the full moon. He is the western face of Siva that is engaged in worshipping Siva's feet,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथानन्तसमावेशान्माया कालमवासृजत् । नियतिं च कलां विद्यां कलातो रागपूरुषौ
verses.transliteration: athānantasamāveśānmāyā kālamavāsṛjat | niyatiṃ ca kalāṃ vidyāṃ kalāto rāgapūruṣau
verses.translation: May the two heart-forms of Siva and Siva purified by Siva grant my desire at the behest of the two — Siva and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the two heart-forms of Siva and Siva purified by Siva grant my desire at the behest of the two — Siva and Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मायातः पुनरेवाभूदव्यक्तं त्रिगुणात्मकम् । त्रिगुणाच्च ततोऽव्यक्ताद्विभक्ताः स्युस्त्रयो गुणाः
verses.transliteration: māyātaḥ punarevābhūdavyaktaṃ triguṇātmakam | triguṇācca tato'vyaktādvibhaktāḥ syustrayo guṇāḥ
verses.translation: May the two tuft-forms of Siva and Siva, depend* ing on Siva, grant my desire after honouring the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the two tuft-forms of Siva and Siva, depend* ing on Siva, grant my desire after honouring the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत् । गुणेभ्यः क्षोभ्यमाणेभ्यो गुणेशाख्यास्त्रिमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat | guṇebhyaḥ kṣobhyamāṇebhyo guṇeśākhyāstrimūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: May the two coats of mail of Siva and Siva
verses.commentary: Sense: May the two coats of mail of Siva and Siva
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अभवन् महदादीनि तत्त्वानि च यथाक्रमम् । तेभ्यः स्युरण्डपिण्डानि त्वसङ्ख्यानि शिवाज्ञया । अधिष्ठितान्यनन्ताद्यैर्विद्येशैश्चक्रवर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: abhavan mahadādīni tattvāni ca yathākramam | tebhyaḥ syuraṇḍapiṇḍāni tvasaṅkhyāni śivājñayā | adhiṣṭhitānyanantādyairvidyeśaiścakravartibhiḥ
verses.translation: May the two eye-forms of Siva and Siva depen¬
verses.commentary: Sense: May the two eye-forms of Siva and Siva depen¬
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शरीरान्तरभेदेन शक्तेर्भेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः । नानारूपास्तु विज्ञेयाः स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: śarīrāntarabhedena śakterbhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | nānārūpāstu vijñeyāḥ sthūlasūkṣmavibhedataḥ
verses.translation: May the missile forms of Siva and Siva always
verses.commentary: Sense: May the missile forms of Siva and Siva always
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्य रौद्री सा शक्तिर्विष्णौर्वै वैष्णवी मता । ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्ता चेन्द्रस्यैन्द्रीति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: rudrasya raudrī sā śaktirviṣṇaurvai vaiṣṇavī matā | brahmāṇī brahmaṇaḥ proktā cendrasyaindrīti kathyate
verses.translation: Let these deities Varna, Jyestha, Rudra, Kala, Vikarana, Balavikarana, Balapramathana and Sarvabhutada- mana grant me what I desire, at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let these deities Varna, Jyestha, Rudra, Kala, Vikarana, Balavikarana, Balapramathana and Sarvabhutada- mana grant me what I desire, at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन यद्विश्वमिति कीर्तितम् । शक्यात्मनैव तद्व्याप्तं यथा देहेऽन्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena yadviśvamiti kīrtitam | śakyātmanaiva tadvyāptaṃ yathā dehe'ntarātmanā
verses.translation: May the eight deities Ananta, Suksma, Siva, Ekanetra, Ekarudra, Trimuiti, Srikantha and Sikhandaka and their Saktis, worshipped in the second Avarana grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the eight deities Ananta, Suksma, Siva, Ekanetra, Ekarudra, Trimuiti, Srikantha and Sikhandaka and their Saktis, worshipped in the second Avarana grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छक्तिमयं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । कला या परमा शक्तिः कथिता परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmācchaktimayaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | kalā yā paramā śaktiḥ kathitā paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: May the e'ght Murtis Bhava and others and their Saktis as well as the eleven Murtis Mahadeva and others accompanied by their Saktis, all stationed in the third Avarana confer the desired benefit after honouring the behest of Siva and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the e'ght Murtis Bhava and others and their Saktis as well as the eleven Murtis Mahadeva and others accompanied by their Saktis, all stationed in the third Avarana confer the desired benefit after honouring the behest of Siva and Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमेषा परा शक्तिरीश्वरेच्छानुयायिनी । स्थिरं चरं च यद्विश्वं सृजतीति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: evameṣā parā śaktirīśvarecchānuyāyinī | sthiraṃ caraṃ ca yadviśvaṃ sṛjatīti viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: May the seven mothers — Brahmani, Mahesi, Kaumari, Vainavi, Varahi, Mahendri and Camuna of fierce valour, mothers of all the worlds, grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the seven mothers — Brahmani, Mahesi, Kaumari, Vainavi, Varahi, Mahendri and Camuna of fierce valour, mothers of all the worlds, grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानक्रिया चिकीर्षाभिस्तिसृभिः स्वात्मशक्तिभिः । शक्तिमानीश्वरः शश्वत् विश्वं व्याप्याधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: jñānakriyā cikīrṣābhistisṛbhiḥ svātmaśaktibhiḥ | śaktimānīśvaraḥ śaśvat viśvaṃ vyāpyādhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: He has the face of the elephant in rut. He is the son of Gahga, Uma and Siva. The firmament is his body; the quarters his arms; the moon, the sun and the fire his eyes. He is worshipped by the elephants of the quarters, Airavata and others. The ichor of Saivite knowledge comes out of him. He wards the obstacles of gods. He causes obstacles to the Asuras and others. He is sanctified by Siva. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.wordMeaning: He has the face of the elephant in rut. He is the son of Gahga, Uma and Siva. The firmament is his body; the quarters his arms; the moon, the sun and the fire his eyes. He is worshipped by the elephants of the quarters, Airavata and others.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He has the face of the elephant in rut. He is the son of Gahga, Uma and Siva. The firmament is his body; the quarters his arms; the moon, the sun and the fire his eyes. He is worshipped by the elephants of the quarters, Airavata and others.…

verses.sanskrit: इदमित्थमिदं नेत्थं भवेदित्येवमात्मिका । इच्छाशक्तिर्महेशस्य नित्या कार्यनियामिका
verses.transliteration: idamitthamidaṃ netthaṃ bhavedityevamātmikā | icchāśaktirmaheśasya nityā kāryaniyāmikā
verses.translation: $anmukha is bom of Siva. He holds Sakti and thunderbolt. He is the son of fire. He is also the son of Ganga, Ganamba and Kfttikas. Hd is surrounded by Viakha, Sakha and Naigameya. He is the conqueror of Indra and the demon Taraka. He is the Generalissimo of Indra's armies. He pierced the important mountains Meru and others with his splendour. He resembles molten gold. He has eyes resembling petals of lotuses. He is Kumara and the model for all tender beings. He is the favourite of Siva and

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानशक्तिस्तु तत्कार्यं करणं कारणं तथा । प्रयोजनं च तत्त्वेन बुद्धिरूपाध्यवस्यति
verses.transliteration: jñānaśaktistu tatkāryaṃ karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā | prayojanaṃ ca tattvena buddhirūpādhyavasyati
verses.translation: Jyestha, the excellent deity granting boons, is always engaged in worshipping them. May she grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jyestha, the excellent deity granting boons, is always engaged in worshipping them. May she grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथेप्सितं क्रियाशक्तिर्यथाध्यवसितं जगत् । कल्पयत्यखिलं कार्यं क्षणात्सङ्कल्परूपिणी
verses.transliteration: yathepsitaṃ kriyāśaktiryathādhyavasitaṃ jagat | kalpayatyakhilaṃ kāryaṃ kṣaṇātsaṅkalparūpiṇī
verses.translation: The goddess is saluted by the three worlds in the form of Ulka (meteor, comet ). She is requested by Brahma to multiply the creation th*'ough Siva. She came out from the middle of the eyebrows of Siva who divided herself into DaksayanI, Satl, Mena, Haimavati, Uma. she is the mother of Kauiki, Bhadrakali, Aparna and Patala. She is Rudrani the beloved of Rudra. She is always engaged in worshipping Siva. May she grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: यथाशक्ति त्रयोत्थानं शक्तिप्रसवधर्मिणी । शक्त्या परमया नुन्ना प्रसूते सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yathāśakti trayotthānaṃ śaktiprasavadharmiṇī | śaktyā paramayā nunnā prasūte sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: May Pingala the chief of Ganas, the pros¬ perous one, fondly attached to Siva and a favourite of Siva, grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Pingala the chief of Ganas, the pros¬ perous one, fondly attached to Siva and a favourite of Siva, grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: एवं शक्तिसमायोगात् शक्तिमानुच्यते शिवः । शक्तिशक्तिमदुत्थं तु शाक्तं शैवमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ śaktisamāyogāt śaktimānucyate śivaḥ | śaktiśaktimadutthaṃ tu śāktaṃ śaivamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Virabhadra is of great splendour. He resembles snow, Kunda flower and the moon. He is the beloved of Bhadrakali. He is the perpetual protector of mothers. He re¬ moved the head of Yajfla and of Daksa of wicked soul, he pared the limbs of Visnu, India, Yama and other gods. He is a follower of Siva. He is a glorious executor of Siva's behests. May he grant my desire at the behest of Siva.

verses.translation: Sarasvati born of the lotus-like speech of Mahesa is interested in worshipping Siva and Siva. May she grant rny desire.

verses.translation: KausikI is the daughter of Parvati, She rides on a lion. She is the great Maya, the slumber of Visnu. She is the suppressor of the demon Mahi§a. She destroyed Surnbha

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मा शिवः प्रोक्तः शिवा सा च प्रकीर्तिता शिवः सदाशिवः प्रोक्तः शिवा सा च मनोन्मनी । शिवो महेश्वरो ज्ञेयः शिवा मायेति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: paramātmā śivaḥ proktaḥ śivā sā ca prakīrtitā śivaḥ sadāśivaḥ proktaḥ śivā sā ca manonmanī | śivo maheśvaro jñeyaḥ śivā māyeti kathyate
verses.translation: Rudras have the lustre of Rudra. Pramathas arc famous for their prowess. The Bhutas have great virility. They have the lustre of Mahadeva. They are perpetual Yogins. They are uncomparable and devoid of conflicting pairs of defaults. They are free from dangers. They are accompanied by their laktis and followers. They are bowed to by the world. They are competent to create and anni¬ hilate the worlds. They are mutually loving and accommo¬ dating. They are very affectionate and respectful to one another. They are favourites of Siva and are marked by his traits. They are gentle, terrible and mixture of both. They are in the midway between the two. They are ugly, good- featured and multi featured. May they grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.wordMeaning: Rudras have the lustre of Rudra. Pramathas arc famous for their prowess. The Bhutas have great virility. They have the lustre of Mahadeva. They are perpetual Yogins. They are uncomparable and devoid of conflicting pairs of defaults. They are free from dangers.…

verses.transliteration: puruṣaḥ parameśānaḥ prakṛtiḥ parameśvarī | rudro maheśvaraḥ sākṣād rudrāṇī rudravallabhā
verses.translation: The sun is the Murti with illuminated disc of Mahesa. He is Nirguna, Gunasahkirna, Gunakevala, and Avikaratmaka. The first one is single with general variations. He is of extraordinary activity in creation, sustenance and annihilation. Thus he is divided into three, four or five ways. He is worshipped in the fourth Avarana of Siva along with the followers. He is a favourite of Siva and fondly attached to SivJi. He is engaged in worshipping the feet of Siva. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.=®

verses.translation: May the twelve Adityas, and the twelve Saktis, sages, Gandharvas, serpents, Apsaras, Gramanis, Yaksas Raksasas, Asuras, the seven sets of seven, the seven horses identical with the Vedas and Valakhilya and others, the worshippers of Siva's feet, grant me everything at the behest of Siva and Siva. Brahma the chief of the universe, a form of the lord of gods, having sixtyfour attributes and achieve¬ ments, and established in the principle of Buddhi, shall be worshipped in the fourth Avarana of Siva. He is a favou¬ rite of Siva, fondly attached to Siva and is engaged in wor¬ shipping the feet of Siva. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.translation: May the four Vedas, the Itihasas, Puranas, Dharma-Sastras accompanied by the Vedic lore, although mutually disagreeing but based on the nature of Siva, grant my desire at the behest of Siva and Siva.
