verses.sanskrit: मरीचिर्भगवान् रुद्रः सम्भूतिः शर्ववल्लभा । गङ्गाधरोऽङ्गिरा ज्ञेयः स्मृतिः साक्षादुमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: marīcirbhagavān rudraḥ sambhūtiḥ śarvavallabhā | gaṅgādharo'ṅgirā jñeyaḥ smṛtiḥ sākṣādumā smṛtā
verses.translation: May the bull, the powerful son of Kamadhenu, rivalling with the submarine fire Varava, surrounded by five mother-cows*®' who has attained the state being the vehicle of the lord and the goddess, grant my desire, at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the bull, the powerful son of Kamadhenu, rivalling with the submarine fire Varava, surrounded by five mother-cows*®' who has attained the state being the vehicle of the lord and the goddess, grant my desire, at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः शशभृन्मौलिः प्रीतिः कान्ता पिनाकिनः । पुलहस्त्रिपुरध्वंसी तत्प्रिया तु शिवप्रिया
verses.transliteration: pulastyaḥ śaśabhṛnmauliḥ prītiḥ kāntā pinākinaḥ | pulahastripuradhvaṃsī tatpriyā tu śivapriyā
verses.translation: The five mother- cows stationed in Siva's region are Nanda, Sunanda, Surabhi, Susila and Sumanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five mother- cows stationed in Siva's region are Nanda, Sunanda, Surabhi, Susila and Sumanas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुध्वंसी क्रतुः प्रोक्तः सन्नतिर्दयिता विभोः । त्रिनेत्रोऽत्रिरुमा साक्षादनसूया स्मृता बुधैः
verses.transliteration: kratudhvaṃsī kratuḥ proktaḥ sannatirdayitā vibhoḥ | trinetro'trirumā sākṣādanasūyā smṛtā budhaiḥ
verses.translation: They are engaged in devotion to Siva and are engrossed in his worship. May these grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are engaged in devotion to Siva and are engrossed in his worship. May these grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपः कालहा देवो देवमाता महेश्वरी । वसिष्ठो मन्मथारातिर्देवी साक्षादरुन्धती
verses.transliteration: kaśyapaḥ kālahā devo devamātā maheśvarī | vasiṣṭho manmathārātirdevī sākṣādarundhatī
verses.translation: Ksetrapala of great splendour resembling the blue cloud with his face terrible due to the curved fangs, refulgent with throbbing red lips, with red hairs lifted up, with the crooked, eyebrows, three circular red eyes, with the moon and the serpents as ornaments, being in nude form holds the trident noose, sword and the skull in his hands, of terrible aspect, surrounded by Bhairavas, Siddhas and Yoginis, is seated in every temple. He is the protector of the good. Bowing to lord Siva is his great interest. He is purified by pious feelings towards Siva. He protects those who seek re¬ fuge in him particularly as his own sons. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.
verses.wordMeaning: Ksetrapala of great splendour resembling the blue cloud with his face terrible due to the curved fangs, refulgent with throbbing red lips, with red hairs lifted up, with the crooked, eyebrows, three circular red eyes, with the moon and the serpents as ornaments,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksetrapala of great splendour resembling the blue cloud with his face terrible due to the curved fangs, refulgent with throbbing red lips, with red hairs lifted up, with the crooked, eyebrows, three circular red eyes, with the moon and the serpents as ornaments,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्करः पुरुषाः सर्वे स्त्रियः सर्वा महेश्वरी । सर्वे स्त्रीपुरुषास्तस्मात्तयोरेव विभूतयः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkaraḥ puruṣāḥ sarve striyaḥ sarvā maheśvarī | sarve strīpuruṣāstasmāttayoreva vibhūtayaḥ
verses.translation: May the four deities Talajahgha and others wor¬ shipped in the first Avarana protect me at the behest of Siva and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the four deities Talajahgha and others wor¬ shipped in the first Avarana protect me at the behest of Siva and Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विषयी भगवानीशो विषयः परमेश्वरी । श्राव्यं सर्वमुमारूपं श्रोता शूलवरायुधः
verses.transliteration: viṣayī bhagavānīśo viṣayaḥ parameśvarī | śrāvyaṃ sarvamumārūpaṃ śrotā śūlavarāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: May Bhairava and others who surround him all round bless me at the behest of the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Bhairava and others who surround him all round bless me at the behest of the two.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रष्टव्यं वस्तुजातं तु धत्ते शङ्करवल्लभा । प्रष्टा स एव विश्वात्मा बालचन्द्रावतंसकः
verses.transliteration: praṣṭavyaṃ vastujātaṃ tu dhatte śaṅkaravallabhā | praṣṭā sa eva viśvātmā bālacandrāvataṃsakaḥ
verses.translation: For the names of the mother-cows, see below verse 144*
verses.commentary: Sense: For the names of the mother-cows, see below verse 144*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टव्यं वस्तुरूपं तु बिभर्ति भववल्लभा । द्रष्टा विश्वेश्वरो देवः शशिखण्डशिखामणिः
verses.transliteration: draṣṭavyaṃ vasturūpaṃ tu bibharti bhavavallabhā | draṣṭā viśveśvaro devaḥ śaśikhaṇḍaśikhāmaṇiḥ
verses.translation: The great lore of Siva capable of releasing the individual soul from the fivefold bondage is different from Pasuvidya. The scripture of Saivite virtue and the Dharma, the Purana of Siva approved of by Srutis, and the Saivitc scriptures Kamika and others of four types honoured by iSiva and Siva and worshipped by me may all these make this holy rite accomplished well and fruitful.
verses.wordMeaning: The great lore of Siva capable of releasing the individual soul from the fivefold bondage is different from Pasuvidya. The scripture of Saivite virtue and the Dharma, the Purana of Siva approved of by Srutis,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lore of Siva capable of releasing the individual soul from the fivefold bondage is different from Pasuvidya. The scripture of Saivite virtue and the Dharma, the Purana of Siva approved of by Srutis,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रसजातं महादेवी देवो रसयिता शिवः । प्रेयजातं च गिरिजा प्रेयांश्चैव गराशनः
verses.transliteration: rasajātaṃ mahādevī devo rasayitā śivaḥ | preyajātaṃ ca girijā preyāṃścaiva garāśanaḥ
verses.translation: May the early preceptors from iSveta to NakulTsa along with their disciples, the preceptors born as member? of their families, especially my preceptors, both Saivas and Mahesvaras engrossed in Siva's knowledge and holy rites, permit this holy rite to be fruitful and well accomplis¬ hed.
verses.wordMeaning: May the early preceptors from iSveta to NakulTsa along with their disciples, the preceptors born as member? of their families, especially my preceptors, both Saivas and Mahesvaras engrossed in Siva's knowledge and holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the early preceptors from iSveta to NakulTsa along with their disciples, the preceptors born as member? of their families, especially my preceptors, both Saivas and Mahesvaras engrossed in Siva's knowledge and holy rites,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्तव्यवस्तुतां धत्ते सदा देवी महेश्वरी । मन्ता स एव विश्वात्मा महादेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: mantavyavastutāṃ dhatte sadā devī maheśvarī | mantā sa eva viśvātmā mahādevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: May the, lay brahmins, Ksatriyas.. those who are experts in the knowledge of the Vedas and the ancillaries together with their tenets in the lines of Saivite virtue, those who are well-versed in all sacred scriptures, the followers of Sarhkhya, Vaisesika, Nyaya and other systems of philosophy, the followers of the sun, Brahma, Rudra and Visnu and all
verses.wordMeaning: May the, lay brahmins, Ksatriyas.. those who are experts in the knowledge of the Vedas and the ancillaries together with their tenets in the lines of Saivite virtue, those who are well-versed in all sacred scriptures, the followers of Sarhkhya, Vaisesika,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the, lay brahmins, Ksatriyas.. those who are experts in the knowledge of the Vedas and the ancillaries together with their tenets in the lines of Saivite virtue, those who are well-versed in all sacred scriptures, the followers of Sarhkhya, Vaisesika,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बोद्धव्यवस्तुरूपं तु बिभर्ति भववल्लभा । देवः स एव भगवान् बोद्धा मुग्धेन्दुशेखरः
verses.transliteration: boddhavyavasturūpaṃ tu bibharti bhavavallabhā | devaḥ sa eva bhagavān boddhā mugdhenduśekharaḥ
verses.translation: Those who adhere to the path of knowledge according to the southerners, those who follow the southern cult and the northern cult abide by me. without mutual clash since I wish and seek the welfare through the mantras. »
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who adhere to the path of knowledge according to the southerners, those who follow the southern cult and the northern cult abide by me. without mutual clash since I wish and seek the welfare through the mantras. »
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणः पिनाकी सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भगवान् प्रभुः । प्राणस्थितिस्तु सर्वेषामम्बिका चाम्बुरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: prāṇaḥ pinākī sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhagavān prabhuḥ | prāṇasthitistu sarveṣāmambikā cāmburūpiṇī
verses.translation: May the atheists, tenacious rogues, ungrateful and Tamasic heretics and great sinners be far aXvay from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the atheists, tenacious rogues, ungrateful and Tamasic heretics and great sinners be far aXvay from me.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्ति क्षेत्रतां देवी त्रिपुरान्तकवल्लभा । क्षेत्रज्ञत्वं तदा धत्ते भगवानन्तकान्तकः
verses.transliteration: bibharti kṣetratāṃ devī tripurāntakavallabhā | kṣetrajñatvaṃ tadā dhatte bhagavānantakāntakaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva accompanied by $iva. Obeis¬ ance to you the primordial cause accompanied by your son. Obeisance to you encircled by the universe in the form of five A varan as.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Siva accompanied by $iva. Obeis¬ ance to you the primordial cause accompanied by your son. Obeisance to you encircled by the universe in the form of five A varan as.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहः शूलायुधो देवः शूलपाणिप्रिया निशा । आकाशः शङ्करो देवः पृथिवी शङ्करप्रिया
verses.transliteration: ahaḥ śūlāyudho devaḥ śūlapāṇipriyā niśā | ākāśaḥ śaṅkaro devaḥ pṛthivī śaṅkarapriyā
verses.translation: After saying this he shall prostrate before Siva and $iva and perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra not les.s than hundred and eight times.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this he shall prostrate before Siva and $iva and perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra not les.s than hundred and eight times.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रो भगवानीशो वेला शैलेन्द्रकन्यका । वृक्षो वृषध्वजो देवो लता विश्वेश्वरप्रिया
verses.transliteration: samudro bhagavānīśo velā śailendrakanyakā | vṛkṣo vṛṣadhvajo devo latā viśveśvarapriyā
verses.translation: Similarly he shall perform the Japa of iSakti man¬ tra, dedicate it to Siva and crave forgiveness. He shall thus conclude the remaining rites of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly he shall perform the Japa of iSakti man¬ tra, dedicate it to Siva and crave forgiveness. He shall thus conclude the remaining rites of worship.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुँल्लिङ्गमखिलं धत्ते भगवान् पुरशासनः । स्त्रिलिङ्गं चाखिलं धत्ते देवी देवमनोरमा
verses.transliteration: pum̐lliṅgamakhilaṃ dhatte bhagavān puraśāsanaḥ | striliṅgaṃ cākhilaṃ dhatte devī devamanoramā
verses.translation: He who repeats this everyday or listens to this with mental purity shakes off sins and attains Sivasayujya soon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who repeats this everyday or listens to this with mental purity shakes off sins and attains Sivasayujya soon.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शब्दजालमशेषं तु धत्ते सर्वस्य वल्लभा । अर्थस्वरूपमखिलं धत्ते मुग्धेन्दुशेखरः
verses.transliteration: śabdajālamaśeṣaṃ tu dhatte sarvasya vallabhā | arthasvarūpamakhilaṃ dhatte mugdhenduśekharaḥ
verses.translation: Slayers of cows, ungrateful wretches, murderers of heroes, those who slay children in the womb, murderers of those who seek refuge, those who kill
verses.commentary: Sense: Slayers of cows, ungrateful wretches, murderers of heroes, those who slay children in the womb, murderers of those who seek refuge, those who kill
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यस्य पदार्थस्य या या शक्तिरुदाहृता । सा सा विश्वेश्वरी देवी स स सर्वो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yasya yasya padārthasya yā yā śaktirudāhṛtā | sā sā viśveśvarī devī sa sa sarvo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: When bad dreams and evil portents occur in¬ dicating terror and danger this hymn shall be repeated. Then those dangers do not befall.
verses.commentary: Sense: When bad dreams and evil portents occur in¬ dicating terror and danger this hymn shall be repeated. Then those dangers do not befall.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्परं यत्पवित्रं च यत्पुण्यं यच्च मङ्गलम् । तत्तदाह महाभागास्तयोस्तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: yatparaṃ yatpavitraṃ ca yatpuṇyaṃ yacca maṅgalam | tattadāha mahābhāgāstayostejovijṛmbhitam
verses.translation: Let the accruing of the benefit stand alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the accruing of the benefit stand alone.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा दीपस्य दीप्तस्य शिखा दीपयते गृहम् । तथा तेजस्तयोरेतद् व्याप्य दीपयते जगत्
verses.transliteration: yathā dīpasya dīptasya śikhā dīpayate gṛham | tathā tejastayoretad vyāpya dīpayate jagat
verses.translation: Hence after worshipping the lord and Uma in the heaven the devotee shall siand with palms joined in rever¬ ence and repeat the hymn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence after worshipping the lord and Uma in the heaven the devotee shall siand with palms joined in rever¬ ence and repeat the hymn.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तृणादिशिवमूर्त्यन्तं विश्वख्यातिशयक्रमः । सन्निकर्षक्रमवशात्तयोरिति परा श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: tṛṇādiśivamūrtyantaṃ viśvakhyātiśayakramaḥ | sannikarṣakramavaśāttayoriti parā śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Now I shall mention that great rite of worship, Homa, Japa, meditation, penance and charitable gifts, which yields benefits here itself to men who follow Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall mention that great rite of worship, Homa, Japa, meditation, penance and charitable gifts, which yields benefits here itself to men who follow Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाकारात्मकावेतौ सर्वश्रेयोविधायिनौ । पूजनीयौ नमस्कार्यौ चिन्तनीयौ च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: sarvākārātmakāvetau sarvaśreyovidhāyinau | pūjanīyau namaskāryau cintanīyau ca sarvadā
verses.translation: The devotee expert in the meaning of mantras shall at the outset practise mantras since the rites of visible bene¬ fits here itself are not fruitful otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee expert in the meaning of mantras shall at the outset practise mantras since the rites of visible bene¬ fits here itself are not fruitful otherwise.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथाप्रज्ञमिदं कृष्ण याथात्म्यं परमेशयोः । कथितं हि मया तेऽद्य न तु तावदियत्तया
verses.transliteration: yathāprajñamidaṃ kṛṣṇa yāthātmyaṃ parameśayoḥ | kathitaṃ hi mayā te'dya na tu tāvadiyattayā
verses.translation: A learned and sensible devotee, even after the mantra has been achieved, shall not haphazardly perform any rite the fruit whereof has been thwarted by some un¬ seen powerful obstacle.
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned and sensible devotee, even after the mantra has been achieved, shall not haphazardly perform any rite the fruit whereof has been thwarted by some un¬ seen powerful obstacle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्कथं शक्यते वक्तुं याथात्म्यं परमेशयोः । महतामपि सर्वेषां मनसोऽपि बहिर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: tatkathaṃ śakyate vaktuṃ yāthātmyaṃ parameśayoḥ | mahatāmapi sarveṣāṃ manaso'pi bahirgatam
verses.translation: He who due to delusion performs the rite yield¬ ing the benefit here itself does not attain the fruit thereof and becomes the laughing stock.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who due to delusion performs the rite yield¬ ing the benefit here itself does not attain the fruit thereof and becomes the laughing stock.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्गतमनन्यानामीश्वरार्पितचेतसाम् । अन्येषां बुद्ध्यनारूढमारूढं च यथैव तत्
verses.transliteration: antargatamananyānāmīśvarārpitacetasām | anyeṣāṃ buddhyanārūḍhamārūḍhaṃ ca yathaiva tat
verses.translation: Without faith and devotion no one shall perform the rite intended to yield direct benefit. He becomes an unbeliever and an unbeliever does not attain fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without faith and devotion no one shall perform the rite intended to yield direct benefit. He becomes an unbeliever and an unbeliever does not attain fruit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: येयमुक्ता विभूतिर्वै प्राकृती सा परा मता । अप्राकृतां परामन्यां गुह्यां गुह्यविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: yeyamuktā vibhūtirvai prākṛtī sā parā matā | aprākṛtāṃ parāmanyāṃ guhyāṃ guhyavido viduḥ
verses.translation: An aspirant who has mastered the mantras over¬ coming the obstacles and who performs the rite with full confidence and conviction attains the fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: An aspirant who has mastered the mantras over¬ coming the obstacles and who performs the rite with full confidence and conviction attains the fruit.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते मनसा चेन्द्रियैः सह । अप्राकृती परा चैषा विभूतिः पारमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: yato vāco nivartante manasā cendriyaiḥ saha | aprākṛtī parā caiṣā vibhūtiḥ pārameśvarī
verses.translation: Or, for the attainment of the benefit let him be scrupulously celibate, eating only the Havisya, milk-pudding or fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, for the attainment of the benefit let him be scrupulously celibate, eating only the Havisya, milk-pudding or fruits.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सैवेह परमं धाम सैवेह परमा गतिः । सैवेह परमा काष्ठा विभूतिः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: saiveha paramaṃ dhāma saiveha paramā gatiḥ | saiveha paramā kāṣṭhā vibhūtiḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: He shall not even think of, much less physically do, such prohibited actions as violence. He shall be pure always with clear dress and smear the body with Bhasma always.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not even think of, much less physically do, such prohibited actions as violence. He shall be pure always with clear dress and smear the body with Bhasma always.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां प्राप्तुं प्रयतन्तेऽत्र जितश्वासा जितेन्द्रियाः । गर्भकारागृहद्वारं निश्छिद्रं घटितं यथा
verses.transliteration: tāṃ prāptuṃ prayatante'tra jitaśvāsā jitendriyāḥ | garbhakārāgṛhadvāraṃ niśchidraṃ ghaṭitaṃ yathā
verses.translation: After observing the rules of conduct, the devotee shall on an auspicious and favourable day with the char¬ acteristics mentioned before, smear the ground with cowdung in a spot bedecked with garlands of flowers and draw the auspicious lotus shining with its own refiilgence. It shall be of molten gold with eight petals and filaments, with the peri¬ carp in the middle set with all gems. It shall be not less than a Hasta in width and must have a stalk befitting its size. He shall conceive Anima etc. in the bulbous root made of gold, in accordance with the injunctions. He shall instal the phallic idol with its pedestal, made of gems, gold or crystal with the requisite characteristics. He shall invoke
verses.wordMeaning: After observing the rules of conduct, the devotee shall on an auspicious and favourable day with the char¬ acteristics mentioned before, smear the ground with cowdung in a spot bedecked with garlands of flowers and draw the auspicious lotus shining with its own refiilgence.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After observing the rules of conduct, the devotee shall on an auspicious and favourable day with the char¬ acteristics mentioned before, smear the ground with cowdung in a spot bedecked with garlands of flowers and draw the auspicious lotus shining with its own refiilgence.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संसाराशीविषालीढमृतसञ्जीवनौषधम् । विभूतिं शिवयोर्विद्वान्न बिभेति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: saṃsārāśīviṣālīḍhamṛtasañjīvanauṣadham | vibhūtiṃ śivayorvidvānna bibheti kutaścana
verses.translation: It shall have four arms and four faces. It shall be bedecked in all ornaments. It shall wear the tiger's hide with the smiling face and the gestures of granting boons and of protection to the devotee. Other hands shall hold the deer and the axe. Or if the conceiver desires he can conceive of the Murti as having eight arms.
verses.wordMeaning: It shall have four arms and four faces. It shall be bedecked in all ornaments. It shall wear the tiger's hide with the smiling face and the gestures of granting boons and of protection to the devotee. Other hands shall hold the deer and the axe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It shall have four arms and four faces. It shall be bedecked in all ornaments. It shall wear the tiger's hide with the smiling face and the gestures of granting boons and of protection to the devotee. Other hands shall hold the deer and the axe.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यः परामपरां चैव विभूतिं वेत्ति तत्त्वतः । सोऽपरां भूतिमुल्लङ्घ्य परां भूतिं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ parāmaparāṃ caiva vibhūtiṃ vetti tattvataḥ | so'parāṃ bhūtimullaṅghya parāṃ bhūtiṃ samaśnute
verses.translation: The Murti shall have the lustre of the rising sun. It shall have three eyes in every face. The face towards the east is gentle and has the refulgence befitting its size and features.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murti shall have the lustre of the rising sun. It shall have three eyes in every face. The face towards the east is gentle and has the refulgence befitting its size and features.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं कृष्ण याथात्म्यं परमात्मनोः । रहस्यमपि योग्योऽसि भर्गभक्तो भवानिति
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ kṛṣṇa yāthātmyaṃ paramātmanoḥ | rahasyamapi yogyo'si bhargabhakto bhavāniti
verses.translation: The southern face resembles the blue cloud and has a terrific appearance. The northern face has the lustre of coral and is bedecked with dark forelocks.
verses.commentary: Sense: The southern face resembles the blue cloud and has a terrific appearance. The northern face has the lustre of coral and is bedecked with dark forelocks.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नाशिष्येभ्योऽप्यशैवेभ्यो नाभक्तेभ्यः कदाचन । व्याहरेदीशयोर्भूतिमिति वेदानुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: nāśiṣyebhyo'pyaśaivebhyo nābhaktebhyaḥ kadācana | vyāharedīśayorbhūtimiti vedānuśāsanam
verses.translation: She is famous as Mahalaksmi dark coloured and wholly charming. After conceiving the Murti thus and unifying it into a whole he shall invoke the embodied lord and worship him. For the purpose of ablution he shall arrange for Paricagavya prepared from a tawny cow.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is famous as Mahalaksmi dark coloured and wholly charming. After conceiving the Murti thus and unifying it into a whole he shall invoke the embodied lord and worship him. For the purpose of ablution he shall arrange for Paricagavya prepared from a tawny cow.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमतिकल्याण परेभ्यः कथयेन्न हि । त्वादृशेभ्योऽनुरूपेभ्यः कथयैतन्न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvamatikalyāṇa parebhyaḥ kathayenna hi | tvādṛśebhyo'nurūpebhyaḥ kathayaitanna cānyathā
verses.translation: There shall be Paftcamrta and particularly the full seeds. He shall prepare the Mandala ahead decorated with gem-dust. The water-pot of Isana shall be put in the pericarp. The water-pots of Sadyojata shall be placed around, afterwards.®**
verses.commentary: Sense: There shall be Paftcamrta and particularly the full seeds. He shall prepare the Mandala ahead decorated with gem-dust. The water-pot of Isana shall be put in the pericarp. The water-pots of Sadyojata shall be placed around, afterwards.®**
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विभूतिमेतां शिवयोर्योग्येभ्यो यः प्रदापयेत् । संसारसागरान् मुक्तः शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: vibhūtimetāṃ śivayoryogyebhyo yaḥ pradāpayet | saṃsārasāgarān muktaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Eight pots of Vidyea shall be filled with the waters of holy centres and threads shall be tied round them. Sacred articles of worship shall be dropped therein with due incantations in accordance with the injunctions. They shall be completely covered into the silken cloth with the mantras. When the proper time arrives he shall perform the ablution of the lord with Paricagavya.
verses.wordMeaning: Eight pots of Vidyea shall be filled with the waters of holy centres and threads shall be tied round them. Sacred articles of worship shall be dropped therein with due incantations in accordance with the injunctions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight pots of Vidyea shall be filled with the waters of holy centres and threads shall be tied round them. Sacred articles of worship shall be dropped therein with due incantations in accordance with the injunctions.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तनादस्य नश्यन्ति महान्त्यः पापकोटयः । त्रिश्चतुर्धा समभ्यस्तैर्विनश्यन्ति ततोऽधिकाः
verses.transliteration: kīrtanādasya naśyanti mahāntyaḥ pāpakoṭayaḥ | triścaturdhā samabhyastairvinaśyanti tato'dhikāḥ
verses.translation: Waters dropped from the Darbha grass, golden and gemset vessels, scented and flowery waters purified with the mantras shall be taken from the vessels and Mahevara shall be bathed. Scents and flowers shall be offered, lights shown and the worship performed. The unguent shall be not less than a Pala by weight and the maximum shall be eleven Palas.
verses.wordMeaning: Waters dropped from the Darbha grass, golden and gemset vessels, scented and flowery waters purified with the mantras shall be taken from the vessels and Mahevara shall be bathed. Scents and flowers shall be offered, lights shown and the worship performed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters dropped from the Darbha grass, golden and gemset vessels, scented and flowery waters purified with the mantras shall be taken from the vessels and Mahevara shall be bathed. Scents and flowers shall be offered, lights shown and the worship performed.…

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्त्यनिष्टरिपवो वर्धन्ते सुहृदस्तथा । विद्या च वर्धते शैवी मतिः सत्ये प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: naśyantyaniṣṭaripavo vardhante suhṛdastathā | vidyā ca vardhate śaivī matiḥ satye pravartate
verses.translation: Auspicious and charming flowers of good colour and fragrance blue and other lilies, plenty of Bilva leaves, red lotuses and white lotuses if available shall be used. The incense shall be offered with the black Aguru. The gum-resin shall be used with the camphor and ghee. The ghee used for lamps shall be of the milk of tawny cows. The five Brahmans, the six Angas and the Avaranas shall be worshipped.
verses.wordMeaning: Auspicious and charming flowers of good colour and fragrance blue and other lilies, plenty of Bilva leaves, red lotuses and white lotuses if available shall be used. The incense shall be offered with the black Aguru. The gum-resin shall be used with the camphor and ghee.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Auspicious and charming flowers of good colour and fragrance blue and other lilies, plenty of Bilva leaves, red lotuses and white lotuses if available shall be used. The incense shall be offered with the black Aguru. The gum-resin shall be used with the camphor and ghee.…

verses.sanskrit: भक्तिः पराः शिवे साम्बे सानुगे सपरिच्छिदे । यद्यदिष्टतमं चान्यत्तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktiḥ parāḥ śive sāmbe sānuge saparicchide | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ cānyattattadāpnotyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: The Naivedya shall be made of Caru prepared in ghee and milk with jaggery. The water shall be rendered fragrant with the Patala flowers, lilies and lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Naivedya shall be made of Caru prepared in ghee and milk with jaggery. The water shall be rendered fragrant with the Patala flowers, lilies and lotuses.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःशुचिः शिवे भक्तो विस्रब्धः कीर्तयेद्यदि । प्रबलैः कर्मभिः पूर्वैः फलं चेत्प्रतिबध्यते । पुनः पुनः समभ्यस्येत्तस्य नास्तीह दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: antaḥśuciḥ śive bhakto visrabdhaḥ kīrtayedyadi | prabalaiḥ karmabhiḥ pūrvaiḥ phalaṃ cetpratibadhyate | punaḥ punaḥ samabhyasyettasya nāstīha durlabham
verses.translation: Freshly woven cloths of various colours and of fine fabric attractive to the sight shall be offered with songs and instrumental music.
verses.commentary: Sense: Freshly woven cloths of various colours and of fine fabric attractive to the sight shall be offered with songs and instrumental music.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: When quiescent or nourishing rites are being per¬ formed, Siva shall be thought of as gentle in the phallicimage in the Siva -fire and in other idols as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: When quiescent or nourishing rites are being per¬ formed, Siva shall be thought of as gentle in the phallicimage in the Siva -fire and in other idols as well.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥ ७.२.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोगः । उपमन्युरुवाच । विग्रहं देवदेवस्य विश्वमेतत् चराचरम् । तदेवं न विजानन्ति पशवः पाशगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || 7.2.5. pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ | paśupatitvajñānayogaḥ | upamanyuruvāca | vigrahaṃ devadevasya viśvametat carācaram | tadevaṃ na vijānanti paśavaḥ pāśagauravāt
verses.translation: In Marana and other rites the Sruk and lruva shall be made of iron. In all other rites such as quiescent these shall be made of gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Marana and other rites the Sruk and lruva shall be made of iron. In all other rites such as quiescent these shall be made of gold.

verses.sanskrit: तमेकमेव बहुधा वदन्ति यदुनन्दन । अजानन्तः परं भावमविकल्पं महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: tamekameva bahudhā vadanti yadunandana | ajānantaḥ paraṃ bhāvamavikalpaṃ maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Even if he happens to be a desperado one shall not perform Abhicarika rile against a person who has sought refuge in Siva, mentally, verbally or physically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if he happens to be a desperado one shall not perform Abhicarika rile against a person who has sought refuge in Siva, mentally, verbally or physically.

verses.sanskrit: अपरं ब्रह्मरूपं च परं ब्रह्मात्मकं तथा । केचिदाहुर्महादेवमनादिनिधनं परम्
verses.transliteration: aparaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca paraṃ brahmātmakaṃ tathā | kecidāhurmahādevamanādinidhanaṃ param
verses.translation: The ugly man will become beautiful, the aged will become young. The enemy will turn a friend, the op¬ ponent will grow subordinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ugly man will become beautiful, the aged will become young. The enemy will turn a friend, the op¬ ponent will grow subordinate.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेन्द्रियान्तःकरणप्रधानविषयात्मकम् । अपरं ब्रह्म निर्दिष्टं परं ब्रह्म चिदात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtendriyāntaḥkaraṇapradhānaviṣayātmakam | aparaṃ brahma nirdiṣṭaṃ paraṃ brahma cidātmakam
verses.translation: The rite is attended with the excellence of merits. It has been performed by all the gods, particularly by Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, the nine planets — sun-god and others, by Visvamitra, Vasistha and other sages who know Brahman, by Iveta, Agastya, Dadhica and others, by us seeking refuge in Iiva, by Nandi- svara, Mahakala, Bhrhgisa and other Ganesvaras, by the Daityas residing in the nether worlds, by §esa and other serpents, by Siddhas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Raksasa.s, Bhutas, Pisacas and practically by every one who has attained his respective position. It is by means of this rite that the gods have attained their godhood.
verses.wordMeaning: The rite is attended with the excellence of merits. It has been performed by all the gods, particularly by Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, the nine planets — sun-god and others, by Visvamitra, Vasistha and other sages who know Brahman, by Iveta,…

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्त्वाद् बृंहणत्वाद्वा ब्रह्म चेत्यभिधीयते । उभे ते ब्रह्मणो रूपे ब्रह्मणोऽधिपतेः प्रभोः । विद्याविद्यास्वरूपीति कैश्चिदीशो निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: bṛhattvād bṛṃhaṇatvādvā brahma cetyabhidhīyate | ubhe te brahmaṇo rūpe brahmaṇo'dhipateḥ prabhoḥ | vidyāvidyāsvarūpīti kaiścidīśo nigadyate
verses.translation: Brahma attained his Brahmahood, Visnu his Vi$nu- hood, Rudra his Rudrahood and Indra his Indrahood. It is by means of this rite that Ganesa attained his Ganesahood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma attained his Brahmahood, Visnu his Vi$nu- hood, Rudra his Rudrahood and Indra his Indrahood. It is by means of this rite that Ganesa attained his Ganesahood.

verses.transliteration: vidyāṃ tu cetanāṃ prāhustathāvidyāmacetanām | vidyāvidyātmakaṃ caiva viśvaṃ viśvagurorvibhoḥ
verses.translation: The lihga shall be bathed with white sandal water. Therein Siva and Siva shall be worshipped with
verses.commentary: Sense: The lihga shall be bathed with white sandal water. Therein Siva and Siva shall be worshipped with

verses.sanskrit: रूपमेव न सन्देहो विश्वं तस्य वशे यतः । भ्रान्तिर्विद्या परा चेति शार्वं रूपं परं विदुः
verses.transliteration: rūpameva na sandeho viśvaṃ tasya vaśe yataḥ | bhrāntirvidyā parā ceti śārvaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: To the south he shall apply Aguru. To the west he shall apply red arsenic. To the north he shall apply sandal and to the east he shall apply yellow orpiment. He shall then worship with charming fragrant flowers of various colours.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south he shall apply Aguru. To the west he shall apply red arsenic. To the north he shall apply sandal and to the east he shall apply yellow orpiment. He shall then worship with charming fragrant flowers of various colours.

verses.transliteration: ayathābuddhirartheṣu bahudhā bhrāntirucyate | yathārthākārasaṃvittirvidyeti parikīrtyate
verses.translation: The black Aguru shall be used for incense and fumigation along with Guggulu. Fine cloths bright in colours shall be offered-

verses.sanskrit: विकल्परहितं तत्त्वं परमित्यभिधीयते । वैपरीत्यादसत् शब्दः कथ्यते वेदवादिभिः

verses.translation: After bowing with devotion to the lord of the gods he shall eulogise the lord and crave forgiveness. Naivedya consisting of all offerings shall be offered to the Liiiga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing with devotion to the lord of the gods he shall eulogise the lord and crave forgiveness. Naivedya consisting of all offerings shall be offered to the Liiiga.

For the rites intended to quell ailments to attain prosperity and subdue poverty, gingelly seeds, ghee, milk or lotus-flowers shall be used. Persons seeking to bring persons undei control shall perform Homa with Jati flowers and ghee,

verses.translation: A Brahman shall perform the rite of Akarsana with ghee and Karavira flowers, Uccatana with oil and Slambhana with honey.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahman shall perform the rite of Akarsana with ghee and Karavira flowers, Uccatana with oil and Slambhana with honey.

verses.translation: Stambhana rite can be performed with mustard also; Patana with garlic; Tadana with the blood of mule, camel or of both.
verses.commentary: Sense: Stambhana rite can be performed with mustard also; Patana with garlic; Tadana with the blood of mule, camel or of both.

verses.translation: Marana and Uccatana shall be performed with Rohi and gingelly seeds. Vidvesana rite shall be pcrfoimed with the oil of Lahgala.

verses.transliteration: te rūpe parameśasya tadicchāyāḥ pravartanāt | tayoḥ kāraṇabhāvena śivaṃ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: Bandhana rites and the rite of paralysing of a vast army shall be performed with the seeds of Rohi. Milk yields the subdual of fevers and is conducive to good fortune.

verses.translation: Homa offered with honey, ghee, curds, milk and rice-grains or with Garu grants all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homa offered with honey, ghee, curds, milk and rice-grains or with Garu grants all desires.

verses.translation: Quiescent, nourishing, Vasya and Akarsana rites shall be performed with the seven articles of worship sacrificial twigs etc.

verses.translation: Vaya..Akarsana and Sripada (glorious position) rites shall be performed with the leaves of Bilva for Havana. It yields conquest over the enemies.,

verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतितत्त्वानि व्यक्तमाहुर्मनीषिणः । कालः कार्यप्रपञ्चस्य परिणामैककारणम्
verses.transliteration: trayoviṃśatitattvāni vyaktamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ | kālaḥ kāryaprapañcasya pariṇāmaikakāraṇam
verses.translation: No virtuous man, occupying honourable position or otherwise shall perform the Abhicarika rite against the ruler of his country.
verses.commentary: Sense: No virtuous man, occupying honourable position or otherwise shall perform the Abhicarika rite against the ruler of his country.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एषामीशोऽधिपो धाता प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः । आविर्भावतिरोभावहेतुरेकः स्वराडजः
verses.transliteration: eṣāmīśo'dhipo dhātā pravartakanivartakaḥ | āvirbhāvatirobhāvaheturekaḥ svarāḍajaḥ
verses.translation: A man performing Abhicarika rite against the ruler of his country whether he be a devotee of Siva or not, shall have a fall immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man performing Abhicarika rite against the ruler of his country whether he be a devotee of Siva or not, shall have a fall immediately.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् प्रधानपुरुषव्यक्तकालस्वरूपवान् । हेतुर्नेताधिपस्तेषां धाता चोक्तो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt pradhānapuruṣavyaktakālasvarūpavān | heturnetādhipasteṣāṃ dhātā cokto maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: If he wishes for his own happinness he shall not perform Abhicarika rite against the protector of his country or against any devotee of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he wishes for his own happinness he shall not perform Abhicarika rite against the protector of his country or against any devotee of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विराड् हिरण्यगर्भात्मा कैश्चिदीशो निगद्यते । हिरण्यगर्भो लोकानां हेतुर्विश्वात्मको विराट्
verses.transliteration: virāḍ hiraṇyagarbhātmā kaiścidīśo nigadyate | hiraṇyagarbho lokānāṃ heturviśvātmako virāṭ
verses.translation: If he performs the rite of Marana etc. against any other person he shall perform expiatory rites after due repen tence.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he performs the rite of Marana etc. against any other person he shall perform expiatory rites after due repen tence.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्यामी परश्चेति कथ्यते कविभिः शिवः । प्राज्ञस्तैजसविश्वात्मेत्यपरे सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: antaryāmī paraśceti kathyate kavibhiḥ śivaḥ | prājñastaijasaviśvātmetyapare sampracakṣate
verses.translation: Iflihgas of gold and gems are not available or if he is unable to possess them he shall perform the worship mentally or with substitute articles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Iflihgas of gold and gems are not available or if he is unable to possess them he shall perform the worship mentally or with substitute articles.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयमपरे प्राहुः सौम्यमेव परे विदुः । माता मानं च मेयं च मतिं चाहुरथापरे
verses.transliteration: turīyamapare prāhuḥ saumyameva pare viduḥ | mātā mānaṃ ca meyaṃ ca matiṃ cāhurathāpare
verses.translation: If a devotee can perform worship in some part he too derives the benefit of that part in accordance with his ability.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a devotee can perform worship in some part he too derives the benefit of that part in accordance with his ability.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता क्रिया च कार्यं च करणं कारणं परे । जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्त्यात्मेत्यपरे सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: kartā kriyā ca kāryaṃ ca karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ pare | jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyātmetyapare sampracakṣate
verses.translation: If the preceptor does not wish to receive, the entire gift shall be given to Siva or the devotees of Siva. It shall not be given to any other.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the preceptor does not wish to receive, the entire gift shall be given to Siva or the devotees of Siva. It shall not be given to any other.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयमपरे प्राहुस्तुर्यातीतमितीतरे । तमाहुर्विगुणं केचिद्गुणवन्तं परे विदुः
verses.transliteration: turīyamapare prāhusturyātītamitītare | tamāhurviguṇaṃ kecidguṇavantaṃ pare viduḥ
verses.translation: If any one performs the rite him.self without
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one performs the rite him.self without
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: केचित्संसारिणं प्राहुस्तमसंसारिणं परे । स्वतन्त्रमपरे प्राहुरस्वतन्त्रं परे विदुः
verses.transliteration: kecitsaṃsāriṇaṃ prāhustamasaṃsāriṇaṃ pare | svatantramapare prāhurasvatantraṃ pare viduḥ
verses.translation: The lihga used for worship may be taken by him¬ self or given to others. If he takes that himself he shall worship it everyday or cause it to be worshipped on. his be¬ half.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lihga used for worship may be taken by him¬ self or given to others. If he takes that himself he shall worship it everyday or cause it to be worshipped on. his be¬ half.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: घोरमित्यपरे प्राहुः सौम्यमेव परे विदुः । रागवन्तं परे प्राहुर्वीतरागं तथा परे
verses.transliteration: ghoramityapare prāhuḥ saumyameva pare viduḥ | rāgavantaṃ pare prāhurvītarāgaṃ tathā pare
verses.translation: If he performs the rite as ordained he cannot but have the benefit. What other inducement for worship shall there be?
verses.commentary: Sense: If he performs the rite as ordained he cannot but have the benefit. What other inducement for worship shall there be?
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रियं च परे प्राहुः सक्रियं चेतरे जनाः । निरिन्द्रियं परे प्राहुः सेन्द्रियं च तथा परे
verses.transliteration: niṣkriyaṃ ca pare prāhuḥ sakriyaṃ cetare janāḥ | nirindriyaṃ pare prāhuḥ sendriyaṃ ca tathā pare
verses.translation: Still I shall mention about the excellent achievement through the rite. Even if he is attacked by the enemy or tormented by ailments, even if he falls into the jaws of death he will be freed without danger. Even the worst miserly fellow will become worthy of respect. The poor will become Kuvera,® god of wealth.
verses.wordMeaning: Still I shall mention about the excellent achievement through the rite. Even if he is attacked by the enemy or tormented by ailments, even if he falls into the jaws of death he will be freed without danger. Even the worst miserly fellow will become worthy of respect.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Still I shall mention about the excellent achievement through the rite. Even if he is attacked by the enemy or tormented by ailments, even if he falls into the jaws of death he will be freed without danger. Even the worst miserly fellow will become worthy of respect.…

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवमित्यपरे प्राहुस्तमध्रुवमितीतरे । अरूपं केचिदाहुर्वै रूपवन्तं परे विदुः
verses.transliteration: dhruvamityapare prāhustamadhruvamitītare | arūpaṃ kecidāhurvai rūpavantaṃ pare viduḥ
verses.translation: The nectar that may have turned into poison shall become nectar again. The ground may turn into ocean and ocean into ground; the ditch into a mountain and the mountain into a ditch; fire into a lotus lake and the lotus lake into fire; the park into a forest and the forest into a garden; the animal into a lion and the lion into an animal.
verses.wordMeaning: The nectar that may have turned into poison shall become nectar again. The ground may turn into ocean and ocean into ground; the ditch into a mountain and the mountain into a ditch; fire into a lotus lake and the lotus lake into fire;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The nectar that may have turned into poison shall become nectar again. The ground may turn into ocean and ocean into ground; the ditch into a mountain and the mountain into a ditch; fire into a lotus lake and the lotus lake into fire;…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यमपरे प्राहुर्दृश्यमित्यपरे विदुः । वाच्यमित्यपरे प्राहुरवाच्यमिति चापरे । शब्दात्मकं परे प्राहुश्शब्दातीतमथापरे
verses.transliteration: adṛśyamapare prāhurdṛśyamityapare viduḥ | vācyamityapare prāhuravācyamiti cāpare | śabdātmakaṃ pare prāhuśśabdātītamathāpare
verses.translation: Women will run after him voluntarily. Prosperity will behave like a chaste lady and will not leave him. The goddess of speech will be his slave girl, fame a prostitute.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women will run after him voluntarily. Prosperity will behave like a chaste lady and will not leave him. The goddess of speech will be his slave girl, fame a prostitute.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: केचित् चिन्तामयं प्राहुश्चिन्तया रहितं परे । ज्ञानात्मकं परे प्राहुर्विज्ञानमिति चापरे
verses.transliteration: kecit cintāmayaṃ prāhuścintayā rahitaṃ pare | jñānātmakaṃ pare prāhurvijñānamiti cāpare
verses.translation: The intelligence will roam about as it pleases. His mind will be pure like a diamond. Hi', strength will be like a violent gust of wind or like an elephant in rut.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligence will roam about as it pleases. His mind will be pure like a diamond. Hi', strength will be like a violent gust of wind or like an elephant in rut.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: केचित् ज्ञेयमिति प्राहुरज्ञेयमिति केचन । परमेके तमेवाहुरपरं च तथा परे
verses.transliteration: kecit jñeyamiti prāhurajñeyamiti kecana | parameke tamevāhuraparaṃ ca tathā pare
verses.translation: His activities on the side of the enemies will be paralysed in their effort. The friends of enemies wiill be¬ come their enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: His activities on the side of the enemies will be paralysed in their effort. The friends of enemies wiill be¬ come their enemies.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विकल्प्यमानं तु याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः । नाध्यवस्यन्ति मुनयो नानाप्रत्ययकारणात्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vikalpyamānaṃ tu yāthātmyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | nādhyavasyanti munayo nānāpratyayakāraṇāt
verses.translation: The enemies along with their kinsmen will be no better than corpses though physically alive. Though faced
verses.commentary: Sense: The enemies along with their kinsmen will be no better than corpses though physically alive. Though faced
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: येः पुनः सर्वभावेन प्रपन्नाः परमेश्वरम् । ते हि जानन्त्ययत्नेन शिवं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: yeḥ punaḥ sarvabhāvena prapannāḥ parameśvaram | te hi jānantyayatnena śivaṃ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: Even if he takes unwholesome food it will act as aphrodisiac. Even if he indulges in sexual intercourse every¬ day it will give him fresh thrills.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if he takes unwholesome food it will act as aphrodisiac. Even if he indulges in sexual intercourse every¬ day it will give him fresh thrills.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यावत्पशुर्नैव पश्यत्यनीशं कविं पुराणं भुवनस्येशितारम् । तावद्दुःखे वर्तते बद्धपाशः संसारेऽस्मिञ्चक्रनेमिक्रमेण
verses.transliteration: yāvatpaśurnaiva paśyatyanīśaṃ kaviṃ purāṇaṃ bhuvanasyeśitāram | tāvadduḥkhe vartate baddhapāśaḥ saṃsāre'smiñcakranemikrameṇa
verses.translation: Everything hitherto inaccessible to him will be¬ come accessible like the myrobalan in the palm. Even Siddhis anima etc. will become available at his will.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything hitherto inaccessible to him will be¬ come accessible like the myrobalan in the palm. Even Siddhis anima etc. will become available at his will.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा पश्यः पश्यते रुक्मवर्णं कर्तारमीशं पुरुषं ब्रह्मयोनिम् । तदा विद्वान्पुण्यपापे विधूय निरञ्जनः परममुपैति साम्यम्
verses.transliteration: yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rukmavarṇaṃ kartāramīśaṃ puruṣaṃ brahmayonim | tadā vidvānpuṇyapāpe vidhūya nirañjanaḥ paramamupaiti sāmyam
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the rite for the benefits attain¬ able solely after death. There is nothing like this rite in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall mention the rite for the benefits attain¬ able solely after death. There is nothing like this rite in the three worlds.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and every¬ one. It shall be given to devotees of Siva as mentioned by Siva formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and every¬ one. It shall be given to devotees of Siva as mentioned by Siva formerly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and every¬ one. It shall be given to devotees of Siva as mentioned by Siva formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and every¬ one. It shall be given to devotees of Siva as mentioned by Siva formerly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्ववर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । न शिवस्याणवो बन्धः कार्यो मायेय एव वा । प्राकृतो वाथ बोद्धा वा ह्यहङ्कारात्मकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.2.6. ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | śivatattvavarṇanam | upamanyuruvāca | na śivasyāṇavo bandhaḥ kāryo māyeya eva vā | prākṛto vātha boddhā vā hyahaṅkārātmakastathā
verses.translation: The achievement of benefit that has been mentioned here from the Nitya, Naimittika and Kamya rites can entirely be secured immediately by installing the phallic and the bodily image of iSiva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The achievement of benefit that has been mentioned here from the Nitya, Naimittika and Kamya rites can entirely be secured immediately by installing the phallic and the bodily image of iSiva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नैवास्य मानसो बन्धो न चैत्तो नेन्द्रियात्मकः । न च तन्मात्रबन्धोऽपि भूतबन्धो न कश्चन
verses.transliteration: naivāsya mānaso bandho na caitto nendriyātmakaḥ | na ca tanmātrabandho'pi bhūtabandho na kaścana
verses.translation: Due to Rajasic quality they fought and hit each other with fists. In order to dispel their arrogance and to enlighten them, the wonderful Lihga of the lord appeared in between them. It had thousands of flames. It was incomprehensible and incomparable. It did not increase or decrease. It had no beginning, no middle, no end. Brahma and Visnu were enchanted by thousands of flames. Ceasing from their fight they began to think "What is this?" When they could not understand the reality they attempted to survey its beginning and end.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to Rajasic quality they fought and hit each other with fists. In order to dispel their arrogance and to enlighten them, the wonderful Lihga of the lord appeared in between them. It had thousands of flames. It was incomprehensible and incomparable.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to Rajasic quality they fought and hit each other with fists. In order to dispel their arrogance and to enlighten them, the wonderful Lihga of the lord appeared in between them. It had thousands of flames. It was incomprehensible and incomparable.…

verses.sanskrit: न च कालः कला चैव नाविद्या नियतिस्तथा । न रागो न च विद्वेषः शम्भोरमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: na ca kālaḥ kalā caiva nāvidyā niyatistathā | na rāgo na ca vidveṣaḥ śambhoramitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: There the letter "a" became the Rgveda, the letter "u" the Yajurveda, the letter "ma" the Samaveda and the Nada the Atharvaveda.
verses.commentary: Sense: There the letter "a" became the Rgveda, the letter "u" the Yajurveda, the letter "ma" the Samaveda and the Nada the Atharvaveda.

verses.sanskrit: न चास्त्यभिनिवेशोऽस्य कुशलाकुशलान्यपि । कर्माणि तद्विपाकश्च सुखदुःखे च तत्फले
verses.transliteration: na cāstyabhiniveśo'sya kuśalākuśalānyapi | karmāṇi tadvipākaśca sukhaduḥkhe ca tatphale
verses.translation: Similarly the Samaveda established itself in ten ways. It established Tamas and Rudra the first among the deities in the rites, annihilation in the three worlds and the excellent Siva in the Tattvas, Aghora in the five Brahmans and Vidya among the Kalas, the upper seat in the parts of the Lihga and the source in the three causes. So also the Aisvarya of the Purusa. Thus the universe is pervaded by the Saman.
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the Samaveda established itself in ten ways. It established Tamas and Rudra the first among the deities in the rites, annihilation in the three worlds and the excellent Siva in the Tattvas, Aghora in the five Brahmans and Vidya among the Kalas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the Samaveda established itself in ten ways. It established Tamas and Rudra the first among the deities in the rites, annihilation in the three worlds and the excellent Siva in the Tattvas, Aghora in the five Brahmans and Vidya among the Kalas,…

verses.sanskrit: आशयैर्नापि सम्बन्धः संस्कारैः कर्मणामपि । भोगैश्च भोगसंस्कारैः कालत्रितयगोचरैः
verses.transliteration: āśayairnāpi sambandhaḥ saṃskāraiḥ karmaṇāmapi | bhogaiśca bhogasaṃskāraiḥ kālatritayagocaraiḥ
verses.translation: Then the Atharvaveda established itself thus. It was devoid of Gunas. It placed Mahesvara, Sadasiva as the first among the deities. Though the great Atman, Siva is devoid of activities. It established Sadasiva for the purpase of activities. It created pure blessing whereby the creatures are liberated. Above the worlds, where the words recede along with the mind are the Unmana worlds over which is the divine Somaloka where the lord stays with Uma.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Atharvaveda established itself thus. It was devoid of Gunas. It placed Mahesvara, Sadasiva as the first among the deities. Though the great Atman, Siva is devoid of activities. It established Sadasiva for the purpase of activities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Atharvaveda established itself thus. It was devoid of Gunas. It placed Mahesvara, Sadasiva as the first among the deities. Though the great Atman, Siva is devoid of activities. It established Sadasiva for the purpase of activities.…

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य कारणं कर्ता नादिरन्तस्तथान्तरम् । न कर्म करणं वापि नाकार्यं कार्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: na tasya kāraṇaṃ kartā nādirantastathāntaram | na karma karaṇaṃ vāpi nākāryaṃ kāryameva ca
verses.translation: He who reaches above there in the Unmana world does not return. Sand and Santyatita are all-pervasive among the Kalas. Among the five Brahmans it is Purusa and Isana. There is the head of the Linga, the most excellent among the parts, where the sole Niskala Siva shall be invoked
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reaches above there in the Unmana world does not return. Sand and Santyatita are all-pervasive among the Kalas. Among the five Brahmans it is Purusa and Isana. There is the head of the Linga, the most excellent among the parts, where the sole Niskala Siva shall be invoked

verses.sanskrit: नास्य बन्धुरबन्धुर्वा नियन्ता प्रेरकोऽपि वा । न पतिर्न गुरुस्त्राता नाधिको न समस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nāsya bandhurabandhurvā niyantā prerako'pi vā | na patirna gurustrātā nādhiko na samastathā
verses.translation: Among the Tattvas it is the greater Tattva than Bindu, Nada and Sakti. It is greater than the greatest and in reality a non-Tattva. It transcends the three causes..It is beyond Maya the cause of agitation. It is beyond Ananta, the Suddhavidya, Mahesvara, Sadasiva the great lord of all lores. It is beyond the lord who has mantras for his body, who is accompanied by all Saktis, who has five faces and ten arms and who is both Sakala and Niskala. Beyond even that, beyond the Bindu, the half moon, the moon, the

verses.sanskrit: न जन्ममरणे तस्य न काङ्क्षितमकाङ्क्षितम् । न विधिर्न निषेधश्च न मुक्तिर्न च बन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: na janmamaraṇe tasya na kāṅkṣitamakāṅkṣitam | na vidhirna niṣedhaśca na muktirna ca bandhanam
verses.translation: Rgveda said again — "The state of wakefulness is being mentioned by me whereby I perpetually express the Atmatattva". Yajurveda said— "The state of dream is being mentioned by me because the Vidya that has transformed itself into objects of enjoyments is to be known through me." Samaveda said: — ''What is called sound slumber is being mentioned wholly by me through Siva that is my meaning and Tamasic in form. Atharvaveda said:--"What is called the fourth stage and what is beyond the fourth is expressed by me." The three which are of the nature of the path are ter¬ med Siva, Vidya, Atman. Their state of three attributes is attainable through the Vedas and shall be purified by him who wishes for Siva's region. What is called Turiya, beyond the path is the greatest region of salvation. That which is beyond it is the purifier of this path because of its attribute¬ less state. The Nada is the measurer of both. The end of Nada has me for its Atman. Hence the supreme lord is the chief in view of freedom from my topics. Whatever object is there whether compounded or separated, they call as the meaning of Pranava in view of the association of the Gunas. Therefore, this single-syllabled Brahman is the expression of all meanings.
verses.wordMeaning: Rgveda said again — "The state of wakefulness is being mentioned by me whereby I perpetually express the Atmatattva".…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rgveda said again — "The state of wakefulness is being mentioned by me whereby I perpetually express the Atmatattva".…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति यद्यदकल्याणं तत्तदस्य कदाचन । कल्याणं सकलं चास्ति परमात्मा शिवो यतः
verses.transliteration: nāsti yadyadakalyāṇaṃ tattadasya kadācana | kalyāṇaṃ sakalaṃ cāsti paramātmā śivo yataḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, at the outset Siva creates the universe saying "Om". Siva is Pranava and Pranava is Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, at the outset Siva creates the universe saying "Om". Siva is Pranava and Pranava is Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स शिवः सर्वमेवेदमधिष्ठाय स्वशक्तिभिः । अप्रच्युतः स्वतो भावः स्थितः स्थाणुरतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sa śivaḥ sarvamevedamadhiṣṭhāya svaśaktibhiḥ | apracyutaḥ svato bhāvaḥ sthitaḥ sthāṇurataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: What more reason can be advanced for the installa¬ tion of Linga than that Linga of Vis ves vara has been installed by Siva too?
verses.commentary: Sense: What more reason can be advanced for the installa¬ tion of Linga than that Linga of Vis ves vara has been installed by Siva too?
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवेनाधिष्ठितं यस्मात् जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । सर्वरूपः स्मृतः शर्वस्तथा ज्ञात्वा न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: śivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ yasmāt jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | sarvarūpaḥ smṛtaḥ śarvastathā jñātvā na muhyati
verses.translation: Hence by all means one shall instal the phallic or the bodily image of Siva for his welfare here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence by all means one shall instal the phallic or the bodily image of Siva for his welfare here and hereafter.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो रुद्रो नमस्तस्मै पुरुषः सत्परो महान् । हिरण्यबाहुर्भगवान् हिरण्यपतिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śarvo rudro namastasmai puruṣaḥ satparo mahān | hiraṇyabāhurbhagavān hiraṇyapatirīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Bhutas with the sense-organs merge into this at the bidding of Siva, He is Lingin since he commands the

verses.sanskrit: अम्बिकापतिरीशानः पिनाकी वृषवाहनः । एको रुद्रः परं ब्रह्म पुरुषः कृष्णपिङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: ambikāpatirīśānaḥ pinākī vṛṣavāhanaḥ | eko rudraḥ paraṃ brahma puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ
verses.translation: Since the Linga can do nothing by itself with¬ out being commanded by Siva, since the dissolution of the universe born of it is only within it, this constitutes the state of being Linga in Siva and not due to any other reason. The Linga is the body of Siva and Siva because it is presided over by them.
verses.wordMeaning: Since the Linga can do nothing by itself with¬ out being commanded by Siva, since the dissolution of the universe born of it is only within it, this constitutes the state of being Linga in Siva and not due to any other reason.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the Linga can do nothing by itself with¬ out being commanded by Siva, since the dissolution of the universe born of it is only within it, this constitutes the state of being Linga in Siva and not due to any other reason.…

verses.sanskrit: बालाग्रमात्रो हृन्मध्ये विचिन्त्यो दहरान्तरे । हिरण्यकेशः पद्माक्षो ह्यरुणस्ताम्र एव च
verses.transliteration: bālāgramātro hṛnmadhye vicintyo daharāntare | hiraṇyakeśaḥ padmākṣo hyaruṇastāmra eva ca
verses.translation: Since they arc pure it is their body only in a secondary sense. That is the great Sakti of Siva the great Atman. Sakti at the behest of Siva gives birth to mobile and immobile beings. One cannot describe the glory of the Linga, even in hundreds of years, by which Brahma and Visnu were deluded at the outset.
verses.wordMeaning: Since they arc pure it is their body only in a secondary sense. That is the great Sakti of Siva the great Atman. Sakti at the behest of Siva gives birth to mobile and immobile beings. One cannot describe the glory of the Linga, even in hundreds of years,…

verses.sanskrit: योऽवसर्पत्यसौ देवो नीलग्रीवो हिरण्मयः । सौम्योऽघोरस्तथा मिश्रश्चाक्षारश्चामृतोऽव्ययः
verses.transliteration: yo'vasarpatyasau devo nīlagrīvo hiraṇmayaḥ | saumyo'ghorastathā miśraścākṣāraścāmṛto'vyayaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly when the universe was in the state of dissolution, Visnu lying on his couch in the waters went into deep slumber. He lay comfoi tably asleep. Brahma the grandfather of the worlds casually went there. He saw the lotus-eyed Visnu sleeping undisturbedly. Deluded by the Maya of Siva, Brahma said to Vi?nu.

verses.sanskrit: स पुंविशेषः परमो भगवानन्तकान्तकः । चेतनाचेतनोन्मुक्तः प्रपञ्चाच्च परात्परः
verses.transliteration: sa puṃviśeṣaḥ paramo bhagavānantakāntakaḥ | cetanācetanonmuktaḥ prapañcācca parātparaḥ
verses.translation: "Who are you? Tell me". o saying he hit Vinu angrily and wakened him. Struck by the blow of his hand Vinu woke up in a trice and got up from his bed. He saw Brahma there. Vinu though infuriated within addressed him politely.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are you? Tell me". o saying he hit Vinu angrily and wakened him. Struck by the blow of his hand Vinu woke up in a trice and got up from his bed. He saw Brahma there. Vinu though infuriated within addressed him politely.

verses.sanskrit: शिवेनातिशयत्वेन ज्ञानैश्वर्ये विलोकिते । लोकेशातिशयत्वेन स्थितं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: śivenātiśayatvena jñānaiśvarye vilokite | lokeśātiśayatvena sthitaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "O dear son, whence have you come? Why are you agitated? Tell me." On hearing the words of Vi?nu, in¬ dicative of his lordly attitude Brahma felt irritated due to his Rajasic qualities and spoke again. "Why do you address me as "dear son" like a preceptor calling his disciple? Don't you know that I am the lord. This universe is my creation. After dividing myself into three, I create, protect and annihi¬ late. There is none in the universe who has created me." When thus addressed Visnu said to Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear son, whence have you come? Why are you agitated? Tell me." On hearing the words of Vi?nu, in¬ dicative of his lordly attitude Brahma felt irritated due to his Rajasic qualities and spoke again.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिसर्गप्रसूतानां ब्रह्मणां शास्त्रविस्तरम् । उपदेष्टा स एवादौ कालावच्छेदवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pratisargaprasūtānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ śāstravistaram | upadeṣṭā sa evādau kālāvacchedavartinām
verses.translation: *T am the primordial creator of this universe,
verses.commentary: Sense: *T am the primordial creator of this universe,

verses.sanskrit: कालावच्छेदयुक्तानां गुरूणामप्यसौ गुरुः । सर्वेषामेव सर्वेशः कालावच्छेदवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: kālāvacchedayuktānāṃ gurūṇāmapyasau guruḥ | sarveṣāmeva sarveśaḥ kālāvacchedavarjitaḥ
verses.translation: A verbal dispute between Brahma and Visnu arose thus. Thereafter a terrible fight ensued causing horripilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: A verbal dispute between Brahma and Visnu arose thus. Thereafter a terrible fight ensued causing horripilation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धा स्वाभाविकी तस्य शक्तिः सर्वातिशायिनी । ज्ञानमप्रतिमं नित्यं वपुरत्यन्तनिर्मिलम्
verses.transliteration: śuddhā svābhāvikī tasya śaktiḥ sarvātiśāyinī | jñānamapratimaṃ nityaṃ vapuratyantanirmilam
verses.translation: Brahma took the form of a swan with wings all round and went up assiduously with the speed of the mind or wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma took the form of a swan with wings all round and went up assiduously with the speed of the mind or wind.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्यमप्रतिद्वन्द्वं सुखमात्यन्तिकं बलम् । तेजःप्रभावो वीर्यं च क्षमा कारुण्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryamapratidvandvaṃ sukhamātyantikaṃ balam | tejaḥprabhāvo vīryaṃ ca kṣamā kāruṇyameva ca
verses.translation: Vijnu, the Atman of the universe, assumed the form of a Boar resembling a mass of coHyrium and went downwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vijnu, the Atman of the universe, assumed the form of a Boar resembling a mass of coHyrium and went downwards.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिपूर्णस्य सर्गाद्यैर्नात्मनोऽस्ति प्रयोजनम् । परानुग्रह एवास्य फलं सर्वस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: paripūrṇasya sargādyairnātmano'sti prayojanam | parānugraha evāsya phalaṃ sarvasya karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thus hastening down for a thousand years he did not have even a glimpse of the root of Linga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus hastening down for a thousand years he did not have even a glimpse of the root of Linga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवो वाचकस्तस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः । शिवरुद्रादिशब्दानां प्रणवो हि परः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: praṇavo vācakastasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ | śivarudrādiśabdānāṃ praṇavo hi paraḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly the weary Vi§nu with dejected mind due to the great distress quickly rose up from below.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the weary Vi§nu with dejected mind due to the great distress quickly rose up from below.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शम्भोः प्रणववाच्यस्य भवनात्तज्जपादपि । या सिद्धिः सा परा प्राप्या भवत्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: śambhoḥ praṇavavācyasya bhavanāttajjapādapi | yā siddhiḥ sā parā prāpyā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: When they met each other again they were com¬ pletely perplexed and stared at each other with a smile of shame. Deluded by the Maya of Siva they did not know whtt to do or what not to do.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they met each other again they were com¬ pletely perplexed and stared at each other with a smile of shame. Deluded by the Maya of Siva they did not know whtt to do or what not to do.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवमाहुरागमपारगाः । वाच्यवाचकयोरैक्यं मन्यमाना मनस्विनः
verses.transliteration: tasmādekākṣaraṃ devamāhurāgamapāragāḥ | vācyavācakayoraikyaṃ manyamānā manasvinaḥ
verses.translation: They stood in front, at the back and on cither side of it and bowed. They began to think "Of what nature is this?"
verses.commentary: Sense: They stood in front, at the back and on cither side of it and bowed. They began to think "Of what nature is this?"
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्य मात्राः समाख्याताश्चतस्रो वेदमूर्द्धनि । अकारश्चाप्युकारश्च मकारो नाद इत्यपि
verses.transliteration: asya mātrāḥ samākhyātāścatasro vedamūrddhani | akāraścāpyukāraśca makāro nāda ityapi
verses.translation: Then there manifested the single-syllabled Brahman in the characteristic way o a word with its sound *Om*. It expressed the Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then there manifested the single-syllabled Brahman in the characteristic way o a word with its sound *Om*. It expressed the Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अकारं बह्वृचं प्राहुरुकारो यजुरुच्यते । मकारः सामनादोऽस्य श्रुतिराथर्वणी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: akāraṃ bahvṛcaṃ prāhurukāro yajurucyate | makāraḥ sāmanādo'sya śrutirātharvaṇī smṛtā
verses.translation: Then that syllable divided itself into four, the three Matras — A, U, Ma and half the Matra thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that syllable divided itself into four, the three Matras — A, U, Ma and half the Matra thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अकारश्च महाबीजं रजः स्रष्टा चतुर्मुखः । उकारः प्रकृतिर्योनिः सत्त्वं पालयिता हरिः
verses.transliteration: akāraśca mahābījaṃ rajaḥ sraṣṭā caturmukhaḥ | ukāraḥ prakṛtiryoniḥ sattvaṃ pālayitā hariḥ
verses.translation: The letter 'a' attached itself to the southern side of the blazing Lihga, the letter "u" to the north and the letter "ma" to its middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The letter 'a' attached itself to the southern side of the blazing Lihga, the letter "u" to the north and the letter "ma" to its middle.

verses.sanskrit: मकारः पुरुषो बीजं तमः संहारको हरः । नादः परः पुमानीशो निर्गुणो निष्क्रियः शिवः
verses.transliteration: makāraḥ puruṣo bījaṃ tamaḥ saṃhārako haraḥ | nādaḥ paraḥ pumānīśo nirguṇo niṣkriyaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: The half a Matra sound was heard on the head of the Lihga. Even when the great syllable Pranava was divided, the two gods did not understand the purpose of division. I'hc unrnanifest Pranava then underwent the change into the Veda.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तिसृभिरेवेदं मात्राभिर्निखिलं त्रिधा । अभिधाय शिवात्मानं बोधयत्यर्धमात्रया
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tisṛbhirevedaṃ mātrābhirnikhilaṃ tridhā | abhidhāya śivātmānaṃ bodhayatyardhamātrayā

It established the sixtyfour Gunas and AiiSvarya of the cosmic intellect Anima etc. Thus with the ten topics the universe was pervaded by the Rgveda.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्परं नापरमस्ति किञ्चिद्- यस्मान्नाणीयो न ज्यायोऽस्ति किञ्चित् । वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो दिवि तिष्ठत्येक- स्तेनेदं पूर्णं पुरुषेण सर्वम्
verses.transliteration: yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcid- yasmānnāṇīyo na jyāyo'sti kiñcit | vṛkṣa iva stabdho divi tiṣṭhatyeka- stenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam
verses.translation: Then the Yajurveda established itself in the ten ways: Sattva among the attributes, Visnu the first among the deities in the rites also, sustenance in the worlds and the firmament, Vidya in the three principles, Prati§tha in the paths of Kala and Vamadeva in the five Brahmans, the parts of Liiiga and Yoni in the three causes. The Prakfta was established in accordance with the Aisvarya. Hence the universe is of the form of the Yajurveda.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Yajurveda established itself in the ten ways: Sattva among the attributes, Visnu the first among the deities in the rites also, sustenance in the worlds and the firmament, Vidya in the three principles, Prati§tha in the paths of Kala and Vamadeva in the five Brahmans,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The deity Brahmatman is born of the right limb of Mahesa. Visnu came out of the left. So he is termed Vidya. Nilarudra came out of the heart of Siva and is called Siva. Brahmii is the activiser of creation, Visnu the enchanter maintains sustenance. Rudra who controls both is the initiator of annihilation. The three are the causes of the universe. Siva, the source of the three, is the great cause.

Siva, the source of the three, is the great cause.
