verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वकथनम् । उपमन्युरुवच । शक्तिः स्वाभविकी तस्य विद्या विश्वविलक्षणा । एकानेकस्य रूपेण भाति भानोरिव प्रभा
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.2.7. saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | śivatattvakathanam | upamanyuruvaca | śaktiḥ svābhavikī tasya vidyā viśvavilakṣaṇā | ekānekasya rūpeṇa bhāti bhānoriva prabhā
verses.translation: The Liiiga stood in between you two in order to enlighten you when you became mutually inimical due to ■your Rajasic quality and could not understand this meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Liiiga stood in between you two in order to enlighten you when you became mutually inimical due to ■your Rajasic quality and could not understand this meaning.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ताः शक्तयो यस्या इच्छाज्ञानक्रियादयः । मायाद्याश्चाभवन्वह्नोर्विस्फुलिङ्गा यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: anantāḥ śaktayo yasyā icchājñānakriyādayaḥ | māyādyāścābhavanvahnorvisphuliṅgā yathā tathā
verses.translation: When thus implored lord Siva became highly delighted. He blessed the two deities and spoke to them smilingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: When thus implored lord Siva became highly delighted. He blessed the two deities and spoke to them smilingly.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवेश्वराद्या हि विद्याविद्येश्वरादयः । अभवन् पुरुषाश्चास्याः प्रकृतिश्च परात्परा
verses.transliteration: sadāśiveśvarādyā hi vidyāvidyeśvarādayaḥ | abhavan puruṣāścāsyāḥ prakṛtiśca parātparā
verses.translation: Selecting an auspicious spot he shall test the ground. He shall perform the ten forms of service.
verses.commentary: Sense: Selecting an auspicious spot he shall test the ground. He shall perform the ten forms of service.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महदादिविशेषान्तास्त्वजाद्याश्चापि मूर्तयः । यच्चान्यदस्ति तत्सर्वं तस्याः कार्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: mahadādiviśeṣāntāstvajādyāścāpi mūrtayaḥ | yaccānyadasti tatsarvaṃ tasyāḥ kāryaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Beginning with the east, the eight Murtis shall be placed all round or only the four Murtis Brahma and others in the four quarters. The conductors of the Homa shall possess good mastery of the Vedas. They shall be accompa¬ nied by those who can repeat the mantras well. The pre¬ ceptor shall perform the main Homa either in the north-east or in the west. He shall use all tlie seven materials in order. The other branmins shall perform half or one-fourth of the number of sacrifices that the preceptor performs.
verses.wordMeaning: Beginning with the east, the eight Murtis shall be placed all round or only the four Murtis Brahma and others in the four quarters. The conductors of the Homa shall possess good mastery of the Vedas. They shall be accompa¬ nied by those who can repeat the mantras well.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning with the east, the eight Murtis shall be placed all round or only the four Murtis Brahma and others in the four quarters. The conductors of the Homa shall possess good mastery of the Vedas. They shall be accompa¬ nied by those who can repeat the mantras well.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा शक्तिः सर्वगा सूक्ष्मा प्रबोधानन्दरूपिणी । शक्तिमानुच्यते देवः शिवः शीतांशुभूषणः
verses.transliteration: sā śaktiḥ sarvagā sūkṣmā prabodhānandarūpiṇī | śaktimānucyate devaḥ śivaḥ śītāṃśubhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The priest and the sculptor shall be given half or one-fourth of what the preceptor is given and half of that shall be given to the other brahmins in accordance with one's capacity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The priest and the sculptor shall be given half or one-fourth of what the preceptor is given and half of that shall be given to the other brahmins in accordance with one's capacity.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वेद्यः शिवः शिवा विद्या प्रज्ञा चैव श्रुतिः स्मृतिः । धृतिरेषा स्थितिर्निष्ठा ज्ञानेच्छाकर्मशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: vedyaḥ śivaḥ śivā vidyā prajñā caiva śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ | dhṛtireṣā sthitirniṣṭhā jñānecchākarmaśaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Then either an image of the bull made of gold or a bunch of KiKa grass shall be placed in the pit. Brahma- Sila shall be purified with water and clay, also with Pafica- gavya, with pure water. It shall be placed in the pit after smearing it with sandal. Repeating the names of the nine Saktis, the rite of Karanyasa shall be performed. Then in accordance with the injunctions prescribed in Saivite scriptures he shall strew the minerals — Haritala and others along with scents, seeds and medicinal herbs.
verses.wordMeaning: Then either an image of the bull made of gold or a bunch of KiKa grass shall be placed in the pit. Brahma- Sila shall be purified with water and clay, also with Pafica- gavya, with pure water. It shall be placed in the pit after smearing it with sandal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then either an image of the bull made of gold or a bunch of KiKa grass shall be placed in the pit. Brahma- Sila shall be purified with water and clay, also with Pafica- gavya, with pure water. It shall be placed in the pit after smearing it with sandal.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञा चैव परं ब्रह्म द्वे विद्ये च परापरे । शुद्धविद्या शुद्धकला सर्वं शक्तिकृतं यतः
verses.transliteration: ājñā caiva paraṃ brahma dve vidye ca parāpare | śuddhavidyā śuddhakalā sarvaṃ śaktikṛtaṃ yataḥ
verses.translation: The Lihga shall be installed on the Brahmasila and dripped in the exudations of trees. To the east and the north the aloe wood shall be placed repeating the basic mantra. Repeating the basic mantra of iSakti the nave shall be joined to the articles of fixation and joining. The place shall be purified. Arghya shall be given and flowers offered. Thereafter the screen shall be drawn all round.
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga shall be installed on the Brahmasila and dripped in the exudations of trees. To the east and the north the aloe wood shall be placed repeating the basic mantra. Repeating the basic mantra of iSakti the nave shall be joined to the articles of fixation and joining.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga shall be installed on the Brahmasila and dripped in the exudations of trees. To the east and the north the aloe wood shall be placed repeating the basic mantra. Repeating the basic mantra of iSakti the nave shall be joined to the articles of fixation and joining.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: माया च प्रकृतिर्जीवो विकारो विकृतिस्तथा । असच्च सच्च यत्किञ्चित्तया सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: māyā ca prakṛtirjīvo vikāro vikṛtistathā | asacca sacca yatkiñcittayā sarvamidaṃ tatam
verses.translation: The ablution and other rites of the Lihga shall be performed in a befitting manner. After taking it away from the place of rest the Kalasas shall be placed in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ablution and other rites of the Lihga shall be performed in a befitting manner. After taking it away from the place of rest the Kalasas shall be placed in order.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा देवी मायया सर्वं ब्रह्माण्डं सचराचरम् । मोहयत्यप्रयत्नेन मोचयत्यपि लीलया
verses.transliteration: sā devī māyayā sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram | mohayatyaprayatnena mocayatyapi līlayā
verses.translation: The great worship begins with the worship of the ten water-jars. In the water inside the Sivakumbha, the thumb and the ring-finger shall be jointly inserted with the Siva mantras. Water thu» taken shall be sprinkled. The knower of mantra shall touch the north-east side of the Lihga. He shall perform the Nyasas of lakti, Vidya and Vidyesas in order at the root of the lahga. He shall perform the ablution of the Linga with auspicious water.
verses.wordMeaning: The great worship begins with the worship of the ten water-jars. In the water inside the Sivakumbha, the thumb and the ring-finger shall be jointly inserted with the Siva mantras. Water thu» taken shall be sprinkled.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The great worship begins with the worship of the ten water-jars. In the water inside the Sivakumbha, the thumb and the ring-finger shall be jointly inserted with the Siva mantras. Water thu» taken shall be sprinkled.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनया सह सर्वेशः सप्तविंशप्रकारया । विश्वं व्याप्य स्थितस्तस्मात् मुक्तिरत्र प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: anayā saha sarveśaḥ saptaviṃśaprakārayā | viśvaṃ vyāpya sthitastasmāt muktiratra pravartate
verses.translation: Thus they call me "Om". What was thus mentioned by the Atharva was repeated by the Rgveda, Yajurveda, S-imaveda and thousands of their Sakhas. Even when the Vcdiis themselves declaied thus clearly through their own mouths it was not comprehended by the two who thought it were a dream.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus they call me "Om". What was thus mentioned by the Atharva was repeated by the Rgveda, Yajurveda, S-imaveda and thousands of their Sakhas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus they call me "Om". What was thus mentioned by the Atharva was repeated by the Rgveda, Yajurveda, S-imaveda and thousands of their Sakhas.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुमुक्षवः पुरा केचिन्मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । संशयाविष्टमनसो विस्मृशन्ति यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: mumukṣavaḥ purā kecinmunayo brahmavādinaḥ | saṃśayāviṣṭamanaso vismṛśanti yathātatham
verses.translation: In order to enlighten them and to remove their ignorance the statement of the Vedas was inscribed in the Lihga too.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to enlighten them and to remove their ignorance the statement of the Vedas was inscribed in the Lihga too.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किं कारणं कुतो जाता जीवामः केन वा वयम् । कुत्रास्माकं सम्प्रतिष्ठा केन वाधिष्ठिता वयम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ kuto jātā jīvāmaḥ kena vā vayam | kutrāsmākaṃ sampratiṣṭhā kena vādhiṣṭhitā vayam
verses.translation: On seeing that inscribed in the Lihga due to the favour of iSiva the deities were pacified and enlightened.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that inscribed in the Lihga due to the favour of iSiva the deities were pacified and enlightened.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: केन वर्तामहे शश्वत्सुखेष्वन्येषु चानिशम् । अविलङ्घ्या च विश्वस्य व्यवस्था केन वा कृता
verses.transliteration: kena vartāmahe śaśvatsukheṣvanyeṣu cāniśam | avilaṅghyā ca viśvasya vyavasthā kena vā kṛtā
verses.translation: On realising the mode of evolution and dissolu¬ tion, the nature of the six pathways and the splendour be¬ yond the Purusa possessing brilliance, the Brahman than whom there is nothing greater, Niskala Siva Isvara, who is the perpetual lord of this universe consisting of Pasu and Pasa who has no fear from any quarter, who is stable without in¬ crease or decrease who pervades within and without who has neither inside nor outside, who is unsurpassable, who is different from all the worlds, who is indefinable, incompre¬ hensible, inexpressible, who is essentially in the form of brilliance, who is quite delighted and ever ri.sing, who is the abode of auspiciousness and who is accompanied by a
verses.wordMeaning: On realising the mode of evolution and dissolu¬ tion, the nature of the six pathways and the splendour be¬ yond the Purusa possessing brilliance, the Brahman than whom there is nothing greater, Niskala Siva Isvara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On realising the mode of evolution and dissolu¬ tion, the nature of the six pathways and the splendour be¬ yond the Purusa possessing brilliance, the Brahman than whom there is nothing greater, Niskala Siva Isvara,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कालस्य भावो नियतिर्यदृच्छा नात्र युज्यते । भूतानि योनिः पुरुषो योगी चैषां परोऽथवा
verses.transliteration: kālasya bhāvo niyatiryadṛcchā nātra yujyate | bhūtāni yoniḥ puruṣo yogī caiṣāṃ paro'thavā
verses.translation: VVhether 1 am ignorant or not, O lord, I was created by you at the beginning. Whose fault is it that 1 have been under such a delusion?
verses.commentary: Sense: VVhether 1 am ignorant or not, O lord, I was created by you at the beginning. Whose fault is it that 1 have been under such a delusion?
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अचेतनत्वात्कालादेश्चेतनत्वेऽपि चात्मनः । सुखदुःखानि भूतत्वादनीशत्वाद्विचार्यते
verses.transliteration: acetanatvātkālādeścetanatve'pi cātmanaḥ | sukhaduḥkhāni bhūtatvādanīśatvādvicāryate
verses.translation: Let my ignorance alone. O lord, when you are near who can fearlessly talk about his duty or that of' others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let my ignorance alone. O lord, when you are near who can fearlessly talk about his duty or that of' others.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्ध्यानयोगानुगताः प्रपश्यन् शक्तिमैश्वरीम् । पाशविच्छेदिकां साक्षान्निगूढां स्वगुणैर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: taddhyānayogānugatāḥ prapaśyan śaktimaiśvarīm | pāśavicchedikāṃ sākṣānnigūḍhāṃ svaguṇairbhṛśam
verses.translation: O lord of gods, our mutual wrangle too is splen¬ didly auspicious since it has yielded us the benefit of paying our homage to the feet of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of gods, our mutual wrangle too is splen¬ didly auspicious since it has yielded us the benefit of paying our homage to the feet of the lord.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तया विच्छिन्नपाशास्ते सर्वकारणकारणम् । शक्तिमन्तं महादेवमपश्यन्दिव्यचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: tayā vicchinnapāśāste sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | śaktimantaṃ mahādevamapaśyandivyacakṣuṣā
verses.translation: O lord, I do not have the power of eulogising you in the manner befitting your greatness. On the other hand if the devotees keep quiet in front of the lord it is merely a transgression of virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I do not have the power of eulogising you in the manner befitting your greatness. On the other hand if the devotees keep quiet in front of the lord it is merely a transgression of virtue.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यः कारणान्यशेषाणि कालात्मसहितानि च । अप्रमेयोऽनया शक्त्या सकलं योऽधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kāraṇānyaśeṣāṇi kālātmasahitāni ca | aprameyo'nayā śaktyā sakalaṃ yo'dhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: That you were the primordial cause we forgot due to your Maya. I am deluded, puffed up and have hence been chastised by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: That you were the primordial cause we forgot due to your Maya. I am deluded, puffed up and have hence been chastised by you.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसादयोगेन योगेन परमेण च । दृष्टेन भक्तियोगेन दिव्यां गतिमवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasādayogena yogena parameṇa ca | dṛṣṭena bhaktiyogena divyāṃ gatimavāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: O Siva, they call you a great lord, the destroyer of the distress of the frightened. I entreat you to forgive my transgression thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, they call you a great lord, the destroyer of the distress of the frightened. I entreat you to forgive my transgression thus.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सह तथा शक्त्या हृदि पश्यन्ति ये शिवम् । तेषां शाश्वतिकी शान्तिर्नैतरेषामिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsaha tathā śaktyā hṛdi paśyanti ye śivam | teṣāṃ śāśvatikī śāntirnaitareṣāmiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Dear Brahma, dear Visnu, you had been deluded by my Maya. You were proud of yoifr lordship and became mutually inimical.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dear Brahma, dear Visnu, you had been deluded by my Maya. You were proud of yoifr lordship and became mutually inimical.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि शक्तिमतः शक्त्या विप्रयोगोऽस्ति जातुचित् । तस्मात् शक्तेः शक्तिमतस्तादात्म्यान्निर्वृतिर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: na hi śaktimataḥ śaktyā viprayogo'sti jātucit | tasmāt śakteḥ śaktimatastādātmyānnirvṛtirdvayoḥ
verses.translation: You did not cease even when the wrangle turned into an actual fight. Therefore the creative activity of you both, the cause of the universe, was broken in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: You did not cease even when the wrangle turned into an actual fight. Therefore the creative activity of you both, the cause of the universe, was broken in the middle.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रमो विवक्षितो नूनं विमुक्तौ ज्ञानकर्मणोः । प्रसादे सति सा मूर्तिर्यस्मात्करतले स्थिता
verses.transliteration: kramo vivakṣito nūnaṃ vimuktau jñānakarmaṇoḥ | prasāde sati sā mūrtiryasmātkaratale sthitā
verses.translation: In order to turn you back fiom your mutual
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to turn you back fiom your mutual
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवो वा दानवो वापि पशुर्वा विहगोऽपि वा । कीरो वाथ कृमिर्वापि मुच्यते तत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: devo vā dānavo vāpi paśurvā vihago'pi vā | kīro vātha kṛmirvāpi mucyate tatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Formerly at my command the compendiums on knowledge were given to you in order to proclaim your causal nature. The jewel of Mantras consisting of five syllab¬ les has been imparted to you. But you forgot all this. I shall give you everything as before together with my behest since without that you cannot create or sustain.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly at my command the compendiums on knowledge were given to you in order to proclaim your causal nature. The jewel of Mantras consisting of five syllab¬ les has been imparted to you. But you forgot all this.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly at my command the compendiums on knowledge were given to you in order to proclaim your causal nature. The jewel of Mantras consisting of five syllab¬ les has been imparted to you. But you forgot all this.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थो जायमानो वा बालो वा तरुणोऽपि वा । वृद्धो वा म्रियमाणो वा स्वर्गस्थो वाथ नारकी
verses.transliteration: garbhastho jāyamāno vā bālo vā taruṇo'pi vā | vṛddho vā mriyamāṇo vā svargastho vātha nārakī
verses.translation: After telling Visnu and Brahma thus, the lord gave them the principal mantra along with the Jnanasarii- hita. After obtaining the divine order of the lord, the jewel of Mantra pregnant with meaning, and the Kalas, they prostrated at tlie feet of the lord. They stood without fear, rhey were overpowered by joy.
verses.wordMeaning: After telling Visnu and Brahma thus, the lord gave them the principal mantra along with the Jnanasarii- hita. After obtaining the divine order of the lord, the jewel of Mantra pregnant with meaning, and the Kalas, they prostrated at tlie feet of the lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After telling Visnu and Brahma thus, the lord gave them the principal mantra along with the Jnanasarii- hita. After obtaining the divine order of the lord, the jewel of Mantra pregnant with meaning, and the Kalas, they prostrated at tlie feet of the lord.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पतितो वापि धर्मात्मा पण्डितो मूढ एव वा । प्रसादे तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: patito vāpi dharmātmā paṇḍito mūḍha eva vā | prasāde tatkṣaṇādeva mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime there was a great wonder. As if by magic the Liiiga of the god became invisible. Due to the sudden snapping of love they lamented and cried loudly, saying to each other 'O what a false thing has befal¬ len us, Pondering over the unimaginable prowess of Siva they became free from pain.
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime there was a great wonder. As if by magic the Liiiga of the god became invisible. Due to the sudden snapping of love they lamented and cried loudly, saying to each other 'O what a false thing has befal¬ len us,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime there was a great wonder. As if by magic the Liiiga of the god became invisible. Due to the sudden snapping of love they lamented and cried loudly, saying to each other 'O what a false thing has befal¬ len us,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयोग्यानां च कारुण्याद्भक्तानां परमेश्वरः । प्रसीदति न सन्देहो विगृह्य विविधान् मलान्
verses.transliteration: ayogyānāṃ ca kāruṇyādbhaktānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | prasīdati na sandeho vigṛhya vividhān malān
verses.translation: Becoming great friends once again and embracing each other the leading deities returned to their duties in the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Becoming great friends once again and embracing each other the leading deities returned to their duties in the universe.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसदादेव सा भक्तिः प्रसादो भक्तिसम्भवः । अवस्थाभेदमुत्प्रेक्ष्य विद्वांस्तत्र न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: prasadādeva sā bhaktiḥ prasādo bhaktisambhavaḥ | avasthābhedamutprekṣya vidvāṃstatra na muhyati
verses.translation: Ever since that Indra and other gods, Asuras, sages, men, serpents as well as women instal Lihgas in accordance with the injunctions and worship him in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since that Indra and other gods, Asuras, sages, men, serpents as well as women instal Lihgas in accordance with the injunctions and worship him in the Lihga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादपूर्विका येयं भुक्तिमुक्तिविधायिनी । नैव सा शक्यते प्राप्तुं नरैरेकेन जन्मना
verses.transliteration: prasādapūrvikā yeyaṃ bhuktimuktividhāyinī | naiva sā śakyate prāptuṃ narairekena janmanā
verses.translation: O lord, I wish to hear the rules governing the installation of the phallic and the embodied image of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I wish to hear the rules governing the installation of the phallic and the embodied image of Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनेकजन्मसिद्धानां श्रौतस्मार्तानुवर्तिनाम् । विरक्तानां प्रबुद्धानां प्रसीदति महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: anekajanmasiddhānāṃ śrautasmārtānuvartinām | viraktānāṃ prabuddhānāṃ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On a day in the bright half of the month not un¬ favourable to him, the devotee shall make the Lihga of the proper size in the manner prescribed in the Saivite scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: On a day in the bright half of the month not un¬ favourable to him, the devotee shall make the Lihga of the proper size in the manner prescribed in the Saivite scriptures.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ने सति देवेशे पशौ तस्मिन् प्रवर्तते । अस्ति नाथो ममेत्यल्पा भक्तिर्बुद्धिपुरःसरा
verses.transliteration: prasanne sati deveśe paśau tasmin pravartate | asti nātho mametyalpā bhaktirbuddhipuraḥsarā
verses.translation: But before the actual performance of this service Vinayaka shall be worshipped. After purifying the spot and other rites he shall take the Lihga to the ablution chamber.
verses.commentary: Sense: But before the actual performance of this service Vinayaka shall be worshipped. After purifying the spot and other rites he shall take the Lihga to the ablution chamber.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसा विविधैः शैवैर्धर्मैः संयुज्यते नरः । तत्त्रयोगे तदभ्यासस्ततो भक्तिः परा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tapasā vividhaiḥ śaivairdharmaiḥ saṃyujyate naraḥ | tattrayoge tadabhyāsastato bhaktiḥ parā bhavet
verses.translation: With a gold rod dipped into the solution of saffron he shall draw the characteristic signs in the prescribed manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a gold rod dipped into the solution of saffron he shall draw the characteristic signs in the prescribed manner.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परया च तया भक्त्या प्रसादो लभ्यते परः । प्रसादात्सर्वपाशेभ्यो मुक्तिर्मुक्तस्य निर्वृतिः
verses.transliteration: parayā ca tayā bhaktyā prasādo labhyate paraḥ | prasādātsarvapāśebhyo muktirmuktasya nirvṛtiḥ
verses.translation: He shall purify the Lihga along with its axle or nave with a solution of eight or five types of clay as well as with Paheagavya.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall purify the Lihga along with its axle or nave with a solution of eight or five types of clay as well as with Paheagavya.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अल्पभावोऽपि यो मर्त्यः सोऽपि जन्मत्रयात्परम् । न योनियन्त्रपीडायै भवेन्नैवात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: alpabhāvo'pi yo martyaḥ so'pi janmatrayātparam | na yoniyantrapīḍāyai bhavennaivātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping the Lihga along with its pedestal he shall take it to the water-receptacle and keep the Lihga immersed in water.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the Lihga along with its pedestal he shall take it to the water-receptacle and keep the Lihga immersed in water.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गानङ्गा च या सेवा सा भक्तिरिति कथ्यते । सा पुनर्भिद्यते त्रेधा मनोवाक्कायसाधनैः
verses.transliteration: sāṅgānaṅgā ca yā sevā sā bhaktiriti kathyate | sā punarbhidyate tredhā manovākkāyasādhanaiḥ
verses.translation: In a well-constructed shed for the immersion of Lihga, pure and well-embellished with festoons and screens all round, surrounded by garlands of Darbha grass, an inner shed for the seat shall be arranged in the middle. The seat may be metallic or wooden in the shape of a lotus. On the eight quarters the representations of the eight elephants of the quarters shall be made. Eight pots shall be kept for the eight quardians of the guarters. Eight auspicious things shall be kept ready. The guardians of the quarters shall be duly worshipped. Subhadra, Vibhadra,.Sunanda and Vinanda the gatekeepers of the lord shall be worshipped in the four quarters. The Linga shall be bathed and worshipped with the pedestal. It shall be tied with two cloths and bunches of Kusa grass. It.shall be brought to the Pitha and laid
verses.wordMeaning: In a well-constructed shed for the immersion of Lihga, pure and well-embellished with festoons and screens all round, surrounded by garlands of Darbha grass, an inner shed for the seat shall be arranged in the middle. The seat may be metallic or wooden in the shape of a lotus.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In a well-constructed shed for the immersion of Lihga, pure and well-embellished with festoons and screens all round, surrounded by garlands of Darbha grass, an inner shed for the seat shall be arranged in the middle. The seat may be metallic or wooden in the shape of a lotus.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिवरूपादिचिन्ता या सा सेवा मानसी स्मृता । जपादिर्वाचिकी सेवा कर्मपूजादि कायिकी
verses.transliteration: śivarūpādicintā yā sā sevā mānasī smṛtā | japādirvācikī sevā karmapūjādi kāyikī
verses.translation: Thereafter the linga shall be worshipped after due ceremonies as before. After worship it shall be carried along the path of festivities to the place of rest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the linga shall be worshipped after due ceremonies as before. After worship it shall be carried along the path of festivities to the place of rest.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सेयं त्रिसाधना सेवा शिवधर्मश्च कथ्यते । स तु पञ्चविधः प्रोक्तः शिवेन परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: seyaṃ trisādhanā sevā śivadharmaśca kathyate | sa tu pañcavidhaḥ proktaḥ śivena paramātmanā
verses.translation: A mystical lotus-diagram shall be drawn in the north-east on a spot of ground well-smeared. The water vessel of Siva shall be purified. Siva shall be invoked and worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mystical lotus-diagram shall be drawn in the north-east on a spot of ground well-smeared. The water vessel of Siva shall be purified. Siva shall be invoked and worshipped.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपः कर्म जपो ध्यानं ज्ञानं चेति समासतः । कर्म लिङ्गार्चनाद्यं च तपश्चान्द्रायणादिकम्
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ karma japo dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ ceti samāsataḥ | karma liṅgārcanādyaṃ ca tapaścāndrāyaṇādikam
verses.translation: In the middle of the altar he shall make a dia¬ gram of white lotus in accordance with injunctions and to the west of it he shall draw the lotus of Gandika.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of the altar he shall make a dia¬ gram of white lotus in accordance with injunctions and to the west of it he shall draw the lotus of Gandika.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जपस्त्रिधा शिवाभ्यासश्चिन्ता ध्यानं शिवस्य तु । शिवागमोक्तं यज्ज्ञानं तदत्र ज्ञानमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: japastridhā śivābhyāsaścintā dhyānaṃ śivasya tu | śivāgamoktaṃ yajjñānaṃ tadatra jñānamucyate
verses.translation: The bed shall be made of silken cloth or other cloth fresh from the loom, before being washed or of flowers or Darbha grass. After making it up he shall put golden flower in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bed shall be made of silken cloth or other cloth fresh from the loom, before being washed or of flowers or Darbha grass. After making it up he shall put golden flower in it.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकण्ठेन शिवेनोक्तं शिवायै च शिवागमः । शिवाश्रितानां कारुण्याच्छ्रेयसामेकसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: śrīkaṇṭhena śivenoktaṃ śivāyai ca śivāgamaḥ | śivāśritānāṃ kāruṇyācchreyasāmekasādhanam
verses.translation: The Linga shall be brought there with the songs and music vocal and instrumental. It shall be wrapped in two red cloths and a bunch of Kusa grass along with the nave and laid down as before. A lotus shall be drawn in front and in its petals he shall place the water-pots of Vidyesa and the vessel VardhanI of Siva. The excellent brahmins shall perform Homa all round the three lotuses.
verses.wordMeaning: The Linga shall be brought there with the songs and music vocal and instrumental. It shall be wrapped in two red cloths and a bunch of Kusa grass along with the nave and laid down as before.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Linga shall be brought there with the songs and music vocal and instrumental. It shall be wrapped in two red cloths and a bunch of Kusa grass along with the nave and laid down as before.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विवर्धयेद्भक्तिं शिवे परमकारणे । त्यजेच्च विषयासङ्गं श्रेयोऽर्थी मतिमान्नरः
verses.transliteration: tasmādvivardhayedbhaktiṃ śive paramakāraṇe | tyajecca viṣayāsaṅgaṃ śreyo'rthī matimānnaraḥ
verses.translation: Or the preceptor alone shall perform the main sacrifice. He ahall perform the Purnahuti and then
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the preceptor alone shall perform the main sacrifice. He ahall perform the Purnahuti and then
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: After performing the Nyasa rite of the five Kalas he shall meditate on the blazing Linga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke §iva and liva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Nyasa rite of the five Kalas he shall meditate on the blazing Linga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke §iva and liva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: After performing the Nyasa rite of the five Kalas he shall meditate on the blazing Linga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke §iva and liva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Nyasa rite of the five Kalas he shall meditate on the blazing Linga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke §iva and liva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वज्ञाने व्यासावतारवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छामि शिवेन परिभाषितम् । वेदसारं शिवज्ञानं स्वाश्रितानां विमुक्तये
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.2.8. aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | śivatattvajñāne vyāsāvatāravarṇanam | kṛṣṇa uvāca | bhagavan śrotumicchāmi śivena paribhāṣitam | vedasāraṃ śivajñānaṃ svāśritānāṃ vimuktaye
verses.translation: At the rite of Laksanoddhara the eyes shall be shut. The immersion shall be performed with the idols placed prone on the bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the rite of Laksanoddhara the eyes shall be shut. The immersion shall be performed with the idols placed prone on the bed.

verses.sanskrit: अभक्तानामबुद्धीनामयुक्तानामगोचरम् । अर्थैर्दशर्धैः संयुक्तं गूढमप्राज्ञनिन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: abhaktānāmabuddhīnāmayuktānāmagocaram | arthairdaśardhaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ gūḍhamaprājñaninditam
verses.translation: The lord shall be dismissed ritualistically from the idol that is mutilated, after due worship but retained in the heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord shall be dismissed ritualistically from the idol that is mutilated, after due worship but retained in the heart.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमकृतैर्धर्मैर्विपरीतं क्वचित्समम् । वेदात् षडङ्गादुद्धृत्य साङ्ख्याद्योगाच्च कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramakṛtairdharmairviparītaṃ kvacitsamam | vedāt ṣaḍaṅgāduddhṛtya sāṅkhyādyogācca kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: The six Angas are in brief Asana, Pranasarhrodha, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana and Samadhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The six Angas are in brief Asana, Pranasarhrodha, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana and Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: शतकोटिप्रमाणेन विस्तीर्णं ग्रन्थसङ्ख्यया । कथितं परमेशेन तत्र पूजा कथं प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: śatakoṭipramāṇena vistīrṇaṃ granthasaṅkhyayā | kathitaṃ parameśena tatra pūjā kathaṃ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: Urine, phlegm and faeces are reduced in quan¬ tity. Ability to eat much and to breathe slowly, lightness of the body, ability to walk fast, enthusiasm, clearness of voice and tone, destruction of ailments, strength, brilliance, comeli¬ ness of features, courage, intelligence, youthfulness, firmness and all round pleasure these are the symptoms. verses.sanskrit: कस्याधिकारः पूजादौ ज्ञानयोगादयः कथम् । तत्सर्वं विस्तरादेव वक्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: kasyādhikāraḥ pūjādau jñānayogādayaḥ katham | tatsarvaṃ vistarādeva vaktumarhasi suvrata
verses.translation: All his obstacles and hindrances perish gradually if the Yogin practises the excellent Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: All his obstacles and hindrances perish gradually if the Yogin practises the excellent Yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । शैवं सङ्क्षिप्य वेदोक्तं शिवेन परिभाषितम् । स्तुतिनिन्दादिरहितं सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | śaivaṃ saṅkṣipya vedoktaṃ śivena paribhāṣitam | stutinindādirahitaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam
verses.translation: Illusion is misconception. Misery is of three types. That due to ignorance is spiritual misery. The misery that affects the body due to previous actions is the corporal misery. Thunderbolt, missiles, poisons are the miseries caused by divine intercession.
verses.commentary: Sense: Illusion is misconception. Misery is of three types. That due to ignorance is spiritual misery. The misery that affects the body due to previous actions is the corporal misery. Thunderbolt, missiles, poisons are the miseries caused by divine intercession.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुप्रसादजं दिव्यमनायासेन मुक्तिदम् । कथयिष्ये समासेन तस्य शक्यो न विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: guruprasādajaṃ divyamanāyāsena muktidam | kathayiṣye samāsena tasya śakyo na vistaraḥ
verses.translation: When the obstacles subside and the Yogin is absor¬ bed in Yoga the signs begin to appear. They are divine in¬ dications of the imminent success.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the obstacles subside and the Yogin is absor¬ bed in Yoga the signs begin to appear. They are divine in¬ dications of the imminent success.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सिसृक्षया पुराव्यक्ताच्छिवः स्थाणुर्महेश्वरः । सत्कार्यकारणोपेतः स्वयमाविरभूत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sisṛkṣayā purāvyaktācchivaḥ sthāṇurmaheśvaraḥ | satkāryakāraṇopetaḥ svayamāvirabhūtprabhuḥ
verses.translation: The Upasargas are — Pratibha, Sravana, Varta, Darsana, Asvada and Vedana. They are the Siddhis at the expense of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Upasargas are — Pratibha, Sravana, Varta, Darsana, Asvada and Vedana. They are the Siddhis at the expense of Yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जनयामास च तदा ऋषिर्विश्वाधिकः प्रभुः । देवानां प्रथमं देवं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: janayāmāsa ca tadā ṛṣirviśvādhikaḥ prabhuḥ | devānāṃ prathamaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatim
verses.translation: The correct perception of objects whether they be subtle, hidden by other objects, or of bygone days, or situated far off, or not yet born is called Pratibha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The correct perception of objects whether they be subtle, hidden by other objects, or of bygone days, or situated far off, or not yet born is called Pratibha.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मापि पितरं देवं जायमानं न्यवैक्षत । तं जायमानं जनको देवः प्रापश्यदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: brahmāpi pitaraṃ devaṃ jāyamānaṃ nyavaikṣata | taṃ jāyamānaṃ janako devaḥ prāpaśyadājñayā
verses.translation: The installation of the idol with the rites for the temple is better than without those rites. If the idols are immersed in the water of the vessel the mantras shall be repeated touching the chest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The installation of the idol with the rites for the temple is better than without those rites. If the idols are immersed in the water of the vessel the mantras shall be repeated touching the chest.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टो रुद्रेण देवोऽसावसृजद्विश्वमीश्वरः । वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थां च चकार स पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭo rudreṇa devo'sāvasṛjadviśvamīśvaraḥ | varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca cakāra sa pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Affluent people shall first build the temple and then perform the installation. If the devotee is not affluent he shall perform the installation of the phallic or the em¬ bodied image and shall afterwards build the Siva temple in accordance with his capacity. Now I shall mention the mode of worship at the house and the excellent installation rite.
verses.wordMeaning: Affluent people shall first build the temple and then perform the installation. If the devotee is not affluent he shall perform the installation of the phallic or the em¬ bodied image and shall afterwards build the Siva temple in accordance with his capacity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Affluent people shall first build the temple and then perform the installation. If the devotee is not affluent he shall perform the installation of the phallic or the em¬ bodied image and shall afterwards build the Siva temple in accordance with his capacity.…

verses.sanskrit: सोमं ससर्ज यज्ञार्थे सोमाद् घौः समजायत । धरा च वह्निः सूर्यश्च यज्ञो विष्णुः शचीपतिः
verses.transliteration: somaṃ sasarja yajñārthe somād ghauḥ samajāyata | dharā ca vahniḥ sūryaśca yajño viṣṇuḥ śacīpatiḥ
verses.translation: The idol shall be small in size but endowed with all traits. In the northern transit of the sun ( Jan-July) on an auspicious day in the bright half of the month, the altar shall be made in an auspicious spot. He shall draw the diagram of the lotus in as before. The idol shall be purified with water and clay as before. An auspicious scat shall be kept in the north. Covering the Liiiga with flowers he shall place it on the seat. Flowers and leaves shall be strewn and

verses.commentary: Sense: The idol shall be small in size but endowed with all traits. In the northern transit of the sun ( Jan-July) on an auspicious day in the bright half of the month, the altar shall be made in an auspicious spot. He shall draw the diagram of the lotus in as before.…

verses.sanskrit: ते चान्ये च सुरा रुद्रं रुद्राध्यायेन तुष्टुवुः । प्रसन्नवदनस्तस्थौ देवानामग्रतः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: te cānye ca surā rudraṃ rudrādhyāyena tuṣṭuvuḥ | prasannavadanastasthau devānāmagrataḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: After placing the flower on its top it shall be sprinkled with the water from the Proksani vessel. Again it shall be worshipped along with the proclamation of victory. With the water from the vessels of the four deities from Iana to Vidya he shall bathe the Linga with the basic mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: After placing the flower on its top it shall be sprinkled with the water from the Proksani vessel. Again it shall be worshipped along with the proclamation of victory.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After placing the flower on its top it shall be sprinkled with the water from the Proksani vessel. Again it shall be worshipped along with the proclamation of victory.…

verses.sanskrit: अपहृत्य स्वलीलार्थं तेषां ज्ञानं महेश्वरः । तमपृच्छंस्ततो देवाः को भवानिति मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: apahṛtya svalīlārthaṃ teṣāṃ jñānaṃ maheśvaraḥ | tamapṛcchaṃstato devāḥ ko bhavāniti mohitāḥ
verses.translation: The rite of the Nyasa of the five Kalas shall be performed and the worship too as before. The devotee shall worship the lord and the goddess there everyday.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of the Nyasa of the five Kalas shall be performed and the worship too as before. The devotee shall worship the lord and the goddess there everyday.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽब्रवीद्भगवान् रुद्रो ह्यहमेकः पुरातनः । आसं प्रथममेवाहं वर्तामि च सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: so'bravīdbhagavān rudro hyahamekaḥ purātanaḥ | āsaṃ prathamamevāhaṃ vartāmi ca surottamāḥ
verses.translation: Or only one vessel shall be placed with the basic mantra and everything fixed therein. Every other rite shall be performed as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or only one vessel shall be placed with the basic mantra and everything fixed therein. Every other rite shall be performed as before.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यामि च मत्तोऽन्यो व्यतिरिक्तो न कश्चन । अहमेव जगत् सर्वं तर्पयामि स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyāmi ca matto'nyo vyatirikto na kaścana | ahameva jagat sarvaṃ tarpayāmi svatejasā
verses.translation: Too much unclean Linga shall at first be puri¬ fied and reinstalled. Unclean Lingas shall be sprinkled with holy water. Slightly unclean Lingas too shall be worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: Too much unclean Linga shall at first be puri¬ fied and reinstalled. Unclean Lingas shall be sprinkled with holy water. Slightly unclean Lingas too shall be worshipped.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मत्तोऽधिकः समो नास्ति मां यो वेद स मुच्यते । इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधत्त सः
verses.transliteration: matto'dhikaḥ samo nāsti māṃ yo veda sa mucyate | ityuktvā bhagavān rudrastatraivāntaradhatta saḥ
verses.translation: Bana Lingas may be installed at will, for they have been already consecrated by Siva himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bana Lingas may be installed at will, for they have been already consecrated by Siva himself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यन्तस्तमीशानं स्तुवन्तश्चैव सामभिः । व्रतं पाशुपतं कृत्वा त्वथर्वशिरसि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: apaśyantastamīśānaṃ stuvantaścaiva sāmabhiḥ | vrataṃ pāśupataṃ kṛtvā tvatharvaśirasi sthitam
verses.translation: Such other Lingas may also be installed. In regard to a Svayambhu, a divine or a sage Linga the same is the procedure. If there is no pedestal, a pedestal shall be assigned and the rite of Proksana performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such other Lingas may also be installed. In regard to a Svayambhu, a divine or a sage Linga the same is the procedure. If there is no pedestal, a pedestal shall be assigned and the rite of Proksana performed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भस्मसञ्छन्नसर्वाङ्गा बभूवुरमरास्तदा । अथ तेषां प्रसादार्थं पशूनां पतिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bhasmasañchannasarvāṅgā babhūvuramarāstadā | atha teṣāṃ prasādārthaṃ paśūnāṃ patirīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Burnt, weakened or partially broken Linga shall be thrown in a pond or a river. That which can be joined shall be joined and installed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Burnt, weakened or partially broken Linga shall be thrown in a pond or a river. That which can be joined shall be joined and installed.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सगणश्चोमया सार्धं सान्निध्यमकरोत्प्रभुः । यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासा योगिनो दग्धकिल्बिषाः
verses.transliteration: sagaṇaścomayā sārdhaṃ sānnidhyamakarotprabhuḥ | yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsā yogino dagdhakilbiṣāḥ
verses.translation: Samproksana rite is as follows: — The lord is ritualistically dismissed from the Linga as before, bathed
verses.commentary: Sense: Samproksana rite is as follows: — The lord is ritualistically dismissed from the Linga as before, bathed
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हृदि पश्यन्ति तं देवं ददृशुर्देवपुङ्गवाः । यामाहुः परमां शक्तिमीश्वरेच्छानुवर्तिनीम्
verses.transliteration: hṛdi paśyanti taṃ devaṃ dadṛśurdevapuṅgavāḥ | yāmāhuḥ paramāṃ śaktimīśvarecchānuvartinīm
verses.translation: Holding flowers and Darbha, the hand shall be placed on the top of the Linga five times and the basic mantra shall be repeated hundred and eight times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Holding flowers and Darbha, the hand shall be placed on the top of the Linga five times and the basic mantra shall be repeated hundred and eight times.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तामपश्यन् महेशस्य वामतो वामलोचनाम् । ये विनिर्धूतसंसाराः प्राप्ताः शैवं परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tāmapaśyan maheśasya vāmato vāmalocanām | ye vinirdhūtasaṃsārāḥ prāptāḥ śaivaṃ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: Beginning from the head and ending with the pedestal, the Linga shall be touched repeating the basic mantra. The great worship shall be performed after invoking the lord as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning from the head and ending with the pedestal, the Linga shall be touched repeating the basic mantra. The great worship shall be performed after invoking the lord as before.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नित्यसिद्धाश्च ये वान्ये ते च दृष्टा गणेश्वराः । अथ तं तुष्टुवुर्देवा देव्या सह महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nityasiddhāśca ye vānye te ca dṛṣṭā gaṇeśvarāḥ | atha taṃ tuṣṭuvurdevā devyā saha maheśvaram
verses.translation: Everything mentioned succinctly by your holiness with regard to knowledge, rites and activities, after taking out the essence, has been heard by me. It is as sacred as the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything mentioned succinctly by your holiness with regard to knowledge, rites and activities, after taking out the essence, has been heard by me. It is as sacred as the Vedas.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रैर्माहेश्वरैर्दिव्यैः श्रोतैः पौराणिकैरपि । देवोऽपि देवानालोक्य घृणया वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: stotrairmāheśvarairdivyaiḥ śrotaiḥ paurāṇikairapi | devo'pi devānālokya ghṛṇayā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Now I wish to hear about Yoga which is very diffi¬ cult to achieve along with its authorisation, ancillaries, injunc¬ tions and purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I wish to hear about Yoga which is very diffi¬ cult to achieve along with its authorisation, ancillaries, injunc¬ tions and purpose.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टोऽस्मीत्याह सुप्रीतः स्वभावमधुरां गिरम् । अथ सुप्रीतमनसं प्रणिपत्य वृषध्वजम् । अर्थमहत्तमं देवाः पप्रच्छुरिममादरात्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo'smītyāha suprītaḥ svabhāvamadhurāṃ giram | atha suprītamanasaṃ praṇipatya vṛṣadhvajam | arthamahattamaṃ devāḥ papracchurimamādarāt
verses.translation: If death were to overtake before, it can be averted without resorting to the practices of penance, by taking recourse to Yoga whereby the man avoids becoming a self- » killer. Hence it behoves you to mention factually the different types of Yoga and their relative importance, cause, time and procedure.
verses.wordMeaning: If death were to overtake before, it can be averted without resorting to the practices of penance, by taking recourse to Yoga whereby the man avoids becoming a self- » killer. Hence it behoves you to mention factually the different types of Yoga and their relative importance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If death were to overtake before, it can be averted without resorting to the practices of penance, by taking recourse to Yoga whereby the man avoids becoming a self- » killer. Hence it behoves you to mention factually the different types of Yoga and their relative importance,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । भगवन् केन मार्गेण पूजनीयोऽसि भूतले । कस्याधिकारः पूजायां वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ | bhagavan kena mārgeṇa pūjanīyo'si bhūtale | kasyādhikāraḥ pūjāyāṃ vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: O Krfna, the question has been pertinently put by you
verses.commentary: Sense: O Krfna, the question has been pertinently put by you
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः सस्मितमालोक्य देवीं देववरो हरः । स्वरूपं दर्शयामास घोरं सूर्यात्मकं परम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sasmitamālokya devīṃ devavaro haraḥ | svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa ghoraṃ sūryātmakaṃ param
verses.translation: The concentration of the mind without disturbances, on the expressed meaning of the mantra along with the practice of the mantra is mantrayoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The concentration of the mind without disturbances, on the expressed meaning of the mantra along with the practice of the mantra is mantrayoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्यगुणोपेतं सर्वतेजोमयं परम् । शक्तिभिर्मूर्तिभिश्चाङ्गैर्ग्रहैर्देवैश्च संवृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaiśvaryaguṇopetaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ param | śaktibhirmūrtibhiścāṅgairgrahairdevaiśca saṃvṛtam
verses.translation: Wherein the universe with all its parts is medi¬ tated upon it is called Abhavayoga since in that the existent object is not seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherein the universe with all its parts is medi¬ tated upon it is called Abhavayoga since in that the existent object is not seen.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अष्टबाहुं चतुर्वक्त्रमर्द्धनारीकमद्भुतम् । दृष्ट्वैवमद्भुताकारं देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭabāhuṃ caturvaktramarddhanārīkamadbhutam | dṛṣṭvaivamadbhutākāraṃ devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ
verses.translation: In brief the Yoga is of eight or six ancillaries. The eight ancillaries are Yama, Niyama, Asana Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana and Samadhi as mentioned by the wise.
verses.commentary: Sense: In brief the Yoga is of eight or six ancillaries. The eight ancillaries are Yama, Niyama, Asana Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana and Samadhi as mentioned by the wise.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्वा दिवाकरं देवं देवीं चैव निशाकरम् । पञ्चभूतानि शेषाणि तन्मयं च चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: buddhvā divākaraṃ devaṃ devīṃ caiva niśākaram | pañcabhūtāni śeṣāṇi tanmayaṃ ca carācaram
verses.translation: The definitions of all these separately have been mentioned in SivaSastra and other Saivite scriptures, especially K.amika etc. They are mentioned in YogaSastras and Puranas also. Yama is the observance of restraints such as non¬ violence, non-stealing, abstention from sexual intercourse and non-acceptance of monetary gifts. The five constitute the subdivisions of Yama.
verses.wordMeaning: The definitions of all these separately have been mentioned in SivaSastra and other Saivite scriptures, especially K.amika etc. They are mentioned in YogaSastras and Puranas also. Yama is the observance of restraints such as non¬ violence, non-stealing,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The definitions of all these separately have been mentioned in SivaSastra and other Saivite scriptures, especially K.amika etc. They are mentioned in YogaSastras and Puranas also. Yama is the observance of restraints such as non¬ violence, non-stealing,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा नमश्चक्रुस्तस्मै चार्घ्यं प्रदाय वै
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā namaścakrustasmai cārghyaṃ pradāya vai
verses.translation: Then through the other nostril the external air is inhaled and the body is filled up like the bellows. It is Puraka (Inhaling).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then through the other nostril the external air is inhaled and the body is filled up like the bellows. It is Puraka (Inhaling).
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सिन्दूरवर्णाय सुमण्डलाय सुवर्णवर्णाभरणाय तुभ्यम् । पद्माभनेत्राय सपङ्कजाय ब्रह्मेन्द्रनारायणकारणाय
verses.transliteration: sindūravarṇāya sumaṇḍalāya suvarṇavarṇābharaṇāya tubhyam | padmābhanetrāya sapaṅkajāya brahmendranārāyaṇakāraṇāya
verses.translation: He does not breathe out the internal or breathe in the external air. He remains steady like the filled-up jar. It is called Kumbhaka (Retention).
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not breathe out the internal or breathe in the external air. He remains steady like the filled-up jar. It is called Kumbhaka (Retention).
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुरत्नपूर्णं ससुवर्णतोयं सुकुङ्कुमाद्यं सकुशं सपुष्पम् । प्रदत्तमादाय सहेमपात्रं प्रशस्तमर्घ्यं भगवन् प्रसीद
verses.transliteration: suratnapūrṇaṃ sasuvarṇatoyaṃ sukuṅkumādyaṃ sakuśaṃ sapuṣpam | pradattamādāya sahemapātraṃ praśastamarghyaṃ bhagavan prasīda
verses.translation: The three, Recaka etc. shall not be done hurriedly or slowly. The practiser of Yoga shall adopt them grad¬ ually with restraint.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three, Recaka etc. shall not be done hurriedly or slowly. The practiser of Yoga shall adopt them grad¬ ually with restraint.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय सगणायादिहेतवे । रुद्राय विष्णवे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे सूर्यमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sagaṇāyādihetave | rudrāya viṣṇave tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe sūryamūrtaye
verses.translation: The practice of Recaka shall begin with the purification of the veins and conclude with its voluntary exit as mentioned in the Yoganuasana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The practice of Recaka shall begin with the purification of the veins and conclude with its voluntary exit as mentioned in the Yoganuasana.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यः शिवं मण्डले सौरे सम्पूज्यैव समाहितः । प्रातर्मध्याह्नसायाह्ने प्रदद्यादर्घ्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śivaṃ maṇḍale saure sampūjyaiva samāhitaḥ | prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne pradadyādarghyamuttamam
verses.translation: Uttama has three strokes and its duration is thirty- six Matras. Uttara is the Pranayama that causes perspiration and trembling of the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttama has three strokes and its duration is thirty- six Matras. Uttara is the Pranayama that causes perspiration and trembling of the body.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणमेद्वा पठेदेतान् शलोकान् श्रुतिमुखानिमान् । न तस्य दुर्ल्लभं किञ्चिद्भक्तश्चेन्मुच्यते दृढम्
verses.transliteration: praṇamedvā paṭhedetān śalokān śrutimukhānimān | na tasya durllabhaṃ kiñcidbhaktaścenmucyate dṛḍham
verses.translation: The yogin has experiences — the thrill of bliss, horri¬ pilation and shedding of tears. He may prattle. There may be vertigo and senselessness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogin has experiences — the thrill of bliss, horri¬ pilation and shedding of tears. He may prattle. There may be vertigo and senselessness.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादभ्यर्चयेनित्यं शिवमादित्यरूपिणम् । धर्मकामार्थमुक्त्यर्थं मनसा कर्मणा गिरा
verses.transliteration: tasmādabhyarcayenityaṃ śivamādityarūpiṇam | dharmakāmārthamuktyarthaṃ manasā karmaṇā girā
verses.translation: The duration of Pranfiyama shall be increased in accordance with the Matras and strokes. The veins shall be necessarily purified.
verses.commentary: Sense: The duration of Pranfiyama shall be increased in accordance with the Matras and strokes. The veins shall be necessarily purified.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवान् समालोक्य मण्डलस्थो महेश्वरः । सर्वागमोत्तरं दत्त्वा शास्त्रमन्तरधाद्धरः
verses.transliteration: atha devān samālokya maṇḍalastho maheśvaraḥ | sarvāgamottaraṃ dattvā śāstramantaradhāddharaḥ
verses.translation: The vital breaths of the body can be conquered through the mastery over Prana. The vital breaths arc Prana, Apana, Samana, Udana, Vyana, Naga, Kurma, Kykara, Devadatta and Dhanahjaya. That which causes the move¬ ment is called Praa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The vital breaths of the body can be conquered through the mastery over Prana. The vital breaths arc Prana, Apana, Samana, Udana, Vyana, Naga, Kurma, Kykara, Devadatta and Dhanahjaya. That which causes the move¬ ment is called Praa.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पूजाधिकारोऽयं ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशामिति । ज्ञात्वा प्रणम्य देवेशं देवा जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra pūjādhikāro'yaṃ brahmakṣatraviśāmiti | jñātvā praṇamya deveśaṃ devā jagmuryathāgatam
verses.translation: It burns off all defects. It preserves the body of practisers. When the Prana is mastered the symptoms arc manifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: It burns off all defects. It preserves the body of practisers. When the Prana is mastered the symptoms arc manifest.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालेन महता तस्मिन् शास्त्रे तिरोहिते । भर्तारं परिपप्रच्छ तदङ्कस्था महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: atha kālena mahatā tasmin śāstre tirohite | bhartāraṃ paripapraccha tadaṅkasthā maheśvarī
verses.translation: The vital airs of the body, PrSna, ApSna and others, ten in number, play a distinct role in the general yogic exercises. The practices of these airs constitute an important feature of Sivayoga too. The present context describes the various processes in regulating the function of vital airs as a part of Sivayoga.
verses.wordMeaning: The vital airs of the body, PrSna, ApSna and others, ten in number, play a distinct role in the general yogic exercises. The practices of these airs constitute an important feature of Sivayoga too.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The vital airs of the body, PrSna, ApSna and others, ten in number, play a distinct role in the general yogic exercises. The practices of these airs constitute an important feature of Sivayoga too.…

verses.sanskrit: तया सञ्चोदितो देवो देव्या चन्द्रविभूषणः । अवदत्करमुद्धृत्य शास्त्रं सर्वागमोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tayā sañcodito devo devyā candravibhūṣaṇaḥ | avadatkaramuddhṛtya śāstraṃ sarvāgamottaram
verses.translation: The total withdrawal of the sense-organs operat¬ ing in their respective objects is called Pratyahara. The sense-organs are the mind etc. They are capable of accord¬ ing heaven and hell. When restrained they yield heaven, when let loose they are hellish. Hence the intelligent man who seeks happiness shall have recourse to perfect knowledge and detachment, and lift up his soul through his own soul after carefully restraining the horses of his sense- organs.
verses.wordMeaning: The total withdrawal of the sense-organs operat¬ ing in their respective objects is called Pratyahara. The sense-organs are the mind etc. They are capable of accord¬ ing heaven and hell. When restrained they yield heaven, when let loose they are hellish.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तितं च तल्लोके नियोगात्परमेष्ठिनः । मयागस्त्येन गुरुणा दधीचेन महर्षिणा
verses.transliteration: pravartitaṃ ca talloke niyogātparameṣṭhinaḥ | mayāgastyena guruṇā dadhīcena maharṣiṇā
verses.translation: In brief, what is called Dharana is the fixation of the mind in a spot. The spot is Siva alone and nothing else. The Dharana shall take place when the mind is establi¬ shed in the spot for a stipulated duration and when it does not swerve from the target. The initial stability of the mind is generated through Dharana. Hence one shall endow the mind with fortitude by the practice of Dharana.
verses.wordMeaning: In brief, what is called Dharana is the fixation of the mind in a spot. The spot is Siva alone and nothing else. The Dharana shall take place when the mind is establi¬ shed in the spot for a stipulated duration and when it does not swerve from the target.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमप्यवतीर्योर्व्यां युगावर्तेषु शूलधृक् । स्वाश्रितानां विमुक्त्यर्थं कुरुते ज्ञानसन्ततिम्
verses.transliteration: svayamapyavatīryorvyāṃ yugāvarteṣu śūladhṛk | svāśritānāṃ vimuktyarthaṃ kurute jñānasantatim
verses.translation: The root 'Dhyai' means to contemplate. Frequ¬ ent contemplation of Siva with an unconfounded mind is called Dhyana. It is a series of visions in the mind that is fixed on the object of meditation to the exclusion of other visions. Eschewing everything else, Siva, the cause of auspici¬ ousness, the great lord of the gods, shall be meditated upon. Thus concludes the Atharvaveda. Similarly the great god¬ dess Siva shall be meditated upon. In the Vedas Siva and Siva are mentioned as pervading all living beings. In the Smrtis and Sastras they are mentioned as present everywhere and awakened always. They are omniscient. They shall always be meditated upon in different forms. There are two benefits accruing from meditation, the first one being freedom from other visions and the second one the acquisition of Siddhis, Anima etc.

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुः सत्यो भार्गवश्च ह्यङ्गिराः सविता द्विजाः । मृत्युः शतक्रतुर्धीमान् वसिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuḥ satyo bhārgavaśca hyaṅgirāḥ savitā dvijāḥ | mṛtyuḥ śatakraturdhīmān vasiṣṭho munipuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: The knower of Yoga shall practise Yoga with the know¬ ledge of four things — the meditator, the meditation, the ob¬ ject of meditation and the benefit of meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of Yoga shall practise Yoga with the know¬ ledge of four things — the meditator, the meditation, the ob¬ ject of meditation and the benefit of meditation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतस्त्रिधामा च त्रिवृतो मुनिपुङ्गवः । शततेजाः स्वयं धर्मो नारायण इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sārasvatastridhāmā ca trivṛto munipuṅgavaḥ | śatatejāḥ svayaṃ dharmo nārāyaṇa iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: Dharana extends upto the twclve-petalled lotus of the heart. Dhyana is the fixation of the Dharana in the twelve-petalled lotus. When Dhyana extends to the twelvc- petalled lotus it is called Samadhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharana extends upto the twclve-petalled lotus of the heart. Dhyana is the fixation of the Dharana in the twelve-petalled lotus. When Dhyana extends to the twelvc- petalled lotus it is called Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरक्षश्चारुणिर्धीमांस्तथा चैव कृतञ्जयः । मामतेयो भरद्वाजो गौतमः कविरुत्तमः
verses.transliteration: svarakṣaścāruṇirdhīmāṃstathā caiva kṛtañjayaḥ | māmateyo bharadvājo gautamaḥ kaviruttamaḥ
verses.translation: Fixing the mind in the object of meditation he shall see it steadily. The Yogin thus like the fire extinguished is absorbed in Samadhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fixing the mind in the object of meditation he shall see it steadily. The Yogin thus like the fire extinguished is absorbed in Samadhi.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वाचःस्रवा मुनिस्साक्षात्तथा सूक्ष्मायणिः शुचिः । तृणबिन्दुर्मुनिः कृष्णः शक्तिः शाक्तेय उत्तरः
verses.transliteration: vācaḥsravā munissākṣāttathā sūkṣmāyaṇiḥ śuciḥ | tṛṇabindurmuniḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaktiḥ śākteya uttaraḥ
verses.translation: He neither hears nor smells nor prattles nor sees nor feels the touch. The mind does not think.
verses.commentary: Sense: He neither hears nor smells nor prattles nor sees nor feels the touch. The mind does not think.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जातूकर्ण्यो हरिः साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । व्यासावतारान् शृण्वन्तु कल्पयोगेश्वरान् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: jātūkarṇyo hariḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ | vyāsāvatārān śṛṇvantu kalpayogeśvarān kramāt
verses.translation: Nor does he identify with anything external. Nor is it bound like the inanimate log of wood. A person whose Atman has thus merged into Siva is called Samadhistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nor does he identify with anything external. Nor is it bound like the inanimate log of wood. A person whose Atman has thus merged into Siva is called Samadhistha.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लैङ्गे व्यासावतारा हि द्वापरान्तेषु सुव्रताः । योगाचार्यावताराश्च तथा शिष्येषु शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: laiṅge vyāsāvatārā hi dvāparānteṣu suvratāḥ | yogācāryāvatārāśca tathā śiṣyeṣu śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Just as the lamp in a windless spot never flickers so also is the Yogin who is Samadhistha, An intelligent man shall not swerve. He shall be steady.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the lamp in a windless spot never flickers so also is the Yogin who is Samadhistha, An intelligent man shall not swerve. He shall be steady.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र विभोः शिष्याश्चत्वारः स्युर्महौजसः । शिष्यास्तेषां प्रशिष्याश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra vibhoḥ śiṣyāścatvāraḥ syurmahaujasaḥ | śiṣyāsteṣāṃ praśiṣyāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: There are ten obstacles in the path of those who practise Yoga; — Idleness, acute ailments, blunder, doubtful¬ ness about the spot, unsteady mind, lack of faith, illusions, miseries, dejectedness and indulgence in sensual objecs.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are ten obstacles in the path of those who practise Yoga; — Idleness, acute ailments, blunder, doubtful¬ ness about the spot, unsteady mind, lack of faith, illusions, miseries, dejectedness and indulgence in sensual objecs.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सम्भावनाल्लोके शैवाज्ञाकरणादिभिः । भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भक्त्या चात्यन्तभाविताः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sambhāvanālloke śaivājñākaraṇādibhiḥ | bhāgyavanto vimucyante bhaktyā cātyantabhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: Idleness affects the body and the mind. Ailments are caused by the imbalance of the Dhatus. They are also due to the defective previous Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Idleness affects the body and the mind. Ailments are caused by the imbalance of the Dhatus. They are also due to the defective previous Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: Vedana is the ability to know the divine touch and the divine smell. All the lords of the worlds beginning with Brahma stand before him and give him many gems and jewels. Words naturally sweet and eloquent function through his mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedana is the ability to know the divine touch and the divine smell. All the lords of the worlds beginning with Brahma stand before him and give him many gems and jewels. Words naturally sweet and eloquent function through his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: Vedana is the ability to know the divine touch and the divine smell. All the lords of the worlds beginning with Brahma stand before him and give him many gems and jewels. Words naturally sweet and eloquent function through his mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedana is the ability to know the divine touch and the divine smell. All the lords of the worlds beginning with Brahma stand before him and give him many gems and jewels. Words naturally sweet and eloquent function through his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । शिवस्य योगावतारवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । युगावर्तेषु सर्वेषु योगाचार्यच्छलेन तु । अवतारान्हि शर्वस्य शिष्यांश्च भगवन् वद
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.2.9. navamo'dhyāyaḥ | śivasya yogāvatāravarṇanam | kṛṣṇa uvāca | yugāvarteṣu sarveṣu yogācāryacchalena tu | avatārānhi śarvasya śiṣyāṃśca bhagavan vada
verses.translation: The Yogic Siddhi pertaining to the earth named 'Pai4aca Pada' consists of eight types of powers, viz., lean¬ ness, bulkiness, infancy, old age, youthfulness, the ability to assume different forms and the ability to collect sveet- smelling scents without any earthly part.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogic Siddhi pertaining to the earth named 'Pai4aca Pada' consists of eight types of powers, viz., lean¬ ness, bulkiness, infancy, old age, youthfulness, the ability to assume different forms and the ability to collect sveet- smelling scents without any earthly part.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । श्वेतः सुतारो मदनः सुहोत्रः कङ्क एव च । लौगाक्षिश्च महामायो जैगीषव्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | śvetaḥ sutāro madanaḥ suhotraḥ kaṅka eva ca | laugākṣiśca mahāmāyo jaigīṣavyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Hence he who abandons the attributes and the pleasures of the gods, Asuras and kings, considering them as worthless as blades of grass acquires the greatest Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence he who abandons the attributes and the pleasures of the gods, Asuras and kings, considering them as worthless as blades of grass acquires the greatest Yogic power.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दधिवाहश्च ऋषभो मुनिरुग्रोऽत्रिरेव च । सुपालको गौतमश्च तथा वेदशिरा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: dadhivāhaśca ṛṣabho munirugro'trireva ca | supālako gautamaśca tathā vedaśirā muniḥ
verses.translation: The Mortis beginning with Brahma and ending with Sadaiva, the eight Murtis beginning with Bhava, the gross Murtis of Siva prescribed in the Saivite scriptures, the terrible, the quiet or the mixture of both shall be meditated upon by the sages without the desire for fruits, and by the experts in meditation.

verses.commentary: Sense: The Mortis beginning with Brahma and ending with Sadaiva, the eight Murtis beginning with Bhava, the gross Murtis of Siva prescribed in the Saivite scriptures, the terrible, the quiet or the mixture of both shall be meditated upon by the sages without the desire for fruits,…
