verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णश्च गुहावासी शिखण्डी चापरः स्मृतः । जटामाली चाट्टहासो दारुको लाङ्गुली तथा
verses.transliteration: gokarṇaśca guhāvāsī śikhaṇḍī cāparaḥ smṛtaḥ | jaṭāmālī cāṭṭahāso dāruko lāṅgulī tathā
verses.translation: If the terrible forms of the lord are meditated upon they shall dispel sins and ailments. If the mixtures of the form are contemplated upon, the effect is often delayed. If the calm and the gentle form is contemplated upon, the effect is neither immediate nor delayed. But the special benefit in the gentle form is salvation, peace and intellect. The Siddhis are achieved gradually. There is no doubt about this.
verses.wordMeaning: If the terrible forms of the lord are meditated upon they shall dispel sins and ailments. If the mixtures of the form are contemplated upon, the effect is often delayed. If the calm and the gentle form is contemplated upon, the effect is neither immediate nor delayed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the terrible forms of the lord are meditated upon they shall dispel sins and ailments. If the mixtures of the form are contemplated upon, the effect is often delayed. If the calm and the gentle form is contemplated upon, the effect is neither immediate nor delayed.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महाकालश्च शूली च दण्डी मुण्डीश एव च । सहिष्णुः सोमशर्मा च लकुलीश्वर एव च
verses.transliteration: mahākālaśca śūlī ca daṇḍī muṇḍīśa eva ca | sahiṣṇuḥ somaśarmā ca lakulīśvara eva ca
verses.translation: Some Yogins perform meditation with the full con¬ viction that Siddhis are immediately acquired by those who remember the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Yogins perform meditation with the full con¬ viction that Siddhis are immediately acquired by those who remember the lord.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एते वाराहकल्पेऽस्मिन् सप्तमस्यान्तरो मनोः । अष्टाविंशतिसङ्ख्याता योगाचार्या युगक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ete vārāhakalpe'smin saptamasyāntaro manoḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyātā yogācāryā yugakramāt
verses.translation: In order to steady the mind some perform medita¬ tion on the gross form. The mind that is fixed on the gross form becomes stable in the subtle form.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to steady the mind some perform medita¬ tion on the gross form. The mind that is fixed on the gross form becomes stable in the subtle form.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिष्याः प्रत्येकमेतेषां चत्वारः शान्तचेतसः । श्वेतादयश्च रुष्यान्तांस्तान् ब्रवीमि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: śiṣyāḥ pratyekameteṣāṃ catvāraḥ śāntacetasaḥ | śvetādayaśca ruṣyāntāṃstān bravīmi yathākramam
verses.translation: He shall observe the steadiness of the mind and frequently meditate. This meditation, they say, has at the
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall observe the steadiness of the mind and frequently meditate. This meditation, they say, has at the
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेताश्वः श्वेतलोहितः । दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश्च ऋचीकः केतुमांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāśvaḥ śvetalohitaḥ | dundubhiḥ śatarūpaśca ṛcīkaḥ ketumāṃstathā
verses.translation: But the intellectual vision by itself without an object shall also function. Therefore the fact is — the Savisaya meditation is on the lord who is conceived as brilliant as the sun. The meditation on the subtle form is Nirvisaya. Savisaya meditation has a definite form in view. Meditation of the formless is the Nirvisaya meditation. The two are called Nirbija and Sabija also. Hence the practiser shall at the outset perform the Savisaya or Sabija meditation and in the end perform Nirbija or Nirvisaya meditation.
verses.wordMeaning: But the intellectual vision by itself without an object shall also function. Therefore the fact is — the Savisaya meditation is on the lord who is conceived as brilliant as the sun. The meditation on the subtle form is Nirvisaya. Savisaya meditation has a definite form in view.…
verses.commentary: Sense: But the intellectual vision by itself without an object shall also function. Therefore the fact is — the Savisaya meditation is on the lord who is conceived as brilliant as the sun. The meditation on the subtle form is Nirvisaya. Savisaya meditation has a definite form in view.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विकोशश्च विकेशश्च विपाशः पाशनाशनः । सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चैव दुर्गमो दुरतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: vikośaśca vikeśaśca vipāśaḥ pāśanāśanaḥ | sumukho durmukhaścaiva durgamo duratikramaḥ
verses.translation: The benefits derived from Pranayama are Santi, Prasanti, DIpti and Prasada. When adversities subside it is called Sunti. Prasanti is the destruction of ignorance both ex¬ ternal and internal. The external and internal illumination is called DIpti. The normal and the healthy state of the intellect is called Prasada. When the intellect is in healthy normal state the internal and external sense-organs too acquire healthy and normal state,
verses.wordMeaning: The benefits derived from Pranayama are Santi, Prasanti, DIpti and Prasada. When adversities subside it is called Sunti. Prasanti is the destruction of ignorance both ex¬ ternal and internal. The external and internal illumination is called DIpti.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The benefits derived from Pranayama are Santi, Prasanti, DIpti and Prasada. When adversities subside it is called Sunti. Prasanti is the destruction of ignorance both ex¬ ternal and internal. The external and internal illumination is called DIpti.…

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारः सनकः सनन्दश्च सनातनः । सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खश्चाण्डज एव च
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandaśca sanātanaḥ | sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhaścāṇḍaja eva ca
verses.translation: The wonderful Yogic Siddhi pertaining to water consists of sixteen powers, viz: — he can stay under water, he can come out of the earth, at his will he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it, wherever he wishes he can let water spring up or he can hold water in the palm of his hand. Whatever he wishes to eat he can transform into juicy substance, he can assume these forms, he can have the body free from cuts and wounds. Over and above these powers he can have the eight powers of the Yogins.
verses.wordMeaning: The wonderful Yogic Siddhi pertaining to water consists of sixteen powers, viz: — he can stay under water, he can come out of the earth, at his will he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The wonderful Yogic Siddhi pertaining to water consists of sixteen powers, viz: — he can stay under water, he can come out of the earth, at his will he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतश्च मेघश्च मेघवाहः सुवाहकः । कपिलश्चासुरिः पञ्चशिखो बाष्कल एव च
verses.transliteration: sārasvataśca meghaśca meghavāhaḥ suvāhakaḥ | kapilaścāsuriḥ pañcaśikho bāṣkala eva ca
verses.translation: The Yogic Siddhi called Taijasa consists of twenty- four types of powers viz: — the ability to create fire from the body, absence of fear of being scorched by the fire, the ability to burn the universe without difficulty, placing of fire in water or in the palms, re-create things burnt in fire, cook food in the mouth, create bodies with the fire and wind and above all these are the sixteen powers of the Apya Yogins.
verses.wordMeaning: The Yogic Siddhi called Taijasa consists of twenty- four types of powers viz: — the ability to create fire from the body, absence of fear of being scorched by the fire, the ability to burn the universe without difficulty, placing of fire in water or in the palms,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogic Siddhi called Taijasa consists of twenty- four types of powers viz: — the ability to create fire from the body, absence of fear of being scorched by the fire, the ability to burn the universe without difficulty, placing of fire in water or in the palms,…

verses.sanskrit: पराशराश्च गर्गश्च भार्गवश्चाङ्गिरास्तथा । बलबन्धुर्निरामित्राः केतुशृङ्गस्तपोधनः
verses.transliteration: parāśarāśca gargaśca bhārgavaścāṅgirāstathā | balabandhurnirāmitrāḥ ketuśṛṅgastapodhanaḥ
verses.translation: The wise know that the Yogic Siddhi called Maruta consists of thirtytwo types of powers viz: — the speed of the mind, the ability to enter the bodies of living beings, to hold weighty things like mountains etc. without difficulty, weightiness, weightlessness, holding the wind within the palms, ability to shake even the earth with the tip of the finger, to produce bodies with the wind and apart frtjm these the twenty- four powers of the Taijasa Yogins.
verses.wordMeaning: The wise know that the Yogic Siddhi called Maruta consists of thirtytwo types of powers viz: — the speed of the mind, the ability to enter the bodies of living beings, to hold weighty things like mountains etc. without difficulty, weightiness, weightlessness,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise know that the Yogic Siddhi called Maruta consists of thirtytwo types of powers viz: — the speed of the mind, the ability to enter the bodies of living beings, to hold weighty things like mountains etc. without difficulty, weightiness, weightlessness,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लम्बोदरश्च लम्बश्च लम्बात्मा लम्बकेशकः । सर्वज्ञः समबुद्धिश्च साध्यसिद्धिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: lambodaraśca lambaśca lambātmā lambakeśakaḥ | sarvajñaḥ samabuddhiśca sādhyasiddhistathaiva ca
verses.translation: The Yogic Siddhi called Aindra pertaining to the ether consists of forty powers: — Shadowlessness, absence of the sense-organs, ability to walk over the ether, to have the sense-objects at will, to transgress the ether, to instil the ether into the body, to solidify ether, having no body and
verses.wordMeaning: The Yogic Siddhi called Aindra pertaining to the ether consists of forty powers: — Shadowlessness, absence of the sense-organs, ability to walk over the ether, to have the sense-objects at will, to transgress the ether, to instil the ether into the body, to solidify ether,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogic Siddhi called Aindra pertaining to the ether consists of forty powers: — Shadowlessness, absence of the sense-organs, ability to walk over the ether, to have the sense-objects at will, to transgress the ether, to instil the ether into the body, to solidify ether,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सुधामा कश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठो विरजास्तथा । अत्रिरुग्रो गुरुश्रेष्ठः श्रवनोऽथ श्रविष्टकः
verses.transliteration: sudhāmā kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho virajāstathā | atrirugro guruśreṣṭhaḥ śravano'tha śraviṣṭakaḥ
verses.translation: Ability to acquire whatever is desired, to wander as he pleases, to attack all, to sec all the hidden secrets of others, to create bodies according to the task, to bring others under control, to appear pleasing, and to see the world, these powers along with those of the Aindra Yogins constitute the candramasa type of yogin. The powers are mainly mental and the number of powers is fortyeight.
verses.wordMeaning: Ability to acquire whatever is desired, to wander as he pleases, to attack all, to sec all the hidden secrets of others, to create bodies according to the task, to bring others under control, to appear pleasing, and to see the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ability to acquire whatever is desired, to wander as he pleases, to attack all, to sec all the hidden secrets of others, to create bodies according to the task, to bring others under control, to appear pleasing, and to see the world,…

verses.sanskrit: कुणिश्च कुणिबाहुश्च कुशरीरः कुनेत्रकः । काश्यपो ह्युशनाश्चैव च्यवनश्च बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: kuṇiśca kuṇibāhuśca kuśarīraḥ kunetrakaḥ | kāśyapo hyuśanāścaiva cyavanaśca bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: Ability to cut, to strike, to bind and to release, seizure of all living beings under the influence of worldly existence, ability to delight all, mastery over death and time these arc the** special powers of the Prajapatya Yogins. These powers along with those of Candramasa Yogins are fiftysix in number.
verses.wordMeaning: Ability to cut, to strike, to bind and to release, seizure of all living beings under the influence of worldly existence, ability to delight all, mastery over death and time these arc the** special powers of the Prajapatya Yogins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ability to cut, to strike, to bind and to release, seizure of all living beings under the influence of worldly existence, ability to delight all, mastery over death and time these arc the** special powers of the Prajapatya Yogins.…

verses.sanskrit: उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महाकालो महानिलः । वाचःश्रवाः सुवीरश्च श्यावकश्च यतीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: utathyo vāmadevaśca mahākālo mahānilaḥ | vācaḥśravāḥ suvīraśca śyāvakaśca yatīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Creation by mere conception, protection, and annihilation, ability to exercise authority to make minds function, dissimilarity with all, creation of a separate uni¬ verse doing auspicious and inauspicious things — these powers along with the Prajapatya powers, altogether numbering sixtyfour, constitute the powers of the Yogin of the Brahma type.
verses.wordMeaning: Creation by mere conception, protection, and annihilation, ability to exercise authority to make minds function, dissimilarity with all, creation of a separate uni¬ verse doing auspicious and inauspicious things — these powers along with the Prajapatya powers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Creation by mere conception, protection, and annihilation, ability to exercise authority to make minds function, dissimilarity with all, creation of a separate uni¬ verse doing auspicious and inauspicious things — these powers along with the Prajapatya powers,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यनाभः कौशल्यो लोकाक्षिः कुथुमिस्तथा । सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिश्चैव कुबन्धः कुशकन्धरः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyanābhaḥ kauśalyo lokākṣiḥ kuthumistathā | sumanturjaiminiścaiva kubandhaḥ kuśakandharaḥ
verses.translation: This Aivarya functions through intellect. The power greater than and beyond this is the Prakrta Aisvarya called Vainava. The sustenance of the universe is his alone. Only Brahma can explain that region wholly and not others.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Aivarya functions through intellect. The power greater than and beyond this is the Prakrta Aisvarya called Vainava. The sustenance of the universe is his alone. Only Brahma can explain that region wholly and not others.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षो दार्भायणिश्चैव केतुमान् गौतमस्तथा । भल्लवी मधुपिङ्गश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: plakṣo dārbhāyaṇiścaiva ketumān gautamastathā | bhallavī madhupiṅgaśca śvetaketustathaiva ca
verses.translation: All the Siddhis due to knowledge and the Upasargas shall be checked assiduously by means of great detachment.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Siddhis due to knowledge and the Upasargas shall be checked assiduously by means of great detachment.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उशिजो बृहदश्वश्च देवलः कविरेव च । शालिहोत्रः सुवेषश्च युवनाश्वः शरद्वसुः
verses.transliteration: uśijo bṛhadaśvaśca devalaḥ kavireva ca | śālihotraḥ suveṣaśca yuvanāśvaḥ śaradvasuḥ
verses.translation: The great Aisvarya that affords protection and is coveted by all cannot by acquired if the mind is attached to false appearances, forms and attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Aisvarya that affords protection and is coveted by all cannot by acquired if the mind is attached to false appearances, forms and attributes.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षपादः कणादश्च उलूको वत्स एव च । कुलिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रको रुष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: akṣapādaḥ kaṇādaśca ulūko vatsa eva ca | kulikaścaiva gargaśca mitrako ruṣya eva ca
verses.translation: Or the sage with Yogic powers shall move about with a desire to bless the universe. He can then enjoy the pleasures at his will and attain salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the sage with Yogic powers shall move about with a desire to bless the universe. He can then enjoy the pleasures at his will and attain salvation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एते शिष्या महेशस्य योगाचार्यस्वरूपिणः । सङ्ख्या च शतमेतेषां सह द्वादशसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: ete śiṣyā maheśasya yogācāryasvarūpiṇaḥ | saṅkhyā ca śatameteṣāṃ saha dvādaśasaṅkhyayā
verses.translation: Now I shall explain the practice of Yoga. Listen attentively. The time and the spot shall be auspicious; it may be the temple of Siva and or other clean place; it shall be a secluded spot devoid of people, creatures, noises and other disturbances. It shall be well-scrubbed and smeared. •It shall be rendered fragrant with scents and incense. Flo¬ wers shall be strewn..There shall be canopies etc. above. The place shall be abounding in Kusa grass, flowers, sacrifi¬ cial twigs, water, fruits, roots, etc. It shall not be near fire or water-receptacles. There shall not be too many dry leaves. The place shall not be infested by flies, mosquitoes, serpents and beasts of prey. There shall not be harmful beasts or wicked men instilling terror. It shall not be the cremation ground, monastery, anthill, dilapidated house, meeting-place of high¬ ways, banks and shores of rivers and oCeans nor should it be the middle of streets. It shall not be a park in disrepair nor a dilapidated cowshed. It shall not be displeasing nor repulsive. It shall not have been defiled by vomited material or undigested foul smell or faeces and urine. The Yogin shall not practise when he has vomiting or when he suffers from diarrhoea, when he has taken too much of food, or when he has exhausted himself. If he is too hungry or too thirsty or too much worried he shall not practise Yoga. If he is enga¬ ged in any of the tasks set by his preceptor he shall not practise Yoga.
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall explain the practice of Yoga. Listen attentively. The time and the spot shall be auspicious; it may be the temple of Siva and or other clean place; it shall be a secluded spot devoid of people, creatures, noises and other disturbances.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall explain the practice of Yoga. Listen attentively. The time and the spot shall be auspicious; it may be the temple of Siva and or other clean place; it shall be a secluded spot devoid of people, creatures, noises and other disturbances.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे पाशुपताः सिद्धा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः । सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः
verses.transliteration: sarve pāśupatāḥ siddhā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ | sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ
verses.translation: He shall have proper food and activity. He shall be sober in recreation and rest. Both his sleep and wakefulness shall be of the normal proper nature. He shall eschew all tiresomeness. The seat shall be soft, pleasant, sufficiently wide, level and pure. He shall practise one of the poses Padmaka, Svastika and others.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall have proper food and activity. He shall be sober in recreation and rest. Both his sleep and wakefulness shall be of the normal proper nature. He shall eschew all tiresomeness. The seat shall be soft, pleasant, sufficiently wide, level and pure.…

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रमरताः सर्वे शिवज्ञानपरायणाः । सर्वे सङ्गविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवैकासक्तचेतसः
verses.transliteration: śivāśramaratāḥ sarve śivajñānaparāyaṇāḥ | sarve saṅgavinirmuktāḥ śivaikāsaktacetasaḥ
verses.translation: He shall pay homage to all those venerable persons who reside with his' preceptors. He shall keep his head and chest erect. The head shall be lifted up a little. The teeth should not gnash one another. The tongue should be kept well within the teeth and motionless. The scrotum
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall pay homage to all those venerable persons who reside with his' preceptors. He shall keep his head and chest erect. The head shall be lifted up a little. The teeth should not gnash one another. The tongue should be kept well within the teeth and motionless. The scrotum

verses.sanskrit: सर्वद्वन्द्वसहा धीराः सर्वभूतहिते रताः । ऋजवो मृदवः स्वस्था जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: sarvadvandvasahā dhīrāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ | ṛjavo mṛdavaḥ svasthā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ
verses.translation: He shall remember the lord at the root or tip of the nose, or in the umbilicus, or neck, or in the palate or the gullet or in the middle of the eyebrows or at the jiostrils or in the forehead or on the head. After conceiving a suitable seat to Siva and Siva he shall remember Siva with or without Avarana in the two-petalled, or twelve-pe tailed lotus in accordance with injunction. Or it may be in the ten-petalled six-cornered or four-cornered lotus.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall remember the lord at the root or tip of the nose, or in the umbilicus, or neck, or in the palate or the gullet or in the middle of the eyebrows or at the jiostrils or in the forehead or on the head.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall remember the lord at the root or tip of the nose, or in the umbilicus, or neck, or in the palate or the gullet or in the middle of the eyebrows or at the jiostrils or in the forehead or on the head.…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षमालाभरणास्त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः । शिखाजटाः सर्वजटा अजटा मुण्डशीर्षकाः
verses.transliteration: rudrākṣamālābharaṇāstripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ | śikhājaṭāḥ sarvajaṭā ajaṭā muṇḍaśīrṣakāḥ
verses.translation: The lotus shall be conceived in the middle of the eye-brows as having two petals and as brilliant as light¬ ning. To the south and north of the lotus in the middle of the eyebrow two leaves shall be conceived with the colour of lightning ending with letters. The leaves of the sixteen- petalled lotus are the sixteen vowels. They shall be conceived beginning from the petal to the east and proceeding in order.
verses.wordMeaning: The lotus shall be conceived in the middle of the eye-brows as having two petals and as brilliant as light¬ ning. To the south and north of the lotus in the middle of the eyebrow two leaves shall be conceived with the colour of lightning ending with letters.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lotus shall be conceived in the middle of the eye-brows as having two petals and as brilliant as light¬ ning. To the south and north of the lotus in the middle of the eyebrow two leaves shall be conceived with the colour of lightning ending with letters.…

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलाशनप्रायाः प्राणायामपरायणाः । शिवाभिमानसम्पन्नाः शिवध्यानैकतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: phalamūlāśanaprāyāḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ | śivābhimānasampannāḥ śivadhyānaikatatparāḥ
verses.translation: The twelve letters beginning with 'Ka' and ending with 'Tha' are the leaves. The lotus of the colour of the sun, which is meditated inside the heart and which is of the colour of the cow's milk has ten letters from "Da" to "Pha" for its petals. The letters upto the letter "La'* (i.e Ba, Bha, Ma, Ya, Ra and La) constitute the six petals of the lotus with petals facing down and having the colour of the smoke- * less burning coal. The letters from "Va" to "Sa" consti¬ tute the petals of the lotus at the Muladhara, having the colour of gold.
verses.wordMeaning: The twelve letters beginning with 'Ka' and ending with 'Tha' are the leaves. The lotus of the colour of the sun, which is meditated inside the heart and which is of the colour of the cow's milk has ten letters from "Da" to "Pha" for its petals.…

verses.sanskrit: समुन्मथितसंसारविषवृक्षाङ्कुरोद्गमाः । प्रयातुमेव सन्नद्धाः परं शिवपुरं प्रति
verses.transliteration: samunmathitasaṃsāraviṣavṛkṣāṅkurodgamāḥ | prayātumeva sannaddhāḥ paraṃ śivapuraṃ prati
verses.translation: He shall meditate on the lord and the goddess in any of these lotuses according to his taste. The mind shall be steady.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on the lord and the goddess in any of these lotuses according to his taste. The mind shall be steady.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सदेशिकानिमान् मत्वा नित्यं यः शिवमर्चयेत् । स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sadeśikānimān matvā nityaṃ yaḥ śivamarcayet | sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: He shall conceive him in any of the following forms — of the size of the thumb, pure, brilliant and illuminat¬ ing all round, of the form of pure lamp, endowed with its Sakti completely, of the size of the digit of the moon, of the form of the star, the awn of Nivara grain and the stalk of the lotus, of the circular shape of the Kadamba, of the form of the dewdrop. He shall contemplate on him as the lord of different Tattvas of the earth and others of which the meditator wishes the mastery.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall conceive him in any of the following forms — of the size of the thumb, pure, brilliant and illuminat¬ ing all round, of the form of pure lamp, endowed with its Sakti completely, of the size of the digit of the moon, of the form of the star,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall conceive him in any of the following forms — of the size of the thumb, pure, brilliant and illuminat¬ ing all round, of the form of pure lamp, endowed with its Sakti completely, of the size of the digit of the moon, of the form of the star,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The object of meditation on the form of intellect¬ ual visions is Dhyeya and that is Siva himself accompanied by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The object of meditation on the form of intellect¬ ual visions is Dhyeya and that is Siva himself accompanied by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ
verses.translation: The object of meditation on the form of intellect¬ ual visions is Dhyeya and that is Siva himself accompanied by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The object of meditation on the form of intellect¬ ual visions is Dhyeya and that is Siva himself accompanied by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । शिवभक्तिवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् सर्वयोगीन्द्र गणेश्वर मुनीश्वर । षडाननसमप्रख्य सर्वज्ञाननिधे गुरो
verses.transliteration: śrīśivamahāpurāṇam || 7.2.10. daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | śivabhaktivarṇanam | kṛṣṇa uvāca | bhagavan sarvayogīndra gaṇeśvara munīśvara | ṣaḍānanasamaprakhya sarvajñānanidhe guro
verses.translation: The experience of salvation and the perfect Ani ma etc. is the direct fruit of meditation on Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The experience of salvation and the perfect Ani ma etc. is the direct fruit of meditation on Siva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रायस्त्वमवतीर्योर्व्यां पाशविच्छित्तये नृणाम् । महर्षिवपुरास्थाय स्थितोऽसि परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: prāyastvamavatīryorvyāṃ pāśavicchittaye nṛṇām | maharṣivapurāsthāya sthito'si parameśvara
verses.translation: If a person in his attempt for knowledge and
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person in his attempt for knowledge and

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा हि जगत्यस्मिन् देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा । त्वत्तोऽन्यः परमं भावं को जानीयात् शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: anyathā hi jagatyasmin devo vā dānavo'pi vā | tvatto'nyaḥ paramaṃ bhāvaṃ ko jānīyāt śivātmakam
verses.translation: If he has courage enough he shall abandon his life there voluntarily even without ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he has courage enough he shall abandon his life there voluntarily even without ailments.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तव मुखोद्गीर्णं साक्षादिव पिनाकिनः । शिवज्ञानामृतं पीत्वा न मे तृप्तमभून्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttava mukhodgīrṇaṃ sākṣādiva pinākinaḥ | śivajñānāmṛtaṃ pītvā na me tṛptamabhūnmanaḥ
verses.translation: After performing the rite of Tarpana to the gods with her auspicious waters they remembered the previous events and went to Varwasl.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the rite of Tarpana to the gods with her auspicious waters they remembered the previous events and went to Varwasl.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साक्षात्सर्वजगत्कर्तुर्भर्तुरङ्कं समाश्रिता । भगवन्किन्नु पप्रच्छ भर्तारं परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: sākṣātsarvajagatkarturbharturaṅkaṃ samāśritā | bhagavankinnu papraccha bhartāraṃ parameśvarī
verses.translation: Not identified.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not identified.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । स्थाने पृष्टं त्वया कृष्ण तद्वक्ष्यामि यथातथम् । भवभक्तस्य युक्तस्य तव कल्याणचेतसः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvāca | sthāne pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa tadvakṣyāmi yathātatham | bhavabhaktasya yuktasya tava kalyāṇacetasaḥ
verses.translation: Lord iSiva smiled and spoke to the chief of Ganas. This sage was arrogant and he insulted me. Hence O sinless one, explain my true nature to him. The eldest son of Brahma who took me for a fool is given to you as your disciple. He will be the protagonist of my knowledge. He will perform your coronation as the presiding deity of virtue.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord iSiva smiled and spoke to the chief of Ganas. This sage was arrogant and he insulted me. Hence O sinless one, explain my true nature to him. The eldest son of Brahma who took me for a fool is given to you as your disciple. He will be the protagonist of my knowledge.…

verses.sanskrit: महीधरवरे दिव्ये मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे । देव्या सह महादेवो दिव्यो ध्यानगतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: mahīdharavare divye mandare cārukandare | devyā saha mahādevo divyo dhyānagato'bhavat
verses.translation: In some places the sound of the Karaidava is heard. In some places there is the chirping sound of the Sarasa. In some places the ruddy goose. cackles. In some places the bees hum. The lake appears to be holding a loving conversation perpetually with the birds and animals living on the trees and taking bath therein or drinking its water. Through the cooing sound of the cuckoos lying hid¬ den on the trees on its banks it appears to invite all those who are oppressed by the sun.
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the sound of the Karaidava is heard. In some places there is the chirping sound of the Sarasa. In some places the ruddy goose. cackles. In some places the bees hum.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the sound of the Karaidava is heard. In some places there is the chirping sound of the Sarasa. In some places the ruddy goose. cackles. In some places the bees hum.…

verses.sanskrit: तदा देव्याः प्रियसखी सुस्मितास्या शुभावती । फुल्लान्यतिमनोज्ञानि पुष्पाणि समुदाहरत्
verses.transliteration: tadā devyāḥ priyasakhī susmitāsyā śubhāvatī | phullānyatimanojñāni puṣpāṇi samudāharat
verses.translation: In the middle of the aerial chariot the son of Brahma accompanied by the sages saw the son of Silada seated in a divine throne with Suyaa, brilliant as the goddess Lakml. On either side there was a chowrie. He sat under a royal umbrella with a gemset handle, resembling the pure mooiK He had three eyes. Even by his gestures he remin¬ ded one of the lord. He appeared like the untransgressable behest of the creator. He was one who blessed all. He stood directly in front of Siva. He held an excellent trident. As the commander of the Ganas he looked like another Visve- vara. He could curb and bless the rulers of the universe. He had four arms, a splendid body embellished with the digit of the moon. A serpent adorned his neck and the moon his head. He was the embodied form of Aivarya. He appeared like active cflSciency. It seemed that the very salvation or the omniscient lord had come there. On seeing him the son of Brahina was highly delighted. He stood up with palms joined in reverence. He seemed to dedicate himself to him.
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of the aerial chariot the son of Brahma accompanied by the sages saw the son of Silada seated in a divine throne with Suyaa, brilliant as the goddess Lakml. On either side there was a chowrie. He sat under a royal umbrella with a gemset handle,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of the aerial chariot the son of Brahma accompanied by the sages saw the son of Silada seated in a divine throne with Suyaa, brilliant as the goddess Lakml. On either side there was a chowrie. He sat under a royal umbrella with a gemset handle,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वमङ्कमारोप्य देवीं देववरोहरः । अलङ्कृत्य च तैः पुष्पैरास्ते हृष्टतरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svamaṅkamāropya devīṃ devavaroharaḥ | alaṅkṛtya ca taiḥ puṣpairāste hṛṣṭataraḥ svayam
verses.translation: In the meantime when the aerial chariot reached
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime when the aerial chariot reached
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथान्तःपुरचारिण्यो देव्यो दिव्यविभूषणाः । अन्तरङ्गा गणेन्द्राश्च सर्वलोकमहेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: athāntaḥpuracāriṇyo devyo divyavibhūṣaṇāḥ | antaraṅgā gaṇendrāśca sarvalokamaheśvarīm
verses.translation: Man shall eschew everything and be engaged in meditation since he will be having both happiness and salva¬ tion from the practice of meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Man shall eschew everything and be engaged in meditation since he will be having both happiness and salva¬ tion from the practice of meditation.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं परिपूर्णं च सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् । चामरासक्तहस्ताश्च देवीं देवं सिषेविरे
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca sarvalokamaheśvaram | cāmarāsaktahastāśca devīṃ devaṃ siṣevire
verses.translation: Knowledge cannot be attained without meditation. A non-yogin cannot have meditation. The ocean of worldly existence is crossed by the person who has both meditation and knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowledge cannot be attained without meditation. A non-yogin cannot have meditation. The ocean of worldly existence is crossed by the person who has both meditation and knowledge.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रियाः कथा वृत्ता विनोदाय महेशयोः । त्राणाय च नृणां लोके ये शिवं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ priyāḥ kathā vṛttā vinodāya maheśayoḥ | trāṇāya ca nṛṇāṃ loke ye śivaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The clear and single-centred knowledge devoid of all conditioning factors can be achieved only by a Yogin who regularly practises Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The clear and single-centred knowledge devoid of all conditioning factors can be achieved only by a Yogin who regularly practises Yoga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदावसरमालोक्य सर्वलोकमहेश्वरी । भर्तारं परिपप्रच्छ सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tadāvasaramālokya sarvalokamaheśvarī | bhartāraṃ paripapraccha sarvalokamaheśvaram
verses.translation: The minds of only those whose sins have been en¬ tirely quelled become inclined towards knowledge and medita¬ tion. Those whose intellects have been defiled by sins find it wholly inaccessible.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of only those whose sins have been en¬ tirely quelled become inclined towards knowledge and medita¬ tion. Those whose intellects have been defiled by sins find it wholly inaccessible.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । केन वश्यो महादेवो मर्त्यानां मन्दचेतसाम् । आत्मतत्त्वाद्यशक्तानामात्मनामकृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca | kena vaśyo mahādevo martyānāṃ mandacetasām | ātmatattvādyaśaktānāmātmanāmakṛtātmanām
verses.translation: Just as the blazing fire burns both the dry and the wet twigs, so also the fire of meditation burns in a trice both the auspicious and the inauspicious Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the blazing fire burns both the dry and the wet twigs, so also the fire of meditation burns in a trice both the auspicious and the inauspicious Karmans.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । न कर्मणा न तपसा न जपैर्नासनादिभिः । न ज्ञानेन न चान्येन वश्योऽहं श्रद्धया विना
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca | na karmaṇā na tapasā na japairnāsanādibhiḥ | na jñānena na cānyena vaśyo'haṃ śraddhayā vinā
verses.translation: Just as even a modicum of light dispels darkness so also even the slightest practice of Yoga destroys great sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as even a modicum of light dispels darkness so also even the slightest practice of Yoga destroys great sins.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा मय्यस्ति चेत्पुंसां येन केनापि हेतुना । वश्यः स्पृश्यश्च दृश्यश्च पूज्यस्सम्भाष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: śraddhā mayyasti cetpuṃsāṃ yena kenāpi hetunā | vaśyaḥ spṛśyaśca dṛśyaśca pūjyassambhāṣya eva ca
verses.translation: Yogins do not resort to holy centres full of waters nor to deities made of stone or clay because they have belief only in their Atmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yogins do not resort to holy centres full of waters nor to deities made of stone or clay because they have belief only in their Atmans.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: साध्या तस्मान् मयि शद्धा मां वशीकर्तुमिच्छता । श्रद्धा हेतुः स्वधर्मस्य रक्षणं वर्णिनामिह
verses.transliteration: sādhyā tasmān mayi śaddhā māṃ vaśīkartumicchatā | śraddhā hetuḥ svadharmasya rakṣaṇaṃ varṇināmiha
verses.translation: Just as the gross form of the lord fashioned out of clay or wood is observed by the non-yogins so also his subtle form can be perceived by the Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the gross form of the lord fashioned out of clay or wood is observed by the non-yogins so also his subtle form can be perceived by the Yogins.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मेऽथ वर्तते यस्तु मानवः । तस्यैव भवति श्रद्धा मयि नान्यस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: svavarṇāśramadharme'tha vartate yastu mānavaḥ | tasyaiva bhavati śraddhā mayi nānyasya kasyacit
verses.translation: Just as in the Royal household, the interior officials not the workers outside are the favourites of kings so also those who are engaged in inner meditation are the favourites of lord Siva and not those who perform holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as in the Royal household, the interior officials not the workers outside are the favourites of kings so also those who are engaged in inner meditation are the favourites of lord Siva and not those who perform holy rites.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आम्नायसिद्धमखिलं धर्ममाश्रमिणामिह । ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं ममैवाज्ञापुरः सरम्
verses.transliteration: āmnāyasiddhamakhilaṃ dharmamāśramiṇāmiha | brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ mamaivājñāpuraḥ saram
verses.translation: Just as the exterior workers do not enjoy the pleasures in the royal palace, the same is the case with the Karmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the exterior workers do not enjoy the pleasures in the royal palace, the same is the case with the Karmins.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तु पैतामहो धर्मो बहुवित्तक्रियान्वितः । नात्यन्तफलभूयिष्ठः क्लेशायाससमन्वितः । तेन धर्मेण महता श्रद्धां प्राप्य सुदुर्ल्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu paitāmaho dharmo bahuvittakriyānvitaḥ | nātyantaphalabhūyiṣṭhaḥ kleśāyāsasamanvitaḥ | tena dharmeṇa mahatā śraddhāṃ prāpya sudurllabhām
verses.translation: Even by performing sacrifices, that goal is not obtained which a man with the desire for the knowledge of Yoga attains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even by performing sacrifices, that goal is not obtained which a man with the desire for the knowledge of Yoga attains.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णिनो ये प्रपद्यन्ते मामनन्यसमाश्रयाः । तेषां सुखेन मार्गेण धर्मकामार्थमुक्तयः
verses.transliteration: varṇino ye prapadyante māmananyasamāśrayāḥ | teṣāṃ sukhena mārgeṇa dharmakāmārthamuktayaḥ
verses.translation: The fruit derivable by worshipping a crore of brahmins can be attained by giving alms alone to a Siva Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fruit derivable by worshipping a crore of brahmins can be attained by giving alms alone to a Siva Yogin.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमसमाचारो मया भूयः प्रकल्पितः । तस्मिन् भक्तिमतामेव मदीयानां तु वर्णिनाम्
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramasamācāro mayā bhūyaḥ prakalpitaḥ | tasmin bhaktimatāmeva madīyānāṃ tu varṇinām
verses.translation: By giving cooked rice to him the benefits of sacri¬ fices, Agnihotras, charitable gifts and pilgrimages can be secured.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving cooked rice to him the benefits of sacri¬ fices, Agnihotras, charitable gifts and pilgrimages can be secured.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अधिकारो न चान्येषामित्याज्ञा नैष्ठिकी मम । तदाज्ञप्तेन मार्गेण वर्णिनो मदुपाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: adhikāro na cānyeṣāmityājñā naiṣṭhikī mama | tadājñaptena mārgeṇa varṇino madupāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: Those who disparage Bivayogins under delusion undergo sufferings in hells along with those who listen, till the dissolution of the world,
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who disparage Bivayogins under delusion undergo sufferings in hells along with those who listen, till the dissolution of the world,
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मलमायादिपाशेभ्यो विमुक्ता मत्प्रसादतः । परं मदीयमासाद्य पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् । परमं मम साधर्म्यं प्राप्य निर्वृतिमाययुः
verses.transliteration: malamāyādipāśebhyo vimuktā matprasādataḥ | paraṃ madīyamāsādya punarāvṛttidurlabham | paramaṃ mama sādharmyaṃ prāpya nirvṛtimāyayuḥ
verses.translation: Only when there is some listener, does a person disparage the Yogin. Hence the listener too is a sinner. Those who worship Sivayogins attain pleasures here and salva¬ tion hereafter. Hence, Sivayogins shall be honoured and revered' by those who seek worldly pleasures, giving them asylum, food stuffs and drinks, beds and blankets. The Yogic virtue cannot be smashed by the iron clubs of sins. It is very strong and shall be considered to possess adaman¬ tine fibres. Yogins are not smeared by sins like the lotus leaf not affected by water.
verses.wordMeaning: Only when there is some listener, does a person disparage the Yogin. Hence the listener too is a sinner. Those who worship Sivayogins attain pleasures here and salva¬ tion hereafter. Hence, Sivayogins shall be honoured and revered' by those who seek worldly pleasures,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Only when there is some listener, does a person disparage the Yogin. Hence the listener too is a sinner. Those who worship Sivayogins attain pleasures here and salva¬ tion hereafter. Hence, Sivayogins shall be honoured and revered' by those who seek worldly pleasures,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् लब्ध्वाप्यलब्ध्वा वा वर्णधर्मं मयेरितम् । आश्रित्य मम भक्तश्चेत्स्वात्मनात्मानमुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt labdhvāpyalabdhvā vā varṇadharmaṃ mayeritam | āśritya mama bhaktaścetsvātmanātmānamuddharet
verses.translation: Even the land where the sage engaged in Sivayoga resides is hallowed and sacred, let alone Sivayogin himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the land where the sage engaged in Sivayoga resides is hallowed and sacred, let alone Sivayogin himself.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धलाभ एवैष कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकः । तस्मान्मे मुखतो लब्धं वर्णधर्मं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: alabdhalābha evaiṣa koṭikoṭiguṇādhikaḥ | tasmānme mukhato labdhaṃ varṇadharmaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Hence a shrewd and efficient man shall eschew all activities and practise livayoga in order to quell miseries.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence a shrewd and efficient man shall eschew all activities and practise livayoga in order to quell miseries.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ममावतारा हि शुभे योगाचार्यच्छलेन तु । सर्वान्तरेषु सन्त्यार्ये सन्ततिश्च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: mamāvatārā hi śubhe yogācāryacchalena tu | sarvāntareṣu santyārye santatiśca sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: A Yogin who has achieved the fruits of Yoga may sport about after enjoying the pleasures as he wishes or shall remain here performing the requisite services.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Yogin who has achieved the fruits of Yoga may sport about after enjoying the pleasures as he wishes or shall remain here performing the requisite services.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तानामबुद्धीनामभक्तानां सुरेश्वरि । दुर्लभं सन्ततिज्ञानं ततो यत्नात्समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: ayuktānāmabuddhīnāmabhaktānāṃ sureśvari | durlabhaṃ santatijñānaṃ tato yatnātsamāśrayet
verses.translation: Or let him consider worldly pleasures worthless and eschew them. Due to detachment let him abandon rites and be liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or let him consider worldly pleasures worthless and eschew them. Due to detachment let him abandon rites and be liberated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा हानिस्तन्महच्छिद्रं स मोहस्सान्धमूकता । यदन्यत्र श्रमं कुर्यान्मोक्षमार्गबहिष्कृतः
verses.transliteration: sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sa mohassāndhamūkatā | yadanyatra śramaṃ kuryānmokṣamārgabahiṣkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Or seeing evil portents and realising death as im¬ minent the Yogin engaged in the practice of Yoga shall resort to a Saivitc holy centre or temple.*®*
verses.commentary: Sense: Or seeing evil portents and realising death as im¬ minent the Yogin engaged in the practice of Yoga shall resort to a Saivitc holy centre or temple.*®*
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं क्रिया च चर्या च योगश्चेति सुरेश्वरि । चतुष्पादः समाख्यातो मम धर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ kriyā ca caryā ca yogaśceti sureśvari | catuṣpādaḥ samākhyāto mama dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: He who voluntarily forsakes his life as prescribed in $aivite scriptures, by observing fast, or by consigning his body to Siva- fire, or by plunging into Saivite holy rivers, shall immediately be liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who voluntarily forsakes his life as prescribed in $aivite scriptures, by observing fast, or by consigning his body to Siva- fire, or by plunging into Saivite holy rivers, shall immediately be liberated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पशुपाशपतिज्ञानं ज्ञानमित्यभिधीयते । षडध्वशुद्धिर्विधिना गुर्वधीना क्रियोच्यते
verses.transliteration: paśupāśapatijñānaṃ jñānamityabhidhīyate | ṣaḍadhvaśuddhirvidhinā gurvadhīnā kriyocyate
verses.translation: Since voluntary death by means of fasts etc. is sought with a mind full of confidence and devotion, they say that this death is commendable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since voluntary death by means of fasts etc. is sought with a mind full of confidence and devotion, they say that this death is commendable.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमप्रयुक्तस्य मयैव विहितस्य च । ममार्चनादिधर्मस्य चर्या चर्येति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramaprayuktasya mayaiva vihitasya ca | mamārcanādidharmasya caryā caryeti kathyate
verses.translation: After killing a person engaged in disparaging Siva or being afflicted himself, if a devotee eschews his life, not ordinarily possible to forsake, he is not reborn.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a person engaged in disparaging Siva or being afflicted himself, if a devotee eschews his life, not ordinarily possible to forsake, he is not reborn.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मदुक्तेनैव मार्गेण मय्यवस्थितचेतसः । वृत्त्यन्तरनिरोधो यो योग इत्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: maduktenaiva mārgeṇa mayyavasthitacetasaḥ | vṛttyantaranirodho yo yoga ityabhidhīyate
verses.translation: He who dies after fighting being incapable of killing a disparager of Siva shall be liberated with the mem¬ bers of his family for twentyone generations.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dies after fighting being incapable of killing a disparager of Siva shall be liberated with the mem¬ bers of his family for twentyone generations.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधगणात् श्रेष्ठं देवि चित्तप्रसाधनम् । मुक्तिदं च तथा ह्येतद्दुष्प्राप्यं विषयैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhagaṇāt śreṣṭhaṃ devi cittaprasādhanam | muktidaṃ ca tathā hyetadduṣprāpyaṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām
verses.translation: No man treading the path of salvation is equal to one who eschews his life for Siva or for a devotee of §iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: No man treading the path of salvation is equal to one who eschews his life for Siva or for a devotee of §iva.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विजितेन्द्रियवर्गस्य यमेन नियमेन च । पूर्वपापहरो योगो विरक्तस्यैव कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: vijitendriyavargasya yamena niyamena ca | pūrvapāpaharo yogo viraktasyaiva kathyate
verses.translation: His descendants shall not observe post-mortem pollution. His body shall be buried under ground or burnt in fire, or cast off in Saivite holy waters or left abandoned like a log of wood or a clod of clay. Or if at all some post-mortem holy rite has to be performed let it be • some auspicious rite. The descendant shall propitiate devotees. Only a devotee
verses.wordMeaning: His descendants shall not observe post-mortem pollution. His body shall be buried under ground or burnt in fire, or cast off in Saivite holy waters or left abandoned like a log of wood or a clod of clay.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His descendants shall not observe post-mortem pollution. His body shall be buried under ground or burnt in fire, or cast off in Saivite holy waters or left abandoned like a log of wood or a clod of clay.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्याज्जायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद्योगः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: vairāgyājjāyate jñānaṃ jñānādyogaḥ pravartate
verses.translation: After explaining to the sages, who honoured and exalted him, the path of knowledge that had been previously imparted by the sage Upamanyu of restrained senses to Sri Kfsna, Vayu vanished in the air at sunset.
verses.commentary: Sense: After explaining to the sages, who honoured and exalted him, the path of knowledge that had been previously imparted by the sage Upamanyu of restrained senses to Sri Kfsna, Vayu vanished in the air at sunset.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: योगज्ञः पतितो वापि मुच्यते नात्र संशयः । दया कार्याथ सततमहिंसा ज्ञानसङ्ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: yogajñaḥ patito vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | dayā kāryātha satatamahiṃsā jñānasaṅgrahaḥ
verses.translation: The next day in the morning the sages of Naimifa set out to perform the holy rite of ablution at the end of their Sattra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The next day in the morning the sages of Naimifa set out to perform the holy rite of ablution at the end of their Sattra.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमस्तेयमास्तिक्यं श्रद्धा चेन्द्रियनिग्रहः । अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा
verses.transliteration: satyamasteyamāstikyaṃ śraddhā cendriyanigrahaḥ | adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Brahma the delighted goddess Sarasvatl herself flowed as an auspicious river of sweet water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the behest of Brahma the delighted goddess Sarasvatl herself flowed as an auspicious river of sweet water.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानमीश्वरभावश्च सततं ज्ञानशीलता । य एवं वर्तते विप्रो ज्ञानयोगस्य सिद्धये
verses.transliteration: dhyānamīśvarabhāvaśca satataṃ jñānaśīlatā | ya evaṃ vartate vipro jñānayogasya siddhaye
verses.translation: On seeing her the sages were delighted in their minds. They concluded the Sattra they had begun and plunged into the river.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her the sages were delighted in their minds. They concluded the Sattra they had begun and plunged into the river.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अचिरादेव विज्ञानं लब्ध्वा योगं च विन्दति । दग्ध्वा देहमिमं ज्ञानी क्षणात् ज्ञानाग्निना प्रिये । प्रसादान्मम योगज्ञः कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यति
verses.transliteration: acirādeva vijñānaṃ labdhvā yogaṃ ca vindati | dagdhvā dehamimaṃ jñānī kṣaṇāt jñānāgninā priye | prasādānmama yogajñaḥ karmabandhaṃ prahāsyati
verses.translation: There they saw the holy river Ganga descending from the Him&layan ridges and flowing to the south. They took their bath there and went along the bank.
verses.commentary: Sense: There they saw the holy river Ganga descending from the Him&layan ridges and flowing to the south. They took their bath there and went along the bank.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यःपुण्यात्मकं कर्म मुक्तेस्तत्प्रतिबन्धकम् । तस्मान्नियोगतो योगी पुण्यापुण्यं विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: puṇyaḥpuṇyātmakaṃ karma muktestatpratibandhakam | tasmānniyogato yogī puṇyāpuṇyaṃ vivarjayet
verses.translation: After reaching Varanasi they rejoiced much. They plunged into the north-flowing waters of the Ganga. They visited Avimuktesvara*®* and worshipped it. They were about to start when they saw a brilliant splendour in the sky that resembled a crore of sons. Its spreading lustre pervaded all the quarters.
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching Varanasi they rejoiced much. They plunged into the north-flowing waters of the Ganga. They visited Avimuktesvara*®* and worshipped it. They were about to start when they saw a brilliant splendour in the sky that resembled a crore of sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching Varanasi they rejoiced much. They plunged into the north-flowing waters of the Ganga. They visited Avimuktesvara*®* and worshipped it. They were about to start when they saw a brilliant splendour in the sky that resembled a crore of sons.…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: फलकामनया कर्मकरणात्प्रतिबध्यते । न कर्ममात्रकरणात्तस्मात्कर्मफलं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: phalakāmanayā karmakaraṇātpratibadhyate | na karmamātrakaraṇāttasmātkarmaphalaṃ tyajet
verses.translation: Then the Siddhas and sages who had performed Paupata rites with their bodies covered with Bhasma came there in hundreds and merged into that splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Siddhas and sages who had performed Paupata rites with their bodies covered with Bhasma came there in hundreds and merged into that splendour.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं कर्मयज्ञेन बहिः सम्पूज्य मां प्रिये । ज्ञानयोगरतो भूत्वा पश्चाद्योगं समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ karmayajñena bahiḥ sampūjya māṃ priye | jñānayogarato bhūtvā paścādyogaṃ samabhyaset
verses.translation: When those noble saints merged in it, the splen¬ dour suddenly vanished. It was highly mysterious.
verses.commentary: Sense: When those noble saints merged in it, the splen¬ dour suddenly vanished. It was highly mysterious.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विदिते मम याथात्म्ये कर्मयज्ञेन देहिनः । न यजन्ति हि मां युक्ताः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनाः
verses.transliteration: vidite mama yāthātmye karmayajñena dehinaḥ | na yajanti hi māṃ yuktāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that great mystery the sages from Naimi$a could not know what it was. They went to the forest Brahma vana.*®®
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that great mystery the sages from Naimi$a could not know what it was. They went to the forest Brahma vana.*®®
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नित्ययुक्तो मुनिः श्रेष्ठो मद्भक्तश्च समाहितः । ज्ञानयोगरतो योगी मम सायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: nityayukto muniḥ śreṣṭho madbhaktaśca samāhitaḥ | jñānayogarato yogī mama sāyujyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Even before they arrived there, the wind-god, the purifier of the worlds, had mentioned to Brahma the creator of the worlds and the source of the Vedas how he visited the sages of Naimisa, what he talked to them, how they were inclined to Siva, his attendants and Siva and how they had concluded their Sattra of long duration. When permitted by Brahma, the wind-god left for his own city.
verses.wordMeaning: Even before they arrived there, the wind-god, the purifier of the worlds, had mentioned to Brahma the creator of the worlds and the source of the Vedas how he visited the sages of Naimisa, what he talked to them, how they were inclined to Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even before they arrived there, the wind-god, the purifier of the worlds, had mentioned to Brahma the creator of the worlds and the source of the Vedas how he visited the sages of Naimisa, what he talked to them, how they were inclined to Siva,…
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथाविरक्तचित्ता ये वर्णिनो मदुपाश्रिताः । ज्ञानचर्या क्रियास्वेव तेऽधिकुर्युस्तदर्हकाः
verses.transliteration: athāviraktacittā ye varṇino madupāśritāḥ | jñānacaryā kriyāsveva te'dhikuryustadarhakāḥ
verses.translation: Brahma was comfortably seated in his abode acting as an umpire when Tumburu and Narada had their mutual rivalry in regard to their musical performance. He was taking a keen interest in their performance while Gandh- arvas and Apsaras waited onim.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma was comfortably seated in his abode acting as an umpire when Tumburu and Narada had their mutual rivalry in regard to their musical performance. He was taking a keen interest in their performance while Gandh- arvas and Apsaras waited onim.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विधा मत्पूजनं ज्ञेयं बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं तथा । वाङ्मनःकायभेदाच्च त्रिधा मद्भजनं विदुः
verses.transliteration: dvidhā matpūjanaṃ jñeyaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ tathā | vāṅmanaḥkāyabhedācca tridhā madbhajanaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: That being inopportune time the sages were stopped at the threshold by the gate-keepers and they sat outside the palace of Brahma towards a side.
verses.commentary: Sense: That being inopportune time the sages were stopped at the threshold by the gate-keepers and they sat outside the palace of Brahma towards a side.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपः कर्म जपो ध्यानं ज्ञानं वेत्यनुपूर्वशः । पञ्चधा कथ्यते सद्भिस्तदेव भजनं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ karma japo dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ vetyanupūrvaśaḥ | pañcadhā kathyate sadbhistadeva bhajanaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Narada was pronounced equal to Tumburu ■®® in musical skill. Permitted by Brahma to act in collaboration with him he eschewed mutual rivalry and quarrd and contracted friendship with Tumburu. With him and the other Gandharvas and Apsaras, be started from the palace of Brahma like the sun coming out of the clouds, in order to sing and play on his Vina before lord Nakulivara.
verses.wordMeaning: Narada was pronounced equal to Tumburu ■®® in musical skill. Permitted by Brahma to act in collaboration with him he eschewed mutual rivalry and quarrd and contracted friendship with Tumburu. With him and the other Gandharvas and Apsaras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Narada was pronounced equal to Tumburu ■®® in musical skill. Permitted by Brahma to act in collaboration with him he eschewed mutual rivalry and quarrd and contracted friendship with Tumburu. With him and the other Gandharvas and Apsaras,…

verses.sanskrit: अन्यात्मविदितं बाह्यमस्मदभ्यर्चनादिकम् । तदेव तु स्वसंवेद्यमाभ्यन्तरमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: anyātmaviditaṃ bāhyamasmadabhyarcanādikam | tadeva tu svasaṃvedyamābhyantaramudāhṛtam
verses.translation: On seeing Narada the sages bowed to him and asked him wh<ither that time was suitable to see the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Narada the sages bowed to him and asked him wh<ither that time was suitable to see the lord.

verses.sanskrit: मनोमत्प्रवणं चित्तं न मनोमात्रमुच्यते । मन्नामनिरता वाणी वाङ्मता खलु नेतरा
verses.transliteration: manomatpravaṇaṃ cittaṃ na manomātramucyate | mannāmaniratā vāṇī vāṅmatā khalu netarā
verses.translation: The gatekeepers intimated to Brahma and the party entered the abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gatekeepers intimated to Brahma and the party entered the abode.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गैर्मच्छासनादिष्टैस्त्रिपुण्ड्रादिभिरङ्कितः । ममोपचारनिरतः कायः कायो न चेतरः
verses.transliteration: liṅgairmacchāsanādiṣṭaistripuṇḍrādibhiraṅkitaḥ | mamopacāranirataḥ kāyaḥ kāyo na cetaraḥ
verses.translation: After entering, the party prostrated to the lord from distance. Or being permitted by Brahma, the party stood there respectfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering, the party prostrated to the lord from distance. Or being permitted by Brahma, the party stood there respectfully.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मदर्चा कर्म विज्ञेयं बाह्ये यागादिनोच्यते । मदर्थे देहसंशोषस्तपः कृच्छ्रादि नो मतम्
verses.transliteration: madarcā karma vijñeyaṃ bāhye yāgādinocyate | madarthe dehasaṃśoṣastapaḥ kṛcchrādi no matam
verses.translation: On hearing what was mentioned by the sages the four-faced creator of the universe shook his head and spoke in a majestic tone — -'A great Siddhi in the next world awaits you all."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing what was mentioned by the sages the four-faced creator of the universe shook his head and spoke in a majestic tone — -'A great Siddhi in the next world awaits you all."
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जपः पञ्चाक्षराभ्यासः प्रणवाभ्यास एव च । रुद्राध्यायादिकाभ्यासो न वेदाध्ययनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: japaḥ pañcākṣarābhyāsaḥ praṇavābhyāsa eva ca | rudrādhyāyādikābhyāso na vedādhyayanādikam
verses.translation: The lord has been propitiated by you through the protracted Sattra. The fact that the lord is delighted has been indicated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord has been propitiated by you through the protracted Sattra. The fact that the lord is delighted has been indicated.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं मद्रूपचिन्ताद्यं नात्माद्यर्थसमाधयः । ममागमार्थविज्ञानं ज्ञानं नान्यार्थवेदनम्
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ madrūpacintādyaṃ nātmādyarthasamādhayaḥ | mamāgamārthavijñānaṃ jñānaṃ nānyārthavedanam
verses.translation: The refulgence in the air seen by you in Varanasi is the splendour of Mahesvara Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The refulgence in the air seen by you in Varanasi is the splendour of Mahesvara Lihga.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बाह्ये वाभ्यन्तरे वाथ यत्र स्यान्मनसो रतिः । प्राग्वासनावशाद्देवि तत्त्वनिष्ठां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: bāhye vābhyantare vātha yatra syānmanaso ratiḥ | prāgvāsanāvaśāddevi tattvaniṣṭhāṃ samācaret
verses.translation: The sages who were merged therein are those who had performed the Pasupata rites in accordance with the Vcdic injunctions. They have become liberated. Their sins have been washed in view of their stable piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages who were merged therein are those who had performed the Pasupata rites in accordance with the Vcdic injunctions. They have become liberated. Their sins have been washed in view of their stable piety.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यादाभ्यन्तरं श्रेष्ठं भवेच्छतगुणाधिकम् । असङ्करत्वाद्दोषाणां दृष्टानामप्यसम्भवात्
verses.transliteration: bāhyādābhyantaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavecchataguṇādhikam | asaṅkaratvāddoṣāṇāṃ dṛṣṭānāmapyasambhavāt
verses.translation: Just as they achieved salvation by means of Pasupata rite, so also, ere long, you too will achieve liberation. This fact is indicated by the splendour seen by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as they achieved salvation by means of Pasupata rite, so also, ere long, you too will achieve liberation. This fact is indicated by the splendour seen by you.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शौचमाभ्यन्तरं विद्यान्न बाह्यं शौचमुच्यते । अन्तः शौचविमुक्तात्मा शुचिरप्यशुचिर्यतः
verses.transliteration: śaucamābhyantaraṃ vidyānna bāhyaṃ śaucamucyate | antaḥ śaucavimuktātmā śucirapyaśuciryataḥ
verses.translation: Fortunately your time has come up now. You go to the southern summit ofMeru resorted to by the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fortunately your time has come up now. You go to the southern summit ofMeru resorted to by the gods.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यमाभ्यंर्तरं चैव भजनं भवपूर्वकम् । न भावरहितं देवि विप्रलम्भैककारणम्
verses.transliteration: bāhyamābhyaṃrtaraṃ caiva bhajanaṃ bhavapūrvakam | na bhāvarahitaṃ devi vipralambhaikakāraṇam
verses.translation: Formerly, on seeing Lord liva, Sanatkumara did not pay homage due to his ignorance or arrogance of being a Yogin or carelessness or lack of humility. Due.to this offence Nandin was infuriated and he made him a camel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, on seeing Lord liva, Sanatkumara did not pay homage due to his ignorance or arrogance of being a Yogin or carelessness or lack of humility. Due.to this offence Nandin was infuriated and he made him a camel.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्यस्य पूतस्य मम किं क्रियते नरैः । बहिर्वाभ्यन्तरं वाथ मया भावो हि गृह्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛtakṛtyasya pūtasya mama kiṃ kriyate naraiḥ | bahirvābhyantaraṃ vātha mayā bhāvo hi gṛhyate
verses.translation: I bewailed this for a long time. I worshipped the lord and the goddess and craved forgiveness. With great difficulty I atoned for his wickedness. Sanatkumara was restored to his previous form.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bewailed this for a long time. I worshipped the lord and the goddess and craved forgiveness. With great difficulty I atoned for his wickedness. Sanatkumara was restored to his previous form.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भावैकात्मा क्रिया देवि मम धर्मः सनातनः । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा ह्यनपेक्ष्य फलं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: bhāvaikātmā kriyā devi mama dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | manasā karmaṇā vācā hyanapekṣya phalaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the leader of the Bhutas was plea¬ sed to accept the behest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the leader of the Bhutas was plea¬ sed to accept the behest.

verses.sanskrit: फलोद्देशेन देवेशि लघुर्मम समाश्रयः । फलार्थी तदभावे मां परित्यक्तुं क्षमो यतः
verses.transliteration: phaloddeśena deveśi laghurmama samāśrayaḥ | phalārthī tadabhāve māṃ parityaktuṃ kṣamo yataḥ
verses.translation: He shall be seen by you all before the lord of the Ganas meets him. Ere long, Nandin will come there to delight him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be seen by you all before the lord of the Ganas meets him. Ere long, Nandin will come there to delight him.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: फलार्थिनोऽपि यस्यैव मयि चित्तं प्रतिष्ठितम् । भावानुरूपफलदस्तस्याप्यहमनिन्दिते
verses.transliteration: phalārthino'pi yasyaiva mayi cittaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | bhāvānurūpaphaladastasyāpyahamanindite
verses.translation: After bidding thus the Vivayogin sent the sages to Kumarasikhara,*®' the southern peak of Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bidding thus the Vivayogin sent the sages to Kumarasikhara,*®' the southern peak of Meru.

verses.sanskrit: फलानपेक्षया येषां मनो मत्प्रवणं भवेत् । प्रार्थयेयुः फलं पश्चाद्भक्तास्तेऽपि मम प्रियाः
verses.transliteration: phalānapekṣayā yeṣāṃ mano matpravaṇaṃ bhavet | prārthayeyuḥ phalaṃ paścādbhaktāste'pi mama priyāḥ
verses.translation: Ciystal slabs are neatly,fbted all around. The place abounds in blooming flowers in tiie seasons throughout.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ciystal slabs are neatly,fbted all around. The place abounds in blooming flowers in tiie seasons throughout.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक् संस्कारवशादेव ये विचिन्त्य फलाफले । विवशा मां प्रपद्यन्ते मम प्रियतमा मताः
verses.transliteration: prāk saṃskāravaśādeva ye vicintya phalāphale | vivaśā māṃ prapadyante mama priyatamā matāḥ
verses.translation: Not identified According to the context this hill can be placed to the south of mount Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not identified According to the context this hill can be placed to the south of mount Meru.

verses.sanskrit: मल्लाभान्न परो लाभस्तेषामस्ति यथातथम् । ममापि लाभस्तल्लाभान्नापरः परमेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: mallābhānna paro lābhasteṣāmasti yathātatham | mamāpi lābhastallābhānnāparaḥ parameśvari
verses.translation: Not identified
verses.commentary: Sense: Not identified

verses.sanskrit: मदनुग्रहतस्तेषां भावो मयि समर्पितः । फलं परमनिर्वाणं प्रयच्छति बलादिव
verses.transliteration: madanugrahatasteṣāṃ bhāvo mayi samarpitaḥ | phalaṃ paramanirvāṇaṃ prayacchati balādiva
verses.translation: Lilies, lotuses and other aquatic plants resemble the Stan. The waves are like clouds. The sky itself appears to have come to the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lilies, lotuses and other aquatic plants resemble the Stan. The waves are like clouds. The sky itself appears to have come to the earth.

verses.sanskrit: महात्मनामनन्यानां मयि संन्यस्तचेतसाम् । अष्टधा लक्षणं प्राहुर्मम धर्माधिकारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: mahātmanāmananyānāṃ mayi saṃnyastacetasām | aṣṭadhā lakṣaṇaṃ prāhurmama dharmādhikāriṇām
verses.translation: The steps that lead to it consist of blue stones and arc beautiful. People can ascend and descend comfortably. Through these the lake brightens all the eight quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The steps that lead to it consist of blue stones and arc beautiful. People can ascend and descend comfortably. Through these the lake brightens all the eight quarters.
verses.science: शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तजनवात्सल्यं पूजायां चानुमोदनम् । स्वयमभ्यर्चनं चैव मदर्थे चाङ्गचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: madbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ pūjāyāṃ cānumodanam | svayamabhyarcanaṃ caiva madarthe cāṅgaceṣṭitam
verses.translation: Some stand on rocks submerged in water as if avoiding, contact with the low-born people. They observe good conduct and their bodies are grey with Bhasma. They plunge into the water here and there. On the rock are seen the remnants of worship — gingelly seeds, raw rice-grains, flowers, Darbhas, Pavitras These indicate that the brahmins who come here for bath perform worship and Tarpanas to the gods, sages and the manes.

verses.sanskrit: मत्कथाश्रवणे भक्तिः स्वरनेत्राङ्गविक्रियाः । ममानुस्मरणं नित्यं यश्च मामुपजीवति
verses.transliteration: matkathāśravaṇe bhaktiḥ svaranetrāṅgavikriyāḥ | mamānusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ yaśca māmupajīvati
verses.translation: At places people perform worship on dry banks after performing Arghya to the sun as indicated by the scattered oblations and flowers. At places leaders of elephant herds are merging in and emerging out of water. At places the deer, the hind and die horses have come to quench thirst. At places peacocks and elephants are drinking water. At places oxen and hostile bulls are butting against the banks.
verses.wordMeaning: At places people perform worship on dry banks after performing Arghya to the sun as indicated by the scattered oblations and flowers. At places leaders of elephant herds are merging in and emerging out of water. At places the deer,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमष्टविधं चिह्नं यस्मिन् म्लेच्छेऽपि वर्तते । स विप्रेन्द्रो मुनिः श्रीमान् स यतिः स च पण्डितः
verses.transliteration: evamaṣṭavidhaṃ cihnaṃ yasmin mlecche'pi vartate | sa viprendro muniḥ śrīmān sa yatiḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: On the northern bank of the lake under the Kalpa tree, on a platform of adamantine rock, the sages from Naimia saw Sanatkumara seated on a soft deer-skin. He had just woken up from his trance. He was being worship¬ ped by the sages and the leading Yogins. On seeing him they bowed to him and stood in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: न मे प्रियश्चतुर्वेदी मद्भक्तो श्वपचोऽपि यः । तस्मै देयं ततो ग्राह्यं स च पूज्यो यथा ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: na me priyaścaturvedī madbhakto śvapaco'pi yaḥ | tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham
verses.translation: On being asked they told him the purpose of their visit. The tumultuous sound of Dundubhi was heard in the heaven immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked they told him the purpose of their visit. The tumultuous sound of Dundubhi was heard in the heaven immediately.

verses.sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati | tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
verses.translation: At the same time an aerial chariot brilliant as the sun was visible. All round, it was surrounded by leading Ganas, numerous and countless. It was thronged by the celestial damsels and surrounded by Rudra girls. Sounds of Mfdahga, lute and flute were heard. It had canopies set with gems of various colours. It shone with strings of pearls. It was encircled by sages, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Yakas, Caranas, Kinnaras dancing, or playing on instruments. A banner marked by the sign of a heroic bull was fluttering from a post set with corals. The aerial chariot had a gabled front.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
verses.translation: You and I have helped each other through this path. I have realised my desire. I shall go now. Let everything be auspicious to you always.
verses.commentary: Sense: You and I have helped each other through this path. I have realised my desire. I shall go now. Let everything be auspicious to you always.
